name: intervalListLength_singleton_eq_lengthAt
statement:
theorem intervalListLength_singleton_eq_lengthAt
    {iota : Type u} (l r : iota -> Point) (i : iota) :
    intervalListLength l r [i] = IntervalLengthAt l r i
proof:
:= by
  unfold intervalListLength
  change
    RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r i) RealTheory.zero =
      IntervalLengthAt l r i
  rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

name: intervalListOrdered_congr_on
proof:

name: intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_congr_on
statement:
private theorem intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_congr_on {iota : Type u}
    {l₁ r₁ l₂ r₂ : iota -> Point} :
    forall {js : List iota},
      (forall i : iota, List.Mem i js -> l₁ i = l₂ i) ->
        (forall i : iota, List.Mem i js -> r₁ i = r₂ i) ->
          IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint l₁ r₁ js ->
            IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint l₂ r₂ js
  | [], _hl, _hr, _hpair => by
      unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
      exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | i :: js, hl, hr, hpair => by
      unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint at hpair
      cases hpair with
      | cons hhead htail =>
          unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
          apply List.Pairwise.cons
          · intro j hj x hx hy
            apply hhead j hj x
            · unfold IntervalAt
              rw [hl i (List.Mem.head js), hr i (List.Mem.head js)]
              exact hx
            · unfold IntervalAt
              rw [hl j (List.Mem.tail i hj), hr j (List.Mem.tail i hj)]
              exact hy
          · apply intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_congr_on
            · intro j hj
              exact hl j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
            · intro j hj
              exact hr j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
            · exact htail

/
agree on the listed indices. -/

name: finiteDisjointSubfamily_congr_on
proof:
:=
  And.intro hfinite.left
    (intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_congr_on hl hr hfinite.right)

name: intervalListLength_congr_on
statement:
theorem intervalListLength_congr_on {iota : Type u}
    {l₁ r₁ l₂ r₂ : iota -> Point} :
    forall (js : List iota),
      (forall i : iota, List.Mem i js -> l₁ i = l₂ i) ->
        (forall i : iota, List.Mem i js -> r₁ i = r₂ i) ->
          intervalListLength l₁ r₁ js = intervalListLength l₂ r₂ js
  | [], _hl, _hr => rfl
  | i :: js, hl, hr => by
      unfold intervalListLength
      have hhead :
          IntervalLengthAt l₁ r₁ i = IntervalLengthAt l₂ r₂ i
proof:
:= by
        unfold IntervalLengthAt
        rw [hl i (List.Mem.head js), hr i (List.Mem.head js)]
      have htail :
          intervalListLength l₁ r₁ js =
            intervalListLength l₂ r₂ js :=
        intervalListLength_congr_on js
          (fun j hj => hl j (List.Mem.tail i hj))
          (fun j hj => hr j (List.Mem.tail i hj))
      rw [hhead, htail]

name: exists_intervalLongestCandidate_nonempty
statement:
private theorem exists_intervalLongestCandidate_nonempty {iota : Type u}
    {l r : iota -> Point} :
    forall {js : List iota},
      Exists (fun i : iota => List.Mem i js) ->
        Exists (fun j : iota => IntervalLongestCandidate l r js j)
  | [], hnonempty => by
      match hnonempty with
      | Exists.intro _ hmem => cases hmem
  | head :: tail, _hnonempty => by
      cases tail with
      | nil =>
          refine Exists.intro head ?_
          unfold IntervalLongestCandidate
          refine And.intro (List.Mem.head _) ?_
          intro i hmem
          cases hmem with
          | head =>
              exact RealTheory.le_refl (IntervalLengthAt l r head)
          | tail _ htail =>
              cases htail
      | cons a rest =>
          have htail_nonempty :
              Exists (fun i : iota => List.Mem i (a :: rest))
proof:
:=
            Exists.intro a (List.Mem.head _)
          match exists_intervalLongestCandidate_nonempty
              (l := l) (r := r) htail_nonempty with
          | Exists.intro k hk =>
              cases
                RealTheory.le_total
                  (IntervalLengthAt l r head)
                  (IntervalLengthAt l r k) with
              | inl hhead_le_k =>
                  refine Exists.intro k ?_
                  unfold IntervalLongestCandidate at hk
                  unfold IntervalLongestCandidate
                  refine And.intro (List.Mem.tail _ hk.left) ?_
                  intro i hmem
                  cases hmem with
                  | head =>
                      exact hhead_le_k
                  | tail _ htailmem =>
                      exact hk.right i htailmem
              | inr hk_le_head =>
                  refine Exists.intro head ?_
                  unfold IntervalLongestCandidate at hk
                  unfold IntervalLongestCandidate
                  refine And.intro (List.Mem.head _) ?_
                  intro i hmem
                  cases hmem with
                  | head =>
                      exact RealTheory.le_refl (IntervalLengthAt l r head)
                  | tail _ htailmem =>
                      exact
                        RealTheory.le_trans
                          (hk.right i htailmem)
                          hk_le_head

name: exists_intervalLongestCandidate_of_mem
proof:
:=
  exists_intervalLongestCandidate_nonempty
    (Exists.intro i hmem)

name: intervalLongestIndex_spec
proof:
:= by
  unfold intervalLongestIndex at h
  by_cases hmax :
      Exists (fun k : iota => IntervalLongestCandidate l r js k)
  · simp [hmax] at h
    cases h
    exact Classical.choose_spec hmax
  · simp [hmax] at h

name: intervalLongestIndex_mem
proof:
:=
  (intervalLongestIndex_spec h).left

name: intervalLongestIndex_length_max
proof:
:=
  (intervalLongestIndex_spec h).right i hmem

name: exists_intervalLongestIndex_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmax : Exists (fun j : iota =>
      IntervalLongestCandidate l r js j) :=
    exists_intervalLongestCandidate_of_mem hmem
  refine Exists.intro (Classical.choose hmax) ?_
  constructor
  · unfold intervalLongestIndex
    simp [hmax]
  · exact Classical.choose_spec hmax

name: exists_intervalMinRightCandidate_nonempty
statement:
private theorem exists_intervalMinRightCandidate_nonempty {iota : Type u}
    {r : iota -> Point} :
    forall {js : List iota},
      Exists (fun i : iota => List.Mem i js) ->
        Exists (fun j : iota => IntervalMinRightCandidate r js j)
  | [], hnonempty => by
      match hnonempty with
      | Exists.intro _ hmem => cases hmem
  | head :: tail, _hnonempty => by
      cases tail with
      | nil =>
          refine Exists.intro head ?_
          unfold IntervalMinRightCandidate
          refine And.intro (List.Mem.head _) ?_
          intro i hmem
          cases hmem with
          | head =>
              exact RealTheory.le_refl (r head)
          | tail _ htail =>
              cases htail
      | cons a rest =>
          have htail_nonempty :
              Exists (fun i : iota => List.Mem i (a :: rest))
proof:
:=
            Exists.intro a (List.Mem.head _)
          match exists_intervalMinRightCandidate_nonempty
              (r := r) htail_nonempty with
          | Exists.intro k hk =>
              cases RealTheory.le_total (r head) (r k) with
              | inl hhead_le_k =>
                  refine Exists.intro head ?_
                  unfold IntervalMinRightCandidate at hk
                  unfold IntervalMinRightCandidate
                  refine And.intro (List.Mem.head _) ?_
                  intro i hmem
                  cases hmem with
                  | head =>
                      exact RealTheory.le_refl (r head)
                  | tail _ htailmem =>
                      exact RealTheory.le_trans hhead_le_k
                        (hk.right i htailmem)
              | inr hk_le_head =>
                  refine Exists.intro k ?_
                  unfold IntervalMinRightCandidate at hk
                  unfold IntervalMinRightCandidate
                  refine And.intro (List.Mem.tail _ hk.left) ?_
                  intro i hmem
                  cases hmem with
                  | head =>
                      exact hk_le_head
                  | tail _ htailmem =>
                      exact hk.right i htailmem

name: exists_intervalMinRightCandidate_of_mem
proof:
:=
  exists_intervalMinRightCandidate_nonempty
    (Exists.intro i hmem)

name: intervalMidpoint_mem_of_open
proof:
:= by
  unfold intervalMidpoint
  unfold IntervalAt
  exact
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hopen)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hopen)

name: intervalOverlap_of_crossing_open
statement:
private theorem intervalOverlap_of_crossing_open {iota : Type u}
    {l r : iota -> Point} {i j : iota}
    (hi : RealTheory.lt (l i) (r i))
    (hj : RealTheory.lt (l j) (r j))
    (hij : RealTheory.lt (l i) (r j))
    (hji : RealTheory.lt (l j) (r i)) :
    IntervalOverlap l r i j
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.le_total (l i) (l j) with
  | inl hli_lj =>
      cases RealTheory.le_total (r i) (r j) with
      | inl hri_rj =>
          refine
            Exists.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F (l j) (r i)) ?_
          unfold IntervalAt
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · exact
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                  F hli_lj
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hji)
            · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hji
          · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hji
            · exact
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hji)
                  hri_rj
      | inr hrj_ri =>
          refine
            Exists.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F (l j) (r j)) ?_
          unfold IntervalAt
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · exact
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                  F hli_lj
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hj)
            · exact
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hj)
                  hrj_ri
          · exact
              And.intro
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hj)
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hj)
  | inr hlj_li =>
      cases RealTheory.le_total (r i) (r j) with
      | inl hri_rj =>
          refine
            Exists.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F (l i) (r i)) ?_
          unfold IntervalAt
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact
              And.intro
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hi)
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hi)
          · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · exact
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                  F hlj_li
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hi)
            · exact
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hi)
                  hri_rj
      | inr hrj_ri =>
          refine
            Exists.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F (l i) (r j)) ?_
          unfold IntervalAt
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hij
            · exact
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hij)
                  hrj_ri
          · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · exact
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                  F hlj_li
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hij)
            · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hij

name: interval_left_or_right_of_disjoint_open
statement:
private theorem interval_left_or_right_of_disjoint_open {iota : Type u}
    {l r : iota -> Point} {i j : iota}
    (hi : RealTheory.lt (l i) (r i))
    (hj : RealTheory.lt (l j) (r j))
    (hdisj :
      SetPred.Disjoint (IntervalAt l r i) (IntervalAt l r j)) :
    Or (RealTheory.le (r i) (l j)) (RealTheory.le (r j) (l i))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hleft : RealTheory.le (r i) (l j)
  · exact Or.inl hleft
  · refine Or.inr ?_
    have hji : RealTheory.lt (l j) (r i) := by
      cases RealTheory.le_total (l j) (r i) with
      | inl hle =>
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hle hleft
      | inr hle =>
          exact False.elim (hleft hle)
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F
    intro hij
    have hoverlap : IntervalOverlap l r i j :=
      intervalOverlap_of_crossing_open hi hj hij hji
    match hoverlap with
    | Exists.intro x hx =>
        exact hdisj x hx.left hx.right

name: setDisjoint_symm
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxB hxA
  exact h x hxA hxB

name: intervalDisjoint_selected_remove_middle
proof:
:= by
  unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint at hpair
  induction pre with
  | nil =>
      have htail := List.Pairwise.tail hpair
      cases hpair with
      | cons hrel _ =>
          exact hrel k hk
  | cons a pre ih =>
      cases hpair with
      | cons hrel htail =>
          cases hk with
          | head =>
              have hhead_selected :=
                hrel selected
                  (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr (List.Mem.head post)))
              exact setDisjoint_symm hhead_selected
          | tail _ hkTail =>
              exact ih hkTail htail

name: rightEndpoint_le_left_of_minRight_remove_middle
statement:
private theorem rightEndpoint_le_left_of_minRight_remove_middle
    {iota : Type u}
    {l r : iota -> Point} {selected k : iota}
    {pre post : List iota}
    (hmin :
      IntervalMinRightCandidate r (pre ++ selected :: post) selected)
    (hordered : IntervalListOrdered l r (pre ++ selected :: post))
    (hpair :
      IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint l r (pre ++ selected :: post))
    (hselected_pos : RealTheory.lt (l selected) (r selected))
    (hk : List.Mem k (pre ++ post)) :
    RealTheory.le (r selected) (l k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hkOld : List.Mem k (pre ++ selected :: post) := by
    have hkSplit := List.mem_append.mp hk
    cases hkSplit with
    | inl hkPre =>
        exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hkPre)
    | inr hkPost =>
        exact
          List.mem_append.mpr
            (Or.inr (List.Mem.tail selected hkPost))
  have hmin_k : RealTheory.le (r selected) (r k) :=
    hmin.right k hkOld
  have hk_ordered : RealTheory.le (l k) (r k) :=
    hordered k hkOld
  by_cases hk_pos : RealTheory.lt (l k) (r k)
  · have hdisj :
        SetPred.Disjoint (IntervalAt l r selected) (IntervalAt l r k) :=
      intervalDisjoint_selected_remove_middle hk hpair
    have hsep :
        Or (RealTheory.le (r selected) (l k))
          (RealTheory.le (r k) (l selected)) :=
      interval_left_or_right_of_disjoint_open
        hselected_pos hk_pos hdisj
    cases hsep with
    | inl hright =>
        exact hright
    | inr hleft =>
        have hbad : RealTheory.le (r selected) (l selected) :=
          RealTheory.le_trans hmin_k hleft
        exact False.elim
          ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hselected_pos) hbad)
  · have hr_le_l : RealTheory.le (r k) (l k) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hk_pos
    have hr_eq_l : r k = l k :=
      RealTheory.le_antisymm hr_le_l hk_ordered
    rw [hr_eq_l] at hmin_k
    exact hmin_k

name: intervalOverlap_self_of_open
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro (intervalMidpoint l r i) ?_
  have hmid : IntervalAt l r i (intervalMidpoint l r i) :=
    intervalMidpoint_mem_of_open hopen
  exact And.intro hmid hmid

name: controlsKeptAfterSelection_mem
proof:

name: controlsKeptAfterSelection_mem_of

name: controlsKeptAfterSelection_length_lt
proof:
:= by
  unfold controlsKeptAfterSelection
  classical
  let p : iota -> Bool :=
    fun i : iota => decide (IntervalDisjointFromSelection l r selected i)
  have hle :
      (List.filter p controls).length <= controls.length :=
    List.length_filter_le p controls
  have hne :
      Not ((List.filter p controls).length = controls.length) := by
    intro heq
    have hall :
        forall i : iota, List.Mem i controls -> p i = true :=
      (List.length_filter_eq_length_iff.mp heq)
    have hdec : p selected = true := hall selected hselected
    have hdisj : IntervalDisjointFromSelection l r selected selected :=
      of_decide_eq_true hdec
    have hoverlap :
        IntervalOverlap l r selected selected :=
      intervalOverlap_self_of_open (hopen selected hselected)
    match hoverlap with
    | Exists.intro x hx =>
        unfold IntervalDisjointFromSelection at hdisj
        exact hdisj x hx.left hx.right
  exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne

name: intervalLeft_add_lengthAt
proof:
:= by
  unfold IntervalLengthAt
  calc
    RealTheory.add (l i) (RealTheory.sub (r i) (l i)) =
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub (r i) (l i)) (l i) := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_comm]
    _ = r i :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (r i) (l i)

name: intervalContainedInTriple_of_overlap_length_le
statement:
private theorem intervalContainedInTriple_of_overlap_length_le {iota : Type u}
    {l r : iota -> Point} {i selected : iota}
    (hoverlap : IntervalOverlap l r i selected)
    (hlen :
      RealTheory.le (IntervalLengthAt l r i)
        (IntervalLengthAt l r selected)) :
    IntervalContainedInTriple l r i selected
proof:
:= by
  match hoverlap with
  | Exists.intro y hy =>
      intro x hx
      unfold IntervalTripleAt
      constructor
      · unfold intervalTripleLeft
        have hselected_left_lt_ri :
            RealTheory.lt (l selected) (r i) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            hy.right.left hy.left.right
        have hselected_left_lt_li_add_leni :
            RealTheory.lt (l selected)
              (RealTheory.add (l i) (IntervalLengthAt l r i)) := by
          rw [intervalLeft_add_lengthAt l r i]
          exact hselected_left_lt_ri
        have hselected_sub_li_lt_leni :
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.sub (l selected) (l i))
              (IntervalLengthAt l r i) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            hselected_left_lt_li_add_leni
        have hselected_sub_li_lt_lenselected :
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.sub (l selected) (l i))
              (IntervalLengthAt l r selected) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            hselected_sub_li_lt_leni hlen
        have htriple_left_lt_li :
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.sub (l selected)
                (IntervalLengthAt l r selected))
              (l i) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            hselected_sub_li_lt_lenselected
        exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            htriple_left_lt_li hx.left
      · unfold intervalTripleRight
        have hli_lt_selected_right :
            RealTheory.lt (l i) (r selected) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            hy.left.left hy.right.right
        have hli_add_leni_le_hli_add_lenselected :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.add (l i) (IntervalLengthAt l r i))
              (RealTheory.add (l i)
                (IntervalLengthAt l r selected)) :=
          RealTheory.add_le_add_left hlen (l i)
        have hri_le_li_add_lenselected :
            RealTheory.le (r i)
              (RealTheory.add (l i)
                (IntervalLengthAt l r selected)) := by
          rw [<- intervalLeft_add_lengthAt l r i]
          exact hli_add_leni_le_hli_add_lenselected
        have hli_add_lenselected_lt_rselected_add_lenselected :
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.add (l i)
                (IntervalLengthAt l r selected))
              (RealTheory.add (r selected)
                (IntervalLengthAt l r selected)) :=
          RealTheory.add_lt_add_right
            hli_lt_selected_right
            (IntervalLengthAt l r selected)
        have hri_le_rselected_add_lenselected :
            RealTheory.le (r i)
              (RealTheory.add (r selected)
                (IntervalLengthAt l r selected)) :=
          RealTheory.le_trans
            hri_le_li_add_lenselected
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              hli_add_lenselected_lt_rselected_add_lenselected)
        exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            hx.right hri_le_rselected_add_lenselected

name: three_mul_as_sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealTheory.nat_succ 2]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_succ 1]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
  change
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one)
          RealTheory.one) x =
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x x) x
  rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.one_mul]

name: add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub_real
statement:
private theorem add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub_real
    (x y a b : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add x y) (RealTheory.add a b) =
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub x a) (RealTheory.sub y b)
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y a b

name: intervalTripleLengthAt_eq_three_mul
statement:
private theorem intervalTripleLengthAt_eq_three_mul {iota : Type u}
    (l r : iota -> Point) (i : iota) :
    IntervalLengthAt (intervalTripleLeft l r) (intervalTripleRight l r) i =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) (IntervalLengthAt l r i)
proof:
:= by
  let d := IntervalLengthAt l r i
  change
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add (r i) d)
        (RealTheory.sub (l i) d) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) d
  rw [three_mul_as_sum]
  rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg (l i) d]
  rw [add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub_real
    (r i) d (l i) (RealTheory.neg d)]
  have hd : RealTheory.sub (r i) (l i) = d := by
    unfold d
    unfold IntervalLengthAt
    rfl
  rw [hd]
  rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg d (RealTheory.neg d)]
  rw [RealTheory.neg_neg]
  rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc d d d]

name: intervalTripleListLength_eq_three_mul
statement:
theorem intervalTripleListLength_eq_three_mul {iota : Type u}
    (l r : iota -> Point) :
    forall js : List iota,
      intervalListLength (intervalTripleLeft l r)
          (intervalTripleRight l r) js =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) (intervalListLength l r js)
  | [] => by
      unfold intervalListLength
      rw [RealTheory.mul_zero]
  | i :: js => by
      change
        RealTheory.add
            (IntervalLengthAt (intervalTripleLeft l r)
              (intervalTripleRight l r) i)
            (intervalListLength (intervalTripleLeft l r)
              (intervalTripleRight l r) js) =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
            (RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r i)
              (intervalListLength l r js))
      rw [intervalTripleLengthAt_eq_three_mul l r i]
      rw [intervalTripleListLength_eq_three_mul l r js]
      rw [RealTheory.mul_add]

private theorem intervalTripleOpen_of_open {iota : Type u}
    {l r : iota -> Point} {i : iota}
    (hopen : RealTheory.lt (l i) (r i)) :
    RealTheory.lt (intervalTripleLeft l r i)
      (intervalTripleRight l r i)
proof:
:= by
  let d := IntervalLengthAt l r i
  have hd : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero d := by
    unfold d
    unfold IntervalLengthAt
    exact
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hopen
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.lt (intervalTripleLeft l r i) (l i) := by
    unfold intervalTripleLeft
    change RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub (l i) d) (l i)
    exact
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hd
  have hrightStep :
      RealTheory.lt (r i) (RealTheory.add (r i) d) := by
    have h :=
      RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hd (r i)
    change
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add (r i) RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add (r i) d) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
  have hright :
      RealTheory.lt (l i) (intervalTripleRight l r i) := by
    unfold intervalTripleRight
    change RealTheory.lt (l i) (RealTheory.add (r i) d)
    exact
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hopen hrightStep
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hleft hright

proof:

name: greedyIntervalSelectionWithFuel_triple_covers_controls
statement:
private theorem greedyIntervalSelectionWithFuel_triple_covers_controls
    {iota : Type u} {l r : iota -> Point} :
    forall fuel : Nat,
      forall controls : List iota,
        IntervalListOpen l r controls ->
          controls.length <= fuel ->
            forall i : iota,
              List.Mem i controls ->
                Exists (fun j : iota =>
                  And
                    (List.Mem j
                      (greedyIntervalSelectionWithFuel l r fuel controls))
                    (IntervalContainedInTriple l r i j))
  | 0, controls, _hopen, hfuel, i, hmem => by
      cases controls with
      | nil =>
          cases hmem
      | cons head tail =>
          cases hfuel
  | Nat.succ fuel, controls, hopen, hfuel, i, hmem => by
      unfold greedyIntervalSelectionWithFuel
      cases hlong : intervalLongestIndex l r controls with
      | none =>
          match exists_intervalLongestIndex_of_mem
              (l := l) (r := r) hmem with
          | Exists.intro selected hselected =>
              have hsome
proof:
:= hselected.left
              rw [hlong] at hsome
              cases hsome
      | some selected =>
          let kept := controlsKeptAfterSelection l r selected controls
          by_cases hkept : List.Mem i kept
          · have hselected_mem : List.Mem selected controls :=
              intervalLongestIndex_mem hlong
            have hkept_len_lt :
                kept.length < controls.length :=
              controlsKeptAfterSelection_length_lt
                hopen hselected_mem
            have hkept_len_le_fuel : kept.length <= fuel := by
              exact
                Nat.le_of_lt_succ
                  (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hkept_len_lt hfuel)
            have hopen_kept : IntervalListOpen l r kept :=
              intervalListOpen_keptAfterSelection hopen
            match
              greedyIntervalSelectionWithFuel_triple_covers_controls
                fuel kept hopen_kept hkept_len_le_fuel i hkept with
            | Exists.intro j hj =>
                refine Exists.intro j ?_
                exact And.intro (List.Mem.tail _ hj.left) hj.right
          · have hselected_mem : List.Mem selected controls :=
              intervalLongestIndex_mem hlong
            have hlen :
                RealTheory.le (IntervalLengthAt l r i)
                  (IntervalLengthAt l r selected) :=
              intervalLongestIndex_length_max hlong hmem
            have hoverlap : IntervalOverlap l r i selected := by
              classical
              exact
                Classical.byContradiction
                  (fun hno_overlap => by
                    have hdisj :
                        IntervalDisjointFromSelection l r selected i := by
                      unfold IntervalDisjointFromSelection
                      intro x hxselected hxi
                      exact
                        hno_overlap
                          (Exists.intro x (And.intro hxi hxselected))
                    have hkept' : List.Mem i kept :=
                      controlsKeptAfterSelection_mem_of hmem hdisj
                    exact hkept hkept')
            refine Exists.intro selected ?_
            exact
              And.intro (List.Mem.head _)
                (intervalContainedInTriple_of_overlap_length_le
                  hoverlap hlen)

name: intervalListLength_nonnegative_of_ordered
statement:
private theorem intervalListLength_nonnegative_of_ordered {iota : Type u}
    {l r : iota -> Point} :
    forall {js : List iota},
      IntervalListOrdered l r js ->
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (intervalListLength l r js)
  | [], _hordered => by
      unfold intervalListLength
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  | i :: js, hordered => by
      unfold intervalListLength
      have hhead :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (IntervalLengthAt l r i)
proof:
:=
        intervalLengthAt_nonnegative_of_le
          (hordered i (List.Mem.head _))
      have htail_ordered : IntervalListOrdered l r js := by
        intro j hj
        exact hordered j (List.Mem.tail _ hj)
      have htail :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (intervalListLength l r js) :=
        intervalListLength_nonnegative_of_ordered htail_ordered
      have hsum :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)
            (RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r i)
              (intervalListLength l r js)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hhead htail
      rwa [RealTheory.zero_add] at hsum

name: intervalListLength_append

name: listNodup_remove_middle
statement:
private theorem listNodup_remove_middle {alpha : Type u}
    (x : alpha) :
    forall (pre post : List alpha),
      List.Nodup (pre ++ x :: post) ->
        List.Nodup (pre ++ post)
  | [], post, hnodup => by
      exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).right
  | head :: pre, post, hnodup => by
      apply List.nodup_cons.mpr
      have htailNodup :
          List.Nodup (pre ++ x :: post)
proof:
:=
        (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).right
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · intro hmem
        have hmemOld :
            List.Mem head (pre ++ x :: post) :=
          listMembersIn_remove_middle x pre post head hmem
        exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).left hmemOld
      · exact listNodup_remove_middle x pre post htailNodup

private theorem listPairwise_remove_middle {alpha : Type u}

        List.Pairwise R (pre ++ post)
  | [], post, hpair => by
      exact List.Pairwise.tail hpair
  | head :: pre, post, hpair => by
      apply List.Pairwise.cons
      · intro z hz
        have hzOld :
            List.Mem z (pre ++ x :: post)
proof:
:=
          listMembersIn_remove_middle x pre post z hz
        cases hpair with
        | cons hrel _htail =>
            exact hrel z hzOld
      · cases hpair with
        | cons _hrel htail =>
            exact listPairwise_remove_middle x pre post htail

name: intervalListLength_insert_split
statement:
private theorem intervalListLength_insert_split {iota : Type u}
    (l r : iota -> Point) (pre post : List iota) (x : iota) :
    intervalListLength l r (pre ++ x :: post) =
      RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r x)
        (intervalListLength l r (pre ++ post))
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalListLength_append l r pre (x :: post)]
  rw [intervalListLength_append l r pre post]
  change
    RealTheory.add (intervalListLength l r pre)
        (RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r x)
          (intervalListLength l r post)) =
      RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r x)
        (RealTheory.add (intervalListLength l r pre)
          (intervalListLength l r post))
  calc
    RealTheory.add (intervalListLength l r pre)
        (RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r x)
          (intervalListLength l r post)) =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add (intervalListLength l r pre)
            (IntervalLengthAt l r x))
          (intervalListLength l r post) := by
          rw [← RealTheory.add_assoc]
    _ = RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r x)
            (intervalListLength l r pre))
          (intervalListLength l r post) := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_comm (intervalListLength l r pre)
            (IntervalLengthAt l r x)]
    _ = RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r x)
          (RealTheory.add (intervalListLength l r pre)
            (intervalListLength l r post)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]

name: add_left_segment_tail_le_span
statement:
private theorem add_left_segment_tail_le_span
    {u left right v : Point}
    (hu_left : RealTheory.le u left) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub right left)
        (RealTheory.sub v right))
      (RealTheory.sub v u)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub right left)
          (RealTheory.sub v right) =
        RealTheory.sub v left := by
    calc
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub right left)
          (RealTheory.sub v right) =
          RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub v right)
            (RealTheory.sub right left) := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_comm]
      _ = RealTheory.sub v left :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base v right left
  rw [hsum]
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (RealTheory.le_refl v) hu_left

name: exists_intervalListHeadDecomposition_of_ordered_disjoint
statement:
theorem exists_intervalListHeadDecomposition_of_ordered_disjoint
    {iota : Type u} {l r : iota -> Point} {sources : List iota}
    (hne : Exists (fun i : iota => List.Mem i sources))
    (hordered : IntervalListOrdered l r sources)
    (hfinite : FiniteDisjointSubfamily l r sources) :
    Exists (fun j : iota =>
      Exists (fun rest : List iota =>
        And (List.Perm sources (j :: rest))
          (And (IntervalListOrdered l r rest)
            (And (FiniteDisjointSubfamily l r rest)
              (Or (l j = r j)
                (forall i : iota, List.Mem i rest ->
                  RealTheory.le (r j) (l i)))))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmoveToHead :
      forall (pre post : List iota) (selected : iota),
        List.Perm (pre ++ selected :: post)
          (selected :: (pre ++ post)) := by
    intro pre
    induction pre with
    | nil =>
        intro post selected
        exact List.Perm.refl (selected :: post)
    | cons head pre ih =>
        intro post selected
        exact
          List.Perm.trans
            (List.Perm.cons head (ih post selected))
            (List.Perm.swap selected head (pre ++ post))
  match exists_intervalMinRightCandidate_nonempty (r := r) hne with
  | Exists.intro selected hmin =>
      match List.mem_iff_append.mp hmin.left with
      | Exists.intro pre hpre =>
          match hpre with
          | Exists.intro post hdecomp =>
              rw [hdecomp] at hordered hfinite hmin
              have hmembersRest :
                  ListMembersIn (pre ++ post)
                    (pre ++ selected :: post) :=
                listMembersIn_remove_middle selected pre post
              have horderedRest :
                  IntervalListOrdered l r (pre ++ post) := by
                intro i hi
                exact hordered i (hmembersRest i hi)
              have hfiniteRest :
                  FiniteDisjointSubfamily l r (pre ++ post) := by
                refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                · exact
                    listNodup_remove_middle selected pre post hfinite.left
                · have hpair := hfinite.right
                  unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint at hpair
                  unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
                  exact
                    listPairwise_remove_middle selected pre post hpair
              have hselectedMem :
                  List.Mem selected (pre ++ selected :: post) :=
                List.mem_append.mpr
                  (Or.inr (List.Mem.head post))
              have hhead :
                  Or (l selected = r selected)
                    (forall i : iota, List.Mem i (pre ++ post) ->
                      RealTheory.le (r selected) (l i)) := by
                by_cases hselectedPos :
                    RealTheory.lt (l selected) (r selected)
                · exact Or.inr (fun i hi =>
                    rightEndpoint_le_left_of_minRight_remove_middle
                      hmin hordered hfinite.right hselectedPos hi)
                · have hselectedOrdered :
                      RealTheory.le (l selected) (r selected) :=
                    hordered selected hselectedMem
                  have hreverse :
                      RealTheory.le (r selected) (l selected) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt
                      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hselectedPos
                  exact Or.inl
                    (RealTheory.le_antisymm hselectedOrdered hreverse)
              refine Exists.intro selected ?_
              refine Exists.intro (pre ++ post) ?_
              refine And.intro ?_ ?_
              · rw [hdecomp]
                exact hmoveToHead pre post selected
              · exact
                  And.intro horderedRest
                    (And.intro hfiniteRest hhead)

name: intervalListLength_le_of_disjoint_closedBounds
statement:
private theorem intervalListLength_le_of_disjoint_closedBounds
    {source : Type u} {sourceL sourceR : source -> Point}
    (sources : List source) (u v : Point)
    (huv : RealTheory.le u v)
    (hordered : IntervalListOrdered sourceL sourceR sources)
    (hfinite : FiniteDisjointSubfamily sourceL sourceR sources)
    (hbounds :
      forall i : source,
        List.Mem i sources ->
          And (RealTheory.le u (sourceL i))
            (RealTheory.le (sourceR i) v)) :
    RealTheory.le (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR sources)
      (RealTheory.sub v u)
proof:
:= by
  have hmain :
      forall n : Nat,
        forall sources : List source,
          sources.length = n ->
            forall u v : Point,
              RealTheory.le u v ->
                IntervalListOrdered sourceL sourceR sources ->
                  FiniteDisjointSubfamily sourceL sourceR sources ->
                    (forall i : source,
                      List.Mem i sources ->
                        And (RealTheory.le u (sourceL i))
                          (RealTheory.le (sourceR i) v)) ->
                      RealTheory.le
                        (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR sources)
                        (RealTheory.sub v u) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro sources hlen u v huv hordered hfinite hbounds
        cases sources with
        | nil =>
            change RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub v u)
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base huv
        | cons head tail =>
            cases hlen
    | succ n ih =>
        intro sources hlen u v huv hordered hfinite hbounds
        cases sources with
        | nil =>
            change RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub v u)
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base huv
        | cons head tail =>
            have hheadMem : List.Mem head (head :: tail) :=
              List.Mem.head _
            match exists_intervalMinRightCandidate_of_mem
                (r := sourceR) hheadMem with
            | Exists.intro selected hmin =>
                match List.mem_iff_append.mp hmin.left with
                | Exists.intro pre hpre =>
                    match hpre with
                    | Exists.intro post hdecomp =>
                        rw [hdecomp] at hlen hordered hfinite hbounds hmin
                        have hmembersRest :
                            ListMembersIn (pre ++ post)
                              (pre ++ selected :: post) :=
                          listMembersIn_remove_middle selected pre post
                        have hlenRest : (pre ++ post).length = n := by
                          simp [List.length_append] at hlen ⊢
                          omega
                        have horderedRest :
                            IntervalListOrdered sourceL sourceR
                              (pre ++ post) := by
                          intro i hi
                          exact hordered i (hmembersRest i hi)
                        have hfiniteRest :
                            FiniteDisjointSubfamily sourceL sourceR
                              (pre ++ post) := by
                          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                          · exact
                              listNodup_remove_middle selected pre post
                                hfinite.left
                          · have hpair := hfinite.right
                            unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint at hpair
                            unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
                            exact
                              listPairwise_remove_middle selected pre post
                                hpair
                        have hselectedMem :
                            List.Mem selected (pre ++ selected :: post) :=
                          List.mem_append.mpr
                            (Or.inr (List.Mem.head post))
                        by_cases hselectedPos :
                            RealTheory.lt (sourceL selected)
                              (sourceR selected)
                        · have htailBounds :
                              forall i : source,
                                List.Mem i (pre ++ post) ->
                                  And
                                    (RealTheory.le (sourceR selected)
                                      (sourceL i))
                                    (RealTheory.le (sourceR i) v) := by
                            intro i hi
                            have hiOld : List.Mem i
                                (pre ++ selected :: post) :=
                              hmembersRest i hi
                            exact
                              And.intro
                                (rightEndpoint_le_left_of_minRight_remove_middle
                                  hmin hordered hfinite.right
                                  hselectedPos hi)
                                ((hbounds i hiOld).right)
                          have htailOuter :
                              RealTheory.le (sourceR selected) v :=
                            (hbounds selected hselectedMem).right
                          have htail :
                              RealTheory.le
                                (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR
                                  (pre ++ post))
                                (RealTheory.sub v (sourceR selected)) :=
                            ih (pre ++ post) hlenRest
                              (sourceR selected) v htailOuter
                              horderedRest hfiniteRest htailBounds
                          have hsum :
                              RealTheory.le
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (IntervalLengthAt sourceL sourceR selected)
                                  (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR
                                    (pre ++ post)))
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (IntervalLengthAt sourceL sourceR selected)
                                  (RealTheory.sub v
                                    (sourceR selected))) :=
                            RealTheory.add_le_add_left htail
                              (IntervalLengthAt sourceL sourceR selected)
                          have hspan :
                              RealTheory.le
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (IntervalLengthAt sourceL sourceR selected)
                                  (RealTheory.sub v (sourceR selected)))
                                (RealTheory.sub v u) := by
                            unfold IntervalLengthAt
                            exact
                              add_left_segment_tail_le_span
                                (u := u)
                                (left := sourceL selected)
                                (right := sourceR selected)
                                (v := v)
                                ((hbounds selected hselectedMem).left)
                          rw [hdecomp]
                          rw [intervalListLength_insert_split
                            sourceL sourceR pre post selected]
                          exact RealTheory.le_trans hsum hspan
                        · have hselectedOrdered :
                              RealTheory.le (sourceL selected)
                                (sourceR selected) :=
                            hordered selected hselectedMem
                          have hzero :
                              IntervalLengthAt sourceL sourceR selected =
                                RealTheory.zero :=
                            intervalLengthAt_eq_zero_of_ordered_not_lt
                              hselectedOrdered hselectedPos
                          have htailBounds :
                              forall i : source,
                                List.Mem i (pre ++ post) ->
                                  And (RealTheory.le u (sourceL i))
                                    (RealTheory.le (sourceR i) v) := by
                            intro i hi
                            exact hbounds i (hmembersRest i hi)
                          have htail :
                              RealTheory.le
                                (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR
                                  (pre ++ post))
                                (RealTheory.sub v u) :=
                            ih (pre ++ post) hlenRest
                              u v huv horderedRest hfiniteRest htailBounds
                          rw [hdecomp]
                          rw [intervalListLength_insert_split
                            sourceL sourceR pre post selected]
                          rw [hzero, RealTheory.zero_add]
                          exact htail
  exact hmain sources.length sources rfl u v huv hordered hfinite hbounds

name: intervalImage_disjoint_of_monotone
statement:
private theorem intervalImage_disjoint_of_monotone
    {H : Point -> Point} {u v li ri lj rj : Point}
    (hmono :
      forall x y : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v x ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v y ->
            RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (H x) (H y))
    (hli : RealTheory.le li ri)
    (hlj : RealTheory.le lj rj)
    (hbi : And (RealTheory.le u li) (RealTheory.le ri v))
    (hbj : And (RealTheory.le u lj) (RealTheory.le rj v))
    (hdisj :
      SetPred.Disjoint (RealTheory.OpenInterval li ri)
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval lj rj)) :
    SetPred.Disjoint (RealTheory.OpenInterval (H li) (H ri))
      (RealTheory.OpenInterval (H lj) (H rj))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro x hxI hxJ
  have hli_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v li := by
    refine And.intro hbi.left ?_
    exact RealTheory.le_trans hli hbi.right
  have hri_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v ri := by
    refine And.intro ?_ hbi.right
    exact RealTheory.le_trans hbi.left hli
  have hlj_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v lj := by
    refine And.intro hbj.left ?_
    exact RealTheory.le_trans hlj hbj.right
  have hrj_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v rj := by
    refine And.intro ?_ hbj.right
    exact RealTheory.le_trans hbj.left hlj
  have hH_i_ordered : RealTheory.le (H li) (H ri) :=
    hmono li ri hli_mem hri_mem hli
  have hH_j_ordered : RealTheory.le (H lj) (H rj) :=
    hmono lj rj hlj_mem hrj_mem hlj
  have hH_i_pos : RealTheory.lt (H li) (H ri) := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hxI.left hxI.right
  have hH_j_pos : RealTheory.lt (H lj) (H rj) := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hxJ.left hxJ.right
  have hli_strict : RealTheory.lt li ri := by
    by_cases hstrict : RealTheory.lt li ri
    case pos =>
      exact hstrict
    case neg =>
      have hri_li : RealTheory.le ri li :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hstrict
      have heq : li = ri := RealTheory.le_antisymm hli hri_li
      rw [heq] at hH_i_pos
      exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (H ri) hH_i_pos)
  have hlj_strict : RealTheory.lt lj rj := by
    by_cases hstrict : RealTheory.lt lj rj
    case pos =>
      exact hstrict
    case neg =>
      have hrj_lj : RealTheory.le rj lj :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hstrict
      have heq : lj = rj := RealTheory.le_antisymm hlj hrj_lj
      rw [heq] at hH_j_pos
      exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (H rj) hH_j_pos)
  let l : Bool -> Point := fun b => if b then li else lj
  let r : Bool -> Point := fun b => if b then ri else rj
  have hdisj_bool :
      SetPred.Disjoint (IntervalAt l r true) (IntervalAt l r false) := by
    change
      SetPred.Disjoint (RealTheory.OpenInterval li ri)
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval lj rj)
    exact hdisj
  have hsep :
      Or (RealTheory.le ri lj) (RealTheory.le rj li) := by
    have hsep_bool :=
      interval_left_or_right_of_disjoint_open
        (l := l) (r := r) (i := true) (j := false)
        hli_strict hlj_strict hdisj_bool
    simpa [l, r] using hsep_bool
  cases hsep with
  | inl hri_lj =>
      have hHri_lj : RealTheory.le (H ri) (H lj) :=
        hmono ri lj hri_mem hlj_mem hri_lj
      have hx_lt_Hlj : RealTheory.lt x (H lj) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxI.right hHri_lj
      have hx_lt_x : RealTheory.lt x x :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx_lt_Hlj hxJ.left
      exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F x hx_lt_x)
  | inr hrj_li =>
      have hHrj_li : RealTheory.le (H rj) (H li) :=
        hmono rj li hrj_mem hli_mem hrj_li
      have hx_lt_Hli : RealTheory.lt x (H li) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxJ.right hHrj_li
      have hx_lt_x : RealTheory.lt x x :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx_lt_Hli hxI.left
      exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F x hx_lt_x)

name: intervalListLength_monotoneImage_le_of_disjoint_closedBounds
statement:
theorem intervalListLength_monotoneImage_le_of_disjoint_closedBounds
    {source : Type u} {sourceL sourceR : source -> Point}
    {H : Point -> Point}
    (sources : List source) (u v : Point)
    (huv : RealTheory.le u v)
    (hmono :
      forall x y : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v x ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v y ->
            RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (H x) (H y))
    (hordered : IntervalListOrdered sourceL sourceR sources)
    (hfinite : FiniteDisjointSubfamily sourceL sourceR sources)
    (hbounds :
      forall i : source,
        List.Mem i sources ->
          And (RealTheory.le u (sourceL i))
            (RealTheory.le (sourceR i) v)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (intervalListLength (fun i : source => H (sourceL i))
        (fun i : source => H (sourceR i)) sources)
      (RealTheory.sub (H v) (H u))
proof:
:= by
  let imageL : source -> Point := fun i => H (sourceL i)
  let imageR : source -> Point := fun i => H (sourceR i)
  change
    RealTheory.le (intervalListLength imageL imageR sources)
      (RealTheory.sub (H v) (H u))
  have hu_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v u :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_left_mem RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base huv
  have hv_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v v :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_right_mem RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base huv
  have hHuv : RealTheory.le (H u) (H v) :=
    hmono u v hu_mem hv_mem huv
  have himageOrdered : IntervalListOrdered imageL imageR sources := by
    intro i hi
    have hiOrdered : RealTheory.le (sourceL i) (sourceR i) :=
      hordered i hi
    have hiBounds := hbounds i hi
    have hleft_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v (sourceL i) := by
      refine And.intro hiBounds.left ?_
      exact RealTheory.le_trans hiOrdered hiBounds.right
    have hright_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v (sourceR i) := by
      refine And.intro ?_ hiBounds.right
      exact RealTheory.le_trans hiBounds.left hiOrdered
    exact hmono (sourceL i) (sourceR i) hleft_mem hright_mem hiOrdered
  have himageBounds :
      forall i : source,
        List.Mem i sources ->
          And (RealTheory.le (H u) (imageL i))
            (RealTheory.le (imageR i) (H v)) := by
    intro i hi
    have hiOrdered : RealTheory.le (sourceL i) (sourceR i) :=
      hordered i hi
    have hiBounds := hbounds i hi
    have hleft_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v (sourceL i) := by
      refine And.intro hiBounds.left ?_
      exact RealTheory.le_trans hiOrdered hiBounds.right
    have hright_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v (sourceR i) := by
      refine And.intro ?_ hiBounds.right
      exact RealTheory.le_trans hiBounds.left hiOrdered
    exact And.intro
      (hmono u (sourceL i) hu_mem hleft_mem hiBounds.left)
      (hmono (sourceR i) v hright_mem hv_mem hiBounds.right)
  have hpairImage :
      IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint imageL imageR sources := by
    have hpair := hfinite.right
    unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint at hpair
    unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
    have hmain :
        forall xs : List source,
          IntervalListOrdered sourceL sourceR xs ->
            (forall i : source,
              List.Mem i xs ->
                And (RealTheory.le u (sourceL i))
                  (RealTheory.le (sourceR i) v)) ->
              List.Pairwise
                (fun i j : source =>
                  SetPred.Disjoint (IntervalAt sourceL sourceR i)
                    (IntervalAt sourceL sourceR j)) xs ->
                List.Pairwise
                  (fun i j : source =>
                    SetPred.Disjoint (IntervalAt imageL imageR i)
                      (IntervalAt imageL imageR j)) xs := by
      intro xs hxsOrdered hxsBounds hxsPair
      induction xs with
      | nil =>
          exact List.Pairwise.nil
      | cons i rest ih =>
          cases hxsPair with
          | cons hrel htail =>
              apply List.Pairwise.cons
              · intro j hj
                have hiMem : List.Mem i (i :: rest) := List.Mem.head rest
                have hjMem : List.Mem j (i :: rest) := List.Mem.tail i hj
                change
                  SetPred.Disjoint
                    (RealTheory.OpenInterval (imageL i) (imageR i))
                    (RealTheory.OpenInterval (imageL j) (imageR j))
                unfold imageL
                unfold imageR
                apply intervalImage_disjoint_of_monotone
                  (H := H) (u := u) (v := v)
                  (li := sourceL i) (ri := sourceR i)
                  (lj := sourceL j) (rj := sourceR j)
                  hmono
                · exact hxsOrdered i hiMem
                · exact hxsOrdered j hjMem
                · exact hxsBounds i hiMem
                · exact hxsBounds j hjMem
                · exact hrel j hj
              · apply ih
                · intro j hj
                  exact hxsOrdered j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
                · intro j hj
                  exact hxsBounds j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
                · exact htail
    exact hmain sources hordered hbounds hpair
  have himageFinite : FiniteDisjointSubfamily imageL imageR sources :=
    And.intro hfinite.left hpairImage
  exact
    intervalListLength_le_of_disjoint_closedBounds
      (sourceL := imageL) (sourceR := imageR)
      sources (H u) (H v) hHuv himageOrdered himageFinite himageBounds

name: intervalListLength_le_of_pointwise_length_le
statement:
theorem intervalListLength_le_of_pointwise_length_le {iota : Type u}
    {left1 right1 left2 right2 : iota -> Point} :
    forall xs : List iota,
      (forall i : iota,
        List.Mem i xs ->
          RealTheory.le (IntervalLengthAt left1 right1 i)
            (IntervalLengthAt left2 right2 i)) ->
        RealTheory.le (intervalListLength left1 right1 xs)
          (intervalListLength left2 right2 xs)
  | [], _hle => by
      unfold intervalListLength
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  | i :: xs, hle => by
      unfold intervalListLength
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (hle i (List.Mem.head xs))
        (intervalListLength_le_of_pointwise_length_le xs
          (fun j hj => hle j (List.Mem.tail i hj)))

private theorem intervalListLength_le_of_disjoint_containedInOpenAt
    {source : Type u} {control : Type v}
    {sourceL sourceR : source -> Point}
    {coverL coverR : control -> Point}
    (sources : List source) (j : control)
    (hcoverOpen : RealTheory.lt (coverL j) (coverR j))
    (hordered : IntervalListOrdered sourceL sourceR sources)
    (hfinite : FiniteDisjointSubfamily sourceL sourceR sources)
    (hcontain :
      forall i : source,
        List.Mem i sources ->
          ClosedIntervalContainedInOpen sourceL sourceR
            coverL coverR i j) :
    RealTheory.le (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR sources)
      (IntervalLengthAt coverL coverR j)
proof:
:= by
  change
    RealTheory.le (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR sources)
      (RealTheory.sub (coverR j) (coverL j))
  apply
    intervalListLength_le_of_disjoint_closedBounds
      (sourceL := sourceL) (sourceR := sourceR)
      sources (coverL j) (coverR j)
  · exact
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hcoverOpen
  · exact hordered
  · exact hfinite
  · intro i hi
    have hiOrdered : RealTheory.le (sourceL i) (sourceR i) :=
      hordered i hi
    have hleftClosed :
        ClosedIntervalAt sourceL sourceR i (sourceL i) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_left_mem RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hiOrdered
    have hrightClosed :
        ClosedIntervalAt sourceL sourceR i (sourceR i) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_right_mem RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hiOrdered
    have hleftOpen :
        IntervalAt coverL coverR j (sourceL i) :=
      hcontain i hi (sourceL i) hleftClosed
    have hrightOpen :
        IntervalAt coverL coverR j (sourceR i) :=
      hcontain i hi (sourceR i) hrightClosed
    exact
      And.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hleftOpen.left)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hrightOpen.right)

name: intervalListLength_le_of_disjoint_containedInOpenAt
statement:
private theorem intervalListLength_le_of_disjoint_containedInOpenAt
    {source : Type u} {control : Type v}
    {sourceL sourceR : source -> Point}
    {coverL coverR : control -> Point}
    (sources : List source) (j : control)
    (hcoverOpen : RealTheory.lt (coverL j) (coverR j))
    (hordered : IntervalListOrdered sourceL sourceR sources)
    (hfinite : FiniteDisjointSubfamily sourceL sourceR sources)
    (hcontain :
      forall i : source,
        List.Mem i sources ->
          ClosedIntervalContainedInOpen sourceL sourceR
            coverL coverR i j) :
    RealTheory.le (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR sources)
      (IntervalLengthAt coverL coverR j)
proof:
:= by
  change
    RealTheory.le (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR sources)
      (RealTheory.sub (coverR j) (coverL j))
  apply
    intervalListLength_le_of_disjoint_closedBounds
      (sourceL := sourceL) (sourceR := sourceR)
      sources (coverL j) (coverR j)
  · exact
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hcoverOpen
  · exact hordered
  · exact hfinite
  · intro i hi
    have hiOrdered : RealTheory.le (sourceL i) (sourceR i) :=
      hordered i hi
    have hleftClosed :
        ClosedIntervalAt sourceL sourceR i (sourceL i) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_left_mem RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hiOrdered
    have hrightClosed :
        ClosedIntervalAt sourceL sourceR i (sourceR i) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_right_mem RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hiOrdered
    have hleftOpen :
        IntervalAt coverL coverR j (sourceL i) :=
      hcontain i hi (sourceL i) hleftClosed
    have hrightOpen :
        IntervalAt coverL coverR j (sourceR i) :=
      hcontain i hi (sourceR i) hrightClosed
    exact
      And.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hleftOpen.left)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hrightOpen.right)

name: intervalListOrdered_filter
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi

name: finiteDisjointSubfamily_filter
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact
      List.Nodup.sublist
        (List.filter_sublist (p := p) (l := xs)) hfinite.left
  · have hpair := hfinite.right
    unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint at hpair
    unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint

name: intervalListLength_filter_partition
statement:
private theorem intervalListLength_filter_partition {iota : Type u}
    (l r : iota -> Point) (p : iota -> Bool) :
    forall xs : List iota,
      intervalListLength l r xs =
        RealTheory.add
          (intervalListLength l r (xs.filter p))
          (intervalListLength l r
            (xs.filter (fun i : iota => !p i)))
  | [] => by
      change RealTheory.zero =
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  | x :: xs => by
      cases hpx : p x
      · simp [List.filter, hpx]
        change
          RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r x)
              (intervalListLength l r xs) =
            RealTheory.add
              (intervalListLength l r (List.filter p xs))
              (RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r x)
                (intervalListLength l r
                  (List.filter (fun i : iota => !p i) xs)))
        rw [intervalListLength_filter_partition l r p xs]
        let a
proof:
:= IntervalLengthAt l r x
        let left := intervalListLength l r (xs.filter p)
        let right :=
          intervalListLength l r
            (xs.filter (fun i : iota => !p i))
        change
          RealTheory.add a (RealTheory.add left right) =
            RealTheory.add left (RealTheory.add a right)
        calc
          RealTheory.add a (RealTheory.add left right) =
              RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add a left) right := by
              rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
          _ = RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add left a) right := by
              rw [RealTheory.add_comm a left]
          _ = RealTheory.add left (RealTheory.add a right) := by
              rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
      · simp [List.filter, hpx]
        change
          RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r x)
              (intervalListLength l r xs) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r x)
                (intervalListLength l r (List.filter p xs)))
              (intervalListLength l r
                (List.filter (fun i : iota => !p i) xs))
        rw [intervalListLength_filter_partition l r p xs]
        rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]

name: closedIntervalListContainmentLengthEstimate
statement:
private theorem closedIntervalListContainmentLengthEstimate
    {source : Type u} {control : Type v}
    {sourceL sourceR : source -> Point}
    {coverL coverR : control -> Point} :
    forall (covers : List control) (sources : List source),
      IntervalListOrdered sourceL sourceR sources ->
        FiniteDisjointSubfamily sourceL sourceR sources ->
          IntervalListOpen coverL coverR covers ->
            ClosedIntervalListContainedByList sourceL sourceR sources
              coverL coverR covers ->
              RealTheory.le
                (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR sources)
                (intervalListLength coverL coverR covers)
  | [], sources, hordered, hfinite, hopen, hcontain => by
      cases sources with
      | nil =>
          change RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
          exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
      | cons head tail =>
          have hbad
proof:
:= hcontain head (List.Mem.head tail)
          match hbad with
          | Exists.intro j hj =>
              cases hj.left
  | cover :: covers, sources, hordered, hfinite, hopen, hcontain => by
      classical
      let p : source -> Bool :=
        fun i : source =>
          decide
            (ClosedIntervalContainedInOpen sourceL sourceR
              coverL coverR i cover)
      let q : source -> Bool :=
        fun i : source => !p i
      have hheadOrdered :
          IntervalListOrdered sourceL sourceR (sources.filter p) :=
        intervalListOrdered_filter p hordered
      have hheadFinite :
          FiniteDisjointSubfamily sourceL sourceR (sources.filter p) :=
        finiteDisjointSubfamily_filter p hfinite
      have hheadContain :
          forall i : source,
            List.Mem i (sources.filter p) ->
              ClosedIntervalContainedInOpen sourceL sourceR
                coverL coverR i cover := by
        intro i hi
        have hp : p i := (List.mem_filter.mp hi).right
        unfold p at hp
        exact of_decide_eq_true hp
      have hheadLen :
          RealTheory.le
            (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR (sources.filter p))
            (IntervalLengthAt coverL coverR cover) :=
        intervalListLength_le_of_disjoint_containedInOpenAt
          (sourceL := sourceL) (sourceR := sourceR)
          (coverL := coverL) (coverR := coverR)
          (sources.filter p) cover
          (hopen cover (List.Mem.head covers))
          hheadOrdered hheadFinite hheadContain
      have htailOrdered :
          IntervalListOrdered sourceL sourceR (sources.filter q) :=
        intervalListOrdered_filter q hordered
      have htailFinite :
          FiniteDisjointSubfamily sourceL sourceR (sources.filter q) :=
        finiteDisjointSubfamily_filter q hfinite
      have htailOpen :
          IntervalListOpen coverL coverR covers := by
        intro j hj
        exact hopen j (List.Mem.tail cover hj)
      have htailContain :
          ClosedIntervalListContainedByList sourceL sourceR
            (sources.filter q) coverL coverR covers := by
        intro i hi
        have hifilter := List.mem_filter.mp hi
        have hiSource : List.Mem i sources := hifilter.left
        have hnotp : q i := hifilter.right
        match hcontain i hiSource with
        | Exists.intro j hj =>
            cases hj.left with
            | head =>
                have hpTrue : p i = true := by
                  unfold p
                  exact decide_eq_true hj.right
                unfold q at hnotp
                rw [hpTrue] at hnotp
                cases hnotp
            | tail _ hjtail =>
                exact Exists.intro j (And.intro hjtail hj.right)
      have htailLen :
          RealTheory.le
            (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR (sources.filter q))
            (intervalListLength coverL coverR covers) :=
        closedIntervalListContainmentLengthEstimate covers
          (sources.filter q) htailOrdered htailFinite htailOpen
          htailContain
      have hsum :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.add
              (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR (sources.filter p))
              (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR (sources.filter q)))
            (RealTheory.add
              (IntervalLengthAt coverL coverR cover)
              (intervalListLength coverL coverR covers)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hheadLen htailLen
      have hpartition :
          intervalListLength sourceL sourceR sources =
            RealTheory.add
              (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR (sources.filter p))
              (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR (sources.filter q)) := by
        unfold q
        exact intervalListLength_filter_partition sourceL sourceR p sources
      rw [hpartition]
      exact hsum

name: intervalListLength_le_of_nodup_members_of_ordered
statement:
theorem intervalListLength_le_of_nodup_members_of_ordered {iota : Type u}
    {l r : iota -> Point} :
    forall (xs ys : List iota),
      List.Nodup xs ->
        ListMembersIn xs ys ->
          IntervalListOrdered l r ys ->
            RealTheory.le (intervalListLength l r xs)
              (intervalListLength l r ys)
  | [], ys, _hnodup, _hmembers, hordered => by
      change
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (intervalListLength l r ys)
      exact
        intervalListLength_nonnegative_of_ordered hordered
  | x :: xs, ys, hnodup, hmembers, hordered => by
      have hnotMem : Not (List.Mem x xs)
proof:
:=
        (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).left
      have hxsNodup : List.Nodup xs :=
        (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).right
      have hxMem : List.Mem x ys :=
        hmembers x (List.Mem.head xs)
      match List.mem_iff_append.mp hxMem with
      | Exists.intro pre hpre =>
          match hpre with
          | Exists.intro post hys =>
              subst ys
              have hmembersTail :
                  ListMembersIn xs (pre ++ post) := by
                apply listMembersIn_remove_split_of_not_mem hnotMem
                intro z hz
                exact hmembers z (List.Mem.tail _ hz)
              have horderedTail :
                  IntervalListOrdered l r (pre ++ post) :=
                intervalListOrdered_remove_split hordered
              have htail :
                  RealTheory.le (intervalListLength l r xs)
                    (intervalListLength l r (pre ++ post)) :=
                intervalListLength_le_of_nodup_members_of_ordered
                  xs (pre ++ post) hxsNodup hmembersTail horderedTail
              change
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r x)
                    (intervalListLength l r xs))
                  (intervalListLength l r (pre ++ x :: post))
              rw [intervalListLength_insert_split l r pre post x]
              exact
                RealTheory.add_le_add_left htail
                  (IntervalLengthAt l r x)

name: finiteIntervalSelectionLengthControl_of_hypotheses_of_tripleSelection
statement:
private theorem finiteIntervalSelectionLengthControl_of_hypotheses_of_tripleSelection
    {source : Type u} {control : Type v}
    {sourceL sourceR : source -> Point} {sources : List source}
    {controlL controlR : control -> Point} {controls selected : List control}
    (h :
      FiniteIntervalSelectionHypotheses sourceL sourceR sources
        controlL controlR controls)
    (hselection :
      FiniteIntervalTripleSelection controlL controlR controls selected) :
    FiniteIntervalSelectionLengthControl sourceL sourceR sources
      controlL controlR controls selected
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro h ?_
  refine And.intro hselection ?_
  have htripleOpen :
      IntervalListOpen (intervalTripleLeft controlL controlR)
        (intervalTripleRight controlL controlR) selected :=
    intervalTripleListOpen_of_open_of_members
      h.right.right.left hselection.left
  have htripleContain :
      ClosedIntervalListContainedByTriples sourceL sourceR sources
        controlL controlR selected :=
    closedIntervalListContainedByTriples_of_containedByList_of_tripleSelection
      h.right.right.right hselection
  have htripleHyp :
      ClosedIntervalListContainmentLengthHypotheses sourceL sourceR sources
        (intervalTripleLeft controlL controlR)
        (intervalTripleRight controlL controlR) selected := by
    refine And.intro h.left ?_
    refine And.intro h.right.left ?_
    exact And.intro htripleOpen htripleContain
  have hcontrol :
      ClosedIntervalListContainmentLengthControl sourceL sourceR sources
        (intervalTripleLeft controlL controlR)
        (intervalTripleRight controlL controlR) selected :=
    closedIntervalListContainmentLengthControl_of_hypotheses htripleHyp
  have hlen := hcontrol.right
  rw [intervalTripleListLength_eq_three_mul controlL controlR selected] at hlen

name: intervalListLength_eq_of_perm
proof:
:= by
  induction hperm with
  | nil =>
      rfl
  | cons i hperm ih =>
      unfold intervalListLength
      rw [ih]
  | swap i j rest =>
      change
        RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r j)
            (RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r i)
              (intervalListLength l r rest)) =
          RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r i)
            (RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r j)
              (intervalListLength l r rest))
      rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc]
      rw [RealTheory.add_comm (IntervalLengthAt l r j) (IntervalLengthAt l r i)]
      rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
  | trans hxy hyz ihxy ihyz =>
      exact Eq.trans ihxy ihyz

name: intervalListSpatiallyOrdered_of_pairwise_left_le_of_open_of_disjoint
statement:
private theorem intervalListSpatiallyOrdered_of_pairwise_left_le_of_open_of_disjoint
    {iota : Type u} {l r : iota -> Point} :
    forall {js : List iota},
      List.Pairwise (fun i j : iota => RealTheory.le (l i) (l j)) js ->
        IntervalListOpen l r js ->
          IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint l r js ->
            IntervalListSpatiallyOrdered l r js
  | [], _hleft, _hopen, _hdisjoint => by
      exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | i :: rest, hleft, hopen, hdisjoint => by
      unfold IntervalListSpatiallyOrdered
      unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint at hdisjoint
      cases hleft with
      | cons hleftHead hleftTail =>
          cases hdisjoint with
          | cons hdisjointHead hdisjointTail =>
              apply List.Pairwise.cons
              · intro j hj
                have hiOpen : RealTheory.lt (l i) (r i)
proof:
:=
                  hopen i (List.Mem.head rest)
                have hjOpen : RealTheory.lt (l j) (r j) :=
                  hopen j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
                have hsep :=
                  interval_left_or_right_of_disjoint_open
                    hiOpen hjOpen (hdisjointHead j hj)
                cases hsep with
                | inl hij =>
                    exact hij
                | inr hji =>
                    have hbad : RealTheory.le (r j) (l j) :=
                      RealTheory.le_trans hji (hleftHead j hj)
                    exact False.elim
                      ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt
                        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hjOpen) hbad)
              · apply
                  intervalListSpatiallyOrdered_of_pairwise_left_le_of_open_of_disjoint
                    hleftTail
                · intro j hj
                  exact hopen j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
                · unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
                  exact hdisjointTail

name: exists_spatiallyOrderedFiniteIntervalSelection_of_hypotheses
statement:
theorem exists_spatiallyOrderedFiniteIntervalSelection_of_hypotheses
    {source : Type u} {control : Type v}
    {sourceL sourceR : source -> Point} {sources : List source}
    {controlL controlR : control -> Point} {controls : List control}
    (h :
      FiniteIntervalSelectionHypotheses sourceL sourceR sources
        controlL controlR controls) :
    Exists
      (fun selected : List control =>
        And
          (FiniteIntervalSelectionLengthControl sourceL sourceR sources
            controlL controlR controls selected)
          (And (IntervalListOpen controlL controlR selected)
            (IntervalListSpatiallyOrdered controlL controlR selected)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let raw : List control :=
    greedyIntervalSelection controlL controlR controls
  let cmp : control -> control -> Bool :=
    fun i j => decide (RealTheory.le (controlL i) (controlL j))
  let selected : List control := List.mergeSort raw cmp
  have hraw :
      FiniteIntervalSelectionLengthControl sourceL sourceR sources
        controlL controlR controls raw := by
    simpa [raw] using
      (finiteIntervalSelectionLengthControl_greedy_of_hypotheses h)
  have hperm : List.Perm selected raw := by
    simpa [selected] using List.mergeSort_perm raw cmp
  have hopen : IntervalListOpen controlL controlR selected := by
    intro i hi
    have hiRaw : List.Mem i raw := (hperm.mem_iff).mp hi
    have hiControls : List.Mem i controls :=
      hraw.right.left.left i hiRaw
    exact h.right.right.left i hiControls
  have hleft :
      List.Pairwise
        (fun i j : control => RealTheory.le (controlL i) (controlL j))
        selected := by
    have hpair :
        List.Pairwise (fun i j : control => cmp i j = true)
          (List.mergeSort raw cmp) := by
      apply List.pairwise_mergeSort
      · intro i j k hij hjk
        unfold cmp at hij hjk ⊢
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hij hjk ⊢
        exact RealTheory.le_trans hij hjk
      · intro i j
        unfold cmp
        simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
        exact RealTheory.le_total (controlL i) (controlL j)
    simpa [selected, cmp] using hpair
  have hselection :
      FiniteIntervalTripleSelection controlL controlR controls selected := by
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · intro i hi
      exact hraw.right.left.left i ((hperm.mem_iff).mp hi)
    · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
        · exact hperm.symm.nodup hraw.right.left.right.left.left
        · unfold IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
          apply hperm.symm.pairwise
          · exact hraw.right.left.right.left.right
          · intro i j hij x hxj hxi
            exact hij x hxi hxj
      · intro i hi
        cases hraw.right.left.right.right i hi with
        | intro j hj =>
            exact Exists.intro j
              (And.intro ((hperm.mem_iff).mpr hj.left) hj.right)
  have hbound := hraw.right.right
  have hlength :
      intervalListLength controlL controlR selected =
        intervalListLength controlL controlR raw :=
    intervalListLength_eq_of_perm controlL controlR hperm
  rw [<- hlength] at hbound
  have hcontrol :
      FiniteIntervalSelectionLengthControl sourceL sourceR sources
        controlL controlR controls selected :=
    And.intro h (And.intro hselection hbound)
  have hspatial :
      IntervalListSpatiallyOrdered controlL controlR selected :=
    intervalListSpatiallyOrdered_of_pairwise_left_le_of_open_of_disjoint
      hleft hopen hselection.right.left.right
  exact Exists.intro selected (And.intro hcontrol (And.intro hopen hspatial))

proof:
:=
  Exists.intro (greedyIntervalSelection controlL controlR controls)
