name: cantorStageBit_lt_two
statement:
private theorem cantorStageBit_lt_two
    (digits : Nat -> Nat) (i : Nat) :
    cantorStageBit digits i < 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold cantorStageBit
  split <;> omega

name: cantorStageBit_double
statement:
private theorem cantorStageBit_double
    {digits : Nat -> Nat} {i : Nat}
    (hi : RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed (digits i)) :
    2 * cantorStageBit digits i = digits i
proof:
:= by
  unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hi
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hi
  cases hi with
  | inl hzero =>
      simp [cantorStageBit, hzero]
  | inr htwo =>
      simp [cantorStageBit, htwo]

name: cantorStageCode_lt_pow
statement:
private theorem cantorStageCode_lt_pow
    (digits : Nat -> Nat) :
    forall n : Nat, cantorStageCode digits n < 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp [cantorStageCode]
  | succ n ih =>
      have hbit := cantorStageBit_lt_two digits n
      rw [Nat.pow_succ]
      unfold cantorStageCode
      omega

name: cantorStageDigit_allowed
statement:
private theorem cantorStageDigit_allowed
    {n k i : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n)
    (hi : i < n) :
    RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed (cantorStageDigit n k i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k i with
  | zero =>
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
      unfold cantorStageDigit
      by_cases hin : i < n
      · rw [if_pos hin]
        apply ih
        · rw [Nat.pow_succ] at hk
          omega
        · exact hin
      · rw [if_neg hin]
        have hieq : i = n := by omega
        rw [if_pos hieq]
        have hmod : k % 2 < 2 := Nat.mod_lt k (by omega)
        unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
        unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
        omega

name: cantorStageDigit_zero_of_le
statement:
private theorem cantorStageDigit_zero_of_le
    {n k i : Nat}
    (hni : n <= i) :
    cantorStageDigit n k i = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k i with
  | zero =>
      rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      unfold cantorStageDigit
      have hnot : Not (i < n) := by omega
      rw [if_neg hnot]
      have hne : Not (i = n) := by omega
      rw [if_neg hne]

name: cantorStageDigit_succ_of_lt
statement:
private theorem cantorStageDigit_succ_of_lt
    {n k i : Nat}
    (hi : i < n) :
    cantorStageDigit (n + 1) k i = cantorStageDigit n (k / 2) i
proof:
:= by
  change
    (if i < n then cantorStageDigit n (k / 2) i
      else if i = n then 2 * (k % 2) else 0) =
      cantorStageDigit n (k / 2) i
  rw [if_pos hi]

name: cantorStageDigit_code
statement:
private theorem cantorStageDigit_code
    {digits : Nat -> Nat}
    (hallowed :
      forall i : Nat,
        RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed (digits i)) :
    forall n i : Nat,
      i < n ->
        cantorStageDigit n (cantorStageCode digits n) i = digits i
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro i hi
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
      intro i hi
      unfold cantorStageDigit cantorStageCode
      by_cases hin : i < n
      · rw [if_pos hin]
        have hbit := cantorStageBit_lt_two digits n
        have hdiv :
            (2 * cantorStageCode digits n + cantorStageBit digits n) / 2 =
              cantorStageCode digits n := by
          omega
        rw [hdiv]
        exact ih i hin
      · rw [if_neg hin]
        have hieq : i = n := by omega
        rw [if_pos hieq]
        have hbit := cantorStageBit_lt_two digits n
        have hmod :
            (2 * cantorStageCode digits n + cantorStageBit digits n) % 2 =
              cantorStageBit digits n := by
          omega
        rw [hmod]
        subst i
        exact cantorStageBit_double (hallowed n)

name: cantorStageDigit_restrictedStream
statement:
private theorem cantorStageDigit_restrictedStream
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    RealTheory.RestrictedBaseDigitStream 3
      RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
      (cantorStageDigit n k)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro i
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.BaseDigit
    by_cases hi : i < n
    · have hallowed := cantorStageDigit_allowed hk hi
      unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
      omega
    · rw [cantorStageDigit_zero_of_le (by omega)]
      omega
  · intro i
    by_cases hi : i < n
    · exact cantorStageDigit_allowed hk hi
    · rw [cantorStageDigit_zero_of_le (by omega)]
      unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
      exact Or.inl rfl

name: cantorStageRightDigit_restrictedStream
statement:
private theorem cantorStageRightDigit_restrictedStream
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    RealTheory.RestrictedBaseDigitStream 3
      RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
      (cantorStageRightDigit n k)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro i
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.BaseDigit
    unfold cantorStageRightDigit
    split
    · have hallowed := cantorStageDigit_allowed hk (by assumption)
      unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
      omega
    · omega
  · intro i
    unfold cantorStageRightDigit
    split
    · exact cantorStageDigit_allowed hk (by assumption)
    · unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
      exact Or.inr rfl

name: cantorStageLeftPartial_eq_of_le
statement:
private theorem cantorStageLeftPartial_eq_of_le
    (n k r : Nat) :
    RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 3 (cantorStageDigit n k) (n + r) =
      cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      rw [Nat.add_zero]
      rfl
  | succ r ih =>
      change
        F.baseExpansionPartial 3 (cantorStageDigit n k) (n + r) =
          cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k at ih
      rw [Nat.add_succ]
      change
        F.baseExpansionPartial 3
            (cantorStageDigit n k) ((n + r) + 1) =
          cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_succ]
      rw [ih]
      rw [cantorStageDigit_zero_of_le (by omega)]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseWeightedDigit_zero]
      exact RealTheory.add_zero (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k)

name: cantorStageRightPartial_at_stage
statement:
private theorem cantorStageRightPartial_at_stage
    (n k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 3 (cantorStageRightDigit n k) n =
      cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k
proof:
:= by
  unfold cantorStageLeftEndpoint
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_eq_of_prefix_eq
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base 3 n
    (by
      intro i hi
      unfold cantorStageRightDigit
      rw [if_pos hi])

name: cantorStageRightEnvelope_eq_of_le
statement:
private theorem cantorStageRightEnvelope_eq_of_le
    (n k r : Nat) :
    RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 3
        (cantorStageRightDigit n k) (n + r) =
      cantorStageRightEndpoint n k
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      rw [Nat.add_zero]
      unfold RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope
      change
        F.add
            (F.baseExpansionPartial 3
              (cantorStageRightDigit n k) n)
            (F.baseTail 3 n) =
          cantorStageRightEndpoint n k
      have hpartial := cantorStageRightPartial_at_stage n k
      change
        F.baseExpansionPartial 3 (cantorStageRightDigit n k) n =
          cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k at hpartial
      rw [hpartial]
      rfl
  | succ r ih =>
      change
        F.add
            (F.baseExpansionPartial 3
              (cantorStageRightDigit n k) (n + r))
            (F.baseTail 3 (n + r)) =
          cantorStageRightEndpoint n k at ih
      have hdigit : cantorStageRightDigit n k (n + r) = 2 := by
        unfold cantorStageRightDigit
        rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      have hmax :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseWeightedMax_add_tail_succ
          F validBase_three (n := n + r)
      have hmax' :
          F.add (F.baseWeightedDigit 3 2 (n + r))
              (F.baseTail 3 ((n + r) + 1)) =
            F.baseTail 3 (n + r) := by
        simpa using hmax
      change
        F.add
            (F.baseExpansionPartial 3
              (cantorStageRightDigit n k) (n + (r + 1)))
            (F.baseTail 3 (n + (r + 1))) =
          cantorStageRightEndpoint n k
      have hidx : n + (r + 1) = (n + r) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hidx]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_succ]
      rw [hdigit]
      rw [F.add_assoc]
      rw [hmax']
      exact ih

name: cantorStageCylinder_width
statement:
theorem cantorStageCylinder_width (n k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k)
        (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) =
      RealTheory.baseTail 3 n
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold cantorStageRightEndpoint
  have hcancel :
      F.add
          (F.sub
            (F.add (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) (RealTheory.baseTail 3 n))
            (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k))
          (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) =
        F.add (RealTheory.baseTail 3 n) (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) := by
    calc
      F.add
          (F.sub
            (F.add (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) (RealTheory.baseTail 3 n))
            (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k))
          (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) =
          F.add (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) (RealTheory.baseTail 3 n) :=
        F.sub_add_cancel
          (F.add (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) (RealTheory.baseTail 3 n))
          (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k)
      _ = F.add (RealTheory.baseTail 3 n) (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) := by
        rw [F.add_comm]
  exact F.add_right_cancel hcancel

name: cantorStageCylinder_ordered
statement:
theorem cantorStageCylinder_ordered (n k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k)
      (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold cantorStageRightEndpoint
  have htail := RealTheory.baseTail_pos validBase_three n
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base htail)
    (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k)
  rwa [F.add_zero] at h

name: cantorSet_mem_stageCylinder
statement:
theorem cantorSet_mem_stageCylinder
    {x : Point}
    (hx : CantorSet x) (n : Nat) :
    Exists
      (fun k : Nat =>
        And (k < 2 ^ n)
          (And
            (RealTheory.le (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) x)
            (RealTheory.le x (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k))))
proof:
:= by
  cases hx with
  | intro digits hdigits =>
      let k := cantorStageCode digits n
      have hallowed :
          forall i : Nat,
            RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed (digits i) :=
        hdigits.right.left.right
      have hk : k < 2 ^ n := cantorStageCode_lt_pow digits n
      have hbase :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.restricted_hasBaseExpansion
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hdigits
      have hpref :
          forall i : Nat, i < n ->
            cantorStageDigit n k i = digits i := by
        intro i hi
        exact cantorStageDigit_code hallowed n i hi
      have hpartial :
          cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k =
            RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 3 digits n := by
        unfold cantorStageLeftEndpoint
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_eq_of_prefix_eq
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base 3 n hpref
      refine Exists.intro k (And.intro hk ?_)
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · rw [hpartial]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_le_value
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hbase n
      · have hupper :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansion_value_le_envelope
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hbase n
        unfold RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope at hupper
        unfold cantorStageRightEndpoint
        rw [hpartial]
        exact hupper

name: cantorStageLeft_hasTernaryCantorExpansion
statement:
private theorem cantorStageLeft_hasTernaryCantorExpansion
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    RealTheory.HasTernaryCantorExpansion
      (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) (cantorStageDigit n k)
proof:
:= by
  have hleftStream := cantorStageDigit_restrictedStream hk
  cases RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial_converges
      validBase_three hleftStream.left with
  | intro value hvalue =>
      have hconst :
          RealTheory.SeqTendsto
            (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 3 (cantorStageDigit n k))
            (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) := by
        apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_eventually_eq_const (N := n)
        intro m hm
        have hmEq : m = n + (m - n) := by omega
        rw [hmEq]
        exact cantorStageLeftPartial_eq_of_le n k (m - n)
      have hvalueEq : value = cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k :=
        RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hvalue.right.right hconst
      rw [<- hvalueEq]
      exact And.intro validBase_three
        (And.intro hleftStream hvalue.right.right)

name: cantorStageRight_hasTernaryCantorExpansion
statement:
private theorem cantorStageRight_hasTernaryCantorExpansion
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    RealTheory.HasTernaryCantorExpansion
      (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) (cantorStageRightDigit n k)
proof:
:= by
  have hrightStream := cantorStageRightDigit_restrictedStream hk
  cases RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial_converges
      validBase_three hrightStream.left with
  | intro value hvalue =>
      have henvelope := RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope_tendsto hvalue
      have hconst :
          RealTheory.SeqTendsto
            (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 3
              (cantorStageRightDigit n k))
            (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) := by
        apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_eventually_eq_const (N := n)
        intro m hm
        have hmEq : m = n + (m - n) := by omega
        rw [hmEq]
        exact cantorStageRightEnvelope_eq_of_le n k (m - n)
      have hvalueEq : value = cantorStageRightEndpoint n k :=
        RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique henvelope hconst
      rw [<- hvalueEq]
      exact And.intro validBase_three
        (And.intro hrightStream hvalue.right.right)

name: cantorStageCylinderEndpoint_mem_cantorSet
statement:
theorem cantorStageCylinderEndpoint_mem_cantorSet
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    And
      (CantorSet (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k))
      (CantorSet (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k))
proof:
:= by
  exact And.intro
    (Exists.intro (cantorStageDigit n k)
      (cantorStageLeft_hasTernaryCantorExpansion hk))
    (Exists.intro (cantorStageRightDigit n k)
      (cantorStageRight_hasTernaryCantorExpansion hk))

name: cantorStageHalfDigit_binaryStream
statement:
private theorem cantorStageHalfDigit_binaryStream
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    RealTheory.BaseDigitStream 2
      (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit n k i / 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.BaseDigit
  change cantorStageDigit n k i / 2 < 2
  by_cases hi : i < n
  · have hallowed := cantorStageDigit_allowed hk hi
    unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
    omega
  · rw [cantorStageDigit_zero_of_le (by omega)]
    omega

name: cantorStageRightHalfDigit_binaryStream
statement:
private theorem cantorStageRightHalfDigit_binaryStream
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    RealTheory.BaseDigitStream 2
      (fun i : Nat => cantorStageRightDigit n k i / 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.BaseDigit
  unfold cantorStageRightDigit
  change (if i < n then cantorStageDigit n k i else 2) / 2 < 2
  by_cases hi : i < n
  · rw [if_pos hi]
    have hallowed := cantorStageDigit_allowed hk hi
    unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
    omega
  · rw [if_neg hi]
    omega

name: cantorStageHalfDigit_partial_eq_rank
statement:
private theorem cantorStageHalfDigit_partial_eq_rank :
    forall n k : Nat,
      k < 2 ^ n ->
        RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2
            (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit n k i / 2) n =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat k)
            (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro k hk
      have hkzero : k = 0 := by
        simp at hk
        omega
      subst k
      change F.zero = F.mul (F.nat 0) (F.baseTail 2 0)
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero]
      exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F (F.baseTail 2 0)).symm
  | succ n ih =>
      intro k hk
      have hkdiv : k / 2 < 2 ^ n := by
        rw [Nat.pow_succ] at hk
        omega
      change
        F.baseExpansionPartial 2
            (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit (n + 1) k i / 2) (n + 1) =
          F.mul (F.nat k) (F.baseTail 2 (n + 1))
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_succ]
      have hprefix :
          RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2
              (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit (n + 1) k i / 2) n =
            RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2
              (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit n (k / 2) i / 2) n :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_eq_of_prefix_eq F 2 n
          (by
            intro i hi
            rw [cantorStageDigit_succ_of_lt hi])
      change
        F.baseExpansionPartial 2
            (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit (n + 1) k i / 2) n =
          F.baseExpansionPartial 2
            (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit n (k / 2) i / 2) n at hprefix
      rw [hprefix]
      have ihrank := ih (k / 2) hkdiv
      change
        F.baseExpansionPartial 2
            (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit n (k / 2) i / 2) n =
          F.mul (F.nat (k / 2)) (F.baseTail 2 n) at ihrank
      rw [ihrank]
      have hlast : cantorStageDigit (n + 1) k n / 2 = k % 2 := by
        unfold cantorStageDigit
        rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos rfl]
        have hmod := Nat.mod_lt k (by omega : 0 < 2)
        omega
      rw [hlast]
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseWeightedDigit
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseDigitValue
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail_eq_mul_baseTail_succ
        F validBase_two n]
      rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      rw [<- F.add_mul]
      rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_mul F]
      rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_add F]
      have hnat : k / 2 * 2 + k % 2 = k := by omega
      rw [hnat]

name: binaryTailOne_envelope_eq_of_le
statement:
private theorem binaryTailOne_envelope_eq_of_le
    {digits : Nat -> Nat} {N : Nat}
    (hone : forall i : Nat, N <= i -> digits i = 1) :
    forall r : Nat,
      RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2 digits (N + r) =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits N)
          (RealTheory.baseTail 2 N)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      rw [Nat.add_zero]
      rfl
  | succ r ih =>
      change
        F.add
            (F.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits (N + (r + 1)))
            (F.baseTail 2 (N + (r + 1))) =
          F.add (F.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits N) (F.baseTail 2 N)
      have hidx : N + (r + 1) = (N + r) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hidx]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_succ]
      rw [hone (N + r) (by omega)]
      rw [F.add_assoc]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseWeightedMax_add_tail_succ
        F validBase_two]
      exact ih

name: hasBaseExpansion_of_binary_tail_one
statement:
private theorem hasBaseExpansion_of_binary_tail_one
    {digits : Nat -> Nat} {N : Nat}
    (hstream : RealTheory.BaseDigitStream 2 digits)
    (hone : forall i : Nat, N <= i -> digits i = 1) :
    RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits N)
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 N))
      digits
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let value := F.add (F.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits N) (F.baseTail 2 N)
  refine And.intro validBase_two (And.intro hstream ?_)
  have hconst : RealTheory.SeqTendsto (fun _ : Nat => value) value :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_const value
  have htail := RealTheory.baseTail_tendsto_zero_all validBase_two
  have hsub := RealTheory.seqTendsto_sub hconst htail
  have htarget :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun m : Nat => F.sub value (F.baseTail 2 m)) value := by
    change
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun m : Nat => F.sub value (F.baseTail 2 m))
        (F.sub value F.zero) at hsub
    rwa [F.sub_zero] at hsub
  apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually htarget
  refine Exists.intro N ?_
  intro m hm
  have hmEq : m = N + (m - N) := by omega
  have henv := binaryTailOne_envelope_eq_of_le hone (m - N)
  change
    F.add (F.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits (N + (m - N)))
        (F.baseTail 2 (N + (m - N))) = value at henv
  rw [<- hmEq] at henv
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_right_cancel F
    (a := F.baseTail 2 m)
  rw [F.sub_add_cancel]
  exact henv

name: cantorStageLeftHalf_hasBaseExpansion
statement:
private theorem cantorStageLeftHalf_hasBaseExpansion
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat k)
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n))
      (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit n k i / 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro validBase_two
    (And.intro (cantorStageHalfDigit_binaryStream hk) ?_)
  apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_eventually_eq_const (N := n)
  intro m hm
  have hmEq : m = n + (m - n) := by omega
  rw [hmEq]
  have hzero :
      forall i : Nat, n <= i -> cantorStageDigit n k i / 2 = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    rw [cantorStageDigit_zero_of_le hi]
  have hpartial :=
    RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial_eq_of_zero_after
      (q := 2) hzero (m - n)
  change
    F.baseExpansionPartial 2
        (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit n k i / 2) (n + (m - n)) =
      F.baseExpansionPartial 2
        (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit n k i / 2) n at hpartial
  rw [hpartial]
  exact cantorStageHalfDigit_partial_eq_rank n k hk

name: cantorStageRightHalf_hasBaseExpansion
statement:
private theorem cantorStageRightHalf_hasBaseExpansion
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (k + 1))
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n))
      (fun i : Nat => cantorStageRightDigit n k i / 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hone :
      forall i : Nat, n <= i -> cantorStageRightDigit n k i / 2 = 1 := by
    intro i hi
    unfold cantorStageRightDigit
    rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  have hbase := hasBaseExpansion_of_binary_tail_one
    (cantorStageRightHalfDigit_binaryStream hk) hone
  have hprefix :
      F.baseExpansionPartial 2
          (fun i : Nat => cantorStageRightDigit n k i / 2) n =
        F.baseExpansionPartial 2
          (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit n k i / 2) n :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_eq_of_prefix_eq F 2 n
      (by
        intro i hi
        unfold cantorStageRightDigit
        rw [if_pos hi])
  have hrank := cantorStageHalfDigit_partial_eq_rank n k hk
  change
    F.baseExpansionPartial 2
        (fun i : Nat => cantorStageDigit n k i / 2) n =
      F.mul (F.nat k) (F.baseTail 2 n) at hrank
  have hvalue :
      F.add (F.mul (F.nat k) (F.baseTail 2 n)) (F.baseTail 2 n) =
        F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) (F.baseTail 2 n) := by
    calc
      F.add (F.mul (F.nat k) (F.baseTail 2 n)) (F.baseTail 2 n) =
          F.add (F.mul (F.nat k) (F.baseTail 2 n))
            (F.mul F.one (F.baseTail 2 n)) := by
              rw [F.one_mul]
      _ = F.mul (F.add (F.nat k) F.one) (F.baseTail 2 n) := by
            rw [F.add_mul]
      _ = F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) (F.baseTail 2 n) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ]
  change
    RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2
      (F.add
        (F.baseExpansionPartial 2
          (fun i : Nat => cantorStageRightDigit n k i / 2) n)
        (F.baseTail 2 n))
      (fun i : Nat => cantorStageRightDigit n k i / 2) at hbase
  rw [hprefix, hrank, hvalue] at hbase
  exact hbase

name: cantorStageEndpoint_rankExpansions
statement:
theorem cantorStageEndpoint_rankExpansions
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    And
      (Exists (fun digits : Nat -> Nat =>
        And
          (RealTheory.HasTernaryCantorExpansion
            (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) digits)
          (And
            (RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat k)
                (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n))
              (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2))
            (forall i : Nat, n <= i -> digits i = 0))))
      (Exists (fun digits : Nat -> Nat =>
        And
          (RealTheory.HasTernaryCantorExpansion
            (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) digits)
          (And
            (RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (k + 1))
                (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n))
              (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2))
            (forall i : Nat, n <= i -> digits i = 2))))
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · refine Exists.intro (cantorStageDigit n k) ?_
    exact And.intro
      (cantorStageLeft_hasTernaryCantorExpansion hk)
      (And.intro
        (cantorStageLeftHalf_hasBaseExpansion hk)
        (fun i hi => cantorStageDigit_zero_of_le hi))
  · refine Exists.intro (cantorStageRightDigit n k) ?_
    exact And.intro
      (cantorStageRight_hasTernaryCantorExpansion hk)
      (And.intro
        (cantorStageRightHalf_hasBaseExpansion hk)
        (by
          intro i hi
          unfold cantorStageRightDigit
          rw [if_neg (by omega)]))

name: cantor_even_stage_nat_inequality
statement:
private theorem cantor_even_stage_nat_inequality (n : Nat) :
    2 ^ (2 * n) * 2 ^ n <= 3 ^ (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        2 ^ (2 * (n + 1)) * 2 ^ (n + 1) =
            8 * (2 ^ (2 * n) * 2 ^ n) := by
          have htwo : 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2 := by omega
          have hsucc : 2 ^ (n + 1) = 2 ^ n * 2 := by
            rw [Nat.pow_succ]
          rw [htwo, Nat.pow_add, hsucc]
          change
            (2 ^ (2 * n) * 4) * (2 ^ n * 2) =
              (4 * 2) * (2 ^ (2 * n) * 2 ^ n)
          simp only [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm]
        _ <= 9 * 3 ^ (2 * n) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) ih
        _ = 3 ^ (2 * (n + 1)) := by
          have hthree : 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2 := by omega
          rw [hthree, Nat.pow_add]
          simp [Nat.mul_comm]

name: cantorStageResidual_even_le_baseTail_two
statement:
theorem cantorStageResidual_even_le_baseTail_two (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (cantorStageResidual (2 * n))
      (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := F.nat (2 ^ (2 * n))
  let B := F.nat (3 ^ (2 * n))
  let C := F.nat (2 ^ n)
  have hnat := cantor_even_stage_nat_inequality n
  have hrealRaw := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_le_nat_of_le F hnat
  have hreal : F.le (F.mul A C) B := by
    unfold A B C
    rwa [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_mul F]
  have hBpos : F.lt F.zero B := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F
    have hpow : 0 < 3 ^ (2 * n) := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
    omega
  have hCpos : F.lt F.zero C := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F
    have hpow : 0 < 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
    omega
  have hBne : Not (B = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hBpos) hzero.symm
  have hCne : Not (C = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hCpos) hzero.symm
  have hCinvNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv C) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hCpos)
  have hBinvNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv B) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hBpos)
  have hdivideC :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F hreal hCinvNonneg
  have hA_le : F.le A (F.mul B (F.inv C)) := by
    have hleft : F.mul (F.mul A C) (F.inv C) = A := by
      calc
        F.mul (F.mul A C) (F.inv C) =
            F.mul A (F.mul C (F.inv C)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul A F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hCne]
        _ = A := F.mul_one A
    rwa [hleft] at hdivideC
  have hdivideB :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F hA_le hBinvNonneg
  have hright :
      F.mul (F.mul B (F.inv C)) (F.inv B) = F.inv C := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul B (F.inv C)) (F.inv B) =
          F.mul B (F.mul (F.inv C) (F.inv B)) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul B (F.mul (F.inv B) (F.inv C)) := by
        rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv C) (F.inv B)]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul B (F.inv B)) (F.inv C) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul F.one (F.inv C) := by
        rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hBne]
      _ = F.inv C := F.one_mul (F.inv C)
  rw [hright] at hdivideB
  unfold cantorStageResidual RealTheory.baseTail
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.basePow
  change F.le (F.mul A (F.inv B)) (F.inv C)
  exact hdivideB

name: cantorStageResidual_eventually_lt
statement:
theorem cantorStageResidual_eventually_lt
    (eps : Point)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.lt (cantorStageResidual (2 * n)) eps)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htail := RealTheory.baseTail_tendsto_zero_all validBase_two
  have hevent := RealTheory.seqTendsto_eventually htail heps
  cases hevent with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have hsmall := hN n hn
      change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n) F.zero)) eps at hsmall
      rw [F.sub_zero] at hsmall
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (RealTheory.baseTail_pos validBase_two n))] at hsmall
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
        (cantorStageResidual_even_le_baseTail_two n) hsmall

name: cantorCoverRadius_pos
statement:
private theorem cantorCoverRadius_pos
    {eps : Point} (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (cantorCoverRadius eps n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcountNat : Not (2 ^ n = 0) := by
    have hpow : 0 < 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
    omega
  have hcount : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (2 ^ n)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F hcountNat
  have hquarter : F.lt F.zero (F.half (F.half eps)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps)
  unfold cantorCoverRadius
  exact F.mul_pos hquarter (F.inv_pos hcount)

name: add_sub_self_eq
statement:
private theorem add_sub_self_eq
    (x d : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add x d) x = d
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcancel :
      F.add (F.sub (F.add x d) x) x = F.add d x := by
    calc
      F.add (F.sub (F.add x d) x) x = F.add x d :=
        F.sub_add_cancel (F.add x d) x
      _ = F.add d x := by rw [F.add_comm]
  exact F.add_right_cancel hcancel

name: self_sub_sub_eq
statement:
private theorem self_sub_sub_eq
    (x d : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub x (RealTheory.sub x d) = d
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcancel :
      F.add (F.sub x (F.sub x d)) (F.sub x d) =
        F.add d (F.sub x d) := by
    calc
      F.add (F.sub x (F.sub x d)) (F.sub x d) = x :=
        F.sub_add_cancel x (F.sub x d)
      _ = F.add (F.sub x d) d := by
        symm
        exact F.sub_add_cancel x d
      _ = F.add d (F.sub x d) := by rw [F.add_comm]
  exact F.add_right_cancel hcancel

name: expandedInterval_length
statement:
private theorem expandedInterval_length
    (left right radius : Point) :
    intervalLength
        (RealTheory.sub left radius)
        (RealTheory.add right radius) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.sub right left)
        (RealTheory.add radius radius)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold intervalLength
  have hleft : F.sub (F.add right radius) right = radius :=
    add_sub_self_eq right radius
  have hright : F.sub left (F.sub left radius) = radius :=
    self_sub_sub_eq left radius
  have hinner := F.sub_add_sub_cancel right left (F.sub left radius)
  rw [hright] at hinner
  have houter :=
    F.sub_add_sub_cancel (F.add right radius) right (F.sub left radius)
  rw [hleft, <- hinner] at houter
  calc
    F.sub (F.add right radius) (F.sub left radius) =
        F.add radius (F.add (F.sub right left) radius) := houter.symm
    _ = F.add (F.add radius (F.sub right left)) radius := by
      rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.sub right left) radius) radius := by
      rw [F.add_comm radius (F.sub right left)]
    _ = F.add (F.sub right left) (F.add radius radius) := by
      rw [F.add_assoc]

name: cantorCoverLength_active
statement:
private theorem cantorCoverLength_active
    {eps : Point} {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    coverLength (cantorCoverLeft eps n) (cantorCoverRight eps n) k =
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.baseTail 3 n)
        (RealTheory.add (cantorCoverRadius eps n) (cantorCoverRadius eps n))
proof:
:= by
  unfold coverLength cantorCoverLeft cantorCoverRight
  rw [if_pos hk, if_pos hk]
  rw [expandedInterval_length]
  rw [cantorStageCylinder_width]

name: cantorCoverLength_inactive
statement:
private theorem cantorCoverLength_inactive
    {eps : Point} {n k : Nat}
    (hk : Not (k < 2 ^ n)) :
    coverLength (cantorCoverLeft eps n) (cantorCoverRight eps n) k =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold coverLength cantorCoverLeft cantorCoverRight intervalLength
  rw [if_neg hk, if_neg hk]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.zero

name: cantorCover_ordered
statement:
private theorem cantorCover_ordered
    {eps : Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    (n k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le (cantorCoverLeft eps n k) (cantorCoverRight eps n k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hk : k < 2 ^ n
  · unfold cantorCoverLeft cantorCoverRight
    rw [if_pos hk, if_pos hk]
    have hradius := cantorCoverRadius_pos heps n
    have hleft :
        F.lt
          (F.sub (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) (cantorCoverRadius eps n))
          (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hradius
    have hright :
        F.lt
          (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k)
          (F.add (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) (cantorCoverRadius eps n)) := by
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hradius
        (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k)
      change
        F.lt
          (F.add (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) F.zero)
          (F.add (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) (cantorCoverRadius eps n)) at h
      rwa [F.add_zero] at h
    exact F.le_trans (F.le_of_lt hleft)
      (F.le_trans (cantorStageCylinder_ordered n k) (F.le_of_lt hright))
  · unfold cantorCoverLeft cantorCoverRight
    rw [if_neg hk, if_neg hk]
    exact F.le_refl F.zero

name: cantorCountableOpenIntervalCover
statement:
private theorem cantorCountableOpenIntervalCover
    {eps : Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    (n : Nat) :
    CountableOpenIntervalCover CantorSet
      (cantorCoverLeft eps n) (cantorCoverRight eps n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro (cantorCover_ordered heps n) ?_
  intro x hx
  cases cantorSet_mem_stageCylinder hx n with
  | intro k hk =>
      refine Exists.intro k ?_
      unfold OpenInterval cantorCoverLeft cantorCoverRight
      rw [if_pos hk.left, if_pos hk.left]
      have hradius := cantorCoverRadius_pos heps n
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact F.lt_of_lt_of_le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hradius)
          hk.right.left
      · have hright :
            F.lt
              (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k)
              (F.add (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) (cantorCoverRadius eps n)) := by
          have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hradius
            (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k)
          change
            F.lt
              (F.add (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) F.zero)
              (F.add (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) (cantorCoverRadius eps n)) at h
          rwa [F.add_zero] at h
        exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hk.right.right hright

name: cantorCoverRadius_total
statement:
private theorem cantorCoverRadius_total
    (eps : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (2 ^ n))
        (RealTheory.add (cantorCoverRadius eps n) (cantorCoverRadius eps n)) =
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.half eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let count := F.nat (2 ^ n)
  have hcountNat : Not (2 ^ n = 0) := by
    have hpow : 0 < 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
    omega
  have hcountPos : F.lt F.zero count :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F hcountNat
  have hcountNe : Not (count = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (F.ne_of_lt hcountPos) hzero.symm
  have hradiusDouble :
      F.add (cantorCoverRadius eps n) (cantorCoverRadius eps n) =
        F.mul (F.half eps) (F.inv count) := by
    unfold cantorCoverRadius
    change
      F.add
          (F.mul (F.half (F.half eps)) (F.inv count))
          (F.mul (F.half (F.half eps)) (F.inv count)) =
        F.mul (F.half eps) (F.inv count)
    rw [<- F.add_mul]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F (F.half eps)]
  change
    F.mul count
        (F.add (cantorCoverRadius eps n) (cantorCoverRadius eps n)) =
      F.half eps
  rw [hradiusDouble]
  calc
    F.mul count (F.mul (F.half eps) (F.inv count)) =
        F.mul (F.mul count (F.half eps)) (F.inv count) := by
      rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.half eps) count) (F.inv count) := by
      rw [F.mul_comm count (F.half eps)]
    _ = F.mul (F.half eps) (F.mul count (F.inv count)) := by
      rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.half eps) F.one := by
      rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hcountNe]
    _ = F.half eps := F.mul_one (F.half eps)

name: cantorCoverPrefixSum
statement:
private theorem cantorCoverPrefixSum
    (eps : Point) (n : Nat) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (coverLength (cantorCoverLeft eps n) (cantorCoverRight eps n))
        (2 ^ n) =
      RealTheory.add (cantorStageResidual n)
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.half eps)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let unit := F.add (RealTheory.baseTail 3 n)
    (F.add (cantorCoverRadius eps n) (cantorCoverRadius eps n))
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
  have hsum := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F (2 ^ n)
    (fun k hk => cantorCoverLength_active (eps := eps) hk)
  change
    F.finiteSum
        (coverLength (cantorCoverLeft eps n) (cantorCoverRight eps n))
        (2 ^ n) =
      F.add (cantorStageResidual n) (F.half eps)
  rw [hsum]
  change F.finiteSum (fun _ : Nat => unit) (2 ^ n) =
    F.add (cantorStageResidual n) (F.half eps)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_const]
  unfold unit cantorStageResidual
  rw [F.mul_add]
  have hradius := cantorCoverRadius_total eps n
  change
    F.mul (F.nat (2 ^ n))
        (F.add (cantorCoverRadius eps n) (cantorCoverRadius eps n)) =
      F.half eps at hradius
  rw [hradius]
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.nat (2 ^ n)) (RealTheory.baseTail 3 n)) (F.half eps) =
      F.add (F.mul (F.nat (2 ^ n)) (RealTheory.baseTail 3 n)) (F.half eps)
  rfl

name: cantorCoverTailSum_zero
statement:
private theorem cantorCoverTailSum_zero
    (eps : Point) (n N : Nat) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (fun j : Nat =>
          coverLength (cantorCoverLeft eps n) (cantorCoverRight eps n)
            (2 ^ n + j)) N =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_eq_zero
  intro j _hj
  exact cantorCoverLength_inactive (by omega)

name: cantorCoverBudget
statement:
private theorem cantorCoverBudget
    {eps : Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    {n : Nat}
    (hresidual :
      RealTheory.lt (cantorStageResidual n)
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.half eps)) :
    CoverBudgetLt (cantorCoverLeft eps n) (cantorCoverRight eps n) eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply coverBudgetLt_of_prefix_tail_bounds
    (2 ^ n)
    (P := F.add (cantorStageResidual n) (F.half eps))
    (T := F.zero)
  · exact cantorCover_ordered heps n
  · have hpref := cantorCoverPrefixSum eps n
    change
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
          (coverLength (cantorCoverLeft eps n) (cantorCoverRight eps n))
          (2 ^ n) =
        F.add (cantorStageResidual n) (F.half eps) at hpref
    rw [hpref]
    exact F.le_refl (F.add (cantorStageResidual n) (F.half eps))
  · intro N
    have htail := cantorCoverTailSum_zero eps n N
    change
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
          (fun j : Nat =>
            coverLength (cantorCoverLeft eps n) (cantorCoverRight eps n)
              (2 ^ n + j)) N = F.zero at htail
    rw [htail]
    exact F.le_refl F.zero
  · change
      F.lt
        (F.add (F.add (cantorStageResidual n) (F.half eps)) F.zero)
        eps
    rw [F.add_zero]
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F
      hresidual (F.half eps)
    change
      F.lt
        (F.add (cantorStageResidual n) (F.half eps))
        (F.add (F.half eps) (F.half eps)) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at h

name: nullSet_cantorSet
statement: theorem nullSet_cantorSet : NullSet CantorSet
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro eps heps
  have hhalf : F.lt F.zero (F.half eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases cantorStageResidual_eventually_lt (F.half eps) hhalf with
  | intro N hN =>
      let n := 2 * N
      have hresidual : F.lt (cantorStageResidual n) (F.half eps) := by
        unfold n
        exact hN N (Nat.le_refl N)
      refine Exists.intro (cantorCoverLeft eps n) ?_
      refine Exists.intro (cantorCoverRight eps n) ?_
      exact And.intro
        (cantorCountableOpenIntervalCover heps n)
        (cantorCoverBudget heps hresidual)

name: cantorCanonicalTernaryDigits_spec
statement:
private theorem cantorCanonicalTernaryDigits_spec
    {x : Point}
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.HasCanonicalBaseExpansion 3 x
      (cantorCanonicalTernaryDigits x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold cantorCanonicalTernaryDigits
  rw [dif_pos (And.intro hx0 hx1)]
  exact Classical.choose_spec
    ((RealTheory.baseExpansionPackage validBase_three).exists_canonical
      x hx0 hx1)

name: cantorCanonicalTernaryDigit_lt_three
statement:
private theorem cantorCanonicalTernaryDigit_lt_three
    {x : Point}
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one)
    (n : Nat) :
    cantorCanonicalTernaryDigits x n < 3
proof:
:= by
  have hspec := cantorCanonicalTernaryDigits_spec hx0 hx1
  have hbase := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.canonical_hasBaseExpansion
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hspec
  exact hbase.right.left n

name: cantorStageDigit_code_of_prefix_cantor
statement:
private theorem cantorStageDigit_code_of_prefix_cantor
    {digits : Nat -> Nat} :
    forall n i : Nat,
      (forall j : Nat, j < n ->
        RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed (digits j)) ->
      i < n ->
        cantorStageDigit n (cantorStageCode digits n) i = digits i
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro i _ hi
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
      intro i hallowed hi
      unfold cantorStageDigit cantorStageCode
      by_cases hin : i < n
      · rw [if_pos hin]
        have hbit := cantorStageBit_lt_two digits n
        have hdiv :
            (2 * cantorStageCode digits n + cantorStageBit digits n) / 2 =
              cantorStageCode digits n := by
          omega
        rw [hdiv]
        exact ih i (fun j hj => hallowed j (by omega)) hin
      · rw [if_neg hin]
        have hieq : i = n := by omega
        rw [if_pos hieq]
        have hbit := cantorStageBit_lt_two digits n
        have hmod :
            (2 * cantorStageCode digits n + cantorStageBit digits n) % 2 =
              cantorStageBit digits n := by
          omega
        rw [hmod]
        subst i
        exact cantorStageBit_double (hallowed n (by omega))

name: cantorStageDigit_zero_rank
statement:
private theorem cantorStageDigit_zero_rank :
    forall n i : Nat, cantorStageDigit n 0 i = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro i
      rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      intro i
      unfold cantorStageDigit
      by_cases hi : i < n
      · rw [if_pos hi]
        simpa using ih i
      · rw [if_neg hi]
        by_cases hieq : i = n
        · rw [if_pos hieq]
        · rw [if_neg hieq]

name: cantorStageLeftEndpoint_succ
statement:
private theorem cantorStageLeftEndpoint_succ (n k : Nat) :
    cantorStageLeftEndpoint (n + 1) k =
      RealTheory.add
        (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k / 2))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (2 * (k % 2)))
          (RealTheory.baseTail 3 (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold cantorStageLeftEndpoint
  change
    F.baseExpansionPartial 3 (cantorStageDigit (n + 1) k) (n + 1) =
      F.add
        (F.baseExpansionPartial 3 (cantorStageDigit n (k / 2)) n)
        (F.mul (F.nat (2 * (k % 2))) (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_succ]
  have hprefix :
      F.baseExpansionPartial 3 (cantorStageDigit (n + 1) k) n =
        F.baseExpansionPartial 3 (cantorStageDigit n (k / 2)) n :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_eq_of_prefix_eq F 3 n
      (by
        intro i hi
        exact cantorStageDigit_succ_of_lt hi)
  rw [hprefix]
  have hlast : cantorStageDigit (n + 1) k n = 2 * (k % 2) := by
    unfold cantorStageDigit
    rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos rfl]
  rw [hlast]
  rfl

name: cantorStageLeftEndpoint_zero
statement:
theorem cantorStageLeftEndpoint_zero (n : Nat) :
    cantorStageLeftEndpoint n 0 = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold cantorStageLeftEndpoint
  have hdigits : cantorStageDigit n 0 = (fun _ : Nat => 0) := by
    funext i
    exact cantorStageDigit_zero_rank n i
  rw [hdigits]
  exact RealTheory.zeroDigitsPartial_zero 3 n

name: cantorStageLeftEndpoint_succ_even
statement:
private theorem cantorStageLeftEndpoint_succ_even
    (n k : Nat) (hk : k % 2 = 0) :
    cantorStageLeftEndpoint (n + 1) k =
      cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k / 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [cantorStageLeftEndpoint_succ, hk]
  change
    F.add (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k / 2))
        (F.mul (F.nat (2 * 0)) (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1))) =
      cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k / 2)
  rw [Nat.mul_zero, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero,
    F.zero_mul, F.add_zero]

name: cantorStageLeftEndpoint_succ_odd
statement:
private theorem cantorStageLeftEndpoint_succ_odd
    (n k : Nat) (hk : k % 2 = 1) :
    cantorStageLeftEndpoint (n + 1) k =
      RealTheory.add
        (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k / 2))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat 2)
          (RealTheory.baseTail 3 (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cantorStageLeftEndpoint_succ, hk]

name: cantorStageRightEndpoint_succ_even
statement:
private theorem cantorStageRightEndpoint_succ_even
    (n k : Nat) (hk : k % 2 = 0) :
    cantorStageRightEndpoint (n + 1) k =
      RealTheory.add
        (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k / 2))
        (RealTheory.baseTail 3 (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold cantorStageRightEndpoint
  rw [cantorStageLeftEndpoint_succ_even n k hk]

name: cantorStageRightEndpoint_succ_odd
statement:
private theorem cantorStageRightEndpoint_succ_odd
    (n k : Nat) (hk : k % 2 = 1) :
    cantorStageRightEndpoint (n + 1) k =
      cantorStageRightEndpoint n (k / 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold cantorStageRightEndpoint
  rw [cantorStageLeftEndpoint_succ_odd n k hk]
  change
    F.add
        (F.add (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k / 2))
          (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1))))
        (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)) =
      F.add (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k / 2)) (F.baseTail 3 n)
  rw [F.add_assoc]
  congr 1
  calc
    F.add (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)))
        (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)) =
        F.add (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)))
          (F.mul F.one (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1))) := by
            rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.add (F.nat 2) F.one) (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.nat 3) (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)) := by
          congr 1
    _ = F.baseTail 3 n := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail_eq_mul_baseTail_succ
            F validBase_three n]

name: cantorStageCylinders_adjacent_lt
statement:
theorem cantorStageCylinders_adjacent_lt
    {n k : Nat} (hk : k + 1 < 2 ^ n) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k)
      (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero =>
      simp at hk
  | succ n ih =>
      have hmod : k % 2 < 2 := Nat.mod_lt k (by omega)
      by_cases heven : k % 2 = 0
      · have hnextDiv : (k + 1) / 2 = k / 2 := by omega
        have hnextMod : (k + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
        rw [cantorStageRightEndpoint_succ_even n k heven]
        rw [cantorStageLeftEndpoint_succ_odd n (k + 1) hnextMod,
          hnextDiv]
        have htail := RealTheory.baseTail_pos validBase_three (n + 1)
        have hdouble :
            F.lt (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1))
              (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1))) := by
          have h := F.add_lt_add_left htail (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1))
          rw [F.add_zero] at h
          have htwo :
              F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)) =
                F.add (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1))
                  (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)) := by
            calc
              F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)) =
                  F.mul (F.add (F.nat 1) F.one)
                    (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)) := by
                      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ]
              _ = F.add
                    (F.mul (F.nat 1) (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)))
                    (F.mul F.one (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1))) := by
                      rw [F.add_mul]
              _ = F.add (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1))
                    (F.baseTail 3 (n + 1)) := by
                      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_one, F.one_mul]
          rwa [htwo]
        exact F.add_lt_add_left hdouble
          (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k / 2))
      · have hodd : k % 2 = 1 := by omega
        have hnextDiv : (k + 1) / 2 = k / 2 + 1 := by omega
        have hnextMod : (k + 1) % 2 = 0 := by omega
        have hk' : k / 2 + 1 < 2 ^ n := by
          rw [Nat.pow_succ] at hk
          omega
        rw [cantorStageRightEndpoint_succ_odd n k hodd]
        rw [cantorStageLeftEndpoint_succ_even n (k + 1) hnextMod,
          hnextDiv]
        exact ih hk'

name: cantorStageRightEndpoint_last_eq_one
statement:
theorem cantorStageRightEndpoint_last_eq_one (n : Nat) :
    cantorStageRightEndpoint n (2 ^ n - 1) = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      unfold cantorStageRightEndpoint
      rw [cantorStageLeftEndpoint_zero]
      change F.add F.zero (F.baseTail 3 0) = F.one
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail_zero, F.zero_add]
  | succ n ih =>
      have hpowPos : 0 < 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
      have hmod : (2 ^ (n + 1) - 1) % 2 = 1 := by
        rw [Nat.pow_succ]
        omega
      have hdiv : (2 ^ (n + 1) - 1) / 2 = 2 ^ n - 1 := by
        rw [Nat.pow_succ]
        omega
      rw [cantorStageRightEndpoint_succ_odd n (2 ^ (n + 1) - 1) hmod,
        hdiv, ih]

name: cantorStageEndpoints_mem_unitInterval
statement:
theorem cantorStageEndpoints_mem_unitInterval
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    And
      (And
        (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k))
        (RealTheory.le (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) RealTheory.one))
      (And
        (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k))
        (RealTheory.le (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) RealTheory.one))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hranks := cantorStageEndpoint_rankExpansions hk
  cases hranks.left with
  | intro leftDigits hleft =>
      cases hranks.right with
      | intro rightDigits hright =>
          have hleftBase :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.restricted_hasBaseExpansion F hleft.left
          have hrightBase :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.restricted_hasBaseExpansion F hright.left
          exact And.intro
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansion_value_mem_unitInterval
              F hleftBase)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansion_value_mem_unitInterval
              F hrightBase)

name: cantorStageCylinder_lt
statement:
theorem cantorStageCylinder_lt (n k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k)
      (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply F.lt_of_le_of_not_le
    (cantorStageCylinder_ordered n k)
  intro hreverse
  have heq := F.le_antisymm
    (cantorStageCylinder_ordered n k) hreverse
  have hwidth := cantorStageCylinder_width n k
  rw [heq] at hwidth
  change F.sub _ _ = F.baseTail 3 n at hwidth
  rw [F.sub_self] at hwidth
  have htail := RealTheory.baseTail_pos validBase_three n
  change F.lt F.zero (F.baseTail 3 n) at htail
  rw [<- hwidth] at htail
  exact F.lt_irrefl F.zero htail

name: exists_cantorStageGap_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem exists_cantorStageGap_of_not_mem
    {x : Point}
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one)
    (hxC : Not (CantorSet x)) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat =>
      Exists (fun k : Nat =>
        And (k + 1 < 2 ^ n)
          (And
            (RealTheory.lt (cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) x)
            (RealTheory.lt x (cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k + 1))))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let digits := cantorCanonicalTernaryDigits x
  have hspec : RealTheory.HasCanonicalBaseExpansion 3 x digits := by
    exact cantorCanonicalTernaryDigits_spec hx0 hx1
  have hone : Exists (fun j : Nat => digits j = 1) := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hnone
    have hrestricted :
        RealTheory.RestrictedBaseDigitStream 3
          RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed digits := by
      refine And.intro hspec.right.left.left ?_
      intro i
      have hbound : digits i < 3 := by
        exact cantorCanonicalTernaryDigit_lt_three hx0 hx1 i
      by_cases hzero : digits i = 0
      · unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
        unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
        exact Or.inl hzero
      · have hnotOne : Not (digits i = 1) := by
          intro hi
          exact hnone (Exists.intro i hi)
        have htwo : digits i = 2 := by omega
        unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
        unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
        exact Or.inr htwo
    apply hxC
    refine Exists.intro digits ?_
    exact And.intro validBase_three
      (And.intro hrestricted hspec.right.right)
  let j := Tautology.Nat.least (fun i : Nat => digits i = 1) hone
  have hj : digits j = 1 := by
    exact Tautology.Nat.least_spec (fun i : Nat => digits i = 1) hone
  have hbefore : forall i : Nat, i < j -> Not (digits i = 1) := by
    intro i hi hione
    have hmin := Tautology.Nat.least_min
      (fun r : Nat => digits r = 1) hone hione
    change j <= i at hmin
    omega
  have hallowed :
      forall i : Nat, i < j ->
        RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed (digits i) := by
    intro i hi
    have hbound : digits i < 3 := by
      exact cantorCanonicalTernaryDigit_lt_three hx0 hx1 i
    by_cases hzero : digits i = 0
    · unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
      exact Or.inl hzero
    · have htwo : digits i = 2 := by
        have hnotOne := hbefore i hi
        omega
      unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed
      exact Or.inr htwo
  let r := cantorStageCode digits j
  have hr : r < 2 ^ j := by
    exact cantorStageCode_lt_pow digits j
  have hgapBound : 2 * r + 1 < 2 ^ (j + 1) := by
    rw [Nat.pow_succ]
    omega
  have hlowerPrefix :
      forall i : Nat, i < j ->
        cantorStageDigit (j + 1) (2 * r) i = digits i := by
    intro i hi
    rw [cantorStageDigit_succ_of_lt hi]
    have hdiv : 2 * r / 2 = r := by omega
    rw [hdiv]
    exact cantorStageDigit_code_of_prefix_cantor j i hallowed hi
  have hupperPrefix :
      forall i : Nat, i < j ->
        cantorStageDigit (j + 1) (2 * r + 1) i = digits i := by
    intro i hi
    rw [cantorStageDigit_succ_of_lt hi]
    have hdiv : (2 * r + 1) / 2 = r := by omega
    rw [hdiv]
    exact cantorStageDigit_code_of_prefix_cantor j i hallowed hi
  have hlowerDigit : cantorStageDigit (j + 1) (2 * r) j = 0 := by
    unfold cantorStageDigit
    rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos rfl]
    have hmod : (2 * r) % 2 = 0 := by omega
    rw [hmod]
  have hupperDigit : cantorStageDigit (j + 1) (2 * r + 1) j = 2 := by
    unfold cantorStageDigit
    rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos rfl]
    have hmod : (2 * r + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
    rw [hmod]
  have hlowerBridge :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionEnvelope_succ_le_partial_succ_of_digit_lt
      F validBase_three hlowerPrefix (by rw [hlowerDigit, hj]; omega)
  change
    F.le
      (cantorStageRightEndpoint (j + 1) (2 * r))
      (F.baseExpansionPartial 3 digits (j + 1)) at hlowerBridge
  have hbase := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.canonical_hasBaseExpansion F hspec
  have hpartialLe :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_le_value F hbase (j + 1)
  have hlowerLe :
      F.le (cantorStageRightEndpoint (j + 1) (2 * r)) x :=
    F.le_trans hlowerBridge hpartialLe
  have hlowerLt :
      F.lt (cantorStageRightEndpoint (j + 1) (2 * r)) x := by
    apply F.lt_of_le_of_not_le hlowerLe
    intro hxle
    have heq := F.le_antisymm hlowerLe hxle
    apply hxC
    rw [<- heq]
    exact (cantorStageCylinderEndpoint_mem_cantorSet
      (by omega : 2 * r < 2 ^ (j + 1))).right
  have hxEnvelope :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.canonicalBaseExpansion_value_lt_envelope
      F hspec (j + 1)
  have hupperBridge :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionEnvelope_succ_le_partial_succ_of_digit_lt
      F validBase_three
        (fun i hi => (hupperPrefix i hi).symm)
        (by rw [hj, hupperDigit]; omega)
  change
    F.le
      (F.baseExpansionEnvelope 3 digits (j + 1))
      (cantorStageLeftEndpoint (j + 1) (2 * r + 1)) at hupperBridge
  have hupperLt :
      F.lt x (cantorStageLeftEndpoint (j + 1) (2 * r + 1)) :=
    F.lt_of_lt_of_le hxEnvelope hupperBridge
  exact Exists.intro (j + 1)
    (Exists.intro (2 * r)
      (And.intro hgapBound (And.intro hlowerLt hupperLt)))

name: coverLength_nonnegative_of_ordered
statement:
theorem coverLength_nonnegative_of_ordered
    {a b : Nat -> Point}
    (hab : forall n : Nat, RealTheory.le (a n) (b n)) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.NonnegativeSeq
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (coverLength a b)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  unfold coverLength intervalLength
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (hab n)

statement:
theorem coverLength_nonnegative_of_cover
    {E : Point -> Prop} {a b : Nat -> Point}
    (hcover : CountableOpenIntervalCover E a b) :

name: coverLength_seriesPartialSum_add_length
statement:
theorem coverLength_seriesPartialSum_add_length
    (a b : Nat -> Point) (K N : Nat) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (coverLength a b) (K + N) =
      RealTheory.add
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (coverLength a b) K)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (fun j : Nat => coverLength a b (K + j)) N)
proof:
:= by
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_add_length
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (coverLength a b) K N

name: coverBudgetLt_of_partialSum_le
statement:
theorem coverBudgetLt_of_partialSum_le
    {a b : Nat -> Point} {B eps : Point}
    (hbound :
      forall N : Nat,
        RealTheory.le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            (coverLength a b) N)
          B)
    (hlt : RealTheory.lt B eps) :
    CoverBudgetLt a b eps
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (hbound N) hlt

name: coverBudgetLt_of_prefix_tail_bounds
statement:
theorem coverBudgetLt_of_prefix_tail_bounds
    {a b : Nat -> Point} {P T eps : Point} (K : Nat)
    (hordered : forall n : Nat, RealTheory.le (a n) (b n))
    (hprefix :
      RealTheory.le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (coverLength a b) K)
        P)
    (htail :
      forall N : Nat,
        RealTheory.le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            (fun j : Nat => coverLength a b (K + j)) N)
          T)
    (hbudget : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add P T) eps) :
    CoverBudgetLt a b eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnonneg :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.NonnegativeSeq F
        (coverLength a b) :=
    coverLength_nonnegative_of_ordered hordered
  have hmono :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.MonotoneIncreasing F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
          (coverLength a b)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum_monotone F hnonneg
  have hT_nonneg : F.le F.zero T := by
    have h0 := htail 0
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum_zero] at h0
    exact h0
  have hP_le_add : F.le P (RealTheory.add P T) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hT_nonneg P
    change F.le (F.add P F.zero) (F.add P T) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  intro N
  by_cases hNK : N <= K
  · have hpartial_le_prefix :
        F.le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
            (coverLength a b) N)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
            (coverLength a b) K) :=
      hmono N K hNK
    have hpartial_le_P :
        F.le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
            (coverLength a b) N)
          P :=
      F.le_trans hpartial_le_prefix hprefix
    exact
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
        (F.le_trans hpartial_le_P hP_le_add) hbudget
  · have hKleN : K <= N := by
      omega
    have hsplit :
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
            (coverLength a b) N =
          RealTheory.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
              (coverLength a b) K)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                coverLength a b (K + j)) (N - K)) := by
      have hKN : K + (N - K) = N := Nat.add_sub_of_le hKleN
      have hbase := coverLength_seriesPartialSum_add_length a b K (N - K)
      rwa [hKN] at hbase
    have hsum_le :
        F.le
          (RealTheory.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
              (coverLength a b) K)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                coverLength a b (K + j)) (N - K)))
          (RealTheory.add P T) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hprefix (htail (N - K))
    rw [hsplit]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hsum_le hbudget

name: centeredInterval_length
statement:
theorem centeredInterval_length (x d : Point) :
    intervalLength (RealTheory.sub x d) (RealTheory.add x d) =
      RealTheory.add d d
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold intervalLength RealTheory.sub RealTheory.add
  change F.sub (F.add x d) (F.sub x d) = F.add d d
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_right_cancel F (a := F.sub x d)
  calc
    F.add (F.sub (F.add x d) (F.sub x d)) (F.sub x d) =
        F.add x d := by
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F]
    _ = F.add (F.add d d) (F.sub x d) := by
        symm
        calc
          F.add (F.add d d) (F.sub x d) =
              F.add d (F.add d (F.sub x d)) := by
              rw [F.add_assoc]
          _ = F.add d (F.add (F.sub x d) d) := by
              rw [F.add_comm d (F.sub x d)]
          _ = F.add d x := by
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x d]
          _ = F.add x d := F.add_comm d x

name: singletonCoverLength_zero
statement:
theorem singletonCoverLength_zero (x d : Point) :
    coverLength (singletonCoverLeft x d) (singletonCoverRight x d) 0 =
      RealTheory.add d d
proof:
:= by
  unfold coverLength singletonCoverLeft singletonCoverRight
  exact centeredInterval_length x d

name: singletonCoverLength_succ
statement:
theorem singletonCoverLength_succ (x d : Point) (n : Nat) :
    coverLength
        (singletonCoverLeft x d)
        (singletonCoverRight x d)
        (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold coverLength intervalLength singletonCoverLeft singletonCoverRight
  unfold RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F x

name: nullSet_mono
statement:
theorem nullSet_mono
    {E F : Point -> Prop}
    (hEF : forall x : Point, E x -> F x)
    (hF : NullSet F) :
    NullSet E
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hF eps heps with
  | intro a ha =>
      cases ha with
      | intro b hb =>
          refine Exists.intro a ?_
          refine Exists.intro b ?_
          constructor
          · constructor
            · exact hb.left.left
            · intro x hx
              exact hb.left.right x (hEF x hx)
          · exact hb.right

name: nullSet_empty
statement:
theorem nullSet_empty :
    NullSet (fun _ : Point => False)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine Exists.intro (fun _ : Nat => RealTheory.zero) ?_
  refine Exists.intro (fun _ : Nat => RealTheory.zero) ?_
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro n
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
    · intro x hx
      cases hx
  · intro N
    have hsum :
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
            (coverLength
              (fun _ : Nat => RealTheory.zero)
              (fun _ : Nat => RealTheory.zero))
            N =
          F.zero := by
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_eq_zero F
      intro k hk
      unfold coverLength intervalLength RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.zero
    change
      F.lt
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
          (coverLength
            (fun _ : Nat => RealTheory.zero)
            (fun _ : Nat => RealTheory.zero))
          N)
        eps
    rw [hsum]
    exact heps

name: nullSet_singleton
statement:
theorem nullSet_singleton (x : Point) :
    NullSet (fun y : Point => y = x)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps)
  refine Exists.intro (singletonCoverLeft x d) ?_
  refine Exists.intro (singletonCoverRight x d) ?_
  have hhalf_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have hd_pos : F.lt F.zero d :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hhalf_pos
  have hleft_lt_x : F.lt (F.sub x d) x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hd_pos
  have hx_lt_right : F.lt x (F.add x d) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hd_pos x
    change F.lt (F.add x F.zero) (F.add x d) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hleft_lt_right : F.lt (F.sub x d) (F.add x d) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hleft_lt_x hx_lt_right
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro n
      cases n with
      | zero =>
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hleft_lt_right
      | succ n =>
          exact RealTheory.le_refl x
    · intro y hy
      refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
      rw [hy]
      exact And.intro hleft_lt_x hx_lt_right
  · intro N
    have hhalf_lt_eps :
        F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps) eps :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps
    cases N with
    | zero =>
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum_zero]
        exact heps
    | succ n =>
        have hsum :
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
                (coverLength
                  (singletonCoverLeft x d)
                  (singletonCoverRight x d))
                (n + 1) =
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps := by
          induction n with
          | zero =>
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum_succ]
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum_zero]
              rw [singletonCoverLength_zero]
              unfold d
              unfold RealTheory.add
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half]
              rw [F.zero_add]
          | succ n ih =>
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum_succ]
              rw [ih]
              rw [singletonCoverLength_succ]
              unfold RealTheory.zero
              rw [F.add_zero]
        rw [hsum]
        exact hhalf_lt_eps

name: coverLength_diagonalFlatten
statement:
theorem coverLength_diagonalFlatten
    (a b : Nat -> Nat -> Point) (m : Nat) :
    coverLength
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.diagonalFlatten a)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.diagonalFlatten b)
        m =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.diagonalFlatten
        (fun i j : Nat => coverLength (a i) (b i) j)
        m
proof:
:= by
  unfold coverLength intervalLength
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.diagonalFlatten
  cases Foundation.Cardinal.diagonalEnum m with
  | mk i j => rfl

name: countableOpenIntervalCover_countableUnion_of_dyadicBudget
statement:
theorem countableOpenIntervalCover_countableUnion_of_dyadicBudget
    {A : Nat -> Point -> Prop} {eps : Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    (left right : Nat -> Nat -> Point)
    (hrowSpec :
      forall n : Nat,
        And
          (CountableOpenIntervalCover (A n) (left n) (right n))
          (CoverBudgetLt (left n) (right n)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadicBudget
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps n))) :
    Exists
      (fun flatLeft : Nat -> Point =>
        Exists
          (fun flatRight : Nat -> Point =>
            And
              (CountableOpenIntervalCover (CountableUnion A)
                flatLeft flatRight)
              (CoverBudgetLt flatLeft flatRight eps)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let flatLeft : Nat -> Point :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.diagonalFlatten left
  let flatRight : Nat -> Point :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.diagonalFlatten right
  refine Exists.intro flatLeft ?_
  refine Exists.intro flatRight ?_
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro m
      unfold flatLeft flatRight
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.diagonalFlatten
      cases Foundation.Cardinal.diagonalEnum m with
      | mk i j =>
          exact (hrowSpec i).left.left j
    · intro x hx
      cases hx with
      | intro i hxi =>
          cases (hrowSpec i).left.right x hxi with
          | intro j hij =>
              refine Exists.intro
                (Foundation.Cardinal.triangular (i + j) + j) ?_
              unfold flatLeft flatRight
              have hleft :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.diagonalFlatten_triangular_add
                  left i j
              have hright :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.diagonalFlatten_triangular_add
                  right i j
              rw [hleft, hright]
              exact hij
  · intro N
    let term : Nat -> Nat -> Point :=
      fun i j : Nat => coverLength (left i) (right i) j
    have hflatLength :
        forall m : Nat,
          coverLength flatLeft flatRight m =
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.diagonalFlatten term m := by
      intro m
      unfold term flatLeft flatRight
      exact coverLength_diagonalFlatten left right m
    have hsum_eq :
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
            (coverLength flatLeft flatRight)
            N =
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.diagonalFlatten term)
            N := by
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
      intro k hk
      exact hflatLength k
    have hterm_nonneg :
        forall i j : Nat, F.le F.zero (term i j) := by
      intro i j
      unfold term
      exact coverLength_nonnegative_of_cover (hrowSpec i).left j
    have hrow_budget :
        forall i n : Nat,
          F.le
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F (term i) n)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadicBudget F eps i) := by
      intro i n
      have hlt := (hrowSpec i).right n
      change
        F.lt
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
            (coverLength (left i) (right i)) n)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadicBudget F eps i) at hlt
      unfold term
      change
        F.le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
            (coverLength (left i) (right i)) n)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadicBudget F eps i)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlt
    have hbudget :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.diagonalFlatten_dyadicBudget_lt
        F hterm_nonneg hrow_budget heps N
    rw [hsum_eq]
    exact hbudget

name: nullSet_countableUnion
statement:
theorem nullSet_countableUnion
    {A : Nat -> Point -> Prop}
    (hA : forall n : Nat, NullSet (A n)) :
    NullSet (CountableUnion A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt F.zero eps at heps
  let budget : Nat -> Point :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadicBudget F eps
  have hbudget_pos :
      forall n : Nat, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (budget n) := by
    intro n
    change F.lt F.zero (budget n)
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadicBudget_pos F heps n
  let coverExists :
      forall n : Nat,
        Exists
          (fun a : Nat -> Point =>
            Exists
              (fun b : Nat -> Point =>
                And
                  (CountableOpenIntervalCover (A n) a b)
                  (CoverBudgetLt a b (budget n)))) :=
    fun n => hA n (budget n) (hbudget_pos n)
  let left : Nat -> Nat -> Point :=
    fun n => Classical.choose (coverExists n)
  let right : Nat -> Nat -> Point :=
    fun n => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (coverExists n))
  have hrowSpec :
      forall n : Nat,
        And
          (CountableOpenIntervalCover (A n) (left n) (right n))
          (CoverBudgetLt (left n) (right n) (budget n)) := by
    intro n
    exact Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (coverExists n))
  apply countableOpenIntervalCover_countableUnion_of_dyadicBudget
    heps left right
  intro n
  simpa [budget] using hrowSpec n

name: nullSet_of_countableSet
statement:
theorem nullSet_of_countableSet
    {S : Point -> Prop}
    (hS : Foundation.Cardinal.CountableSet S) :
    NullSet S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases hS with
  | intro e he =>
      let fiber : Nat -> Point -> Prop :=
        fun n x => e n = some x
      have hfiber_null : forall n : Nat, NullSet (fiber n) := by
        intro n
        cases h : e n with
        | none =>
            exact nullSet_mono
              (E := fiber n)
              (F := fun _ : Point => False)
              (fun x hx => by
                unfold fiber at hx
                rw [h] at hx
                cases hx)
              nullSet_empty
        | some y =>
            exact nullSet_mono
              (E := fiber n)
              (F := fun x : Point => x = y)
              (fun x hx => by
                unfold fiber at hx
                rw [h] at hx
                cases hx
                rfl)
              (nullSet_singleton y)
      exact nullSet_mono
        (E := S)
        (F := CountableUnion fiber)
        (fun x hx => by
          cases he x hx with
          | intro n hn =>
              exact Exists.intro n hn)
        (nullSet_countableUnion hfiber_null)

name: nullSet_union
statement:
theorem nullSet_union
    {E F : Point -> Prop}
    (hE : NullSet E) (hF : NullSet F) :
    NullSet (Foundation.Cardinal.SetUnion E F)
proof:
:= by
  have hcount :
      NullSet
        (CountableUnion
          (Foundation.Cardinal.binaryUnionFamily E F)) :=
    nullSet_countableUnion
      (fun n : Nat =>
        match n with
        | 0 => hE
        | _ + 1 => hF)
  exact nullSet_mono
    (fun x hx => Foundation.Cardinal.binaryUnionFamily_covers hx)
    hcount

name: nullSet_pointListSet
statement:
theorem nullSet_pointListSet :
    forall P : List Point, NullSet (PointListSet P)
  | [] => by
      exact nullSet_mono
        (E := PointListSet [])
        (F := fun _ : Point => False)
        (fun x hx => by
          unfold PointListSet at hx
          cases hx)
        nullSet_empty
  | p :: ps => by
      have hp : NullSet (fun x : Point => x = p)
proof:
:=
        nullSet_singleton p
      have hps : NullSet (PointListSet ps) :=
        nullSet_pointListSet ps
      exact nullSet_mono
        (E := PointListSet (p :: ps))
        (F := Foundation.Cardinal.SetUnion
          (fun x : Point => x = p)
          (PointListSet ps))
        (fun x hx => by
          unfold PointListSet at hx
          cases hx with
          | head =>
              exact Or.inl rfl
          | tail _ htail =>
              exact Or.inr htail)
        (nullSet_union hp hps)
