name: lemniscaticAddPhiFun_continuousOn_unitOpenInterval
statement:
private theorem lemniscaticAddPhiFun_continuousOn_unitOpenInterval
    (x : Point) :
    ContinuousOn UnitOpenInterval (lemniscaticAddPhiFun x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lemniscaticAddPhiFun lemniscaticAddPhi lemniscaticAddNum
    lemniscaticDen
  change ContinuousOn UnitOpenInterval
    (MulFun
      (AddFun
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => x) lemniscaticSqrt)
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => lemniscaticSqrt x) IdentityFun))
      (InvFun
        (AddFun
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
          (MulFun
            (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.mul x x)
            (MulFun IdentityFun IdentityFun)))))
  exact continuousOn_mul
    (continuousOn_add
      (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const
        lemniscaticSqrt_continuousOn_unitOpenInterval)
      (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const continuousOn_identity))
    (continuousOn_inv
      (continuousOn_add continuousOn_const
        (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const
          (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_identity continuousOn_identity)))
      (fun t _ => lemniscaticDen_ne_zero x t))

name: lemniscaticDeltaFun_continuousOn_unitOpenInterval
statement:
private theorem lemniscaticDeltaFun_continuousOn_unitOpenInterval
    (x : Point) :
    ContinuousOn UnitOpenInterval (lemniscaticDeltaFun x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lemniscaticDeltaFun lemniscaticDelta
  change ContinuousOn UnitOpenInterval
    (SubFun
      (MulFun
        (MulFun
          (fun _ : Point => lemniscaticSqrt x)
          lemniscaticSqrt)
        (SubFun
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
          (MulFun
            (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.mul x x)
            (MulFun IdentityFun IdentityFun))))
      (MulFun
        (MulFun
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.nat 2)
          (MulFun (fun _ : Point => x) IdentityFun))
        (AddFun
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.mul x x)
          (MulFun IdentityFun IdentityFun))))
  exact continuousOn_sub
    (continuousOn_mul
      (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const
        lemniscaticSqrt_continuousOn_unitOpenInterval)
      (continuousOn_sub continuousOn_const
        (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const
          (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_identity continuousOn_identity))))
    (continuousOn_mul
      (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const
        (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const continuousOn_identity))
      (continuousOn_add continuousOn_const
        (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_identity continuousOn_identity)))

name: lemniscaticAddPhiDeriv_continuousOn_unitOpenInterval
statement:
private theorem lemniscaticAddPhiDeriv_continuousOn_unitOpenInterval
    (x : Point) :
    ContinuousOn UnitOpenInterval (lemniscaticAddPhiDeriv x)
proof:
:= by
  let denFun : Point -> Point :=
    AddFun
      (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
      (MulFun
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.mul x x)
        (MulFun IdentityFun IdentityFun))
  have hdenCont : ContinuousOn UnitOpenInterval denFun := by
    unfold denFun
    exact continuousOn_add continuousOn_const
      (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const
        (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_identity continuousOn_identity))
  unfold lemniscaticAddPhiDeriv
  change ContinuousOn UnitOpenInterval
    (MulFun
      (lemniscaticDeltaFun x)
      (InvFun
        (MulFun lemniscaticSqrt
          (MulFun denFun denFun))))
  exact continuousOn_mul
    (lemniscaticDeltaFun_continuousOn_unitOpenInterval x)
    (continuousOn_inv
      (continuousOn_mul lemniscaticSqrt_continuousOn_unitOpenInterval
        (continuousOn_mul hdenCont hdenCont))
      (fun t ht => by
        let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        have hsne := lemniscaticSqrt_ne_zero_unitOpenInterval ht
        have hden_ne := lemniscaticDen_ne_zero x t
        have hdenSq_ne :
            Not (F.mul (lemniscaticDen x t) (lemniscaticDen x t) =
              F.zero) := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F hden_ne hden_ne
        change
          Not (F.mul (lemniscaticSqrt t)
            (F.mul (lemniscaticDen x t) (lemniscaticDen x t)) =
              F.zero)
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F hsne hdenSq_ne))

name: inv_mul_inv_right_mul_eq_base
statement:
private theorem inv_mul_inv_right_mul_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {a b : Point}
    (hb : Not (b = F.zero))
    (hab : Not (F.mul a (F.inv b) = F.zero)) :
    F.mul (F.inv (F.mul a (F.inv b))) a = b
proof:
:= by
  have hrecover :
      F.mul (F.mul a (F.inv b)) b = a :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right F a hb
  calc
    F.mul (F.inv (F.mul a (F.inv b))) a =
        F.mul (F.inv (F.mul a (F.inv b)))
          (F.mul (F.mul a (F.inv b)) b) := by
          rw [hrecover]
    _ = F.mul
          (F.mul (F.inv (F.mul a (F.inv b)))
            (F.mul a (F.inv b))) b := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul F.one b := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hab]
    _ = b := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: mul_inv_mul_right_eq_inv_left_base
statement:
private theorem mul_inv_mul_right_eq_inv_left_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : Not (a = F.zero))
    (hb : Not (b = F.zero)) :
    F.mul b (F.inv (F.mul a b)) = F.inv a
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F ha hb]
  calc
    F.mul b (F.mul (F.inv b) (F.inv a)) =
        F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv b)) (F.inv a) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul F.one (F.inv a) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hb]
    _ = F.inv a := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: LemniscaticSubstitutionData.source_integrand_eq
statement:
private theorem LemniscaticSubstitutionData.source_integrand_eq
    {x y u v t : Point}
    (data : LemniscaticSubstitutionData x y u v)
    (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero y t) :
    substitutionIntegrand lemniscaticIntegrand
      (lemniscaticAddPhiFun x) (lemniscaticAddPhiDeriv x) t =
      lemniscaticIntegrand t
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let denSq := F.mul (lemniscaticDen x t) (lemniscaticDen x t)
  have htOpen : UnitOpenInterval t :=
    closedInterval_zero_right_subset_unitOpenInterval data.y_open t ht
  have hxClosed : UnitClosedInterval x :=
    unitOpenInterval_subset_unitClosedInterval x data.x_open
  have htClosed : UnitClosedInterval t :=
    unitOpenInterval_subset_unitClosedInterval t htOpen
  have hphiOpen : UnitOpenInterval (lemniscaticAddPhi x t) :=
    data.phi_maps_unit_open t ht
  have hdelta_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (lemniscaticDelta x t) :=
    data.branch_nonneg t ht
  have hbranch :
      lemniscaticSqrt (lemniscaticAddPhi x t) =
        F.mul (lemniscaticDelta x t) (F.inv denSq) := by
    unfold denSq
    exact
      lemniscaticSqrt_lemniscaticAddPhi_eq_delta_div_den_sq
        hxClosed htClosed hdelta_nonneg
  have hsne : Not (lemniscaticSqrt t = F.zero) :=
    lemniscaticSqrt_ne_zero_unitOpenInterval htOpen
  have hphi_sqrt_ne :
      Not (lemniscaticSqrt (lemniscaticAddPhi x t) = F.zero) :=
    lemniscaticSqrt_ne_zero_unitOpenInterval hphiOpen
  have hden_ne : Not (lemniscaticDen x t = F.zero) :=
    lemniscaticDen_ne_zero x t
  have hdenSq_ne : Not (denSq = F.zero) := by
    unfold denSq
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F hden_ne hden_ne
  have hbranch_ne :
      Not (F.mul (lemniscaticDelta x t) (F.inv denSq) = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    have hsqrt_zero :
        lemniscaticSqrt (lemniscaticAddPhi x t) = F.zero := by
      rw [hbranch]
      exact hzero
    exact hphi_sqrt_ne hsqrt_zero
  unfold substitutionIntegrand lemniscaticIntegrand
  unfold lemniscaticAddPhiFun lemniscaticAddPhiDeriv
  rw [hbranch]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.inv
          (F.mul (lemniscaticDelta x t) (F.inv denSq)))
        (F.mul (lemniscaticDelta x t)
          (F.inv (F.mul (lemniscaticSqrt t) denSq))) =
      F.inv (lemniscaticSqrt t)
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.inv
          (F.mul (lemniscaticDelta x t) (F.inv denSq)))
        (F.mul (lemniscaticDelta x t)
          (F.inv (F.mul (lemniscaticSqrt t) denSq))) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.inv
              (F.mul (lemniscaticDelta x t) (F.inv denSq)))
            (lemniscaticDelta x t))
          (F.inv (F.mul (lemniscaticSqrt t) denSq)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul denSq
          (F.inv (F.mul (lemniscaticSqrt t) denSq)) := by
          rw [inv_mul_inv_right_mul_eq_base F hdenSq_ne hbranch_ne]
    _ = F.inv (lemniscaticSqrt t) := by
          exact
            mul_inv_mul_right_eq_inv_left_base F hsne hdenSq_ne

name: LemniscaticSubstitutionData.endpoint_open

private theorem LemniscaticSubstitutionData.endpoint_open
    {x y u v : Point}
    (data : LemniscaticSubstitutionData x y u v) :
    UnitOpenInterval (lemniscaticAdd x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lemniscaticAdd
  exact data.phi_maps_unit_open y
    (And.intro data.source_order (RealTheory.le_refl y))

name: LemniscaticSubstitutionData.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_source
statement:
private theorem LemniscaticSubstitutionData.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_source
    {x y u v : Point}
    (data : LemniscaticSubstitutionData x y u v) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral lemniscaticIntegrand
      RealTheory.zero y data.c1Data.value
proof:
:= by
  have hsubst :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (substitutionIntegrand lemniscaticIntegrand
          (lemniscaticAddPhiFun x) (lemniscaticAddPhiDeriv x))
        RealTheory.zero y data.c1Data.value :=
    (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_c1_ordered
      data.c1Data).left
  exact
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
      data.source_order
      (fun t ht => data.source_integrand_eq ht)
      hsubst

name: LemniscaticSubstitutionData.source_value_eq_riLemniscaticIntegral
statement:
private theorem LemniscaticSubstitutionData.source_value_eq_riLemniscaticIntegral
    {x y u v : Point}
    (data : LemniscaticSubstitutionData x y u v) :
    data.c1Data.value = riLemniscaticIntegral y
proof:
:= by
  exact
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
      data.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_source
      (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_riLemniscaticIntegral data.y_open)

name: LemniscaticSubstitutionData.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_target
statement:
private theorem LemniscaticSubstitutionData.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_target
    {x y u v : Point}
    (data : LemniscaticSubstitutionData x y u v) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral lemniscaticIntegrand
      x (lemniscaticAdd x y) data.c1Data.value
proof:
:= by
  have htarget :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral lemniscaticIntegrand
        ((lemniscaticAddPhiFun x) RealTheory.zero)
        ((lemniscaticAddPhiFun x) y) data.c1Data.value :=
    (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_c1_ordered
      data.c1Data).right
  change
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral lemniscaticIntegrand
      (lemniscaticAddPhi x RealTheory.zero)
      (lemniscaticAddPhi x y) data.c1Data.value at htarget
  rw [lemniscaticAddPhi_zero x] at htarget
  unfold lemniscaticAdd
  exact htarget

name: LemniscaticSubstitutionData.riLemniscaticIntegral_add_ordered
statement:
private theorem LemniscaticSubstitutionData.riLemniscaticIntegral_add_ordered
    {x y u v : Point}
    (data : LemniscaticSubstitutionData x y u v)
    (h0x : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxz : RealTheory.le x (lemniscaticAdd x y)) :
    riLemniscaticIntegral (lemniscaticAdd x y) =
      RealTheory.add (riLemniscaticIntegral x)
        (riLemniscaticIntegral y)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft_oriented :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral lemniscaticIntegrand
        RealTheory.zero x (riLemniscaticIntegral x) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_riLemniscaticIntegral data.x_open
  have hleft_raw :
      HasRiemannIntegral lemniscaticIntegrand
        RealTheory.zero x (riLemniscaticIntegral x) :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_of_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_le
      h0x hleft_oriented
  have hleft_bdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded lemniscaticIntegrand
        RealTheory.zero x :=
    taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
      (Exists.intro (riLemniscaticIntegral x) hleft_raw)
  have hleft_darboux :
      HasDarbouxIntegral lemniscaticIntegrand
        RealTheory.zero x (riLemniscaticIntegral x) :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral h0x hleft_raw
  have hright_oriented :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral lemniscaticIntegrand
        x (lemniscaticAdd x y) data.c1Data.value :=
    data.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_target
  have hright_raw :
      HasRiemannIntegral lemniscaticIntegrand
        x (lemniscaticAdd x y) data.c1Data.value :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_of_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_le
      hxz hright_oriented
  have hright_bdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded lemniscaticIntegrand
        x (lemniscaticAdd x y) :=
    taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
      (Exists.intro data.c1Data.value hright_raw)
  have hright_darboux :
      HasDarbouxIntegral lemniscaticIntegrand
        x (lemniscaticAdd x y) data.c1Data.value :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral hxz hright_raw
  have htotal :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral lemniscaticIntegrand
        RealTheory.zero (lemniscaticAdd x y)
        (RealTheory.add (riLemniscaticIntegral x) data.c1Data.value) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_adjacent_ordered
      h0x hxz hleft_bdd hleft_darboux
      hright_bdd hright_darboux
  have hwhole :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral lemniscaticIntegrand
        RealTheory.zero (lemniscaticAdd x y)
        (riLemniscaticIntegral (lemniscaticAdd x y)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_riLemniscaticIntegral data.endpoint_open
  calc
    riLemniscaticIntegral (lemniscaticAdd x y) =
        RealTheory.add (riLemniscaticIntegral x) data.c1Data.value := by
          exact
            (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
              htotal hwhole).symm
    _ = RealTheory.add (riLemniscaticIntegral x)
          (riLemniscaticIntegral y) := by
          rw [data.source_value_eq_riLemniscaticIntegral]

name: LemniscaticSubstitutionData.riLemniscaticIntegral_double_ordered
statement:
private theorem LemniscaticSubstitutionData.riLemniscaticIntegral_double_ordered
    {x u v : Point}
    (data : LemniscaticSubstitutionData x x u v)
    (h0x : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxx : RealTheory.le x (lemniscaticAdd x x)) :
    riLemniscaticIntegral (lemniscaticAdd x x) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (riLemniscaticIntegral x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [data.riLemniscaticIntegral_add_ordered h0x hxx]
  rw [nat_two_mul_eq_add_self]

name: closedInterval_lemniscaticAdd_subset_unitOpenInterval

name: FagnanoAdditionConditions.strictMonotoneOn
statement:
private theorem FagnanoAdditionConditions.strictMonotoneOn
    {x y : Point}
    (data : FagnanoAdditionConditions x y) :
    StrictMonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero y)
      (lemniscaticAddPhiFun x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hclosedSubset :
      SetPred.Subset (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero y)
        UnitOpenInterval :=
    closedInterval_zero_right_subset_unitOpenInterval data.right_open
  have hopenSubset :
      SetPred.Subset (RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero y)
        UnitOpenInterval :=
    openInterval_zero_right_subset_unitOpenInterval data.right_open
  have hcont :
      ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero y)
        (lemniscaticAddPhiFun x) :=
    continuousOn_subset hclosedSubset
      (lemniscaticAddPhiFun_continuousOn_unitOpenInterval x)
  have hderiv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero y)
        (lemniscaticAddPhiFun x) (lemniscaticAddPhiDeriv x) := by
    intro t ht
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
      hopenSubset ht
      (lemniscaticAddPhi_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval x
        (hopenSubset t ht))
  have hdiff :
      RealDerivative.DifferentiableOnOpenInterval
        RealTheory.zero y (lemniscaticAddPhiFun x) := by
    intro t ht
    exact Exists.intro (lemniscaticAddPhiDeriv x t) (hderiv t ht)
  have hpositive :
      RealDerivative.DerivativePositiveOnOpenInterval
        RealTheory.zero y (lemniscaticAddPhiFun x) := by
    intro t A ht hA
    have hAeq : A = lemniscaticAddPhiDeriv x t :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
        (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint ht) hA (hderiv t ht)
    have htClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero y t :=
      And.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F ht.left)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F ht.right)
    have hdelta : F.lt F.zero (lemniscaticDelta x t) := by
      simpa only [lemniscaticAdditionDiscriminant, lemniscaticDelta] using
        data.discriminant_positive t htClosed
    have htUnit : UnitOpenInterval t := hopenSubset t ht
    have hsqrt : F.lt F.zero (lemniscaticSqrt t) :=
      lemniscaticSqrt_pos_unitOpenInterval htUnit
    have hden : F.lt F.zero (lemniscaticDen x t) :=
      lemniscaticDen_pos x t
    have hdenSq :
        F.lt F.zero (F.mul (lemniscaticDen x t) (lemniscaticDen x t)) :=
      F.mul_pos hden hden
    have hdenom :
        F.lt F.zero
          (F.mul (lemniscaticSqrt t)
            (F.mul (lemniscaticDen x t) (lemniscaticDen x t))) :=
      F.mul_pos hsqrt hdenSq
    rw [hAeq]
    unfold lemniscaticAddPhiDeriv
    exact F.mul_pos hdelta (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hdenom)
  exact RealDerivative.strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_positive
    hcont hdiff hpositive

name: FagnanoAdditionConditions.toLemniscaticAdditionAdmissible
statement:
theorem FagnanoAdditionConditions.toLemniscaticAdditionAdmissible
    {x y : Point}
    (data : FagnanoAdditionConditions x y) :
    LemniscaticAdditionAdmissible x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hstrict := data.strictMonotoneOn
  have hmono := strictMonotoneOn_monotoneOn hstrict
  have hzero : RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero y F.zero :=
    And.intro (F.le_refl F.zero) data.right_nonnegative
  have hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero y y :=
    And.intro data.right_nonnegative (F.le_refl y)
  have hphiZero : lemniscaticAddPhiFun x F.zero = x := by
    unfold lemniscaticAddPhiFun
    change lemniscaticAddPhi x RealTheory.zero = x
    exact lemniscaticAddPhi_zero x
  have hphiY :
      lemniscaticAddPhiFun x y = lemniscaticAdd x y := by
    unfold lemniscaticAddPhiFun
    exact lemniscaticAddPhi_endpoint x y
  refine
    { left_nonnegative := data.left_nonnegative
      right_nonnegative := data.right_nonnegative
      left_open := data.left_open
      right_open := data.right_open
      sum_order := ?_
      sum_open := data.sum_open
      maps_closed := ?_
      maps_open := ?_
      branch_nonnegative := ?_ }
  · have h := hmono F.zero y hzero hy data.right_nonnegative
    rw [hphiZero, hphiY] at h
    exact h
  · intro t ht
    have hlower := hmono F.zero t hzero ht ht.left
    have hupper := hmono t y ht hy ht.right
    rw [hphiZero] at hlower
    rw [hphiY] at hupper
    exact And.intro hlower hupper
  · intro t ht
    have htClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero y t :=
      And.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F ht.left)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F ht.right)
    have hlower := hstrict F.zero t hzero htClosed ht.left
    have hupper := hstrict t y htClosed hy ht.right
    rw [hphiZero] at hlower
    rw [hphiY] at hupper
    exact And.intro hlower hupper
  · intro t ht
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (data.discriminant_positive t ht)

name: riLemniscaticIntegral_add_of_fagnanoConditions
statement:
theorem riLemniscaticIntegral_add_of_fagnanoConditions
    {x y : Point}
    (data : FagnanoAdditionConditions x y) :
    riLemniscaticIntegral (lemniscaticAdd x y) =
      RealTheory.add (riLemniscaticIntegral x)
        (riLemniscaticIntegral y)
proof:
:=
  riLemniscaticIntegral_add
    data.toLemniscaticAdditionAdmissible

name: riLemniscaticIntegral_double_of_fagnanoConditions
statement:
theorem riLemniscaticIntegral_double_of_fagnanoConditions
    {x : Point}
    (data : FagnanoAdditionConditions x x) :
    riLemniscaticIntegral (lemniscaticAdd x x) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (riLemniscaticIntegral x)
proof:
:=
  riLemniscaticIntegral_double
    data.toLemniscaticAdditionAdmissible

name: upperBound_mono
statement:
theorem upperBound_mono {S T : alpha -> Prop} {u : alpha}
    (hST : forall x : alpha, S x -> T x)
    (hu : IsUpperBound F.le T u) :
    IsUpperBound F.le S u
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact hu x (hST x hx)

name: lowerBound_mono
statement:
theorem lowerBound_mono {S T : alpha -> Prop} {l : alpha}
    (hST : forall x : alpha, S x -> T x)
    (hl : IsLowerBound F.le T l) :
    IsLowerBound F.le S l
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact hl x (hST x hx)

name: lub_mono
statement:
theorem lub_mono {S T : alpha -> Prop} {s t : alpha}
    (hST : forall x : alpha, S x -> T x)
    (hs : IsLeastUpperBound F.le S s)
    (ht : IsLeastUpperBound F.le T t) :
    F.le s t
proof:
:=
  hs.right t (upperBound_mono F hST ht.left)

name: glb_mono
statement:
theorem glb_mono {S T : alpha -> Prop} {s t : alpha}
    (hST : forall x : alpha, S x -> T x)
    (hs : IsGreatestLowerBound F.le S s)
    (ht : IsGreatestLowerBound F.le T t) :
    F.le t s
proof:
:=
  hs.right t (lowerBound_mono F hST ht.left)

name: lub_of_greatest
statement:
theorem lub_of_greatest {S : alpha -> Prop} {m : alpha}
    (hm : S m)
    (hmax : forall x : alpha, S x -> F.le x m) :
    IsLeastUpperBound F.le S m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact hmax
  · intro u hu
    exact hu m hm

name: glb_of_least
statement:
theorem glb_of_least {S : alpha -> Prop} {m : alpha}
    (hm : S m)
    (hmin : forall x : alpha, S x -> F.le m x) :
    IsGreatestLowerBound F.le S m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact hmin
  · intro l hl
    exact hl m hm

name: lub_singleton
statement:
theorem lub_singleton (x : alpha) :
    IsLeastUpperBound F.le (fun y : alpha => y = x) x
proof:
:= by
  apply lub_of_greatest F
  · rfl
  · intro y hy
    rw [hy]
    exact F.le_refl x

name: glb_singleton
statement:
theorem glb_singleton (x : alpha) :
    IsGreatestLowerBound F.le (fun y : alpha => y = x) x
proof:
:= by
  apply glb_of_least F
  · rfl
  · intro y hy
    rw [hy]
    exact F.le_refl x

name: lub_pair_max2
statement:
theorem lub_pair_max2 (x y : alpha) :
    IsLeastUpperBound F.le
      (fun z : alpha => Or (z = x) (z = y))
      (max2 F x y)
proof:
:= by
  apply lub_of_greatest F
  · unfold max2
    by_cases hxy : F.le x y
    · simp [hxy]
    · simp [hxy]
  · intro z hz
    cases hz with
    | inl hx =>
        rw [hx]
        exact le_max2_left F x y
    | inr hy =>
        rw [hy]
        exact le_max2_right F x y

name: glb_pair_min2
statement:
theorem glb_pair_min2 (x y : alpha) :
    IsGreatestLowerBound F.le
      (fun z : alpha => Or (z = x) (z = y))
      (min2 F x y)
proof:
:= by
  apply glb_of_least F
  · unfold min2
    by_cases hxy : F.le x y
    · simp [hxy]
    · simp [hxy]
  · intro z hz
    cases hz with
    | inl hx =>
        rw [hx]
        exact min2_le_left F x y
    | inr hy =>
        rw [hy]
        exact min2_le_right F x y

name: exists_internalRat_between_self_add
statement:
theorem exists_internalRat_between_self_add {x eps : alpha}
    (heps : C.field.lt C.field.zero eps) :
    Exists (fun q : alpha =>
      And (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalRat C.field q)
        (And (C.field.lt x q)
          (C.field.lt q (C.field.add x eps))))
proof:
:= by
  have hx_lt : C.field.lt x (C.field.add x eps) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left C.field heps x
    rwa [C.field.add_zero] at h
  exact exists_internalRat_between C hx_lt

name: exists_internalRat_between_sub_self
statement:
theorem exists_internalRat_between_sub_self {x eps : alpha}
    (heps : C.field.lt C.field.zero eps) :
    Exists (fun q : alpha =>
      And (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalRat C.field q)
        (And (C.field.lt (C.field.sub x eps) q)
          (C.field.lt q x)))
proof:
:= by
  have hx_lt : C.field.lt (C.field.sub x eps) x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos C.field heps
  exact exists_internalRat_between C hx_lt

name: exists_internalRat_abs_sub_lt
statement:
theorem exists_internalRat_abs_sub_lt {x eps : alpha}
    (heps : C.field.lt C.field.zero eps) :
    Exists (fun q : alpha =>
      And (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalRat C.field q)
        (C.field.lt
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C.field (C.field.sub q x))
          eps))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_internalRat_between_self_add C (x := x) heps with
  | intro q hq =>
      have hsub_pos :
          C.field.lt C.field.zero (C.field.sub q x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt C.field hq.right.left
      have hsub_lt :
          C.field.lt (C.field.sub q x) eps :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add C.field hq.right.right
      have habs :
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C.field (C.field.sub q x) =
            C.field.sub q x :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg C.field
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C.field hsub_pos)
      exact Exists.intro q (And.intro hq.left (by rwa [habs]))

name: exists_internalInt_ceiling
statement:
theorem exists_internalInt_ceiling (a : alpha) :
    Exists (fun z : alpha =>
      And (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalInt C.field z)
        (And (C.field.le z (C.field.add a C.field.one))
          (C.field.lt a z)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := C.field
  let nat := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F
  cases exists_nat_gt C (F.neg a) with
  | intro N hNeg =>
      let nN := nat N
      let shift := F.add a nN
      have hShiftPos : F.lt F.zero shift := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F hNeg a
        change F.lt (F.add (F.neg a) a) (F.add nN a) at h
        rwa [F.neg_add, F.add_comm nN a] at h
      have hAbove : Exists (fun k : Nat => F.lt shift (nat k)) :=
        exists_nat_gt C shift
      let p : Nat -> Prop := fun k => F.lt shift (nat k)
      let K := Tautology.Nat.least p hAbove
      have hK : p K := Tautology.Nat.least_spec p hAbove
      have hKmin : forall k : Nat, p k -> K <= k := by
        intro k hk
        exact Tautology.Nat.least_min p hAbove hk
      have hKne : Not (K = 0) := by
        intro hK0
        have hbad : F.lt shift F.zero := by
          have hK' := hK
          change F.lt shift (nat K) at hK'
          rw [hK0] at hK'
          change F.lt shift (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F 0) at hK'
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero F] at hK'
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_asymm F hShiftPos) hbad
      have hKpos : 0 < K := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hKne
      let k : Nat := K - 1
      have hk_succ : k + 1 = K := by
        dsimp [k]
        omega
      let z := F.sub (nat K) nN
      have hprev_not : Not (p k) := by
        intro hk
        have hmin := hKmin k hk
        dsimp [k] at hmin
        omega
      have hprev_le_shift : F.le (nat k) shift := by
        by_cases hle : F.le (nat k) shift
        · exact hle
        · cases F.le_total shift (nat k) with
          | inl hshift =>
              have hlt : p k :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F
                  hshift hle
              exact False.elim (hprev_not hlt)
          | inr hle' =>
              exact hle'
      have hz_int : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalInt F z := by
        dsimp [z]
        refine Exists.intro (nat K) ?_
        refine Exists.intro nN ?_
        exact And.intro
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.internalNat_of_nat F K)
          (And.intro
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.internalNat_of_nat F N)
            rfl)
      have hshift_sub :
          F.add shift (F.neg nN) = a := by
        change F.add (F.add a nN) (F.neg nN) = a
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_neg_cancel_right F a nN
      have ha_lt_z : F.lt a z := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F hK
          (F.neg nN)
        change F.lt (F.add shift (F.neg nN))
          (F.add (nat K) (F.neg nN)) at h
        rwa [
          hshift_sub,
          <- F.sub_eq_add_neg (nat K) nN
        ] at h
      have hz_le_a1 : F.le z (F.add a F.one) := by
        have hprev_sub : F.le (F.sub (nat k) nN) a := by
          have h := F.add_le_add_right hprev_le_shift (F.neg nN)
          change F.le (F.add (nat k) (F.neg nN))
            (F.add shift (F.neg nN)) at h
          rwa [
            hshift_sub,
            <- F.sub_eq_add_neg (nat k) nN
          ] at h
        have hprev_sub_one :
            F.le (F.add (F.sub (nat k) nN) F.one)
              (F.add a F.one) :=
          F.add_le_add_right hprev_sub F.one
        have hleft :
            z = F.add (F.sub (nat k) nN) F.one := by
          dsimp [z]
          calc
            F.sub (nat K) nN =
                F.sub (nat (k + 1)) nN := by
                  rw [hk_succ]
            _ = F.add (nat (k + 1)) (F.neg nN) := by
                  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
            _ = F.add
                  (F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F k) F.one)
                  (F.neg nN) := by
                  change
                    F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (k + 1))
                      (F.neg nN) =
                    F.add
                      (F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F k) F.one)
                      (F.neg nN)
                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ F k]
            _ = F.add (nat k) (F.add F.one (F.neg nN)) := by
                  rw [F.add_assoc]
            _ = F.add (nat k) (F.add (F.neg nN) F.one) := by
                  rw [F.add_comm F.one (F.neg nN)]
            _ = F.add (F.add (nat k) (F.neg nN)) F.one := by
                  rw [<- F.add_assoc]
            _ = F.add (F.sub (nat k) nN) F.one := by
                  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
        rwa [hleft]
      refine Exists.intro z ?_
      exact And.intro hz_int (And.intro hz_le_a1 ha_lt_z)

name: exists_internalRat_between
statement:
theorem exists_internalRat_between {x y : alpha}
    (hxy : C.field.lt x y) :
    Exists (fun q : alpha =>
      And (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalRat C.field q)
        (And (C.field.lt x q) (C.field.lt q y)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := C.field
  let nat := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F
  have hdelta : F.lt F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  cases exists_nat_pos_mul_gt_one C hdelta with
  | intro n hgap =>
      have hn_ne : Not (n = 0) := by
        intro hn0
        subst hn0
        have hbad : F.lt F.one F.zero := by
          change F.lt F.one (F.mul (nat 0) (F.sub y x)) at hgap
          change F.lt F.one
            (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F 0) (F.sub y x)) at hgap
          rwa [
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero F,
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F
          ] at hgap
        exact
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_asymm F
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)) hbad
      let nval := nat n
      let a := F.mul nval x
      have hn_pos : F.lt F.zero nval :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F hn_ne
      have hn_nat_ne : Not (nval = F.zero) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F hn_ne
      have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv nval) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hn_pos
      cases exists_internalInt_ceiling C a with
      | intro z hz =>
          let q := F.mul z (F.inv nval)
          have hq_rat : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalRat F q := by
            dsimp [q]
            refine Exists.intro z ?_
            refine Exists.intro nval ?_
            exact And.intro hz.left
              (And.intro
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.internalNat_of_nat F n)
                (And.intro hn_nat_ne rfl))
          have hxq : F.lt x q := by
            have hmul :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F
                hz.right.right hinv_pos
            have hleft :
                F.mul a (F.inv nval) = x := by
              dsimp [a]
              calc
                F.mul (F.mul nval x) (F.inv nval) =
                    F.mul (F.mul x nval) (F.inv nval) := by
                      rw [F.mul_comm nval x]
                _ = x :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right
                    F x hn_nat_ne
            change F.lt (F.mul a (F.inv nval)) q at hmul
            rwa [hleft] at hmul
          have hqy : F.lt q y := by
            have hgap' : F.lt (F.add a F.one) (F.mul nval y) := by
              have h :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hgap a
              have hright :
                  F.add a (F.mul nval (F.sub y x)) =
                    F.mul nval y := by
                dsimp [a]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F nval y x]
                rw [F.add_comm (F.mul nval x)
                  (F.sub (F.mul nval y) (F.mul nval x))]
                exact
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F
                    (F.mul nval y) (F.mul nval x)
              change F.lt (F.add a F.one)
                (F.add a (F.mul nval (F.sub y x))) at h
              rwa [hright] at h
            have hz_lt_ny : F.lt z (F.mul nval y) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hz.right.left hgap'
            have hmul :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F
                hz_lt_ny hinv_pos
            have hright :
                F.mul (F.mul nval y) (F.inv nval) = y := by
              calc
                F.mul (F.mul nval y) (F.inv nval) =
                    F.mul (F.mul y nval) (F.inv nval) := by
                      rw [F.mul_comm nval y]
                _ = y :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right
                    F y hn_nat_ne
            change F.lt q (F.mul (F.mul nval y) (F.inv nval)) at hmul
            rwa [hright] at hmul
          refine Exists.intro q ?_
          exact And.intro hq_rat (And.intro hxq hqy)

name: lt_of_le_of_not_le
statement:
theorem lt_of_le_of_not_le {x y : alpha}
    (hxy : F.le x y) (hyx : Not (F.le y x)) : F.lt x y
proof:
:=
  (F.lt_def (x := x) (y := y)).mpr (And.intro hxy hyx)

name: le_of_lt
statement: theorem le_of_lt {x y : alpha} (hxy : F.lt x y) : F.le x y
proof:
:=
  ((F.lt_def (x := x) (y := y)).mp hxy).left

name: not_le_of_lt
statement: theorem not_le_of_lt {x y : alpha} (hxy : F.lt x y) : Not (F.le y x)
proof:
:=
  ((F.lt_def (x := x) (y := y)).mp hxy).right

name: le_of_not_lt
proof:
:= by
  cases F.le_total y x with
  | inl hyx => exact hyx
  | inr hxy =>
      by_cases hyx : F.le y x
      · exact hyx
      · exact False.elim (h (lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hyx))

name: lt_irrefl
statement: theorem lt_irrefl (x : alpha) : Not (F.lt x x)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact (not_le_of_lt F h) (F.le_refl x)

name: lt_asymm
statement: theorem lt_asymm {x y : alpha} (hxy : F.lt x y) : Not (F.lt y x)
proof:
:= by
  intro hyx
  exact (not_le_of_lt F hxy) (le_of_lt F hyx)

name: ne_of_lt
statement: theorem ne_of_lt {x y : alpha} (hxy : F.lt x y) : Not (x = y)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [h] at hxy
  exact lt_irrefl F y hxy

name: pos_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact ne_of_lt F hx h.symm

name: lt_of_le_of_lt
statement:
theorem lt_of_le_of_lt {x y z : alpha}
    (hxy : F.le x y) (hyz : F.lt y z) : F.lt x z
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le F
  · exact F.le_trans hxy (le_of_lt F hyz)
  · intro hzx
    have hzy : F.le z y := F.le_trans hzx hxy
    exact (not_le_of_lt F hyz) hzy

name: lt_of_lt_of_le
statement:
theorem lt_of_lt_of_le {x y z : alpha}
    (hxy : F.lt x y) (hyz : F.le y z) : F.lt x z
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le F
  · exact F.le_trans (le_of_lt F hxy) hyz
  · intro hzx
    have hyx : F.le y x := F.le_trans hyz hzx
    exact (not_le_of_lt F hxy) hyx

name: le_of_add_le_add_right
statement:
theorem le_of_add_le_add_right {x y z : alpha}
    (h : F.le (F.add x z) (F.add y z)) : F.le x y
proof:
:= by
  have h' := F.add_le_add_right h (F.neg z)
  rwa [add_neg_cancel_right F x z, add_neg_cancel_right F y z] at h'

name: add_lt_add_right
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le F
  · exact F.add_le_add_right (le_of_lt F hxy) z
  · intro hrev
    exact (not_le_of_lt F hxy)
      (le_of_add_le_add_right F hrev)

name: add_lt_add_left
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.add_comm z x, F.add_comm z y]
  exact add_lt_add_right F hxy z

name: lt_trans
statement:
theorem lt_trans {x y z : alpha}
    (hxy : F.lt x y) (hyz : F.lt y z) : F.lt x z
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le F
  · exact F.le_trans (le_of_lt F hxy) (le_of_lt F hyz)
  · intro hzx
    have hzy : F.le z y := F.le_trans hzx (le_of_lt F hxy)
    exact (not_le_of_lt F hyz) hzy

name: add_lt_add
proof:
:=
  lt_trans F (add_lt_add_right F hwx y) (add_lt_add_left F hyz x)

name: exists_lt_of_not_lowerBound
statement:
theorem exists_lt_of_not_lowerBound
    {S : alpha -> Prop} {x : alpha}
    (hx : Not (IsLowerBound F.le S x)) :
    Exists (fun y : alpha => And (S y) (F.lt y x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h :
      Exists (fun y : alpha => And (S y) (F.lt y x))
  · exact h
  · have hlower : IsLowerBound F.le S x := by
      intro y hy
      by_cases hxy : F.le x y
      · exact hxy
      · cases F.le_total y x with
        | inl hyx =>
            exact False.elim
              (h (Exists.intro y
                (And.intro hy (lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyx hxy))))
        | inr hxy' => exact False.elim (hxy hxy')
    exact False.elim (hx hlower)

name: exists_gt_of_not_upperBound
statement:
theorem exists_gt_of_not_upperBound
    {S : alpha -> Prop} {x : alpha}
    (hx : Not (IsUpperBound F.le S x)) :
    Exists (fun y : alpha => And (S y) (F.lt x y))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h :
      Exists (fun y : alpha => And (S y) (F.lt x y))
  · exact h
  · have hupper : IsUpperBound F.le S x := by
      intro y hy
      by_cases hyx : F.le y x
      · exact hyx
      · cases F.le_total x y with
        | inl hxy =>
            exact False.elim
              (h (Exists.intro y
                (And.intro hy (lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hyx))))
        | inr hyx' => exact False.elim (hyx hyx')
    exact False.elim (hx hupper)

name: lub_unique
statement:
theorem lub_unique {S : alpha -> Prop} {s t : alpha}
    (hs : IsLeastUpperBound F.le S s)
    (ht : IsLeastUpperBound F.le S t) :
    s = t
proof:
:=
  F.le_antisymm (hs.right t ht.left) (ht.right s hs.left)

name: le_lub_of_mem
statement:
theorem le_lub_of_mem {S : alpha -> Prop} {s x : alpha}
    (hs : IsLeastUpperBound F.le S s)
    (hx : S x) :
    F.le x s
proof:
:=
  hs.left x hx

name: lub_le_of_upper
statement:
theorem lub_le_of_upper {S : alpha -> Prop} {s u : alpha}
    (hs : IsLeastUpperBound F.le S s)
    (hu : IsUpperBound F.le S u) :
    F.le s u
proof:
:=
  hs.right u hu

name: exists_lt_of_lt_lub
statement:
theorem exists_lt_of_lt_lub {S : alpha -> Prop} {s t : alpha}
    (hs : IsLeastUpperBound F.le S s)
    (hts : F.lt t s) :
    Exists (fun x => And (S x) (F.lt t x))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hex : Exists (fun x => And (S x) (F.lt t x))
  · exact hex
  · have htUpper : IsUpperBound F.le S t := by
      intro x hxS
      by_cases hxt : F.le x t
      · exact hxt
      · cases F.le_total t x with
        | inl htx =>
            have htxlt : F.lt t x := lt_of_le_of_not_le F htx hxt
            exact False.elim
              (hex (Exists.intro x (And.intro hxS htxlt)))
        | inr hxt' =>
            exact hxt'
    have hst : F.le s t := hs.right t htUpper
    exact False.elim ((not_le_of_lt F hts) hst)

name: glb_unique
statement:
theorem glb_unique {S : alpha -> Prop} {s t : alpha}
    (hs : IsGreatestLowerBound F.le S s)
    (ht : IsGreatestLowerBound F.le S t) :
    s = t
proof:
:=
  F.le_antisymm (ht.right s hs.left) (hs.right t ht.left)

name: glb_le_of_mem
statement:
theorem glb_le_of_mem {S : alpha -> Prop} {s x : alpha}
    (hs : IsGreatestLowerBound F.le S s)
    (hx : S x) :
    F.le s x
proof:
:=
  hs.left x hx

name: le_glb_of_lower
statement:
theorem le_glb_of_lower {S : alpha -> Prop} {s l : alpha}
    (hs : IsGreatestLowerBound F.le S s)
    (hl : IsLowerBound F.le S l) :
    F.le l s
proof:
:=
  hs.right l hl

name: exists_gt_of_glb_lt
statement:
theorem exists_gt_of_glb_lt {S : alpha -> Prop} {s t : alpha}
    (hs : IsGreatestLowerBound F.le S s)
    (hst : F.lt s t) :
    Exists (fun x => And (S x) (F.lt x t))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hex : Exists (fun x => And (S x) (F.lt x t))
  · exact hex
  · have htLower : IsLowerBound F.le S t := by
      intro x hxS
      by_cases htx : F.le t x
      · exact htx
      · cases F.le_total x t with
        | inl hxt =>
            have hxtlt : F.lt x t := lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxt htx
            exact False.elim
              (hex (Exists.intro x (And.intro hxS hxtlt)))
        | inr htx' =>
            exact htx'
    have hts : F.le t s := hs.right t htLower
    exact False.elim ((not_le_of_lt F hst) hts)

name: exists_lub
statement:
theorem exists_lub (S : alpha -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound C.field.le S)) :
    Exists (fun s => IsLeastUpperBound C.field.le S s)
proof:
:=
  C.complete.exists_lub S hne hbdd

name: exists_glb
statement:
theorem exists_glb (S : alpha -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsLowerBound C.field.le S)) :
    Exists (fun s => IsGreatestLowerBound C.field.le S s)
proof:
:= by
  let L : alpha -> Prop := fun l => IsLowerBound C.field.le S l
  have hL_nonempty : Exists L := hbdd
  have hL_bounded : Exists (IsUpperBound C.field.le L) := by
    cases hne with
    | intro x hx =>
        refine Exists.intro x ?_
        intro l hl
        exact hl x hx
  cases C.complete.exists_lub L hL_nonempty hL_bounded with
  | intro s hs =>
      refine Exists.intro s ?_
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        apply hs.right x
        intro l hl
        exact hl x hx
      · intro l hl
        exact hs.left l hl

name: nat_zero
statement: theorem nat_zero : nat F 0 = F.zero
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: nat_succ
statement:
theorem nat_succ (n : Nat) :
    nat F (n + 1) = F.add (nat F n) F.one
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: internalNat_zero
statement: theorem internalNat_zero : InternalNat F F.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS
  exact hS.left

name: internalNat_succ
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS
  exact hS.right x (hx S hS)

name: internalNat_inductive
statement:
theorem internalNat_inductive :
    InductiveSet F (InternalNat F)
proof:
:=
  And.intro
    (internalNat_zero F)
    (fun _ hx => internalNat_succ F hx)

name: internalNat_minimal
proof:
:=
  hx S hS

name: internalNat_induction
statement:
theorem internalNat_induction {P : alpha -> Prop}
    (h0 : P F.zero)
    (hsucc : forall x : alpha, InternalNat F x -> P x ->
      P (F.add x F.one)) :
    forall x : alpha, InternalNat F x -> P x
proof:
:= by
  let Q : alpha -> Prop := fun x => And (InternalNat F x) (P x)
  have hQ : InductiveSet F Q := by
    constructor
    · exact And.intro (internalNat_zero F) h0
    · intro x hx
      exact And.intro
        (internalNat_succ F hx.left)
        (hsucc x hx.left hx.right)
  intro x hx
  exact (internalNat_minimal F hQ hx).right

name: internalNat_of_nat
statement:
theorem internalNat_of_nat (n : Nat) :
    InternalNat F (nat F n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact internalNat_zero F
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [nat_succ]
      exact internalNat_succ F ih

name: internalNat_exists_nat
proof:
:= by
  let S : alpha -> Prop := fun y => Exists (fun n : Nat => y = nat F n)
  have hS : InductiveSet F S := by
    constructor
    · exact Exists.intro 0 rfl
    · intro y hy
      cases hy with
      | intro n hn =>
          refine Exists.intro (n + 1) ?_
          rw [hn, nat_succ]
  exact hx S hS

name: internalNat_one
statement: theorem internalNat_one : InternalNat F F.one
proof:
:= by
  have h := internalNat_succ F (internalNat_zero F)
  rwa [F.zero_add] at h

name: nat_one
statement: theorem nat_one : nat F 1 = F.one
proof:
:= by
  rw [nat_succ, nat_zero, F.zero_add]

name: nat_add
statement:
theorem nat_add (m n : Nat) :
    nat F (m + n) = F.add (nat F m) (nat F n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [Nat.add_zero, nat_zero, F.add_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.add_succ, nat_succ, ih, nat_succ, F.add_assoc]

name: nat_mul
statement:
theorem nat_mul (m n : Nat) :
    nat F (m * n) = F.mul (nat F m) (nat F n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [Nat.mul_zero, nat_zero, mul_zero F]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, nat_add, ih, nat_succ, F.mul_add, F.mul_one]

name: internalNat_add
proof:
:= by
  apply internalNat_induction F
    (P := fun y => InternalNat F (F.add x y))
  · rwa [F.add_zero]
  · intro y _ ih
    have h :
        F.add x (F.add y F.one) =
          F.add (F.add x y) F.one := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    rw [h]
    exact internalNat_succ F ih
  exact hy

name: internalNat_mul
proof:
:= by
  apply internalNat_induction F
    (P := fun y => InternalNat F (F.mul x y))
  · rw [mul_zero F]
    exact internalNat_zero F
  · intro y _ ih
    have h :
        F.mul x (F.add y F.one) =
          F.add (F.mul x y) x := by
      rw [F.mul_add, F.mul_one]
    rw [h]
    exact internalNat_add F ih hx
  exact hy

name: nat_nonneg
statement: theorem nat_nonneg (n : Nat) : F.le F.zero (nat F n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [nat_zero]
      exact F.le_refl F.zero
  | succ n ih =>
      have hstep :
          F.le (nat F n) (nat F (n + 1)) := by
        have h := F.add_le_add_right (zero_le_one F) (nat F n)
        rwa [F.zero_add, F.add_comm F.one (nat F n), <- nat_succ] at h
      exact F.le_trans ih hstep

name: nat_le_nat_succ
statement:
theorem nat_le_nat_succ (n : Nat) :
    F.le (nat F n) (nat F (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := F.add_le_add_right (zero_le_one F) (nat F n)
  rwa [F.zero_add, F.add_comm F.one (nat F n), <- nat_succ] at h

name: nat_lt_nat_succ
statement:
theorem nat_lt_nat_succ (n : Nat) :
    F.lt (nat F n) (nat F (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := add_lt_add_left F (zero_lt_one F) (nat F n)
  rwa [F.add_zero, <- nat_succ] at h

name: nat_le_nat_of_le
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hm0 : m = 0 := by omega
      subst hm0
      exact F.le_refl (nat F 0)
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hmn' : m <= n
      · exact F.le_trans (ih hmn') (nat_le_nat_succ F n)
      · have hm : m = n + 1 := by omega
        subst hm
        exact F.le_refl (nat F (n + 1))

name: nat_lt_nat_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : m + 1 <= n := by omega
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le F
    (nat_lt_nat_succ F m)
    (nat_le_nat_of_le F hsucc)

name: le_of_nat_le_nat
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hle : m <= n
  · exact hle
  · have hlt : n < m := by omega
    exact False.elim
      ((not_le_of_lt F (nat_lt_nat_of_lt F hlt)) hmn)

name: nat_succ_pos
statement:
theorem nat_succ_pos (n : Nat) :
    F.lt F.zero (nat F (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hstep :
      F.lt (nat F n) (nat F (n + 1)) := by
    exact nat_lt_nat_succ F n
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt F (nat_nonneg F n) hstep

name: nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      exact False.elim (hn rfl)
  | succ n =>
      intro h
      exact ne_of_lt F (nat_succ_pos F n) h.symm

name: nat_pos_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      exact False.elim (hn rfl)
  | succ n =>
      exact nat_succ_pos F n

name: bernoulliNumber_zero
statement:
theorem bernoulliNumber_zero :
    bernoulliNumber F 0 = F.one
proof:
:= by
  unfold bernoulliNumber Nat.strongRecOn
  rw [WellFounded.fix_eq]
  rfl

name: bernoulliNumber_succ
statement:
theorem bernoulliNumber_succ (n : Nat) :
    bernoulliNumber F (n + 1) =
      F.neg (F.mul (F.inv (nat F (n + 2)))
        (finiteSum F
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (n + 2) k))
              (bernoulliNumber F k))
          (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold bernoulliNumber Nat.strongRecOn
  rw [WellFounded.fix_eq]
  change
    F.neg (F.mul (F.inv (nat F (n + 2)))
        (finiteSum F
          (fun k : Nat =>
            if hk : k < n + 1 then
              F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (n + 2) k))
                ((Nat.lt_wfRel.wf.fix (bernoulliStep F)) k)
            else
              F.zero)
          (n + 1))) = _
  congr 2
  apply finiteSum_congr_lt F
  intro k hk
  simp only [dif_pos hk]

name: binom_succ_pred
statement:
private theorem binom_succ_pred :
    forall n : Nat,
      Tautology.Nat.binom (n + 1) n = n + 1
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_succ_succ]
      rw [binom_succ_pred n]
      rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_self]



/
of the numbers up to `n` vanishes, for every positive `n`. The definition is
this equation solved for the last summand, so the identity is a consequence
of it rather than the definition itself; `n = 0` is excluded because the sum
there is `B 0 = 1`. -/

name: bernoulli_recurrence
statement:
theorem bernoulli_recurrence {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) :
    finiteSum F
      (fun k : Nat =>
        F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (n + 1) k))
          (bernoulliNumber F k))
      (n + 1) = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hn)
  | succ m =>
      rw [finiteSum_succ]
      rw [binom_succ_pred (m + 1)]
      rw [bernoulliNumber_succ F m]
      let S : alpha :=
        finiteSum F
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 2) k))
              (bernoulliNumber F k))
          (m + 1)
      change
        F.add S
          (F.mul (nat F (m + 2))
            (F.neg (F.mul (F.inv (nat F (m + 2))) S))) = F.zero
      rw [mul_neg F]
      rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      rw [F.mul_inv_cancel (nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega))]
      rw [F.one_mul]
      rw [F.add_neg]

name: bernoulliNumber_one
statement:
theorem bernoulliNumber_one :
    bernoulliNumber F 1 = F.neg (F.inv (nat F 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [bernoulliNumber_succ F 0]
  rw [finiteSum_one]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_zero]
  rw [nat_one]
  rw [bernoulliNumber_zero]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [F.mul_one]

name: one_add_three_mul_neg_inv_two
statement:
private theorem one_add_three_mul_neg_inv_two :
    F.add F.one
        (F.mul (nat F 3) (F.neg (F.inv (nat F 2)))) =
      F.neg (F.inv (nat F 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_neg F]
  rw [nat_succ F 2]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [F.mul_inv_cancel (nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega))]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [neg_add_distrib F]
  rw [<- F.add_assoc]
  rw [F.add_neg]
  rw [F.zero_add]

name: bernoulliNumber_two
statement:
theorem bernoulliNumber_two :
    bernoulliNumber F 2 = F.inv (nat F 6)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bernoulliNumber_succ F 1]
  rw [finiteSum_succ]
  rw [finiteSum_one]
  change
    F.neg (F.mul (F.inv (nat F 3))
      (F.add
        (F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom 3 0))
          (bernoulliNumber F 0))
        (F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom 3 1))
          (bernoulliNumber F 1)))) = F.inv (nat F 6)
  rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_zero]
  change
    F.neg (F.mul (F.inv (nat F 3))
      (F.add
        (F.mul (nat F 1) (bernoulliNumber F 0))
        (F.mul (nat F 3) (bernoulliNumber F 1)))) = F.inv (nat F 6)
  rw [nat_one]
  rw [bernoulliNumber_zero]
  rw [bernoulliNumber_one]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [one_add_three_mul_neg_inv_two]
  rw [mul_neg F]
  rw [neg_neg F]
  have h2 : Not (nat F 2 = F.zero) :=
    nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega)
  have h3 : Not (nat F 3 = F.zero) :=
    nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega)
  calc
    F.mul (F.inv (nat F 3)) (F.inv (nat F 2)) =
        F.inv (F.mul (nat F 2) (nat F 3)) := by
          exact Eq.symm (inv_mul F h2 h3)
    _ = F.inv (nat F 6) := by
          rw [<- nat_mul F 2 3]

name: four_mul_inv_two_eq_two
statement:
private theorem four_mul_inv_two_eq_two :
    F.mul (nat F 4) (F.inv (nat F 2)) = nat F 2
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : Not (nat F 2 = F.zero) :=
    nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega)
  calc
    F.mul (nat F 4) (F.inv (nat F 2)) =
        F.mul (F.mul (nat F 2) (nat F 2))
          (F.inv (nat F 2)) := by
            rw [<- nat_mul F 2 2]
    _ = F.mul (nat F 2)
          (F.mul (nat F 2) (F.inv (nat F 2))) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (nat F 2) F.one := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel h2]
    _ = nat F 2 := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: bernoulli_three_inner_zero
statement:
private theorem bernoulli_three_inner_zero :
    F.add
        (F.add F.one
          (F.mul (nat F 4) (F.neg (F.inv (nat F 2)))))
        (F.mul (nat F 6) (F.inv (nat F 6))) =
      F.zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_neg F]
  rw [four_mul_inv_two_eq_two]
  rw [F.mul_inv_cancel (nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega))]
  rw [nat_succ F 1]
  rw [nat_one]
  rw [neg_add_distrib F]
  calc
    F.add
        (F.add F.one (F.add (F.neg F.one) (F.neg F.one)))
        F.one =
        F.add
          (F.add (F.add F.one (F.neg F.one)) (F.neg F.one))
          F.one := by
            congr 1
            exact Eq.symm
              (F.add_assoc F.one (F.neg F.one) (F.neg F.one))
    _ = F.add (F.add F.one (F.neg F.one))
          (F.add (F.neg F.one) F.one) := by
            exact F.add_assoc
              (F.add F.one (F.neg F.one)) (F.neg F.one) F.one
    _ = F.add F.zero F.zero := by
            rw [F.add_neg, F.neg_add]
    _ = F.zero := by rw [F.zero_add]

name: bernoulliNumber_three
statement:
theorem bernoulliNumber_three :
    bernoulliNumber F 3 = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [bernoulliNumber_succ F 2]
  rw [finiteSum_succ]
  rw [finiteSum_succ]
  rw [finiteSum_one]
  change
    F.neg (F.mul (F.inv (nat F 4))
      (F.add
        (F.add
          (F.mul (nat F 1) (bernoulliNumber F 0))
          (F.mul (nat F 4) (bernoulliNumber F 1)))
        (F.mul (nat F 6) (bernoulliNumber F 2)))) = F.zero
  rw [nat_one]
  rw [bernoulliNumber_zero]
  rw [bernoulliNumber_one]
  rw [bernoulliNumber_two]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [bernoulli_three_inner_zero]
  rw [F.mul_zero]
  rw [neg_zero F]

name: six_mul_five_mul_inv_two_eq_fifteen
statement:
private theorem six_mul_five_mul_inv_two_eq_fifteen :
    F.mul (nat F 6)
        (F.mul (nat F 5) (F.inv (nat F 2))) =
      nat F 15
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : Not (nat F 2 = F.zero) :=
    nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega)
  calc
    F.mul (nat F 6)
        (F.mul (nat F 5) (F.inv (nat F 2))) =
        F.mul (F.mul (nat F 6) (nat F 5))
          (F.inv (nat F 2)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (nat F (6 * 5)) (F.inv (nat F 2)) := by
            rw [nat_mul]
    _ = F.mul (nat F (15 * 2)) (F.inv (nat F 2)) := by
            rfl
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (nat F 15) (nat F 2))
          (F.inv (nat F 2)) := by
            rw [nat_mul]
    _ = F.mul (nat F 15)
          (F.mul (nat F 2) (F.inv (nat F 2))) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (nat F 15) F.one := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel h2]
    _ = nat F 15 := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: six_mul_ten_mul_inv_six_eq_ten
statement:
private theorem six_mul_ten_mul_inv_six_eq_ten :
    F.mul (nat F 6)
        (F.mul (nat F 10) (F.inv (nat F 6))) =
      nat F 10
proof:
:= by
  have h6 : Not (nat F 6 = F.zero) :=
    nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega)
  calc
    F.mul (nat F 6)
        (F.mul (nat F 10) (F.inv (nat F 6))) =
        F.mul (nat F 10)
          (F.mul (nat F 6) (F.inv (nat F 6))) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
            rw [F.mul_comm (nat F 6) (nat F 10)]
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (nat F 10) F.one := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel h6]
    _ = nat F 10 := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: bernoulli_four_inner_eq_inv_six
statement:
private theorem bernoulli_four_inner_eq_inv_six :
    F.add
        (F.add F.one
          (F.mul (nat F 5) (F.neg (F.inv (nat F 2)))))
        (F.mul (nat F 10) (F.inv (nat F 6))) =
      F.inv (nat F 6)
proof:
:= by
  have h6 : Not (nat F 6 = F.zero) :=
    nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega)
  apply eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left F h6
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [F.mul_one]
  rw [mul_neg F]
  rw [mul_neg F]
  rw [six_mul_five_mul_inv_two_eq_fifteen]
  rw [six_mul_ten_mul_inv_six_eq_ten]
  calc
    F.add (F.add (nat F 6) (F.neg (nat F 15))) (nat F 10) =
        F.add (F.add (nat F 6) (nat F 10))
          (F.neg (nat F 15)) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
            rw [F.add_comm (F.neg (nat F 15)) (nat F 10)]
            rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (nat F 16) (F.neg (nat F 15)) := by
            rw [<- nat_add]
    _ = F.add (F.add (nat F 15) F.one)
          (F.neg (nat F 15)) := by
            rw [nat_succ]
    _ = F.add (nat F 15)
          (F.add F.one (F.neg (nat F 15))) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (nat F 15)
          (F.add (F.neg (nat F 15)) F.one) := by
            rw [F.add_comm F.one (F.neg (nat F 15))]
    _ = F.add (F.add (nat F 15) (F.neg (nat F 15)))
          F.one := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.one := by rw [F.add_neg, F.zero_add]

name: bernoulliNumber_four
statement:
theorem bernoulliNumber_four :
    bernoulliNumber F 4 = F.neg (F.inv (nat F 30))
proof:
:= by
  rw [bernoulliNumber_succ F 3]
  rw [finiteSum_succ]
  rw [finiteSum_succ]
  rw [finiteSum_succ]
  rw [finiteSum_one]
  change
    F.neg (F.mul (F.inv (nat F 5))
      (F.add
        (F.add
          (F.add
            (F.mul (nat F 1) (bernoulliNumber F 0))
            (F.mul (nat F 5) (bernoulliNumber F 1)))
          (F.mul (nat F 10) (bernoulliNumber F 2)))
        (F.mul (nat F 10) (bernoulliNumber F 3)))) =
      F.neg (F.inv (nat F 30))
  rw [nat_one]
  rw [bernoulliNumber_zero]
  rw [bernoulliNumber_one]
  rw [bernoulliNumber_two]
  rw [bernoulliNumber_three]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [F.mul_zero]
  rw [F.add_zero]
  rw [bernoulli_four_inner_eq_inv_six]
  congr 1
  have h5 : Not (nat F 5 = F.zero) :=
    nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega)
  have h6 : Not (nat F 6 = F.zero) :=
    nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega)
  calc
    F.mul (F.inv (nat F 5)) (F.inv (nat F 6)) =
        F.inv (F.mul (nat F 6) (nat F 5)) := by
          exact Eq.symm (inv_mul F h6 h5)
    _ = F.inv (nat F 30) := by
          rw [<- nat_mul F 6 5]

name: bernoulliPower_zero
statement:
private theorem bernoulliPower_zero (x : alpha) :
    bernoulliPower F x 0 = F.one
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: bernoulliPower_succ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: bernoulliPower_zero_succ
statement:
private theorem bernoulliPower_zero_succ (n : Nat) :
    bernoulliPower F F.zero (n + 1) = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [bernoulliPower_succ]
  rw [zero_mul F]

name: bernoulliPower_one
statement:
private theorem bernoulliPower_one :
    forall n : Nat, bernoulliPower F F.one n = F.one
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [bernoulliPower_succ]
      rw [bernoulliPower_one n]
      rw [F.one_mul]



/
with Bernoulli-number coefficients, `B k` times `t ^ (m - k)`, summed over
`k <= m`. Only values are formalised 
this depth of the library, and the powers are a private `Nat.rec` iteration 
so a polynomial value is literally a finite sum and the whole calculus of
`Tautology.RealBootstrap.FiniteSum.Basic` applies to it. -/
noncomputable def bernoulliPolynomialValue (m : Nat) (t : alpha) : alpha
proof:
:=
  finiteSum F
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.mul
        (F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom m k))
          (bernoulliNumber F k))
        (bernoulliPower F t (m - k)))
    (m + 1)

name: bernoulliPolynomialValue_zero
statement:
theorem bernoulliPolynomialValue_zero (m : Nat) :
    bernoulliPolynomialValue F m F.zero = bernoulliNumber F m
proof:
:= by
  unfold bernoulliPolynomialValue
  rw [finiteSum_succ]
  have hprefix :
      finiteSum F
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.mul
              (F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom m k))
                (bernoulliNumber F k))
              (bernoulliPower F F.zero (m - k)))
          m = F.zero := by
    apply finiteSum_eq_zero F
    intro k hk
    have hpos : 0 < m - k := by omega
    cases hpow : m - k with
    | zero => omega
    | succ q =>
        rw [bernoulliPower_zero_succ]
        rw [F.mul_zero]
  rw [hprefix]
  rw [F.zero_add]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_self]
  rw [nat_one]
  rw [Nat.sub_self]
  rw [bernoulliPower_zero]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [F.mul_one]

name: bernoulliPolynomialValue_one_eq
statement:
theorem bernoulliPolynomialValue_one_eq {m : Nat} (hm : 2 <= m) :
    bernoulliPolynomialValue F m F.one =
      bernoulliPolynomialValue F m F.zero
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m =>
      cases m with
      | zero => omega
      | succ r =>
          rw [bernoulliPolynomialValue_zero]
          unfold bernoulliPolynomialValue
          rw [finiteSum_succ]
          have hprefix :
              finiteSum F
                  (fun k : Nat =>
                    F.mul
                      (F.mul
                        (nat F
                          (Tautology.Nat.binom (r + 2) k))
                        (bernoulliNumber F k))
                      (bernoulliPower F F.one (r + 2 - k)))
                  (r + 2) = F.zero := by
            calc
              finiteSum F
                  (fun k : Nat =>
                    F.mul
                      (F.mul
                        (nat F
                          (Tautology.Nat.binom (r + 2) k))
                        (bernoulliNumber F k))
                      (bernoulliPower F F.one (r + 2 - k)))
                  (r + 2) =
                  finiteSum F
                    (fun k : Nat =>
                      F.mul
                        (nat F
                          (Tautology.Nat.binom (r + 2) k))
                        (bernoulliNumber F k))
                    (r + 2) := by
                      apply finiteSum_congr_lt F
                      intro k hk
                      rw [bernoulliPower_one]
                      rw [F.mul_one]
              _ = F.zero :=
                    bernoulli_recurrence F (n := r + 1) (by omega)
          rw [hprefix]
          rw [F.zero_add]
          rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_self]
          rw [nat_one]
          rw [Nat.sub_self]
          rw [bernoulliPower_one]
          rw [F.one_mul]
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: bernoulliSign_zero
statement:
private theorem bernoulliSign_zero :
    bernoulliSign F 0 = F.one
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: bernoulliSign_succ
statement:
private theorem bernoulliSign_succ (n : Nat) :
    bernoulliSign F (n + 1) = F.neg (bernoulliSign F n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: bernoulliPolynomialValue_eq_coefficientValue
statement:
private theorem bernoulliPolynomialValue_eq_coefficientValue
    (m : Nat) (t : alpha) :
    bernoulliPolynomialValue F m t =
      finiteCoefficientValue F (bernoulliCoefficient F m) m t
proof:
:= by
  unfold bernoulliPolynomialValue finiteCoefficientValue
  rw [finiteSum_reverse F
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.mul
        (F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom m k))
          (bernoulliNumber F k))
        (bernoulliPower F t (m - k)))
    m]
  apply finiteSum_congr_lt F
  intro j hj
  unfold bernoulliCoefficient
  have hjm : j <= m := by omega
  have hsub : m - (m - j) = j := by omega
  rw [hsub]
  rw [<- Tautology.Nat.binom_symm_of_le (n := m) (k := j) hjm]

name: bernoulliCoefficient_derivative
statement:
private theorem bernoulliCoefficient_derivative
    {m j : Nat} (hj : j <= m) :
    F.mul (nat F (j + 1))
        (bernoulliCoefficient F (m + 1) (j + 1)) =
      F.mul (nat F (m + 1))
        (bernoulliCoefficient F m j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bernoulliCoefficient
  have hsub : m + 1 - (j + 1) = m - j := by omega
  rw [hsub]
  have hweighted :
      F.mul (nat F (j + 1))
          (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1))) =
        F.mul (nat F (m + 1))
          (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom m j)) := by
    calc
      F.mul (nat F (j + 1))
          (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1))) =
          nat F
            ((j + 1) * Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1)) := by
              rw [nat_mul]
      _ = nat F
            ((m + 1) * Tautology.Nat.binom m j) := by
              rw [Tautology.Nat.succ_mul_binom_succ hj]
      _ = F.mul (nat F (m + 1))
            (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom m j)) := by
              rw [nat_mul]
  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
  rw [hweighted]

name: mul_inv_eq_inv_mul_of_cross
statement:
private theorem mul_inv_eq_inv_mul_of_cross
    {a b c d : alpha}
    (ha : Not (a = F.zero)) (hb : Not (b = F.zero))
    (hcross : F.mul a c = F.mul b d) :
    F.mul d (F.inv a) = F.mul (F.inv b) c
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul d (F.inv a) =
        F.mul F.one (F.mul d (F.inv a)) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.inv b) b)
          (F.mul d (F.inv a)) := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hb]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv b)
          (F.mul (F.mul b d) (F.inv a)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv b)
          (F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.inv a)) := by
          rw [hcross]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv b)
          (F.mul c (F.mul a (F.inv a))) := by
          congr 1
          calc
            F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.inv a) =
                F.mul (F.mul c a) (F.inv a) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm a c]
            _ = F.mul c (F.mul a (F.inv a)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv b) (F.mul c F.one) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel ha]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv b) c := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: bernoulliCoefficient_average_term
statement:
private theorem bernoulliCoefficient_average_term
    {m j : Nat} (hj : j <= m) :
    F.mul (bernoulliCoefficient F m j)
        (F.inv (nat F (j + 1))) =
      F.mul (F.inv (nat F (m + 1)))
        (F.mul
          (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1)))
          (bernoulliNumber F (m - j)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold bernoulliCoefficient
  have hj1 : Not (nat F (j + 1) = F.zero) :=
    nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega)
  have hm1 : Not (nat F (m + 1) = F.zero) :=
    nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F (by omega)
  have hcross :
      F.mul (nat F (j + 1))
          (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1))) =
        F.mul (nat F (m + 1))
          (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom m j)) := by
    calc
      F.mul (nat F (j + 1))
          (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1))) =
          nat F
            ((j + 1) * Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1)) := by
              rw [nat_mul]
      _ = nat F
            ((m + 1) * Tautology.Nat.binom m j) := by
              rw [Tautology.Nat.succ_mul_binom_succ hj]
      _ = F.mul (nat F (m + 1))
            (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom m j)) := by
              rw [nat_mul]
  have hratio :
      F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom m j))
          (F.inv (nat F (j + 1))) =
        F.mul (F.inv (nat F (m + 1)))
          (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1))) :=
    mul_inv_eq_inv_mul_of_cross F hj1 hm1 hcross
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom m j))
          (bernoulliNumber F (m - j)))
        (F.inv (nat F (j + 1))) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom m j))
            (F.inv (nat F (j + 1))))
          (bernoulliNumber F (m - j)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
            rw [F.mul_comm
              (bernoulliNumber F (m - j))
              (F.inv (nat F (j + 1)))]
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul
          (F.mul (F.inv (nat F (m + 1)))
            (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1))))
          (bernoulliNumber F (m - j)) := by
            rw [hratio]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv (nat F (m + 1)))
          (F.mul
            (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1)))
            (bernoulliNumber F (m - j))) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: bernoulliCoefficient_average_zero
statement:
private theorem bernoulliCoefficient_average_zero
    {m : Nat} (hm : 0 < m) :
    finiteCoefficientAverage F (bernoulliCoefficient F m) m =
      F.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteCoefficientAverage
  calc
    finiteSum F
        (fun j : Nat =>
          F.mul (bernoulliCoefficient F m j)
            (F.inv (nat F (j + 1))))
        (m + 1) =
        finiteSum F
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.mul (F.inv (nat F (m + 1)))
              (F.mul
                (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1)))
                (bernoulliNumber F (m - j))))
          (m + 1) := by
            apply finiteSum_congr_lt F
            intro j hj
            exact bernoulliCoefficient_average_term F (by omega)
    _ = F.mul (F.inv (nat F (m + 1)))
          (finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul
                (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1)))
                (bernoulliNumber F (m - j)))
            (m + 1)) := by
            exact finiteSum_mul_left F
              (F.inv (nat F (m + 1)))
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.mul
                  (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1)))
                  (bernoulliNumber F (m - j)))
              (m + 1)
    _ = F.mul (F.inv (nat F (m + 1)))
          (finiteSum F
            (fun k : Nat =>
              F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) k))
                (bernoulliNumber F k))
            (m + 1)) := by
            congr 1
            rw [finiteSum_reverse F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.mul
                  (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) (j + 1)))
                  (bernoulliNumber F (m - j)))
              m]
            apply finiteSum_congr_lt F
            intro k hk
            have hkm : k <= m := by omega
            have hindex : m - (m - k) = k := by omega
            have hchooseIndex :
                m - k + 1 = (m + 1) - k := by omega
            rw [hindex]
            rw [hchooseIndex]
            rw [<- Tautology.Nat.binom_symm_of_le
              (n := m + 1) (k := k) (by omega)]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv (nat F (m + 1))) F.zero := by
            rw [bernoulli_recurrence F hm]
    _ = F.zero := by rw [F.mul_zero]

name: bernoulliPower_step_of_lt
statement:
private theorem bernoulliPower_step_of_lt
    (x : alpha) {n j : Nat} (hj : j < n) :
    F.mul x (bernoulliPower F x (n - (j + 1))) =
      bernoulliPower F x (n - j)
proof:
:= by
  have h : n - j = (n - (j + 1)) + 1 := by omega
  rw [h]

name: binomialPowerTerm_out_of_range
statement:
private theorem binomialPowerTerm_out_of_range
    (x y : alpha) (n : Nat) :
    binomialPowerTerm F x y n (n + 1) = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold binomialPowerTerm
  rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_eq_zero_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]
  rw [nat_zero]
  rw [F.zero_mul]
  rw [F.zero_mul]

name: binomialPowerPascalRight_prepend_zero
statement:
private theorem binomialPowerPascalRight_prepend_zero
    (x y : alpha) (n : Nat) :
    finiteSum F
        (binomialPowerPascalRightTerm F x y n)
        ((n + 1) + 1) =
      finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat => binomialPowerShiftTerm F x y n k)
        (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold binomialPowerPascalRightTerm
  change
    finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat =>
          match k with
          | 0 => F.zero
          | j + 1 => binomialPowerShiftTerm F x y n j)
        ((n + 1) + 1) =
      finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat => binomialPowerShiftTerm F x y n k)
        (n + 1)
  exact finiteSum_prepend_zero F
    (fun k : Nat => binomialPowerShiftTerm F x y n k) (n + 1)

name: binomialPowerTerm_pascal
statement:
private theorem binomialPowerTerm_pascal
    (x y : alpha) (n k : Nat) (hk : k < (n + 1) + 1) :
    F.add
        (F.mul x (binomialPowerTerm F x y n k))
        (binomialPowerPascalRightTerm F x y n k) =
      binomialPowerTerm F x y (n + 1) k
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      unfold binomialPowerPascalRightTerm binomialPowerTerm
      rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_zero]
      rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_succ_zero]
      rw [nat_one]
      rw [Nat.sub_zero]
      rw [Nat.sub_zero]
      rw [bernoulliPower_zero]
      rw [F.one_mul]
      rw [F.mul_one]
      rw [F.mul_one]
      rw [F.add_zero]
      rw [bernoulliPower_succ]
      rw [F.one_mul]
  | succ j =>
      unfold binomialPowerPascalRightTerm
      unfold binomialPowerShiftTerm binomialPowerTerm
      rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_succ_succ]
      rw [nat_add]
      have hexp : n + 1 - (j + 1) = n - j := by omega
      rw [hexp]
      by_cases hj : j < n
      · have hstep := bernoulliPower_step_of_lt F x hj
        let A : alpha := nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom n j)
        let B : alpha := nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom n (j + 1))
        let X : alpha := bernoulliPower F x (n - j)
        let Y : alpha := bernoulliPower F y (j + 1)
        have hfirst :
            F.mul x
                (F.mul
                  (F.mul B
                    (bernoulliPower F x (n - (j + 1)))) Y) =
              F.mul (F.mul B X) Y := by
          let P : alpha := bernoulliPower F x (n - (j + 1))
          calc
            F.mul x
                (F.mul
                  (F.mul B
                    (bernoulliPower F x (n - (j + 1)))) Y) =
                F.mul (F.mul x (F.mul B P)) Y := by
                  exact Eq.symm
                    (F.mul_assoc x (F.mul B P) Y)
            _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul x B) P) Y := by
                  congr 1
                  exact Eq.symm (F.mul_assoc x B P)
            _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul B x) P) Y := by
                  congr 1
                  congr 1
                  exact F.mul_comm x B
            _ = F.mul (F.mul B (F.mul x P)) Y := by
                  congr 1
                  exact F.mul_assoc B x P
            _ = F.mul (F.mul B X) Y := by rw [hstep]
        rw [hfirst]
        change
          F.add (F.mul (F.mul B X) Y) (F.mul (F.mul A X) Y) =
            F.mul (F.mul (F.add A B) X) Y
        calc
          F.add (F.mul (F.mul B X) Y) (F.mul (F.mul A X) Y) =
              F.add (F.mul (F.mul A X) Y)
                (F.mul (F.mul B X) Y) := by
                  rw [F.add_comm]
          _ = F.mul
                (F.add (F.mul A X) (F.mul B X)) Y := by
                  exact Eq.symm
                    (F.add_mul (F.mul A X) (F.mul B X) Y)
          _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.add A B) X) Y := by
                  rw [<- F.add_mul]
      · have hjn : j = n := by omega
        subst j
        simp only
        rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_eq_zero_of_lt
          (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]
        rw [nat_zero]
        rw [F.zero_mul]
        rw [F.zero_mul]
        rw [F.mul_zero]
        rw [F.zero_add]
        rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_self]
        rw [nat_one]
        rw [Nat.sub_self]
        rw [bernoulliPower_zero]
        rw [F.one_mul]
        rw [F.one_mul]
        rw [F.add_zero]
        rw [F.one_mul]
        rw [F.one_mul]

name: binomialPowerExpansion_pascal
statement:
private theorem binomialPowerExpansion_pascal
    (x y : alpha) (n : Nat) :
    binomialPowerExpansion F x y (n + 1) =
      F.add
        (F.mul x (binomialPowerExpansion F x y n))
        (finiteSum F
          (fun k : Nat => binomialPowerShiftTerm F x y n k)
          (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold binomialPowerExpansion
  calc
    finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat => binomialPowerTerm F x y (n + 1) k)
        ((n + 1) + 1) =
        finiteSum F
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.add
              (F.mul x (binomialPowerTerm F x y n k))
              (binomialPowerPascalRightTerm F x y n k))
          ((n + 1) + 1) := by
            apply finiteSum_congr_lt F
            intro k hk
            exact Eq.symm (binomialPowerTerm_pascal F x y n k hk)
    _ = F.add
          (finiteSum F
            (fun k : Nat =>
              F.mul x (binomialPowerTerm F x y n k))
            ((n + 1) + 1))
          (finiteSum F
            (binomialPowerPascalRightTerm F x y n)
            ((n + 1) + 1)) := by
            exact finiteSum_add F
              (fun k : Nat =>
                F.mul x (binomialPowerTerm F x y n k))
              (binomialPowerPascalRightTerm F x y n)
              ((n + 1) + 1)
    _ = F.add
          (finiteSum F
            (fun k : Nat =>
              F.mul x (binomialPowerTerm F x y n k))
            (n + 1))
          (finiteSum F
            (binomialPowerPascalRightTerm F x y n)
            ((n + 1) + 1)) := by
            have hlast :
                F.mul x (binomialPowerTerm F x y n (n + 1)) =
                  F.zero := by
              rw [binomialPowerTerm_out_of_range]
              rw [F.mul_zero]
            rw [finiteSum_append_zero
              (F := F)
              (term := fun k : Nat =>
                F.mul x (binomialPowerTerm F x y n k))
              (n := n + 1) hlast]
    _ = F.add
          (F.mul x
            (finiteSum F
              (fun k : Nat => binomialPowerTerm F x y n k)
              (n + 1)))
          (finiteSum F
            (binomialPowerPascalRightTerm F x y n)
            ((n + 1) + 1)) := by
            rw [finiteSum_mul_left]
    _ = F.add
          (F.mul x
            (finiteSum F
              (fun k : Nat => binomialPowerTerm F x y n k)
              (n + 1)))
          (finiteSum F
            (fun k : Nat => binomialPowerShiftTerm F x y n k)
            (n + 1)) := by
            rw [binomialPowerPascalRight_prepend_zero]

name: binomialPowerShift_eq_mul_term
statement:
private theorem binomialPowerShift_eq_mul_term
    (x y : alpha) (n k : Nat) :
    binomialPowerShiftTerm F x y n k =
      F.mul y (binomialPowerTerm F x y n k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold binomialPowerShiftTerm binomialPowerTerm
  rw [bernoulliPower_succ]
  let A : alpha :=
    F.mul (nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom n k))
      (bernoulliPower F x (n - k))
  calc
    F.mul A (F.mul y (bernoulliPower F y k)) =
        F.mul (F.mul A y) (bernoulliPower F y k) := by
          exact Eq.symm (F.mul_assoc A y (bernoulliPower F y k))
    _ = F.mul (F.mul y A) (bernoulliPower F y k) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm A y]
    _ = F.mul y (F.mul A (bernoulliPower F y k)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: binomialPowerExpansion_eq_power
statement:
private theorem binomialPowerExpansion_eq_power :
    forall n : Nat,
      binomialPowerExpansion F x y n =
        bernoulliPower F (F.add x y) n
  | 0 => by
      unfold binomialPowerExpansion binomialPowerTerm
      rw [finiteSum_one]
      rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_zero_zero]
      rw [nat_one]
      rw [Nat.sub_zero]
      change F.mul (F.mul F.one F.one) F.one = F.one
      rw [F.one_mul]
      rw [F.one_mul]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [binomialPowerExpansion_pascal]
      have hshift :
          finiteSum F
              (fun k : Nat => binomialPowerShiftTerm F x y n k)
              (n + 1) =
            F.mul y (binomialPowerExpansion F x y n)
proof:
:= by
        unfold binomialPowerExpansion
        calc
          finiteSum F
              (fun k : Nat => binomialPowerShiftTerm F x y n k)
              (n + 1) =
              finiteSum F
                (fun k : Nat =>
                  F.mul y (binomialPowerTerm F x y n k))
                (n + 1) := by
                  apply finiteSum_congr F
                  intro k
                  rw [binomialPowerShift_eq_mul_term]
          _ = F.mul y
                (finiteSum F
                  (fun k : Nat => binomialPowerTerm F x y n k)
                  (n + 1)) := by
                  rw [finiteSum_mul_left]
      rw [hshift]
      rw [binomialPowerExpansion_eq_power n]
      rw [bernoulliPower_succ]
      rw [F.add_mul]

name: bernoulliPower_neg
statement:
private theorem bernoulliPower_neg
    (t : alpha) : forall n : Nat,
      bernoulliPower F (F.neg t) n =
        F.mul (bernoulliSign F n) (bernoulliPower F t n)
  | 0 => by
      rw [bernoulliPower_zero]
      rw [bernoulliSign_zero]
      rw [F.one_mul]
      rw [bernoulliPower_zero]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [bernoulliPower_succ]
      rw [bernoulliPower_neg t n]
      rw [bernoulliSign_succ]
      rw [bernoulliPower_succ]
      calc
        F.mul (F.neg t)
            (F.mul (bernoulliSign F n) (bernoulliPower F t n)) =
            F.neg
              (F.mul t
                (F.mul (bernoulliSign F n)
                  (bernoulliPower F t n)))
proof:
:= by
                rw [neg_mul F]
        _ = F.neg
              (F.mul (bernoulliSign F n)
                (F.mul t (bernoulliPower F t n))) := by
                congr 1
                calc
                  F.mul t
                      (F.mul (bernoulliSign F n)
