cauchyCoeff_comm
statement:
theorem cauchyCoeff_comm
    (a b : Nat -> alpha) (k : Nat) :
    cauchyCoeff F a b k = cauchyCoeff F b a k
proof:
:= by
  unfold cauchyCoeff
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_reverse F
    (fun i : Nat => F.mul (a i) (b (k - i))) k]
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
  intro i hi
  have hidx : k - (k - i) = i := by
    omega
  rw [hidx]
  rw [F.mul_comm]

name: eqUpTo_mul_comm
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [coeff_mul, coeff_mul]
  exact cauchyCoeff_comm F s.coeff t.coeff k

name: cauchyCoeff_assoc
statement:
theorem cauchyCoeff_assoc
    (a b c : Nat -> alpha) (k : Nat) :
    cauchyCoeff F (fun i : Nat => cauchyCoeff F a b i) c k =
      cauchyCoeff F a (fun i : Nat => cauchyCoeff F b c i) k
proof:
:= by
  unfold cauchyCoeff
  calc
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun i : Nat =>
          F.mul
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat => F.mul (a j) (b (i - j))) (i + 1))
            (c (k - i)))
        (k + 1) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun i : Nat =>
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul (F.mul (a j) (b (i - j))) (c (k - i)))
            (i + 1))
        (k + 1) := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
        intro i hi
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_right F]
    _ =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun j : Nat =>
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun h : Nat =>
              F.mul (F.mul (a j) (b ((j + h) - j)))
                (c (k - (j + h))))
            (k + 1 - j))
        (k + 1) := by
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_triangle_swap F]
    _ =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun j : Nat =>
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun h : Nat =>
              F.mul (F.mul (a j) (b h))
                (c (k - j - h)))
            (k + 1 - j))
        (k + 1) := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
        intro j hj
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
        intro h hh
        have hsub1 : (j + h) - j = h := by
          omega
        have hsub2 : k - (j + h) = k - j - h := by
          omega
        rw [hsub1, hsub2]
    _ =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun j : Nat =>
          F.mul (a j)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun h : Nat => F.mul (b h) (c (k - j - h)))
              (k - j + 1)))
        (k + 1) := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
        intro j hj
        have hlen : k + 1 - j = k - j + 1 := by
          omega
        rw [hlen]
        calc
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun h : Nat =>
                F.mul (F.mul (a j) (b h))
                  (c (k - j - h)))
              (k - j + 1) =
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun h : Nat =>
                F.mul (a j)
                  (F.mul (b h) (c (k - j - h))))
              (k - j + 1) := by
              apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
              intro h hh
              rw [F.mul_assoc]
          _ =
            F.mul (a j)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun h : Nat => F.mul (b h) (c (k - j - h)))
                (k - j + 1)) := by
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_left F]

name: eqUpTo_mul_assoc
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [coeff_mul, coeff_mul]
  exact cauchyCoeff_assoc F s.coeff t.coeff u.coeff k

name: eqUpTo_mul_add
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_mul_add {N : Nat}
    (s t u : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N) :
    EqUpTo (mul F s (add F t u))
      (add F (mul F s t) (mul F s u))
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [coeff_mul]
  rw [coeff_add]
  rw [coeff_mul]
  rw [coeff_mul]
  unfold cauchyCoeff
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_add F
    (fun i : Nat => F.mul (s.coeff i) (t.coeff (k - i)))
    (fun i : Nat => F.mul (s.coeff i) (u.coeff (k - i)))
    (k + 1)]
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
  intro i hi
  rw [coeff_add]
  rw [F.mul_add]

name: eqUpTo_add_mul
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_add_mul {N : Nat}
    (s t u : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N) :
    EqUpTo (mul F (add F s t) u)
      (add F (mul F s u) (mul F t u))
proof:
:= by
  have hComm :
      EqUpTo (mul F (add F s t) u)
        (mul F u (add F s t)) :=
    eqUpTo_mul_comm F (add F s t) u
  have hDist :
      EqUpTo (mul F u (add F s t))
        (add F (mul F u s) (mul F u t)) :=
    eqUpTo_mul_add F u s t
  have hTerms :
      EqUpTo (add F (mul F u s) (mul F u t))
        (add F (mul F s u) (mul F t u)) :=
    eqUpTo_add F
      (eqUpTo_mul_comm F u s)
      (eqUpTo_mul_comm F u t)
  exact eqUpTo_trans hComm (eqUpTo_trans hDist hTerms)

name: coeff_mul_shiftUp_left_succ
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_shiftUp_left_succ {N : Nat}
    (A : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N)
    (B : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1)) (m : Nat) :
    (mul F (shiftUp F A) B).coeff (m + 1) =
      (mul F A (truncate B)).coeff m
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul, coeff_mul]
  unfold cauchyCoeff
  have hterms :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun i : Nat =>
            F.mul ((shiftUp F A).coeff i) (B.coeff (m + 1 - i)))
          (m + 1 + 1) =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun i : Nat =>
            match i with
            | 0 => F.zero
            | j + 1 => F.mul (A.coeff j) (B.coeff (m - j)))
          (m + 1 + 1) := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero =>
        rw [coeff_shiftUp_zero]
        rw [F.zero_mul]
    | succ j =>
        rw [coeff_shiftUp_succ]
        have hidx : m + 1 - (j + 1) = m - j := by
          omega
        rw [hidx]
  calc
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun i : Nat =>
          F.mul ((shiftUp F A).coeff i) (B.coeff (m + 1 - i)))
        (m + 1 + 1) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun i : Nat =>
          match i with
          | 0 => F.zero
          | j + 1 => F.mul (A.coeff j) (B.coeff (m - j)))
        (m + 1 + 1) := hterms
    _ =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun j : Nat => F.mul (A.coeff j) (B.coeff (m - j)))
        (m + 1) := by
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_prepend_zero F
        (fun j : Nat => F.mul (A.coeff j) (B.coeff (m - j))) (m + 1)
    _ =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun i : Nat => F.mul (A.coeff i) ((truncate B).coeff (m - i)))
        (m + 1) := by
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
      intro i hi
      rw [coeff_truncate]

name: eqUpTo_mul_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk

  rw [coeff_zero]
  unfold cauchyCoeff

name: eqUpTo_mul_scale_left

name: eqUpTo_mul_rotate_right
proof:
:= by
  exact eqUpTo_trans
    (eqUpTo_mul_assoc F q a r)
    (eqUpTo_trans
      (eqUpTo_mul F (eqUpTo_refl q) (eqUpTo_mul_comm F a r))

name: eqUpTo_add_neg_scale_nat_neg_self
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_add_neg_scale_nat_neg_self {N : Nat}
    (n : Nat) (s : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N) :
    EqUpTo
      (add F
        (neg F (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) s))
        (neg F s))
      (neg F
        (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (n + 1)) s))
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [coeff_add]
  rw [coeff_neg]
  rw [coeff_scale]
  rw [coeff_neg]
  rw [coeff_neg]
  rw [coeff_scale]
  calc
    F.add
        (F.neg (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) (s.coeff k)))
        (F.neg (s.coeff k)) =
      F.neg
        (F.add
          (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) (s.coeff k))
          (s.coeff k)) := by
        rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F
          (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) (s.coeff k))
          (s.coeff k)]
    _ =
      F.neg
        (F.add
          (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) (s.coeff k))
          (F.mul F.one (s.coeff k))) := by
        rw [F.one_mul]
    _ =
      F.neg
        (F.mul
          (F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) F.one)
          (s.coeff k)) := by
        rw [F.add_mul]
    _ =
      F.neg
        (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (n + 1)) (s.coeff k)) := by
        rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ F n]

name: cauchyCoeff_one_left
statement:
theorem cauchyCoeff_one_left {N : Nat}
    (a : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall k : Nat,
      cauchyCoeff F
        ((one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N).coeff) a k =
        a k
  | 0 => by
      unfold cauchyCoeff
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_one]
      change
        F.mul ((one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N).coeff 0)
          (a 0) = a 0
      rw [coeff_one_zero]
      rw [F.one_mul]
  | k + 1 => by
      unfold cauchyCoeff
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_split_first F
        (fun i : Nat =>
          F.mul
            ((one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N).coeff i)
            (a (k + 1 - i)))
        (k + 1)]
      change
        F.add
            (F.mul
              ((one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N).coeff 0)
              (a (k + 1 - 0)))
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.mul
                  ((one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N).coeff (j + 1))
                  (a (k + 1 - (j + 1))))
              (k + 1)) =
          a (k + 1)
      rw [Nat.sub_zero]
      rw [coeff_one_zero]
      rw [F.one_mul]
      have htail :
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.mul
                  ((one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N).coeff (j + 1))
                  (a (k + 1 - (j + 1))))
              (k + 1) =
            F.zero
proof:
:= by
        calc
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.mul
                  ((one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N).coeff (j + 1))
                  (a (k + 1 - (j + 1))))
              (k + 1) =
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun _ : Nat => F.zero) (k + 1) := by
                apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
                intro j
                rw [coeff_one_succ]
                rw [F.zero_mul]
          _ = F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (k + 1))
                F.zero := by
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_const]
          _ = F.zero := by
                rw [F.mul_zero]
      rw [htail]
      rw [F.add_zero]

name: coeff_pow_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ, pow_zero]
  rw [coeff_mul]
  exact cauchyCoeff_one_left (F := F) (N := N) s.coeff k

name: cauchyCoeff_one_right
statement:
theorem cauchyCoeff_one_right {N : Nat}
    (a : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall k : Nat,
      cauchyCoeff F a
        ((one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N).coeff) k =
        a k
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  calc
    cauchyCoeff F a
        ((one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N).coeff) k =
        cauchyCoeff F
          ((one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N).coeff) a k :=
      cauchyCoeff_comm F a
        ((one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N).coeff) k
    _ = a k :=
      cauchyCoeff_one_left (F := F) (N := N) a k

name: eqUpTo_one_mul
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [coeff_mul]
  exact cauchyCoeff_one_left (F := F) (N := N) s.coeff k

name: eqUpTo_mul_one
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [coeff_mul]
  exact cauchyCoeff_one_right (F := F) (N := N) s.coeff k

name: eqUpTo_deriv
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [coeff_deriv, coeff_deriv]
  rw [h (k + 1) (by omega)]

name: eqUpTo_deriv_add
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_deriv_add {N : Nat}
    (s t : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1)) :
    EqUpTo (deriv F (add F s t))
      (add F (deriv F s) (deriv F t))
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [coeff_deriv]
  rw [coeff_add]
  rw [coeff_add]
  rw [coeff_deriv]
  rw [coeff_deriv]
  exact F.mul_add
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (k + 1))
    (s.coeff (k + 1))
    (t.coeff (k + 1))

name: eqUpTo_deriv_sub
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_deriv_sub {N : Nat}
    (s t : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1)) :
    EqUpTo (deriv F (sub F s t))
      (sub F (deriv F s) (deriv F t))
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [coeff_deriv]
  rw [coeff_sub]
  rw [coeff_sub]
  rw [coeff_deriv]
  rw [coeff_deriv]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
    F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (k + 1))
    (s.coeff (k + 1))
    (t.coeff (k + 1))

name: eqUpTo_euler
proof:
:= by
  unfold euler
  exact eqUpTo_shiftUp F (eqUpTo_deriv F h)

name: euler_mul_coeff_term
statement:
theorem euler_mul_coeff_term
    (a b : Nat -> alpha) {k i : Nat}
    (hi : i < k + 1) :
    F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F k)
        (F.mul (a i) (b (k - i))) =
      F.add
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F i) (a i))
          (b (k - i)))
        (F.mul (a i)
          (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (k - i))
            (b (k - i))))
proof:
:= by
  let ni := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F i
  let nj := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (k - i)
  let ai := a i
  let bj := b (k - i)
  have hle : i <= k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hi
  have hnat :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F k = F.add ni nj := by
    have hsum : i + (k - i) = k := Nat.add_sub_of_le hle
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_add F i (k - i)
    unfold ni nj
    rw [hsum] at h
    exact h
  change
    F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F k) (F.mul ai bj) =
      F.add (F.mul (F.mul ni ai) bj)
        (F.mul ai (F.mul nj bj))
  rw [hnat]
  calc
    F.mul (F.add ni nj) (F.mul ai bj) =
        F.add (F.mul ni (F.mul ai bj))
          (F.mul nj (F.mul ai bj)) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul (F.mul ni ai) bj)
          (F.mul nj (F.mul ai bj)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc ni ai bj]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul (F.mul ni ai) bj)
          (F.mul ai (F.mul nj bj)) := by
          congr 1
          calc
            F.mul nj (F.mul ai bj) =
                F.mul (F.mul nj ai) bj := by
                rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
            _ = F.mul (F.mul ai nj) bj := by
                rw [F.mul_comm nj ai]
            _ = F.mul ai (F.mul nj bj) := by
                rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: eqUpTo_euler_mul
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_euler_mul {N : Nat}
    (s t : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1)) :
    EqUpTo (euler F (mul F s t))
      (add F (mul F (euler F s) t) (mul F s (euler F t)))
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [coeff_euler]
  rw [coeff_add]
  rw [coeff_mul]
  rw [coeff_mul]
  rw [coeff_mul]
  unfold cauchyCoeff
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_left F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F k)
    (fun i : Nat => F.mul (s.coeff i) (t.coeff (k - i)))
    (k + 1)]
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_add F
    (fun i : Nat =>
      F.mul ((euler F s).coeff i) (t.coeff (k - i)))
    (fun i : Nat =>
      F.mul (s.coeff i) ((euler F t).coeff (k - i)))
    (k + 1)]
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
  intro i hi
  rw [coeff_euler]
  rw [coeff_euler]
  exact euler_mul_coeff_term F s.coeff t.coeff hi

name: eqUpTo_euler_one_zero
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_euler_one_zero {N : Nat} :
    EqUpTo (euler F (one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1)))
      (zero F)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      rw [coeff_euler_zero, coeff_zero]
  | succ k =>
      rw [coeff_euler_succ, coeff_one_succ, F.mul_zero, coeff_zero]

name: coeff_sub_euler_self
statement:
theorem coeff_sub_euler_self {N : Nat}
    (s : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1)) (n : Nat) :
    (sub F (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) s)
        (euler F s)).coeff n = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_sub]
  rw [coeff_scale]
  rw [coeff_euler]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.add_neg]

name: reciprocalCoeff_congr_lt_aux
statement:
theorem reciprocalCoeff_congr_lt_aux
    {N : Nat} {a b : Nat -> alpha} {a0Inv b0Inv : alpha}
    (h0 : a0Inv = b0Inv)
    (h : forall k : Nat, k < N -> a k = b k) :
    forall k : Nat, k < N ->
      reciprocalCoeff F a a0Inv k =
        reciprocalCoeff F b b0Inv k
  | 0, hk => by
      rw [reciprocalCoeff.eq_def, reciprocalCoeff.eq_def]
      rw [h0]
  | n + 1, hk => by
      rw [reciprocalCoeff.eq_def, reciprocalCoeff.eq_def]
      rw [h0]
      change
        F.neg
            (F.mul b0Inv
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun i : Nat =>
                  F.mul (a (i + 1))
                    (reciprocalCoeff F a b0Inv (n - i)))
                (n + 1))) =
          F.neg
            (F.mul b0Inv
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun i : Nat =>
                  F.mul (b (i + 1))
                    (reciprocalCoeff F b b0Inv (n - i)))
                (n + 1)))
      congr 2
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
      intro i hi
      rw [h (i + 1) (by omega)]
      rw [reciprocalCoeff_congr_lt_aux
        (N := N) rfl h (n - i) (by omega)]

/
precision, so sequences agreeing below `N` have agreeing reciprocal
sequences. This is what lets `EqUpTo` propagate through `reciprocal`
(`eqUpTo_reciprocal`). -/

name: reciprocalCoeff_congr_lt
statement:
theorem reciprocalCoeff_congr_lt
    {N : Nat} {a b : Nat -> alpha}
    (h : forall k : Nat, k < N -> a k = b k) :
    forall k : Nat, k < N ->
      reciprocalCoeff F a (F.inv (a 0)) k =
        reciprocalCoeff F b (F.inv (b 0)) k
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  exact reciprocalCoeff_congr_lt_aux F
    (by rw [h 0 (by omega)]) h k hk

name: eqUpTo_reciprocal
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  unfold reciprocal
  change
    reciprocalCoeff F s.coeff (F.inv (s.coeff 0)) k =
      reciprocalCoeff F t.coeff (F.inv (t.coeff 0)) k
  exact reciprocalCoeff_congr_lt F h k hk

name: eqUpTo_div
proof:
:= by
  unfold div
  exact eqUpTo_mul F hs (eqUpTo_reciprocal F ht)

name: cauchyCoeff_reciprocalCoeff_zero
statement:
theorem cauchyCoeff_reciprocalCoeff_zero
    (a : Nat -> alpha)
    (ha0 : Not (a 0 = F.zero)) :
    cauchyCoeff F a
      (reciprocalCoeff F a (F.inv (a 0))) 0 =
      F.one
proof:
:= by
  unfold cauchyCoeff
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_one]
  change F.mul (a 0)
    (reciprocalCoeff F a (F.inv (a 0)) 0) = F.one
  rw [reciprocalCoeff.eq_def]
  exact F.mul_inv_cancel ha0

name: cauchyCoeff_reciprocalCoeff_succ
statement:
theorem cauchyCoeff_reciprocalCoeff_succ
    (a : Nat -> alpha)
    (ha0 : Not (a 0 = F.zero)) (n : Nat) :
    cauchyCoeff F a
      (reciprocalCoeff F a (F.inv (a 0))) (n + 1) =
      F.zero
proof:
:= by
  let r : Nat -> alpha := reciprocalCoeff F a (F.inv (a 0))
  let tailSum : alpha :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
      (fun i : Nat => F.mul (a (i + 1)) (r (n - i))) (n + 1)
  have hrec :
      r (n + 1) =
        F.neg (F.mul (F.inv (a 0)) tailSum) := by
    unfold r tailSum
    rw [reciprocalCoeff.eq_def]
  have hsplit :
      cauchyCoeff F a r (n + 1) =
        F.add (F.mul (a 0) (r (n + 1))) tailSum := by
    unfold cauchyCoeff tailSum
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_split_first F
      (fun i : Nat => F.mul (a i) (r (n + 1 - i))) (n + 1)]
    change
      F.add (F.mul (a 0) (r (n + 1 - 0)))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul (a (j + 1)) (r (n + 1 - (j + 1))))
            (n + 1)) =
        F.add (F.mul (a 0) (r (n + 1)))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun i : Nat => F.mul (a (i + 1)) (r (n - i)))
            (n + 1))
    rw [Nat.sub_zero]
    congr 1
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
    intro j
    have hidx : n + 1 - (j + 1) = n - j := by
      omega
    rw [hidx]
  change cauchyCoeff F a r (n + 1) = F.zero
  rw [hsplit]
  rw [hrec]
  calc
    F.add (F.mul (a 0)
        (F.neg (F.mul (F.inv (a 0)) tailSum))) tailSum =
        F.add
          (F.neg
            (F.mul (a 0)
              (F.mul (F.inv (a 0)) tailSum))) tailSum := by
          rw [F.mul_neg]
    _ =
        F.add
          (F.neg
            (F.mul (F.mul (a 0) (F.inv (a 0))) tailSum))
          tailSum := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.add
          (F.neg (F.mul F.one tailSum)) tailSum := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel ha0]
    _ = F.add (F.neg tailSum) tailSum := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.zero := by
          rw [F.neg_add]

name: eqUpTo_mul_reciprocal
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_mul_reciprocal {N : Nat}
    (s : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N)
    (hs : HasUnitConstant F s) :
    EqUpTo (mul F s (reciprocal F s)) (one F)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      rw [coeff_mul]
      rw [coeff_one_zero]
      unfold reciprocal
      exact cauchyCoeff_reciprocalCoeff_zero F s.coeff hs
  | succ n =>
      rw [coeff_mul]
      rw [coeff_one_succ]
      unfold reciprocal
      exact cauchyCoeff_reciprocalCoeff_succ F s.coeff hs n

name: eqUpTo_mul_reciprocal_left
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_mul_reciprocal_left {N : Nat}
    (s : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N)
    (hs : HasUnitConstant F s) :
    EqUpTo (mul F (reciprocal F s) s) (one F)
proof:
:= by
  exact eqUpTo_trans
    (eqUpTo_mul_comm F (reciprocal F s) s)
    (eqUpTo_mul_reciprocal F s hs)

name: eqUpTo_unit_left_cancel_zero
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_unit_left_cancel_zero {N : Nat}
    (s t : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N)
    (hs : HasUnitConstant F s)
    (h : EqUpTo (mul F s t) (zero F)) :
    EqUpTo t (zero F)
proof:
:= by
  let r : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N := reciprocal F s
  have hmul :
      EqUpTo (mul F r (mul F s t)) (mul F r (zero F)) :=
    eqUpTo_mul F (eqUpTo_refl r) h
  have hmulZero :
      EqUpTo (mul F r (mul F s t)) (zero F) :=
    eqUpTo_trans hmul (eqUpTo_mul_zero F r)
  have hassoc :
      EqUpTo (mul F (mul F r s) t) (mul F r (mul F s t)) :=
    eqUpTo_mul_assoc F r s t
  have hleft :
      EqUpTo (mul F (mul F r s) t) (zero F) :=
    eqUpTo_trans hassoc hmulZero
  have hone :
      EqUpTo (mul F (mul F r s) t) (mul F (one F) t) :=
    eqUpTo_mul F (eqUpTo_mul_reciprocal_left F s hs) (eqUpTo_refl t)
  have honeZero :
      EqUpTo (mul F (one F) t) (zero F) :=
    eqUpTo_trans (eqUpTo_symm hone) hleft
  exact eqUpTo_trans (eqUpTo_symm (eqUpTo_one_mul F t)) honeZero

name: eqUpTo_euler_mul_reciprocal_zero
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_euler_mul_reciprocal_zero {N : Nat}
    (s : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1))
    (hs : HasUnitConstant F s) :
    EqUpTo (euler F (mul F s (reciprocal F s))) (zero F)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul :
      EqUpTo (mul F s (reciprocal F s)) (one F) :=
    eqUpTo_mul_reciprocal F s hs
  have heuler :
      EqUpTo (euler F (mul F s (reciprocal F s)))
        (euler F (one F)) :=
    eqUpTo_euler F hmul
  exact eqUpTo_trans heuler (eqUpTo_euler_one_zero F)

name: eqUpTo_euler_reciprocal
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_euler_reciprocal {N : Nat}
    (s : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1))
    (hs : HasUnitConstant F s) :
    EqUpTo (euler F (reciprocal F s))
      (neg F
        (mul F (reciprocal F s)
          (mul F (euler F s) (reciprocal F s))))
proof:
:= by
  let r : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1) := reciprocal F s
  let B : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1) := euler F r
  let A : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1) :=
    mul F (euler F s) r
  let P : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1) := mul F r A
  have hproductRule :
      EqUpTo (euler F (mul F s r))
        (add F A (mul F s B)) := by
    exact eqUpTo_euler_mul F s r
  have hproductZero :
      EqUpTo (euler F (mul F s r)) (zero F) := by
    exact eqUpTo_euler_mul_reciprocal_zero F s hs
  have hsumZero :
      EqUpTo (add F A (mul F s B)) (zero F) :=
    eqUpTo_trans (eqUpTo_symm hproductRule) hproductZero
  have hdist :
      EqUpTo (mul F s (add F B P))
        (add F (mul F s B) (mul F s P)) :=
    eqUpTo_mul_add F s B P
  have hspAssoc :
      EqUpTo (mul F s P) (mul F (mul F s r) A) :=
    eqUpTo_symm (eqUpTo_mul_assoc F s r A)
  have hspOne :
      EqUpTo (mul F (mul F s r) A) (mul F (one F) A) :=
    eqUpTo_mul F (eqUpTo_mul_reciprocal F s hs) (eqUpTo_refl A)
  have hspA :
      EqUpTo (mul F s P) A :=
    eqUpTo_trans hspAssoc
      (eqUpTo_trans hspOne (eqUpTo_one_mul F A))
  have haddReorder :
      EqUpTo (add F (mul F s B) (mul F s P))
        (add F A (mul F s B)) :=
    eqUpTo_trans
      (eqUpTo_add F (eqUpTo_refl (mul F s B)) hspA)
      (eqUpTo_add_comm F (mul F s B) A)
  have hmulSumZero :
      EqUpTo (mul F s (add F B P)) (zero F) :=
    eqUpTo_trans hdist (eqUpTo_trans haddReorder hsumZero)
  have haddZero :
      EqUpTo (add F B P) (zero F) :=
    eqUpTo_unit_left_cancel_zero F s (add F B P) hs hmulSumZero
  exact eqUpTo_eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right F haddZero

name: eqUpTo_euler_pow
statement:
theorem eqUpTo_euler_pow {N : Nat}
    (s : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1))
    (hs : HasUnitConstant F s) (n : Nat) :
    EqUpTo (euler F (pow F (reciprocal F s) n))
      (neg F
        (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
          (mul F (pow F (reciprocal F s) n)
            (mul F (euler F s) (reciprocal F s)))))
proof:
:= by
  let r : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1) := reciprocal F s
  let A : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1) :=
    mul F (euler F s) r
  change
    EqUpTo (euler F (pow F r n))
      (neg F
        (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
          (mul F (pow F r n) A)))
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [pow_zero]
      have hleft :
          EqUpTo (euler F (one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1)))
            (zero F) :=
        eqUpTo_euler_one_zero F
      have hright :
          EqUpTo
            (neg F
              (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F 0)
                (mul F (one F : TruncatedPowerSeries alpha (N + 1)) A)))
            (zero F) := by
        intro k hk
        rw [coeff_neg]
        rw [coeff_scale]
        rw [coeff_zero]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero]
      exact eqUpTo_trans hleft (eqUpTo_symm hright)
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      have hproduct :
          EqUpTo (euler F (mul F (pow F r n) r))
            (add F
              (mul F (euler F (pow F r n)) r)
              (mul F (pow F r n) (euler F r))) :=
        eqUpTo_euler_mul F (pow F r n) r
      have hterm1 :
          EqUpTo
            (mul F (euler F (pow F r n)) r)
            (neg F
              (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
                (mul F (mul F (pow F r n) r) A))) := by
        have h1 :
            EqUpTo
              (mul F (euler F (pow F r n)) r)
              (mul F
                (neg F
                  (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
                    (mul F (pow F r n) A)))
                r) :=
          eqUpTo_mul F ih (eqUpTo_refl r)
        have h2 :
            EqUpTo
              (mul F
                (neg F
                  (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
                    (mul F (pow F r n) A)))
                r)
              (neg F
                (mul F
                  (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
                    (mul F (pow F r n) A))
                  r)) :=
          eqUpTo_mul_neg_left F
            (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
              (mul F (pow F r n) A))
            r
        have h3 :
            EqUpTo
              (neg F
                (mul F
                  (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
                    (mul F (pow F r n) A))
                  r))
              (neg F
                (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
                  (mul F (mul F (pow F r n) A) r))) :=
          eqUpTo_neg F
            (eqUpTo_mul_scale_left F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
              (mul F (pow F r n) A) r)
        have h4 :
            EqUpTo
              (neg F
                (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
                  (mul F (mul F (pow F r n) A) r)))
              (neg F
                (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
                  (mul F (mul F (pow F r n) r) A))) :=
          eqUpTo_neg F
            (eqUpTo_scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
              (eqUpTo_mul_rotate_right F (pow F r n) A r))
        exact eqUpTo_trans h1 (eqUpTo_trans h2 (eqUpTo_trans h3 h4))
      have hterm2 :
          EqUpTo
            (mul F (pow F r n) (euler F r))
            (neg F (mul F (mul F (pow F r n) r) A)) := by
        have hrec :
            EqUpTo (euler F r) (neg F (mul F r A)) :=
          eqUpTo_euler_reciprocal F s hs
        have h1 :
            EqUpTo
              (mul F (pow F r n) (euler F r))
              (mul F (pow F r n) (neg F (mul F r A))) :=
          eqUpTo_mul F (eqUpTo_refl (pow F r n)) hrec
        have h2 :
            EqUpTo
              (mul F (pow F r n) (neg F (mul F r A)))
              (neg F (mul F (pow F r n) (mul F r A))) :=
          eqUpTo_mul_neg_right F (pow F r n) (mul F r A)
        have h3 :
            EqUpTo
              (neg F (mul F (pow F r n) (mul F r A)))
              (neg F (mul F (mul F (pow F r n) r) A)) :=
          eqUpTo_neg F
            (eqUpTo_symm (eqUpTo_mul_assoc F (pow F r n) r A))
        exact eqUpTo_trans h1 (eqUpTo_trans h2 h3)
      have hsum :
          EqUpTo
            (add F
              (mul F (euler F (pow F r n)) r)
              (mul F (pow F r n) (euler F r)))
            (neg F
              (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (n + 1))
                (mul F (mul F (pow F r n) r) A))) := by
        have hadd :
            EqUpTo
              (add F
                (mul F (euler F (pow F r n)) r)
                (mul F (pow F r n) (euler F r)))
              (add F
                (neg F
                  (scale F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
                    (mul F (mul F (pow F r n) r) A)))
                (neg F (mul F (mul F (pow F r n) r) A))) :=
          eqUpTo_add F hterm1 hterm2
        exact eqUpTo_trans hadd
          (eqUpTo_add_neg_scale_nat_neg_self F n
            (mul F (mul F (pow F r n) r) A))
      exact eqUpTo_trans hproduct hsum

name: one_ne_zero
statement: theorem one_ne_zero : Not (F.one = F.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact F.zero_ne_one h.symm

name: add_add_add_comm
statement:
theorem add_add_add_comm (a b c d : alpha) :
    F.add (F.add a b) (F.add c d) =
      F.add (F.add a c) (F.add b d)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.add a b) (F.add c d) =
        F.add a (F.add b (F.add c d)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add a (F.add (F.add b c) d) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc b c d]
    _ = F.add a (F.add (F.add c b) d) := by
          rw [F.add_comm b c]
    _ = F.add a (F.add c (F.add b d)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc c b d]
    _ = F.add (F.add a c) (F.add b d) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc a c (F.add b d)]

name: add_left_cancel
statement:
theorem add_left_cancel {a b c : alpha}
    (h : F.add a b = F.add a c) : b = c
proof:
:= by
  calc
    b = F.add F.zero b := by rw [F.zero_add]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.neg a) a) b := by rw [F.neg_add]
    _ = F.add (F.neg a) (F.add a b) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.neg a) (F.add a c) := by rw [h]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.neg a) a) c := by rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add F.zero c := by rw [F.neg_add]
    _ = c := by rw [F.zero_add]

name: add_right_cancel
statement:
theorem add_right_cancel {a b c : alpha}
    (h : F.add b a = F.add c a) : b = c
proof:
:= by
  apply add_left_cancel F (a := a)
  calc
    F.add a b = F.add b a := F.add_comm a b
    _ = F.add c a := h
    _ = F.add a c := F.add_comm c a

name: add_neg_cancel_right
statement:
theorem add_neg_cancel_right (x y : alpha) :
    F.add (F.add x y) (F.neg y) = x
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.add x y) (F.neg y) =
        F.add x (F.add y (F.neg y)) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add x F.zero := by rw [F.add_neg]
    _ = x := by rw [F.add_zero]

name: neg_add_cancel_left
statement:
theorem neg_add_cancel_left (x y : alpha) :
    F.add (F.neg x) (F.add x y) = y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.neg x) (F.add x y) =
        F.add (F.add (F.neg x) x) y := by rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add F.zero y := by rw [F.neg_add]
    _ = y := by rw [F.zero_add]

name: eq_zero_of_add_eq_self_left
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_add_eq_self_left {x y : alpha}
    (h : F.add x y = x) : y = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  apply add_left_cancel F (a := x)
  rw [h, F.add_zero]

name: eq_zero_of_add_eq_self_right
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_add_eq_self_right {x y : alpha}
    (h : F.add y x = x) : y = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_add_eq_self_left F (x := x)
  calc
    F.add x y = F.add y x := F.add_comm x y
    _ = x := h

name: eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left
statement:
theorem eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left {x y : alpha}
    (h : F.add x y = F.zero) : y = F.neg x
proof:
:= by
  apply add_left_cancel F (a := x)
  rw [h, F.add_neg]

name: eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right
statement:
theorem eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right {x y : alpha}
    (h : F.add y x = F.zero) : y = F.neg x
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left F (x := x)
  calc
    F.add x y = F.add y x := F.add_comm x y
    _ = F.zero := h

name: neg_zero
statement: theorem neg_zero : F.neg F.zero = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_add_eq_self_right F (x := F.zero)
  exact F.neg_add F.zero

name: neg_neg
statement: theorem neg_neg (x : alpha) : F.neg (F.neg x) = x
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left F (x := F.neg x)
  exact F.neg_add x

name: neg_add_distrib
statement:
theorem neg_add_distrib (x y : alpha) :
    F.neg (F.add x y) = F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left F (x := F.add x y)
  have hinner :
      F.add y (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y)) = F.neg x := by
    calc
      F.add y (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y)) =
          F.add y (F.add (F.neg y) (F.neg x)) := by
            rw [F.add_comm (F.neg x) (F.neg y)]
      _ = F.add (F.add y (F.neg y)) (F.neg x) := by
            rw [<- F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add F.zero (F.neg x) := by rw [F.add_neg]
      _ = F.neg x := by rw [F.zero_add]
  calc
    F.add (F.add x y) (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y)) =
        F.add x (F.add y (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add x (F.neg x) := by rw [hinner]
    _ = F.zero := F.add_neg x

name: sub_self
statement: theorem sub_self (x : alpha) : F.sub x x = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact F.add_neg x

name: zero_mul
statement: theorem zero_mul (x : alpha) : F.mul F.zero x = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      F.add (F.mul F.zero x) (F.mul F.zero x) =
        F.mul F.zero x := by
    calc
      F.add (F.mul F.zero x) (F.mul F.zero x) =
          F.mul (F.add F.zero F.zero) x := by rw [F.add_mul]
      _ = F.mul F.zero x := by rw [F.add_zero]
  exact eq_zero_of_add_eq_self_left F hsum

name: mul_zero
statement: theorem mul_zero (x : alpha) : F.mul x F.zero = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.mul_comm]
  exact zero_mul F x

name: mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  calc
    y = F.mul F.one y := by rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.inv x) x) y := by rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hx]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv x) (F.mul x y) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv x) (F.mul x z) := by rw [h]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.inv x) x) z := by rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul F.one z := by rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hx]
    _ = z := by rw [F.one_mul]

name: mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero F (x := z) hz
  calc
    F.mul z x = F.mul x z := F.mul_comm z x
    _ = F.mul y z := h
    _ = F.mul z y := F.mul_comm y z

name: eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero_left
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero F (x := x) hx
  rw [h, mul_zero]

name: eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero_right
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero F (z := y) hy
  rw [h, zero_mul]

name: mul_eq_zero_cases
statement:
theorem mul_eq_zero_cases {x y : alpha}
    (h : F.mul x y = F.zero) : Or (x = F.zero) (y = F.zero)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = F.zero
  · exact Or.inl hx
  · exact Or.inr (eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero_left F hx h)

name: mul_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mul_ne_zero {x y : alpha}
    (hx : Not (x = F.zero))
    (hy : Not (y = F.zero)) :
    Not (F.mul x y = F.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  cases mul_eq_zero_cases F h with
  | inl hx0 => exact hx hx0
  | inr hy0 => exact hy hy0

name: eq_one_of_mul_eq_self_left
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero F (x := x) hx
  rw [h, F.mul_one]

name: eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero F (x := x) hx
  rw [h, F.mul_inv_cancel hx]

name: eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left F hx
  calc
    F.mul x y = F.mul y x := F.mul_comm x y
    _ = F.one := h

name: inv_one
statement: theorem inv_one : F.inv F.one = F.one
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left F (x := F.one)
  · exact one_ne_zero F
  · rw [F.mul_one]

name: inv_mul
statement:
theorem inv_mul {x y : alpha}
    (hx : Not (x = F.zero))
    (hy : Not (y = F.zero)) :
    F.inv (F.mul x y) = F.mul (F.inv y) (F.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left F
    (x := F.mul x y)
  · exact mul_ne_zero F hx hy
  · calc
      F.mul (F.mul x y) (F.mul (F.inv y) (F.inv x)) =
          F.mul x (F.mul y (F.mul (F.inv y) (F.inv x))) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc x y (F.mul (F.inv y) (F.inv x))]
      _ = F.mul x (F.mul (F.mul y (F.inv y)) (F.inv x)) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc y (F.inv y) (F.inv x)]
      _ = F.mul x (F.mul F.one (F.inv x)) := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hy]
      _ = F.mul x (F.inv x) := by rw [F.one_mul]
      _ = F.one := by rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hx]

name: inv_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro hinv
  have h := F.mul_inv_cancel hx
  rw [hinv, mul_zero F x] at h
  exact F.zero_ne_one h

name: inv_mul_inv_right
statement:
theorem inv_mul_inv_right {a b : alpha}
    (ha : Not (a = F.zero))
    (hb : Not (b = F.zero)) :
    F.inv (F.mul a (F.inv b)) =
      F.mul b (F.inv a)
proof:
:= by
  have hinvb_ne := inv_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F hb
  have hinv_inv : F.inv (F.inv b) = b := by
    symm
    exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left F hinvb_ne (F.inv_mul_cancel hb)
  rw [inv_mul F ha hinvb_ne, hinv_inv]

name: inv_inv_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hinv_ne : Not (F.inv x = F.zero) :=
    inv_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F hx
  symm
  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left F hinv_ne (F.inv_mul_cancel hx)

name: mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul x (F.inv y)) y =
        F.mul x (F.mul (F.inv y) y) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul x F.one := by rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hy]
    _ = x := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: mul_mul_inv_cancel_right
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul x y) (F.inv y) =
        F.mul x (F.mul y (F.inv y)) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul x F.one := by rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hy]
    _ = x := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: nonpos_of_not_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl h0x =>
      exact False.elim (h h0x)
  | inr hx0 =>
      exact hx0

name: neg_nonneg_of_nonpos
proof:
:= by
  have h := F.add_le_add_right hx (F.neg x)
  rwa [F.add_neg, F.zero_add] at h

name: neg_nonpos_of_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  have h := F.add_le_add_right hx (F.neg x)
  rwa [F.zero_add, F.add_neg] at h

name: nonpos_of_neg_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  have h := F.add_le_add_right hx x
  rwa [F.zero_add, F.neg_add] at h

name: nonneg_of_neg_nonpos
proof:
:= by
  have h := F.add_le_add_right hx x
  rwa [F.neg_add, F.zero_add] at h

name: abs_of_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold abs
  simp [hx]

name: abs_of_nonpos
proof:
:= by
  unfold abs
  by_cases h0x : F.le F.zero x
  · have hx0 : x = F.zero := F.le_antisymm hx h0x
    rw [if_pos h0x, hx0, neg_zero F]
  · simp [h0x]

name: abs_zero
statement:
theorem abs_zero :
    abs F F.zero = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  exact abs_of_nonneg F (F.le_refl F.zero)

name: abs_one
statement:
theorem abs_one :
    abs F F.one = F.one
proof:
:= by
  exact abs_of_nonneg F (le_of_lt F (zero_lt_one F))

name: abs_nonneg
statement:
theorem abs_nonneg (x : alpha) :
    F.le F.zero (abs F x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : F.le F.zero x
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg F hx]
    exact hx
  · rw [abs_of_nonpos F (nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hx)]
    exact neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F (nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hx)

name: abs_add_one_pos
statement:
theorem abs_add_one_pos (x : alpha) :
    F.lt F.zero (F.add (abs F x) F.one)
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : F.lt (abs F x) (F.add (abs F x) F.one) := by
    have h := add_lt_add_left F (zero_lt_one F) (abs F x)
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt F (abs_nonneg F x) hstep

name: abs_neg
statement:
theorem abs_neg (x : alpha) :
    abs F (F.neg x) = abs F x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : F.le F.zero x
  · have hnx : F.le (F.neg x) F.zero :=
      neg_nonpos_of_nonneg F hx
    rw [abs_of_nonpos F hnx]
    rw [neg_neg F x]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg F hx]
  · have hx0 : F.le x F.zero :=
      nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hx
    have h0nx : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
      neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx0
    rw [abs_of_nonneg F h0nx]
    rw [abs_of_nonpos F hx0]

name: le_abs_self
statement:
theorem le_abs_self (x : alpha) :
    F.le x (abs F x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : F.le F.zero x
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg F hx]
    exact F.le_refl x
  · have hx0 : F.le x F.zero :=
      nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hx
    exact F.le_trans hx0 (abs_nonneg F x)

name: neg_le_abs_self
statement:
theorem neg_le_abs_self (x : alpha) :
    F.le (F.neg x) (abs F x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : F.le F.zero x
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg F hx]
    exact F.le_trans (neg_nonpos_of_nonneg F hx) hx
  · have hx0 : F.le x F.zero :=
      nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hx
    rw [abs_of_nonpos F hx0]
    exact F.le_refl (F.neg x)

name: abs_le_of_bounds
statement:
theorem abs_le_of_bounds {x b : alpha}
    (hxb : F.le x b)
    (hnxb : F.le (F.neg x) b) :
    F.le (abs F x) b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : F.le F.zero x
  · rwa [abs_of_nonneg F hx]
  · have hx0 : F.le x F.zero :=
      nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hx
    rwa [abs_of_nonpos F hx0]

name: abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
statement:
theorem abs_add_le_abs_add_abs (x y : alpha) :
    F.le (abs F (F.add x y)) (F.add (abs F x) (abs F y))
proof:
:= by
  apply abs_le_of_bounds F
  · exact add_le_add F (le_abs_self F x) (le_abs_self F y)
  · rw [neg_add_distrib F x y]
    exact add_le_add F (neg_le_abs_self F x) (neg_le_abs_self F y)

name: abs_add_sub_add_le_abs_sub_add_abs_sub
statement:
theorem abs_add_sub_add_le_abs_sub_add_abs_sub
    (x y I J : alpha) :
    F.le
      (abs F (F.sub (F.add x y) (F.add I J)))
      (F.add (abs F (F.sub x I)) (abs F (F.sub y J)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F]
  exact abs_add_le_abs_add_abs F (F.sub x I) (F.sub y J)

name: abs_mul
statement:
theorem abs_mul (x y : alpha) :
    abs F (F.mul x y) = F.mul (abs F x) (abs F y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : F.le F.zero x
  · by_cases hy : F.le F.zero y
    · have hxy : F.le F.zero (F.mul x y) :=
        F.mul_nonneg hx hy
      rw [abs_of_nonneg F hx]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg F hy]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg F hxy]
    · have hy0 : F.le y F.zero :=
        nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hy
      have hny : F.le F.zero (F.neg y) :=
        neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hy0
      have hnegprod : F.le F.zero (F.neg (F.mul x y)) := by
        have hprod : F.le F.zero (F.mul x (F.neg y)) :=
          F.mul_nonneg hx hny
        rwa [F.mul_neg] at hprod
      have hprod0 : F.le (F.mul x y) F.zero :=
        nonpos_of_neg_nonneg F hnegprod
      rw [abs_of_nonneg F hx]
      rw [abs_of_nonpos F hy0]
      rw [abs_of_nonpos F hprod0]
      rw [F.mul_neg]
  · have hx0 : F.le x F.zero :=
      nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hx
    have hnx : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
      neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx0
    by_cases hy : F.le F.zero y
    · have hnegprod : F.le F.zero (F.neg (F.mul x y)) := by
        have hprod : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) y) :=
          F.mul_nonneg hnx hy
        rwa [F.neg_mul] at hprod
      have hprod0 : F.le (F.mul x y) F.zero :=
        nonpos_of_neg_nonneg F hnegprod
      rw [abs_of_nonpos F hx0]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg F hy]
      rw [abs_of_nonpos F hprod0]
      rw [F.neg_mul]
    · have hy0 : F.le y F.zero :=
        nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hy
      have hny : F.le F.zero (F.neg y) :=
        neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hy0
      have hprod : F.le F.zero (F.mul x y) := by
        have hprod' : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg y)) :=
          F.mul_nonneg hnx hny
        rwa [F.neg_mul_neg] at hprod'
      rw [abs_of_nonpos F hx0]
      rw [abs_of_nonpos F hy0]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg F hprod]
      rw [F.neg_mul_neg]

name: abs_sub_comm
statement:
theorem abs_sub_comm (x y : alpha) :
    abs F (F.sub x y) = abs F (F.sub y x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F y x]
  rw [abs_neg F (F.sub y x)]

name: abs_abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub
statement:
theorem abs_abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (x y : alpha) :
    F.le
      (abs F (F.sub (abs F x) (abs F y)))
      (abs F (F.sub x y))
proof:
:= by
  have hxyTriangle := abs_add_le_abs_add_abs F (F.sub x y) y
  change
    F.le
      (F.abs (F.add (F.sub x y) y))
      (F.add (F.abs (F.sub x y)) (F.abs y)) at hxyTriangle
  rw [F.sub_add_cancel] at hxyTriangle
  have hupper := F.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
    hxyTriangle (F.le_refl (F.abs y))
  change
    F.le
      (F.sub (F.abs x) (F.abs y))
      (F.sub
        (F.add (F.abs (F.sub x y)) (F.abs y)) (F.abs y)) at hupper
  rw [F.add_sub_cancel] at hupper
  have hyxTriangle := abs_add_le_abs_add_abs F (F.sub y x) x
  change
    F.le
      (F.abs (F.add (F.sub y x) x))
      (F.add (F.abs (F.sub y x)) (F.abs x)) at hyxTriangle
  rw [F.sub_add_cancel] at hyxTriangle
  have hreverse := F.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
    hyxTriangle (F.le_refl (F.abs x))
  change
    F.le
      (F.sub (F.abs y) (F.abs x))
      (F.sub
        (F.add (F.abs (F.sub y x)) (F.abs x)) (F.abs x)) at hreverse
  rw [F.add_sub_cancel] at hreverse
  rw [abs_sub_comm F y x] at hreverse
  have hlower :
      F.le
        (F.neg (F.sub (F.abs x) (F.abs y)))
        (F.abs (F.sub x y)) := by
    rw [<- F.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub (F.abs x) (F.abs y)]
    exact hreverse
  exact abs_le_of_bounds F hupper hlower

name: abs_eq_zero_of_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [hx]
  exact abs_zero F

name: eq_zero_of_abs_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0x : F.le F.zero x
  · rwa [abs_of_nonneg F h0x] at hx
  · have hx0 : F.le x F.zero :=
      nonpos_of_not_nonneg F h0x
    have hneg : F.neg x = F.zero := by
      rwa [abs_of_nonpos F hx0] at hx
    calc
      x = F.neg (F.neg x) := by rw [neg_neg F x]
      _ = F.neg F.zero := by rw [hneg]
      _ = F.zero := neg_zero F

name: abs_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem abs_eq_zero_iff {x : alpha} :
    abs F x = F.zero <-> x = F.zero
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (eq_zero_of_abs_eq_zero F)
    (abs_eq_zero_of_eq_zero F)

name: abs_pos_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le F
  · exact abs_nonneg F x
  · intro hle
    have hzero : abs F x = F.zero :=
      F.le_antisymm hle (abs_nonneg F x)
    exact hx ((abs_eq_zero_iff F).mp hzero)

name: quotient_error_eq_remainder_mul_inv
statement:
theorem quotient_error_eq_remainder_mul_inv
    {A c d : alpha}
    (hd : Not (d = F.zero)) :
    F.sub (F.mul A (F.inv d)) c =
      F.mul (F.sub A (F.mul c d)) (F.inv d)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.inv d) = c := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.inv d) =
          F.mul c (F.mul d (F.inv d)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul c F.one := by rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hd]
      _ = c := by rw [F.mul_one]
  calc
    F.sub (F.mul A (F.inv d)) c =
        F.sub (F.mul A (F.inv d))
          (F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.inv d)) := by rw [hc]
    _ = F.mul (F.sub A (F.mul c d)) (F.inv d) := by
      exact Eq.symm
        (sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F A (F.mul c d) (F.inv d))

name: abs_mul_inv_le_of_abs_le_mul_abs
statement:
theorem abs_mul_inv_le_of_abs_le_mul_abs
    {R M d : alpha}
    (hd : Not (d = F.zero))
    (hR : F.le (abs F R) (F.mul M (abs F d))) :
    F.le (abs F (F.mul R (F.inv d))) M
proof:
:= by
  have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero (abs F d) :=
    abs_pos_of_ne_zero F hd
  have hprod_eq :
      F.mul (abs F (F.mul R (F.inv d))) (abs F d) =
        abs F R := by
    rw [<- abs_mul F (F.mul R (F.inv d)) d]
    have hcancel : F.mul (F.mul R (F.inv d)) d = R := by
      calc
        F.mul (F.mul R (F.inv d)) d =
            F.mul R (F.mul (F.inv d) d) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul R F.one := by rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hd]
        _ = R := by rw [F.mul_one]
    rw [hcancel]
  have hmul_le :
      F.le
        (F.mul (abs F (F.mul R (F.inv d))) (abs F d))
        (F.mul M (abs F d)) := by
    rw [hprod_eq]
    exact hR
  by_cases hle : F.le (abs F (F.mul R (F.inv d))) M
  case pos => exact hle
  case neg =>
    have hMle : F.le M (abs F (F.mul R (F.inv d))) := by
      cases F.le_total M (abs F (F.mul R (F.inv d))) with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr h => exact False.elim (hle h)
    have hMlt : F.lt M (abs F (F.mul R (F.inv d))) :=
      lt_of_le_of_not_le F hMle hle
    have hstrict := mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hMlt hden_pos
    exact False.elim ((not_le_of_lt F hstrict) hmul_le)

name: abs_sub_self
statement:
theorem abs_sub_self (x : alpha) :
    abs F (F.sub x x) = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_self F x]
  exact abs_zero F

name: abs_sub_lt_of_two_sided_sub_lt
statement:
theorem abs_sub_lt_of_two_sided_sub_lt
    {x I eps : alpha}
    (hupper : F.lt (F.sub x I) eps)
    (hlower : F.lt (F.sub I x) eps) :
    F.lt (abs F (F.sub x I)) eps
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub x I)
  case pos =>
    rw [abs_of_nonneg F hnonneg]
    exact hupper
  case neg =>
    have hnonpos : F.le (F.sub x I) F.zero :=
      nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hnonneg
    rw [abs_of_nonpos F hnonpos]
    rwa [sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x I] at hlower

name: lt_left_add_of_abs_sub_lt
statement:
theorem lt_left_add_of_abs_sub_lt
    {x I eps : alpha}
    (h : F.lt (abs F (F.sub x I)) eps) :
    F.lt I (F.add x eps)
proof:
:= by
  have hsym : F.lt (abs F (F.sub I x)) eps := by
    rwa [abs_sub_comm F I x]
  have hsub : F.lt (F.sub I x) eps :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt F (le_abs_self F (F.sub I x)) hsym
  exact lt_add_of_sub_lt F hsub

name: lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt
statement:
theorem lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt
    {x I eps : alpha}
    (h : F.lt (abs F (F.sub x I)) eps) :
    F.lt x (F.add I eps)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : F.lt (F.sub x I) eps :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt F (le_abs_self F (F.sub x I)) h
  exact lt_add_of_sub_lt F hsub

name: exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt
statement:
theorem exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt
    (c : alpha) {eps : alpha}
    (heps : F.lt F.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun eta : alpha =>
        And (F.lt F.zero eta)
          (F.lt (F.mul (abs F c) eta) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let C := abs F c
  by_cases hC_zero : C = F.zero
  case pos =>
    refine Exists.intro F.one ?_
    refine And.intro F.zero_lt_one ?_
    change F.lt (F.mul C F.one) eps
    rw [hC_zero, F.zero_mul]
    exact heps
  case neg =>
    let e2 := half F eps
    let eta := F.mul e2 (F.inv C)
    have he2_pos : F.lt F.zero e2 :=
      half_pos F heps
    have he2_lt_eps : F.lt e2 eps := by
      have h := add_lt_add_left F he2_pos e2
      change F.lt (F.add e2 F.zero) (F.add e2 e2) at h
      rwa [F.add_zero, half_add_half F eps] at h
    have hc_ne : Not (c = F.zero) := by
      intro hc
      exact hC_zero (abs_eq_zero_of_eq_zero F hc)
    have hC_pos : F.lt F.zero C :=
      abs_pos_of_ne_zero F hc_ne
    have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv C) :=
      inv_pos F hC_pos
    refine Exists.intro eta ?_
    refine And.intro (F.mul_pos he2_pos hinv_pos) ?_
    have hC_eta : F.mul C eta = e2 := by
      dsimp [eta]
      calc
        F.mul C (F.mul e2 (F.inv C)) =
            F.mul (F.mul C e2) (F.inv C) := by
              rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul (F.mul e2 C) (F.inv C) := by
              rw [F.mul_comm C e2]
        _ = F.mul e2 (F.mul C (F.inv C)) := by
              rw [F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul e2 F.one := by
              rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hC_zero]
        _ = e2 := by
              rw [F.mul_one]
    change F.lt (F.mul C eta) eps
    rw [hC_eta]
    exact he2_lt_eps

name: le_max2_left
statement:
theorem le_max2_left (x y : alpha) :
    F.le x (max2 F x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold max2
  by_cases hxy : F.le x y
  · simp [hxy]
  · simp [hxy]
    exact F.le_refl x

name: le_max2_right
statement:
theorem le_max2_right (x y : alpha) :
    F.le y (max2 F x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold max2
  by_cases hxy : F.le x y
  · simp [hxy]
    exact F.le_refl y
  · simp [hxy]
    cases F.le_total y x with
    | inl hyx => exact hyx
    | inr hxy' => exact False.elim (hxy hxy')

name: max2_le
statement:
theorem max2_le {x y z : alpha}

    (hyz : F.le y z) :

proof:
:= by

    exact hyz

name: min2_le_left
statement:
theorem min2_le_left (x y : alpha) :
    F.le (min2 F x y) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold min2

  · simp [hxy]
    exact F.le_refl x
  · simp [hxy]
    cases F.le_total y x with
    | inl hyx => exact hyx
    | inr hxy' => exact False.elim (hxy hxy')

statement:
theorem min2_le_right (x y : alpha) :

proof:
:= by

name: le_min2
statement:
theorem le_min2 {x y z : alpha}
    (hzx : F.le z x)
    (hzy : F.le z y) :
    F.le z (min2 F x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold min2

  · simp [hxy]
    exact hzx
  · simp [hxy]
    exact hzy

name: max2_comm
statement:
theorem max2_comm (x y : alpha) :
    max2 F x y = max2 F y x
proof:
:= by
  apply F.le_antisymm
  · exact max2_le F (le_max2_right F y x) (le_max2_left F y x)
  · exact max2_le F (le_max2_right F x y) (le_max2_left F x y)

name: min2_comm
statement:
theorem min2_comm (x y : alpha) :
    min2 F x y = min2 F y x
proof:
:= by
  apply F.le_antisymm
  · exact le_min2 F (min2_le_right F x y) (min2_le_left F x y)
  · exact le_min2 F (min2_le_right F y x) (min2_le_left F y x)

statement:
theorem min2_pos {x y : alpha}
    (hx : F.lt F.zero x)

proof:
