name: zero_le_one_of_one_le_zero
statement:
theorem zero_le_one_of_one_le_zero (h10 : F.le F.one F.zero) :
    F.le F.zero F.one
proof:
:= by
  have hneg_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg F.one) := by
    have h := F.add_le_add_right h10 (F.neg F.one)
    rwa [F.add_neg, F.zero_add] at h
  have hsquare :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg F.one) (F.neg F.one)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hneg_nonneg hneg_nonneg
  rwa [neg_one_mul_neg_one F] at hsquare

name: zero_lt_one
statement: theorem zero_lt_one : F.lt F.zero F.one
proof:
:= by
  cases F.le_total F.zero F.one with
  | inl h01 =>
      apply lt_of_le_of_not_le F h01
      intro h10
      exact F.zero_ne_one (F.le_antisymm h01 h10)
  | inr h10 =>
      have h01 : F.le F.zero F.one :=
        zero_le_one_of_one_le_zero F h10
      exact False.elim (F.zero_ne_one (F.le_antisymm h01 h10))

name: zero_le_one
statement: theorem zero_le_one : F.le F.zero F.one
proof:
:=
  le_of_lt F (zero_lt_one F)

name: exists_internalInt_floor
statement:
theorem exists_internalInt_floor (a : alpha) :
    Exists (fun z : alpha =>
      And (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalInt C.field z)
        (And (C.field.le z a)
          (C.field.lt a (C.field.add z C.field.one))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := C.field
  cases exists_internalInt_ceiling C (F.sub a F.one) with
  | intro z hz =>
      have hsub_add_one :
          F.add (F.sub a F.one) F.one = a :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F a F.one
      have hz_le_a : F.le z a := by
        have hceil : F.le z (F.add (F.sub a F.one) F.one) := hz.right.left
        rwa [hsub_add_one] at hceil
      have ha_lt_z_one : F.lt a (F.add z F.one) := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F
          hz.right.right F.one
        rwa [hsub_add_one] at h
      exact Exists.intro z
        (And.intro hz.left (And.intro hz_le_a ha_lt_z_one))

name: internalInt_floor_unique
statement:
theorem internalInt_floor_unique {a z w : alpha}
    (hz :
      And (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalInt C.field z)
        (And (C.field.le z a)
          (C.field.lt a (C.field.add z C.field.one))))
    (hw :
      And (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalInt C.field w)
        (And (C.field.le w a)
          (C.field.lt a (C.field.add w C.field.one)))) :
    z = w
proof:
:= by
  let F := C.field
  have hzw : F.le z w := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F
    intro hwz
    have hpos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub z w) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hwz
    have hz_lt_w_one : F.lt z (F.add w F.one) :=
      F.lt_of_le_of_lt hz.right.left hw.right.right
    have hlt_one : F.lt (F.sub z w) F.one :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hz_lt_w_one
    exact
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_internalInt_of_zero_lt_of_lt_one
        F hpos hlt_one)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.internalInt_sub F hz.left hw.left)
  have hwz : F.le w z := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F
    intro hzw'
    have hpos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub w z) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hzw'
    have hw_lt_z_one : F.lt w (F.add z F.one) :=
      F.lt_of_le_of_lt hw.right.left hz.right.right
    have hlt_one : F.lt (F.sub w z) F.one :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hw_lt_z_one
    exact
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_internalInt_of_zero_lt_of_lt_one
        F hpos hlt_one)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.internalInt_sub F hw.left hz.left)
  exact F.le_antisymm hzw hwz

name: integerFloor_internalInt
statement:
theorem integerFloor_internalInt (a : alpha) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalInt C.field (integerFloor C a)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_internalInt_floor C a)).left

name: integerFloor_le
statement:
theorem integerFloor_le (a : alpha) :
    C.field.le (integerFloor C a) a
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_internalInt_floor C a)).right.left

name: lt_integerFloor_add_one
statement:
theorem lt_integerFloor_add_one (a : alpha) :
    C.field.lt a (C.field.add (integerFloor C a) C.field.one)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_internalInt_floor C a)).right.right

name: integerFloor_eq_of_internalInt_bounds
statement:
theorem integerFloor_eq_of_internalInt_bounds {a z : alpha}
    (hz : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalInt C.field z)
    (hza : C.field.le z a)
    (haz : C.field.lt a (C.field.add z C.field.one)) :
    integerFloor C a = z
proof:
:=
  internalInt_floor_unique C
    (And.intro (integerFloor_internalInt C a)
      (And.intro (integerFloor_le C a)
        (lt_integerFloor_add_one C a)))
    (And.intro hz (And.intro hza haz))

name: fractionalPart_nonneg
statement:
theorem fractionalPart_nonneg (a : alpha) :
    C.field.le C.field.zero (fractionalPart C a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fractionalPart
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C.field
    (integerFloor_le C a)

name: fractionalPart_lt_one
statement:
theorem fractionalPart_lt_one (a : alpha) :
    C.field.lt (fractionalPart C a) C.field.one
proof:
:= by
  unfold fractionalPart
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add C.field
    (lt_integerFloor_add_one C a)

name: fractionalPart_eq_sub_of_internalInt_bounds
statement:
theorem fractionalPart_eq_sub_of_internalInt_bounds {a z : alpha}
    (hz : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalInt C.field z)
    (hza : C.field.le z a)
    (haz : C.field.lt a (C.field.add z C.field.one)) :
    fractionalPart C a = C.field.sub a z
proof:
:= by
  unfold fractionalPart
  rw [integerFloor_eq_of_internalInt_bounds C hz hza haz]

name: fractionalPart_internalInt
proof:
:= by
  let F := C.field
  have ha_lt_add_one : F.lt a (F.add a F.one) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) a
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  rw [fractionalPart_eq_sub_of_internalInt_bounds C
    ha (F.le_refl a) ha_lt_add_one]
  exact F.sub_self a

name: fractionalPart_add_internalInt
proof:
:= by
  let F := C.field
  have hfloor :
      integerFloor C (F.add a z) = F.add (integerFloor C a) z := by
    apply integerFloor_eq_of_internalInt_bounds C
    · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.internalInt_add F
        (integerFloor_internalInt C a) hz
    · exact F.add_le_add_right (integerFloor_le C a) z
    · have h := F.add_lt_add_right (lt_integerFloor_add_one C a) z
      rw [F.add_assoc, F.add_comm F.one z, <- F.add_assoc] at h
      exact h
  unfold fractionalPart
  rw [hfloor]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F]
  rw [F.sub_self, F.add_zero]

name: lt_add_of_pos
proof:
:= by
  have h := add_lt_add_left F heps x
  rwa [F.add_zero] at h

name: le_add_one
statement:
theorem le_add_one (x : alpha) :
    F.le x (F.add x F.one)
proof:
:= by
  have h01 : F.le F.zero F.one :=
    le_of_lt F F.zero_lt_one
  have h := add_le_add_left F h01 x
  rwa [F.add_zero] at h

name: one_le_add_one_of_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  have h := F.add_le_add_right hx F.one
  rwa [F.zero_add] at h

name: mul_mul_mul_comm
statement:
theorem mul_mul_mul_comm (a b c d : alpha) :
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
      F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
        F.mul a (F.mul b (F.mul c d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul b c) d) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc b c d]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul c b) d) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm b c]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul c (F.mul b d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc c b d]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc a c (F.mul b d)]

name: sub_zero
statement: theorem sub_zero (x : alpha) : F.sub x F.zero = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, neg_zero F, F.add_zero]

name: zero_sub
statement: theorem zero_sub (x : alpha) : F.sub F.zero x = F.neg x
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, F.zero_add]

name: le_sub_of_add_le
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_add_le_add_right F
  change F.le (F.add x z) (F.add (F.sub y z) z)
  rwa [sub_add_cancel F y z]

name: sub_right_le_sub_left_of_le_sub
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : F.le (F.add x z) y := by
    have h' := F.add_le_add_right h z
    change F.le (F.add x z) (F.add (F.sub y z) z) at h'
    rwa [sub_add_cancel F y z] at h'
  have hsum_comm : F.le (F.add z x) y := by
    rwa [F.add_comm z x]
  exact le_sub_of_add_le F hsum_comm

name: add_le_add_of_sub_le_sub
proof:
:= by
  have h' := F.add_le_add_right h (F.add u y)
  change
    F.le
      (F.add (F.sub x y) (F.add u y))
      (F.add (F.sub v u) (F.add u y)) at h'
  have hleft :
      F.add (F.sub x y) (F.add u y) = F.add u x := by
    calc
      F.add (F.sub x y) (F.add u y) =
          F.add (F.sub x y) (F.add y u) := by
            rw [F.add_comm u y]
      _ = F.add (F.add (F.sub x y) y) u := by
            rw [<- F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add x u := by rw [sub_add_cancel F x y]
      _ = F.add u x := by rw [F.add_comm x u]
  have hright :
      F.add (F.sub v u) (F.add u y) = F.add v y := by
    calc
      F.add (F.sub v u) (F.add u y) =
          F.add (F.add (F.sub v u) u) y := by
            rw [<- F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add v y := by rw [sub_add_cancel F v u]
  rwa [hleft, hright] at h'

name: sub_self_sub
statement:
theorem sub_self_sub (x y : alpha) :
    F.sub x (F.sub x y) = y
proof:
:= by
  apply add_right_cancel F (a := F.sub x y)
  calc
    F.add (F.sub x (F.sub x y)) (F.sub x y) =
        x := sub_add_cancel F x (F.sub x y)
    _ = F.add y (F.sub x y) := by
        rw [F.add_comm y (F.sub x y), sub_add_cancel F x y]

name: sub_add_sub_cancel
statement:
theorem sub_add_sub_cancel (x y z : alpha) :
    F.add (F.sub x y) (F.sub y z) = F.sub x z
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    F.add (F.add x (F.neg y)) (F.add y (F.neg z)) =
        F.add x (F.add (F.neg y) (F.add y (F.neg z))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add x (F.add (F.add (F.neg y) y) (F.neg z)) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc (F.neg y) y (F.neg z)]
    _ = F.add x (F.add F.zero (F.neg z)) := by rw [F.neg_add]
    _ = F.add x (F.neg z) := by rw [F.zero_add]

name: add_sub_right_reassociate
statement:
theorem add_sub_right_reassociate (A t b : alpha) :
    F.sub (F.add A t) b = F.add (F.sub A b) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    F.add (F.add A t) (F.neg b) =
        F.add A (F.add t (F.neg b)) := F.add_assoc A t (F.neg b)
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.neg b) t) := by
          rw [F.add_comm t (F.neg b)]
    _ = F.add (F.add A (F.neg b)) t :=
          (F.add_assoc A (F.neg b) t).symm

name: sub_sub_eq_sub_add
statement:
theorem sub_sub_eq_sub_add (x y z : alpha) :
    F.sub (F.sub x y) z = F.sub x (F.add y z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [neg_add_distrib F y z]
  calc
    F.add (F.add x (F.neg y)) (F.neg z) =
        F.add x (F.add (F.neg y) (F.neg z)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]

name: sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : F.le (F.neg y) F.zero := by
    have h := F.add_le_add_right hy (F.neg y)
    rwa [F.add_neg, F.zero_add] at h
  have h := add_le_add_left F hneg x
  rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg x y, F.add_zero] at h

name: eq_of_sub_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h' := congrArg (fun t => F.add t y) h
  change F.add (F.sub x y) y = F.add F.zero y at h'
  rw [sub_add_cancel F x y, F.zero_add] at h'
  exact h'

name: sub_lt_self_of_pos
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : F.lt (F.neg eps) F.zero := by
    have h := add_lt_add_right F heps (F.neg eps)
    rwa [F.zero_add, F.add_neg] at h
  have h := add_lt_add_left F hneg x
  rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg x eps, F.add_zero] at h

name: sub_pos_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  have h := add_lt_add_right F hxy (F.neg x)
  rwa [F.add_neg, <- F.sub_eq_add_neg y x] at h

name: le_of_forall_lt_add_pos
statement:
theorem le_of_forall_lt_add_pos {x y : alpha}
    (h : forall eps : alpha,
      F.lt F.zero eps -> F.lt x (F.add y eps)) :
    F.le x y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : F.le x y
  case pos => exact hxy
  case neg =>
    have hyx : F.le y x := by
      cases F.le_total y x with
      | inl hle => exact hle
      | inr hle => exact False.elim (hxy hle)
    have hy_lt_x : F.lt y x :=
      lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyx hxy
    let gap := F.sub x y
    have hgap_pos : F.lt F.zero gap := by
      dsimp [gap]
      exact sub_pos_of_lt F hy_lt_x
    have hx_lt : F.lt x (F.add y gap) := h gap hgap_pos
    have hy_gap : F.add y gap = x := by
      dsimp [gap]
      rw [F.add_comm y (F.sub x y)]
      exact sub_add_cancel F x y
    rw [hy_gap] at hx_lt
    exact False.elim (lt_irrefl F x hx_lt)

name: lt_of_sub_pos
proof:
:= by
  have h' := add_lt_add_right F h x
  rwa [F.zero_add, sub_add_cancel F y x] at h'

name: sub_lt_of_lt_add
proof:
:= by
  have h' := add_lt_add_right F h (F.neg a)
  have hright :
      F.add (F.add a eps) (F.neg a) = eps := by
    calc
      F.add (F.add a eps) (F.neg a) =
          F.add (F.add eps a) (F.neg a) := by
            rw [F.add_comm a eps]
      _ = eps := add_neg_cancel_right F eps a
  rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg x a, hright] at h'

name: sub_lt_of_lt_right
proof:
:= by
  have hax : F.lt a (F.add eps x) := by
    have h' := add_lt_add_right F h x
    rwa [sub_add_cancel F a x] at h'
  have h' := add_lt_add_right F hax (F.neg eps)
  have hrhs :
      F.add (F.add eps x) (F.neg eps) = x := by
    calc
      F.add (F.add eps x) (F.neg eps) =
          F.add (F.add x eps) (F.neg eps) := by
            rw [F.add_comm eps x]
      _ = x := add_neg_cancel_right F x eps
  rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg a eps, hrhs] at h'

name: lt_sub_of_add_lt
proof:
:= by
  have h' := add_lt_add_right F h (F.neg a)
  have hleft :
      F.add (F.add a eps) (F.neg a) = eps := by
    calc
      F.add (F.add a eps) (F.neg a) =
          F.add (F.add eps a) (F.neg a) := by
            rw [F.add_comm a eps]
      _ = eps := add_neg_cancel_right F eps a
  rwa [hleft, <- F.sub_eq_add_neg x a] at h'

name: sub_lt_of_sub_lt_left
proof:
:= by
  have hax : F.lt a (F.add x eps) := by
    have h' := add_lt_add_right F h eps
    have hleft : F.add (F.sub a eps) eps = a :=
      sub_add_cancel F a eps
    have hright : F.add x eps = F.add x eps := rfl
    rwa [hleft, hright] at h'
  exact sub_lt_of_lt_add F hax

name: sub_nonpos_of_le
proof:
:= by
  have h := F.add_le_add_right hyx (F.neg x)
  rwa [F.add_neg, <- F.sub_eq_add_neg y x] at h

name: le_of_sub_nonpos
proof:
:= by
  have h' := F.add_le_add_right h x
  rwa [F.zero_add, sub_add_cancel F y x] at h'

name: le_of_neg_le_neg
proof:
:= by
  have h' := neg_le_neg F h
  rwa [neg_neg F x, neg_neg F y] at h'

name: neg_lt_neg
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le F
  · exact neg_le_neg F (le_of_lt F hxy)
  · intro hle
    exact (not_le_of_lt F hxy) (le_of_neg_le_neg F hle)

name: sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : F.lt (F.neg b) (F.neg a) :=
    neg_lt_neg F hab
  have h := add_lt_add_left F hneg c
  rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg c b,
    <- F.sub_eq_add_neg c a] at h

name: mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
statement:
theorem mul_sub_eq_mul_sub (x y z : alpha) :
    F.mul x (F.sub y z) =
      F.sub (F.mul x y) (F.mul x z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, F.mul_add, mul_neg F, F.sub_eq_add_neg]

name: sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
statement:
theorem sub_mul_eq_sub_mul (x y z : alpha) :
    F.mul (F.sub x y) z =
      F.sub (F.mul x z) (F.mul y z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, F.add_mul, neg_mul F, F.sub_eq_add_neg]

name: sub_one_mul_inv_eq_one_sub_inv
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_inv_eq_one_sub_inv
    {x : alpha} (hx : Not (x = F.zero)) :
    F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x) =
      F.sub F.one (F.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F, F.mul_inv_cancel hx, F.one_mul]

name: mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub
statement:
theorem mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub (x y a b : alpha) :
    F.sub (F.mul x y) (F.mul a b) =
      F.add (F.mul (F.sub x a) y) (F.mul a (F.sub y b))
proof:
:= by
  symm
  calc
    F.add (F.mul (F.sub x a) y) (F.mul a (F.sub y b)) =
        F.add
          (F.sub (F.mul x y) (F.mul a y))
          (F.sub (F.mul a y) (F.mul a b)) := by
            rw [sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F x a y]
            rw [mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F a y b]
    _ = F.sub (F.mul x y) (F.mul a b) :=
        sub_add_sub_cancel F (F.mul x y) (F.mul a y) (F.mul a b)

name: mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : F.le F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
    sub_nonneg_of_le F hxy
  have hprod : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.sub y x) z) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hdiff hz
  apply le_of_sub_nonneg F
  rwa [<- sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F y x z]

name: mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.mul_comm z x, F.mul_comm z y]
  exact mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F hxy hz

name: mul_self_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_self_nonneg (x : alpha) :
    F.le F.zero (F.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl hx =>
      exact F.mul_nonneg hx hx
  | inr hx =>
      have hneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) := by
        have h := neg_le_neg F hx
        change F.le (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg x) at h
        rwa [neg_zero F] at h
      have hprod : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) :=
        F.mul_nonneg hneg hneg
      rwa [F.neg_mul_neg] at hprod

name: mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
    {x y : alpha}
    (hx : F.le x F.zero)
    (hy : F.le F.zero y) :
    F.le (F.mul x y) F.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hnegx : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) := by
    have h := neg_le_neg F hx
    change F.le (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg x) at h
    rwa [neg_zero F] at h
  have hprod : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) y) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hnegx hy
  have hneg := neg_le_neg F hprod
  change F.le (F.neg (F.mul (F.neg x) y)) (F.neg F.zero) at hneg
  rw [neg_zero F] at hneg
  rwa [neg_mul F x y, neg_neg F (F.mul x y)] at hneg

name: mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos
    {x y : alpha}
    (hx : F.le x F.zero)
    (hy : F.le y F.zero) :
    F.le F.zero (F.mul x y)
proof:
:= by
  have hnegx : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) := by
    have h := neg_le_neg F hx
    change F.le (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg x) at h
    rwa [neg_zero F] at h
  have hnegy : F.le F.zero (F.neg y) := by
    have h := neg_le_neg F hy
    change F.le (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg y) at h
    rwa [neg_zero F] at h
  have hprod : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg y)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hnegx hnegy
  rwa [F.neg_mul_neg] at hprod

name: mul_le_mul_nonpos_right
statement:
theorem mul_le_mul_nonpos_right
    {x y z : alpha}
    (hxy : F.le x y)
    (hz : F.le z F.zero) :
    F.le (F.mul y z) (F.mul x z)
proof:
:= by
  have hnegz : F.le F.zero (F.neg z) := by
    have h := neg_le_neg F hz
    change F.le (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg z) at h
    rwa [neg_zero F] at h
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F hxy hnegz
  change F.le (F.mul x (F.neg z)) (F.mul y (F.neg z)) at hmul
  rw [F.mul_neg, F.mul_neg] at hmul
  exact le_of_neg_le_neg F hmul

name: mul_le_mul_nonpos_left
statement:
theorem mul_le_mul_nonpos_left
    {x y z : alpha}
    (hxy : F.le x y)
    (hz : F.le z F.zero) :
    F.le (F.mul z y) (F.mul z x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.mul_comm z y, F.mul_comm z x]
  exact mul_le_mul_nonpos_right F hxy hz

name: mul_lt_mul_pos_right
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : F.lt F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
    sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  have hprod : F.lt F.zero (F.mul (F.sub y x) z) :=
    mul_pos F hdiff hz
  apply lt_of_sub_pos F
  rwa [<- sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F y x z]

name: mul_lt_mul_pos_left
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.mul_comm z x, F.mul_comm z y]
  exact mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hxy hz

name: lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right
statement:
theorem lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right {x y z : alpha}
    (h : F.lt (F.mul x z) (F.mul y z))
    (hz : F.lt F.zero z) :
    F.lt x y
proof:
:= by
  have hnot : Not (F.le y x) := by
    intro hyx
    have hmul : F.le (F.mul y z) (F.mul x z) :=
      mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F hyx (le_of_lt F hz)
    exact (not_le_of_lt F h) hmul
  cases F.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hnot
  | inr hyx =>
      exact False.elim (hnot hyx)

name: lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_left
statement:
theorem lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_left {x y z : alpha}
    (h : F.lt (F.mul z x) (F.mul z y))
    (hz : F.lt F.zero z) :
    F.lt x y
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right F (z := z) ?_ hz
  rwa [F.mul_comm x z, F.mul_comm y z]

name: inv_neg_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem inv_neg_of_ne_zero
    {x : alpha}
    (hx : Not (x = F.zero)) :
    F.inv (F.neg x) = F.neg (F.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left F
  · intro hneg
    have h := congrArg F.neg hneg
    rw [neg_neg F x, neg_zero F] at h
    exact hx h
  · rw [F.neg_mul_neg]
    exact F.mul_inv_cancel hx

name: inv_nonpos_of_neg
statement:
theorem inv_nonpos_of_neg
    {x : alpha}
    (hx : F.lt x F.zero) :
    F.le (F.inv x) F.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hx_ne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hx
    exact lt_irrefl F F.zero hx
  have hnegx_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.neg x) := by
    have h := neg_lt_neg F hx
    change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg x) at h
    rwa [neg_zero F] at h
  have hinv_negx_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv (F.neg x)) :=
    le_of_lt F (inv_pos F hnegx_pos)
  have hinv_neg : F.inv (F.neg x) = F.neg (F.inv x) :=
    inv_neg_of_ne_zero F hx_ne
  have hneg_inv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg (F.inv x)) := by
    rwa [hinv_neg] at hinv_negx_nonneg
  have h := neg_le_neg F hneg_inv_nonneg
  change F.le (F.neg (F.neg (F.inv x))) (F.neg F.zero) at h
  rwa [neg_neg F (F.inv x), neg_zero F] at h

name: neg_one_mul_eq_neg
statement:
theorem neg_one_mul_eq_neg (x : alpha) :
    F.mul (F.neg F.one) x = F.neg x
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm (neg_eq_neg_one_mul F x)

name: value_sub_left_of_eq_add
statement:
theorem value_sub_left_of_eq_add
    {x y z : alpha}
    (h : x = F.add y z) :
    z = F.sub x y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    z = F.add F.zero z := by rw [F.zero_add]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.neg y) y) z := by rw [F.neg_add]
    _ = F.add (F.neg y) (F.add y z) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.neg y) x := by rw [← h]
    _ = F.add x (F.neg y) := by rw [F.add_comm]
    _ = F.sub x y := by rw [← F.sub_eq_add_neg]

name: inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
statement:
theorem inv_le_inv_of_le_pos {a b : alpha}
    (ha : F.lt F.zero a)
    (hb : F.lt F.zero b)
    (hab : F.le a b) :
    F.le (F.inv b) (F.inv a)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hle : F.le (F.inv b) (F.inv a)
  · exact hle
  · have hlt : F.lt (F.inv a) (F.inv b) := by
      cases F.le_total (F.inv a) (F.inv b) with
      | inl h =>
          exact lt_of_le_of_not_le F h hle
      | inr h =>
          exact False.elim (hle h)
    have ha_ne : Not (a = F.zero) := by
      intro h
      exact ne_of_lt F ha h.symm
    have hb_ne : Not (b = F.zero) := by
      intro h
      exact ne_of_lt F hb h.symm
    have hinvb_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv b) := inv_pos F hb
    have hmul_lt :
        F.lt (F.mul a (F.inv a)) (F.mul a (F.inv b)) :=
      mul_lt_mul_pos_left F hlt ha
    have hmul_le :
        F.le (F.mul a (F.inv b)) (F.mul b (F.inv b)) :=
      mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F hab (le_of_lt F hinvb_pos)
    have hone_lt :
        F.lt F.one (F.mul a (F.inv b)) := by
      rwa [F.mul_inv_cancel ha_ne] at hmul_lt
    have hle_one :
        F.le (F.mul a (F.inv b)) F.one := by
      rwa [F.mul_inv_cancel hb_ne] at hmul_le
    exact False.elim ((not_le_of_lt F hone_lt) hle_one)

name: inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
statement:
theorem inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos {a b : alpha}
    (ha : F.lt F.zero a)
    (hb : F.lt F.zero b)
    (hab : F.lt a b) :
    F.lt (F.inv b) (F.inv a)
proof:
:= by
  have hle :
      F.le (F.inv b) (F.inv a) :=
    inv_le_inv_of_le_pos F ha hb (le_of_lt F hab)
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le F hle
  intro hrev
  have ha_nonneg : F.le F.zero a := le_of_lt F ha
  have hb_ne : Not (b = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact ne_of_lt F hb h.symm
  have ha_ne : Not (a = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact ne_of_lt F ha h.symm
  have hleft :
      F.le (F.mul a (F.inv a)) (F.mul a (F.inv b)) :=
    mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F hrev ha_nonneg
  have hleft_one :
      F.le F.one (F.mul a (F.inv b)) := by
    rwa [F.mul_inv_cancel ha_ne] at hleft
  have hinvb_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv b) := inv_pos F hb
  have hright :
      F.lt (F.mul a (F.inv b)) (F.mul b (F.inv b)) :=
    mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hab hinvb_pos
  have hright_one :
      F.lt (F.mul a (F.inv b)) F.one := by
    rwa [F.mul_inv_cancel hb_ne] at hright
  exact (not_le_of_lt F hright_one) hleft_one

name: half_add
statement:
theorem half_add (x y : alpha) :
    half F (F.add x y) =
      F.add (half F x) (half F y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold half
  exact F.add_mul x y (F.inv (two F))

name: half_one_mul
statement:
theorem half_one_mul (x : alpha) :
    F.mul (half F F.one) x = half F x
proof:
:= by
  unfold half
  rw [F.one_mul]
  exact F.mul_comm (F.inv (two F)) x

name: add_self_cancel
proof:
:= by
  have hmul :
      F.mul (two F) a = F.mul (two F) b := by
    unfold two
    rw [F.add_mul, F.add_mul, F.one_mul, F.one_mul]
    exact h
  exact mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero F (two_ne_zero F) hmul

name: half_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold half
  exact F.mul_nonneg heps
    (le_of_lt F (inv_pos F (zero_lt_two F)))

name: add_half_sub_eq_sub_half
statement:
theorem add_half_sub_eq_sub_half (a b : alpha) :
    F.add b (half F (F.sub a b)) =
      F.sub a (half F (F.sub a b))
proof:
:= by
  let eps := half F (F.sub a b)
  change F.add b eps = F.sub a eps
  apply add_right_cancel F (a := eps)
  calc
    F.add (F.add b eps) eps =
        F.add b (F.add eps eps) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add b (F.sub a b) := by rw [half_add_half F (F.sub a b)]
    _ = F.add (F.sub a b) b := by rw [F.add_comm b (F.sub a b)]
    _ = a := sub_add_cancel F a b
    _ = F.add (F.sub a eps) eps := by rw [sub_add_cancel F a eps]

name: not_between_sub_add_half
statement:
theorem not_between_sub_add_half {a b x : alpha}
    (hleft :
      F.lt (F.sub a (half F (F.sub a b))) x)
    (hright :
      F.lt x (F.add b (half F (F.sub a b)))) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have hlt :
      F.lt (F.sub a (half F (F.sub a b)))
        (F.add b (half F (F.sub a b))) :=
    lt_trans F hleft hright
  rw [add_half_sub_eq_sub_half F a b] at hlt
  exact (lt_irrefl F (F.sub a (half F (F.sub a b)))) hlt

name: sub_half_self
statement:
theorem sub_half_self (x : alpha) :
    F.sub x (half F x) = half F x
proof:
:= by
  apply add_right_cancel F (a := half F x)
  calc
    F.add (F.sub x (half F x)) (half F x) =
        x := sub_add_cancel F x (half F x)
    _ = F.add (half F x) (half F x) := by
        rw [half_add_half F x]

name: add_half_add_half
statement:
theorem add_half_add_half (x eps : alpha) :
    F.add (F.add x (half F eps)) (half F eps) =
      F.add x eps
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.add x (half F eps)) (half F eps) =
        F.add x (F.add (half F eps) (half F eps)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add x eps := by
          rw [half_add_half F eps]

name: sub_half_add_self
statement:
theorem sub_half_add_self (x eps : alpha) :
    F.add (F.sub x (half F eps)) eps =
      F.add x (half F eps)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.sub x (half F eps)) eps =
        F.add (F.sub x (half F eps))
          (F.add (half F eps) (half F eps)) := by
          rw [half_add_half F eps]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.sub x (half F eps)) (half F eps))
        (half F eps) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add x (half F eps) := by
          rw [sub_add_cancel F x (half F eps)]

name: half_lt_self
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : F.lt F.zero (half F x) :=
    half_pos F hx
  have h := add_lt_add_left F hhalf (half F x)
  rwa [F.add_zero, half_add_half F x] at h

name: midpoint_sub_left
statement:
theorem midpoint_sub_left (x y : alpha) :
    F.sub (midpoint F x y) x = half F (F.sub y x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold midpoint
  rw [F.add_comm x (half F (F.sub y x))]
  exact add_sub_cancel F (half F (F.sub y x)) x

name: midpoint_eq_sub_half
statement:
theorem midpoint_eq_sub_half (x y : alpha) :
    midpoint F x y = F.sub y (half F (F.sub y x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold midpoint
  exact add_half_sub_eq_sub_half F y x

name: right_sub_midpoint
statement:
theorem right_sub_midpoint (x y : alpha) :
    F.sub y (midpoint F x y) = half F (F.sub y x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [midpoint_eq_sub_half]
  exact sub_self_sub F y (half F (F.sub y x))

name: left_le_midpoint
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_sub_nonneg F
  rw [midpoint_sub_left]
  exact half_nonneg F (sub_nonneg_of_le F hxy)

name: midpoint_le_right
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_sub_nonneg F
  rw [right_sub_midpoint]
  exact half_nonneg F (sub_nonneg_of_le F hxy)

name: left_lt_midpoint
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_sub_pos F
  rw [midpoint_sub_left]
  exact half_pos F (sub_pos_of_lt F hxy)

name: midpoint_lt_right
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_sub_pos F
  rw [right_sub_midpoint]
  exact half_pos F (sub_pos_of_lt F hxy)

name: add_left_comm
statement:
theorem add_left_comm (x y z : alpha) :
    F.add x (F.add y z) = F.add y (F.add x z)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add x (F.add y z) = F.add (F.add x y) z := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.add y x) z := by rw [F.add_comm x y]
    _ = F.add y (F.add x z) := by rw [F.add_assoc]

name: add_add_sub_cancel_same
statement:
theorem add_add_sub_cancel_same (A B C : alpha) :
    F.add (F.add A C) (F.sub B C) = F.add A B
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.add A C) (F.sub B C) =
        F.add A (F.add C (F.sub B C)) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.sub B C) C) := by
      rw [F.add_comm C (F.sub B C)]
    _ = F.add A B := by rw [sub_add_cancel F B C]

name: sub_add_add_cancel_same
statement:
theorem sub_add_add_cancel_same (A C : alpha) :
    F.add (F.sub A C) (F.add C C) = F.add A C
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.sub A C) (F.add C C) =
        F.add (F.add (F.sub A C) C) C := by rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add A C := by rw [sub_add_cancel F A C]

name: add_four_reorder
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add C B) =
        F.add A (F.add D (F.add C B)) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add A (F.add C (F.add D B)) := by
      rw [add_left_comm F D C B]
    _ = F.add A (F.add C (F.add B D)) := by rw [F.add_comm D B]
    _ = F.add A (F.add B (F.add C D)) := by
      rw [add_left_comm F C B D]
    _ = F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) := by rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: add_square_raw
statement:
private theorem add_square_raw (a b : alpha) :
    F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b) =
      F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a b))
        (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.mul_add, F.add_mul, F.add_mul]
  calc
    F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b a))
        (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b b)) =
        F.add (F.mul a a)
          (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b b))) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.mul a a)
          (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b))) := by
            rw [add_left_comm F (F.mul b a) (F.mul a b) (F.mul b b)]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a b))
          (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b)) := by rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: add_square
statement:
theorem add_square (a b : alpha) :
    F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b) =
      F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))
        (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_square_raw F a b]
  let A := F.mul a a
  let B := F.mul a b
  let C := F.mul b a
  let D := F.mul b b
  change F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) =
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C)
  calc
    F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) = F.add A (F.add B (F.add C D)) := by
      rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.add B C) D) := by rw [<- F.add_assoc B C D]
    _ = F.add A (F.add D (F.add B C)) := by rw [F.add_comm (F.add B C) D]
    _ = F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C) := by rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: sub_square
statement:
theorem sub_square (a b : alpha) :
    F.mul (F.sub a b) (F.sub a b) =
      F.sub (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))
        (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, F.add_mul, F.mul_add, F.mul_add]
  rw [mul_neg F, neg_mul F, F.neg_mul_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, neg_add_distrib F]
  let aa := F.mul a a
  let ab := F.mul a b
  let ba := F.mul b a
  let bb := F.mul b b
  change F.add (F.add aa (F.neg ab)) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb) =
    F.add (F.add aa bb) (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba))
  calc
    F.add (F.add aa (F.neg ab)) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb) =
        F.add aa (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add aa (F.add (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba)) bb) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba) bb]
    _ = F.add aa (F.add bb (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba))) := by
      rw [F.add_comm (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba)) bb]
    _ = F.add (F.add aa bb) (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba)) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: add_sub_add_sub_eq_sub_add
statement:
theorem add_sub_add_sub_eq_sub_add (A B C D : alpha) :
    F.add (F.sub A B) (F.sub C D) =
      F.sub (F.add A C) (F.add B D)
proof:
:= by
  exact (add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F A C B D).symm

name: sub_sub_add_eq_sub_sub_add
statement:
theorem sub_sub_add_eq_sub_sub_add (A B C D : alpha) :
    F.sub (F.sub A B) (F.add C D) =
      F.sub (F.sub A D) (F.add B C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg A B]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.add A (F.neg B)) (F.add C D)]
  rw [neg_add_distrib F C D]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg A D]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.add A (F.neg D)) (F.add B C)]
  rw [neg_add_distrib F B C]
  calc
    F.add (F.add A (F.neg B)) (F.add (F.neg C) (F.neg D)) =
        F.add A (F.add (F.neg B) (F.add (F.neg C) (F.neg D))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.neg D) (F.add (F.neg B) (F.neg C))) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc (F.neg B) (F.neg C) (F.neg D)]
      rw [F.add_comm (F.add (F.neg B) (F.neg C)) (F.neg D)]
    _ = F.add (F.add A (F.neg D)) (F.add (F.neg B) (F.neg C)) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: sub_sub_sub_eq_add_sub_add
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg A B, F.sub_eq_add_neg C D]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.add A (F.neg B)) (F.add C (F.neg D))]
  rw [neg_add_distrib F C (F.neg D), neg_neg F D]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.add A D) (F.add B C)]
  rw [neg_add_distrib F B C]
  calc
    F.add (F.add A (F.neg B)) (F.add (F.neg C) D) =
        F.add (F.add A D) (F.add (F.neg C) (F.neg B)) := by
          exact Eq.symm (add_four_reorder F A (F.neg B) (F.neg C) D)
    _ = F.add (F.add A D) (F.add (F.neg B) (F.neg C)) := by
      rw [F.add_comm (F.neg C) (F.neg B)]

name: sub_mul_sub
statement:
theorem sub_mul_sub (a b c d : alpha) :
    F.mul (F.sub a b) (F.sub c d) =
      F.sub (F.add (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d))
        (F.add (F.mul a d) (F.mul b c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F a b (F.sub c d)]
  rw [mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F a c d, mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F b c d]
  exact sub_sub_sub_eq_add_sub_add F
    (F.mul a c) (F.mul a d) (F.mul b c) (F.mul b d)

name: cross_terms_eq
statement:
private theorem cross_terms_eq (a b c d : alpha) :
    F.add (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d))
        (F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.mul a b)) =
      F.add (F.mul (F.mul c b) (F.mul a d))
        (F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul c b))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d))
        (F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.mul a b)) =
        F.add (F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d))
          (F.mul (F.mul c a) (F.mul d b)) := by
            rw [mul_mul_mul_comm F a b c d, mul_mul_mul_comm F c d a b]
    _ = F.add (F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d))
        (F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm c a, F.mul_comm d b]
    _ = F.add (F.mul (F.mul c b) (F.mul a d))
        (F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul c b)) := by
          rw [mul_mul_mul_comm F c b a d, mul_mul_mul_comm F a d c b]
          rw [F.mul_comm c a, F.mul_comm d b]

name: sum_squares_pair_identity
statement:
private theorem sum_squares_pair_identity (a b c d : alpha) :
    F.add
        (F.add (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul a b))
          (F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.mul c d)))
        (F.add (F.mul (F.mul c b) (F.mul c b))
          (F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul a d))) =
      F.mul (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_mul_mul_comm F a b a b, mul_mul_mul_comm F c d c d]
  rw [mul_mul_mul_comm F c b c b, mul_mul_mul_comm F a d a d]
  let A := F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b)
  let B := F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul d d)
  let C := F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul b b)
  let D := F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul d d)
  change F.add (F.add A D) (F.add C B) =
    F.mul (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
      (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d))
  calc
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add C B) = F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) := by
      exact add_four_reorder F A B C D
    _ = F.mul (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d)) := by
          symm
          rw [F.add_mul, F.mul_add, F.mul_add]

name: brahmagupta_fibonacci_identity
statement:
theorem brahmagupta_fibonacci_identity (a b c d : alpha) :
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d))
          (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d)))
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul c b) (F.mul a d))
          (F.sub (F.mul c b) (F.mul a d))) =
      F.mul (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d))
proof:
:= by
  let p := F.mul a b
  let q := F.mul c d
  let r := F.mul c b
  let s := F.mul a d
  change F.add (F.mul (F.add p q) (F.add p q))
      (F.mul (F.sub r s) (F.sub r s)) =
    F.mul (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
      (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d))
  rw [add_square F p q, sub_square F r s]
  rw [<- cross_terms_eq F a b c d]
  calc
    F.add
        (F.add (F.add (F.mul p p) (F.mul q q))
          (F.add (F.mul p q) (F.mul q p)))
        (F.sub (F.add (F.mul r r) (F.mul s s))
          (F.add (F.mul p q) (F.mul q p))) =
        F.add (F.add (F.mul p p) (F.mul q q))
          (F.add (F.mul r r) (F.mul s s)) := by
            exact add_add_sub_cancel_same F
              (F.add (F.mul p p) (F.mul q q))
              (F.add (F.mul r r) (F.mul s s))
              (F.add (F.mul p q) (F.mul q p))
    _ = F.mul (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d)) := by
          exact sum_squares_pair_identity F a b c d

name: difference_eq_square_difference_mul_inv_sum
statement:
theorem difference_eq_square_difference_mul_inv_sum
    {a b : alpha} (hsum : Not (F.add a b = F.zero)) :
    F.sub a b = F.mul (F.sub (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))
      (F.inv (F.add a b))
proof:
:= by
  have hsquare :
      F.sub (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b) =
        F.mul (F.sub a b) (F.add a b) := by
    rw [mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub F a a b b]
    rw [F.mul_add, F.mul_comm b (F.sub a b)]
  rw [hsquare]
  exact Eq.symm (mul_mul_inv_cancel_right F (F.sub a b) hsum)

name: correctedDifferenceQuotient_at
statement:
theorem correctedDifferenceQuotient_at
    (g : Map) (y0 B : Point) :
    CorrectedDifferenceQuotient g y0 B y0 = B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold CorrectedDifferenceQuotient
  rw [dif_pos rfl]

name: correctedDifferenceQuotient_of_ne
statement:
theorem correctedDifferenceQuotient_of_ne
    {g : Map} {y0 B y : Point}
    (hy : Not (y = y0)) :
    CorrectedDifferenceQuotient g y0 B y =
      DifferenceQuotient g y0 y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold CorrectedDifferenceQuotient
  rw [dif_neg hy]

name: differenceQuotient_comp_eq
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_comp_eq
    {f g : Map} {x0 x : Point}
    (hfx : Not (f x = f x0)) :
    DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.CompFun g f) x0 x =
      RealTheory.mul
        (DifferenceQuotient g (f x0) (f x))
        (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient RealFunction.CompFun
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (g (f x)) (g (f x0)))
      (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) =
    F.mul
      (F.mul (F.sub (g (f x)) (g (f x0)))
        (F.inv (F.sub (f x) (f x0))))
      (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
  have hfsub_ne : Not (F.sub (f x) (f x0) = F.zero) := by
    intro hsub
    have hEq : f x = f x0 :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hsub
    exact hfx hEq
  calc
    F.mul (F.sub (g (f x)) (g (f x0)))
        (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) =
        F.mul (F.sub (g (f x)) (g (f x0)))
          (F.mul F.one (F.inv (F.sub x x0))) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.sub (g (f x)) (g (f x0)))
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (F.inv (F.sub (f x) (f x0)))
              (F.sub (f x) (f x0)))
            (F.inv (F.sub x x0))) := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hfsub_ne]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (F.sub (g (f x)) (g (f x0)))
            (F.inv (F.sub (f x) (f x0))))
          (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0))) := by
          let a := F.sub (g (f x)) (g (f x0))
          let b := F.inv (F.sub (f x) (f x0))
          let c := F.sub (f x) (f x0)
          let d := F.inv (F.sub x x0)
          change F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul b c) d) =
            F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d)
          calc
            F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul b c) d) =
                F.mul a (F.mul b (F.mul c d)) := by
                rw [F.mul_assoc b c d]
            _ = F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) := by
                rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: differenceQuotient_eq_zero_of_value_eq
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_eq_zero_of_value_eq
    {f : Map} {x0 x : Point}
    (h : f x = f x0) :
    DifferenceQuotient f x0 x = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  rw [h]
  rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg (f x0) (f x0)]
  rw [RealTheory.add_neg (f x0)]
  rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]

name: differenceQuotient_comp_corrected_eq
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_comp_corrected_eq
    {f g : Map} {x0 x B : Point} :
    DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.CompFun g f) x0 x =
      RealTheory.mul
        (CorrectedDifferenceQuotient g (f x0) B (f x))
        (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  classical
  by_cases hfx : f x = f x0
  · have hleft :
        DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.CompFun g f) x0 x =
          RealTheory.zero := by
      apply differenceQuotient_eq_zero_of_value_eq
      unfold RealFunction.CompFun
      rw [hfx]
    have hright0 :
        DifferenceQuotient f x0 x = RealTheory.zero :=
      differenceQuotient_eq_zero_of_value_eq hfx
    rw [hleft, hright0]
    change F.zero = F.mul
      (CorrectedDifferenceQuotient g (f x0) B (f x)) F.zero
    rw [F.mul_zero]
  · rw [correctedDifferenceQuotient_of_ne hfx]
    exact differenceQuotient_comp_eq hfx

name: correctedDifferenceQuotient_comp_tendsto
statement:
theorem correctedDifferenceQuotient_comp_tendsto
    {E G : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 y0 B : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.TendstoWithin E f x0 y0)
    (hg : RealFunction.TendstoWithin G (DifferenceQuotient g y0) y0 B)
    (hmap :
      (x : Point) -> E x -> Not (x = x0) ->
        Not (f x = y0) -> G (f x)) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
      (fun x => CorrectedDifferenceQuotient g y0 B (f x)) x0 B
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hg eps heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases hf eta heta.left with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hclose := hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd
          change RealTheory.lt
            (RealFunction.dist
              (CorrectedDifferenceQuotient g y0 B (f x)) B) eps
          classical
          by_cases hfx : f x = y0
          · rw [hfx, correctedDifferenceQuotient_at, RealFunction.dist_self]
            exact heps
          · rw [correctedDifferenceQuotient_of_ne hfx]
            exact heta.right (f x) (hmap x hx hxne hfx) hfx hclose

name: hasDerivWithin_comp_noncollapsing
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_comp_noncollapsing
    {E G : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 A B : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A)
    (hg : HasDerivWithin G g (f x0) B)
    (hmap : ∀ x, E x -> Not (x = x0) -> G (f x))
    (hneq : ∀ x, E x -> Not (x = x0) -> Not (f x = f x0)) :
    HasDerivWithin E (RealFunction.CompFun g f) x0
      (RealTheory.mul B A)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  have hfcont : RealFunction.TendstoWithin E f x0 (f x0) :=
    (hasDerivWithin_continuousAtOn hf).right
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point => DifferenceQuotient g (f x0) (f x))
        x0 B := by
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_comp_tendstoWithin
      hfcont hg.right hmap hneq
  have hprod :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (DifferenceQuotient g (f x0) (f x))
            (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x))
        x0 (RealTheory.mul B A) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hleft hf.right
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := fun x : Point =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (DifferenceQuotient g (f x0) (f x))
        (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x))
    (g := DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.CompFun g f) x0)
  · intro x hx hxne
    symm
    exact differenceQuotient_comp_eq (hneq x hx hxne)
  · exact hprod

name: hasDerivWithin_comp
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_comp
    {E G : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 A B : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A)
    (hg : HasDerivWithin G g (f x0) B)
    (hmap :
      (x : Point) -> E x -> Not (x = x0) ->
        Not (f x = f x0) -> G (f x)) :
    HasDerivWithin E (RealFunction.CompFun g f) x0
      (RealTheory.mul B A)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  have hfcont : RealFunction.TendstoWithin E f x0 (f x0) :=
    (hasDerivWithin_continuousAtOn hf).right
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          CorrectedDifferenceQuotient g (f x0) B (f x))
        x0 B :=
    correctedDifferenceQuotient_comp_tendsto hfcont hg.right hmap
  have hprod :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (CorrectedDifferenceQuotient g (f x0) B (f x))
            (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x))
        x0 (RealTheory.mul B A) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hleft hf.right
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := fun x : Point =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (CorrectedDifferenceQuotient g (f x0) B (f x))
        (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x))
    (g := DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.CompFun g f) x0)
  · intro x hx hxne
    symm
    exact differenceQuotient_comp_corrected_eq
  · exact hprod

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_comp
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_comp
    {E G : Domain} {f g f' g' : Map}
    (hf : HasDerivativeWithinOn E f f')
    (hg : HasDerivativeWithinOn G g g')
    (hbase : RealFunction.MapsInto E G f) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (RealFunction.CompFun g f)
      (RealFunction.MulFun (RealFunction.CompFun g' f) f')
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change HasDerivWithin E (RealFunction.CompFun g f) x
    (RealTheory.mul (g' (f x)) (f' x))
  exact hasDerivWithin_comp
    (hf x hx)
    (hg (f x) (hbase x hx))
    (fun y hy _hyne _hneq => hbase y hy)

name: inverse_derivative_value_of_left_inverse
statement:
theorem inverse_derivative_value_of_left_inverse
    {E G : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 A B : Point}
    (hcluster : RealFunction.ClusterPoint E x0)
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A)
    (hg : HasDerivWithin G g (f x0) B)
    (hmap : ∀ x, E x -> Not (x = x0) -> G (f x))
    (hleftInv : ∀ x, E x -> RealFunction.CompFun g f x = x)
    (hA : Not (A = RealTheory.zero)) :
    B = RealTheory.inv A
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hneq :
      forall x, E x -> Not (x = x0) -> Not (f x = f x0) := by
    intro x hx hxne hfx
    apply hxne
    calc
      x = RealFunction.CompFun g f x := (hleftInv x hx).symm
      _ = RealFunction.CompFun g f x0 := by
        unfold RealFunction.CompFun
        rw [hfx]
      _ = x0 := hleftInv x0 hf.left
  have hchain :
      HasDerivWithin E (RealFunction.CompFun g f) x0
        (RealTheory.mul B A) :=
    hasDerivWithin_comp_noncollapsing hf hg hmap hneq
  have hchain_id :
      HasDerivWithin E (fun x : Point => x) x0
        (RealTheory.mul B A) := by
    refine And.intro hf.left ?_
    apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
      (f := DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.CompFun g f) x0)
      (g := DifferenceQuotient (fun x : Point => x) x0)
    · intro x hx hxne
      unfold DifferenceQuotient
      rw [hleftInv x hx]
      rw [hleftInv x0 hf.left]
    · exact hchain.right
  have hid : HasDerivWithin E (fun x : Point => x) x0 RealTheory.one :=
    hasDerivWithin_id hf.left
  have hmul : RealTheory.mul B A = RealTheory.one :=
    hasDerivWithin_unique hcluster hchain_id hid
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hA hmul

name: hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_of_sequence

name: hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_subset
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_subset
    {E G : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {n : Nat}

    (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn G f D n) :
    HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx
    exact hD.left x (hEG x hx)
  · intro k hk x hx

name: hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_shift
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_shift
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {n : Nat}

proof:
:= by

  · intro x _hx
    rfl
  · intro k hk
    unfold DerivativeChainShift

name: hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_prepend
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_prepend
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {n : Nat}
    (hf : HasDerivativeWithinOn E f (D 0))
    (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E (D 0) D n) :
    HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f
      (PrependDerivativeChain f D) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro x _hx
    rfl
  · intro k hk
    cases k with
    | zero =>
        exact hf
    | succ k =>
        change HasDerivativeWithinOn E (D k) (D (k + 1))
        exact hD.right k (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk)

name: isNthDerivativeWithinOn_of_derivativeChain
statement:
theorem isNthDerivativeWithinOn_of_derivativeChain
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} (n : Nat)
    (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n) :
    IsNthDerivativeWithinOn E n f (D n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact hD.left
  | succ n ih =>
      refine Exists.intro (D n) ?_
      exact And.intro
        (ih
          (hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_of_le
            (Nat.le_succ n) hD))
        (hD.right n (Nat.lt_succ_self n))

name: hasNthDerivWithin_of_isNthDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
theorem hasNthDerivWithin_of_isNthDerivativeWithinOn
    {E : Domain} {n : Nat} {f g : Map} {x : Point}
    (hg : IsNthDerivativeWithinOn E n f g)

    HasNthDerivWithin E n f x (g x)

name: isNthDerivativeWithinOn_of_derivative_sequence
statement:
theorem isNthDerivativeWithinOn_of_derivative_sequence
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    (hD : HasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn E f D) :
    forall n : Nat,
      IsNthDerivativeWithinOn E n f (D n)
  | 0 => hD.left
  | n + 1 => by
      refine Exists.intro (D n) ?_
      exact And.intro
        (isNthDerivativeWithinOn_of_derivative_sequence hD n)
        (hD.right n)

name: hasNthDerivWithin_of_derivative_sequence
proof:
:=
  hasNthDerivWithin_of_isNthDerivativeWithinOn
    (isNthDerivativeWithinOn_of_derivative_sequence hD n) hx

  hasNthDerivWithin_of_isNthDerivativeWithinOn

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_inv_positive
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_inv_positive :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.inv x)
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.neg
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x) (RealTheory.inv x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let positive : Domain := fun x : Point => F.lt F.zero x
  have hraw :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn positive
        (RealFunction.InvFun RealFunction.IdentityFun)
        (InvDerivativeFormula RealFunction.IdentityFun
          (fun _ : Point => F.one)) := by
    apply hasDerivativeWithinOn_inv
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_id positive)
    intro x hx
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx hzero.symm
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn positive
        (RealFunction.InvFun RealFunction.IdentityFun)
        (fun x : Point => F.inv x) := by
    intro x _hx
    rfl
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn positive
        (InvDerivativeFormula RealFunction.IdentityFun
          (fun _ : Point => F.one))
        (fun x : Point => F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))) := by
    intro x _hx
    unfold InvDerivativeFormula RealFunction.IdentityFun
    change
      F.neg (F.mul (F.mul F.one (F.inv x)) (F.inv x)) =
        F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))
    rw [F.one_mul (F.inv x)]
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hraw)

name: weightedPowerSum_hasDerivWithin_zero
statement:
theorem weightedPowerSum_hasDerivWithin_zero
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k)) :
    HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain
      (fun r : Point => I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1))
      RealTheory.zero
      (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let term : Nat -> Map :=
    fun k : Nat => fun r : Point =>
      F.mul (w k)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r (x k))
  let term' : Nat -> Map :=
    fun k : Nat => fun r : Point =>
      F.mul (w k)
        (F.mul (I.logSpec.log (x k))
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r (x k)))
  have hterms :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 ->
        HasDerivativeWithinOn UniversalDomain (term k) (term' k) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold term term'
    exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul
      (E := UniversalDomain)
      (f := fun r : Point =>
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r (x k))
      (f' := fun r : Point =>
        F.mul (I.logSpec.log (x k))
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r (x k)))
      (c := w k)
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_power_exponent I (hx k hk))
  have hsum :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum
      (E := UniversalDomain)
      (term := term) (term' := term') (n + 1) hterms
  have hraw :
      HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain
        (fun r : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k r) (n + 1))
        F.zero
        (RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term' k F.zero) (n + 1)) :=
    hsum F.zero trivial
  have hvalue :
      RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term' k F.zero) (n + 1) =
        WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1) := by
    unfold term' WeightedValueSum
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
    intro k hk
    change
      F.mul (w k)
          (F.mul (I.logSpec.log (x k))
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power F.zero (x k))) =
        F.mul (w k) (I.logSpec.log (x k))
    rw [I.power_exp_log F.zero (x k) (hx k hk)]
    change
      F.mul (w k)
          (F.mul (I.logSpec.log (x k))
            (I.expSpec.exp
              (F.mul F.zero (I.logSpec.log (x k))))) =
        F.mul (w k) (I.logSpec.log (x k))
    rw [F.zero_mul]
    have hexp_zero : I.expSpec.exp F.zero = F.one := by
      change I.expSpec.exp RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
      exact I.expSpec.zero_value
    rw [hexp_zero]
    rw [F.mul_one]
  have hraw' :
      HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain
        (fun r : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k r) (n + 1))
        F.zero
        (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1)) :=
    hasDerivWithin_congr_value hvalue hraw
  exact hasDerivWithin_congr
    (E := UniversalDomain)
    (f := fun r : Point =>
      RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k r) (n + 1))
    (g := fun r : Point => I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1))
    (by
      intro r _hr
      unfold term
      unfold RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface.weightedPowerSum
      unfold WeightedPointSum
      rfl)
    hraw'

name: weightedPowerSum_logQuotient_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem weightedPowerSum_logQuotient_tendsto_zero
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hw : ConvexWeights w (n + 1)) :
    TendstoWithin PuncturedZero
      (fun r : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv r)
          (I.logSpec.log (I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1))))
      RealTheory.zero
      (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A : Map :=
    fun r : Point => I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1)
  let L := WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1)
  have hA0 : A F.zero = F.one := by
    unfold A
    exact I.weightedPowerSum_zero_eq_one n hx hw
  have hlogA0 : I.logSpec.log (A F.zero) = F.zero := by
    rw [hA0]
    exact I.logSpec.one_value
  have hAderiv : HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain A F.zero L := by
    unfold A L
    exact weightedPowerSum_hasDerivWithin_zero I n hx
  have houter :
      HasDerivWithin PositiveDomain I.logSpec.log (A F.zero) F.one := by
    rw [hA0]
    exact hasDerivWithin_congr_value
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F)
      (NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface.hasDerivWithin_log_at
        I RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
  have hcomp :
      HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain (CompFun I.logSpec.log A)
        F.zero (F.mul F.one L) := by
    exact hasDerivWithin_comp hAderiv houter
      (fun r _hr _hrne _hneq =>
        I.weightedPowerSum_pos n hx hw)
  have hcomp' :
      HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain (CompFun I.logSpec.log A)
        F.zero L :=
    hasDerivWithin_congr_value (F.one_mul L) hcomp
  have hpunct :
      TendstoWithin PuncturedZero
        (DifferenceQuotient (CompFun I.logSpec.log A) F.zero)
        F.zero L :=
    tendstoWithin_of_subset
      (E := UniversalDomain) (G := PuncturedZero)
      (f := DifferenceQuotient (CompFun I.logSpec.log A) F.zero)
      (x0 := F.zero)
      (fun _r _hr => trivial)
      hcomp'.right
  exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (E := PuncturedZero)
    (f := DifferenceQuotient (CompFun I.logSpec.log A) F.zero)
    (g := fun r : Point =>
      F.mul (F.inv r) (I.logSpec.log (A r)))
    (by
      intro r _hr _hrne
      unfold DifferenceQuotient CompFun
      rw [hlogA0]
      change
        F.mul (F.sub (I.logSpec.log (A r)) F.zero)
            (F.inv (F.sub r F.zero)) =
          F.mul (F.inv r) (I.logSpec.log (A r))
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (I.logSpec.log (A r))]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F r]
      exact F.mul_comm (I.logSpec.log (A r)) (F.inv r))
    hpunct

name: weightedPowerMean_tendsto_geometricMean_zero
statement:
theorem weightedPowerMean_tendsto_geometricMean_zero
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hw : ConvexWeights w (n + 1)) :
    TendstoWithin PuncturedZero
      (fun r : Point => I.weightedPowerMean r x w (n + 1))
      RealTheory.zero
      (I.weightedGeometricMeanExp x w (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A : Map :=
    fun r : Point => I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1)
  let L := WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1)
  let B : Map :=
    fun r : Point => F.mul (F.inv r) (I.logSpec.log (A r))
  have hB :
      TendstoWithin PuncturedZero B F.zero L := by
    unfold B A L
    exact weightedPowerSum_logQuotient_tendsto_zero I n hx hw
  have hexp :
      TendstoWithin PuncturedZero
        (CompFun I.expSpec.exp B) F.zero (I.expSpec.exp L) := by
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_comp_continuousAtOn
      (E := PuncturedZero) (G := UniversalDomain)
      (f := B) (g := I.expSpec.exp)
      (x0 := F.zero) (A := L)
      hB (I.expSpec.continuousOn L trivial)
      (fun _r _hr _hrne => trivial)
  have hmean :
      TendstoWithin PuncturedZero
        (fun r : Point => I.weightedPowerMean r x w (n + 1))
        F.zero (I.expSpec.exp L) := by
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
      (E := PuncturedZero)
      (f := CompFun I.expSpec.exp B)
      (g := fun r : Point => I.weightedPowerMean r x w (n + 1))
      (by
        intro r _hr hrne
        unfold CompFun B A
        change
          I.expSpec.exp
              (F.mul (F.inv r)
                (I.logSpec.log (I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1)))) =
            I.weightedPowerMean r x w (n + 1)
        rw [I.weightedPowerMean_of_ne_zero x w (n + 1) hrne]
        exact (I.power_exp_log
          (F.inv r) (I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1))
          (I.weightedPowerSum_pos n hx hw)).symm)
      hexp
  have hlimit :
      I.expSpec.exp L = I.weightedGeometricMeanExp x w (n + 1) := by
    unfold L
    unfold RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface.weightedGeometricMeanExp
    rfl
  exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlimit hmean

name: differenceQuotient_nonnegative_of_right_le
statement:
private theorem differenceQuotient_nonnegative_of_right_le
    {f : Map} {x0 x : Point}
    (hfx : RealTheory.le (f x0) (f x))
    (hxright : RealTheory.lt x0 x) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  change F.le F.zero
    (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
  have hnum : F.le F.zero (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hfx
  have hdenpos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub x x0) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxright
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hdenpos)
  exact F.mul_nonneg hnum hinv_nonneg

name: differenceQuotient_nonpositive_of_right_le
statement:
private theorem differenceQuotient_nonpositive_of_right_le
    {f : Map} {x0 x : Point}
    (hfx : RealTheory.le (f x) (f x0))
    (hxright : RealTheory.lt x0 x) :
    RealTheory.le (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  change F.le
    (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0))) F.zero
  have hnum : F.le (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) F.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hfx
  have hdenpos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub x x0) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxright
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hdenpos)
  have hmul :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hnum hinv_nonneg
  change F.le
    (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
    (F.mul F.zero (F.inv (F.sub x x0))) at hmul
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F] at hmul

name: hasDerivWithin_nonnegative_of_monotoneOn_openInterval

name: secantSlope_derivative_witness
statement:
private theorem secantSlope_derivative_witness
    {a b x y : Point} {f : Map}
    (hxClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hyClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (hfcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b f) :
    Exists
      (fun c : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b c)
          (HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f c
            (SecantSlope f x y)))
proof:
:= by
  let hclosedSub :=
    closedInterval_subset_of_endpoints
      (a := a) (b := b) (x := x) (y := y)
      hxClosed.left hyClosed.right
  let hopenSub :=
    openInterval_subset_of_endpoints
      (a := a) (b := b) (x := x) (y := y)
      hxClosed.left hyClosed.right
  have hfcontSmall :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y) f :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hclosedSub hfcont
  have hdiffSmall : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval x y f := by
    intro z hz
    have hzBig : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b z := hopenSub z hz
    cases hdiff z hzBig with
    | intro A hA =>
        exact Exists.intro A
          (hasDerivWithin_subset hopenSub hz hA)
  cases lagrange_mean_value_theorem x y f hxy hfcontSmall hdiffSmall with
  | intro c hc =>
      have hcBig : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b c := hopenSub c hc.left
      cases hdiff c hcBig with
      | intro A hA =>
          have hA_small :
              HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval x y) f c A :=
            hasDerivWithin_subset hopenSub hc.left hA
          have hm_eq_A : SecantSlope f x y = A :=
            hasDerivWithin_unique
              (openInterval_clusterPoint hc.left)
              hc.right hA_small
          refine Exists.intro c (And.intro hcBig ?_)
          rw [hm_eq_A]
          exact hA

name: endpoint_le_of_nonnegative_secantSlope
statement:
private theorem endpoint_le_of_nonnegative_secantSlope
    {x y : Point} {f : Map}
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (hm : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (SecantSlope f x y)) :
    RealTheory.le (f x) (f y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let m := SecantSlope f x y
  have hdx_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  have hprod_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul m (F.sub y x)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hdx_pos)
  have hsec :
      F.mul m (F.sub y x) = F.sub (f y) (f x) := by
    unfold m
    exact secantSlope_mul_intervalLength (f := f) hxy
  have hdy_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub (f y) (f x)) := by
    rwa [<- hsec]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_sub_nonneg F hdy_nonneg

    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hm hdx_pos
  have hsec :
      F.mul m (F.sub y x) = F.sub (f y) (f x) := by

name: endpoint_ge_of_nonpositive_secantSlope
statement:
private theorem endpoint_ge_of_nonpositive_secantSlope
    {x y : Point} {f : Map}

      F.le (F.mul m (F.sub y x)) F.zero := by

        F.le (F.mul m (F.sub y x))
          (F.mul F.zero (F.sub y x)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
        F hm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hdx_pos)

name: endpoint_gt_of_negative_secantSlope
statement:
private theorem endpoint_gt_of_negative_secantSlope
    {x y : Point} {f : Map}
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (hm : RealTheory.lt (SecantSlope f x y) RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.lt (f y) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let m := SecantSlope f x y
  have hdx_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  have hprod_neg :
      F.lt (F.mul m (F.sub y x)) F.zero := by
    have hmul :
        F.lt (F.mul m (F.sub y x))
          (F.mul F.zero (F.sub y x)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hm hdx_pos
    rwa [F.zero_mul] at hmul
  have hsec :
      F.mul m (F.sub y x) = F.sub (f y) (f x) := by

  have hdy_neg : F.lt (F.sub (f y) (f x)) F.zero := by
    rwa [<- hsec]
  have hnegdy_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.neg (F.sub (f y) (f x))) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hdy_neg
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
  have hrev_sub_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub (f x) (f y)) := by
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f y) (f x)]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F hrev_sub_pos

name: monotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonnegative
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonnegative
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hfcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b f)
    (hderiv : DerivativeNonnegativeOnOpenInterval a b f) :
    RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hEq : x = y
  · rw [hEq]
    exact F.le_refl (f y)
  · have hnot_yx : Not (F.le y x) := by
      intro hyx
      exact hEq (F.le_antisymm hxy hyx)
    have hxy_lt : F.lt x y :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hnot_yx
    exact endpoint_le_of_nonnegative_secantSlope hxy_lt
      (secantSlope_nonnegative_of_derivative_nonnegative
        hx hy hxy_lt hfcont hdiff hderiv)
