name: monotoneOn_openInterval_iff_derivative_nonnegative
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_openInterval_iff_derivative_nonnegative
    {a b : Point} {f f' : Map}
    (_hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hf : HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f f') :
    RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f <->
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f' x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hmono x hx
    exact hasDerivWithin_nonnegative_of_monotoneOn_openInterval
      hx hmono (hf x hx)
  · intro hsign x y hx hy hxy
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    by_cases hEq : x = y
    · rw [hEq]
      exact F.le_refl (f y)
    · have hnot_yx : Not (F.le y x) := by
        intro hyx
        exact hEq (F.le_antisymm hxy hyx)
      have hxy_lt : F.lt x y :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hnot_yx
      have hfcont :
          RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y) f :=
        continuousOn_closedSubinterval_of_derivativeOn_openInterval hx hy hf
      have hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval x y f :=
        differentiableOn_openSubinterval_of_derivativeOn_openInterval hx hy hf
      have hderiv : DerivativeNonnegativeOnOpenInterval x y f :=
        derivativeNonnegativeOn_openSubinterval hx hy hf hsign
      have hclosed :=
        monotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonnegative
          hfcont hdiff hderiv
      exact hclosed x y
        (And.intro (F.le_refl x) hxy)
        (And.intro hxy (F.le_refl y)) hxy

name: decreasingOn_openInterval_iff_derivative_nonpositive
statement:
theorem decreasingOn_openInterval_iff_derivative_nonpositive
    {a b : Point} {f f' : Map}
    (_hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hf : HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f f') :
    RealFunction.DecreasingOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f <->
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (f' x) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hdecr x hx
    exact hasDerivWithin_nonpositive_of_decreasingOn_openInterval
      hx hdecr (hf x hx)
  · intro hsign x y hx hy hxy
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    by_cases hEq : x = y
    · rw [hEq]
      exact F.le_refl (f y)
    · have hnot_yx : Not (F.le y x) := by
        intro hyx
        exact hEq (F.le_antisymm hxy hyx)
      have hxy_lt : F.lt x y :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hnot_yx
      have hfcont :
          RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y) f :=
        continuousOn_closedSubinterval_of_derivativeOn_openInterval hx hy hf
      have hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval x y f :=
        differentiableOn_openSubinterval_of_derivativeOn_openInterval hx hy hf
      have hderiv : DerivativeNonpositiveOnOpenInterval x y f :=
        derivativeNonpositiveOn_openSubinterval hx hy hf hsign
      have hclosed :=
        decreasingOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonpositive
          hfcont hdiff hderiv
      exact hclosed x y
        (And.intro (F.le_refl x) hxy)
        (And.intro hxy (F.le_refl y)) hxy

name: constantOn_openInterval_iff_derivative_zero
statement:
theorem constantOn_openInterval_iff_derivative_zero
    {a b : Point} {f f' : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hf : HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f f') :
    (Exists fun c : Point =>
      RealFunction.ConstantOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f c) <->
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          f' x = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hconstant x hx
    cases hconstant with
    | intro c hc =>
        have hzero :
            HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x
              RealTheory.zero :=
          hasDerivWithin_constantOn hx hc
        exact hasDerivWithin_unique
          (openInterval_clusterPoint hx) (hf x hx) hzero
  · intro hzero
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    have hmono :
        RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f :=
      (monotoneOn_openInterval_iff_derivative_nonnegative hab hf).2
        (fun x hx => by
          rw [hzero x hx]
          exact F.le_refl F.zero)
    have hdecr :
        RealFunction.DecreasingOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f :=
      (decreasingOn_openInterval_iff_derivative_nonpositive hab hf).2
        (fun x hx => by
          rw [hzero x hx]
          exact F.le_refl F.zero)
    let c := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F a b
    have hc : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b c := by
      unfold c RealTheory.OpenInterval
      exact And.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hab)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hab)
    refine Exists.intro (f c) ?_
    intro x hx
    cases F.le_total c x with
    | inl hcx =>
        exact F.le_antisymm
          (hdecr c x hc hx hcx)
          (hmono c x hc hx hcx)
    | inr hxc =>
        exact F.le_antisymm
          (hmono x c hx hc hxc)
          (hdecr x c hx hc hxc)

name: constantOn_closedInterval_of_continuousOn_of_derivative_zero
statement:
theorem constantOn_closedInterval_of_continuousOn_of_derivative_zero
    {a b : Point} {f f' : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hfcont : ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hf : HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f f')
    (hzero : forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x -> f' x = RealTheory.zero) :
    ConstantOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f (f a)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b f := by
    intro x hx
    exact Exists.intro (f' x) (hf x hx)
  have hnonneg : DerivativeNonnegativeOnOpenInterval a b f := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hAeq : A = f' x :=
      hasDerivWithin_unique (openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA (hf x hx)
    rw [hAeq, hzero x hx]
    exact F.le_refl F.zero
  have hnonpos : DerivativeNonpositiveOnOpenInterval a b f := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hAeq : A = f' x :=
      hasDerivWithin_unique (openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA (hf x hx)
    rw [hAeq, hzero x hx]
    exact F.le_refl F.zero
  have hmono : MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f :=
    monotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonnegative
      hfcont hdiff hnonneg
  have hdecr : DecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f :=
    decreasingOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonpositive
      hfcont hdiff hnonpos
  have ha : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    And.intro (F.le_refl a)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab)
  intro x hx
  exact F.le_antisymm
    (hdecr a x ha hx hx.left)
    (hmono a x ha hx hx.left)

name: right_value_gt_of_positive_differenceQuotient
statement:
private theorem right_value_gt_of_positive_differenceQuotient
    {f : Map} {x0 x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt x0 x)
    (hq :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)) :
    RealTheory.lt (f x0) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dx := F.sub x x0
  let dy := F.sub (f x) (f x0)
  have hdx_pos : F.lt F.zero dx := by
    unfold dx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx
  have hdx_ne : Not (dx = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hdx_pos h.symm
  have hmul :
      F.lt (F.mul F.zero dx)
        (F.mul (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x) dx) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hq hdx_pos
  have hdy_pos : F.lt F.zero dy := by
    unfold DifferenceQuotient at hmul
    change
      F.lt (F.mul F.zero dx)
        (F.mul (F.mul dy (F.inv dx)) dx) at hmul
    rw [F.zero_mul] at hmul
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right F dy hdx_ne] at hmul
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F hdy_pos

name: left_value_lt_of_positive_differenceQuotient
statement:
private theorem left_value_lt_of_positive_differenceQuotient
    {f : Map} {x0 x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt x x0)
    (hq :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)) :
    RealTheory.lt (f x) (f x0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dx := F.sub x x0
  let leftdx := F.sub x0 x
  let dy := F.sub (f x) (f x0)
  have hleftdx_pos : F.lt F.zero leftdx := by
    unfold leftdx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx
  have hdx_ne : Not (dx = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    have hEq : x = x0 :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx hEq
  have hmul :
      F.lt (F.mul F.zero leftdx)
        (F.mul (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x) leftdx) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hq hleftdx_pos
  have hnegdy_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.neg dy) := by
    unfold DifferenceQuotient at hmul
    have hleftdx_eq : leftdx = F.neg dx := by
      unfold leftdx dx
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x x0
    change
      F.lt (F.mul F.zero leftdx)
        (F.mul (F.mul dy (F.inv dx)) leftdx) at hmul
    rw [F.zero_mul] at hmul
    rw [hleftdx_eq] at hmul
    rw [F.mul_neg] at hmul
    have hcancel :
        F.mul (F.mul dy (F.inv dx)) dx = dy :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right F dy hdx_ne
    rw [hcancel] at hmul
    exact hmul
  have hrev_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub (f x0) (f x)) := by
    unfold dy at hnegdy_pos
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f x) (f x0)]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F hrev_pos

name: localStrictCrossingIncreasingAt_of_hasDerivAt_positive
statement:
theorem localStrictCrossingIncreasingAt_of_hasDerivAt_positive
    {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivAt f x0 A)
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A) :
    LocalStrictCrossingIncreasingAt f x0
proof:
:= by
  have hevent :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain x0
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
            (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_eventually_lt_of_limit_lt
      hf.right hA
  cases hevent with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      refine And.intro ?left ?right
      · intro x hx hxd
        have hxne : Not (x = x0) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx
        exact left_value_lt_of_positive_differenceQuotient hx
          (hdelta.right x True.intro hxne hxd)
      · intro x hx hxd
        have hxne : Not (x = x0) := by
          intro h
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx h.symm
        exact right_value_gt_of_positive_differenceQuotient hx
          (hdelta.right x True.intro hxne hxd)

name: localStrictCrossingDecreasingAt_of_hasDerivAt_negative
statement:
theorem localStrictCrossingDecreasingAt_of_hasDerivAt_negative
    {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivAt f x0 A)
    (hA : RealTheory.lt A RealTheory.zero) :
    LocalStrictCrossingDecreasingAt f x0
proof:
:= by
  have hneg :
      HasDerivAt (RealFunction.NegFun f) x0 (RealTheory.neg A) :=
    hasDerivWithin_neg hf
  have hnegA_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.neg A) := by
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg
      F hA
    change F.lt F.zero (F.neg A)
    change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg A) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
  cases localStrictCrossingIncreasingAt_of_hasDerivAt_positive
      hneg hnegA_pos with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      refine And.intro ?left ?right
      · intro x hx hxd
        have hneglt := hdelta.right.left x hx hxd
        unfold RealFunction.NegFun at hneglt
        let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg
          F hneglt
        change F.lt (f x0) (f x)
        change F.lt (F.neg (F.neg (f x0)))
          (F.neg (F.neg (f x))) at h
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F (f x0),
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F (f x)] at h
      · intro x hx hxd
        have hneglt := hdelta.right.right x hx hxd
        unfold RealFunction.NegFun at hneglt
        let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg
          F hneglt
        change F.lt (f x) (f x0)
        change F.lt (F.neg (F.neg (f x)))
          (F.neg (F.neg (f x0))) at h
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F (f x),
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F (f x0)] at h

name: differenceQuotient_sub_const_error_eq
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_sub_const_error_eq
    (f : Map) (x y L : Point)
    (hyx : Not (y = x)) :
    RealTheory.sub (DifferenceQuotient f x y) L =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))
          (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub y x)))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub y x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := F.sub (f y) (f x)
  let dx := F.sub y x
  have hdxne : Not (dx = F.zero) := by
    intro hdx
    exact hyx (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hdx)
  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  change
    F.sub (F.mul d (F.inv dx)) L =
      F.mul (F.sub d (F.mul L dx)) (F.inv dx)
  calc
    F.sub (F.mul d (F.inv dx)) L =
        F.sub (F.mul d (F.inv dx)) (F.mul L F.one) := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = F.sub (F.mul d (F.inv dx))
        (F.mul L (F.mul dx (F.inv dx))) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hdxne]
    _ = F.sub (F.mul d (F.inv dx))
        (F.mul (F.mul L dx) (F.inv dx)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.sub d (F.mul L dx)) (F.inv dx) := by
          exact Eq.symm
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
              F d (F.mul L dx) (F.inv dx))

name: differenceQuotient_linearError_abs_mul_abs_sub_eq_abs
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_linearError_abs_mul_abs_sub_eq_abs
    {f : Map} {x y L : Point}
    (hyx : Not (y = x)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub (DifferenceQuotient f x y) L))
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)) =
      RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))
          (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub y x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let err :=
    F.sub
      (F.sub (f y) (f x))
      (F.mul L (F.sub y x))
  let dx := F.sub y x
  have hdxne : Not (dx = F.zero) := by
    intro hdx
    exact hyx (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hdx)
  have hquot :
      F.sub (DifferenceQuotient f x y) L =
        F.mul err (F.inv dx) := by
    dsimp [err, dx]
    exact differenceQuotient_sub_const_error_eq f x y L hyx
  have hprod :
      F.mul (F.sub (DifferenceQuotient f x y) L) dx =
        err := by
    rw [hquot]
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul err (F.inv dx)) dx =
          F.mul err (F.mul (F.inv dx) dx) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul err F.one := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hdxne]
      _ = err := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.abs (F.sub (DifferenceQuotient f x y) L))
        (F.abs dx) =
      F.abs err
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F
    (F.sub (DifferenceQuotient f x y) L) dx]
  rw [hprod]

name: increment_sub_center
statement:
theorem increment_sub_center (x0 h : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add x0 h) x0 = h
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.sub (F.add x0 h) x0 = h
  rw [F.add_comm x0 h]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F h x0

name: add_sub_center
statement:
theorem add_sub_center (x0 x : Point) :
    RealTheory.add x0 (RealTheory.sub x x0) = x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.add x0 (F.sub x x0) = x
  rw [F.add_comm x0 (F.sub x x0)]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x x0

name: dist_incrementMap_zero
statement:
theorem dist_incrementMap_zero (x0 h : Point) :
    RealFunction.dist (RealTheory.add x0 h) x0 =
      RealFunction.dist h RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  change F.abs (F.sub (F.add x0 h) x0) =
    F.abs (F.sub h F.zero)
  rw [F.add_comm x0 h]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F]

name: dist_subCenter_zero
statement:
theorem dist_subCenter_zero (x0 x : Point) :
    RealFunction.dist (RealTheory.sub x x0) RealTheory.zero =
      RealFunction.dist x x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  change F.abs (F.sub (F.sub x x0) F.zero) =
    F.abs (F.sub x x0)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F]

name: incrementMap_ne_center_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem incrementMap_ne_center_of_ne_zero
    {x0 h : Point} (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) :
    Not (RealTheory.add x0 h = x0)
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  exact hh (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_zero_of_add_eq_self_left
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx)

name: subCenterMap_ne_zero_of_ne_center
statement:
theorem subCenterMap_ne_zero_of_ne_center
    {x0 x : Point} (hx : Not (x = x0)) :
    Not (RealTheory.sub x x0 = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro hsub
  exact hx (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsub)

name: tendstoWithin_incrementDomain
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_incrementDomain
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 L : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.TendstoWithin E f x0 L) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin
      (IncrementDomain E x0)
      (fun h : Point => f (RealTheory.add x0 h))
      RealTheory.zero L
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro h hh hhne hdist
      exact hdelta.right
        (RealTheory.add x0 h) hh
        (incrementMap_ne_center_of_ne_zero hhne)
        (by rwa [dist_incrementMap_zero x0 h])

name: tendstoWithin_of_incrementDomain
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_of_incrementDomain
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 L : Point}
    (hf :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        (fun h : Point => f (RealTheory.add x0 h))
        RealTheory.zero L) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin E f x0 L
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hdist
      let h := RealTheory.sub x x0
      have hh : IncrementDomain E x0 h := by
        unfold h IncrementDomain
        rw [add_sub_center x0 x]
        exact hx
      have hhne : Not (h = RealTheory.zero) := by
        unfold h
        exact subCenterMap_ne_zero_of_ne_center hxne
      have hdist' : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist h RealTheory.zero) delta := by
        unfold h
        rwa [dist_subCenter_zero x0 x]
      have hclose := hdelta.right h hh hhne hdist'
      unfold h at hclose
      change
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealFunction.dist
            (f (RealTheory.add x0 (RealTheory.sub x x0))) L)
          eps at hclose
      rwa [add_sub_center x0 x] at hclose

name: tendstoWithin_id
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_id (E : Domain) (x0 : Point) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin E (fun x : Point => x) x0 x0
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  refine Exists.intro eps ?_
  refine And.intro heps ?_
  intro x hx hxne hdist
  exact hdist

name: tendstoWithin_of_subset
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_of_subset
    {E G : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 L : Point}
    (hsub : forall x : Point, G x -> E x)
    (hf : RealFunction.TendstoWithin E f x0 L) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin G f x0 L
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      exact hdelta.right x (hsub x hx) hxne hxd

name: hasDerivWithin_subset
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_subset
    {E G : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hsub : forall x : Point, G x -> E x)
    (hx0 : G x0)
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A) :
    HasDerivWithin G f x0 A
proof:
:=
  And.intro hx0 (tendstoWithin_of_subset hsub hf.right)

name: hasDerivWithin_leftTendsto
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_leftTendsto
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A) :
    RealFunction.LeftTendstoWithin E (DifferenceQuotient f x0) x0 A
proof:
:=
  tendstoWithin_of_subset
    (fun _ hx => hx.left) hf.right

name: hasDerivWithin_rightTendsto
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_rightTendsto
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A) :
    RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin E (DifferenceQuotient f x0) x0 A

:=
  tendstoWithin_of_subset
    (fun _ hx => hx.left) hf.right

name: hasDerivWithin_unique
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_unique {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A B : Point}
    (hcluster : RealFunction.ClusterPoint E x0)
    (hA : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A)
    (hB : HasDerivWithin E f x0 B) :
    A = B
proof:
:=
  RealFunction.tendstoWithin_unique hcluster hA.right hB.right

name: hasDerivWithin_const
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hx0 ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
    (g := DifferenceQuotient (fun _ : Point => c) x0)
  · intro x hx hxne
    symm
    unfold DifferenceQuotient
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg c c]
    rw [RealTheory.add_neg c]
    rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  · exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const E RealTheory.zero x0

name: hasDerivAt_const
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_const (c x0 : Point) :
    HasDerivAt (fun _ : Point => c) x0 RealTheory.zero
proof:
:=
  hasDerivWithin_const (E := RealFunction.UniversalDomain) True.intro

name: hasDerivWithin_congr
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_congr
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hfg : RealFunction.SameOn E f g)
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A) :
    HasDerivWithin E g x0 A
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := DifferenceQuotient f x0)
    (g := DifferenceQuotient g x0)
  · intro x hx hxne
    unfold DifferenceQuotient
    rw [hfg x hx, hfg x0 hf.left]
  · exact hf.right

name: hasDerivWithin_congr_value
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_congr_value
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A B : Point}
    (hAB : A = B)
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A) :
    HasDerivWithin E f x0 B
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hAB hf.right

name: hasDerivWithin_constantOn
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_constantOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {c x0 : Point}
    (hx0 : E x0)
    (hfconst : RealFunction.ConstantOn E f c) :
    HasDerivWithin E f x0 RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  apply hasDerivWithin_congr
    (E := E) (f := fun _ : Point => c) (g := f)
  · intro x hx
    symm
    exact hfconst x hx
  · exact hasDerivWithin_const hx0

name: differenceQuotient_id_eq_one
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_id_eq_one
    {x0 x : Point} (hx : Not (x = x0)) :
    DifferenceQuotient (fun y : Point => y) x0 x = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  change F.mul (F.sub x x0) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) = F.one
  have hsub_ne : Not (F.sub x x0 = F.zero) := by
    intro hsub
    have hEq : x = x0 :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hsub
    exact hx hEq
  exact F.mul_inv_cancel hsub_ne

name: hasDerivWithin_id
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hx0 ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
    (g := DifferenceQuotient (fun x : Point => x) x0)
  · intro x hx hxne
    symm
    exact differenceQuotient_id_eq_one hxne
  · exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const E RealTheory.one x0

name: hasDerivAt_id
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_id (x0 : Point) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : Point => x) x0 RealTheory.one
proof:
:=
  hasDerivWithin_id (E := RealFunction.UniversalDomain) True.intro

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_subCenterMap
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_subCenterMap
    (E : Domain) (x0 : Point) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (SubCenterMap x0)
      (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine And.intro hx ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
    (g := DifferenceQuotient (SubCenterMap x0) x)
  · intro y _hy hyne
    symm
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    unfold DifferenceQuotient SubCenterMap
    change
      F.mul
          (F.sub (F.sub y x0) (F.sub x x0))
          (F.inv (F.sub y x)) = F.one
    have hdiff :
        F.sub (F.sub y x0) (F.sub x x0) = F.sub y x := by
      change
        RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.sub y x0) (RealTheory.sub x x0) =
          RealTheory.sub y x
      rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg y x0]
      rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg x x0]
      change
        F.sub (F.add y (F.neg x0)) (F.add x (F.neg x0)) =
          F.sub y x
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F]
      change
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub y x)
            (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.neg x0) (RealTheory.neg x0)) =
          RealTheory.sub y x
      rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg
        (RealTheory.neg x0) (RealTheory.neg x0)]
      rw [RealTheory.add_neg, RealTheory.add_zero]
    rw [hdiff]
    have hsub_ne : Not (F.sub y x = F.zero) := by
      intro hsub
      exact hyne (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hsub)
    exact F.mul_inv_cancel hsub_ne
  · exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const E RealTheory.one x

name: hasDerivWithin_id_constMul
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_id_constMul
    {E : Domain} {x0 c : Point} (hx0 : E x0) :
    HasDerivWithin E
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul c x)
      x0 c
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro hx0 ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := fun _ : Point => c)
    (g := DifferenceQuotient
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul c x) x0)
  · intro x _hx hxne
    symm
    unfold DifferenceQuotient
    change
      F.mul (F.sub (F.mul c x) (F.mul c x0))
          (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) = c
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F c x x0]
    rw [F.mul_assoc]
    have hsub_ne : Not (F.sub x x0 = F.zero) := by
      intro hsub
      exact hxne (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hsub)
    rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hsub_ne, F.mul_one]
  · exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const E c x0

name: hasDerivWithin_id_mul_const
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_id_mul_const
    {E : Domain} {x0 c : Point} (hx0 : E x0) :
    HasDerivWithin E
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul x c)
      x0 c
proof:
:= by
  apply hasDerivWithin_congr
    (E := E)
    (f := fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul c x)
    (g := fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul x c)
  · intro x _hx
    exact RealTheory.mul_comm c x
  · exact hasDerivWithin_id_constMul hx0

name: tendstoWithin_sub_const_self
proof:
:= by
  have hsub :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_sub
      (tendstoWithin_id E x0)
      (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const E x0 x0)
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
    (M := RealTheory.zero) ?_ hsub
  rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg x0 x0]
  exact RealTheory.add_neg x0

name: hasDerivWithin_continuousAtOn
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_continuousAtOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 L : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 L) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn E f x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dq := DifferenceQuotient f x0
  have hsubx :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub x x0) x0 RealTheory.zero :=
    tendstoWithin_sub_const_self E x0
  have hprod :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x x0) (dq x))
        x0 (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero L) := by
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hsubx hf.right
  have hprod_zero :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x x0) (dq x))
        x0 RealTheory.zero := by
    apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (M := RealTheory.zero) ?_ hprod
    exact RealTheory.zero_mul L
  have hdiff :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (f x) (f x0))
        x0 RealTheory.zero := by
    apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
      (f := fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x x0) (dq x))
      (g := fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (f x) (f x0))
    · intro x hx hxne
      unfold dq
      unfold DifferenceQuotient
      change
        F.mul (F.sub x x0)
          (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0))) =
        F.sub (f x) (f x0)
      have hsub_ne : Not (F.sub x x0 = F.zero) := by
        intro hsub
        have hEq : x = x0 :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hsub
        exact hxne hEq
      calc
        F.mul (F.sub x x0)
            (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0))) =
            F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0))
              (F.mul (F.sub x x0) (F.inv (F.sub x x0))) := by
              rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
              rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub x x0) (F.sub (f x) (f x0))]
              rw [F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) F.one := by
              rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hsub_ne]
        _ = F.sub (f x) (f x0) := by rw [F.mul_one]
    · exact hprod_zero
  have hadd :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_add hdiff
      (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const E (f x0) x0)
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := RealFunction.AddFun
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (f x) (f x0))
      (fun _ : Point => f x0))
    (g := f)
  · intro x hx hxne
    unfold RealFunction.AddFun
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F (f x) (f x0)
  · apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (M := f x0) ?_ hadd
    rw [RealTheory.zero_add]

name: eventuallyWithin_ne_zero_of_tendsto_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eventuallyWithin_ne_zero_of_tendsto_ne_zero
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.TendstoWithin E f x0 A)
    (hA : Not (A = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E x0
      (fun x => Not (f x = RealTheory.zero))
proof:
:= by
  cases RealFunction.tendstoWithin_eventuallyAwayFromZero hf hA with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases hdelta.right with
      | intro c hc =>
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd hzero
          have hcx := hc.right x hx hxne hxd
          rw [hzero] at hcx
          unfold RealTheory.zero at hcx
          rw [RealTheory.abs_zero] at hcx
          exact
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.zero)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hc.left hcx)

name: differenceQuotient_nonpos_of_right_max
statement:
private theorem differenceQuotient_nonpos_of_right_max
    {f : Map} {x0 x : Point}
    (hfx : RealTheory.le (f x) (f x0))
    (hxright : RealTheory.lt x0 x) :
    RealTheory.le (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  change F.le
    (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0))) F.zero
  have hnum : F.le (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) F.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hfx
  have hdenpos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub x x0) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxright
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hdenpos)
  have hmul :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hnum hinv_nonneg
  change F.le
    (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
    (F.mul F.zero (F.inv (F.sub x x0))) at hmul
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F] at hmul

name: differenceQuotient_nonneg_of_left_max
statement:
private theorem differenceQuotient_nonneg_of_left_max
    {f : Map} {x0 x : Point}
    (hfx : RealTheory.le (f x) (f x0))
    (hxleft : RealTheory.lt x x0) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  change F.le F.zero
    (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
  have hnum : F.le (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) F.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hfx
  have hdenneg : F.lt (F.sub x x0) F.zero := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right
      F hxleft (F.neg x0)
    rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg x x0, F.add_neg] at h
  have hinv_nonpos : F.le (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) F.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_nonpos_of_neg F hdenneg
  have hneg_num : F.le F.zero (F.neg (F.sub (f x) (f x0))) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hnum
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
  have hneg_inv : F.le F.zero (F.neg (F.inv (F.sub x x0))) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hinv_nonpos
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
  have hprod :
      F.le F.zero
        (F.mul
          (F.neg (F.sub (f x) (f x0)))
          (F.neg (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hneg_num hneg_inv
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F] at hprod

name: rightEventually_dq_nonpos_of_localMaximum
statement:
private theorem rightEventually_dq_nonpos_of_localMaximum
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hmax : LocalMaximumAt E f x0) :
    RealFunction.RightEventuallyWithin E x0
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.le (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x) RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  cases hmax.right with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      have hxE : E x := hx.left
      have hxright : RealTheory.lt x0 x := hx.right
      have hfx := hdelta.right x hxE hxne hxd
      exact differenceQuotient_nonpos_of_right_max hfx hxright

name: leftEventually_dq_nonneg_of_localMaximum
statement:
private theorem leftEventually_dq_nonneg_of_localMaximum
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hmax : LocalMaximumAt E f x0) :
    RealFunction.LeftEventuallyWithin E x0
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x))
proof:
:= by
  cases hmax.right with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      have hxE : E x := hx.left
      have hxleft : RealTheory.lt x x0 := hx.right
      have hfx := hdelta.right x hxE hxne hxd
      exact differenceQuotient_nonneg_of_left_max hfx hxleft

name: fermat_localMaximum
statement:
theorem fermat_localMaximum
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hleftCluster : RealFunction.LeftClusterPoint E x0)
    (hrightCluster : RealFunction.RightClusterPoint E x0)
    (hmax : LocalMaximumAt E f x0)
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A) :
    A = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hA_le_zero : F.le A F.zero := by
    apply RealFunction.rightTendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
      hrightCluster
      (hasDerivWithin_rightTendsto hf)
      (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
        (RealFunction.RightDomain E x0) RealTheory.zero x0)
      (rightEventually_dq_nonpos_of_localMaximum hmax)
  have hzero_le_A : F.le F.zero A := by
    apply RealFunction.leftTendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
      hleftCluster
      (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
        (RealFunction.LeftDomain E x0) RealTheory.zero x0)
      (hasDerivWithin_leftTendsto hf)
      (leftEventually_dq_nonneg_of_localMaximum hmax)
  exact F.le_antisymm hA_le_zero hzero_le_A

name: localMinimum_neg_localMaximum
statement:
theorem localMinimum_neg_localMaximum
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hmin : LocalMinimumAt E f x0) :
    LocalMaximumAt E (RealFunction.NegFun f) x0
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hmin.left ?_
  cases hmin.right with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      unfold RealFunction.NegFun
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd)

name: fermat_localMinimum
statement:
theorem fermat_localMinimum
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hleftCluster : RealFunction.LeftClusterPoint E x0)
    (hrightCluster : RealFunction.RightClusterPoint E x0)
    (hmin : LocalMinimumAt E f x0)
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A) :
    A = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hneg :
      HasDerivWithin E (RealFunction.NegFun f) x0 (F.neg A) :=
    hasDerivWithin_neg hf
  have hzero :
      F.neg A = F.zero :=
    fermat_localMaximum hleftCluster hrightCluster
      (localMinimum_neg_localMaximum hmin) hneg
  have h := congrArg F.neg hzero
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F A,
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
  exact h

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum
    {E : Domain} {term term' : Nat -> Map} :
    forall n : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        HasDerivativeWithinOn E (term k) (term' k)) ->
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k x) n)
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term' k x) n)
  | 0, _ => by
      change HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
      exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_const E RealTheory.zero
  | n + 1, h => by
      have hprev :
          HasDerivativeWithinOn E
            (fun x : Point =>
              RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k x) n)
            (fun x : Point =>
              RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term' k x) n)
proof:
:=
        hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum n
          (fun k hk => h k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))
      have hlast : HasDerivativeWithinOn E (term n) (term' n) :=
        h n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
      change HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (RealFunction.AddFun
          (fun x : Point =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k x) n)
          (term n))
        (RealFunction.AddFun
          (fun x : Point =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term' k x) n)
          (term' n))
      exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_add hprev hlast

name: hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_mono
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_mono
    {a b c d : Point} {F g : Map}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (_hcd : RealTheory.le c d)
    (hdb : RealTheory.le d b)
    (hDeriv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b F g) :
    HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval c d F g
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval at hDeriv
  unfold HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
  unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn at hDeriv
  unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn
  exact RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
    (fun x hx =>
      And.intro
        (And.intro
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hac hx.left.left)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C hx.left.right hdb))
        (fun hlarge =>
          hx.right
            (And.intro hx.left
              (tendstoWithin_of_subset
                (fun y hy =>
                  And.intro
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hac hy.left)
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C hy.right hdb))
                hlarge.right))))
    hDeriv

name: hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_congr
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_congr
    {a b : Point} {F G g h : Map}
    (hFG : RealFunction.SameOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) F G)
    (hgh :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x -> g x = h x)
    (hF : HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b F g) :
    HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b G h
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval at hF
  unfold HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
  exact
    RealNegligibility.almostEverywhereOn_mono
      (fun x hx hderiv => by
        have hG :
            HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) G x (g x) :=
          hasDerivWithin_congr hFG hderiv
        rw [<- hgh x hx]
        exact hG)
      hF

name: hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_congr_representative
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_congr_representative
    {a b : Point} {F g h : Map}

      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x -> g x = h x)
    (hF : HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b F g) :
    HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b F h
proof:
:=
  hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_congr
    (RealFunction.sameOn_refl (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) F)
    hgh hF

name: powerDerivativeStep_sameOn
statement:
private theorem powerDerivativeStep_sameOn
    (E : Domain) (n : Nat) :
    RealFunction.SameOn E
      (RealFunction.AddFun
        (RealFunction.MulFun (PowerDerivative n) (fun x : Point => x))
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (RealFunction.PowerFun n)
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)))
      (PowerDerivative (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      unfold PowerDerivative
      unfold RealFunction.AddFun
      unfold RealFunction.MulFun
      unfold ConstMulFun
      unfold RealFunction.PowerFun
      change
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero x)
          (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 1)
          (RealFunction.powNat x 0)
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
      rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
      rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
      change RealTheory.one =
        RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one RealTheory.one
      rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
  | succ n =>
      unfold PowerDerivative
      unfold RealFunction.AddFun
      unfold RealFunction.MulFun
      unfold ConstMulFun
      unfold RealFunction.PowerFun
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
      rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
      let p := RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x n) x
      change
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) p)
          p =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1 + 1)) p
      calc
        RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) p) p =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) p)
              (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one p) := by
              rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
        _ =
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) RealTheory.one)
              p := by
              exact Eq.symm
                (RealTheory.add_mul
                  (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) RealTheory.one p)
        _ =
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1 + 1)) p := by
              change
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.add
                    (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
                    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one)
                  p =
                RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat ((n + 1) + 1)) p
              exact congrArg (fun z : Point => RealTheory.mul z p)
                (Eq.symm (RealTheory.nat_succ (n + 1)))

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_powerFun
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_powerFun
    (E : Domain) :
    forall n : Nat,
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (RealFunction.PowerFun n)
        (PowerDerivative n)
  | 0 => by
      rw [RealFunction.powerFun_zero]
      unfold PowerDerivative
      exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_const E RealTheory.one
  | n + 1 => by
      have hprev
proof:
:= hasDerivativeWithinOn_powerFun E n
      have hid := hasDerivativeWithinOn_id E
      rw [RealFunction.powerFun_succ]
      apply hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
        (powerDerivativeStep_sameOn E n)
      exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_mul hprev hid

name: inverseOn_differenceQuotient_eq_inv_comp
statement:
private theorem inverseOn_differenceQuotient_eq_inv_comp
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 y : Point}
    (hinj : RealFunction.InjectiveOn E f)
    (hx0 : E x0)
    (hy : RealFunction.Image E f y)
    (hyne : Not (y = f x0)) :
    DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) (f x0) y =
      RealFunction.InvFun
        (RealFunction.CompFun (DifferenceQuotient f x0)
          (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)) y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let g := RealFunction.InverseOn E f
  let x := g y
  have hy0 : RealFunction.Image E f (f x0) :=
    RealFunction.image_intro hx0
  have hg_y0 : g (f x0) = x0 :=
    RealFunction.inverseOn_image_self hinj hx0
  have hfx : f x = y := by
    unfold x g
    exact RealFunction.inverseOn_value hy
  have hx_ne : Not (x = x0) := by
    intro hx
    have hy_eq : y = f x0 := by
      rw [<- hfx, hx]
    exact hyne hy_eq
  have hdx_ne : Not (F.sub x x0 = F.zero) := by
    intro hdx
    exact hx_ne (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hdx)
  have hdy_ne : Not (F.sub y (f x0) = F.zero) := by
    intro hdy
    exact hyne (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hdy)
  unfold DifferenceQuotient RealFunction.InvFun RealFunction.CompFun
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (g y) (g (f x0))) (F.inv (F.sub y (f x0))) =
      F.inv
        (F.mul (F.sub (f (g y)) (f x0))
          (F.inv (F.sub (g y) x0)))
  rw [hg_y0]
  change
    F.mul (F.sub x x0) (F.inv (F.sub y (f x0))) =
      F.inv
        (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0))
          (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
  rw [hfx]
  exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul_inv_right F
    (a := F.sub y (f x0)) (b := F.sub x x0) hdy_ne hdx_ne)

name: inverseOn_hasDerivWithin_at_image_of_continuousAt
statement:
theorem inverseOn_hasDerivWithin_at_image_of_continuousAt
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hinj : RealFunction.InjectiveOn E f)
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A)
    (hA : Not (A = RealTheory.zero))
    (hinvCont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) (f x0)) :
    HasDerivWithin (RealFunction.Image E f)
      (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) (f x0) (RealTheory.inv A)
proof:
:= by
  let g := RealFunction.InverseOn E f
  have hx0 : E x0 := hf.left
  have hy0 : RealFunction.Image E f (f x0) :=
    RealFunction.image_intro hx0
  have hg_y0 : g (f x0) = x0 :=
    RealFunction.inverseOn_image_self hinj hx0
  have hinvTendsto :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin (RealFunction.Image E f) g
        (f x0) x0 := by
    apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (L := g (f x0)) (M := x0)
    · exact hg_y0
    · exact hinvCont.right
  have hcomp :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.CompFun (DifferenceQuotient f x0) g)
        (f x0) A := by
    apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_comp_tendstoWithin
      hinvTendsto hf.right
    · intro y hy hyne
      exact RealFunction.inverseOn_mem hy
    · intro y hy hyne
      intro hg_eq
      have hy_eq : y = f x0 := by
        have hfy : f (g y) = y :=
          RealFunction.inverseOn_value hy
        rw [hg_eq] at hfy
        exact Eq.symm hfy
      exact hyne hy_eq
  have hinvDQ :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InvFun
          (RealFunction.CompFun (DifferenceQuotient f x0) g))
        (f x0) (RealTheory.inv A) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_inv hcomp hA
  refine And.intro hy0 ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_eventually
    (f :=
      RealFunction.InvFun
        (RealFunction.CompFun (DifferenceQuotient f x0) g))
    (g := DifferenceQuotient g (f x0))
  · apply RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_of_forall
    intro y hy hyne
    symm
    exact inverseOn_differenceQuotient_eq_inv_comp
      hinj hx0 hy hyne
  · exact hinvDQ

name: inverseOn_hasDerivWithin_at_image_of_compact_injective
statement:
theorem inverseOn_hasDerivWithin_at_image_of_compact_injective
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hcompact : RealTheory.IsCompact.{0} E)
    (hfcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn E f)

      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) :=
    RealFunction.inverseOn_continuousOn_of_compact hcompact hfcont hinj
  exact inverseOn_hasDerivWithin_at_image_of_continuousAt
    hinj hf hA (hinvContOn (f x0) (RealFunction.image_intro hf.left))

name: inverseOn_hasDerivWithin_at_image_of_closedInterval_injective

name: closedInterval_left_endpoint

private theorem closedInterval_left_endpoint

:= by

  exact And.intro (F.le_refl a)

name: segment_endpoint_le_of_derivative_nonnegative
statement:
private theorem segment_endpoint_le_of_derivative_nonnegative
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hseg : DerivativeNonnegativeSegmentData a b f) :
    RealTheory.le (f a) (f b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hmono :
      RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f :=
    monotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonnegative
      hseg.right.left hseg.right.right.left hseg.right.right.right
  exact hmono a b
    (closedInterval_left_endpoint hseg.left)
    (closedInterval_right_endpoint hseg.left)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hseg.left)

name: closedSubinterval_subset_openInterval
statement:
private theorem closedSubinterval_subset_openInterval
    {a b x y : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y) :
    forall z : Point,
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b z
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro z hz
  exact And.intro
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hx.left hz.left)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hz.right hy.right)

name: openSubinterval_subset_openInterval

private theorem openSubinterval_subset_openInterval

    forall z : Point,
      RealTheory.OpenInterval x y z ->
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b z
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  exact closedSubinterval_subset_openInterval hx hy z

name: continuousOn_closedSubinterval
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_closedSubinterval
    {a b x y : Point} {f : Map}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y)
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b f) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y) f
proof:
:= by
  let hsub := closedSubinterval_subset_openInterval hx hy
  intro z hz
  cases hdiff z (hsub z hz) with
  | intro A hA =>
      exact hasDerivWithin_continuousAtOn
        (hasDerivWithin_subset hsub hz hA)

name: differentiableOn_openSubinterval
statement:
private theorem differentiableOn_openSubinterval
    {a b x y : Point} {f : Map}

    (hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b f) :
    DifferentiableOnOpenInterval x y f
proof:
:= by
  let hsub := openSubinterval_subset_openInterval hx hy
  intro z hz
  cases hdiff z (hsub z hz) with
  | intro A hA =>
      exact Exists.intro A (hasDerivWithin_subset hsub hz hA)

name: derivativeNonnegativeOn_openSubinterval
statement:
private theorem derivativeNonnegativeOn_openSubinterval
    {a b x y : Point} {f : Map}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y)
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b f)
    (hsign : DerivativeNonnegativeOnOpenInterval a b f) :
    DerivativeNonnegativeOnOpenInterval x y f
proof:
:= by
  let hsub := openSubinterval_subset_openInterval hx hy
  intro z A hz hA
  have hzBig := hsub z hz
  cases hdiff z hzBig with
  | intro B hB =>
      have hBsmall := hasDerivWithin_subset hsub hz hB
      have hAB : A = B :=
        hasDerivWithin_unique (openInterval_clusterPoint hz) hA hBsmall
      rw [hAB]
      exact hsign z B hzBig hB

name: monotoneOn_openInterval_of_derivative_nonnegative
statement:
private theorem monotoneOn_openInterval_of_derivative_nonnegative
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b f)
    (hsign : DerivativeNonnegativeOnOpenInterval a b f) :
    RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hEq : x = y
  · rw [hEq]
    exact F.le_refl (f y)
  · have hnot_yx : Not (F.le y x) := by
      intro hyx
      exact hEq (F.le_antisymm hxy hyx)
    have hxy_lt : F.lt x y :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hnot_yx
    exact segment_endpoint_le_of_derivative_nonnegative
      (And.intro hxy_lt
        (And.intro
          (continuousOn_closedSubinterval hx hy hdiff)
          (And.intro
            (differentiableOn_openSubinterval hx hy hdiff)
            (derivativeNonnegativeOn_openSubinterval
              hx hy hdiff hsign))))

name: strictMonotoneOn_openInterval_of_derivative_positive
statement:
private theorem strictMonotoneOn_openInterval_of_derivative_positive
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b f)
    (hsign : DerivativePositiveOnOpenInterval a b f) :
    RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  exact segment_endpoint_lt_of_derivative_positive
    (And.intro hxy
      (And.intro
        (continuousOn_closedSubinterval hx hy hdiff)
        (And.intro
          (differentiableOn_openSubinterval hx hy hdiff)
          (derivativePositiveOn_openSubinterval hx hy hdiff hsign))))

name: decreasingOn_openInterval_of_derivative_nonpositive
statement:
private theorem decreasingOn_openInterval_of_derivative_nonpositive
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b f)
    (hsign : DerivativeNonpositiveOnOpenInterval a b f) :
    RealFunction.DecreasingOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hEq : x = y
  · rw [hEq]
    exact F.le_refl (f y)
  · have hnot_yx : Not (F.le y x) := by
      intro hyx
      exact hEq (F.le_antisymm hxy hyx)
    have hxy_lt : F.lt x y :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hnot_yx
    exact segment_endpoint_ge_of_derivative_nonpositive
      (And.intro hxy_lt
        (And.intro
          (continuousOn_closedSubinterval hx hy hdiff)
          (And.intro
            (differentiableOn_openSubinterval hx hy hdiff)
            (derivativeNonpositiveOn_openSubinterval
              hx hy hdiff hsign))))

    RealFunction.StrictDecreasingOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  exact segment_endpoint_gt_of_derivative_negative
    (And.intro hxy
      (And.intro
        (continuousOn_closedSubinterval hx hy hdiff)
        (And.intro
          (differentiableOn_openSubinterval hx hy hdiff)
          (derivativeNegativeOn_openSubinterval hx hy hdiff hsign))))

proof:
:= by

  · have hnot_yx : Not (F.le y x) := by

name: left_endpoint_le_of_monotoneOn
statement:
private theorem left_endpoint_le_of_monotoneOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {a x0 b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt a x0)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt x0 b)
    (hsub : forall y : Point, RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y -> E y)
    (hcont : RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn E f x0)
    (hmono : RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a x0) f)
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a x0 x) :
    RealTheory.le (f x) (f x0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let G := RealFunction.LeftDomain (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x0
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
    (openInterval_leftClusterPoint (And.intro ha hb))
    (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const G (f x) x0)
    (tendstoWithin_of_subset
      (fun y hy => hsub y hy.left) hcont.right)
  let delta := F.sub x0 x
  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
  refine And.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx.right) ?_
  intro y hy _ hdist
  have hxy : F.lt x y := by
    have hclose := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hdist
    have hcollapse : F.sub x0 delta = x := by
      unfold delta
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F x0 x
    rwa [hcollapse] at hclose
  exact hmono x y hx (And.intro hy.left.left hy.right)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxy)

name: right_endpoint_ge_of_monotoneOn
statement:
private theorem right_endpoint_ge_of_monotoneOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {a x0 b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt a x0)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt x0 b)
    (hsub : forall y : Point, RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y -> E y)
    (hcont : RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn E f x0)
    (hmono : RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval x0 b) f)
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval x0 b x) :
    RealTheory.le (f x0) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let G := RealFunction.RightDomain (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x0
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
    (openInterval_rightClusterPoint (And.intro ha hb))
    (tendstoWithin_of_subset
      (fun y hy => hsub y hy.left) hcont.right)
    (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const G (f x) x0)
  let delta := F.sub x x0
  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
  refine And.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx.left) ?_
  intro y hy _ hdist
  have hyx : F.lt y x := by
    have hclose := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hdist
    have hcollapse : F.add x0 delta = x := by
      unfold delta
      calc
        F.add x0 (F.sub x x0) = F.add (F.sub x x0) x0 := by
          rw [F.add_comm]
        _ = x := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x x0
    rwa [hcollapse] at hclose
  exact hmono y x (And.intro hy.right hy.left.right) hx
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hyx)

    And.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx.left hxm) hmx0

    (hstrict x m hx hm hxm)
    (left_endpoint_le_of_monotoneOn ha hb hsub hcont
      (RealFunction.strictMonotoneOn_monotoneOn hstrict) hm)

proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let delta := F.sub x0 a

name: sub_eq_add_sub_add_right
statement:
private theorem sub_eq_add_sub_add_right
    (x a b : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub x a =
      RealTheory.add b (RealTheory.sub x (RealTheory.add a b))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.sub x a = F.add b (F.sub x (F.add a b))
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_right_cancel F (a := a)
  calc
    F.add (F.sub x a) a = x := by
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x a
    _ = F.add (F.add b (F.sub x (F.add a b))) a := by
      symm
      calc
        F.add (F.add b (F.sub x (F.add a b))) a =
            F.add b (F.add (F.sub x (F.add a b)) a) := by
              rw [F.add_assoc]
        _ = F.add b (F.add a (F.sub x (F.add a b))) := by
              rw [F.add_comm (F.sub x (F.add a b)) a]
        _ = F.add (F.add b a) (F.sub x (F.add a b)) := by
              rw [<- F.add_assoc]
        _ = F.add (F.add a b) (F.sub x (F.add a b)) := by
              rw [F.add_comm b a]
        _ = F.add (F.sub x (F.add a b)) (F.add a b) := by
              rw [F.add_comm (F.add a b) (F.sub x (F.add a b))]
        _ = x := by
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x (F.add a b)

name: lt_of_sub_lt_zero
statement:
private theorem lt_of_sub_lt_zero
    {x y : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x y) RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.lt x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt (F.sub x y) F.zero at h
  change F.lt x y
  have h' := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F h y
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x y, F.zero_add] at h'

name: TaylorRemainderRatio_two_mul_pow
statement:
private theorem TaylorRemainderRatio_two_mul_pow
    {D : Nat -> Map} {f : Map} {x0 h : Point}
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 2 h)
        (RealFunction.powNat h 2) =
      TaylorRemainder D f x0 2 h
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpow :
      Not (RealFunction.powNat h 2 = RealTheory.zero) :=
    TaylorRemainderRatio_denominator_ne_zero hh 2
  unfold TaylorRemainderRatio
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (TaylorRemainder D f x0 2 h)
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h 2)))
        (RealFunction.powNat h 2) =
      TaylorRemainder D f x0 2 h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right F
    (TaylorRemainder D f x0 2 h) hpow

name: taylorCoeff_one_term_zero
statement:
private theorem taylorCoeff_one_term_zero
    {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 h : Point}
    (hD1 : D 1 x0 = RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.mul (TaylorCoeff D x0 1) h = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorCoeff
  rw [hD1]
  rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]

name: TaylorPolynomial_two_critical
statement:
private theorem TaylorPolynomial_two_critical
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 h : Point}
    (hT : TaylorPeanoAt E f D x0 2)
    (hD1 : D 1 x0 = RealTheory.zero) :
    TaylorPolynomial D x0 2 h =
      RealTheory.add
        (f x0)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (TaylorCoeff D x0 2)
          (RealFunction.powNat h 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hD0 : D 0 x0 = f x0 :=
    hT.left.right.left x0 hT.left.left
  rw [TaylorPolynomial_two]
  rw [hD0]
  rw [taylorCoeff_one_term_zero (hD1 := hD1)]
  rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

name: secondOrderTaylor_sub_center_eq
statement:
private theorem secondOrderTaylor_sub_center_eq
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 h : Point}
    (hT : TaylorPeanoAt E f D x0 2)
    (hD1 : D 1 x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.sub (f (RealTheory.add x0 h)) (f x0) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add
          (TaylorCoeff D x0 2)
          (TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 2 h))
        (RealFunction.powNat h 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := RealFunction.powNat h 2
  let c := TaylorCoeff D x0 2
  let r := TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 2 h
  have hpoly :
      TaylorPolynomial D x0 2 h =
        F.add (f x0) (F.mul c p) := by
    unfold c p
    exact TaylorPolynomial_two_critical hT hD1
  have hratio :
      F.mul r p = TaylorRemainder D f x0 2 h := by
    unfold r p
    exact TaylorRemainderRatio_two_mul_pow
      (D := D) (f := f) (x0 := x0) (h := h) hh
  change
    F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0) =
      F.mul (F.add c r) p
  calc
    F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0) =
        F.add (F.mul c p)
          (F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (F.add (f x0) (F.mul c p))) := by
          exact sub_eq_add_sub_add_right
            (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0) (F.mul c p)
    _ = F.add (F.mul c p) (TaylorRemainder D f x0 2 h) := by
          unfold TaylorRemainder IncrementLift IncrementMap
          rw [hpoly]
          rfl
    _ = F.add (F.mul c p) (F.mul r p) := by
          rw [<- hratio]
    _ = F.mul (F.add c r) p := by
          rw [F.add_mul]

name: eventuallyIncrement_strictMin_of_taylorPeano_two_pos
statement:
private theorem eventuallyIncrement_strictMin_of_taylorPeano_two_pos
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hT : TaylorPeanoAt E f D x0 2)
    (hD1 : D 1 x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hc : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (TaylorCoeff D x0 2)) :
    RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
      (IncrementDomain E x0)
      RealTheory.zero
      (fun h : Point =>
        RealTheory.lt (f x0) (f (RealTheory.add x0 h)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let c := TaylorCoeff D x0 2
  let r := TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 2
  have hnegc_lt_zero : F.lt (F.neg c) F.zero := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hc
    change F.lt (F.neg c) (F.neg F.zero) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
  have hr_event :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        RealTheory.zero
        (fun h : Point => F.lt (F.neg c) (r h)) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_eventually_lt_of_limit_lt
      hT.right hnegc_lt_zero
  cases hr_event with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro h hhDomain hh hdist
      have hrh := hdelta.right h hhDomain hh hdist
      let p := RealFunction.powNat h 2
      have hsum_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.add c (r h)) := by
        have h' := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hrh c
        rwa [F.add_neg] at h'
      have hp_pos : F.lt F.zero p := by
        unfold p
        exact RealFunction.powNat_two_pos_of_ne_zero hh
      have hprod_pos :
          F.lt F.zero (F.mul (F.add c (r h)) p) :=
        F.mul_pos hsum_pos hp_pos
      have hdiff :
          F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0) =
            F.mul (F.add c (r h)) p := by
        unfold c r p
        exact secondOrderTaylor_sub_center_eq hT hD1 hh
      have hdiff_pos :
          F.lt F.zero (F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0)) := by
        rwa [hdiff]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F hdiff_pos

name: eventuallyIncrement_strictMax_of_taylorPeano_two_neg
statement:
private theorem eventuallyIncrement_strictMax_of_taylorPeano_two_neg
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hT : TaylorPeanoAt E f D x0 2)
    (hD1 : D 1 x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hc : RealTheory.lt (TaylorCoeff D x0 2) RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
      (IncrementDomain E x0)
      RealTheory.zero
      (fun h : Point =>
        RealTheory.lt (f (RealTheory.add x0 h)) (f x0))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let c := TaylorCoeff D x0 2
  let r := TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 2
  have hzero_lt_negc : F.lt F.zero (F.neg c) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hc
    change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg c) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
  have hr_event :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        RealTheory.zero
        (fun h : Point => F.lt (r h) (F.neg c)) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_eventually_lt_of_lt_limit
      hT.right hzero_lt_negc
  cases hr_event with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro h hhDomain hh hdist
      have hrh := hdelta.right h hhDomain hh hdist
      let p := RealFunction.powNat h 2
      have hsum_neg : F.lt (F.add c (r h)) F.zero := by
        have h' := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hrh c
        rwa [F.add_neg] at h'
      have hp_pos : F.lt F.zero p := by
        unfold p
        exact RealFunction.powNat_two_pos_of_ne_zero hh
      have hprod_neg :
          F.lt (F.mul (F.add c (r h)) p) F.zero := by
        have hmul :=
          F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hsum_neg hp_pos
        rwa [F.zero_mul] at hmul
      have hdiff :
          F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0) =
            F.mul (F.add c (r h)) p := by
        unfold c r p
        exact secondOrderTaylor_sub_center_eq hT hD1 hh
      have hdiff_neg :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.sub (f (RealTheory.add x0 h)) (f x0))
            RealTheory.zero := by
        change F.lt (F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0)) F.zero
        rwa [hdiff]
      exact lt_of_sub_lt_zero hdiff_neg

name: eventuallyWithin_of_incrementDomain_eventually
statement:
private theorem eventuallyWithin_of_incrementDomain_eventually
    {E : Domain} {x0 : Point} {P : Point -> Prop}
    (hP :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        RealTheory.zero
        (fun h : Point => P (RealTheory.add x0 h))) :
    RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E x0 P
proof:
:= by
  cases hP with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hdist
      let h := RealTheory.sub x x0
      have hhDomain : IncrementDomain E x0 h := by
        unfold h
        unfold IncrementDomain
        rw [add_sub_center x0 x]
        exact hx
      have hhne : Not (h = RealTheory.zero) := by
        unfold h
        exact subCenterMap_ne_zero_of_ne_center hxne
      have hdist' : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist h RealTheory.zero) delta := by
        unfold h
        rwa [dist_subCenter_zero x0 x]
      have hp := hdelta.right h hhDomain hhne hdist'
      unfold h at hp
      change P (RealTheory.add x0 (RealTheory.sub x x0)) at hp
      rwa [add_sub_center x0 x] at hp

name: localStrictMinimumAt_of_taylorPeano_two_pos
statement:
theorem localStrictMinimumAt_of_taylorPeano_two_pos
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hT : TaylorPeanoAt E f D x0 2)

proof:

name: localStrictMaximumAt_of_taylorPeano_two_neg
statement:

name: TaylorTerm_eq_zero_of_value_zero

name: finiteSum_taylorTerm_firstNonzero_prefix
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_taylorTerm_firstNonzero_prefix
    {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 h : Point} :
    forall m : Nat,
      0 < m ->
        D 0 x0 = f x0 ->
          FirstNonzeroDerivativeHyp D x0 m ->
            RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat => TaylorTerm D x0 k h)
                m =
              f x0
  | 0, hm, _hD0, _hzero => by
      exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hm)
  | 1, _hm, hD0, _hzero => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
      rw [TaylorTerm_zero_eq_value]
      exact hD0
  | n + 2, _hm, hD0, hzero => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      have hprefix :
          RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat => TaylorTerm D x0 k h)
              (n + 1) =
            f x0
proof:
:= by
        exact finiteSum_taylorTerm_firstNonzero_prefix
          (m := n + 1)
          (Nat.succ_pos n)
          hD0
          (fun k hk1 hk =>
            hzero k hk1 (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1))))
      have hlast :
          TaylorTerm D x0 (n + 1) h = RealTheory.zero := by
        exact TaylorTerm_eq_zero_of_value_zero
          (hzero (n + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n))
            (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1)))
      rw [hprefix, hlast]
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

name: TaylorPolynomial_firstNonzero
statement:
private theorem TaylorPolynomial_firstNonzero
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 h : Point} {m : Nat}
    (hT : TaylorPeanoAt E f D x0 m)
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (hzero : FirstNonzeroDerivativeHyp D x0 m) :
    TaylorPolynomial D x0 m h =
      RealTheory.add
        (f x0)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (TaylorCoeff D x0 m)
          (RealFunction.powNat h m))
proof:
:= by
  have hD0 : D 0 x0 = f x0 :=
    hT.left.right.left x0 hT.left.left
  unfold TaylorPolynomial
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
  rw [finiteSum_taylorTerm_firstNonzero_prefix
    (m := m) hm hD0 hzero]
  unfold TaylorTerm
  rfl

name: TaylorRemainderRatio_mul_pow
statement:
private theorem TaylorRemainderRatio_mul_pow
    {D : Nat -> Map} {f : Map} {x0 h : Point} {m : Nat}
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 m h)
        (RealFunction.powNat h m) =
      TaylorRemainder D f x0 m h
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpow :
      Not (RealFunction.powNat h m = RealTheory.zero) :=
    TaylorRemainderRatio_denominator_ne_zero hh m
  unfold TaylorRemainderRatio
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (TaylorRemainder D f x0 m h)
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h m)))
        (RealFunction.powNat h m) =
      TaylorRemainder D f x0 m h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right F
    (TaylorRemainder D f x0 m h) hpow

name: firstNonzeroTaylor_sub_center_eq
statement:
private theorem firstNonzeroTaylor_sub_center_eq
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 h : Point} {m : Nat}
    (hT : TaylorPeanoAt E f D x0 m)
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (hzero : FirstNonzeroDerivativeHyp D x0 m)
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.sub (f (RealTheory.add x0 h)) (f x0) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add
          (TaylorCoeff D x0 m)
          (TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 m h))
        (RealFunction.powNat h m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := RealFunction.powNat h m
  let c := TaylorCoeff D x0 m
  let r := TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 m h
  have hpoly :
      TaylorPolynomial D x0 m h =
        F.add (f x0) (F.mul c p) := by
    unfold c p
    exact TaylorPolynomial_firstNonzero hT hm hzero
  have hratio :
      F.mul r p = TaylorRemainder D f x0 m h := by
    unfold r p
    exact TaylorRemainderRatio_mul_pow
      (D := D) (f := f) (x0 := x0) (h := h) (m := m) hh
  change
    F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0) =
      F.mul (F.add c r) p
  calc
    F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0) =
        F.add (F.mul c p)
          (F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (F.add (f x0) (F.mul c p))) := by
          exact sub_eq_add_sub_add_right
            (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0) (F.mul c p)
    _ = F.add (F.mul c p) (TaylorRemainder D f x0 m h) := by
          unfold TaylorRemainder IncrementLift IncrementMap
          rw [hpoly]
          rfl
    _ = F.add (F.mul c p) (F.mul r p) := by
          rw [<- hratio]
    _ = F.mul (F.add c r) p := by
          rw [F.add_mul]

name: sub_lt_zero_of_lt
statement:
private theorem sub_lt_zero_of_lt
    {x y : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x y) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt (F.sub x y) F.zero
  have h' := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F hxy (F.neg y)
  change F.lt (F.add x (F.neg y)) (F.add y (F.neg y)) at h'
  rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg x y, F.add_neg] at h'

name: mul_pos_neg_lt_zero
statement:
private theorem mul_pos_neg_lt_zero
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt b RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul a b) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt F.zero a at ha
  change F.lt b F.zero at hb
  change F.lt (F.mul a b) F.zero
  have hmul := F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hb ha
  rwa [F.mul_zero] at hmul

name: mul_neg_neg_pos
statement:
private theorem mul_neg_neg_pos
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt a RealTheory.zero)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt b RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt a F.zero at ha
  change F.lt b F.zero at hb
  change F.lt F.zero (F.mul a b)
  have hapos : F.lt F.zero (F.neg a) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F ha
    change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg a) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
  have hbpos : F.lt F.zero (F.neg b) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hb
    change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg b) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
  have hprod : F.lt F.zero (F.mul (F.neg a) (F.neg b)) :=
    F.mul_pos hapos hbpos
  rwa [F.neg_mul_neg] at hprod

name: eventuallyIncrement_strictMin_of_taylorPeano_firstNonzero_even_pos
statement:
private theorem eventuallyIncrement_strictMin_of_taylorPeano_firstNonzero_even_pos
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point} {n : Nat}

  let c := TaylorCoeff D x0 m

      have hdiff_pos :
          F.lt F.zero (F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0)) := by
        rwa [hdiff]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F hdiff_pos

name: eventuallyIncrement_strictMax_of_taylorPeano_firstNonzero_even_neg

  cases hr_event with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro h hhDomain hh hdist
      have hrh := hdelta.right h hhDomain hh hdist
      let p := RealFunction.powNat h m
      have hsum_neg : F.lt (F.add c (r h)) F.zero := by
