statement:
theorem localStrictCrossingIncreasingWithinAt_of_taylorPeano_firstNonzero_odd_pos
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hT : TaylorPeanoAt E f D x0 (n + n + 1))
    (hzero : FirstNonzeroDerivativeHyp D x0 (n + n + 1))
    (hDm : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (D (n + n + 1) x0)) :
    LocalStrictCrossingIncreasingWithinAt E f x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let m := n + n + 1
  let c := TaylorCoeff D x0 m
  let r := TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 m
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    unfold m
    omega
  have hc : F.lt F.zero c := by
    unfold c m
    exact TaylorCoeff_pos_of_value_pos hDm
  have hnegc_lt_zero : F.lt (F.neg c) F.zero := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hc
    change F.lt (F.neg c) (F.neg F.zero) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
  have hr_event :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        RealTheory.zero
        (fun h : Point => F.lt (F.neg c) (r h)) := by
    unfold c r m
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_eventually_lt_of_limit_lt
      hT.right hnegc_lt_zero
  cases hr_event with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine And.intro hT.left.left ?_
      refine And.intro ?left ?right
      · refine Exists.intro delta ?_
        refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
        intro x hxLeft hxne hdist
        let h := RealTheory.sub x x0
        have hhDomain : IncrementDomain E x0 h := by
          unfold h
          unfold IncrementDomain
          rw [add_sub_center x0 x]
          exact hxLeft.left
        have hhne : Not (h = RealTheory.zero) := by
          unfold h
          exact subCenterMap_ne_zero_of_ne_center hxne
        have hdist' :
            RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist h RealTheory.zero) delta := by
          unfold h
          rwa [dist_subCenter_zero x0 x]
        have hrh := hdelta.right h hhDomain hhne hdist'
        let p := RealFunction.powNat h m
        have hsum_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.add c (r h)) := by
          have h' := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hrh c
          rwa [F.add_neg] at h'
        have hh_neg : F.lt h F.zero := by
          unfold h
          exact sub_lt_zero_of_lt hxLeft.right
        have hp_neg : F.lt p F.zero := by
          unfold p m
          exact RealFunction.powNat_add_self_succ_neg_of_neg hh_neg
        have hprod_neg :
            F.lt (F.mul (F.add c (r h)) p) F.zero :=
          mul_pos_neg_lt_zero hsum_pos hp_neg
        have hdiff :
            F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0) =
              F.mul (F.add c (r h)) p := by
          unfold c r p m
          exact firstNonzeroTaylor_sub_center_eq hT hm hzero hhne
        have hdiff_neg :
            F.lt (F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0)) F.zero := by
          rwa [hdiff]
        have hdiff_x :
            RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f x0)) RealTheory.zero := by
          unfold h at hdiff_neg
          change
            F.lt
              (F.sub (f (F.add x0 (F.sub x x0))) (f x0))
              F.zero at hdiff_neg
          have hcenter : F.add x0 (F.sub x x0) = x := by
            change RealTheory.add x0 (RealTheory.sub x x0) = x
            exact add_sub_center x0 x
          rwa [hcenter] at hdiff_neg
        exact lt_of_sub_lt_zero hdiff_x
      · refine Exists.intro delta ?_
        refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
        intro x hxRight hxne hdist
        let h := RealTheory.sub x x0
        have hhDomain : IncrementDomain E x0 h := by
          unfold h
          unfold IncrementDomain
          rw [add_sub_center x0 x]
          exact hxRight.left
        have hhne : Not (h = RealTheory.zero) := by
          unfold h
          exact subCenterMap_ne_zero_of_ne_center hxne
        have hdist' :
            RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist h RealTheory.zero) delta := by
          unfold h
          rwa [dist_subCenter_zero x0 x]
        have hrh := hdelta.right h hhDomain hhne hdist'
        let p := RealFunction.powNat h m
        have hsum_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.add c (r h)) := by
          have h' := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hrh c
          rwa [F.add_neg] at h'
        have hh_pos : F.lt F.zero h := by
          unfold h
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxRight.right
        have hp_pos : F.lt F.zero p := by
          unfold p m
          exact RealFunction.powNat_add_self_succ_pos_of_pos hh_pos
        have hprod_pos :
            F.lt F.zero (F.mul (F.add c (r h)) p) :=
          F.mul_pos hsum_pos hp_pos
        have hdiff :
            F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0) =
              F.mul (F.add c (r h)) p := by
          unfold c r p m
          exact firstNonzeroTaylor_sub_center_eq hT hm hzero hhne
        have hdiff_pos :
            F.lt F.zero (F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0)) := by
          rwa [hdiff]
        have hdiff_x :
            RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
              (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f x0)) := by
          unfold h at hdiff_pos
          change
            F.lt F.zero
              (F.sub (f (F.add x0 (F.sub x x0))) (f x0))
              at hdiff_pos
          have hcenter : F.add x0 (F.sub x x0) = x := by
            change RealTheory.add x0 (RealTheory.sub x x0) = x
            exact add_sub_center x0 x
          rwa [hcenter] at hdiff_pos
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F hdiff_x

name: closedInterval_endpoint_or_open
statement:
theorem closedInterval_endpoint_or_open
    {a b x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) :
    Or (x = a) (Or (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x) (x = b))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxa : x = a
  · exact Or.inl hxa
  · by_cases hxb : x = b
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hxb)
    · have ha_x : F.lt a x := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx.left
        intro hxa_le
        have hax : a = x := F.le_antisymm hx.left hxa_le
        exact hxa hax.symm
      have hx_b : F.lt x b := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx.right
        intro hbx
        exact hxb (F.le_antisymm hx.right hbx)
      exact Or.inr (Or.inl (And.intro ha_x hx_b))

statement:
private theorem value_eq_left_of_endpoint
    {a b x : Point} {f : Map}

    (hx : Or (x = a) (x = b)) :
    f x = f a
proof:
:= by
  cases hx with
  | inl hxa =>
      rw [hxa]
  | inr hxb =>
      rw [hxb]
      exact hend.symm

name: constantOn_openInterval_of_closedIntervalExtremaAtEndpoints
statement:
theorem constantOn_openInterval_of_closedIntervalExtremaAtEndpoints
    {a b xmin xmax : Point} {f : Map}
    (hend : f a = f b)
    (hmin :
      RealFunction.HasMinimumOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f xmin)
    (hmax :
      RealFunction.HasMaximumOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f xmax)
    (hmin_endpoint : Or (xmin = a) (xmin = b))
    (hmax_endpoint : Or (xmax = a) (xmax = b)) :
    RealFunction.ConstantOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f (f a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x hx
  have hmin_le : RealTheory.le (f xmin) (f x) :=
    hmin.right x hxClosed
  have hx_le_max : RealTheory.le (f x) (f xmax) :=
    hmax.right x hxClosed
  have hmin_value : f xmin = f a :=
    value_eq_left_of_endpoint hend hmin_endpoint
  have hmax_value : f xmax = f a :=
    value_eq_left_of_endpoint hend hmax_endpoint
  have hfa_le_fx : RealTheory.le (f a) (f x) := by
    rwa [hmin_value] at hmin_le
  have hfx_le_fa : RealTheory.le (f x) (f a) := by
    rwa [hmax_value] at hx_le_max
  exact RealTheory.le_antisymm hfx_le_fa hfa_le_fx

name: hasDerivWithin_lagrangeAux
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_lagrangeAux
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {a b x0 A : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A) :
    HasDerivWithin E (LagrangeAux f a b) x0
      (RealTheory.sub A (SecantSlope f a b))
proof:
:= by
  let m := SecantSlope f a b
  have hid :
      HasDerivWithin E (fun x : Point => x) x0 RealTheory.one :=
    hasDerivWithin_id hf.left
  have hlin :
      HasDerivWithin E (ConstMulFun m (fun x : Point => x)) x0
        (RealTheory.mul m RealTheory.one) :=
    hasDerivWithin_constMul hid
  have hsub :
      HasDerivWithin E (LagrangeAux f a b) x0
        (RealTheory.sub A (RealTheory.mul m RealTheory.one)) := by
    unfold LagrangeAux
    exact hasDerivWithin_sub hf hlin
  refine And.intro hsub.left ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
    (M := RealTheory.sub A (SecantSlope f a b)) ?_ hsub.right
  unfold m
  rw [RealTheory.mul_one]

name: hasDerivWithin_cauchyAux

theorem hasDerivWithin_cauchyAux
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {a b x0 A B : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A)
    (hg : HasDerivWithin E g x0 B) :
    HasDerivWithin E (CauchyAux f g a b) x0
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (g b) (g a)) A)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)) B))
proof:
:= by
  have hfShift :
      HasDerivWithin E (SubConstFun f (f a)) x0 A :=
    hasDerivWithin_subConst hf
  have hgShift :
      HasDerivWithin E (SubConstFun g (g a)) x0 B :=
    hasDerivWithin_subConst hg
  have hleft :
      HasDerivWithin E
        (ConstMulFun (RealTheory.sub (g b) (g a))
          (SubConstFun f (f a))) x0
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (g b) (g a)) A) :=
    hasDerivWithin_constMul hfShift
  have hright :
      HasDerivWithin E
        (ConstMulFun (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))
          (SubConstFun g (g a))) x0
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)) B) :=
    hasDerivWithin_constMul hgShift
  unfold CauchyAux
  exact hasDerivWithin_sub hleft hright

name: cauchyAux_left_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem cauchyAux_left_eq_zero
    (f g : Map) (a b : Point) :
    CauchyAux f g a b a = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dg := F.sub (g b) (g a)
  let df := F.sub (f b) (f a)
  unfold CauchyAux SubConstFun RealFunction.SubFun ConstMulFun
  change F.sub (F.mul dg (F.sub (f a) (f a)))
      (F.mul df (F.sub (g a) (g a))) = F.zero
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F (f a)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F (g a)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_zero F dg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_zero F df]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.zero

name: cauchyAux_right_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem cauchyAux_right_eq_zero
    (f g : Map) (a b : Point) :
    CauchyAux f g a b b = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dg := F.sub (g b) (g a)
  let df := F.sub (f b) (f a)
  unfold CauchyAux SubConstFun RealFunction.SubFun ConstMulFun
  change F.sub (F.mul dg df) (F.mul df dg) = F.zero
  rw [F.mul_comm df dg]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F (F.mul dg df)

name: cauchyAux_endpoint_eq
statement:
theorem cauchyAux_endpoint_eq
    (f g : Map) (a b : Point) :
    CauchyAux f g a b a = CauchyAux f g a b b
proof:
:= by
  calc
    CauchyAux f g a b a = RealTheory.zero :=
      cauchyAux_left_eq_zero f g a b
    _ = CauchyAux f g a b b := by
      exact Eq.symm (cauchyAux_right_eq_zero f g a b)

name: secantSlope_mul_intervalLength
statement:
theorem secantSlope_mul_intervalLength
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b) :
    RealTheory.mul (SecantSlope f a b) (RealTheory.sub b a) =
      RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dy := F.sub (f b) (f a)
  let dx := F.sub b a
  have hdx_pos : F.lt F.zero dx := by
    unfold dx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hab
  have hdx_ne : Not (dx = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hdx_pos h.symm
  unfold SecantSlope
  change F.mul (F.mul dy (F.inv dx)) dx = dy
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul dy (F.inv dx)) dx =
        F.mul dy (F.mul (F.inv dx) dx) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul dy F.one := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hdx_ne]
    _ = dy := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: sub_add_eq_sub_sub
statement:
private theorem sub_add_eq_sub_sub
    (x y z : Point) :
    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub x y) z =
      RealTheory.sub x (RealTheory.sub y z)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.add (F.sub x y) z = F.sub x (F.sub y z)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_right_cancel F
    (a := F.sub y z)
  calc
    F.add (F.add (F.sub x y) z) (F.sub y z) =
        F.add (F.sub x y) (F.add z (F.sub y z)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.sub x y) (F.add (F.sub y z) z) := by
          rw [F.add_comm z (F.sub y z)]
    _ = F.add (F.sub x y) y := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y z]
    _ = x := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x y]
    _ = F.add (F.sub x (F.sub y z)) (F.sub y z) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x (F.sub y z)]

name: lagrangeAux_endpoint_eq
statement:
theorem lagrangeAux_endpoint_eq
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b) :
    LagrangeAux f a b a = LagrangeAux f a b b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let m := SecantSlope f a b
  have hm_len :
      F.mul m (F.sub b a) = F.sub (f b) (f a) := by
    unfold m
    exact secantSlope_mul_intervalLength (f := f) hab
  have hm_sub :
      F.sub (F.mul m b) (F.mul m a) =
        F.sub (f b) (f a) := by
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F m b a]
    exact hm_len
  unfold LagrangeAux RealFunction.SubFun ConstMulFun
  change F.sub (f a) (F.mul m a) =
    F.sub (f b) (F.mul m b)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_right_cancel F
    (a := F.mul m a)
  calc
    F.add (F.sub (f a) (F.mul m a)) (F.mul m a) =
        f a := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F (f a) (F.mul m a)]
    _ = F.sub (f b) (F.sub (f b) (f a)) := by
          exact Eq.symm
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F (f b) (f a))
    _ = F.sub (f b) (F.sub (F.mul m b) (F.mul m a)) := by
          rw [hm_sub]
    _ = F.add (F.sub (f b) (F.mul m b)) (F.mul m a) := by
          exact Eq.symm
            (sub_add_eq_sub_sub (f b) (F.mul m b) (F.mul m a))

name: openInterval_rightClusterPoint
statement:
theorem openInterval_rightClusterPoint
    {a b c : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b c) :
    RealFunction.RightClusterPoint (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) c
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let gap := F.sub b c
  have hgap : F.lt F.zero gap := by
    unfold gap
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hc.right
  let radius := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F gap eps
  have hradius_pos : F.lt F.zero radius :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hgap heps
  let theta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F radius
  have htheta_pos : F.lt F.zero theta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hradius_pos
  have htheta_lt_radius : F.lt theta radius :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hradius_pos
  have htheta_lt_gap : F.lt theta gap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htheta_lt_radius
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F gap eps)
  have htheta_lt_eps : F.lt theta eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htheta_lt_radius
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F gap eps)
  let x := F.add c theta
  have hc_x : F.lt c x := by
    unfold x
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F htheta_pos
  have hcgap : F.add c gap = b := by
    unfold gap
    calc
      F.add c (F.sub b c) =
          F.add (F.sub b c) c := by
            rw [F.add_comm]
      _ = b := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b c
  have hx_b : F.lt x b := by
    have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F htheta_lt_gap c
    change F.lt x (F.add c gap) at hadd
    rwa [hcgap] at hadd
  have ha_x : F.lt a x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hc.left hc_x
  have hleft_bound : F.lt (F.sub c eps) x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps) hc_x
  have hright_bound : F.lt x (F.add c eps) := by
    have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F htheta_lt_eps c
    change F.lt x (F.add c eps) at hadd
    exact hadd
  have hdist : F.lt (RealFunction.dist x c) eps := by
    unfold RealFunction.dist
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
      F hleft_bound hright_bound
  exact Exists.intro x
    (And.intro
      (And.intro (And.intro ha_x hx_b) hc_x)
      (And.intro
        (fun h => IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hc_x h.symm)
        hdist))

name: lagrangeConclusion_of_lagrangeAux_rolle
statement:
theorem lagrangeConclusion_of_lagrangeAux_rolle
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (haux : RolleConclusion a b (LagrangeAux f a b))
    (hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b f) :
    LagrangeConclusion a b f
proof:
:= by
  cases haux with
  | intro c hc =>
      cases hdiff c hc.left with
      | intro A hDeriv =>
          have hauxA :
              HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
                (LagrangeAux f a b) c
                (RealTheory.sub A (SecantSlope f a b)) :=
            hasDerivWithin_lagrangeAux hDeriv
          have hcluster :
              RealFunction.ClusterPoint (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) c := by
            intro eps heps
            cases openInterval_leftClusterPoint hc.left eps heps with
            | intro x hx =>
                exact Exists.intro x
                  (And.intro hx.left.left hx.right)
          have hzero :
              RealTheory.sub A (SecantSlope f a b) =
                RealTheory.zero :=
            hasDerivWithin_unique hcluster hauxA hc.right
          have hAeq :
              A = SecantSlope f a b :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hzero
          refine Exists.intro c ?_
          refine And.intro hc.left ?_
          rwa [hAeq] at hDeriv

name: cauchyConclusion_of_cauchyAux_rolle
statement:
theorem cauchyConclusion_of_cauchyAux_rolle
    {a b : Point} {f g : Map}
    (haux : RolleConclusion a b (CauchyAux f g a b))
    (hdiffF : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b f)
    (hdiffG : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b g) :
    CauchyConclusion a b f g
proof:
:= by
  cases haux with
  | intro c hc =>
      cases hdiffF c hc.left with
      | intro A hA =>
          cases hdiffG c hc.left with
          | intro B hB =>
              have hauxAB :
                  HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
                    (CauchyAux f g a b) c
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (RealTheory.mul
                        (RealTheory.sub (g b) (g a)) A)
                      (RealTheory.mul
                        (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)) B)) :=
                hasDerivWithin_cauchyAux hA hB
              have hcluster :
                  RealFunction.ClusterPoint
                    (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) c := by
                intro eps heps
                cases openInterval_leftClusterPoint hc.left eps heps with
                | intro x hx =>
                    exact Exists.intro x
                      (And.intro hx.left.left hx.right)
              have hzero :
                  RealTheory.sub
                      (RealTheory.mul
                        (RealTheory.sub (g b) (g a)) A)
                      (RealTheory.mul
                        (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)) B) =
                    RealTheory.zero :=
                hasDerivWithin_unique hcluster hauxAB hc.right
              have hEq :
                  RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (g b) (g a)) A =
                    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)) B :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hzero
              refine Exists.intro c ?_
              refine And.intro hc.left ?_
              refine Exists.intro A ?_
              refine Exists.intro B ?_
              exact And.intro hA (And.intro hB hEq)

name: rolleConclusion_of_localMaximum
statement:
theorem rolleConclusion_of_localMaximum
    {a b c A : Point} {f : Map}
    (hc : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b c)
    (hleftCluster :
      RealFunction.LeftClusterPoint (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) c)
    (hrightCluster :
      RealFunction.RightClusterPoint (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) c)
    (hmax : LocalMaximumAt (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f c)
    (hf : HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f c A) :
    RolleConclusion a b f
proof:
:= by
  have hA :
      A = RealTheory.zero :=
    fermat_localMaximum hleftCluster hrightCluster hmax hf
  refine Exists.intro c ?_
  refine And.intro hc ?_
  rwa [hA] at hf

name: rolleConclusion_of_localMinimum
statement:
theorem rolleConclusion_of_localMinimum
    {a b c A : Point} {f : Map}

name: rolleConclusion_of_openIntervalLocalMaximum
statement:
theorem rolleConclusion_of_openIntervalLocalMaximum
    {a b c A : Point} {f : Map}
    (hc : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b c)

statement:

statement:
theorem localMaximumAt_openInterval_of_closedIntervalMaximum

name: rolle_theorem
statement: theorem rolle_theorem : RolleTheoremStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f hab hfcont hend hdiff
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleab : RealTheory.le a b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab
  have hext :
      And
        (RealFunction.AttainsMinimumOn
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
        (RealFunction.AttainsMaximumOn
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_closedInterval_attainsExtrema hleab hfcont
  cases hext.left with
  | intro xmin hmin =>
      cases hext.right with
      | intro xmax hmax =>
          let finish_constant
              (hmin_endpoint : Or (xmin = a) (xmin = b))
              (hmax_endpoint : Or (xmax = a) (xmax = b)) :
              RolleConclusion a b f := by
            let c := IntervalMidpoint a b
            have hc : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b c :=
              intervalMidpoint_mem_open hab
            have hconst :
                RealFunction.ConstantOn
                  (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f (f a) :=
              constantOn_openInterval_of_closedIntervalExtremaAtEndpoints
                hend hmin hmax hmin_endpoint hmax_endpoint
            refine Exists.intro c ?_
            refine And.intro hc ?_
            exact hasDerivWithin_constantOn hc hconst
          cases closedInterval_endpoint_or_open hmax.left with
          | inl hmax_left =>
              cases closedInterval_endpoint_or_open hmin.left with
              | inl hmin_left =>
                  exact finish_constant
                    (Or.inl hmin_left) (Or.inl hmax_left)
              | inr hmin_cases =>
                  cases hmin_cases with
                  | inl hmin_open =>
                      cases hdiff xmin hmin_open with
                      | intro A hA =>
                          exact
                            rolleConclusion_of_closedIntervalMinimumAtInterior
                              hmin_open hmin hA
                  | inr hmin_right =>
                      exact finish_constant
                        (Or.inr hmin_right) (Or.inl hmax_left)
          | inr hmax_cases =>
              cases hmax_cases with
              | inl hmax_open =>
                  cases hdiff xmax hmax_open with
                  | intro A hA =>
                      exact
                        rolleConclusion_of_closedIntervalMaximumAtInterior
                          hmax_open hmax hA
              | inr hmax_right =>
                  cases closedInterval_endpoint_or_open hmin.left with
                  | inl hmin_left =>
                      exact finish_constant
                        (Or.inl hmin_left) (Or.inr hmax_right)
                  | inr hmin_cases =>
                      cases hmin_cases with
                      | inl hmin_open =>
                          cases hdiff xmin hmin_open with
                          | intro A hA =>
                              exact
                                rolleConclusion_of_closedIntervalMinimumAtInterior
                                  hmin_open hmin hA
                      | inr hmin_right =>
                          exact finish_constant
                            (Or.inr hmin_right) (Or.inr hmax_right)

name: lagrange_mean_value_theorem
statement:
theorem lagrange_mean_value_theorem :
    LagrangeMeanValueTheoremStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f hab hfcont hdiff
  have hauxCont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (LagrangeAux f a b) :=
    continuousOn_lagrangeAux hfcont
  have hauxEnd :
      LagrangeAux f a b a = LagrangeAux f a b b :=
    lagrangeAux_endpoint_eq hab
  have hauxDiff :
      DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b (LagrangeAux f a b) := by
    intro x hx
    cases hdiff x hx with
    | intro A hA =>
        exact Exists.intro
          (RealTheory.sub A (SecantSlope f a b))
          (hasDerivWithin_lagrangeAux hA)
  have hauxRolle :
      RolleConclusion a b (LagrangeAux f a b) :=
    rolle_theorem a b (LagrangeAux f a b)
      hab hauxCont hauxEnd hauxDiff
  exact lagrangeConclusion_of_lagrangeAux_rolle hauxRolle hdiff

name: cauchy_mean_value_theorem
statement:
theorem cauchy_mean_value_theorem :
    CauchyMeanValueTheoremStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f g hab hfcont hgcont hdiffF hdiffG
  have hauxCont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (CauchyAux f g a b) :=
    continuousOn_cauchyAux hfcont hgcont
  have hauxEnd :
      CauchyAux f g a b a = CauchyAux f g a b b :=
    cauchyAux_endpoint_eq f g a b
  have hauxDiff :
      DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b (CauchyAux f g a b) := by
    intro x hx
    cases hdiffF x hx with
    | intro A hA =>
        cases hdiffG x hx with
        | intro B hB =>
            exact Exists.intro
              (RealTheory.sub
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.sub (g b) (g a)) A)
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)) B))
              (hasDerivWithin_cauchyAux hA hB)
  have hauxRolle :
      RolleConclusion a b (CauchyAux f g a b) :=
    rolle_theorem a b (CauchyAux f g a b)
      hab hauxCont hauxEnd hauxDiff
  exact cauchyConclusion_of_cauchyAux_rolle
    hauxRolle hdiffF hdiffG

name: finiteIncrementBound_of_derivativeAbsBound
statement:
theorem finiteIncrementBound_of_derivativeAbsBound :
    FiniteIncrementBoundStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro a b M f hab hfcont hdiff hbound
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases lagrange_mean_value_theorem a b f hab hfcont hdiff with
  | intro c hc =>
      let m := SecantSlope f a b
      have hmDeriv :
          HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f c m := by
        unfold m
        exact hc.right
      have hm_le : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs m) M :=
        hbound c m hc.left hmDeriv
      have hlen_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b a)) :=
        RealTheory.abs_nonneg (RealTheory.sub b a)
      have hmul_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs m)
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b a)))
            (RealTheory.mul M
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b a))) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hm_le hlen_nonneg
      have hsec :
          RealTheory.mul m (RealTheory.sub b a) =
            RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a) := by
        unfold m
        exact secantSlope_mul_intervalLength (f := f) hab
      have hleft_eq :
          RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)) =
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs m)
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b a)) := by
        have hsecSymm :
            RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a) =
              RealTheory.mul m (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
          Eq.symm hsec
        rw [hsecSymm]
        exact RealTheory.abs_mul m (RealTheory.sub b a)
      rw [hleft_eq]
      exact hmul_le

name: finiteIncrementBound_of_derivativeAbsSup
statement:
theorem finiteIncrementBound_of_derivativeAbsSup :
    FiniteIncrementSupBoundStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro a b M f hab hfcont hdiff hsup
  apply finiteIncrementBound_of_derivativeAbsBound
    a b M f hab hfcont hdiff
  intro c A hc hA
  exact hsup.left
    (RealTheory.abs A)
    (Exists.intro c
      (Exists.intro A
        (And.intro hc (And.intro hA rfl))))

name: cauchyDerivativeEquality_of_cauchyConclusion
statement:
theorem cauchyDerivativeEquality_of_cauchyConclusion
    {a b : Point} {f g f' g' : Map}
    (hC : CauchyConclusion a b f g)
    (hf : HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f f')
    (hg : HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) g g') :
    Exists
      (fun c : Point =>
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b c /\
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (g b) (g a)) (f' c) =
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)) (g' c))
proof:
:= by
  cases hC with
  | intro c hc =>
      cases hc.right with
      | intro A hA =>
          cases hA with
          | intro B hB =>
              have hcluster :
                  RealFunction.ClusterPoint
                    (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) c := by
                intro eps heps
                cases openInterval_leftClusterPoint hc.left eps heps with
                | intro x hx =>
                    exact Exists.intro x
                      (And.intro hx.left.left
                        (And.intro hx.right.left hx.right.right))
              have hAeq : A = f' c :=
                hasDerivWithin_unique hcluster hB.left (hf c hc.left)
              have hBeq : B = g' c :=
                hasDerivWithin_unique hcluster hB.right.left (hg c hc.left)
              refine Exists.intro c ?_
              refine And.intro hc.left ?_
              rw [<- hAeq, <- hBeq]
              exact hB.right.right

name: continuousOn_constMul
statement:
theorem continuousOn_constMul
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {c : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn E f) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn E (ConstMulFun c f)
proof:
:= by
  apply RealFunction.continuousOn_congr
    (E := E)
    (f := RealFunction.MulFun (fun _ : Point => c) f)
    (g := ConstMulFun c f)
  · intro x hx
    rfl
  · exact RealFunction.continuousOn_mul
      RealFunction.continuousOn_const hf

name: differenceQuotient_add_eq
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_add_eq
    (f g : Map) (x0 x : Point) :
    DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.AddFun f g) x0 x =
      RealTheory.add
        (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
        (DifferenceQuotient g x0 x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient RealFunction.AddFun
  change
    F.mul
      (F.sub (F.add (f x) (g x)) (F.add (f x0) (g x0)))
      (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) =
    F.add
      (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
      (F.mul (F.sub (g x) (g x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F]
  rw [F.add_mul]

name: hasDerivWithin_add
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_add
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 A B : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A)
    (hg : HasDerivWithin E g x0 B) :
    HasDerivWithin E (RealFunction.AddFun f g) x0
      (RealTheory.add A B)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  have hlim :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_add hf.right hg.right
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := RealFunction.AddFun
      (DifferenceQuotient f x0) (DifferenceQuotient g x0))
    (g := DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.AddFun f g) x0)
  · intro x hx hxne
    unfold RealFunction.AddFun
    symm
    exact differenceQuotient_add_eq f g x0 x
  · exact hlim

name: differenceQuotient_neg_eq
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_neg_eq
    (f : Map) (x0 x : Point) :
    DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.NegFun f) x0 x =
      RealTheory.neg (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient RealFunction.NegFun
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (F.neg (f x)) (F.neg (f x0)))
      (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) =
    F.neg
      (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F]

name: differenceQuotient_sub_eq
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_sub_eq
    (f g : Map) (x0 x : Point) :
    DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.SubFun f g) x0 x =
      RealTheory.sub
        (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
        (DifferenceQuotient g x0 x)
proof:
:= by
  change
    DifferenceQuotient
        (RealFunction.AddFun f (RealFunction.NegFun g)) x0 x =
      RealTheory.sub
        (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
        (DifferenceQuotient g x0 x)
  rw [differenceQuotient_add_eq]
  rw [differenceQuotient_neg_eq]
  rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]

name: differenceQuotient_swap_eq
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_swap_eq
    {f : Map} {x y : Point}
    (hyx : Not (y = x)) :
    DifferenceQuotient f x y = DifferenceQuotient f y x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (f y) (f x)) (F.inv (F.sub y x)) =
      F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f y)) (F.inv (F.sub x y))
  have hden_ne : Not (F.sub y x = F.zero) := by
    intro hden
    have hy_eq_x : y = x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hden
    exact hyx hy_eq_x
  have hnum :
      F.sub (f x) (f y) =
        F.neg (F.sub (f y) (f x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f y) (f x)
  have hden :
      F.sub x y = F.neg (F.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F y x
  have hinv :
      F.inv (F.neg (F.sub y x)) =
        F.neg (F.inv (F.sub y x)) := by
    change
      RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg (F.sub y x)) =
        RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.inv (F.sub y x))
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_neg_of_ne_zero F hden_ne
  rw [hnum, hden, hinv]
  exact Eq.symm
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F
      (F.sub (f y) (f x)) (F.inv (F.sub y x)))

name: hasDerivWithin_neg
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_neg
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A) :
    HasDerivWithin E (RealFunction.NegFun f) x0
      (RealTheory.neg A)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  have hlim := RealFunction.tendstoWithin_neg hf.right
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := RealFunction.NegFun (DifferenceQuotient f x0))
    (g := DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.NegFun f) x0)
  · intro x hx hxne
    unfold RealFunction.NegFun
    symm
    exact differenceQuotient_neg_eq f x0 x
  · exact hlim

name: hasDerivWithin_sub
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_sub
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 A B : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A)
    (hg : HasDerivWithin E g x0 B) :
    HasDerivWithin E (RealFunction.SubFun f g) x0
      (RealTheory.sub A B)
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    hasDerivWithin_add hf (hasDerivWithin_neg hg)
  refine And.intro h.left ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := DifferenceQuotient
      (RealFunction.AddFun f (RealFunction.NegFun g)) x0)
    (g := DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.SubFun f g) x0)
  · intro x hx hxne
    unfold DifferenceQuotient RealFunction.AddFun
      RealFunction.NegFun RealFunction.SubFun
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg (f x) (g x)]
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg (f x0) (g x0)]
  · apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (M := RealTheory.sub A B) ?_ h.right
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg A B]

name: differenceQuotient_constMul_eq
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_constMul_eq
    (c : Point) (f : Map) (x0 x : Point) :
    DifferenceQuotient (ConstMulFun c f) x0 x =
      RealTheory.mul c (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient ConstMulFun
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (F.mul c (f x)) (F.mul c (f x0)))
      (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) =
    F.mul c
      (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F c (f x) (f x0)]
  rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: hasDerivWithin_constMul
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_constMul
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A c : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A) :
    HasDerivWithin E (ConstMulFun c f) x0
      (RealTheory.mul c A)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  have hlim :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul
      (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const E c x0) hf.right
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := RealFunction.MulFun
      (fun _ : Point => c) (DifferenceQuotient f x0))
    (g := DifferenceQuotient (ConstMulFun c f) x0)
  · intro x hx hxne
    unfold RealFunction.MulFun
    symm
    exact differenceQuotient_constMul_eq c f x0 x
  · exact hlim

name: differenceQuotient_mul_eq
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_mul_eq
    {f g : Map} {x0 x : Point} :
    DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.MulFun f g) x0 x =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x) (g x))
        (RealTheory.mul (f x0) (DifferenceQuotient g x0 x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient RealFunction.MulFun
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (F.mul (f x) (g x)) (F.mul (f x0) (g x0)))
      (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) =
    F.add
      (F.mul
        (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
        (g x))
      (F.mul (f x0)
        (F.mul (F.sub (g x) (g x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0))))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub F]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  congr 1
  · calc
      F.mul (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (g x))
          (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) =
          F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0))
            (F.mul (g x) (F.inv (F.sub x x0))) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0))
            (F.mul (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) (g x)) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (g x) (F.inv (F.sub x x0))]
      _ = F.mul
            (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
            (g x) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
  · rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: hasDerivWithin_mul
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_mul
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 A B : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A)
    (hg : HasDerivWithin E g x0 B) :
    HasDerivWithin E (RealFunction.MulFun f g) x0
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul A (g x0))
        (RealTheory.mul (f x0) B))
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  have hgCont : RealFunction.TendstoWithin E g x0 (g x0) :=
    (hasDerivWithin_continuousAtOn hg).right
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x) (g x))
        x0 (RealTheory.mul A (g x0)) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hf.right hgCont
  have hright :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul (f x0) (DifferenceQuotient g x0 x))
        x0 (RealTheory.mul (f x0) B) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul
      (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const E (f x0) x0) hg.right
  have hsum :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_add hleft hright
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := RealFunction.AddFun
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x) (g x))
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul (f x0) (DifferenceQuotient g x0 x)))
    (g := DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.MulFun f g) x0)
  · intro x hx hxne
    unfold RealFunction.AddFun
    symm
    exact differenceQuotient_mul_eq
  · exact hsum

name: differenceQuotient_inv_eq
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_inv_eq
    {f : Map} {x0 x : Point}
    (hx : Not (f x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hx0 : Not (f x0 = RealTheory.zero)) :
    DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.InvFun f) x0 x =
      RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
            (RealTheory.inv (f x)))
          (RealTheory.inv (f x0)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient RealFunction.InvFun
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (F.inv (f x)) (F.inv (f x0)))
      (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) =
    F.neg
      (F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)))
          (F.inv (f x)))
        (F.inv (f x0)))
  have hinvsub :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_sub_inv_eq_neg_sub_mul_inv_mul_inv
      F hx hx0
  change
    F.sub (F.inv (f x)) (F.inv (f x0)) =
      F.neg
        (F.mul (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (f x)))
          (F.inv (f x0))) at hinvsub
  rw [hinvsub]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F]
  congr 1
  let a := F.sub (f x) (f x0)
  let b := F.inv (F.sub x x0)
  let c := F.inv (f x)
  let d := F.inv (f x0)
  change F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a c) d) b =
    F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a b) c) d
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a c) d) b =
        F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul d b) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d) := by
        rw [F.mul_comm d b]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a c) b) d := by
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc (F.mul a c) b d]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul b (F.mul a c)) d := by
        rw [F.mul_comm (F.mul a c) b]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul b a) c) d := by
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc b a c]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a b) c) d := by
        rw [F.mul_comm b a]

name: hasDerivWithin_inv
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_inv
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A)
    (hx0 : Not (f x0 = RealTheory.zero)) :
    HasDerivWithin E (RealFunction.InvFun f) x0
      (RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv (f x0)))
          (RealTheory.inv (f x0))))
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  have hfcont : RealFunction.TendstoWithin E f x0 (f x0) :=
    (hasDerivWithin_continuousAtOn hf).right
  have hinv :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E (RealFunction.InvFun f) x0
        (RealTheory.inv (f x0)) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_inv hfcont hx0
  have hprod1 :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (RealFunction.MulFun (DifferenceQuotient f x0)
          (RealFunction.InvFun f))
        x0
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv (f x0))) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hf.right hinv
  have hprod2 :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (RealFunction.MulFun (DifferenceQuotient f x0)
            (RealFunction.InvFun f))
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.inv (f x0)))
        x0
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv (f x0)))
          (RealTheory.inv (f x0))) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hprod1
      (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const E (RealTheory.inv (f x0)) x0)
  have hneg := RealFunction.tendstoWithin_neg hprod2
  have hnonzero :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E x0
        (fun x => Not (f x = RealTheory.zero)) :=
    eventuallyWithin_ne_zero_of_tendsto_ne_zero hfcont hx0
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_eventually
    (f :=
      RealFunction.NegFun
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (RealFunction.MulFun (DifferenceQuotient f x0)
            (RealFunction.InvFun f))
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.inv (f x0))))
    (g := DifferenceQuotient (RealFunction.InvFun f) x0)
  · apply RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_mono
      (P := fun x => Not (f x = RealTheory.zero))
    · intro x hxnezero
      unfold RealFunction.NegFun RealFunction.MulFun
      symm
      exact differenceQuotient_inv_eq hxnezero hx0
    · exact hnonzero
  · exact hneg

name: hasDerivWithin_div
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_div
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 A B : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A)
    (hg : HasDerivWithin E g x0 B)
    (hg0 : Not (g x0 = RealTheory.zero)) :
    HasDerivWithin E (RealFunction.DivFun f g) x0
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv (g x0)))
        (RealTheory.mul (f x0)
          (RealTheory.neg
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul B (RealTheory.inv (g x0)))
              (RealTheory.inv (g x0))))))
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    hasDerivWithin_mul hf (hasDerivWithin_inv hg hg0)
  exact h

name: openInterval_leftClusterPoint
statement:
theorem openInterval_leftClusterPoint
    {a b c : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b c) :
    RealFunction.LeftClusterPoint (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) c
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let gap := F.sub c a
  have hgap : F.lt F.zero gap := by
    unfold gap
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hc.left
  let radius := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F gap eps
  have hradius_pos : F.lt F.zero radius :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hgap heps
  let theta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F radius
  have htheta_pos : F.lt F.zero theta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hradius_pos
  have htheta_lt_radius : F.lt theta radius :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hradius_pos
  have htheta_lt_gap : F.lt theta gap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htheta_lt_radius
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F gap eps)
  have htheta_lt_eps : F.lt theta eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htheta_lt_radius
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F gap eps)
  let x := F.sub c theta
  have hcgap : F.sub c gap = a := by
    unfold gap
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F c a
  have ha_x : F.lt a x := by
    have hsub :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt
        F (a := theta) (b := gap) (c := c) htheta_lt_gap
    change F.lt (F.sub c gap) x at hsub
    rwa [hcgap] at hsub
  have hx_c : F.lt x c := by
    unfold x
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F htheta_pos
  have hx_b : F.lt x b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx_c hc.right
  have hleft_bound : F.lt (F.sub c eps) x := by
    have hsub :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt
        F (a := theta) (b := eps) (c := c) htheta_lt_eps
    change F.lt (F.sub c eps) x at hsub
    exact hsub
  have hright_bound : F.lt x (F.add c eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx_c
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F heps)
  have hdist : F.lt (RealFunction.dist x c) eps := by
    unfold RealFunction.dist
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
      F hleft_bound hright_bound
  exact Exists.intro x
    (And.intro
      (And.intro (And.intro ha_x hx_b) hx_c)
      (And.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx_c) hdist))

name: hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_comp_exists
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_comp_exists
    {E K : Domain} {f g : Map}
    {Df Dg : Nat -> Map} {n : Nat}
    (hf : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn K f Df n)
    (hg : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E g Dg n)
    (hmap : RealFunction.MapsInto E K g) :
    Exists
      (fun Dfg : Nat -> Map =>
        HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E
          (RealFunction.CompFun f g) Dfg n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing f g Df Dg with
  | zero =>
      refine Exists.intro
        (fun _ : Nat => RealFunction.CompFun f g) ?_
      exact And.intro
        (RealFunction.sameOn_refl E (RealFunction.CompFun f g))
        (fun k hk => False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk))
  | succ n ih =>
      have hgPrefix :
          HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E g Dg n :=
        hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_of_le (Nat.le_succ n) hg
      have hfShift :
          HasDerivativeChainWithinOn K (Df 1)
            (DerivativeChainShift Df) n :=
        hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_shift hf
      have hgShift :
          HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E (Dg 1)
            (DerivativeChainShift Dg) n :=
        hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_shift hg
      cases ih
          (f := Df 1) (g := g)
          (Df := DerivativeChainShift Df) (Dg := Dg)
          hfShift hgPrefix hmap with
      | intro Douter hDouter =>
          let Dproduct : Nat -> Map :=
            fun k : Nat =>
              LeibnizProductFormula Douter
                (DerivativeChainShift Dg) k
          have hDproduct :
              HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E
                (RealFunction.MulFun
                  (RealFunction.CompFun (Df 1) g) (Dg 1))
                Dproduct n := by
            dsimp [Dproduct]
            exact hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_mul_leibniz
              hDouter hgShift
          have hfFirst :
              HasDerivativeWithinOn K f (Df 1) :=
            hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hf.left
              (hf.right 0 (Nat.zero_lt_succ n))
          have hgFirst :
              HasDerivativeWithinOn E g (Dg 1) :=
            hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hg.left
              (hg.right 0 (Nat.zero_lt_succ n))
          have hcompFirst :
              HasDerivativeWithinOn E
                (RealFunction.CompFun f g)
                (RealFunction.MulFun
                  (RealFunction.CompFun (Df 1) g) (Dg 1)) :=
            hasDerivativeWithinOn_comp hgFirst hfFirst hmap
          have hfirstRow :
              HasDerivativeWithinOn E
                (RealFunction.CompFun f g) (Dproduct 0) :=
            hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
              (fun x hx => (hDproduct.left x hx).symm)
              hcompFirst
          have hDproductSelf :
              HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E
                (Dproduct 0) Dproduct n :=
            And.intro
              (RealFunction.sameOn_refl E (Dproduct 0))
              hDproduct.right
          refine Exists.intro
            (PrependDerivativeChain
              (RealFunction.CompFun f g) Dproduct) ?_
          exact hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_prepend
            hfirstRow hDproductSelf

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_leibnizProductTerm
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_leibnizProductTerm
    {E : Domain} {Df Dg : Nat -> Map} {n k : Nat}
    (hf : HasDerivativeWithinOn E (Df k) (Df (k + 1)))
    (hg : HasDerivativeWithinOn E (Dg (n - k)) (Dg ((n - k) + 1))) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (LeibnizProductTerm Df Dg n k)
      (LeibnizProductStepTerm Df Dg n k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold LeibnizProductTerm
  unfold LeibnizProductStepTerm
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_mul hf hg)

name: leibnizProductStepTerm_apply_eq
statement:
private theorem leibnizProductStepTerm_apply_eq
    (Df Dg : Nat -> Map) (n k : Nat) (x : Point)
    (hk : k < n + 1) :
    LeibnizProductStepTerm Df Dg n k x =
      RealTheory.add
        (LeibnizProductLeftTerm Df Dg n k x)
        (LeibnizProductRightTerm Df Dg n k x)
proof:
:= by
  have hk_le : k <= n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hk
  have hright : n + 1 - k = n - k + 1 :=
    Nat.sub_add_comm hk_le
  unfold LeibnizProductStepTerm
  unfold ConstMulFun
  unfold RealFunction.AddFun
  unfold RealFunction.MulFun
  unfold LeibnizProductLeftTerm
  unfold LeibnizProductRightTerm
  unfold LeibnizProductCore
  rw [RealTheory.mul_add]
  rw [Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub]
  rw [hright]
  rfl

name: finiteSum_leftExtendTerm_apply
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_leftExtendTerm_apply
    (Df Dg : Nat -> Map) (n : Nat) (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductLeftExtendTerm Df Dg n k x)
      ((n + 1) + 1) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductLeftTerm Df Dg n k x)
        (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold LeibnizProductLeftExtendTerm
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat =>
        match k with
        | 0 => RealTheory.zero
        | j + 1 => LeibnizProductLeftTerm Df Dg n j x)
      ((n + 1) + 1) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductLeftTerm Df Dg n k x)
        (n + 1)
  exact
    RealTheory.finiteSum_prepend_zero
      (term := fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductLeftTerm Df Dg n k x)
      (n + 1)

name: finiteSum_rightTerm_append_zero_apply
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_rightTerm_append_zero_apply
    (Df Dg : Nat -> Map) (n : Nat) (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductRightTerm Df Dg n k x)
      ((n + 1) + 1) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductRightTerm Df Dg n k x)
        (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
  have hlast :
      LeibnizProductRightTerm Df Dg n (n + 1) x =
        RealTheory.zero := by
    unfold LeibnizProductRightTerm
    unfold ConstMulFun
    unfold LeibnizProductCore
    unfold RealFunction.MulFun
    rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_eq_zero_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]
    rw [RealTheory.nat_zero]
    change
      RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.mul (Df (n + 1) x)
            (Dg (n + 1 - (n + 1)) x)) =
        RealTheory.zero
    rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  rw [hlast]
  rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

name: leibnizProductPascalTerm_apply_eq
statement:
private theorem leibnizProductPascalTerm_apply_eq
    (Df Dg : Nat -> Map) (n k : Nat) (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
      (LeibnizProductLeftExtendTerm Df Dg n k x)
      (LeibnizProductRightTerm Df Dg n k x) =
      LeibnizProductTerm Df Dg (n + 1) k x
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      unfold LeibnizProductLeftExtendTerm
      unfold LeibnizProductRightTerm
      unfold LeibnizProductTerm
      unfold ConstMulFun
      unfold LeibnizProductCore
      unfold RealFunction.MulFun
      rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_zero n]
      rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_succ_zero n]
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  | succ k =>
      unfold LeibnizProductLeftExtendTerm
      unfold LeibnizProductLeftTerm
      unfold LeibnizProductRightTerm
      unfold LeibnizProductTerm
      unfold ConstMulFun
      unfold LeibnizProductCore
      unfold RealFunction.MulFun
      rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_succ_succ]
      rw [RealTheory.nat_add]
      change
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom n k))
            (RealTheory.mul (Df (k + 1) x)
              (Dg (n + 1 - (k + 1)) x)))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom n (k + 1)))
            (RealTheory.mul (Df (k + 1) x)
              (Dg (n + 1 - (k + 1)) x))) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom n k))
              (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom n (k + 1))))
            (RealTheory.mul (Df (k + 1) x)
              (Dg (n + 1 - (k + 1)) x))
      exact Eq.symm
        (RealTheory.add_mul
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom n k))
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom n (k + 1)))
          (RealTheory.mul (Df (k + 1) x)
            (Dg (n + 1 - (k + 1)) x)))

name: leibnizProductStepFormula_eq_succ
statement:
private theorem leibnizProductStepFormula_eq_succ
    (Df Dg : Nat -> Map) (n : Nat) :
    LeibnizProductStepFormula Df Dg n =
      LeibnizProductFormula Df Dg (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  unfold LeibnizProductStepFormula
  unfold LeibnizProductFormula
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductStepTerm Df Dg n k x)
        (n + 1) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.add
              (LeibnizProductLeftTerm Df Dg n k x)
              (LeibnizProductRightTerm Df Dg n k x))
          (n + 1) := by
          exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
            (n := n + 1)
            (fun k hk =>
              leibnizProductStepTerm_apply_eq Df Dg n k x hk)
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductLeftTerm Df Dg n k x)
            (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductRightTerm Df Dg n k x)
            (n + 1)) := by
          exact RealTheory.finiteSum_add
            (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductLeftTerm Df Dg n k x)
            (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductRightTerm Df Dg n k x)
            (n + 1)
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              LeibnizProductLeftExtendTerm Df Dg n k x)
            ((n + 1) + 1))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductRightTerm Df Dg n k x)
            ((n + 1) + 1)) := by
          rw [finiteSum_leftExtendTerm_apply]
          rw [finiteSum_rightTerm_append_zero_apply]
    _ =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.add
              (LeibnizProductLeftExtendTerm Df Dg n k x)
              (LeibnizProductRightTerm Df Dg n k x))
          ((n + 1) + 1) := by
          exact Eq.symm
            (RealTheory.finiteSum_add
              (fun k : Nat =>
                LeibnizProductLeftExtendTerm Df Dg n k x)
              (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductRightTerm Df Dg n k x)
              ((n + 1) + 1))
    _ =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductTerm Df Dg (n + 1) k x)
          ((n + 1) + 1) := by
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
          intro k
          exact leibnizProductPascalTerm_apply_eq Df Dg n k x

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_leibnizProductFormula_step
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_leibnizProductFormula_step
    {E : Domain} {Df Dg : Nat -> Map} {n : Nat}
    (hf : forall j : Nat, j < n + 1 ->
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E (Df j) (Df (j + 1)))
    (hg : forall j : Nat, j < n + 1 ->
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E (Dg j) (Dg (j + 1))) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (LeibnizProductFormula Df Dg n)
      (LeibnizProductStepFormula Df Dg n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold LeibnizProductFormula
  unfold LeibnizProductStepFormula
  apply hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum
  intro k hk
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_leibnizProductTerm
    (hf k hk)
    (hg (n - k)
      (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.sub_le n k)))

name: hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_mul_leibniz
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_mul_leibniz
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {Df Dg : Nat -> Map} {n : Nat}
    (hf : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f Df n)
    (hg : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E g Dg n) :
    HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E
      (RealFunction.MulFun f g)
      (fun k : Nat => LeibnizProductFormula Df Dg k) n
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx
    change
      LeibnizProductFormula Df Dg 0 x =
        RealFunction.MulFun f g x
    unfold LeibnizProductFormula
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
    unfold LeibnizProductTerm ConstMulFun LeibnizProductCore
    unfold RealFunction.MulFun
    rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_zero_zero]
    rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
    change
      RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (Df 0 x) (Dg (0 - 0) x)) =
        RealTheory.mul (f x) (g x)
    rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
    change
      RealTheory.mul (Df 0 x) (Dg 0 x) =
        RealTheory.mul (f x) (g x)
    rw [hf.left x hx, hg.left x hx]
  · intro k hk
    have hstep :
        HasDerivativeWithinOn E
          (LeibnizProductFormula Df Dg k)
          (LeibnizProductStepFormula Df Dg k) :=
      hasDerivativeWithinOn_leibnizProductFormula_step
        (fun j hj =>
          hf.right j
            (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hj) hk))
        (fun j hj =>
          hg.right j
            (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hj) hk))
    rw [leibnizProductStepFormula_eq_succ Df Dg k] at hstep
    exact hstep

name: isNthDerivativeWithinOn_mul_leibniz
statement:
theorem isNthDerivativeWithinOn_mul_leibniz
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {Df Dg : Nat -> Map}
    (hf : HasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn E f Df)
    (hg : HasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn E g Dg) :
    forall n : Nat,
      IsNthDerivativeWithinOn E n
        (RealFunction.MulFun f g)
        (LeibnizProductFormula Df Dg n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  exact isNthDerivativeWithinOn_of_derivativeChain n
    (hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_mul_leibniz
      (hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_of_sequence hf n)
      (hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_of_sequence hg n))

name: differentiableNTimesOn_mul_of_derivative_sequences
statement:
theorem differentiableNTimesOn_mul_of_derivative_sequences
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {Df Dg : Nat -> Map} {n : Nat}
    (hf : HasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn E f Df)
    (hg : HasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn E g Dg) :
    DifferentiableNTimesOn E n (RealFunction.MulFun f g)
proof:
:=
  Exists.intro (LeibnizProductFormula Df Dg n)
    (isNthDerivativeWithinOn_mul_leibniz hf hg n)

name: hasNthDerivWithin_mul_leibniz
statement:
theorem hasNthDerivWithin_mul_leibniz
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {Df Dg : Nat -> Map}
    {n : Nat} {x : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn E f Df)
    (hg : HasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn E g Dg)

    HasNthDerivWithin E n (RealFunction.MulFun f g) x
      (LeibnizProductFormula Df Dg n x)

:=
  hasNthDerivWithin_of_isNthDerivativeWithinOn
    (isNthDerivativeWithinOn_mul_leibniz hf hg n) hx

name: differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_right
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_right
    {f : Map} {x0 x : Point}
    (_hx : RealTheory.lt x0 x) :
    DifferenceQuotient f x0 x =
      RealFunction.SecantSlope f x0 x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_left
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_left
    {f : Map} {x0 x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt x x0) :
    DifferenceQuotient f x0 x =
      RealFunction.SecantSlope f x x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) =
      F.mul (F.sub (f x0) (f x)) (F.inv (F.sub x0 x))
  have hdx_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub x0 x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx
  have hdx_ne : Not (F.sub x0 x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hdx_pos) hzero.symm
  have hnum :
      F.sub (f x) (f x0) =
        F.neg (F.sub (f x0) (f x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f x0) (f x)
  have hden :
      F.sub x x0 = F.neg (F.sub x0 x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x0 x
  have hinv :
      F.inv (F.neg (F.sub x0 x)) =
        F.neg (F.inv (F.sub x0 x)) := by
    change
      RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg (F.sub x0 x)) =
        RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.inv (F.sub x0 x))
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_neg_of_ne_zero F hdx_ne
  rw [hnum, hden, hinv]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F
    (F.sub (f x0) (f x)) (F.inv (F.sub x0 x))

name: differenceQuotient_mono_left_of_convexOn
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_mono_left_of_convexOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x y x0 : Point}
    (hconv : RealFunction.ConvexOn E f)
    (hx : E x) (hx0 : E x0)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (hyx0 : RealTheory.lt y x0) :
    RealTheory.le
      (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
      (DifferenceQuotient f x0 y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxx0 : F.lt x x0 := F.lt_trans hxy hyx0
  rw [differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_left hxx0,
    differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_left hyx0]
  exact RealFunction.secantSlope_mono_fixed_right
    hconv hx hx0 hxy hyx0

name: differenceQuotient_mono_right_of_convexOn
statement:
theorem differenceQuotient_mono_right_of_convexOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 x y : Point}

    (hx0 : E x0) (hy : E y)
    (hx0x : RealTheory.lt x0 x)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
      (DifferenceQuotient f x0 y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hx0y : F.lt x0 y := F.lt_trans hx0x hxy
  rw [differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_right hx0x,
    differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_right hx0y]
  exact RealFunction.secantSlope_mono_fixed_left
    hconv hx0 hy hx0x hxy

name: leftDifferenceQuotient_lower_of_convexOn
statement:
theorem leftDifferenceQuotient_lower_of_convexOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {u x x0 : Point}
    (hconv : RealFunction.ConvexOn E f)
    (hu : E u) (hx0 : E x0)
    (hux : RealTheory.lt u x)
    (hxx0 : RealTheory.lt x x0) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealFunction.SecantSlope f u x0)
      (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_left hxx0]
  exact RealFunction.secantSlope_mono_fixed_right
    hconv hu hx0 hux hxx0

name: leftDifferenceQuotient_upper_of_convexOn
statement:
theorem leftDifferenceQuotient_upper_of_convexOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x x0 v : Point}
    (hconv : RealFunction.ConvexOn E f)
    (hx : E x) (hv : E v)
    (hxx0 : RealTheory.lt x x0)
    (hx0v : RealTheory.lt x0 v) :
    RealTheory.le
      (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
      (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x0 v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_left hxx0]
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x x0)
        (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x v) :=
    RealFunction.secantSlope_le_secantSlope_left
      hconv hx hv hxx0 hx0v
  have hright :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x v)
        (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x0 v) :=
    RealFunction.secantSlope_le_secantSlope_right
      hconv hx hv hxx0 hx0v
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hleft hright

name: rightDifferenceQuotient_lower_of_convexOn
statement:
theorem rightDifferenceQuotient_lower_of_convexOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {u x0 x : Point}
    (hconv : RealFunction.ConvexOn E f)
    (hu : E u) (hx : E x)
    (hux0 : RealTheory.lt u x0)
    (hx0x : RealTheory.lt x0 x) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealFunction.SecantSlope f u x0)
      (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_right hx0x]
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealFunction.SecantSlope f u x0)
        (RealFunction.SecantSlope f u x) :=
    RealFunction.secantSlope_le_secantSlope_left
      hconv hu hx hux0 hx0x
  have hright :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealFunction.SecantSlope f u x)
        (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x0 x) :=
    RealFunction.secantSlope_le_secantSlope_right
      hconv hu hx hux0 hx0x
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hleft hright

name: rightDifferenceQuotient_upper_of_convexOn
statement:
theorem rightDifferenceQuotient_upper_of_convexOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 x v : Point}
    (hconv : RealFunction.ConvexOn E f)
    (hx0 : E x0) (hv : E v)
    (hx0x : RealTheory.lt x0 x)
    (hxv : RealTheory.lt x v) :
    RealTheory.le
      (DifferenceQuotient f x0 x)
      (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x0 v)

name: convexOn_closedInterval_exists_hasLeftDerivWithin
statement:
theorem convexOn_closedInterval_exists_hasLeftDerivWithin
    {a b x0 : Point} {f : Map}
    (hconv : RealFunction.ConvexOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x0) :
    Exists
      (fun L : Point =>
        HasLeftDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x0 L)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Eopen := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  let Eclosed := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
  let q := DifferenceQuotient f x0
  have hab : F.le a b := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (F.lt_trans hx0.left hx0.right)
  have hx0Closed : Eclosed x0 :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x0 hx0
  have hbClosed : Eclosed b := RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab
  have hcluster :
      RealFunction.LeftClusterPoint Eopen x0 :=
    openInterval_leftClusterPoint hx0
  have hne : Exists (RealFunction.LeftValueSet Eopen q x0) :=
    RealFunction.leftValueSet_nonempty_of_leftCluster hcluster
  have hbdd :
      Exists
        (IsUpperBound F.le
          (RealFunction.LeftValueSet Eopen q x0)) := by
    refine Exists.intro (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x0 b) ?_
    intro y hy
    cases hy with
    | intro x hx =>
        have hxLeft : RealFunction.LeftDomain Eopen x0 x := hx.left
        have hxOpen : Eopen x := hxLeft.left
        have hxClosed : Eclosed x :=
          RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x hxOpen
        have hupper :
            F.le (q x) (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x0 b) :=
          leftDifferenceQuotient_upper_of_convexOn
            (E := Eclosed) (f := f) (x := x) (x0 := x0)
            (v := b) hconv hxClosed hbClosed hxLeft.right hx0.right
        rwa [<- hx.right]
  have hmonoLeft :
      forall x y : Point,
        RealFunction.LeftDomain Eopen x0 x ->
          RealFunction.LeftDomain Eopen x0 y ->
            F.le x y -> F.le (q x) (q y) := by
    intro x y hx hy hxy
    by_cases hEq : x = y
    · rw [hEq]
      exact F.le_refl (q y)
    · have hnot_yx : Not (F.le y x) := by
        intro hyx
        exact hEq (F.le_antisymm hxy hyx)
      have hxy_lt : F.lt x y :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hnot_yx
      have hxClosed : Eclosed x :=
        RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x hx.left
      exact
        differenceQuotient_mono_left_of_convexOn
          (E := Eclosed) (f := f) (x := x) (y := y)
          (x0 := x0) hconv hxClosed hx0Closed hxy_lt hy.right
  cases RealTheory.current_bootstrap_complete_ordered_field.exists_lub
      (RealFunction.LeftValueSet Eopen q x0) hne hbdd with
  | intro L hL =>
      refine Exists.intro L ?_
      refine And.intro hx0 ?_
      let Eleft := RealFunction.LeftDomain Eopen x0
      have hdomain : RealFunction.LeftDomain Eleft x0 = Eleft := by
        funext x
        apply propext
        constructor
        case mp =>
          intro hx
          exact hx.left
        case mpr =>
          intro hx
          exact And.intro hx hx.right
      have hmono' : RealFunction.MonotoneOn Eleft q := by
        intro x y hx hy hxy
        exact hmonoLeft x y hx hy hxy
      have hL' :
          IsLeastUpperBound F.le
            (RealFunction.LeftValueSet Eleft q x0) L := by
        change
          IsLeastUpperBound F.le
            (RealFunction.Image (RealFunction.LeftDomain Eleft x0) q) L
        rw [hdomain]
        exact hL
      have ht := RealFunction.leftValue_lub_is_leftLimit hmono' hL'
      change
        RealFunction.TendstoWithin
          (RealFunction.LeftDomain Eleft x0) q x0 L at ht
      rw [hdomain] at ht
      exact ht

name: convexOn_closedInterval_exists_hasRightDerivWithin
statement:
theorem convexOn_closedInterval_exists_hasRightDerivWithin
    {a b x0 : Point} {f : Map}

    (hx0 : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x0) :
    Exists
      (fun R : Point =>
        HasRightDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x0 R)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Eopen := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  let Eclosed := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
  let q := DifferenceQuotient f x0
  have hab : F.le a b := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (F.lt_trans hx0.left hx0.right)
  have hx0Closed : Eclosed x0 :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x0 hx0
  have haClosed : Eclosed a := RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab
  have hcluster :
      RealFunction.RightClusterPoint Eopen x0 :=
    openInterval_rightClusterPoint hx0
  have hne : Exists (RealFunction.RightValueSet Eopen q x0) :=
    RealFunction.rightValueSet_nonempty_of_rightCluster hcluster
  have hbdd :
      Exists
        (IsLowerBound F.le
          (RealFunction.RightValueSet Eopen q x0)) := by
    refine Exists.intro (RealFunction.SecantSlope f a x0) ?_
    intro y hy
    cases hy with
    | intro x hx =>
        have hxRight : RealFunction.RightDomain Eopen x0 x := hx.left
        have hxOpen : Eopen x := hxRight.left
        have hxClosed : Eclosed x :=
          RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x hxOpen
        have hlower :
            F.le (RealFunction.SecantSlope f a x0) (q x) :=
          rightDifferenceQuotient_lower_of_convexOn
            (E := Eclosed) (f := f) (u := a) (x0 := x0)
            (x := x) hconv haClosed hxClosed hx0.left hxRight.right
        rwa [<- hx.right]
  have hmonoRight :
      forall x y : Point,
        RealFunction.RightDomain Eopen x0 x ->
          RealFunction.RightDomain Eopen x0 y ->
            F.le x y -> F.le (q x) (q y) := by
    intro x y hx hy hxy
    by_cases hEq : x = y
    · rw [hEq]
      exact F.le_refl (q y)
    · have hnot_yx : Not (F.le y x) := by
        intro hyx
        exact hEq (F.le_antisymm hxy hyx)
      have hxy_lt : F.lt x y :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hnot_yx
      have hyClosed : Eclosed y :=
        RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b y hy.left
      exact
        differenceQuotient_mono_right_of_convexOn
          (E := Eclosed) (f := f) (x0 := x0) (x := x)
          (y := y) hconv hx0Closed hyClosed hx.right hxy_lt
  cases RealTheory.current_bootstrap_complete_ordered_field.exists_glb
      (RealFunction.RightValueSet Eopen q x0) hne hbdd with
  | intro R hR =>
      refine Exists.intro R ?_
      refine And.intro hx0 ?_
      let Eright := RealFunction.RightDomain Eopen x0
      have hdomain : RealFunction.RightDomain Eright x0 = Eright := by
        funext x
        apply propext
        constructor
        case mp =>
          intro hx
          exact hx.left
        case mpr =>
          intro hx
          exact And.intro hx hx.right
      have hmono' : RealFunction.MonotoneOn Eright q := by
        intro x y hx hy hxy
        exact hmonoRight x y hx hy hxy
      have hR' :
          IsGreatestLowerBound F.le
            (RealFunction.RightValueSet Eright q x0) R := by
        change
          IsGreatestLowerBound F.le
            (RealFunction.Image (RealFunction.RightDomain Eright x0) q) R
        rw [hdomain]
        exact hR
      have ht := RealFunction.rightValue_glb_is_rightLimit hmono' hR'
      change
        RealFunction.TendstoWithin
          (RealFunction.RightDomain Eright x0) q x0 R at ht
      rw [hdomain] at ht
      exact ht

name: hasRightDerivWithin_le_secantSlope_of_convexOn
statement:
theorem hasRightDerivWithin_le_secantSlope_of_convexOn
    {a b x y R : Point} {f : Map}
    (hconv : RealFunction.ConvexOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (hR :
      HasRightDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x R) :
    RealTheory.le R (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Eopen := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  let Eclosed := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
  let q := DifferenceQuotient f x
  have hxClosed : Eclosed x :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x hx
  apply RealFunction.rightTendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
    (openInterval_rightClusterPoint hx)
    hR.right
    (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
      (RealFunction.RightDomain Eopen x)
      (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x y) x)
  let delta := F.sub y x
  have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta := by
    unfold delta
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
  refine And.intro hdelta ?_
  intro t ht htne htd
  have htRight : RealFunction.RightDomain Eopen x t := ht
  have htClosed : Eclosed t :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b t htRight.left
  have hty : F.lt t y := by
    have hright_close : F.lt t (F.add x delta) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F htd
    have hcollapse : F.add x delta = y := by
      unfold delta
      calc
        F.add x (F.sub y x) =
            F.add (F.sub y x) x := by rw [F.add_comm]
        _ = y := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y x
    rwa [hcollapse] at hright_close
  rw [differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_right htRight.right]
  exact RealFunction.secantSlope_mono_fixed_left
    hconv hxClosed hy htRight.right hty

name: secantSlope_le_hasLeftDerivWithin_of_convexOn

theorem secantSlope_le_hasLeftDerivWithin_of_convexOn

    (hL :
      HasLeftDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f y L) :

proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Eopen := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  let Eclosed := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
  let q := DifferenceQuotient f y
  have hyClosed : Eclosed y :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b y hy
  apply RealFunction.leftTendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
    (openInterval_leftClusterPoint hy)
    (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
      (RealFunction.LeftDomain Eopen y)
      (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x y) y)
    hL.right
  let delta := F.sub y x
  have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta := by
    unfold delta
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
  refine And.intro hdelta ?_
  intro t ht htne htd
  have htLeft : RealFunction.LeftDomain Eopen y t := ht
  have htClosed : Eclosed t :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b t htLeft.left
  have hxt : F.lt x t := by
    have hleft_close : F.lt (F.sub y delta) t :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F htd
    have hcollapse : F.sub y delta = x := by
      unfold delta
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F y x
    rwa [hcollapse] at hleft_close
  rw [differenceQuotient_eq_secantSlope_left htLeft.right]
  exact RealFunction.secantSlope_mono_fixed_right
    hconv hx hyClosed hxt htLeft.right

name: supportLine_le_of_mul_sub_le_increment

private theorem supportLine_le_of_mul_sub_le_increment
    {x y D : Point} {f : Map}
    (hinc :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul D (RealTheory.sub y x))
        (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))) :

        (RealTheory.mul D (RealTheory.sub y x)))
      (f y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base

      F.le
        (F.sub (F.mul D (F.sub y x)) F.zero)

  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_of_sub_le_sub F hsub
  change
    F.le

theorem supportLine_le_of_convex_hasDerivWithin
    {a b x0 D y : Point} {f : Map}

  case pos =>
