    change
      F.le (F.add (f x0) (F.mul D (F.sub x0 x0))) (f x0)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F x0]
    rw [F.mul_zero]
    rw [F.add_zero]
    exact F.le_refl (f x0)
  case neg =>
    by_cases hx0y : F.lt x0 y
    case pos =>
      have hslope :
          F.le D (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x0 y) :=
        hasRightDerivWithin_le_secantSlope_of_convexOn
          (a := a) (b := b) (x := x0) (y := y) (R := D)
          (f := f) hconv hx0 hy hx0y
          (hasDerivWithin_hasRightDerivWithin hD)
      exact supportLine_le_of_le_secantSlope_right hx0y hslope
    case neg =>
      have hyx0_le : F.le y x0 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hx0y
      have hnot_x0_le_y : Not (F.le x0 y) := by
        intro hx0_le_y
        have hx0_eq_y : x0 = y := F.le_antisymm hx0_le_y hyx0_le
        exact hy_eq hx0_eq_y.symm
      have hyx0 : F.lt y x0 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
          F hyx0_le hnot_x0_le_y
      have hslope :
          F.le (RealFunction.SecantSlope f y x0) D :=
        secantSlope_le_hasLeftDerivWithin_of_convexOn
          (a := a) (b := b) (x := y) (y := x0) (L := D)
          (f := f) hconv hy hx0 hyx0
          (hasDerivWithin_hasLeftDerivWithin hD)
      exact supportLine_le_of_secantSlope_le_left hyx0 hslope

name: supportLine_zero_left
statement:
private theorem supportLine_zero_left
    (x y : Point) {f : Map} :
    RealTheory.add (f x)
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub y x)) =
      f x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.add (f x) (F.mul F.zero (F.sub y x)) = f x
  rw [F.zero_mul]
  rw [F.add_zero]

name: globalMinimum_of_convex_oneSidedDeriv_sign
statement:
theorem globalMinimum_of_convex_oneSidedDeriv_sign
    {a b x0 L R : Point} {f : Map}
    (hconv : RealFunction.ConvexOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x0)
    (hL : HasLeftDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x0 L)
    (hR : HasRightDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x0 R)
    (hLnonpos : RealTheory.le L RealTheory.zero)
    (hRnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero R) :
    RealFunction.HasMinimumOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro
    (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x0 hx0) ?_
  intro y hy
  by_cases hy_eq : y = x0
  case pos =>
    rw [hy_eq]
    exact F.le_refl (f x0)
  case neg =>
    by_cases hx0y : F.lt x0 y
    case pos =>
      have hR_le_slope :
          F.le R (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x0 y) :=
        hasRightDerivWithin_le_secantSlope_of_convexOn
          (a := a) (b := b) (x := x0) (y := y) (R := R)
          (f := f) hconv hx0 hy hx0y hR
      have hzero_le_slope :
          F.le F.zero (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x0 y) :=
        F.le_trans hRnonneg hR_le_slope
      have hsupport :
          F.le
            (F.add (f x0)
              (F.mul F.zero (F.sub y x0))) (f y) := by
        change
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.add (f x0)
              (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.sub y x0))) (f y)
        exact supportLine_le_of_le_secantSlope_right
          (f := f) hx0y hzero_le_slope
      have hzeroLine :
          F.add (f x0) (F.mul F.zero (F.sub y x0)) = f x0 := by
        change
          RealTheory.add (f x0)
              (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.sub y x0)) =
            f x0
        exact supportLine_zero_left x0 y (f := f)
      rwa [hzeroLine] at hsupport
    case neg =>
      have hyx0_le : F.le y x0 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hx0y
      have hnot_x0_le_y : Not (F.le x0 y) := by
        intro hx0_le_y
        have hx0_eq_y : x0 = y := F.le_antisymm hx0_le_y hyx0_le
        exact hy_eq hx0_eq_y.symm
      have hyx0 : F.lt y x0 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
          F hyx0_le hnot_x0_le_y
      have hslope_le_L :
          F.le (RealFunction.SecantSlope f y x0) L :=
        secantSlope_le_hasLeftDerivWithin_of_convexOn
          (a := a) (b := b) (x := y) (y := x0) (L := L)
          (f := f) hconv hy hx0 hyx0 hL
      have hslope_le_zero :
          F.le (RealFunction.SecantSlope f y x0) F.zero :=
        F.le_trans hslope_le_L hLnonpos
      have hsupport :
          F.le
            (F.add (f x0)
              (F.mul F.zero (F.sub y x0))) (f y) := by
        change
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.add (f x0)
              (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.sub y x0))) (f y)
        exact supportLine_le_of_secantSlope_le_left
          (f := f) hyx0 hslope_le_zero
      have hzeroLine :
          F.add (f x0) (F.mul F.zero (F.sub y x0)) = f x0 := by
        change
          RealTheory.add (f x0)
              (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.sub y x0)) =
            f x0
        exact supportLine_zero_left x0 y (f := f)
      rwa [hzeroLine] at hsupport

name: globalMinimum_of_convex_hasDerivWithin_zero
statement:
theorem globalMinimum_of_convex_hasDerivWithin_zero
    {a b x0 : Point} {f : Map}
    (hconv : RealFunction.ConvexOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x0)
    (hD :
      HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x0
        RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.HasMinimumOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f x0
proof:
:=
  globalMinimum_of_convex_oneSidedDeriv_sign
    (a := a) (b := b) (x0 := x0)
    (L := RealTheory.zero) (R := RealTheory.zero)
    (f := f) hconv hx0
    (hasDerivWithin_hasLeftDerivWithin hD)
    (hasDerivWithin_hasRightDerivWithin hD)
    (RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero)
    (RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero)

name: dist_self
statement: theorem dist_self (x : Point) : dist x x = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold dist
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_self
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x

name: dist_comm
statement: theorem dist_comm (x y : Point) : dist x y = dist y x
proof:
:= by
  unfold dist
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_comm
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y

name: dist_pos_of_ne
statement:
theorem dist_pos_of_ne {x y : Point} (h : Not (x = y)) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (dist x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold dist
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_pos_of_ne
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base h

name: dist_triangle
statement:
theorem dist_triangle (x y z : Point) :
    RealTheory.le (dist x z)
      (RealTheory.add (dist x y) (dist y z))
proof:
:= by
  unfold dist
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y z

name: dist_lt_of_two_half_steps
statement:
theorem dist_lt_of_two_half_steps
    {x y z delta : Point}
    (hxy :
      RealTheory.lt (dist x y)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base delta))
    (hyz :
      RealTheory.lt (dist y z)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base delta)) :
    RealTheory.lt (dist x z) delta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htriangle :
      F.le (dist x z) (RealTheory.add (dist x y) (dist y z)) := by
    unfold dist
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle F x y z
  have hadd :
      F.lt
        (RealTheory.add (dist x y) (dist y z))
        (RealTheory.add
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F delta)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F delta)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hxy hyz
  have hsum :
      F.lt (RealTheory.add (dist x y) (dist y z)) delta := by
    unfold RealTheory.add at hadd
    unfold RealTheory.add
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F delta] at hadd
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htriangle hsum

name: eq_of_forall_dist_lt
statement:
theorem eq_of_forall_dist_lt {x y : Point}
    (h :
      forall eps : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
          RealTheory.lt (dist x y) eps) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · exact hxy
  · have hpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (dist x y) :=
      dist_pos_of_ne hxy
    have hself := h (dist x y) hpos
    exact False.elim
      ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (dist x y)) hself)

name: tendstoWithin_const
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_const (E : Domain) (c x0 : Point) :
    TendstoWithin E (fun _ => c) x0 c
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  refine Exists.intro RealTheory.one ?_
  refine And.intro RealTheory.zero_lt_one ?_
  intro x hx hxne hxd
  rw [dist_self]
  exact heps

name: tendstoWithin_congr
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_congr {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 L : Point}
    (hfg : ∀ x, E x -> Not (x = x0) -> f x = g x)
    (hf : TendstoWithin E f x0 L) :
    TendstoWithin E g x0 L
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      rw [<- hfg x hx hxne]
      exact hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd

name: tendstoWithin_congr_limit
proof:
:= by
  rw [<- hLM]
  exact hf

name: tendstoWithin_unique
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_unique {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A B : Point}
    (hcluster : ClusterPoint E x0)
    (hA : TendstoWithin E f x0 A)
    (hB : TendstoWithin E f x0 B) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hAB : A = B
  · exact hAB
  · let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    let gap := dist A B
    have hgap_pos : F.lt F.zero gap := by
      unfold gap
      exact dist_pos_of_ne hAB
    let eps := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F gap
    have heps : F.lt F.zero eps :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hgap_pos
    cases hA eps heps with
    | intro deltaA hdeltaA =>
        cases hB eps heps with
        | intro deltaB hdeltaB =>
            let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaA deltaB
            have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
                F hdeltaA.left hdeltaB.left
            cases hcluster delta hdelta with
            | intro x hx =>
                have hxE : E x := hx.left
                have hxne : Not (x = x0) := hx.right.left
                have hxd : F.lt (dist x x0) delta := hx.right.right
                have hxdA : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaA :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaA deltaB)
                have hxdB : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaB :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaA deltaB)
                have hnearA := hdeltaA.right x hxE hxne hxdA
                have hnearB := hdeltaB.right x hxE hxne hxdB
                have hnearA' : F.lt (dist A (f x)) eps := by
                  rwa [dist_comm A (f x)]
                have hbad : F.lt (dist A B) (dist A B) := by
                  apply dist_lt_of_two_half_steps
                  · simpa [eps, gap] using hnearA'
                  · simpa [eps, gap] using hnearB
                exact False.elim
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (dist A B) hbad)

name: finiteSum_weighted_mem_convexSet
statement:
theorem finiteSum_weighted_mem_convexSet
    {E : Domain} {x w : Nat -> Point} :
    forall n : Nat,
      ConvexSet E ->
      (forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> E (x k)) ->
      ConvexWeights w (n + 1) ->
        E (WeightedPointSum x w (n + 1))
  | 0, hE, hx, hw => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hw0 : w 0 = F.one := by
        have hsum := hw.right
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one] at hsum
        exact hsum
      unfold WeightedPointSum
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
      rw [hw0]
      change E (F.mul F.one (x 0))
      rw [F.one_mul]
      exact hx 0 (Nat.lt_succ_self 0)
  | n + 1, hE, hx, hw => by
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let oldLen := n + 1
      let lastIndex := n + 1
      let total := RealTheory.finiteSum w oldLen
      let lastWeight := w lastIndex
      have hsum :
          F.add total lastWeight = F.one := by
        have h := hw.right
        change
          RealTheory.finiteSum w (oldLen + 1) = F.one at h
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ] at h
        change F.add total lastWeight = F.one at h
        exact h
      have hprefix_nonneg :
          forall k : Nat, k < oldLen -> F.le F.zero (w k) := by
        intro k hk
        exact hw.left k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self oldLen))
      have htotal_nonneg : F.le F.zero total := by
        unfold total
        exact RealTheory.finiteSum_nonneg w oldLen hprefix_nonneg
      have hlast_nonneg : F.le F.zero lastWeight := by
        change F.le F.zero (w (n + 1))
        exact hw.left (n + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1))
      by_cases htotal_zero : total = F.zero
      · have hprefix_zero :
            forall k : Nat, k < oldLen -> w k = F.zero := by
          intro k hk
          exact
            RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero_of_nonneg_terms
              oldLen hprefix_nonneg htotal_zero k hk
        have hlast_one : lastWeight = F.one := by
          have h := hsum
          rw [htotal_zero, F.zero_add] at h
          exact h
        rw [weightedPointSum_succ]
        have hprefix_sum_zero :
            WeightedPointSum x w oldLen = F.zero :=
          weightedPointSum_eq_zero_of_weights_eq_zero
            x w oldLen hprefix_zero
        rw [hprefix_sum_zero]
        change E (F.add F.zero (F.mul lastWeight (x lastIndex)))
        rw [hlast_one]
        rw [F.zero_add]
        rw [F.one_mul]
        exact hx lastIndex (Nat.lt_succ_self lastIndex)
      · have htotal_pos : F.lt F.zero total := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F htotal_nonneg
          intro hle_total_zero
          exact htotal_zero
            (F.le_antisymm hle_total_zero htotal_nonneg)
        let wnorm : Nat -> Point :=
          fun k : Nat => F.mul (w k) (F.inv total)
        let oldPoint := WeightedPointSum x wnorm oldLen
        have hnorm : ConvexWeights wnorm oldLen := by
          unfold wnorm
          exact
            convexWeights_normalized
              w oldLen total htotal_pos hprefix_nonneg rfl
        have hxprefix :
            forall k : Nat, k < oldLen -> E (x k) := by
          intro k hk
          exact hx k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self oldLen))
        have hold_mem : E oldPoint := by
          unfold oldPoint
          exact
            finiteSum_weighted_mem_convexSet
              n hE hxprefix hnorm
        have hlast_le_one : F.le lastWeight F.one := by
          have h := F.add_le_add_right htotal_nonneg lastWeight
          change
            F.le (F.add F.zero lastWeight)
              (F.add total lastWeight) at h
          rwa [F.zero_add, hsum] at h
        have hlast_weight : ConvexWeight lastWeight :=
          And.intro hlast_nonneg hlast_le_one
        have htotal_sub :
            total = F.sub F.one lastWeight :=
          RealTheory.eq_sub_of_eq_add_right hsum.symm
        have htotal_old :
            F.mul total oldPoint = WeightedPointSum x w oldLen := by
          have hnorm_eq :
              oldPoint =
                F.mul (WeightedPointSum x w oldLen) (F.inv total) := by
            unfold oldPoint wnorm
            exact weightedPointSum_normalized x w oldLen total
          rw [hnorm_eq, <- F.mul_assoc,
            F.mul_comm total (WeightedPointSum x w oldLen)]
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right F
            (WeightedPointSum x w oldLen) htotal_zero
        have hcombo :
            ConvexCombo lastWeight oldPoint (x lastIndex) =
              WeightedPointSum x w (oldLen + 1) := by
          unfold ConvexCombo
          change
            F.add
                (F.mul (F.sub F.one lastWeight) oldPoint)
                (F.mul lastWeight (x lastIndex)) =
              WeightedPointSum x w (oldLen + 1)
          change
            F.add
                (F.mul (F.sub F.one lastWeight) oldPoint)
                (F.mul lastWeight (x lastIndex)) =
              F.add (WeightedPointSum x w oldLen)
                (F.mul lastWeight (x lastIndex))
          rw [<- htotal_sub]
          rw [htotal_old]
        rw [<- hcombo]
        exact hE lastWeight oldPoint (x lastIndex)
          hlast_weight hold_mem
          (hx lastIndex (Nat.lt_succ_self lastIndex))

name: convexOn_binaryJensen
statement:
theorem convexOn_binaryJensen
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {theta x y : Point}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (htheta : ConvexWeight theta)
    (hx : E x) (hy : E y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (f (ConvexCombo theta x y))
      (ConvexCombo theta (f x) (f y))
proof:
:=
  hconv.right theta x y htheta hx hy

name: convexCombo_neg
statement:
theorem convexCombo_neg (theta x y : Point) :
    ConvexCombo theta (RealTheory.neg x) (RealTheory.neg y) =
      RealTheory.neg (ConvexCombo theta x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ConvexCombo
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) (F.neg x))
        (F.mul theta (F.neg y)) =
      F.neg
        (F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) x) (F.mul theta y))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F,
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F]

name: concaveOn_binaryJensen
statement:
theorem concaveOn_binaryJensen
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {theta x y : Point}
    (hconc : ConcaveOn E f)
    (htheta : ConvexWeight theta)
    (hx : E x) (hy : E y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (ConvexCombo theta (f x) (f y))
      (f (ConvexCombo theta x y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := convexOn_binaryJensen hconc htheta hx hy
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.neg (f (ConvexCombo theta x y)))
      (ConvexCombo theta (RealTheory.neg (f x))
        (RealTheory.neg (f y))) at h
  rw [convexCombo_neg] at h
  have h' := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_neg_le_neg F h
  exact h'

name: convexOn_finiteJensen
statement:
theorem convexOn_finiteJensen
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x w : Nat -> Point} :
    forall n : Nat,
      ConvexOn E f ->
      (forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> E (x k)) ->
      ConvexWeights w (n + 1) ->
        RealTheory.le
          (f (WeightedPointSum x w (n + 1)))
          (WeightedValueSum f x w (n + 1))
  | 0, hconv, hx, hw => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hw0 : w 0 = F.one := by
        have hsum := hw.right
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one] at hsum
        exact hsum
      unfold WeightedPointSum
      unfold WeightedValueSum
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
      rw [hw0]
      change F.le (f (F.mul F.one (x 0)))
        (F.mul F.one (f (x 0)))
      rw [F.one_mul]
      rw [F.one_mul]
      exact F.le_refl (f (x 0))
  | n + 1, hconv, hx, hw => by
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let oldLen := n + 1
      let lastIndex := n + 1
      let total := RealTheory.finiteSum w oldLen
      let lastWeight := w lastIndex
      have hsum :
          F.add total lastWeight = F.one := by
        have h := hw.right
        change
          RealTheory.finiteSum w (oldLen + 1) = F.one at h
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ] at h
        change F.add total lastWeight = F.one at h
        exact h
      have hprefix_nonneg :
          forall k : Nat, k < oldLen -> F.le F.zero (w k) := by
        intro k hk
        exact hw.left k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self oldLen))
      have htotal_nonneg : F.le F.zero total := by
        unfold total
        exact RealTheory.finiteSum_nonneg w oldLen hprefix_nonneg
      have hlast_nonneg : F.le F.zero lastWeight := by
        change F.le F.zero (w (n + 1))
        exact hw.left (n + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1))
      by_cases htotal_zero : total = F.zero
      · have hprefix_zero :
            forall k : Nat, k < oldLen -> w k = F.zero := by
          intro k hk
          exact
            RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero_of_nonneg_terms
              oldLen hprefix_nonneg htotal_zero k hk
        have hlast_one : lastWeight = F.one := by
          have h := hsum
          rw [htotal_zero, F.zero_add] at h
          exact h
        have hpoint_eq :
            WeightedPointSum x w (oldLen + 1) = x lastIndex := by
          rw [weightedPointSum_succ]
          have hprefix_sum_zero :
              WeightedPointSum x w oldLen = F.zero :=
            weightedPointSum_eq_zero_of_weights_eq_zero
              x w oldLen hprefix_zero
          rw [hprefix_sum_zero]
          change F.add F.zero (F.mul lastWeight (x lastIndex)) =
            x lastIndex
          rw [hlast_one]
          rw [F.zero_add]
          rw [F.one_mul]
        have hvalue_eq :
            WeightedValueSum f x w (oldLen + 1) =
              f (x lastIndex) := by
          rw [weightedValueSum_succ]
          have hprefix_sum_zero :
              WeightedValueSum f x w oldLen = F.zero :=
            weightedValueSum_eq_zero_of_weights_eq_zero
              f x w oldLen hprefix_zero
          rw [hprefix_sum_zero]
          change F.add F.zero
              (F.mul lastWeight (f (x lastIndex))) =
            f (x lastIndex)
          rw [hlast_one]
          rw [F.zero_add]
          rw [F.one_mul]
        rw [hpoint_eq, hvalue_eq]
        exact F.le_refl (f (x lastIndex))
      · have htotal_pos : F.lt F.zero total := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F htotal_nonneg
          intro hle_total_zero
          exact htotal_zero
            (F.le_antisymm hle_total_zero htotal_nonneg)
        let wnorm : Nat -> Point :=
          fun k : Nat => F.mul (w k) (F.inv total)
        let oldPoint := WeightedPointSum x wnorm oldLen
        let oldValue := WeightedValueSum f x w oldLen
        let oldValueNorm := WeightedValueSum f x wnorm oldLen
        have hnorm : ConvexWeights wnorm oldLen := by
          unfold wnorm
          exact
            convexWeights_normalized
              w oldLen total htotal_pos hprefix_nonneg rfl
        have hxprefix :
            forall k : Nat, k < oldLen -> E (x k) := by
          intro k hk
          exact hx k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self oldLen))
        have hold_mem : E oldPoint := by
          unfold oldPoint
          exact
            finiteSum_weighted_mem_convexSet
              n hconv.left hxprefix hnorm
        have hih :
            F.le (f oldPoint) oldValueNorm := by
          unfold oldPoint oldValueNorm
          exact
            convexOn_finiteJensen
              n hconv hxprefix hnorm
        have hlast_le_one : F.le lastWeight F.one := by
          have h := F.add_le_add_right htotal_nonneg lastWeight
          change
            F.le (F.add F.zero lastWeight)
              (F.add total lastWeight) at h
          rwa [F.zero_add, hsum] at h
        have hlast_weight : ConvexWeight lastWeight :=
          And.intro hlast_nonneg hlast_le_one
        have htotal_sub :
            total = F.sub F.one lastWeight :=
          RealTheory.eq_sub_of_eq_add_right hsum.symm
        have htotal_oldPoint :
            F.mul total oldPoint = WeightedPointSum x w oldLen := by
          have hnorm_eq :
              oldPoint =
                F.mul (WeightedPointSum x w oldLen) (F.inv total) := by
            unfold oldPoint wnorm
            exact weightedPointSum_normalized x w oldLen total
          rw [hnorm_eq, <- F.mul_assoc,
            F.mul_comm total (WeightedPointSum x w oldLen)]
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right F
            (WeightedPointSum x w oldLen) htotal_zero
        have htotal_oldValue :
            F.mul total oldValueNorm = oldValue := by
          have hnorm_eq :
              oldValueNorm =
                F.mul (WeightedValueSum f x w oldLen)
                  (F.inv total) := by
            unfold oldValueNorm wnorm
            exact weightedValueSum_normalized f x w oldLen total
          rw [hnorm_eq]
          unfold oldValue
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc,
            F.mul_comm total (WeightedValueSum f x w oldLen)]
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right F
            (WeightedValueSum f x w oldLen) htotal_zero
        have hcombo :
            ConvexCombo lastWeight oldPoint (x lastIndex) =
              WeightedPointSum x w (oldLen + 1) := by
          unfold ConvexCombo
          change
            F.add
                (F.mul (F.sub F.one lastWeight) oldPoint)
                (F.mul lastWeight (x lastIndex)) =
              WeightedPointSum x w (oldLen + 1)
          change
            F.add
                (F.mul (F.sub F.one lastWeight) oldPoint)
                (F.mul lastWeight (x lastIndex)) =
              F.add (WeightedPointSum x w oldLen)
                (F.mul lastWeight (x lastIndex))
          rw [<- htotal_sub]
          rw [htotal_oldPoint]
        have hbinary :
            F.le
              (f (ConvexCombo lastWeight oldPoint (x lastIndex)))
              (ConvexCombo lastWeight (f oldPoint)
                (f (x lastIndex))) :=
          convexOn_binaryJensen hconv hlast_weight hold_mem
            (hx lastIndex (Nat.lt_succ_self lastIndex))
        have hscaled :
            F.le
              (F.mul total (f oldPoint))
              (F.mul total oldValueNorm) :=
          F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hih htotal_nonneg
        have hright :
            F.le
              (ConvexCombo lastWeight (f oldPoint)
                (f (x lastIndex)))
              (WeightedValueSum f x w (oldLen + 1)) := by
          unfold ConvexCombo
          change
            F.le
              (F.add
                (F.mul (F.sub F.one lastWeight) (f oldPoint))
                (F.mul lastWeight (f (x lastIndex))))
              (WeightedValueSum f x w (oldLen + 1))
          change
            F.le
              (F.add
                (F.mul (F.sub F.one lastWeight) (f oldPoint))
                (F.mul lastWeight (f (x lastIndex))))
              (F.add oldValue
                (F.mul lastWeight (f (x lastIndex))))
          rw [<- htotal_sub]
          have hscaled' :
              F.le
                (F.mul total (f oldPoint))
                oldValue := by
            rwa [htotal_oldValue] at hscaled
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hscaled'
            (F.le_refl (F.mul lastWeight (f (x lastIndex))))
        rw [<- hcombo]
        exact F.le_trans hbinary hright

name: weightedValueSum_neg
statement:
theorem weightedValueSum_neg
    (f : Map) (x w : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    WeightedValueSum (NegFun f) x w n =
      RealTheory.neg (WeightedValueSum f x w n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold WeightedValueSum
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (w k) (RealTheory.neg (f (x k)))) n =
      RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (w k) (f (x k))) n)
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_neg]
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
  intro k
  exact RealTheory.mul_neg (w k) (f (x k))

name: concaveOn_finiteJensen
statement:
theorem concaveOn_finiteJensen
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hconc : ConcaveOn E f)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> E (x k))
    (hw : ConvexWeights w (n + 1)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (WeightedValueSum f x w (n + 1))
      (f (WeightedPointSum x w (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := convexOn_finiteJensen n hconc hx hw
  change
    F.le
      (F.neg (f (WeightedPointSum x w (n + 1))))
      (WeightedValueSum (NegFun f) x w (n + 1)) at h
  rw [weightedValueSum_neg f x w (n + 1)] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_neg_le_neg F h

name: convexOn_neg_iff_concaveOn
statement:
theorem convexOn_neg_iff_concaveOn {E : Domain} {f : Map} :
    ConvexOn E (NegFun f) <-> ConcaveOn E f

name: concaveOn_iff_neg_convexOn
statement:
theorem concaveOn_iff_neg_convexOn {E : Domain} {f : Map} :
    ConcaveOn E f <-> ConvexOn E (NegFun f)

name: tendstoWithin_to_cauchyAtWithin
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_to_cauchyAtWithin
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 L : Point}
    (hf : TendstoWithin E f x0 L) :
    CauchyAtWithin E f x0
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : F.lt F.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hf e2 he2 with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x y hx hy hxne hyne hxd hyd
      have hxL : F.lt (dist (f x) L) e2 :=
        hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd
      have hyL : F.lt (dist (f y) L) e2 :=
        hdelta.right y hy hyne hyd
      have hLy : F.lt (dist L (f y)) e2 := by
        rwa [dist_comm L (f y)]
      have htri :
          F.le (dist (f x) (f y))
            (F.add (dist (f x) L) (dist L (f y))) := by
        change
          F.le
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f x) (f y))
            (F.add
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f x) L)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F L (f y)))
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle F (f x) L (f y)
      have hsum :
          F.lt (F.add (dist (f x) L) (dist L (f y))) eps := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hxL hLy
        have hhalf : F.add e2 e2 = eps := by
          unfold e2
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps
        rwa [hhalf] at h
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: clusterApproachSeq_spec
statement:
theorem clusterApproachSeq_spec
    {E : Domain} {x0 : Point}
    (hcluster : ClusterPoint E x0) (n : Nat) :
    And (E (clusterApproachSeq hcluster n))
      (And (Not (clusterApproachSeq hcluster n = x0))
        (RealTheory.lt
          (dist (clusterApproachSeq hcluster n) x0)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold clusterApproachSeq
  exact
    Classical.choose_spec
      (hcluster
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
          (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)))

name: clusterApproachSeq_mem
statement:
theorem clusterApproachSeq_mem
    {E : Domain} {x0 : Point}
    (hcluster : ClusterPoint E x0) :
    forall n : Nat, E (clusterApproachSeq hcluster n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  exact (clusterApproachSeq_spec hcluster n).left

name: clusterApproachSeq_ne
statement:
theorem clusterApproachSeq_ne
    {E : Domain} {x0 : Point}
    (hcluster : ClusterPoint E x0) :

name: clusterApproachSeq_tendsto
statement:
theorem clusterApproachSeq_tendsto
    {E : Domain} {x0 : Point}
    (hcluster : ClusterPoint E x0) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto (clusterApproachSeq hcluster) x0

  intro n

name: cauchyAtWithin_clusterApproachSeq_cauchy
statement:
theorem cauchyAtWithin_clusterApproachSeq_cauchy
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hcluster : ClusterPoint E x0)
    (hf : CauchyAtWithin E f x0) :
    RealTheory.SeqCauchy
      (fun n : Nat => f (clusterApproachSeq hcluster n))
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases clusterApproachSeq_tendsto hcluster delta hdelta.left with
      | intro N hN =>
          refine Exists.intro N ?_
          intro n m hn hm
          have hnclose := hN n hn
          have hmclose := hN m hm
          change RealTheory.lt
            (dist (clusterApproachSeq hcluster n) x0) delta at hnclose
          change RealTheory.lt
            (dist (clusterApproachSeq hcluster m) x0) delta at hmclose
          exact hdelta.right
            (clusterApproachSeq hcluster n)
            (clusterApproachSeq hcluster m)
            (clusterApproachSeq_mem hcluster n)
            (clusterApproachSeq_mem hcluster m)
            (clusterApproachSeq_ne hcluster n)
            (clusterApproachSeq_ne hcluster m)
            hnclose hmclose

name: cauchyAtWithin_to_exists_tendstoWithin
statement:
theorem cauchyAtWithin_to_exists_tendstoWithin
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hcluster : ClusterPoint E x0)
    (hf : CauchyAtWithin E f x0) :
    Exists (fun L : Point => TendstoWithin E f x0 L)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have himageCauchy :
      RealTheory.SeqCauchy
        (fun n : Nat => f (clusterApproachSeq hcluster n)) :=
    cauchyAtWithin_clusterApproachSeq_cauchy hcluster hf
  cases RealTheory.seqCauchy_converges himageCauchy with
  | intro L hL =>
      refine Exists.intro L ?_
      intro eps heps
      let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
      have he2 : F.lt F.zero e2 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
      cases hf e2 he2 with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          cases clusterApproachSeq_tendsto hcluster delta hdelta.left with
          | intro Nclose hNclose =>
              cases hL e2 he2 with
              | intro Nval hNval =>
                  let N := Nat.max Nclose Nval
                  have hNsrc :
                      F.lt (dist (clusterApproachSeq hcluster N) x0)
                        delta :=
                    hNclose N (Nat.le_max_left Nclose Nval)
                  have hNimage :
                      F.lt
                        (dist
                          (f (clusterApproachSeq hcluster N)) L) e2 :=
                    hNval N (Nat.le_max_right Nclose Nval)
                  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                  refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
                  intro x hx hxne hxd
                  have hxN :
                      F.lt
                        (dist (f x)
                          (f (clusterApproachSeq hcluster N))) e2 :=
                    hdelta.right
                      x
                      (clusterApproachSeq hcluster N)
                      hx
                      (clusterApproachSeq_mem hcluster N)
                      hxne
                      (clusterApproachSeq_ne hcluster N)
                      hxd hNsrc
                  have htri :
                      F.le (dist (f x) L)
                        (F.add
                          (dist (f x)
                            (f (clusterApproachSeq hcluster N)))
                          (dist
                            (f (clusterApproachSeq hcluster N)) L)) := by
                    change
                      F.le
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f x) L)
                        (F.add
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f x)
                            (f (clusterApproachSeq hcluster N)))
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F
                            (f (clusterApproachSeq hcluster N)) L))
                    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle
                      F (f x) (f (clusterApproachSeq hcluster N)) L
                  have hsum :
                      F.lt
                        (F.add
                          (dist (f x)
                            (f (clusterApproachSeq hcluster N)))
                          (dist
                            (f (clusterApproachSeq hcluster N)) L))
                        eps := by
                    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hxN hNimage
                    have hhalf : F.add e2 e2 = eps := by
                      unfold e2
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps
                    rwa [hhalf] at h
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: exists_tendstoWithin_iff_cauchyAtWithin
statement:
theorem exists_tendstoWithin_iff_cauchyAtWithin
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hcluster : ClusterPoint E x0) :
    (Exists (fun L : Point => TendstoWithin E f x0 L)) <->
      CauchyAtWithin E f x0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | intro L hL =>
        exact tendstoWithin_to_cauchyAtWithin hL
  · exact cauchyAtWithin_to_exists_tendstoWithin hcluster

name: strictMonotoneOn_monotoneOn
statement:
theorem strictMonotoneOn_monotoneOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hstrict : StrictMonotoneOn E f) :
    MonotoneOn E f
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases heq : x = y
  · rw [heq]
    exact F.le_refl (f y)
  · have hnot_yx : Not (F.le y x) := by
      intro hyx
      exact heq (F.le_antisymm hxy hyx)
    have hlt : F.lt x y :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hnot_yx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (hstrict x y hx hy hlt)

name: strictMonotoneOn_comp
statement:
theorem strictMonotoneOn_comp
    {E G : Domain} {f g : Map}

    (hmap : MapsInto E G f) :
    StrictMonotoneOn E (CompFun g f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  unfold CompFun
  exact hg (f x) (f y) (hmap x hx) (hmap y hy)
    (hf x y hx hy hxy)

statement:
theorem inverseOn_image_self
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x : Point}
    (hinj : InjectiveOn E f)

    InverseOn E f (f x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hy : Image E f (f x) := image_intro hx
  exact hinj (InverseOn E f (f x)) x
    (inverseOn_mem hy) hx (inverseOn_value hy)

statement:
theorem inverseOn_left_inverse

name: strictMonotoneOn_injectiveOn
statement:
theorem strictMonotoneOn_injectiveOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hstrict : StrictMonotoneOn E f) :
    InjectiveOn E f
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hEq : x = y
  · exact hEq
  · cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hEq with
    | inl hlt =>
        have hflt : F.lt (f x) (f y) := hstrict x y hx hy hlt
        rw [hxy] at hflt
        exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (f y) hflt)
    | inr hgt =>
        have hflt : F.lt (f y) (f x) := hstrict y x hy hx hgt
        rw [hxy] at hflt
        exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (f y) hflt)

name: inverseOn_strictMonotoneOn_image
statement:
theorem inverseOn_strictMonotoneOn_image
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hstrict : StrictMonotoneOn E f) :
    StrictMonotoneOn (Image E f) (InverseOn E f)
proof:
:= by
  intro y z hy hz hyz
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let x := InverseOn E f y
  let w := InverseOn E f z
  have hxE : E x := inverseOn_mem hy
  have hwE : E w := inverseOn_mem hz
  have hfx : f x = y := inverseOn_value hy
  have hfw : f w = z := inverseOn_value hz
  have hxw_ne : Not (x = w) := by
    intro hxw
    have hy_eq_z : y = z := by
      rw [<- hfx, <- hfw, hxw]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hyz hy_eq_z
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hxw_ne with
  | inl hxw =>
      exact hxw
  | inr hwx =>
      have hzw : F.lt (f w) (f x) := hstrict w x hwE hxE hwx
      rw [hfx, hfw] at hzw
      exact False.elim ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_asymm F hyz) hzw)

name: inverseOn_monotoneOn_image
statement:
theorem inverseOn_monotoneOn_image
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hstrict : StrictMonotoneOn E f) :
    MonotoneOn (Image E f) (InverseOn E f)
proof:
:= by
  intro y z hy hz hyz
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hyzEq : y = z
  · rw [hyzEq]
    exact F.le_refl (InverseOn E f z)
  · have hyzLt : F.lt y z :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyz ?_
    · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (inverseOn_strictMonotoneOn_image hstrict y z hy hz hyzLt)
    · intro hzy
      exact hyzEq (F.le_antisymm hyz hzy)

name: preimageOn_inverseOn_same_image_inter
statement:
theorem preimageOn_inverseOn_same_image_inter
    {E C : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hinj : InjectiveOn E f) :
    SetPred.Same
      (PreimageOn (Image E f) (InverseOn E f) C)
      (Image (SetPred.Inter E C) f)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    refine Exists.intro (InverseOn E f y) ?_
    exact And.intro
      (And.intro (inverseOn_mem hy.left) hy.right)
      (inverseOn_value hy.left)
  · intro hy
    cases hy with
    | intro x hx =>
        have hxE : E x := hx.left.left
        have hyImage : Image E f y := by
          refine Exists.intro x ?_
          exact And.intro hxE hx.right
        refine And.intro hyImage ?_
        have hinv : InverseOn E f y = x := by
          apply hinj (InverseOn E f y) x
          · exact inverseOn_mem hyImage
          · exact hxE
          · rw [inverseOn_value hyImage, hx.right]
        rw [hinv]
        exact hx.left.right

name: inverseOn_topologicallyContinuousOn_of_compact
statement:
theorem inverseOn_topologicallyContinuousOn_of_compact
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hcompact : RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} E)
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f)
    (hinj : InjectiveOn E f) :
    TopologicallyContinuousOn (Image E f) (InverseOn E f)
proof:
:= by
  apply topologicallyContinuousOn_of_preimage_closed
  intro C hC
  have hcompactInter :
      RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} (SetPred.Inter E C) :=
    compact_inter_closed hcompact hC
  have hfInter : ContinuousOn (SetPred.Inter E C) f :=
    continuousOn_subset (SetPred.inter_subset_left E C) hf
  have hcompactImage :
      RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} (Image (SetPred.Inter E C) f) :=
    compact_image_of_continuousOn hcompactInter hfInter
  have hclosedImage :
      RealTheory.IsClosed (Image (SetPred.Inter E C) f) :=
    RealTheory.closed_of_compact hcompactImage
  have hclosedIn :
      RealTheory.ClosedIn (Image E f)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Trace
          (Image E f) (Image (SetPred.Inter E C) f)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedIn_trace
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hclosedImage
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.relativeClosed_congr
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hclosedIn
  intro y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    exact (preimageOn_inverseOn_same_image_inter hinj y).mpr hy.right
  · intro hy
    refine And.intro hy.left ?_
    exact (preimageOn_inverseOn_same_image_inter hinj y).mp hy

name: inverseOn_continuousOn_of_compact
statement:
theorem inverseOn_continuousOn_of_compact
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hcompact : RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} E)
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f)
    (hinj : InjectiveOn E f) :

    (inverseOn_topologicallyContinuousOn_of_compact hcompact hf hinj)

name: tendstoWithin_to_sequential
proof:
:= by
  intro u huE hune hu
  intro eps heps
  cases h eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      have hu_delta := hu delta hdelta.left
      exact Eventually.mono
        (fun n hn => by
          change RealTheory.lt (dist (u n) x0) delta at hn
          exact hdelta.right (u n) (huE n) (hune n) hn)
        hu_delta

name: sequentiallyTendstoWithin_const

    (tendstoWithin_const E c x0)

name: sequentiallyTendstoWithin_congr
proof:
:= by
  intro u huE hune hu
  have hseq := hf u huE hune hu
  have hsame : (fun n => f (u n)) = (fun n => g (u n)) := by
    funext n
    exact hfg (u n) (huE n) (hune n)
  rw [<- hsame]
  exact hseq

name: seqTendsto_of_dist_lt_inv_nat_succ
statement:
theorem seqTendsto_of_dist_lt_inv_nat_succ
    {u : Nat -> Point} {x : Point}
    (hclose :
      forall n : Nat,
        RealTheory.lt (dist (u n) x)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto u x
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.exists_inv_nat_lt heps with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have hnClose := hclose n
      have hNpos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat N) :=
        RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hN.left
      have hnpos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) :=
        RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
      have hN_le_succ : N <= n + 1 :=
        Nat.le_trans hn (Nat.le_succ n)
      have hNatLe :
          F.le (RealTheory.nat N) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) :=
        RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hN_le_succ
      have hinvLe :
          F.le (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat N)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
          F hNpos hnpos hNatLe
      have hltN :
          F.lt (dist (u n) x) (F.inv (RealTheory.nat N)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hnClose hinvLe
      change F.lt (dist (u n) x) eps
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hltN hN.right

name: heine_sequential_to_tendstoWithin
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  classical
  by_cases hgoal :
      ∃ delta, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta ∧
        ∀ x, E x -> Not (x = x0) ->
          RealTheory.lt (dist x x0) delta ->
            RealTheory.lt (dist (f x) L) eps
  · exact hgoal
  · exfalso
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    have hbad_delta :
        ∀ delta, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta ->
          ∃ x, E x ∧ Not (x = x0) ∧
            RealTheory.lt (dist x x0) delta ∧
            Not (RealTheory.lt (dist (f x) L) eps) := by
      intro delta hdelta
      by_cases hbad :
          ∃ x, E x ∧ Not (x = x0) ∧
            RealTheory.lt (dist x x0) delta ∧
            Not (RealTheory.lt (dist (f x) L) eps)
      · exact hbad
      · exfalso
        apply hgoal
        refine Exists.intro delta ?_
        refine And.intro hdelta ?_
        intro x hxE hxne hxd
        by_cases hclose : RealTheory.lt (dist (f x) L) eps
        · exact hclose
        · exfalso
          exact hbad
            (Exists.intro x
              (And.intro hxE
                (And.intro hxne (And.intro hxd hclose))))
    let radius : Nat -> Point :=
      fun n => F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
    have radius_pos :
        ∀ n, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (radius n) := by
      intro n
      unfold radius
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)
    let bad :
        ∀ n, ∃ x, E x ∧ Not (x = x0) ∧
            RealTheory.lt (dist x x0) (radius n) ∧
            Not (RealTheory.lt (dist (f x) L) eps) :=
      fun n => hbad_delta (radius n) (radius_pos n)
    let u : Nat -> Point := fun n => Classical.choose (bad n)
    have uspec :
        ∀ n, E (u n) ∧ Not (u n = x0) ∧
            RealTheory.lt (dist (u n) x0) (radius n) ∧
            Not (RealTheory.lt (dist (f (u n)) L) eps) := by
      intro n
      exact Classical.choose_spec (bad n)
    have huE : ∀ n, E (u n) := by
      intro n
      exact (uspec n).left
    have hune : ∀ n, Not (u n = x0) := by
      intro n
      exact (uspec n).right.left
    have hu : RealTheory.SeqTendsto u x0 := by
      apply seqTendsto_of_dist_lt_inv_nat_succ
      intro n
      simpa [radius, F, RealTheory.inv] using
        (uspec n).right.right.left
    have himage := hseq u huE hune hu
    cases himage eps heps with
    | intro N hN =>
        have hclose := hN N (Nat.le_refl N)
        change RealTheory.lt (dist (f (u N)) L) eps at hclose
        exact (uspec N).right.right.right hclose

name: heine_tendstoWithin_iff
statement:
theorem heine_tendstoWithin_iff {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    {x0 L : Point} :
    TendstoWithin E f x0 L <->

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact tendstoWithin_to_sequential
  · exact heine_sequential_to_tendstoWithin

name: continuousAtOn_to_sequential
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  intro u huE hu
  intro eps heps
  cases hf.right eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      have hu_delta := hu delta hdelta.left
      exact Eventually.mono
        (fun n hn => by
          change RealTheory.lt (dist (u n) x0) delta at hn
          change RealTheory.lt (dist (f (u n)) (f x0)) eps
          by_cases hux : u n = x0
          · rw [hux, dist_self]
            exact heps
          · exact hdelta.right (u n) (huE n) hux hn)
        hu_delta

name: sequentiallyContinuousAtOn_to_continuousAtOn

    (fun u huE hune hu => hf.right u huE hu)

name: continuousOn_to_sequential
proof:

name: continuousOn_sameOn_of_dense
statement:
theorem continuousOn_sameOn_of_dense
    {E S : Domain} {f g : Map}
    (hdense :
      forall x : Point, E x -> RealTheory.ClosurePoint S x)
    (hSE : SetPred.Subset S E)
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f)
    (hg : ContinuousOn E g)
    (hfg : SameOn S f g) :
    SameOn E f g
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxE
  cases (RealTheory.closurePoint_iff_exists_seqTendsto.mp
      (hdense x hxE)) with
  | intro u hu =>
      have huS : forall n : Nat, S (u n) := hu.left
      have huE : forall n : Nat, E (u n) := by
        intro n
        exact hSE (u n) (huS n)
      have hfu :
          RealTheory.SeqTendsto (fun n : Nat => f (u n)) (f x) :=
        (continuousOn_to_sequential hf x hxE).right u huE hu.right
      have hgu :
          RealTheory.SeqTendsto (fun n : Nat => g (u n)) (g x) :=
        (continuousOn_to_sequential hg x hxE).right u huE hu.right
      have hsame :
          (fun n : Nat => f (u n)) =
            (fun n : Nat => g (u n)) := by
        funext n
        exact hfg (u n) (huS n)
      rw [hsame] at hfu
      exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hfu hgu

name: compact_image_of_topologicallyContinuousOn
statement:
theorem compact_image_of_topologicallyContinuousOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hcompact : RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} E)
    (hf : TopologicallyContinuousOn E f) :
    RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} (Image E f)
proof:
:= by
  intro iota U hopen hcover
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Pre : iota -> Point -> Prop :=
    fun i => PreimageOn E f (U i)
  have hrel : forall i : iota, RealTheory.OpenIn E (Pre i) := by
    intro i
    exact hf (U i) (hopen i)
  have hcoverPre : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Covers Pre E := by
    intro x hx
    have hfx : Image E f (f x) := image_intro hx
    cases hcover (f x) hfx with
    | intro i hi =>
        exact Exists.intro i (And.intro hx hi)
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_ambient_open_cover_of_relative_cover
      F hrel hcoverPre with
  | intro V hV =>
      cases hcompact V hV.left hV.right.right with
      | intro js hjs =>
          refine Exists.intro js ?_
          intro y hy
          cases hy with
          | intro x hx =>
              cases hjs x hx.left with
              | intro i hi =>
                  refine Exists.intro i ?_
                  refine And.intro hi.left ?_
                  have hxPre : Pre i x :=
                    (hV.right.left i x).mpr (And.intro hx.left hi.right)
                  rw [<- hx.right]
                  exact hxPre.right

name: compact_image_of_continuousOn
statement:
theorem compact_image_of_continuousOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hcompact : RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} E)
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f) :
    RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} (Image E f)
proof:
:=
  compact_image_of_topologicallyContinuousOn hcompact
    (continuousOn_to_topologicallyContinuousOn hf)

name: compact_inter_closed
statement:
theorem compact_inter_closed
    {E C : Domain}
    (hcompact : RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} E)
    (hclosed : RealTheory.IsClosed C) :
    RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} (SetPred.Inter E C)
proof:
:= by
  intro iota U hopen hcover
  let W : Option iota -> Point -> Prop
    | none => SetPred.Compl C
    | some i => U i
  have hWopen : forall j : Option iota, RealTheory.IsOpen (W j) := by
    intro j
    cases j with
    | none =>
        exact hclosed
    | some i =>
        exact hopen i
  have hWcover : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Covers W E := by
    intro x hxE
    classical
    by_cases hxC : C x
    · cases hcover x (And.intro hxE hxC) with
      | intro i hi =>
          exact Exists.intro (some i) hi
    · exact Exists.intro none hxC
  cases hcompact W hWopen hWcover with
  | intro js hjs =>
      refine Exists.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.optionSomeList js) ?_
      intro x hx
      cases hjs x hx.left with
      | intro j hj =>
          cases j with
          | none =>
              exact False.elim (hj.right hx.right)
          | some i =>
              exact Exists.intro i
                (And.intro
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mem_optionSomeList_of_mem_some
                    hj.left)
                  hj.right)

name: boundedOn_of_compact_of_continuousOn
statement:
theorem boundedOn_of_compact_of_continuousOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hcompact : RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} E)
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f) :
    BoundedOn E f
proof:
:= by
  have himage :
      RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} (Image E f) :=
    compact_image_of_continuousOn hcompact hf
  cases RealTheory.bounded_of_compact himage with
  | intro left hleft =>
      cases hleft with
      | intro right hright =>
          refine Exists.intro left ?_
          refine Exists.intro right ?_
          intro x hx
          exact hright (f x) (image_intro hx)

name: mem_of_closed_of_lub
statement:
private theorem mem_of_closed_of_lub
    {S : Point -> Prop} {s : Point}
    (hclosed : RealTheory.IsClosed S)
    (hs : IsLeastUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le S s) :
    S s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs_mem : S s
  · exact hs_mem
  · let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    cases hclosed s hs_mem with
    | intro left hleft =>
        cases hleft with
        | intro right hright =>
            cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub
                F hs hright.left with
            | intro x hx =>
                have hx_le_s : F.le x s := hs.left x hx.left
                have hx_lt_right : F.lt x right :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                    F hx_le_s hright.right.left
                have hx_interval :
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval F left right x :=
                  And.intro hx.right hx_lt_right
                exact False.elim
                  (hright.right.right x hx_interval hx.left)

name: mem_of_closed_of_glb
statement:
private theorem mem_of_closed_of_glb
    {S : Point -> Prop} {s : Point}
    (hclosed : RealTheory.IsClosed S)
    (hs : IsGreatestLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le S s) :
    S s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs_mem : S s
  · exact hs_mem
  · let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    cases hclosed s hs_mem with
    | intro left hleft =>
        cases hleft with
        | intro right hright =>
            cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_gt_of_glb_lt
                F hs hright.right.left with
            | intro x hx =>
                have hs_le_x : F.le s x := hs.left x hx.left
                have left_lt_x : F.lt left x :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                    F hright.left hs_le_x
                have hx_interval :
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval F left right x :=
                  And.intro left_lt_x hx.right
                exact False.elim
                  (hright.right.right x hx_interval hx.left)

name: attainsMaximumOn_of_compact_of_continuousOn
statement:
theorem attainsMaximumOn_of_compact_of_continuousOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hne : Exists E)
    (hcompact : RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} E)
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f) :
    AttainsMaximumOn E f
proof:
:= by
  have himage :
      RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} (Image E f) :=
    compact_image_of_continuousOn hcompact hf
  have hclosed : RealTheory.IsClosed (Image E f) :=
    RealTheory.closed_of_compact himage
  have hbdd : RealTheory.SetBounded (Image E f) :=
    RealTheory.bounded_of_compact himage
  have himage_nonempty : Exists (Image E f) := by
    cases hne with
    | intro x hx =>
        exact Exists.intro (f x) (image_intro hx)
  have hupper :
      Exists
        (IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (Image E f)) := by
    cases hbdd with
    | intro left hleft =>
        cases hleft with
        | intro right hright =>
            refine Exists.intro right ?_
            intro y hy
            exact (hright y hy).right
  cases RealTheory.exists_lub (Image E f) himage_nonempty hupper with
  | intro M hM =>
      have hM_mem : Image E f M :=
        mem_of_closed_of_lub hclosed hM
      cases hM_mem with
      | intro x hx =>
          refine Exists.intro x ?_
          refine And.intro hx.left ?_
          intro y hy
          rw [hx.right]
          exact hM.left (f y) (image_intro hy)

name: attainsMinimumOn_of_compact_of_continuousOn
statement:
theorem attainsMinimumOn_of_compact_of_continuousOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hne : Exists E)
    (hcompact : RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} E)
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f) :
    AttainsMinimumOn E f
proof:
:= by
  have himage :
      RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} (Image E f) :=
    compact_image_of_continuousOn hcompact hf
  have hclosed : RealTheory.IsClosed (Image E f) :=
    RealTheory.closed_of_compact himage
  have hbdd : RealTheory.SetBounded (Image E f) :=
    RealTheory.bounded_of_compact himage
  have himage_nonempty : Exists (Image E f) := by
    cases hne with
    | intro x hx =>
        exact Exists.intro (f x) (image_intro hx)
  have hlower :
      Exists
        (IsLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (Image E f)) := by
    cases hbdd with
    | intro left hleft =>
        cases hleft with
        | intro right hright =>
            refine Exists.intro left ?_
            intro y hy
            exact (hright y hy).left
  cases RealTheory.exists_glb (Image E f) himage_nonempty hlower with
  | intro m hm =>
      have hm_mem : Image E f m :=
        mem_of_closed_of_glb hclosed hm
      cases hm_mem with
      | intro x hx =>
          refine Exists.intro x ?_
          refine And.intro hx.left ?_
          intro y hy
          rw [hx.right]
          exact hm.left (f y) (image_intro hy)

name: uniformContinuousOn_const
statement:
theorem uniformContinuousOn_const {E : Domain} {c : Point} :
    UniformContinuousOn E (fun _ => c)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  refine Exists.intro RealTheory.one ?_
  refine And.intro RealTheory.zero_lt_one ?_
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  rw [dist_self]
  exact heps

name: uniformContinuousOn_congr
statement:
theorem uniformContinuousOn_congr {E : Domain} {f g : Map}
    (hfg : SameOn E f g)
    (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f) :
    UniformContinuousOn E g
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x y hx hy hxy
      rw [<- hfg x hx, <- hfg y hy]
      exact hdelta.right x y hx hy hxy

name: uniformContinuousOn_comp
statement:
theorem uniformContinuousOn_comp
    {E G : Domain} {f g : Map}
    (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f)
    (hg : UniformContinuousOn G g)
    (hmap : MapsInto E G f) :
    UniformContinuousOn E (CompFun g f)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hg eps heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases hf eta heta.left with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          intro x y hx hy hxy
          unfold CompFun
          exact heta.right (f x) (f y)
            (hmap x hx) (hmap y hy)
            (hdelta.right x y hx hy hxy)

name: uniformContinuousOn_maps_seqCauchy
statement:
theorem uniformContinuousOn_maps_seqCauchy
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f)
    {u : Nat -> Point}
    (huE : forall n : Nat, E (u n))
    (hu : RealTheory.SeqCauchy u) :
    RealTheory.SeqCauchy (fun n : Nat => f (u n))
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases hu delta hdelta.left with
      | intro N hN =>
          refine Exists.intro N ?_
          intro n m hn hm
          have hclose := hN n m hn hm
          change RealTheory.lt (dist (u n) (u m)) delta at hclose
          exact hdelta.right (u n) (u m) (huE n) (huE m) hclose

name: uniformContinuousOn_seqTendsto_image
statement:
theorem uniformContinuousOn_seqTendsto_image
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f)
    {u : Nat -> Point} {x0 : Point}
    (huE : forall n : Nat, E (u n))
    (hu : RealTheory.SeqTendsto u x0)
    (hx0 : E x0) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto (fun n : Nat => f (u n)) (f x0)
proof:
:=
  (continuousOn_to_sequential
    (uniformContinuousOn_to_continuousOn hf)
    x0 hx0).right u huE hu

name: uniformTube_halfRadius_pos

private theorem uniformTube_halfRadius_pos

name: uniformTube_halfRadius_lt_radius
