name: uniformTube_center_mem_coverSet
statement:
private theorem uniformTube_center_mem_coverSet
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {eps : Point}
    (T : UniformTube E f eps) :
    T.coverSet T.center
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hhalf : F.lt F.zero T.halfRadius :=
    uniformTube_halfRadius_pos T
  unfold UniformTube.coverSet
  constructor
  · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hhalf
  · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hhalf

name: dist_lt_uniformTube_halfRadius_of_mem_coverSet
statement:
private theorem dist_lt_uniformTube_halfRadius_of_mem_coverSet
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {eps x : Point}
    (T : UniformTube E f eps)
    (hx : T.coverSet x) :
    RealTheory.lt (dist x T.center) T.halfRadius
proof:
:= by
  unfold UniformTube.coverSet at hx
  exact dist_lt_of_mem_center_interval hx

name: uniformTubeListRadius_pos
statement:
private theorem uniformTubeListRadius_pos
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {eps : Point} :
    forall Ts : List (ULift (UniformTube E f eps)),
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (uniformTubeListRadius Ts)
  | [] => RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  | T :: rest =>
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (uniformTube_halfRadius_pos T.down)
        (uniformTubeListRadius_pos rest)

private theorem uniformTubeListRadius_le_of_mem
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {eps : Point} :
    forall {Ts : List (ULift (UniformTube E f eps))}
      {T : ULift (UniformTube E f eps)},
        List.Mem T Ts ->
          RealTheory.le (uniformTubeListRadius Ts) T.down.halfRadius
  | [], T, hmem => nomatch hmem
  | head :: rest, T, hmem => by
      cases hmem with
      | head =>
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            head.down.halfRadius
            (uniformTubeListRadius rest)
      | tail _ htail =>
          exact RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le_trans
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              head.down.halfRadius
              (uniformTubeListRadius rest))
            (uniformTubeListRadius_le_of_mem htail)

/
proof covers `E` by the open inner halves of continuity tubes at half the
tolerance, extracts a finite subcover, and takes the minimum radius; that
finite minimum is exactly what a non-compact set cannot supply. The
equal-partition integral opens with it
(`Tautology.RealIntegral.EqualPartition`) and the Riemann
Weierstrass approximation arguments quote it as well. -/

name: uniformTubeListRadius_le_of_mem
statement:
private theorem uniformTubeListRadius_le_of_mem
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {eps : Point} :
    forall {Ts : List (ULift (UniformTube E f eps))}
      {T : ULift (UniformTube E f eps)},
        List.Mem T Ts ->
          RealTheory.le (uniformTubeListRadius Ts) T.down.halfRadius
  | [], T, hmem => nomatch hmem
  | head :: rest, T, hmem => by
      cases hmem with
      | head =>
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            head.down.halfRadius
            (uniformTubeListRadius rest)
      | tail _ htail =>
          exact RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le_trans
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              head.down.halfRadius
              (uniformTubeListRadius rest))
            (uniformTubeListRadius_le_of_mem htail)

/
proof covers `E` by the open inner halves of continuity tubes at half the
tolerance, extracts a finite subcover, and takes the minimum radius; that
finite minimum is exactly what a non-compact set cannot supply. The
equal-partition integral opens with it
(`Tautology.RealIntegral.EqualPartition`) and the Riemann
Weierstrass approximation arguments quote it as well. -/

name: continuousOn_compact_uniformContinuousOn
statement:
theorem continuousOn_compact_uniformContinuousOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hcompact : RealTheory.IsCompact.{u} E)
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f) :
    UniformContinuousOn E f
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : F.lt F.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  let U : ULift (UniformTube E f e2) -> Point -> Prop :=
    fun T => T.down.coverSet
  have hUopen : forall T : ULift (UniformTube E f e2),
      RealTheory.IsOpen (U T) := by
    intro T
    exact uniformTube_coverSet_open T.down
  have hcover : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Covers U E := by
    intro x hx
    cases (hf x hx).right e2 he2 with
    | intro radius hradius =>
        let T : UniformTube E f e2 := {
          center := x
          mem := hx
          radius := radius
          radius_pos := hradius.left
          maps := by
            intro y hy hydist
            by_cases hyx : y = x
            · rw [hyx, dist_self]
              exact he2
            · exact hradius.right y hy hyx hydist
        }
        refine Exists.intro (ULift.up T) ?_
        exact uniformTube_center_mem_coverSet T
  cases hcompact U hUopen hcover with
  | intro Ts hTs =>
      refine Exists.intro (uniformTubeListRadius Ts) ?_
      refine And.intro (uniformTubeListRadius_pos Ts) ?_
      intro x y hx hy hxy
      cases hTs x hx with
      | intro T hT =>
          have hxT_cover : U T x := hT.right
          have hxT_half :
              F.lt (dist x T.down.center) T.down.halfRadius :=
            dist_lt_uniformTube_halfRadius_of_mem_coverSet T.down hxT_cover
          have hdelta_le_half :
              F.le (uniformTubeListRadius Ts) T.down.halfRadius :=
            uniformTubeListRadius_le_of_mem hT.left
          have hxy_half :
              F.lt (dist x y) T.down.halfRadius :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxy hdelta_le_half
          have hyx_half :
              F.lt (dist y x) T.down.halfRadius := by
            rwa [dist_comm y x]
          have hyT_radius :
              F.lt (dist y T.down.center) T.down.radius := by
            have htri :
                F.le (dist y T.down.center)
                  (F.add (dist y x) (dist x T.down.center)) := by
              change
                F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F y T.down.center)
                  (F.add
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F y x)
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x T.down.center))
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle F y x T.down.center
            have hsum :
                F.lt
                  (F.add (dist y x) (dist x T.down.center))
                  T.down.radius := by
              have hsum_half :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hyx_half hxT_half
              have hhalf :
                  F.add T.down.halfRadius T.down.halfRadius =
                    T.down.radius := by
                unfold UniformTube.halfRadius
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F T.down.radius
              rwa [hhalf] at hsum_half
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum
          have hxT_radius :
              F.lt (dist x T.down.center) T.down.radius :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hxT_half
              (uniformTube_halfRadius_lt_radius T.down)
          have hx_image := T.down.maps x hx hxT_radius
          have hy_image := T.down.maps y hy hyT_radius
          have hy_image' :
              F.lt (dist (f T.down.center) (f y)) e2 := by
            rwa [dist_comm (f T.down.center) (f y)]
          have htri :
              F.le (dist (f x) (f y))
                (F.add
                  (dist (f x) (f T.down.center))
                  (dist (f T.down.center) (f y))) := by
            change
              F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f x) (f y))
                (F.add
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f x) (f T.down.center))
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f T.down.center) (f y)))
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle
              F (f x) (f T.down.center) (f y)
          have hsum :
              F.lt
                (F.add
                  (dist (f x) (f T.down.center))
                  (dist (f T.down.center) (f y))) eps := by
            have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hx_image hy_image'
            have hhalf : F.add e2 e2 = eps := by
              unfold e2
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps
            rwa [hhalf] at h
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: closureSeq_mem
statement:
private theorem closureSeq_mem
    {E : Domain} {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.Closure E x) :
    forall n : Nat, E (closureSeq E x hx n)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec
    (RealTheory.closurePoint_iff_exists_seqTendsto.mp hx)).left

name: closureSeq_tendsto
statement:
private theorem closureSeq_tendsto
    {E : Domain} {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.Closure E x) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto (closureSeq E x hx) x
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec
    (RealTheory.closurePoint_iff_exists_seqTendsto.mp hx)).right

name: uniformClosureExtensionValue_spec
statement:
private theorem uniformClosureExtensionValue_spec
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f)
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.Closure E x) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat => f (closureSeq E x hx n))
      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold uniformClosureExtensionValue
  rw [dif_pos hx]
  exact
    Classical.choose_spec
      (RealTheory.seqCauchy_converges
        (uniformContinuousOn_maps_seqCauchy hf
          (closureSeq_mem hx)
          (RealTheory.seqCauchy_of_seqTendsto
            (closureSeq_tendsto hx))))

name: uniformClosureExtensionValue_agrees_on
statement:
theorem uniformClosureExtensionValue_agrees_on
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f) :
    SameOn E (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf) f
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxE
  have hxClosure : RealTheory.Closure E x :=
    RealTheory.subset_closure E x hxE
  have hchosen :=
    uniformClosureExtensionValue_spec hf hxClosure
  have himage :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat => f (closureSeq E x hxClosure n)) (f x) :=
    uniformContinuousOn_seqTendsto_image hf
      (closureSeq_mem hxClosure)
      (closureSeq_tendsto hxClosure)
      hxE
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hchosen himage

name: closureSeq_mem_closure
statement:
private theorem closureSeq_mem_closure
    {E : Domain} {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.Closure E x) :
    forall n : Nat, RealTheory.Closure E (closureSeq E x hx n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  exact RealTheory.subset_closure E
    (closureSeq E x hx n)
    (closureSeq_mem hx n)

name: continuousClosureExtension_unique
statement:
theorem continuousClosureExtension_unique
    {E : Domain} {f g h : Map}
    (hg : ContinuousClosureExtension E f g)
    (hh : ContinuousClosureExtension E f h) :
    SameOn (RealTheory.Closure E) g h
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hgseq :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat => g (closureSeq E x hx n)) (g x) :=
    (continuousOn_to_sequential
      hg.continuous x hx).right
      (closureSeq E x hx)
      (closureSeq_mem_closure hx)
      (closureSeq_tendsto hx)
  have hhseq :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat => h (closureSeq E x hx n)) (h x) :=
    (continuousOn_to_sequential
      hh.continuous x hx).right
      (closureSeq E x hx)
      (closureSeq_mem_closure hx)
      (closureSeq_tendsto hx)
  have hsame :
      (fun n : Nat => g (closureSeq E x hx n)) =
        (fun n : Nat => h (closureSeq E x hx n)) := by
    funext n
    have hnE := closureSeq_mem hx n
    exact Eq.trans (hg.agrees (closureSeq E x hx n) hnE)
      (Eq.symm (hh.agrees (closureSeq E x hx n) hnE))
  rw [hsame] at hgseq
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hgseq hhseq

name: uniformClosureExtensionValue_unique_of_continuous
statement:
theorem uniformClosureExtensionValue_unique_of_continuous
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map}
    (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f)
    (hg : ContinuousClosureExtension E f g) :
    SameOn (RealTheory.Closure E)
      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf) g
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hchosen :=
    uniformClosureExtensionValue_spec hf hx
  have hgseq :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat => g (closureSeq E x hx n)) (g x) :=
    (continuousOn_to_sequential
      hg.continuous x hx).right
      (closureSeq E x hx)
      (closureSeq_mem_closure hx)
      (closureSeq_tendsto hx)
  have hsame :
      (fun n : Nat => f (closureSeq E x hx n)) =
        (fun n : Nat => g (closureSeq E x hx n)) := by
    funext n
    exact Eq.symm (hg.agrees (closureSeq E x hx n)
      (closureSeq_mem hx n))
  rw [hsame] at hchosen
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hchosen hgseq

name: uniformClosureExtensionValue_approximated
statement:
theorem uniformClosureExtensionValue_approximated
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f)
    {x eta gamma : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.Closure E x)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hgamma : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gamma) :
    Exists
      (fun a : Point =>
        And (E a)
          (And
            (RealTheory.lt (dist a x) eta)
            (RealTheory.lt
              (dist (f a) (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x))
              gamma)))
proof:
:= by
  cases closureSeq_tendsto hx eta heta with
  | intro Npos hNpos =>
      cases uniformClosureExtensionValue_spec hf hx gamma hgamma with
      | intro Nval hNval =>
          let N := Nat.max Npos Nval
          refine Exists.intro (closureSeq E x hx N) ?_
          refine And.intro (closureSeq_mem hx N) ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact hNpos N (Nat.le_max_left Npos Nval)
          · exact hNval N (Nat.le_max_right Npos Nval)

name: uniformClosureExtensionValue_continuousOn
statement:
theorem uniformClosureExtensionValue_continuousOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f) :
    ContinuousOn (RealTheory.Closure E)
      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf)
proof:
:= by
  intro x0 hx0
  refine And.intro hx0 ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : F.lt F.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hf e2 he2 with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      let d2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F delta
      have hd2 : F.lt F.zero d2 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hdelta.left
      let d4 := RealTheory.quarter delta
      have hd4 : F.lt F.zero d4 :=
        RealTheory.quarter_pos hdelta.left
      refine Exists.intro d2 ?_
      refine And.intro hd2 ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      cases uniformClosureExtensionValue_approximated
          hf hx hd4 (RealTheory.quarter_pos heps) with
      | intro a ha =>
          cases uniformClosureExtensionValue_approximated
              hf hx0 hd4 (RealTheory.quarter_pos heps) with
          | intro b hb =>
              have hx0b :
                  F.lt (dist x0 b) d4 := by
                have hbpos := hb.right.left
                rw [dist_comm x0 b]
                exact hbpos
              have hab_delta : F.lt (dist a b) delta := by
                have htri1 :
                    F.le (dist a b)
                      (F.add (dist a x) (dist x b)) := by
                  change
                    F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F a b)
                      (F.add
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F a x)
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x b))
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle F a x b
                have htri2 :
                    F.le (dist x b)
                      (F.add (dist x x0) (dist x0 b)) := by
                  change
                    F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x b)
                      (F.add
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x x0)
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x0 b))
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle F x x0 b
                have htri2_add :
                    F.le (F.add (dist a x) (dist x b))
                      (F.add (dist a x)
                        (F.add (dist x x0) (dist x0 b))) :=
                  F.add_le_add_left htri2 (dist a x)
                have htri :
                    F.le (dist a b)
                      (F.add (dist a x)
                        (F.add (dist x x0) (dist x0 b))) :=
                  F.le_trans htri1 htri2_add
                have hsum :
                    F.lt
                      (F.add (dist a x)
                        (F.add (dist x x0) (dist x0 b))) delta :=
                  RealTheory.add_lt_quarter_half_quarter
                    ha.right.left hxd hx0b
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum
              have hfab : F.lt (dist (f a) (f b)) e2 :=
                hdelta.right a b ha.left hb.left hab_delta
              have hfirst :
                  F.lt
                    (dist
                      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x) (f a))
                    (RealTheory.quarter eps) := by
                have haval := ha.right.right
                rw [dist_comm
                  (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x) (f a)]
                exact haval
              have htri1 :
                  F.le
                    (dist (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x)
                      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0))
                    (F.add
                      (dist (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x) (f a))
                      (dist (f a)
                        (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0))) := by
                change
                  F.le
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F
                      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x)
                      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0))
                    (F.add
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F
                        (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x) (f a))
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f a)
                        (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0)))
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle
                  F
                  (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x)
                  (f a)
                  (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0)
              have htri2 :
                  F.le
                    (dist (f a)
                      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0))
                    (F.add (dist (f a) (f b))
                      (dist (f b)
                        (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0))) := by
                change
                  F.le
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f a)
                      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0))
                    (F.add
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f a) (f b))
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f b)
                        (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0)))
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle
                  F (f a) (f b)
                  (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0)
              have htri2_add :
                  F.le
                    (F.add
                      (dist (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x) (f a))
                      (dist (f a)
                        (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0)))
                    (F.add
                      (dist (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x) (f a))
                      (F.add (dist (f a) (f b))
                        (dist (f b)
                          (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0)))) :=
                F.add_le_add_left htri2
                  (dist (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x) (f a))
              have htri :
                  F.le
                    (dist (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x)
                      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0))
                    (F.add
                      (dist (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x) (f a))
                      (F.add (dist (f a) (f b))
                        (dist (f b)
                          (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0)))) :=
                F.le_trans htri1 htri2_add
              have hsum :
                  F.lt
                    (F.add
                      (dist (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x) (f a))
                      (F.add (dist (f a) (f b))
                        (dist (f b)
                          (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf x0)))) eps :=
                RealTheory.add_lt_quarter_half_quarter
                  hfirst hfab hb.right.right
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: uniformClosureExtensionValue_boundedOn_of_bounded
statement:
theorem uniformClosureExtensionValue_boundedOn_of_bounded
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f)
    (hbdd : RealTheory.SetBounded E) :
    BoundedOn (RealTheory.Closure E)
      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf)
proof:
:=
  boundedOn_of_compact_of_continuousOn.{0}
    (RealTheory.compact_closure_of_bounded.{0} hbdd)
    (uniformClosureExtensionValue_continuousOn hf)

name: uniformContinuousOn_boundedOn_of_bounded
statement:
theorem uniformContinuousOn_boundedOn_of_bounded
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f)
    (hbdd : RealTheory.SetBounded E) :
    BoundedOn E f
proof:
:= by
  cases uniformClosureExtensionValue_boundedOn_of_bounded hf hbdd with
  | intro left hleft =>
      cases hleft with
      | intro right hbounds =>
          refine Exists.intro left ?_
          refine Exists.intro right ?_
          intro x hx
          have hxClosure : RealTheory.Closure E x :=
            RealTheory.subset_closure E x hx
          have hbound := hbounds x hxClosure
          have hagree :=
            uniformClosureExtensionValue_agrees_on hf x hx
          rw [<- hagree]
          exact hbound

name: uniformClosureExtensionValue_attainsMaximum_of_bounded
statement:
theorem uniformClosureExtensionValue_attainsMaximum_of_bounded
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f)
    (hne : Exists E)
    (hbdd : RealTheory.SetBounded E) :
    AttainsMaximumOn (RealTheory.Closure E)
      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf)
proof:
:=
  attainsMaximumOn_of_compact_of_continuousOn.{0}
    (RealTheory.closure_nonempty_of_nonempty hne)
    (RealTheory.compact_closure_of_bounded.{0} hbdd)
    (uniformClosureExtensionValue_continuousOn hf)

name: uniformClosureExtensionValue_attainsMinimum_of_bounded
statement:
theorem uniformClosureExtensionValue_attainsMinimum_of_bounded
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf : UniformContinuousOn E f)
    (hne : Exists E)
    (hbdd : RealTheory.SetBounded E) :
    AttainsMinimumOn (RealTheory.Closure E)
      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E f hf)
proof:
:=
  attainsMinimumOn_of_compact_of_continuousOn.{0}
    (RealTheory.closure_nonempty_of_nonempty hne)
    (RealTheory.compact_closure_of_bounded.{0} hbdd)
    (uniformClosureExtensionValue_continuousOn hf)

name: uniformClosureGluedValue_eq_left
statement:
theorem uniformClosureGluedValue_eq_left
    {E1 E2 : Domain} {f1 f2 : Map}
    (hf1 : UniformContinuousOn E1 f1)
    (hf2 : UniformContinuousOn E2 f2)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.Closure E1 x) :
    uniformClosureGluedValue E1 f1 hf1 E2 f2 hf2 x =
      uniformClosureExtensionValue E1 f1 hf1 x
proof:
:= by
  unfold uniformClosureGluedValue
  rw [dif_pos hx]

name: uniformClosureGluedValue_eq_right_of_not_left
statement:
theorem uniformClosureGluedValue_eq_right_of_not_left
    {E1 E2 : Domain} {f1 f2 : Map}
    (hf1 : UniformContinuousOn E1 f1)
    (hf2 : UniformContinuousOn E2 f2)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : Not (RealTheory.Closure E1 x)) :
    uniformClosureGluedValue E1 f1 hf1 E2 f2 hf2 x =
      uniformClosureExtensionValue E2 f2 hf2 x
proof:
:= by

name: uniformClosureGluedValue_agrees_left
statement:
theorem uniformClosureGluedValue_agrees_left
    {E1 E2 : Domain} {f1 f2 : Map}
    (hf1 : UniformContinuousOn E1 f1)
    (hf2 : UniformContinuousOn E2 f2) :
    SameOn E1
      (uniformClosureGluedValue E1 f1 hf1 E2 f2 hf2) f1
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxClosure : RealTheory.Closure E1 x :=
    RealTheory.subset_closure E1 x hx
  rw [uniformClosureGluedValue_eq_left hf1 hf2 hxClosure]
  exact uniformClosureExtensionValue_agrees_on hf1 x hx

name: uniformClosureGluedValue_agrees_right
statement:
theorem uniformClosureGluedValue_agrees_right
    {E1 E2 : Domain} {f1 f2 : Map}
    (hf1 : UniformContinuousOn E1 f1)
    (hf2 : UniformContinuousOn E2 f2)
    (hcompat :
      UniformClosureExtensionsAgreeOnOverlap E1 f1 hf1 E2 f2 hf2) :
    SameOn E2
      (uniformClosureGluedValue E1 f1 hf1 E2 f2 hf2) f2
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hx2 : RealTheory.Closure E2 x :=
    RealTheory.subset_closure E2 x hx
  by_cases hx1 : RealTheory.Closure E1 x
  · rw [uniformClosureGluedValue_eq_left hf1 hf2 hx1]
    have hoverlap := hcompat x (And.intro hx1 hx2)
    rw [hoverlap]
    exact uniformClosureExtensionValue_agrees_on hf2 x hx
  · rw [uniformClosureGluedValue_eq_right_of_not_left hf1 hf2 hx1]
    exact uniformClosureExtensionValue_agrees_on hf2 x hx

name: uniformClosureGluedValue_agrees_right_on_closure
statement:
theorem uniformClosureGluedValue_agrees_right_on_closure
    {E1 E2 : Domain} {f1 f2 : Map}

    (hcompat :

      (uniformClosureExtensionValue E2 f2 hf2)
proof:
:= by

  · rw [uniformClosureGluedValue_eq_left hf1 hf2 hx1]

name: uniformClosureGluedValue_continuousOn
statement:
theorem uniformClosureGluedValue_continuousOn
    {E1 E2 : Domain} {f1 f2 : Map}
    (hf1 : UniformContinuousOn E1 f1)
    (hf2 : UniformContinuousOn E2 f2)
    (hcompat :
      UniformClosureExtensionsAgreeOnOverlap E1 f1 hf1 E2 f2 hf2) :
    ContinuousOn
      (SetPred.Union (RealTheory.Closure E1) (RealTheory.Closure E2))
      (uniformClosureGluedValue E1 f1 hf1 E2 f2 hf2)
proof:
:= by
  apply topologicallyContinuousOn_to_continuousOn
  exact topologicallyContinuousOn_closed_paste
    (RealTheory.closed_closure E1)
    (RealTheory.closed_closure E2)
    (continuousOn_to_topologicallyContinuousOn
      (uniformClosureExtensionValue_continuousOn hf1))
    (continuousOn_to_topologicallyContinuousOn
      (uniformClosureExtensionValue_continuousOn hf2))
    (uniformClosureGluedValue_agrees_left_on_closure hf1 hf2)
    (uniformClosureGluedValue_agrees_right_on_closure hf1 hf2 hcompat)

name: uniformClosureGluedValue_unique_of_continuous
statement:
theorem uniformClosureGluedValue_unique_of_continuous
    {E1 E2 : Domain} {f1 f2 g : Map}
    (hf1 : UniformContinuousOn E1 f1)
    (hf2 : UniformContinuousOn E2 f2)
    (hcompat :
      UniformClosureExtensionsAgreeOnOverlap E1 f1 hf1 E2 f2 hf2)
    (hg :
      ContinuousOn
        (SetPred.Union (RealTheory.Closure E1) (RealTheory.Closure E2)) g)
    (hg1 : SameOn E1 g f1)
    (hg2 : SameOn E2 g f2) :
    SameOn
      (SetPred.Union (RealTheory.Closure E1) (RealTheory.Closure E2))
      (uniformClosureGluedValue E1 f1 hf1 E2 f2 hf2) g
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  cases hx with
  | inl hx1 =>
      have hgOn1 : ContinuousOn (RealTheory.Closure E1) g :=
        continuousOn_subset
          (fun y hy => Or.inl hy) hg
      have huniq1 :
          SameOn (RealTheory.Closure E1)
            (uniformClosureExtensionValue E1 f1 hf1) g :=
        uniformClosureExtensionValue_unique_of_continuous
          hf1
          { continuous := hgOn1, agrees := hg1 }
      rw [uniformClosureGluedValue_eq_left hf1 hf2 hx1]
      exact huniq1 x hx1
  | inr hx2 =>
      have hgOn2 : ContinuousOn (RealTheory.Closure E2) g :=
        continuousOn_subset
          (fun y hy => Or.inr hy) hg
      have huniq2 :
          SameOn (RealTheory.Closure E2)
            (uniformClosureExtensionValue E2 f2 hf2) g :=
        uniformClosureExtensionValue_unique_of_continuous
          hf2
          { continuous := hgOn2, agrees := hg2 }
      have hright :=
        uniformClosureGluedValue_agrees_right_on_closure
          hf1 hf2 hcompat x hx2
      rw [hright]
      exact huniq2 x hx2

name: dist_left_endpoint_le_of_closedInterval
statement:
theorem dist_left_endpoint_le_of_closedInterval
    {x0 x t : Point}
    (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval x0 x t) :
    RealTheory.le (dist t x0) (dist x x0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hx0x : F.le x0 x := F.le_trans ht.left ht.right
  have ht_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub t x0) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F ht.left
  have hx_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub x x0) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hx0x
  unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  change F.le (RealTheory.abs (F.sub t x0)) (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x x0))
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg ht_nonneg]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hx_nonneg]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
    F ht.right (F.le_refl x0)

name: dist_right_endpoint_le_of_closedInterval
statement:

proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxx0 : F.le x x0 := F.le_trans ht.left ht.right
  have ht_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub x0 t) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F ht.right
  have hx_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub x0 x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hxx0
  unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  change F.le (RealTheory.abs (F.sub t x0)) (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x x0))
  rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm t x0]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm x x0]
  change F.le (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x0 t)) (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x0 x))
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg ht_nonneg]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hx_nonneg]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
    F (F.le_refl x0) ht.left

statement:
theorem frequentlyWithin_mono
    {E : Domain} {x0 : Point} {P Q : Point -> Prop}
    (hPQ : forall x : Point, P x -> Q x)

    FrequentlyWithin E x0 Q
proof:

  intro delta hdelta
  cases hP delta hdelta with
  | intro x hx =>
      refine Exists.intro x ?_
      exact And.intro hx.left
        (And.intro hx.right.left
          (And.intro hx.right.right.left
            (hPQ x hx.right.right.right)))

name: frequentlyWithin_of_cluster_eventually
statement:
theorem frequentlyWithin_of_cluster_eventually
    {E : Domain} {x0 : Point} {P : Point -> Prop}
    (hcluster : ClusterPoint E x0)
    (hP : EventuallyWithin E x0 P) :
    FrequentlyWithin E x0 P
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hP with
  | intro deltaP hdeltaP =>
      intro delta hdelta
      let radius := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F delta deltaP
      have hradius : F.lt F.zero radius :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdelta hdeltaP.left
      cases hcluster radius hradius with
      | intro x hx =>
          have hxE : E x := hx.left
          have hxne : Not (x = x0) := hx.right.left
          have hxr : F.lt (dist x x0) radius := hx.right.right
          have hxd : F.lt (dist x x0) delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxr
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F delta deltaP)
          have hxdP : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaP :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxr
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F delta deltaP)
          refine Exists.intro x ?_
          exact And.intro hxE
            (And.intro hxne
              (And.intro hxd (hdeltaP.right x hxE hxne hxdP)))

name: limsupWithin_le_of_eventually_lt_add
statement:
theorem limsupWithin_le_of_eventually_lt_add
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 L B : Point}
    (hL : IsLimsupWithin E f x0 L)
    (hB :
      forall eps : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
          EventuallyWithin E x0
            (fun x : Point =>
              RealTheory.lt (f x) (RealTheory.add B eps))) :
    RealTheory.le L B
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hLB : F.le L B
  · exact hLB
  · have hBL_le : F.le B L := by
      cases F.le_total B L with
      | inl hle => exact hle
      | inr hle => exact False.elim (hLB hle)
    have hBL : F.lt B L :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hBL_le hLB
    let eps := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.sub L B)
    have hgap : F.lt F.zero (F.sub L B) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hBL
    have heps : F.lt F.zero eps :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hgap
    cases hB eps heps with
    | intro delta hdelta =>
        cases hL.right eps heps delta hdelta.left with
        | intro x hx =>
            have hxE : E x := hx.left
            have hxne : Not (x = x0) := hx.right.left
            have hxd : F.lt (dist x x0) delta :=
              hx.right.right.left
            have hlow : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (f x) :=
              hx.right.right.right
            have hhigh : F.lt (f x) (F.add B eps) :=
              hdelta.right x hxE hxne hxd
            exact False.elim
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_between_sub_add_half F hlow hhigh)

name: tendstoWithin_isLimsupWithin

    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 L : Point}

proof:

  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base

  · intro eps heps

      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps L
      change F.lt (F.add L F.zero) (F.add L eps) at h
      rwa [F.add_zero] at h
    exact tendstoWithin_eventually_lt_of_lt_limit hf hL_lt_add
  · intro eps heps
    have hsub_lt : F.lt (F.sub L eps) L :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
    exact frequentlyWithin_of_cluster_eventually hcluster
      (tendstoWithin_eventually_lt_of_limit_lt hf hsub_lt)

name: mem_interval_of_dist_lt_min
statement:
theorem mem_interval_of_dist_lt_min
    {left center right x : Point}
    (hleft : RealTheory.lt left center)
    (hright : RealTheory.lt center right)
    (hdist :
      RealTheory.lt (dist x center)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (RealTheory.sub center left)
          (RealTheory.sub right center))) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base left right x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dl := F.sub center left
  let dr := F.sub right center
  let eps := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F dl dr
  have hdl : F.lt F.zero dl := by
    unfold dl
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hleft
  have hdr : F.lt F.zero dr := by
    unfold dr
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hright
  have hdist' : F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub x center)) eps := by
    unfold eps dl dr
    change
      F.lt (dist x center)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F
          (F.sub center left) (F.sub right center)) at hdist
    exact hdist
  have hleft_close : F.lt (F.sub center eps) x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hdist'
  have hright_close : F.lt x (F.add center eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hdist'
  have heps_dl : F.le eps dl :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F dl dr
  have heps_dr : F.le eps dr :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F dl dr
  have hleft_le :
      F.le left (F.sub center eps) := by
    have hsub :
        F.le (F.sub center dl) (F.sub center eps) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
        F (F.le_refl center) heps_dl
    have hcenter_dl : F.sub center dl = left := by
      unfold dl
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F center left
    rwa [hcenter_dl] at hsub
  have hright_le :
      F.le (F.add center eps) right := by
    have hadd : F.le (F.add center eps) (F.add center dr) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F heps_dr center
    have hcenter_dr : F.add center dr = right := by
      unfold dr
      calc
        F.add center (F.sub right center) =
            F.add (F.sub right center) center := by
              rw [F.add_comm]
        _ = right := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F right center
    rwa [hcenter_dr] at hadd
  exact And.intro
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hleft_le hleft_close)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hright_close hright_le)

name: dist_lt_of_mem_center_interval
statement:
theorem dist_lt_of_mem_center_interval
    {center radius x : Point}
    (hx :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (RealTheory.sub center radius)
        (RealTheory.add center radius) x) :
    RealTheory.lt (dist x center) radius
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub x center)) radius
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds F hx.left hx.right

name: topologicallyContinuousOn_congr
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  cases hf V hV with
  | intro W hW =>
      refine Exists.intro W ?_
      refine And.intro hW.left ?_
      intro x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        have hxE : E x := hx.left
        have hfx : V (f x) := by
          rw [hfg x hxE]
          exact hx.right
        exact (hW.right x).mp (And.intro hxE hfx)
      · intro hx
        have hpre := (hW.right x).mpr hx
        refine And.intro hpre.left ?_
        rw [<- hfg x hpre.left]
        exact hpre.right

name: topologicallyContinuousOn_const
statement:
theorem topologicallyContinuousOn_const {E : Domain} {c : Point} :
    TopologicallyContinuousOn E (fun _ => c)
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  by_cases hc : V c
  · refine Exists.intro (fun _ => True) ?_
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.open_universal
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    · intro x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        exact And.intro hx.left True.intro
      · intro hx
        exact And.intro hx.left hc
  · refine Exists.intro (fun _ => False) ?_
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.open_empty
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    · intro x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        exact False.elim (hc hx.right)
      · intro hx
        exact False.elim hx.right

name: topologicallyContinuousOn_preimage_closed
statement:
theorem topologicallyContinuousOn_preimage_closed
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {C : Domain}
    (hf : TopologicallyContinuousOn E f)
    (hC : RealTheory.IsClosed C) :
    RealTheory.ClosedIn E (PreimageOn E f C)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpreOpen :
      RealTheory.OpenIn E (PreimageOn E f (SetPred.Compl C)) :=
    hf (SetPred.Compl C) hC
  have hsame :
      SetPred.Same (PreimageOn E f (SetPred.Compl C))
        (SetPred.Diff E (PreimageOn E f C)) := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact And.intro hx.left
        (fun hxpre => hx.right hxpre.right)
    · intro hx
      refine And.intro hx.left ?_
      intro hfx
      exact hx.right (And.intro hx.left hfx)
  have hdiffOpen :
      RealTheory.OpenIn E (SetPred.Diff E (PreimageOn E f C)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.relativeOpen_congr F hpreOpen hsame
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.relativeClosed_of_diff_relativeOpen
    F (fun x hx => hx.left) hdiffOpen

name: topologicallyContinuousOn_of_preimage_closed
statement:
theorem topologicallyContinuousOn_of_preimage_closed
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf :
      forall C : Domain,
        RealTheory.IsClosed C ->
          RealTheory.ClosedIn E (PreimageOn E f C)) :
    TopologicallyContinuousOn E f
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hclosedCompl :
      RealTheory.IsClosed (SetPred.Compl V) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closed_compl_of_open F hV
  have hpreClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedIn E (PreimageOn E f (SetPred.Compl V)) :=
    hf (SetPred.Compl V) hclosedCompl
  have hdiffOpen :
      RealTheory.OpenIn E
        (SetPred.Diff E (PreimageOn E f (SetPred.Compl V))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.relativeOpen_diff_of_relativeClosed F hpreClosed
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.relativeOpen_congr F hdiffOpen
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine And.intro hx.left ?_
    classical
    by_cases hfx : V (f x)
    · exact hfx
    · exact False.elim (hx.right (And.intro hx.left hfx))
  · intro hx
    exact And.intro hx.left
      (fun hxpre => hxpre.right hx.right)

name: closedIn_of_closedIn_left_closed_subset_union
statement:
theorem closedIn_of_closedIn_left_closed_subset_union
    {A B U : Domain}
    (hAclosed : RealTheory.IsClosed A)
    (hU : RealTheory.ClosedIn A U) :
    RealTheory.ClosedIn (SetPred.Union A B) U
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hU with
  | intro C hC =>
      refine Exists.intro (SetPred.Inter A C) ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closed_inter F hAclosed hC.left
      · intro x
        constructor
        · intro hxU
          have hxAC := (hC.right x).mp hxU
          exact And.intro (Or.inl hxAC.left) hxAC
        · intro hx
          exact (hC.right x).mpr hx.right

name: closedIn_of_closedIn_right_closed_subset_union
statement:
theorem closedIn_of_closedIn_right_closed_subset_union
    {A B U : Domain}
    (hBclosed : RealTheory.IsClosed B)
    (hU : RealTheory.ClosedIn B U) :
    RealTheory.ClosedIn (SetPred.Union A B) U
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hU with
  | intro C hC =>
      refine Exists.intro (SetPred.Inter B C) ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closed_inter F hBclosed hC.left
      · intro x
        constructor
        · intro hxU
          have hxBC := (hC.right x).mp hxU
          exact And.intro (Or.inr hxBC.left) hxBC
        · intro hx
          exact (hC.right x).mpr hx.right

name: topologicallyContinuousOn_closed_paste
statement:
theorem topologicallyContinuousOn_closed_paste
    {A B : Domain} {f gA gB : Map}
    (hAclosed : RealTheory.IsClosed A)
    (hBclosed : RealTheory.IsClosed B)
    (hgA : TopologicallyContinuousOn A gA)
    (hgB : TopologicallyContinuousOn B gB)
    (hAgrees : SameOn A f gA)
    (hBagrees : SameOn B f gB) :
    TopologicallyContinuousOn (SetPred.Union A B) f
proof:
:= by
  apply topologicallyContinuousOn_of_preimage_closed
  intro C hC
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpreA : RealTheory.ClosedIn A (PreimageOn A gA C) :=
    topologicallyContinuousOn_preimage_closed hgA hC
  have hpreB : RealTheory.ClosedIn B (PreimageOn B gB C) :=
    topologicallyContinuousOn_preimage_closed hgB hC
  have hpreAonUnion :
      RealTheory.ClosedIn (SetPred.Union A B) (PreimageOn A gA C) :=
    closedIn_of_closedIn_left_closed_subset_union hAclosed hpreA
  have hpreBonUnion :
      RealTheory.ClosedIn (SetPred.Union A B) (PreimageOn B gB C) :=
    closedIn_of_closedIn_right_closed_subset_union hBclosed hpreB
  have hunionClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedIn (SetPred.Union A B)
        (SetPred.Union (PreimageOn A gA C) (PreimageOn B gB C)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.relativeClosed_union
      F hpreAonUnion hpreBonUnion
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.relativeClosed_congr F hunionClosed
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    cases hx with
    | inl hxA =>
        refine And.intro (Or.inl hxA.left) ?_
        rw [hAgrees x hxA.left]
        exact hxA.right
    | inr hxB =>
        refine And.intro (Or.inr hxB.left) ?_
        rw [hBagrees x hxB.left]
        exact hxB.right
  · intro hx
    cases hx.left with
    | inl hxA =>
        have hCgA : C (gA x) := by
          rw [<- hAgrees x hxA]
          exact hx.right
        exact Or.inl (And.intro hxA hCgA)
    | inr hxB =>
        have hCgB : C (gB x) := by
          rw [<- hBagrees x hxB]
          exact hx.right
        exact Or.inr (And.intro hxB hCgB)

name: continuousOn_to_topologicallyContinuousOn
statement:
theorem continuousOn_to_topologicallyContinuousOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f) :
    TopologicallyContinuousOn E f
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let U : LocalTube E f V -> Point -> Prop :=
    fun T => T.interval
  refine Exists.intro (SetPred.IndexedUnion U) ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.open_indexedUnion F
    intro T
    unfold U
    unfold LocalTube.interval
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.open_interval F
      (F.sub T.center T.radius) (F.add T.center T.radius)
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hcont := hf x hx.left
      cases hV (f x) hx.right with
      | intro left hleft =>
          cases hleft with
          | intro right hright =>
              let dl := F.sub (f x) left
              let dr := F.sub right (f x)
              let eps := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F dl dr
              have hdl : F.lt F.zero dl := by
                unfold dl
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hright.left
              have hdr : F.lt F.zero dr := by
                unfold dr
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt
                  F hright.right.left
              have heps : F.lt F.zero eps :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdl hdr
              cases hcont.right eps heps with
              | intro delta hdelta =>
                  let T : LocalTube E f V := {
                    center := x
                    mem := hx
                    radius := delta
                    radius_pos := hdelta.left
                    maps_punctured := by
                      intro y hyE hyne hydist
                      have hyclose := hdelta.right y hyE hyne hydist
                      have hyinterval :
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval
                            F left right (f y) :=
                        mem_interval_of_dist_lt_min
                          hright.left hright.right.left hyclose
                      exact hright.right.right (f y) hyinterval
                  }
                  refine And.intro hx.left ?_
                  refine Exists.intro T ?_
                  unfold U
                  unfold LocalTube.interval
                  constructor
                  · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos
                      F hdelta.left
                  · have hright_delta : F.lt x (F.add x delta) := by
                      have h :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
                          F hdelta.left x
                      change F.lt (F.add x F.zero) (F.add x delta) at h
                      rwa [F.add_zero] at h
                    exact hright_delta
    · intro hx
      cases hx.right with
      | intro T hTx =>
          by_cases hcenter : x = T.center
          · rw [hcenter]
            exact T.mem
          · refine And.intro hx.left ?_
            have hdist : RealTheory.lt (dist x T.center) T.radius := by
              unfold U at hTx
              exact dist_lt_of_mem_center_interval hTx
            exact T.maps_punctured x hx.left hcenter hdist

name: topologicallyContinuousOn_to_continuousOn
statement:
theorem topologicallyContinuousOn_to_continuousOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf : TopologicallyContinuousOn E f) :
    ContinuousOn E f
proof:
:= by
  intro x0 hx0
  refine And.intro hx0 ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let V : Point -> Prop :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval F
      (F.sub (f x0) eps) (F.add (f x0) eps)
  have hVopen : RealTheory.IsOpen V := by
    unfold V
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.open_interval F
      (F.sub (f x0) eps) (F.add (f x0) eps)
  have hx0V : V (f x0) := by
    unfold V
    constructor
    · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
    · have h :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps (f x0)
      change F.lt (F.add (f x0) F.zero) (F.add (f x0) eps) at h
      rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  cases hf V hVopen with
  | intro W hW =>
      have hx0U : PreimageOn E f V x0 :=
        And.intro hx0 hx0V
      have hx0W : W x0 :=
        ((hW.right x0).mp hx0U).right
      cases hW.left x0 hx0W with
      | intro left hleft =>
          cases hleft with
          | intro right hright =>
              let dl := F.sub x0 left
              let dr := F.sub right x0
              let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F dl dr
              have hdl : F.lt F.zero dl := by
                unfold dl
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hright.left
              have hdr : F.lt F.zero dr := by
                unfold dr
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt
                  F hright.right.left
              have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdl hdr
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro hdelta ?_
              intro x hxE hxne hxd
              have hxinterval :
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval F left right x :=
                mem_interval_of_dist_lt_min
                  hright.left hright.right.left hxd
              have hxW : W x := hright.right.right x hxinterval
              have hxU : PreimageOn E f V x :=
                (hW.right x).mpr (And.intro hxE hxW)
              have hfxV : V (f x) := hxU.right
              unfold V at hfxV
              change
                F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) (f x0)))
                  eps
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
                F hfxV.left hfxV.right

name: continuousOn_iff_topologicallyContinuousOn
statement:
theorem continuousOn_iff_topologicallyContinuousOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} :
    ContinuousOn E f <-> TopologicallyContinuousOn E f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact continuousOn_to_topologicallyContinuousOn
  · exact topologicallyContinuousOn_to_continuousOn

name: tendstoWithin_universal_of_left_right
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_universal_of_left_right
    {f : Map} {x L : Point}
    (hL : LeftTendstoWithin UniversalDomain f x L)
    (hR : RightTendstoWithin UniversalDomain f x L) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain f x L
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hL eps heps with
  | intro deltaL hdeltaL =>
      cases hR eps heps with
      | intro deltaR hdeltaR =>
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaL deltaR
          have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
              F hdeltaL.left hdeltaR.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta ?_
          intro y hy hyne hyd
          have hydL : F.lt (dist y x) deltaL :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hyd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaL deltaR)
          have hydR : F.lt (dist y x) deltaR :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hyd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaL deltaR)
          cases F.le_total y x with
          | inl hyx =>
              by_cases hxy : F.le x y
              · have hy_eq : y = x := F.le_antisymm hyx hxy
                exact False.elim (hyne hy_eq)
              · have hy_lt : F.lt y x :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyx hxy
                exact hdeltaL.right y
                  (And.intro True.intro hy_lt) hyne hydL
          | inr hxy =>
              by_cases hyx : F.le y x
              · have hy_eq : y = x := F.le_antisymm hyx hxy
                exact False.elim (hyne hy_eq)
              · have hx_lt : F.lt x y :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hyx
                exact hdeltaR.right y
                  (And.intro True.intro hx_lt) hyne hydR

name: tendstoWithin_comp_tendstoWithin
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_comp_tendstoWithin
    {E G : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 A L : Point}
    (hf : TendstoWithin E f x0 A)
    (hg : TendstoWithin G g A L)
    (hmap : ∀ x, E x -> Not (x = x0) -> G (f x))
    (hneq : ∀ x, E x -> Not (x = x0) -> Not (f x = A)) :
    TendstoWithin E (CompFun g f) x0 L
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hg eps heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases hf eta heta.left with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hclose := hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd
          unfold CompFun
          exact heta.right (f x) (hmap x hx hxne) (hneq x hx hxne)
            hclose

name: tendstoWithin_comp_tendstoWithin_of_eq_center

    (hg : TendstoWithin G g A L)
    (hmap : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (x = x0) -> G (f x))
    (hcenter : g A = L) :
    TendstoWithin E (CompFun g f) x0 L
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hg eps heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases hf eta heta.left with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hclose := hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd
          unfold CompFun
          by_cases hfx : f x = A
          case pos =>
            rw [hfx, hcenter, dist_self]
            exact heps
          case neg =>
            exact heta.right (f x) (hmap x hx hxne) hfx hclose

name: strictDecreasingOn_injectiveOn
statement:
theorem strictDecreasingOn_injectiveOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hstrict : StrictDecreasingOn E f) :
    forall x y : Point, E x -> E y -> f x = f y -> x = y
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hEq : x = y
  · exact hEq
  · cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hEq with
    | inl hlt =>
        have hflt : F.lt (f y) (f x) := hstrict x y hx hy hlt
        rw [hxy] at hflt
        exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (f y) hflt)
    | inr hgt =>
        have hflt : F.lt (f x) (f y) := hstrict y x hy hx hgt
        rw [hxy] at hflt
        exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (f y) hflt)

name: eventuallyWithin_and
statement:
theorem eventuallyWithin_and
    {E : Domain} {x0 : Point} {P Q : Point -> Prop}
    (hP : EventuallyWithin E x0 P)
    (hQ : EventuallyWithin E x0 Q) :
    EventuallyWithin E x0 (fun x => And (P x) (Q x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hP with
  | intro deltaP hdeltaP =>
      cases hQ with
      | intro deltaQ hdeltaQ =>
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaP deltaQ
          have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
              F hdeltaP.left hdeltaQ.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hxdP : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaP :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaP deltaQ)
          have hxdQ : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaQ :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaP deltaQ)
          exact And.intro
            (hdeltaP.right x hx hxne hxdP)
            (hdeltaQ.right x hx hxne hxdQ)

          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hxdF : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaF :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaF deltaG)
          have hxdG : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaG :=

name: tendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 A B : Point}
    (hcluster : ClusterPoint E x0)
    (hf : TendstoWithin E f x0 A)
    (hg : TendstoWithin E g x0 B)
    (hfg :
      EventuallyWithin E x0
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.le (f x) (g x))) :
    RealTheory.le A B
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hAB : F.le A B
  · exact hAB
  · have hBAle : F.le B A := by
      cases F.le_total B A with
      | inl hBA => exact hBA
      | inr hAB' => exact False.elim (hAB hAB')
    have hBA : F.lt B A :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hBAle hAB
    have hgap : F.lt F.zero (F.sub A B) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hBA
    let eps := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.sub A B)
    have heps : F.lt F.zero eps :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hgap
    cases hf eps heps with
    | intro deltaF hdeltaF =>
        cases hg eps heps with
        | intro deltaG hdeltaG =>
            cases hfg with
            | intro deltaO hdeltaO =>
                let deltaFG :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaF deltaG
                let delta :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaFG deltaO
                have hdeltaFG : F.lt F.zero deltaFG :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
                    F hdeltaF.left hdeltaG.left
                have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
                    F hdeltaFG hdeltaO.left
                cases hcluster delta hdelta with
                | intro x hx =>
                    have hxE : E x := hx.left
                    have hxne : Not (x = x0) := hx.right.left
                    have hxd : F.lt (dist x x0) delta := hx.right.right
                    have hxdFG : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaFG :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                          F deltaFG deltaO)
                    have hxdO : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaO :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                          F deltaFG deltaO)
                    have hxdF : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaF :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxdFG
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                          F deltaF deltaG)
                    have hxdG : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaG :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxdFG
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                          F deltaF deltaG)
                    have hfclose := hdeltaF.right x hxE hxne hxdF
                    have hgclose := hdeltaG.right x hxE hxne hxdG
                    have hfgx := hdeltaO.right x hxE hxne hxdO
                    have hlow : F.lt (F.sub A eps) (f x) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hfclose
                    have hmid : F.lt (F.sub A eps) (g x) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hlow hfgx
                    have hhigh : F.lt (g x) (F.add B eps) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hgclose
                    have hbad : F.lt (F.sub A eps) (F.add B eps) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hmid hhigh
                    have hcollapse :
                        F.add B eps = F.sub A eps := by
                      unfold eps
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_half_sub_eq_sub_half
                        F A B
                    rw [hcollapse] at hbad
                    exact False.elim
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
                        F (F.sub A eps) hbad)

theorem tendstoWithin_nonneg_of_eventually_nonneg

name: tendstoWithin_of_squeeze
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_of_squeeze
    {E : Domain} {lower f upper : Map} {x0 L : Point}
    (hlower : TendstoWithin E lower x0 L)
    (hupper : TendstoWithin E upper x0 L)
    (hlf :
      EventuallyWithin E x0
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.le (lower x) (f x)))
    (hfu :
      EventuallyWithin E x0
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.le (f x) (upper x))) :
    TendstoWithin E f x0 L
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hlower eps heps with
  | intro deltaL hdeltaL =>
      cases hupper eps heps with
      | intro deltaU hdeltaU =>
          cases eventuallyWithin_and hlf hfu with
          | intro deltaO hdeltaO =>
              let deltaLU :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaL deltaU
              let delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaLU deltaO
              have hdeltaLU : F.lt F.zero deltaLU :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
                  F hdeltaL.left hdeltaU.left
              have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
                  F hdeltaLU hdeltaO.left
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro hdelta ?_
              intro x hx hxne hxd
              have hxdLU : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaLU :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaLU deltaO)
              have hxdO : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaO :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaLU deltaO)
              have hxdL : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaL :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxdLU
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaL deltaU)
              have hxdU : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaU :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxdLU
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaL deltaU)
              have hlclose := hdeltaL.right x hx hxne hxdL
              have huclose := hdeltaU.right x hx hxne hxdU
              have horder := hdeltaO.right x hx hxne hxdO
              have hleft_lower : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (lower x) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hlclose
              have hleft_f : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (f x) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  F hleft_lower horder.left
              have hright_upper : F.lt (upper x) (F.add L eps) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F huclose
              have hright_f : F.lt (f x) (F.add L eps) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                  F horder.right hright_upper
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
                F hleft_f hright_f

name: tendstoWithin_zero_of_eventually_abs_le
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_zero_of_eventually_abs_le
    {E : Domain} {f bound : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hbound :
      EventuallyWithin E x0
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) (bound x)))
    (hbound_tendsto :
      TendstoWithin E bound x0 RealTheory.zero) :
    TendstoWithin E f x0 RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hbound_tendsto eps heps with
  | intro deltaT hdeltaT =>
      cases hbound with
      | intro deltaB hdeltaB =>
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaT deltaB
          have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
              F hdeltaT.left hdeltaB.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hxdT : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaT :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaT deltaB)
          have hxdB : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaB :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaT deltaB)
          have hle := hdeltaB.right x hx hxne hxdB
          have hbound_nonneg : F.le F.zero (bound x) :=
            F.le_trans (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f x)) hle
          have hbound_close := hdeltaT.right x hx hxne hxdT
          have hbound_lt_eps : F.lt (bound x) eps := by
            unfold dist at hbound_close
            change F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (bound x) F.zero)) eps at hbound_close
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (bound x)] at hbound_close
            rwa [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hbound_nonneg] at hbound_close
          have hf_abs_lt : F.lt (RealTheory.abs (f x)) eps :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle hbound_lt_eps
          unfold dist
          change F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (f x) F.zero)) eps
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (f x)]

name: tendstoWithin_eventually_lt_of_lt_limit
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_eventually_lt_of_lt_limit
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A c : Point}
    (hf : TendstoWithin E f x0 A)
    (hAc : RealTheory.lt A c) :
    EventuallyWithin E x0
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.lt (f x) c)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let eps := F.sub c A
  have heps : F.lt F.zero eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hAc
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      have hclose := hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd
      have hright : F.lt (f x) (F.add A eps) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hclose
      have hcollapse : F.add A eps = c := by
        unfold eps
        rw [F.add_comm A (F.sub c A)]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F c A
      rwa [hcollapse] at hright

name: tendstoWithin_eventually_lt_of_limit_lt
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_eventually_lt_of_limit_lt
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A c : Point}
    (hf : TendstoWithin E f x0 A)
    (hcA : RealTheory.lt c A) :
    EventuallyWithin E x0
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.lt c (f x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let eps := F.sub A c
  have heps : F.lt F.zero eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hcA
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      have hclose := hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd
      have hleft : F.lt (F.sub A eps) (f x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hclose
      have hcollapse : F.sub A eps = c := by
        unfold eps
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F A c
      rwa [hcollapse] at hleft

name: acIntervalFamilyOn_mono_closedInterval
statement:
private theorem acIntervalFamilyOn_mono_closedInterval
    {iota : Type u} {a b c d : Point}
    {l r : iota -> Point} {js : List iota}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c)
    (hd : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b d)
    (hfamily : ACIntervalFamilyOn c d l r js) :
    ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js
proof:
:= by
  exact
    And.intro hab
      (And.intro hfamily.right.left
        (And.intro
          (by
            intro i hi
            have hbounds := hfamily.right.right.left i hi
            exact And.intro
              (And.intro
                (RealTheory.le_trans hc.left hbounds.left.left)
                (RealTheory.le_trans hbounds.left.right hd.right))
              (And.intro
                (RealTheory.le_trans hc.left hbounds.right.left)
                (RealTheory.le_trans hbounds.right.right hd.right)))
          hfamily.right.right.right))

name: absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_mono
statement:
theorem absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_mono
    {F : Map} {a b c d : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d)
    (hdb : RealTheory.le d b)
    (hAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval F a b) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval F c d
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hcd ?_
  intro eps heps
  cases hAC.right eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro iota l r js hfamily hlength
      exact hdelta.right l r js
        (acIntervalFamilyOn_mono_closedInterval
          hAC.left
          (And.intro hac (RealTheory.le_trans hcd hdb))
          (And.intro (RealTheory.le_trans hac hcd) hdb)
          hfamily)
        hlength

name: acIntervalFamilyOn_singleton_of_closedInterval_ordered
statement:
private theorem acIntervalFamilyOn_singleton_of_closedInterval_ordered
    {a b x y : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y) :
    ACIntervalFamilyOn a b
      (fun _ : Unit => x) (fun _ : Unit => y) [()]
proof:
:= by
  exact
    And.intro hab
      (And.intro
        (by
          intro i hi
          cases i
          exact hxy)
        (And.intro
          (by
            intro i hi
            cases i
            exact And.intro hx hy)
          (And.intro
            (List.nodup_cons.mpr
              (And.intro (by intro h; cases h) (by simp)))
            (by
              unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
              exact List.Pairwise.cons
                (by intro j hj; cases hj)
                List.Pairwise.nil))))

proof:

  acIntervalFamilyOn_singleton_of_closedInterval_ordered
    hab hyx hy hx

name: acIntervalIncrementSum_singleton_eq_abs_sub
statement:
private theorem acIntervalIncrementSum_singleton_eq_abs_sub
    (F : Map) (x y : Point) :
    acIntervalIncrementSum F
      (fun _ : Unit => x) (fun _ : Unit => y) [()] =
        RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold acIntervalIncrementSum acIntervalIncrement
  change
    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)))
      RealTheory.zero =
        RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
  rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

name: acIntervalIncrementSum_singleton_eq_increment
statement:
theorem acIntervalIncrementSum_singleton_eq_increment
    (F : Map) {iota : Type u} (l r : iota -> Point) (i : iota) :
    acIntervalIncrementSum F l r [i] =
      acIntervalIncrement F l r i
proof:
:= by
  unfold acIntervalIncrementSum
  change
    RealTheory.add (acIntervalIncrement F l r i) RealTheory.zero =
      acIntervalIncrement F l r i
  rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

name: acIntervalIncrementSum_append
statement:
theorem acIntervalIncrementSum_append
    (F : Map) {iota : Type u} (l r : iota -> Point) :
    forall xs ys : List iota,
      acIntervalIncrementSum F l r (xs ++ ys) =
        RealTheory.add
          (acIntervalIncrementSum F l r xs)
          (acIntervalIncrementSum F l r ys)
  | [], ys => by
      change
        acIntervalIncrementSum F l r ys =
          RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
            (acIntervalIncrementSum F l r ys)
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  | i :: xs, ys => by
      change
        RealTheory.add (acIntervalIncrement F l r i)
          (acIntervalIncrementSum F l r (xs ++ ys)) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add (acIntervalIncrement F l r i)
                (acIntervalIncrementSum F l r xs))
              (acIntervalIncrementSum F l r ys)
      rw [acIntervalIncrementSum_append F l r xs ys]
      rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc]

private theorem acIntervalIncrementSum_range_eq_partitionVariation
    (F : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      acIntervalIncrementSum F
        (fun k : Nat => p k) (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1))
        (List.range n) =
          BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F p n
  | 0 => by
      change
        RealTheory.zero =
          BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F p 0
      unfold BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [List.range_succ]
      rw [acIntervalIncrementSum_append]
      rw [acIntervalIncrementSum_range_eq_partitionVariation F p n]
      rw [acIntervalIncrementSum_singleton_eq_increment]
      rw [BoundedVariation.partitionVariation_succ]
      unfold acIntervalIncrement BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm
      change
        RealTheory.add (BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F p n)
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F (p (n + 1))) (F (p n)))) =
            RealTheory.add (BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F p n)
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F (p (n + 1))) (F (p n))))
      rfl

private theorem intervalListLength_singleton_eq_sub
    (x y : Point) :
    RealInterval.intervalListLength
      (fun _ : Unit => x) (fun _ : Unit => y) [()] =
        RealTheory.sub y x
proof:
:= by
  unfold RealInterval.intervalListLength RealInterval.IntervalLengthAt
  change
    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub y x) RealTheory.zero =
      RealTheory.sub y x
  rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

name: acIntervalIncrementSum_range_eq_partitionVariation
statement:
private theorem acIntervalIncrementSum_range_eq_partitionVariation
    (F : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      acIntervalIncrementSum F
        (fun k : Nat => p k) (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1))
        (List.range n) =
          BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F p n
  | 0 => by
      change
        RealTheory.zero =
          BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F p 0
      unfold BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [List.range_succ]
      rw [acIntervalIncrementSum_append]
      rw [acIntervalIncrementSum_range_eq_partitionVariation F p n]
      rw [acIntervalIncrementSum_singleton_eq_increment]
      rw [BoundedVariation.partitionVariation_succ]
      unfold acIntervalIncrement BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm
      change
        RealTheory.add (BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F p n)
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F (p (n + 1))) (F (p n)))) =
            RealTheory.add (BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F p n)
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F (p (n + 1))) (F (p n))))
      rfl

private theorem intervalListLength_singleton_eq_sub
    (x y : Point) :
    RealInterval.intervalListLength
      (fun _ : Unit => x) (fun _ : Unit => y) [()] =
        RealTheory.sub y x
proof:
:= by
