name: sub_lt_of_dist_lt_of_le
statement:
private theorem sub_lt_of_dist_lt_of_le
    {x y delta : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hdist : RealTheory.lt (dist x y) delta) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub y x) delta
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hdist
  change
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub x y))
      delta
      at hdist
  rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm x y] at hdist
  have hnonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hxy
  change
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub y x) delta
  rwa [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hnonneg] at hdist

name: uniformContinuousOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
statement:
theorem uniformContinuousOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
    {F : Map} {a b : Point}
    (hAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval F a b) :
    UniformContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hAC.right eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x y hx hy hdist
      cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
      | inl hxy =>
          have hfamily :
              ACIntervalFamilyOn a b
                (fun _ : Unit => x) (fun _ : Unit => y) [()] :=
            acIntervalFamilyOn_singleton_of_closedInterval_ordered
              hAC.left hxy hx hy
          have hlength :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealInterval.intervalListLength
                  (fun _ : Unit => x) (fun _ : Unit => y) [()])
                delta := by
            rw [intervalListLength_singleton_eq_sub x y]
            exact sub_lt_of_dist_lt_of_le hxy hdist
          have hac :=
            hdelta.right
              (fun _ : Unit => x) (fun _ : Unit => y) [()]
              hfamily hlength
          rw [acIntervalIncrementSum_singleton_eq_abs_sub F x y] at hac
          change
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub (F y) (F x)))
              eps at hac
          unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
          change
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub (F x) (F y)))
              eps
          rwa [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm (F x) (F y)]
      | inr hyx =>
          have hfamily :
              ACIntervalFamilyOn a b
                (fun _ : Unit => y) (fun _ : Unit => x) [()] :=
            acIntervalFamilyOn_singleton_of_closedInterval_reverse
              hAC.left hyx hx hy
          have hlength :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealInterval.intervalListLength
                  (fun _ : Unit => y) (fun _ : Unit => x) [()])
                delta := by
            rw [intervalListLength_singleton_eq_sub y x]
            have hdist' : RealTheory.lt (dist y x) delta := by
              rwa [dist_comm y x]
            exact sub_lt_of_dist_lt_of_le hyx hdist'
          have hac :=
            hdelta.right
              (fun _ : Unit => y) (fun _ : Unit => x) [()]
              hfamily hlength
          rw [acIntervalIncrementSum_singleton_eq_abs_sub F y x] at hac
          change
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub (F x) (F y)))
              eps at hac
          unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
          change
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub (F x) (F y)))
              eps
          exact hac

name: continuousOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
statement:
theorem continuousOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
    {F : Map} {a b : Point}
    (hAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval F a b) :
    ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F
proof:
:=
  uniformContinuousOn_to_continuousOn
    (uniformContinuousOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hAC)

name: acIntervalFamilyOn_range_of_intervalPartition
statement:
private theorem acIntervalFamilyOn_range_of_intervalPartition
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    ACIntervalFamilyOn a b
      (fun k : Nat => p k)
      (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1))
      (List.range n)
proof:
:= by
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b :=
    IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_interval_le hp
  exact
    And.intro hab
      (And.intro
        (by
          intro k hmem
          exact IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_step_le hp
            (List.mem_range.mp hmem))
        (And.intro
          (by
            intro k hmem
            have hk : k < n := List.mem_range.mp hmem
            exact And.intro
              (IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left hp hk)
              (IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right hp hk))
          (And.intro List.nodup_range
            (IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_of_mem_lt
              hp (List.range n)
              (fun k hmem => List.mem_range.mp hmem)
              List.nodup_range))))

name: refinementBlock_intervalPartition
statement:
private theorem refinementBlock_intervalPartition
    {a b : Point} {merge coarse : Nat -> Point}
    {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href :
      IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines merge m coarse n cut)
    (hmerge : IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b m merge)
    {i : Nat} (hi : i < n) :
    IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
      (coarse i) (coarse (i + 1))
      (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i)
      (IntervalPartition.suffixPartition merge (cut i))
proof:
:= by
  have hcut_i_le_m : cut i <= m :=
    IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right href
      (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
  have hsuffix :
      IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
        (merge (cut i)) b (m - cut i)
        (IntervalPartition.suffixPartition merge (cut i)) :=
    IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_suffix hmerge hcut_i_le_m
  have hcut_succ_le_m : cut (i + 1) <= m :=
    IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right href
      (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
  have hcount_le :
      IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i <= m - cut i := by
    unfold IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength
    omega
  have hpref :=
    IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_prefix hsuffix hcount_le
  have hmono : cut i <= cut (i + 1) :=
    IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono_step href hi
  have hidx :
      cut i + IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i =
        cut (i + 1) := by
    unfold IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength
    exact Nat.add_sub_of_le hmono
  have hleft :
      merge (cut i) = coarse i :=
    IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href
      (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
  have hright :
      merge (cut (i + 1)) = coarse (i + 1) :=
    IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href
      (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
  change
    IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
      (merge (cut i))
      (IntervalPartition.suffixPartition merge (cut i)
        (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i))
      (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i)
      (IntervalPartition.suffixPartition merge (cut i)) at hpref
  rw [IntervalPartition.suffixPartition_step, hidx] at hpref
  rwa [hleft, hright] at hpref

name: partitionVariation_suffixPartition_block_eq
statement:
private theorem partitionVariation_suffixPartition_block_eq
    (F : Map) (merge : Nat -> Point) (cut : Nat -> Nat) (i : Nat) :
    BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F
      (IntervalPartition.suffixPartition merge (cut i))
      (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun h : Nat =>
          BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm F merge (cut i + h))
        (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
  intro h
  unfold BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm
  unfold IntervalPartition.suffixPartition
  have hidx : cut i + (h + 1) = cut i + h + 1 := by
    omega
  rw [hidx]

name: refinementBlockVariation_lt_ac_budget
statement:
private theorem refinementBlockVariation_lt_ac_budget
    {F : Map} {a b delta eps0 : Point}
    {merge coarse : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (hsmall :
      forall {iota : Type} (l r : iota -> Point) (js : List iota),
        ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js ->
          RealTheory.lt (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js) delta ->
            RealTheory.lt (acIntervalIncrementSum F l r js) eps0)
    (hmerge : IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b m merge)
    (hcoarse : IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b n coarse)
    (href :
      IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines merge m coarse n cut)
    (hcell :
      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
        RealTheory.lt (IntervalPartition.cellLength coarse i) delta)
    {i : Nat} (hi : i < n) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun h : Nat =>
          BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm F merge (cut i + h))
        (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i))
      eps0
proof:
:= by
  let block := IntervalPartition.suffixPartition merge (cut i)
  let count := IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i
  have hblock :
      IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
        (coarse i) (coarse (i + 1)) count block := by
    dsimp [block, count]
    exact refinementBlock_intervalPartition href hmerge hi
  have hlocalFamily :
      ACIntervalFamilyOn (coarse i) (coarse (i + 1))
        block (fun h : Nat => block (h + 1)) (List.range count) :=
    acIntervalFamilyOn_range_of_intervalPartition hblock
  have hfamily :
      ACIntervalFamilyOn a b
        block (fun h : Nat => block (h + 1)) (List.range count) :=
    acIntervalFamilyOn_mono_closedInterval
      (IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_interval_le hcoarse)
      (IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
        hcoarse hi)
      (IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
        hcoarse hi)
      hlocalFamily
  have hlength :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealInterval.intervalListLength
          block (fun h : Nat => block (h + 1)) (List.range count))
        delta := by
    rw [IntervalPartition.intervalListLength_range_of_intervalPartition_eq_sub hblock]
    change RealTheory.lt (IntervalPartition.cellLength coarse i) delta
    exact hcell i hi
  have hac :=
    hsmall block (fun h : Nat => block (h + 1))
      (List.range count) hfamily hlength
  rw [acIntervalIncrementSum_range_eq_partitionVariation F block count] at hac
  rw [partitionVariation_suffixPartition_block_eq F merge cut i] at hac
  exact hac

name: partitionVariation_le_nat_mul_ac_budget_of_partitionBlockRefines
statement:
private theorem partitionVariation_le_nat_mul_ac_budget_of_partitionBlockRefines
    {F : Map} {a b delta eps0 : Point}
    {merge coarse : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (hsmall :
      forall {iota : Type} (l r : iota -> Point) (js : List iota),
        ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js ->
          RealTheory.lt (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js) delta ->
            RealTheory.lt (acIntervalIncrementSum F l r js) eps0)
    (hmerge : IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b m merge)
    (hcoarse : IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b n coarse)
    (href :
      IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines merge m coarse n cut)
    (hcell :
      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
        RealTheory.lt (IntervalPartition.cellLength coarse i) delta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F merge m)
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
  have hblocks :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm F merge) m =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun h : Nat =>
                BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm F merge
                  (cut i + h))
              (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i))
          n := by
    have h :=
      IntervalPartition.finiteSum_cut_blocks
        (BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm F merge)
        (IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_left href)
        (fun i hi =>
          IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono_step
            href hi)
    rwa [IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_right href] at h
  rw [hblocks]
  have hle :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun h : Nat =>
                BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm F merge
                  (cut i + h))
              (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i))
          n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum (fun _ : Nat => eps0) n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun i : Nat =>
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat =>
            BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm F merge
              (cut i + h))
          (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i))
      (fun _ : Nat => eps0)
      n
      (fun i hi =>
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (refinementBlockVariation_lt_ac_budget
            hsmall hmerge hcoarse href hcell hi))
  rwa [RealTheory.finiteSum_const eps0 n] at hle

name: partitionVariation_le_nat_mul_ac_budget
statement:
private theorem partitionVariation_le_nat_mul_ac_budget
    {F : Map} {a b delta eps0 : Point} {N n : Nat}
    {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hsmall :
      forall {iota : Type} (l r : iota -> Point) (js : List iota),
        ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js ->
          RealTheory.lt (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js) delta ->
            RealTheory.lt (acIntervalIncrementSum F l r js) eps0)
    (hlarge :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b a)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N) delta))
    (hp : IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    RealTheory.le
      (BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F p n)
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N) eps0)
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b :=
    IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_interval_le hp
  have hlen_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hab
  have hN : Not (N = 0) := by
    intro hN0
    have hbad : C.lt (RealTheory.sub b a) C.zero := by
      rw [hN0] at hlarge
      change
        C.lt (RealTheory.sub b a)
          (C.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat C 0) delta)
        at hlarge
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero C] at hlarge
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul C] at hlarge
      exact hlarge
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt C hbad) hlen_nonneg
  let step := IntervalPartition.uniformStep a b N
  let coarse := IntervalPartition.uniformPartition a step
  have hstep_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero step := by
    dsimp [step]
    exact IntervalPartition.uniformStep_nonnegative hab hN
  have hspan :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N) step =
        RealTheory.sub b a := by
    dsimp [step]
    exact IntervalPartition.nat_mul_uniformStep hN
  have hcoarse :
      IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b N coarse := by
    dsimp [coarse]
    exact IntervalPartition.uniformPartition_intervalPartition
      hstep_nonneg hspan
  have hstep_lt : RealTheory.lt step delta := by
    dsimp [step]
    exact IntervalPartition.uniformStep_lt_of_intervalLength_lt_nat_mul
      hN hlarge
  have hcell :
      forall i : Nat, i < N ->
        RealTheory.lt (IntervalPartition.cellLength coarse i) delta := by
    intro i _hi
    dsimp [coarse, step]
    rw [IntervalPartition.cellLength_uniformPartition]
    exact hstep_lt
  have hpTag :
      IntervalPartition.TaggedPartition a b n p
        (IntervalPartition.leftTags p) :=
    IntervalPartition.leftTags_taggedPartition hp
  have hcoarseTag :
      IntervalPartition.TaggedPartition a b N coarse
        (IntervalPartition.leftTags coarse) :=
    IntervalPartition.leftTags_taggedPartition hcoarse
  cases
      IntervalPartition.exists_commonTaggedBlockRefinement
        hpTag hcoarseTag with
  | intro mergeCount hmergeCount =>
      cases hmergeCount with
      | intro merge hmerge =>
          cases hmerge with
          | intro mergeTag hmergeTag =>
              cases hmergeTag with
              | intro leftCut hleftCut =>
                  cases hleftCut with
                  | intro rightCut hcommon =>
                      have hmergePartition :
                          IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
                            a b mergeCount merge :=
                        (IntervalPartition.commonTaggedBlockRefinement_taggedPartition
                          hcommon).left
                      have hrefLeft :
                          IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
                            merge mergeCount p n leftCut :=
                        IntervalPartition.commonTaggedBlockRefinement_left_refines
                          hcommon
                      have hrefRight :
                          IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
                            merge mergeCount coarse N rightCut :=
                        IntervalPartition.commonTaggedBlockRefinement_right_refines
                          hcommon
                      have hp_le_merge :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F p n)
                            (BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F
                              merge mergeCount) :=
                        BoundedVariation.partitionVariation_le_of_partitionBlockRefines
                          hrefLeft
                      have hmerge_le_bound :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (BoundedVariation.partitionVariation F
                              merge mergeCount)
                            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N) eps0) :=
                        partitionVariation_le_nat_mul_ac_budget_of_partitionBlockRefines
                          hsmall hmergePartition hcoarse hrefRight hcell
                      exact RealTheory.le_trans hp_le_merge hmerge_le_bound

name: boundedVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
statement:
theorem boundedVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
    {F : Map} {a b : Point}
    (hAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval F a b) :
    BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b F
proof:
:= by
  cases hAC.right RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero_lt_one with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hlength_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hAC.left
      cases RealTheory.exists_nat_mul_gt hlength_nonneg hdelta.left with
      | intro N hlarge =>
          refine Exists.intro
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N) RealTheory.one) ?_
          refine And.intro hAC.left ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg
              (RealTheory.nat_nonneg N)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
          · intro n p hp
            have hpNeutral :
                IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b n p :=
              IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_intervalPartition hp
            exact
              partitionVariation_le_nat_mul_ac_budget
                hdelta.right
                hlarge hpNeutral

name: strictMonotoneOn_reflects_le
statement:
theorem strictMonotoneOn_reflects_le
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x y : Point}
    (hstrict : StrictMonotoneOn E f)
    (hx : E x) (hy : E y)
    (hfy : RealTheory.le (f x) (f y)) :
    RealTheory.le x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxy : F.le x y
  · exact hxy
  · have hyx : F.le y x := by
      cases F.le_total x y with
      | inl h => exact False.elim (hxy h)
      | inr h => exact h
    have hyx_lt : F.lt y x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyx hxy
    have hfyx : F.lt (f y) (f x) :=
      hstrict y x hy hx hyx_lt
    exact False.elim
      ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hfyx) hfy)

name: concaveOn_of_convexOn_strictMonotone_inverse
statement:
theorem concaveOn_of_convexOn_strictMonotone_inverse
    {E G : Domain} {f g : Map}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (hstrict : StrictMonotoneOn E f)
    (hG : ConvexSet G)
    (hg : MapsInto G E g)
    (hright : forall y : Point, G y -> f (g y) = y) :
    ConcaveOn G g
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro hG ?_
  intro theta y z htheta hy hz
  let c := ConvexCombo theta (g y) (g z)
  let C := ConvexCombo theta y z
  have hC : G C := hG theta y z htheta hy hz
  have hgy : E (g y) := hg y hy
  have hgz : E (g z) := hg z hz
  have hc : E c := by
    unfold c
    exact hconv.left theta (g y) (g z) htheta hgy hgz
  have hgC : E (g C) := hg C hC
  have hfconv :
      RealTheory.le (f c) C := by
    unfold c C
    have h := hconv.right theta (g y) (g z) htheta hgy hgz
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (f (ConvexCombo theta (g y) (g z)))
        (ConvexCombo theta (f (g y)) (f (g z))) at h
    rw [hright y hy, hright z hz] at h
    exact h
  have hf_le :
      RealTheory.le (f c) (f (g C)) := by
    rw [hright C hC]
    exact hfconv
  have hdirect : RealTheory.le c (g C) :=
    strictMonotoneOn_reflects_le hstrict hc hgC hf_le
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.neg (g C))
      (ConvexCombo theta
        (RealTheory.neg (g y)) (RealTheory.neg (g z)))
  rw [convexCombo_neg]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hdirect

name: pointOscillationZeroOn_of_functionContinuousAtOn
statement:
theorem pointOscillationZeroOn_of_functionContinuousAtOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hf : ContinuousAtOn E f x0) :
    PointOscillationZeroOn E f x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  intro eps heps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have he2_lt_eps : RealTheory.lt e2 eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps
  cases hf.right e2 he2_pos with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x y hx hy hxd hyd
      by_cases hx0 : x = x0
      · rw [hx0]
        by_cases hy0 : y = x0
        · rw [hy0, dist_self]
          exact heps
        · have hyclose : RealTheory.lt (dist (f y) (f x0)) e2 :=
            hdelta.right y hy hy0 hyd
          have hyclose' : RealTheory.lt (dist (f x0) (f y)) e2 := by
            rwa [dist_comm (f x0) (f y)]
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hyclose' he2_lt_eps
      · by_cases hy0 : y = x0
        · rw [hy0]
          have hxclose : RealTheory.lt (dist (f x) (f x0)) e2 :=
            hdelta.right x hx hx0 hxd
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hxclose he2_lt_eps
        · have hxclose : RealTheory.lt (dist (f x) (f x0)) e2 :=
            hdelta.right x hx hx0 hxd
          have hyclose : RealTheory.lt (dist (f x0) (f y)) e2 := by
            have hyclose' : RealTheory.lt (dist (f y) (f x0)) e2 :=
              hdelta.right y hy hy0 hyd
            rwa [dist_comm (f x0) (f y)]
          have htri :
              RealTheory.le (dist (f x) (f y))
                (RealTheory.add (dist (f x) (f x0)) (dist (f x0) (f y))) := by
            unfold dist
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle F (f x) (f x0) (f y)
          have hsum :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.add (dist (f x) (f x0)) (dist (f x0) (f y)))
                eps := by
            have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hxclose hyclose
            rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at h
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

      · exact False.elim

name: tendstoAtNegInf_unique
statement:
theorem tendstoAtNegInf_unique
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {A B : Point}
    (hunbounded : UnboundedBelow E)
    (hA : TendstoAtNegInf E f A)
    (hB : TendstoAtNegInf E f B) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hAB : A = B
  · exact hAB
  · let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    let gap := dist A B
    have hgap_pos : F.lt F.zero gap := by
      unfold gap
      exact dist_pos_of_ne hAB
    let eps := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F gap
    have heps : F.lt F.zero eps :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hgap_pos
    cases hA eps heps with
    | intro thresholdA hthresholdA =>
        cases hB eps heps with
        | intro thresholdB hthresholdB =>
            let threshold :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F thresholdA thresholdB
            cases hunbounded threshold with
            | intro x hx =>
                have hxE : E x := hx.left
                have hsmall : F.lt x threshold := hx.right
                have hsmallA : F.lt x thresholdA :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsmall
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                      F thresholdA thresholdB)
                have hsmallB : F.lt x thresholdB :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsmall
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                      F thresholdA thresholdB)
                have hnearA := hthresholdA x hxE hsmallA
                have hnearB := hthresholdB x hxE hsmallB
                have hnearA' : F.lt (dist A (f x)) eps := by
                  rwa [dist_comm A (f x)]
                have htri :
                    F.le (dist A B)
                      (F.add (dist A (f x)) (dist (f x) B)) := by
                  change
                    F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F A B)
                      (F.add
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F A (f x))
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f x) B))
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle F A (f x) B
                have hsum :
                    F.lt (F.add (dist A (f x)) (dist (f x) B))
                      (dist A B) := by
                  have hsum_eps :
                      F.lt
                        (F.add (dist A (f x)) (dist (f x) B))
                        (F.add eps eps) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hnearA' hnearB
                  have hhalf : F.add eps eps = dist A B := by
                    unfold eps
                    unfold gap
                    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F (dist A B)
                  rwa [hhalf] at hsum_eps
                have hbad : F.lt (dist A B) (dist A B) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum
                exact False.elim
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (dist A B) hbad)

proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hf e2 he2 with
  | intro thresholdF hthresholdF =>
      cases hg e2 he2 with
      | intro thresholdG hthresholdG =>
          let threshold := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2 F thresholdF thresholdG
          refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
          intro x hx hlarge
          have hlargeF : RealTheory.lt thresholdF x :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_left F thresholdF thresholdG)
              hlarge
          have hlargeG : RealTheory.lt thresholdG x :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_right F thresholdF thresholdG)
              hlarge
          have hfclose := hthresholdF x hx hlargeF
          have hgclose := hthresholdG x hx hlargeG
          have hsum :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.add (dist (f x) A) (dist (g x) B)) eps := by
            have hsum_e2 :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.add (dist (f x) A) (dist (g x) B))
                  (RealTheory.add e2 e2) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hfclose hgclose
            have hhalf : RealTheory.add e2 e2 = eps := by
              unfold e2
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps
            rwa [hhalf] at hsum_e2
          have htri :
              RealTheory.le
                (dist (AddFun f g x) (RealTheory.add A B))
                (RealTheory.add (dist (f x) A) (dist (g x) B)) := by
            unfold AddFun
            exact dist_add_le (f x) (g x) A B
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: tendstoAtInf_const_mul
statement:
private theorem tendstoAtInf_const_mul
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {A c : Point}
    {Tail : Point -> Point -> Prop}
    (hf :
      forall eps : Point, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
        Exists
          (fun threshold : Point =>
            forall x : Point, E x -> Tail threshold x ->
              RealTheory.lt (dist (f x) A) eps)) :
    forall eps : Point, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
      Exists
        (fun threshold : Point =>
          forall x : Point, E x -> Tail threshold x ->
            RealTheory.lt
              (dist
                (MulFun (fun _ : Point => c) f x)
                (RealTheory.mul c A)) eps)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let scale := RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs c) RealTheory.one
  let delta := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv scale) eps
  have habs_lt_scale : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs c) scale := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one (RealTheory.abs c)
    change F.lt (F.add (RealTheory.abs c) F.zero)
      (F.add (RealTheory.abs c) F.one) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hscale_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero scale :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg c) habs_lt_scale
  have hscale_ne : Not (scale = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hscale_pos h.symm
  have hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta := by
    dsimp [delta]
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hscale_pos) heps
  cases hf delta hdelta_pos with
  | intro threshold hthreshold =>
      refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
      intro x hx htail
      have hclose := hthreshold x hx htail
      have hdist_eq :
          dist (MulFun (fun _ : Point => c) f x)
              (RealTheory.mul c A) =
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) (dist (f x) A) := by
        unfold MulFun dist
        change
          F.abs (F.sub (F.mul c (f x)) (F.mul c A)) =
            F.mul (F.abs c) (F.abs (F.sub (f x) A))
        rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F c (f x) A]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F c (F.sub (f x) A)
      have hdist_le_delta : RealTheory.le (dist (f x) A) delta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hclose
      have hmul_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) (dist (f x) A))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) delta) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
          hdist_le_delta (RealTheory.abs_nonneg c)
      have hmul_lt_scale :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) delta)
            (RealTheory.mul scale delta) :=
        RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_right habs_lt_scale hdelta_pos
      have hscale_delta : RealTheory.mul scale delta = eps := by
        dsimp [delta]
        change F.mul scale (F.mul (F.inv scale) eps) = eps
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc scale (F.inv scale) eps]
        rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hscale_ne]
        rw [F.one_mul]
      rw [hdist_eq]
      have hlt :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) (dist (f x) A))
            (RealTheory.mul scale delta) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hmul_le hmul_lt_scale
      rwa [hscale_delta] at hlt

name: tendstoAtPosInf_unique
statement:
theorem tendstoAtPosInf_unique
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {A B : Point}
    (hunbounded : UnboundedAbove E)
    (hA : TendstoAtPosInf E f A)
    (hB : TendstoAtPosInf E f B) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hAB : A = B
  · exact hAB
  · let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    let gap := dist A B
    have hgap_pos : F.lt F.zero gap := by
      unfold gap
      exact dist_pos_of_ne hAB
    let eps := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F gap
    have heps : F.lt F.zero eps :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hgap_pos
    cases hA eps heps with
    | intro thresholdA hthresholdA =>
        cases hB eps heps with
        | intro thresholdB hthresholdB =>
            let threshold :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2 F thresholdA thresholdB
            cases hunbounded threshold with
            | intro x hx =>
                have hxE : E x := hx.left
                have hlarge : F.lt threshold x := hx.right
                have hlargeA : F.lt thresholdA x :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_left
                      F thresholdA thresholdB)
                    hlarge
                have hlargeB : F.lt thresholdB x :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_right
                      F thresholdA thresholdB)
                    hlarge
                have hnearA := hthresholdA x hxE hlargeA
                have hnearB := hthresholdB x hxE hlargeB
                have hnearA' : F.lt (dist A (f x)) eps := by
                  rwa [dist_comm A (f x)]
                have htri :
                    F.le (dist A B)
                      (F.add (dist A (f x)) (dist (f x) B)) := by
                  change
                    F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F A B)
                      (F.add
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F A (f x))
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (f x) B))
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle F A (f x) B
                have hsum :
                    F.lt (F.add (dist A (f x)) (dist (f x) B))
                      (dist A B) := by
                  have hsum_eps :
                      F.lt
                        (F.add (dist A (f x)) (dist (f x) B))
                        (F.add eps eps) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hnearA' hnearB
                  have hhalf : F.add eps eps = dist A B := by
                    unfold eps
                    unfold gap
                    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F (dist A B)
                  rwa [hhalf] at hsum_eps
                have hbad : F.lt (dist A B) (dist A B) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum
                exact False.elim
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (dist A B) hbad)

name: tendstoAtPosInf_le_of_eventually_le
statement:
theorem tendstoAtPosInf_le_of_eventually_le
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {A B : Point}
    (hunbounded : UnboundedAbove E)
    (hf : TendstoAtPosInf E f A)
    (hg : TendstoAtPosInf E g B)
    (hfg :
      EventuallyAtPosInf E
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.le (f x) (g x))) :
    RealTheory.le A B
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hAB : F.le A B
  · exact hAB
  · have hBAle : F.le B A := by
      cases F.le_total B A with
      | inl hBA => exact hBA
      | inr hAB' => exact False.elim (hAB hAB')
    have hBA : F.lt B A :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hBAle hAB
    have hgap : F.lt F.zero (F.sub A B) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hBA
    let eps := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.sub A B)
    have heps : F.lt F.zero eps :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hgap
    cases hf eps heps with
    | intro thresholdF hthresholdF =>
        cases hg eps heps with
        | intro thresholdG hthresholdG =>
            cases hfg with
            | intro thresholdO hthresholdO =>
                let thresholdFG :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2 F thresholdF thresholdG
                let threshold :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2 F thresholdFG thresholdO
                cases hunbounded threshold with
                | intro x hx =>
                    have hxE : E x := hx.left
                    have hlarge : F.lt threshold x := hx.right
                    have hlargeFG : F.lt thresholdFG x :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_left
                          F thresholdFG thresholdO)
                        hlarge
                    have hlargeO : F.lt thresholdO x :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_right
                          F thresholdFG thresholdO)
                        hlarge
                    have hlargeF : F.lt thresholdF x :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_left
                          F thresholdF thresholdG)
                        hlargeFG
                    have hlargeG : F.lt thresholdG x :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_right
                          F thresholdF thresholdG)
                        hlargeFG
                    have hfclose := hthresholdF x hxE hlargeF
                    have hgclose := hthresholdG x hxE hlargeG
                    have hfgx := hthresholdO x hxE hlargeO
                    have hlow : F.lt (F.sub A eps) (f x) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hfclose
                    have hmid : F.lt (F.sub A eps) (g x) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hlow hfgx
                    have hhigh : F.lt (g x) (F.add B eps) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hgclose
                    have hbad : F.lt (F.sub A eps) (F.add B eps) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hmid hhigh
                    have hcollapse :
                        F.add B eps = F.sub A eps := by
                      unfold eps
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_half_sub_eq_sub_half
                        F A B
                    rw [hcollapse] at hbad
                    exact False.elim
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
                        F (F.sub A eps) hbad)

name: tendstoAtPosInf_of_squeeze
statement:
theorem tendstoAtPosInf_of_squeeze
    {E : Domain} {lower f upper : Map} {L : Point}
    (hlower : TendstoAtPosInf E lower L)
    (hupper : TendstoAtPosInf E upper L)
    (hlf :
      EventuallyAtPosInf E
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.le (lower x) (f x)))
    (hfu :
      EventuallyAtPosInf E
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.le (f x) (upper x))) :
    TendstoAtPosInf E f L
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hlower eps heps with
  | intro thresholdL hthresholdL =>
      cases hupper eps heps with
      | intro thresholdU hthresholdU =>
          cases eventuallyAtPosInf_and hlf hfu with
          | intro thresholdO hthresholdO =>
              let thresholdLU :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2 F thresholdL thresholdU
              let threshold :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2 F thresholdLU thresholdO
              refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
              intro x hx hlarge
              have hlargeLU : F.lt thresholdLU x :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_left F thresholdLU thresholdO)
                  hlarge
              have hlargeO : F.lt thresholdO x :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_right F thresholdLU thresholdO)
                  hlarge
              have hlargeL : F.lt thresholdL x :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_left F thresholdL thresholdU)
                  hlargeLU
              have hlargeU : F.lt thresholdU x :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_right F thresholdL thresholdU)
                  hlargeLU
              have hlclose := hthresholdL x hx hlargeL
              have huclose := hthresholdU x hx hlargeU
              have horder := hthresholdO x hx hlargeO
              have hleft_lower : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (lower x) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hlclose
              have hleft_f : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (f x) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  F hleft_lower horder.left
              have hright_upper : F.lt (upper x) (F.add L eps) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F huclose
              have hright_f : F.lt (f x) (F.add L eps) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                  F horder.right hright_upper
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
                F hleft_f hright_f

name: tendstoWithinToPosInf_eventually_gt

    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 bound : Point}

name: tendstoWithinToPosInf_of_eventually_le
statement:
theorem tendstoWithinToPosInf_of_eventually_le
    {E : Domain} {lower f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hlower : TendstoWithinToPosInf E lower x0)
    (hlf :
      EventuallyWithin E x0
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.le (lower x) (f x))) :
    TendstoWithinToPosInf E f x0
proof:
:= by
  intro bound
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hlower bound with
  | intro deltaL hdeltaL =>
      cases hlf with
      | intro deltaO hdeltaO =>
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaL deltaO
          have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
              F hdeltaL.left hdeltaO.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hxdL : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaL :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaL deltaO)
          have hxdO : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaO :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaL deltaO)
          have hbig := hdeltaL.right x hx hxne hxdL
          have hle := hdeltaO.right x hx hxne hxdO
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hbig hle

name: tendstoAtPosInfToPosInf_of_eventually_le
statement:
theorem tendstoAtPosInfToPosInf_of_eventually_le
    {E : Domain} {lower f : Map}
    (hlower : TendstoAtPosInfToPosInf E lower)

            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2 F thresholdL thresholdO

name: exists_tendstoAtPosInf_of_monotoneOn_boundedAbove
statement:
theorem exists_tendstoAtPosInf_of_monotoneOn_boundedAbove
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hunbounded : UnboundedAbove E)
    (hmono : MonotoneOn E f)
    (hbdd :
      Exists
        (IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (Image E f))) :
    Exists (fun L : Point => TendstoAtPosInf E f L)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hne : Exists (Image E f) := by
    cases hunbounded RealTheory.zero with
    | intro x hx =>
        exact Exists.intro (f x)
          (Exists.intro x (And.intro hx.left rfl))
  cases RealTheory.current_bootstrap_complete_ordered_field.exists_lub
      (Image E f) hne hbdd with
  | intro L hL =>
      refine Exists.intro L ?_
      intro eps heps
      have hL_minus_lt_L : F.lt (F.sub L eps) L :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
      cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub
          F hL hL_minus_lt_L with
      | intro y hy =>
          cases hy.left with
          | intro base hbase =>
              have hbaseE : E base := hbase.left
              have hlow_base : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (f base) := by
                have h := hy.right
                rwa [<- hbase.right] at h
              refine Exists.intro base ?_
              intro x hx hlarge
              have hbase_le_x : F.le base x :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlarge
              have hbase_fx : F.le (f base) (f x) :=
                hmono base x hbaseE hx hbase_le_x
              have hlower : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (f x) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  F hlow_base hbase_fx
              have hupper_le : F.le (f x) L :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F hL
                  (Exists.intro x (And.intro hx rfl))
              have hupper : F.lt (f x) (F.add L eps) := by
                have hL_lt_add : F.lt L (F.add L eps) := by
                  have h :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps L
                  change F.lt (F.add L F.zero) (F.add L eps) at h
                  rwa [F.add_zero] at h
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                  F hupper_le hL_lt_add
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
                F hlower hupper

name: exists_tendstoAtNegInf_of_antitone_boundedAbove
statement:
theorem exists_tendstoAtNegInf_of_antitone_boundedAbove
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hunbounded : UnboundedBelow E)
    (hanti :
      forall x y : Point,
        E x -> E y -> RealTheory.le x y ->
          RealTheory.le (f y) (f x))
    (hbdd :
      Exists
        (IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (Image E f))) :
    Exists (fun L : Point => TendstoAtNegInf E f L)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hne : Exists (Image E f) := by
    cases hunbounded RealTheory.zero with
    | intro x hx =>
        exact Exists.intro (f x)
          (Exists.intro x (And.intro hx.left rfl))
  cases RealTheory.current_bootstrap_complete_ordered_field.exists_lub
      (Image E f) hne hbdd with
  | intro L hL =>
      refine Exists.intro L ?_
      intro eps heps
      have hL_minus_lt_L : F.lt (F.sub L eps) L :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
      cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub
          F hL hL_minus_lt_L with
      | intro y hy =>
          cases hy.left with
          | intro base hbase =>
              have hbaseE : E base := hbase.left
              have hlow_base : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (f base) := by
                have h := hy.right
                rwa [<- hbase.right] at h
              refine Exists.intro base ?_
              intro x hx hsmall
              have hx_le_base : F.le x base :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsmall
              have hbase_fx : F.le (f base) (f x) :=
                hanti x base hx hbaseE hx_le_base
              have hlower : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (f x) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  F hlow_base hbase_fx
              have hupper_le : F.le (f x) L :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F hL
                  (Exists.intro x (And.intro hx rfl))
              have hupper : F.lt (f x) (F.add L eps) := by
                have hL_lt_add : F.lt L (F.add L eps) := by
                  have h :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps L
                  change F.lt (F.add L F.zero) (F.add L eps) at h
                  rwa [F.add_zero] at h
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                  F hupper_le hL_lt_add
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
                F hlower hupper

name: openIn_preimageOn_of_openIn_image
statement:
theorem openIn_preimageOn_of_openIn_image
    {E U : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hf : TopologicallyContinuousOn E f)
    (hU : RealTheory.OpenIn (Image E f) U) :
    RealTheory.OpenIn E (PreimageOn E f U)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hU with
  | intro W hW =>
      have hpreW : RealTheory.OpenIn E (PreimageOn E f W) :=
        hf W hW.left
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.relativeOpen_congr F hpreW
      intro x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        refine And.intro hx.left ?_
        exact
          (hW.right (f x)).mpr
            (And.intro (image_intro hx.left) hx.right)
      · intro hx
        refine And.intro hx.left ?_
        exact ((hW.right (f x)).mp hx.right).right

name: connected_image_of_topologicallyContinuousOn
statement:
theorem connected_image_of_topologicallyContinuousOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hconn : RealTheory.IsConnected E)
    (hf : TopologicallyContinuousOn E f) :
    RealTheory.IsConnected (Image E f)
proof:
:= by
  intro U V hsep
  let Upre : Domain := PreimageOn E f U
  let Vpre : Domain := PreimageOn E f V
  have hUopen : RealTheory.OpenIn E Upre :=
    openIn_preimageOn_of_openIn_image hf hsep.left
  have hVopen : RealTheory.OpenIn E Vpre :=
    openIn_preimageOn_of_openIn_image hf hsep.right.left
  have hUnonempty : SetPred.Nonempty Upre := by
    have hUsub : SetPred.Subset U (Image E f) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.openIn_subset
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsep.left
    cases hsep.right.right.left with
    | intro y hy =>
        cases hUsub y hy with
        | intro x hx =>
            refine Exists.intro x ?_
            refine And.intro hx.left ?_
            rw [hx.right]
            exact hy
  have hVnonempty : SetPred.Nonempty Vpre := by
    have hVsub : SetPred.Subset V (Image E f) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.openIn_subset
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsep.right.left
    cases hsep.right.right.right.left with
    | intro y hy =>
        cases hVsub y hy with
        | intro x hx =>
            refine Exists.intro x ?_
            refine And.intro hx.left ?_
            rw [hx.right]
            exact hy
  have hcover : RealTheory.CoversByTwo E Upre Vpre := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hfx : Image E f (f x) := image_intro hx
      cases (hsep.right.right.right.right.left (f x)).mp hfx with
      | inl hU =>
          exact Or.inl (And.intro hx hU)
      | inr hV =>
          exact Or.inr (And.intro hx hV)
    · intro hx
      cases hx with
      | inl hxU => exact hxU.left
      | inr hxV => exact hxV.left
  have hdisjoint : SetPred.Disjoint Upre Vpre := by
    intro x hxU hxV
    exact hsep.right.right.right.right.right (f x) hxU.right hxV.right
  have hsepPre : RealTheory.IsSeparation E Upre Vpre := by
    refine And.intro hUopen ?_
    refine And.intro hVopen ?_
    refine And.intro hUnonempty ?_
    refine And.intro hVnonempty ?_
    exact And.intro hcover hdisjoint
  exact hconn Upre Vpre hsepPre

name: connected_image_of_continuousOn
statement:
theorem connected_image_of_continuousOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hconn : RealTheory.IsConnected E)
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f) :
    RealTheory.IsConnected (Image E f)
proof:
:=
  connected_image_of_topologicallyContinuousOn hconn
    (continuousOn_to_topologicallyContinuousOn hf)

name: intermediate_value_of_connected
statement:
theorem intermediate_value_of_connected
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hconn : RealTheory.IsConnected E)
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f)
    {x y z : Point}
    (hx : E x) (hy : E y)
    (hz : RealTheory.Between (f x) z (f y)) :
    Exists (fun c : Point => And (E c) (f c = z))
proof:
:= by
  have himage_conn : RealTheory.IsConnected (Image E f) :=
    connected_image_of_continuousOn hconn hf
  have himage_interval : RealTheory.IsIntervalSet (Image E f) :=
    RealTheory.intervalSet_of_connected himage_conn
  exact himage_interval (f x) z (f y)
    (image_intro hx) (image_intro hy) hz

name: intermediate_value_of_connected_unordered
statement:
theorem intermediate_value_of_connected_unordered
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hconn : RealTheory.IsConnected E)
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f)
    {x y z : Point}
    (hx : E x) (hy : E y)
    (hz :
      Or (RealTheory.Between (f x) z (f y))
        (RealTheory.Between (f y) z (f x))) :
    Exists (fun c : Point => And (E c) (f c = z))
proof:
:= by
  cases hz with
  | inl hxyz =>
      exact intermediate_value_of_connected hconn hf hx hy hxyz
  | inr hyxz =>
      exact intermediate_value_of_connected hconn hf hy hx hyxz

name: upperSemicontinuousAtOn_const
statement:
theorem upperSemicontinuousAtOn_const
    {E : Domain} {c x0 : Point}
    (hx : E x0) :
    UpperSemicontinuousAtOn E (fun _ => c) x0
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hx ?_
  intro eps heps
  exact eventuallyWithin_of_forall
    (fun x hx hxne =>
      by
        let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps c
        change F.lt (F.add c F.zero) (F.add c eps) at h
        rwa [F.add_zero] at h)

name: upper_lower_semicontinuousAtOn_to_continuousAtOn
statement:
theorem upper_lower_semicontinuousAtOn_to_continuousAtOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hupper : UpperSemicontinuousAtOn E f x0)
    (hlower : LowerSemicontinuousAtOn E f x0) :
    ContinuousAtOn E f x0
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hupper.left ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hupper.right eps heps with
  | intro deltaU hdeltaU =>
      cases hlower.right eps heps with
      | intro deltaL hdeltaL =>
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaU deltaL
          have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdeltaU.left hdeltaL.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hxdU : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaU :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaU deltaL)
          have hxdL : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaL :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaU deltaL)
          have hupper_x := hdeltaU.right x hx hxne hxdU
          have hlower_x := hdeltaL.right x hx hxne hxdL
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
            F hlower_x hupper_x

name: eventuallyWithin_of_left_right
statement:
theorem eventuallyWithin_of_left_right
    {E : Domain} {x0 : Point} {P : Point -> Prop}
    (hleft : LeftEventuallyWithin E x0 P)
    (hright : RightEventuallyWithin E x0 P) :
    EventuallyWithin E x0 P
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hleft with
  | intro deltaLeft hdeltaLeft =>
      cases hright with
      | intro deltaRight hdeltaRight =>
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaLeft deltaRight
          have hdelta_pos : F.lt F.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
              F hdeltaLeft.left hdeltaRight.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta_pos ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          cases F.le_total x x0 with
          | inl hx_le_x0 =>
              have hnot_x0_le_x : Not (F.le x0 x) := by
                intro hx0_le_x
                exact hxne (F.le_antisymm hx_le_x0 hx0_le_x)
              have hx_left : F.lt x x0 :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
                  F hx_le_x0 hnot_x0_le_x
              have hxd_left : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaLeft :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                    F deltaLeft deltaRight)
              exact hdeltaLeft.right x
                (And.intro hx hx_left) hxne hxd_left
          | inr hx0_le_x =>
              have hnot_x_le_x0 : Not (F.le x x0) := by
                intro hx_le_x0
                exact hxne
                  (Eq.symm (F.le_antisymm hx0_le_x hx_le_x0))
              have hx_right : F.lt x0 x :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
                  F hx0_le_x hnot_x_le_x0
              have hxd_right : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaRight :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                    F deltaLeft deltaRight)
              exact hdeltaRight.right x
                (And.intro hx hx_right) hxne hxd_right

name: universal_leftClusterPoint
statement:
theorem universal_leftClusterPoint (x0 : Point) :
    LeftClusterPoint UniversalDomain x0
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.exists_internalRat_between_sub_self
      (x := x0) heps with
  | intro q hq =>
      have hq_left : F.lt (F.sub x0 eps) q := hq.right.left
      have hq_lt : F.lt q x0 := hq.right.right
      have hq_ne : Not (q = x0) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hq_lt
      have hx0_lt_add : F.lt x0 (F.add x0 eps) := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps x0
        change F.lt (F.add x0 F.zero) (F.add x0 eps) at h
        rwa [F.add_zero] at h
      have hq_right : F.lt q (F.add x0 eps) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hq_lt hx0_lt_add
      have hdist : F.lt (dist q x0) eps := by
        unfold dist
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
          F hq_left hq_right
      exact Exists.intro q
        (And.intro (And.intro True.intro hq_lt)
          (And.intro hq_ne hdist))

name: universal_rightClusterPoint
statement:
theorem universal_rightClusterPoint (x0 : Point) :
    RightClusterPoint UniversalDomain x0
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.exists_internalRat_between_self_add
      (x := x0) heps with
  | intro q hq =>
      have hx0_lt_q : F.lt x0 q := hq.right.left
      have hq_right : F.lt q (F.add x0 eps) := hq.right.right
      have hq_ne : Not (q = x0) := by
        intro h
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx0_lt_q h.symm
      have hsub_lt : F.lt (F.sub x0 eps) x0 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
      have hq_left : F.lt (F.sub x0 eps) q :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hsub_lt hx0_lt_q
      have hdist : F.lt (dist q x0) eps := by
        unfold dist
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
          F hq_left hq_right
      exact Exists.intro q
        (And.intro (And.intro True.intro hx0_lt_q)
          (And.intro hq_ne hdist))

name: leftValue_lub_is_leftLimit
statement:
theorem leftValue_lub_is_leftLimit
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 L : Point}
    (hmono : MonotoneOn E f)
    (hL :
      IsLeastUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
        (LeftValueSet E f x0) L) :
    LeftTendstoWithin E f x0 L
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hL_minus_lt_L : F.lt (F.sub L eps) L :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub F hL hL_minus_lt_L with
  | intro y hy =>
      cases hy.left with
      | intro a ha =>
          have haLeft : LeftDomain E x0 a := ha.left
          have hlow_a : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (f a) := by
            have h := hy.right
            rwa [<- ha.right] at h
          let delta := F.sub x0 a
          have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta := by
            unfold delta
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F haLeft.right
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hxLeft : LeftDomain E x0 x := hx
          have hupper_le : F.le (f x) L :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F hL
              (Exists.intro x (And.intro hxLeft rfl))
          have hupper : F.lt (f x) (F.add L eps) := by
            have hL_lt_add : F.lt L (F.add L eps) := by
              have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps L
              change F.lt (F.add L F.zero) (F.add L eps) at h
              rwa [F.add_zero] at h
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hupper_le hL_lt_add
          have hax : F.lt a x := by
            have hleft_close : F.lt (F.sub x0 delta) x :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hxd
            have hcollapse : F.sub x0 delta = a := by
              unfold delta
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F x0 a
            rwa [hcollapse] at hleft_close
          have hfa_le_fx : F.le (f a) (f x) :=
            hmono a x haLeft.left hxLeft.left
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hax)
          have hlower : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (f x) := by
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hlow_a hfa_le_fx
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds F hlower hupper

name: rightValue_glb_is_rightLimit
statement:
theorem rightValue_glb_is_rightLimit
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 l : Point}
    (hmono : MonotoneOn E f)
    (hl :
      IsGreatestLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
        (RightValueSet E f x0) l) :
    RightTendstoWithin E f x0 l
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hl_lt_add : F.lt l (F.add l eps) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps l
    change F.lt (F.add l F.zero) (F.add l eps) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_gt_of_glb_lt F hl hl_lt_add with
  | intro y hy =>
      cases hy.left with
      | intro b hb =>
          have hbRight : RightDomain E x0 b := hb.left
          have hhigh_b : F.lt (f b) (F.add l eps) := by
            have h := hy.right
            rwa [<- hb.right] at h
          let delta := F.sub b x0
          have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta := by
            unfold delta
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hbRight.right
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hxRight : RightDomain E x0 x := hx
          have hlower_le : F.le l (f x) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.glb_le_of_mem F hl
              (Exists.intro x (And.intro hxRight rfl))
          have hlower : F.lt (F.sub l eps) (f x) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps)
              hlower_le
          have hxb : F.lt x b := by
            have hright_close : F.lt x (F.add x0 delta) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hxd
            have hcollapse : F.add x0 delta = b := by
              unfold delta
              calc
                F.add x0 (F.sub b x0) =
                    F.add (F.sub b x0) x0 := by rw [F.add_comm]
                _ = b := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b x0
            rwa [hcollapse] at hright_close
          have hfx_le_fb : F.le (f x) (f b) :=
            hmono x b hxRight.left hbRight.left
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxb)
          have hupper : F.lt (f x) (F.add l eps) := by
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hfx_le_fb hhigh_b
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds F hlower hupper

name: monotone_leftLimit_exists
statement:
theorem monotone_leftLimit_exists
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hx0 : E x0)
    (hcluster : LeftClusterPoint E x0)
    (hmono : MonotoneOn E f) :
    Exists (fun L : Point => LeftTendstoWithin E f x0 L)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : Exists (LeftValueSet E f x0) :=
    leftValueSet_nonempty_of_leftCluster hcluster
  have hbdd :
      Exists
        (IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (LeftValueSet E f x0)) :=
    Exists.intro (f x0)
      (leftValueSet_boundedAbove_of_monotone hx0 hmono)
  cases RealTheory.current_bootstrap_complete_ordered_field.exists_lub
      (LeftValueSet E f x0) hne hbdd with
  | intro L hL =>
      exact Exists.intro L (leftValue_lub_is_leftLimit hmono hL)

proof:

          (RightValueSet E f x0)) :=

name: monotone_leftLimit_exists_of_leftValueSet_boundedAbove
statement:
theorem monotone_leftLimit_exists_of_leftValueSet_boundedAbove
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hcluster : LeftClusterPoint E x0)
    (hmono : MonotoneOn E f)
    (hbdd :
      Exists
        (IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (LeftValueSet E f x0))) :
    Exists (fun L : Point => LeftTendstoWithin E f x0 L)
proof:
:= by

    leftValueSet_nonempty_of_leftCluster hcluster
  cases RealTheory.current_bootstrap_complete_ordered_field.exists_lub

  | intro L hL =>

name: antitone_rightLimit_exists_of_rightValueSet_boundedAbove
statement:
theorem antitone_rightLimit_exists_of_rightValueSet_boundedAbove
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hcluster : RightClusterPoint E x0)
    (hanti :
      forall x y : Point,
        E x -> E y -> RealTheory.le x y ->
          RealTheory.le (f y) (f x))
    (hbdd :
      Exists
        (IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (RightValueSet E f x0))) :
    Exists (fun L : Point => RightTendstoWithin E f x0 L)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hne : Exists (RightValueSet E f x0) :=
    rightValueSet_nonempty_of_rightCluster hcluster
  cases RealTheory.current_bootstrap_complete_ordered_field.exists_lub
      (RightValueSet E f x0) hne hbdd with
  | intro L hL =>
      refine Exists.intro L ?_
      intro eps heps
      have hL_minus_lt_L : F.lt (F.sub L eps) L :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
      cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub
          F hL hL_minus_lt_L with
      | intro y hy =>
          cases hy.left with
          | intro b hb =>
              have hbRight : RightDomain E x0 b := hb.left
              have hhigh_b : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (f b) := by
                have h := hy.right
                rwa [<- hb.right] at h
              let delta := F.sub b x0
              have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta := by
                unfold delta
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hbRight.right
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro hdelta ?_
              intro x hx hxne hxd
              have hxRight : RightDomain E x0 x := hx
              have hupper_le : F.le (f x) L :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F hL
                  (Exists.intro x (And.intro hxRight rfl))
              have hupper : F.lt (f x) (F.add L eps) := by
                have hL_lt_add : F.lt L (F.add L eps) := by
                  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps L
                  change F.lt (F.add L F.zero) (F.add L eps) at h
                  rwa [F.add_zero] at h
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                  hupper_le hL_lt_add
              have hxb : F.lt x b := by
                have hright_close : F.lt x (F.add x0 delta) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hxd
                have hcollapse : F.add x0 delta = b := by
                  unfold delta
                  calc
                    F.add x0 (F.sub b x0) =
                        F.add (F.sub b x0) x0 := by rw [F.add_comm]
                    _ = b := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b x0
                rwa [hcollapse] at hright_close
              have hfb_le_fx : F.le (f b) (f x) :=
                hanti x b hxRight.left hbRight.left
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxb)
              have hlower : F.lt (F.sub L eps) (f x) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hhigh_b hfb_le_fx
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
                F hlower hupper

name: rightLimit_le_value_of_monotone_universal
statement:
theorem rightLimit_le_value_of_monotone_universal
    {f : Map} {x z R : Point}
    (hmono : MonotoneOn UniversalDomain f)
    (hxz : RealTheory.lt x z)
    (hR : RightTendstoWithin UniversalDomain f x R) :
    RealTheory.le R (f z)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply rightTendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
    (universal_rightClusterPoint x)
    hR
    (tendstoWithin_const (RightDomain UniversalDomain x) (f z) x)
  let delta := F.sub z x
  have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta := by
    unfold delta
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxz
  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
  refine And.intro hdelta ?_
  intro t ht htne htd
  have ht_lt_z : F.lt t z := by
    have ht_bound : F.lt t (F.add x delta) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F htd
    have hcollapse : F.add x delta = z := by
      unfold delta
      calc
        F.add x (F.sub z x) =
            F.add (F.sub z x) x := by rw [F.add_comm]
        _ = z := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F z x
    rwa [hcollapse] at ht_bound
  exact hmono t z True.intro True.intro
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F ht_lt_z)

name: value_le_leftLimit_of_monotone_universal
statement:
theorem value_le_leftLimit_of_monotone_universal
    {f : Map} {z y L : Point}
    (hmono : MonotoneOn UniversalDomain f)
    (hzy : RealTheory.lt z y)
    (hL : LeftTendstoWithin UniversalDomain f y L) :
    RealTheory.le (f z) L
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply leftTendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
    (universal_leftClusterPoint y)
    (tendstoWithin_const (LeftDomain UniversalDomain y) (f z) y)
    hL
  let delta := F.sub y z
  have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta := by
    unfold delta
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hzy
  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
  refine And.intro hdelta ?_
  intro t ht htne htd
  have hz_lt_t : F.lt z t := by
    have ht_bound : F.lt (F.sub y delta) t :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F htd
    have hcollapse : F.sub y delta = z := by
      unfold delta
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F y z
    rwa [hcollapse] at ht_bound
  exact hmono z t True.intro True.intro
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hz_lt_t)

name: rightLimit_le_leftLimit_of_lt_universal
statement:
theorem rightLimit_le_leftLimit_of_lt_universal
    {f : Map} {x y R L : Point}
    (hmono : MonotoneOn UniversalDomain f)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (hR : RightTendstoWithin UniversalDomain f x R)
    (hL : LeftTendstoWithin UniversalDomain f y L) :
    RealTheory.le R L
proof:
:= by
  cases RealTheory.exists_internalRat_between hxy with
  | intro z hz =>
      exact RealTheory.le_trans
        (rightLimit_le_value_of_monotone_universal
          hmono hz.right.left hR)
        (value_le_leftLimit_of_monotone_universal
          hmono hz.right.right hL)

name: leftLimit_le_value_of_monotone_universal
statement:
theorem leftLimit_le_value_of_monotone_universal
    {f : Map} {x L : Point}
    (hmono : MonotoneOn UniversalDomain f)
    (hL : LeftTendstoWithin UniversalDomain f x L) :
    RealTheory.le L (f x)
proof:
:= by
  apply leftTendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
    (universal_leftClusterPoint x)
    hL
    (tendstoWithin_const (LeftDomain UniversalDomain x) (f x) x)
  exact eventuallyWithin_of_forall
    (fun t ht htne =>
      hmono t x True.intro True.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base ht.right))

name: value_le_rightLimit_of_monotone_universal
statement:
theorem value_le_rightLimit_of_monotone_universal
    {f : Map} {x R : Point}

name: monotoneDiscontinuity_jump_universal
statement:
theorem monotoneDiscontinuity_jump_universal
    {f : Map} {x : Point}
    (hmono : MonotoneOn UniversalDomain f)
    (hd : MonotoneDiscontinuityPoint UniversalDomain f x) :
    JumpPoint UniversalDomain f x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases monotone_leftLimit_exists
      (E := UniversalDomain) (f := f) (x0 := x)
      True.intro (universal_leftClusterPoint x) hmono with
  | intro L hL =>
      cases monotone_rightLimit_exists
          (E := UniversalDomain) (f := f) (x0 := x)
          True.intro (universal_rightClusterPoint x) hmono with
      | intro R hR =>
          have hL_fx : F.le L (f x) :=
            leftLimit_le_value_of_monotone_universal hmono hL
          have hfx_R : F.le (f x) R :=
            value_le_rightLimit_of_monotone_universal hmono hR
          by_cases hLR : F.lt L R
          · exact Exists.intro L
              (Exists.intro R
                (And.intro hL (And.intro hR hLR)))
          · have hRL : F.le R L :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hLR
            have hL_eq_fx : L = f x := by
              apply F.le_antisymm hL_fx
              exact F.le_trans hfx_R hRL
            have hR_eq_fx : R = f x := by
              apply F.le_antisymm
              · exact F.le_trans hRL hL_fx
              · exact hfx_R
            have hL' : LeftTendstoWithin
                UniversalDomain f x (f x) :=
              tendstoWithin_congr_limit hL_eq_fx hL
            have hR' : RightTendstoWithin
                UniversalDomain f x (f x) :=
              tendstoWithin_congr_limit hR_eq_fx hR
            have hcont : ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain f x :=
              And.intro True.intro
                (tendstoWithin_universal_of_left_right hL' hR')
            exact False.elim (hd.right hcont)

name: countable_of_rationalJumpCoding
statement:
theorem countable_of_rationalJumpCoding
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {J : Point -> Prop}
    (hcode : RationalJumpCoding E f J) :
    Foundation.Cardinal.CountableSet J
proof:
:= by
  cases hcode with
  | intro code hcode =>
      let Q : Point -> Prop := RealTheory.InternalRat
      have hQ : Foundation.Cardinal.CountableSet Q :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.internalRat_countable
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      exact Foundation.Cardinal.countableSet_of_injective_code
        (S := J) (T := Q) (code := code)
        hQ
        (fun x hx => (hcode.left x hx).left)
        hcode.right

name: rationalJumpSeparator_exists_of_jumpPoint
statement:
theorem rationalJumpSeparator_exists_of_jumpPoint
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x : Point}
    (hj : JumpPoint E f x) :
    Exists (fun q : Point => RationalJumpSeparator E f x q)
proof:
:= by
  cases hj with
  | intro leftLimit hleft =>
      cases hleft with
      | intro rightLimit hjump =>
          cases RealTheory.exists_internalRat_between
              hjump.right.right with
          | intro q hq =>
              exact Exists.intro q
                (And.intro hq.left
                  (Exists.intro leftLimit
                    (Exists.intro rightLimit
                      (And.intro hjump.left
                        (And.intro hjump.right.left
                          (And.intro hq.right.left
                            hq.right.right))))))

name: rationalJumpCode_spec
statement:
private theorem rationalJumpCode_spec
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x : Point}
    (hj : JumpPoint E f x) :
    RationalJumpSeparator E f x (rationalJumpCode E f x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hspec :=
    Classical.choose_spec
      (rationalJumpSeparator_exists_of_jumpPoint hj)
  simpa [rationalJumpCode, hj] using hspec

name: rationalJumpSeparator_lt_of_lt_universal
statement:
theorem rationalJumpSeparator_lt_of_lt_universal
    {f : Map} {x y qx qy : Point}
    (hmono : MonotoneOn UniversalDomain f)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (hxq : RationalJumpSeparator UniversalDomain f x qx)
    (hyq : RationalJumpSeparator UniversalDomain f y qy) :
    RealTheory.lt qx qy
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hxq.right with
  | intro leftX hxleft =>
      cases hxleft with
      | intro rightX hxjump =>
          cases hyq.right with
          | intro leftY hyleft =>
              cases hyleft with
              | intro rightY hyjump =>
                  have hright_left :
                      F.le rightX leftY :=
                    rightLimit_le_leftLimit_of_lt_universal
                      hmono hxy hxjump.right.left hyjump.left
                  have hqx_lt_leftY : F.lt qx leftY :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                      F hxjump.right.right.right hright_left
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
                    F hqx_lt_leftY hyjump.right.right.left

name: rationalJumpCoding_universal_of_monotone
statement:
theorem rationalJumpCoding_universal_of_monotone
    {f : Map}
    (hmono : MonotoneOn UniversalDomain f) :
    RationalJumpCoding UniversalDomain f
      (JumpPoint UniversalDomain f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let code := rationalJumpCode UniversalDomain f
  refine Exists.intro code ?_
  refine And.intro ?map ?inj
  · intro x hx
    exact rationalJumpCode_spec hx
  · intro x y hx hy hcode
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    by_cases hxyEq : x = y
    · exact hxyEq
    · cases F.le_total x y with
      | inl hxle =>
          have hxy : F.lt x y := by
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxle
            intro hyle
            exact hxyEq (F.le_antisymm hxle hyle)
          have hlt : F.lt (code x) (code y) :=
            rationalJumpSeparator_lt_of_lt_universal
              hmono hxy
              (rationalJumpCode_spec hx)
              (rationalJumpCode_spec hy)
          rw [hcode] at hlt
          exact False.elim
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (code y) hlt)
      | inr hyle =>
          have hyx : F.lt y x := by
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyle
            intro hxle
            exact hxyEq (F.le_antisymm hxle hyle)
          have hlt : F.lt (code y) (code x) :=
            rationalJumpSeparator_lt_of_lt_universal
              hmono hyx
              (rationalJumpCode_spec hy)
              (rationalJumpCode_spec hx)
          rw [hcode] at hlt
          exact False.elim
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (code y) hlt)

name: monotone_jumpPoints_countable_universal

theorem monotone_jumpPoints_countable_universal
