name: dist_add_le
statement:
theorem dist_add_le (x y a b : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (dist (RealTheory.add x y) (RealTheory.add a b))
      (RealTheory.add (dist x a) (dist y b))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.sub (F.add x y) (F.add a b)))
      (F.add
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub x a))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub y b)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F x y a b]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
    F (F.sub x a) (F.sub y b)

name: dist_neg_neg
statement:
theorem dist_neg_neg (x a : Point) :
    dist (RealTheory.neg x) (RealTheory.neg a) = dist x a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (F.neg x) (F.neg a)) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub x a)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F x a]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F (F.sub x a)

name: tendstoWithin_add
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base heps
  cases hf e2 he2 with
  | intro deltaF hdeltaF =>
      cases hg e2 he2 with
      | intro deltaG hdeltaG =>
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base deltaF deltaG
          have hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              hdeltaF.left hdeltaG.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hxdF : RealTheory.lt (dist x x0) deltaF :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base deltaF deltaG)
          have hxdG : RealTheory.lt (dist x x0) deltaG :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base deltaF deltaG)
          have hfclose := hdeltaF.right x hx hxne hxdF
          have hgclose := hdeltaG.right x hx hxne hxdG
          have hsum :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.add (dist (f x) A) (dist (g x) B)) eps := by
            have hsum_e2 :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.add (dist (f x) A) (dist (g x) B))
                  (RealTheory.add e2 e2) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hfclose hgclose
            have hhalf : RealTheory.add e2 e2 = eps := by
              unfold e2
              unfold RealTheory.add
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps
            rwa [hhalf] at hsum_e2
          have htri :
              RealTheory.le
                (dist (AddFun f g x) (RealTheory.add A B))
                (RealTheory.add (dist (f x) A) (dist (g x) B)) := by
            unfold AddFun
            exact dist_add_le (f x) (g x) A B
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base htri hsum

name: tendstoWithin_neg
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      unfold NegFun
      rw [dist_neg_neg]
      exact hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd

name: tendstoWithin_sub
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  have h :=
    tendstoWithin_add hf (tendstoWithin_neg hg) eps heps
  cases h with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      have hclose := hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd
      unfold AddFun NegFun at hclose
      unfold SubFun
      change
        RealTheory.lt
          (dist
            (RealTheory.add (f x) (RealTheory.neg (g x)))
            (RealTheory.add A (RealTheory.neg B))) eps
      exact hclose

name: tendstoWithin_eventually_half_abs_lt_abs
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_eventually_half_abs_lt_abs
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hf : TendstoWithin E f x0 A)
    (hA : Not (A = RealTheory.zero)) :
    ∃ delta, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta ∧
      ∀ x, E x -> Not (x = x0) ->
        RealTheory.lt (dist x x0) delta ->
          RealTheory.lt
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (RealTheory.abs A))
            (RealTheory.abs (f x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let c := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (RealTheory.abs A)
  have habs_pos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.abs A) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_pos_of_ne_zero F hA
  have hcpos : F.lt F.zero c :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F habs_pos
  cases hf c hcpos with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      have hn := hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd
      change F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) A)) c
        at hn
      have hclose' :
          F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub A (f x))) c := by
        simpa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm F A (f x)] using hn
      have htri :
          F.le (RealTheory.abs A)
            (F.add
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub A (f x)))
              (RealTheory.abs (f x))) := by
        have h :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
            F (F.sub A (f x)) (f x)
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F A (f x)] at h
      have hsum :
          F.lt (RealTheory.abs A)
            (F.add c (RealTheory.abs (f x))) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right
            F hclose' (RealTheory.abs (f x)))
      have hsum_comm :
          F.lt (RealTheory.abs A)
            (F.add (RealTheory.abs (f x)) c) := by
        rwa [F.add_comm c (RealTheory.abs (f x))] at hsum
      have hdiff :
          F.lt (F.sub (RealTheory.abs A) (RealTheory.abs (f x))) c :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hsum_comm
      have haway :
          F.lt (F.sub (RealTheory.abs A) c) (RealTheory.abs (f x)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right F hdiff
      unfold c at haway
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_half_self F (RealTheory.abs A)]
        at haway

name: tendstoWithin_eventuallyAwayFromZero
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_eventuallyAwayFromZero
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hf : TendstoWithin E f x0 A)
    (hA : Not (A = RealTheory.zero)) :
    ∃ delta, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta ∧
      ∃ c, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c ∧
        ∀ x, E x -> Not (x = x0) ->
          RealTheory.lt (dist x x0) delta ->
            RealTheory.lt c (RealTheory.abs (f x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let c := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (RealTheory.abs A)
  have habs_pos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.abs A) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_pos_of_ne_zero F hA
  have hcpos : F.lt F.zero c :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F habs_pos
  cases tendstoWithin_eventually_half_abs_lt_abs hf hA with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      refine Exists.intro c ?_
      exact And.intro hcpos hdelta.right

name: tendstoWithin_inv
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let c := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (RealTheory.abs A)
  have habs_pos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.abs A) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_pos_of_ne_zero F hA
  have hcpos : F.lt F.zero c :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F habs_pos
  have hc_abs_A : F.lt c (RealTheory.abs A) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F habs_pos
  let K := F.inv c
  have hKpos : F.lt F.zero K :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hcpos
  let scale := F.mul K K
  have hscale_pos : F.lt F.zero scale := by
    unfold scale
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hKpos hKpos
  have hscale_ne : Not (scale = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hscale_pos hzero.symm
  let deltaClose := F.mul eps (F.inv scale)
  have hdeltaClosePos : F.lt F.zero deltaClose := by
    unfold deltaClose
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F heps
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hscale_pos)
  have hdelta_scale : F.mul deltaClose scale = eps := by
    unfold deltaClose
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right F eps hscale_ne
  cases hf deltaClose hdeltaClosePos with
  | intro deltaC hdeltaC =>
      cases tendstoWithin_eventually_half_abs_lt_abs hf hA with
      | intro deltaAway hdeltaAway =>
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaC deltaAway
          have hdeltaPos : F.lt F.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
              F hdeltaC.left hdeltaAway.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdeltaPos ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hxdC : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaC :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                F deltaC deltaAway)
          have hxdAway : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaAway :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                F deltaC deltaAway)
          have hclose := hdeltaC.right x hx hxne hxdC
          change
            F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) A))
              deltaClose at hclose
          have haway := hdeltaAway.right x hx hxne hxdAway
          change F.lt c (RealTheory.abs (f x)) at haway
          change F.lt c (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (f x)) at haway
          have hneX : Not (f x = RealTheory.zero) := by
            intro hzero
            change f x = F.zero at hzero
            rw [hzero, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_zero F] at haway
            exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F F.zero)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hcpos haway)
          have hInvX : F.lt (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.inv (f x))) K := by
            unfold K
            exact
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_inv_lt_inv_of_pos_lt_abs
                F hcpos haway
          have hInvA : F.lt (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.inv A)) K := by
            unfold K
            exact
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_inv_lt_inv_of_pos_lt_abs
                F hcpos hc_abs_A
          have hidentity :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_sub_inv_eq_neg_sub_mul_inv_mul_inv
              F hneX hA
          have hidentityF :
              F.sub (F.inv (f x)) (F.inv A) =
                F.neg
                  (F.mul (F.mul (F.sub (f x) A) (F.inv (f x)))
                    (F.inv A)) := by
            change
              F.sub (F.inv (f x)) (F.inv A) =
                F.neg
                  (F.mul (F.mul (F.sub (f x) A) (F.inv (f x)))
                    (F.inv A)) at hidentity
            exact hidentity
          have habs_identity :
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                  (F.sub (F.inv (f x)) (F.inv A)) =
                F.mul
                  (F.mul
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) A))
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.inv (f x))))
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.inv A)) := by
            rw [hidentityF]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F
              (F.mul (F.mul (F.sub (f x) A) (F.inv (f x)))
                (F.inv A))]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F
              (F.mul (F.sub (f x) A) (F.inv (f x))) (F.inv A)]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F
              (F.sub (f x) A) (F.inv (f x))]
          unfold InvFun
          change
            F.lt
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                (F.sub (F.inv (f x)) (F.inv A))) eps
          rw [habs_identity]
          let D := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) A)
          let IX := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.inv (f x))
          let IA := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.inv A)
          have hIXle : F.le IX K :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hInvX
          have hIAle : F.le IA K :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hInvA
          have hDnonneg : F.le F.zero D := by
            unfold D
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F (F.sub (f x) A)
          have hKnonneg : F.le F.zero K :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hKpos
          have hDKnonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul D K) :=
            F.mul_nonneg hDnonneg hKnonneg
          have hle1 : F.le (F.mul D IX) (F.mul D K) :=
            F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hIXle hDnonneg
          have hle2 :
              F.le (F.mul (F.mul D IX) IA)
                (F.mul (F.mul D K) IA) :=
            F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hle1
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F (F.inv A))
          have hle3 :
              F.le (F.mul (F.mul D K) IA)
                (F.mul (F.mul D K) K) :=
            F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hIAle hDKnonneg
          have hle :
              F.le (F.mul (F.mul D IX) IA)
                (F.mul (F.mul D K) K) :=
            F.le_trans hle2 hle3
          have hlt :
              F.lt (F.mul (F.mul D K) K) eps := by
            have hDK_lt :
                F.lt (F.mul D K) (F.mul deltaClose K) :=
              F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hclose hKpos
            have hDKK_lt :
                F.lt (F.mul (F.mul D K) K)
                  (F.mul (F.mul deltaClose K) K) :=
              F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hDK_lt hKpos
            have hright :
                F.mul (F.mul deltaClose K) K = eps := by
              calc
                F.mul (F.mul deltaClose K) K =
                    F.mul deltaClose (F.mul K K) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
                _ = F.mul deltaClose scale := rfl
                _ = eps := hdelta_scale
            rwa [hright] at hDKK_lt
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle hlt

name: continuousOn_finiteSum
statement:
theorem continuousOn_finiteSum
    {E : Domain} {term : Nat -> Map} :
    forall n : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        ContinuousOn E (term k)) ->
      ContinuousOn E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k x) n)
  | 0, _ => by
      change ContinuousOn E (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
      exact continuousOn_const
  | n + 1, h => by
      have hprev :
          ContinuousOn E
            (fun x : Point =>
              RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k x) n)
proof:
:=
        continuousOn_finiteSum n
          (fun k hk => h k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))
      have hlast : ContinuousOn E (term n) :=
        h n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
      change ContinuousOn E
        (AddFun
          (fun x : Point =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k x) n)
          (term n))
      exact continuousOn_add hprev hlast

    CauchyAtPosInf E f
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : F.lt F.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hf e2 he2 with
  | intro threshold hthreshold =>
      refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
      intro x y hx hy hxlarge hylarge
      have hxL : F.lt (dist (f x) L) e2 :=
        hthreshold x hx hxlarge
      have hyL : F.lt (dist (f y) L) e2 :=
        hthreshold y hy hylarge
      have hLy : F.lt (dist L (f y)) e2 := by
        rwa [dist_comm L (f y)]
      exact dist_lt_of_two_half_steps hxL hLy

name: tendstoAtNegInf_to_cauchyAtNegInf
statement:
theorem tendstoAtNegInf_to_cauchyAtNegInf
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {L : Point}

    CauchyAtNegInf E f
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base

  have he2 : F.lt F.zero e2 :=

  cases hf e2 he2 with
  | intro threshold hthreshold =>
      refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
      intro x y hx hy hxsmall hysmall
      have hxL : F.lt (dist (f x) L) e2 :=
        hthreshold x hx hxsmall
      have hyL : F.lt (dist (f y) L) e2 :=
        hthreshold y hy hysmall
      have hLy : F.lt (dist L (f y)) e2 := by
        rwa [dist_comm L (f y)]
      exact dist_lt_of_two_half_steps hxL hLy

name: cofinalSeqAtPosInf_mem
statement:
private theorem cofinalSeqAtPosInf_mem
    {E : Domain} (hunbounded : UnboundedAbove E) (n : Nat) :
    E (cofinalSeqAtPosInf hunbounded n)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (hunbounded (RealTheory.nat n))).left

name: cofinalSeqAtPosInf_nat_lt
statement:
private theorem cofinalSeqAtPosInf_nat_lt
    {E : Domain} (hunbounded : UnboundedAbove E) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.nat n)
      (cofinalSeqAtPosInf hunbounded n)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (hunbounded (RealTheory.nat n))).right

name: cofinalSeqAtPosInf_eventually_gt
statement:
private theorem cofinalSeqAtPosInf_eventually_gt
    {E : Domain} (hunbounded : UnboundedAbove E) (threshold : Point) :
    Exists
      (fun N : Nat =>
        forall n : Nat, N <= n ->
          RealTheory.lt threshold (cofinalSeqAtPosInf hunbounded n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_gt threshold with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have hNat : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat N) (RealTheory.nat n) :=
        RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hn
      have hNat_lt :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.nat N)
            (cofinalSeqAtPosInf hunbounded n) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hNat
          (cofinalSeqAtPosInf_nat_lt hunbounded n)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hN hNat_lt

name: cauchyAtInf_to_exists_tendstoAtInf
statement:
private theorem cauchyAtInf_to_exists_tendstoAtInf
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {Tail : Point -> Point -> Prop}
    {u : Nat -> Point}
    (hu_mem : forall n : Nat, E (u n))
    (hu_eventually :
      forall threshold : Point,
        Exists
          (fun N : Nat =>
            forall n : Nat, N <= n -> Tail threshold (u n)))
    (hf :
      forall eps : Point, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
        Exists
          (fun threshold : Point =>
            forall x y : Point,
              E x -> E y -> Tail threshold x -> Tail threshold y ->
                RealTheory.lt (dist (f x) (f y)) eps)) :
    Exists
      (fun L : Point =>
        forall eps : Point, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
          Exists
            (fun threshold : Point =>
              forall x : Point, E x -> Tail threshold x ->
                RealTheory.lt (dist (f x) L) eps))
proof:
:= by
  have hseqCauchy :
      RealTheory.SeqCauchy (fun n : Nat => f (u n)) := by
    intro eps heps
    cases hf eps heps with
    | intro threshold hthreshold =>
      cases hu_eventually threshold with
      | intro N hN =>
        refine Exists.intro N ?_
        intro n m hn hm
        change RealTheory.lt (dist (f (u n)) (f (u m))) eps
        exact hthreshold (u n) (u m)
          (hu_mem n) (hu_mem m) (hN n hn) (hN m hm)
  cases RealTheory.seqCauchy_converges hseqCauchy with
  | intro L hL =>
    refine Exists.intro L ?_
    intro eps heps
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
    have he2 : F.lt F.zero e2 :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
    cases hf e2 he2 with
    | intro threshold hthreshold =>
      cases hu_eventually threshold with
      | intro Nco hNco =>
        cases hL e2 he2 with
        | intro Nval hNval =>
          let N := Nat.max Nco Nval
          have hNco_le : Nco <= N := Nat.le_max_left Nco Nval
          have hNval_le : Nval <= N := Nat.le_max_right Nco Nval
          have hy_close : F.lt (dist (f (u N)) L) e2 := by
            have h := hNval N hNval_le
            change F.lt (dist (f (u N)) L) e2 at h
            exact h
          refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
          intro x hx htail
          have hx_y : F.lt (dist (f x) (f (u N))) e2 :=
            hthreshold x (u N) hx (hu_mem N) htail (hNco N hNco_le)
          exact dist_lt_of_two_half_steps hx_y hy_close

name: cauchyAtPosInf_to_exists_tendstoAtPosInf
statement:
theorem cauchyAtPosInf_to_exists_tendstoAtPosInf
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hunbounded : UnboundedAbove E)
    (hf : CauchyAtPosInf E f) :
    Exists (fun L : Point => TendstoAtPosInf E f L)
proof:
:=
  cauchyAtInf_to_exists_tendstoAtInf
    (fun n : Nat => cofinalSeqAtPosInf_mem hunbounded n)
    (cofinalSeqAtPosInf_eventually_gt hunbounded)
    hf

name: cofinalSeqAtNegInf_mem
statement:
private theorem cofinalSeqAtNegInf_mem
    {E : Domain} (hunbounded : UnboundedBelow E) (n : Nat) :
    E (cofinalSeqAtNegInf hunbounded n)
proof:

  (Classical.choose_spec
    (hunbounded (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n)))).left

name: cofinalSeqAtNegInf_lt_negNat
statement:
private theorem cofinalSeqAtNegInf_lt_negNat
    {E : Domain} (hunbounded : UnboundedBelow E) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt (cofinalSeqAtNegInf hunbounded n)
      (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n))
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec
    (hunbounded (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n)))).right

name: cofinalSeqAtNegInf_eventually_lt
statement:
private theorem cofinalSeqAtNegInf_eventually_lt
    {E : Domain} (hunbounded : UnboundedBelow E) (threshold : Point) :
    Exists
      (fun N : Nat =>
        forall n : Nat, N <= n ->
          RealTheory.lt (cofinalSeqAtNegInf hunbounded n) threshold)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_gt (RealTheory.neg threshold) with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have hNat : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat N) (RealTheory.nat n) :=
        RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hn
      have hneg_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n))
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat N)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hNat
      have hnegN_lt : RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat N)) threshold := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hN
        change F.lt (F.neg (RealTheory.nat N))
          (F.neg (F.neg threshold)) at h
        rwa [F.neg_neg] at h
      have hx_lt_negN :
          RealTheory.lt (cofinalSeqAtNegInf hunbounded n)
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat N)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
          (cofinalSeqAtNegInf_lt_negNat hunbounded n) hneg_le
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx_lt_negN hnegN_lt

name: cauchyAtNegInf_to_exists_tendstoAtNegInf
statement:
theorem cauchyAtNegInf_to_exists_tendstoAtNegInf
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hunbounded : UnboundedBelow E)
    (hf : CauchyAtNegInf E f) :
    Exists (fun L : Point => TendstoAtNegInf E f L)
proof:
:=
  cauchyAtInf_to_exists_tendstoAtInf
    (fun n : Nat => cofinalSeqAtNegInf_mem hunbounded n)
    (cofinalSeqAtNegInf_eventually_lt hunbounded)
    hf

name: strictIntervalPartition_twoPoint
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartition_twoPoint
    {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b) :
    StrictIntervalPartition a b 1 (twoPointPartition a b)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (Nat.zero_lt_succ 0) ?_
  refine And.intro rfl ?_
  refine And.intro rfl ?_
  intro k hk
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      exact hab
  | succ k =>
      have hk0 : k < 0 := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk
      exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk0)

name: strictIntervalPartition_step_lt
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartition_step_lt
    {a b : Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : StrictIntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.lt (p k) (p (k + 1))
proof:
:=
  h.right.right.right k hk

name: strictIntervalPartition_step_le
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartition_step_le
    {a b : Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : StrictIntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.le (p k) (p (k + 1))
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (strictIntervalPartition_step_lt h hk)

name: strictIntervalPartition_appendRightEndpoint
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartition_appendRightEndpoint
    {a x b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : StrictIntervalPartition a x n p)
    (hxb : RealTheory.lt x b) :
    StrictIntervalPartition a b (n + 1)
      (appendRightEndpoint p n b)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (Nat.succ_pos n) ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · rw [appendRightEndpoint_of_lt p n b (Nat.succ_pos n)]
    exact strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint hp
  refine And.intro (appendRightEndpoint_last p n b) ?_
  intro k hk
  by_cases hkn : k < n
  · have hk_app : k < n + 1 :=
      Nat.lt_trans hkn (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    have hk_succ_app : k + 1 < n + 1 :=
      Nat.succ_lt_succ hkn
    rw [appendRightEndpoint_of_lt p n b hk_app]
    rw [appendRightEndpoint_of_lt p n b hk_succ_app]
    exact strictIntervalPartition_step_lt hp hkn
  · have hk_eq : k = n := by
      omega
    rw [hk_eq]
    rw [appendRightEndpoint_of_lt p n b (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]
    rw [appendRightEndpoint_last p n b]
    rw [strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint hp]
    exact hxb

name: strictIntervalPartition_refineCellWithThreePoints
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartition_refineCellWithThreePoints
    {a b u v w : Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : StrictIntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hpu : RealTheory.lt (p k) u)
    (huv : RealTheory.lt u v)
    (hvw : RealTheory.lt v w)
    (hwp : RealTheory.lt w (p (k + 1))) :
    StrictIntervalPartition a b (n + 3)
      (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w)
proof:
:= by
  let q := refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w
  refine And.intro (by omega) ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_le p k u v w (Nat.zero_le k)]
    exact strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint hp
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · have hgt : k + 3 < n + 3 := by omega
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_gt_third p k u v w hgt]
    have hn : (n + 3) - 3 = n := by omega
    rw [hn]
    exact strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint hp
  intro j hj
  by_cases hj_lt_k : j < k
  · have hj_le : j <= k := Nat.le_of_lt hj_lt_k
    have hjs_le : j + 1 <= k := by omega
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_le p k u v w hj_le]
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_le p k u v w hjs_le]
    exact strictIntervalPartition_step_lt hp (Nat.lt_trans hj_lt_k hk)
  by_cases hj_eq_k : j = k
  · rw [hj_eq_k]
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_le p k u v w (Nat.le_refl k)]
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_first p k u v w]
    exact hpu
  by_cases hj_eq_k1 : j = k + 1
  · rw [hj_eq_k1]
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_first p k u v w]
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_second p k u v w]
    exact huv
  by_cases hj_eq_k2 : j = k + 2
  · rw [hj_eq_k2]
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_second p k u v w]
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_third p k u v w]
    exact hvw
  by_cases hj_eq_k3 : j = k + 3
  · rw [hj_eq_k3]
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_third p k u v w]
    have hgt : k + 3 < k + 4 := by omega
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_gt_third p k u v w hgt]
    have hk4 : (k + 4) - 3 = k + 1 := by omega
    rw [hk4]
    exact hwp
  · have hj_gt : k + 3 < j := by omega
    have hjs_gt : k + 3 < j + 1 := by omega
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_gt_third p k u v w hj_gt]
    rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_gt_third p k u v w hjs_gt]
    have hsucc : (j + 1) - 3 = (j - 3) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hsucc]
    have hj_old : j - 3 < n := by omega
    exact strictIntervalPartition_step_lt hp hj_old

name: partitionEndpointList_mem_of_le
statement:
theorem partitionEndpointList_mem_of_le
    {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k <= n) :
    List.Mem (p k) (partitionEndpointList p n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
      subst hk0
      unfold partitionEndpointList
      exact List.Mem.head []
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hkn : k <= n
      case pos =>
        unfold partitionEndpointList
        exact List.mem_append_left [p (n + 1)] (ih hkn)
      case neg =>
        have hk_eq : k = n + 1 := by omega
        rw [hk_eq]
        unfold partitionEndpointList
        exact
          List.mem_append_right (partitionEndpointList p n)
            (List.Mem.head [])

theorem partitionEndpoint_of_eq

name: strictIntervalPartition_le_of_le
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartition_le_of_le
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : StrictIntervalPartition a b n p) :
    forall i j : Nat,
      i <= j -> j <= n -> RealTheory.le (p i) (p j)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  induction j generalizing i with
  | zero =>
      intro hij _hjn
      have hi0 : i = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hij
      rw [hi0]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl (p 0)
  | succ j ih =>
      intro hij hjn
      by_cases hij' : i <= j
      · have hjn' : j <= n := Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ j) hjn
        have hleft : RealTheory.le (p i) (p j) :=
          ih i hij' hjn'
        have hstep : RealTheory.le (p j) (p (j + 1)) :=
          strictIntervalPartition_step_le h (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hjn)
        exact RealTheory.le_trans hleft hstep
      · have hji_lt : j < i := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hij'
        have hji : j + 1 <= i := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hji_lt
        have hi_eq : i = j + 1 := Nat.le_antisymm hij hji
        rw [hi_eq]
        exact RealTheory.le_refl (p (j + 1))

name: strictIntervalPartition_exists_openCell_of_openInterval_not_endpoint
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartition_exists_openCell_of_openInterval_not_endpoint
    {a b x : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : StrictIntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hnot : Not (PartitionEndpoint p n x)) :
    Exists
      (fun k : Nat =>
        And (k < n)
          (And (RealTheory.lt (p k) x)
            (RealTheory.lt x (p (k + 1)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let P : Nat -> Prop :=
    fun j : Nat => And (j <= n) (RealTheory.lt x (p j))
  have hP_exists : Exists P := by
    refine Exists.intro n ?_
    refine And.intro (Nat.le_refl n) ?_
    have hxb : RealTheory.lt x b := hx.right
    simpa [strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint h] using hxb
  let j0 := Tautology.Nat.least P hP_exists
  have hj0 : P j0 := Tautology.Nat.least_spec P hP_exists
  have hj0_ne_zero : Not (j0 = 0) := by
    intro hj0_eq
    have hx_p0 : RealTheory.lt x (p 0) := by
      simpa [j0, hj0_eq] using hj0.right
    have hxa : RealTheory.lt x a := by
      rwa [strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint h] at hx_p0
    have haa : RealTheory.lt a a :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx.left hxa
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F a haa
  cases hj0_cases : j0 with
  | zero =>
      exact False.elim (hj0_ne_zero hj0_cases)
  | succ k =>
      have hj : P (k + 1) := by
        simpa [hj0_cases] using hj0
      have hk_lt_n : k < n := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hj.left
      have hx_ne_pk : Not (x = p k) := by
        intro hxpk
        exact hnot
          (partitionEndpoint_of_eq (Nat.le_of_lt hk_lt_n) hxpk)
      have hpk_lt_x : RealTheory.lt (p k) x := by
        cases F.le_total (p k) x with
        | inl hpkx =>
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hpkx
            intro hxpk_le
            have hpk_eq_x : p k = x := F.le_antisymm hpkx hxpk_le
            exact hx_ne_pk hpk_eq_x.symm
        | inr hxpk_le =>
            have hx_lt_pk : RealTheory.lt x (p k) := by
              apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxpk_le
              intro hpkx
              have hx_eq_pk : x = p k := F.le_antisymm hxpk_le hpkx
              exact hx_ne_pk hx_eq_pk
            have hkP : P k :=
              And.intro (Nat.le_of_lt hk_lt_n) hx_lt_pk
            have hmin : j0 <= k :=
              Tautology.Nat.least_min P hP_exists hkP
            have hbad : k + 1 <= k := by
              simpa [j0, hj0_cases] using hmin
            exact False.elim (Nat.not_succ_le_self k hbad)
      refine Exists.intro k ?_
      refine And.intro hk_lt_n ?_
      exact And.intro hpk_lt_x hj.right

name: strictIntervalPartition_openCell_gauge
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartition_openCell_gauge
    {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat} {x : Point}
    (hleft : RealTheory.lt (p k) x)
    (hright : RealTheory.lt x (p (k + 1))) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall y : Point,
            RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) delta ->
              RealTheory.OpenInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)) y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dl := RealTheory.sub x (p k)
  let dr := RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) x
  let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F dl dr
  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
  have hdl : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero dl := by
    unfold dl
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hleft
  have hdr : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero dr := by
    unfold dr
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hright
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · unfold delta
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdl hdr
  · intro y hyd
    unfold delta dl dr at hyd
    exact RealFunction.mem_interval_of_dist_lt_min hleft hright hyd

name: strictIntervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval
    {a b : Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : StrictIntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k <= n) :
    RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : RealTheory.le a (p k) := by
    have h0k :
        RealTheory.le (p 0) (p k) :=
      strictIntervalPartition_le_of_le h 0 k (Nat.zero_le k) hk
    rwa [strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint h] at h0k
  have hright : RealTheory.le (p k) b := by
    have hkn :
        RealTheory.le (p k) (p n) :=
      strictIntervalPartition_le_of_le h k n hk (Nat.le_refl n)
    rwa [strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint h] at hkn
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: taggedPartition_suffix
statement:
theorem taggedPartition_suffix
    {a b : Point} {n cut : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hcut : cut <= n) :
    TaggedPartition (p cut) b (n - cut)
      (suffixPartition p cut) (suffixTags tag cut)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (intervalPartition_suffix h.left hcut) ?_
  intro k hk
  have hidx_lt : cut + k < n := by
    omega
  have hcell := h.right (cut + k) hidx_lt
  unfold PartitionCell at hcell
  unfold PartitionCell suffixPartition suffixTags
  have hidx : cut + (k + 1) = cut + k + 1 := by
    omega
  rw [hidx]

name: taggedPartition_cutCellPrefix
statement:
theorem taggedPartition_cutCellPrefix
    {a b c : Point} {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hc : PartitionCell p k c) :
    TaggedPartition a c (k + 1)
      (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
      (cutCellPrefixTags tag k c)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (intervalPartition_cutCellPrefix h.left hk hc) ?_
  intro i hi
  by_cases hik : i < k
  · have hne : Not (i = k) := by
      omega
    rw [cutCellPrefixTags_of_ne hne]
    exact
      (partitionCell_cutCellPrefixPartition_of_lt
        p k c (tag i) hik).mpr
        (h.right i (Nat.lt_trans hik hk))
  · have hik_eq : i = k := by
      omega
    subst i
    rw [cutCellPrefixTags_split]
    exact
      (partitionCell_cutCellPrefixPartition_split
        p k c c).mpr
        (And.intro hc.left (RealTheory.le_refl c))

name: taggedPartition_cutCellSuffix

theorem taggedPartition_cutCellSuffix
    {a b c : Point} {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}

    TaggedPartition c b (n - k)
      (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)
      (cutCellSuffixTags tag k c)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (intervalPartition_cutCellSuffix h.left hk hc) ?_
  intro i hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      rw [cutCellSuffixTags_zero]
      exact
        (partitionCell_cutCellSuffixPartition_zero
          p k c c).mpr
          (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl c) hc.right)
  | succ i =>
      rw [cutCellSuffixTags_succ]
      have hold : k + i + 1 < n := by
        omega
      exact
        (partitionCell_cutCellSuffixPartition_succ
          p k i c (tag (k + i + 1))).mpr
          (h.right (k + i + 1) hold)

name: adjacentTaggedPartition
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro
    (adjacentPartition_intervalPartition hleft.left hright.left) ?_
  intro k hk
  by_cases hk_left : k < leftCount
  case pos =>
    have hcell := hleft.right k hk_left
    unfold PartitionCell at hcell
    unfold PartitionCell
    rw [adjacentPartition_left_of_lt left right hk_left]
    rw [adjacentTags_left_of_lt leftTag rightTag hk_left]
    by_cases hk_succ_left : k + 1 < leftCount
    case pos =>
      rw [adjacentPartition_left_of_lt left right hk_succ_left]
      exact hcell
    case neg =>
      have hk_succ_eq : k + 1 = leftCount := by
        omega
      rw [hk_succ_eq]
      rw [adjacentPartition_boundary left right leftCount]
      rw [intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright.left]
      rwa [hk_succ_eq, intervalPartition_right_endpoint hleft.left]
        at hcell
  case neg =>
    have hleft_le : leftCount <= k := Nat.le_of_not_gt hk_left
    have hk_right : k - leftCount < rightCount := by
      omega
    have hcell := hright.right (k - leftCount) hk_right
    unfold PartitionCell at hcell
    unfold PartitionCell
    rw [adjacentPartition_right_of_le left right hleft_le]
    rw [adjacentTags_right_of_le leftTag rightTag hleft_le]
    have hleft_le_succ : leftCount <= k + 1 := Nat.le_trans
      hleft_le (Nat.le_succ k)
    rw [adjacentPartition_right_of_le left right hleft_le_succ]
    have hsub : (k + 1) - leftCount = (k - leftCount) + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [hsub]
    exact hcell

name: splitPointTaggedPartition
statement:
theorem splitPointTaggedPartition
    {a x b : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) :
    TaggedPartition a b 2
      (splitPointPartition a x b)
      (splitPointTags x b)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : IntervalPartition a b 2 (splitPointPartition a x b) :=
    splitPointPartition_intervalPartition hx
  refine And.intro hp ?_
  intro k hk
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      unfold PartitionCell
      exact And.intro hx.left (RealTheory.le_refl x)
  | succ k =>
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          unfold PartitionCell
          exact And.intro hx.right (RealTheory.le_refl b)
      | succ k =>
          have hk0 : k < 0 := by
            omega
          exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk0)

name: taggedPartition_tag_mem_closedInterval
statement:
theorem taggedPartition_tag_mem_closedInterval
    {a b : Point} {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}

    (hk : k < n) :

proof:
:= by
  have hcell : PartitionCell p k (tag k) :=
    taggedPartition_tag_mem_cell h hk
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left h.left hk
  have hright :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right h.left hk
  exact And.intro
    (RealTheory.le_trans hleft.left hcell.left)
    (RealTheory.le_trans hcell.right hright.right)

name: taggedPartition_tag_eq_left_endpoint_cell_left
statement:
theorem taggedPartition_tag_eq_left_endpoint_cell_left

:= by

    taggedPartition_tag_mem_cell h hk
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left h.left hk
  have hpk_le_a : RealTheory.le (p k) a := by
    have hpk_le_tag : RealTheory.le (p k) (tag k) := hcell.left
    rwa [htag] at hpk_le_tag
  exact RealTheory.le_antisymm hpk_le_a hleft.left

theorem taggedPartition_tag_eq_right_endpoint_cell_right

name: taggedPartition_left_endpoint_tag_cellLength_eq_zero_of_cell_right
statement:
theorem taggedPartition_left_endpoint_tag_cellLength_eq_zero_of_cell_right

name: taggedPartition_right_endpoint_tag_cellLength_eq_zero_of_cell_left

theorem taggedPartition_right_endpoint_tag_cellLength_eq_zero_of_cell_left

name: tagSplitPartition_even
statement:
theorem tagSplitPartition_even
    (p tag : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) :
    tagSplitPartition p tag (2 * k) = p k
proof:
:= by
  unfold tagSplitPartition
  have hmod : (2 * k) % 2 = 0 := by omega
  have hdiv : (2 * k) / 2 = k := by omega
  simp [hmod, hdiv]

name: tagSplitPartition_odd
statement:
theorem tagSplitPartition_odd
    (p tag : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) :
    tagSplitPartition p tag (2 * k + 1) = tag k
proof:
:= by
  unfold tagSplitPartition
  have hmod : (2 * k + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
  have hdiv : (2 * k + 1) / 2 = k := by omega
  simp [hmod, hdiv]

name: tagSplitTags_even
statement:
theorem tagSplitTags_even
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) :
    tagSplitTags p (2 * k) = p k
proof:
:= by

  have hdiv : (2 * k) / 2 = k := by omega

name: tagSplitTags_odd
statement:
theorem tagSplitTags_odd
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) :
    tagSplitTags p (2 * k + 1) = p (k + 1)
proof:
:= by

name: tagSplitPartition_intervalPartition
statement:
theorem tagSplitPartition_intervalPartition
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag) :
    IntervalPartition a b (tagSplitCount n) (tagSplitPartition p tag)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tagSplitCount
  refine And.intro ?left ?_
  · change tagSplitPartition p tag (2 * 0) = a
    rw [tagSplitPartition_even]
    exact h.left.left
  · refine And.intro ?right ?step
    · rw [tagSplitPartition_even]
      exact h.left.right.left
    · intro j hj
      let k := j / 2
      by_cases hpar : j % 2 = 0
      · have hj_eq : j = 2 * k := by
          unfold k
          omega
        have hk : k < n := by
          unfold k
          omega
        rw [hj_eq, tagSplitPartition_even, tagSplitPartition_odd]
        exact (h.right k hk).left
      · have hj_eq : j = 2 * k + 1 := by
          unfold k
          omega
        have hk : k < n := by
          unfold k
          omega
        have hsucc : 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
        rw [hj_eq, tagSplitPartition_odd, hsucc, tagSplitPartition_even]
        exact (h.right k hk).right

name: tagSplitTags_taggedPartition
statement:
theorem tagSplitTags_taggedPartition
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag) :
    TaggedPartition a b (tagSplitCount n)
      (tagSplitPartition p tag) (tagSplitTags p)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (tagSplitPartition_intervalPartition h) ?_
  intro j hj
  unfold tagSplitCount at hj
  let k := j / 2
  by_cases hpar : j % 2 = 0
  · have hj_eq : j = 2 * k := by
      unfold k
      omega
    have hk : k < n := by
      unfold k
      omega
    rw [hj_eq]
    unfold PartitionCell
    rw [tagSplitPartition_even, tagSplitPartition_odd, tagSplitTags_even]
    exact And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl (p k)) (h.right k hk).left
  · have hj_eq : j = 2 * k + 1 := by
      unfold k
      omega
    have hk : k < n := by
      unfold k
      omega
    rw [hj_eq]
    unfold PartitionCell
    have hsucc : 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
    rw [tagSplitPartition_odd, hsucc, tagSplitPartition_even, tagSplitTags_odd]
    exact And.intro (h.right k hk).right (RealTheory.le_refl (p (k + 1)))

name: tagSplitPartition_refines
statement:
theorem tagSplitPartition_refines
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag) :
    PartitionRefines (tagSplitPartition p tag) (tagSplitCount n) p n
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  unfold tagSplitCount at hj
  let k := j / 2
  have hk : k < n := by
    unfold k
    omega
  refine Exists.intro k ?_
  refine And.intro hk ?_
  by_cases hpar : j % 2 = 0
  · have hj_eq : j = 2 * k := by
      unfold k
      omega
    rw [hj_eq, tagSplitPartition_even, tagSplitPartition_odd]
    exact And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl (p k)) (h.right k hk).right
  · have hj_eq : j = 2 * k + 1 := by
      unfold k
      omega
    have hsucc : 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
    rw [hj_eq, tagSplitPartition_odd, hsucc, tagSplitPartition_even]
    exact And.intro (h.right k hk).left (RealTheory.le_refl (p (k + 1)))

name: exists_consecutiveActiveIndexBlock_or_none
statement:
theorem exists_consecutiveActiveIndexBlock_or_none
    (active : Nat -> Prop) (n : Nat)
    (hconvex :
      forall i j k : Nat,
        i <= j -> j <= k -> k < n ->
          active i -> active k -> active j) :
    Or
      (Exists fun lo : Nat =>
        Exists fun hi : Nat =>
          And (lo <= hi)
            (And (hi < n)
              (forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                Iff (active k) (And (lo <= k) (k <= hi)))))
      (forall k : Nat, k < n -> Not (active k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact Or.inr (fun k hk => by omega)
  | succ n ih =>
      have hconvex_n :
          forall i j k : Nat,
            i <= j -> j <= k -> k < n ->
              active i -> active k -> active j := by
        intro i j k hij hjk hk hai hak
        exact hconvex i j k hij hjk
          (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n)) hai hak
      by_cases hlast : active n
      · cases ih hconvex_n with
        | inl hblock_exists =>
            rcases hblock_exists with ⟨lo, hi, hblock⟩
            have hlo_lt : lo < n :=
              Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hblock.left hblock.right.left
            have hlo_active : active lo :=
              (hblock.right.right lo hlo_lt).mpr
                (And.intro (Nat.le_refl lo) hblock.left)
            refine Or.inl ?_
            refine ⟨lo, n, ?_⟩
            refine And.intro (Nat.le_of_lt hlo_lt) ?_
            refine And.intro (Nat.lt_succ_self n) ?_
            intro k hk
            constructor
            · intro hak
              have hk_le : k <= n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hk
              have hlo_le : lo <= k := by
                by_cases hkn : k < n
                · exact (hblock.right.right k hkn).mp hak |>.left
                · omega
              exact And.intro hlo_le hk_le
            · intro hbounds
              exact hconvex lo k n hbounds.left hbounds.right
                (Nat.lt_succ_self n) hlo_active hlast
        | inr hnone =>
            refine Or.inl ?_
            refine ⟨n, n, ?_⟩
            refine And.intro (Nat.le_refl n) ?_
            refine And.intro (Nat.lt_succ_self n) ?_
            intro k hk
            constructor
            · intro hak
              have hnk : n <= k := by
                by_cases hkn : k < n
                · exact False.elim ((hnone k hkn) hak)
                · omega
              exact And.intro hnk (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hk)
            · intro hbounds
              have hk_eq : k = n := Nat.le_antisymm hbounds.right hbounds.left
              rwa [hk_eq]
      · cases ih hconvex_n with
        | inl hblock_exists =>
            rcases hblock_exists with ⟨lo, hi, hblock⟩
            refine Or.inl ?_
            refine ⟨lo, hi, ?_⟩
            refine And.intro hblock.left ?_
            refine And.intro
              (Nat.lt_trans hblock.right.left (Nat.lt_succ_self n)) ?_
            intro k hk
            constructor
            · intro hak
              have hkn : k < n := by
                by_cases hkn' : k < n
                · exact hkn'
                · have hk_eq : k = n := by omega
                  exact False.elim (hlast (hk_eq ▸ hak))
              exact (hblock.right.right k hkn).mp hak
            · intro hbounds
              have hkn : k < n :=
                Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hbounds.right hblock.right.left
              exact (hblock.right.right k hkn).mpr hbounds
        | inr hnone =>
            refine Or.inr ?_
            intro k hk hak
            by_cases hkn : k < n
            · exact (hnone k hkn) hak
            · have hk_eq : k = n := by omega
              exact hlast (hk_eq ▸ hak)

    (f : Point -> Point)
    {a c b : Point}
    {left right leftTag rightTag : Nat -> Point}
    {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    (hleft : TaggedPartition a c leftCount left leftTag)
    (hright : TaggedPartition c b rightCount right rightTag) :
    cellLengthTagSum f
        (adjacentPartition left right leftCount)
        (adjacentTags leftTag rightTag leftCount)
        (leftCount + rightCount) =
      RealTheory.add
        (cellLengthTagSum f left leftTag leftCount)
        (cellLengthTagSum f right rightTag rightCount)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cellLengthTagSum weightedTagSum
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length]
  have hleft_terms :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (f (adjacentTags leftTag rightTag leftCount k))
              (cellLength
                (adjacentPartition left right leftCount) k))
          leftCount =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (f (leftTag k)) (cellLength left k))
          leftCount := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
    intro k hk
    rw [adjacentTags_left_of_lt leftTag rightTag hk]
    rw [cellLength_adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
      hleft.left (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright.left) hk]
  have hright_terms :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (f (adjacentTags leftTag rightTag leftCount
                (leftCount + j)))
              (cellLength
                (adjacentPartition left right leftCount)
                (leftCount + j)))
          rightCount =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (f (rightTag j)) (cellLength right j))
          rightCount := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro j
    rw [adjacentTags_right_shift leftTag rightTag leftCount j]
    rw [cellLength_adjacentPartition_right left right leftCount j]
  rw [hleft_terms, hright_terms]

name: cellLengthTagSum_cutCellSplit
statement:
theorem cellLengthTagSum_cutCellSplit
    (f : Point -> Point)
    {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point} {c : Point}
    (hk : k < n)
    (htag : tag k = c) :
    cellLengthTagSum f p tag n =
      RealTheory.add
        (cellLengthTagSum f
          (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
          (cutCellPrefixTags tag k c)
          (k + 1))
        (cellLengthTagSum f
          (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)
          (cutCellSuffixTags tag k c)
          (n - k))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let oldTerm :=
    fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (f (tag i)) (cellLength p i)
  let prefixTerm :=
    fun i : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (f (cutCellPrefixTags tag k c i))
        (cellLength (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c) i)
  let suffixTerm :=
    fun i : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (f (cutCellSuffixTags tag k c i))
        (cellLength (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c) i)
  have hcount : k + (n - k) = n :=
    Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hk)
  have htail : n - k = (n - (k + 1)) + 1 := by
    omega
  have hprefix_terms :
      RealTheory.finiteSum prefixTerm k =
        RealTheory.finiteSum oldTerm k := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
    intro i hi
    unfold prefixTerm oldTerm
    have hne : Not (i = k) := by
      omega
    rw [cutCellPrefixTags_of_ne hne]
    rw [cellLength_cutCellPrefixPartition_of_lt p k c hi]
  have hsuffix_rest :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => suffixTerm (j + 1))
          (n - (k + 1)) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => oldTerm (k + (j + 1)))
          (n - (k + 1)) := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro j
    unfold suffixTerm oldTerm
    rw [cutCellSuffixTags_succ]
    rw [cellLength_cutCellSuffixPartition_succ]
    have hidx : k + (j + 1) = k + j + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [hidx]
  have hsplitTerm :
      oldTerm k = RealTheory.add (prefixTerm k) (suffixTerm 0) := by
    unfold oldTerm prefixTerm suffixTerm
    rw [htag]
    rw [cutCellPrefixTags_split]
    rw [cutCellSuffixTags_zero]
    rw [cellLength_cutCellPrefixPartition_split]
    rw [cellLength_cutCellSuffixPartition_zero]
    unfold cellLength
    have hlen :
        RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.sub c (p k))
            (RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) c) := by
      calc
        RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) c)
              (RealTheory.sub c (p k)) := by
          exact Eq.symm
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
              F (p (k + 1)) c (p k))
        _ =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.sub c (p k))
              (RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) c) := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_comm]
    rw [hlen]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_add]
  unfold cellLengthTagSum weightedTagSum
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum oldTerm n =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum prefixTerm (k + 1))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum suffixTerm (n - k))
  rw [<- hcount]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length oldTerm k (n - k)]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ prefixTerm k]
  rw [hprefix_terms]
  rw [htail]
  have hsuffix_count :
      k + (n - (k + 1) + 1) - k = n - (k + 1) + 1 := by
    omega
  rw [hsuffix_count]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first
    (fun j : Nat => oldTerm (k + j)) (n - (k + 1))]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first suffixTerm (n - (k + 1))]
  rw [hsuffix_rest]
  have hzero : oldTerm (k + 0) = oldTerm k := by
    rw [Nat.add_zero]
  rw [hzero]
  rw [hsplitTerm]
  calc
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum oldTerm k)
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add (prefixTerm k) (suffixTerm 0))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => oldTerm (k + (j + 1)))
            (n - (k + 1)))) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum oldTerm k)
        (RealTheory.add
          (prefixTerm k)
          (RealTheory.add
            (suffixTerm 0)
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun j : Nat => oldTerm (k + (j + 1)))
              (n - (k + 1))))) := by
        rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
    _ =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum oldTerm k)
          (prefixTerm k))
        (RealTheory.add
          (suffixTerm 0)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => oldTerm (k + (j + 1)))
            (n - (k + 1)))) := by
        rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc]

name: cellLengthTagSum_le_of_pointwise_le
statement:
theorem cellLengthTagSum_le_of_pointwise_le
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hfg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (f x) (g x)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (cellLengthTagSum f p tag n)
      (cellLengthTagSum g p tag n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cellLengthTagSum
  exact weightedTagSum_le_of_pointwise_le
    (fun k hk => by
      have htag_closed :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (tag k) :=
        taggedPartition_tag_mem_closedInterval htag hk
      exact hfg (tag k) htag_closed)
    (fun k hk => cellLength_nonnegative htag.left hk)

name: abs_cellLengthTagSum_le_cellLengthTagSum_abs
statement:
theorem abs_cellLengthTagSum_le_cellLengthTagSum_abs
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (cellLengthTagSum f p tag n))
      (cellLengthTagSum
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p tag n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cellLengthTagSum
  exact abs_weightedTagSum_le_weightedTagSum_abs
    (fun k hk => cellLength_nonnegative htag.left hk)

name: cellLengthTagSum_abs_le_bound_mul_length
statement:
theorem cellLengthTagSum_abs_le_bound_mul_length
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b M : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hM :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (cellLengthTagSum
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p tag n)
      (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (cellLengthTagSum
          (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p tag n)
        (cellLengthTagSum (fun _ : Point => M) p tag n) :=
    cellLengthTagSum_le_of_pointwise_le htag hM
  have hconst :
      cellLengthTagSum (fun _ : Point => M) p tag n =
        RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
    cellLengthTagSum_const_of_intervalPartition M htag.left
  rwa [hconst] at hsum

name: abs_cellLengthTagSum_le_bound_mul_length
statement:
theorem abs_cellLengthTagSum_le_bound_mul_length
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b M : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hM :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (cellLengthTagSum f p tag n))
      (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.le_trans
    (abs_cellLengthTagSum_le_cellLengthTagSum_abs htag)
    (cellLengthTagSum_abs_le_bound_mul_length htag hM)

name: cellLengthTagSum_replaceTag_sub
statement:
theorem cellLengthTagSum_replaceTag_sub
    {f : Point -> Point} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    {n k : Nat} {x : Point}
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.sub
      (cellLengthTagSum f p (replaceTag tag k x) n)
      (cellLengthTagSum f p tag n) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f (tag k)))
        (cellLength p k)
proof:
:= by
  let u := fun j : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul (f (replaceTag tag k x j)) (cellLength p j)
  let v := fun j : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul (f (tag j)) (cellLength p j)
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hdiff :
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.finiteSum u n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum v n) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat => RealTheory.sub (u j) (v j)) n := by
    rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_sub u v n]
  unfold cellLengthTagSum weightedTagSum
  change
    RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.finiteSum u n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum v n) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f (tag k)))
        (cellLength p k)
  rw [hdiff]
  have hsingle :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => RealTheory.sub (u j) (v j)) n =
        RealTheory.sub (u k) (v k) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_single_of_eq_zero_off hk
      (fun j _hj hne => by
        unfold u v
        rw [replaceTag_of_ne (tag := tag) (k := k) (x := x) hne]
        change
          F.sub
            (F.mul (f (tag j)) (cellLength p j))
            (F.mul (f (tag j)) (cellLength p j)) =
          F.zero
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F])
  rw [hsingle]
  unfold u v
  rw [replaceTag_self]
  change
    F.sub
        (F.mul (f x) (cellLength p k))
        (F.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k)) =
      F.mul
        (F.sub (f x) (f (tag k)))
        (cellLength p k)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F]

name: strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_of_le
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_of_le
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (d : Point)
    {i : Nat} (hi : i <= k) :
    strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d i = p i
proof:
:= by
  unfold strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint
  rw [dif_pos hi]

name: strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_inserted
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_inserted
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (d : Point) :
    strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d (k + 1) = d
proof:
:= by
  have hnot_left : Not (k + 1 <= k) :=
    Nat.not_succ_le_self k
  unfold strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint
  rw [dif_neg hnot_left, dif_pos rfl]

name: strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_after_of_gt
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_after_of_gt
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (d : Point)
    {i : Nat} (hi : k + 1 < i) :
    strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d i = p (i - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hnot_left : Not (i <= k) := by
    intro hik
    have hle : k + 1 <= k := Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt hi) hik
    exact (Nat.not_succ_le_self k) hle
  have hnot_at : Not (i = k + 1) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hi
    exact (Nat.lt_irrefl (k + 1)) hi
  unfold strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint
  rw [dif_neg hnot_left, dif_neg hnot_at]

name: strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_strictIntervalPartition
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_strictIntervalPartition
    {A B : Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point} {d : Point}
    (hp : StrictIntervalPartition A B n p)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hleft : RealTheory.lt (p k) d)
    (hright : RealTheory.lt d (p (k + 1))) :
    StrictIntervalPartition A B (n + 1)
      (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (Nat.succ_pos n) ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_of_le p k d (Nat.zero_le k)]
    exact hp.right.left
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · have hgt : k + 1 < n + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_after_of_gt p k d hgt]
    have hsub : n + 1 - 1 = n := by
      omega
    rw [hsub]
    exact hp.right.right.left
  intro i hi
  by_cases hik : i < k
  · have hi_old : i < n := Nat.lt_trans hik hk
    have hi_le : i <= k := Nat.le_of_lt hik
    have hi_succ_le : i + 1 <= k := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hik
    rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_of_le p k d hi_le]
    rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_of_le p k d hi_succ_le]
    exact hp.right.right.right i hi_old
  · have hk_le_i : k <= i := Nat.le_of_not_gt hik
    by_cases hik_eq : i = k
    · subst i
      rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_of_le p k d (Nat.le_refl k)]
      rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_inserted p k d]
      exact hleft
    · have hk_ne_i : k ≠i := by
        intro h
        exact hik_eq (Eq.symm h)
      have hk_lt_i : k < i := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hk_le_i hk_ne_i
      by_cases hsucc : i = k + 1
      · subst i
        rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_inserted p k d]
        have hgt_next : k + 1 < k + 1 + 1 := by
          omega
        rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_after_of_gt p k d hgt_next]
        have hsub : k + 1 + 1 - 1 = k + 1 := by
          omega
        rw [hsub]
        exact hright
      · have hk1_le_i : k + 1 <= i := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk_lt_i
        have hk1_ne_i : k + 1 ≠i := by
          intro h
          exact hsucc (Eq.symm h)
        have hk1_lt_i : k + 1 < i :=
          Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hk1_le_i hk1_ne_i
        have hk1_lt_succ : k + 1 < i + 1 := by
          omega
        rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_after_of_gt p k d hk1_lt_i]
        rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_after_of_gt p k d hk1_lt_succ]
        have hright_idx :
            i + 1 - 1 = (i - 1) + 1 := by
          omega
        rw [hright_idx]
        have hi_old : i - 1 < n := by
          omega
        exact hp.right.right.right (i - 1) hi_old

name: exists_commonStrictIntervalPartition_reachableByInsertions_raw
statement:
private theorem
    exists_commonStrictIntervalPartition_reachableByInsertions_raw
    {A B : Point} {n m : Nat} {p q : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : StrictIntervalPartition A B n p)
    (hq : StrictIntervalPartition A B m q) :
    Exists
      (fun count : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun r : Nat -> Point =>
            Exists
              (fun s : Nat -> Point =>
                And (StrictIntervalPartition A B count r)
                  (And (StrictIntervalPartition A B count s)
                    (And
                      (StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable
                        A B n p count r)
                      (And
                        (StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable
                          A B m q count s)
                        (forall k : Nat,
                          k <= count -> r k = s k)))))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let rec merge
      (fuel i rn sn : Nat)
      (r s : Nat -> Point)
      (hr : StrictIntervalPartition A B rn r)
      (hs : StrictIntervalPartition A B sn s)
      (hpr : StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable A B n p rn r)
      (hqs : StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable A B m q sn s)
      (hirn : i <= rn)
      (hisn : i <= sn)
      (hprefix : forall k : Nat, k <= i -> r k = s k)
      (hfuel : (rn - i) + (sn - i) <= fuel) :
      Exists
        (fun count : Nat =>
          Exists
            (fun r' : Nat -> Point =>
              Exists
                (fun s' : Nat -> Point =>
                  And (StrictIntervalPartition A B count r')
                    (And (StrictIntervalPartition A B count s')
                      (And
                        (StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable
                          A B n p count r')
                        (And
                          (StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable
                            A B m q count s')
                          (forall k : Nat,
                            k <= count -> r' k = s' k))))))) :=
    match fuel with
    | 0 => by
        have hir : i = rn := by omega
        have his : i = sn := by omega
        subst rn
        subst sn
        exact
          Exists.intro i
            (Exists.intro r
              (Exists.intro s
                (And.intro hr
                  (And.intro hs
                    (And.intro hpr
                      (And.intro hqs hprefix))))))
    | fuel + 1 => by
        by_cases hir : i = rn
        · have his : i = sn := by
            by_cases heq : i = sn
            · exact heq
            · have hislt : i < sn := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hisn heq
              have hlt : RealTheory.lt (s i) (s sn) :=
                RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_lt_of_lt
                  hs i sn hislt (Nat.le_refl sn)
              have hsiB : s i = B := by
                calc
                  s i = r i := Eq.symm (hprefix i (Nat.le_refl i))
                  _ = B := by
                    rw [hir]
                    exact
                      RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint
                        hr
              have hsnB : s sn = B :=
                RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint
                  hs
              rw [hsiB, hsnB] at hlt
              exact
                False.elim
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F B hlt)
          subst rn
          subst sn
          exact
            Exists.intro i
              (Exists.intro r
                (Exists.intro s
                  (And.intro hr
                    (And.intro hs
                      (And.intro hpr
                        (And.intro hqs hprefix))))))
        · by_cases his : i = sn
          · have hir' : i = rn := by
              by_cases heq : i = rn
              · exact heq
              · have hirlt : i < rn := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hirn heq
                have hlt : RealTheory.lt (r i) (r rn) :=
                  RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_lt_of_lt
                    hr i rn hirlt (Nat.le_refl rn)
                have hriB : r i = B := by
                  calc
                    r i = s i := hprefix i (Nat.le_refl i)
                    _ = B := by
                      rw [his]
                      exact
                        RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint
                          hs
                have hrnB : r rn = B :=
                  RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint
                    hr
                rw [hriB, hrnB] at hlt
                exact
                  False.elim
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F B hlt)
            exact False.elim (hir hir')
          · have hirlt : i < rn := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hirn hir
            have hislt : i < sn := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hisn his
            cases F.le_total (r (i + 1)) (s (i + 1)) with
            | inl hrs =>
                by_cases heq : r (i + 1) = s (i + 1)
                · have hprefix' :
                      forall k : Nat, k <= i + 1 -> r k = s k := by
                    intro k hk
                    by_cases hki : k <= i
                    · exact hprefix k hki
                    · have hkeq : k = i + 1 := by omega
                      rw [hkeq]
                      exact heq
                  exact
                    merge fuel (i + 1) rn sn r s hr hs hpr hqs
                      (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hirlt)
                      (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hislt)
                      hprefix' (by omega)
                · have hnot_reverse :
                      Not (F.le (s (i + 1)) (r (i + 1))) := by
                    intro hreverse
                    exact heq (RealTheory.le_antisymm hrs hreverse)
                  have hnext :
                      RealTheory.lt (r (i + 1)) (s (i + 1)) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
                      F hrs hnot_reverse
                  have hleft : RealTheory.lt (s i) (r (i + 1)) := by
                    rw [<- hprefix i (Nat.le_refl i)]
                    exact
                      RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_step_lt
                        hr hirlt
                  have hinsert :
                      And (RealTheory.lt (s i) (r (i + 1)))
                        (RealTheory.lt (r (i + 1)) (s (i + 1))) :=
                    And.intro hleft hnext
                  let s' :=
                    strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint s i (r (i + 1))
                  have hs' : StrictIntervalPartition A B (sn + 1) s' := by
                    dsimp [s']
                    exact
                      strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_strictIntervalPartition
                        hs hislt hinsert.left hinsert.right
                  have hqs' :
                      StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable
                        A B m q (sn + 1) s' := by
                    dsimp [s']
                    exact
                      StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable.step
                        hqs hs hislt hinsert.left hinsert.right
                  have hprefix' :
                      forall k : Nat, k <= i + 1 -> r k = s' k := by
                    intro k hk
                    by_cases hki : k <= i
                    · dsimp [s']
                      rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_of_le s i
                        (r (i + 1)) hki]
                      exact hprefix k hki
                    · have hkeq : k = i + 1 := by omega
                      rw [hkeq]
                      dsimp [s']
                      rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_inserted]
                  exact
                    merge fuel (i + 1) rn (sn + 1) r s' hr hs' hpr hqs'
                      (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hirlt) (by omega)
                      hprefix' (by omega)
            | inr hsr =>
                by_cases heq : r (i + 1) = s (i + 1)
                · have hprefix' :
                      forall k : Nat, k <= i + 1 -> r k = s k := by
                    intro k hk
                    by_cases hki : k <= i
                    · exact hprefix k hki
                    · have hkeq : k = i + 1 := by omega
                      rw [hkeq]
                      exact heq
                  exact
                    merge fuel (i + 1) rn sn r s hr hs hpr hqs
                      (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hirlt)
                      (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hislt)
                      hprefix' (by omega)
                · have hnot_reverse :
                      Not (F.le (r (i + 1)) (s (i + 1))) := by
                    intro hreverse
                    exact heq (RealTheory.le_antisymm hreverse hsr)
                  have hnext :
                      RealTheory.lt (s (i + 1)) (r (i + 1)) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
                      F hsr hnot_reverse
                  have hleft : RealTheory.lt (r i) (s (i + 1)) := by
                    rw [hprefix i (Nat.le_refl i)]
                    exact
                      RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_step_lt
                        hs hislt
                  have hinsert :
                      And (RealTheory.lt (r i) (s (i + 1)))
                        (RealTheory.lt (s (i + 1)) (r (i + 1))) :=
                    And.intro hleft hnext
                  let r' :=
                    strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint r i (s (i + 1))
                  have hr' : StrictIntervalPartition A B (rn + 1) r' := by
                    dsimp [r']
                    exact
                      strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_strictIntervalPartition
                        hr hirlt hinsert.left hinsert.right
                  have hpr' :
                      StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable
                        A B n p (rn + 1) r' := by
                    dsimp [r']
                    exact
                      StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable.step
                        hpr hr hirlt hinsert.left hinsert.right
                  have hprefix' :
                      forall k : Nat, k <= i + 1 -> r' k = s k := by
                    intro k hk
                    by_cases hki : k <= i
                    · dsimp [r']
                      rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_of_le r i
                        (s (i + 1)) hki]
                      exact hprefix k hki
                    · have hkeq : k = i + 1 := by omega
                      rw [hkeq]
                      dsimp [r']
                      rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_inserted]
                  exact
                    merge fuel (i + 1) (rn + 1) sn r' s hr' hs hpr' hqs
                      (by omega) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hislt)
                      hprefix' (by omega)
  have hpq0 : forall k : Nat, k <= 0 -> p k = q k := by
    intro k hk
    have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk
    subst k
    calc
      p 0 = A :=
        RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint hp
      _ = q 0 :=
        Eq.symm
          (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint hq)
  exact
    merge (n + m) 0 n m p q hp hq
      (StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable.refl hp)
      (StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable.refl hq)
      (Nat.zero_le n) (Nat.zero_le m) hpq0 (by omega)

name: exists_commonStrictIntervalPartition_reachableByInsertions
statement:
theorem exists_commonStrictIntervalPartition_reachableByInsertions
    {A B : Point} {n m : Nat} {p q : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : StrictIntervalPartition A B n p)
    (hq : StrictIntervalPartition A B m q) :
    Nonempty (StrictCommonRefinementData A B n p m q)
proof:
:= by
  cases
      exists_commonStrictIntervalPartition_reachableByInsertions_raw hp hq with
  | intro count hcount =>
      cases hcount with
      | intro left hleft =>
          cases hleft with
          | intro right hdata =>
              exact
                Nonempty.intro
                  { count := count
                    left := left
                    right := right

name: gaugeFineTaggedPartition_one_of_cell_subset_gaugeBall
statement:
theorem gaugeFineTaggedPartition_one_of_cell_subset_gaugeBall
    {x y xi : Point} {delta : Point -> Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hxi : RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y xi)
    (hball :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
          RealTheory.OpenInterval
            (RealTheory.sub xi (delta xi))
            (RealTheory.add xi (delta xi)) z) :
    GaugeFineTaggedPartition x y 1
      (twoPointPartition x y) (fun _ : Nat => xi) delta
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · refine And.intro (twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hxy) ?_
    intro k hk
    cases k with
    | zero =>
        unfold PartitionCell twoPointPartition
        exact hxi
    | succ k =>
        have hk0 : k < 0 := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk
        exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk0)
  · intro k hk
    unfold GaugeFineCell
    intro z hz
    cases k with
    | zero =>
        unfold twoPointPartition at hz
        exact RealFunction.dist_lt_of_mem_center_interval (hball z hz)
    | succ k =>
        have hk0 : k < 0 := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk
        exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk0)

name: gaugeFineTaggedPartition_adjacent
statement:
theorem gaugeFineTaggedPartition_adjacent
    {a c b : Point}
    {left right leftTag rightTag : Nat -> Point}
    {leftCount rightCount : Nat} {delta : Point -> Point}
    (hleft :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a c leftCount left leftTag delta)
    (hright :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition c b rightCount right rightTag delta) :
    GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b (leftCount + rightCount)
      (adjacentPartition left right leftCount)
      (adjacentTags leftTag rightTag leftCount) delta
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro
    (adjacentTaggedPartition hleft.left hright.left) ?_
  intro k hk
  unfold GaugeFineCell
  intro y hy
  by_cases hk_left : k < leftCount
  · have hfine := hleft.right k hk_left
    unfold GaugeFineCell at hfine
    change
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist y (adjacentTags leftTag rightTag leftCount k))
        (delta (adjacentTags leftTag rightTag leftCount k))
    rw [adjacentTags_left_of_lt leftTag rightTag hk_left]
    apply hfine y
    change
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval
        (adjacentPartition left right leftCount k)
        (adjacentPartition left right leftCount (k + 1)) y at hy
    rw [adjacentPartition_left_of_lt left right hk_left] at hy
    by_cases hk_succ_left : k + 1 < leftCount
    · rw [adjacentPartition_left_of_lt left right hk_succ_left] at hy
      exact hy
    · have hk_succ_eq : k + 1 = leftCount := by
        omega
      rw [hk_succ_eq] at hy
      rw [adjacentPartition_boundary left right leftCount] at hy
      rw [intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright.left.left] at hy
      rw [<- intervalPartition_right_endpoint hleft.left.left] at hy
      rw [<- hk_succ_eq] at hy
      exact hy
  · have hleft_le : leftCount <= k := Nat.le_of_not_gt hk_left
    have hk_right : k - leftCount < rightCount := by
      omega
    have hfine := hright.right (k - leftCount) hk_right
    unfold GaugeFineCell at hfine
    change
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist y (adjacentTags leftTag rightTag leftCount k))
        (delta (adjacentTags leftTag rightTag leftCount k))
    rw [adjacentTags_right_of_le leftTag rightTag hleft_le]
    apply hfine y
    change
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval
        (adjacentPartition left right leftCount k)
        (adjacentPartition left right leftCount (k + 1)) y at hy
    rw [adjacentPartition_right_of_le left right hleft_le] at hy
    have hleft_le_succ : leftCount <= k + 1 :=
      Nat.le_trans hleft_le (Nat.le_succ k)
    rw [adjacentPartition_right_of_le left right hleft_le_succ] at hy
    have hsub : (k + 1) - leftCount = (k - leftCount) + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [hsub] at hy
    exact hy
