name: cousinReachable_append_one
statement:
private theorem cousinReachable_append_one
    {a x y xi : Point} {delta : Point -> Point}
    (hreach : CousinReachable a delta x)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hxi : RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y xi)
    (hball :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
          RealTheory.OpenInterval
            (RealTheory.sub xi (delta xi))
            (RealTheory.add xi (delta xi)) z) :
    CousinReachable a delta y
proof:
:= by
  cases hreach with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases hn with
      | intro p hp =>
          cases hp with
          | intro tag htag =>
              refine Exists.intro (n + 1) ?_
              refine Exists.intro (adjacentPartition p (twoPointPartition x y) n) ?_
              refine Exists.intro
                (adjacentTags tag (fun _ : Nat => xi) n) ?_
              exact
                gaugeFineTaggedPartition_adjacent
                  htag
                  (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_one_of_cell_subset_gaugeBall
                    hxy hxi hball)

theorem closedInterval_subset_rightEndpointGaugeBall_of_left_gt
    {left right radius : Point}

name: exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_closedIntervalGaugeOn
statement:
theorem exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_closedIntervalGaugeOn
    {a b : Point} {delta : Point -> Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hgauge : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
            Exists
              (fun tag : Nat -> Point =>
                GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag delta)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let S : Point -> Prop :=
    fun x : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (CousinReachable a delta x)
  have hS_nonempty : Exists S := by
    refine Exists.intro a ?_
    exact And.intro
      (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab)
      (cousinReachable_self a delta)
  have hS_bdd : Exists (IsUpperBound F.le S) := by
    refine Exists.intro b ?_
    intro x hx
    exact hx.left.right
  cases RealTheory.exists_lub S hS_nonempty hS_bdd with
  | intro s hs =>
      have haS : S a := by
        exact And.intro
          (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab)
          (cousinReachable_self a delta)
      have has : RealTheory.le a s :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F hs haS
      have hsb : RealTheory.le s b := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lub_le_of_upper F hs
        intro x hx
        exact hx.left.right
      have hsClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b s :=
        And.intro has hsb
      have hdelta_s : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (delta s) :=
        hgauge s hsClosed
      have hsReach : CousinReachable a delta s := by
        have hleft_lt_s :
            RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub s (delta s)) s :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hdelta_s
        cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub F hs hleft_lt_s with
        | intro x hx =>
            have hxS : S x := hx.left
            have hx_gt : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub s (delta s)) x :=
              hx.right
            have hxs : RealTheory.le x s :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F hs hxS
            exact
              cousinReachable_append_one
                hxS.right
                hxs
                (And.intro hxs (RealTheory.le_refl s))
                (closedInterval_subset_rightEndpointGaugeBall_of_left_gt
                  hx_gt hdelta_s)
      by_cases hsb_lt : RealTheory.lt s b
      · have hgap_right_pos :
            RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b s) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hsb_lt
        let gap := RealTheory.min (delta s) (RealTheory.sub b s)
        have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap := by
          unfold gap RealTheory.min
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdelta_s hgap_right_pos
        let theta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F gap
        have htheta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero theta := by
          unfold theta
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hgap_pos
        have htheta_lt_gap : RealTheory.lt theta gap := by
          unfold theta
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hgap_pos
        let y := RealTheory.add s theta
        have hsy_lt : RealTheory.lt s y := by
          unfold y
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F htheta_pos
        have hsy : RealTheory.le s y :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsy_lt
        have htheta_le_bsub :
            RealTheory.le theta (RealTheory.sub b s) := by
          have htheta_le_gap : RealTheory.le theta gap :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F htheta_lt_gap
          have hgap_le_bsub :
              RealTheory.le gap (RealTheory.sub b s) := by
            unfold gap
            exact
              RealTheory.min_le_right (delta s) (RealTheory.sub b s)
          exact RealTheory.le_trans htheta_le_gap hgap_le_bsub
        have hyb : RealTheory.le y b := by
          unfold y
          have hadd :
              F.le (F.add s theta) (F.add s (F.sub b s)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F htheta_le_bsub s
          have hright_eq : F.add s (F.sub b s) = b := by
            rw [F.add_comm]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b s
          rwa [hright_eq] at hadd
        have htheta_lt_delta :
            RealTheory.lt theta (delta s) := by
          have hgap_le_delta : RealTheory.le gap (delta s) := by
            unfold gap
            exact RealTheory.min_le_left (delta s) (RealTheory.sub b s)
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
            htheta_lt_gap hgap_le_delta
        have hy_delta :
            RealTheory.lt y (RealTheory.add s (delta s)) := by
          unfold y
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F htheta_lt_delta s
        have hyClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y :=
          And.intro (RealTheory.le_trans has hsy) hyb
        have hyReach : CousinReachable a delta y :=
          cousinReachable_append_one
            hsReach
            hsy
            (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl s) hsy)
            (closedInterval_subset_leftEndpointGaugeBall_of_right_lt
              hy_delta hdelta_s)
        have hyS : S y := And.intro hyClosed hyReach
        have hys : RealTheory.le y s :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F hs hyS
        exact False.elim
          ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hsy_lt) hys)
      · have hbs : RealTheory.le b s :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hsb_lt
        have hs_eq_b : s = b := F.le_antisymm hsb hbs
        rw [hs_eq_b] at hsReach
        exact hsReach

theorem imageTaggedPartitionIncreasing_of_monotoneOn
    {phi : Point -> Point} {c d a b : Point}

      (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p)
      (imageTagIncreasing phi tag)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : IntervalPartition c d n p := htag.left
  refine And.intro
    (imagePartitionIncreasing_intervalPartition_of_monotoneOn
      hleft hright hmono hp) ?_
  intro k hk
  unfold PartitionCell imagePartitionIncreasing imageTagIncreasing
  have htagCell : PartitionCell p k (tag k) :=
    taggedPartition_tag_mem_cell htag hk
  have hleftClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left hp hk
  have hrightClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right hp hk
  have htagClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d (tag k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval hp hk htagCell
  exact And.intro
    (hmono (p k) (tag k) hleftClosed htagClosed htagCell.left)
    (hmono (tag k) (p (k + 1)) htagClosed hrightClosed htagCell.right)

name: preimagePartitionIncreasing_left_endpoint

name: preimagePartitionIncreasing_intervalPartition_of_image
statement:
theorem preimagePartitionIncreasing_intervalPartition_of_image
    {phi : Point -> Point} {c d a b : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d)
    (hleft : phi c = a)
    (hright : phi d = b)
    (hstrict :
      RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (himage :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        RealFunction.Image (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi (p k)) :
    IntervalPartition c d n (preimagePartitionIncreasing phi c d p)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact preimagePartitionIncreasing_left_endpoint
      hcd hstrict (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hp) hleft
  · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · exact preimagePartitionIncreasing_right_endpoint
        hcd hstrict (intervalPartition_right_endpoint hp) hright
    · intro k hk
      unfold preimagePartitionIncreasing
      exact
        RealFunction.inverseOn_monotoneOn_image hstrict
          (p k) (p (k + 1))
          (himage k (Nat.le_of_lt hk))
          (himage (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk))
          (intervalPartition_step_le hp hk)

name: imagePartitionIncreasing_partitionRefines_of_preimagePartitionIncreasing
statement:
theorem imagePartitionIncreasing_partitionRefines_of_preimagePartitionIncreasing
    {phi : Point -> Point} {c d a b : Point}
    {m n : Nat} {fine p : Nat -> Point}
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d)
    (hleft : phi c = a)
    (hright : phi d = b)
    (hstrict :
      RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hfine : IntervalPartition c d m fine)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (href :
      PartitionRefines fine m
        (preimagePartitionIncreasing phi c d p) n) :
    PartitionRefines (imagePartitionIncreasing phi fine) m p n
proof:
:= by
  have hpre :
      IntervalPartition c d n (preimagePartitionIncreasing phi c d p) :=
    preimagePartitionIncreasing_intervalPartition_of_endpoint_values
      hcd hleft hright hstrict hcont hp
  have hrefImage :
      PartitionRefines
        (imagePartitionIncreasing phi fine) m
        (imagePartitionIncreasing phi
          (preimagePartitionIncreasing phi c d p)) n :=
    imagePartitionIncreasing_partitionRefines_of_strictMonotoneOn
      hstrict hfine hpre href
  intro j hj
  cases hrefImage j hj with
  | intro i hi =>
      refine Exists.intro i ?_
      refine And.intro hi.left ?_
      unfold imagePartitionIncreasing at hi
      unfold imagePartitionIncreasing
      have hleftValue :
          phi (preimagePartitionIncreasing phi c d p i) = p i :=
        preimagePartitionIncreasing_value_of_endpoint_values
          hcd hleft hright hcont hp (Nat.le_of_lt hi.left)
      have hrightValue :
          phi (preimagePartitionIncreasing phi c d p (i + 1)) =
            p (i + 1) :=
        preimagePartitionIncreasing_value_of_endpoint_values
          hcd hleft hright hcont hp (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi.left)
      exact And.intro
        (by
          rw [<- hleftValue]
          exact hi.right.left)
        (by
          rw [<- hrightValue]
          exact hi.right.right)

theorem imageTaggedPartitionIncreasing_refines_of_preimagePartitionIncreasing

      PartitionRefines fine m
        (preimagePartitionIncreasing phi c d p) n) :
    And
      (TaggedPartition a b m
        (imagePartitionIncreasing phi fine)
        (imageTagIncreasing phi tag))
      (PartitionRefines (imagePartitionIncreasing phi fine) m p n)
proof:
:= by

    (imageTaggedPartitionIncreasing_of_strictMonotoneOn

    (imagePartitionIncreasing_partitionRefines_of_preimagePartitionIncreasing

name: preimagePartitionIncreasing_partitionRefines_of_imagePartitionIncreasing
statement:
theorem preimagePartitionIncreasing_partitionRefines_of_imagePartitionIncreasing
    {phi : Point -> Point} {c d a b : Point}
    {m n : Nat} {fine coarse : Nat -> Point}
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d)
    (hleft : phi c = a)
    (hright : phi d = b)
    (hstrict :
      RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hfine : IntervalPartition a b m fine)
    (hcoarse : IntervalPartition c d n coarse)
    (href :
      PartitionRefines fine m
        (imagePartitionIncreasing phi coarse) n) :
    PartitionRefines
      (preimagePartitionIncreasing phi c d fine) m coarse n
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  cases href j hj with
  | intro i hi =>
      refine Exists.intro i ?_
      refine And.intro hi.left ?_
      unfold imagePartitionIncreasing at hi
      have hcoarseLeft :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d (coarse i) :=
        intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left hcoarse hi.left
      have hcoarseRight :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d (coarse (i + 1)) :=
        intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right hcoarse hi.left
      have hfineLeftImage :
          RealFunction.Image (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi (fine j) :=
        intervalPartition_point_image_of_endpoint_values
          hcd hleft hright hcont hfine (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
      have hfineRightImage :
          RealFunction.Image
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi (fine (j + 1)) :=
        intervalPartition_point_image_of_endpoint_values
          hcd hleft hright hcont hfine (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj)
      have hcoarseLeftImage :
          RealFunction.Image
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi (phi (coarse i)) :=
        RealFunction.image_intro hcoarseLeft
      have hcoarseRightImage :
          RealFunction.Image
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi (phi (coarse (i + 1))) :=
        RealFunction.image_intro hcoarseRight
      have hleftInv :
          RealFunction.InverseOn
              (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi (phi (coarse i)) =
            coarse i :=
        RealFunction.inverseOn_image_self
          (RealFunction.strictMonotoneOn_injectiveOn hstrict)
          hcoarseLeft
      have hrightInv :
          RealFunction.InverseOn
              (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi
              (phi (coarse (i + 1))) =
            coarse (i + 1) :=
        RealFunction.inverseOn_image_self
          (RealFunction.strictMonotoneOn_injectiveOn hstrict)
          hcoarseRight
      have hleftLe :
          RealTheory.le (coarse i)
            (preimagePartitionIncreasing phi c d fine j) := by
        have hmonoInv :=
          RealFunction.inverseOn_monotoneOn_image hstrict
            (phi (coarse i)) (fine j)
            hcoarseLeftImage hfineLeftImage hi.right.left
        unfold preimagePartitionIncreasing
        rwa [hleftInv] at hmonoInv
      have hrightLe :
          RealTheory.le
            (preimagePartitionIncreasing phi c d fine (j + 1))
            (coarse (i + 1)) := by
        have hmonoInv :=
          RealFunction.inverseOn_monotoneOn_image hstrict
            (fine (j + 1)) (phi (coarse (i + 1)))
            hfineRightImage hcoarseRightImage hi.right.right
        unfold preimagePartitionIncreasing
        rwa [hrightInv] at hmonoInv
      exact And.intro hleftLe hrightLe

name: partitionBlockRefines_cut_succ_eq_of_blockLength_one
statement:
theorem partitionBlockRefines_cut_succ_eq_of_blockLength_one
    {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    {i : Nat}
    (hi : i < n)
    (hblock : refinementBlockLength cut i = 1) :
    cut i + 1 = cut (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : cut i <= cut (i + 1) :=
    partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono_step href hi
  unfold refinementBlockLength at hblock

name: partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono
statement:
theorem partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono
    {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut) :
    forall i j : Nat,
      i <= j -> j <= n -> cut i <= cut j
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  induction j generalizing i with
  | zero =>
      intro hij _hjn
      have hi0 : i = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hij
      rw [hi0]
      exact Nat.le_refl (cut 0)
  | succ j ih =>
      intro hij hjn
      by_cases hij' : i <= j
      case pos =>
        have hleft : cut i <= cut j :=
          ih i hij' (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ j) hjn)
        have hstep : cut j <= cut (j + 1) :=
          partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono_step href
            (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hjn)
        exact Nat.le_trans hleft hstep
      case neg =>
        have hji_lt : j < i := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hij'
        have hji : j + 1 <= i := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hji_lt
        have hi_eq : i = j + 1 := Nat.le_antisymm hij hji
        rw [hi_eq]
        exact Nat.le_refl (cut (j + 1))

name: partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [<- partitionBlockRefines_right href]
  exact partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono href i n hi (Nat.le_refl n)

name: partitionBlockRefines_exists_block_index
statement:
theorem partitionBlockRefines_exists_block_index
    {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    {j : Nat}
    (hj : j < m) :
    Exists
      (fun i : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun h : Nat =>
            And (i < n)
              (And (h < refinementBlockLength cut i)
                (j = cut i + h))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P := fun k : Nat => j < cut k
  have hex : Exists P := by
    refine Exists.intro n ?_
    unfold P
    rw [partitionBlockRefines_right href]
    exact hj
  let k := Tautology.Nat.least P hex
  have hkP : P k := Tautology.Nat.least_spec P hex
  have hk_le_n : k <= n :=
    Tautology.Nat.least_min P hex
      (k := n) (by
        unfold P
        rw [partitionBlockRefines_right href]
        exact hj)
  have hk_pos : 0 < k := by
    by_cases hk0 : k = 0
    case pos =>
      unfold P at hkP
      rw [hk0, partitionBlockRefines_left href] at hkP
      exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero j hkP)
    case neg =>
      omega
  let i := k - 1
  have hi_succ : i + 1 = k := by
    unfold i
    omega
  have hi_lt_n : i < n := by
    unfold i
    omega
  have hleft_cut : cut i <= j := by
    by_cases hle : cut i <= j
    case pos =>
      exact hle
    case neg =>
      have hP_i : P i := by
        unfold P
        omega
      have hk_le_i : k <= i :=
        Tautology.Nat.least_min P hex hP_i
      unfold i at hk_le_i
      omega
  have hright_cut : j < cut (i + 1) := by
    unfold P at hkP
    rw [hi_succ]
    exact hkP
  let h := j - cut i
  have h_eq : cut i + h = j := by
    unfold h
    exact Nat.add_sub_of_le hleft_cut
  have hh : h < refinementBlockLength cut i := by
    unfold h refinementBlockLength
    omega
  exact
    Exists.intro i
      (Exists.intro h
        (And.intro hi_lt_n (And.intro hh (Eq.symm h_eq))))

name: partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines
statement:
theorem partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines
    {a b : Point} {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    (hq : IntervalPartition a b m q) :
    PartitionRefines q m p n
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  cases partitionBlockRefines_exists_block_index href hj with
  | intro i hi_exists =>
      cases hi_exists with
      | intro h hdata =>
          have hi : i < n := hdata.left
          have hh : h < refinementBlockLength cut i := hdata.right.left
          have hj_eq : j = cut i + h := hdata.right.right
          have hleft_cut : cut i <= j := by omega
          have hright_cut : j + 1 <= cut (i + 1) := by
            unfold refinementBlockLength at hh
            omega
          have hcut_succ_le_m : cut (i + 1) <= m :=
            partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right href (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
          have hleft_q : RealTheory.le (q (cut i)) (q j) :=
            intervalPartition_le_of_le hq (cut i) j
              hleft_cut (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
          have hright_q : RealTheory.le (q (j + 1)) (q (cut (i + 1))) :=
            intervalPartition_le_of_le hq (j + 1) (cut (i + 1))
              hright_cut hcut_succ_le_m
          have hpi : q (cut i) = p i :=
            partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
          have hpi_succ : q (cut (i + 1)) = p (i + 1) :=
            partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
          refine Exists.intro i ?_
          refine And.intro hi ?_
          exact And.intro
            (by rwa [hpi] at hleft_q)
            (by rwa [hpi_succ] at hright_q)

name: firstIndexGe_spec_of_exists
statement:
theorem firstIndexGe_spec_of_exists
    {x : Point} {q : Nat -> Point}
    (h : Exists (fun j : Nat => RealTheory.le x (q j))) :
    RealTheory.le x (q (firstIndexGe x q))
proof:
:= by
  unfold firstIndexGe
  classical
  simp [h]
  exact Tautology.Nat.least_spec
    (fun j : Nat => RealTheory.le x (q j)) h

name: firstIndexGe_le_of_le
statement:
theorem firstIndexGe_le_of_le
    {x : Point} {q : Nat -> Point} {j : Nat}
    (hj : RealTheory.le x (q j)) :
    firstIndexGe x q <= j
proof:
:= by
  have h : Exists (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.le x (q k)) :=
    Exists.intro j hj
  unfold firstIndexGe
  classical
  simp [h]
  exact Tautology.Nat.least_min
    (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.le x (q k)) h hj

name: partitionRefines_firstIndexGe_endpoint
statement:
theorem partitionRefines_firstIndexGe_endpoint
    {a b : Point} {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n i : Nat}
    (hq : IntervalPartition a b m q)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (href : PartitionRefines q m p n)
    (hi : i < n) :
    q (firstIndexGe (p i) q) = p i
proof:
:= by
  let cut := firstIndexGe (p i) q
  have hpi_le_qm : RealTheory.le (p i) (q m) := by
    have hpin : RealTheory.le (p i) (p n) :=
      intervalPartition_le_of_le hp i n (Nat.le_of_lt hi) (Nat.le_refl n)
    rw [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hp] at hpin
    rwa [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hq]
  have hex : Exists (fun j : Nat => RealTheory.le (p i) (q j)) :=
    Exists.intro m hpi_le_qm
  have hpi_le_qcut : RealTheory.le (p i) (q cut) := by
    dsimp [cut]
    exact firstIndexGe_spec_of_exists hex
  have hcut_le_m : cut <= m := by
    dsimp [cut]
    exact firstIndexGe_le_of_le hpi_le_qm
  have hqcut_le_pi : RealTheory.le (q cut) (p i) := by
    by_cases hcut0 : cut = 0
    case pos =>
      have hp0_le_pi : RealTheory.le (p 0) (p i) :=
        intervalPartition_le_of_le hp 0 i (Nat.zero_le i) (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
      rw [hcut0, intervalPartition_left_endpoint hq,
        <- intervalPartition_left_endpoint hp]
      exact hp0_le_pi
    case neg =>
      have hcut_pos : 0 < cut := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hcut0
      have hprev_lt_m : cut - 1 < m := by
        omega
      have hnot_prev :
          Not (RealTheory.le (p i) (q (cut - 1))) := by
        intro hprev
        have hcut_le_prev : cut <= cut - 1 := by
          dsimp [cut] at hprev
          exact firstIndexGe_le_of_le hprev
        omega
      cases href (cut - 1) hprev_lt_m with
      | intro r hr =>
          have hr_lt_n : r < n := hr.left
          have hpr_le_qprev : RealTheory.le (p r) (q (cut - 1)) :=
            hr.right.left
          have hqcut_le_prsucc :
              RealTheory.le (q cut) (p (r + 1)) := by
            have hcell := hr.right.right
            have hidx : (cut - 1) + 1 = cut := by
              omega
            rwa [hidx] at hcell
          have hr_lt_i : r < i := by
            by_cases hir : i <= r
            case pos =>
              have hpi_le_pr : RealTheory.le (p i) (p r) :=
                intervalPartition_le_of_le hp i r hir (Nat.le_of_lt hr_lt_n)
              have hprev : RealTheory.le (p i) (q (cut - 1)) :=
                RealTheory.le_trans hpi_le_pr hpr_le_qprev
              exact False.elim (hnot_prev hprev)
            case neg =>
              exact Nat.lt_of_not_ge hir
          have hrsucc_le_i : r + 1 <= i := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hr_lt_i
          have hprsucc_le_pi : RealTheory.le (p (r + 1)) (p i) :=
            intervalPartition_le_of_le hp (r + 1) i
              hrsucc_le_i (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
          exact RealTheory.le_trans hqcut_le_prsucc hprsucc_le_pi
  exact RealTheory.le_antisymm hqcut_le_pi hpi_le_qcut

name: exists_partitionBlockRefines_of_partitionRefines
statement:
theorem exists_partitionBlockRefines_of_partitionRefines
    {a b : Point} {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat}
    (hq : IntervalPartition a b m q)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (href : PartitionRefines q m p n) :
    Exists (fun cut : Nat -> Nat =>
      PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  case pos =>
    have hm0 : m = 0 := by
      by_cases hmpos : 0 < m
      case pos =>
        cases href 0 hmpos with
        | intro i hi =>
            have hilt : i < n := hi.left
            have hi0 : i < 0 := by
              rwa [hn0] at hilt
            exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero i hi0)
      case neg =>
        omega
    let cut := fun _ : Nat => 0
    refine Exists.intro cut ?_
    refine And.intro rfl ?_
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · dsimp [cut]
      exact hm0.symm
    · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · intro i hi
        have hi0 : i = 0 := by
          omega
        subst i
        dsimp [cut]
        rw [intervalPartition_left_endpoint hq,
          intervalPartition_left_endpoint hp]
      · intro i hi
        rw [hn0] at hi
        exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero i hi)
  case neg =>
    have hnpos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0
    let cut := fun i : Nat =>
      if h : i < n then firstIndexGe (p i) q else m
    refine Exists.intro cut ?_
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · have hq0 : RealTheory.le (p 0) (q 0) := by
        rw [intervalPartition_left_endpoint hq,
          intervalPartition_left_endpoint hp]
        exact RealTheory.le_refl a
      have hfirst0 : firstIndexGe (p 0) q = 0 := by
        apply Nat.le_antisymm
        · exact firstIndexGe_le_of_le hq0
        · exact Nat.zero_le _
      dsimp [cut]
      rw [if_pos hnpos, hfirst0]
    · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · dsimp [cut]
        rw [if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl n)]
      · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
        · intro i hi
          by_cases hin : i < n
          case pos =>
            dsimp [cut]
            rw [if_pos hin]
            exact partitionRefines_firstIndexGe_endpoint hq hp href hin
          case neg =>
            have hin_eq : i = n := Nat.le_antisymm hi (Nat.le_of_not_gt hin)
            subst i
            dsimp [cut]
            rw [if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl n)]
            rw [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hq,
              intervalPartition_right_endpoint hp]
        · intro i hi
          have hsucc_le_n : i + 1 <= n := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi
          by_cases hsucc_lt : i + 1 < n
          case pos =>
            have hstep : RealTheory.le (p i) (p (i + 1)) :=
              intervalPartition_step_le hp hi
            have hsucc_ge :
                RealTheory.le (p (i + 1))
                  (q (firstIndexGe (p (i + 1)) q)) := by
              have hsucc_le_qm : RealTheory.le (p (i + 1)) (q m) := by
                have hpin : RealTheory.le (p (i + 1)) (p n) :=
                  intervalPartition_le_of_le hp (i + 1) n
                    hsucc_le_n (Nat.le_refl n)
                rw [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hp] at hpin
                rwa [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hq]
              exact firstIndexGe_spec_of_exists
                (Exists.intro m hsucc_le_qm)
            have hpi_le_qsucc :
                RealTheory.le (p i)
                  (q (firstIndexGe (p (i + 1)) q)) :=
              RealTheory.le_trans hstep hsucc_ge
            dsimp [cut]
            rw [if_pos hi, if_pos hsucc_lt]
            exact firstIndexGe_le_of_le hpi_le_qsucc
          case neg =>
            have hpi_le_qm : RealTheory.le (p i) (q m) := by
              have hpin : RealTheory.le (p i) (p n) :=
                intervalPartition_le_of_le hp i n
                  (Nat.le_of_lt hi) (Nat.le_refl n)
              rw [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hp] at hpin
              rwa [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hq]
            dsimp [cut]
            rw [if_pos hi, if_neg hsucc_lt]
            exact firstIndexGe_le_of_le hpi_le_qm

name: partitionBlockRefines_unsplit_start_unique
statement:
theorem partitionBlockRefines_unsplit_start_unique
    {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    {i j : Nat}
    (hi : i < n)
    (hj : j < n)
    (hi_block : refinementBlockLength cut i = 1)
    (hj_block : refinementBlockLength cut j = 1)
    (hcut : cut i = cut j) :
    i = j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i < j
  case pos =>
    have hij_succ : i + 1 <= j := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hij
    have hi_succ :
        cut i + 1 = cut (i + 1) :=
      partitionBlockRefines_cut_succ_eq_of_blockLength_one
        href hi hi_block
    have hmono :
        cut (i + 1) <= cut j :=
      partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono href (i + 1) j
        hij_succ (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
    have hcontra : cut i + 1 <= cut i := by
      rw [<- hi_succ] at hmono
      rw [<- hcut] at hmono
      exact hmono
    omega
  case neg =>
    by_cases hji : j < i
    case pos =>
      have hji_succ : j + 1 <= i := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hji
      have hj_succ :
          cut j + 1 = cut (j + 1) :=
        partitionBlockRefines_cut_succ_eq_of_blockLength_one
          href hj hj_block
      have hmono :
          cut (j + 1) <= cut i :=
        partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono href (j + 1) i
          hji_succ (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
      have hcontra : cut j + 1 <= cut j := by
        rw [<- hj_succ] at hmono
        rw [hcut] at hmono
        exact hmono
      omega
    case neg =>
      omega

name: coarseTag_mem_fineCell_of_unsplit_block
proof:
:= by
  have htag : PartitionCell p i (coarseTag i) :=
    hcoarse.right i hi
  have hleft_endpoint : q (cut i) = p i :=
    partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
  have hright_index : cut i + 1 = cut (i + 1) :=
    partitionBlockRefines_cut_succ_eq_of_blockLength_one
      href hi hblock
  have hright_endpoint : q (cut i + 1) = p (i + 1) := by
    rw [hright_index]
    exact partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
  unfold PartitionCell at htag
  unfold PartitionCell
  exact And.intro
    (by
      rw [hleft_endpoint]
      exact htag.left)
    (by
      rw [hright_endpoint]
      exact htag.right)

name: refinementPreserveUnsplitTags_preserves
statement:
theorem refinementPreserveUnsplitTags_preserves
    {q p coarseTag : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut) :
    RefinementTagsPreserveUnsplitBlocks
      (refinementPreserveUnsplitTags q coarseTag n cut) coarseTag n cut
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro i hi hblock
  unfold refinementPreserveUnsplitTags
  by_cases h :
      Exists
        (fun k : Nat =>
          And (k < n)
            (And (refinementBlockLength cut k = 1) (cut i = cut k)))
  case pos =>
    have hspec := Classical.choose_spec h
    have hidx :
        Classical.choose h = i :=
      partitionBlockRefines_unsplit_start_unique href
        hspec.left hi hspec.right.left hblock
        (Eq.symm hspec.right.right)
    rw [dif_pos h]
    rw [hidx]
  case neg =>
    exfalso
    exact h
      (Exists.intro i
        (And.intro hi (And.intro hblock rfl)))

name: refinementPreserveUnsplitTags_taggedPartition
statement:
theorem refinementPreserveUnsplitTags_taggedPartition
    {a b : Point} {q p coarseTag : Nat -> Point}
    {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    (hq : IntervalPartition a b m q)
    (hcoarse : TaggedPartition a b n p coarseTag) :
    TaggedPartition a b m q
      (refinementPreserveUnsplitTags q coarseTag n cut)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hq ?_
  intro j hj
  unfold refinementPreserveUnsplitTags
  by_cases h :
      Exists
        (fun i : Nat =>
          And (i < n)
            (And (refinementBlockLength cut i = 1) (j = cut i)))
  case pos =>
    have hspec := Classical.choose_spec h
    rw [dif_pos h]
    have htag :
        PartitionCell p (Classical.choose h)
          (coarseTag (Classical.choose h)) :=
      hcoarse.right (Classical.choose h) hspec.left
    have hleft_endpoint :
        q j = p (Classical.choose h) :=
      Eq.trans (congrArg q hspec.right.right)
        (partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (Nat.le_of_lt hspec.left))
    have hright_index :
        cut (Classical.choose h) + 1 =
          cut (Classical.choose h + 1) :=
      partitionBlockRefines_cut_succ_eq_of_blockLength_one
        href hspec.left hspec.right.left
    have hright_j :
        j + 1 = cut (Classical.choose h + 1) := by
      omega
    have hright_endpoint :
        q (j + 1) = p (Classical.choose h + 1) :=
      Eq.trans (congrArg q hright_j)
        (partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href
          (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hspec.left))
    unfold PartitionCell at htag
    unfold PartitionCell
    exact And.intro
      (by
        rw [hleft_endpoint]
        exact htag.left)
      (by
        rw [hright_endpoint]
        exact htag.right)
  case neg =>
    rw [dif_neg h]
    exact (leftTags_taggedPartition hq).right j hj

name: exists_refinementPreserveUnsplitTaggedPartition
statement:
theorem exists_refinementPreserveUnsplitTaggedPartition
    {a b : Point} {q p coarseTag : Nat -> Point}
    {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    (hq : IntervalPartition a b m q)
    (hcoarse : TaggedPartition a b n p coarseTag) :
    Exists
      (fun fineTag : Nat -> Point =>
        And (TaggedPartition a b m q fineTag)
          (RefinementTagsPreserveUnsplitBlocks fineTag coarseTag n cut))
proof:
:= by
  exact
    Exists.intro (refinementPreserveUnsplitTags q coarseTag n cut)
      (And.intro
        (refinementPreserveUnsplitTags_taggedPartition href hq hcoarse)
        (refinementPreserveUnsplitTags_preserves href))

name: finiteSum_cut_blocks
statement:
theorem finiteSum_cut_blocks
    (term : Nat -> Point) :
    forall {n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat},
      cut 0 = 0 ->
      (forall i : Nat, i < n -> cut i <= cut (i + 1)) ->
      RealTheory.finiteSum term (cut n) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun h : Nat => term (cut i + h))
              (cut (i + 1) - cut i))
          n
  | 0, cut, h0, _ => by
      rw [h0]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero, RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  | n + 1, cut, h0, hmono => by
      have hmono_last : cut n <= cut (n + 1)
proof:
:=
        hmono n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
      have hidx : cut n + (cut (n + 1) - cut n) = cut (n + 1) :=
        Nat.add_sub_of_le hmono_last
      rw [<- hidx]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length term (cut n)
        (cut (n + 1) - cut n)]
      rw [finiteSum_cut_blocks term h0
        (fun i hi =>
          hmono i (Nat.lt_trans hi (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]

name: partitionBlockRefines_block_index_lt_right_bound

theorem partitionBlockRefines_block_index_lt_right_bound
    {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}

:= by

name: finiteSum_refinementBlockCellLength
statement:
theorem finiteSum_refinementBlockCellLength
    {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    {i : Nat}
    (hi : i < n) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun h : Nat => refinementBlockCellLength q cut i h)
      (refinementBlockLength cut i) =
      cellLength p i
proof:
:= by
  let start := cut i
  let count := refinementBlockLength cut i
  let r := fun h : Nat => q (start + h)
  have hterm :
      forall h : Nat,
        refinementBlockCellLength q cut i h =
          RealTheory.sub (r (h + 1)) (r h) := by
    intro h
    unfold refinementBlockCellLength cellLength r start
    have hidx : cut i + h + 1 = cut i + (h + 1) := by
      omega
    rw [hidx]
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun h : Nat => refinementBlockCellLength q cut i h) count =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat => RealTheory.sub (r (h + 1)) (r h)) count :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_congr hterm count
  rw [hsum]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_telescope_sub]
  unfold count refinementBlockLength r start
  have hmono : cut i <= cut (i + 1) :=
    partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono_step href hi
  have hidx : cut i + (cut (i + 1) - cut i) = cut (i + 1) :=
    Nat.add_sub_of_le hmono
  rw [hidx]
  unfold cellLength
  rw [partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)]
  rw [Nat.add_zero]
  rw [partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (Nat.le_of_lt hi)]

name: refinementBlockCellLength_nonnegative
statement:

    {a b : Point} {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}

name: refinementBlockFineCell_mem_coarseCell
proof:
:= by
  let j := cut i + h
  have hj_lt_cut : j < cut (i + 1) :=
    partitionBlockRefines_block_index_lt_right href hi hh
  have hj_lt_m : j < m :=
    partitionBlockRefines_block_index_lt_right_bound href hi hh
  have hcut_i_le_j : cut i <= j := by
    unfold j
    exact Nat.le_add_right (cut i) h
  have hsucc_le_cut : j + 1 <= cut (i + 1) :=
    Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj_lt_cut
  have hcut_succ_le_m : cut (i + 1) <= m :=
    partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right href (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
  have hleft_q : RealTheory.le (q (cut i)) (q j) :=
    intervalPartition_le_of_le hq (cut i) j
      hcut_i_le_j (Nat.le_of_lt hj_lt_m)
  have hright_q : RealTheory.le (q (j + 1)) (q (cut (i + 1))) :=
    intervalPartition_le_of_le hq (j + 1) (cut (i + 1))
      hsucc_le_cut hcut_succ_le_m
  have hpi : q (cut i) = p i :=
    partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
  have hpi_succ : q (cut (i + 1)) = p (i + 1) :=
    partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
  unfold PartitionCell
  have hleft : RealTheory.le (p i) x := by
    have hleft_q' : RealTheory.le (p i) (q j) := by
      rw [<- hpi]
      exact hleft_q
    exact RealTheory.le_trans hleft_q' hx.left
  have hright : RealTheory.le x (p (i + 1)) := by
    have hright_q' : RealTheory.le (q (j + 1)) (p (i + 1)) := by
      rwa [hpi_succ] at hright_q
    exact RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hright_q'
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: intervalPartition_le_of_le
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_le_of_le
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    forall i j : Nat,
      i <= j -> j <= n -> RealTheory.le (p i) (p j)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  induction j generalizing i with
  | zero =>
      intro hij _hjn
      have hi0 : i = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hij
      rw [hi0]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl (p 0)
  | succ j ih =>
      intro hij hjn
      by_cases hij' : i <= j
      · have hjn' : j <= n := Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ j) hjn
        have hleft : RealTheory.le (p i) (p j) :=
          ih i hij' hjn'
        have hstep : RealTheory.le (p j) (p (j + 1)) :=
          intervalPartition_step_le h (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hjn)
        exact RealTheory.le_trans hleft hstep
      · have hji_lt : j < i := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hij'
        have hji : j + 1 <= i := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hji_lt
        have hi_eq : i = j + 1 := Nat.le_antisymm hij hji
        rw [hi_eq]
        exact RealTheory.le_refl (p (j + 1))

name: strictIntervalPartition_lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem strictIntervalPartition_lt_of_lt
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : StrictIntervalPartition a b n p) :
    forall i j : Nat,
      i < j -> j <= n -> RealTheory.lt (p i) (p j)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  induction j generalizing i with
  | zero =>
      intro hij _hjn
      omega
  | succ j ih =>
      intro hij hjn
      by_cases hij_eq : i = j
      · rw [hij_eq]
        exact strictIntervalPartition_step_lt h (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hjn)
      · have hij' : i < j := by
          omega
        have hjn' : j <= n := Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ j) hjn
        have hleft : RealTheory.lt (p i) (p j) :=
          ih i hij' hjn'
        have hstep : RealTheory.le (p j) (p (j + 1)) :=
          intervalPartition_step_le
            (strictIntervalPartition_intervalPartition h)
            (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hjn)
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hleft hstep

name: intervalPartition_interval_le
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_interval_le
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    RealTheory.le a b
proof:
:= by
  have hle : RealTheory.le (p 0) (p n) :=
    intervalPartition_le_of_le h 0 n (Nat.zero_le n) (Nat.le_refl n)
  rwa [intervalPartition_left_endpoint h, intervalPartition_right_endpoint h]
    at hle

name: not_intervalPartition_of_right_lt_left
statement:
theorem not_intervalPartition_of_right_lt_left
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hba : RealTheory.lt b a) :
    Not (IntervalPartition a b n p)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hba)
      (intervalPartition_interval_le h)

name: intervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval
    {a b : Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k <= n) :
    RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : RealTheory.le a (p k) := by
    have h0k : RealTheory.le (p 0) (p k) :=
      intervalPartition_le_of_le h 0 k (Nat.zero_le k) hk
    rwa [intervalPartition_left_endpoint h] at h0k
  have hright : RealTheory.le (p k) b := by
    have hkn : RealTheory.le (p k) (p n) :=
      intervalPartition_le_of_le h k n hk (Nat.le_refl n)
    rwa [intervalPartition_right_endpoint h] at hkn
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: intervalPartition_degenerate_point_eq
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_degenerate_point_eq
    {a : Point} {n i : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : IntervalPartition a a n p)
    (hi : i <= n) :
    p i = a
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a a (p i) :=
    intervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval h hi
  exact RealTheory.le_antisymm hmem.right hmem.left

name: intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
    {a b : Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k)
proof:
:=
  intervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval h (Nat.le_of_lt hk)

name: intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
    {a b : Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1))
proof:
:=
  intervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval h (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)

name: intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
    {a b : Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point} {x : Point}
    (h : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hx : PartitionCell p k x) :
    RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left h hk
  have hright : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right h hk
  exact And.intro
    (RealTheory.le_trans hleft.left hx.left)
    (RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hright.right)

name: intervalPartition_prefix
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_prefix
    {a b : Point} {n cut : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hcut : cut <= n) :
    IntervalPartition a (p cut) cut p
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro h.left ?_
  refine And.intro rfl ?_
  intro k hk
  exact intervalPartition_step_le h (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk hcut)

name: suffixPartition_zero
statement:
theorem suffixPartition_zero (p : Nat -> Point) (start : Nat) :
    suffixPartition p start 0 = p start
proof:
:= by
  unfold suffixPartition
  rw [Nat.add_zero]

name: suffixPartition_step
statement:
theorem suffixPartition_step (p : Nat -> Point) (start k : Nat) :
    suffixPartition p start k = p (start + k)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le
statement:
theorem cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (c : Point)
    {i : Nat} (hi : i <= k) :
    cutCellPrefixPartition p k c i = p i
proof:
:= by
  unfold cutCellPrefixPartition
  rw [dif_pos hi]

name: cutCellPrefixPartition_succ
statement:
theorem cutCellPrefixPartition_succ
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (c : Point) :
    cutCellPrefixPartition p k c (k + 1) = c
proof:
:= by
  unfold cutCellPrefixPartition
  have hnot : Not (k + 1 <= k) := Nat.not_succ_le_self k
  rw [dif_neg hnot]

name: cutCellSuffixPartition_zero
statement:
theorem cutCellSuffixPartition_zero
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (c : Point) :
    cutCellSuffixPartition p k c 0 = c
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: cutCellSuffixPartition_succ
statement:
theorem cutCellSuffixPartition_succ
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k i : Nat) (c : Point) :
    cutCellSuffixPartition p k c (i + 1) = p (k + i + 1)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: cutCellSuffixPartition_of_pos
statement:
theorem cutCellSuffixPartition_of_pos
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (c : Point)
    {i : Nat} (hi : 0 < i) :
    cutCellSuffixPartition p k c i = p (k + i)
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hi)
  | succ i =>
      have hidx : k + (i + 1) = k + i + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [cutCellSuffixPartition_succ, hidx]

name: intervalPartition_suffix
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_suffix
    {a b : Point} {n cut : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hcut : cut <= n) :
    IntervalPartition (p cut) b (n - cut) (suffixPartition p cut)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact suffixPartition_zero p cut
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · unfold suffixPartition
    have hidx : cut + (n - cut) = n := Nat.add_sub_of_le hcut
    rw [hidx]
    exact h.right.left
  · intro k hk
    unfold suffixPartition
    have hk_lt_n : cut + k < n := by
      omega
    have hidx : cut + (k + 1) = cut + k + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [hidx]
    exact intervalPartition_step_le h hk_lt_n

name: intervalPartition_cutCellPrefix
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_cutCellPrefix
    {a b c : Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hc : PartitionCell p k c) :
    IntervalPartition a c (k + 1) (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · rw [cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le p k c (Nat.zero_le k)]
    exact hp.left
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact cutCellPrefixPartition_succ p k c
  · intro i hi
    by_cases hik : i < k
    · have hi_le : i <= k := Nat.le_of_lt hik
      have hsucc_le : i + 1 <= k := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hik
      rw [cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le p k c hi_le]
      rw [cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le p k c hsucc_le]
      exact intervalPartition_step_le hp (Nat.lt_trans hik hk)
    · have hik_eq : i = k := by
        omega
      subst i
      rw [cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le p k c (Nat.le_refl k)]
      rw [cutCellPrefixPartition_succ p k c]
      exact hc.left

name: intervalPartition_cutCellSuffix
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_cutCellSuffix
    {a b c : Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hc : PartitionCell p k c) :
    IntervalPartition c b (n - k) (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact cutCellSuffixPartition_zero p k c
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · have hpos : 0 < n - k := by
      omega
    rw [cutCellSuffixPartition_of_pos p k c hpos]
    have hidx : k + (n - k) = n := Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hk)
    rw [hidx]
    exact hp.right.left
  · intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero =>
        rw [cutCellSuffixPartition_zero p k c]
        rw [cutCellSuffixPartition_succ p k 0 c]
        have hidx : k + 0 + 1 = k + 1 := by
          omega
        rw [hidx]
        exact hc.right
    | succ i =>
        have hleft_pos : 0 < i + 1 := Nat.succ_pos i
        have hright_pos : 0 < i + 1 + 1 := by
          omega
        rw [cutCellSuffixPartition_of_pos p k c hleft_pos]
        rw [cutCellSuffixPartition_of_pos p k c hright_pos]
        have hidx : k + (i + 1 + 1) = k + (i + 1) + 1 := by
          omega
        rw [hidx]
        have hold : k + (i + 1) < n := by
          omega
        exact intervalPartition_step_le hp hold

name: intervalPartition_cell_cover_succ
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_cell_cover_succ
    {a b x : Point} :
    forall {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point},
      IntervalPartition a b (n + 1) p ->
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
      Exists (fun k : Nat => And (k < n + 1) (PartitionCell p k x))
  | 0, p, h, hx => by
      refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
      refine And.intro (Nat.lt_succ_self 0) ?_
      unfold PartitionCell
      rw [h.left, h.right.left]
      exact hx
  | n + 1, p, h, hx => by
      let c
proof:
:= p (n + 1)
      have hpref : IntervalPartition a c (n + 1) p := by
        refine And.intro h.left ?_
        refine And.intro rfl ?_
        intro k hk
        exact h.right.right k
          (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1)))
      cases RealTheory.le_total x c with
      | inl hxc =>
          have hxpref : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x :=
            And.intro hx.left hxc
          cases intervalPartition_cell_cover_succ
              (n := n) (p := p) hpref hxpref with
          | intro k hk =>
              exact Exists.intro k
                (And.intro
                  (Nat.lt_trans hk.left (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1)))
                  hk.right)
      | inr hcx =>
          refine Exists.intro (n + 1) ?_
          refine And.intro (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1)) ?_
          unfold PartitionCell
          have hright : RealTheory.le x (p ((n + 1) + 1)) := by
            rw [h.right.left]
            exact hx.right
          exact And.intro hcx hright

name: dist_le_cellLength_of_partitionCell
statement:
theorem dist_le_cellLength_of_partitionCell
    {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat} {x y : Point}
    (hx : PartitionCell p k x)
    (hy : PartitionCell p k y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y)
      (cellLength p k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist cellLength
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_le_of_bounds F
  · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
      hx.right hy.left
  · rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x y]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
      hy.right hx.left

name: cellLength_eq_zero_of_degenerate
statement:
theorem cellLength_eq_zero_of_degenerate
    {a : Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : IntervalPartition a a n p)
    (hk : k < n) :
    cellLength p k = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold cellLength
  rw [intervalPartition_degenerate_point_eq h (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)]
  rw [intervalPartition_degenerate_point_eq h (Nat.le_of_lt hk)]
  rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg, RealTheory.add_neg]

name: mesh_nonnegative_of_cellLength_nonnegative
statement:
theorem mesh_nonnegative_of_cellLength_nonnegative
    (p : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (cellLength p k)) ->
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (mesh p n)
  | 0, _ => by
      rw [mesh_zero]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  | n + 1, hnonneg => by
      rw [mesh_succ]
      have ih : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (mesh p n)
proof:
:=
        mesh_nonnegative_of_cellLength_nonnegative p n
          (fun k hk =>
            hnonneg k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))
      exact RealTheory.le_trans ih
        (RealTheory.le_max_left (mesh p n) (cellLength p n))

name: mesh_nonnegative
statement:
theorem mesh_nonnegative
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (mesh p n)
proof:
:=
  mesh_nonnegative_of_cellLength_nonnegative p n
    (fun _ hk => cellLength_nonnegative h hk)

name: cellLength_le_mesh
statement:
theorem cellLength_le_mesh
    (p : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n k : Nat,
      k < n -> RealTheory.le (cellLength p k) (mesh p n)
  | 0, _, hk => False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hk)
  | n + 1, k, hk => by
      rw [mesh_succ]
      by_cases hkn : k < n
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans
          (cellLength_le_mesh p n k hkn)
          (RealTheory.le_max_left (mesh p n) (cellLength p n))
      · have hk_eq : k = n
proof:
:= by
          omega
        rw [hk_eq]
        exact RealTheory.le_max_right (mesh p n) (cellLength p n)

name: cellLength_le_cellLength_of_cell_subset
statement:
theorem cellLength_le_cellLength_of_cell_subset
    {p q : Nat -> Point} {i j : Nat}
    (hleft : RealTheory.le (p i) (q j))
    (hright : RealTheory.le (q (j + 1)) (p (i + 1))) :
    RealTheory.le (cellLength q j) (cellLength p i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cellLength
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hright hleft

name: mesh_le_of_cellLength_le
statement:
theorem mesh_le_of_cellLength_le
    (p : Nat -> Point) :
    forall (n : Nat) (M : Point),
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M ->
      (forall k : Nat, k < n -> RealTheory.le (cellLength p k) M) ->
      RealTheory.le (mesh p n) M
  | 0, M, hM, _ => by
      rw [mesh_zero]
      exact hM
  | n + 1, M, hM, hcell => by
      rw [mesh_succ]
      exact RealTheory.max_le
        (mesh_le_of_cellLength_le p n M hM
          (fun k hk =>
            hcell k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n))))
        (hcell n (Nat.lt_succ_self n))

name: mesh_lt_of_cellLength_lt
statement:
theorem mesh_lt_of_cellLength_lt
    (p : Nat -> Point) :
    forall (n : Nat) (delta : Point),
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta ->
      (forall k : Nat, k < n -> RealTheory.lt (cellLength p k) delta) ->
      RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta
  | 0, delta, hdelta, _ => by
      rw [mesh_zero]
      exact hdelta
  | n + 1, delta, hdelta, hcell => by
      rw [mesh_succ]
      unfold RealTheory.max
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (mesh_lt_of_cellLength_lt p n delta hdelta
          (fun k hk =>
            hcell k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n))))
        (hcell n (Nat.lt_succ_self n))

name: cellLength_le_mesh_of_refines
statement:
theorem cellLength_le_mesh_of_refines
    {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n j : Nat}
    (href : PartitionRefines q m p n)
    (hj : j < m) :
    RealTheory.le (cellLength q j) (mesh p n)
proof:
:= by
  cases href j hj with
  | intro i hi =>
      exact RealTheory.le_trans
        (cellLength_le_cellLength_of_cell_subset
          hi.right.left hi.right.right)
        (cellLength_le_mesh p n i hi.left)

name: mesh_le_of_refines
statement:
theorem mesh_le_of_refines
    {a b : Point} {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (href : PartitionRefines q m p n) :
    RealTheory.le (mesh q m) (mesh p n)
proof:
:=
  mesh_le_of_cellLength_le q m (mesh p n)
    (mesh_nonnegative hp)
    (fun _ hj => cellLength_le_mesh_of_refines href hj)

name: mesh_prefix_le
statement:
theorem mesh_prefix_le
    {a b : Point} {n cut : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hcut : cut <= n) :
    RealTheory.le (mesh p cut) (mesh p n)
proof:
:=
  mesh_le_of_cellLength_le p cut (mesh p n)
    (mesh_nonnegative hp)
    (fun k hk =>
      cellLength_le_mesh p n k (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk hcut))

name: cellLength_suffixPartition
statement:
theorem cellLength_suffixPartition
    (p : Nat -> Point) (cut k : Nat) :
    cellLength (suffixPartition p cut) k = cellLength p (cut + k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cellLength suffixPartition
  have hidx : cut + (k + 1) = cut + k + 1 := by
    omega
  rw [hidx]

name: cellLength_cutCellPrefixPartition_of_lt
statement:
theorem cellLength_cutCellPrefixPartition_of_lt
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (c : Point)
    {i : Nat} (hi : i < k) :
    cellLength (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c) i = cellLength p i
proof:
:= by
  unfold cellLength
  have hi_le : i <= k := Nat.le_of_lt hi
  have hsucc_le : i + 1 <= k := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi
  rw [cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le p k c hi_le]
  rw [cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le p k c hsucc_le]

name: cellLength_cutCellPrefixPartition_split
statement:
theorem cellLength_cutCellPrefixPartition_split
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (c : Point) :
    cellLength (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c) k =
      RealTheory.sub c (p k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cellLength
  rw [cutCellPrefixPartition_succ p k c]
  rw [cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le p k c (Nat.le_refl k)]

name: cellLength_cutCellSuffixPartition_zero
statement:
theorem cellLength_cutCellSuffixPartition_zero
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (c : Point) :
    cellLength (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c) 0 =
      RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) c
proof:
:= by
  unfold cellLength
  rw [cutCellSuffixPartition_zero p k c]
  rw [cutCellSuffixPartition_succ p k 0 c]

name: cellLength_cutCellSuffixPartition_succ
statement:
theorem cellLength_cutCellSuffixPartition_succ
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k i : Nat) (c : Point) :
    cellLength (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c) (i + 1) =
      cellLength p (k + i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cellLength
  rw [cutCellSuffixPartition_succ p k i c]
  rw [cutCellSuffixPartition_succ p k (i + 1) c]
  have hidx : k + (i + 1) + 1 = k + i + 1 + 1 := by
    omega
  rw [hidx]

name: mesh_suffix_le
statement:
theorem mesh_suffix_le
    {a b : Point} {n cut : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hcut : cut <= n) :
    RealTheory.le (mesh (suffixPartition p cut) (n - cut)) (mesh p n)
proof:
:=
  mesh_le_of_cellLength_le (suffixPartition p cut) (n - cut) (mesh p n)
    (mesh_nonnegative hp)
    (fun k hk => by
      rw [cellLength_suffixPartition]
      have hk_lt : cut + k < n := by
        omega
      exact cellLength_le_mesh p n (cut + k) hk_lt)

name: finiteSum_cellLength
statement:
theorem finiteSum_cellLength
    (p : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.finiteSum (cellLength p) n =
        RealTheory.sub (p n) (p 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  unfold cellLength
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_telescope_sub p n

name: intervalPartition_finiteSum_cellLength
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_finiteSum_cellLength
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum (cellLength p) n =
      RealTheory.sub b a
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSum_cellLength]
  rw [intervalPartition_right_endpoint h]
  rw [intervalPartition_left_endpoint h]

name: intervalListLength_partition_range_eq_finiteSum_cellLength
statement:
private theorem intervalListLength_partition_range_eq_finiteSum_cellLength
    (p : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealInterval.intervalListLength
        (fun k : Nat => p k) (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1))
        (List.range n) =
          RealTheory.finiteSum (cellLength p) n
  | 0 => by
      change
        RealTheory.zero =
          RealTheory.finiteSum (cellLength p) 0
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [List.range_succ]
      rw [RealInterval.intervalListLength_append]
      rw [intervalListLength_partition_range_eq_finiteSum_cellLength p n]
      rw [RealInterval.intervalListLength_singleton_eq_lengthAt]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      unfold RealInterval.IntervalLengthAt cellLength
      change
        RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.finiteSum (cellLength p) n)
            (RealTheory.sub (p (n + 1)) (p n)) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.finiteSum (cellLength p) n)
            (RealTheory.sub (p (n + 1)) (p n))
      rfl

/
of intervals, over the index list `List.range n`. Arc length and absolute
continuity read partitions through this bridge between the two presentations.
-/

name: intervalListLength_range_of_intervalPartition_eq_sub
statement:
theorem intervalListLength_range_of_intervalPartition_eq_sub
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    RealInterval.intervalListLength
      (fun k : Nat => p k) (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1))
      (List.range n) =
        RealTheory.sub b a
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalListLength_partition_range_eq_finiteSum_cellLength]

name: intervalPartition_openCell_disjoint_of_lt
statement:
private theorem intervalPartition_openCell_disjoint_of_lt
    {a b : Point} {n i j : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hij : i < j)
    (hj : j < n) :
    SetPred.Disjoint
      (RealInterval.IntervalAt
        (fun k : Nat => p k) (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) i)
      (RealInterval.IntervalAt
        (fun k : Nat => p k) (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) j)
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro x hxi hxj
  have hi_succ_le_j : i + 1 <= j := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hij
  have hp_right_le_left :
      RealTheory.le (p (i + 1)) (p j) :=
    intervalPartition_le_of_le hp (i + 1) j
      hi_succ_le_j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
  have hright_lt_x :
      RealTheory.lt (p (i + 1)) x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hp_right_le_left hxj.left
  have hbad :
      RealTheory.lt (p (i + 1)) (p (i + 1)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans C hright_lt_x hxi.right
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl C (p (i + 1)) hbad

name: intervalPartition_openCell_disjoint_of_ne
statement:
private theorem intervalPartition_openCell_disjoint_of_ne
    {a b : Point} {n i j : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hi : i < n)
    (hj : j < n)
    (hij : Not (i = j)) :
    SetPred.Disjoint
      (RealInterval.IntervalAt
        (fun k : Nat => p k) (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) i)
      (RealInterval.IntervalAt
        (fun k : Nat => p k) (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlt : i < j
  case pos =>
    exact intervalPartition_openCell_disjoint_of_lt hp hlt hj
  case neg =>
    have hjlt : j < i := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne
      (Nat.le_of_not_gt hlt) (fun hji => hij (Eq.symm hji))
    intro x hxi hxj
    exact
      intervalPartition_openCell_disjoint_of_lt hp hjlt hi
        x hxj hxi

name: intervalPartition_intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_of_mem_lt
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_of_mem_lt
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    forall xs : List Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, List.Mem k xs -> k < n) ->
        List.Nodup xs ->
          RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
            (fun k : Nat => p k)
            (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) xs
  | [], _hmem, _hnodup => by
      unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
      exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | head :: tail, hmem, hnodup => by
      have hhead_lt : head < n
proof:
:=
        hmem head (List.Mem.head tail)
      have htail_mem :
          forall k : Nat, List.Mem k tail -> k < n := by
        intro k hk
        exact hmem k (List.Mem.tail head hk)
      have hnot_mem : Not (List.Mem head tail) :=
        (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).left
      have htail_nodup : List.Nodup tail :=
        (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).right
      have htail_pair :
          RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
            (fun k : Nat => p k)
            (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) tail :=
        intervalPartition_intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_of_mem_lt
          hp tail htail_mem htail_nodup
      unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
      exact List.Pairwise.cons
        (by
          intro y hy
          have hy_lt : y < n := htail_mem y hy
          have hne : Not (head = y) := by
            intro h
            exact hnot_mem (by rw [h]; exact hy)
          exact intervalPartition_openCell_disjoint_of_ne
            hp hhead_lt hy_lt hne)
        (by
          unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint at htail_pair
          exact htail_pair)

    rw [adjacentPartition_right_of_le p (suffixPartition p cut) hcut_le]

name: adjacentPartition_intervalPartition
statement:
theorem adjacentPartition_intervalPartition
    {a c b : Point}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a c leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition c b rightCount right) :
    IntervalPartition a b (leftCount + rightCount)
      (adjacentPartition left right leftCount)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · by_cases hpos : 0 < leftCount
    · rw [adjacentPartition_left_of_lt left right hpos]
      exact intervalPartition_left_endpoint hleft
    · have hzero : leftCount = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hpos
      have hac : a = c := by
        have hleft0 : left 0 = a := intervalPartition_left_endpoint hleft
        have hright0 : left 0 = c := by
          rw [← hzero]
          exact intervalPartition_right_endpoint hleft
        exact Eq.trans hleft0.symm hright0
      rw [hzero]
      rw [adjacentPartition_right_shift left right 0 0]
      rw [hac]
      exact intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · rw [adjacentPartition_right_shift left right leftCount rightCount]
    exact intervalPartition_right_endpoint hright
  · intro k hk
    by_cases hk_left : k < leftCount
    · by_cases hk_succ_left : k + 1 < leftCount
      · rw [adjacentPartition_left_of_lt left right hk_left]
        rw [adjacentPartition_left_of_lt left right hk_succ_left]
        exact intervalPartition_step_le hleft hk_left
      · have hk_succ_eq : k + 1 = leftCount := by
          omega
        rw [adjacentPartition_left_of_lt left right hk_left]
        rw [hk_succ_eq]
        rw [adjacentPartition_boundary left right leftCount]
        rw [intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright]
        have hstep : RealTheory.le (left k) c := by
          have hmono := intervalPartition_step_le hleft hk_left
          rw [hk_succ_eq, intervalPartition_right_endpoint hleft] at hmono
          exact hmono
        exact hstep
    · have hleft_le : leftCount <= k := Nat.le_of_not_gt hk_left
      have hleft_le_succ : leftCount <= k + 1 := Nat.le_trans
        hleft_le (Nat.le_succ k)
      rw [adjacentPartition_right_of_le left right hleft_le]
      rw [adjacentPartition_right_of_le left right hleft_le_succ]
      have hsub : (k + 1) - leftCount = (k - leftCount) + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [hsub]
      have hk_right : k - leftCount < rightCount := by
        omega
      exact intervalPartition_step_le hright hk_right

name: mesh_adjacentPartition_lt
statement:
theorem mesh_adjacentPartition_lt
    {a c b delta : Point}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat}

    (hright : IntervalPartition c b rightCount right)
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)

    RealTheory.lt
      (mesh (adjacentPartition left right leftCount)
        (leftCount + rightCount))
      delta
proof:
:=
  mesh_lt_of_cellLength_lt
    (adjacentPartition left right leftCount)
    (leftCount + rightCount) delta hdelta
    (fun k hk => by
      by_cases hk_left : k < leftCount
      · rw [cellLength_adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
          hleft (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright) hk_left]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (cellLength_le_mesh left leftCount k hk_left)
          hleft_mesh
      · have hleft_le : leftCount <= k := Nat.le_of_not_gt hk_left
        rw [cellLength_adjacentPartition_right_of_le left right hleft_le]
        have hk_right : k - leftCount < rightCount := by
          omega
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (cellLength_le_mesh right rightCount (k - leftCount) hk_right)
          hright_mesh)

name: uniformPartition_zero
statement:
theorem uniformPartition_zero (a step : Point) :
    uniformPartition a step 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.add a (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F 0) step) = a
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F]
  rw [F.add_zero]

name: uniformPartition_succ_eq_add
statement:
theorem uniformPartition_succ_eq_add
    (a step : Point) (k : Nat) :
    uniformPartition a step (k + 1) =
      RealTheory.add (uniformPartition a step k) step
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.add a (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (k + 1)) step) =
      F.add (F.add a (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F k) step)) step
  calc
    F.add a (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (k + 1)) step) =
        F.add a
          (F.mul
            (F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F k) F.one) step) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ F k]
    _ = F.add a
          (F.add
            (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F k) step)
            (F.mul F.one step)) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.add a
          (F.add (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F k) step) step) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.add (F.add a
          (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F k) step)) step := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: uniformPartition_endpoint_of_span
statement:
theorem uniformPartition_endpoint_of_span
    {a b step : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hspan : RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) step =

    uniformPartition a step n = b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold uniformPartition
  rw [hspan]
  change F.add a (F.sub b a) = b
  rw [F.add_comm a (F.sub b a)]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b a

name: uniformPartition_step_le

        (uniformPartition a step k)
        (uniformPartition a step (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  have h :=
    RealTheory.add_le_add_left hstep (uniformPartition a step k)
  rw [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
  rwa [uniformPartition_succ_eq_add]

name: uniformPartition_intervalPartition

      RealTheory.sub b a) :
    IntervalPartition a b n (uniformPartition a step)

  refine And.intro (uniformPartition_endpoint_of_span hspan) ?_

name: nat_mul_uniformStep
statement:
theorem nat_mul_uniformStep
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hn : Not (n = 0)) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) (uniformStep a b n) =
      RealTheory.sub b a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := RealTheory.sub b a
  let N := RealTheory.nat n
  have hn_pos : F.lt F.zero N := by
    unfold N
    exact RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hn
  have hn_ne : Not (N = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hn_pos) h.symm
  unfold uniformStep
  change F.mul N (F.mul L (F.inv N)) = L
  calc
    F.mul N (F.mul L (F.inv N)) =
        F.mul (F.mul N L) (F.inv N) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul L N) (F.inv N) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm N L]
    _ = F.mul L (F.mul N (F.inv N)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul L F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hn_ne]
    _ = L := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: uniformStep_nonnegative
statement:
theorem uniformStep_nonnegative
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hn : Not (n = 0)) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (uniformStep a b n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hL : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hab
  have hn_pos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat n) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hn
  have hinv_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hn_pos)
  unfold uniformStep
  exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hL hinv_nonneg

name: uniformStep_pos
statement:
theorem uniformStep_pos
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hn : Not (n = 0)) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (uniformStep a b n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hL : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hab
  have hn_pos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat n) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hn
  have hinv_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hn_pos
  unfold uniformStep
  exact RealTheory.mul_pos hL hinv_pos

name: uniformStep_lt_of_intervalLength_lt_nat_mul
statement:
theorem uniformStep_lt_of_intervalLength_lt_nat_mul
    {a b delta : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hn : Not (n = 0))
    (hlarge :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b a)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) delta)) :
    RealTheory.lt (uniformStep a b n) delta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := RealTheory.sub b a
  let N := RealTheory.nat n
  have hn_pos : F.lt F.zero N := by
    unfold N
    exact RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hn
  have hn_ne : Not (N = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hn_pos) h.symm
  have hmul :
      F.lt (F.mul (uniformStep a b n) N) (F.mul delta N) := by
    unfold uniformStep
    change F.lt (F.mul (F.mul L (F.inv N)) N) (F.mul delta N)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right F L hn_ne]
    rw [F.mul_comm delta N]
    exact hlarge
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hmul hn_pos

name: exists_nat_uniformStep_lt
statement:
theorem exists_nat_uniformStep_lt
    {a b delta : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        And (Not (n = 0))
          (RealTheory.lt (uniformStep a b n) delta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := RealTheory.sub b a
  have hL_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero L :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hab
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_mul_gt hL_nonneg hdelta with
  | intro n hlarge =>
      have hn : Not (n = 0) := by
        intro hn0
        have hbad : F.lt L F.zero := by
          rw [hn0] at hlarge
          change F.lt L (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F 0) delta)
            at hlarge
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero F] at hlarge
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F] at hlarge
          exact hlarge
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hbad) hL_nonneg
      exact Exists.intro n
        (And.intro hn
          (uniformStep_lt_of_intervalLength_lt_nat_mul hn hlarge))

name: exists_intervalPartition_mesh_lt
statement:
theorem exists_intervalPartition_mesh_lt
    {a b delta : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b n p)
              (RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta)))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_nat_uniformStep_lt hab hdelta with
  | intro n hn =>
      let step := uniformStep a b n
      refine Exists.intro n ?_
      refine Exists.intro (uniformPartition a step) ?_
      have hstep_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero step :=
        uniformStep_nonnegative hab hn.left
      have hspan :
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) step =
            RealTheory.sub b a := by
        dsimp [step]
        exact nat_mul_uniformStep hn.left
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact uniformPartition_intervalPartition hstep_nonneg hspan
      · exact mesh_uniformPartition_lt_of_step_lt hstep_nonneg hn.right

name: splitUniformPartition_left
statement:
theorem splitUniformPartition_left

proof:

name: splitUniformPartition_right
statement:
theorem splitUniformPartition_right
    {a x b : Point} {n k : Nat}

proof:
