name: splitUniformPartition_zero
statement:
theorem splitUniformPartition_zero (a x b : Point) (n : Nat) :
    splitUniformPartition a x b n 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [splitUniformPartition_left (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
    (n := n) (k := 0) (Nat.zero_le n)]
  exact uniformPartition_zero a (uniformStep a x n)

name: splitUniformPartition_middle
statement:
theorem splitUniformPartition_middle
    {a x b : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hn : Not (n = 0)) :
    splitUniformPartition a x b n n = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [splitUniformPartition_left (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
    (n := n) (k := n) (Nat.le_refl n)]
  exact uniformPartition_endpoint_of_span
    (a := a) (b := x) (step := uniformStep a x n) (n := n)
    (nat_mul_uniformStep hn)

name: splitUniformPartition_endpoint
statement:
theorem splitUniformPartition_endpoint
    {a x b : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hn : Not (n = 0)) :
    splitUniformPartition a x b n (n + n) = b
proof:
:= by
  have hnot : Not (n + n <= n) := by
    omega
  rw [splitUniformPartition_right (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
    (n := n) (k := n + n) hnot]
  have hsub : n + n - n = n := by
    omega
  rw [hsub]
  exact uniformPartition_endpoint_of_span
    (a := x) (b := b) (step := uniformStep x b n) (n := n)
    (nat_mul_uniformStep hn)

name: splitUniformPartition_step_le
statement:
theorem splitUniformPartition_step_le
    {a x b : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hn : Not (n = 0))
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x)
    (hxb : RealTheory.le x b) :
    forall k : Nat, k < n + n ->
      RealTheory.le
        (splitUniformPartition a x b n k)
        (splitUniformPartition a x b n (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro k _hk
  by_cases hk_left : k < n
  case pos =>
    rw [splitUniformPartition_left (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
        (n := n) (k := k) (Nat.le_of_lt hk_left)]
    rw [splitUniformPartition_left (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
        (n := n) (k := k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk_left)]
    exact uniformPartition_step_le
      (uniformStep_nonnegative hax hn) k
  case neg =>
    by_cases hk_eq : k = n
    case pos =>
      rw [hk_eq]
      rw [splitUniformPartition_middle (a := a) (x := x) (b := b) hn]
      have hnot : Not (n + 1 <= n) := by
        omega
      rw [splitUniformPartition_right (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
        (n := n) (k := n + 1) hnot]
      have hsub : n + 1 - n = 1 := by
        omega
      rw [hsub]
      have hstep :=
        uniformPartition_step_le (a := x) (step := uniformStep x b n)
          (uniformStep_nonnegative hxb hn) 0
      rw [uniformPartition_zero] at hstep
      exact hstep
    case neg =>
      have hnot_k : Not (k <= n) := by
        omega
      have hnot_succ : Not (k + 1 <= n) := by
        omega
      rw [splitUniformPartition_right (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
        (n := n) (k := k) hnot_k]
      rw [splitUniformPartition_right (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
        (n := n) (k := k + 1) hnot_succ]
      have hsub : k + 1 - n = (k - n) + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [hsub]
      exact uniformPartition_step_le
        (uniformStep_nonnegative hxb hn) (k - n)

name: splitUniformPartition_intervalPartition
statement:
theorem splitUniformPartition_intervalPartition
    {a x b : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hn : Not (n = 0))
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) :
    IntervalPartition a b (n + n) (splitUniformPartition a x b n)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (splitUniformPartition_zero a x b n) ?_
  refine And.intro (splitUniformPartition_endpoint (a := a) (x := x)
    (b := b) hn) ?_
  exact splitUniformPartition_step_le hn hx.left hx.right

name: cellLength_splitUniformPartition_lt
statement:
theorem cellLength_splitUniformPartition_lt
    {a x b delta : Point} {n k : Nat}
    (hn : Not (n = 0))
    (hleft : RealTheory.lt (uniformStep a x n) delta)
    (hright : RealTheory.lt (uniformStep x b n) delta)
    (_hk : k < n + n) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (cellLength (splitUniformPartition a x b n) k)
      delta
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk_left : k < n
  case pos =>
    have hcell :
        cellLength (splitUniformPartition a x b n) k =
          uniformStep a x n := by
      unfold cellLength
      rw [splitUniformPartition_left (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
        (n := n) (k := k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk_left)]
      rw [splitUniformPartition_left (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
        (n := n) (k := k) (Nat.le_of_lt hk_left)]
      exact cellLength_uniformPartition a (uniformStep a x n) k
    rw [hcell]
    exact hleft
  case neg =>
    by_cases hk_eq : k = n
    case pos =>
      rw [hk_eq]
      have hcell :
          cellLength (splitUniformPartition a x b n) n =
            uniformStep x b n := by
        unfold cellLength
        rw [splitUniformPartition_middle (a := a) (x := x) (b := b) hn]
        have hnot : Not (n + 1 <= n) := by
          omega
        rw [splitUniformPartition_right (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
          (n := n) (k := n + 1) hnot]
        have hsub : n + 1 - n = 1 := by
          omega
        rw [hsub]
        let step := uniformStep x b n
        change RealTheory.sub (uniformPartition x step 1) x = step
        calc
          RealTheory.sub (uniformPartition x step 1) x =
              RealTheory.sub
                (uniformPartition x step 1)
                (uniformPartition x step 0) := by
                rw [uniformPartition_zero x step]
          _ = step := by
              exact cellLength_uniformPartition x step 0
      rw [hcell]
      exact hright
    case neg =>
      have hnot_k : Not (k <= n) := by
        omega
      have hnot_succ : Not (k + 1 <= n) := by
        omega
      have hcell :
          cellLength (splitUniformPartition a x b n) k =
            uniformStep x b n := by
        unfold cellLength
        rw [splitUniformPartition_right (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
          (n := n) (k := k + 1) hnot_succ]
        rw [splitUniformPartition_right (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
          (n := n) (k := k) hnot_k]
        have hsub : k + 1 - n = (k - n) + 1 := by
          omega
        rw [hsub]
        exact cellLength_uniformPartition x (uniformStep x b n) (k - n)
      rw [hcell]
      exact hright

name: mesh_splitUniformPartition_lt
statement:
theorem mesh_splitUniformPartition_lt
    {a x b delta : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hn : Not (n = 0))
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
    (hleft : RealTheory.lt (uniformStep a x n) delta)
    (hright : RealTheory.lt (uniformStep x b n) delta) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (mesh (splitUniformPartition a x b n) (n + n))
      delta
proof:
:=
  mesh_lt_of_cellLength_lt (splitUniformPartition a x b n) (n + n)
    delta hdelta
    (fun k hk =>
      cellLength_splitUniformPartition_lt (k := k) hn hleft hright hk)

name: twoPointPartition_intervalPartition
statement:
theorem twoPointPartition_intervalPartition
    {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b) :
    IntervalPartition a b 1 (twoPointPartition a b)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro rfl ?_
  refine And.intro rfl ?_
  intro k hk
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      exact hab
  | succ k =>
      have hk0 : k < 0 := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk

name: mesh_twoPointPartition_lt_of_length_lt
statement:
theorem mesh_twoPointPartition_lt_of_length_lt
    {a b delta : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hlen : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b a) delta) :
    RealTheory.lt (mesh (twoPointPartition a b) 1) delta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hlen_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hab
  have hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hlen_nonneg hlen
  rw [mesh_succ, mesh_zero]
  unfold cellLength twoPointPartition RealTheory.max
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2_lt F hdelta_pos hlen

  | succ l ih =>
      by_cases hkle : k <= l
      · exact Nat.le_trans
          (ih hkle)
          (endpointMergeIndex_snd_mono_step left right leftCount rightCount l)

    EndpointMergeCrossBounds left right leftCount rightCount (0, 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold EndpointMergeCrossBounds
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro hleftCount
    rw [intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright]
    rw [<- intervalPartition_left_endpoint hleft]
    exact intervalPartition_step_le hleft hleftCount

name: endpointMergeStep_crossBounds
statement:
private theorem endpointMergeStep_crossBounds
    {a b : Point} {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    {state : Nat × Nat}
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a b leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition a b rightCount right)
    (hfst : state.fst <= leftCount)
    (hsnd : state.snd <= rightCount)
    (hcross :
      EndpointMergeCrossBounds left right leftCount rightCount state) :
    EndpointMergeCrossBounds left right leftCount rightCount
      (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount state)
proof:
:= by
  cases state with
  | mk i j =>
      unfold EndpointMergeCrossBounds at hcross
      by_cases hi : i < leftCount
      · by_cases hj : j < rightCount
        · by_cases hcmp : RealTheory.le (left (i + 1)) (right (j + 1))
          · simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj, hcmp]
            refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · intro hi_next
              have hright_left : RealTheory.le (right j) (left (i + 1)) :=
                hcross.left hi
              have hleft_step :
                  RealTheory.le (left (i + 1)) (left ((i + 1) + 1)) :=
                intervalPartition_step_le hleft hi_next
              exact RealTheory.le_trans hright_left hleft_step
            · intro _hj
              exact hcmp
          · simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj, hcmp]
            refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · intro _hi
              cases RealTheory.le_total (right (j + 1)) (left (i + 1)) with
              | inl hle =>
                  exact hle
              | inr hle =>
                  exact False.elim (hcmp hle)
            · intro hj_next
              have hleft_right : RealTheory.le (left i) (right (j + 1)) :=
                hcross.right hj
              have hright_step :
                  RealTheory.le (right (j + 1)) (right ((j + 1) + 1)) :=
                intervalPartition_step_le hright hj_next
              exact RealTheory.le_trans hleft_right hright_step
        · simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj]
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · intro hi_next
            have hj_eq : j = rightCount := by
              omega
            have hright_left : RealTheory.le (right j) (left (i + 1)) :=
              hcross.left hi
            have hleft_le_b :
                RealTheory.le (left (i + 1)) b :=
              (intervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval hleft
                (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)).right
            have hleft_eq_b : left (i + 1) = b := by
              apply RealTheory.le_antisymm
              · exact hleft_le_b
              · rw [<- intervalPartition_right_endpoint hright]
                rw [<- hj_eq]
                exact hright_left
            have hleft_step :
                RealTheory.le (left (i + 1)) (left ((i + 1) + 1)) :=
              intervalPartition_step_le hleft hi_next
            rw [hj_eq]
            rw [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hright]
            rw [<- hleft_eq_b]
            exact hleft_step
          · intro hj_bad
            exact False.elim (hj hj_bad)
      · by_cases hj : j < rightCount
        · simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj]
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · intro hi_bad
            exact False.elim (hi hi_bad)
          · intro hj_next
            have hi_eq : i = leftCount := by
              omega
            have hleft_right : RealTheory.le (left i) (right (j + 1)) :=
              hcross.right hj
            have hright_le_b :
                RealTheory.le (right (j + 1)) b :=
              (intervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval hright
                (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj)).right
            have hright_eq_b : right (j + 1) = b := by
              apply RealTheory.le_antisymm
              · exact hright_le_b
              · rw [<- intervalPartition_right_endpoint hleft]
                rw [<- hi_eq]
                exact hleft_right
            have hright_step :
                RealTheory.le (right (j + 1)) (right ((j + 1) + 1)) :=
              intervalPartition_step_le hright hj_next
            rw [hi_eq]
            rw [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hleft]
            rw [<- hright_eq_b]
            exact hright_step
        · simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj]
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · intro hi_bad
            exact False.elim (hi hi_bad)
          · intro hj_bad
            exact False.elim (hj hj_bad)

name: endpointMergeIndex_crossBounds
statement:
private theorem endpointMergeIndex_crossBounds
    {a b : Point} {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a b leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition a b rightCount right) :
    forall k : Nat,
      EndpointMergeCrossBounds left right leftCount rightCount
        (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k)
  | 0 => by
      exact endpointMergeCrossBounds_zero hleft hright
  | k + 1 => by
      rw [endpointMergeIndex_succ left right leftCount rightCount k]
      exact endpointMergeStep_crossBounds hleft hright
        (endpointMergeIndex_fst_bound left right leftCount rightCount k)
        (endpointMergeIndex_snd_bound left right leftCount rightCount k)
        (endpointMergeIndex_crossBounds hleft hright k)

private theorem endpointMergeStep_point_eq_left_of_fst_advance
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    {state : Nat × Nat}
    (hcross :
      EndpointMergeCrossBounds left right leftCount rightCount state)
    (hadvance :
      (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount state).fst =
        state.fst + 1) :
    RealTheory.max
        (left (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount state).fst)
        (right (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount state).snd) =
      left (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount state).fst
proof:
:= by
  cases state with
  | mk i j =>
      unfold EndpointMergeCrossBounds at hcross
      by_cases hi : i < leftCount
      · by_cases hj : j < rightCount
        · by_cases hcmp : RealTheory.le (left (i + 1)) (right (j + 1))
          · have hle : RealTheory.le (right j) (left (i + 1)) :=
              hcross.left hi
            simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj, hcmp]
            exact RealTheory.max_eq_left_of_right_le hle
          · have hbad := hadvance
            simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj, hcmp] at hbad
        · have hle : RealTheory.le (right j) (left (i + 1)) :=
            hcross.left hi
          simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj]
          exact RealTheory.max_eq_left_of_right_le hle
      · by_cases hj : j < rightCount
        · have hbad := hadvance
          simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj] at hbad
        · have hbad := hadvance
          simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj] at hbad

name: endpointMergeStep_sum_succ_of_incomplete
statement:
private theorem endpointMergeStep_sum_succ_of_incomplete
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    {state : Nat × Nat}
    (hincomplete :
      state.fst < leftCount ∨ state.snd < rightCount) :
    (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount state).fst +
      (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount state).snd =
        state.fst + state.snd + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases state with
  | mk i j =>
      by_cases hi : i < leftCount
      · by_cases hj : j < rightCount
        · by_cases hcmp : RealTheory.le (left (i + 1)) (right (j + 1))
          · simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj, hcmp]
            omega
          · simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj, hcmp]
            omega
        · simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj]
          omega
      · by_cases hj : j < rightCount
        · simp [endpointMergeStep, hi, hj]
          omega
        · exact False.elim
            (hincomplete.elim
              (fun h => hi h)
              (fun h => hj h))

name: endpointMergeIndex_sum_of_le_total
statement:
private theorem endpointMergeIndex_sum_of_le_total
    (left right : Nat -> Point) (leftCount rightCount : Nat) :
    forall k : Nat,
      k <= leftCount + rightCount ->
        (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).fst +
          (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).snd = k
  | 0, _ => by
      simp [endpointMergeIndex]
  | k + 1, hk => by
      have hk_prev : k <= leftCount + rightCount
proof:
:= by
        omega
      have ih :
          (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).fst +
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).snd =
              k :=
        endpointMergeIndex_sum_of_le_total left right leftCount rightCount
          k hk_prev
      have hincomplete :
          (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).fst <
              leftCount ∨
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).snd <
              rightCount := by
        by_cases h :
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).fst <
                leftCount ∨
              (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).snd <
                rightCount
        · exact h
        · have hnot_left :
              Not
                ((endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).fst <
                  leftCount) := by
            intro hleft_lt
            exact h (Or.inl hleft_lt)
          have hnot_right :
              Not
                ((endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).snd <
                  rightCount) := by
            intro hright_lt
            exact h (Or.inr hright_lt)
          have hleft_ge :
              leftCount <=
                (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).fst :=
            Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot_left
          have hright_ge :
              rightCount <=
                (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).snd :=
            Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot_right
          have hleft_le :
              (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).fst <=
                leftCount :=
            endpointMergeIndex_fst_bound left right leftCount rightCount k
          have hright_le :
              (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).snd <=
                rightCount :=
            endpointMergeIndex_snd_bound left right leftCount rightCount k
          omega
      rw [endpointMergeIndex_succ left right leftCount rightCount k]
      rw [endpointMergeStep_sum_succ_of_incomplete hincomplete]
      rw [ih]

name: endpointMergeIndex_final
statement:
private theorem endpointMergeIndex_final
    (left right : Nat -> Point) (leftCount rightCount : Nat) :
    endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount
      (leftCount + rightCount) = (leftCount, rightCount)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount
          (leftCount + rightCount)).fst +
        (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount
          (leftCount + rightCount)).snd =
          leftCount + rightCount :=
    endpointMergeIndex_sum_of_le_total left right leftCount rightCount
      (leftCount + rightCount) (Nat.le_refl _)
  have hleft :
      (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount
          (leftCount + rightCount)).fst <= leftCount :=
    endpointMergeIndex_fst_bound left right leftCount rightCount
      (leftCount + rightCount)
  have hright :
      (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount
          (leftCount + rightCount)).snd <= rightCount :=
    endpointMergeIndex_snd_bound left right leftCount rightCount
      (leftCount + rightCount)
  cases hstate :
      endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount
        (leftCount + rightCount) with
  | mk i j =>
      have hsum' : i + j = leftCount + rightCount := by
        simpa [hstate] using hsum
      have hleft' : i <= leftCount := by
        simpa [hstate] using hleft
      have hright' : j <= rightCount := by
        simpa [hstate] using hright
      have hi : i = leftCount := by
        omega
      have hj : j = rightCount := by
        omega
      rw [hi, hj]

name: endpointMergePoint_le_succ
statement:
private theorem endpointMergePoint_le_succ
    {a b : Point} {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount k : Nat}
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a b leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition a b rightCount right) :
    RealTheory.le
      (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount k)
      (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hleft_idx :
      (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).fst <=
        (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount (k + 1)).fst :=
    endpointMergeIndex_fst_mono_step left right leftCount rightCount k
  have hright_idx :
      (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).snd <=
        (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount (k + 1)).snd :=
    endpointMergeIndex_snd_mono_step left right leftCount rightCount k
  have hleft_bound :
      (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount (k + 1)).fst <=
        leftCount :=
    endpointMergeIndex_fst_bound left right leftCount rightCount (k + 1)
  have hright_bound :
      (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount (k + 1)).snd <=
        rightCount :=
    endpointMergeIndex_snd_bound left right leftCount rightCount (k + 1)
  have hleft_mono :
      RealTheory.le
        (left (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).fst)
        (left
          (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount (k + 1)).fst) :=
    intervalPartition_le_of_le hleft
      (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).fst
      (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount (k + 1)).fst
      hleft_idx hleft_bound
  have hright_mono :
      RealTheory.le
        (right (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).snd)
        (right
          (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount (k + 1)).snd) :=
    intervalPartition_le_of_le hright
      (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount k).snd
      (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount (k + 1)).snd
      hright_idx hright_bound
  unfold endpointMergePoint
  exact RealTheory.max_le_max_of_le_of_le hleft_mono hright_mono

name: endpointMergeLeftCut_endpoint
statement:
private theorem endpointMergeLeftCut_endpoint
    {a b : Point} {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount i : Nat}
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a b leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition a b rightCount right)
    (hi : i <= leftCount) :
    endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount
      (endpointMergeLeftCut left right leftCount rightCount i) =
        left i
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      rw [endpointMergeLeftCut_zero]
      rw [intervalPartition_left_endpoint hleft]
      exact endpointMergePoint_zero hleft hright
  | succ i =>
      let cut := endpointMergeLeftCut left right leftCount rightCount (i + 1)
      have hspec :
          i + 1 <=
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount cut).fst := by
        unfold cut
        exact endpointMergeLeftCut_spec hi
      have hcut_pos : 0 < cut := by
        by_cases hpos : 0 < cut
        · exact hpos
        · have hcut0 : cut = 0 :=
            Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_not_gt hpos)
          have hspec0 := hspec
          rw [hcut0] at hspec0
          simp [endpointMergeIndex] at hspec0
      let prev := cut - 1
      have hcut_eq : cut = prev + 1 := by
        unfold prev
        omega
      have hprev_not :
          Not
            (i + 1 <=
              (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev).fst) := by
        intro hprev
        have hmin :
            endpointMergeLeftCut left right leftCount rightCount (i + 1) <=
              prev :=
          endpointMergeLeftCut_min hi hprev
        change cut <= prev at hmin
        omega
      have hprev_lt :
          (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev).fst <
            i + 1 :=
        Nat.lt_of_not_ge hprev_not
      have hstep_le :
          (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).fst <=
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev).fst + 1 :=
        endpointMergeStep_fst_le_succ
      have hspec_step :
          i + 1 <=
            (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
              (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).fst := by
        rw [<- endpointMergeIndex_succ left right leftCount rightCount prev]
        rw [<- hcut_eq]
        exact hspec
      have hadvance :
          (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).fst =
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev).fst + 1 := by
        omega
      have hstep_fst_eq :
          (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).fst =
            i + 1 := by
        omega
      unfold endpointMergePoint
      change
        RealTheory.max
          (left
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount cut).fst)
          (right
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount cut).snd) =
          left (i + 1)
      rw [hcut_eq]
      rw [endpointMergeIndex_succ left right leftCount rightCount prev]
      have hemitted :
          RealTheory.max
              (left
                (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
                  (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).fst)
              (right
                (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
                  (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).snd) =
            left
              (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
                (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).fst :=
        endpointMergeStep_point_eq_left_of_fst_advance
          (endpointMergeIndex_crossBounds hleft hright prev)
          hadvance
      rw [hemitted]
      rw [hstep_fst_eq]

name: endpointMergeRightCut_endpoint
statement:
private theorem endpointMergeRightCut_endpoint
    {a b : Point} {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount j : Nat}
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a b leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition a b rightCount right)
    (hj : j <= rightCount) :
    endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount
      (endpointMergeRightCut left right leftCount rightCount j) =
        right j
proof:
:= by
  cases j with
  | zero =>
      rw [endpointMergeRightCut_zero]
      rw [intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright]
      exact endpointMergePoint_zero hleft hright
  | succ j =>
      let cut := endpointMergeRightCut left right leftCount rightCount (j + 1)
      have hspec :
          j + 1 <=
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount cut).snd := by
        unfold cut
        exact endpointMergeRightCut_spec hj
      have hcut_pos : 0 < cut := by
        by_cases hpos : 0 < cut
        · exact hpos
        · have hcut0 : cut = 0 :=
            Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_not_gt hpos)
          have hspec0 := hspec
          rw [hcut0] at hspec0
          simp [endpointMergeIndex] at hspec0
      let prev := cut - 1
      have hcut_eq : cut = prev + 1 := by
        unfold prev
        omega
      have hprev_not :
          Not
            (j + 1 <=
              (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev).snd) := by
        intro hprev
        have hmin :
            endpointMergeRightCut left right leftCount rightCount (j + 1) <=
              prev :=
          endpointMergeRightCut_min hj hprev
        change cut <= prev at hmin
        omega
      have hprev_lt :
          (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev).snd <
            j + 1 :=
        Nat.lt_of_not_ge hprev_not
      have hstep_le :
          (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).snd <=
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev).snd + 1 :=
        endpointMergeStep_snd_le_succ
      have hspec_step :
          j + 1 <=
            (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
              (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).snd := by
        rw [<- endpointMergeIndex_succ left right leftCount rightCount prev]
        rw [<- hcut_eq]
        exact hspec
      have hadvance :
          (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).snd =
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev).snd + 1 := by
        omega
      have hstep_snd_eq :
          (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).snd =
            j + 1 := by
        omega
      unfold endpointMergePoint
      change
        RealTheory.max
          (left
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount cut).fst)
          (right
            (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount cut).snd) =
          right (j + 1)
      rw [hcut_eq]
      rw [endpointMergeIndex_succ left right leftCount rightCount prev]
      have hemitted :
          RealTheory.max
              (left
                (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
                  (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).fst)
              (right
                (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
                  (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).snd) =
            right
              (endpointMergeStep left right leftCount rightCount
                (endpointMergeIndex left right leftCount rightCount prev)).snd :=
        endpointMergeStep_point_eq_right_of_snd_advance
          (endpointMergeIndex_crossBounds hleft hright prev)
          hadvance
      rw [hemitted]
      rw [hstep_snd_eq]

      let prev := cut - 1

        omega
      have hprev_not :

        rw [<- hleft_zero]
        exact intervalPartition_right_endpoint hleft.left
      exact hla.symm.trans hlb
    subst b

    refine Exists.intro (leftTags (degeneratePartition a)) ?_
    refine Exists.intro zeroCut ?_
    refine Exists.intro zeroCut ?_
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · exact leftTags_taggedPartition (degeneratePartition_intervalPartition a)
    · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact degeneratePartition_blockRefines hleft.left
      · exact degeneratePartition_blockRefines hright.left
  · by_cases hright_zero : rightCount = 0
    · have hab : a = b := by
        have hra : right 0 = a :=
          intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright.left
        have hrb : right 0 = b := by
          rw [<- hright_zero]
          exact intervalPartition_right_endpoint hright.left
        exact hra.symm.trans hrb
      subst b

      refine Exists.intro (degeneratePartition a) ?_
      refine Exists.intro (leftTags (degeneratePartition a)) ?_
      refine Exists.intro zeroCut ?_
      refine Exists.intro zeroCut ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_

    · have hleft_pos : 0 < leftCount := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hleft_zero

      refine Exists.intro (leftCount + rightCount) ?_

        (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount) ?_

        (leftTags (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)) ?_
      refine Exists.intro

        (endpointMergeRightBlockCut left right leftCount rightCount) ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact endpointMergePoint_leftTaggedPartition hleft.left hright.left

name: endpointMergeSplitPoint_prefix_taggedPartition
statement:
theorem endpointMergeSplitPoint_prefix_taggedPartition
    {a b c : Point} {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c) :
    TaggedPartition a c
      (endpointMergeRightBlockCut p (splitPointPartition a c b) n 2 1)
      (endpointMergePoint p (splitPointPartition a c b) n 2)
      (refinementPreserveUnsplitTags
        (endpointMergePoint p (splitPointPartition a c b) n 2)
        tag n
        (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut p (splitPointPartition a c b) n 2))
proof:
:= by
  let merge := endpointMergePoint p (splitPointPartition a c b) n 2
  let mergeTag :=
    refinementPreserveUnsplitTags merge tag n
      (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut p (splitPointPartition a c b) n 2)
  let cut :=
    endpointMergeRightBlockCut p (splitPointPartition a c b) n 2 1
  have hright : IntervalPartition a b 2 (splitPointPartition a c b) :=
    splitPointPartition_intervalPartition hc
  have hmergeI : IntervalPartition a b (n + 2) merge :=
    endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition htag.left hright
  have hmergeTag : TaggedPartition a b (n + 2) merge mergeTag := by
    by_cases hpos : 0 < n
    · have href :
          PartitionBlockRefines merge (n + 2) p n
            (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut p (splitPointPartition a c b) n 2) :=
        endpointMergeLeft_partitionBlockRefines htag.left hright hpos
      exact refinementPreserveUnsplitTags_taggedPartition
        href hmergeI htag
    · have hn : n = 0 :=
        Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_not_gt hpos)
      subst n
      refine And.intro hmergeI ?_
      intro j hj
      dsimp [mergeTag, refinementPreserveUnsplitTags]
      exact (leftTags_taggedPartition hmergeI).right j hj
  have hcut_le : cut <= n + 2 := by
    have hright_ref :
        PartitionBlockRefines merge (n + 2)
          (splitPointPartition a c b) 2
          (endpointMergeRightBlockCut p (splitPointPartition a c b) n 2) :=
      endpointMergeRight_partitionBlockRefines
        htag.left hright (by omega : 0 < 2)
    exact partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right hright_ref
      (show 1 <= 2 by omega)
  have hprefix :=
    taggedPartition_prefix hmergeTag hcut_le
  have hendpoint :
      merge cut = c := by
    exact endpointMergeRightBlockCut_splitPoint_one_endpoint
      htag.left hc
  dsimp [mergeTag, merge, cut] at hprefix hendpoint
  rwa [hendpoint] at hprefix

  rwa [hendpoint] at hsuffix

name: exists_threshold_refinement_mesh_lt
statement:
theorem exists_threshold_refinement_mesh_lt
    {a b delta : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
    {baseCount : Nat} {base : Nat -> Point}
    (hbase : IntervalPartition a b baseCount base) :
    Exists
      (fun thresholdCount : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun threshold : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount threshold)
              (And
                (PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount base baseCount)
                (forall (n : Nat) (p tag : Nat -> Point),
                  TaggedPartition a b n p tag ->
                  PartitionRefines p n threshold thresholdCount ->
                    RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases exists_intervalPartition_mesh_lt hab hdelta with
  | intro smallCount hsmallCount =>
      cases hsmallCount with
      | intro small hsmall =>
          let baseTag := leftTags base
          let smallTag := leftTags small
          have hbaseTag : TaggedPartition a b baseCount base baseTag :=
            leftTags_taggedPartition hbase
          have hsmallTag :
              TaggedPartition a b smallCount small smallTag :=
            leftTags_taggedPartition hsmall.left
          cases exists_commonTaggedBlockRefinement hbaseTag hsmallTag with
          | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
              cases hthresholdCount with
              | intro threshold hthreshold =>
                  cases hthreshold with
                  | intro thresholdTag hthresholdTag =>
                      cases hthresholdTag with
                      | intro baseCut hbaseCut =>
                          cases hbaseCut with
                          | intro smallCut hcommon =>
                              have hthresholdTagged :
                                  TaggedPartition a b thresholdCount
                                    threshold thresholdTag :=
                                commonTaggedBlockRefinement_taggedPartition
                                  hcommon
                              have hthresholdI :
                                  IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount
                                    threshold :=
                                hthresholdTagged.left
                              have hrefBase :
                                  PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount
                                    base baseCount :=
                                partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines
                                  (commonTaggedBlockRefinement_left_refines
                                    hcommon)
                                  hthresholdI
                              have hrefSmall :
                                  PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount
                                    small smallCount :=
                                partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines
                                  (commonTaggedBlockRefinement_right_refines
                                    hcommon)
                                  hthresholdI
                              have hthreshold_mesh :
                                  RealTheory.le
                                    (mesh threshold thresholdCount)
                                    (mesh small smallCount) :=
                                mesh_le_of_refines hsmall.left hrefSmall
                              refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
                              refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
                              refine And.intro hthresholdI ?_
                              refine And.intro hrefBase ?_
                              intro n p tag htag href
                              have hp_mesh_threshold :
                                  RealTheory.le (mesh p n)
                                    (mesh threshold thresholdCount) :=
                                mesh_le_of_refines hthresholdI href
                              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                                (RealTheory.le_trans
                                  hp_mesh_threshold hthreshold_mesh)
                                hsmall.right

name: weightedLowerSum_adjacent
statement:
theorem weightedLowerSum_adjacent
    (f : Point -> Point)
    {a c b : Point}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    {leftWeight rightWeight : Nat -> Point}
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a c leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition c b rightCount right)
    (hinfLeft :
      forall k : Nat, k < leftCount ->
        Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f left k m))
    (hinfRight :
      forall k : Nat, k < rightCount ->
        Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f right k m)) :
    weightedLowerSum f
        (fun k : Nat =>
          if _h : k < leftCount then
            leftWeight k
          else
            rightWeight (k - leftCount))
        (adjacentPartition left right leftCount)
        (leftCount + rightCount) =
      RealTheory.add
        (weightedLowerSum f leftWeight left leftCount)
        (weightedLowerSum f rightWeight right rightCount)
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedLowerSum
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length]
  have hleft_terms :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (cellLower f (adjacentPartition left right leftCount) k)
              (if h : k < leftCount then
                leftWeight k
              else
                rightWeight (k - leftCount)))
          leftCount =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (cellLower f left k) (leftWeight k))
          leftCount := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
    intro k hk
    rw [dif_pos hk]
    rw [cellLower_eq_of_partitionCell_iff
      (fun x : Point =>
        partitionCell_adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
          hleft (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright) hk)
      (hinfLeft k hk)]
  have hright_terms :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (cellLower f (adjacentPartition left right leftCount)
                (leftCount + j))
              (if h : leftCount + j < leftCount then
                leftWeight (leftCount + j)
              else
                rightWeight (leftCount + j - leftCount)))
          rightCount =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (cellLower f right j) (rightWeight j))
          rightCount := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
    intro j hj
    have hnot : Not (leftCount + j < leftCount) := by
      omega
    rw [dif_neg hnot]
    have hidx : leftCount + j - leftCount = j := by
      omega
    rw [hidx]
    rw [cellLower_eq_of_partitionCell_iff
      (fun x : Point =>
        partitionCell_adjacentPartition_right
          left right leftCount j x)
      (hinfRight j hj)]
  rw [hleft_terms, hright_terms]

name: cellUpper_le_cellLower_add_of_pairwise_sub_lt
statement:
theorem cellUpper_le_cellLower_add_of_pairwise_sub_lt
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    {eta : Point}
    (hinf : Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m))
    (hsup : Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M))
    (hpair :
      forall x y : Point,
        PartitionCell p k x -> PartitionCell p k y ->
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) eta) :
    RealTheory.le (cellUpper f p k)
      (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) eta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let hInf := cellLower_hasCellInf hinf
  let hSup := cellUpper_hasCellSup hsup
  have hupper :
      IsUpperBound F.le (CellValueSet f p k)
        (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) eta) := by
    intro v hv
    cases hv with
    | intro x hx =>
        rw [hx.right]
        have hlowerBound :
            IsLowerBound F.le (CellValueSet f p k)
              (RealTheory.sub (f x) eta) := by
          intro w hw
          cases hw with
          | intro y hy =>
              rw [hy.right]
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right F
                  (hpair x y hx.left hy.left))
        have hshift_left :
            RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f x) eta)
              (cellLower f p k) :=
          hInf.right (RealTheory.sub (f x) eta) hlowerBound
        have hshift :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub (f x) eta) eta)
              (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) eta) :=
          RealTheory.add_le_add_right hshift_left eta
        change
          F.le (F.add (F.sub (f x) eta) eta)
            (F.add (cellLower f p k) eta) at hshift
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F (f x) eta] at hshift
        exact hshift
  exact hSup.right (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) eta) hupper

name: cellUpper_le_cellLower_add_of_pairwise_sub_le
statement:
theorem cellUpper_le_cellLower_add_of_pairwise_sub_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    {error : Point}
    (hinf : Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m))
    (hsup : Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M))
    (hpair :
      forall x y : Point,
        PartitionCell p k x -> PartitionCell p k y ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) error) :
    RealTheory.le (cellUpper f p k)
      (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) error)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let hInf := cellLower_hasCellInf hinf
  let hSup := cellUpper_hasCellSup hsup
  have hupper :
      IsUpperBound F.le (CellValueSet f p k)
        (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) error) := by
    intro v hv
    cases hv with
    | intro x hx =>
        rw [hx.right]
        have hlowerBound :
            IsLowerBound F.le (CellValueSet f p k)
              (RealTheory.sub (f x) error) := by
          intro w hw
          cases hw with
          | intro y hy =>
              rw [hy.right]
              have hsub_le :
                  RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) error :=
                hpair x y hx.left hy.left
              have hfx_le :
                  RealTheory.le (f x)
                    (RealTheory.add error (f y)) := by
                have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_right hsub_le (f y)
                change
                  F.le
                    (F.add (F.sub (f x) (f y)) (f y))
                    (F.add error (f y)) at h
                rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
                  F (f x) (f y)] at h
              have hshift :
                  RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f x) error) (f y) := by
                have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_right
                  hfx_le (RealTheory.neg error)
                change
                  F.le
                    (F.add (f x) (F.neg error))
                    (F.add (F.add error (f y)) (F.neg error)) at h
                have hrhs :
                    F.add (F.add error (f y)) (F.neg error) =
                      f y := by
                  calc
                    F.add (F.add error (f y)) (F.neg error) =
                        F.add (F.add (f y) error) (F.neg error) := by
                          rw [F.add_comm error (f y)]
                    _ = f y :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_neg_cancel_right
                          F (f y) error
                rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg, hrhs] at h
              exact hshift
        have hshift_left :
            RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f x) error)
              (cellLower f p k) :=
          hInf.right (RealTheory.sub (f x) error) hlowerBound
        have hshift :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub (f x) error) error)
              (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) error) :=
          RealTheory.add_le_add_right hshift_left error
        change
          F.le (F.add (F.sub (f x) error) error)
            (F.add (cellLower f p k) error) at hshift
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F (f x) error] at hshift
        exact hshift
  exact hSup.right (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) error) hupper

name: cellGap_le_of_cell_values_between
statement:
theorem cellGap_le_of_cell_values_between
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    {lower upper : Point}
    (hinf : Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m))
    (hsup : Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M))
    (hbounds :
      forall x : Point, PartitionCell p k x ->
        And (RealTheory.le lower (f x)) (RealTheory.le (f x) upper)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
      (RealTheory.sub upper lower)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let error := RealTheory.sub upper lower
  have hcell :
      RealTheory.le (cellUpper f p k)
        (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) error) := by
    dsimp [error]
    exact
      cellUpper_le_cellLower_add_of_pairwise_sub_le hinf hsup
        (fun x y hx hy =>
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
            F (hbounds x hx).right (hbounds y hy).left)
  have hsub :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) error)
          (cellLower f p k)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F hcell
      (RealTheory.le_refl (cellLower f p k))
  have hrhs :
      RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) error)
          (cellLower f p k) =
        error := by
    rw [RealTheory.add_comm (cellLower f p k) error]
    exact RealTheory.add_sub_cancel error (cellLower f p k)
  rwa [hrhs] at hsub

name: exists_cellPoint_cellSup_lt_add
statement:
theorem exists_cellPoint_cellSup_lt_add
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    {M eps : Point}
    (hM : HasCellSup f p k M)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun x : Point =>
        And (PartitionCell p k x)
          (RealTheory.lt M (RealTheory.add (f x) eps)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbelow : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub M eps) M :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub F hM hbelow with
  | intro v hv =>
      cases hv.left with
      | intro x hx =>
          have hsub : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub M eps) (f x) := by
            have hvlt := hv.right
            rwa [hx.right] at hvlt
          have hlt : F.lt M (F.add eps (f x)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt F hsub
          refine Exists.intro x ?_
          refine And.intro hx.left ?_
          rwa [F.add_comm eps (f x)] at hlt

name: exists_cellPoint_lt_cellInf_add
statement:
theorem exists_cellPoint_lt_cellInf_add
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}

    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :

        And (PartitionCell p k x)
          (RealTheory.lt (f x) (RealTheory.add m eps)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have habove : RealTheory.lt m (RealTheory.add m eps) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps m
    change F.lt (F.add m F.zero) (F.add m eps) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_gt_of_glb_lt F hm habove with
  | intro v hv =>
      cases hv.left with
      | intro x hx =>
          refine Exists.intro x ?_
          refine And.intro hx.left ?_
          have hvlt := hv.right
          rwa [hx.right] at hvlt

name: weightedUpperSum_le_nearCellSupWeightedTagSum_add_error
statement:
theorem weightedUpperSum_le_nearCellSupWeightedTagSum_add_error
    {f : Point -> Point} {weight : Nat -> Point} {eta : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hweight :
      forall k : Nat, k < n -> RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (weight k))
    (hsup :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M))
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    RealTheory.le (weightedUpperSum f weight p n)
      (RealTheory.add
        (weightedTagSum f weight
          (nearCellSupTag f p n eta hsup heta) n)
        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n)))
proof:
:= by
  let tag := nearCellSupTag f p n eta hsup heta
  change RealTheory.le (weightedUpperSum f weight p n)
    (RealTheory.add (weightedTagSum f weight tag n)
      (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n)))
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le (weightedUpperSum f weight p n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add (f (tag k)) eta)
              (weight k))
          n) := by
    unfold weightedUpperSum
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (cellUpper f p k) (weight k))
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add (f (tag k)) eta)
          (weight k))
      n
      (fun k hk => by
        have hnear :
            RealTheory.lt (cellUpper f p k)
              (RealTheory.add (f (tag k)) eta) := by
          dsimp [tag]
          exact nearCellSupTag_property hsup heta hk
        have hnear_le :
            RealTheory.le (cellUpper f p k)
              (RealTheory.add (f (tag k)) eta) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hnear
        exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hnear_le
          (hweight k hk))
  have hdist :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add (f (tag k)) eta)
              (weight k))
          n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (weight k))
              (RealTheory.mul eta (weight k)))
          n := by
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt (n := n)
      (fun k _hk => RealTheory.add_mul (f (tag k)) eta (weight k))
  have hsplit :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (weight k))
              (RealTheory.mul eta (weight k)))
          n =
        RealTheory.add (weightedTagSum f weight tag n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (weight k)) n) := by
    unfold weightedTagSum
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_add
      (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (weight k))
      (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (weight k))
      n
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (weight k)) n =
        RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left eta weight n
  rw [hdist, hsplit, hmul] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: weightedUpperSum_le_weightedLowerSum_add_error_of_cellUpper_le

name: weightedDarbouxGap_le_error_of_cellUpper_le
statement:
theorem weightedDarbouxGap_le_error_of_cellUpper_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {weight : Nat -> Point} {eta : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hweight :
      forall k : Nat, k < n -> RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (weight k))
    (hcell :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        RealTheory.le (cellUpper f p k)
          (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) eta)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub
        (weightedUpperSum f weight p n)
        (weightedLowerSum f weight p n))
      (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let U := weightedUpperSum f weight p n
  let L := weightedLowerSum f weight p n
  let E := RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n)
  have hle :
      RealTheory.le U (RealTheory.add L E) := by
    dsimp [U, L, E]
    exact weightedUpperSum_le_weightedLowerSum_add_error_of_cellUpper_le
      hweight hcell
  have hsub :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub U L)
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add L E) L) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F hle
      (RealTheory.le_refl L)
  have hrhs :
      RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add L E) L = E := by
    rw [RealTheory.add_comm L E]
    exact RealTheory.add_sub_cancel E L
  rw [hrhs] at hsub
  exact hsub

name: cellLower_le_cellLower_abs
statement:
theorem cellLower_le_cellLower_abs
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    (hinf : Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m))
    (hinf_abs :
      Exists
        (fun m : Point =>
          HasCellInf (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k m)) :
    RealTheory.le (cellLower f p k)
      (cellLower (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := cellLower f p k
  let absf := fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)
  have hInf := cellLower_hasCellInf hinf
  have hAbsInf := cellLower_hasCellInf hinf_abs
  have hLower :
      IsLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
        (CellValueSet absf p k) L := by
    intro v hv
    cases hv with
    | intro x hxv =>
        cases hxv with
        | intro hx hv_eq =>
            rw [hv_eq]
            have hLfx : RealTheory.le L (f x) := by
              dsimp [L]
              exact le_of_hasCellInf hInf hx
            cases F.le_total RealTheory.zero L with
            | inl _h0L =>
                exact RealTheory.le_trans hLfx
                  (RealTheory.le_abs_self (f x))
            | inr hL0 =>
                exact RealTheory.le_trans hL0
                  (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f x))
  dsimp [L, absf] at hLower
  exact hAbsInf.right (cellLower f p k) hLower

name: neg_cellUpper_le_cellLower_abs
statement:
theorem neg_cellUpper_le_cellLower_abs
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    (hsup : Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M))
    (hinf_abs :
      Exists
        (fun m : Point =>
          HasCellInf (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k m)) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg (cellUpper f p k))
      (cellLower (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let U := cellUpper f p k
  let absf := fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)
  have hSup := cellUpper_hasCellSup hsup
  have hAbsInf := cellLower_hasCellInf hinf_abs
  have hLower :
      IsLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
        (CellValueSet absf p k) (RealTheory.neg U) := by
    intro v hv
    cases hv with
    | intro x hxv =>
        cases hxv with
        | intro hx hv_eq =>
            rw [hv_eq]
            have hfxU : RealTheory.le (f x) U := by
              dsimp [U]
              exact le_of_hasCellSup hSup hx
            cases F.le_total RealTheory.zero U with
            | inl h0U =>
                have hnegU_nonpos :
                    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg U) RealTheory.zero :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonpos_of_nonneg F h0U
                exact RealTheory.le_trans hnegU_nonpos
                  (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f x))
            | inr _hU0 =>
                have hneg : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg U)
                    (RealTheory.neg (f x)) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hfxU
                exact RealTheory.le_trans hneg
                  (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self (f x))
  dsimp [U, absf] at hLower
  exact hAbsInf.right (RealTheory.neg (cellUpper f p k)) hLower

name: cellUpper_abs_le_cellLower_abs_add_cellGap
statement:
theorem cellUpper_abs_le_cellLower_abs_add_cellGap
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    (hinf : Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m))
    (hsup : Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M))
    (hinf_abs :
      Exists
        (fun m : Point =>
          HasCellInf (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k m))
    (hsup_abs :
      Exists
        (fun M : Point =>
          HasCellSup (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k M)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (cellUpper (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k)
      (RealTheory.add
        (cellLower (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k)
        (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := cellLower f p k
  let U := cellUpper f p k
  let A := cellLower (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k
  let gap := RealTheory.sub U L
  let rhs := RealTheory.add A gap
  have hInf := cellLower_hasCellInf hinf
  have hSup := cellUpper_hasCellSup hsup
  have hAbsSup := cellUpper_hasCellSup hsup_abs
  have hL_le_A : RealTheory.le L A := by
    dsimp [L, A]
    exact cellLower_le_cellLower_abs hinf hinf_abs
  have hnegU_le_A : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg U) A := by
    dsimp [U, A]
    exact neg_cellUpper_le_cellLower_abs hsup hinf_abs
  have hU_le_rhs : RealTheory.le U rhs := by
    have hU_eq :
        U = RealTheory.add gap L := by
      dsimp [gap]
      exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F U L)
    have hstep :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.add gap L)
          (RealTheory.add gap A) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
          F hL_le_A gap
    have hstep' :
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.add gap L) rhs := by
      dsimp [rhs]
      change RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add gap L) (RealTheory.add A gap)
      rw [RealTheory.add_comm A gap]
      exact hstep
    rw [hU_eq]
    exact hstep'
  have hnegL_le_rhs : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg L) rhs := by
    have hgap_negU :
        RealTheory.add gap (RealTheory.neg U) = RealTheory.neg L := by
      dsimp [gap]
      rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
      rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
      rw [RealTheory.add_comm (RealTheory.neg L) (RealTheory.neg U)]
      rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc]
      rw [RealTheory.add_neg]
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
    have hstep :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.add gap (RealTheory.neg U))
          (RealTheory.add gap A) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hnegU_le_A gap
    have hstep' :
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.add gap (RealTheory.neg U)) rhs := by
      dsimp [rhs]
      change RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add gap (RealTheory.neg U)) (RealTheory.add A gap)
      rw [RealTheory.add_comm A gap]
      exact hstep
    rw [<- hgap_negU]
    exact hstep'
  have hUpper :
      IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
        (CellValueSet (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k)
        rhs := by
    intro v hv
    cases hv with
    | intro x hxv =>
        cases hxv with
        | intro hx hv_eq =>
            rw [hv_eq]
            have hfxU : RealTheory.le (f x) U :=
              le_of_hasCellSup hSup hx
            have hLfx : RealTheory.le L (f x) :=
              le_of_hasCellInf hInf hx
            have hfx_rhs : RealTheory.le (f x) rhs :=
              RealTheory.le_trans hfxU hU_le_rhs
            have hnegfx_negL :
                RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg (f x)) (RealTheory.neg L) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hLfx
            have hnegfx_rhs :
                RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg (f x)) rhs :=
              RealTheory.le_trans hnegfx_negL hnegL_le_rhs
            exact RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hfx_rhs hnegfx_rhs
  dsimp [rhs, A, gap] at hUpper
  exact hAbsSup.right
    (RealTheory.add
      (cellLower (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k)
      (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)))
    hUpper

name: weightedDarbouxGap_abs_le_weightedDarbouxGap
statement:
theorem weightedDarbouxGap_abs_le_weightedDarbouxGap
    {f : Point -> Point} {weight : Nat -> Point}
    {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hweight :
      forall k : Nat, k < n -> RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (weight k))
    (hinf :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m))
    (hsup :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M))
    (hinf_abs :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists
          (fun m : Point =>
            HasCellInf (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k m))
    (hsup_abs :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists
          (fun M : Point =>
            HasCellSup (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) p k M)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub
        (weightedUpperSum (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x))
          weight p n)
        (weightedLowerSum (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x))
          weight p n))
      (RealTheory.sub
        (weightedUpperSum f weight p n)
        (weightedLowerSum f weight p n))
proof:
:= by
  let absf := fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)
  have hgap_abs :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub
          (weightedUpperSum absf weight p n)
          (weightedLowerSum absf weight p n))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))

    exact weightedDarbouxGap_le_errorSum_of_cellUpper_le
      (f := absf) (weight := weight)
      (error := fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))

      (fun k hk =>
        cellUpper_abs_le_cellLower_abs_add_cellGap
          (hinf k hk) (hsup k hk) (hinf_abs k hk) (hsup_abs k hk))
  have hgap_eq :=
    weightedDarbouxGap_eq_finiteSum_cellGap_mul_weight
      f weight p n
  dsimp [absf] at hgap_abs
  rwa [<- hgap_eq] at hgap_abs

name: weightedUpperSum_isLeastUpperBound_fixedWeightedTaggedSumValueSet_of_totalWeight_pos
statement:
theorem weightedUpperSum_isLeastUpperBound_fixedWeightedTaggedSumValueSet_of_totalWeight_pos
    {f : Point -> Point} {weight : Nat -> Point}
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hweight :
      forall k : Nat, k < n -> RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (weight k))
    (htotal_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n))
    (hsup :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M)) :
    IsLeastUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
      (FixedWeightedTaggedSumValueSet f weight a b p n)
      (weightedUpperSum f weight p n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro
    (weightedUpperSum_isUpperBound_fixedWeightedTaggedSumValueSet
      hweight hsup) ?_
  intro u hu
  by_cases hle : RealTheory.le (weightedUpperSum f weight p n) u
  · exact hle
  · have hu_le_upper : RealTheory.le u (weightedUpperSum f weight p n) := by
      cases RealTheory.le_total u (weightedUpperSum f weight p n) with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr hupper => exact False.elim (hle hupper)
    have hlt : RealTheory.lt u (weightedUpperSum f weight p n) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hu_le_upper hle
    let gap := RealTheory.sub (weightedUpperSum f weight p n) u
    have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap := by
      dsimp [gap]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hlt
    cases RealTheory.exists_pos_eta_mul_lt htotal_pos hgap_pos with
    | intro eta heta =>
        cases exists_fixedWeightedTaggedSumValueSet_upperSum_le_add_error
            hp hweight hsup heta.left with
        | intro v hv =>
            have hupper_le_error :
                RealTheory.le (weightedUpperSum f weight p n)
                  (RealTheory.add v
                    (RealTheory.mul eta
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n))) :=
              hv.right
            have hvu : RealTheory.le v u := hu v hv.left
            have herror_le_u_error :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.add v
                    (RealTheory.mul eta
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n)))
                  (RealTheory.add u
                    (RealTheory.mul eta
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n))) :=
              RealTheory.add_le_add_right hvu
                (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n))
            have hupper_le_u_error :
                RealTheory.le (weightedUpperSum f weight p n)
                  (RealTheory.add u
                    (RealTheory.mul eta
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n))) :=
              RealTheory.le_trans hupper_le_error herror_le_u_error
            have hu_error_lt_upper :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.add u
                    (RealTheory.mul eta
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n)))
                  (weightedUpperSum f weight p n) := by
              have h :=
                RealTheory.add_lt_add_left heta.right u
              have hgap_add :
                  RealTheory.add u gap = weightedUpperSum f weight p n := by
                dsimp [gap]
                rw [RealTheory.add_comm u
                  (RealTheory.sub (weightedUpperSum f weight p n) u)]
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
                  F (weightedUpperSum f weight p n) u
              rwa [hgap_add] at h
            exact False.elim
              ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F
                hu_error_lt_upper) hupper_le_u_error)

name: weightedLowerSum_isGreatestLowerBound_fixedWeightedTaggedSumValueSet_of_totalWeight_pos
statement:
theorem weightedLowerSum_isGreatestLowerBound_fixedWeightedTaggedSumValueSet_of_totalWeight_pos
    {f : Point -> Point} {weight : Nat -> Point}
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hweight :
      forall k : Nat, k < n -> RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (weight k))
    (htotal_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n))
    (hinf :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m)) :
    IsGreatestLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
      (FixedWeightedTaggedSumValueSet f weight a b p n)
      (weightedLowerSum f weight p n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro
    (weightedLowerSum_isLowerBound_fixedWeightedTaggedSumValueSet
      hweight hinf) ?_
  intro l hl
  by_cases hle : RealTheory.le l (weightedLowerSum f weight p n)
  · exact hle
  · have hlower_le_l :
        RealTheory.le (weightedLowerSum f weight p n) l := by
      cases RealTheory.le_total (weightedLowerSum f weight p n) l with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr hlower => exact False.elim (hle hlower)
    have hlt : RealTheory.lt (weightedLowerSum f weight p n) l :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hlower_le_l hle
    let gap := RealTheory.sub l (weightedLowerSum f weight p n)
    have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap := by
      dsimp [gap]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hlt
    cases RealTheory.exists_pos_eta_mul_lt htotal_pos hgap_pos with
    | intro eta heta =>
        cases exists_fixedWeightedTaggedSumValueSet_le_lowerSum_add_error
            hp hweight hinf heta.left with
        | intro v hv =>
            have hv_le_error :
                RealTheory.le v
                  (RealTheory.add (weightedLowerSum f weight p n)
                    (RealTheory.mul eta
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n))) :=
              hv.right
            have hlv : RealTheory.le l v := hl v hv.left
            have hl_le_error :
                RealTheory.le l
                  (RealTheory.add (weightedLowerSum f weight p n)
                    (RealTheory.mul eta
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n))) :=
              RealTheory.le_trans hlv hv_le_error
            have herror_lt_l :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.add (weightedLowerSum f weight p n)
                    (RealTheory.mul eta
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n)))
                  l := by
              have h :=
                RealTheory.add_lt_add_left heta.right
                  (weightedLowerSum f weight p n)
              have hgap_add :
                  RealTheory.add (weightedLowerSum f weight p n) gap = l := by
                dsimp [gap]
                rw [RealTheory.add_comm (weightedLowerSum f weight p n)
                  (RealTheory.sub l (weightedLowerSum f weight p n))]
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
                  F l (weightedLowerSum f weight p n)
              rwa [hgap_add] at h
            exact False.elim
              ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F herror_lt_l)
                hl_le_error)

name: planeCurveLengthOn_degenerate

    (a : Point) (x y : Map) :
    planeCurveLengthOn a a x y = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hzeroValue :
      PlaneCurveLengthValueOn a a x y F.zero :=
    planeCurveLengthValueOn_zero rfl
  have hzeroSpec : HasPlaneCurveLengthOn a a x y F.zero := by
    unfold HasPlaneCurveLengthOn
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · intro value hvalue
      cases hvalue with
      | inl hzero =>
          rw [hzero.right]
          change F.le F.zero F.zero
          exact F.le_refl F.zero
      | inr hpart =>
          cases hpart with
          | intro n hn =>
              cases hn with
              | intro p hp =>
                  exact False.elim
                    ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F a) hp.left)
    · intro upper hupper
      exact hupper F.zero hzeroValue
  have hexists :
      Exists (fun total : Point => HasPlaneCurveLengthOn a a x y total) :=
    Exists.intro F.zero hzeroSpec
  have hchosen := planeCurveLengthOn_spec_of_exists hexists
  exact F.le_antisymm
    (hchosen.right F.zero hzeroSpec.left)
    (hzeroSpec.right (planeCurveLengthOn a a x y) hchosen.left)

    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :

        (RealTheory.sub (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y) eta)
        (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heta
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub F hspec hbelow with
  | intro value hvalue =>
      cases hvalue.left with
      | inl hzero =>
          have hbad : RealTheory.lt b b := by
            rwa [hzero.left] at hab
          exact False.elim
            ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F b) hbad)
      | inr hpart =>
          cases hpart with
          | intro n hn =>
              cases hn with
              | intro p hp =>
                  refine Exists.intro n ?_
                  refine Exists.intro p ?_
                  refine And.intro hp.right.left ?_
                  have hlt := hvalue.right
                  rwa [hp.right.right] at hlt

name: rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_iff_boundedVariationOn_coordinates

theorem rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_iff_boundedVariationOn_coordinates
    {a b : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hcurve : PlaneCurveOn a b x y) :
    RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y <->
      And
        (BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b x)
        (BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  constructor
  · intro hrect
    cases hrect.right with
    | intro bound hbound =>
        have hboundNonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero bound :=
          planeCurveLengthBoundOn_nonneg hcurve.left hbound
        refine And.intro ?_ ?_
        · apply BoundedVariation.boundedVariationOn_of_bound
            hcurve.left hboundNonneg
          intro n p hp
          exact RealTheory.le_trans
            (partitionVariation_left_le_planePolygonalLength x y p n)
            (hbound n p
              (IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_intervalPartition hp))
        · apply BoundedVariation.boundedVariationOn_of_bound
            hcurve.left hboundNonneg
          intro n p hp
          exact RealTheory.le_trans
            (partitionVariation_right_le_planePolygonalLength x y p n)
            (hbound n p
              (IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_intervalPartition hp))
  · intro hvariation
    refine And.intro hcurve ?_
    let Vx := BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a x b
    let Vy := BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a y b
    refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.add Vx Vy) ?_
    intro n p hp
    have hx :
        RealTheory.le
          (BoundedVariation.partitionVariation x p n) Vx := by
      unfold Vx
      exact
        BoundedVariation.partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_of_intervalPartition
          hvariation.left hp
    have hy :
        RealTheory.le
          (BoundedVariation.partitionVariation y p n) Vy := by
      unfold Vy
      exact
        BoundedVariation.partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_of_intervalPartition
          hvariation.right hp
    exact RealTheory.le_trans
      (planePolygonalLength_le_add_partitionVariation x y p n)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hx hy)

theorem planeCurveLengthFrom_sub_eq_subarcLength
    {a b u v : Point} {x y : Map}

proof:

  have ha : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hrect.left.left

    rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect ha hv hv.left
  have huAV : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a v u :=
    And.intro hu.left huv
  have hadd := planeCurveLengthOn_additive hrectAV huAV
  unfold planeCurveLengthFrom

  change
    F.sub

          (planeCurveLengthOn a u x y)
          (planeCurveLengthOn u v x y))
        (planeCurveLengthOn a u x y) =
      planeCurveLengthOn u v x y

    (x y : Map) {iota : Type u} (l r : iota -> Point) :

      change
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)

      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  | i :: js => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change
        F.le
          (F.add
            (PlaneDistance (x (l i)) (y (l i)) (x (r i)) (y (r i)))
            (planeChordIncrementSum x y l r js))
          (F.add
            (F.add
              (acIntervalIncrement x l r i)
              (acIntervalIncrementSum x l r js))
            (F.add
              (acIntervalIncrement y l r i)
              (acIntervalIncrementSum y l r js)))
      have hhead :

            (PlaneDistance (x (l i)) (y (l i)) (x (r i)) (y (r i)))

              (acIntervalIncrement x l r i)

            (acIntervalIncrementSum x l r js)
            (acIntervalIncrementSum y l r js)) at htail
      have hadd := F.add_le_add hhead htail
      have hrearrange :

                (acIntervalIncrementSum x l r js))
              (F.add
                (acIntervalIncrement y l r i)
                (acIntervalIncrementSum y l r js)) := by
        rw [F.add_assoc]
        rw [<- F.add_assoc
          (acIntervalIncrement y l r i)
          (acIntervalIncrementSum x l r js)
          (acIntervalIncrementSum y l r js)]
        rw [F.add_comm
          (acIntervalIncrement y l r i)
          (acIntervalIncrementSum x l r js)]
        rw [F.add_assoc
          (acIntervalIncrementSum x l r js)
          (acIntervalIncrement y l r i)
          (acIntervalIncrementSum y l r js)]
        rw [<- F.add_assoc]
      rw [hrearrange] at hadd
      exact hadd

name: mem_flattenedSubarcCells
proof:
:= by
  unfold flattenedSubarcCells at hq
  have hq' := List.mem_flatMap.mp hq
  cases hq' with
  | intro i hi =>
      have himap := hi.right
      rw [List.mem_map] at himap
      cases himap with
      | intro k hk =>
          have hfirst := congrArg Prod.fst hk.right
          have hsecond := congrArg Prod.snd hk.right
          change i = q.1 at hfirst
          change k = q.2 at hsecond
          rw [<- hfirst, <- hsecond]

name: fixedFirst_range_nodup
statement:
private theorem fixedFirst_range_nodup {iota : Type u}
    (i : iota) :
    forall n : Nat,
      List.Nodup ((List.range n).map (fun k => (i, k)))
  | 0 => by
      simp
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.nodup_append]
      refine And.intro (fixedFirst_range_nodup i n) ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · simp
      · intro a ha b hb
        rw [List.mem_map] at ha
        cases ha with
        | intro k hk =>
            have hb' : b = (i, n)
proof:
:= by
              simpa using hb
            rw [hb']
            intro hab
            have hkn : k = n := congrArg Prod.snd (hk.right.trans hab)
            rw [hkn] at hk
            exact (Nat.lt_irrefl n) (List.mem_range.mp hk.left)

name: flattenedSubarcCells_nodup
statement:
private theorem flattenedSubarcCells_nodup
    {iota : Type u} (count : iota -> Nat) :
    forall {js : List iota},
      List.Nodup js -> List.Nodup (flattenedSubarcCells count js)
  | [], _hnodup => by
      unfold flattenedSubarcCells
      exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | i :: js, hnodup => by
      have hi
proof:
:= List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup
      change
        List.Nodup
          ((List.range (count i)).map (fun k => (i, k)) ++
            flattenedSubarcCells count js)
      rw [List.nodup_append]
      refine And.intro (fixedFirst_range_nodup i (count i)) ?_
      refine And.intro (flattenedSubarcCells_nodup count hi.right) ?_
      intro q hq q' hq'
      rw [List.mem_map] at hq
      cases hq with
      | intro k hk =>
          have hfirst : q.1 = i := by
            have h := congrArg Prod.fst hk.right
            exact h.symm
          have hq'info := mem_flattenedSubarcCells hq'
          intro heq
          have hiTail : List.Mem i js := by
            rw [<- hfirst, heq]
            exact hq'info.left
          exact hi.left hiTail
