          (ks.map (fun k => (i, k))) =
        RealInterval.intervalListLength
          (fun k : Nat => part i k)
          (fun k : Nat => part i (k + 1)) ks
  | [] => rfl

            (RealInterval.intervalListLength
              (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)

            (RealInterval.intervalListLength
              (fun h : Nat => part i h)

      rw [intervalListLength_fixedFirst_map part i ks]

name: flattenedSubarcCells_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
private theorem flattenedSubarcCells_pairwiseDisjoint
    {iota : Type u} {a b : Point} {l r : iota -> Point}
    {count : iota -> Nat} {part : iota -> Nat -> Point} :
    forall {js : List iota},
      ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js ->
        (forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
          IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
            (l i) (r i) (count i) (part i)) ->
          RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
            (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
            (flattenedSubarcCells count js)
  | [], _hfamily, _hpart => by
      unfold flattenedSubarcCells
      unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
      exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | i :: js, hfamily, hpart => by
      have hp
proof:
:= hpart i (List.Mem.head js)
      have htailFamily := acIntervalFamilyOn_tail hfamily
      have htailPart :
          forall j : iota, List.Mem j js ->
            IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
              (l j) (r j) (count j) (part j) := by
        intro j hj
        exact hpart j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
      change
        RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
          (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
          ((List.range (count i)).map (fun k => (i, k)) ++
            flattenedSubarcCells count js)
      unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
      rw [List.pairwise_append]
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · rw [List.pairwise_map]
        have hblock :=
          IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_of_mem_lt
            hp (List.range (count i))
            (fun k hk => List.mem_range.mp hk)
            List.nodup_range
        unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint at hblock
        simpa [flattenedSubarcLeft, flattenedSubarcRight] using hblock
      · refine And.intro
          (flattenedSubarcCells_pairwiseDisjoint
            htailFamily htailPart) ?_
        intro q hq q' hq'
        rw [List.mem_map] at hq
        cases hq with
        | intro k hk =>
            have hqEq := hk.right
            have hq'info := mem_flattenedSubarcCells hq'
            have hpart' :=
              hpart q'.1 (List.Mem.tail i hq'info.left)
            have horiginal := hfamily.right.right.right.right
            unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint at horiginal
            cases horiginal with
            | cons hhead _htail =>
                have hdisjointOriginal :=
                  hhead q'.1 hq'info.left
                intro z hz hz'
                apply hdisjointOriginal z
                · have hzCell :
                      RealInterval.IntervalAt
                        (fun h : Nat => part i h)
                        (fun h : Nat => part i (h + 1)) k z := by
                    rw [<- hqEq] at hz
                    exact hz
                  exact
                    intervalPartition_openCell_subset_openInterval
                      hp (List.mem_range.mp hk.left) z hzCell
                · have hz'Cell :
                      RealInterval.IntervalAt
                        (fun h : Nat => part q'.1 h)
                        (fun h : Nat => part q'.1 (h + 1)) q'.2 z := by
                    exact hz'
                  exact
                    intervalPartition_openCell_subset_openInterval
                      hpart' hq'info.right z hz'Cell

name: flattenedSubarcCells_acIntervalFamilyOn
statement:
private theorem flattenedSubarcCells_acIntervalFamilyOn
    {iota : Type u} {a b : Point} {l r : iota -> Point}
    {js : List iota} {count : iota -> Nat}
    {part : iota -> Nat -> Point}
    (hfamily : ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js)
    (hpart : forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
      IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
        (l i) (r i) (count i) (part i)) :
    ACIntervalFamilyOn a b
      (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
      (flattenedSubarcCells count js)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hfamily.left ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro q hq
    have hqinfo := mem_flattenedSubarcCells hq
    exact
      IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_step_le
        (hpart q.1 hqinfo.left) hqinfo.right
  · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · intro q hq
      have hqinfo := mem_flattenedSubarcCells hq
      have hp := hpart q.1 hqinfo.left
      have hleft :=
        IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
          hp hqinfo.right
      have hright :=
        IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
          hp hqinfo.right
      have horiginal := hfamily.right.right.left q.1 hqinfo.left
      exact And.intro
        (And.intro
          (RealTheory.le_trans horiginal.left.left hleft.left)
          (RealTheory.le_trans hleft.right horiginal.right.right))
        (And.intro
          (RealTheory.le_trans horiginal.left.left hright.left)
          (RealTheory.le_trans hright.right horiginal.right.right))
    · exact And.intro
        (flattenedSubarcCells_nodup count
          hfamily.right.right.right.left)
        (flattenedSubarcCells_pairwiseDisjoint hfamily hpart)

statement:
private theorem intervalListLength_flattenedSubarcCells_eq
    {iota : Type u} {l r : iota -> Point}

      (forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->

            (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)

          RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js
  | [], _hpart => rfl
  | i :: js, hpart => by
      have hp
proof:
:= hpart i (List.Mem.head js)

          forall j : iota, List.Mem j js ->
            IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
              (l j) (r j) (count j) (part j) := by
        intro j hj

            (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)

name: exists_near_subarc_partition
statement:
private theorem exists_near_subarc_partition
    {a b eta : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    {iota : Type u} {l r : iota -> Point} {js : List iota}
    (hfamily : ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
      Exists (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
          And
            (IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
              (l i) (r i) n p)
            (RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.sub
                (planeCurveLengthOn (l i) (r i) x y) eta)
              (planePolygonalLength x y p n))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro i hi
  have hbounds := hfamily.right.right.left i hi
  have hle := hfamily.right.left i hi
  by_cases hlt : RealTheory.lt (l i) (r i)
  · exact
      planeCurveLengthOn_exists_partition_gt_sub hlt
        (rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval
          hrect hbounds.left hbounds.right hle)
        heta
  · have hrl : RealTheory.le (r i) (l i) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hlt
    have heq : l i = r i := F.le_antisymm hle hrl
    let p : Nat -> Point := fun _ => l i
    refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
    refine Exists.intro p ?_
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · refine And.intro rfl ?_
      refine And.intro heq ?_
      intro k hk
      omega
    · rw [<- heq]
      rw [planeCurveLengthOn_degenerate]
      unfold planePolygonalLength
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      change F.lt (F.sub F.zero eta) F.zero
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F eta]
      have hneg := F.neg_lt_neg heta
      change F.lt (F.neg eta) (F.neg F.zero) at hneg
      rw [F.neg_zero] at hneg
      exact hneg

name: nat_mul_equalSubarcBudget_lt
statement:
private theorem nat_mul_equalSubarcBudget_lt
    (m : Nat) {eta : Point}
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    let step
proof:
:= RealTheory.mul eta
      (RealTheory.inv
        (RealTheory.nat (m + 1)))
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) step) eta := by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let denom := F.nat (m + 1)
  let step := F.mul eta (F.inv denom)
  dsimp only
  have hsuccNeNat : Not (m + 1 = 0) := Nat.succ_ne_zero m
  have hdenomPos : F.lt F.zero denom :=
    F.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hsuccNeNat
  have hdenomNe : Not (denom = F.zero) :=
    by
      intro hzero
      rw [hzero] at hdenomPos
      exact F.lt_irrefl F.zero hdenomPos
  have hnatLt : F.lt (F.nat m) denom :=
    F.nat_lt_nat_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self m)
  have hinvPos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv denom) :=
    F.inv_pos hdenomPos
  have hratio := F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hnatLt hinvPos
  have hdenomInv : F.mul denom (F.inv denom) = F.one :=
    F.mul_inv_cancel hdenomNe
  rw [hdenomInv] at hratio
  have hscaled := F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hratio heta
  change F.lt (F.mul (F.nat m) step) eta
  unfold step
  have hrearrange :
      F.mul (F.nat m) (F.mul eta (F.inv denom)) =
        F.mul eta (F.mul (F.nat m) (F.inv denom)) := by
    rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    rw [F.mul_comm (F.nat m) eta]
    rw [F.mul_assoc]
  rw [hrearrange]
  rw [F.mul_one] at hscaled
  exact hscaled

name: nat_succ_mul_subarcBudget
statement:
private theorem nat_succ_mul_subarcBudget
    (m : Nat) (step : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1)) step =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) step) step
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (F.nat (m + 1)) step =
      F.add (F.mul (F.nat m) step) step
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: acIntervalIncrementSum_lengthFrom_le_flattenedChord_add_budget
statement:
private theorem acIntervalIncrementSum_lengthFrom_le_flattenedChord_add_budget
    {a b eta : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    {iota : Type u} {l r : iota -> Point}
    {count : iota -> Nat} {part : iota -> Nat -> Point} :
    forall {js : List iota},
      ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js ->
        (forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
          IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
            (l i) (r i) (count i) (part i)) ->
        (forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.sub
              (planeCurveLengthOn (l i) (r i) x y) eta)
            (planePolygonalLength x y (part i) (count i))) ->
        RealTheory.le
          (acIntervalIncrementSum
            (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r js)
          (RealTheory.add
            (planeChordIncrementSum x y
              (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
              (flattenedSubarcCells count js))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat js.length) eta))
  | [], _hfamily, _hpart, _hnear => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change
        F.le F.zero
          (F.add F.zero (F.mul (F.nat 0) eta))
      rw [F.nat_zero, F.zero_mul, F.add_zero]
      exact F.le_refl F.zero
  | i :: js, hfamily, hpart, hnear => by
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hp := hpart i (List.Mem.head js)
      have htailFamily := acIntervalFamilyOn_tail hfamily
      have htailPart :
          forall j : iota, List.Mem j js ->
            IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
              (l j) (r j) (count j) (part j) := by
        intro j hj
        exact hpart j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
      have htailNear :
          forall j : iota, List.Mem j js ->
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.sub
                (planeCurveLengthOn (l j) (r j) x y) eta)
              (planePolygonalLength x y (part j) (count j)) := by
        intro j hj
        exact hnear j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
      have htailLe :=
        acIntervalIncrementSum_lengthFrom_le_flattenedChord_add_budget
          hrect htailFamily htailPart htailNear
      have hheadNear := hnear i (List.Mem.head js)
      have hheadIncrement :=
        acIntervalIncrement_planeCurveLengthFrom_eq_subarcLength
          hrect hfamily (List.Mem.head js)
      have hblockChord :
          planeChordIncrementSum x y
              (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
              ((List.range (count i)).map (fun k => (i, k))) =
            planePolygonalLength x y (part i) (count i) := by
        rw [planeChordIncrementSum_fixedFirst_map]
        exact
          planeChordIncrementSum_range_eq_planePolygonalLength
            x y (part i) (count i)
      rw [<- hheadIncrement, <- hblockChord] at hheadNear
      have hheadLt := F.add_lt_add_right hheadNear eta
      change
        F.lt
          (F.add
            (F.sub
              (acIntervalIncrement
                (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r i) eta)
            eta)
          (F.add
            (planeChordIncrementSum x y
              (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
              ((List.range (count i)).map (fun k => (i, k))))
            eta) at hheadLt
      rw [F.sub_add_cancel] at hheadLt
      have hheadLe := F.le_of_lt hheadLt
      change
        F.le
          (F.add
            (acIntervalIncrement
              (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r i)
            (acIntervalIncrementSum
              (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r js))
          (F.add
            (planeChordIncrementSum x y
              (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
              (((List.range (count i)).map (fun k => (i, k))) ++
                flattenedSubarcCells count js))
            (F.mul (F.nat (js.length + 1)) eta))
      rw [planeChordIncrementSum_append]
      change
        F.le
          (F.add
            (acIntervalIncrement
              (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r i)
            (acIntervalIncrementSum
              (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r js))
          (F.add
            (F.add
              (planeChordIncrementSum x y
                (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
                ((List.range (count i)).map (fun k => (i, k))))
              (planeChordIncrementSum x y
                (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
                (flattenedSubarcCells count js)))
            (F.mul (F.nat (js.length + 1)) eta))
      have hsucc := nat_succ_mul_subarcBudget js.length eta
      change
        F.mul (F.nat (js.length + 1)) eta =
          F.add (F.mul (F.nat js.length) eta) eta at hsucc
      rw [hsucc]
      change
        F.le
          (F.add
            (acIntervalIncrement
              (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r i)
            (acIntervalIncrementSum
              (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r js))
          (F.add
            (F.add
              (planeChordIncrementSum x y
                (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
                ((List.range (count i)).map (fun k => (i, k))))
              (planeChordIncrementSum x y
                (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
                (flattenedSubarcCells count js)))
            (F.add (F.mul (F.nat js.length) eta) eta))
      change
        F.le
          (acIntervalIncrementSum
            (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r js)
          (F.add
            (planeChordIncrementSum x y
              (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
              (flattenedSubarcCells count js))
            (F.mul (F.nat js.length) eta)) at htailLe
      have hadd := F.add_le_add hheadLe htailLe
      have hrearrange :
          F.add
              (F.add
                (planeChordIncrementSum x y
                  (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
                  ((List.range (count i)).map (fun k => (i, k))))
                eta)
              (F.add
                (planeChordIncrementSum x y
                  (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
                  (flattenedSubarcCells count js))
                (F.mul (F.nat js.length) eta)) =
            F.add
              (F.add
                (planeChordIncrementSum x y
                  (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
                  ((List.range (count i)).map (fun k => (i, k))))
                (planeChordIncrementSum x y
                  (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
                  (flattenedSubarcCells count js)))
              (F.add (F.mul (F.nat js.length) eta) eta) := by
        let A :=
          planeChordIncrementSum x y
            (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
            ((List.range (count i)).map (fun k => (i, k)))
        let B :=
          planeChordIncrementSum x y
            (flattenedSubarcLeft part) (flattenedSubarcRight part)
            (flattenedSubarcCells count js)
        let C := F.mul (F.nat js.length) eta
        change F.add (F.add A eta) (F.add B C) =
          F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C eta)
        calc
          F.add (F.add A eta) (F.add B C) =
              F.add A (F.add eta (F.add B C)) :=
            F.add_assoc A eta (F.add B C)
          _ = F.add A (F.add (F.add eta B) C) := by
            rw [<- F.add_assoc eta B C]
          _ = F.add A (F.add (F.add B eta) C) := by
            rw [F.add_comm eta B]
          _ = F.add A (F.add B (F.add eta C)) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc B eta C]
          _ = F.add (F.add A B) (F.add eta C) := by
            rw [<- F.add_assoc A B (F.add eta C)]
          _ = F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C eta) := by
            rw [F.add_comm eta C]
      rw [hrearrange] at hadd
      exact hadd

name: exists_flattened_subarcPartitions_near_length_family
statement:
theorem exists_flattened_subarcPartitions_near_length_family
    {a b eta : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    {iota : Type u} {l r : iota -> Point} {js : List iota}
    (hfamily : ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    Exists (fun flatL : iota × Nat -> Point =>
      Exists (fun flatR : iota × Nat -> Point =>
        Exists (fun cells : List (iota × Nat) =>
          And (ACIntervalFamilyOn a b flatL flatR cells)
            (And
              (RealInterval.intervalListLength flatL flatR cells =
                RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js)
              (RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (acIntervalIncrementSum
                    (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r js)
                  eta)
                (planeChordIncrementSum x y flatL flatR cells))))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let step :=
    F.mul eta (F.inv (F.nat (js.length + 1)))
  have hsuccNe : Not (js.length + 1 = 0) :=
    Nat.succ_ne_zero js.length
  have hdenomPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (js.length + 1)) :=
    F.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hsuccNe
  have hstepPos : F.lt F.zero step := by
    unfold step
    exact F.mul_pos heta (F.inv_pos hdenomPos)
  have hnearEach :=
    exists_near_subarc_partition hrect hfamily hstepPos
  have hall :
      forall i : iota,
        Exists (fun n : Nat =>
          Exists (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
            List.Mem i js ->
              And
                (IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
                  (l i) (r i) n p)
                (F.lt
                  (F.sub (planeCurveLengthOn (l i) (r i) x y) step)
                  (planePolygonalLength x y p n)))) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : List.Mem i js
    · cases hnearEach i hi with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              exact Exists.intro n
                (Exists.intro p (fun _ => hp))
    · exact Exists.intro 0
        (Exists.intro (fun _ => l i)
          (fun hmem => False.elim (hi hmem)))
  let count : iota -> Nat :=
    fun i => Classical.choose (hall i)
  let part : iota -> Nat -> Point :=
    fun i => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (hall i))
  have hselected :
      forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
        And
          (IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
            (l i) (r i) (count i) (part i))
          (F.lt
            (F.sub (planeCurveLengthOn (l i) (r i) x y) step)
            (planePolygonalLength x y (part i) (count i))) := by
    intro i hi
    simpa [count, part] using
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hall i)) hi)
  have hpart :
      forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
          (l i) (r i) (count i) (part i) := by
    intro i hi
    exact (hselected i hi).left
  have hnear :
      forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
        F.lt
          (F.sub (planeCurveLengthOn (l i) (r i) x y) step)
          (planePolygonalLength x y (part i) (count i)) := by
    intro i hi
    exact (hselected i hi).right
  let flatL := flattenedSubarcLeft part
  let flatR := flattenedSubarcRight part
  let cells := flattenedSubarcCells count js
  refine Exists.intro flatL ?_
  refine Exists.intro flatR ?_
  refine Exists.intro cells ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact flattenedSubarcCells_acIntervalFamilyOn hfamily hpart
  · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · exact intervalListLength_flattenedSubarcCells_eq hpart
    · have haggregate :=
        acIntervalIncrementSum_lengthFrom_le_flattenedChord_add_budget
          hrect hfamily hpart hnear
      have hbudget :=
        nat_mul_equalSubarcBudget_lt js.length heta
      change
        F.lt (F.mul (F.nat js.length) step) eta at hbudget
      change
        F.le
          (acIntervalIncrementSum
            (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r js)
          (F.add
            (planeChordIncrementSum x y flatL flatR cells)
            (F.mul (F.nat js.length) step)) at haggregate
      have hupper :=
        F.add_lt_add_left hbudget
          (planeChordIncrementSum x y flatL flatR cells)
      have hsumLt := F.lt_of_le_of_lt haggregate hupper
      have hshift := F.add_lt_add_right hsumLt (F.neg eta)
      change
        F.lt
          (F.add
            (acIntervalIncrementSum
              (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r js)
            (F.neg eta))
          (F.add
            (F.add
              (planeChordIncrementSum x y flatL flatR cells) eta)
            (F.neg eta)) at hshift
      rw [F.add_assoc, F.add_neg, F.add_zero] at hshift
      simpa [F.sub_eq_add_neg] using hshift

name: planeCurveLengthFrom_absolutelyContinuous_of_coordinates
statement:
theorem planeCurveLengthFrom_absolutelyContinuous_of_coordinates
    {a b : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hxAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval x a b)
    (hyAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval y a b) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
      (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcurve : PlaneCurveOn a b x y :=
    And.intro hxAC.left
      (And.intro
        (continuousOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hxAC)
        (continuousOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hyAC))
  have hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y :=
    (rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_iff_boundedVariationOn_coordinates
      hcurve).mpr
      (And.intro
        (boundedVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hxAC)
        (boundedVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hyAC))
  refine And.intro hxAC.left ?_
  intro eps heps
  let half := F.half eps
  let quarter := F.half half
  have hhalfPos : F.lt F.zero half := by
    unfold half
    exact F.half_pos heps
  have hquarterPos : F.lt F.zero quarter := by
    unfold quarter
    exact F.half_pos hhalfPos
  cases hxAC.right quarter hquarterPos with
  | intro deltaX hdeltaX =>
      cases hyAC.right quarter hquarterPos with
      | intro deltaY hdeltaY =>
          let delta := F.min2 deltaX deltaY
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro (F.min2_pos hdeltaX.left hdeltaY.left) ?_
          intro iota l r js hfamily hlength
          cases
              exists_flattened_subarcPartitions_near_length_family
                hrect hfamily hhalfPos with
          | intro flatL hflatL =>
              cases hflatL with
              | intro flatR hflatR =>
                  cases hflatR with
                  | intro cells hflat =>
                      have hflatLength :
                          RealInterval.intervalListLength
                              flatL flatR cells =
                            RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js :=
                        hflat.right.left
                      have hflatLtDelta :
                          F.lt
                            (RealInterval.intervalListLength
                              flatL flatR cells)
                            delta := by
                        rw [hflatLength]
                        exact hlength
                      have hflatLtX :
                          F.lt
                            (RealInterval.intervalListLength
                              flatL flatR cells)
                            deltaX :=
                        F.lt_of_lt_of_le hflatLtDelta
                          (F.min2_le_left deltaX deltaY)
                      have hflatLtY :
                          F.lt
                            (RealInterval.intervalListLength
                              flatL flatR cells)
                            deltaY :=
                        F.lt_of_lt_of_le hflatLtDelta
                          (F.min2_le_right deltaX deltaY)
                      have hxSmall :=
                        hdeltaX.right flatL flatR cells
                          hflat.left hflatLtX
                      have hySmall :=
                        hdeltaY.right flatL flatR cells
                          hflat.left hflatLtY
                      have hcoordinateSmall :=
                        F.add_lt_add hxSmall hySmall
                      change
                        F.lt
                          (F.add
                            (acIntervalIncrementSum x flatL flatR cells)
                            (acIntervalIncrementSum y flatL flatR cells))
                          (F.add quarter quarter) at hcoordinateSmall
                      have hquarterTwice :
                          F.add quarter quarter = half := by
                        unfold quarter
                        exact F.half_add_half half
                      rw [hquarterTwice] at hcoordinateSmall
                      have hchordLe :=
                        planeChordIncrementSum_le_add_acIntervalIncrementSums
                          x y flatL flatR cells
                      have hchordSmall :=
                        F.lt_of_le_of_lt hchordLe hcoordinateSmall
                      have hnear := hflat.right.right
                      have hsubSmall := F.lt_trans hnear hchordSmall
                      have hadd := F.add_lt_add_right hsubSmall half
                      change
                        F.lt
                          (F.add
                            (F.sub
                              (acIntervalIncrementSum
                                (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) l r js)
                              half)
                            half)
                          (F.add half half) at hadd
                      rw [F.sub_add_cancel] at hadd
                      have hhalfTwice : F.add half half = eps := by
                        unfold half
                        exact F.half_add_half eps
                      rwa [hhalfTwice] at hadd

name: acIntervalIncrement_leftCoordinate_le_lengthFrom
statement:
private theorem acIntervalIncrement_leftCoordinate_le_lengthFrom
    {a b : Point} {x y : Map}

proof:

  have hordered := hfamily.right.left i hi
  have hcoordinate :
      F.le
        (acIntervalIncrement x l r i)
        (PlaneDistance (x (l i)) (y (l i)) (x (r i)) (y (r i))) := by
    unfold acIntervalIncrement PlaneDistance
    exact abs_left_le_planeNorm
      (F.sub (x (r i)) (x (l i)))
      (F.sub (y (r i)) (y (l i)))
  have hchord :=
    planeDistance_endpoints_le_planeCurveLengthFrom_sub
      hrect hbounds.left hbounds.right hordered
  rw [planeCurveLengthFrom_sub_eq_subarcLength
    hrect hbounds.left hbounds.right hordered] at hchord
  have hincrement :=
    acIntervalIncrement_planeCurveLengthFrom_eq_subarcLength
      hrect hfamily hi
  rw [hincrement]
  exact F.le_trans hcoordinate hchord

statement:

    {a b : Point} {x y : Map}

name: acIntervalIncrementSum_le_of_pointwise
statement:
private theorem acIntervalIncrementSum_le_of_pointwise
    (f g : Map) {iota : Type u} (l r : iota -> Point) :
    forall js : List iota,
      (forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
        RealTheory.le
          (acIntervalIncrement f l r i)
          (acIntervalIncrement g l r i)) ->
        RealTheory.le
          (acIntervalIncrementSum f l r js)
          (acIntervalIncrementSum g l r js)
  | [], _hpoint => RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  | i :: js, hpoint => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change
        F.le
          (F.add
            (acIntervalIncrement f l r i)
            (acIntervalIncrementSum f l r js))
          (F.add
            (acIntervalIncrement g l r i)
            (acIntervalIncrementSum g l r js))

name: planeSumSquares_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.le F.zero (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v))
  have hu := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg F u
  have hv := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg F v
  change F.le F.zero (F.mul u u) at hu
  change F.le F.zero (F.mul v v) at hv
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hu hv
  rwa [F.zero_add] at h

name: planeAbs_mul_self
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F x)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F x) = F.mul x x
  have hx := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg F x
  change F.le F.zero (F.mul x x) at hx
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F x x]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hx]

name: nthRoot_two_mul_self_eq_abs
statement:
private theorem nthRoot_two_mul_self_eq_abs (x : Point) :
    Elementary.nthRoot 2 (RealTheory.mul x x) = RealTheory.abs x
proof:
:= by
  apply Elementary.nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ (n := 1)
  refine And.intro (RealTheory.abs_nonneg x) ?_
  rw [powNat_two]
  exact planeAbs_mul_self x

name: nthRoot_two_le
statement:
private theorem nthRoot_two_le
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hy : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    RealTheory.le (Elementary.nthRoot 2 x) (Elementary.nthRoot 2 y)
proof:
:= by
  exact
    Elementary.nthRootFun_monotoneOn_nonnegative_succ 1
      x y hx hy hxy

name: planeNorm_nonneg
statement:
theorem planeNorm_nonneg (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (PlaneNorm u v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold PlaneNorm
  exact
    Elementary.nthRoot_nonneg_succ_of_nonneg 1
      (planeSumSquares_nonneg u v)

name: planeNorm_mul_self
statement:
theorem planeNorm_mul_self (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (PlaneNorm u v) (PlaneNorm u v) =
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u u) (RealTheory.mul v v)
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    Elementary.powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg 1
      (planeSumSquares_nonneg u v)
  unfold PlaneNorm
  rwa [powNat_two] at h

name: abs_left_le_planeNorm
statement:
theorem abs_left_le_planeNorm (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs u) (PlaneNorm u v)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F u)
      (Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v)))
  have hv := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg F v
  change F.le F.zero (F.mul v v) at hv
  have hle :
      F.le (F.mul u u) (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v)) := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F
        hv (F.mul u u)
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hsqrt := nthRoot_two_mul_self_eq_abs u
  change
    Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul u u) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F u at hsqrt
  rw [<- hsqrt]
  exact nthRoot_two_le
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg F u)
    (planeSumSquares_nonneg u v) hle

name: abs_right_le_planeNorm
statement:
theorem abs_right_le_planeNorm (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs v) (PlaneNorm u v)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F v)
      (Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v)))
  have hu := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg F u
  change F.le F.zero (F.mul u u) at hu
  have hle :
      F.le (F.mul v v) (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v)) := by
    have h := F.add_le_add_right hu (F.mul v v)
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have hsqrt := nthRoot_two_mul_self_eq_abs v
  change
    Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul v v) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F v at hsqrt
  rw [<- hsqrt]
  exact nthRoot_two_le
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg F v)
    (planeSumSquares_nonneg u v) hle

name: planeNorm_le_abs_add_abs
statement:
theorem planeNorm_le_abs_add_abs (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.le (PlaneNorm u v)
      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs u) (RealTheory.abs v))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.le
      (Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v)))
      (F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F u)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F v))
  let au := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F u
  let av := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F v
  have hu : F.le F.zero au := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F u
  have hv : F.le F.zero av := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F v
  have hvu : F.le F.zero (F.mul av au) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hv hu
  have huv : F.le F.zero (F.mul au av) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hu hv
  have hleft :
      F.le (F.mul au au) (F.add (F.mul au au) (F.mul av au)) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hvu
      (F.mul au au)
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hright :
      F.le (F.mul av av) (F.add (F.mul au av) (F.mul av av)) := by
    have h := F.add_le_add_right huv (F.mul av av)
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have habsu := planeAbs_mul_self u
  have habsv := planeAbs_mul_self v
  change F.mul au au = F.mul u u at habsu
  change F.mul av av = F.mul v v at habsv
  have hnormSq :
      F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v) =
        F.add (F.mul au au) (F.mul av av) := by
    rw [habsu, habsv]
  have hexpand :
      F.add
          (F.add (F.mul au au) (F.mul av au))
          (F.add (F.mul au av) (F.mul av av)) =
        F.mul (F.add au av) (F.add au av) := by
    rw [F.mul_add, F.add_mul, F.add_mul]
  have hsq :
      F.le (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v))
        (F.mul (F.add au av) (F.add au av)) := by
    rw [hnormSq, <- hexpand]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hleft hright
  have hsum : F.le F.zero (F.add au av) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hu hv
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have hsumSq : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.add au av) (F.add au av)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hsum hsum
  have hroot :
      F.le
        (Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v)))
        (Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul (F.add au av) (F.add au av))) :=
    nthRoot_two_le (planeSumSquares_nonneg u v) hsumSq hsq
  have hsqrt := nthRoot_two_mul_self_eq_abs (F.add au av)
  change
    Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul (F.add au av) (F.add au av)) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.add au av) at hsqrt
  rw [hsqrt, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hsum] at hroot
  exact hroot

name: planeNorm_one_zero
statement:
theorem planeNorm_one_zero :
    PlaneNorm RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hlower := abs_left_le_planeNorm F.one F.zero
  change F.le (F.abs F.one) (PlaneNorm F.one F.zero) at hlower
  rw [F.abs_one] at hlower
  have hupper := planeNorm_le_abs_add_abs F.one F.zero
  change
    F.le (PlaneNorm F.one F.zero) (F.add (F.abs F.one) (F.abs F.zero))
      at hupper
  rw [F.abs_one, F.abs_zero, F.add_zero] at hupper
  exact F.le_antisymm hupper hlower

name: planeDot_cross_sq_identity
statement:
private theorem planeDot_cross_sq_identity
    (u v u' v' : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u u') (RealTheory.mul v v'))
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u u') (RealTheory.mul v v')))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul u v') (RealTheory.mul v u'))
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul u v') (RealTheory.mul v u'))) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u u) (RealTheory.mul v v))
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u' u') (RealTheory.mul v' v'))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.add (F.mul u u') (F.mul v v'))
          (F.add (F.mul u u') (F.mul v v')))
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul u v') (F.mul v u'))
          (F.sub (F.mul u v') (F.mul v u'))) =
      F.mul (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v))
        (F.add (F.mul u' u') (F.mul v' v'))
  have hmul_left_comm :
      forall x y z : Point,
        F.mul x (F.mul y z) = F.mul y (F.mul x z) := by
    intro x y z
    calc
      F.mul x (F.mul y z) = F.mul (F.mul x y) z :=
        (F.mul_assoc x y z).symm
      _ = F.mul (F.mul y x) z := by rw [F.mul_comm x y]
      _ = F.mul y (F.mul x z) := F.mul_assoc y x z
  have hadd_left_comm :
      forall x y z : Point,
        F.add x (F.add y z) = F.add y (F.add x z) := by
    intro x y z
    calc
      F.add x (F.add y z) = F.add (F.add x y) z :=
        (F.add_assoc x y z).symm
      _ = F.add (F.add y x) z := by rw [F.add_comm x y]
      _ = F.add y (F.add x z) := F.add_assoc y x z
  have hadd_neg_middle :
      forall x y : Point,
        F.add x (F.add (F.neg x) y) = y := by
    intro x y
    calc
      F.add x (F.add (F.neg x) y) =
          F.add (F.add x (F.neg x)) y :=
        (F.add_assoc x (F.neg x) y).symm
      _ = F.add F.zero y := by rw [F.add_neg]
      _ = y := F.zero_add y
  simp only [
    F.sub_eq_add_neg,
    F.mul_add,
    F.add_mul,
    F.mul_neg,
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F,
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F,
    F.mul_assoc,
    F.mul_comm,
    hmul_left_comm,
    F.add_assoc,
    F.add_comm,
    hadd_left_comm]
  simp only [hadd_neg_middle]

name: planeDot_sq_le_normSq_mul_normSq
statement:
private theorem planeDot_sq_le_normSq_mul_normSq
    (u v u' v' : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u u') (RealTheory.mul v v'))
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u u') (RealTheory.mul v v')))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u u) (RealTheory.mul v v))
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u' u') (RealTheory.mul v' v')))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dot := F.add (F.mul u u') (F.mul v v')
  let cross := F.sub (F.mul u v') (F.mul v u')
  have hcross : F.le F.zero (F.mul cross cross) := by
    unfold cross
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg F
      (F.sub (F.mul u v') (F.mul v u'))
  have h := F.add_le_add_right hcross (F.mul dot dot)
  have hid := planeDot_cross_sq_identity u v u' v'
  change
    F.add (F.mul dot dot) (F.mul cross cross) =
      F.mul (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v))
        (F.add (F.mul u' u') (F.mul v' v')) at hid
  change
    F.le (F.mul dot dot)
      (F.mul (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v))
        (F.add (F.mul u' u') (F.mul v' v')))
  rw [F.zero_add, F.add_comm (F.mul cross cross) (F.mul dot dot), hid] at h
  exact h

name: planeDot_abs_le_planeNorm_mul_planeNorm
statement:
theorem planeDot_abs_le_planeNorm_mul_planeNorm
    (u v u' v' : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u u') (RealTheory.mul v v')))
      (RealTheory.mul (PlaneNorm u v) (PlaneNorm u' v'))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dot := F.add (F.mul u u') (F.mul v v')
  let leftSq := F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v)
  let rightSq := F.add (F.mul u' u') (F.mul v' v')
  change
    F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dot)
      (F.mul (Elementary.nthRoot 2 leftSq)
        (Elementary.nthRoot 2 rightSq))
  have hdot : F.le F.zero (F.mul dot dot) := by
    unfold dot
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg F
      (F.add (F.mul u u') (F.mul v v'))
  have hleft : F.le F.zero leftSq := by
    unfold leftSq
    exact planeSumSquares_nonneg u v
  have hright : F.le F.zero rightSq := by
    unfold rightSq
    exact planeSumSquares_nonneg u' v'
  have hproduct : F.le F.zero (F.mul leftSq rightSq) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hleft hright
  have hsq := planeDot_sq_le_normSq_mul_normSq u v u' v'
  change F.le (F.mul dot dot) (F.mul leftSq rightSq) at hsq
  have hroot :
      F.le (Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul dot dot))
        (Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul leftSq rightSq)) :=
    nthRoot_two_le hdot hproduct hsq
  have hdotRoot := nthRoot_two_mul_self_eq_abs dot
  change
    Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul dot dot) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dot at hdotRoot
  have hproductRoot :=
    Elementary.nthRoot_mul_succ_of_nonneg 1 hleft hright
  change
    Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul leftSq rightSq) =
      F.mul (Elementary.nthRoot 2 leftSq)
        (Elementary.nthRoot 2 rightSq) at hproductRoot
  rw [hdotRoot, hproductRoot] at hroot
  exact hroot

name: planeMul_mul_self
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.mul (F.mul c x) (F.mul c x) =
    F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul x x)
  have hinner : F.mul x (F.mul c x) = F.mul c (F.mul x x) := by
    calc
      F.mul x (F.mul c x) = F.mul (F.mul x c) x :=
        (F.mul_assoc x c x).symm
      _ = F.mul (F.mul c x) x := by rw [F.mul_comm x c]
      _ = F.mul c (F.mul x x) := F.mul_assoc c x x
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul c x) (F.mul c x) =
        F.mul c (F.mul x (F.mul c x)) := F.mul_assoc c x (F.mul c x)
    _ = F.mul c (F.mul c (F.mul x x)) := by rw [hinner]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul x x) :=
      (F.mul_assoc c c (F.mul x x)).symm

name: planeNorm_mul
statement:
theorem planeNorm_mul (c u v : Point) :
    PlaneNorm (RealTheory.mul c u) (RealTheory.mul c v) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) (PlaneNorm u v)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    Elementary.nthRoot 2
        (F.add (F.mul (F.mul c u) (F.mul c u))
          (F.mul (F.mul c v) (F.mul c v))) =
      F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F c)
        (Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v)))
  have hu := planeMul_mul_self c u
  have hv := planeMul_mul_self c v
  change F.mul (F.mul c u) (F.mul c u) =
    F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul u u) at hu
  change F.mul (F.mul c v) (F.mul c v) =
    F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul v v) at hv
  have hradicand :
      F.add (F.mul (F.mul c u) (F.mul c u))
          (F.mul (F.mul c v) (F.mul c v)) =
        F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v)) := by
    rw [hu, hv, F.mul_add]
  rw [hradicand]
  have hmulRoot :=
    Elementary.nthRoot_mul_succ_of_nonneg 1
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg F c)
      (planeSumSquares_nonneg u v)
  change
    Elementary.nthRoot 2
        (F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v))) =
      F.mul (Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul c c))
        (Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v))) at hmulRoot
  rw [hmulRoot]
  have hcRoot := nthRoot_two_mul_self_eq_abs c
  change
    Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul c c) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F c at hcRoot
  rw [hcRoot]

name: planeNorm_neg
statement:
theorem planeNorm_neg (u v : Point) :
    PlaneNorm (RealTheory.neg u) (RealTheory.neg v) = PlaneNorm u v
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    Elementary.nthRoot 2
        (F.add (F.mul (F.neg u) (F.neg u))
          (F.mul (F.neg v) (F.neg v))) =
      Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F u u]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F v v]

name: planeNorm_shear
statement:
theorem planeNorm_shear
    (dx dy rho : Point) :
    PlaneNorm
        (RealTheory.add dx (RealTheory.mul rho dy))
        (RealTheory.sub dy (RealTheory.mul rho dx)) =
      RealTheory.mul (PlaneNorm RealTheory.one rho) (PlaneNorm dx dy)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := F.add dx (F.mul rho dy)
  let B := F.sub dy (F.mul rho dx)
  let oneSq := F.add (F.mul F.one F.one) (F.mul rho rho)
  let vectorSq := F.add (F.mul dx dx) (F.mul dy dy)
  have hid := planeDot_cross_sq_identity dx dy F.one rho
  have hdot :
      F.add (F.mul dx F.one) (F.mul dy rho) = A := by
    unfold A
    rw [F.mul_one, F.mul_comm dy rho]
  have hcross :
      F.sub (F.mul dx rho) (F.mul dy F.one) = F.neg B := by
    unfold B
    rw [F.mul_one, F.mul_comm dx rho]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F dy (F.mul rho dx)
  change
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.add (F.mul dx F.one) (F.mul dy rho))
          (F.add (F.mul dx F.one) (F.mul dy rho)))
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul dx rho) (F.mul dy F.one))
          (F.sub (F.mul dx rho) (F.mul dy F.one))) =
      F.mul vectorSq oneSq at hid
  rw [hdot, hcross, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg] at hid
  have hradicand : F.add (F.mul A A) (F.mul B B) = F.mul oneSq vectorSq := by
    calc
      F.add (F.mul A A) (F.mul B B) = F.mul vectorSq oneSq := hid
      _ = F.mul oneSq vectorSq := F.mul_comm vectorSq oneSq
  unfold PlaneNorm
  change
    Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.add (F.mul A A) (F.mul B B)) =
      F.mul
        (Elementary.nthRoot 2 oneSq)
        (Elementary.nthRoot 2 vectorSq)
  rw [hradicand]
  exact Elementary.nthRoot_mul_succ_of_nonneg 1
    (by
      unfold oneSq
      exact planeSumSquares_nonneg F.one rho)
    (by
      unfold vectorSq
      exact planeSumSquares_nonneg dx dy)

name: planeSumSquares_add_identity
statement:
private theorem planeSumSquares_add_identity
    (u v u' v' : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add u u') (RealTheory.add u u'))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add v v') (RealTheory.add v v')) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u u) (RealTheory.mul v v))
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u u') (RealTheory.mul v v')))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u u') (RealTheory.mul v v'))
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul u' u') (RealTheory.mul v' v')))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.add u u') (F.add u u'))
        (F.mul (F.add v v') (F.add v v')) =
      F.add
        (F.add (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v))
          (F.add (F.mul u u') (F.mul v v')))
        (F.add (F.add (F.mul u u') (F.mul v v'))
          (F.add (F.mul u' u') (F.mul v' v')))
  have hadd_left_comm :
      forall x y z : Point,
        F.add x (F.add y z) = F.add y (F.add x z) := by
    intro x y z
    calc
      F.add x (F.add y z) = F.add (F.add x y) z :=
        (F.add_assoc x y z).symm
      _ = F.add (F.add y x) z := by rw [F.add_comm x y]
      _ = F.add y (F.add x z) := F.add_assoc y x z
  simp only [
    F.mul_add,
    F.add_mul,
    F.mul_comm,
    F.add_assoc,
    hadd_left_comm]

name: planeNorm_triangle
statement:
theorem planeNorm_triangle (u v u' v' : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (PlaneNorm (RealTheory.add u u') (RealTheory.add v v'))
      (RealTheory.add (PlaneNorm u v) (PlaneNorm u' v'))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let n := PlaneNorm u v
  let m := PlaneNorm u' v'
  let dot := F.add (F.mul u u') (F.mul v v')
  let addedSq :=
    F.add (F.mul (F.add u u') (F.add u u'))
      (F.mul (F.add v v') (F.add v v'))
  change F.le (Elementary.nthRoot 2 addedSq) (F.add n m)
  have hn := planeNorm_nonneg u v
  have hm := planeNorm_nonneg u' v'
  change F.le F.zero n at hn
  change F.le F.zero m at hm
  have hdotAbs := planeDot_abs_le_planeNorm_mul_planeNorm u v u' v'
  change F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dot) (F.mul n m) at hdotAbs
  have hdot : F.le dot (F.mul n m) :=
    F.le_trans (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_abs_self F dot) hdotAbs
  have hdotRev : F.le dot (F.mul m n) := by
    rw [F.mul_comm m n]
    exact hdot
  have hnSq := planeNorm_mul_self u v
  have hmSq := planeNorm_mul_self u' v'
  change F.mul n n = F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v) at hnSq
  change F.mul m m = F.add (F.mul u' u') (F.mul v' v') at hmSq
  have haddSq := planeSumSquares_add_identity u v u' v'
  change
    addedSq =
      F.add
        (F.add (F.add (F.mul u u) (F.mul v v)) dot)
        (F.add dot (F.add (F.mul u' u') (F.mul v' v'))) at haddSq
  rw [<- hnSq, <- hmSq] at haddSq
  have hleft :
      F.le (F.add (F.mul n n) dot)
        (F.add (F.mul n n) (F.mul m n)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hdotRev (F.mul n n)
  have hright :
      F.le (F.add dot (F.mul m m))
        (F.add (F.mul n m) (F.mul m m)) :=
    F.add_le_add_right hdot (F.mul m m)
  have hgroup :
      F.le
        (F.add (F.add (F.mul n n) dot)
          (F.add dot (F.mul m m)))
        (F.add (F.add (F.mul n n) (F.mul m n))
          (F.add (F.mul n m) (F.mul m m))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hleft hright
  have hexpand :
      F.mul (F.add n m) (F.add n m) =
        F.add (F.add (F.mul n n) (F.mul m n))
          (F.add (F.mul n m) (F.mul m m)) := by
    rw [F.mul_add, F.add_mul, F.add_mul]
  have hsq :
      F.le addedSq (F.mul (F.add n m) (F.add n m)) := by
    rw [haddSq, hexpand]
    exact hgroup
  have haddNonneg : F.le F.zero addedSq := by
    unfold addedSq
    exact
      planeSumSquares_nonneg (F.add u u') (F.add v v')
  have hsum : F.le F.zero (F.add n m) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hn hm
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have hsumSq : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.add n m) (F.add n m)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hsum hsum
  have hroot :
      F.le (Elementary.nthRoot 2 addedSq)
        (Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul (F.add n m) (F.add n m))) :=
    nthRoot_two_le haddNonneg hsumSq hsq
  have hsqrt := nthRoot_two_mul_self_eq_abs (F.add n m)
  change
    Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul (F.add n m) (F.add n m)) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.add n m) at hsqrt
  rw [hsqrt, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hsum] at hroot
  exact hroot

name: planeDistance_nonneg
statement:
theorem planeDistance_nonneg (x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (PlaneDistance x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂)
proof:
:= by
  unfold PlaneDistance
  exact planeNorm_nonneg
    (RealTheory.sub x₂ x₁) (RealTheory.sub y₂ y₁)

name: planeDistance_self
statement:
theorem planeDistance_self (x y : Point) :
    PlaneDistance x y x y = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PlaneDistance
  change PlaneNorm (F.sub x x) (F.sub y y) = F.zero
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F x]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F y]
  have hsq := planeNorm_mul_self F.zero F.zero
  change
    F.mul (PlaneNorm F.zero F.zero) (PlaneNorm F.zero F.zero) =
      F.add (F.mul F.zero F.zero) (F.mul F.zero F.zero) at hsq
  rw [F.zero_mul, F.zero_add] at hsq
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_eq_zero_cases F hsq with
  | inl hzero => exact hzero
  | inr hzero => exact hzero

name: planeDistance_symm
statement:
theorem planeDistance_symm (x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : Point) :
    PlaneDistance x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ = PlaneDistance x₂ y₂ x₁ y₁
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PlaneDistance
  change
    PlaneNorm (F.sub x₂ x₁) (F.sub y₂ y₁) =
      PlaneNorm (F.sub x₁ x₂) (F.sub y₁ y₂)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x₂ x₁]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F y₂ y₁]
  exact (planeNorm_neg (F.sub x₂ x₁) (F.sub y₂ y₁)).symm

name: planeDistance_triangle
statement:
theorem planeDistance_triangle
    (x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ x₃ y₃ : Point) :
    RealTheory.le (PlaneDistance x₁ y₁ x₃ y₃)
      (RealTheory.add
        (PlaneDistance x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂)
        (PlaneDistance x₂ y₂ x₃ y₃))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PlaneDistance
  change
    F.le (PlaneNorm (F.sub x₃ x₁) (F.sub y₃ y₁))
      (F.add
        (PlaneNorm (F.sub x₂ x₁) (F.sub y₂ y₁))
        (PlaneNorm (F.sub x₃ x₂) (F.sub y₃ y₂)))
  have hx :
      F.sub x₃ x₁ = F.add (F.sub x₂ x₁) (F.sub x₃ x₂) := by
    calc
      F.sub x₃ x₁ = F.add (F.sub x₃ x₂) (F.sub x₂ x₁) :=
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel F x₃ x₂ x₁).symm
      _ = F.add (F.sub x₂ x₁) (F.sub x₃ x₂) :=
        F.add_comm (F.sub x₃ x₂) (F.sub x₂ x₁)
  have hy :
      F.sub y₃ y₁ = F.add (F.sub y₂ y₁) (F.sub y₃ y₂) := by
    calc
      F.sub y₃ y₁ = F.add (F.sub y₃ y₂) (F.sub y₂ y₁) :=
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel F y₃ y₂ y₁).symm
      _ = F.add (F.sub y₂ y₁) (F.sub y₃ y₂) :=
        F.add_comm (F.sub y₃ y₂) (F.sub y₂ y₁)
  rw [hx, hy]
  exact planeNorm_triangle
    (F.sub x₂ x₁) (F.sub y₂ y₁)
    (F.sub x₃ x₂) (F.sub y₃ y₂)

name: planeDistance_le_finiteSum_consecutive
statement:
private theorem planeDistance_le_finiteSum_consecutive
    (x y : Map) (q : Nat -> Point) (start : Nat) :
    forall count : Nat,
      RealTheory.le
        (PlaneDistance
          (x (q start)) (y (q start))
          (x (q (start + count))) (y (q (start + count))))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat =>
            planePolygonalLengthTerm x y q (start + h))
          count)
  | 0 => by
      rw [Nat.add_zero, RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      rw [planeDistance_self]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  | count + 1 => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      have htriangle := planeDistance_triangle
        (x (q start)) (y (q start))
        (x (q (start + count))) (y (q (start + count)))
        (x (q (start + (count + 1))))
        (y (q (start + (count + 1))))
      have hinduction :=
        planeDistance_le_finiteSum_consecutive x y q start count
      have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hinduction
        (F.le_refl
          (PlaneDistance
            (x (q (start + count))) (y (q (start + count)))
            (x (q (start + (count + 1))))
            (y (q (start + (count + 1))))))
      refine RealTheory.le_trans htriangle ?_
      have hidx : start + (count + 1) = start + count + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [hidx] at hadd
      exact hadd

name: planePolygonalLengthTerm_le_refinementBlockLength
statement:
private theorem planePolygonalLengthTerm_le_refinementBlockLength
    {x y : Map} {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href :
      IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    {i : Nat}
    (hi : i < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (planePolygonalLengthTerm x y p i)
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun h : Nat =>
          planePolygonalLengthTerm x y q (cut i + h))
        (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i))
proof:
:= by
  have hchain :=
    planeDistance_le_finiteSum_consecutive x y q (cut i)
      (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i)
  have hmono : cut i <= cut (i + 1) :=
    IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono_step href hi
  have hidx :
      cut i + IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i =
        cut (i + 1) := by
    unfold IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength
    exact Nat.add_sub_of_le hmono
  unfold planePolygonalLengthTerm
  rw [hidx] at hchain
  rw [IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href
    (Nat.le_of_lt hi)] at hchain
  rw [IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href
    (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)] at hchain
  exact hchain

name: planePolygonalLength_le_of_partitionBlockRefines
statement:
theorem planePolygonalLength_le_of_partitionBlockRefines
    {x y : Map} {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href :
      IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut) :
    RealTheory.le
      (planePolygonalLength x y p n)
      (planePolygonalLength x y q m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold planePolygonalLength
  have hblocksum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum (planePolygonalLengthTerm x y q) (cut n) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun h : Nat =>
                planePolygonalLengthTerm x y q (cut i + h))
              (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i))
          n :=
    IntervalPartition.finiteSum_cut_blocks
      (planePolygonalLengthTerm x y q)
      (IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_left href)
      (fun i hi =>
        IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono_step href hi)
  have hle :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum (planePolygonalLengthTerm x y p) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun h : Nat =>
                planePolygonalLengthTerm x y q (cut i + h))
              (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i))
          n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (planePolygonalLengthTerm x y p)
      (fun i : Nat =>
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat =>
            planePolygonalLengthTerm x y q (cut i + h))
          (IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i))
      n
      (fun i hi =>
        planePolygonalLengthTerm_le_refinementBlockLength href hi)
  rw [<- hblocksum] at hle
  rw [IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_right href] at hle
  exact hle

name: planePolygonalLengthTerm_adjacent_left

private theorem planePolygonalLengthTerm_adjacent_left
    {a c : Point} {x y : Map}

proof:

name: planePolygonalLength_adjacentPartition_eq_add
statement:
private theorem planePolygonalLength_adjacentPartition_eq_add
    {a c b : Point} {x y : Map}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    (hleft :
      IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a c leftCount left)
    (hright :
      IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition c b rightCount right) :
    planePolygonalLength x y
        (IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition left right leftCount)
        (leftCount + rightCount) =
      RealTheory.add
        (planePolygonalLength x y left leftCount)
        (planePolygonalLength x y right rightCount)
proof:
:= by
  unfold planePolygonalLength
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length]
  have hleftSum := RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt leftCount
    (fun k hk =>
      planePolygonalLengthTerm_adjacent_left (x := x) (y := y) hleft
        (IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright) hk)
  rw [hleftSum]
  have hrightSum := RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    (fun j : Nat =>
      planePolygonalLengthTerm_adjacent_right
        x y left right leftCount j)
    rightCount
  rw [hrightSum]

name: rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval
statement:
theorem rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval
    {a b u v : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (hu : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b u)
    (hv : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b v)
    (huv : RealTheory.le u v) :
    RectifiablePlaneCurveOn u v x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsubset :
      SetPred.Subset
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v)
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) := by
    intro t ht
    exact And.intro
      (RealTheory.le_trans hu.left ht.left)
      (RealTheory.le_trans ht.right hv.right)
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact And.intro huv
      (And.intro
        (continuousOn_subset hsubset hrect.left.right.left)
        (continuousOn_subset hsubset hrect.left.right.right))
  · refine Exists.intro (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y) ?_
    intro n p hp
    let left := IntervalPartition.twoPointPartition a u
    let right := IntervalPartition.twoPointPartition v b
    let first := IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition left p 1
    let whole := IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition first right (1 + n)
    have hleft :
        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a u 1 left :=
      IntervalPartition.twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hu.left
    have hright :
        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition v b 1 right :=
      IntervalPartition.twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hv.right
    have hfirst :
        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a v (1 + n) first :=
      IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_intervalPartition hleft hp
    have hwhole :
        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b ((1 + n) + 1) whole :=
      IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_intervalPartition hfirst hright
    have hfirstLength :
        planePolygonalLength x y first (1 + n) =
          F.add
            (planePolygonalLength x y left 1)
            (planePolygonalLength x y p n) :=
      planePolygonalLength_adjacentPartition_eq_add hleft hp
    have hwholeLength :
        planePolygonalLength x y whole ((1 + n) + 1) =
          F.add
            (planePolygonalLength x y first (1 + n))
            (planePolygonalLength x y right 1) :=
      planePolygonalLength_adjacentPartition_eq_add hfirst hright
    have hleftNonneg := planePolygonalLength_nonneg x y left 1
    have hrightNonneg := planePolygonalLength_nonneg x y right 1
    have hmid_le_first :
        F.le (planePolygonalLength x y p n)
          (planePolygonalLength x y first (1 + n)) := by
      rw [hfirstLength]
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_right F
        hleftNonneg (planePolygonalLength x y p n)
      change
        F.le
          (F.add F.zero (planePolygonalLength x y p n))
          (F.add (planePolygonalLength x y left 1)
            (planePolygonalLength x y p n)) at h
      rw [F.zero_add] at h
      exact h
    have hfirst_le_whole :
        F.le (planePolygonalLength x y first (1 + n))
          (planePolygonalLength x y whole ((1 + n) + 1)) := by
      rw [hwholeLength]
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hrightNonneg
        (planePolygonalLength x y first (1 + n))
      change
        F.le
          (F.add (planePolygonalLength x y first (1 + n)) F.zero)
          (F.add (planePolygonalLength x y first (1 + n))
            (planePolygonalLength x y right 1)) at h
      rw [F.add_zero] at h
      exact h
    exact RealTheory.le_trans
      (RealTheory.le_trans hmid_le_first hfirst_le_whole)
      (planePolygonalLength_le_planeCurveLengthOn hrect hwhole)

name: planeCurveLengthValueOn_add_le_global
statement:
private theorem planeCurveLengthValueOn_add_le_global
    {a c b leftValue rightValue : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (hleftValue :
      PlaneCurveLengthValueOn a c x y leftValue)
    (hrightValue :
      PlaneCurveLengthValueOn c b x y rightValue) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add leftValue rightValue)
      (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hglobalSpec := planeCurveLengthOn_spec_of_rectifiable hrect
  cases hleftValue with
  | inl hleftZero =>
      rw [<- hleftZero.left] at hrightValue
      rw [hleftZero.right]
      change F.le (F.add F.zero rightValue)
        (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y)
      rw [F.zero_add]
      exact hglobalSpec.left rightValue hrightValue
  | inr hleftPart =>
      cases hrightValue with
      | inl hrightZero =>
          rw [hrightZero.left] at hleftPart
          rw [hrightZero.right]
          change F.le (F.add leftValue F.zero)
            (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y)
          rw [F.add_zero]
          exact hglobalSpec.left leftValue (Or.inr hleftPart)
      | inr hrightPart =>
          cases hleftPart with
          | intro leftCount hleftCount =>
              cases hleftCount with
              | intro left hleft =>
                  cases hrightPart with
                  | intro rightCount hrightCount =>
                      cases hrightCount with
                      | intro right hright =>
                          let whole :=
                            IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition
                              left right leftCount
                          have hwhole :
                              IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b
                                (leftCount + rightCount) whole :=
                            IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_intervalPartition
                              hleft.right.left hright.right.left
                          have hvalue :
                              PlaneCurveLengthValueOn a b x y
                                (planePolygonalLength x y whole
                                  (leftCount + rightCount)) :=
                            Or.inr
                              (Exists.intro (leftCount + rightCount)
                                (Exists.intro whole
                                  (And.intro
                                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                                      hleft.left hright.left)
                                    (And.intro hwhole rfl))))
                          have hle := hglobalSpec.left
                            (planePolygonalLength x y whole
                              (leftCount + rightCount)) hvalue
                          have hsum :=
                            planePolygonalLength_adjacentPartition_eq_add
                              (x := x) (y := y)
                              hleft.right.left hright.right.left
                          rw [hsum] at hle
                          rw [hleft.right.right, hright.right.right]
                          exact hle

name: add_le_planeCurveLengthOn_at
statement:
theorem add_le_planeCurveLengthOn_at
    {a c b : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add
        (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y)
        (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y))
      (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleftRect := rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect
    (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hrect.left.left) hc hc.left
  have hrightRect := rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect
    hc (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hrect.left.left) hc.right
  have hleftSpec := planeCurveLengthOn_spec_of_rectifiable hleftRect
  have hrightSpec := planeCurveLengthOn_spec_of_rectifiable hrightRect
  let total := planeCurveLengthOn a b x y
  let leftTotal := planeCurveLengthOn a c x y
  let rightTotal := planeCurveLengthOn c b x y
  have hleftValueAdd :
      forall leftValue : Point,
        PlaneCurveLengthValueOn a c x y leftValue ->
          F.le (F.add leftValue rightTotal) total := by
    intro leftValue hleftValue
    have hrightUpper :
        IsUpperBound F.le (PlaneCurveLengthValueOn c b x y)
          (F.sub total leftValue) := by
      intro rightValue hrightValue
      have hsum :=
        planeCurveLengthValueOn_add_le_global
          (a := a) (c := c) (b := b)
          (leftValue := leftValue) (rightValue := rightValue) hrect
          hleftValue hrightValue
      change F.le (F.add leftValue rightValue) total at hsum
      rw [F.add_comm leftValue rightValue] at hsum
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_sub_of_add_le F hsum
    have hrightLe : F.le rightTotal (F.sub total leftValue) :=
      hrightSpec.right (F.sub total leftValue) hrightUpper
    have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F
      hrightLe leftValue
    change
      F.le (F.add leftValue rightTotal)
        (F.add leftValue (F.sub total leftValue)) at hadd
    rw [F.add_comm leftValue (F.sub total leftValue)] at hadd
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F total leftValue] at hadd
    exact hadd
  have hleftUpper :
      IsUpperBound F.le (PlaneCurveLengthValueOn a c x y)
        (F.sub total rightTotal) := by
    intro leftValue hleftValue
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_sub_of_add_le F
      (hleftValueAdd leftValue hleftValue)
  have hleftLe : F.le leftTotal (F.sub total rightTotal) :=
    hleftSpec.right (F.sub total rightTotal) hleftUpper
  have hadd := F.add_le_add_right hleftLe rightTotal
  change
    F.le (F.add leftTotal rightTotal)
      (F.add (F.sub total rightTotal) rightTotal) at hadd
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F total rightTotal] at hadd
  exact hadd

name: planeCurveLengthOn_le_add_at
statement:
theorem planeCurveLengthOn_le_add_at
    {a c b : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c) :
    RealTheory.le
      (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y)
      (RealTheory.add
        (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y)
        (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleftRect := rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect
    (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hrect.left.left) hc hc.left
  have hrightRect := rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect
    hc (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hrect.left.left) hc.right
  have hglobalSpec := planeCurveLengthOn_spec_of_rectifiable hrect
  apply hglobalSpec.right
  intro value hvalue
  cases hvalue with
  | inl hzero =>
      rw [hzero.right]
      have hleftNonneg := planeCurveLengthOn_nonneg hleftRect
      have hrightNonneg := planeCurveLengthOn_nonneg hrightRect
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
        hleftNonneg hrightNonneg
      change
        F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero)
          (F.add (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y)
            (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y)) at h
      rw [F.zero_add] at h
      exact h
  | inr hpart =>
      cases hpart with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              let split := IntervalPartition.splitPointPartition a c b
              let merge :=
                IntervalPartition.endpointMergePoint p split n 2
              let cut :=
                IntervalPartition.endpointMergeRightBlockCut p split n 2 1
              have hsplit :
                  IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b 2 split :=
                IntervalPartition.splitPointPartition_intervalPartition hc
              have hnpos : 0 < n := by
                by_cases hn : 0 < n
                · exact hn
                · have hn0 : n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn
                  have habEq : a = b := by
                    have hleft :=
                      IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_left_endpoint
                        hp.right.left
                    have hright :=
                      IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_right_endpoint
                        hp.right.left
                    rw [hn0] at hright
                    exact hleft.symm.trans hright
                  have hbad := hp.left
                  rw [habEq] at hbad
                  exact False.elim
                    ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F b) hbad)
              have hmerge :
                  IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b (n + 2) merge :=
                IntervalPartition.endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition
                  hp.right.left hsplit
              have hrefP :
                  IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
                    merge (n + 2) p n
                    (IntervalPartition.endpointMergeLeftBlockCut
                      p split n 2) :=
                IntervalPartition.endpointMergeLeft_partitionBlockRefines
                  hp.right.left hsplit hnpos
              have hrefSplit :
                  IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
                    merge (n + 2) split 2
                    (IntervalPartition.endpointMergeRightBlockCut
                      p split n 2) :=
                IntervalPartition.endpointMergeRight_partitionBlockRefines
                  hp.right.left hsplit (by omega)
              have hcutLe : cut <= n + 2 := by
                unfold cut
                exact IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right
                  hrefSplit (by omega)
              have hcutPoint : merge cut = c := by
                unfold cut merge split
                rw [IntervalPartition.endpointMergeRightBlockCut_endpoint
                  hp.right.left hsplit (by omega)]
                exact IntervalPartition.splitPointPartition_one a c b
              have hprefix :
                  IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a c cut merge := by
                have h :=
                  IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_prefix hmerge hcutLe
                rwa [hcutPoint] at h
              have hsuffix :
                  IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition c b
                    ((n + 2) - cut)
                    (IntervalPartition.suffixPartition merge cut) := by
                have h :=
                  IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_suffix hmerge hcutLe
                rwa [hcutPoint] at h
              have hpLeMerge :=
                planePolygonalLength_le_of_partitionBlockRefines
                  (x := x) (y := y) hrefP
              have hmergeSum :=
                planePolygonalLength_adjacentPartition_eq_add
                  (x := x) (y := y) hprefix hsuffix
              rw [IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_suffix_eq_self] at hmergeSum
              have hcount : cut + ((n + 2) - cut) = n + 2 :=
                Nat.add_sub_of_le hcutLe
              rw [hcount] at hmergeSum
              have hleftLe :=
                planePolygonalLength_le_planeCurveLengthOn hleftRect hprefix
              have hrightLe :=
                planePolygonalLength_le_planeCurveLengthOn hrightRect hsuffix
              have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
                hleftLe hrightLe
              have hmergeLe :
                  RealTheory.le
                    (planePolygonalLength x y merge (n + 2))
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y)
                      (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y)) := by
                rw [hmergeSum]
                exact hadd
              rw [hp.right.right]
              exact RealTheory.le_trans hpLeMerge hmergeLe

name: planeCurveLengthOn_additive
statement:
theorem planeCurveLengthOn_additive
    {a c b : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c) :
    planeCurveLengthOn a b x y =
      RealTheory.add
        (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y)
        (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y)
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.le_antisymm
    (planeCurveLengthOn_le_add_at hrect hc)
    (add_le_planeCurveLengthOn_at hrect hc)

name: adjacentCutCellPartition_blockRefines
statement:
private theorem adjacentCutCellPartition_blockRefines
    {c : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < n) :
    let leftPart
proof:
:= IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition p k c
    let rightPart := IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition p k c
    let inserted :=
      IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition leftPart rightPart (k + 1)
    IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
      inserted (n + 1) p n (insertedPartitionCut k) := by
  let leftPart := IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition p k c
  let rightPart := IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition p k c
  let inserted :=
    IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition leftPart rightPart (k + 1)
  dsimp only
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · unfold insertedPartitionCut
    simp
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · unfold insertedPartitionCut
    simp [Nat.not_le_of_lt hk]
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro i hi
    unfold insertedPartitionCut
    by_cases hik : i <= k
    · simp [hik]
      rw [IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_left_of_lt]
      · exact IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le p k c hik
      · omega
    · simp [hik]
      have hki : k < i := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hik
      have hshift : k + 1 <= i + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_right_of_le
        _ _ hshift]
      have hsub : (i + 1) - (k + 1) = i - k := by
        omega
      rw [hsub]
      have hpos : 0 < i - k := by
        omega
      rw [IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_of_pos p k c hpos]
      have hidx : k + (i - k) = i := Nat.add_sub_of_le
        (Nat.le_of_lt hki)
      rw [hidx]
  · intro i hi
    unfold insertedPartitionCut
    by_cases hik : i <= k
    · by_cases hsik : i + 1 <= k
      · simp [hik, hsik]
      · simp [hik, hsik]
        omega
    · have hsik : Not (i + 1 <= k) := by
        omega
      simp [hik, hsik]

name: planePolygonalLength_suffix_le_planeDistance_add_cutSuffix
statement:
private theorem planePolygonalLength_suffix_le_planeDistance_add_cutSuffix
    (x y : Map) (q : Nat -> Point) (cut : Nat) (t : Point) :
    forall count : Nat,
      RealTheory.le
        (planePolygonalLength x y
          (IntervalPartition.suffixPartition q cut) count)
        (RealTheory.add
          (PlaneDistance
            (x (q cut)) (y (q cut)) (x t) (y t))
          (planePolygonalLength x y
            (IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition q cut t) count))
  | 0 => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      unfold planePolygonalLength
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero, RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      have hdist := planeDistance_nonneg
        (x (q cut)) (y (q cut)) (x t) (y t)
      have h := F.add_le_add_right hdist F.zero
      change F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero)
        (F.add
          (PlaneDistance (x (q cut)) (y (q cut)) (x t) (y t))
          F.zero) at h
      rw [F.zero_add] at h
      exact h
  | count + 1 => by
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      unfold planePolygonalLength
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first]
      have htailPointwise :
          forall j : Nat,
            planePolygonalLengthTerm x y
                (IntervalPartition.suffixPartition q cut) (j + 1) =
              planePolygonalLengthTerm x y
                (IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition q cut t)
                (j + 1) := by
        intro j
        unfold planePolygonalLengthTerm IntervalPartition.suffixPartition
        rw [IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_succ q cut j t]
        rw [IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_succ q cut (j + 1) t]
        have hleft : cut + (j + 1) = cut + j + 1 := by omega
        have hright : cut + (j + 1 + 1) = cut + j + 1 + 1 := by omega
        rw [hleft, hright]
      have htail := RealTheory.finiteSum_congr htailPointwise count
      rw [htail]
      have htriangle := planeDistance_triangle
        (x (q cut)) (y (q cut))
        (x t) (y t)
        (x (q (cut + 1))) (y (q (cut + 1)))
      have hfirstOld :
          planePolygonalLengthTerm x y
              (IntervalPartition.suffixPartition q cut) 0 =
            PlaneDistance
              (x (q cut)) (y (q cut))
              (x (q (cut + 1))) (y (q (cut + 1))) := by
        unfold planePolygonalLengthTerm IntervalPartition.suffixPartition
        rw [Nat.add_zero]
      have hfirstNew :
          planePolygonalLengthTerm x y
              (IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition q cut t) 0 =
            PlaneDistance
              (x t) (y t)
              (x (q (cut + 1))) (y (q (cut + 1))) := by
        unfold planePolygonalLengthTerm
        rw [IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_zero]
        rw [IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_succ]
      rw [hfirstOld, hfirstNew]
      have hadd := F.add_le_add_right htriangle
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            planePolygonalLengthTerm x y
              (IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition q cut t) (j + 1))
          count)
      change
        F.le
          (F.add
            (PlaneDistance
              (x (q cut)) (y (q cut))
              (x (q (cut + 1))) (y (q (cut + 1))))
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun j : Nat =>
                planePolygonalLengthTerm x y
                  (IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition q cut t)
                  (j + 1)) count))
          (F.add
            (F.add
              (PlaneDistance (x (q cut)) (y (q cut)) (x t) (y t))
