              (PlaneDistance
                (x t) (y t)
                (x (q (cut + 1))) (y (q (cut + 1)))))
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun j : Nat =>
                planePolygonalLengthTerm x y
                  (IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition q cut t)
                  (j + 1)) count)) at hadd
      rw [F.add_assoc] at hadd
      exact hadd

name: planePolygonalLength_prefix_le_cutPrefix_add_planeDistance
statement:
private theorem planePolygonalLength_prefix_le_cutPrefix_add_planeDistance
    (x y : Map) (q : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (t : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (planePolygonalLength x y q (k + 1))
      (RealTheory.add
        (planePolygonalLength x y
          (IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition q k t) (k + 1))
        (PlaneDistance
          (x t) (y t) (x (q (k + 1))) (y (q (k + 1)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold planePolygonalLength
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ, RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
  have hprefixPointwise :
      forall i : Nat, i < k ->
        planePolygonalLengthTerm x y q i =
          planePolygonalLengthTerm x y
            (IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition q k t) i := by
    intro i hi
    unfold planePolygonalLengthTerm
    rw [IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le q k t
      (Nat.le_of_lt hi)]
    rw [IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le q k t
      (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)]
  have hprefix := RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt k hprefixPointwise
  rw [hprefix]
  have hlast :
      planePolygonalLengthTerm x y
          (IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition q k t) k =
        PlaneDistance
          (x (q k)) (y (q k)) (x t) (y t) := by
    unfold planePolygonalLengthTerm
    rw [IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le q k t
      (Nat.le_refl k)]
    rw [IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_succ]
  rw [hlast]
  unfold planePolygonalLengthTerm
  have htriangle := planeDistance_triangle
    (x (q k)) (y (q k))
    (x t) (y t)
    (x (q (k + 1))) (y (q (k + 1)))
  have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
    (F.le_refl
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (planePolygonalLengthTerm x y
          (IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition q k t)) k))
    htriangle
  change
    F.le
      (F.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (planePolygonalLengthTerm x y
            (IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition q k t)) k)
        (PlaneDistance
          (x (q k)) (y (q k))
          (x (q (k + 1))) (y (q (k + 1)))))
      (F.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (planePolygonalLengthTerm x y
            (IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition q k t)) k)
        (F.add
          (PlaneDistance (x (q k)) (y (q k)) (x t) (y t))
          (PlaneDistance
            (x t) (y t)
            (x (q (k + 1))) (y (q (k + 1)))))) at hadd
  rw [<- F.add_assoc] at hadd
  exact hadd

name: lt_of_add_lt_add_right_properties
statement:
private theorem lt_of_add_lt_add_right_properties
    {x y z : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add x z) (RealTheory.add y z)) :
    RealTheory.lt x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h' := F.add_lt_add_right h (F.neg z)
  change
    F.lt
      (F.add (F.add x z) (F.neg z))
      (F.add (F.add y z) (F.neg z)) at h'
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_neg_cancel_right F x z,
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_neg_cancel_right F y z] at h'

name: lt_of_add_lt_add_left_properties
statement:
private theorem lt_of_add_lt_add_left_properties
    {x y z : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add z x) (RealTheory.add z y)) :
    RealTheory.lt x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt (F.add z x) (F.add z y) at h
  rw [F.add_comm z x, F.add_comm z y] at h
  exact lt_of_add_lt_add_right_properties h

name: middle_lt_eta_add_of_sub_lt
statement:
private theorem middle_lt_eta_add_of_sub_lt
    {left middle right eta chord : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.add left (RealTheory.add middle right)) eta)
      (RealTheory.add left (RealTheory.add chord right))) :
    RealTheory.lt middle (RealTheory.add eta chord)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hadd := F.add_lt_add_right h eta
  change
    F.lt
      (F.add (F.sub (F.add left (F.add middle right)) eta) eta)
      (F.add (F.add left (F.add chord right)) eta) at hadd
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F
    (F.add left (F.add middle right)) eta] at hadd
  have hreorder :
      F.add (F.add left (F.add chord right)) eta =
        F.add left (F.add (F.add eta chord) right) := by
    calc
      F.add (F.add left (F.add chord right)) eta =
          F.add left (F.add (F.add chord right) eta) :=
        F.add_assoc left (F.add chord right) eta
      _ = F.add left (F.add chord (F.add right eta)) := by
        rw [<- F.add_assoc chord right eta]
      _ = F.add left (F.add chord (F.add eta right)) := by
        rw [F.add_comm right eta]
      _ = F.add left (F.add (F.add chord eta) right) := by
        rw [F.add_assoc chord eta right]
      _ = F.add left (F.add (F.add eta chord) right) := by
        rw [F.add_comm chord eta]
  rw [hreorder] at hadd
  have hwithoutLeft := lt_of_add_lt_add_left_properties hadd
  exact lt_of_add_lt_add_right_properties hwithoutLeft

name: planeDistance_lt_of_coordinate_dist_lt
statement:
private theorem planeDistance_lt_of_coordinate_dist_lt
    {x1 y1 x2 y2 eps : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt (dist x2 x1)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps))
    (hy : RealTheory.lt (dist y2 y1)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps)) :
    RealTheory.lt (PlaneDistance x1 y1 x2 y2) eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x2 x1) (F.half eps) at hx
  change
    F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F y2 y1) (F.half eps) at hy
  have hsum := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hx hy
  change
    F.lt
      (F.add
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub x2 x1))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub y2 y1)))
      (F.add (F.half eps) (F.half eps)) at hsum
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hsum
  have hnorm := planeNorm_le_abs_add_abs
    (F.sub x2 x1) (F.sub y2 y1)
  unfold PlaneDistance
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hnorm hsum

name: lt_right_of_dist_lt_sub
statement:
private theorem lt_right_of_dist_lt_sub
    {left x right : Point}
    (hgap : RealTheory.lt (dist x left)
      (RealTheory.sub right left)) :
    RealTheory.lt x right
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsubDist : F.le (F.sub x left) (dist x left) := by
    unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_abs_self F (F.sub x left)
  have hsub : F.lt (F.sub x left) (F.sub right left) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hsubDist hgap
  have hadd := F.add_lt_add_right hsub left
  change
    F.lt
      (F.add (F.sub x left) left)
      (F.add (F.sub right left) left) at hadd
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x left,
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F right left] at hadd

name: lt_left_of_dist_lt_sub
statement:
private theorem lt_left_of_dist_lt_sub
    {left x right : Point}
    (hgap : RealTheory.lt (dist x right)
      (RealTheory.sub right left)) :
    RealTheory.lt left x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcomm := dist_comm x right
  have hgap' : F.lt (dist right x) (F.sub right left) := by
    rw [hcomm] at hgap
    exact hgap
  have hsubDist : F.le (F.sub right x) (dist right x) := by
    unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_abs_self F (F.sub right x)
  have hsub : F.lt (F.sub right x) (F.sub right left) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hsubDist hgap'
  by_cases hlx : F.lt left x
  · exact hlx
  · have hxl : F.le x left :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hlx
    have hle := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hxl
      (F.sub right left)
    change
      F.le
        (F.add (F.sub right left) x)
        (F.add (F.sub right left) left) at hle
    have hrightEq : F.add (F.sub right left) left = right :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F right left
    rw [hrightEq] at hle
    have hsubAdd := F.add_lt_add_right hsub x
    change
      F.lt
        (F.add (F.sub right x) x)
        (F.add (F.sub right left) x) at hsubAdd
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F right x] at hsubAdd
    exact False.elim
      ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hsubAdd) hle)

name: planeCurveLengthOn_right_small
statement:
theorem planeCurveLengthOn_right_small
    {a b c eps : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall t : Point,
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval c b t ->
              RealTheory.lt (dist t c) delta ->
                RealTheory.lt
                  (planeCurveLengthOn c t x y) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hcbEq : c = b
  · refine Exists.intro F.one ?_
    refine And.intro F.zero_lt_one ?_
    intro t ht _htdist
    have htRight := ht.right
    rw [<- hcbEq] at htRight
    have htc : t = c := RealTheory.le_antisymm htRight ht.left
    subst t
    rw [planeCurveLengthOn_degenerate]
    exact heps
  · have hbc : Not (F.le b c) := by
      intro hbc
      exact hcbEq (RealTheory.le_antisymm hc.right hbc)
    have hcb : F.lt c b :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hc.right hbc
    have hab : F.lt a b :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hc.left hcb
    let eta := F.half eps
    have heta : F.lt F.zero eta :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
    let coordinateBudget := F.half eta
    have hcoordinateBudget : F.lt F.zero coordinateBudget :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heta
    have hxContinuous := hrect.left.right.left c hc
    have hyContinuous := hrect.left.right.right c hc
    cases hxContinuous.right coordinateBudget hcoordinateBudget with
    | intro deltaX hdeltaX =>
        cases hyContinuous.right coordinateBudget hcoordinateBudget with
        | intro deltaY hdeltaY =>
            cases planeCurveLengthOn_exists_partition_gt_sub
                hab hrect heta with
            | intro n hn =>
                cases hn with
                | intro p hp =>
                    let P := fun j : Nat => F.lt c (p j)
                    have hPn : P n := by
                      unfold P
                      rw [IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_right_endpoint
                        hp.left]
                      exact hcb
                    have hPExists : Exists P := Exists.intro n hPn
                    let j := Tautology.Nat.least P hPExists
                    have hjSpec : P j :=
                      Tautology.Nat.least_spec P hPExists
                    have hjLe : j <= n :=
                      Tautology.Nat.least_min P hPExists hPn
                    have hjPos : 0 < j := by
                      by_cases hjZero : j = 0
                      · unfold P at hjSpec
                        rw [hjZero] at hjSpec
                        rw [IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_left_endpoint
                          hp.left] at hjSpec
                        exact False.elim
                          ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hjSpec)
                            hc.left)
                      · omega
                    let k := j - 1
                    have hkSucc : k + 1 = j := by
                      unfold k
                      omega
                    have hkLt : k < n := by
                      omega
                    have hpkLe : F.le (p k) c := by
                      by_cases hle : F.le (p k) c
                      · exact hle
                      · have hcpk : F.lt c (p k) :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F
                            ((F.le_total c (p k)).resolve_right hle) hle
                        have hjMin : j <= k :=
                          Tautology.Nat.least_min P hPExists (by
                            unfold P
                            exact hcpk)
                        exact False.elim (by omega)
                    have hcRight : F.le c (p (k + 1)) := by
                      rw [hkSucc]
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hjSpec
                    have hcCell :
                        IntervalPartition.PartitionCell p k c :=
                      And.intro hpkLe hcRight
                    let leftPart :=
                      IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition p k c
                    let rightPart :=
                      IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition p k c
                    let cut := k + 1
                    let inserted :=
                      IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition
                        leftPart rightPart cut
                    have hleftPart :
                        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a c cut leftPart := by
                      unfold cut leftPart
                      exact IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cutCellPrefix
                        hp.left hkLt hcCell
                    have hrightPart :
                        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition c b (n - k)
                          rightPart := by
                      unfold rightPart
                      exact IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cutCellSuffix
                        hp.left hkLt hcCell
                    have hinsertedRaw :
                        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b
                          (cut + (n - k)) inserted := by
                      unfold inserted
                      exact
                        IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_intervalPartition
                          hleftPart hrightPart
                    have hcount : cut + (n - k) = n + 1 := by
                      unfold cut
                      omega
                    have hinserted :
                        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b (n + 1)
                          inserted := by
                      rwa [hcount] at hinsertedRaw
                    have href :
                        IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
                          inserted (n + 1) p n
                          (insertedPartitionCut k) := by
                      have h :=
                        adjacentCutCellPartition_blockRefines
                          (p := p) (n := n) (k := k) (c := c) hkLt
                      change
                        IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
                          inserted (n + 1) p n
                          (insertedPartitionCut k) at h
                      exact h
                    have hpLeInserted :=
                      planePolygonalLength_le_of_partitionBlockRefines
                        (x := x) (y := y) href
                    have hinsertedNear :
                        F.lt
                          (F.sub (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y) eta)
                          (planePolygonalLength x y inserted (n + 1)) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hp.right
                        hpLeInserted
                    have hinsertedCut : inserted cut = c := by
                      unfold inserted cut rightPart
                      rw [IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_boundary]
                      exact
                        IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_zero p k c
                    have hinsertedNext :
                        inserted (cut + 1) = p (k + 1) := by
                      unfold inserted cut rightPart
                      rw [IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_right_shift
                        leftPart
                        (IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)
                        (k + 1) 1]
                      exact
                        IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_succ p k 0 c
                    have hnextStrict : F.lt c (p (k + 1)) := by
                      rw [hkSucc]
                      exact hjSpec
                    let gap := F.sub (p (k + 1)) c
                    have hgap : F.lt F.zero gap := by
                      have h := F.add_lt_add_right hnextStrict (F.neg c)
                      change
                        F.lt (F.add c (F.neg c))
                          (F.add (p (k + 1)) (F.neg c)) at h
                      rw [F.add_neg] at h
                      unfold gap
                      rwa [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
                    let deltaXY := F.min2 deltaX deltaY
                    let delta := F.min2 deltaXY gap
                    have hdeltaXY : F.lt F.zero deltaXY :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
                        hdeltaX.left hdeltaY.left
                    have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdeltaXY hgap
                    refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                    refine And.intro hdelta ?_
                    intro t ht htdist
                    by_cases htc : t = c
                    · subst t
                      rw [planeCurveLengthOn_degenerate]
                      exact heps
                    · have hdeltaLeXY : F.le delta deltaXY :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaXY gap
                      have hdeltaXYLeX : F.le deltaXY deltaX :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaX deltaY
                      have hdeltaXYLeY : F.le deltaXY deltaY :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaX deltaY
                      have hdeltaLeGap : F.le delta gap :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaXY gap
                      have htdistX : F.lt (dist t c) deltaX :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htdist
                          (F.le_trans hdeltaLeXY hdeltaXYLeX)
                      have htdistY : F.lt (dist t c) deltaY :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htdist
                          (F.le_trans hdeltaLeXY hdeltaXYLeY)
                      have htdistGap : F.lt (dist t c) gap :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htdist
                          hdeltaLeGap
                      have htBefore : F.lt t (p (k + 1)) := by
                        unfold gap at htdistGap
                        exact lt_right_of_dist_lt_sub htdistGap
                      have htGlobal : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b t :=
                        And.intro (F.le_trans hc.left ht.left) ht.right
                      have hxClose := hdeltaX.right t htGlobal htc htdistX
                      have hyClose := hdeltaY.right t htGlobal htc htdistY
                      change F.lt (dist (x t) (x c)) coordinateBudget at hxClose
                      change F.lt (dist (y t) (y c)) coordinateBudget at hyClose
                      have hchord :
                          F.lt
                            (PlaneDistance (x c) (y c) (x t) (y t)) eta := by
                        unfold coordinateBudget at hxClose hyClose
                        exact planeDistance_lt_of_coordinate_dist_lt
                          hxClose hyClose
                      have hcutLt : cut < n + 1 := by
                        unfold cut
                        omega
                      have htCell :
                          IntervalPartition.PartitionCell inserted cut t := by
                        unfold IntervalPartition.PartitionCell
                        rw [hinsertedCut, hinsertedNext]
                        exact And.intro ht.left
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F htBefore)
                      let tSuffix :=
                        IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition
                          inserted cut t
                      have htSuffix :
                          IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition t b
                            ((n + 1) - cut) tSuffix := by
                        unfold tSuffix
                        exact IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cutCellSuffix
                          hinserted hcutLt htCell
                      have hfixedPrefixRaw :=
                        IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_prefix hinserted
                          (Nat.le_of_lt hcutLt)
                      have hfixedPrefix :
                          IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a c cut
                            inserted := by
                        rwa [hinsertedCut] at hfixedPrefixRaw
                      have hfixedSuffixRaw :=
                        IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_suffix hinserted
                          (Nat.le_of_lt hcutLt)
                      have hfixedSuffix :
                          IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition c b
                            ((n + 1) - cut)
                            (IntervalPartition.suffixPartition inserted cut) := by
                        rwa [hinsertedCut] at hfixedSuffixRaw
                      have hleftRect :=
                        rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect
                          (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hrect.left.left)
                          hc hc.left
                      have htRect :=
                        rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect
                          htGlobal
                          (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hrect.left.left)
                          ht.right
                      have hprefixLe :=
                        planePolygonalLength_le_planeCurveLengthOn
                          hleftRect hfixedPrefix
                      have htSuffixLe :=
                        planePolygonalLength_le_planeCurveLengthOn
                          htRect htSuffix
                      have hsuffixCompare :=
                        planePolygonalLength_suffix_le_planeDistance_add_cutSuffix
                          x y inserted cut t ((n + 1) - cut)
                      rw [hinsertedCut] at hsuffixCompare
                      have hchordAdd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
                        (F.le_refl
                          (PlaneDistance (x c) (y c) (x t) (y t)))
                        htSuffixLe
                      have hsuffixLe := F.le_trans hsuffixCompare hchordAdd
                      have hinsertedSum :=
                        planePolygonalLength_adjacentPartition_eq_add
                          (x := x) (y := y) hfixedPrefix hfixedSuffix
                      rw [IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_suffix_eq_self]
                        at hinsertedSum
                      have hsplitCount :
                          cut + ((n + 1) - cut) = n + 1 :=
                        Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hcutLt)
                      rw [hsplitCount] at hinsertedSum
                      have hpartsLe := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
                        hprefixLe hsuffixLe
                      have hinsertedLe :
                          F.le (planePolygonalLength x y inserted (n + 1))
                            (F.add
                              (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y)
                              (F.add
                                (PlaneDistance (x c) (y c) (x t) (y t))
                                (planeCurveLengthOn t b x y))) := by
                        rw [hinsertedSum]
                        exact hpartsLe
                      have hnearBound :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                          hinsertedNear hinsertedLe
                      have hrightRect :=
                        rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect hc
                          (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hrect.left.left)
                          hc.right
                      have htRight : RealTheory.ClosedInterval c b t := ht
                      have hdecomp :
                          planeCurveLengthOn a b x y =
                            RealTheory.add
                              (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y)
                              (RealTheory.add
                                (planeCurveLengthOn c t x y)
                                (planeCurveLengthOn t b x y)) := by
                        calc
                          planeCurveLengthOn a b x y =
                              RealTheory.add
                                (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y)
                                (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y) :=
                            planeCurveLengthOn_additive hrect hc
                          _ = RealTheory.add
                                (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y)
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (planeCurveLengthOn c t x y)
                                  (planeCurveLengthOn t b x y)) := by
                            rw [planeCurveLengthOn_additive hrightRect htRight]
                      rw [hdecomp] at hnearBound
                      have htailEta :=
                        middle_lt_eta_add_of_sub_lt hnearBound
                      have hetaChord :
                          F.lt
                            (F.add eta
                              (PlaneDistance (x c) (y c) (x t) (y t)))
                            eps := by
                        have h :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hchord eta
                        change
                          F.lt
                            (F.add eta
                              (PlaneDistance (x c) (y c) (x t) (y t)))
                            (F.add eta eta) at h
                        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at h
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                        htailEta hetaChord

name: planeCurveLengthOn_left_small
statement:
theorem planeCurveLengthOn_left_small
    {a b c eps : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall t : Point,
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c t ->
              RealTheory.lt (dist t c) delta ->
                RealTheory.lt
                  (planeCurveLengthOn t c x y) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hcaEq : c = a
  · refine Exists.intro F.one ?_
    refine And.intro F.zero_lt_one ?_
    intro t ht _htdist
    have htLeft := ht.left
    rw [<- hcaEq] at htLeft
    have htc : t = c := RealTheory.le_antisymm ht.right htLeft
    subst t
    rw [planeCurveLengthOn_degenerate]
    exact heps
  · have hacNot : Not (F.le c a) := by
      intro hac
      exact hcaEq (RealTheory.le_antisymm hc.left hac).symm
    have hac : F.lt a c :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hc.left hacNot
    have hab : F.lt a b :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hac hc.right
    let eta := F.half eps
    have heta : F.lt F.zero eta :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
    let coordinateBudget := F.half eta
    have hcoordinateBudget : F.lt F.zero coordinateBudget :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heta
    have hxContinuous := hrect.left.right.left c hc
    have hyContinuous := hrect.left.right.right c hc
    cases hxContinuous.right coordinateBudget hcoordinateBudget with
    | intro deltaX hdeltaX =>
        cases hyContinuous.right coordinateBudget hcoordinateBudget with
        | intro deltaY hdeltaY =>
            cases planeCurveLengthOn_exists_partition_gt_sub
                hab hrect heta with
            | intro n hn =>
                cases hn with
                | intro p hp =>
                    let P := fun j : Nat => F.le c (p j)
                    have hPn : P n := by
                      unfold P
                      rw [IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_right_endpoint
                        hp.left]
                      exact hc.right
                    have hPExists : Exists P := Exists.intro n hPn
                    let j := Tautology.Nat.least P hPExists
                    have hjSpec : P j :=
                      Tautology.Nat.least_spec P hPExists
                    have hjLe : j <= n :=
                      Tautology.Nat.least_min P hPExists hPn
                    have hjPos : 0 < j := by
                      by_cases hjZero : j = 0
                      · unfold P at hjSpec
                        rw [hjZero] at hjSpec
                        rw [IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_left_endpoint
                          hp.left] at hjSpec
                        exact False.elim
                          ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hac) hjSpec)
                      · omega
                    let k := j - 1
                    have hkSucc : k + 1 = j := by
                      unfold k
                      omega
                    have hkLt : k < n := by
                      omega
                    have hpkStrict : F.lt (p k) c := by
                      by_cases hlt : F.lt (p k) c
                      · exact hlt
                      · have hcpk : F.le c (p k) :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hlt
                        have hjMin : j <= k :=
                          Tautology.Nat.least_min P hPExists (by
                            unfold P
                            exact hcpk)
                        exact False.elim (by omega)
                    have hcRight : F.le c (p (k + 1)) := by
                      rw [hkSucc]
                      exact hjSpec
                    have hcCell :
                        IntervalPartition.PartitionCell p k c :=
                      And.intro
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hpkStrict)
                        hcRight
                    let leftPart :=
                      IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition p k c
                    let rightPart :=
                      IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition p k c
                    let cut := k + 1
                    let inserted :=
                      IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition
                        leftPart rightPart cut
                    have hleftPart :
                        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a c cut leftPart := by
                      unfold cut leftPart
                      exact IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cutCellPrefix
                        hp.left hkLt hcCell
                    have hrightPart :
                        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition c b (n - k)
                          rightPart := by
                      unfold rightPart
                      exact IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cutCellSuffix
                        hp.left hkLt hcCell
                    have hinsertedRaw :
                        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b
                          (cut + (n - k)) inserted := by
                      unfold inserted
                      exact
                        IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_intervalPartition
                          hleftPart hrightPart
                    have hcount : cut + (n - k) = n + 1 := by
                      unfold cut
                      omega
                    have hinserted :
                        IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b (n + 1)
                          inserted := by
                      rwa [hcount] at hinsertedRaw
                    have href :
                        IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
                          inserted (n + 1) p n
                          (insertedPartitionCut k) := by
                      have h :=
                        adjacentCutCellPartition_blockRefines
                          (p := p) (n := n) (k := k) (c := c) hkLt
                      change
                        IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
                          inserted (n + 1) p n
                          (insertedPartitionCut k) at h
                      exact h
                    have hpLeInserted :=
                      planePolygonalLength_le_of_partitionBlockRefines
                        (x := x) (y := y) href
                    have hinsertedNear :
                        F.lt
                          (F.sub (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y) eta)
                          (planePolygonalLength x y inserted (n + 1)) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hp.right
                        hpLeInserted
                    have hinsertedCut : inserted cut = c := by
                      unfold inserted cut rightPart
                      rw [IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_boundary]
                      exact
                        IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_zero p k c
                    have hinsertedPrev : inserted k = p k := by
                      unfold inserted cut leftPart
                      rw [IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_left_of_lt]
                      · exact
                          IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le
                            p k c (Nat.le_refl k)
                      · omega
                    let gap := F.sub c (p k)
                    have hgap : F.lt F.zero gap := by
                      have h := F.add_lt_add_right hpkStrict (F.neg (p k))
                      change
                        F.lt (F.add (p k) (F.neg (p k)))
                          (F.add c (F.neg (p k))) at h
                      rw [F.add_neg] at h
                      unfold gap
                      rwa [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
                    let deltaXY := F.min2 deltaX deltaY
                    let delta := F.min2 deltaXY gap
                    have hdeltaXY : F.lt F.zero deltaXY :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
                        hdeltaX.left hdeltaY.left
                    have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdeltaXY hgap
                    refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                    refine And.intro hdelta ?_
                    intro t ht htdist
                    by_cases htc : t = c
                    · subst t
                      rw [planeCurveLengthOn_degenerate]
                      exact heps
                    · have hdeltaLeXY : F.le delta deltaXY :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaXY gap
                      have hdeltaXYLeX : F.le deltaXY deltaX :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaX deltaY
                      have hdeltaXYLeY : F.le deltaXY deltaY :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaX deltaY
                      have hdeltaLeGap : F.le delta gap :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaXY gap
                      have htdistX : F.lt (dist t c) deltaX :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htdist
                          (F.le_trans hdeltaLeXY hdeltaXYLeX)
                      have htdistY : F.lt (dist t c) deltaY :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htdist
                          (F.le_trans hdeltaLeXY hdeltaXYLeY)
                      have htdistGap : F.lt (dist t c) gap :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htdist
                          hdeltaLeGap
                      have htAfter : F.lt (p k) t := by
                        unfold gap at htdistGap
                        exact lt_left_of_dist_lt_sub htdistGap
                      have htGlobal : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b t :=
                        And.intro ht.left (F.le_trans ht.right hc.right)
                      have hxClose := hdeltaX.right t htGlobal htc htdistX
                      have hyClose := hdeltaY.right t htGlobal htc htdistY
                      change F.lt (dist (x t) (x c)) coordinateBudget at hxClose
                      change F.lt (dist (y t) (y c)) coordinateBudget at hyClose
                      have hchordCT :
                          F.lt
                            (PlaneDistance (x c) (y c) (x t) (y t)) eta := by
                        unfold coordinateBudget at hxClose hyClose
                        exact planeDistance_lt_of_coordinate_dist_lt
                          hxClose hyClose
                      have hchord :
                          F.lt
                            (PlaneDistance (x t) (y t) (x c) (y c)) eta := by
                        rw [planeDistance_symm]
                        exact hchordCT
                      have hcutPos : 0 < cut := by
                        unfold cut
                        omega
                      have hcutLt : cut < n + 1 := by
                        unfold cut
                        omega
                      have htCell :
                          IntervalPartition.PartitionCell inserted k t := by
                        unfold IntervalPartition.PartitionCell
                        rw [hinsertedPrev]
                        have hnext : inserted (k + 1) = c := by
                          rwa [<- show cut = k + 1 by rfl]
                        rw [hnext]
                        exact And.intro
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F htAfter) ht.right
                      let tPrefix :=
                        IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition inserted k t
                      have htPrefix :
                          IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a t cut
                            tPrefix := by
                        unfold tPrefix cut
                        exact IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cutCellPrefix
                          hinserted (by omega) htCell
                      have hfixedPrefixRaw :=
                        IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_prefix hinserted
                          (Nat.le_of_lt hcutLt)
                      have hfixedPrefix :
                          IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a c cut
                            inserted := by
                        rwa [hinsertedCut] at hfixedPrefixRaw
                      have hfixedSuffixRaw :=
                        IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_suffix hinserted
                          (Nat.le_of_lt hcutLt)
                      have hfixedSuffix :
                          IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition c b
                            ((n + 1) - cut)
                            (IntervalPartition.suffixPartition inserted cut) := by
                        rwa [hinsertedCut] at hfixedSuffixRaw
                      have htRect :=
                        rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect
                          (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hrect.left.left)
                          htGlobal ht.left
                      have hrightRect :=
                        rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect hc
                          (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hrect.left.left)
                          hc.right
                      have htPrefixLe :=
                        planePolygonalLength_le_planeCurveLengthOn
                          htRect htPrefix
                      have hsuffixLe :=
                        planePolygonalLength_le_planeCurveLengthOn
                          hrightRect hfixedSuffix
                      have hprefixCompare :=
                        planePolygonalLength_prefix_le_cutPrefix_add_planeDistance
                          x y inserted k t
                      have hprefixCompare' :
                          F.le
                            (planePolygonalLength x y inserted cut)
                            (F.add
                              (planePolygonalLength x y tPrefix cut)
                              (PlaneDistance
                                (x t) (y t) (x c) (y c))) := by
                        unfold cut tPrefix
                        rw [hinsertedCut] at hprefixCompare
                        exact hprefixCompare
                      have hprefixAdd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
                        htPrefixLe
                        (F.le_refl
                          (PlaneDistance (x t) (y t) (x c) (y c)))
                      have hprefixLe := F.le_trans hprefixCompare' hprefixAdd
                      have hinsertedSum :=
                        planePolygonalLength_adjacentPartition_eq_add
                          (x := x) (y := y) hfixedPrefix hfixedSuffix
                      rw [IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_suffix_eq_self]
                        at hinsertedSum
                      have hsplitCount :
                          cut + ((n + 1) - cut) = n + 1 :=
                        Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hcutLt)
                      rw [hsplitCount] at hinsertedSum
                      have hpartsLe := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
                        hprefixLe hsuffixLe
                      have hinsertedLe :
                          F.le (planePolygonalLength x y inserted (n + 1))
                            (F.add
                              (planeCurveLengthOn a t x y)
                              (F.add
                                (PlaneDistance (x t) (y t) (x c) (y c))
                                (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y))) := by
                        rw [hinsertedSum]
                        have h := hpartsLe
                        change
                          F.le
                            (F.add
                              (planePolygonalLength x y inserted cut)
                              (planePolygonalLength x y
                                (IntervalPartition.suffixPartition inserted cut)
                                ((n + 1) - cut)))
                            (F.add
                              (F.add
                                (planeCurveLengthOn a t x y)
                                (PlaneDistance (x t) (y t) (x c) (y c)))
                              (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y)) at h
                        rw [F.add_assoc] at h
                        exact h
                      have hnearBound :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                          hinsertedNear hinsertedLe
                      have hleftRect :=
                        rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect
                          (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hrect.left.left)
                          hc hc.left
                      have htLeft : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c t := ht
                      have hdecomp :
                          planeCurveLengthOn a b x y =
                            RealTheory.add
                              (planeCurveLengthOn a t x y)
                              (RealTheory.add
                                (planeCurveLengthOn t c x y)
                                (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y)) := by
                        calc
                          planeCurveLengthOn a b x y =
                              RealTheory.add
                                (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y)
                                (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y) :=
                            planeCurveLengthOn_additive hrect hc
                          _ = RealTheory.add
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (planeCurveLengthOn a t x y)
                                  (planeCurveLengthOn t c x y))
                                (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y) := by
                            rw [planeCurveLengthOn_additive hleftRect htLeft]
                          _ = RealTheory.add
                                (planeCurveLengthOn a t x y)
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (planeCurveLengthOn t c x y)
                                  (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y)) := by
                            exact F.add_assoc
                              (planeCurveLengthOn a t x y)
                              (planeCurveLengthOn t c x y)
                              (planeCurveLengthOn c b x y)
                      rw [hdecomp] at hnearBound
                      have htailEta :=
                        middle_lt_eta_add_of_sub_lt hnearBound
                      have hetaChord :
                          F.lt
                            (F.add eta
                              (PlaneDistance (x t) (y t) (x c) (y c)))
                            eps := by
                        have h :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hchord eta
                        change
                          F.lt
                            (F.add eta
                              (PlaneDistance (x t) (y t) (x c) (y c)))
                            (F.add eta eta) at h
                        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at h
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                        htailEta hetaChord

name: dist_add_tail_eq_tail
statement:
private theorem dist_add_tail_eq_tail
    {base tail : Point}
    (htail : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero tail) :
    dist (RealTheory.add base tail) base = tail
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  have hsub : F.sub (F.add base tail) base = tail := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    calc
      F.add (F.add base tail) (F.neg base) =
          F.add base (F.add tail (F.neg base)) :=
        F.add_assoc base tail (F.neg base)
      _ = F.add base (F.add (F.neg base) tail) := by
        rw [F.add_comm tail (F.neg base)]
      _ = F.add (F.add base (F.neg base)) tail := by
        rw [F.add_assoc base (F.neg base) tail]
      _ = F.add F.zero tail := by
        rw [F.add_neg]
      _ = tail := F.zero_add tail
  change F.abs (F.sub (F.add base tail) base) = tail
  rw [hsub]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F htail

name: continuousOn_planeCurveLengthOn_from
statement:
theorem continuousOn_planeCurveLengthOn_from
    {a b : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y) :
    ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (fun t : Point => planeCurveLengthOn a t x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro c hc
  refine And.intro hc ?_
  intro eps heps
  cases planeCurveLengthOn_left_small hrect hc heps with
  | intro deltaLeft hdeltaLeft =>
      cases planeCurveLengthOn_right_small hrect hc heps with
      | intro deltaRight hdeltaRight =>
          let delta := F.min2 deltaLeft deltaRight
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
              hdeltaLeft.left hdeltaRight.left) ?_
          intro t ht _htne htdist
          have hdeltaLeLeft : F.le delta deltaLeft :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaLeft deltaRight
          have hdeltaLeRight : F.le delta deltaRight :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaLeft deltaRight
          cases F.le_total c t with
          | inl hct =>
              have htRight : RealTheory.ClosedInterval c b t :=
                And.intro hct ht.right
              have htail := hdeltaRight.right t htRight
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htdist
                  hdeltaLeRight)
              have htRect := rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect
                hc ht hct
              have htailNonneg := planeCurveLengthOn_nonneg htRect
              have hleftToT := rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect
                (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hrect.left.left)
                ht ht.left
              have hcInLeftToT : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a t c :=
                And.intro hc.left hct
              have hsum := planeCurveLengthOn_additive
                hleftToT hcInLeftToT
              have hdistEq :
                  dist
                      (planeCurveLengthOn a t x y)
                      (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y) =
                    planeCurveLengthOn c t x y := by
                rw [hsum]
                exact dist_add_tail_eq_tail htailNonneg
              rw [hdistEq]
              exact htail
          | inr htc =>
              have htLeft : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c t :=
                And.intro ht.left htc
              have htail := hdeltaLeft.right t htLeft
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htdist
                  hdeltaLeLeft)
              have htRect := rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect
                ht hc htc
              have htailNonneg := planeCurveLengthOn_nonneg htRect
              have hleftRect := rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect
                (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hrect.left.left)
                hc hc.left
              have hsum := planeCurveLengthOn_additive hleftRect htLeft
              have hdistEq :
                  dist
                      (planeCurveLengthOn a t x y)
                      (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y) =
                    planeCurveLengthOn t c x y := by
                calc
                  dist
                      (planeCurveLengthOn a t x y)
                      (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y) =
                      dist
                        (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y)
                        (planeCurveLengthOn a t x y) :=
                    dist_comm
                      (planeCurveLengthOn a t x y)
                      (planeCurveLengthOn a c x y)
                  _ = planeCurveLengthOn t c x y := by
                    rw [hsum]
                    exact dist_add_tail_eq_tail htailNonneg
              rw [hdistEq]
              exact htail

name: mapIntervalPartition_strictMonotone
statement:
theorem mapIntervalPartition_strictMonotone
    {c d a b : Point} {phi : Map}
    {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hleft : phi c = a)
    (hright : phi d = b)
    (hstrict :
      StrictMonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hp : IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition c d n p) :
    IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b n
      (IntervalPartition.imagePartitionIncreasing phi p)
proof:
:=
  IntervalPartition.imagePartitionIncreasing_intervalPartition_of_strictMonotoneOn
    hleft hright hstrict hp

name: exists_liftIntervalPartition_strictMonotone_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_liftIntervalPartition_strictMonotone_surjective
    {c d a b : Point} {phi : Map}
    {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d)
    (hleft : phi c = a)
    (hright : phi d = b)
    (hstrict :
      StrictMonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hsurj :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z ->
          Image (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi z)
    (hp : IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    Exists
      (fun q : Nat -> Point =>
        And (IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition c d n q)
          (forall k : Nat, k <= n -> phi (q k) = p k))
proof:
:= by
  let q :=
    IntervalPartition.preimagePartitionIncreasing phi c d p
  have himage :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        Image (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi (p k) := by
    intro k hk
    exact hsurj (p k)
      (IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval hp hk)
  refine Exists.intro q ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact
      IntervalPartition.preimagePartitionIncreasing_intervalPartition_of_image
        hcd hleft hright hstrict hp himage
  · intro k hk
    exact IntervalPartition.preimagePartitionIncreasing_value (himage k hk)

name: planePolygonalLength_comp_imagePartitionIncreasing
statement:
private theorem planePolygonalLength_comp_imagePartitionIncreasing
    (x y phi : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    planePolygonalLength
        (fun t : Point => x (phi t))
        (fun t : Point => y (phi t)) p n =
      planePolygonalLength x y
        (IntervalPartition.imagePartitionIncreasing phi p) n
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: planePolygonalLength_comp_eq_of_node_values
statement:
private theorem planePolygonalLength_comp_eq_of_node_values
    {x y phi : Map} {p q : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hnodes : forall k : Nat, k <= n -> phi (q k) = p k) :
    planePolygonalLength
        (fun t : Point => x (phi t))
        (fun t : Point => y (phi t)) q n =
      planePolygonalLength x y p n
proof:
:= by
  unfold planePolygonalLength
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt n
  intro k hk
  unfold planePolygonalLengthTerm
  change
    PlaneDistance
        (x (phi (q k))) (y (phi (q k)))
        (x (phi (q (k + 1)))) (y (phi (q (k + 1)))) =
      PlaneDistance
        (x (p k)) (y (p k))
        (x (p (k + 1))) (y (p (k + 1)))
  rw [hnodes k (Nat.le_of_lt hk)]
  rw [hnodes (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)]

name: mapsInto_closedInterval_of_strictMonotone_endpoints
statement:
private theorem mapsInto_closedInterval_of_strictMonotone_endpoints
    {c d a b : Point} {phi : Map}
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d)
    (hleft : phi c = a)
    (hright : phi d = b)
    (hstrict :
      StrictMonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi) :
    MapsInto (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d)
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) phi
proof:
:= by
  have hmono := strictMonotoneOn_monotoneOn hstrict
  intro t ht
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · rw [<- hleft]
    exact hmono c t
      (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hcd) ht ht.left
  · rw [<- hright]
    exact hmono t d ht
      (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hcd) ht.right

name: rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_comp_strictMonotone
statement:
private theorem rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_comp_strictMonotone
    {c d a b : Point} {x y phi : Map}
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d)
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hstrict :
      StrictMonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hleft : phi c = a)
    (hright : phi d = b) :
    RectifiablePlaneCurveOn c d
      (fun t : Point => x (phi t))
      (fun t : Point => y (phi t))
proof:
:= by
  have hmaps :=
    mapsInto_closedInterval_of_strictMonotone_endpoints
      hcd hleft hright hstrict
  have hxcont :
      ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d)
        (fun t : Point => x (phi t)) := by
    exact continuousOn_comp hcont hrect.left.right.left hmaps
  have hycont :
      ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d)
        (fun t : Point => y (phi t)) := by
    exact continuousOn_comp hcont hrect.left.right.right hmaps
  refine And.intro (And.intro hcd (And.intro hxcont hycont)) ?_
  refine Exists.intro (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y) ?_
  intro n p hp
  have himage := mapIntervalPartition_strictMonotone
    hleft hright hstrict hp
  have hle := planePolygonalLength_le_planeCurveLengthOn hrect himage
  rwa [planePolygonalLength_comp_imagePartitionIncreasing]

name: planeCurveLengthOn_comp_strictMonotone
statement:
theorem planeCurveLengthOn_comp_strictMonotone
    {c d a b : Point} {x y phi : Map}
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d)
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hstrict :
      StrictMonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hleft : phi c = a)
    (hright : phi d = b) :
    planeCurveLengthOn c d
        (fun t : Point => x (phi t))
        (fun t : Point => y (phi t)) =
      planeCurveLengthOn a b x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let xcomp : Map := fun t : Point => x (phi t)
  let ycomp : Map := fun t : Point => y (phi t)
  have hsurj :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z ->
          Image (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi z := by
    intro z hz
    exact IntervalPartition.closedInterval_image_of_endpoint_values
      hcd hleft hright hcont hz
  have hreparam : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn c d xcomp ycomp := by
    exact rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_comp_strictMonotone
      hcd hrect hcont hstrict hleft hright
  have hreparamSpec := planeCurveLengthOn_spec_of_rectifiable hreparam
  have horiginalSpec := planeCurveLengthOn_spec_of_rectifiable hrect
  have hforward :
      F.le (planeCurveLengthOn c d xcomp ycomp)
        (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y) := by
    apply hreparamSpec.right
    intro value hvalue
    cases hvalue with
    | inl hzero =>
        rw [hzero.right]
        exact planeCurveLengthOn_nonneg hrect
    | inr hpart =>
        cases hpart with
        | intro n hn =>
            cases hn with
            | intro p hp =>
                rw [hp.right.right]
                have himage := mapIntervalPartition_strictMonotone
                  hleft hright hstrict hp.right.left
                have hle :=
                  planePolygonalLength_le_planeCurveLengthOn hrect himage
                change
                  F.le
                    (planePolygonalLength
                      (fun t : Point => x (phi t))
                      (fun t : Point => y (phi t)) p n)
                    (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y)
                rwa [planePolygonalLength_comp_imagePartitionIncreasing]
  have hbackward :
      F.le (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y)
        (planeCurveLengthOn c d xcomp ycomp) := by
    apply horiginalSpec.right
    intro value hvalue
    cases hvalue with
    | inl hzero =>
        rw [hzero.right]
        exact planeCurveLengthOn_nonneg hreparam
    | inr hpart =>
        cases hpart with
        | intro n hn =>
            cases hn with
            | intro p hp =>
                cases exists_liftIntervalPartition_strictMonotone_surjective
                    hcd hleft hright hstrict hsurj hp.right.left with
                | intro q hq =>
                    have hle :=
                      planePolygonalLength_le_planeCurveLengthOn hreparam
                        hq.left
                    have heq :=
                      planePolygonalLength_comp_eq_of_node_values
                        (x := x) (y := y) (phi := phi)
                        (p := p) (q := q) (n := n) hq.right
                    rw [hp.right.right]
                    rw [<- heq]
                    exact hle
  exact F.le_antisymm hforward hbackward

name: weightedValueSum_log_power_eq_mul
statement:
theorem weightedValueSum_log_power_eq_mul
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {r : Point} {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n -> PositiveDomain (x k)) :
    WeightedValueSum
        I.logSpec.log
        (fun k : Nat =>
          I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r (x k)) w n =
      RealTheory.mul r (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold WeightedValueSum
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          F.mul (w k)
            (I.logSpec.log
              (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r (x k)))) n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.mul r (F.mul (w k) (I.logSpec.log (x k)))) n := by
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
          intro k hk
          have hxk : PositiveDomain (x k) := hx k hk
          change
            F.mul (w k)
                (I.logSpec.log
                  (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r (x k))) =
              F.mul r (F.mul (w k) (I.logSpec.log (x k)))
          rw [I.power_exp_log r (x k) hxk]
          rw [I.log_exp
            (RealTheory.mul r (I.logSpec.log (x k)))]
          calc
            F.mul (w k) (F.mul r (I.logSpec.log (x k))) =
                F.mul (F.mul (w k) r) (I.logSpec.log (x k)) := by
                  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
            _ = F.mul (F.mul r (w k)) (I.logSpec.log (x k)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm (w k) r]
            _ = F.mul r (F.mul (w k) (I.logSpec.log (x k))) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul r
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.mul (w k) (I.logSpec.log (x k))) n) := by
          exact RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left r
            (fun k : Nat =>
              F.mul (w k) (I.logSpec.log (x k))) n

name: weightedValueSum_power_power_eq_weightedPowerSum
statement:
theorem weightedValueSum_power_power_eq_weightedPowerSum
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {alpha r s : Point} {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hars : RealTheory.mul alpha r = s) :
    WeightedValueSum
        (fun y : Point =>
          I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha y)
        (fun k : Nat =>
          I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r (x k)) w n =
      I.weightedPowerSum s x w n
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold WeightedValueSum weightedPowerSum WeightedPointSum
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
  intro k hk
  change
    F.mul (w k)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r (x k))) =
      F.mul (w k)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power s (x k))
  rw [I.power_power (hx k hk)]
  rw [hars]

name: ratio_exponent_gt_one_of_pos_lt
statement:
theorem ratio_exponent_gt_one_of_pos_lt
    {r s : Point}
    (hr : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero r)
    (hrs : RealTheory.lt r s) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hr_ne : Not (r = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hr hzero.symm
  have hinv_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv r) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hr
  have hmul :=
    RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hrs hinv_pos
  change
    F.lt (F.mul r (F.inv r)) (F.mul s (F.inv r)) at hmul
  rwa [F.mul_inv_cancel hr_ne] at hmul

name: neg_pos_of_lt_zero
statement:
theorem neg_pos_of_lt_zero
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.zero) :
    PositiveDomain (RealTheory.neg x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hx
  change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg x) at h
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h

name: inv_le_zero_of_neg
statement:
theorem inv_le_zero_of_neg
    {x : Point}

      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx

name: ratio_exponent_pos_of_neg_neg
statement:
theorem ratio_exponent_pos_of_neg_neg
    {r s : Point}
    (hr : RealTheory.lt r RealTheory.zero)
    (hs : RealTheory.lt s RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hr_ne : Not (r = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hr
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero hr
  have hneg_s_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.neg s) :=
    neg_pos_of_lt_zero hs
  have hneg_r_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.neg r) :=
    neg_pos_of_lt_zero hr
  have hinv_neg_r_pos :
      PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg r)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hneg_r_pos
  have hprod :
      F.lt F.zero
        (F.mul (F.neg s) (F.inv (F.neg r))) :=
    F.mul_pos hneg_s_pos hinv_neg_r_pos
  have heq :
      F.mul (F.neg s) (F.inv (F.neg r)) =
        F.mul s (F.inv r) := by
    have hinv_neg :
        RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg r) =
          RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.inv r) := by
      simpa [F] using
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_neg_of_ne_zero F hr_ne)
    change
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg s)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg r)) =
        RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r)
    rw [hinv_neg]
    rw [RealTheory.neg_mul_neg s (RealTheory.inv r)]
  rwa [heq] at hprod

name: ratio_exponent_lt_one_of_neg_lt_neg
statement:
theorem ratio_exponent_lt_one_of_neg_lt_neg
    {r s : Point}
    (hr : RealTheory.lt r RealTheory.zero)
    (_hs : RealTheory.lt s RealTheory.zero)
    (hrs : RealTheory.lt r s) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hr_ne : Not (r = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hr
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero hr
  have hneg_r_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.neg r) :=
    neg_pos_of_lt_zero hr
  have hneg_s_lt_neg_r :
      F.lt (F.neg s) (F.neg r) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hrs
  have hinv_neg_r_pos :
      PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg r)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hneg_r_pos
  have hmul :=
    RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hneg_s_lt_neg_r hinv_neg_r_pos
  have hneg_r_ne : Not (RealTheory.neg r = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hneg_r_pos hzero.symm
  change
    F.lt
      (F.mul (F.neg s) (F.inv (F.neg r)))
      (F.mul (F.neg r) (F.inv (F.neg r))) at hmul
  have hneg_r_neF : Not (F.neg r = F.zero) := by
    change Not (RealTheory.neg r = RealTheory.zero)
    exact hneg_r_ne
  have hcancel :
      F.mul (F.neg r) (F.inv (F.neg r)) = F.one :=
    F.mul_inv_cancel hneg_r_neF
  rw [hcancel] at hmul
  have heq :
      F.mul (F.neg s) (F.inv (F.neg r)) =
        F.mul s (F.inv r) := by
    have hinv_neg :
        RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg r) =
          RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.inv r) := by
      simpa [F] using
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_neg_of_ne_zero F hr_ne)
    change
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg s)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg r)) =
        RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r)
    rw [hinv_neg]
    rw [RealTheory.neg_mul_neg s (RealTheory.inv r)]
  rwa [heq] at hmul

name: weightedPowerMean_pos
statement:
theorem weightedPowerMean_pos
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {r : Point} {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hw : ConvexWeights w (n + 1)) :
    PositiveDomain (I.weightedPowerMean r x w (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : r = RealTheory.zero
  case pos =>
    rw [hr, I.weightedPowerMean_zero]
    exact I.weightedGeometricMeanExp_pos x w (n + 1)
  case neg =>
    rw [I.weightedPowerMean_of_ne_zero x w (n + 1) hr]
    exact I.power_positive (RealTheory.inv r)
      (I.weightedPowerSum_pos n hx hw)

name: finiteSum_pos_succ_of_pos_terms
statement:
theorem finiteSum_pos_succ_of_pos_terms
    {term : Nat -> Point} :
    forall n : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (term k)) ->
        PositiveDomain (RealTheory.finiteSum term (n + 1))
  | 0, hpos => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
      exact hpos 0 (Nat.lt_succ_self 0)
  | n + 1, hpos => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      have hprefix :
          PositiveDomain (RealTheory.finiteSum term (n + 1)) :=
        finiteSum_pos_succ_of_pos_terms n
          (fun k hk =>
            hpos k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1))))
      have hlast : PositiveDomain (term (n + 1)) :=
        hpos (n + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1))
      have hsum :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hprefix hlast
      change
        F.lt (F.add F.zero F.zero)
          (F.add (RealTheory.finiteSum term (n + 1))
            (term (n + 1))) at hsum
      rwa [F.zero_add] at hsum

name: finitePowerSum_pos
statement:
theorem finitePowerSum_pos

    {r : Point} {x : Nat -> Point}

    PositiveDomain (I.finitePowerSum r x (n + 1))
proof:

  exact finiteSum_pos_succ_of_pos_terms n
    (fun k hk => I.power_positive r (hx k hk))

name: finiteProductSum_pos
