name: young
statement:
theorem young
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {theta a b : Point}
    (htheta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero theta)
    (htheta_lt_one : RealTheory.lt theta RealTheory.one)
    (ha : PositiveDomain a)
    (hb : PositiveDomain b) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul a b)
      (ConvexCombo theta
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta)) a)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.inv theta) b))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let leftBase :=
    I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta)) a
  let rightBase :=
    I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power (RealTheory.inv theta) b
  have htheta_weight : ConvexWeight theta :=
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F htheta_pos)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F htheta_lt_one)
  have hsub_pos :
      PositiveDomain (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F htheta_lt_one
  have hleft_pos : PositiveDomain leftBase := by
    unfold leftBase
    exact I.power_positive
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta)) ha
  have hright_pos : PositiveDomain rightBase := by
    unfold rightBase
    exact I.power_positive (RealTheory.inv theta) hb
  have hamgm :=
    I.binaryWeightedAMGM htheta_weight hleft_pos hright_pos
  have hleft_cancel :
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) leftBase =
        a := by
    unfold leftBase
    exact I.power_mul_inv_cancel hsub_pos ha
  have hright_cancel :
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power theta rightBase = b := by
    unfold rightBase
    exact I.power_mul_inv_cancel htheta_pos hb
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) leftBase)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power theta rightBase))
      (ConvexCombo theta leftBase rightBase) at hamgm
  rw [hleft_cancel, hright_cancel] at hamgm
  exact hamgm

name: holder_normalized_positive
statement:
theorem holder_normalized_positive
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {theta : Point} {u v : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (htheta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero theta)
    (htheta_lt_one : RealTheory.lt theta RealTheory.one)
    (hu : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (u k))
    (hv : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (v k))
    (hu_sum :
      I.finitePowerSum
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta))
        u (n + 1) = RealTheory.one)
    (hv_sum :
      I.finitePowerSum (RealTheory.inv theta) v (n + 1) =
        RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.le
      (finiteProductSum u v (n + 1))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta)
  let q := RealTheory.inv theta
  have hpoint :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul (u k) (v k))
          (ConvexCombo theta
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (u k))
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power q (v k))) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold p q
    exact I.young htheta_pos htheta_lt_one (hu k hk) (hv k hk)
  have hsum :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (u k) (v k))
      (fun k : Nat =>
        ConvexCombo theta
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (u k))
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power q (v k)))
      (n + 1) hpoint
  change
    F.le (finiteProductSum u v (n + 1))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          ConvexCombo theta
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (u k))
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power q (v k)))
        (n + 1)) at hsum
  have hright :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          ConvexCombo theta
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (u k))
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power q (v k)))
        (n + 1) = RealTheory.one := by
    have hu_sum_expanded :
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
              (F.inv (F.sub F.one theta)) (u k))
          (n + 1) = F.one := by
      change
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta))
              (u k))
          (n + 1) = RealTheory.one
      exact hu_sum
    have hv_sum_expanded :
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power (F.inv theta) (v k))
          (n + 1) = F.one := by
      change
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power (RealTheory.inv theta) (v k))
          (n + 1) = RealTheory.one
      exact hv_sum
    unfold p q
    unfold ConvexCombo
    calc
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.add
              (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta)
                (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                  (F.inv (F.sub F.one theta)) (u k)))
              (F.mul theta
                (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                  (F.inv theta) (v k))))
          (n + 1) =
          F.add
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                F.mul (F.sub F.one theta)
                  (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                    (F.inv (F.sub F.one theta)) (u k)))
              (n + 1))
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                F.mul theta
                  (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                    (F.inv theta) (v k)))
              (n + 1)) := by
            change
              RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat =>
                  RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.mul (F.sub F.one theta)
                      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                        (F.inv (F.sub F.one theta)) (u k)))
                    (RealTheory.mul theta
                      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                        (F.inv theta) (v k))))
                (n + 1) =
              RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.finiteSum
                  (fun k : Nat =>
                    RealTheory.mul (F.sub F.one theta)
                      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                        (F.inv (F.sub F.one theta)) (u k)))
                  (n + 1))
                (RealTheory.finiteSum
                  (fun k : Nat =>
                    RealTheory.mul theta
                      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                        (F.inv theta) (v k)))
                  (n + 1))
            exact RealTheory.finiteSum_add
              (fun k : Nat =>
                RealTheory.mul (F.sub F.one theta)
                  (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                    (F.inv (F.sub F.one theta)) (u k)))
              (fun k : Nat =>
                RealTheory.mul theta
                  (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                    (F.inv theta) (v k)))
              (n + 1)
      _ =
          F.add
            (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta)
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat =>
                  I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                    (F.inv (F.sub F.one theta)) (u k))
                (n + 1)))
            (F.mul theta
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat =>
                  I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                    (F.inv theta) (v k))
                (n + 1))) := by
            change
              RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.finiteSum
                  (fun k : Nat =>
                    RealTheory.mul (F.sub F.one theta)
                      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                        (F.inv (F.sub F.one theta)) (u k)))
                  (n + 1))
                (RealTheory.finiteSum
                  (fun k : Nat =>
                    RealTheory.mul theta
                      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                        (F.inv theta) (v k)))
                  (n + 1)) =
              RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.mul (F.sub F.one theta)
                  (RealTheory.finiteSum
                    (fun k : Nat =>
                      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                        (F.inv (F.sub F.one theta)) (u k))
                    (n + 1)))
                (RealTheory.mul theta
                  (RealTheory.finiteSum
                    (fun k : Nat =>
                      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                        (F.inv theta) (v k))
                    (n + 1)))
            rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left]
            rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left]
      _ =
          F.add
            (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) F.one)
            (F.mul theta F.one) := by
            rw [hu_sum_expanded, hv_sum_expanded]
      _ = F.add (F.sub F.one theta) theta := by
            rw [F.mul_one, F.mul_one]
      _ = F.one := by
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F F.one theta
  rw [hright] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: finitePowerSum_normalized_to_one
statement:
theorem finitePowerSum_normalized_to_one
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {alpha : Point} {x : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (halpha : PositiveDomain alpha)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k)) :
    I.finitePowerSum (RealTheory.inv alpha)
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (x k)
          (RealTheory.inv
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha
              (I.finitePowerSum (RealTheory.inv alpha) x (n + 1)))))
      (n + 1) = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := RealTheory.inv alpha
  let S := I.finitePowerSum p x (n + 1)
  let A := I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha S
  have hS_pos : PositiveDomain S := by
    unfold S p
    exact I.finitePowerSum_pos n hx
  have hA_pos : PositiveDomain A := by
    unfold A
    exact I.power_positive alpha hS_pos
  have hS_ne : Not (S = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hS_pos hzero.symm
  have hinvA_pos : PositiveDomain (F.inv A) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hA_pos
  have hA_cancel : I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p A = S := by
    unfold A p
    exact I.power_mul_inv_cancel_right halpha hS_pos
  have hterm :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 ->
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (F.mul (x k) (F.inv A)) =
          F.mul (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (x k))
            (F.inv S) := by
    intro k hk
    have hmul :
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p
            (F.mul (x k) (F.inv A)) =
          F.mul
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (x k))
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (F.inv A)) := by
      change
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p
            (RealTheory.mul (x k) (RealTheory.inv A)) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (x k))
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p
              (RealTheory.inv A))
      exact I.power_mul_base (hx k hk) hinvA_pos
    rw [hmul]
    have hinv_base :
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (F.inv A) =
          F.inv (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p A) := by
      change
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (RealTheory.inv A) =
          RealTheory.inv (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p A)
      exact I.power_inv_base hA_pos
    rw [hinv_base, hA_cancel]
  have hsum :
      I.finitePowerSum p
        (fun k : Nat => F.mul (x k) (F.inv A)) (n + 1) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.mul (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (x k))
              (F.inv S))
          (n + 1) := by
    unfold finitePowerSum
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt (n + 1) hterm
  change
    I.finitePowerSum p
      (fun k : Nat => F.mul (x k) (F.inv A)) (n + 1) =
      F.one
  rw [hsum]
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (x k))
          (RealTheory.inv S))
      (n + 1) = F.one
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_right]
  change F.mul S (F.inv S) = F.one
  exact F.mul_inv_cancel hS_ne

name: finiteProductSum_normalized_right
statement:
theorem finiteProductSum_normalized_right
    {x y : Nat -> Point} {A B : Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hA : PositiveDomain A)
    (hB : PositiveDomain B) :
    finiteProductSum
      (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (x k) (RealTheory.inv A))
      (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (y k) (RealTheory.inv B))
      (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.mul (finiteProductSum x y (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul A B))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hA_ne : Not (A = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hA hzero.symm
  have hB_ne : Not (B = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hB hzero.symm
  have hpoint :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 ->
        F.mul (F.mul (x k) (F.inv A))
            (F.mul (y k) (F.inv B)) =
          F.mul (F.mul (x k) (y k))
            (F.inv (F.mul A B)) := by
    intro k _hk
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul (x k) (F.inv A))
          (F.mul (y k) (F.inv B)) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.mul (x k) (F.inv A)) (y k))
            (F.inv B) := by
            exact Eq.symm
              (F.mul_assoc
                (F.mul (x k) (F.inv A)) (y k) (F.inv B))
      _ =
          F.mul (F.mul (x k) (F.mul (F.inv A) (y k)))
            (F.inv B) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc (x k) (F.inv A) (y k)]
      _ =
          F.mul (F.mul (x k) (F.mul (y k) (F.inv A)))
            (F.inv B) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv A) (y k)]
      _ =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.mul (x k) (y k)) (F.inv A))
            (F.inv B) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc (x k) (y k) (F.inv A)]
      _ =
          F.mul (F.mul (x k) (y k))
            (F.mul (F.inv A) (F.inv B)) := by
            exact F.mul_assoc
              (F.mul (x k) (y k)) (F.inv A) (F.inv B)
      _ =
          F.mul (F.mul (x k) (y k))
            (F.inv (F.mul A B)) := by
            have hinv_mul := RealTheory.inv_mul hA_ne hB_ne
            change F.inv (F.mul A B) =
              F.mul (F.inv A) (F.inv B) at hinv_mul
            rw [<- hinv_mul]
  have hsum :
      finiteProductSum
        (fun k : Nat => F.mul (x k) (F.inv A))
        (fun k : Nat => F.mul (y k) (F.inv B))
        (n + 1) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.mul (F.mul (x k) (y k))
              (F.inv (F.mul A B)))
          (n + 1) := by
    unfold finiteProductSum
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt (n + 1) hpoint
  change
    finiteProductSum
      (fun k : Nat => F.mul (x k) (F.inv A))
      (fun k : Nat => F.mul (y k) (F.inv B))
      (n + 1) =
      F.mul (finiteProductSum x y (n + 1))
        (F.inv (F.mul A B))
  rw [hsum]
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul (x k) (y k))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul A B)))
      (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (finiteProductSum x y (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul A B))
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_right]
  rfl

name: finiteProductSum_add_left
statement:
theorem finiteProductSum_add_left
    (x y w : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteProductSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.add (x k) (y k)) w n =
        RealTheory.add (finiteProductSum x w n)
          (finiteProductSum y w n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold finiteProductSum
  have hpoint :
      forall k : Nat,
        F.mul (F.add (x k) (y k)) (w k) =
          F.add (F.mul (x k) (w k)) (F.mul (y k) (w k)) := by
    intro k
    exact F.add_mul (x k) (y k) (w k)
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat => F.mul (F.add (x k) (y k)) (w k)) n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.add (F.mul (x k) (w k)) (F.mul (y k) (w k))) n := by
          exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr hpoint n
    _ =
        F.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => F.mul (x k) (w k)) n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => F.mul (y k) (w k)) n) := by
          change
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.mul (x k) (w k))
                  (RealTheory.mul (y k) (w k))) n =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (x k) (w k)) n)
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (y k) (w k)) n)
          exact RealTheory.finiteSum_add
            (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (x k) (w k))
            (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (y k) (w k)) n

name: finitePowerSum_eq_product_power_sub_one
statement:
theorem finitePowerSum_eq_product_power_sub_one
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {p : Point} {z : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hz : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (z k)) :
    I.finitePowerSum p z (n + 1) =
      finiteProductSum z
        (fun k : Nat =>
          I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (RealTheory.sub p RealTheory.one) (z k))
        (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpoint :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 ->
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (z k) =
          F.mul (z k)
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
              (F.sub p F.one) (z k)) := by
    intro k hk
    have hcoeff : F.add F.one (F.sub p F.one) = p := by
      calc
        F.add F.one (F.sub p F.one) =
            F.add (F.sub p F.one) F.one := by
              rw [F.add_comm]
        _ = p := by
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F p F.one
    have hpow :=
      I.power_add_exponent
        (mu := F.one) (nu := F.sub p F.one) (hz k hk)
    change
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (F.add F.one (F.sub p F.one)) (z k) =
        F.mul
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power F.one (z k))
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.sub p F.one) (z k)) at hpow
    have hone_exp :
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power F.one (z k) = z k := by
      change
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power RealTheory.one (z k) =
          z k
      exact I.power_one_exponent (hz k hk)
    rw [hcoeff, hone_exp] at hpow
    exact hpow
  unfold finitePowerSum finiteProductSum
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt (n + 1) hpoint

name: finitePowerSum_power_power_eq
statement:
theorem finitePowerSum_power_power_eq
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {alpha beta gamma : Point} {z : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hz : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (z k))
    (hcoeff : RealTheory.mul alpha beta = gamma) :
    I.finitePowerSum alpha
        (fun k : Nat =>
          I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power beta (z k))
        (n + 1) =
      I.finitePowerSum gamma z (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold finitePowerSum
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
  intro k hk
  rw [I.power_power (hz k hk)]
  rw [hcoeff]

name: holder_conjugate_decrement_mul
statement:
theorem holder_conjugate_decrement_mul
    {theta : Point}
    (htheta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero theta)
    (htheta_lt_one : RealTheory.lt theta RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv theta)
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta))
          RealTheory.one) =
      RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let alpha := F.sub F.one theta
  have halpha_pos : PositiveDomain alpha := by
    unfold alpha
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F htheta_lt_one
  have halpha_ne : Not (alpha = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F halpha_pos hzero.symm
  have htheta_ne : Not (theta = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F htheta_pos hzero.symm
  have htheta_eq : F.sub F.one alpha = theta := by
    unfold alpha
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F F.one theta
  have hdecrement :
      F.sub (F.inv alpha) F.one =
        F.mul theta (F.inv alpha) := by
    calc
      F.sub (F.inv alpha) F.one =
          F.sub (F.mul F.one (F.inv alpha))
            (F.mul alpha (F.inv alpha)) := by
            rw [F.one_mul, F.mul_inv_cancel halpha_ne]
      _ = F.mul (F.sub F.one alpha) (F.inv alpha) := by
            exact Eq.symm
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
                F F.one alpha (F.inv alpha))
      _ = F.mul theta (F.inv alpha) := by
            rw [htheta_eq]
  change
    F.mul (F.inv theta) (F.sub (F.inv alpha) F.one) =
      F.inv alpha
  rw [hdecrement]
  calc
    F.mul (F.inv theta) (F.mul theta (F.inv alpha)) =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.inv theta) theta) (F.inv alpha) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul F.one (F.inv alpha) := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel htheta_ne]
    _ = F.inv alpha := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: power_mul_inv_complement
statement:
theorem power_mul_inv_complement
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {alpha theta S : Point}
    (hadd : RealTheory.add alpha theta = RealTheory.one)
    (hS : PositiveDomain S) :
    RealTheory.mul S
        (RealTheory.inv
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power theta S)) =
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha S
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha S
  let B := I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power theta S
  have hB_pos : PositiveDomain B := by
    unfold B
    exact I.power_positive theta hS
  have hB_ne : Not (B = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hB_pos hzero.symm
  have hmul : F.mul A B = S := by
    have h :=
      I.power_add_exponent (mu := alpha) (nu := theta) hS
    change
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (F.add alpha theta) S =
        F.mul A B at h
    have haddF : F.add alpha theta = F.one := by
      change RealTheory.add alpha theta = RealTheory.one
      exact hadd
    have hone_exp :
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power F.one S = S := by
      change
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power RealTheory.one S = S
      exact I.power_one_exponent hS
    rw [haddF, hone_exp] at h
    exact h.symm
  change F.mul S (F.inv B) = A
  rw [<- hmul]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right F A hB_ne

name: holder_positive
statement:
theorem holder_positive
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {theta : Point} {x y : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (htheta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero theta)
    (htheta_lt_one : RealTheory.lt theta RealTheory.one)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hy : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (y k)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (finiteProductSum x y (n + 1))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta)
          (I.finitePowerSum
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta))
            x (n + 1)))
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power theta
          (I.finitePowerSum (RealTheory.inv theta) y (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let alpha := RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta
  let p := RealTheory.inv alpha
  let q := RealTheory.inv theta
  let Sx := I.finitePowerSum p x (n + 1)
  let Sy := I.finitePowerSum q y (n + 1)
  let A := I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha Sx
  let B := I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power theta Sy
  let u : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat => F.mul (x k) (F.inv A)
  let v : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat => F.mul (y k) (F.inv B)
  have halpha_pos : PositiveDomain alpha := by
    unfold alpha
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F htheta_lt_one
  have hSx_pos : PositiveDomain Sx := by
    unfold Sx p
    exact I.finitePowerSum_pos n hx
  have hSy_pos : PositiveDomain Sy := by
    unfold Sy q
    exact I.finitePowerSum_pos n hy
  have hA_pos : PositiveDomain A := by
    unfold A
    exact I.power_positive alpha hSx_pos
  have hB_pos : PositiveDomain B := by
    unfold B
    exact I.power_positive theta hSy_pos
  have hAB_pos : PositiveDomain (F.mul A B) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hA_pos hB_pos
  have hAB_ne : Not (F.mul A B = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hAB_pos hzero.symm
  have hu :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (u k) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold u
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos (hx k hk)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hA_pos)
  have hv :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (v k) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold v
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos (hy k hk)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hB_pos)
  have hu_sum :
      I.finitePowerSum p u (n + 1) = F.one := by
    unfold u A Sx p alpha
    exact I.finitePowerSum_normalized_to_one n halpha_pos hx
  have hv_sum :
      I.finitePowerSum q v (n + 1) = F.one := by
    unfold v B Sy q
    exact I.finitePowerSum_normalized_to_one n htheta_pos hy
  have hnorm :=
    I.holder_normalized_positive n htheta_pos htheta_lt_one
      hu hv hu_sum hv_sum
  change F.le (finiteProductSum u v (n + 1)) F.one at hnorm
  have hscaled :
      finiteProductSum u v (n + 1) =
        F.mul (finiteProductSum x y (n + 1))
          (F.inv (F.mul A B)) := by
    unfold u v
    exact finiteProductSum_normalized_right n hA_pos hB_pos
  rw [hscaled] at hnorm
  have hmul :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hnorm
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hAB_pos)
  change
    F.le
      (F.mul
        (F.mul (finiteProductSum x y (n + 1))
          (F.inv (F.mul A B)))
        (F.mul A B))
      (F.mul F.one (F.mul A B)) at hmul
  have hleft :
      F.mul
        (F.mul (finiteProductSum x y (n + 1))
          (F.inv (F.mul A B)))
        (F.mul A B) =
        finiteProductSum x y (n + 1) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
      F (finiteProductSum x y (n + 1)) hAB_ne
  rw [hleft, F.one_mul] at hmul
  change
    F.le (finiteProductSum x y (n + 1))
      (F.mul A B) at hmul
  exact hmul

name: minkowski_positive
statement:
theorem minkowski_positive
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {theta : Point} {x y : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (htheta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero theta)
    (htheta_lt_one : RealTheory.lt theta RealTheory.one)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hy : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (y k)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta)
        (I.finitePowerSum
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta))
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.add (x k) (y k))
          (n + 1)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta)
          (I.finitePowerSum
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta))
            x (n + 1)))
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta)
          (I.finitePowerSum
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta))
            y (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let pow := I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
  let alpha := RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta
  let p := RealTheory.inv alpha
  let q := RealTheory.inv theta
  let z : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat => RealTheory.add (x k) (y k)
  let w : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat => pow (RealTheory.sub p RealTheory.one) (z k)
  let S := I.finitePowerSum p z (n + 1)
  let Sx := I.finitePowerSum p x (n + 1)
  let Sy := I.finitePowerSum p y (n + 1)
  let Nx := pow alpha Sx
  let Ny := pow alpha Sy
  let Sθ := pow theta S
  have halpha_pos : PositiveDomain alpha := by
    unfold alpha
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F htheta_lt_one
  have hadd_alpha_theta :
      RealTheory.add alpha theta = RealTheory.one := by
    unfold alpha
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F RealTheory.one theta
  have hz :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (z k) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold z
    have hsum := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F (hx k hk) (hy k hk)
    change
      F.lt (F.add F.zero F.zero)
        (F.add (x k) (y k)) at hsum
    rwa [F.zero_add] at hsum
  have hw :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (w k) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold w
    exact I.power_positive (RealTheory.sub p RealTheory.one) (hz k hk)
  have hS_pos : PositiveDomain S := by
    unfold S
    exact I.finitePowerSum_pos n hz
  have hSx_pos : PositiveDomain Sx := by
    unfold Sx
    exact I.finitePowerSum_pos n hx
  have hSy_pos : PositiveDomain Sy := by
    unfold Sy
    exact I.finitePowerSum_pos n hy
  have hSθ_pos : PositiveDomain Sθ := by
    unfold Sθ
    exact I.power_positive theta hS_pos
  have hSθ_ne : Not (Sθ = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hSθ_pos hzero.symm
  have htail_coeff :
      RealTheory.mul q (RealTheory.sub p RealTheory.one) = p := by
    unfold q p alpha
    exact holder_conjugate_decrement_mul htheta_pos htheta_lt_one
  have htail_sum :
      I.finitePowerSum q w (n + 1) = S := by
    unfold w S
    exact I.finitePowerSum_power_power_eq n hz htail_coeff
  have hS_eq_prod :
      S = finiteProductSum z w (n + 1) := by
    unfold S w
    exact I.finitePowerSum_eq_product_power_sub_one n hz
  have hprod_split :
      finiteProductSum z w (n + 1) =
        F.add (finiteProductSum x w (n + 1))
          (finiteProductSum y w (n + 1)) := by
    unfold z
    exact finiteProductSum_add_left x y w (n + 1)
  have hS_split :
      S =
        F.add (finiteProductSum x w (n + 1))
          (finiteProductSum y w (n + 1)) := by
    calc
      S = finiteProductSum z w (n + 1) := hS_eq_prod
      _ =
          F.add (finiteProductSum x w (n + 1))
            (finiteProductSum y w (n + 1)) := hprod_split
  have hholder_x :=
    I.holder_positive n htheta_pos htheta_lt_one hx hw
  change
    F.le (finiteProductSum x w (n + 1))
      (F.mul (pow alpha Sx)
        (pow theta (I.finitePowerSum q w (n + 1)))) at hholder_x
  rw [htail_sum] at hholder_x
  change
    F.le (finiteProductSum x w (n + 1))
      (F.mul Nx Sθ) at hholder_x
  have hholder_y :=
    I.holder_positive n htheta_pos htheta_lt_one hy hw
  change
    F.le (finiteProductSum y w (n + 1))
      (F.mul (pow alpha Sy)
        (pow theta (I.finitePowerSum q w (n + 1)))) at hholder_y
  rw [htail_sum] at hholder_y
  change
    F.le (finiteProductSum y w (n + 1))
      (F.mul Ny Sθ) at hholder_y
  have hsum_le :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hholder_x hholder_y
  change
    F.le
      (F.add (finiteProductSum x w (n + 1))
        (finiteProductSum y w (n + 1)))
      (F.add (F.mul Nx Sθ) (F.mul Ny Sθ)) at hsum_le
  rw [<- hS_split] at hsum_le
  have hfactor :
      F.add (F.mul Nx Sθ) (F.mul Ny Sθ) =
        F.mul (F.add Nx Ny) Sθ := by
    exact Eq.symm (F.add_mul Nx Ny Sθ)
  rw [hfactor] at hsum_le
  have hinvSθ_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.inv Sθ) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hSθ_pos)
  have hscaled :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hsum_le hinvSθ_nonneg
  change
    F.le (F.mul S (F.inv Sθ))
      (F.mul (F.mul (F.add Nx Ny) Sθ) (F.inv Sθ)) at hscaled
  have hright :
      F.mul (F.mul (F.add Nx Ny) Sθ) (F.inv Sθ) =
        F.add Nx Ny :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right
      F (F.add Nx Ny) hSθ_ne
  rw [hright] at hscaled
  have hleft :
      F.mul S (F.inv Sθ) = pow alpha S := by
    unfold Sθ pow
    exact I.power_mul_inv_complement hadd_alpha_theta hS_pos
  rw [hleft] at hscaled
  change F.le (pow alpha S) (F.add Nx Ny) at hscaled
  exact hscaled

name: power_inv_weightedAMGM_point
statement:
theorem power_inv_weightedAMGM_point
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {alpha t : Point}
    (halpha_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero alpha)
    (halpha_lt_one : RealTheory.lt alpha RealTheory.one)
    (ht : PositiveDomain t) :
    RealTheory.le t
      (ConvexCombo alpha RealTheory.one
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.inv alpha) t))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have halpha_weight : ConvexWeight alpha :=
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F halpha_pos)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F halpha_lt_one)
  have hpow_pos :
      PositiveDomain
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.inv alpha) t) :=
    I.power_positive (RealTheory.inv alpha) ht
  have h :=
    I.binaryWeightedAMGM
      halpha_weight RealTheory.zero_lt_one hpow_pos
  change
    F.le
      (F.mul
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (F.sub F.one alpha) F.one)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.inv alpha) t)))
      (ConvexCombo alpha F.one
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (F.inv alpha) t)) at h
  have hone :
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (F.sub F.one alpha) F.one = F.one := by
    change
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one alpha)
          RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one
    exact I.power_one_base (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one alpha)
  rw [hone] at h
  have hcancel :
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power (F.inv alpha) t) =
        t := by
    change
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (RealTheory.inv alpha) t) = t
    exact I.power_mul_inv_cancel halpha_pos ht
  rw [hcancel] at h
  rw [F.one_mul] at h
  exact h

name: power_inv_convexOn_positive
statement:
theorem power_inv_convexOn_positive
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {alpha : Point}
    (halpha_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero alpha)
    (halpha_lt_one : RealTheory.lt alpha RealTheory.one) :
    ConvexOn PositiveDomain
      (fun x : Point =>
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.inv alpha) x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := F.inv alpha
  have hp_pos : PositiveDomain p := by
    unfold p
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F halpha_pos
  refine And.intro convexSet_positiveDomain ?_
  intro theta x y htheta hx hy
  let pow := I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
  let combo := ConvexCombo theta x y
  let A := ConvexCombo theta (pow p x) (pow p y)
  let root := pow alpha A
  let u := F.mul x (F.inv root)
  let v := F.mul y (F.inv root)
  have hpx_pos : PositiveDomain (pow p x) := by
    unfold pow
    exact I.power_positive p hx
  have hpy_pos : PositiveDomain (pow p y) := by
    unfold pow
    exact I.power_positive p hy
  have hA_pos : PositiveDomain A := by
    unfold A
    exact convexSet_positiveDomain theta
      (pow p x) (pow p y) htheta hpx_pos hpy_pos
  have hroot_pos : PositiveDomain root := by
    unfold root pow
    exact I.power_positive alpha hA_pos
  have hroot_ne : Not (root = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hroot_pos hzero.symm
  have hA_ne : Not (A = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hA_pos hzero.symm
  have hcombo_pos : PositiveDomain combo := by
    unfold combo
    exact convexSet_positiveDomain theta x y htheta hx hy
  have hinv_root_pos : PositiveDomain (F.inv root) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hroot_pos
  have hu_pos : PositiveDomain u := by
    unfold u
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos hx hinv_root_pos
  have hv_pos : PositiveDomain v := by
    unfold v
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos hy hinv_root_pos
  have hu_single :=
    I.power_inv_weightedAMGM_point
      halpha_pos halpha_lt_one hu_pos
  have hv_single :=
    I.power_inv_weightedAMGM_point
      halpha_pos halpha_lt_one hv_pos
  have hroot_cancel : pow p root = A := by
    unfold root pow p
    exact I.power_mul_inv_cancel_right halpha_pos hA_pos
  have hroot_cancel_expanded :
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p root = A := by
    exact hroot_cancel
  have hu_pow :
      pow p u = F.mul (pow p x) (F.inv A) := by
    unfold u pow
    have hmul_base :
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p
            (F.mul x (F.inv root)) =
          F.mul
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p x)
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (F.inv root)) := by
      change
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p
            (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv root)) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p x)
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p
              (RealTheory.inv root))
      exact I.power_mul_base hx hinv_root_pos
    rw [hmul_base]
    have hinv_base :
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (F.inv root) =
          F.inv (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p root) := by
      change
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p
            (RealTheory.inv root) =
          RealTheory.inv
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p root)
      exact I.power_inv_base hroot_pos
    rw [hinv_base]
    change
      F.mul
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p x)
        (F.inv
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p root)) =
        F.mul
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p x)
          (F.inv A)
    rw [hroot_cancel_expanded]
  have hv_pow :
      pow p v = F.mul (pow p y) (F.inv A) := by
    unfold v pow
    have hmul_base :
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p
            (F.mul y (F.inv root)) =
          F.mul
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p y)
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (F.inv root)) := by
      change
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p
            (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.inv root)) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p y)
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p
              (RealTheory.inv root))
      exact I.power_mul_base hy hinv_root_pos
    rw [hmul_base]
    have hinv_base :
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p (F.inv root) =
          F.inv (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p root) := by
      change
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p
            (RealTheory.inv root) =
          RealTheory.inv
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p root)
      exact I.power_inv_base hroot_pos
    rw [hinv_base]
    change
      F.mul
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p y)
        (F.inv
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p root)) =
        F.mul
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power p y)
          (F.inv A)
    rw [hroot_cancel_expanded]
  have hpow_combo :
      ConvexCombo theta (pow p u) (pow p v) = F.one := by
    rw [hu_pow, hv_pow]
    change
      ConvexCombo theta
          (F.mul (pow p x) (F.inv A))
          (F.mul (pow p y) (F.inv A)) = F.one
    have hmul_right :
        ConvexCombo theta
            (F.mul (pow p x) (F.inv A))
            (F.mul (pow p y) (F.inv A)) =
          F.mul (ConvexCombo theta (pow p x) (pow p y))
            (F.inv A) := by
      change
        ConvexCombo theta
            (RealTheory.mul (pow p x) (RealTheory.inv A))
            (RealTheory.mul (pow p y) (RealTheory.inv A)) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (ConvexCombo theta (pow p x) (pow p y))
            (RealTheory.inv A)
      exact convexCombo_mul_right theta
        (pow p x) (pow p y) (RealTheory.inv A)
    rw [hmul_right]
    change F.mul A (F.inv A) = F.one
    exact F.mul_inv_cancel hA_ne
  have hnorm_pre :
      F.le (ConvexCombo theta u v)
        (ConvexCombo theta
          (ConvexCombo alpha F.one (pow p u))
          (ConvexCombo alpha F.one (pow p v))) :=
    convexCombo_mono_endpoints htheta hu_single hv_single
  have hnorm_rhs :
      ConvexCombo theta
          (ConvexCombo alpha F.one (pow p u))
          (ConvexCombo alpha F.one (pow p v)) =
        F.one := by
    change
      ConvexCombo theta
          (F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one alpha) F.one)
            (F.mul alpha (pow p u)))
          (F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one alpha) F.one)
            (F.mul alpha (pow p v))) =
        F.one
    have hadd_common :
        ConvexCombo theta
            (F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one alpha) F.one)
              (F.mul alpha (pow p u)))
            (F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one alpha) F.one)
              (F.mul alpha (pow p v))) =
          F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one alpha) F.one)
            (ConvexCombo theta
              (F.mul alpha (pow p u))
              (F.mul alpha (pow p v))) := by
      change
        ConvexCombo theta
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one alpha)
                RealTheory.one)
              (RealTheory.mul alpha (pow p u)))
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one alpha)
                RealTheory.one)
              (RealTheory.mul alpha (pow p v))) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one alpha)
              RealTheory.one)
            (ConvexCombo theta
              (RealTheory.mul alpha (pow p u))
              (RealTheory.mul alpha (pow p v)))
      exact convexCombo_add_common_left theta
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one alpha)
          RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.mul alpha (pow p u))
        (RealTheory.mul alpha (pow p v))
    rw [hadd_common]
    have hmul_left :
        ConvexCombo theta
            (F.mul alpha (pow p u))
            (F.mul alpha (pow p v)) =
          F.mul alpha (ConvexCombo theta (pow p u) (pow p v)) := by
      change
        ConvexCombo theta
            (RealTheory.mul alpha (pow p u))
            (RealTheory.mul alpha (pow p v)) =
          RealTheory.mul alpha
            (ConvexCombo theta (pow p u) (pow p v))
      exact convexCombo_mul_left theta alpha (pow p u) (pow p v)
    rw [hmul_left]
    rw [hpow_combo]
    change
      F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one alpha) F.one)
          (F.mul alpha F.one) = F.one
    rw [F.mul_one]
    rw [F.mul_one]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F F.one alpha]
  have hnorm :
      F.le (ConvexCombo theta u v) F.one := by
    rw [hnorm_rhs] at hnorm_pre
    exact hnorm_pre
  have hscaled :
      ConvexCombo theta u v = F.mul combo (F.inv root) := by
    unfold u v combo
    exact convexCombo_mul_right theta x y (F.inv root)
  have hcombo_le_root : F.le combo root := by
    have hmul :=
      RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
        hnorm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hroot_pos)
    change
      F.le
        (F.mul (ConvexCombo theta u v) root)
        (F.mul F.one root) at hmul
    rw [hscaled] at hmul
    have hleft :
        F.mul (F.mul combo (F.inv root)) root = combo :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
        F combo hroot_ne
    rw [hleft] at hmul
    rw [F.one_mul] at hmul
    exact hmul
  have hraised :=
    I.power_le_of_le_pos_exponent
      hp_pos hcombo_pos hroot_pos hcombo_le_root
  change
    F.le (pow p combo) (pow p root) at hraised
  rw [hroot_cancel] at hraised
  exact hraised

name: power_gt_one_convexOn_positive
statement:
theorem power_gt_one_convexOn_positive
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {r : Point}
    (hr : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one r) :
    ConvexOn PositiveDomain
      (fun x : Point =>
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hr_pos : PositiveDomain r :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hr
  have hr_ne : Not (r = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hr_pos hzero.symm
  have halpha_pos :
      PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv r) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hr_pos
  have halpha_lt_one :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.inv r) RealTheory.one :=
    NaturalPowerThinSpec.inv_lt_one_of_one_lt hr
  have hcore :=
    I.power_inv_convexOn_positive
      (alpha := RealTheory.inv r) halpha_pos halpha_lt_one
  change
    ConvexOn PositiveDomain
      (fun x : Point =>
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv r)) x) at hcore
  rw [inv_inv_of_ne_zero hr_ne] at hcore
  exact hcore

name: weightedPowerSum_powered_le_of_pos_lt
statement:
theorem weightedPowerSum_powered_le_of_pos_lt
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {r s : Point} {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hr : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero r)
    (hrs : RealTheory.lt r s)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hw : ConvexWeights w (n + 1)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
        (RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r))
        (I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1)))
      (I.weightedPowerSum s x w (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let alpha := RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r)
  let pow := I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
  let u : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat => pow r (x k)
  have halpha_gt_one :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one alpha := by
    unfold alpha
    exact ratio_exponent_gt_one_of_pos_lt hr hrs
  have hconv :
      ConvexOn PositiveDomain (fun y : Point => pow alpha y) := by
    unfold pow
    exact I.power_gt_one_convexOn_positive halpha_gt_one
  have hu :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (u k) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold u pow
    exact I.power_positive r (hx k hk)
  have hj :=
    convexOn_finiteJensen n hconv hu hw
  change
    F.le
      (pow alpha (WeightedPointSum u w (n + 1)))
      (WeightedValueSum (fun y : Point => pow alpha y)
        u w (n + 1)) at hj
  have hleft :
      WeightedPointSum u w (n + 1) =
        I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1) := by
    rfl
  rw [hleft] at hj
  have hr_ne : Not (r = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hr hzero.symm
  have halpha_mul :
      RealTheory.mul alpha r = s := by
    unfold alpha
    calc
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r)) r =
          RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv r) r) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      _ = RealTheory.mul s RealTheory.one := by
            rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hr_ne]
      _ = s := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  have hrhs :
      WeightedValueSum (fun y : Point => pow alpha y)
          u w (n + 1) =
        I.weightedPowerSum s x w (n + 1) := by
    unfold u pow alpha
    exact I.weightedValueSum_power_power_eq_weightedPowerSum
      (n + 1) hx halpha_mul
  rw [hrhs] at hj
  exact hj

name: weightedPowerMean_le_of_pos_lt
statement:
theorem weightedPowerMean_le_of_pos_lt
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {r s : Point} {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hr : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero r)
    (hrs : RealTheory.lt r s)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hw : ConvexWeights w (n + 1)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (I.weightedPowerMean r x w (n + 1))
      (I.weightedPowerMean s x w (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let alpha := RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r)
  let sumR := I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1)
  let sumS := I.weightedPowerSum s x w (n + 1)
  let pow := I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
  have hs_pos : PositiveDomain s :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hr hrs
  have hs_ne : Not (s = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hs_pos hzero.symm
  have hr_ne : Not (r = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hr hzero.symm
  have hsumR_pos : PositiveDomain sumR := by
    unfold sumR
    exact I.weightedPowerSum_pos n hx hw
  have hsumS_pos : PositiveDomain sumS := by
    unfold sumS
    exact I.weightedPowerSum_pos n hx hw
  have hpowered :
      RealTheory.le (pow alpha sumR) sumS := by
    unfold alpha sumR sumS pow
    exact I.weightedPowerSum_powered_le_of_pos_lt n hr hrs hx hw
  have hpow_alpha_pos : PositiveDomain (pow alpha sumR) := by
    unfold pow
    exact I.power_positive alpha hsumR_pos
  have hinvs_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv s) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hs_pos
  have hraised :
      RealTheory.le
        (pow (RealTheory.inv s) (pow alpha sumR))
        (pow (RealTheory.inv s) sumS) := by
    unfold pow
    exact I.power_le_of_le_pos_exponent
      hinvs_pos hpow_alpha_pos hsumS_pos hpowered
  have hcoeff :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv s) alpha =
        RealTheory.inv r := by
    unfold alpha
    calc
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv s)
          (RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r)) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv s) s)
            (RealTheory.inv r) := by
            rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      _ = RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv r) := by
            rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hs_ne]
      _ = RealTheory.inv r := by
            rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power (RealTheory.inv s)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha sumR))
      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power (RealTheory.inv s) sumS) at hraised
  rw [I.power_power hsumR_pos] at hraised
  rw [hcoeff] at hraised
  rw [I.weightedPowerMean_of_ne_zero x w (n + 1) hr_ne]
  rw [I.weightedPowerMean_of_ne_zero x w (n + 1) hs_ne]
  unfold sumR sumS at hraised
  exact hraised

name: weightedGeometricMeanExp_le_weightedPowerMean_of_pos
statement:
theorem weightedGeometricMeanExp_le_weightedPowerMean_of_pos
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {s : Point} {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hs_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero s)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hw : ConvexWeights w (n + 1)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (I.weightedGeometricMeanExp x w (n + 1))
      (I.weightedPowerMean s x w (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hs_ne : Not (s = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hs_pos hzero.symm
  let y : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat => I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power s (x k)
  let G := I.weightedGeometricMeanExp x w (n + 1)
  let sumS := I.weightedPowerSum s x w (n + 1)
  have hG_pos : PositiveDomain G := by
    unfold G
    exact I.weightedGeometricMeanExp_pos x w (n + 1)
  have hsumS_pos : PositiveDomain sumS := by
    unfold sumS
    exact I.weightedPowerSum_pos n hx hw
  have hy :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (y k) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold y
    exact I.power_positive s (hx k hk)
  have hamgm :=
    I.finiteWeightedAMGMExp n hy hw
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (I.expSpec.exp
        (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log y w (n + 1)))
      (WeightedPointSum y w (n + 1)) at hamgm
  have hright :
      WeightedPointSum y w (n + 1) = sumS := by
    unfold y sumS weightedPowerSum
    rfl
  rw [hright] at hamgm
  have hlogsum :
      WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log y w (n + 1) =
        RealTheory.mul s
          (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1)) := by
    unfold y
    exact I.weightedValueSum_log_power_eq_mul (n + 1) hx
  have hleft :
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power s G =
        I.expSpec.exp
          (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log y w (n + 1)) := by
    unfold G weightedGeometricMeanExp
    have hGraw_pos :
        PositiveDomain
          (I.expSpec.exp
            (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1))) :=
      I.expSpec.pos (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1))
    rw [I.power_exp_log s
      (I.expSpec.exp
        (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1))) hGraw_pos]
    rw [I.log_exp
      (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1))]
    rw [hlogsum]
  rw [<- hleft] at hamgm
  have hpowG_pos :
      PositiveDomain (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power s G) :=
    I.power_positive s hG_pos
  have hinvs_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv s) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hs_pos
  have hraised :=
    I.power_le_of_le_pos_exponent
      hinvs_pos hpowG_pos hsumS_pos hamgm
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power (RealTheory.inv s)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power s G))
      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
        (RealTheory.inv s) sumS) at hraised
  rw [I.power_mul_inv_cancel_right hs_pos hG_pos] at hraised
  rw [I.weightedPowerMean_of_ne_zero x w (n + 1) hs_ne]
  unfold G sumS at hraised
  exact hraised

name: weightedPowerMean_le_weightedGeometricMeanExp_of_neg
statement:
theorem weightedPowerMean_le_weightedGeometricMeanExp_of_neg
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {r : Point} {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hr_neg : RealTheory.lt r RealTheory.zero)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hw : ConvexWeights w (n + 1)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (I.weightedPowerMean r x w (n + 1))
      (I.weightedGeometricMeanExp x w (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hr_ne : Not (r = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hr_neg
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero hr_neg
  let y : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat => I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r (x k)
  let L := WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1)
  let sumR := I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1)
  have hy :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (y k) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold y
    exact I.power_positive r (hx k hk)
  have hsumR_pos : PositiveDomain sumR := by
    unfold sumR
    exact I.weightedPowerSum_pos n hx hw
  have hamgm :=
    I.finiteWeightedAMGMExp n hy hw
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (I.expSpec.exp
        (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log y w (n + 1)))
      (WeightedPointSum y w (n + 1)) at hamgm
  have hright :
      WeightedPointSum y w (n + 1) = sumR := by
    unfold y sumR weightedPowerSum
    rfl
  rw [hright] at hamgm
  have hlogsum :
      WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log y w (n + 1) =
        RealTheory.mul r L := by
    unfold y L
    exact I.weightedValueSum_log_power_eq_mul (n + 1) hx
  rw [hlogsum] at hamgm
  have hlog_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul r L)
        (I.logSpec.log sumR) := by
    have h :=
      I.logSpec.le_of_le
        (I.expSpec.pos (RealTheory.mul r L))
        hsumR_pos hamgm
    rw [I.log_exp (RealTheory.mul r L)] at h
    exact h
  have hinvr_nonpos :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.inv r) RealTheory.zero :=
    inv_le_zero_of_neg hr_neg
  have hscaled :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv r) (I.logSpec.log sumR))
        L := by
    have h :=
      mul_le_mul_nonpos_left hlog_le hinvr_nonpos
    have hcoeff :
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv r)
            (RealTheory.mul r L) =
          L := by
      calc
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv r)
            (RealTheory.mul r L) =
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv r) r) L := by
              rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]
        _ = RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one L := by
              rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hr_ne]
        _ = L := by
              rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
    rw [hcoeff] at h
    exact h
  have hexp := I.expSpec.le_of_le hscaled
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (I.expSpec.exp
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv r) (I.logSpec.log sumR)))
      (I.expSpec.exp L) at hexp
  rw [I.weightedPowerMean_of_ne_zero x w (n + 1) hr_ne]
  unfold weightedGeometricMeanExp
  unfold L sumR at hexp
  rw [I.power_exp_log (RealTheory.inv r)
      (I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1))
      (I.weightedPowerSum_pos n hx hw)]
  exact hexp

name: power_between_zero_one_concaveOn_positive
statement:
theorem power_between_zero_one_concaveOn_positive
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {r : Point}
    (hr_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero r)
    (hr_lt_one : RealTheory.lt r RealTheory.one) :
    ConcaveOn PositiveDomain
      (fun x : Point =>
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hconv_inv :
      ConvexOn PositiveDomain
        (fun x : Point =>
          I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (RealTheory.inv r) x) :=
    I.power_inv_convexOn_positive hr_pos hr_lt_one
  have hinv_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv r) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hr_pos
  have hstrict_inv :
      StrictMonotoneOn PositiveDomain
        (fun x : Point =>
          I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (RealTheory.inv r) x) :=
    I.power_strictMonotoneOn_positive hinv_pos
  have hg :
      MapsInto PositiveDomain PositiveDomain
        (fun y : Point =>
          I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r y) := by
    intro y hy
    exact I.power_positive r hy
  have hright :
      forall y : Point,
        PositiveDomain y ->
          I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
              (RealTheory.inv r)
              (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r y) =
            y := by
    intro y hy
    exact I.power_mul_inv_cancel_right hr_pos hy
  exact
    concaveOn_of_convexOn_strictMonotone_inverse
      hconv_inv hstrict_inv convexSet_positiveDomain hg hright

name: weightedPowerSum_le_powered_of_neg_lt_neg
statement:
theorem weightedPowerSum_le_powered_of_neg_lt_neg
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {r s : Point} {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hr_neg : RealTheory.lt r RealTheory.zero)
    (hs_neg : RealTheory.lt s RealTheory.zero)
    (hrs : RealTheory.lt r s)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hw : ConvexWeights w (n + 1)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (I.weightedPowerSum s x w (n + 1))
      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
        (RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r))
        (I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let alpha := RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r)
  let pow := I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
  let u : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat => pow r (x k)
  have halpha_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero alpha := by
    unfold alpha
    exact ratio_exponent_pos_of_neg_neg hr_neg hs_neg
  have halpha_lt_one :
      RealTheory.lt alpha RealTheory.one := by
    unfold alpha
    exact ratio_exponent_lt_one_of_neg_lt_neg hr_neg hs_neg hrs
  have hconc :
      ConcaveOn PositiveDomain (fun y : Point => pow alpha y) := by
    unfold pow
    exact I.power_between_zero_one_concaveOn_positive
      halpha_pos halpha_lt_one
  have hu :
      forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (u k) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold u pow
    exact I.power_positive r (hx k hk)
  have hj :=
    concaveOn_finiteJensen n hconc hu hw
  change
    F.le
      (WeightedValueSum (fun y : Point => pow alpha y)
        u w (n + 1))
      (pow alpha (WeightedPointSum u w (n + 1))) at hj
  have hright :
      WeightedPointSum u w (n + 1) =
        I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1) := by
    rfl
  rw [hright] at hj
  have hr_ne : Not (r = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hr_neg
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F F.zero hr_neg
  have halpha_mul :
      RealTheory.mul alpha r = s := by
    unfold alpha
    calc
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r)) r =
          RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv r) r) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      _ = RealTheory.mul s RealTheory.one := by
            rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hr_ne]
      _ = s := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  have hleft :
      WeightedValueSum (fun y : Point => pow alpha y)
          u w (n + 1) =
        I.weightedPowerSum s x w (n + 1) := by
    unfold u pow alpha
    exact I.weightedValueSum_power_power_eq_weightedPowerSum
      (n + 1) hx halpha_mul
  rw [hleft] at hj
  exact hj

name: weightedPowerMean_le_of_neg_lt_neg
statement:
theorem weightedPowerMean_le_of_neg_lt_neg
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {r s : Point} {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hr_neg : RealTheory.lt r RealTheory.zero)
    (hs_neg : RealTheory.lt s RealTheory.zero)
    (hrs : RealTheory.lt r s)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hw : ConvexWeights w (n + 1)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (I.weightedPowerMean r x w (n + 1))
      (I.weightedPowerMean s x w (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hr_ne : Not (r = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hr_neg
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero hr_neg
  have hs_ne : Not (s = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hs_neg
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero hs_neg
  let alpha := RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r)
  let sumR := I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1)
  let sumS := I.weightedPowerSum s x w (n + 1)
  let pow := I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
  have hsumR_pos : PositiveDomain sumR := by
    unfold sumR
    exact I.weightedPowerSum_pos n hx hw
  have hsumS_pos : PositiveDomain sumS := by
    unfold sumS
    exact I.weightedPowerSum_pos n hx hw
  have halpha_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero alpha := by
    unfold alpha
    exact ratio_exponent_pos_of_neg_neg hr_neg hs_neg
  have hpowered :
      RealTheory.le sumS (pow alpha sumR) := by
    unfold alpha sumR sumS pow
    exact I.weightedPowerSum_le_powered_of_neg_lt_neg
      n hr_neg hs_neg hrs hx hw
  have hpow_alpha_pos : PositiveDomain (pow alpha sumR) := by
    unfold pow
    exact I.power_positive alpha hsumR_pos
  have hlog :
      RealTheory.le (I.logSpec.log sumS)
        (RealTheory.mul alpha (I.logSpec.log sumR)) := by
    have h :=
      I.logSpec.le_of_le hsumS_pos hpow_alpha_pos hpowered
    have hlogpow :
        I.logSpec.log (pow alpha sumR) =
          RealTheory.mul alpha (I.logSpec.log sumR) := by
      unfold pow
      rw [I.power_exp_log alpha sumR hsumR_pos]
      exact I.log_exp
        (RealTheory.mul alpha (I.logSpec.log sumR))
    rw [hlogpow] at h
    exact h
  have hinvs_nonpos :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.inv s) RealTheory.zero :=
    inv_le_zero_of_neg hs_neg
  have hscaled :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv r) (I.logSpec.log sumR))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv s) (I.logSpec.log sumS)) := by
    have h :=
      mul_le_mul_nonpos_left hlog hinvs_nonpos
    have hcoeff :
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv s)
            (RealTheory.mul alpha (I.logSpec.log sumR)) =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv r)
            (I.logSpec.log sumR) := by
      unfold alpha
      calc
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv s)
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r))
              (I.logSpec.log sumR)) =
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv s)
                (RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.inv r)))
              (I.logSpec.log sumR) := by
              rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]
        _ =
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv s) s)
                (RealTheory.inv r))
              (I.logSpec.log sumR) := by
              rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]
        _ =
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv r))
              (I.logSpec.log sumR) := by
              rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hs_ne]
        _ =
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv r)
              (I.logSpec.log sumR) := by
              rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
    rw [hcoeff] at h
    exact h
  have hexp := I.expSpec.le_of_le hscaled
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (I.expSpec.exp
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv r) (I.logSpec.log sumR)))
      (I.expSpec.exp
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv s) (I.logSpec.log sumS))) at hexp
  rw [I.weightedPowerMean_of_ne_zero x w (n + 1) hr_ne]
  rw [I.weightedPowerMean_of_ne_zero x w (n + 1) hs_ne]
  unfold sumR sumS at hexp
  rw [I.power_exp_log (RealTheory.inv r)
      (I.weightedPowerSum r x w (n + 1))
      (I.weightedPowerSum_pos n hx hw)]
  rw [I.power_exp_log (RealTheory.inv s)
      (I.weightedPowerSum s x w (n + 1))
      (I.weightedPowerSum_pos n hx hw)]
  exact hexp

name: weightedPowerMean_le_of_neg_lt_pos
statement:
theorem weightedPowerMean_le_of_neg_lt_pos
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {r s : Point} {x w : Nat -> Point}

    (I.weightedGeometricMeanExp_le_weightedPowerMean_of_pos
      n hs_pos hx hw)

name: power_negative_convexOn_positive
statement:
theorem power_negative_convexOn_positive
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {r : Point}
    (hr_neg : RealTheory.lt r RealTheory.zero) :
    ConvexOn PositiveDomain
      (fun x : Point =>
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro convexSet_positiveDomain ?_
  intro theta x y htheta hx hy
  let pow := I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
  let combo := ConvexCombo theta x y
  let Lx := I.logSpec.log x
  let Ly := I.logSpec.log y
  let logCombo := ConvexCombo theta Lx Ly
  have hcombo_pos : PositiveDomain combo := by
    unfold combo
    exact convexSet_positiveDomain theta x y htheta hx hy
  have hlog :
      RealTheory.le logCombo (I.logSpec.log combo) := by
    unfold logCombo combo Lx Ly
    exact concaveOn_binaryJensen
      I.logSpec.concaveOn htheta hx hy
  have hr_nonpos : RealTheory.le r RealTheory.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hr_neg
  have hscaled :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul r (I.logSpec.log combo))
        (RealTheory.mul r logCombo) :=
    mul_le_mul_nonpos_left hlog hr_nonpos
  have hexp := I.expSpec.le_of_le hscaled
  have hleft :
      I.expSpec.exp
          (RealTheory.mul r (I.logSpec.log combo)) =
        pow r combo := by
    unfold pow
    rw [I.power_exp_log r combo hcombo_pos]
  have hright :
      I.expSpec.exp (RealTheory.mul r logCombo) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (pow (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta)
            (pow r x))
          (pow theta (pow r y)) := by
    unfold logCombo Lx Ly pow
    unfold ConvexCombo
    change
      I.expSpec.exp
          (F.mul r
            (F.add
              (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) (I.logSpec.log x))
              (F.mul theta (I.logSpec.log y)))) =
        F.mul
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.sub F.one theta)
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r x))
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power theta
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r y))
    rw [F.mul_add]
    have hxpow_pos :
        PositiveDomain (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r x) :=
      I.power_positive r hx
    have hypow_pos :
        PositiveDomain (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r y) :=
      I.power_positive r hy
    rw [I.power_exp_log
      (F.sub F.one theta)
      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r x) hxpow_pos]
    rw [I.power_exp_log r x hx]
    have hlogx :
        I.logSpec.log
            (I.expSpec.exp
              (RealTheory.mul r (I.logSpec.log x))) =
          RealTheory.mul r (I.logSpec.log x) :=
      I.log_exp (RealTheory.mul r (I.logSpec.log x))
    rw [hlogx]
    rw [I.power_exp_log theta
      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r y) hypow_pos]
    rw [I.power_exp_log r y hy]
    have hlogy :
        I.logSpec.log
            (I.expSpec.exp
              (RealTheory.mul r (I.logSpec.log y))) =
          RealTheory.mul r (I.logSpec.log y) :=
      I.log_exp (RealTheory.mul r (I.logSpec.log y))
    rw [hlogy]
    have hargx :
        F.mul r (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) (I.logSpec.log x)) =
          F.mul (F.sub F.one theta)
            (F.mul r (I.logSpec.log x)) := by
      calc
        F.mul r (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) (I.logSpec.log x)) =
            F.mul (F.mul r (F.sub F.one theta))
              (I.logSpec.log x) := by
              rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) r)
              (I.logSpec.log x) := by
              rw [F.mul_comm r (F.sub F.one theta)]
        _ = F.mul (F.sub F.one theta)
              (F.mul r (I.logSpec.log x)) := by
              rw [F.mul_assoc]
    have hargy :
        F.mul r (F.mul theta (I.logSpec.log y)) =
          F.mul theta (F.mul r (I.logSpec.log y)) := by
      calc
        F.mul r (F.mul theta (I.logSpec.log y)) =
            F.mul (F.mul r theta) (I.logSpec.log y) := by
              rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul (F.mul theta r) (I.logSpec.log y) := by
              rw [F.mul_comm r theta]
        _ = F.mul theta (F.mul r (I.logSpec.log y)) := by
              rw [F.mul_assoc]
    rw [hargx, hargy]
    exact I.expSpec.add_law
      (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta)
        (F.mul r (I.logSpec.log x)))
      (F.mul theta (F.mul r (I.logSpec.log y)))
  rw [hleft, hright] at hexp
  have hxpow_pos : PositiveDomain (pow r x) := by
    unfold pow
    exact I.power_positive r hx
  have hypow_pos : PositiveDomain (pow r y) := by
    unfold pow
    exact I.power_positive r hy
  have hamgm :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul
          (pow (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) (pow r x))
          (pow theta (pow r y)))
        (ConvexCombo theta (pow r x) (pow r y)) :=
    I.binaryWeightedAMGM htheta hxpow_pos hypow_pos
  exact F.le_trans hexp hamgm

name: finiteWeightedAMGMExp
statement:
theorem finiteWeightedAMGMExp
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hw : ConvexWeights w (n + 1)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (I.expSpec.exp
        (WeightedValueSum I.logSpec.log x w (n + 1)))
      (WeightedPointSum x w (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hlog :=
    concaveOn_finiteJensen n I.logSpec.concaveOn hx hw
  have hsum_pos : PositiveDomain (WeightedPointSum x w (n + 1)) :=
    finiteSum_weighted_mem_convexSet
      n convexSet_positiveDomain hx hw
  have hexp := I.expSpec.le_of_le hlog
  rw [I.exp_log (WeightedPointSum x w (n + 1)) hsum_pos] at hexp
  exact hexp

name: binaryWeightedAMGM
statement:
theorem binaryWeightedAMGM
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {theta x y : Point}
    (htheta : ConvexWeight theta)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (hy : PositiveDomain y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) x)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power theta y))
      (ConvexCombo theta x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let lx := I.logSpec.log x
  let ly := I.logSpec.log y
  let logCombo := ConvexCombo theta lx ly
  let combo := ConvexCombo theta x y
  have hlog :
      RealTheory.le logCombo (I.logSpec.log combo) := by
    unfold logCombo combo
    exact concaveOn_binaryJensen
      I.logSpec.concaveOn htheta hx hy
  have hcombo_pos : PositiveDomain combo := by
    unfold combo
    exact convexSet_positiveDomain theta x y htheta hx hy
  have hexp := I.expSpec.le_of_le hlog
  rw [I.exp_log combo hcombo_pos] at hexp
  have hleft :
      I.expSpec.exp logCombo =
        RealTheory.mul
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) x)
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power theta y) := by
    unfold logCombo lx ly
    unfold ConvexCombo
    change
      I.expSpec.exp
          (F.add
            (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) (I.logSpec.log x))
            (F.mul theta (I.logSpec.log y))) =
        F.mul
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.sub F.one theta) x)
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power theta y)
    rw [I.power_exp_log (F.sub F.one theta) x hx]
    rw [I.power_exp_log theta y hy]
    exact I.expSpec.add_law
      (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) (I.logSpec.log x))
      (F.mul theta (I.logSpec.log y))
  rwa [hleft] at hexp

name: weightedPowerSum_zero_eq_one
statement:
theorem weightedPowerSum_zero_eq_one
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {x w : Nat -> Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hx : forall k : Nat, k < n + 1 -> PositiveDomain (x k))
    (hw : ConvexWeights w (n + 1)) :
    I.weightedPowerSum RealTheory.zero x w (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold weightedPowerSum
  unfold WeightedPointSum
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          F.mul (w k)
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power F.zero (x k)))
        (n + 1) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum w (n + 1) := by
        apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
        intro k hk
        rw [I.power_exp_log F.zero (x k) (hx k hk)]
        change
          F.mul (w k)
              (I.expSpec.exp
                (F.mul F.zero (I.logSpec.log (x k)))) =
            w k
        rw [F.zero_mul]
        have hexp_zero : I.expSpec.exp F.zero = F.one := by
          change I.expSpec.exp RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
          exact I.expSpec.zero_value
        rw [hexp_zero]
        rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = F.one := hw.right

name: weightedPointSum_normalized
statement:
theorem weightedPointSum_normalized
    (x w : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (total : Point) :
    WeightedPointSum
        x
        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (w k) (RealTheory.inv total))
        n =
      RealTheory.mul (WeightedPointSum x w n) (RealTheory.inv total)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold WeightedPointSum
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          F.mul (F.mul (w k) (F.inv total)) (x k)) n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.mul (F.mul (w k) (x k)) (F.inv total)) n := by
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
          intro k hk
          calc
            F.mul (F.mul (w k) (F.inv total)) (x k) =
                F.mul (w k) (F.mul (F.inv total) (x k)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
            _ = F.mul (w k) (F.mul (x k) (F.inv total)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv total) (x k)]
            _ = F.mul (F.mul (w k) (x k)) (F.inv total) := by
                  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => F.mul (w k) (x k)) n)
          (F.inv total) := by
          exact
            RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_right
              (fun k : Nat => F.mul (w k) (x k))
              (F.inv total) n

statement:
theorem weightedValueSum_normalized
    (f : Map) (x w : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (total : Point) :

        n =

proof:

  unfold WeightedValueSum
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          F.mul (F.mul (w k) (F.inv total)) (f (x k))) n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.mul (F.mul (w k) (f (x k))) (F.inv total)) n := by
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
          intro k hk
          calc
            F.mul (F.mul (w k) (F.inv total)) (f (x k)) =
                F.mul (w k) (F.mul (F.inv total) (f (x k))) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
            _ =
                F.mul (w k) (F.mul (f (x k)) (F.inv total)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv total) (f (x k))]
            _ =
                F.mul (F.mul (w k) (f (x k))) (F.inv total) := by
                  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => F.mul (w k) (f (x k))) n)
          (F.inv total) := by
          exact
            RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_right

              (F.inv total) n

name: convexWeights_normalized
statement:
theorem convexWeights_normalized
    (w : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (total : Point)
    (htotal_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero total)
    (hnonneg :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (w k))
    (htotal : RealTheory.finiteSum w n = total) :
    ConvexWeights
      (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (w k) (RealTheory.inv total)) n
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htotal_ne : Not (total = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F htotal_pos hzero.symm
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro k hk
    exact F.mul_nonneg (hnonneg k hk)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F htotal_pos))
  · calc
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => F.mul (w k) (F.inv total)) n =
          F.mul (RealTheory.finiteSum w n) (F.inv total) :=
            RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_right w (F.inv total) n
      _ = F.mul total (F.inv total) := by
            rw [htotal]
      _ = F.one := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel htotal_ne]
