name: secantSlope_mul_intervalLength
statement:
theorem secantSlope_mul_intervalLength
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b) :
    RealTheory.mul (SecantSlope f a b) (RealTheory.sub b a) =
      RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dy := F.sub (f b) (f a)
  let dx := F.sub b a
  have hdx_pos : F.lt F.zero dx := by
    unfold dx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hab
  have hdx_ne : Not (dx = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hdx_pos h.symm
  unfold SecantSlope
  change F.mul (F.mul dy (F.inv dx)) dx = dy
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul dy (F.inv dx)) dx =
        F.mul dy (F.mul (F.inv dx) dx) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul dy F.one := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hdx_ne]
    _ = dy := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: secantSlope_le_of_increment_le
statement:
theorem secantSlope_le_of_increment_le
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} {m : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hinc :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))
        (RealTheory.mul m (RealTheory.sub b a))) :
    RealTheory.le (SecantSlope f a b) m
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dx := F.sub b a
  have hdx_pos : F.lt F.zero dx := by
    unfold dx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hab
  have hdx_ne : Not (dx = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hdx_pos h.symm
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv dx) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hdx_pos)
  have hmul :
      F.le
        (F.mul (F.sub (f b) (f a)) (F.inv dx))
        (F.mul (F.mul m dx) (F.inv dx)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hinc hinv_nonneg
  have hright : F.mul (F.mul m dx) (F.inv dx) = m :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right F m hdx_ne
  change
    F.le (SecantSlope f a b)
      (F.mul (F.mul m dx) (F.inv dx)) at hmul
  rwa [hright] at hmul

name: le_secantSlope_of_mul_intervalLength_le
statement:
theorem le_secantSlope_of_mul_intervalLength_le
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} {m : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hinc :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul m (RealTheory.sub b a))
        (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))) :
    RealTheory.le m (SecantSlope f a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dx := F.sub b a
  have hdx_pos : F.lt F.zero dx := by
    unfold dx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hab
  have hdx_ne : Not (dx = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hdx_pos h.symm
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv dx) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hdx_pos)
  have hmul :
      F.le
        (F.mul (F.mul m dx) (F.inv dx))
        (F.mul (F.sub (f b) (f a)) (F.inv dx)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hinc hinv_nonneg
  have hleft : F.mul (F.mul m dx) (F.inv dx) = m :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right F m hdx_ne
  change
    F.le (F.mul (F.mul m dx) (F.inv dx))
      (SecantSlope f a b) at hmul
  rwa [hleft] at hmul

name: increment_le_of_secantSlope_le
statement:
theorem increment_le_of_secantSlope_le
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} {m : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hslope : RealTheory.le (SecantSlope f a b) m) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))
      (RealTheory.mul m (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dx := F.sub b a
  have hdx_nonneg : F.le F.zero dx := by
    unfold dx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hab)
  have hmul :
      F.le
        (F.mul (SecantSlope f a b) dx)
        (F.mul m dx) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hslope hdx_nonneg
  have hleft :
      F.mul (SecantSlope f a b) dx =
        F.sub (f b) (f a) := by
    unfold dx
    exact secantSlope_mul_intervalLength hab
  change
    F.le (F.mul (SecantSlope f a b) dx)
      (F.mul m dx) at hmul
  rwa [hleft] at hmul

name: mul_intervalLength_le_increment_of_le_secantSlope
statement:
theorem mul_intervalLength_le_increment_of_le_secantSlope
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} {m : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hslope : RealTheory.le m (SecantSlope f a b)) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul m (RealTheory.sub b a))
      (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dx := F.sub b a
  have hdx_nonneg : F.le F.zero dx := by
    unfold dx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hab)
  have hmul :
      F.le
        (F.mul m dx)
        (F.mul (SecantSlope f a b) dx) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hslope hdx_nonneg
  have hright :
      F.mul (SecantSlope f a b) dx =
        F.sub (f b) (f a) := by
    unfold dx
    exact secantSlope_mul_intervalLength hab
  change
    F.le (F.mul m dx)
      (F.mul (SecantSlope f a b) dx) at hmul
  rwa [hright] at hmul

name: abs_le_max_abs_of_bounds
statement:
theorem abs_le_max_abs_of_bounds {lower value upper : Point}
    (hlower : RealTheory.le lower value)
    (hupper : RealTheory.le value upper) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs value)
      (RealTheory.max (RealTheory.abs lower) (RealTheory.abs upper))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let M := RealTheory.max (RealTheory.abs lower) (RealTheory.abs upper)
  have hvalue_abs_upper : F.le value (RealTheory.abs upper) :=
    F.le_trans hupper (RealTheory.le_abs_self upper)
  have hvalue_M : F.le value M :=
    F.le_trans hvalue_abs_upper
      (RealTheory.le_max_right (RealTheory.abs lower) (RealTheory.abs upper))
  have hneg_value_neg_lower :
      F.le (F.neg value) (F.neg lower) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hlower
  have hneg_value_abs_lower :
      F.le (F.neg value) (RealTheory.abs lower) :=
    F.le_trans hneg_value_neg_lower
      (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self lower)
  have hneg_value_M : F.le (F.neg value) M :=
    F.le_trans hneg_value_abs_lower
      (RealTheory.le_max_left (RealTheory.abs lower) (RealTheory.abs upper))
  change F.le (RealTheory.abs value) M
  exact RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hvalue_M hneg_value_M

name: abs_le_mul_abs_of_two_sided_mul_bounds
statement:
theorem abs_le_mul_abs_of_two_sided_mul_bounds
    {lower value upper scale bound : Point}
    (hscale : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero scale)
    (hlower : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul lower scale) value)
    (hupper : RealTheory.le value (RealTheory.mul upper scale))
    (hlower_bound : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs lower) bound)
    (hupper_bound : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs upper) bound) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs value)
      (RealTheory.mul bound (RealTheory.abs scale))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hscale_abs : RealTheory.abs scale = scale :=
    RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hscale
  have hupper_to_abs :
      F.le (F.mul upper scale)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.abs upper) scale) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F (RealTheory.le_abs_self upper) hscale
  have hupper_to_bound :
      F.le (F.mul (RealTheory.abs upper) scale)
        (F.mul bound scale) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hupper_bound hscale
  have hvalue_bound : F.le value (F.mul bound scale) :=
    F.le_trans hupper (F.le_trans hupper_to_abs hupper_to_bound)
  have hneg_value :
      F.le (F.neg value) (F.neg (F.mul lower scale)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hlower
  have hneg_mul_eq :
      F.neg (F.mul lower scale) = F.mul (F.neg lower) scale :=
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F lower scale).symm
  have hneg_value_mul :
      F.le (F.neg value) (F.mul (F.neg lower) scale) := by
    rwa [hneg_mul_eq] at hneg_value
  have hneg_to_abs :
      F.le (F.mul (F.neg lower) scale)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.abs lower) scale) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self lower) hscale
  have hneg_to_bound :
      F.le (F.mul (RealTheory.abs lower) scale)
        (F.mul bound scale) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hlower_bound hscale
  have hneg_bound : F.le (F.neg value) (F.mul bound scale) :=
    F.le_trans hneg_value_mul (F.le_trans hneg_to_abs hneg_to_bound)
  rw [hscale_abs]
  exact RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hvalue_bound hneg_bound

name: add_one_pos_of_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hone_le : F.le F.one (F.add x F.one) := by
    have h := F.add_le_add_right hx F.one
    change F.le (F.add F.zero F.one) (F.add x F.one) at h
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
    F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hone_le

name: weighted_increment_eq_secantSlope_mul
statement:
theorem weighted_increment_eq_secantSlope_mul
    (f : Map) (a c d : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul d
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub c a)))
        (RealTheory.sub (f c) (f a)) =
      RealTheory.mul (SecantSlope f a c) d
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold SecantSlope
  change
    F.mul (F.mul d (F.inv (F.sub c a)))
        (F.sub (f c) (f a)) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (F.sub (f c) (f a))
          (F.inv (F.sub c a))) d
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul d (F.inv (F.sub c a)))
        (F.sub (f c) (f a)) =
        F.mul (F.sub (f c) (f a))
          (F.mul d (F.inv (F.sub c a))) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.sub (f c) (f a))
          (F.mul (F.inv (F.sub c a)) d) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm d (F.inv (F.sub c a))]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (F.sub (f c) (f a))
            (F.inv (F.sub c a))) d := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: convexCombo_zero
statement:
theorem convexCombo_zero (x y : Point) :
    ConvexCombo RealTheory.zero x y = x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ConvexCombo
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one F.zero) x)
      (F.mul F.zero y) = x
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F F.one]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [F.zero_mul]
  rw [F.add_zero]

name: convexCombo_one
statement:
theorem convexCombo_one (x y : Point) :
    ConvexCombo RealTheory.one x y = y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ConvexCombo
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one F.one) x)
      (F.mul F.one y) = y
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.one]
  rw [F.zero_mul]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [F.zero_add]

name: convexCombo_self
statement:
theorem convexCombo_self (theta x : Point) :
    ConvexCombo theta x x = x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ConvexCombo
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) x)
      (F.mul theta x) = x
  rw [<- F.add_mul]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F F.one theta]
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: convexCombo_mul_right
statement:
theorem convexCombo_mul_right (theta x y z : Point) :
    ConvexCombo theta
        (RealTheory.mul x z) (RealTheory.mul y z) =
      RealTheory.mul (ConvexCombo theta x y) z
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ConvexCombo
  change
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) (F.mul x z))
        (F.mul theta (F.mul y z)) =
      F.mul
        (F.add
          (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) x)
          (F.mul theta y)) z
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [<- F.mul_assoc (F.sub F.one theta) x z]
  rw [<- F.mul_assoc theta y z]

name: convexCombo_mul_left
statement:
theorem convexCombo_mul_left (theta z x y : Point) :
    ConvexCombo theta
        (RealTheory.mul z x) (RealTheory.mul z y) =
      RealTheory.mul z (ConvexCombo theta x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealTheory.mul_comm z x]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_comm z y]
  rw [convexCombo_mul_right theta x y z]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_comm (ConvexCombo theta x y) z]

name: convexCombo_add_common_left
statement:
theorem convexCombo_add_common_left (theta c x y : Point) :
    ConvexCombo theta
        (RealTheory.add c x) (RealTheory.add c y) =
      RealTheory.add c (ConvexCombo theta x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ConvexCombo
  change
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) (F.add c x))
        (F.mul theta (F.add c y)) =
      F.add c
        (F.add
          (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) x)
          (F.mul theta y))
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_add_add_comm F]
  change
    F.add (ConvexCombo theta c c) (ConvexCombo theta x y) =
      F.add c (ConvexCombo theta x y)
  rw [convexCombo_self theta c]

name: convexCombo_symm
statement:
theorem convexCombo_symm (theta x y : Point) :
    ConvexCombo theta x y =
      ConvexCombo (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) y x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ConvexCombo
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) x) (F.mul theta y) =
      F.add
        (F.mul (F.sub F.one (F.sub F.one theta)) y)
        (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) x)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F F.one theta]
  rw [F.add_comm]

name: nat_two_eq_two
statement:
theorem nat_two_eq_two :
    RealTheory.nat 2 =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F 2 =
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F
  change IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (1 + 1) =
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_one]
  rfl

name: binary_baseTail_half_succ
statement:
theorem binary_baseTail_half_succ (n : Nat) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n) =
      RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let t := RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1)
  have hvalid : RealTheory.ValidBase 2 := by
    unfold RealTheory.ValidBase
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
    omega
  have htail :
      RealTheory.baseTail 2 n =
        F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F) t := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail_eq_mul_baseTail_succ
        F hvalid n
    change
      RealTheory.baseTail 2 n =
        F.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) t at h
    rw [nat_two_eq_two] at h
    exact h
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
  rw [htail]
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F) t)
        (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F)) =
      t
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F) t)
        (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F)) =
        F.mul t
          (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F)
            (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F))) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F) t]
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul t F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two_ne_zero F)]
    _ = t := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: binary_baseTail_eq_add_succ_succ
statement:
theorem binary_baseTail_eq_add_succ_succ (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.baseTail 2 n =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let t := RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1)
  have hvalid : RealTheory.ValidBase 2 := by
    unfold RealTheory.ValidBase
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
    omega
  have h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail_eq_mul_baseTail_succ
      F hvalid n
  change
    RealTheory.baseTail 2 n =
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) t at h
  rw [nat_two_eq_two] at h
  rw [h]
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two
  rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
  rfl

name: binary_baseExpansionEnvelope_zero

name: binary_baseExpansionPartial_succ_zero
statement:
theorem binary_baseExpansionPartial_succ_zero
    {digits : Nat -> Nat} {n : Nat}
    (hd : digits n = 0) :
    RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial F 2 digits (n + 1) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial F 2 digits n
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_succ]
  change
    F.add (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
        (RealTheory.baseWeightedDigit 2 (digits n) n) =
      RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n
  rw [hd, binary_baseWeightedDigit_zero n]
  change
    F.add (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n) F.zero =
      RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n
  rw [F.add_zero]

name: binary_baseExpansionPartial_succ_one
statement:
theorem binary_baseExpansionPartial_succ_one
    {digits : Nat -> Nat} {n : Nat}
    (hd : digits n = 1) :
    RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial F 2 digits (n + 1) =
      F.add
        (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_succ]
  change
    F.add (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
        (RealTheory.baseWeightedDigit 2 (digits n) n) =
      F.add
        (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1))
  rw [hd, binary_baseWeightedDigit_one n]

name: convexCombo_mono_endpoints
statement:
theorem convexCombo_mono_endpoints
    {theta a b c d : Point}
    (htheta : ConvexWeight theta)
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d) :
    RealTheory.le
      (ConvexCombo theta a c)
      (ConvexCombo theta b d)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ConvexCombo
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
        F hab
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F htheta.right))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
        F hcd htheta.left)

name: convexWeight_convexCombo
statement:
theorem convexWeight_convexCombo
    {theta a b : Point}
    (htheta : ConvexWeight theta)
    (ha : ConvexWeight a)
    (hb : ConvexWeight b) :
    ConvexWeight (ConvexCombo theta a b)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · have h :=
      convexCombo_mono_endpoints
        htheta ha.left hb.left
    rw [convexCombo_self theta RealTheory.zero] at h
    exact h
  · have h :=
      convexCombo_mono_endpoints
        htheta ha.right hb.right
    rw [convexCombo_self theta RealTheory.one] at h
    exact h

name: convexCombo_between_of_le
statement:
theorem convexCombo_between_of_le {theta x y : Point}
    (htheta : ConvexWeight theta)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    RealTheory.Between x (ConvexCombo theta x y) y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htheta_nonneg : F.le F.zero theta := htheta.left
  have hone_sub_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub F.one theta) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F htheta.right
  have hleft_raw :
      F.le
        (F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) x) (F.mul theta x))
        (F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) x) (F.mul theta y)) := by
    exact
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
        (F.le_refl (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) x))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
          F hxy htheta_nonneg)
  have hleft : F.le x (ConvexCombo theta x y) := by
    change
      RealTheory.le (ConvexCombo theta x x) (ConvexCombo theta x y)
      at hleft_raw
    rw [convexCombo_self theta x] at hleft_raw
    exact hleft_raw
  have hright_raw :
      F.le
        (F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) x) (F.mul theta y))
        (F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) y) (F.mul theta y)) := by
    exact
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
          F hxy hone_sub_nonneg)
        (F.le_refl (F.mul theta y))
  have hright : F.le (ConvexCombo theta x y) y := by
    change
      RealTheory.le (ConvexCombo theta x y) (ConvexCombo theta y y)
      at hright_raw
    rw [convexCombo_self theta y] at hright_raw
    exact hright_raw
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: convexSet_of_intervalSet
proof:
:= by
  intro theta x y htheta hx hy
  cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact hE x (ConvexCombo theta x y) y hx hy
        (convexCombo_between_of_le htheta hxy)
  | inr hyx =>
      have htheta' : ConvexWeight (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) :=
        convexWeight_one_sub htheta
      rw [convexCombo_symm theta x y]
      exact hE y
        (ConvexCombo (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) y x)
        x hy hx (convexCombo_between_of_le htheta' hyx)

name: eq_left_of_between_eq_endpoints
statement:
theorem eq_left_of_between_eq_endpoints {x y z : Point}
    (hbetween : RealTheory.Between x y z)
    (hxz : x = z) :
    y = x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [hxz] at hbetween
  have hyz : y = z :=
    F.le_antisymm hbetween.right hbetween.left
  rw [hxz]
  exact hyz

name: convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub
statement:
theorem convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub
    (theta x y : Point) :
    ConvexCombo theta x y =
      RealTheory.add x
        (RealTheory.mul theta (RealTheory.sub y x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ConvexCombo
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) x) (F.mul theta y) =
      F.add x (F.mul theta (F.sub y x))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F F.one theta x]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F theta y x]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg x (F.mul theta x)]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.mul theta y) (F.mul theta x)]
  calc
    F.add (F.add x (F.neg (F.mul theta x))) (F.mul theta y) =
        F.add x
          (F.add (F.neg (F.mul theta x)) (F.mul theta y)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ =
        F.add x
          (F.add (F.mul theta y) (F.neg (F.mul theta x))) := by
          rw [F.add_comm (F.neg (F.mul theta x)) (F.mul theta y)]

name: convexCombo_midpointWeight_eq_midpoint
statement:
theorem convexCombo_midpointWeight_eq_midpoint
    (x y : Point) :
    ConvexCombo MidpointWeight x y =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold MidpointWeight
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
  rw [convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.one) x y]
  change
    RealTheory.add x
        (RealTheory.mul
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.sub y x)) =
      RealTheory.add x
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (RealTheory.sub y x))
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
  unfold RealTheory.one RealTheory.mul
  rw [RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul_comm
    (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.inv
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base))
    (RealTheory.sub y x)]

name: midpointConvexOn_ordered_midpoint
statement:
theorem midpointConvexOn_ordered_midpoint
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hmid : MidpointConvexOn E f)
    {x y : Point} (hx : E x) (hy : E y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (f (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (f x) (f y))
proof:
:= by
  have h := hmid.right x y hx hy
  rw [convexCombo_midpointWeight_eq_midpoint x y] at h
  rw [convexCombo_midpointWeight_eq_midpoint (f x) (f y)] at h
  exact h

name: convexCombo_same_endpoints_sub
statement:
theorem convexCombo_same_endpoints_sub
    (a b x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (ConvexCombo b x y) (ConvexCombo a x y) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) (RealTheory.sub y x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := F.sub y x
  rw [convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub b x y]
  rw [convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub a x y]
  change
    F.sub (F.add x (F.mul b d)) (F.add x (F.mul a d)) =
      F.mul (F.sub b a) d
  calc
    F.sub (F.add x (F.mul b d)) (F.add x (F.mul a d)) =
        F.add (F.sub x x) (F.sub (F.mul b d) (F.mul a d)) := by
          exact
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
              F x (F.mul b d) x (F.mul a d)
    _ = F.add F.zero (F.sub (F.mul b d) (F.mul a d)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F x]
    _ = F.sub (F.mul b d) (F.mul a d) := by
          rw [F.zero_add]
    _ = F.mul (F.sub b a) d := by
          rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F b a d]

name: convexCombo_midpointWeight_same_segment
statement:
theorem convexCombo_midpointWeight_same_segment
    (a b x y : Point) :
    ConvexCombo MidpointWeight (ConvexCombo a x y) (ConvexCombo b x y) =
      ConvexCombo (ConvexCombo MidpointWeight a b) x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := MidpointWeight
  let d := F.sub y x
  rw [convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub h
    (ConvexCombo a x y) (ConvexCombo b x y)]
  rw [convexCombo_same_endpoints_sub a b x y]
  rw [convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub a x y]
  rw [convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub
    (ConvexCombo h a b) x y]
  rw [convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub h a b]
  change
    F.add (F.add x (F.mul a d))
        (F.mul h (F.mul (F.sub b a) d)) =
      F.add x
        (F.mul
          (F.add a (F.mul h (F.sub b a))) d)
  calc
    F.add (F.add x (F.mul a d))
        (F.mul h (F.mul (F.sub b a) d)) =
        F.add x
          (F.add (F.mul a d)
            (F.mul h (F.mul (F.sub b a) d))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ =
        F.add x
          (F.add (F.mul a d)
            (F.mul (F.mul h (F.sub b a)) d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.add x
          (F.mul
            (F.add a (F.mul h (F.sub b a))) d) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]

name: convexCombo_midpointWeight_left_add_delta
statement:
theorem convexCombo_midpointWeight_left_add_delta
    (p delta : Point) :
    ConvexCombo MidpointWeight p (RealTheory.add p delta) =
      RealTheory.add p
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base delta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub MidpointWeight p
    (RealTheory.add p delta)]
  unfold MidpointWeight
  change
    F.add p
        (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one)
          (F.sub (F.add p delta) p)) =
      F.add p (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F delta)
  rw [F.add_comm p delta]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F delta p]
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F)) delta]

name: binary_baseExpansionEnvelope_succ_zero
statement:
theorem binary_baseExpansionEnvelope_succ_zero
    {digits : Nat -> Nat} {n : Nat}
    (hd : digits n = 0) :
    RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2 digits (n + 1) =
      ConvexCombo MidpointWeight
        (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
        (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2 digits n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseExpansionEnvelope_eq_add]
  rw [binary_baseExpansionPartial_succ_zero hd]
  rw [baseExpansionEnvelope_eq_add 2 digits n]
  rw [convexCombo_midpointWeight_left_add_delta
    (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
    (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n)]
  rw [binary_baseTail_half_succ n]

name: binary_baseExpansionPartial_succ_one_as_midpoint
statement:
theorem binary_baseExpansionPartial_succ_one_as_midpoint
    {digits : Nat -> Nat} {n : Nat}
    (hd : digits n = 1) :
    RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits (n + 1) =
      ConvexCombo MidpointWeight
        (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
        (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2 digits n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [binary_baseExpansionPartial_succ_one hd]
  rw [baseExpansionEnvelope_eq_add 2 digits n]
  rw [convexCombo_midpointWeight_left_add_delta
    (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
    (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n)]
  rw [binary_baseTail_half_succ n]

name: binary_baseExpansionEnvelope_succ_one
statement:
theorem binary_baseExpansionEnvelope_succ_one
    {digits : Nat -> Nat} {n : Nat}
    (hd : digits n = 1) :
    RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2 digits (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2 digits n
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [baseExpansionEnvelope_eq_add]
  rw [binary_baseExpansionPartial_succ_one hd]
  rw [baseExpansionEnvelope_eq_add 2 digits n]
  change
    F.add
        (F.add (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
          (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1)))
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1)) =
      F.add (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n)
  rw [binary_baseTail_eq_add_succ_succ n]
  change
    F.add
        (F.add (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
          (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1)))
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1)) =
      F.add (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
        (F.add
          (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (n + 1)))
  rw [F.add_assoc]

name: midpointConvexOn_jensen_midpoint_weight
statement:
theorem midpointConvexOn_jensen_midpoint_weight
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {a b x y : Point}
    (hmid : MidpointConvexOn E f)
    (haW : ConvexWeight a)
    (hbW : ConvexWeight b)
    (hx : E x) (hy : E y)
    (ha :
      RealTheory.le
        (f (ConvexCombo a x y))
        (ConvexCombo a (f x) (f y)))
    (hb :
      RealTheory.le
        (f (ConvexCombo b x y))
        (ConvexCombo b (f x) (f y))) :
    RealTheory.le
      (f (ConvexCombo (ConvexCombo MidpointWeight a b) x y))
      (ConvexCombo (ConvexCombo MidpointWeight a b) (f x) (f y))
proof:
:= by
  let za := ConvexCombo a x y
  let zb := ConvexCombo b x y
  have hza : E za := by
    unfold za
    exact hmid.left a x y haW hx hy
  have hzb : E zb := by
    unfold zb
    exact hmid.left b x y hbW hx hy
  have hraw := hmid.right za zb hza hzb
  have hleft :
      ConvexCombo MidpointWeight za zb =
        ConvexCombo (ConvexCombo MidpointWeight a b) x y := by
    unfold za zb
    exact convexCombo_midpointWeight_same_segment a b x y
  rw [hleft] at hraw
  have hupper :
      RealTheory.le
        (ConvexCombo MidpointWeight (f za) (f zb))
        (ConvexCombo MidpointWeight
          (ConvexCombo a (f x) (f y))
          (ConvexCombo b (f x) (f y))) := by
    unfold za zb
    exact
      convexCombo_mono_endpoints
        midpointWeight_convexWeight ha hb
  have hright :
      ConvexCombo MidpointWeight
          (ConvexCombo a (f x) (f y))
          (ConvexCombo b (f x) (f y)) =
        ConvexCombo (ConvexCombo MidpointWeight a b) (f x) (f y) :=
    convexCombo_midpointWeight_same_segment a b (f x) (f y)
  rw [hright] at hupper
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hraw hupper

name: midpointConvexOn_binary_endpoint_jensen
statement:
theorem midpointConvexOn_binary_endpoint_jensen
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x y : Point}
    {digits : Nat -> Nat}
    (hmid : MidpointConvexOn E f)
    (hx : E x) (hy : E y)
    (hdigits : RealTheory.BaseDigitStream 2 digits) :
    forall n : Nat,
      And
        (And
          (ConvexWeight
            (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n))
          (RealTheory.le
            (f (ConvexCombo
              (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n) x y))
            (ConvexCombo
              (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n)
              (f x) (f y))))
        (And
          (ConvexWeight
            (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2 digits n))
          (RealTheory.le
            (f (ConvexCombo
              (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2 digits n) x y))
            (ConvexCombo
              (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2 digits n)
              (f x) (f y))))
  | 0 => by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · rw [baseExpansionPartial_zero]
        refine And.intro convexWeight_zero ?_
        rw [convexCombo_zero x y]
        rw [convexCombo_zero (f x) (f y)]
        exact RealTheory.le_refl (f x)
      · rw [binary_baseExpansionEnvelope_zero]
        refine And.intro convexWeight_one ?_
        rw [convexCombo_one x y]
        rw [convexCombo_one (f x) (f y)]
        exact RealTheory.le_refl (f y)
  | n + 1 => by
      have ih
proof:
:=
        midpointConvexOn_binary_endpoint_jensen
          hmid hx hy hdigits n
      let p := RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n
      let e := RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2 digits n
      have hpW : ConvexWeight p := ih.left.left
      have hpJ :
          RealTheory.le
            (f (ConvexCombo p x y))
            (ConvexCombo p (f x) (f y)) := ih.left.right
      have heW : ConvexWeight e := ih.right.left
      have heJ :
          RealTheory.le
            (f (ConvexCombo e x y))
            (ConvexCombo e (f x) (f y)) := ih.right.right
      have hmidW :
          ConvexWeight (ConvexCombo MidpointWeight p e) :=
        convexWeight_convexCombo midpointWeight_convexWeight hpW heW
      have hmidJ :
          RealTheory.le
            (f (ConvexCombo
              (ConvexCombo MidpointWeight p e) x y))
            (ConvexCombo
              (ConvexCombo MidpointWeight p e)
              (f x) (f y)) :=
        midpointConvexOn_jensen_midpoint_weight
          hmid hpW heW hx hy hpJ heJ
      cases binary_digit_zero_or_one (hdigits n) with
      | inl hzero =>
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · rw [binary_baseExpansionPartial_succ_zero hzero]
            exact And.intro hpW hpJ
          · rw [binary_baseExpansionEnvelope_succ_zero hzero]
            exact And.intro hmidW hmidJ
      | inr hone =>
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · rw [binary_baseExpansionPartial_succ_one_as_midpoint hone]
            exact And.intro hmidW hmidJ
          · rw [binary_baseExpansionEnvelope_succ_one hone]
            exact And.intro heW heJ

name: seqTendsto_convexCombo_weight
statement:
theorem seqTendsto_convexCombo_weight
    {u : Nat -> Point} {theta x y : Point}
    (hu : RealTheory.SeqTendsto u theta) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat => ConvexCombo (u n) x y)
      (ConvexCombo theta x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := F.sub y x
  have hxconst : RealTheory.SeqTendsto (fun _ : Nat => x) x :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_const x
  have hdconst : RealTheory.SeqTendsto (fun _ : Nat => d) d :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_const d
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat => F.mul (u n) d)
        (F.mul theta d) := by
    exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul hu hdconst
  have hadd := RealTheory.seqTendsto_add hxconst hmul
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat => F.add x (F.mul (u n) d))
      (F.add x (F.mul theta d)) at hadd
  have hseq :
      (fun n : Nat => ConvexCombo (u n) x y) =
        (fun n : Nat => F.add x (F.mul (u n) d)) := by
    funext n
    unfold d
    exact convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub (u n) x y
  have hlim :
      ConvexCombo theta x y =
        F.add x (F.mul theta d) := by
    unfold d
    exact convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub theta x y
  rw [hseq, hlim]
  exact hadd

name: continuousOn_midpointConvexOn_to_convexOn
statement:
theorem continuousOn_midpointConvexOn_to_convexOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hcont : ContinuousOn E f)
    (hmid : MidpointConvexOn E f) :
    ConvexOn E f
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hmid.left ?_
  intro theta x y htheta hx hy
  have hvalid : RealTheory.ValidBase 2 := by
    unfold RealTheory.ValidBase
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
    omega
  cases RealTheory.baseExpansion_exists hvalid
      theta htheta.left htheta.right with
  | intro digits hbase =>
      let p : Nat -> Point :=
        fun n : Nat => RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 digits n
      have hdigits : RealTheory.BaseDigitStream 2 digits :=
        RealTheory.hasBaseExpansion_digits hbase
      have hp_tendsto : RealTheory.SeqTendsto p theta := by
        unfold p
        exact RealTheory.hasBaseExpansion_tendsto hbase
      have hend :=
        midpointConvexOn_binary_endpoint_jensen
          hmid hx hy hdigits
      have hp_weight :
          forall n : Nat, ConvexWeight (p n) := by
        intro n
        exact (hend n).left.left
      have hp_jensen :
          forall n : Nat,
            RealTheory.le
              (f (ConvexCombo (p n) x y))
              (ConvexCombo (p n) (f x) (f y)) := by
        intro n
        exact (hend n).left.right
      have hztheta : E (ConvexCombo theta x y) :=
        hmid.left theta x y htheta hx hy
      have hz_seq :
          RealTheory.SeqTendsto
            (fun n : Nat => ConvexCombo (p n) x y)
            (ConvexCombo theta x y) :=
        seqTendsto_convexCombo_weight hp_tendsto
      have hz_mem :
          forall n : Nat, E (ConvexCombo (p n) x y) := by
        intro n
        exact hmid.left (p n) x y (hp_weight n) hx hy
      have hf_seq :
          RealTheory.SeqTendsto
            (fun n : Nat => f (ConvexCombo (p n) x y))
            (f (ConvexCombo theta x y)) :=
        (continuousOn_to_sequential hcont
          (ConvexCombo theta x y) hztheta).right
          (fun n : Nat => ConvexCombo (p n) x y)
          hz_mem hz_seq
      have hrhs_seq :
          RealTheory.SeqTendsto
            (fun n : Nat => ConvexCombo (p n) (f x) (f y))
            (ConvexCombo theta (f x) (f y)) :=
        seqTendsto_convexCombo_weight hp_tendsto
      exact
        RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le
          hf_seq hrhs_seq
          (Eventually.of_forall hp_jensen)

name: continuousOn_midpointConcaveOn_to_concaveOn
statement:
theorem continuousOn_midpointConcaveOn_to_concaveOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    (hcont : ContinuousOn E f)
    (hmid : MidpointConcaveOn E f) :
    ConcaveOn E f
proof:
:=
  continuousOn_midpointConvexOn_to_convexOn
    (continuousOn_neg hcont) hmid

name: left_sub_convexCombo_eq_weighted_sub
statement:
theorem left_sub_convexCombo_eq_weighted_sub
    (theta x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub x (ConvexCombo theta x y) =
      RealTheory.mul theta (RealTheory.sub x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub theta x y]
  change
    F.sub x (F.add x (F.mul theta (F.sub y x))) =
      F.mul theta (F.sub x y)
  calc
    F.sub x (F.add x (F.mul theta (F.sub y x))) =
        F.neg (F.mul theta (F.sub y x)) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F
            x (F.mul theta (F.sub y x))]
          calc
            F.add x
                (F.add (F.neg x)
                  (F.neg (F.mul theta (F.sub y x)))) =
                F.add (F.add x (F.neg x))
                  (F.neg (F.mul theta (F.sub y x))) := by
                  rw [<- F.add_assoc]
            _ = F.add F.zero
                  (F.neg (F.mul theta (F.sub y x))) := by
                  rw [F.add_neg]
            _ = F.neg (F.mul theta (F.sub y x)) := by
                  rw [F.zero_add]
    _ = F.mul theta (F.neg (F.sub y x)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F theta (F.sub y x)]
    _ = F.mul theta (F.sub x y) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x y]
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F (F.sub x y)]

name: convexWeight_between_of_lt
statement:
theorem convexWeight_between_of_lt {x y z : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hyz : RealTheory.le y z)
    (hxz : RealTheory.lt x z) :
    ConvexWeight
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub y x)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub z x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let den := F.sub z x
  let theta := F.mul (F.sub y x) (F.inv den)
  change ConvexWeight theta
  have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero den := by
    unfold den
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxz
  have hden_ne : Not (den = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos hzero.symm
  have hnum_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hxy
  have hnum_le_den : F.le (F.sub y x) den := by
    unfold den
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F hyz (F.le_refl x)
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · unfold theta
    exact F.mul_nonneg hnum_nonneg
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos))
  · by_cases hle : F.le theta F.one
    · exact hle
    · have hone_lt_theta : F.lt F.one theta := by
        cases F.le_total F.one theta with
        | inl hone_le_theta =>
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
              F hone_le_theta hle
        | inr htheta_le_one =>
            exact False.elim (hle htheta_le_one)
      have hmul_lt :
          F.lt (F.mul F.one den) (F.mul theta den) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right
          F hone_lt_theta hden_pos
      have htheta_den : F.mul theta den = F.sub y x := by
        unfold theta den
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
          F (F.sub y x) hden_ne
      rw [F.one_mul, htheta_den] at hmul_lt
      exact False.elim
        ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hmul_lt)
          hnum_le_den)

name: convexCombo_between_eq_of_lt
statement:
theorem convexCombo_between_eq_of_lt {x y z : Point}
    (hxz : RealTheory.lt x z) :
    ConvexCombo
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub y x)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub z x)))
        x z =
      y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let den := F.sub z x
  let theta := F.mul (F.sub y x) (F.inv den)
  have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero den := by
    unfold den
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxz
  have hden_ne : Not (den = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos hzero.symm
  change ConvexCombo theta x z = y
  calc
    ConvexCombo theta x z =
        F.add x (F.mul theta (F.sub z x)) :=
          convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub theta x z
    _ = F.add x (F.sub y x) := by
          unfold theta den
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
            F (F.sub y x) hden_ne]
    _ = y := by
          calc
            F.add x (F.sub y x) =
                F.add (F.sub y x) x := by rw [F.add_comm]
            _ = y := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y x

name: one_sub_leftWeight_eq_rightWeight
statement:
theorem one_sub_leftWeight_eq_rightWeight
    {a b c : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hbc : RealTheory.lt b c) :
    RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub b a)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub c a))) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub c b)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub c a))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dab := F.sub b a
  let dbc := F.sub c b
  let dac := F.sub c a
  have hac : F.lt a c :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hab hbc
  have hdac_pos : F.lt F.zero dac := by
    unfold dac
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hac
  have hdac_ne : Not (dac = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hdac_pos hzero.symm
  have hsum : F.add dbc dab = dac := by
    unfold dbc dab dac
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel F c b a
  have hdac_sub_dab : F.sub dac dab = dbc := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_right_cancel F (a := dab)
    calc
      F.add (F.sub dac dab) dab = dac :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F dac dab
      _ = F.add dbc dab := by
        exact Eq.symm hsum
  change F.sub F.one (F.mul dab (F.inv dac)) =
    F.mul dbc (F.inv dac)
  calc
    F.sub F.one (F.mul dab (F.inv dac)) =
        F.sub (F.mul dac (F.inv dac))
          (F.mul dab (F.inv dac)) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hdac_ne]
    _ = F.mul (F.sub dac dab) (F.inv dac) := by
          rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
            F dac dab (F.inv dac)]
    _ = F.mul dbc (F.inv dac) := by
          rw [hdac_sub_dab]

name: intervalSet_of_convexSet
proof:
:= by
  intro x y z hx hz hbetween
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxz_eq : x = z
  · have hyx : y = x :=
      eq_left_of_between_eq_endpoints hbetween hxz_eq
    rw [hyx]
    exact hx
  · have hxz_le : F.le x z :=
      F.le_trans hbetween.left hbetween.right
    have hxz_lt : F.lt x z := by
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxz_le
      intro hzx
      exact hxz_eq (F.le_antisymm hxz_le hzx)
    let theta :=
      F.mul (F.sub y x) (F.inv (F.sub z x))
    have htheta : ConvexWeight theta := by
      unfold theta
      exact convexWeight_between_of_lt
        hbetween.left hbetween.right hxz_lt
    have hcombo : ConvexCombo theta x z = y := by
      unfold theta
      exact convexCombo_between_eq_of_lt hxz_lt
    rw [<- hcombo]
    exact hE theta x z htheta hx hz

name: convexSet_iff_intervalSet
statement:
theorem convexSet_iff_intervalSet (E : Domain) :
    ConvexSet E <-> RealTheory.IsIntervalSet E
proof:
:= by
  exact Iff.intro intervalSet_of_convexSet convexSet_of_intervalSet

name: secantSlope_le_secantSlope_left
statement:
theorem secantSlope_le_secantSlope_left
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {a b c : Point}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (ha : E a) (hc : E c)
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hbc : RealTheory.lt b c) :
    RealTheory.le (SecantSlope f a b) (SecantSlope f a c)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hac : F.lt a c :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hab hbc
  let theta := F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (F.sub c a))
  have htheta : ConvexWeight theta := by
    unfold theta
    exact convexWeight_between_of_lt
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hbc)
      hac
  have hb_combo : ConvexCombo theta a c = b := by
    unfold theta
    exact convexCombo_between_eq_of_lt
      (x := a) (y := b) (z := c) hac
  have hineq :
      F.le (f b) (ConvexCombo theta (f a) (f c)) := by
    have hraw := hconv.right theta a c htheta ha hc
    rwa [hb_combo] at hraw
  have hsub :
      F.le (F.sub (f b) (f a))
        (F.sub (ConvexCombo theta (f a) (f c)) (f a)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F hineq (F.le_refl (f a))
  have hcombo_sub :
      F.sub (ConvexCombo theta (f a) (f c)) (f a) =
        F.mul theta (F.sub (f c) (f a)) := by
    rw [convexCombo_eq_left_add_weighted_sub theta (f a) (f c)]
    change
      F.sub
          (F.add (f a)
            (F.mul theta (F.sub (f c) (f a))))
          (f a) =
        F.mul theta (F.sub (f c) (f a))
    calc
      F.sub
          (F.add (f a)
            (F.mul theta (F.sub (f c) (f a))))
          (f a) =
          F.sub
            (F.add
              (F.mul theta (F.sub (f c) (f a)))
              (f a)) (f a) := by
            rw [F.add_comm]
      _ = F.mul theta (F.sub (f c) (f a)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel
              F (F.mul theta (F.sub (f c) (f a))) (f a)
  rw [hcombo_sub] at hsub
  have hweight :
      F.mul theta (F.sub (f c) (f a)) =
        F.mul (SecantSlope f a c) (F.sub b a) := by
    unfold theta
    exact weighted_increment_eq_secantSlope_mul
      f a c (F.sub b a)
  rw [hweight] at hsub
  exact secantSlope_le_of_increment_le hab hsub

name: secantSlope_le_secantSlope_right
statement:
theorem secantSlope_le_secantSlope_right
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {a b c : Point}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (ha : E a) (hc : E c)
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hbc : RealTheory.lt b c) :
    RealTheory.le (SecantSlope f a c) (SecantSlope f b c)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hac : F.lt a c :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hab hbc
  let theta := F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (F.sub c a))
  have htheta : ConvexWeight theta := by
    unfold theta
    exact convexWeight_between_of_lt
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hbc)
      hac
  have hb_combo : ConvexCombo theta a c = b := by
    unfold theta
    exact convexCombo_between_eq_of_lt
      (x := a) (y := b) (z := c) hac
  have hineq :
      F.le (f b) (ConvexCombo theta (f a) (f c)) := by
    have hraw := hconv.right theta a c htheta ha hc
    rwa [hb_combo] at hraw
  have hsub :
      F.le
        (F.sub (f c) (ConvexCombo theta (f a) (f c)))
        (F.sub (f c) (f b)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F (F.le_refl (f c)) hineq
  have hcombo_sub :
      F.sub (f c) (ConvexCombo theta (f a) (f c)) =
        F.mul (F.sub F.one theta) (F.sub (f c) (f a)) := by
    rw [convexCombo_symm theta (f a) (f c)]
    exact left_sub_convexCombo_eq_weighted_sub
      (F.sub F.one theta) (f c) (f a)
  rw [hcombo_sub] at hsub
  have hone :
      F.sub F.one theta =
        F.mul (F.sub c b) (F.inv (F.sub c a)) := by
    unfold theta
    exact one_sub_leftWeight_eq_rightWeight hab hbc
  rw [hone] at hsub
  have hweight :
      F.mul
          (F.mul (F.sub c b) (F.inv (F.sub c a)))
          (F.sub (f c) (f a)) =
        F.mul (SecantSlope f a c) (F.sub c b) :=
    weighted_increment_eq_secantSlope_mul f a c (F.sub c b)
  rw [hweight] at hsub
  exact le_secantSlope_of_mul_intervalLength_le hbc hsub

name: secantSlope_three_point
statement:
theorem secantSlope_three_point
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {a b c : Point}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (ha : E a) (hc : E c)
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hbc : RealTheory.lt b c) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le (SecantSlope f a b) (SecantSlope f a c))
      (RealTheory.le (SecantSlope f a c) (SecantSlope f b c))
proof:
:=
  And.intro
    (secantSlope_le_secantSlope_left hconv ha hc hab hbc)
    (secantSlope_le_secantSlope_right hconv ha hc hab hbc)

name: secantSlope_mono_fixed_left
statement:
theorem secantSlope_mono_fixed_left
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 x y : Point}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (hx0 : E x0) (hy : E y)
    (hx0x : RealTheory.lt x0 x)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y) :
    RealTheory.le (SecantSlope f x0 x) (SecantSlope f x0 y)
proof:
:=
  secantSlope_le_secantSlope_left
    hconv hx0 hy hx0x hxy

name: secantSlope_mono_fixed_right
statement:
theorem secantSlope_mono_fixed_right
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x y x0 : Point}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (hx : E x) (hx0 : E x0)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (hyx0 : RealTheory.lt y x0) :
    RealTheory.le (SecantSlope f x x0) (SecantSlope f y x0)
proof:
:=
  secantSlope_le_secantSlope_right
    hconv hx hx0 hxy hyx0

name: convexOn_right_increment_lower
statement:
theorem convexOn_right_increment_lower
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {u x0 x v : Point}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (hu : E u) (_hx0 : E x0) (hx : E x) (_hv : E v)
    (hux0 : RealTheory.lt u x0)
    (hx0x : RealTheory.lt x0 x)
    (_hxv : RealTheory.lt x v) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul (SecantSlope f u x0) (RealTheory.sub x x0))
      (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f x0))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft :
      F.le (SecantSlope f u x0) (SecantSlope f u x) :=
    secantSlope_le_secantSlope_left hconv hu hx hux0 hx0x
  have hright :
      F.le (SecantSlope f u x) (SecantSlope f x0 x) :=
    secantSlope_le_secantSlope_right hconv hu hx hux0 hx0x
  have hslope :
      F.le (SecantSlope f u x0) (SecantSlope f x0 x) :=
    F.le_trans hleft hright
  exact
    mul_intervalLength_le_increment_of_le_secantSlope
      hx0x hslope

name: convexOn_right_increment_upper
statement:
theorem convexOn_right_increment_upper
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {u x0 x v : Point}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (_hu : E u) (hx0 : E x0) (_hx : E x) (hv : E v)
    (_hux0 : RealTheory.lt u x0)
    (hx0x : RealTheory.lt x0 x)
    (hxv : RealTheory.lt x v) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f x0))
      (RealTheory.mul (SecantSlope f x0 v) (RealTheory.sub x x0))
proof:
:= by
  have hslope :
      RealTheory.le (SecantSlope f x0 x) (SecantSlope f x0 v) :=
    secantSlope_mono_fixed_left hconv hx0 hv hx0x hxv
  exact increment_le_of_secantSlope_le hx0x hslope

name: convexOn_left_increment_lower
statement:
theorem convexOn_left_increment_lower
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {u x x0 v : Point}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (hu : E u) (_hx : E x) (hx0 : E x0) (_hv : E v)
    (hux : RealTheory.lt u x)
    (hxx0 : RealTheory.lt x x0)
    (_hx0v : RealTheory.lt x0 v) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul (SecantSlope f u x0) (RealTheory.sub x0 x))
      (RealTheory.sub (f x0) (f x))
proof:
:= by
  have hslope :
      RealTheory.le (SecantSlope f u x0) (SecantSlope f x x0) :=
    secantSlope_le_secantSlope_right hconv hu hx0 hux hxx0
  exact
    mul_intervalLength_le_increment_of_le_secantSlope
      hxx0 hslope

name: convexOn_left_increment_upper
statement:
theorem convexOn_left_increment_upper
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {u x x0 v : Point}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (_hu : E u) (hx : E x) (_hx0 : E x0) (hv : E v)
    (_hux : RealTheory.lt u x)
    (hxx0 : RealTheory.lt x x0)
    (hx0v : RealTheory.lt x0 v) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub (f x0) (f x))
      (RealTheory.mul (SecantSlope f x0 v) (RealTheory.sub x0 x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft :
      F.le (SecantSlope f x x0) (SecantSlope f x v) :=
    secantSlope_le_secantSlope_left hconv hx hv hxx0 hx0v
  have hright :
      F.le (SecantSlope f x v) (SecantSlope f x0 v) :=
    secantSlope_le_secantSlope_right hconv hx hv hxx0 hx0v
  have hslope :
      F.le (SecantSlope f x x0) (SecantSlope f x0 v) :=
    F.le_trans hleft hright
  exact increment_le_of_secantSlope_le hxx0 hslope

name: convexOn_bracket_abs_increment_le
statement:
theorem convexOn_bracket_abs_increment_le
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {u x x0 v : Point}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (hu : E u) (hx : E x) (hx0 : E x0) (hv : E v)
    (hux0 : RealTheory.lt u x0)
    (hx0v : RealTheory.lt x0 v)
    (hxuv : RealTheory.OpenInterval u v x) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f x0)))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.max
          (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f u x0))
          (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f x0 v)))
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub x x0)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let B :=
    RealTheory.max
      (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f u x0))
      (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f x0 v))
  have hLB :
      F.le (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f u x0)) B := by
    unfold B
    exact
      RealTheory.le_max_left
        (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f u x0))
        (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f x0 v))
  have hRB :
      F.le (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f x0 v)) B := by
    unfold B
    exact
      RealTheory.le_max_right
        (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f u x0))
        (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f x0 v))
  change
    F.le
      (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (f x) (f x0)))
      (F.mul B (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x x0)))
  by_cases hxeq : x = x0
  · rw [hxeq]
    rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_self (f x0)]
    rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_self x0]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_zero F B]
    exact F.le_refl F.zero
  · cases F.le_total x x0 with
    | inl hxx0_le =>
        have hxx0 : F.lt x x0 := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxx0_le
          intro hx0x_le
          exact hxeq (F.le_antisymm hxx0_le hx0x_le)
        have hscale : F.le F.zero (F.sub x0 x) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxx0)
        have hlower :
            F.le
              (F.mul (SecantSlope f u x0) (F.sub x0 x))
              (F.sub (f x0) (f x)) :=
          convexOn_left_increment_lower
            hconv hu hx hx0 hv hxuv.left hxx0 hx0v
        have hupper :
            F.le
              (F.sub (f x0) (f x))
              (F.mul (SecantSlope f x0 v) (F.sub x0 x)) :=
          convexOn_left_increment_upper
            hconv hu hx hx0 hv hxuv.left hxx0 hx0v
        have hback :
            F.le
              (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (f x0) (f x)))
              (F.mul B (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x0 x))) :=
          abs_le_mul_abs_of_two_sided_mul_bounds
            hscale hlower hupper hLB hRB
        rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm (f x) (f x0)]
        rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm x x0]
        exact hback
    | inr hx0x_le =>
        have hx0x : F.lt x0 x := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx0x_le
          intro hxx0_le
          exact hxeq (F.le_antisymm hxx0_le hx0x_le)
        have hscale : F.le F.zero (F.sub x x0) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx0x)
        have hlower :
            F.le
              (F.mul (SecantSlope f u x0) (F.sub x x0))
              (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) :=
          convexOn_right_increment_lower
            hconv hu hx0 hx hv hux0 hx0x hxuv.right
        have hupper :
            F.le
              (F.sub (f x) (f x0))
              (F.mul (SecantSlope f x0 v) (F.sub x x0)) :=
          convexOn_right_increment_upper
            hconv hu hx0 hx hv hux0 hx0x hxuv.right
        exact
          abs_le_mul_abs_of_two_sided_mul_bounds
            hscale hlower hupper hLB hRB

name: convexOn_continuousAtOn_of_bracket
statement:
theorem convexOn_continuousAtOn_of_bracket
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {u x0 v : Point}
    (hconv : ConvexOn E f)
    (hu : E u) (hx0 : E x0) (hv : E v)
    (hux0 : RealTheory.lt u x0)
    (hx0v : RealTheory.lt x0 v) :
    ContinuousAtOn E f x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro hx0 ?_
  intro eps heps
  let B :=
    RealTheory.max
      (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f u x0))
      (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f x0 v))
  let K := F.add B F.one
  have hLB : F.le (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f u x0)) B := by
    unfold B
    exact
      RealTheory.le_max_left
        (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f u x0))
        (RealTheory.abs (SecantSlope f x0 v))
  have hB_nonneg : F.le F.zero B :=
    F.le_trans (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (SecantSlope f u x0)) hLB
  have hK_pos : F.lt F.zero K := by
    unfold K
    exact add_one_pos_of_nonneg hB_nonneg
  have hK_ne : Not (K = F.zero) := by
    intro hK_zero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hK_pos hK_zero.symm
  let eta := F.mul (F.inv K) eps
  have heta_pos : F.lt F.zero eta := by
    unfold eta
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hK_pos) heps
  let bracket :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F
      (F.sub x0 u) (F.sub v x0)
  have hleft_radius : F.lt F.zero (F.sub x0 u) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hux0
  have hright_radius : F.lt F.zero (F.sub v x0) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx0v
  have hbracket_pos : F.lt F.zero bracket := by
    unfold bracket
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
      F hleft_radius hright_radius
  let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F bracket eta
  have hdelta_pos : F.lt F.zero delta := by
    unfold delta
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
      F hbracket_pos heta_pos
  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
  refine And.intro hdelta_pos ?_
  intro x hx hxne hxd
  have hdelta_le_bracket : F.le delta bracket := by
    unfold delta
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F bracket eta
  have hxd_bracket : F.lt (dist x x0) bracket :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd hdelta_le_bracket
  have hxuv_raw :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval F u v x :=
    mem_interval_of_dist_lt_min hux0 hx0v hxd_bracket
  have hxuv : RealTheory.OpenInterval u v x := by
    change IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval F u v x
    exact hxuv_raw
  have hLip :
      F.le (dist (f x) (f x0))
        (F.mul B (dist x x0)) := by
    unfold dist
    change
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (f x) (f x0)))
        (F.mul B (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x x0)))
    exact
      convexOn_bracket_abs_increment_le
        hconv hu hx hx0 hv hux0 hx0v hxuv
  have hB_le_K : F.le B K := by
    unfold K
    exact RealTheory.le_add_one B
  have hdist_nonneg : F.le F.zero (dist x x0) := by
    unfold dist
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F (F.sub x x0)
  have hBdist_le_Kdist :
      F.le (F.mul B (dist x x0))
        (F.mul K (dist x x0)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hB_le_K hdist_nonneg
  have hdist_bound :
      F.le (dist (f x) (f x0))
        (F.mul K (dist x x0)) :=
    F.le_trans hLip hBdist_le_Kdist
  have hdelta_le_eta : F.le delta eta := by
    unfold delta
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F bracket eta
  have hxd_eta : F.lt (dist x x0) eta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd hdelta_le_eta
  have hKdist_lt_Keta :
      F.lt (F.mul K (dist x x0)) (F.mul K eta) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left F hxd_eta hK_pos
  have hKeta : F.mul K eta = eps := by
    unfold eta
    calc
      F.mul K (F.mul (F.inv K) eps) =
          F.mul (F.mul K (F.inv K)) eps := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul F.one eps := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hK_ne]
      _ = eps := by
            rw [F.one_mul]
  have hKdist_lt_eps : F.lt (F.mul K (dist x x0)) eps := by
    rwa [hKeta] at hKdist_lt_Keta
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
    F hdist_bound hKdist_lt_eps

name: convexSet_closedInterval
statement:
theorem convexSet_closedInterval (left right : Point) :
    ConvexSet (RealTheory.ClosedInterval left right)
proof:
:= by
  intro theta x y htheta hx hy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinterval :
      RealTheory.IsIntervalSet (RealTheory.ClosedInterval left right) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.intervalSet_closedInterval F left right
  cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact hinterval x (ConvexCombo theta x y) y hx hy
        (convexCombo_between_of_le htheta hxy)
  | inr hyx =>
      have htheta' : ConvexWeight (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) :=
        convexWeight_one_sub htheta
      rw [convexCombo_symm theta x y]
      exact hinterval y
        (ConvexCombo (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) y x)
        x hy hx (convexCombo_between_of_le htheta' hyx)

name: convexSet_openInterval
statement:
theorem convexSet_openInterval (left right : Point) :
    ConvexSet (RealTheory.OpenInterval left right)
proof:
:= by
  intro theta x y htheta hx hy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinterval :
      RealTheory.IsIntervalSet (RealTheory.OpenInterval left right) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.intervalSet_openInterval F left right
  cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact hinterval x (ConvexCombo theta x y) y hx hy
        (convexCombo_between_of_le htheta hxy)
  | inr hyx =>
      have htheta' : ConvexWeight (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) :=
        convexWeight_one_sub htheta
      rw [convexCombo_symm theta x y]
      exact hinterval y
        (ConvexCombo (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one theta) y x)
        x hy hx (convexCombo_between_of_le htheta' hyx)

name: convexOn_openInterval_continuousAtOn_of_mem
statement:
theorem convexOn_openInterval_continuousAtOn_of_mem
    {left right x0 : Point} {f : Map}
    (hconv : ConvexOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval left right) f)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.OpenInterval left right x0) :
    ContinuousAtOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval left right) f x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let u := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F left x0
  let v := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x0 right
  have hleftu : F.lt left u :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hx0.left
  have hux0 : F.lt u x0 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hx0.left
  have hx0v : F.lt x0 v :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hx0.right
  have hvright : F.lt v right :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hx0.right
  have hu : RealTheory.OpenInterval left right u :=
    And.intro hleftu
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hux0 hx0.right)
  have hv : RealTheory.OpenInterval left right v :=
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx0.left hx0v)
      hvright
  exact
    convexOn_continuousAtOn_of_bracket
      hconv hu hx0 hv hux0 hx0v

name: convexOn_closedInterval_continuousAtOn_of_interior
statement:
theorem convexOn_closedInterval_continuousAtOn_of_interior
    {left right x0 : Point} {f : Map}
    (hconv : ConvexOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval left right) f)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.OpenInterval left right x0) :
    ContinuousAtOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval left right) f x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hlr : F.lt left right :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx0.left hx0.right
  have hle_lr : F.le left right :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlr
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval left right left :=
    And.intro (F.le_refl left) hle_lr
  have hx0_closed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval left right x0 :=
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx0.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx0.right)
  have hright :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval left right right :=
    And.intro hle_lr (F.le_refl right)
  exact
    convexOn_continuousAtOn_of_bracket
      hconv hleft hx0_closed hright hx0.left hx0.right
