name: powNat_zero
statement:
theorem powNat_zero (x : Point) :
    powNat x 0 = RealTheory.one
proof: := rfl

name: powNat_succ
statement:
theorem powNat_succ (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    powNat x (n + 1) = RealTheory.mul (powNat x n) x
proof: := rfl

name: powNat_nat
statement:
theorem powNat_nat (a k : Nat) :
    powNat (RealTheory.nat a) k =
      RealTheory.nat (a ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero]
      change RealTheory.one = RealTheory.nat 1
      exact RealTheory.nat_one.symm
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ, ih, Nat.pow_succ]
      exact (RealTheory.nat_mul (a ^ k) a).symm

name: powNat_one
statement:
theorem powNat_one (x : Point) :
    powNat x 1 = x
proof:
:= by
  change RealTheory.mul (powNat x 0) x = x
  rw [powNat_zero]
  exact RealTheory.one_mul x

name: powNat_one_base
statement:
theorem powNat_one_base :
    forall n : Nat, powNat RealTheory.one n = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ, ih]
      exact RealTheory.mul_one RealTheory.one

name: powNat_zero_succ
statement:
theorem powNat_zero_succ (n : Nat) :
    powNat RealTheory.zero (n + 1) = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [powNat_succ]
  exact RealTheory.mul_zero (powNat RealTheory.zero n)

name: powNat_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ]
      exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg ih hx

name: powNat_pos
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero]
      exact RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ]
      exact RealTheory.mul_pos ih hx

name: powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero {x : Point}
    (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    forall n : Nat, Not (powNat x n = RealTheory.zero)
  | 0 => by
      rw [powNat_zero]
      exact RealTheory.one_ne_zero
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [powNat_succ]
      exact RealTheory.mul_ne_zero
        (powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hx n) hx

name: inv_powNat_succ_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem inv_powNat_succ_of_ne_zero
    {x : Point}
    (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.inv (powNat x (n + 1)) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (powNat x n)) (RealTheory.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [powNat_succ]
  exact RealTheory.inv_mul (powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hx n) hx

name: powNat_mul_inv_powNat_succ
statement:
theorem powNat_mul_inv_powNat_succ
    {x : Point}
    (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (powNat x n) (RealTheory.inv (powNat x (n + 1))) =
      RealTheory.inv x
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_powNat_succ_of_ne_zero hx n]
  rw [← RealTheory.mul_assoc]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel (powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hx n)]
  rw [RealTheory.one_mul]

name: abs_powNat
statement:
theorem abs_powNat (x : Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.abs (powNat x n) =
        powNat (RealTheory.abs x) n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero]
      rw [powNat_zero]
      exact RealTheory.abs_one
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ]
      rw [powNat_succ]
      change
        RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
              (powNat x n) x) =
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
            (powNat (RealTheory.abs x) n) (RealTheory.abs x)
      rw [RealTheory.abs_mul (powNat x n) x]
      rw [ih]

name: powNat_mono_nonneg
statement:
theorem powNat_mono_nonneg {x y : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    forall n : Nat, RealTheory.le (powNat x n) (powNat y n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  have hy : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero y :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hx hxy
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero, powNat_zero]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.one
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ, powNat_succ]
      have hleft :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (powNat x n) x)
            (RealTheory.mul (powNat y n) x) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right ih hx
      have hright :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (powNat y n) x)
            (RealTheory.mul (powNat y n) y) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hxy
          (powNat_nonneg hy n)
      exact RealTheory.le_trans hleft hright

name: one_le_powNat_of_one_le
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.one
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ]
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have h0x : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x :=
        RealTheory.le_trans
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
          hx
      have h := RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right ih h0x
      rw [RealTheory.one_mul] at h
      exact RealTheory.le_trans hx h

name: one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add
statement:
theorem one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add
    {eps : Point} (heps : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps))
        (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      change
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero eps))
          (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) 0)
      rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
      rw [powNat_zero]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.one
  | succ n ih =>
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let lhs :=
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps)
      let step := RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps
      have hstep_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero step := by
        unfold step
        exact RealTheory.le_trans
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
          (by
            rw [RealTheory.add_comm RealTheory.one eps]
            exact RealTheory.one_le_add_one_of_nonneg heps)
      have hmul :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul lhs step)
            (RealTheory.mul
              (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) n)
              step) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right ih hstep_nonneg
      have hpow :
          RealTheory.mul
              (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) n)
              step =
            powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) (n + 1) := by
        unfold step
        rw [powNat_succ]
      have hlhs_ge_one : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one lhs := by
        unfold lhs
        have hmul_nonneg :
            RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps) :=
          RealTheory.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg n) heps
        have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_left hmul_nonneg RealTheory.one
        rw [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
        exact h
      have heps_le :
          RealTheory.le eps (RealTheory.mul lhs eps) := by
        have h := RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hlhs_ge_one heps
        rwa [RealTheory.one_mul] at h
      have hadd_le :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.add lhs eps)
            (RealTheory.add lhs (RealTheory.mul lhs eps)) :=
        RealTheory.add_le_add_left heps_le lhs
      have hmul_expand :
          RealTheory.add lhs (RealTheory.mul lhs eps) =
            RealTheory.mul lhs step := by
        unfold step
        rw [RealTheory.mul_add]
        rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
      have hsucc_lhs :
          RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps) =
            RealTheory.add lhs eps := by
        unfold lhs
        rw [RealTheory.nat_succ]
        change
          RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat n) RealTheory.one)
                eps) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps))
              eps
        rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
        rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
        rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc]
      have htarget :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps))
            (RealTheory.mul lhs step) := by
        rw [hsucc_lhs]
        rwa [hmul_expand] at hadd_le
      rw [<- hpow]
      exact RealTheory.le_trans htarget hmul

name: one_sub_succ_nat_mul_le_one_sub_nat_mul_mul_one_sub
statement:
theorem one_sub_succ_nat_mul_le_one_sub_nat_mul_mul_one_sub
    {eps : Point} (heps : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps))
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let denSucc :=
    RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps)
  let den :=
    RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps)
  have hterm_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps) :=
    RealTheory.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg n) heps
  have hden_le_one : RealTheory.le den RealTheory.one := by
    unfold den
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic
      F hterm_nonneg
  have heps_mul_den_le_eps :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul eps den) eps := by
    have h := RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hden_le_one heps
    change
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul eps den)
        (RealTheory.mul eps RealTheory.one) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.mul_one] at h
  have hdenSucc_eq :
      denSucc = RealTheory.sub den eps := by
    have hsucc_mul :
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps) eps := by
      rw [RealTheory.nat_succ]
      change
        F.mul (F.add (RealTheory.nat n) F.one) eps =
          F.add (F.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps) eps
      rw [F.add_mul]
      rw [F.one_mul]
    unfold denSucc den
    rw [hsucc_mul]
    exact Eq.symm
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add F
        RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps)
        eps)
  have hprod_eq :
      RealTheory.mul den (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one eps) =
        RealTheory.sub den (RealTheory.mul eps den) := by
    change
      F.mul den (F.sub F.one eps) =
        F.sub den (F.mul eps den)
    calc
      F.mul den (F.sub F.one eps) =
          F.sub (F.mul den F.one)
            (F.mul den eps) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F]
      _ =
          F.sub den (F.mul eps den) := by
            rw [F.mul_one]
            rw [F.mul_comm den eps]
  change RealTheory.le denSucc
    (RealTheory.mul den (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one eps))
  rw [hdenSucc_eq, hprod_eq]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
    F (RealTheory.le_refl den) heps_mul_den_le_eps

name: one_sub_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_sub
statement:
theorem one_sub_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_sub
    {eps : Point} (heps : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps)
    (hbase_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one eps)) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps))
        (powNat (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one eps) n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change
        F.le
          (F.sub F.one (F.mul F.zero eps))
          (powNat (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one eps) 0)
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F eps]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F]
      rw [powNat_zero]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.one
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ]
      have hstep :=
        one_sub_succ_nat_mul_le_one_sub_nat_mul_mul_one_sub
          heps n
      have hmul :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps))
              (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one eps))
            (RealTheory.mul
              (powNat (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one eps) n)
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one eps)) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right ih hbase_nonneg
      exact RealTheory.le_trans hstep hmul

name: powNat_one_sub_le_one
statement:
theorem powNat_one_sub_le_one
    {eps : Point} (heps : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps)
    (hbase_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one eps))
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one eps) n)
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hbase_le_one :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one eps)
        RealTheory.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base heps
  have h :=
    powNat_mono_nonneg hbase_nonneg hbase_le_one n
  rwa [powNat_one_base n] at h

name: nat_succ_le_powNat_two
statement:
theorem nat_succ_le_powNat_two (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
      (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) n)
proof:
:= by
  have hbern :=
    one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
      n
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) RealTheory.one) =
        RealTheory.nat (n + 1) := by
    rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
    rw [RealTheory.add_comm]
    exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.nat_succ n)
  rwa [hleft] at hbern

name: nat_le_powNat_two
statement:
theorem nat_le_powNat_two (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat n)
      (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) n)
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc := nat_succ_le_powNat_two n
  exact RealTheory.le_trans
    (RealTheory.nat_le_nat_succ n) hsucc

name: self_le_powNat_succ_of_one_le
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rw [powNat_succ]
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h0x : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x :=
    RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
      hx
  have hpow : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (powNat x n) :=
    one_le_powNat_of_one_le hx n
  have h := RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hpow h0x
  rw [RealTheory.one_mul] at h
  exact h

name: le_powNat_add_one_succ_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem le_powNat_add_one_succ_of_nonneg {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.le x
        (powNat (RealTheory.add x RealTheory.one) (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  have hxstep :
      RealTheory.le x (RealTheory.add x RealTheory.one) :=
    RealTheory.le_add_one x
  have hstep_pow :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.add x RealTheory.one)
        (powNat (RealTheory.add x RealTheory.one) (n + 1)) :=
    self_le_powNat_succ_of_one_le
      (RealTheory.one_le_add_one_of_nonneg hx) n
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hxstep hstep_pow

name: powNat_mul
statement:
theorem powNat_mul (x y : Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      powNat (RealTheory.mul x y) n =
        RealTheory.mul (powNat x n) (powNat y n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero, powNat_zero, powNat_zero]
      exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.mul_one RealTheory.one)
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ, powNat_succ, powNat_succ, ih]
      exact RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm (powNat x n) (powNat y n) x y

name: powNat_mul_factor_le_succ
statement:
theorem powNat_mul_factor_le_succ
    {base factor : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero base)
    (hfactor : RealTheory.le (powNat factor n) base) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat (RealTheory.mul base factor) n)
      (powNat base (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [powNat_mul]
  rw [powNat_succ]
  exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
    hfactor (powNat_nonneg hbase n)

name: powNat_add
statement:
theorem powNat_add (x : Point) (m : Nat) :
    forall n : Nat,
      powNat x (m + n) =
        RealTheory.mul (powNat x m) (powNat x n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [Nat.add_zero, powNat_zero]
      exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.mul_one (powNat x m))
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.add_succ, powNat_succ, ih, powNat_succ]
      exact RealTheory.mul_assoc (powNat x m) (powNat x n) x

name: powNat_two
statement:
theorem powNat_two (x : Point) :
    powNat x 2 = RealTheory.mul x x
proof:
:= by
  change
    RealTheory.mul (powNat x 1) x =
      RealTheory.mul x x
  rw [powNat_one]

name: powNat_two_pos_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [powNat_two]
  change F.lt F.zero (F.mul x x)
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl h0x =>
      have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0x
        intro hx0
        exact hx (F.le_antisymm hx0 h0x)
      exact F.mul_pos hxpos hxpos
  | inr hx0 =>
      have hxneg : F.lt x F.zero := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx0
        intro h0x
        exact hx (F.le_antisymm hx0 h0x)
      have hnegpos : F.lt F.zero (F.neg x) := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hxneg
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
      have hsq : F.lt F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) :=
        F.mul_pos hnegpos hnegpos
      rwa [F.neg_mul_neg] at hsq

name: powNat_add_self
statement:
theorem powNat_add_self (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    powNat x (n + n) =
      RealTheory.mul (powNat x n) (powNat x n)
proof:
:=
  powNat_add x n n

name: powNat_add_self_pos_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [powNat_add_self]
  have hpow_ne : Not (powNat x n = RealTheory.zero) :=
    powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hx n
  have hsq := powNat_two_pos_of_ne_zero (x := powNat x n) hpow_ne
  rwa [powNat_two] at hsq

name: powNat_add_self_succ_pos_of_pos
proof:
:= by
  exact powNat_pos hx (n + n + 1)

name: powNat_add_self_succ_neg_of_neg
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [powNat_succ]
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx
  have heven_pos : F.lt F.zero (powNat x (n + n)) :=
    powNat_add_self_pos_of_ne_zero hxne
  have hmul := F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hx heven_pos
  change
    F.lt (F.mul (powNat x (n + n)) x)
      (F.mul (powNat x (n + n)) F.zero) at hmul
  rwa [F.mul_zero] at hmul

name: powNat_powNat
statement:
theorem powNat_powNat (x : Point) (m : Nat) :
    forall n : Nat,
      powNat (powNat x m) n =
        powNat x (m * n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [Nat.mul_zero, powNat_zero, powNat_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, powNat_succ, ih]
      exact Eq.symm (powNat_add x (m * n) m)

name: powNat_two_one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add_double
statement:
theorem powNat_two_one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add_double
    {eps : Point} (heps : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps)
    (m : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) eps))
        2)
      (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) (m + m))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let lower :=
    RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) eps)
  let base := RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps
  have hbern :
      RealTheory.le lower (powNat base m) := by
    unfold lower base
    exact one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add heps m
  have hterm_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) eps) :=
    RealTheory.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg m) heps
  have hlower_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero lower := by
    unfold lower
    exact RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
      (by
        rw [RealTheory.add_comm RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) eps)]
        exact RealTheory.one_le_add_one_of_nonneg hterm_nonneg)
  have hsquare :
      RealTheory.le (powNat lower 2)
        (powNat (powNat base m) 2) :=
    powNat_mono_nonneg hlower_nonneg hbern 2
  have hpow :
      powNat (powNat base m) 2 =
        powNat base (m + m) := by
    rw [powNat_powNat]
    have hmul : m * 2 = m + m := by omega
    rw [hmul]
  rwa [hpow] at hsquare

name: one_sub_succ_nat_mul_add_eq_one_sub_nat_mul
statement:
private theorem one_sub_succ_nat_mul_add_eq_one_sub_nat_mul
    (eps : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps)) eps =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [RealTheory.nat_succ]
  change
    F.add
      (F.sub F.one
        (F.mul (F.add (RealTheory.nat n) F.one) eps))
      eps =
      F.sub F.one (F.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps)
  rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add F
    F.one (F.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps) eps]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F
    (F.sub F.one (F.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps)) eps

name: one_add_mul_one_sub_succ_nat_mul_le_one_sub_nat_mul
statement:
theorem one_add_mul_one_sub_succ_nat_mul_le_one_sub_nat_mul
    {eps : Point} (heps : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps)
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps)))
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let denSucc :=
    RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps)
  let den :=
    RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps)
  have hterm_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps) :=
    RealTheory.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg (n + 1)) heps
  have hdenSucc_le_one : RealTheory.le denSucc RealTheory.one := by
    unfold denSucc
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic
      F hterm_nonneg
  have hprod_le_eps :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul eps denSucc) eps := by
    have h :=
      RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
        hdenSucc_le_one heps
    change
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul eps denSucc)
        (RealTheory.mul eps RealTheory.one) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.mul_one] at h
  have hdenSucc_add_eps :
      RealTheory.add denSucc eps = den :=
    one_sub_succ_nat_mul_add_eq_one_sub_nat_mul eps n
  have hexpand :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps)
          denSucc =
        RealTheory.add denSucc
          (RealTheory.mul eps denSucc) := by
    calc
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps)
          denSucc =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one denSucc)
            (RealTheory.mul eps denSucc) := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
      _ =
          RealTheory.add denSucc
            (RealTheory.mul eps denSucc) := by
          rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
  rw [show
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps) =
        denSucc from rfl]
  rw [show
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps) =
        den from rfl]
  rw [hexpand]
  have hadd :=
    RealTheory.add_le_add_left hprod_le_eps denSucc
  rwa [hdenSucc_add_eps] at hadd

name: powNat_one_add_mul_one_sub_nat_mul_le_one
statement:
theorem powNat_one_add_mul_one_sub_nat_mul_le_one
    {eps : Point} (heps : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps) :
    forall m : Nat,
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) eps)) ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul
            (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) m)
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) eps)))
          RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      intro _hden
      change
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) 0)
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 0) eps)))
          RealTheory.one
      rw [powNat_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.nat_zero]
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change
        F.le
          (F.mul F.one
            (F.sub F.one (F.mul F.zero eps)))
          F.one
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F eps]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F]
      rw [F.one_mul]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.one
  | succ n ih =>
      intro hdenSucc
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let base := RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps
      let denSucc :=
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps)
      let den :=
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps)
      have hbase_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero base := by
        unfold base
        exact RealTheory.le_trans
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
          (by
            rw [RealTheory.add_comm RealTheory.one eps]
            exact RealTheory.one_le_add_one_of_nonneg heps)
      have hpow_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (powNat base n) :=
        powNat_nonneg hbase_nonneg n
      have hden_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero den := by
        have hdenSucc_add_eps :
            RealTheory.add denSucc eps = den :=
          one_sub_succ_nat_mul_add_eq_one_sub_nat_mul eps n
        rw [<- hdenSucc_add_eps]
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
          hdenSucc heps
        change F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero)
          (F.add denSucc eps) at h
        rwa [F.zero_add] at h
      have hih :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (powNat base n) den)
            RealTheory.one := by
        exact ih hden_nonneg
      have hfactor :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul base denSucc) den := by
        unfold base denSucc den
        exact one_add_mul_one_sub_succ_nat_mul_le_one_sub_nat_mul
          heps n
      have hmul :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (powNat base n)
              (RealTheory.mul base denSucc))
            (RealTheory.mul (powNat base n) den) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hfactor hpow_nonneg
      have htarget :
          RealTheory.mul (powNat base (n + 1)) denSucc =
            RealTheory.mul (powNat base n)
              (RealTheory.mul base denSucc) := by
        rw [powNat_succ]
        rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      change
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul (powNat base (n + 1)) denSucc)
          RealTheory.one
      rw [htarget]
      exact RealTheory.le_trans hmul hih

name: powNat_one_add_le_inv_one_sub_nat_mul
statement:
theorem powNat_one_add_le_inv_one_sub_nat_mul
    {eps : Point} (heps : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps)
    {m : Nat}
    (hden_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) eps))) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) m)
      (RealTheory.inv
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) eps)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let den :=
    RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) eps)
  have hden_ne : Not (den = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos hzero.symm
  have hinv_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv den) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos)
  have hprod :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul
          (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) m) den)
        RealTheory.one := by
    unfold den
    exact powNat_one_add_mul_one_sub_nat_mul_le_one
      heps m (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hden_pos)
  have h := RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
    hprod hinv_nonneg
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) m) den)
        (RealTheory.inv den))
      (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv den)) at h
  change
    F.le
      (F.mul
        (F.mul
          (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) m) den)
        (F.inv den))
      (F.mul F.one (F.inv den)) at h
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right
    F (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) m) hden_ne] at h
  rwa [F.one_mul] at h

name: powNat_strictMono_nonneg_succ
statement:
theorem powNat_strictMono_nonneg_succ {x y : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.lt (powNat x (n + 1)) (powNat y (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_one, powNat_one]
      exact hxy
  | succ n ih =>
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      rw [powNat_succ, powNat_succ]
      have hypos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hx hxy
      have hxpow_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (powNat x (n + 1)) :=
        powNat_nonneg hx (n + 1)
      have hleft :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (powNat x (n + 1)) x)
            (RealTheory.mul (powNat x (n + 1)) y) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxy) hxpow_nonneg
      have hright :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul (powNat x (n + 1)) y)
            (RealTheory.mul (powNat y (n + 1)) y) :=
        RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_right ih hypos
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hleft hright

name: powerFun_zero
statement:
theorem powerFun_zero :
    PowerFun 0 = fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  rfl

name: powerFun_succ
statement:
theorem powerFun_succ (n : Nat) :
    PowerFun (n + 1) =
      MulFun (PowerFun n) IdentityFun
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  rfl

name: continuousOn_powerFun
statement:
theorem continuousOn_powerFun {E : Domain} (n : Nat) :
    ContinuousOn E (PowerFun n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powerFun_zero]
      exact continuousOn_const
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powerFun_succ n]
      exact continuousOn_mul ih continuousOn_identity

name: continuousAtOn_powerFun
proof:
:=
  continuousOn_powerFun n x0 hx0

name: eulerNumberSequence_eq_expSequence_one
statement:
theorem eulerNumberSequence_eq_expSequence_one :
    EulerNumberSequence =
      Route.EulerLimit.ExpSequence RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  unfold EulerNumberSequence Route.EulerLimit.ExpSequence
  change
    powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (n + 1))))
        (n + 1) =
      powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (n + 1)))))
        (n + 1)
  rw [RealTheory.one_mul]

name: eulerNumber_isEulerNumber
statement:
theorem eulerNumber_isEulerNumber :
    IsEulerNumber eulerNumber
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsEulerNumber eulerNumber
  rw [eulerNumberSequence_eq_expSequence_one]
  exact package.exp_formula RealTheory.one

name: nat_succ_mul_inv_succ
statement:
theorem nat_succ_mul_inv_succ
    (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.mul x
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  have hN_ne : Not (N = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold N
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  change F.mul N (F.mul x (F.inv N)) = x
  calc
    F.mul N (F.mul x (F.inv N)) =
        F.mul N (F.mul (F.inv N) x) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm x (F.inv N)]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.mul N (F.inv N)) x := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul F.one x := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hN_ne]
    _ = x := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: expSequence_upper_inv_one_sub
statement:
theorem expSequence_upper_inv_one_sub
    {x : Point}
    (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le (ExpSequence x n)
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let eps :=
    RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
  have hden_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
  have heps_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps := by
    unfold eps
    exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hxnonneg
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos))
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps = x := by
    unfold eps
    exact nat_succ_mul_inv_succ x n
  have hden_sub :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps) =
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x := by
    rw [hmul]
  have hden_target_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxlt
  have hupper :=
    powNat_one_add_le_inv_one_sub_nat_mul
      heps_nonneg (m := n + 1)
      (by rwa [hden_sub])
  simpa [ExpSequence, eps, hden_sub] using hupper

name: expSequence_boundedAbove_local
statement:
theorem expSequence_boundedAbove_local
    {x : Point}
    (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.SeqBoundedAbove (ExpSequence x)
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro
    (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)) ?_
  intro n
  exact expSequence_upper_inv_one_sub hxnonneg hxlt n

name: localExpConvergence_of_monotone
statement:
theorem localExpConvergence_of_monotone :
    (forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x ->
        RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one ->
          RealTheory.MonotoneIncreasing (ExpSequence x)) ->
      LocalExpConvergence
proof:
:= by
  intro hmono x hxnonneg hxlt
  exact RealTheory.monotone_increasing_converges
    (hmono x hxnonneg hxlt)
    (expSequence_boundedAbove_local hxnonneg hxlt)

name: localExpConvergence_of_step
statement:
theorem localExpConvergence_of_step :
    (forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x ->
        RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one ->
          forall n : Nat,
            RealTheory.le
              (ExpSequence x n) (ExpSequence x (n + 1))) ->
      LocalExpConvergence
proof:
:= by
  intro hstep
  exact localExpConvergence_of_monotone
    (fun x hxnonneg hxlt =>
      RealTheory.monotoneIncreasing_of_step
        (hstep x hxnonneg hxlt))

name: expStepSum_pos
statement:
theorem expStepSum_pos
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hN_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hN_le :
      F.le (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))
        (F.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
      F hxnonneg (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))
    change
      F.le (F.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) F.zero)
        (F.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hN_pos hN_le

name: expStepRightBase_nonneg
statement:
theorem expStepRightBase_nonneg
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (expStepRightBase x n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hden_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hterm_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul x
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)))) :=
    RealTheory.mul_nonneg hxnonneg
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos))
  unfold expStepRightBase
  exact RealTheory.le_trans
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
    (by
      rw [RealTheory.add_comm RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul x
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))))]
      exact RealTheory.one_le_add_one_of_nonneg hterm_nonneg)

name: expStepCorrection_nonneg
statement:
theorem expStepCorrection_nonneg
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (expStepCorrection x n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let S := RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x
  have hn_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
  have hS_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero S := by
    unfold S
    exact expStepSum_pos hxnonneg n
  have hden_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) S) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hn_pos hS_pos
  unfold expStepCorrection
  change
    F.le F.zero
      (F.mul x (F.inv (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) S)))
  exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hxnonneg
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos))

name: expStepCorrection_scaled
statement:
theorem expStepCorrection_scaled
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (expStepCorrection x n) =
      RealTheory.mul x
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let M := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  let S := RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x
  have hM_ne : Not (M = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold M
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  have hS_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero S := by
    unfold S
    exact expStepSum_pos hxnonneg n
  have hS_ne : Not (S = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hS_pos hzero.symm
  unfold expStepCorrection
  change
    F.mul M (F.mul x (F.inv (F.mul M S))) =
      F.mul x (F.inv S)
  calc
    F.mul M (F.mul x (F.inv (F.mul M S))) =
        F.mul x (F.mul M (F.inv (F.mul M S))) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
          rw [F.mul_comm M x]
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul x (F.mul M (F.mul (F.inv S) (F.inv M))) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hM_ne hS_ne]
    _ =
        F.mul x (F.mul (F.mul M (F.inv M)) (F.inv S)) := by
          have hinner :
              F.mul M (F.mul (F.inv S) (F.inv M)) =
                F.mul (F.mul M (F.inv M)) (F.inv S) := by
            calc
              F.mul M (F.mul (F.inv S) (F.inv M)) =
                  F.mul M (F.mul (F.inv M) (F.inv S)) := by
                    rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv S) (F.inv M)]
              _ = F.mul (F.mul M (F.inv M)) (F.inv S) := by
                    rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
          rw [hinner]
    _ =
        F.mul x (F.mul F.one (F.inv S)) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hM_ne]
    _ = F.mul x (F.inv S) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: expStepCorrection_den_eq
statement:
theorem expStepCorrection_den_eq
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (expStepCorrection x n)) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := RealTheory.nat (n + 2)
  let S := RealTheory.add N x
  have hS_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero S := by
    unfold S N
    exact expStepSum_pos hxnonneg n
  have hS_ne : Not (S = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hS_pos hzero.symm
  have hscaled := expStepCorrection_scaled hxnonneg n
  have hscaledS :
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (expStepCorrection x n) =
        F.mul x (F.inv S) := by
    unfold S N
    exact hscaled
  change
    F.sub F.one
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (expStepCorrection x n)) =
      F.mul N (F.inv S)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_right_cancel F
    (a := F.mul x (F.inv S))
  calc
    F.add
        (F.sub F.one
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (expStepCorrection x n)))
        (F.mul x (F.inv S)) =
        F.add
          (F.sub F.one
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
              (expStepCorrection x n)))
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (expStepCorrection x n)) := by
          rw [<- hscaledS]
    _ = F.one := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
            F F.one
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
              (expStepCorrection x n))
    _ = F.mul S (F.inv S) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hS_ne]
    _ = F.mul (F.add N x) (F.inv S) := by
          rfl
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul N (F.inv S))
          (F.mul x (F.inv S)) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]

name: expStepRightBase_eq_sum_mul_inv_nat
statement:
theorem expStepRightBase_eq_sum_mul_inv_nat
    (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    expStepRightBase x n =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := RealTheory.nat (n + 2)
  have hN_ne : Not (N = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold N
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  unfold expStepRightBase
  change F.add F.one (F.mul x (F.inv N)) =
    F.mul (F.add N x) (F.inv N)
  calc
    F.add F.one (F.mul x (F.inv N)) =
        F.add (F.mul N (F.inv N)) (F.mul x (F.inv N)) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hN_ne]
    _ = F.mul (F.add N x) (F.inv N) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]

name: expStepCorrection_inv_den_eq_rightBase
statement:
theorem expStepCorrection_inv_den_eq_rightBase
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.inv
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (expStepCorrection x n))) =
      expStepRightBase x n
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := RealTheory.nat (n + 2)
  let S := RealTheory.add N x
  have hN_ne : Not (N = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold N
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hS_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero S := by
    unfold S N
    exact expStepSum_pos hxnonneg n
  have hS_ne : Not (S = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hS_pos hzero.symm
  have hleft_ne :
      Not (F.mul N (F.inv S) = F.zero) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F hN_ne
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F hS_ne)
  have hinv :
      F.mul S (F.inv N) =
        F.inv (F.mul N (F.inv S)) := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left F hleft_ne
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul N (F.inv S)) (F.mul S (F.inv N)) =
          F.mul N (F.mul (F.inv S) (F.mul S (F.inv N))) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul N (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv S) S) (F.inv N)) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc (F.inv S) S (F.inv N)]
      _ = F.mul N (F.mul F.one (F.inv N)) := by
            rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hS_ne]
      _ = F.mul N (F.inv N) := by
            rw [F.one_mul]
      _ = F.one := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hN_ne]
  have hden :
      F.sub F.one
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (expStepCorrection x n)) =
        F.mul N (F.inv S) := by
    unfold S N
    exact expStepCorrection_den_eq hxnonneg n
  change
    F.inv
        (F.sub F.one
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (expStepCorrection x n))) =
      expStepRightBase x n
  rw [hden]
  calc
    F.inv (F.mul N (F.inv S)) =
        F.mul S (F.inv N) := hinv.symm
    _ = expStepRightBase x n := by
          unfold S N
          change
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))) =
            expStepRightBase x n
          rw [expStepRightBase_eq_sum_mul_inv_nat x n]

name: expStepCorrection_factor_bound
statement:
theorem expStepCorrection_factor_bound
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (expStepCorrection x n))
        (n + 1))
      (expStepRightBase x n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let den :=
    RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (expStepCorrection x n))
  have hN_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hS_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x) :=
    expStepSum_pos hxnonneg n
  have hden_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero den := by
    unfold den
    rw [expStepCorrection_den_eq hxnonneg n]
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos hN_pos
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hS_pos)
  have h :=
    powNat_one_add_le_inv_one_sub_nat_mul
      (expStepCorrection_nonneg hxnonneg n)
      (m := n + 1) hden_pos
  unfold den at h
  rw [expStepCorrection_inv_den_eq_rightBase hxnonneg n] at h
  exact h

name: expStepLeftBase_mul_nat_eq_sum
statement:
theorem expStepLeftBase_mul_nat_eq_sum (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (expStepLeftBase x n) =
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let M := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  have hM_ne : Not (M = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold M
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  unfold expStepLeftBase
  change F.mul M (F.add F.one (F.mul x (F.inv M))) =
    F.add M x
  calc
    F.mul M (F.add F.one (F.mul x (F.inv M))) =
        F.add (F.mul M F.one) (F.mul M (F.mul x (F.inv M))) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
    _ = F.add M (F.mul M (F.mul x (F.inv M))) := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = F.add M (F.mul x (F.mul M (F.inv M))) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
          rw [F.mul_comm M x]
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.add M (F.mul x F.one) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hM_ne]
    _ = F.add M x := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: expStepRightBase_mul_scaled_correction
statement:
theorem expStepRightBase_mul_scaled_correction
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (expStepRightBase x n)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (expStepCorrection x n)) =
      RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := RealTheory.nat (n + 2)
  let S := RealTheory.add N x
  have hN_ne : Not (N = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold N
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hS_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero S := by
    unfold S N
    exact expStepSum_pos hxnonneg n
  have hS_ne : Not (S = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hS_pos hzero.symm
  have hB :
      expStepRightBase x n = F.mul S (F.inv N) := by
    unfold S N
    change
      expStepRightBase x n =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)))
    exact expStepRightBase_eq_sum_mul_inv_nat x n
  have hc :
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (expStepCorrection x n) =
        F.mul x (F.inv S) := by
    unfold S N
    exact expStepCorrection_scaled hxnonneg n
  rw [hB]
  change
    F.mul (F.mul S (F.inv N))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (expStepCorrection x n)) =
      F.mul x (F.inv N)
  rw [hc]
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul S (F.inv N)) (F.mul x (F.inv S)) =
        F.mul x (F.mul (F.mul S (F.inv S)) (F.inv N)) := by
          calc
            F.mul (F.mul S (F.inv N)) (F.mul x (F.inv S)) =
                F.mul S (F.mul (F.inv N) (F.mul x (F.inv S))) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
            _ = F.mul S (F.mul x (F.mul (F.inv N) (F.inv S))) := by
                  rw [<- F.mul_assoc (F.inv N) x (F.inv S)]
                  rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv N) x]
                  rw [F.mul_assoc x (F.inv N) (F.inv S)]
            _ = F.mul x (F.mul S (F.mul (F.inv N) (F.inv S))) := by
                  calc
                    F.mul S (F.mul x
                        (F.mul (F.inv N) (F.inv S))) =
                        F.mul (F.mul S x)
                          (F.mul (F.inv N) (F.inv S)) := by
                          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
                    _ = F.mul (F.mul x S)
                          (F.mul (F.inv N) (F.inv S)) := by
                          rw [F.mul_comm S x]
                    _ = F.mul x
                          (F.mul S (F.mul (F.inv N) (F.inv S))) := by
                          rw [F.mul_assoc]
            _ = F.mul x (F.mul (F.mul S (F.inv S)) (F.inv N)) := by
                  have hinner :
                      F.mul S (F.mul (F.inv N) (F.inv S)) =
                        F.mul (F.mul S (F.inv S)) (F.inv N) := by
                    calc
                      F.mul S (F.mul (F.inv N) (F.inv S)) =
                          F.mul S (F.mul (F.inv S) (F.inv N)) := by
                            rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv N) (F.inv S)]
                      _ = F.mul (F.mul S (F.inv S)) (F.inv N) := by
                            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
                  rw [hinner]
    _ = F.mul x (F.mul F.one (F.inv N)) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hS_ne]
    _ = F.mul x (F.inv N) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: expStep_num_identity
statement:
theorem expStep_num_identity (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x))
        x =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let M := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  let N := RealTheory.nat (n + 2)
  have hN_eq : N = F.add M F.one := by
    unfold N M
    change
      RealTheory.nat (n + 2) =
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) RealTheory.one
    have h : n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 := by omega
    calc
      RealTheory.nat (n + 2) =
          RealTheory.nat ((n + 1) + 1) := by rw [h]
      _ =
          RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) RealTheory.one :=
            RealTheory.nat_succ (n + 1)
  change F.add (F.mul M (F.add N x)) x =
    F.mul N (F.add M x)
  rw [hN_eq]
  calc
    F.add (F.mul M (F.add (F.add M F.one) x)) x =
        F.add
          (F.add (F.mul M (F.add M F.one)) (F.mul M x))
          x := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul M (F.add M F.one))
          (F.add (F.mul M x) x) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul M (F.add M F.one))
          (F.add (F.mul M x) (F.mul F.one x)) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul M (F.add M F.one))
          (F.mul (F.add M F.one) x) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul (F.add M F.one) M)
          (F.mul (F.add M F.one) x) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm M (F.add M F.one)]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.add M F.one) (F.add M x) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]

name: expStep_nat_mul_rightBase_add_x_inv_nat_eq_sum
statement:
theorem expStep_nat_mul_rightBase_add_x_inv_nat_eq_sum
    (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (expStepRightBase x n))
        (RealTheory.mul x
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)))) =
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let M := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  let N := RealTheory.nat (n + 2)
  let S := RealTheory.add N x
  have hN_ne : Not (N = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold N
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hB :
      expStepRightBase x n = F.mul S (F.inv N) := by
    unfold S N
    change
      expStepRightBase x n =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) x)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)))
    exact expStepRightBase_eq_sum_mul_inv_nat x n
  have hnum :
      F.add (F.mul M S) x = F.mul N (F.add M x) := by
    unfold S N M
    exact expStep_num_identity x n
  rw [hB]
  change
    F.add (F.mul M (F.mul S (F.inv N)))
        (F.mul x (F.inv N)) =
      F.add M x
  calc
    F.add (F.mul M (F.mul S (F.inv N)))
        (F.mul x (F.inv N)) =
        F.add (F.mul (F.mul M S) (F.inv N))
          (F.mul x (F.inv N)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.add (F.mul M S) x) (F.inv N) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.mul N (F.add M x)) (F.inv N) := by
          rw [hnum]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.add M x) (F.mul N (F.inv N)) := by
          calc
            F.mul (F.mul N (F.add M x)) (F.inv N) =
                F.mul (F.mul (F.add M x) N) (F.inv N) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm N (F.add M x)]
            _ = F.mul (F.add M x) (F.mul N (F.inv N)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.add M x) F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hN_ne]
    _ = F.add M x := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: expStepRightBase_factor_mul_nat_eq_sum
statement:
theorem expStepRightBase_factor_mul_nat_eq_sum
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.mul (expStepRightBase x n)
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (expStepCorrection x n))) =
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let M := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  let B := expStepRightBase x n
  let c := expStepCorrection x n
  have hscaledB :
      F.mul B (F.mul M c) =
        F.mul x (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))) := by
    unfold B M c
    change
      RealTheory.mul (expStepRightBase x n)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (expStepCorrection x n)) =
        RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)))
    exact expStepRightBase_mul_scaled_correction hxnonneg n
  change F.mul M (F.mul B (F.add F.one c)) = F.add M x
  calc
    F.mul M (F.mul B (F.add F.one c)) =
        F.mul (F.mul M B) (F.add F.one c) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul (F.mul M B) F.one)
          (F.mul (F.mul M B) c) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul M B) (F.mul (F.mul M B) c) := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul M B) (F.mul B (F.mul M c)) := by
          have hsecond :
              F.mul (F.mul M B) c = F.mul B (F.mul M c) := by
            calc
              F.mul (F.mul M B) c =
                  F.mul (F.mul B M) c := by
                    rw [F.mul_comm M B]
              _ = F.mul B (F.mul M c) := by
                    rw [F.mul_assoc]
          rw [hsecond]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul M B)
          (F.mul x (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)))) := by
          rw [hscaledB]
    _ = F.add M x := by
          unfold B M
          exact expStep_nat_mul_rightBase_add_x_inv_nat_eq_sum x n

name: expStepLeftBase_eq_rightBase_mul_factor
statement:
theorem expStepLeftBase_eq_rightBase_mul_factor
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    expStepLeftBase x n =
      RealTheory.mul (expStepRightBase x n)
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (expStepCorrection x n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let M := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  have hM_ne : Not (M = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold M
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero F
    (x := M) hM_ne
  change
    F.mul M (expStepLeftBase x n) =
      F.mul M
        (F.mul (expStepRightBase x n)
          (F.add F.one (expStepCorrection x n)))
  calc
    F.mul M (expStepLeftBase x n) =
        F.add M x := by
          unfold M
          exact expStepLeftBase_mul_nat_eq_sum x n
    _ =
        F.mul M
          (F.mul (expStepRightBase x n)
            (F.add F.one (expStepCorrection x n))) := by
          unfold M
          exact (expStepRightBase_factor_mul_nat_eq_sum hxnonneg n).symm

name: expSequence_step_le_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem expSequence_step_le_of_nonneg
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le (ExpSequence x n) (ExpSequence x (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hidx : (n + 1) + 1 = n + 2 := by omega
  unfold ExpSequence
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat (expStepLeftBase x n) (n + 1))
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul x
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat ((n + 1) + 1)))))
        ((n + 1) + 1))
  rw [hidx]
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat (expStepLeftBase x n) (n + 1))
      (powNat (expStepRightBase x n) (n + 2))
  rw [expStepLeftBase_eq_rightBase_mul_factor hxnonneg n]
  simpa [hidx] using
    (powNat_mul_factor_le_succ
      (base := expStepRightBase x n)
      (factor :=
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (expStepCorrection x n))
      (n := n + 1)
      (expStepRightBase_nonneg hxnonneg n)
      (expStepCorrection_factor_bound hxnonneg n))

statement:

name: expSequence_nonneg_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem expSequence_nonneg_of_nonneg
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (ExpSequence x n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  have hN_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero N := by
    unfold N
    exact RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
  have hinvN_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv N) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hN_pos)
  have hterm_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv N)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_nonneg hxnonneg hinvN_nonneg
  have hbase_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv N))) := by
    have h1 :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv N)) RealTheory.one) :=
      RealTheory.one_le_add_one_of_nonneg hterm_nonneg
    rw [RealTheory.add_comm] at h1
    exact RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one) h1
  unfold ExpSequence
  change
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv N))) (n + 1))
  exact powNat_nonneg hbase_nonneg (n + 1)

name: one_le_expSequence_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem one_le_expSequence_of_nonneg
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (ExpSequence x n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  have hN_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero N := by
    unfold N
    exact RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
  have hinvN_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv N) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hN_pos)
  have hterm_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv N)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_nonneg hxnonneg hinvN_nonneg
  have hbase :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv N))) := by
    have h :=
      RealTheory.add_le_add_left hterm_nonneg RealTheory.one
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
  unfold ExpSequence
  change
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.one
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv N))) (n + 1))
  exact one_le_powNat_of_one_le hbase (n + 1)

name: expSequence_nat_mul_le_pow
statement:
theorem expSequence_nat_mul_le_pow
    {y : Point} (hy : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero y)
    (k n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (ExpSequence (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) y) n)
      (powNat (ExpSequence y n) k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let K := RealTheory.nat k
  let N := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  let eps := RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.inv N)
  let baseX :=
    RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul K y) (RealTheory.inv N))
  let baseY := RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps
  have hN_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero N := by
    unfold N
    exact RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
  have hinvN_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv N) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hN_pos)
  have heps_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps := by
    unfold eps
    exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hy hinvN_nonneg
  have hK_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K := by
    unfold K
    exact RealTheory.nat_nonneg k
  have hterm_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul K eps) :=
    RealTheory.mul_nonneg hK_nonneg heps_nonneg
  have hbaseX_eq :
      baseX =
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul K eps) := by
    unfold baseX eps
    change
      F.add F.one (F.mul (F.mul K y) (F.inv N)) =
        F.add F.one (F.mul K (F.mul y (F.inv N)))
    rw [F.mul_assoc]
  have hbaseX_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero baseX := by
    rw [hbaseX_eq]
    have h1 :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul K eps) RealTheory.one) :=
      RealTheory.one_le_add_one_of_nonneg hterm_nonneg
    rw [RealTheory.add_comm] at h1
    exact RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one) h1
  have hbase_le :
      RealTheory.le baseX (powNat baseY k) := by
    rw [hbaseX_eq]
    unfold baseY
    exact one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add heps_nonneg k
  have hpow :=
    powNat_mono_nonneg hbaseX_nonneg hbase_le (n + 1)
  unfold ExpSequence
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat baseX (n + 1))
      (powNat (powNat baseY (n + 1)) k)
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat baseX (n + 1))
      (powNat (powNat baseY k) (n + 1)) at hpow
  rw [powNat_powNat baseY k (n + 1)] at hpow
  rw [powNat_powNat baseY (n + 1) k]
  have hmul : k * (n + 1) = (n + 1) * k := Nat.mul_comm k (n + 1)
  rwa [hmul] at hpow

name: expSequence_boundedAbove_nonneg
statement:
theorem expSequence_boundedAbove_nonneg
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.SeqBoundedAbove (ExpSequence x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_gt x with
  | intro k hxk =>
      let K := RealTheory.nat k
      let y := RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv K)
      have hK_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero K := by
        unfold K
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hxnonneg hxk
      have hK_ne : Not (K = RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro hzero
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hK_pos hzero.symm
      have hinvK_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv K) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hK_pos)
      have hy_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero y := by
        unfold y
        exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hxnonneg hinvK_nonneg
      have hy_lt_one : RealTheory.lt y RealTheory.one := by
        have hinvK_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv K) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hK_pos
        have hmul :=
          RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hxk hinvK_pos
        change
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv K))
            (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.inv K)) at hmul
        rwa [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hK_ne] at hmul
      have hscale : RealTheory.mul K y = x := by
        unfold y
        change F.mul K (F.mul x (F.inv K)) = x
        calc
          F.mul K (F.mul x (F.inv K)) =
              F.mul K (F.mul (F.inv K) x) := by
                rw [F.mul_comm x (F.inv K)]
          _ = F.mul (F.mul K (F.inv K)) x := by
                rw [F.mul_assoc]
          _ = F.mul F.one x := by
                rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hK_ne]
          _ = x := by
                rw [F.one_mul]
      cases expSequence_boundedAbove_local hy_nonneg hy_lt_one with
      | intro B hB =>
          refine Exists.intro (powNat B k) ?_
          intro n
          have hscaled :=
            expSequence_nat_mul_le_pow hy_nonneg k n
          unfold K y at hscale
          rw [hscale] at hscaled
          have hpowB :
              RealTheory.le
                (powNat (ExpSequence y n) k)
                (powNat B k) :=
            powNat_mono_nonneg
              (expSequence_nonneg_of_nonneg hy_nonneg n)
              (hB n) k
          exact RealTheory.le_trans hscaled hpowB

name: expSequence_converges_nonneg
statement:
theorem expSequence_converges_nonneg
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x) :

name: nthRoot_one_succ_eq_one
statement:
theorem nthRoot_one_succ_eq_one (n : Nat) :
    nthRoot (n + 1) RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  apply nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  · exact powNat_one_base (n + 1)

name: one_le_nthRoot_succ_of_one_le
statement:
theorem one_le_nthRoot_succ_of_one_le
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (nthRoot (n + 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h0one : NonnegativeDomain RealTheory.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  have h0x : NonnegativeDomain x :=
    RealTheory.le_trans h0one hx
  have hmono :=
    nthRootFun_monotoneOn_nonnegative_succ n
      RealTheory.one x h0one h0x hx
  unfold NthRootFun at hmono
  rwa [nthRoot_one_succ_eq_one n] at hmono

name: one_lt_nthRoot_succ_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem one_lt_nthRoot_succ_of_one_lt
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one (nthRoot (n + 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hx_le : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx
  have hx_nonneg : NonnegativeDomain x :=
    RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
      hx_le
  have hroot_le : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (nthRoot (n + 1) x) :=
    one_le_nthRoot_succ_of_one_le hx_le n
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hroot_le
  intro hroot_le_one
  have hroot_nonneg :
      NonnegativeDomain (nthRoot (n + 1) x) :=
    nthRoot_nonneg_succ_of_nonneg n hx_nonneg
  have hpow_le_one :
      RealTheory.le
        (powNat (nthRoot (n + 1) x) (n + 1))
        (powNat RealTheory.one (n + 1)) :=
    powNat_mono_nonneg hroot_nonneg hroot_le_one (n + 1)
  rw [powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg n hx_nonneg] at hpow_le_one
  rw [powNat_one_base] at hpow_le_one
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hx) hpow_le_one

name: nthRoot_succ_le_of_powNat_bound
statement:
theorem nthRoot_succ_le_of_powNat_bound
    {x y : Point} (n : Nat)
    (hx : NonnegativeDomain x)
    (hy : NonnegativeDomain y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x (powNat y (n + 1))) :
    RealTheory.le (nthRoot (n + 1) x) y
proof:
:= by
  have hyPow : NonnegativeDomain (powNat y (n + 1)) :=
    powNat_nonneg hy (n + 1)
  have hmono :=
    nthRootFun_monotoneOn_nonnegative_succ n
      x (powNat y (n + 1)) hx hyPow hxy
  unfold NthRootFun at hmono
  have hroot :
      nthRoot (n + 1) (powNat y (n + 1)) = y :=
    nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
      (And.intro hy rfl)
  rwa [hroot] at hmono

name: exists_nthRoot_succ_lt_one_add_of_one_le
statement:
theorem exists_nthRoot_succ_lt_one_add_of_one_le
    {base eps : Point}
    (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.lt (nthRoot (n + 1) base)
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let eta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have heta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have heta_lt_eps : RealTheory.lt eta eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps
  have hbase_nonneg : NonnegativeDomain base :=
    RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
      hbase
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_mul_gt hbase_nonneg heta_pos with
  | intro m hm =>
      have hm_ne : Not (m = 0) := by
        intro hm0
        subst hm0
        have hbad : RealTheory.lt base RealTheory.zero := by
          change
            RealTheory.lt base
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 0) eta) at hm
          rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at hm
          change F.lt base (F.mul F.zero eta) at hm
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F eta] at hm
        have hbase_pos :
            RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero base :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
            RealTheory.zero_lt_one hbase
        exact
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_asymm F hbase_pos) hbad
      cases m with
      | zero =>
          exact False.elim (hm_ne rfl)
      | succ d =>
          refine Exists.intro d ?_
          change
            RealTheory.lt
              (nthRoot (d + 1) base)
              (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps)
          have hmul_lt_one_add :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (d + 1)) eta)
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (d + 1)) eta)) := by
            let A := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (d + 1)) eta
            have h :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
                F RealTheory.zero_lt_one
                A
            have hA : F.lt A (F.add A F.one) := by
              change F.lt (F.add A F.zero) (F.add A F.one) at h
              rwa [F.add_zero] at h
            change F.lt A (F.add F.one A)
            rwa [F.add_comm A F.one] at hA
          have hbase_lt_one_add :
              RealTheory.lt base
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (d + 1)) eta)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hm hmul_lt_one_add
          have heta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heta_pos
          have hbern :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (d + 1)) eta))
                (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eta) (d + 1)) :=
            one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add heta_nonneg (d + 1)
          have hbase_le_pow :
              RealTheory.le base
                (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eta) (d + 1)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                F hbase_lt_one_add hbern)
          have hy_nonneg :
              NonnegativeDomain (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eta) := by
            exact RealTheory.le_trans
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
              (by
                rw [RealTheory.add_comm RealTheory.one eta]
                exact RealTheory.one_le_add_one_of_nonneg heta_nonneg)
          have hroot_le :
              RealTheory.le (nthRoot (d + 1) base)
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eta) :=
            nthRoot_succ_le_of_powNat_bound d
              hbase_nonneg hy_nonneg hbase_le_pow
          have hone_add_lt :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eta)
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) :=
            RealTheory.add_lt_add_left heta_lt_eps RealTheory.one
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
            F hroot_le hone_add_lt

name: powByNatDiv_one_le_of_one_le
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_one_le_of_one_le
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x)
    (q : NatDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (powByNatDiv x q)
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | mk numerator denominator hden =>
      cases denominator with
      | zero =>
          exact False.elim (hden rfl)
      | succ d =>
          unfold powByNatDiv
          exact one_le_powNat_of_one_le
            (one_le_nthRoot_succ_of_one_le hx d)
            numerator

name: one_lt_powByNatDiv_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem one_lt_powByNatDiv_of_one_lt
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x)
    (q : NatDivExponent) (hn : Not (q.numerator = 0)) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one (powByNatDiv x q)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases q with
  | mk numerator denominator hden =>
      cases denominator with
      | zero =>
          exact False.elim (hden rfl)
      | succ d =>
          cases numerator with
          | zero =>
              exact False.elim (hn rfl)
          | succ k =>
              unfold powByNatDiv
              have hroot_lt :
                  RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one
                    (nthRoot (d + 1) x) :=
                one_lt_nthRoot_succ_of_one_lt hx d
              have hroot_le :
                  RealTheory.le RealTheory.one
                    (nthRoot (d + 1) x) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hroot_lt
              have hroot_le_pow :
                  RealTheory.le (nthRoot (d + 1) x)
                    (powNat (nthRoot (d + 1) x) (k + 1)) :=
                self_le_powNat_succ_of_one_le hroot_le k
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                F hroot_lt hroot_le_pow

name: nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos
statement:
theorem nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos
    (n : Nat) {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    PositiveDomain (nthRoot (n + 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxnonneg : NonnegativeDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx
  have hrel := nthRoot_spec_succ_of_nonneg n hxnonneg
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hrel.left
  intro hroot_le_zero
  have hroot_zero :
      nthRoot (n + 1) x = RealTheory.zero :=
    RealTheory.le_antisymm hroot_le_zero hrel.left
  have hpow_zero :
      powNat (nthRoot (n + 1) x) (n + 1) =
        RealTheory.zero := by
    rw [hroot_zero]
    exact powNat_zero_succ n
  have hxzero : x = RealTheory.zero := by
    rw [<- hrel.right, hpow_zero]
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hxzero.symm

name: powByNatDiv_pos_of_pos
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_pos_of_pos
    {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (q : NatDivExponent) :

proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | mk numerator denominator hden =>
      cases denominator with
      | zero =>
          exact False.elim (hden rfl)
      | succ d =>
          unfold powByNatDiv
          exact powNat_pos (nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos d hx)
            numerator

name: powByNatDivFun_continuousOn_nonnegative
statement:
theorem powByNatDivFun_continuousOn_nonnegative
    (q : NatDivExponent) :
    ContinuousOn NonnegativeDomain (PowByNatDivFun q)
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | mk numerator denominator hden =>
      cases denominator with
      | zero =>
          exact False.elim (hden rfl)
      | succ d =>
          change
            ContinuousOn NonnegativeDomain
              (CompFun (PowerFun numerator) (NthRootFun (d + 1)))
          have hroot :
              ContinuousOn NonnegativeDomain (NthRootFun (d + 1)) :=
            nthRootFun_continuousOn_nonnegative_succ d
          have hpow :
              ContinuousOn NonnegativeDomain (PowerFun numerator) :=
            continuousOn_powerFun numerator
          have hmap :
              MapsInto NonnegativeDomain NonnegativeDomain
                (NthRootFun (d + 1)) := by
            intro x hx
            exact nthRoot_nonneg_succ_of_nonneg d hx
          exact continuousOn_comp hroot hpow hmap

name: powByNatDivFun_continuousOn_positive
statement:
theorem powByNatDivFun_continuousOn_positive
    (q : NatDivExponent) :
    ContinuousOn PositiveDomain (PowByNatDivFun q)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  exact continuousOn_subset
    (fun x hx => IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx)
    (powByNatDivFun_continuousOn_nonnegative q)

name: powByNatDivFun_monotoneOn_positive
statement:
theorem powByNatDivFun_monotoneOn_positive
    (q : NatDivExponent) :
    MonotoneOn PositiveDomain (PowByNatDivFun q)
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | mk numerator denominator hden =>
      cases denominator with
      | zero =>
          exact False.elim (hden rfl)
      | succ d =>
          intro x y hx hy hxy
          let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          have hxnonneg : NonnegativeDomain x :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx
          have hynonneg : NonnegativeDomain y :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy
          unfold PowByNatDivFun powByNatDiv
          exact powNat_mono_nonneg
            (nthRoot_nonneg_succ_of_nonneg d hxnonneg)
            (nthRootFun_monotoneOn_nonnegative_succ d
              x y hxnonneg hynonneg hxy)
            numerator

name: powByNatDivFun_monotoneOn_positive_of_nonzero
statement:
theorem powByNatDivFun_monotoneOn_positive_of_nonzero
    (q : NatDivExponent) (_hn : Not (q.numerator = 0)) :

:=
  powByNatDivFun_monotoneOn_positive q

name: powByNatDiv_mul_base_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_mul_base_of_nonneg
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : NonnegativeDomain x) (hy : NonnegativeDomain y)

  | mk numerator denominator hden =>

      | zero =>
          exact False.elim (hden rfl)

name: powByNatDiv_mul_base_law
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_mul_base_law :
    PowByNatDivMulBaseLawStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy q
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
