name: powByNatDiv_common_refinement_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_common_refinement_of_nonneg
    {x : Point} (hx : NonnegativeDomain x)
    (q : NatDivExponent) {k : Nat} (hk : Not (k = 0)) :
    powByNatDiv x
        { numerator := q.numerator * k
          denominator := q.denominator * k
          denominator_ne_zero :=
            Nat.mul_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero hk } =
      powByNatDiv x q
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | mk numerator denominator hden =>
      cases denominator with
      | zero =>
          exact False.elim (hden rfl)
      | succ d =>
          cases k with
          | zero =>
              exact False.elim (hk rfl)
          | succ j =>
              let refinedRoot :=
                nthRoot ((d + 1) * (j + 1)) x
              have hrefRoot :
                  HasNthRoot ((d + 1) * (j + 1)) x :=
                (hasPowByNatDivInput_of_nonneg hx
                  { numerator := numerator * (j + 1)
                    denominator := (d + 1) * (j + 1)
                    denominator_ne_zero :=
                      Nat.mul_ne_zero hden hk }).right
              have hcandidate :
                  NthRootRelation (d + 1) x
                    (powNat refinedRoot (j + 1)) := by
                refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                · exact powNat_nonneg
                    (nthRoot_nonneg_of_exists hrefRoot) (j + 1)
                · unfold refinedRoot
                  rw [powNat_powNat]
                  rw [Nat.mul_comm (j + 1) (d + 1)]
                  exact powNat_nthRoot_eq_of_exists hrefRoot
              have hold :
                  nthRoot (d + 1) x =
                    powNat refinedRoot (j + 1) :=
                nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ hcandidate
              unfold powByNatDiv
              change
                powNat refinedRoot (numerator * (j + 1)) =
                  powNat (nthRoot (d + 1) x) numerator
              rw [hold]
              rw [powNat_powNat]
              rw [Nat.mul_comm (j + 1) numerator]

name: powByNatDiv_powNat_den_mul_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_powNat_den_mul_of_nonneg
    {a : Point} (ha : NonnegativeDomain a)
    (m d k : Nat) (hd : Not (d = 0)) :
    powByNatDiv (powNat a (d * k))
        { numerator := m
          denominator := d
          denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
      powNat a (m * k)
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | zero =>
      exact False.elim (hd rfl)
  | succ d =>
      let candidate := powNat a k
      have hcandidate :
          NthRootRelation (d + 1)
            (powNat a ((d + 1) * k)) candidate := by
        refine And.intro ?_ ?_
        · unfold candidate
          exact powNat_nonneg ha k
        · unfold candidate
          rw [powNat_powNat]
          rw [Nat.mul_comm k (d + 1)]
      have hroot :
          nthRoot (d + 1)
              (powNat a ((d + 1) * k)) =
            candidate :=
        nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ hcandidate
      unfold powByNatDiv
      change
        powNat
            (nthRoot (d + 1)
              (powNat a ((d + 1) * k))) m =
          powNat a (m * k)
      rw [hroot]
      unfold candidate
      rw [powNat_powNat]
      rw [Nat.mul_comm k m]

name: powByNatDiv_refinements_eq_of_cross_mul
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_refinements_eq_of_cross_mul
    {x : Point} {q r : NatDivExponent}
    (h :
      q.numerator * r.denominator =
        r.numerator * q.denominator) :
    powByNatDiv x
        { numerator := q.numerator * r.denominator
          denominator := q.denominator * r.denominator
          denominator_ne_zero :=
            Nat.mul_ne_zero
              q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero } =
      powByNatDiv x
        { numerator := r.numerator * q.denominator
          denominator := r.denominator * q.denominator
          denominator_ne_zero :=
            Nat.mul_ne_zero
              r.denominator_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero }
proof:
:= by
  unfold powByNatDiv
  change
    powNat (nthRoot (q.denominator * r.denominator) x)
        (q.numerator * r.denominator) =
      powNat (nthRoot (r.denominator * q.denominator) x)
        (r.numerator * q.denominator)
  rw [h]
  rw [Nat.mul_comm r.denominator q.denominator]

name: powByNatDiv_denominator_mul_comm
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_denominator_mul_comm
    {x : Point} {a d e : Nat}
    (hd : Not (d = 0)) (he : Not (e = 0)) :
    powByNatDiv x
        { numerator := a
          denominator := d * e
          denominator_ne_zero := Nat.mul_ne_zero hd he } =
      powByNatDiv x
        { numerator := a
          denominator := e * d
          denominator_ne_zero := Nat.mul_ne_zero he hd }
proof:
:= by
  unfold powByNatDiv
  change
    powNat (nthRoot (d * e) x) a =
      powNat (nthRoot (e * d) x) a
  rw [Nat.mul_comm d e]

name: powByNatDiv_same_den_add
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_same_den_add
    {x : Point} {a b d : Nat}
    (hd : Not (d = 0)) :
    powByNatDiv x
        { numerator := a + b
          denominator := d
          denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
      RealTheory.mul
        (powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := a
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd })
        (powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := b
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd })
proof:
:= by
  unfold powByNatDiv
  change
    powNat (nthRoot d x) (a + b) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (powNat (nthRoot d x) a)
        (powNat (nthRoot d x) b)
  exact powNat_add (nthRoot d x) a b

name: le_mul_of_one_le_right
statement:
theorem le_mul_of_one_le_right {x y : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hy : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one y) :
    RealTheory.le x (RealTheory.mul x y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hy hx
  rwa [RealTheory.mul_one] at h

name: powByNatDiv_same_den_mono_of_one_le
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_same_den_mono_of_one_le
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x)
    {a b d : Nat} (hd : Not (d = 0)) (hab : a <= b) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powByNatDiv x
        { numerator := a
          denominator := d
          denominator_ne_zero := hd })
      (powByNatDiv x
        { numerator := b
          denominator := d
          denominator_ne_zero := hd })
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxnonneg : NonnegativeDomain x :=
    RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one) hx
  let left : NatDivExponent :=
    { numerator := a
      denominator := d
      denominator_ne_zero := hd }
  let diff : NatDivExponent :=
    { numerator := b - a
      denominator := d
      denominator_ne_zero := hd }
  have hsum :
      powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := a + (b - a)
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
        RealTheory.mul (powByNatDiv x left)
          (powByNatDiv x diff) :=
    powByNatDiv_same_den_add
      (x := x) (a := a) (b := b - a) (d := d) hd
  have htarget :
      powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := b
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
        RealTheory.mul (powByNatDiv x left)
          (powByNatDiv x diff) := by
    have hnum : a + (b - a) = b := by omega
    rw [<- hsum]
    rw [hnum]
  have hleft_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (powByNatDiv x left) :=
    powByNatDiv_nonneg_of_nonneg hxnonneg left
  have hdiff_one :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (powByNatDiv x diff) :=
    powByNatDiv_one_le_of_one_le hx diff
  have hle :
      RealTheory.le (powByNatDiv x left)
        (RealTheory.mul (powByNatDiv x left)
          (powByNatDiv x diff)) :=
    le_mul_of_one_le_right hleft_nonneg hdiff_one
  rwa [<- htarget] at hle

name: powByNatDiv_cross_mul_mono_of_one_le
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_cross_mul_mono_of_one_le
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x)
    {q r : NatDivExponent}
    (hcross :
      q.numerator * r.denominator <=
        r.numerator * q.denominator) :
    RealTheory.le (powByNatDiv x q) (powByNatDiv x r)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxnonneg : NonnegativeDomain x :=
    RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one) hx
  let qCommon : NatDivExponent :=
    { numerator := q.numerator * r.denominator
      denominator := q.denominator * r.denominator
      denominator_ne_zero :=
        Nat.mul_ne_zero
          q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero }
  let rCommon : NatDivExponent :=
    { numerator := r.numerator * q.denominator
      denominator := q.denominator * r.denominator
      denominator_ne_zero :=
        Nat.mul_ne_zero
          q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero }
  let rRefined : NatDivExponent :=
    { numerator := r.numerator * q.denominator
      denominator := r.denominator * q.denominator
      denominator_ne_zero :=
        Nat.mul_ne_zero
          r.denominator_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero }
  have hq :
      powByNatDiv x qCommon = powByNatDiv x q :=
    powByNatDiv_common_refinement_of_nonneg hxnonneg q
      r.denominator_ne_zero
  have hrRefined :
      powByNatDiv x rRefined = powByNatDiv x r :=
    powByNatDiv_common_refinement_of_nonneg hxnonneg r
      q.denominator_ne_zero
  have hrCommon :
      powByNatDiv x rCommon = powByNatDiv x rRefined := by
    exact powByNatDiv_denominator_mul_comm
      (x := x)
      (a := r.numerator * q.denominator)
      (d := q.denominator)
      (e := r.denominator)
      q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero
  have hcommon :
      RealTheory.le (powByNatDiv x qCommon)
        (powByNatDiv x rCommon) :=
    powByNatDiv_same_den_mono_of_one_le
      (x := x) hx
      (a := q.numerator * r.denominator)
      (b := r.numerator * q.denominator)
      (d := q.denominator * r.denominator)
      (Nat.mul_ne_zero
        q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero)
      hcross
  rw [hq, hrCommon, hrRefined] at hcommon
  exact hcommon

name: powByNatDiv_representation_independent
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_representation_independent :
    PowByNatDivRepresentationIndependenceStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx q r hcross
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxnonneg : NonnegativeDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx
  have hq :
      powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := q.numerator * r.denominator
            denominator := q.denominator * r.denominator
            denominator_ne_zero :=
              Nat.mul_ne_zero
                q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero } =
        powByNatDiv x q :=
    powByNatDiv_common_refinement_of_nonneg hxnonneg q
      r.denominator_ne_zero
  have hr :
      powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := r.numerator * q.denominator
            denominator := r.denominator * q.denominator
            denominator_ne_zero :=
              Nat.mul_ne_zero
                r.denominator_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero } =
        powByNatDiv x r :=
    powByNatDiv_common_refinement_of_nonneg hxnonneg r
      q.denominator_ne_zero
  calc
    powByNatDiv x q =
        powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := q.numerator * r.denominator
            denominator := q.denominator * r.denominator
            denominator_ne_zero :=
              Nat.mul_ne_zero
                q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero } := by
          exact Eq.symm hq
    _ =
        powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := r.numerator * q.denominator
            denominator := r.denominator * q.denominator
            denominator_ne_zero :=
              Nat.mul_ne_zero
                r.denominator_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero } := by
          exact powByNatDiv_refinements_eq_of_cross_mul hcross
    _ = powByNatDiv x r := hr

name: powByNatDiv_add_law
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_add_law :
    PowByNatDivAddLawStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx q r
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxnonneg : NonnegativeDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx
  let commonDen := q.denominator * r.denominator
  let qCommon : NatDivExponent :=
    { numerator := q.numerator * r.denominator
      denominator := commonDen
      denominator_ne_zero :=
        Nat.mul_ne_zero
          q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero }
  let rCommon : NatDivExponent :=
    { numerator := r.numerator * q.denominator
      denominator := commonDen
      denominator_ne_zero :=
        Nat.mul_ne_zero
          q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero }
  let rRefined : NatDivExponent :=
    { numerator := r.numerator * q.denominator
      denominator := r.denominator * q.denominator
      denominator_ne_zero :=
        Nat.mul_ne_zero
          r.denominator_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero }
  have hsame :
      powByNatDiv x
          { numerator :=
              q.numerator * r.denominator +
                r.numerator * q.denominator
            denominator := q.denominator * r.denominator
            denominator_ne_zero :=
              Nat.mul_ne_zero
                q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero } =
        RealTheory.mul (powByNatDiv x qCommon)
          (powByNatDiv x rCommon) := by
    exact powByNatDiv_same_den_add
      (x := x)
      (a := q.numerator * r.denominator)
      (b := r.numerator * q.denominator)
      (d := q.denominator * r.denominator)
      (Nat.mul_ne_zero
        q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero)
  have hq :
      powByNatDiv x qCommon = powByNatDiv x q :=
    powByNatDiv_common_refinement_of_nonneg hxnonneg q
      r.denominator_ne_zero
  have hrRefined :
      powByNatDiv x rRefined = powByNatDiv x r :=
    powByNatDiv_common_refinement_of_nonneg hxnonneg r
      q.denominator_ne_zero
  have hrCommon :
      powByNatDiv x rCommon = powByNatDiv x rRefined := by
    exact powByNatDiv_denominator_mul_comm
      (x := x)
      (a := r.numerator * q.denominator)
      (d := q.denominator)
      (e := r.denominator)
      q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero
  calc
    powByNatDiv x
        { numerator :=
            q.numerator * r.denominator +
              r.numerator * q.denominator
          denominator := q.denominator * r.denominator
          denominator_ne_zero :=
            Nat.mul_ne_zero
              q.denominator_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero } =
        RealTheory.mul (powByNatDiv x qCommon)
          (powByNatDiv x rCommon) := hsame
    _ = RealTheory.mul (powByNatDiv x q)
          (powByNatDiv x r) := by
          rw [hq, hrCommon, hrRefined]

name: seqTendsto_scaled_invNatSucc_zero

theorem seqTendsto_scaled_invNatSucc_zero

name: scaled_lt_one_eventually_of_tendsto_zero_nonneg
statement:
theorem scaled_lt_one_eventually_of_tendsto_zero_nonneg
    {s : Nat -> Point}
    (hs : RealTheory.SeqTendsto s RealTheory.zero)
    (hs_nonneg :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (s n))) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.lt (s n) RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hclose := hs RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  cases Eventually.and hclose hs_nonneg with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have hcloseN := (hN n hn).left
      have hnonneg := (hN n hn).right
      change
        F.lt
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
            (F.sub (s n) F.zero))
          F.one at hcloseN
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F] at hcloseN
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hnonneg] at hcloseN

name: one_sub_scaled_pos_eventually_of_tendsto_zero_nonneg
statement:
theorem one_sub_scaled_pos_eventually_of_tendsto_zero_nonneg

        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (s n))) :

proof:

  apply Eventually.mono ?_
    (scaled_lt_one_eventually_of_tendsto_zero_nonneg
      hs hs_nonneg)
  intro n hlt
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hlt

name: inv_one_sub_scaled_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem inv_one_sub_scaled_tendsto_one
    {s : Nat -> Point}
    (hs : RealTheory.SeqTendsto s RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (s n)))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hden :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_sub
      (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const RealTheory.one) hs
  have hden_one :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (s n))
        RealTheory.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat => F.sub F.one (s n))
        (F.sub F.one F.zero) at hden
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F] at hden
  have hinv := RealTheory.seqTendsto_inv hden_one RealTheory.one_ne_zero
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        F.inv (F.sub F.one (s n)))
      (F.inv F.one) at hinv
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at hinv

name: smallPower_tendsto_one_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem smallPower_tendsto_one_of_nonneg
    {a : Nat -> Point}
    (ha_nonneg :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (a n)))
    (hscaled :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (a n))
        RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (SmallPowerSequence a) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let scaled : Nat -> Point :=
    fun n : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (a n)
  have hscaled_nonneg :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (scaled n)) := by
    unfold scaled
    exact scaled_nonneg_eventually_of_nonneg_eventually ha_nonneg
  have hlower : RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (scaled n))
      RealTheory.one :=
    one_add_scaled_tendsto_one hscaled
  have hupper : RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (scaled n)))
      RealTheory.one :=
    inv_one_sub_scaled_tendsto_one hscaled
  have hden_pos :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (scaled n))) :=
    one_sub_scaled_pos_eventually_of_tendsto_zero_nonneg
      hscaled hscaled_nonneg
  apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_squeeze
    (u := fun n : Nat => RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (scaled n))
    (w :=
      fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (scaled n)))
    hlower hupper
  case huv =>
    cases Eventually.and ha_nonneg hden_pos with
    | intro N hN =>
        refine Exists.intro N ?_
        intro n hn
        have han := (hN n hn).left
        unfold SmallPowerSequence scaled
        exact one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add han (n + 1)
  case hvw =>
    cases Eventually.and ha_nonneg hden_pos with
    | intro N hN =>
        refine Exists.intro N ?_
        intro n hn
        have han := (hN n hn).left
        have hden := (hN n hn).right
        unfold SmallPowerSequence scaled
        exact powNat_one_add_le_inv_one_sub_nat_mul
          han (m := n + 1) hden

proof:

name: small_term_le_scaled
statement:
theorem small_term_le_scaled
    {eps : Point} (heps : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le eps
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hone_le_nat :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) := by
    have hnat : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat 1)
        (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) :=
      RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (by omega)
    rwa [RealTheory.nat_one] at hnat
  have h :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hone_le_nat heps
  rwa [RealTheory.one_mul] at h

name: one_sub_small_term_nonneg_eventually
statement:
theorem one_sub_small_term_nonneg_eventually
    {eps : Nat -> Point}
    (heps_nonneg :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (eps n)))
    (hscaled :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (eps n))
        RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (eps n)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let scaled : Nat -> Point :=
    fun n : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (eps n)
  have hscaled_nonneg :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (scaled n)) := by
    unfold scaled
    exact scaled_nonneg_eventually_of_nonneg_eventually heps_nonneg
  have hscaled_lt_one :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.lt (scaled n) RealTheory.one) :=
    scaled_lt_one_eventually_of_tendsto_zero_nonneg
      hscaled hscaled_nonneg
  cases Eventually.and heps_nonneg hscaled_lt_one with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have heps := (hN n hn).left
      have hlt := (hN n hn).right
      have heps_lt_one :
          RealTheory.lt (eps n) RealTheory.one :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
          (by
            unfold scaled at hlt
            exact small_term_le_scaled heps n)
          hlt
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heps_lt_one)

name: smallPower_tendsto_one_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem smallPower_tendsto_one_of_nonpos
    {a : Nat -> Point}
    (ha_nonpos :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.le (a n) RealTheory.zero))
    (hscaled_neg :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (RealTheory.neg (a n)))
        RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (SmallPowerSequence a) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let eps : Nat -> Point := fun n : Nat => RealTheory.neg (a n)
  have heps_nonneg :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (eps n)) := by
    apply Eventually.mono ?_ ha_nonpos
    intro n hn
    unfold eps
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hn
  have hlower :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (eps n)))
        RealTheory.one :=
    one_sub_scaled_tendsto_one hscaled_neg
  have hupper :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto (fun _ : Nat => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.one :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_const RealTheory.one
  have hbase_nonneg :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (eps n))) :=
    one_sub_small_term_nonneg_eventually
      heps_nonneg hscaled_neg
  apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_squeeze
    (u :=
      fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (eps n)))
    (w := fun _ : Nat => RealTheory.one)
    hlower hupper
  case huv =>
    cases Eventually.and heps_nonneg hbase_nonneg with
    | intro N hN =>
        refine Exists.intro N ?_
        intro n hn
        have heps := (hN n hn).left
        have hbase := (hN n hn).right
        change
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.neg (a n)) at heps
        change
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
              (RealTheory.neg (a n))) at hbase
        have hbase_eq :
            RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (a n) =
              RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                (RealTheory.neg (a n)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
          rw [RealTheory.neg_neg]
        unfold SmallPowerSequence
        change
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
                (RealTheory.neg (a n))))
            (powNat
              (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (a n)) (n + 1))
        rw [hbase_eq]
        exact one_sub_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_sub
          heps hbase (n + 1)
  case hvw =>
    cases Eventually.and heps_nonneg hbase_nonneg with
    | intro N hN =>
        refine Exists.intro N ?_
        intro n hn
        have heps := (hN n hn).left
        have hbase := (hN n hn).right
        change
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.neg (a n)) at heps
        change
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
              (RealTheory.neg (a n))) at hbase
        have hbase_eq :
            RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (a n) =
              RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                (RealTheory.neg (a n)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
          rw [RealTheory.neg_neg]
        unfold SmallPowerSequence
        change
          RealTheory.le
            (powNat
              (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (a n)) (n + 1))
            RealTheory.one
        rw [hbase_eq]
        exact powNat_one_sub_le_one
          heps hbase (n + 1)

name: natSucc_mul_invNatSucc
statement:
theorem natSucc_mul_invNatSucc (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (invNatSucc n) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by

    (RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (Nat.succ_ne_zero n))

name: natSucc_mul_mul_invNatSucc
statement:
theorem natSucc_mul_mul_invNatSucc (z : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.mul z (invNatSucc n)) =
      z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.mul z (invNatSucc n)) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) z) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_comm z (invNatSucc n)]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (invNatSucc n)) z := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
    _ = RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one z := by
          rw [natSucc_mul_invNatSucc n]
    _ = z := RealTheory.one_mul z

name: natSucc_mul_mul_invNatSucc_sq
statement:
theorem natSucc_mul_mul_invNatSucc_sq (z : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.mul z
          (RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n))) =
      RealTheory.mul z (invNatSucc n)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.mul z
          (RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n))) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n)) z) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_comm z
            (RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n))]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n))) z := by
          rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
              (invNatSucc n)) (invNatSucc n)) z := by
          rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc
            (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n)]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one (invNatSucc n)) z := by
          rw [natSucc_mul_invNatSucc n]
    _ = RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) z := by
          rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
    _ = RealTheory.mul z (invNatSucc n) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_comm]

name: exists_nthRootRelation_closedInterval_succ
statement:
theorem exists_nthRootRelation_closedInterval_succ
    (n : Nat) {x right : Point}
    (h0right : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero right)
    (hx : NonnegativeDomain x)
    (hxbound :
      RealTheory.le x (powNat right (n + 1))) :
    Exists
      (fun c : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero right c)
          (NthRootRelation (n + 1) x c))
proof:
:= by
  have hf :
      ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero right)
        (PowerFun (n + 1)) :=
    continuousOn_powerFun (n + 1)
  have hbetween :
      RealTheory.Between
        (PowerFun (n + 1) RealTheory.zero)
        x
        (PowerFun (n + 1) right) := by
    unfold RealTheory.Between IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Between
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · unfold PowerFun
      rw [powNat_zero_succ]
      exact hx
    · unfold PowerFun
      exact hxbound
  cases intermediate_value_closedInterval h0right hf hbetween with
  | intro c hc =>
      refine Exists.intro c ?_
      refine And.intro hc.left ?_
      unfold NthRootRelation NonnegativeDomain PowerFun at *
      exact And.intro hc.left.left hc.right

name: hasNthRoot_succ_of_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  let right := RealTheory.add x RealTheory.one
  have hle : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero right :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hx (RealTheory.le_add_one x)
  have hbound :
      RealTheory.le x (powNat right (n + 1)) :=
    le_powNat_add_one_succ_of_nonneg hx n
  cases exists_nthRootRelation_closedInterval_succ n hle hx hbound with
  | intro c hc =>
      exact Exists.intro c hc.right

name: nthRoot_spec_succ_of_nonneg
proof:
:=
  nthRoot_spec_of_exists (hasNthRoot_succ_of_nonneg n hx)

name: nthRoot_nonneg_succ_of_nonneg
proof:
:=
  (nthRoot_spec_succ_of_nonneg n hx).left

name: powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg
proof:
:=
  (nthRoot_spec_succ_of_nonneg n hx).right

name: nthRoot_one_eq_of_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  have hroot : HasNthRoot 1 x :=
    hasNthRoot_one_of_nonneg hx
  have hpow := powNat_nthRoot_eq_of_exists hroot
  rw [powNat_one] at hpow
  exact hpow

name: nthRoot_exists_succ
statement:
theorem nthRoot_exists_succ (n : Nat) :
    NthRootExistenceStatement (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact hasNthRoot_succ_of_nonneg n hx

name: nthRoot_unique_succ
statement:
theorem nthRoot_unique_succ (n : Nat) :
    NthRootUniquenessStatement (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y z hy hz
  have hinj :
      InjectiveOn NonnegativeDomain (PowerFun (n + 1)) :=
    strictMonotoneOn_injectiveOn
      (powerFun_strictMonotoneOn_nonnegative_succ n)
  apply hinj y z hy.left hz.left
  unfold PowerFun
  rw [hy.right, hz.right]

name: nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
proof:
:= by
  have hroot : HasNthRoot (n + 1) x :=
    Exists.intro y hy
  exact nthRoot_unique_succ n x (nthRoot (n + 1) x) y
    (nthRoot_spec_of_exists hroot) hy

name: nthRootFun_monotoneOn_nonnegative_succ
statement:
theorem nthRootFun_monotoneOn_nonnegative_succ (n : Nat) :
    MonotoneOn NonnegativeDomain (NthRootFun (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let rx := nthRoot (n + 1) x
  let ry := nthRoot (n + 1) y
  have hxroot : NthRootRelation (n + 1) x rx :=
    nthRoot_spec_succ_of_nonneg n hx
  have hyroot : NthRootRelation (n + 1) y ry :=
    nthRoot_spec_succ_of_nonneg n hy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hle : RealTheory.le rx ry
  · exact hle
  · have hryx_le : RealTheory.le ry rx := by
      cases RealTheory.le_total rx ry with
      | inl h =>
          exact False.elim (hle h)
      | inr h =>
          exact h
    have hryx_lt : RealTheory.lt ry rx :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hryx_le hle
    have hp :
        RealTheory.lt
          (PowerFun (n + 1) ry)
          (PowerFun (n + 1) rx) :=
      powerFun_strictMonotoneOn_nonnegative_succ n
        ry rx hyroot.left hxroot.left hryx_lt
    unfold PowerFun at hp
    rw [hyroot.right, hxroot.right] at hp
    exact False.elim ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hp) hxy)

name: compactImage_mem_of_nonneg_le_pow_right_succ
statement:
theorem compactImage_mem_of_nonneg_le_pow_right_succ
    {n : Nat} {right y : Point}
    (h0right : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero right)
    (hy : NonnegativeDomain y)
    (hybound :
      RealTheory.le y (powNat right (n + 1))) :
    NthRootCompactImageDomain n right y
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_nthRootRelation_closedInterval_succ n h0right hy hybound with
  | intro c hc =>
      refine Exists.intro c ?_
      refine And.intro hc.left ?_
      unfold PowerFun
      exact hc.right.right

name: compactImage_mem_of_nonneg_le_right_succ
statement:
theorem compactImage_mem_of_nonneg_le_right_succ
    {n : Nat} {right y : Point}
    (h0right : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero right)
    (h1right : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one right)
    (hy : NonnegativeDomain y)
    (hyright : RealTheory.le y right) :
    NthRootCompactImageDomain n right y
proof:
:= by
  have hright_pow :
      RealTheory.le right (powNat right (n + 1)) :=
    self_le_powNat_succ_of_one_le h1right n
  exact compactImage_mem_of_nonneg_le_pow_right_succ h0right hy
    (RealTheory.le_trans hyright hright_pow)

name: nthRootFun_sameOn_compactImage_succ
statement:
theorem nthRootFun_sameOn_compactImage_succ
    {n : Nat} {right : Point}
    (_h0r : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero right) :
    SameOn (NthRootCompactImageDomain n right)
      (NthRootFun (n + 1))
      (InverseOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero right)
        (PowerFun (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  unfold NthRootFun
  apply nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact (inverseOn_mem hy).left
  · unfold PowerFun
    exact inverseOn_value hy

name: nthRootFun_continuousOn_compactImage_succ
statement:
theorem nthRootFun_continuousOn_compactImage_succ
    {n : Nat} {right : Point}
    (h0r : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero right) :
    ContinuousOn (NthRootCompactImageDomain n right)
      (NthRootFun (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hstrict :
      StrictMonotoneOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero right)
        (PowerFun (n + 1)) := by
    intro x y hx hy hxy
    exact powerFun_strictMonotoneOn_nonnegative_succ n
      x y hx.left hy.left hxy
  have hinv :
      ContinuousOn
        (Image (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero right)
          (PowerFun (n + 1)))
        (InverseOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero right)
          (PowerFun (n + 1))) :=
    inverseOn_continuousOn_closedInterval_strictMonotone
      h0r (continuousOn_powerFun (n + 1)) hstrict
  exact continuousOn_congr
    (sameOn_symm (nthRootFun_sameOn_compactImage_succ h0r)) hinv

name: nthRootFun_continuousOn_nonnegative_succ
statement:
theorem nthRootFun_continuousOn_nonnegative_succ (n : Nat) :
    ContinuousOn NonnegativeDomain (NthRootFun (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro x0 hx0
  refine And.intro hx0 ?_
  let right := RealTheory.add x0 RealTheory.one
  have h0right : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero right :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hx0 (RealTheory.le_add_one x0)
  have h1right : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one right :=
    RealTheory.one_le_add_one_of_nonneg hx0
  have hx0right : RealTheory.le x0 right :=
    RealTheory.le_add_one x0
  have hx0Image : NthRootCompactImageDomain n right x0 :=
    compactImage_mem_of_nonneg_le_right_succ h0right h1right
      hx0 hx0right
  have hcompactCont :
      ContinuousOn (NthRootCompactImageDomain n right)
        (NthRootFun (n + 1)) :=
    nthRootFun_continuousOn_compactImage_succ h0right
  have hcompactAt :
      ContinuousAtOn (NthRootCompactImageDomain n right)
        (NthRootFun (n + 1)) x0 :=
    hcompactCont x0 hx0Image
  intro eps heps
  cases hcompactAt.right eps heps with
  | intro delta0 hdelta0 =>
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F delta0 RealTheory.one
      have hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdelta0.left
          RealTheory.zero_lt_one
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta ?_
      intro y hy hyne hydist
      have hydist_delta0 :
          RealTheory.lt (dist y x0) delta0 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hydist
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F delta0 RealTheory.one)
      have hydist_one :
          RealTheory.lt (dist y x0) RealTheory.one :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hydist
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F delta0 RealTheory.one)
      have hy_lt_right : RealTheory.lt y right := by
        unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hydist_one
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hydist_one
      have hyImage : NthRootCompactImageDomain n right y :=
        compactImage_mem_of_nonneg_le_right_succ h0right h1right
          hy (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy_lt_right)
      exact hdelta0.right y hyImage hyne hydist_delta0

name: nthRoot_mul_succ_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem nthRoot_mul_succ_of_nonneg (n : Nat)
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : NonnegativeDomain x) (hy : NonnegativeDomain y) :
    nthRoot (n + 1) (RealTheory.mul x y) =
      RealTheory.mul (nthRoot (n + 1) x)
        (nthRoot (n + 1) y)
proof:
:= by
  apply nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg
      (nthRoot_nonneg_succ_of_nonneg n hx)
      (nthRoot_nonneg_succ_of_nonneg n hy)
  · rw [powNat_mul]
    rw [powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg n hx]
    rw [powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg n hy]

name: eulerNumberSequence_eq_sharedExpSequence_one
statement:
theorem eulerNumberSequence_eq_sharedExpSequence_one :
    EulerNumberSequence =
      SharedEulerLimit.ExpSequence RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  unfold EulerNumberSequence SharedEulerLimit.ExpSequence
  change
    powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (n + 1))))
        (n + 1) =
      powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (n + 1)))))
        (n + 1)
  rw [RealTheory.one_mul]

name: sharedEulerNumber_exists
statement:
theorem sharedEulerNumber_exists :
    Exists (fun e : Point => IsEulerNumber e)
proof:
:= by
  have hone_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  cases SharedEulerLimit.expSequence_converges_nonneg hone_nonneg with
  | intro e he =>
      refine Exists.intro e ?_
      unfold IsEulerNumber
      rwa [eulerNumberSequence_eq_sharedExpSequence_one]

name: sharedEulerNumber_isEulerNumber
statement:
theorem sharedEulerNumber_isEulerNumber :
    IsEulerNumber sharedEulerNumber
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec sharedEulerNumber_exists

name: expLogPowerCandidate_of_pos
statement:
theorem expLogPowerCandidate_of_pos
    (E : NaturalExpThinSpec) (L : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    (mu : Point) {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    ExpLogPowerCandidate E L mu x =
      E.exp (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold ExpLogPowerCandidate
  simp [hx]

name: scaled_log_window
statement:
theorem scaled_log_window
    (L : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv mu))) :
    And
      (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x)))
      (RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x)) RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.one) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hx1
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.one hx1
  have hsub_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx1
  have hinv_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hxpos
  have hprod_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv x)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hsub_pos hinv_pos
  have hlog_lower := L.local_lower x hxpos hxne
  have hlog_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (L.log x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hprod_pos hlog_lower
  have ht_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hmu hlog_pos
  have hlog_upper := L.local_upper x hxpos hxne
  have hmul_upper :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x))
        (RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hlog_upper hmu
  have hx_sub_lt_inv :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv mu) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hxlt
  have hmu_ne : Not (mu = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hmu hzero.symm
  have hscaled_lt_one :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul mu (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))
        RealTheory.one := by
    have h := RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hx_sub_lt_inv hmu
    rwa [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hmu_ne] at h
  exact And.intro ht_pos
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hmul_upper hscaled_lt_one)

name: expLogPowerCandidate_mul_law
statement:
theorem expLogPowerCandidate_mul_law
    (E : NaturalExpThinSpec) (L : NaturalLogThinSpec) :
    NaturalPowerPositiveBaseMultiplicative (ExpLogPowerCandidate E L)
proof:
:= by
  intro mu x y hx hy
  have hxy : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.mul x y) := RealTheory.mul_pos hx hy
  rw [expLogPowerCandidate_of_pos E L mu hxy]
  rw [expLogPowerCandidate_of_pos E L mu hx]
  rw [expLogPowerCandidate_of_pos E L mu hy]
  rw [L.mul_law x y hx hy, RealTheory.mul_add]
  exact E.add_law
    (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x))
    (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log y))

name: expLogPowerCandidate_positive_exponent_local_lower
statement:
theorem expLogPowerCandidate_positive_exponent_local_lower
    (E : NaturalExpThinSpec) (L : NaturalLogThinSpec) :
    NaturalPowerPositiveExponentLocalLower (ExpLogPowerCandidate E L)
proof:
:= by
  intro mu hmu x hx1 hxlt
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.one) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hx1
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.one hx1
  have hwindow := L.scaled_log_window hmu hx1 hxlt
  rw [expLogPowerCandidate_of_pos E L mu hxpos]
  have hlog_lower := L.local_lower x hxpos hxne
  have hmul_lower :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.inv x)))
        (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hlog_lower hmu
  have hxne0 : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxpos hzero.symm
  have hrewrite :
      RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x)) =
        RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.inv x)) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_one_mul_inv_eq_one_sub_inv F hxne0
    change
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) (RealTheory.inv x) =
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x) at h
    rw [h]
  rw [hrewrite]
  have hadd := RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hmul_lower RealTheory.one
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hadd
    (E.local_lower
      (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x)) hwindow.left hwindow.right)

name: expLogPowerCandidate_positive_exponent_local_upper
statement:
theorem expLogPowerCandidate_positive_exponent_local_upper
    (E : NaturalExpThinSpec) (L : NaturalLogThinSpec) :
    NaturalPowerPositiveExponentLocalUpper (ExpLogPowerCandidate E L)
proof:
:= by
  intro mu hmu x hx1 hxlt
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.one) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hx1
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.one hx1
  have hwindow := L.scaled_log_window hmu hx1 hxlt
  rw [expLogPowerCandidate_of_pos E L mu hxpos]
  have hlog_upper := L.local_upper x hxpos hxne
  have hmul_upper :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x))
        (RealTheory.mul mu (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hlog_upper hmu
  have hx_sub_lt_inv :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) (RealTheory.inv mu) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hxlt
  have hmu_ne : Not (mu = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hmu hzero.symm
  have hmu_sub_lt_one :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul mu (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))
        RealTheory.one := by
    have h := RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hx_sub_lt_inv hmu
    rwa [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hmu_ne] at h
  have hden_t_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hwindow.right
  have hden_u_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul mu (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hmu_sub_lt_one
  have hden_order :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul mu (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)))
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt F hmul_upper
  have hinv_order :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x))))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul mu (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
      F hden_u_pos hden_t_pos hden_order
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
    (E.local_upper
      (RealTheory.mul mu (L.log x)) hwindow.left hwindow.right)
    hinv_order

name: naturalExp_powNat_of_add_law
statement:
theorem naturalExp_powNat_of_add_law
    {exp : Map}
    (hzero : exp RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one)
    (hadd : NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative exp)
    (x : Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      powNat (exp x) n =
        exp (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) x)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.nat_zero]
      change RealTheory.one =
        exp (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero x)
      rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
      exact Eq.symm hzero
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ, ih]
      have harg :
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) x =
            RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) x) x := by
        rw [RealTheory.nat_succ]
        change
          RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat n) RealTheory.one) x =
            RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) x) x
        rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
        rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
      rw [harg]
      exact Eq.symm (hadd (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) x) x)

name: naturalExp_powNat_div_eq_of_add_law
statement:
theorem naturalExp_powNat_div_eq_of_add_law
    {exp : Map}
    (hzero : exp RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one)
    (hadd : NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative exp)
    {x : Point} {n : Nat} (hn : Not (n = 0)) :
    powNat
        (exp
          (RealTheory.mul x
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))))
        n =
      exp x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [naturalExp_powNat_of_add_law hzero hadd]
  have hn_ne :
      Not (RealTheory.nat n = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
          (RealTheory.mul x
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))) =
        x := by
    calc
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
          (RealTheory.mul x
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))) =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) x) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_comm
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) x]
      _ =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))) x := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      _ = RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one x := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hn_ne]
      _ = x := RealTheory.one_mul x
  rw [hmul]

name: naturalExp_global_lower_of_local
statement:
theorem naturalExp_global_lower_of_local
    {exp : Map}
    (hzero : exp RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one)
    (hadd : NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative exp)
    (hlocal : NaturalExpLocalLower exp)
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x) (exp x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_gt x with
  | intro n hn_gt =>
      have hn_ne : Not (n = 0) := by
        intro hn0
        rw [hn0] at hn_gt
        change RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.zero at hn_gt
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx hn_gt)
      cases n with
      | zero =>
          exact False.elim (hn_ne rfl)
      | succ k =>
          let N := k + 1
          let denom := RealTheory.nat N
          let t := RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv denom)
          have hN_ne : Not (N = 0) := Nat.succ_ne_zero k
          have hden_ne : Not (denom = RealTheory.zero) := by
            unfold denom
            exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hN_ne
          have hden_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero denom := by
            unfold denom
            exact RealTheory.nat_succ_pos k
          have hinv_pos :
              RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv denom) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos
          have ht_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero t := by
            unfold t
            exact RealTheory.mul_pos hx hinv_pos
          have ht_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero t :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F ht_pos
          have ht_lt_one : RealTheory.lt t RealTheory.one := by
            have hmul :=
              RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_right
                (x := x) (y := denom)
                (z := RealTheory.inv denom)
                (by
                  change RealTheory.lt x denom
                  unfold denom N
                  exact hn_gt)
                hinv_pos
            change
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv denom))
                (RealTheory.mul denom (RealTheory.inv denom)) at hmul
            rwa [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hden_ne] at hmul
          have hlocal_t :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one t) (exp t) :=
            hlocal t ht_pos ht_lt_one
          have hstep_nonneg :
              RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one t) := by
            exact RealTheory.le_trans
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
              (by
                rw [RealTheory.add_comm RealTheory.one t]
                exact RealTheory.one_le_add_one_of_nonneg ht_nonneg)
          have hbern :=
            one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add ht_nonneg N
          have hN_mul_t :
              RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N) t = x := by
            unfold t denom
            calc
              RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N)
                  (RealTheory.mul x
                    (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N))) =
                  RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N)
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N)) x) := by
                    rw [RealTheory.mul_comm
                      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N)) x]
              _ =
                  RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N)
                      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N))) x := by
                    rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
              _ = RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one x := by
                    rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hden_ne]
              _ = x := RealTheory.one_mul x
          have hbern_x :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
                (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one t) N) := by
            rwa [hN_mul_t] at hbern
          have hpow_strict :
              RealTheory.lt
                (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one t) N)
                (powNat (exp t) N) := by
            unfold N
            exact powNat_strictMono_nonneg_succ
              hstep_nonneg hlocal_t k
          have hpow_exp :
              powNat (exp t) N = exp x := by
            unfold t denom
            exact naturalExp_powNat_div_eq_of_add_law
              hzero hadd hN_ne
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
            hbern_x (by rwa [hpow_exp] at hpow_strict)

name: eulerNumberSequence_one_le
statement:
theorem eulerNumberSequence_one_le (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (EulerNumberSequence n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnpos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (n + 1)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ_pos F n
  have hinv_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (n + 1))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hnpos)
  have hbase :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (n + 1)))
          RealTheory.one) :=
    RealTheory.one_le_add_one_of_nonneg hinv_nonneg
  unfold EulerNumberSequence
  rw [RealTheory.add_comm RealTheory.one
    (RealTheory.inv
      (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (n + 1)))]
  exact one_le_powNat_of_one_le hbase (n + 1)

name: eulerNumberSequence_two_le
statement:
theorem eulerNumberSequence_two_le (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one)
      (EulerNumberSequence n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let denom := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  let eps := RealTheory.inv denom
  have hden_ne : Not (denom = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold denom
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  have hden_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero denom := by
    unfold denom
    exact RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
  have heps_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps := by
    unfold eps
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos)
  have hbern :=
    one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add heps_nonneg (n + 1)
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps) =
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one := by
    unfold eps denom
    rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hden_ne]
  unfold EulerNumberSequence
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one)
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))
        (n + 1))
  rw [<- hleft]
  exact hbern

name: isEulerNumber_one_le
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const RealTheory.one)
    he
    (Eventually.of_forall eulerNumberSequence_one_le)

name: isEulerNumber_two_le
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one))
    he
    (Eventually.of_forall eulerNumberSequence_two_le)

name: isEulerNumber_one_lt
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hone_lt_two :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) := by
    have h :=
      RealTheory.add_lt_add_left RealTheory.zero_lt_one
        RealTheory.one
    change
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
    F hone_lt_two (isEulerNumber_two_le he)

name: eulerNumberSequence_pos
statement:
theorem eulerNumberSequence_pos (n : Nat) :
    PositiveDomain (EulerNumberSequence n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hone_lt_two :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) := by
    have h :=
      RealTheory.add_lt_add_left RealTheory.zero_lt_one
        RealTheory.one
    change
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
    F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one hone_lt_two)
    (eulerNumberSequence_two_le n)

name: isEulerNumber_pos
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    RealTheory.zero_lt_one
    (isEulerNumber_one_le he)

name: isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_tendsto
statement:
theorem isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_tendsto
    {e : Point} (he : IsEulerNumber e)
    (q : NatDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat => powByNatDiv (EulerNumberSequence n) q)
      (powByNatDiv e q)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont :
      ContinuousOn PositiveDomain (PowByNatDivFun q) :=
    powByNatDivFun_continuousOn_positive q
  have hseq :=
    (continuousOn_to_sequential hcont e (isEulerNumber_pos he)).right
  exact hseq EulerNumberSequence eulerNumberSequence_pos he

name: eulerEvenMultipleIndex_succ_add_one
statement:
theorem eulerEvenMultipleIndex_succ_add_one
    {d : Nat} (hd : Not (d = 0)) (k : Nat) :
    EulerEvenMultipleIndex d k + 1 =
      2 * d * (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold EulerEvenMultipleIndex
  have hpos : 0 < 2 * d * (k + 1) := by
    have hdpos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd
    exact Nat.mul_pos
      (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hdpos)
      (Nat.succ_pos k)
  omega

name: eulerEvenMultipleIndex_subsequence
statement:
theorem eulerEvenMultipleIndex_subsequence
    {d : Nat} (hd : Not (d = 0)) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.SubsequenceIndex
      (EulerEvenMultipleIndex d)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  unfold EulerEvenMultipleIndex
  have hdpos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd
  have hApos : 0 < 2 * d :=
    Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hdpos
  have hmul : (2 * d) * (k + 1) < (2 * d) * (k + 2) :=
    Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left
      (Nat.lt_succ_self (k + 1)) hApos
  have hmul' :
      2 * d * (k + 1) <
        2 * d * ((k + 1) + 1) := by
    have hsucc : k + 2 = (k + 1) + 1 := by omega
    rwa [hsucc] at hmul
  have hleft_ge : 1 <= 2 * d * (k + 1) := by
    have hpos : 0 < 2 * d * (k + 1) :=
      Nat.mul_pos hApos (Nat.succ_pos k)
    exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt hpos
  exact Nat.sub_lt_sub_right hleft_ge hmul'

name: isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_evenMultiple_tendsto
statement:
theorem isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_evenMultiple_tendsto
    {e : Point} (he : IsEulerNumber e)
    (q : NatDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
        (fun n : Nat => powByNatDiv (EulerNumberSequence n) q)
        (EulerEvenMultipleIndex q.denominator))
      (powByNatDiv e q)
proof:
:= by
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seqTendsto_of_subsequenceIndex
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_tendsto he q)
    (eulerEvenMultipleIndex_subsequence q.denominator_ne_zero)

name: eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_eq
statement:
theorem eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_eq
    {d : Nat} (hd : Not (d = 0)) (k : Nat) :
    EulerNumberSequence (EulerEvenMultipleIndex d k) =
      powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.nat (2 * d * (k + 1)))))
        (2 * d * (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold EulerNumberSequence
  rw [eulerEvenMultipleIndex_succ_add_one hd k]
  change
    powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.nat (2 * d * (k + 1)))))
        (2 * d * (k + 1)) =
      powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.nat (2 * d * (k + 1)))))
        (2 * d * (k + 1))
  rfl

name: powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_eq
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_eq
    (q : NatDivExponent) (k : Nat) :
    powByNatDiv
        (EulerNumberSequence
          (EulerEvenMultipleIndex q.denominator k)) q =
      powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.nat
              (2 * q.denominator * (k + 1)))))
        (q.numerator * (2 * (k + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := 2 * q.denominator * (k + 1)
  let base :=
    RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N))
  have hN_ne : Not (N = 0) := by
    unfold N
    exact Nat.mul_ne_zero
      (Nat.mul_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
        q.denominator_ne_zero)
      (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
  have hN_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat N) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hN_ne
  have hinv_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hN_pos)
  have hbase_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero base := by
    unfold base
    exact RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
      (by
        rw [RealTheory.add_comm RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N))]
        exact RealTheory.one_le_add_one_of_nonneg hinv_nonneg)
  have hden_mul :
      q.denominator * (2 * (k + 1)) =
        2 * q.denominator * (k + 1) := by
    calc
      q.denominator * (2 * (k + 1)) =
          q.denominator * 2 * (k + 1) := by
            rw [Nat.mul_assoc]
      _ = 2 * q.denominator * (k + 1) := by
            rw [Nat.mul_comm q.denominator 2]
  rw [eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_eq
      q.denominator_ne_zero k]
  unfold N at base
  change
    powByNatDiv
        (powNat base (2 * q.denominator * (k + 1))) q =
      powNat base (q.numerator * (2 * (k + 1)))
  rw [<- hden_mul]
  exact powByNatDiv_powNat_den_mul_of_nonneg
    hbase_nonneg q.numerator q.denominator
    (2 * (k + 1)) q.denominator_ne_zero

name: powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_square_lower
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_square_lower
    (q : NatDivExponent) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (k + 1)))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealTheory.nat
                (2 * q.denominator * (k + 1))))))
        2)
      (powByNatDiv
        (EulerNumberSequence
          (EulerEvenMultipleIndex q.denominator k)) q)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := 2 * q.denominator * (k + 1)
  let eps := RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N)
  have hN_ne : Not (N = 0) := by
    unfold N
    exact Nat.mul_ne_zero
      (Nat.mul_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
        q.denominator_ne_zero)
      (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
  have hN_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat N) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hN_ne
  have heps_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps := by
    unfold eps
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hN_pos)
  have hbern :=
    powNat_two_one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add_double
      heps_nonneg (q.numerator * (k + 1))
  have hright :
      powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps)
          (q.numerator * (k + 1) +
            q.numerator * (k + 1)) =
        powByNatDiv
          (EulerNumberSequence
            (EulerEvenMultipleIndex q.denominator k)) q := by
    rw [powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_eq q k]
    unfold eps N
    have hnum :
        q.numerator * (k + 1) +
            q.numerator * (k + 1) =
          q.numerator * (2 * (k + 1)) := by
      calc
        q.numerator * (k + 1) +
            q.numerator * (k + 1) =
            q.numerator * ((k + 1) + (k + 1)) :=
              Eq.symm
                (Nat.mul_add q.numerator (k + 1) (k + 1))
        _ = q.numerator * (2 * (k + 1)) := by
              have htwo :
                  (k + 1) + (k + 1) =
                    2 * (k + 1) := by omega
              rw [htwo]
    rw [hnum]
  unfold eps N at hbern
  rwa [hright] at hbern

name: variationValueOn_zero
statement:
theorem variationValueOn_zero
    {a x : Point} {f : Map}

name: variationValueOn_partition
statement:
theorem variationValueOn_partition
    {a x : Point} {f : Map} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a x n p) :
    VariationValueOn a x f (partitionVariation f p n)
proof:
:=
  Or.inr
    (Exists.intro n
      (Exists.intro p (And.intro hp rfl)))

name: variationValueOn_nonempty_of_le
statement:
theorem variationValueOn_nonempty_of_le
    {a x : Point} {f : Map}
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x) :
    Exists (VariationValueOn a x f)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxa : RealTheory.le x a
  · have h_eq : a = x := RealTheory.le_antisymm hax hxa
    exact Exists.intro RealTheory.zero
      (variationValueOn_zero h_eq)
  · have hlt : RealTheory.lt a x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hax hxa
    exact Exists.intro
      (partitionVariation f (twoPointPartition a x) 1)
      (variationValueOn_partition
        (strictIntervalPartition_twoPoint hlt))

name: variationValueOn_nonnegative
statement:
theorem variationValueOn_nonnegative
    {a x : Point} {f : Map} {value : Point}
    (hvalue : VariationValueOn a x f value) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero value
proof:
:= by
  cases hvalue with
  | inl hzero =>
      rw [hzero.right]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  | inr hpart =>
      cases hpart with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              rw [hp.right]
              exact partitionVariation_nonnegative f p n

name: variationValueOn_boundedAbove_of_variationBoundOn

      (IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
        (VariationValueOn a x f))
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro V ?_
  intro value hvalue
  cases hvalue with
  | inl hzero =>
      rw [hzero.right]
      exact variationBoundOn_bound_nonnegative hV
  | inr hpart =>
      cases hpart with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              rw [hp.right]
              exact
                variationBoundOn_subinterval_partitionVariation_le
                  hV hx hp.left

name: totalVariationFrom_exists_of_variationBoundOn
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_exists_of_variationBoundOn

name: totalVariationFrom_spec_of_variationBoundOn
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_spec_of_variationBoundOn
    {a b x : Point} {f : Map} {V : Point}

name: totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn
    {a b x : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) :

name: totalVariationFrom_self_eq_zero_of_boundedVariationOn
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_self_eq_zero_of_boundedVariationOn
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f) :
    totalVariationFrom a f a = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab := boundedVariationOn_interval_le h
  have ha : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab
  have hspec := totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn h ha
  have hzeroUpper :
      IsUpperBound F.le (VariationValueOn a a f) F.zero := by
    intro value hvalue
    cases hvalue with
    | inl hzero =>
        rw [hzero.right]
        exact F.le_refl F.zero
    | inr hpartition =>
        cases hpartition with
        | intro n hn =>
            cases hn with
            | intro p hp =>
                have hstrict := hp.left
                have hstep :=
                  Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_step_lt
                    hstrict hstrict.left
                have htail :=
                  Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
                    (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_intervalPartition
                      hstrict)
                    1 n (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hstrict.left) (Nat.le_refl n)
                have hbad := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hstep htail
                rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint
                  hstrict] at hbad
                rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint
                  hstrict] at hbad
                exact False.elim (F.lt_irrefl a hbad)
  apply F.le_antisymm
  · exact hspec.right F.zero hzeroUpper
  · exact hspec.left F.zero (variationValueOn_zero rfl)

name: totalVariationFrom_exists_partitionVariation_gt_sub
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_exists_partitionVariation_gt_sub
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} {eta : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b n p)
              (RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.sub (totalVariationFrom a f b) eta)
                (partitionVariation f p n))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab_le : RealTheory.le a b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab
  have hb : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab_le
  have hspec := totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn h hb
  have hbelow :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub (totalVariationFrom a f b) eta)
        (totalVariationFrom a f b) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heta
  cases
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub F hspec hbelow with
  | intro value hvalue =>
      cases hvalue.left with
      | inl hzero =>
          have hbad : RealTheory.lt b b := by
            rwa [hzero.left] at hab
          exact False.elim
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F b hbad)
      | inr hpart =>
          cases hpart with
          | intro n hn =>
              cases hn with
              | intro p hp =>
                  refine Exists.intro n ?_
                  refine Exists.intro p ?_
                  refine And.intro hp.left ?_
                  have hlt := hvalue.right
                  rwa [hp.right] at hlt

name: partitionVariation_gain_lt_totalVariation_deficit
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_gain_lt_totalVariation_deficit
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    {n m : Nat} {p q : Nat -> Point} {gain : Point}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hq : IntervalPartition a b m q)
    (hgain :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add (partitionVariation f p n) gain)
        (partitionVariation f q m)) :
    RealTheory.lt gain
      (RealTheory.sub
        (totalVariationFrom a f b)
        (partitionVariation f p n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b := by
    match h with
    | Exists.intro _ hV => exact hV.left
  have hb : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab
  have hspec := totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn h hb
  have hqValue :
      VariationValueOn a b f (partitionVariation f q m) :=
    variationValueOn_partition hq
  have hq_le_total :
      F.le
        (partitionVariation f q m)
        (totalVariationFrom a f b) :=
    hspec.left (partitionVariation f q m) hqValue
  have hsum_lt_total :
      F.lt
        (F.add (partitionVariation f p n) gain)
        (totalVariationFrom a f b) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hgain hq_le_total
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_sub_of_add_lt F hsum_lt_total

name: totalVariationFrom_nonnegative_of_boundedVariationOn
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_nonnegative_of_boundedVariationOn
    {a b x : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (totalVariationFrom a f x)
proof:
:= by
  have hspec := totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn h hx
  cases variationValueOn_nonempty_of_le hx.left with
  | intro value hvalue =>
      have hvalue_nonneg := variationValueOn_nonnegative hvalue
      have hvalue_le_total := hspec.left value hvalue
      exact RealTheory.le_trans hvalue_nonneg hvalue_le_total

name: totalVariationFrom_upperBound_subinterval_of_boundedVariationOn
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_upperBound_subinterval_of_boundedVariationOn
    {a b x y : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
      (VariationValueOn a x f)
      (totalVariationFrom a f y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hspec_y := totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn h hy
  intro value hvalue
  cases hvalue with
  | inl hzero =>
      rw [hzero.right]
      exact totalVariationFrom_nonnegative_of_boundedVariationOn h hy
  | inr hpart =>
      cases hpart with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              rw [hp.right]
              by_cases hyx : RealTheory.le y x
              · have hxy_eq : x = y := RealTheory.le_antisymm hxy hyx
                have hvalue_y :
                    VariationValueOn a y f
                      (partitionVariation f p n) := by
                  rw [<- hxy_eq]
                  exact variationValueOn_partition hp.left
                exact hspec_y.left (partitionVariation f p n) hvalue_y
              · have hx_lt_y : RealTheory.lt x y :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hyx
                have happ :
                    IntervalPartition a y (n + 1)
                      (appendRightEndpoint p n y) :=
                  strictIntervalPartition_appendRightEndpoint
                    hp.left hx_lt_y
                have hvalue_y :
                    VariationValueOn a y f
                      (partitionVariation f
                        (appendRightEndpoint p n y) (n + 1)) :=
                  variationValueOn_partition happ
                have happ_le_total :=
                  hspec_y.left
                    (partitionVariation f
                      (appendRightEndpoint p n y) (n + 1))
                    hvalue_y
                have hprefix :=
                  partitionVariation_le_appendRightEndpoint f p n y
                exact RealTheory.le_trans hprefix happ_le_total

name: totalVariationFrom_sub_increment_upperBound
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_sub_increment_upperBound
    {a b x y : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
      (VariationValueOn a x f)
      (RealTheory.sub
        (totalVariationFrom a f y)
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))
  have hspec_y := totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn h hy
  intro value hvalue
  cases hvalue with
  | inl hzero =>
      rw [hzero.right]
      by_cases hyx : RealTheory.le y x
      · have hxy_eq : x = y := RealTheory.le_antisymm hxy hyx
        have hd_zero : d = RealTheory.zero := by
          unfold d
          rw [hxy_eq]
          exact RealTheory.abs_sub_self (f y)
        change
          F.le F.zero
            (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f y) d)
        rw [hd_zero]
        change
          F.le F.zero
            (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f y) F.zero)
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F
          (totalVariationFrom a f y)]
        exact totalVariationFrom_nonnegative_of_boundedVariationOn h hy
      · have hx_lt_y : RealTheory.lt x y :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hyx
        have ha_lt_y : RealTheory.lt a y := by
          rwa [hzero.left]
        have hpart :
            VariationValueOn a y f
              (partitionVariation f (twoPointPartition a y) 1) :=
          variationValueOn_partition
            (strictIntervalPartition_twoPoint ha_lt_y)
        have hpart_eq :
            partitionVariation f (twoPointPartition a y) 1 = d := by
          unfold d
          rw [partitionVariation_twoPoint]
          rw [hzero.left]
        have hd_value : VariationValueOn a y f d := by
          rw [<- hpart_eq]
          exact hpart
        have hd_le_total := hspec_y.left d hd_value
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hd_le_total
  | inr hpart =>
      cases hpart with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              rw [hp.right]
              by_cases hyx : RealTheory.le y x
              · have hxy_eq : x = y := RealTheory.le_antisymm hxy hyx
                have hd_zero : d = RealTheory.zero := by
                  unfold d
                  rw [hxy_eq]
                  exact RealTheory.abs_sub_self (f y)
                have hvalue_y :
                    VariationValueOn a y f
                      (partitionVariation f p n) := by
                  rw [<- hxy_eq]
                  exact variationValueOn_partition hp.left
                have hle_total :=
                  hspec_y.left (partitionVariation f p n) hvalue_y
                change
                  F.le (partitionVariation f p n)
                    (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f y) d)
                rw [hd_zero]
                change
                  F.le (partitionVariation f p n)
                    (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f y) F.zero)
                rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F
                  (totalVariationFrom a f y)]
              · have hx_lt_y : RealTheory.lt x y :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hyx
                have happ :
                    IntervalPartition a y (n + 1)
                      (appendRightEndpoint p n y) :=
                  strictIntervalPartition_appendRightEndpoint
                    hp.left hx_lt_y
                have hvalue_y :
                    VariationValueOn a y f
                      (partitionVariation f
                        (appendRightEndpoint p n y) (n + 1)) :=
                  variationValueOn_partition happ
                have happ_le_total :=
                  hspec_y.left
                    (partitionVariation f
                      (appendRightEndpoint p n y) (n + 1))
                    hvalue_y
                have happ_eq :
                    partitionVariation f
                        (appendRightEndpoint p n y) (n + 1) =
                      RealTheory.add
                        (partitionVariation f p n) d := by
                  unfold d
                  rw [partitionVariation_appendRightEndpoint_eq_add_last]
                  rw [strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint hp.left]
                have hadd_le_total :
                    RealTheory.le
