                      (RealTheory.add
                        (partitionVariation f p n) d)
                      (totalVariationFrom a f y) := by
                  rw [<- happ_eq]
                  exact happ_le_total
                exact
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_sub_of_add_le
                    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hadd_le_total

name: totalVariationFrom_monotoneOn_closedInterval
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_monotoneOn_closedInterval
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f) :
    MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (totalVariationFrom a f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  have hspec_x := totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn h hx
  exact hspec_x.right (totalVariationFrom a f y)
    (totalVariationFrom_upperBound_subinterval_of_boundedVariationOn
      h hy hxy)

name: totalVariationFrom_increment_abs_le
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_increment_abs_le
    {a b x y : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x)))
      (RealTheory.sub
        (totalVariationFrom a f y)
        (totalVariationFrom a f x))
proof:
:= by
  let d := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))
  let Vx := totalVariationFrom a f x
  let Vy := totalVariationFrom a f y
  have hspec_x := totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn h hx
  have hupper :
      IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
        (VariationValueOn a x f)
        (RealTheory.sub Vy d) := by
    unfold Vy d
    exact totalVariationFrom_sub_increment_upperBound h hy hxy
  have hVx_le_sub : RealTheory.le Vx (RealTheory.sub Vy d) := by
    unfold Vx
    exact hspec_x.right (RealTheory.sub Vy d) hupper
  change RealTheory.le d (RealTheory.sub Vy Vx)
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_right_le_sub_left_of_le_sub
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hVx_le_sub

name: partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_of_intervalPartition
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_of_intervalPartition
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hp :
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
        a b n p) :
    RealTheory.le
      (partitionVariation f p n)
      (totalVariationFrom a f b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let V := fun x : Point => totalVariationFrom a f x
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_interval_le hp
  have ha : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab
  have hVa_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (V a) := by
    dsimp [V]
    exact totalVariationFrom_nonnegative_of_boundedVariationOn h ha
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (partitionVariation f p n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub (V (p (k + 1))) (V (p k)))
          n) := by
    unfold partitionVariation
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (partitionVariationTerm f p)
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.sub (V (p (k + 1))) (V (p k)))
      n
      (fun k hk => by
        unfold partitionVariationTerm
        dsimp [V]
        exact totalVariationFrom_increment_abs_le h
          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
            hp hk)
          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
            hp hk)
          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_step_le
            hp hk))
  have htelescope :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_telescope_sub
      (fun k : Nat => V (p k)) n
  rw [htelescope] at hsum
  have hend :
      RealTheory.sub (V (p n)) (V (p 0)) =
        RealTheory.sub (V b) (V a) := by
    rw
      [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_right_endpoint
        hp,
       Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_left_endpoint
        hp]
  rw [hend] at hsum
  have hsub_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub (V b) (V a))
        (V b) := by
    dsimp [V]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic
      F hVa_nonneg
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hsum hsub_le

name: partitionVariation_adjacentPartition_eq_add
statement:
private theorem partitionVariation_adjacentPartition_eq_add
    {a c b : Point} {f : Map}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a c leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition c b rightCount right) :
    partitionVariation f
        (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition
          left right leftCount)
        (leftCount + rightCount) =
      RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariation f left leftCount)
        (partitionVariation f right rightCount)
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length]
  have hleftSum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (partitionVariationTerm f
            (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition
              left right leftCount))
          leftCount =
        RealTheory.finiteSum (partitionVariationTerm f left) leftCount := by
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt leftCount (fun k hk => by
      unfold partitionVariationTerm
      rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
        left right hk]
      by_cases hsucc : k + 1 < leftCount
      · rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
          left right hsucc]
      · have heq : k + 1 = leftCount := by omega
        rw [heq]
        rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_boundary]
        rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint
          hright]
        rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint
          hleft])
  rw [hleftSum]
  have hrightSum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            partitionVariationTerm f
              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition
                left right leftCount)
              (leftCount + j))
          rightCount =
        RealTheory.finiteSum (partitionVariationTerm f right) rightCount := by
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr (fun j : Nat => by
      unfold partitionVariationTerm
      rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_right_shift]
      have hidx : leftCount + j + 1 = leftCount + (j + 1) := by omega
      rw [hidx]
      rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_right_shift])
      rightCount
  rw [hrightSum]

name: boundedVariationOn_subinterval_of_closedInterval
statement:
private theorem boundedVariationOn_subinterval_of_closedInterval
    {a b x y : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    BoundedVariationOn x y f
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases h with
  | intro V hV =>
      refine Exists.intro V ?_
      refine And.intro hxy ?_
      refine And.intro hV.right.left ?_
      intro n p hp
      by_cases hxa : RealTheory.le x a
      · have hax : a = x := RealTheory.le_antisymm hx.left hxa
        have hp' : IntervalPartition a y n p := by
          rw [hax]
          exact hp
        exact variationBoundOn_subinterval_partitionVariation_le hV hy hp'
      · have hax : RealTheory.lt a x :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx.left hxa
        let left := twoPointPartition a x
        let joined :=
          Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition
            left p 1
        have hleft : IntervalPartition a x 1 left :=
          strictIntervalPartition_twoPoint hax
        have hjoined : IntervalPartition a y (1 + n) joined := by
          refine And.intro (by omega) ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · unfold joined
            rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
              left p (Nat.zero_lt_succ 0)]
            exact
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint
                hleft
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · unfold joined
            rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_right_shift]
            exact
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint
                hp
          · intro k hk
            by_cases hkleft : k < 1
            · have hkzero : k = 0 := by omega
              subst k
              unfold joined
              rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
                left p (Nat.zero_lt_succ 0)]
              rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_boundary]
              rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint
                hleft]
              rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint
                hp]
              exact hax
            · have hone_le : 1 <= k := Nat.le_of_not_gt hkleft
              have hone_le_succ : 1 <= k + 1 :=
                Nat.le_trans hone_le (Nat.le_succ k)
              unfold joined
              rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_right_of_le
                left p hone_le]
              rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_right_of_le
                left p hone_le_succ]
              have hsub : (k + 1) - 1 = (k - 1) + 1 := by omega
              rw [hsub]
              exact
                Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_step_lt
                  hp (by omega)
        have hsum :=
          partitionVariation_adjacentPartition_eq_add (f := f) hleft hp
        change
          partitionVariation f joined (1 + n) =
            F.add (partitionVariation f left 1)
              (partitionVariation f p n) at hsum
        have hleft_nonneg := partitionVariation_nonnegative f left 1
        have hle := F.add_le_add_right hleft_nonneg
          (partitionVariation f p n)
        change
          F.le
            (F.add F.zero (partitionVariation f p n))
            (F.add (partitionVariation f left 1)
              (partitionVariation f p n)) at hle
        rw [F.zero_add] at hle
        rw [<- hsum] at hle
        have hbound :=
          variationBoundOn_subinterval_partitionVariation_le hV hy hjoined
        exact F.le_trans hle hbound

name: partitionVariation_le_cutCellPrefix_add_suffix
statement:
private theorem partitionVariation_le_cutCellPrefix_add_suffix
    {a b c : Point} {f : Map} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (_hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n)
    (_hc : PartitionCell p k c) :
    RealTheory.le
      (partitionVariation f p n)
      (RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariation f
          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition
            p k c)
          (k + 1))
        (partitionVariation f
          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition
            p k c)
          (n - k)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let pref :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition p k c
  let suff :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition p k c
  let leftTerm := F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f (p k)))
  let rightTerm := F.abs (F.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f c))
  let tail :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
      (n - (k + 1))
  have hprefixBase :
      partitionVariation f pref k = partitionVariation f p k := by
    unfold partitionVariation
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt k
      (fun i hi => by
        unfold partitionVariationTerm pref
        rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le
          p k c (Nat.le_of_lt hi)]
        rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le
          p k c (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)])
  have hprefix :
      partitionVariation f pref (k + 1) =
        F.add (partitionVariation f p k) leftTerm := by
    rw [partitionVariation_succ]
    rw [hprefixBase]
    unfold partitionVariationTerm pref leftTerm
    rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le
      p k c (Nat.le_refl k)]
    rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_succ]
    rfl
  have hcount : n - k = n - (k + 1) + 1 := by omega
  have hsuffix :
      partitionVariation f suff (n - k) =
        F.add rightTerm tail := by
    have hfirst :
        partitionVariationTerm f suff 0 = rightTerm := by
      unfold partitionVariationTerm suff rightTerm
      rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_zero]
      rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_succ]
      rfl
    have htail :
        RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f suff (j + 1))
            (n - (k + 1)) = tail := by
      unfold tail
      exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
        (fun j : Nat => by
          unfold partitionVariationTerm suff
          rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_of_pos
            p k c (Nat.succ_pos j)]
          rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_of_pos
            p k c (by omega)]
          have hleftIndex : k + (j + 1) = k + 1 + j := by omega
          have hrightIndex : k + (j + 1 + 1) = k + 1 + j + 1 := by omega
          rw [hleftIndex, hrightIndex])
        (n - (k + 1))
    rw [hcount]
    unfold partitionVariation
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first]
    rw [hfirst, htail]
    rfl
  have hcell :
      F.le (partitionVariationTerm f p k)
        (F.add leftTerm rightTerm) := by
    unfold partitionVariationTerm leftTerm rightTerm
    have htri := F.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
      (F.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f c))
      (F.sub (f c) (f (p k)))
    rw [F.sub_add_sub_cancel] at htri
    rwa [F.add_comm] at htri
  have hsplit :
      partitionVariation f p n =
        F.add (partitionVariation f p k)
          (F.add (partitionVariationTerm f p k) tail) := by
    unfold tail
    have hn_split : n = (k + 1) + (n - (k + 1)) := by omega
    calc
      partitionVariation f p n =
          partitionVariation f p ((k + 1) + (n - (k + 1))) := by
            exact congrArg (fun m : Nat => partitionVariation f p m) hn_split
      _ = F.add
          (partitionVariation f p (k + 1))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p ((k + 1) + j))
            (n - (k + 1))) := by
            unfold partitionVariation
            rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length]
            rfl
      _ = F.add
          (F.add (partitionVariation f p k)
            (partitionVariationTerm f p k))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p ((k + 1) + j))
            (n - (k + 1))) := by
            rw [partitionVariation_succ]
            rfl
      _ = F.add (partitionVariation f p k)
          (F.add (partitionVariationTerm f p k)
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
              (n - (k + 1)))) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
  change
    F.le
      (partitionVariation f p n)
      (F.add (partitionVariation f pref (k + 1))
        (partitionVariation f suff (n - k)))
  rw [hsplit, hprefix, hsuffix]
  unfold tail
  have hcell_tail := F.add_le_add_right hcell
    (RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
      (n - (k + 1)))
  have hwith_prefix := F.add_le_add_left hcell_tail
    (partitionVariation f p k)
  change
    F.le
      (F.add (partitionVariation f p k)
        (F.add (partitionVariationTerm f p k)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
            (n - (k + 1)))))
      (F.add
        (F.add (partitionVariation f p k)
          (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f (p k)))))
        (F.add
          (F.abs (F.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f c)))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
            (n - (k + 1)))))
  have halg :
      F.add (partitionVariation f p k)
          (F.add
            (F.add
              (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f (p k))))
              (F.abs (F.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f c))))
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
              (n - (k + 1)))) =
        F.add
        (F.add (partitionVariation f p k)
          (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f (p k)))))
        (F.add
          (F.abs (F.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f c)))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
            (n - (k + 1)))) := by
    rw [F.add_assoc]
    rw [F.add_assoc]
  rwa [halg] at hwith_prefix

name: totalVariationFrom_additive_of_boundedVariationOn
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_additive_of_boundedVariationOn
    {a b c : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c) :
    totalVariationFrom a f b =
      RealTheory.add
        (totalVariationFrom a f c)
        (totalVariationFrom c f b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab := boundedVariationOn_interval_le h
  have ha : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab
  have hb : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab
  have hac :=
    boundedVariationOn_subinterval_of_closedInterval h ha hc hc.left
  have hcb :=
    boundedVariationOn_subinterval_of_closedInterval h hc hb hc.right
  have hspec_ab := totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn h hb
  have hspec_ac := totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn hac
    (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hc.left)
  have hspec_cb := totalVariationFrom_spec_of_boundedVariationOn hcb
    (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hc.right)
  have hleft_nonneg := totalVariationFrom_nonnegative_of_boundedVariationOn
    hac (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hc.left)
  have hright_nonneg := totalVariationFrom_nonnegative_of_boundedVariationOn
    hcb (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hc.right)
  have hsum_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero
        (F.add (totalVariationFrom a f c)
          (totalVariationFrom c f b)) := by
    have hsum := F.add_le_add hleft_nonneg hright_nonneg
    change
      F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero)
        (F.add (totalVariationFrom a f c)
          (totalVariationFrom c f b)) at hsum
    rwa [F.zero_add] at hsum
  have hupper :
      IsUpperBound F.le (VariationValueOn a b f)
        (F.add (totalVariationFrom a f c)
          (totalVariationFrom c f b)) := by
    intro value hvalue
    cases hvalue with
    | inl hzero =>
        rw [hzero.right]
        exact hsum_nonneg
    | inr hpart =>
        cases hpart with
        | intro n hn =>
            cases hn with
            | intro p hp =>
                rw [hp.right]
                cases n with
                | zero =>
                    exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hp.left.left)
                | succ m =>
                    have hpBase :=
                      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_intervalPartition
                        hp.left
                    cases
                        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_cover_succ
                          hpBase hc with
                    | intro k hkcell =>
                        have hprefix :=
                          Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cutCellPrefix
                            hpBase hkcell.left hkcell.right
                        have hsuffix :=
                          Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cutCellSuffix
                            hpBase hkcell.left hkcell.right
                        have hsplit :=
                          partitionVariation_le_cutCellPrefix_add_suffix
                            (f := f) hp.left hkcell.left hkcell.right
                        have hprefix_le :=
                          partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_of_intervalPartition
                            hac hprefix
                        have hsuffix_le :=
                          partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_of_intervalPartition
                            hcb hsuffix
                        exact F.le_trans hsplit
                          (F.add_le_add hprefix_le hsuffix_le)
  have hab_le_sum := hspec_ab.right
    (F.add (totalVariationFrom a f c)
      (totalVariationFrom c f b)) hupper
  have hstrictAdjacent :
      forall {u v w : Point}
        {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat},
        IntervalPartition u v leftCount left ->
        IntervalPartition v w rightCount right ->
        IntervalPartition u w (leftCount + rightCount)
          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition
            left right leftCount) := by
    intro u v w left right leftCount rightCount hleft hright
    refine And.intro
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hleft.left
        (Nat.le_add_right leftCount rightCount)) ?_
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
        left right hleft.left]
      exact
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint
          hleft
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_right_shift]
      exact
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint
          hright
    · intro k hk
      by_cases hkleft : k < leftCount
      · by_cases hksucc : k + 1 < leftCount
        · rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
            left right hkleft]
          rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
            left right hksucc]
          exact
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_step_lt
              hleft hkleft
        · have heq : k + 1 = leftCount := by omega
          rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
            left right hkleft]
          rw [heq]
          rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_boundary]
          rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint
            hright]
          have hstep :=
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_step_lt
              hleft hkleft
          rwa [heq,
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint
              hleft] at hstep
      · have hleft_le : leftCount <= k := Nat.le_of_not_gt hkleft
        have hleft_le_succ : leftCount <= k + 1 :=
          Nat.le_trans hleft_le (Nat.le_succ k)
        rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_right_of_le
          left right hleft_le]
        rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition_right_of_le
          left right hleft_le_succ]
        have hsub : (k + 1) - leftCount = (k - leftCount) + 1 := by omega
        rw [hsub]
        exact
          Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_step_lt
            hright (by omega)
  have hpair :
      forall u v : Point,
        VariationValueOn a c f u ->
        VariationValueOn c b f v ->
        F.le (F.add u v) (totalVariationFrom a f b) := by
    intro u v hu hv
    cases hu with
    | inl hzero =>
        have hv_ab : VariationValueOn a b f v := by
          rw [hzero.left]
          exact hv
        rw [hzero.right]
        change F.le (F.add F.zero v) (totalVariationFrom a f b)
        rw [F.zero_add]
        exact hspec_ab.left v hv_ab
    | inr hleft =>
        cases hv with
        | inl hzero =>
            have hu_ab : VariationValueOn a b f u := by
              rw [<- hzero.left]
              exact Or.inr hleft
            rw [hzero.right]
            change F.le (F.add u F.zero) (totalVariationFrom a f b)
            rw [F.add_zero]
            exact hspec_ab.left u hu_ab
        | inr hright =>
            cases hleft with
            | intro leftCount hleftCount =>
                cases hleftCount with
                | intro left hleftData =>
                    cases hright with
                    | intro rightCount hrightCount =>
                        cases hrightCount with
                        | intro right hrightData =>
                            rw [hleftData.right, hrightData.right]
                            have hj :
                                IntervalPartition a b
                                  (leftCount + rightCount)
                                  (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition
                                    left right leftCount) :=
                              hstrictAdjacent hleftData.left hrightData.left
                            have hj_le := hspec_ab.left
                              (partitionVariation f
                                (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.adjacentPartition
                                  left right leftCount)
                                (leftCount + rightCount))
                              (variationValueOn_partition hj)
                            rw [partitionVariation_adjacentPartition_eq_add
                              hleftData.left hrightData.left] at hj_le
                            exact hj_le
  have hleft_plus_right :
      forall u : Point, VariationValueOn a c f u ->
        F.le (F.add u (totalVariationFrom c f b))
          (totalVariationFrom a f b) := by
    intro u hu
    have hrightUpper :
        IsUpperBound F.le (VariationValueOn c b f)
          (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f b) u) := by
      intro v hv
      have hp := hpair u v hu hv
      rw [F.add_comm u v] at hp
      exact F.le_sub_of_add_le hp
    have hright_le := hspec_cb.right
      (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f b) u) hrightUpper
    have hadd := F.add_le_add_left hright_le u
    change
      F.le
        (F.add u (totalVariationFrom c f b))
        (F.add u (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f b) u)) at hadd
    have hcancel :
        F.add u (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f b) u) =
          totalVariationFrom a f b := by
      rw [F.add_comm]
      exact F.sub_add_cancel (totalVariationFrom a f b) u
    rwa [hcancel] at hadd
  have hleftUpper :
      IsUpperBound F.le (VariationValueOn a c f)
        (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f b)
          (totalVariationFrom c f b)) := by
    intro u hu
    exact F.le_sub_of_add_le (hleft_plus_right u hu)
  have hleft_le := hspec_ac.right
    (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f b)
      (totalVariationFrom c f b)) hleftUpper
  have hsum_le := F.add_le_add_right hleft_le
    (totalVariationFrom c f b)
  change
    F.le
      (F.add (totalVariationFrom a f c)
        (totalVariationFrom c f b))
      (F.add
        (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f b)
          (totalVariationFrom c f b))
        (totalVariationFrom c f b)) at hsum_le
  rw [F.sub_add_cancel] at hsum_le
  exact F.le_antisymm hab_le_sum hsum_le

name: totalVariationFrom_right_increment_lt_of_continuousAtOn
statement:
private theorem totalVariationFrom_right_increment_lt_of_continuousAtOn
    {a b c eps : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hcont : ContinuousAtOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.lt c b)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall x : Point,
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval c b x ->
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x c) delta ->
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                    (totalVariationFrom a f c)) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let eta := F.half eps
  have heta : F.lt F.zero eta := F.half_pos heps
  have hab := boundedVariationOn_interval_le h
  have hb : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab
  have hcbBV :=
    boundedVariationOn_subinterval_of_closedInterval
      h hcont.left hb (F.le_of_lt hcb)
  cases hcont.right eta heta with
  | intro deltaF hdeltaF =>
      cases totalVariationFrom_exists_partitionVariation_gt_sub
          hcb hcbBV heta with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              have hcpOne : F.lt c (p 1) := by
                have hstep :=
                  Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_step_lt
                    hp.left hp.left.left
                rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint
                  hp.left] at hstep
                exact hstep
              let gap := F.sub (p 1) c
              have hgap : F.lt F.zero gap := by
                unfold gap
                exact F.sub_pos_of_lt hcpOne
              let delta := F.min2 deltaF gap
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro (F.min2_pos hdeltaF.left hgap) ?_
              intro x hx hxcDelta
              by_cases hxcEq : x = c
              · rw [hxcEq]
                change
                  F.lt
                    (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f c)
                      (totalVariationFrom a f c)) eps
                rw [F.sub_self]
                exact heps
              · have hdeltaLeF : F.le delta deltaF :=
                  F.min2_le_left deltaF gap
                have hdeltaLeGap : F.le delta gap :=
                  F.min2_le_right deltaF gap
                have hxcF : F.lt (F.sub x c) deltaF :=
                  F.lt_of_lt_of_le hxcDelta hdeltaLeF
                have hxcGap : F.lt (F.sub x c) gap :=
                  F.lt_of_lt_of_le hxcDelta hdeltaLeGap
                have hxGlobal : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
                  And.intro (F.le_trans hcont.left.left hx.left) hx.right
                have hdist : F.lt (dist x c) deltaF := by
                  unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
                  rw [F.abs_of_nonneg (F.sub_nonneg_of_le hx.left)]
                  exact hxcF
                have hfunDist := hdeltaF.right x hxGlobal hxcEq hdist
                have hfun :
                    F.lt (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c))) eta := by
                  change F.lt (dist (f x) (f c)) eta at hfunDist
                  unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hfunDist
                  exact hfunDist
                have hxLtOne : F.lt x (p 1) := by
                  unfold gap at hxcGap
                  have hlt := F.lt_add_of_sub_lt hxcGap
                  have hcancel : F.add c (F.sub (p 1) c) = p 1 := by
                    rw [F.add_comm]
                    exact F.sub_add_cancel (p 1) c
                  rwa [hcancel] at hlt
                have hxCell : PartitionCell p 0 x := by
                  change RealTheory.ClosedInterval (p 0) (p (0 + 1)) x
                  rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint
                    hp.left]
                  exact And.intro hx.left (F.le_of_lt hxLtOne)
                let pref :=
                  Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition
                    p 0 x
                let suff :=
                  Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition
                    p 0 x
                have hpref :
                    partitionVariation f pref 1 =
                      F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c)) := by
                  rw [partitionVariation_one]
                  unfold partitionVariationTerm pref
                  rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le
                    p 0 x (Nat.le_refl 0)]
                  rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_succ]
                  rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint
                    hp.left]
                  rfl
                have hpBase :=
                  Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_intervalPartition
                    hp.left
                have hsuffPart :
                    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
                      x b (n - 0) suff := by
                  unfold suff
                  exact
                    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cutCellSuffix
                      hpBase hp.left.left hxCell
                have hxb :=
                  boundedVariationOn_subinterval_of_closedInterval
                    h hxGlobal hb hx.right
                have hsuffLe :=
                  partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_of_intervalPartition
                    hxb hsuffPart
                have hsplit :=
                  partitionVariation_le_cutCellPrefix_add_suffix
                    (f := f) hp.left hp.left.left hxCell
                change
                  F.le (partitionVariation f p n)
                    (F.add (partitionVariation f pref 1)
                      (partitionVariation f suff (n - 0))) at hsplit
                rw [hpref] at hsplit
                have hsplitBound := F.le_trans hsplit
                  (F.add_le_add
                    (F.le_refl (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c)))) hsuffLe)
                have hnearBound := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hp.right hsplitBound
                have hcbAdd :=
                  totalVariationFrom_additive_of_boundedVariationOn hcbBV hx
                rw [hcbAdd] at hnearBound
                have hmiddle :
                    F.lt (totalVariationFrom c f x)
                      (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c)))) := by
                  have hadd := F.add_lt_add_right hnearBound eta
                  change
                    F.lt
                      (F.add
                        (F.sub
                          (F.add (totalVariationFrom c f x)
                            (totalVariationFrom x f b)) eta) eta)
                      (F.add
                        (F.add (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c)))
                          (totalVariationFrom x f b)) eta) at hadd
                  rw [F.sub_add_cancel] at hadd
                  have hreorder :
                      F.add
                          (F.add (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c)))
                            (totalVariationFrom x f b)) eta =
                        F.add
                          (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c))))
                          (totalVariationFrom x f b) := by
                    calc
                      F.add
                          (F.add (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c)))
                            (totalVariationFrom x f b)) eta =
                          F.add (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c)))
                            (F.add (totalVariationFrom x f b) eta) := by
                              rw [<- F.add_assoc]
                      _ = F.add (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c)))
                            (F.add eta (totalVariationFrom x f b)) := by
                              rw [F.add_comm
                                (totalVariationFrom x f b) eta]
                      _ = F.add
                            (F.add (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c))) eta)
                            (totalVariationFrom x f b) := by
                              rw [F.add_assoc]
                      _ = F.add
                            (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c))))
                            (totalVariationFrom x f b) := by
                              rw [F.add_comm
                                (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c))) eta]
                  rw [hreorder] at hadd
                  have hcancel := F.add_lt_add_right hadd
                    (F.neg (totalVariationFrom x f b))
                  change
                    F.lt
                      (F.add
                        (F.add (totalVariationFrom c f x)
                          (totalVariationFrom x f b))
                        (F.neg (totalVariationFrom x f b)))
                      (F.add
                        (F.add
                          (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c))))
                          (totalVariationFrom x f b))
                        (F.neg (totalVariationFrom x f b))) at hcancel
                  rwa [F.add_neg_cancel_right, F.add_neg_cancel_right]
                    at hcancel
                have hetaFun :
                    F.lt (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c)))) eps := by
                  have hadd := F.add_lt_add_left hfun eta
                  change
                    F.lt
                      (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c))))
                      (F.add eta eta) at hadd
                  rwa [F.half_add_half] at hadd
                have hcx : F.lt (totalVariationFrom c f x) eps :=
                  F.lt_trans hmiddle hetaFun
                have hax :=
                  boundedVariationOn_subinterval_of_closedInterval
                    h
                    (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab)
                    hxGlobal hxGlobal.left
                have hcAx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a x c :=
                  And.intro hcont.left.left hx.left
                have haxAdd :=
                  totalVariationFrom_additive_of_boundedVariationOn hax hcAx
                change
                  F.lt
                    (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                      (totalVariationFrom a f c)) eps
                rw [haxAdd]
                change
                  F.lt
                    (F.sub
                      (F.add (totalVariationFrom a f c)
                        (totalVariationFrom c f x))
                      (totalVariationFrom a f c)) eps
                rw [F.add_comm]
                rw [F.add_sub_cancel]
                exact hcx

name: totalVariationFrom_left_increment_lt_of_continuousAtOn
statement:
private theorem totalVariationFrom_left_increment_lt_of_continuousAtOn
    {a b c eps : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hcont : ContinuousAtOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f c)
    (hac : RealTheory.lt a c)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall x : Point,
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x ->
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c x) delta ->
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (totalVariationFrom a f c)
                    (totalVariationFrom a f x)) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let eta := F.half eps
  have heta : F.lt F.zero eta := F.half_pos heps
  have hab := boundedVariationOn_interval_le h
  have ha : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab
  have hacBV :=
    boundedVariationOn_subinterval_of_closedInterval
      h ha hcont.left (F.le_of_lt hac)
  cases hcont.right eta heta with
  | intro deltaF hdeltaF =>
      cases totalVariationFrom_exists_partitionVariation_gt_sub
          hac hacBV heta with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              cases n with
              | zero =>
                  exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hp.left.left)
              | succ m =>
                  have hpmC : F.lt (p m) c := by
                    have hstep :=
                      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_step_lt
                        hp.left (Nat.lt_succ_self m)
                    rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint
                      hp.left] at hstep
                    exact hstep
                  let gap := F.sub c (p m)
                  have hgap : F.lt F.zero gap := by
                    unfold gap
                    exact F.sub_pos_of_lt hpmC
                  let delta := F.min2 deltaF gap
                  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                  refine And.intro (F.min2_pos hdeltaF.left hgap) ?_
                  intro x hx hcxDelta
                  by_cases hxcEq : x = c
                  · rw [hxcEq]
                    change
                      F.lt
                        (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f c)
                          (totalVariationFrom a f c)) eps
                    rw [F.sub_self]
                    exact heps
                  · have hdeltaLeF : F.le delta deltaF :=
                      F.min2_le_left deltaF gap
                    have hdeltaLeGap : F.le delta gap :=
                      F.min2_le_right deltaF gap
                    have hcxF : F.lt (F.sub c x) deltaF :=
                      F.lt_of_lt_of_le hcxDelta hdeltaLeF
                    have hcxGap : F.lt (F.sub c x) gap :=
                      F.lt_of_lt_of_le hcxDelta hdeltaLeGap
                    have hxGlobal : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
                      And.intro hx.left (F.le_trans hx.right hcont.left.right)
                    have hdist : F.lt (dist x c) deltaF := by
                      rw [dist_comm x c]
                      unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
                      rw [F.abs_of_nonneg (F.sub_nonneg_of_le hx.right)]
                      exact hcxF
                    have hfunDist := hdeltaF.right x hxGlobal hxcEq hdist
                    have hfun :
                        F.lt (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x))) eta := by
                      change
                        F.lt (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f c))) eta at hfunDist
                      rwa [F.abs_sub_comm] at hfunDist
                    have hmLtX : F.lt (p m) x := by
                      unfold gap at hcxGap
                      have hlt := F.sub_lt_of_lt_right hcxGap
                      have hcancel : F.sub c (F.sub c (p m)) = p m := by
                        rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
                        rw [<- F.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub c (p m)]
                        rw [F.add_comm]
                        rw [F.sub_add_cancel]
                      rwa [hcancel] at hlt
                    have hxCell : PartitionCell p m x := by
                      change
                        RealTheory.ClosedInterval (p m) (p (m + 1)) x
                      rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint
                        hp.left]
                      exact And.intro (F.le_of_lt hmLtX) hx.right
                    let pref :=
                      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition
                        p m x
                    let suff :=
                      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition
                        p m x
                    have hcount : m + 1 - m = 1 := by omega
                    have hsuff :
                        partitionVariation f suff (m + 1 - m) =
                          F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x)) := by
                      rw [hcount]
                      rw [partitionVariation_one]
                      unfold partitionVariationTerm suff
                      rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_zero]
                      rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_succ]
                      rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint
                        hp.left]
                      rfl
                    have hpBase :=
                      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_intervalPartition
                        hp.left
                    have hprefPart :
                        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
                          a x (m + 1) pref := by
                      unfold pref
                      exact
                        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cutCellPrefix
                          hpBase (Nat.lt_succ_self m) hxCell
                    have hax :=
                      boundedVariationOn_subinterval_of_closedInterval
                        h ha hxGlobal hx.left
                    have hprefLe :=
                      partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_of_intervalPartition
                        hax hprefPart
                    have hsplit :=
                      partitionVariation_le_cutCellPrefix_add_suffix
                        (f := f) hp.left (Nat.lt_succ_self m) hxCell
                    change
                      F.le (partitionVariation f p (m + 1))
                        (F.add (partitionVariation f pref (m + 1))
                          (partitionVariation f suff (m + 1 - m))) at hsplit
                    rw [hsuff] at hsplit
                    have hsplitBound := F.le_trans hsplit
                      (F.add_le_add hprefLe
                        (F.le_refl (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x)))))
                    have hnearBound := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hp.right hsplitBound
                    have hacAdd :=
                      totalVariationFrom_additive_of_boundedVariationOn hacBV hx
                    rw [hacAdd] at hnearBound
                    have hmiddle :
                        F.lt (totalVariationFrom x f c)
                          (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x)))) := by
                      have hadd := F.add_lt_add_right hnearBound eta
                      change
                        F.lt
                          (F.add
                            (F.sub
                              (F.add (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                                (totalVariationFrom x f c)) eta) eta)
                          (F.add
                            (F.add (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                              (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x)))) eta) at hadd
                      rw [F.sub_add_cancel] at hadd
                      have hreorder :
                          F.add
                              (F.add (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                                (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x)))) eta =
                            F.add (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                              (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x)))) := by
                        calc
                          F.add
                              (F.add (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                                (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x)))) eta =
                              F.add (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                                (F.add (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x))) eta) := by
                                  rw [<- F.add_assoc]
                          _ = F.add (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                                (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x)))) := by
                                  rw [F.add_comm
                                    (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x))) eta]
                      rw [hreorder] at hadd
                      rw [F.add_comm (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                        (totalVariationFrom x f c)] at hadd
                      rw [F.add_comm (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                        (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x))))] at hadd
                      have hcancel := F.add_lt_add_right hadd
                        (F.neg (totalVariationFrom a f x))
                      change
                        F.lt
                          (F.add
                            (F.add (totalVariationFrom x f c)
                              (totalVariationFrom a f x))
                            (F.neg (totalVariationFrom a f x)))
                          (F.add
                            (F.add
                              (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x))))
                              (totalVariationFrom a f x))
                            (F.neg (totalVariationFrom a f x))) at hcancel
                      rwa [F.add_neg_cancel_right, F.add_neg_cancel_right]
                        at hcancel
                    have hetaFun :
                        F.lt (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x)))) eps := by
                      have hadd := F.add_lt_add_left hfun eta
                      change
                        F.lt
                          (F.add eta (F.abs (F.sub (f c) (f x))))
                          (F.add eta eta) at hadd
                      rwa [F.half_add_half] at hadd
                    have hxc : F.lt (totalVariationFrom x f c) eps :=
                      F.lt_trans hmiddle hetaFun
                    change
                      F.lt
                        (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f c)
                          (totalVariationFrom a f x)) eps
                    rw [hacAdd]
                    change
                      F.lt
                        (F.sub
                          (F.add (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                            (totalVariationFrom x f c))
                          (totalVariationFrom a f x)) eps
                    rw [F.add_comm]
                    rw [F.add_sub_cancel]
                    exact hxc

name: totalVariationFrom_continuousOn_closedInterval
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_continuousOn_closedInterval
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hf : ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f) :
    ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (totalVariationFrom a f)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro c hc
  refine And.intro hc ?_
  intro eps heps
  have hcont := hf c hc
  have hleft :
      Exists
        (fun delta : Point =>
          And (F.lt F.zero delta)
            (forall x : Point,
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x ->
                F.lt (F.sub c x) delta ->
                  F.lt
                    (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f c)
                      (totalVariationFrom a f x)) eps)) := by
    by_cases hac : F.lt a c
    · exact totalVariationFrom_left_increment_lt_of_continuousAtOn
        h hcont hac heps
    · have hca : F.le c a := F.le_of_not_lt hac
      have hacEq : a = c := F.le_antisymm hc.left hca
      refine Exists.intro F.one ?_
      refine And.intro F.zero_lt_one ?_
      intro x hx _hxDelta
      have hxc : x = c := by
        rw [hacEq] at hx
        exact F.le_antisymm hx.right hx.left
      rw [hxc]
      rw [F.sub_self]
      exact heps
  have hright :
      Exists
        (fun delta : Point =>
          And (F.lt F.zero delta)
            (forall x : Point,
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval c b x ->
                F.lt (F.sub x c) delta ->
                  F.lt
                    (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                      (totalVariationFrom a f c)) eps)) := by
    by_cases hcb : F.lt c b
    · exact totalVariationFrom_right_increment_lt_of_continuousAtOn
        h hcont hcb heps
    · have hbc : F.le b c := F.le_of_not_lt hcb
      have hcbEq : c = b := F.le_antisymm hc.right hbc
      refine Exists.intro F.one ?_
      refine And.intro F.zero_lt_one ?_
      intro x hx _hxDelta
      have hxc : x = c := by
        rw [hcbEq] at hx
        have hxb : x = b := F.le_antisymm hx.right hx.left
        exact Eq.trans hxb hcbEq.symm
      rw [hxc]
      rw [F.sub_self]
      exact heps
  cases hleft with
  | intro deltaLeft hdeltaLeft =>
      cases hright with
      | intro deltaRight hdeltaRight =>
          let delta := F.min2 deltaLeft deltaRight
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro
            (F.min2_pos hdeltaLeft.left hdeltaRight.left) ?_
          intro x hx _hxcNe hdist
          have hdeltaLeftLe : F.le delta deltaLeft :=
            F.min2_le_left deltaLeft deltaRight
          have hdeltaRightLe : F.le delta deltaRight :=
            F.min2_le_right deltaLeft deltaRight
          cases F.le_total c x with
          | inl hcx =>
              have hxRight : RealTheory.ClosedInterval c b x :=
                And.intro hcx hx.right
              have hdistRight : F.lt (dist x c) deltaRight :=
                F.lt_of_lt_of_le hdist hdeltaRightLe
              have hsub : F.lt (F.sub x c) deltaRight := by
                unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hdistRight
                rw [F.abs_of_nonneg (F.sub_nonneg_of_le hcx)] at hdistRight
                exact hdistRight
              have hinc := hdeltaRight.right x hxRight hsub
              have hmono :=
                totalVariationFrom_monotoneOn_closedInterval h
                  c x hc hx hcx
              unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
              rw [F.abs_of_nonneg (F.sub_nonneg_of_le hmono)]
              exact hinc
          | inr hxc =>
              have hxLeft : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x :=
                And.intro hx.left hxc
              have hdistLeft : F.lt (dist x c) deltaLeft :=
                F.lt_of_lt_of_le hdist hdeltaLeftLe
              have hsub : F.lt (F.sub c x) deltaLeft := by
                rw [dist_comm x c] at hdistLeft
                unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hdistLeft
                rw [F.abs_of_nonneg (F.sub_nonneg_of_le hxc)] at hdistLeft
                exact hdistLeft
              have hinc := hdeltaLeft.right x hxLeft hsub
              have hmono :=
                totalVariationFrom_monotoneOn_closedInterval h
                  x c hx hc hxc
              rw [dist_comm
                (totalVariationFrom a f x)
                (totalVariationFrom a f c)]
              unfold dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
              rw [F.abs_of_nonneg (F.sub_nonneg_of_le hmono)]
              exact hinc

name: totalVariationFrom_add_function_monotoneOn_closedInterval
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_add_function_monotoneOn_closedInterval
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f) :
    MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (AddFun (totalVariationFrom a f) f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let Vx := totalVariationFrom a f x
  let Vy := totalVariationFrom a f y
  let d := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))
  have hinc :
      RealTheory.le d (RealTheory.sub Vy Vx) := by
    unfold d Vx Vy
    exact totalVariationFrom_increment_abs_le h hx hy hxy
  have hsub_le_abs :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) d := by
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    unfold d
    change
      F.le (F.sub (f x) (f y))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f y) (f x)))
    have hle :
        F.le (F.sub (f x) (f y))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) (f y))) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_abs_self F (F.sub (f x) (f y))
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm F (f x) (f y)] at hle
  have hsub_le_gap :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))
        (RealTheory.sub Vy Vx) :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hsub_le_abs hinc
  unfold AddFun
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add Vx (f x))
      (RealTheory.add Vy (f y))
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_of_sub_le_sub
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsub_le_gap

name: totalVariationFrom_sub_function_monotoneOn_closedInterval
statement:
theorem totalVariationFrom_sub_function_monotoneOn_closedInterval
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f) :
    MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (SubFun (totalVariationFrom a f) f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Vx := totalVariationFrom a f x
  let Vy := totalVariationFrom a f y
  let d := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))
  have hinc :
      RealTheory.le d (RealTheory.sub Vy Vx) := by
    unfold d Vx Vy
    exact totalVariationFrom_increment_abs_le h hx hy hxy
  have hneg_sub_eq :
      RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.neg (f x)) (RealTheory.neg (f y)) =
        RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x) := by
    change
      F.sub (F.neg (f x)) (F.neg (f y)) =
        F.sub (f y) (f x)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F (f x) (f y)]
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f x) (f y)]
  have hsub_le_abs :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.neg (f x)) (RealTheory.neg (f y)))
        d := by
    rw [hneg_sub_eq]
    unfold d
    exact RealTheory.le_abs_self (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))
  have hsub_le_gap :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.neg (f x)) (RealTheory.neg (f y)))
        (RealTheory.sub Vy Vx) :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hsub_le_abs hinc
  unfold SubFun
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub Vx (f x))
      (RealTheory.sub Vy (f y))
  rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg Vx (f x)]
  rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg Vy (f y)]
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_of_sub_le_sub
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsub_le_gap

name: boundedVariationOn_standardJordanDecompositionOn
statement:
theorem boundedVariationOn_standardJordanDecompositionOn
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f) :
    JordanDecompositionOn a b f
      (totalVariationFrom a f)
      (SubFun (totalVariationFrom a f) f)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro
    (totalVariationFrom_monotoneOn_closedInterval h) ?_
  refine And.intro
    (totalVariationFrom_sub_function_monotoneOn_closedInterval h) ?_
  intro x _hx
  unfold SubFun
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    f x =
      F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f x)
        (F.sub (totalVariationFrom a f x) (f x))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [<- F.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub (totalVariationFrom a f x) (f x)]
  rw [F.add_comm]
  rw [F.sub_add_cancel]

name: boundedVariationOn_alternateJordanDecompositionOn
statement:
theorem boundedVariationOn_alternateJordanDecompositionOn
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f) :
    JordanDecompositionOn a b f
      (AddFun (totalVariationFrom a f) f)
      (totalVariationFrom a f)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro
    (totalVariationFrom_add_function_monotoneOn_closedInterval h) ?_
  refine And.intro
    (totalVariationFrom_monotoneOn_closedInterval h) ?_
  intro x _hx
  unfold SubFun AddFun
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    f x =
      F.sub (F.add (totalVariationFrom a f x) (f x))
        (totalVariationFrom a f x)
  rw [F.add_comm (totalVariationFrom a f x) (f x)]
  exact Eq.symm
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F
      (f x) (totalVariationFrom a f x))

name: boundedVariationOn_exists_jordanDecompositionOn
statement:
theorem boundedVariationOn_exists_jordanDecompositionOn
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f) :
    Exists
      (fun g : Map =>
        Exists
          (fun k : Map =>
            JordanDecompositionOn a b f g k))
proof:
:=
  Exists.intro (totalVariationFrom a f)
    (Exists.intro (SubFun (totalVariationFrom a f) f)
      (boundedVariationOn_standardJordanDecompositionOn h))

name: jordanDecompositionOn_boundedVariationOn
statement:
theorem jordanDecompositionOn_boundedVariationOn
    {a b : Point} {f g k : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hJ : JordanDecompositionOn a b f g k) :
    BoundedVariationOn a b f
proof:
:= by
  have hg := monotoneOn_closedInterval_boundedVariationOn hab hJ.left
  have hk := monotoneOn_closedInterval_boundedVariationOn hab hJ.right.left
  have hsub := boundedVariationOn_sub hg hk
  exact boundedVariationOn_congrOn
    (fun x hx => Eq.symm (hJ.right.right x hx)) hsub

name: boundedVariationOn_iff_exists_jordanDecompositionOn
statement:
theorem boundedVariationOn_iff_exists_jordanDecompositionOn
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b) :
    BoundedVariationOn a b f <->
      Exists
        (fun g : Map =>
          Exists
            (fun k : Map =>
              JordanDecompositionOn a b f g k))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact boundedVariationOn_exists_jordanDecompositionOn
  · intro hJ
    cases hJ with
    | intro g hg =>
        cases hg with
        | intro k hk =>
            exact jordanDecompositionOn_boundedVariationOn hab hk

name: boundedVariationOn_exists_continuousJordanDecompositionOn
statement:
theorem boundedVariationOn_exists_continuousJordanDecompositionOn
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hf : ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f) :
    Exists
      (fun g : Map =>
        Exists
          (fun k : Map =>
            And (JordanDecompositionOn a b f g k)
              (And (ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g)
                (ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) k))))
proof:
:= by
  let V := totalVariationFrom a f
  refine Exists.intro V ?_
  refine Exists.intro (SubFun V f) ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact boundedVariationOn_standardJordanDecompositionOn h
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact totalVariationFrom_continuousOn_closedInterval h hf
  · exact continuousOn_sub
      (totalVariationFrom_continuousOn_closedInterval h hf) hf

name: partitionVariationTerm_nonnegative
statement:
theorem partitionVariationTerm_nonnegative
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (partitionVariationTerm f p k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  exact RealTheory.abs_nonneg
    (RealTheory.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k)))

name: finiteSum_refinementBlockFunctionIncrement
statement:
theorem finiteSum_refinementBlockFunctionIncrement
    {f : Map} {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href :
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
        q m p n cut)
    {i : Nat}
    (hi : i < n) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun h : Nat =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (f (q (cut i + h + 1)))
            (f (q (cut i + h))))
        (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i) =
      RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i))
proof:
:= by
  let start := cut i
  let count :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i
  let r := fun h : Nat => f (q (start + h))
  have hterm :
      forall h : Nat,
        RealTheory.sub
            (f (q (cut i + h + 1)))
            (f (q (cut i + h))) =
          RealTheory.sub (r (h + 1)) (r h) := by
    intro h
    unfold r start
    have hidx : cut i + h + 1 = cut i + (h + 1) := by
      omega
    rw [hidx]
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub
              (f (q (cut i + h + 1)))
              (f (q (cut i + h))))
          count =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat => RealTheory.sub (r (h + 1)) (r h))
          count :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_congr hterm count
  rw [hsum]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_telescope_sub]
  unfold count
  unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength
  have hmono : cut i <= cut (i + 1) :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono_step
      href hi
  have hidx : cut i + (cut (i + 1) - cut i) = cut (i + 1) :=
    Nat.add_sub_of_le hmono
  unfold r start
  rw [hidx]
  have hzero : cut i + 0 = cut i := by
    omega
  rw [hzero]
  rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_endpoint
    href (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)]
  rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_endpoint
    href (Nat.le_of_lt hi)]

name: partitionVariationTerm_le_refinementBlockVariation
statement:
theorem partitionVariationTerm_le_refinementBlockVariation
    {f : Map} {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href :
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
        q m p n cut)
    {i : Nat}
    (hi : i < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (partitionVariationTerm f p i)
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun h : Nat =>
          partitionVariationTerm f q (cut i + h))
        (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength
          cut i))
proof:
:= by
  let term := fun h : Nat =>
    RealTheory.sub
      (f (q (cut i + h + 1)))
      (f (q (cut i + h)))
  let count :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength cut i
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum term count =
        RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i)) := by
    dsimp [term, count]
    exact finiteSum_refinementBlockFunctionIncrement href hi
  have htri := RealTheory.abs_finiteSum_le_finiteSum_abs term count
  have hrhs :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat => RealTheory.abs (term h)) count =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f q (cut i + h))
          count := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro h
    unfold term partitionVariationTerm
    have hidx : (cut i + h) + 1 = cut i + h + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [hidx]
  rw [hsum] at htri
  rw [hrhs] at htri
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  exact htri

name: partitionVariation_le_of_partitionBlockRefines
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_le_of_partitionBlockRefines
    {f : Map} {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href :
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
        q m p n cut) :
    RealTheory.le (partitionVariation f p n) (partitionVariation f q m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  have hblocksum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum (partitionVariationTerm f q) (cut n) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun h : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f q (cut i + h))
              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength
                cut i))
          n :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.finiteSum_cut_blocks
      (partitionVariationTerm f q)
      (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_left
        href)
      (fun i hi =>
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono_step
          href hi)
  have hle :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum (partitionVariationTerm f p) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun h : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f q (cut i + h))
              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength
                cut i))
          n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (partitionVariationTerm f p)
      (fun i : Nat =>
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f q (cut i + h))
          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.refinementBlockLength
            cut i))
      n
      (fun i hi =>
        partitionVariationTerm_le_refinementBlockVariation href hi)
  rw [<- hblocksum] at hle
  rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_right
    href] at hle
  exact hle

name: partitionVariation_le_of_partitionRefines
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_le_of_partitionRefines
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat}
    (hq :
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b m q)
    (hp :
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (href :
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.PartitionRefines q m p n) :
    RealTheory.le (partitionVariation f p n) (partitionVariation f q m)
proof:
:= by
  cases
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.exists_partitionBlockRefines_of_partitionRefines
        hq hp href with
  | intro cut hcut =>
      exact partitionVariation_le_of_partitionBlockRefines hcut

name: threePointVariationExcess_nonnegative
statement:
theorem threePointVariationExcess_nonnegative
    (f : Map) (u v w : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (threePointVariationExcess f u v w)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold threePointVariationExcess
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F
  have hsum :
      F.sub (f w) (f u) =
        F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f w) (f v)) := by
    rw [F.add_comm (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f w) (f v))]
    exact Eq.symm
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
        F (f w) (f v) (f u))
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f w) (f u)))
      (F.add
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f v) (f u)))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f w) (f v))))
  rw [hsum]
  exact RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
    (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f w) (f v))

name: threePointVariationExcess_negFun_eq
statement:
theorem threePointVariationExcess_negFun_eq
    (f : Map) (u v w : Point) :
    threePointVariationExcess (NegFun f) u v w =
      threePointVariationExcess f u v w
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold threePointVariationExcess NegFun
  change
    F.sub
      (F.add
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (F.neg (f v)) (F.neg (f u))))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (F.neg (f w)) (F.neg (f v)))))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (F.neg (f w)) (F.neg (f u)))) =
    F.sub
      (F.add
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f v) (f u)))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f w) (f v))))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f w) (f u)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F (f v) (f u)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F (f w) (f v)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F (f w) (f u)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F (F.sub (f v) (f u))]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F (F.sub (f w) (f v))]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F (F.sub (f w) (f u))]

name: threePointVariationExcess_middle_high_left_le_right
statement:
private theorem threePointVariationExcess_middle_high_left_le_right
    {f : Map} {u v w B : Point}
    (hB : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero B)
    (huv : RealTheory.lt B (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)))
    (hwv : RealTheory.lt B (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f w)))
    (huw : RealTheory.le (f u) (f w)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add B B)
      (threePointVariationExcess f u v w)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have huv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub (f v) (f u)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hB huv
  have hwv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub (f v) (f w)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hB hwv
  have hfu_fv : F.le (f u) (f v) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F huv_pos)
  have hfw_fv : F.le (f w) (f v) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F hwv_pos)
  have hsum :
      F.lt
        (F.add B B)
        (F.add (F.sub (f v) (f w)) (F.sub (f v) (f w))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hwv hwv
  have hexcess :
      threePointVariationExcess f u v w =
        F.add (F.sub (f v) (f w)) (F.sub (f v) (f w)) := by
    unfold threePointVariationExcess
    change
      F.sub
        (F.add
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f v) (f u)))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f w) (f v))))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f w) (f u))) =
      F.add (F.sub (f v) (f w)) (F.sub (f v) (f w))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hfu_fv)]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hfw_fv)]
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f w) (f v)]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F huw)]
    change
      F.sub
        (F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f v) (f w)))
        (F.sub (f w) (f u)) =
      F.add (F.sub (f v) (f w)) (F.sub (f v) (f w))
    calc
      F.sub
          (F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f v) (f w)))
          (F.sub (f w) (f u)) =
          F.add
            (F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f v) (f w)))
            (F.sub (f u) (f w)) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
          rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f w) (f u)]
      _ = F.add
            (F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f u) (f w)))
            (F.sub (f v) (f w)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
          rw [F.add_comm (F.sub (f v) (f w)) (F.sub (f u) (f w))]
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add (F.sub (f v) (f w)) (F.sub (f v) (f w)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
            F (f v) (f u) (f w)]
  rw [hexcess]
  exact hsum

name: threePointVariationExcess_middle_high_right_le_left
statement:
private theorem threePointVariationExcess_middle_high_right_le_left
    {f : Map} {u v w B : Point}
    (hB : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero B)
    (huv : RealTheory.lt B (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)))
    (hwv : RealTheory.lt B (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f w)))
    (hwu : RealTheory.le (f w) (f u)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add B B)
      (threePointVariationExcess f u v w)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have huv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub (f v) (f u)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hB huv
  have hwv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub (f v) (f w)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hB hwv
  have hfu_fv : F.le (f u) (f v) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F huv_pos)
  have hfw_fv : F.le (f w) (f v) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F hwv_pos)
  have hsum :
      F.lt
        (F.add B B)
        (F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f v) (f u))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F huv huv
  have hexcess :
      threePointVariationExcess f u v w =
        F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f v) (f u)) := by
    unfold threePointVariationExcess
    change
      F.sub
        (F.add
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f v) (f u)))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f w) (f v))))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f w) (f u))) =
      F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f v) (f u))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hfu_fv)]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hfw_fv)]
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f w) (f v)]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hwu)]
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f w) (f u)]
    change
      F.sub
        (F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f v) (f w)))
        (F.sub (f u) (f w)) =
      F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f v) (f u))
    calc
      F.sub
          (F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f v) (f w)))
          (F.sub (f u) (f w)) =
          F.add
            (F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f v) (f w)))
            (F.sub (f w) (f u)) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
          rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f u) (f w)]
      _ = F.add
            (F.sub (f v) (f u))
            (F.add (F.sub (f v) (f w)) (F.sub (f w) (f u))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add (F.sub (f v) (f u)) (F.sub (f v) (f u)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
            F (f v) (f w) (f u)]
  rw [hexcess]
  exact hsum

name: threePointVariationExcess_middle_high_gt_add
statement:
theorem threePointVariationExcess_middle_high_gt_add
    {f : Map} {u v w B : Point}
    (hB : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero B)
    (huv : RealTheory.lt B (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)))
    (hwv : RealTheory.lt B (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f w))) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add B B)
      (threePointVariationExcess f u v w)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases F.le_total (f u) (f w) with
  | inl huw =>
      exact
        threePointVariationExcess_middle_high_left_le_right
          (f := f) (u := u) (v := v) (w := w) (B := B)
          hB huv hwv huw
  | inr hwu =>
      exact
        threePointVariationExcess_middle_high_right_le_left
          (f := f) (u := u) (v := v) (w := w) (B := B)
          hB huv hwv hwu

name: threePointVariationExcess_middle_low_gt_add
statement:
theorem threePointVariationExcess_middle_low_gt_add
    {f : Map} {u v w B : Point}
    (hB : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero B)
    (huv : RealTheory.lt B (RealTheory.sub (f u) (f v)))
    (hwv : RealTheory.lt B (RealTheory.sub (f w) (f v))) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add B B)
      (threePointVariationExcess f u v w)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hhigh :
      F.lt
        (F.add B B)
        (threePointVariationExcess (NegFun f) u v w) := by
    apply threePointVariationExcess_middle_high_gt_add
      (f := NegFun f) (u := u) (v := v) (w := w) (B := B) hB
    · unfold NegFun
      change F.lt B (F.sub (F.neg (f v)) (F.neg (f u)))
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F (f v) (f u)]
      rwa [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f v) (f u)]
    · unfold NegFun
      change F.lt B (F.sub (F.neg (f v)) (F.neg (f w)))
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F (f v) (f w)]
      rwa [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f v) (f w)]
  rwa [threePointVariationExcess_negFun_eq f u v w] at hhigh

name: oldCell_add_threePointExcess_le_refinedCellThreePointVariation
statement:
private theorem oldCell_add_threePointExcess_le_refinedCellThreePointVariation
    (f : Map) (left u v w right : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f right) (f left)))
        (threePointVariationExcess f u v w))
      (refinedCellThreePointVariation f left u v w right)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f u) (f left))
  let b := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u))
  let c := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f w) (f v))
  let d := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f right) (f w))
  let e := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f w) (f u))
  let old := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f right) (f left))
  have hright_left :
      F.sub (f right) (f left) =
        F.add (F.sub (f u) (f left))
          (F.sub (f right) (f u)) := by
    rw [F.add_comm (F.sub (f u) (f left))
      (F.sub (f right) (f u))]
    exact Eq.symm
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
        F (f right) (f u) (f left))
  have hright_u :
      F.sub (f right) (f u) =
        F.add (F.sub (f w) (f u))
          (F.sub (f right) (f w)) := by
    rw [F.add_comm (F.sub (f w) (f u))
      (F.sub (f right) (f w))]
    exact Eq.symm
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
        F (f right) (f w) (f u))
  have hold1 :
      F.le old
        (F.add a
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f right) (f u)))) := by
    unfold old a
    change
      F.le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f right) (f left)))
        (F.add
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f u) (f left)))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f right) (f u))))
    rw [hright_left]
    exact RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
      (F.sub (f u) (f left)) (F.sub (f right) (f u))
  have hold2 :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f right) (f u)))
        (F.add e d) := by
    unfold e d
    change
      F.le
