        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f right) (f u)))
        (F.add
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f w) (f u)))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f right) (f w))))
    rw [hright_u]
    exact RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
      (F.sub (f w) (f u)) (F.sub (f right) (f w))
  have hold :
      F.le old (F.add a (F.add e d)) := by
    exact F.le_trans hold1
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hold2 a)
  have hmain :=
    F.add_le_add_right hold (F.sub (F.add b c) e)
  have halg :
      F.add (F.add a (F.add e d)) (F.sub (F.add b c) e) =
        F.add a (F.add b (F.add c d)) := by
    calc
      F.add (F.add a (F.add e d)) (F.sub (F.add b c) e) =
          F.add a
            (F.add (F.add e d) (F.sub (F.add b c) e)) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add a
            (F.add e
              (F.add d (F.sub (F.add b c) e))) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc e d (F.sub (F.add b c) e)]
      _ = F.add a
            (F.add e
              (F.add (F.sub (F.add b c) e) d)) := by
            rw [F.add_comm d (F.sub (F.add b c) e)]
      _ = F.add a
            (F.add (F.add e (F.sub (F.add b c) e)) d) := by
            rw [<- F.add_assoc e (F.sub (F.add b c) e) d]
      _ = F.add a
            (F.add (F.add (F.sub (F.add b c) e) e) d) := by
            rw [F.add_comm e (F.sub (F.add b c) e)]
      _ = F.add a (F.add (F.add b c) d) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F (F.add b c) e]
      _ = F.add a (F.add b (F.add c d)) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc b c d]
  unfold threePointVariationExcess refinedCellThreePointVariation
  change
    F.le
      (F.add old (F.sub (F.add b c) e))
      (F.add a (F.add b (F.add c d)))
  rwa [halg] at hmain

name: partitionVariation_zero
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_zero
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) :
    partitionVariation f p 0 = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_zero (partitionVariationTerm f p)

name: partitionVariation_succ
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_succ
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    partitionVariation f p (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariation f p n)
        (partitionVariationTerm f p n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_succ (partitionVariationTerm f p) n

name: partitionVariation_nonnegative
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_nonnegative
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (partitionVariation f p n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_nonneg
    (partitionVariationTerm f p) n
    (fun k _hk => partitionVariationTerm_nonnegative f p k)

name: partitionVariation_one
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_one
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) :
    partitionVariation f p 1 =
      partitionVariationTerm f p 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_one (partitionVariationTerm f p)

name: partitionVariation_twoPoint
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_twoPoint
    (f : Map) (a b : Point) :
    partitionVariation f (twoPointPartition a b) 1 =
      RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [partitionVariation_one]
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  rw [twoPointPartition_zero, twoPointPartition_succ]

name: partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_prefix
statement:
private theorem partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_prefix
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k j : Nat) (u v w : Point)
    (hj : j < k) :
    partitionVariationTerm f (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w) j =
      partitionVariationTerm f p j
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  have hj_le : j <= k := Nat.le_of_lt hj
  have hjs_le : j + 1 <= k := by omega
  rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_le p k u v w hj_le]
  rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_le p k u v w hjs_le]

name: partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_first
statement:
private theorem partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_first
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (u v w : Point) :
    partitionVariationTerm f (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w) k =
      RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f u) (f (p k)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_le p k u v w (Nat.le_refl k)]
  rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_first p k u v w]

name: partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_second
statement:
private theorem partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_second
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (u v w : Point) :
    partitionVariationTerm f (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w) (k + 1) =
      RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u))
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_first p k u v w]
  rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_second p k u v w]

name: partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_third
statement:
private theorem partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_third
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (u v w : Point) :
    partitionVariationTerm f (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w) (k + 2) =
      RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f w) (f v))
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_second p k u v w]
  rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_third p k u v w]

name: partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_fourth
statement:
private theorem partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_fourth
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (u v w : Point) :
    partitionVariationTerm f (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w) (k + 3) =
      RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f w))
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_third p k u v w]
  have hgt : k + 3 < k + 4 := by omega
  rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_gt_third p k u v w hgt]
  have hidx : (k + 4) - 3 = k + 1 := by omega
  rw [hidx]

name: partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_suffix
statement:
private theorem partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_suffix
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (u v w : Point) (j : Nat) :
    partitionVariationTerm f (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w)
        (k + 4 + j) =
      partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  have hleft_gt : k + 3 < k + 4 + j := by omega
  have hright_gt : k + 3 < k + 4 + j + 1 := by omega
  rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_gt_third p k u v w hleft_gt]
  rw [refineCellWithThreePoints_of_gt_third p k u v w hright_gt]
  have hleft : (k + 4 + j) - 3 = k + 1 + j := by omega
  have hright : (k + 4 + j + 1) - 3 = k + 1 + j + 1 := by omega
  rw [hleft, hright]

name: partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_prefix
statement:
private theorem partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_prefix
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (u v w : Point) :
    partitionVariation f (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w) k =
      partitionVariation f p k
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt k
    (fun j hj =>
      partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_prefix
        f p k j u v w hj)

name: partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_block
statement:
private theorem partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_block
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (u v w : Point) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          partitionVariationTerm f
            (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w) (k + j))
        4 =
      refinedCellThreePointVariation f (p k) u v w (p (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w
  let term := fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f q (k + j)
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ term 3]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ term 2]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ term 1]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ term 0]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  unfold term q
  rw [Nat.add_zero]
  rw [partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_first]
  rw [partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_second]
  rw [partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_third]
  rw [partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_fourth]
  unfold refinedCellThreePointVariation
  change
    F.add
        (F.add
          (F.add
            (F.add F.zero
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f u) (f (p k)))))
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u))))
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f w) (f v))))
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f w))) =
      F.add
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f u) (f (p k))))
        (F.add
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)))
          (F.add
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f w) (f v)))
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f w)))))
  rw [F.zero_add]
  rw [F.add_assoc]
  rw [F.add_assoc]

name: partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_suffix
statement:
private theorem partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_suffix
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (u v w : Point) (m : Nat) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          partitionVariationTerm f
            (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w) (k + 4 + j))
        m =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
        m
proof:
:= by
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    (fun j : Nat =>
      partitionVariationTerm_refineCellWithThreePoints_suffix
        f p k u v w j)
    m

name: partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_prefix_block
statement:
private theorem partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_prefix_block
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (u v w : Point) :
    partitionVariation f (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w) (k + 4) =
      RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariation f p k)
        (refinedCellThreePointVariation f (p k) u v w (p (k + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let q := refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w
  calc
    partitionVariation f q (k + 4) =
        RealTheory.add
          (partitionVariation f q k)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f q (k + j)) 4) := by
          unfold partitionVariation
          rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length
            (partitionVariationTerm f q) k 4]
    _ = RealTheory.add
          (partitionVariation f p k)
          (refinedCellThreePointVariation f (p k) u v w (p (k + 1))) := by
          rw [partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_prefix]
          rw [partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_block]

name: partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_split
statement:
private theorem partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_split
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) {n k : Nat} (u v w : Point)
    (hk : k < n) :
    partitionVariation f (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w) (n + 3) =
      RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariation f p k)
        (RealTheory.add
          (refinedCellThreePointVariation f (p k) u v w (p (k + 1)))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
            (n - (k + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w
  let m := n - (k + 1)
  have hn_split : n + 3 = (k + 4) + m := by
    unfold m
    omega
  calc
    partitionVariation f q (n + 3) =
        partitionVariation f q ((k + 4) + m) := by
          exact congrArg (fun t : Nat => partitionVariation f q t) hn_split
    _ = RealTheory.add
          (partitionVariation f q (k + 4))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat =>
              partitionVariationTerm f q ((k + 4) + j)) m) := by
          unfold partitionVariation
          rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length
            (partitionVariationTerm f q) (k + 4) m]
    _ = RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (partitionVariation f p k)
            (refinedCellThreePointVariation f (p k) u v w (p (k + 1))))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat =>
              partitionVariationTerm f q ((k + 4) + j)) m) := by
          rw [partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_prefix_block]
    _ = RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (partitionVariation f p k)
            (refinedCellThreePointVariation f (p k) u v w (p (k + 1))))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
            m) := by
          rw [partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_suffix]
    _ = RealTheory.add
          (partitionVariation f p k)
          (RealTheory.add
            (refinedCellThreePointVariation f (p k) u v w (p (k + 1)))
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
              m)) := by
          change
            F.add
              (F.add
                (partitionVariation f p k)
                (refinedCellThreePointVariation f (p k) u v w (p (k + 1))))
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
                m) =
            F.add
              (partitionVariation f p k)
              (F.add
                (refinedCellThreePointVariation f (p k) u v w (p (k + 1)))
                (RealTheory.finiteSum
                  (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
                  m))
          rw [F.add_assoc]

name: partitionVariation_split_at_cell
statement:
private theorem partitionVariation_split_at_cell
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < n) :
    partitionVariation f p n =
      RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariation f p k)
        (RealTheory.add
          (partitionVariationTerm f p k)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
            (n - (k + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hn_split : n = (k + 1) + (n - (k + 1)) := by omega
  calc
    partitionVariation f p n =
        partitionVariation f p ((k + 1) + (n - (k + 1))) := by
          exact congrArg (fun m : Nat => partitionVariation f p m) hn_split
    _ = RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariation f p (k + 1))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            partitionVariationTerm f p ((k + 1) + j))
          (n - (k + 1))) := by
          unfold partitionVariation
          rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length
            (partitionVariationTerm f p) (k + 1) (n - (k + 1))]
    _ = RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add
          (partitionVariation f p k)
          (partitionVariationTerm f p k))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            partitionVariationTerm f p ((k + 1) + j))
          (n - (k + 1))) := by
          rw [partitionVariation_succ]
    _ = RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariation f p k)
        (RealTheory.add
          (partitionVariationTerm f p k)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat =>
              partitionVariationTerm f p ((k + 1) + j))
            (n - (k + 1)))) := by
          change
            F.add
                (F.add
                  (partitionVariation f p k)
                  (partitionVariationTerm f p k))
                (RealTheory.finiteSum
                  (fun j : Nat =>
                    partitionVariationTerm f p ((k + 1) + j))
                  (n - (k + 1))) =
              F.add
                (partitionVariation f p k)
                (F.add
                  (partitionVariationTerm f p k)
                  (RealTheory.finiteSum
                    (fun j : Nat =>
                      partitionVariationTerm f p ((k + 1) + j))
                    (n - (k + 1))))
          rw [F.add_assoc]

name: partitionVariation_add_threePointExcess_le_refineCellWithThreePoints
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_add_threePointExcess_le_refineCellWithThreePoints
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) {n k : Nat} (u v w : Point)
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariation f p n)
        (threePointVariationExcess f u v w))
      (partitionVariation f (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w)
        (n + 3))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let preVar := partitionVariation f p k
  let oldCell := partitionVariationTerm f p k
  let excess := threePointVariationExcess f u v w
  let refined :=
    refinedCellThreePointVariation f (p k) u v w (p (k + 1))
  let suffix :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
      (n - (k + 1))
  have hlocal :
      F.le (F.add oldCell excess) refined := by
    unfold oldCell excess refined
    unfold partitionVariationTerm
    exact
      oldCell_add_threePointExcess_le_refinedCellThreePointVariation
        f (p k) u v w (p (k + 1))
  have hwithSuffix :
      F.le
        (F.add (F.add oldCell excess) suffix)
        (F.add refined suffix) :=
    F.add_le_add_right hlocal suffix
  have hwithPrefix :
      F.le
        (F.add preVar (F.add (F.add oldCell excess) suffix))
        (F.add preVar (F.add refined suffix)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hwithSuffix preVar
  have holdSplit :=
    partitionVariation_split_at_cell
      (f := f) (p := p) (n := n) (k := k) hk
  have hrefinedSplit :=
    partitionVariation_refineCellWithThreePoints_split
      (f := f) (p := p) (n := n) (k := k) u v w hk
  have hleft :
      F.add (partitionVariation f p n) excess =
        F.add preVar (F.add (F.add oldCell excess) suffix) := by
    unfold preVar oldCell suffix at *
    rw [holdSplit]
    change
      F.add
          (F.add
            (partitionVariation f p k)
            (F.add
              (partitionVariationTerm f p k)
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
                (n - (k + 1)))))
          excess =
        F.add
          (partitionVariation f p k)
          (F.add
            (F.add (partitionVariationTerm f p k) excess)
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
              (n - (k + 1))))
    let pre := partitionVariation f p k
    let old := partitionVariationTerm f p k
    let suf :=
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat => partitionVariationTerm f p (k + 1 + j))
        (n - (k + 1))
    change
      F.add (F.add pre (F.add old suf)) excess =
        F.add pre (F.add (F.add old excess) suf)
    calc
      F.add (F.add pre (F.add old suf)) excess =
          F.add pre (F.add (F.add old suf) excess) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc pre (F.add old suf) excess]
      _ = F.add pre (F.add old (F.add suf excess)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc old suf excess]
      _ = F.add pre (F.add old (F.add excess suf)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm suf excess]
      _ = F.add pre (F.add (F.add old excess) suf) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc old excess suf]
  change
    F.le
      (F.add (partitionVariation f p n) excess)
      (partitionVariation f (refineCellWithThreePoints p k u v w)
        (n + 3))
  rw [hleft]
  rw [hrefinedSplit]
  exact hwithPrefix

name: partitionVariationTerm_congr
statement:
theorem partitionVariationTerm_congr
    {f g : Map} (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat)
    (hfg : forall x : Point, f x = g x) :
    partitionVariationTerm f p k =
      partitionVariationTerm g p k
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  rw [hfg (p (k + 1)), hfg (p k)]

name: partitionVariation_congr
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_congr
    {f g : Map} (p : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat)
    (hfg : forall x : Point, f x = g x) :
    partitionVariation f p n =
      partitionVariation g p n
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    (fun k : Nat => partitionVariationTerm_congr p k hfg) n

name: partitionVariationTerm_neg
statement:
theorem partitionVariationTerm_neg
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) :
    partitionVariationTerm (NegFun f) p k =
      partitionVariationTerm f p k
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold partitionVariationTerm NegFun
  change
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.sub (F.neg (f (p (k + 1)))) (F.neg (f (p k)))) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub
    F (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k))]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F
    (F.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k)))

name: partitionVariation_neg
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_neg
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    partitionVariation (NegFun f) p n =
      partitionVariation f p n
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    (fun k : Nat => partitionVariationTerm_neg f p k) n

name: partitionVariationTerm_add_le
statement:
theorem partitionVariationTerm_add_le
    (f g : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (partitionVariationTerm (AddFun f g) p k)
      (RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariationTerm f p k)
        (partitionVariationTerm g p k))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold partitionVariationTerm AddFun
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.sub
          (F.add (f (p (k + 1))) (g (p (k + 1))))
          (F.add (f (p k)) (g (p k)))))
      (F.add
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
          (F.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k))))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
          (F.sub (g (p (k + 1))) (g (p k)))))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
    F (f (p (k + 1))) (g (p (k + 1))) (f (p k)) (g (p k))]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs F
    (F.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k)))
    (F.sub (g (p (k + 1))) (g (p k)))

name: partitionVariation_add_le
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_add_le
    (f g : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (partitionVariation (AddFun f g) p n)
      (RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariation f p n)
        (partitionVariation g p n))
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  let lhs := partitionVariationTerm (AddFun f g) p
  let rhs := fun k : Nat =>
    RealTheory.add
      (partitionVariationTerm f p k)
      (partitionVariationTerm g p k)
  have hle :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum lhs n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum rhs n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le lhs rhs n
      (fun k _hk => partitionVariationTerm_add_le f g p k)
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum rhs n =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum (partitionVariationTerm f p) n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum (partitionVariationTerm g p) n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_add
      (partitionVariationTerm f p)
      (partitionVariationTerm g p) n
  rwa [hsum] at hle

name: partitionVariationTerm_scale
statement:
theorem partitionVariationTerm_scale
    (c : Point) (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) :
    partitionVariationTerm (RealFunction.ScaleFun c f) p k =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c)
        (partitionVariationTerm f p k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold partitionVariationTerm RealFunction.ScaleFun
  change
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.sub (F.mul c (f (p (k + 1)))) (F.mul c (f (p k)))) =
      F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F c)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
          (F.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k))))
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
    F c (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k))]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F c
    (F.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k)))

name: partitionVariation_scale
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_scale
    (c : Point) (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    partitionVariation (RealFunction.ScaleFun c f) p n =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c)
        (partitionVariation f p n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  have hterm :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (partitionVariationTerm (RealFunction.ScaleFun c f) p) n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c)
              (partitionVariationTerm f p k)) n :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
      (fun k : Nat => partitionVariationTerm_scale c f p k) n
  rw [hterm]
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left
    (RealTheory.abs c) (partitionVariationTerm f p) n

name: partitionVariation_sub_eq_add_neg
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_sub_eq_add_neg
    (f g : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    partitionVariation (SubFun f g) p n =
      partitionVariation (AddFun f (NegFun g)) p n
proof:
:= by
  exact partitionVariation_congr p n
    (fun x : Point => by
      unfold SubFun AddFun NegFun
      exact RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg (f x) (g x))

name: partitionVariation_appendRightEndpoint_prefix
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_appendRightEndpoint_prefix
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (right : Point) :
    partitionVariation f (appendRightEndpoint p n right) n =
      partitionVariation f p n
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt n
    (fun k hk => by
      unfold partitionVariationTerm
      have hk_app : k < n + 1 :=
        Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
      have hk_succ_app : k + 1 < n + 1 :=
        Nat.succ_lt_succ hk
      rw [appendRightEndpoint_of_lt p n right hk_app]
      rw [appendRightEndpoint_of_lt p n right hk_succ_app])

name: partitionVariation_le_appendRightEndpoint
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_le_appendRightEndpoint
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (right : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (partitionVariation f p n)
      (partitionVariation f (appendRightEndpoint p n right) (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := appendRightEndpoint p n right
  have hnonneg :
      F.le F.zero (partitionVariationTerm f q n) :=
    partitionVariationTerm_nonnegative f q n
  have hle :
      F.le
        (partitionVariation f p n)
        (F.add (partitionVariation f p n)
          (partitionVariationTerm f q n)) := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
        F hnonneg (partitionVariation f p n)
    change
      F.le
        (F.add (partitionVariation f p n) F.zero)
        (F.add (partitionVariation f p n)
          (partitionVariationTerm f q n)) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  change
    F.le
      (partitionVariation f p n)
      (partitionVariation f q (n + 1))
  rw [partitionVariation_succ]
  rw [partitionVariation_appendRightEndpoint_prefix]
  exact hle

name: partitionVariation_appendRightEndpoint_eq_add_last
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_appendRightEndpoint_eq_add_last
    (f : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (right : Point) :
    partitionVariation f (appendRightEndpoint p n right) (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariation f p n)
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub (f right) (f (p n))))
proof:
:= by
  let q := appendRightEndpoint p n right
  change
    partitionVariation f q (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.add
        (partitionVariation f p n)
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub (f right) (f (p n))))
  rw [partitionVariation_succ]
  rw [partitionVariation_appendRightEndpoint_prefix]
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  unfold q
  rw [appendRightEndpoint_of_lt p n right (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]
  rw [appendRightEndpoint_last p n right]

name: variationBoundOn_subinterval_partitionVariation_le
statement:
theorem variationBoundOn_subinterval_partitionVariation_le
    {a b x : Point} {f : Map} {V : Point}
    (h : VariationBoundOn a b f V)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a x n p) :
    RealTheory.le (partitionVariation f p n) V
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hbx : RealTheory.le b x
  · have hxb_eq : x = b := RealTheory.le_antisymm hx.right hbx
    have hpab : IntervalPartition a b n p := by
      rwa [hxb_eq] at hp
    exact variationBoundOn_partitionVariation_le h hpab
  · have hx_lt_b : RealTheory.lt x b :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx.right hbx
    have happ :
        IntervalPartition a b (n + 1)
          (appendRightEndpoint p n b) :=
      strictIntervalPartition_appendRightEndpoint hp hx_lt_b
    have hprefix :=
      partitionVariation_le_appendRightEndpoint f p n b
    have happ_bound :=
      variationBoundOn_partitionVariation_le h happ
    exact RealTheory.le_trans hprefix happ_bound

statement:

    {a b : Point} {f g : Map}
    (hfg : SameOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f g)
    (h : BoundedVariationOn a b f) :
    BoundedVariationOn a b g
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | intro V hV =>
      refine Exists.intro V ?_
      refine And.intro hV.left ?_
      refine And.intro hV.right.left ?_
      intro n p hp
      have hpart := variationBoundOn_partitionVariation_le hV hp
      have heq :
          partitionVariation f p n = partitionVariation g p n := by
        unfold partitionVariation
        exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt n
          (fun k hk => by
            unfold partitionVariationTerm
            rw [hfg (p (k + 1))
              (strictIntervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right hp hk)]
            rw [hfg (p k)
              (strictIntervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left hp hk)])
      rwa [<- heq]

name: boundedVariationOn_sub_const
statement:
theorem boundedVariationOn_sub_const
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} (c : Point)
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn a b f) :
    BoundedVariationOn a b
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (f x) c)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsubShift : forall x y : Point,
      RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub x c) (RealTheory.sub y c) =
        RealTheory.sub x y := by
    intro x y
    change F.sub (F.sub x c) (F.sub y c) = F.sub x y
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_right_cancel F
      (a := F.sub y c)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F]
    exact Eq.symm
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel F x y c)
  cases hBV with
  | intro V hV =>
      refine Exists.intro V ?_
      refine And.intro hV.left ?_
      refine And.intro hV.right.left ?_
      intro n p hp
      have hpart := hV.right.right n p hp
      have hvariation :
          partitionVariation
              (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (f x) c) p n =
            partitionVariation f p n := by
        unfold partitionVariation
        apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
        intro k
        unfold partitionVariationTerm
        rw [hsubShift]
      rw [hvariation]
      exact hpart

name: variationBoundOn_add
statement:
theorem variationBoundOn_add
    {a b : Point} {f g : Map} {V W : Point}
    (hf : VariationBoundOn a b f V)
    (hg : VariationBoundOn a b g W) :
    VariationBoundOn a b (AddFun f g)
      (RealTheory.add V W)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  have hnonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.add V W) := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hf.right.left hg.right.left
    change F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero) (F.add V W) at h
    change F.le F.zero (F.add V W)
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  refine And.intro hnonneg ?_
  intro n p hp
  have hvar := partitionVariation_add_le f g p n
  have hfpart := variationBoundOn_partitionVariation_le hf hp
  have hgpart := variationBoundOn_partitionVariation_le hg hp
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add
          (partitionVariation f p n)
          (partitionVariation g p n))
        (RealTheory.add V W) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hfpart hgpart
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hvar hsum

name: boundedVariationOn_add
statement:

            (variationBoundOn_add hV hW)

name: variationBoundOn_sub
statement:
theorem variationBoundOn_sub
    {a b : Point} {f g : Map} {V W : Point}
    (hf : VariationBoundOn a b f V)
    (hg : VariationBoundOn a b g W) :
    VariationBoundOn a b (SubFun f g)
      (RealTheory.add V W)
proof:
:= by
  have hadd :
      VariationBoundOn a b (AddFun f (NegFun g))
        (RealTheory.add V W) :=
    variationBoundOn_add hf (variationBoundOn_neg hg)
  exact variationBoundOn_congr
    (fun x : Point => by
      unfold AddFun NegFun SubFun
      exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg (f x) (g x)))
    hadd

    (RealTheory.mul_nonneg
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg c) h.right.left) ?_

  have hscaled :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c)
          (partitionVariation f p n))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) V) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hpart
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg c)

name: partitionVariationTerm_eq_increment_of_monotone
statement:
theorem partitionVariationTerm_eq_increment_of_monotone
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hmono : MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f) :
    partitionVariationTerm f p k =
      RealTheory.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k))
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
    strictIntervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left hp hk
  have hright :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
    strictIntervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right hp hk
  have hstep : RealTheory.le (p k) (p (k + 1)) :=
    strictIntervalPartition_step_le hp hk
  have hmono_step :
      RealTheory.le (f (p k)) (f (p (k + 1))) :=
    hmono (p k) (p (k + 1)) hleft hright hstep
  have hnonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hmono_step
  exact RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hnonneg

name: partitionVariation_eq_endpoint_sub_of_monotone
statement:
theorem partitionVariation_eq_endpoint_sub_of_monotone
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hmono : MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f) :
    partitionVariation f p n =
      RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitionVariation
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum (partitionVariationTerm f p) n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k))) n := by
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt n
      (fun k hk =>
        partitionVariationTerm_eq_increment_of_monotone
          hp hk hmono)
  rw [hsum]
  have htelescope :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k))) n =
        RealTheory.sub (f (p n)) (f (p 0)) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_telescope_sub (fun k : Nat => f (p k)) n
  rw [htelescope]
  rw [strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint hp]
  rw [strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint hp]

name: monotoneOn_closedInterval_variationBoundOn
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_closedInterval_variationBoundOn
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)

proof:

  · have hfab : RealTheory.le (f a) (f b) :=
      hmono a b
        (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab)
        (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab)
        hab
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hfab
  · intro n p hp
    rw [partitionVariation_eq_endpoint_sub_of_monotone hp hmono]
    exact RealTheory.le_refl (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))
