name: tendstoWithin_localBounded
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_localBounded {E : Domain} {f : Map}
    {x0 A : Point}
    (hf : TendstoWithin E f x0 A) :
    ∃ delta, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta ∧
      ∃ B, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero B ∧
        ∀ x, E x -> Not (x = x0) ->
          RealTheory.lt (dist x x0) delta ->
            RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs (f x)) B
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let B := RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs A) RealTheory.one
  cases hf RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero_lt_one with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      refine Exists.intro B ?_
      have hBpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero B := by
        unfold B
        change F.lt F.zero
          (F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F A) F.one)
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_one_pos F A
      refine And.intro hBpos ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      have hclose := hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd
      change
        F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) A)) F.one
          at hclose
      have htri :
          F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (f x))
            (F.add
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) A))
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F A)) := by
        have h :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
            F (F.sub (f x) A) A
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F (f x) A] at h
      have hsum :
          F.lt
            (F.add
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) A))
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F A)) B := by
        have h :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right
            F hclose (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F A)
        unfold B
        change
          F.lt
            (F.add
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) A))
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F A))
            (F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F A) F.one)
        rwa [F.add_comm F.one (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F A)] at h
      change F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (f x)) B
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: tendstoWithin_mul
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : F.lt F.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases tendstoWithin_localBounded hg with
  | intro deltaBound hdeltaBound =>
      cases hdeltaBound.right with
      | intro Bound hBound =>
          have hBoundPos : F.lt F.zero Bound := hBound.left
          have hBoundNe : Not (Bound = F.zero) := by
            intro hzero
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hBoundPos hzero.symm
          let AScale := F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F A) F.one
          have hAScalePos : F.lt F.zero AScale :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_one_pos F A
          have hAScaleNe : Not (AScale = F.zero) := by
            intro hzero
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hAScalePos hzero.symm
          let deltaF := F.mul e2 (F.inv Bound)
          let deltaG := F.mul (F.inv AScale) e2
          have hdeltaFpos : F.lt F.zero deltaF := by
            unfold deltaF
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F he2
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hBoundPos)
          have hdeltaGpos : F.lt F.zero deltaG := by
            unfold deltaG
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hAScalePos) he2
          have hscaleF : F.mul deltaF Bound = e2 := by
            unfold deltaF
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
              F e2 hBoundNe
          have hscaleG : F.mul AScale deltaG = e2 := by
            unfold deltaG
            calc
              F.mul AScale (F.mul (F.inv AScale) e2) =
                  F.mul (F.mul AScale (F.inv AScale)) e2 := by
                    rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
              _ = F.mul F.one e2 := by rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hAScaleNe]
              _ = e2 := by rw [F.one_mul]
          cases hf deltaF hdeltaFpos with
          | intro deltaFx hdeltaFx =>
              cases hg deltaG hdeltaGpos with
              | intro deltaGx hdeltaGx =>
                  let inner :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaFx deltaGx
                  let delta :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaBound inner
                  have hinnerPos : F.lt F.zero inner :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
                      F hdeltaFx.left hdeltaGx.left
                  have hdeltaPos : F.lt F.zero delta :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
                      F hdeltaBound.left hinnerPos
                  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                  refine And.intro hdeltaPos ?_
                  intro x hx hxne hxd
                  have hxdBound : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaBound :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                        F deltaBound inner)
                  have hxdInner : F.lt (dist x x0) inner :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                        F deltaBound inner)
                  have hxdF : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaFx :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxdInner
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                        F deltaFx deltaGx)
                  have hxdG : F.lt (dist x x0) deltaGx :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxdInner
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                        F deltaFx deltaGx)
                  have hfclose := hdeltaFx.right x hx hxne hxdF
                  have hgclose := hdeltaGx.right x hx hxne hxdG
                  change
                    F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) A))
                      deltaF at hfclose
                  change
                    F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (g x) B))
                      deltaG at hgclose
                  have hgBound := hBound.right x hx hxne hxdBound
                  change
                    F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (g x)) Bound
                      at hgBound
                  let t1 := F.mul (F.sub (f x) A) (g x)
                  let t2 := F.mul A (F.sub (g x) B)
                  have htri :
                      F.le
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F
                          (F.mul (f x) (g x)) (F.mul A B))
                        (F.add
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t1)
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t2)) := by
                    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
                    have h :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
                        F t1 t2
                    unfold t1 at h
                    unfold t2 at h
                    rwa [<-
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub
                        F (f x) (g x) A B] at h
                  have hterm1 :
                      F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t1) e2 := by
                    unfold t1
                    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul
                      F (F.sub (f x) A) (g x)]
                    have hle :
                        F.le
                          (F.mul
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) A))
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (g x)))
                          (F.mul
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) A))
                            Bound) :=
                      F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hgBound)
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F (F.sub (f x) A))
                    have hlt :
                        F.lt
                          (F.mul
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) A))
                            Bound)
                          (F.mul deltaF Bound) :=
                      F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hfclose hBoundPos
                    have h' :
                        F.lt
                          (F.mul
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) A))
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (g x))) e2 := by
                      have h'' :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle hlt
                      rwa [hscaleF] at h''
                    exact h'
                  have hterm2 :
                      F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t2) e2 := by
                    unfold t2
                    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul
                      F A (F.sub (g x) B)]
                    have hAbsA_lt_AScale :
                        F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F A) AScale := by
                      unfold AScale
                      have h :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
                          F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F A)
                      rwa [F.add_zero] at h
                    have hle :
                        F.le
                          (F.mul
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F A)
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (g x) B)))
                          (F.mul AScale
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (g x) B))) :=
                      F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                          F hAbsA_lt_AScale)
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F (F.sub (g x) B))
                    have hlt :
                        F.lt
                          (F.mul AScale
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (g x) B)))
                          (F.mul AScale deltaG) :=
                      F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hgclose hAScalePos
                    have h' :
                        F.lt
                          (F.mul
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F A)
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (g x) B)))
                          e2 := by
                      have h'' :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle hlt
                      rwa [hscaleG] at h''
                    exact h'
                  have hsum :
                      F.lt
                        (F.add
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t1)
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t2)) eps := by
                    have h :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hterm1 hterm2
                    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at h
                  unfold MulFun
                  change
                    F.lt
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F
                        (F.mul (f x) (g x)) (F.mul A B)) eps
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: continuousAtOn_mul
statement:
theorem continuousAtOn_mul {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hf : ContinuousAtOn E f x0)
    (hg : ContinuousAtOn E g x0) :
    ContinuousAtOn E (MulFun f g) x0
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  exact tendstoWithin_mul hf.right hg.right

name: continuousOn_mul
statement:
theorem continuousOn_mul {E : Domain} {f g : Map}
    (hf : ContinuousOn E f)
    (hg : ContinuousOn E g) :
    ContinuousOn E (MulFun f g)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact continuousAtOn_mul (hf x hx) (hg x hx)

name: zero_value
statement:
theorem zero_value (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) :
    S.exp RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F RealTheory.one
  have hpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  have hlt1 : RealTheory.lt h RealTheory.one := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  have hlower := S.local_lower h hpos hlt1
  have hone_add_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hpos)
  have hexph_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (S.exp h) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hone_add_pos hlower
  have hexph_ne : Not (S.exp h = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hexph_pos hzero.symm
  have hadd := S.add_law RealTheory.zero h
  change
    S.exp (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero h) =
      RealTheory.mul (S.exp RealTheory.zero) (S.exp h) at hadd
  rw [RealTheory.zero_add] at hadd
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.mul (S.exp h) (S.exp RealTheory.zero) =
        S.exp h := by
    rw [RealTheory.mul_comm (S.exp h) (S.exp RealTheory.zero)]
    exact hadd.symm
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_one_of_mul_eq_self_left
    F hexph_ne hmul

name: mul_neg_eq_one
statement:
theorem mul_neg_eq_one (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (S.exp x) (S.exp (RealTheory.neg x)) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have h := S.add_law x (RealTheory.neg x)
  change
    S.exp (RealTheory.add x (RealTheory.neg x)) =
      RealTheory.mul (S.exp x) (S.exp (RealTheory.neg x)) at h
  rw [RealTheory.add_neg x, S.zero_value] at h
  exact h.symm

name: ne_zero
statement:
theorem ne_zero (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) (x : Point) :
    Not (S.exp x = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro hx0
  have hprod := S.mul_neg_eq_one x
  rw [hx0, RealTheory.zero_mul] at hprod
  exact RealTheory.zero_ne_one hprod

name: neg_eq_inv
statement:
theorem neg_eq_inv (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) (x : Point) :
    S.exp (RealTheory.neg x) = RealTheory.inv (S.exp x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    S.exp (F.neg x) = F.inv (S.exp x)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
    F (S.ne_zero x) (S.mul_neg_eq_one x)

name: pos_of_pos
statement:
theorem pos_of_pos
    (S : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    PositiveDomain (S.exp x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hglobal :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x) (S.exp x) :=
    naturalExp_global_lower_of_local
      S.zero_value S.add_law S.local_lower hx
  have hone_add_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x) := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hx)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hone_add_pos hglobal

name: pos
statement:
theorem pos (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) (x : Point) :
    PositiveDomain (S.exp x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxzero : x = RealTheory.zero
  · rw [hxzero, S.zero_value]
    exact RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  · cases F.le_total RealTheory.zero x with
    | inl h0x =>
        have hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0x
          intro hxle0
          have hEq : RealTheory.zero = x := F.le_antisymm h0x hxle0
          exact hxzero hEq.symm
        exact S.pos_of_pos hxpos
    | inr hxle0 =>
        have hxneg : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.zero := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxle0
          intro h0x
          have hEq : RealTheory.zero = x := F.le_antisymm h0x hxle0
          exact hxzero hEq.symm
        let z := RealTheory.neg x
        have hzpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero z := by
          unfold z
          have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hxneg
          change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg x) at h
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
        have hexpz_pos : PositiveDomain (S.exp z) :=
          S.pos_of_pos hzpos
        have hneg : S.exp (RealTheory.neg z) =
            RealTheory.inv (S.exp z) :=
          S.neg_eq_inv z
        have hx_eq_neg_z : x = RealTheory.neg z := by
          unfold z
          exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.neg_neg x)
        rw [hx_eq_neg_z, hneg]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hexpz_pos

name: maps_positive
statement:
theorem maps_positive (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) :
    MapsInto UniversalDomain PositiveDomain S.exp
proof:
:= by
  intro x _hx
  exact S.pos x

name: lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem lt_of_lt
    (S : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    {x y : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y) :
    RealTheory.lt (S.exp x) (S.exp y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := RealTheory.sub y x
  have hdpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero d := by
    unfold d
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  have hone_lt_one_add_d :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one d) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hdpos RealTheory.one
    change
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one d) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
  have hone_lt_expd :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one (S.exp d) := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
      hone_lt_one_add_d
      (naturalExp_global_lower_of_local
        S.zero_value S.add_law S.local_lower hdpos)
  have hexpx_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (S.exp x) :=
    S.pos x
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (S.exp x) RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.mul (S.exp x) (S.exp d)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hone_lt_expd hexpx_pos
  have hx_add_d : RealTheory.add x d = y := by
    unfold d
    change F.add x (F.sub y x) = y
    rw [F.add_comm x (F.sub y x)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y x
  have hadd := S.add_law x d
  change
    S.exp (RealTheory.add x d) =
      RealTheory.mul (S.exp x) (S.exp d) at hadd
  rw [hx_add_d] at hadd
  rwa [RealTheory.mul_one, <- hadd] at hmul

name: injective
statement:
theorem injective (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) :
    forall x y : Point, S.exp x = S.exp y -> x = y
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases heq : x = y
  · exact heq
  · cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F heq with
    | inl hlt =>
        have hltExp := S.lt_of_lt hlt
        rw [hxy] at hltExp
        exact False.elim
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (S.exp y) hltExp)
    | inr hgt =>
        have hltExp := S.lt_of_lt hgt
        rw [hxy] at hltExp
        exact False.elim
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (S.exp y) hltExp)

name: lt_inv_of_pos_lt_inv
statement:
theorem lt_inv_of_pos_lt_inv
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hb_inv_a : RealTheory.lt b (RealTheory.inv a)) :
    RealTheory.lt a (RealTheory.inv b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have ha_ne : Not (a = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F ha hzero.symm
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
    F hb (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F ha) hb_inv_a
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_inv_of_ne_zero F ha_ne] at h

name: expLowerSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem expLowerSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain ExpLowerSqueezeFun
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hconst :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one :=
    tendstoWithin_const UniversalDomain RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero
  have hid :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain IdentityFun
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero :=
    (continuousAtOn_identity trivial).right
  have h := tendstoWithin_add hconst hid
  have hlim :
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero =
        RealTheory.one :=
    RealTheory.add_zero RealTheory.one
  have h' := tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim h
  exact tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun _x _hx _hxne => rfl)
    h'

name: expUpperSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem expUpperSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain ExpUpperSqueezeFun
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hconst :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one :=
    tendstoWithin_const UniversalDomain RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero
  have hid :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain IdentityFun
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero :=
    (continuousAtOn_identity trivial).right
  have hsub := tendstoWithin_sub hconst hid
  have hsubLim :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero =
        RealTheory.one := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.one
  have hsub' := tendstoWithin_congr_limit hsubLim hsub
  have hinv := tendstoWithin_inv hsub' RealTheory.one_ne_zero
  have hinvLim :
      RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv' := tendstoWithin_congr_limit hinvLim hinv
  exact tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun _x _hx _hxne => rfl)
    hinv'

name: one_add_mul_one_sub_eq_one_sub_square
statement:
theorem one_add_mul_one_sub_eq_one_sub_square (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.mul (F.add F.one x) (F.sub F.one x) =
    F.sub F.one (F.mul x x)
  calc
    F.mul (F.add F.one x) (F.sub F.one x) =
        F.sub
          (F.mul (F.add F.one x) F.one)
          (F.mul (F.add F.one x) x) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F]
    _ =
        F.sub
          (F.add F.one x)
          (F.mul (F.add F.one x) x) := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
    _ =
        F.sub
          (F.add F.one x)
          (F.add (F.mul F.one x) (F.mul x x)) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ =
        F.sub
          (F.add F.one x)
          (F.add x (F.mul x x)) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ =
        F.sub F.one (F.mul x x) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F]
          rw [F.add_assoc]
          have hcancel :
              F.add x (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg (F.mul x x))) =
                F.neg (F.mul x x) := by
            rw [<- F.add_assoc]
            rw [F.add_neg]
            rw [F.zero_add]
          rw [hcancel]

name: one_sub_square_pos
statement:
theorem one_sub_square_pos
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul x x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxx_lt_x :
      F.lt (F.mul x x) x := by
    have h := F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hxlt hxpos
    change F.lt (F.mul x x) (F.mul F.one x) at h
    rwa [F.one_mul] at h
  have hxx_lt_one :
      F.lt (F.mul x x) F.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hxx_lt_x hxlt
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxx_lt_one

name: eventually_squeeze_bounds_at_zero
statement:
theorem eventually_squeeze_bounds_at_zero
    (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) :
    EventuallyWithin UniversalDomain RealTheory.zero
      (fun x : Point =>
        And
          (RealTheory.le (ExpLowerSqueezeFun x) (S.exp x))
          (RealTheory.le (S.exp x) (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine Exists.intro RealTheory.one ?_
  refine And.intro RealTheory.zero_lt_one ?_
  intro x hx hxne hdist
  have hxlt1 : F.lt x F.one := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hdist
    change F.lt x (F.add F.zero F.one) at h
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have hneg1ltx : F.lt (F.neg F.one) x := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hdist
    change F.lt (F.sub F.zero F.one) x at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F F.one] at h
  by_cases hxpos : F.lt F.zero x
  · have hlowerStrict := S.local_lower x hxpos hxlt1
    have hupperStrict := S.local_upper x hxpos hxlt1
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlowerStrict)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hupperStrict)
  · have hxle0 : F.le x F.zero := by
      by_cases hxle0 : F.le x F.zero
      · exact hxle0
      · have h0x : F.le F.zero x := by
          cases F.le_total F.zero x with
          | inl h => exact h
          | inr h => exact False.elim (hxle0 h)
        exact False.elim
          (hxpos (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0x hxle0))
    have hxlt0 : F.lt x F.zero := by
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxle0
      intro h0x
      exact hxne (F.le_antisymm hxle0 h0x)
    let z := F.neg x
    have hzpos : F.lt F.zero z := by
      unfold z
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hxlt0
      change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg x) at h
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
    have hzlt1 : F.lt z F.one := by
      unfold z
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hneg1ltx
      change F.lt (F.neg x) (F.neg (F.neg F.one)) at h
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F F.one] at h
    have hden_pos :
        F.lt F.zero (F.sub F.one z) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hzlt1
    have hupper_z := S.local_upper z hzpos hzlt1
    have hexp_z_pos : F.lt F.zero (S.exp z) := S.pos z
    have hlower_neg :
        F.lt (F.sub F.one z) (F.inv (S.exp z)) :=
      lt_inv_of_pos_lt_inv hden_pos hexp_z_pos hupper_z
    have hone_add_x_eq :
        F.add F.one x = F.sub F.one z := by
      unfold z
      rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F x]
    have hx_eq_neg_z : x = F.neg z := by
      unfold z
      exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F x)
    have hexp_x_eq :
        S.exp x = F.inv (S.exp z) := by
      rw [hx_eq_neg_z]
      exact S.neg_eq_inv z
    have hupper_den_eq :
        F.sub F.one x = F.add F.one z := by
      rw [hx_eq_neg_z]
      rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F z]
    have hone_add_z_pos :
        F.lt F.zero (F.add F.one z) := by
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hzpos)
    have hglobal_lower_z :
        F.lt (F.add F.one z) (S.exp z) :=
      naturalExp_global_lower_of_local
        S.zero_value S.add_law S.local_lower hzpos
    have hupper_neg :
        F.lt (F.inv (S.exp z)) (F.inv (F.add F.one z)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
        F hone_add_z_pos hexp_z_pos hglobal_lower_z
    constructor
    · unfold ExpLowerSqueezeFun
      change F.le (F.add F.one x) (S.exp x)
      rw [hone_add_x_eq, hexp_x_eq]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlower_neg
    · unfold ExpUpperSqueezeFun
      change F.le (S.exp x) (F.inv (F.sub F.one x))
      rw [hexp_x_eq, hupper_den_eq]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hupper_neg

name: tendstoWithin_zero
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_zero (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain S.exp
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hbounds := S.eventually_squeeze_bounds_at_zero
  have hlower :
      EventuallyWithin UniversalDomain RealTheory.zero
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.le (ExpLowerSqueezeFun x) (S.exp x)) :=
    eventuallyWithin_mono (fun _x hx => hx.left) hbounds
  have hupper :
      EventuallyWithin UniversalDomain RealTheory.zero
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.le (S.exp x) (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x)) :=
    eventuallyWithin_mono (fun _x hx => hx.right) hbounds
  exact tendstoWithin_of_squeeze
    expLowerSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero
    expUpperSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero
    hlower
    hupper

name: shiftToZero_sameOn
statement:
theorem shiftToZero_sameOn
    (x0 : Point) :
    SameOn UniversalDomain (ShiftToZero x0)
      (SubFun IdentityFun (fun _ : Point => x0))
proof:
:= by
  intro _x _hx
  rfl

name: tendstoWithin_shiftToZero
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_shiftToZero
    (x0 : Point) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain (ShiftToZero x0)
      x0 RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hid :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain IdentityFun x0 :=
    continuousAtOn_identity trivial
  have hconst :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain (fun _ : Point => x0) x0 :=
    continuousAtOn_const trivial
  have hsub :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain
        (SubFun IdentityFun (fun _ : Point => x0)) x0 :=
    continuousAtOn_sub hid hconst
  have hlimit : RealTheory.sub x0 x0 = RealTheory.zero := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x0
  have h := tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlimit hsub.right
  exact tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun x hx _hxne => (shiftToZero_sameOn x0 x hx).symm)
    h

name: tendstoWithin_exp_shift_one_of_zero
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_exp_shift_one_of_zero
    (S : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    (hzero_cont :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain S.exp
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one)
    (x0 : Point) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
      (fun x : Point => S.exp (ShiftToZero x0 x))
      x0 RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hzeroAt :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain S.exp RealTheory.zero :=
    And.intro trivial
      (tendstoWithin_congr_limit S.zero_value.symm hzero_cont)
  have hcomp :=
    tendstoWithin_comp_continuousAtOn
      (tendstoWithin_shiftToZero x0)
      hzeroAt
      (fun x hx hxne =>
        (show UniversalDomain (ShiftToZero x0 x) from trivial))
  unfold CompFun ShiftToZero at hcomp
  simpa [S.zero_value] using hcomp

name: tendstoWithin_at
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_at (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) (x0 : Point) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain S.exp x0 (S.exp x0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let shifted : Map := fun x : Point => S.exp (ShiftToZero x0 x)
  let scaled : Map := fun x : Point =>
    RealTheory.mul (S.exp x0) (shifted x)
  have hzero_cont := S.tendstoWithin_zero
  have hshift :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain shifted x0 RealTheory.one := by
    unfold shifted
    exact S.tendstoWithin_exp_shift_one_of_zero hzero_cont x0
  have hconst :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (fun _ : Point => S.exp x0) x0 (S.exp x0) :=
    tendstoWithin_const UniversalDomain (S.exp x0) x0
  have hscaled :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain scaled x0 (S.exp x0) := by
    have hmul :=
      tendstoWithin_mul hconst hshift
    change
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.exp x0) shifted)
        x0 (RealTheory.mul (S.exp x0) RealTheory.one) at hmul
    have htarget :
        RealTheory.mul (S.exp x0) RealTheory.one = S.exp x0 :=
      RealTheory.mul_one (S.exp x0)
    have hmul' := tendstoWithin_congr_limit htarget hmul
    exact tendstoWithin_congr
      (fun _x _hx _hxne => rfl)
      hmul'
  apply tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun x _hx _hxne => ?_)
    hscaled
  unfold scaled shifted ShiftToZero
  have harg :
      RealTheory.add x0 (RealTheory.sub x x0) = x := by
    change F.add x0 (F.sub x x0) = x
    rw [F.add_comm x0 (F.sub x x0)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x x0
  have hadd := S.add_law x0 (RealTheory.sub x x0)
  change
    S.exp (RealTheory.add x0 (RealTheory.sub x x0)) =
      RealTheory.mul (S.exp x0)
        (S.exp (RealTheory.sub x x0)) at hadd
  rw [harg] at hadd
  exact hadd.symm

name: continuousOn
statement:
theorem continuousOn (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) :
    ContinuousOn UniversalDomain S.exp
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact And.intro hx (S.tendstoWithin_at x)

name: zero_value
statement:
theorem zero_value
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec) :
    ExpRatio P Q RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ExpRatio
  rw [P.zero_value, Q.zero_value]
  change F.mul F.one (F.inv F.one) = F.one
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F]
  exact F.mul_one F.one

name: pos
statement:
theorem pos
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    (x : Point) :
    PositiveDomain (ExpRatio P Q x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ExpRatio
  exact RealTheory.mul_pos
    (P.pos x)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (Q.pos x))

name: ne_zero
statement:
theorem ne_zero
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    (x : Point) :
    Not (ExpRatio P Q x = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro hzero
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F (pos P Q x) hzero.symm

name: mul_swap_eq_one
statement:
theorem mul_swap_eq_one
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (ExpRatio P Q x) (ExpRatio Q P x) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ExpRatio
  change
    F.mul
      (F.mul (P.exp x) (F.inv (Q.exp x)))
      (F.mul (Q.exp x) (F.inv (P.exp x))) =
        F.one
  calc
    F.mul
      (F.mul (P.exp x) (F.inv (Q.exp x)))
      (F.mul (Q.exp x) (F.inv (P.exp x))) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul (P.exp x) (F.inv (Q.exp x)))
            (Q.exp x))
          (F.inv (P.exp x)) := by
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (P.exp x)
            (F.mul (F.inv (Q.exp x)) (Q.exp x)))
          (F.inv (P.exp x)) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc (P.exp x) (F.inv (Q.exp x)) (Q.exp x)]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.mul (P.exp x) F.one)
          (F.inv (P.exp x)) := by
        rw [F.inv_mul_cancel (Q.ne_zero x)]
    _ =
        F.mul (P.exp x) (F.inv (P.exp x)) := by
        rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = F.one := by
        rw [F.mul_inv_cancel (P.ne_zero x)]

name: swapped_eq_inv
statement:
theorem swapped_eq_inv
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    (x : Point) :
    ExpRatio Q P x = RealTheory.inv (ExpRatio P Q x)
proof:
:= by
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (ne_zero P Q x)
    (mul_swap_eq_one P Q x)

name: add_law
statement:
theorem add_law
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec) :
    NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative (ExpRatio P Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold ExpRatio
  rw [P.add_law x y, Q.add_law x y]
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (P.exp x) (P.exp y))
        (F.inv (F.mul (Q.exp x) (Q.exp y))) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (P.exp x) (F.inv (Q.exp x)))
        (F.mul (P.exp y) (F.inv (Q.exp y)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F (Q.ne_zero x) (Q.ne_zero y)]
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (P.exp x) (P.exp y))
        (F.mul (F.inv (Q.exp y)) (F.inv (Q.exp x))) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (P.exp x) (F.inv (Q.exp x)))
        (F.mul (P.exp y) (F.inv (Q.exp y)))
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (P.exp x) (P.exp y))
        (F.mul (F.inv (Q.exp y)) (F.inv (Q.exp x))) =
        F.mul (F.mul (P.exp x) (P.exp y))
          (F.mul (F.inv (Q.exp x)) (F.inv (Q.exp y))) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv (Q.exp y)) (F.inv (Q.exp x))]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (P.exp x) (F.inv (Q.exp x)))
          (F.mul (P.exp y) (F.inv (Q.exp y))) :=
          RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm
            (P.exp x) (P.exp y)
            (F.inv (Q.exp x)) (F.inv (Q.exp y))

name: neg_eq_inv
statement:
theorem neg_eq_inv
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    (x : Point) :
    ExpRatio P Q (RealTheory.neg x) =
      RealTheory.inv (ExpRatio P Q x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
    F
    (ne_zero P Q x)
    (by
      have h := add_law P Q x (RealTheory.neg x)
      change
        ExpRatio P Q (F.add x (F.neg x)) =
          F.mul (ExpRatio P Q x)
            (ExpRatio P Q (F.neg x)) at h
      have hz0 := zero_value P Q
      change ExpRatio P Q F.zero = F.one at hz0
      rw [F.add_neg, hz0] at h
      exact h.symm)

name: powNat_of_add_law
statement:
theorem powNat_of_add_law
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    (x : Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      powNat (ExpRatio P Q x) n =
        ExpRatio P Q
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) x)
proof:
:= by
  exact
    naturalExp_powNat_of_add_law
      (zero_value P Q)
      (add_law P Q)
      x

name: powNat_div_eq
statement:
theorem powNat_div_eq
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    {x : Point} {n : Nat} (hn : Not (n = 0)) :
    powNat
        (ExpRatio P Q
          (RealTheory.mul x
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))))
        n =
      ExpRatio P Q x
proof:
:= by
  exact
    naturalExp_powNat_div_eq_of_add_law
      (zero_value P Q)
      (add_law P Q)
      hn

name: local_lower_square
statement:
theorem local_lower_square
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul x x))
      (ExpRatio P Q x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hden_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.sub F.one x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxlt
  have hP_lower :
      F.lt (F.add F.one x) (P.exp x) :=
    P.local_lower x hxpos hxlt
  have hQ_upper :
      F.lt (Q.exp x) (F.inv (F.sub F.one x)) :=
    Q.local_upper x hxpos hxlt
  have hQ_inv_lower :
      F.lt (F.sub F.one x) (F.inv (Q.exp x)) :=
    lt_inv_of_pos_lt_inv hden_pos (Q.pos x) hQ_upper
  have hleft_step :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (F.add F.one x) (F.sub F.one x))
        (F.mul (P.exp x) (F.sub F.one x)) :=
    F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hP_lower hden_pos
  have hright_step :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (P.exp x) (F.sub F.one x))
        (F.mul (P.exp x) (F.inv (Q.exp x))) :=
    F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hQ_inv_lower (P.pos x)
  unfold ExpRatio
  have hprod := one_add_mul_one_sub_eq_one_sub_square x
  change
    F.mul (F.add F.one x) (F.sub F.one x) =
      F.sub F.one (F.mul x x) at hprod
  rw [hprod] at hleft_step
  change
    F.lt (F.sub F.one (F.mul x x))
      (F.mul (P.exp x) (F.inv (Q.exp x)))
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hleft_step hright_step

name: local_upper_square
statement:
theorem local_upper_square
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (ExpRatio P Q x)
      (RealTheory.inv
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul x x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hden_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.sub F.one x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxlt
  have hone_add_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.add F.one x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hxpos)
  have hsquare_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.sub F.one (F.mul x x)) :=
    one_sub_square_pos hxpos hxlt
  have hP_upper :
      F.lt (P.exp x) (F.inv (F.sub F.one x)) :=
    P.local_upper x hxpos hxlt
  have hQ_lower :
      F.lt (F.add F.one x) (Q.exp x) :=
    Q.local_lower x hxpos hxlt
  have hQ_inv_upper :
      F.lt (F.inv (Q.exp x)) (F.inv (F.add F.one x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
      F hone_add_pos (Q.pos x) hQ_lower
  have hinvQ_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.inv (Q.exp x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (Q.pos x)
  have hinvDen_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.inv (F.sub F.one x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos
  have hleft_step :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (P.exp x) (F.inv (Q.exp x)))
        (F.mul (F.inv (F.sub F.one x)) (F.inv (Q.exp x))) :=
    F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hP_upper hinvQ_pos
  have hright_step :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (F.inv (F.sub F.one x)) (F.inv (Q.exp x)))
        (F.mul (F.inv (F.sub F.one x))
          (F.inv (F.add F.one x))) :=
    F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hQ_inv_upper hinvDen_pos
  have htarget :
      F.mul (F.inv (F.sub F.one x))
          (F.inv (F.add F.one x)) =
        F.inv (F.sub F.one (F.mul x x)) := by
    have hden_ne : Not (F.sub F.one x = F.zero) := by
      intro hzero
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos hzero.symm
    have hone_add_ne : Not (F.add F.one x = F.zero) := by
      intro hzero
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hone_add_pos hzero.symm
    have hprod := one_add_mul_one_sub_eq_one_sub_square x
    change
      F.mul (F.add F.one x) (F.sub F.one x) =
        F.sub F.one (F.mul x x) at hprod
    calc
      F.mul (F.inv (F.sub F.one x))
          (F.inv (F.add F.one x)) =
          F.mul (F.inv (F.add F.one x))
            (F.inv (F.sub F.one x)) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm]
      _ =
          F.inv
            (F.mul (F.sub F.one x) (F.add F.one x)) := by
            exact Eq.symm
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul
                F hden_ne hone_add_ne)
      _ =
          F.inv
            (F.mul (F.add F.one x) (F.sub F.one x)) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub F.one x) (F.add F.one x)]
      _ = F.inv (F.sub F.one (F.mul x x)) := by
            rw [hprod]
  unfold ExpRatio
  rw [htarget] at hright_step
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hleft_step hright_step

name: one_le_of_pos_arg
statement:
theorem one_le_of_pos_arg
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (ExpRatio P Q x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let step : Nat -> Point :=
    fun n : Nat => RealTheory.mul x (invNatSucc n)
  have hstep_tendsto :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto step RealTheory.zero := by
    unfold step
    exact seqTendsto_scaled_invNatSucc_zero x
  have hstep_nonneg :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (step n)) := by
    refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
    intro n _hn
    unfold step
    exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxpos)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
          (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)))
  have hstep_lt_one :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.lt (step n) RealTheory.one) :=
    scaled_lt_one_eventually_of_tendsto_zero_nonneg
      hstep_tendsto hstep_nonneg
  have hlower_lim :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (SmallPowerSequence (squareScaledInvNatSuccTerm x))
        RealTheory.one :=
    squareScaledInvNatSucc_smallPower_tendsto_one x
  have hconst :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun _ : Nat => ExpRatio P Q x)
        (ExpRatio P Q x) :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_const (ExpRatio P Q x)
  apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le
    hlower_lim hconst
  cases hstep_lt_one with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      let t := step n
      have htpos : F.lt F.zero t := by
        unfold t step
        exact RealTheory.mul_pos hxpos
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
            (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n))
      have htlt : F.lt t F.one := hN n hn
      have hlocal :
          F.lt (F.sub F.one (F.mul t t)) (ExpRatio P Q t) :=
        local_lower_square P Q htpos htlt
      have hbase_nonneg :
          F.le F.zero (F.sub F.one (F.mul t t)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (one_sub_square_pos htpos htlt)
      have hpow_le :
          F.le
            (powNat (F.sub F.one (F.mul t t)) (n + 1))
            (powNat (ExpRatio P Q t) (n + 1)) :=
        powNat_mono_nonneg
          hbase_nonneg
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlocal)
          (n + 1)
      have hpow_ratio :
          powNat (ExpRatio P Q t) (n + 1) =
            ExpRatio P Q x := by
        unfold t step invNatSucc
        exact powNat_div_eq P Q (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
      unfold SmallPowerSequence squareScaledInvNatSuccTerm
      change
        F.le
          (powNat
            (F.add F.one
              (F.neg
                (F.mul
                  (F.mul x (invNatSucc n))
                  (F.mul x (invNatSucc n)))))
            (n + 1))
          (ExpRatio P Q x)
      unfold t step at hpow_le hpow_ratio
      rw [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg F.one
        (F.mul
          (F.mul x (invNatSucc n))
          (F.mul x (invNatSucc n)))]
      rw [hpow_ratio] at hpow_le
      exact hpow_le

name: le_one_of_pos_arg
statement:
theorem le_one_of_pos_arg
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.le (ExpRatio P Q x) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hswap_ge :
      F.le F.one (ExpRatio Q P x) :=
    one_le_of_pos_arg Q P hxpos
  have hswap_inv :
      ExpRatio Q P x = F.inv (ExpRatio P Q x) :=
    swapped_eq_inv P Q x
  rw [hswap_inv] at hswap_ge
  have hqpos : F.lt F.zero (ExpRatio P Q x) :=
    pos P Q x
  have hqnonneg : F.le F.zero (ExpRatio P Q x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hqpos
  have hmul :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hswap_ge hqnonneg
  change
    F.le
      (F.mul (ExpRatio P Q x) F.one)
      (F.mul (ExpRatio P Q x)
        (F.inv (ExpRatio P Q x))) at hmul
  rwa [F.mul_one, F.mul_inv_cancel (ne_zero P Q x)] at hmul

name: eq_one_of_pos_arg
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_pos_arg
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    ExpRatio P Q x = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  exact RealTheory.le_antisymm
    (le_one_of_pos_arg P Q hxpos)
    (one_le_of_pos_arg P Q hxpos)

name: eq_one
statement:
theorem eq_one
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    (x : Point) :
    ExpRatio P Q x = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxzero : x = RealTheory.zero
  · rw [hxzero]
    exact zero_value P Q
  · cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hxzero with
    | inl hxneg =>
        let z := F.neg x
        have hzpos : F.lt F.zero z := by
          unfold z
          have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hxneg
          change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg x) at h
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
        have hz : ExpRatio P Q z = F.one :=
          eq_one_of_pos_arg P Q hzpos
        have hx_eq_neg_z : x = F.neg z := by
          unfold z
          exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F x)
        have hneg := neg_eq_inv P Q z
        change ExpRatio P Q (F.neg z) =
          F.inv (ExpRatio P Q z) at hneg
        rw [hx_eq_neg_z, hneg, hz]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F
    | inr hxpos =>
        exact eq_one_of_pos_arg P Q hxpos

name: exp_eq
statement:
theorem exp_eq
    (P Q : NaturalExpThinSpec) :
    P.exp = Q.exp
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hratio : ExpRatio P Q x = F.one :=
    eq_one P Q x
  unfold ExpRatio at hratio
  have hmul :=
    congrArg (fun z : Point => F.mul z (Q.exp x)) hratio
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (P.exp x) (F.inv (Q.exp x))) (Q.exp x) =
      F.mul F.one (Q.exp x) at hmul
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
      F (P.exp x) (Q.ne_zero x),
    F.one_mul] at hmul

name: uniqueness
statement:
theorem uniqueness :
    NaturalExpUniquenessStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q
  exact exp_eq
    { exp := P.exp
      add_law := P.add_law
      local_lower := P.local_lower
      local_upper := P.local_upper }
    { exp := Q.exp
      add_law := Q.add_law
      local_lower := Q.local_lower
      local_upper := Q.local_upper }

name: power_exp_log_of_pos
statement:
theorem power_exp_log_of_pos
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    I.powerSpec.power mu x =
      I.expSpec.exp (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x))
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    PowerRatio.positive_arg_eq
      I.powerSpec
      (expLogPowerCandidateThinSpec I.expSpec I.logSpec)
      hmu hx
  change
    I.powerSpec.power mu x =
      ExpLogPowerCandidate I.expSpec I.logSpec mu x at h
  rwa [expLogPowerCandidate_of_pos I.expSpec I.logSpec mu hx] at h

name: inv_inv_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem inv_inv_of_ne_zero
    {x : Point} (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv x) = x
proof:
:= by
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_inv_of_ne_zero
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx

name: completedPower_exp_log
statement:
theorem completedPower_exp_log
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface) :
    NaturalPowerExpLogFormula
      I.expSpec.exp I.logSpec.log I.powerSpec.completedPower
proof:
:= by
  intro mu x hx
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hmu_pos : PositiveDomain mu
  case pos =>
    rw [I.powerSpec.completedPower_of_pos hmu_pos]
    exact I.power_exp_log_of_pos hmu_pos hx
  case neg =>
    by_cases hmu_zero : mu = RealTheory.zero
    case pos =>
      rw [hmu_zero, I.powerSpec.completedPower_zero x]
      change
        RealTheory.one =
          I.expSpec.exp
            (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero (I.logSpec.log x))
      rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
      exact Eq.symm I.expSpec.zero_value
    case neg =>
      have hmu_neg : RealTheory.lt mu RealTheory.zero := by
        cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hmu_zero with
        | inl hlt => exact hlt
        | inr hpos =>
            exact False.elim (hmu_pos hpos)
      have hneg_pos :
          PositiveDomain (RealTheory.neg mu) :=
        NaturalPowerThinSpec.neg_pos_of_lt_zero hmu_neg
      rw [I.powerSpec.completedPower_of_neg hmu_neg]
      rw [I.power_exp_log_of_pos hneg_pos hx]
      have harg :
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg mu) (I.logSpec.log x) =
            RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x)) := by
        exact RealTheory.neg_mul mu (I.logSpec.log x)
      rw [harg]
      rw [I.expSpec.neg_eq_inv
        (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x))]
      exact inv_inv_of_ne_zero
        (I.expSpec.ne_zero (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x)))

name: power_exp_log
statement:
theorem power_exp_log
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface) :
    NaturalPowerExpLogFormula
      I.expSpec.exp I.logSpec.log I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
proof:
:= by
  intro mu x hx
  change
    I.powerSpec.completedPower mu x =
      I.expSpec.exp (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x))
  exact I.completedPower_exp_log mu x hx

name: exp_log
statement:
theorem exp_log
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    (x : Point) (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    I.expSpec.exp (I.logSpec.log x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    I.completedPower_exp_log RealTheory.one x hx
  have hleft :
      I.powerSpec.completedPower RealTheory.one x = x := by
    rw [I.powerSpec.completedPower_of_pos RealTheory.zero_lt_one]
    exact I.powerSpec.power_one_eq_self hx
  rw [hleft] at h
  change
    x =
      I.expSpec.exp
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one (I.logSpec.log x)) at h
  rw [RealTheory.one_mul] at h
  exact h.symm

name: log_exp
statement:
theorem log_exp
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    (x : Point) :
    I.logSpec.log (I.expSpec.exp x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain (I.expSpec.exp x) :=
    I.expSpec.pos x
  have h := I.exp_log (I.expSpec.exp x) hxpos
  exact I.expSpec.injective
    (I.logSpec.log (I.expSpec.exp x)) x h

name: exp_image_positive
statement:
theorem exp_image_positive
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {y : Point}
    (hy : PositiveDomain y) :
    Image UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp y
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro (I.logSpec.log y) ?_
  exact And.intro trivial (I.exp_log y hy)

name: image_exp_subset_positive
statement:
theorem image_exp_subset_positive
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface) :
    SetPred.Subset
      (Image UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp) PositiveDomain
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  cases hy with
  | intro x hx =>
      rw [← hx.right]
      exact I.expSpec.pos x

name: inverseOn_exp_eq_log
statement:
theorem inverseOn_exp_eq_log
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {y : Point}
    (hy : PositiveDomain y) :
    InverseOn UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp y =
      I.logSpec.log y
proof:
:= by
  have himage : Image UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp y :=
    exp_image_positive I hy
  have hinv_val :
      I.expSpec.exp (InverseOn UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp y) = y :=
    inverseOn_value himage
  have hlog_val :
      I.expSpec.exp (I.logSpec.log y) = y :=
    I.exp_log y hy
  exact I.expSpec.injective
    (InverseOn UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp y)
    (I.logSpec.log y)
    (by rw [hinv_val, hlog_val])

name: inverseOn_exp_continuousAtOn
statement:
theorem inverseOn_exp_continuousAtOn
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {y : Point}
    (hy : PositiveDomain y) :
    ContinuousAtOn (Image UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp)
      (InverseOn UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp) y
proof:
:= by
  have himage : Image UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp y :=
    exp_image_positive I hy
  have hlog_image :
      ContinuousAtOn (Image UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp)
        I.logSpec.log y := by
    exact
      (continuousOn_subset
        (E := Image UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp)
        (G := PositiveDomain)
        (f := I.logSpec.log)
        (image_exp_subset_positive I)
        I.logSpec.continuousOn) y himage
  apply continuousAtOn_congr
    (E := Image UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp)
    (f := I.logSpec.log)
    (g := InverseOn UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp)
  · intro z hz
    exact (inverseOn_exp_eq_log I
      (image_exp_subset_positive I z hz)).symm
  · exact hlog_image

name: power_positive
statement:
theorem power_positive
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    (mu : Point)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    PositiveDomain (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.power_exp_log mu x hx]
  exact I.expSpec.pos
    (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x))

name: power_one_base
statement:
theorem power_one_base
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    (mu : Point) :
    I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu RealTheory.one =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.power_exp_log mu RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero_lt_one]
  rw [I.logSpec.one_value]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_zero]
  exact I.expSpec.zero_value

name: power_one_exponent
statement:
theorem power_one_exponent
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power RealTheory.one x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.power_exp_log RealTheory.one x hx]
  rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
  exact I.exp_log x hx

name: power_mul_base
statement:
theorem power_mul_base
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {mu x y : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (hy : PositiveDomain y) :
    I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu (RealTheory.mul x y) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.power_exp_log mu (RealTheory.mul x y)
    (RealTheory.mul_pos hx hy)]
  rw [I.logSpec.mul_law x y hx hy]
  rw [I.power_exp_log mu x hx]
  rw [I.power_exp_log mu y hy]
  change
    I.expSpec.exp
        (RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.add (I.logSpec.log x) (I.logSpec.log y))) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (I.expSpec.exp
          (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x)))
        (I.expSpec.exp
          (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log y)))
  rw [RealTheory.mul_add]
  exact I.expSpec.add_law
    (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x))
    (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log y))

name: power_inv_base
statement:
theorem power_inv_base
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu (RealTheory.inv x) =
      RealTheory.inv (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx
  rw [I.power_exp_log mu (RealTheory.inv x) hinv_pos]
  rw [I.logSpec.inv_eq_neg hx]
  rw [I.power_exp_log mu x hx]
  change
    I.expSpec.exp
        (F.mul mu (F.neg (I.logSpec.log x))) =
      F.inv
        (I.expSpec.exp (F.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F mu (I.logSpec.log x)]
  exact I.expSpec.neg_eq_inv
    (F.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x))

name: power_add_exponent
statement:
theorem power_add_exponent
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {mu nu x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
        (RealTheory.add mu nu) x =
      RealTheory.mul
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power nu x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.power_exp_log (RealTheory.add mu nu) x hx]
  rw [I.power_exp_log mu x hx]
  rw [I.power_exp_log nu x hx]
  change
    I.expSpec.exp
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add mu nu)
          (I.logSpec.log x)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (I.expSpec.exp
          (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x)))
        (I.expSpec.exp
          (RealTheory.mul nu (I.logSpec.log x)))
  rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
  exact I.expSpec.add_law
    (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x))
    (RealTheory.mul nu (I.logSpec.log x))

name: power_power
statement:
theorem power_power
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {mu nu x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power nu
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x) =
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
        (RealTheory.mul nu mu) x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbase_pos :
      PositiveDomain
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x) :=
    I.power_positive mu hx
  rw [I.power_exp_log nu
    (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x) hbase_pos]
  rw [I.power_exp_log mu x hx]
  change
    I.expSpec.exp
        (F.mul nu
          (I.logSpec.log
            (I.expSpec.exp
              (F.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x))))) =
      I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power (F.mul nu mu) x
  rw [I.log_exp (F.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x))]
  rw [I.power_exp_log (F.mul nu mu) x hx]
  change
    I.expSpec.exp
        (F.mul nu (F.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x))) =
      I.expSpec.exp
        (F.mul (F.mul nu mu) (I.logSpec.log x))
  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: power_mul_inv_cancel
statement:
theorem power_mul_inv_cancel
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {alpha x : Point}
    (halpha : PositiveDomain alpha)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.inv alpha) x) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := I.logSpec.log x
  have hbase_pos :
      PositiveDomain
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.inv alpha) x) :=
    I.power_positive (RealTheory.inv alpha) hx
  rw [I.power_exp_log alpha
    (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
      (RealTheory.inv alpha) x) hbase_pos]
  rw [I.power_exp_log (RealTheory.inv alpha) x hx]
  change
    I.expSpec.exp
        (F.mul alpha
          (I.logSpec.log
            (I.expSpec.exp (F.mul (F.inv alpha) L)))) =
      x
  rw [I.log_exp (F.mul (F.inv alpha) L)]
  have halpha_ne : Not (alpha = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F halpha hzero.symm
  have harg :
      F.mul alpha (F.mul (F.inv alpha) L) = L := by
    calc
      F.mul alpha (F.mul (F.inv alpha) L) =
          F.mul (F.mul alpha (F.inv alpha)) L := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul F.one L := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel halpha_ne]
      _ = L := by
            rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [harg]
  exact I.exp_log x hx

name: power_mul_inv_cancel_right
statement:
theorem power_mul_inv_cancel_right
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {alpha x : Point}
    (halpha : PositiveDomain alpha)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power (RealTheory.inv alpha)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power alpha x) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have halpha_ne : Not (alpha = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F halpha hzero.symm
  rw [I.power_power hx]
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv alpha) alpha =
        RealTheory.one :=
    RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel halpha_ne
  rw [hmul]
  exact I.power_one_exponent hx

name: power_le_of_le_pos_exponent
statement:
theorem power_le_of_le_pos_exponent
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {mu x y : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (hy : PositiveDomain y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)
      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [I.power_exp_log mu x hx]
  rw [I.power_exp_log mu y hy]
  by_cases heq : x = y
  case pos =>
    rw [heq]
    exact F.le_refl
      (I.expSpec.exp (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log y)))
  case neg =>
    have hnot_yx : Not (RealTheory.le y x) := by
      intro hyx
      exact heq (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_antisymm F hxy hyx)
    have hxy_strict : RealTheory.lt x y :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hnot_yx
    have hlog_strict :
        RealTheory.lt (I.logSpec.log x) (I.logSpec.log y) :=
      I.logSpec.lt_of_lt hx hy hxy_strict
    have harg_strict :
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x))
          (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log y)) :=
      RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hlog_strict hmu
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (I.expSpec.lt_of_lt harg_strict)

name: power_strictMonotoneOn_positive
statement:
theorem power_strictMonotoneOn_positive
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {mu : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu) :
    StrictMonotoneOn PositiveDomain
      (fun x : Point =>
        I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hle :
      RealTheory.le
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu y) :=
    I.power_le_of_le_pos_exponent
      hmu hx hy (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxy)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hle
  intro hrev
  have hxpow_pos :
      PositiveDomain
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x) :=
    I.power_positive mu hx
  have hypow_pos :
      PositiveDomain
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu y) :=
    I.power_positive mu hy
  have hrev_base :
      RealTheory.le y x := by
    have hpow :=
      I.power_le_of_le_pos_exponent
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hmu)
        hypow_pos hxpow_pos hrev
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.inv mu)
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu y))
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.inv mu)
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)) at hpow
    rw [I.power_mul_inv_cancel_right hmu hy] at hpow
    rw [I.power_mul_inv_cancel_right hmu hx] at hpow
    exact hpow
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hxy) hrev_base

name: smallNatId_tendstoInfinity
statement:
theorem smallNatId_tendstoInfinity :
    SmallNatTendstoInfinity (fun n : Nat => n)

:=
  Tautology.natId_tendstoInfinity

name: seqTendsto_inv_nat_succ_of_smallNatTendstoInfinity
statement:
theorem seqTendsto_inv_nat_succ_of_smallNatTendstoInfinity
    {k : Nat -> Nat}
    (hk : SmallNatTendstoInfinity k) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (k n + 1)))
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:=
  IsDedekindCompleteOrderedFieldBaseLike.seqTendsto_inv_nat_succ_of_natTendstoInfinity
    RealTheory.current_complete_ordered_field_base hk

name: seqTendsto_inv_nat_succ
statement:
theorem seqTendsto_inv_nat_succ :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))

proof:

  IsDedekindCompleteOrderedFieldBaseLike.seqTendsto_inv_nat_succ
    RealTheory.current_complete_ordered_field_base

name: inv_powNat_eq_powNat_inv_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem inv_powNat_eq_powNat_inv_of_ne_zero
    (x : Point) (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    forall q : Nat,
      RealTheory.inv (powNat x q) =
        powNat (RealTheory.inv x) q
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro q
  induction q with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero, powNat_zero]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F
  | succ q ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ, powNat_succ]
      have hpow : Not (powNat x q = F.zero) :=
        powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hx q
      change F.inv (F.mul (powNat x q) x) =
        F.mul (powNat (F.inv x) q) (F.inv x)
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hpow hx]
      change F.inv (powNat x q) = powNat (F.inv x) q at ih
      rw [ih, F.mul_comm]

name: seqTendsto_powNat_inv_nat_succ_zero
statement:
theorem seqTendsto_powNat_inv_nat_succ_zero
    (q : Nat) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat =>
        powNat (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))) (q + 1))
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  induction q with
  | zero =>
      exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually
        seqTendsto_inv_nat_succ
        (Exists.intro 0 (fun k _hk => by
          change powNat (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))) 1 =
            F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))
          rw [powNat_one]))
  | succ q ih =>
      have hmul := RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul ih seqTendsto_inv_nat_succ
      change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun k : Nat =>
          F.mul
            (powNat (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))) (q + 1))
            (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))))
        (F.mul F.zero F.zero) at hmul
      rw [F.zero_mul] at hmul
      exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hmul
        (Exists.intro 0 (fun k _hk => by
          change powNat (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))) (q + 1 + 1) =
            F.mul
              (powNat (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))) (q + 1))
              (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)))
          exact powNat_succ _ (q + 1)))

name: seqTendsto_inv_powNat_nat_succ_zero
statement:
theorem seqTendsto_inv_powNat_nat_succ_zero
    (q : Nat) (hq : 0 < q) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.inv (powNat (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) q))
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | zero => omega
  | succ q =>
      exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually
        (seqTendsto_powNat_inv_nat_succ_zero q)
        (Exists.intro 0 (fun k _hk => by
          have hkNe : Not (RealTheory.nat (k + 1) = RealTheory.zero) :=
            RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
          exact inv_powNat_eq_powNat_inv_of_ne_zero
            (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) hkNe (q + 1)))

name: square_nonneg
statement:
theorem square_nonneg (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl hx =>
      exact F.mul_nonneg hx hx
  | inr hx =>
      have hneg_nonneg :
          F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx
      have hsq :
          F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) :=
        F.mul_nonneg hneg_nonneg hneg_nonneg
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x x] at hsq

name: squareScaledInvNatSucc_smallPower_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem squareScaledInvNatSucc_smallPower_tendsto_one
    (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (SmallPowerSequence (squareScaledInvNatSuccTerm x))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let sq := RealTheory.mul x x
  have hnonpos :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.le (squareScaledInvNatSuccTerm x n)
            RealTheory.zero) := by
    refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
    intro n _hn
    unfold squareScaledInvNatSuccTerm
    have hterm_nonneg :
        F.le F.zero
          (F.mul
            (F.mul x (invNatSucc n))
            (F.mul x (invNatSucc n))) :=
      square_nonneg (F.mul x (invNatSucc n))
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonpos_of_nonneg F hterm_nonneg
  have hscaled :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (RealTheory.neg (squareScaledInvNatSuccTerm x n)))
        RealTheory.zero := by
    have hbase :
        RealTheory.SeqTendsto
          (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.mul sq (invNatSucc n))
          RealTheory.zero := by
      unfold sq
      exact seqTendsto_scaled_invNatSucc_zero (RealTheory.mul x x)
    apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hbase
    refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
    intro n _hn
    unfold squareScaledInvNatSuccTerm sq
    rw [RealTheory.neg_neg]
    calc
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul x (invNatSucc n))
            (RealTheory.mul x (invNatSucc n))) =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x x)
              (RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n))) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm x (invNatSucc n) x (invNatSucc n)]
      _ =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x x) (invNatSucc n) := by
            exact natSucc_mul_mul_invNatSucc_sq
              (RealTheory.mul x x) n
  exact smallPower_tendsto_one_of_nonpos hnonpos hscaled

name: inv_lt_one_of_one_lt
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx
  have h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
      F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hxpos hx
  change F.lt (F.inv x) F.one
  change F.lt (F.inv x) (F.inv F.one) at h
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at h

name: local_value_pos_of_pos
statement:
theorem local_value_pos_of_pos
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv mu))) :
    PositiveDomain (S.power mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv_lt_one :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.inv x) RealTheory.one :=
    inv_lt_one_of_one_lt hx1
  have hsub_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hinv_lt_one
  have hprod_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x))) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hmu hsub_pos
  have hlower_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul mu
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
              (RealTheory.inv x)))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hprod_pos)
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hlower_pos
      (S.positive_exponent_local_lower mu hmu x hx1 hxlt)

name: one_value_of_pos
statement:
theorem one_value_of_pos
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu : Point} (hmu : PositiveDomain mu) :
    S.power mu RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (RealTheory.inv mu)
  let x := RealTheory.add RealTheory.one delta
  have hmu_ne : Not (mu = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hmu hzero.symm
  have hinv_mu_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv mu) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hmu
  have hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta := by
    unfold delta
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hinv_mu_pos
  have hdelta_lt_inv :
      RealTheory.lt delta (RealTheory.inv mu) := by
    unfold delta
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hinv_mu_pos
  have hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x := by
    unfold x
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hdelta_pos
  have hxlt :
      RealTheory.lt x
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv mu)) := by
    unfold x
    exact RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hdelta_lt_inv RealTheory.one
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hpx_pos : PositiveDomain (S.power mu x) :=
    S.local_value_pos_of_pos hmu hx1 hxlt
  have hpx_ne : Not (S.power mu x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hpx_pos hzero.symm
  have hmul := S.mul_law mu x RealTheory.one hxpos RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  change
    S.power mu (RealTheory.mul x RealTheory.one) =
      RealTheory.mul (S.power mu x)
        (S.power mu RealTheory.one) at hmul
  rw [RealTheory.mul_one x] at hmul
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_one_of_mul_eq_self_left
    F hpx_ne hmul.symm

name: positiveExponentOneValue
statement:
theorem positiveExponentOneValue
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec) :
    PositiveExponentOneValue S
proof:
:= by
  intro mu hmu
  exact S.one_value_of_pos hmu

name: powNat_base_law
statement:
theorem powNat_base_law
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    forall n : Nat,
      S.power mu (powNat x n) =
        powNat (S.power mu x) n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero]
      exact S.one_value_of_pos hmu
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ]
      have hpow_pos : PositiveDomain (powNat x n) :=
        powNat_pos hx n
      rw [S.mul_law mu (powNat x n) x hpow_pos hx]
      rw [ih]
      rfl

name: root_law
statement:
theorem root_law
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (n : Nat) :
    S.power mu x =
      powNat (S.power mu (nthRoot (n + 1) x)) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxnonneg : NonnegativeDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx
  have hroot_pos :
      PositiveDomain (nthRoot (n + 1) x) :=
    nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos n hx
  have hpow :=
    S.powNat_base_law hmu hroot_pos (n + 1)
  rw [powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg n hxnonneg] at hpow
  exact hpow

name: value_pos_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem value_pos_of_one_lt
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    PositiveDomain (S.power mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxle : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx
  have hinv_mu_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv mu) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hmu
  cases exists_nthRoot_succ_lt_one_add_of_one_le hxle hinv_mu_pos with
  | intro n hroot_lt =>
      let r := nthRoot (n + 1) x
      have hr_gt_one : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one r :=
        one_lt_nthRoot_succ_of_one_lt hx n
      have hrpos : PositiveDomain r :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hr_gt_one
      have hlocal :
          PositiveDomain (S.power mu r) :=
        S.local_value_pos_of_pos hmu hr_gt_one hroot_lt
      have hrootLaw :
          S.power mu x =
            powNat (S.power mu r) (n + 1) := by
        unfold r
        exact S.root_law hmu
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx)
          n
      rw [hrootLaw]
      exact powNat_pos hlocal (n + 1)

name: value_pos
statement:
theorem value_pos
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    PositiveDomain (S.power mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxone : x = RealTheory.one
  · rw [hxone, S.one_value_of_pos hmu]
    exact RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  · cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hxone with
    | inl hxlt =>
        have hinv_gt_one :
            RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x) :=
          LogDifference.one_lt_inv_of_pos_lt_one hx hxlt
        have hinv_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv x) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx
        have hval_inv_pos :
            PositiveDomain (S.power mu (RealTheory.inv x)) :=
          S.value_pos_of_one_lt hmu hinv_gt_one
        have hval_inv_ne :
            Not (S.power mu (RealTheory.inv x) = RealTheory.zero) := by
          intro hzero
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hval_inv_pos hzero.symm
        have hmul := S.mul_law mu x (RealTheory.inv x) hx hinv_pos
        change
          S.power mu (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv x)) =
            RealTheory.mul (S.power mu x)
              (S.power mu (RealTheory.inv x)) at hmul
        have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
          intro hzero
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx hzero.symm
        rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hxne, S.one_value_of_pos hmu] at hmul
        have hxpow :
            S.power mu x =
              RealTheory.inv (S.power mu (RealTheory.inv x)) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right
            F hval_inv_ne hmul.symm
        rw [hxpow]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hval_inv_pos
    | inr hxgt =>
        exact S.value_pos_of_one_lt hmu hxgt

name: value_ne_zero
statement:
theorem value_ne_zero
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    Not (S.power mu x = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (S.value_pos hmu hx) hzero.symm

name: completedPower_of_pos
statement:
theorem completedPower_of_pos
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu) :
    S.completedPower mu x = S.power mu x
proof:
:= by
  unfold completedPower
  exact if_pos hmu

name: completedPower_zero
statement:
theorem completedPower_zero
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    (x : Point) :
    S.completedPower RealTheory.zero x = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnotpos : Not (PositiveDomain RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero h
  simp [completedPower, hnotpos]

name: neg_pos_of_lt_zero
statement:
theorem neg_pos_of_lt_zero
    {mu : Point}
    (hmu : RealTheory.lt mu RealTheory.zero) :
    PositiveDomain (RealTheory.neg mu)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hmu
  change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg mu) at h
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h

name: completedPower_of_neg
statement:
theorem completedPower_of_neg
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : RealTheory.lt mu RealTheory.zero) :
    S.completedPower mu x =
      RealTheory.inv (S.power (RealTheory.neg mu) x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnotpos : Not (PositiveDomain mu) := by
    intro hpos
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hpos hmu)
  have hnotzero : Not (mu = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hmu
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero hmu
