  simp [completedPower, hnotpos, hnotzero]

name: one_value
statement:
theorem one_value
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu) :
    PowerRatio P Q mu RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PowerRatio
  rw [P.one_value_of_pos hmu, Q.one_value_of_pos hmu]
  change F.mul F.one (F.inv F.one) = F.one
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F]
  exact F.mul_one F.one

name: pos
statement:
theorem pos
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    PositiveDomain (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PowerRatio
  exact RealTheory.mul_pos
    (P.value_pos hmu hx)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (Q.value_pos hmu hx))

name: ne_zero
statement:
theorem ne_zero
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    Not (PowerRatio P Q mu x = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (pos P Q hmu hx) hzero.symm

name: mul_swap_eq_one
statement:
theorem mul_swap_eq_one
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    RealTheory.mul (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
        (PowerRatio Q P mu x) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PowerRatio
  change
    F.mul
      (F.mul (P.power mu x) (F.inv (Q.power mu x)))
      (F.mul (Q.power mu x) (F.inv (P.power mu x))) =
        F.one
  calc
    F.mul
      (F.mul (P.power mu x) (F.inv (Q.power mu x)))
      (F.mul (Q.power mu x) (F.inv (P.power mu x))) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul (P.power mu x)
            (F.inv (Q.power mu x))) (Q.power mu x))
          (F.inv (P.power mu x)) := by
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (P.power mu x)
            (F.mul (F.inv (Q.power mu x)) (Q.power mu x)))
          (F.inv (P.power mu x)) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc (P.power mu x)
          (F.inv (Q.power mu x)) (Q.power mu x)]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.mul (P.power mu x) F.one)
          (F.inv (P.power mu x)) := by
        rw [F.inv_mul_cancel (Q.value_ne_zero hmu hx)]
    _ =
        F.mul (P.power mu x) (F.inv (P.power mu x)) := by
        rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = F.one := by
        rw [F.mul_inv_cancel (P.value_ne_zero hmu hx)]

name: swapped_eq_inv
statement:
theorem swapped_eq_inv
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    PowerRatio Q P mu x =
      RealTheory.inv (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
proof:
:= by
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (ne_zero P Q hmu hx)
    (mul_swap_eq_one P Q hmu hx)

name: mul_law
statement:
theorem mul_law
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x y : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (hy : PositiveDomain y) :
    PowerRatio P Q mu (RealTheory.mul x y) =
      RealTheory.mul (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
        (PowerRatio P Q mu y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxy : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.mul x y) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hx hy
  unfold PowerRatio
  rw [P.mul_law mu x y hx hy, Q.mul_law mu x y hx hy]
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (P.power mu x) (P.power mu y))
        (F.inv (F.mul (Q.power mu x) (Q.power mu y))) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (P.power mu x) (F.inv (Q.power mu x)))
        (F.mul (P.power mu y) (F.inv (Q.power mu y)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul
      F (Q.value_ne_zero hmu hx) (Q.value_ne_zero hmu hy)]
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (P.power mu x) (P.power mu y))
        (F.mul (F.inv (Q.power mu y))
          (F.inv (Q.power mu x))) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (P.power mu x) (F.inv (Q.power mu x)))
        (F.mul (P.power mu y) (F.inv (Q.power mu y)))
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (P.power mu x) (P.power mu y))
        (F.mul (F.inv (Q.power mu y))
          (F.inv (Q.power mu x))) =
        F.mul (F.mul (P.power mu x) (P.power mu y))
          (F.mul (F.inv (Q.power mu x))
            (F.inv (Q.power mu y))) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv (Q.power mu y))
            (F.inv (Q.power mu x))]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (P.power mu x) (F.inv (Q.power mu x)))
          (F.mul (P.power mu y) (F.inv (Q.power mu y))) :=
          RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm
            (P.power mu x) (P.power mu y)
            (F.inv (Q.power mu x)) (F.inv (Q.power mu y))

name: powNat_base_law
statement:
theorem powNat_base_law
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    forall n : Nat,
      PowerRatio P Q mu (powNat x n) =
        powNat (PowerRatio P Q mu x) n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero]
      exact one_value P Q hmu
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ]
      have hpow_pos : PositiveDomain (powNat x n) :=
        powNat_pos hx n
      rw [mul_law P Q hmu hpow_pos hx]
      rw [ih]
      rfl

name: root_law
statement:
theorem root_law
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (n : Nat) :
    PowerRatio P Q mu x =
      powNat (PowerRatio P Q mu (nthRoot (n + 1) x)) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxnonneg : NonnegativeDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx
  have hroot_pos :
      PositiveDomain (nthRoot (n + 1) x) :=
    nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos n hx
  have hpow :=
    powNat_base_law P Q hmu hroot_pos (n + 1)
  rw [powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg n hxnonneg] at hpow
  exact hpow

name: one_sub_mul_one_add_eq_sub_sub_mul
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_one_add_eq_sub_sub_mul
    (a b : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one a)
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one b) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub a b)
          (RealTheory.mul a b))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (F.sub F.one a) (F.add F.one b) =
      F.sub F.one (F.add (F.sub a b) (F.mul a b))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg a b]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg F.one
    (F.add (F.add a (F.neg b)) (F.mul a b))]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F
    (F.add a (F.neg b)) (F.mul a b)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F a (F.neg b)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F b]
  calc
    F.mul (F.add F.one (F.neg a)) (F.add F.one b) =
        F.add
          (F.mul F.one (F.add F.one b))
          (F.mul (F.neg a) (F.add F.one b)) := by
        rw [F.add_mul]
    _ =
        F.add (F.add F.one b)
          (F.add (F.mul (F.neg a) F.one)
            (F.mul (F.neg a) b)) := by
        rw [F.one_mul]
        rw [F.mul_add]
    _ =
        F.add (F.add F.one b)
          (F.add (F.neg a)
            (F.neg (F.mul a b))) := by
        rw [F.mul_one]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F a b]
    _ =
        F.add F.one
          (F.add b
            (F.add (F.neg a)
              (F.neg (F.mul a b)))) := by
        rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ =
        F.add F.one
          (F.add (F.add b (F.neg a))
            (F.neg (F.mul a b))) := by
        rw [<- F.add_assoc b (F.neg a) (F.neg (F.mul a b))]
    _ =
        F.add F.one
          (F.add (F.add (F.neg a) b)
            (F.neg (F.mul a b))) := by
        rw [F.add_comm b (F.neg a)]
    _ =
        F.add F.one
          (F.add
            (F.add (F.neg a) b)
            (F.neg (F.mul a b))) := rfl
    _ =
        F.add F.one
          (F.add
            (F.add (F.neg a) b)
            (F.neg (F.mul a b))) := rfl

name: localFactor_product_eq_one_sub_exact_error
statement:
theorem localFactor_product_eq_one_sub_exact_error
    {mu x : Point}
    (hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul (LocalLowerFactor mu x)
        (LocalUpperFactor mu x) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul
          (LocalQuadraticError mu x)
          (RealTheory.inv x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := F.sub x F.one
  let a := F.mul mu h
  let b := F.mul mu (F.mul h (F.inv x))
  have hone_sub_inv :
      F.sub F.one (F.inv x) =
        F.mul h (F.inv x) := by
    unfold h
    exact LogDifference.one_sub_inv_eq_sub_one_mul_inv hxne
  have hmain :=
    one_sub_mul_one_add_eq_sub_sub_mul a b
  change
    F.mul (F.sub F.one a) (F.add F.one b) =
      F.sub F.one (F.add (F.sub a b) (F.mul a b)) at hmain
  unfold LocalLowerFactor LocalUpperFactor
  change
    F.mul (F.sub F.one a)
        (F.add F.one
          (F.mul mu (F.sub F.one (F.inv x)))) =
      F.sub F.one
        (F.mul (LocalQuadraticError mu x) (F.inv x))
  rw [hone_sub_inv]
  change
    F.mul (F.sub F.one a) (F.add F.one b) =
      F.sub F.one
        (F.mul (LocalQuadraticError mu x) (F.inv x))
  rw [hmain]
  congr 1
  have hsub_part :
      F.sub a b =
        F.mul (F.mul mu (F.mul h h)) (F.inv x) := by
    unfold a b
    calc
      F.sub (F.mul mu h)
          (F.mul mu (F.mul h (F.inv x))) =
          F.mul mu (F.sub h (F.mul h (F.inv x))) := by
          exact Eq.symm
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
              F mu h (F.mul h (F.inv x)))
      _ =
          F.mul mu (F.mul h (F.sub F.one (F.inv x))) := by
          have hinner :
              F.sub h (F.mul h (F.inv x)) =
                F.mul h (F.sub F.one (F.inv x)) := by
            calc
              F.sub h (F.mul h (F.inv x)) =
                  F.sub (F.mul h F.one)
                    (F.mul h (F.inv x)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_one]
              _ =
                  F.mul h (F.sub F.one (F.inv x)) := by
                  exact Eq.symm
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
                      F h F.one (F.inv x))
          rw [hinner]
      _ =
          F.mul mu (F.mul h (F.mul h (F.inv x))) := by
          rw [hone_sub_inv]
      _ =
          F.mul (F.mul mu (F.mul h h)) (F.inv x) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc h h (F.inv x)]
          rw [F.mul_assoc mu (F.mul h h) (F.inv x)]
  have hmul_part :
      F.mul a b =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.mul mu mu) (F.mul h h))
          (F.inv x) := by
    unfold a b
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul mu h)
          (F.mul mu (F.mul h (F.inv x))) =
          F.mul (F.mul mu mu)
            (F.mul h (F.mul h (F.inv x))) := by
          exact RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm mu h mu (F.mul h (F.inv x))
      _ =
          F.mul (F.mul mu mu)
            (F.mul (F.mul h h) (F.inv x)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc h h (F.inv x)]
      _ =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.mul mu mu) (F.mul h h))
            (F.inv x) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc (F.mul mu mu) (F.mul h h) (F.inv x)]
  rw [hsub_part, hmul_part]
  unfold LocalQuadraticError h
  calc
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul mu
          (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.sub x F.one)))
          (F.inv x))
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul mu mu)
            (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.sub x F.one)))
          (F.inv x)) =
        F.mul
          (F.add
            (F.mul mu
              (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.sub x F.one)))
            (F.mul (F.mul mu mu)
              (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.sub x F.one))))
          (F.inv x) := by
        rw [<- F.add_mul]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.add mu (F.mul mu mu))
            (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.sub x F.one)))
          (F.inv x) := by
        rw [<- F.add_mul]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.mul mu (F.add F.one mu))
            (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.sub x F.one)))
          (F.inv x) := by
        rw [F.mul_add]
        rw [F.mul_one]

name: localQuadraticError_nonneg
statement:
theorem localQuadraticError_nonneg
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (LocalQuadraticError mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hmu_nonneg : F.le F.zero mu :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hmu
  have hone_add_mu_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.add F.one mu) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F F.zero_lt_one
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hmu)
  have hcoef_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul mu (F.add F.one mu)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hmu_nonneg
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hone_add_mu_pos)
  have hsquare_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero
        (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.sub x F.one)) :=
    square_nonneg (F.sub x F.one)
  unfold LocalQuadraticError
  exact F.mul_nonneg hcoef_nonneg hsquare_nonneg

name: localQuadraticLower_le_factor_product
statement:
theorem localQuadraticLower_le_factor_product
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.le (LocalQuadraticLower mu x)
      (RealTheory.mul (LocalLowerFactor mu x)
        (LocalUpperFactor mu x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F F.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hxne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxpos hzero.symm
  have herror_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (LocalQuadraticError mu x) :=
    localQuadraticError_nonneg hmu
  have hinv_le_one :
      F.le (F.inv x) F.one :=
    LogDifference.inv_le_one_of_one_le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx1)
  have hscaled_le :
      F.le
        (F.mul (LocalQuadraticError mu x) (F.inv x))
        (LocalQuadraticError mu x) := by
    have h :=
      F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hinv_le_one herror_nonneg
    change
      F.le
        (F.mul (LocalQuadraticError mu x) (F.inv x))
        (F.mul (LocalQuadraticError mu x) F.one) at h
    rwa [F.mul_one] at h
  have hsub :
      F.le
        (F.sub F.one (LocalQuadraticError mu x))
        (F.sub F.one
          (F.mul (LocalQuadraticError mu x) (F.inv x))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F (F.le_refl F.one) hscaled_le
  unfold LocalQuadraticLower
  have hprod_eq :=
    localFactor_product_eq_one_sub_exact_error
      (mu := mu) (x := x) hxne
  change
    F.mul (LocalLowerFactor mu x) (LocalUpperFactor mu x) =
      F.sub F.one
        (F.mul (LocalQuadraticError mu x) (F.inv x)) at hprod_eq
  rw [<- hprod_eq] at hsub
  exact hsub

name: localLowerFactor_pos
statement:
theorem localLowerFactor_pos
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (_hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv mu))) :
    PositiveDomain (LocalLowerFactor mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hmu_ne : Not (mu = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hmu hzero.symm
  have hsub_lt_inv :
      F.lt (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv mu) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hxlt
  have hmul_lt :
      F.lt (F.mul mu (F.sub x F.one))
        (F.mul mu (F.inv mu)) :=
    F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hsub_lt_inv hmu
  have hmul_lt_one :
      F.lt (F.mul mu (F.sub x F.one)) F.one := by
    rwa [F.mul_inv_cancel hmu_ne] at hmul_lt
  unfold LocalLowerFactor
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hmul_lt_one

name: localUpperFactor_pos
statement:
theorem localUpperFactor_pos
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    PositiveDomain (LocalUpperFactor mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv_lt_one :
      F.lt (F.inv x) F.one :=
    NaturalPowerThinSpec.inv_lt_one_of_one_lt hx1
  have hsub_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.sub F.one (F.inv x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hinv_lt_one
  have hprod_pos :
      F.lt F.zero
        (F.mul mu (F.sub F.one (F.inv x))) :=
    F.mul_pos hmu hsub_pos
  unfold LocalUpperFactor
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F F.zero_lt_one
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hprod_pos)

name: local_factor_lower
statement:
theorem local_factor_lower
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv mu))) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (LocalLowerFactor mu x)
        (LocalUpperFactor mu x))
      (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F F.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hApos :
      PositiveDomain (LocalLowerFactor mu x) :=
    localLowerFactor_pos hmu hx1 hxlt
  have hBpos :
      PositiveDomain (LocalUpperFactor mu x) :=
    localUpperFactor_pos hmu hx1
  have hQpos : PositiveDomain (Q.power mu x) :=
    Q.local_value_pos_of_pos hmu hx1 hxlt
  have hPpos : PositiveDomain (P.power mu x) :=
    P.local_value_pos_of_pos hmu hx1 hxlt
  have hP_lower :
      F.lt (LocalUpperFactor mu x) (P.power mu x) := by
    unfold LocalUpperFactor
    exact P.positive_exponent_local_lower mu hmu x hx1 hxlt
  have hQ_upper :
      F.lt (Q.power mu x)
        (F.inv (LocalLowerFactor mu x)) := by
    unfold LocalLowerFactor
    exact Q.positive_exponent_local_upper mu hmu x hx1 hxlt
  have hQ_inv_lower :
      F.lt (LocalLowerFactor mu x)
        (F.inv (Q.power mu x)) :=
    lt_inv_of_pos_lt_inv hApos hQpos hQ_upper
  have hleft :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (LocalUpperFactor mu x)
          (LocalLowerFactor mu x))
        (F.mul (P.power mu x)
          (LocalLowerFactor mu x)) :=
    F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hP_lower hApos
  have hright :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (P.power mu x)
          (LocalLowerFactor mu x))
        (F.mul (P.power mu x)
          (F.inv (Q.power mu x))) :=
    F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hQ_inv_lower hPpos
  unfold PowerRatio
  have h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hleft hright
  rwa [F.mul_comm (LocalUpperFactor mu x)
      (LocalLowerFactor mu x)] at h

name: local_quadratic_lower
statement:
theorem local_quadratic_lower
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv mu))) :
    RealTheory.lt (LocalQuadraticLower mu x)
      (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
proof:
:= by
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (localQuadraticLower_le_factor_product hmu hx1)
    (local_factor_lower P Q hmu hx1 hxlt)

name: nat_mul_localQuadraticError_root_lt_gap
statement:
theorem nat_mul_localQuadraticError_root_lt_gap
    {mu x gap : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x)
    {n : Nat}
    (hroot_sub_lt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub (nthRoot (n + 1) x) RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.mul gap
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul mu
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one mu))
              (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))))) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (LocalQuadraticError mu (nthRoot (n + 1) x)))
      gap
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let r := nthRoot (n + 1) x
  let h := F.sub r F.one
  let coef := F.mul mu (F.add F.one mu)
  let xm := F.sub x F.one
  let den := F.mul coef xm
  have hxle : F.le F.one x := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx1
  have hr_ge_one : F.le F.one r :=
    one_le_nthRoot_succ_of_one_le hxle n
  have hh_nonneg : F.le F.zero h := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hr_ge_one
  have hxm_pos : F.lt F.zero xm := by
    unfold xm
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx1
  have hone_add_mu_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.add F.one mu) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F F.zero_lt_one
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hmu)
  have hcoef_pos : F.lt F.zero coef := by
    unfold coef
    exact F.mul_pos hmu hone_add_mu_pos
  have hcoef_nonneg : F.le F.zero coef :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hcoef_pos
  have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero den := by
    unfold den
    exact F.mul_pos hcoef_pos hxm_pos
  have hden_ne : Not (den = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos hzero.symm
  have hN_h_bound :
      F.le (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) h) xm := by
    unfold h xm r
    exact LogDifference.root_sub_one_nat_bound hx1 n
  have hN_h_h_bound :
      F.le (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) h) h)
        (F.mul xm h) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hN_h_bound hh_nonneg
  have hcoef_bound :
      F.le
        (F.mul coef
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) h) h))
        (F.mul coef (F.mul xm h)) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hN_h_h_bound hcoef_nonneg
  have herror_bound :
      F.le
        (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1))
          (LocalQuadraticError mu r))
        (F.mul den h) := by
    unfold LocalQuadraticError
    change
      F.le
        (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1))
          (F.mul coef (F.mul h h)))
        (F.mul den h)
    have hleft_eq :
        F.mul (F.nat (n + 1))
            (F.mul coef (F.mul h h)) =
          F.mul coef
            (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) h) h) := by
      calc
        F.mul (F.nat (n + 1))
            (F.mul coef (F.mul h h)) =
            F.mul (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) coef)
              (F.mul h h) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
        _ =
            F.mul (F.mul coef (F.nat (n + 1)))
              (F.mul h h) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.nat (n + 1)) coef]
        _ =
            F.mul coef
              (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) (F.mul h h)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc coef (F.nat (n + 1)) (F.mul h h)]
        _ =
            F.mul coef
              (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) h) h) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc (F.nat (n + 1)) h h]
    have hright_eq :
        F.mul den h = F.mul coef (F.mul xm h) := by
      unfold den
      rw [F.mul_assoc coef xm h]
    rw [hleft_eq, hright_eq]
    exact hcoef_bound
  have hden_h_lt :
      F.lt (F.mul den h) gap := by
    have hmul :=
      F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hroot_sub_lt hden_pos
    change
      F.lt
        (F.mul den h)
        (F.mul den (F.mul gap (F.inv den))) at hmul
    have htarget :
        F.mul den (F.mul gap (F.inv den)) = gap := by
      calc
        F.mul den (F.mul gap (F.inv den)) =
            F.mul gap (F.mul den (F.inv den)) := by
            calc
              F.mul den (F.mul gap (F.inv den)) =
                  F.mul (F.mul den gap) (F.inv den) := by
                  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
              _ =
                  F.mul (F.mul gap den) (F.inv den) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm den gap]
              _ =
                  F.mul gap (F.mul den (F.inv den)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul gap F.one := by rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hden_ne]
        _ = gap := by rw [F.mul_one]
    rwa [htarget] at hmul
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
    F herror_bound hden_h_lt

name: one_lt_arg_not_lt_one
statement:
theorem one_lt_arg_not_lt_one
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    Not (RealTheory.lt (PowerRatio P Q mu x) RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  intro hratio_lt_one
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let ratio := PowerRatio P Q mu x
  let gap := F.sub F.one ratio
  let xm := F.sub x F.one
  let coef := F.mul mu (F.add F.one mu)
  let den := F.mul coef xm
  let eta := F.mul gap (F.inv den)
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F F.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hratio_pos : F.lt F.zero ratio := by
    unfold ratio
    exact pos P Q hmu hxpos
  have hgap_pos : F.lt F.zero gap := by
    unfold gap ratio
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hratio_lt_one
  have hgap_lt_one : F.lt gap F.one := by
    unfold gap ratio
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hratio_pos
  have hxm_pos : F.lt F.zero xm := by
    unfold xm
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx1
  have hone_add_mu_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.add F.one mu) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F F.zero_lt_one
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hmu)
  have hcoef_pos : F.lt F.zero coef := by
    unfold coef
    exact F.mul_pos hmu hone_add_mu_pos
  have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero den := by
    unfold den
    exact F.mul_pos hcoef_pos hxm_pos
  have hden_ne : Not (den = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos hzero.symm
  have heta_pos : F.lt F.zero eta := by
    unfold eta
    exact F.mul_pos hgap_pos
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos)
  have hinv_mu_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv mu) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hmu
  have finish_with_theta :
      forall theta : Point,
        F.lt F.zero theta ->
          F.lt theta eta ->
            F.lt theta (F.inv mu) -> False := by
    intro theta htheta_pos htheta_lt_eta htheta_lt_inv_mu
    have hxle : F.le F.one x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx1
    cases exists_nthRoot_succ_lt_one_add_of_one_le
        hxle htheta_pos with
    | intro n hroot_lt =>
        let r := nthRoot (n + 1) x
        let h := F.sub r F.one
        let error := LocalQuadraticError mu r
        have hr_gt_one : F.lt F.one r :=
          one_lt_nthRoot_succ_of_one_lt hx1 n
        have hrpos : PositiveDomain r :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F F.zero_lt_one hr_gt_one
        have htheta_window :
            F.lt (F.add F.one theta)
              (F.add F.one (F.inv mu)) :=
          RealTheory.add_lt_add_left htheta_lt_inv_mu F.one
        have hr_lt_window :
            F.lt r (F.add F.one (F.inv mu)) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hroot_lt htheta_window
        have hroot_sub_lt_theta : F.lt h theta := by
          unfold h r
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hroot_lt
        have hroot_sub_lt_eta : F.lt h eta :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
            hroot_sub_lt_theta htheta_lt_eta
        have hroot_sub_lt_den :
            F.lt h
              (F.mul gap
                (F.inv
                  (F.mul
                    (F.mul mu (F.add F.one mu))
                    (F.sub x F.one)))) := by
          unfold eta den coef xm at hroot_sub_lt_eta
          exact hroot_sub_lt_eta
        have hNerror_lt_gap :
            F.lt
              (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1))
                (LocalQuadraticError mu r))
              gap := by
          unfold r
          exact nat_mul_localQuadraticError_root_lt_gap
            hmu hx1 hroot_sub_lt_den
        have herror_nonneg : F.le F.zero error := by
          unfold error
          exact localQuadraticError_nonneg hmu
        have herror_le_Nerror :
            F.le error
              (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) error) := by
          unfold error
          exact small_term_le_scaled
            (localQuadraticError_nonneg (mu := mu) (x := r) hmu)
            n
        have herror_lt_gap : F.lt error gap :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
            F herror_le_Nerror hNerror_lt_gap
        have herror_lt_one : F.lt error F.one :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
            herror_lt_gap hgap_lt_one
        have hbase_nonneg :
            F.le F.zero (F.sub F.one error) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F herror_lt_one)
        have hlocal :
            F.lt (F.sub F.one error)
              (PowerRatio P Q mu r) := by
          unfold error
          exact local_quadratic_lower
            P Q hmu hr_gt_one hr_lt_window
        have hpow_lower :
            F.le
              (F.sub F.one
                (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) error))
              (powNat (F.sub F.one error) (n + 1)) := by
          exact one_sub_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_sub
            herror_nonneg hbase_nonneg (n + 1)
        have hpow_strict :
            F.lt
              (powNat (F.sub F.one error) (n + 1))
              (powNat (PowerRatio P Q mu r) (n + 1)) :=
          powNat_strictMono_nonneg_succ
            hbase_nonneg hlocal n
        have hrootLaw :
            PowerRatio P Q mu x =
              powNat (PowerRatio P Q mu r) (n + 1) := by
          unfold r
          exact root_law P Q hmu hxpos n
        have hratio_eq_one_sub_gap :
            F.sub F.one gap = ratio := by
          unfold gap
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F F.one ratio
        have hratio_lt_one_sub_Nerror :
            F.lt ratio
              (F.sub F.one
                (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) error)) := by
          have hNerror_lt_gap_error :
              F.lt (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) error) gap := by
            unfold error
            exact hNerror_lt_gap
          have hsub :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt
              F (c := F.one) hNerror_lt_gap_error
          change
            F.lt (F.sub F.one gap)
              (F.sub F.one
                (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) error)) at hsub
          rwa [hratio_eq_one_sub_gap] at hsub
        have hratio_lt_pow_lower :
            F.lt ratio (powNat (F.sub F.one error) (n + 1)) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
            F hratio_lt_one_sub_Nerror hpow_lower
        have hratio_lt_pow_ratio :
            F.lt ratio
              (powNat (PowerRatio P Q mu r) (n + 1)) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
            F hratio_lt_pow_lower hpow_strict
        change
          F.lt (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
            (powNat (PowerRatio P Q mu r) (n + 1))
            at hratio_lt_pow_ratio
        rw [<- hrootLaw] at hratio_lt_pow_ratio
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
          F (PowerRatio P Q mu x) hratio_lt_pow_ratio
  by_cases heta_le_inv : F.le eta (F.inv mu)
  · let theta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eta
    have htheta_pos : F.lt F.zero theta := by
      unfold theta
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heta_pos
    have htheta_lt_eta : F.lt theta eta := by
      unfold theta
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heta_pos
    have htheta_lt_inv :
        F.lt theta (F.inv mu) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
        F htheta_lt_eta heta_le_inv
    exact finish_with_theta theta
      htheta_pos htheta_lt_eta htheta_lt_inv
  · have hinv_le_eta : F.le (F.inv mu) eta := by
      cases F.le_total (F.inv mu) eta with
      | inl hle => exact hle
      | inr heta_le =>
          exact False.elim (heta_le_inv heta_le)
    have hinv_lt_eta : F.lt (F.inv mu) eta :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
        F hinv_le_eta heta_le_inv
    let theta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.inv mu)
    have htheta_pos : F.lt F.zero theta := by
      unfold theta
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hinv_mu_pos
    have htheta_lt_inv : F.lt theta (F.inv mu) := by
      unfold theta
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hinv_mu_pos
    have htheta_lt_eta : F.lt theta eta :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F htheta_lt_inv hinv_lt_eta
    exact finish_with_theta theta
      htheta_pos htheta_lt_eta htheta_lt_inv

name: one_lt_arg_one_le
statement:
theorem one_lt_arg_one_le
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (one_lt_arg_not_lt_one P Q hmu hx1)

name: one_lt_arg_le_one
statement:
theorem one_lt_arg_le_one
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.le (PowerRatio P Q mu x) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F F.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hswap_ge :
      F.le F.one (PowerRatio Q P mu x) :=
    one_lt_arg_one_le Q P hmu hx1
  have hswap_inv :
      PowerRatio Q P mu x =
        F.inv (PowerRatio P Q mu x) :=
    swapped_eq_inv P Q hmu hxpos
  rw [hswap_inv] at hswap_ge
  have hqpos : F.lt F.zero (PowerRatio P Q mu x) :=
    pos P Q hmu hxpos
  have hqnonneg : F.le F.zero (PowerRatio P Q mu x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hqpos
  have hmul :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hswap_ge hqnonneg
  change
    F.le
      (F.mul (PowerRatio P Q mu x) F.one)
      (F.mul (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
        (F.inv (PowerRatio P Q mu x))) at hmul
  rwa [F.mul_one, F.mul_inv_cancel (ne_zero P Q hmu hxpos)] at hmul

name: one_lt_arg_eq_one
statement:
theorem one_lt_arg_eq_one
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    PowerRatio P Q mu x = RealTheory.one
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.le_antisymm
    (one_lt_arg_le_one P Q hmu hx1)
    (one_lt_arg_one_le P Q hmu hx1)

name: inv_base_eq_inv
statement:
theorem inv_base_eq_inv
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    PowerRatio P Q mu (RealTheory.inv x) =
      RealTheory.inv (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx hzero.symm
  have hinv_pos : PositiveDomain (F.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx
  have hmul :=
    mul_law P Q hmu hx hinv_pos
  change
    PowerRatio P Q mu (F.mul x (F.inv x)) =
      F.mul (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
        (PowerRatio P Q mu (F.inv x)) at hmul
  rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hxne] at hmul
  change
    PowerRatio P Q mu RealTheory.one =
      F.mul (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
        (PowerRatio P Q mu (F.inv x)) at hmul
  rw [one_value P Q hmu] at hmul
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
    F (ne_zero P Q hmu hx) hmul.symm

name: positive_arg_eq_one
statement:
theorem positive_arg_eq_one
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    PowerRatio P Q mu x = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxone : x = F.one
  · rw [hxone]
    exact one_value P Q hmu
  · cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hxone with
    | inl hxlt =>
        have hinv_gt_one :
            F.lt F.one (F.inv x) :=
          LogDifference.one_lt_inv_of_pos_lt_one hx hxlt
        have hinv_one :
            PowerRatio P Q mu (F.inv x) = F.one :=
          one_lt_arg_eq_one P Q hmu hinv_gt_one
        have hinv_eq :
            PowerRatio P Q mu (F.inv x) =
              F.inv (PowerRatio P Q mu x) :=
          inv_base_eq_inv P Q hmu hx
        rw [hinv_eq] at hinv_one
        have hmul :=
          congrArg
            (fun z : Point =>
              F.mul (PowerRatio P Q mu x) z)
            hinv_one
        change
          F.mul (PowerRatio P Q mu x)
              (F.inv (PowerRatio P Q mu x)) =
            F.mul (PowerRatio P Q mu x) F.one at hmul
        rw [F.mul_inv_cancel (ne_zero P Q hmu hx),
          F.mul_one] at hmul
        exact hmul.symm
    | inr hxgt =>
        exact one_lt_arg_eq_one P Q hmu hxgt

name: positive_arg_eq
statement:
theorem positive_arg_eq
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    P.power mu x = Q.power mu x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hratio :
      PowerRatio P Q mu x = F.one :=
    positive_arg_eq_one P Q hmu hx
  unfold PowerRatio at hratio
  have hmul :=
    congrArg
      (fun z : Point => F.mul z (Q.power mu x))
      hratio
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul (P.power mu x)
          (F.inv (Q.power mu x)))
        (Q.power mu x) =
      F.mul F.one (Q.power mu x) at hmul
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
      F (P.power mu x) (Q.value_ne_zero hmu hx),
    F.one_mul] at hmul

name: uniqueness
statement:
theorem uniqueness :
    NaturalPowerUniquenessStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q mu hmu x hx
  exact positive_arg_eq
    { power := P.power
      mul_law := P.mul_law
      positive_exponent_local_lower :=
        P.positive_exponent_local_lower
      positive_exponent_local_upper :=
        P.positive_exponent_local_upper }
    { power := Q.power
      mul_law := Q.mul_law
      positive_exponent_local_lower :=
        Q.positive_exponent_local_lower
      positive_exponent_local_upper :=
        Q.positive_exponent_local_upper }
    hmu hx

name: power_eq_of_fixed_positive_spec
statement:
theorem power_eq_of_fixed_positive_spec
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu : Point} (hmu : PositiveDomain mu)
    (p : Map)
    (hp_mul :
      forall x y : Point,
        PositiveDomain x ->
          PositiveDomain y ->
            p (RealTheory.mul x y) =
              RealTheory.mul (p x) (p y))
    (hp_lower :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x ->
          RealTheory.lt x
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv mu)) ->
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
                (RealTheory.mul mu
                  (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                    (RealTheory.inv x))))
              (p x))
    (hp_upper :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x ->
          RealTheory.lt x
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv mu)) ->
            RealTheory.lt (p x)
              (RealTheory.inv
                (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                  (RealTheory.mul mu
                    (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)))))
    {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    S.power mu x = p x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let replacementPower : Point -> Map :=
    fun nu z : Point =>
      if h : nu = mu then p z else S.power nu z
  let Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec :=
    { power := replacementPower
      mul_law := by
        intro nu x y hx hy
        by_cases hnu : nu = mu
        case pos =>
          simp [replacementPower, hnu, hp_mul x y hx hy]
        case neg =>
          simp [replacementPower, hnu, S.mul_law nu x y hx hy]
      positive_exponent_local_lower := by
        intro nu hnu_pos x hx1 hxlt
        by_cases hnu : nu = mu
        case pos =>
          subst nu
          simp [replacementPower, hp_lower x hx1 hxlt]
        case neg =>
          simp [replacementPower, hnu,
            S.positive_exponent_local_lower nu hnu_pos x hx1 hxlt]
      positive_exponent_local_upper := by
        intro nu hnu_pos x hx1 hxlt
        by_cases hnu : nu = mu
        case pos =>
          subst nu
          simp [replacementPower, hp_upper x hx1 hxlt]
        case neg =>
          simp [replacementPower, hnu,
            S.positive_exponent_local_upper nu hnu_pos x hx1 hxlt] }
  have h := PowerRatio.positive_arg_eq S Q hmu hx
  change S.power mu x = replacementPower mu x at h
  simpa [replacementPower] using h

name: identity_power_one_fixed_local_lower
statement:
theorem identity_power_one_fixed_local_lower
    {x : Point}
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x))))
      x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxpos hzero.symm
  have hsub_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx1
  have hinv_lt_one :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.inv x) RealTheory.one :=
    inv_lt_one_of_one_lt hx1
  have hmul_lt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv x))
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) := by
    have h :=
      RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hinv_lt_one hsub_pos
    change
      F.lt
        (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x))
        (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) F.one) at h
    rwa [F.mul_one] at h
  have hone_sub :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    LogDifference.one_sub_inv_eq_sub_one_mul_inv hxne
  change
    F.sub F.one (F.inv x) =
      F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x) at hone_sub
  have hadd :=
    RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hmul_lt RealTheory.one
  have hright :
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) = x := by
    change F.add F.one (F.sub x F.one) = x
    rw [F.add_comm F.one (F.sub x F.one)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x F.one
  change
    F.lt
      (F.add F.one
        (F.mul F.one (F.sub F.one (F.inv x))))
      x
  rw [F.one_mul]
  change F.lt (F.add F.one (F.sub F.one (F.inv x))) x
  rw [hone_sub]
  rwa [hright] at hadd

name: identity_power_one_fixed_local_upper
statement:
theorem identity_power_one_fixed_local_upper
    {x : Point}
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x)
    (hxlt :
      RealTheory.lt x
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one))) :
    RealTheory.lt x
      (RealTheory.inv
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let u := RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one
  let den := RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one u
  have hu_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero u := by
    unfold u
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx1
  have hxlt_two :
      RealTheory.lt x (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) := by
    change F.lt x (F.add F.one (F.inv F.one)) at hxlt
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at hxlt
  have hu_lt_one : RealTheory.lt u RealTheory.one := by
    unfold u
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hxlt_two
  have hden_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero den := by
    unfold den
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hu_lt_one
  have hden_ne : Not (den = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos hzero.symm
  have hx_eq : x = RealTheory.add RealTheory.one u := by
    unfold u
    change x = F.add F.one (F.sub x F.one)
    rw [F.add_comm F.one (F.sub x F.one)]
    exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x F.one)
  have hprod_eq :
      RealTheory.mul den x =
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul u u) := by
    change F.mul den x = F.sub F.one (F.mul u u)
    unfold den
    rw [hx_eq]
    change
      F.mul (F.sub F.one u) (F.add F.one u) =
        F.sub F.one (F.mul u u)
    rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub F.one u) (F.add F.one u)]
    exact one_add_mul_one_sub_eq_one_sub_square u
  have huu_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul u u) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hu_pos hu_pos
  have hprod_lt :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul den x) RealTheory.one := by
    rw [hprod_eq]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F huu_pos
  have hscaled :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul den x)
        (RealTheory.mul den (RealTheory.inv den)) := by
    rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hden_ne]
    exact hprod_lt
  have hx_lt_inv_den :
      RealTheory.lt x (RealTheory.inv den) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_left
      F hscaled hden_pos
  change
    F.lt x
      (F.inv
        (F.sub F.one
          (F.mul F.one (F.sub x F.one))))
  unfold den u at hx_lt_inv_den
  rwa [F.one_mul]

name: power_one_eq_self
statement:
theorem power_one_eq_self
    (S : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    S.power RealTheory.one x = x
proof:
:= by
  exact
    S.power_eq_of_fixed_positive_spec
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one
      (fun z : Point => z)
      (by
        intro x y _hx _hy
        rfl)
      (by
        intro x hx1 _hxlt
        exact identity_power_one_fixed_local_lower hx1)
      (by
        intro x hx1 hxlt
        exact identity_power_one_fixed_local_upper hx1 hxlt)
      hx

name: completedPower_unique
statement:
theorem completedPower_unique
    (P Q : NaturalPowerThinSpec)
    {mu x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    P.completedPower mu x = Q.completedPower mu x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hmu_pos : PositiveDomain mu
  · rw [P.completedPower_of_pos hmu_pos,
      Q.completedPower_of_pos hmu_pos]
    exact PowerRatio.positive_arg_eq P Q hmu_pos hx
  · by_cases hmu_zero : mu = RealTheory.zero
    · rw [hmu_zero, P.completedPower_zero x,
        Q.completedPower_zero x]
    · have hmu_neg : F.lt mu F.zero := by
        cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hmu_zero with
        | inl hlt => exact hlt
        | inr hpos =>
            exact False.elim (hmu_pos hpos)
      have hneg_pos :
          PositiveDomain (RealTheory.neg mu) :=
        neg_pos_of_lt_zero hmu_neg
      rw [P.completedPower_of_neg hmu_neg,
        Q.completedPower_of_neg hmu_neg]
      exact congrArg RealTheory.inv
        (PowerRatio.positive_arg_eq P Q hneg_pos hx)

name: uniqueness
statement:
theorem uniqueness :
    NaturalPowerDerivedUniquenessStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q mu x hx
  rw [P.power_eq_completed, Q.power_eq_completed]
  exact NaturalPowerThinSpec.completedPower_unique
    P.thinSpec Q.thinSpec hx

name: one_value
statement:
theorem one_value (S : NaturalLogThinSpec) :
    S.log RealTheory.one = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := S.mul_law RealTheory.one RealTheory.one
    RealTheory.zero_lt_one RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  change
    S.log (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) =
      RealTheory.add (S.log RealTheory.one) (S.log RealTheory.one) at h
  rw [RealTheory.one_mul] at h
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.add (S.log RealTheory.one) (S.log RealTheory.one) =
        S.log RealTheory.one := h.symm
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_zero_of_add_eq_self_left F hsum

name: inv_eq_neg
statement:
theorem inv_eq_neg
    (S : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    S.log (RealTheory.inv x) =
      RealTheory.neg (S.log x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx hzero.symm
  have hinv_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx
  have h := S.mul_law x (RealTheory.inv x) hx hinv_pos
  change
    S.log (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv x)) =
      RealTheory.add (S.log x) (S.log (RealTheory.inv x)) at h
  rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hxne, S.one_value] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left F h.symm

name: pos_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem pos_of_one_lt
    (S : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (S.log x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.one) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.one hx
  have hsub_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx
  have hinv_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hxpos
  have hprod_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv x)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hsub_pos hinv_pos
  have hlog_lower := S.local_lower x hxpos hxne
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hprod_pos hlog_lower

name: neg_of_lt_one
statement:
theorem neg_of_lt_one
    (S : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : PositiveDomain x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.lt (S.log x) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.one) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hxlt
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.one hxlt
  have hupper := S.local_upper x hxpos hxne
  have hsub_neg :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) RealTheory.zero := by
    have h := RealTheory.add_lt_add_right hxlt (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one)
    change
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add x (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one))
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one)) at h
    rwa [<- RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg x RealTheory.one,
      RealTheory.add_neg] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hupper hsub_neg

name: lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem lt_of_lt
    (S : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (hy : PositiveDomain y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y) :
    RealTheory.lt (S.log x) (S.log y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let ratio := RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.inv x)
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx hzero.symm
  have hinv_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx
  have hratio_pos : PositiveDomain ratio := by
    unfold ratio
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos hy hinv_pos
  have hone_lt_ratio :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one ratio := by
    have h := RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hxy hinv_pos
    change
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv x))
        (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.inv x)) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hxne] at h
  have hlog_ratio_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (S.log ratio) :=
    S.pos_of_one_lt hone_lt_ratio
  have hratio_mul :
      RealTheory.mul ratio x = y := by
    unfold ratio
    calc
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.inv x)) x =
          RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x) x) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      _ = RealTheory.mul y RealTheory.one := by
            rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hxne]
      _ = y := by rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  have hlog_mul := S.mul_law ratio x hratio_pos hx
  change
    S.log (RealTheory.mul ratio x) =
      RealTheory.add (S.log ratio) (S.log x) at hlog_mul
  rw [hratio_mul] at hlog_mul
  have hlt_add :
      RealTheory.lt (S.log x)
        (RealTheory.add (S.log ratio) (S.log x)) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos
      F (x := S.log x) hlog_ratio_pos
    rwa [F.add_comm (S.log x) (S.log ratio)] at h
  rwa [<- hlog_mul] at hlt_add

name: injective_on_positive
statement:
theorem injective_on_positive (S : NaturalLogThinSpec) :
    forall x y : Point,
      PositiveDomain x -> PositiveDomain y ->
        S.log x = S.log y -> x = y
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hlog
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · exact hxy
  · cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hxy with
    | inl hlt =>
        have hltlog := S.lt_of_lt hx hy hlt
        rw [hlog] at hltlog
        exact False.elim
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (S.log y) hltlog)
    | inr hgt =>
        have hltlog := S.lt_of_lt hy hx hgt
        rw [hlog] at hltlog
        exact False.elim
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (S.log y) hltlog)

name: lowerSqueeze_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem lowerSqueeze_tendsto_one :
    TendstoWithin PositiveDomain LogLowerSqueezeFun
      RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hid :
      TendstoWithin PositiveDomain IdentityFun
        RealTheory.one RealTheory.one :=
    (continuousAtOn_identity RealTheory.zero_lt_one).right
  have hconst_one :
      TendstoWithin PositiveDomain
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.one RealTheory.one :=
    tendstoWithin_const PositiveDomain RealTheory.one RealTheory.one
  have hsub := tendstoWithin_sub hid hconst_one
  have hsub_lim :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one RealTheory.one =
        RealTheory.zero := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.one
  have hsub' := tendstoWithin_congr_limit hsub_lim hsub
  have hinv := tendstoWithin_inv hid RealTheory.one_ne_zero
  have hmul := tendstoWithin_mul hsub' hinv
  change
    TendstoWithin PositiveDomain
      (MulFun
        (SubFun IdentityFun (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one))
        (InvFun IdentityFun))
      RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one))
      at hmul
  have hlim :
      RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one) =
        RealTheory.zero := by
    rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  exact tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun _x _hx _hxne => rfl)
    (tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim hmul)

name: upperSqueeze_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem upperSqueeze_tendsto_one :
    TendstoWithin PositiveDomain LogUpperSqueezeFun
      RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hid :
      TendstoWithin PositiveDomain IdentityFun
        RealTheory.one RealTheory.one :=
    (continuousAtOn_identity RealTheory.zero_lt_one).right
  have hconst_one :
      TendstoWithin PositiveDomain
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.one RealTheory.one :=
    tendstoWithin_const PositiveDomain RealTheory.one RealTheory.one
  have hsub := tendstoWithin_sub hid hconst_one
  have hsub_lim :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one RealTheory.one =
        RealTheory.zero := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.one
  exact tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun _x _hx _hxne => rfl)
    (tendstoWithin_congr_limit hsub_lim hsub)

name: tendstoWithin_one
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_one (S : NaturalLogThinSpec) :
    TendstoWithin PositiveDomain S.log
      RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbounds :
      EventuallyWithin PositiveDomain RealTheory.one
        (fun x : Point =>
          And
            (RealTheory.le (LogLowerSqueezeFun x) (S.log x))
            (RealTheory.le (S.log x) (LogUpperSqueezeFun x))) := by
    refine Exists.intro RealTheory.one ?_
    refine And.intro RealTheory.zero_lt_one ?_
    intro x hx hxne _hdist
    have hlower := S.local_lower x hx hxne
    have hupper := S.local_upper x hx hxne
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlower)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hupper)
  have hlower :
      EventuallyWithin PositiveDomain RealTheory.one
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.le (LogLowerSqueezeFun x) (S.log x)) :=
    eventuallyWithin_mono (fun _x hx => hx.left) hbounds
  have hupper :
      EventuallyWithin PositiveDomain RealTheory.one
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.le (S.log x) (LogUpperSqueezeFun x)) :=
    eventuallyWithin_mono (fun _x hx => hx.right) hbounds
  exact tendstoWithin_of_squeeze
    lowerSqueeze_tendsto_one
    upperSqueeze_tendsto_one
    hlower hupper

name: ratioTo_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem ratioTo_tendsto_one
    (x0 : Point) (hx0 : PositiveDomain x0) :
    TendstoWithin PositiveDomain (RatioTo x0)
      x0 RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hx0ne : Not (x0 = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx0 hzero.symm
  have hid :
      TendstoWithin PositiveDomain IdentityFun x0 x0 :=
    (continuousAtOn_identity hx0).right
  have hconst :
      TendstoWithin PositiveDomain
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.inv x0)
        x0 (RealTheory.inv x0) :=
    tendstoWithin_const PositiveDomain (RealTheory.inv x0) x0
  have hmul := tendstoWithin_mul hid hconst
  change
    TendstoWithin PositiveDomain
      (MulFun IdentityFun (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.inv x0))
      x0 (RealTheory.mul x0 (RealTheory.inv x0)) at hmul
  have hlim :
      RealTheory.mul x0 (RealTheory.inv x0) =
        RealTheory.one :=
    RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hx0ne
  exact tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun _x _hx _hxne => rfl)
    (tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim hmul)

name: ratioTo_maps_positive
statement:
theorem ratioTo_maps_positive
    (x0 : Point) (hx0 : PositiveDomain x0) :
    forall x : Point,
      PositiveDomain x -> Not (x = x0) ->
        PositiveDomain (RatioTo x0 x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx _hne
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RatioTo
  exact RealTheory.mul_pos hx (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx0)

name: continuousAtOn
statement:
theorem continuousAtOn
    (S : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x0 : Point}
    (hx0 : PositiveDomain x0) :
    ContinuousAtOn PositiveDomain S.log x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hx0ne : Not (x0 = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx0 hzero.symm
  have hcont_one :
      ContinuousAtOn PositiveDomain S.log RealTheory.one :=
    And.intro RealTheory.zero_lt_one
      (tendstoWithin_congr_limit S.one_value.symm S.tendstoWithin_one)
  have hcomp :=
    tendstoWithin_comp_continuousAtOn
      (ratioTo_tendsto_one x0 hx0)
      hcont_one
      (ratioTo_maps_positive x0 hx0)
  have hcomp_zero :
      TendstoWithin PositiveDomain
        (CompFun S.log (RatioTo x0))
        x0 RealTheory.zero :=
    tendstoWithin_congr_limit S.one_value hcomp
  have hconst :
      TendstoWithin PositiveDomain
        (fun _ : Point => S.log x0) x0 (S.log x0) :=
    tendstoWithin_const PositiveDomain (S.log x0) x0
  have hsum := tendstoWithin_add hcomp_zero hconst
  have hlim :
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero (S.log x0) =
        S.log x0 :=
    RealTheory.zero_add (S.log x0)
  have hsum' := tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim hsum
  refine And.intro hx0 ?_
  apply tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun x hx _hxne => ?_)
    hsum'
  unfold AddFun CompFun RatioTo
  let ratio := RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv x0)
  have hratio_pos : PositiveDomain ratio := by
    unfold ratio
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos hx (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx0)
  have hratio_mul :
      RealTheory.mul ratio x0 = x := by
    unfold ratio
    calc
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv x0)) x0 =
          RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x0) x0) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      _ = RealTheory.mul x RealTheory.one := by
            rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hx0ne]
      _ = x := by rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  have hlog_mul := S.mul_law ratio x0 hratio_pos hx0
  change
    S.log (RealTheory.mul ratio x0) =
      RealTheory.add (S.log ratio) (S.log x0) at hlog_mul
  rw [hratio_mul] at hlog_mul
  exact hlog_mul.symm

name: continuousOn
statement:
theorem continuousOn (S : NaturalLogThinSpec) :
    ContinuousOn PositiveDomain S.log
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact S.continuousAtOn hx

name: one_value
statement:
theorem one_value
    (P Q : NaturalLogThinSpec) :
    LogDifference P Q RealTheory.one = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold LogDifference
  rw [P.one_value, Q.one_value]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.zero

name: add_law
statement:
theorem add_law
    (P Q : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (hy : PositiveDomain y) :
    LogDifference P Q (RealTheory.mul x y) =
      RealTheory.add (LogDifference P Q x)
        (LogDifference P Q y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold LogDifference
  rw [P.mul_law x y hx hy, Q.mul_law x y hx hy]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (P.log x) (P.log y) (Q.log x) (Q.log y)

name: inv_eq_neg
statement:
theorem inv_eq_neg
    (P Q : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    LogDifference P Q (RealTheory.inv x) =
      RealTheory.neg (LogDifference P Q x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold LogDifference
  rw [P.inv_eq_neg hx, Q.inv_eq_neg hx]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (P.log x) (Q.log x)

name: powNat_law
statement:
theorem powNat_law
    (P Q : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    forall n : Nat,
      LogDifference P Q (powNat x n) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
          (LogDifference P Q x)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [powNat_zero]
      rw [one_value]
      rw [RealTheory.nat_zero]
      exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.zero_mul (LogDifference P Q x))
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [powNat_succ]
      rw [add_law P Q (powNat_pos hx n) hx]
      rw [ih]
      have hnat :
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
              (LogDifference P Q x) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                (LogDifference P Q x))
              (LogDifference P Q x) := by
        rw [RealTheory.nat_succ]
        change
          RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat n) RealTheory.one)
              (LogDifference P Q x) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                (LogDifference P Q x))
              (LogDifference P Q x)
        rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
        rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
      exact Eq.symm hnat

name: root_law
statement:
theorem root_law
    (P Q : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (n : Nat) :
    LogDifference P Q x =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (LogDifference P Q (nthRoot (n + 1) x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxnonneg : NonnegativeDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx
  have hroot_pos :
      PositiveDomain (nthRoot (n + 1) x) :=
    nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos n hx
  have hpow :=
    powNat_law P Q hroot_pos (n + 1)
  rw [powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg n hxnonneg] at hpow
  exact hpow

name: local_upper_gap
statement:
theorem local_upper_gap
    (P Q : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.one)) :
    RealTheory.lt (LogDifference P Q x) (LocalGap x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hP :
      F.lt (P.log x) (F.sub x F.one) :=
    P.local_upper x hx hxne
  have hQ :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x))
        (Q.log x) :=
    Q.local_lower x hx hxne
  have hnegQ :
      F.lt (F.neg (Q.log x))
        (F.neg (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hQ
  have hleft :=
    F.add_lt_add_right hP (F.neg (Q.log x))
  have hright :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
      F hnegQ (F.sub x F.one)
  have h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hleft hright
  unfold LogDifference LocalGap
  change
    F.lt (F.sub (P.log x) (Q.log x))
      (F.sub (F.sub x F.one)
        (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x)))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (P.log x) (Q.log x)]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.sub x F.one)
    (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x))]
  exact h

name: local_lower_gap
statement:
theorem local_lower_gap
    (P Q : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.one)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.neg (LogDifference P Q x))
      (LocalGap x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := local_upper_gap Q P hx hxne
  unfold LogDifference at h
  unfold LogDifference
  have hrev :
      RealTheory.sub (Q.log x) (P.log x) =
        RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.sub (P.log x) (Q.log x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (P.log x) (Q.log x)
  rw [<- hrev]
  exact h

name: one_sub_inv_eq_sub_one_mul_inv
statement:
theorem one_sub_inv_eq_sub_one_mul_inv
    {x : Point}
    (hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  calc
    F.sub F.one (F.inv x) =
        F.sub (F.mul x (F.inv x))
          (F.mul F.one (F.inv x)) := by
        rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hxne, F.one_mul]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x) := by
        exact Eq.symm
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F
            x F.one (F.inv x))

name: localGap_eq_square_mul_inv
statement:
theorem localGap_eq_square_mul_inv
    {x : Point}
    (hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    LocalGap x =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))
        (RealTheory.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hfactor :
      F.sub F.one (F.inv x) =
        F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x) := by
    exact one_sub_inv_eq_sub_one_mul_inv hxne
  unfold LocalGap
  calc
    F.sub (F.sub x F.one)
        (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x)) =
        F.mul (F.sub x F.one)
          (F.sub F.one (F.inv x)) := by
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F]
        rw [F.mul_one]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.sub x F.one)
          (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x)) := by
        rw [hfactor]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (F.sub x F.one)
            (F.sub x F.one))
          (F.inv x) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: inv_le_one_of_one_le
statement:
theorem inv_le_one_of_one_le
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.inv x) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F F.zero_lt_one hx
  have h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
      F F.zero_lt_one hxpos hx
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at h

name: localGap_le_square_of_one_le
statement:
theorem localGap_le_square_of_one_le
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.le (LocalGap x)
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F F.zero_lt_one hx
  have hxne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxpos hzero.symm
  have hsub_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.sub x F.one) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hx
  have hsquare_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero
        (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.sub x F.one)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hsub_nonneg hsub_nonneg
  have hinv_le_one :
      F.le (F.inv x) F.one :=
    inv_le_one_of_one_le hx
  have hmul :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hinv_le_one hsquare_nonneg
  change
    F.le
      (F.mul
        (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.sub x F.one))
        (F.inv x))
      (F.mul
        (F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.sub x F.one))
        F.one) at hmul
  rw [F.mul_one] at hmul
  rwa [localGap_eq_square_mul_inv hxne]

name: sub_one_le_of_one_add_le
statement:
theorem sub_one_le_of_one_add_le
    {a x : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one a) x) :
    RealTheory.le a (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h' := F.add_le_add_right h (F.neg F.one)
  have hleft :
      F.add (F.add F.one a) (F.neg F.one) = a := by
    calc
      F.add (F.add F.one a) (F.neg F.one) =
          F.add a (F.add F.one (F.neg F.one)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm F.one a]
          rw [F.add_assoc a F.one (F.neg F.one)]
      _ = F.add a F.zero := by rw [F.add_neg]
      _ = a := by rw [F.add_zero]
  have hright :
      F.add x (F.neg F.one) = F.sub x F.one := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  change
    F.le (F.add (F.add F.one a) (F.neg F.one))
      (F.add x (F.neg F.one)) at h'
  rwa [hleft, hright] at h'

name: root_sub_one_nat_bound
statement:
theorem root_sub_one_nat_bound
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.sub (nthRoot (n + 1) x) RealTheory.one))
      (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let r := nthRoot (n + 1) x
  let h := F.sub r F.one
  have hxle : F.le F.one x := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx
  have hxnonneg : NonnegativeDomain x :=
    F.le_trans (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F F.zero_lt_one) hxle
  have hone_le_r : F.le F.one r :=
    one_le_nthRoot_succ_of_one_le hxle n
  have hh_nonneg : F.le F.zero h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hone_le_r
  have hbern :
      F.le (F.add F.one (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) h))
        (powNat (F.add F.one h) (n + 1)) :=
    one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add hh_nonneg (n + 1)
  have hone_add_h : F.add F.one h = r := by
    unfold h
    rw [F.add_comm F.one (F.sub r F.one)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F r F.one
  have hpow :
      powNat (F.add F.one h) (n + 1) = x := by
    rw [hone_add_h]
    exact powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg n hxnonneg
  have hle :
      F.le (F.add F.one (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) h)) x := by
    rwa [hpow] at hbern
  change
    F.le
      (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1))
        (F.sub (nthRoot (n + 1) x) F.one))
      (F.sub x F.one)
  exact sub_one_le_of_one_add_le hle

name: one_lt_arg_not_pos_difference
statement:
theorem one_lt_arg_not_pos_difference
    (P Q : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    Not (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (LogDifference P Q x))
proof:
:= by
  intro hdiff_pos
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := LogDifference P Q x
  let xm := F.sub x F.one
  have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F F.zero_lt_one hx
  have hxm_pos : F.lt F.zero xm := by
    unfold xm
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx
  have hxm_ne : Not (xm = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxm_pos hzero.symm
  let eta := F.mul d (F.inv xm)
  have heta_pos : F.lt F.zero eta := by
    unfold eta d
    exact F.mul_pos hdiff_pos
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hxm_pos)
  have hxle : F.le F.one x := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx
  cases exists_nthRoot_succ_lt_one_add_of_one_le hxle heta_pos with
  | intro n hroot_lt =>
      let r := nthRoot (n + 1) x
      let h := F.sub r F.one
      have hr_gt_one : F.lt F.one r :=
        one_lt_nthRoot_succ_of_one_lt hx n
      have hrpos : F.lt F.zero r :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F F.zero_lt_one hr_gt_one
      have hrne_one : Not (r = F.one) := by
        intro hr_eq
        rw [hr_eq] at hr_gt_one
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F F.one hr_gt_one
      have hh_nonneg : F.le F.zero h := by
        unfold h
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hr_gt_one)
      have hdr_gap :
          F.lt (LogDifference P Q r) (LocalGap r) :=
        local_upper_gap P Q hrpos hrne_one
      have hgap_square :
          F.le (LocalGap r) (F.mul h h) := by
        unfold h
        exact localGap_le_square_of_one_le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hr_gt_one)
      have hdr_square :
          F.lt (LogDifference P Q r) (F.mul h h) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
          hdr_gap hgap_square
      have hNpos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (n + 1)) :=
        F.nat_succ_pos n
      have hmul_strict :
          F.lt
            (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1))
              (LogDifference P Q r))
            (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) (F.mul h h)) :=
        F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hdr_square hNpos
      have hrootLaw :
          LogDifference P Q x =
            F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) (LogDifference P Q r) := by
        unfold r
        exact root_law P Q hxpos n
      rw [<- hrootLaw] at hmul_strict
      have hN_h_bound :
          F.le (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) h) xm := by
        unfold h xm r
        exact root_sub_one_nat_bound hx n
      have hnat_square_le :
          F.le
            (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) (F.mul h h))
            (F.mul xm h) := by
        have hmul :=
          F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hN_h_bound hh_nonneg
        change
          F.le
            (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) h) h)
            (F.mul xm h) at hmul
        have hassoc :
            F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) (F.mul h h) =
              F.mul (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) h) h := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
        rwa [hassoc]
      have hh_lt_eta : F.lt h eta := by
        unfold h r eta
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hroot_lt
      have hxm_h_lt_eta :
          F.lt (F.mul xm h) (F.mul xm eta) :=
        F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hh_lt_eta hxm_pos
      have hxm_eta_eq_d :
          F.mul xm eta = d := by
        unfold eta
        calc
          F.mul xm (F.mul d (F.inv xm)) =
              F.mul d (F.mul xm (F.inv xm)) := by
              calc
                F.mul xm (F.mul d (F.inv xm)) =
                    F.mul (F.mul xm d) (F.inv xm) := by
                    rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
                _ =
                    F.mul (F.mul d xm) (F.inv xm) := by
                    rw [F.mul_comm xm d]
                _ =
                    F.mul d (F.mul xm (F.inv xm)) := by
                    rw [F.mul_assoc]
          _ = F.mul d F.one := by
              rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hxm_ne]
          _ = d := by rw [F.mul_one]
      have hlt_to_xmh :
          F.lt d (F.mul xm h) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
          hmul_strict hnat_square_le
      have hxm_h_lt_d : F.lt (F.mul xm h) d := by
        rwa [hxm_eta_eq_d] at hxm_h_lt_eta
      have hbad : F.lt d d :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hlt_to_xmh hxm_h_lt_d
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F d hbad

name: one_lt_arg_le_zero
statement:
theorem one_lt_arg_le_zero
    (P Q : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.le (LogDifference P Q x) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (one_lt_arg_not_pos_difference P Q hx)

name: one_lt_arg_eq_zero
statement:
theorem one_lt_arg_eq_zero
    (P Q : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    LogDifference P Q x = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hle : F.le (LogDifference P Q x) F.zero :=
    one_lt_arg_le_zero P Q hx
  have hle_swap : F.le (LogDifference Q P x) F.zero :=
    one_lt_arg_le_zero Q P hx
  have hrev :
      LogDifference Q P x =
        F.neg (LogDifference P Q x) := by
    unfold LogDifference
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
      F (P.log x) (Q.log x)
  rw [hrev] at hle_swap
  have hnonneg :
      F.le F.zero (LogDifference P Q x) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hle_swap
    change F.le (F.neg F.zero)
      (F.neg (F.neg (LogDifference P Q x))) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F,
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F] at h
  exact F.le_antisymm hle hnonneg

name: one_lt_inv_of_pos_lt_one
statement:
theorem one_lt_inv_of_pos_lt_one
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : PositiveDomain x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
      F hxpos F.zero_lt_one hxlt
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at h

name: positive_arg_eq_zero
statement:
theorem positive_arg_eq_zero
    (P Q : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    LogDifference P Q x = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxone : x = F.one
  · rw [hxone]
    exact one_value P Q
  · cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hxone with
    | inl hxlt =>
        have hinv_gt :
            F.lt F.one (F.inv x) :=
          one_lt_inv_of_pos_lt_one hx hxlt
        have hInvZero :
            LogDifference P Q (F.inv x) = F.zero :=
          one_lt_arg_eq_zero P Q hinv_gt
        have hinvDiff :
            LogDifference P Q (F.inv x) =
              F.neg (LogDifference P Q x) :=
          inv_eq_neg P Q hx
        rw [hinvDiff] at hInvZero
        have h := congrArg (fun z : Point => F.neg z) hInvZero
        change
          F.neg (F.neg (LogDifference P Q x)) =
            F.neg F.zero at h
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F,
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
    | inr hxgt =>
        exact one_lt_arg_eq_zero P Q hxgt

name: positive_arg_eq
statement:
theorem positive_arg_eq
    (P Q : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    P.log x = Q.log x
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := positive_arg_eq_zero P Q hx
  unfold LogDifference at hzero
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hzero

name: uniqueness
statement:
theorem uniqueness :
    NaturalLogUniquenessStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q x hx
  exact positive_arg_eq
    { log := P.log
      mul_law := P.mul_law
      local_lower := P.local_lower
      local_upper := P.local_upper }
    { log := Q.log
      mul_law := Q.mul_law
      local_lower := Q.local_lower
      local_upper := Q.local_upper }
    hx

name: midpoint_add_self_eq_add
statement:
theorem midpoint_add_self_eq_add (x y : Point) :
    let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x y
    F.add m m = F.add x y := by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.sub y x)
  let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x y
  change F.add m m = F.add x y
  have hm : m = F.add x h := by
    unfold m h
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
    rfl
  rw [hm]
  calc
    F.add (F.add x h) (F.add x h) =
        F.add x (F.add h (F.add x h)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add x (F.add x (F.add h h)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm h (F.add x h)]
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add x (F.add x (F.sub y x)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F (F.sub y x)]
    _ = F.add x (F.add (F.sub y x) x) := by
          rw [F.add_comm x (F.sub y x)]
    _ = F.add x y := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y x]

name: midpoint_square_sub_mul_eq_half_square
statement:
theorem midpoint_square_sub_mul_eq_half_square (x y : Point) :
    let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (RealTheory.sub y x)
    let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x y
    F.sub (F.mul m m) (F.mul x y) = F.mul h h := by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (RealTheory.sub y x)
  let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x y
  change F.sub (F.mul m m) (F.mul x y) = F.mul h h
  have hm : m = F.add x h := by
    unfold m h
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
    rfl
  have hy : y = F.add x (F.add h h) := by
    unfold h
    apply Eq.symm
    calc
      F.add x
          (F.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.sub y x))
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.sub y x))) =
          F.add x (F.sub y x) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F (F.sub y x)]
      _ = F.add (F.sub y x) x := by
            rw [F.add_comm]
      _ = y := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y x
  rw [hm, hy]
  calc
