    F.sub (F.mul (F.add x h) (F.add x h))
        (F.mul x (F.add x (F.add h h))) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (F.sub (F.add x h) x) (F.add x h))
          (F.mul x
            (F.sub (F.add x h) (F.add x (F.add h h)))) := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub
            F (F.add x h) (F.add x h) x (F.add x (F.add h h))
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul h (F.add x h))
          (F.mul x (F.neg h)) := by
          have hsub_left :
              F.sub (F.add x h) x = h := by
            rw [F.add_comm x h]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F h x
          rw [hsub_left]
          have hsub :
              F.sub (F.add x h) (F.add x (F.add h h)) = F.neg h := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F x h x (F.add h h)]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F x]
            rw [F.zero_add]
            rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F h h]
            calc
              F.add h (F.add (F.neg h) (F.neg h)) =
                  F.add (F.add h (F.neg h)) (F.neg h) := by
                    rw [<- F.add_assoc]
              _ = F.add F.zero (F.neg h) := by rw [F.add_neg]
              _ = F.neg h := by rw [F.zero_add]
          rw [hsub]
    _ =
        F.add (F.add (F.mul h x) (F.mul h h))
          (F.neg (F.mul x h)) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F]
    _ = F.add (F.mul h h)
          (F.add (F.mul h x) (F.neg (F.mul x h))) := by
          rw [F.add_comm (F.mul h x) (F.mul h h)]
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.mul h h := by
          rw [F.mul_comm h x]
          rw [F.add_neg]
          rw [F.add_zero]

name: mul_le_midpoint_square
statement:
theorem mul_le_midpoint_square (x y : Point) :
    let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x y
    F.le (F.mul x y) (F.mul m m) := by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.sub y x)
  let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x y
  change F.le (F.mul x y) (F.mul m m)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_sub_nonneg F
  rw [midpoint_square_sub_mul_eq_half_square x y]
  exact square_nonneg h

name: midpoint_nonnegative_of_nonnegative
statement:
theorem midpoint_nonnegative_of_nonnegative
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : NonnegativeDomain x)
    (hy : NonnegativeDomain y) :
    NonnegativeDomain
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y)
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    convexCombo_mono_endpoints
      midpointWeight_convexWeight hx hy
  rw [convexCombo_self MidpointWeight RealTheory.zero] at h
  rw [convexCombo_midpointWeight_eq_midpoint x y] at h
  exact h

name: geometricMean_le_midpoint
statement:
theorem geometricMean_le_midpoint
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : NonnegativeDomain x)
    (hy : NonnegativeDomain y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (nthRoot 2 (RealTheory.mul x y))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x y
  have hxy_nonneg : NonnegativeDomain (RealTheory.mul x y) :=
    RealTheory.mul_nonneg hx hy
  have hm_nonneg : NonnegativeDomain m :=
    midpoint_nonnegative_of_nonnegative hx hy
  have hbound : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul x y) (powNat m (1 + 1)) := by
    rw [show (1 + 1 : Nat) = 2 by rfl]
    rw [powNat_two]
    exact mul_le_midpoint_square x y
  have hroot :=
    nthRoot_succ_le_of_powNat_bound
      (n := 1) hxy_nonneg hm_nonneg hbound
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (nthRoot 2 (RealTheory.mul x y))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y) at hroot
  exact hroot

name: convexSet_universal
statement: theorem convexSet_universal : ConvexSet UniversalDomain
proof:
:= by
  intro _theta _x _y _htheta _hx _hy
  exact True.intro

name: convexSet_positiveDomain
statement: theorem convexSet_positiveDomain : ConvexSet PositiveDomain
proof:
:= by
  intro theta x y htheta hx hy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      have hbetween := convexCombo_between_of_le htheta hxy
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hx hbetween.left
  | inr hyx =>
      have hbetween :=
        convexCombo_between_of_le
          (convexWeight_one_sub htheta) hyx
      have hleft :
          RealTheory.le y (ConvexCombo theta x y) := by
        rw [convexCombo_symm theta x y]
        exact hbetween.left
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hy hleft

name: le_of_le
statement:
theorem le_of_le
    (S : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    {x y : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    RealTheory.le (S.exp x) (S.exp y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hEq : x = y
  · rw [hEq]
    exact F.le_refl (S.exp y)
  · have hlt : RealTheory.lt x y := by
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy
      intro hyx
      exact hEq (F.le_antisymm hxy hyx)
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (S.lt_of_lt hlt)

name: exp_midpoint_eq_geometricMean
statement:
theorem exp_midpoint_eq_geometricMean
    (S : NaturalExpThinSpec)
    (x y : Point) :
    S.exp
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y) =
      nthRoot 2
        (RealTheory.mul (S.exp x) (S.exp y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x y
  have hm_nonneg : NonnegativeDomain (S.exp m) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (S.pos m)
  have hsquare :
      RealTheory.mul (S.exp m) (S.exp m) =
        RealTheory.mul (S.exp x) (S.exp y) := by
    have hmid := S.add_law m m
    change
      S.exp (F.add m m) =
        F.mul (S.exp m) (S.exp m) at hmid
    rw [midpoint_add_self_eq_add x y] at hmid
    have hxy := S.add_law x y
    change
      S.exp (F.add x y) =
        F.mul (S.exp x) (S.exp y) at hxy
    rw [hxy] at hmid
    exact hmid.symm
  have hroot :
      NthRootRelation (1 + 1)
        (RealTheory.mul (S.exp x) (S.exp y)) (S.exp m) := by
    refine And.intro hm_nonneg ?_
    rw [show (1 + 1 : Nat) = 2 by rfl]
    rw [powNat_two]
    exact hsquare
  have h :=
    nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ (n := 1) hroot
  change
    nthRoot 2 (RealTheory.mul (S.exp x) (S.exp y)) =
      S.exp
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y) at h
  exact h.symm

name: midpointConvexOn
statement:
theorem midpointConvexOn (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) :
    MidpointConvexOn UniversalDomain S.exp
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro convexSet_universal ?_
  intro x y _hx _hy
  rw [convexCombo_midpointWeight_eq_midpoint x y]
  rw [convexCombo_midpointWeight_eq_midpoint (S.exp x) (S.exp y)]
  rw [S.exp_midpoint_eq_geometricMean x y]
  exact geometricMean_le_midpoint
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (S.pos x))
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (S.pos y))

name: log_geometricMean_eq_midpoint
statement:
theorem log_geometricMean_eq_midpoint
    (S : NaturalLogThinSpec)
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (hy : PositiveDomain y) :
    S.log (nthRoot 2 (RealTheory.mul x y)) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (S.log x) (S.log y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let r := nthRoot 2 (RealTheory.mul x y)
  let m :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F (S.log x) (S.log y)
  have hxy_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.mul x y) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hx hy
  have hxy_nonneg : NonnegativeDomain (RealTheory.mul x y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxy_pos
  have hr_pos : PositiveDomain r := by
    have h := nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos (n := 1) hxy_pos
    change PositiveDomain (nthRoot 2 (RealTheory.mul x y)) at h
    exact h
  have hrr :
      RealTheory.mul r r = RealTheory.mul x y := by
    have hpow :=
      powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg
        (n := 1) hxy_nonneg
    change powNat r 2 = RealTheory.mul x y at hpow
    rwa [powNat_two] at hpow
  have hlog_rr := S.mul_law r r hr_pos hr_pos
  change
    S.log (RealTheory.mul r r) =
      RealTheory.add (S.log r) (S.log r) at hlog_rr
  rw [hrr] at hlog_rr
  have hlog_xy := S.mul_law x y hx hy
  change
    S.log (RealTheory.mul x y) =
      RealTheory.add (S.log x) (S.log y) at hlog_xy
  rw [hlog_xy] at hlog_rr
  have hmid_double :
      RealTheory.add m m =
        RealTheory.add (S.log x) (S.log y) := by
    unfold m
    exact midpoint_add_self_eq_add (S.log x) (S.log y)
  have hdouble :
      RealTheory.add (S.log r) (S.log r) =
        RealTheory.add m m := by
    rw [<- hlog_rr]
    exact hmid_double.symm
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_self_cancel F hdouble

name: midpointConcaveOn
statement:
theorem midpointConcaveOn (S : NaturalLogThinSpec) :
    MidpointConcaveOn PositiveDomain S.log
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro convexSet_positiveDomain ?_
  intro x y hx hy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let domainMid := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x y
  let valueMid := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F (S.log x) (S.log y)
  have hdomain_mid_pos : PositiveDomain domainMid := by
    have h :=
      convexSet_positiveDomain
        MidpointWeight x y midpointWeight_convexWeight hx hy
    rw [convexCombo_midpointWeight_eq_midpoint x y] at h
    exact h
  have hroot_pos :
      PositiveDomain (nthRoot 2 (RealTheory.mul x y)) := by
    have hxy_pos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.mul x y) :=
      RealTheory.mul_pos hx hy
    have h := nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos (n := 1) hxy_pos
    change PositiveDomain (nthRoot 2 (RealTheory.mul x y)) at h
    exact h
  have hgeom :
      RealTheory.le
        (nthRoot 2 (RealTheory.mul x y)) domainMid := by
    unfold domainMid
    exact geometricMean_le_midpoint
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy)
  have hlog :
      RealTheory.le valueMid (S.log domainMid) := by
    have hmono := S.le_of_le hroot_pos hdomain_mid_pos hgeom
    unfold valueMid
    rw [<- S.log_geometricMean_eq_midpoint hx hy]
    exact hmono
  have hneg := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hlog
  change
    F.le
      (F.neg (S.log domainMid))
      (F.neg valueMid) at hneg
  unfold domainMid valueMid at hneg
  rw [<- convexCombo_midpointWeight_eq_midpoint x y] at hneg
  rw [<- convexCombo_midpointWeight_eq_midpoint (S.log x) (S.log y)] at hneg
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (NegFun S.log (ConvexCombo MidpointWeight x y))
      (RealTheory.neg
        (ConvexCombo MidpointWeight (S.log x) (S.log y))) at hneg
  rw [<- convexCombo_neg MidpointWeight (S.log x) (S.log y)] at hneg
  exact hneg

:=

    S.continuousOn S.midpointConcaveOn

name: RationalExtensionThinData.log_pos_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem RationalExtensionThinData.log_pos_of_one_lt
    (D : RationalExtensionThinData)
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (D.log x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.one) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.one hx
  have hxne0 : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxpos hzero.symm
  have hsub_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx
  have hinv_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hxpos
  have hprod_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv x)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hsub_pos hinv_pos
  have hlog_lower := D.logThinSpec.local_lower x hxpos hxne
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hprod_pos hlog_lower

proof:
:= by

name: inv_lt_of_inv_lt_pos
statement:
theorem inv_lt_of_inv_lt_pos
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hy : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.inv x) y) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.inv y) x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hx_ne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx hzero.symm
  have hinvx_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx
  have h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
      F hinvx_pos hy hxy
  change F.lt (F.inv y) (F.inv (F.inv x)) at h
  have hinv_inv : F.inv (F.inv x) = x := by
    change RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv x) = x
    exact inv_inv_of_ne_zero hx_ne
  change F.lt (F.inv y) x
  rwa [hinv_inv] at h

name: ExpCoreLaws.exists_exp_gt
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.exists_exp_gt
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (x : Point) :
    Exists (fun b : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
        (RealTheory.lt x (exp b)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_gt x with
  | intro n hxn =>
      let b := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
      have hn_le_succ :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat n) b := by
        unfold b
        exact RealTheory.nat_le_nat_succ n
      have hxb : RealTheory.lt x b :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxn hn_le_succ
      have hbpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b := by
        unfold b
        exact RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
      have hb_lt_one_add :
          RealTheory.lt b (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one b) := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
          F RealTheory.zero_lt_one b
        change
          F.lt (F.add b F.zero) (F.add b F.one) at h
        rw [F.add_zero] at h
        rwa [F.add_comm b F.one] at h
      have hone_add_lt_exp :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one b) (exp b) :=
        naturalExp_global_lower_of_local
          H.zero H.add H.local_lower hbpos
      refine Exists.intro b ?_
      exact And.intro hbpos
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hxb
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
            hb_lt_one_add hone_add_lt_exp))

name: ExpCoreLaws.exists_exp_lt_positive
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.exists_exp_lt_positive
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    Exists (fun a : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.lt a RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.lt (exp a) x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hx_ne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx hzero.symm
  have hinvx_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx
  cases H.exists_exp_gt (RealTheory.inv x) with
  | intro b hb =>
      let a := RealTheory.neg b
      have ha_neg : RealTheory.lt a RealTheory.zero := by
        unfold a
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hb.left
        change F.lt (F.neg b) (F.neg F.zero) at h
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
      have hexpb_pos : PositiveDomain (exp b) :=
        H.exp_pos b
      have hinv_lt_x :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.inv (exp b)) x :=
        inv_lt_of_inv_lt_pos hx hexpb_pos hb.right
      refine Exists.intro a ?_
      refine And.intro ha_neg ?_
      unfold a
      rwa [H.exp_neg_eq_inv b]

name: ExpCoreLaws.surjective_positive
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.surjective_positive
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn UniversalDomain exp) :
    forall x : Point,
      PositiveDomain x ->
        Exists (fun y : Point => exp y = x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases H.exists_exp_lt_positive hx with
  | intro a ha =>
      cases H.exists_exp_gt x with
      | intro b hb =>
          have hle_ab : RealTheory.le a b := by
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_trans F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F ha.left)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hb.left)
          have hcont_interval :
              ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) exp :=
            continuousOn_subset
              (fun z _hz => trivial) hcont
          have hbetween :
              RealTheory.Between (exp a) x (exp b) := by
            unfold RealTheory.Between IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Between
            exact And.intro
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F ha.right)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hb.right)
          cases intermediate_value_closedInterval
              hle_ab hcont_interval hbetween with
          | intro c hc =>
              exact Exists.intro c hc.right

name: ExpCoreLaws.surjective_positive_of_core
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.surjective_positive_of_core
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp) :
    forall x : Point,
      PositiveDomain x ->
        Exists (fun y : Point => exp y = x)
proof:
:=
  H.surjective_positive
    (H.continuousOn_of_zero H.tendstoWithin_zero)

name: ExpCoreLaws.nthRoot_exp_div
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.nthRoot_exp_div
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (n : Nat) (y : Point) :
    nthRoot (n + 1) (exp y) =
      exp
        (RealTheory.mul y
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  apply nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
  exact And.intro
    (show
      NonnegativeDomain
        (exp
          (RealTheory.mul y
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))) from
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (H.exp_pos
          (RealTheory.mul y
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))))
    (show
      powNat
          (exp
            (RealTheory.mul y
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))))
          (n + 1) =
        exp y from
      naturalExp_powNat_div_eq_of_add_law
        (exp := exp) H.zero H.add
        (x := y) (n := n + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero n))

name: ExpCoreLaws.logSequence_exp_eq_linearization
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.logSequence_exp_eq_linearization
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (y : Point) :
    LogSequence (exp y) =
      ExpLogLinearizationSequence exp y
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  unfold LogSequence ExpLogLinearizationSequence invNatSucc
  rw [H.nthRoot_exp_div n y]
  change
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (exp
            (RealTheory.mul y
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))))
          RealTheory.one) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (exp
            (RealTheory.mul y
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))))
          RealTheory.one)
  rfl

name: inv_sub_one_sub_one_eq_mul
statement:
theorem inv_sub_one_sub_one_eq_mul
    {t : Point}
    (hden_ne :
      Not (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one t = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one t))
        RealTheory.one =
      RealTheory.mul t
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one t))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := F.sub F.one t
  change F.sub (F.inv d) F.one =
    F.mul t (F.inv d)
  have hd_ne : Not (d = F.zero) := by
    unfold d
    exact hden_ne
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_right_cancel F
    (a := F.one)
  have ht_eq : t = F.sub F.one d := by
    unfold d
    exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F F.one t)
  calc
    F.add (F.sub (F.inv d) F.one) F.one =
        F.inv d := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F
            (F.inv d) F.one
    _ = F.mul F.one (F.inv d) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one d) (F.inv d)) F.one := by
          calc
            F.mul F.one (F.inv d) =
                F.mul (F.add (F.sub F.one d) d) (F.inv d) := by
                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F F.one d]
            _ =
                F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one d) (F.inv d))
                  (F.mul d (F.inv d)) := by
                  rw [F.add_mul]
            _ =
                F.add (F.mul (F.sub F.one d) (F.inv d)) F.one := by
                  rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hd_ne]
    _ = F.add (F.mul t (F.inv d)) F.one := by
          rw [ht_eq]

name: natSucc_mul_sub_inv_one_sub_eq
statement:
theorem natSucc_mul_sub_inv_one_sub_eq
    (y : Point) (n : Nat)
    (hden_ne :
      Not
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul y (invNatSucc n)) =
            RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
              (RealTheory.mul y (invNatSucc n))))
          RealTheory.one) =
      RealTheory.mul y
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul y (invNatSucc n))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let t := RealTheory.mul y (invNatSucc n)
  let d := RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one t
  have hsub :
      RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.inv d) RealTheory.one =
        RealTheory.mul t (RealTheory.inv d) := by
    unfold d
    exact inv_sub_one_sub_one_eq_mul hden_ne
  change F.sub (F.inv d) F.one =
    F.mul t (F.inv d) at hsub
  change
    F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (F.sub (F.inv d) F.one) =
      F.mul y (F.inv d)
  rw [hsub]
  unfold t
  calc
    F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (F.mul (F.mul y (invNatSucc n)) (F.inv d)) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (F.mul y (invNatSucc n)))
          (F.inv d) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul y (F.inv d) := by
          have hcancel := natSucc_mul_mul_invNatSucc y n
          change
            F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
                (F.mul y (invNatSucc n)) =
              y at hcancel
          rw [hcancel]

name: ExpCoreLaws.exp_lt_inv_one_sub_of_neg
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.exp_lt_inv_one_sub_of_neg
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    {t : Point}
    (htneg : RealTheory.lt t RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.lt (exp t)
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one t))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := RealTheory.neg t
  have hspos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero s := by
    unfold s
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F htneg
    change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg t) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
  have hglobal :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one s) (exp s) :=
    naturalExp_global_lower_of_local
      H.zero H.add H.local_lower hspos
  have hleft_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one s) := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hspos)
  have hexps_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (exp s) :=
    H.exp_pos s
  have hinv :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.inv (exp s))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one s)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
      F hleft_pos hexps_pos hglobal
  have ht_eq_neg_s : t = RealTheory.neg s := by
    unfold s
    exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.neg_neg t)
  have hden_eq :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one t =
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.one s := by
    unfold s
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hden_eq_neg :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.neg s) =
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.one s := by
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [RealTheory.neg_neg]
  rw [ht_eq_neg_s, H.exp_neg_eq_inv s]
  rwa [hden_eq_neg]

name: scaled_inv_one_sub_tendsto
statement:
private theorem scaled_inv_one_sub_tendsto
    (y : Point) {t : Nat -> Point}
    (ht_zero : RealTheory.SeqTendsto t RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul y
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (t n))))
      y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (t n)))
        RealTheory.one :=
    inv_one_sub_scaled_tendsto_one ht_zero
  have hmul :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul
      (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const y) hinv
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto _ (F.mul y F.one) at hmul
  rwa [F.mul_one] at hmul

name: ExpCoreLaws.expLogLinearization_tendsto_of_pos
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.expLogLinearization_tendsto_of_pos
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    {y : Point}
    (hypos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (ExpLogLinearizationSequence exp y) y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let t : Nat -> Point :=
    fun n : Nat => RealTheory.mul y (invNatSucc n)
  have ht_zero :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto t RealTheory.zero := by
    unfold t
    exact seqTendsto_scaled_invNatSucc_zero y
  have ht_nonneg :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (t n)) := by
    apply Eventually.of_forall
    intro n
    unfold t invNatSucc
    exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hypos)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
          (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)))
  have ht_lt_one :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.lt (t n) RealTheory.one) :=
    scaled_lt_one_eventually_of_tendsto_zero_nonneg
      ht_zero ht_nonneg
  have hupper_tendsto :=
    scaled_inv_one_sub_tendsto y ht_zero
  apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_squeeze
    (u := fun _ : Nat => y)
    (w :=
      fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul y
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (t n))))
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const y)
    hupper_tendsto
  · apply Eventually.mono ?_ ht_lt_one
    intro n htlt
    unfold ExpLogLinearizationSequence
    have htpos : F.lt F.zero (F.mul y (invNatSucc n)) := by
      unfold invNatSucc
      exact RealTheory.mul_pos hypos
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
          (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n))
    have hlower := H.local_lower
      (F.mul y (invNatSucc n)) htpos htlt
    have hsub :
        F.lt (F.mul y (invNatSucc n))
          (F.sub (exp (F.mul y (invNatSucc n))) F.one) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_sub_of_add_lt F hlower
    have hscaled :=
      F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hsub
        (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)
    change
      F.lt
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.mul y (invNatSucc n)))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.sub (exp (F.mul y (invNatSucc n))) F.one)) at hscaled
    have hcancel := natSucc_mul_mul_invNatSucc y n
    change
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.mul y (invNatSucc n)) =
        y at hcancel
    rw [hcancel] at hscaled
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hscaled
  · apply Eventually.mono ?_ ht_lt_one
    intro n htlt
    unfold ExpLogLinearizationSequence
    let tn := F.mul y (invNatSucc n)
    let den := F.sub F.one tn
    have htpos : F.lt F.zero tn := by
      unfold tn invNatSucc
      exact RealTheory.mul_pos hypos
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
          (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n))
    have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero den := by
      unfold den
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F htlt
    have hden_ne : Not (den = F.zero) := by
      intro hzero
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos hzero.symm
    have hupper := H.local_upper
      tn htpos htlt
    have hsub :
        F.lt (F.sub (exp tn) F.one)
          (F.sub (F.inv den) F.one) := by
      have h := F.add_lt_add_right hupper (F.neg F.one)
      change
        F.lt (F.add (exp tn) (F.neg F.one))
          (F.add (F.inv den) (F.neg F.one)) at h
      rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg (exp tn) F.one,
        <- F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.inv den) F.one] at h
    have hscaled :=
      F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hsub
        (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)
    change
      F.lt
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.sub (exp tn) F.one))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.sub (F.inv den) F.one)) at hscaled
    have hright :
        F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.sub (F.inv den) F.one) =
        F.mul y (F.inv den) := by
      unfold den tn
      exact natSucc_mul_sub_inv_one_sub_eq y n hden_ne
    rw [hright] at hscaled
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hscaled

name: ExpCoreLaws.expLogLinearization_tendsto_of_neg
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.expLogLinearization_tendsto_of_neg
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    {y : Point}
    (hyneg : RealTheory.lt y RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (ExpLogLinearizationSequence exp y) y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let t : Nat -> Point :=
    fun n : Nat => RealTheory.mul y (invNatSucc n)
  have ht_zero :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto t RealTheory.zero := by
    unfold t
    exact seqTendsto_scaled_invNatSucc_zero y
  have hupper_tendsto :=
    scaled_inv_one_sub_tendsto y ht_zero
  apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_squeeze
    (u := fun _ : Nat => y)
    (w :=
      fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul y
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (t n))))
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const y)
    hupper_tendsto
  · refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
    intro n _hn
    unfold ExpLogLinearizationSequence
    have htneg : F.lt (F.mul y (invNatSucc n)) F.zero := by
      unfold invNatSucc
      have hinvpos :
          F.lt F.zero
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
          (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)
      have hmul := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right
        F hyneg hinvpos
      change
        F.lt
          (F.mul y (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))
          (F.mul F.zero
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))) at hmul
      rwa [F.zero_mul] at hmul
    have htne : Not (F.mul y (invNatSucc n) = F.zero) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F htneg
    have hlower := H.one_add_lt_exp_of_ne_zero htne
    change
      F.lt (F.add F.one (F.mul y (invNatSucc n)))
        (exp (F.mul y (invNatSucc n))) at hlower
    have hsub :
        F.lt (F.mul y (invNatSucc n))
          (F.sub (exp (F.mul y (invNatSucc n))) F.one) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_sub_of_add_lt F hlower
    have hscaled :=
      F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hsub
        (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)
    change
      F.lt
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.mul y (invNatSucc n)))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.sub (exp (F.mul y (invNatSucc n))) F.one)) at hscaled
    have hcancel := natSucc_mul_mul_invNatSucc y n
    change
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.mul y (invNatSucc n)) =
        y at hcancel
    rw [hcancel] at hscaled
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hscaled
  · refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
    intro n _hn
    unfold ExpLogLinearizationSequence
    let tn := F.mul y (invNatSucc n)
    let den := F.sub F.one tn
    have htneg : F.lt tn F.zero := by
      unfold tn invNatSucc
      have hinvpos :
          F.lt F.zero
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
          (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)
      have hmul := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right
        F hyneg hinvpos
      change
        F.lt
          (F.mul y (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))
          (F.mul F.zero
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))) at hmul
      rwa [F.zero_mul] at hmul
    have htlt_one : F.lt tn F.one :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F htneg RealTheory.zero_lt_one
    have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero den := by
      unfold den
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F htlt_one
    have hden_ne : Not (den = F.zero) := by
      intro hzero
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos hzero.symm
    have hupper := H.exp_lt_inv_one_sub_of_neg htneg
    change F.lt (exp tn) (F.inv den) at hupper
    have hsub :
        F.lt (F.sub (exp tn) F.one)
          (F.sub (F.inv den) F.one) := by
      have h := F.add_lt_add_right hupper (F.neg F.one)
      change
        F.lt (F.add (exp tn) (F.neg F.one))
          (F.add (F.inv den) (F.neg F.one)) at h
      rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg (exp tn) F.one,
        <- F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.inv den) F.one] at h
    have hscaled :=
      F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hsub
        (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)
    change
      F.lt
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.sub (exp tn) F.one))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.sub (F.inv den) F.one)) at hscaled
    have hright :
        F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.sub (F.inv den) F.one) =
        F.mul y (F.inv den) := by
      unfold den tn
      exact natSucc_mul_sub_inv_one_sub_eq y n hden_ne
    rw [hright] at hscaled
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hscaled

name: ExpCoreLaws.logSequence_exp_tendsto_of_pos
proof:
:= by

name: ExpCoreLaws.logSequence_exp_tendsto_of_neg
proof:

name: ExpCoreLaws.logSequence_exp_tendsto
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.logSequence_exp_tendsto
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (y : Point) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto (LogSequence (exp y)) y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hyzero : y = RealTheory.zero
  · rw [hyzero, H.zero]
    have hconst :
        RealTheory.SeqTendsto
          (LogSequence RealTheory.one) RealTheory.zero := by
      apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually
        (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const RealTheory.zero)
      exact Exists.intro 0
        (fun n _hn => logSequence_one n)
    exact hconst
  · cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hyzero with
    | inl hyneg =>
        exact H.logSequence_exp_tendsto_of_neg hyneg
    | inr hypos =>
        exact H.logSequence_exp_tendsto_of_pos hypos

name: ExpCoreLaws.log_convergence
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.log_convergence
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp) :
    LogConvergence
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  cases H.surjective_positive_of_core x hx with
  | intro y hy =>
      refine Exists.intro y ?_
      rw [<- hy]
      exact H.logSequence_exp_tendsto y

name: log_exp_of_convergence
statement:
theorem log_exp_of_convergence
    (C : ConvergenceData) :
    forall x : Point,
      C.log (C.exp x) = x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  let H := exp_core_laws_of_convergence C
  have hpos : PositiveDomain (C.exp x) :=
    H.exp_pos x
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique
    (C.log_formula (C.exp x) hpos)
    (H.logSequence_exp_tendsto x)

name: exp_log_of_convergence
statement:
theorem exp_log_of_convergence
    (C : ConvergenceData) :
    forall x : Point,
      PositiveDomain x -> C.exp (C.log x) = x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let H := exp_core_laws_of_convergence C
  cases H.surjective_positive_of_core x hx with
  | intro y hy =>
      calc
        C.exp (C.log x) =
            C.exp (C.log (C.exp y)) := by
              rw [hy]
        _ = C.exp y := by
              rw [log_exp_of_convergence C y]
        _ = x := hy

name: ExpCoreLaws.one_sub_lt_exp_neg_of_pos
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.one_sub_lt_exp_neg_of_pos
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    {y : Point}
    (hypos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one y)
      (exp (RealTheory.neg y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hylt1 : F.lt y F.one
  · have hdenpos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub F.one y) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hylt1
    have hupper : F.lt (exp y) (F.inv (F.sub F.one y)) :=
      H.local_upper y hypos hylt1
    have hexpy_pos : F.lt F.zero (exp y) :=
      H.exp_pos y
    have hltinv :
        F.lt (F.sub F.one y) (F.inv (exp y)) :=
      lt_inv_of_pos_lt_inv hdenpos hexpy_pos hupper
    rw [H.exp_neg_eq_inv y]
    exact hltinv
  · have h1y : F.le F.one y :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hylt1
    have hsub_nonpos : F.le (F.sub F.one y) F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F h1y
    have hexpneg_pos : F.lt F.zero (exp (F.neg y)) :=
      H.exp_pos (F.neg y)
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
      F hsub_nonpos hexpneg_pos

name: ExpCoreLaws.one_add_lt_exp_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.one_add_lt_exp_of_ne_zero
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    {t : Point}
    (htne : Not (t = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one t) (exp t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F htne with
  | inl htneg =>
      let y := F.neg t
      have hypos : F.lt F.zero y := by
        unfold y
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F htneg
        change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg t) at h
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
      have hneg := H.one_sub_lt_exp_neg_of_pos hypos
      have hleft :
          F.add F.one t = F.sub F.one y := by
        unfold y
        rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F t]
      have hright :
          exp t = exp (F.neg y) := by
        unfold y
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F t]
      change F.lt (F.add F.one t) (exp t)
      rw [hleft, hright]
      exact hneg
  | inr htpos =>
      exact naturalExp_global_lower_of_local
        H.zero H.add H.local_lower htpos

name: log_one_of_exp_log
statement:
theorem log_one_of_exp_log
    {exp log : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (hexp_log :
      forall x : Point, PositiveDomain x -> exp (log x) = x) :
    log RealTheory.one = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  exact H.exp_injective
    (log RealTheory.one) RealTheory.zero
    (by
      rw [hexp_log RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero_lt_one, H.zero])

name: log_ne_zero_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem log_ne_zero_of_ne_one
    {exp log : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (hexp_log :
      forall x : Point, PositiveDomain x -> exp (log x) = x)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.one)) :
    Not (log x = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro hlog
  have hxone : x = RealTheory.one := by
    calc
      x = exp (log x) := by
        exact Eq.symm (hexp_log x hx)
      _ = exp RealTheory.zero := by
        rw [hlog]
      _ = RealTheory.one := H.zero
  exact hxne hxone

name: log_local_upper_of_exp_core_inverse
statement:
theorem log_local_upper_of_exp_core_inverse
    {exp log : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (hexp_log :
      forall x : Point, PositiveDomain x -> exp (log x) = x) :
    NaturalLogLocalUpper log
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hxne
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let t := log x
  have htne : Not (t = F.zero) := by
    unfold t
    exact log_ne_zero_of_ne_one H hexp_log hx hxne
  have htan := H.one_add_lt_exp_of_ne_zero htne
  change F.lt (F.add F.one t) (exp t) at htan
  have htan_x : F.lt (F.add F.one t) x := by
    rwa [show exp t = x by unfold t; exact hexp_log x hx] at htan
  have hres : F.lt t (F.sub x F.one) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_sub_of_add_lt F htan_x
  exact hres

name: sub_one_mul_inv_eq_one_sub_inv
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_inv_eq_one_sub_inv
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv x) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx hzero.symm
  change
    F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x) =
      F.sub F.one (F.inv x)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_one_mul_inv_eq_one_sub_inv F hxne

name: log_local_lower_of_exp_core_inverse
statement:
theorem log_local_lower_of_exp_core_inverse
    {exp log : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (hexp_log :
      forall x : Point, PositiveDomain x -> exp (log x) = x) :
    NaturalLogLocalLower log
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hxne
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let t := log x
  have htne : Not (t = F.zero) := by
    unfold t
    exact log_ne_zero_of_ne_one H hexp_log hx hxne
  have hneg_t_ne : Not (F.neg t = F.zero) := by
    intro hneg0
    have ht0 : t = F.zero := by
      calc
        t = F.neg (F.neg t) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F t]
        _ = F.neg F.zero := by
          rw [hneg0]
        _ = F.zero := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F
    exact htne ht0
  have htan := H.one_add_lt_exp_of_ne_zero hneg_t_ne
  change F.lt (F.add F.one (F.neg t)) (exp (F.neg t)) at htan
  have hleft :
      F.add F.one (F.neg t) = F.sub F.one t := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hright :
      exp (F.neg t) = F.inv x := by
    calc
      exp (F.neg t) = F.inv (exp t) := by
        exact H.exp_neg_eq_inv t
      _ = F.inv x := by
        rw [show exp t = x by unfold t; exact hexp_log x hx]
  have htan' : F.lt (F.sub F.one t) (F.inv x) := by
    rwa [hleft, hright] at htan
  have hone_sub_inv_lt_t :
      F.lt (F.sub F.one (F.inv x)) t :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right F htan'
  rw [sub_one_mul_inv_eq_one_sub_inv hx]
  exact hone_sub_inv_lt_t

name: lt_inv_of_pos_lt_inv
statement:
theorem lt_inv_of_pos_lt_inv
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hb_inv_a : RealTheory.lt b (RealTheory.inv a)) :
    RealTheory.lt a (RealTheory.inv b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have ha_ne : Not (a = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F ha hzero.symm
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
    F hb (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F ha) hb_inv_a
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_inv_of_ne_zero F ha_ne] at h

name: expLowerSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem expLowerSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain ExpLowerSqueezeFun
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hconst :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one :=
    tendstoWithin_const UniversalDomain RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero
  have hid :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain IdentityFun
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero :=
    (continuousAtOn_identity trivial).right
  have h := tendstoWithin_add hconst hid
  have hlim :
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero =
        RealTheory.one :=
    RealTheory.add_zero RealTheory.one
  have h' := tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim h
  exact tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun x hx hxne => rfl)
    h'

name: expUpperSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem expUpperSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain ExpUpperSqueezeFun
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hconst :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one :=
    tendstoWithin_const UniversalDomain RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero
  have hid :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain IdentityFun
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero :=
    (continuousAtOn_identity trivial).right
  have hsub := tendstoWithin_sub hconst hid
  have hsubLim :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero =
        RealTheory.one := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.one
  have hsub' := tendstoWithin_congr_limit hsubLim hsub
  have hinv := tendstoWithin_inv hsub' RealTheory.one_ne_zero
  have hinvLim :
      RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv' := tendstoWithin_congr_limit hinvLim hinv
  exact tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun x hx hxne => rfl)
    hinv'

name: ExpCoreLaws.eventually_squeeze_bounds_at_zero
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.eventually_squeeze_bounds_at_zero
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp) :
    EventuallyWithin UniversalDomain RealTheory.zero
      (fun x : Point =>
        And
          (RealTheory.le (ExpLowerSqueezeFun x) (exp x))
          (RealTheory.le (exp x) (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine Exists.intro RealTheory.one ?_
  refine And.intro RealTheory.zero_lt_one ?_
  intro x hx hxne hdist
  have hxlt1 : F.lt x F.one := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hdist
    change F.lt x (F.add F.zero F.one) at h
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have hneg1ltx : F.lt (F.neg F.one) x := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hdist
    change F.lt (F.sub F.zero F.one) x at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F F.one] at h
  by_cases hxpos : F.lt F.zero x
  · have hlowerStrict := H.local_lower x hxpos hxlt1
    have hupperStrict := H.local_upper x hxpos hxlt1
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlowerStrict)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hupperStrict)
  · have hxle0 : F.le x F.zero := by
      by_cases hxle0 : F.le x F.zero
      · exact hxle0
      · have h0x : F.le F.zero x := by
          cases F.le_total F.zero x with
          | inl h => exact h
          | inr h => exact False.elim (hxle0 h)
        exact False.elim
          (hxpos (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0x hxle0))
    have hxlt0 : F.lt x F.zero := by
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxle0
      intro h0x
      exact hxne (F.le_antisymm hxle0 h0x)
    let z := F.neg x
    have hzpos : F.lt F.zero z := by
      unfold z
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hxlt0
      change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg x) at h
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
    have hzlt1 : F.lt z F.one := by
      unfold z
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hneg1ltx
      change F.lt (F.neg x) (F.neg (F.neg F.one)) at h
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F F.one] at h
    have hden_pos :
        F.lt F.zero (F.sub F.one z) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hzlt1
    have hupper_z := H.local_upper z hzpos hzlt1
    have hexp_z_pos : F.lt F.zero (exp z) := H.exp_pos z
    have hlower_neg :
        F.lt (F.sub F.one z) (F.inv (exp z)) :=
      lt_inv_of_pos_lt_inv hden_pos hexp_z_pos hupper_z
    have hone_add_x_eq :
        F.add F.one x = F.sub F.one z := by
      unfold z
      rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F x]
    have hx_eq_neg_z : x = F.neg z := by
      unfold z
      exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F x)
    have hexp_x_eq :
        exp x = F.inv (exp z) := by
      rw [hx_eq_neg_z]
      exact H.exp_neg_eq_inv z
    have hupper_den_eq :
        F.sub F.one x = F.add F.one z := by
      rw [hx_eq_neg_z]
      rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F z]
    have hone_add_z_pos :
        F.lt F.zero (F.add F.one z) := by
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hzpos)
    have hglobal_lower_z :
        F.lt (F.add F.one z) (exp z) :=
      naturalExp_global_lower_of_local H.zero H.add H.local_lower hzpos
    have hupper_neg :
        F.lt (F.inv (exp z)) (F.inv (F.add F.one z)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
        F hone_add_z_pos hexp_z_pos hglobal_lower_z
    constructor
    · unfold ExpLowerSqueezeFun
      change F.le (F.add F.one x) (exp x)
      rw [hone_add_x_eq, hexp_x_eq]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlower_neg
    · unfold ExpUpperSqueezeFun
      change F.le (exp x) (F.inv (F.sub F.one x))
      rw [hexp_x_eq, hupper_den_eq]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hupper_neg

name: ExpCoreLaws.tendstoWithin_zero
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.tendstoWithin_zero
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain exp
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hbounds := H.eventually_squeeze_bounds_at_zero
  have hlower :
      EventuallyWithin UniversalDomain RealTheory.zero
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.le (ExpLowerSqueezeFun x) (exp x)) :=
    eventuallyWithin_mono (fun x hx => hx.left) hbounds
  have hupper :
      EventuallyWithin UniversalDomain RealTheory.zero
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.le (exp x) (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x)) :=
    eventuallyWithin_mono (fun x hx => hx.right) hbounds
  exact tendstoWithin_of_squeeze
    expLowerSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero
    expUpperSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero
    hlower
    hupper

name: shiftToZero_sameOn
statement:
theorem shiftToZero_sameOn
    (x0 : Point) :
    SameOn UniversalDomain (ShiftToZero x0)
      (SubFun IdentityFun (fun _ : Point => x0))
proof:
:= by
  intro x _hx
  rfl

name: tendstoWithin_shiftToZero
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_shiftToZero
    (x0 : Point) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain (ShiftToZero x0)
      x0 RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hid :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain IdentityFun x0 :=
    continuousAtOn_identity trivial
  have hconst :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain (fun _ : Point => x0) x0 :=
    continuousAtOn_const trivial
  have hsub :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain
        (SubFun IdentityFun (fun _ : Point => x0)) x0 :=
    continuousAtOn_sub hid hconst
  have hlimit : RealTheory.sub x0 x0 = RealTheory.zero := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x0
  have h := tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlimit hsub.right
  exact tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun x hx hxne => (shiftToZero_sameOn x0 x hx).symm)
    h

name: tendstoWithin_exp_shift_one_of_zero
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_exp_shift_one_of_zero
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (hzero_cont :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain exp
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one)
    (x0 : Point) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
      (fun x : Point => exp (ShiftToZero x0 x))
      x0 RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hzeroAt :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain exp RealTheory.zero :=
    And.intro trivial
      (tendstoWithin_congr_limit H.zero.symm hzero_cont)
  have hcomp :=
    tendstoWithin_comp_continuousAtOn
      (tendstoWithin_shiftToZero x0)
      hzeroAt
      (fun x hx hxne =>
        (show UniversalDomain (ShiftToZero x0 x) from trivial))
  unfold CompFun ShiftToZero at hcomp
  simpa [H.zero] using hcomp

name: tendstoWithin_exp_of_zero
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_exp_of_zero
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (hzero_cont :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain exp
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one)
    (x0 : Point) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain exp x0 (exp x0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let shifted : Map := fun x : Point => exp (ShiftToZero x0 x)
  let scaled : Map := fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul (exp x0) (shifted x)
  have hshift :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain shifted x0 RealTheory.one := by
    unfold shifted
    exact tendstoWithin_exp_shift_one_of_zero H hzero_cont x0
  have hconst :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (fun _ : Point => exp x0) x0 (exp x0) :=
    tendstoWithin_const UniversalDomain (exp x0) x0
  have hscaled :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain scaled x0 (exp x0) := by
    have hmul :=
      tendstoWithin_mul hconst hshift
    change
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => exp x0) shifted)
        x0 (RealTheory.mul (exp x0) RealTheory.one) at hmul
    have htarget :
        RealTheory.mul (exp x0) RealTheory.one = exp x0 :=
      RealTheory.mul_one (exp x0)
    have hmul' := tendstoWithin_congr_limit htarget hmul
    exact tendstoWithin_congr
      (fun x hx hxne => rfl)
      hmul'
  apply tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun x hx hxne => ?_)
    hscaled
  unfold scaled shifted ShiftToZero
  have harg :
      RealTheory.add x0 (RealTheory.sub x x0) = x := by
    change F.add x0 (F.sub x x0) = x
    rw [F.add_comm x0 (F.sub x x0)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x x0
  have hadd := H.add x0 (RealTheory.sub x x0)
  change
    exp (RealTheory.add x0 (RealTheory.sub x x0)) =
      RealTheory.mul (exp x0)
        (exp (RealTheory.sub x x0)) at hadd
  rw [harg] at hadd
  exact hadd.symm

name: ExpCoreLaws.continuousOn_of_zero
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.continuousOn_of_zero
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (hzero_cont :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain exp
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one) :
    ContinuousOn UniversalDomain exp
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact And.intro hx (tendstoWithin_exp_of_zero H hzero_cont x)

name: evenIndex_succ_add_one
statement:
theorem evenIndex_succ_add_one (k : Nat) :
    EvenIndex k + 1 = 2 * (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold EvenIndex
  have hpos : 0 < 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
  omega

name: evenIndex_subsequence
statement:
theorem evenIndex_subsequence :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.SubsequenceIndex EvenIndex
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  unfold EvenIndex
  have hmul : 2 * (k + 1) < 2 * ((k + 1) + 1) := by omega
  have hleft_ge : 1 <= 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
  exact Nat.sub_lt_sub_right hleft_ge hmul

name: expSequence_evenIndex_eq
statement:
theorem expSequence_evenIndex_eq (x : Point) (k : Nat) :
    ExpSequence x (EvenIndex k) =
      powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul x
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (2 * (k + 1))))))
        (2 * (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold ExpSequence
  rw [evenIndex_succ_add_one k]
  rfl

name: nat_succ_mul_inv_double_succ
statement:
theorem nat_succ_mul_inv_double_succ
    (x : Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
        (RealTheory.mul x
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (2 * (k + 1))))) =
      RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let K := RealTheory.nat (k + 1)
  let two := RealTheory.nat 2
  have hK_ne : Not (K = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold K
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
  have htwo_ne : Not (two = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold two
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hden :
      F.nat (2 * (k + 1)) =
        F.mul two K := by
    unfold two K
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_mul F 2 (k + 1)
  change
    F.mul K
        (F.mul x (F.inv (F.nat (2 * (k + 1))))) =
      F.mul x (F.inv two)
  calc
    F.mul K
        (F.mul x (F.inv (F.nat (2 * (k + 1))))) =
        F.mul x
          (F.mul K (F.inv (F.nat (2 * (k + 1))))) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
          rw [F.mul_comm K x]
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul x (F.mul K (F.inv (F.mul two K))) := by
          rw [hden]
    _ =
        F.mul x
          (F.mul K (F.mul (F.inv K) (F.inv two))) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F htwo_ne hK_ne]
    _ =
        F.mul x
          (F.mul (F.mul K (F.inv K)) (F.inv two)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul x (F.mul F.one (F.inv two)) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hK_ne]
    _ =
        F.mul x (F.inv two) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: expSequence_evenIndex_lower_square
statement:
theorem expSequence_evenIndex_lower_square
    {x : Point}
    (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)))) 2)
      (ExpSequence x (EvenIndex k))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let eps :=
    RealTheory.mul x
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (2 * (k + 1))))
  have hden_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.nat (2 * (k + 1))) := by
    exact RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have heps_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps := by
    unfold eps
    exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hxnonneg
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos))
  have hbern :=
    powNat_two_one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add_double
      heps_nonneg (k + 1)
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) eps =
        RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)) := by
    unfold eps
    exact nat_succ_mul_inv_double_succ x k
  have hexp :
      ExpSequence x (EvenIndex k) =
        powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps)
          ((k + 1) + (k + 1)) := by
    unfold eps
    rw [expSequence_evenIndex_eq x k]
    have hnum : (k + 1) + (k + 1) = 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
    rw [hnum]
  rw [hleft] at hbern
  rw [hexp]
  exact hbern

name: one_add_lt_square_one_add_half
statement:
theorem one_add_lt_square_one_add_half
    {x : Point} (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)))) 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))
  have htwo_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 2) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hhalf_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h := by
    unfold h
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos hxpos
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F htwo_pos)
  have hhalf_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hhalf_pos
  have htwo_ne : Not (RealTheory.nat 2 = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hx_eq_double_half :
      x = RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) h := by
    unfold h
    calc
      x =
          RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one x := by
            rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
      _ =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))) x := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel htwo_ne]
      _ =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)) x) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      _ =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
            (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_comm
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)) x]
  have htwo_h :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) h =
        RealTheory.add h h := by
    change F.mul (F.nat 2) h = F.add h h
    rw [show F.nat 2 = F.add F.one F.one by
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ F 1]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ F 0]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero F]
      rw [F.zero_add]]
    rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
  have hlinear :
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x =
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) h := by
    rw [hx_eq_double_half, htwo_h]
    rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc]
  have hstrict :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) h)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)) := by
    have hone_lt_one_add_h :
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) := by
      have hadd :=
        RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hhalf_pos RealTheory.one
      change
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero)
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) at hadd
      rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at hadd
    have hmul_lt :
        RealTheory.lt h
          (RealTheory.mul h (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)) := by
      have hm :=
        RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hone_lt_one_add_h hhalf_pos
      change
        RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul h RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.mul h (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)) at hm
      rwa [RealTheory.mul_one] at hm
    have hadd :=
      RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hmul_lt
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)
    have hexpand :
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) =
          RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)
            (RealTheory.mul h (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)) := by
      calc
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h))
              (RealTheory.mul h
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)) := by
              rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
        _ =
            RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)
              (RealTheory.mul h
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)) := by
              rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
    rw [hexpand]
    exact hadd
  rw [hlinear]
  rw [powNat_two]
  exact hstrict

name: exp_local_lower_of_formula
statement:
theorem exp_local_lower_of_formula
    {exp : Map}
    (hformula : ExpFormula exp) :
    NaturalExpLocalLower exp
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxpos _hxlt
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let lower :=
    powNat
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)))) 2
  have hstrict :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x) lower := by
    unfold lower
    exact one_add_lt_square_one_add_half hxpos
  have hsub :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
          (ExpSequence x) EvenIndex)
        (exp x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seqTendsto_of_subsequenceIndex
      F (hformula x) evenIndex_subsequence
  have hlower_le :
      RealTheory.le lower (exp x) := by
    apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le
      (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const lower) hsub
    exact Exists.intro 0
      (fun k _ =>
        expSequence_evenIndex_lower_square
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxpos) k)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hstrict hlower_le

name: nat_succ_mul_inv_succ
statement:
theorem nat_succ_mul_inv_succ
    (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.mul x
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  have hN_ne : Not (N = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold N
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  change F.mul N (F.mul x (F.inv N)) = x
  calc
    F.mul N (F.mul x (F.inv N)) =
        F.mul N (F.mul (F.inv N) x) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm x (F.inv N)]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.mul N (F.inv N)) x := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul F.one x := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hN_ne]
    _ = x := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: expSequence_upper_inv_one_sub
statement:
theorem expSequence_upper_inv_one_sub
    {x : Point}
    (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le (ExpSequence x n)
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let eps :=
    RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
  have hden_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
  have heps_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps := by
    unfold eps
    exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hxnonneg
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos))
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps = x := by
    unfold eps
    exact nat_succ_mul_inv_succ x n
  have hden_sub :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) eps) =
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x := by
    rw [hmul]
  have hden_target_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxlt
  have hupper :=
    powNat_one_add_le_inv_one_sub_nat_mul
      heps_nonneg (m := n + 1)
      (by rwa [hden_sub])
  simpa [ExpSequence, eps, hden_sub] using hupper

name: exp_local_upper_le_of_formula

    {exp : Map}
    (hformula : ExpFormula exp) :

name: logSequence_one
statement:
theorem logSequence_one (n : Nat) :
    LogSequence RealTheory.one n = RealTheory.zero
proof:

  unfold LogSequence
  rw [nthRoot_one_succ_eq_one n]
  change
    F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) (F.sub F.one F.one) = F.zero
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.one]

  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique (C.log_formula RealTheory.one hone_pos)
    hconst

name: eventually_one_add_positive_of_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem eventually_one_add_positive_of_tendsto_zero
    {a : Nat -> Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.SeqTendsto a RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (a n)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases ha RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero_lt_one with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have hclose := hN n hn
      change
        F.lt
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
            (F.sub (a n) F.zero))
          F.one at hclose
      have hleft := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hclose
      change F.lt (F.sub F.zero F.one) (a n) at hleft
      have hadd := RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hleft RealTheory.one
      change
        F.lt
          (F.add F.one (F.sub F.zero F.one))
          (F.add F.one (a n)) at hadd
      have hzero :
          F.add F.one (F.sub F.zero F.one) = F.zero := by
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F F.one]
        rw [F.add_neg]
      rwa [hzero] at hadd

name: seqTendsto_inv_one_add_of_tendsto_zero
statement:

    {a : Nat -> Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.SeqTendsto a RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (a n)))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hone :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (a n))
        RealTheory.one := by
    have h :=
      RealTheory.seqTendsto_add
        (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const RealTheory.one) ha
    change
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat => F.add F.one (a n))
        (F.add F.one F.zero) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hinv := RealTheory.seqTendsto_inv hone RealTheory.one_ne_zero
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        F.inv (F.add F.one (a n)))
      (F.inv F.one) at hinv
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at hinv

statement:
theorem natSucc_mul_mul_invNatSucc_sq (z : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.mul z
          (RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n))) =
      RealTheory.mul z (invNatSucc n)
proof:
:= by
  exact Tautology.RealFunction.Elementary.natSucc_mul_mul_invNatSucc_sq z n

name: eulerAddLawBaseProduct
statement:
theorem eulerAddLawBaseProduct
    (x y : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul x (invNatSucc n)))
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul y (invNatSucc n))) =
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (EulerAddLawPerturbation x y n)
proof:
:= by
  let r := invNatSucc n
  have hcross :
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul y r)
          (RealTheory.mul x r) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add x y) r := by
    calc
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul y r)
          (RealTheory.mul x r) =
          RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul x r)
            (RealTheory.mul y r) := by
            rw [RealTheory.add_comm]
      _ =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add x y) r := by
            rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
  have hquad :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x r)
          (RealTheory.mul y r) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x y)
          (RealTheory.mul r r) :=
    RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm x r y r
  unfold EulerAddLawPerturbation
  change
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul x r))
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul y r)) =
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add x y) r)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x y)
            (RealTheory.mul r r)))
  calc
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul x r))
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul y r)) =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul y r)))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x r)
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul y r))) := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul y r))
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x r) RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x r)
              (RealTheory.mul y r))) := by
          rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
          rw [RealTheory.mul_add]
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul y r))
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul x r)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x y)
              (RealTheory.mul r r))) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
          rw [hquad]
    _ =
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul y r)
              (RealTheory.mul x r))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x y)
              (RealTheory.mul r r))) := by
          rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc]
          rw [RealTheory.add_assoc RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul y r) (RealTheory.mul x r)]
          rw [RealTheory.add_assoc RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul y r)
              (RealTheory.mul x r))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x y)
              (RealTheory.mul r r))]
    _ =
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add x y) r)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x y)
              (RealTheory.mul r r))) := by
          rw [hcross]

name: eulerProductSequence_eq_smallPowerPerturbation
statement:
theorem eulerProductSequence_eq_smallPowerPerturbation
    (x y : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (ExpSequence x n) (ExpSequence y n) =
      EulerSmallPowerSequence (EulerAddLawPerturbation x y) n
proof:
:= by
  unfold ExpSequence EulerSmallPowerSequence
  change
    RealTheory.mul
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul x (invNatSucc n))) (n + 1))
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul y (invNatSucc n))) (n + 1)) =
      powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (EulerAddLawPerturbation x y n)) (n + 1)
  rw [<- powNat_mul]
  rw [eulerAddLawBaseProduct]

name: eulerAddBase_step_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem eulerAddBase_step_tendsto_zero
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add x y) (invNatSucc n))
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:=
  seqTendsto_scaled_invNatSucc_zero (RealTheory.add x y)

name: eulerAddBase_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem eulerAddBase_tendsto_one
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (EulerAddBase x y) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  unfold EulerAddBase

    (eulerAddBase_step_tendsto_zero x y)

name: eulerAddBase_pos_eventually
statement:
theorem eulerAddBase_pos_eventually
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (EulerAddBase x y n))
proof:
:= by
  unfold EulerAddBase
