    (eulerAddBase_step_tendsto_zero x y)

name: eulerAddBase_inv_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem eulerAddBase_inv_tendsto_one
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.inv (EulerAddBase x y n))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := RealTheory.seqTendsto_inv
    (eulerAddBase_tendsto_one x y)
    RealTheory.one_ne_zero
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat => F.inv (EulerAddBase x y n))
      (F.inv F.one) at h
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at h

name: natSucc_mul_eulerAddCorrection
statement:
theorem natSucc_mul_eulerAddCorrection
    (x y : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (EulerAddCorrection x y n) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x y) (invNatSucc n))
        (RealTheory.inv (EulerAddBase x y n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold EulerAddCorrection
  change
    F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul x y)
            (F.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n)))
          (F.inv (EulerAddBase x y n))) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (F.mul x y) (invNatSucc n))
        (F.inv (EulerAddBase x y n))
  calc
    F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul x y)
            (F.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n)))
          (F.inv (EulerAddBase x y n))) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (F.mul (F.mul x y)
              (F.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n))))
          (F.inv (EulerAddBase x y n)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul x y) (invNatSucc n))
          (F.inv (EulerAddBase x y n)) := by
          have h :=
            natSucc_mul_mul_invNatSucc_sq
              (RealTheory.mul x y) n
          exact congrArg
            (fun t : Point =>
              F.mul t (F.inv (EulerAddBase x y n))) h

name: eulerAddCorrection_scaled_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem eulerAddCorrection_scaled_tendsto_zero
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (EulerAddCorrection x y n))
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x y) (invNatSucc n))
        RealTheory.zero :=
    seqTendsto_scaled_invNatSucc_zero (RealTheory.mul x y)
  have hprod :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul hleft
      (eulerAddBase_inv_tendsto_one x y)
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul x y) (invNatSucc n))
          (F.inv (EulerAddBase x y n)))
      (F.mul F.zero F.one) at hprod
  have hprod_zero :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          F.mul
            (F.mul (F.mul x y) (invNatSucc n))
            (F.inv (EulerAddBase x y n)))
        F.zero := by
    rwa [F.zero_mul] at hprod
  have htarget :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (EulerAddCorrection x y n))
        F.zero := by
    apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hprod_zero
    exact Eventually.of_forall
      (fun n : Nat => natSucc_mul_eulerAddCorrection x y n)
  exact htarget

name: eulerAddCorrection_nonneg_eventually_of_mul_nonneg
statement:
theorem eulerAddCorrection_nonneg_eventually_of_mul_nonneg
    {x y : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul x y)) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (EulerAddCorrection x y n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply Eventually.mono ?_ (eulerAddBase_pos_eventually x y)
  intro n hbase_pos
  have hinv_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv (EulerAddBase x y n)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hbase_pos)
  have hinvN_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (invNatSucc n) := by
    unfold invNatSucc
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)
  have hinvN_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (invNatSucc n) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinvN_pos
  have hsquare :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_nonneg hinvN_nonneg hinvN_nonneg
  unfold EulerAddCorrection
  exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg
    (RealTheory.mul_nonneg hxy hsquare) hinv_nonneg

name: neg_eulerAddCorrection_eq
statement:
theorem neg_eulerAddCorrection_eq
    (x y : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.neg (EulerAddCorrection x y n) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul x y))
          (RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n)))
        (RealTheory.inv (EulerAddBase x y n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold EulerAddCorrection
  change
    F.neg
      (F.mul
        (F.mul (F.mul x y)
          (F.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n)))
        (F.inv (EulerAddBase x y n))) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (F.neg (F.mul x y))
          (F.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n)))
        (F.inv (EulerAddBase x y n))
  rw [<- F.neg_mul]
  rw [<- F.neg_mul]

name: eulerAddCorrection_nonpos_eventually_of_mul_nonpos
statement:
theorem eulerAddCorrection_nonpos_eventually_of_mul_nonpos
    {x y : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul x y) RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.le (EulerAddCorrection x y n) RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnegxy :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul x y)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hxy
  have hneg_nonneg :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.neg (EulerAddCorrection x y n))) := by
    apply Eventually.mono ?_ (eulerAddBase_pos_eventually x y)
    intro n hbase_pos
    have hinv_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.inv (EulerAddBase x y n)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hbase_pos)
    have hinvN_pos :
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (invNatSucc n) := by
      unfold invNatSucc
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)
    have hinvN_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (invNatSucc n) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinvN_pos
    have hsquare :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n)) :=
      RealTheory.mul_nonneg hinvN_nonneg hinvN_nonneg
    rw [neg_eulerAddCorrection_eq]
    exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg
      (RealTheory.mul_nonneg hnegxy hsquare) hinv_nonneg
  apply Eventually.mono ?_ hneg_nonneg
  intro n hn
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_neg_nonneg F hn

name: eulerAddCorrection_neg_scaled_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem eulerAddCorrection_neg_scaled_tendsto_zero
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.neg (EulerAddCorrection x y n)))
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hneg :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_neg
      (eulerAddCorrection_scaled_tendsto_zero x y)
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        F.neg
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (EulerAddCorrection x y n)))
      (F.neg F.zero) at hneg
  have hcongr :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun n : Nat =>
          F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
              (F.neg (EulerAddCorrection x y n)) =
            F.neg
              (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
                (EulerAddCorrection x y n))) :=
    Eventually.of_forall
      (fun n : Nat => by
        rw [F.mul_neg])
  have htarget :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hneg hcongr
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (F.neg (EulerAddCorrection x y n)))
      F.zero
  rwa [F.neg_zero] at htarget

name: eulerAddCorrection_smallPower_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem eulerAddCorrection_smallPower_tendsto_one
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (EulerSmallPowerSequence (EulerAddCorrection x y))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases F.le_total F.zero (RealTheory.mul x y) with
  | inl hnonneg =>
      exact eulerSmallPower_tendsto_one_of_nonneg
        (eulerAddCorrection_nonneg_eventually_of_mul_nonneg hnonneg)
        (eulerAddCorrection_scaled_tendsto_zero x y)
  | inr hnonpos =>
      exact eulerSmallPower_tendsto_one_of_nonpos
        (eulerAddCorrection_nonpos_eventually_of_mul_nonpos hnonpos)
        (eulerAddCorrection_neg_scaled_tendsto_zero x y)

name: eulerAddBase_mul_one_addCorrection
statement:
theorem eulerAddBase_mul_one_addCorrection
    (x y : Point) (n : Nat)
    (hbase_ne : Not (EulerAddBase x y n = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul (EulerAddBase x y n)
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (EulerAddCorrection x y n)) =
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (EulerAddLawPerturbation x y n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := RealTheory.add x y
  let q := RealTheory.mul x y
  let r := invNatSucc n
  let A := RealTheory.mul q (RealTheory.mul r r)
  let B := RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul s r)
  have hB_ne : Not (B = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold B s
    exact hbase_ne
  have hBA :
      F.mul B (F.mul A (F.inv B)) = A := by
    calc
      F.mul B (F.mul A (F.inv B)) =
          F.mul (F.mul B A) (F.inv B) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul A B) (F.inv B) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm B A]
      _ = F.mul A (F.mul B (F.inv B)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul A F.one := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hB_ne]
      _ = A := by
            rw [F.mul_one]
  unfold EulerAddBase EulerAddCorrection EulerAddLawPerturbation
  change
    F.mul B (F.add F.one (F.mul A (F.inv B))) =
      F.add F.one (F.add (F.mul s r) A)
  calc
    F.mul B (F.add F.one (F.mul A (F.inv B))) =
        F.add (F.mul B F.one)
          (F.mul B (F.mul A (F.inv B))) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
    _ = F.add B (F.mul B (F.mul A (F.inv B))) := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = F.add B A := by
          rw [hBA]
    _ = F.add (F.add F.one (F.mul s r)) A := by
          rfl
    _ = F.add F.one (F.add (F.mul s r) A) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]

name: eulerAddPerturbation_smallPower_factor
statement:
theorem eulerAddPerturbation_smallPower_factor
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat =>
        EulerSmallPowerSequence (EulerAddLawPerturbation x y) n =
          RealTheory.mul
            (ExpSequence (RealTheory.add x y) n)
            (EulerSmallPowerSequence
              (EulerAddCorrection x y) n))
proof:
:= by
  apply Eventually.mono ?_ (eulerAddBase_pos_eventually x y)
  intro n hbase_pos
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbase_ne : Not (EulerAddBase x y n = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hbase_pos hzero.symm
  have hbase :=
    eulerAddBase_mul_one_addCorrection x y n hbase_ne
  unfold EulerSmallPowerSequence ExpSequence
  unfold EulerAddBase at hbase
  change
    powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (EulerAddLawPerturbation x y n)) (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (powNat
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add x y) (invNatSucc n)))
          (n + 1))
        (powNat
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
            (EulerAddCorrection x y n)) (n + 1))
  rw [<- hbase]
  rw [powNat_mul]

name: eulerProductSequence_eq_expAdd_mul_correction_eventually
statement:
theorem eulerProductSequence_eq_expAdd_mul_correction_eventually
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (ExpSequence x n) (ExpSequence y n) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (ExpSequence (RealTheory.add x y) n)
            (EulerSmallPowerSequence
              (EulerAddCorrection x y) n))
proof:
:= by
  apply Eventually.mono ?_ (eulerAddPerturbation_smallPower_factor x y)
  intro n hfactor
  rw [eulerProductSequence_eq_smallPowerPerturbation x y n]
  exact hfactor

name: exp_add_of_formula
statement:
theorem exp_add_of_formula
    {exp : Map}
    (hformula : ExpFormula exp) :
    NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative exp
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxy :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (ExpSequence x n) (ExpSequence y n))
        (RealTheory.mul (exp x) (exp y)) := by
    exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul
      (hformula x) (hformula y)
  have hright_raw :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (ExpSequence (RealTheory.add x y) n)
            (EulerSmallPowerSequence
              (EulerAddCorrection x y) n))
        (RealTheory.mul (exp (RealTheory.add x y))
          RealTheory.one) := by
    exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul
      (hformula (RealTheory.add x y))
      (eulerAddCorrection_smallPower_tendsto_one x y)
  have hright :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (ExpSequence (RealTheory.add x y) n)
            (EulerSmallPowerSequence
              (EulerAddCorrection x y) n))
        (exp (RealTheory.add x y)) := by
    change
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          F.mul
            (ExpSequence (RealTheory.add x y) n)
            (EulerSmallPowerSequence
              (EulerAddCorrection x y) n))
        (F.mul (exp (RealTheory.add x y)) F.one) at hright_raw
    rwa [F.mul_one] at hright_raw
  have hxy_to_add :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (ExpSequence x n) (ExpSequence y n))
        (exp (RealTheory.add x y)) := by
    apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hright
    exact eulerProductSequence_eq_expAdd_mul_correction_eventually x y
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hxy_to_add hxy

name: exp_add_of_convergence
statement:
theorem exp_add_of_convergence
    (C : ConvergenceData) :
    NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative C.exp
proof:
:=
  exp_add_of_formula C.exp_formula

name: RoutePackage.power_of_pos
statement:
theorem RoutePackage.power_of_pos
    (P : RoutePackage)
    (mu : Point) {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    P.power mu x =
      P.exp (RealTheory.mul mu (P.log x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold RoutePackage.power
  simp [hx]

name: RoutePackage.log_pos_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem RoutePackage.log_pos_of_one_lt
    (P : RoutePackage)
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (P.log x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.one) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.one hx
  have hsub_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx
  have hinv_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hxpos
  have hprod_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv x)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hsub_pos hinv_pos
  have hlog_lower := P.logThinSpec.local_lower x hxpos hxne
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hprod_pos hlog_lower

name: RoutePackage.sub_one_mul_inv_eq_one_sub_inv
statement:
theorem RoutePackage.sub_one_mul_inv_eq_one_sub_inv
    (_P : RoutePackage)

        (RealTheory.inv x) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x)
proof:

name: log_mul_of_exp_log_log_exp
statement:
theorem log_mul_of_exp_log_log_exp
    {exp log : Map}
    (hadd : NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative exp)
    (hexp_log :
      forall x : Point, PositiveDomain x -> exp (log x) = x)
    (hlog_exp :
      forall x : Point, log (exp x) = x) :
    NaturalLogMultiplicativeAdditive log
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hprod :
      RealTheory.mul x y =
        exp (RealTheory.add (log x) (log y)) := by
    calc
      RealTheory.mul x y =
          RealTheory.mul (exp (log x)) y := by
            rw [hexp_log x hx]
      _ =
          RealTheory.mul (exp (log x)) (exp (log y)) := by
            rw [hexp_log y hy]
      _ =
          exp (RealTheory.add (log x) (log y)) := by
            exact Eq.symm (hadd (log x) (log y))
  calc
    log (RealTheory.mul x y) =
        log (exp (RealTheory.add (log x) (log y))) := by
          rw [hprod]
    _ = RealTheory.add (log x) (log y) := by
          exact hlog_exp (RealTheory.add (log x) (log y))

name: log_lt_log_of_lt
statement:
theorem log_lt_log_of_lt
    {exp log : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (hexp_log :
      forall x : Point, PositiveDomain x -> exp (log x) = x)
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (hy : PositiveDomain y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y) :
    RealTheory.lt (log x) (log y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnot_yx : Not (F.le (log y) (log x)) := by
    intro hyx
    by_cases hxylog : log x = log y
    · have hxy_eq : x = y := by
        rw [<- hexp_log x hx, <- hexp_log y hy, hxylog]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxy hxy_eq
    · have hyx_lt : F.lt (log y) (log x) := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyx
        intro hxy_le
        exact hxylog (F.le_antisymm hxy_le hyx)
      have h_exp := H.exp_lt_exp_of_lt hyx_lt
      rw [hexp_log y hy, hexp_log x hx] at h_exp
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_asymm F hxy h_exp
  cases F.le_total (log x) (log y) with
  | inl hxylog_le =>
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F
        hxylog_le hnot_yx
  | inr hyxlog_le =>
      exact False.elim (hnot_yx hyxlog_le)

name: exp_mul_neg_eq_one_of_add
statement:
theorem exp_mul_neg_eq_one_of_add
    {exp : Map}
    (hzero : exp RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one)
    (hadd : NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative exp)
    (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (exp x) (exp (RealTheory.neg x)) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have h := hadd x (RealTheory.neg x)
  change
    exp (RealTheory.add x (RealTheory.neg x)) =
      RealTheory.mul (exp x) (exp (RealTheory.neg x)) at h
  rw [RealTheory.add_neg x, hzero] at h
  exact h.symm

name: exp_ne_zero_of_add
statement:
theorem exp_ne_zero_of_add
    {exp : Map}

    Not (exp x = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro hx0
  have hprod := exp_mul_neg_eq_one_of_add hzero hadd x
  rw [hx0, RealTheory.zero_mul] at hprod
  exact RealTheory.zero_ne_one hprod

name: exp_neg_eq_inv_of_add
statement:
theorem exp_neg_eq_inv_of_add
    {exp : Map}
    (hzero : exp RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one)
    (hadd : NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative exp)
    (x : Point) :
    exp (RealTheory.neg x) = RealTheory.inv (exp x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    exp (F.neg x) = F.inv (exp x)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
    F
    (exp_ne_zero_of_add hzero hadd x)
    (exp_mul_neg_eq_one_of_add hzero hadd x)

name: half_square_den_gt_one_sub
statement:
theorem half_square_den_gt_one_sub
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x
    let d := F.sub F.one h
    F.lt (F.sub F.one x) (F.mul d d) := by
  intro F h d
  have hhpos : F.lt F.zero h := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hxpos
  have hh_sq_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.mul h h) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hhpos hhpos
  have hsum : F.add h h = x := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F x
  have hhd : F.add h d = F.one := by
    unfold d
    rw [F.add_comm h (F.sub F.one h)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F F.one h
  have hsum_sq :
      F.add x (F.mul d d) =
        F.add F.one (F.mul h h) := by
    calc
      F.add x (F.mul d d) =
          F.add (F.add h h) (F.mul d d) := by
            rw [<- hsum]
      _ =
          F.add h (F.add h (F.mul d d)) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ =
          F.add h
            (F.add (F.mul h (F.add h d))
              (F.mul d d)) := by
            rw [hhd, F.mul_one]
      _ =
          F.add h
            (F.add
              (F.add (F.mul h h) (F.mul h d))
              (F.mul d d)) := by
            rw [F.mul_add]
      _ =
          F.add h
            (F.add (F.mul h h)
              (F.add (F.mul h d) (F.mul d d))) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ =
          F.add h
            (F.add (F.mul h h)
              (F.mul (F.add h d) d)) := by
            rw [F.add_mul]
      _ =
          F.add h
            (F.add (F.mul h h) d) := by
            rw [hhd, F.one_mul]
      _ =
          F.add (F.add h d) (F.mul h h) := by
            calc
              F.add h (F.add (F.mul h h) d) =
                  F.add h (F.add d (F.mul h h)) := by
                    rw [F.add_comm (F.mul h h) d]
              _ =
                  F.add (F.add h d) (F.mul h h) := by
                    rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ =
          F.add F.one (F.mul h h) := by
            rw [hhd]
  have hone_lt :
      F.lt F.one (F.add x (F.mul d d)) := by
    rw [hsum_sq]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hh_sq_pos
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hone_lt

name: ExpCoreLaws.local_upper
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.local_upper
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp) :
    NaturalExpLocalUpper exp
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxpos hxlt
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x
  let d := F.sub F.one h
  have hhpos : F.lt F.zero h := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hxpos
  have hh_lt_x : F.lt h x := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hxpos
  have hhlt1 : F.lt h F.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hh_lt_x hxlt
  have hsum : F.add h h = x := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F x
  have hweak : F.le (exp h) (F.inv d) := by
    unfold d
    exact H.local_upper_weak h hhpos hhlt1
  have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero d := by
    unfold d
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hhlt1
  have hden_ne : Not (d = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos hzero.symm
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv d) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos)
  have hexp_pos : F.lt F.zero (exp h) := by
    have hlower := H.local_lower h hhpos hhlt1
    have hone_add_pos :
        F.lt F.zero (F.add F.one h) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hhpos)
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hone_add_pos hlower
  have hexp_nonneg : F.le F.zero (exp h) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hexp_pos
  have hmul₁ :
      F.le (F.mul (exp h) (exp h))
        (F.mul (F.inv d) (exp h)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hweak hexp_nonneg
  have hmul₂ :
      F.le (F.mul (F.inv d) (exp h))
        (F.mul (F.inv d) (F.inv d)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
      F hweak hinv_nonneg
  have hsq_le :
      F.le (F.mul (exp h) (exp h))
        (F.mul (F.inv d) (F.inv d)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_trans F hmul₁ hmul₂
  have hden_sq_gt :
      F.lt (F.sub F.one x) (F.mul d d) := by
    simpa [h, d] using half_square_den_gt_one_sub hxpos
  have htarget_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.sub F.one x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxlt
  have hden_sq_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.mul d d) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hden_pos hden_pos
  have hinv_sq_lt :
      F.lt (F.mul (F.inv d) (F.inv d))
        (F.inv (F.sub F.one x)) := by
    have hinv_lt :
        F.lt (F.inv (F.mul d d))
          (F.inv (F.sub F.one x)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
        F htarget_pos hden_sq_pos hden_sq_gt
    have hinv_sq :
        F.mul (F.inv d) (F.inv d) =
          F.inv (F.mul d d) := by
      rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hden_ne hden_ne]
    rwa [hinv_sq]
  have hadd := H.add h h
  change exp (F.add h h) = F.mul (exp h) (exp h) at hadd
  rw [hsum] at hadd
  rw [hadd]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hsq_le hinv_sq_lt

name: ExpCoreLaws.exp_pos_of_pos
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hglobal :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x) (exp x) :=
    naturalExp_global_lower_of_local H.zero H.add H.local_lower hx
  have hone_add_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x) := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hx)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hone_add_pos hglobal

name: ExpCoreLaws.exp_pos
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.exp_pos
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp)
    (x : Point) :
    PositiveDomain (exp x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxzero : x = RealTheory.zero
  · rw [hxzero, H.zero]
    exact RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  · cases F.le_total RealTheory.zero x with
    | inl h0x =>
        have hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0x
          intro hxle0
          have hEq : RealTheory.zero = x := F.le_antisymm h0x hxle0
          exact hxzero hEq.symm
        exact H.exp_pos_of_pos hxpos
    | inr hxle0 =>
        have hxneg : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.zero := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxle0
          intro h0x
          have hEq : RealTheory.zero = x := F.le_antisymm h0x hxle0
          exact hxzero hEq.symm
        let z := RealTheory.neg x
        have hzpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero z := by
          unfold z
          have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hxneg
          change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg x) at h
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
        have hexpz_pos : PositiveDomain (exp z) :=
          H.exp_pos_of_pos hzpos
        have hneg : exp (RealTheory.neg z) =
            RealTheory.inv (exp z) :=
          H.exp_neg_eq_inv z
        have hx_eq_neg_z : x = RealTheory.neg z := by
          unfold z
          exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.neg_neg x)
        rw [hx_eq_neg_z, hneg]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hexpz_pos

name: ExpCoreLaws.exp_lt_exp_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := RealTheory.sub y x
  have hdpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero d := by
    unfold d
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  have hone_lt_one_add_d :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one d) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hdpos RealTheory.one
    change
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one d) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
  have hone_lt_expd :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one (exp d) := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
      hone_lt_one_add_d
      (naturalExp_global_lower_of_local
        H.zero H.add H.local_lower hdpos)
  have hexpx_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (exp x) :=
    H.exp_pos x
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (exp x) RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.mul (exp x) (exp d)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hone_lt_expd hexpx_pos
  have hx_add_d : RealTheory.add x d = y := by
    unfold d
    change F.add x (F.sub y x) = y
    rw [F.add_comm x (F.sub y x)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y x
  have hadd := H.add x d
  change
    exp (RealTheory.add x d) =
      RealTheory.mul (exp x) (exp d) at hadd
  rw [hx_add_d] at hadd
  rwa [RealTheory.mul_one, <- hadd] at hmul

name: ExpCoreLaws.exp_injective
statement:
theorem ExpCoreLaws.exp_injective
    {exp : Map}
    (H : ExpCoreLaws exp) :
    forall x y : Point, exp x = exp y -> x = y
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases heq : x = y
  · exact heq
  · cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F heq with
    | inl hlt =>
        have hltExp := H.exp_lt_exp_of_lt hlt
        rw [hxy] at hltExp
        exact False.elim
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (exp y) hltExp)
    | inr hgt =>
        have hltExp := H.exp_lt_exp_of_lt hgt
        rw [hxy] at hltExp
        exact False.elim
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (exp y) hltExp)

statement:
theorem expStepCorrection_scaled
    {x : Point} (hxnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (expStepCorrection x n) =

name: eulerAddLawPerturbation_neg_eq
statement:
theorem eulerAddLawPerturbation_neg_eq
    (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    EulerAddLawPerturbation x (RealTheory.neg x) n =
      RealTheory.neg (ExpProductError x n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let r := invNatSucc n
  unfold EulerAddLawPerturbation ExpProductError
  change
    F.add
      (F.mul (F.add x (F.neg x)) r)
      (F.mul (F.mul x (F.neg x)) (F.mul r r)) =
    F.neg (F.mul (F.mul x x) (F.mul r r))
  calc
    F.add
      (F.mul (F.add x (F.neg x)) r)
      (F.mul (F.mul x (F.neg x)) (F.mul r r)) =
        F.add
          (F.mul F.zero r)
          (F.mul (F.mul x (F.neg x)) (F.mul r r)) := by
          rw [F.add_neg]
    _ =
        F.add F.zero
          (F.mul (F.mul x (F.neg x)) (F.mul r r)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F r]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.mul x (F.neg x)) (F.mul r r) := by
          rw [F.zero_add]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.neg (F.mul x x)) (F.mul r r) := by
          rw [F.mul_neg]
    _ =
        F.neg (F.mul (F.mul x x) (F.mul r r)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F]

name: expSequence_mul_neg_eq_one_sub_error
statement:

    (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (ExpSequence x n)
        (ExpSequence (RealTheory.neg x) n) =
      powNat
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (ExpProductError x n))
        (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := eulerProductSequence_eq_smallPowerPerturbation
    x (RealTheory.neg x) n
  unfold EulerSmallPowerSequence at hprod
  rw [eulerAddLawPerturbation_neg_eq x n] at hprod
  change
    RealTheory.mul (ExpSequence x n)
        (ExpSequence (RealTheory.neg x) n) =
      powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.neg (ExpProductError x n)))
        (n + 1) at hprod
  rwa [<- RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg] at hprod

name: square_nonneg
statement:
theorem square_nonneg (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl hx =>
      exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hx hx
  | inr hx =>
      have hneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx
      have hprod : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) :=
        RealTheory.mul_nonneg hneg hneg
      rwa [F.neg_mul_neg] at hprod

name: expProductError_nonneg
statement:
theorem expProductError_nonneg (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (ExpProductError x n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsquare : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul x x) :=
    square_nonneg x
  have hinv_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (invNatSucc n) := by
    unfold invNatSucc
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)
  have hinv_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (invNatSucc n) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinv_pos
  have hinv_sq :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_nonneg hinv_nonneg hinv_nonneg
  unfold ExpProductError
  exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hsquare hinv_sq

name: expProductError_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem expProductError_tendsto_zero (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat => ExpProductError x n)
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto invNatSucc RealTheory.zero := by
    unfold invNatSucc
    exact seqTendsto_inv_nat_succ
  have hinv_sq :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n))
        RealTheory.zero := by
    have h := RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul hinv hinv
    change
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          F.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n))
        (F.mul F.zero F.zero) at h
    rwa [F.zero_mul] at h
  have hmul :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul
      (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const (RealTheory.mul x x))
      hinv_sq
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        F.mul (F.mul x x)
          (F.mul (invNatSucc n) (invNatSucc n)))
      (F.mul (F.mul x x) F.zero) at hmul
  rwa [F.mul_zero] at hmul

name: expProductError_le_scaled
statement:
theorem expProductError_le_scaled (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le (ExpProductError x n)
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (ExpProductError x n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hone_le_nat :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) := by
    have hnat : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat 1)
        (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) :=
      RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (by omega)
    rwa [RealTheory.nat_one] at hnat
  have h :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      hone_le_nat (expProductError_nonneg x n)
  rwa [RealTheory.one_mul] at h

name: expProductError_scaled_lt_one_eventually
statement:
theorem expProductError_scaled_lt_one_eventually (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (ExpProductError x n))
          RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hclose :=
    expProductError_scaled_tendsto_zero x
      RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  apply Eventually.mono ?_ hclose
  intro n hn
  have hnonneg := expProductError_scaled_nonneg x n
  change
    F.le F.zero
      (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (ExpProductError x n)) at hnonneg
  change
    F.lt
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.sub
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (ExpProductError x n))
          F.zero))
      F.one at hn
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F] at hn
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hnonneg] at hn

name: expProductError_base_nonneg_eventually
statement:
theorem expProductError_base_nonneg_eventually (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (ExpProductError x n)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply Eventually.mono ?_
    (expProductError_scaled_lt_one_eventually x)
  intro n hscaled_lt_one
  have herr_le_scaled := expProductError_le_scaled x n
  have herr_lt_one :
      RealTheory.lt (ExpProductError x n) RealTheory.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
      F herr_le_scaled hscaled_lt_one
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F herr_lt_one)

name: expProductError_lower_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem expProductError_lower_tendsto_one (x : Point) :

name: expSequence_mul_neg_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem expSequence_mul_neg_tendsto_one (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (ExpSequence x n)
          (ExpSequence (RealTheory.neg x) n))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_squeeze
    (u :=
      fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (ExpProductError x n)))
    (w := fun _ : Nat => RealTheory.one)
    (expProductError_lower_tendsto_one x)
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const RealTheory.one)
  · apply Eventually.mono ?_
      (expProductError_base_nonneg_eventually x)
    intro n hbase_nonneg
    rw [expSequence_mul_neg_eq_one_sub_error x n]
    exact one_sub_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_sub
      (expProductError_nonneg x n)
      hbase_nonneg
      (n + 1)
  · apply Eventually.mono ?_
      (expProductError_base_nonneg_eventually x)
    intro n hbase_nonneg
    rw [expSequence_mul_neg_eq_one_sub_error x n]
    exact powNat_one_sub_le_one
      (expProductError_nonneg x n)
      hbase_nonneg
      (n + 1)

    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
      F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hone_le_l

  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hzero_lt_l hzero.symm

name: expSequence_product_div_eq_left_of_nonneg_right
statement:
theorem expSequence_product_div_eq_left_of_nonneg_right
    {x y : Point} (hynonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero y)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (ExpSequence x n) (ExpSequence y n))
        (RealTheory.inv (ExpSequence y n)) =
      ExpSequence x n
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hyne : Not (ExpSequence y n = RealTheory.zero) :=
    expSequence_ne_zero_of_nonneg hynonneg n
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (ExpSequence x n) (ExpSequence y n))
        (F.inv (ExpSequence y n)) =
        F.mul (ExpSequence x n)
          (F.mul (ExpSequence y n)
            (F.inv (ExpSequence y n))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (ExpSequence x n) F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hyne]
    _ = ExpSequence x n := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: expSequence_converges_neg
statement:
theorem expSequence_converges_neg
    {x : Point} (hxneg : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.zero) :
    Exists (fun l : Point =>
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto (ExpSequence x) l)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let y := RealTheory.neg x
  have hxle0 : RealTheory.le x RealTheory.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxneg
  have hynonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero y := by
    unfold y
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hxle0
  cases expSequence_converges_nonneg hynonneg with
  | intro l hylim =>
      have hprod : RealTheory.SeqTendsto
          (fun n : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (ExpSequence x n) (ExpSequence y n))
          RealTheory.one := by
        unfold y
        exact expSequence_mul_neg_tendsto_one x
      have hlnz : Not (l = RealTheory.zero) :=
        expSequence_limit_ne_zero_of_nonneg hynonneg hylim
      have hdiv :=
        RealTheory.seqTendsto_div hprod hylim hlnz
      refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv l)) ?_
      apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hdiv
      exact Eventually.of_forall
        (fun n : Nat =>
          (expSequence_product_div_eq_left_of_nonneg_right
            (x := x) (y := y) hynonneg n).symm)

name: expConvergence
statement:
theorem expConvergence :
    ExpConvergence
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.le_total RealTheory.zero x with
  | inl hxnonneg =>
      exact expSequence_converges_nonneg hxnonneg
  | inr hxle0 =>
      by_cases hxzero : x = RealTheory.zero
      · rw [hxzero]
        exact expSequence_converges_nonneg
          (RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero)
      · have hnot_nonneg : Not (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x) := by
          intro h0x
          exact hxzero (RealTheory.le_antisymm hxle0 h0x)
        have hxlt0 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.zero :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
            F hxle0 hnot_nonneg
        exact expSequence_converges_neg hxlt0

theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_lt_of_lt
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    {x y : Point} (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x)
      (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := RealTheory.sub y x
  have hdpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero d := by
    unfold d
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  have hpos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x) :=
    naturalExpDedekindExtension_maps_positive D x trivial
  have hdgt :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D d) :=
    naturalExpDedekindExtension_one_lt_of_pos D hdpos
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.lt
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x)
          (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D d)) :=
    lt_mul_of_pos_of_one_lt hpos hdgt
  have hadd := naturalExpDedekindExtension_add_law D x d
  have hxd : RealTheory.add x d = y := by
    unfold d
    rw [RealTheory.add_comm]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y x
  rw [hxd] at hadd
  rwa [<- hadd] at hmul

name: one_add_lt_powNat_two_one_add_half
statement:
theorem one_add_lt_powNat_two_one_add_half
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul x
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))))
        2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x
  have hh_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hx
  have hh_add : RealTheory.add h h = x := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F x
  have hh_square_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul h h) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hh_pos hh_pos
  have harg :
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul x
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))) =
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h := by
    unfold h
    rw [half_eq_mul_inv_nat_two x]
  have hexpand :
      powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) 2 =
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
          (RealTheory.mul h h) := by
    calc
      powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) 2 =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) := by
            exact powNat_two (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)
      _ =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) h) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_add]
      _ =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h) h) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
      _ =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one h)
              (RealTheory.mul h h)) := by
            rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
      _ =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)
            (RealTheory.add h (RealTheory.mul h h)) := by
            rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
      _ =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
              (RealTheory.add h h))
            (RealTheory.mul h h) := by
            calc
              RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one h)
                  (RealTheory.add h (RealTheory.mul h h)) =
                  RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
                    (RealTheory.add h
                      (RealTheory.add h (RealTheory.mul h h))) := by
                    exact RealTheory.add_assoc RealTheory.one h
                      (RealTheory.add h (RealTheory.mul h h))
              _ =
                  RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.add h h)
                      (RealTheory.mul h h)) := by
                    exact congrArg
                      (fun t : Point =>
                        RealTheory.add RealTheory.one t)
                      (Eq.symm
                        (RealTheory.add_assoc h h
                          (RealTheory.mul h h)))
              _ =
                  RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
                      (RealTheory.add h h))
                    (RealTheory.mul h h) := by
                    exact Eq.symm
                      (RealTheory.add_assoc RealTheory.one
                        (RealTheory.add h h)
                        (RealTheory.mul h h))
      _ =
          RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
            (RealTheory.mul h h) := by
            rw [hh_add]
  have hlt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
          (RealTheory.mul h h)) := by
    have haddlt := RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hh_square_pos
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
    change
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
          RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
          (RealTheory.mul h h)) at haddlt
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at haddlt
  rw [harg, hexpand]
  exact hlt

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_local_lower_of_natDiv_margin
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_local_lower_of_natDiv_margin
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    {x : Point} (q : NatDivExponent)
    (hq_le_x : RealTheory.le (NatDivExponentPoint q) x)
    (hmargin :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
        (powNat
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))))
          2)) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
      (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hlower :
      RealTheory.le
        (powNat
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))))
          2)
        (powByNatDiv D.extension.base q) :=
    isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_square_lower_const
      D.base_is_euler_number q
  have hext :
      NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D
          (NatDivExponentPoint q) =
        powByNatDiv D.extension.base q := by
    unfold NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun
    exact
      (rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_extends_intDiv
        D.extension).toNatDiv q
  have hmono :
      RealTheory.le
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D
          (NatDivExponentPoint q))
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x) :=
    naturalExpDedekindExtension_le_of_le D hq_le_x
  rw [hext] at hmono
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
    hmargin (RealTheory.le_trans hlower hmono)

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_lt_of_exp_lt

name: exists_powNat_two_gt
statement:
theorem exists_powNat_two_gt
    {L : Point} (hL : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero L) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.lt L
          (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) n))
proof:
:= by
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_mul_gt hL RealTheory.zero_lt_one with
  | intro n hn =>
      have hn' : RealTheory.lt L (RealTheory.nat n) := by
        change
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.lt L
            (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
              (RealTheory.nat n)
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one) at hn
        rwa [RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul_one] at hn
      exact Exists.intro n
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hn'
          (nat_le_powNat_two n))

name: inv_inv_of_pos
statement:
theorem inv_inv_of_pos
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv x) = x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx h.symm
  have hinvpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx
  have hinvne : Not (RealTheory.inv x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hinvpos h.symm
  have h :
      x = RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv x) := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left F
      (x := RealTheory.inv x)
      (y := x)
      hinvne
    exact RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hxne
  exact Eq.symm h

name: le_sub_of_le_sub_left

proof:

        (RealTheory.sub x (RealTheory.sub x a))

    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F (F.le_refl x) hdelta
  change F.le (F.sub x (F.sub x a)) (F.sub x delta) at hsub
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F x a] at hsub

name: exists_natDivExponentPoint_local_lower_margin
statement:
theorem exists_natDivExponentPoint_local_lower_margin
    {x : Point} (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    Exists
      (fun q : NatDivExponent =>
        And (RealTheory.le (NatDivExponentPoint q) x)
          (RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
            (powNat
              (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
                (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))))
              2)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let invTwo := RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)
  let shift : Map :=
    fun y : Point =>
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul y invTwo)
  let square : Map :=
    fun y : Point => powNat (shift y) 2
  have hshift0 :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain
        (AddFun (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
          (MulFun IdentityFun (fun _ : Point => invTwo))) x := by
    exact continuousAtOn_add
      (continuousAtOn_const (E := UniversalDomain)
        (c := RealTheory.one) trivial)
      (continuousAtOn_mul
        (continuousAtOn_identity (E := UniversalDomain)
          (x0 := x) trivial)
        (continuousAtOn_const (E := UniversalDomain)
          (c := invTwo) trivial))
  have hshift :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain shift x := by
    apply continuousAtOn_congr ?_ hshift0
    intro y _hy
    rfl
  have hsquare0 :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain
        (MulFun shift shift) x :=
    continuousAtOn_mul hshift hshift
  have hsquare :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain square x := by
    apply continuousAtOn_congr ?_ hsquare0
    intro y _hy
    unfold square MulFun
    exact Eq.symm (powNat_two (shift y))
  have hgap_lt :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
        (square x) := by
    unfold square shift invTwo
    exact one_add_lt_powNat_two_one_add_half hxpos
  let gap := RealTheory.sub (square x)
    (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
  have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap := by
    unfold gap
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hgap_lt
  cases hsquare.right gap hgap_pos with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      let hxhalf := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x
      let radius := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F delta hxhalf
      have hxhalf_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero hxhalf := by
        unfold hxhalf
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hxpos
      have hradius_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero radius := by
        unfold radius
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
          hdelta.left hxhalf_pos
      have hradius_le_delta : RealTheory.le radius delta := by
        unfold radius
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F delta hxhalf
      have hradius_le_half : RealTheory.le radius hxhalf := by
        unfold radius
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F delta hxhalf
      let left := RealTheory.sub x radius
      have hleft_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero left := by
        have hrad_le_sub :
            RealTheory.le radius (RealTheory.sub x hxhalf) := by
          have hxhalf_sub :
              RealTheory.sub x hxhalf = hxhalf := by
            unfold hxhalf
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_half_self F x
          rw [hxhalf_sub]
          exact hradius_le_half
        have hhalf_le_left :
            RealTheory.le hxhalf left := by
          unfold left
          exact le_sub_of_le_sub_left hrad_le_sub
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
          hxhalf_pos hhalf_le_left
      have hleft_lt_x : RealTheory.lt left x := by
        unfold left
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos
          F hradius_pos
      cases exists_natDivExponentPoint_between_pos
          hleft_pos hleft_lt_x with
      | intro q hq =>
          refine Exists.intro q ?_
          refine And.intro
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hq.right) ?_
          have hq_ne_x : Not (NatDivExponentPoint q = x) := by
            intro hqx
            rw [hqx] at hq
            exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F x) hq.right
          have hsub_delta_le_sub_radius :
              RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub x delta)
                (RealTheory.sub x radius) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
              F (F.le_refl x) hradius_le_delta
          have hx_delta_lt_q :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x delta)
                (NatDivExponentPoint q) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
              hsub_delta_le_sub_radius hq.left
          have hx_lt_x_delta :
              RealTheory.lt x (RealTheory.add x delta) := by
            have h := RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hdelta.left x
            change
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.add x RealTheory.zero)
                (RealTheory.add x delta) at h
            rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
          have hq_lt_x_delta :
              RealTheory.lt (NatDivExponentPoint q)
                (RealTheory.add x delta) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hq.right
              hx_lt_x_delta
          have hdist :
              RealTheory.lt (dist (NatDivExponentPoint q) x)
                delta := by
            change
              F.lt
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                  (F.sub (NatDivExponentPoint q) x))
                delta
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
              F hx_delta_lt_q hq_lt_x_delta
          have hclose :
              RealTheory.lt
                (dist (square (NatDivExponentPoint q))
                  (square x)) gap :=
            hdelta.right (NatDivExponentPoint q) trivial
              hq_ne_x hdist
          have hlower :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.sub (square x) gap)
                (square (NatDivExponentPoint q)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hclose
          have hsub_gap :
              RealTheory.sub (square x) gap =
                RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x := by
            unfold gap
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F
              (square x) (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
          rw [hsub_gap] at hlower
          exact hlower

name: powByIntDiv_euler_le_inv_one_sub_of_point_le
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_euler_le_inv_one_sub_of_point_le
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one)
    (q : IntDivExponent)
    (hqle : RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint q) x) :
    RealTheory.le (powByIntDiv D.extension.base q)
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hden_x_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxlt
  have hden_x_le_one :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)
        RealTheory.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic
      F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxpos)
  have hone_le_target :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)) :=
    one_le_inv_of_pos_le_one hden_x_pos hden_x_le_one
  cases q with
  | mk numerator denominator hden =>
      cases numerator with
      | ofNat n =>
          let qNat : NatDivExponent :=
            { numerator := n
              denominator := denominator
              denominator_ne_zero := hden }
          have hqnat_le_x :
              RealTheory.le (NatDivExponentPoint qNat) x := by
            change
              RealTheory.le
                (IntDivExponentPoint
                  (IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv qNat)) x at hqle
            rwa [intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv] at hqle
          have hqnat_lt_one :
              RealTheory.lt (NatDivExponentPoint qNat)
                RealTheory.one :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
              hqnat_le_x hxlt
          have hpow_upper :
              RealTheory.le (powByNatDiv D.extension.base qNat)
                (RealTheory.inv
                  (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                    (NatDivExponentPoint qNat))) :=
            isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_upper_const
              D.base_is_euler_number qNat hqnat_lt_one
          have hden_q_pos :
              RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                  (NatDivExponentPoint qNat)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hqnat_lt_one
          have hden_le :
              RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)
                (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                  (NatDivExponentPoint qNat)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
              F (F.le_refl RealTheory.one) hqnat_le_x
          have hinv_le :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.inv
                  (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                    (NatDivExponentPoint qNat)))
                (RealTheory.inv
                  (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
              F hden_x_pos hden_q_pos hden_le
          change
            RealTheory.le (powByNatDiv D.extension.base qNat)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x))
          exact RealTheory.le_trans hpow_upper hinv_le
      | negSucc n =>
          let qNat : NatDivExponent :=
            { numerator := n + 1
              denominator := denominator
              denominator_ne_zero := hden }
          have hbase_one_le :
              RealTheory.le RealTheory.one D.extension.base :=
            isEulerNumber_one_le D.base_is_euler_number
          have hle_one :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.inv
                  (powByNatDiv D.extension.base qNat))
                RealTheory.one :=
            inv_powByNatDiv_le_one_of_one_le
              hbase_one_le qNat
          change
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.inv
                (powByNatDiv D.extension.base qNat))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x))
          exact RealTheory.le_trans hle_one hone_le_target

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_le_inv_one_sub

theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_le_inv_one_sub
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)

name: one_sub_lt_mul_one_sub_half
statement:
theorem one_sub_lt_mul_one_sub_half
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x))
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x
  let den := RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one h
  have hh_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hxpos
  have hh_add : RealTheory.add h h = x := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F x
  have hh_lt_x : RealTheory.lt h x := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hxpos
  have hh_lt_one : RealTheory.lt h RealTheory.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hh_lt_x hxlt
  have hden_lt_one : RealTheory.lt den RealTheory.one := by
    unfold den
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hh_pos
  have hmul_den_h_lt_h :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul den h) h := by
    have hmul :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right
        F hden_lt_one hh_pos
    change F.lt (F.mul den h) (F.mul F.one h) at hmul
    rwa [F.one_mul] at hmul
  have htarget_eq :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x =
        RealTheory.sub den h := by
    rw [<- hh_add]
    unfold den
    exact
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add
        F RealTheory.one h h).symm
  have hprod_eq :
      RealTheory.mul den den =
        RealTheory.sub den (RealTheory.mul den h) := by
    unfold den
    change
      F.mul (F.sub F.one h) (F.sub F.one h) =
        F.sub (F.sub F.one h) (F.mul (F.sub F.one h) h)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F]
    rw [F.mul_one]
  have htarget_lt_prod :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)
        (RealTheory.mul den den) := by
    rw [htarget_eq, hprod_eq]
    exact
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt
        F hmul_den_h_lt_h
  exact htarget_lt_prod

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_local_upper
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_local_upper
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData) :
    NaturalExpLocalUpper (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxpos hxlt
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x
  let den := RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one h
  have hh_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hxpos
  have hh_add : RealTheory.add h h = x := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F x
  have hh_lt_x : RealTheory.lt h x := by
    unfold h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hxpos
  have hh_lt_one : RealTheory.lt h RealTheory.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hh_lt_x hxlt
  have hden_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero den := by
    unfold den
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hh_lt_one
  have htarget_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxlt
  have hprod_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul den den) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hden_pos hden_pos
  have hden_ne : Not (den = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos hzero.symm
  have hupper_half :
      RealTheory.le (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D h)
        (RealTheory.inv den) := by
    unfold den
    exact naturalExpDedekindExtension_le_inv_one_sub
      D hh_pos hh_lt_one
  have hexp_half_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D h) :=
    naturalExpDedekindExtension_maps_positive D h trivial
  have hinvden_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv den) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos
  have hsq_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul
          (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D h)
          (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D h))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv den)
          (RealTheory.inv den)) := by
    have hstep1 :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul
            (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D h)
            (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D h))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv den)
            (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D h)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
        F hupper_half
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hexp_half_pos)
    have hstep2 :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv den)
            (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D h))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv den)
            (RealTheory.inv den)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
        F hupper_half
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinvden_pos)
    exact F.le_trans hstep1 hstep2
  have htarget_lt_prod :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)
        (RealTheory.mul den den) := by
    unfold den h
    exact one_sub_lt_mul_one_sub_half hxpos hxlt
  have hinv_sq_lt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv den)
          (RealTheory.inv den))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)) := by
    have hinv_prod :
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul den den))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
        F htarget_pos hprod_pos htarget_lt_prod
    have hinv_eq :
        RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul den den) =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv den) (RealTheory.inv den) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hden_ne hden_ne
    rwa [hinv_eq] at hinv_prod
  have hexp_x_eq :
      NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x =
        RealTheory.mul
          (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D h)
          (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D h) := by
    rw [<- hh_add]
    exact naturalExpDedekindExtension_add_law D h h
  rw [hexp_x_eq]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hsq_le hinv_sq_lt

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_neg_nat_value
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_neg_nat_value
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    (n : Nat) :
    NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D
        (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n)) =
      RealTheory.inv (powNat D.extension.base n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hmul :=
    naturalExpDedekindExtension_add_law D
      (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n)) (RealTheory.nat n)
  rw [RealTheory.neg_add] at hmul
  change
    RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D.extension RealTheory.zero =
      RealTheory.mul
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D
          (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n)))
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D (RealTheory.nat n)) at hmul
  rw [rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_zero D.extension] at hmul
  rw [naturalExpDedekindExtension_nat_value D n] at hmul
  have hpowpos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (powNat D.extension.base n) :=
    powNat_pos D.extension.base_positive n
  have hpowne : Not (powNat D.extension.base n = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hpowpos h.symm
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right
    F hpowne hmul.symm

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_neg_value
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_neg_value
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)

    NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D

      RealTheory.mul
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D (RealTheory.neg x))
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x) at hmul
  rw [rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_zero D.extension] at hmul
  have hxpos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x) :=
    naturalExpDedekindExtension_maps_positive D x trivial
  have hxne :
      Not (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x = RealTheory.zero) := by

  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right
    F hxne hmul.symm

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_neg_local_lower_of_local_upper
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_neg_local_lower_of_local_upper
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    (hupper :
      NaturalExpLocalUpper (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D))
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)
      (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D (RealTheory.neg x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hden_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxlt
  have hinv_den_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos
  have hexp_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x) :=
    naturalExpDedekindExtension_maps_positive D x trivial
  have hloc :
      RealTheory.lt
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)) :=
    hupper x hxpos hxlt
  have hinv_lt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)))
        (RealTheory.inv (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
      F hexp_pos hinv_den_pos hloc
  rw [inv_inv_of_pos hden_pos] at hinv_lt
  rwa [<- naturalExpDedekindExtension_neg_value D x] at hinv_lt

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_global_neg_lower_of_local_upper
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_global_neg_lower_of_local_upper
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    (hupper :
      NaturalExpLocalUpper (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D))
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)
      (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D (RealTheory.neg x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hone_le_x : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x
  · have hsub_nonpos :
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)
          RealTheory.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hone_le_x
    have hexp_pos :
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
          (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D (RealTheory.neg x)) :=
      naturalExpDedekindExtension_maps_positive
        D (RealTheory.neg x) trivial
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
      F hsub_nonpos hexp_pos
  · have hx_le_one : RealTheory.le x RealTheory.one := by
      cases F.le_total x RealTheory.one with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr h => exact False.elim (hone_le_x h)
    have hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx_le_one hone_le_x
    exact naturalExpDedekindExtension_neg_local_lower_of_local_upper
      D hupper hxpos hxlt

name: mul_sub_one_inv_eq_one_sub_inv
statement:
theorem mul_sub_one_inv_eq_one_sub_inv
    {x : Point} (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv x) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x)
proof:

  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x) =
      F.sub F.one (F.inv x)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F]
  rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hx]
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: one_sub_lt_neg_of_one_add_lt
statement:
theorem one_sub_lt_neg_of_one_add_lt
    {x y : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one y) x) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)
      (RealTheory.neg y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hy_lt_sub :
      RealTheory.lt y (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) :=
    sub_one_lt_of_one_add_lt h
  have hneg :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))
        (RealTheory.neg y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hy_lt_sub
  have hrev :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x =
        RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x RealTheory.one
  rwa [<- hrev] at hneg

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_exists_nat_value_gt
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_exists_nat_value_gt
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    {L : Point} (hL : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero L) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.lt L
          (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D (RealTheory.nat n)))
proof:
:= by
  let two := RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one
  have htwo_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero two := by
    unfold two
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        RealTheory.zero_lt_one
        (by
          have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_left
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
            RealTheory.one
          rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h))
  have htwo_le_base :
      RealTheory.le two D.extension.base := by
    unfold two
    exact isEulerNumber_two_le D.base_is_euler_number
  cases exists_powNat_two_gt hL with
  | intro n htwo_gt =>
      have hpow_le :
          RealTheory.le (powNat two n)
            (powNat D.extension.base n) :=
        powNat_mono_nonneg htwo_nonneg htwo_le_base n
      refine Exists.intro n ?_
      rw [naturalExpDedekindExtension_nat_value D n]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base htwo_gt hpow_le

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_positive_in_image
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_positive_in_image
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    {y : Point} (hy : PositiveDomain y) :
    Image UniversalDomain (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D) y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hy_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero y :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy
  have hinvy_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hy
  have hinvy_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinvy_pos
  cases naturalExpDedekindExtension_exists_nat_value_gt
      D hinvy_nonneg with
  | intro nlow hlow =>
      cases naturalExpDedekindExtension_exists_nat_value_gt
          D hy_nonneg with
      | intro nhigh hhigh =>
          let left := RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat nlow)
          let right := RealTheory.nat nhigh
          have hleft_le_zero :
              RealTheory.le left RealTheory.zero := by
            unfold left
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonpos_of_nonneg
              F (RealTheory.nat_nonneg nlow)
          have hzero_le_right :
              RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero right := by
            unfold right
            exact RealTheory.nat_nonneg nhigh
          have hleft_le_right : RealTheory.le left right :=
            RealTheory.le_trans hleft_le_zero hzero_le_right
          have hcont :
              ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval left right)
                (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D) :=
            continuousOn_subset
              (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval left right)
              (G := UniversalDomain)
              (f := NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D)
              (fun _ _ => trivial)
              (naturalExpDedekindExtension_continuousOn D)
          have hlow_le :
              RealTheory.le
                (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D left) y := by
            have hle :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.inv
                    (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D
                      (RealTheory.nat nlow)))
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv y)) := by
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
                F hinvy_pos
                (naturalExpDedekindExtension_maps_positive
                  D (RealTheory.nat nlow) trivial)
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlow)
            rw [inv_inv_of_pos hy] at hle
            rw [naturalExpDedekindExtension_nat_value D nlow] at hle
            rw [<- naturalExpDedekindExtension_neg_nat_value D nlow] at hle
            exact hle
          have hhigh_le :
              RealTheory.le y
                (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D right) := by
            unfold right
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hhigh
          have hbetween :
              RealTheory.Between
                (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D left)
                y
                (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D right) := by
            unfold RealTheory.Between IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Between
            exact And.intro hlow_le hhigh_le
          cases intermediate_value_closedInterval
              hleft_le_right hcont hbetween with
          | intro c hc =>
              exact Exists.intro c (And.intro trivial hc.right)

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_exp_log
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_exp_log
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    (x : Point) (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionLogFun D x) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  unfold NaturalExpDedekindExtensionLogFun
  exact naturalExpDedekindExtension_image_log_right_inverse
    D (naturalExpDedekindExtension_positive_in_image D hx)

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_exp
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_exp
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    (x : Point) :
    NaturalExpDedekindExtensionLogFun D
        (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D x) =

proof:
:= by
