name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_one
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_one
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData) :
    NaturalExpDedekindExtensionLogFun D RealTheory.one =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have h := naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_exp D RealTheory.zero
  change
    NaturalExpDedekindExtensionLogFun D
        (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D.extension RealTheory.zero) =
      RealTheory.zero at h
  rwa [rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_zero D.extension] at h

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_mul_law
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_mul_law
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData) :
    NaturalLogMultiplicativeAdditive
      (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionLogFun D)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy
  let log := NaturalExpDedekindExtensionLogFun D
  have hxypos : PositiveDomain (RealTheory.mul x y) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hx hy
  have hleft :
      NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D
          (log (RealTheory.mul x y)) =
        RealTheory.mul x y := by
    unfold log
    exact naturalExpDedekindExtension_exp_log D
      (RealTheory.mul x y) hxypos
  have hxexp :
      NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D (log x) = x := by
    unfold log
    exact naturalExpDedekindExtension_exp_log D x hx
  have hyexp :
      NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D (log y) = y := by
    unfold log
    exact naturalExpDedekindExtension_exp_log D y hy
  have hright :=
    naturalExpDedekindExtension_add_law D (log x) (log y)
  rw [hxexp, hyexp] at hright
  exact
    naturalExpDedekindExtension_injectiveOn D
      (log (RealTheory.mul x y))
      (RealTheory.add (log x) (log y))
      trivial trivial
      (Eq.trans hleft hright.symm)

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_ne_zero_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_ne_zero_of_ne_one
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.one)) :
    Not
      (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionLogFun D x =
        RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro hlog0
  have h := naturalExpDedekindExtension_exp_log D x hx
  rw [hlog0] at h
  change
    RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D.extension
        RealTheory.zero = x at h
  rw [rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_zero D.extension] at h
  exact hxne h.symm

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_local_upper_of_exp_bounds
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_local_upper_of_exp_bounds
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    (hlower :
      NaturalExpLocalLower (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D))
    (hupper :
      NaturalExpLocalUpper (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D)) :
    NaturalLogLocalUpper
      (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionLogFun D)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hxne
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let log := NaturalExpDedekindExtensionLogFun D
  let y := log x
  have hyne : Not (y = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold y log
    exact naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_ne_zero_of_ne_one
      D hx hxne
  cases F.le_total RealTheory.zero y with
  | inl h0y =>
      have hypos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0y
        intro hy0
        exact hyne (RealTheory.le_antisymm hy0 h0y)
      have hglobal :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one y)
            (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D y) :=
        naturalExp_global_lower_of_local
          (by
            unfold NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun
            exact rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_zero
              D.extension)
          (naturalExpDedekindExtension_add_law D)
          hlower hypos
      have hto_x :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one y) x := by
        unfold y log at hglobal
        rwa [naturalExpDedekindExtension_exp_log D x hx] at hglobal
      change
        RealTheory.lt y (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
      exact sub_one_lt_of_one_add_lt hto_x
  | inr hy0 =>
      have hyneg : RealTheory.lt y RealTheory.zero := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hy0
        intro h0y
        exact hyne (RealTheory.le_antisymm hy0 h0y)
      let z := RealTheory.neg y
      have hzpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero z := by
        unfold z
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hyneg
        change
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.zero)
            (RealTheory.neg y) at h
        rwa [RealTheory.neg_zero] at h
      have hneg :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one z)
            (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D
              (RealTheory.neg z)) :=
        naturalExpDedekindExtension_global_neg_lower_of_local_upper
          D hupper hzpos
      have hto_x :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one y) x := by
        unfold z at hneg
        rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg] at hneg
        rw [RealTheory.neg_neg] at hneg
        unfold y log at hneg
        rwa [naturalExpDedekindExtension_exp_log D x hx] at hneg
      change
        RealTheory.lt y (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
      exact sub_one_lt_of_one_add_lt hto_x

name: naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_local_lower_of_exp_bounds
statement:
theorem naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_local_lower_of_exp_bounds
    (D : NaturalExpDedekindExtensionData)
    (hlower :
      NaturalExpLocalLower (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D))
    (hupper :
      NaturalExpLocalUpper (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D)) :
    NaturalLogLocalLower
      (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionLogFun D)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hxne
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let log := NaturalExpDedekindExtensionLogFun D
  let y := log x
  have hxne0 : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx hzero.symm
  have hrewrite :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv x) =
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    mul_sub_one_inv_eq_one_sub_inv hxne0
  rw [hrewrite]
  have hyne : Not (y = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold y log
    exact naturalExpDedekindExtension_log_ne_zero_of_ne_one
      D hx hxne
  cases F.le_total RealTheory.zero y with
  | inl h0y =>
      have hypos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0y
        intro hy0
        exact hyne (RealTheory.le_antisymm hy0 h0y)
      have hneg :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one y)
            (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D
              (RealTheory.neg y)) :=
        naturalExpDedekindExtension_global_neg_lower_of_local_upper
          D hupper hypos
      have hto_inv :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one y)
            (RealTheory.inv x) := by
        rw [naturalExpDedekindExtension_neg_value D y] at hneg
        unfold y log at hneg
        rwa [naturalExpDedekindExtension_exp_log D x hx] at hneg
      have hresult :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.inv x)) y :=
        one_sub_lt_of_sub_one_lt hto_inv
      change
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x)) y
      exact hresult
  | inr hy0 =>
      have hyneg : RealTheory.lt y RealTheory.zero := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hy0
        intro h0y
        exact hyne (RealTheory.le_antisymm hy0 h0y)
      let z := RealTheory.neg y
      have hzpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero z := by
        unfold z
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hyneg
        change
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.zero)
            (RealTheory.neg y) at h
        rwa [RealTheory.neg_zero] at h
      have hglobal :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one z)
            (NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun D z) :=
        naturalExp_global_lower_of_local
          (by
            unfold NaturalExpDedekindExtensionFun
            exact rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_zero
              D.extension)
          (naturalExpDedekindExtension_add_law D)
          hlower hzpos
      have hto_inv :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one z)
            (RealTheory.inv x) := by
        unfold z at hglobal
        rw [naturalExpDedekindExtension_neg_value D y] at hglobal
        unfold y log at hglobal
        rwa [naturalExpDedekindExtension_exp_log D x hx] at hglobal
      have hresult :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.inv x)) (RealTheory.neg z) :=
        one_sub_lt_neg_of_one_add_lt hto_inv
      unfold z at hresult
      rw [RealTheory.neg_neg] at hresult
      change
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x)) y
      exact hresult

name: natDivExponentPoint_mul_denominator
statement:
theorem natDivExponentPoint_mul_denominator
    (q : NatDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
      (RealTheory.nat q.denominator) =
        RealTheory.nat q.numerator
proof:
:= by
  unfold NatDivExponentPoint
  rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
  rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel
    (RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero)]
  exact RealTheory.mul_one (RealTheory.nat q.numerator)

name: natDivExponentPoint_mul_denominator_mul
statement:
theorem natDivExponentPoint_mul_denominator_mul
    (q r : NatDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
        (RealTheory.nat q.denominator))
        (RealTheory.nat r.denominator) =
        RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * r.denominator)
proof:
:= by
  rw [natDivExponentPoint_mul_denominator]
  change
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
      (RealTheory.nat q.numerator)
      (RealTheory.nat r.denominator) =
        RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * r.denominator)
  exact Eq.symm
    (RealTheory.nat_mul q.numerator r.denominator)

name: natDivExponentPoint_mul_nat_mul_denominator
statement:
theorem natDivExponentPoint_mul_nat_mul_denominator
    (q : NatDivExponent) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
        (RealTheory.nat k))
      (RealTheory.nat q.denominator) =
        RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold NatDivExponentPoint
  calc
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.numerator)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)))
          (RealTheory.nat k))
        (RealTheory.nat q.denominator) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.numerator)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.numerator)
            (RealTheory.nat k))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q.denominator))
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)) := by
          exact RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm
            (RealTheory.nat q.numerator)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q.denominator))
            (RealTheory.nat k)
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.numerator)
            (RealTheory.nat k))
          RealTheory.one := by
          rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel
            (RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero)]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.numerator)
          (RealTheory.nat k) := by
          exact RealTheory.mul_one
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.numerator)
              (RealTheory.nat k))
    _ = RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * k) := by
          change
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
              (RealTheory.nat q.numerator)
              (RealTheory.nat k) =
                RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * k)
          exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.nat_mul q.numerator k)

name: natDivExponentPoint_half_eq_even_scaled
statement:
theorem natDivExponentPoint_half_eq_even_scaled
    (q : NatDivExponent) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (k + 1)))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.nat
            (2 * q.denominator * (k + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := 2 * q.denominator * (k + 1)
  have hN_ne : Not (RealTheory.nat N = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold N
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (Nat.mul_ne_zero
        (Nat.mul_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
          q.denominator_ne_zero)
        (Nat.succ_ne_zero k))
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero
    F (z := RealTheory.nat N) hN_ne
  have htwo_ne : Not (RealTheory.nat 2 = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have hN_nat :
      RealTheory.nat N =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
            (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))) := by
    unfold N
    calc
      RealTheory.nat (2 * q.denominator * (k + 1)) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (2 * q.denominator))
            (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) := by
            exact RealTheory.nat_mul
              (2 * q.denominator) (k + 1)
      _ =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
              (RealTheory.nat q.denominator))
            (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) := by
            rw [RealTheory.nat_mul 2 q.denominator]
            rfl
      _ =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
              (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
  calc
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)))
        (RealTheory.nat N) =
        RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))
            (RealTheory.nat N)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
                (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))))) := by
          rw [hN_nat]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))
              (RealTheory.nat 2))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
              (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))) := by
          rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))
            (RealTheory.nat 2)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
              (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
              (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))) := by
          rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel htwo_ne]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
            (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))) := by
          rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
            (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))
          (RealTheory.nat q.denominator) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_comm
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
            (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))]
          rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (k + 1)) := by
          exact natDivExponentPoint_mul_nat_mul_denominator
            q (k + 1)
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (k + 1)))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N)))
          (RealTheory.nat N) := by
          calc
            RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (k + 1)) =
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (k + 1)))
                  RealTheory.one := by
                exact Eq.symm
                  (RealTheory.mul_one
                    (RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (k + 1))))
            _ =
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (k + 1)))
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N))
                    (RealTheory.nat N)) := by
                rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hN_ne]
            _ =
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (k + 1)))
                    (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N)))
                  (RealTheory.nat N) := by
                rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]

name: natDivExponentPoint_eq_even_scaled
statement:
theorem natDivExponentPoint_eq_even_scaled
    (q : NatDivExponent) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (2 * (k + 1))))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.nat
            (2 * q.denominator * (k + 1)))) =
      NatDivExponentPoint q
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let scale := 2 * (k + 1)
  let N := 2 * q.denominator * (k + 1)
  have hN_ne : Not (N = 0) := by
    unfold N
    exact Nat.mul_ne_zero
      (Nat.mul_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
        q.denominator_ne_zero)
      (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
  have hN_point_ne : Not (RealTheory.nat N = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hN_ne
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero
    F (z := RealTheory.nat N) hN_point_ne
  have hN_nat :
      RealTheory.nat N =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat scale)
          (RealTheory.nat q.denominator) := by
    unfold N scale
    calc
      RealTheory.nat (2 * q.denominator * (k + 1)) =
          RealTheory.nat (q.denominator * (2 * (k + 1))) := by
          have hnat : 2 * q.denominator * (k + 1) =
              q.denominator * (2 * (k + 1)) := by
            calc
              2 * q.denominator * (k + 1) =
                  q.denominator * 2 * (k + 1) := by
                  rw [Nat.mul_comm 2 q.denominator]
              _ = q.denominator * (2 * (k + 1)) := by
                  rw [Nat.mul_assoc]
          rw [hnat]
      _ =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
            (RealTheory.nat (2 * (k + 1))) := by
          exact RealTheory.nat_mul q.denominator
            (2 * (k + 1))
      _ =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (2 * (k + 1)))
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_comm]
  calc
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (2 * (k + 1))))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N)))
        (RealTheory.nat N) =
        RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (2 * (k + 1))) := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
            F (RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * (2 * (k + 1))))
            hN_point_ne
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
            (RealTheory.nat scale))
          (RealTheory.nat q.denominator) := by
          unfold scale
          exact Eq.symm
            (natDivExponentPoint_mul_nat_mul_denominator
              q (2 * (k + 1)))
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat scale)
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.nat N) := by
          rw [hN_nat]

name: powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_square_lower_const
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_square_lower_const
    (q : NatDivExponent) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))))
        2)
      (powByNatDiv
        (EulerNumberSequence
          (EulerEvenMultipleIndex q.denominator k)) q)
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_square_lower
      q k
  rw [<- natDivExponentPoint_half_eq_even_scaled q k] at h
  exact h

name: isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_square_lower_const
statement:
theorem isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_square_lower_const
    {e : Point} (he : IsEulerNumber e)
    (q : NatDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powNat
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))))
        2)
      (powByNatDiv e q)
proof:
:= by
  let lower :=
    powNat
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))))
      2
  have hseq :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
          (fun n : Nat => powByNatDiv (EulerNumberSequence n) q)
          (EulerEvenMultipleIndex q.denominator))
        (powByNatDiv e q) :=
    isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_evenMultiple_tendsto he q
  have hevent :
      Eventually
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.le lower
            ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
              (fun n : Nat =>
                powByNatDiv (EulerNumberSequence n) q)
              (EulerEvenMultipleIndex q.denominator)) k)) := by
    apply Eventually.of_forall
    intro k
    unfold lower IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
    exact
      powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_square_lower_const
        q k
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const lower)
    hseq hevent

name: powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_upper_const
statement:
theorem powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_upper_const
    (q : NatDivExponent) (k : Nat)
    (hq_lt_one :
      RealTheory.lt (NatDivExponentPoint q) RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powByNatDiv
        (EulerNumberSequence
          (EulerEvenMultipleIndex q.denominator k)) q)
      (RealTheory.inv
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (NatDivExponentPoint q)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := 2 * q.denominator * (k + 1)
  let m := q.numerator * (2 * (k + 1))
  let eps := RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N)
  have hN_ne : Not (N = 0) := by
    unfold N
    exact Nat.mul_ne_zero
      (Nat.mul_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
        q.denominator_ne_zero)
      (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
  have hN_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat N) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hN_ne
  have heps_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps := by
    unfold eps
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hN_pos)
  have hscaled :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) eps =
        NatDivExponentPoint q := by
    unfold m eps N
    exact natDivExponentPoint_eq_even_scaled q k
  have hden_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) eps)) := by
    rw [hscaled]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hq_lt_one
  have hupper :
      RealTheory.le
        (powNat (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps) m)
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) eps))) :=
    powNat_one_add_le_inv_one_sub_nat_mul
      heps_nonneg hden_pos
  rw [hscaled] at hupper
  rw [powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_eq q k]
  exact hupper

name: isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_upper_const
statement:
theorem isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_upper_const
    {e : Point} (he : IsEulerNumber e)
    (q : NatDivExponent)
    (hq_lt_one :
      RealTheory.lt (NatDivExponentPoint q) RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powByNatDiv e q)
      (RealTheory.inv
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (NatDivExponentPoint q)))
proof:
:= by
  let upper :=
    RealTheory.inv
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (NatDivExponentPoint q))
  have hseq :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
          (fun n : Nat => powByNatDiv (EulerNumberSequence n) q)
          (EulerEvenMultipleIndex q.denominator))
        (powByNatDiv e q) :=
    isEulerNumber_powByNatDiv_evenMultiple_tendsto he q
  have hevent :
      Eventually
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.le
            ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
              (fun n : Nat =>
                powByNatDiv (EulerNumberSequence n) q)
              (EulerEvenMultipleIndex q.denominator)) k)
            upper) := by
    apply Eventually.of_forall
    intro k
    unfold upper IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
    exact powByNatDiv_eulerNumberSequence_evenMultiple_upper_const
      q k hq_lt_one
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le
    hseq (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const upper) hevent

name: natDivExponentPoint_mul_common_denominator
statement:
theorem natDivExponentPoint_mul_common_denominator
    (q r : NatDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
      (RealTheory.nat (q.denominator * r.denominator)) =
        RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * r.denominator)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  calc
    RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
        (RealTheory.nat (q.denominator * r.denominator)) =
        RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
            (RealTheory.nat r.denominator)) := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun t : Point =>
              RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q) t)
            (RealTheory.nat_mul q.denominator r.denominator)
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat r.denominator)
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_comm
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
            (RealTheory.nat r.denominator)]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
            (RealTheory.nat r.denominator))
          (RealTheory.nat q.denominator) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
    _ = RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * r.denominator) :=
          natDivExponentPoint_mul_nat_mul_denominator q
            r.denominator

name: natDivExponentPoint_add
statement:
theorem natDivExponentPoint_add
    (q r : NatDivExponent) :
    NatDivExponentPoint (NatDivExponent.add q r) =
      RealTheory.add (NatDivExponentPoint q)
        (NatDivExponentPoint r)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let commonDen := q.denominator * r.denominator
  have hcommon_ne :
      Not (RealTheory.nat commonDen = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (Nat.mul_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero
        r.denominator_ne_zero)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero
    F (z := RealTheory.nat commonDen) hcommon_ne
  calc
    RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint (NatDivExponent.add q r))
        (RealTheory.nat commonDen) =
        RealTheory.nat
          (q.numerator * r.denominator +
            r.numerator * q.denominator) := by
          unfold commonDen
          exact natDivExponentPoint_mul_denominator
            (NatDivExponent.add q r)
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.nat (q.numerator * r.denominator))
          (RealTheory.nat (r.numerator * q.denominator)) := by
          exact RealTheory.nat_add
            (q.numerator * r.denominator)
            (r.numerator * q.denominator)
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
            (RealTheory.nat commonDen))
          (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint r)
            (RealTheory.nat commonDen)) := by
          rw [natDivExponentPoint_mul_common_denominator]
          unfold commonDen
          rw [Nat.mul_comm q.denominator r.denominator]
          rw [natDivExponentPoint_mul_common_denominator]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add (NatDivExponentPoint q)
            (NatDivExponentPoint r))
          (RealTheory.nat commonDen) := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_mul]

name: cross_mul_le_of_natDivExponentPoint_le
statement:
theorem cross_mul_le_of_natDivExponentPoint_le
    {q r : NatDivExponent}
    (hqr : RealTheory.le (NatDivExponentPoint q)
      (NatDivExponentPoint r)) :
    q.numerator * r.denominator <=
      r.numerator * q.denominator
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hqden_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.nat q.denominator) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero)
  have hrden_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.nat r.denominator) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero r.denominator_ne_zero)
  have h1 :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.nat q.denominator))
        (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint r)
          (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hqr hqden_nonneg
  have h2 :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint q)
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator))
          (RealTheory.nat r.denominator))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (NatDivExponentPoint r)
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator))
          (RealTheory.nat r.denominator)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right h1 hrden_nonneg
  rw [natDivExponentPoint_mul_denominator_mul] at h2
  rw [natDivExponentPoint_mul_nat_mul_denominator] at h2
  exact RealTheory.le_of_nat_le_nat h2

name: natDivExponentPoint_nonneg
statement:
theorem natDivExponentPoint_nonneg
    (q : NatDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (NatDivExponentPoint q)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold NatDivExponentPoint
  exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg
    (RealTheory.nat_nonneg q.numerator)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
        (RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero)))

name: natDivExponentPoint_pos_of_numerator_pos
statement:
theorem natDivExponentPoint_pos_of_numerator_pos
    {n d : Nat} (hn : Not (n = 0)) (hd : Not (d = 0)) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (NatDivExponentPoint
        { numerator := n
          denominator := d
          denominator_ne_zero := hd })
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold NatDivExponentPoint
  exact RealTheory.mul_pos
    (RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hn)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
      (RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hd))

name: exists_positive_natDivExponentPoint_pow_lt_one_add_of_one_le
statement:
theorem exists_positive_natDivExponentPoint_pow_lt_one_add_of_one_le
    {base eps : Point}
    (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun q : NatDivExponent =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (NatDivExponentPoint q))
          (RealTheory.lt (powByNatDiv base q)
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps)))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_nthRoot_succ_lt_one_add_of_one_le hbase heps with
  | intro d hd =>
      let q : NatDivExponent :=
        { numerator := 1
          denominator := d + 1
          denominator_ne_zero := Nat.succ_ne_zero d }
      refine Exists.intro q ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · dsimp [q]
        exact natDivExponentPoint_pos_of_numerator_pos
          (Nat.succ_ne_zero 0) (Nat.succ_ne_zero d)
      · dsimp [q]
        unfold powByNatDiv
        rw [powNat_one]
        exact hd

name: ExtendsIntDivPowers.toNatDiv
statement:
theorem ExtendsIntDivPowers.toNatDiv
    {base : Point} {exp : Map}
    (h : ExtendsIntDivPowers base exp) :
    ExtendsNatDivPowers base exp
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  have hq := h (IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv q)
  rw [intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv, powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv] at hq
  exact hq

name: intDivPowerMonotone_of_one_le
statement:
theorem intDivPowerMonotone_of_one_le
    {base : Point} (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base) :
    IntDivPowerMonotone base
proof:
:= by
  intro q r hqr
  cases q with
  | mk qnum qden qhd =>
      cases r with
      | mk rnum rden rhd =>
          cases qnum with
          | ofNat m =>
              cases rnum with
              | ofNat n =>
                  exact
                    powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv_le_ofNatDiv_of_point_le_of_one_le
                      hbase
                      (q :=
                        { numerator := m
                          denominator := qden
                          denominator_ne_zero := qhd })
                      (r :=
                        { numerator := n
                          denominator := rden
                          denominator_ne_zero := rhd })
                      hqr
              | negSucc n =>
                  exact False.elim
                    (not_intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv_le_negSucc
                      (m := m) (n := n) qhd rhd hqr)
          | negSucc m =>
              cases rnum with
              | ofNat n =>
                  exact
                    powByIntDiv_negSucc_le_ofNatDiv_of_one_le
                      hbase qhd
                      { numerator := n
                        denominator := rden
                        denominator_ne_zero := rhd }
              | negSucc n =>
                  exact
                    powByIntDiv_negSucc_le_negSucc_of_point_le_of_one_le
                      hbase qhd rhd hqr

name: powByIntDiv_lt_one_add_of_le_small_positive
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_lt_one_add_of_le_small_positive
    {base eps : Point}
    (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base)
    {small q : IntDivExponent}
    (hsmall :
      RealTheory.lt (powByIntDiv base small)
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps))
    (hqsmall :
      RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint q)
        (IntDivExponentPoint small)) :
    RealTheory.lt (powByIntDiv base q)
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps)
proof:
:= by
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    ((intDivPowerMonotone_of_one_le hbase) q small hqsmall)
    hsmall

name: exists_positive_intDivExponentPoint_upper_control_of_one_le
statement:
theorem exists_positive_intDivExponentPoint_upper_control_of_one_le
    {base eps : Point}
    (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun small : IntDivExponent =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (IntDivExponentPoint small))
          (And
            (RealTheory.lt (powByIntDiv base small)
              (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps))
            (forall q : IntDivExponent,
              RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint q)
                (IntDivExponentPoint small) ->
                RealTheory.lt (powByIntDiv base q)
                  (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps))))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_positive_intDivExponentPoint_pow_lt_one_add_of_one_le
      hbase heps with
  | intro small hsmall =>
      refine Exists.intro small ?_
      exact And.intro hsmall.left
        (And.intro hsmall.right
          (fun q hq =>
            powByIntDiv_lt_one_add_of_le_small_positive
              hbase hsmall.right hq))

name: mul_one_add_lt_add_of_le_mul_lt
statement:
theorem mul_one_add_lt_add_of_le_mul_lt
    {v M eta eps : Point}
    (hvM : RealTheory.le v M)
    (heta : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hMeta : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul M eta) eps) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul v (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eta))
      (RealTheory.add v eps)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hveta_le :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul v eta)
        (RealTheory.mul M eta) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hvM heta
  have hveta_lt :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul v eta) eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hveta_le hMeta
  have hexpand :
      RealTheory.mul v (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eta) =
        RealTheory.add v (RealTheory.mul v eta) := by
    calc
      RealTheory.mul v (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eta) =
          RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul v RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.mul v eta) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_add]
      _ = RealTheory.add v (RealTheory.mul v eta) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  rw [hexpand]
  exact RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hveta_lt v

name: exists_pos_mul_lt
statement:
theorem exists_pos_mul_lt
    {M eps : Point}
    (hM : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun eta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
          (RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul M eta) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_mul_gt hM heps with
  | intro n hn =>
      have hn_ne : Not (n = 0) := by
        intro hn0
        subst hn0
        have hbad : RealTheory.lt M RealTheory.zero := by
          change
            RealTheory.lt M
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 0) eps) at hn
          rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at hn
          change F.lt M (F.mul F.zero eps) at hn
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F eps] at hn
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hbad) hM
      let eta := RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)
      have hn_pos :
          RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat n) :=
        RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hn_ne
      have heta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta := by
        unfold eta
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hn_pos
      have hmul := RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hn heta_pos
      have hcancel :
          RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps)
              eta =
            eps := by
        unfold eta
        calc
          RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) =
              RealTheory.mul eps
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))) := by
              calc
                RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps)
                    (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) =
                    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                      (RealTheory.mul eps
                        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))) := by
                    rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
                _ =
                    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                      (RealTheory.mul
                        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) eps) := by
                    rw [RealTheory.mul_comm eps
                      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))]
                _ =
                    RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)))
                      eps := by
                    rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]
                _ =
                    RealTheory.mul eps
                      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))) := by
                    rw [RealTheory.mul_comm
                      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))) eps]
          _ = RealTheory.mul eps RealTheory.one := by
              rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel
                (RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn_ne)]
          _ = eps := by
              rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
      change
        F.lt (F.mul M eta)
          (F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps) eta) at hmul
      change F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps) eta = eps at hcancel
      rw [hcancel] at hmul
      exact Exists.intro eta (And.intro heta_pos hmul)

name: exists_positive_intDivExponentPoint_mul_factor_control
statement:
theorem exists_positive_intDivExponentPoint_mul_factor_control
    {base M eps : Point}
    (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base)
    (hM : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun small : IntDivExponent =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (IntDivExponentPoint small))
          (forall v : Point,
            RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero v ->
              RealTheory.le v M ->
                forall r : IntDivExponent,
                  RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint r)
                    (IntDivExponentPoint small) ->
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.mul v (powByIntDiv base r))
                      (RealTheory.add v eps)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases exists_pos_mul_lt hM heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      have heta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heta.left
      cases exists_positive_intDivExponentPoint_upper_control_of_one_le
          hbase heta.left with
      | intro small hsmall =>
          refine Exists.intro small ?_
          refine And.intro hsmall.left ?_
          intro v hvpos hvM r hrsmall
          have hpow_lt :
              RealTheory.lt (powByIntDiv base r)
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eta) :=
            hsmall.right.right r hrsmall
          have hmul_lt :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.mul v (powByIntDiv base r))
                (RealTheory.mul v
                  (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eta)) :=
            RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hpow_lt hvpos
          have hupper :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.mul v
                  (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eta))
                (RealTheory.add v eps) :=
            mul_one_add_lt_add_of_le_mul_lt
              hvM heta_nonneg heta.right
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hmul_lt hupper

name: powByIntDiv_add_small_lt_add_of_factor_control
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_add_small_lt_add_of_factor_control
    {base M eps : Point}
    (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base)
    {small : IntDivExponent}
    (hcontrol :
      forall v : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero v ->
          RealTheory.le v M ->
            forall r : IntDivExponent,
              RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint r)
                (IntDivExponentPoint small) ->
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.mul v (powByIntDiv base r))
                (RealTheory.add v eps))
    {p r : IntDivExponent}
    (hpM : RealTheory.le (powByIntDiv base p) M)
    (hrsmall :
      RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint r)
        (IntDivExponentPoint small)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (powByIntDiv base (IntDivExponent.add p r))
      (RealTheory.add (powByIntDiv base p) eps)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbase_pos : PositiveDomain base :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one hbase
  rw [powByIntDiv_add hbase_pos p r]
  exact hcontrol (powByIntDiv base p)
    (powByIntDiv_pos_of_pos hbase_pos p) hpM r hrsmall

name: natDivPowerCrossMonotone_of_one_le
statement:
theorem natDivPowerCrossMonotone_of_one_le

name: exists_intDivExponentPoint_lt
statement:
theorem exists_intDivExponentPoint_lt (x : Point) :
    Exists
      (fun q : IntDivExponent =>
        RealTheory.lt (IntDivExponentPoint q) x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_gt (RealTheory.neg x) with
  | intro n hn =>
      refine Exists.intro (IntDivExponent.negSuccNat n) ?_
      rw [intDivExponentPoint_negSuccNat]
      have hneg_n_lt_x :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n)) x := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hn
        change
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n))
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.neg x)) at h
        rwa [RealTheory.neg_neg] at h
      have hsucc_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F
          (RealTheory.nat_le_nat_succ n)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
        hsucc_le hneg_n_lt_x

name: exists_intDivExponentPoint_le
statement:
theorem exists_intDivExponentPoint_le (x : Point) :

proof:

name: exists_intDivExponentPoint_gt
statement:
theorem exists_intDivExponentPoint_gt (x : Point) :

proof:

name: exists_intDivExponentPoint_ge
statement:
theorem exists_intDivExponentPoint_ge (x : Point) :

name: rationalPowerLowerSet_nonempty
statement:
theorem rationalPowerLowerSet_nonempty

name: rationalPowerLowerSet_bounded_above_of_monotone
statement:
theorem rationalPowerLowerSet_bounded_above_of_monotone
    {base : Point} (hmono : IntDivPowerMonotone base)
    (x : Point) :
    Exists
      (IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
        (RationalPowerLowerSet base x))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_intDivExponentPoint_ge x with
  | intro r hr =>
      refine Exists.intro (powByIntDiv base r) ?_
      intro y hy

      | intro q hq =>
          rw [hq.right]
          exact hmono q r (RealTheory.le_trans hq.left hr)

statement:
theorem rationalPowerLowerSet_mono
    {base x y : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :

        RationalPowerLowerSet base y z
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  cases hz with
  | intro q hq =>
      exact Exists.intro q
        (And.intro (RealTheory.le_trans hq.left hxy) hq.right)

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_is_lub
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_is_lub
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData) (x : Point) :
    IsLeastUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
      (RationalPowerLowerSet D.base x)
      (rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue D x)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec
    (RealTheory.exists_lub (RationalPowerLowerSet D.base x)
      (rationalPowerLowerSet_nonempty D.base x)
      (rationalPowerLowerSet_bounded_above_of_monotone D.monotone x))

name: rationalPowerLowerSet_rational_greatest
statement:
theorem rationalPowerLowerSet_rational_greatest
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData) (q : IntDivExponent) :

      (RationalPowerLowerSet D.base (IntDivExponentPoint q))
      (powByIntDiv D.base q)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lub_of_greatest
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  · exact Exists.intro q
      (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl (IntDivExponentPoint q)) rfl)
  · intro y hy
    cases hy with
    | intro r hr =>
        rw [hr.right]
        exact D.monotone r q hr.left

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_extends_intDiv
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_extends_intDiv
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData) :
    ExtendsIntDivPowers D.base
      (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lub_unique
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_is_lub D
      (IntDivExponentPoint q))
    (rationalPowerLowerSet_rational_greatest D q)

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_on_intDiv
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_on_intDiv
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (q r : IntDivExponent) :
    RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D
        (RealTheory.add (IntDivExponentPoint q)
          (IntDivExponentPoint r)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D
          (IntDivExponentPoint q))
        (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D
          (IntDivExponentPoint r))
proof:
:= by
  let hext := rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_extends_intDiv D
  rw [<- intDivExponentPoint_add q r]
  rw [hext (IntDivExponent.add q r)]
  rw [hext q]
  rw [hext r]
  exact powByIntDiv_add D.base_positive q r

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun_mono
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun_mono
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    {x y : Point} (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x)
      (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D y)
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.lub_mono
    (rationalPowerLowerSet_mono (base := D.base) hxy)
    (rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_is_lub D x)
    (rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_is_lub D y)

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun_pos
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun_pos
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (x : Point) :
    PositiveDomain (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases exists_intDivExponentPoint_le x with
  | intro q hq =>
      have hmem :
          RationalPowerLowerSet D.base x (powByIntDiv D.base q) :=
        Exists.intro q (And.intro hq rfl)
      have hle :
          RealTheory.le (powByIntDiv D.base q)
            (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem
          F
          (rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_is_lub D x)
          hmem
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
        F (powByIntDiv_pos_of_pos D.base_positive q) hle

statement:
