name: rationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun_one_lt_of_pos
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun_one_lt_of_pos
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (hbase : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one D.base)
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one
      (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases exists_intDivExponentPoint_between hx with
  | intro q hq =>
      have hq_le_x :
          RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint q) x :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hq.right
      have hext :=
        rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_extends_intDiv D q
      have hpow_lt :
          RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one
            (powByIntDiv D.base q) :=
        one_lt_powByIntDiv_of_point_pos_of_one_lt
          hbase q hq.left
      have hmono :
          RealTheory.le
            (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D
              (IntDivExponentPoint q))
            (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x) :=
        rationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun_mono D hq_le_x
      rw [hext] at hmono
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
        F hpow_lt hmono

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_lower_approx
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_lower_approx
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (x eps : Point) (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun q : IntDivExponent =>
        And (RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint q) x)
          (RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.sub (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x) eps)
            (powByIntDiv D.base q)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x
  have hbelow : F.lt (F.sub L eps) L :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub F
      (rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_is_lub D x) hbelow with
  | intro y hy =>
      cases hy.left with
      | intro q hq =>
          refine Exists.intro q ?_
          refine And.intro hq.left ?_
          rw [hq.right] at hy
          exact hy.right

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_lower_approx_close
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_lower_approx_close
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (x eps : Point) (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun q : IntDivExponent =>
        And (RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint q) x)
          (RealTheory.lt
            (dist (powByIntDiv D.base q)
              (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x)) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x
  cases rationalPowerDedekindExtension_lower_approx D x eps heps with
  | intro q hq =>
      refine Exists.intro q ?_
      refine And.intro hq.left ?_
      have hmem :
          RationalPowerLowerSet D.base x (powByIntDiv D.base q) :=
        Exists.intro q (And.intro hq.left rfl)
      have hle_lub :
          F.le (powByIntDiv D.base q) L :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F
          (rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_is_lub D x) hmem
      have hL_lt_add : F.lt L (F.add L eps) := by
        have h :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps L
        change F.lt (F.add L F.zero) (F.add L eps) at h
        rwa [F.add_zero] at h
      have hright :
          F.lt (powByIntDiv D.base q) (F.add L eps) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle_lub hL_lt_add
      change
        F.lt
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
            (F.sub (powByIntDiv D.base q) L)) eps
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
        F hq.right hright

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_le_right_endpoint
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_le_right_endpoint
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    {x : Point} (r : IntDivExponent)
    (hxr : RealTheory.le x (IntDivExponentPoint r)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x)
      (powByIntDiv D.base r)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lub_le_of_upper
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_is_lub D x)
  intro y hy
  cases hy with
  | intro q hq =>
      rw [hq.right]
      exact D.monotone q r
        (RealTheory.le_trans hq.left hxr)

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_right_endpoint_close_of_upper
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_right_endpoint_close_of_upper
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    {x eps : Point} (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    (r : IntDivExponent)
    (hxr : RealTheory.le x (IntDivExponentPoint r))
    (hupper :
      RealTheory.lt (powByIntDiv D.base r)
        (RealTheory.add
          (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x) eps)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (dist (powByIntDiv D.base r)
        (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x)) eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x
  have hL_le :
      F.le L (powByIntDiv D.base r) :=
    rationalPowerDedekindExtension_le_right_endpoint D r hxr
  have hsub_lt_L : F.lt (F.sub L eps) L :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
  have hleft :
      F.lt (F.sub L eps) (powByIntDiv D.base r) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsub_lt_L hL_le
  change
    F.lt
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.sub (powByIntDiv D.base r) L)) eps
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
    F hleft hupper

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_strict_upper_approx_of_one_le
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_strict_upper_approx_of_one_le
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one D.base) :
    RationalPowerDedekindExtensionStrictUpperApprox D
proof:
:= by
  intro x eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have he2lt : RealTheory.lt e2 eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps
  cases rationalPowerDedekindExtension_lower_approx D x e2 he2pos with
  | intro q hq =>
      cases exists_intDivExponentPoint_ge x with
      | intro r0 hr0 =>
          let M := powByIntDiv D.base r0
          have hMnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M := by
            unfold M
            exact powByIntDiv_nonneg_of_pos D.base_positive r0
          cases exists_positive_intDivExponentPoint_mul_factor_control
              hbase hMnonneg he2pos with
          | intro small hsmall =>
              let qPoint := IntDivExponentPoint q
              let smallPoint := IntDivExponentPoint small
              have hsmall_pos :
                  RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero smallPoint := by
                unfold smallPoint
                exact hsmall.left
              have hsub_lt_x :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x smallPoint) x :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos
                  F hsmall_pos
              have hq_le_x : RealTheory.le qPoint x := by
                unfold qPoint
                exact hq.left
              have hp_exists :
                  Exists
                    (fun p : IntDivExponent =>
                      And (RealTheory.le qPoint
                            (IntDivExponentPoint p))
                        (And
                          (RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint p) x)
                          (RealTheory.lt x
                            (RealTheory.add
                              (IntDivExponentPoint p)
                              smallPoint)))) := by
                by_cases hqx : qPoint = x
                · refine Exists.intro q ?_
                  refine And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl qPoint) ?_
                  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                  · change RealTheory.le qPoint x
                    rw [hqx]
                    exact RealTheory.le_refl x
                  · have h :=
                      RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hsmall_pos qPoint
                    change
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.add qPoint RealTheory.zero)
                        (RealTheory.add qPoint smallPoint) at h
                    rw [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
                    rw [hqx] at h
                    change
                      RealTheory.lt x
                        (RealTheory.add qPoint smallPoint)
                    rw [hqx]
                    exact h
                · have hnot_x_le_q : Not (RealTheory.le x qPoint) := by
                    intro hxq
                    exact hqx (RealTheory.le_antisymm hq_le_x hxq)
                  have hq_lt_x : RealTheory.lt qPoint x :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
                      F hq_le_x hnot_x_le_q
                  by_cases hq_le_sub :
                      RealTheory.le qPoint
                        (RealTheory.sub x smallPoint)
                  · cases exists_intDivExponentPoint_between
                        hsub_lt_x with
                    | intro p hp =>
                        refine Exists.intro p ?_
                        have hq_le_p :
                            RealTheory.le qPoint
                              (IntDivExponentPoint p) :=
                          RealTheory.le_trans hq_le_sub
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                              F hp.left)
                        have hp_le_x :
                            RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint p) x :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                            F hp.right
                        have hx_lt_p_add :
                            RealTheory.lt x
                              (RealTheory.add
                                (IntDivExponentPoint p)
                                smallPoint) := by
                          have hraw :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt
                              F hp.left
                          change
                            RealTheory.lt x
                              (RealTheory.add smallPoint
                                (IntDivExponentPoint p)) at hraw
                          rwa [RealTheory.add_comm smallPoint
                            (IntDivExponentPoint p)] at hraw
                        exact And.intro hq_le_p
                          (And.intro hp_le_x hx_lt_p_add)
                  · have hsub_le_q :
                        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub x smallPoint)
                          qPoint := by
                      cases RealTheory.le_total
                          (RealTheory.sub x smallPoint) qPoint with
                      | inl h => exact h
                      | inr h => exact False.elim (hq_le_sub h)
                    cases exists_intDivExponentPoint_between
                        hq_lt_x with
                    | intro p hp =>
                        refine Exists.intro p ?_
                        have hq_le_p :
                            RealTheory.le qPoint
                              (IntDivExponentPoint p) :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                            F hp.left
                        have hp_le_x :
                            RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint p) x :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                            F hp.right
                        have hsub_lt_p :
                            RealTheory.lt
                              (RealTheory.sub x smallPoint)
                              (IntDivExponentPoint p) :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                            F hsub_le_q hp.left
                        have hx_lt_p_add :
                            RealTheory.lt x
                              (RealTheory.add
                                (IntDivExponentPoint p)
                                smallPoint) := by
                          have hraw :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt
                              F hsub_lt_p
                          change
                            RealTheory.lt x
                              (RealTheory.add smallPoint
                                (IntDivExponentPoint p)) at hraw
                          rwa [RealTheory.add_comm smallPoint
                            (IntDivExponentPoint p)] at hraw
                        exact And.intro hq_le_p
                          (And.intro hp_le_x hx_lt_p_add)
              cases hp_exists with
              | intro p hp =>
                  let right := IntDivExponent.add p small
                  refine Exists.intro right ?_
                  have hright_point :
                      IntDivExponentPoint right =
                        RealTheory.add (IntDivExponentPoint p)
                          smallPoint := by
                    unfold right smallPoint
                    exact intDivExponentPoint_add p small
                  have hx_lt_right :
                      RealTheory.lt x (IntDivExponentPoint right) := by
                    rw [hright_point]
                    exact hp.right.right
                  refine And.intro hx_lt_right ?_
                  have hq_val_lt :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.sub L e2)
                        (powByIntDiv D.base q) := by
                    unfold L
                    exact hq.right
                  have hq_val_le_p :
                      RealTheory.le (powByIntDiv D.base q)
                        (powByIntDiv D.base p) :=
                    D.monotone q p hp.left
                  have hL_sub_lt_p :
                      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub L e2)
                        (powByIntDiv D.base p) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                      F hq_val_lt hq_val_le_p
                  have hp_mem :
                      RationalPowerLowerSet D.base x
                        (powByIntDiv D.base p) :=
                    Exists.intro p
                      (And.intro hp.right.left rfl)
                  have hp_le_L :
                      RealTheory.le (powByIntDiv D.base p) L := by
                    unfold L
                    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem
                      F
                      (rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_is_lub
                        D x)
                      hp_mem
                  have hp_le_M :
                      RealTheory.le (powByIntDiv D.base p) M := by
                    unfold M
                    exact D.monotone p r0
                      (RealTheory.le_trans hp.right.left hr0)
                  have hsmall_refl :
                      RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint small)
                        (IntDivExponentPoint small) :=
                    RealTheory.le_refl (IntDivExponentPoint small)
                  have hright_val_lt_p_e2 :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (powByIntDiv D.base right)
                        (RealTheory.add
                          (powByIntDiv D.base p) e2) := by
                    unfold right
                    exact
                      powByIntDiv_add_small_lt_add_of_factor_control
                        hbase hsmall.right hp_le_M hsmall_refl
                  have hp_e2_le_L_e2 :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.add (powByIntDiv D.base p) e2)
                        (RealTheory.add L e2) :=
                    RealTheory.add_le_add_right hp_le_L e2
                  have hL_e2_lt_L_eps :
                      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add L e2)
                        (RealTheory.add L eps) :=
                    RealTheory.add_lt_add_left he2lt L
                  have hright_upper :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (powByIntDiv D.base right)
                        (RealTheory.add L eps) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                        F hright_val_lt_p_e2 hp_e2_le_L_e2)
                      hL_e2_lt_L_eps
                  unfold L at hright_upper
                  exact
                    rationalPowerDedekindExtension_right_endpoint_close_of_upper
                      D heps right
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                        hx_lt_right)
                      hright_upper

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_strict_lower_approx_of_one_le
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_strict_lower_approx_of_one_le
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one D.base) :
    RationalPowerDedekindExtensionStrictLowerApprox D
proof:
:= by
  intro x eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have he2lt : RealTheory.lt e2 eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps
  cases rationalPowerDedekindExtension_lower_approx_close
      D x e2 he2pos with
  | intro q hq =>
      let qPoint := IntDivExponentPoint q
      have hq_le_x : RealTheory.le qPoint x := by
        unfold qPoint
        exact hq.left
      by_cases hqx : qPoint = x
      · cases exists_intDivExponentPoint_ge x with
        | intro r0 hr0 =>
            let M := powByIntDiv D.base r0
            have hMnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M := by
              unfold M
              exact powByIntDiv_nonneg_of_pos D.base_positive r0
            cases exists_positive_intDivExponentPoint_mul_factor_control
                hbase hMnonneg he2pos with
            | intro small hsmall =>
                let smallPoint := IntDivExponentPoint small
                have hsmall_pos :
                    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero smallPoint := by
                  unfold smallPoint
                  exact hsmall.left
                let p := IntDivExponent.add q (IntDivExponent.neg small)
                have hp_point :
                    IntDivExponentPoint p =
                      RealTheory.add qPoint
                        (RealTheory.neg smallPoint) := by
                  unfold p qPoint smallPoint
                  rw [intDivExponentPoint_add]
                  rw [intDivExponentPoint_neg]
                have hp_eq_sub :
                    IntDivExponentPoint p =
                      RealTheory.sub x smallPoint := by
                  rw [hp_point]
                  rw [hqx]
                  exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg x smallPoint)
                have hp_lt_x :
                    RealTheory.lt (IntDivExponentPoint p) x := by
                  rw [hp_eq_sub]
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos
                    F hsmall_pos
                refine Exists.intro p ?_
                refine And.intro hp_lt_x ?_
                have hp_le_x :
                    RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint p) x :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hp_lt_x
                have hp_mem :
                    RationalPowerLowerSet D.base x
                      (powByIntDiv D.base p) :=
                  Exists.intro p (And.intro hp_le_x rfl)
                have hp_le_L :
                    RealTheory.le (powByIntDiv D.base p) L := by
                  unfold L
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem
                    F
                    (rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_is_lub
                      D x)
                    hp_mem
                have hp_le_M :
                    RealTheory.le (powByIntDiv D.base p) M := by
                  unfold M
                  exact D.monotone p r0
                    (RealTheory.le_trans hp_le_x hr0)
                let ps := IntDivExponent.add p small
                have hps_point :
                    IntDivExponentPoint ps = qPoint := by
                  unfold ps p qPoint
                  rw [intDivExponentPoint_add]
                  rw [intDivExponentPoint_add]
                  rw [intDivExponentPoint_neg]
                  calc
                    RealTheory.add
                        (RealTheory.add (IntDivExponentPoint q)
                          (RealTheory.neg
                            (IntDivExponentPoint small)))
                        (IntDivExponentPoint small) =
                        RealTheory.add (IntDivExponentPoint q)
                          (RealTheory.add
                            (RealTheory.neg
                              (IntDivExponentPoint small))
                            (IntDivExponentPoint small)) := by
                        rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
                    _ = RealTheory.add (IntDivExponentPoint q)
                          RealTheory.zero := by
                        rw [RealTheory.neg_add]
                    _ = IntDivExponentPoint q := by
                        rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
                have hps_pow_eq_q :
                    powByIntDiv D.base ps = powByIntDiv D.base q := by
                  apply RealTheory.le_antisymm
                  · exact D.monotone ps q (by
                      rw [hps_point]
                      exact RealTheory.le_refl qPoint)
                  · exact D.monotone q ps (by
                      rw [hps_point]
                      exact RealTheory.le_refl qPoint)
                have hps_mul :
                    powByIntDiv D.base ps =
                      RealTheory.mul (powByIntDiv D.base p)
                        (powByIntDiv D.base small) := by
                  unfold ps
                  exact powByIntDiv_add D.base_positive p small
                have hq_eq_mul :
                    powByIntDiv D.base q =
                      RealTheory.mul (powByIntDiv D.base p)
                        (powByIntDiv D.base small) := by
                  rw [<- hps_pow_eq_q]
                  exact hps_mul
                have hsmall_refl :
                    RealTheory.le (IntDivExponentPoint small)
                      (IntDivExponentPoint small) :=
                  RealTheory.le_refl (IntDivExponentPoint small)
                have hq_lt_p_e2 :
                    RealTheory.lt (powByIntDiv D.base q)
                      (RealTheory.add (powByIntDiv D.base p) e2) := by
                  rw [hq_eq_mul]
                  exact hsmall.right
                    (powByIntDiv D.base p)
                    (powByIntDiv_pos_of_pos D.base_positive p)
                    hp_le_M small hsmall_refl
                have hL_eq_q :
                    L = powByIntDiv D.base q := by
                  unfold L
                  change
                    RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x =
                      powByIntDiv D.base q
                  rw [<- hqx]
                  exact rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_extends_intDiv
                    D q
                have hL_lt_p_e2 :
                    RealTheory.lt L
                      (RealTheory.add (powByIntDiv D.base p) e2) := by
                  rw [hL_eq_q]
                  exact hq_lt_p_e2
                have hL_sub_lt_p :
                    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub L e2)
                      (powByIntDiv D.base p) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right
                    F
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add
                      F hL_lt_p_e2)
                have hL_sub_eps_lt_sub_e2 :
                    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub L eps)
                      (RealTheory.sub L e2) := by
                  have hneg := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F he2lt
                  have h :=
                    RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hneg L
                  change
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.add L (RealTheory.neg eps))
                      (RealTheory.add L (RealTheory.neg e2)) at h
                  rwa [<- RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg,
                    <- RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg] at h
                have hL_sub_eps_lt_p :
                    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub L eps)
                      (powByIntDiv D.base p) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
                    F hL_sub_eps_lt_sub_e2 hL_sub_lt_p
                have hL_lt_L_eps :
                    RealTheory.lt L (RealTheory.add L eps) := by
                  have h :=
                    RealTheory.add_lt_add_left heps L
                  change
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.add L RealTheory.zero)
                      (RealTheory.add L eps) at h
                  rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
                have hp_lt_L_eps :
                    RealTheory.lt (powByIntDiv D.base p)
                      (RealTheory.add L eps) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                    F hp_le_L hL_lt_L_eps
                change
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                      (RealTheory.sub (powByIntDiv D.base p) L))
                    eps
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
                  F hL_sub_eps_lt_p hp_lt_L_eps
      · have hnot_x_le_q : Not (RealTheory.le x qPoint) := by
          intro hxq
          exact hqx (RealTheory.le_antisymm hq_le_x hxq)
        have hq_lt_x : RealTheory.lt qPoint x :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
            F hq_le_x hnot_x_le_q
        refine Exists.intro q ?_
        refine And.intro hq_lt_x ?_
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hq.right he2lt

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_brackets_of_strict_approximations
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_brackets_of_strict_approximations
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (hleft : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionStrictLowerApprox D)
    (hright : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionStrictUpperApprox D) :
    RationalPowerDedekindExtensionContinuityBrackets D
proof:
:= by
  intro x eps heps
  cases hleft x eps heps with
  | intro left hleftData =>
      cases hright x eps heps with
      | intro right hrightData =>
          exact Exists.intro left
            (Exists.intro right
              (And.intro hleftData.left
                (And.intro hrightData.left
                  (And.intro hleftData.right hrightData.right))))

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_continuousOn_of_brackets
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_continuousOn_of_brackets
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (hbrackets :
      RationalPowerDedekindExtensionContinuityBrackets D) :
    ContinuousOn UniversalDomain
      (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine And.intro hx ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hbrackets x eps heps with
  | intro left hleft =>
      cases hleft with
      | intro right hright =>
          let leftPoint := IntDivExponentPoint left
          let rightPoint := IntDivExponentPoint right
          let L := RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x
          let delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F
              (F.sub x leftPoint) (F.sub rightPoint x)
          have hleft_lt : F.lt leftPoint x := hright.left
          have hright_lt : F.lt x rightPoint := hright.right.left
          have hleft_close :
              F.lt
                (dist (powByIntDiv D.base left) L) eps :=
            hright.right.right.left
          have hright_close :
              F.lt
                (dist (powByIntDiv D.base right) L) eps :=
            hright.right.right.right
          have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta := by
            unfold delta
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hleft_lt)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hright_lt)
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta ?_
          intro y hy hyne hydist
          have hy_interval :
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval F
                leftPoint rightPoint y := by
            unfold delta at hydist
            exact mem_interval_of_dist_lt_min
              hleft_lt hright_lt hydist
          have hleft_y :
              F.le leftPoint y :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy_interval.left
          have hy_right :
              F.le y rightPoint :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy_interval.right
          have hleft_value_le :
              F.le (powByIntDiv D.base left)
                (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D y) := by
            have hmono :
                F.le
                  (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D leftPoint)
                  (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D y) :=
              rationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun_mono D hleft_y
            have hleft_ext :=
              rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_extends_intDiv D left
            rwa [hleft_ext] at hmono
          have hy_value_right :
              F.le (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D y)
                (powByIntDiv D.base right) := by
            have hmono :
                F.le
                  (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D y)
                  (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D rightPoint) :=
              rationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun_mono D hy_right
            have hright_ext :=
              rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_extends_intDiv D right
            rwa [hright_ext] at hmono
          have hleft_low :
              F.lt (F.sub L eps) (powByIntDiv D.base left) := by
            change
              F.lt
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                  (F.sub (powByIntDiv D.base left) L)) eps
                at hleft_close
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left
              F hleft_close
          have hleft_final :
              F.lt (F.sub L eps)
                (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D y) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
              F hleft_low hleft_value_le
          have hright_high :
              F.lt (powByIntDiv D.base right) (F.add L eps) := by
            change
              F.lt
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                  (F.sub (powByIntDiv D.base right) L)) eps
                at hright_close
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right
              F hright_close
          have hright_final :
              F.lt (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D y)
                (F.add L eps) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
              F hy_value_right hright_high
          change
            F.lt
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                (F.sub (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D y) L))
              eps
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
            F hleft_final hright_final

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_continuousOn_of_strict_approximations
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_continuousOn_of_strict_approximations
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (hleft : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionStrictLowerApprox D)
    (hright : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionStrictUpperApprox D) :
    ContinuousOn UniversalDomain
      (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D)
proof:
:=
  rationalPowerDedekindExtension_continuousOn_of_brackets D
    (rationalPowerDedekindExtension_brackets_of_strict_approximations
      D hleft hright)

statement:

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_right_intDiv_of_continuous
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_right_intDiv_of_continuous
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (hcont :
      ContinuousOn UniversalDomain
        (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D))
    (r : IntDivExponent) :
    forall x : Point,
      RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D
          (RealTheory.add x (IntDivExponentPoint r)) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x)
          (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D
            (IntDivExponentPoint r))
proof:
:= by
  let left : Map :=
    CompFun (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D)
      (AddFun IdentityFun (fun _ : Point => IntDivExponentPoint r))
  let right : Map :=
    MulFun (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D)
      (fun _ : Point =>
        RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D
          (IntDivExponentPoint r))
  have hleft_cont : ContinuousOn UniversalDomain left := by
    unfold left
    apply continuousOn_comp
    · exact continuousOn_add continuousOn_identity continuousOn_const
    · exact hcont
    · intro x hx
      unfold AddFun IdentityFun UniversalDomain
      exact True.intro
  have hright_cont : ContinuousOn UniversalDomain right := by
    unfold right
    exact continuousOn_mul hcont continuousOn_const
  have hsame_dense : SameOn IntDivExponentPointSet left right := by
    intro x hx
    cases hx with
    | intro q hq =>
        rw [hq]
        unfold left right CompFun AddFun IdentityFun MulFun
        exact rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_on_intDiv D q r
  have hsame_all :
      SameOn UniversalDomain left right :=
    continuousOn_sameOn_of_dense
      intDivExponentPointSet_dense
      (fun x hx => True.intro)
      hleft_cont hright_cont hsame_dense
  intro x
  have h := hsame_all x True.intro
  unfold left right CompFun AddFun IdentityFun MulFun at h
  exact h

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_law_of_continuous
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_law_of_continuous
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (hcont :
      ContinuousOn UniversalDomain
        (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D)) :
    NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative
      (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  let left : Map :=
    CompFun (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D)
      (AddFun (fun _ : Point => x) IdentityFun)
  let right : Map :=
    MulFun (fun _ : Point =>
        RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D x)
      (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D)
  have hleft_cont : ContinuousOn UniversalDomain left := by
    unfold left
    apply continuousOn_comp
    · exact continuousOn_add continuousOn_const continuousOn_identity
    · exact hcont
    · intro z hz
      unfold AddFun IdentityFun UniversalDomain
      exact True.intro
  have hright_cont : ContinuousOn UniversalDomain right := by
    unfold right
    exact continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const hcont
  have hsame_dense : SameOn IntDivExponentPointSet left right := by
    intro z hz
    cases hz with
    | intro r hr =>
        rw [hr]
        unfold left right CompFun AddFun IdentityFun MulFun
        exact rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_right_intDiv_of_continuous
          D hcont r x
  have hsame_all :
      SameOn UniversalDomain left right :=
    continuousOn_sameOn_of_dense
      intDivExponentPointSet_dense
      (fun z hz => True.intro)
      hleft_cont hright_cont hsame_dense
  have h := hsame_all y True.intro
  unfold left right CompFun AddFun IdentityFun MulFun at h
  exact h

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_law_of_strict_approximations
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_law_of_strict_approximations
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (hleft : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionStrictLowerApprox D)
    (hright : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionStrictUpperApprox D) :
    NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative
      (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D)
proof:
:=
  rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_law_of_continuous D
    (rationalPowerDedekindExtension_continuousOn_of_strict_approximations
      D hleft hright)

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_law_of_one_le
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_law_of_one_le
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData)
    (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one D.base) :
    NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative
      (RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D)
proof:
:=
  rationalPowerDedekindExtension_add_law_of_continuous D
    (rationalPowerDedekindExtension_continuousOn_of_one_le
      D hbase)

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_zero
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_zero
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData) :
    RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D RealTheory.zero =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnonneg : NonnegativeDomain D.base :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F D.base_positive
  have h :=
    rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_extends_intDiv D
      (IntDivExponent.ofNat 0)
  calc
    RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D RealTheory.zero =
        RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D
          (IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.ofNat 0)) := by
          rw [intDivExponentPoint_ofNat, RealTheory.nat_zero]
          rfl
    _ = powByIntDiv D.base (IntDivExponent.ofNat 0) := h
    _ = RealTheory.one := powByIntDiv_zero_of_nonneg hnonneg

name: rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_one
statement:
theorem rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_one
    (D : RationalPowerDedekindExtensionData) :
    RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D RealTheory.one =
      D.base
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnonneg : NonnegativeDomain D.base :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F D.base_positive
  have h :=
    rationalPowerDedekindExtensionValue_extends_intDiv D
      (IntDivExponent.ofNat 1)
  calc
    RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D RealTheory.one =
        RationalPowerDedekindExtensionFun D
          (IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.ofNat 1)) := by
          rw [intDivExponentPoint_ofNat, RealTheory.nat_one]
          rfl
    _ = powByIntDiv D.base (IntDivExponent.ofNat 1) := h
    _ = D.base := powByIntDiv_one_of_nonneg hnonneg

name: internalRat_exists_intDivExponentPoint
statement:
theorem internalRat_exists_intDivExponentPoint
    {x : Point} (hx : RealTheory.InternalRat x) :
    Exists (fun q : IntDivExponent => x = IntDivExponentPoint q)
proof:
:= by
  cases hx with
  | intro z hz =>
      cases hz with
      | intro d hd =>
          cases RealTheory.internalInt_exists_int hd.left with
          | intro numerator hnumerator =>
              cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.internalNat_exists_nat
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                  hd.right.left with
              | intro denominator hdenominator =>
                  have hdenominator_ne_zero :
                      Not (denominator = 0) := by
                    intro hzero
                    exact hd.right.right.left (by
                      calc
                        d = RealTheory.nat denominator := hdenominator
                        _ = RealTheory.nat 0 := by rw [hzero]
                        _ = RealTheory.zero := RealTheory.nat_zero)
                  refine Exists.intro
                    { numerator := numerator
                      denominator := denominator
                      denominator_ne_zero := hdenominator_ne_zero } ?_
                  unfold IntDivExponentPoint
                  rw [hd.right.right.right, hnumerator, hdenominator]
                  rfl

name: intDivExponentPointSet_mem
statement:
theorem intDivExponentPointSet_mem (q : IntDivExponent) :
    IntDivExponentPointSet (IntDivExponentPoint q)

name: exists_intDivExponentPoint_between
statement:
theorem exists_intDivExponentPoint_between
    {left right : Point}
    (hlr : RealTheory.lt left right) :
    Exists
      (fun q : IntDivExponent =>
        And (RealTheory.lt left (IntDivExponentPoint q))
          (RealTheory.lt (IntDivExponentPoint q) right))
proof:
:= by
  cases RealTheory.exists_internalRat_between hlr with
  | intro q hq =>
      cases internalRat_exists_intDivExponentPoint hq.left with
      | intro r hr =>
          refine Exists.intro r ?_
          rw [<- hr]
          exact hq.right

name: intDivExponentPointSet_dense
statement:
theorem intDivExponentPointSet_dense :
    forall x : Point,
      RealFunction.UniversalDomain x ->
        RealTheory.ClosurePoint IntDivExponentPointSet x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx U hUopen hxU
  cases hUopen x hxU with
  | intro left hleft =>
      cases hleft with
      | intro right hright =>
          cases exists_intDivExponentPoint_between
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                hright.left hright.right.left) with
          | intro q hq =>
              refine Exists.intro (IntDivExponentPoint q) ?_
              exact And.intro (intDivExponentPointSet_mem q)
                (hright.right.right (IntDivExponentPoint q) hq)

name: intDivExponentPoint_mul_denominator
statement:
theorem intDivExponentPoint_mul_denominator
    (q : IntDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.mul (IntDivExponentPoint q)
      (RealTheory.nat q.denominator) =
        RealTheory.int q.numerator
proof:
:= by
  unfold IntDivExponentPoint
  rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
  rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel
    (RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero)]
  exact RealTheory.mul_one (RealTheory.int q.numerator)

name: intDivExponentPoint_mul_common_denominator
statement:
theorem intDivExponentPoint_mul_common_denominator
    (q r : IntDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.mul (IntDivExponentPoint q)
      (RealTheory.nat (q.denominator * r.denominator)) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.int q.numerator)
          (RealTheory.nat r.denominator)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IntDivExponentPoint
  calc
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.int q.numerator)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)))
        (RealTheory.nat (q.denominator * r.denominator)) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.int q.numerator)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
            (RealTheory.nat r.denominator)) := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun t : Point =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.int q.numerator)
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q.denominator))) t)
            (RealTheory.nat_mul q.denominator r.denominator)
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.int q.numerator)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat r.denominator)
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_comm
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
            (RealTheory.nat r.denominator)]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.int q.numerator)
            (RealTheory.nat r.denominator))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q.denominator))
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)) := by
          exact RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm
            (RealTheory.int q.numerator)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q.denominator))
            (RealTheory.nat r.denominator)
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.int q.numerator)
            (RealTheory.nat r.denominator))
          RealTheory.one := by
          rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel
            (RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero)]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.int q.numerator)
          (RealTheory.nat r.denominator) := by
          exact RealTheory.mul_one
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.int q.numerator)
              (RealTheory.nat r.denominator))

name: intDivExponentPoint_add
statement:
theorem intDivExponentPoint_add
    (q r : IntDivExponent) :
    IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.add q r) =
      RealTheory.add (IntDivExponentPoint q)
        (IntDivExponentPoint r)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let commonDen := q.denominator * r.denominator
  have hcommon_ne :
      Not (RealTheory.nat commonDen = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (Nat.mul_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero
        r.denominator_ne_zero)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero
    F (z := RealTheory.nat commonDen) hcommon_ne
  calc
    RealTheory.mul
        (IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.add q r))
        (RealTheory.nat commonDen) =
        RealTheory.int
          (q.numerator * Int.ofNat r.denominator +
            r.numerator * Int.ofNat q.denominator) := by
          unfold commonDen
          exact intDivExponentPoint_mul_denominator
            (IntDivExponent.add q r)
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.int
            (q.numerator * Int.ofNat r.denominator))
          (RealTheory.int
            (r.numerator * Int.ofNat q.denominator)) := by
          exact RealTheory.int_add
            (q.numerator * Int.ofNat r.denominator)
            (r.numerator * Int.ofNat q.denominator)
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.int q.numerator)
            (RealTheory.nat r.denominator))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.int r.numerator)
            (RealTheory.nat q.denominator)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.int_mul_ofNat]
          rw [RealTheory.int_mul_ofNat]
          rfl
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (IntDivExponentPoint q)
            (RealTheory.nat commonDen))
          (RealTheory.mul (IntDivExponentPoint r)
            (RealTheory.nat commonDen)) := by
          rw [intDivExponentPoint_mul_common_denominator]
          unfold commonDen
          rw [Nat.mul_comm q.denominator r.denominator]
          rw [intDivExponentPoint_mul_common_denominator]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add (IntDivExponentPoint q)
            (IntDivExponentPoint r))
          (RealTheory.nat commonDen) := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_mul]

name: intDivExponentPoint_scaleDen
statement:
theorem intDivExponentPoint_scaleDen
    (q : IntDivExponent) {k : Nat} (hk : Not (k = 0)) :
    IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.scaleDen q k hk) =
      IntDivExponentPoint q
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let commonDen := q.denominator * k
  have hcommon_ne :
      Not (RealTheory.nat commonDen = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (Nat.mul_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero hk)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero
    F (z := RealTheory.nat commonDen) hcommon_ne
  calc
    RealTheory.mul
        (IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.scaleDen q k hk))
        (RealTheory.nat commonDen) =
        RealTheory.int (q.numerator * Int.ofNat k) := by
          unfold commonDen
          exact intDivExponentPoint_mul_denominator
            (IntDivExponent.scaleDen q k hk)
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.int q.numerator)
          (RealTheory.nat k) := by
          exact RealTheory.int_mul_ofNat q.numerator k
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul (IntDivExponentPoint q)
          (RealTheory.nat commonDen) := by
          unfold commonDen
          exact Eq.symm
            (intDivExponentPoint_mul_common_denominator q
              { numerator := Int.ofNat 0
                denominator := k
                denominator_ne_zero := hk })

name: intDivExponentPoint_neg
statement:
theorem intDivExponentPoint_neg
    (q : IntDivExponent) :
    IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.neg q) =

proof:
:= by
  unfold IntDivExponentPoint IntDivExponent.neg
  rw [RealTheory.int_neg]
  exact RealTheory.neg_mul (RealTheory.int q.numerator)

name: powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv (x : Point) (q : NatDivExponent) :

name: exists_positive_intDivExponentPoint_pow_lt_one_add_of_one_le
statement:
theorem exists_positive_intDivExponentPoint_pow_lt_one_add_of_one_le
    {base eps : Point}
    (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun q : IntDivExponent =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (IntDivExponentPoint q))
          (RealTheory.lt (powByIntDiv base q)
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one eps)))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_positive_natDivExponentPoint_pow_lt_one_add_of_one_le
      hbase heps with
  | intro q hq =>
      refine Exists.intro (IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv q) ?_
      rw [intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv, powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv]
      exact hq

name: powByIntDiv_addOfNatDiv
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_addOfNatDiv
    {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (q r : NatDivExponent) :
    powByIntDiv x (IntDivExponent.addOfNatDiv q r) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (powByIntDiv x (IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv q))
        (powByIntDiv x (IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv r))
proof:
:= by
  unfold IntDivExponent.addOfNatDiv
  rw [powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv, powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv,
    powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv]
  exact powByNatDiv_add hx q r

name: intDivExponentPoint_addOfNatDiv
statement:
theorem intDivExponentPoint_addOfNatDiv
    (q r : NatDivExponent) :
    IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.addOfNatDiv q r) =
      RealTheory.add
        (IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv q))

proof:
:= by

  rw [intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv, intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv,
    intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv]

name: natDivExponentPoint_ofNat
statement:
theorem natDivExponentPoint_ofNat (n : Nat) :
    NatDivExponentPoint (NatDivExponent.ofNat n) =
      RealTheory.nat n
proof:
:= by
  unfold NatDivExponentPoint NatDivExponent.ofNat
  rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
  change
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
      (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one) = RealTheory.nat n
  rw [show RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one from
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base]
  exact RealTheory.mul_one (RealTheory.nat n)

name: intDivExponentPoint_ofNat
statement:
theorem intDivExponentPoint_ofNat (n : Nat) :
    IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.ofNat n) =
      RealTheory.nat n
proof:
:= by
  unfold IntDivExponent.ofNat
  rw [intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv]
  exact natDivExponentPoint_ofNat n

name: intDivExponentPoint_negSuccNat
statement:
theorem intDivExponentPoint_negSuccNat (n : Nat) :
    IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.negSuccNat n) =
      RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold IntDivExponentPoint IntDivExponent.negSuccNat
  rw [RealTheory.int_negSucc]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
  change
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
      (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one) =
      RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
  rw [show RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one from
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base]
  exact RealTheory.mul_one (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))

name: intDivExponentPoint_negSucc_eq_neg_natDiv
statement:
theorem intDivExponentPoint_negSucc_eq_neg_natDiv
    {n d : Nat} (hd : Not (d = 0)) :
    IntDivExponentPoint
      { numerator := Int.negSucc n
        denominator := d
        denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
      RealTheory.neg
        (NatDivExponentPoint
          { numerator := n + 1
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd })
proof:
:= by
  unfold IntDivExponentPoint NatDivExponentPoint
  rw [RealTheory.int_negSucc]
  exact RealTheory.neg_mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
    (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat d))

name: intDivExponentPoint_negSucc_lt_zero
statement:
theorem intDivExponentPoint_negSucc_lt_zero
    {n d : Nat} (hd : Not (d = 0)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (IntDivExponentPoint
        { numerator := Int.negSucc n
          denominator := d
          denominator_ne_zero := hd })
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (NatDivExponentPoint
          { numerator := n + 1
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd }) :=
    natDivExponentPoint_pos_of_numerator_pos
      (Nat.succ_ne_zero n) hd
  have hneg := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hpos
  change
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.neg
        (NatDivExponentPoint
          { numerator := n + 1
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd }))
      (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.zero) at hneg
  rw [intDivExponentPoint_negSucc_eq_neg_natDiv]
  rwa [RealTheory.neg_zero] at hneg

name: exists_natDivExponentPoint_between_pos
statement:
theorem exists_natDivExponentPoint_between_pos
    {left right : Point}
    (hleft_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero left)
    (hlr : RealTheory.lt left right) :
    Exists
      (fun q : NatDivExponent =>
        And (RealTheory.lt left (NatDivExponentPoint q))
          (RealTheory.lt (NatDivExponentPoint q) right))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases exists_intDivExponentPoint_between hlr with
  | intro q hq =>
      cases q with
      | mk numerator denominator hden =>
          cases numerator with
          | ofNat n =>
              cases n with
              | zero =>
                  have hpoint_zero :
                      IntDivExponentPoint
                          { numerator := Int.ofNat 0
                            denominator := denominator
                            denominator_ne_zero := hden } =
                        RealTheory.zero := by
                    unfold IntDivExponentPoint
                    rw [RealTheory.int_ofNat, RealTheory.nat_zero]
                    exact RealTheory.zero_mul
                      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat denominator))
                  rw [hpoint_zero] at hq
                  exact False.elim
                    ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero)
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                        hleft_pos hq.left))
              | succ n =>
                  let r : NatDivExponent :=
                    { numerator := n + 1
                      denominator := denominator
                      denominator_ne_zero := hden }
                  refine Exists.intro r ?_
                  have hsame :
                      IntDivExponentPoint
                          { numerator := Int.ofNat (n + 1)
                            denominator := denominator
                            denominator_ne_zero := hden } =
                        NatDivExponentPoint r := by
                    exact intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv r
                  rw [hsame] at hq
                  exact hq
          | negSucc n =>
              have hneg :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (IntDivExponentPoint
                      { numerator := Int.negSucc n
                        denominator := denominator
                        denominator_ne_zero := hden })
                    RealTheory.zero :=
                intDivExponentPoint_negSucc_lt_zero hden
              have hzero_lt_point :
                  RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                    (IntDivExponentPoint
                      { numerator := Int.negSucc n
                        denominator := denominator
                        denominator_ne_zero := hden }) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hleft_pos hq.left
              exact False.elim
                ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_asymm F hzero_lt_point) hneg)

name: not_intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv_le_negSucc
statement:
theorem not_intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv_le_negSucc
    {m n d e : Nat} (hd : Not (d = 0)) (he : Not (e = 0)) :
    Not
      (RealTheory.le
        (IntDivExponentPoint
          { numerator := Int.ofNat m
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd })
        (IntDivExponentPoint
          { numerator := Int.negSucc n
            denominator := e
            denominator_ne_zero := he }))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro hle
  have hnonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (IntDivExponentPoint
          { numerator := Int.ofNat m
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd }) := by
    change
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (IntDivExponentPoint
          (IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv
            { numerator := m
              denominator := d
              denominator_ne_zero := hd }))
    rw [intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv]
    exact natDivExponentPoint_nonneg
      { numerator := m
        denominator := d
        denominator_ne_zero := hd }
  have hneg :
      RealTheory.lt
        (IntDivExponentPoint
          { numerator := Int.negSucc n
            denominator := e
            denominator_ne_zero := he })
        RealTheory.zero :=
    intDivExponentPoint_negSucc_lt_zero he
  have hlt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (IntDivExponentPoint
          { numerator := Int.negSucc n
            denominator := e
            denominator_ne_zero := he })
        (IntDivExponentPoint
          { numerator := Int.ofNat m
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd }) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hneg hnonneg
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hlt) hle

name: powByIntDiv_ofNat
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_ofNat
    {x : Point} (hx : NonnegativeDomain x) (n : Nat) :
    powByIntDiv x (IntDivExponent.ofNat n) =
      powNat x n
proof:
:= by
  unfold IntDivExponent.ofNat
  rw [powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv]
  exact powByNatDiv_ofNat_eq_powNat hx

name: powByIntDiv_zero_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_zero_of_nonneg
    {x : Point} (hx : NonnegativeDomain x) :
    powByIntDiv x (IntDivExponent.ofNat 0) = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  rw [powByIntDiv_ofNat hx 0]

name: powByIntDiv_one_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_one_of_nonneg
    {x : Point} (hx : NonnegativeDomain x) :
    powByIntDiv x (IntDivExponent.ofNat 1) = x
