name: powByIntDiv_pos_of_pos
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_pos_of_pos
    {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (q : IntDivExponent) :
    PositiveDomain (powByIntDiv x q)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases q with
  | mk numerator denominator hden =>
      cases numerator with
      | ofNat n =>
          unfold powByIntDiv
          exact powByNatDiv_pos_of_pos hx
            { numerator := n
              denominator := denominator
              denominator_ne_zero := hden }
      | negSucc n =>
          unfold powByIntDiv
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
            (powByNatDiv_pos_of_pos hx
              { numerator := n + 1
                denominator := denominator
                denominator_ne_zero := hden })

name: powByIntDiv_nonneg_of_pos
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_nonneg_of_pos
    {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (q : IntDivExponent) :
    NonnegativeDomain (powByIntDiv x q)
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (powByIntDiv_pos_of_pos hx q)

name: one_lt_powByIntDiv_of_point_pos_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem one_lt_powByIntDiv_of_point_pos_of_one_lt
    {base : Point} (hbase : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one base)
    (q : IntDivExponent)
    (hqpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (IntDivExponentPoint q)) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one (powByIntDiv base q)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases q with
  | mk numerator denominator hden =>
      cases numerator with
      | ofNat n =>
          cases n with
          | zero =>
              have hpoint_zero :
                  IntDivExponentPoint
                      { numerator := Int.ofNat 0
                        denominator := denominator
                        denominator_ne_zero := hden } =
                    RealTheory.zero := by
                unfold IntDivExponentPoint
                rw [RealTheory.int_ofNat, RealTheory.nat_zero]
                exact RealTheory.zero_mul
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat denominator))
              rw [hpoint_zero] at hqpos
              exact False.elim
                ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero)
                  hqpos)
          | succ n =>
              change
                RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one
                  (powByNatDiv base
                    { numerator := n + 1
                      denominator := denominator
                      denominator_ne_zero := hden })
              exact one_lt_powByNatDiv_of_one_lt hbase
                { numerator := n + 1
                  denominator := denominator
                  denominator_ne_zero := hden }
                (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
      | negSucc n =>
          have hneg :
              RealTheory.lt
                (IntDivExponentPoint
                  { numerator := Int.negSucc n
                    denominator := denominator
                    denominator_ne_zero := hden })
                RealTheory.zero :=
            intDivExponentPoint_negSucc_lt_zero hden
          exact False.elim
            ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_asymm F hqpos) hneg)

name: powByIntDiv_negOfNat
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_negOfNat
    (x : Point) {n d : Nat}
    (hn : Not (n = 0)) (hd : Not (d = 0)) :
    powByIntDiv x
        { numerator := Int.negOfNat n
          denominator := d
          denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
      RealTheory.inv
        (powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := n
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd })
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      exact False.elim (hn rfl)
  | succ n =>
      rfl

name: powByIntDiv_scaleDen
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_scaleDen
    {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (q : IntDivExponent) {k : Nat} (hk : Not (k = 0)) :
    powByIntDiv x (IntDivExponent.scaleDen q k hk) =
      powByIntDiv x q
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxnonneg : NonnegativeDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx
  cases q with
  | mk numerator denominator hden =>
      cases numerator with
      | ofNat n =>
          change
            powByNatDiv x
                { numerator := n * k
                  denominator := denominator * k
                  denominator_ne_zero :=
                    Nat.mul_ne_zero hden hk } =
              powByNatDiv x
                { numerator := n
                  denominator := denominator
                  denominator_ne_zero := hden }
          exact powByNatDiv_common_refinement_of_nonneg
            hxnonneg
            { numerator := n
              denominator := denominator
              denominator_ne_zero := hden }
            hk
      | negSucc n =>
          have hprod_ne :
              Not ((n + 1) * k = 0) :=
            Nat.mul_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero n) hk
          change
            powByIntDiv x
                { numerator := Int.negOfNat ((n + 1) * k)
                  denominator := denominator * k
                  denominator_ne_zero :=
                    Nat.mul_ne_zero hden hk } =
              RealTheory.inv
                (powByNatDiv x
                  { numerator := n + 1
                    denominator := denominator
                    denominator_ne_zero := hden })
          rw [powByIntDiv_negOfNat x hprod_ne]
          rw [powByNatDiv_common_refinement_of_nonneg
            hxnonneg
            { numerator := n + 1
              denominator := denominator
              denominator_ne_zero := hden }
            hk]

name: powByIntDiv_denominator_mul_comm
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_denominator_mul_comm
    (x : Point) (z : Int) {d e : Nat}
    (hd : Not (d = 0)) (he : Not (e = 0)) :
    powByIntDiv x
        { numerator := z
          denominator := d * e
          denominator_ne_zero := Nat.mul_ne_zero hd he } =
      powByIntDiv x
        { numerator := z
          denominator := e * d
          denominator_ne_zero := Nat.mul_ne_zero he hd }
proof:
:= by
  cases z with
  | ofNat n =>
      change
        powByNatDiv x
            { numerator := n
              denominator := d * e
              denominator_ne_zero := Nat.mul_ne_zero hd he } =
          powByNatDiv x
            { numerator := n
              denominator := e * d
              denominator_ne_zero := Nat.mul_ne_zero he hd }
      exact powByNatDiv_denominator_mul_comm hd he
  | negSucc n =>
      change
        RealTheory.inv
            (powByNatDiv x
              { numerator := n + 1
                denominator := d * e
                denominator_ne_zero := Nat.mul_ne_zero hd he }) =
          RealTheory.inv
            (powByNatDiv x
              { numerator := n + 1
                denominator := e * d
                denominator_ne_zero := Nat.mul_ne_zero he hd })
      rw [powByNatDiv_denominator_mul_comm hd he]

name: powByIntDiv_scaleDenLeft
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_scaleDenLeft
    {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (q : IntDivExponent) {k : Nat} (hk : Not (k = 0)) :
    powByIntDiv x
        { numerator := q.numerator * Int.ofNat k
          denominator := k * q.denominator
          denominator_ne_zero :=
            Nat.mul_ne_zero hk q.denominator_ne_zero } =
      powByIntDiv x q
proof:
:= by
  calc
    powByIntDiv x
        { numerator := q.numerator * Int.ofNat k
          denominator := k * q.denominator
          denominator_ne_zero :=
            Nat.mul_ne_zero hk q.denominator_ne_zero } =
        powByIntDiv x (IntDivExponent.scaleDen q k hk) := by
          exact powByIntDiv_denominator_mul_comm
            x (q.numerator * Int.ofNat k) hk q.denominator_ne_zero
    _ = powByIntDiv x q :=
          powByIntDiv_scaleDen hx q hk

name: powByIntDiv_subNatNat_same_den
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_subNatNat_same_den
    {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (a b d : Nat) (hd : Not (d = 0)) :
    powByIntDiv x
        { numerator := Int.subNatNat a b
          denominator := d
          denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
      RealTheory.mul
        (powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := a
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd })
        (RealTheory.inv
          (powByNatDiv x
            { numerator := b
              denominator := d
              denominator_ne_zero := hd }))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  exact Int.subNatNat_elim a b
    (fun a b z =>
      powByIntDiv x
          { numerator := z
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
        RealTheory.mul
          (powByNatDiv x
            { numerator := a
              denominator := d
              denominator_ne_zero := hd })
          (RealTheory.inv
            (powByNatDiv x
              { numerator := b
                denominator := d
                denominator_ne_zero := hd })))
    (by
      intro i n
      let A : Point :=
        powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := n
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd }
      let B : Point :=
        powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := i
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd }
      have hsum :
          powByNatDiv x
              { numerator := n + i
                denominator := d
                denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
            RealTheory.mul A B := by
        dsimp [A, B]
        exact powByNatDiv_same_den_add
          (x := x) (a := n) (b := i) (d := d) hd
      have hApos : PositiveDomain A := by
        dsimp [A]
        exact powByNatDiv_pos_of_pos hx
          { numerator := n
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd }
      have hAne : Not (A = RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro hzero
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hApos hzero.symm
      change
        B =
          RealTheory.mul
            (powByNatDiv x
              { numerator := n + i
                denominator := d
                denominator_ne_zero := hd })
            (RealTheory.inv A)
      rw [hsum]
      symm
      calc
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul A B) (RealTheory.inv A) =
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul B A) (RealTheory.inv A) := by
              rw [RealTheory.mul_comm A B]
        _ = B := by
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right
                F B hAne)
    (by
      intro i m
      let A : Point :=
        powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := m
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd }
      let B : Point :=
        powByNatDiv x
          { numerator := i + 1
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd }
      have hsum :
          powByNatDiv x
              { numerator := m + (i + 1)
                denominator := d
                denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
            RealTheory.mul A B := by
        dsimp [A, B]
        exact powByNatDiv_same_den_add
          (x := x) (a := m) (b := i + 1) (d := d) hd
      have hApos : PositiveDomain A := by
        dsimp [A]
        exact powByNatDiv_pos_of_pos hx
          { numerator := m
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd }
      have hBpos : PositiveDomain B := by
        dsimp [B]
        exact powByNatDiv_pos_of_pos hx
          { numerator := i + 1
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd }
      have hAne : Not (A = RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro hzero
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hApos hzero.symm
      have hBne : Not (B = RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro hzero
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hBpos hzero.symm
      have hindex : m + i + 1 = m + (i + 1) := by omega
      change
        RealTheory.inv B =
          RealTheory.mul
            (powByNatDiv x
              { numerator := m
                denominator := d
                denominator_ne_zero := hd })
            (RealTheory.inv
              (powByNatDiv x
                { numerator := m + i + 1
                  denominator := d
                  denominator_ne_zero := hd }))
      rw [hindex]
      rw [hsum]
      symm
      calc
        RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul A B)) =
            RealTheory.mul A
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv B)
                (RealTheory.inv A)) := by
              change
                F.mul A (F.inv (F.mul A B)) =
                  F.mul A (F.mul (F.inv B) (F.inv A))
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hAne hBne]
        _ =
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv B)
              (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv A)) := by
              calc
                RealTheory.mul A
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv B)
                      (RealTheory.inv A)) =
                    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul A
                      (RealTheory.inv B)) (RealTheory.inv A) := by
                      rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]
                _ =
                    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.inv B) A) (RealTheory.inv A) := by
                      rw [RealTheory.mul_comm A (RealTheory.inv B)]
                _ =
                    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv B)
                      (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv A)) := by
                      rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
        _ =
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv B) RealTheory.one := by
              rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hAne]
        _ = RealTheory.inv B := by
              rw [RealTheory.mul_one])

name: powByIntDiv_same_den_add
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_same_den_add
    {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (a b : Int) {d : Nat} (hd : Not (d = 0)) :
    powByIntDiv x
        { numerator := a + b
          denominator := d
          denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
      RealTheory.mul
        (powByIntDiv x
          { numerator := a
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd })
        (powByIntDiv x
          { numerator := b
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd })
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases a with
  | ofNat m =>
      cases b with
      | ofNat n =>
          change
            powByNatDiv x
                { numerator := m + n
                  denominator := d
                  denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
              RealTheory.mul
                (powByNatDiv x
                  { numerator := m
                    denominator := d
                    denominator_ne_zero := hd })
                (powByNatDiv x
                  { numerator := n
                    denominator := d
                    denominator_ne_zero := hd })
          exact powByNatDiv_same_den_add
            (x := x) (a := m) (b := n) (d := d) hd
      | negSucc n =>
          change
            powByIntDiv x
                { numerator := Int.subNatNat m (n + 1)
                  denominator := d
                  denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
              RealTheory.mul
                (powByNatDiv x
                  { numerator := m
                    denominator := d
                    denominator_ne_zero := hd })
                (RealTheory.inv
                  (powByNatDiv x
                    { numerator := n + 1
                      denominator := d
                      denominator_ne_zero := hd }))
          exact powByIntDiv_subNatNat_same_den
            hx m (n + 1) d hd
  | negSucc m =>
      cases b with
      | ofNat n =>
          let A : Point :=
            powByNatDiv x
              { numerator := m + 1
                denominator := d
                denominator_ne_zero := hd }
          let B : Point :=
            powByNatDiv x
              { numerator := n
                denominator := d
                denominator_ne_zero := hd }
          have hsub :
              powByIntDiv x
                  { numerator := Int.subNatNat n (m + 1)
                    denominator := d
                    denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
                RealTheory.mul B (RealTheory.inv A) := by
            dsimp [A, B]
            exact powByIntDiv_subNatNat_same_den
              hx n (m + 1) d hd
          change
            powByIntDiv x
                { numerator := Int.subNatNat n (m + 1)
                  denominator := d
                  denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
              RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv A) B
          rw [hsub]
          exact RealTheory.mul_comm B (RealTheory.inv A)
      | negSucc n =>
          let A : Point :=
            powByNatDiv x
              { numerator := m + 1
                denominator := d
                denominator_ne_zero := hd }
          let B : Point :=
            powByNatDiv x
              { numerator := n + 1
                denominator := d
                denominator_ne_zero := hd }
          have hsum :
              powByNatDiv x
                  { numerator := (m + 1) + (n + 1)
                    denominator := d
                    denominator_ne_zero := hd } =
                RealTheory.mul A B := by
            dsimp [A, B]
            exact powByNatDiv_same_den_add
              (x := x) (a := m + 1) (b := n + 1)
              (d := d) hd
          have hApos : PositiveDomain A := by
            dsimp [A]
            exact powByNatDiv_pos_of_pos hx
              { numerator := m + 1
                denominator := d
                denominator_ne_zero := hd }
          have hBpos : PositiveDomain B := by
            dsimp [B]
            exact powByNatDiv_pos_of_pos hx
              { numerator := n + 1
                denominator := d
                denominator_ne_zero := hd }
          have hAne : Not (A = RealTheory.zero) := by
            intro hzero
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hApos hzero.symm
          have hBne : Not (B = RealTheory.zero) := by
            intro hzero
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hBpos hzero.symm
          have hindex :
              m + n + 1 + 1 = (m + 1) + (n + 1) := by omega
          change
            RealTheory.inv
                (powByNatDiv x
                  { numerator := m + n + 1 + 1
                    denominator := d
                    denominator_ne_zero := hd }) =
              RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv A) (RealTheory.inv B)
          rw [hindex]
          rw [hsum]
          calc
            RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul A B) =
                RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv B)
                  (RealTheory.inv A) := by
                change
                  F.inv (F.mul A B) =
                    F.mul (F.inv B) (F.inv A)
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hAne hBne
            _ =
                RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv A)
                  (RealTheory.inv B) := by
                exact RealTheory.mul_comm
                  (RealTheory.inv B) (RealTheory.inv A)

name: powByIntDiv_add
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_add
    {x : Point} (hx : PositiveDomain x)
    (q r : IntDivExponent) :
    powByIntDiv x (IntDivExponent.add q r) =
      RealTheory.mul (powByIntDiv x q) (powByIntDiv x r)
proof:
:= by
  let commonDen := q.denominator * r.denominator
  have hcommon_ne :
      Not (commonDen = 0) :=
    Nat.mul_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero
      r.denominator_ne_zero
  calc
    powByIntDiv x (IntDivExponent.add q r) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (powByIntDiv x
            { numerator :=
                q.numerator * Int.ofNat r.denominator
              denominator := commonDen
              denominator_ne_zero := hcommon_ne })
          (powByIntDiv x
            { numerator :=
                r.numerator * Int.ofNat q.denominator
              denominator := commonDen
              denominator_ne_zero := hcommon_ne }) := by
          change
            powByIntDiv x
                { numerator :=
                    q.numerator * Int.ofNat r.denominator +
                      r.numerator * Int.ofNat q.denominator
                  denominator := commonDen
                  denominator_ne_zero := hcommon_ne } =
              RealTheory.mul
                (powByIntDiv x
                  { numerator :=
                      q.numerator * Int.ofNat r.denominator
                    denominator := commonDen
                    denominator_ne_zero := hcommon_ne })
                (powByIntDiv x
                  { numerator :=
                      r.numerator * Int.ofNat q.denominator
                    denominator := commonDen
                    denominator_ne_zero := hcommon_ne })
          exact powByIntDiv_same_den_add
            hx
            (q.numerator * Int.ofNat r.denominator)
            (r.numerator * Int.ofNat q.denominator)
            hcommon_ne
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul (powByIntDiv x q)
          (powByIntDiv x r) := by
          have hqscale :
              powByIntDiv x
                  { numerator :=
                      q.numerator * Int.ofNat r.denominator
                    denominator := commonDen
                    denominator_ne_zero := hcommon_ne } =
                powByIntDiv x q := by
            unfold commonDen
            change
              powByIntDiv x
                  (IntDivExponent.scaleDen q r.denominator
                    r.denominator_ne_zero) =
                powByIntDiv x q
            exact powByIntDiv_scaleDen
              hx q r.denominator_ne_zero
          have hrscale :
              powByIntDiv x
                  { numerator :=
                      r.numerator * Int.ofNat q.denominator
                    denominator := commonDen
                    denominator_ne_zero := hcommon_ne } =
                powByIntDiv x r := by
            unfold commonDen
            change
              powByIntDiv x
                  { numerator :=
                      r.numerator * Int.ofNat q.denominator
                    denominator := q.denominator * r.denominator
                    denominator_ne_zero :=
                      Nat.mul_ne_zero q.denominator_ne_zero
                        r.denominator_ne_zero } =
                powByIntDiv x r
            exact powByIntDiv_scaleDenLeft
              hx r q.denominator_ne_zero
          rw [hqscale, hrscale]

name: inv_le_one_of_one_le_pos
statement:
theorem inv_le_one_of_one_le_pos
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hone : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.inv x) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
      F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hxpos hone
  change
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.inv x)
      (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one) at h
  rw [show RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one from
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at h
  exact h

name: one_le_inv_of_pos_le_one
statement:
theorem one_le_inv_of_pos_le_one
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxone : RealTheory.le x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
      F hxpos RealTheory.zero_lt_one hxone
  change
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one)
      (RealTheory.inv x) at h
  rw [show RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one from
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at h
  exact h

name: inv_powByNatDiv_le_one_of_one_le
statement:
theorem inv_powByNatDiv_le_one_of_one_le
    {base : Point} (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base)
    (q : NatDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.inv (powByNatDiv base q))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbase_pos : PositiveDomain base :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hbase
  exact inv_le_one_of_one_le_pos
    (powByNatDiv_pos_of_pos hbase_pos q)
    (powByNatDiv_one_le_of_one_le hbase q)

name: inv_powByNatDiv_le_powByNatDiv_of_one_le
statement:
theorem inv_powByNatDiv_le_powByNatDiv_of_one_le
    {base : Point} (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base)
    (q r : NatDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.inv (powByNatDiv base q))
      (powByNatDiv base r)
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.le_trans
    (inv_powByNatDiv_le_one_of_one_le hbase q)
    (powByNatDiv_one_le_of_one_le hbase r)

name: powByIntDiv_negSucc_le_ofNatDiv_of_one_le
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_negSucc_le_ofNatDiv_of_one_le
    {base : Point} (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base)
    {n d : Nat} (hd : Not (d = 0)) (r : NatDivExponent) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powByIntDiv base
        { numerator := Int.negSucc n
          denominator := d
          denominator_ne_zero := hd })
      (powByIntDiv base (IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv r))
proof:
:= by
  unfold powByIntDiv IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv
  exact inv_powByNatDiv_le_powByNatDiv_of_one_le hbase
    { numerator := n + 1
      denominator := d
      denominator_ne_zero := hd }
    r

name: powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv_le_ofNatDiv_of_point_le_of_one_le
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv_le_ofNatDiv_of_point_le_of_one_le
    {base : Point} (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base)
    {q r : NatDivExponent}
    (hqr :
      RealTheory.le
        (IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv q))
        (IntDivExponentPoint (IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv r))) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powByIntDiv base (IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv q))
      (powByIntDiv base (IntDivExponent.ofNatDiv r))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat :
      RealTheory.le (NatDivExponentPoint q)
        (NatDivExponentPoint r) := by
    rwa [intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv,
      intDivExponentPoint_ofNatDiv] at hqr
  rw [powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv, powByIntDiv_ofNatDiv]
  exact powByNatDiv_cross_mul_mono_of_one_le hbase
    (cross_mul_le_of_natDivExponentPoint_le hnat)

name: powByIntDiv_negSucc_le_negSucc_of_point_le_of_one_le
statement:
theorem powByIntDiv_negSucc_le_negSucc_of_point_le_of_one_le
    {base : Point} (hbase : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one base)
    {m n d e : Nat} (hd : Not (d = 0)) (he : Not (e = 0))
    (hqr :
      RealTheory.le
        (IntDivExponentPoint
          { numerator := Int.negSucc m
            denominator := d
            denominator_ne_zero := hd })
        (IntDivExponentPoint
          { numerator := Int.negSucc n
            denominator := e
            denominator_ne_zero := he })) :
    RealTheory.le
      (powByIntDiv base
        { numerator := Int.negSucc m
          denominator := d
          denominator_ne_zero := hd })
      (powByIntDiv base
        { numerator := Int.negSucc n
          denominator := e
          denominator_ne_zero := he })
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let qNat : NatDivExponent :=
    { numerator := m + 1
      denominator := d
      denominator_ne_zero := hd }
  let rNat : NatDivExponent :=
    { numerator := n + 1
      denominator := e
      denominator_ne_zero := he }
  have hneg :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg (NatDivExponentPoint qNat))
        (RealTheory.neg (NatDivExponentPoint rNat)) := by
    dsimp [qNat, rNat]
    rwa [intDivExponentPoint_negSucc_eq_neg_natDiv,
      intDivExponentPoint_negSucc_eq_neg_natDiv] at hqr
  have hrq :
      RealTheory.le (NatDivExponentPoint rNat)
        (NatDivExponentPoint qNat) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_neg_le_neg F hneg
  have hbase_pos : PositiveDomain base :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hbase
  have hpow :
      RealTheory.le (powByNatDiv base rNat)
        (powByNatDiv base qNat) :=
    powByNatDiv_cross_mul_mono_of_one_le hbase
      (cross_mul_le_of_natDivExponentPoint_le hrq)
  have hrpos : PositiveDomain (powByNatDiv base rNat) :=
    powByNatDiv_pos_of_pos hbase_pos rNat
  have hqpos : PositiveDomain (powByNatDiv base qNat) :=
    powByNatDiv_pos_of_pos hbase_pos qNat
  have hinv :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.inv (powByNatDiv base qNat))
        (RealTheory.inv (powByNatDiv base rNat)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos F hrpos hqpos hpow
  dsimp [qNat, rNat] at hinv
  unfold powByIntDiv
  exact hinv

name: exists_cantorStageGap_neighborhood_of_not_cantorSet
statement:
private theorem exists_cantorStageGap_neighborhood_of_not_cantorSet
    {x : Point}
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one)
    (hxC : Not (RealNegligibility.CantorSet x)) :
    Exists (fun radius : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero radius)
        (forall y : Point,
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)) radius ->
            cantorStaircase y = cantorStaircase x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealNegligibility.exists_cantorStageGap_of_not_mem hx0 hx1 hxC with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases hn with
      | intro k hk =>
          let lower := RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint n k
          let upper := RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k + 1)
          have hk0 : k < 2 ^ n := by omega
          have hlowerUnit :=
            (RealNegligibility.cantorStageEndpoints_mem_unitInterval hk0).right
          have hupperUnit :=
            (RealNegligibility.cantorStageEndpoints_mem_unitInterval hk.left).left
          have hlowerValue :=
            (cantorStaircase_stageEndpoint_values hk0).right
          have hupperValue :=
            (cantorStaircase_stageEndpoint_values hk.left).left
          have hendpoint : cantorStaircase lower = cantorStaircase upper := by
            unfold lower upper
            rw [hlowerValue, hupperValue]
          have hlowerLt : F.lt lower x := hk.right.left
          have hupperLt : F.lt x upper := hk.right.right
          let dl := F.sub x lower
          let dr := F.sub upper x
          have hdl : F.lt F.zero dl := by
            unfold dl
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hlowerLt
          have hdr : F.lt F.zero dr := by
            unfold dr
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hupperLt
          let radius := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F dl dr
          have hradius : F.lt F.zero radius :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdl hdr
          refine Exists.intro radius (And.intro hradius ?_)
          intro y hy
          have hyDl : F.lt (F.abs (F.sub y x)) dl :=
            F.lt_of_lt_of_le hy (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F dl dr)
          have hyDr : F.lt (F.abs (F.sub y x)) dr :=
            F.lt_of_lt_of_le hy (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F dl dr)
          have hyLowerRaw := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hyDl
          have hyLower : F.lt lower y := by
            unfold dl at hyLowerRaw
            rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F x lower] at hyLowerRaw
          have hyUpperRaw := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hyDr
          have hyUpper : F.lt y upper := by
            unfold dr at hyUpperRaw
            have hsum : F.add x (F.sub upper x) = upper := by
              rw [F.add_comm x (F.sub upper x)]
              exact F.sub_add_cancel upper x
            rwa [hsum] at hyUpperRaw
          have hxClosed :
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one x :=
            And.intro hx0 (F.le_of_lt hx1)
          have hyClosed :
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one y :=
            And.intro
              (F.le_trans hlowerUnit.left (F.le_of_lt hyLower))
              (F.le_trans (F.le_of_lt hyUpper) hupperUnit.right)
          have hLx := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
            lower x hlowerUnit hxClosed (F.le_of_lt hlowerLt)
          have hxU := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
            x upper hxClosed hupperUnit (F.le_of_lt hupperLt)
          have hLy := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
            lower y hlowerUnit hyClosed (F.le_of_lt hyLower)
          have hyU := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
            y upper hyClosed hupperUnit (F.le_of_lt hyUpper)
          rw [<- hendpoint] at hxU hyU
          have hxEq : cantorStaircase x = cantorStaircase lower :=
            F.le_antisymm hxU hLx
          have hyEq : cantorStaircase y = cantorStaircase lower :=
            F.le_antisymm hyU hLy
          rw [hyEq, hxEq]

name: cantorStaircase_locallyConstant_off_cantorSet
statement:
theorem cantorStaircase_locallyConstant_off_cantorSet
    {x : Point}
    (hxC : Not (RealNegligibility.CantorSet x)) :
    Exists (fun radius : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero radius)
        (forall y : Point,
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)) radius ->
            cantorStaircase y = cantorStaircase x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hx0 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.zero
  · let radius := F.sub F.zero x
    have hradius : F.lt F.zero radius := by
      unfold radius
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx0
    refine Exists.intro radius (And.intro hradius ?_)
    intro y hy
    have hyRaw := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hy
    have hy0 : F.lt y F.zero := by
      unfold radius at hyRaw
      have hsum : F.add x (F.sub F.zero x) = F.zero := by
        rw [F.add_comm x (F.sub F.zero x)]
        exact F.sub_add_cancel F.zero x
      rwa [hsum] at hyRaw
    have hy0le : RealTheory.le y RealTheory.zero := F.le_of_lt hy0
    have hx0le : RealTheory.le x RealTheory.zero := F.le_of_lt hx0
    unfold cantorStaircase
    rw [if_pos hy0le, if_pos hx0le]
  · have hx0le : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hx0
    by_cases hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one
    · exact exists_cantorStageGap_neighborhood_of_not_cantorSet
        hx0le hx1 hxC
    · have hOneCantor : RealNegligibility.CantorSet RealTheory.one := by
        have hendpoint :=
          (RealNegligibility.cantorStageCylinderEndpoint_mem_cantorSet
            (by simp : 0 < 2 ^ 0)).right
        rw [RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint_last_eq_one 0] at hendpoint
        exact hendpoint
      have hOneLe : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hx1
      have hOneLt : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x := by
        apply F.lt_of_le_of_not_le hOneLe
        intro hxLeOne
        have heq := F.le_antisymm hOneLe hxLeOne
        apply hxC
        rw [<- heq]
        exact hOneCantor
      let radius := F.sub x F.one
      have hradius : F.lt F.zero radius := by
        unfold radius
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hOneLt
      refine Exists.intro radius (And.intro hradius ?_)
      intro y hy
      have hyRaw := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hy
      have hOneY : F.lt F.one y := by
        unfold radius at hyRaw
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F x F.one] at hyRaw
      have hyNotZero : Not (RealTheory.le y RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro hy0
        have hbad : F.lt F.one F.zero := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hOneY hy0
        have hzeroBad := F.lt_trans F.zero_lt_one hbad
        exact F.lt_irrefl F.zero hzeroBad
      have hxNotZero : Not (RealTheory.le x RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro hxle
        have hbad : F.lt F.one F.zero := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hOneLt hxle
        have hzeroBad := F.lt_trans F.zero_lt_one hbad
        exact F.lt_irrefl F.zero hzeroBad
      have hyNotOne : Not (RealTheory.lt y RealTheory.one) := by
        intro hy1
        have hbad := F.lt_trans hOneY hy1
        exact F.lt_irrefl F.one hbad
      unfold cantorStaircase
      rw [if_neg hyNotZero, if_neg hyNotOne, if_neg hxNotZero, if_neg hx1]

name: planeNorm_one_right_le
statement:
private theorem planeNorm_one_right_le (u : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (PlaneNorm u RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base

name: cantorStageGraphLength_eventually_gt_two_sub
statement:
theorem cantorStageGraphLength_eventually_gt_two_sub
    (eps : Point) (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat =>
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) eps)
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n))
          (PlaneNorm (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n) RealTheory.one)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual_eventually_lt eps heps with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro (2 * N) ?_
      have hres :
          F.lt (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual (2 * N)) eps :=
        hN N (Nat.le_refl N)
      have hsub :
          F.lt (F.sub F.one eps)
            (F.sub F.one (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual (2 * N))) := by
        have hneg := F.neg_lt_neg hres
        have haddNeg := F.add_lt_add_left hneg F.one
        simpa [F.sub_eq_add_neg] using haddNeg
      have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hsub F.one
      have hnorm := planeNorm_one_right_le
        (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual (2 * N))
      have hright := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hnorm
        (F.sub F.one (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual (2 * N)))
      have htwoSub :
          F.sub (F.add F.one F.one) eps =
            F.add F.one (F.sub F.one eps) := by
        rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
        rw [F.add_assoc]
        rw [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg]
      change F.lt (F.sub (F.add F.one F.one) eps)
        (F.add
          (F.sub F.one (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual (2 * N)))
          (PlaneNorm (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual (2 * N)) F.one))
      rw [htwoSub]
      rw [F.add_comm F.one
        (F.sub F.one (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual (2 * N)))] at hadd
      exact F.lt_of_lt_of_le hadd hright

name: cantorStageGraphPartition_strict
statement:
private theorem cantorStageGraphPartition_strict
    (n : Nat) :
    IntervalPartition.StrictIntervalPartition
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one (2 * (2 ^ n) - 1)
      (cantorStageGraphPartition n)
proof:
:= by
  let m := 2 ^ n
  have hm : 0 < m := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  refine And.intro (by omega) ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · rw [cantorStageGraphPartition_even n 0]
    exact RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint_zero n
  · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · have hcount : 2 * m - 1 = 2 * (m - 1) + 1 := by omega
      change cantorStageGraphPartition n (2 * m - 1) = RealTheory.one
      rw [hcount, cantorStageGraphPartition_odd]
      exact RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint_last_eq_one n
    · intro i hi
      by_cases heven : i % 2 = 0
      · have hiEq : i = 2 * (i / 2) := by omega
        rw [hiEq]
        rw [cantorStageGraphPartition_even,
          cantorStageGraphPartition_odd]
        exact RealNegligibility.cantorStageCylinder_lt n (i / 2)
      · have hiEq : i = 2 * (i / 2) + 1 := by omega
        have hk : i / 2 + 1 < 2 ^ n := by
          omega
        rw [hiEq]
        have hnextEq : 2 * (i / 2) + 1 + 1 = 2 * (i / 2 + 1) := by
          omega
        rw [hnextEq]
        rw [cantorStageGraphPartition_odd,
          cantorStageGraphPartition_even]
        exact RealNegligibility.cantorStageCylinders_adjacent_lt hk

name: finiteSum_interleaved_last
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_interleaved_last
    (term : Nat -> Point) (m : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum term (2 * m - 1) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term (2 * k)) m)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term (2 * k + 1)) (m - 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcount : 2 * m - 1 = 2 * (m - 1) + 1 := by omega
  rw [hcount]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_pair_even_odd]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
  have hmEq : m = (m - 1) + 1 := by omega
  have hevenSucc :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_succ (fun k : Nat => term (2 * k)) (m - 1)
  rw [<- hmEq] at hevenSucc
  rw [hevenSucc]
  let evenSum := RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term (2 * k)) (m - 1)
  let oddSum := RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term (2 * k + 1)) (m - 1)
  let last := term (2 * (m - 1))
  change F.add (F.add evenSum oddSum) last =
    F.add (F.add evenSum last) oddSum
  calc
    F.add (F.add evenSum oddSum) last =
        F.add evenSum (F.add oddSum last) :=
      F.add_assoc evenSum oddSum last
    _ = F.add evenSum (F.add last oddSum) := by
      rw [F.add_comm oddSum last]
    _ = F.add (F.add evenSum last) oddSum :=
      (F.add_assoc evenSum last oddSum).symm

name: planeNorm_zero_right_eq_of_nonneg
statement:
private theorem planeNorm_zero_right_eq_of_nonneg
    {u : Point} (hu : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero u) :
    PlaneNorm u RealTheory.zero = u
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hlower := abs_left_le_planeNorm u RealTheory.zero
  change F.le (F.abs u) (PlaneNorm u F.zero) at hlower
  rw [F.abs_of_nonneg hu] at hlower
  have hupper := planeNorm_le_abs_add_abs u RealTheory.zero
  change F.le (PlaneNorm u F.zero) (F.add (F.abs u) (F.abs F.zero)) at hupper
  rw [F.abs_of_nonneg hu, F.abs_zero, F.add_zero] at hupper
  exact F.le_antisymm hupper hlower

name: cantorStage_survivorChord
statement:
private theorem cantorStage_survivorChord
    {n k : Nat} (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
        (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * k) =
      PlaneNorm (RealTheory.baseTail 3 n) (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold planePolygonalLengthTerm PlaneDistance IdentityFun
  rw [cantorStageGraphPartition_even, cantorStageGraphPartition_odd]
  have hvalues := cantorStaircase_stageEndpoint_values hk
  rw [hvalues.left, hvalues.right]
  rw [RealNegligibility.cantorStageCylinder_width]
  change
    PlaneNorm (F.baseTail 3 n)
        (F.sub
          (F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) (F.baseTail 2 n))
          (F.mul (F.nat k) (F.baseTail 2 n))) =
      PlaneNorm (F.baseTail 3 n) (F.baseTail 2 n)
  have hsucc := CantorStaircaseInternal.nat_succ_mul_step k (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n)
  change
    F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) (F.baseTail 2 n) =
      F.add (F.mul (F.nat k) (F.baseTail 2 n)) (F.baseTail 2 n)
      at hsucc
  rw [hsucc]
  have hsub :
      F.sub
          (F.add (F.mul (F.nat k) (F.baseTail 2 n)) (F.baseTail 2 n))
          (F.mul (F.nat k) (F.baseTail 2 n)) =
        F.baseTail 2 n := by
    apply F.add_right_cancel
    rw [F.sub_add_cancel]
    rw [F.add_comm]
  rw [hsub]

name: cantorStage_removedGapChord
statement:
private theorem cantorStage_removedGapChord
    {n k : Nat} (hk : k + 1 < 2 ^ n) :
    planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
        (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * k + 1) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k + 1))
        (RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint n k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold planePolygonalLengthTerm PlaneDistance IdentityFun
  have hnext : 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
  rw [hnext]
  rw [cantorStageGraphPartition_odd, cantorStageGraphPartition_even]
  have hk0 : k < 2 ^ n := by omega
  have hright := (cantorStaircase_stageEndpoint_values hk0).right
  have hleft := (cantorStaircase_stageEndpoint_values hk).left
  rw [hright, hleft]
  change
    PlaneNorm
        (F.sub
          (RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k + 1))
          (RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint n k))
        (F.sub
          (F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) (F.baseTail 2 n))
          (F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) (F.baseTail 2 n))) =
      F.sub
        (RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k + 1))
        (RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint n k)
  rw [F.sub_self]
  exact planeNorm_zero_right_eq_of_nonneg
    (F.le_of_lt
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F
        (RealNegligibility.cantorStageCylinders_adjacent_lt hk)))

name: cantorStage_survivorChordSum
statement:
private theorem cantorStage_survivorChordSum (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
            (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * k))
        (2 ^ n) =
      PlaneNorm (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let m := 2 ^ n
  let diagonal := PlaneNorm (F.baseTail 3 n) (F.baseTail 2 n)
  have hterms :
      F.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
              (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * k)) m =
        F.finiteSum (fun _ : Nat => diagonal) m := by
    exact F.finiteSum_congr_lt m (fun k hk => cantorStage_survivorChord hk)
  change
    F.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
            (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * k)) m =
      PlaneNorm (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n) F.one
  rw [hterms]
  rw [F.finiteSum_const]
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    unfold m
    exact Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  have hmNe : Not (m = 0) := by omega
  have hnatNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.nat m) :=
    F.le_of_lt (F.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hmNe)
  have habs : F.abs (F.nat m) = F.nat m :=
    F.abs_of_nonneg hnatNonneg
  have hscale := planeNorm_mul (F.nat m) (F.baseTail 3 n) (F.baseTail 2 n)
  change
    PlaneNorm
        (F.mul (F.nat m) (F.baseTail 3 n))
        (F.mul (F.nat m) (F.baseTail 2 n)) =
      F.mul (F.abs (F.nat m)) diagonal at hscale
  rw [habs] at hscale
  have htwo : F.mul (F.nat m) (F.baseTail 2 n) = F.one := by
    exact CantorStaircaseInternal.nat_mul_baseTail_two_eq_one_of_eq_pow (by rfl)
  unfold RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual
  change
    F.mul (F.nat m) diagonal =
      PlaneNorm (F.mul (F.nat m) (F.baseTail 3 n)) F.one
  rw [<- htwo]
  exact hscale.symm

name: cantorStageHorizontal_even
statement:
private theorem cantorStageHorizontal_even
    {n k : Nat} :
    RealTheory.sub
        (cantorStageGraphPartition n (2 * k + 1))
        (cantorStageGraphPartition n (2 * k)) =
      RealTheory.baseTail 3 n
proof:
:= by
  rw [cantorStageGraphPartition_even, cantorStageGraphPartition_odd]
  exact RealNegligibility.cantorStageCylinder_width n k

name: cantorStageHorizontal_odd
statement:
private theorem cantorStageHorizontal_odd
    {n k : Nat} :
    RealTheory.sub
        (cantorStageGraphPartition n (2 * k + 1 + 1))
        (cantorStageGraphPartition n (2 * k + 1)) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k + 1))
        (RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint n k)
proof:
:= by
  have hnext : 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
  rw [hnext]
  rw [cantorStageGraphPartition_odd, cantorStageGraphPartition_even]

name: cantorStage_removedGapChordSum
statement:
private theorem cantorStage_removedGapChordSum (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
            (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * k + 1))
        (2 ^ n - 1) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let m := 2 ^ n
  let p := cantorStageGraphPartition n
  let horizontal : Nat -> Point := fun i : Nat => F.sub (p (i + 1)) (p i)
  let gapSum :=
    F.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat =>
        planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase p (2 * k + 1))
      (m - 1)
  change gapSum = F.sub F.one (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n)
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    unfold m
    exact Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  have hinter := finiteSum_interleaved_last horizontal m hm
  have htelescope := F.finiteSum_telescope_sub p (2 * m - 1)
  change
    F.finiteSum horizontal (2 * m - 1) =
      F.sub (p (2 * m - 1)) (p 0) at htelescope
  have hp0 : p 0 = F.zero := by
    unfold p
    rw [show 0 = 2 * 0 by omega]
    rw [cantorStageGraphPartition_even]
    exact RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint_zero n
  have hplast : p (2 * m - 1) = F.one := by
    have hcount : 2 * m - 1 = 2 * (m - 1) + 1 := by omega
    unfold p
    rw [hcount, cantorStageGraphPartition_odd]
    exact RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint_last_eq_one n
  have htotal : F.finiteSum horizontal (2 * m - 1) = F.one := by
    rw [htelescope, hp0, hplast, F.sub_zero]
  change
    F.finiteSum horizontal (2 * m - 1) =
      F.add
        (F.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => horizontal (2 * k)) m)
        (F.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => horizontal (2 * k + 1)) (m - 1))
      at hinter
  rw [htotal] at hinter
  have heven :
      F.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => horizontal (2 * k)) m =
        RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n := by
    have hcongr :
        F.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => horizontal (2 * k)) m =
          F.finiteSum (fun _ : Nat => F.baseTail 3 n) m := by
      apply F.finiteSum_congr_lt m
      intro k _hk
      unfold horizontal p
      exact cantorStageHorizontal_even
    rw [hcongr, F.finiteSum_const]
    unfold RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual m
    rfl
  have hodd :
      F.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => horizontal (2 * k + 1)) (m - 1) =
        gapSum := by
    unfold gapSum
    apply F.finiteSum_congr_lt (m - 1)
    intro k hk
    have hk' : k + 1 < 2 ^ n := by
      unfold m at hk
      omega
    unfold horizontal p
    have hhorizontal := cantorStageHorizontal_odd (n := n) (k := k)
    change
      F.sub
          (cantorStageGraphPartition n (2 * k + 1 + 1))
          (cantorStageGraphPartition n (2 * k + 1)) =
        F.sub
          (RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k + 1))
          (RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) at hhorizontal
    rw [hhorizontal]
    exact (cantorStage_removedGapChord hk').symm
  rw [heven, hodd] at hinter
  apply F.add_left_cancel
  rw [hinter.symm]
  rw [F.add_comm (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n)
    (F.sub F.one (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n))]
  rw [F.sub_add_cancel]

name: cantorStageGraphPolygonalLength_eq
statement:
private theorem cantorStageGraphPolygonalLength_eq (n : Nat) :
    planePolygonalLength IdentityFun cantorStaircase
        (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * (2 ^ n) - 1) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n))
        (PlaneNorm (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n) RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let m := 2 ^ n
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    unfold m
    exact Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  unfold planePolygonalLength
  have hinter := finiteSum_interleaved_last
    (planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
      (cantorStageGraphPartition n)) m hm
  change
    F.finiteSum
        (planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
          (cantorStageGraphPartition n)) (2 * m - 1) = _
  change
    F.finiteSum
        (planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
          (cantorStageGraphPartition n)) (2 * m - 1) =
      F.add
        (F.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
              (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * k)) m)
        (F.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
              (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * k + 1)) (m - 1))
      at hinter
  rw [hinter]
  have hsurvivor := cantorStage_survivorChordSum n
  have hgap := cantorStage_removedGapChordSum n
  change
    F.add
        (F.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
              (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * k)) m)
        (F.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
              (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * k + 1)) (m - 1)) = _
  change
    F.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
            (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * k)) m =
      PlaneNorm (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n) F.one at hsurvivor
  change
    F.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          planePolygonalLengthTerm IdentityFun cantorStaircase
            (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * k + 1)) (m - 1) =
      F.sub F.one (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n) at hgap
  rw [hsurvivor, hgap]
  change
    F.add
        (PlaneNorm (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n) F.one)
        (F.sub F.one (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n)) =
      F.add
        (F.sub F.one (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n))
        (PlaneNorm (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n) F.one)
  rw [F.add_comm]

name: cantorGraph_totalVariation_identity_le_one
statement:
private theorem cantorGraph_totalVariation_identity_le_one :
    RealTheory.le
      (BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom RealTheory.zero IdentityFun
        RealTheory.one)
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h01 : F.le F.zero F.one := F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one
  have hV := BoundedVariation.identityFun_variationBoundOn h01
  have honeMem := RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem h01
  have hspec :=
    BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_spec_of_variationBoundOn hV honeMem
  have hupper :
      IsUpperBound F.le
        (BoundedVariation.VariationValueOn F.zero F.one IdentityFun)
        (F.sub F.one F.zero) := by
    intro value hvalue
    cases hvalue with
    | inl hzero =>
        rw [hzero.right]
        exact BoundedVariation.variationBoundOn_bound_nonnegative hV
    | inr hpart =>
        cases hpart with
        | intro n hn =>
            cases hn with
            | intro p hp =>
                rw [hp.right]
                exact
                  BoundedVariation.variationBoundOn_subinterval_partitionVariation_le
                    hV honeMem hp.left
  have hle := hspec.right (F.sub F.one F.zero) hupper
  rw [F.sub_zero] at hle
  exact hle

name: cantorGraph_totalVariation_staircase_le_one
statement:
private theorem cantorGraph_totalVariation_staircase_le_one :
    RealTheory.le
      (BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom RealTheory.zero cantorStaircase
        RealTheory.one)
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h01 : F.le F.zero F.one := F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one
  have hV :=
    BoundedVariation.monotoneOn_closedInterval_variationBoundOn
      h01 cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
  have honeMem := RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem h01
  have hspec :=
    BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_spec_of_variationBoundOn hV honeMem
  have hupper :
      IsUpperBound F.le
        (BoundedVariation.VariationValueOn F.zero F.one cantorStaircase)
        (F.sub (cantorStaircase F.one) (cantorStaircase F.zero)) := by
    intro value hvalue
    cases hvalue with
    | inl hzero =>
        rw [hzero.right]
        exact BoundedVariation.variationBoundOn_bound_nonnegative hV
    | inr hpart =>
        cases hpart with
        | intro n hn =>
            cases hn with
            | intro p hp =>
                rw [hp.right]
                exact
                  BoundedVariation.variationBoundOn_subinterval_partitionVariation_le
                    hV honeMem hp.left
  have hle :=
    hspec.right
      (F.sub (cantorStaircase F.one) (cantorStaircase F.zero)) hupper
  change
    F.le
      (BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom F.zero cantorStaircase F.one)
      (F.sub (cantorStaircase F.one) (cantorStaircase F.zero)) at hle
  change
    F.le
      (BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom F.zero cantorStaircase F.one)
      F.one
  have hOne : cantorStaircase F.one = F.one := cantorStaircase_one
  have hZero : cantorStaircase F.zero = F.zero := cantorStaircase_zero
  rw [hOne, hZero, F.sub_zero] at hle
  exact hle

name: cantorGraph_planeCurveLength_le_two
statement:
private theorem cantorGraph_planeCurveLength_le_two :
    RealTheory.le
      (planeCurveLengthOn RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
        IdentityFun cantorStaircase)
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbound :
      PlaneCurveLengthBoundOn F.zero F.one IdentityFun cantorStaircase
        (F.add F.one F.one) := by
    intro n p hp
    have hpoly :=
      planePolygonalLength_le_add_partitionVariation
        IdentityFun cantorStaircase p n
    have hx :=
      BoundedVariation.partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_of_intervalPartition
        cantorGraph_identity_boundedVariationOn hp
    have hy :=
      BoundedVariation.partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_of_intervalPartition
        cantorStaircase_boundedVariationOn hp
    have hvariation := F.add_le_add hx hy
    have htotals := F.add_le_add
      cantorGraph_totalVariation_identity_le_one
      cantorGraph_totalVariation_staircase_le_one
    exact F.le_trans hpoly (F.le_trans hvariation htotals)
  have hspec :=
    planeCurveLengthOn_spec_of_rectifiable cantorGraph_rectifiablePlaneCurveOn
  have hupper :
      IsUpperBound F.le
        (PlaneCurveLengthValueOn F.zero F.one IdentityFun cantorStaircase)
        (F.add F.one F.one) := by
    intro value hvalue
    cases hvalue with
    | inl hzero =>
        rw [hzero.right]
        have h := F.add_le_add
          (F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one) (F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one)
        rw [F.zero_add] at h
        exact h
    | inr hpart =>
        cases hpart with
        | intro n hn =>
            cases hn with
            | intro p hp =>
                rw [hp.right.right]
                exact hbound n p hp.right.left
  exact hspec.right (F.add F.one F.one) hupper

name: cantorGraph_two_le_planeCurveLength
statement:
private theorem cantorGraph_two_le_planeCurveLength :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one)
      (planeCurveLengthOn RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
        IdentityFun cantorStaircase)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let two := F.add F.one F.one
  let length :=
    planeCurveLengthOn F.zero F.one IdentityFun cantorStaircase
  have hnear :
      forall eps : Point, F.lt F.zero eps -> F.lt (F.sub two eps) length := by
    intro eps heps
    cases cantorStageGraphLength_eventually_gt_two_sub eps heps with
    | intro n hn =>
        have hpart :=
          IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_intervalPartition
            (cantorStageGraphPartition_strict n)
        have hpoly :=
          planePolygonalLength_le_planeCurveLengthOn
            cantorGraph_rectifiablePlaneCurveOn hpart
        have hexact := cantorStageGraphPolygonalLength_eq n
        change
          F.lt (F.sub two eps)
            (F.add
              (F.sub F.one (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n))
              (PlaneNorm (RealNegligibility.cantorStageResidual n) F.one)) at hn
        change
          F.le
            (planePolygonalLength IdentityFun cantorStaircase
              (cantorStageGraphPartition n) (2 * (2 ^ n) - 1)) length at hpoly
        rw [hexact] at hpoly
        exact F.lt_of_lt_of_le hn hpoly
  cases F.le_total two length with
  | inl h => exact h
  | inr hle =>
      by_cases heq : length = two
      · change F.le two length
        rw [heq]
        exact F.le_refl two
      · have hlt : F.lt length two := by
          apply F.lt_of_le_of_not_le hle
          intro hreverse
          exact heq (F.le_antisymm hle hreverse)
        let eps := F.sub two length
        have heps : F.lt F.zero eps :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hlt
        have hbad := hnear eps heps
        have hcancel : F.sub two eps = length := by
          unfold eps
          apply F.add_right_cancel
          rw [F.sub_add_cancel]
          rw [F.add_comm length (F.sub two length)]
          rw [F.sub_add_cancel]
        rw [hcancel] at hbad
        exact False.elim (F.lt_irrefl length hbad)

name: cantorGraph_planeCurveLength_eq_two
statement:
theorem cantorGraph_planeCurveLength_eq_two :
    planeCurveLengthOn RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
        IdentityFun cantorStaircase =
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  exact RealTheory.le_antisymm
    cantorGraph_planeCurveLength_le_two
    cantorGraph_two_le_planeCurveLength

name: canonicalTernaryDigits_spec
statement:
private theorem canonicalTernaryDigits_spec
    {x : Point}
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.HasCanonicalBaseExpansion 3 x (canonicalTernaryDigits x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold canonicalTernaryDigits
  rw [dif_pos (And.intro hx0 hx1)]
  exact Classical.choose_spec
    ((RealTheory.baseExpansionPackage validBase_three_staircase).exists_canonical
      x hx0 hx1)

private theorem canonicalTernaryDigits_unique

  (RealTheory.baseExpansionPackage validBase_three_staircase).unique_canonical
