name: cantorStaircase_one
statement:
theorem cantorStaircase_one :
    cantorStaircase RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold cantorStaircase
  rw [if_neg]
  · have hnot : Not (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) := by
      intro h
      exact F.lt_irrefl F.one h
    rw [if_neg hnot]
  · intro h
    have hbad : F.lt F.zero F.zero :=
      F.lt_of_lt_of_le F.zero_lt_one h
    exact F.lt_irrefl F.zero hbad

name: hasEarlierTernaryOne_of_prefix
statement:
private theorem hasEarlierTernaryOne_of_prefix
    {x y : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hprefix :
      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
        canonicalTernaryDigits x i = canonicalTernaryDigits y i) :
    HasEarlierTernaryOne x n -> HasEarlierTernaryOne y n
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  cases h with
  | intro k hk =>
      exact Exists.intro k
        (And.intro hk.left ((hprefix k hk.left) ▸ hk.right))

name: cantorTransformedDigit_eq_of_prefix
statement:
private theorem cantorTransformedDigit_eq_of_prefix
    {x y : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hprefix :
      forall i : Nat, i <= n ->
        canonicalTernaryDigits x i = canonicalTernaryDigits y i) :
    cantorTransformedDigit x n = cantorTransformedDigit y n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hstrict :
      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
        canonicalTernaryDigits x i = canonicalTernaryDigits y i := by
    intro i hi
    exact hprefix i (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
  have hxy := hasEarlierTernaryOne_of_prefix hstrict
  have hyx := hasEarlierTernaryOne_of_prefix
    (fun i hi => (hstrict i hi).symm)
  unfold cantorTransformedDigit
  by_cases hx : HasEarlierTernaryOne x n
  · rw [if_pos hx, if_pos (hxy hx)]
  · have hy : Not (HasEarlierTernaryOne y n) := by
      intro hy
      exact hx (hyx hy)
    rw [if_neg hx, if_neg hy, hprefix n (Nat.le_refl n)]

name: cantorTransformedDigit_eq_zero_of_digit_zero
statement:
private theorem cantorTransformedDigit_eq_zero_of_digit_zero
    {x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hdigit : canonicalTernaryDigits x n = 0) :
    cantorTransformedDigit x n = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold cantorTransformedDigit
  by_cases h : HasEarlierTernaryOne x n
  · rw [if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_pos hdigit]

name: cantorTransformedDigit_eq_one_of_no_earlier_of_digit_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem cantorTransformedDigit_eq_one_of_no_earlier_of_digit_ne_zero
    {x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hearlier : Not (HasEarlierTernaryOne x n))
    (hdigit : Not (canonicalTernaryDigits x n = 0)) :
    cantorTransformedDigit x n = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold cantorTransformedDigit
  rw [if_neg hearlier, if_neg hdigit]

name: transformed_prefix_eq_of_ternary_prefix
statement:
private theorem transformed_prefix_eq_of_ternary_prefix
    {x y : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hprefix :
      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
        canonicalTernaryDigits x i = canonicalTernaryDigits y i) :
    forall i : Nat, i < n ->
      cantorTransformedDigit x i = cantorTransformedDigit y i
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  apply cantorTransformedDigit_eq_of_prefix
  intro j hj
  exact hprefix j (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hj hi)

name: baseExpansion_value_le_of_first_digit_lt
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hvalueLe :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansion_value_le_envelope F hvalue (n + 1)
  have hbridge :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionEnvelope_succ_le_partial_succ_of_digit_lt
      F hq hprefix hlt
  have hpartialLe :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_le_value F hother (n + 1)
  exact F.le_trans hvalueLe (F.le_trans hbridge hpartialLe)

name: cantorBinaryValue_eq_of_transformed_digits
statement:
private theorem cantorBinaryValue_eq_of_transformed_digits
    {x y : Point}
    (hdigits : cantorTransformedDigit x = cantorTransformedDigit y) :
    cantorBinaryValue x = cantorBinaryValue y
proof:
:= by
  have hx := cantorBinaryValue_spec x
  rw [hdigits] at hx
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.same_digits_baseExpansion_unique
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    hx (cantorBinaryValue_spec y)

name: lt_of_le_of_ne_right
statement:
private theorem lt_of_le_of_ne_right
    {x y : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hne : Not (x = y)) :
    RealTheory.lt x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hyx : RealTheory.le y x
  · exact False.elim (hne (F.le_antisymm hxy hyx))
  · exact F.lt_of_le_of_not_le hxy hyx

name: transformed_digits_eq_of_earlier_one_before_prefix
statement:
private theorem transformed_digits_eq_of_earlier_one_before_prefix
    {x y : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hprefix :
      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
        canonicalTernaryDigits x i = canonicalTernaryDigits y i)
    (hearlier : HasEarlierTernaryOne x n) :
    cantorTransformedDigit x = cantorTransformedDigit y
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  cases hearlier with
  | intro k hk =>
      have hyk : canonicalTernaryDigits y k = 1 := by
        rw [<- hprefix k hk.left]
        exact hk.right
      by_cases hik : i <= k
      · apply cantorTransformedDigit_eq_of_prefix
        intro j hj
        exact hprefix j (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_trans hj hik) hk.left)
      · have hki : k < i := by omega
        rw [cantorTransformedDigit_freezes_after_one hk.right hki]
        rw [cantorTransformedDigit_freezes_after_one hyk hki]

name: seqTendsto_partial_of_eventually_constant
statement:
private theorem seqTendsto_partial_of_eventually_constant
    {q : Nat} {digits : Nat -> Nat} {N : Nat}
    (hzero : forall i : Nat, N <= i -> digits i = 0) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial q digits)
      (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial q digits N)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  refine Exists.intro N ?_
  intro m hm
  have hmEq : m = N + (m - N) := by omega
  rw [hmEq]
  rw [RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial_eq_of_zero_after hzero]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_zero
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base]
  exact heps

name: baseExpansionEnvelope_eventually_constant_of_max_after
statement:
private theorem baseExpansionEnvelope_eventually_constant_of_max_after
    {q : Nat} {digits : Nat -> Nat} {N : Nat}
    (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q)
    (hmax : forall i : Nat, N <= i -> digits i = q - 1) :
    forall r : Nat,
      RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope q digits (N + r) =
        RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope q digits N
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero => rw [Nat.add_zero]
  | succ r ih =>
      change
        F.add
            (F.baseExpansionPartial q digits (N + (r + 1)))
            (F.baseTail q (N + (r + 1))) =
          RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope q digits N
      have hidx : N + (r + 1) = (N + r) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hidx]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_succ]
      rw [hmax (N + r) (by omega)]
      rw [F.add_assoc]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseWeightedMax_add_tail_succ F hq]
      change
        RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope q digits (N + r) =
          RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope q digits N
      exact ih

name: hasBaseExpansion_of_zero_after
statement:
private theorem hasBaseExpansion_of_zero_after
    {q : Nat} {digits : Nat -> Nat} {N : Nat}
    (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q)
    (hstream : RealTheory.BaseDigitStream q digits)
    (hzero : forall i : Nat, N <= i -> digits i = 0) :
    RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion q
      (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial q digits N) digits
proof:
:=
  And.intro hq
    (And.intro hstream
      (seqTendsto_partial_of_eventually_constant hzero))

name: hasBaseExpansion_of_max_after
statement:
private theorem hasBaseExpansion_of_max_after
    {q : Nat} {digits : Nat -> Nat} {N : Nat}
    (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q)
    (hstream : RealTheory.BaseDigitStream q digits)
    (hmax : forall i : Nat, N <= i -> digits i = q - 1) :
    RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion q
      (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope q digits N) digits
proof:
:= by
  cases RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial_converges hq hstream with
  | intro value hvalue =>
      have henvelope := RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope_tendsto hvalue
      have hconst :
          RealTheory.SeqTendsto
            (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope q digits)
            (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope q digits N) := by
        apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_eventually_eq_const (N := N)
        intro m hm
        have hmEq : m = N + (m - N) := by omega
        rw [hmEq]
        exact baseExpansionEnvelope_eventually_constant_of_max_after
          hq hmax (m - N)
      have hvalueEq :
          value = RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope q digits N :=
        RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique henvelope hconst
      rw [<- hvalueEq]
      exact hvalue

name: maxDigitPartial_tendsto_one
statement:
private theorem maxDigitPartial_tendsto_one
    {q : Nat}
    (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial q (fun _ : Nat => q - 1))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hconst : RealTheory.SeqTendsto (fun _ : Nat => F.one) F.one :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_const F.one
  have htail := RealTheory.baseTail_tendsto_zero_all hq
  have hsub := RealTheory.seqTendsto_sub hconst htail
  have hrep :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.repeatingMaxDigitPartial q n)
        RealTheory.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat => F.sub F.one (F.baseTail q n))
        (F.sub F.one F.zero) at hsub
    rwa [F.sub_zero] at hsub
  apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hrep
  refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
  intro n _
  exact RealTheory.maxDigitsPartial_eq_repeatingMaxDigitPartial hq n

name: baseExpansion_value_lt_one_of_exists_digit_lt_max
statement:
private theorem baseExpansion_value_lt_one_of_exists_digit_lt_max
    {q : Nat} {x : Point} {digits : Nat -> Nat}
    (hbase : RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion q x digits)
    (hexists : Exists (fun n : Nat => digits n < q - 1)) :
    RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let P : Nat -> Prop := fun n : Nat => digits n < q - 1
  let n := Tautology.Nat.least P hexists
  have hn : P n := Tautology.Nat.least_spec P hexists
  have hprefix :
      forall i : Nat, i < n -> digits i = q - 1 := by
    intro i hi
    have hdigit := hbase.right.left i
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.BaseDigit at hdigit
    by_cases hlt : digits i < q - 1
    · have hmin := Tautology.Nat.least_min P hexists hlt
      change n <= i at hmin
      omega
    · omega
  have hvalueLe :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansion_value_le_envelope F hbase (n + 1)
  have hbridge :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionEnvelope_succ_le_partial_succ_of_digit_lt
      F hbase.left hprefix hn
  have hmaxLt :
      F.lt
        (F.baseExpansionPartial q (fun _ : Nat => q - 1) (n + 1))
        F.one := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.maxDigitsPartial_eq_repeatingMaxDigitPartial
      F hbase.left]
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.repeatingMaxDigitPartial
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail_pos F hbase.left (n + 1))
  exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt (F.le_trans hvalueLe hbridge) hmaxLt

name: nat_mul_baseTail_two_eq_one_of_eq_pow
statement:
private theorem nat_mul_baseTail_two_eq_one_of_eq_pow
    {m n : Nat}
    (hm : m = 2 ^ n) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat m)
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  subst m
  unfold RealTheory.baseTail
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.basePow
  apply F.mul_inv_cancel
  intro hzero
  have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  have hpowNe : Not (2 ^ n = 0) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hpos
    omega
  have hnatPos := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F hpowNe
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hnatPos) hzero.symm

name: nat_mul_baseTail_two_lt_one_of_lt_pow
statement:
private theorem nat_mul_baseTail_two_lt_one_of_lt_pow
    {m n : Nat}
    (hm : m < 2 ^ n) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat m)
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpowPos : 0 < 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  have hpowNeNat : Not (2 ^ n = 0) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hpowPos
    omega
  have hpowNe : Not (F.nat (2 ^ n) = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    have hnatPos := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F hpowNeNat
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hnatPos) hzero.symm
  have hnatLt := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_lt_nat_of_lt F hm
  have hinvPos := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F hpowNeNat)
  have hmul := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hnatLt hinvPos
  unfold RealTheory.baseTail
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.basePow
  have hone := F.mul_inv_cancel hpowNe
  rw [hone] at hmul
  exact hmul

name: baseExpansion_digits_eq_zero_of_value_zero
statement:
private theorem baseExpansion_digits_eq_zero_of_value_zero
    {q : Nat} {digits : Nat -> Nat}
    (hbase : RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion q RealTheory.zero digits) :
    digits = (fun _ : Nat => 0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  funext i
  by_cases hzero : digits i = 0
  · exact hzero
  · have hdigitPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (digits i)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F hzero
    have htailPos :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail_pos F hbase.left (i + 1)
    have hweightedPos :
        F.lt F.zero (F.baseWeightedDigit q (digits i) i) := by
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseWeightedDigit
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseDigitValue
      exact F.mul_pos hdigitPos htailPos
    have hpartialNonneg :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_nonneg
        F hbase.left digits i
    have hpartialLt :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hweightedPos
        (x := F.baseExpansionPartial q digits i)
    have hpositive :
        F.lt F.zero (F.baseExpansionPartial q digits (i + 1)) := by
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_succ]
      exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hpartialNonneg hpartialLt
    have hle :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_le_value F hbase (i + 1)
    have hbad : F.lt F.zero F.zero := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hpositive hle
    exact False.elim (F.lt_irrefl F.zero hbad)

name: exists_carry_index_of_trailingTwo
statement:
private theorem exists_carry_index_of_trailingTwo
    {x : Point} {digits : Nat -> Nat} {N : Nat}
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one)
    (hternary : RealTheory.HasTernaryCantorExpansion x digits)
    (htwo : forall i : Nat, N <= i -> digits i = 2) :
    Exists (fun j : Nat =>
      And (digits j = 0)
        (forall i : Nat, j + 1 <= i -> digits i = 2))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let P : Nat -> Prop := fun M : Nat =>
    forall i : Nat, M <= i -> digits i = 2
  have hP : Exists P := Exists.intro N htwo
  let M := Tautology.Nat.least P hP
  have hMtail : P M := Tautology.Nat.least_spec P hP
  have hMpos : 0 < M := by
    by_cases hMzero : M = 0
    · have hdigits : digits = (fun _ : Nat => 2) := by
        funext i
        exact hMtail i (by omega)
      have hxconv := hternary.right.right
      rw [hdigits] at hxconv
      have honeconv := maxDigitPartial_tendsto_one validBase_three_staircase
      have hxeq : x = F.one := RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hxconv honeconv
      rw [hxeq] at hx1
      exact False.elim (F.lt_irrefl F.one hx1)
    · omega
  let j := M - 1
  have hM : M = j + 1 := by
    unfold j
    omega
  have hjAllowed := hternary.right.left.right j
  have hjzero : digits j = 0 := by
    unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hjAllowed
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hjAllowed
    cases hjAllowed with
    | inl hzero => exact hzero
    | inr htwoAtJ =>
        have hPj : P j := by
          intro i hi
          by_cases hij : i = j
          · subst i
            exact htwoAtJ
          · apply hMtail
            rw [hM]
            omega
        have hmin := Tautology.Nat.least_min P hP hPj
        change M <= j at hmin
        rw [hM] at hmin
        omega
  refine Exists.intro j (And.intro hjzero ?_)
  intro i hi
  apply hMtail
  rw [hM]
  exact hi

name: carry_partial_eq_envelope
statement:
private theorem carry_partial_eq_envelope
    {q : Nat} {digits : Nat -> Nat} {j : Nat}
    (hzero : digits j = 0) :
    RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial q
        (ternaryCarryDigits digits j) (j + 1) =
      RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope q digits (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hprefix :
      F.baseExpansionPartial q (ternaryCarryDigits digits j) j =
        F.baseExpansionPartial q digits j :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_eq_of_prefix_eq F q j
      (by
        intro i hi
        unfold ternaryCarryDigits
        rw [if_pos hi])
  change
    F.add
        (F.baseExpansionPartial q (ternaryCarryDigits digits j) j)
        (F.baseWeightedDigit q (ternaryCarryDigits digits j j) j) =
      F.add
        (F.baseExpansionPartial q digits (j + 1))
        (F.baseTail q (j + 1))
  rw [hprefix]
  have hcarry : ternaryCarryDigits digits j j = 1 := by
    unfold ternaryCarryDigits
    rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos rfl]
  rw [hcarry]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_succ]
  rw [hzero]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseWeightedDigit_zero]
  rw [F.add_zero]
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseWeightedDigit
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseDigitValue
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_one]
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: ternaryCarry_hasCanonicalBaseExpansion
statement:
private theorem ternaryCarry_hasCanonicalBaseExpansion
    {x : Point} {digits : Nat -> Nat} {j : Nat}
    (hternary : RealTheory.HasTernaryCantorExpansion x digits)
    (hzero : digits j = 0)
    (htwo : forall i : Nat, j + 1 <= i -> digits i = 2) :
    RealTheory.HasCanonicalBaseExpansion 3 x
      (ternaryCarryDigits digits j)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcarryBase :
      RealTheory.BaseDigitStream 3 (ternaryCarryDigits digits j) := by
    intro i
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.BaseDigit
    unfold ternaryCarryDigits
    by_cases hij : i < j
    · rw [if_pos hij]
      exact hternary.right.left.left i
    · rw [if_neg hij]
      by_cases hieq : i = j
      · rw [if_pos hieq]
        omega
      · rw [if_neg hieq]
        omega
  have hcarryCanonical :
      RealTheory.CanonicalBaseDigitStream 3
        (ternaryCarryDigits digits j) := by
    refine And.intro hcarryBase ?_
    intro N
    refine Exists.intro (N + (j + 1)) ?_
    refine And.intro (by omega) ?_
    unfold ternaryCarryDigits
    rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
    omega
  have hbase :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.restricted_hasBaseExpansion F hternary
  have henvelope := RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope_tendsto hbase
  have henvelopeConst :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 3 digits)
        (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 3 digits (j + 1)) := by
    apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_eventually_eq_const (N := j + 1)
    intro m hm
    have hmEq : m = (j + 1) + (m - (j + 1)) := by omega
    rw [hmEq]
    exact baseExpansionEnvelope_eventually_constant_of_max_after
      validBase_three_staircase htwo (m - (j + 1))
  have hxEnvelope :
      x = RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 3 digits (j + 1) :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique henvelope henvelopeConst
  have hcarryZero :
      forall i : Nat, j + 1 <= i -> ternaryCarryDigits digits j i = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    unfold ternaryCarryDigits
    rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
  have hcarryConv :=
    seqTendsto_partial_of_eventually_constant (q := 3) hcarryZero
  have hpartial := carry_partial_eq_envelope (q := 3) hzero
  rw [hpartial, <- hxEnvelope] at hcarryConv
  exact And.intro validBase_three_staircase
    (And.intro hcarryCanonical hcarryConv)

name: cantorBinaryValue_eq_partial_after_first_one
statement:
private theorem cantorBinaryValue_eq_partial_after_first_one
    {x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hdigit : canonicalTernaryDigits x n = 1) :
    cantorBinaryValue x =
      RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 (cantorTransformedDigit x) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero :
      forall i : Nat, n + 1 <= i -> cantorTransformedDigit x i = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    exact cantorTransformedDigit_freezes_after_one hdigit (by omega)
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique
    (cantorBinaryValue_spec x).right.right
    (seqTendsto_partial_of_eventually_constant hzero)

name: canonical_first_difference_order
statement:
private theorem canonical_first_difference_order
    {x y : Point}
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one)
    (hy0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero y)
    (hy1 : RealTheory.lt y RealTheory.one)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    {n : Nat}
    (hprefix :
      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
        canonicalTernaryDigits x i = canonicalTernaryDigits y i)
    (hdiff :
      Not (canonicalTernaryDigits x n = canonicalTernaryDigits y n)) :
    canonicalTernaryDigits x n < canonicalTernaryDigits y n
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hle : canonicalTernaryDigits x n <= canonicalTernaryDigits y n
  · omega
  · have hlt : canonicalTernaryDigits y n < canonicalTernaryDigits x n := by
      omega
    have hyBase := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.canonical_hasBaseExpansion F
      (canonicalTernaryDigits_spec hy0 hy1)
    have hxBase := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.canonical_hasBaseExpansion F
      (canonicalTernaryDigits_spec hx0 hx1)
    have hyx : F.le y x :=
      baseExpansion_value_le_of_first_digit_lt validBase_three_staircase
        (value := y) (other := x)
        (digits := canonicalTernaryDigits y)
        (e := canonicalTernaryDigits x)
        hyBase hxBase (fun i hi => (hprefix i hi).symm) hlt
    have hbad : F.lt x x := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hxy hyx
    exact False.elim (F.lt_irrefl x hbad)

name: cantorBinaryValue_mono_interior
statement:
private theorem cantorBinaryValue_mono_interior
    {x y : Point}
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one)
    (hy0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero y)
    (hy1 : RealTheory.lt y RealTheory.one)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    RealTheory.le (cantorBinaryValue x) (cantorBinaryValue y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases heq : x = y
  · subst y
    exact F.le_refl (cantorBinaryValue x)
  · have hltxy : F.lt x y := lt_of_le_of_ne_right hxy heq
    by_cases hdigits : canonicalTernaryDigits x = canonicalTernaryDigits y
    · have htrans : cantorTransformedDigit x = cantorTransformedDigit y := by
        funext n
        apply cantorTransformedDigit_eq_of_prefix
        intro i _
        exact congrFun hdigits i
      rw [cantorBinaryValue_eq_of_transformed_digits htrans]
      exact F.le_refl (cantorBinaryValue y)
    · let P : Nat -> Prop := fun n : Nat =>
        Not (canonicalTernaryDigits x n = canonicalTernaryDigits y n)
      have hP : Exists P := by
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro hnone
        apply hdigits
        funext n
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro hn
        exact hnone (Exists.intro n hn)
      let n := Tautology.Nat.least P hP
      have hdiff : P n := Tautology.Nat.least_spec P hP
      have hprefix :
          forall i : Nat, i < n ->
            canonicalTernaryDigits x i = canonicalTernaryDigits y i := by
        intro i hi
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro hne
        have hmin := Tautology.Nat.least_min P hP hne
        omega
      have hdigitOrder := canonical_first_difference_order
        hx0 hx1 hy0 hy1 hltxy hprefix hdiff
      by_cases hearlier : HasEarlierTernaryOne x n
      · have htrans :=
          transformed_digits_eq_of_earlier_one_before_prefix hprefix hearlier
        rw [cantorBinaryValue_eq_of_transformed_digits htrans]
        exact F.le_refl (cantorBinaryValue y)
      · have hxBound := canonicalTernaryDigit_lt_three hx0 hx1 n
        have hyBound := canonicalTernaryDigit_lt_three hy0 hy1 n
        have htransPrefix := transformed_prefix_eq_of_ternary_prefix hprefix
        have hearlierY : Not (HasEarlierTernaryOne y n) := by
          intro hyEarlier
          have hyxEarlier := hasEarlierTernaryOne_of_prefix
            (fun i hi => (hprefix i hi).symm) hyEarlier
          exact hearlier hyxEarlier
        by_cases hxDigitZero : canonicalTernaryDigits x n = 0
        · have hyDigitNeZero : Not (canonicalTernaryDigits y n = 0) := by
            omega
          have hxTrans := cantorTransformedDigit_eq_zero_of_digit_zero hxDigitZero
          have hyTrans :=
            cantorTransformedDigit_eq_one_of_no_earlier_of_digit_ne_zero
              hearlierY hyDigitNeZero
          apply baseExpansion_value_le_of_first_digit_lt validBase_two_staircase
            (cantorBinaryValue_spec x) (cantorBinaryValue_spec y)
            htransPrefix
          rw [hxTrans, hyTrans]
          omega
        · have hxDigitOne : canonicalTernaryDigits x n = 1 := by omega
          have hyDigitTwo : canonicalTernaryDigits y n = 2 := by omega
          have hxTrans :=
            cantorTransformedDigit_eq_one_of_no_earlier_of_digit_ne_zero
              hearlier hxDigitZero
          have hyTrans :=
            cantorTransformedDigit_eq_one_of_no_earlier_of_digit_ne_zero
              hearlierY (by omega)
          have hpartialEq :
              RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 (cantorTransformedDigit x) (n + 1) =
                RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 (cantorTransformedDigit y) (n + 1) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_eq_of_prefix_eq
              F 2 (n + 1) (by
                intro i hi
                by_cases hin : i < n
                · exact htransPrefix i hin
                · have hieq : i = n := by omega
                  subst i
                  rw [hxTrans, hyTrans])
          rw [cantorBinaryValue_eq_partial_after_first_one hxDigitOne]
          rw [hpartialEq]
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_le_value F
            (cantorBinaryValue_spec y) (n + 1)

name: cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
statement:
theorem cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval :
    MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one)
      cantorStaircase
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  by_cases hxzero : x = RealTheory.zero
  · subst x
    change RealTheory.le
      (cantorStaircase RealTheory.zero) (cantorStaircase y)
    rw [cantorStaircase_zero]
    by_cases hyzero : y = RealTheory.zero
    · subst y
      rw [cantorStaircase_zero]
      exact F.le_refl F.zero
    · by_cases hyone : y = RealTheory.one
      · subst y
        rw [cantorStaircase_one]
        exact F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one
      · have hylt : RealTheory.lt y RealTheory.one :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne_right hy.right hyone
        have hypos : Not (RealTheory.le y RealTheory.zero) := by
          intro hy0
          exact hyzero (F.le_antisymm hy0 hy.left)
        unfold cantorStaircase
        rw [if_neg hypos, if_pos hylt]
        exact (RealTheory.baseExpansion_value_mem_unitInterval
          (cantorBinaryValue_spec y)).left
  · by_cases hyone : y = RealTheory.one
    · subst y
      change RealTheory.le
        (cantorStaircase x) (cantorStaircase RealTheory.one)
      rw [cantorStaircase_one]
      by_cases hxone : x = RealTheory.one
      · subst x
        rw [cantorStaircase_one]
        exact F.le_refl F.one
      · have hxpos : Not (RealTheory.le x RealTheory.zero) := by
          intro hxle
          exact hxzero (F.le_antisymm hxle hx.left)
        have hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne_right hx.right hxone
        unfold cantorStaircase
        rw [if_neg hxpos, if_pos hxlt]
        exact (RealTheory.baseExpansion_value_mem_unitInterval
          (cantorBinaryValue_spec x)).right
    · have hxpos : Not (RealTheory.le x RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro hxle
        exact hxzero (F.le_antisymm hxle hx.left)
      have hypos : Not (RealTheory.le y RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro hyle
        have hyzero := F.le_antisymm hyle hy.left
        subst y
        exact hxzero (F.le_antisymm hxy hx.left)
      have hxone : Not (x = RealTheory.one) := by
        intro h
        subst x
        exact hyone (F.le_antisymm hy.right hxy)
      have hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne_right hx.right hxone
      have hylt : RealTheory.lt y RealTheory.one :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne_right hy.right hyone
      unfold cantorStaircase
      rw [if_neg hxpos, if_pos hxlt, if_neg hypos, if_pos hylt]
      exact cantorBinaryValue_mono_interior hx.left hxlt hy.left hylt hxy

name: cantorBinaryValue_eq_of_terminating_cantorExpansion
statement:
private theorem cantorBinaryValue_eq_of_terminating_cantorExpansion
    {x value : Point} {digits : Nat -> Nat} {N : Nat}
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one)
    (hternary : RealTheory.HasTernaryCantorExpansion x digits)
    (hbinary : RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2 value
      (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2))
    (hzero : forall i : Nat, N <= i -> digits i = 0) :
    cantorBinaryValue x = value
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcanonicalStream :
      RealTheory.CanonicalBaseDigitStream 3 digits := by
    refine And.intro hternary.right.left.left ?_
    intro M
    refine Exists.intro (M + N) ?_
    refine And.intro (by omega) ?_
    rw [hzero (M + N) (by omega)]
    omega
  have hcanonical : RealTheory.HasCanonicalBaseExpansion 3 x digits :=
    And.intro hternary.left
      (And.intro hcanonicalStream hternary.right.right)
  have hdigitsEq : digits = canonicalTernaryDigits x :=
    canonicalTernaryDigits_unique hx0 hx1 hcanonical
  have hnoOne :
      forall i : Nat, Not (canonicalTernaryDigits x i = 1) := by
    intro i hi
    have hallowed := hternary.right.left.right i
    have heq := congrFun hdigitsEq i
    unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
    omega
  have htransformed :
      cantorTransformedDigit x = (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2) := by
    funext i
    have hearlier : Not (HasEarlierTernaryOne x i) := by
      intro h
      cases h with
      | intro k hk => exact hnoOne k hk.right
    have hallowed := hternary.right.left.right i
    have heq := congrFun hdigitsEq i
    unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
    cases hallowed with
    | inl hdigitZero =>
        have hcanonicalZero : canonicalTernaryDigits x i = 0 := by
          rw [<- heq]
          exact hdigitZero
        rw [cantorTransformedDigit_eq_zero_of_digit_zero hcanonicalZero]
        rw [hdigitZero]
    | inr hdigitTwo =>
        have hcanonicalNeZero :
            Not (canonicalTernaryDigits x i = 0) := by
          rw [<- heq]
          omega
        rw [cantorTransformedDigit_eq_one_of_no_earlier_of_digit_ne_zero
          hearlier hcanonicalNeZero]
        rw [hdigitTwo]
  have hvalue := cantorBinaryValue_spec x
  rw [htransformed] at hvalue
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.same_digits_baseExpansion_unique F hvalue hbinary

name: cantorBinaryValue_eq_of_trailingTwo_cantorExpansion
statement:
private theorem cantorBinaryValue_eq_of_trailingTwo_cantorExpansion
    {x value : Point} {digits : Nat -> Nat} {N : Nat}
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one)
    (hternary : RealTheory.HasTernaryCantorExpansion x digits)
    (hbinary : RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2 value
      (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2))
    (htwo : forall i : Nat, N <= i -> digits i = 2) :
    cantorBinaryValue x = value
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases exists_carry_index_of_trailingTwo hx1 hternary htwo with
  | intro j hj =>
      have hcarryCanonical :=
        ternaryCarry_hasCanonicalBaseExpansion hternary hj.left hj.right
      have hcarryEq :
          ternaryCarryDigits digits j = canonicalTernaryDigits x :=
        canonicalTernaryDigits_unique hx0 hx1 hcarryCanonical
      have hcanonicalAtJ : canonicalTernaryDigits x j = 1 := by
        have h := congrFun hcarryEq j
        unfold ternaryCarryDigits at h
        rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos rfl] at h
        exact h.symm
      have hnoEarlier : Not (HasEarlierTernaryOne x j) := by
        intro h
        cases h with
        | intro i hi =>
            have hcarryAt := congrFun hcarryEq i
            unfold ternaryCarryDigits at hcarryAt
            rw [if_pos hi.left] at hcarryAt
            have hallowed := hternary.right.left.right i
            unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
            unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
            omega
      have htransformed :
          cantorTransformedDigit x =
            ternaryCarryDigits (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2) j := by
        funext i
        by_cases hij : i < j
        · have hcarryAt := congrFun hcarryEq i
          unfold ternaryCarryDigits at hcarryAt
          rw [if_pos hij] at hcarryAt
          have hallowed := hternary.right.left.right i
          unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
          unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
          have hearlier : Not (HasEarlierTernaryOne x i) := by
            intro h
            cases h with
            | intro r hr =>
                exact hnoEarlier
                  (Exists.intro r (And.intro (Nat.lt_trans hr.left hij) hr.right))
          unfold ternaryCarryDigits
          rw [if_pos hij]
          cases hallowed with
          | inl hdigitZero =>
              have hcanonicalZero : canonicalTernaryDigits x i = 0 := by
                rw [<- hcarryAt]
                exact hdigitZero
              rw [cantorTransformedDigit_eq_zero_of_digit_zero hcanonicalZero]
              change 0 = digits i / 2
              rw [hdigitZero]
          | inr hdigitTwo =>
              have hcanonicalNeZero :
                  Not (canonicalTernaryDigits x i = 0) := by
                rw [<- hcarryAt]
                omega
              rw [cantorTransformedDigit_eq_one_of_no_earlier_of_digit_ne_zero
                hearlier hcanonicalNeZero]
              change 1 = digits i / 2
              rw [hdigitTwo]
        · by_cases hieq : i = j
          · subst i
            unfold ternaryCarryDigits
            rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos rfl]
            rw [cantorTransformedDigit_eq_one_of_no_earlier_of_digit_ne_zero
              hnoEarlier (by omega)]
          · have hji : j < i := by omega
            unfold ternaryCarryDigits
            rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg hieq]
            exact cantorTransformedDigit_freezes_after_one hcanonicalAtJ hji
      have horiginalTail :
          forall i : Nat, j + 1 <= i -> digits i / 2 = 1 := by
        intro i hi
        rw [hj.right i hi]
      have henvelope := RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope_tendsto hbinary
      have henvelopeConst :
          RealTheory.SeqTendsto
            (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2
              (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2))
            (RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2
              (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2) (j + 1)) := by
        apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_eventually_eq_const (N := j + 1)
        intro m hm
        have hmEq : m = (j + 1) + (m - (j + 1)) := by omega
        rw [hmEq]
        exact baseExpansionEnvelope_eventually_constant_of_max_after
          validBase_two_staircase horiginalTail (m - (j + 1))
      have hvalueEnvelope :
          value = RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2
            (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2) (j + 1) :=
        RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique henvelope henvelopeConst
      have htransformedZero :
          forall i : Nat, j + 1 <= i -> cantorTransformedDigit x i = 0 := by
        intro i hi
        exact cantorTransformedDigit_freezes_after_one hcanonicalAtJ (by omega)
      have htransformedConv :=
        seqTendsto_partial_of_eventually_constant
          (q := 2) htransformedZero
      have hzeroHalf : digits j / 2 = 0 := by rw [hj.left]
      have hpartialCarry :=
        carry_partial_eq_envelope
          (q := 2) (digits := fun i : Nat => digits i / 2) (j := j)
          hzeroHalf
      have hpartialTransformed :
          RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2
              (cantorTransformedDigit x) (j + 1) =
            RealTheory.baseExpansionEnvelope 2
              (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2) (j + 1) := by
        rw [htransformed]
        exact hpartialCarry
      rw [hpartialTransformed, <- hvalueEnvelope] at htransformedConv
      have hvalueExpansion :
          RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2 value (cantorTransformedDigit x) :=
        And.intro validBase_two_staircase
          (And.intro (cantorTransformedDigit_binaryStream x) htransformedConv)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.same_digits_baseExpansion_unique F
        (cantorBinaryValue_spec x) hvalueExpansion

name: cantorStaircase_eq_of_terminating_cantorExpansion
statement:
private theorem cantorStaircase_eq_of_terminating_cantorExpansion
    {x value : Point} {digits : Nat -> Nat} {N : Nat}
    (hternary : RealTheory.HasTernaryCantorExpansion x digits)
    (hbinary : RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2 value
      (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2))
    (hzero : forall i : Nat, N <= i -> digits i = 0) :
    cantorStaircase x = value
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbase := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.restricted_hasBaseExpansion F hternary
  have hx0 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansion_value_nonneg F hbase
  have hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one :=
    baseExpansion_value_lt_one_of_exists_digit_lt_max hbase
      (Exists.intro N (by rw [hzero N (Nat.le_refl N)]; omega))
  by_cases hxle : RealTheory.le x RealTheory.zero
  · have hxeq : x = RealTheory.zero := F.le_antisymm hxle hx0
    have hbaseZero := hbase
    rw [hxeq] at hbaseZero
    have hdigitsZero := baseExpansion_digits_eq_zero_of_value_zero hbaseZero
    have hbinaryZero := hbinary
    rw [hdigitsZero] at hbinaryZero
    have hbinaryZero' :
        RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2 value (fun _ : Nat => 0) := by
      simpa using hbinaryZero
    have hzeroExpansion :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zeroDigits_hasBaseExpansion_zero
        F validBase_two_staircase
    have hvalueZero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.same_digits_baseExpansion_unique F
        hbinaryZero' hzeroExpansion
    unfold cantorStaircase
    rw [if_pos hxle]
    exact hvalueZero.symm
  · have hvalue :=
      cantorBinaryValue_eq_of_terminating_cantorExpansion
        hx0 hx1 hternary hbinary hzero
    unfold cantorStaircase
    rw [if_neg hxle, if_pos hx1, hvalue]

name: cantorStaircase_eq_of_trailingTwo_cantorExpansion_of_value_lt_one
statement:
private theorem cantorStaircase_eq_of_trailingTwo_cantorExpansion_of_value_lt_one
    {x value : Point} {digits : Nat -> Nat} {N : Nat}
    (hternary : RealTheory.HasTernaryCantorExpansion x digits)
    (hbinary : RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2 value
      (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2))
    (htwo : forall i : Nat, N <= i -> digits i = 2)
    (hvalue1 : RealTheory.lt value RealTheory.one) :
    cantorStaircase x = value
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbase := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.restricted_hasBaseExpansion F hternary
  have hx0 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansion_value_nonneg F hbase
  have hzeroDigit : Exists (fun i : Nat => digits i = 0) := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hnone
    have hdigitsTwo : digits = (fun _ : Nat => 2) := by
      funext i
      have hallowed := hternary.right.left.right i
      unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
      cases hallowed with
      | inl hzero => exact False.elim (hnone (Exists.intro i hzero))
      | inr htwoAt => exact htwoAt
    have hbinaryMax := hbinary
    rw [hdigitsTwo] at hbinaryMax
    have hbinaryMax' :
        RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2 value (fun _ : Nat => 1) := by
      simpa using hbinaryMax
    have honeExpansion :
        RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2 RealTheory.one (fun _ : Nat => 1) :=
      And.intro validBase_two_staircase
        (And.intro
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.maxDigitStream validBase_two_staircase)
          (maxDigitPartial_tendsto_one validBase_two_staircase))
    have hvalueEq := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.same_digits_baseExpansion_unique
      F hbinaryMax' honeExpansion
    rw [hvalueEq] at hvalue1
    exact F.lt_irrefl F.one hvalue1
  have hx1 : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one :=
    baseExpansion_value_lt_one_of_exists_digit_lt_max hbase
      (by
        cases hzeroDigit with
        | intro i hi => exact Exists.intro i (by rw [hi]; omega))
  have hxpos : Not (RealTheory.le x RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hxle
    have hxeq : x = RealTheory.zero := F.le_antisymm hxle hx0
    have hbaseZero := hbase
    rw [hxeq] at hbaseZero
    have hdigitsZero := baseExpansion_digits_eq_zero_of_value_zero hbaseZero
    have htail := htwo N (Nat.le_refl N)
    rw [hdigitsZero] at htail
    change 0 = 2 at htail
    omega
  have hvalue :=
    cantorBinaryValue_eq_of_trailingTwo_cantorExpansion
      hx0 hx1 hternary hbinary htwo
  unfold cantorStaircase
  rw [if_neg hxpos, if_pos hx1, hvalue]

name: cantorStaircase_eq_one_of_cantorExpansion
statement:
private theorem cantorStaircase_eq_one_of_cantorExpansion
    {x value : Point} {digits : Nat -> Nat}
    (hternary : RealTheory.HasTernaryCantorExpansion x digits)
    (hbinary : RealTheory.HasBaseExpansion 2 value
      (fun i : Nat => digits i / 2))
    (hvalue : value = RealTheory.one) :
    cantorStaircase x = value
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnoZero : forall i : Nat, Not (digits i = 0) := by
    intro i hzero
    have hlt : RealTheory.lt value RealTheory.one :=
      baseExpansion_value_lt_one_of_exists_digit_lt_max hbinary
        (Exists.intro i (by rw [hzero]; omega))
    rw [hvalue] at hlt
    exact F.lt_irrefl F.one hlt
  have hdigitsTwo : digits = (fun _ : Nat => 2) := by
    funext i
    have hallowed := hternary.right.left.right i
    unfold RealTheory.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.TernaryCantorDigitAllowed at hallowed
    cases hallowed with
    | inl hzero => exact False.elim (hnoZero i hzero)
    | inr htwo => exact htwo
  have hxconv := hternary.right.right
  rw [hdigitsTwo] at hxconv
  have honeconv := maxDigitPartial_tendsto_one validBase_three_staircase
  have hxeq : x = RealTheory.one :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hxconv honeconv
  rw [hxeq, hvalue, cantorStaircase_one]

name: cantorStaircase_stageEndpoint_values
statement:
theorem cantorStaircase_stageEndpoint_values
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    And
      (cantorStaircase (RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat k)
          (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n))
      (cantorStaircase (RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint n k) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (k + 1))
          (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n))
proof:
:= by
  have hranks := RealNegligibility.cantorStageEndpoint_rankExpansions hk
  cases hranks.left with
  | intro leftDigits hleft =>
      cases hranks.right with
      | intro rightDigits hright =>
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact cantorStaircase_eq_of_terminating_cantorExpansion
              hleft.left hleft.right.left hleft.right.right
          · by_cases hterminal : k + 1 = 2 ^ n
            · have hvalueOne :=
                nat_mul_baseTail_two_eq_one_of_eq_pow hterminal
              exact cantorStaircase_eq_one_of_cantorExpansion
                hright.left hright.right.left hvalueOne
            · have hlt : k + 1 < 2 ^ n := by omega
              have hvalueLt := nat_mul_baseTail_two_lt_one_of_lt_pow hlt
              exact
                cantorStaircase_eq_of_trailingTwo_cantorExpansion_of_value_lt_one
                  hright.left hright.right.left hright.right.right hvalueLt

name: nat_mul_baseTail_two_eq_one_of_eq_pow
statement:
theorem nat_mul_baseTail_two_eq_one_of_eq_pow
    {m n : Nat} (hm : m = 2 ^ n) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat m)
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 n) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:=

name: nat_succ_mul_step
statement:
private theorem nat_succ_mul_step
    (m : Nat) (step : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (m + 1)) step =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat m) step)
        step
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.mul (F.nat (m + 1)) step =
    F.add (F.mul (F.nat m) step) step
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: nat_two_steps_lt_add
statement:
private theorem nat_two_steps_lt_add
    (m : Nat) {step eps : Point}
    (htwo : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add step step) eps) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (m + 2)) step)
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat m) step)
        eps)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt (F.add step step) eps at htwo
  change F.lt (F.mul (F.nat (m + 2)) step)
    (F.add (F.mul (F.nat m) step) eps)
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F htwo
    (F.mul (F.nat m) step)
  rw [<- F.add_assoc] at h
  have hm1 := nat_succ_mul_step m step
  have hm2 := nat_succ_mul_step (m + 1) step
  change F.mul (F.nat (m + 1)) step =
    F.add (F.mul (F.nat m) step) step at hm1
  change F.mul (F.nat (m + 1 + 1)) step =
    F.add (F.mul (F.nat (m + 1)) step) step at hm2
  rw [hm1] at hm2
  have hidx : m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 := by omega
  rw [hidx] at hm2
  rw [<- hm2] at h
  exact h

name: nat_mul_step_lt_succ
statement:
private theorem nat_mul_step_lt_succ
    (m : Nat) {step : Point}
    (hstep : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero step) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat m) step)
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (m + 1)) step)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt (F.mul (F.nat m) step)
    (F.mul (F.nat (m + 1)) step)
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hstep
    (x := F.mul (F.nat m) step)
  have hs := nat_succ_mul_step m step
  change F.mul (F.nat (m + 1)) step =
    F.add (F.mul (F.nat m) step) step at hs
  rw [hs]
  exact h

name: cantorStageEndpoints_mem_unitInterval
statement:
private theorem cantorStageEndpoints_mem_unitInterval
    {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < 2 ^ n) :
    And
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
        (RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k))
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
        (RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint n k))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hranks := RealNegligibility.cantorStageEndpoint_rankExpansions hk
  cases hranks.left with
  | intro leftDigits hleft =>
      cases hranks.right with
      | intro rightDigits hright =>
          have hleftBase :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.restricted_hasBaseExpansion F hleft.left
          have hrightBase :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.restricted_hasBaseExpansion F hright.left
          exact And.intro
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansion_value_mem_unitInterval
              F hleftBase)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansion_value_mem_unitInterval
              F hrightBase)

name: cantorStaircase_twoSided_continuity_witness
statement:
private theorem cantorStaircase_twoSided_continuity_witness
    {lower x upper eps : Point}
    (hlower : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one lower)
    (hupper : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one upper)
    (hlx : RealTheory.lt lower x)
    (hxu : RealTheory.lt x upper)
    (hlowerValue : RealTheory.lt (cantorStaircase x)
      (RealTheory.add (cantorStaircase lower) eps))
    (hupperValue : RealTheory.lt (cantorStaircase upper)
      (RealTheory.add (cantorStaircase x) eps)) :
    Exists (fun delta : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
        (forall y : Point,
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one y ->
          Not (y = x) -> RealTheory.lt (dist y x) delta ->
            RealTheory.lt (dist (cantorStaircase y) (cantorStaircase x)) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dl := F.sub x lower
  let dr := F.sub upper x
  have hdl : F.lt F.zero dl := by
    unfold dl
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hlx
  have hdr : F.lt F.zero dr := by
    unfold dr
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxu
  let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F dl dr
  have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdl hdr
  refine Exists.intro delta (And.intro hdelta ?_)
  intro y hy _ hyd
  change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub y x)) delta at hyd
  have hydl := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hyd
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F dl dr)
  have hydr := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hyd
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F dl dr)
  have hylRaw := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hydl
  have hyl : F.lt lower y := by
    unfold dl at hylRaw
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F x lower] at hylRaw
  have hyuRaw := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hydr
  have hyu : F.lt y upper := by
    unfold dr at hyuRaw
    have hsum : F.add x (F.sub upper x) = upper := by
      rw [F.add_comm x (F.sub upper x)]
      exact F.sub_add_cancel upper x
    rwa [hsum] at hyuRaw
  have hly := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
    lower y hlower hy (F.le_of_lt hyl)
  have hyuValue := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
    y upper hy hupper (F.le_of_lt hyu)
  have hlowerBound :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hlowerValue)
  have hfinalLower := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hlowerBound hly
  have hfinalUpper := F.lt_of_le_of_lt hyuValue hupperValue
  change F.lt
    (F.abs (F.sub (cantorStaircase y) (cantorStaircase x))) eps
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds F
    hfinalLower hfinalUpper

name: cantorStaircase_rightSided_continuity_witness
statement:
private theorem cantorStaircase_rightSided_continuity_witness
    {x upper eps : Point}
    (hupper : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one upper)
    (hxu : RealTheory.lt x upper)
    (hlowerValue : RealTheory.lt (cantorStaircase x)
      (RealTheory.add (cantorStaircase RealTheory.zero) eps))
    (hupperValue : RealTheory.lt (cantorStaircase upper)
      (RealTheory.add (cantorStaircase x) eps)) :
    Exists (fun delta : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
        (forall y : Point,
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one y ->
          Not (y = x) -> RealTheory.lt (dist y x) delta ->
            RealTheory.lt (dist (cantorStaircase y) (cantorStaircase x)) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let delta := F.sub upper x
  have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxu
  refine Exists.intro delta (And.intro hdelta ?_)
  intro y hy _ hyd
  change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub y x)) delta at hyd
  have hyuRaw := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hyd
  have hyu : F.lt y upper := by
    unfold delta at hyuRaw
    have hsum : F.add x (F.sub upper x) = upper := by
      rw [F.add_comm x (F.sub upper x)]
      exact F.sub_add_cancel upper x
    rwa [hsum] at hyuRaw
  have hzeroClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero :=
    And.intro (F.le_refl F.zero) (F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one)
  have hzeroY := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
    RealTheory.zero y hzeroClosed hy hy.left
  have hyUpper := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
    y upper hy hupper (F.le_of_lt hyu)
  have hlowerBound :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hlowerValue)
  have hfinalLower := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hlowerBound hzeroY
  have hfinalUpper := F.lt_of_le_of_lt hyUpper hupperValue
  change F.lt
    (F.abs (F.sub (cantorStaircase y) (cantorStaircase x))) eps
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds F
    hfinalLower hfinalUpper

name: cantorStaircase_leftSided_continuity_witness
statement:
private theorem cantorStaircase_leftSided_continuity_witness
    {lower x eps : Point}
    (hlower : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one lower)
    (hlx : RealTheory.lt lower x)
    (hlowerValue : RealTheory.lt (cantorStaircase x)
      (RealTheory.add (cantorStaircase lower) eps))
    (hupperValue : RealTheory.lt (cantorStaircase RealTheory.one)
      (RealTheory.add (cantorStaircase x) eps)) :
    Exists (fun delta : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
        (forall y : Point,
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one y ->
          Not (y = x) -> RealTheory.lt (dist y x) delta ->
            RealTheory.lt (dist (cantorStaircase y) (cantorStaircase x)) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let delta := F.sub x lower
  have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hlx
  refine Exists.intro delta (And.intro hdelta ?_)
  intro y hy _ hyd
  change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub y x)) delta at hyd
  have hylRaw := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hyd
  have hyl : F.lt lower y := by
    unfold delta at hylRaw
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F x lower] at hylRaw
  have honeClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one RealTheory.one :=
    And.intro (F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one) (F.le_refl F.one)
  have hLowerY := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
    lower y hlower hy (F.le_of_lt hyl)
  have hyOne := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
    y RealTheory.one hy honeClosed hy.right
  have hlowerBound :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hlowerValue)
  have hfinalLower := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hlowerBound hLowerY
  have hfinalUpper := F.lt_of_le_of_lt hyOne hupperValue
  change F.lt
    (F.abs (F.sub (cantorStaircase y) (cantorStaircase x))) eps
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds F
    hfinalLower hfinalUpper

name: cantorStaircase_continuousOn_unitInterval
statement:
theorem cantorStaircase_continuousOn_unitInterval :
    ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one)
      cantorStaircase
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro x hx
  refine And.intro hx ?_
  intro eps heps
  by_cases hxC : RealNegligibility.CantorSet x
  · have hhalfPos := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
    have htailConv := RealTheory.baseTail_tendsto_zero_all
      CantorStaircaseInternal.validBase_two
    cases htailConv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps) hhalfPos with
    | intro N hN =>
        let n := N + 1
        let step := RealTheory.baseTail 2 n
        have hstepPos : F.lt F.zero step := by
          unfold step
          exact RealTheory.baseTail_pos CantorStaircaseInternal.validBase_two n
        have hstepHalf : F.lt step (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps) := by
          have hclose := hN n (by unfold n; omega)
          change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub step F.zero)) (F.half eps) at hclose
          have habs : F.abs (F.sub step F.zero) = step := by
            rw [F.sub_zero]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F (F.le_of_lt hstepPos)
          rwa [habs] at hclose
        have htwo : F.lt (F.add step step) eps := by
          have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hstepHalf hstepHalf
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at h
          exact h
        have hnPos : 0 < n := by
          unfold n
          omega
        have hpowTwo : 1 < 2 ^ n := by
          have hpow : 2 <= 2 ^ n := by
            unfold n
            rw [Nat.pow_succ]
            have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ N := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
            omega
          omega
        cases RealNegligibility.cantorSet_mem_stageCylinder hxC n with
        | intro k hk =>
            have hkBound := hk.left
            have hcurrentUnit :=
              cantorStageEndpoints_mem_unitInterval hkBound
            have hvalues := cantorStaircase_stageEndpoint_values hkBound
            let leftPoint := RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint n k
            let rightPoint := RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint n k
            have hleftLeX : RealTheory.le leftPoint x := hk.right.left
            have hxLeRight : RealTheory.le x rightPoint := hk.right.right
            have hleftCx := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
              leftPoint x hcurrentUnit.left hx hleftLeX
            have hcxRight := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
              x rightPoint hx hcurrentUnit.right hxLeRight
            have hleftValue :
                cantorStaircase leftPoint = F.mul (F.nat k) step := by
              exact hvalues.left
            have hrightValue :
                cantorStaircase rightPoint = F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) step := by
              exact hvalues.right
            by_cases hkzero : k = 0
            · subst k
              have hnotTerminal : Not (0 + 1 = 2 ^ n) := by omega
              have hnext : 1 < 2 ^ n := hpowTwo
              let upper := RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint n 1
              have hupperUnit :=
                (cantorStageEndpoints_mem_unitInterval hnext).right
              have hupperValue :=
                (cantorStaircase_stageEndpoint_values hnext).right
              have hstepRank :
                  F.lt (F.mul (F.nat 1) step) (F.mul (F.nat 2) step) := by
                exact nat_mul_step_lt_succ 1 hstepPos
              have hcxUpperValue :
                  F.lt (cantorStaircase x) (cantorStaircase upper) := by
                rw [hupperValue]
                rw [hrightValue] at hcxRight
                exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hcxRight hstepRank
              have hxu : RealTheory.lt x upper := by
                by_cases hlt : RealTheory.lt x upper
                · exact hlt
                · have hux := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hlt
                  have hmono := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
                    upper x hupperUnit hx hux
                  have hbad := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hcxUpperValue hmono
                  exact False.elim (F.lt_irrefl (cantorStaircase x) hbad)
              have hlowerValue :
                  RealTheory.lt (cantorStaircase x)
                    (RealTheory.add (cantorStaircase RealTheory.zero) eps) := by
                rw [cantorStaircase_zero]
                change F.lt (cantorStaircase x) (F.add F.zero eps)
                rw [F.zero_add]
                rw [hrightValue] at hcxRight
                have hcxStep : F.le (cantorStaircase x) step := by
                  change F.le (cantorStaircase x) (F.mul (F.nat 1) step) at hcxRight
                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_one, F.one_mul] at hcxRight
                  exact hcxRight
                have hstepEps : F.lt step eps :=
                  F.lt_trans hstepHalf
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps)
                exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hcxStep hstepEps
              have hupperEps :
                  RealTheory.lt (cantorStaircase upper)
                    (RealTheory.add (cantorStaircase x) eps) := by
                rw [hupperValue]
                have htwoZero : F.lt (F.mul (F.nat 2) step) eps := by
                  have htwoEq := nat_succ_mul_step 1 step
                  change F.mul (F.nat 2) step =
                    F.add (F.mul (F.nat 1) step) step at htwoEq
                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_one, F.one_mul] at htwoEq
                  rw [htwoEq]
                  exact htwo
                have hxNonneg : F.le F.zero (cantorStaircase x) := by
                  rw [hleftValue] at hleftCx
                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero,
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul] at hleftCx
                  exact hleftCx
                have hepsLe : F.le eps (F.add (cantorStaircase x) eps) := by
                  have h := F.add_le_add_right hxNonneg eps
                  rw [F.zero_add] at h
                  exact h
                exact F.lt_of_lt_of_le htwoZero hepsLe
              exact cantorStaircase_rightSided_continuity_witness
                hupperUnit hxu hlowerValue hupperEps
            · by_cases hterminal : k + 1 = 2 ^ n
              · have hkPos : 0 < k := by omega
                let lower := RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k - 1)
                have hprev : k - 1 < 2 ^ n := by omega
                have hlowerUnit :=
                  (cantorStageEndpoints_mem_unitInterval hprev).left
                have hlowerValue :=
                  (cantorStaircase_stageEndpoint_values hprev).left
                have hlowRank :
                    F.lt (F.mul (F.nat (k - 1)) step)
                      (F.mul (F.nat k) step) := by
                  have hidx : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
                  rw [<- hidx]
                  exact nat_mul_step_lt_succ (k - 1) hstepPos
                have hlowerCxValue :
                    F.lt (cantorStaircase lower) (cantorStaircase x) := by
                  rw [hlowerValue]
                  rw [hleftValue] at hleftCx
                  exact F.lt_of_lt_of_le hlowRank hleftCx
                have hlx : RealTheory.lt lower x := by
                  by_cases hlt : RealTheory.lt lower x
                  · exact hlt
                  · have hxl := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hlt
                    have hmono := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
                      x lower hx hlowerUnit hxl
                    have hbad := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hlowerCxValue hmono
                    exact False.elim (F.lt_irrefl (cantorStaircase lower) hbad)
                have hlowerEps :
                    RealTheory.lt (cantorStaircase x)
                      (RealTheory.add (cantorStaircase lower) eps) := by
                  have htwoRank := nat_two_steps_lt_add (k - 1) htwo
                  have hidx : k - 1 + 2 = k + 1 := by omega
                  rw [hidx] at htwoRank
                  change F.lt (F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) step)
                    (F.add (F.mul (F.nat (k - 1)) step) eps) at htwoRank
                  have honeRank :=
                    CantorStaircaseInternal.nat_mul_baseTail_two_eq_one_of_eq_pow hterminal
                  change F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) step = F.one at honeRank
                  rw [honeRank] at htwoRank
                  rw [hlowerValue]
                  have hcxOne := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
                    x RealTheory.one hx
                    (And.intro (F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one) (F.le_refl F.one))
                    hx.right
                  rw [cantorStaircase_one] at hcxOne
                  exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hcxOne htwoRank
                have hupperEps :
                    RealTheory.lt (cantorStaircase RealTheory.one)
                      (RealTheory.add (cantorStaircase x) eps) := by
                  have hstepEps : F.lt step eps :=
                    F.lt_trans hstepHalf
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps)
                  have hnext := nat_succ_mul_step k step
                  change F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) step =
                    F.add (F.mul (F.nat k) step) step at hnext
                  have hrankLt :
                      F.lt (F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) step)
                        (F.add (F.mul (F.nat k) step) eps) := by
                    rw [hnext]
                    exact F.add_lt_add_left hstepEps (F.mul (F.nat k) step)
                  rw [cantorStaircase_one]
                  have honeRank :=
                    CantorStaircaseInternal.nat_mul_baseTail_two_eq_one_of_eq_pow hterminal
                  change F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) step = F.one at honeRank
                  have hresult :
                      F.lt F.one (F.add (cantorStaircase x) eps) := by
                    rw [<- honeRank]
                    have hleftCx' := hleftCx
                    rw [hleftValue] at hleftCx'
                    have hadd := F.add_le_add_right hleftCx' eps
                    exact F.lt_of_lt_of_le hrankLt hadd
                  exact hresult
                exact cantorStaircase_leftSided_continuity_witness
                  hlowerUnit hlx hlowerEps hupperEps
              · have hnext : k + 1 < 2 ^ n := by omega
                have hkPos : 0 < k := by omega
                let lower := RealNegligibility.cantorStageLeftEndpoint n (k - 1)
                let upper := RealNegligibility.cantorStageRightEndpoint n (k + 1)
                have hprev : k - 1 < 2 ^ n := by omega
                have hlowerUnit :=
                  (cantorStageEndpoints_mem_unitInterval hprev).left
                have hupperUnit :=
                  (cantorStageEndpoints_mem_unitInterval hnext).right
                have hlowerValue :=
                  (cantorStaircase_stageEndpoint_values hprev).left
                have hupperValue :=
                  (cantorStaircase_stageEndpoint_values hnext).right
                have hlowRank :
                    F.lt (F.mul (F.nat (k - 1)) step)
                      (F.mul (F.nat k) step) := by
                  have hidx : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
                  rw [<- hidx]
                  exact nat_mul_step_lt_succ (k - 1) hstepPos
                have huppRank :
                    F.lt (F.mul (F.nat (k + 1)) step)
                      (F.mul (F.nat (k + 2)) step) :=
                  nat_mul_step_lt_succ (k + 1) hstepPos
                have hlowerCxValue :
                    F.lt (cantorStaircase lower) (cantorStaircase x) := by
                  rw [hlowerValue]
                  rw [hleftValue] at hleftCx
                  exact F.lt_of_lt_of_le hlowRank hleftCx
                have hcxUpperValue :
                    F.lt (cantorStaircase x) (cantorStaircase upper) := by
                  rw [hupperValue]
                  rw [hrightValue] at hcxRight
                  exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hcxRight huppRank
                have hlx : RealTheory.lt lower x := by
                  by_cases hlt : RealTheory.lt lower x
                  · exact hlt
                  · have hxl := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hlt
                    have hmono := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
                      x lower hx hlowerUnit hxl
                    have hbad := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hlowerCxValue hmono
                    exact False.elim (F.lt_irrefl (cantorStaircase lower) hbad)
                have hxu : RealTheory.lt x upper := by
                  by_cases hlt : RealTheory.lt x upper
                  · exact hlt
                  · have hux := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hlt
                    have hmono := cantorStaircase_monotoneOn_unitInterval
                      upper x hupperUnit hx hux
                    have hbad := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hcxUpperValue hmono
                    exact False.elim (F.lt_irrefl (cantorStaircase x) hbad)
                have hlowerEps :
                    RealTheory.lt (cantorStaircase x)
                      (RealTheory.add (cantorStaircase lower) eps) := by
                  have htwoRank := nat_two_steps_lt_add (k - 1) htwo
                  have hidx : k - 1 + 2 = k + 1 := by omega
                  rw [hidx] at htwoRank
                  rw [hlowerValue]
                  rw [hrightValue] at hcxRight
                  exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hcxRight htwoRank
                have hupperEps :
                    RealTheory.lt (cantorStaircase upper)
                      (RealTheory.add (cantorStaircase x) eps) := by
                  have htwoRank := nat_two_steps_lt_add k htwo
                  rw [hupperValue]
                  have hleftCx' := hleftCx
                  rw [hleftValue] at hleftCx'
                  have hadd := F.add_le_add_right hleftCx' eps
                  exact F.lt_of_lt_of_le htwoRank hadd
                exact cantorStaircase_twoSided_continuity_witness
                  hlowerUnit hupperUnit hlx hxu hlowerEps hupperEps
  · cases cantorStaircase_locallyConstant_off_cantorSet hxC with
    | intro delta hdelta =>
        refine Exists.intro delta (And.intro hdelta.left ?_)
        intro y hy _ hyd
        have hclose :
            RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)) delta := by
          exact hyd
        have heq := hdelta.right y hclose
        rw [heq]
        rw [dist_self]
        exact heps

name: nat_succ_mul_step
statement:
theorem nat_succ_mul_step
    (m : Nat) (step : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat (m + 1)) step =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.nat m) step)
        step
proof:
:=
  Curve.nat_succ_mul_step m step

name: sub_neg_eq_add_base
statement:
private theorem sub_neg_eq_add_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x y : Point) :
    F.sub x (F.neg y) = F.add x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg]

name: add_pair_rotate_last_base
statement:
private theorem add_pair_rotate_last_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.add (F.add a b) (F.add c d) =
      F.add (F.add a d) (F.add b c)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.add a b) (F.add c d) =
        F.add a (F.add b (F.add c d)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add a (F.add (F.add b c) d) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc b c d]
    _ = F.add a (F.add d (F.add b c)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm (F.add b c) d]
    _ = F.add (F.add a d) (F.add b c) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc a d (F.add b c)]

name: add_add_sub_eq_sub_add_add_base
statement:
private theorem add_add_sub_eq_sub_add_add_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.add (F.add a b) (F.sub c d) =
      F.add (F.sub a d) (F.add b c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg c d]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg a d]
  exact add_pair_rotate_last_base F a b c (F.neg d)

name: add_neg_pair_eq_sub_add_neg_pair_base
statement:
private theorem add_neg_pair_eq_sub_add_neg_pair_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.add (F.add a (F.neg b)) (F.neg (F.add c d)) =
      F.add (F.sub a d) (F.neg (F.add b c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg a d]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F c d]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F b c]
  exact add_pair_rotate_last_base F a (F.neg b) (F.neg c) (F.neg d)

name: rotPairOfSpec_add
statement:
private theorem rotPairOfSpec_add
    (S : CircularThinSpec) (x y : Point) :
    RotPair.ofSpec S (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RotPair.mul (RotPair.ofSpec S x) (RotPair.ofSpec S y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold RotPair.ofSpec RotPair.mul
  rw [sin_add S x y]
  rw [cos_add S x y]

name: rotPairRel_sin_apply
statement:
private theorem rotPairRel_sin_apply
    (p q : RotPair) :
    (RotPair.rel p q).sin =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul p.sin q.cos)
        (RealTheory.mul p.cos q.sin)
proof:
:= by
  unfold RotPair.rel RotPair.mul RotPair.conj
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.add (F.mul p.sin q.cos) (F.mul p.cos (F.neg q.sin)) =
      F.sub (F.mul p.sin q.cos) (F.mul p.cos q.sin)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]

name: rotPairRel_cos_apply
statement:
private theorem rotPairRel_cos_apply
    (p q : RotPair) :
    (RotPair.rel p q).cos =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul p.cos q.cos)
        (RealTheory.mul p.sin q.sin)
proof:
:= by
  unfold RotPair.rel RotPair.mul RotPair.conj
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.sub (F.mul p.cos q.cos) (F.mul p.sin (F.neg q.sin)) =
      F.add (F.mul p.cos q.cos) (F.mul p.sin q.sin)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
  rw [sub_neg_eq_add_base]

name: rotPairMul_assoc
statement:
private theorem rotPairMul_assoc
    (p q r : RotPair) :
    RotPair.mul (RotPair.mul p q) r =
      RotPair.mul p (RotPair.mul q r)
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | mk ps pc =>
      cases q with
      | mk qs qc =>
          cases r with
          | mk rs rc =>
              unfold RotPair.mul
              dsimp
              let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              have hsin :
                  F.add
                    (F.mul
                      (F.add (F.mul ps qc) (F.mul pc qs)) rc)
                    (F.mul
                      (F.sub (F.mul pc qc) (F.mul ps qs)) rs) =
                    F.add
                      (F.mul ps
                        (F.sub (F.mul qc rc) (F.mul qs rs)))
                      (F.mul pc
                        (F.add (F.mul qs rc) (F.mul qc rs))) := by
                rw [F.add_mul]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F]
                rw [F.mul_add]
                repeat rw [F.mul_assoc]
                exact add_add_sub_eq_sub_add_add_base F
                  (F.mul ps (F.mul qc rc))
                  (F.mul pc (F.mul qs rc))
                  (F.mul pc (F.mul qc rs))
                  (F.mul ps (F.mul qs rs))
              have hcos :
                  F.sub
                    (F.mul
                      (F.sub (F.mul pc qc) (F.mul ps qs)) rc)
                    (F.mul
                      (F.add (F.mul ps qc) (F.mul pc qs)) rs) =
                    F.sub
                      (F.mul pc
                        (F.sub (F.mul qc rc) (F.mul qs rs)))
                      (F.mul ps
                        (F.add (F.mul qs rc) (F.mul qc rs))) := by
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F]
                rw [F.add_mul]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F]
                rw [F.mul_add]
                rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
                rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
                rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
                repeat rw [F.mul_assoc]
                exact add_neg_pair_eq_sub_add_neg_pair_base F
                  (F.mul pc (F.mul qc rc))
                  (F.mul ps (F.mul qs rc))
                  (F.mul ps (F.mul qc rs))
                  (F.mul pc (F.mul qs rs))
              change
                RotPair.mk
                  (F.add
                    (F.mul
                      (F.add (F.mul ps qc) (F.mul pc qs)) rc)
                    (F.mul
                      (F.sub (F.mul pc qc) (F.mul ps qs)) rs))
                  (F.sub
                    (F.mul
                      (F.sub (F.mul pc qc) (F.mul ps qs)) rc)
                    (F.mul
                      (F.add (F.mul ps qc) (F.mul pc qs)) rs)) =
                RotPair.mk
                  (F.add
                    (F.mul ps
                      (F.sub (F.mul qc rc) (F.mul qs rs)))
                    (F.mul pc
                      (F.add (F.mul qs rc) (F.mul qc rs))))
                  (F.sub
                    (F.mul pc
                      (F.sub (F.mul qc rc) (F.mul qs rs)))
                    (F.mul ps
                      (F.add (F.mul qs rc) (F.mul qc rs))))
              rw [hsin, hcos]

name: rotPairMul_comm
statement:
private theorem rotPairMul_comm
    (p q : RotPair) :
    RotPair.mul p q = RotPair.mul q p
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | mk ps pc =>
      cases q with
      | mk qs qc =>
          unfold RotPair.mul
          dsimp
          let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          have hsin :
              F.add (F.mul ps qc) (F.mul pc qs) =
                F.add (F.mul qs pc) (F.mul qc ps) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm ps qc]
            rw [F.mul_comm pc qs]
            rw [F.add_comm (F.mul qc ps) (F.mul qs pc)]
          have hcos :
              F.sub (F.mul pc qc) (F.mul ps qs) =
                F.sub (F.mul qc pc) (F.mul qs ps) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm pc qc]
            rw [F.mul_comm ps qs]
          change
            RotPair.mk
              (F.add (F.mul ps qc) (F.mul pc qs))
              (F.sub (F.mul pc qc) (F.mul ps qs)) =
            RotPair.mk
              (F.add (F.mul qs pc) (F.mul qc ps))
              (F.sub (F.mul qc pc) (F.mul qs ps))
          rw [hsin, hcos]

name: rotPairConj_mul
statement:
private theorem rotPairConj_mul
    (p q : RotPair) :
    RotPair.conj (RotPair.mul p q) =
      RotPair.mul (RotPair.conj p) (RotPair.conj q)
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | mk ps pc =>
      cases q with
      | mk qs qc =>
          unfold RotPair.conj RotPair.mul
          dsimp
          let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          have hsin :
              F.neg (F.add (F.mul ps qc) (F.mul pc qs)) =
                F.add (F.mul (F.neg ps) qc) (F.mul pc (F.neg qs)) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
          have hcos :
              F.sub (F.mul pc qc) (F.mul ps qs) =
                F.sub (F.mul pc qc) (F.mul (F.neg ps) (F.neg qs)) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg]
          change
            RotPair.mk
              (F.neg (F.add (F.mul ps qc) (F.mul pc qs)))
              (F.sub (F.mul pc qc) (F.mul ps qs)) =
            RotPair.mk
              (F.add (F.mul (F.neg ps) qc) (F.mul pc (F.neg qs)))
              (F.sub (F.mul pc qc) (F.mul (F.neg ps) (F.neg qs)))
          rw [hsin, hcos]

name: rotPairMul_pair_swap
statement:
private theorem rotPairMul_pair_swap
    (p q r w : RotPair) :
    RotPair.mul (RotPair.mul p q) (RotPair.mul r w) =
      RotPair.mul (RotPair.mul p r) (RotPair.mul q w)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    RotPair.mul (RotPair.mul p q) (RotPair.mul r w) =
        RotPair.mul p (RotPair.mul q (RotPair.mul r w)) := by
          exact rotPairMul_assoc p q (RotPair.mul r w)
    _ = RotPair.mul p (RotPair.mul (RotPair.mul q r) w) := by
          exact congrArg (fun z : RotPair => RotPair.mul p z)
            (Eq.symm (rotPairMul_assoc q r w))
    _ = RotPair.mul p (RotPair.mul (RotPair.mul r q) w) := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun z : RotPair => RotPair.mul p (RotPair.mul z w))
            (rotPairMul_comm q r)
    _ = RotPair.mul p (RotPair.mul r (RotPair.mul q w)) := by
          exact congrArg (fun z : RotPair => RotPair.mul p z)
            (rotPairMul_assoc r q w)
    _ = RotPair.mul (RotPair.mul p r) (RotPair.mul q w) := by
          exact Eq.symm (rotPairMul_assoc p r (RotPair.mul q w))

name: rotPairRel_mul
statement:
private theorem rotPairRel_mul
    (p q r w : RotPair) :
    RotPair.rel (RotPair.mul p q) (RotPair.mul r w) =
      RotPair.mul (RotPair.rel p r) (RotPair.rel q w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold RotPair.rel
  rw [rotPairConj_mul]
