  exact rotPairMul_pair_swap p q (RotPair.conj r) (RotPair.conj w)

name: rotPairMul_one_right
statement:
private theorem rotPairMul_one_right
    (p : RotPair) :
    RotPair.mul p RotPair.one = p
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | mk ps pc =>
      unfold RotPair.mul RotPair.one
      dsimp
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change
        RotPair.mk
          (F.add (F.mul ps F.one) (F.mul pc F.zero))
          (F.sub (F.mul pc F.one) (F.mul ps F.zero)) =
        RotPair.mk ps pc
      rw [F.mul_one, F.mul_zero, F.add_zero]
      rw [F.mul_one, F.mul_zero]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero]

name: rotPairMul_one_left
statement:
private theorem rotPairMul_one_left
    (p : RotPair) :
    RotPair.mul RotPair.one p = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotPairMul_comm]
  exact rotPairMul_one_right p

name: rotPairConj_conj
statement:
private theorem rotPairConj_conj
    (p : RotPair) :
    RotPair.conj (RotPair.conj p) = p
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | mk ps pc =>
      unfold RotPair.conj
      dsimp
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change RotPair.mk (F.neg (F.neg ps)) pc = RotPair.mk ps pc
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg]

name: rotPairConj_rel
statement:
private theorem rotPairConj_rel
    (p q : RotPair) :
    RotPair.conj (RotPair.rel p q) = RotPair.rel q p
proof:
:= by
  unfold RotPair.rel
  rw [rotPairConj_mul]
  rw [rotPairConj_conj]
  exact rotPairMul_comm (RotPair.conj p) q

name: rotPairMul_conj_self_of_unit
statement:
private theorem rotPairMul_conj_self_of_unit
    (p : RotPair)
    (hunit :
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul p.sin p.sin)
        (RealTheory.mul p.cos p.cos) =
      RealTheory.one) :
    RotPair.mul p (RotPair.conj p) = RotPair.one
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | mk ps pc =>
      unfold RotPair.mul RotPair.conj RotPair.one
      dsimp
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change
        F.add (F.mul ps ps) (F.mul pc pc) = F.one at hunit
      have hsin :
          F.add (F.mul ps pc) (F.mul pc (F.neg ps)) = F.zero := by
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
        rw [F.mul_comm pc ps]
        rw [F.add_neg]
      have hcos :
          F.sub (F.mul pc pc) (F.mul ps (F.neg ps)) = F.one := by
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
        rw [sub_neg_eq_add_base]
        rw [F.add_comm (F.mul pc pc) (F.mul ps ps)]
        exact hunit
      change
        RotPair.mk
          (F.add (F.mul ps pc) (F.mul pc (F.neg ps)))
          (F.sub (F.mul pc pc) (F.mul ps (F.neg ps))) =
        RotPair.mk F.zero F.one
      rw [hsin, hcos]

name: rotPairOfSpec_unit
statement:
private theorem rotPairOfSpec_unit
    (S : CircularThinSpec) (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RotPair.ofSpec S x).sin (RotPair.ofSpec S x).sin)
        (RealTheory.mul (RotPair.ofSpec S x).cos (RotPair.ofSpec S x).cos) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x

name: rotPairRel_mul_conj_one
statement:
private theorem rotPairRel_mul_conj_one
    (p q : RotPair)
    (hp :
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul p.sin p.sin)
        (RealTheory.mul p.cos p.cos) =
      RealTheory.one)
    (hq :
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul q.sin q.sin)
        (RealTheory.mul q.cos q.cos) =
      RealTheory.one) :
    RotPair.mul (RotPair.rel p q) (RotPair.conj (RotPair.rel p q)) =
      RotPair.one
proof:
:= by
  calc
    RotPair.mul (RotPair.rel p q) (RotPair.conj (RotPair.rel p q)) =
        RotPair.mul (RotPair.rel p q) (RotPair.rel q p) := by
          rw [rotPairConj_rel]
    _ = RotPair.mul
          (RotPair.mul p (RotPair.conj q))
          (RotPair.mul q (RotPair.conj p)) := by
          rfl
    _ = RotPair.mul
          (RotPair.mul p (RotPair.conj q))
          (RotPair.mul (RotPair.conj p) q) := by
          rw [rotPairMul_comm q (RotPair.conj p)]
    _ = RotPair.mul
          (RotPair.mul p (RotPair.conj p))
          (RotPair.mul (RotPair.conj q) q) := by
          exact rotPairMul_pair_swap p (RotPair.conj q) (RotPair.conj p) q
    _ = RotPair.mul RotPair.one (RotPair.mul (RotPair.conj q) q) := by
          rw [rotPairMul_conj_self_of_unit p hp]
    _ = RotPair.mul RotPair.one (RotPair.mul q (RotPair.conj q)) := by
          rw [rotPairMul_comm (RotPair.conj q) q]
    _ = RotPair.mul RotPair.one RotPair.one := by
          rw [rotPairMul_conj_self_of_unit q hq]
    _ = RotPair.one := by
          rw [rotPairMul_one_left]

name: local_order_sin_pos
statement:
private theorem local_order_sin_pos
    (S : CircularThinSpec) {delta x : Point}
    (hdelta :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero z ->
          RealTheory.lt z delta ->
            And
              (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.mul z (S.cos z)))
              (And
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.mul z (S.cos z))
                  (S.sin z))
                (RealTheory.lt (S.sin z) z)))
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x delta) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (S.sin x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hloc := hdelta x hxpos hxlt
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hloc.left hloc.right.left

name: local_order_cos_pos
statement:
private theorem local_order_cos_pos
    (S : CircularThinSpec) {delta x : Point}
    (hdelta :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero z ->
          RealTheory.lt z delta ->
            And
              (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.mul z (S.cos z)))
              (And
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.mul z (S.cos z))
                  (S.sin z))
                (RealTheory.lt (S.sin z) z)))
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x delta) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (S.cos x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hloc := hdelta x hxpos hxlt
  have hmul :
      F.lt (F.mul x F.zero) (F.mul x (S.cos x)) := by
    rw [F.mul_zero]
    exact hloc.left
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_left F hmul hxpos

name: local_order_sin_sq_lt_square
statement:
private theorem local_order_sin_sq_lt_square
    (S : CircularThinSpec) {delta x : Point}
    (hdelta :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero z ->
          RealTheory.lt z delta ->
            And
              (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.mul z (S.cos z)))
              (And
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.mul z (S.cos z))
                  (S.sin z))
                (RealTheory.lt (S.sin z) z)))
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x delta) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
      (RealTheory.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hloc := hdelta x hxpos hxlt
  have hsin_pos : F.lt F.zero (S.sin x) :=
    local_order_sin_pos S hdelta hxpos hxlt
  have hsin_lt_x : F.lt (S.sin x) x :=
    hloc.right.right
  have hleft :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
        (F.mul x (S.sin x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hsin_lt_x hsin_pos
  have hright :
      F.lt
        (F.mul x (S.sin x))
        (F.mul x x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left F hsin_lt_x hxpos
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hleft hright

name: local_order_one_sub_cos_lt_square
statement:
private theorem local_order_one_sub_cos_lt_square
    (S : CircularThinSpec) {delta x : Point}
    (hdelta :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero z ->
          RealTheory.lt z delta ->
            And
              (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.mul z (S.cos z)))
              (And
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.mul z (S.cos z))
                  (S.sin z))
                (RealTheory.lt (S.sin z) z)))
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x delta) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (S.cos x))
      (RealTheory.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcos_pos : F.lt F.zero (S.cos x) :=
    local_order_cos_pos S hdelta hxpos hxlt
  have hcos_nonneg : F.le F.zero (S.cos x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hcos_pos
  have habs :=
    abs_cos_sub_one_le_sin_sq_of_cos_nonneg S x hcos_nonneg
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (S.cos x) F.one))
      (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)) at habs
  have hneg_le_abs :
      F.le
        (F.neg (F.sub (S.cos x) F.one))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (S.cos x) F.one)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_abs_self F (F.sub (S.cos x) F.one)
  have hone_sub_le_sin_sq :
      F.le (F.sub F.one (S.cos x))
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)) := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (S.cos x) F.one]
    exact F.le_trans hneg_le_abs habs
  have hsin_sq_lt :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
        (F.mul x x) :=
    local_order_sin_sq_lt_square S hdelta hxpos hxlt
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
    hone_sub_le_sin_sq hsin_sq_lt

name: relativePair_add
statement:
private theorem relativePair_add
    (x y : Point) :
    relativePair S T (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RotPair.mul (relativePair S T x) (relativePair S T y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold relativePair
  rw [rotPairOfSpec_add S x y]
  rw [rotPairOfSpec_add T x y]
  exact rotPairRel_mul
    (RotPair.ofSpec S x) (RotPair.ofSpec S y)
    (RotPair.ofSpec T x) (RotPair.ofSpec T y)

name: relativeSin_apply
statement:
theorem relativeSin_apply (x : Point) :
    relativeSin S T x =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (T.cos x))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (T.sin x))
proof:
:=
  rotPairRel_sin_apply
    (RotPair.ofSpec S x) (RotPair.ofSpec T x)

name: relativeCos_apply
statement:
theorem relativeCos_apply (x : Point) :
    relativeCos S T x =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (T.cos x))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (T.sin x))
proof:
:=
  rotPairRel_cos_apply
    (RotPair.ofSpec S x) (RotPair.ofSpec T x)

name: relativeSin_lt_cube_of_local
statement:
private theorem relativeSin_lt_cube_of_local
    {deltaS deltaT x : Point}
    (hSdelta : LocalOrderBody S deltaS)
    (hTdelta : LocalOrderBody T deltaT)
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxS : RealTheory.lt x deltaS)
    (hxT : RealTheory.lt x deltaT) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (relativeSin S T x)
      (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.mul x x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := S.sin x
  let c := S.cos x
  let u := T.sin x
  let v := T.cos x
  let A := F.sub s (F.mul x c)
  have hSlocal := hSdelta x hxpos hxS
  have hTlocal := hTdelta x hxpos hxT
  have hScos_pos : F.lt F.zero c := by
    change F.lt F.zero (S.cos x)
    exact local_order_cos_pos S hSdelta hxpos hxS
  have hA_pos : F.lt F.zero A := by
    unfold A
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hSlocal.right.left
  have hTcos_lt_one : F.lt v F.one := by
    have hxv_lt_x : F.lt (F.mul x v) x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hTlocal.right.left hTlocal.right.right
    have hxv_lt_xone : F.lt (F.mul x v) (F.mul x F.one) := by
      rw [F.mul_one]
      exact hxv_lt_x
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_left
      F hxv_lt_xone hxpos
  have hA_mul_v_lt_A : F.lt (F.mul A v) A := by
    have hvA : F.lt (F.mul v A) (F.mul F.one A) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hTcos_lt_one hA_pos
    rw [F.one_mul] at hvA
    rwa [F.mul_comm A v]
  have hA_lt_x_one_sub_c :
      F.lt A (F.mul x (F.sub F.one c)) := by
    have hsub :
        F.lt (F.sub s (F.mul x c)) (F.sub x (F.mul x c)) := by
      rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg s (F.mul x c)]
      rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg x (F.mul x c)]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right
        F hSlocal.right.right (F.neg (F.mul x c))
    have hxsub :
        F.sub x (F.mul x c) = F.mul x (F.sub F.one c) := by
      calc
        F.sub x (F.mul x c) =
            F.sub (F.mul x F.one) (F.mul x c) := by
              rw [F.mul_one]
        _ = F.mul x (F.sub F.one c) := by
              exact
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
                  F x F.one c).symm
    unfold A
    rwa [hxsub] at hsub
  have hA_mul_v_lt_x_one_sub_c :
      F.lt (F.mul A v) (F.mul x (F.sub F.one c)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hA_mul_v_lt_A hA_lt_x_one_sub_c
  have hone_sub_c_lt_sq :
      F.lt (F.sub F.one c) (F.mul x x) := by
    unfold c
    exact local_order_one_sub_cos_lt_square S hSdelta hxpos hxS
  have hx_one_sub_c_lt_cube :
      F.lt
        (F.mul x (F.sub F.one c))
        (F.mul x (F.mul x x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left F
      hone_sub_c_lt_sq hxpos
  have hA_mul_v_lt_cube :
      F.lt (F.mul A v) (F.mul x (F.mul x x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
      hA_mul_v_lt_x_one_sub_c hx_one_sub_c_lt_cube
  have hcu_gt_cxv :
      F.lt (F.mul c (F.mul x v)) (F.mul c u) := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left
      F hTlocal.right.left hScos_pos
  have hsub_lt :
      F.lt
        (F.sub (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u))
        (F.sub (F.mul s v) (F.mul c (F.mul x v))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt F hcu_gt_cxv
  have hsub_eq_Av :
      F.sub (F.mul s v) (F.mul c (F.mul x v)) =
        F.mul A v := by
    have hcxv :
        F.mul c (F.mul x v) = F.mul (F.mul x c) v := by
      calc
        F.mul c (F.mul x v) =
            F.mul (F.mul c x) v := by
              rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul (F.mul x c) v := by
              rw [F.mul_comm c x]
    unfold A
    rw [hcxv]
    exact
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
        F s (F.mul x c) v).symm
  have hD_lt_Av :
      F.lt (F.sub (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u)) (F.mul A v) := by
    rwa [hsub_eq_Av] at hsub_lt
  rw [relativeSin_apply]
  change F.lt (F.sub (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u))
    (F.mul x (F.mul x x))
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hD_lt_Av hA_mul_v_lt_cube

name: relativeSin_swap
statement:
theorem relativeSin_swap (x : Point) :
    relativeSin T S x = RealTheory.neg (relativeSin S T x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [relativeSin_apply]
  rw [relativeSin_apply]
  change
    F.sub
      (F.mul (T.sin x) (S.cos x))
      (F.mul (T.cos x) (S.sin x)) =
      F.neg
        (F.sub
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (T.cos x))
          (F.mul (S.cos x) (T.sin x)))
  rw [F.mul_comm (T.sin x) (S.cos x)]
  rw [F.mul_comm (T.cos x) (S.sin x)]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
    F (F.mul (S.sin x) (T.cos x)) (F.mul (S.cos x) (T.sin x))

name: neg_relativeSin_lt_cube_of_local
statement:
private theorem neg_relativeSin_lt_cube_of_local
    {deltaS deltaT x : Point}
    (hSdelta : LocalOrderBody S deltaS)
    (hTdelta : LocalOrderBody T deltaT)
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxS : RealTheory.lt x deltaS)
    (hxT : RealTheory.lt x deltaT) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.neg (relativeSin S T x))
      (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.mul x x))
proof:
:= by
  have hswap :=
    relativeSin_lt_cube_of_local (S := T) (T := S)
      hTdelta hSdelta hxpos hxT hxS
  rwa [relativeSin_swap S T x] at hswap

name: abs_lt_of_bounds_base
statement:
private theorem abs_lt_of_bounds_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x b : Point}
    (hxb : F.lt x b)
    (hnxb : F.lt (F.neg x) b) :
    F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F x) b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : F.le F.zero x
  case pos =>
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hx]
    exact hxb
  case neg =>
    have hx0 : F.le x F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hx
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F hx0]
    exact hnxb

name: relativeSin_abs_lt_cube_of_local
statement:
theorem relativeSin_abs_lt_cube_of_local
    {deltaS deltaT x : Point}
    (hSdelta : LocalOrderBody S deltaS)
    (hTdelta : LocalOrderBody T deltaT)
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxS : RealTheory.lt x deltaS)
    (hxT : RealTheory.lt x deltaT) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.abs (relativeSin S T x))
      (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.mul x x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.lt
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (relativeSin S T x))
      (F.mul x (F.mul x x))
  exact abs_lt_of_bounds_base F
    (relativeSin_lt_cube_of_local
      (S := S) (T := T) hSdelta hTdelta hxpos hxS hxT)
    (neg_relativeSin_lt_cube_of_local
      (S := S) (T := T) hSdelta hTdelta hxpos hxS hxT)

name: exists_relativeSin_abs_lt_cube
statement:
theorem exists_relativeSin_abs_lt_cube :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall x : Point,
            RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x ->
              RealTheory.lt x delta ->
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.abs (relativeSin S T x))
                  (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.mul x x))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases S.local_order with
  | intro deltaS hS =>
      cases T.local_order with
      | intro deltaT hT =>
          let delta := RealTheory.min deltaS deltaT
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          constructor
          case left =>
            unfold delta
            change F.lt F.zero
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaS deltaT)
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hS.left hT.left
          case right =>
            intro x hxpos hxlt
            have hxS : F.lt x deltaS := by
              have hminle : F.le delta deltaS := by
                unfold delta
                change F.le
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaS deltaT) deltaS
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaS deltaT
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxlt hminle
            have hxT : F.lt x deltaT := by
              have hminle : F.le delta deltaT := by
                unfold delta
                change F.le
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaS deltaT) deltaT
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaS deltaT
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxlt hminle
            exact relativeSin_abs_lt_cube_of_local
              (S := S) (T := T)
              hS.right hT.right hxpos hxS hxT

name: relativeSin_add
statement:
theorem relativeSin_add (x y : Point) :
    relativeSin S T (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (relativeSin S T x) (relativeCos S T y))
        (RealTheory.mul (relativeCos S T x) (relativeSin S T y))
proof:
:= by
  unfold relativeSin relativeCos
  rw [relativePair_add]
  unfold RotPair.mul
  rfl

name: relativeCos_add
statement:
theorem relativeCos_add (x y : Point) :
    relativeCos S T (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (relativeCos S T x) (relativeCos S T y))
        (RealTheory.mul (relativeSin S T x) (relativeSin S T y))
proof:
:= by
  unfold relativeSin relativeCos
  rw [relativePair_add]
  unfold RotPair.mul
  rfl

name: relativeSin_sq_add_relativeCos_sq
statement:
theorem relativeSin_sq_add_relativeCos_sq (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (relativeSin S T x) (relativeSin S T x))
        (RealTheory.mul (relativeCos S T x) (relativeCos S T x)) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let P := relativePair S T x
  have hmul :
      RotPair.mul P (RotPair.conj P) = RotPair.one := by
    unfold P
    change
      RotPair.mul
          (RotPair.rel (RotPair.ofSpec S x) (RotPair.ofSpec T x))
          (RotPair.conj
            (RotPair.rel (RotPair.ofSpec S x) (RotPair.ofSpec T x))) =
        RotPair.one
    exact rotPairRel_mul_conj_one
      (RotPair.ofSpec S x) (RotPair.ofSpec T x)
      (rotPairOfSpec_unit S x) (rotPairOfSpec_unit T x)
  have hcos := congrArg RotPair.cos hmul
  unfold RotPair.mul RotPair.conj RotPair.one at hcos
  dsimp at hcos
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.sub (F.mul P.cos P.cos) (F.mul P.sin (F.neg P.sin)) =
      F.one at hcos
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg] at hcos
  rw [sub_neg_eq_add_base] at hcos
  unfold relativeSin relativeCos
  change
    F.add (F.mul P.sin P.sin) (F.mul P.cos P.cos) = F.one
  rw [F.add_comm (F.mul P.sin P.sin) (F.mul P.cos P.cos)]
  exact hcos

name: square_nonneg_for_uniqueness
statement:
private theorem square_nonneg_for_uniqueness
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x : Point) :
    F.le F.zero (F.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : F.le F.zero x
  case pos =>
    exact F.mul_nonneg hx hx
  case neg =>
    have hx0 : F.le x F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hx
    have hnx : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx0
    have h := F.mul_nonneg hnx hnx
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x x] at h

name: abs_component_le_one_of_unit
statement:
private theorem abs_component_le_one_of_unit
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point)
    (hunit : F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b) = F.one) :
    F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F b) F.one
proof:
:= by
  have ha_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul a a) :=
    square_nonneg_for_uniqueness F a
  have hb_sq_le_one : F.le (F.mul b b) F.one := by
    have hb_sq :
        F.mul b b = F.sub F.one (F.mul a a) := by
      calc
        F.mul b b =
            F.sub (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul a a)) (F.mul a a) := by
              exact
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel
                  F (F.mul b b) (F.mul a a)).symm
        _ = F.sub (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b)) (F.mul a a) := by
              rw [F.add_comm (F.mul b b) (F.mul a a)]
        _ = F.sub F.one (F.mul a a) := by
              rw [hunit]
    rw [hb_sq]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic F ha_nonneg
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_le_of_bounds F
  case hxb =>
    by_cases hb_nonneg : F.le F.zero b
    case pos =>
      by_cases hb_le_one : F.le b F.one
      case pos => exact hb_le_one
      case neg =>
        have hone_le_b : F.le F.one b := by
          cases F.le_total F.one b with
          | inl h => exact h
          | inr h => exact False.elim (hb_le_one h)
        have hone_lt_b : F.lt F.one b :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hone_le_b hb_le_one
        have hb_pos : F.lt F.zero b :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) hone_lt_b
        have hmul_lt : F.lt (F.mul F.one b) (F.mul b b) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hone_lt_b hb_pos
        rw [F.one_mul] at hmul_lt
        have hb_lt_one : F.lt b F.one :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hmul_lt hb_sq_le_one
        exact False.elim
          (hb_le_one (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hb_lt_one))
    case neg =>
      have hb_nonpos : F.le b F.zero :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hb_nonneg
      exact F.le_trans hb_nonpos
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F))
  case hnxb =>
    by_cases hb_nonneg : F.le F.zero b
    case pos =>
      have hneg_nonpos : F.le (F.neg b) F.zero :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonpos_of_nonneg F hb_nonneg
      exact F.le_trans hneg_nonpos
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F))
    case neg =>
      have hb_nonpos : F.le b F.zero :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hb_nonneg
      have hneg_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg b) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hb_nonpos
      have hneg_sq_le_one :
          F.le (F.mul (F.neg b) (F.neg b)) F.one := by
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F b b]
      by_cases hneg_le_one : F.le (F.neg b) F.one
      case pos => exact hneg_le_one
      case neg =>
        have hone_le_negb : F.le F.one (F.neg b) := by
          cases F.le_total F.one (F.neg b) with
          | inl h => exact h
          | inr h => exact False.elim (hneg_le_one h)
        have hone_lt_negb : F.lt F.one (F.neg b) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
            F hone_le_negb hneg_le_one
        have hnegb_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.neg b) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) hone_lt_negb
        have hmul_lt :
            F.lt (F.mul F.one (F.neg b))
              (F.mul (F.neg b) (F.neg b)) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right
            F hone_lt_negb hnegb_pos
        rw [F.one_mul] at hmul_lt
        have hnegb_lt_one : F.lt (F.neg b) F.one :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hmul_lt hneg_sq_le_one
        exact False.elim
          (hneg_le_one
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hnegb_lt_one))

name: relativeCos_abs_le_one
statement:
theorem relativeCos_abs_le_one (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (relativeCos S T x)) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hunit := relativeSin_sq_add_relativeCos_sq S T x
  change
    F.add
        (F.mul (relativeSin S T x) (relativeSin S T x))
        (F.mul (relativeCos S T x) (relativeCos S T x)) =
      F.one at hunit
  change F.le
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (relativeCos S T x)) F.one
  exact abs_component_le_one_of_unit F
    (relativeSin S T x) (relativeCos S T x) hunit

name: relativeSin_abs_add_le
statement:
theorem relativeSin_abs_add_le (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (relativeSin S T (RealTheory.add x y)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.abs (relativeSin S T x))
        (RealTheory.abs (relativeSin S T y)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dx := relativeSin S T x
  let dy := relativeSin S T y
  let cx := relativeCos S T x
  let cy := relativeCos S T y
  have hadd := relativeSin_add S T x y
  change
    relativeSin S T (F.add x y) =
      F.add (F.mul dx cy) (F.mul cx dy) at hadd
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (relativeSin S T (F.add x y)))
      (F.add
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dx)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dy))
  rw [hadd]
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.add (F.mul dx cy) (F.mul cx dy)))
      (F.add
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dx)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dy))
  have htri :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
      F (F.mul dx cy) (F.mul cx dy)
  have hterm1 :
      F.le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.mul dx cy))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dx) := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F dx cy]
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
        F (relativeCos_abs_le_one S T y)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F dx)
    change
      F.le
        (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dx)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F cy))
        (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dx) F.one) at h
    rw [F.mul_one] at h
    exact h
  have hterm2 :
      F.le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.mul cx dy))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dy) := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F cx dy]
    rw [F.mul_comm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F cx)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dy)]
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
        F (relativeCos_abs_le_one S T x)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F dy)
    change
      F.le
        (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dy)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F cx))
        (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F dy) F.one) at h
    rw [F.mul_one] at h
    exact h
  exact F.le_trans htri
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hterm1 hterm2)

name: relativeSin_zero
statement:
theorem relativeSin_zero :
    relativeSin S T RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [relativeSin_apply]
  change
    F.sub
      (F.mul (S.sin F.zero) (T.cos F.zero))
      (F.mul (S.cos F.zero) (T.sin F.zero)) =
      F.zero
  have hSsin0 : S.sin F.zero = F.zero := by
    change S.sin RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
    exact sin_zero S
  have hTsin0 : T.sin F.zero = F.zero := by
    change T.sin RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
    exact sin_zero T
  have hScos0 : S.cos F.zero = F.one := by
    change S.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
    exact cos_zero S
  have hTcos0 : T.cos F.zero = F.one := by
    change T.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
    exact cos_zero T
  rw [hSsin0, hTsin0, hScos0, hTcos0]
  rw [F.zero_mul, F.mul_zero]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.zero

name: relativeCos_zero
statement:
theorem relativeCos_zero :
    relativeCos S T RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [relativeCos_apply]
  change
    F.add
      (F.mul (S.cos F.zero) (T.cos F.zero))
      (F.mul (S.sin F.zero) (T.sin F.zero)) =
      F.one
  have hSsin0 : S.sin F.zero = F.zero := by
    change S.sin RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
    exact sin_zero S
  have hTsin0 : T.sin F.zero = F.zero := by
    change T.sin RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
    exact sin_zero T
  have hScos0 : S.cos F.zero = F.one := by
    change S.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
    exact cos_zero S
  have hTcos0 : T.cos F.zero = F.one := by
    change T.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
    exact cos_zero T
  rw [hSsin0, hTsin0, hScos0, hTcos0]
  rw [F.one_mul, F.zero_mul, F.add_zero]

name: relativeSin_neg
statement:
theorem relativeSin_neg (x : Point) :
    relativeSin S T (RealTheory.neg x) =
      RealTheory.neg (relativeSin S T x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [relativeSin_apply]
  rw [relativeSin_apply]
  change
    F.sub
      (F.mul (S.sin (F.neg x)) (T.cos (F.neg x)))
      (F.mul (S.cos (F.neg x)) (T.sin (F.neg x))) =
      F.neg
        (F.sub
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (T.cos x))
          (F.mul (S.cos x) (T.sin x)))
  have hSsin : S.sin (F.neg x) = F.neg (S.sin x) := by
    change S.sin (RealTheory.neg x) = RealTheory.neg (S.sin x)
    exact sin_neg S x
  have hTsin : T.sin (F.neg x) = F.neg (T.sin x) := by
    change T.sin (RealTheory.neg x) = RealTheory.neg (T.sin x)
    exact sin_neg T x
  have hScos : S.cos (F.neg x) = S.cos x := by
    change S.cos (RealTheory.neg x) = S.cos x
    exact cos_neg S x
  have hTcos : T.cos (F.neg x) = T.cos x := by
    change T.cos (RealTheory.neg x) = T.cos x
    exact cos_neg T x
  rw [hSsin, hTsin, hScos, hTcos]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F
    (F.mul (S.sin x) (T.cos x))
    (F.mul (S.cos x) (T.sin x))

name: repeatAdd_zero
statement:
private theorem repeatAdd_zero (h : Point) :
    repeatAdd 0 h = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: repeatAdd_succ
statement:
private theorem repeatAdd_succ (n : Nat) (h : Point) :
    repeatAdd (n + 1) h = RealTheory.add (repeatAdd n h) h
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: repeatAdd_eq_nat_mul
statement:
private theorem repeatAdd_eq_nat_mul (n : Nat) (h : Point) :
    repeatAdd n h =
      RealTheory.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n)
        h
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [repeatAdd_zero]
      change F.zero = F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F 0) h
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero]
      rw [F.zero_mul]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [repeatAdd_succ]
      rw [ih]
      change
        F.add (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) h) h =
          F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (n + 1)) h
      calc
        F.add (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) h) h =
            F.add (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) h)
              (F.mul F.one h) := by
              rw [F.one_mul]
        _ = F.mul
            (F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) F.one) h := by
              rw [F.add_mul]
        _ = F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (n + 1)) h := by
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ]

name: relativeSin_repeatAdd_abs_le_nat_mul
statement:
theorem relativeSin_repeatAdd_abs_le_nat_mul
    (n : Nat) (h : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (relativeSin S T (repeatAdd n h)))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n)
        (RealTheory.abs (relativeSin S T h)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (relativeSin S T h)
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [repeatAdd_zero]
      rw [relativeSin_zero]
      change F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F F.zero)
        (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F 0) a)
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_zero]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero]
      rw [F.zero_mul]
      exact F.le_refl F.zero
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [repeatAdd_succ]
      have hsub := relativeSin_abs_add_le S T (repeatAdd n h) h
      change
        F.le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
            (relativeSin S T (F.add (repeatAdd n h) h)))
          (F.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
              (relativeSin S T (repeatAdd n h)))
            a) at hsub
      have hstep :
          F.le
            (F.add
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                (relativeSin S T (repeatAdd n h)))
              a)
            (F.add (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) a) a) := by
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F ih (F.le_refl a)
      have hrewrite :
          F.add (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) a) a =
            F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (n + 1)) a := by
        calc
          F.add (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) a) a =
              F.add (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) a)
                (F.mul F.one a) := by
                rw [F.one_mul]
          _ = F.mul
              (F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) F.one) a := by
                rw [F.add_mul]
          _ = F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (n + 1)) a := by
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ]
      have hbound := F.le_trans hsub hstep
      rw [hrewrite] at hbound
      exact hbound

name: relativeSin_nat_mul_abs_le
statement:
theorem relativeSin_nat_mul_abs_le
    (n : Nat) (h : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (relativeSin S T
          (RealTheory.mul
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n)
            h)))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n)
        (RealTheory.abs (relativeSin S T h)))
proof:
:= by
  have hrep := relativeSin_repeatAdd_abs_le_nat_mul S T n h
  rw [repeatAdd_eq_nat_mul n h] at hrep
  exact hrep

name: relativeSin_nat_mul_abs_lt_nat_mul_cube_of_local
statement:
theorem relativeSin_nat_mul_abs_lt_nat_mul_cube_of_local
    {deltaS deltaT h : Point}
    (n : Nat)
    (hn : Not (n = 0))
    (hSdelta : LocalOrderBody S deltaS)
    (hTdelta : LocalOrderBody T deltaT)
    (hhpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hhS : RealTheory.lt h deltaS)
    (hhT : RealTheory.lt h deltaT) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.abs
        (relativeSin S T
          (RealTheory.mul
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n)
            h)))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n)
        (RealTheory.mul h (RealTheory.mul h h)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hle := relativeSin_nat_mul_abs_le S T n h
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (relativeSin S T
          (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) h)))
      (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (relativeSin S T h))) at hle
  have hlocal :=
    relativeSin_abs_lt_cube_of_local
      (S := S) (T := T)
      hSdelta hTdelta hhpos hhS hhT
  change
    F.lt
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (relativeSin S T h))
      (F.mul h (F.mul h h)) at hlocal
  have hnpos :
      F.lt F.zero (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F hn
  have hstrict :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (relativeSin S T h)))
        (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n)
          (F.mul h (F.mul h h))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left F hlocal hnpos
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle hstrict

name: nat_mul_scaled_step_eq
statement:
private theorem nat_mul_scaled_step_eq
    (n : Nat) (hn : Not (n = 0)) (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.inv
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n))
          x) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n
  change F.mul N (F.mul (F.inv N) x) = x
  have hNne : Not (N = F.zero) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F hn
  calc
    F.mul N (F.mul (F.inv N) x) =
        F.mul (F.mul N (F.inv N)) x := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul F.one x := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hNne]
    _ = x := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: scaled_step_pos
statement:
private theorem scaled_step_pos
    (n : Nat) (hn : Not (n = 0)) {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.inv
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n))
        x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n
  change F.lt F.zero (F.mul (F.inv N) x)
  have hNpos : F.lt F.zero N :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F hn
  have hinvpos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv N) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hNpos
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hinvpos hxpos

name: scaled_step_lt_delta
statement:
private theorem scaled_step_lt_delta
    (n : Nat) {x delta : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hinvlt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.inv
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n))
        (RealTheory.mul delta (RealTheory.inv x))) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.inv
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n))
        x)
      delta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n
  change F.lt (F.mul (F.inv N) x) delta
  have hxne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxpos h.symm
  have hmul :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (F.inv N) x)
        (F.mul (F.mul delta (F.inv x)) x) := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hinvlt hxpos
  have hcancel :
      F.mul (F.mul delta (F.inv x)) x = delta := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul delta (F.inv x)) x =
          F.mul delta (F.mul (F.inv x) x) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul delta F.one := by
            rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hxne]
      _ = delta := by
            rw [F.mul_one]
  rwa [hcancel] at hmul

name: scaled_cube_bound_lt
statement:
private theorem scaled_cube_bound_lt
    (n : Nat) (hn : Not (n = 0)) {x a : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hinv_one :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.inv
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n))
        RealTheory.one)
    (hinv_a :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.inv
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n))
        (RealTheory.mul a
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.mul x x))))) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.inv
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n))
            x)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.inv
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n))
              x)
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.inv
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base n))
              x))))
      a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n
  let i := F.inv N
  let h := F.mul i x
  let x3 := F.mul x (F.mul x x)
  change
    F.lt (F.mul N (F.mul h (F.mul h h))) a
  have hNmul : F.mul N h = x := by
    unfold h i N
    exact nat_mul_scaled_step_eq n hn x
  have hhpos : F.lt F.zero h := by
    unfold h i N
    exact scaled_step_pos n hn hxpos
  have hh_lt_x : F.lt h x := by
    have hmul :
        F.lt (F.mul i x) (F.mul F.one x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hinv_one hxpos
    rw [F.one_mul] at hmul
    exact hmul
  have hh2_lt_xh :
      F.lt (F.mul h h) (F.mul x h) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hh_lt_x hhpos
  have hxh2_lt_xxh :
      F.lt (F.mul x (F.mul h h)) (F.mul x (F.mul x h)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left F hh2_lt_xh hxpos
  have hleft :
      F.mul N (F.mul h (F.mul h h)) =
        F.mul x (F.mul h h) := by
    calc
      F.mul N (F.mul h (F.mul h h)) =
          F.mul (F.mul N h) (F.mul h h) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul x (F.mul h h) := by
            rw [hNmul]
  have hxxh :
      F.mul x (F.mul x h) = F.mul x3 i := by
    unfold h x3
    calc
      F.mul x (F.mul x (F.mul i x)) =
          F.mul x (F.mul x (F.mul x i)) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm i x]
      _ = F.mul x (F.mul (F.mul x x) i) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc x x i]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul x (F.mul x x)) i := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
  have hx_sq_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.mul x x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hxpos hxpos
  have hx3pos : F.lt F.zero x3 := by
    unfold x3
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hxpos hx_sq_pos
  have hx3ne : Not (x3 = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx3pos hzero.symm
  have hx3i_lt_a :
      F.lt (F.mul x3 i) a := by
    have hmul :
        F.lt (F.mul x3 i) (F.mul x3 (F.mul a (F.inv x3))) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left F hinv_a hx3pos
    have hcancel :
        F.mul x3 (F.mul a (F.inv x3)) = a := by
      calc
        F.mul x3 (F.mul a (F.inv x3)) =
            F.mul (F.mul x3 a) (F.inv x3) := by
              rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul (F.mul a x3) (F.inv x3) := by
              rw [F.mul_comm x3 a]
        _ = F.mul a (F.mul x3 (F.inv x3)) := by
              rw [F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul a F.one := by
              rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hx3ne]
        _ = a := by
              rw [F.mul_one]
    rwa [hcancel] at hmul
  have hfinite_lt_x3i :
      F.lt (F.mul N (F.mul h (F.mul h h))) (F.mul x3 i) := by
    rw [hleft]
    rw [hxxh] at hxh2_lt_xxh
    exact hxh2_lt_xxh
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hfinite_lt_x3i hx3i_lt_a

name: relativeSin_eq_zero_of_pos
statement:
private theorem relativeSin_eq_zero_of_pos
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    relativeSin S T x = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hDzero : relativeSin S T x = F.zero
  case pos =>
    exact hDzero
  case neg =>
    cases S.local_order with
    | intro deltaS hS =>
        cases T.local_order with
        | intro deltaT hT =>
            let Dabs := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (relativeSin S T x)
            let x3 := F.mul x (F.mul x x)
            have hDabs_pos : F.lt F.zero Dabs := by
              unfold Dabs
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_pos_of_ne_zero F hDzero
            have hx_sq_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.mul x x) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hxpos hxpos
            have hx3pos : F.lt F.zero x3 := by
              unfold x3
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hxpos hx_sq_pos
            let epsS := F.mul deltaS (F.inv x)
            let epsT := F.mul deltaT (F.inv x)
            let epsA := F.mul Dabs (F.inv x3)
            let eps :=
              F.min2 epsS
                (F.min2 epsT (F.min2 F.one epsA))
            have hxinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv x) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hxpos
            have hepsS_pos : F.lt F.zero epsS := by
              unfold epsS
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hS.left hxinv_pos
            have hepsT_pos : F.lt F.zero epsT := by
              unfold epsT
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hT.left hxinv_pos
            have hx3inv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv x3) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx3pos
            have hepsA_pos : F.lt F.zero epsA := by
              unfold epsA
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hDabs_pos hx3inv_pos
            have heps_pos : F.lt F.zero eps := by
              unfold eps
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hepsS_pos
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hepsT_pos
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
                    hepsA_pos))
            cases RealTheory.exists_inv_nat_lt heps_pos with
            | intro n hnsmall =>
                let N := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F n
                let i := F.inv N
                let h := F.mul i x
                have hn : Not (n = 0) := hnsmall.left
                have hinv_eps : F.lt i eps := by
                  unfold i N
                  exact hnsmall.right
                have heps_le_S : F.le eps epsS := by
                  unfold eps
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F epsS
                    (F.min2 epsT (F.min2 F.one epsA))
                have heps_le_T : F.le eps epsT := by
                  unfold eps
                  have hright :
                      F.le (F.min2 epsT (F.min2 F.one epsA)) epsT :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F epsT
                      (F.min2 F.one epsA)
                  exact F.le_trans
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F epsS
                      (F.min2 epsT (F.min2 F.one epsA)))
                    hright
                have heps_le_one : F.le eps F.one := by
                  unfold eps
                  have hright :
                      F.le (F.min2 epsT (F.min2 F.one epsA)) F.one := by
                    have hright2 :
                        F.le (F.min2 F.one epsA) F.one :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F F.one epsA
                    exact F.le_trans
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F epsT
                        (F.min2 F.one epsA))
                      hright2
                  exact F.le_trans
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F epsS
                      (F.min2 epsT (F.min2 F.one epsA)))
                    hright
                have heps_le_A : F.le eps epsA := by
                  unfold eps
                  have hright :
                      F.le (F.min2 epsT (F.min2 F.one epsA)) epsA := by
                    have hright2 :
                        F.le (F.min2 F.one epsA) epsA :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F F.one epsA
                    exact F.le_trans
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F epsT
                        (F.min2 F.one epsA))
                      hright2
                  exact F.le_trans
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F epsS
                      (F.min2 epsT (F.min2 F.one epsA)))
                    hright
                have hinvS : F.lt i epsS :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                    hinv_eps heps_le_S
                have hinvT : F.lt i epsT :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                    hinv_eps heps_le_T
                have hinvOne : F.lt i F.one :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                    hinv_eps heps_le_one
                have hinvA : F.lt i epsA :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                    hinv_eps heps_le_A
                have hhpos : F.lt F.zero h := by
                  unfold h i N
                  exact scaled_step_pos n hn hxpos
                have hhS : F.lt h deltaS := by
                  unfold h i N epsS at *
                  exact scaled_step_lt_delta n hxpos hinvS
                have hhT : F.lt h deltaT := by
                  unfold h i N epsT at *
                  exact scaled_step_lt_delta n hxpos hinvT
                have hlocal :=
                  relativeSin_nat_mul_abs_lt_nat_mul_cube_of_local
                    (S := S) (T := T)
                    n hn hS.right hT.right hhpos hhS hhT
                change
                  F.lt
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                      (relativeSin S T (F.mul N h)))
                    (F.mul N (F.mul h (F.mul h h))) at hlocal
                have hNmulx : F.mul N h = x := by
                  unfold h i N
                  exact nat_mul_scaled_step_eq n hn x
                rw [hNmulx] at hlocal
                have hcube :
                    F.lt (F.mul N (F.mul h (F.mul h h))) Dabs := by
                  unfold h i N epsA x3 Dabs at *
                  exact scaled_cube_bound_lt n hn hxpos hinvOne hinvA
                have hself : F.lt Dabs Dabs :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hlocal hcube
                exact False.elim
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F Dabs hself)

name: relativeSin_eq_zero
statement:
theorem relativeSin_eq_zero (x : Point) :
    relativeSin S T x = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxpos : F.lt F.zero x
  case pos =>
    exact relativeSin_eq_zero_of_pos (S := S) (T := T) hxpos
  case neg =>
    by_cases hxzero : x = F.zero
    case pos =>
      rw [hxzero]
      exact relativeSin_zero S T
    case neg =>
      have hxle0 : F.le x F.zero :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hxpos
      have hxlt0 : F.lt x F.zero := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxle0
        intro h0x
        exact hxzero (F.le_antisymm hxle0 h0x)
      have hnegpos : F.lt F.zero (F.neg x) := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hxlt0
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
      have hneg_zero :
          relativeSin S T (F.neg x) = F.zero :=
        relativeSin_eq_zero_of_pos (S := S) (T := T) hnegpos
      have hrel_neg :
          relativeSin S T (F.neg x) =
            F.neg (relativeSin S T x) := by
        change relativeSin S T (RealTheory.neg x) =
          RealTheory.neg (relativeSin S T x)
        exact relativeSin_neg S T x
      rw [hrel_neg] at hneg_zero
      have h := congrArg F.neg hneg_zero
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero] at h
      exact h

name: two_ne_zero_for_uniqueness
statement:
private theorem two_ne_zero_for_uniqueness :
    Not
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one =
        RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change Not (F.add F.one F.one = F.zero)
  have htwo_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.add F.one F.one) := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  intro hzero
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F htwo_pos hzero.symm

name: half_add_half_eq_self
statement:
private theorem half_add_half_eq_self (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one))
          x)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one))
          x) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let two := F.add F.one F.one
  let i := F.inv two
  change F.add (F.mul i x) (F.mul i x) = x
  have htwo_ne : Not (two = F.zero) := by
    unfold two
    exact two_ne_zero_for_uniqueness
  have hi_add : F.add i i = F.mul two i := by
    unfold two
    calc
      F.add i i =
          F.add (F.mul F.one i) (F.mul F.one i) := by
            rw [F.one_mul]
      _ = F.mul (F.add F.one F.one) i := by
            rw [F.add_mul]
  calc
    F.add (F.mul i x) (F.mul i x) =
        F.mul (F.add i i) x := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul two i) x := by
          rw [hi_add]
    _ = F.mul F.one x := by
          unfold i
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel htwo_ne]
    _ = x := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: relativeCos_eq_one
statement:
theorem relativeCos_eq_one (x : Point) :
    relativeCos S T x = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let half := F.mul (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one)) x
  have hhalf : F.add half half = x := by
    unfold half
    exact half_add_half_eq_self x
  have hadd := relativeCos_add S T half half
  change
    relativeCos S T (F.add half half) =
      F.sub
        (F.mul (relativeCos S T half) (relativeCos S T half))
        (F.mul (relativeSin S T half) (relativeSin S T half)) at hadd
  rw [hhalf] at hadd
  have hDhalf : relativeSin S T half = F.zero :=
    relativeSin_eq_zero S T half
  rw [hDhalf] at hadd
  rw [F.mul_zero] at hadd
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero] at hadd
  have hunit := relativeSin_sq_add_relativeCos_sq S T half
  change
    F.add
        (F.mul (relativeSin S T half) (relativeSin S T half))
        (F.mul (relativeCos S T half) (relativeCos S T half)) =
      F.one at hunit
  rw [hDhalf] at hunit
  rw [F.zero_mul] at hunit
  rw [F.zero_add] at hunit
  exact Eq.trans hadd hunit

name: relativePair_eq_one
statement:
private theorem relativePair_eq_one (x : Point) :
    relativePair S T x = RotPair.one
proof:
:= by
  let p := relativePair S T x
  have hsin : p.sin = RealTheory.zero := by
    change relativeSin S T x = RealTheory.zero
    exact relativeSin_eq_zero S T x
  have hcos : p.cos = RealTheory.one := by
    change relativeCos S T x = RealTheory.one
    exact relativeCos_eq_one S T x
  change p = RotPair.one
  cases hp : p with
  | mk s c =>
      have hs : s = RealTheory.zero := by
        have h := hsin
        rw [hp] at h
        exact h
      have hc : c = RealTheory.one := by
        have h := hcos
        rw [hp] at h
        exact h
      unfold RotPair.one
      rw [hs, hc]

name: rotPair_eq_of_rel_eq_one
statement:
private theorem rotPair_eq_of_rel_eq_one
    (p q : RotPair)
    (hq :
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul q.sin q.sin)
        (RealTheory.mul q.cos q.cos) =
      RealTheory.one)
    (hrel : RotPair.rel p q = RotPair.one) :
    p = q
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :
      RotPair.mul (RotPair.rel p q) q = p := by
    unfold RotPair.rel
    calc
      RotPair.mul (RotPair.mul p (RotPair.conj q)) q =
          RotPair.mul p (RotPair.mul (RotPair.conj q) q) := by
            rw [rotPairMul_assoc]
      _ = RotPair.mul p (RotPair.mul q (RotPair.conj q)) := by
            rw [rotPairMul_comm (RotPair.conj q) q]
      _ = RotPair.mul p RotPair.one := by
            rw [rotPairMul_conj_self_of_unit q hq]
      _ = p := by
            rw [rotPairMul_one_right]
  have hright :
      RotPair.mul (RotPair.rel p q) q = q := by
    rw [hrel]
    rw [rotPairMul_one_left]
  exact Eq.trans hleft.symm hright

name: rotPairOfSpec_eq_of_relativePair_eq_one
statement:
private theorem rotPairOfSpec_eq_of_relativePair_eq_one
    (x : Point) :
    RotPair.ofSpec S x = RotPair.ofSpec T x
proof:
:= by
  have hrel := relativePair_eq_one S T x
  unfold relativePair at hrel
  exact rotPair_eq_of_rel_eq_one
    (RotPair.ofSpec S x) (RotPair.ofSpec T x)
    (rotPairOfSpec_unit T x) hrel

name: circularThinSpec_unique
statement:
theorem circularThinSpec_unique :
    And
      (forall x : Point, S.sin x = T.sin x)
      (forall x : Point, S.cos x = T.cos x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  case left =>
    intro x
    have hpair := rotPairOfSpec_eq_of_relativePair_eq_one S T x
    have hsin := congrArg RotPair.sin hpair
    unfold RotPair.ofSpec at hsin
    exact hsin
  case right =>
    intro x
    have hpair := rotPairOfSpec_eq_of_relativePair_eq_one S T x
    have hcos := congrArg RotPair.cos hpair
    unfold RotPair.ofSpec at hcos
    exact hcos

name: add_left_comm_base
statement:
private theorem add_left_comm_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x y z : Point) :
    F.add x (F.add y z) = F.add y (F.add x z)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add x (F.add y z) =
        F.add (F.add x y) z := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.add y x) z := by
          rw [F.add_comm x y]
    _ = F.add y (F.add x z) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]

name: mul_left_comm_base
statement:
private theorem mul_left_comm_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x y z : Point) :
    F.mul x (F.mul y z) = F.mul y (F.mul x z)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul x (F.mul y z) =
        F.mul (F.mul x y) z := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul y x) z := by
          rw [F.mul_comm x y]
    _ = F.mul y (F.mul x z) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: sub_neg_eq_add_base
statement:
private theorem sub_neg_eq_add_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x y : Point) :
    F.sub x (F.neg y) = F.add x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg]

name: add_add_neg_cancel_cross
statement:
private theorem add_add_neg_cancel_cross
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (A C D : Point) :
    F.add (F.add A C) (F.add D (F.neg A)) = F.add C D
proof:
:= by
  have hinner :
      F.add C (F.add D (F.neg A)) =
        F.add (F.add C D) (F.neg A) := by
    rw [<- F.add_assoc]
  calc
    F.add (F.add A C) (F.add D (F.neg A)) =
        F.add A (F.add C (F.add D (F.neg A))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.add C D) (F.neg A)) := by
          rw [hinner]
    _ = F.add (F.add A (F.add C D)) (F.neg A) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.add C D) A) (F.neg A) := by
          rw [F.add_comm A (F.add C D)]
    _ = F.add C D := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_neg_cancel_right F
            (F.add C D) A

name: cross_mul_swap
statement:
private theorem cross_mul_swap
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (s0 sa ca : Point) :
    F.mul (F.mul s0 ca) sa =
      F.mul (F.mul s0 sa) ca
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul s0 ca) sa =
        F.mul s0 (F.mul ca sa) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul s0 (F.mul sa ca) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm ca sa]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul s0 sa) ca := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: left_inverse_sin_component_base
statement:
private theorem left_inverse_sin_component_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (s c u v : Point)
    (hunit :
      F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul c c) = F.one) :
    F.sub
        (F.mul c (F.add (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u)))
        (F.mul s (F.sub (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u))) =
      u
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.sub
        (F.mul c (F.add (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u)))
        (F.mul s (F.sub (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u))) =
      F.sub
        (F.add (F.mul c (F.mul s v)) (F.mul c (F.mul c u)))
        (F.add
          (F.mul s (F.mul c v))
          (F.neg (F.mul s (F.mul s u)))) := by
        rw [F.mul_add]
        rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u)]
        rw [F.mul_add]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
    _ =
      F.add
        (F.add (F.mul c (F.mul s v)) (F.mul c (F.mul c u)))
        (F.add
          (F.mul s (F.mul s u))
          (F.neg (F.mul c (F.mul s v)))) := by
        rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg]
        rw [mul_left_comm_base F s c v]
        rw [F.add_comm (F.neg (F.mul c (F.mul s v)))
          (F.mul s (F.mul s u))]
    _ =
      F.add
        (F.mul c (F.mul c u))
        (F.mul s (F.mul s u)) := by
        exact add_add_neg_cancel_cross F
          (F.mul c (F.mul s v))
          (F.mul c (F.mul c u))
          (F.mul s (F.mul s u))
    _ = F.mul (F.add (F.mul c c) (F.mul s s)) u := by
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc c c u]
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc s s u]
        rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul c c)) u := by
        rw [F.add_comm (F.mul c c) (F.mul s s)]
    _ = F.mul F.one u := by
        rw [hunit]
    _ = u := by
        rw [F.one_mul]

name: left_inverse_cos_component_base
statement:
private theorem left_inverse_cos_component_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (s c u v : Point)
    (hunit :
      F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul c c) = F.one) :
    F.add
        (F.mul s (F.add (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u)))
        (F.mul c (F.sub (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u))) =
      v
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add
        (F.mul s (F.add (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u)))
        (F.mul c (F.sub (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u))) =
      F.add
        (F.add (F.mul s (F.mul s v)) (F.mul s (F.mul c u)))
        (F.add
          (F.mul c (F.mul c v))
          (F.neg (F.mul c (F.mul s u)))) := by
        rw [F.mul_add]
        rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u)]
        rw [F.mul_add]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
    _ =
      F.add
        (F.add (F.mul s (F.mul c u)) (F.mul s (F.mul s v)))
        (F.add
          (F.mul c (F.mul c v))
          (F.neg (F.mul s (F.mul c u)))) := by
        rw [F.add_comm
          (F.mul s (F.mul s v))
          (F.mul s (F.mul c u))]
        rw [mul_left_comm_base F c s u]
    _ =
      F.add
        (F.mul s (F.mul s v))
        (F.mul c (F.mul c v)) := by
        exact add_add_neg_cancel_cross F
          (F.mul s (F.mul c u))
          (F.mul s (F.mul s v))
          (F.mul c (F.mul c v))
    _ = F.mul (F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul c c)) v := by
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc s s v]
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc c c v]
        rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.mul F.one v := by
        rw [hunit]
    _ = v := by
        rw [F.one_mul]

name: fixed_unit_left_cos_mul_unit
statement:
private theorem fixed_unit_left_cos_mul_unit
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (s0 c0 sa ca : Point)
    (hfixSin :
      sa = F.add (F.mul s0 ca) (F.mul c0 sa))
    (hfixCos :
      ca = F.sub (F.mul c0 ca) (F.mul s0 sa)) :
    F.add (F.mul sa sa) (F.mul ca ca) =
      F.mul c0 (F.add (F.mul sa sa) (F.mul ca ca))
proof:
:= by
  have hsinMul :
      F.mul sa sa =
        F.mul (F.add (F.mul s0 ca) (F.mul c0 sa)) sa := by
    exact congrArg (fun t => F.mul t sa) hfixSin
  have hcosMul :
      F.mul ca ca =
        F.mul (F.sub (F.mul c0 ca) (F.mul s0 sa)) ca := by
    exact congrArg (fun t => F.mul t ca) hfixCos
  calc
    F.add (F.mul sa sa) (F.mul ca ca) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (F.add (F.mul s0 ca) (F.mul c0 sa)) sa)
          (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul c0 ca) (F.mul s0 sa)) ca) := by
          rw [hsinMul, hcosMul]
    _ =
        F.add
          (F.add
            (F.mul (F.mul s0 ca) sa)
            (F.mul (F.mul c0 sa) sa))
          (F.add
            (F.mul (F.mul c0 ca) ca)
            (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul s0 sa) ca))) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
          rw [F.add_mul]
          rw [F.add_mul]
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul]
    _ =
        F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul c0 sa) sa)
          (F.mul (F.mul c0 ca) ca) := by
          rw [cross_mul_swap F s0 sa ca]
          let A := F.mul (F.mul s0 sa) ca
          let C := F.mul (F.mul c0 sa) sa
          let D := F.mul (F.mul c0 ca) ca
          change F.add (F.add A C) (F.add D (F.neg A)) = F.add C D
          exact add_add_neg_cancel_cross F A C D
    _ = F.mul c0 (F.add (F.mul sa sa) (F.mul ca ca)) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc c0 sa sa]
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc c0 ca ca]

name: sin_add
statement:
theorem sin_add (x y : Point) :
    S.sin (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y))
proof:
:=
  S.sin_add x y

name: cos_add
statement:
theorem cos_add (x y : Point) :
    S.cos (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
proof:
:=
  S.cos_add x y

name: sin_sq_add_cos_sq
statement:
theorem sin_sq_add_cos_sq (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:=
  S.pythagorean x

name: square_nonneg_base
statement:
private theorem square_nonneg_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x : Point) :
    F.le F.zero (F.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : F.le F.zero x
  · exact F.mul_nonneg hx hx
  · have hx0 : F.le x F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hx
    have hnx : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx0
    have h := F.mul_nonneg hnx hnx
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x x] at h

name: component_square_le_one_of_unit
statement:
private theorem component_square_le_one_of_unit
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point)
    (hunit : F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b) = F.one) :
    F.le (F.mul a a) F.one
proof:
:= by
  have hb_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul b b) :=
    square_nonneg_base F b
  have hsquare :
      F.mul a a = F.sub F.one (F.mul b b) := by
    calc
      F.mul a a =
          F.sub (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b)) (F.mul b b) := by
          exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel
            F (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b)).symm
      _ = F.sub F.one (F.mul b b) := by
          rw [hunit]
  rw [hsquare]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic F hb_nonneg

name: nonneg_le_one_of_square_le_one
statement:
private theorem nonneg_le_one_of_square_le_one
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a : Point)
    (ha_sq_le_one : F.le (F.mul a a) F.one) :
    F.le a F.one
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha_le_one : F.le a F.one
  · exact ha_le_one
  · have hone_le_a : F.le F.one a := by
      cases F.le_total F.one a with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr h => exact False.elim (ha_le_one h)
    have hone_lt_a : F.lt F.one a :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hone_le_a ha_le_one
    have ha_pos : F.lt F.zero a :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) hone_lt_a
    have hmul_lt : F.lt (F.mul F.one a) (F.mul a a) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hone_lt_a ha_pos
    rw [F.one_mul] at hmul_lt
    have ha_lt_one : F.lt a F.one :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hmul_lt ha_sq_le_one
    exact False.elim
      (ha_le_one (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F ha_lt_one))

name: abs_le_one_of_square_le_one
statement:
private theorem abs_le_one_of_square_le_one
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a : Point)
    (ha_sq_le_one : F.le (F.mul a a) F.one) :
    F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F a) F.one
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_le_of_bounds F
  · by_cases ha_nonneg : F.le F.zero a
    · exact nonneg_le_one_of_square_le_one F a ha_sq_le_one
    · have ha_nonpos : F.le a F.zero :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F ha_nonneg
      exact F.le_trans ha_nonpos
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F))
  · by_cases ha_nonneg : F.le F.zero a
    · have hneg_nonpos : F.le (F.neg a) F.zero :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonpos_of_nonneg F ha_nonneg
      exact F.le_trans hneg_nonpos
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F))
    · have hneg_sq_le_one :
          F.le (F.mul (F.neg a) (F.neg a)) F.one := by
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F a a]
      exact nonneg_le_one_of_square_le_one
        F (F.neg a) hneg_sq_le_one

name: sin_le_one_of_nonneg
statement:

    (x : Point)

proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base

      (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
      (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) = F.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x
  change F.le (S.sin x) F.one
  exact nonneg_le_one_of_square_le_one F (S.sin x)
    (component_square_le_one_of_unit F (S.sin x) (S.cos x) hunit)
