name: exists_local_sin_pos_cos_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_local_sin_pos_cos_ne_zero :
    Exists
      (fun a : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
          (And
            (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (S.sin a))
            (Not (S.cos a = RealTheory.zero))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases S.local_order with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      let a := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F delta
      have ha_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a := by
        change F.lt F.zero a
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hdelta.left
      have ha_lt_delta : RealTheory.lt a delta := by
        change F.lt a delta
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hdelta.left
      have hloc := hdelta.right a ha_pos ha_lt_delta
      have hsin_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (S.sin a) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hloc.left hloc.right.left
      have hcos_ne : Not (S.cos a = RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro hcos_zero
        have hzero_ne_mul :
            Not (RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.mul a (S.cos a)) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hloc.left
        have hmul_zero :
            RealTheory.mul a (S.cos a) = RealTheory.zero := by
          change F.mul a (S.cos a) = F.zero
          rw [hcos_zero]
          exact F.mul_zero a
        exact hzero_ne_mul hmul_zero.symm
      exact Exists.intro a
        (And.intro ha_pos (And.intro hsin_pos hcos_ne))

name: cos_zero
statement:
theorem cos_zero :
    S.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases exists_local_sin_pos_cos_ne_zero S with
  | intro a ha =>
      have hunit := sin_sq_add_cos_sq S a
      have hfixSin :
          S.sin a =
            F.add
              (F.mul (S.sin RealTheory.zero) (S.cos a))
              (F.mul (S.cos RealTheory.zero) (S.sin a)) := by
        have h := sin_add S RealTheory.zero a
        change
          S.sin (F.add F.zero a) =
            F.add
              (F.mul (S.sin F.zero) (S.cos a))
              (F.mul (S.cos F.zero) (S.sin a)) at h
        rw [F.zero_add] at h
        exact h
      have hfixCos :
          S.cos a =
            F.sub
              (F.mul (S.cos RealTheory.zero) (S.cos a))
              (F.mul (S.sin RealTheory.zero) (S.sin a)) := by
        have h := cos_add S RealTheory.zero a
        change
          S.cos (F.add F.zero a) =
            F.sub
              (F.mul (S.cos F.zero) (S.cos a))
              (F.mul (S.sin F.zero) (S.sin a)) at h
        rw [F.zero_add] at h
        exact h
      change
        F.add
            (F.mul (S.sin a) (S.sin a))
            (F.mul (S.cos a) (S.cos a)) =
          F.one at hunit
      have hmulUnit :=
        fixed_unit_left_cos_mul_unit F
          (S.sin F.zero) (S.cos F.zero) (S.sin a) (S.cos a)
          hfixSin hfixCos
      have hone_eq_mul :
          F.one = F.mul (S.cos F.zero) F.one := by
        calc
          F.one =
              F.add
                (F.mul (S.sin a) (S.sin a))
                (F.mul (S.cos a) (S.cos a)) := by
                exact hunit.symm
          _ = F.mul (S.cos F.zero)
                (F.add
                  (F.mul (S.sin a) (S.sin a))
                  (F.mul (S.cos a) (S.cos a))) := by
                exact hmulUnit
          _ = F.mul (S.cos F.zero) F.one := by
                rw [hunit]
      change S.cos F.zero = F.one
      calc
        S.cos F.zero = F.mul (S.cos F.zero) F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
        _ = F.one := by
          exact hone_eq_mul.symm

name: sin_zero
statement:
theorem sin_zero :
    S.sin RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases exists_local_sin_pos_cos_ne_zero S with
  | intro a ha =>
      have hcos0 := cos_zero S
      have hcos0F : S.cos F.zero = F.one := by
        change S.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
        exact hcos0
      have hfixSin :
          S.sin a =
            F.add
              (F.mul (S.sin RealTheory.zero) (S.cos a))
              (F.mul (S.cos RealTheory.zero) (S.sin a)) := by
        have h := sin_add S RealTheory.zero a
        change
          S.sin (F.add F.zero a) =
            F.add
              (F.mul (S.sin F.zero) (S.cos a))
              (F.mul (S.cos F.zero) (S.sin a)) at h
        rw [F.zero_add] at h
        exact h
      have hsum_self :
          F.add
              (F.mul (S.sin F.zero) (S.cos a))
              (S.sin a) =
            S.sin a := by
        change
          S.sin a =
            F.add
              (F.mul (S.sin F.zero) (S.cos a))
              (F.mul (S.cos F.zero) (S.sin a)) at hfixSin
        rw [hcos0F] at hfixSin
        change
          S.sin a =
            F.add
              (F.mul (S.sin F.zero) (S.cos a))
              (F.mul F.one (S.sin a)) at hfixSin
        rw [F.one_mul] at hfixSin
        exact hfixSin.symm
      have hmul_zero :
          F.mul (S.sin F.zero) (S.cos a) = F.zero :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_zero_of_add_eq_self_right F hsum_self
      have hsin0_zero :
          S.sin F.zero = F.zero :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero_right
          F ha.right.right hmul_zero
      change S.sin F.zero = F.zero
      exact hsin0_zero

name: sin_neg
statement:
theorem sin_neg (x : Point) :
    S.sin (RealTheory.neg x) = RealTheory.neg (S.sin x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := S.sin x
  let c := S.cos x
  let u := S.sin (F.neg x)
  let v := S.cos (F.neg x)
  have hunit :
      F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul c c) = F.one := by
    change
      F.add
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
          (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        F.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x
  have hsin0F : S.sin F.zero = F.zero := by
    change S.sin RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
    exact sin_zero S
  have hcos0F : S.cos F.zero = F.one := by
    change S.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
    exact cos_zero S
  have hsum :
      F.add (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u) = F.zero := by
    have h := sin_add S x (F.neg x)
    change
      S.sin (F.add x (F.neg x)) =
        F.add (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u) at h
    rw [F.add_neg] at h
    rw [hsin0F] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hdiff :
      F.sub (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u) = F.one := by
    have h := cos_add S x (F.neg x)
    change
      S.cos (F.add x (F.neg x)) =
        F.sub (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u) at h
    rw [F.add_neg] at h
    rw [hcos0F] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hleft :
      F.sub
          (F.mul c (F.add (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u)))
          (F.mul s (F.sub (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u))) =
        u :=
    left_inverse_sin_component_base F s c u v hunit
  have hright :
      F.sub
          (F.mul c (F.add (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u)))
          (F.mul s (F.sub (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u))) =
        F.neg s := by
    rw [hsum, hdiff]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_zero F c]
    rw [F.mul_one]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F s]
  change u = F.neg s
  exact Eq.trans hleft.symm hright

name: cos_neg
statement:
theorem cos_neg (x : Point) :
    S.cos (RealTheory.neg x) = S.cos x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := S.sin x
  let c := S.cos x
  let u := S.sin (F.neg x)
  let v := S.cos (F.neg x)
  have hunit :
      F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul c c) = F.one := by
    change
      F.add
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
          (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        F.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x
  have hsin0F : S.sin F.zero = F.zero := by
    change S.sin RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
    exact sin_zero S
  have hcos0F : S.cos F.zero = F.one := by
    change S.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
    exact cos_zero S
  have hsum :
      F.add (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u) = F.zero := by
    have h := sin_add S x (F.neg x)
    change
      S.sin (F.add x (F.neg x)) =
        F.add (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u) at h
    rw [F.add_neg] at h
    rw [hsin0F] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hdiff :
      F.sub (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u) = F.one := by
    have h := cos_add S x (F.neg x)
    change
      S.cos (F.add x (F.neg x)) =
        F.sub (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u) at h
    rw [F.add_neg] at h
    rw [hcos0F] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hleft :
      F.add
          (F.mul s (F.add (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u)))
          (F.mul c (F.sub (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u))) =
        v :=
    left_inverse_cos_component_base F s c u v hunit
  have hright :
      F.add
          (F.mul s (F.add (F.mul s v) (F.mul c u)))
          (F.mul c (F.sub (F.mul c v) (F.mul s u))) =
        c := by
    rw [hsum, hdiff]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_zero F s]
    rw [F.mul_one]
    rw [F.zero_add]
  change v = c
  exact Eq.trans hleft.symm hright

name: sin_sub
statement:
theorem sin_sub (x y : Point) :
    S.sin (RealTheory.sub x y) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcosNegF : S.cos (F.neg y) = S.cos y := by
    change S.cos (RealTheory.neg y) = S.cos y
    exact cos_neg S y
  have hsinNegF : S.sin (F.neg y) = F.neg (S.sin y) := by
    change S.sin (RealTheory.neg y) = RealTheory.neg (S.sin y)
    exact sin_neg S y
  have h := sin_add S x (F.neg y)
  change
    S.sin (F.add x (F.neg y)) =
      F.add
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos (F.neg y)))
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin (F.neg y))) at h
  change
    S.sin (F.sub x y) =
      F.sub
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y))
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [h]
  rw [hcosNegF]
  rw [hsinNegF]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]

name: cos_sub
statement:
theorem cos_sub (x y : Point) :
    S.cos (RealTheory.sub x y) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcosNegF : S.cos (F.neg y) = S.cos y := by
    change S.cos (RealTheory.neg y) = S.cos y
    exact cos_neg S y
  have hsinNegF : S.sin (F.neg y) = F.neg (S.sin y) := by
    change S.sin (RealTheory.neg y) = RealTheory.neg (S.sin y)
    exact sin_neg S y
  have h := cos_add S x (F.neg y)
  change
    S.cos (F.add x (F.neg y)) =
      F.sub
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos (F.neg y)))
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin (F.neg y))) at h
  change
    S.cos (F.sub x y) =
      F.add
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [h]
  rw [hcosNegF]
  rw [hsinNegF]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
  rw [sub_neg_eq_add_base F]

name: cotDoubleDomain_sin_add_self
proof:
:=
  h.right

name: tanDoubleDomain_to_addDomain
proof:
:=
  And.intro h.left (And.intro h.left h.right)

name: cotDoubleDomain_to_addDomain
proof:
:=
  And.intro h.left (And.intro h.left h.right)

name: square_nonneg_base
statement:
private theorem square_nonneg_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x : Point) :
    F.le F.zero (F.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : F.le F.zero x
  · exact F.mul_nonneg hx hx
  · have hx0 : F.le x F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hx
    have hnx : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx0
    have h := F.mul_nonneg hnx hnx
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x x] at h

private theorem mul_ne_zero_local {a b : Point}

    Not (RealTheory.mul a b = RealTheory.zero)
proof:

  RealTheory.mul_ne_zero ha hb

name: one_add_square_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change Not (F.add F.one (F.mul t t) = F.zero)
  intro hzero
  have hsquare : F.le F.zero (F.mul t t) :=
    square_nonneg_base F t
  have hone_lt : F.lt F.zero F.one :=
    RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  have hone_add_lt :
      F.lt (F.add F.zero (F.mul t t))
        (F.add F.one (F.mul t t)) :=
    F.add_lt_add_right hone_lt (F.mul t t)
  have ht_lt :
      F.lt (F.mul t t) (F.add F.one (F.mul t t)) := by
    simpa [F.zero_add] using hone_add_lt
  have hpos : F.lt F.zero (F.add F.one (F.mul t t)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hsquare ht_lt
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hpos) hzero.symm

name: mul_pair_mul_inv_left_cancel_base
statement:
private theorem mul_pair_mul_inv_left_cancel_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b d : Point)
    (hb : Not (b = F.zero)) :
    F.mul (F.mul b d) (F.mul a (F.inv b)) =
      F.mul a d
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul b d) (F.mul a (F.inv b)) =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.mul b d) a) (F.inv b) := by
          exact (F.mul_assoc (F.mul b d) a (F.inv b)).symm
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a (F.mul b d)) (F.inv b) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (F.mul b d) a]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul b d) (F.inv b)) := by
          exact F.mul_assoc a (F.mul b d) (F.inv b)
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul d b) (F.inv b)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm b d]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul d (F.mul b (F.inv b))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc d b (F.inv b)]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul d F.one) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hb]
    _ = F.mul a d := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: mul_pair_mul_inv_right_cancel_base
statement:
private theorem mul_pair_mul_inv_right_cancel_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b d : Point)
    (hd : Not (d = F.zero)) :
    F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul b (F.inv d)) =
      F.mul a b
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul b (F.inv d)) =
        F.mul a (F.mul d (F.mul b (F.inv d))) := by
          exact F.mul_assoc a d (F.mul b (F.inv d))
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul d b) (F.inv d)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc d b (F.inv d)]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul b d) (F.inv d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm d b]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul b (F.mul d (F.inv d))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc b d (F.inv d)]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul b F.one) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hd]
    _ = F.mul a b := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: mul_fraction_pair_cancel_base
statement:
private theorem mul_fraction_pair_cancel_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point)
    (hb : Not (b = F.zero))
    (hd : Not (d = F.zero)) :
    F.mul (F.mul b d)
        (F.mul (F.mul a (F.inv b)) (F.mul c (F.inv d))) =
      F.mul a c
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul b d)
        (F.mul (F.mul a (F.inv b)) (F.mul c (F.inv d))) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul b d) (F.mul a (F.inv b)))
          (F.mul c (F.inv d)) := by
          exact (F.mul_assoc
            (F.mul b d)
            (F.mul a (F.inv b))
            (F.mul c (F.inv d))).symm
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul c (F.inv d)) := by
          rw [mul_pair_mul_inv_left_cancel_base F a b d hb]
    _ = F.mul a c := by
          rw [mul_pair_mul_inv_right_cancel_base F a c d hd]

name: cos_add_eq_cos_mul_cos_mul_one_sub_tan_mul_tan
statement:
private theorem cos_add_eq_cos_mul_cos_mul_one_sub_tan_mul_tan
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : CosNonzero S x)
    (hy : CosNonzero S y) :
    S.cos (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (tan S y)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change S.cos (F.add x y) =
    F.mul
      (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
      (F.sub F.one (F.mul (tan S x) (tan S y)))
  let A := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y)
  let T := F.mul (tan S x) (tan S y)
  have hprod :
      F.mul A T = F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y) := by
    change
      F.mul (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x)))
          (F.mul (S.sin y) (F.inv (S.cos y)))) =
        F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y)
    exact mul_fraction_pair_cancel_base F
      (S.sin x) (S.cos x) (S.sin y) (S.cos y) hx hy
  have hfactor :
      F.mul A (F.sub F.one T) = F.sub A (F.mul A T) := by
    calc
      F.mul A (F.sub F.one T) =
          F.mul A (F.add F.one (F.neg T)) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
      _ = F.add (F.mul A F.one) (F.mul A (F.neg T)) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
      _ = F.add A (F.neg (F.mul A T)) := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
      _ = F.sub A (F.mul A T) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    S.cos (F.add x y) =
        F.sub A (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y)) := by
        exact cos_add S x y
    _ = F.sub A (F.mul A T) := by
        rw [hprod]
    _ = F.mul A (F.sub F.one T) := by
        exact hfactor.symm

name: sin_add_eq_sin_mul_sin_mul_cot_add
statement:
private theorem sin_add_eq_sin_mul_sin_mul_cot_add
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : SinNonzero S x)
    (hy : SinNonzero S y) :
    S.sin (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
        (RealTheory.add (cot S x) (cot S y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change S.sin (F.add x y) =
    F.mul
      (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
      (F.add (cot S x) (cot S y))
  let A := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y)
  have hleft :
      F.mul A (cot S x) = F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y) := by
    change
      F.mul (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (F.inv (S.sin x))) =
        F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y)
    exact mul_pair_mul_inv_left_cancel_base F
      (S.cos x) (S.sin x) (S.sin y) hx
  have hright :
      F.mul A (cot S y) = F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y) := by
    change
      F.mul (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
        (F.mul (S.cos y) (F.inv (S.sin y))) =
        F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y)
    exact mul_pair_mul_inv_right_cancel_base F
      (S.sin x) (S.cos y) (S.sin y) hy
  have hfactor :
      F.mul A (F.add (cot S x) (cot S y)) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y))
          (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y)) := by
    calc
      F.mul A (F.add (cot S x) (cot S y)) =
          F.add (F.mul A (cot S x)) (F.mul A (cot S y)) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
      _ =
          F.add
            (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y))
            (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y)) := by
          rw [hleft, hright]
      _ =
          F.add
            (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y))
            (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm]
  calc
    S.sin (F.add x y) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y))
          (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y)) := by
        exact sin_add S x y
    _ = F.mul A (F.add (cot S x) (cot S y)) := by
        exact hfactor.symm

name: tan_add_denominator_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem tan_add_denominator_ne_zero
    {x y : Point}
    (h : TanAddDomain S x y) :
    Not
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (tan S y)) =
        RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change Not (F.sub F.one (F.mul (tan S x) (tan S y)) = F.zero)
  intro hden
  have hfact :=
    cos_add_eq_cos_mul_cos_mul_one_sub_tan_mul_tan S
      (tanAddDomain_cos_left S h)
      (tanAddDomain_cos_right S h)
  have hcos_zero : S.cos (F.add x y) = F.zero := by
    calc
      S.cos (F.add x y) =
          F.mul
            (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
            (F.sub F.one (F.mul (tan S x) (tan S y))) := hfact
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y)) F.zero := by
          rw [hden]
      _ = F.zero := by
          rw [F.mul_zero]
  exact (tanAddDomain_cos_add S h) hcos_zero

name: cot_add_denominator_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem cot_add_denominator_ne_zero
    {x y : Point}
    (h : CotAddDomain S x y) :
    Not (RealTheory.add (cot S x) (cot S y) = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change Not (F.add (cot S x) (cot S y) = F.zero)
  intro hden
  have hfact :=
    sin_add_eq_sin_mul_sin_mul_cot_add S
      (cotAddDomain_sin_left S h)
      (cotAddDomain_sin_right S h)
  have hsin_zero : S.sin (F.add x y) = F.zero := by
    calc
      S.sin (F.add x y) =
          F.mul
            (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
            (F.add (cot S x) (cot S y)) := hfact
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y)) F.zero := by
          rw [hden]
      _ = F.zero := by
          rw [F.mul_zero]
  exact (cotAddDomain_sin_add S h) hsin_zero

name: reciprocal_cross_mul_eq_one_base
statement:
private theorem reciprocal_cross_mul_eq_one_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : Not (a = F.zero))
    (hb : Not (b = F.zero)) :
    F.mul (F.mul a (F.inv b)) (F.mul b (F.inv a)) =
      F.one
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul a (F.inv b)) (F.mul b (F.inv a)) =
        F.mul a (F.mul (F.inv b) (F.mul b (F.inv a))) := by
          exact F.mul_assoc a (F.inv b) (F.mul b (F.inv a))
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv b) b) (F.inv a)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc (F.inv b) b (F.inv a)]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul F.one (F.inv a)) := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hb]
    _ = F.mul a (F.inv a) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel ha]

name: tan_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem tan_ne_zero {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S x)
    (hsin : SinNonzero S x) :
    Not (tan S x = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    Not (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x)) = F.zero)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F hsin
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F hcos)

name: cot_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem cot_ne_zero {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S x)
    (hsin : SinNonzero S x) :
    Not (cot S x = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    Not (F.mul (S.cos x) (F.inv (S.sin x)) = F.zero)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F hcos
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F hsin)

name: tan_mul_cot_eq_one
statement:
theorem tan_mul_cot_eq_one {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S x)
    (hsin : SinNonzero S x) :
    RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (cot S x) = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x)))
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (F.inv (S.sin x))) =
      F.one
  exact reciprocal_cross_mul_eq_one_base F hsin hcos

name: cot_mul_tan_eq_one
statement:
theorem cot_mul_tan_eq_one {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S x)
    (hsin : SinNonzero S x) :
    RealTheory.mul (cot S x) (tan S x) = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (F.inv (S.sin x)))
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x))) =
      F.one
  exact reciprocal_cross_mul_eq_one_base F hcos hsin

name: cot_eq_inv_tan
statement:
theorem cot_eq_inv_tan {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S x)
    (hsin : SinNonzero S x) :
    cot S x = RealTheory.inv (tan S x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change cot S x = F.inv (tan S x)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left F
    (tan_ne_zero S hcos hsin)
    (tan_mul_cot_eq_one S hcos hsin)

name: cosNonzero_neg
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change Not (S.cos (F.neg x) = F.zero)
  intro hneg
  have hxzero : S.cos x = F.zero := by
    calc
      S.cos x = S.cos (F.neg x) := by
        exact (cos_neg S x).symm
      _ = F.zero := hneg
  exact hx hxzero

name: sinNonzero_neg
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change Not (S.sin (F.neg x) = F.zero)
  intro hneg
  have hnegzero : F.neg (S.sin x) = F.zero := by
    calc
      F.neg (S.sin x) = S.sin (F.neg x) := by
        exact (sin_neg S x).symm
      _ = F.zero := hneg
  have hxzero := congrArg F.neg hnegzero
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F (S.sin x),
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at hxzero
  exact hx hxzero

name: tan_neg
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (S.sin (F.neg x)) (F.inv (S.cos (F.neg x))) =
      F.neg (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x)))
  have hsinneg : S.sin (F.neg x) = F.neg (S.sin x) := by
    change S.sin (RealTheory.neg x) = RealTheory.neg (S.sin x)
    exact sin_neg S x
  have hcosneg : S.cos (F.neg x) = S.cos x := by
    change S.cos (RealTheory.neg x) = S.cos x
    exact cos_neg S x
  rw [hsinneg, hcosneg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x))]

name: cot_neg
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (S.cos (F.neg x)) (F.inv (S.sin (F.neg x))) =
      F.neg (F.mul (S.cos x) (F.inv (S.sin x)))
  have hcosneg : S.cos (F.neg x) = S.cos x := by
    change S.cos (RealTheory.neg x) = S.cos x
    exact cos_neg S x
  have hsinneg : S.sin (F.neg x) = F.neg (S.sin x) := by
    change S.sin (RealTheory.neg x) = RealTheory.neg (S.sin x)
    exact sin_neg S x
  rw [hcosneg, hsinneg]
  have hinvneg :
      F.inv (F.neg (S.sin x)) = F.neg (F.inv (S.sin x)) := by
    change
      RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg (S.sin x)) =
        RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.inv (S.sin x))
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_neg_of_ne_zero F hsin
  rw [hinvneg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F (S.cos x) (F.inv (S.sin x))]

name: common_left_quotient_base
statement:
private theorem common_left_quotient_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {A N D : Point}
    (hA : Not (A = F.zero))
    (hD : Not (D = F.zero)) :
    F.mul (F.mul A N) (F.inv (F.mul A D)) =
      F.mul N (F.inv D)
proof:
:= by
  have hcancel :
      F.mul (F.mul A N) (F.inv A) = N := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul A N) (F.inv A) =
          F.mul (F.mul N A) (F.inv A) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm A N]
      _ = F.mul N (F.mul A (F.inv A)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc N A (F.inv A)]
      _ = F.mul N F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hA]
      _ = N := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul A N) (F.inv (F.mul A D)) =
        F.mul (F.mul A N) (F.mul (F.inv D) (F.inv A)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hA hD]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul A N) (F.mul (F.inv A) (F.inv D)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv D) (F.inv A)]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.mul A N) (F.inv A)) (F.inv D) := by
          exact (F.mul_assoc (F.mul A N) (F.inv A) (F.inv D)).symm
    _ = F.mul N (F.inv D) := by
          rw [hcancel]

name: sin_add_eq_cos_mul_cos_mul_tan_add
statement:
private theorem sin_add_eq_cos_mul_cos_mul_tan_add
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : CosNonzero S x)
    (hy : CosNonzero S y) :
    S.sin (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
        (RealTheory.add (tan S x) (tan S y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change S.sin (F.add x y) =
    F.mul
      (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
      (F.add (tan S x) (tan S y))
  let A := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y)
  have hleft :
      F.mul A (tan S x) = F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y) := by
    change
      F.mul (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x))) =
        F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y)
    exact mul_pair_mul_inv_left_cancel_base F
      (S.sin x) (S.cos x) (S.cos y) hx
  have hright :
      F.mul A (tan S y) = F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y) := by
    change
      F.mul (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
        (F.mul (S.sin y) (F.inv (S.cos y))) =
        F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y)
    exact mul_pair_mul_inv_right_cancel_base F
      (S.cos x) (S.sin y) (S.cos y) hy
  have hfactor :
      F.mul A (F.add (tan S x) (tan S y)) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y))
          (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y)) := by
    calc
      F.mul A (F.add (tan S x) (tan S y)) =
          F.add (F.mul A (tan S x)) (F.mul A (tan S y)) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
      _ =
          F.add
            (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y))
            (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y)) := by
          rw [hleft, hright]
  calc
    S.sin (F.add x y) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y))
          (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y)) := by
        exact sin_add S x y
    _ = F.mul A (F.add (tan S x) (tan S y)) := by
        exact hfactor.symm

name: cos_add_eq_sin_mul_sin_mul_cot_mul_cot_sub_one
statement:
private theorem cos_add_eq_sin_mul_sin_mul_cot_mul_cot_sub_one
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : SinNonzero S x)
    (hy : SinNonzero S y) :
    S.cos (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul (cot S x) (cot S y))
          RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change S.cos (F.add x y) =
    F.mul
      (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
      (F.sub (F.mul (cot S x) (cot S y)) F.one)
  let A := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y)
  let T := F.mul (cot S x) (cot S y)
  have hprod :
      F.mul A T = F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y) := by
    change
      F.mul (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (S.cos x) (F.inv (S.sin x)))
          (F.mul (S.cos y) (F.inv (S.sin y)))) =
        F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y)
    exact mul_fraction_pair_cancel_base F
      (S.cos x) (S.sin x) (S.cos y) (S.sin y) hx hy
  have hfactor :
      F.mul A (F.sub T F.one) = F.sub (F.mul A T) A := by
    calc
      F.mul A (F.sub T F.one) =
          F.mul A (F.add T (F.neg F.one)) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
      _ = F.add (F.mul A T) (F.mul A (F.neg F.one)) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
      _ = F.add (F.mul A T) (F.neg A) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F A F.one]
          rw [F.mul_one]
      _ = F.sub (F.mul A T) A := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    S.cos (F.add x y) =
        F.sub (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y)) A := by
        exact cos_add S x y
    _ = F.sub (F.mul A T) A := by
        rw [hprod]
    _ = F.mul A (F.sub T F.one) := by
        exact hfactor.symm

name: tan_add
statement:
theorem tan_add {x y : Point}
    (h : TanAddDomain S x y) :
    tan S (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add (tan S x) (tan S y))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (tan S y))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (S.sin (F.add x y)) (F.inv (S.cos (F.add x y))) =
      F.mul
        (F.add (tan S x) (tan S y))
        (F.inv (F.sub F.one (F.mul (tan S x) (tan S y))))
  let A := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y)
  let N := F.add (tan S x) (tan S y)
  let D := F.sub F.one (F.mul (tan S x) (tan S y))
  have hA : Not (A = F.zero) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F
      (tanAddDomain_cos_left S h)
      (tanAddDomain_cos_right S h)
  have hD : Not (D = F.zero) := by
    change
      Not (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (tan S y)) =
        RealTheory.zero)
    exact tan_add_denominator_ne_zero S h
  have hsin :
      S.sin (F.add x y) = F.mul A N := by
    change S.sin (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
        (RealTheory.add (tan S x) (tan S y))
    exact sin_add_eq_cos_mul_cos_mul_tan_add S
      (tanAddDomain_cos_left S h)
      (tanAddDomain_cos_right S h)
  have hcos :
      S.cos (F.add x y) = F.mul A D := by
    change S.cos (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (tan S y)))
    exact cos_add_eq_cos_mul_cos_mul_one_sub_tan_mul_tan S
      (tanAddDomain_cos_left S h)
      (tanAddDomain_cos_right S h)
  rw [hsin, hcos]
  exact common_left_quotient_base F hA hD

name: cot_add
statement:
theorem cot_add {x y : Point}
    (h : CotAddDomain S x y) :
    cot S (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul (cot S x) (cot S y))
          RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.add (cot S x) (cot S y)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (S.cos (F.add x y)) (F.inv (S.sin (F.add x y))) =
      F.mul
        (F.sub (F.mul (cot S x) (cot S y)) F.one)
        (F.inv (F.add (cot S x) (cot S y)))
  let A := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y)
  let N := F.sub (F.mul (cot S x) (cot S y)) F.one
  let D := F.add (cot S x) (cot S y)
  have hA : Not (A = F.zero) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F
      (cotAddDomain_sin_left S h)
      (cotAddDomain_sin_right S h)
  have hD : Not (D = F.zero) := by
    change Not (RealTheory.add (cot S x) (cot S y) = RealTheory.zero)
    exact cot_add_denominator_ne_zero S h
  have hcos :
      S.cos (F.add x y) = F.mul A N := by
    change S.cos (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul (cot S x) (cot S y))
          RealTheory.one)
    exact cos_add_eq_sin_mul_sin_mul_cot_mul_cot_sub_one S
      (cotAddDomain_sin_left S h)
      (cotAddDomain_sin_right S h)
  have hsin :
      S.sin (F.add x y) = F.mul A D := by
    change S.sin (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
        (RealTheory.add (cot S x) (cot S y))
    exact sin_add_eq_sin_mul_sin_mul_cot_add S
      (cotAddDomain_sin_left S h)
      (cotAddDomain_sin_right S h)
  rw [hcos, hsin]
  exact common_left_quotient_base F hA hD

name: tan_add_self
statement:
theorem tan_add_self {x : Point}
    (h : TanDoubleDomain S x) :
    tan S (RealTheory.add x x) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add (tan S x) (tan S x))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (tan S x))))
proof:
:= by
  exact tan_add S (tanDoubleDomain_to_addDomain S h)

name: cot_add_self
statement:
theorem cot_add_self {x : Point}
    (h : CotDoubleDomain S x) :
    cot S (RealTheory.add x x) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul (cot S x) (cot S x))
          RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.add (cot S x) (cot S x)))
proof:
:= by
  exact cot_add S (cotDoubleDomain_to_addDomain S h)

name: eq_mul_inv_of_mul_eq_right_base
statement:
private theorem eq_mul_inv_of_mul_eq_right_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {v d n : Point}
    (hd : Not (d = F.zero))
    (h : F.mul v d = n) :
    v = F.mul n (F.inv d)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    v = F.mul v F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = F.mul v (F.mul d (F.inv d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hd]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul v d) (F.inv d) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul n (F.inv d) := by
          rw [h]

name: tan_mul_cos_sq_eq_sin_mul_cos
statement:
private theorem tan_mul_cos_sq_eq_sin_mul_cos
    {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S x) :
    RealTheory.mul (tan S x)
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
      RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x)))
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
      F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos x)
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x)))
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        F.mul (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x))
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x))) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm]
    _ = F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos x) := by
          exact mul_pair_mul_inv_left_cancel_base F
            (S.sin x) (S.cos x) (S.cos x) hcos

name: tan_sq_mul_cos_sq_eq_sin_sq
statement:
private theorem tan_sq_mul_cos_sq_eq_sin_sq
    {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S x) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (tan S x))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
      RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x)))
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x))))
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
      F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x)))
          (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x))))
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        F.mul (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x))
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x)))
            (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x)))) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm]
    _ = F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x) := by
          exact mul_fraction_pair_cancel_base F
            (S.sin x) (S.cos x) (S.sin x) (S.cos x) hcos hcos

name: one_add_tan_sq_mul_cos_sq_eq_one
statement:
private theorem one_add_tan_sq_mul_cos_sq_eq_one
    {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S x) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (tan S x)))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s2 := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)
  let c2 := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)
  let t2 := F.mul (tan S x) (tan S x)
  have ht2 : F.mul t2 c2 = s2 := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (tan S x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)
    exact tan_sq_mul_cos_sq_eq_sin_sq S hcos
  have hunit : F.add s2 c2 = F.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x
  change F.mul (F.add F.one t2) c2 = F.one
  calc
    F.mul (F.add F.one t2) c2 =
        F.add (F.mul F.one c2) (F.mul t2 c2) := by
        rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.add c2 s2 := by
        rw [F.one_mul, ht2]
    _ = F.add s2 c2 := by
        rw [F.add_comm]
    _ = F.one := hunit

name: one_sub_tan_sq_mul_cos_sq_eq_cos_add_self
statement:
private theorem one_sub_tan_sq_mul_cos_sq_eq_cos_add_self
    {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S x) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (tan S x)))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
      S.cos (RealTheory.add x x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s2 := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)
  let c2 := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)
  let t2 := F.mul (tan S x) (tan S x)
  have ht2 : F.mul t2 c2 = s2 := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (tan S x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)
    exact tan_sq_mul_cos_sq_eq_sin_sq S hcos
  have hcos2 : S.cos (F.add x x) = F.sub c2 s2 := by
    change S.cos (RealTheory.add x x) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
    exact cos_add_self_sq_sub_sq S x
  change F.mul (F.sub F.one t2) c2 = S.cos (F.add x x)
  calc
    F.mul (F.sub F.one t2) c2 =
        F.sub (F.mul F.one c2) (F.mul t2 c2) := by
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F]
    _ = F.sub c2 s2 := by
        rw [F.one_mul, ht2]
    _ = S.cos (F.add x x) := hcos2.symm

name: tan_add_self_numerator_mul_cos_sq_eq_sin_add_self
statement:
private theorem tan_add_self_numerator_mul_cos_sq_eq_sin_add_self
    {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S x) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add (tan S x) (tan S x))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
      S.sin (RealTheory.add x x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let c2 := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)
  let sc := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos x)
  have htcos :
      F.mul (tan S x) c2 = sc := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul (tan S x)
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos x)
    exact tan_mul_cos_sq_eq_sin_mul_cos S hcos
  have hsin2 : S.sin (F.add x x) = F.add sc sc := by
    change S.sin (RealTheory.add x x) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos x))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos x))
    exact sin_add_self S x
  change F.mul (F.add (tan S x) (tan S x)) c2 =
    S.sin (F.add x x)
  calc
    F.mul (F.add (tan S x) (tan S x)) c2 =
        F.add
          (F.mul (tan S x) c2)
          (F.mul (tan S x) c2) := by
        rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.add sc sc := by
        rw [htcos]
    _ = S.sin (F.add x x) := hsin2.symm

name: sin_mul_one_add_tan_sq_eq_tan_add_self_numerator
statement:
private theorem sin_mul_one_add_tan_sq_eq_tan_add_self_numerator
    {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S (trigHalf x)) :
    RealTheory.mul (S.sin x)
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (tan S (trigHalf x)) (tan S (trigHalf x)))) =
      RealTheory.add (tan S (trigHalf x)) (tan S (trigHalf x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := trigHalf x
  let c2 := F.mul (S.cos h) (S.cos h)
  let D := F.add F.one (F.mul (tan S h) (tan S h))
  let N := F.add (tan S h) (tan S h)
  have hc2 : Not (c2 = F.zero) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F hcos hcos
  have hDcos : F.mul D c2 = F.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (tan S h) (tan S h)))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos h) (S.cos h)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact one_add_tan_sq_mul_cos_sq_eq_one S hcos
  have hNcos : F.mul N c2 = S.sin (F.add h h) := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add (tan S h) (tan S h))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos h) (S.cos h)) =
        S.sin (RealTheory.add h h)
    exact tan_add_self_numerator_mul_cos_sq_eq_sin_add_self S hcos
  have hdouble : F.add h h = x := by
    change RealTheory.add (trigHalf x) (trigHalf x) = x
    exact trigHalf_add_self x
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero F
    (z := c2) hc2
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (S.sin x) D) c2 =
        F.mul (S.sin x) (F.mul D c2) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (S.sin x) F.one := by
        rw [hDcos]
    _ = S.sin x := by
        rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = S.sin (F.add h h) := by
        rw [hdouble]
    _ = F.mul N c2 := hNcos.symm

name: cos_mul_one_add_tan_sq_eq_one_sub_tan_sq
statement:
private theorem cos_mul_one_add_tan_sq_eq_one_sub_tan_sq
    {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S (trigHalf x)) :
    RealTheory.mul (S.cos x)
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (tan S (trigHalf x)) (tan S (trigHalf x)))) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (tan S (trigHalf x)) (tan S (trigHalf x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := trigHalf x
  let c2 := F.mul (S.cos h) (S.cos h)
  let D := F.add F.one (F.mul (tan S h) (tan S h))
  let N := F.sub F.one (F.mul (tan S h) (tan S h))
  have hc2 : Not (c2 = F.zero) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F hcos hcos
  have hDcos : F.mul D c2 = F.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (tan S h) (tan S h)))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos h) (S.cos h)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact one_add_tan_sq_mul_cos_sq_eq_one S hcos
  have hNcos : F.mul N c2 = S.cos (F.add h h) := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (tan S h) (tan S h)))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos h) (S.cos h)) =
        S.cos (RealTheory.add h h)
    exact one_sub_tan_sq_mul_cos_sq_eq_cos_add_self S hcos
  have hdouble : F.add h h = x := by
    change RealTheory.add (trigHalf x) (trigHalf x) = x
    exact trigHalf_add_self x
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero F
    (z := c2) hc2
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (S.cos x) D) c2 =
        F.mul (S.cos x) (F.mul D c2) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (S.cos x) F.one := by
        rw [hDcos]
    _ = S.cos x := by
        rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = S.cos (F.add h h) := by
        rw [hdouble]
    _ = F.mul N c2 := hNcos.symm

name: tanHalf_one_sub_square_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem tanHalf_one_sub_square_ne_zero
    {x : Point}
    (hhalf : CosNonzero S (trigHalf x))
    (hx : CosNonzero S x) :
    Not
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (tan S (trigHalf x)) (tan S (trigHalf x))) =
        RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := trigHalf x
  have hdouble : F.add h h = x := by
    change RealTheory.add (trigHalf x) (trigHalf x) = x
    exact trigHalf_add_self x
  have hadd : CosNonzero S (F.add h h) := by
    change Not (S.cos (F.add h h) = F.zero)
    intro hzero
    have hxzero : S.cos x = F.zero := by
      rw [<- hdouble]
      exact hzero
    exact hx hxzero
  have hdom : TanAddDomain S h h :=
    And.intro hhalf (And.intro hhalf hadd)
  change
    Not
      (F.sub F.one
        (F.mul (tan S h) (tan S h)) = F.zero)
  exact tan_add_denominator_ne_zero S hdom

name: sin_universal_tan_half
statement:
theorem sin_universal_tan_half {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S (trigHalf x)) :
    S.sin x =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add (tan S (trigHalf x)) (tan S (trigHalf x)))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (tan S (trigHalf x))
              (tan S (trigHalf x)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := trigHalf x
  let D := F.add F.one (F.mul (tan S h) (tan S h))
  let N := F.add (tan S h) (tan S h)
  have hD : Not (D = F.zero) := by
    change
      Not (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (tan S h) (tan S h)) = RealTheory.zero)
    exact one_add_square_ne_zero (tan S h)
  have hcross : F.mul (S.sin x) D = N := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul (S.sin x)
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (tan S (trigHalf x))
              (tan S (trigHalf x)))) =
        RealTheory.add (tan S (trigHalf x)) (tan S (trigHalf x))
    exact sin_mul_one_add_tan_sq_eq_tan_add_self_numerator S hcos
  exact eq_mul_inv_of_mul_eq_right_base F hD hcross

name: cos_universal_tan_half
statement:
theorem cos_universal_tan_half {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S (trigHalf x)) :
    S.cos x =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (tan S (trigHalf x))
            (tan S (trigHalf x))))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (tan S (trigHalf x))
              (tan S (trigHalf x)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := trigHalf x
  let D := F.add F.one (F.mul (tan S h) (tan S h))
  let N := F.sub F.one (F.mul (tan S h) (tan S h))
  have hD : Not (D = F.zero) := by
    change
      Not (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (tan S h) (tan S h)) = RealTheory.zero)
    exact one_add_square_ne_zero (tan S h)
  have hcross : F.mul (S.cos x) D = N := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul (S.cos x)
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (tan S (trigHalf x))
              (tan S (trigHalf x)))) =
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (tan S (trigHalf x))
            (tan S (trigHalf x)))
    exact cos_mul_one_add_tan_sq_eq_one_sub_tan_sq S hcos
  exact eq_mul_inv_of_mul_eq_right_base F hD hcross

name: tan_universal_tan_half
statement:
theorem tan_universal_tan_half {x : Point}
    (hhalf : CosNonzero S (trigHalf x))
    (hx : CosNonzero S x) :
    tan S x =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add (tan S (trigHalf x)) (tan S (trigHalf x)))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (tan S (trigHalf x))
              (tan S (trigHalf x)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := trigHalf x
  have hdouble : F.add h h = x := by
    change RealTheory.add (trigHalf x) (trigHalf x) = x
    exact trigHalf_add_self x
  have hadd : CosNonzero S (F.add h h) := by
    change Not (S.cos (F.add h h) = F.zero)
    intro hzero
    have hxzero : S.cos x = F.zero := by
      rw [<- hdouble]
      exact hzero
    exact hx hxzero
  have hdom : TanDoubleDomain S h :=
    And.intro hhalf hadd
  have htan := tan_add_self S hdom
  change
    tan S (F.add h h) =
      F.mul
        (F.add (tan S h) (tan S h))
        (F.inv
          (F.sub F.one
            (F.mul (tan S h) (tan S h)))) at htan
  rw [hdouble] at htan
  exact htan

name: sin_sq_eq_one_sub_cos_sq
statement:
private theorem sin_sq_eq_one_sub_cos_sq
    (S : CircularThinSpec) (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hunit := sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x
  change
    F.add
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
      F.one at hunit
  calc
    F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x) =
        F.sub
          (F.add
            (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
            (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)))
          (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) := by
          exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel
            F (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
              (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x))).symm
    _ = F.sub F.one (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) := by
          rw [hunit]

name: cos_nonneg_of_pos_lt_local
statement:
private theorem cos_nonneg_of_pos_lt_local
    (S : CircularThinSpec)
    {x delta : Point}
    (hdelta :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero z ->
          RealTheory.lt z delta ->
            And
              (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.mul z (S.cos z)))
              (And
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.mul z (S.cos z))
                  (S.sin z))
                (RealTheory.lt (S.sin z) z)))
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x delta) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (S.cos x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hloc := hdelta x hxpos hxlt
  by_cases hcos : F.le F.zero (S.cos x)
  · exact hcos
  · have hcos_nonpos : F.le (S.cos x) F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hcos
    have hmul_le_zero :
        F.le (F.mul x (S.cos x)) F.zero := by
      have h :=
        F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hcos_nonpos
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxpos)
      rwa [F.mul_zero] at h
    exact False.elim
      ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hloc.left) hmul_le_zero)

name: eventually_cos_nonneg_near_zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases S.local_order with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      unfold dist at hxd
      change
        F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub x F.zero)) delta
          at hxd
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F x] at hxd
      by_cases h0x : F.le F.zero x
      · have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0x
          intro hx0
          have hzero : x = F.zero := F.le_antisymm hx0 h0x
          exact hxne hzero
        have hxlt : F.lt x delta := by
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F h0x] at hxd
        exact cos_nonneg_of_pos_lt_local S hdelta.right hxpos hxlt
      · have hx_nonpos : F.le x F.zero :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F h0x
        have hx_neg : F.lt x F.zero := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx_nonpos
          intro hzero_le_x
          exact h0x hzero_le_x
        have hnegx_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.neg x) := by
          have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hx_neg
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
        have hnegx_lt_delta : F.lt (F.neg x) delta := by
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F hx_nonpos] at hxd
        have hcos_negx :
            F.le F.zero (S.cos (F.neg x)) :=
          cos_nonneg_of_pos_lt_local
            S hdelta.right hnegx_pos hnegx_lt_delta
        have hcos :
            S.cos (F.neg x) = S.cos x := by
          change S.cos (RealTheory.neg x) = S.cos x
          exact cos_neg S x
        rwa [hcos] at hcos_negx

name: abs_cos_sub_one_le_sin_sq_of_cos_nonneg
statement:
theorem abs_cos_sub_one_le_sin_sq_of_cos_nonneg
    (S : CircularThinSpec) (x : Point)
    (hcos_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (S.cos x)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (S.cos x) RealTheory.one))
      (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := S.sin x
  let c := S.cos x
  have hcos_le_one : F.le c F.one :=
    cos_le_one_of_nonneg S x hcos_nonneg
  have hcos_sq_le_cos : F.le (F.mul c c) c := by
    have h := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hcos_le_one hcos_nonneg
    rwa [F.mul_one] at h
  have hone_sub_cos_le_one_sub_cos_sq :
      F.le (F.sub F.one c) (F.sub F.one (F.mul c c)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F (F.le_refl F.one) hcos_sq_le_cos
  have hsin_sq :
      F.mul s s = F.sub F.one (F.mul c c) := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x) =
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x))
    exact sin_sq_eq_one_sub_cos_sq S x
  have hsub_nonpos : F.le (F.sub c F.one) F.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hcos_le_one
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub c F.one))
      (F.mul s s)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F hsub_nonpos]
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F c F.one]
  rw [hsin_sq]
  exact hone_sub_cos_le_one_sub_cos_sq

name: eventually_abs_cos_sub_one_le_sin_sq
statement:
private theorem eventually_abs_cos_sub_one_le_sin_sq :
    EventuallyWithin UniversalDomain RealTheory.zero
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs (CosMinusOneFun S x))
          (SinSquareFun S x))
proof:
:= by
  cases eventually_cos_nonneg_near_zero S with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      have hcos := hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd
      unfold CosMinusOneFun
      unfold SinSquareFun MulFun
      exact abs_cos_sub_one_le_sin_sq_of_cos_nonneg S x hcos

name: tendstoWithin_absIdentity_zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro eps heps
  refine Exists.intro eps ?_
  refine And.intro heps ?_
  intro x hx hxne hxd
  unfold AbsIdentityFun
  unfold dist at hxd
  change
    F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub x F.zero)) eps at hxd
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F x] at hxd
  unfold dist
  change
    F.lt
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.sub (RealTheory.abs x) F.zero)) eps
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (RealTheory.abs x)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
    (RealTheory.abs_nonneg x)]
  exact hxd

name: eventually_abs_sin_le_abs_identity
statement:
theorem eventually_abs_sin_le_abs_identity :
    EventuallyWithin UniversalDomain RealTheory.zero
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (S.sin x)) (RealTheory.abs x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases S.local_order with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      change
        F.le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (S.sin x))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F x)
      unfold dist at hxd
      change
        F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub x F.zero)) delta
          at hxd
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F x] at hxd
      by_cases h0x : F.le F.zero x
      · have hx_pos : F.lt F.zero x := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0x
          intro hx0
          have hzero : x = F.zero := F.le_antisymm hx0 h0x
          exact hxne hzero
        have hx_lt_delta : F.lt x delta := by
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F h0x] at hxd
        have hloc := hdelta.right x hx_pos hx_lt_delta
        have hsin_pos : F.lt F.zero (S.sin x) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hloc.left hloc.right.left
        have hsin_le_x : F.le (S.sin x) x :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hloc.right.right
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsin_pos)]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F h0x]
        exact hsin_le_x
      · have hx_nonpos : F.le x F.zero :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F h0x
        have hx_neg : F.lt x F.zero := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx_nonpos
          intro hzero_le_x
          exact h0x hzero_le_x
        have hnegx_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.neg x) := by
          have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hx_neg
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
        have hnegx_lt_delta : F.lt (F.neg x) delta := by
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F hx_nonpos] at hxd
        have hloc := hdelta.right (F.neg x) hnegx_pos hnegx_lt_delta
        have hsin_negx_pos : F.lt F.zero (S.sin (F.neg x)) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hloc.left hloc.right.left
        have hsin_x :
            S.sin x = F.neg (S.sin (F.neg x)) := by
          have h := sin_neg S (F.neg x)
          change
            S.sin (F.neg (F.neg x)) =
              F.neg (S.sin (F.neg x)) at h
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F x] at h
        rw [hsin_x]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F (S.sin (F.neg x))]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsin_negx_pos)]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F hx_nonpos]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hloc.right.right

name: tendsto_sin_zero_at_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_sin_zero_at_zero :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain S.sin
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
proof:
:=
  tendstoWithin_zero_of_eventually_abs_le
    (eventually_abs_sin_le_abs_identity S)
    tendstoWithin_absIdentity_zero

name: tendsto_sin_square_zero_at_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hmul :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain (MulFun S.sin S.sin)
        RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero) :=
    tendstoWithin_mul
      (tendsto_sin_zero_at_zero S)
      (tendsto_sin_zero_at_zero S)
  have hzero :
      RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero =
        RealTheory.zero := by
    exact RealTheory.zero_mul RealTheory.zero
  unfold SinSquareFun
  exact tendstoWithin_congr_limit hzero hmul

name: tendsto_cos_one_at_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_cos_one_at_zero :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain S.cos
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain (CosMinusOneFun S)
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero :=
    tendstoWithin_zero_of_eventually_abs_le
      (eventually_abs_cos_sub_one_le_sin_sq S)
      (tendsto_sin_square_zero_at_zero S)
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro eps heps
  cases hdiff eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      have hclose := hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd
      unfold CosMinusOneFun at hclose
      unfold dist at hclose
      change
        F.lt
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
            (F.sub (F.sub (S.cos x) F.one) F.zero)) eps at hclose
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (F.sub (S.cos x) F.one)]
        at hclose
      unfold dist
      change
        F.lt
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
          (F.sub (S.cos x) F.one)) eps
      exact hclose

name: tendstoWithin_trigShiftToZero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hid :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain IdentityFun x0 :=
    continuousAtOn_identity trivial
  have hconst :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain (fun _ : Point => x0) x0 :=
    continuousAtOn_const trivial
  have hsub :
      ContinuousAtOn UniversalDomain
        (SubFun IdentityFun (fun _ : Point => x0)) x0 :=
    continuousAtOn_sub hid hconst
  have hlimit :
      RealTheory.sub x0 x0 = RealTheory.zero := by
    change F.sub x0 x0 = F.zero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F x0
  have h :=
    tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlimit hsub.right
  unfold TrigShiftToZero
  change
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
      (SubFun IdentityFun (fun _ : Point => x0))
      x0 RealTheory.zero
  exact h

name: tendsto_shifted_sin_zero
statement:
private theorem tendsto_shifted_sin_zero (x0 : Point) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
      (CompFun S.sin (TrigShiftToZero x0))
      x0 RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  exact
    tendstoWithin_comp_tendstoWithin_of_eq_center
      (tendstoWithin_trigShiftToZero x0)
      (tendsto_sin_zero_at_zero S)
      (fun _ _ _ => trivial)
      (sin_zero S)

name: tendsto_shifted_cos_one
statement:
private theorem tendsto_shifted_cos_one (x0 : Point) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
      (CompFun S.cos (TrigShiftToZero x0))
      x0 RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  exact
    tendstoWithin_comp_tendstoWithin_of_eq_center
      (tendstoWithin_trigShiftToZero x0)
      (tendsto_cos_one_at_zero S)
      (fun _ _ _ => trivial)
      (cos_zero S)

name: add_base_sub_eq_self
statement:
private theorem add_base_sub_eq_self (x x0 : Point) :
    RealTheory.add x0 (RealTheory.sub x x0) = x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.add x0 (F.sub x x0) = x
  rw [F.add_comm x0 (F.sub x x0)]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x x0

name: sin_shift_formula
statement:
private theorem sin_shift_formula (x0 x : Point) :
    S.sin x =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x0)
          (S.cos (TrigShiftToZero x0 x)))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x0)
          (S.sin (TrigShiftToZero x0 x)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := sin_add S x0 (TrigShiftToZero x0 x)
  have hadd :
      RealTheory.add x0 (TrigShiftToZero x0 x) = x := by
    unfold TrigShiftToZero
    exact add_base_sub_eq_self x x0
  rwa [hadd] at h

name: cos_shift_formula
statement:
private theorem cos_shift_formula (x0 x : Point) :
    S.cos x =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x0)
          (S.cos (TrigShiftToZero x0 x)))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x0)
          (S.sin (TrigShiftToZero x0 x)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := cos_add S x0 (TrigShiftToZero x0 x)
  have hadd :
      RealTheory.add x0 (TrigShiftToZero x0 x) = x := by
    unfold TrigShiftToZero
    exact add_base_sub_eq_self x x0
  rwa [hadd] at h

name: tendsto_sin_at
statement:
theorem tendsto_sin_at (x0 : Point) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain S.sin x0 (S.sin x0)
proof:
:= by
  have hcosShift := tendsto_shifted_cos_one S x0
  have hsinShift := tendsto_shifted_sin_zero S x0
  have hterm1Raw :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.sin x0)
          (CompFun S.cos (TrigShiftToZero x0)))
        x0 (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x0) RealTheory.one) :=
    tendstoWithin_mul
      (tendstoWithin_const UniversalDomain (S.sin x0) x0)
      hcosShift
  have hterm1 :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.sin x0)
          (CompFun S.cos (TrigShiftToZero x0)))
        x0 (S.sin x0) := by
    exact tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (RealTheory.mul_one (S.sin x0)) hterm1Raw
  have hterm2Raw :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.cos x0)
          (CompFun S.sin (TrigShiftToZero x0)))
        x0 (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x0) RealTheory.zero) :=
    tendstoWithin_mul
      (tendstoWithin_const UniversalDomain (S.cos x0) x0)
      hsinShift
  have hterm2 :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.cos x0)
          (CompFun S.sin (TrigShiftToZero x0)))
        x0 RealTheory.zero := by
    exact tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (RealTheory.mul_zero (S.cos x0)) hterm2Raw
  have hsumRaw :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (AddFun
          (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.sin x0)
            (CompFun S.cos (TrigShiftToZero x0)))
          (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.cos x0)
            (CompFun S.sin (TrigShiftToZero x0))))
        x0 (RealTheory.add (S.sin x0) RealTheory.zero) :=
    tendstoWithin_add hterm1 hterm2
  have hsum :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (AddFun
          (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.sin x0)
            (CompFun S.cos (TrigShiftToZero x0)))
          (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.cos x0)
            (CompFun S.sin (TrigShiftToZero x0))))
        x0 (S.sin x0) := by
    exact tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (RealTheory.add_zero (S.sin x0)) hsumRaw
  exact
    tendstoWithin_congr
      (fun x _ _ => by
        unfold AddFun MulFun CompFun
        exact (sin_shift_formula S x0 x).symm)
      hsum

name: tendsto_cos_at
statement:
theorem tendsto_cos_at (x0 : Point) :
    TendstoWithin UniversalDomain S.cos x0 (S.cos x0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcosShift := tendsto_shifted_cos_one S x0
  have hsinShift := tendsto_shifted_sin_zero S x0
  have hterm1Raw :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.cos x0)
          (CompFun S.cos (TrigShiftToZero x0)))
        x0 (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x0) RealTheory.one) :=
    tendstoWithin_mul
      (tendstoWithin_const UniversalDomain (S.cos x0) x0)
      hcosShift
  have hterm1 :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.cos x0)
          (CompFun S.cos (TrigShiftToZero x0)))
        x0 (S.cos x0) := by
    exact tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (RealTheory.mul_one (S.cos x0)) hterm1Raw
  have hterm2Raw :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.sin x0)
          (CompFun S.sin (TrigShiftToZero x0)))
        x0 (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x0) RealTheory.zero) :=
    tendstoWithin_mul
      (tendstoWithin_const UniversalDomain (S.sin x0) x0)
      hsinShift
  have hterm2 :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.sin x0)
          (CompFun S.sin (TrigShiftToZero x0)))
        x0 RealTheory.zero := by
    exact tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (RealTheory.mul_zero (S.sin x0)) hterm2Raw
  have hdiffRaw :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (SubFun
          (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.cos x0)
            (CompFun S.cos (TrigShiftToZero x0)))
          (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.sin x0)
            (CompFun S.sin (TrigShiftToZero x0))))
        x0 (RealTheory.sub (S.cos x0) RealTheory.zero) :=
    tendstoWithin_sub hterm1 hterm2
  have hdiff :
      TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (SubFun
          (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.cos x0)
            (CompFun S.cos (TrigShiftToZero x0)))
          (MulFun (fun _ : Point => S.sin x0)
            (CompFun S.sin (TrigShiftToZero x0))))
        x0 (S.cos x0) := by
    have hlim :
        RealTheory.sub (S.cos x0) RealTheory.zero = S.cos x0 := by
      change F.sub (S.cos x0) F.zero = S.cos x0
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (S.cos x0)
    exact tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim hdiffRaw
  exact
    tendstoWithin_congr
      (fun x _ _ => by
        unfold SubFun MulFun CompFun
        exact (cos_shift_formula S x0 x).symm)
      hdiff
