name: eq_trigHalf_of_add_self_eq
statement:
private theorem eq_trigHalf_of_add_self_eq
    {a b : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.add a a = b) :
    a = trigHalf b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.add a a = b at h
  unfold trigHalf
  change a = IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F b
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two
  have htwo_ne : Not (F.add F.one F.one = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two_ne_zero F (by
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two
      exact hzero)
  calc
    a = F.mul a F.one := by rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = F.mul a
        (F.mul (F.add F.one F.one)
          (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one))) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel htwo_ne]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a (F.add F.one F.one))
        (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.add a a) (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one)) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
          rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = F.mul b (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one)) := by
          rw [h]

name: trigHalf_add_self
statement:
theorem trigHalf_add_self (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.add (trigHalf x) (trigHalf x) = x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold trigHalf
  change
    F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x) = x
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F x

name: add_add_sub_eq_add_self
statement:
private theorem add_add_sub_eq_add_self
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.add (F.add a b) (F.sub a b) = F.add a a
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    F.add (F.add a b) (F.add a (F.neg b)) =
        F.add a (F.add b (F.add a (F.neg b))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add a (F.add a (F.add b (F.neg b))) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc b a (F.neg b)]
          rw [F.add_comm b a]
          rw [F.add_assoc a b (F.neg b)]
    _ = F.add a (F.add a F.zero) := by
          rw [F.add_neg]
    _ = F.add a a := by
          rw [F.add_zero]

name: sub_add_add_eq_add_self
statement:
private theorem sub_add_add_eq_add_self
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.add (F.sub a b) (F.add a b) = F.add a a
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.add_comm (F.sub a b) (F.add a b)]
  exact add_add_sub_eq_add_self F a b

name: add_add_sub_sub_eq_add_self
statement:
private theorem add_add_sub_sub_eq_add_self
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.sub (F.add a b) (F.sub a b) = F.add b b
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg a b]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F a (F.neg b)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F b]
  calc
    F.add (F.add a b) (F.add (F.neg a) b) =
        F.add a (F.add b (F.add (F.neg a) b)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add a (F.add (F.neg a) (F.add b b)) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc b (F.neg a) b]
          rw [F.add_comm b (F.neg a)]
          rw [F.add_assoc (F.neg a) b b]
    _ = F.add (F.add a (F.neg a)) (F.add b b) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add F.zero (F.add b b) := by
          rw [F.add_neg]
    _ = F.add b b := by
          rw [F.zero_add]

name: add_pair_add_pair
statement:
private theorem add_pair_add_pair
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.add (F.add a b) (F.add a b) =
      F.add (F.add a a) (F.add b b)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.add a b) (F.add a b) =
        F.add a (F.add b (F.add a b)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add a (F.add a (F.add b b)) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc b a b]
          rw [F.add_comm b a]
          rw [F.add_assoc a b b]
    _ = F.add (F.add a a) (F.add b b) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: sub_pair_add_pair
statement:
private theorem sub_pair_add_pair
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.add (F.sub a b) (F.sub a b) =
      F.sub (F.add a a) (F.add b b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.add a a) (F.add b b)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F b b]
  calc
    F.add (F.add a (F.neg b)) (F.add a (F.neg b)) =
        F.add (F.add a a) (F.add (F.neg b) (F.neg b)) := by
          exact add_pair_add_pair F a (F.neg b)

name: add_half_sum_half_diff_eq_left
statement:
private theorem add_half_sum_half_diff_eq_left
    (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
      (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v))
      (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v)) = u
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_self_cancel F
  change
    F.add
        (F.add
          (trigHalf (F.add u v))
          (trigHalf (F.sub u v)))
        (F.add
          (trigHalf (F.add u v))
          (trigHalf (F.sub u v))) =
      F.add u u
  rw [add_pair_add_pair F
    (trigHalf (F.add u v)) (trigHalf (F.sub u v))]
  have hleft :
      F.add (trigHalf (F.add u v)) (trigHalf (F.add u v)) =
        F.add u v := by
    change
      RealTheory.add (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v))
        (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v)) = RealTheory.add u v
    exact trigHalf_add_self (RealTheory.add u v)
  have hright :
      F.add (trigHalf (F.sub u v)) (trigHalf (F.sub u v)) =
        F.sub u v := by
    change
      RealTheory.add (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v))
        (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v)) = RealTheory.sub u v
    exact trigHalf_add_self (RealTheory.sub u v)
  rw [hleft, hright]
  exact add_add_sub_eq_add_self F u v

name: sub_half_sum_half_diff_eq_right
statement:
private theorem sub_half_sum_half_diff_eq_right
    (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub
      (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v))
      (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v)) = v
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_self_cancel F
  change
    F.add
        (F.sub
          (trigHalf (F.add u v))
          (trigHalf (F.sub u v)))
        (F.sub
          (trigHalf (F.add u v))
          (trigHalf (F.sub u v))) =
      F.add v v
  rw [sub_pair_add_pair F
    (trigHalf (F.add u v)) (trigHalf (F.sub u v))]
  have hleft :
      F.add (trigHalf (F.add u v)) (trigHalf (F.add u v)) =
        F.add u v := by
    change
      RealTheory.add (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v))
        (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v)) = RealTheory.add u v
    exact trigHalf_add_self (RealTheory.add u v)
  have hright :
      F.add (trigHalf (F.sub u v)) (trigHalf (F.sub u v)) =
        F.sub u v := by
    change
      RealTheory.add (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v))
        (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v)) = RealTheory.sub u v
    exact trigHalf_add_self (RealTheory.sub u v)
  rw [hleft, hright]
  exact add_add_sub_sub_eq_add_self F u v

name: sin_add_self
statement:
theorem sin_add_self (x : Point) :
    S.sin (RealTheory.add x x) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos x))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := sin_add S x x
  change
    S.sin (F.add x x) =
      F.add
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos x))
        (F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin x)) at h
  change
    S.sin (F.add x x) =
      F.add
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos x))
        (F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos x))
  rwa [F.mul_comm (S.cos x) (S.sin x)] at h

name: cos_add_self_sq_sub_sq
statement:
theorem cos_add_self_sq_sub_sq (x : Point) :
    S.cos (RealTheory.add x x) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
proof:
:= by
  exact cos_add S x x

name: cos_sq_eq_one_sub_sin_sq
statement:
private theorem cos_sq_eq_one_sub_sin_sq
    (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s2 := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)
  let c2 := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)
  have hunit :
      F.add s2 c2 = F.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x
  change c2 = F.sub F.one s2
  calc
    c2 = F.sub (F.add c2 s2) s2 := by
          exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F c2 s2).symm
    _ = F.sub (F.add s2 c2) s2 := by
          rw [F.add_comm c2 s2]
    _ = F.sub F.one s2 := by
          rw [hunit]

name: sin_sq_eq_one_sub_cos_sq
statement:
private theorem sin_sq_eq_one_sub_cos_sq
    (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s2 := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)
  let c2 := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)
  have hunit :
      F.add s2 c2 = F.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x
  change s2 = F.sub F.one c2
  calc
    s2 = F.sub (F.add s2 c2) c2 := by
          exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F s2 c2).symm
    _ = F.sub F.one c2 := by
          rw [hunit]

name: cos_add_self_one_sub_two_sin_sq
statement:
theorem cos_add_self_one_sub_two_sin_sq (x : Point) :
    S.cos (RealTheory.add x x) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s2 := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)
  let c2 := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)
  have hcos := cos_add_self_sq_sub_sq S x
  change S.cos (F.add x x) = F.sub c2 s2 at hcos
  have hc2 : c2 = F.sub F.one s2 := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x) =
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
    exact cos_sq_eq_one_sub_sin_sq S x
  change S.cos (F.add x x) = F.sub F.one (F.add s2 s2)
  rw [hcos]
  change F.sub c2 s2 = F.sub F.one (F.add s2 s2)
  rw [hc2]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add F F.one s2 s2

name: cos_add_self_two_cos_sq_sub_one
statement:
theorem cos_add_self_two_cos_sq_sub_one (x : Point) :
    S.cos (RealTheory.add x x) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)))
        RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s2 := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x)
  let c2 := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)
  have hcos := cos_add_self_sq_sub_sq S x
  change S.cos (F.add x x) = F.sub c2 s2 at hcos
  have hunit :
      F.add s2 c2 = F.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x
  change S.cos (F.add x x) = F.sub (F.add c2 c2) F.one
  rw [hcos]
  change F.sub c2 s2 = F.sub (F.add c2 c2) F.one
  symm
  calc
    F.sub (F.add c2 c2) F.one =
        F.sub (F.add c2 c2) (F.add s2 c2) := by
          rw [hunit]
    _ = F.sub (F.add c2 c2) (F.add c2 s2) := by
          rw [F.add_comm s2 c2]
    _ = F.add (F.sub c2 c2) (F.sub c2 s2) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F]
    _ = F.add F.zero (F.sub c2 s2) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F c2]
    _ = F.sub c2 s2 := by
          rw [F.zero_add]

name: sin_add_add_sin_sub_eq_two_sin_cos
statement:
theorem sin_add_add_sin_sub_eq_two_sin_cos
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
      (S.sin (RealTheory.add x y))
      (S.sin (RealTheory.sub x y)) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y)
  let B := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.sin y)
  have hadd := sin_add S x y
  have hsub := sin_sub S x y
  change S.sin (F.add x y) = F.add A B at hadd
  change S.sin (F.sub x y) = F.sub A B at hsub
  change
    F.add
      (S.sin (F.add x y))
      (S.sin (F.sub x y)) =
      F.add A A
  rw [hadd, hsub]
  exact add_add_sub_eq_add_self F A B

name: sin_mul_cos_eq_half_sin_add_add_sin_sub
statement:
theorem sin_mul_cos_eq_half_sin_add_add_sin_sub
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y) =
      trigHalf
        (RealTheory.add
          (S.sin (RealTheory.add x y))
          (S.sin (RealTheory.sub x y)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.cos y)
  have h :=
    sin_add_add_sin_sub_eq_two_sin_cos S x y
  change A =
    trigHalf (F.add (S.sin (F.add x y)) (S.sin (F.sub x y)))
  exact eq_trigHalf_of_add_self_eq h.symm

name: cos_add_add_cos_sub_eq_two_cos_cos
statement:
theorem cos_add_add_cos_sub_eq_two_cos_cos
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
      (S.cos (RealTheory.add x y))
      (S.cos (RealTheory.sub x y)) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y)
  let B := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y)
  have hadd := cos_add S x y
  have hsub := cos_sub S x y
  change S.cos (F.add x y) = F.sub A B at hadd
  change S.cos (F.sub x y) = F.add A B at hsub
  change
    F.add
      (S.cos (F.add x y))
      (S.cos (F.sub x y)) =
      F.add A A
  rw [hadd, hsub]
  exact sub_add_add_eq_add_self F A B

name: cos_mul_cos_eq_half_cos_add_add_cos_sub
statement:
theorem cos_mul_cos_eq_half_cos_add_add_cos_sub
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y) =
      trigHalf
        (RealTheory.add
          (S.cos (RealTheory.add x y))
          (S.cos (RealTheory.sub x y)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y)
  have h :=
    cos_add_add_cos_sub_eq_two_cos_cos S x y
  change A =
    trigHalf (F.add (S.cos (F.add x y)) (S.cos (F.sub x y)))
  exact eq_trigHalf_of_add_self_eq h.symm

name: cos_sub_sub_cos_add_eq_two_sin_sin
statement:
theorem cos_sub_sub_cos_add_eq_two_sin_sin
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub
      (S.cos (RealTheory.sub x y))
      (S.cos (RealTheory.add x y)) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := F.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos y)
  let B := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y)
  have hadd := cos_add S x y
  have hsub := cos_sub S x y
  change S.cos (F.add x y) = F.sub A B at hadd
  change S.cos (F.sub x y) = F.add A B at hsub
  change
    F.sub
      (S.cos (F.sub x y))
      (S.cos (F.add x y)) =
      F.add B B
  rw [hadd, hsub]
  exact add_add_sub_sub_eq_add_self F A B

name: sin_mul_sin_eq_half_cos_sub_sub_cos_add
statement:
theorem sin_mul_sin_eq_half_cos_sub_sub_cos_add
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y) =
      trigHalf
        (RealTheory.sub
          (S.cos (RealTheory.sub x y))
          (S.cos (RealTheory.add x y)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let B := F.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin y)
  have h :=
    cos_sub_sub_cos_add_eq_two_sin_sin S x y
  change B =
    trigHalf (F.sub (S.cos (F.sub x y)) (S.cos (F.add x y)))
  exact eq_trigHalf_of_add_self_eq h.symm

name: sin_add_sin_eq_two_sin_half_sum_cos_half_diff
statement:
theorem sin_add_sin_eq_two_sin_half_sum_cos_half_diff
    (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.add (S.sin u) (S.sin v) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (S.sin (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v)))
          (S.cos (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v))))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (S.sin (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v)))
          (S.cos (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a := trigHalf (F.add u v)
  let b := trigHalf (F.sub u v)
  let P := F.mul (S.sin a) (S.cos b)
  have hp := sin_mul_cos_eq_half_sin_add_add_sin_sub S a b
  have hab : F.add a b = u := by
    unfold a b
    exact add_half_sum_half_diff_eq_left u v
  have hsub : F.sub a b = v := by
    unfold a b
    exact sub_half_sum_half_diff_eq_right u v
  change F.add (S.sin u) (S.sin v) = F.add P P
  change
    P = trigHalf
      (F.add (S.sin (F.add a b)) (S.sin (F.sub a b))) at hp
  rw [hab, hsub] at hp
  symm
  calc
    F.add P P =
        F.add
          (trigHalf (F.add (S.sin u) (S.sin v)))
          (trigHalf (F.add (S.sin u) (S.sin v))) := by
          rw [hp]
    _ = F.add (S.sin u) (S.sin v) := by
          exact trigHalf_add_self (F.add (S.sin u) (S.sin v))

name: sin_sub_sin_eq_two_cos_half_sum_sin_half_diff
statement:
theorem sin_sub_sin_eq_two_cos_half_sum_sin_half_diff
    (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (S.sin u) (S.sin v) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (S.cos (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v)))
          (S.sin (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v))))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (S.cos (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v)))
          (S.sin (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a := trigHalf (F.add u v)
  let b := trigHalf (F.sub u v)
  let A := F.mul (S.sin a) (S.cos b)
  let B := F.mul (S.cos a) (S.sin b)
  have hab : F.add a b = u := by
    unfold a b
    exact add_half_sum_half_diff_eq_left u v
  have hsub : F.sub a b = v := by
    unfold a b
    exact sub_half_sum_half_diff_eq_right u v
  have hadd := sin_add S a b
  have hsubTrig := sin_sub S a b
  change S.sin (F.add a b) = F.add A B at hadd
  change S.sin (F.sub a b) = F.sub A B at hsubTrig
  have hsinU : S.sin u = F.add A B := by
    rw [<- hab]
    exact hadd
  have hsinV : S.sin v = F.sub A B := by
    rw [<- hsub]
    exact hsubTrig
  change F.sub (S.sin u) (S.sin v) = F.add B B
  rw [hsinU, hsinV]
  exact add_add_sub_sub_eq_add_self F A B

name: cos_add_cos_eq_two_cos_half_sum_cos_half_diff
statement:
theorem cos_add_cos_eq_two_cos_half_sum_cos_half_diff
    (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.add (S.cos u) (S.cos v) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (S.cos (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v)))
          (S.cos (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v))))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (S.cos (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v)))
          (S.cos (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a := trigHalf (F.add u v)
  let b := trigHalf (F.sub u v)
  let P := F.mul (S.cos a) (S.cos b)
  have hp := cos_mul_cos_eq_half_cos_add_add_cos_sub S a b
  have hab : F.add a b = u := by
    unfold a b
    exact add_half_sum_half_diff_eq_left u v
  have hsub : F.sub a b = v := by
    unfold a b
    exact sub_half_sum_half_diff_eq_right u v
  change F.add (S.cos u) (S.cos v) = F.add P P
  change
    P = trigHalf
      (F.add (S.cos (F.add a b)) (S.cos (F.sub a b))) at hp
  rw [hab, hsub] at hp
  symm
  calc
    F.add P P =
        F.add
          (trigHalf (F.add (S.cos u) (S.cos v)))
          (trigHalf (F.add (S.cos u) (S.cos v))) := by
          rw [hp]
    _ = F.add (S.cos u) (S.cos v) := by
          exact trigHalf_add_self (F.add (S.cos u) (S.cos v))

name: sub_sub_add_eq_neg_add_self
statement:
private theorem sub_sub_add_eq_neg_add_self
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.sub (F.sub a b) (F.add a b) =
      F.neg (F.add b b)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.sub (F.sub a b) (F.add a b) =
        F.neg (F.sub (F.add a b) (F.sub a b)) := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
            F (F.add a b) (F.sub a b)
    _ = F.neg (F.add b b) := by
          rw [add_add_sub_sub_eq_add_self F a b]

name: cos_sub_cos_eq_neg_two_sin_half_sum_sin_half_diff
statement:
theorem cos_sub_cos_eq_neg_two_sin_half_sum_sin_half_diff
    (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (S.cos u) (S.cos v) =
      RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul
            (S.sin (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v)))
            (S.sin (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v))))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (S.sin (trigHalf (RealTheory.add u v)))
            (S.sin (trigHalf (RealTheory.sub u v)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a := trigHalf (F.add u v)
  let b := trigHalf (F.sub u v)
  let A := F.mul (S.cos a) (S.cos b)
  let B := F.mul (S.sin a) (S.sin b)
  have hab : F.add a b = u := by
    unfold a b
    exact add_half_sum_half_diff_eq_left u v
  have hsub : F.sub a b = v := by
    unfold a b
    exact sub_half_sum_half_diff_eq_right u v
  have hadd := cos_add S a b
  have hsubTrig := cos_sub S a b
  change S.cos (F.add a b) = F.sub A B at hadd
  change S.cos (F.sub a b) = F.add A B at hsubTrig
  have hcosU : S.cos u = F.sub A B := by
    rw [<- hab]
    exact hadd
  have hcosV : S.cos v = F.add A B := by
    rw [<- hsub]
    exact hsubTrig
  change F.sub (S.cos u) (S.cos v) = F.neg (F.add B B)
  rw [hcosU, hcosV]
  exact sub_sub_add_eq_neg_add_self F A B

name: sin_sq_half_eq_half_one_sub_cos
statement:
theorem sin_sq_half_eq_half_one_sub_cos
    (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul
      (S.sin (trigHalf x)) (S.sin (trigHalf x)) =
      trigHalf (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (S.cos x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := trigHalf x
  let s2 := F.mul (S.sin h) (S.sin h)
  have hdouble : F.add h h = x := by
    unfold h
    change RealTheory.add (trigHalf x) (trigHalf x) = x
    exact trigHalf_add_self x
  have hcos := cos_add_self_one_sub_two_sin_sq S h
  change S.cos (F.add h h) = F.sub F.one (F.add s2 s2) at hcos
  rw [hdouble] at hcos
  have htwice :
      F.add s2 s2 = F.sub F.one (S.cos x) := by
    calc
      F.add s2 s2 =
          F.sub F.one (F.sub F.one (F.add s2 s2)) := by
          exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub
            F F.one (F.add s2 s2)).symm
      _ = F.sub F.one (S.cos x) := by
          rw [<- hcos]
  change s2 = trigHalf (F.sub F.one (S.cos x))
  exact eq_trigHalf_of_add_self_eq htwice

name: cos_sq_half_eq_half_one_add_cos
statement:
theorem cos_sq_half_eq_half_one_add_cos
    (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul
      (S.cos (trigHalf x)) (S.cos (trigHalf x)) =
      trigHalf (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (S.cos x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := trigHalf x
  let c2 := F.mul (S.cos h) (S.cos h)
  have hdouble : F.add h h = x := by
    unfold h
    change RealTheory.add (trigHalf x) (trigHalf x) = x
    exact trigHalf_add_self x
  have hcos := cos_add_self_two_cos_sq_sub_one S h
  change S.cos (F.add h h) = F.sub (F.add c2 c2) F.one at hcos
  rw [hdouble] at hcos
  have htwice :
      F.add c2 c2 = F.add F.one (S.cos x) := by
    calc
      F.add c2 c2 =
          F.add (F.sub (F.add c2 c2) F.one) F.one := by
          exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
            F (F.add c2 c2) F.one).symm
      _ = F.add (S.cos x) F.one := by
          rw [<- hcos]
      _ = F.add F.one (S.cos x) := by
          rw [F.add_comm]
  change c2 = trigHalf (F.add F.one (S.cos x))
  exact eq_trigHalf_of_add_self_eq htwice

name: inverseBaseJet_eqUpTo_constantPlusPositiveSeries
statement:
private theorem inverseBaseJet_eqUpTo_constantPlusPositiveSeries
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (N : Nat) :
    _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (InverseBaseJet D x N)
      (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.constantPlusPositiveSeries
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (N := N) (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x))
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      rw [inverseBaseJet_coeff]
      rw [inverseJetCoeff_zero]
      rw [Formal.Bell.Ordinary.constantPlusPositive_coeff_zero]
  | succ j =>
      rw [inverseBaseJet_coeff]
      rw [Formal.Bell.Ordinary.constantPlusPositive_coeff_succ]
      unfold inverseJetCoeff inverseTailCoeff
      have hidx : j + 1 + 1 = j + 2 := by
        omega
      rw [hidx]

name: eqUpTo_pow_reciprocalPowerAtPrecision
statement:
private theorem eqUpTo_pow_reciprocalPowerAtPrecision
    (a0 : Point) (c : Nat -> Point) (N r : Nat) :
    _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.reciprocalSeries
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (N := N) a0 c) r)
      (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.reciprocalPowerAtPrecision
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base a0 c (N := N) r)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      exact _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_refl
        (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.one
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base)
  | succ r ih =>
      rw [_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow_succ]
      rw [Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.reciprocalPowerAtPrecision_succ]
      exact _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans
        (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base ih
          (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_refl
            (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.reciprocalSeries
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (N := N) a0 c)))
        (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_comm
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.reciprocalPowerAtPrecision
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base a0 c (N := N) r)
          (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.reciprocalSeries
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (N := N) a0 c))

name: inverseRawCoeff_eq_ordinaryBellCoeff
statement:
private theorem inverseRawCoeff_eq_ordinaryBellCoeff
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (n - 1)))
        ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
            (InverseBaseJet D x n)) n).coeff (n - 1)) =
      inverseOrdinaryBellCoeff D x n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      omega
  | succ m =>
      unfold inverseOrdinaryBellCoeff
      change
        RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
            ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                (InverseBaseJet D x (m + 1))) (m + 1)).coeff m) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
            (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.closedCoeff
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x) m m)
      congr 1
      have hbase :=
        inverseBaseJet_eqUpTo_constantPlusPositiveSeries D x (m + 1)
      have hrec :
          _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
              (InverseBaseJet D x (m + 1)))
            (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.reciprocalSeries
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (N := m + 1) (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x)) :=
        _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_reciprocal
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hbase
      have hpow :
          _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                (InverseBaseJet D x (m + 1))) (m + 1))
            (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.reciprocalSeries
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                (N := m + 1) (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x))
              (m + 1)) :=
        _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_pow
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hrec (m + 1)
      have horient :=
        eqUpTo_pow_reciprocalPowerAtPrecision
          (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x) (m + 1) (m + 1)
      have hcoeff :
          _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                (InverseBaseJet D x (m + 1))) (m + 1))
            (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.reciprocalPowerAtPrecision
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x)
              (N := m + 1) (m + 1)) :=
        _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans hpow horient
      calc
        ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
              (InverseBaseJet D x (m + 1))) (m + 1)).coeff m) =
            (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.reciprocalPowerAtPrecision
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x)
              (N := m + 1) (m + 1)).coeff m := by
          exact hcoeff m (by omega)
        _ =
            Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.closedCoeff
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x) m m := by
          change
            Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x) (m + 1) m (m + 1) =
            Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.closedCoeff
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x) m m
          exact
            Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_succ_eq_closedCoeff
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x) (m + 1) m m

name: inverseDerivativeOrdinaryBellCoeffFormula
statement:
theorem inverseDerivativeOrdinaryBellCoeffFormula
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {n : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n)
    (hinj : RealFunction.InjectiveOn E f)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hg1 :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
        (fun y : Point =>
          RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y))))
    {x : Point} (hx : E x) (hn : 0 < n) :
    HasNthDerivWithin (RealFunction.Image E f) n
      (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) (f x)
      (inverseOrdinaryBellCoeff D x n)
proof:
:= by
  cases inverseDerivativeCoeffFormula hD hinj hD1 hg1 hx hn with
  | intro row hrow =>
      refine Exists.intro row ?_
      refine And.intro hrow.left ?_
      refine And.intro hrow.right.left ?_
      rw [hrow.right.right]
      exact inverseRawCoeff_eq_ordinaryBellCoeff D x hn

name: inverseDerivativeOrdinaryBellCoeffFormula_of_sequence
statement:
theorem inverseDerivativeOrdinaryBellCoeffFormula_of_sequence
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    (hD : HasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn E f D)
    (hinj : RealFunction.InjectiveOn E f)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hg1 :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
        (fun y : Point =>
          RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y))))
    {x : Point} (hx : E x) {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) :
    HasNthDerivWithin (RealFunction.Image E f) n
      (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) (f x)
      (inverseOrdinaryBellCoeff D x n)
proof:
:=
  inverseDerivativeOrdinaryBellCoeffFormula
    (hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_of_sequence hD n)
    hinj hD1 hg1 hx hn

name: compositionTaylorCoeff_eq_taylorCoeff
statement:
theorem compositionTaylorCoeff_eq_taylorCoeff
    {E K : Domain} {f g : Map} {Df Dg Dfg : Nat -> Map}
    {x0 : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hcluster : RealFunction.ClusterPoint E x0)
    (houter : TaylorPeanoAt K f Df (g x0) n)
    (hinner : TaylorPeanoAt E g Dg x0 n)
    (hcomp :
      TaylorPeanoAt E (RealFunction.CompFun f g) Dfg x0 n)
    (hlin : LocalLinearIncrementBoundAt E g x0)
    (hmap : LocalCompMapsIntoAt E K g x0) :
    CompositionTaylorCoeff Df Dg g x0 n =
      TaylorCoeff Dfg x0 n
proof:
:= by
  have houterJet :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt K f (g x0)
        (CompositionTaylorOuterCoeff Df g x0) n := by
    change
      TaylorJetExpansionAt K f (g x0)
        (DerivativeTaylorJetCoeff Df (g x0)) n
    exact taylorJetExpansionAt_of_taylorPeanoAt houter
  have hinnerJet :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt E g x0
        (DerivativeTaylorJetCoeff Dg x0) n :=
    taylorJetExpansionAt_of_taylorPeanoAt hinner
  have hJ :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt E
        (RealFunction.CompFun f g)
        x0
        (CompositionTaylorCoeff Df Dg g x0) n := by
    change
      TaylorJetExpansionAt E
        (RealFunction.CompFun f g)
        x0
        (TaylorJetComposeCoeff
          (CompositionTaylorOuterCoeff Df g x0)
          (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff
            (DerivativeTaylorJetCoeff Dg x0))) n
    exact
      taylorJetExpansionAt_comp
        (E := E) (K := K) (f := f) (g := g) (x0 := x0)
        (outer := CompositionTaylorOuterCoeff Df g x0)
        (inner := DerivativeTaylorJetCoeff Dg x0) (n := n)
        houterJet hinnerJet hlin hmap
  exact
    taylorJetCoeff_unique_of_taylorPeanoAt
      (E := E) (f := RealFunction.CompFun f g)
      (D := Dfg) (x0 := x0)
      (c := CompositionTaylorCoeff Df Dg g x0)
      (n := n)
      hcomp hJ hcluster n (Nat.le_refl n)

name: compositionInnerTaylorJet_eqUpTo_positiveSeries
statement:
private theorem compositionInnerTaylorJet_eqUpTo_positiveSeries
    (Dg : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) (N : Nat) :
    _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (TaylorJet
        (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff (DerivativeTaylorJetCoeff Dg x0)) N)
      (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.positiveSeries
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (N := N)
        (Formal.Bell.Exponential.ordinaryAtom
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (CompositionBellInput Dg x0)))
proof:
:= by
  intro k _hk
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      rw [taylorJet_coeff]
      rw [deltaTaylorJetCoeff_zero]
      rw [Formal.Bell.Ordinary.positiveSeries_coeff_zero]
      rfl
  | succ j =>
      rw [taylorJet_coeff]
      rw [deltaTaylorJetCoeff_succ]
      rw [Formal.Bell.Ordinary.positiveSeries_coeff_succ]
      unfold DerivativeTaylorJetCoeff
      unfold TaylorCoeff
      unfold Formal.Bell.Exponential.ordinaryAtom
      unfold CompositionBellInput
      rfl

name: eqUpTo_pow_positiveSeries_powerAtPrecision
statement:
private theorem eqUpTo_pow_positiveSeries_powerAtPrecision
    (c : Nat -> Point) (N r : Nat) :
    _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.positiveSeries
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (N := N) c) r)
      (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.powerAtPrecision
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base c (N := N) r)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      exact _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_refl
        (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.one
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base)
  | succ r ih =>
      rw [_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow_succ]
      rw [Formal.Bell.Ordinary.powerAtPrecision_succ]
      exact _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans
        (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base ih
          (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_refl
            (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.positiveSeries
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (N := N) c)))
        (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_comm
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.powerAtPrecision
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base c (N := N) r)
          (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.positiveSeries
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (N := N) c))

name: compositionInnerPowCoeff_eq_ordinaryBellCoeff
statement:
private theorem compositionInnerPowCoeff_eq_ordinaryBellCoeff
    (Dg : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) (n k : Nat) :
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
      (TaylorJet
        (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff (DerivativeTaylorJetCoeff Dg x0))
        (n + 1)) k).coeff n =
      Formal.Bell.Ordinary.coeff
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (Formal.Bell.Exponential.ordinaryAtom
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (CompositionBellInput Dg x0))
        n k
proof:
:= by
  let c : Nat -> Point :=
    Formal.Bell.Exponential.ordinaryAtom
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (CompositionBellInput Dg x0)
  have hinner :
      _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (TaylorJet
          (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff (DerivativeTaylorJetCoeff Dg x0))
          (n + 1))
        (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.positiveSeries
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (N := n + 1) c) := by
    unfold c
    exact compositionInnerTaylorJet_eqUpTo_positiveSeries Dg x0 (n + 1)
  have hpow :
      _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (TaylorJet
            (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff (DerivativeTaylorJetCoeff Dg x0))
            (n + 1)) k)
        (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.positiveSeries
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (N := n + 1) c) k) :=
    _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_pow
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hinner k
  have horient :
      _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.positiveSeries
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (N := n + 1) c) k)
        (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.powerAtPrecision
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base c (N := n + 1) k) :=
    eqUpTo_pow_positiveSeries_powerAtPrecision c (n + 1) k
  have hcoeff :
      _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (TaylorJet
            (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff (DerivativeTaylorJetCoeff Dg x0))
            (n + 1)) k)
        (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.powerAtPrecision
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base c (N := n + 1) k) :=
    _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans hpow horient
  change
    (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (TaylorJet
        (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff (DerivativeTaylorJetCoeff Dg x0))
        (n + 1)) k).coeff n =
      Formal.Bell.Ordinary.coeff
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base c n k
  calc
    (_root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (TaylorJet
          (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff (DerivativeTaylorJetCoeff Dg x0))
          (n + 1)) k).coeff n =
        (Formal.Bell.Ordinary.powerAtPrecision
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base c (N := n + 1) k).coeff n := by
      exact hcoeff n (by omega)
    _ =
        Formal.Bell.Ordinary.coeff
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base c n k := by
      change
        Formal.Bell.Ordinary.coeffAtPrecision
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base c (n + 1) n k =
        Formal.Bell.Ordinary.coeff
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base c n k
      exact Formal.Bell.Ordinary.coeffAtPrecision_eq_coeff
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base c (n + 1) n k

name: compositionTaylorCoeff_eq_ordinaryBellSum
statement:
theorem compositionTaylorCoeff_eq_ordinaryBellSum
    (Df Dg : Nat -> Map) (g : Map) (x0 : Point)

name: composition_faaDiBruno_taylorCoeff
statement:
theorem composition_faaDiBruno_taylorCoeff
    {E K : Domain} {f g : Map} {Df Dg Dfg : Nat -> Map}
    {x0 : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hcluster : RealFunction.ClusterPoint E x0)
    (houter : TaylorPeanoAt K f Df (g x0) n)
    (hinner : TaylorPeanoAt E g Dg x0 n)

      TaylorPeanoAt E (RealFunction.CompFun f g) Dfg x0 n)
    (hlin : LocalLinearIncrementBoundAt E g x0)

    TaylorCoeff Dfg x0 n =
      CompositionOrdinaryBellRhs Df Dg g x0 n
proof:
:= by

    (E := E) (K := K) (f := f) (g := g)
    (Df := Df) (Dg := Dg) (Dfg := Dfg)

name: factorial_mul_compositionOrdinaryBellTerm_eq_faaDiBrunoTerm
statement:
private theorem factorial_mul_compositionOrdinaryBellTerm_eq_faaDiBrunoTerm
    (Df Dg : Nat -> Map) (g : Map) (x0 : Point)
    (n k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
        (CompositionOrdinaryBellTerm Df Dg g x0 n k) =
      CompositionFaaDiBrunoTerm Df Dg g x0 n k
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let nf : Point := RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n)
  let kf : Point := RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k)
  let df : Point := Df k (g x0)
  let b : Point :=
    Formal.Bell.Ordinary.coeff
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (Formal.Bell.Exponential.ordinaryAtom
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (CompositionBellInput Dg x0))
      n k
  unfold CompositionOrdinaryBellTerm
  unfold CompositionFaaDiBrunoTerm
  unfold TaylorCoeff
  unfold Formal.Bell.Exponential.coeff
  change
    F.mul nf (F.mul (F.mul df (F.inv kf)) b) =
      F.mul df (F.mul (F.mul nf (F.inv kf)) b)
  calc
    F.mul nf (F.mul (F.mul df (F.inv kf)) b) =
        F.mul (F.mul nf (F.mul df (F.inv kf))) b := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul df (F.mul nf (F.inv kf))) b := by
          congr 1
          calc
            F.mul nf (F.mul df (F.inv kf)) =
                F.mul (F.mul nf df) (F.inv kf) := by
                  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
            _ = F.mul (F.mul df nf) (F.inv kf) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm nf df]
            _ = F.mul df (F.mul nf (F.inv kf)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul df (F.mul (F.mul nf (F.inv kf)) b) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: factorial_mul_compositionOrdinaryBellRhs_eq_faaDiBrunoRhs
statement:
private theorem factorial_mul_compositionOrdinaryBellRhs_eq_faaDiBrunoRhs
    (Df Dg : Nat -> Map) (g : Map) (x0 : Point)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
        (CompositionOrdinaryBellRhs Df Dg g x0 n) =
      CompositionFaaDiBrunoRhs Df Dg g x0 n
proof:
:= by
  unfold CompositionOrdinaryBellRhs
  unfold CompositionFaaDiBrunoRhs
  calc
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            CompositionOrdinaryBellTerm Df Dg g x0 n k)
          (n + 1)) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
              (CompositionOrdinaryBellTerm Df Dg g x0 n k))
          (n + 1) := by
          rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left]
    _ =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            CompositionFaaDiBrunoTerm Df Dg g x0 n k)
          (n + 1) := by
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
          intro k
          exact
            factorial_mul_compositionOrdinaryBellTerm_eq_faaDiBrunoTerm
              Df Dg g x0 n k

name: composition_faaDiBruno_of_compositeTaylorPeano
statement:
theorem composition_faaDiBruno_of_compositeTaylorPeano
    {E K : Domain} {f g : Map} {Df Dg Dfg : Nat -> Map}
    {x0 : Point} {n : Nat}
    (houter : TaylorPeanoAt K f Df (g x0) n)
    (hinner : TaylorPeanoAt E g Dg x0 n)
    (hcomp :
      TaylorPeanoAt E (RealFunction.CompFun f g) Dfg x0 n)
    (hlin : LocalLinearIncrementBoundAt E g x0)
    (hmap : LocalCompMapsIntoAt E K g x0)
    (hcluster : RealFunction.ClusterPoint E x0) :
    Dfg n x0 =
      CompositionFaaDiBrunoRhs Df Dg g x0 n
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Dfg n x0 =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
          (TaylorCoeff Dfg x0 n) := by
          exact Eq.symm (factorial_mul_taylorCoeff Dfg x0 n)
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
          (CompositionOrdinaryBellRhs Df Dg g x0 n) := by
          rw [composition_faaDiBruno_taylorCoeff
            (E := E) (K := K) (f := f) (g := g)
            (Df := Df) (Dg := Dg) (Dfg := Dfg)
            (x0 := x0) (n := n)
            hcluster houter hinner hcomp hlin hmap]
    _ = CompositionFaaDiBrunoRhs Df Dg g x0 n :=
          factorial_mul_compositionOrdinaryBellRhs_eq_faaDiBrunoRhs
            Df Dg g x0 n

name: composition_faaDiBruno
statement:
theorem composition_faaDiBruno
    {E K : Domain} {f g : Map} {Df Dg : Nat -> Map}
    {x0 : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (houterChain : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn K f Df n)
    (hinnerChain : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E g Dg n)
    (hinnerSegment : LocalSegmentWithinAt E x0)
    (houterSegment : LocalSegmentWithinAt K (g x0))
    (hcluster : RealFunction.ClusterPoint E x0)
    (hmap : RealFunction.MapsInto E K g) :
    HasNthDerivWithin E n (RealFunction.CompFun f g) x0
      (CompositionFaaDiBrunoRhs Df Dg g x0 n)
proof:
:= by
  cases
      hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_comp_exists
        houterChain hinnerChain hmap with
  | intro Dfg hDfgChain =>
      have hDfgNth :
          IsNthDerivativeWithinOn E n
            (RealFunction.CompFun f g) (Dfg n) :=
        isNthDerivativeWithinOn_of_derivativeChain n hDfgChain
      have houter : TaylorPeanoAt K f Df (g x0) n :=
        taylorPeanoAt_succ_of_derivativeChain_local
          hn houterChain houterSegment
      have hinner : TaylorPeanoAt E g Dg x0 n :=
        taylorPeanoAt_succ_of_derivativeChain_local
          hn hinnerChain hinnerSegment
      have hcomp :
          TaylorPeanoAt E (RealFunction.CompFun f g) Dfg x0 n :=
        taylorPeanoAt_succ_of_derivativeChain_local
          hn hDfgChain hinnerSegment
      have hinnerFirstOn :
          HasDerivativeWithinOn E g (Dg 1) :=
        hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hinnerChain.left
          (hinnerChain.right 0 hn)
      have hlin : LocalLinearIncrementBoundAt E g x0 :=
        localLinearIncrementBoundAt_of_hasDerivWithin
          (hinnerFirstOn x0 hinnerSegment.left)
      have hlocalMap : LocalCompMapsIntoAt E K g x0 := by
        refine Exists.intro RealTheory.one ?_
        refine And.intro RealTheory.zero_lt_one ?_
        intro h hh _hne _hsmall
        exact hmap (RealTheory.add x0 h) hh
      have hvalue :
          Dfg n x0 =
            CompositionFaaDiBrunoRhs Df Dg g x0 n :=
        composition_faaDiBruno_of_compositeTaylorPeano
          houter hinner hcomp hlin hlocalMap hcluster
      exact Exists.intro (Dfg n)
        (And.intro hDfgNth
          (And.intro hinnerSegment.left hvalue))

name: inverseJetCoeff_succ_add_euler_coeff
statement:
theorem inverseJetCoeff_succ_add_euler_coeff
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.add
        (inverseJetCoeff D x (k + 1))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
          (inverseJetCoeff D x (k + 1))) =
      shiftedDerivativeJetCoeff D x (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have ha :
      Not (RealTheory.nat (k + 1 + 1) = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero (k + 1))
  have hb :
      Not
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (k + 1)) =
          RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (Tautology.Nat.factorial_ne_zero (k + 1))
  unfold inverseJetCoeff shiftedDerivativeJetCoeff
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_succ (k + 1)]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_mul]
  let d := D (k + 2) x
  let a := RealTheory.nat (k + 1 + 1)
  let m := RealTheory.nat (k + 1)
  let b := RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (k + 1))
  have hsucc : a = F.add m F.one := by
    unfold a m
    exact RealTheory.nat_succ (k + 1)
  have hinv : F.inv (F.mul a b) = F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv b) := by
    change
      RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul a b) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv a) (RealTheory.inv b)
    exact RealTheory.inv_mul ha hb
  change
    F.add (F.mul d (F.inv (F.mul a b)))
        (F.mul m (F.mul d (F.inv (F.mul a b)))) =
      F.mul d (F.inv b)
  rw [hinv]
  let y := F.mul d (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv b))
  change F.add y (F.mul m y) = F.mul d (F.inv b)
  calc
    F.add y (F.mul m y) =
        F.add (F.mul F.one y) (F.mul m y) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.add F.one m) y := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.add m F.one) y := by
          rw [F.add_comm F.one m]
    _ = F.mul a y := by
          rw [hsucc]
    _ = F.mul a
          (F.mul d (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv b))) := by
          rfl
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv b)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul d a) (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv b)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm a d]
    _ = F.mul d (F.mul a (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv b))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc d a (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv b))]
    _ = F.mul d (F.mul (F.mul a (F.inv a)) (F.inv b)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc a (F.inv a) (F.inv b)]
    _ = F.mul d (F.mul F.one (F.inv b)) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel ha]
    _ = F.mul d (F.inv b) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: inverseBaseJet_add_euler_eq_shiftedDerivativeJet
statement:
theorem inverseBaseJet_add_euler_eq_shiftedDerivativeJet
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (N : Nat) :
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
        (InverseBaseJet D x (N + 1))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler
          (InverseBaseJet D x (N + 1))))
      (ShiftedDerivativeJet D x (N + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_add]
      rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_euler_zero]
      rw [inverseBaseJet_coeff]
      rw [shiftedDerivativeJet_coeff]
      rw [inverseJetCoeff_zero]
      rw [shiftedDerivativeJetCoeff_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
  | succ k =>
      rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_add]
      rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_euler_succ]
      rw [inverseBaseJet_coeff]
      rw [shiftedDerivativeJet_coeff]
      exact inverseJetCoeff_succ_add_euler_coeff D x k

name: eqUpTo_mul_base_reciprocalPow_succ
statement:
private theorem eqUpTo_mul_base_reciprocalPow_succ
    {N : Nat} (R : RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries N)
    (hR : RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.HasUnitConstant R)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R) (n + 1)))
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow_succ]
  let r := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R
  let q := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r n
  change
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q r))
      q
  have hAssoc :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q r))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R q) r) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_symm
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_assoc R q r)
  have hRotate :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R q) r)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R r) q) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_rotate_right R q r
  have hRec :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R r) q)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.one q) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_reciprocal R hR)
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_refl q)
  exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans hAssoc
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans hRotate
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans hRec
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_one_mul q)))

name: eqUpTo_eulerPow_rhs_reassociate
statement:
private theorem eqUpTo_eulerPow_rhs_reassociate
    {N : Nat} (R : RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (N + 1))
    (hR : RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.HasUnitConstant R)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler R)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R) (n + 1))))
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R) n)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow_succ]
  let r := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R
  let q := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r n
  let ER := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler R
  let A :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER r))
  change
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q r)))
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler q))
  have hAssocLeft :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q r))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER q) r) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_symm
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_assoc ER q r)
  have hCommMiddle :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER q) r)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q ER) r) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_comm ER q)
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_refl r)
  have hAssocRight :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q ER) r)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER r)) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_assoc q ER r
  have hMul :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q r))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER r)) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans hAssocLeft
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans hCommMiddle hAssocRight)
  have hScaled :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q r)))
        A :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_scale (RealTheory.nat n) hMul
  have hEuler :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler q)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg A) := by
    unfold A q r ER
    exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_euler_pow R hR n
  have hNegEulerToA :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler q))
        A :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_neg hEuler)
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_neg_neg A)
  exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans hScaled
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_symm hNegEulerToA)

name: eqUpTo_baseAddEulerKernel_eq_clean
statement:
private theorem eqUpTo_baseAddEulerKernel_eq_clean
    {N : Nat} (R : RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (N + 1))
    (hR : RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.HasUnitConstant R)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add R
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler R))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R) (n + 1))))
      (inverseCleanEulerKernel R n)
proof:
:= by
  let r := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R
  let q := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r n
  let P := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r (n + 1)
  let ER := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler R
  change
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add R ER) P))
      (inverseCleanEulerKernel R n)
  have hDistrib :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add R ER) P)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R P)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER P)) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_add_mul R ER P
  have hScaleDistrib :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add R ER) P))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R P))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER P))) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_scale
        (RealTheory.nat n) hDistrib)
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_scale_add
        (RealTheory.nat n)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R P)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER P))
  have hFirst :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R P))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n) q) := by
    unfold P q r
    exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_scale
      (RealTheory.nat n)
      (eqUpTo_mul_base_reciprocalPow_succ R hR n)
  have hSecond :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER P))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler q)) := by
    unfold P q r ER
    exact eqUpTo_eulerPow_rhs_reassociate R hR n
  have hTerms :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R P))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul ER P)))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n) q)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler q))) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_add hFirst hSecond
  have hClean :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (inverseCleanEulerKernel R n)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n) q)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler q))) := by
    unfold inverseCleanEulerKernel q r
    exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_sub_eq_add_neg
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R) n))
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R) n))
  exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans hScaleDistrib
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans hTerms
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_symm hClean))

name: inverseExpandedKernel_eq_clean
statement:
theorem inverseExpandedKernel_eq_clean
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (n N : Nat)
    (hD1 : Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (inverseExpandedKernel D x n N)
      (inverseCleanEulerKernel (InverseBaseJet D x (N + 1)) n)
proof:
:= by
  let R := InverseBaseJet D x (N + 1)
  let B :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
      (constantD1Jet D x (N + 1))
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.shiftUp
        (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x N))
  let P :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R) (n + 1)
  change
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul B P))
      (inverseCleanEulerKernel R n)
  have hBridge :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo B
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add R
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler R)) := by
    unfold B R
    exact constantD1_add_shiftUp_xDeriv_eq_base_add_euler D x N
  have hMul :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul B P)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add R
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler R)) P) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul hBridge
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_refl P)
  have hScale :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul B P))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat n)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add R
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.euler R)) P)) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_scale
      (RealTheory.nat n) hMul
  exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans hScale
    (eqUpTo_baseAddEulerKernel_eq_clean R
      (inverseBaseJet_hasUnitConstant D x (N + 1) hD1) n)

name: inverseCleanEulerKernel_coeff_zero
statement:
private theorem inverseCleanEulerKernel_coeff_zero
    {N : Nat} (R : RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (N + 1))
    (n : Nat) :
    (inverseCleanEulerKernel R n).coeff n = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold inverseCleanEulerKernel
  exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_sub_euler_self
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R) n) n

name: inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision_zero
statement:
private theorem inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision_zero
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (P : Nat) :
    inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D x P 0 =
      RealTheory.inv (D 1 x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_pow_one]
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_zero]
  rw [inverseBaseJet_coeff]
  rw [inverseJetCoeff_zero]
  change RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv (D 1 x)) =
    RealTheory.inv (D 1 x)
  rw [RealTheory.one_mul]

name: inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_zero
statement:
private theorem inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_zero
    (E : Domain) (f : Map) (D : Nat -> Map) (P : Nat) :

proof:
:=
  rfl

name: inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_succ
statement:
private theorem inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_succ
    (E : Domain) (f : Map) (D : Nat -> Map)
    (P m : Nat) :

name: inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_at_image_succ
statement:
private theorem inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_at_image_succ
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    (hinj : RealFunction.InjectiveOn E f)

    inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P (m + 1) (f x) =

proof:
