name: inverseExpandedKernel_coeff_zero_of_lt
statement:
private theorem inverseExpandedKernel_coeff_zero_of_lt
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (n N : Nat)
    (hD1 : Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hn : n < N + 1) :
    (inverseExpandedKernel D x n N).coeff n = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let R := InverseBaseJet D x (N + 1)
  have hEq :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (inverseExpandedKernel D x n N)
        (inverseCleanEulerKernel R n) := by
    unfold R
    exact inverseExpandedKernel_eq_clean D x n N hD1
  have hCoeff := hEq n hn
  rw [hCoeff]
  exact inverseCleanEulerKernel_coeff_zero R n

name: inverseJetCoeff_hasDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
private theorem inverseJetCoeff_hasDerivativeWithinOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {n : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k + 2 <= n) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (fun x : Point => inverseJetCoeff D x k)
      (fun x : Point => inverseXDerivJetCoeff D x k)
proof:
:= by
  let c :=
    RealTheory.inv
      (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (k + 1)))
  have hbase :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E (D (k + 1)) (D (k + 2)) := by
    exact hD.right (k + 1) (by omega)
  have hconst :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (ConstMulFun c (D (k + 1)))
        (ConstMulFun c (D (k + 2))) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul hbase
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (ConstMulFun c (D (k + 1)))
        (fun x : Point => inverseJetCoeff D x k) := by
    intro x hx
    unfold ConstMulFun inverseJetCoeff c
    rw [RealTheory.mul_comm]
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (ConstMulFun c (D (k + 2)))
        (fun x : Point => inverseXDerivJetCoeff D x k) := by
    intro x hx
    unfold ConstMulFun inverseXDerivJetCoeff c
    rw [RealTheory.mul_comm]
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hconst)

name: coeff_mul_hasDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
private theorem coeff_mul_hasDerivativeWithinOn
    {E : Domain} {N : Nat}
    {S Sx T Tx : Point -> RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries N}
    (k : Nat)
    (hS : forall i : Nat, i < k + 1 ->
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun x : Point => (S x).coeff i)
        (fun x : Point => (Sx x).coeff i))
    (hT : forall i : Nat, i < k + 1 ->
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun x : Point => (T x).coeff i)
        (fun x : Point => (Tx x).coeff i)) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (fun x : Point =>
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul (S x) (T x)).coeff k)
      (fun x : Point =>
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul (Sx x) (T x))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul (S x) (Tx x))).coeff k)
proof:
:= by
  let term : Nat -> Map :=
    fun i : Nat =>
      fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul ((S x).coeff i) ((T x).coeff (k - i))
  let term' : Nat -> Map :=
    fun i : Nat =>
      fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul ((Sx x).coeff i) ((T x).coeff (k - i)))
          (RealTheory.mul ((S x).coeff i) ((Tx x).coeff (k - i)))
  have hterm :
      forall i : Nat, i < k + 1 ->
        HasDerivativeWithinOn E (term i) (term' i) := by
    intro i hi
    unfold term term'
    change HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (RealFunction.MulFun
        (fun x : Point => (S x).coeff i)
        (fun x : Point => (T x).coeff (k - i)))
      (RealFunction.AddFun
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (fun x : Point => (Sx x).coeff i)
          (fun x : Point => (T x).coeff (k - i)))
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (fun x : Point => (S x).coeff i)
          (fun x : Point => (Tx x).coeff (k - i))))
    exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_mul
      (hS i hi)
      (hT (k - i) (by omega))
  have hsum :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => term i x) (k + 1))
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => term' i x) (k + 1)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum (k + 1) hterm
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => term i x) (k + 1))
        (fun x : Point =>
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul (S x) (T x)).coeff k) := by
    intro x hx
    unfold term
    change
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul ((S x).coeff i) ((T x).coeff (k - i)))
          (k + 1) =
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul (S x) (T x)).coeff k
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    rfl
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => term' i x) (k + 1))
        (fun x : Point =>
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul (Sx x) (T x))
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul (S x) (Tx x))).coeff k) := by
    intro x hx
    unfold term'
    change
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul ((Sx x).coeff i) ((T x).coeff (k - i)))
              (RealTheory.mul ((S x).coeff i) ((Tx x).coeff (k - i))))
          (k + 1) =
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul (Sx x) (T x))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul (S x) (Tx x))).coeff k
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_add]
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    unfold RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
    unfold _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
    rfl
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hsum)

name: coeff_mul_succ_split
statement:
private theorem coeff_mul_succ_split
    {N : Nat} (A B : RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries N) (n : Nat) :
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul A B).coeff (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (A.coeff 0) (B.coeff (n + 1)))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (A.coeff (i + 1)) (B.coeff (n - i)))
          (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  unfold RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
  unfold _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_split_first F
    (fun i : Nat => F.mul (A.coeff i) (B.coeff (n + 1 - i)))
    (n + 1)]
  change
    F.add (F.mul (A.coeff 0) (B.coeff (n + 1 - 0)))
        (F.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.mul (A.coeff (j + 1)) (B.coeff (n + 1 - (j + 1))))
          (n + 1)) =
      F.add (F.mul (A.coeff 0) (B.coeff (n + 1)))
        (F.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            F.mul (A.coeff (i + 1)) (B.coeff (n - i)))
          (n + 1))
  rw [Nat.sub_zero]
  congr 1
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
  intro j
  have hidx : n + 1 - (j + 1) = n - j := by
    omega
  rw [hidx]

name: inverseReciprocalCoeff_zero_hasDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalCoeff_zero_hasDerivativeWithinOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {n : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (P : Nat) (hn : 2 <= n) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (fun x : Point =>
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
          (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))).coeff 0)
      (fun x : Point =>
        (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hraw :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (RealFunction.InvFun (D 1))
        (InvDerivativeFormula (D 1) (D 2)) := by
    exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_inv (hD.right 1 (by omega)) hD1
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (RealFunction.InvFun (D 1))
        (fun x : Point =>
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
            (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))).coeff 0) := by
    intro x hx
    unfold RealFunction.InvFun
    change
      RealTheory.inv (D 1 x) =
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
          (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))).coeff 0
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_zero]
    rw [inverseBaseJet_coeff]
    rw [inverseJetCoeff_zero]
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (InvDerivativeFormula (D 1) (D 2))
        (fun x : Point =>
          (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff 0) := by
    intro x hx
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    unfold InvDerivativeFormula
    change
      RealTheory.neg
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (D 2 x) (RealTheory.inv (D 1 x)))
            (RealTheory.inv (D 1 x))) =
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
              (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)))
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
              (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1))
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)))))).coeff 0
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_neg]
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    unfold RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
    unfold _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
    rw [Nat.zero_add]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_one F]
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_zero]
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    unfold RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
    unfold _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
    rw [Nat.zero_sub]
    rw [Nat.zero_add]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_one F]
    rw [Nat.zero_sub]
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_zero]
    rw [inverseBaseJet_coeff]
    rw [inverseBaseJetXDeriv_coeff]
    rw [inverseJetCoeff_zero]
    unfold inverseXDerivJetCoeff
    rw [Nat.zero_add]
    rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_one]
    rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
    change
      F.neg
          (F.mul (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv (D 1 x)))
            (F.inv (D 1 x))) =
        F.neg
          (F.mul (F.inv (D 1 x))
            (F.mul
              (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv F.one))
              (F.inv (D 1 x))))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F]
    rw [F.mul_one]
    congr 1
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv (D 1 x)))
          (F.inv (D 1 x)) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.inv (D 1 x)) (D 2 x))
            (F.inv (D 1 x)) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (D 2 x) (F.inv (D 1 x))]
      _ =
          F.mul (F.inv (D 1 x))
            (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv (D 1 x))) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hraw)

name: inverseReciprocalTailSum_hasDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalTailSum_hasDerivativeWithinOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {N : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D N)
    (P n : Nat)
    (hn : n + 3 <= N)
    (hRec : forall j : Nat, j < n + 1 ->
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P j)
        (fun x : Point =>
          (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff j)) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalTailSum D x P n)
      (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalTailDerivativeSum D x P n)
proof:
:= by
  let term : Nat -> Map :=
    fun i : Nat =>
      fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          ((InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
          (inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n - i))
  let term' : Nat -> Map :=
    fun i : Nat =>
      fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul
            ((InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
            (inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n - i)))
          (RealTheory.mul
            ((InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
            ((inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff (n - i)))
  have hterm :
      forall i : Nat, i < n + 1 ->
        HasDerivativeWithinOn E (term i) (term' i) := by
    intro i hi
    unfold term term'
    change HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (RealFunction.MulFun
        (fun x : Point => (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
        (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n - i)))
      (RealFunction.AddFun
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (fun x : Point =>
            (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
          (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n - i)))
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (fun x : Point =>
            (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
          (fun x : Point =>
            (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff (n - i))))
    have hR :
        HasDerivativeWithinOn E
          (fun x : Point =>
            (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
          (fun x : Point =>
            (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1)) := by
      exact inverseJetCoeff_hasDerivativeWithinOn hD (i + 1)
        (by omega)
    exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_mul hR
      (hRec (n - i) (by omega))
  have hsum :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => term i x) (n + 1))
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => term' i x) (n + 1)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum (n + 1) hterm
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => term i x) (n + 1))
        (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalTailSum D x P n) := by
    intro x hx
    unfold inverseReciprocalTailSum term
    rfl
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => term' i x) (n + 1))
        (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalTailDerivativeSum D x P n) := by
    intro x hx
    unfold inverseReciprocalTailDerivativeSum term'
    rfl
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hsum)

name: inverseReciprocalCoeffAt_zero_hasDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalCoeffAt_zero_hasDerivativeWithinOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {n : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (P : Nat) (hn : 2 <= n) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P 0)
      (fun x : Point =>
        (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold inverseReciprocalCoeffAt
  exact inverseReciprocalCoeff_zero_hasDerivativeWithinOn hD hD1 P hn

name: inverseReciprocalCoeffAt_succ
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalCoeffAt_succ
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (P n : Nat) :
    inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul (inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P 0)
          (inverseReciprocalTailSum D x P n))
proof:
:= by
  unfold inverseReciprocalCoeffAt inverseReciprocalTailSum
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_zero]
  unfold inverseReciprocalCoeffAt
  rfl

name: inverseReciprocalCoeff_succ_rawDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalCoeff_succ_rawDerivativeWithinOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {N : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D N)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (P n : Nat)
    (hn : n + 3 <= N)
    (hRec : forall j : Nat, j < n + 1 ->
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P j)
        (fun x : Point =>
          (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff j)) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n + 1))
      (fun x : Point =>
        inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative D x P n)
proof:
:= by
  let r0 : Map :=
    fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P 0
  let r0x : Map :=
    fun x : Point =>
      (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff 0
  let tail : Map :=
    fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalTailSum D x P n
  let tailx : Map :=
    fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalTailDerivativeSum D x P n
  have hr0 :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E r0 r0x := by
    unfold r0 r0x
    exact inverseReciprocalCoeffAt_zero_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      hD hD1 P (by omega)
  have htail :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E tail tailx := by
    unfold tail tailx
    exact inverseReciprocalTailSum_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      hD P n hn hRec
  have hprod :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (RealFunction.MulFun r0 tail)
        (RealFunction.AddFun
          (RealFunction.MulFun r0x tail)
          (RealFunction.MulFun r0 tailx)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_mul hr0 htail
  have hneg :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (RealFunction.NegFun (RealFunction.MulFun r0 tail))
        (RealFunction.NegFun
          (RealFunction.AddFun
            (RealFunction.MulFun r0x tail)
            (RealFunction.MulFun r0 tailx))) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_neg hprod
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (RealFunction.NegFun (RealFunction.MulFun r0 tail))
        (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n + 1)) := by
    intro x hx
    unfold RealFunction.NegFun RealFunction.MulFun
    unfold r0 tail inverseReciprocalCoeffAt inverseReciprocalTailSum
    change
      RealTheory.neg
          (RealTheory.mul
            ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
              (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))).coeff 0)
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun i : Nat =>
                RealTheory.mul
                  ((InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
                  ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                    (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))).coeff (n - i)))
              (n + 1))) =
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
          (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))).coeff (n + 1)
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_succ]
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_zero]
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (RealFunction.NegFun
          (RealFunction.AddFun
            (RealFunction.MulFun r0x tail)
            (RealFunction.MulFun r0 tailx)))
        (fun x : Point =>
          inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative D x P n) := by
    intro x hx
    unfold RealFunction.NegFun RealFunction.AddFun RealFunction.MulFun
    unfold r0 r0x tail tailx inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative
    rfl
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hneg)

name: inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet_coeff_zero_base_mul
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet_coeff_zero_base_mul
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (P : Nat)
    (hD1 : Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        ((InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff 0)
        ((inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff 0) =
      RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul
          ((InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)).coeff 0)
          (inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P 0))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold inverseReciprocalCoeffAt
  rw [inverseBaseJet_coeff]
  rw [inverseJetCoeff_zero]
  rw [inverseBaseJetXDeriv_coeff]
  unfold inverseXDerivJetCoeff
  rw [Nat.zero_add]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_one]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
  change
    F.mul (D 1 x)
        ((inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff 0) =
      F.neg
        (F.mul (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv F.one))
          ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
            (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))).coeff 0))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F]
  rw [F.mul_one]
  change
    F.mul (D 1 x)
        ((inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff 0) =
      F.neg
        (F.mul (D 2 x)
          ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
            (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))).coeff 0))
  unfold inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_neg]
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  unfold RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
  unfold _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
  rw [Nat.zero_add]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_one F]
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  unfold RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
  unfold _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
  rw [Nat.zero_sub]
  rw [Nat.zero_add]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_one F]
  rw [Nat.zero_sub]
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_zero]
  rw [inverseBaseJet_coeff]
  rw [inverseBaseJetXDeriv_coeff]
  rw [inverseJetCoeff_zero]
  unfold inverseXDerivJetCoeff
  rw [Nat.zero_add]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_one]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
  change
    F.mul (D 1 x)
      (F.neg
        (F.mul (F.inv (D 1 x))
          (F.mul (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv F.one))
            (F.inv (D 1 x))))) =
      F.neg (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv (D 1 x)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F]
  rw [F.mul_one]
  change
    F.mul (D 1 x)
      (F.neg
        (F.mul (F.inv (D 1 x))
          (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv (D 1 x))))) =
      F.neg
        (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv (D 1 x)))
  calc
    F.mul (D 1 x)
        (F.neg
          (F.mul (F.inv (D 1 x))
            (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv (D 1 x))))) =
        F.neg
          (F.mul (D 1 x)
            (F.mul (F.inv (D 1 x))
              (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv (D 1 x))))) := by
          rw [F.mul_neg]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.mul (F.mul (D 1 x) (F.inv (D 1 x)))
            (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv (D 1 x)))) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.mul F.one
            (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv (D 1 x)))) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hD1]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.mul (D 2 x) (F.inv (D 1 x))) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivative_unit_equation
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivative_unit_equation
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (P : Nat)
    (hD1 : Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))
          (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
            (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)))))
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.zero
proof:
:= by
  let R := InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)
  let Rx := InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)
  let r := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R
  let A := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul Rx r
  have hunit :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R r)
        RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.one := by
    exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_reciprocal R
      (inverseBaseJet_hasUnitConstant D x (P + 1) hD1)
  have hmulA :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R r) A)
        A := by
    exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul hunit
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_refl A))
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_one_mul A)
  have hassoc :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul r A))
        A := by
    exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_symm
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_assoc R r A))
      hmulA
  have hneg :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul R
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul r A)))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg A) := by
    exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_neg_right R
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul r A))
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_neg hassoc)
  intro k hk
  have hkneg := hneg k hk
  change
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
      (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))
      (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P)).coeff k =
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
            (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))))).coeff k at hkneg
  change
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
        (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))
        (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P))
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
        (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
          (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))))).coeff k =
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.zero.coeff k
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_add]
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_zero]
  rw [hkneg]
  change
    RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.neg
        ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
            (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)))).coeff k))
      ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
        (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
          (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)))).coeff k) =
      RealTheory.zero
  rw [RealTheory.neg_add]

name: inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivative_unit_equation_succ_split
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivative_unit_equation_succ_split
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (P n : Nat)
    (hD1 : Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero)) (hn : n < P) :
    RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          ((InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff 0)
          ((inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff (n + 1)))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              ((InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
              ((inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff (n - i)))
          (n + 1)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          ((InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)).coeff 0)
          (inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n + 1)))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              ((InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
              (inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n - i)))
          (n + 1))) =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivative_unit_equation D x P hD1
      (n + 1) (by omega)
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_add] at h
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_zero] at h
  rw [coeff_mul_succ_split
    (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))
    (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P) n] at h
  rw [coeff_mul_succ_split
    (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1))
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
      (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) n] at h
  unfold inverseReciprocalCoeffAt
  exact h

name: inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivative_base_mul_succ
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivative_base_mul_succ
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (P n : Nat)
    (hD1 : Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero)) (hn : n < P) :
    RealTheory.mul
        ((InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff 0)
        ((inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff (n + 1)) =
      RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul
            ((InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)).coeff 0)
            (inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n + 1)))
          (inverseReciprocalTailDerivativeSum D x P n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a :=
    F.mul
      ((InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff 0)
      ((inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff (n + 1))
  let b :=
    F.mul
      ((InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)).coeff 0)
      (inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n + 1))
  let tailR :=
    F.finiteSum
      (fun i : Nat =>
        F.mul ((InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
          ((inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff (n - i)))
      (n + 1)
  let tailRx :=
    F.finiteSum
      (fun i : Nat =>
        F.mul ((InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
          (inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n - i)))
      (n + 1)
  have hsplit :
      F.add (F.add a tailR) (F.add b tailRx) = F.zero := by
    unfold a b tailR tailRx
    exact inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivative_unit_equation_succ_split
      D x P n hD1 hn
  have htail :
      inverseReciprocalTailDerivativeSum D x P n =
        F.add tailRx tailR := by
    unfold inverseReciprocalTailDerivativeSum tailRx tailR
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
    rfl
  have hzero :
      F.add a
        (F.add b (inverseReciprocalTailDerivativeSum D x P n)) =
        F.zero := by
    rw [htail]
    calc
      F.add a (F.add b (F.add tailRx tailR)) =
          F.add a (F.add (F.add b tailRx) tailR) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc b tailRx tailR]
      _ = F.add a (F.add tailR (F.add b tailRx)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm (F.add b tailRx) tailR]
      _ = F.add (F.add a tailR) (F.add b tailRx) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc a tailR (F.add b tailRx)]
      _ = F.zero := hsplit
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right F hzero

name: inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative_base_mul
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative_base_mul
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (P n : Nat)
    (hD1 : Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        ((InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff 0)
        (inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative D x P n) =
      RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul
            ((InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)).coeff 0)
            (inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n + 1)))
          (inverseReciprocalTailDerivativeSum D x P n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let R0 := (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff 0
  let Rx0 := (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)).coeff 0
  let c0 := (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff 0
  let r0 := inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P 0
  let tail := inverseReciprocalTailSum D x P n
  let tailx := inverseReciprocalTailDerivativeSum D x P n
  have hc0 :
      F.mul R0 c0 = F.neg (F.mul Rx0 r0) := by
    unfold R0 Rx0 c0 r0
    exact inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet_coeff_zero_base_mul
      D x P hD1
  have hr0cancel : F.mul R0 r0 = F.one := by
    unfold R0 r0 inverseReciprocalCoeffAt
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_zero]
    exact F.mul_inv_cancel
      (inverseBaseJet_hasUnitConstant D x (P + 1) hD1)
  have hrnext :
      inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n + 1) =
        F.neg (F.mul r0 tail) := by
    unfold r0 tail
    exact inverseReciprocalCoeffAt_succ D x P n
  change
    F.mul R0
        (F.neg (F.add (F.mul c0 tail) (F.mul r0 tailx))) =
      F.neg
        (F.add
          (F.mul Rx0 (inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n + 1)))
          tailx)
  calc
    F.mul R0
        (F.neg (F.add (F.mul c0 tail) (F.mul r0 tailx))) =
        F.neg
          (F.mul R0
            (F.add (F.mul c0 tail) (F.mul r0 tailx))) := by
          rw [F.mul_neg]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.add
            (F.mul R0 (F.mul c0 tail))
            (F.mul R0 (F.mul r0 tailx))) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.add
            (F.mul (F.mul R0 c0) tail)
            (F.mul (F.mul R0 r0) tailx)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc R0 c0 tail]
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc R0 r0 tailx]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.add
            (F.mul (F.neg (F.mul Rx0 r0)) tail)
            (F.mul F.one tailx)) := by
          rw [hc0]
          rw [hr0cancel]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.add
            (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul Rx0 r0) tail))
            tailx) := by
          rw [F.neg_mul]
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.add
            (F.neg (F.mul Rx0 (F.mul r0 tail)))
            tailx) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc Rx0 r0 tail]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.add
            (F.mul Rx0 (inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n + 1)))
            tailx) := by
          rw [hrnext]
          rw [F.mul_neg]

name: inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative_eq_closed
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative_eq_closed
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (P n : Nat)
    (hD1 : Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero)) (hn : n < P) :
    inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative D x P n =
      (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let R0 := (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff 0
  have hR0 : Not (R0 = F.zero) := by
    unfold R0
    exact inverseBaseJet_hasUnitConstant D x (P + 1) hD1
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero F
    (x := R0) hR0
  unfold R0
  change
    RealTheory.mul ((InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff 0)
        (inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative D x P n) =
      RealTheory.mul ((InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)).coeff 0)
        ((inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff (n + 1))
  rw [inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative_base_mul D x P n hD1]
  rw [inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivative_base_mul_succ D x P n hD1 hn]

name: inverseReciprocalCoeff_hasDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalCoeff_hasDerivativeWithinOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {N : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D N)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (P : Nat) :
    forall k : Nat, k < P + 1 -> k + 2 <= N ->
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P k)
        (fun x : Point =>
          (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff k)
  | 0, _, hkN =>
      inverseReciprocalCoeffAt_zero_hasDerivativeWithinOn hD hD1 P hkN
  | n + 1, hk, hkN => by
      have hn : n < P
proof:
:= by
        omega
      have hRec : forall j : Nat, j < n + 1 ->
          HasDerivativeWithinOn E
            (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P j)
            (fun x : Point =>
              (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff j) := by
        intro j hj
        exact inverseReciprocalCoeff_hasDerivativeWithinOn
          hD hD1 P j (by omega) (by omega)
      have hraw :
          HasDerivativeWithinOn E
            (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P (n + 1))
            (fun x : Point =>
              inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative D x P n) :=
        inverseReciprocalCoeff_succ_rawDerivativeWithinOn
          hD hD1 P n (by omega) hRec
      have hsame :
          RealFunction.SameOn E
            (fun x : Point =>
              inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative D x P n)
            (fun x : Point =>
              (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff
                (n + 1)) := by
        intro x hx
        exact inverseReciprocalCoeffSuccRawDerivative_eq_closed
          D x P n (hD1 x hx) hn
      exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hsame hraw

name: inverseReciprocalPowerDerivative_step_eq_closed
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalPowerDerivative_step_eq_closed
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (P q : Nat) :
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (inverseReciprocalPowerDerivativeJet D x P q)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
            (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
              (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) q)
          (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P)))
      (inverseReciprocalPowerDerivativeJet D x P (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let R := InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)
  let Rx := InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)
  let r := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal R
  let A := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul Rx r
  change
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat q)
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) A)))
          r)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul r A))))
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
          (RealTheory.nat (q + 1))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r (q + 1)) A)))
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow_succ]
  have hterm1 :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat q)
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) A)))
          r)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat q)
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) r) A))) := by
    have h1 :
        RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat q)
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) A)))
            r)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat q)
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) A))
              r)) :=
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_neg_left
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat q)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) A)) r
    have h2 :
        RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat q)
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) A))
              r))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat q)
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) A) r))) :=
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_neg
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_scale_left
          (RealTheory.nat q)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) A) r)
    have h3 :
        RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat q)
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) A) r)))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat q)
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) r) A))) :=
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_neg
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_scale (RealTheory.nat q)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_rotate_right
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) A r))
    exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans h1
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans h2 h3)
  have hterm2 :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul r A)))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) r) A)) := by
    have h1 :
        RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q)
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul r A)))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q)
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul r A))) :=
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_neg_right
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul r A)
    have h2 :
        RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q)
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul r A)))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) r) A)) :=
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_neg
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_symm
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_assoc
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) r A))
    exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans h1 h2
  have hadd :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat q)
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) A)))
            r)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q)
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul r A))))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat q)
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) r) A)))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) r) A))) :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_add hterm1 hterm2
  exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans hadd
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_add_neg_scale_nat_neg_self q
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r q) r) A))

name: inverseReciprocalPowerCoeff_hasDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalPowerCoeff_hasDerivativeWithinOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {N : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D N)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (P q : Nat) :
    forall k : Nat, k < P + 1 -> k + 2 <= N ->
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun x : Point =>
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
              (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) q).coeff k)
        (fun x : Point =>
          (inverseReciprocalPowerDerivativeJet D x P q).coeff k)
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero =>
      intro k hk _hkN
      have hconst :
          HasDerivativeWithinOn E
            (fun _ : Point =>
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.one :
                RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (P + 1)).coeff k)
            (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero) :=
        hasDerivativeWithinOn_const E
          ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.one :
            RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (P + 1)).coeff k)
      have hleft :
          RealFunction.SameOn E
            (fun _ : Point =>
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.one :
                RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (P + 1)).coeff k)
            (fun x : Point =>
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                  (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) 0).coeff k) := by
        intro x hx
        change
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.one :
              RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (P + 1)).coeff k =
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) 0).coeff k
        rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow_zero]
      have hright :
          RealFunction.SameOn E
            (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
            (fun x : Point =>
              (inverseReciprocalPowerDerivativeJet D x P 0).coeff k) := by
        intro x hx
        change
          RealTheory.zero =
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat 0)
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                      (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) 0)
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                    (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1))
                    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                      (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))))))).coeff k
        rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_neg]
        rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_scale]
        rw [RealTheory.nat_zero]
        change
          RealTheory.zero =
            RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
                ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                      (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) 0)
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                    (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1))
                    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                      (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))))).coeff k))
        rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
        rw [RealTheory.neg_zero]
      exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
        (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hconst)
  | succ q ih =>
      intro k hk hkN
      let Rfun : Point -> RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (P + 1) :=
        fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
            (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))
      let Qfun : Point -> RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (P + 1) :=
        fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow (Rfun x) q
      let Qxfun : Point -> RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (P + 1) :=
        fun x : Point =>
          inverseReciprocalPowerDerivativeJet D x P q
      let Rxfun : Point -> RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (P + 1) :=
        fun x : Point =>
          inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P
      have hmul :
          HasDerivativeWithinOn E
            (fun x : Point =>
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                (Qfun x) (Rfun x)).coeff k)
            (fun x : Point =>
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (Qxfun x) (Rfun x))
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (Qfun x) (Rxfun x))).coeff k) := by
        apply coeff_mul_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        · intro i hi
          unfold Qfun Qxfun Rfun
          exact ih i (by omega) (by omega)
        · intro i hi
          unfold Rfun Rxfun
          change
            HasDerivativeWithinOn E
              (fun x : Point => inverseReciprocalCoeffAt D x P i)
              (fun x : Point =>
                (inverseReciprocalCoeffDerivativeJet D x P).coeff i)
          exact inverseReciprocalCoeff_hasDerivativeWithinOn
            hD hD1 P i (by omega) (by omega)
      have hleft :
          RealFunction.SameOn E
            (fun x : Point =>
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                (Qfun x) (Rfun x)).coeff k)
            (fun x : Point =>
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                  (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (q + 1)).coeff k) := by
        intro x hx
        unfold Qfun Rfun
        change
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) q)
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
              (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1)))).coeff k =
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (q + 1)).coeff k
        rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow_succ]
      have hright :
          RealFunction.SameOn E
            (fun x : Point =>
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (Qxfun x) (Rfun x))
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (Qfun x) (Rxfun x))).coeff k)
            (fun x : Point =>
              (inverseReciprocalPowerDerivativeJet D x P (q + 1)).coeff k) := by
        intro x hx
        unfold Qfun Qxfun Rfun Rxfun
        exact inverseReciprocalPowerDerivative_step_eq_closed
          D x P q k hk
      exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
        (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hmul)

name: inverseReciprocalPowerCoeff_diag_hasDerivativeWithinOn
statement:

name: inverseReciprocalPowerDerivativeJet_diag_coeff_shape
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalPowerDerivativeJet_diag_coeff_shape
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) {P m : Nat} (hm : m < P) :
    (inverseReciprocalPowerDerivativeJet D x P (m + 1)).coeff m =
      RealTheory.neg
        ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
          (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.shiftUp
              (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x P))
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (m + 2)))).coeff
          (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let r :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
      (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))
  let q := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r (m + 1)
  let Rx := InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x (P + 1)
  let RxShort := InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x P
  let A := RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul Rx r
  have hpow :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r (m + 2) =
        RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q r := by
    unfold q
    change
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r ((m + 1) + 1) =
        RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r (m + 1)) r
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow_succ]
  have hleftEq :
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q A).coeff m =
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul Rx
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r (m + 2))).coeff m := by
    have h1 :
        RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q A)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul r Rx)) := by
      unfold A
      exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_refl q)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_comm Rx r)
    have h2 :
        RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul r Rx))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q r) Rx) :=
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_symm
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_assoc q r Rx)
    have h3 :
        RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q r) Rx)
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul Rx
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q r)) :=
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_mul_comm
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q r) Rx
    have h :=
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans h1
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans h2 h3)
    have hcoeff := h m (by omega)
    rw [hpow]
    exact hcoeff
  have htruncate :
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul RxShort
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.truncate
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r (m + 2)))).coeff m =
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul Rx
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r (m + 2))).coeff m := by
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    unfold RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
    unfold _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro i
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_truncate]
    rfl
  change
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.neg
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
        (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul q A))).coeff m =
      RealTheory.neg
        ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
          (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.shiftUp RxShort)
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow r (m + 2)))).coeff
          (m + 1))
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_neg]
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_scale]
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_scale]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul_shiftUp_left_succ]
  rw [htruncate]
  exact hleftEq

name: inverseReciprocalPowerCoeff_rawDerivative
statement:
private theorem inverseReciprocalPowerCoeff_rawDerivative
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {N : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D N)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))

        RealTheory.neg
          ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale

                (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x P))

                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal

        (fun x : Point =>

        (fun x : Point =>
          (inverseReciprocalPowerDerivativeJet D x P (m + 1)).coeff m) :=

  have hsame :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (fun x : Point =>

            ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale

name: constantD1_mul_coeff_succ
statement:
private theorem constantD1_mul_coeff_succ
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (P m : Nat)
    (Q : RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (P + 1)) :
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
      (constantD1Jet D x (P + 1)) Q).coeff (m + 1) =
      RealTheory.mul (D 1 x) (Q.coeff (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul_succ_split]
  rw [constantD1Jet_coeff_zero]
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            ((constantD1Jet D x (P + 1)).coeff (i + 1))
            (Q.coeff (m - i)))
        (m + 1) = RealTheory.zero := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    rw [constantD1Jet_coeff_succ]
    rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  rw [hsum]
  rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

name: inverseExpandedKernel_raw_shift_neg_eq_constant_part
statement:
private theorem inverseExpandedKernel_raw_shift_neg_eq_constant_part
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) {P m : Nat}
    (hD1 : Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero)) (hm : m < P) :
    RealTheory.neg
      ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
        (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.shiftUp
            (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x P))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
              (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (m + 2)))).coeff
        (m + 1)) =
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
        (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (constantD1Jet D x (P + 1))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
              (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (m + 2)))).coeff
        (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let C := constantD1Jet D x (P + 1)
  let B :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.shiftUp
      (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x P)
  let Q :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
        (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (m + 2)
  have hzero :=
    inverseExpandedKernel_coeff_zero_of_lt D x (m + 1) P hD1
      (by omega)
  change
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add C B) Q)).coeff
      (m + 1) = RealTheory.zero at hzero
  have hsplit :
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.EqUpTo
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add C B) Q))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.add
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul C Q))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul B Q))) := by
    exact RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_trans
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_scale
        (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_add_mul C B Q))
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.eqUpTo_scale_add
        (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul C Q)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul B Q))
  have hcoeff := hsplit (m + 1) (by omega)
  rw [hcoeff] at hzero
  rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_add] at hzero
  have hconst :
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul C Q)).coeff (m + 1) =
        RealTheory.neg
          ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul B Q)).coeff (m + 1)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hzero
  change
    RealTheory.neg
      ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
        (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul B Q)).coeff
        (m + 1)) =
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
        (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul C Q)).coeff
        (m + 1)
  exact hconst.symm

name: inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision_rawDerivative_eq_recurrence_point
statement:
private theorem inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision_rawDerivative_eq_recurrence_point
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) {P m : Nat}
    (hD1 : Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero)) (hm : m < P) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
      (RealTheory.neg
        ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
          (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.shiftUp
              (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x P))
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (m + 2)))).coeff
          (m + 1))) =
      RealTheory.mul (D 1 x)
        (inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D x P (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let fact := RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)
  let step := RealTheory.nat (m + 1)
  let Rpow :=
    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
        (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (m + 2)
  let c := Rpow.coeff (m + 1)
  have hraw :=
    inverseExpandedKernel_raw_shift_neg_eq_constant_part
      D x hD1 hm
  have hrawLocal :
      F.neg
        ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
          (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.shiftUp
              (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x P))
            Rpow)).coeff (m + 1)) =
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
          (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (constantD1Jet D x (P + 1)) Rpow)).coeff
          (m + 1) := by
    unfold Rpow
    exact hraw
  have hconst :
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale step
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
          (constantD1Jet D x (P + 1)) Rpow)).coeff (m + 1) =
        RealTheory.mul step (RealTheory.mul (D 1 x) c) := by
    unfold step c Rpow
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_scale]
    rw [constantD1_mul_coeff_succ]
  unfold inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision
  change
    F.mul fact
      (F.neg
        ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
          (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.shiftUp
              (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x P))
            Rpow)).coeff (m + 1))) =
      F.mul (D 1 x)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (m + 1))) c)
  rw [hrawLocal]
  rw [hconst]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_mul]
  unfold fact step
  change
    F.mul (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
      (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1)) (F.mul (D 1 x) c)) =
      F.mul (D 1 x)
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))) c)
  calc
    F.mul (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1)) (F.mul (D 1 x) c)) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
            (RealTheory.nat (m + 1)))
          (F.mul (D 1 x) c) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)))
          (F.mul (D 1 x) c) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
            (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.mul (D 1 x) c)
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm]
    _ =
        F.mul (D 1 x)
          (F.mul c
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
              (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul (D 1 x)
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
              (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))) c) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm c
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
              (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)))]

name: inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision_hasDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
private theorem inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision_hasDerivativeWithinOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {N : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D N)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    {P m : Nat} (hm : m < P) (hmN : m + 2 <= N) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (fun x : Point => inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D x P m)
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul (D 1 x)
          (inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D x P (m + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let fact := RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)
  have hraw :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun x : Point =>
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
              (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (m + 1)).coeff m)
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.neg
            ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
              (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.shiftUp
                  (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x P))
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                    (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (m + 2)))).coeff
              (m + 1))) :=
    inverseReciprocalPowerCoeff_rawDerivative hD hD1 hm hmN
  have hscaled :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (ConstMulFun fact
          (fun x : Point =>
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (m + 1)).coeff m))
        (ConstMulFun fact
          (fun x : Point =>
            RealTheory.neg
              ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
                (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.shiftUp
                    (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x P))
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                      (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (m + 2)))).coeff
                (m + 1)))) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul hraw
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (ConstMulFun fact
          (fun x : Point =>
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (m + 1)).coeff m))
        (fun x : Point => inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D x P m) := by
    intro x hx
    unfold ConstMulFun inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision fact
    rfl
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (ConstMulFun fact
          (fun x : Point =>
            RealTheory.neg
              ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
                (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.mul
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.shiftUp
                    (InverseBaseJetXDeriv D x P))
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
                      (InverseBaseJet D x (P + 1))) (m + 2)))).coeff
                (m + 1))))
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul (D 1 x)
            (inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D x P (m + 1))) := by
    intro x hx
    unfold ConstMulFun fact
    exact inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision_rawDerivative_eq_recurrence_point
      D x (hD1 x hx) hm
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hscaled)

name: inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_chain_cancel
statement:
private theorem inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_chain_cancel
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x c : Point)
    (hD1 : Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (D 1 x) c)
        (RealTheory.inv (D 1 x)) =
      c
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (D 1 x) c) (F.inv (D 1 x)) = c
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (D 1 x) c) (F.inv (D 1 x)) =
        F.mul (F.mul c (D 1 x)) (F.inv (D 1 x)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (D 1 x) c]
    _ = F.mul c (F.mul (D 1 x) (F.inv (D 1 x))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul c F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hD1]
    _ = c := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_base_step
statement:
private theorem inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_base_step
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {P : Nat}
    (hg1 :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
        (fun y : Point =>
          RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y)))) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
      (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P 0)
      (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
        (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P 0) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_zero]
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (fun y : Point =>
          RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y)))
        (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P 1) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_succ]
    change
      RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y)) =
        inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D
          (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y) P 0
    rw [inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision_zero]
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hg1)

name: inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_step
statement:
private theorem inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_step
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {N : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D N)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hg1 :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
        (fun y : Point =>
          RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y))))
    {P m : Nat} (hm : m < P) (hmN : m + 2 <= N) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
      (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P (m + 1))
      (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P (m + 2))
proof:
:= by
  let invF := RealFunction.InverseOn E f
  let C : Map :=
    fun x : Point => inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D x P m
  let Cnext : Map :=
    fun x : Point => inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D x P (m + 1)
  let Cderiv : Map :=
    fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul (D 1 x) (Cnext x)
  let invDeriv : Map :=
    fun y : Point => RealTheory.inv (D 1 (invF y))
  have houter : HasDerivativeWithinOn E C Cderiv := by
    unfold C Cderiv Cnext
    exact inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      hD hD1 hm hmN
  have hinner : HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f) invF invDeriv := by
    unfold invF invDeriv
    exact hg1
  have hbase : RealFunction.MapsInto (RealFunction.Image E f) E invF := by
    intro y hy
    unfold invF
    exact RealFunction.inverseOn_mem hy
  have hchain :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.CompFun C invF)
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (RealFunction.CompFun Cderiv invF) invDeriv) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_comp
      (E := RealFunction.Image E f) (G := E)
      (f := invF) (g := C) (f' := invDeriv) (g' := Cderiv)
      hinner houter hbase
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.CompFun C invF)
        (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P (m + 1)) := by
    intro y hy
    unfold RealFunction.CompFun C invF
    rw [inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_succ]
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (RealFunction.CompFun Cderiv invF) invDeriv)
        (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P (m + 2)) := by
    intro y hy
    unfold RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.CompFun
    unfold Cderiv Cnext invDeriv invF
    change
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y))
          (inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D
            (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y) P (m + 1)))
        (RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y))) =
        inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D
          (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y) P (m + 1)
    exact inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_chain_cancel
      D (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y)
      (inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y) P (m + 1))
      (hD1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y)
        (RealFunction.inverseOn_mem hy))
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hchain)

name: inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_isNthDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
private theorem inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_isNthDerivativeWithinOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {N : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D N)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hg1 :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
        (fun y : Point =>
          RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y))))
    {P k : Nat} (hk : k <= P + 1) (hkN : k <= N) :
    IsNthDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f) k
      (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
      (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro y hy
      rw [inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          refine Exists.intro
            (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P 0) ?_
          have hzero :
              IsNthDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f) 0
                (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
                (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P 0) := by
            intro y hy
            rw [inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_zero]
          exact And.intro
            hzero
            (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_base_step (P := P) hg1)
      | succ m =>
          refine Exists.intro
            (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P (m + 1)) ?_
          have hprev :
              IsNthDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f) (m + 1)
                (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
                (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D P (m + 1)) :=
            ih (by omega) (by omega)
          have hm : m < P := by
            omega
          exact And.intro hprev
            (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_step hD hD1 hg1 (P := P)
              (m := m) hm (by omega))

name: inverseEulerDerivativeRows_finite
statement:
private theorem inverseEulerDerivativeRows_finite
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {n : Nat}
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hg1 :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
        (fun y : Point =>
          RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y)))) :
    IsNthDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f) n
      (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
      (inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D (n - 1) n)
proof:
:= by
  exact inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_isNthDerivativeWithinOn
    hD hD1 hg1 (P := n - 1) (k := n) (by omega) (Nat.le_refl n)

name: inverseDerivativeCoeffFormula_succ_at_image
statement:
private theorem inverseDerivativeCoeffFormula_succ_at_image
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {n : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D (n + 1))
    (hinj : RealFunction.InjectiveOn E f)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hg1 :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
        (fun y : Point =>
          RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y))))
    {x : Point} (hx : E x) :
    HasNthDerivWithin (RealFunction.Image E f) (n + 1)
      (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) (f x)
      (inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D x n n)
proof:
:= by
  let row := inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision E f D n (n + 1)
  have hrow :
      IsNthDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f) (n + 1)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) row := by
    unfold row
    exact inverseEulerDerivativeRows_finite
      (n := n + 1) (Nat.zero_lt_succ n) hD hD1 hg1
  refine Exists.intro row ?_
  refine And.intro hrow ?_
  refine And.intro (RealFunction.image_intro hx) ?_
  unfold row
  exact inverseFormulaRowsAtPrecision_at_image_succ hinj hx n n

name: inverseDerivativeCoeffFormula
statement:
theorem inverseDerivativeCoeffFormula
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {n : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n)
    (hinj : RealFunction.InjectiveOn E f)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hg1 :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
        (fun y : Point =>
          RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y))))
    {x : Point} (hx : E x) (hn : 0 < n) :
    HasNthDerivWithin (RealFunction.Image E f) n
      (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) (f x)
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (n - 1)))
        ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
            (InverseBaseJet D x n)) n).coeff (n - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      omega
  | succ m =>
      change
        HasNthDerivWithin (RealFunction.Image E f) (m + 1)
          (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) (f x)
          (inverseCoeffValueAtPrecision D x m m)
      exact inverseDerivativeCoeffFormula_succ_at_image
        hD hinj hD1 hg1 hx

statement:
theorem inverseDerivativeCoeffFormula_of_sequence
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}

    (hinj : RealFunction.InjectiveOn E f)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hg1 :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
        (fun y : Point =>
          RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y))))
    {x : Point} (hx : E x) {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) :
