      (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) (f x)
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (n - 1)))
        ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal
            (InverseBaseJet D x n)) n).coeff (n - 1)))
proof:
:=
  inverseDerivativeCoeffFormula
    (hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_of_sequence hD n)
    hinj hD1 hg1 hx hn

name: inverseBellInput_atom_eq_tail
statement:
theorem inverseBellInput_atom_eq_tail
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (j : Nat) :
    Formal.Bell.Exponential.ordinaryAtom
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (InverseBellInput D x) j =
      inverseTailCoeff D x j
proof:
:= by
  unfold Formal.Bell.Exponential.ordinaryAtom
  unfold InverseBellInput inverseTailCoeff
  rw [show j + 1 + 1 = j + 2 by omega]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_succ (j + 1)]
  rw [show j + 1 + 1 = j + 2 by omega]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_mul]
  have hleft :
      Not (RealTheory.nat (j + 2) = RealTheory.zero) := by
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hright :
      Not
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (j + 1)) =
          RealTheory.zero) := by
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (Tautology.Nat.factorial_ne_zero (j + 1))
  change
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (D (j + 2) x)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (j + 2))))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (j + 1)))) =
      RealTheory.mul (D (j + 2) x)
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (j + 2))
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (j + 1)))))
  rw [RealTheory.inv_mul hleft hright]
  rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]

        (fun k : Nat =>

proof: := rfl

name: factorial_mul_inverseClosedTerm_eq_inverseFaaTermAtDegree
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_inverseClosedTerm_eq_inverseFaaTermAtDegree
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) (m k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
        (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.closedTerm
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x) m m k) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.closedFactor
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (D 1 x) m k)
        (Formal.Bell.Exponential.scaledCoeff
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (InverseBellInput D x) m k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let nf : Point := RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)
  let a : Point :=
    Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.closedFactor F (D 1 x) m k
  let b : Point :=
    Formal.Bell.Ordinary.coeff F
      (Formal.Bell.Exponential.ordinaryAtom F
        (InverseBellInput D x))
      m k
  have htail :
      inverseTailCoeff D x =
        Formal.Bell.Exponential.ordinaryAtom F
          (InverseBellInput D x) := by
    funext j
    exact Eq.symm (inverseBellInput_atom_eq_tail D x j)
  rw [Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.closedTerm_eq_closedFactor_mul_coeff]
  rw [htail]
  change
    F.mul nf (F.mul a b) =
      F.mul a
        (Formal.Bell.Exponential.scaledCoeff F
          (InverseBellInput D x) m k)
  rw [<- Formal.Bell.Exponential.factorial_mul_ordinaryCoeff_eq_scaledCoeff
    F (InverseBellInput D x) m k]
  change F.mul nf (F.mul a b) = F.mul a (F.mul nf b)
  calc
    F.mul nf (F.mul a b) =
        F.mul (F.mul nf a) b := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a nf) b := by
          rw [F.mul_comm nf a]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul nf b) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: inverseOrdinaryBellCoeff_eq_inverseFaaDiBrunoRhs
statement:
theorem inverseOrdinaryBellCoeff_eq_inverseFaaDiBrunoRhs
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) :
    inverseOrdinaryBellCoeff D x n =
      InverseFaaDiBrunoRhs D x n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      omega
  | succ m =>
      unfold inverseOrdinaryBellCoeff
      unfold InverseFaaDiBrunoRhs
      change
        RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
            (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.closedCoeff
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x) m m) =
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              InverseFaaDiBrunoTerm D x (m + 1) k)
            (m + 1)
      unfold Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.closedCoeff
      change
        RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.closedTerm
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                  (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x) m m k)
              (m + 1)) =
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              InverseFaaDiBrunoTerm D x (m + 1) k)
            (m + 1)
      rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left]
      apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
      intro k
      change
        RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
            (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.closedTerm
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (D 1 x) (inverseTailCoeff D x) m m k) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (Formal.Bell.ReciprocalPower.closedFactor
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (D 1 x) m k)
            (Formal.Bell.Exponential.scaledCoeff
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (InverseBellInput D x) m k)
      exact factorial_mul_inverseClosedTerm_eq_inverseFaaTermAtDegree
        D x m k

name: inverse_faaDiBruno
statement:
theorem inverse_faaDiBruno
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    {n : Nat} (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n)
    (hinj : RealFunction.InjectiveOn E f)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hg1 :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
        (fun y : Point =>
          RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y))))
    {x : Point} (hx : E x) (hn : 0 < n) :
    HasNthDerivWithin (RealFunction.Image E f) n
      (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) (f x)
      (InverseFaaDiBrunoRhs D x n)
proof:
:= by
  cases inverseDerivativeOrdinaryBellCoeffFormula hD hinj hD1 hg1 hx hn with
  | intro row hrow =>
      refine Exists.intro row ?_
      refine And.intro hrow.left ?_
      refine And.intro hrow.right.left ?_
      rw [hrow.right.right]
      exact inverseOrdinaryBellCoeff_eq_inverseFaaDiBrunoRhs D x hn

name: inverse_faaDiBruno_of_sequence
statement:
theorem inverse_faaDiBruno_of_sequence
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map}
    (hD : HasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn E f D)
    (hinj : RealFunction.InjectiveOn E f)
    (hD1 : forall x : Point, E x -> Not (D 1 x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hg1 :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealFunction.Image E f)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
        (fun y : Point =>
          RealTheory.inv (D 1 (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y))))
    {x : Point} (hx : E x) {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) :
    HasNthDerivWithin (RealFunction.Image E f) n
      (RealFunction.InverseOn E f) (f x)
      (InverseFaaDiBrunoRhs D x n)
proof:
:=
  inverse_faaDiBruno
    (hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_of_sequence hD n)
    hinj hD1 hg1 hx hn

name: add_self_le_add_of_increment_le
statement:
private theorem add_self_le_add_of_increment_le
    {x m y : Point}
    (hinc :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub m x) (RealTheory.sub y m)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add m m) (RealTheory.add x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h :=
    F.add_le_add_right hinc (F.add x m)
  have hleft :
      F.add (F.sub m x) (F.add x m) = F.add m m := by
    calc
      F.add (F.sub m x) (F.add x m) =
          F.add (F.add (F.sub m x) x) m := by
            rw [<- F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add m m := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F m x]
  have hright :
      F.add (F.sub y m) (F.add x m) = F.add x y := by
    calc
      F.add (F.sub y m) (F.add x m) =
          F.add (F.sub y m) (F.add m x) := by
            rw [F.add_comm x m]
      _ = F.add (F.add (F.sub y m) m) x := by
            rw [<- F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add y x := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y m]
      _ = F.add x y := by
            rw [F.add_comm y x]
  change
    F.le (F.add (F.sub m x) (F.add x m))
      (F.add (F.sub y m) (F.add x m)) at h
  rwa [hleft, hright] at h

name: le_midpoint_of_add_self_le_add
statement:
private theorem le_midpoint_of_add_self_le_add
    {v x y : Point}
    (h :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add v v) (RealTheory.add x y)) :
    RealTheory.le v
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x y
  change F.le v m
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F
  intro hmv
  have hdouble :
      F.lt (F.add m m) (F.add v v) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hmv hmv
  have hmadd : F.add m m = F.add x y := by
    let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.sub y x)
    have hm : m = F.add x h := by
      unfold m h IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
      rfl
    rw [hm]
    calc
      F.add (F.add x h) (F.add x h) =
          F.add x (F.add h (F.add x h)) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add x (F.add x (F.add h h)) := by
            rw [F.add_comm h (F.add x h)]
            rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add x (F.add x (F.sub y x)) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F (F.sub y x)]
      _ = F.add x (F.add (F.sub y x) x) := by
            rw [F.add_comm x (F.sub y x)]
      _ = F.add x y := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y x]
  have hxy_lt_vv : F.lt (F.add x y) (F.add v v) := by
    rwa [hmadd] at hdouble
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hxy_lt_vv) h

name: midpoint_value_le_of_secantSlope_le
statement:
private theorem midpoint_value_le_of_secantSlope_le
    {x y : Point} {f : Map}
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (hslope :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y))
        (RealFunction.SecantSlope f
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y) y)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (f (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (f x) (f y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x y
  have hxm : F.lt x m := by
    unfold m
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hxy
  have hmy : F.lt m y := by
    unfold m
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hxy
  have hincLeft :
      F.le (F.sub (f m) (f x))
        (F.mul (RealFunction.SecantSlope f m y) (F.sub m x)) := by
    change
      F.le (F.sub (f m) (f x))
        (F.mul (RealFunction.SecantSlope f m y) (F.sub m x))
    exact
      RealFunction.increment_le_of_secantSlope_le
        (f := f) hxm hslope
  have hlen :
      F.sub m x = F.sub y m := by
    unfold m
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_sub_left F x y]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.right_sub_midpoint F x y]
  have hright :
      F.mul (RealFunction.SecantSlope f m y) (F.sub m x) =
        F.sub (f y) (f m) := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact RealFunction.secantSlope_mul_intervalLength hmy
  have hinc :
      F.le (F.sub (f m) (f x)) (F.sub (f y) (f m)) := by
    rwa [hright] at hincLeft
  have hsum :
      F.le (F.add (f m) (f m)) (F.add (f x) (f y)) :=
    add_self_le_add_of_increment_le hinc
  exact le_midpoint_of_add_self_le_add hsum

name: midpointConvex_ineq_of_derivative_monotone_of_lt
statement:
private theorem midpointConvex_ineq_of_derivative_monotone_of_lt
    {a b x y : Point} {f D : Map}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hD :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b z ->
          HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f z (D z))
    (hDmono :
      RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) D) :
    RealTheory.le
      (f (RealFunction.ConvexCombo RealFunction.MidpointWeight x y))
      (RealFunction.ConvexCombo RealFunction.MidpointWeight
        (f x) (f y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F x y
  have hxm : F.lt x m := by
    unfold m
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint F hxy
  have hmy : F.lt m y := by
    unfold m
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right F hxy
  have hxm_le : F.le x m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxm
  have hmy_le : F.le m y := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hmy
  have hmClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b m :=
    And.intro
      (F.le_trans hx.left hxm_le)
      (F.le_trans hmy_le hy.right)
  let hclosedLeft :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset F
      hx.left hmClosed.right
  let hopenLeft :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.openInterval_subset F
      hx.left hmClosed.right
  let hclosedRight :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset F
      hmClosed.left hy.right
  let hopenRight :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.openInterval_subset F
      hmClosed.left hy.right
  have hfcontLeft :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval x m) f :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hclosedLeft hfcont
  have hfcontRight :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval m y) f :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hclosedRight hfcont
  have hdiffLeft : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval x m f := by
    intro z hz
    have hzBig : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b z := hopenLeft z hz
    exact Exists.intro (D z)
      (hasDerivWithin_subset hopenLeft hz (hD z hzBig))
  have hdiffRight : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval m y f := by
    intro z hz
    have hzBig : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b z := hopenRight z hz
    exact Exists.intro (D z)
      (hasDerivWithin_subset hopenRight hz (hD z hzBig))
  cases lagrange_mean_value_theorem x m f hxm hfcontLeft hdiffLeft with
  | intro c1 hc1 =>
      cases lagrange_mean_value_theorem m y f hmy hfcontRight hdiffRight with
      | intro c2 hc2 =>
          have hc1Big : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b c1 :=
            hopenLeft c1 hc1.left
          have hc2Big : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b c2 :=
            hopenRight c2 hc2.left
          have hD1Small :
              HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval x m) f c1 (D c1) :=
            hasDerivWithin_subset hopenLeft hc1.left (hD c1 hc1Big)
          have hD2Small :
              HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval m y) f c2 (D c2) :=
            hasDerivWithin_subset hopenRight hc2.left (hD c2 hc2Big)
          have hslope1 :
              RealFunction.SecantSlope f x m = D c1 := by
            change SecantSlope f x m = D c1
            exact
              hasDerivWithin_unique
                (openInterval_clusterPoint hc1.left) hc1.right hD1Small
          have hslope2 :
              RealFunction.SecantSlope f m y = D c2 := by
            change SecantSlope f m y = D c2
            exact
              hasDerivWithin_unique
                (openInterval_clusterPoint hc2.left) hc2.right hD2Small
          have hc1_lt_c2 : F.lt c1 c2 :=
            F.lt_trans hc1.left.right hc2.left.left
          have hDle : F.le (D c1) (D c2) :=
            hDmono c1 c2 hc1Big hc2Big
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hc1_lt_c2)
          have hslope :
              F.le (RealFunction.SecantSlope f x m)
                (RealFunction.SecantSlope f m y) := by
            rw [hslope1, hslope2]
            exact hDle
          rw [RealFunction.convexCombo_midpointWeight_eq_midpoint x y]
          rw [RealFunction.convexCombo_midpointWeight_eq_midpoint
            (f x) (f y)]
          change
            F.le (f m)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint F (f x) (f y))
          exact midpoint_value_le_of_secantSlope_le hxy hslope

name: midpointConvexOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_monotone
statement:
theorem midpointConvexOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_monotone
    {a b : Point} {f D : Map}
    (hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hD :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x (D x))
    (hDmono :
      RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) D) :
    RealFunction.MidpointConvexOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (RealFunction.convexSet_closedInterval a b) ?_
  intro x y hx hy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxy_le : F.le x y
  case pos =>
    by_cases hyx_le : F.le y x
    case pos =>
      have hxy_eq : x = y := F.le_antisymm hxy_le hyx_le
      rw [hxy_eq]
      rw [RealFunction.convexCombo_self]
      rw [RealFunction.convexCombo_self]
      exact F.le_refl (f y)
    case neg =>
      have hxy_lt : F.lt x y :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy_le hyx_le
      exact
        midpointConvex_ineq_of_derivative_monotone_of_lt
          hx hy hxy_lt hfcont hD hDmono
  case neg =>
    have hyx_le : F.le y x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F
        (fun hyx_lt =>
          hxy_le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hyx_lt))
    by_cases hxy_le' : F.le x y
    case pos =>
      exact False.elim (hxy_le hxy_le')
    case neg =>
      have hyx_lt : F.lt y x :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyx_le hxy_le'
      have hsym :=
        midpointConvex_ineq_of_derivative_monotone_of_lt
          hy hx hyx_lt hfcont hD hDmono
      rw [RealFunction.convexCombo_symm RealFunction.MidpointWeight x y]
      rw [midpointWeight_one_sub]
      rw [RealFunction.convexCombo_symm
        RealFunction.MidpointWeight (f x) (f y)]
      rw [midpointWeight_one_sub]
      exact hsym

name: convexOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_monotone
statement:
theorem convexOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_monotone
    {a b : Point} {f D : Map}
    (hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hD :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x (D x))
    (hDmono :
      RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) D) :
    RealFunction.ConvexOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f
proof:
:=
  RealFunction.continuousOn_midpointConvexOn_to_convexOn
    hfcont
    (midpointConvexOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_monotone
      hfcont hD hDmono)

name: convexOn_closedInterval_of_secondDerivative_nonnegative
statement:
theorem convexOn_closedInterval_of_secondDerivative_nonnegative
    {a b : Point} {f D : Map}
    (hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hD :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x (D x))
    (hDcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) D)
    (hDdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b D)
    (hDderiv :
      DerivativeNonnegativeOnOpenInterval a b D) :
    RealFunction.ConvexOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f
proof:
:= by
  have hDmonoClosed :
      RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) D :=
    monotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonnegative
      hDcont hDdiff hDderiv
  have hDmonoOpen :
      RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) D := by
    intro x y hx hy hxy
    exact hDmonoClosed x y
      (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x hx)
      (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b y hy)
      hxy
  exact
    convexOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_monotone
      hfcont hD hDmonoOpen

name: concaveOn_closedInterval_of_secondDerivative_nonpositive
statement:
theorem concaveOn_closedInterval_of_secondDerivative_nonpositive
    {a b : Point} {f D : Map}
    (hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hD :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x (D x))
    (hDcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) D)
    (hDdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b D)
    (hDderiv :
      DerivativeNonpositiveOnOpenInterval a b D) :
    RealFunction.ConcaveOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hDdecreasing :
      RealFunction.DecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) D :=
    decreasingOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonpositive
      hDcont hDdiff hDderiv
  have hNegDmonoOpen :
      RealFunction.MonotoneOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) (RealFunction.NegFun D) := by
    intro x y hx hy hxy
    have hdec :
        F.le (D y) (D x) :=
      hDdecreasing x y
        (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x hx)
        (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b y hy)
        hxy
    change F.le (F.neg (D x)) (F.neg (D y))
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hdec
  have hNegDeriv :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
            (RealFunction.NegFun f) x (RealFunction.NegFun D x) := by
    intro x hx
    have h := hasDerivWithin_neg (hD x hx)
    change
      HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
        (RealFunction.NegFun f) x (RealFunction.NegFun D x)
    exact h
  exact
    convexOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_monotone
      (RealFunction.continuousOn_neg hfcont)
      hNegDeriv hNegDmonoOpen

name: taylorRemainderIntervalData_cosDerivativeCycle_four
statement:
private theorem taylorRemainderIntervalData_cosDerivativeCycle_four
    (a b : Point) :
    TaylorRemainderIntervalData (cosDerivativeCycle S) S.cos 4 a b
proof:
:= by
  have hD := hasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn_cosDerivativeCycle S
  refine
    { same_zero := ?same_zero
      continuous := ?continuous
      derivative := ?derivative }
  · intro x _hx
    exact hD.left x trivial
  · intro k _hk
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun _ _ => trivial)
      (continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn (hD.right k))
  · intro k _hk x hx
    exact hasDerivWithin_subset
      (fun _ _ => trivial) hx (hD.right k x trivial)

name: abs_cosDerivativeCycle_five_le_one
statement:
private theorem abs_cosDerivativeCycle_five_le_one
    (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs ((cosDerivativeCycle S 5) x))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold cosDerivativeCycle
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.neg (S.sin x)))
      F.one
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F]
  exact abs_sin_le_one S x

name: taylorRemainder_cos_two_abs_bound
statement:
private theorem taylorRemainder_cos_two_abs_bound :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (TaylorPointRemainder
          (cosDerivativeCycle S) S.cos RealTheory.zero 4
          (RealTheory.nat 2)))
      (TaylorRemainderAbsBoundRhs
        RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 2) 4)
proof:
:= by
  apply taylor_lagrange_remainder_abs_bound_right
  · exact RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  · exact taylorRemainderIntervalData_cosDerivativeCycle_four
      S RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 2)
  · intro t _ht
    exact abs_cosDerivativeCycle_five_le_one S t

name: cosDerivativeCycle_zero_at_zero
statement:
private theorem cosDerivativeCycle_zero_at_zero :
    cosDerivativeCycle S 0 RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  unfold cosDerivativeCycle

statement:
private theorem cosDerivativeCycle_one_at_zero :

:= by

name: taylorPolynomial_cos_two_four
statement:
private theorem taylorPolynomial_cos_two_four :
    TaylorPolynomial
      (cosDerivativeCycle S) RealTheory.zero 4
      (RealTheory.nat 2) =
      cosTwoTaylorPolynomialFourRhs
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorPolynomial
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat =>
        TaylorTerm (cosDerivativeCycle S) RealTheory.zero k
          (RealTheory.nat 2)) 5 =
      cosTwoTaylorPolynomialFourRhs
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
  unfold TaylorTerm TaylorCoeff
  rw [cosDerivativeCycle_zero_at_zero S]
  rw [cosDerivativeCycle_one_at_zero S]
  rw [cosDerivativeCycle_two_at_zero S]
  rw [cosDerivativeCycle_three_at_zero S]
  rw [cosDerivativeCycle_four_at_zero S]
  rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  rw [Nat.factorial_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
  have hinvOne :
      RealTheory.inv RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one =
        RealTheory.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.inv
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one =
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [hinvOne]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  unfold cosTwoTaylorPolynomialFourRhs
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let two := F.nat 2
  change
    F.add
      (F.add
        F.one
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.neg F.one)
            (F.inv (F.nat (Nat.factorial 2))))
          (RealFunction.powNat two 2)))
      (F.mul
        (F.mul F.one
          (F.inv (F.nat (Nat.factorial 4))))
        (RealFunction.powNat two 4)) =
    F.add
      (F.add
        F.one
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.neg F.one)
            (F.inv (F.nat (Nat.factorial 2))))
          (RealFunction.powNat two 2)))
      (F.mul
        (F.mul F.one
          (F.inv (F.nat (Nat.factorial 4))))
        (RealFunction.powNat two 4))
  rfl

name: cos_two_eq_taylorPolynomial_four_add_remainder
statement:
private theorem cos_two_eq_taylorPolynomial_four_add_remainder :
    S.cos (RealTheory.nat 2) =
      RealTheory.add
        cosTwoTaylorPolynomialFourRhs
        (TaylorPointRemainder
          (cosDerivativeCycle S) S.cos RealTheory.zero 4
          (RealTheory.nat 2))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let two := F.nat 2
  let P :=
    TaylorPolynomial (cosDerivativeCycle S) F.zero 4 two
  have hP : P = cosTwoTaylorPolynomialFourRhs := by
    unfold P
    exact taylorPolynomial_cos_two_four S
  unfold TaylorPointRemainder
  have htwoSub :
      RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.nat 2) RealTheory.zero =
        RealTheory.nat 2 := by
    change F.sub two F.zero = two
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F two
  rw [htwoSub]
  change S.cos two =
    F.add cosTwoTaylorPolynomialFourRhs (F.sub (S.cos two) P)
  rw [<- hP]
  change S.cos two = F.add P (F.sub (S.cos two) P)
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.add_comm P (F.add (S.cos two) (F.neg P))]
  rw [F.add_assoc]
  rw [F.neg_add]
  rw [F.add_zero]

name: mul_inv_mul_cancel_common
statement:
private theorem mul_inv_mul_cancel_common
    (a b c : Point) (hb : Not (b = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul a (RealTheory.inv b))
        (RealTheory.mul b c) =

      RealTheory.mul a c
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.mul (F.mul a (F.inv b)) (F.mul b c) = F.mul a c
  rw [F.mul_assoc]
  rw [← F.mul_assoc (F.inv b) b c]
  rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hb]
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: inv_mul_mul_cancel_common
statement:
private theorem inv_mul_mul_cancel_common
    (a b c : Point)
    (hb : Not (b = RealTheory.zero))
    (hc : Not (c = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul b c))
        (RealTheory.mul a c) =
      RealTheory.mul a (RealTheory.inv b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [RealTheory.inv_mul hb hc]
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (F.inv b) (F.inv c)) (F.mul a c) =
      F.mul a (F.inv b)
  rw [F.mul_comm a c]
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.inv b) (F.inv c)) (F.mul c a) =
        F.mul (F.inv b) a :=
      mul_inv_mul_cancel_common (F.inv b) c a hc
    _ = F.mul a (F.inv b) := F.mul_comm (F.inv b) a

name: cosTwoTaylorUpperBoundRhs_lt_zero
statement:
private theorem cosTwoTaylorUpperBoundRhs_lt_zero :
    RealTheory.lt cosTwoTaylorUpperBoundRhs RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h1ne : Not (RealTheory.nat 1 = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 0)
  have h2ne : Not (RealTheory.nat 2 = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have h3ne : Not (RealTheory.nat 3 = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 2)
  have h8ne : Not (RealTheory.nat 8 = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 7)
  have h15ne : Not (RealTheory.nat 15 = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 14)
  have hpow2 :
      RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) 2 = RealTheory.nat 4 := by
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ, RealFunction.powNat_succ]
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero, RealTheory.one_mul]
    change F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat 2) = F.nat 4
    rw [← F.nat_mul]
  have hpow4 :
      RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) 4 = RealTheory.nat 16 := by
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ, RealFunction.powNat_succ]
    rw [hpow2]
    change F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 4) (F.nat 2)) (F.nat 2) = F.nat 16
    rw [← F.nat_mul, ← F.nat_mul]
  have hpow5 :
      RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) 5 = RealTheory.nat 32 := by
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ, hpow4]
    change F.mul (F.nat 16) (F.nat 2) = F.nat 32
    rw [← F.nat_mul]
  have hhalfFour :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))
          (RealTheory.nat 4) = RealTheory.nat 2 := by
    have h :=
      inv_mul_mul_cancel_common (RealTheory.nat 2) (RealTheory.nat 1)
        (RealTheory.nat 2) h1ne h2ne
    change
      F.mul (F.inv (F.mul (F.nat 1) (F.nat 2)))
          (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat 2)) =
        F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.inv (F.nat 1)) at h
    rw [F.nat_one, F.one_mul, F.inv_one, F.mul_one] at h
    change
      F.mul (F.inv (F.nat 2)) (F.nat (2 * 2)) = F.nat 2
    rw [F.nat_mul]
    exact h
  have htwentyfourSixteen :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 24))
          (RealTheory.nat 16) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 3)) := by
    have h :=
      inv_mul_mul_cancel_common (RealTheory.nat 2) (RealTheory.nat 3)
        (RealTheory.nat 8) h3ne h8ne
    change
      F.mul (F.inv (F.mul (F.nat 3) (F.nat 8)))
          (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat 8)) =
        F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.inv (F.nat 3)) at h
    change
      F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (3 * 8))) (F.nat (2 * 8)) =
        F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.inv (F.nat 3))
    rw [F.nat_mul, F.nat_mul]
    exact h
  have honeTwentyThirtyTwo :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 120))
          (RealTheory.nat 32) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 4)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 15)) := by
    have h :=
      inv_mul_mul_cancel_common (RealTheory.nat 4) (RealTheory.nat 15)
        (RealTheory.nat 8) h15ne h8ne
    change
      F.mul (F.inv (F.mul (F.nat 15) (F.nat 8)))
          (F.mul (F.nat 4) (F.nat 8)) =
        F.mul (F.nat 4) (F.inv (F.nat 15)) at h
    change
      F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (15 * 8))) (F.nat (4 * 8)) =
        F.mul (F.nat 4) (F.inv (F.nat 15))
    rw [F.nat_mul, F.nat_mul]
    exact h
  have hupper :
      cosTwoTaylorUpperBoundRhs =
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 3)))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 4)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 15)))) := by
    unfold cosTwoTaylorUpperBoundRhs
    unfold cosTwoTaylorPolynomialFourRhs
    unfold TaylorRemainderAbsBoundRhs
    dsimp
    rw [show Nat.factorial 2 = 2 from rfl]

    rw [show Nat.factorial 4 = 24 from rfl]
    rw [show Nat.factorial (4 + 1) = 120 from rfl]
    have hsub :
        RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.nat 2) RealTheory.zero =
          RealTheory.nat 2 :=
      F.sub_zero (RealTheory.nat 2)
    rw [hsub]
    rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg 2)]
    rw [hpow2, hpow4, hpow5]
    rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc, hhalfFour]
    have hnegTwo :
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.nat 2) =
          RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat 2) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_one_mul_eq_neg F (RealTheory.nat 2)
    rw [hnegTwo]
    rw [RealTheory.one_mul, htwentyfourSixteen]
    rw [RealTheory.one_mul, honeTwentyThirtyTwo]
    have honeSubTwo :
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat 2)) =
          RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one := by
      change F.add F.one (F.neg (F.nat 2)) = F.neg F.one
      have htwo : F.nat 2 = F.add F.one F.one := by
        rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 from rfl, F.nat_succ, F.nat_one]
      rw [htwo, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F]
      rw [← F.add_assoc, F.add_neg, F.zero_add]
    rw [honeSubTwo]
  have htwoThirdsTimesFifteen :
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 3)))
          (RealTheory.nat 15) = RealTheory.nat 10 := by
    have h :=
      mul_inv_mul_cancel_common (RealTheory.nat 2) (RealTheory.nat 3)
        (RealTheory.nat 5) h3ne
    change
      F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.inv (F.nat 3)))
          (F.mul (F.nat 3) (F.nat 5)) =
        F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat 5) at h
    change
      F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.inv (F.nat 3))) (F.nat (3 * 5)) =
        F.nat (2 * 5)
    rw [F.nat_mul, F.nat_mul]
    exact h
  have hfourFifteenthsTimesFifteen :
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 4)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 15)))
          (RealTheory.nat 15) = RealTheory.nat 4 := by
    have h :=
      mul_inv_mul_cancel_common (RealTheory.nat 4) (RealTheory.nat 15)
        RealTheory.one h15ne
    simpa only [RealTheory.mul_one] using h
  have htailTimesFifteen :
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 3)))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 4)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 15))))
          (RealTheory.nat 15) = RealTheory.nat 14 := by
    rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
    rw [htwoThirdsTimesFifteen, hfourFifteenthsTimesFifteen]
    change F.add (F.nat 10) (F.nat 4) = F.nat 14
    rw [← F.nat_add]
  have htailLtOne :
      RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 3)))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 4)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 15))))
          RealTheory.one := by
    have h15pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 15) :=
      RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 14)
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right
      F (z := RealTheory.nat 15) ?_ h15pos
    change
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 3)))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 4)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 15))))
          (RealTheory.nat 15))
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one (RealTheory.nat 15))
    rw [htailTimesFifteen, RealTheory.one_mul]
    exact RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt (by decide)
  rw [hupper]
  have h :=
    RealTheory.add_lt_add_left htailLtOne (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one)
  rwa [RealTheory.neg_add] at h

name: taylorRemainder_cos_two_le_abs_bound
statement:
private theorem taylorRemainder_cos_two_le_abs_bound :
    RealTheory.le
      (TaylorPointRemainder
        (cosDerivativeCycle S) S.cos RealTheory.zero 4
        (RealTheory.nat 2))
      (TaylorRemainderAbsBoundRhs
        RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 2) 4)
proof:
:= by
  exact RealTheory.le_trans
    (RealTheory.le_abs_self
      (TaylorPointRemainder
        (cosDerivativeCycle S) S.cos RealTheory.zero 4
        (RealTheory.nat 2)))
    (taylorRemainder_cos_two_abs_bound S)

name: cos_two_le_taylor_upper_bound
statement:
private theorem cos_two_le_taylor_upper_bound :
    RealTheory.le (S.cos (RealTheory.nat 2)) cosTwoTaylorUpperBoundRhs
proof:
:= by
  rw [cos_two_eq_taylorPolynomial_four_add_remainder S]
  unfold cosTwoTaylorUpperBoundRhs
  exact RealTheory.add_le_add_left
    (taylorRemainder_cos_two_le_abs_bound S)
    cosTwoTaylorPolynomialFourRhs

name: cos_two_lt_zero
statement:
theorem cos_two_lt_zero :
    RealTheory.lt (S.cos (RealTheory.nat 2)) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by

  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
    (cos_two_le_taylor_upper_bound S)
    cosTwoTaylorUpperBoundRhs_lt_zero

name: zero_le_nat_two
statement:
private theorem zero_le_nat_two :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 2)
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.nat_nonneg 2

name: continuousOn_cos_closedInterval_zero_two
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_cos_closedInterval_zero_two :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 2))
      S.cos
proof:
:= by
  exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
    (fun _x _hx => trivial)
    (continuousOn_cos_universal S)

name: cos_two_zero_cos_zero_between
statement:
private theorem cos_two_zero_cos_zero_between :
    RealTheory.Between
      (S.cos (RealTheory.nat 2)) RealTheory.zero
      (S.cos RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealTheory.Between
  change
    And
      (F.le (S.cos (RealTheory.nat 2)) F.zero)
      (F.le F.zero (S.cos RealTheory.zero))
  refine And.intro ?left ?right
  · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (cos_two_lt_zero S)
  · rw [cos_zero S]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one

name: exists_cos_zero_closedInterval_zero_two
statement:
private theorem exists_cos_zero_closedInterval_zero_two :
    Exists
      (fun c : Point =>
        And
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 2) c)
          (S.cos c = RealTheory.zero))
proof:
:=
  RealFunction.intermediate_value_closedInterval_unordered
    zero_le_nat_two
    (continuousOn_cos_closedInterval_zero_two S)
    (Or.inr (cos_two_zero_cos_zero_between S))

name: cos_zero_closedInterval_zero_two_pos
statement:
private theorem cos_zero_closedInterval_zero_two_pos
    {c : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 2) c)
    (hcos : S.cos c = RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt F.zero c
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F
  · exact hc.left
  · intro hc_le_zero
    have hc_eq_zero : c = F.zero :=
      F.le_antisymm hc_le_zero hc.left
    have hcos0_zero : S.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero := by
      have h := hcos
      change S.cos c = F.zero at h
      rw [hc_eq_zero] at h
      exact h
    have hone_zero : RealTheory.one = RealTheory.zero := by
      rw [<- cos_zero S]
      exact hcos0_zero
    exact RealTheory.one_ne_zero hone_zero

name: cos_zero_closedInterval_zero_two_lt_nat_two
statement:
private theorem cos_zero_closedInterval_zero_two_lt_nat_two
    {c : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 2) c)
    (hcos : S.cos c = RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.lt c (RealTheory.nat 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt c (F.nat 2)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F
  · exact hc.right
  · intro htwo_le_c
    have hc_eq_two : c = F.nat 2 :=
      F.le_antisymm hc.right htwo_le_c
    have hcos_two_zero : S.cos (RealTheory.nat 2) = RealTheory.zero := by
      have h := hcos
      change S.cos c = F.zero at h
      rw [hc_eq_two] at h
      exact h
    exact
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F (cos_two_lt_zero S))
        hcos_two_zero

name: exists_cos_zero_openInterval_zero_two
statement:
private theorem exists_cos_zero_openInterval_zero_two :
    Exists
      (fun c : Point =>
        And
          (RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 2) c)
          (S.cos c = RealTheory.zero))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_cos_zero_closedInterval_zero_two S with
  | intro c hc =>
      refine Exists.intro c ?_
      exact And.intro
        (And.intro
          (cos_zero_closedInterval_zero_two_pos S hc.left hc.right)
          (cos_zero_closedInterval_zero_two_lt_nat_two S hc.left hc.right))
        hc.right

name: positiveCosZeroSet_nonempty
statement:
private theorem positiveCosZeroSet_nonempty :
    Exists (PositiveCosZeroSet S)
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_cos_zero_openInterval_zero_two S with
  | intro c hc =>
      exact Exists.intro c (And.intro hc.left.left hc.right)

name: positiveCosZeroSet_has_positive_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem positiveCosZeroSet_has_positive_lower_bound :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>

        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (IsLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
            (PositiveCosZeroSet S) delta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases S.local_order with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx
      change F.le delta x
      by_cases hdelta_le_x : F.le delta x
      · exact hdelta_le_x
      · have hx_le_delta : F.le x delta := by
          cases F.le_total x delta with
          | inl h => exact h
          | inr h => exact False.elim (hdelta_le_x h)
        have hx_lt_delta : F.lt x delta :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
            F hx_le_delta hdelta_le_x
        have hloc := hdelta.right x hx.left hx_lt_delta
        have hzero_ne_mul :
            Not (F.zero = F.mul x (S.cos x)) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hloc.left
        have hmul_zero :
            F.mul x (S.cos x) = F.zero := by
          rw [hx.right]
          exact F.mul_zero x
        exact False.elim (hzero_ne_mul hmul_zero.symm)

name: exists_positiveCosZeroSet_glb
statement:
private theorem exists_positiveCosZeroSet_glb :
    Exists
      (fun h : Point =>
        IsGreatestLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (PositiveCosZeroSet S) h)
proof:
:= by
  cases positiveCosZeroSet_has_positive_lower_bound S with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      exact
        RealTheory.exists_glb
          (PositiveCosZeroSet S)
          (positiveCosZeroSet_nonempty S)
          (Exists.intro delta hdelta.right)

name: halfPi_isGreatestLowerBound_positiveCosZeroSet
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_positiveCosZeroSet_glb S)

name: halfPi_pos
statement:
theorem halfPi_pos :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (halfPi S)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases positiveCosZeroSet_has_positive_lower_bound S with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      have hdelta_le_half :
          F.le delta (halfPi S) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_glb_of_lower
          F
          (halfPi_isGreatestLowerBound_positiveCosZeroSet S)
          hdelta.right
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
        F hdelta.left hdelta_le_half

name: isClosed_cosZeroSet
statement:
private theorem isClosed_cosZeroSet :
    RealTheory.IsClosed (CosZeroSet S)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htargetClosed :
      RealTheory.IsClosed
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero) := by
    change
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.IsClosed F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ClosedInterval F F.zero F.zero)
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closed_interval F F.zero F.zero
  have htop :
      RealFunction.TopologicallyContinuousOn
        RealFunction.UniversalDomain S.cos :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_to_topologicallyContinuousOn
      (continuousOn_cos_universal S)
  have hclosedIn :
      RealTheory.ClosedIn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (RealFunction.PreimageOn
          RealFunction.UniversalDomain S.cos
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)) :=
    RealFunction.topologicallyContinuousOn_preimage_closed
      htop htargetClosed
  cases hclosedIn with
  | intro C hC =>
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closed_congr F hC.left
      intro x
      constructor
      · intro hxC
        have hxpre :
            RealFunction.PreimageOn
              RealFunction.UniversalDomain S.cos
              (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero) x :=
          (hC.right x).mpr (And.intro True.intro hxC)
        exact F.le_antisymm hxpre.right.right hxpre.right.left
      · intro hxzero
        have hxpre :
            RealFunction.PreimageOn
              RealFunction.UniversalDomain S.cos
              (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero) x := by
          refine And.intro True.intro ?_
          change And (F.le F.zero (S.cos x)) (F.le (S.cos x) F.zero)
          rw [hxzero]
          exact And.intro (F.le_refl F.zero) (F.le_refl F.zero)
        exact ((hC.right x).mp hxpre).right

name: mem_closed_superset_of_glb
statement:
private theorem mem_closed_superset_of_glb
    {A C : Point -> Prop} {s : Point}
    (hsub : SetPred.Subset A C)
    (hclosed : RealTheory.IsClosed C)
    (hs :
      IsGreatestLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le A s) :
    C s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs_mem : C s
  · exact hs_mem

  · let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    cases hclosed s hs_mem with
    | intro left hleft =>
        cases hleft with
        | intro right hright =>
            cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_gt_of_glb_lt
                F hs hright.right.left with
            | intro x hx =>
                have hs_le_x : F.le s x := hs.left x hx.left
                have left_lt_x : F.lt left x :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                    F hright.left hs_le_x
                have hx_interval :
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval F left right x :=
                  And.intro left_lt_x hx.right
                exact False.elim
                  (hright.right.right x hx_interval (hsub x hx.left))

name: cos_halfPi_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cos_halfPi_eq_zero :
    S.cos (halfPi S) = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:=
  mem_closed_superset_of_glb
    (A := PositiveCosZeroSet S)
    (C := CosZeroSet S)
    (s := halfPi S)
    (fun _ hx => hx.right)
    (isClosed_cosZeroSet S)
    (halfPi_isGreatestLowerBound_positiveCosZeroSet S)

name: halfPi_le_of_positive_cos_zero
statement:
theorem halfPi_le_of_positive_cos_zero
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hcos : S.cos x = RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.le (halfPi S) x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.glb_le_of_mem
      F
      (halfPi_isGreatestLowerBound_positiveCosZeroSet S)
      (And.intro hxpos hcos)

name: exists_positive_cos_zero_le_of_pos_of_cos_nonpos
statement:
private theorem exists_positive_cos_zero_le_of_pos_of_cos_nonpos
    {x : Point}
    (hxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hcos_nonpos : RealTheory.le (S.cos x) RealTheory.zero) :
    Exists
      (fun c : Point =>
        And
          (And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c)
            (RealTheory.le c x))
          (S.cos c = RealTheory.zero))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hzero_le_x : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxpos
  have hcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero x) S.cos := by
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun _y _hy => trivial)
      (continuousOn_cos_universal S)
  have hbetween :
      RealTheory.Between
        (S.cos x) RealTheory.zero (S.cos RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold RealTheory.Between
    change
      And
        (F.le (S.cos x) F.zero)
        (F.le F.zero (S.cos F.zero))
    refine And.intro hcos_nonpos ?_
    have hcos0 : S.cos F.zero = F.one := by
      change S.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
      exact cos_zero S
    rw [hcos0]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  cases
      RealFunction.intermediate_value_closedInterval_unordered
        hzero_le_x hcont (Or.inr hbetween) with
  | intro c hc =>
      have hcpos : F.lt F.zero c := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F
        · exact hc.left.left
        · intro hc_le_zero
          have hc_eq_zero : c = F.zero :=
            F.le_antisymm hc_le_zero hc.left.left
          have hcos0_zero : S.cos F.zero = F.zero := by
            have h := hc.right
            change S.cos c = F.zero at h
            rw [hc_eq_zero] at h
            exact h
          have hone_zero : F.one = F.zero := by
            have hcos0 : S.cos F.zero = F.one := by
              change S.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
              exact cos_zero S
            rw [hcos0] at hcos0_zero
            exact hcos0_zero
          exact RealTheory.one_ne_zero hone_zero
      exact Exists.intro c
        (And.intro (And.intro hcpos hc.left.right) hc.right)

name: cos_pos_openInterval_zero_halfPi
statement:
theorem cos_pos_openInterval_zero_halfPi
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S) x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (S.cos x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnot_nonpos : Not (F.le (S.cos x) F.zero) := by
    intro hcos_nonpos
    cases
        exists_positive_cos_zero_le_of_pos_of_cos_nonpos
          S hx.left hcos_nonpos with
    | intro c hc =>
        have hhalf_le_c :
            F.le (halfPi S) c :=
          halfPi_le_of_positive_cos_zero S hc.left.left hc.right
        have hhalf_le_x : F.le (halfPi S) x :=
          F.le_trans hhalf_le_c hc.left.right
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hx.right) hhalf_le_x
  have hzero_le_cos : F.le F.zero (S.cos x) := by
    cases F.le_total F.zero (S.cos x) with
    | inl h => exact h
    | inr h => exact False.elim (hnot_nonpos h)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le

    F hzero_le_cos hnot_nonpos

name: strictMonotoneOn_sin_closedInterval_zero_of_le_halfPi
statement:
private theorem strictMonotoneOn_sin_closedInterval_zero_of_le_halfPi
    {b : Point}
    (_hbpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hb_le_half : RealTheory.le b (halfPi S)) :
    RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero b) S.sin
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero b) S.sin := by
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun _x _hx => trivial)
      (continuousOn_sin_universal S)
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval RealTheory.zero b S.sin := by
    intro y hy
    exact Exists.intro (S.cos y)
      (hasDerivWithin_subset
        (fun _z _hz => trivial)
        hy
        (hasDerivWithin_sin_universal S y))
  have hderiv : DerivativePositiveOnOpenInterval RealTheory.zero b S.sin := by
    intro y A hy hA
    have hsin_open :
        HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero b)
          S.sin y (S.cos y) :=
      hasDerivWithin_subset
        (fun _z _hz => trivial)
        hy
        (hasDerivWithin_sin_universal S y)
    have hA_eq_cos : A = S.cos y :=
      hasDerivWithin_unique
        (openInterval_clusterPoint hy)
        hA hsin_open
    rw [hA_eq_cos]
    exact cos_pos_openInterval_zero_halfPi S
      (And.intro hy.left
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hy.right hb_le_half))
  exact strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_positive
    hfcont hdiff hderiv

name: sin_pos_openInterval_zero_halfPi
statement:

proof:
:= by

      S hx.left (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.right)

  have hx_mem :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero x x :=
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.left)

name: pos_eq_one_of_mul_self_eq_one
statement:
private theorem pos_eq_one_of_mul_self_eq_one
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {s : Point}
    (hspos : F.lt F.zero s)
    (hsq : F.mul s s = F.one) :
    s = F.one
proof:
:= by
  have hs_le_one : F.le s F.one := by
    by_cases hsle : F.le s F.one
    · exact hsle
    · have hone_le_s : F.le F.one s := by
        cases F.le_total F.one s with
        | inl h => exact h
        | inr h => exact False.elim (hsle h)
      have hone_lt_s : F.lt F.one s :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hone_le_s hsle
      have hmul_lt : F.lt (F.mul F.one s) (F.mul s s) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hone_lt_s hspos
      rw [F.one_mul, hsq] at hmul_lt
      exact False.elim
        (hsle (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hmul_lt))
  have hone_le_s : F.le F.one s := by
    by_cases hle : F.le F.one s
    · exact hle
    · have hs_lt_one : F.lt s F.one :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hs_le_one hle
      have hmul_lt : F.lt (F.mul s s) (F.mul F.one s) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hs_lt_one hspos
      rw [hsq, F.one_mul] at hmul_lt
      exact False.elim
        ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hmul_lt) hs_le_one)
  exact F.le_antisymm hs_le_one hone_le_s

name: sin_halfPi_eq_one
statement:
theorem sin_halfPi_eq_one :
    S.sin (halfPi S) = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := S.sin (halfPi S)

  let c := S.cos (halfPi S)
  have hunit :
      F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul c c) = F.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin (halfPi S)) (S.sin (halfPi S)))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos (halfPi S)) (S.cos (halfPi S))) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S (halfPi S)
  have hc : c = F.zero := by
    change S.cos (halfPi S) = RealTheory.zero
    exact cos_halfPi_eq_zero S
  have hsq : F.mul s s = F.one := by
    rw [hc] at hunit
    rw [F.mul_zero] at hunit
    rw [F.add_zero] at hunit
    exact hunit
  change s = F.one
  exact pos_eq_one_of_mul_self_eq_one
    F (sin_halfPi_pos S) hsq

name: sin_halfPi_add

:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := sin_add S (halfPi S) x

        (F.mul (S.sin (halfPi S)) (S.cos x))
        (F.mul (S.cos (halfPi S)) (S.sin x)) at h
  have hsinHalf : S.sin (halfPi S) = F.one := by
    change S.sin (halfPi S) = RealTheory.one
    exact sin_halfPi_eq_one S
  have hcosHalf : S.cos (halfPi S) = F.zero := by
    change S.cos (halfPi S) = RealTheory.zero
    exact cos_halfPi_eq_zero S
  rw [hsinHalf, hcosHalf] at h
  rw [F.one_mul] at h
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F] at h
  rw [F.add_zero] at h
  exact h

  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F] at h
  rw [F.one_mul] at h
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F] at h

statement:
private theorem trigHalf_mem_closedInterval_zero_halfPi_of_mem_closedInterval_zero_pi
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (pi S) x) :
    RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S) (trigHalf x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    And (F.le F.zero (trigHalf x))
      (F.le (trigHalf x) (halfPi S))
  refine And.intro ?left ?right
  · unfold trigHalf
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_nonneg F hx.left
  · apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F
    intro hlt
    have hsum := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hlt hlt
    change
      F.lt (F.add (halfPi S) (halfPi S))
        (F.add (trigHalf x) (trigHalf x)) at hsum
    have hpi : F.add (halfPi S) (halfPi S) = pi S := by
      exact (pi_eq_halfPi_add_halfPi S).symm
    have hdouble : F.add (trigHalf x) (trigHalf x) = x := by
      exact trigHalf_add_self x
    rw [hpi, hdouble] at hsum
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hsum) hx.right

name: trigHalf_mem_openInterval_zero_halfPi_of_mem_openInterval_zero_pi
statement:
private theorem trigHalf_mem_openInterval_zero_halfPi_of_mem_openInterval_zero_pi
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero (pi S) x) :
    RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S) (trigHalf x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    And (F.lt F.zero (trigHalf x))
      (F.lt (trigHalf x) (halfPi S))
  refine And.intro ?left ?right
  · unfold trigHalf
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hx.left
  · have hclosed :
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (pi S) x :=
      And.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.left)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.right)
    have hle :
        F.le (trigHalf x) (halfPi S) :=
      (trigHalf_mem_closedInterval_zero_halfPi_of_mem_closedInterval_zero_pi
        S hclosed).right
    have hnot : Not (F.le (halfPi S) (trigHalf x)) := by
      intro hhalf_le
      have hsum := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hhalf_le hhalf_le
      change
        F.le (F.add (halfPi S) (halfPi S))
          (F.add (trigHalf x) (trigHalf x)) at hsum
      have hpi : F.add (halfPi S) (halfPi S) = pi S := by
        exact (pi_eq_halfPi_add_halfPi S).symm
      have hdouble : F.add (trigHalf x) (trigHalf x) = x := by
        exact trigHalf_add_self x
      rw [hpi, hdouble] at hsum
      exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hx.right) hsum
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hle hnot

name: sin_nonneg_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
statement:
private theorem sin_nonneg_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
    {t : Point}
    (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S) t) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (S.sin t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.le F.zero (S.sin t)
  by_cases ht_le_zero : F.le t F.zero
  · have ht_eq : t = F.zero :=
      F.le_antisymm ht_le_zero ht.left
    have hsin0 : S.sin F.zero = F.zero := by
      change S.sin RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
      exact sin_zero S
    rw [ht_eq, hsin0]
    exact F.le_refl F.zero
  · by_cases hhalf_le_t : F.le (halfPi S) t
    · have ht_eq : t = halfPi S :=
        F.le_antisymm ht.right hhalf_le_t
      rw [ht_eq]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (sin_halfPi_pos S)
    · have ht_pos : F.lt F.zero t :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F ht.left ht_le_zero
      have ht_lt_half : F.lt t (halfPi S) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F ht.right hhalf_le_t

      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (sin_pos_openInterval_zero_halfPi S
          (And.intro ht_pos ht_lt_half))

name: cos_nonneg_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
statement:
private theorem cos_nonneg_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
    {t : Point}
    (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S) t) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (S.cos t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.le F.zero (S.cos t)
  by_cases ht_le_zero : F.le t F.zero
  · have ht_eq : t = F.zero :=
      F.le_antisymm ht_le_zero ht.left
    have hcos0 : S.cos F.zero = F.one := by
      change S.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
      exact cos_zero S
    rw [ht_eq, hcos0]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  · by_cases hhalf_le_t : F.le (halfPi S) t
    · have ht_eq : t = halfPi S :=
        F.le_antisymm ht.right hhalf_le_t
      have hcosHalf : S.cos (halfPi S) = F.zero := by
        change S.cos (halfPi S) = RealTheory.zero
        exact cos_halfPi_eq_zero S
      rw [ht_eq, hcosHalf]
      exact F.le_refl F.zero
    · have ht_pos : F.lt F.zero t :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F ht.left ht_le_zero
      have ht_lt_half : F.lt t (halfPi S) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F ht.right hhalf_le_t
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (cos_pos_openInterval_zero_halfPi S
          (And.intro ht_pos ht_lt_half))

statement:
theorem sin_trigHalf_nonneg_of_mem_closedInterval_zero_pi

name: halfPi_lt_pi
statement:
private theorem halfPi_lt_pi :
    RealTheory.lt (halfPi S) (pi S)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold pi
  change F.lt (halfPi S) (F.add (halfPi S) (halfPi S))
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
    F (halfPi_pos S) (halfPi S)
  change F.lt (F.add (halfPi S) F.zero)
    (F.add (halfPi S) (halfPi S)) at h
  rwa [F.add_zero] at h

name: halfPi_le_pi
statement:

    RealTheory.le (halfPi S) (pi S)

    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (halfPi_lt_pi S)
