name: eq_of_pos_of_mul_self_eq_mul_self
statement:
private theorem eq_of_pos_of_mul_self_eq_mul_self
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hsq : RealTheory.mul a a = RealTheory.mul b b) :
    a = b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt F.zero a at ha
  change F.lt F.zero b at hb
  change F.mul a a = F.mul b b at hsq
  by_cases heq : a = b
  · exact heq
  · cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F heq with
    | inl hab =>
        have hleft : F.lt (F.mul a a) (F.mul b a) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hab ha
        have hright : F.lt (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left F hab hb
        have hlt : F.lt (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hleft hright
        rw [<- hsq] at hlt
        exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (F.mul a a) hlt)
    | inr hba =>
        have hleft : F.lt (F.mul b b) (F.mul a b) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hba hb
        have hright : F.lt (F.mul a b) (F.mul a a) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left F hba ha
        have hlt : F.lt (F.mul b b) (F.mul a a) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hleft hright
        rw [hsq] at hlt
        exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (F.mul b b) hlt)

name: sin_quarterPi_eq_cos_quarterPi
statement:
theorem sin_quarterPi_eq_cos_quarterPi :
    S.sin (quarterPi S) = S.cos (quarterPi S)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply eq_of_pos_of_mul_self_eq_mul_self
  · exact sin_quarterPi_pos S
  · exact cos_quarterPi_pos S
  · change
      F.mul (S.sin (quarterPi S)) (S.sin (quarterPi S)) =
        F.mul (S.cos (quarterPi S)) (S.cos (quarterPi S))
    have hcosDouble := cos_add_self_sq_sub_sq S (quarterPi S)
    have hsum : F.add (quarterPi S) (quarterPi S) = halfPi S := by
      exact quarterPi_add_self_eq_halfPi S
    change
      S.cos (F.add (quarterPi S) (quarterPi S)) =
        F.sub
          (F.mul (S.cos (quarterPi S)) (S.cos (quarterPi S)))
          (F.mul (S.sin (quarterPi S)) (S.sin (quarterPi S))) at hcosDouble
    rw [hsum, cos_halfPi_eq_zero S] at hcosDouble
    have hsub_zero :
        F.sub
          (F.mul (S.cos (quarterPi S)) (S.cos (quarterPi S)))
          (F.mul (S.sin (quarterPi S)) (S.sin (quarterPi S))) =
        F.zero := by
      exact hcosDouble.symm
    have hleq :
        F.mul (S.cos (quarterPi S)) (S.cos (quarterPi S)) =
          F.mul (S.sin (quarterPi S)) (S.sin (quarterPi S)) := by
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero
      exact hsub_zero
    exact hleq.symm

name: sin_quarterPi_sq_eq_half_one
statement:
theorem sin_quarterPi_sq_eq_half_one :
    RealTheory.mul (S.sin (quarterPi S)) (S.sin (quarterPi S)) =
      trigHalf RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (S.sin (quarterPi S)) (S.sin (quarterPi S)) =
      trigHalf F.one
  have hsq := sin_sq_trigHalf_eq_half_one_sub_cos S (halfPi S)
  change
    F.mul
      (S.sin (trigHalf (halfPi S))) (S.sin (trigHalf (halfPi S))) =
      trigHalf (F.sub F.one (S.cos (halfPi S))) at hsq
  have hcosHalf : S.cos (halfPi S) = F.zero := by
    change S.cos (halfPi S) = RealTheory.zero
    exact cos_halfPi_eq_zero S
  rw [<- quarterPi_eq_trigHalf_halfPi S, hcosHalf, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F] at hsq
  exact hsq

name: cos_quarterPi_sq_eq_half_one
statement:
theorem cos_quarterPi_sq_eq_half_one :
    RealTheory.mul (S.cos (quarterPi S)) (S.cos (quarterPi S)) =
      trigHalf RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (S.cos (quarterPi S)) (S.cos (quarterPi S)) =
      trigHalf F.one
  have hsq := cos_sq_trigHalf_eq_half_one_add_cos S (halfPi S)
  change
    F.mul
      (S.cos (trigHalf (halfPi S))) (S.cos (trigHalf (halfPi S))) =
      trigHalf (F.add F.one (S.cos (halfPi S))) at hsq
  have hcosHalf : S.cos (halfPi S) = F.zero := by
    change S.cos (halfPi S) = RealTheory.zero
    exact cos_halfPi_eq_zero S
  rw [<- quarterPi_eq_trigHalf_halfPi S, hcosHalf, F.add_zero] at hsq
  exact hsq

name: neg_mem_openInterval_zero_halfPi_of_mem_openInterval_neg_halfPi_zero
statement:
private theorem neg_mem_openInterval_zero_halfPi_of_mem_openInterval_neg_halfPi_zero
    {x : Point}
    (hx :
      RealTheory.OpenInterval
        (RealTheory.neg (halfPi S)) RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S)
      (RealTheory.neg x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    And (F.lt F.zero (F.neg x))
      (F.lt (F.neg x) (halfPi S))
  refine And.intro ?left ?right
  · have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hx.right

    change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg x) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
  · have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hx.left
    change F.lt (F.neg x) (F.neg (F.neg (halfPi S))) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F (halfPi S)] at h

name: sub_halfPi_mem_openInterval_zero_halfPi_of_mem_openInterval_halfPi_pi
statement:
private theorem sub_halfPi_mem_openInterval_zero_halfPi_of_mem_openInterval_halfPi_pi
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval (halfPi S) (pi S) x) :
    RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S)
      (RealTheory.sub x (halfPi S))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    And (F.lt F.zero (F.sub x (halfPi S)))
      (F.lt (F.sub x (halfPi S)) (halfPi S))
  refine And.intro ?left ?right
  · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx.left
  · unfold pi at hx
    have hx_right : F.lt x (F.add (halfPi S) (halfPi S)) :=
      hx.right
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hx_right

name: cos_pos_openInterval_neg_halfPi_halfPi
statement:
theorem cos_pos_openInterval_neg_halfPi_halfPi
    {x : Point}
    (hx :
      RealTheory.OpenInterval
        (RealTheory.neg (halfPi S)) (halfPi S) x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (S.cos x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases h0x : F.le F.zero x
  · by_cases hx0 : F.le x F.zero
    · have hx_eq_zero : x = F.zero := F.le_antisymm hx0 h0x
      rw [hx_eq_zero]
      have hcos0 : S.cos F.zero = F.one := by
        change S.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
        exact cos_zero S
      rw [hcos0]
      exact RealTheory.zero_lt_one
    · have hx_pos : F.lt F.zero x :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0x hx0
      exact cos_pos_openInterval_zero_halfPi S
        (And.intro hx_pos hx.right)
  · have hx_nonpos : F.le x F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F h0x
    have hx_neg : F.lt x F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx_nonpos h0x
    have hnegx :
        RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S)
          (RealTheory.neg x) :=
      neg_mem_openInterval_zero_halfPi_of_mem_openInterval_neg_halfPi_zero
        S (And.intro hx.left hx_neg)
    have hcospos := cos_pos_openInterval_zero_halfPi S hnegx
    rw [cos_neg S x] at hcospos
    exact hcospos

name: sin_pos_openInterval_zero_pi
statement:
theorem sin_pos_openInterval_zero_pi
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero (pi S) x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (S.sin x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hx_le_half : F.le x (halfPi S)
  · by_cases hhalf_le_x : F.le (halfPi S) x
    · have hx_eq_half : x = halfPi S :=
        F.le_antisymm hx_le_half hhalf_le_x
      rw [hx_eq_half]
      exact sin_halfPi_pos S
    · have hx_lt_half : F.lt x (halfPi S) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
          F hx_le_half hhalf_le_x
      exact sin_pos_openInterval_zero_halfPi S
        (And.intro hx.left hx_lt_half)
  · have hhalf_le_x : F.le (halfPi S) x := by
      cases F.le_total (halfPi S) x with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr h => exact False.elim (hx_le_half h)
    have hhalf_lt_x : F.lt (halfPi S) x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
        F hhalf_le_x hx_le_half
    let t := F.sub x (halfPi S)
    have ht :
        RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S) t :=
      sub_halfPi_mem_openInterval_zero_halfPi_of_mem_openInterval_halfPi_pi
        S (And.intro hhalf_lt_x hx.right)
    have hx_eq : F.add (halfPi S) t = x :=
      by
        rw [F.add_comm (halfPi S) (F.sub x (halfPi S))]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x (halfPi S)
    have hsin := sin_halfPi_add S t
    change S.sin (F.add (halfPi S) t) = S.cos t at hsin
    rw [hx_eq] at hsin
    rw [hsin]
    exact cos_pos_openInterval_zero_halfPi S ht

name: cos_neg_openInterval_halfPi_pi
statement:
theorem cos_neg_openInterval_halfPi_pi
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval (halfPi S) (pi S) x) :
    RealTheory.lt (S.cos x) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let t := F.sub x (halfPi S)
  have ht :
      RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S) t :=
    sub_halfPi_mem_openInterval_zero_halfPi_of_mem_openInterval_halfPi_pi
      S hx
  have hx_eq : F.add (halfPi S) t = x :=
    by
      rw [F.add_comm (halfPi S) (F.sub x (halfPi S))]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x (halfPi S)
  have hcos := cos_halfPi_add S t
  change S.cos (F.add (halfPi S) t) = F.neg (S.sin t) at hcos
  rw [hx_eq] at hcos
  rw [hcos]
  have hspos := sin_pos_openInterval_zero_halfPi S ht
  have hneg := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hspos
  change F.lt (F.neg (S.sin t)) (F.neg F.zero) at hneg
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at hneg

name: sin_strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval_neg_halfPi_halfPi
statement:
theorem sin_strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval_neg_halfPi_halfPi :
    RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
        (RealTheory.neg (halfPi S)) (halfPi S)) S.sin
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval

          (RealTheory.neg (halfPi S)) (halfPi S)) S.sin := by
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun _x _hx => trivial)
      (continuousOn_sin_universal S)
  have hdiff :
      DifferentiableOnOpenInterval
        (RealTheory.neg (halfPi S)) (halfPi S) S.sin := by
    intro y hy
    exact Exists.intro (S.cos y)
      (hasDerivWithin_subset
        (fun _z _hz => trivial)
        hy
        (hasDerivWithin_sin_universal S y))
  have hderiv :
      DerivativePositiveOnOpenInterval
        (RealTheory.neg (halfPi S)) (halfPi S) S.sin := by
    intro y A hy hA
    have hsin_open :
        HasDerivWithin
          (RealTheory.OpenInterval
            (RealTheory.neg (halfPi S)) (halfPi S))
          S.sin y (S.cos y) :=
      hasDerivWithin_subset
        (fun _z _hz => trivial)
        hy
        (hasDerivWithin_sin_universal S y)
    have hA_eq_cos : A = S.cos y :=
      hasDerivWithin_unique
        (openInterval_clusterPoint hy)
        hA hsin_open
    rw [hA_eq_cos]
    exact cos_pos_openInterval_neg_halfPi_halfPi S hy
  exact strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_positive
    hfcont hdiff hderiv

name: sin_strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
statement:
theorem sin_strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi :
    RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S)) S.sin
proof:
:=
  strictMonotoneOn_sin_closedInterval_zero_of_le_halfPi
    S (halfPi_pos S)
    (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le_refl (halfPi S))

name: strictDecreasingOn_cos_closedInterval_zero_of_le_pi
statement:
private theorem strictDecreasingOn_cos_closedInterval_zero_of_le_pi
    {b : Point}
    (_hbpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hb_le_pi : RealTheory.le b (pi S)) :
    RealFunction.StrictDecreasingOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero b) S.cos
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero b) S.cos := by
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun _x _hx => trivial)
      (continuousOn_cos_universal S)
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval RealTheory.zero b S.cos := by
    intro y hy
    exact Exists.intro (F.neg (S.sin y))
      (hasDerivWithin_subset
        (fun _z _hz => trivial)
        hy
        (hasDerivWithin_cos_universal S y))
  have hderiv : DerivativeNegativeOnOpenInterval RealTheory.zero b S.cos := by
    intro y A hy hA
    have hcos_open :
        HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero b)
          S.cos y (F.neg (S.sin y)) :=
      hasDerivWithin_subset
        (fun _z _hz => trivial)
        hy
        (hasDerivWithin_cos_universal S y)
    have hA_eq : A = F.neg (S.sin y) :=
      hasDerivWithin_unique
        (openInterval_clusterPoint hy)
        hA hcos_open
    rw [hA_eq]
    have hsinpos : F.lt F.zero (S.sin y) :=
      sin_pos_openInterval_zero_pi S
        (And.intro hy.left
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hy.right hb_le_pi))
    have hneg := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hsinpos
    change F.lt (F.neg (S.sin y)) (F.neg F.zero) at hneg
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at hneg
  exact strictDecreasingOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_negative
    hfcont hdiff hderiv

name: cos_strictDecreasingOn_closedInterval_zero_pi
statement:
theorem cos_strictDecreasingOn_closedInterval_zero_pi :
    RealFunction.StrictDecreasingOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (pi S)) S.cos
proof:
:=
  strictDecreasingOn_cos_closedInterval_zero_of_le_pi
    S (pi_pos S)
    (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le_refl (pi S))

name: cos_strictDecreasingOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
statement:
theorem cos_strictDecreasingOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi :
    RealFunction.StrictDecreasingOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S)) S.cos
proof:
:=
  strictDecreasingOn_cos_closedInterval_zero_of_le_pi
    S (halfPi_pos S) (halfPi_le_pi S)

name: tendstoWithinToPosInf_tan_halfPi
statement:
theorem tendstoWithinToPosInf_tan_halfPi :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithinToPosInf
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S))
      (tan S) (halfPi S)
proof:
:= by
  intro bound
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let half := F.half F.one
  let B := F.add (F.abs bound) F.one
  let epsCos := F.mul half (F.inv B)
  have hhalf_pos : F.lt F.zero half := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  have habs_lt_B : F.lt (F.abs bound) B := by
    have h := F.add_lt_add_left RealTheory.zero_lt_one (F.abs bound)
    change F.lt (F.add (F.abs bound) F.zero)
      (F.add (F.abs bound) F.one) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hB_pos : F.lt F.zero B :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F bound) habs_lt_B
  have hbound_lt_B : F.lt bound B :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_abs_self F bound) habs_lt_B
  have hepsCos_pos : F.lt F.zero epsCos := by
    exact F.mul_pos hhalf_pos (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hB_pos)
  cases (continuousAtOn_sin_universal S (halfPi S)).right
      half hhalf_pos with
  | intro deltaSin hdeltaSin =>
      cases (continuousAtOn_cos_universal S (halfPi S)).right
          epsCos hepsCos_pos with
      | intro deltaCos hdeltaCos =>
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaSin deltaCos
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
              hdeltaSin.left hdeltaCos.left) ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxdist
          have hxdistSin : F.lt (RealFunction.dist x (halfPi S)) deltaSin :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxdist
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaSin deltaCos)
          have hxdistCos : F.lt (RealFunction.dist x (halfPi S)) deltaCos :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxdist
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaSin deltaCos)
          have hsinClose :=
            hdeltaSin.right x trivial hxne hxdistSin
          rw [sin_halfPi_eq_one S] at hsinClose
          have hsinLowerRaw :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hsinClose
          have hsinLower : F.lt half (S.sin x) := by
            have hhalfEq : F.sub F.one half = half := by
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_half_self F F.one
            change F.lt (F.sub F.one half) (S.sin x) at hsinLowerRaw
            rwa [hhalfEq] at hsinLowerRaw
          have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x := by
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx.left
            intro hxnonpos
            have hxzero : x = F.zero := F.le_antisymm hxnonpos hx.left
            have hbad : F.lt half F.zero := by
              have hsinZero : S.sin F.zero = F.zero := by
                change S.sin RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
                exact sin_zero S
              rw [hxzero, hsinZero] at hsinLower
              exact hsinLower
            have hcycle := F.lt_trans hhalf_pos hbad
            exact (F.lt_irrefl F.zero) hcycle
          have hxlt : F.lt x (halfPi S) := by
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx.right
            intro hhalfLe
            exact hxne (F.le_antisymm hx.right hhalfLe)
          have hcosPos : F.lt F.zero (S.cos x) :=
            cos_pos_openInterval_zero_halfPi S (And.intro hxpos hxlt)
          have hcosClose :=
            hdeltaCos.right x trivial hxne hxdistCos
          rw [cos_halfPi_eq_zero S] at hcosClose
          have hcosUpperRaw :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hcosClose
          have hcosUpper : F.lt (S.cos x) epsCos := by
            change F.lt (S.cos x) (F.add F.zero epsCos) at hcosUpperRaw
            rwa [F.zero_add] at hcosUpperRaw
          have hBcos_lt_half : F.lt (F.mul B (S.cos x)) half := by
            have hmul :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left F hcosUpper hB_pos
            have hB_eps : F.mul B epsCos = half := by
              unfold epsCos
              calc
                F.mul B (F.mul half (F.inv B)) =
                    F.mul (F.mul B half) (F.inv B) := by
                      exact (F.mul_assoc B half (F.inv B)).symm
                _ = F.mul (F.mul half B) (F.inv B) := by
                      rw [F.mul_comm B half]
                _ = F.mul half (F.mul B (F.inv B)) := by
                      exact F.mul_assoc half B (F.inv B)
                _ = F.mul half F.one := by
                      rw [F.mul_inv_cancel
                        (by
                          intro hzero
                          exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hB_pos)
                            hzero.symm)]
                _ = half := by rw [F.mul_one]
            rwa [hB_eps] at hmul
          have hboundCos_lt_Bcos :
              F.lt (F.mul bound (S.cos x)) (F.mul B (S.cos x)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hbound_lt_B hcosPos
          have hboundCos_lt_sin :
              F.lt (F.mul bound (S.cos x)) (S.sin x) :=
            F.lt_trans hboundCos_lt_Bcos
              (F.lt_trans hBcos_lt_half hsinLower)
          have hinvCosPos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv (S.cos x)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hcosPos
          have hscaled :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F
              hboundCos_lt_sin hinvCosPos
          have hleft :
              F.mul (F.mul bound (S.cos x)) (F.inv (S.cos x)) = bound := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel
              (by
                intro hzero
                exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hcosPos)
                  hzero.symm)]
            rw [F.mul_one]
          rw [hleft] at hscaled
          change F.lt bound
            (F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x)))
          exact hscaled

name: tendstoWithinToPosInf_tan_halfPi_of_subset
statement:
theorem tendstoWithinToPosInf_tan_halfPi_of_subset
    {E : RealFunction.Domain}
    (hE :
      SetPred.Subset E
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero (halfPi S))) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithinToPosInf E (tan S) (halfPi S)
proof:
:= by
  intro bound
  cases tendstoWithinToPosInf_tan_halfPi S bound with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta (And.intro hdelta.left ?_)
      intro x hx hxne hxdist
      exact hdelta.right x (hE x hx) hxne hxdist

name: relating
statement:
lemma relating it to the successor; that is the whole interface between the
phase machine and the order index.

## Position in the development

Above `Tautology.RealDerivative.Higher`, whose sequence form of higher
derivatives is what the cycles inhabit, and
`Tautology.RealDerivative.Trigonometric.Derivative`, which supplies the first
step. Reached through `Tautology.RealDerivative.Trigonometric`.

## Role

Implementation.
-/

namespace Tautology
namespace RealDerivative
namespace Trigonometric

open RealFunction.Trigonometric.Derived

variable (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)

private inductive TrigDerivativePhase where
  | sin
  | cos
  | negSin
  | negCos

namespace TrigDerivativePhase

private def next : TrigDerivativePhase -> TrigDerivativePhase
  | sin => cos
  | cos => negSin
  | negSin => negCos
  | negCos => sin

private noncomputable def toMap
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec) :
    TrigDerivativePhase -> Map
  | sin => S.sin
  | cos => S.cos
  | negSin => RealFunction.NegFun S.sin
  | negCos => RealFunction.NegFun S.cos

private def after (start : TrigDerivativePhase) : Nat -> TrigDerivativePhase
  | 0 => start
  | n + 1 => next (after start n)

private theorem after_succ (start : TrigDerivativePhase) (n : Nat) :
    after start (n + 1) = next (after start n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: after_succ
statement:
private theorem after_succ (start : TrigDerivativePhase) (n : Nat) :
    after start (n + 1) = next (after start n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_trigDerivativePhase_next
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_trigDerivativePhase_next
    (phase : TrigDerivativePhase) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      (TrigDerivativePhase.toMap S phase)
      (TrigDerivativePhase.toMap S phase.next)
proof:
:= by
  cases phase with
  | sin =>
      exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_sin_universal S
  | cos =>
      exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_cos_universal S
  | negSin =>
      exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_neg
        (hasDerivativeWithinOn_sin_universal S)
  | negCos =>
      have hraw :
          HasDerivativeWithinOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
            (TrigDerivativePhase.toMap S TrigDerivativePhase.negCos)
            (RealFunction.NegFun
              (fun x : Point => RealTheory.neg (S.sin x))) :=
        hasDerivativeWithinOn_neg
          (hasDerivativeWithinOn_cos_universal S)
      exact
        hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
          (fun x _hx => by
            unfold TrigDerivativePhase.toMap
            unfold RealFunction.NegFun
            change
              RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.neg (S.sin x)) =
                S.sin x
            exact RealTheory.neg_neg (S.sin x))
          hraw

name: continuousOn_trigDerivativePhase_toMap
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_trigDerivativePhase_toMap
    {E : Domain} (phase : TrigDerivativePhase) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
      (TrigDerivativePhase.toMap S phase)
proof:
:= by
  cases phase with
  | sin =>
      exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
        (fun _x _hx => trivial)
        (continuousOn_sin_universal S)
  | cos =>
      exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
        (fun _x _hx => trivial)
        (continuousOn_cos_universal S)
  | negSin =>
      exact RealFunction.continuousOn_neg
        (RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
          (fun _x _hx => trivial)
          (continuousOn_sin_universal S))
  | negCos =>
      exact RealFunction.continuousOn_neg
        (RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
          (fun _x _hx => trivial)
          (continuousOn_cos_universal S))

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_trigDerivativePhase_next_subset
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_trigDerivativePhase_next_subset
    {E : Domain} (phase : TrigDerivativePhase) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (TrigDerivativePhase.toMap S phase)
      (TrigDerivativePhase.toMap S phase.next)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact hasDerivWithin_subset
    (fun _y _hy => trivial)
    hx
    ((hasDerivativeWithinOn_trigDerivativePhase_next S phase) x trivial)

name: hasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn_sinDerivativeCycle
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn_sinDerivativeCycle :
    HasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      S.sin (sinDerivativeCycle S)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?same ?step
  · intro x _hx
    unfold sinDerivativeCycle
    unfold TrigDerivativePhase.after
    unfold TrigDerivativePhase.toMap
    rfl
  · intro k
    unfold sinDerivativeCycle
    change
      HasDerivativeWithinOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (TrigDerivativePhase.toMap S
          (TrigDerivativePhase.after TrigDerivativePhase.sin k))
        (TrigDerivativePhase.toMap S
          (TrigDerivativePhase.after TrigDerivativePhase.sin (k + 1)))
    rw [TrigDerivativePhase.after_succ]
    exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_trigDerivativePhase_next
      S (TrigDerivativePhase.after TrigDerivativePhase.sin k)

name: hasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn_cosDerivativeCycle
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn_cosDerivativeCycle :
    HasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      S.cos (cosDerivativeCycle S)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?same ?step
  · intro x _hx
    unfold cosDerivativeCycle
    unfold TrigDerivativePhase.after
    unfold TrigDerivativePhase.toMap
    rfl
  · intro k
    unfold cosDerivativeCycle
    change
      HasDerivativeWithinOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (TrigDerivativePhase.toMap S
          (TrigDerivativePhase.after TrigDerivativePhase.cos k))
        (TrigDerivativePhase.toMap S
          (TrigDerivativePhase.after TrigDerivativePhase.cos (k + 1)))
    rw [TrigDerivativePhase.after_succ]
    exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_trigDerivativePhase_next
      S (TrigDerivativePhase.after TrigDerivativePhase.cos k)

name: hasNthDerivWithin_sin_cycle
statement:
theorem hasNthDerivWithin_sin_cycle
    (n : Nat) (x : Point) :
    HasNthDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain n S.sin x
      (sinDerivativeCycle S n x)
proof:
:=
  hasNthDerivWithin_of_derivative_sequence
    (hasDerivativeSequenceWithinOn_sinDerivativeCycle S) trivial

statement:

name: sub_add_self_eq_neg
statement:
private theorem sub_add_self_eq_neg
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.sub a (F.add b a) = F.neg b
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.add_comm b a]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F a b]
  calc
    F.add a (F.add (F.neg a) (F.neg b)) =
        F.add (F.add a (F.neg a)) (F.neg b) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add F.zero (F.neg b) := by rw [F.add_neg]
    _ = F.neg b := by rw [F.zero_add]

name: sub_one_mul_one_add_eq_sub_sq_one
statement:
private theorem sub_one_mul_one_add_eq_sub_sq_one
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (c : Point) :
    F.mul (F.sub c F.one) (F.add F.one c) =
      F.sub (F.mul c c) F.one
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.sub c F.one) (F.add F.one c) =
        F.sub
          (F.mul c (F.add F.one c))
          (F.mul F.one (F.add F.one c)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F]
    _ =
        F.sub
          (F.add (F.mul c c) c)
          (F.add F.one c) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
          rw [F.mul_one]
          rw [F.one_mul]
          rw [F.add_comm c (F.mul c c)]
    _ =
        F.add
          (F.sub (F.mul c c) F.one)
          (F.sub c c) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F]
    _ =
        F.add
          (F.sub (F.mul c c) F.one)
          F.zero := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F c]
    _ = F.sub (F.mul c c) F.one := by
          rw [F.add_zero]

name: cos_sub_one_mul_one_add_cos_eq_neg_sin_sq
statement:
private theorem cos_sub_one_mul_one_add_cos_eq_neg_sin_sq
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (h : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.sub (S.cos h) RealTheory.one)
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (S.cos h)) =
      RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul (S.sin h) (S.sin h))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := S.sin h
  let c := S.cos h
  have hunit :
      F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul c c) = F.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin h) (S.sin h))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos h) (S.cos h)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S h
  change F.mul (F.sub c F.one) (F.add F.one c) =
    F.neg (F.mul s s)
  calc
    F.mul (F.sub c F.one) (F.add F.one c) =
        F.sub (F.mul c c) F.one :=
          sub_one_mul_one_add_eq_sub_sq_one F c
    _ = F.sub (F.mul c c) (F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul c c)) := by
          rw [hunit]
    _ = F.neg (F.mul s s) :=
          sub_add_self_eq_neg F (F.mul c c) (F.mul s s)

name: mul_four_rearrange
statement:
private theorem mul_four_rearrange
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a b) c) d =
      F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul b c)
proof:
:= by
  have hinner :
      F.mul b (F.mul c d) = F.mul d (F.mul b c) := by
    calc
      F.mul b (F.mul c d) =
          F.mul b (F.mul d c) := by rw [F.mul_comm c d]

      _ = F.mul (F.mul b d) c := by rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul d b) c := by rw [F.mul_comm b d]
      _ = F.mul d (F.mul b c) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a b) c) d =
        F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul b (F.mul c d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul d (F.mul b c)) := by
          rw [hinner]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul b c) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: neg_square_inv_mul_inv_eq_model
statement:
private theorem neg_square_inv_mul_inv_eq_model
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (s h den : Point) :
    F.mul (F.mul (F.neg (F.mul s s)) (F.inv den)) (F.inv h) =
      F.neg
        (F.mul
          (F.mul s (F.inv h))
          (F.mul s (F.inv den)))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.neg (F.mul s s)) (F.inv den)) (F.inv h) =
        F.mul
          (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul s s) (F.inv den)))
          (F.inv h) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F (F.mul s s) (F.inv den)]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (F.mul s s) (F.inv den))
            (F.inv h)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F
            (F.mul (F.mul s s) (F.inv den)) (F.inv h)]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.mul
            (F.mul s (F.inv h))
            (F.mul s (F.inv den))) := by
          rw [mul_four_rearrange F s s (F.inv den) (F.inv h)]

name: sin_zero_differenceQuotient_eq
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  change
    F.mul
      (F.sub (S.sin x) (S.sin F.zero))
      (F.inv (F.sub x F.zero)) =
    F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv x)
  have hsin0 : S.sin F.zero = F.zero := by
    change S.sin RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
    exact sin_zero S
  rw [hsin0]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (S.sin x)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F x]

name: sin_zero_differenceQuotient_neg
statement:
private theorem sin_zero_differenceQuotient_neg
    {x : Point} (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.neg x) =
      DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero (F.neg x) =
      DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero x
  rw [sin_zero_differenceQuotient_eq S (F.neg x)]
  rw [sin_zero_differenceQuotient_eq S x]
  change
    F.mul (S.sin (F.neg x)) (F.inv (F.neg x)) =
      F.mul (S.sin x) (F.inv x)
  have hsinneg : S.sin (F.neg x) = F.neg (S.sin x) := by
    change S.sin (RealTheory.neg x) = RealTheory.neg (S.sin x)
    exact sin_neg S x
  rw [hsinneg]
  have hinvneg : F.inv (F.neg x) = F.neg (F.inv x) := by
    change
      RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg x) =
        RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.inv x)
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_neg_of_ne_zero F hx
  rw [hinvneg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F (S.sin x) (F.inv x)]

name: mul_self_inv_right
statement:
private theorem mul_self_inv_right
    {x y : Point} (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.inv x)) = y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.mul x (F.mul y (F.inv x)) = y
  calc
    F.mul x (F.mul y (F.inv x)) =
        F.mul y (F.mul x (F.inv x)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
          rw [F.mul_comm x y]
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul y F.one := by rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hx]
    _ = y := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: sin_zero_differenceQuotient_bounds_of_pos
statement:
private theorem sin_zero_differenceQuotient_bounds_of_pos
    (localOrder :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero z ->
          RealTheory.lt z delta ->
            And
              (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.mul z (S.cos z)))
              (And
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.mul z (S.cos z))
                  (S.sin z))
                (RealTheory.lt (S.sin z) z)))
    {h : Point}
    (hhpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hhlt : RealTheory.lt h delta) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le (S.cos h)
        (DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero h))
      (RealTheory.le
        (DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero h)
        RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by

  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hloc := localOrder h hhpos hhlt
  have hhne : Not (h = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    have hzero_eq_h : F.zero = h := hzero.symm
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hhpos) hzero_eq_h
  have hdq :
      DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero h =
        F.mul (S.sin h) (F.inv h) := by
    change
      DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero h =
        RealTheory.mul (S.sin h) (RealTheory.inv h)
    exact sin_zero_differenceQuotient_eq S h
  have hmul_cancel :
      F.mul h (F.mul (S.sin h) (F.inv h)) = S.sin h := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul h
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin h) (RealTheory.inv h)) =
        S.sin h
    exact mul_self_inv_right hhne
  have hlower_lt :
      F.lt (S.cos h) (F.mul (S.sin h) (F.inv h)) := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_left
      F (z := h) ?_ hhpos
    rw [hmul_cancel]
    exact hloc.right.left
  have hupper_lt :
      F.lt (F.mul (S.sin h) (F.inv h)) F.one := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_left
      F (z := h) ?_ hhpos
    rw [hmul_cancel]
    rw [F.mul_one]
    exact hloc.right.right
  rw [hdq]
  exact And.intro
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlower_lt)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hupper_lt)

name: eventually_sin_zero_differenceQuotient_between_cos_one
statement:
private theorem eventually_sin_zero_differenceQuotient_between_cos_one :
    RealFunction.EventuallyWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain RealTheory.zero
      (fun h : Point =>
        And
          (RealTheory.le (S.cos h)
            (DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero h))
          (RealTheory.le
            (DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero h)
            RealTheory.one))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases S.local_order with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro h _hh hne hdist
      unfold RealFunction.dist at hdist
      change
        F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub h F.zero)) delta
          at hdist
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F h] at hdist
      by_cases h0h : F.le F.zero h
      · have hhpos : F.lt F.zero h := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0h
          intro hh0
          have hzero : h = F.zero := F.le_antisymm hh0 h0h
          exact hne hzero
        have hhlt : F.lt h delta := by
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F h0h] at hdist
        exact
          sin_zero_differenceQuotient_bounds_of_pos
            S hdelta.right hhpos hhlt
      · have hh_nonpos : F.le h F.zero :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F h0h
        have hh_neg : F.lt h F.zero := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hh_nonpos
          intro hzero_le_h
          exact h0h hzero_le_h
        have hneg_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.neg h) := by
          have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hh_neg
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
        have hneg_lt_delta : F.lt (F.neg h) delta := by
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F hh_nonpos] at hdist
        have hbounds :=
          sin_zero_differenceQuotient_bounds_of_pos
            S hdelta.right hneg_pos hneg_lt_delta
        have hcos :
            S.cos (F.neg h) = S.cos h := by
          change S.cos (RealTheory.neg h) = S.cos h
          exact cos_neg S h
        have hdq :
            DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero (F.neg h) =
              DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero h := by
          change
            DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero
              (RealTheory.neg h) =
            DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero h
          exact sin_zero_differenceQuotient_neg S hne
        rw [hcos, hdq] at hbounds
        exact hbounds

name: tendsto_sin_zero_differenceQuotient_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_sin_zero_differenceQuotient_one :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      (DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero)
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hbounds :=
    eventually_sin_zero_differenceQuotient_between_cos_one S
  exact
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_of_squeeze
      (tendsto_cos_one_at_zero S)
      (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
        RealFunction.UniversalDomain RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero)
      (RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_mono
        (fun h hh => hh.left) hbounds)
      (RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_mono
        (fun h hh => hh.right) hbounds)

name: cos_zero_differenceQuotient_eq
statement:
private theorem cos_zero_differenceQuotient_eq (h : Point) :
    DifferenceQuotient S.cos RealTheory.zero h =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub (S.cos h) RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv h)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base

  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  change
    F.mul
      (F.sub (S.cos h) (S.cos F.zero))
      (F.inv (F.sub h F.zero)) =
    F.mul (F.sub (S.cos h) F.one) (F.inv h)
  have hcos0 : S.cos F.zero = F.one := by
    change S.cos RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
    exact cos_zero S
  rw [hcos0]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F h]

name: cos_zero_differenceQuotient_model_eq
statement:
private theorem cos_zero_differenceQuotient_model_eq
    {h : Point}
    (hden :
      Not
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (S.cos h) =
          RealTheory.zero)) :
    CosZeroDifferenceQuotientModel S h =
      DifferenceQuotient S.cos RealTheory.zero h
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := S.sin h
  let c := S.cos h
  let den := F.add F.one c
  have hcosdq :
      DifferenceQuotient S.cos RealTheory.zero h =
        F.mul (F.sub c F.one) (F.inv h) := by
    change
      DifferenceQuotient S.cos RealTheory.zero h =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (S.cos h) RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv h)
    exact cos_zero_differenceQuotient_eq S h
  have hsindq :
      DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero h =
        F.mul s (F.inv h) := by
    change
      DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero h =
        RealTheory.mul (S.sin h) (RealTheory.inv h)
    exact sin_zero_differenceQuotient_eq S h
  have hdenF : Not (den = F.zero) := by
    change
      Not
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (S.cos h) =
          RealTheory.zero)
    exact hden
  have hcosSub :
      F.sub c F.one =
        F.mul (F.neg (F.mul s s)) (F.inv den) := by
    calc
      F.sub c F.one =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.sub c F.one) den) (F.inv den) := by
          exact
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right
              F (F.sub c F.one) hdenF).symm
      _ = F.mul (F.neg (F.mul s s)) (F.inv den) := by
          have hprod :
              F.mul (F.sub c F.one) den =
                F.neg (F.mul s s) := by
            change
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.sub (S.cos h) RealTheory.one)
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (S.cos h)) =
                RealTheory.neg
                  (RealTheory.mul (S.sin h) (S.sin h))
            exact cos_sub_one_mul_one_add_cos_eq_neg_sin_sq S h
          rw [hprod]
  unfold CosZeroDifferenceQuotientModel
  unfold SinOverOnePlusCosFun
  unfold OnePlusCosFun
  unfold RealFunction.NegFun RealFunction.MulFun
  unfold RealFunction.InvFun RealFunction.AddFun
  change
    F.neg
      (F.mul
        (DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero h)
        (F.mul s (F.inv den))) =
      DifferenceQuotient S.cos RealTheory.zero h
  rw [hsindq, hcosdq, hcosSub]
  exact
    (neg_square_inv_mul_inv_eq_model F s h den).symm

name: eventually_one_add_cos_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem eventually_one_add_cos_ne_zero :
    RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
      RealFunction.UniversalDomain RealTheory.zero
      (fun h : Point =>
        Not
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (S.cos h) =
            RealTheory.zero))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcospos :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        RealFunction.UniversalDomain RealTheory.zero
        (fun h : Point => F.lt F.zero (S.cos h)) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_eventually_lt_of_limit_lt
      (tendsto_cos_one_at_zero S)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
  cases hcospos with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro h hh hne hdist
      have hcpos := hdelta.right h hh hne hdist
      have hdenpos :
          F.lt F.zero (F.add F.one (S.cos h)) := by
        have h :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) hcpos
        rwa [F.zero_add] at h
      intro hzero
      exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hdenpos) hzero.symm

name: eventually_cos_zero_differenceQuotient_model_eq
statement:
private theorem eventually_cos_zero_differenceQuotient_model_eq :
    RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
      RealFunction.UniversalDomain RealTheory.zero
      (fun h : Point =>
        CosZeroDifferenceQuotientModel S h =
          DifferenceQuotient S.cos RealTheory.zero h)
proof:
:= by
  cases eventually_one_add_cos_ne_zero S with
  | intro delta hdelta =>

      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro h hh hne hdist
      exact
        cos_zero_differenceQuotient_model_eq
          S (hdelta.right h hh hne hdist)

name: tendsto_cos_zero_differenceQuotient_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_cos_zero_differenceQuotient_zero :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      (DifferenceQuotient S.cos RealTheory.zero)
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hdenTendsto :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (OnePlusCosFun S) RealTheory.zero
        (F.add F.one F.one) := by
    unfold OnePlusCosFun
    change
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (RealFunction.AddFun (fun _ : Point => F.one) S.cos)
        F.zero (F.add F.one F.one)
    exact
      RealFunction.tendstoWithin_add
        (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
          RealFunction.UniversalDomain F.one F.zero)
        (tendsto_cos_one_at_zero S)
  have htwo_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.add F.one F.one) := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have htwo_ne : Not (F.add F.one F.one = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F htwo_pos) hzero.symm
  have hdenInv :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (RealFunction.InvFun (OnePlusCosFun S)) RealTheory.zero
        (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one)) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_inv hdenTendsto htwo_ne
  have hsinOverRaw :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (SinOverOnePlusCosFun S) RealTheory.zero
        (F.mul F.zero (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one))) := by
    unfold SinOverOnePlusCosFun
    exact
      RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul
        (tendsto_sin_zero_at_zero S)
        hdenInv
  have hsinOver :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (SinOverOnePlusCosFun S) RealTheory.zero
        RealTheory.zero := by
    have hzero :
        F.mul F.zero (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one)) = F.zero := by
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one))
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hzero hsinOverRaw
  have hprodRaw :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero)
          (SinOverOnePlusCosFun S))
        RealTheory.zero (F.mul F.one F.zero) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul
      (tendsto_sin_zero_differenceQuotient_one S)
      hsinOver
  have hprod :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (DifferenceQuotient S.sin RealTheory.zero)
          (SinOverOnePlusCosFun S))
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
    have hzero : F.mul F.one F.zero = F.zero := by
      exact F.mul_zero F.one
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hzero hprodRaw
  have hmodelRaw :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (CosZeroDifferenceQuotientModel S)
        RealTheory.zero (F.neg F.zero) := by
    unfold CosZeroDifferenceQuotientModel
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_neg hprod
  have hmodel :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (CosZeroDifferenceQuotientModel S)
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
    have hzero : F.neg F.zero = F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hzero hmodelRaw
  exact
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_eventually
      (eventually_cos_zero_differenceQuotient_model_eq S)
      hmodel

name: hasDerivWithin_sin_zero
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_sin_zero :
    HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      S.sin RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
proof:
:=
  And.intro trivial (tendsto_sin_zero_differenceQuotient_one S)

name: hasDerivWithin_cos_zero
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_cos_zero :
    HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      S.cos RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
proof:
:=
  And.intro trivial (tendsto_cos_zero_differenceQuotient_zero S)

name: shifted_center_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem shifted_center_eq_zero (x0 : Point) :
    SubCenterMap x0 x0 = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold SubCenterMap
  change F.sub x0 x0 = F.zero
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F x0

name: hasDerivWithin_shifted_sin
statement:
private theorem hasDerivWithin_shifted_sin
    (x0 : Point) :
    HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      (ShiftedSinFun S x0) x0 RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hshift :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_subCenterMap
      RealFunction.UniversalDomain x0 x0 trivial
  have hbase :
      HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain

        S.sin (SubCenterMap x0 x0) RealTheory.one := by
    rw [shifted_center_eq_zero x0]
    exact hasDerivWithin_sin_zero S
  have hcomp :
      HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (ShiftedSinFun S x0) x0
        (F.mul F.one F.one) := by
    unfold ShiftedSinFun
    exact
      hasDerivWithin_comp
        hshift hbase
        (fun _ _ _ _ => trivial)
  refine And.intro hcomp.left ?_
  have hlim : F.mul F.one F.one = F.one := by
    rw [F.one_mul]
  exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim hcomp.right

name: hasDerivWithin_shifted_cos
statement:
private theorem hasDerivWithin_shifted_cos
    (x0 : Point) :
    HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      (ShiftedCosFun S x0) x0 RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hshift :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_subCenterMap
      RealFunction.UniversalDomain x0 x0 trivial
  have hbase :
      HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        S.cos (SubCenterMap x0 x0) RealTheory.zero := by
    rw [shifted_center_eq_zero x0]
    exact hasDerivWithin_cos_zero S
  have hcomp :
      HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (ShiftedCosFun S x0) x0
        (F.mul F.zero F.one) := by
    unfold ShiftedCosFun
    exact
      hasDerivWithin_comp
        hshift hbase
        (fun _ _ _ _ => trivial)
  refine And.intro hcomp.left ?_
  have hlim : F.mul F.zero F.one = F.zero := by
    rw [F.zero_mul]
  exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim hcomp.right

name: add_base_sub_eq_self
statement:
private theorem add_base_sub_eq_self (y x0 : Point) :
    RealTheory.add x0 (RealTheory.sub y x0) = y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.add x0 (F.sub y x0) = y
  rw [F.add_comm x0 (F.sub y x0)]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y x0

name: sin_addition_model_sameOn
proof:
:= by
  intro y _hy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := sin_add S x0 (SubCenterMap x0 y)
  have hadd :
      RealTheory.add x0 (SubCenterMap x0 y) = y := by
    unfold SubCenterMap
    exact add_base_sub_eq_self y x0
  rw [hadd] at h
  unfold SinAdditionDerivativeModel
  unfold ShiftedSinFun ShiftedCosFun
  unfold ConstMulFun
  unfold RealFunction.AddFun RealFunction.CompFun
  change
    F.add
      (F.mul (S.sin x0) (S.cos (SubCenterMap x0 y)))
      (F.mul (S.cos x0) (S.sin (SubCenterMap x0 y))) =
      S.sin y
  exact h.symm

name: cos_addition_model_sameOn
proof:
:= by
  intro y _hy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := cos_add S x0 (SubCenterMap x0 y)
  have hadd :
      RealTheory.add x0 (SubCenterMap x0 y) = y := by
    unfold SubCenterMap
    exact add_base_sub_eq_self y x0
  rw [hadd] at h
  unfold CosAdditionDerivativeModel
  unfold ShiftedSinFun ShiftedCosFun
  unfold ConstMulFun
  unfold RealFunction.SubFun RealFunction.CompFun
  change
    F.sub
      (F.mul (S.cos x0) (S.cos (SubCenterMap x0 y)))
      (F.mul (S.sin x0) (S.sin (SubCenterMap x0 y))) =
      S.cos y
  exact h.symm

name: hasDerivWithin_sin_universal
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_sin_universal (x0 : Point) :
    HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      S.sin x0 (S.cos x0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcosShift := hasDerivWithin_shifted_cos S x0
  have hsinShift := hasDerivWithin_shifted_sin S x0
  have hmodelRaw :
      HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (SinAdditionDerivativeModel S x0) x0
        (F.add
          (F.mul (S.sin x0) F.zero)
          (F.mul (S.cos x0) F.one)) := by
    unfold SinAdditionDerivativeModel
    exact
      hasDerivWithin_add
        (hasDerivWithin_constMul
          (c := S.sin x0) hcosShift)
        (hasDerivWithin_constMul
          (c := S.cos x0) hsinShift)
  have hmodel :
      HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (SinAdditionDerivativeModel S x0) x0
        (S.cos x0) := by
    refine And.intro hmodelRaw.left ?_
    have hlim :

        F.add
          (F.mul (S.sin x0) F.zero)
          (F.mul (S.cos x0) F.one) =
        S.cos x0 := by
      rw [F.mul_zero]
      rw [F.mul_one]
      rw [F.zero_add]
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim hmodelRaw.right
  exact
    hasDerivWithin_congr
      (sin_addition_model_sameOn S x0)
      hmodel

name: hasDerivWithin_cos_universal
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_cos_universal (x0 : Point) :
    HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      S.cos x0 (RealTheory.neg (S.sin x0))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcosShift := hasDerivWithin_shifted_cos S x0
  have hsinShift := hasDerivWithin_shifted_sin S x0
  have hmodelRaw :
      HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (CosAdditionDerivativeModel S x0) x0
        (F.sub
          (F.mul (S.cos x0) F.zero)
          (F.mul (S.sin x0) F.one)) := by
    unfold CosAdditionDerivativeModel
    exact
      hasDerivWithin_sub
        (hasDerivWithin_constMul
          (c := S.cos x0) hcosShift)
        (hasDerivWithin_constMul
          (c := S.sin x0) hsinShift)
  have hmodel :
      HasDerivWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (CosAdditionDerivativeModel S x0) x0
        (RealTheory.neg (S.sin x0)) := by
    refine And.intro hmodelRaw.left ?_
    have hlim :
        F.sub
          (F.mul (S.cos x0) F.zero)
          (F.mul (S.sin x0) F.one) =
        F.neg (S.sin x0) := by
      rw [F.mul_zero]
      rw [F.mul_one]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F (S.sin x0)]
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim hmodelRaw.right
  exact
    hasDerivWithin_congr
      (cos_addition_model_sameOn S x0)
      hmodel

name: square_mul_inv_square_eq_one
statement:
private theorem square_mul_inv_square_eq_one
    {a : Point}
    (ha : Not (a = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul a a)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv a) (RealTheory.inv a)) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let ia := F.inv a
  change F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul ia ia) = F.one
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul ia ia) =
        F.mul a (F.mul a (F.mul ia ia)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul a ia) ia) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc a ia ia]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul F.one ia) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel ha]
    _ = F.mul a ia := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel ha]

name: product_square_eq_square_product
statement:
private theorem product_square_eq_square_product
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul a b) =
      F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul a b) =
        F.mul a (F.mul b (F.mul a b)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul b a) b) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc b a b]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul a b) b) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm b a]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul a (F.mul b b)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc a b b]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: one_add_square_mul_inv_square_eq_inv_square
statement:
private theorem one_add_square_mul_inv_square_eq_inv_square
    (a b : Point)
    (hunit :
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul a a) (RealTheory.mul b b) =
        RealTheory.one)
    (hb : Not (b = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul a a)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv b) (RealTheory.inv b))) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv b) (RealTheory.inv b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [<- square_mul_inv_square_eq_one hb]
  rw [<- RealTheory.add_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.add_comm (RealTheory.mul b b) (RealTheory.mul a a)]
  rw [hunit, RealTheory.one_mul]

name: tan_rawDerivativeValue_eq_inv_cos_sq
statement:
private theorem tan_rawDerivativeValue_eq_inv_cos_sq
    {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S x) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (RealTheory.inv (S.cos x)))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x)
          (RealTheory.neg
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.neg (S.sin x))
                (RealTheory.inv (S.cos x)))
              (RealTheory.inv (S.cos x))))) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.inv (S.cos x))
        (RealTheory.inv (S.cos x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := S.sin x
  let c := S.cos x
  let i := F.inv c
  let s2 := F.mul s s
  let c2 := F.mul c c
  let i2 := F.mul i i
  have hunit : F.add s2 c2 = F.one := by
    unfold s2 c2 s c
    change
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x
  have hneg :
      F.neg (F.mul (F.mul (F.neg s) i) i) =
        F.mul (F.mul s i) i := by
    calc
      F.neg (F.mul (F.mul (F.neg s) i) i) =
          F.neg (F.mul (F.neg (F.mul s i)) i) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul]
      _ = F.neg (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul s i) i)) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul s i) i := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg]
  have hterm :
      F.mul s (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul (F.neg s) i) i)) =
        F.mul s2 i2 := by
    rw [hneg]
    unfold s2 i2
    calc
      F.mul s (F.mul (F.mul s i) i) =
          F.mul (F.mul s (F.mul s i)) i := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul s s) i) i := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc s s i]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul s s) (F.mul i i) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
  change
    F.add (F.mul c i)
      (F.mul s (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul (F.neg s) i) i))) =
    F.mul i i
  rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hcos]
  rw [hterm]
  change F.add F.one (F.mul s2 i2) = i2
  exact one_add_square_mul_inv_square_eq_inv_square
    s c hunit hcos

name: cot_rawDerivativeValue_eq_neg_inv_sin_sq
statement:
private theorem cot_rawDerivativeValue_eq_neg_inv_sin_sq
    {x : Point}
    (hsin : SinNonzero S x) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.neg (S.sin x))
          (RealTheory.inv (S.sin x)))
        (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x)
          (RealTheory.neg
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x)
                (RealTheory.inv (S.sin x)))
              (RealTheory.inv (S.sin x))))) =
      RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.inv (S.sin x))
          (RealTheory.inv (S.sin x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := S.sin x
  let c := S.cos x
  let j := F.inv s
  let s2 := F.mul s s
  let c2 := F.mul c c
  let j2 := F.mul j j
  have hunit : F.add s2 c2 = F.one := by
    unfold s2 c2 s c
    change
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x
  have hfirst :
      F.mul (F.neg s) j = F.neg F.one := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.neg s) j =
          F.neg (F.mul s j) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul]
      _ = F.neg F.one := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hsin]
  have hterm :
      F.mul c (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul c j) j)) =
        F.neg (F.mul c2 j2) := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
    congr 1
    unfold c2 j2
    calc
      F.mul c (F.mul (F.mul c j) j) =
          F.mul (F.mul c (F.mul c j)) j := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul c c) j) j := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc c c j]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul j j) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
  have hone_add_c2j2 :
      F.add F.one (F.mul c2 j2) = j2 := by
    have hunit_comm : F.add c2 s2 = F.one := by
      rw [F.add_comm c2 s2]
      exact hunit
    exact one_add_square_mul_inv_square_eq_inv_square
      c s hunit_comm hsin
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.neg s) j)
      (F.mul c (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul c j) j))) =
    F.neg j2
  rw [hfirst, hterm]
  calc
    F.add (F.neg F.one) (F.neg (F.mul c2 j2)) =
        F.neg (F.add F.one (F.mul c2 j2)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib]
    _ = F.neg j2 := by
          rw [hone_add_c2j2]

name: one_add_tan_sq_eq_inv_cos_sq
statement:
private theorem one_add_tan_sq_eq_inv_cos_sq
    {x : Point}
    (hcos : CosNonzero S x) :
    RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (tan S x) (tan S x)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.inv (S.cos x))
        (RealTheory.inv (S.cos x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := S.sin x
  let c := S.cos x
  let i := F.inv c
  let s2 := F.mul s s
  let c2 := F.mul c c
  let i2 := F.mul i i
  have hunit : F.add s2 c2 = F.one := by
    unfold s2 c2 s c
    change
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x
  have htan2 :
      F.mul (tan S x) (tan S x) = F.mul s2 i2 := by
    unfold tan s2 i2 s i c
    exact product_square_eq_square_product F
      (S.sin x) (F.inv (S.cos x))
  change F.add F.one (F.mul (tan S x) (tan S x)) = F.mul i i
  rw [htan2]
  change F.add F.one (F.mul s2 i2) = i2
  exact one_add_square_mul_inv_square_eq_inv_square
    s c hunit hcos

name: one_add_cot_sq_eq_inv_sin_sq
statement:
private theorem one_add_cot_sq_eq_inv_sin_sq
    {x : Point}
    (hsin : SinNonzero S x) :
    RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (cot S x) (cot S x)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.inv (S.sin x))
        (RealTheory.inv (S.sin x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := S.sin x
  let c := S.cos x
  let j := F.inv s
  let s2 := F.mul s s
  let c2 := F.mul c c
  let j2 := F.mul j j
  have hunit : F.add s2 c2 = F.one := by
    unfold s2 c2 s c
    change
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (S.sin x) (S.sin x))
          (RealTheory.mul (S.cos x) (S.cos x)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq S x
  have hcot2 :
      F.mul (cot S x) (cot S x) = F.mul c2 j2 := by
    unfold cot c2 j2 c j s
    exact product_square_eq_square_product F
      (S.cos x) (F.inv (S.sin x))
  change F.add F.one (F.mul (cot S x) (cot S x)) = F.mul j j
  rw [hcot2]
  change F.add F.one (F.mul c2 j2) = j2
  have hunit_comm : F.add c2 s2 = F.one := by
    rw [F.add_comm c2 s2]
    exact hunit
  exact one_add_square_mul_inv_square_eq_inv_square
    c s hunit_comm hsin

name: hasDerivWithin_tan_universal_inv_cos_sq

statement:

name: cantorStaircase_hasDerivWithin_zero_of_not_cantorSet
statement:
private theorem cantorStaircase_hasDerivWithin_zero_of_not_cantorSet
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one x)
    (hxC : Not (RealNegligibility.CantorSet x)) :
    HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one)
      RealFunction.Curve.cantorStaircase x RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealFunction.Curve.cantorStaircase_locallyConstant_off_cantorSet hxC with
  | intro radius hradius =>
      refine And.intro hx ?_
      intro eps heps
      refine Exists.intro radius ?_
      refine And.intro hradius.left ?_
      intro y _hy _hyne hydist
      have hclose : F.lt (F.abs (F.sub y x)) radius := hydist
      have hvalue := hradius.right y hclose
      unfold DifferenceQuotient
      have hdq :
          F.mul
              (F.sub
                (RealFunction.Curve.cantorStaircase y)
                (RealFunction.Curve.cantorStaircase x))
              (F.inv (F.sub y x)) = F.zero := by
        rw [hvalue, F.sub_self, F.zero_mul]
      change
        F.lt
          (RealFunction.dist
            (F.mul
              (F.sub
                (RealFunction.Curve.cantorStaircase y)
                (RealFunction.Curve.cantorStaircase x))
              (F.inv (F.sub y x)))
            F.zero)
          eps
      rw [hdq, RealFunction.dist_self]
      exact heps

name: cantorStaircase_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE_zero

theorem cantorStaircase_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE_zero :
    HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
      RealFunction.Curve.cantorStaircase
      (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
  unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn
  apply RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
    (F := RealNegligibility.CantorSet)
  · intro x hx
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hxC
    exact hx.right
      (cantorStaircase_hasDerivWithin_zero_of_not_cantorSet hx.left hxC)
  · exact RealNegligibility.nullSet_cantorSet

name: exists_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
statement:
theorem exists_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
    {F : Map} {a b : Point}
    (hAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval F a b) :
    Exists (fun g : Map =>
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b F g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases habEq : a = b
  · subst b
    refine Exists.intro (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero) ?_
    unfold HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
    unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn
    exact RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
      (F := fun _ : Point => False)
      (fun _t ht =>
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl C a)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans C ht.left.left ht.left.right))
      RealNegligibility.nullSet_empty
  · have hab : RealTheory.lt a b := by
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le C hAC.left
      intro hba
      exact habEq (RealTheory.le_antisymm hAC.left hba)
    have hBV : BoundedVariationOn a b F :=
      boundedVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hAC
    have hdiff :
        RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
          (fun t : Point =>
            DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F t) :=
      BoundedVariation.boundedVariationOn_closedInterval_differentiableWithin_ae
        hab hBV
    let g : Map := fun t : Point =>
      if ht : DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F t then
        Classical.choose ht
      else RealTheory.zero
    refine Exists.intro g ?_
    unfold HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
    unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn at hdiff ⊢
    exact RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
      (E := fun t : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b t)
          (Not (HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) F t (g t))))
      (F := fun t : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b t)
          (Not (DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F t)))
      (fun t ht => by
        refine And.intro ht.left ?_
        intro hdiffClosed
        have hchosen :
            HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F t (g t) := by
          unfold g
          rw [dif_pos hdiffClosed]
          exact Classical.choose_spec hdiffClosed
        exact ht.right
          (And.intro ht.left
            (tendstoWithin_of_subset
              (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b)
              hchosen.right)))
      hdiff

name: normalizedShearP_base

name: sub_sub_same_right_local
statement:
private theorem sub_sub_same_right_local
    (x y c : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub y c) (RealTheory.sub x c) =
      RealTheory.sub y x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.sub (F.sub y c) (F.sub x c) = F.sub y x
  calc
    F.sub (F.sub y c) (F.sub x c) =
        F.sub (F.add y (F.neg c)) (F.add x (F.neg c)) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg y c, F.sub_eq_add_neg x c]
    _ = F.add (F.sub y x) (F.sub (F.neg c) (F.neg c)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub]
    _ = F.add (F.sub y x) F.zero := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self]
    _ = F.sub y x := by rw [F.add_zero]

name: sub_sub_sub_sub_local
statement:
private theorem sub_sub_sub_sub_local
    (A B C D : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub A B) (RealTheory.sub C D) =
      RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub A C) (RealTheory.sub B D)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.sub (F.sub A B) (F.sub C D) =
    F.sub (F.sub A C) (F.sub B D)
  calc
    F.sub (F.sub A B) (F.sub C D) =
        F.sub (F.add A (F.neg B)) (F.add C (F.neg D)) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg A B, F.sub_eq_add_neg C D]
    _ = F.add (F.sub A C) (F.sub (F.neg B) (F.neg D)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub]
    _ = F.add (F.sub A C) (F.neg (F.sub B D)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub]
    _ = F.sub (F.sub A C) (F.sub B D) :=
          (F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.sub A C) (F.sub B D)).symm

name: normalizedProjection_increment_P
statement:
private theorem normalizedProjection_increment_P
    (a r : Point) (x y : Map) (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (normalizedShearP a r x y v)
        (normalizedShearP a r x y u) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.sub (x v) (x u))
        (RealTheory.mul r (RealTheory.sub (y v) (y u)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold normalizedShearP
  change
    F.sub
        (F.add (F.sub (x v) (x a)) (F.mul r (F.sub (y v) (y a))))
        (F.add (F.sub (x u) (x a)) (F.mul r (F.sub (y u) (y a)))) =
      F.add (F.sub (x v) (x u)) (F.mul r (F.sub (y v) (y u)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub]
  have hx := sub_sub_same_right_local (x u) (x v) (x a)
  change F.sub (F.sub (x v) (x a)) (F.sub (x u) (x a)) =
    F.sub (x v) (x u) at hx
  rw [hx]
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub]
  have hy := sub_sub_same_right_local (y u) (y v) (y a)
  change F.sub (F.sub (y v) (y a)) (F.sub (y u) (y a)) =
    F.sub (y v) (y u) at hy
  rw [hy]

name: normalizedProjection_increment_Q
statement:
private theorem normalizedProjection_increment_Q
    (a r : Point) (x y : Map) (u v : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (normalizedShearQ a r x y v)
        (normalizedShearQ a r x y u) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.sub (y v) (y u))
        (RealTheory.mul r (RealTheory.sub (x v) (x u)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold normalizedShearQ
  change
    F.sub
        (F.sub (F.sub (y v) (y a)) (F.mul r (F.sub (x v) (x a))))
        (F.sub (F.sub (y u) (y a)) (F.mul r (F.sub (x u) (x a)))) =
      F.sub (F.sub (y v) (y u)) (F.mul r (F.sub (x v) (x u)))
  have hfour :=
    sub_sub_sub_sub_local
      (F.sub (y v) (y a)) (F.mul r (F.sub (x v) (x a)))
      (F.sub (y u) (y a)) (F.mul r (F.sub (x u) (x a)))
  change
    F.sub
        (F.sub (F.sub (y v) (y a)) (F.mul r (F.sub (x v) (x a))))
        (F.sub (F.sub (y u) (y a)) (F.mul r (F.sub (x u) (x a)))) =
      F.sub
        (F.sub (F.sub (y v) (y a)) (F.sub (y u) (y a)))
        (F.sub (F.mul r (F.sub (x v) (x a)))
          (F.mul r (F.sub (x u) (x a)))) at hfour
  rw [hfour]
  have hy := sub_sub_same_right_local (y u) (y v) (y a)
  change F.sub (F.sub (y v) (y a)) (F.sub (y u) (y a)) =
    F.sub (y v) (y u) at hy
  rw [hy]
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub]
  have hx := sub_sub_same_right_local (x u) (x v) (x a)
  change F.sub (F.sub (x v) (x a)) (F.sub (x u) (x a)) =
    F.sub (x v) (x u) at hx
  rw [hx]

name: add_pair_rearrange_local
statement:
private theorem add_pair_rearrange_local
    (A B C D : Point) :
    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add A B) (RealTheory.add C D) =
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add A C) (RealTheory.add B D)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) =
    F.add (F.add A C) (F.add B D)
  calc
    F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) =
        F.add A (F.add B (F.add C D)) := F.add_assoc A B (F.add C D)
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.add B C) D) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc B C D]
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.add C B) D) := by rw [F.add_comm B C]
    _ = F.add A (F.add C (F.add B D)) := by rw [F.add_assoc C B D]
    _ = F.add (F.add A C) (F.add B D) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc A C (F.add B D)]

name: acIntervalIncrementSum_normalizedShearP_le
statement:
private theorem acIntervalIncrementSum_normalizedShearP_le
    (a rho : Point) (x y : Map) {iota : Type u} (l q : iota -> Point) :
    forall js : List iota,
      RealTheory.le
        (acIntervalIncrementSum (normalizedShearP a rho x y) l q js)
        (RealTheory.add
          (acIntervalIncrementSum x l q js)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs rho)
            (acIntervalIncrementSum y l q js)))
  | [] => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change F.le F.zero (F.add F.zero (F.mul (F.abs rho) F.zero))
      rw [F.mul_zero, F.add_zero]
      exact F.le_refl F.zero
  | i :: js => by
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hhead :
          F.le
            (acIntervalIncrement (normalizedShearP a rho x y) l q i)
            (F.add (acIntervalIncrement x l q i)
              (F.mul (F.abs rho) (acIntervalIncrement y l q i))) := by
        unfold acIntervalIncrement
        rw [normalizedProjection_increment_P]
        have h := RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
          (F.sub (x (q i)) (x (l i)))
          (F.mul rho (F.sub (y (q i)) (y (l i))))
        rw [RealTheory.abs_mul] at h
        exact h
      have htail :=
        acIntervalIncrementSum_normalizedShearP_le
          a rho x y l q js
      change
        F.le
          (acIntervalIncrementSum (normalizedShearP a rho x y) l q js)
          (F.add (acIntervalIncrementSum x l q js)
            (F.mul (F.abs rho) (acIntervalIncrementSum y l q js)))
        at htail
      change
        F.le
          (F.add
            (acIntervalIncrement (normalizedShearP a rho x y) l q i)
            (acIntervalIncrementSum (normalizedShearP a rho x y) l q js))
          (F.add
            (F.add (acIntervalIncrement x l q i)
              (acIntervalIncrementSum x l q js))
            (F.mul (F.abs rho)
              (F.add (acIntervalIncrement y l q i)
                (acIntervalIncrementSum y l q js))))
      have hadd := F.add_le_add hhead htail
      rw [F.mul_add]
      have hrearrange := add_pair_rearrange_local
        (acIntervalIncrement x l q i)
        (F.mul (F.abs rho) (acIntervalIncrement y l q i))
        (acIntervalIncrementSum x l q js)
        (F.mul (F.abs rho) (acIntervalIncrementSum y l q js))
      change
        F.add
            (F.add (acIntervalIncrement x l q i)
              (F.mul (F.abs rho) (acIntervalIncrement y l q i)))
            (F.add (acIntervalIncrementSum x l q js)
              (F.mul (F.abs rho) (acIntervalIncrementSum y l q js))) =
          F.add
            (F.add (acIntervalIncrement x l q i)
              (acIntervalIncrementSum x l q js))
            (F.add
              (F.mul (F.abs rho) (acIntervalIncrement y l q i))
              (F.mul (F.abs rho) (acIntervalIncrementSum y l q js)))
        at hrearrange
      rw [hrearrange] at hadd
      exact hadd

name: acIntervalIncrementSum_normalizedShearQ_le
statement:
private theorem acIntervalIncrementSum_normalizedShearQ_le
    (a rho : Point) (x y : Map) {iota : Type u} (l q : iota -> Point) :
    forall js : List iota,
      RealTheory.le
        (acIntervalIncrementSum (normalizedShearQ a rho x y) l q js)
        (RealTheory.add
          (acIntervalIncrementSum y l q js)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs rho)
            (acIntervalIncrementSum x l q js)))
  | [] => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change F.le F.zero (F.add F.zero (F.mul (F.abs rho) F.zero))
      rw [F.mul_zero, F.add_zero]

                (RealTheory.mul rho (RealTheory.sub (x (q i)) (x (l i)))))

        rw [hsub]
        have h := RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs

name: normalizedShearProjections_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
statement:
private theorem normalizedShearProjections_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
    {a b rho : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hxAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval x a b)
    (hyAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval y a b) :
    And
      (AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
        (normalizedShearP a rho x y) a b)
      (AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
        (normalizedShearQ a rho x y) a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let denom := F.add F.one (F.abs rho)
  have hdenomPos : F.lt F.zero denom := by
    unfold denom
    have hone := F.add_lt_add_right RealTheory.zero_lt_one (F.abs rho)
    change F.lt (F.add F.zero (F.abs rho)) (F.add F.one (F.abs rho)) at hone
    rw [F.zero_add] at hone
    exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt (RealTheory.abs_nonneg rho) hone
  have hdenomNe : Not (denom = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hdenomPos
    exact (F.lt_irrefl F.zero) hdenomPos
  have hcommon :
      forall eps : Point,
        F.lt F.zero eps ->
          Exists (fun delta : Point =>
            And (F.lt F.zero delta)
              (And
                (forall {iota : Type} (l q : iota -> Point) (js : List iota),
                  ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l q js ->
                    F.lt (RealInterval.intervalListLength l q js) delta ->
                      F.lt
                        (acIntervalIncrementSum
                          (normalizedShearP a rho x y) l q js)
                        eps)
                (forall {iota : Type} (l q : iota -> Point) (js : List iota),
                  ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l q js ->
                    F.lt (RealInterval.intervalListLength l q js) delta ->
                      F.lt
                        (acIntervalIncrementSum
                          (normalizedShearQ a rho x y) l q js)
                        eps))) := by
    intro eps heps
    let budget := F.mul (F.inv denom) (F.half eps)
    have hbudgetPos : F.lt F.zero budget := by
      unfold budget
      exact F.mul_pos (F.inv_pos hdenomPos) (F.half_pos heps)
    cases hxAC.right budget hbudgetPos with
    | intro deltaX hdeltaX =>
        cases hyAC.right budget hbudgetPos with
        | intro deltaY hdeltaY =>
            let delta := F.min2 deltaX deltaY
            refine Exists.intro delta ?_
            refine And.intro (F.min2_pos hdeltaX.left hdeltaY.left) ?_
            have hbudgetScale : F.mul denom budget = F.half eps := by
              unfold budget
              rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
              rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hdenomNe]
              rw [F.one_mul]
            have hhalfLt : F.lt (F.half eps) eps :=
              F.half_lt_self heps
            refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · intro iota l q js hfamily hlength
              have hlengthX :
                  F.lt (RealInterval.intervalListLength l q js) deltaX :=
                F.lt_of_lt_of_le hlength (F.min2_le_left deltaX deltaY)
              have hlengthY :
                  F.lt (RealInterval.intervalListLength l q js) deltaY :=
                F.lt_of_lt_of_le hlength (F.min2_le_right deltaX deltaY)
              have hxSmall := hdeltaX.right l q js hfamily hlengthX
              have hySmall := hdeltaY.right l q js hfamily hlengthY
              have hyLe :
                  F.le
                    (acIntervalIncrementSum y l q js) budget :=
