                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hySmall
              have hmulLe :
                  F.le
                    (F.mul (F.abs rho) (acIntervalIncrementSum y l q js))
                    (F.mul (F.abs rho) budget) :=
                F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hyLe (RealTheory.abs_nonneg rho)
              have hsumLt :
                  F.lt
                    (F.add
                      (acIntervalIncrementSum x l q js)
                      (F.mul (F.abs rho)
                        (acIntervalIncrementSum y l q js)))
                    (F.add budget (F.mul (F.abs rho) budget)) :=
                F.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  (F.add_lt_add_right hxSmall
                    (F.mul (F.abs rho)
                      (acIntervalIncrementSum y l q js)))
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hmulLe budget)
              have hbound :=
                acIntervalIncrementSum_normalizedShearP_le
                  a rho x y l q js
              have htoHalf := F.lt_of_le_of_lt hbound hsumLt
              have hscaled :
                  F.add budget (F.mul (F.abs rho) budget) =
                    F.mul denom budget := by
                unfold denom
                rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
              rw [hscaled, hbudgetScale] at htoHalf
              exact F.lt_trans htoHalf hhalfLt
            · intro iota l q js hfamily hlength
              have hlengthX :
                  F.lt (RealInterval.intervalListLength l q js) deltaX :=
                F.lt_of_lt_of_le hlength (F.min2_le_left deltaX deltaY)
              have hlengthY :
                  F.lt (RealInterval.intervalListLength l q js) deltaY :=
                F.lt_of_lt_of_le hlength (F.min2_le_right deltaX deltaY)
              have hxSmall := hdeltaX.right l q js hfamily hlengthX
              have hySmall := hdeltaY.right l q js hfamily hlengthY
              have hxLe :
                  F.le
                    (acIntervalIncrementSum x l q js) budget :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxSmall
              have hmulLe :
                  F.le
                    (F.mul (F.abs rho) (acIntervalIncrementSum x l q js))
                    (F.mul (F.abs rho) budget) :=
                F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hxLe (RealTheory.abs_nonneg rho)
              have hsumLt :
                  F.lt
                    (F.add
                      (acIntervalIncrementSum y l q js)
                      (F.mul (F.abs rho)
                        (acIntervalIncrementSum x l q js)))
                    (F.add budget (F.mul (F.abs rho) budget)) :=
                F.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  (F.add_lt_add_right hySmall
                    (F.mul (F.abs rho)
                      (acIntervalIncrementSum x l q js)))
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hmulLe budget)
              have hbound :=
                acIntervalIncrementSum_normalizedShearQ_le
                  a rho x y l q js
              have htoHalf := F.lt_of_le_of_lt hbound hsumLt
              have hscaled :
                  F.add budget (F.mul (F.abs rho) budget) =
                    F.mul denom budget := by
                unfold denom
                rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
              rw [hscaled, hbudgetScale] at htoHalf
              exact F.lt_trans htoHalf hhalfLt
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · refine And.intro hxAC.left ?_
    intro eps heps
    cases hcommon eps heps with
    | intro delta hdelta =>
        exact Exists.intro delta (And.intro hdelta.left hdelta.right.left)
  · refine And.intro hxAC.left ?_
    intro eps heps
    cases hcommon eps heps with
    | intro delta hdelta =>
        exact Exists.intro delta (And.intro hdelta.left hdelta.right.right)

name: hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_of_normalized_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
statement:
private theorem hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_of_normalized_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
    {a b : Point} {F f : Map}
    (hAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval F a b)
    (hDeriv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b F f)
    (hbase : F a = RealTheory.zero) :
    RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f F a b
proof:
:= by
  let OF := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro hbase ?_
  intro t ht
  have hACat : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval F a t :=
    absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_mono
      (RealTheory.le_refl a) ht.left ht.right hAC
  have hDerivat :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a t F f :=
    hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_mono
      (RealTheory.le_refl a) ht.left ht.right hDeriv
  have hIntegral :=
    RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE
      ht.left hACat hDerivat
  change
    RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
      f a t (OF.sub (F t) (F a)) at hIntegral
  rw [hbase] at hIntegral
  change
    RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
      f a t (OF.sub (F t) OF.zero) at hIntegral
  rw [OF.sub_zero] at hIntegral
  exact hIntegral

name: normalizedShearP_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE
statement:
private theorem normalizedShearP_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE
    {a b r : Point} {x y u v : Map}
    (hx : HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b x u)
    (hy : HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b y v) :
    HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b
      (normalizedShearP a r x y) (shearDerivativeP r u v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let E := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  unfold HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval at hx hy ⊢
  unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn at hx hy ⊢
  apply RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
    (F := Foundation.Cardinal.SetUnion
      (fun t : Point => And (E t) (Not (HasDerivWithin E x t (u t))))
      (fun t : Point => And (E t) (Not (HasDerivWithin E y t (v t)))))
  · intro t ht
    by_cases hxt : HasDerivWithin E x t (u t)
    · by_cases hyt : HasDerivWithin E y t (v t)
      · exact False.elim (ht.right (by
          have hxc := hasDerivWithin_const (E := E) (c := x a) ht.left
          have hyc := hasDerivWithin_const (E := E) (c := y a) ht.left
          have hxsub := hasDerivWithin_sub hxt hxc
          have hysub := hasDerivWithin_sub hyt hyc
          have hrmul := hasDerivWithin_constMul (c := r) hysub
          have hsum := hasDerivWithin_add hxsub hrmul
          unfold RealFunction.SubFun RealFunction.AddFun ConstMulFun at hsum
          have hu0 : RealTheory.sub (u t) RealTheory.zero = u t := F.sub_zero (u t)
          have hv0 : RealTheory.sub (v t) RealTheory.zero = v t := F.sub_zero (v t)
          rw [hu0, hv0] at hsum
          simpa [E, normalizedShearP, shearDerivativeP] using hsum))
      · exact Or.inr (And.intro ht.left hyt)
    · exact Or.inl (And.intro ht.left hxt)
  · exact RealNegligibility.nullSet_union hx hy

name: normalizedShearQ_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE
statement:
private theorem normalizedShearQ_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE
    {a b r : Point} {x y u v : Map}
    (hx : HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b x u)
    (hy : HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b y v) :
    HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b
      (normalizedShearQ a r x y) (shearDerivativeQ r u v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let E := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  unfold HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval at hx hy ⊢
  unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn at hx hy ⊢
  apply RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
    (F := Foundation.Cardinal.SetUnion
      (fun t : Point => And (E t) (Not (HasDerivWithin E x t (u t))))
      (fun t : Point => And (E t) (Not (HasDerivWithin E y t (v t)))))
  · intro t ht
    by_cases hxt : HasDerivWithin E x t (u t)
    · by_cases hyt : HasDerivWithin E y t (v t)
      · exact False.elim (ht.right (by
          have hxc := hasDerivWithin_const (E := E) (c := x a) ht.left
          have hyc := hasDerivWithin_const (E := E) (c := y a) ht.left
          have hxsub := hasDerivWithin_sub hxt hxc
          have hysub := hasDerivWithin_sub hyt hyc
          have hrmul := hasDerivWithin_constMul (c := r) hxsub
          have hdiff := hasDerivWithin_sub hysub hrmul
          unfold RealFunction.SubFun ConstMulFun at hdiff
          have hu0 : RealTheory.sub (u t) RealTheory.zero = u t := F.sub_zero (u t)
          have hv0 : RealTheory.sub (v t) RealTheory.zero = v t := F.sub_zero (v t)
          rw [hu0, hv0] at hdiff
          simpa [E, normalizedShearQ, shearDerivativeQ] using hdiff))
      · exact Or.inr (And.intro ht.left hyt)
    · exact Or.inl (And.intro ht.left hxt)
  · exact RealNegligibility.nullSet_union hx hy

name: shearVariation_hasDerivativeRepresentativesAE
statement:
private theorem shearVariation_hasDerivativeRepresentativesAE
    {a b rho : Point} {x y u v : Map}
    (hxAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval x a b)
    (hyAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval y a b)
    (hxDeriv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b x u)
    (hyDeriv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b y v) :
    And
      (HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b
        (shearVariationP a rho x y)
        (fun t : Point => RealTheory.abs (shearDerivativeP rho u v t)))
      (HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b
        (shearVariationQ a rho x y)
        (fun t : Point => RealTheory.abs (shearDerivativeQ rho u v t)))
proof:
:= by
  have hAC :=
    normalizedShearProjections_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
      (rho := rho) hxAC hyAC
  have hPDeriv :=
    normalizedShearP_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE
      (r := rho) hxDeriv hyDeriv
  have hQDeriv :=
    normalizedShearQ_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE
      (r := rho) hxDeriv hyDeriv
  have hPBV :
      BoundedVariationOn a b (normalizedShearP a rho x y) :=
    boundedVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hAC.left
  have hQBV :
      BoundedVariationOn a b (normalizedShearQ a rho x y) :=
    boundedVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hAC.right
  have hPPrimitive :
      RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn
        (shearDerivativeP rho u v) (normalizedShearP a rho x y) a b :=
    hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_of_normalized_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
      hAC.left hPDeriv (normalizedShearP_base a rho x y)
  have hQPrimitive :
      RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn
        (shearDerivativeQ rho u v) (normalizedShearQ a rho x y) a b :=
    hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_of_normalized_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
      hAC.right hQDeriv (normalizedShearQ_base a rho x y)
  have hVPPrimitive :=
    RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_hkAbsFun_totalVariationFrom
      hxAC.left hPPrimitive hPBV
  have hVQPrimitive :=
    RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_hkAbsFun_totalVariationFrom
      hxAC.left hQPrimitive hQBV
  have hVP :=
    RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_of_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn
      hVPPrimitive
  have hVQ :=
    RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_of_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn
      hVQPrimitive
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · simpa [shearVariationP, RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.HKAbsFun] using hVP
  · simpa [shearVariationQ, RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.HKAbsFun] using hVQ

name: partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_sub
statement:
private theorem partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_sub
    {a b u w : Point} {f : Map} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hBV : BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hu : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b u)
    (hw : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b w)
    (_huw : RealTheory.le u w)
    (hp : RealFunction.IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition u w n p) :
    RealTheory.le
      (partitionVariation f p n)
      (RealTheory.sub
        (totalVariationFrom a f w)
        (totalVariationFrom a f u))
proof:
:= by
  let V := fun t : Point => totalVariationFrom a f t
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (partitionVariation f p n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub (V (p (k + 1))) (V (p k))) n) := by
    unfold partitionVariation
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (partitionVariationTerm f p)
      (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.sub (V (p (k + 1))) (V (p k)))
      n
      (fun k hk => by
        unfold partitionVariationTerm
        dsimp [V]
        have hleftLocal :=
          RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
            hp hk
        have hrightLocal :=
          RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
            hp hk
        have hleft : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
          And.intro
            (RealTheory.le_trans hu.left hleftLocal.left)
            (RealTheory.le_trans hleftLocal.right hw.right)
        have hright : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
          And.intro
            (RealTheory.le_trans hu.left hrightLocal.left)
            (RealTheory.le_trans hrightLocal.right hw.right)
        exact totalVariationFrom_increment_abs_le hBV hleft hright
          (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_step_le hp hk))
  have htelescope :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_telescope_sub (fun k : Nat => V (p k)) n
  rw [htelescope] at hsum
  have hend :
      RealTheory.sub (V (p n)) (V (p 0)) =
        RealTheory.sub (V w) (V u) := by
    rw [RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_right_endpoint hp,
      RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_left_endpoint hp]
  rw [hend] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: planePolygonalLengthTerm_le_shearTerms
statement:
private theorem planePolygonalLengthTerm_le_shearTerms
    (a rho : Point) (x y : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (planePolygonalLengthTerm x y p k)
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (PlaneNorm RealTheory.one rho))
        (RealTheory.add
          (partitionVariationTerm (normalizedShearP a rho x y) p k)
          (partitionVariationTerm (normalizedShearQ a rho x y) p k)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dx := F.sub (x (p (k + 1))) (x (p k))
  let dy := F.sub (y (p (k + 1))) (y (p k))
  let N := PlaneNorm F.one rho
  have hNgeOne := abs_left_le_planeNorm F.one rho
  change F.le (F.abs F.one) N at hNgeOne
  rw [F.abs_one] at hNgeOne
  have hNpos : F.lt F.zero N :=
    F.lt_of_lt_of_le RealTheory.zero_lt_one hNgeOne
  have hNne : Not (N = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hNpos
    exact (F.lt_irrefl F.zero) hNpos
  have hInvNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv N) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (F.inv_pos hNpos)
  have hshear := RealFunction.Curve.planeNorm_shear dx dy rho
  change
    PlaneNorm (F.add dx (F.mul rho dy)) (F.sub dy (F.mul rho dx)) =
      F.mul N (PlaneNorm dx dy) at hshear
  have hinvMul : F.mul (F.inv N) N = F.one := by
    rw [F.mul_comm]
    exact F.mul_inv_cancel hNne
  have hsolve :
      PlaneNorm dx dy =
        F.mul (F.inv N)
          (PlaneNorm (F.add dx (F.mul rho dy))
            (F.sub dy (F.mul rho dx))) := by
    symm
    calc
      F.mul (F.inv N)
          (PlaneNorm (F.add dx (F.mul rho dy))
            (F.sub dy (F.mul rho dx))) =
          F.mul (F.inv N) (F.mul N (PlaneNorm dx dy)) := by rw [hshear]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.inv N) N) (PlaneNorm dx dy) :=
        (F.mul_assoc (F.inv N) N (PlaneNorm dx dy)).symm
      _ = F.mul F.one (PlaneNorm dx dy) := by rw [hinvMul]
      _ = PlaneNorm dx dy := F.one_mul (PlaneNorm dx dy)
  have hshearUpper :=
    planeNorm_le_abs_add_abs
      (F.add dx (F.mul rho dy)) (F.sub dy (F.mul rho dx))
  change
    F.le
      (PlaneNorm (F.add dx (F.mul rho dy)) (F.sub dy (F.mul rho dx)))
      (F.add (F.abs (F.add dx (F.mul rho dy)))
        (F.abs (F.sub dy (F.mul rho dx)))) at hshearUpper
  have hPinc :=
    normalizedProjection_increment_P
      a rho x y (p k) (p (k + 1))
  have hQinc :=
    normalizedProjection_increment_Q
      a rho x y (p k) (p (k + 1))
  change
    F.sub
        (normalizedShearP a rho x y (p (k + 1)))
        (normalizedShearP a rho x y (p k)) =
      F.add dx (F.mul rho dy) at hPinc
  change
    F.sub
        (normalizedShearQ a rho x y (p (k + 1)))
        (normalizedShearQ a rho x y (p k)) =
      F.sub dy (F.mul rho dx) at hQinc
  have hmulRaw := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hshearUpper hInvNonneg
  have hterms :
      F.add (F.abs (F.add dx (F.mul rho dy)))
          (F.abs (F.sub dy (F.mul rho dx))) =
        F.add
          (F.abs
            (F.sub
              (normalizedShearP a rho x y (p (k + 1)))
              (normalizedShearP a rho x y (p k))))
          (F.abs
            (F.sub
              (normalizedShearQ a rho x y (p (k + 1)))
              (normalizedShearQ a rho x y (p k)))) := by
    rw [hPinc, hQinc]
  have hmul :
      F.le
        (F.mul (F.inv N)
          (PlaneNorm (F.add dx (F.mul rho dy))
            (F.sub dy (F.mul rho dx))))
        (F.mul (F.inv N)
          (F.add
            (F.abs
              (F.sub
                (normalizedShearP a rho x y (p (k + 1)))
                (normalizedShearP a rho x y (p k))))
            (F.abs
              (F.sub
                (normalizedShearQ a rho x y (p (k + 1)))
                (normalizedShearQ a rho x y (p k)))))) := by
    rw [<- hterms]
    exact hmulRaw
  unfold planePolygonalLengthTerm PlaneDistance
  change
    F.le (PlaneNorm dx dy)
      (F.mul (F.inv N)
        (F.add
          (partitionVariationTerm (normalizedShearP a rho x y) p k)
          (partitionVariationTerm (normalizedShearQ a rho x y) p k)))
  rw [hsolve]
  unfold partitionVariationTerm
  exact hmul

name: planePolygonalLength_le_shearPartitionVariation
statement:
private theorem planePolygonalLength_le_shearPartitionVariation
    (a rho : Point) (x y : Map) (p : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (planePolygonalLength x y p n)
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (PlaneNorm RealTheory.one rho))
        (RealTheory.add
          (partitionVariation (normalizedShearP a rho x y) p n)
          (partitionVariation (normalizedShearQ a rho x y) p n)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold planePolygonalLength
  have hsum := RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
    (planePolygonalLengthTerm x y p)
    (fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (PlaneNorm RealTheory.one rho))
        (RealTheory.add
          (partitionVariationTerm (normalizedShearP a rho x y) p k)
          (partitionVariationTerm (normalizedShearQ a rho x y) p k)))
    n
    (fun k _hk => planePolygonalLengthTerm_le_shearTerms a rho x y p k)
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left] at hsum
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add] at hsum
  unfold partitionVariation
  exact hsum

name: planeCurveLengthFrom_sub_le_shearVariation
statement:
private theorem planeCurveLengthFrom_sub_le_shearVariation
    {a b u w rho : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (hPBV : BoundedVariationOn a b (normalizedShearP a rho x y))
    (hQBV : BoundedVariationOn a b (normalizedShearQ a rho x y))
    (hu : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b u)
    (hw : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b w)
    (huw : RealTheory.le u w) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub
        (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y w)
        (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y u))
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (PlaneNorm RealTheory.one rho))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub
            (shearVariationP a rho x y w)
            (shearVariationP a rho x y u))
          (RealTheory.sub
            (shearVariationQ a rho x y w)
            (shearVariationQ a rho x y u))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := PlaneNorm F.one rho
  let VP := shearVariationP a rho x y
  let VQ := shearVariationQ a rho x y
  let bound :=
    F.mul (F.inv N)
      (F.add (F.sub (VP w) (VP u)) (F.sub (VQ w) (VQ u)))
  have hNgeOne := abs_left_le_planeNorm F.one rho
  change F.le (F.abs F.one) N at hNgeOne
  rw [F.abs_one] at hNgeOne
  have hNpos : F.lt F.zero N :=
    F.lt_of_lt_of_le RealTheory.zero_lt_one hNgeOne
  have hInvNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv N) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (F.inv_pos hNpos)
  have hVPmono := totalVariationFrom_monotoneOn_closedInterval hPBV
  have hVQmono := totalVariationFrom_monotoneOn_closedInterval hQBV
  have hVPincNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub (VP w) (VP u)) := by
    unfold VP shearVariationP
    exact F.sub_nonneg_of_le (hVPmono u w hu hw huw)
  have hVQincNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub (VQ w) (VQ u)) := by
    unfold VQ shearVariationQ
    exact F.sub_nonneg_of_le (hVQmono u w hu hw huw)
  have hsumNonneg :
      F.le F.zero
        (F.add (F.sub (VP w) (VP u)) (F.sub (VQ w) (VQ u))) := by
    have h := F.add_le_add hVPincNonneg hVQincNonneg
    change
      F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero)
        (F.add (F.sub (VP w) (VP u)) (F.sub (VQ w) (VQ u))) at h
    rw [F.zero_add] at h
    exact h
  have hboundNonneg : F.le F.zero bound :=
    F.mul_nonneg hInvNonneg hsumNonneg
  have hrectSub : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn u w x y :=
    rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_subinterval hrect hu hw huw
  rw [planeCurveLengthFrom_sub_eq_subarcLength hrect hu hw huw]
  have hspec := planeCurveLengthOn_spec_of_rectifiable hrectSub
  apply hspec.right
  intro value hvalue
  cases hvalue with
  | inl hzero =>
      rw [hzero.right]
      exact hboundNonneg
  | inr hpart =>
      cases hpart with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hpData =>
              rw [hpData.right.right]
              have hpoly :=
                planePolygonalLength_le_shearPartitionVariation
                  a rho x y p n
              have hP := partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_sub
                hPBV hu hw huw hpData.right.left
              have hQ := partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_sub
                hQBV hu hw huw hpData.right.left
              have hadd := F.add_le_add hP hQ
              have hscaled := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hadd hInvNonneg
              change
                F.le (planePolygonalLength x y p n) bound
              exact F.le_trans hpoly hscaled

name: shearAccumulatedVariation_increment
statement:
private theorem shearAccumulatedVariation_increment
    (a rho : Point) (x y : Map) (u w : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (shearAccumulatedVariation a rho x y w)
        (shearAccumulatedVariation a rho x y u) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (PlaneNorm RealTheory.one rho))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub
            (shearVariationP a rho x y w)
            (shearVariationP a rho x y u))
          (RealTheory.sub
            (shearVariationQ a rho x y w)
            (shearVariationQ a rho x y u)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold shearAccumulatedVariation
  change
    F.sub
        (F.mul (F.inv (PlaneNorm F.one rho))
          (F.add
            (shearVariationP a rho x y w)
            (shearVariationQ a rho x y w)))
        (F.mul (F.inv (PlaneNorm F.one rho))
          (F.add
            (shearVariationP a rho x y u)
            (shearVariationQ a rho x y u))) =
      F.mul (F.inv (PlaneNorm F.one rho))
        (F.add
          (F.sub
            (shearVariationP a rho x y w)
            (shearVariationP a rho x y u))
          (F.sub
            (shearVariationQ a rho x y w)
            (shearVariationQ a rho x y u)))
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub]

name: shearVariationComparator_monotoneOn
statement:
private theorem shearVariationComparator_monotoneOn
    {a b rho : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (hPBV : BoundedVariationOn a b (normalizedShearP a rho x y))
    (hQBV : BoundedVariationOn a b (normalizedShearQ a rho x y)) :
    MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (shearVariationComparator a rho x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro u w hu hw huw
  have hlen := planeCurveLengthFrom_sub_le_shearVariation
    hrect hPBV hQBV hu hw huw
  change
    F.le
      (F.sub (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y w)
        (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y u))
      (F.mul (F.inv (PlaneNorm F.one rho))
        (F.add
          (F.sub (shearVariationP a rho x y w)
            (shearVariationP a rho x y u))
          (F.sub (shearVariationQ a rho x y w)
            (shearVariationQ a rho x y u)))) at hlen
  have hinc := shearAccumulatedVariation_increment a rho x y u w
  have hincF :
      F.sub
          (shearAccumulatedVariation a rho x y w)
          (shearAccumulatedVariation a rho x y u) =
        F.mul (F.inv (PlaneNorm F.one rho))
          (F.add
            (F.sub (shearVariationP a rho x y w)
              (shearVariationP a rho x y u))
            (F.sub (shearVariationQ a rho x y w)
              (shearVariationQ a rho x y u))) := hinc
  rw [<- hincF] at hlen
  have hneg :
      F.sub
          (F.neg (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y u))
          (F.neg (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y w)) =
        F.sub
          (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y w)
          (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y u) := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub]
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F
      (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y u)
      (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y w)).symm
  have hprem :
      F.le
        (F.sub
          (F.neg (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y u))
          (F.neg (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y w)))
        (F.sub
          (shearAccumulatedVariation a rho x y w)
          (shearAccumulatedVariation a rho x y u)) := by
    rw [hneg]
    exact hlen
  have hsum := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_of_sub_le_sub F
    (u := shearAccumulatedVariation a rho x y u)
    (v := shearAccumulatedVariation a rho x y w)
    (x := F.neg (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y u))
    (y := F.neg (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y w))
    hprem
  unfold shearVariationComparator
  change
    F.le
      (F.sub
        (shearAccumulatedVariation a rho x y u)
        (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y u))
      (F.sub
        (shearAccumulatedVariation a rho x y w)
        (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y w))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact hsum

name: sub_le_of_le_add_local
statement:
private theorem sub_le_of_le_add_local
    {x y z : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.le x (RealTheory.add y z)) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub x y) z
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h' := F.add_le_add_right h (F.neg y)
  change
    F.le (F.add x (F.neg y))
      (F.add (F.add y z) (F.neg y)) at h'
  have hcancel : F.add (F.add y z) (F.neg y) = z := by
    calc
      F.add (F.add y z) (F.neg y) =
          F.add y (F.add z (F.neg y)) := F.add_assoc y z (F.neg y)
      _ = F.add y (F.add (F.neg y) z) := by rw [F.add_comm z (F.neg y)]
      _ = F.add (F.add y (F.neg y)) z :=
        (F.add_assoc y (F.neg y) z).symm
      _ = F.add F.zero z := by rw [F.add_neg]
      _ = z := F.zero_add z
  rw [hcancel] at h'
  rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg] at h'

name: planeNorm_dist_le_add_dist
statement:
private theorem planeNorm_dist_le_add_dist
    (u v u' v' : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealFunction.dist (PlaneNorm u v) (PlaneNorm u' v'))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealFunction.dist u u') (RealFunction.dist v v'))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let du := F.sub u u'
  let dv := F.sub v v'
  have huDecomp : F.add u' du = u := by
    unfold du
    rw [F.add_comm]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F u u'
  have hvDecomp : F.add v' dv = v := by
    unfold dv
    rw [F.add_comm]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F v v'
  have hforward := planeNorm_triangle u' v' du dv
  change
    F.le (PlaneNorm (F.add u' du) (F.add v' dv))
      (F.add (PlaneNorm u' v') (PlaneNorm du dv)) at hforward
  rw [huDecomp, hvDecomp] at hforward
  have hupper :
      F.le (F.sub (PlaneNorm u v) (PlaneNorm u' v'))
        (PlaneNorm du dv) :=
    sub_le_of_le_add_local hforward
  have hduRev : F.sub u' u = F.neg du := by
    unfold du
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F u u'
  have hdvRev : F.sub v' v = F.neg dv := by
    unfold dv
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F v v'
  have hback :=
    planeNorm_triangle u v (F.sub u' u) (F.sub v' v)
  have huBack : F.add u (F.sub u' u) = u' := by
    rw [F.add_comm]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F u' u
  have hvBack : F.add v (F.sub v' v) = v' := by
    rw [F.add_comm]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F v' v
  change
    F.le
      (PlaneNorm (F.add u (F.sub u' u)) (F.add v (F.sub v' v)))
      (F.add (PlaneNorm u v) (PlaneNorm (F.sub u' u) (F.sub v' v)))
      at hback
  rw [huBack, hvBack, hduRev, hdvRev] at hback
  have hnegNorm := planeNorm_neg du dv
  change PlaneNorm (F.neg du) (F.neg dv) = PlaneNorm du dv at hnegNorm
  rw [hnegNorm] at hback
  have hlower :
      F.le (F.sub (PlaneNorm u' v') (PlaneNorm u v))
        (PlaneNorm du dv) :=
    sub_le_of_le_add_local hback
  have habs :
      F.le (F.abs (F.sub (PlaneNorm u v) (PlaneNorm u' v')))
        (PlaneNorm du dv) := by
    apply F.abs_le_of_bounds
    · exact hupper
    · have hneg :
          F.neg (F.sub (PlaneNorm u v) (PlaneNorm u' v')) =
            F.sub (PlaneNorm u' v') (PlaneNorm u v) := by
          exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F
            (PlaneNorm u v) (PlaneNorm u' v')).symm
      rw [hneg]
      exact hlower
  have herr := planeNorm_le_abs_add_abs du dv
  change F.le (PlaneNorm du dv) (F.add (F.abs du) (F.abs dv)) at herr
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  exact F.le_trans habs herr

name: planeNorm_tendstoWithin
statement:
private theorem planeNorm_tendstoWithin
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {t A B : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.TendstoWithin E f t A)
    (hg : RealFunction.TendstoWithin E g t B) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
      (fun z : Point => PlaneNorm (f z) (g z)) t (PlaneNorm A B)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro eps heps
  let half := F.half eps
  have hhalfPos : F.lt F.zero half := F.half_pos heps
  cases hf half hhalfPos with
  | intro deltaF hdeltaF =>
      cases hg half hhalfPos with
      | intro deltaG hdeltaG =>
          let delta := F.min2 deltaF deltaG
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro (F.min2_pos hdeltaF.left hdeltaG.left) ?_
          intro z hz hzne hdist
          have hdistF : F.lt (RealFunction.dist (f z) A) half :=
            hdeltaF.right z hz hzne
              (F.lt_of_lt_of_le hdist (F.min2_le_left deltaF deltaG))
          have hdistG : F.lt (RealFunction.dist (g z) B) half :=
            hdeltaG.right z hz hzne
              (F.lt_of_lt_of_le hdist (F.min2_le_right deltaF deltaG))
          have hsum := F.add_lt_add hdistF hdistG
          change
            F.lt
              (F.add (RealFunction.dist (f z) A)
                (RealFunction.dist (g z) B))
              (F.add half half) at hsum
          have hhalf : F.add half half = eps := by
            unfold half
            exact F.half_add_half eps
          rw [hhalf] at hsum
          exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt
            (planeNorm_dist_le_add_dist (f z) (g z) A B) hsum

name: planeSpeed_le_accumulatedLength_derivative_at
statement:
private theorem planeSpeed_le_accumulatedLength_derivative_at
    {a b t ux uy sPrime : Point} {x y : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (ht : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b t)
    (hx : HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x t ux)
    (hy : HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) y t uy)
    (hs : HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) t sPrime) :
    RealTheory.le (PlaneNorm ux uy) sPrime
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let E := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  let normDQ : Map := fun z : Point =>
    PlaneNorm (DifferenceQuotient x t z) (DifferenceQuotient y t z)
  have hnorm :
      RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin E normDQ t (PlaneNorm ux uy) := by
    unfold RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
    unfold normDQ
    exact planeNorm_tendstoWithin
      (hasDerivWithin_rightTendsto hx)
      (hasDerivWithin_rightTendsto hy)
  apply RealFunction.rightTendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
    (openInterval_rightClusterPoint ht)
    hnorm
    (hasDerivWithin_rightTendsto hs)
  apply RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_of_forall
  intro z hz hzne
  let d := F.sub z t
  let dx := F.sub (x z) (x t)
  let dy := F.sub (y z) (y t)
  have htz : F.lt t z := hz.right
  have hdPos : F.lt F.zero d := by
    unfold d
    exact F.sub_pos_of_lt htz
  have hInvPos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv d) := F.inv_pos hdPos
  have hInvNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv d) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hInvPos
  have htClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b t :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b t ht
  have hzClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b z hz.left
  have hchord := planeDistance_endpoints_le_planeCurveLengthFrom_sub
    hrect htClosed hzClosed (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F htz)
  change
    F.le (PlaneNorm dx dy)
      (F.sub (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y z)
        (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y t)) at hchord
  have hscaled := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hchord hInvNonneg
  have hAbsInv : F.abs (F.inv d) = F.inv d :=
    F.abs_of_nonneg hInvNonneg
  have hnormScale := planeNorm_mul (F.inv d) dx dy
  change
    PlaneNorm (F.mul (F.inv d) dx) (F.mul (F.inv d) dy) =
      F.mul (F.abs (F.inv d)) (PlaneNorm dx dy) at hnormScale
  rw [hAbsInv] at hnormScale
  unfold normDQ DifferenceQuotient
  change
    F.le
      (PlaneNorm (F.mul dx (F.inv d)) (F.mul dy (F.inv d)))
      (F.mul
        (F.sub (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y z)
          (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y t))
        (F.inv d))
  rw [F.mul_comm dx (F.inv d), F.mul_comm dy (F.inv d)]
  rw [hnormScale]
  rw [F.mul_comm
    (F.sub (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y z)
      (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y t)) (F.inv d)]
  exact hscaled

name: accumulatedLength_derivative_le_shear_at
statement:
private theorem accumulatedLength_derivative_le_shear_at
    {a b t rho sPrime : Point} {x y u v : Map}
    (hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y)
    (hPBV : BoundedVariationOn a b (normalizedShearP a rho x y))
    (hQBV : BoundedVariationOn a b (normalizedShearQ a rho x y))
    (ht : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b t)
    (hVP : HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (shearVariationP a rho x y) t
      (RealTheory.abs (shearDerivativeP rho u v t)))
    (hVQ : HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (shearVariationQ a rho x y) t
      (RealTheory.abs (shearDerivativeQ rho u v t)))
    (hs : HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) t sPrime) :
    RealTheory.le sPrime
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (PlaneNorm RealTheory.one rho))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.abs (shearDerivativeP rho u v t))
          (RealTheory.abs (shearDerivativeQ rho u v t))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let E := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  have hsum := hasDerivWithin_add hVP hVQ
  have hscaled :=
    hasDerivWithin_constMul
      (c := F.inv (PlaneNorm F.one rho)) hsum
  have hcomp := hasDerivWithin_sub hscaled hs
  have hcomp' :
      HasDerivWithin E (shearVariationComparator a rho x y) t
        (F.sub
          (F.mul (F.inv (PlaneNorm F.one rho))
            (F.add
              (F.abs (shearDerivativeP rho u v t))
              (F.abs (shearDerivativeQ rho u v t))))
          sPrime) := by
    unfold RealFunction.AddFun ConstMulFun RealFunction.SubFun at hcomp
    simpa [E, shearAccumulatedVariation, shearVariationComparator] using hcomp
  have hmonoClosed :=
    shearVariationComparator_monotoneOn hrect hPBV hQBV
  have hmonoOpen :
      MonotoneOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
        (shearVariationComparator a rho x y) := by
    intro p q hp hq hpq
    exact hmonoClosed p q
      (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b p hp)
      (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b q hq) hpq
  have hnonneg :=
    hasDerivWithin_nonnegative_of_monotoneOn_openInterval
      ht hmonoOpen hcomp'
  exact F.le_of_sub_nonneg hnonneg

name: shearDerivativeBadSet_null
statement:
private theorem shearDerivativeBadSet_null
    {a b rho : Point} {x y u v : Map}
    (hxAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval x a b)
    (hyAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval y a b)
    (hxDeriv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b x u)
    (hyDeriv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b y v) :
    RealNegligibility.NullSet (shearDerivativeBadSet a b rho x y u v)
proof:
:= by
  have hvariation := shearVariation_hasDerivativeRepresentativesAE
    (rho := rho) hxAC hyAC hxDeriv hyDeriv
  unfold shearDerivativeBadSet
  exact RealNegligibility.nullSet_union
    (derivativeRepresentativeExceptionalSet_null_of_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
      hvariation.left)
    (derivativeRepresentativeExceptionalSet_null_of_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
      hvariation.right)

name: internalRat_countable_local
statement:
private theorem internalRat_countable_local :
    Foundation.Cardinal.CountableSet RealTheory.InternalRat
proof:
:= by
  unfold RealTheory.InternalRat
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.internalRat_countable
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base

name: internalRatEnumerator_enumerates
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec internalRat_countable_local

name: internalRatShearBadSet_null
statement:
private theorem internalRatShearBadSet_null
    {a b : Point} {x y u v : Map}
    (hxAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval x a b)
    (hyAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval y a b)
    (hxDeriv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b x u)
    (hyDeriv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b y v) :
    RealNegligibility.NullSet (internalRatShearBadSet a b x y u v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold internalRatShearBadSet
  apply RealNegligibility.nullSet_countableUnion
  intro n
  cases hvalue : internalRatEnumerator n with
  | none =>
      simpa [internalRatShearBadRow, hvalue] using RealNegligibility.nullSet_empty
  | some rho =>
      by_cases hrho : RealTheory.InternalRat rho
      · simpa [internalRatShearBadRow, hvalue, hrho] using
          (shearDerivativeBadSet_null
            (rho := rho) hxAC hyAC hxDeriv hyDeriv)
      · simpa [internalRatShearBadRow, hvalue, hrho] using
          RealNegligibility.nullSet_empty

name: internalRatShearBadSet_covers
statement:
private theorem internalRatShearBadSet_covers
    {a b rho t : Point} {x y u v : Map}
    (hrho : RealTheory.InternalRat rho)
    (ht : shearDerivativeBadSet a b rho x y u v t) :
    internalRatShearBadSet a b x y u v t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases internalRatEnumerator_enumerates rho hrho with
  | intro n hn =>
      unfold internalRatShearBadSet
      unfold Foundation.Cardinal.CountableUnion
      refine Exists.intro n ?_
      simp [internalRatShearBadRow, hn, hrho]
      exact ht

name: planeNorm_zero_left
statement:
private theorem planeNorm_zero_left (z : Point) :
    PlaneNorm RealTheory.zero z = RealTheory.abs z
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hlower := abs_right_le_planeNorm F.zero z
  change F.le (F.abs z) (PlaneNorm F.zero z) at hlower
  have hupper := planeNorm_le_abs_add_abs F.zero z
  change F.le (PlaneNorm F.zero z) (F.add (F.abs F.zero) (F.abs z)) at hupper
  rw [F.abs_zero, F.zero_add] at hupper
  exact F.le_antisymm hupper hlower

name: shearQuotient_le_planeNorm_add_residual
statement:
private theorem shearQuotient_le_planeNorm_add_residual
    (U V rho : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (PlaneNorm RealTheory.one rho))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.add U (RealTheory.mul rho V)))
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub V (RealTheory.mul rho U)))))
      (RealTheory.add (PlaneNorm U V)
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub V (RealTheory.mul rho U))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let N := PlaneNorm F.one rho
  let speed := PlaneNorm U V
  let residual := F.abs (F.sub V (F.mul rho U))
  have hNgeOne := abs_left_le_planeNorm F.one rho
  change F.le (F.abs F.one) N at hNgeOne
  rw [F.abs_one] at hNgeOne
  have hNpos : F.lt F.zero N :=
    F.lt_of_lt_of_le RealTheory.zero_lt_one hNgeOne
  have hNne : Not (N = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hNpos
    exact (F.lt_irrefl F.zero) hNpos
  have hInvNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv N) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (F.inv_pos hNpos)
  have hinvMul : F.mul (F.inv N) N = F.one := by
    rw [F.mul_comm]
    exact F.mul_inv_cancel hNne
  have hdot := planeDot_abs_le_planeNorm_mul_planeNorm U V F.one rho
  change
    F.le
      (F.abs (F.add (F.mul U F.one) (F.mul V rho)))
      (F.mul speed N) at hdot
  rw [F.mul_one, F.mul_comm V rho] at hdot
  have hPscaled := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hdot hInvNonneg
  have hPcancel : F.mul (F.inv N) (F.mul speed N) = speed := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.inv N) (F.mul speed N) =
          F.mul (F.inv N) (F.mul N speed) := by rw [F.mul_comm speed N]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.inv N) N) speed :=
        (F.mul_assoc (F.inv N) N speed).symm
      _ = F.mul F.one speed := by rw [hinvMul]
      _ = speed := F.one_mul speed
  rw [hPcancel] at hPscaled
  have hresNonneg : F.le F.zero residual := by
    unfold residual
    exact RealTheory.abs_nonneg (F.sub V (F.mul rho U))
  have hNres := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hNgeOne hresNonneg
  change F.le (F.mul F.one residual) (F.mul N residual) at hNres
  rw [F.one_mul] at hNres
  have hQscaled := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hNres hInvNonneg
  have hQcancel : F.mul (F.inv N) (F.mul N residual) = residual := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.inv N) (F.mul N residual) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.inv N) N) residual :=
        (F.mul_assoc (F.inv N) N residual).symm
      _ = F.mul F.one residual := by rw [hinvMul]
      _ = residual := F.one_mul residual
  rw [hQcancel] at hQscaled
  have hadd := F.add_le_add hPscaled hQscaled
  change
    F.le
      (F.add
        (F.mul (F.inv N) (F.abs (F.add U (F.mul rho V))))
        (F.mul (F.inv N) residual))
      (F.add speed residual) at hadd
  change
    F.le
      (F.mul (F.inv N)
        (F.add (F.abs (F.add U (F.mul rho V))) residual))
      (F.add speed residual)
  rw [F.mul_add]
  exact hadd

name: le_of_forall_lt_add_pos_local
statement:
private theorem le_of_forall_lt_add_pos_local
    {x y : Point}
    (h : forall eps : Point, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
      RealTheory.lt x (RealTheory.add y eps)) :
    RealTheory.le x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hnot
  have hyxLe : F.le y x := by
    cases F.le_total x y with
    | inl hxy => exact False.elim (hnot hxy)
    | inr hyx => exact hyx
  have hyxLt : F.lt y x :=
    F.lt_of_le_of_not_le hyxLe hnot
  let gap := F.sub x y
  have hgapPos : F.lt F.zero gap := by
    unfold gap
    exact F.sub_pos_of_lt hyxLt
  let eps := F.half gap
  have hepsPos : F.lt F.zero eps := by
    unfold eps
    exact F.half_pos hgapPos
  have hhalfLt : F.lt eps gap := by
    unfold eps
    exact F.half_lt_self hgapPos
  have hyadd : F.lt (F.add y eps) x := by
    have hshift := F.add_lt_add_left hhalfLt y
    change F.lt (F.add y eps) (F.add y gap) at hshift
    have hgap : F.add y gap = x := by
      unfold gap
      rw [F.add_comm]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x y
    rwa [hgap] at hshift
  exact (F.lt_irrefl x) (F.lt_trans (h eps hepsPos) hyadd)

name: accumulatedLength_derivative_le_planeSpeed_of_internalRat_shears
statement:
private theorem accumulatedLength_derivative_le_planeSpeed_of_internalRat_shears
    {U V sPrime : Point}
    (hall : forall rho : Point,
      RealTheory.InternalRat rho ->
        RealTheory.le sPrime
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (PlaneNorm RealTheory.one rho))
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.add U (RealTheory.mul rho V)))
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub V (RealTheory.mul rho U)))))) :
    RealTheory.le sPrime (PlaneNorm U V)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hU : U = F.zero
  · have hzero := hall F.zero RealTheory.internalRat_zero
    change
      F.le sPrime
        (F.mul (F.inv (PlaneNorm F.one F.zero))
          (F.add
            (F.abs (F.add U (F.mul F.zero V)))
            (F.abs (F.sub V (F.mul F.zero U))))) at hzero
    rw [hU] at hzero
    have hNzero : PlaneNorm F.one F.zero = F.one :=
      RealFunction.Curve.planeNorm_one_zero
    rw [hNzero] at hzero
    rw [F.inv_one, F.zero_mul, F.zero_add, F.abs_zero] at hzero
    rw [F.zero_mul, F.sub_zero, F.one_mul, F.zero_add] at hzero
    rw [hU]
    have hzeroLeft : PlaneNorm F.zero V = F.abs V := planeNorm_zero_left V
    rw [hzeroLeft]
    exact hzero
  · apply le_of_forall_lt_add_pos_local
    intro eps heps
    let absU := F.abs U
    let denom := F.add absU F.one
    let eta := F.mul eps (F.inv denom)
    let ratio := F.mul V (F.inv U)
    have hAbsUPos : F.lt F.zero absU := by
      unfold absU
      exact RealTheory.abs_pos_of_ne_zero hU
    have hAbsUDenom : F.lt absU denom := by
      unfold denom
      have h := F.add_lt_add_left RealTheory.zero_lt_one absU
      change F.lt (F.add absU F.zero) (F.add absU F.one) at h
      rwa [F.add_zero] at h
    have hdenomPos : F.lt F.zero denom :=
      F.lt_trans hAbsUPos hAbsUDenom
    have hdenomNe : Not (denom = F.zero) := by
      intro hzero
      rw [hzero] at hdenomPos
      exact (F.lt_irrefl F.zero) hdenomPos
    have hInvDenomPos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv denom) :=
      F.inv_pos hdenomPos
    have hetaPos : F.lt F.zero eta := by
      unfold eta
      exact F.mul_pos heps hInvDenomPos
    cases RealTheory.exists_internalRat_abs_sub_lt
        (x := ratio) (eps := eta) hetaPos with
    | intro rho hrhoData =>
        have hrho := hrhoData.left
        have hclose := hrhoData.right
        have hupper := hall rho hrho
        have hfinite := shearQuotient_le_planeNorm_add_residual U V rho
        have hquotient := F.le_trans hupper hfinite
        have hUinv : F.mul (F.inv U) U = F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_comm]
          exact F.mul_inv_cancel hU
        have hratioMul : F.mul ratio U = V := by
          unfold ratio
          calc
            F.mul (F.mul V (F.inv U)) U =
                F.mul V (F.mul (F.inv U) U) := F.mul_assoc V (F.inv U) U
            _ = F.mul V F.one := by rw [hUinv]
            _ = V := F.mul_one V
        have hresidual :
            F.sub V (F.mul rho U) = F.mul (F.sub ratio rho) U := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul]
          rw [hratioMul]
        have hresidualAbs :
            F.abs (F.sub V (F.mul rho U)) =
              F.mul (F.abs (F.sub rho ratio)) absU := by
          rw [hresidual, F.abs_mul]
          unfold absU
          rw [F.abs_sub_comm ratio rho]
        have hproductLt :
            F.lt
              (F.mul (F.abs (F.sub rho ratio)) absU)
              (F.mul eta absU) :=
          F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hclose hAbsUPos
        have hInvMulDenom : F.mul (F.inv denom) denom = F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_comm]
          exact F.mul_inv_cancel hdenomNe
        have hfractionLtOne :
            F.lt (F.mul (F.inv denom) absU) F.one := by
          have h := F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hAbsUDenom hInvDenomPos
          change
            F.lt (F.mul (F.inv denom) absU)
              (F.mul (F.inv denom) denom) at h
          rwa [hInvMulDenom] at h
        have hetaMulLt : F.lt (F.mul eta absU) eps := by
          have h := F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hfractionLtOne heps
          change
            F.lt
              (F.mul eps (F.mul (F.inv denom) absU))
              (F.mul eps F.one) at h
          rw [F.mul_one] at h
          unfold eta
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
          exact h
        have hresLt :
            F.lt (F.abs (F.sub V (F.mul rho U))) eps := by
          rw [hresidualAbs]
          exact F.lt_trans hproductLt hetaMulLt
        have haddLt := F.add_lt_add_left hresLt (PlaneNorm U V)
        exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hquotient haddLt

name: planeCurveLengthFrom_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE_planeCurveSpeed
statement:
theorem planeCurveLengthFrom_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE_planeCurveSpeed
    {a b : Point} {x y u v : Map}
    (hxAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval x a b)
    (hyAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval y a b)
    (hxDeriv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b x u)
    (hyDeriv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b y v) :
    HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b
      (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) (RealFunction.Curve.planeCurveSpeed u v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b := hxAC.left
  have hcurve : PlaneCurveOn a b x y :=
    And.intro hab
      (And.intro
        (continuousOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hxAC)
        (continuousOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hyAC))
  have hrect : RectifiablePlaneCurveOn a b x y :=
    (rectifiablePlaneCurveOn_iff_boundedVariationOn_coordinates hcurve).mpr
      (And.intro
        (boundedVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hxAC)
        (boundedVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hyAC))
  have hsAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
      (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) a b :=
    planeCurveLengthFrom_absolutelyContinuous_of_coordinates hxAC hyAC
  cases
      exists_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
        hsAC with
  | intro sPrime hsDeriv =>
      let XBad := DerivativeRepresentativeExceptionalSet a b x u
      let YBad := DerivativeRepresentativeExceptionalSet a b y v
      let SBad := DerivativeRepresentativeExceptionalSet a b
        (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) sPrime
      let RBad := internalRatShearBadSet a b x y u v
      let Bad := Foundation.Cardinal.SetUnion XBad
        (Foundation.Cardinal.SetUnion YBad
          (Foundation.Cardinal.SetUnion SBad RBad))
      have hXNull : RealNegligibility.NullSet XBad := by
        unfold XBad
        exact
          derivativeRepresentativeExceptionalSet_null_of_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
            hxDeriv
      have hYNull : RealNegligibility.NullSet YBad := by
        unfold YBad
        exact
          derivativeRepresentativeExceptionalSet_null_of_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
            hyDeriv
      have hSNull : RealNegligibility.NullSet SBad := by
        unfold SBad
        exact
          derivativeRepresentativeExceptionalSet_null_of_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
            hsDeriv
      have hRNull : RealNegligibility.NullSet RBad := by
        unfold RBad
        exact internalRatShearBadSet_null hxAC hyAC hxDeriv hyDeriv
      have hBadNull : RealNegligibility.NullSet Bad := by
        unfold Bad
        exact RealNegligibility.nullSet_union hXNull
          (RealNegligibility.nullSet_union hYNull
            (RealNegligibility.nullSet_union hSNull hRNull))
      apply
        hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_of_exceptionalSet_null
      apply RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
        (F := Bad)
      · intro t htBad
        by_cases hxt :
            HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x t (u t)
        · by_cases hyt :
              HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) y t (v t)
          · by_cases hst :
                HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
                  (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) t (sPrime t)
            · by_cases htR : RBad t
              · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr htR))
              · have hall : forall rho : Point,
                    RealTheory.InternalRat rho ->
                      F.le (sPrime t)
                        (F.mul (F.inv (PlaneNorm F.one rho))
                          (F.add
                            (F.abs (F.add (u t) (F.mul rho (v t))))
                            (F.abs (F.sub (v t) (F.mul rho (u t)))))) := by
                  intro rho hrho
                  have hShearAC :=
                    normalizedShearProjections_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
                      (rho := rho) hxAC hyAC
                  have hPBV :
                      BoundedVariationOn a b
                        (normalizedShearP a rho x y) :=
                    boundedVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
                      hShearAC.left
                  have hQBV :
                      BoundedVariationOn a b
                        (normalizedShearQ a rho x y) :=
                    boundedVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
                      hShearAC.right
                  have hvariation :=
                    shearVariation_hasDerivativeRepresentativesAE
                      (rho := rho) hxAC hyAC hxDeriv hyDeriv
                  have hVP :
                      HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
                        (shearVariationP a rho x y) t
                        (F.abs (shearDerivativeP rho u v t)) := by
                    apply Classical.byContradiction
                    intro hnot
                    have hrow : shearDerivativeBadSet a b rho x y u v t :=
                      Or.inl (And.intro htBad.left hnot)
                    exact htR
                      (internalRatShearBadSet_covers hrho hrow)
                  have hVQ :
                      HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
                        (shearVariationQ a rho x y) t
                        (F.abs (shearDerivativeQ rho u v t)) := by
                    apply Classical.byContradiction
                    intro hnot
                    have hrow : shearDerivativeBadSet a b rho x y u v t :=
                      Or.inr (And.intro htBad.left hnot)
                    exact htR
                      (internalRatShearBadSet_covers hrho hrow)
                  have hupper := accumulatedLength_derivative_le_shear_at
                    (u := u) (v := v)
                    hrect hPBV hQBV htBad.left hVP hVQ hst
                  simpa [shearDerivativeP, shearDerivativeQ] using hupper
                have hUpperSpeed :
                    F.le (sPrime t) (PlaneNorm (u t) (v t)) :=
                  accumulatedLength_derivative_le_planeSpeed_of_internalRat_shears
                    hall
                have hLowerSpeed :
                    F.le (PlaneNorm (u t) (v t)) (sPrime t) :=
                  planeSpeed_le_accumulatedLength_derivative_at
                    hrect htBad.left hxt hyt hst
                have heq : sPrime t = PlaneNorm (u t) (v t) :=
                  F.le_antisymm hUpperSpeed hLowerSpeed
                have hspeed :
                    HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
                      (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) t
                      (RealFunction.Curve.planeCurveSpeed u v t) := by
                  unfold RealFunction.Curve.planeCurveSpeed
                  rw [<- heq]
                  exact hst
                exact False.elim (htBad.right hspeed)
            · exact Or.inr (Or.inr
                (Or.inl (And.intro htBad.left hst)))
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (And.intro htBad.left hyt))
        · exact Or.inl (And.intro htBad.left hxt)
      · exact hBadNull

name: exp_convexOn_closedInterval_by_derivative
statement:
theorem exp_convexOn_closedInterval_by_derivative
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    (a b : Point) :
    RealFunction.ConvexOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) I.expSpec.exp
proof:
:= by
  let Eclosed := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
  let Eopen := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  have hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn Eclosed I.expSpec.exp := by
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (E := Eclosed) (G := UniversalDomain)
      (f := I.expSpec.exp)
      (fun _x _hx => trivial)
      I.expSpec.continuousOn
  have hD :
      forall x : Point,
        Eopen x ->
          HasDerivWithin Eopen I.expSpec.exp x
            (I.expSpec.exp x) := by
    intro x hx
    exact hasDerivWithin_subset
      (E := UniversalDomain) (G := Eopen)
      (f := I.expSpec.exp) (x0 := x)
      (A := I.expSpec.exp x)
      (fun _y _hy => trivial) hx
      (hasDerivWithin_exp_at I x)
  have hDcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn Eclosed I.expSpec.exp :=
    hfcont
  have hDdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b I.expSpec.exp := by
    intro x hx
    exact Exists.intro (I.expSpec.exp x) (hD x hx)
  have hDderiv :
      DerivativeNonnegativeOnOpenInterval a b I.expSpec.exp := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hknown : HasDerivWithin Eopen I.expSpec.exp x
        (I.expSpec.exp x) := hD x hx
    have hAeq :
        A = I.expSpec.exp x :=
      hasDerivWithin_unique
        (openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA hknown
    rw [hAeq]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (I.expSpec.pos x)
  exact
    convexOn_closedInterval_of_secondDerivative_nonnegative
      (a := a) (b := b)
      (f := I.expSpec.exp) (D := I.expSpec.exp)
      hfcont hD hDcont hDdiff hDderiv

name: log_concaveOn_closedInterval_by_derivative
statement:
theorem log_concaveOn_closedInterval_by_derivative
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : PositiveDomain a) :
    RealFunction.ConcaveOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) I.logSpec.log
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Eclosed := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
  let Eopen := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  let invFun : Map := fun x : Point => F.inv x
  have hclosedPos :
      SetPred.Subset Eclosed PositiveDomain :=
    RealFunction.closedInterval_subset_positive_of_left_pos ha
  have hopenPos :
      SetPred.Subset Eopen PositiveDomain :=
    RealFunction.openInterval_subset_positive_of_left_pos ha
  have hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn Eclosed I.logSpec.log := by
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (E := Eclosed) (G := PositiveDomain)
      (f := I.logSpec.log)
      hclosedPos I.logSpec.continuousOn
  have hD :
      forall x : Point,
        Eopen x ->
          HasDerivWithin Eopen I.logSpec.log x (invFun x) := by
    intro x hx
    exact hasDerivWithin_subset
      (E := PositiveDomain) (G := Eopen)
      (f := I.logSpec.log) (x0 := x) (A := invFun x)
      hopenPos hx
      (hasDerivWithin_log_at I (hopenPos x hx))
  have hDcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn Eclosed invFun := by
    have hinvCont :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn PositiveDomain invFun :=
      continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        (E := PositiveDomain)
        (f := invFun)
        (f' := fun x : Point =>
          F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)))
        hasDerivativeWithinOn_inv_positive
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (E := Eclosed) (G := PositiveDomain)
      (f := invFun) hclosedPos hinvCont
  have hDdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b invFun := by
    intro x hx
    exact Exists.intro
      (F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)))
      (hasDerivWithin_subset
        (E := PositiveDomain) (G := Eopen)
        (f := invFun) (x0 := x)
        (A := F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)))
        hopenPos hx
        (hasDerivativeWithinOn_inv_positive x (hopenPos x hx)))
  have hDderiv :
      DerivativeNonpositiveOnOpenInterval a b invFun := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hknown :
        HasDerivWithin Eopen invFun x
          (F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))) := by
      exact hasDerivWithin_subset
        (E := PositiveDomain) (G := Eopen)
        (f := invFun) (x0 := x)
        (A := F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)))
        hopenPos hx
        (hasDerivativeWithinOn_inv_positive x (hopenPos x hx))
    have hAeq :
        A = F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)) :=
      hasDerivWithin_unique
        (openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA hknown
    rw [hAeq]
    have hsquare :
        F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg F (F.inv x)
    have hneg := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hsquare
    change
      F.le (F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)))
        (F.neg F.zero) at hneg
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at hneg
  exact
    concaveOn_closedInterval_of_secondDerivative_nonpositive
      (a := a) (b := b)
      (f := I.logSpec.log) (D := invFun)
      hfcont hD hDcont hDdiff hDderiv

name: power_ge_one_convexOn_positive_closedInterval_by_derivative
statement:
theorem power_ge_one_convexOn_positive_closedInterval_by_derivative
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {mu a b : Point}
    (hmu : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one mu)
    (ha : PositiveDomain a) :
    RealFunction.ConvexOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (fun x : Point => I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Eclosed := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
  let Eopen := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  let powMu : Map :=
    fun x : Point => I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x
  let D : Map :=
    fun x : Point =>
      F.mul mu
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (F.sub mu F.one) x)
  let DD : Map :=
    fun x : Point =>
      F.mul mu
        (F.mul (F.sub mu F.one)
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one) x))
  have hclosedPos :
      SetPred.Subset Eclosed PositiveDomain :=
    RealFunction.closedInterval_subset_positive_of_left_pos ha
  have hopenPos :
      SetPred.Subset Eopen PositiveDomain :=
    RealFunction.openInterval_subset_positive_of_left_pos ha
  have hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn Eclosed powMu := by
    have hcontPos :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn PositiveDomain powMu :=
      continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        (hasDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu)
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hclosedPos hcontPos
  have hD :
      forall x : Point,
        Eopen x -> HasDerivWithin Eopen powMu x (D x) := by
    intro x hx
    exact hasDerivWithin_subset
      (E := PositiveDomain) (G := Eopen)
      (f := powMu) (x0 := x) (A := D x)
      hopenPos hx
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu x (hopenPos x hx))
  have hDcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn Eclosed D := by
    have hcontPos :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn PositiveDomain D :=
      continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        (hasSecondDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu)
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hclosedPos hcontPos
  have hDdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b D :=
    differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn_subset
      hopenPos (hasSecondDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu)
  have hDderiv : DerivativeNonnegativeOnOpenInterval a b D := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hknown :
        HasDerivWithin Eopen D x (DD x) :=
      hasDerivWithin_subset
        (E := PositiveDomain) (G := Eopen)
        (f := D) (x0 := x) (A := DD x)
        hopenPos hx
        (hasSecondDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu x
          (hopenPos x hx))
    have hAeq : A = DD x :=
      hasDerivWithin_unique
        (openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA hknown
    rw [hAeq]
    unfold DD
    have hmu_nonneg : F.le F.zero mu :=
      F.le_trans (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F F.zero_lt_one) hmu
    have hmu_sub_nonneg :
        F.le F.zero (F.sub mu F.one) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hmu
    have hpow_nonneg :
        F.le F.zero
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one) x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (Tautology.RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface.power_positive I
          (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one)
          (hopenPos x hx))
    exact F.mul_nonneg hmu_nonneg
      (F.mul_nonneg hmu_sub_nonneg hpow_nonneg)
  exact
    convexOn_closedInterval_of_secondDerivative_nonnegative
      (a := a) (b := b)
      (f := powMu) (D := D)
      hfcont hD hDcont hDdiff hDderiv

name: power_negative_convexOn_positive_closedInterval_by_derivative
statement:
theorem power_negative_convexOn_positive_closedInterval_by_derivative
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {mu a b : Point}
    (hmu_neg : RealTheory.lt mu RealTheory.zero)
    (ha : PositiveDomain a) :
    RealFunction.ConvexOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (fun x : Point => I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Eclosed := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
  let Eopen := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  let powMu : Map :=
    fun x : Point => I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x
  let D : Map :=
    fun x : Point =>
      F.mul mu
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (F.sub mu F.one) x)
  let DD : Map :=
    fun x : Point =>
      F.mul mu
        (F.mul (F.sub mu F.one)
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one) x))
  have hclosedPos :
      SetPred.Subset Eclosed PositiveDomain :=
    RealFunction.closedInterval_subset_positive_of_left_pos ha
  have hopenPos :
      SetPred.Subset Eopen PositiveDomain :=
    RealFunction.openInterval_subset_positive_of_left_pos ha
  have hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn Eclosed powMu := by
    have hcontPos :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn PositiveDomain powMu :=
      continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        (hasDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu)
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hclosedPos hcontPos
  have hD :
      forall x : Point,
        Eopen x -> HasDerivWithin Eopen powMu x (D x) := by
    intro x hx
    exact hasDerivWithin_subset
      (E := PositiveDomain) (G := Eopen)
      (f := powMu) (x0 := x) (A := D x)
      hopenPos hx
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu x (hopenPos x hx))
  have hDcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn Eclosed D := by
    have hcontPos :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn PositiveDomain D :=
      continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        (hasSecondDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu)
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hclosedPos hcontPos
  have hDdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b D :=
    differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn_subset
      hopenPos (hasSecondDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu)
  have hDderiv : DerivativeNonnegativeOnOpenInterval a b D := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hknown :
        HasDerivWithin Eopen D x (DD x) :=
      hasDerivWithin_subset
        (E := PositiveDomain) (G := Eopen)
        (f := D) (x0 := x) (A := DD x)
        hopenPos hx
        (hasSecondDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu x
          (hopenPos x hx))
    have hAeq : A = DD x :=
      hasDerivWithin_unique
        (openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA hknown
    rw [hAeq]
    unfold DD
    have hmu_nonpos : F.le mu F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hmu_neg
    have hmu_le_one : F.le mu F.one :=
      F.le_trans hmu_nonpos
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F F.zero_lt_one)
    have hmu_sub_nonpos :
        F.le (F.sub mu F.one) F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hmu_le_one
    have hpow_nonneg :
        F.le F.zero
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one) x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (Tautology.RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface.power_positive I
          (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one)
          (hopenPos x hx))
    have hinner_nonpos :
        F.le
          (F.mul (F.sub mu F.one)
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
              (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one) x))
          F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
        F hmu_sub_nonpos hpow_nonneg
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos
      F hmu_nonpos hinner_nonpos
  exact
    convexOn_closedInterval_of_secondDerivative_nonnegative
      (a := a) (b := b)
      (f := powMu) (D := D)
      hfcont hD hDcont hDdiff hDderiv

name: power_between_zero_one_concaveOn_positive_closedInterval_by_derivative
statement:
theorem power_between_zero_one_concaveOn_positive_closedInterval_by_derivative
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {mu a b : Point}
    (hmu_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero mu)
    (hmu_le_one : RealTheory.le mu RealTheory.one)
    (ha : PositiveDomain a) :
    RealFunction.ConcaveOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (fun x : Point => I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Eclosed := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
  let Eopen := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  let powMu : Map :=
    fun x : Point => I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x
  let D : Map :=
    fun x : Point =>
      F.mul mu
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (F.sub mu F.one) x)
  let DD : Map :=
    fun x : Point =>
      F.mul mu
        (F.mul (F.sub mu F.one)
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one) x))
  have hclosedPos :
      SetPred.Subset Eclosed PositiveDomain :=
    RealFunction.closedInterval_subset_positive_of_left_pos ha
  have hopenPos :
      SetPred.Subset Eopen PositiveDomain :=
    RealFunction.openInterval_subset_positive_of_left_pos ha
  have hfcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn Eclosed powMu := by
    have hcontPos :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn PositiveDomain powMu :=
      continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        (hasDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu)
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hclosedPos hcontPos
  have hD :
      forall x : Point,
        Eopen x -> HasDerivWithin Eopen powMu x (D x) := by
    intro x hx
    exact hasDerivWithin_subset
      (E := PositiveDomain) (G := Eopen)
      (f := powMu) (x0 := x) (A := D x)
      hopenPos hx
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu x (hopenPos x hx))
  have hDcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn Eclosed D := by
    have hcontPos :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn PositiveDomain D :=
      continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        (hasSecondDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu)
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hclosedPos hcontPos
  have hDdiff : DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b D :=
    differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn_subset
      hopenPos (hasSecondDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu)
  have hDderiv : DerivativeNonpositiveOnOpenInterval a b D := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hknown :
        HasDerivWithin Eopen D x (DD x) :=
      hasDerivWithin_subset
        (E := PositiveDomain) (G := Eopen)
        (f := D) (x0 := x) (A := DD x)
        hopenPos hx
        (hasSecondDerivativeWithinOn_power_base I mu x
          (hopenPos x hx))
    have hAeq : A = DD x :=
      hasDerivWithin_unique
        (openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA hknown
    rw [hAeq]
    unfold DD
    have hmu_sub_nonpos :
        F.le (F.sub mu F.one) F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hmu_le_one
    have hpow_nonneg :
        F.le F.zero
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one) x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (Tautology.RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface.power_positive I
          (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one)
          (hopenPos x hx))
    have hinner_nonpos :
        F.le
          (F.mul (F.sub mu F.one)
            (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
              (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one) x))
          F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
        F hmu_sub_nonpos hpow_nonneg
    have hcomm_nonpos :
        F.le
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (F.sub mu F.one)
              (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one) x))
            mu)
          F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
        F hinner_nonpos hmu_nonneg
    rwa [F.mul_comm
      (F.mul (F.sub mu F.one)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (F.sub (F.sub mu F.one) F.one) x)) mu]
      at hcomm_nonpos
  exact
    concaveOn_closedInterval_of_secondDerivative_nonpositive
      (a := a) (b := b)
      (f := powMu) (D := D)
      hfcont hD hDcont hDdiff hDderiv

name: expUpperSubOne_mul_inv_eq_expUpper
statement:
private theorem expUpperSubOne_mul_inv_eq_expUpper
    {x : Point}
    (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hden : Not (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.sub (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x) RealTheory.one)
      (RealTheory.inv x) =
        ExpUpperSqueezeFun x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let den := F.sub F.one x
  have hden' : Not (den = F.zero) := hden
  change F.mul (F.sub (F.inv den) F.one) (F.inv x) =
    F.inv den
  have hsub :
      F.sub (F.inv den) F.one = F.mul x (F.inv den) := by
    calc
      F.sub (F.inv den) F.one =
          F.sub (F.mul F.one (F.inv den))
            (F.mul den (F.inv den)) := by
          rw [F.one_mul, F.mul_inv_cancel hden']
      _ = F.mul (F.sub F.one den) (F.inv den) := by
          rw [← IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F
            F.one den (F.inv den)]
      _ = F.mul x (F.inv den) := by
          unfold den
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F F.one x]
  rw [hsub]
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul x (F.inv den)) (F.inv x) =
        F.mul (F.mul x (F.inv x)) (F.inv den) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
        rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv den) (F.inv x)]
        rw [← F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul F.one (F.inv den) := by
        rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hx]
    _ = F.inv den := by
        rw [F.one_mul]

name: exp_differenceQuotient_zero_eq
statement:
private theorem exp_differenceQuotient_zero_eq
    (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) (x : Point) :
    DifferenceQuotient S.exp RealTheory.zero x =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub (S.exp x) RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  rw [S.zero_value]
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (S.exp x) F.one) (F.inv (F.sub x F.zero)) =
      F.mul (F.sub (S.exp x) F.one) (F.inv x)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F x]

name: exp_differenceQuotient_zero_tendsto
statement:
theorem exp_differenceQuotient_zero_tendsto
    (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
      (DifferenceQuotient S.exp RealTheory.zero)
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hupperTend :=
    expUpperSqueezeFun_tendsto_zero eps heps
  cases hupperTend with
  | intro deltaU hdeltaU =>
      have hbounds := S.eventually_squeeze_bounds_at_zero
      cases hbounds with
      | intro deltaB hdeltaB =>
          let delta0 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaU deltaB
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F delta0 F.one
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
                hdeltaU.left hdeltaB.left)
              F.zero_lt_one
          · intro x _hx hxne hxd
            have hdelta_le_delta0 :
                F.le delta delta0 :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F delta0 F.one
            have hdelta0_le_U :
                F.le delta0 deltaU :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaU deltaB
            have hdelta0_le_B :
                F.le delta0 deltaB :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaU deltaB
            have hxd_U : F.lt (RealFunction.dist x F.zero) deltaU :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd hdelta_le_delta0)
                hdelta0_le_U
            have hxd_B : F.lt (RealFunction.dist x F.zero) deltaB :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd hdelta_le_delta0)
                hdelta0_le_B
            have hxd_one : F.lt (RealFunction.dist x F.zero) F.one :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F delta0 F.one)
            have hupperClose :=
              hdeltaU.right x trivial hxne hxd_U
            have hboundsx := hdeltaB.right x trivial hxne hxd_B
            have hxlt1 : F.lt x F.one := by
              have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hxd_one
              change F.lt x (F.add F.zero F.one) at h
              rwa [F.zero_add] at h
            have hden_pos :
                F.lt F.zero (F.sub F.one x) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxlt1
            have hden_ne :
                Not (F.sub F.one x = F.zero) := by
              intro hzero
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos hzero.symm
            have hdq :
                DifferenceQuotient S.exp F.zero x =
                  F.mul (F.sub (S.exp x) F.one) (F.inv x) :=
              exp_differenceQuotient_zero_eq S x
            have hupper_eq :
                F.mul (F.sub (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x) F.one)
                    (F.inv x) =
                  ExpUpperSqueezeFun x :=
              expUpperSubOne_mul_inv_eq_expUpper hxne hden_ne
            have hupperLeft :
                F.lt (F.sub F.one eps) (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hupperClose
            have hupperRight :
                F.lt (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x) (F.add F.one eps) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hupperClose
            have hlow_sub :
                F.le x (F.sub (S.exp x) F.one) := by
              have h := F.add_le_add_right hboundsx.left (F.neg F.one)
              change
                F.le
                  (F.add (F.add F.one x) (F.neg F.one))
                  (F.add (S.exp x) (F.neg F.one)) at h
              have hleft :
                  F.add (F.add F.one x) (F.neg F.one) = x := by
                calc
                  F.add (F.add F.one x) (F.neg F.one) =
                      F.add (F.add x F.one) (F.neg F.one) := by
                      rw [F.add_comm F.one x]
                  _ = F.add x (F.add F.one (F.neg F.one)) := by
                      rw [F.add_assoc]
                  _ = F.add x F.zero := by
                      rw [F.add_neg]
                  _ = x := by
                      rw [F.add_zero]
              have hright :
                  F.add (S.exp x) (F.neg F.one) =
                    F.sub (S.exp x) F.one := by
                exact F.sub_eq_add_neg (S.exp x) F.one
              rwa [hleft, hright] at h
            have hhigh_sub :
                F.le (F.sub (S.exp x) F.one)
                  (F.sub (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x) F.one) := by
              have h := F.add_le_add_right hboundsx.right (F.neg F.one)
              change
                F.le
                  (F.add (S.exp x) (F.neg F.one))
                  (F.add (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x) (F.neg F.one)) at h
              rwa [← F.sub_eq_add_neg (S.exp x) F.one,
