                ← F.sub_eq_add_neg (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x) F.one] at h
            cases F.le_total F.zero x with
            | inl h0x =>
                have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x := by
                  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0x
                  intro hxle0
                  have hx0 : x = F.zero := F.le_antisymm hxle0 h0x
                  exact hxne hx0
                have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv x) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hxpos
                have hlow_scaled :=
                  F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hlow_sub
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinv_pos)
                have hhigh_scaled :=
                  F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hhigh_sub
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinv_pos)
                have hleft :
                    F.lt (F.sub F.one eps)
                      (DifferenceQuotient S.exp F.zero x) := by
                  rw [hdq]
                  have hone_le :
                      F.le F.one
                        (F.mul (F.sub (S.exp x) F.one) (F.inv x)) := by
                    change F.le (F.mul x (F.inv x))
                      (F.mul (F.sub (S.exp x) F.one) (F.inv x))
                      at hlow_scaled
                    rwa [F.mul_inv_cancel
                      (by
                        intro hzero
                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxpos hzero.symm)]
                      at hlow_scaled
                  have hone_low :
                      F.lt (F.sub F.one eps) F.one :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                    hone_low hone_le
                have hright :
                    F.lt (DifferenceQuotient S.exp F.zero x)
                      (F.add F.one eps) := by
                  rw [hdq]
                  have hle_upper :
                      F.le
                        (F.mul (F.sub (S.exp x) F.one) (F.inv x))
                        (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x) := by
                    rwa [hupper_eq] at hhigh_scaled
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                    hle_upper hupperRight
                unfold RealFunction.dist
                change
                  F.lt
                    (F.abs
                      (F.sub
                        (DifferenceQuotient S.exp F.zero x) F.one))
                    eps
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
                  F hleft hright
            | inr hxle0 =>
                have hxlt0 : F.lt x F.zero := by
                  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxle0
                  intro h0x
                  have hx0 : x = F.zero := F.le_antisymm hxle0 h0x
                  exact hxne hx0
                have hinv_nonpos : F.le (F.inv x) F.zero :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_nonpos_of_neg F hxlt0
                have hlow_scaled :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonpos_right
                    F hlow_sub hinv_nonpos
                have hhigh_scaled :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonpos_right
                    F hhigh_sub hinv_nonpos
                have hleft :
                    F.lt (F.sub F.one eps)
                      (DifferenceQuotient S.exp F.zero x) := by
                  rw [hdq]
                  have hupper_le :
                      F.le (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x)
                        (F.mul (F.sub (S.exp x) F.one) (F.inv x)) := by
                    change
                      F.le
                        (F.mul (F.sub (ExpUpperSqueezeFun x) F.one)
                          (F.inv x))
                        (F.mul (F.sub (S.exp x) F.one) (F.inv x))
                      at hhigh_scaled
                    rwa [hupper_eq] at hhigh_scaled
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                    hupperLeft hupper_le
                have hright :
                    F.lt (DifferenceQuotient S.exp F.zero x)
                      (F.add F.one eps) := by
                  rw [hdq]
                  have hle_one :
                      F.le
                        (F.mul (F.sub (S.exp x) F.one) (F.inv x))
                        F.one := by
                    change
                      F.le
                        (F.mul (F.sub (S.exp x) F.one) (F.inv x))
                        (F.mul x (F.inv x)) at hlow_scaled
                    rwa [F.mul_inv_cancel
                      (by
                        intro hzero
                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxlt0 hzero)]
                      at hlow_scaled
                  have hone_lt_add :
                      F.lt F.one (F.add F.one eps) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F heps
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                    hle_one hone_lt_add
                unfold RealFunction.dist
                change
                  F.lt
                    (F.abs
                      (F.sub
                        (DifferenceQuotient S.exp F.zero x) F.one))
                    eps
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
                  F hleft hright

name: exp_differenceQuotient_at_eq_constMul_shift
statement:
private theorem exp_differenceQuotient_at_eq_constMul_shift
    (S : NaturalExpThinSpec) (x0 x : Point) :
    DifferenceQuotient S.exp x0 x =
      RealTheory.mul (S.exp x0)
        (DifferenceQuotient S.exp RealTheory.zero
          (NaturalExpThinSpec.ShiftToZero x0 x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient NaturalExpThinSpec.ShiftToZero
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (S.exp x) (S.exp x0))
        (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) =
      F.mul (S.exp x0)
        (F.mul
          (F.sub (S.exp (F.sub x x0)) (S.exp F.zero))
          (F.inv (F.sub (F.sub x x0) F.zero)))
  have hzero : S.exp F.zero = F.one := S.zero_value
  rw [hzero]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (F.sub x x0)]
  let d := F.sub x x0
  let e0 := S.exp x0
  let ez := S.exp d
  have harg : F.add x0 d = x := by
    unfold d
    change F.add x0 (F.sub x x0) = x
    rw [F.add_comm x0 (F.sub x x0)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x x0
  have hadd := S.add_law x0 d
  change S.exp (F.add x0 d) = F.mul e0 ez at hadd
  rw [harg] at hadd
  rw [hadd]
  change F.mul (F.sub (F.mul e0 ez) e0) (F.inv d) =
    F.mul e0 (F.mul (F.sub ez F.one) (F.inv d))
  have hsub :
      F.sub (F.mul e0 ez) e0 =
        F.mul e0 (F.sub ez F.one) := by
    calc
      F.sub (F.mul e0 ez) e0 =
          F.sub (F.mul e0 ez) (F.mul e0 F.one) := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
      _ = F.mul e0 (F.sub ez F.one) := by
          rw [← IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
            F e0 ez F.one]
  rw [hsub]
  rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: hasDerivWithin_exp_at
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_exp_at
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    (x0 : Point) :
    HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp x0
      (I.expSpec.exp x0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let shift := NaturalExpThinSpec.ShiftToZero x0
  let zeroDQ := DifferenceQuotient I.expSpec.exp F.zero
  have hshift :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin UniversalDomain shift x0 F.zero :=
    NaturalExpThinSpec.tendstoWithin_shiftToZero x0
  have hzero :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin UniversalDomain zeroDQ F.zero F.one :=
    exp_differenceQuotient_zero_tendsto I.expSpec
  have hcomp :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (CompFun zeroDQ shift) x0 F.one := by
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_comp_tendstoWithin
      hshift hzero
      (fun _x _hx _hxne => trivial)
      (fun x _hx hxne hshift_zero => by
        unfold shift NaturalExpThinSpec.ShiftToZero at hshift_zero
        have hx_eq :
            x = x0 :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hshift_zero
        exact hxne hx_eq)
  have hconst :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (fun _ : Point => I.expSpec.exp x0)
        x0 (I.expSpec.exp x0) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const UniversalDomain
      (I.expSpec.exp x0) x0
  have hprod_raw :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => I.expSpec.exp x0)
          (CompFun zeroDQ shift))
        x0 (F.mul (I.expSpec.exp x0) F.one) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hconst hcomp
  have hprod :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin UniversalDomain
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => I.expSpec.exp x0)
          (CompFun zeroDQ shift))
        x0 (I.expSpec.exp x0) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (F.mul_one (I.expSpec.exp x0)) hprod_raw
  refine And.intro trivial ?_
  exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := MulFun (fun _ : Point => I.expSpec.exp x0)
      (CompFun zeroDQ shift))
    (g := DifferenceQuotient I.expSpec.exp x0)
    (fun x _hx _hxne => by
      unfold MulFun CompFun zeroDQ shift
      symm
      exact exp_differenceQuotient_at_eq_constMul_shift I.expSpec x0 x)
    hprod

name: hasDerivWithin_log_at
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_log_at
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {x0 : Point}
    (hx0 : PositiveDomain x0) :
    HasDerivWithin PositiveDomain I.logSpec.log x0
      (RealTheory.inv x0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let y0 := I.logSpec.log x0
  have hexp_deriv :
      HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp y0
        (I.expSpec.exp y0) :=
    hasDerivWithin_exp_at I y0
  have hcenter : I.expSpec.exp y0 = x0 := by
    unfold y0
    exact I.exp_log x0 hx0
  have hA_ne : Not (I.expSpec.exp y0 = F.zero) := by
    rw [hcenter]
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx0 hzero.symm
  have hinj_exp :
      RealFunction.InjectiveOn UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp := by
    intro a b _ha _hb hab
    exact I.expSpec.injective a b hab
  have hinv_deriv_image :
      HasDerivWithin (Image UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp)
        (InverseOn UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp)
        (I.expSpec.exp y0)
        (F.inv (I.expSpec.exp y0)) :=
    inverseOn_hasDerivWithin_at_image_of_continuousAt
      hinj_exp
      hexp_deriv hA_ne
      (inverseOn_exp_continuousAtOn I
        (I.expSpec.pos y0))
  have hinv_deriv_image' :
      HasDerivWithin (Image UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp)
        (InverseOn UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp)
        x0 (F.inv x0) := by
    rw [hcenter] at hinv_deriv_image
    exact hinv_deriv_image
  have hpos_subset :
      SetPred.Subset PositiveDomain
        (Image UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp) := by
    intro y hy
    exact exp_image_positive I hy
  have hinv_deriv_pos :
      HasDerivWithin PositiveDomain
        (InverseOn UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp)
        x0 (F.inv x0) :=
    hasDerivWithin_subset hpos_subset hx0 hinv_deriv_image'
  exact hasDerivWithin_congr
    (E := PositiveDomain)
    (f := InverseOn UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp)
    (g := I.logSpec.log)
    (fun y hy => inverseOn_exp_eq_log I hy)
    hinv_deriv_pos

statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_power_exponent_at
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    {x r0 : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain
      (fun r : Point => I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r x)
      r0
      (RealTheory.mul (I.logSpec.log x)
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r0 x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let inner : Map := fun r : Point => F.mul r (I.logSpec.log x)
  have hinner :
      HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain inner r0 (I.logSpec.log x) := by
    exact hasDerivWithin_id_mul_const (E := UniversalDomain)
      (x0 := r0) (c := I.logSpec.log x) trivial
  have houter :
      HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp (inner r0)
        (I.expSpec.exp (inner r0)) :=
    hasDerivWithin_exp_at I (inner r0)
  have hcomp :
      HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain
        (CompFun I.expSpec.exp inner)
        r0
        (F.mul (I.expSpec.exp (inner r0)) (I.logSpec.log x)) := by
    exact hasDerivWithin_comp hinner houter
      (fun _y _hy _hyne _hneq => trivial)
  have hvalue :
      F.mul (I.expSpec.exp (inner r0)) (I.logSpec.log x) =
        F.mul (I.logSpec.log x)
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r0 x) := by
    unfold inner
    rw [I.power_exp_log r0 x hx]
    exact F.mul_comm
      (I.expSpec.exp (F.mul r0 (I.logSpec.log x)))
      (I.logSpec.log x)
  have hcomp' :
      HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain
        (CompFun I.expSpec.exp inner)
        r0
        (F.mul (I.logSpec.log x)
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r0 x)) :=
    hasDerivWithin_congr_value hvalue hcomp
  exact hasDerivWithin_congr
    (E := UniversalDomain)
    (f := CompFun I.expSpec.exp inner)
    (g := fun r : Point => I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power r x)
    (by
      intro r _hr
      unfold CompFun inner
      exact (I.power_exp_log r x hx).symm)
    hcomp'

name: power_base_derivative_factor
statement:
private theorem power_base_derivative_factor
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    (mu : Point)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PositiveDomain x) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (I.expSpec.exp
          (RealTheory.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x)))
        (RealTheory.mul mu (RealTheory.inv x)) =
      RealTheory.mul mu
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.sub mu RealTheory.one) x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let lx := I.logSpec.log x
  let a := I.expSpec.exp (F.mul mu lx)
  have hinv_x :
      F.inv x = I.expSpec.exp (F.neg lx) := by
    calc
      F.inv x = F.inv (I.expSpec.exp lx) := by
          rw [I.exp_log x hx]
      _ = I.expSpec.exp (F.neg lx) := by
          exact (I.expSpec.neg_eq_inv lx).symm
  have harg :
      F.add (F.mul mu lx) (F.neg lx) =
        F.mul (F.sub mu F.one) lx := by
    calc
      F.add (F.mul mu lx) (F.neg lx) =
          F.add (F.mul mu lx) (F.mul (F.neg F.one) lx) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F F.one lx]
          rw [F.one_mul]
      _ = F.mul (F.add mu (F.neg F.one)) lx := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
      _ = F.mul (F.sub mu F.one) lx := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  change F.mul a (F.mul mu (F.inv x)) =
    F.mul mu
      (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power (F.sub mu F.one) x)
  calc
    F.mul a (F.mul mu (F.inv x)) =
        F.mul mu (F.mul a (F.inv x)) := by
        calc
          F.mul a (F.mul mu (F.inv x)) =
              F.mul (F.mul a mu) (F.inv x) := by
              rw [← F.mul_assoc]
          _ = F.mul (F.mul mu a) (F.inv x) := by
              rw [F.mul_comm a mu]
          _ = F.mul mu (F.mul a (F.inv x)) := by
              rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul mu (F.mul a (I.expSpec.exp (F.neg lx))) := by
        rw [hinv_x]
    _ =
        F.mul mu
          (I.expSpec.exp (F.add (F.mul mu lx) (F.neg lx))) := by
        unfold a
        have hadd := I.expSpec.add_law
          (F.mul mu lx) (F.neg lx)
        change
          I.expSpec.exp (F.add (F.mul mu lx) (F.neg lx)) =
            F.mul (I.expSpec.exp (F.mul mu lx))
              (I.expSpec.exp (F.neg lx)) at hadd
        exact congrArg (fun z : Point => F.mul mu z) hadd.symm
    _ =
        F.mul mu
          (I.expSpec.exp (F.mul (F.sub mu F.one) lx)) := by
        rw [harg]
    _ =
        F.mul mu
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.sub mu F.one) x) := by
        change
          F.mul mu
              (I.expSpec.exp
                (RealTheory.mul (F.sub mu F.one)
                  (I.logSpec.log x))) =
            F.mul mu
              (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
                (F.sub mu F.one) x)
        rw [I.power_exp_log (F.sub mu F.one) x hx]

name: hasDerivWithin_power_base_at
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_power_base_at
    (I : NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface)
    (mu : Point)
    {x0 : Point}
    (hx0 : PositiveDomain x0) :
    HasDerivWithin PositiveDomain
      (fun x : Point => I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)
      x0
      (RealTheory.mul mu
        (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
          (RealTheory.sub mu RealTheory.one) x0))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let inner : Map := fun x : Point => F.mul mu (I.logSpec.log x)
  have hinner :
      HasDerivWithin PositiveDomain inner x0
        (F.mul mu (F.inv x0)) := by
    exact hasDerivWithin_constMul
      (hasDerivWithin_log_at I hx0)
  have houter :
      HasDerivWithin UniversalDomain I.expSpec.exp (inner x0)
        (I.expSpec.exp (inner x0)) :=
    hasDerivWithin_exp_at I (inner x0)
  have hcomp :
      HasDerivWithin PositiveDomain
        (CompFun I.expSpec.exp inner)
        x0
        (F.mul (I.expSpec.exp (inner x0))
          (F.mul mu (F.inv x0))) := by
    exact hasDerivWithin_comp hinner houter
      (fun _y _hy _hyne _hneq => trivial)
  have hvalue :
      F.mul (I.expSpec.exp (inner x0))
          (F.mul mu (F.inv x0)) =
        F.mul mu
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.sub mu F.one) x0) := by
    unfold inner
    exact power_base_derivative_factor I mu hx0
  have hcomp' :
      HasDerivWithin PositiveDomain
        (CompFun I.expSpec.exp inner)
        x0
        (F.mul mu
          (I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power
            (F.sub mu F.one) x0)) :=
    hasDerivWithin_congr_value hvalue hcomp
  exact hasDerivWithin_congr
    (E := PositiveDomain)
    (f := CompFun I.expSpec.exp inner)
    (g := fun x : Point => I.powerSpec.toDerivedSpec.power mu x)
    (by
      intro x hx
      unfold CompFun inner
      exact (I.power_exp_log mu x hx).symm)
    hcomp'

name: square_nonneg_base
statement:
private theorem square_nonneg_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x : Point) :
    F.le F.zero (F.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl hx =>
      exact F.mul_nonneg hx hx
  | inr hx =>
      have hneg_nonneg :
          F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx
      have hsq :
          F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) :=
        F.mul_nonneg hneg_nonneg hneg_nonneg
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x x] at hsq

name: le_one_of_nonneg_square_le_one_base
statement:
private theorem le_one_of_nonneg_square_le_one_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {z : Point}
    (hz0 : F.le F.zero z)
    (hsq : F.le (F.mul z z) F.one) :
    F.le z F.one
proof:
:= by
  cases F.le_total z F.one with
  | inl hz_le_one =>
      exact hz_le_one
  | inr hone_le_z =>
      have hz_le_sq :
          F.le z (F.mul z z) := by
        have hmul :
            F.le (F.mul F.one z) (F.mul z z) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
            F hone_le_z hz0
        rwa [F.one_mul] at hmul
      exact F.le_trans hz_le_sq hsq

name: lt_one_of_nonneg_square_lt_one_base
statement:
private theorem lt_one_of_nonneg_square_lt_one_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {z : Point}
    (hz0 : F.le F.zero z)
    (hsq : F.lt (F.mul z z) F.one) :
    F.lt z F.one
proof:
:= by
  have hzle :
      F.le z F.one :=
    le_one_of_nonneg_square_le_one_base F hz0
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsq)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hzle
  intro hone_le_z
  have hone_le_sq :
      F.le F.one (F.mul z z) := by
    have hmul :
        F.le (F.mul F.one z) (F.mul z z) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
        F hone_le_z hz0
    have hmul' : F.le z (F.mul z z) := by
      rwa [F.one_mul] at hmul
    exact F.le_trans hone_le_z hmul'
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hsq) hone_le_sq

name: unitClosedInterval_sq_le_one
statement:
theorem unitClosedInterval_sq_le_one
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul x x) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft : F.le (F.neg F.one) x := hx.left
  have hright : F.le x F.one := hx.right
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl h0x =>
      have hmul :
          F.le (F.mul x x) (F.mul F.one x) :=
        F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hright h0x
      have hmul' : F.le (F.mul x x) x := by
        rwa [F.one_mul] at hmul
      exact F.le_trans hmul' hright
  | inr hx0 =>
      have hneg_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx0
      have hneg_le_one : F.le (F.neg x) F.one := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hleft
        change F.le (F.neg x) (F.neg (F.neg F.one)) at h
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F F.one] at h
      have hmul :
          F.le (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x))
            (F.mul F.one (F.neg x)) :=
        F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hneg_le_one hneg_nonneg
      have hmul' :
          F.le (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) (F.neg x) := by
        rwa [F.one_mul] at hmul
      have hsquare_neg_le_one :
          F.le (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) F.one :=
        F.le_trans hmul' hneg_le_one
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x x]
        at hsquare_neg_le_one

name: unitOpenInterval_sq_lt_one
statement:
theorem unitOpenInterval_sq_lt_one
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitOpenInterval x) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul x x) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft : F.lt (F.neg F.one) x := hx.left
  have hright : F.lt x F.one := hx.right
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl h0x =>
      have hmul :
          F.le (F.mul x x) (F.mul F.one x) :=
        F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hright) h0x
      have hmul' : F.le (F.mul x x) x := by
        rwa [F.one_mul] at hmul
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hmul' hright
  | inr hx0 =>
      have hneg_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx0
      have hneg_lt_one : F.lt (F.neg x) F.one := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hleft
        change F.lt (F.neg x) (F.neg (F.neg F.one)) at h
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F F.one] at h
      have hmul :
          F.le (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x))
            (F.mul F.one (F.neg x)) :=
        F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hneg_lt_one)
          hneg_nonneg
      have hmul' :
          F.le (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) (F.neg x) := by
        rwa [F.one_mul] at hmul
      have hsquare_neg_lt_one :
          F.lt (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) F.one :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hmul' hneg_lt_one
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x x]
        at hsquare_neg_lt_one

name: sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq
statement:
theorem sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x) :
    RealTheory.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x) =
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sqrtOneMinusSq sqrt2
  have h :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg
      1 (unitClosedInterval_one_sub_sq_nonneg hx)
  rwa [RealFunction.powNat_two] at h

name: sqrtOneMinusSq_nonneg_unitClosedInterval
statement:
theorem sqrtOneMinusSq_nonneg_unitClosedInterval
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sqrtOneMinusSq sqrt2
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_nonneg_succ_of_nonneg
    1 (unitClosedInterval_one_sub_sq_nonneg hx)

name: sqrtOneMinusSq_le_one_unitClosedInterval
statement:
theorem sqrtOneMinusSq_le_one_unitClosedInterval
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x) :
    RealTheory.le (sqrtOneMinusSq x) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hs0 :
      F.le F.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_nonneg_unitClosedInterval hx
  have hx_sq_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul x x) :=
    square_nonneg_base F x
  have hrad_le_one :
      F.le (F.sub F.one (F.mul x x)) F.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic F hx_sq_nonneg
  have hs_sq :
      F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x) =
        F.sub F.one (F.mul x x) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq hx
  have hs_sq_le_one :
      F.le (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x)) F.one := by
    rwa [hs_sq]
  exact le_one_of_nonneg_square_le_one_base F hs0 hs_sq_le_one

name: sqrtOneMinusSq_lt_one_zeroOneOpenInterval
statement:
theorem sqrtOneMinusSq_lt_one_zeroOneOpenInterval
    {x : Point}
    (hx : ZeroOneOpenInterval x) :
    RealTheory.lt (sqrtOneMinusSq x) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxUnitClosed : UnitClosedInterval x := by
    exact And.intro
      (F.le_trans
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_one_lt_zero F))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.left))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.right)
  have hs0 :
      F.le F.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_nonneg_unitClosedInterval hxUnitClosed
  have hx_sq_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.mul x x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hx.left hx.left
  have hrad_lt_one :
      F.lt (F.sub F.one (F.mul x x)) F.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hx_sq_pos
  have hs_sq :
      F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x) =
        F.sub F.one (F.mul x x) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq hxUnitClosed
  have hs_sq_lt_one :
      F.lt (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x)) F.one := by
    rwa [hs_sq]
  exact lt_one_of_nonneg_square_lt_one_base F hs0 hs_sq_lt_one

name: square_le_square_of_nonneg_le_base
statement:
private theorem square_le_square_of_nonneg_le_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x y : Point}
    (hx0 : F.le F.zero x)
    (hxy : F.le x y) :
    F.le (F.mul x x) (F.mul y y)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :
      F.le (F.mul x x) (F.mul y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hxy hx0
  have hy0 : F.le F.zero y := F.le_trans hx0 hxy
  have hright :
      F.le (F.mul y x) (F.mul y y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
      F hxy hy0
  exact F.le_trans hleft hright

name: sqrtOneMinusSq_antitoneOn_zeroOneClosedInterval
statement:
theorem sqrtOneMinusSq_antitoneOn_zeroOneClosedInterval
    {x y : Point}
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hy1 : RealTheory.le y RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.le (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxUnit : UnitClosedInterval x := by
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · exact F.le_trans
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_one_lt_zero F))
        hx0
    · exact F.le_trans hxy hy1
  have hyUnit : UnitClosedInterval y := by
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · exact F.le_trans
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_one_lt_zero F))
        (F.le_trans hx0 hxy)
    · exact hy1
  have hsq :
      F.le (F.mul x x) (F.mul y y) :=
    square_le_square_of_nonneg_le_base F hx0 hxy
  have hrad :
      F.le
        (F.sub F.one (F.mul y y))
        (F.sub F.one (F.mul x x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F (F.le_refl F.one) hsq
  have hroot :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.nthRootFun_monotoneOn_nonnegative_succ 1
      (F.sub F.one (F.mul y y))
      (F.sub F.one (F.mul x x))
      (unitClosedInterval_one_sub_sq_nonneg hyUnit)
      (unitClosedInterval_one_sub_sq_nonneg hxUnit)
      hrad
  change
    F.le
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2
        (F.sub F.one (F.mul y y)))
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2
        (F.sub F.one (F.mul x x)))
  exact hroot

name: sqrtOneMinusSq_pos_unitOpenInterval
statement:
theorem sqrtOneMinusSq_pos_unitOpenInterval
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitOpenInterval x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxClosed : UnitClosedInterval x := by
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.right)
  have hsqrtNonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_nonneg_unitClosedInterval hxClosed
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hsqrtNonneg
  intro hsqrtLeZero
  have hsqrtZero : sqrtOneMinusSq x = RealTheory.zero :=
    F.le_antisymm hsqrtLeZero hsqrtNonneg
  have hsquare := sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq hxClosed
  rw [hsqrtZero, RealTheory.zero_mul] at hsquare
  have hradPos := unitOpenInterval_one_sub_sq_pos hx
  rw [<- hsquare] at hradPos
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero) hradPos

name: square_sub_square_eq_sub_mul_add
statement:
theorem square_sub_square_eq_sub_mul_add
    (a b : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul a a) (RealTheory.mul b b) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub a b) (RealTheory.add a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.sub (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b) =
      F.mul (F.sub a b) (F.add a b)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub F a a b b]
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [F.mul_comm b (F.sub a b)]

name: sub_eq_square_sub_mul_inv_add
statement:
theorem sub_eq_square_sub_mul_inv_add
    {a b : Point}
    (hsum : Not (RealTheory.add a b = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.sub a b =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul a a) (RealTheory.mul b b))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.add a b))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.sub a b =
      F.mul (F.sub (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))
        (F.inv (F.add a b))
  have hsquare :
      F.sub (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b) =
        F.mul (F.sub a b) (F.add a b) := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub F a a b b]
    rw [F.mul_add]
    rw [F.mul_comm b (F.sub a b)]
  rw [hsquare]
  exact Eq.symm
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right
      F (F.sub a b) hsum)

name: sqrtOneMinusSq_add_pos_unitOpen
statement:
theorem sqrtOneMinusSq_add_pos_unitOpen
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : UnitOpenInterval x)
    (hy : UnitOpenInterval y) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.add (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos := sqrtOneMinusSq_pos_unitOpenInterval hx
  have hypos := sqrtOneMinusSq_pos_unitOpenInterval hy
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hxpos hypos
  change
    F.lt (F.add F.zero F.zero)
      (F.add (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq y)) at h
  rwa [F.add_zero] at h

name: sqrtOneMinusSq_differenceQuotient_eq
statement:
theorem sqrtOneMinusSq_differenceQuotient_eq
    {x0 y : Point}
    (hx0 : UnitOpenInterval x0)
    (hy : UnitOpenInterval y)
    (_hyne : Not (y = x0)) :
    RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient sqrtOneMinusSq x0 y =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient oneMinusSqFun x0 y)
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.add (sqrtOneMinusSq y)
            (sqrtOneMinusSq x0)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hx0Closed : UnitClosedInterval x0 := by
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx0.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx0.right)
  have hyClosed : UnitClosedInterval y := by
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy.right)
  have hsum_pos :
      F.lt F.zero
        (F.add (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq x0)) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_add_pos_unitOpen hy hx0
  have hsum_ne :
      Not (RealTheory.add (sqrtOneMinusSq y)
        (sqrtOneMinusSq x0) = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hsum_pos) hzero.symm
  unfold RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient
  rw [sub_eq_square_sub_mul_inv_add hsum_ne]
  rw [sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq hyClosed]
  rw [sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq hx0Closed]
  unfold oneMinusSqFun SubFun MulFun IdentityFun
  change
    F.mul
      (F.mul
        (F.sub (F.sub F.one (F.mul y y))
          (F.sub F.one (F.mul x0 x0)))
        (F.inv (F.add (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq x0))))
      (F.inv (F.sub y x0)) =
    F.mul
      (F.mul
        (F.sub (F.sub F.one (F.mul y y))
          (F.sub F.one (F.mul x0 x0)))
        (F.inv (F.sub y x0)))
      (F.inv (F.add (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq x0)))
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.sub (F.sub F.one (F.mul y y))
            (F.sub F.one (F.mul x0 x0)))
          (F.inv (F.add (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq x0))))
        (F.inv (F.sub y x0)) =
        F.mul
          (F.sub (F.sub F.one (F.mul y y))
            (F.sub F.one (F.mul x0 x0)))
          (F.mul
            (F.inv (F.add (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq x0)))
            (F.inv (F.sub y x0))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.sub (F.sub F.one (F.mul y y))
            (F.sub F.one (F.mul x0 x0)))
          (F.mul
            (F.inv (F.sub y x0))
            (F.inv (F.add (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq x0)))) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm
            (F.inv (F.add (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq x0)))
            (F.inv (F.sub y x0))]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.sub (F.sub F.one (F.mul y y))
              (F.sub F.one (F.mul x0 x0)))
            (F.inv (F.sub y x0)))
          (F.inv (F.add (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq x0))) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: oneMinusSqFun_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval
statement:
theorem oneMinusSqFun_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitOpenInterval x) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval oneMinusSqFun x
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.add x x))
proof:
:= by
  have hconst :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one) x RealTheory.zero :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_const hx
  have hid :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
        IdentityFun x RealTheory.one := by
    unfold IdentityFun
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_id hx
  have hsquare :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
        (MulFun IdentityFun IdentityFun) x
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one x)
          (RealTheory.mul x RealTheory.one)) :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_mul hid hid
  have hsub :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
        oneMinusSqFun x
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one x)
            (RealTheory.mul x RealTheory.one))) := by
    unfold oneMinusSqFun
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_sub hconst hsquare
  rwa [RealTheory.one_mul, RealTheory.mul_one] at hsub

name: sqrtOneMinusSq_hasDerivWithin_raw_unitOpenInterval
statement:
theorem sqrtOneMinusSq_hasDerivWithin_raw_unitOpenInterval
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitOpenInterval x) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval sqrtOneMinusSq x
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.add x x))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.add (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x))))
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hx ?_
  have hrad :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval oneMinusSqFun x
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.add x x)) :=
    oneMinusSqFun_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval hx
  have hxClosed : UnitClosedInterval x :=
    unitOpenInterval_subset_unitClosedInterval x hx
  have hsClosedAt :
      ContinuousAtOn UnitClosedInterval sqrtOneMinusSq x :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_continuousOn_unitClosedInterval x hxClosed
  have hsOpen :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin UnitOpenInterval
        sqrtOneMinusSq x (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
    RealDerivative.tendstoWithin_of_subset
      unitOpenInterval_subset_unitClosedInterval hsClosedAt.right
  have hconst :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin UnitOpenInterval
        (fun _ : Point => sqrtOneMinusSq x)
        x (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const UnitOpenInterval (sqrtOneMinusSq x) x
  have hsum :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin UnitOpenInterval
        (AddFun sqrtOneMinusSq (fun _ : Point => sqrtOneMinusSq x))
        x
        (RealTheory.add (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x)) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_add hsOpen hconst
  have hsum_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.add (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x)) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_add_pos_unitOpen hx hx
  have hsum_ne :
      Not (RealTheory.add (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x) =
        RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsum_pos) hzero.symm
  have hinv :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin UnitOpenInterval
        (InvFun
          (AddFun sqrtOneMinusSq
            (fun _ : Point => sqrtOneMinusSq x)))
        x
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.add (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x))) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_inv hsum hsum_ne
  have hprod :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin UnitOpenInterval
        (MulFun
          (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient oneMinusSqFun x)
          (InvFun
            (AddFun sqrtOneMinusSq
              (fun _ : Point => sqrtOneMinusSq x))))
        x
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.add x x))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.add (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x)))) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hrad.right hinv
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f :=
      MulFun
        (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient oneMinusSqFun x)
        (InvFun
          (AddFun sqrtOneMinusSq
            (fun _ : Point => sqrtOneMinusSq x))))
    (g := RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient sqrtOneMinusSq x)
  · intro y hy hyne
    unfold MulFun InvFun AddFun
    symm
    exact sqrtOneMinusSq_differenceQuotient_eq hx hy hyne
  · exact hprod

name: sqrtOneMinusSq_raw_derivative_eq_neg_x_inv
statement:
theorem sqrtOneMinusSq_raw_derivative_eq_neg_x_inv
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitOpenInterval x) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.add x x))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.add (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x))) =
      RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := sqrtOneMinusSq x
  have hspos : F.lt F.zero s :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_pos_unitOpenInterval hx
  have hsne : Not (s = F.zero) := by
    intro hs
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hspos) hs.symm
  have hsum_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.add s s) := by
    change
      F.lt F.zero
        (F.add (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x))
    exact sqrtOneMinusSq_add_pos_unitOpen hx hx
  have hsum_ne : Not (F.add s s = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hsum_pos) hzero.symm
  have hright :
      F.mul (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv s))) (F.add s s) =
        F.neg (F.add x x) := by
    have hxs :
        F.mul (F.mul x (F.inv s)) s = x := by
      calc
        F.mul (F.mul x (F.inv s)) s =
            F.mul x (F.mul (F.inv s) s) := by
              rw [F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul x F.one := by
              rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hsne]
        _ = x := by rw [F.mul_one]
    calc
      F.mul (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv s))) (F.add s s) =
          F.neg (F.mul (F.mul x (F.inv s)) (F.add s s)) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F]
      _ =
          F.neg
            (F.add
              (F.mul (F.mul x (F.inv s)) s)
              (F.mul (F.mul x (F.inv s)) s)) := by
            rw [F.mul_add]
      _ = F.neg (F.add x x) := by
            rw [hxs]
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero
    F (z := F.add s s) hsum_ne
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (F.sub F.zero (F.add x x)) (F.inv (F.add s s)))
        (F.add s s) =
        F.sub F.zero (F.add x x) := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
            F (F.sub F.zero (F.add x x)) hsum_ne
    _ = F.neg (F.add x x) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F]
    _ = F.mul (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv s))) (F.add s s) := by
          exact Eq.symm hright

name: sqrtOneMinusSq_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval
statement:
theorem sqrtOneMinusSq_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitOpenInterval x) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval sqrtOneMinusSq x
      (RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq x))))
proof:

name: factorial_mul_taylorCoeff
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_taylorCoeff
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
      (TaylorCoeff D x0 n) =
    D n x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hfact :
      Not (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n) = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
  unfold TaylorCoeff
  change
    F.mul (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
        (F.mul (D n x0)
          (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n)))) =
      D n x0
  calc
    F.mul (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
        (F.mul (D n x0)
          (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n)))) =
        F.mul (D n x0)
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n)))) := by
          calc
            F.mul (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
                (F.mul (D n x0)
                  (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n)))) =
                F.mul
                  (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
                    (D n x0))
                  (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))) := by
                  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
            _ =
                F.mul
                  (F.mul (D n x0)
                    (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n)))
                  (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
                    (D n x0)]
            _ =
                F.mul (D n x0)
                  (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n))
                    (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n)))) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (D n x0) F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hfact]
    _ = D n x0 := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: taylorJetCoeff_unique_of_taylorPeanoAt
statement:
theorem taylorJetCoeff_unique_of_taylorPeanoAt
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point}
    {c : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hT : TaylorPeanoAt E f D x0 n)
    (hJ : TaylorJetExpansionAt E f x0 c n)
    (hcluster : RealFunction.ClusterPoint E x0) :
    forall k : Nat, k <= n -> c k = TaylorCoeff D x0 k
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hfact :
      Not (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k) = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
  have hP : CoefficientPeanoExpansionAt E f x0 (TaylorJetRawCoeff c) n :=
    coefficientPeanoExpansionAt_of_taylorJetExpansionAt hJ
  have hraw :
      TaylorJetRawCoeff c k = D k x0 :=
    derivativeRows_unique_of_coefficientPeanoExpansion hT hP hcluster k hk
  have hscaled :=
    congrArg
      (fun z : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul z
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k))))
      hraw
  unfold TaylorJetRawCoeff at hscaled
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul (c k) (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k)))
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k))) =
      F.mul (D k x0)
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k))) at hscaled
  rw [F.mul_assoc] at hscaled
  rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hfact] at hscaled
  rw [F.mul_one] at hscaled
  unfold TaylorCoeff
  exact hscaled

name: hasIntegral_taylorTransportRemainderDerivative_endpoint
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_taylorTransportRemainderDerivative_endpoint
    {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hData : TaylorRemainderSegmentData D f n x0 x)
    (hcont :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        (TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n) x0 x) :
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
      (TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n) x0 x
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero
        (TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x))
proof:
:= by
  have hI :=
    hasIntegral_taylorTransportRemainderDerivative
      (f := f) (D := D) (x0 := x0) (x := x) (n := n)
      hData hcont
  have hend :
      TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n x = RealTheory.zero := by
    cases RealTheory.le_total x0 x with
    | inl hx0x =>
        exact
          taylorTransportRemainder_at_endpoint
            (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval x0 x)
            (D := D) (f := f) (x := x) (n := n)
            (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hx0x)
            (hData.left hx0x).same_zero
    | inr hxx0 =>
        exact
          taylorTransportRemainder_at_endpoint
            (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval x x0)
            (D := D) (f := f) (x := x) (n := n)
            (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hxx0)
            (hData.right hxx0).same_zero
  have hbase :
      TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n x0 =
        TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x :=
    taylorTransportRemainder_at_base D f x0 n x
  simpa [hend, hbase] using hI

name: taylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand_hasIntegral_value_eq
statement:
theorem taylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand_hasIntegral_value_eq
    {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 x I : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hData : TaylorRemainderSegmentData D f n x0 x)
    (hcont :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        (TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n) x0 x)
    (hI :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        (TaylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand D x n) x0 x I) :
    I = TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x
proof:
:= by
  let R := TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x
  let G := TaylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand D x n
  let T := TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n
  have hnegI :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        (RealFunction.NegFun G) x0 x (RealTheory.neg I) :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.hasIntegral_neg hI
  have htransportI :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral T x0 x
        (RealTheory.neg I) := by
    apply RealIntegral.EqualPartition.hasIntegral_congr_integrand
      (f := RealFunction.NegFun G) (g := T)
    · intro t
      have hfun :=
        congrFun
          (TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative_eq_neg_integrand
            D x n) t
      exact hfun.symm
    · exact hnegI
  have hendpoint :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral T x0 x
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero R) := by
    exact
      hasIntegral_taylorTransportRemainderDerivative_endpoint
        (f := f) (D := D) (x0 := x0) (x := x) (n := n)
        hData hcont
  have huniq :
      RealTheory.neg I = RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero R :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.hasIntegral_unique htransportI hendpoint
  have hnegEq :
      RealTheory.neg I = RealTheory.neg R := by
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    change F.neg I = F.neg R
    change F.neg I = F.sub F.zero R at huniq
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F R] at huniq
  have h := congrArg RealTheory.neg hnegEq
  change
    RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.neg I) =
      RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.neg R) at h
  rwa [RealTheory.neg_neg I, RealTheory.neg_neg R] at h

name: taylor_integral_remainder_hasIntegral
statement:
theorem taylor_integral_remainder_hasIntegral
    {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 x I : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hData : TaylorRemainderSegmentData D f n x0 x)
    (hcont :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        (D (n + 1)) x0 x)
    (hI :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        (TaylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand D x n) x0 x I) :
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
      (TaylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand D x n) x0 x
      (TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x)
proof:
:= by
  have htransportCont :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        (TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n) x0 x :=
    continuousOnSegment_taylorTransportRemainderDerivative
      (D := D) (a := x0) (b := x) (x := x) (n := n)
      hcont
  have hvalue :
      I = TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x :=
    taylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand_hasIntegral_value_eq
      (f := f) (D := D) (x0 := x0) (x := x) (I := I)
      (n := n) hData htransportCont hI
  simpa [hvalue] using hI

name: taylor_integral_remainder
statement:
theorem taylor_integral_remainder
    {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hData : TaylorRemainderSegmentData D f n x0 x)
    (hcont :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        (D (n + 1)) x0 x) :
    TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x =
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integral
        (TaylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand D x n) x0 x
        (taylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand_integrable
          (D := D) (a := x0) (b := x) (x := x) (n := n)
          hcont)
proof:
:= by
  let hint :=
    taylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand_integrable
      (D := D) (a := x0) (b := x) (x := x) (n := n)
      hcont
  have hspec :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        (TaylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand D x n) x0 x
        (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integral
          (TaylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand D x n) x0 x hint) :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integral_spec hint
  have hrel :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        (TaylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand D x n) x0 x
        (TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x) :=
    taylor_integral_remainder_hasIntegral
      (f := f) (D := D) (x0 := x0) (x := x)
      (I := RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integral
        (TaylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand D x n) x0 x hint)
      (n := n) hData hcont hspec
  have heq :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integral
        (TaylorIntegralRemainderIntegrand D x n) x0 x hint =
        TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integral_eq_of_hasIntegral hint hrel
  exact heq.symm

name: taylorComparisonRemainder_algebra_of_product
statement:
theorem taylorComparisonRemainder_algebra_of_product
    {A B C P R : Point}
    (hB : Not (B = RealTheory.zero))
    (h :
      RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.mul C P) =
        RealTheory.mul R B) :
    R =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv B)) C)
        P
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change Not (B = F.zero) at hB
  change F.mul A (F.mul C P) = F.mul R B at h
  calc
    R = F.mul (F.mul R B) (F.inv B) := by
          symm
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right F R hB
    _ = F.mul (F.mul A (F.mul C P)) (F.inv B) := by
          rw [<- h]
    _ = F.mul A (F.mul (F.mul C P) (F.inv B)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul A (F.mul (F.inv B) (F.mul C P)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (F.mul C P) (F.inv B)]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul A (F.inv B)) (F.mul C P) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul A (F.inv B)) C) P := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: taylorComparisonRemainder_algebra
statement:
theorem taylorComparisonRemainder_algebra
    {A B C P R : Point}
    (hB : Not (B = RealTheory.zero))
    (h :
      RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul C P)) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg R) B) :
    R =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv B)) C)
        P
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change Not (B = F.zero) at hB
  change
    F.mul A (F.neg (F.mul C P)) =
      F.mul (F.neg R) B at h
  have hprod : F.mul A (F.mul C P) = F.mul R B := by
    have hneg :
        F.neg (F.mul A (F.mul C P)) =
          F.neg (F.mul R B) := by
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F A (F.mul C P),
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F R B] at h
    calc
      F.mul A (F.mul C P) =
          F.neg (F.neg (F.mul A (F.mul C P))) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F]
      _ = F.neg (F.neg (F.mul R B)) := by
            rw [hneg]
      _ = F.mul R B := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F]
  exact taylorComparisonRemainder_algebra_of_product
    (A := A) (B := B) (C := C) (P := P) (R := R) hB hprod

name: taylorComparisonRemainder_left_algebra
statement:
theorem taylorComparisonRemainder_left_algebra
    {A B C P R : Point}
    (hB : Not (B = RealTheory.zero))
    (h :
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.neg A)
          (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul C P)) =
        RealTheory.mul R B) :
    R =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv B)) C)
        P
proof:
:= by
  have hprod :
      RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.mul C P) =
        RealTheory.mul R B := by
    rwa [RealTheory.neg_mul_neg A (RealTheory.mul C P)] at h
  exact taylorComparisonRemainder_algebra_of_product
    (A := A) (B := B) (C := C) (P := P) (R := R) hB hprod

name: taylorComparisonRhs_lagrange_algebra
statement:
theorem taylorComparisonRhs_lagrange_algebra
    {a c q r : Point}
    (ha : Not (a = RealTheory.zero))
    (hr : Not (r = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.neg q)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul a r))))
          (RealTheory.mul c a))
        r =
      RealTheory.mul c q
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.neg q)
            (F.inv (F.neg (F.mul a r))))
          (F.mul c a))
        r =
      F.mul c q
  have har : Not (F.mul a r = F.zero) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F ha hr
  have hinv_neg :
      F.inv (F.neg (F.mul a r)) =
        F.neg (F.inv (F.mul a r)) := by
    change RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul a r)) =
      RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul a r))
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_neg_of_ne_zero F har
  have hinv_mul :
      F.inv (F.mul a r) = F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv r) := by
    change RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul a r) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv a) (RealTheory.inv r)
    exact RealTheory.inv_mul ha hr
  have hinner :
      F.mul (F.inv a) (F.mul c a) = c := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.inv a) (F.mul c a) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.inv a) c) a := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul c (F.inv a)) a := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv a) c]
      _ = F.mul c (F.mul (F.inv a) a) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul c F.one := by
            rw [F.inv_mul_cancel ha]
      _ = c := by
            rw [F.mul_one]
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.neg q)
            (F.inv (F.neg (F.mul a r))))
          (F.mul c a))
        r =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.mul
              (F.neg q)
              (F.neg (F.inv (F.mul a r))))
            (F.mul c a))
          r := by
          rw [hinv_neg]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.mul q (F.inv (F.mul a r)))
            (F.mul c a))
          r := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F q
            (F.inv (F.mul a r))]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.mul q (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv r)))
            (F.mul c a))
          r := by
          rw [hinv_mul]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (F.mul q (F.inv a)) (F.inv r))
            (F.mul c a))
          r := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc q (F.inv a) (F.inv r)]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (F.mul q (F.inv a)) (F.mul c a))
            (F.inv r))
          r := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc (F.mul q (F.inv a))
            (F.inv r) (F.mul c a)]
          rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv r) (F.mul c a)]
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc (F.mul q (F.inv a))
            (F.mul c a) (F.inv r)]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.mul q (F.inv a)) (F.mul c a) := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right F
            (F.mul (F.mul q (F.inv a)) (F.mul c a)) hr
    _ = F.mul q (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.mul c a)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul q c := by
          rw [hinner]
    _ = F.mul c q := by
          rw [F.mul_comm q c]

name: taylorComparisonRhs_lagrange_of_center_ne
statement:
theorem taylorComparisonRhs_lagrange_of_center_ne
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 x xi : Point) (n : Nat)
    (hxi : Not (x = xi)) :
    TaylorComparisonRemainderRhs D x n
        (TaylorLagrangeComparison x n)
        (TaylorLagrangeComparisonDerivative x n)
        xi x0 =
      TaylorLagrangeRemainderRhs D x0 x n xi
proof:
:= by
  let a := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  let c := TaylorCoeff D xi (n + 1)
  let q := RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x x0) (n + 1)
  let r := RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x xi) n
  have hbase : Not (RealTheory.sub x xi = RealTheory.zero) :=
    centerSub_ne_zero_of_ne hxi
  have ha : Not (a = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold a
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  have hr : Not (r = RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold r
    exact RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hbase n
  unfold TaylorComparisonRemainderRhs TaylorLagrangeRemainderRhs
  unfold TaylorLagrangeComparison TaylorLagrangeComparisonDerivative
  unfold CenterSubPowerDerivative
  unfold CenterSubPower CenterSubMap
  unfold TaylorNextDerivativeFactor
  rw [pow_centerSub_self_succ x n]
  rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg RealTheory.zero
    (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x x0) (n + 1))]
  rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  rw [<- taylorCoeff_succ_mul_nat_succ D xi n]
  exact taylorComparisonRhs_lagrange_algebra
    (a := RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
    (c := TaylorCoeff D xi (n + 1))
    (q := RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x x0) (n + 1))
    (r := RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x xi) n)
    ha hr

name: taylorComparisonRhs_cauchy_algebra
statement:
theorem taylorComparisonRhs_cauchy_algebra
    {c p q : Point} :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.neg q)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one)))
          c)
        p =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul c p) q
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.neg q)
            (F.inv (F.neg F.one)))
          c)
        p =
      F.mul (F.mul c p) q
  have hinv_neg_one :
      F.inv (F.neg F.one) = F.neg F.one := by
    change RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) =
      RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one
    calc
      RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) =
          RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_neg_of_ne_zero F RealTheory.one_ne_zero
      _ = RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one :=
        congrArg RealTheory.neg (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F)
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.neg q)
            (F.inv (F.neg F.one)))
          c)
        p =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.mul
              (F.neg q)
              (F.neg F.one))
            c)
          p := by
          rw [hinv_neg_one]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.mul q F.one)
            c)
          p := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F q F.one]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul q c) p := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = F.mul q (F.mul c p) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul c p) q := by
          rw [F.mul_comm q (F.mul c p)]

name: taylorTransportRemainder_neg_increment_eq_comparison
statement:
private theorem taylorTransportRemainder_neg_increment_eq_comparison
    {D : Nat -> Map} {f phi phi' : Map}
    {a b x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hRcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n))
    (hRderiv : HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n)
      (TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n))
    (hphi_cont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) phi)
    (hphi_deriv : HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) phi phi')
    (hphi_ne : forall xi : Point, RealTheory.OpenInterval a b xi ->
      Not (phi' xi = RealTheory.zero)) :
    Exists (fun xi : Point => RealTheory.OpenInterval a b xi /\
      RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.sub
        (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n b)
        (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n a)) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub (phi b) (phi a)) (RealTheory.inv (phi' xi)))
        (TaylorNextDerivativeFactor D n xi))
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x xi) n))
proof:
:= by
  have hEq := cauchyDerivativeEquality_of_cauchyConclusion
    (cauchy_mean_value_theorem a b (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n) phi
      hab hRcont hphi_cont
      (differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn_open hRderiv)
      (differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn_open hphi_deriv))
    hRderiv hphi_deriv
  cases hEq with
  | intro xi hxi =>
      refine Exists.intro xi (And.intro hxi.left ?_)
      apply taylorComparisonRemainder_algebra
        (A := RealTheory.sub (phi b) (phi a)) (B := phi' xi)
        (C := TaylorNextDerivativeFactor D n xi)
        (P := RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x xi) n)
        (R := RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.sub
          (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n b)
          (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n a)))
        (hphi_ne xi hxi.left)
      rw [RealTheory.neg_neg]
      unfold TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative RealFunction.NegFun at hxi
      unfold TaylorNextDerivativeFactor
      exact hxi.right

name: taylor_remainder_comparison_right_from_cauchyInputs
statement:
theorem taylor_remainder_comparison_right_from_cauchyInputs
    {D : Nat -> Map} {f phi phi' : Map}
    {x0 x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hx0x : RealTheory.lt x0 x)
    (hD0 :
      RealFunction.SameOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval x0 x) (D 0) f)
    (hRcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval x0 x)
        (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n))
    (hRderiv :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval x0 x)
        (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n)
        (TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n))
    (hphi_cont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval x0 x) phi)
    (hphi_deriv :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval x0 x) phi phi')
    (hphi_ne :
      forall xi : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval x0 x xi ->
          Not (phi' xi = RealTheory.zero)) :
    Exists
      (fun xi : Point =>
        RealTheory.OpenInterval x0 x xi /\
          TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x =
            TaylorComparisonRemainderRhs D x n phi phi' xi x0)
proof:
:= by
  have hx0x_le := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx0x
  have hbase := taylorTransportRemainder_at_base D f x0 n x
  have hend := taylorTransportRemainder_at_endpoint
    (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval x0 x) (D := D) (f := f)
    (x := x) (n := n) (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hx0x_le) hD0
  cases taylorTransportRemainder_neg_increment_eq_comparison
      (D := D) (f := f) (phi := phi) (phi' := phi')
      (a := x0) (b := x) (x := x) (n := n)
      hx0x hRcont hRderiv hphi_cont hphi_deriv hphi_ne with
  | intro xi hxi =>
      refine Exists.intro xi (And.intro hxi.left ?_)
      have h := hxi.right
      rw [hend, hbase] at h
      rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg RealTheory.zero
        (TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x)] at h
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add, RealTheory.neg_neg] at h
      exact h

name: taylor_remainder_comparison_left_from_cauchyInputs
statement:
theorem taylor_remainder_comparison_left_from_cauchyInputs
    {D : Nat -> Map} {f phi phi' : Map}
    {x0 x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hxx0 : RealTheory.lt x x0)
    (hD0 :
      RealFunction.SameOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval x x0) (D 0) f)
    (hRcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval x x0)
        (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n))
    (hRderiv :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval x x0)
        (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n)
        (TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n))
    (hphi_cont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval x x0) phi)
    (hphi_deriv :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval x x0) phi phi')
    (hphi_ne :
      forall xi : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval x x0 xi ->
          Not (phi' xi = RealTheory.zero)) :
    Exists
      (fun xi : Point =>
        RealTheory.OpenInterval x x0 xi /\
          TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x =
            TaylorComparisonRemainderRhs D x n phi phi' xi x0)
proof:
:= by
  have hxx0_le := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hxx0
  have hbase := taylorTransportRemainder_at_base D f x0 n x
  have hend := taylorTransportRemainder_at_endpoint
    (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval x x0) (D := D) (f := f)
    (x := x) (n := n) (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hxx0_le) hD0
  cases taylorTransportRemainder_neg_increment_eq_comparison
      (D := D) (f := f) (phi := phi) (phi' := phi')
      (a := x) (b := x0) (x := x) (n := n)
      hxx0 hRcont hRderiv hphi_cont hphi_deriv hphi_ne with
  | intro xi hxi =>
      refine Exists.intro xi (And.intro hxi.left ?_)
      have hphi_rev : RealTheory.sub (phi x0) (phi x) =
          RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.sub (phi x) (phi x0)) := by
        change RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub (phi x0) (phi x) =
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.neg
            (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub (phi x) (phi x0))
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (phi x) (phi x0)
      have h := congrArg RealTheory.neg hxi.right
      rw [hbase, hend] at h
      rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg
        (TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x) RealTheory.zero] at h
      rw [RealTheory.neg_zero, RealTheory.add_zero, RealTheory.neg_neg] at h
      rw [hphi_rev, RealTheory.neg_mul, RealTheory.neg_mul,
        RealTheory.neg_mul, RealTheory.neg_neg] at h
      exact h

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_zero
statement:
theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_zero
    (c : Nat -> Point) (h : Point) :
    RawTaylorPolynomial c 0 h = c 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold RawTaylorPolynomial
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_one]

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_at_zero
statement:
theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_at_zero
    (c : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat, RawTaylorPolynomial c n RealTheory.zero = c 0
  | 0 => by
      exact rawTaylorPolynomial_zero c RealTheory.zero
  | n + 1 => by
      unfold RawTaylorPolynomial
      change
        RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul (c k)
                (RealFunction.powNat RealTheory.zero k))
            ((n + 1) + 1) =
          c 0
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_append_zero
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (c k)
            (RealFunction.powNat RealTheory.zero k))
        (h := by
          change
            RealTheory.mul (c (n + 1))
              (RealFunction.powNat RealTheory.zero (n + 1)) =
            RealTheory.zero
          rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero_succ]
          rw [RealTheory.mul_zero])]
      exact rawTaylorPolynomial_at_zero c n

theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_rawTaylorPolynomial
    (E : Domain) (c : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (RawTaylorPolynomial c n)
      (fun h : Point =>
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            ConstMulFun (c k) (PowerDerivative k) h)
          (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold RawTaylorPolynomial
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum
    (E := E)
    (term := fun k : Nat =>
      ConstMulFun (c k) (RealFunction.PowerFun k))
    (term' := fun k : Nat =>
      ConstMulFun (c k) (PowerDerivative k))
    (n + 1)
    (fun k _hk =>
      hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul
        (hasDerivativeWithinOn_powerFun E k))

name: rawTaylorRatio_mul_power_eq_polynomial
statement:
theorem rawTaylorRatio_mul_power_eq_polynomial
    {c : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat} {h : Point}
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RawTaylorRatio c n h)
        (RealFunction.powNat h n) =
      RawTaylorPolynomial c n h
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpow : Not (RealFunction.powNat h n = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hh n
  unfold RawTaylorRatio
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (RawTaylorPolynomial c n h)
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n)))
        (RealFunction.powNat h n) =
      RawTaylorPolynomial c n h
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (RawTaylorPolynomial c n h)
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n)))
        (RealFunction.powNat h n) =
        F.mul
          (RawTaylorPolynomial c n h)
          (F.mul
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n))
            (RealFunction.powNat h n)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (RawTaylorPolynomial c n h) F.one := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hpow]
    _ = RawTaylorPolynomial c n h := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_constant_zero_of_peanoZero
statement:
theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_constant_zero_of_peanoZero
    {H : Domain} {c : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (h0 : H RealTheory.zero)
    (hcluster : RealFunction.ClusterPoint H RealTheory.zero)
    (hlim :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (RawTaylorRatio c n)
        RealTheory.zero
        RealTheory.zero) :
    c 0 = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hpow :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (RealFunction.PowerFun n)
        RealTheory.zero
        (RealFunction.PowerFun n RealTheory.zero) :=
    (RealFunction.continuousAtOn_powerFun h0 n).right
  have hprod :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (fun h : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RawTaylorRatio c n h)
            (RealFunction.PowerFun n h))
        RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
          (RealFunction.PowerFun n RealTheory.zero)) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hlim hpow
  have hprodZero :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (fun h : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RawTaylorRatio c n h)
            (RealFunction.PowerFun n h))
        RealTheory.zero
        RealTheory.zero := by
    refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit ?_ hprod
    rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  have hpolyZero :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (RawTaylorPolynomial c n)
        RealTheory.zero
        RealTheory.zero := by
    refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
      (f := fun h : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RawTaylorRatio c n h)
          (RealFunction.PowerFun n h))
      (g := RawTaylorPolynomial c n)
      ?_ hprodZero
    intro h _hh hhne
    unfold RealFunction.PowerFun
    exact rawTaylorRatio_mul_power_eq_polynomial
      (c := c) (n := n) (h := h) hhne
  have hpolyDeriv :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn H
        (RawTaylorPolynomial c n)
        (fun h : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              ConstMulFun (c k) (PowerDerivative k) h)
            (n + 1)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_rawTaylorPolynomial H c n
  have hpolyCont :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (RawTaylorPolynomial c n)
        RealTheory.zero
        (RawTaylorPolynomial c n RealTheory.zero) :=
    (hasDerivWithin_continuousAtOn
      (hpolyDeriv RealTheory.zero h0)).right
  have hvalueEq :
      RealTheory.zero = RawTaylorPolynomial c n RealTheory.zero :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_unique hcluster hpolyZero hpolyCont
  rw [rawTaylorPolynomial_at_zero c n] at hvalueEq
  exact hvalueEq.symm

name: rawTaylorShiftTerm_factor
statement:
theorem rawTaylorShiftTerm_factor
    (c : Nat -> Point) (h : Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (c (k + 1)) (RealFunction.powNat h (k + 1)) =
      RealTheory.mul h
        (RealTheory.mul (c (k + 1)) (RealFunction.powNat h k))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
  change
    F.mul (c (k + 1)) (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat h k) h) =
      F.mul h (F.mul (c (k + 1)) (RealFunction.powNat h k))
  calc
    F.mul (c (k + 1)) (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat h k) h) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (c (k + 1)) (RealFunction.powNat h k))
          h := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul h
          (F.mul (c (k + 1)) (RealFunction.powNat h k)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm]

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_split_constant_tail
statement:
theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_split_constant_tail
    (c : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (h : Point) :
    RawTaylorPolynomial c (n + 1) h =
      RealTheory.add (c 0)
        (RealTheory.mul h
          (RawTaylorPolynomial (fun k : Nat => c (k + 1)) n h))
proof:
:= by
  unfold RawTaylorPolynomial
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (c k) (RealFunction.powNat h k))
        ((n + 1) + 1) =
      RealTheory.add (c 0)
        (RealTheory.mul h
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul (c (k + 1))
                (RealFunction.powNat h k))
            (n + 1)))
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first
    (fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul (c k) (RealFunction.powNat h k))
    (n + 1)]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  congr 1
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left h
    (fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul (c (k + 1)) (RealFunction.powNat h k))
    (n + 1)]
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
  intro k _hk
  exact rawTaylorShiftTerm_factor c h k

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_sub
statement:
theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_sub
    (c d : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (h : Point) :
    RawTaylorPolynomial
        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.sub (c k) (d k)) n h =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RawTaylorPolynomial c n h)
        (RawTaylorPolynomial d n h)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RawTaylorPolynomial
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_sub
    (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (c k) (RealFunction.powNat h k))
    (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (d k) (RealFunction.powNat h k))
    (n + 1)]
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
  intro k _hk
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (c k) (d k)) (RealFunction.powNat h k) =
      F.sub
        (F.mul (c k) (RealFunction.powNat h k))
        (F.mul (d k) (RealFunction.powNat h k))
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
    F (c k) (d k) (RealFunction.powNat h k)

name: sub_sub_same_left_eq_sub_right
statement:
theorem sub_sub_same_left_eq_sub_right
    (x y z : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub x y) (RealTheory.sub x z) =
      RealTheory.sub z y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.sub (F.sub x y) (F.sub x z) = F.sub z y
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.sub x y) (F.sub x z)]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg x y]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg x z]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F x (F.neg z)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F z]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg z y]
  calc
    F.add (F.add x (F.neg y)) (F.add (F.neg x) z) =
        F.add x (F.add (F.neg y) (F.add (F.neg x) z)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ =
        F.add x (F.add (F.neg x) (F.add (F.neg y) z)) := by
          congr 1
          calc
            F.add (F.neg y) (F.add (F.neg x) z) =
                F.add (F.add (F.neg y) (F.neg x)) z := by
                  rw [<- F.add_assoc]
            _ =
                F.add (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y)) z := by
                  rw [F.add_comm (F.neg y) (F.neg x)]
            _ =
                F.add (F.neg x) (F.add (F.neg y) z) := by
                  rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ =
        F.add (F.add x (F.neg x)) (F.add (F.neg y) z) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ =
        F.add F.zero (F.add (F.neg y) z) := by
          rw [F.add_neg]
    _ =
        F.add (F.neg y) z := by
          rw [F.zero_add]
    _ =
        F.add z (F.neg y) := by
          rw [F.add_comm]

name: mul_inv_powNat_succ_left_cancel
statement:
theorem mul_inv_powNat_succ_left_cancel
    {h : Point} (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul h
      (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h (n + 1))) =
    RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [RealFunction.inv_powNat_succ_of_ne_zero hh n]
  change
    F.mul h
        (F.mul
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n))
          (F.inv h)) =
      F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n)
  calc
    F.mul h
        (F.mul
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n))
          (F.inv h)) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n))
            (F.inv h))
          h := by
          rw [F.mul_comm]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n))
          (F.mul (F.inv h) h) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n)) F.one := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hh]
    _ = F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n) := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: rawTaylorRatio_succ_tail_of_constant_zero
statement:
theorem rawTaylorRatio_succ_tail_of_constant_zero
    {c : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat} {h : Point}
    (hc0 : c 0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RawTaylorRatio c (n + 1) h =
      RawTaylorRatio (fun k : Nat => c (k + 1)) n h
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RawTaylorRatio
  rw [rawTaylorPolynomial_split_constant_tail c n h]
  rw [hc0]
  rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul h
          (RawTaylorPolynomial (fun k : Nat => c (k + 1)) n h))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h (n + 1))) =
      F.mul
        (RawTaylorPolynomial (fun k : Nat => c (k + 1)) n h)
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n))
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul h
          (RawTaylorPolynomial (fun k : Nat => c (k + 1)) n h))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h (n + 1))) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (RawTaylorPolynomial (fun k : Nat => c (k + 1)) n h)
            h)
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h (n + 1))) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm h
            (RawTaylorPolynomial (fun k : Nat => c (k + 1)) n h)]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (RawTaylorPolynomial (fun k : Nat => c (k + 1)) n h)
          (F.mul h
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h (n + 1)))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (RawTaylorPolynomial (fun k : Nat => c (k + 1)) n h)
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n)) := by
          congr 1
          exact mul_inv_powNat_succ_left_cancel hh n

name: coefficientTaylorPolynomial_of_taylorRows

name: mul_inv_factorial_right_cancel
statement:
private theorem mul_inv_factorial_right_cancel
    {x y : Point} (k : Nat)
    (h :
      RealTheory.mul x
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k))) =
        RealTheory.mul y
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k)))) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hfact :
      Not (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k) = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F hfact)
    h

name: coefficientTaylorRemainderRatio_zero
