    (f : Map) (x0 : Point) (a : Nat -> Point) (h : Point) :

proof:

      RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one := by

          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one =
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one

      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base

name: incrementDomain_clusterPoint_of_clusterPoint
statement:
private theorem incrementDomain_clusterPoint_of_clusterPoint

proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hcluster eps heps with
  | intro x hx =>
      let h := RealTheory.sub x x0
      refine Exists.intro h ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · unfold h IncrementDomain
        rw [add_sub_center x0 x]
        exact hx.left
      · refine And.intro ?_ ?_

name: coefficientPeanoExpansionAt_zero_unique
statement:
theorem coefficientPeanoExpansionAt_zero_unique
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point} {a : Nat -> Point}
    (hcluster :
      RealFunction.ClusterPoint (IncrementDomain E x0) RealTheory.zero)
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn E f x0)
    (hP : CoefficientPeanoExpansionAt E f x0 a 0) :
    a 0 = f x0
proof:
:= by
  have hPzero :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        (fun h : Point =>
          RealTheory.sub (f (RealTheory.add x0 h)) (a 0))
        RealTheory.zero
        RealTheory.zero := by
    refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
      (f := CoefficientTaylorRemainderRatio f x0 a 0)
      (g := fun h : Point =>
        RealTheory.sub (f (RealTheory.add x0 h)) (a 0))
      ?_ hP.right
    intro h _hh _hhne
    exact coefficientTaylorRemainderRatio_zero f x0 a h
  have hpull :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        (fun h : Point => f (RealTheory.add x0 h))
        RealTheory.zero
        (f x0) :=
    tendstoWithin_incrementDomain hf.right
  have hconst :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        (fun _ : Point => a 0)
        RealTheory.zero
        (a 0) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
      (IncrementDomain E x0) (a 0) RealTheory.zero
  have hsub :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        (RealFunction.SubFun
          (fun h : Point => f (RealTheory.add x0 h))
          (fun _ : Point => a 0))
        RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub (f x0) (a 0)) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_sub hpull hconst
  have hsub' :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        (fun h : Point =>
          RealTheory.sub (f (RealTheory.add x0 h)) (a 0))
        RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub (f x0) (a 0)) :=
    hsub
  have hlimEq :
      RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.sub (f x0) (a 0) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_unique hcluster hPzero hsub'
  have hfxa : f x0 = a 0 := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hlimEq.symm
  exact hfxa.symm

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_coeff_eq_zero_of_peanoZero
statement:
private theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_coeff_eq_zero_of_peanoZero
    {H : Domain}
    (h0 : H RealTheory.zero)
    (hcluster : RealFunction.ClusterPoint H RealTheory.zero) :
    forall {c : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat},
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (RawTaylorRatio c n)
        RealTheory.zero
        RealTheory.zero ->
      forall k : Nat, k <= n -> c k = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro c n
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero =>
      intro hlim k hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk
      rw [hk0]
      exact rawTaylorPolynomial_constant_zero_of_peanoZero
        h0
        hcluster
        hlim
  | succ n ih =>
      intro hlim k hk
      have hc0 : c 0 = RealTheory.zero :=
        rawTaylorPolynomial_constant_zero_of_peanoZero
          h0 hcluster hlim
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          exact hc0
      | succ k =>
          have hk' : k <= n := Nat.succ_le_succ_iff.mp hk
          have htail :
              RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
                (RawTaylorRatio (fun j : Nat => c (j + 1)) n)
                RealTheory.zero
                RealTheory.zero := by
            refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
              (f := RawTaylorRatio c (n + 1))
              (g := RawTaylorRatio (fun j : Nat => c (j + 1)) n)
              ?_ hlim
            intro h _hh hhne
            exact rawTaylorRatio_succ_tail_of_constant_zero hc0 hhne
          exact ih
            (c := fun j : Nat => c (j + 1))
            htail k hk'

name: coefficientTaylorPolynomial_coeff_eq_zero_of_peanoZero
statement:
private theorem coefficientTaylorPolynomial_coeff_eq_zero_of_peanoZero
    {H : Domain} {a : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (h0 : H RealTheory.zero)
    (hcluster : RealFunction.ClusterPoint H RealTheory.zero)
    (hlim :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (fun h : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (CoefficientTaylorPolynomial a n h)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n)))
        RealTheory.zero
        RealTheory.zero) :
    forall k : Nat, k <= n -> a k = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hraw :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (RawTaylorRatio (TaylorRawCoeffSequence a) n)
        RealTheory.zero
        RealTheory.zero := by
    refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
      (f := fun h : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (CoefficientTaylorPolynomial a n h)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n)))
      (g := RawTaylorRatio (TaylorRawCoeffSequence a) n)
      ?_ hlim
    intro h _hh _hhne
    unfold RawTaylorRatio
    change
      RealTheory.mul
          (CoefficientTaylorPolynomial a n h)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n)) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RawTaylorPolynomial (TaylorRawCoeffSequence a) n h)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n))
    rw [coefficientTaylorPolynomial_eq_raw a n h]
  intro k hk
  exact coefficient_eq_zero_of_taylorRawCoeffSequence_zero
    (rawTaylorPolynomial_coeff_eq_zero_of_peanoZero
      h0 hcluster hraw k hk)

name: coefficientTaylorRemainderRatio_sub_eq_rawTaylorRatio_sub
statement:
theorem coefficientTaylorRemainderRatio_sub_eq_rawTaylorRatio_sub
    (f : Map) (x0 : Point) (a b : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (h : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (CoefficientTaylorRemainderRatio f x0 b n h)
        (CoefficientTaylorRemainderRatio f x0 a n h) =
      RawTaylorRatio
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (TaylorRawCoeffSequence a k)
            (TaylorRawCoeffSequence b k))
        n h
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold CoefficientTaylorRemainderRatio CoefficientTaylorRemainder
  unfold RawTaylorRatio
  rw [coefficientTaylorPolynomial_eq_raw a n h]
  rw [coefficientTaylorPolynomial_eq_raw b n h]
  rw [rawTaylorPolynomial_sub
    (TaylorRawCoeffSequence a) (TaylorRawCoeffSequence b) n h]
  change
    F.sub
        (F.mul
          (F.sub (IncrementLift x0 f h)
            (RawTaylorPolynomial (TaylorRawCoeffSequence b) n h))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n)))
        (F.mul
          (F.sub (IncrementLift x0 f h)
            (RawTaylorPolynomial (TaylorRawCoeffSequence a) n h))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n))) =
      F.mul
        (F.sub
          (RawTaylorPolynomial (TaylorRawCoeffSequence a) n h)
          (RawTaylorPolynomial (TaylorRawCoeffSequence b) n h))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n))
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
    F
    (F.sub (IncrementLift x0 f h)
      (RawTaylorPolynomial (TaylorRawCoeffSequence b) n h))
    (F.sub (IncrementLift x0 f h)
      (RawTaylorPolynomial (TaylorRawCoeffSequence a) n h))
    (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n))]
  congr 1
  exact sub_sub_same_left_eq_sub_right
    (IncrementLift x0 f h)
    (RawTaylorPolynomial (TaylorRawCoeffSequence b) n h)
    (RawTaylorPolynomial (TaylorRawCoeffSequence a) n h)

name: derivativeRows_unique_of_coefficientPeanoExpansion
statement:
theorem derivativeRows_unique_of_coefficientPeanoExpansion
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point}
    {a : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hT : TaylorPeanoAt E f D x0 n)
    (hP : CoefficientPeanoExpansionAt E f x0 a n)
    (hcluster : RealFunction.ClusterPoint E x0) :
    forall k : Nat, k <= n -> a k = D k x0
proof:
:= by
  let b : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat => D k x0
  have hB : CoefficientPeanoExpansionAt E f x0 b n :=
    coefficientPeanoExpansionAt_of_taylorPeanoAt hT
  have hsub :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        (RealFunction.SubFun
          (CoefficientTaylorRemainderRatio f x0 b n)
          (CoefficientTaylorRemainderRatio f x0 a n))
        RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_sub hB.right hP.right
  have hsubZero :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        (RealFunction.SubFun
          (CoefficientTaylorRemainderRatio f x0 b n)
          (CoefficientTaylorRemainderRatio f x0 a n))
        RealTheory.zero
        RealTheory.zero := by
    refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit ?_ hsub
    change
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.zero
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.zero =
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.zero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.zero
  have hraw :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        (RawTaylorRatio
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub
              (TaylorRawCoeffSequence a k)
              (TaylorRawCoeffSequence b k))
          n)
        RealTheory.zero
        RealTheory.zero := by
    refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
      (f := RealFunction.SubFun
        (CoefficientTaylorRemainderRatio f x0 b n)
        (CoefficientTaylorRemainderRatio f x0 a n))
      (g := RawTaylorRatio
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (TaylorRawCoeffSequence a k)
            (TaylorRawCoeffSequence b k))
        n)
      ?_ hsubZero
    intro h _hh _hhne
    unfold RealFunction.SubFun
    exact coefficientTaylorRemainderRatio_sub_eq_rawTaylorRatio_sub
      f x0 a b n h
  have hzero :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        RealTheory.sub
          (TaylorRawCoeffSequence a k)
          (TaylorRawCoeffSequence b k) =
        RealTheory.zero :=
    rawTaylorPolynomial_coeff_eq_zero_of_peanoZero
      (by
        unfold IncrementDomain
        rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
        exact hT.left.left)
      (incrementDomain_clusterPoint_of_clusterPoint hcluster)
      hraw
  intro k hk
  have hrawEq :
      TaylorRawCoeffSequence a k = TaylorRawCoeffSequence b k :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (hzero k hk)
  exact coefficient_eq_of_taylorRawCoeffSequence_eq hrawEq

name: factorialInv_nonneg
statement:
theorem factorialInv_nonneg (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial n)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
      (RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)))

name: abs_taylorCoeff_le_of_abs_derivative_le
statement:
theorem abs_taylorCoeff_le_of_abs_derivative_le
    {D : Nat -> Map} {x M : Point} {k : Nat}
    (hbound : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (D k x)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (TaylorCoeff D x k))
      (RealTheory.mul M
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold TaylorCoeff
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.mul (D k x)
          (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k)))))
      (F.mul M
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k))))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F (D k x)
    (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k)))]
  have hinv_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k))) :=
    factorialInv_nonneg k
  have habs_inv :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
          (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k))) =
        F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k)) := by
    change
      RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k))) =
        RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k))
    exact RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hinv_nonneg
  rw [habs_inv]
  exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hbound hinv_nonneg

name: abs_taylorLagrangeRemainderRhs_le
statement:
theorem abs_taylorLagrangeRemainderRhs_le
    {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 x xi M : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hbound :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (D (n + 1) xi)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (TaylorLagrangeRemainderRhs D x0 x n xi))
      (TaylorRemainderAbsBoundRhs M x0 x n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold TaylorLagrangeRemainderRhs TaylorRemainderAbsBoundRhs
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.mul (TaylorCoeff D xi (n + 1))
          (RealFunction.powNat (F.sub x x0) (n + 1))))
      (F.mul
        (F.mul M
          (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial (n + 1)))))
        (RealFunction.powNat
          (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x x0)) (n + 1)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F (TaylorCoeff D xi (n + 1))
    (RealFunction.powNat (F.sub x x0) (n + 1))]
  have habs_pow :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
          (RealFunction.powNat (F.sub x x0) (n + 1)) =
        RealFunction.powNat
          (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x x0)) (n + 1) := by
    change
      RealTheory.abs
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x x0) (n + 1)) =
        RealFunction.powNat
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub x x0)) (n + 1)
    exact RealFunction.abs_powNat (RealTheory.sub x x0) (n + 1)
  rw [habs_pow]
  have hcoeff :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (TaylorCoeff D xi (n + 1)))
        (RealTheory.mul M
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial (n + 1))))) :=
    abs_taylorCoeff_le_of_abs_derivative_le hbound
  have hpow_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealFunction.powNat
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub x x0)) (n + 1)) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_nonneg
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (RealTheory.sub x x0)) (n + 1)
  exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hcoeff hpow_nonneg

name: taylor_lagrange_remainder_abs_bound_right
statement:
theorem taylor_lagrange_remainder_abs_bound_right
    {D : Nat -> Map} {f : Map}

name: taylor_lagrange_remainder_abs_bound_left

theorem taylor_lagrange_remainder_abs_bound_left

name: taylorNextDerivativeAbsBoundOnOpenInterval_of_isLeastUpperBound
statement:
theorem taylorNextDerivativeAbsBoundOnOpenInterval_of_isLeastUpperBound
    {D : Nat -> Map} {n : Nat} {a b M : Point}
    (hsup :
      IsLeastUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
        (TaylorNextDerivativeAbsValueSet D n a b) M) :
    TaylorNextDerivativeAbsBoundOnOpenInterval D n a b M
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  exact hsup.left
    (RealTheory.abs (D (n + 1) t))
    (Exists.intro t (And.intro ht rfl))

name: taylor_lagrange_remainder_abs_sup_bound_right

theorem taylor_lagrange_remainder_abs_sup_bound_right

theorem taylor_lagrange_remainder_abs_sup_bound_left

name: TaylorCoeff_zero_basic
statement:
theorem TaylorCoeff_zero_basic
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) :
    TaylorCoeff D x0 0 = D 0 x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold TaylorCoeff
  rw [Nat.factorial_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
  change F.mul (D 0 x0) (F.inv F.one) = D 0 x0
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F]
  rw [F.mul_one]

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTerm_raw
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTerm_raw
    (E : Domain) (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) (k : Nat) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (TaylorTerm D x0 k)
      (TaylorRawDerivativeTerm D x0 k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorTerm TaylorRawDerivativeTerm
  change HasDerivativeWithinOn E
    (ConstMulFun (TaylorCoeff D x0 k) (RealFunction.PowerFun k))
    (ConstMulFun (TaylorCoeff D x0 k) (PowerDerivative k))
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_powerFun E k)

name: taylorCoeff_succ_mul_nat_succ
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_succ_mul_nat_succ
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
      (TaylorCoeff D x0 (k + 1))
      (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) =
    TaylorCoeff (DerivativeChainShift D) x0 k
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsucc :
      Not (RealTheory.nat (k + 1) = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
  have hfact :
      Not (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k) = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
  unfold TaylorCoeff DerivativeChainShift
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_mul]
  let d := D (k + 1) x0
  let a := RealTheory.nat (k + 1)
  let b := RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k)
  change
    F.mul (F.mul d (F.inv (F.mul a b))) a =
      F.mul d (F.inv b)
  have hinv : F.inv (F.mul a b) = F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv b) := by
    change
      RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul a b) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv a) (RealTheory.inv b)
    exact RealTheory.inv_mul hsucc hfact
  rw [hinv]
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul d (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv b))) a =
        F.mul d (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv b)) a) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul d (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.mul (F.inv b) a)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc (F.inv a) (F.inv b) a]
    _ =
        F.mul d (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.mul a (F.inv b))) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv b) a]
    _ =
        F.mul d (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv a) a) (F.inv b)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc (F.inv a) a (F.inv b)]
    _ =
        F.mul d (F.mul F.one (F.inv b)) := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hsucc]
    _ =
        F.mul d (F.inv b) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: taylorRawDerivativeTerm_succ_sameOn_shiftTerm
statement:
theorem taylorRawDerivativeTerm_succ_sameOn_shiftTerm
    (E : Domain) (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealFunction.SameOn E
      (TaylorRawDerivativeTerm D x0 (k + 1))
      (TaylorTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x0 k)
proof:
:= by
  intro h _hh
  unfold TaylorRawDerivativeTerm TaylorTerm PowerDerivative ConstMulFun
  unfold RealFunction.PowerFun
  change
    RealTheory.mul
      (TaylorCoeff D x0 (k + 1))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
        (RealFunction.powNat h k)) =
    RealTheory.mul
      (TaylorCoeff (DerivativeChainShift D) x0 k)
      (RealFunction.powNat h k)
  rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]
  rw [taylorCoeff_succ_mul_nat_succ]

name: TaylorRawDerivativeTerm_zero
statement:
theorem TaylorRawDerivativeTerm_zero
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 h : Point) :
    TaylorRawDerivativeTerm D x0 0 h = RealTheory.zero
proof:

name: TaylorTerm_succ_at_zero
statement:
theorem TaylorTerm_succ_at_zero
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) (k : Nat) :
    TaylorTerm D x0 (k + 1) RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorPolynomial_raw
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorPolynomial_raw
    (E : Domain) (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) (n : Nat) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (TaylorPolynomial D x0 n)
      (fun h : Point =>
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => TaylorRawDerivativeTerm D x0 k h)
          (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorPolynomial
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum
    (E := E)
    (term := fun k : Nat => TaylorTerm D x0 k)
    (term' := fun k : Nat => TaylorRawDerivativeTerm D x0 k)
    (n + 1)
    (fun k _hk => hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTerm_raw E D x0 k)

name: finiteSum_taylorRawDerivative_succ_eq_shiftPolynomial
statement:
theorem finiteSum_taylorRawDerivative_succ_eq_shiftPolynomial
    (E : Domain) (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealFunction.SameOn E
      (fun h : Point =>
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => TaylorRawDerivativeTerm D x0 k h)
          (n + 2))
      (TaylorPolynomial (DerivativeChainShift D) x0 n)
proof:
:= by
  intro h hh
  unfold TaylorPolynomial
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat => TaylorRawDerivativeTerm D x0 k h)
      ((n + 1) + 1) =
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat => TaylorTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x0 k h)
      (n + 1)
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first
    (fun k : Nat => TaylorRawDerivativeTerm D x0 k h) (n + 1)]
  rw [TaylorRawDerivativeTerm_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
  intro k _hk
  exact taylorRawDerivativeTerm_succ_sameOn_shiftTerm
    E D x0 k h hh

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorPolynomial_succ
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorPolynomial_succ
    (E : Domain) (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) (n : Nat) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (TaylorPolynomial D x0 (n + 1))
      (TaylorPolynomial (DerivativeChainShift D) x0 n)
proof:
:= by
  apply hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (finiteSum_taylorRawDerivative_succ_eq_shiftPolynomial E D x0 n)
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorPolynomial_raw E D x0 (n + 1)

name: TaylorPolynomial_zero
statement:
theorem TaylorPolynomial_zero
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 h : Point) :
    TaylorPolynomial D x0 0 h = D 0 x0
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorPolynomial
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
  unfold TaylorTerm
  unfold TaylorCoeff
  rw [Nat.factorial_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
  change
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.mul (D 0 x0) (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one))
      RealTheory.one =
    D 0 x0
  have hinv : RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.inv
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one =
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [hinv]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_one]

name: TaylorPolynomial_at_zero
statement:
theorem TaylorPolynomial_at_zero
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      TaylorPolynomial D x0 n RealTheory.zero = D 0 x0
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact TaylorPolynomial_zero D x0 RealTheory.zero
  | succ n ih =>
      unfold TaylorPolynomial
      change
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            TaylorTerm D x0 k RealTheory.zero)
          ((n + 1) + 1) =
        D 0 x0
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_append_zero
        (fun k : Nat => TaylorTerm D x0 k RealTheory.zero)
        (h := TaylorTerm_succ_at_zero D x0 n)]
      exact ih

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_incrementMap
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_incrementMap
    (E : Domain) (x0 : Point) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn
      (IncrementDomain E x0)
      (IncrementMap x0)
      (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let H := IncrementDomain E x0
  have hraw :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn H
        (IncrementMap x0)
        (RealFunction.AddFun
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)) := by
    unfold IncrementMap
    change HasDerivativeWithinOn H
      (RealFunction.AddFun
        (fun _ : Point => x0)
        (fun h : Point => h))
      (RealFunction.AddFun
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one))
    exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_add
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_const H x0)
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_id H)
  apply hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (E := H)
    (f := IncrementMap x0)
    (f' :=
      RealFunction.AddFun
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one))
    (g' := fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
  · intro h _hh
    unfold RealFunction.AddFun
    rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  · exact hraw

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_incrementLift
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_incrementLift
    {E : Domain} {f f' : Map} (x0 : Point)
    (hf : HasDerivativeWithinOn E f f') :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn
      (IncrementDomain E x0)
      (IncrementLift x0 f)
      (IncrementLift x0 f')
proof:
:= by
  let H := IncrementDomain E x0
  have hinc :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn H
        (IncrementMap x0)
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_incrementMap E x0
  have hbase : RealFunction.MapsInto H E (IncrementMap x0) := by
    intro h hh
    exact hh
  have hcomp :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn H
        (RealFunction.CompFun f (IncrementMap x0))
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (RealFunction.CompFun f' (IncrementMap x0))
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_comp hinc hf hbase
  change HasDerivativeWithinOn H
    (RealFunction.CompFun f (IncrementMap x0))
    (IncrementLift x0 f')
  apply hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (E := H)
    (f := RealFunction.CompFun f (IncrementMap x0))
    (f' :=
      RealFunction.MulFun
        (RealFunction.CompFun f' (IncrementMap x0))
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one))
    (g' := IncrementLift x0 f')
  · intro h _hh
    unfold RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.CompFun IncrementLift
    rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  · exact hcomp

name: hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_incrementLift
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_incrementLift
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {n : Nat} (x0 : Point)
    (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n) :
    HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
      (IncrementDomain E x0)
      (IncrementLift x0 f)
      (IncrementLiftSequence x0 D)
      n
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?same ?steps
  · intro h hh
    unfold IncrementLiftSequence IncrementLift
    exact hD.left (IncrementMap x0 h) hh
  · intro k hk
    unfold IncrementLiftSequence
    exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_incrementLift x0 (hD.right k hk)

name: taylorRemainder_chain
statement:
theorem taylorRemainder_chain
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point} :
    forall n : Nat,
      HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n ->
        HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
          (IncrementDomain E x0)
          (TaylorRemainder D f x0 n)
          (TaylorRemainderRows D x0 n)
          n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n generalizing f D with
  | zero =>
      intro hD
      constructor
      · intro h hh
        unfold TaylorRemainderRows TaylorRemainder
        unfold RealFunction.SubFun IncrementLift
        rw [hD.left (IncrementMap x0 h) hh]
      · intro k hk
        exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk)
  | succ n ih =>
      intro hD
      let H := IncrementDomain E x0
      have hDshift :
          HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E (D 1) (DerivativeChainShift D) n :=
        hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_shift hD
      have ihshift :
          HasDerivativeChainWithinOn H
            (TaylorRemainder (DerivativeChainShift D) (D 1) x0 n)
            (TaylorRemainderRows (DerivativeChainShift D) x0 n)
            n :=
        ih hDshift
      constructor
      · intro h hh
        unfold TaylorRemainderRows TaylorRemainder
        unfold RealFunction.SubFun IncrementLift
        rw [hD.left (IncrementMap x0 h) hh]
      · intro k hk
        cases k with
        | zero =>
            rw [Nat.zero_add]
            unfold TaylorRemainderRows
            unfold TaylorRemainderRows
            change HasDerivativeWithinOn H
              (RealFunction.SubFun
                (IncrementLift x0 (D 0))
                (TaylorPolynomial D x0 (n + 1)))
              (RealFunction.SubFun
                (IncrementLift x0 (D 1))
                (TaylorPolynomial (DerivativeChainShift D) x0 n))
            exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_sub
              (hasDerivativeWithinOn_incrementLift x0
                (hD.right 0 (Nat.succ_pos n)))
              (hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorPolynomial_succ H D x0 n)
        | succ k =>
            have hk' : k < n := Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hk
            change HasDerivativeWithinOn H
              (TaylorRemainderRows (DerivativeChainShift D) x0 n k)
              (TaylorRemainderRows (DerivativeChainShift D) x0 n (k + 1))
            exact ihshift.right k hk'

name: taylorRemainder_zeroJet_at_center
statement:
theorem taylorRemainder_zeroJet_at_center
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point} :
    forall n : Nat,
      HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n ->
        E x0 ->
          forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
            TaylorRemainderRows D x0 n k RealTheory.zero =
              RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n generalizing f D with
  | zero =>
      intro hD hx0 k hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk
      subst k
      unfold TaylorRemainderRows
      unfold RealFunction.SubFun IncrementLift IncrementMap
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
      rw [TaylorPolynomial_at_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
      rw [RealTheory.add_neg]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro hD hx0 k hk
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          unfold TaylorRemainderRows
          unfold RealFunction.SubFun IncrementLift IncrementMap
          rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
          rw [TaylorPolynomial_at_zero]
          rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
          rw [RealTheory.add_neg]
      | succ k =>
          have hDshift :
              HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E (D 1) (DerivativeChainShift D) n :=
            hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_shift hD
          have hk' : k <= n := Nat.succ_le_succ_iff.mp hk
          change TaylorRemainderRows (DerivativeChainShift D) x0 n k
              RealTheory.zero =
            RealTheory.zero
          exact ih hDshift hx0 k hk'

name: TaylorPolynomial_two
statement:
theorem TaylorPolynomial_two
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 h : Point) :
    TaylorPolynomial D x0 2 h =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add
          (D 0 x0)
          (RealTheory.mul (TaylorCoeff D x0 1) h))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (TaylorCoeff D x0 2)
          (RealFunction.powNat h 2))
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorPolynomial
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat => TaylorTerm D x0 k h) 3 =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add
          (D 0 x0)
          (RealTheory.mul (TaylorCoeff D x0 1) h))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (TaylorCoeff D x0 2)
          (RealFunction.powNat h 2))
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
  unfold TaylorTerm
  rw [TaylorCoeff_zero_basic]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_one]

name: TaylorCoeff_two_pos_of_value_pos
statement:
theorem TaylorCoeff_two_pos_of_value_pos
    {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hD2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (D 2 x0)) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (TaylorCoeff D x0 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold TaylorCoeff
  rw [Nat.factorial_two]
  change F.lt F.zero
    (F.mul (D 2 x0) (F.inv (F.nat 2)))
  have htwo : F.lt F.zero (F.nat 2) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  exact F.mul_pos hD2 (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F htwo)

name: TaylorCoeff_two_neg_of_value_neg
statement:
theorem TaylorCoeff_two_neg_of_value_neg
    {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hD2 : RealTheory.lt (D 2 x0) RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.lt (TaylorCoeff D x0 2) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold TaylorCoeff
  rw [Nat.factorial_two]
  change F.lt
    (F.mul (D 2 x0) (F.inv (F.nat 2))) F.zero
  have htwo : F.lt F.zero (F.nat 2) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have hmul :=
    F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hD2 (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F htwo)
  change F.lt
    (F.mul (D 2 x0) (F.inv (F.nat 2)))
    (F.mul F.zero (F.inv (F.nat 2))) at hmul
  rwa [F.zero_mul] at hmul

name: TaylorCoeff_pos_of_value_pos
statement:
theorem TaylorCoeff_pos_of_value_pos
    {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point} {m : Nat}
    (hDm : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (D m x0)) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (TaylorCoeff D x0 m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold TaylorCoeff
  change F.lt F.zero
    (F.mul (D m x0) (F.inv (F.nat (Nat.factorial m))))
  have hfact : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (Nat.factorial m)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)
  exact F.mul_pos hDm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hfact)

name: TaylorCoeff_neg_of_value_neg
statement:
theorem TaylorCoeff_neg_of_value_neg
    {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point} {m : Nat}
    (hDm : RealTheory.lt (D m x0) RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.lt (TaylorCoeff D x0 m) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold TaylorCoeff
  change F.lt
    (F.mul (D m x0) (F.inv (F.nat (Nat.factorial m)))) F.zero
  have hfact : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (Nat.factorial m)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)
  have hmul :=
    F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hDm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hfact)
  change F.lt
    (F.mul (D m x0) (F.inv (F.nat (Nat.factorial m))))
    (F.mul F.zero (F.inv (F.nat (Nat.factorial m)))) at hmul
  rwa [F.zero_mul] at hmul

name: TaylorPolynomial_eq_finiteSum_taylorTerm
statement:
theorem TaylorPolynomial_eq_finiteSum_taylorTerm
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x0 : Point) (n : Nat) (h : Point) :
    TaylorPolynomial D x0 n h =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat => TaylorTerm D x0 k h)
        (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TaylorRemainderRatio_zero_order
statement:
theorem TaylorRemainderRatio_zero_order
    (D : Nat -> Map) (f : Map) (x0 h : Point) :
    TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 0 h =
      TaylorRemainder D f x0 0 h
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorRemainderRatio
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
  change
    RealTheory.mul
      (TaylorRemainder D f x0 0 h)
      (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one) =
    TaylorRemainder D f x0 0 h
  have hinv : RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.inv
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one =
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [hinv]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_one]

name: TaylorRemainderRatio_denominator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem TaylorRemainderRatio_denominator_ne_zero
    {h : Point} (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) (n : Nat) :
    Not (RealFunction.powNat h n = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:=
  RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hh n

name: taylorJetRemainder_center_zero
statement:
private theorem taylorJetRemainder_center_zero
    {f : Map} {c : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hcenter : f RealTheory.zero = c 0) :
    TaylorJetRemainder f RealTheory.zero c n RealTheory.zero =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold TaylorJetRemainder
  unfold IncrementLift IncrementMap TaylorJetPolynomial
  change
    F.sub (f (F.add F.zero F.zero)) (RawTaylorPolynomial c n F.zero) =
      F.zero
  rw [F.zero_add]
  have hpoly : RawTaylorPolynomial c n F.zero = c 0 := by
    change RawTaylorPolynomial c n RealTheory.zero = c 0
    exact rawTaylorPolynomial_at_zero c n
  rw [hpoly]
  change F.sub (f RealTheory.zero) (c 0) = F.zero
  rw [hcenter]
  rw [F.sub_self]

name: taylorJetRemainderRatio_center_zero
statement:
private theorem taylorJetRemainderRatio_center_zero
    {f : Map} {c : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hcenter : f RealTheory.zero = c 0) :
    TaylorJetRemainderRatio f RealTheory.zero c n RealTheory.zero =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hrem := taylorJetRemainder_center_zero
    (f := f) (c := c) (n := n) hcenter
  unfold TaylorJetRemainderRatio
  change
    F.mul
        (TaylorJetRemainder f RealTheory.zero c n F.zero)
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat F.zero n)) =
      F.zero
  have hremF :
      TaylorJetRemainder f RealTheory.zero c n F.zero = F.zero := by
    change
      TaylorJetRemainder f RealTheory.zero c n RealTheory.zero =
        RealTheory.zero
    exact hrem
  rw [hremF]
  rw [F.zero_mul]

name: taylorJetRemainder_substitution_ratio_split
statement:
private theorem taylorJetRemainder_substitution_ratio_split
    {outerFun u : Map} {outer : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat} {t : Point}
    (hcenter : outerFun RealTheory.zero = outer 0) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (TaylorJetRemainder outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n (u t))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (TaylorJetRemainderRatio outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n (u t))
        (TaylorJetPowerRatioFactor u n t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hu : u t = RealTheory.zero
  · have hrem0 := taylorJetRemainder_center_zero
      (f := outerFun) (c := outer) (n := n) hcenter
    have hratio0 := taylorJetRemainderRatio_center_zero
      (f := outerFun) (c := outer) (n := n) hcenter
    have hremu :
        TaylorJetRemainder outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n (u t) =
          F.zero := by
      rw [hu]
      change
        TaylorJetRemainder outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n RealTheory.zero =
          RealTheory.zero
      exact hrem0
    have hratiou :
        TaylorJetRemainderRatio outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n (u t) =
          F.zero := by
      rw [hu]
      change
        TaylorJetRemainderRatio outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n
            RealTheory.zero =
          RealTheory.zero
      exact hratio0
    change
      F.mul
          (TaylorJetRemainder outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n (u t))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
        F.mul
          (TaylorJetRemainderRatio outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n (u t))
          (TaylorJetPowerRatioFactor u n t)
    rw [hremu, hratiou]
    rw [F.zero_mul, F.zero_mul]
  · have huF : Not (u t = F.zero) := by
      change Not (u t = RealTheory.zero)
      exact hu
    have hpowu : Not (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n = F.zero) :=
      RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero huF n
    unfold TaylorJetPowerRatioFactor
    unfold TaylorJetRemainderRatio
    change
      F.mul
          (TaylorJetRemainder outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n (u t))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (TaylorJetRemainder outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n (u t))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n)))
          (F.mul
            (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n)
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
    symm
    calc
      F.mul
          (F.mul
            (TaylorJetRemainder outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n (u t))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n)))
          (F.mul
            (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n)
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))) =
          F.mul
            (TaylorJetRemainder outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n (u t))
            (F.mul
              (F.mul
                (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n))
                (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n))
              (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n)
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))]
      _ =
          F.mul
            (TaylorJetRemainder outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n (u t))
            (F.mul F.one (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))) := by
            rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hpowu]
      _ =
          F.mul
            (TaylorJetRemainder outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n (u t))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) := by
            rw [F.one_mul]

name: tendstoWithin_mul_zero_of_localBoundedAtZero
statement:
private theorem tendstoWithin_mul_zero_of_localBoundedAtZero
    {H : Domain} {f g : Map}
    (hf :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H f
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)
    (hg : LocalBoundedAtZero H g) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (RealFunction.MulFun f g)
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hg with
  | intro deltaBound hdeltaBound =>
      cases hdeltaBound.right with
      | intro Bound hBound =>
          have hBoundPos : F.lt F.zero Bound := hBound.left
          have hBoundNe : Not (Bound = F.zero) := by
            intro hzero
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hBoundPos hzero.symm
          let deltaF := F.mul eps (F.inv Bound)
          have hdeltaFpos : F.lt F.zero deltaF := by
            unfold deltaF
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F heps
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hBoundPos)
          have hscaleF : F.mul deltaF Bound = eps := by
            unfold deltaF
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
              F eps hBoundNe
          cases hf deltaF hdeltaFpos with
          | intro deltaFx hdeltaFx =>
              let delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaBound deltaFx
              have hdeltaPos : F.lt F.zero delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
                  F hdeltaBound.left hdeltaFx.left
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro hdeltaPos ?_
              intro x hx hxne hxd
              have hxdBound :
                  F.lt (RealFunction.dist x F.zero) deltaBound :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                    F deltaBound deltaFx)
              have hxdF :
                  F.lt (RealFunction.dist x F.zero) deltaFx :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                    F deltaBound deltaFx)
              have hfclose := hdeltaFx.right x hx hxne hxdF
              have hgBound := hBound.right x hx hxne hxdBound
              change
                F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) F.zero))
                  deltaF at hfclose
              rw [F.sub_zero] at hfclose
              change F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (g x)) Bound
                at hgBound
              unfold RealFunction.MulFun
              change
                F.lt
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                    (F.sub (F.mul (f x) (g x)) F.zero))
                  eps
              rw [F.sub_zero]
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F (f x) (g x)]
              have hle :
                  F.le
                    (F.mul
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (f x))
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (g x)))
                    (F.mul
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (f x))
                      Bound) :=
                F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hgBound)
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F (f x))
              have hlt :
                  F.lt
                    (F.mul
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (f x))
                      Bound)
                    (F.mul deltaF Bound) :=
                F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hfclose hBoundPos
              have hprod :
                  F.lt
                    (F.mul
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (f x))
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (g x)))
                    eps := by
                have hprod' :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle hlt
                rwa [hscaleF] at hprod'
              exact hprod

name: localBoundedAtZero_mul
statement:
private theorem localBoundedAtZero_mul
    {H : Domain} {f g : Map}
    (hf : LocalBoundedAtZero H f)
    (hg : LocalBoundedAtZero H g) :
    LocalBoundedAtZero H (RealFunction.MulFun f g)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hf with
  | intro deltaF hdeltaF =>
      cases hdeltaF.right with
      | intro BoundF hBoundF =>
          cases hg with
          | intro deltaG hdeltaG =>
              cases hdeltaG.right with
              | intro BoundG hBoundG =>
                  let delta :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaF deltaG
                  let Bound := F.mul BoundF BoundG
                  have hdeltaPos : F.lt F.zero delta :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
                      F hdeltaF.left hdeltaG.left
                  have hBoundPos : F.lt F.zero Bound := by
                    unfold Bound
                    exact F.mul_pos hBoundF.left hBoundG.left
                  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                  refine And.intro hdeltaPos ?_
                  refine Exists.intro Bound ?_
                  refine And.intro hBoundPos ?_
                  intro t ht htne htdist
                  have htdistF :
                      F.lt (RealFunction.dist t F.zero) deltaF :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htdist
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                        F deltaF deltaG)
                  have htdistG :
                      F.lt (RealFunction.dist t F.zero) deltaG :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htdist
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                        F deltaF deltaG)
                  have hfBound := hBoundF.right t ht htne htdistF
                  have hgBound := hBoundG.right t ht htne htdistG
                  change F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (f t)) BoundF
                    at hfBound
                  change F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (g t)) BoundG
                    at hgBound
                  unfold RealFunction.MulFun
                  change
                    F.lt
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                        (F.mul (f t) (g t)))
                      Bound
                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F (f t) (g t)]
                  have hle :
                      F.le
                        (F.mul
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (f t))
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (g t)))
                        (F.mul
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (f t))
                          BoundG) :=
                    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hgBound)
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F (f t))
                  have hlt :
                      F.lt
                        (F.mul
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (f t))
                          BoundG)
                        Bound := by
                    unfold Bound
                    exact F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hfBound hBoundG.left
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle hlt

name: localBoundedAtZero_of_tendstoWithin
statement:
private theorem localBoundedAtZero_of_tendstoWithin
    {H : Domain} {f : Map} {L : Point}
    (hf :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H f
        RealTheory.zero L) :
    LocalBoundedAtZero H f
proof:
:= by
  exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_localBounded hf

name: localBoundedAtZero_firstOrderRatio_of_localLinearBoundAtZero
statement:
private theorem localBoundedAtZero_firstOrderRatio_of_localLinearBoundAtZero
    {H : Domain} {u : Map}
    (hlin : LocalLinearBoundAtZero H u) :
    LocalBoundedAtZero H (TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio u)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hlin with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases hdelta.right with
      | intro B hB =>
          let Bound := F.add B F.one
          have hBltBound : F.lt B Bound := by
            unfold Bound
            have h := F.add_lt_add_left
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) B
            rwa [F.add_zero] at h
          have hBoundPos : F.lt F.zero Bound :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hB.left hBltBound
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          refine Exists.intro Bound ?_
          refine And.intro hBoundPos ?_
          intro t ht htne htdist
          have hlinear := hB.right t ht htne htdist
          change
            F.le
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (u t))
              (F.mul B (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t))
            at hlinear
          have htAbsPos :
              F.lt F.zero (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_pos_of_ne_zero F htne
          have htAbsNe :
              Not (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t = F.zero) := by
            intro hzero
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F htAbsPos hzero.symm
          have hinvAbsNonneg :
              F.le F.zero (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F htAbsPos)
          have hprod :
              F.mul
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                    (TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio u t))
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t) =
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (u t) := by
            unfold TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio
            have hmul :
                F.mul (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t)) t = u t := by
              calc
                F.mul (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t)) t =
                    F.mul (u t) (F.mul (F.inv t) t) := by
                      rw [F.mul_assoc]
                _ = F.mul (u t) F.one := by
                      rw [F.inv_mul_cancel htne]
                _ = u t := by rw [F.mul_one]
            calc
              F.mul
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                    (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t)))
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t) =
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                    (F.mul (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t)) t) := by
                    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul
                      F (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t)) t]
              _ = IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (u t) := by
                    rw [hmul]
          have hmulLe :
              F.le
                (F.mul
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                    (TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio u t))
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t))
                (F.mul B (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t)) := by
            rwa [hprod]
          have hscaled :=
            F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hmulLe hinvAbsNonneg
          have hleft :
              F.mul
                  (F.mul
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                      (TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio u t))
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t))
                  (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t)) =
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                  (TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio u t) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right
              F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                (TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio u t))
              htAbsNe
          have hright :
              F.mul
                  (F.mul B (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t))
                  (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t)) =
                B :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right
              F B htAbsNe
          rw [hleft, hright] at hscaled
          change
            F.lt
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                (TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio u t))
              Bound
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hscaled hBltBound

name: taylorJetPowerRatioFactor_succ_eq_mul_firstOrderRatio
statement:
private theorem taylorJetPowerRatioFactor_succ_eq_mul_firstOrderRatio
    {u : Map} {n : Nat} {t : Point}
    (ht : Not (t = RealTheory.zero)) :
    TaylorJetPowerRatioFactor u (n + 1) t =
      RealFunction.MulFun
        (TaylorJetPowerRatioFactor u n)
        (TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio u) t
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htF : Not (t = F.zero) := by
    change Not (t = RealTheory.zero)
    exact ht
  have hpowt : Not (RealFunction.powNat t n = F.zero) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero htF n
  unfold TaylorJetPowerRatioFactor TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio
  unfold RealFunction.MulFun
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ, RealFunction.powNat_succ]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n) (u t))
        (F.inv
          (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t n) t)) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul
          (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n)
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
        (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hpowt htF]
  rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv t) (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n) (u t))
        (F.mul
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
          (F.inv t)) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul
          (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n)
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
        (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t))
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n) (u t))
        (F.mul
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
          (F.inv t)) =
        F.mul
          (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n)
          (F.mul
            (u t)
            (F.mul
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
              (F.inv t))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n)
          (F.mul
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
            (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t))) := by
          congr 1
          calc
            F.mul
                (u t)
                (F.mul
                  (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
                  (F.inv t)) =
                F.mul
                  (F.mul (u t)
                    (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
                  (F.inv t) := by
                  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
            _ =
                F.mul
                  (F.mul
                    (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
                    (u t))
                  (F.inv t) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm (u t)
                    (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))]
            _ =
                F.mul
                  (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
                  (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (RealFunction.powNat (u t) n)
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
          (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: localBoundedAtZero_powerRatio_of_localLinearBoundAtZero
statement:
private theorem localBoundedAtZero_powerRatio_of_localLinearBoundAtZero
    {H : Domain} {u : Map} (n : Nat)
    (hlin : LocalLinearBoundAtZero H u) :
    LocalBoundedAtZero H (TaylorJetPowerRatioFactor u n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      let Bound := F.add F.one F.one
      have hBoundPos : F.lt F.zero Bound := by
        have h := F.add_lt_add_left
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) F.one
        have hone_lt : F.lt F.one Bound := by
          unfold Bound
          rwa [F.add_zero] at h
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) hone_lt
      refine Exists.intro F.one ?_
      refine And.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) ?_
      refine Exists.intro Bound ?_
      refine And.intro hBoundPos ?_
      intro t _ht _htne _htdist
      unfold TaylorJetPowerRatioFactor
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero, RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      change
        F.lt
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
            (F.mul F.one (F.inv F.one)))
          Bound
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F]
      rw [F.mul_one]
      change F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F F.one) Bound
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_one F]
      unfold Bound
      have h := F.add_lt_add_left
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) F.one
      rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  | succ n ih =>
      have hfirst :=
        localBoundedAtZero_firstOrderRatio_of_localLinearBoundAtZero
          (H := H) (u := u) hlin
      have hprod :=
        localBoundedAtZero_mul
          (H := H)
          (f := TaylorJetPowerRatioFactor u n)
          (g := TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio u)
          ih hfirst
      cases hprod with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          cases hdelta.right with
          | intro Bound hBound =>
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
              refine Exists.intro Bound ?_
              refine And.intro hBound.left ?_
              intro t ht htne htdist
              have hbound := hBound.right t ht htne htdist
              change
                F.lt
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                    (TaylorJetPowerRatioFactor u (n + 1) t))
                  Bound
              rw [taylorJetPowerRatioFactor_succ_eq_mul_firstOrderRatio
                (u := u) (n := n) (t := t) htne]
              exact hbound

name: tendstoWithin_identity_at_zero
statement:
private theorem tendstoWithin_identity_at_zero (H : Domain) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      RealFunction.IdentityFun
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  refine Exists.intro eps ?_
  refine And.intro heps ?_
  intro t _ht _htne htdist
  unfold RealFunction.IdentityFun
  exact htdist

name: localLinearBoundAtZero_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem localLinearBoundAtZero_tendsto_zero
    {H : Domain} {u : Map}
    (hlin : LocalLinearBoundAtZero H u) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H u
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hfirst :=
    localBoundedAtZero_firstOrderRatio_of_localLinearBoundAtZero
      (H := H) (u := u) hlin
  have hid := tendstoWithin_identity_at_zero H
  have hprod :=
    tendstoWithin_mul_zero_of_localBoundedAtZero
      (H := H)
      (f := RealFunction.IdentityFun)
      (g := TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio u)
      hid hfirst
  refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hprod
  intro t _ht htne
  unfold RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.IdentityFun
  unfold TaylorJetFirstOrderRatio
  change
    F.mul t (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t)) = u t
  calc
    F.mul t (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t)) =
        F.mul (F.mul t (u t)) (F.inv t) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (u t) t) (F.inv t) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm t (u t)]
    _ = F.mul (u t) (F.mul t (F.inv t)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (u t) F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel htne]
    _ = u t := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: taylorJetExpansionAt_zero_remainderRatio_tendsto
statement:
private theorem taylorJetExpansionAt_zero_remainderRatio_tendsto
    {H : Domain} {u : Map} {inner : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hinner :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt H u RealTheory.zero inner n) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (fun t : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (u t) (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hinner.right.right eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro t ht htne htdist
      have htInc : IncrementDomain H RealTheory.zero t := by
        unfold IncrementDomain
        rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
        exact ht
      have hclose := hdelta.right t htInc htne htdist
      unfold TaylorJetRemainderRatio TaylorJetRemainder at hclose
      unfold IncrementLift IncrementMap at hclose
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add] at hclose
      exact hclose

name: taylorJetRemainderRatio_comp_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem taylorJetRemainderRatio_comp_tendsto_zero
    {H K : Domain} {outerFun u : Map}
    {outer : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (houter :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt K outerFun
        RealTheory.zero outer n)
    (hlin : LocalLinearBoundAtZero H u)
    (hmap : LocalMapsIntoAtZero H K u) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (RealFunction.CompFun
        (TaylorJetRemainderRatio outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n)
        u)
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have houterCenter : outerFun RealTheory.zero = outer 0 :=
    houter.right.left
  have huTendsto := localLinearBoundAtZero_tendsto_zero
    (H := H) (u := u) hlin
  cases houter.right.right eps heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases huTendsto eta heta.left with
      | intro deltaU hdeltaU =>
          cases hmap with
          | intro deltaMap hdeltaMap =>
              let delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaU deltaMap
              have hdeltaPos : F.lt F.zero delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
                  F hdeltaU.left hdeltaMap.left
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro hdeltaPos ?_
              intro t ht htne htdist
              have htdistU :
                  F.lt (RealFunction.dist t F.zero) deltaU :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htdist
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                    F deltaU deltaMap)
              have htdistMap :
                  F.lt (RealFunction.dist t F.zero) deltaMap :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F htdist
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                    F deltaU deltaMap)
              have huclose := hdeltaU.right t ht htne htdistU
              unfold RealFunction.CompFun
              by_cases hu0 : u t = RealTheory.zero
              · rw [hu0]
                rw [taylorJetRemainderRatio_center_zero
                  (f := outerFun) (c := outer) (n := n)
                  houterCenter]
                rw [RealFunction.dist_self]
                exact heps
              · have huK := hdeltaMap.right t ht htne htdistMap
                have huKinc :
                    IncrementDomain K RealTheory.zero (u t) := by
                  unfold IncrementDomain
                  rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
                  exact huK
                exact heta.right (u t) huKinc hu0 huclose

name: taylorJetOuterRemainderSubstitutionRatio_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem taylorJetOuterRemainderSubstitutionRatio_tendsto_zero
    {H K : Domain} {outerFun u : Map}
    {outer : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (houter :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt K outerFun
        RealTheory.zero outer n)
    (hlin : LocalLinearBoundAtZero H u)
    (hmap : LocalMapsIntoAtZero H K u) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (TaylorJetOuterRemainderSubstitutionRatio outerFun u outer n)
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hratio :=
    taylorJetRemainderRatio_comp_tendsto_zero
      (H := H) (K := K)
      (outerFun := outerFun) (u := u)
      (outer := outer) (n := n)
      houter hlin hmap
  have hfactor :=
    localBoundedAtZero_powerRatio_of_localLinearBoundAtZero
      (H := H) (u := u) n hlin
  have hprod :=
    tendstoWithin_mul_zero_of_localBoundedAtZero
      (H := H)
      (f :=
        RealFunction.CompFun
          (TaylorJetRemainderRatio outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n)
          u)
      (g := TaylorJetPowerRatioFactor u n)
      hratio hfactor
  refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hprod
  intro t _ht _htne
  unfold RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.CompFun
  unfold TaylorJetOuterRemainderSubstitutionRatio
  exact Eq.symm
    (taylorJetRemainder_substitution_ratio_split
      (outerFun := outerFun) (u := u)
      (outer := outer) (n := n) (t := t)
      houter.right.left)

name: differenceQuotient_zero_eq_mul_inv
statement:
private theorem differenceQuotient_zero_eq_mul_inv
    {u : Map} {t : Point}
    (hu0 : u RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero) :
    DifferenceQuotient u RealTheory.zero t =
      RealTheory.mul (u t) (RealTheory.inv t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (u t) (u F.zero)) (F.inv (F.sub t F.zero)) =
      F.mul (u t) (F.inv t)
  have hu0F : u F.zero = F.zero := by
    change u RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
    exact hu0
  rw [hu0F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (u t)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F t]

name: abs_differenceQuotient_zero_mul_abs_eq_abs
statement:
private theorem abs_differenceQuotient_zero_mul_abs_eq_abs
    {u : Map} {t : Point}
    (hu0 : u RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero)
    (ht : Not (t = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.abs (DifferenceQuotient u RealTheory.zero t))
        (RealTheory.abs t) =
      RealTheory.abs (u t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hdq := differenceQuotient_zero_eq_mul_inv (u := u) (t := t) hu0
  have hdqF : DifferenceQuotient u F.zero t = F.mul (u t) (F.inv t) := by
    change
      DifferenceQuotient u RealTheory.zero t =
        RealTheory.mul (u t) (RealTheory.inv t)
    exact hdq
  have htF : Not (t = F.zero) := by
    change Not (t = RealTheory.zero)
    exact ht
  have hprod :
      F.mul (DifferenceQuotient u F.zero t) t = u t := by
    rw [hdqF]
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul (u t) (F.inv t)) t =
          F.mul (u t) (F.mul (F.inv t) t) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (u t) F.one := by
            rw [F.inv_mul_cancel htF]
      _ = u t := by
            rw [F.mul_one]
  change
    F.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
          (DifferenceQuotient u F.zero t))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (u t)
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F
    (DifferenceQuotient u F.zero t) t]
  rw [hprod]

name: localLinearBoundAtZero_of_deriv
statement:
private theorem localLinearBoundAtZero_of_deriv
    {H : Domain} {u : Map} {A : Point}
    (hu0 : u RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero)
    (hu : HasDerivWithin H u RealTheory.zero A) :
    LocalLinearBoundAtZero H u
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealFunction.tendstoWithin_localBounded hu.right with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases hdelta.right with
      | intro B hB =>
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          refine Exists.intro B ?_
          refine And.intro hB.left ?_
          intro t ht htne htdist
          have hdqBound := hB.right t ht htne htdist
          have habs_t_pos :
              F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.abs t) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_pos_of_ne_zero F htne
          have hmul_lt :
              F.lt
                (F.mul
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (DifferenceQuotient u RealTheory.zero t))
                  (RealTheory.abs t))
                (F.mul B (RealTheory.abs t)) :=
            F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hdqBound habs_t_pos
          have hmul_le :
              F.le
                (F.mul
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (DifferenceQuotient u RealTheory.zero t))
                  (RealTheory.abs t))
                (F.mul B (RealTheory.abs t)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hmul_lt
          have habs :=
            abs_differenceQuotient_zero_mul_abs_eq_abs
              (u := u) (t := t) hu0 htne
          rw [<- habs]
          exact hmul_le

name: finiteSum_eq_prefix_of_zero_tail
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_eq_prefix_of_zero_tail
    (term : Nat -> Point) {a b : Nat}
    (hab : a <= b)
    (hzero : forall k : Nat, a <= k -> k < b ->
      term k = RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum term b =
      RealTheory.finiteSum term a
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : b = a + (b - a) := by
    omega
  rw [hlen]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length term a (b - a)]
  have htail :
      RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => term (a + j)) (b - a) =
        RealTheory.zero := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    exact hzero (a + j) (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [htail]
  rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

name: taylorJetPolynomialSubstitutionCoeff_eq_composeCoeff_of_le
statement:
private theorem taylorJetPolynomialSubstitutionCoeff_eq_composeCoeff_of_le
    {outer inner : Nat -> Point} {n m : Nat}
    (hinner0 : inner 0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hmn : m <= n) :
    TaylorJetPolynomialSubstitutionCoeff outer inner n m =
      TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer inner m
proof:
:= by
  let s : RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries (m + 1) :=
    TaylorJet inner (m + 1)
  have hs0 : s.coeff 0 = RealTheory.zero := by
    unfold s
    rw [taylorJet_coeff]
    exact hinner0
  let term : Nat -> Point :=
    fun j : Nat =>
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
        (outer j)
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow s j)).coeff m
  have htail :
      forall j : Nat, m + 1 <= j -> j < n + 1 ->
        term j = RealTheory.zero := by
    intro j hjm _hjn
    unfold term
    rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_scale]
    have hpow :
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow s j).coeff m =
          RealTheory.zero :=
      RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow_coeff_eq_zero_of_lt
        s hs0 (m := m) (k := j) (by omega)
    rw [hpow]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_zero]
  unfold TaylorJetPolynomialSubstitutionCoeff
  change RealTheory.finiteSum term (n + 1) =
    TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer inner m
  rw [finiteSum_eq_prefix_of_zero_tail
    term (a := m + 1) (b := n + 1) (by omega) htail]
  rw [taylorJetComposeCoeff_eq_sum outer inner m]

name: taylorJetPolynomial_substitutionCoeff_eq_composeCoeff
statement:
private theorem taylorJetPolynomial_substitutionCoeff_eq_composeCoeff
    {outer inner : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hinner0 : inner 0 = RealTheory.zero) (t : Point) :
    TaylorJetPolynomial
        (TaylorJetPolynomialSubstitutionCoeff outer inner n) n t =
      TaylorJetPolynomial (TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer inner) n t
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorJetPolynomial RawTaylorPolynomial
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
  intro k hk
  rw [taylorJetPolynomialSubstitutionCoeff_eq_composeCoeff_of_le
    (outer := outer) (inner := inner) (n := n) (m := k)
    hinner0 (by omega)]

name: powNat_add_mul_inv_powNat_left_cancel
statement:
private theorem powNat_add_mul_inv_powNat_left_cancel
    {t : Point} (ht : Not (t = RealTheory.zero))
    (n r : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealFunction.powNat t (n + r))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
      RealFunction.powNat t r
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpow : Not (RealFunction.powNat t n = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero ht n
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_add t n r]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t n)
          (RealFunction.powNat t r))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
      RealFunction.powNat t r
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t n)
          (RealFunction.powNat t r))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
        F.mul
          (RealFunction.powNat t r)
          (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t n)
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))) := by
          calc
            F.mul
                (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t n)
                  (RealFunction.powNat t r))
                (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
                F.mul
                  (RealFunction.powNat t n)
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t r)
                    (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
            _ =
                F.mul
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t r)
                    (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
                  (RealFunction.powNat t n) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm]
            _ =
                F.mul
                  (RealFunction.powNat t r)
                  (F.mul (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
                    (RealFunction.powNat t n)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
            _ =
                F.mul
                  (RealFunction.powNat t r)
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t n)
                    (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm
                    (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
                    (RealFunction.powNat t n)]
    _ =
        F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t r) F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hpow]
    _ = RealFunction.powNat t r := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: tendstoWithin_monomial_tail_ratio_zero
statement:
private theorem tendstoWithin_monomial_tail_ratio_zero
    (H : Domain) (a : Point) (n r : Nat) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (fun t : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul a
            (RealFunction.powNat t (n + (r + 1))))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
      RealTheory.zero
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let tailPower : Map :=
    fun t : Point => RealFunction.powNat t (r + 1)
  have hpowUniversal :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        tailPower RealTheory.zero (tailPower RealTheory.zero) :=
    (RealFunction.continuousAtOn_powerFun
      (E := RealFunction.UniversalDomain)
      (x0 := RealTheory.zero) trivial (r + 1)).right
  have hpow :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        tailPower RealTheory.zero (tailPower RealTheory.zero) :=
    tendstoWithin_of_subset
      (E := RealFunction.UniversalDomain)
      (G := H)
      (f := tailPower)
      (x0 := RealTheory.zero)
      (L := tailPower RealTheory.zero)
      (fun _ _ => trivial)
      hpowUniversal
  have hpowZeroValue :
      tailPower RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero := by
    unfold tailPower
    exact RealFunction.powNat_zero_succ r
  have hpowZero :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        tailPower RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hpowZeroValue hpow
  have hconst :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (fun _ : Point => a) RealTheory.zero a :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const H a RealTheory.zero
  have hmul :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (RealFunction.MulFun (fun _ : Point => a) tailPower)
        RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul a RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hconst hpowZero
  have hmulZero :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (RealFunction.MulFun (fun _ : Point => a) tailPower)
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
    refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit ?_ hmul
    rw [RealTheory.mul_zero]
  refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hmulZero
  intro t _ht htne
  symm
  unfold RealFunction.MulFun tailPower
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul (F.mul a (RealFunction.powNat t (n + (r + 1))))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
      F.mul a (RealFunction.powNat t (r + 1))
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul a (RealFunction.powNat t (n + (r + 1))))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
        F.mul a
          (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t (n + (r + 1)))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul a (RealFunction.powNat t (r + 1)) := by
          have hcancel :
              F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t (n + (r + 1)))
                  (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
                RealFunction.powNat t (r + 1) := by
            change
              RealTheory.mul
                  (RealFunction.powNat t (n + (r + 1)))
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
                RealFunction.powNat t (r + 1)
            exact powNat_add_mul_inv_powNat_left_cancel
              htne n (r + 1)
          rw [hcancel]

name: tendstoWithin_finiteSum_zero
statement:
private theorem tendstoWithin_finiteSum_zero
    {H : Domain} {term : Nat -> Map} :
    forall n : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        RealFunction.TendstoWithin H (term k)
          RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero) ->
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k t) n)
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
  | 0, _ => by
      refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_
        (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
          H RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)
      intro t _ht _htne
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  | n + 1, hterm => by
      have hprefix :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
            (fun t : Point =>
              RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k t) n)
            RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
proof:
:=
        tendstoWithin_finiteSum_zero n
          (fun k hk => hterm k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))
      have hlast :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin H (term n)
            RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero :=
        hterm n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
      have hsum :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
            (RealFunction.AddFun
              (fun t : Point =>
                RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k t) n)
              (term n))
            RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero) :=
        RealFunction.tendstoWithin_add hprefix hlast
      have hsumZero :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
            (RealFunction.AddFun
              (fun t : Point =>
                RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => term k t) n)
              (term n))
            RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
        refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit ?_ hsum
        rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
      refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hsumZero
      intro t _ht _htne
      unfold RealFunction.AddFun
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]

name: tendstoWithin_rawTaylorProductHighTailRatio_zero
statement:
private theorem tendstoWithin_rawTaylorProductHighTailRatio_zero
    (H : Domain) (c d : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (fun t : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
      RealTheory.zero
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold RawTaylorProductHighTail
  refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_
    (tendstoWithin_finiteSum_zero
      (H := H)
      (term := fun i : Nat =>
        fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun h : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul (c i) (d (n + 1 - i + h)))
                  (RealFunction.powNat t (n + (h + 1))))
                (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
            i)
      (n + 1)
      (by
        intro i hi
        apply tendstoWithin_finiteSum_zero
        intro h hh
        exact tendstoWithin_monomial_tail_ratio_zero
          H (RealTheory.mul (c i) (d (n + 1 - i + h))) n h))
  intro t _ht _htne
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_right
    (fun i : Nat =>
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun h : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (c i) (d (n + 1 - i + h)))
            (RealFunction.powNat t (n + (h + 1))))
        i)
    (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
    (n + 1)]
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
  intro i hi
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_right
    (fun h : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (c i) (d (n + 1 - i + h)))
        (RealFunction.powNat t (n + (h + 1))))
    (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
    i]

name: monomial_mul_monomial
statement:
private theorem monomial_mul_monomial
    (a b t : Point) (i j : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul a (RealFunction.powNat t i))
        (RealTheory.mul b (RealFunction.powNat t j)) =
      RealTheory.mul
