        (RealTheory.mul a b)
        (RealFunction.powNat t (i + j))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_add t i j]
  change
    F.mul (F.mul a (RealFunction.powNat t i))
        (F.mul b (RealFunction.powNat t j)) =
      F.mul (F.mul a b)
        (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t i) (RealFunction.powNat t j))
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul a (RealFunction.powNat t i))
        (F.mul b (RealFunction.powNat t j)) =
        F.mul a
          (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t i)
            (F.mul b (RealFunction.powNat t j))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul a
          (F.mul b
            (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t i)
              (RealFunction.powNat t j))) := by
          congr 1
          calc
            F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t i)
                (F.mul b (RealFunction.powNat t j)) =
                F.mul (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t i) b)
                  (RealFunction.powNat t j) := by
                  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
            _ =
                F.mul (F.mul b (RealFunction.powNat t i))
                  (RealFunction.powNat t j) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm (RealFunction.powNat t i) b]
            _ =
                F.mul b
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t i)
                    (RealFunction.powNat t j)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.mul a b)
          (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat t i)
            (RealFunction.powNat t j)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_mul_split
statement:
private theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_mul_split
    (c d : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (t : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RawTaylorPolynomial c n t)
        (RawTaylorPolynomial d n t) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RawTaylorPolynomial
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff c d k)
          n t)
        (RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t)
proof:
:= by
  let mono : Nat -> Nat -> Point :=
    fun i j : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (c i) (d j))
        (RealFunction.powNat t (i + j))
  let low : Nat -> Point :=
    fun i : Nat =>
      RealTheory.finiteSum (fun h : Nat => mono i h) (n + 1 - i)
  let high : Nat -> Point :=
    fun i : Nat =>
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun h : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (c i) (d (n + 1 - i + h)))
            (RealFunction.powNat t (n + (h + 1))))
        i
  have hProductRect :
      RealTheory.mul
          (RawTaylorPolynomial c n t)
          (RawTaylorPolynomial d n t) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => mono i j) (n + 1))
          (n + 1) := by
    unfold RawTaylorPolynomial mono
    rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_right
      (fun i : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (c i) (RealFunction.powNat t i))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (d k) (RealFunction.powNat t k))
        (n + 1))
      (n + 1)]
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
    intro i hi
    rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left
      (RealTheory.mul (c i) (RealFunction.powNat t i))
      (fun j : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (d j) (RealFunction.powNat t j))
      (n + 1)]
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
    intro j hj
    exact monomial_mul_monomial (c i) (d j) t i j
  have hRectSplit :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => mono i j) (n + 1))
          (n + 1) =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum low (n + 1))
          (RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t) := by
    calc
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => mono i j) (n + 1))
          (n + 1) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.add (low i) (high i))
          (n + 1) := by
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
          intro i hi
          unfold low high mono
          have hlen : n + 1 = (n + 1 - i) + i := by
            omega
          rw [hlen]
          rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length
            (fun j : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul (c i) (d j))
                (RealFunction.powNat t (i + j)))
            (n + 1 - i) i]
          have hlowLen : n + 1 - i + i - i = n + 1 - i := by
            omega
          rw [hlowLen]
          congr 1
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
          intro h
          have hidx : i + (n + 1 - i + h) = n + (h + 1) := by
            omega
          rw [hidx]
      _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum low (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum high (n + 1)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
      _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum low (n + 1))
          (RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t) := by
          unfold RawTaylorProductHighTail high
          rfl
  have hCauchyLow :
      RawTaylorPolynomial
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff c d k)
          n t =
        RealTheory.finiteSum low (n + 1) := by
    unfold RawTaylorPolynomial low mono
    unfold RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
    unfold _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
    calc
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (c i) (d (k - i)))
                (k + 1))
              (RealFunction.powNat t k))
          (n + 1) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun i : Nat =>
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul (c i) (d (k - i)))
                  (RealFunction.powNat t k))
              (k + 1))
          (n + 1) := by
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
          intro k hk
          rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_right
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (c i) (d (k - i)))
            (RealFunction.powNat t k)
            (k + 1)]
      _ =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun h : Nat =>
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul (c i) (d ((i + h) - i)))
                  (RealFunction.powNat t (i + h)))
              (n + 1 - i))
          (n + 1) := by
          rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_triangle_swap
            (fun k i : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul (c i) (d (k - i)))
                (RealFunction.powNat t k))
            n]
      _ =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun h : Nat =>
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul (c i) (d h))
                  (RealFunction.powNat t (i + h)))
              (n + 1 - i))
          (n + 1) := by
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
          intro i hi
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
          intro h hh
          have hsub : (i + h) - i = h := by
            omega
          rw [hsub]
  rw [hProductRect]
  rw [hRectSplit]
  rw [<- hCauchyLow]

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_mul_truncationRatio_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_mul_truncationRatio_tendsto_zero
    (H : Domain) (c d : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (fun t : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RawTaylorPolynomial c n t)
              (RawTaylorPolynomial d n t))
            (RawTaylorPolynomial
              (fun k : Nat =>
                RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff c d k)
              n t))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
      RealTheory.zero
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_
    (tendstoWithin_rawTaylorProductHighTailRatio_zero H c d n)
  intro t _ht _htne
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsplit := rawTaylorPolynomial_mul_split c d n t
  have hsplitF :
      F.mul
          (RawTaylorPolynomial c n t)
          (RawTaylorPolynomial d n t) =
        F.add
          (RawTaylorPolynomial
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff c d k)
            n t)
          (RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t) := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul
          (RawTaylorPolynomial c n t)
          (RawTaylorPolynomial d n t) =
        RealTheory.add
          (RawTaylorPolynomial
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff c d k)
            n t)
          (RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t)
    exact hsplit
  symm
  change
    F.mul
        (F.sub
          (F.mul (RawTaylorPolynomial c n t)
            (RawTaylorPolynomial d n t))
          (RawTaylorPolynomial
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff c d k)
            n t))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
      F.mul (RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t)
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
  rw [hsplitF]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.sub
          (F.add
            (RawTaylorPolynomial
              (fun k : Nat =>
                RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff c d k)
              n t)
            (RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t))
          (RawTaylorPolynomial
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff c d k)
            n t))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
      F.mul (RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t)
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
  have hcancel :
      F.sub
          (F.add
            (RawTaylorPolynomial
              (fun k : Nat =>
                RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff c d k)
              n t)
            (RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t))
          (RawTaylorPolynomial
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff c d k)
            n t) =
        RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t := by
    rw [F.add_comm
      (RawTaylorPolynomial
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff c d k)
        n t)
      (RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t)]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F
      (RawTaylorProductHighTail c d n t)
      (RawTaylorPolynomial
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff c d k)
        n t)]
  rw [hcancel]

name: tendstoWithin_rawTaylorPolynomial_zero
statement:
private theorem tendstoWithin_rawTaylorPolynomial_zero
    (H : Domain) (c : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (RawTaylorPolynomial c n)
      RealTheory.zero
      (c 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hpolyUniversal :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (RawTaylorPolynomial c n)
        RealTheory.zero
        (RawTaylorPolynomial c n RealTheory.zero) :=
    (hasDerivWithin_continuousAtOn
      ((hasDerivativeWithinOn_rawTaylorPolynomial
        RealFunction.UniversalDomain c n)
        RealTheory.zero trivial)).right
  have hpolyH :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (RawTaylorPolynomial c n)
        RealTheory.zero
        (RawTaylorPolynomial c n RealTheory.zero) :=
    tendstoWithin_of_subset
      (E := RealFunction.UniversalDomain)
      (G := H)
      (f := RawTaylorPolynomial c n)
      (x0 := RealTheory.zero)
      (L := RawTaylorPolynomial c n RealTheory.zero)
      (fun _ _ => trivial)
      hpolyUniversal
  refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit ?_ hpolyH
  exact rawTaylorPolynomial_at_zero c n

name: localBoundedAtZero_rawTaylorPolynomial
statement:
private theorem localBoundedAtZero_rawTaylorPolynomial
    (H : Domain) (c : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    LocalBoundedAtZero H (RawTaylorPolynomial c n)
proof:
:=
  localBoundedAtZero_of_tendstoWithin
    (tendstoWithin_rawTaylorPolynomial_zero H c n)

name: localLinearBoundAtZero_taylorJetPolynomial_of_zero_const
statement:
private theorem localLinearBoundAtZero_taylorJetPolynomial_of_zero_const
    (H : Domain) (inner : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat)
    (hinner0 : inner 0 = RealTheory.zero) :
    LocalLinearBoundAtZero H (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      refine Exists.intro F.one ?_
      refine And.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) ?_
      refine Exists.intro F.one ?_
      refine And.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) ?_
      intro t _ht _htne _htdist
      unfold TaylorJetPolynomial
      rw [rawTaylorPolynomial_zero inner t]
      rw [hinner0]
      change
        F.le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F F.zero)
          (F.mul F.one (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t))
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_zero F]
      rw [F.one_mul]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F t
  | succ m =>
      let shifted : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat => inner (k + 1)
      have hshiftBound :
          LocalBoundedAtZero H (RawTaylorPolynomial shifted m) :=
        localBoundedAtZero_rawTaylorPolynomial H shifted m
      cases hshiftBound with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          cases hdelta.right with
          | intro B hB =>
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
              refine Exists.intro B ?_
              refine And.intro hB.left ?_
              intro t ht htne htdist
              have hQ := hB.right t ht htne htdist
              change
                F.lt
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                    (RawTaylorPolynomial shifted m t))
                  B at hQ
              unfold TaylorJetPolynomial
              have hsplit :=
                rawTaylorPolynomial_split_constant_tail inner m t
              have hpoly :
                  RawTaylorPolynomial inner (m + 1) t =
                    F.mul t (RawTaylorPolynomial shifted m t) := by
                unfold shifted
                rw [hsplit]
                rw [hinner0]
                change
                  F.add F.zero
                    (F.mul t
                      (RawTaylorPolynomial
                        (fun k : Nat => inner (k + 1)) m t)) =
                    F.mul t
                      (RawTaylorPolynomial
                        (fun k : Nat => inner (k + 1)) m t)
                rw [F.zero_add]
              change
                F.le
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                    (RawTaylorPolynomial inner (m + 1) t))
                  (F.mul B (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t))
              rw [hpoly]
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul
                F t (RawTaylorPolynomial shifted m t)]
              rw [F.mul_comm
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t)
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial shifted m t))]
              exact F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hQ)
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F t)

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_add
statement:
private theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_add
    (c d : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (t : Point) :
    RawTaylorPolynomial
        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.add (c k) (d k)) n t =
      RealTheory.add
        (RawTaylorPolynomial c n t)
        (RawTaylorPolynomial d n t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RawTaylorPolynomial
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_add
    (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (c k) (RealFunction.powNat t k))
    (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (d k) (RealFunction.powNat t k))
    (n + 1)]
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
  intro k _hk
  change
    F.mul (F.add (c k) (d k)) (RealFunction.powNat t k) =
      F.add
        (F.mul (c k) (RealFunction.powNat t k))
        (F.mul (d k) (RealFunction.powNat t k))
  exact F.add_mul (c k) (d k) (RealFunction.powNat t k)

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_scale
statement:
private theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_scale
    (a : Point) (c : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (t : Point) :
    RawTaylorPolynomial
        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul a (c k)) n t =
      RealTheory.mul a (RawTaylorPolynomial c n t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RawTaylorPolynomial
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left a
    (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (c k) (RealFunction.powNat t k))
    (n + 1)]
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
  intro k _hk
  change
    F.mul (F.mul a (c k)) (RealFunction.powNat t k) =
      F.mul a (F.mul (c k) (RealFunction.powNat t k))
  rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_finiteSum_scaled
statement:
private theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_finiteSum_scaled
    (outer : Nat -> Point) (coeff : Nat -> Nat -> Point)
    (n len : Nat) (t : Point) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (outer j)
            (RawTaylorPolynomial (coeff j) n t))
        len =
      RawTaylorPolynomial
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => RealTheory.mul (outer j) (coeff j k))
            len)
        n t
proof:
:= by
  induction len with
  | zero =>
      unfold RawTaylorPolynomial
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      apply Eq.symm
      apply RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero
      intro k _hk
      change
        RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
          (RealFunction.powNat t k) =
        RealTheory.zero
      rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  | succ len ih =>
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      rw [ih]
      rw [<- rawTaylorPolynomial_scale (outer len) (coeff len) n t]
      rw [<- rawTaylorPolynomial_add
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => RealTheory.mul (outer j) (coeff j k))
            len)
        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (outer len) (coeff len k))
        n t]
      congr 1

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_oneCoeff
statement:
private theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_oneCoeff
    (N n : Nat) (t : Point) :
    RawTaylorPolynomial
        (fun k : Nat =>
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.one
            (N := N)).coeff k)
        n t =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      unfold RawTaylorPolynomial
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      change RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one RealTheory.one =
        RealTheory.one
      rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
  | succ n ih =>
      unfold RawTaylorPolynomial at ih
      unfold RawTaylorPolynomial
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_append_zero
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            ((RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.one
              (N := N)).coeff k)
            (RealFunction.powNat t k))
        (h := by
          change
            RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
              (RealFunction.powNat t (n + 1)) =
            RealTheory.zero
          rw [RealTheory.zero_mul])]
      exact ih

name: tps_pow_truncate_coeff
statement:
private theorem tps_pow_truncate_coeff
    {N M : Nat} (s : RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries M)
    (j m : Nat) :
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.truncate (N := N) s) j).coeff m =
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow s j).coeff m
proof:
:= by
  revert m
  induction j with
  | zero =>
      intro m
      rfl
  | succ j ih =>
      intro m
      rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow_succ]
      rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow_succ]
      rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      unfold RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
      unfold _root_.Tautology.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
      apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
      intro i _hi
      rw [ih i]
      rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_truncate]

name: taylorJet_pow_coeff_of_precision_le
statement:
private theorem taylorJet_pow_coeff_of_precision_le
    (inner : Nat -> Point) {m n j : Nat}
    (_hmn : m <= n) :
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
      (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff m =
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
        (TaylorJet inner (m + 1)) j).coeff m
proof:
:= by
  symm
  have h :=
    tps_pow_truncate_coeff
      (N := m + 1)
      (M := n + 1)
      (s := TaylorJet inner (n + 1))
      j m
  change
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.truncate
        (N := m + 1) (TaylorJet inner (n + 1))) j).coeff m =
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
        (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff m at h
  change
    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
      (TaylorJet inner (m + 1)) j).coeff m =
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
        (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff m
  exact h

name: ratio_sub_trans_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem ratio_sub_trans_tendsto_zero
    {H : Domain} {a b c : Map} {n : Nat}
    (hab :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.sub (a t) (b t))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)
    (hbc :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.sub (b t) (c t))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (fun t : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (a t) (c t))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (RealFunction.AddFun
          (fun t : Point =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub (a t) (b t))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
          (fun t : Point =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub (b t) (c t))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))))
        RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_add hab hbc
  have hsumZero :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (RealFunction.AddFun
          (fun t : Point =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub (a t) (b t))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
          (fun t : Point =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub (b t) (c t))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))))
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
    refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit ?_ hsum
    rw [RealTheory.zero_add]

name: powerDifferenceRatio_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem powerDifferenceRatio_tendsto_zero
    {H : Domain} {u v : Map} {n : Nat}
    (herr :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.sub (u t) (v t))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)
    (hu : LocalBoundedAtZero H u)
    (hv : LocalBoundedAtZero H v) :
    forall j : Nat,
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j)
              (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
  | 0 => by
      refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_
        (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
          H RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)
      intro t _ht _htne
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero, RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change F.zero = F.mul (F.sub F.one F.one)
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
      rw [F.sub_self]
      rw [F.zero_mul]
  | j + 1 => by
      have ratioMul :
          forall {err g : Map} {m : Nat},
            RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
                (fun t : Point =>
                  RealTheory.mul (err t)
                    (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t m)))
                RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero ->
              LocalBoundedAtZero H g ->
                RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
                  (fun t : Point =>
                    RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.mul (err t) (g t))
                      (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t m)))
                  RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
        intro err g m herr' hg'
        have hprod :=
          tendstoWithin_mul_zero_of_localBoundedAtZero
            (H := H)
            (f := fun t : Point =>
              RealTheory.mul (err t)
                (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t m)))
            (g := g)
            herr' hg'
        refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hprod
        intro t _ht _htne
        unfold RealFunction.MulFun
        let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        change
          F.mul
              (F.mul (err t) (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t m)))
              (g t) =
            F.mul
              (F.mul (err t) (g t))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t m))
        calc
          F.mul
              (F.mul (err t) (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t m)))
              (g t) =
              F.mul (err t)
                (F.mul (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t m)) (g t)) := by
                rw [F.mul_assoc]
          _ =
              F.mul (err t)
                (F.mul (g t) (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t m))) := by
                rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t m)) (g t)]
          _ =
              F.mul
                (F.mul (err t) (g t))
                (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t m)) := by
                rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      let diffPow : Map :=
        fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j)
            (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j)
      let termLeft : Map :=
        fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (diffPow t) (u t))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
      let termRight : Map :=
        fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j)
              (RealTheory.sub (u t) (v t)))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
      have hleft :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin H termLeft
            RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
        unfold termLeft diffPow
        exact ratioMul
          (err := fun t : Point =>
            RealTheory.sub
              (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j)
              (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j))
          (g := u)
          (m := n)
          (powerDifferenceRatio_tendsto_zero herr hu hv j)
          hu
      have boundedPow :
          forall k : Nat,
            LocalBoundedAtZero H
              (fun t : Point => RealFunction.powNat (v t) k) := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero =>
            change LocalBoundedAtZero H (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
            let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            let Bound := F.add F.one F.one
            have hBoundPos : F.lt F.zero Bound := by
              have hone_lt : F.lt F.one Bound := by
                unfold Bound
                have h := F.add_lt_add_left
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) F.one
                rwa [F.add_zero] at h
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) hone_lt
            refine Exists.intro F.one ?_
            refine And.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) ?_
            refine Exists.intro Bound ?_
            refine And.intro hBoundPos ?_
            intro _t _ht _htne _hdist
            change F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F F.one) Bound
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_one F]
            unfold Bound
            have h := F.add_lt_add_left
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) F.one
            rwa [F.add_zero] at h
        | succ j ih =>
            have hprod :=
              localBoundedAtZero_mul
                (H := H)
                (f := fun t : Point => RealFunction.powNat (v t) j)
                (g := v)
                ih hv
            change
              LocalBoundedAtZero H
                (RealFunction.MulFun
                  (fun t : Point => RealFunction.powNat (v t) j)
                  v)
            exact hprod
      have hvpow : LocalBoundedAtZero H
          (fun t : Point => RealFunction.powNat (v t) j) :=
        boundedPow j
      have hrightComm :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
            (fun t : Point =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.sub (u t) (v t))
                  (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j))
                (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
            RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero :=
        ratioMul
          (err := fun t : Point => RealTheory.sub (u t) (v t))
          (g := fun t : Point => RealFunction.powNat (v t) j)
          (m := n)
          herr hvpow
      have hright :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin H termRight
            RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
        refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hrightComm
        intro t _ht _htne
        unfold termRight
        let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        change
          F.mul
              (F.mul
                (F.sub (u t) (v t))
                (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
            F.mul
              (F.mul
                (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j)
                (F.sub (u t) (v t)))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
        rw [F.mul_comm
          (F.sub (u t) (v t))
          (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j)]
      have hsum :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
            (RealFunction.AddFun termLeft termRight)
            RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
        have hsumRaw :=
          RealFunction.tendstoWithin_add hleft hright
        refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit ?_ hsumRaw
        rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
      refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hsum
      intro t _ht _htne
      unfold RealFunction.AddFun termLeft termRight diffPow
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hsplitF :
          F.sub
              (RealFunction.powNat (u t) (j + 1))
              (RealFunction.powNat (v t) (j + 1)) =
            F.add
              (F.mul
                (F.sub
                  (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j)
                  (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j))
                (u t))
              (F.mul
                (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j)
                (F.sub (u t) (v t))) := by
        change
          RealTheory.sub
              (RealFunction.powNat (u t) (j + 1))
              (RealFunction.powNat (v t) (j + 1)) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j)
                  (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j))
                (u t))
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j)
                (RealTheory.sub (u t) (v t)))
        rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ, RealFunction.powNat_succ]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j) (u t)
          (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j) (v t)
      change
        F.add
          (F.mul
            (F.mul
              (F.sub
                (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j)
                (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j))
              (u t))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
          (F.mul
            (F.mul
              (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j)
              (F.sub (u t) (v t)))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))) =
        F.mul
          (F.sub
            (RealFunction.powNat (u t) (j + 1))
            (RealFunction.powNat (v t) (j + 1)))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
      rw [<- F.add_mul]
      rw [<- hsplitF]

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_pow_truncationRatio_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_pow_truncationRatio_tendsto_zero
    (H : Domain) (inner : Nat -> Point) (n j : Nat) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (fun t : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealFunction.powNat (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) j)
            (RawTaylorPolynomial
              (fun k : Nat =>
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                  (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
              n t))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
      RealTheory.zero
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
      refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_
        (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
          H RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)
      intro t _ht _htne
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      symm
      change
        F.mul
          (F.sub F.one
            (RawTaylorPolynomial
              (fun k : Nat =>
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.one
                  (N := n + 1)).coeff k)
              n t))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
        F.zero
      rw [rawTaylorPolynomial_oneCoeff (n + 1) n t]
      change
        F.mul (F.sub F.one F.one)
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
        F.zero
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.one]
      rw [F.zero_mul]
  | succ j ih =>
      let qj : Nat -> Point :=
        fun k : Nat =>
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
            (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k
      let qsucc : Nat -> Point :=
        fun k : Nat =>
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
            (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) (j + 1)).coeff k
      let mid : Map :=
        fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RawTaylorPolynomial qj n t)
            (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t)
      have hleft :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
            (fun t : Point =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealFunction.powNat
                    (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) (j + 1))
                  (mid t))
                (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
            RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
        have hmul :=
          ratio_mul_rawTaylorPolynomial_tendsto_zero
            (H := H)
            (err := fun t : Point =>
              RealTheory.sub
                (RealFunction.powNat
                  (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) j)
                (RawTaylorPolynomial qj n t))
            (p := inner)
            (n := n)
            ih
        refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hmul
        intro t _ht _htne
        let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        unfold qj mid TaylorJetPolynomial
        change
          F.mul
              (F.mul
                (F.sub
                  (RealFunction.powNat
                    (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t) j)
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial
                    (fun k : Nat =>
                      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                        (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
                    n t))
                (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
            F.mul
              (F.sub
                (RealFunction.powNat
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t) (j + 1))
                (F.mul
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial
                    (fun k : Nat =>
                      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                        (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
                    n t)
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t)))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
        rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F
          (RealFunction.powNat (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t) j)
          (RawTaylorPolynomial
            (fun k : Nat =>
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
            n t)
          (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t)]
        rfl
      have hrightBase :=
        rawTaylorPolynomial_mul_truncationRatio_tendsto_zero
          H qj inner n
      have hright :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
            (fun t : Point =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (mid t)
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial qsucc n t))
                (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
            RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
        refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hrightBase
        intro t _ht _htne
        let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        unfold mid qj qsucc TaylorJetPolynomial
        change
          F.mul
              (F.sub
                (F.mul
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial
                    (fun k : Nat =>
                      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                        (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
                    n t)
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t))
                (RawTaylorPolynomial
                  (fun k : Nat =>
                    RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
                      (fun k : Nat =>
                        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                          (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
                      inner k)
                  n t))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
            F.mul
              (F.sub
                (F.mul
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial
                    (fun k : Nat =>
                      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                        (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
                    n t)
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t))
                (RawTaylorPolynomial
                  (fun k : Nat =>
                    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                      (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) (j + 1)).coeff k)
                  n t))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
        congr 2
      exact
        ratio_sub_trans_tendsto_zero
          (H := H)
          (a := fun t : Point =>
            RealFunction.powNat (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) (j + 1))
          (b := mid)
          (c := RawTaylorPolynomial qsucc n)
          (n := n)
          hleft hright

name: taylorJetOuterPolynomialPerturbationRatio_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem taylorJetOuterPolynomialPerturbationRatio_tendsto_zero
    {H : Domain} (outer inner : Nat -> Point) {u : Map} (n : Nat)
    (hinner :

    (hinner0 : inner 0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (huLinear : LocalLinearBoundAtZero H u) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (TaylorJetOuterPolynomialPerturbationRatio outer inner u n)
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let v : Map := TaylorJetPolynomial inner n
  have herr :=
    taylorJetExpansionAt_zero_remainderRatio_tendsto
      (H := H) (u := u) (inner := inner) (n := n) hinner
  have huBound : LocalBoundedAtZero H u :=
    localBoundedAtZero_of_tendstoWithin
      (localLinearBoundAtZero_tendsto_zero huLinear)
  have hvLinear :
      LocalLinearBoundAtZero H v := by
    unfold v
    exact localLinearBoundAtZero_taylorJetPolynomial_of_zero_const
      H inner n hinner0
  have hvBound : LocalBoundedAtZero H v :=
    localBoundedAtZero_of_tendstoWithin
      (localLinearBoundAtZero_tendsto_zero hvLinear)
  have hsum :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul (outer j)
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j)
                    (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j)))
                (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
            (n + 1))
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
    apply tendstoWithin_finiteSum_zero
    intro j _hj
    exact ratio_const_mul_tendsto_zero
      (H := H)
      (err := fun t : Point =>
        RealTheory.sub
          (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j)
          (RealFunction.powNat (v t) j))
      (n := n)
      (outer j)
      (powerDifferenceRatio_tendsto_zero
        (H := H) (u := u) (v := v) (n := n)
        herr huBound hvBound j)
  refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hsum
  intro t _ht _htne
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold TaylorJetOuterPolynomialPerturbationRatio
  unfold TaylorJetPolynomialSubstitution
  unfold TaylorJetPolynomial RawTaylorPolynomial
  unfold v
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          F.mul
            (F.mul (outer j)
              (F.sub
                (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j)
                (RealFunction.powNat
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t) j)))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
        (n + 1) =
      F.mul
        (F.sub
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul (outer j)
                (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j))
            (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul (outer j)
                (RealFunction.powNat
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t) j))
            (n + 1)))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
  unfold RealTheory.finiteSum
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_right F
    (fun j : Nat =>
      F.mul (outer j)
        (F.sub
          (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j)
          (RealFunction.powNat
            (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t) j)))
    (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
    (n + 1)]
  have hscaleSub :
      F.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.mul (outer j)
              (F.sub
                (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j)
                (RealFunction.powNat
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t) j)))
          (n + 1) =
        F.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.sub
              (F.mul (outer j)
                (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j))
              (F.mul (outer j)
                (RealFunction.powNat
                  (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t) j)))
          (n + 1) := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
    intro j _hj
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F
      (outer j)
      (RealFunction.powNat (u t) j)
      (RealFunction.powNat (RawTaylorPolynomial inner n t) j)
  rw [hscaleSub]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_sub F]

name: taylorJetPolynomialSubstitution_fixedCoeffRatio_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem taylorJetPolynomialSubstitution_fixedCoeffRatio_tendsto_zero
    (H : Domain) (outer inner : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (fun t : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub
            (TaylorJetPolynomialSubstitution outer inner n t)
            (RawTaylorPolynomial
              (TaylorJetPolynomialFixedSubstitutionCoeff outer inner n)
              n t))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
      RealTheory.zero
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let coeff : Nat -> Nat -> Point :=
    fun j k : Nat =>
      (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
        (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k
  have hsum :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
        (fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul (outer j)
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealFunction.powNat
                      (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) j)
                    (RawTaylorPolynomial (coeff j) n t)))
                (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
            (n + 1))
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
    apply tendstoWithin_finiteSum_zero
    intro j hj
    exact
      ratio_const_mul_tendsto_zero
        (H := H)
        (err := fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (RealFunction.powNat (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) j)
            (RawTaylorPolynomial (coeff j) n t))
        (n := n)
        (outer j)
        (rawTaylorPolynomial_pow_truncationRatio_tendsto_zero
          H inner n j)
  refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hsum
  intro t _ht _htne
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold TaylorJetPolynomialSubstitution
  unfold TaylorJetPolynomialFixedSubstitutionCoeff
  unfold coeff
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          F.mul
            (F.mul (outer j)
              (F.sub
                (RealFunction.powNat
                  (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) j)
                (RawTaylorPolynomial
                  (fun k : Nat =>
                    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                      (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
                  n t)))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)))
        (n + 1) =
      F.mul
        (F.sub
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul (outer j)
                (RealFunction.powNat
                  (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) j))
            (n + 1))
          (RawTaylorPolynomial
            (fun m : Nat =>
              RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun j : Nat =>
                  (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
                    (outer j)
                    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                      (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j)).coeff m)
                (n + 1))
            n t))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
  unfold RealTheory.finiteSum
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_right F
    (fun j : Nat =>
      F.mul (outer j)
        (F.sub
          (RealFunction.powNat
            (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) j)
          (RawTaylorPolynomial
            (fun k : Nat =>
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
            n t)))
    (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
    (n + 1)]
  have hscaleSub :
      F.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.mul (outer j)
              (F.sub
                (RealFunction.powNat
                  (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) j)
                (RawTaylorPolynomial
                  (fun k : Nat =>
                    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                      (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
                  n t)))
          (n + 1) =
        F.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.sub
              (F.mul (outer j)
                (RealFunction.powNat
                  (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) j))
              (F.mul (outer j)
                (RawTaylorPolynomial
                  (fun k : Nat =>
                    (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                      (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
                  n t)))
          (n + 1) := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
    intro j _hj
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F
      (outer j)
      (RealFunction.powNat (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) j)
      (RawTaylorPolynomial
        (fun k : Nat =>
          (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
            (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
        n t)
  rw [hscaleSub]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_sub F
    (fun j : Nat =>
      F.mul (outer j)
        (RealFunction.powNat (TaylorJetPolynomial inner n t) j))
    (fun j : Nat =>
      F.mul (outer j)
        (RawTaylorPolynomial
          (fun k : Nat =>
            (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
              (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
          n t))
    (n + 1)]
  congr 2
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (outer j)
            (RawTaylorPolynomial
              (fun k : Nat =>
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                  (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
              n t))
        (n + 1) =
      RawTaylorPolynomial
        (fun m : Nat =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat =>
              (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.scale
                (outer j)
                (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
                  (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j)).coeff m)
            (n + 1))
        n t
  rw [rawTaylorPolynomial_finiteSum_scaled
      outer
      (fun j k : Nat =>
        (RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow
          (TaylorJet inner (n + 1)) j).coeff k)
      n (n + 1) t]
  unfold RawTaylorPolynomial
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
  intro m _hm
  congr 1

name: taylorJetComposeTruncationErrorRatio_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem taylorJetComposeTruncationErrorRatio_tendsto_zero
    (H : Domain) (outer inner : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat)
    (hinner0 : inner 0 = RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
      (TaylorJetComposeTruncationErrorRatio outer inner n)
      RealTheory.zero
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by

    (taylorJetPolynomialSubstitution_fixedCoeffRatio_tendsto_zero
      H outer inner n)

  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold TaylorJetComposeTruncationErrorRatio
  unfold TaylorJetComposeTruncationError
  have hfixedSubst :=
    taylorJetPolynomial_fixedSubstitutionCoeff_eq_substitutionCoeff
      outer inner n t
  have hsubstCompose :=
    taylorJetPolynomial_substitutionCoeff_eq_composeCoeff
      (outer := outer) (inner := inner)
      (n := n) (t := t) hinner0
  have hfixedCompose :
      RawTaylorPolynomial
          (TaylorJetPolynomialFixedSubstitutionCoeff outer inner n)
          n t =
        TaylorJetPolynomial (TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer inner) n t := by
    rw [hfixedSubst]
    exact hsubstCompose
  change
    F.mul
        (F.sub
          (TaylorJetPolynomialSubstitution outer inner n t)
          (RawTaylorPolynomial
            (TaylorJetPolynomialFixedSubstitutionCoeff outer inner n)
            n t))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n)) =
      F.mul
        (F.sub
          (TaylorJetPolynomialSubstitution outer inner n t)
          (TaylorJetPolynomial (TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer inner) n t))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
  rw [hfixedCompose]

name: taylorJetExpansionAt_comp_increment
statement:
private theorem taylorJetExpansionAt_comp_increment
    {H K : Domain} {outerFun innerDelta : Map}
    {outer inner : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (houter :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt K outerFun
        RealTheory.zero outer n)
    (hinner :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt H innerDelta
        RealTheory.zero inner n)
    (hinner0 : inner 0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hlin : LocalLinearBoundAtZero H innerDelta)
    (hmap : LocalMapsIntoAtZero H K innerDelta) :
    TaylorJetExpansionAt H
      (RealFunction.CompFun outerFun innerDelta)
      RealTheory.zero
      (TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer inner) n
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hinner.left ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · have hinnerDelta0 : innerDelta RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero := by
      calc
        innerDelta RealTheory.zero = inner 0 := hinner.right.left
        _ = RealTheory.zero := hinner0
    have hcomposeCoeffZero :
        TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer inner 0 = outer 0 := by
      rw [<- taylorJetPolynomialSubstitutionCoeff_eq_composeCoeff_of_le
        hinner0 (Nat.le_refl 0)]
      unfold TaylorJetPolynomialSubstitutionCoeff
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
      rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_scale]
      rw [RealTheory.TruncatedPowerSeries.pow_zero]
      change RealTheory.mul (outer 0) RealTheory.one = outer 0
      rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
    unfold RealFunction.CompFun
    rw [hinnerDelta0, houter.right.left, hcomposeCoeffZero]
  let standardRatio : Map :=
    fun t : Point =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub
          (outerFun (innerDelta t))
          (TaylorJetPolynomial (TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer inner) n t))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat t n))
  have hstandard :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin H standardRatio
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
    unfold standardRatio
    exact
      taylorJetComposedStandardRatio_tendsto_zero
        (H := H) (K := K)
        (outerFun := outerFun) (innerDelta := innerDelta)
        (outer := outer) (inner := inner) (n := n)
        houter hinner hinner0 hlin hmap
  have hstandardIncrement :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        (IncrementDomain H RealTheory.zero)
        standardRatio RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
    exact
      tendstoWithin_of_subset
        (E := H) (G := IncrementDomain H RealTheory.zero)
        (f := standardRatio)
        (x0 := RealTheory.zero) (L := RealTheory.zero)
        (fun t ht => by
          unfold IncrementDomain at ht
          rw [RealTheory.zero_add] at ht
          exact ht)
        hstandard
  refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hstandardIncrement
  intro t _ht _htne
  unfold standardRatio
  unfold TaylorJetRemainderRatio TaylorJetRemainder
  unfold IncrementLift IncrementMap RealFunction.CompFun
  rw [RealTheory.zero_add]

name: localLinearIncrementBoundAt_of_hasDerivWithin
statement:
theorem localLinearIncrementBoundAt_of_hasDerivWithin
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A : Point}
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A) :
    LocalLinearIncrementBoundAt E f x0
proof:
:= by
  have hinc :
      HasDerivWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        (IncrementDelta x0 f)
        RealTheory.zero A := by
    have hmem : IncrementDomain E x0 RealTheory.zero := by
      unfold IncrementDomain
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
      exact hf.left
    refine And.intro hmem ?_
    have hshift :
        RealFunction.TendstoWithin
          (IncrementDomain E x0)
          (fun h : Point =>
            DifferenceQuotient f x0 (RealTheory.add x0 h))
          RealTheory.zero A :=
      tendstoWithin_incrementDomain hf.right
    refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hshift
    intro h _hh _hne
    unfold DifferenceQuotient IncrementDelta IncrementLift IncrementMap
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    change
      F.mul (F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0))
          (F.inv (F.sub (F.add x0 h) x0)) =
        F.mul
          (F.sub (F.sub (f (F.add x0 h)) (f x0))
            (F.sub (f (F.add x0 F.zero)) (f x0)))
          (F.inv (F.sub h F.zero))
    rw [F.add_zero]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F]
    rw [F.add_comm x0 h]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F]
  have hzero :
      IncrementDelta x0 f RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero := by
    unfold IncrementDelta IncrementLift IncrementMap
    rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (f x0)
  exact localLinearBoundAtZero_of_deriv
    hzero hinc

name: taylorJetRemainder_incrementDelta_eq_original
statement:
private theorem taylorJetRemainder_incrementDelta_eq_original
    {g : Map} {x0 : Point} {c : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat} {h : Point}
    (hcenter : g x0 = c 0) :
    TaylorJetRemainder (IncrementDelta x0 g)
        RealTheory.zero (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff c) n h =
      TaylorJetRemainder g x0 c n h
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      unfold TaylorJetRemainder IncrementDelta
      unfold IncrementLift IncrementMap TaylorJetPolynomial RawTaylorPolynomial
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
      unfold DeltaTaylorJetCoeff
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      change
        F.sub (F.sub (g (F.add x0 h)) (g x0))
            (F.mul F.zero F.one) =
          F.sub (g (F.add x0 h)) (F.mul (c 0) F.one)
      rw [F.zero_mul]
      rw [F.mul_one]
      rw [hcenter]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F]
  | succ n =>
      unfold TaylorJetRemainder IncrementDelta
      unfold IncrementLift IncrementMap TaylorJetPolynomial
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
      rw [rawTaylorPolynomial_split_constant_tail
        (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff c) n h]
      rw [rawTaylorPolynomial_split_constant_tail c n h]
      change
        F.sub
            (F.sub (g (F.add x0 h)) (g x0))
            (F.add F.zero
              (F.mul h
                (RawTaylorPolynomial
                  (fun k : Nat => c (k + 1)) n h))) =
          F.sub
            (g (F.add x0 h))
            (F.add (c 0)
              (F.mul h
                (RawTaylorPolynomial
                  (fun k : Nat => c (k + 1)) n h)))
      rw [F.zero_add]
      rw [hcenter]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add
        F (g (F.add x0 h)) (c 0)
          (F.mul h
            (RawTaylorPolynomial
              (fun k : Nat => c (k + 1)) n h))

name: taylorJetRemainderRatio_incrementDelta_eq_original
statement:
private theorem taylorJetRemainderRatio_incrementDelta_eq_original
    {g : Map} {x0 : Point} {c : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat} {h : Point}

    TaylorJetRemainderRatio (IncrementDelta x0 g)
        RealTheory.zero (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff c) n h =

proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorJetRemainderRatio
  rw [taylorJetRemainder_incrementDelta_eq_original
    (g := g) (x0 := x0) (c := c) (n := n) (h := h)
    hcenter]

name: taylorJetExpansionAt_incrementDelta
statement:
private theorem taylorJetExpansionAt_incrementDelta
    {E : Domain} {g : Map} {x0 : Point}
    {c : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hg : TaylorJetExpansionAt E g x0 c n) :
    TaylorJetExpansionAt
      (IncrementDomain E x0)
      (IncrementDelta x0 g)
      RealTheory.zero (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff c) n
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  ·
    unfold IncrementDomain
    rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
    exact hg.left
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · rw [incrementDelta_zero, deltaTaylorJetCoeff_zero]
  ·
    have hcenter : g x0 = c 0 := hg.right.left
    have hbase :
        RealFunction.TendstoWithin
          (IncrementDomain (IncrementDomain E x0) RealTheory.zero)
          (TaylorJetRemainderRatio g x0 c n)
          RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
      exact
        tendstoWithin_of_subset
          (E := IncrementDomain E x0)
          (G := IncrementDomain (IncrementDomain E x0) RealTheory.zero)
          (f := TaylorJetRemainderRatio g x0 c n)
          (x0 := RealTheory.zero) (L := RealTheory.zero)
          (fun h hh => by
            unfold IncrementDomain at hh
            rw [RealTheory.zero_add] at hh
            exact hh)
          hg.right.right
    refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hbase
    intro h _hh _hne
    exact Eq.symm
      (taylorJetRemainderRatio_incrementDelta_eq_original
        (g := g) (x0 := x0) (c := c) (n := n) (h := h)
        hcenter)

name: localMapsIntoAtZero_of_localCompMapsIntoAt
statement:
private theorem localMapsIntoAtZero_of_localCompMapsIntoAt
    {E K : Domain} {g : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hmap : LocalCompMapsIntoAt E K g x0) :
    LocalMapsIntoAtZero
      (IncrementDomain E x0)
      (IncrementDomain K (g x0))
      (IncrementDelta x0 g)
proof:
:= by
  cases hmap with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro h hh hne hdist
      have hK := hdelta.right h hh hne hdist
      unfold IncrementDomain
      unfold IncrementDelta IncrementLift IncrementMap
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change
        K
          (F.add (g x0)
            (F.sub (g (F.add x0 h)) (g x0)))
      have harg :
          F.add (g x0)
              (F.sub (g (F.add x0 h)) (g x0)) =
            g (F.add x0 h) := by
        rw [F.add_comm (g x0)
          (F.sub (g (F.add x0 h)) (g x0))]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
          F (g (F.add x0 h)) (g x0)
      rwa [harg]

name: taylorJetRemainderRatio_comp_increment_eq_original
statement:
private theorem taylorJetRemainderRatio_comp_increment_eq_original
    (f g : Map) (x0 : Point) (c : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) (h : Point) :
    TaylorJetRemainderRatio
        (RealFunction.CompFun
          (IncrementLift (g x0) f)
          (IncrementDelta x0 g))
        RealTheory.zero c n h =
      TaylorJetRemainderRatio
        (RealFunction.CompFun f g)
        x0 c n h
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorJetRemainderRatio TaylorJetRemainder
  unfold IncrementLift IncrementMap RealFunction.CompFun IncrementDelta
  rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.mul
        (F.sub
          (f
            (F.add (g x0)
              (F.sub (g (F.add x0 h)) (g x0))))
          (TaylorJetPolynomial c n h))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n)) =
      F.mul
        (F.sub
          (f (g (F.add x0 h)))
          (TaylorJetPolynomial c n h))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat h n))
  have harg :
      F.add (g x0)
          (F.sub (g (F.add x0 h)) (g x0)) =
        g (F.add x0 h) := by
    rw [F.add_comm (g x0)
      (F.sub (g (F.add x0 h)) (g x0))]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
      F (g (F.add x0 h)) (g x0)
  rw [harg]

name: taylorJetExpansionAt_comp
statement:
theorem taylorJetExpansionAt_comp
    {E K : Domain} {f g : Map} {x0 : Point}
    {outer inner : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (houter :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt K f (g x0) outer n)
    (hinner :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt E g x0 inner n)
    (hlin : LocalLinearIncrementBoundAt E g x0)
    (hmap : LocalCompMapsIntoAt E K g x0) :
    TaylorJetExpansionAt E
      (RealFunction.CompFun f g)
      x0
      (TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff inner)) n
proof:
:= by
  let H : Domain := IncrementDomain E x0
  let outerFun : Map := IncrementLift (g x0) f
  let innerDelta : Map := IncrementDelta x0 g
  have houterInc :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt
        (IncrementDomain K (g x0))
        outerFun RealTheory.zero outer n := by
    unfold outerFun
    exact taylorJetExpansionAt_incrementLift_zero houter
  have hinnerInc :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt H innerDelta
        RealTheory.zero (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff inner) n := by
    unfold H innerDelta
    exact taylorJetExpansionAt_incrementDelta hinner
  have hinner0 : DeltaTaylorJetCoeff inner 0 = RealTheory.zero := rfl
  have hmapInc :
      LocalMapsIntoAtZero H
        (IncrementDomain K (g x0))
        innerDelta := by
    unfold H innerDelta
    exact localMapsIntoAtZero_of_localCompMapsIntoAt hmap
  have hcompInc :
      TaylorJetExpansionAt H
        (RealFunction.CompFun outerFun innerDelta)
        RealTheory.zero
        (TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff inner)) n :=
    taylorJetExpansionAt_comp_increment
      (H := H) (K := IncrementDomain K (g x0))
      (outerFun := outerFun) (innerDelta := innerDelta)
      (outer := outer) (inner := DeltaTaylorJetCoeff inner) (n := n)
      houterInc hinnerInc hinner0
      hlin hmapInc
  refine And.intro hinner.left ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · have houterFun0 : outerFun RealTheory.zero = f (g x0) := by
      unfold outerFun IncrementLift IncrementMap
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
    have hinnerDelta0 : innerDelta RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero := by
      unfold innerDelta
      exact incrementDelta_zero x0 g
    have hcenter := hcompInc.right.left
    unfold RealFunction.CompFun at hcenter
    calc
      f (g x0) = outerFun RealTheory.zero := Eq.symm houterFun0
      _ = outerFun (innerDelta RealTheory.zero) := by rw [hinnerDelta0]
      _ = TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff inner) 0 :=
        hcenter
  have hright :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        (TaylorJetRemainderRatio
          (RealFunction.CompFun outerFun innerDelta)
          RealTheory.zero
          (TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff inner)) n)
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero := by
    exact
      tendstoWithin_of_subset
        (E := IncrementDomain H RealTheory.zero)
        (G := IncrementDomain E x0)
        (f := TaylorJetRemainderRatio
          (RealFunction.CompFun outerFun innerDelta)
          RealTheory.zero
          (TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff inner)) n)
        (x0 := RealTheory.zero) (L := RealTheory.zero)
        (fun h hh => by
          unfold H IncrementDomain
          rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
          exact hh)
        hcompInc.right.right
  refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr ?_ hright
  intro h _hh _hne
  unfold outerFun innerDelta
  exact taylorJetRemainderRatio_comp_increment_eq_original
    f g x0 (TaylorJetComposeCoeff outer (DeltaTaylorJetCoeff inner)) n h

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_incrementPower_succ
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_incrementPower_succ
    (E : Domain) (x0 : Point) (n : Nat) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1))
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x x0) n))
proof:
:= by
  have hinner :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (SubCenterMap x0)
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_subCenterMap E x0
  have houter :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (RealFunction.PowerFun (n + 1))
        (PowerDerivative (n + 1)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_powerFun RealFunction.UniversalDomain (n + 1)
  have hbase :
      RealFunction.MapsInto E RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (SubCenterMap x0) := by
    intro x hx
    exact True.intro
  have hcomp :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (RealFunction.CompFun
          (RealFunction.PowerFun (n + 1))
          (SubCenterMap x0))
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (RealFunction.CompFun (PowerDerivative (n + 1))
            (SubCenterMap x0))
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_comp hinner houter hbase
  change HasDerivativeWithinOn E
    (RealFunction.CompFun
      (RealFunction.PowerFun (n + 1))
      (SubCenterMap x0))
    (fun x : Point =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x x0) n))
  apply hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (E := E)
    (f :=
      RealFunction.CompFun
        (RealFunction.PowerFun (n + 1))
        (SubCenterMap x0))
    (f' :=
      RealFunction.MulFun
        (RealFunction.CompFun (PowerDerivative (n + 1))
          (SubCenterMap x0))
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one))
    (g' := fun x : Point =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x x0) n))
  · intro x _hx
    unfold RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.CompFun SubCenterMap
    change
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x x0) n))
          RealTheory.one =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x x0) n)
    rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  · exact hcomp

name: incrementPower_zero_at_center_succ
statement:
theorem incrementPower_zero_at_center_succ
    (x0 : Point) (n : Nat) :
    IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x0 = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold IncrementPower
  change RealFunction.powNat (F.sub x0 x0) (n + 1) = F.zero
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F x0]
  exact RealFunction.powNat_zero_succ n

name: incrementPower_ne_zero_of_ne_center
statement:
theorem incrementPower_ne_zero_of_ne_center
    {x0 x : Point}
    (hx : Not (x = x0)) (n : Nat) :
    Not (IncrementPower x0 n x = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub_ne : Not (RealTheory.sub x x0 = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hsub
    have hEq : x = x0 :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hsub
    exact hx hEq
  unfold IncrementPower
  exact RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hsub_ne n

name: incrementPowerDerivative_ne_zero_of_ne_center
statement:
theorem incrementPowerDerivative_ne_zero_of_ne_center
    {x0 x : Point}
    (hx : Not (x = x0)) (n : Nat) :
    Not (IncrementPowerDerivative x0 n x = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat :
      Not (RealTheory.nat (n + 1) = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  have hpow :
      Not (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x x0) n =
        RealTheory.zero) := by
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    have hsub_ne :
        Not (RealTheory.sub x x0 = RealTheory.zero) := by
      intro hsub
      have hEq : x = x0 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hsub
      exact hx hEq
    exact RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hsub_ne n
  unfold IncrementPowerDerivative
  exact RealTheory.mul_ne_zero hnat hpow

name: dist_eq_sub_of_lt_for_lhopital
statement:
theorem dist_eq_sub_of_lt_for_lhopital
    {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b) :
    RealFunction.dist b a = RealTheory.sub b a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealFunction.dist
  change
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub b a) =
      F.sub b a
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab))

name: dist_openInterval_right_lt_of_endpoint_lt
statement:
theorem dist_openInterval_right_lt_of_endpoint_lt
    {x0 x c eta : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.OpenInterval x0 x c)
    (hxd : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x x0) eta) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist c x0) eta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hx0x : RealTheory.lt x0 x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hc.left hc.right
  have hsub_lt :
      F.lt (F.sub c x0) (F.sub x x0) := by
    have h := F.add_lt_add_right hc.right (F.neg x0)
    rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg c x0,
      <- F.sub_eq_add_neg x x0] at h
  rw [dist_eq_sub_of_lt_for_lhopital hc.left]
  rw [dist_eq_sub_of_lt_for_lhopital hx0x] at hxd
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hsub_lt hxd

name: dist_openInterval_left_lt_of_endpoint_lt
statement:
theorem dist_openInterval_left_lt_of_endpoint_lt
    {x0 x c eta : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.OpenInterval x x0 c)
    (hxd : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x x0) eta) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist c x0) eta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcx0 : RealTheory.lt c x0 := hc.right
  have hxx0 : RealTheory.lt x x0 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hc.left hc.right
  have hsub_lt :
      F.lt (F.sub x0 c) (F.sub x0 x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt F hc.left
  rw [RealFunction.dist_comm c x0]
  rw [dist_eq_sub_of_lt_for_lhopital hcx0]
  rw [RealFunction.dist_comm x x0] at hxd
  rw [dist_eq_sub_of_lt_for_lhopital hxx0] at hxd
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hsub_lt hxd

name: quotient_eq_of_product_eq_for_lhopital
statement:
theorem quotient_eq_of_product_eq_for_lhopital
    {fx gx A B : Point}
    (hgx : Not (gx = RealTheory.zero))
    (hB : Not (B = RealTheory.zero))
    (hEq : RealTheory.mul gx A = RealTheory.mul fx B) :
    RealTheory.mul fx (RealTheory.inv gx) =
      RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv B)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.mul fx (F.inv gx) = F.mul A (F.inv B)
  have hGB : Not (F.mul gx B = F.zero) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F hgx hB
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero
    F (z := F.mul gx B) hGB
  have hleft :
      F.mul (F.mul fx (F.inv gx)) (F.mul gx B) =
        F.mul fx B := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul fx (F.inv gx)) (F.mul gx B) =
          F.mul fx (F.mul (F.inv gx) (F.mul gx B)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ =
          F.mul fx (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv gx) gx) B) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc (F.inv gx) gx B]
      _ =
          F.mul fx (F.mul F.one B) := by
            rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hgx]
      _ =
          F.mul fx B := by
            rw [F.one_mul]
  have hinner :
      F.mul (F.inv B) (F.mul gx B) = gx := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.inv B) (F.mul gx B) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.inv B) gx) B := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ =
          F.mul (F.mul gx (F.inv B)) B := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv B) gx]
      _ =
          F.mul gx (F.mul (F.inv B) B) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ =
          F.mul gx F.one := by
            rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hB]
      _ =
          gx := by
            rw [F.mul_one]
  have hright :
      F.mul (F.mul A (F.inv B)) (F.mul gx B) =
        F.mul gx A := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul A (F.inv B)) (F.mul gx B) =
          F.mul A (F.mul (F.inv B) (F.mul gx B)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ =
          F.mul A gx := by
            rw [hinner]
      _ =
          F.mul gx A := by
            rw [F.mul_comm]
  rw [hleft, hright]
  exact Eq.symm hEq

name: quotient_eq_of_cauchy_zero_product_for_lhopital
statement:
theorem quotient_eq_of_cauchy_zero_product_for_lhopital
    {f g : Map} {x0 x A B : Point}
    (hf0 : f x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hg0 : g x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hgx : Not (g x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hB : Not (B = RealTheory.zero))
    (hEq :
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (g x) (g x0)) A =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f x0)) B) :
    RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.inv (g x)) =
      RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv B)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hEqSimple :
      RealTheory.mul (g x) A =
        RealTheory.mul (f x) B := by
    change
      F.mul (F.sub (g x) (g x0)) A =
        F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f x0)) B at hEq
    rw [hg0] at hEq
    rw [hf0] at hEq
    change
      F.mul (F.sub (g x) F.zero) A =
      F.mul (F.sub (f x) F.zero) B at hEq
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (g x)] at hEq
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (f x)] at hEq
    exact hEq
  exact quotient_eq_of_product_eq_for_lhopital hgx hB hEqSimple

name: quotient_eq_of_cauchy_zero_product_left_for_lhopital
statement:
theorem quotient_eq_of_cauchy_zero_product_left_for_lhopital
    {f g : Map} {x0 x A B : Point}
    (hf0 : f x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hg0 : g x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hgx : Not (g x = RealTheory.zero))
    (hB : Not (B = RealTheory.zero))
    (hEq :
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (g x0) (g x)) A =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (f x0) (f x)) B) :
    RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.inv (g x)) =
      RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv B)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hEqSimple :
      RealTheory.mul (g x) A =
        RealTheory.mul (f x) B := by
    change
      F.mul (F.sub (g x0) (g x)) A =
        F.mul (F.sub (f x0) (f x)) B at hEq
    rw [hg0] at hEq
    rw [hf0] at hEq
    change
      F.mul (F.sub F.zero (g x)) A =
        F.mul (F.sub F.zero (f x)) B at hEq
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F (g x)] at hEq
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F (f x)] at hEq
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F (g x) A] at hEq
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F (f x) B] at hEq
    have hneg := congrArg F.neg hEq
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F
      (F.mul (g x) A)] at hneg
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F
      (F.mul (f x) B)] at hneg
    exact hneg
  exact quotient_eq_of_product_eq_for_lhopital hgx hB hEqSimple

name: incrementPowerDerivative_quotient_eq_scaled
statement:
theorem incrementPowerDerivative_quotient_eq_scaled
    {x0 x a : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hx : Not (x = x0)) :
    RealTheory.mul a
        (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPowerDerivative x0 n x)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul a
          (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 n x)))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnat :
      Not (RealTheory.nat (n + 1) = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  have hpow :
      Not (IncrementPower x0 n x = RealTheory.zero) :=
    incrementPower_ne_zero_of_ne_center hx n
  unfold IncrementPowerDerivative IncrementPower
  have hpowF :
      Not (RealFunction.powNat (F.sub x x0) n = F.zero) := by
    change Not (IncrementPower x0 n x = RealTheory.zero)
    exact hpow
  change
    F.mul a
        (F.inv
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (RealFunction.powNat (F.sub x x0) n))) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul a
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.sub x x0) n)))
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hnat hpowF]
  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: tendstoWithin_incrementPowerDerivative_of_incrementPower
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_incrementPowerDerivative_of_incrementPower
    {E : Domain} {r' : Map} {x0 : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hlim :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (r' x)
            (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 n x)))
        x0
        RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (r' x)
          (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPowerDerivative x0 n x)))
      x0
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let scale := RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
  have hscale :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun _ : Point => scale)
        x0
        scale :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const E scale x0
  have hmul :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (fun x : Point =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (r' x)
              (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 n x)))
          (fun _ : Point => scale))
        x0
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero scale) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hlim hscale
  have hmulZero :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (fun x : Point =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (r' x)
              (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 n x)))
          (fun _ : Point => scale))
        x0
        RealTheory.zero := by
    apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (M := RealTheory.zero) ?_ hmul
    exact RealTheory.zero_mul scale
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := RealFunction.MulFun
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (r' x)
          (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 n x)))
      (fun _ : Point => scale))
    (g := fun x : Point =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (r' x)
        (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPowerDerivative x0 n x)))
  · intro x _hx hxne
    unfold RealFunction.MulFun
    unfold scale
    symm
    exact incrementPowerDerivative_quotient_eq_scaled
      (x0 := x0) (x := x) (a := r' x) (n := n) hxne
  · exact hmulZero
