name: localSegmentWithinAt_incrementDomain
statement:
private theorem localSegmentWithinAt_incrementDomain
    {E : Domain} {x0 : Point}
    (hE : LocalSegmentWithinAt E x0) :
    LocalSegmentWithinAt (IncrementDomain E x0) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  exact And.intro
    (by
      unfold IncrementDomain
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
      exact hE.left)
    (by
      cases hE.right with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          intro h hh hdistPos hdist
          have hhne : Not (h = RealTheory.zero) := by
            intro hzero
            rw [hzero, RealFunction.dist_self] at hdistPos
            exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.zero) hdistPos
          have hxne :
              Not (RealTheory.add x0 h = x0) :=
            incrementMap_ne_center_of_ne_zero hhne
          have hdistXPos :
              RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                (RealFunction.dist (RealTheory.add x0 h) x0) := by
            rwa [dist_incrementMap_zero x0 h]
          have hdistX :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealFunction.dist (RealTheory.add x0 h) x0)
                delta := by
            rwa [dist_incrementMap_zero x0 h]
          have hpack := hdelta.right
            (RealTheory.add x0 h) hh hdistXPos hdistX
          exact And.intro
            (by
              intro hpos y hy
              unfold IncrementDomain
              have hxpos :
                  RealTheory.lt x0 (RealTheory.add x0 h) := by
                have hlt := RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hpos x0
                rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at hlt
              exact hpack.left hxpos
                (RealTheory.add x0 y)
                (closedInterval_add_left_from_zero_right_for_peano hy))
            (by
              intro hneg y hy
              unfold IncrementDomain
              have hxneg :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add x0 h) x0 := by
                have hlt := RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hneg x0
                rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at hlt
              exact hpack.right hxneg
                (RealTheory.add x0 y)
                (closedInterval_add_left_to_zero_left_for_peano hy)))

name: peano_zero_over_incrementPower_succ_local
statement:
private theorem peano_zero_over_incrementPower_succ_local
    {E : Domain} {r r' : Map} {x0 : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hE : LocalSegmentWithinAt E x0)
    (hr0 : r x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hr : HasDerivativeWithinOn E r r')
    (hlim :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (r' x)
            (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPowerDerivative x0 n x)))
        x0
        RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (r x)
          (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x)))
      x0
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hlim eps heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases hE.right with
      | intro rho hrho =>
          let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F eta rho
          have hdeltaPos : F.lt F.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F heta.left hrho.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdeltaPos ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hxdEta : F.lt (RealFunction.dist x x0) eta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F eta rho)
          have hxdRho : F.lt (RealFunction.dist x x0) rho :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F eta rho)
          have hdistPos :
              F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.dist x x0) :=
            RealFunction.dist_pos_of_ne hxne
          have hpack := hrho.right x hx hdistPos hxdRho
          have hden :
              HasDerivativeWithinOn E
                (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1))
                (IncrementPowerDerivative x0 n) := by
            unfold IncrementPowerDerivative
            exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_incrementPower_succ E x0 n
          cases F.le_total x x0 with
          | inl hxx0 =>
              have hnot : Not (F.le x0 x) := by
                intro hx0x
                exact hxne (F.le_antisymm hxx0 hx0x)
              have hlt : F.lt x x0 :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxx0 hnot
              have hclosed :
                  forall y : Point,
                    RealTheory.ClosedInterval x x0 y -> E y :=
                hpack.right hlt
              have hopen :
                  forall y : Point,
                    RealTheory.OpenInterval x x0 y -> E y := by
                intro y hy
                exact hclosed y
                  (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval x x0 y hy)
              have hC :
                  CauchyConclusion x x0 r
                    (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1)) :=
                cauchy_mean_value_theorem x x0 r
                  (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1)) hlt
                  (peano_continuousOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_subset
                    hclosed hr)
                  (peano_continuousOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_subset
                    hclosed hden)
                  (peano_differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_derivative_subset
                    hopen hr)
                  (peano_differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_derivative_subset
                    hopen hden)
              have hEqExists := cauchyDerivativeEquality_of_cauchyConclusion hC
                (peano_hasDerivativeWithinOn_subset hopen hr)
                (peano_hasDerivativeWithinOn_subset hopen hden)
              cases hEqExists with
              | intro c hc =>
                  have hcE : E c :=
                    hclosed c
                      (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval x x0 c
                        hc.left)
                  have hcne : Not (c = x0) := by
                    intro hcx0
                    have hbad : F.lt x0 x0 := by
                      rw [hcx0] at hc
                      exact hc.left.right
                    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F x0) hbad
                  have hcdist : F.lt (RealFunction.dist c x0) eta :=
                    dist_openInterval_left_lt_of_endpoint_lt hc.left hxdEta
                  have hclose := heta.right c hcE hcne hcdist
                  have hquot :
                      RealTheory.mul
                          (r x)
                          (RealTheory.inv
                            (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x)) =
                        RealTheory.mul
                          (r' c)
                          (RealTheory.inv
                            (IncrementPowerDerivative x0 n c)) :=
                    quotient_eq_of_cauchy_zero_product_left_for_lhopital
                      hr0
                      (incrementPower_zero_at_center_succ x0 n)
                      (incrementPower_ne_zero_of_ne_center
                        hxne (n + 1))
                      (incrementPowerDerivative_ne_zero_of_ne_center
                        hcne n)
                      hc.right
                  change
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealFunction.dist
                        (RealTheory.mul
                          (r x)
                          (RealTheory.inv
                            (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x)))
                        RealTheory.zero)
                      eps
                  rw [hquot]
                  exact hclose
          | inr hx0x =>
              have hnot : Not (F.le x x0) := by
                intro hxx0
                exact hxne (F.le_antisymm hxx0 hx0x)
              have hlt : F.lt x0 x :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx0x hnot
              have hclosed :
                  forall y : Point,
                    RealTheory.ClosedInterval x0 x y -> E y :=
                hpack.left hlt
              have hopen :
                  forall y : Point,
                    RealTheory.OpenInterval x0 x y -> E y := by
                intro y hy
                exact hclosed y
                  (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval x0 x y hy)
              have hC :
                  CauchyConclusion x0 x r
                    (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1)) :=
                cauchy_mean_value_theorem x0 x r
                  (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1)) hlt
                  (peano_continuousOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_subset
                    hclosed hr)
                  (peano_continuousOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_subset
                    hclosed hden)
                  (peano_differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_derivative_subset
                    hopen hr)
                  (peano_differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_derivative_subset
                    hopen hden)
              have hEqExists := cauchyDerivativeEquality_of_cauchyConclusion hC
                (peano_hasDerivativeWithinOn_subset hopen hr)
                (peano_hasDerivativeWithinOn_subset hopen hden)
              cases hEqExists with
              | intro c hc =>
                  have hcE : E c :=
                    hclosed c
                      (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval x0 x c
                        hc.left)
                  have hcne : Not (c = x0) := by
                    intro hcx0
                    have hbad : F.lt x0 x0 := by
                      rw [hcx0] at hc
                      exact hc.left.left
                    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F x0) hbad
                  have hcdist : F.lt (RealFunction.dist c x0) eta :=
                    dist_openInterval_right_lt_of_endpoint_lt hc.left hxdEta
                  have hclose := heta.right c hcE hcne hcdist
                  have hquot :
                      RealTheory.mul
                          (r x)
                          (RealTheory.inv
                            (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x)) =
                        RealTheory.mul
                          (r' c)
                          (RealTheory.inv
                            (IncrementPowerDerivative x0 n c)) :=
                    quotient_eq_of_cauchy_zero_product_for_lhopital
                      hr0
                      (incrementPower_zero_at_center_succ x0 n)
                      (incrementPower_ne_zero_of_ne_center
                        hxne (n + 1))
                      (incrementPowerDerivative_ne_zero_of_ne_center
                        hcne n)
                      hc.right
                  change
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealFunction.dist
                        (RealTheory.mul
                          (r x)
                          (RealTheory.inv
                            (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x)))
                        RealTheory.zero)
                      eps
                  rw [hquot]
                  exact hclose

name: peano_zero_over_power_succ_local
statement:
private theorem peano_zero_over_power_succ_local
    {E : Domain} {r r' : Map} {x0 : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hE : LocalSegmentWithinAt E x0)
    (hr0 : r x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hr : HasDerivativeWithinOn E r r')
    (hlim :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (r' x)
            (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 n x)))
        x0
        RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (r x)
          (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x)))
      x0
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:=
  peano_zero_over_incrementPower_succ_local hE hr0 hr
    (tendstoWithin_incrementPowerDerivative_of_incrementPower hlim)

name: peano_hasDerivWithin_congr_limit
statement:
private theorem peano_hasDerivWithin_congr_limit
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 A B : Point}
    (hAB : A = B)
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 A) :
    HasDerivWithin E f x0 B
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hAB hf.right

name: peano_zero_over_id_of_hasDerivWithin_zero
statement:
private theorem peano_zero_over_id_of_hasDerivWithin_zero
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hf0 : f x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hf : HasDerivWithin E f x0 RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (f x)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub x x0)))
      x0
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := DifferenceQuotient f x0)
    (g := fun x : Point =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (f x)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub x x0)))
    ?_ hf.right
  intro x _hx _hxne
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold DifferenceQuotient
  rw [hf0]
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (f x) F.zero) (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) =
      F.mul (f x) (F.inv (F.sub x x0))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (f x)]

name: peano_zeroJet_one_of_hasDerivWithin_zero
statement:
private theorem peano_zeroJet_one_of_hasDerivWithin_zero
    {E : Domain} {r : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hr0 : r x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hr : HasDerivWithin E r x0 RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin
      (IncrementDomain E x0)
      (fun h : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
          (RealTheory.inv h))
      RealTheory.zero
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hbase :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (r x)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub x x0)))
        x0
        RealTheory.zero :=
    peano_zero_over_id_of_hasDerivWithin_zero hr0 hr
  have hpull :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        (IncrementDomain E x0)
        (fun h : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add x0 h) x0)))
        RealTheory.zero
        RealTheory.zero :=
    tendstoWithin_incrementDomain hbase
  refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (f := fun h : Point =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add x0 h) x0)))
    (g := fun h : Point =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
        (RealTheory.inv h))
    ?_ hpull
  intro h _hh _hhne
  change
    RealTheory.mul
        (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add x0 h) x0)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
        (RealTheory.inv h)
  rw [increment_sub_center x0 h]

name: peano_zeroJet_succ_local
statement:
private theorem peano_zeroJet_succ_local
    {E : Domain} {r : Map} {Dr : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point} :
    forall n : Nat,
      LocalSegmentWithinAt E x0 ->
        HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E r Dr (n + 1) ->
          E x0 ->
            (forall k : Nat, k <= n + 1 ->
              Dr k x0 = RealTheory.zero) ->
              RealFunction.TendstoWithin
                (IncrementDomain E x0)
                (fun h : Point =>
                  RealTheory.mul
                    (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
                    (RealTheory.inv
                      (RealFunction.powNat h (n + 1))))
                RealTheory.zero
                RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n generalizing r Dr with
  | zero =>
      intro _hE hD hx0 hzero
      have hr0 : r x0 = RealTheory.zero := by
        have hsame := hD.left x0 hx0
        have hz0 : Dr 0 x0 = RealTheory.zero :=
          hzero 0 (Nat.zero_le 1)
        rw [<- hsame]
        exact hz0
      have hstep :
          HasDerivativeWithinOn E (Dr 0) (Dr 1) :=
        hD.right 0 (Nat.succ_pos 0)
      have hrOn : HasDerivativeWithinOn E r (Dr 1) :=
        hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hD.left hstep
      have hrAt : HasDerivWithin E r x0 (Dr 1 x0) :=
        hrOn x0 hx0
      have hderivZero : HasDerivWithin E r x0 RealTheory.zero :=
        peano_hasDerivWithin_congr_limit
          (hzero 1 (Nat.le_refl 1)) hrAt
      have hbase := peano_zeroJet_one_of_hasDerivWithin_zero hr0 hderivZero
      refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
        (f := fun h : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
            (RealTheory.inv h))
        (g := fun h : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h (0 + 1))))
        ?_ hbase
      intro h _hh _hhne
      change
        RealTheory.mul
            (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
            (RealTheory.inv h) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h 1))
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_one]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro hE hD hx0 hzero
      have hr0 : r x0 = RealTheory.zero := by
        have hsame := hD.left x0 hx0
        have hz0 : Dr 0 x0 = RealTheory.zero :=
          hzero 0 (Nat.zero_le ((n + 1) + 1))
        rw [<- hsame]
        exact hz0
      have hstep0 :
          HasDerivativeWithinOn E (Dr 0) (Dr 1) :=
        hD.right 0 (Nat.succ_pos (n + 1))
      have hrOn : HasDerivativeWithinOn E r (Dr 1) :=
        hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hD.left hstep0
      have hDshift :
          HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E
            (Dr 1) (DerivativeChainShift Dr) (n + 1) :=
        hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_shift hD
      have hzeroShift :
          forall k : Nat, k <= n + 1 ->
            DerivativeChainShift Dr k x0 = RealTheory.zero := by
        intro k hk
        unfold DerivativeChainShift
        exact hzero (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hk)
      have hInd := ih hE hDshift hx0 hzeroShift
      have hIndForPullback :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin
            (IncrementDomain E x0)
            (fun h : Point =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (Dr 1 (RealTheory.add x0 h))
                (RealTheory.inv
                  (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1)
                    (RealTheory.add x0 h))))
            RealTheory.zero
            RealTheory.zero := by
        refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
          (f := fun h : Point =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (Dr 1 (RealTheory.add x0 h))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h (n + 1))))
          (g := fun h : Point =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (Dr 1 (RealTheory.add x0 h))
              (RealTheory.inv
                (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1)
                  (RealTheory.add x0 h))))
          ?_ hInd
        intro h _hh _hhne
        change
          RealTheory.mul
              (Dr 1 (RealTheory.add x0 h))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h (n + 1))) =
            RealTheory.mul
              (Dr 1 (RealTheory.add x0 h))
              (RealTheory.inv
                (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1)
                  (RealTheory.add x0 h)))
        unfold IncrementPower
        rw [increment_sub_center x0 h]
      have hlimX :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
            (fun x : Point =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (Dr 1 x)
                (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x)))
            x0
            RealTheory.zero :=
        tendstoWithin_of_incrementDomain hIndForPullback
      have hlocal :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
            (fun x : Point =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (r x)
                (RealTheory.inv
                  (IncrementPower x0 ((n + 1) + 1) x)))
            x0
            RealTheory.zero :=
        peano_zero_over_power_succ_local
          (n := n + 1) hE hr0 hrOn hlimX
      have hpull :
          RealFunction.TendstoWithin
            (IncrementDomain E x0)
            (fun h : Point =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
                (RealTheory.inv
                  (IncrementPower x0 ((n + 1) + 1)
                    (RealTheory.add x0 h))))
            RealTheory.zero
            RealTheory.zero :=
        tendstoWithin_incrementDomain hlocal
      refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
        (f := fun h : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (IncrementPower x0 ((n + 1) + 1)
                (RealTheory.add x0 h))))
        (g := fun h : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealFunction.powNat h ((n + 1) + 1))))
        ?_ hpull
      intro h _hh _hhne
      change
        RealTheory.mul
            (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (IncrementPower x0 ((n + 1) + 1)
                (RealTheory.add x0 h))) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (r (RealTheory.add x0 h))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealFunction.powNat h ((n + 1) + 1)))
      unfold IncrementPower
      rw [increment_sub_center x0 h]

name: taylorPeanoAt_zero_of_continuousAtOn
statement:
theorem taylorPeanoAt_zero_of_continuousAtOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hx0 : E x0)
    (hD0 : RealFunction.SameOn E (D 0) f)
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn E f x0) :
    TaylorPeanoAt E f D x0 0
proof:
:= by
  have hchain : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D 0 := by
    refine And.intro hD0 ?steps
    intro k hk
    exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk)
  refine And.intro ?approx ?limit
  case approx =>
    exact And.intro hx0 hchain
  case limit =>
    have hpull :
        RealFunction.TendstoWithin
          (IncrementDomain E x0)
          (fun h : Point => f (RealTheory.add x0 h))
          RealTheory.zero
          (f x0) :=
      tendstoWithin_incrementDomain hf.right
    have hconst :
        RealFunction.TendstoWithin
          (IncrementDomain E x0)
          (fun _ : Point => f x0)
          RealTheory.zero
          (f x0) :=
      RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
        (IncrementDomain E x0) (f x0) RealTheory.zero
    have hsub :
        RealFunction.TendstoWithin
          (IncrementDomain E x0)
          (RealFunction.SubFun
            (fun h : Point => f (RealTheory.add x0 h))
            (fun _ : Point => f x0))
          RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.sub (f x0) (f x0)) :=
      RealFunction.tendstoWithin_sub hpull hconst
    have hsubValue :
        RealTheory.sub (f x0) (f x0) = RealTheory.zero := by
      rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
      rw [RealTheory.add_neg]
    have hsubZero :
        RealFunction.TendstoWithin
          (IncrementDomain E x0)
          (RealFunction.SubFun
            (fun h : Point => f (RealTheory.add x0 h))
            (fun _ : Point => f x0))
          RealTheory.zero
          RealTheory.zero :=
      RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hsubValue hsub
    refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
      (f := RealFunction.SubFun
        (fun h : Point => f (RealTheory.add x0 h))
        (fun _ : Point => f x0))
      (g := TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 0)
      ?_ hsubZero
    intro h _hh _hhne
    change
      RealTheory.sub (f (RealTheory.add x0 h)) (f x0) =
        TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 0 h
    rw [TaylorRemainderRatio_zero_order]
    unfold TaylorRemainder IncrementLift IncrementMap
    rw [TaylorPolynomial_zero]
    rw [hD0 x0 hx0]

name: taylorPeanoAt_succ_of_derivativeChain_local
statement:
theorem taylorPeanoAt_succ_of_derivativeChain_local
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x0 : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D n)
    (hE : LocalSegmentWithinAt E x0) :
    TaylorPeanoAt E f D x0 n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hn)
  | succ m =>
      have hx0 : E x0 := hE.left
      refine And.intro ?approx ?limit
      case approx =>
        exact And.intro hx0 hD
      case limit =>
        let H := IncrementDomain E x0
        let R := TaylorRemainder D f x0 (m + 1)
        let DR := TaylorRemainderRows D x0 (m + 1)
        have hHlocal : LocalSegmentWithinAt H RealTheory.zero := by
          unfold H
          exact localSegmentWithinAt_incrementDomain hE
        have hRChain : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn H R DR (m + 1) := by
          unfold H R DR
          exact taylorRemainder_chain (m + 1) hD
        have hHzero : H RealTheory.zero := by
          unfold H IncrementDomain
          rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
          exact hx0
        have hRZero :
            forall k : Nat, k <= m + 1 -> DR k RealTheory.zero =
              RealTheory.zero := by
          intro k hk
          unfold DR
          exact taylorRemainder_zeroJet_at_center
            (m + 1) hD hx0 k hk
        have hZeroJet :
            RealFunction.TendstoWithin
              (IncrementDomain H RealTheory.zero)
              (fun h : Point =>
                RealTheory.mul
                  (R (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero h))
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h (m + 1))))
              RealTheory.zero
              RealTheory.zero :=
          peano_zeroJet_succ_local
            (E := H) (r := R) (Dr := DR) (x0 := RealTheory.zero)
            m hHlocal hRChain hHzero hRZero
        have hOnH :
            RealFunction.TendstoWithin H
              (fun h : Point =>
                RealTheory.mul
                  (R (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero h))
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h (m + 1))))
              RealTheory.zero
              RealTheory.zero :=
          tendstoWithin_of_subset
            (E := IncrementDomain H RealTheory.zero)
            (G := H)
            (fun h hh => by
              unfold IncrementDomain
              rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
              exact hh)
            hZeroJet
        refine RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
          (f := fun h : Point =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (R (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero h))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h (m + 1))))
          (g := TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 (m + 1))
          ?_ hOnH
        intro h _hh _hhne
        unfold R
        change
          RealTheory.mul
              (TaylorRemainder D f x0 (m + 1)
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero h))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat h (m + 1))) =
            TaylorRemainderRatio D f x0 (m + 1) h
        rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
        rfl

name: lhopital_zero_over_incrementPower_succ_right
statement:
theorem lhopital_zero_over_incrementPower_succ_right
    {E : Domain} {r r' : Map} {x0 : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hE : LocalSegmentWithinAt E x0)
    (hr0 : r x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hr : HasDerivativeWithinOn E r r')
    (hlim :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (r' x)
            (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPowerDerivative x0 n x)))
        x0
        RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
      E
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (r x)
          (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x)))
      x0
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hlim eps heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases hE.right with
      | intro rho hrho =>
          let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F eta rho
          have hdelta_pos : F.lt F.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F heta.left hrho.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta_pos ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hxd_eta : F.lt (RealFunction.dist x x0) eta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F eta rho)
          have hxd_rho : F.lt (RealFunction.dist x x0) rho :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F eta rho)
          have hx0x : RealTheory.lt x0 x := hx.right
          have hclosed :
              forall y : Point,
                RealTheory.ClosedInterval x0 x y -> E y :=
            (hrho.right x hx.left
              (RealFunction.dist_pos_of_ne hxne) hxd_rho).left hx0x
          have hopen :
              forall y : Point,
                RealTheory.OpenInterval x0 x y -> E y := by
            intro y hy
            exact hclosed y
              (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval x0 x y hy)
          have hden :
              HasDerivativeWithinOn E
                (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1))
                (IncrementPowerDerivative x0 n) := by
            unfold IncrementPowerDerivative
            exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_incrementPower_succ E x0 n
          have hC : CauchyConclusion x0 x r (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1)) :=
            cauchy_mean_value_theorem x0 x r
              (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1)) hx0x
              (RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hclosed
                (continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn hr))
              (RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hclosed
                (continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn hden))
              (differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn_subset
                hopen hr)
              (differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn_subset
                hopen hden)
          have hEqExists :
              Exists
                (fun c : Point =>
                  RealTheory.OpenInterval x0 x c /\
                    RealTheory.mul
                        (RealTheory.sub
                          (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x)
                          (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x0))
                        (r' c) =
                      RealTheory.mul
                        (RealTheory.sub (r x) (r x0))
                        (IncrementPowerDerivative x0 n c)) :=
            cauchyDerivativeEquality_of_cauchyConclusion hC
              (fun y hy =>
                hasDerivWithin_subset hopen hy (hr y (hopen y hy)))
              (fun y hy =>
                hasDerivWithin_subset hopen hy (hden y (hopen y hy)))
          cases hEqExists with
          | intro c hc =>
              have hcE : E c :=
                hclosed c
                  (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval x0 x c
                    hc.left)
              have hcne : Not (c = x0) := by
                intro hcx0
                have hbad : RealTheory.lt x0 x0 := by
                  rw [hcx0] at hc
                  exact hc.left.left
                exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F x0) hbad
              have hcdist :
                  F.lt (RealFunction.dist c x0) eta :=
                dist_openInterval_right_lt_of_endpoint_lt
                  hc.left hxd_eta
              have hclose :=
                heta.right c hcE hcne hcdist
              have hquot :
                  RealTheory.mul
                      (r x)
                      (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x)) =
                    RealTheory.mul
                      (r' c)
                      (RealTheory.inv
                        (IncrementPowerDerivative x0 n c)) :=
                quotient_eq_of_cauchy_zero_product_for_lhopital
                  hr0
                  (incrementPower_zero_at_center_succ x0 n)
                  (incrementPower_ne_zero_of_ne_center hxne (n + 1))
                  (incrementPowerDerivative_ne_zero_of_ne_center hcne n)
                  hc.right
              change
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealFunction.dist
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (r x)
                      (RealTheory.inv
                        (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x)))
                    RealTheory.zero)
                  eps
              rw [hquot]
              exact hclose

name: lhopital_zero_over_power_succ_local
statement:
theorem lhopital_zero_over_power_succ_local
    {E : Domain} {r r' : Map} {x0 : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hE : LocalSegmentWithinAt E x0)
    (hr0 : r x0 = RealTheory.zero)
    (hr : HasDerivativeWithinOn E r r')
    (hlim :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (r' x)
            (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 n x)))
        x0
        RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (r x)
          (RealTheory.inv (IncrementPower x0 (n + 1) x)))
      x0
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hL := lhopital_zero_over_power_succ_left hE hr0 hr hlim
  have hR := lhopital_zero_over_power_succ_right hE hr0 hr hlim
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hL eps heps with
  | intro deltaL hdeltaL =>
      cases hR eps heps with
      | intro deltaR hdeltaR =>
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaL deltaR
          have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
              F hdeltaL.left hdeltaR.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta ?_
          intro y hy hyne hyd
          have hydL : F.lt (RealFunction.dist y x0) deltaL :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hyd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F deltaL deltaR)
          have hydR : F.lt (RealFunction.dist y x0) deltaR :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hyd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F deltaL deltaR)
          cases F.le_total y x0 with
          | inl hyx =>
              by_cases hxy : F.le x0 y
              case pos =>
                have hy_eq : y = x0 := F.le_antisymm hyx hxy
                exact False.elim (hyne hy_eq)
              case neg =>
                have hy_lt : F.lt y x0 :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyx hxy
                exact hdeltaL.right y
                  (And.intro hy hy_lt) hyne hydL
          | inr hxy =>
              by_cases hyx : F.le y x0
              case pos =>
                have hy_eq : y = x0 := F.le_antisymm hyx hxy
                exact False.elim (hyne hy_eq)
              case neg =>
                have hx_lt : F.lt x0 y :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hyx
                exact hdeltaR.right y
                  (And.intro hy hx_lt) hyne hydR
