name: abs_stieltjesIncrement_sub_derivative_tag_mul_cellLength_le_of_pairwise
statement:
private theorem abs_stieltjesIncrement_sub_derivative_tag_mul_cellLength_le_of_pairwise
    {alpha alpha' : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point} {tag eta : Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n)
    (htag : PartitionCell p k tag)
    (halphaCont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (p k) (p (k + 1))) alpha)
    (hderiv :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)) x ->
          RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
            (RealTheory.OpenInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)))
            alpha x (alpha' x))
    (hosc :
      forall x y : Point,
        PartitionCell p k x ->
        PartitionCell p k y ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (alpha' x) (alpha' y)))
            eta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)
          (RealTheory.mul (alpha' tag) (cellLength p k))))
      (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hstep : RealTheory.le (p k) (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_step_le hp hk
  by_cases hlt : RealTheory.lt (p k) (p (k + 1))
  · have hdiff :
        RealDerivative.DifferentiableOnOpenInterval
          (p k) (p (k + 1)) alpha := by
      intro x hx
      exact Exists.intro (alpha' x) (hderiv x hx)
    cases
        RealDerivative.lagrange_mean_value_theorem
          (p k) (p (k + 1)) alpha hlt halphaCont hdiff with
    | intro c hc =>
        have hcCell : PartitionCell p k c := by
          unfold PartitionCell
          exact RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval
            (p k) (p (k + 1)) c hc.left
        have hsec_eq :
            RealDerivative.SecantSlope alpha (p k) (p (k + 1)) =
              alpha' c :=
          RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
            (openInterval_clusterPoint_for_reduction hc.left)
            hc.right
            (hderiv c hc.left)
        have hinc_eq :
            stieltjesIncrement alpha p k =
              RealTheory.mul (alpha' c) (cellLength p k) := by
          unfold stieltjesIncrement cellLength
          have hsec :
              RealTheory.mul
                  (RealDerivative.SecantSlope alpha (p k) (p (k + 1)))
                  (RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k)) =
                RealTheory.sub (alpha (p (k + 1))) (alpha (p k)) :=
            RealDerivative.secantSlope_mul_intervalLength
              (f := alpha) hlt
          calc
            RealTheory.sub (alpha (p (k + 1))) (alpha (p k)) =
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealDerivative.SecantSlope alpha (p k) (p (k + 1)))
                  (RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k)) := by
                  exact Eq.symm hsec
            _ = RealTheory.mul (alpha' c)
                  (RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k)) := by
                  rw [hsec_eq]
        have hcellOsc :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub (alpha' c) (alpha' tag)))
              eta :=
          hosc c tag hcCell htag
        have hlen_nonneg :
            RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (cellLength p k) :=
          RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength_nonnegative hp hk
        rw [hinc_eq]
        change
          F.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (F.sub
                (F.mul (alpha' c) (cellLength p k))
                (F.mul (alpha' tag) (cellLength p k))))
            (F.mul eta (cellLength p k))
        rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
          F (alpha' c) (alpha' tag) (cellLength p k)]
        rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
        rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hlen_nonneg]
        exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hcellOsc hlen_nonneg
  · have hright_left : RealTheory.le (p (k + 1)) (p k) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hlt
    have heq : p (k + 1) = p k :=
      RealTheory.le_antisymm hright_left hstep
    have hinc_zero :
        stieltjesIncrement alpha p k = RealTheory.zero := by
      unfold stieltjesIncrement
      rw [heq]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F (alpha (p k))
    have hlen_zero :
        cellLength p k = RealTheory.zero := by
      unfold cellLength
      rw [heq]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F (p k)
    rw [hinc_zero, hlen_zero]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_zero (alpha' tag)]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_zero eta]
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub
            RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero))
        RealTheory.zero
    rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_self RealTheory.zero]
    exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero

name: abs_stieltjesTagSum_sub_riemannTaggedSum_le_bound_mul_oscillation_mul_length
statement:
private theorem abs_stieltjesTagSum_sub_riemannTaggedSum_le_bound_mul_oscillation_mul_length
    {f alpha alpha' : Point -> Point} {a b B eta : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hB :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) B)
    (heta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta)
    (halphaCont :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (p k) (p (k + 1))) alpha)
    (hderiv :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        forall x : Point,
          RealTheory.OpenInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)) x ->
            RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
              (RealTheory.OpenInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)))
              alpha x (alpha' x))
    (hosc :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        forall x y : Point,
          PartitionCell p k x ->
          PartitionCell p k y ->
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (alpha' x) (alpha' y)))
              eta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n)
          (Riemann.taggedSum (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') p tag n)))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul B eta) (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let err := fun k : Nat =>
    RealTheory.sub
      (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)
      (RealTheory.mul (alpha' (tag k)) (cellLength p k))
  let diff := fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (err k)
  have hsum_eq :
      RealTheory.sub
          (stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n)
          (Riemann.taggedSum (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') p tag n) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum diff n := by
    unfold stieltjesTagSum weightedTagSum Riemann.taggedSum
      RealFunction.MulFun
    change
      RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul (f (tag k))
                (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
            n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (alpha' (tag k)))
                (cellLength p k))
            n) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum diff n
    rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_sub
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (alpha' (tag k)))
          (cellLength p k))
      n]
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro k
    unfold diff err
    change
      F.sub
          (F.mul (f (tag k)) (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (f (tag k)) (alpha' (tag k)))
            (cellLength p k)) =
        F.mul (f (tag k))
          (F.sub
            (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)
            (F.mul (alpha' (tag k)) (cellLength p k)))
    rw [F.mul_assoc
      (f (tag k)) (alpha' (tag k)) (cellLength p k)]
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
      F (f (tag k)) (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)
        (F.mul (alpha' (tag k)) (cellLength p k))]
  rw [hsum_eq]
  refine RealTheory.le_trans
    (RealTheory.abs_finiteSum_le_finiteSum_abs diff n) ?_
  have hpoint :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs (diff k))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul B eta) (cellLength p k)) := by
    intro k hk
    have htagCell : PartitionCell p k (tag k) :=
      taggedPartition_tag_mem_cell htag hk
    have htagClosed :
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (tag k) :=
      RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_tag_mem_closedInterval
        htag hk
    have hfB :
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f (tag k))) B :=
      hB (tag k) htagClosed
    have hlen_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (cellLength p k) :=
      RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength_nonnegative htag.left hk
    have hcell_raw :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)
              (RealTheory.mul (alpha' (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
          (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k)) :=
      abs_stieltjesIncrement_sub_derivative_tag_mul_cellLength_le_of_pairwise
        htag.left hk htagCell (halphaCont k hk)
        (fun x hx => hderiv k hk x hx)
        (hosc k hk)
    have hcell :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs (err k))
          (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k)) := by
      unfold err
      exact hcell_raw
    unfold diff
    change
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs (F.mul (f (tag k)) (err k)))
        (F.mul (F.mul B eta) (cellLength p k))
    rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
    have hleft :
        F.le
          (F.mul (RealTheory.abs (f (tag k)))
            (RealTheory.abs (err k)))
          (F.mul (RealTheory.abs (f (tag k)))
            (F.mul eta (cellLength p k))) :=
      RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
        hcell (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f (tag k)))
    have heta_len_nonneg :
        F.le F.zero (F.mul eta (cellLength p k)) :=
      RealTheory.mul_nonneg heta_nonneg hlen_nonneg
    have hright :
        F.le
          (F.mul (RealTheory.abs (f (tag k)))
            (F.mul eta (cellLength p k)))
          (F.mul B (F.mul eta (cellLength p k))) :=
      RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hfB heta_len_nonneg
    have hmul_bound :
        F.le
          (F.mul (RealTheory.abs (f (tag k)))
            (RealTheory.abs (err k)))
          (F.mul B (F.mul eta (cellLength p k))) :=
      RealTheory.le_trans hleft hright
    rw [<- F.mul_assoc B eta (cellLength p k)] at hmul_bound
    exact hmul_bound
  have hsum_bound :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.abs (diff k)) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul B eta) (cellLength p k)) n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.abs (diff k))
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul B eta) (cellLength p k))
      n hpoint
  refine RealTheory.le_trans hsum_bound ?_
  have hconst :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul B eta) (cellLength p k)) n =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul B eta)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum (cellLength p) n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left
      (RealTheory.mul B eta) (cellLength p) n
  rw [hconst]
  rw [RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_finiteSum_cellLength
    htag.left]
  exact
    RealTheory.le_refl
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul B eta) (RealTheory.sub b a))

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_hasRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_hasRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative
    {f alpha alpha' : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hbdd : Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hri :
      Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral
        (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') a b I)
    (halpha :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha)
    (halpha' :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha')
    (hderiv :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
            (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) alpha x (alpha' x)) :
    HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab_le : RealTheory.le a b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab
  refine And.intro hab_le ?_
  intro eps heps baseCount base hbase
  cases hbdd with
  | intro B hB =>
      let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
      have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
      have hlength_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hab_le
      have hscale_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.mul B (RealTheory.sub b a)) :=
        RealTheory.mul_nonneg hB.left hlength_nonneg
      cases
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F
            (RealTheory.mul B (RealTheory.sub b a)) he2_pos with
      | intro eta heta =>
          have heta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heta.left
          have hcomparison_budget :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul B eta) (RealTheory.sub b a))
                e2 := by
            have hbudget := heta.right
            change
              F.lt (F.mul (F.abs (F.mul B (F.sub b a))) eta) e2
                at hbudget
            have hscale_nonneg' :
                F.le F.zero (F.mul B (F.sub b a)) := by
              exact hscale_nonneg
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hscale_nonneg']
              at hbudget
            rw [F.mul_assoc B (F.sub b a) eta] at hbudget
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub b a) eta] at hbudget
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc B eta (F.sub b a)] at hbudget
            exact hbudget
          have halpha'_uc :
              RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha' :=
            RealFunction.continuousOn_compact_uniformContinuousOn.{0}
              (RealFunction.closedInterval_compact.{0} hab_le)
              halpha'
          cases halpha'_uc eta heta.left with
          | intro deltaUC hdeltaUC =>
              cases hri.right e2 he2_pos with
              | intro deltaRI hdeltaRI =>
                  let deltaMesh := RealTheory.min deltaRI deltaUC
                  have hdeltaMesh_pos :
                      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero deltaMesh :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_min2 F
                      hdeltaRI.left hdeltaUC.left
                  cases
                      RealFunction.IntervalPartition.exists_threshold_refinement_mesh_lt
                        hab_le hdeltaMesh_pos hbase with
                  | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
                      cases hthresholdCount with
                      | intro threshold hthreshold =>
                          refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
                          refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
                          refine And.intro hthreshold.left ?_
                          refine And.intro hthreshold.right.left ?_
                          intro n p tag htag href
                          have hmeshMin :
                              RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaMesh :=
                            hthreshold.right.right n p tag htag href
                          have hmeshRI :
                              RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaRI :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                              hmeshMin
                              (RealTheory.min_le_left deltaRI deltaUC)
                          have hmeshUC :
                              RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaUC :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                              hmeshMin
                              (RealTheory.min_le_right deltaRI deltaUC)
                          let rs := stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n
                          let ri :=
                            Riemann.taggedSum
                              (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') p tag n
                          have hri_close :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub ri I)) e2 := by
                            dsimp [ri]
                            exact hdeltaRI.right n p tag htag hmeshRI
                          have halphaCell :
                              forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                                RealFunction.ContinuousOn
                                  (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
                                    (p k) (p (k + 1))) alpha := by
                            intro k hk
                            exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
                              (fun x hx =>
                                RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
                                  htag.left hk hx)
                              halpha
                          have hderivCell :
                              forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                                forall x : Point,
                                  RealTheory.OpenInterval
                                      (p k) (p (k + 1)) x ->
                                    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
                                      (RealTheory.OpenInterval
                                        (p k) (p (k + 1)))
                                      alpha x (alpha' x) := by
                            intro k hk x hx
                            have hleftClosed :
                                RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
                              RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
                                htag.left hk
                            have hrightClosed :
                                RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
                              RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
                                htag.left hk
                            have hxGlobal :
                                RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x := by
                              refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                              · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                  F hleftClosed.left hx.left
                              · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                                  F hx.right hrightClosed.right
                            exact
                              hasDerivWithin_subset_for_reduction
                                (fun y hy => by
                                  have hyLeftClosed :
                                      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
                                        (p k) :=
                                    RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
                                      htag.left hk
                                  have hyRightClosed :
                                      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
                                        (p (k + 1)) :=
                                    RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
                                      htag.left hk
                                  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                                  · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                      F hyLeftClosed.left hy.left
                                  · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                                      F hy.right hyRightClosed.right)
                                hx (hderiv x hxGlobal)
                          have hoscCell :
                              forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                                forall x y : Point,
                                  PartitionCell p k x ->
                                  PartitionCell p k y ->
                                    RealTheory.le
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (RealTheory.sub
                                          (alpha' x) (alpha' y)))
                                      eta := by
                            intro k hk x y hx hy
                            have hxClosed :
                                RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
                              RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
                                htag.left hk hx
                            have hyClosed :
                                RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y :=
                              RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
                                htag.left hk hy
                            have hdist_len :
                                RealTheory.le
                                  (RealFunction.dist x y)
                                  (cellLength p k) := by
                              change
                                F.le
                                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x y)
                                  (cellLength p k)
                              exact
                                RealFunction.IntervalPartition.dist_le_cellLength_of_partitionCell
                                  hx hy
                            have hlen_mesh :
                                RealTheory.le (cellLength p k) (mesh p n) :=
                              RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength_le_mesh
                                p n k hk
                            have hdist_mesh :
                                RealTheory.le
                                  (RealFunction.dist x y) (mesh p n) :=
                              RealTheory.le_trans hdist_len hlen_mesh
                            have hdist_delta :
                                RealTheory.lt
                                  (RealFunction.dist x y) deltaUC :=
                              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                                hdist_mesh hmeshUC
                            have huc_close :
                                RealTheory.lt
                                  (RealFunction.dist
                                    (alpha' x) (alpha' y)) eta :=
                              hdeltaUC.right x y hxClosed hyClosed
                                hdist_delta
                            have huc_abs :
                                RealTheory.lt
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (RealTheory.sub
                                      (alpha' x) (alpha' y))) eta := by
                              unfold RealFunction.dist at huc_close
                              change
                                F.lt
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (F.sub (alpha' x) (alpha' y)))
                                  eta at huc_close
                              exact huc_close
                            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F huc_abs
                          have hcomparison_le :
                              RealTheory.le
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub rs ri))
                                (RealTheory.mul
                                  (RealTheory.mul B eta)
                                  (RealTheory.sub b a)) := by
                            dsimp [rs, ri]
                            exact
                              abs_stieltjesTagSum_sub_riemannTaggedSum_le_bound_mul_oscillation_mul_length
                                htag hB.right heta_nonneg
                                halphaCell hderivCell hoscCell
                          have hcomparison_lt :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub rs ri)) e2 :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                              hcomparison_le hcomparison_budget
                          have htri :
                              RealTheory.le
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub rs I))
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (RealTheory.sub rs ri))
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (RealTheory.sub ri I))) := by
                            exact RealFunction.dist_triangle rs ri I
                          have hsum :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (RealTheory.sub rs ri))
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (RealTheory.sub ri I))) eps := by
                            have hadd :=
                              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
                                hcomparison_lt hri_close
                            change
                              F.lt
                                (F.add
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (F.sub rs ri))
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (F.sub ri I)))
                                (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                            rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps]
                              at hadd
                          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                            F htri hsum

name: hasRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
    {f alpha alpha' : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hbdd : Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hrs : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (halpha :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha)
    (halpha' :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha')
    (hderiv :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
            (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) alpha x (alpha' x)) :
    Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral
      (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') a b I
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let g := RealFunction.MulFun f alpha'
  have hab_le : RealTheory.le a b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab
  cases hbdd with
  | intro B hB =>
      have hbdd_f : Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
        Exists.intro B hB
      have halpha'_boundedOn :
          RealFunction.BoundedOn
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha' :=
        RealFunction.continuousOn_closedInterval_bounded
          hab_le halpha'
      have halpha'_bdd :
          Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded alpha' a b := by
        cases halpha'_boundedOn with
        | intro left hleft =>
            cases hleft with
            | intro right hbounds =>
                let M :=
                  RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.abs left) (RealTheory.abs right)
                have hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M := by
                  dsimp [M]
                  have hsum :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
                      F
                      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg left)
                      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg right)
                  change
                    F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero)
                      (F.add
                        (RealTheory.abs left)
                        (RealTheory.abs right)) at hsum
                  rwa [F.add_zero] at hsum
                apply Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le hM_nonneg
                intro x hx
                have hxr := (hbounds x hx).right
                have hlx := (hbounds x hx).left
                have hleft_le_abs_left :
                    F.le left (RealTheory.abs left) :=
                  RealTheory.le_abs_self left
                have hright_le_abs_right :
                    F.le right (RealTheory.abs right) :=
                  RealTheory.le_abs_self right
                have h_abs_left_le_M :
                    F.le (RealTheory.abs left) M := by
                  dsimp [M]
                  have hnonneg :
                      F.le F.zero (RealTheory.abs right) :=
                    RealTheory.abs_nonneg right
                  have h :=
                    F.add_le_add_left hnonneg (RealTheory.abs left)
                  rwa [F.add_zero] at h
                have h_abs_right_le_M :
                    F.le (RealTheory.abs right) M := by
                  dsimp [M]
                  have hnonneg :
                      F.le F.zero (RealTheory.abs left) :=
                    RealTheory.abs_nonneg left
                  have h :=
                    F.add_le_add_right hnonneg (RealTheory.abs right)
                  rwa [F.zero_add] at h
                have hx_le_M :
                    F.le (alpha' x) M :=
                  F.le_trans hxr
                    (F.le_trans hright_le_abs_right h_abs_right_le_M)
                have hneg_x_le_M :
                    F.le (F.neg (alpha' x)) M := by
                  have hneg_left_le_neg_x :
                      F.le (F.neg (alpha' x)) (F.neg left) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hlx
                  have hneg_left_le_abs_left :
                      F.le (F.neg left) (RealTheory.abs left) :=
                    RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self left
                  exact F.le_trans hneg_left_le_neg_x
                    (F.le_trans hneg_left_le_abs_left h_abs_left_le_M)
                exact RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hx_le_M hneg_x_le_M
      have hg_bdd : Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded g a b := by
        dsimp [g]
        exact Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_mul hbdd_f halpha'_bdd
      have hcompare :
          forall {eta delta : Point} {n : Nat}
              {p tag : Nat -> Point},
            RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta ->
            (forall x y : Point,
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y ->
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x y) delta ->
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealFunction.dist (alpha' x) (alpha' y)) eta) ->
            TaggedPartition a b n p tag ->
            RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta ->
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n)
                    (Riemann.taggedSum g p tag n)))
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul B eta) (RealTheory.sub b a)) := by
        intro eta delta n p tag heta_nonneg huc htag hmesh
        have halphaCell :
            forall k : Nat, k < n ->
              RealFunction.ContinuousOn
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (p k) (p (k + 1))) alpha := by
          intro k hk
          exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
            (fun x hx =>
              RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
                htag.left hk hx)
            halpha
        have hderivCell :
            forall k : Nat, k < n ->
              forall x : Point,
                RealTheory.OpenInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)) x ->
                  RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
                    (RealTheory.OpenInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)))
                    alpha x (alpha' x) := by
          intro k hk x hx
          have hleftClosed :
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
            RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
              htag.left hk
          have hrightClosed :
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
            RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
              htag.left hk
          have hxGlobal : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x := by
            refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                F hleftClosed.left hx.left
            · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                F hx.right hrightClosed.right
          exact
            hasDerivWithin_subset_for_reduction
              (fun y hy => by
                have hyLeftClosed :
                    RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
                  RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
                    htag.left hk
                have hyRightClosed :
                    RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
                  RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
                    htag.left hk
                refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                    F hyLeftClosed.left hy.left
                · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                    F hy.right hyRightClosed.right)
              hx (hderiv x hxGlobal)
        have hoscCell :
            forall k : Nat, k < n ->
              forall x y : Point,
                PartitionCell p k x ->
                PartitionCell p k y ->
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (RealTheory.sub (alpha' x) (alpha' y))) eta := by
          intro k hk x y hx hy
          have hxClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
            RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
              htag.left hk hx
          have hyClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y :=
            RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
              htag.left hk hy
          have hdist_len :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealFunction.dist x y) (cellLength p k) :=
            RealFunction.IntervalPartition.dist_le_cellLength_of_partitionCell
              hx hy
          have hlen_mesh :
              RealTheory.le (cellLength p k) (mesh p n) :=
            RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength_le_mesh p n k hk
          have hdist_delta :
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x y) delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
              (RealTheory.le_trans hdist_len hlen_mesh) hmesh
          have hclose := huc x y hxClosed hyClosed hdist_delta
          unfold RealFunction.dist at hclose
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hclose
        dsimp [g]
        exact
          abs_stieltjesTagSum_sub_riemannTaggedSum_le_bound_mul_oscillation_mul_length
            htag hB.right heta_nonneg halphaCell hderivCell hoscCell
      have hrefinementClose :
          forall eps : Point,
            RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
            forall (baseCount : Nat) (base : Nat -> Point),
              IntervalPartition a b baseCount base ->
                ∃ thresholdCount threshold,
                  IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount threshold ∧
                    PartitionRefines
                      threshold thresholdCount base baseCount ∧
                      forall (n : Nat) (p tag : Nat -> Point),
                        TaggedPartition a b n p tag ->
                        PartitionRefines
                          p n threshold thresholdCount ->
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub
                                (Riemann.taggedSum g p tag n) I))
                            eps := by
        intro eps heps baseCount base hbase
        let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
        have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
        have hlength_nonneg :
            RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hab_le
        have hscale_nonneg :
            RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
              (RealTheory.mul B (RealTheory.sub b a)) :=
          RealTheory.mul_nonneg hB.left hlength_nonneg
        cases
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F
              (RealTheory.mul B (RealTheory.sub b a)) he2_pos with
        | intro eta heta =>
            have heta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heta.left
            have hcomparison_budget :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.mul B eta) (RealTheory.sub b a))
                  e2 := by
              have hbudget := heta.right
              change
                F.lt
                  (F.mul (F.abs (F.mul B (F.sub b a))) eta) e2
                  at hbudget
              have hscale_nonneg' :
                  F.le F.zero (F.mul B (F.sub b a)) := by
                exact hscale_nonneg
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hscale_nonneg']
                at hbudget
              rw [F.mul_assoc B (F.sub b a) eta] at hbudget
              rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub b a) eta] at hbudget
              rw [<- F.mul_assoc B eta (F.sub b a)] at hbudget
              exact hbudget
            have halpha'_uc :
                RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn
                  (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha' :=
              RealFunction.continuousOn_compact_uniformContinuousOn.{0}
                (RealFunction.closedInterval_compact.{0} hab_le) halpha'
            cases halpha'_uc eta heta.left with
            | intro deltaUC hdeltaUC =>
                cases
                    RealFunction.IntervalPartition.exists_threshold_refinement_mesh_lt
                      hab_le hdeltaUC.left hbase with
                | intro fineCount hfineCount =>
                    cases hfineCount with
                    | intro fine hfine =>
                        cases hrs.right e2 he2_pos fineCount fine hfine.left with
                        | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
                            cases hthresholdCount with
                            | intro threshold hthreshold =>
                                refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
                                refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
                                refine And.intro hthreshold.left ?_
                                refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                                · exact partitionRefines_trans
                                    hthreshold.right.left hfine.right.left
                                · intro n p tag htag href
                                  have hrefFine :
                                      PartitionRefines p n fine fineCount :=
                                    partitionRefines_trans
                                      href hthreshold.right.left
                                  have hmeshUC :
                                      RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaUC :=
                                    hfine.right.right n p tag htag hrefFine
                                  let rs :=
                                    stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n
                                  let ri := Riemann.taggedSum g p tag n
                                  have hrs_close :
                                      RealTheory.lt
                                        (RealTheory.abs
                                          (RealTheory.sub rs I)) e2 := by
                                    dsimp [rs]
                                    exact hthreshold.right.right
                                      n p tag htag href
                                  have hcomparison_le :
                                      RealTheory.le
                                        (RealTheory.abs
                                          (RealTheory.sub rs ri))
                                        (RealTheory.mul
                                          (RealTheory.mul B eta)
                                          (RealTheory.sub b a)) := by
                                    dsimp [rs, ri]
                                    exact hcompare
                                      heta_nonneg hdeltaUC.right htag hmeshUC
                                  have hcomparison_lt :
                                      RealTheory.lt
                                        (RealTheory.abs
                                          (RealTheory.sub rs ri)) e2 :=
                                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                      F hcomparison_le hcomparison_budget
                                  have htri :
                                      RealTheory.le
                                        (RealTheory.abs
                                          (RealTheory.sub ri I))
                                        (RealTheory.add
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub rs ri))
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub rs I))) := by
                                    change
                                      F.le
                                        (RealFunction.dist ri I)
                                        (F.add
                                          (RealFunction.dist rs ri)
                                          (RealFunction.dist rs I))
                                    rw [RealFunction.dist_comm rs ri]
                                    exact RealFunction.dist_triangle ri rs I
                                  have hsum :
                                      RealTheory.lt
                                        (RealTheory.add
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub rs ri))
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub rs I)))
                                        eps := by
                                    have hadd :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                                        F hcomparison_lt hrs_close
                                    change
                                      F.lt
                                        (F.add
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (F.sub rs ri))
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (F.sub rs I)))
                                        (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                                    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                                      F eps] at hadd
                                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                    F htri hsum
      have hrefinementIntegral :
          Riemann.HasRefinementRiemannIntegral g a b I :=
        And.intro hab_le hrefinementClose
      exact Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_of_hasRefinementRiemannIntegral
        hg_bdd hrefinementIntegral

name: hasRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_le
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_le
    {f alpha alpha' : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hbdd : Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hrs : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (halpha :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha)
    (halpha' :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha')
    (hderiv :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
            (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) alpha x (alpha' x)) :
    Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral
      (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') a b I
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hab_eq : a = b
  · subst b
    have hIzero : I = RealTheory.zero :=
      hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate hrs
    rw [hIzero]
    exact Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_degenerate
      (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') a
  · have hba_not : Not (RealTheory.le b a) := by
      intro hba
      exact hab_eq (RealTheory.le_antisymm hab hba)
    have hab_lt : RealTheory.lt a b :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hab hba_not
    exact
      hasRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
        hab_lt hbdd hrs halpha halpha' hderiv

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative_of_hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative_of_hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
    {f alpha alpha' : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hbdd :
      Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded f
        (RealTheory.min a b) (RealTheory.max a b))
    (hrs : HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (halpha :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.min a b) (RealTheory.max a b)) alpha)
    (halpha' :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.min a b) (RealTheory.max a b)) alpha')
    (hderiv :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval
            (RealTheory.min a b) (RealTheory.max a b) x ->
          RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
            (RealTheory.OpenInterval
              (RealTheory.min a b) (RealTheory.max a b))
            alpha x (alpha' x)) :
    Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') a b I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hab : RealTheory.le a b
  · have hab' :
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le a b := hab
    have hbdd_ab : Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded f a b := by
      simpa [RealTheory.min, RealTheory.max,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2, hab'] using hbdd
    have halpha_ab :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha := by
      simpa [RealTheory.min, RealTheory.max,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2, hab'] using halpha
    have halpha'_ab :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha' := by
      simpa [RealTheory.min, RealTheory.max,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2, hab'] using halpha'
    have hderiv_ab :
        forall x : Point,
          RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
            RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
              (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) alpha x (alpha' x) := by
      simpa [RealTheory.min, RealTheory.max,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2, hab'] using hderiv
    have hrs_ab : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I :=
      hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_le
        hab hrs
    have hri :
        Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral
          (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') a b I :=
      hasRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_le
        hab hbdd_ab hrs_ab halpha_ab halpha'_ab hderiv_ab
    have hg_bdd :
        Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded
          (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') a b := by
      by_cases hab_eq : a = b
      · subst b
        exact Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_right_le_left
          (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') (RealTheory.le_refl a)
      · have hba_not : Not (RealTheory.le b a) := by
          intro hba
          exact hab_eq (RealTheory.le_antisymm hab hba)
        have hab_lt : RealTheory.lt a b :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hab hba_not
        exact Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalBounded_of_lt
          hab_lt hri
    exact Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_le_hasDarbouxIntegral
      hab
      hg_bdd
      (Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral hab hri)
  · have hab' :
        Not (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le a b) := hab
    have hba : RealTheory.le b a := by
      cases RealTheory.le_total a b with
      | inl hab' => exact False.elim (hab hab')
      | inr hba => exact hba
    have hbdd_ba : Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded f b a := by
      simpa [RealTheory.min, RealTheory.max,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2, hab'] using hbdd
    have halpha_ba :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval b a) alpha := by
      simpa [RealTheory.min, RealTheory.max,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2, hab'] using halpha
    have halpha'_ba :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval b a) alpha' := by
      simpa [RealTheory.min, RealTheory.max,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2, hab'] using halpha'
    have hderiv_ba :
        forall x : Point,
          RealTheory.OpenInterval b a x ->
            RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
              (RealTheory.OpenInterval b a) alpha x (alpha' x) := by
      simpa [RealTheory.min, RealTheory.max,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2, hab'] using hderiv
    have hrs_ba :
        HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
          f alpha b a (RealTheory.neg I) :=
      hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_ge
        hba hrs
    have hri :
        Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral
          (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') b a (RealTheory.neg I) :=
      hasRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_le
        hba hbdd_ba hrs_ba halpha_ba halpha'_ba hderiv_ba
    have hba_lt : RealTheory.lt b a :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hba hab
    have hg_bdd :
        Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded
          (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') b a :=
      Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalBounded_of_lt hba_lt hri
    have horiented :
        Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
          (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') a b
          (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.neg I)) :=
      Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_ge_hasDarbouxIntegral
        hba
        hg_bdd
        (Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral hba hri)
    rwa [RealTheory.neg_neg] at horiented

name: riemannIntegrableOn_mul_derivative_of_riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
statement:
theorem riemannIntegrableOn_mul_derivative_of_riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
    {f alpha alpha' : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hbdd : Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hrs : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b)
    (halpha :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha)
    (halpha' :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha')

      forall x : Point,

          RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
            (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) alpha x (alpha' x)) :
    Riemann.RiemannIntegrableOn
      (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab_le : RealTheory.le a b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab
  cases hrs with
  | intro I hI =>
      have hri :
          Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral
            (RealFunction.MulFun f alpha') a b I :=
        hasRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
          hab hbdd hI halpha halpha' hderiv
      refine Exists.intro I ?_
      exact And.intro
        (Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalBounded_of_lt hab hri)
        (Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral hab_le hri)

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_riemannIntegrableOn_differentiableIntegrator
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_riemannIntegrableOn_differentiableIntegrator
    {f alpha alpha' : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}

    Riemann.riemannIntegrableOn_mul_continuousOn_right_of_le
      hab_le hf halpha'
  cases hfg with
  | intro I hI =>
      refine Exists.intro I ?_
      exact
        hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_hasRiemannIntegral_mul_derivative
          hab

          (Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral hI.left hI.right)
