name: upperIntegralPrimitive_increment_hasIntegral
statement:
theorem upperIntegralPrimitive_increment_hasIntegral
    {f G : Map} {a c x0 x : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f)
    (hG : UpperIntegralPrimitiveOn f a c G)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x0)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x) :
    HasIntegral f x0 x (RealTheory.sub (G x) (G x0))
proof:
:= by
  have hseg_ax0 :
      ContinuousOnSegment f a x0 :=
    continuousOnSegment_of_continuousOn_closedInterval
      (f := f) hf
      (x := a) (y := x0)
      (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a)
        (RealTheory.le_trans hx0.left hx0.right)) hx0
  have hseg_x0x :
      ContinuousOnSegment f x0 x :=
    continuousOnSegment_of_continuousOn_closedInterval
      (f := f) hf hx0 hx
  have hseg_ax :
      ContinuousOnSegment f a x :=
    continuousOnSegment_of_continuousOn_closedInterval
      (f := f) hf
      (x := a) (y := x)
      (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a)
        (RealTheory.le_trans hx.left hx.right)) hx
  have hIa0 : HasIntegral f a x0 (G x0) := hG x0 hx0
  have hIax : HasIntegral f a x (G x) := hG x hx
  have hint_x0x : Integrable f x0 x :=
    continuousOnSegment_integrable hseg_x0x
  cases hint_x0x with
  | intro I hI =>
      have hadd :
          G x = RealTheory.add (G x0) I :=
        orientedIntervalAdditivity
          f a x0 x (G x0) I (G x)
          hseg_ax0 hseg_x0x hseg_ax hIa0 hI hIax
      have hI_eq :
          I = RealTheory.sub (G x) (G x0) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.value_sub_left_of_eq_add
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hadd
      rwa [<- hI_eq]

name: hasIntegral_sub_const_on_small_interval
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_sub_const_on_small_interval
    {f : Map} {a b I c : Point}
    (hI : HasIntegral f a b I) :
    HasIntegral
      (fun t : Point => RealTheory.sub (f t) c) a b
      (RealTheory.sub I (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a)))
proof:
:= by
  let constC : Map := fun _ : Point => c
  have hconst :
      HasIntegral constC a b
        (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a)) :=
    hasIntegral_const (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)
  have hneg :
      HasIntegral (RealFunction.NegFun constC) a b
        (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a))) :=
    hasIntegral_neg hconst
  have hadd :
      HasIntegral
        (RealFunction.AddFun f (RealFunction.NegFun constC)) a b
        (RealTheory.add I
          (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a)))) :=
    addLinearity f (RealFunction.NegFun constC) a b
      I (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a)))
      hI hneg
  apply hasIntegral_congr_integrand
    (f := RealFunction.AddFun f (RealFunction.NegFun constC))
    (g := fun t : Point => RealTheory.sub (f t) c)
  · intro t
    unfold RealFunction.AddFun RealFunction.NegFun constC
    rw [<- RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
  · rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
    exact hadd

name: upperIntegralPrimitive_differenceQuotient_error_bound_ordered
statement:
theorem upperIntegralPrimitive_differenceQuotient_error_bound_ordered
    {f G : Map} {a c x0 x eps : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f)
    (hG : UpperIntegralPrimitiveOn f a c G)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x0)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x)
    (hx0x : RealTheory.le x0 x)
    (hdxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub x x0))
    (heps_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps)
    (hbound :
      forall t : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x0 x t ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f t) (f x0))) eps) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealFunction.dist
        (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient G x0 x) (f x0))
      eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dx := F.sub x x0
  let err :=
    F.sub (F.sub (G x) (G x0)) (F.mul (f x0) dx)
  have hdxne : Not (dx = F.zero) := by
    intro hdx
    exact
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hdxpos hdx.symm)
  have hxne : Not (x = x0) := by
    intro hx_eq
    subst x
    have hzero : RealTheory.sub x0 x0 = RealTheory.zero := by
      change F.sub x0 x0 = F.zero
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F x0
    rw [hzero] at hdxpos
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F F.zero hdxpos
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv dx) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hdxpos)
  have hinc :
      HasIntegral f x0 x (F.sub (G x) (G x0)) :=
    upperIntegralPrimitive_increment_hasIntegral
      (f := f) (G := G) (a := a) (c := c)
      hf hG hx0 hx
  have herrInt :
      HasIntegral
        (fun t : Point => F.sub (f t) (f x0)) x0 x err := by
    unfold err dx
    exact
      hasIntegral_sub_const_on_small_interval
        (f := f) (a := x0) (b := x)
        (I := F.sub (G x) (G x0)) (c := f x0) hinc
  have herrBound :
      F.le (RealTheory.abs err) (F.mul eps dx) := by
    unfold err dx
    exact
      integralBoundEstimate
        (fun t : Point => F.sub (f t) (f x0))
        x0 x
        (F.sub (F.sub (G x) (G x0))
          (F.mul (f x0) (F.sub x x0)))
        eps
        hx0x heps_nonneg hbound herrInt
  have hdist_eq :
      RealFunction.dist
          (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient G x0 x) (f x0) =
        RealTheory.abs (F.mul err (F.inv dx)) := by
    unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
    change
      RealTheory.abs
        (F.sub (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient G x0 x) (f x0)) =
        RealTheory.abs (F.mul err (F.inv dx))
    have hsub :=
      RealDerivative.differenceQuotient_sub_const_error_eq
        G x0 x (f x0) hxne
    have hsubF :
        F.sub (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient G x0 x) (f x0) =
          F.mul
            (F.sub (F.sub (G x) (G x0))
              (F.mul (f x0) (F.sub x x0)))
            (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) := by
      change
        RealTheory.sub (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient G x0 x)
            (f x0) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub (G x) (G x0))
              (RealTheory.mul (f x0) (RealTheory.sub x x0)))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub x x0))
      exact hsub
    unfold err dx
    rw [hsubF]
  rw [hdist_eq]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hinv_nonneg]
  have hscaled :
      F.le
        (F.mul (RealTheory.abs err) (F.inv dx))
        (F.mul (F.mul eps dx) (F.inv dx)) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right herrBound hinv_nonneg
  have htarget :
      F.mul (F.mul eps dx) (F.inv dx) = eps := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul eps dx) (F.inv dx) =
          F.mul eps (F.mul dx (F.inv dx)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul eps F.one := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hdxne]
      _ = eps := by rw [F.mul_one]
  rwa [htarget] at hscaled

name: upperIntegralPrimitive_differenceQuotient_error_bound_ordered_left
statement:
theorem upperIntegralPrimitive_differenceQuotient_error_bound_ordered_left
    {f G : Map} {a c x0 x eps : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f)
    (hG : UpperIntegralPrimitiveOn f a c G)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x0)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x)
    (hxx0 : RealTheory.le x x0)
    (hdxpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub x0 x))
    (heps_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps)
    (hbound :
      forall t : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x x0 t ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f t) (f x0))) eps) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealFunction.dist
        (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient G x0 x) (f x0))
      eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let dx := F.sub x x0
  let pos := F.sub x0 x
  let err :=
    F.sub (F.sub (G x) (G x0)) (F.mul (f x0) dx)
  have hposne : Not (pos = F.zero) := by
    intro hpos
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hdxpos hpos.symm
  have hxne : Not (x = x0) := by
    intro hx_eq
    subst x
    have hzero : RealTheory.sub x0 x0 = RealTheory.zero := by
      change F.sub x0 x0 = F.zero
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F x0
    rw [hzero] at hdxpos
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F F.zero hdxpos
  have hinc :
      HasIntegral f x0 x (F.sub (G x) (G x0)) :=
    upperIntegralPrimitive_increment_hasIntegral
      (f := f) (G := G) (a := a) (c := c)
      hf hG hx0 hx
  have herrInt :
      HasIntegral
        (fun t : Point => F.sub (f t) (f x0)) x0 x err := by
    unfold err dx
    exact
      hasIntegral_sub_const_on_small_interval
        (f := f) (a := x0) (b := x)
        (I := F.sub (G x) (G x0)) (c := f x0) hinc
  have herrRev :
      HasIntegral
        (fun t : Point => F.sub (f t) (f x0)) x x0
        (F.neg err) :=
    hasIntegral_reverse herrInt
  have hrevBound :
      F.le (RealTheory.abs (F.neg err)) (F.mul eps pos) := by
    unfold pos
    exact
      integralBoundEstimate
        (fun t : Point => F.sub (f t) (f x0))
        x x0
        (F.neg err)
        eps
        hxx0 heps_nonneg hbound herrRev
  have herrBound :
      F.le (RealTheory.abs err) (F.mul eps pos) := by
    rwa [RealTheory.abs_neg err] at hrevBound
  have hdist_eq :
      RealFunction.dist
          (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient G x0 x) (f x0) =
        RealTheory.abs (F.mul err (F.inv dx)) := by
    unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
    change
      RealTheory.abs
        (F.sub (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient G x0 x) (f x0)) =
        RealTheory.abs (F.mul err (F.inv dx))
    have hsub :=
      RealDerivative.differenceQuotient_sub_const_error_eq
        G x0 x (f x0) hxne
    have hsubF :
        F.sub (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient G x0 x) (f x0) =
          F.mul
            (F.sub (F.sub (G x) (G x0))
              (F.mul (f x0) (F.sub x x0)))
            (F.inv (F.sub x x0)) := by
      change
        RealTheory.sub (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient G x0 x)
            (f x0) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub (G x) (G x0))
              (RealTheory.mul (f x0) (RealTheory.sub x x0)))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub x x0))
      exact hsub
    unfold err dx
    rw [hsubF]
  have hinv_abs :
      RealTheory.abs (F.inv dx) = F.inv pos := by
    have hdx_neg : dx = F.neg pos := by
      unfold dx pos
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x0 x
    have hinv_neg :
        F.inv (F.neg pos) = F.neg (F.inv pos) := by
      change RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.neg pos) =
        RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.inv pos)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_neg_of_ne_zero F hposne
    have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv pos) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hdxpos
    calc
      RealTheory.abs (F.inv dx) =
          RealTheory.abs (F.inv (F.neg pos)) := by
            rw [hdx_neg]
      _ = RealTheory.abs (F.neg (F.inv pos)) := by
            rw [hinv_neg]
      _ = RealTheory.abs (F.inv pos) := by
            rw [RealTheory.abs_neg]
      _ = F.inv pos := by
            exact RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinv_pos)
  rw [hdist_eq]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
  rw [hinv_abs]
  have hinv_pos_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv pos) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hdxpos)
  have hscaled :
      F.le
        (F.mul (RealTheory.abs err) (F.inv pos))
        (F.mul (F.mul eps pos) (F.inv pos)) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right herrBound hinv_pos_nonneg
  have htarget :
      F.mul (F.mul eps pos) (F.inv pos) = eps := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul eps pos) (F.inv pos) =
          F.mul eps (F.mul pos (F.inv pos)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul eps F.one := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hposne]
      _ = eps := by rw [F.mul_one]
  rwa [htarget] at hscaled

name: hasDerivWithin_upperIntegralPrimitive
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_upperIntegralPrimitive
    {f G : Map} {a c x0 : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f)
    (hG : UpperIntegralPrimitiveOn f a c G)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x0) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) G x0 (f x0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro hx0 ?_
  intro eps heps
  let eta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have heta_pos : F.lt F.zero eta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have heta_nonneg : F.le F.zero eta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heta_pos
  have heta_lt_eps : F.lt eta eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps
  cases (hf x0 hx0).right eta heta_pos with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      cases F.le_total x0 x with
      | inl hx0x =>
          have hnot_x_le_x0 : Not (F.le x x0) := by
            intro hxx0
            have hEq : x = x0 :=
              Eq.symm (F.le_antisymm hx0x hxx0)
            exact hxne hEq
          have hx0ltx : F.lt x0 x :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx0x hnot_x_le_x0
          have hdxpos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub x x0) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx0ltx
          have hbound :
              forall t : Point,
                RealTheory.ClosedInterval x0 x t ->
                  F.le
                    (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (f t) (f x0))) eta := by
            intro t ht
            by_cases ht0 : t = x0
            case pos =>
              subst t
              rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_self]
              exact heta_nonneg
            case neg =>
              have ht_ac :
                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c t :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset
                  F hx0.left hx.right t ht
              have htdist_le :
                  F.le (RealFunction.dist t x0)
                    (RealFunction.dist x x0) :=
                RealFunction.dist_left_endpoint_le_of_closedInterval ht
              have htdist_lt :
                  F.lt (RealFunction.dist t x0) delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htdist_le hxd
              have hclose := hdelta.right t ht_ac ht0 htdist_lt
              change
                F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (f t) (f x0))) eta at hclose
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hclose
          have hle_eta :
              F.le
                (RealFunction.dist
                  (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient G x0 x) (f x0))
                eta :=
            upperIntegralPrimitive_differenceQuotient_error_bound_ordered
              (f := f) (G := G) (a := a) (c := c)
              hf hG hx0 hx hx0x hdxpos heta_nonneg hbound
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle_eta heta_lt_eps
      | inr hxx0 =>
          have hnot_x0_le_x : Not (F.le x0 x) := by
            intro hx0x
            have hEq : x = x0 :=
              Eq.symm (F.le_antisymm hx0x hxx0)
            exact hxne hEq
          have hxltx0 : F.lt x x0 :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxx0 hnot_x0_le_x
          have hdxpos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub x0 x) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxltx0
          have hbound :
              forall t : Point,
                RealTheory.ClosedInterval x x0 t ->
                  F.le
                    (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (f t) (f x0))) eta := by
            intro t ht
            by_cases ht0 : t = x0
            case pos =>
              subst t
              rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_self]
              exact heta_nonneg
            case neg =>
              have ht_ac :
                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c t :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset
                  F hx.left hx0.right t ht
              have htdist_le :
                  F.le (RealFunction.dist t x0)
                    (RealFunction.dist x x0) :=
                RealFunction.dist_right_endpoint_le_of_closedInterval ht
              have htdist_lt :
                  F.lt (RealFunction.dist t x0) delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htdist_le hxd
              have hclose := hdelta.right t ht_ac ht0 htdist_lt
              change
                F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (f t) (f x0))) eta at hclose
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hclose
          have hle_eta :
              F.le
                (RealFunction.dist
                  (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient G x0 x) (f x0))
                eta :=
            upperIntegralPrimitive_differenceQuotient_error_bound_ordered_left
              (f := f) (G := G) (a := a) (c := c)
              hf hG hx0 hx hxx0 hdxpos heta_nonneg hbound
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle_eta heta_lt_eps

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_upperIntegralPrimitive
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_upperIntegralPrimitive
    {f G : Map} {a c : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f)
    (hG : UpperIntegralPrimitiveOn f a c G) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) G f
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact hasDerivWithin_upperIntegralPrimitive
    (f := f) (G := G) (a := a) (c := c) hf hG hx

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_upperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_upperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn
    {f : Map} {a c : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f)
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c)
      (UpperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn f a c hf hac) f
proof:
:= by
  exact
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_upperIntegralPrimitive
      (f := f)
      (G := UpperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn f a c hf hac)
      (a := a) (c := c)
      hf
      (upperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn_spec
        (f := f) (a := a) (c := c) hf hac)

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_primitiveSubUpperIntegralPrimitive_zero
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_primitiveSubUpperIntegralPrimitive_zero
    {F f : Map} {a c : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f)
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hF :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a c) F f) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      (RealTheory.OpenInterval a c)
      (RealFunction.SubFun F
        (UpperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn f a c hf hac))
      (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let G := UpperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn f a c hf hac
  have hopenSub :
      forall y : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a c y ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c y := by
    intro y hy
    exact RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a c y hy
  have hxClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x :=
    hopenSub x hx
  have hFopen :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a c) F x (f x) := by
    exact hF x hx
  have hGclosed :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) G f := by
    unfold G
    exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_upperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn
      (f := f) (a := a) (c := c) hf hac
  have hGopen :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a c) G x (f x) := by
    exact And.intro hx
      (RealDerivative.tendstoWithin_of_subset
        hopenSub (hGclosed x hxClosed).right)
  have hsub :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a c)
        (RealFunction.SubFun F G) x
        (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f x)) :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_sub hFopen hGopen
  change
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
      (RealTheory.OpenInterval a c)
      (RealFunction.SubFun F G) x RealTheory.zero
  refine And.intro hsub.left ?_
  exact
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (f x))
      hsub.right

name: primitiveSubUpperIntegralPrimitive_endpoint_eq_ordered
statement:
theorem primitiveSubUpperIntegralPrimitive_endpoint_eq_ordered
    {F f : Map} {a c : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f)
    (hFcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) F)
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hlt : RealTheory.lt a c)
    (hF :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a c) F f) :
    RealFunction.SubFun F
        (UpperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn f a c hf hac) c =
      RealFunction.SubFun F
        (UpperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn f a c hf hac) a
proof:
:= by
  let G := UpperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn f a c hf hac
  let H := RealFunction.SubFun F G
  have hGclosed :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) G f := by
    unfold G
    exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_upperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn
      (f := f) (a := a) (c := c) hf hac
  have hHderiv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a c) H
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero) := by
    unfold H G
    exact
      hasDerivativeWithinOn_primitiveSubUpperIntegralPrimitive_zero
        (F := F) (f := f) (a := a) (c := c) hf hac hF
  have hGcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) G := by
    intro x hx
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_continuousAtOn (hGclosed x hx)
  have hHcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) H := by
    unfold H
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_sub hFcont hGcont
  have hHdiff :
      RealDerivative.DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a c H := by
    intro x hx
    exact Exists.intro RealTheory.zero (hHderiv x hx)
  have hHbound :
      RealDerivative.DerivativeAbsBoundOnOpenInterval
        a c H RealTheory.zero := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hzeroDeriv :
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
          (RealTheory.OpenInterval a c) H x RealTheory.zero :=
      hHderiv x hx
    have hcluster :
        RealFunction.ClusterPoint (RealTheory.OpenInterval a c) x := by
      intro eps heps
      cases RealDerivative.openInterval_leftClusterPoint hx eps heps with
      | intro y hy =>
          exact Exists.intro y
            (And.intro hy.left.left hy.right)
    have hAeq : A = RealTheory.zero :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique hcluster hA hzeroDeriv
    rw [hAeq]
    unfold RealTheory.zero
    rw [RealTheory.abs_zero]
    exact RealTheory.le_refl
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.zero
  have hboundAbs :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (H c) (H a)))
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub c a))) :=
    RealDerivative.finiteIncrementBound_of_derivativeAbsBound
      a c RealTheory.zero H hlt hHcont hHdiff hHbound
  have hleZero :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (H c) (H a)))
        RealTheory.zero := by
    rwa [RealTheory.zero_mul] at hboundAbs
  have habsZero :
      RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (H c) (H a)) =
        RealTheory.zero :=
    RealTheory.le_antisymm hleZero
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (RealTheory.sub (H c) (H a)))
  have hsubZero :
      RealTheory.sub (H c) (H a) = RealTheory.zero :=
    RealTheory.eq_zero_of_abs_eq_zero habsZero
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsubZero

name: hasIntegral_derivative_eq_sub_ordered
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_derivative_eq_sub_ordered
    {F f : Map} {a c : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f)
    (hFcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) F)
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hF :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a c) F f) :
    HasIntegral f a c (RealTheory.sub (F c) (F a))
proof:
:= by
  let K := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hca : RealTheory.le c a
  case pos =>
    have hac_eq : a = c := RealTheory.le_antisymm hac hca
    subst c
    have hzero : RealTheory.sub (F a) (F a) = RealTheory.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self K (F a)
    rw [hzero]
    exact hasIntegral_same_endpoint_zero f a
  case neg =>
    have hlt : RealTheory.lt a c :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le K hac hca
    let G := UpperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn f a c hf hac
    have hc_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c c :=
      And.intro hac (RealTheory.le_refl c)
    have ha_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c a :=
      And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hac
    have hG :
        UpperIntegralPrimitiveOn f a c G := by
      unfold G
      exact
        upperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn_spec
          (f := f) (a := a) (c := c) hf hac
    have hGcInt : HasIntegral f a c (G c) :=
      hG c hc_mem
    have hGaInt : HasIntegral f a a (G a) :=
      hG a ha_mem
    have hGaZero : G a = RealTheory.zero :=
      hasIntegral_same_endpoint_eq_zero hGaInt
    have hEndpoint :
        RealFunction.SubFun F G c =
          RealFunction.SubFun F G a := by
      unfold G
      exact
        primitiveSubUpperIntegralPrimitive_endpoint_eq_ordered
          (F := F) (f := f) (a := a) (c := c)
          hf hFcont hac hlt hF
    have hSubEq :
        RealTheory.sub (F c) (G c) = F a := by
      unfold RealFunction.SubFun at hEndpoint
      rw [hGaZero] at hEndpoint
      have hright :
          RealTheory.sub (F a) RealTheory.zero = F a := by
        change K.sub (F a) K.zero = F a
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero K (F a)
      rw [hright] at hEndpoint
      exact hEndpoint
    have hFcAdd :
        F c = RealTheory.add (F a) (G c) := by
      change K.sub (F c) (G c) = F a at hSubEq
      calc
        F c = K.add (K.sub (F c) (G c)) (G c) := by
          exact Eq.symm
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel K (F c) (G c))
        _ = K.add (F a) (G c) := by rw [hSubEq]
    have hGcValue :
        G c = RealTheory.sub (F c) (F a) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.value_sub_left_of_eq_add K hFcAdd
    rwa [hGcValue] at hGcInt

name: hasIntegral_derivative_eq_sub
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_derivative_eq_sub
    {F f : Map} {a b : Point}
    (hf : ContinuousOnSegment f a b)
    (hFcont : ContinuousOnSegment F a b)
    (hF : HasDerivativeWithinOnOpenSegment F f a b) :
    HasIntegral f a b (RealTheory.sub (F b) (F a))
proof:
:= by
  cases RealTheory.le_total a b with
  | inl hab =>
      exact hasIntegral_derivative_eq_sub_ordered
        (F := F) (f := f) (a := a) (c := b)
        (hf.left hab) (hFcont.left hab) hab (hF.left hab)
  | inr hba =>
      let K := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hIba :
          HasIntegral f b a (RealTheory.sub (F a) (F b)) :=
        hasIntegral_derivative_eq_sub_ordered
          (F := F) (f := f) (a := b) (c := a)
          (hf.right hba) (hFcont.right hba) hba (hF.right hba)
      have hIab :
          HasIntegral f a b
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.sub (F a) (F b))) :=
        hasIntegral_reverse hIba
      have hval :
          RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.sub (F a) (F b)) =
            RealTheory.sub (F b) (F a) := by
        change K.neg (K.sub (F a) (F b)) = K.sub (F b) (F a)
        rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub K (F a) (F b)]
      rwa [hval] at hIab

name: monotoneOn_closedInterval_differentiableWithin_ae
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_closedInterval_differentiableWithin_ae
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hmono : RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f) :
    RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (fun x : Point =>
        DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn
  exact
    RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
      (E :=
        fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
            (Not
              (DifferentiableWithin
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f x)))
      (F := MonotoneSlopeExceptionalSet a b f)
      (fun x hx => by
        by_cases hex : MonotoneSlopeExceptionalSet a b f x
        · exact hex
        · exact False.elim
            (hx.right
              (LeeVybornyInternal.differentiableWithin_closedInterval_of_not_monotoneSlopeExceptionalSet
                hab hx.left hmono hex)))
      (monotoneSlopeExceptionalSet_nullSet_of_monotoneOn hab hmono)

name: differentiableWithin_of_sameOn_sub_differentiableWithin
statement:
private theorem differentiableWithin_of_sameOn_sub_differentiableWithin
    {E : Domain} {f g k : Map} {x : Point}
    (hfgk : RealFunction.SameOn E f (RealFunction.SubFun g k))
    (hg : DifferentiableWithin E g x)
    (hk : DifferentiableWithin E k x) :
    DifferentiableWithin E f x
proof:
:= by
  cases hg with
  | intro A hA =>
      cases hk with
      | intro B hB =>
          refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.sub A B) ?_
          apply hasDerivWithin_congr
            (E := E) (f := RealFunction.SubFun g k) (g := f)
          · intro y hy
            symm
            exact hfgk y hy
          · exact hasDerivWithin_sub hA hB

name: boundedVariationOn_canonicalJordan_components_ae
statement:
private theorem boundedVariationOn_canonicalJordan_components_ae
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hBV :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn
        a b f) :
    let V : Map
proof:
:=
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f
    let g : Map := V
    let k : Map := RealFunction.SubFun V f
    And
      (RealFunction.SameOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f
        (RealFunction.SubFun g k))
      (And
        (RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
          (fun x : Point =>
            DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g x))
        (RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
          (fun x : Point =>
            DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) k x))) := by
  let V : Map :=
    _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f
  let g : Map := V
  let k : Map := RealFunction.SubFun V f
  have hJ :=
    _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.boundedVariationOn_standardJordanDecompositionOn
      hBV
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · simpa [V, g, k] using hJ.right.right
  · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · exact
        monotoneOn_closedInterval_differentiableWithin_ae hab
          (by simpa [V, g, k] using hJ.left)
    · exact
        monotoneOn_closedInterval_differentiableWithin_ae hab
          (by simpa [V, k] using hJ.right.left)

name: boundedVariationOn_closedInterval_differentiableWithin_ae
statement:
theorem boundedVariationOn_closedInterval_differentiableWithin_ae
    {a b : Point} {f : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hBV :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn
        a b f) :
    RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (fun x : Point =>
        DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f x)
proof:
:= by
  let V : Map :=
    _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f
  let g : Map := V
  let k : Map := RealFunction.SubFun V f
  have hcomponents :=
    boundedVariationOn_canonicalJordan_components_ae
      (a := a) (b := b) (f := f) hab hBV
  have hsame :
      RealFunction.SameOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f
        (RealFunction.SubFun g k) := by
    simpa [V, g, k] using hcomponents.left
  have hgAE :
      RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
        (fun x : Point =>
          DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g x) := by
    simpa [V, g, k] using hcomponents.right.left
  have hkAE :
      RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
        (fun x : Point =>
          DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) k x) := by
    simpa [V, g, k] using hcomponents.right.right
  unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn at hgAE
  unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn at hkAE
  unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn
  exact
    RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
      (E :=
        fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
            (Not
              (DifferentiableWithin
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f x)))
      (F :=
        Foundation.Cardinal.SetUnion
          (fun x : Point =>
            And (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
              (Not
                (DifferentiableWithin
                  (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g x)))
          (fun x : Point =>
            And (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
              (Not
                (DifferentiableWithin
                  (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) k x))))
      (fun x hx => by
        by_cases hgx :
            DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g x
        · by_cases hkx :
              DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) k x
          · exact False.elim
              (hx.right
                (differentiableWithin_of_sameOn_sub_differentiableWithin
                  (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
                  (f := f) (g := g) (k := k) hsame hgx hkx))
          · exact Or.inr (And.intro hx.left hkx)
        · exact Or.inl (And.intro hx.left hgx))
      (RealNegligibility.nullSet_union hgAE hkAE)

name: twoPointSlope_linearFun_eq
statement:
theorem twoPointSlope_linearFun_eq
    {B x y : Point} (hyx : Not (y = x)) :
    TwoPointSlope (RealFunction.LinearFun B) x y = B
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub : Not (F.sub y x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact hyx (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hzero)
  unfold TwoPointSlope DifferenceQuotient
  rw [RealFunction.linearFun_apply, RealFunction.linearFun_apply]
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (F.mul B y) (F.mul B x))
      (F.inv (F.sub y x)) = B
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F B y x]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right F B hsub

name: twoPointSlope_affineShiftFun_eq_sub

proof:
:= by

    RealTheory.sub
      (TwoPointSlope f x y)
      (TwoPointSlope (RealFunction.LinearFun B) x y) =

  rw [twoPointSlope_linearFun_eq hyx]

name: twoPointSlope_mul_den_eq_increment
statement:
theorem twoPointSlope_mul_den_eq_increment
    {f : Map} {x y : Point}
    (hyx : Not (y = x)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (TwoPointSlope f x y)
        (RealTheory.sub y x) =
      RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold TwoPointSlope DifferenceQuotient
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul (F.sub (f y) (f x)) (F.inv (F.sub y x)))
        (F.sub y x) =
      F.sub (f y) (f x)
  have hden_ne : Not (F.sub y x = F.zero) := by
    intro hden
    have hy_eq_x : y = x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hden
    exact hyx hy_eq_x
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
    F (F.sub (f y) (f x)) hden_ne

name: twoPointSlopeAbove_increment_of_lt
statement:
theorem twoPointSlopeAbove_increment_of_lt
    {f : Map} {A x y : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (h : RealTheory.lt A (TwoPointSlope f x y)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.sub y x))
      (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  have hmul :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F h hden_pos
  have hyx : Not (y = x) := by
    intro hyx_eq
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxy) hyx_eq.symm
  change
    F.lt
      (F.mul A (F.sub y x))
      (F.mul (TwoPointSlope f x y) (F.sub y x)) at hmul
  have hden_eq :=
    twoPointSlope_mul_den_eq_increment
      (f := f) (x := x) (y := y) hyx
  change
    F.mul (TwoPointSlope f x y) (F.sub y x) =
      F.sub (f y) (f x) at hden_eq
  rw [hden_eq] at hmul
  exact hmul

name: twoPointSlopeAbove_increment_of_gt
statement:
theorem twoPointSlopeAbove_increment_of_gt
    {f : Map} {A x y : Point}
    (hyx : RealTheory.lt y x)
    (h : RealTheory.lt A (TwoPointSlope f x y)) :
    RealTheory.lt

proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hne : Not (y = x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hyx
  have hswap :
      F.lt A (TwoPointSlope f y x) := by
    rwa [twoPointSlope_swap_eq
      (f := f) (x := x) (y := y) hne] at h
  exact
    twoPointSlopeAbove_increment_of_lt
      (f := f) (A := A) (x := y) (y := x) hyx hswap

name: twoPointSlopeBelow_increment_of_lt
statement:
theorem twoPointSlopeBelow_increment_of_lt
    {f : Map} {A x y : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (h : RealTheory.lt
      (TwoPointSlope f x y) (RealTheory.neg A)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.sub y x))
      (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hneg := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F h
  have habove :
      F.lt A (TwoPointSlope (RealFunction.NegFun f) x y) := by
    rw [twoPointSlope_negFun_eq]
    change F.lt A (F.neg (TwoPointSlope f x y))
    change
      F.lt (F.neg (F.neg A)) (F.neg (TwoPointSlope f x y)) at hneg
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F A] at hneg
  have hinc :
      F.lt
        (F.mul A (F.sub y x))
        (F.sub (RealFunction.NegFun f y) (RealFunction.NegFun f x)) :=
    twoPointSlopeAbove_increment_of_lt
      (f := RealFunction.NegFun f) (A := A)
      (x := x) (y := y) hxy habove
  change
    F.lt
      (F.mul A (F.sub y x))
      (F.sub (F.neg (f y)) (F.neg (f x))) at hinc
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F (f y) (f x)] at hinc
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f y) (f x)] at hinc
  exact hinc

name: twoPointSlopeBelow_increment_of_gt
statement:
theorem twoPointSlopeBelow_increment_of_gt

      (f := f) (x := x) (y := y) hne] at h

name: twoPointSlopeAbove_distIncrement_of_lt
statement:
theorem twoPointSlopeAbove_distIncrement_of_lt
    {f : Map} {A x y : Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (h : RealTheory.lt A (TwoPointSlope f x y)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul A (RealFunction.dist y x))
      (RealFunction.dist (f y) (f x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  have hinc :
      F.lt (F.mul A (F.sub y x)) (F.sub (f y) (f x)) :=
    twoPointSlopeAbove_increment_of_lt
      (f := f) (A := A) (x := x) (y := y) hxy h
  have hleft_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.mul A (F.sub y x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hA hden_pos
  have hdiff_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub (f y) (f x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hleft_pos hinc
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hden_pos)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hdiff_pos)]
  exact hinc

name: twoPointSlopeAbove_distIncrement_of_ne
statement:
theorem twoPointSlopeAbove_distIncrement_of_ne
    {f : Map} {A x y : Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A)
    (hyx : Not (y = x))
    (h : RealTheory.lt A (TwoPointSlope f x y)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul A (RealFunction.dist y x))
      (RealFunction.dist (f y) (f x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases F.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy_le =>
      have hxy : F.lt x y := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy_le
        intro hyx_le
        have hxy_eq : x = y := F.le_antisymm hxy_le hyx_le
        exact hyx hxy_eq.symm
      exact
        twoPointSlopeAbove_distIncrement_of_lt
          (f := f) (A := A) (x := x) (y := y) hA hxy h
  | inr hyx_le =>
      have hyx_lt : F.lt y x := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyx_le
        intro hxy_le
        have hyx_eq : y = x := F.le_antisymm hyx_le hxy_le
        exact hyx hyx_eq
      have hswap :
          F.lt A (TwoPointSlope f y x) := by
        rwa [twoPointSlope_swap_eq
          (f := f) (x := x) (y := y) hyx] at h
      have hdist :
          F.lt
            (F.mul A (RealFunction.dist x y))
            (RealFunction.dist (f x) (f y)) :=
        twoPointSlopeAbove_distIncrement_of_lt
          (f := f) (A := A) (x := y) (y := x) hA hyx_lt hswap
      rw [RealFunction.dist_comm x y,
        RealFunction.dist_comm (f x) (f y)] at hdist
      exact hdist

name: twoPointSlopeBelow_distIncrement_of_ne
statement:
theorem twoPointSlopeBelow_distIncrement_of_ne
    {f : Map} {A x y : Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A)
    (hyx : Not (y = x))
    (h : RealTheory.lt
      (TwoPointSlope f x y) (RealTheory.neg A)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul A (RealFunction.dist y x))
      (RealFunction.dist (f y) (f x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hneg :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F h
  have habove :
      F.lt A (TwoPointSlope (RealFunction.NegFun f) x y) := by
    rw [twoPointSlope_negFun_eq]
    change F.lt A (F.neg (TwoPointSlope f x y))
    change
      F.lt (F.neg (F.neg A)) (F.neg (TwoPointSlope f x y)) at hneg
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F A] at hneg
  have hdist :
      F.lt
        (F.mul A (RealFunction.dist y x))
        (RealFunction.dist
          (RealFunction.NegFun f y)
          (RealFunction.NegFun f x)) :=
    twoPointSlopeAbove_distIncrement_of_ne
      (f := RealFunction.NegFun f) (A := A)
      (x := x) (y := y) hA hyx habove
  change
    F.lt
      (F.mul A (RealFunction.dist y x))
      (RealFunction.dist
        (RealTheory.neg (f y)) (RealTheory.neg (f x))) at hdist
  rw [RealFunction.dist_neg_neg (f y) (f x)] at hdist
  exact hdist

private theorem slope_lt_sub_right_of_add_lt
    {A B S : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add B A) S) :

proof:
:=

name: slope_sub_lt_neg_of_lt_sub
statement:
private theorem slope_sub_lt_neg_of_lt_sub
    {A B S : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.lt S (RealTheory.sub B A)) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub S B) (RealTheory.neg A)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt (F.sub S B) (F.neg A)
  have h' := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F h (F.neg B)
  have hleft : F.add S (F.neg B) = F.sub S B := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hright : F.add (RealTheory.sub B A) (F.neg B) = F.neg A := by
    change F.add (F.sub B A) (F.neg B) = F.neg A
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    calc
      F.add (F.add B (F.neg A)) (F.neg B) =
          F.add (F.add (F.neg A) B) (F.neg B) := by
            rw [F.add_comm B (F.neg A)]
      _ = F.neg A :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_neg_cancel_right F (F.neg A) B
  rwa [hleft, hright] at h'

        (f := f) (B := B) (x := x) (y := y)

name: twoPointSlope_nonnegative_of_monotoneOn_of_lt
statement:
theorem twoPointSlope_nonnegative_of_monotoneOn_of_lt
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x y : Point}
    (hmono : RealFunction.MonotoneOn E f)
    (hx : E x) (hy : E y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (TwoPointSlope f x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hfxfy : F.le (f x) (f y) :=
    hmono x y hx hy (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxy)
  have hnum_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub (f y) (f x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hfxfy
  have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv (F.sub y x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos)
  unfold TwoPointSlope DifferenceQuotient
  change
    F.le F.zero
      (F.mul (F.sub (f y) (f x)) (F.inv (F.sub y x)))
  exact F.mul_nonneg hnum_nonneg hinv_nonneg

name: twoPointSlope_nonnegative_of_monotoneOn
statement:
theorem twoPointSlope_nonnegative_of_monotoneOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x y : Point}
    (hmono : RealFunction.MonotoneOn E f)
    (hx : E x) (hy : E y)
    (hyx : Not (y = x)) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (TwoPointSlope f x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases F.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy_le =>
      have hxy_lt : F.lt x y := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy_le
        intro hyx_le
        have hxy_eq : x = y := F.le_antisymm hxy_le hyx_le
        exact hyx hxy_eq.symm
      exact
        twoPointSlope_nonnegative_of_monotoneOn_of_lt
          hmono hx hy hxy_lt
  | inr hyx_le =>
      have hyx_lt : F.lt y x := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyx_le
        intro hxy_le
        have hyx_eq : y = x := F.le_antisymm hyx_le hxy_le
        exact hyx hyx_eq
      have hswap_nonneg :
          F.le F.zero (TwoPointSlope f y x) :=
        twoPointSlope_nonnegative_of_monotoneOn_of_lt
          hmono hy hx hyx_lt
      rw [twoPointSlope_swap_eq (f := f) (x := x) (y := y) hyx]
      exact hswap_nonneg

name: slopeGapRadius_pos
proof:

name: slopeGapCenter_add_radius_eq_right
statement:
private theorem slopeGapCenter_add_radius_eq_right (s r : Point) :
    RealTheory.add (slopeGapCenter s r) (slopeGapRadius s r) = r
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.sub (slopeGapCenter s r) s =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (RealTheory.sub r s) := by
    unfold slopeGapCenter midpointPoint
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_sub_left F s r
  have hright :
      RealTheory.sub r (slopeGapCenter s r) =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (RealTheory.sub r s) := by
    unfold slopeGapCenter midpointPoint
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.right_sub_midpoint F s r
  have hradius :
      slopeGapRadius s r = RealTheory.sub r (slopeGapCenter s r) := by
    unfold slopeGapRadius
    rw [hleft, hright]
  rw [hradius]
  rw [RealTheory.add_comm]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F r (slopeGapCenter s r)

name: intervalSlopeGapSet_affineShift_normalized
statement:
private theorem intervalSlopeGapSet_affineShift_normalized
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} {r s x : Point}
    (hsr : RealTheory.lt s r)
    (hgap : IntervalSlopeGapSet a b f r s x) :
    SlopeGapSet (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (RealFunction.AffineShiftFun f (slopeGapCenter s r))
      (slopeGapRadius s r)
      (RealTheory.neg (slopeGapRadius s r)) x
proof:
:= by
  let B := slopeGapCenter s r
  let A := slopeGapRadius s r
  have _hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A := by
    unfold A
    exact slopeGapRadius_pos hsr
  have habove :
      FrequentlySlopeAbove (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x
        (RealTheory.add B A) := by
    unfold B A
    rw [slopeGapCenter_add_radius_eq_right s r]
    exact hgap.left
  have hbelow :
      FrequentlySlopeBelow (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x
        (RealTheory.sub B A) := by
    unfold B A
    rw [slopeGapCenter_sub_radius_eq_left s r]
    exact hgap.right
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact
      frequentlySlopeAbove_affineShift_of_above_add
        (B := B) (A := A) habove
  · exact
      frequentlySlopeBelow_affineShift_of_below_sub
        (B := B) (A := A) hbelow

name: frequentlySlopeAbove_cellWitness
statement:
theorem frequentlySlopeAbove_cellWitness
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x A left right delta : Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A)
    (h : FrequentlySlopeAbove E f x A)
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
    (hcell :
      forall y : Point,

proof:

  | Exists.intro y hy =>
      refine Exists.intro y ?_
      unfold SlopeAboveCellWitness
      exact
        And.intro hy.left
          (And.intro
            (hcell y (puncturedNearby_dist_lt hy.left))
            (And.intro hy.right

                (f := f) (A := A) (x := x) (y := y)

name: normalizedSlopeGapSet_cellWitnesses
statement:
theorem normalizedSlopeGapSet_cellWitnesses
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x A left right delta : Point}

    (hgap : SlopeGapSet E f A (RealTheory.neg A) x)

proof:

      (left := left) (right := right) (delta := delta)
      hA (slopeGapSet_frequentlyAbove hgap) hdelta hcell with

name: boundedVariationOn_exists_nearOptimalStrictPartition
statement:
theorem boundedVariationOn_exists_nearOptimalStrictPartition
    {a b eta : Point} {f : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hBV :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn
        a b f)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
            And
              (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.StrictIntervalPartition
                a b n p)
              (RealTheory.lt

name: strictIntervalPartition_exists_openCellGauge_of_openInterval_not_endpoint

name: normalizedSlopeGapSet_partitionCellWitnesses
statement:
theorem normalizedSlopeGapSet_partitionCellWitnesses
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {a b x A : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A)
    (hgap : SlopeGapSet E f A (RealTheory.neg A) x)
    (hp :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.StrictIntervalPartition
        a b n p)
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hnot :
      Not
        (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.PartitionEndpoint
          p n x)) :
    Exists
      (fun k : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun delta : Point =>
            Exists
              (fun yAbove : Point =>
                Exists
                  (fun yBelow : Point =>
                    And (k < n)
                      (And (RealTheory.OpenInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)) x)
                        (And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
                          (And
                            (forall y : Point,
                              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) delta ->
                                RealTheory.OpenInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)) y)
                            (And
                              (SlopeAboveCellWitness E f x A
                                (p k) (p (k + 1)) delta yAbove)
                              (SlopeBelowCellWitness E f x A
                                (p k) (p (k + 1)) delta yBelow)))))))))
proof:
:= by
  match
      strictIntervalPartition_exists_openCellGauge_of_openInterval_not_endpoint
        hp hx hnot with
  | Exists.intro k hk =>
      match hk with
      | Exists.intro delta hdelta =>
          match
              normalizedSlopeGapSet_cellWitnesses
                (f := f) (x := x) (A := A)
                (left := p k) (right := p (k + 1))
                (delta := delta)
                hA hgap hdelta.right.right.left hdelta.right.right.right with
          | Exists.intro yAbove hyAbove =>
              match hyAbove with
              | Exists.intro yBelow hyBelow =>
                  refine Exists.intro k ?_
                  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                  refine Exists.intro yAbove ?_
                  refine Exists.intro yBelow ?_
                  exact
                    And.intro hdelta.left
                      (And.intro hdelta.right.left
                        (And.intro hdelta.right.right.left
                          (And.intro hdelta.right.right.right hyBelow)))

name: fixedPartitionGapOfMem_props
statement:
private theorem fixedPartitionGapOfMem_props
    {a b x A : Point} {g : Map} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}

    (hp :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.StrictIntervalPartition
        a b n p)
    (hbad : FixedPartitionNormalizedGapNonEndpointSet a b g A p n x) :
    And (fixedPartitionGapCellOfOfMem hA hp hbad < n)
      (And
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval
          (p (fixedPartitionGapCellOfOfMem hA hp hbad))
          (p (fixedPartitionGapCellOfOfMem hA hp hbad + 1)) x)
        (And
          (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
            (fixedPartitionGapCellGaugeOfMem hA hp hbad))
          (And
            (forall y : Point,
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x)
                (fixedPartitionGapCellGaugeOfMem hA hp hbad) ->
                RealTheory.OpenInterval
                  (p (fixedPartitionGapCellOfOfMem hA hp hbad))
                  (p (fixedPartitionGapCellOfOfMem hA hp hbad + 1)) y)
            (And
              (SlopeAboveCellWitness (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) g x A
                (p (fixedPartitionGapCellOfOfMem hA hp hbad))
                (p (fixedPartitionGapCellOfOfMem hA hp hbad + 1))
                (fixedPartitionGapCellGaugeOfMem hA hp hbad)
                (fixedPartitionGapYAboveOfMem hA hp hbad))
              (SlopeBelowCellWitness (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) g x A

                (p (fixedPartitionGapCellOfOfMem hA hp hbad + 1))
                (fixedPartitionGapCellGaugeOfMem hA hp hbad)
                (fixedPartitionGapYBelowOfMem hA hp hbad))))))

  let hw :=
    fixedPartitionNormalizedGapNonEndpointSet_partitionCellWitnesses
      hA hbad hp
  let hdeltaExists := Classical.choose_spec hw
  let hyAboveExists := Classical.choose_spec hdeltaExists
  let hyBelowExists := Classical.choose_spec hyAboveExists
  have hprops := Classical.choose_spec hyBelowExists
  simpa [fixedPartitionGapCellOfOfMem, fixedPartitionGapCellGaugeOfMem,
    fixedPartitionGapYAboveOfMem, fixedPartitionGapYBelowOfMem] using hprops

name: centeredWitnessControlLeft_dist_eq
statement:
private theorem centeredWitnessControlLeft_dist_eq
    (x y : Point) :
    RealFunction.dist (centeredWitnessControlLeft x y) x =
      RealFunction.dist y x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := RealFunction.dist y x
  have hd : F.le F.zero d := by
    unfold d
    unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F (F.sub y x)
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  unfold centeredWitnessControlLeft
  change F.abs (F.sub (F.sub x d) x) = d
  have hsub : F.sub (F.sub x d) x = F.neg d := by
    calc
      F.sub (F.sub x d) x =
          F.neg (F.sub x (F.sub x d)) := by
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x (F.sub x d)
      _ = F.neg d := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F x d]
  rw [hsub]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F d]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hd

  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  unfold centeredWitnessControlRight
  change F.abs (F.sub (F.add x d) x) = d
  have hsub : F.sub (F.add x d) x = d := by
    rw [F.add_comm x d]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F d x
  rw [hsub]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hd

name: centeredWitnessControl_contains_right
statement:
private theorem centeredWitnessControl_contains_right
    {x y : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le (centeredWitnessControlLeft x y) x)
      (And (RealTheory.le x y)
        (RealTheory.le y (centeredWitnessControlRight x y)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hdist : RealFunction.dist y x = F.sub y x :=
    dist_eq_sub_of_lt_right hxy
  have hdist_pos : F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.dist y x) := by
    rw [hdist]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  have hleft_lt :
      F.lt (centeredWitnessControlLeft x y) x := by
    unfold centeredWitnessControlLeft
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hdist_pos
  have hright_eq :
      centeredWitnessControlRight x y = y := by
    unfold centeredWitnessControlRight
    rw [hdist]
    change F.add x (F.sub y x) = y
    rw [F.add_comm x (F.sub y x)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y x
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hleft_lt
  · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxy
    · rw [hright_eq]
      exact F.le_refl y

name: centeredWitnessControl_contains_left
statement:
private theorem centeredWitnessControl_contains_left
    {x y : Point}
    (hyx : RealTheory.lt y x) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le (centeredWitnessControlLeft x y) y)
      (And (RealTheory.le y x)
        (RealTheory.le x (centeredWitnessControlRight x y)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hdist : RealFunction.dist y x = F.sub x y :=
    dist_eq_sub_of_lt_left hyx
  have hdist_pos : F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.dist y x) := by
    rw [hdist]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hyx
  have hleft_eq :
      centeredWitnessControlLeft x y = y := by
    unfold centeredWitnessControlLeft
    rw [hdist]
    change F.sub x (F.sub x y) = y
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_right_cancel F
      (a := F.sub x y)
    calc
      F.add (F.sub x (F.sub x y)) (F.sub x y) = x := by
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x (F.sub x y)]
      _ = F.add y (F.sub x y) := by
        symm
        rw [F.add_comm y (F.sub x y)]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x y]
  have hright_lt :
      F.lt x (centeredWitnessControlRight x y) := by
    unfold centeredWitnessControlRight
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hdist_pos
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · rw [hleft_eq]
    exact F.le_refl y
  · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hyx
    · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hright_lt

statement:
private theorem intervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet_witnessPackage
    {a b M x : Point} {f : Map}
    (hM : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M)
    (hbad : IntervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet a b f x) :
    Exists
      (fun y : Point =>
        And
          (SlopeAboveCellWitness (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x M
            a b (openIntervalInteriorRadius a b x) y)
          (And
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
              (centeredWitnessControlLeft x y))
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
              (centeredWitnessControlRight x y))))
proof:
:= by
  have hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x :=
    intervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet_mem hbad
  have hradius_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (openIntervalInteriorRadius a b x) :=
    openIntervalInteriorRadius_pos hx
  have hfreq :
      FrequentlySlopeAbove (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x M :=
    intervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet_fixedThreshold hM hbad
  match
      frequentlySlopeAbove_cellWitness
        (E := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) (f := f) (x := x)
        (A := M) (left := a) (right := b)
        (delta := openIntervalInteriorRadius a b x)
        hM hfreq hradius_pos
        (fun y hy =>
          openInterval_mem_of_dist_lt_interiorRadius hx hy) with
  | Exists.intro y hW =>
      refine Exists.intro y ?_
      have hcontrols :
          And
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
              (centeredWitnessControlLeft x y))
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
              (centeredWitnessControlRight x y)) :=
        centeredWitnessControl_closedInterval_of_dist_lt_interiorRadius
          hx (puncturedNearby_dist_lt hW.left)
      exact And.intro hW hcontrols

name: taggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft_eq_centeredWitnessControlLeft
statement:
private theorem taggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft_eq_centeredWitnessControlLeft
    {delta : Point -> Point} {tag : Nat -> Option Point}
    {n : Nat} {xi y : Point}
    (htag : tag n = some xi)
    (hdelta :
      delta (selectedTagPoint tag n) =
        RealFunction.dist y (selectedTagPoint tag n)) :
    TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tag n =
      centeredWitnessControlLeft (selectedTagPoint tag n) y
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft
  unfold centeredWitnessControlLeft
  rw [htag]
  rw [selectedTagPoint_eq_of_some htag] at hdelta
  rw [selectedTagPoint_eq_of_some htag]
  change RealTheory.sub xi (delta xi) =
    RealTheory.sub xi (RealFunction.dist y xi)
  rw [hdelta]

        (selectedTagPoint
          (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM) i)

name: infiniteSlopeSelectedScan_bounds
statement:
private theorem infiniteSlopeSelectedScan_bounds
    {a b M xi : Point} {f : Map} {i : Nat}
    (hM : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M)
    (htag : infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM i = some xi) :
    And
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
        (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft
          (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanDelta a b M f hM)
          (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM) i))
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
        (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight
          (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanDelta a b M f hM)
          (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM) i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let tag := infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM
  let delta := infiniteSlopeSelectedScanDelta a b M f hM
  let witness := infiniteSlopeSelectedScanWitness a b M f hM i
  have hbad := infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTagPoint_mem hM htag
  have hdeltaDist :
      delta (selectedTagPoint tag i) =
        RealFunction.dist witness (selectedTagPoint tag i) := by
    unfold delta
    unfold witness
    exact infiniteSlopeSelectedScan_delta_dist_witness hM htag
  have hleftEq :
      TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tag i =
        centeredWitnessControlLeft (selectedTagPoint tag i) witness :=
    taggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft_eq_centeredWitnessControlLeft htag hdeltaDist
  have hrightEq :
      TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tag i =
        centeredWitnessControlRight (selectedTagPoint tag i) witness :=
    taggedGaugeOpenCoverRight_eq_centeredWitnessControlRight htag hdeltaDist
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · rw [hleftEq]
    unfold witness
    simpa [infiniteSlopeSelectedScanWitness, hbad] using
      (infiniteSlopeAboveWitnessOfMem_controlLeft hM hbad)
  · rw [hrightEq]
    unfold witness
    simpa [infiniteSlopeSelectedScanWitness, hbad] using
      (infiniteSlopeAboveWitnessOfMem_controlRight hM hbad)

name: infiniteSlopeSelectedScan_datum

private theorem infiniteSlopeSelectedScan_datum

      (selectedTagPoint
        (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM) i)

  classical
  have hbad := infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTagPoint_mem hM htag

    infiniteSlopeSelectedScanWitnessDelta, hbad] using
    (infiniteSlopeAboveWitnessOfMem_witness hM hbad)

name: infiniteSlopeSelectedScan_tripleCoverInputs
statement:
private theorem infiniteSlopeSelectedScan_tripleCoverInputs
    {a b M : Point} {f : Map}
    (hM : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M) :
    And
      (TaggedGaugeCoreCountableCover
        (IntervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet a b f)
        (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanDelta a b M f hM)
        (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanLeft a b M f hM)
        (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanRight a b M f hM)
        (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM))
      (And
        (forall i : Nat,
          forall xi : Point,
            infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM i = some xi ->
              RealTheory.lt
                (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanLeft a b M f hM i)
                (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanRight a b M f hM i))
        (And
          (forall i : Nat,
            forall xi : Point,
              infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM i = some xi ->
                infiniteSlopeSelectedScanDelta a b M f hM
                    (selectedTagPoint
                      (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM) i) =
                  RealFunction.dist
                    (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanWitness a b M f hM i)
                    (selectedTagPoint
                      (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM) i))
          (And
            (forall i : Nat,
              forall xi : Point,
                infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM i = some xi ->
                  And
                    (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
                      (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft
                        (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanDelta a b M f hM)
                        (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM) i))
                    (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
                      (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight
                        (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanDelta a b M f hM)
                        (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM) i)))
            (forall i : Nat,
              forall xi : Point,
                infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM i = some xi ->
                  SlopeAboveCellWitness (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f
                    (selectedTagPoint
                      (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanTag a b M f hM) i)
                    M a b
                    (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanWitnessDelta
                      a b M f hM i)
                    (infiniteSlopeSelectedScanWitness
                      a b M f hM i)))))
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (infiniteSlopeSelectedScan_cover hM) ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro i xi htag
    exact infiniteSlopeSelectedScan_activeCore_strictOrdered hM htag
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro i xi htag
    exact infiniteSlopeSelectedScan_delta_dist_witness hM htag
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro i xi htag
    exact infiniteSlopeSelectedScan_bounds hM htag
  · intro i xi htag
    exact infiniteSlopeSelectedScan_datum hM htag

name: subFun_increment_eq_variation_add_reverse_increment
statement:
private theorem subFun_increment_eq_variation_add_reverse_increment
    (V f : Map) (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealFunction.SubFun V f y) (RealFunction.SubFun V f x) =
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub (V y) (V x))
        (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealFunction.SubFun
  change
    F.sub (F.sub (V y) (f y)) (F.sub (V x) (f x)) =
      F.add (F.sub (V y) (V x)) (F.sub (f x) (f y))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (V y) (f y)]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (V x) (f x)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
    F (V y) (F.neg (f y)) (V x) (F.neg (f x))]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F (f y) (f x)]
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f y) (f x)]

name: addFun_increment_eq_variation_add_increment
statement:
private theorem addFun_increment_eq_variation_add_increment

name: subFun_increment_eq_variation_sub_forward_increment
statement:
private theorem subFun_increment_eq_variation_sub_forward_increment
    (V f : Map) (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealFunction.SubFun V f y) (RealFunction.SubFun V f x) =
      RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub (V y) (V x))
        (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [subFun_increment_eq_variation_add_reverse_increment]
  change
    F.add (F.sub (V y) (V x)) (F.sub (f x) (f y)) =
      F.sub (F.sub (V y) (V x)) (F.sub (f y) (f x))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f y) (f x)]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg
    (F.add (V y) (F.neg (V x))) (F.sub (f y) (f x))]

name: addFun_increment_eq_variation_sub_reverse_increment
statement:
private theorem addFun_increment_eq_variation_sub_reverse_increment
    (V f : Map) (x y : Point) :

      F.sub (F.sub (V y) (V x)) (F.sub (f x) (f y))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f x) (f y)]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg
    (F.add (V y) (F.neg (V x))) (F.sub (f x) (f y))]

name: reverse_increment_le_totalVariation_increment
statement:
private theorem reverse_increment_le_totalVariation_increment
    {a b x y : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))
      (RealTheory.sub
        (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f y)
        (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f x))
proof:
:= by
  have hinc :=
    _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_increment_abs_le
      h hx hy hxy
  have hsub_le_abs :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))) := by
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    change
      F.le (F.sub (f x) (f y))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f y) (f x)))
    have hle :
        F.le (F.sub (f x) (f y))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub (f x) (f y))) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_abs_self F (F.sub (f x) (f y))
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm F (f x) (f y)] at hle
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hsub_le_abs hinc

name: forward_increment_le_totalVariation_increment
statement:
private theorem forward_increment_le_totalVariation_increment
    {a b x y : Point} {f : Map}
    (h : _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))
      (RealTheory.sub
        (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f y)
        (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f x))
proof:
:= by
  have hinc :=
    _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_increment_abs_le
      h hx hy hxy
  exact RealTheory.le_trans
    (RealTheory.le_abs_self (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))) hinc

name: twoPointSlopeBelow_subFunTotalVariation_increment_gt_add
statement:
theorem twoPointSlopeBelow_subFunTotalVariation_increment_gt_add
    {a b x y A : Point} {f : Map}
    (hBV :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y)
    (hbelow : RealTheory.lt (TwoPointSlope f x y) (RealTheory.neg A)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.sub y x))
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.sub y x)))
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealFunction.SubFun
          (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f)
          f y)
        (RealFunction.SubFun
          (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f)
          f x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let len := RealTheory.sub y x
  let V : Map :=
    _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f
  have hxy_le : RealTheory.le x y :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxy
  have hslope :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul A len)
        (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) := by
    unfold len
    exact twoPointSlopeBelow_increment_of_lt
      (f := f) (A := A) (x := x) (y := y) hxy hbelow
  have htv :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))
        (RealTheory.sub (V y) (V x)) := by
    unfold V
