name: slopeBelowCellWitness_subFunTotalVariation_centeredControl_intervalListLength_le
statement:
private theorem slopeBelowCellWitness_subFunTotalVariation_centeredControl_intervalListLength_le
    {source : Type u} {E : Domain}
    {tag witness cellLeft cellRight delta : source -> Point}
    (sources : List source) {a b u v A : Point} {f : Map}
    (hBV :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hu : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b u)
    (hv : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b v)
    (huv : RealTheory.le u v)
    (hordered :
      IntervalListOrdered
        (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i))
        (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i))
        sources)
    (hfinite :
      FiniteDisjointSubfamily
        (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i))
        (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i))
        sources)
    (hbounds :
      forall i : source,
        List.Mem i sources ->
          And
            (RealTheory.le u
              (centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i)))
            (RealTheory.le
              (centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i)) v))
    (hbelow :
      forall i : source,
        List.Mem i sources ->
          SlopeBelowCellWitness E f (tag i) A
            (cellLeft i) (cellRight i) (delta i) (witness i)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (intervalListLength
        (fun _i : source => RealTheory.zero)
        (fun i : source =>
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul A (RealFunction.dist (witness i) (tag i)))
            (RealTheory.mul A (RealFunction.dist (witness i) (tag i))))
        sources)
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealFunction.SubFun
          (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f)
          f v)
        (RealFunction.SubFun
          (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f)
          f u))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let V : Map :=
    _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f
  let H : Map := RealFunction.SubFun V f
  let controlL : source -> Point :=
    fun i => centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i)
  let controlR : source -> Point :=
    fun i => centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i)
  let lowerL : source -> Point := fun _i => RealTheory.zero
  let lowerR : source -> Point :=
    fun i =>
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealFunction.dist (witness i) (tag i)))
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealFunction.dist (witness i) (tag i)))
  have hmono_ab :
      RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) H := by
    unfold H V
    exact
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_sub_function_monotoneOn_closedInterval
        hBV
  have hmono_uv :
      forall x y : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v x ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v y ->
            RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (H x) (H y) := by
    intro x y hx hy hxy
    have hx_ab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x := by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hu.left hx.left
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hv.right
    have hy_ab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y := by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hu.left hy.left
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hy.right hv.right
    exact hmono_ab x y hx_ab hy_ab hxy
  have himage :
      RealTheory.le
        (intervalListLength
          (fun i : source => H (controlL i))
          (fun i : source => H (controlR i)) sources)
        (RealTheory.sub (H v) (H u)) := by
    exact
      intervalListLength_monotoneImage_le_of_disjoint_closedBounds
        (sourceL := controlL) (sourceR := controlR)
        (H := H) sources u v huv hmono_uv hordered hfinite hbounds
  have hlower :
      RealTheory.le
        (intervalListLength lowerL lowerR sources)
        (intervalListLength
          (fun i : source => H (controlL i))
          (fun i : source => H (controlR i)) sources) := by
    apply _root_.Tautology.RealInterval.intervalListLength_le_of_pointwise_length_le
    intro i hi
    have hb := hbounds i hi
    have hi_ordered := hordered i hi
    have hcontrolL_ab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (controlL i) := by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hu.left hb.left
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans
          (RealTheory.le_trans hi_ordered hb.right) hv.right
    have hcontrolR_ab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (controlR i) := by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hu.left
          (RealTheory.le_trans hb.left hi_ordered)
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hb.right hv.right
    have hcell :
        F.lt (lowerR i) (F.sub (H (controlR i)) (H (controlL i))) := by
      unfold lowerR controlL controlR H V
      exact
        slopeBelowCellWitness_subFunTotalVariation_centeredControl_increment_gt_add
          (a := a) (b := b) (x := tag i) (A := A)
          (left := cellLeft i) (right := cellRight i)
          (delta := delta i) (y := witness i) (f := f)
          hBV hcontrolL_ab hcontrolR_ab (hbelow i hi)
    unfold IntervalLengthAt
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub (lowerR i) (lowerL i))
        (RealTheory.sub (H (controlR i)) (H (controlL i)))
    unfold lowerL
    change
      F.le (F.sub (lowerR i) F.zero)
        (F.sub (H (controlR i)) (H (controlL i)))
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [F.neg_zero]
    rw [F.add_zero]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hcell
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hlower himage

name: slopeAboveCellWitness_addFunTotalVariation_centeredControl_intervalListLength_le
statement:
private theorem slopeAboveCellWitness_addFunTotalVariation_centeredControl_intervalListLength_le
    {source : Type u} {E : Domain}
    {tag witness cellLeft cellRight delta : source -> Point}
    (sources : List source) {a b u v A : Point} {f : Map}
    (hBV :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hu : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b u)
    (hv : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b v)
    (huv : RealTheory.le u v)
    (hordered :
      IntervalListOrdered
        (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i))
        (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i))
        sources)
    (hfinite :
      FiniteDisjointSubfamily
        (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i))
        (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i))
        sources)
    (hbounds :
      forall i : source,
        List.Mem i sources ->
          And
            (RealTheory.le u
              (centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i)))
            (RealTheory.le
              (centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i)) v))
    (habove :
      forall i : source,
        List.Mem i sources ->
          SlopeAboveCellWitness E f (tag i) A
            (cellLeft i) (cellRight i) (delta i) (witness i)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (intervalListLength
        (fun _i : source => RealTheory.zero)
        (fun i : source =>
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul A (RealFunction.dist (witness i) (tag i)))
            (RealTheory.mul A (RealFunction.dist (witness i) (tag i))))
        sources)
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealFunction.AddFun
          (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f)
          f v)
        (RealFunction.AddFun
          (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f)
          f u))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let V : Map :=
    _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f
  let H : Map := RealFunction.AddFun V f
  let controlL : source -> Point :=
    fun i => centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i)
  let controlR : source -> Point :=
    fun i => centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i)
  let lowerL : source -> Point := fun _i => RealTheory.zero
  let lowerR : source -> Point :=
    fun i =>
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealFunction.dist (witness i) (tag i)))
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealFunction.dist (witness i) (tag i)))
  have hmono_ab :
      RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) H := by
    unfold H V
    exact
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_add_function_monotoneOn_closedInterval
        hBV
  have hmono_uv :
      forall x y : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v x ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v y ->
            RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (H x) (H y) := by
    intro x y hx hy hxy
    have hx_ab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x := by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hu.left hx.left
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hv.right
    have hy_ab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y := by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hu.left hy.left
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hy.right hv.right
    exact hmono_ab x y hx_ab hy_ab hxy
  have himage :
      RealTheory.le
        (intervalListLength
          (fun i : source => H (controlL i))
          (fun i : source => H (controlR i)) sources)
        (RealTheory.sub (H v) (H u)) := by
    exact
      intervalListLength_monotoneImage_le_of_disjoint_closedBounds
        (sourceL := controlL) (sourceR := controlR)
        (H := H) sources u v huv hmono_uv hordered hfinite hbounds
  have hlower :
      RealTheory.le
        (intervalListLength lowerL lowerR sources)
        (intervalListLength
          (fun i : source => H (controlL i))
          (fun i : source => H (controlR i)) sources) := by
    apply _root_.Tautology.RealInterval.intervalListLength_le_of_pointwise_length_le
    intro i hi
    have hb := hbounds i hi
    have hi_ordered := hordered i hi
    have hcontrolL_ab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (controlL i) := by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hu.left hb.left
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans
          (RealTheory.le_trans hi_ordered hb.right) hv.right
    have hcontrolR_ab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (controlR i) := by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hu.left
          (RealTheory.le_trans hb.left hi_ordered)
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hb.right hv.right
    have hcell :
        F.lt (lowerR i) (F.sub (H (controlR i)) (H (controlL i))) := by
      unfold lowerR controlL controlR H V
      exact
        slopeAboveCellWitness_addFunTotalVariation_centeredControl_increment_gt_add
          (a := a) (b := b) (x := tag i) (A := A)
          (left := cellLeft i) (right := cellRight i)
          (delta := delta i) (y := witness i) (f := f)
          hBV hcontrolL_ab hcontrolR_ab (habove i hi)
    unfold IntervalLengthAt
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub (lowerR i) (lowerL i))
        (RealTheory.sub (H (controlR i)) (H (controlL i)))
    unfold lowerL
    change
      F.le (F.sub (lowerR i) F.zero)
        (F.sub (H (controlR i)) (H (controlL i)))
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [F.neg_zero]
    rw [F.add_zero]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hcell
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hlower himage

statement:
private theorem finiteIntervalSelectionConsumedGoal_sourceLength_le_mul_three_of_selected_bound
    {source : Type u} {control : Type v}
    {sourceL sourceR : source -> Point} {sources : List source}
    {controlL controlR : control -> Point} {controls : List control}
    {B : Point}
    (hgoal :
      FiniteIntervalSelectionConsumedGoal sourceL sourceR sources
        controlL controlR controls)
    (hbound :
      forall selected : List control,
        FiniteIntervalSelectionLengthControl sourceL sourceR sources
          controlL controlR controls selected ->
          RealTheory.le (intervalListLength controlL controlR selected) B) :
    RealTheory.le (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR sources)
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) B)
proof:
:= by
  match hgoal with
  | Exists.intro selected hselected =>
      have hsource :
          RealTheory.le (intervalListLength sourceL sourceR sources)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
              (intervalListLength controlL controlR selected)) :=
        hselected.right.right
      have hcontrol :
          RealTheory.le (intervalListLength controlL controlR selected) B :=
        hbound selected hselected
      have hscaled :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
              (intervalListLength controlL controlR selected))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) B) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hcontrol
          (RealTheory.nat_nonneg 3)
      exact RealTheory.le_trans hsource hscaled

name: fixedPartitionGapSelectedScan_bounds
statement:
private theorem fixedPartitionGapSelectedScan_bounds
    {a b A xi : Point} {g : Map} {n i : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}

      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.StrictIntervalPartition
        a b n p)
    (htag : fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag a b A g p n hA hp i =
      some xi) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le
        (p (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanCellOf a b A g p n hA hp i))
        (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft
          (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanDelta a b A g p n hA hp)
          (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag a b A g p n hA hp) i))
      (RealTheory.le
        (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight
          (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanDelta a b A g p n hA hp)
          (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag a b A g p n hA hp) i)
        (p (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanCellOf a b A g p n hA hp i + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let tag := fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag a b A g p n hA hp
  let delta := fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanDelta a b A g p n hA hp
  let witness := fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanWitness a b A g p n hA hp i
  have hbad := fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTagPoint_mem hA hp htag
  have hdeltaDist :
      delta (selectedTagPoint tag i) =
        RealFunction.dist witness (selectedTagPoint tag i) := by
    unfold delta
    unfold witness
    exact fixedPartitionGapSelectedScan_delta_dist_witness hA hp htag
  have hleftEq :
      TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tag i =
        centeredWitnessControlLeft (selectedTagPoint tag i) witness :=
    taggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft_eq_centeredWitnessControlLeft htag hdeltaDist
  have hrightEq :
      TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tag i =
        centeredWitnessControlRight (selectedTagPoint tag i) witness :=
    taggedGaugeOpenCoverRight_eq_centeredWitnessControlRight htag hdeltaDist
  have hgaugeLt :=
    fixedPartitionGapSelectedGaugeOfMem_lt_cellGauge hA hp hbad
  have hleftDist :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist
          (centeredWitnessControlLeft (selectedTagPoint tag i) witness)
          (selectedTagPoint tag i))
        (fixedPartitionGapCellGaugeOfMem hA hp hbad) := by
    rw [centeredWitnessControlLeft_dist_eq]
    unfold witness
    simpa [fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanWitness,
      fixedPartitionGapSelectedGaugeOfMem, hbad] using hgaugeLt
  have hrightDist :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist
          (centeredWitnessControlRight (selectedTagPoint tag i) witness)
          (selectedTagPoint tag i))
        (fixedPartitionGapCellGaugeOfMem hA hp hbad) := by
    rw [centeredWitnessControlRight_dist_eq]
    unfold witness
    simpa [fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanWitness,
      fixedPartitionGapSelectedGaugeOfMem, hbad] using hgaugeLt
  have hleftOpen :=
    fixedPartitionGapCellGaugeOfMem_cell hA hp hbad
      (centeredWitnessControlLeft (selectedTagPoint tag i) witness)
      hleftDist
  have hrightOpen :=
    fixedPartitionGapCellGaugeOfMem_cell hA hp hbad
      (centeredWitnessControlRight (selectedTagPoint tag i) witness)
      hrightDist
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · rw [hleftEq]
    simpa [tag, fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanCellOf, hbad] using
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hleftOpen.left)
  · rw [hrightEq]
    simpa [tag, fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanCellOf, hbad] using
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hrightOpen.right)

name: fixedPartitionGapSelectedScan_tripleCoverInputs
statement:
private theorem fixedPartitionGapSelectedScan_tripleCoverInputs
    {a b A : Point} {g : Map} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A)
    (hp :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.StrictIntervalPartition
        a b n p) :
    And
      (TaggedGaugeCoreCountableCover
        (FixedPartitionNormalizedGapNonEndpointSet a b g A p n)
        (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanDelta a b A g p n hA hp)
        (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanLeft a b A g p n hA hp)
        (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanRight a b A g p n hA hp)
        (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag a b A g p n hA hp))
      (And
        (forall i : Nat,
          forall xi : Point,
            fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag a b A g p n hA hp i =
              some xi ->
              RealTheory.lt
                (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanLeft a b A g p n hA hp i)
                (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanRight a b A g p n hA hp i))
        (And
          (forall i : Nat,
            forall xi : Point,
              fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag a b A g p n hA hp i =
                some xi ->
                fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanCellOf a b A g p n hA hp i < n)
          (And
            (forall i : Nat,
              forall xi : Point,
                fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag a b A g p n hA hp i =
                  some xi ->
                  fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanDelta a b A g p n hA hp
                      (selectedTagPoint
                        (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag
                          a b A g p n hA hp) i) =
                    fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanGaugeRadius
                      a b A g p n hA hp i)
            (And
              (forall i : Nat,
                forall xi : Point,
                  fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag a b A g p n hA hp i =
                    some xi ->
                    And
                      (RealTheory.le
                        (p (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanCellOf
                          a b A g p n hA hp i))
                        (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft
                          (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanDelta
                            a b A g p n hA hp)
                          (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag
                            a b A g p n hA hp) i))
                      (RealTheory.le
                        (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight
                          (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanDelta
                            a b A g p n hA hp)
                          (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag
                            a b A g p n hA hp) i)
                        (p (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanCellOf
                          a b A g p n hA hp i + 1))))
              (forall i : Nat,
                forall xi : Point,
                  fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag a b A g p n hA hp i =
                    some xi ->
                    CellSignSelectedWitnessDatum
                      (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) g g
                      (p (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanCellOf
                        a b A g p n hA hp i))
                      (p (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanCellOf
                        a b A g p n hA hp i + 1))
                      (selectedTagPoint
                        (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanTag
                          a b A g p n hA hp) i)
                      A
                      (p (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanCellOf
                        a b A g p n hA hp i))
                      (p (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanCellOf
                        a b A g p n hA hp i + 1))
                      (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanWitnessDelta
                        a b A g p n hA hp i)
                      (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanYAbove
                        a b A g p n hA hp i)
                      (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanYBelow
                        a b A g p n hA hp i)
                      (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanWitness
                        a b A g p n hA hp i)
                      (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScanGaugeRadius
                        a b A g p n hA hp i))))))
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (fixedPartitionGapSelectedScan_cover hA hp) ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro i xi htag
    exact fixedPartitionGapSelectedScan_activeCore_strictOrdered hA hp htag
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro i xi htag
    exact fixedPartitionGapSelectedScan_cellOf_lt hA hp htag
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro i xi htag
    exact fixedPartitionGapSelectedScan_radius hA hp htag
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro i xi htag
    exact fixedPartitionGapSelectedScan_bounds hA hp htag
  · intro i xi htag
    exact fixedPartitionGapSelectedScan_datum hA hp htag

name: fixedGapBudget_nine_div_eighteen_lt_one
statement:
private theorem fixedGapBudget_nine_div_eighteen_lt_one :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 9)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 18)))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right F
    (z := RealTheory.nat 18)
  · have hleft :
        F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9)
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18))) (RealTheory.nat 18) =
          RealTheory.nat 9 := by
        calc
          F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9)
              (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18))) (RealTheory.nat 18)
              =
            F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9)
              (F.mul (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18))
                (RealTheory.nat 18)) := by
                rw [F.mul_assoc]
          _ = F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9) RealTheory.one := by
                change
                  F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9)
                    (F.mul (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18))
                      (RealTheory.nat 18)) =
                  F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9) F.one
                rw [F.inv_mul_cancel fixedGapBudget_nat18_ne_zero]
          _ = RealTheory.nat 9 := by
                change F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9) F.one =
                  RealTheory.nat 9
                rw [F.mul_one]
    have hright :
        F.mul RealTheory.one (RealTheory.nat 18) = RealTheory.nat 18 := by
      change F.mul F.one (RealTheory.nat 18) = RealTheory.nat 18
      rw [F.one_mul]
    change
      F.lt
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9)
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18)))
          (RealTheory.nat 18))
        (F.mul RealTheory.one (RealTheory.nat 18))
    rw [hleft, hright]
    exact RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt (by decide)
  · exact fixedGapBudget_nat18_pos

name: fixedGapBudgetEta_pos
statement:
private theorem fixedGapBudgetEta_pos
    {A eps : Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (fixedGapBudgetEta A eps)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedGapBudgetEta
  have hmul : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul eps A) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos heps hA
  have hinv18 :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 18)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      fixedGapBudget_nat18_pos

name: fixedGapBudget_inv_mul_eta_eq_eps_mul_inv18
statement:
private theorem fixedGapBudget_inv_mul_eta_eq_eps_mul_inv18
    {A eps : Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv A) (fixedGapBudgetEta A eps) =
      RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 18))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hA_ne : Not (A = RealTheory.zero) :=
    fun h => (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hA) h.symm
  unfold fixedGapBudgetEta
  calc
    F.mul (F.inv A)
        (F.mul (F.mul eps A) (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18)))
        =
      F.mul (F.mul (F.inv A) (F.mul eps A))
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18)) := by
          exact Eq.symm
            (F.mul_assoc (F.inv A) (F.mul eps A)
              (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18)))
    _ =
      F.mul eps (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18)) := by
          have hinner :
              F.mul (F.inv A) (F.mul eps A) = eps := by
            calc
              F.mul (F.inv A) (F.mul eps A) =
                  F.mul (F.mul (F.inv A) eps) A := by
                    rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
              _ = F.mul (F.mul eps (F.inv A)) A := by
                    rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv A) eps]
              _ = F.mul eps (F.mul (F.inv A) A) := by
                    rw [F.mul_assoc]
              _ = F.mul eps RealTheory.one := by
                    change F.mul eps (F.mul (F.inv A) A) =
                      F.mul eps F.one
                    rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hA_ne]
              _ = eps := by
                    change F.mul eps F.one = eps
                    rw [F.mul_one]
          rw [hinner]

name: fixedGapBudget_triple_eta_eq_eps_mul_nine_div_eighteen
statement:
private theorem fixedGapBudget_triple_eta_eq_eps_mul_nine_div_eighteen
    {A eps : Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv A) (fixedGapBudgetEta A eps))) =
      RealTheory.mul eps
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 9)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 18)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [fixedGapBudget_inv_mul_eta_eq_eps_mul_inv18 hA]
  have hthree_three :
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) (RealTheory.nat 3) =
        RealTheory.nat 9 := by
    rw [<- RealTheory.nat_mul 3 3]
  calc
    F.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
          (F.mul eps (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18))))
        =
      F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) (RealTheory.nat 3))
        (F.mul eps (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18))) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9)
        (F.mul eps (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18))) := by
          rw [hthree_three]
    _ =
      F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9) eps)
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
      F.mul (F.mul eps (RealTheory.nat 9))
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (RealTheory.nat 9) eps]
    _ =
      F.mul eps
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9) (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: fixedGapBudgetEta_budget_lt
statement:
private theorem fixedGapBudgetEta_budget_lt
    {A eps : Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv A) (fixedGapBudgetEta A eps))))
      eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [fixedGapBudget_triple_eta_eq_eps_mul_nine_div_eighteen hA]
  have hscaled :
      F.lt
        (F.mul eps
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9)
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18))))
        (F.mul eps RealTheory.one) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left F
      fixedGapBudget_nine_div_eighteen_lt_one heps
  have hscaled' :
      F.lt
        (F.mul eps

    change

        (F.mul eps
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 9)
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 18))))
        (F.mul eps F.one) at hscaled
    rwa [F.mul_one] at hscaled
  exact hscaled'

name: centeredWitnessControl_length_eq_add_dist
statement:
private theorem centeredWitnessControl_length_eq_add_dist
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (centeredWitnessControlRight x y)
        (centeredWitnessControlLeft x y) =
      RealTheory.add (RealFunction.dist y x) (RealFunction.dist y x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := RealFunction.dist y x
  unfold centeredWitnessControlRight
  unfold centeredWitnessControlLeft
  change F.sub (F.add x d) (F.sub x d) = F.add d d
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg x d]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F x d x (F.neg d)]
  have hxx : F.sub x x = F.zero := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, F.add_neg]
  have hdn : F.sub d (F.neg d) = F.add d d := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg]
  rw [hxx, hdn, F.zero_add]

name: intervalListLength_zero_add_self_eq_add_self_intervalListLength
statement:
private theorem intervalListLength_zero_add_self_eq_add_self_intervalListLength
    {source : Type u} (upper : source -> Point) :
    forall sources : List source,
      intervalListLength (fun _i : source => RealTheory.zero)
          (fun i : source => RealTheory.add (upper i) (upper i))
          sources =
        RealTheory.add
          (intervalListLength (fun _i : source => RealTheory.zero)
            upper sources)
          (intervalListLength (fun _i : source => RealTheory.zero)
            upper sources)
  | [] => by
      unfold intervalListLength
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  | i :: sources => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have ih :=
        intervalListLength_zero_add_self_eq_add_self_intervalListLength
          upper sources
      unfold intervalListLength
      unfold IntervalLengthAt
      change
        F.add (F.sub (F.add (upper i) (upper i)) F.zero)
            (intervalListLength (fun _i : source => RealTheory.zero)
              (fun i : source => RealTheory.add (upper i) (upper i))
              sources) =
          F.add
            (F.add (F.sub (upper i) F.zero)
              (intervalListLength (fun _i : source => RealTheory.zero)
                upper sources))
            (F.add (F.sub (upper i) F.zero)
              (intervalListLength (fun _i : source => RealTheory.zero)
                upper sources))
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero]
      rw [ih]
      let tail :=
        intervalListLength (fun _i : source => RealTheory.zero)
          upper sources
      change
        F.add (F.add (upper i) (upper i)) (F.add tail tail) =
          F.add (F.add (upper i) tail) (F.add (upper i) tail)
      calc
        F.add (F.add (upper i) (upper i)) (F.add tail tail) =
            F.add (upper i) (F.add (upper i) (F.add tail tail)) := by
              rw [F.add_assoc]
        _ = F.add (upper i) (F.add (F.add (upper i) tail) tail) := by
              rw [F.add_assoc (upper i) tail tail]
        _ = F.add (upper i) (F.add tail (F.add (upper i) tail)) := by
              rw [F.add_comm (F.add (upper i) tail) tail]
        _ = F.add (F.add (upper i) tail) (F.add (upper i) tail) := by
              rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: nat_two_mul_eq_add_self
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.mul (F.nat 2) x = F.add x x
  have htwo : F.nat 2 = F.add F.one F.one := by
    change F.nat (1 + 1) = F.add F.one F.one
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_one]
  rw [htwo]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  change F.add (F.mul F.one x) (F.mul F.one x) = F.add x x
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: slopeAboveCellWitness_monotone_centeredControl_intervalListLength_le_add
statement:
private theorem slopeAboveCellWitness_monotone_centeredControl_intervalListLength_le_add
    {source : Type u} {E : Domain}
    {tag witness cellLeft cellRight delta : source -> Point}
    (sources : List source) {a b u v A : Point} {f : Map}
    (hmono : RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hu : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b u)
    (hv : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b v)
    (huv : RealTheory.le u v)
    (hordered :
      IntervalListOrdered
        (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i))
        (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i))
        sources)
    (hfinite :
      FiniteDisjointSubfamily
        (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i))
        (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i))
        sources)
    (hbounds :
      forall i : source,
        List.Mem i sources ->
          And
            (RealTheory.le u
              (centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i)))
            (RealTheory.le
              (centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i)) v))
    (habove :
      forall i : source,
        List.Mem i sources ->
          SlopeAboveCellWitness E f (tag i) A
            (cellLeft i) (cellRight i) (delta i) (witness i)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul A
        (intervalListLength
          (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i))
          (fun i : source => centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i))
          sources))
      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u))
        (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let controlL : source -> Point :=
    fun i => centeredWitnessControlLeft (tag i) (witness i)
  let controlR : source -> Point :=
    fun i => centeredWitnessControlRight (tag i) (witness i)
  let lowerL : source -> Point := fun _i => RealTheory.zero
  let lowerR : source -> Point :=
    fun i => RealTheory.mul A (RealFunction.dist (witness i) (tag i))
  have hmono_uv :
      forall x y : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v x ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v y ->
            RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (f x) (f y) := by
    intro x y hx hy hxy
    have hx_ab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x := by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hu.left hx.left
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hv.right
    have hy_ab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y := by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hu.left hy.left
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hy.right hv.right
    exact hmono x y hx_ab hy_ab hxy
  have himage :
      RealTheory.le
        (intervalListLength
          (fun i : source => f (controlL i))
          (fun i : source => f (controlR i)) sources)
        (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)) := by
    exact
      intervalListLength_monotoneImage_le_of_disjoint_closedBounds
        (sourceL := controlL) (sourceR := controlR)
        (H := f) sources u v huv hmono_uv hordered hfinite hbounds
  have hlower :
      RealTheory.le
        (intervalListLength lowerL lowerR sources)
        (intervalListLength
          (fun i : source => f (controlL i))
          (fun i : source => f (controlR i)) sources) := by
    apply _root_.Tautology.RealInterval.intervalListLength_le_of_pointwise_length_le
    intro i hi
    have hb := hbounds i hi
    have hi_ordered := hordered i hi
    have hcontrolL_ab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (controlL i) := by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hu.left hb.left
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans
          (RealTheory.le_trans hi_ordered hb.right) hv.right
    have hcontrolR_ab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (controlR i) := by
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hu.left
          (RealTheory.le_trans hb.left hi_ordered)
      · exact RealTheory.le_trans hb.right hv.right
    have hcell :
        F.lt (lowerR i) (F.sub (f (controlR i)) (f (controlL i))) := by
      unfold lowerR controlL controlR
      exact
        slopeAboveCellWitness_monotone_centeredControl_increment_gt
          (a := a) (b := b) (x := tag i) (A := A)
          (left := cellLeft i) (right := cellRight i)
          (delta := delta i) (y := witness i) (f := f)
          hmono hcontrolL_ab hcontrolR_ab (habove i hi)
    unfold IntervalLengthAt
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub (lowerR i) (lowerL i))
        (RealTheory.sub (f (controlR i)) (f (controlL i)))
    unfold lowerL
    change
      F.le (F.sub (lowerR i) F.zero)
        (F.sub (f (controlR i)) (f (controlL i)))
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [F.neg_zero]
    rw [F.add_zero]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hcell
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (intervalListLength lowerL lowerR sources)
        (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)) :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hlower himage
  have hscaled :
      RealTheory.mul A
          (intervalListLength controlL controlR sources) =
        intervalListLength lowerL
          (fun i : source =>
            RealTheory.add (lowerR i) (lowerR i)) sources := by
    unfold controlL
    unfold controlR
    unfold lowerL
    unfold lowerR
    exact
      centeredWitnessControl_scaled_intervalListLength_eq A
        tag witness sources
  have hdouble :
      intervalListLength lowerL
          (fun i : source =>
            RealTheory.add (lowerR i) (lowerR i)) sources =
        RealTheory.add
          (intervalListLength lowerL lowerR sources)
          (intervalListLength lowerL lowerR sources) := by
    unfold lowerL
    exact
      intervalListLength_zero_add_self_eq_add_self_intervalListLength
        lowerR sources
  rw [hscaled, hdouble]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hsum hsum

name: le_inv_mul_of_mul_le_of_pos_left
statement:
private theorem le_inv_mul_of_mul_le_of_pos_left
    {A L S : Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A)
    (h : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul A L) S) :
    RealTheory.le L (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv A) S)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hA_ne : Not (A = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hA hzero.symm
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv A) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hA)
  have hmul :
      F.le (F.mul (F.inv A) (F.mul A L))
        (F.mul (F.inv A) S) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F h hinv_nonneg
  have hleft : F.mul (F.inv A) (F.mul A L) = L := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.inv A) (F.mul A L) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.inv A) A) L := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul F.one L := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hA_ne]
      _ = L := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
  rwa [hleft] at hmul

name: selectedTaggedControl_intervalListLength_le_of_centeredBudget
statement:
private theorem selectedTaggedControl_intervalListLength_le_of_centeredBudget
    {delta : Point -> Point} {tagOpt : Nat -> Option Point}
    {witness : Nat -> Point} (selected : List Nat)
    {u v A budget : Point}
    (htag :
      forall n : Nat,
        List.Mem n selected -> Exists (fun xi : Point => tagOpt n = some xi))
    (hradius :
      forall n : Nat,
        List.Mem n selected ->
          delta (selectedTagPoint tagOpt n) =
            RealFunction.dist (witness n) (selectedTagPoint tagOpt n))
    (hordered :
      IntervalListOrdered (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt)
        (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt) selected)
    (hfinite :
      FiniteDisjointSubfamily (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt)
        (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt) selected)
    (hbounds :
      forall n : Nat,
        List.Mem n selected ->
          And (RealTheory.le u (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt n))
            (RealTheory.le (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt n) v))
    (hcentered :
      CenteredSelectedControlBudget selected
        (selectedCenteredControlLeft tagOpt witness)
        (selectedCenteredControlRight tagOpt witness)
        u v (selectedCenteredControlScaledLength A tagOpt witness selected)
        budget) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul A
        (intervalListLength (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt)
          (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt) selected))
      budget
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :
      forall n : Nat,
        List.Mem n selected ->
          TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt n =
            selectedCenteredControlLeft tagOpt witness n := by
    intro n hn
    unfold selectedCenteredControlLeft
    exact
      taggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft_eq_centeredWitnessControlLeft_on_selected
        htag hradius n hn
  have hright :
      forall n : Nat,
        List.Mem n selected ->
          TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt n =
            selectedCenteredControlRight tagOpt witness n := by
    intro n hn
    unfold selectedCenteredControlRight
    exact
      taggedGaugeOpenCoverRight_eq_centeredWitnessControlRight_on_selected
        htag hradius n hn
  have horderedCentered :
      IntervalListOrdered
        (selectedCenteredControlLeft tagOpt witness)
        (selectedCenteredControlRight tagOpt witness) selected := by
    unfold selectedCenteredControlLeft
    unfold selectedCenteredControlRight
    exact
      taggedGaugeEndpoints_selected_ordered_as_centered
        htag hradius hordered
  have hfiniteCentered :
      FiniteDisjointSubfamily
        (selectedCenteredControlLeft tagOpt witness)
        (selectedCenteredControlRight tagOpt witness) selected := by
    unfold selectedCenteredControlLeft
    unfold selectedCenteredControlRight
    exact
      taggedGaugeEndpoints_selected_finiteDisjoint_as_centered
        htag hradius hfinite
  have hboundsCentered :
      forall n : Nat,
        List.Mem n selected ->
          And
            (RealTheory.le u (selectedCenteredControlLeft tagOpt witness n))
            (RealTheory.le
              (selectedCenteredControlRight tagOpt witness n) v) := by
    intro n hn
    have hb := hbounds n hn
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · rw [<- hleft n hn]
      exact hb.left
    · rw [<- hright n hn]
      exact hb.right
  have hbudget :
      RealTheory.le
        (selectedCenteredControlScaledLength A tagOpt witness selected)
        budget := by
    unfold CenteredSelectedControlBudget at hcentered
    exact hcentered horderedCentered hfiniteCentered hboundsCentered
  have hlen :
      intervalListLength (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt)
          (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt) selected =
        intervalListLength
          (selectedCenteredControlLeft tagOpt witness)
          (selectedCenteredControlRight tagOpt witness) selected := by
    unfold selectedCenteredControlLeft
    unfold selectedCenteredControlRight
    exact
      taggedGaugeEndpoints_intervalListLength_eq_centered
        selected htag hradius
  have hscaled :
      RealTheory.mul A
          (intervalListLength
            (selectedCenteredControlLeft tagOpt witness)
            (selectedCenteredControlRight tagOpt witness) selected) =
        selectedCenteredControlScaledLength A tagOpt witness selected := by
    unfold selectedCenteredControlLeft
    unfold selectedCenteredControlRight
    unfold selectedCenteredControlScaledLength
    exact
      centeredWitnessControl_scaled_intervalListLength_eq A
        (selectedTagPoint tagOpt) witness selected
  rw [hlen, hscaled]
  exact hbudget

name: finiteSum_add_single_of_lt
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_add_single_of_lt
    (term : Nat -> Point) (a : Point) :
    forall {c n : Nat},
      c < n ->
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            if k = c then RealTheory.add a (term k) else term k)
          n =
          RealTheory.add a (RealTheory.finiteSum term n)
  | c, 0, hc => by
      omega
  | c, n + 1, hc => by
      classical
      by_cases hcn : c = n
      · subst c
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ, RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
        have hprefix :
            RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat =>
                  if k = n then RealTheory.add a (term k) else term k)
                n =
              RealTheory.finiteSum term n
proof:
:= by
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
          intro k hk
          have hkn : Not (k = n) := by
            omega
          simp [hkn]
        rw [hprefix]
        simp
        calc
          RealTheory.add (RealTheory.finiteSum term n)
              (RealTheory.add a (term n)) =
              RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.finiteSum term n) a)
                (term n) := by
              rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
          _ = RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.add a (RealTheory.finiteSum term n))
                (term n) := by
              rw [RealTheory.add_comm (RealTheory.finiteSum term n) a]
          _ = RealTheory.add a
                (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.finiteSum term n) (term n)) := by
              rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
      · have hclt : c < n := by
          omega
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ, RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
        have hprefix :
            RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat =>
                  if k = c then RealTheory.add a (term k) else term k)
                n =
              RealTheory.add a (RealTheory.finiteSum term n) :=
          finiteSum_add_single_of_lt term a hclt
        rw [hprefix]
        have hnc : Not (n = c) := by
          intro h
          exact hcn h.symm
        simp [hnc]
        rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]

name: intervalListLength_eq_finiteSum_selectedControlsInCell
statement:
private theorem intervalListLength_eq_finiteSum_selectedControlsInCell
    {l r : Nat -> Point} (cellOf : Nat -> Nat) :
    forall (n : Nat) (selected : List Nat),
      (forall i : Nat, List.Mem i selected -> cellOf i < n) ->
        intervalListLength l r selected =
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              intervalListLength l r
                (selectedControlsInCell cellOf selected k))
            n
  | n, [], _hcell => by
      change RealTheory.zero =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            intervalListLength l r
              (selectedControlsInCell cellOf [] k))
          n
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero]
      intro k _hk
      rfl
  | n, x :: xs, hcell => by
      classical
      let a
proof:
:= IntervalLengthAt l r x
      let term := fun k : Nat =>
        intervalListLength l r (selectedControlsInCell cellOf xs k)
      have htailCell :
          forall i : Nat, List.Mem i xs -> cellOf i < n := by
        intro i hi
        exact hcell i (List.Mem.tail x hi)
      have htail :
          intervalListLength l r xs =
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                intervalListLength l r
                  (selectedControlsInCell cellOf xs k))
              n :=
        intervalListLength_eq_finiteSum_selectedControlsInCell
          cellOf n xs htailCell
      have hterm :
          RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                intervalListLength l r
                  (selectedControlsInCell cellOf (x :: xs) k))
              n =
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                if k = cellOf x then RealTheory.add a (term k)
                else term k)
              n := by
        apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = cellOf x
        · subst k
          unfold term a selectedControlsInCell
          simp [intervalListLength]
        · have hxk : Not (cellOf x = k) := by
            intro h
            exact hk h.symm
          unfold term a selectedControlsInCell
          simp [hk, hxk]
      change
        RealTheory.add (IntervalLengthAt l r x)
            (intervalListLength l r xs) =
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              intervalListLength l r
                (selectedControlsInCell cellOf (x :: xs) k))
            n
      rw [hterm]
      have hxCell : cellOf x < n :=
        hcell x (List.Mem.head xs)
      have hspike :
          RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                if k = cellOf x then RealTheory.add a (term k)
                else term k)
              n =
            RealTheory.add a (RealTheory.finiteSum term n) :=
        finiteSum_add_single_of_lt term a hxCell
      rw [hspike]
      unfold a term
      rw [<- htail]

name: selectedControlLength_mul_le_finiteSum_mul_cellFilters
statement:
private theorem selectedControlLength_mul_le_finiteSum_mul_cellFilters
    {l r : Nat -> Point} (cellOf : Nat -> Nat)
    (selected : List Nat) {n : Nat} {A : Point}
    (hcell :
      forall i : Nat, List.Mem i selected -> cellOf i < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul A (intervalListLength l r selected))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul A
            (intervalListLength l r
              (selectedControlsInCell cellOf selected k)))
        n)
proof:
:= by
  let term := fun k : Nat =>
    intervalListLength l r (selectedControlsInCell cellOf selected k)
  have hlength :
      intervalListLength l r selected =
        RealTheory.finiteSum term n :=
    intervalListLength_eq_finiteSum_selectedControlsInCell
      (l := l) (r := r) cellOf n selected hcell
  rw [hlength]
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.finiteSum term n))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul A (term k)) n)
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left A term n]
  exact RealTheory.le_refl
    (RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul A (term k)) n)

name: selectedTaggedControl_length_le_finiteSum_cellSignIncrements_of_cellFilter
statement:
private theorem selectedTaggedControl_length_le_finiteSum_cellSignIncrements_of_cellFilter
    {E : Domain} {delta : Point -> Point} {tagOpt : Nat -> Option Point}
    {witness gaugeRadius cellLeft cellRight witnessDelta : Nat -> Point}
    {yAbove yBelow : Nat -> Point}
    (selected : List Nat) (cellOf : Nat -> Nat)

    (hcell :

    (hcellEndpoints :

        k < n ->
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k))
            (And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)))
              (RealTheory.le (p k) (p (k + 1)))))
    (htag :
      forall k : Nat,
        k < n ->
          forall i : Nat,
            List.Mem i (selectedControlsInCell cellOf selected k) ->
              Exists (fun xi : Point => tagOpt i = some xi))

      forall k : Nat,
        k < n ->

            List.Mem i (selectedControlsInCell cellOf selected k) ->
              delta (selectedTagPoint tagOpt i) = gaugeRadius i)

      forall k : Nat,
        k < n ->
          IntervalListOrdered (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt)
            (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt)

        k < n ->

            (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt)
            (selectedControlsInCell cellOf selected k))

      forall k : Nat,

            List.Mem i (selectedControlsInCell cellOf selected k) ->
              And (RealTheory.le (p k)
                (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt i))

                  (p (k + 1))))
    (hdatum :
      forall k : Nat,
        k < n ->

            List.Mem i (selectedControlsInCell cellOf selected k) ->
              CellSignSelectedWitnessDatum E f g (p k) (p (k + 1))
                (selectedTagPoint tagOpt i) A (cellLeft i) (cellRight i)
                (witnessDelta i) (yAbove i) (yBelow i) (witness i)
                (gaugeRadius i)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul A
        (intervalListLength
          (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt)
          (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt) selected))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement g f a (p k) (p (k + 1)))
        n)
proof:
:= by
  apply
    selectedTaggedControl_length_le_finiteSum_cellSignIncrements
      (E := E) (delta := delta) (tagOpt := tagOpt)
      (witness := witness) (gaugeRadius := gaugeRadius)
      (cellLeft := cellLeft) (cellRight := cellRight)
      (witnessDelta := witnessDelta)
      (yAbove := yAbove) (yBelow := yBelow)
      (selected := selected)
      (cellSelected := selectedControlsInCell cellOf selected)
      (n := n) (a := a) (b := b) (A := A)
      (f := f) (g := g) (p := p)
  · exact
      selectedControlLength_mul_le_finiteSum_mul_cellFilters
        (l := TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt)
        (r := TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt)
        cellOf selected hcell
  · exact hBV
  · exact hcellEndpoints
  · exact htag
  · exact hradius
  · exact hordered
  · exact hfinite
  · exact hbounds
  · exact hdatum

name: selectedTaggedControl_length_le_finiteSum_cellSignIncrements_of_cellOf
statement:
private theorem selectedTaggedControl_length_le_finiteSum_cellSignIncrements_of_cellOf
    {E : Domain} {delta : Point -> Point} {tagOpt : Nat -> Option Point}
    {witness gaugeRadius cellLeft cellRight witnessDelta : Nat -> Point}
    {yAbove yBelow : Nat -> Point}
    (selected : List Nat) (cellOf : Nat -> Nat)
    {n : Nat} {a b A : Point} {f g : Map} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hcell :
      forall i : Nat, List.Mem i selected -> cellOf i < n)
    (hBV :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b f)
    (hcellEndpoints :

        k < n ->
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k))
            (And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)))
              (RealTheory.le (p k) (p (k + 1)))))
    (htag :
      forall i : Nat,
        List.Mem i selected ->
          Exists (fun xi : Point => tagOpt i = some xi))
    (hradius :
      forall i : Nat,
        List.Mem i selected ->
          delta (selectedTagPoint tagOpt i) = gaugeRadius i)
    (hordered :
      IntervalListOrdered (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt)
        (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt) selected)
    (hfinite :
      FiniteDisjointSubfamily (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt)
        (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt) selected)
    (hbounds :
      forall i : Nat,
        List.Mem i selected ->
          And (RealTheory.le (p (cellOf i))
            (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt i))
            (RealTheory.le (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tagOpt i)
              (p (cellOf i + 1))))

      forall i : Nat,
        List.Mem i selected ->
          CellSignSelectedWitnessDatum E f g (p (cellOf i))

            (cellLeft i) (cellRight i) (witnessDelta i)
            (yAbove i) (yBelow i) (witness i) (gaugeRadius i)) :
    RealTheory.le

        (intervalListLength
          (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tagOpt)

proof:
:= by
  apply
    selectedTaggedControl_length_le_finiteSum_cellSignIncrements_of_cellFilter
      (E := E) (delta := delta) (tagOpt := tagOpt)
      (witness := witness) (gaugeRadius := gaugeRadius)
      (cellLeft := cellLeft) (cellRight := cellRight)
      (witnessDelta := witnessDelta)
      (yAbove := yAbove) (yBelow := yBelow)
      (selected := selected) (cellOf := cellOf)
      (n := n) (a := a) (b := b) (A := A)
      (f := f) (g := g) (p := p)
  · exact hcell
  · exact hBV
  · exact hcellEndpoints
  · intro k _hk i hi
    exact htag i (selectedControlsInCell_mem_selected hi)
  · intro k _hk i hi
    exact hradius i (selectedControlsInCell_mem_selected hi)
  · intro k _hk
    exact selectedControlsInCell_ordered hordered
  · intro k _hk
    exact selectedControlsInCell_finiteDisjoint hfinite
  · intro k _hk i hi
    have hiSelected : List.Mem i selected :=
      selectedControlsInCell_mem_selected hi
    have hki : cellOf i = k :=
      selectedControlsInCell_mem_cell hi

  · intro k _hk i hi
    have hiSelected : List.Mem i selected :=
      selectedControlsInCell_mem_selected hi

name: cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement_self_eq_variation_sub_abs
statement:
private theorem cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement_self_eq_variation_sub_abs
    (f : Map) (a u v : Point) :
    cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement f f a u v =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.sub
          (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f v)
          (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f u))
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V : Map :=
    _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f
  by_cases hforward : RealTheory.le (f u) (f v)
  · have hnonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hforward
    unfold cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement
    simp [hforward]
    change
      RealTheory.sub (RealFunction.SubFun V f v)
          (RealFunction.SubFun V f u) =
        RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub (V v) (V u))
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)))
    rw [subFun_increment_eq_variation_sub_forward_increment]
    rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
  · have hreverse : RealTheory.le (f v) (f u) :=
      reverseCellSign_of_not_forward (g := f) hforward
    have hnonpos :
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)) RealTheory.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hreverse
    unfold cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement
    simp [hforward]
    change
      RealTheory.sub (RealFunction.AddFun V f v)
          (RealFunction.AddFun V f u) =
        RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub (V v) (V u))
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)))
    rw [addFun_increment_eq_variation_sub_reverse_increment]
    rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonpos hnonpos]
    have hsubrev :
        RealTheory.sub (f u) (f v) =
          RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (f v) (f u)
    rw [hsubrev]
    rfl

name: finiteSum_cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement_self_eq_variation_sub_partitionVariation
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement_self_eq_variation_sub_partitionVariation
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.StrictIntervalPartition
        a b n p) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement f f a (p k) (p (k + 1)))
        n =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.sub
          (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f b)
          (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f a))
        (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
          f p n)
proof:
:= by
  let V : Map :=
    _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f
  have hcell :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement f f a (p k) (p (k + 1)))
          n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (V (p (k + 1))) (V (p k)))
              (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm
                f p k))
          n := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro k
    rw [cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement_self_eq_variation_sub_abs]
    unfold V
    unfold _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm
    rfl
  rw [hcell]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_sub]
  unfold _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
  have htelescope :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.sub (V (p (k + 1))) (V (p k)))
          n =
        RealTheory.sub (V (p n)) (V (p 0)) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_telescope_sub (fun k : Nat => V (p k)) n
  rw [htelescope]
  rw [_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.strictIntervalPartition_right_endpoint hp]
  rw [_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.strictIntervalPartition_left_endpoint hp]

name: finiteSum_cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement_self_eq_totalVariation_sub_partitionVariation
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement_self_eq_totalVariation_sub_partitionVariation
    {a b : Point} {f : Map} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hBV :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn
        a b f)
    (hp :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.StrictIntervalPartition
        a b n p) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement f f a (p k) (p (k + 1)))
        n =
      RealTheory.sub
        (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f b)
        (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
          f p n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f a =
        RealTheory.zero :=
    _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_self_eq_zero_of_boundedVariationOn
      hBV
  rw [finiteSum_cellSignSelectedVariationIncrement_self_eq_variation_sub_partitionVariation hp]
  rw [hleft]
  have hsubzero :
      RealTheory.sub
          (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f b)
          RealTheory.zero =
        _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F
      (_root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a f b)
  rw [hsubzero]

name: selectedTaggedControl_mul_length_le_eta_of_cellOf_nearOptimal
statement:
private theorem selectedTaggedControl_mul_length_le_eta_of_cellOf_nearOptimal
    {E : Domain} {delta : Point -> Point} {tagOpt : Nat -> Option Point}

proof:
:= by

            hp hk)

          (fun k : Nat =>

    selectedTaggedControl_length_le_finiteSum_cellSignIncrements_of_cellOf
      (E := E) (delta := delta) (tagOpt := tagOpt)

  have hselectedDeficit :

name: inv_mul_lt_of_lt_mul_pos
statement:
private theorem inv_mul_lt_of_lt_mul_pos
    {M L eps : Point}
    (hM : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M)
    (hbig : RealTheory.lt L (RealTheory.mul M eps)) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv M) L) eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hM_ne : Not (M = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hM) hzero.symm
  have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv M) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hM
  have hmul :
      F.lt (F.mul (F.inv M) L)
        (F.mul (F.inv M) (F.mul M eps)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left F hbig hinv_pos
  have hright :
      F.mul (F.inv M) (F.mul M eps) = eps := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.inv M) (F.mul M eps) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.inv M) M) eps := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul F.one eps := by
            rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hM_ne]
      _ = eps := by
            rw [F.one_mul]
  rwa [hright] at hmul

name: triple_inv_mul_budget_lt_of_large_threshold
statement:
private theorem triple_inv_mul_budget_lt_of_large_threshold
    {M S eps : Point}
    (hM : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M)
    (hbig :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) S))
        (RealTheory.mul M eps)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv M) S)))
      eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let c := RealTheory.nat 3
  have h :=
    inv_mul_lt_of_lt_mul_pos
      (M := M)
      (L := RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.mul c S))
      (eps := eps) hM hbig
  have halg :
      F.mul (F.inv M) (F.mul c (F.mul c S)) =
        F.mul c (F.mul c (F.mul (F.inv M) S)) := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.inv M) (F.mul c (F.mul c S)) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.inv M) c) (F.mul c S) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul c (F.inv M)) (F.mul c S) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv M) c]
      _ = F.mul c (F.mul (F.inv M) (F.mul c S)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul c (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv M) c) S) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc (F.inv M) c S]
      _ = F.mul c (F.mul (F.mul c (F.inv M)) S) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv M) c]
      _ = F.mul c (F.mul c (F.mul (F.inv M) S)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
  change
    F.lt (F.mul (F.inv M) (F.mul c (F.mul c S))) eps at h
  rwa [halg] at h

name: intervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet_thresholdBudget_exists
statement:
private theorem intervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet_thresholdBudget_exists
    {a b eps : Point} {f : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun M : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M)
          (RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv M)
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
                    (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))))))
            eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let diff := RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)
  let S := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) diff
  let L := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) S)
  have ha_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab
  have hb_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab
  have hfab : RealTheory.le (f a) (f b) :=
    hmono a b ha_mem hb_mem hab
  have hdiff_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero diff := by
    unfold diff
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hfab
  have hS_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero S := by
    unfold S
    exact F.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg 2) hdiff_nonneg
  have hinner_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) S) :=
    F.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg 3) hS_nonneg
  have hL_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero L := by
    unfold L
    exact F.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg 3) hinner_nonneg
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_mul_gt hL_nonneg heps with
  | intro n hn =>
      let M := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
      have hMpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M := by
        unfold M
        exact RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
      have hbig : RealTheory.lt L (RealTheory.mul M eps) := by
        have hn_le_succ : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat n) M := by
          unfold M
          exact RealTheory.nat_le_nat_succ n
        have heps_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heps
        have hmul_le :
            RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) eps)
              (RealTheory.mul M eps) :=
          RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hn_le_succ heps_nonneg
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hn hmul_le
      have hbudget :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv M) S)))
            eps :=
        triple_inv_mul_budget_lt_of_large_threshold
          (M := M) (S := S) (eps := eps) hMpos hbig
      refine Exists.intro M ?_
      refine And.intro hMpos ?_
      unfold S at hbudget
      exact hbudget

      forall i : Nat,

          tag i = some xi -> RealTheory.lt (leftCore i) (rightCore i) := by
    intro i xi htag
    exact hinputs.right.left i xi (by simpa [tag] using htag)
  have hcell :
      forall i : Nat,
        forall xi : Point, tag i = some xi -> cellOf i < n := by
    intro i xi htag
    exact hinputs.right.right.left i xi
      (by simpa [tag, cellOf] using htag)
  have hradius :
      forall i : Nat,
        forall xi : Point,
          tag i = some xi ->
            delta (selectedTagPoint tag i) = gaugeRadius i := by
    intro i xi htag
    exact hinputs.right.right.right.left i xi
      (by simpa [tag, delta, gaugeRadius] using htag)
  have hbounds :
      forall i : Nat,
        forall xi : Point,
          tag i = some xi ->
            And (RealTheory.le (p (cellOf i))
              (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverLeft delta tag i))
              (RealTheory.le (TaggedGaugeOpenCoverRight delta tag i)
                (p (cellOf i + 1))) := by
    intro i xi htag
    exact hinputs.right.right.right.right.left i xi
      (by simpa [tag, delta, cellOf] using htag)
  have hdatum :
      forall i : Nat,
        forall xi : Point,
          tag i = some xi ->
            CellSignSelectedWitnessDatum (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) g g
              (p (cellOf i)) (p (cellOf i + 1))
              (selectedTagPoint tag i) A
              (cellLeft i) (cellRight i) (witnessDelta i)
              (yAbove i) (yBelow i) (witness i) (gaugeRadius i) := by
    intro i xi htag
    exact hinputs.right.right.right.right.right i xi
      (by
        simpa [tag, cellOf, cellLeft, cellRight, witnessDelta,
          yAbove, yBelow, witness, gaugeRadius] using htag)
  have hmain :
      And
        (RealNegligibility.CountableOpenIntervalCover
          (FixedPartitionNormalizedGapNonEndpointSet a b g A p n)
          (intervalTripleLeft leftCore rightCore)
          (intervalTripleRight leftCore rightCore))
        (RealNegligibility.CoverBudgetLt
          (intervalTripleLeft leftCore rightCore)
          (intervalTripleRight leftCore rightCore) eps) :=
    taggedGaugeCore_tripleCoverBudgetLt_of_cellOf_nearOptimal
      (E := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (Sset := FixedPartitionNormalizedGapNonEndpointSet a b g A p n)
      (delta := delta) (l := leftCore) (r := rightCore)
      (tag := tag) (witness := witness)
      (gaugeRadius := gaugeRadius) (cellLeft := cellLeft)
      (cellRight := cellRight) (witnessDelta := witnessDelta)
      (yAbove := yAbove) (yBelow := yBelow)
      (cellOf := cellOf) (n := n) (a := a) (b := b)
      (A := A) (eta := eta) (eps := eps) (f := g) (p := p)
      hA hcover hactive hcell hBV hp hnear hradius hbounds hdatum hbudget
  refine Exists.intro (intervalTripleLeft leftCore rightCore) ?_
  refine Exists.intro (intervalTripleRight leftCore rightCore) ?_
  exact hmain

name: normalizedSlopeGapSet_nullSet_of_boundedVariationOn
statement:
private theorem normalizedSlopeGapSet_nullSet_of_boundedVariationOn
    {a b A : Point} {g : Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hA : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A)
    (hBV :
      _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn
        a b g) :
    RealNegligibility.NullSet (NormalizedSlopeGapSet a b g A)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let rowBudget : Nat -> Point :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadicBudget F eps
  have hbudget_pos :
      forall m : Nat, RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (rowBudget m) := by
    intro m
    change F.lt F.zero (rowBudget m)
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadicBudget_pos F heps m
  cases fixedGapBudgetEta_exists hA (hbudget_pos 0) with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases boundedVariationOn_exists_nearOptimalStrictPartition
          (f := g) hab hBV heta.left with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hpNear =>
              let endpoints :=
                _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionEndpointList
                  p n
              have hnonCover :=
                fixedPartitionNormalizedGapNonEndpointSet_tripleCoverBudgetLt_of_nearOptimal
                  (a := a) (b := b) (A := A) (eta := eta)
                  (eps := rowBudget 0) (g := g) (n := n) (p := p)
                  hA hBV hpNear.left hpNear.right heta.right
              have hendCover :=
                RealNegligibility.nullSet_pointListSet endpoints
                  (rowBudget 1) (hbudget_pos 1)
              let rowSet : Nat -> Point -> Prop :=
                fun m : Nat =>
                  match m with
                  | 0 => FixedPartitionNormalizedGapNonEndpointSet a b g A p n
                  | 1 => RealTheory.PointListSet endpoints
                  | _ + 2 => fun _ : Point => False
              let rowCoverExists :
                  forall m : Nat,
                    Exists
                      (fun left : Nat -> Point =>
                        Exists
                          (fun right : Nat -> Point =>
                            And
                              (RealNegligibility.CountableOpenIntervalCover
                                (rowSet m) left right)
                              (RealNegligibility.CoverBudgetLt left right
                                (rowBudget m)))) := by
                intro m
                cases m with
                | zero =>
                    exact hnonCover
                | succ m =>
                    cases m with
                    | zero =>
                        exact hendCover
                    | succ m =>
                        exact RealNegligibility.nullSet_empty
                          (rowBudget (m + 2)) (hbudget_pos (m + 2))
              let rowLeft : Nat -> Nat -> Point :=
                fun m : Nat => Classical.choose (rowCoverExists m)
              let rowRight : Nat -> Nat -> Point :=
                fun m : Nat =>
                  Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (rowCoverExists m))
              have hrowSpec :
                  forall m : Nat,
                    And
                      (RealNegligibility.CountableOpenIntervalCover
                        (rowSet m) (rowLeft m) (rowRight m))
                      (RealNegligibility.CoverBudgetLt (rowLeft m) (rowRight m)
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadicBudget F eps m)) := by
                intro m
                have hspec :=
                  Classical.choose_spec
                    (Classical.choose_spec (rowCoverExists m))
                simpa [rowBudget, rowLeft, rowRight] using hspec
              cases
                  RealNegligibility.countableOpenIntervalCover_countableUnion_of_dyadicBudget
                    (A := rowSet) heps rowLeft rowRight hrowSpec with
              | intro flatLeft hflatLeft =>
                  cases hflatLeft with
                  | intro flatRight hflat =>
                      refine Exists.intro flatLeft ?_
                      refine Exists.intro flatRight ?_
                      refine And.intro ?_ hflat.right
                      refine And.intro hflat.left.left ?_
                      intro x hx
                      have hrowMem :
                          RealNegligibility.CountableUnion rowSet x := by
                        by_cases hend :
                            _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.PartitionEndpoint
                              p n x
                        · refine Exists.intro 1 ?_
                          unfold rowSet
                          exact
                            _root_.Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionEndpointList_mem_of_endpoint
                              hend
                        · refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
                          unfold rowSet
                          unfold FixedPartitionNormalizedGapNonEndpointSet
                          exact And.intro hx hend
                      exact hflat.left.right x hrowMem

name: not_frequentlySlopeAbove_localUpperBound
statement:
private theorem not_frequentlySlopeAbove_localUpperBound
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x M : Point}
    (hx : E x)
    (hnot : Not (FrequentlySlopeAbove E f x M)) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall y : Point,
            PuncturedNearby E x delta y ->
              Not (RealTheory.lt M (TwoPointSlope f x y))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hex :
      Exists
        (fun delta : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
            (forall y : Point,
              PuncturedNearby E x delta y ->
                Not (RealTheory.lt M (TwoPointSlope f x y))))
  · exact hex
  have hfreq : FrequentlySlopeAbove E f x M := by
    refine And.intro hx ?_
    intro eps heps
    by_cases hwit :
        Exists
          (fun y : Point =>
            And (PuncturedNearby E x eps y)
              (RealTheory.lt M (TwoPointSlope f x y)))
    · exact hwit
    have hdelta :
        Exists
          (fun delta : Point =>
            And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
              (forall y : Point,
                PuncturedNearby E x delta y ->
                  Not (RealTheory.lt M (TwoPointSlope f x y)))) := by
      refine Exists.intro eps ?_
      refine And.intro heps ?_
      intro y hynear hhigh
      exact hwit (Exists.intro y (And.intro hynear hhigh))
    exact False.elim (hex hdelta)
  exact False.elim (hnot hfreq)

private theorem not_intervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet_localUpperBound
    {a b x : Point} {f : Map}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hnot : Not (IntervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet a b f x)) :
    Exists
      (fun M : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M)
          (Exists
            (fun delta : Point =>
              And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
                (forall y : Point,
                  PuncturedNearby (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x delta y ->
                    Not (RealTheory.lt M (TwoPointSlope f x y))))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hex :
      Exists
        (fun M : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M)
            (Exists
              (fun delta : Point =>
                And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
                  (forall y : Point,
                    PuncturedNearby
                      (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x delta y ->
                      Not (RealTheory.lt M (TwoPointSlope f x y))))))
  · exact hex
  have hbad : IntervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet a b f x := by
    unfold IntervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet LocallyUnboundedSlopeAbove
    refine And.intro hx ?_
    intro M hM
    by_cases hfreq :
        FrequentlySlopeAbove (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x M
    · exact hfreq
    have hdelta :
        Exists
          (fun delta : Point =>
            And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
              (forall y : Point,
                PuncturedNearby (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x delta y ->
                  Not (RealTheory.lt M (TwoPointSlope f x y)))) :=
      not_frequentlySlopeAbove_localUpperBound hx hfreq
    exact False.elim (hex (Exists.intro M (And.intro hM hdelta)))
  exact False.elim (hnot hbad)
