name: localBoundedSlope_of_not_monotoneSlopeExceptionalSet
statement:
private theorem localBoundedSlope_of_not_monotoneSlopeExceptionalSet
    {a b x : Point} {f : Map}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hmono : RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hnot : Not (MonotoneSlopeExceptionalSet a b f x)) :
    Exists
      (fun M : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M)
          (Exists
            (fun delta : Point =>
              And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
                (forall y : Point,
                  PuncturedNearby (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x delta y ->
                    And
                      (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (TwoPointSlope f x y))
                      (RealTheory.le (TwoPointSlope f x y) M)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnotUpper :
      Not (IntervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet a b f x) :=
    not_intervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet_of_not_monotoneSlopeExceptionalSet
      hnot
  cases
      not_intervalLocallyUnboundedSlopeAboveSet_localUpperBound
        (a := a) (b := b) (f := f) hx hnotUpper with
  | intro M hM =>
      cases hM.right with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          refine Exists.intro M ?_
          refine And.intro hM.left ?_
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          intro y hynear
          have hnonneg :
              RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (TwoPointSlope f x y) :=
            twoPointSlope_nonnegative_of_monotoneOn_openInterval
              hmono hx (puncturedNearby_mem hynear)
              (puncturedNearby_ne hynear)
          have hupperNot :
              Not (RealTheory.lt M (TwoPointSlope f x y)) :=
            hdelta.right y hynear
          have hupper :
              RealTheory.le (TwoPointSlope f x y) M :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hupperNot
          exact And.intro hnonneg hupper

name: not_cauchyAtWithin_witness
statement:
private theorem not_cauchyAtWithin_witness
    {E : Domain} {g : Map} {x0 : Point}
    (hnot : Not (RealFunction.CauchyAtWithin E g x0)) :
    Exists
      (fun eps : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
          (CauchyFailureScale E g x0 eps))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hex :
      Exists
        (fun eps : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
            (CauchyFailureScale E g x0 eps))
  · exact hex
  have hcauchy : RealFunction.CauchyAtWithin E g x0 := by
    intro eps heps
    by_cases hdeltaGood :
        Exists
          (fun delta : Point =>
            And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
              (forall y z : Point,
                E y -> E z ->
                  Not (y = x0) -> Not (z = x0) ->
                    RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x0) delta ->
                      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist z x0) delta ->
                        RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (g y) (g z)) eps))
    · exact hdeltaGood
    have hbadEps :
        Exists
          (fun eps : Point =>
            And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
              (CauchyFailureScale E g x0 eps)) := by
      refine Exists.intro eps ?_
      refine And.intro heps ?_
      intro delta hdelta
      by_cases hwit :
          Exists
            (fun y : Point =>
              Exists
                (fun z : Point =>
                  CauchyFailurePair E g x0 eps delta y z))
      · exact hwit
      have hgoodDelta :
          Exists
            (fun delta : Point =>
              And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
                (forall y z : Point,
                  E y -> E z ->
                    Not (y = x0) -> Not (z = x0) ->
                      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x0) delta ->
                        RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist z x0) delta ->
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealFunction.dist (g y) (g z)) eps)) := by
        refine Exists.intro delta ?_
        refine And.intro hdelta ?_
        intro y z hy hz hyne hzne hyd hzd
        by_cases hclose :
            RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (g y) (g z)) eps
        · exact hclose
        have hbadPair :
            Exists
              (fun y : Point =>
                Exists
                  (fun z : Point =>
                    CauchyFailurePair E g x0 eps delta y z)) := by
          exact
            Exists.intro y
              (Exists.intro z
                (And.intro hy
                  (And.intro hz
                    (And.intro hyne
                      (And.intro hzne
                        (And.intro hyd
                          (And.intro hzd hclose)))))))
        exact False.elim (hwit hbadPair)
      exact False.elim (hdeltaGood hgoodDelta)
    exact False.elim (hex hbadEps)
  exact False.elim (hnot hcauchy)

name: orderedGap_or_of_not_dist_lt
statement:
private theorem orderedGap_or_of_not_dist_lt
    {u v eps : Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    (hnot : Not (RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist u v) eps)) :
    Or
      (RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add u
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps))
        v)
      (RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add v
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps))
        u)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : F.lt F.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have he2_lt_eps : F.lt e2 eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps
  by_cases huv : F.lt (F.add u e2) v
  · exact Or.inl huv
  by_cases hvu : F.lt (F.add v e2) u
  · exact Or.inr hvu
  have hv_le_u_e2 : F.le v (F.add u e2) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F huv
  have hu_le_v_e2 : F.le u (F.add v e2) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hvu
  have hu_e2_lt_u_eps : F.lt (F.add u e2) (F.add u eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F he2_lt_eps u
  have hv_e2_lt_v_eps : F.lt (F.add v e2) (F.add v eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F he2_lt_eps v
  have hv_lt_u_eps : F.lt v (F.add u eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hv_le_u_e2 hu_e2_lt_u_eps
  have hu_lt_v_eps : F.lt u (F.add v eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hu_le_v_e2 hv_e2_lt_v_eps
  have hv_sub_u_lt_eps : F.lt (F.sub v u) eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hv_lt_u_eps
  have hv_sub_eps_lt_u : F.lt (F.sub v eps) u :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right F hv_sub_u_lt_eps
  have hdist : F.lt (RealFunction.dist u v) eps := by
    unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds F
      hv_sub_eps_lt_u hu_lt_v_eps
  exact False.elim (hnot hdist)

name: intervalSlopeGapSet_of_persistentSlopeGapWitness
statement:
private theorem intervalSlopeGapSet_of_persistentSlopeGapWitness
    {a b x s r : Point} {f : Map}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hpersist :
      forall delta : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta ->
          SlopeGapWitnessAtScale a b f x s r delta) :
    IntervalSlopeGapSet a b f r s x
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?above ?below
  · refine And.intro hx ?_
    intro delta hdelta
    cases hpersist delta hdelta with
    | intro below hbelow =>
        cases hbelow with
        | intro above habove =>
            exact
              Exists.intro above
                (And.intro habove.right.left habove.right.right.right)
  · refine And.intro hx ?_
    intro delta hdelta
    cases hpersist delta hdelta with
    | intro below hbelow =>
        cases hbelow with
        | intro above habove =>
            exact
              Exists.intro below
                (And.intro habove.left habove.right.right.left)

name: intervalSlopeGapSet_of_not_cauchyAtWithin_localBounded
statement:
private theorem intervalSlopeGapSet_of_not_cauchyAtWithin_localBounded
    {a b x M deltaBound : Point} {f : Map}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hdeltaBound : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero deltaBound)
    (hbound :
      forall y : Point,
        PuncturedNearby (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x deltaBound y ->
          And
            (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (TwoPointSlope f x y))
            (RealTheory.le (TwoPointSlope f x y) M))
    (hnotCauchy :
      Not
        (RealFunction.CauchyAtWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
          (DifferenceQuotient f x) x)) :
    Exists
      (fun s : Point =>
        Exists
          (fun r : Point =>
            And (RealTheory.InternalRat s)
              (And (RealTheory.InternalRat r)
                (And (RealTheory.lt s r)
                  (IntervalSlopeGapSet a b f r s x)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases
      not_cauchyAtWithin_witness
        (E := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
        (g := DifferenceQuotient f x) hnotCauchy with
  | intro eps0 heps0 =>
      let gap := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps0
      have hgap : F.lt F.zero gap :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps0.left
      let radius : Nat -> Point := fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.min deltaBound
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
      have hradius_pos : forall n : Nat, F.lt F.zero (radius n) := by
        intro n
        unfold radius RealTheory.min
        exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdeltaBound
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n))
      have hpairs :
          forall n : Nat,
            Exists
              (fun pair : Prod Point Point =>
                CauchyFailurePair
                  (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
                  (DifferenceQuotient f x) x eps0 (radius n)
                  pair.fst pair.snd) := by
        intro n
        cases heps0.right (radius n) (hradius_pos n) with
        | intro y hy =>
            cases hy with
            | intro z hz =>
                exact Exists.intro (Prod.mk y z) hz
      let pair : Nat -> Prod Point Point :=
        fun n : Nat => Classical.choose (hpairs n)
      have hpair :
          forall n : Nat,
            CauchyFailurePair
              (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
              (DifferenceQuotient f x) x eps0 (radius n)
              (pair n).fst (pair n).snd := by
        intro n
        simpa [pair] using Classical.choose_spec (hpairs n)
      let y : Nat -> Point := fun n : Nat => (pair n).fst
      let z : Nat -> Point := fun n : Nat => (pair n).snd
      let u : Nat -> Point := fun n : Nat => TwoPointSlope f x (y n)
      let v : Nat -> Point := fun n : Nat => TwoPointSlope f x (z n)
      let low : Nat -> Point := fun n : Nat =>
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F (u n) (v n)
      let high : Nat -> Point := fun n : Nat =>
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2 F (u n) (v n)
      have hradius_le_bound :
          forall n : Nat, F.le (radius n) deltaBound := by
        intro n
        unfold radius
        exact RealTheory.min_le_left deltaBound
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
      have hradius_le_inv :
          forall n : Nat,
            F.le (radius n)
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))) := by
        intro n
        unfold radius
        exact RealTheory.min_le_right deltaBound
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
      have hyNearBound :
          forall n : Nat,
            PuncturedNearby (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x deltaBound
              (y n) := by
        intro n
        have hn := hpair n
        exact
          puncturedNearby_of_fields hn.left hn.right.right.left
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
              hn.right.right.right.right.left
              (hradius_le_bound n))
      have hzNearBound :
          forall n : Nat,
            PuncturedNearby (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x deltaBound
              (z n) := by
        intro n
        have hn := hpair n
        exact
          puncturedNearby_of_fields hn.right.left hn.right.right.right.left
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
              hn.right.right.right.right.right.left
              (hradius_le_bound n))
      have huBound :
          forall n : Nat,
            And (F.le F.zero (u n)) (F.le (u n) M) := by
        intro n
        simpa [u] using hbound (y n) (hyNearBound n)
      have hvBound :
          forall n : Nat,
            And (F.le F.zero (v n)) (F.le (v n) M) := by
        intro n
        simpa [v] using hbound (z n) (hzNearBound n)
      have hlowBounded : RealTheory.SeqBounded low := by
        refine Exists.intro F.zero ?_
        refine Exists.intro M ?_
        intro n
        refine And.intro ?_ ?_
        · unfold low
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_min2 F
            (huBound n).left (hvBound n).left
        · exact
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_trans F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F (u n) (v n))
              (huBound n).right
      have hlowHighGap :
          forall n : Nat, F.lt (F.add (low n) gap) (high n) := by
        intro n
        have hn := hpair n
        have hnotSlopeDist :
            Not (F.lt (RealFunction.dist (u n) (v n)) eps0) := by
          simpa [u, v, y, z, twoPointSlope_eq_differenceQuotient] using
            hn.right.right.right.right.right.right
        cases orderedGap_or_of_not_dist_lt heps0.left hnotSlopeDist with
        | inl huv =>
            have hlow_u : F.le (low n) (u n) := by
              unfold low
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F (u n) (v n)
            have hadd : F.le (F.add (low n) gap) (F.add (u n) gap) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_right F hlow_u gap
            have hv_high : F.le (v n) (high n) := by
              unfold high
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_right F (u n) (v n)
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hadd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F huv hv_high)
        | inr hvu =>
            have hlow_v : F.le (low n) (v n) := by
              unfold low
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F (u n) (v n)
            have hadd : F.le (F.add (low n) gap) (F.add (v n) gap) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_right F hlow_v gap
            have hu_high : F.le (u n) (high n) := by
              unfold high
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_left F (u n) (v n)
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hadd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hvu hu_high)
      have hyTendsto : RealTheory.SeqTendsto y x := by
        apply RealFunction.seqTendsto_of_dist_lt_inv_nat_succ
        intro n
        have hn := hpair n
        exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
            hn.right.right.right.right.left (hradius_le_inv n)
      have hzTendsto : RealTheory.SeqTendsto z x := by
        apply RealFunction.seqTendsto_of_dist_lt_inv_nat_succ
        intro n
        have hn := hpair n
        exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
            hn.right.right.right.right.right.left (hradius_le_inv n)
      cases
          RealTheory.bounded_sequence_has_convergent_subsequence
            low hlowBounded with
      | intro L hL =>
          cases hL with
          | intro phi hphi =>
              have hhighPhiBounded :
                  RealTheory.SeqBounded
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence high phi) := by
                refine Exists.intro F.zero ?_
                refine Exists.intro M ?_
                intro n
                unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
                refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                · exact
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_trans F
                      (huBound (phi n)).left
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_left F
                        (u (phi n)) (v (phi n)))
                · exact
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2_le F
                      (huBound (phi n)).right (hvBound (phi n)).right
              cases
                  RealTheory.bounded_sequence_has_convergent_subsequence
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence high phi)
                    hhighPhiBounded with
              | intro H hH =>
                  cases hH with
                  | intro psi hpsi =>
                      let low2 : Nat -> Point :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence low phi) psi
                      let high2 : Nat -> Point :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence high phi) psi
                      let y2 : Nat -> Point :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence y phi) psi
                      let z2 : Nat -> Point :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence z phi) psi
                      have hlow2Tendsto : RealTheory.SeqTendsto low2 L := by
                        unfold low2
                        exact
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seqTendsto_of_subsequenceIndex
                            F hphi.right hpsi.left
                      have hhigh2Tendsto : RealTheory.SeqTendsto high2 H := by
                        exact hpsi.right
                      have hy2Tendsto : RealTheory.SeqTendsto y2 x := by
                        unfold y2
                        apply
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seqTendsto_of_subsequenceIndex
                            F
                        · exact
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seqTendsto_of_subsequenceIndex
                              F hyTendsto hphi.left
                        · exact hpsi.left
                      have hz2Tendsto : RealTheory.SeqTendsto z2 x := by
                        unfold z2
                        apply
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seqTendsto_of_subsequenceIndex
                            F
                        · exact
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seqTendsto_of_subsequenceIndex
                              F hzTendsto hphi.left
                        · exact hpsi.left
                      have hlimitGap : F.le (F.add L gap) H := by
                        apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le
                          (RealTheory.seqTendsto_add hlow2Tendsto
                            (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const gap))
                          hhigh2Tendsto
                        refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
                        intro n _hn
                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                          (hlowHighGap (phi (psi n)))
                      have hLH : F.lt L H := by
                        exact
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hgap)
                            hlimitGap
                      cases RealTheory.exists_internalRat_between hLH with
                      | intro s hs =>
                          cases
                              RealTheory.exists_internalRat_between hs.right.right with
                          | intro r hr =>
                              have hlowEventually :
                                  RealTheory.Eventually
                                    (fun n : Nat => F.lt (low2 n) s) := by
                                have hopen :=
                                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.point_in_open_interval_of_tendsto
                                    F hlow2Tendsto
                                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hgap)
                                      hs.right.left
                                exact Eventually.mono
                                  (fun n hn => hn.right) hopen
                              have hhighEventually :
                                  RealTheory.Eventually
                                    (fun n : Nat => F.lt r (high2 n)) := by
                                have hopen :=
                                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.point_in_open_interval_of_tendsto
                                    F hhigh2Tendsto hr.right.right
                                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hgap)
                                exact Eventually.mono
                                  (fun n hn => hn.left) hopen
                              have hpersist :
                                  forall delta : Point,
                                    F.lt F.zero delta ->
                                      SlopeGapWitnessAtScale
                                        a b f x s r delta := by
                                intro delta hdelta
                                have hyEventually := hy2Tendsto delta hdelta
                                have hzEventually := hz2Tendsto delta hdelta
                                have hall := Eventually.and hlowEventually
                                  (Eventually.and hhighEventually
                                    (Eventually.and hyEventually hzEventually))
                                cases hall with
                                | intro N hN =>
                                    have hNall := hN N (Nat.le_refl N)
                                    let k := phi (psi N)
                                    have hkpair := hpair k
                                    have hyClose :
                                        F.lt (RealFunction.dist (y k) x) delta := by
                                      exact hNall.right.right.left
                                    have hzClose :
                                        F.lt (RealFunction.dist (z k) x) delta := by
                                      exact hNall.right.right.right
                                    have hyNear :
                                        PuncturedNearby
                                          (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x delta
                                          (y k) :=
                                      puncturedNearby_of_fields hkpair.left
                                        hkpair.right.right.left hyClose
                                    have hzNear :
                                        PuncturedNearby
                                          (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x delta
                                          (z k) :=
                                      puncturedNearby_of_fields hkpair.right.left
                                        hkpair.right.right.right.left hzClose
                                    have hlowN : F.lt (low k) s :=
                                      hNall.left
                                    have hhighN : F.lt r (high k) :=
                                      hNall.right.left
                                    by_cases huv : F.le (u k) (v k)
                                    · have hlowEq : low k = u k := by
                                        simp [low,
                                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2, huv]
                                      have hhighEq : high k = v k := by
                                        simp [high,
                                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2, huv]
                                      refine Exists.intro (y k) ?_
                                      refine Exists.intro (z k) ?_
                                      refine And.intro hyNear ?_
                                      refine And.intro hzNear ?_
                                      exact And.intro
                                        (by simpa [hlowEq, u] using hlowN)
                                        (by simpa [hhighEq, v] using hhighN)
                                    · have hlowEq : low k = v k := by
                                        simp [low,
                                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2, huv]
                                      have hhighEq : high k = u k := by
                                        simp [high,
                                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2, huv]
                                      refine Exists.intro (z k) ?_
                                      refine Exists.intro (y k) ?_
                                      refine And.intro hzNear ?_
                                      refine And.intro hyNear ?_
                                      exact And.intro
                                        (by simpa [hlowEq, v] using hlowN)
                                        (by simpa [hhighEq, u] using hhighN)
                              refine Exists.intro s ?_
                              refine Exists.intro r ?_
                              exact And.intro hs.left
                                (And.intro hr.left
                                  (And.intro hr.right.left
                                    (intervalSlopeGapSet_of_persistentSlopeGapWitness
                                      hx hpersist)))

name: cauchyAtWithin_openInterval_of_not_monotoneSlopeExceptionalSet
statement:
private theorem cauchyAtWithin_openInterval_of_not_monotoneSlopeExceptionalSet
    {a b x : Point} {f : Map}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hmono : RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hnot : Not (MonotoneSlopeExceptionalSet a b f x)) :
    RealFunction.CauchyAtWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (DifferenceQuotient f x) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hcauchy :
      RealFunction.CauchyAtWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
        (DifferenceQuotient f x) x
  · exact hcauchy
  cases
      localBoundedSlope_of_not_monotoneSlopeExceptionalSet
        (a := a) (b := b) (x := x) (f := f)
        hx hmono hnot with
  | intro M hM =>
      cases hM.right with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          cases
              intervalSlopeGapSet_of_not_cauchyAtWithin_localBounded
                (a := a) (b := b) (x := x) (f := f)
                (M := M) (deltaBound := delta)
                hx hdelta.left hdelta.right hcauchy with
          | intro s hs =>
              cases hs with
              | intro r hr =>
                  have hnoGap :
                      Not (IntervalSlopeGapSet a b f r s x) :=
                    not_intervalSlopeGapSet_of_not_monotoneSlopeExceptionalSet
                      hnot hr.left hr.right.left hr.right.right.left
                  exact False.elim (hnoGap hr.right.right.right)

name: openInterval_clusterPoint_for_lv
statement:
private theorem openInterval_clusterPoint_for_lv

proof:

  cases openInterval_leftClusterPoint hx eps heps with

        (And.intro hy.left.left

name: differentiableWithin_openInterval_of_cauchyAtWithin
statement:
private theorem differentiableWithin_openInterval_of_cauchyAtWithin
    {a b x : Point} {f : Map}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hcauchy :
      RealFunction.CauchyAtWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
        (DifferenceQuotient f x) x) :
    DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x
proof:
:= by
  cases
      RealFunction.cauchyAtWithin_to_exists_tendstoWithin
        (openInterval_clusterPoint_for_lv hx) hcauchy with
  | intro L hL =>

name: differentiableWithin_openInterval_of_not_monotoneSlopeExceptionalSet
statement:
private theorem differentiableWithin_openInterval_of_not_monotoneSlopeExceptionalSet
    {a b x : Point} {f : Map}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hmono : RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hnot : Not (MonotoneSlopeExceptionalSet a b f x)) :
    DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x
proof:
:=
  differentiableWithin_openInterval_of_cauchyAtWithin hx
    (cauchyAtWithin_openInterval_of_not_monotoneSlopeExceptionalSet
      hx hmono hnot)

name: differentiableWithin_closedInterval_of_openInterval_at_interior
statement:
private theorem differentiableWithin_closedInterval_of_openInterval_at_interior
    {a b x : Point} {f : Map}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hf : DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) f x) :
    DifferentiableWithin (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hf with
  | intro L hL =>
      refine Exists.intro L ?_
      refine And.intro (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x hx) ?_
      intro eps heps
      cases hL.right eps heps with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          let leftGap := F.sub x a
          let rightGap := F.sub b x
          let rho := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F leftGap rightGap
          have hleftGap : F.lt F.zero leftGap := by
            unfold leftGap
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx.left
          have hrightGap : F.lt F.zero rightGap := by
            unfold rightGap
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx.right
          have hrho_pos : F.lt F.zero rho := by
            unfold rho
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hleftGap hrightGap
          let eta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F delta rho
          have heta_pos : F.lt F.zero eta := by
            unfold eta
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdelta.left hrho_pos
          refine Exists.intro eta ?_
          refine And.intro heta_pos ?_
          intro y hyClosed hyne hydist
          have hydist_delta : F.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hydist
              (by
                unfold eta
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F delta rho)
          have hydist_rho : F.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) rho :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hydist
              (by
                unfold eta
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F delta rho)
          have hyOpen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y := by
            unfold rho leftGap rightGap at hydist_rho
            exact RealFunction.mem_interval_of_dist_lt_min hx.left hx.right hydist_rho
          exact hdelta.right y hyOpen hyne hydist_delta

name: taggedGaugeCoreInterval_ordered
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le_trans
    h.right.left.left h.right.left.right

name: taggedGaugeCoreEntry_ordered

:= by
  unfold TaggedGaugeCoreEntry at h
  cases htag : tag n with
  | none =>

name: intervalAt_to_realMeasureOpenInterval
statement:
private theorem intervalAt_to_realMeasureOpenInterval
    {l r : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat} {x : Point}
    (h : IntervalAt l r n x) :
    RealNegligibility.OpenInterval (l n) (r n) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold IntervalAt at h
  change And (RealTheory.lt (l n) x) (RealTheory.lt x (r n)) at h
  unfold RealNegligibility.OpenInterval

name: intervalListLength_range_eq_seriesPartialSum_coverLength
statement:
private theorem intervalListLength_range_eq_seriesPartialSum_coverLength
    (a b : Nat -> Point) (N : Nat) :
    intervalListLength a b (List.range N) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b) N
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum_zero]
      rfl
  | succ N ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ]
      rw [intervalListLength_append]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum_succ]
      rw [ih]
      unfold intervalListLength
      unfold IntervalLengthAt
      unfold RealNegligibility.coverLength
      unfold RealNegligibility.intervalLength
      change
        RealTheory.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.sub (b n) (a n)) N)
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub (b N) (a N)) RealTheory.zero) =
          RealTheory.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.sub (b n) (a n)) N)
            (RealTheory.sub (b N) (a N))
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

name: taggedGaugeCore_intervalListLength_range_eq_selectedPrefix
statement:
private theorem taggedGaugeCore_intervalListLength_range_eq_selectedPrefix
    {S : Point -> Prop} {delta : Point -> Point}
    {l r : Nat -> Point} {tag : Nat -> Option Point}
    (hcover : TaggedGaugeCoreCountableCover S delta l r tag) :
    forall N : Nat,
      intervalListLength l r (List.range N) =
        intervalListLength l r (selectedPrefixIndices tag N)
  | 0 => by
      rfl
  | N + 1 => by
      rw [List.range_succ]
      unfold selectedPrefixIndices
      rw [List.range_succ]
      cases htag : tag N with
      | none =>
          simp [htag]
          rw [intervalListLength_append]
          have hlastZero :
              intervalListLength l r [N] = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
            unfold intervalListLength
            unfold IntervalLengthAt
            have hentry : TaggedGaugeCoreEntry S delta l r tag N :=
              hcover.left N
            unfold TaggedGaugeCoreEntry at hentry
            rw [htag] at hentry
            rw [hentry]
            change
              RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub (r N) (r N))
                  RealTheory.zero =
                RealTheory.zero
            have hsubzero :
                RealTheory.sub (r N) (r N) = RealTheory.zero :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (r N)
            rw [hsubzero]
            rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
          rw [hlastZero]
          rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
          have ih :=
            taggedGaugeCore_intervalListLength_range_eq_selectedPrefix
              hcover N
          unfold selectedPrefixIndices at ih
          exact ih
      | some xi =>
          simp [htag]
          rw [intervalListLength_append]
          rw [intervalListLength_append]
          have ih :=
            taggedGaugeCore_intervalListLength_range_eq_selectedPrefix
              hcover N
          unfold selectedPrefixIndices at ih
          rw [ih]

name: taggedGaugeCoreCountableCover_to_tripleOpenIntervalCover
statement:
theorem taggedGaugeCoreCountableCover_to_tripleOpenIntervalCover
    {S : Point -> Prop} {delta : Point -> Point}
    {l r : Nat -> Point} {tag : Nat -> Option Point}
    (hcover : TaggedGaugeCoreCountableCover S delta l r tag)
    (hactiveOpen :

proof:

  · intro n
    exact
      intervalTriple_left_le_right_of_le
        (taggedGaugeCoreEntry_ordered (hcover.left n))
  · intro x hx
    match hcover.right.left x hx with
    | Exists.intro n hn =>
        match hn with
        | Exists.intro xi hxi =>
            refine Exists.intro n ?_
            have htriple :
                IntervalTripleAt l r n x :=
              closedIntervalAt_mem_intervalTriple_of_open

name: taggedGaugeCore_tripleCover_seriesPartialSum_le_of_selectedPrefix_length_le
statement:
theorem taggedGaugeCore_tripleCover_seriesPartialSum_le_of_selectedPrefix_length_le
    {S : Point -> Prop} {delta : Point -> Point}
    {l r : Nat -> Point} {tag : Nat -> Option Point} {B : Point}
    (hcover : TaggedGaugeCoreCountableCover S delta l r tag)
    (hbound :
      forall N : Nat,
        RealTheory.le
          (intervalListLength l r (selectedPrefixIndices tag N)) B) :
    forall N : Nat,
      RealTheory.le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (RealNegligibility.coverLength
            (intervalTripleLeft l r)
            (intervalTripleRight l r)) N)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) B)
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  have hrange :=
    intervalListLength_range_eq_seriesPartialSum_coverLength
      (intervalTripleLeft l r) (intervalTripleRight l r) N
  have htriple :=
    intervalTripleListLength_eq_three_mul l r (List.range N)
  have hselected :=
    taggedGaugeCore_intervalListLength_range_eq_selectedPrefix hcover N
  rw [<- hrange]
  rw [htriple]
  rw [hselected]
  exact
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left (hbound N)
      (RealTheory.nat_nonneg 3)

name: taggedGaugeCore_tripleCoverBudgetLt_of_selectedPrefix_length_le
statement:
theorem taggedGaugeCore_tripleCoverBudgetLt_of_selectedPrefix_length_le
    {S : Point -> Prop} {delta : Point -> Point}
    {l r : Nat -> Point} {tag : Nat -> Option Point} {B eps : Point}
    (hcover : TaggedGaugeCoreCountableCover S delta l r tag)
    (hactiveOpen :
      forall n : Nat,
        forall xi : Point, tag n = some xi -> RealTheory.lt (l n) (r n))
    (hbound :
      forall N : Nat,
        RealTheory.le
          (intervalListLength l r (selectedPrefixIndices tag N)) B)
    (hbudget :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) B) eps) :
    And
      (RealNegligibility.CountableOpenIntervalCover S
        (intervalTripleLeft l r) (intervalTripleRight l r))
      (RealNegligibility.CoverBudgetLt
        (intervalTripleLeft l r) (intervalTripleRight l r) eps)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro
    (taggedGaugeCoreCountableCover_to_tripleOpenIntervalCover
      hcover hactiveOpen) ?_
  exact
    RealNegligibility.coverBudgetLt_of_partialSum_le
      (taggedGaugeCore_tripleCover_seriesPartialSum_le_of_selectedPrefix_length_le
        hcover hbound)
      hbudget

name: exists_taggedGaugeCore_tripleCoverBudgetLt_of_selectedPrefix_length_le
statement:
theorem exists_taggedGaugeCore_tripleCoverBudgetLt_of_selectedPrefix_length_le
    {S : Point -> Prop} {delta : Point -> Point}
    {l r : Nat -> Point} {tag : Nat -> Option Point} {B eps : Point}
    (hcover : TaggedGaugeCoreCountableCover S delta l r tag)

          (fun right : Nat -> Point =>
            And
              (RealNegligibility.CountableOpenIntervalCover S left right)
              (RealNegligibility.CoverBudgetLt left right eps)))
proof:

  refine Exists.intro (intervalTripleRight l r) ?_

name: intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_of_countableInteriorPairwiseDisjoint_nodup

name: false_of_selected_lt_overlap
proof:
:= by
  let scan := gridScanCode code
  let laterScan := gridScanCode later
  have hroot :
      scan.root = laterScan.root := by
    unfold scan laterScan
    exact selectedScanCellWithTag_same_root_of_overlap
      hsel hlater hoverlap
  by_cases hde : scan.depth <= laterScan.depth
  · by_cases hdepthEq : scan.depth = laterScan.depth
    · have hcodeEq : code = later := by
        unfold scan laterScan at hroot hdepthEq
        exact
          gridScanCellAt_eq_of_same_root_same_depth_overlap
            (selectedScanCellWithTag_gridScanCellAt hsel)
            (selectedScanCellWithTag_gridScanCellAt hlater)
            hroot hdepthEq hoverlap
      omega
    · have hdepthLt : scan.depth < laterScan.depth := by omega
      have hcellRoot :
          RootGridCell scan.root scan.depth cell := by
        unfold scan
        exact selectedScanCellWithTag_root_grid_mem hsel
      have hlaterRoot :
          RootGridCell scan.root laterScan.depth laterCell := by
        have hrootLater :
            RootGridCell laterScan.root laterScan.depth laterCell := by
          unfold laterScan
          exact selectedScanCellWithTag_root_grid_mem hlater
        rw [hroot]
        exact hrootLater
      have hsubset : CellClosedSubset laterCell cell :=
        rootGridCells_laminar_subset
          (Nat.le_of_lt hdepthLt) hcellRoot hlaterRoot hoverlap
      exact
        false_of_selected_lt_subset_selected
          hclt hsel hlater hsubset
  · have hdepthLt : laterScan.depth < scan.depth := by omega
    have hoverlapSymm : CellInteriorsOverlap laterCell cell := by
      match hoverlap with
      | Exists.intro x hx =>
          exact Exists.intro x (And.intro hx.right hx.left)
    have hltReverse : later < code := by
      unfold scan laterScan at hroot hdepthLt
      exact
        gridScanCellAt_lt_of_same_root_depth_lt_overlap
          (selectedScanCellWithTag_gridScanCellAt hlater)
          (selectedScanCellWithTag_gridScanCellAt hsel)
          (Eq.symm hroot) hdepthLt hoverlapSymm
    omega

name: selectedScanEntry_some_of_selected
statement:
private theorem selectedScanEntry_some_of_selected

        And (selectedScanEntry S delta code = some entry)
          (SelectedScanCellWithTag S delta code entry.fst entry.snd))

      Exists (fun entry : Prod (Prod Point Point) Point =>
        SelectedScanEntrySpec S delta code entry) :=

  | Exists.intro entry hentry =>

        Eq.symm

            hsel hentry.right)

      · unfold selectedScanTag
        rw [hentry.left]
      · unfold ClosedIntervalAt
        unfold selectedScanLeft

name: selectedCoreCoversBefore_to_selectedScan_cover
statement:
private theorem selectedCoreCoversBefore_to_selectedScan_cover
    {S : Point -> Prop} {delta : Point -> Point} :

      SelectedCoreCoversBefore S delta code x ->
        Exists
          (fun n : Nat =>
            Exists
              (fun xi : Point =>
                And (selectedScanTag S delta n = some xi)
                  (ClosedIntervalAt
                    (selectedScanLeft S delta)
                    (selectedScanRight S delta) n x)))
  | 0, _x, h => by
      unfold SelectedCoreCoversBefore at h
      cases h
  | Nat.succ code, x, h => by
      unfold SelectedCoreCoversBefore at h
      cases h with
      | inl hbefore =>
          exact selectedCoreCoversBefore_to_selectedScan_cover hbefore
      | inr hnew =>
          match hnew with
          | Exists.intro cell hcell =>
              match hcell with
              | Exists.intro xi hxi =>
                  exact
                    selectedScan_cover_of_selected
                      hxi.left hxi.right

name: selectedScan_countableIntervalInteriorPairwiseDisjoint
statement:
private theorem selectedScan_countableIntervalInteriorPairwiseDisjoint
    {S : Point -> Prop} {delta : Point -> Point} :
    CountableIntervalInteriorPairwiseDisjoint
      (selectedScanLeft S delta) (selectedScanRight S delta)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hne x hxi hxj
  unfold IntervalAt at hxi
  unfold IntervalAt at hxj
  cases hi : selectedScanEntry S delta i with
  | none =>
      unfold selectedScanLeft at hxi
      unfold selectedScanRight at hxi
      rw [hi] at hxi
      exact
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_asymm
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hxi.left hxi.right
  | some entryI =>
      cases hj : selectedScanEntry S delta j with
      | none =>
          unfold selectedScanLeft at hxj
          unfold selectedScanRight at hxj
          rw [hj] at hxj
          exact
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_asymm
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hxj.left hxj.right
      | some entryJ =>
          have hcellI : CellInterior entryI.fst x := by
            unfold CellInterior
            unfold selectedScanLeft at hxi
            unfold selectedScanRight at hxi
            rw [hi] at hxi
            exact hxi
          have hcellJ : CellInterior entryJ.fst x := by
            unfold CellInterior
            unfold selectedScanLeft at hxj
            unfold selectedScanRight at hxj
            rw [hj] at hxj
            exact hxj
          exact
            selectedScanCellWithTag_interiors_disjoint
              hne
              (selectedScanEntry_some_selected hi)
              (selectedScanEntry_some_selected hj)
              x hcellI hcellJ

name: dyadicStep_pos
statement:
private theorem dyadicStep_pos (depth : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (dyadicStep depth)
proof:
:= by

  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail_pos F (by
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
    omega) depth

name: dyadicGridPoint_succ
proof:

name: dyadicGridPoint_le_of_index_le

private theorem dyadicGridPoint_le_of_index_le

proof:
:= by
  unfold dyadicGridPoint

  exact F.add_le_add_left
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Compactness.LebesgueToFinite.nat_mul_step_le_of_le

name: cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left
statement:
private theorem cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left
    {cell other : Point × Point}
    (hsep : RealTheory.le cell.snd other.fst) :
    CellInteriorDisjoint cell other
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hother
  have hright_lt_x : RealTheory.lt cell.snd x :=
    F.lt_of_le_of_lt hsep hother.left
  exact F.lt_asymm hright_lt_x hx.right

name: dyadicCells_fixedDepth_disjoint
statement:
private theorem dyadicCells_fixedDepth_disjoint
    {left : Point} {depth i j : Nat}
    (hne : Not (i = j)) :
    CellInteriorDisjoint (dyadicCell left depth i) (dyadicCell left depth j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i < j
  · apply cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left
    exact dyadicGridPoint_le_of_index_le (by omega)
  · have hji : j < i := by omega
    have hdis :
        CellInteriorDisjoint (dyadicCell left depth j)
          (dyadicCell left depth i) :=
      cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left
        (dyadicGridPoint_le_of_index_le (by omega))
    intro x hxi hxj
    exact hdis x hxj hxi

name: exists_fixedDepth_cell_cover
statement:
private theorem exists_fixedDepth_cell_cover
    {left x : Point} {depth : Nat}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval left
      (dyadicGridPoint left depth (2 ^ depth)) x) :
    Exists (fun index : Nat =>
      And (ValidDyadicIndex depth index)
        (CellClosed (dyadicCell left depth index) x))
proof:
:= by
  let N := 2 ^ depth
  have hNpos : 0 < N := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  let P : Nat -> Prop := fun k =>
    RealTheory.le x (dyadicGridPoint left depth (k + 1))
  have hlast : N - 1 + 1 = N := by omega
  have hP_exists : Exists P := by
    refine Exists.intro (N - 1) ?_
    unfold P
    rw [hlast]
    simpa [N] using hx.right
  let k0 := Tautology.Nat.least P hP_exists
  have hkP : P k0 := Tautology.Nat.least_spec P hP_exists
  have hk_le : k0 <= N - 1 :=
    Tautology.Nat.least_min P hP_exists (by
      unfold P
      rw [hlast]
      simpa [N] using hx.right)
  have hk_lt : k0 < N := by omega
  refine Exists.intro k0 (And.intro hk_lt ?_)
  unfold CellClosed dyadicCell
  constructor
  · cases hkcase : k0 with
    | zero =>
        rw [dyadicGridPoint_zero]
        exact hx.left
    | succ k =>
        have hnot : Not (P k) := by
          intro hp
          have hmin := Tautology.Nat.least_min P hP_exists hp
          change Tautology.Nat.least P hP_exists = k + 1 at hkcase
          rw [hkcase] at hmin
          omega
        unfold P at hnot
        have hlt : RealTheory.lt (dyadicGridPoint left depth (k + 1)) x := by
          apply Classical.byContradiction
          intro hnotlt
          exact hnot (F.le_of_not_lt hnotlt)
        change RealTheory.le (dyadicGridPoint left depth (k + 1)) x
        exact F.le_of_lt hlt
  · exact hkP

name: dyadicStep_factor
statement:
private theorem dyadicStep_factor
    (depth gap : Nat) :
    dyadicStep depth =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (2 ^ gap))
        (dyadicStep (depth + gap))
proof:
:= by
  induction gap with
  | zero =>
      rw [Nat.pow_zero, Nat.add_zero, RealTheory.nat_one]
      change dyadicStep depth = F.mul F.one (dyadicStep depth)
      rw [F.one_mul]
  | succ gap ih =>
      have htail := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail_eq_mul_baseTail_succ
        F (by
          unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
          omega : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase 2) (depth + gap)
      change dyadicStep (depth + gap) =
        F.mul (F.nat 2) (dyadicStep (depth + gap + 1)) at htail
      rw [ih, htail]
      have hpow : 2 ^ (gap + 1) = 2 ^ gap * 2 := by
        rw [Nat.pow_succ]
      have hadd : depth + (gap + 1) = depth + gap + 1 := by omega
      change
        F.mul (F.nat (2 ^ gap))
            (F.mul (F.nat 2) (dyadicStep (depth + gap + 1))) =
          F.mul (F.nat (2 ^ (gap + 1)))
            (dyadicStep (depth + (gap + 1)))
      calc
        F.mul (F.nat (2 ^ gap))
            (F.mul (F.nat 2) (dyadicStep (depth + gap + 1))) =
            F.mul (F.mul (F.nat (2 ^ gap)) (F.nat 2))
              (dyadicStep (depth + gap + 1)) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul (F.nat (2 ^ gap * 2))
              (dyadicStep (depth + gap + 1)) := by
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_mul]
        _ = F.mul (F.nat (2 ^ (gap + 1)))
              (dyadicStep (depth + (gap + 1))) := by rw [hpow, hadd]

name: dyadicGridPoint_refines
statement:
private theorem dyadicGridPoint_refines
    {left : Point} {depth deeperDepth index : Nat}
    (hde : depth <= deeperDepth) :
    dyadicGridPoint left depth index =
      dyadicGridPoint left deeperDepth
        (index * 2 ^ (deeperDepth - depth))
proof:
:= by
  have heq : deeperDepth = depth + (deeperDepth - depth) := by omega
  let gap := deeperDepth - depth
  have hstep := dyadicStep_factor depth gap
  unfold dyadicGridPoint
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Compactness.LebesgueToFinite.gridPoint
  rw [heq]
  have hsub : depth + gap - depth = gap := by
    unfold gap
    omega
  rw [hsub]
  change
    F.add left (F.mul (F.nat index) (dyadicStep depth)) =
      F.add left
        (F.mul (F.nat (index * 2 ^ gap)) (dyadicStep (depth + gap)))
  rw [hstep]
  apply congrArg (fun z : Point => F.add left z)
  change
    F.mul (F.nat index)
        (F.mul (F.nat (2 ^ gap)) (dyadicStep (depth + gap))) =
      F.mul (F.nat (index * 2 ^ gap)) (dyadicStep (depth + gap))
  calc
    F.mul (F.nat index)
        (F.mul (F.nat (2 ^ gap)) (dyadicStep (depth + gap))) =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.nat index) (F.nat (2 ^ gap)))
          (dyadicStep (depth + gap)) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.nat (index * 2 ^ gap))
          (dyadicStep (depth + gap)) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_mul]

name: dyadicCells_crossDepth_laminar
statement:
private theorem dyadicCells_crossDepth_laminar
    {left : Point} {depth deeperDepth i j : Nat}
    (hde : depth <= deeperDepth)
    (hoverlap : CellInteriorsOverlap
      (dyadicCell left depth i) (dyadicCell left deeperDepth j)) :
    CellClosedSubset (dyadicCell left deeperDepth j)
      (dyadicCell left depth i)
proof:
:= by
  let q := 2 ^ (deeperDepth - depth)
  have hleftEq :
      (dyadicCell left depth i).fst =
        dyadicGridPoint left deeperDepth (i * q) := by
    unfold dyadicCell q
    exact dyadicGridPoint_refines hde
  have hrightEq :
      (dyadicCell left depth i).snd =
        dyadicGridPoint left deeperDepth ((i + 1) * q) := by
    unfold dyadicCell q
    exact dyadicGridPoint_refines hde
  have hqpos : 0 < q := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  have hijLeft : i * q <= j := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hnot
    have hsep :
        RealTheory.le (dyadicCell left deeperDepth j).snd
          (dyadicCell left depth i).fst := by
      rw [hleftEq]
      exact dyadicGridPoint_le_of_index_le (by omega)
    have hdis := cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left hsep
    match hoverlap with
    | Exists.intro x hx => exact hdis x hx.right hx.left
  have hijRight : j + 1 <= (i + 1) * q := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hnot
    have hsep :
        RealTheory.le (dyadicCell left depth i).snd
          (dyadicCell left deeperDepth j).fst := by
      rw [hrightEq]
      exact dyadicGridPoint_le_of_index_le (by omega)
    have hdis := cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left hsep
    match hoverlap with
    | Exists.intro x hx => exact hdis x hx.left hx.right
  intro x hx
  unfold CellClosed at hx
  unfold CellClosed
  constructor
  · rw [hleftEq]
    exact F.le_trans (dyadicGridPoint_le_of_index_le hijLeft) hx.left
  · rw [hrightEq]
    exact F.le_trans hx.right (dyadicGridPoint_le_of_index_le hijRight)

name: dyadicCells_crossDepth_index_le
statement:
private theorem dyadicCells_crossDepth_index_le
    {left : Point} {depth deeperDepth i j : Nat}
    (hde : depth <= deeperDepth)
    (hoverlap : CellInteriorsOverlap
      (dyadicCell left depth i) (dyadicCell left deeperDepth j)) :
    i <= j
proof:
:= by
  let q := 2 ^ (deeperDepth - depth)
  have hqpos : 0 < q := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  have hleftEq :
      (dyadicCell left depth i).fst =
        dyadicGridPoint left deeperDepth (i * q) := by
    unfold dyadicCell q
    exact dyadicGridPoint_refines hde
  have hiqj : i * q <= j := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hnot
    have hsep :
        RealTheory.le (dyadicCell left deeperDepth j).snd
          (dyadicCell left depth i).fst := by
      rw [hleftEq]
      exact dyadicGridPoint_le_of_index_le (by omega)
    have hdis := cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left hsep
    match hoverlap with
    | Exists.intro x hx => exact hdis x hx.right hx.left
  exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right i hqpos) hiqj

name: rootWindowLeft_even
statement:
private theorem rootWindowLeft_even (n : Nat) :
    rootWindowLeft (2 * n) = RealTheory.nat n
proof:
:= by
  unfold rootWindowLeft
  have hmod : (2 * n) % 2 = 0 := by omega
  have hdiv : (2 * n) / 2 = n := by omega
  simp [hmod, hdiv]

name: rootWindowLeft_odd
proof:
:= by
  unfold rootWindowLeft
  have hdiv : (2 * n + 1) / 2 = n := by omega
  simp [hdiv]

name: int_one
statement:
private theorem int_one :
    RealTheory.int (Int.ofNat 1) = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealTheory.int_ofNat]
  have h := RealTheory.nat_succ 0
  rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at h
  rwa [F.zero_add] at h

name: neg_nat_succ_add_one
statement:
private theorem neg_nat_succ_add_one (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))) RealTheory.one =
        RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : Int.negSucc n + Int.ofNat 1 = Int.negOfNat n := by
    cases n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n => rfl
  have h := RealTheory.int_add (Int.negSucc n) (Int.ofNat 1)
  rw [hsum, RealTheory.int_negOfNat, RealTheory.int_negSucc, int_one] at h
  exact Eq.symm h

name: rootWindowRight_even
statement:
private theorem rootWindowRight_even (n : Nat) :
    rootWindowRight (2 * n) = RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rootWindowRight
  rw [rootWindowLeft_even]
  exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.nat_succ n)

name: rootWindowRight_odd
proof:
:= by
  unfold rootWindowRight
  rw [rootWindowLeft_odd]
  exact neg_nat_succ_add_one n

name: dyadicGridPoint_terminal_add_one
statement:
private theorem dyadicGridPoint_terminal_add_one
    (left : Point) (depth : Nat) :
    dyadicGridPoint left depth (2 ^ depth) =
      RealTheory.add left RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let N := 2 ^ depth
  have hNne : Not (N = 0) := by
    have hNpos : 0 < N := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
    omega
  have hnatne : Not (F.nat N = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_pos_of_ne_zero F hNne) h.symm
  unfold dyadicGridPoint
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Compactness.LebesgueToFinite.gridPoint
  unfold dyadicStep IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.basePow
  change F.add left (F.mul (F.nat N) (F.inv (F.nat N))) =
    F.add left F.one
  rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hnatne]

name: rootWindow_terminal
proof:
:= by
  unfold rootWindowRight
  exact dyadicGridPoint_terminal_add_one (rootWindowLeft root) depth

name: exists_rootDyadicCell_cover
statement:
private theorem exists_rootDyadicCell_cover
    {root depth : Nat} {x : Point}
    (hx : RootWindowContains root x) :
    Exists (fun index : Nat =>
      And (ValidDyadicIndex depth index)
        (CellClosed (dyadicCell (rootWindowLeft root) depth index) x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold RootWindowContains at hx
  have hx' :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval (rootWindowLeft root)
        (dyadicGridPoint (rootWindowLeft root) depth (2 ^ depth)) x := by
    rwa [rootWindow_terminal]
  exact exists_fixedDepth_cell_cover hx'

name: rootDyadicCellAt_strictOrdered
statement:
private theorem rootDyadicCellAt_strictOrdered

name: rootDyadicCells_fixedDepth_disjoint
statement:
private theorem rootDyadicCells_fixedDepth_disjoint
    {root depth i j : Nat} {cell other : Point × Point}
    (hi : RootDyadicCellAt root depth i cell)
    (hj : RootDyadicCellAt root depth j other)
    (hne : Not (i = j)) :
    CellInteriorDisjoint cell other
proof:
:= by
  rw [hi.right, hj.right]
  exact dyadicCells_fixedDepth_disjoint hne

name: rootDyadicCells_crossDepth_laminar
statement:
private theorem rootDyadicCells_crossDepth_laminar
    {root depth deeperDepth i j : Nat} {cell other : Point × Point}
    (hde : depth <= deeperDepth)
    (hi : RootDyadicCellAt root depth i cell)
    (hj : RootDyadicCellAt root deeperDepth j other)
    (hoverlap : CellInteriorsOverlap cell other) :
    CellClosedSubset other cell
proof:
:= by
  rw [hi.right, hj.right] at hoverlap
  rw [hi.right, hj.right]
  exact dyadicCells_crossDepth_laminar hde hoverlap

name: rootDyadicCellAt_rootWindowInterior
statement:
private theorem rootDyadicCellAt_rootWindowInterior
    {root depth index : Nat} {cell : Point × Point} {x : Point}
    (hcell : RootDyadicCellAt root depth index cell)
    (hx : CellInterior cell x) :
    CellInterior (rootWindowCell root) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [hcell.right] at hx
  unfold CellInterior at hx
  unfold CellInterior rootWindowCell
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.le (rootWindowLeft root)
        (dyadicCell (rootWindowLeft root) depth index).fst := by
    have h := dyadicGridPoint_le_of_index_le
      (left := rootWindowLeft root) (depth := depth) (i := 0) (j := index)
      (Nat.zero_le index)
    rwa [dyadicGridPoint_zero] at h
  have hright :
      RealTheory.le (dyadicCell (rootWindowLeft root) depth index).snd
        (rootWindowRight root) := by
    have hindex : index + 1 <= 2 ^ depth := by
      have hvalid := hcell.left
      unfold ValidDyadicIndex at hvalid
      omega
    have h := dyadicGridPoint_le_of_index_le
      (left := rootWindowLeft root) (depth := depth) hindex
    rwa [rootWindow_terminal] at h
  exact And.intro (F.lt_of_le_of_lt hleft hx.left)
    (F.lt_of_lt_of_le hx.right hright)

name: rootWindow_even_even_interiors_disjoint
statement:
private theorem rootWindow_even_even_interiors_disjoint
    {n m : Nat} (hne : Not (n = m)) :
    CellInteriorDisjoint (rootWindowCell (2 * n))
      (rootWindowCell (2 * m))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n < m
  · have hsep :
        RealTheory.le (rootWindowCell (2 * n)).snd
          (rootWindowCell (2 * m)).fst := by
      unfold rootWindowCell
      simp [rootWindowRight_even, rootWindowLeft_even]
      exact RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (by omega)
    exact cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left hsep
  · have hmn : m < n := by omega
    have hsep :
        RealTheory.le (rootWindowCell (2 * m)).snd
          (rootWindowCell (2 * n)).fst := by
      unfold rootWindowCell
      simp [rootWindowRight_even, rootWindowLeft_even]
      exact RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (by omega)
    have hdis := cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left hsep
    intro x hx hy
    exact hdis x hy hx

name: rootWindow_odd_odd_interiors_disjoint
statement:
private theorem rootWindow_odd_odd_interiors_disjoint
    {n m : Nat} (hne : Not (n = m)) :
    CellInteriorDisjoint (rootWindowCell (2 * n + 1))
      (rootWindowCell (2 * m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n < m
  · have hsep :
        RealTheory.le (rootWindowCell (2 * m + 1)).snd
          (rootWindowCell (2 * n + 1)).fst := by
      unfold rootWindowCell
      simp [rootWindowRight_odd, rootWindowLeft_odd]
      have hnat :
          F.le (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (RealTheory.nat m) :=
        RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (by omega)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hnat
    have hdis := cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left hsep
    intro x hx hy
    exact hdis x hy hx
  · have hmn : m < n := by omega
    have hsep :
        RealTheory.le (rootWindowCell (2 * n + 1)).snd
          (rootWindowCell (2 * m + 1)).fst := by
      unfold rootWindowCell
      simp [rootWindowRight_odd, rootWindowLeft_odd]
      have hnat :
          F.le (RealTheory.nat (m + 1)) (RealTheory.nat n) :=
        RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (by omega)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hnat
    exact cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left hsep

name: rootWindow_even_odd_interiors_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  have hsep :
      RealTheory.le (rootWindowCell (2 * m + 1)).snd
        (rootWindowCell (2 * n)).fst := by
    unfold rootWindowCell
    simp [rootWindowRight_odd, rootWindowLeft_even]
    exact RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonpos_of_nonneg F
        (RealTheory.nat_nonneg m))
      (RealTheory.nat_nonneg n)
  have hdis := cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left hsep
  intro x hx hy
  exact hdis x hy hx

name: rootWindow_odd_even_interiors_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  have hsep :
      RealTheory.le (rootWindowCell (2 * n + 1)).snd
        (rootWindowCell (2 * m)).fst := by
    unfold rootWindowCell
    simp [rootWindowRight_odd, rootWindowLeft_even]
    exact RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonpos_of_nonneg F
        (RealTheory.nat_nonneg n))

  exact cellInteriorDisjoint_of_right_le_left hsep

name: rootWindow_interiors_disjoint_of_ne
statement:
private theorem rootWindow_interiors_disjoint_of_ne
    {root other : Nat} (hne : Not (root = other)) :
    CellInteriorDisjoint (rootWindowCell root) (rootWindowCell other)
proof:
:= by
  let n := root / 2
  let m := other / 2
  by_cases hroot : root % 2 = 0
  · have hroot_eq : root = 2 * n := by
      unfold n
      omega
    by_cases hother : other % 2 = 0
    · have hother_eq : other = 2 * m := by
        unfold m
        omega
      rw [hroot_eq, hother_eq]
      have hne_nm : Not (n = m) := by
        intro hnm
        apply hne
        rw [hroot_eq, hother_eq, hnm]
      exact rootWindow_even_even_interiors_disjoint hne_nm
    · have hother_eq : other = 2 * m + 1 := by
        unfold m
        omega
      rw [hroot_eq, hother_eq]
      exact rootWindow_even_odd_interiors_disjoint n m
  · have hroot_eq : root = 2 * n + 1 := by
      unfold n
      omega
    by_cases hother : other % 2 = 0
    · have hother_eq : other = 2 * m := by
        unfold m
        omega
      rw [hroot_eq, hother_eq]
      exact rootWindow_odd_even_interiors_disjoint n m
    · have hother_eq : other = 2 * m + 1 := by
        unfold m
        omega
      rw [hroot_eq, hother_eq]
      have hne_nm : Not (n = m) := by
        intro hnm
        apply hne
        rw [hroot_eq, hother_eq, hnm]
      exact rootWindow_odd_odd_interiors_disjoint hne_nm

name: rootDyadicCells_same_root_of_overlap
statement:
private theorem rootDyadicCells_same_root_of_overlap
    {root other depth otherDepth i j : Nat}
    {cell otherCell : Point × Point}
    (hcell : RootDyadicCellAt root depth i cell)
    (hother : RootDyadicCellAt other otherDepth j otherCell)
    (hoverlap : CellInteriorsOverlap cell otherCell) :
    root = other
proof:
:= by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hne
  have hdis := rootWindow_interiors_disjoint_of_ne hne
  match hoverlap with
  | Exists.intro x hx =>
      exact hdis x
        (rootDyadicCellAt_rootWindowInterior hcell hx.left)
        (rootDyadicCellAt_rootWindowInterior hother hx.right)

name: exists_rootWindow_contains
statement:
private theorem exists_rootWindow_contains (x : Point) :
    Exists (fun root : Nat => RootWindowContains root x)
proof:
:= by
  cases RealTheory.exists_internalInt_floor x with
  | intro z hz =>
      cases RealTheory.internalInt_exists_int hz.left with
      | intro k hk =>
          have hle_z : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.int k) x := by
            have hle0 := hz.right.left
            rwa [hk] at hle0
          have hlt_z :
              RealTheory.lt x
                (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.int k) RealTheory.one) := by
            have hlt0 := hz.right.right
            rwa [hk] at hlt0
          cases k with
          | ofNat n =>
              refine Exists.intro (2 * n) ?_
              unfold RootWindowContains
              rw [rootWindowLeft_even, rootWindowRight_even]
              have hle_left : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat n) x := by
                rwa [RealTheory.int_ofNat] at hle_z
              have hle_right :
                  RealTheory.le x (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) := by
                have hle_add := (RealTheory.lt_def.mp hlt_z).left
                have hadd :
                    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.int (Int.ofNat n))
                        RealTheory.one =
                      RealTheory.nat (n + 1) := by
                  rw [RealTheory.int_ofNat]
                  exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.nat_succ n)
                rwa [hadd] at hle_add
              exact And.intro hle_left hle_right
          | negSucc n =>
              refine Exists.intro (2 * n + 1) ?_
              unfold RootWindowContains
              rw [rootWindowLeft_odd, rootWindowRight_odd]
              have hle_left :
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))) x := by
                rwa [RealTheory.int_negSucc] at hle_z
              have hle_right :
                  RealTheory.le x (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n)) := by
                have hle_add := (RealTheory.lt_def.mp hlt_z).left
                have hadd :
                    RealTheory.add
                        (RealTheory.int (Int.negSucc n)) RealTheory.one =
                      RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.nat n) := by
                  rw [RealTheory.int_negSucc]
                  exact neg_nat_succ_add_one n
                rwa [hadd] at hle_add
              exact And.intro hle_left hle_right

name: diagonalEnum_natPairCode
statement:
private theorem diagonalEnum_natPairCode (a b : Nat) :
    Foundation.Cardinal.diagonalEnum (natPairCode a b) = (a, b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold natPairCode
  have h := Foundation.Cardinal.diagonalEnum_tri_add (a + b) b (by omega)
  have hsub : a + b - b = a := by omega
  rwa [hsub] at h

name: triangular_mono
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing s with
  | zero =>
      have hs : s = 0 := by omega
      subst s
      exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ t ih =>
      by_cases hst' : s <= t
      · have h := ih hst'
        rw [Foundation.Cardinal.triangular_succ]
        omega
      · have hs : s = t + 1 := by omega
        subst s
        exact Nat.le_refl _

name: triangular_add_self_lt_succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Foundation.Cardinal.triangular_succ]
  omega

name: natPairCode_lt_of_sum_lt
proof:
:= by
  unfold natPairCode
  have h1 :
      Foundation.Cardinal.triangular (a + b) + b <=
        Foundation.Cardinal.triangular (a + b) + (a + b) := by omega
  have h2 :
      Foundation.Cardinal.triangular (a + b) + (a + b) <
        Foundation.Cardinal.triangular (a + b + 1) :=
    triangular_add_self_lt_succ (a + b)
  have h3 : a + b + 1 <= c + d := by omega
  have h4 := triangular_mono h3
  omega

name: natPairCode_lt_of_lt_le
proof:
:=
  natPairCode_lt_of_sum_lt (by omega)

name: gridScanCodeOf_spec
proof:
:= by
  unfold gridScanCodeOf
  have houter :
      Foundation.Cardinal.diagonalEnum
          (natPairCode (natPairCode root depth) index) =
        (natPairCode root depth, index) :=
    diagonalEnum_natPairCode (natPairCode root depth) index
  have hinner :
      Foundation.Cardinal.diagonalEnum (natPairCode root depth) =
        (root, depth) :=
    diagonalEnum_natPairCode root depth
  unfold gridScanCode
  simp [houter, hinner]

name: gridScanCodeOf_depth_lt_index_le
statement:
private theorem gridScanCodeOf_depth_lt_index_le
    {root depth deeperDepth index otherIndex : Nat}
    (hdepth : depth < deeperDepth)
    (hindex : index <= otherIndex) :
    gridScanCodeOf root depth index <
      gridScanCodeOf root deeperDepth otherIndex
proof:
:= by
  unfold gridScanCodeOf
  have hinner :
      natPairCode root depth < natPairCode root deeperDepth :=
    natPairCode_lt_of_sum_lt (by omega)
  exact natPairCode_lt_of_lt_le hinner hindex

name: exists_gridScanCellAt
statement:
private theorem exists_gridScanCellAt
    {root depth index : Nat} {cell : Point × Point}
    (hcell : RootDyadicCellAt root depth index cell) :
    Exists (fun code : Nat => GridScanCellAt code cell)
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro (gridScanCodeOf root depth index) ?_
  exact Exists.intro root (Exists.intro depth (Exists.intro index
    (And.intro rfl hcell)))

name: gridScanCellAt_strictOrdered
statement:
private theorem gridScanCellAt_strictOrdered
    {code : Nat} {cell : Point × Point}
    (h : GridScanCellAt code cell) :
    RealTheory.lt cell.fst cell.snd
proof:
:= by
  match h with
  | Exists.intro root hroot =>
      match hroot with
      | Exists.intro depth hdepth =>
          match hdepth with
          | Exists.intro index hindex =>
              exact rootDyadicCellAt_strictOrdered hindex.right

name: gridScanCellAt_unique
statement:
theorem gridScanCellAt_unique
    {code : Nat} {cell other : Point × Point}
    (hcell : GridScanCellAt code cell)
    (hother : GridScanCellAt code other) :
    cell = other
proof:
:= by
  match hcell with
  | Exists.intro root hroot =>
      match hroot with
      | Exists.intro depth hdepth =>
          match hdepth with
          | Exists.intro index hi =>
              match hother with
              | Exists.intro otherRoot hotherRoot =>
                  match hotherRoot with
                  | Exists.intro otherDepth hotherDepth =>
                      match hotherDepth with
                      | Exists.intro otherIndex hj =>
                          have hcodeEq :
                              gridScanCodeOf root depth index =
                                gridScanCodeOf otherRoot otherDepth otherIndex := by
                            rw [<- hi.left, <- hj.left]
                          have hdecoded := congrArg gridScanCode hcodeEq
                          rw [gridScanCodeOf_spec, gridScanCodeOf_spec] at hdecoded
                          have hrootEq : root = otherRoot :=
                            congrArg GridScanCode.root hdecoded
                          have hdepthEq : depth = otherDepth :=
                            congrArg GridScanCode.depth hdecoded
                          have hindexEq : index = otherIndex :=
                            congrArg GridScanCode.index hdecoded
                          rw [hi.right.right, hj.right.right,
                            hrootEq, hdepthEq, hindexEq]

name: gridScanCellAt_rootCell
statement:
private theorem gridScanCellAt_rootCell
    {code : Nat} {cell : Point × Point}
    (h : GridScanCellAt code cell) :
    RootDyadicCellAt
      (gridScanCode code).root (gridScanCode code).depth
      (gridScanCode code).index cell
proof:
:= by
  match h with
  | Exists.intro root hroot =>
      match hroot with
      | Exists.intro depth hdepth =>
          match hdepth with
          | Exists.intro index hindex =>
              rw [hindex.left, gridScanCodeOf_spec]
              exact hindex.right

name: gridScanCodeOf_gridScanCellAt
statement:
private theorem gridScanCodeOf_gridScanCellAt
    {code : Nat} {cell : Point × Point}
    (h : GridScanCellAt code cell) :
    gridScanCodeOf
      (gridScanCode code).root (gridScanCode code).depth
      (gridScanCode code).index = code
proof:
:= by
  match h with
  | Exists.intro root hroot =>
      match hroot with
      | Exists.intro depth hdepth =>
          match hdepth with
          | Exists.intro index hindex =>
              rw [hindex.left, gridScanCodeOf_spec]

name: gridScanCellAt_lt_of_same_root_depth_lt_overlap
statement:
theorem gridScanCellAt_lt_of_same_root_depth_lt_overlap
    {code otherCode : Nat} {cell other : Point × Point}
    (hcell : GridScanCellAt code cell)
    (hother : GridScanCellAt otherCode other)
    (hroot :
      (gridScanCode code).root = (gridScanCode otherCode).root)
    (hdepth :
      (gridScanCode code).depth < (gridScanCode otherCode).depth)
    (hoverlap : CellInteriorsOverlap cell other) :
    code < otherCode
proof:
:= by
  have hc := gridScanCellAt_rootCell hcell
  have ho := gridScanCellAt_rootCell hother
  rw [<- hroot] at ho
  have hoverlap' := hoverlap
  rw [hc.right, ho.right] at hoverlap'
  have hindex :
      (gridScanCode code).index <= (gridScanCode otherCode).index :=
    dyadicCells_crossDepth_index_le (Nat.le_of_lt hdepth) hoverlap'
  have hencoded := gridScanCodeOf_depth_lt_index_le
    (root := (gridScanCode code).root) hdepth hindex
  have hcCode := gridScanCodeOf_gridScanCellAt hcell
  have hoCode := gridScanCodeOf_gridScanCellAt hother
  have hoCode' :
      gridScanCodeOf (gridScanCode code).root
          (gridScanCode otherCode).depth (gridScanCode otherCode).index =
        otherCode := by
    rwa [hroot]
  rw [hcCode, hoCode'] at hencoded
  exact hencoded

name: gridScanCellAt_eq_of_same_root_same_depth_overlap
statement:
theorem gridScanCellAt_eq_of_same_root_same_depth_overlap
    {code otherCode : Nat} {cell other : Point × Point}
    (hcell : GridScanCellAt code cell)
    (hother : GridScanCellAt otherCode other)
    (hroot :
      (gridScanCode code).root = (gridScanCode otherCode).root)
    (hdepth :
      (gridScanCode code).depth = (gridScanCode otherCode).depth)
    (hoverlap : CellInteriorsOverlap cell other) :
    code = otherCode
proof:
:= by
  have hc := gridScanCellAt_rootCell hcell
  have ho := gridScanCellAt_rootCell hother
  rw [<- hroot, <- hdepth] at ho
  have hindex :
      (gridScanCode code).index = (gridScanCode otherCode).index := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hne
    have hdis := rootDyadicCells_fixedDepth_disjoint hc ho hne
    match hoverlap with
    | Exists.intro x hx => exact hdis x hx.left hx.right
  have hcCode := gridScanCodeOf_gridScanCellAt hcell
  have hoCode := gridScanCodeOf_gridScanCellAt hother
  rw [hroot, hdepth, hindex] at hcCode
  exact hcCode.symm.trans hoCode

name: rootGridCells_same_root_of_overlap
statement:
theorem rootGridCells_same_root_of_overlap
    {root other depth otherDepth : Nat}

  | Exists.intro index hi =>
      match hother with
      | Exists.intro otherIndex hj =>

name: rootGridCells_laminar_subset

name: gridScanCellAt_grid_mem

theorem gridScanCellAt_grid_mem

name: cellGaugeSubordinate_of_length_lt
statement:
private theorem cellGaugeSubordinate_of_length_lt
    {delta : Point -> Point} {xi : Point} {cell : Point × Point}
    (hxi : CellClosed cell xi)
    (hlen : RealTheory.lt (CellLength cell) (delta xi)) :
    CellGaugeSubordinate delta xi cell
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  unfold GaugeBall
  unfold CellLength at hlen
  have hxi_y_le :
      F.le (F.sub xi y) (F.sub cell.snd cell.fst) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F hxi.right hy.left
  have hxi_y_lt : F.lt (F.sub xi y) (delta xi) :=
    F.lt_of_le_of_lt hxi_y_le hlen
  have hleft : F.lt (F.sub xi (delta xi)) y :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right F hxi_y_lt
  have hy_xi_le :
      F.le (F.sub y xi) (F.sub cell.snd cell.fst) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F hy.right hxi.left
  have hy_xi_lt : F.lt (F.sub y xi) (delta xi) :=
    F.lt_of_le_of_lt hy_xi_le hlen
  have hright : F.lt y (F.add xi (delta xi)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt F hy_xi_lt
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: dyadicCell_length_eq_step
statement:
private theorem dyadicCell_length_eq_step
    (left : Point) (depth index : Nat) :
    CellLength (dyadicCell left depth index) = dyadicStep depth
proof:
:= by
  unfold CellLength dyadicCell
  rw [dyadicGridPoint_succ]
  change
    F.sub (F.add (dyadicGridPoint left depth index) (dyadicStep depth))
        (dyadicGridPoint left depth index) =
      dyadicStep depth
  rw [F.add_comm]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F
    (dyadicStep depth) (dyadicGridPoint left depth index)

name: exists_dyadicStep_lt
statement:
private theorem exists_dyadicStep_lt
    {eps : Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists (fun depth : Nat => RealTheory.lt (dyadicStep depth) eps)
proof:
:= by
  have htail := RealTheory.baseTail_tendsto_zero_all
    (q := 2) (by
      unfold RealTheory.ValidBase IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
      omega)
  have hevent := RealTheory.seqTendsto_eventually htail heps
  cases hevent with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      have hsmall := hN N (Nat.le_refl N)
      change
        F.lt (F.abs (F.sub (dyadicStep N) F.zero)) eps at hsmall
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero] at hsmall
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
        (F.le_of_lt (dyadicStep_pos N))] at hsmall
      exact hsmall

name: exists_rootDyadicCell_gaugeEligibleWithTag
statement:
private theorem exists_rootDyadicCell_gaugeEligibleWithTag
    {S : Point -> Prop} {delta : Point -> Point}
    {root : Nat} {x : Point}
    (hxS : S x)
    (hxroot : RootWindowContains root x)
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (delta x)) :
    Exists (fun depth : Nat =>
      Exists (fun index : Nat =>
        Exists (fun cell : Point × Point =>
          And (RootDyadicCellAt root depth index cell)
            (GaugeEligibleCellWithTag S delta cell x))))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_dyadicStep_lt hdelta with
  | intro depth hstep =>
      cases exists_rootDyadicCell_cover (depth := depth) hxroot with
      | intro index hindex =>
          let cell := dyadicCell (rootWindowLeft root) depth index
          have hlen : RealTheory.lt (CellLength cell) (delta x) := by
            unfold cell
            rw [dyadicCell_length_eq_step]
            exact hstep
          have hsub : CellGaugeSubordinate delta x cell :=
            cellGaugeSubordinate_of_length_lt hindex.right hlen
          refine Exists.intro depth (Exists.intro index
            (Exists.intro cell ?_))
          exact And.intro
            (And.intro hindex.left rfl)
            (And.intro (And.intro hxS hindex.right) hsub)

name: gridScanGaugeEligibleCellWithTag_strictOrdered

name: exists_leftEndpoint_continuity_radius
statement:
private theorem exists_leftEndpoint_continuity_radius
    {Fmap : Point -> Point} {a b eps : Point}
    (hleab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hFcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) Fmap)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun rho : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rho)
          (forall y : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y ->
            RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y a) rho ->
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealFunction.dist (Fmap y) (Fmap a)) eps))
proof:
:= by
  have ha : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hleab
  cases (hFcont a ha).right eps heps with
  | intro rho hrho =>
      refine Exists.intro rho ?_
      refine And.intro hrho.left ?_
      intro y hy hydist
      by_cases hya : y = a
      case pos =>
        rw [hya, RealFunction.dist_self]
        exact heps
      case neg =>
        exact hrho.right y hy hya hydist
