name: exists_fixedEndpointValue_length_radius
statement:
private theorem exists_fixedEndpointValue_length_radius
    (c : Point) {eps : Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun rho : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rho)
          (forall length : Point,
            RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero length ->
              RealTheory.lt length rho ->
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) length) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F c heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      refine Exists.intro eta ?_
      refine And.intro heta.left ?_
      intro length hlength_nonneg hlength_lt
      have hlength_le : RealTheory.le length eta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlength_lt
      have hmul_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) length)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) eta) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
          hlength_le (RealTheory.abs_nonneg c)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hmul_le heta.right

name: closedInterval_nonendpoint_openInterval
statement:
private theorem closedInterval_nonendpoint_openInterval
    {a b x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hxa : Not (x = a))
    (hxb : Not (x = b)) :
    RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnot_x_le_a : Not (RealTheory.le x a) := by
    intro hle
    exact hxa (RealTheory.le_antisymm hle hx.left)
  have hnot_b_le_x : Not (RealTheory.le b x) := by
    intro hle
    exact hxb (RealTheory.le_antisymm hx.right hle)
  exact And.intro
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx.left hnot_x_le_a)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx.right hnot_b_le_x)

name: ftcPrimitiveGauge_left_eq
statement:
private theorem ftcPrimitiveGauge_left_eq

name: ftcPrimitiveGauge_interior_eq
statement:
private theorem ftcPrimitiveGauge_interior_eq
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b eta x : Point}
    {leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
      rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget : Point}
    (data :
      FTCPrimitiveGaugeData Fmap f a b eta
        leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
        rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget)
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x) :
    ftcPrimitiveGauge data x =
      interiorDerivativeRadius a b x (data.interiorRadius x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxa : Not (x = a) := by
    intro h
    have hax : a = x := h.symm
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx.left hax
  have hxb : Not (x = b) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx.right
  simp [ftcPrimitiveGauge, hxa, hxb, hx]

name: ftcPrimitiveGauge_closedIntervalGaugeOn
statement:
private theorem ftcPrimitiveGauge_closedIntervalGaugeOn
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b eta : Point}
    {leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
      rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget : Point}
    (data :
      FTCPrimitiveGaugeData Fmap f a b eta
        leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
        rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget) :
    ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b (ftcPrimitiveGauge data)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  by_cases hxa : x = a
  case pos =>
    subst x
    rw [ftcPrimitiveGauge_left_eq data]
    unfold RealTheory.min
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      data.leftPrimitiveRadius_pos data.leftScaleRadius_pos
  case neg =>
    by_cases hxb : x = b
    case pos =>
      subst x
      rw [ftcPrimitiveGauge_right_eq data hxa]
      unfold RealTheory.min
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        data.rightPrimitiveRadius_pos data.rightScaleRadius_pos
    case neg =>
      have hxopen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x :=
        closedInterval_nonendpoint_openInterval hx hxa hxb
      rw [ftcPrimitiveGauge_interior_eq data hxopen]
      exact interiorDerivativeRadius_pos hxopen
        (data.interiorRadius_pos x hxopen)

name: exists_ftcPrimitiveGaugeData
statement:
private theorem exists_ftcPrimitiveGaugeData
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b eta : Point}
    {leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
      rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget : Point}
    (hleab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hFcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) Fmap)
    (hFderiv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) Fmap f)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hleftPrimitiveBudget :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero leftPrimitiveBudget)
    (hleftScaleBudget :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero leftScaleBudget)
    (hrightPrimitiveBudget :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rightPrimitiveBudget)
    (hrightScaleBudget :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rightScaleBudget) :
    Exists
      (fun _data :
        FTCPrimitiveGaugeData Fmap f a b eta
          leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
          rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget =>
        True)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases exists_leftEndpoint_continuity_radius
      hleab hFcont hleftPrimitiveBudget with
  | intro leftPrimitiveRadius hleftPrimitiveRadius =>
      cases exists_fixedEndpointValue_length_radius
          (f a) hleftScaleBudget with
      | intro leftScaleRadius hleftScaleRadius =>
          cases exists_rightEndpoint_continuity_radius
              hleab hFcont hrightPrimitiveBudget with
          | intro rightPrimitiveRadius hrightPrimitiveRadius =>
              cases exists_fixedEndpointValue_length_radius
                  (f b) hrightScaleBudget with
              | intro rightScaleRadius hrightScaleRadius =>
                  let interiorRadius : Point -> Point :=
                    fun x : Point =>
                      if hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x then
                        Classical.choose
                          (exists_openInterval_differenceQuotient_close_radius
                            hFderiv hx heta)
                      else
                        RealTheory.one
                  refine Exists.intro
                    { leftPrimitiveRadius := leftPrimitiveRadius
                      leftScaleRadius := leftScaleRadius
                      rightPrimitiveRadius := rightPrimitiveRadius
                      rightScaleRadius := rightScaleRadius
                      interiorRadius := interiorRadius
                      leftPrimitiveRadius_pos :=
                        hleftPrimitiveRadius.left
                      leftScaleRadius_pos := hleftScaleRadius.left
                      rightPrimitiveRadius_pos :=
                        hrightPrimitiveRadius.left
                      rightScaleRadius_pos := hrightScaleRadius.left
                      interiorRadius_pos := ?_
                      leftPrimitive_close :=
                        hleftPrimitiveRadius.right
                      leftScale_close := hleftScaleRadius.right
                      rightPrimitive_close :=
                        hrightPrimitiveRadius.right
                      rightScale_close := hrightScaleRadius.right
                      interior_close := ?_ } ?_
                  · intro x hx
                    dsimp [interiorRadius]
                    rw [dif_pos hx]
                    exact
                      (Classical.choose_spec
                        (exists_openInterval_differenceQuotient_close_radius
                          hFderiv hx heta)).left
                  · intro x hx y hy hyne hydist
                    dsimp [interiorRadius] at hydist
                    rw [dif_pos hx] at hydist
                    exact
                      (Classical.choose_spec
                        (exists_openInterval_differenceQuotient_close_radius
                          hFderiv hx heta)).right
                        y hy hyne hydist
                  · trivial

name: endpointCellError_le_dist_add_absMul_cellLength
statement:
private theorem endpointCellError_le_dist_add_absMul_cellLength
    (Fmap : Point -> Point) (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (c : Point)
    (hlen_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (cellLength p k)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
          (RealTheory.mul c (cellLength p k))))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealFunction.dist (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) (cellLength p k)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := F.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k))
  let B := F.mul c (cellLength p k)
  have htri :
      F.le (F.abs (F.add A (F.neg B)))
        (F.add (F.abs A) (F.abs (F.neg B))) :=
    RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs A (F.neg B)
  have hB :
      F.abs (F.neg B) =
        F.mul (F.abs c) (cellLength p k) := by
    change F.abs (F.neg B) =
      F.mul (F.abs c) (cellLength p k)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F B]
    dsimp [B]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F c (cellLength p k)]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hlen_nonneg]
  change
    F.le (F.abs (F.sub A B))
      (F.add
        (RealFunction.dist (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
        (F.mul (F.abs c) (cellLength p k)))
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  change
    F.le (F.abs (F.sub A B))
      (F.add (F.abs A) (F.mul (F.abs c) (cellLength p k)))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg A B]
  rw [hB] at htri
  exact htri

name: cellLength_eq_dist_of_left_endpoint
statement:
private theorem cellLength_eq_dist_of_left_endpoint
    {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat} {a : Point}
    (hleft : p k = a)
    (hle : RealTheory.le a (p (k + 1))) :
    cellLength p k = RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold cellLength RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  rw [hleft]
  have hnonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.sub (p (k + 1)) a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hle
  change F.sub (p (k + 1)) a =
    F.abs (F.sub (p (k + 1)) a)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hnonneg]

name: cellLength_eq_dist_of_right_endpoint
statement:
private theorem cellLength_eq_dist_of_right_endpoint
    {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat} {b : Point}
    (hright : p (k + 1) = b)
    (hle : RealTheory.le (p k) b) :
    cellLength p k = RealFunction.dist (p k) b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold cellLength RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  rw [hright]
  have hnonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.sub b (p k)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hle
  change F.sub b (p k) =
    F.abs (F.sub (p k) b)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm F (p k) b]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hnonneg]

name: ftcPrimitiveGauge_interior_cell_error_le
statement:
private theorem ftcPrimitiveGauge_interior_cell_error_le
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b eta : Point}
    {leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
      rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget : Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (data :
      FTCPrimitiveGaugeData Fmap f a b eta
        leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
        rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget)
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag (ftcPrimitiveGauge data))
    (hk : k < n)
    (htagOpen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (tag k)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
          (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
      (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
proof:
:= by
  have hcell : PartitionCell p k (tag k) :=
    gaugeFineTaggedPartition_tag_mem_cell hfine hk
  have hleftMem : PartitionCell p k (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hfine.left.left hk
  have hrightMem : PartitionCell p k (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_right_mem hfine.left.left hk
  have hfineCell : GaugeFineCell p tag (ftcPrimitiveGauge data) k :=
    gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cell_fine hfine hk
  have hleftDist :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (p k) (tag k))
        (interiorDerivativeRadius a b (tag k)
          (data.interiorRadius (tag k))) := by
    have hraw := hfineCell (p k) hleftMem
    rwa [ftcPrimitiveGauge_interior_eq data htagOpen] at hraw
  have hrightDist :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (tag k))
        (interiorDerivativeRadius a b (tag k)
          (data.interiorRadius (tag k))) := by
    have hraw := hfineCell (p (k + 1)) hrightMem
    rwa [ftcPrimitiveGauge_interior_eq data htagOpen] at hraw
  unfold cellLength
  exact FundamentalTheoremInternal.straddling_linearError_le_eta_mul_sub_of_interiorRadius
    (Fmap := Fmap) (a := a) (b := b)
    (u := p k) (x := tag k) (v := p (k + 1))
    (L := f (tag k)) (eta := eta)
    (rho := data.interiorRadius (tag k))
    htagOpen
    (data.interior_close (tag k) htagOpen)
    hcell.left hcell.right hleftDist hrightDist

name: ftcPrimitiveGauge_leftEndpoint_cell_error_lt
statement:
private theorem ftcPrimitiveGauge_leftEndpoint_cell_error_lt
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b eta : Point}
    {leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
      rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget : Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (data :
      FTCPrimitiveGaugeData Fmap f a b eta
        leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
        rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget)
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag (ftcPrimitiveGauge data))
    (hk : k < n)
    (htag : tag k = a) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
          (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
      (RealTheory.add leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htagged : TaggedPartition a b n p tag := hfine.left
  have hleftEq : p k = a :=
    leftEndpointTaggedCell_left_eq htagged hk htag
  have hrightMem : PartitionCell p k (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_right_mem htagged.left hk
  have hrightClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
      htagged.left hk hrightMem
  have hlen_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (cellLength p k) :=
    cellLength_nonnegative htagged.left hk
  have hfineCell : GaugeFineCell p tag (ftcPrimitiveGauge data) k :=
    gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cell_fine hfine hk
  have hdistGauge :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) a)
        (ftcPrimitiveGauge data a) := by
    have hraw := hfineCell (p (k + 1)) hrightMem
    rwa [htag] at hraw
  have hdistPrimitive :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) a)
        data.leftPrimitiveRadius := by
    have hgauge_le :
        RealTheory.le
          (ftcPrimitiveGauge data a)
          data.leftPrimitiveRadius := by
      rw [ftcPrimitiveGauge_left_eq data]
      exact RealTheory.min_le_left
        data.leftPrimitiveRadius data.leftScaleRadius
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hdistGauge hgauge_le
  have hdistScale :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) a)
        data.leftScaleRadius := by
    have hgauge_le :
        RealTheory.le
          (ftcPrimitiveGauge data a)
          data.leftScaleRadius := by
      rw [ftcPrimitiveGauge_left_eq data]
      exact RealTheory.min_le_right
        data.leftPrimitiveRadius data.leftScaleRadius
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hdistGauge hgauge_le
  have hlen_eq_dist :
      cellLength p k = RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) a :=
    cellLength_eq_dist_of_left_endpoint hleftEq hrightClosed.left
  have hlen_lt_scale :
      RealTheory.lt (cellLength p k) data.leftScaleRadius := by
    rw [hlen_eq_dist]
    exact hdistScale
  have hprimitive :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap a))
        leftPrimitiveBudget :=
    data.leftPrimitive_close (p (k + 1)) hrightClosed hdistPrimitive
  have hscale :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f a)) (cellLength p k))
        leftScaleBudget :=
    data.leftScale_close (cellLength p k) hlen_nonneg hlen_lt_scale
  have halg :=
    endpointCellError_le_dist_add_absMul_cellLength
      Fmap p k (f (tag k)) hlen_nonneg
  rw [hleftEq, htag] at halg
  have hpieces :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealFunction.dist (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap a))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f a)) (cellLength p k)))
        (RealTheory.add leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hprimitive hscale
  rw [hleftEq, htag]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F halg hpieces

name: ftcPrimitiveGauge_rightEndpoint_cell_error_lt
statement:
private theorem ftcPrimitiveGauge_rightEndpoint_cell_error_lt
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b eta : Point}
    {leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
      rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget : Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (data :
      FTCPrimitiveGaugeData Fmap f a b eta
        leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
        rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget)
    (hba : Not (b = a))
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag (ftcPrimitiveGauge data))
    (hk : k < n)
    (htag : tag k = b) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
          (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
      (RealTheory.add rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htagged : TaggedPartition a b n p tag := hfine.left
  have hrightEq : p (k + 1) = b :=
    rightEndpointTaggedCell_right_eq htagged hk htag
  have hleftMem : PartitionCell p k (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_left_mem htagged.left hk
  have hleftClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
      htagged.left hk hleftMem
  have hlen_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (cellLength p k) :=
    cellLength_nonnegative htagged.left hk
  have hfineCell : GaugeFineCell p tag (ftcPrimitiveGauge data) k :=
    gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cell_fine hfine hk
  have hdistGauge :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (p k) b)
        (ftcPrimitiveGauge data b) := by
    have hraw := hfineCell (p k) hleftMem
    rwa [htag] at hraw
  have hdistPrimitive :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (p k) b)
        data.rightPrimitiveRadius := by
    have hgauge_le :
        RealTheory.le
          (ftcPrimitiveGauge data b)
          data.rightPrimitiveRadius := by
      rw [ftcPrimitiveGauge_right_eq data hba]
      exact RealTheory.min_le_left
        data.rightPrimitiveRadius data.rightScaleRadius
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hdistGauge hgauge_le
  have hdistScale :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (p k) b)
        data.rightScaleRadius := by
    have hgauge_le :
        RealTheory.le
          (ftcPrimitiveGauge data b)
          data.rightScaleRadius := by
      rw [ftcPrimitiveGauge_right_eq data hba]
      exact RealTheory.min_le_right
        data.rightPrimitiveRadius data.rightScaleRadius
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hdistGauge hgauge_le
  have hlen_eq_dist :
      cellLength p k = RealFunction.dist (p k) b :=
    cellLength_eq_dist_of_right_endpoint hrightEq hleftClosed.right
  have hlen_lt_scale :
      RealTheory.lt (cellLength p k) data.rightScaleRadius := by
    rw [hlen_eq_dist]
    exact hdistScale
  have hprimitive_raw :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (Fmap (p k)) (Fmap b))
        rightPrimitiveBudget :=
    data.rightPrimitive_close (p k) hleftClosed hdistPrimitive
  have hprimitive :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (Fmap b) (Fmap (p k)))
        rightPrimitiveBudget := by
    rwa [RealFunction.dist_comm (Fmap b) (Fmap (p k))]
  have hscale :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f b)) (cellLength p k))
        rightScaleBudget :=
    data.rightScale_close (cellLength p k) hlen_nonneg hlen_lt_scale
  have halg :=
    endpointCellError_le_dist_add_absMul_cellLength
      Fmap p k (f (tag k)) hlen_nonneg
  rw [hrightEq, htag] at halg
  have hpieces :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealFunction.dist (Fmap b) (Fmap (p k)))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f b)) (cellLength p k)))
        (RealTheory.add rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hprimitive hscale
  rw [hrightEq, htag]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F halg hpieces

name: abs_taggedSum_sub_endpoint_le_sum_cell_error_abs
statement:
private theorem abs_taggedSum_sub_endpoint_le_sum_cell_error_abs
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point} {n : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (taggedSum f p tag n)
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap b) (Fmap a))))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
        n)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :=
    abs_partialTaggedErrorSum_le_partialTaggedAbsErrorSum
      f p (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) tag
      (primitiveCellIncrement Fmap p) n
  rw [primitiveCellErrorSum_eq_taggedSum_sub_endpoint htag] at hsum
  unfold partialTaggedAbsErrorSum at hsum
  have hcongr :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.abs
              (partialTaggedError f p (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag
                (primitiveCellIncrement Fmap p) k))
          n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub
                (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
                (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
          n :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
      (fun k : Nat =>
        abs_partialPrimitiveCellError_eq_abs_cellError Fmap f p tag k)
      n
  rwa [hcongr] at hsum

name: abs_taggedSum_sub_endpoint_le_budget_sum
statement:
private theorem abs_taggedSum_sub_endpoint_le_budget_sum
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point} {n : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point} {budget : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hbudget :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
          (budget k)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (taggedSum f p tag n)
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap b) (Fmap a))))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum budget n)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum_abs :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub
            (taggedSum f p tag n)
            (RealTheory.sub (Fmap b) (Fmap a))))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub
                (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
                (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
          n) :=
    abs_taggedSum_sub_endpoint_le_sum_cell_error_abs htag
  have hsum_budget :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub
                (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
                (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
          n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum budget n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
            (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
      budget n hbudget
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hsum_abs hsum_budget

name: leftEndpointTaggedCell_error_eq_zero_of_right_eq
statement:
private theorem leftEndpointTaggedCell_error_eq_zero_of_right_eq
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point} {n k : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hk : k < n)
    (htag : tag k = a)
    (hright : p (k + 1) = a) :
    RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
          (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))) =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft : p k = a :=
    leftEndpointTaggedCell_left_eq h hk htag
  have hlen :
      cellLength p k = RealTheory.zero :=
    leftEndpointTaggedCell_cellLength_eq_zero_of_right_eq
      h hk htag hright
  rw [hleft, hright, htag, hlen]
  change
    F.abs
        (F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap a) (Fmap a))
          (F.mul (f a) F.zero)) =
      F.zero
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F (Fmap a)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_zero F (f a)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.zero]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_zero F]

statement:

name: leftEndpointBudgetTerm_unique_nonzero
statement:
private theorem leftEndpointBudgetTerm_unique_nonzero
    {a b : Point} {n k j : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hk : k < n)
    (htagk : tag k = a)
    (hrightk : Not (p (k + 1) = a))
    (hj : j < n)
    (hne : Not (j = k))
    (htagj : tag j = a) :
    p (j + 1) = a
proof:
:= by
  have hleftj : p j = a :=
    leftEndpointTaggedCell_left_eq h hj htagj
  by_cases hjk : j < k
  · have hmono :
        RealTheory.le (p (j + 1)) (p k) :=
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
        h.left (j + 1) k (by omega) (Nat.le_of_lt hk)
    have hupper : RealTheory.le (p (j + 1)) a := by
      have hleftk : p k = a :=
        leftEndpointTaggedCell_left_eq h hk htagk
      rwa [hleftk] at hmono
    have hlower : RealTheory.le a (p (j + 1)) := by
      have hmono0 :
          RealTheory.le (p 0) (p (j + 1)) :=
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
          h.left 0 (j + 1) (Nat.zero_le (j + 1)) (by omega)
      rwa [intervalPartition_left_endpoint h.left] at hmono0
    exact RealTheory.le_antisymm hupper hlower
  · have hkj : k < j := by omega
    have hmono :
        RealTheory.le (p (k + 1)) (p j) :=
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
        h.left (k + 1) j (by omega) (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
    have hupper : RealTheory.le (p (k + 1)) a := by
      rwa [hleftj] at hmono
    have hlower : RealTheory.le a (p (k + 1)) := by
      have hmono0 :
          RealTheory.le (p 0) (p (k + 1)) :=
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
          h.left 0 (k + 1) (Nat.zero_le (k + 1)) (by omega)
      rwa [intervalPartition_left_endpoint h.left] at hmono0
    exact False.elim (hrightk (RealTheory.le_antisymm hupper hlower))

name: rightEndpointBudgetTerm_unique_nonzero
statement:
private theorem rightEndpointBudgetTerm_unique_nonzero
    {a b : Point} {n k j : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hk : k < n)
    (htagk : tag k = b)
    (hleftk : Not (p k = b))
    (hj : j < n)
    (hne : Not (j = k))
    (htagj : tag j = b) :
    p j = b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hjk : j < k
  · have hrightj : p (j + 1) = b :=
      rightEndpointTaggedCell_right_eq h hj htagj
    have hmono :
        RealTheory.le (p (j + 1)) (p k) :=
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
        h.left (j + 1) k (by omega) (Nat.le_of_lt hk)
    have hlower : RealTheory.le b (p k) := by
      rwa [hrightj] at hmono
    have hupper : RealTheory.le (p k) b := by
      have hmonoN :
          RealTheory.le (p k) (p n) :=
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
          h.left k n (Nat.le_of_lt hk) (Nat.le_refl n)
      rwa [intervalPartition_right_endpoint h.left] at hmonoN
    exact False.elim (hleftk (RealTheory.le_antisymm hupper hlower))
  · have hkj : k < j := by omega
    have hrightk : p (k + 1) = b :=
      rightEndpointTaggedCell_right_eq h hk htagk
    have hmono :
        RealTheory.le (p (k + 1)) (p j) :=
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
        h.left (k + 1) j (by omega) (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
    have hlower : RealTheory.le b (p j) := by
      rwa [hrightk] at hmono
    have hupper : RealTheory.le (p j) b := by
      have hmonoN :
          RealTheory.le (p j) (p n) :=
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
          h.left j n (Nat.le_of_lt hj) (Nat.le_refl n)
      rwa [intervalPartition_right_endpoint h.left] at hmonoN
    exact RealTheory.le_antisymm hupper hlower

name: finiteSum_leftEndpointBudgetTerm_le
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_leftEndpointBudgetTerm_le
    {a b leftBudget : Point} {n : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hleftBudget : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero leftBudget) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag) n)
      leftBudget
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hex :
      Exists (fun k : Nat =>
        And (k < n)
          (And (tag k = a) (Not (p (k + 1) = a))))
  · cases hex with
    | intro k hkdata =>
        have hk : k < n := hkdata.left
        have htagk : tag k = a := hkdata.right.left
        have hrightk : Not (p (k + 1) = a) := hkdata.right.right
        have hzero :
            forall j : Nat, j < n -> Not (j = k) ->
              leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag j =
                RealTheory.zero := by
          intro j hj hne
          unfold leftEndpointBudgetTerm
          by_cases htagj : tag j = a
          · have hrightj : p (j + 1) = a :=
              leftEndpointBudgetTerm_unique_nonzero
                h hk htagk hrightk hj hne htagj
            simp [htagj, hrightj]
          · simp [htagj]
        have hsum :
            RealTheory.finiteSum
                (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag) n =
              leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag k :=
          RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_single_of_eq_zero_off hk hzero
        rw [hsum]
        unfold leftEndpointBudgetTerm
        simpa [htagk, hrightk] using
          (RealTheory.le_refl leftBudget)
  · have hzero :
        forall k : Nat, k < n ->
          leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag k =
            RealTheory.zero := by
      intro k hk
      unfold leftEndpointBudgetTerm
      by_cases htagk : tag k = a
      · by_cases hrightk : p (k + 1) = a
        · simp [htagk, hrightk]
        · exact False.elim (hex
            (Exists.intro k
              (And.intro hk (And.intro htagk hrightk))))
      · simp [htagk]
    have hsum :
        RealTheory.finiteSum
            (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag) n =
          RealTheory.zero :=
      RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero n hzero
    rw [hsum]
    exact hleftBudget

name: finiteSum_rightEndpointBudgetTerm_le
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_rightEndpointBudgetTerm_le
    {a b rightBudget : Point} {n : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hrightBudget : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero rightBudget) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag) n)
      rightBudget
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hex :
      Exists (fun k : Nat =>
        And (k < n)
          (And (tag k = b) (Not (p k = b))))
  · cases hex with
    | intro k hkdata =>
        have hk : k < n := hkdata.left
        have htagk : tag k = b := hkdata.right.left
        have hleftk : Not (p k = b) := hkdata.right.right
        have hzero :
            forall j : Nat, j < n -> Not (j = k) ->
              rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag j =
                RealTheory.zero := by
          intro j hj hne
          unfold rightEndpointBudgetTerm
          by_cases htagj : tag j = b
          · have hleftj : p j = b :=
              rightEndpointBudgetTerm_unique_nonzero
                h hk htagk hleftk hj hne htagj
            simp [htagj, hleftj]
          · simp [htagj]
        have hsum :
            RealTheory.finiteSum
                (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag) n =
              rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag k :=
          RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_single_of_eq_zero_off hk hzero
        rw [hsum]
        unfold rightEndpointBudgetTerm
        simpa [htagk, hleftk] using
          (RealTheory.le_refl rightBudget)
  · have hzero :
        forall k : Nat, k < n ->
          rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag k =
            RealTheory.zero := by
      intro k hk
      unfold rightEndpointBudgetTerm
      by_cases htagk : tag k = b
      · by_cases hleftk : p k = b
        · simp [htagk, hleftk]
        · exact False.elim (hex
            (Exists.intro k
              (And.intro hk (And.intro htagk hleftk))))
      · simp [htagk]
    have hsum :
        RealTheory.finiteSum
            (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag) n =
          RealTheory.zero :=
      RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero n hzero
    rw [hsum]
    exact hrightBudget

name: le_add_add_left_of_nonneg
statement:
private theorem le_add_add_left_of_nonneg
    (x y z : Point)
    (hy : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero y)
    (hz : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero z) :
    RealTheory.le x (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x y) z)
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : RealTheory.le x (RealTheory.add x y) := by
    have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_left hy x
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add x RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add x y) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
  have hxyz :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add x y)
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x y) z) := by
    have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_left hz (RealTheory.add x y)
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x y) RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x y) z) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hxy hxyz

name: le_add_add_middle_of_nonneg
statement:
private theorem le_add_add_middle_of_nonneg
    (x y z : Point)
    (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hz : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero z) :
    RealTheory.le y (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x y) z)
proof:
:= by
  have hyx : RealTheory.le y (RealTheory.add x y) := by
    have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_right hx y
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero y)
        (RealTheory.add x y) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.zero_add] at h
  have hxyz :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add x y)
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x y) z) := by
    have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_left hz (RealTheory.add x y)
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x y) RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x y) z) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hyx hxyz

name: le_add_add_right_of_nonneg
statement:
private theorem le_add_add_right_of_nonneg
    (x y z : Point)
    (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
    (hy : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero y) :
    RealTheory.le z (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x y) z)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxy : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.add x y) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hx hy
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add x y) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.zero_add] at h
  have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_right hxy z
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero z)
      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x y) z) at h
  rwa [RealTheory.zero_add] at h

name: endpointLengthBudgetTerm_nonneg
statement:
private theorem endpointLengthBudgetTerm_nonneg
    {a b eta leftBudget rightBudget : Point} {n k : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hk : k < n)
    (heta : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hleftBudget : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero leftBudget)
    (hrightBudget : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero rightBudget) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (endpointLengthBudgetTerm
        a b eta leftBudget rightBudget p tag k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleftTerm :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag k) :=
    leftEndpointBudgetTerm_nonneg hleftBudget
  have hrightTerm :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag k) :=
    rightEndpointBudgetTerm_nonneg hrightBudget
  have hlenTerm :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_nonneg heta
      (cellLength_nonnegative h.left hk)
  unfold endpointLengthBudgetTerm
  have hpair :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.add
          (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag k)
          (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag k)) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hleftTerm hrightTerm
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add
          (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag k)
          (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag k)) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.zero_add] at h
  have htotal := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hpair hlenTerm
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add
          (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag k)
          (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag k))
        (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))) at htotal
  rwa [RealTheory.zero_add] at htotal

name: cellError_le_endpointLengthBudgetTerm_of_cases
statement:
private theorem cellError_le_endpointLengthBudgetTerm_of_cases
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b eta leftBudget rightBudget : Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hk : k < n)
    (heta : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hleftBudget : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero leftBudget)
    (hrightBudget : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero rightBudget)
    (hleft :
      tag k = a ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
          leftBudget)
    (hright :
      tag k = b ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
          rightBudget)
    (hinterior :
      RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (tag k) ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
          (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
          (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
      (endpointLengthBudgetTerm
        a b eta leftBudget rightBudget p tag k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases htagA : tag k = a
  · by_cases hrightA : p (k + 1) = a
    · have hzero :=
        leftEndpointTaggedCell_error_eq_zero_of_right_eq
          (Fmap := Fmap) (f := f) h hk htagA hrightA
      rw [hzero]
      exact endpointLengthBudgetTerm_nonneg
        h hk heta hleftBudget hrightBudget
    · have herr := hleft htagA
      have hleftTerm :
          leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag k =
            leftBudget := by
        unfold leftEndpointBudgetTerm
        simp [htagA, hrightA]
      have hrightTerm_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag k) :=
        rightEndpointBudgetTerm_nonneg hrightBudget
      have hlenTerm_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k)) :=
        RealTheory.mul_nonneg heta
          (cellLength_nonnegative h.left hk)
      have hbudget :
          RealTheory.le leftBudget
            (endpointLengthBudgetTerm
              a b eta leftBudget rightBudget p tag k) := by
        unfold endpointLengthBudgetTerm
        rw [hleftTerm]
        exact le_add_add_left_of_nonneg
          leftBudget
          (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag k)
          (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
          hrightTerm_nonneg hlenTerm_nonneg
      exact RealTheory.le_trans herr hbudget
  · by_cases htagB : tag k = b
    · by_cases hleftB : p k = b
      · have hzero :=
          rightEndpointTaggedCell_error_eq_zero_of_left_eq
            (Fmap := Fmap) (f := f) h hk htagB hleftB
        rw [hzero]
        exact endpointLengthBudgetTerm_nonneg
          h hk heta hleftBudget hrightBudget
      · have herr := hright htagB
        have hrightTerm :
            rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag k =
              rightBudget := by
          unfold rightEndpointBudgetTerm
          simp [htagB, hleftB]
        have hleftTerm_nonneg :
            RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
              (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag k) :=
          leftEndpointBudgetTerm_nonneg hleftBudget
        have hlenTerm_nonneg :
            RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
              (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k)) :=
          RealTheory.mul_nonneg heta
            (cellLength_nonnegative h.left hk)
        have hbudget :
            RealTheory.le rightBudget
              (endpointLengthBudgetTerm
                a b eta leftBudget rightBudget p tag k) := by
          unfold endpointLengthBudgetTerm
          rw [hrightTerm]
          exact le_add_add_middle_of_nonneg
            (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag k)
            rightBudget
            (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
            hleftTerm_nonneg hlenTerm_nonneg
        exact RealTheory.le_trans herr hbudget
    · have htagClosed :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (tag k) :=
        taggedPartition_tag_mem_closedInterval h hk
      have htagOpen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (tag k) :=
        closedInterval_nonendpoint_openInterval
          htagClosed htagA htagB
      have herr := hinterior htagOpen
      have hleftTerm_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag k) :=
        leftEndpointBudgetTerm_nonneg hleftBudget
      have hrightTerm_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag k) :=
        rightEndpointBudgetTerm_nonneg hrightBudget
      have hbudget :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
            (endpointLengthBudgetTerm
              a b eta leftBudget rightBudget p tag k) := by
        unfold endpointLengthBudgetTerm
        exact le_add_add_right_of_nonneg
          (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag k)
          (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag k)
          (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
          hleftTerm_nonneg hrightTerm_nonneg
      exact RealTheory.le_trans herr hbudget

name: finiteSum_eta_mul_cellLength_eq_mul_endpointLength
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_eta_mul_cellLength_eq_mul_endpointLength
    {a b eta : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k)) n =
      RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a)

:= by

name: finiteSum_endpointLengthBudgetTerm_le
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_endpointLengthBudgetTerm_le
    {a b eta leftBudget rightBudget : Point} {n : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hleftBudget : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero leftBudget)
    (hrightBudget : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero rightBudget) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (endpointLengthBudgetTerm
          a b eta leftBudget rightBudget p tag) n)
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add leftBudget rightBudget)
        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsplit :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (endpointLengthBudgetTerm
            a b eta leftBudget rightBudget p tag) n =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag) n)
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag) n))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k)) n) := by
    unfold endpointLengthBudgetTerm
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
  rw [hsplit]
  rw [finiteSum_eta_mul_cellLength_eq_mul_endpointLength h.left]
  have hleftSum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag) n)
        leftBudget :=
    finiteSum_leftEndpointBudgetTerm_le h hleftBudget
  have hrightSum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag) n)
        rightBudget :=
    finiteSum_rightEndpointBudgetTerm_le h hrightBudget
  have hendpoint :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (leftEndpointBudgetTerm a leftBudget p tag) n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (rightEndpointBudgetTerm b rightBudget p tag) n))
        (RealTheory.add leftBudget rightBudget) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hleftSum hrightSum
  exact RealTheory.add_le_add_right hendpoint
    (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a))

name: abs_taggedSum_sub_endpoint_le_endpointBudgets_add_eta_mul_endpointLength
statement:
private theorem abs_taggedSum_sub_endpoint_le_endpointBudgets_add_eta_mul_endpointLength
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b eta leftBudget rightBudget : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (heta : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hleftBudget : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero leftBudget)
    (hrightBudget : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero rightBudget)
    (hleft :
      forall k : Nat, k < n -> tag k = a ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
          leftBudget)
    (hright :
      forall k : Nat, k < n -> tag k = b ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
          rightBudget)
    (hinterior :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (tag k) ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub
                (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
                (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
            (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (taggedSum f p tag n)
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap b) (Fmap a))))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add leftBudget rightBudget)
        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a)))
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (cellLength p k))))
          (endpointLengthBudgetTerm
            a b eta leftBudget rightBudget p tag k) := by
    intro k hk
    exact cellError_le_endpointLengthBudgetTerm_of_cases
      h hk heta hleftBudget hrightBudget
      (hleft k hk) (hright k hk) (hinterior k hk)
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub
            (taggedSum f p tag n)
            (RealTheory.sub (Fmap b) (Fmap a))))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (endpointLengthBudgetTerm
            a b eta leftBudget rightBudget p tag) n) :=
    abs_taggedSum_sub_endpoint_le_budget_sum h hpoint
  have hbudget :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (endpointLengthBudgetTerm
            a b eta leftBudget rightBudget p tag) n)
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add leftBudget rightBudget)
          (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a))) :=
    finiteSum_endpointLengthBudgetTerm_le
      h hleftBudget hrightBudget
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hsum hbudget

name: ftcPrimitiveGauge_abs_taggedSum_sub_endpoint_le_endpointBudgets_add_eta_mul_endpointLength
statement:
private theorem ftcPrimitiveGauge_abs_taggedSum_sub_endpoint_le_endpointBudgets_add_eta_mul_endpointLength
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b eta : Point}
    {leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
      rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (data :
      FTCPrimitiveGaugeData Fmap f a b eta
        leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget
        rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget)
    (hba : Not (b = a))
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag (ftcPrimitiveGauge data))
    (heta : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hleftBudget :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.add leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget))
    (hrightBudget :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.add rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (taggedSum f p tag n)
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap b) (Fmap a))))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget)
          (RealTheory.add rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget))
        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  exact
    abs_taggedSum_sub_endpoint_le_endpointBudgets_add_eta_mul_endpointLength
      (Fmap := Fmap) (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (eta := eta)
      (leftBudget := RealTheory.add leftPrimitiveBudget leftScaleBudget)
      (rightBudget := RealTheory.add rightPrimitiveBudget rightScaleBudget)
      hfine.left heta hleftBudget hrightBudget
      (fun k hk htag =>
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (ftcPrimitiveGauge_leftEndpoint_cell_error_lt
            data hfine hk htag))
      (fun k hk htag =>
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (ftcPrimitiveGauge_rightEndpoint_cell_error_lt
            data hba hfine hk htag))
      (fun k hk htagOpen =>
        ftcPrimitiveGauge_interior_cell_error_le
          data hfine hk htagOpen)

name: ftcEndpointLengthBudget_lt_eps
statement:
private theorem ftcEndpointLengthBudget_lt_eps
    {a b eps eta endpointBudget : Point}
    (hendpoint :
      endpointBudget =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps)
    (heta :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add endpointBudget
        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a)))
      eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  change F.lt (F.add endpointBudget (F.mul eta (F.sub b a))) eps
  have hsum :
      F.lt (F.add e2 (F.mul eta (F.sub b a))) (F.add e2 e2) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heta e2
  rw [hendpoint]
  change F.lt (F.add e2 (F.mul eta (F.sub b a))) eps
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hsum

name: ftcFourEqualEndpointBudgets_eq_half
statement:
private theorem ftcFourEqualEndpointBudgets_eq_half
    (eps : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps)))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps))))
        (RealTheory.add
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps)))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps)))) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  let e4 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F e2
  let e8 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F e4
  change F.add (F.add e8 e8) (F.add e8 e8) = e2
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F e4]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F e2

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_derivative_eq_sub_ordered
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_derivative_eq_sub_ordered
    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hleab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hFcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) Fmap)
    (hFderiv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) Fmap f) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b
      (RealTheory.sub (Fmap b) (Fmap a))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hba : b = a
  · rw [hba]
    change HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a a
      (F.sub (Fmap a) (Fmap a))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F (Fmap a)]
    exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_degenerate f a
  · refine And.intro hleab ?_
    intro eps heps
    let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
    let e4 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F e2
    let e8 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F e4
    have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
    have he4_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e4 :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F he2_pos
    have he8_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e8 :=

theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE

proof:
:= by

  let S := endpointAugmentedDerivativeExceptionalSet a b F f
  have hSNull : RealNegligibility.NullSet S := by
    unfold S
    exact endpointAugmentedDerivativeExceptionalSet_null hDeriv
  have hSLocalNull :
      RealNegligibility.NullSet
        (fun x : Point => And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x)) :=
    RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
      (E := fun x : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x))
      (F := S)
      (fun _x hx => hx.right)
      hSNull
  have hcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval hAC
  have hNV : NegligibleVariationOn F S a b :=
    negligibleVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_of_nullSet
      hAC hSLocalNull
  have hendpoint : forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
        Not (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x) -> S x := by
    intro x hx hnotOpen
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hnotS
    exact hnotOpen
      (endpointAugmentedDerivativeExceptionalSet_good_tag hx hnotS).left
  have hgood : forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x -> Not (S x) ->
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
          (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) F x (f x) := by
    intro x hx hnotS
    have hxClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
      And.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx.left)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx.right)
    exact
      (endpointAugmentedDerivativeExceptionalSet_good_tag
        hxClosed hnotS).right
  have hzeroExtension :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (exceptionalZeroExtension S f) a b
        (RealTheory.sub (F b) (F a)) :=
    hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_exceptionalZeroExtension_derivative_eq_sub
      hab hcont hSLocalNull hendpoint hNV hgood
  have hdiffNull :
      RealNegligibility.NullSet
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
            (Not (exceptionalZeroExtension S f x = f x))) :=
    RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
      (E := fun x : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
          (Not (exceptionalZeroExtension S f x = f x)))
      (F := fun x : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x))
      (fun x hx =>
        And.intro hx.left
          (by
            by_cases hxS : S x
            · exact hxS
            · exact False.elim
                (hx.right
                  (exceptionalZeroExtension_of_not_mem hxS))))
      hSLocalNull
  exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_congr_nullSet
    hab hdiffNull hzeroExtension

statement:
lemma bounds the discrepancy, and the total is made small. Hake's theorem
(`Tautology.RealIntegral.HenstockKurzweil.Hake`) supplies the passage to the
limit at the endpoints.

That is why this file, a single theorem, imports seven modules and reaches
across three regions.

## Position in the development

Above `Tautology.RealDerivative.AlmostEverywhere`,
`Tautology.RealDerivative.MeanValue`,
`Tautology.RealDerivative.BoundedVariation.Covering`,

## Role

Implementation.

private theorem continuousOn_of_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn
    {f primitive : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (h : HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f primitive a b) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) primitive
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hab : RealTheory.le a b
  · intro x hx
    refine And.intro hx ?_
    intro eps heps
    have hleftIntegral :
        HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a x
          (RealTheory.sub (primitive x) (primitive a)) :=
      hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_interval_increment h
        (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab) hx hx.left
    have hrightIntegral :
        HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f x b
          (RealTheory.sub (primitive b) (primitive x)) :=
      hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_interval_increment h hx
        (And.intro hab (RealTheory.le_refl b)) hx.right
    cases
        hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_right_subinterval_tendsTo_zero
          hx.left hleftIntegral eps heps with
    | intro etaLeft hetaLeft =>
        cases
            hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_left_subinterval_tendsTo_zero
              hx.right hrightIntegral eps heps with
        | intro etaRight hetaRight =>
            let eta := RealTheory.min etaLeft etaRight
            have heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta := by
              dsimp [eta, RealTheory.min]
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
                hetaLeft.left hetaRight.left
            refine Exists.intro eta ?_
            refine And.intro heta ?_
            intro y hy hyne hydist
            cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hyne with
            | inl hyx =>
                have hyxLe : RealTheory.le y x :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hyx
                have hsmall :
                    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x y) etaLeft := by
                  have hydist' :
                      F.lt
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub x y)) eta := by
                    change
                      F.lt
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub y x)) eta
                      at hydist
                    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm F y x]
                      at hydist
                    exact hydist
                  have hxyNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub x y) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hyxLe
                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hxyNonneg]
                    at hydist'
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hydist'
                    (RealTheory.min_le_left etaLeft etaRight)
                have hvalue :
                    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f y x
                      (RealTheory.sub (primitive x) (primitive y)) :=
                  hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_interval_increment h hy hx hyxLe
                have hclose :=
                  hetaLeft.right y
                    (RealTheory.sub (primitive x) (primitive y))
                    hy.left hyx hsmall hvalue
                change
                  F.lt
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                      (F.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))) eps
                change
                  F.lt
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                      (F.sub (primitive x) (primitive y))) eps
                  at hclose
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm F
                  (primitive y) (primitive x)]
                exact hclose
            | inr hxy =>
                have hxyLe : RealTheory.le x y :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxy
                have hsmall :
                    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub y x) etaRight := by
                  change
                    F.lt
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub y x)) eta
                    at hydist
                  have hyxNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hxyLe
                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hyxNonneg]
                    at hydist
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hydist
                    (RealTheory.min_le_right etaLeft etaRight)
                have hvalue :
                    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f x y
                      (RealTheory.sub (primitive y) (primitive x)) :=
                  hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_interval_increment h hx hy hxyLe
                have hclose :=
                  hetaRight.right y
                    (RealTheory.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))
                    hxy hy.right hsmall hvalue
                change
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (RealTheory.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))) eps
                exact hclose
  · intro x hx
    exact False.elim
      (hab (RealTheory.le_trans hx.left hx.right))
