    cases
        hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_right_subinterval_tendsTo_zero
          hx.left hleftIntegral eps heps with
    | intro etaLeft hetaLeft =>
        cases
            hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_left_subinterval_tendsTo_zero
              hx.right hrightIntegral eps heps with
        | intro etaRight hetaRight =>
            let eta := RealTheory.min etaLeft etaRight
            have heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta := by
              dsimp [eta, RealTheory.min]
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
                hetaLeft.left hetaRight.left
            refine Exists.intro eta ?_
            refine And.intro heta ?_
            intro y hy hyne hydist
            cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hyne with
            | inl hyx =>
                have hyxLe : RealTheory.le y x :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hyx
                have hsmall :
                    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x y) etaLeft := by
                  have hydist' :
                      F.lt
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub x y)) eta := by
                    change
                      F.lt
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub y x)) eta
                      at hydist
                    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm F y x]
                      at hydist
                    exact hydist
                  have hxyNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub x y) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hyxLe
                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hxyNonneg]
                    at hydist'
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hydist'
                    (RealTheory.min_le_left etaLeft etaRight)
                have hvalue :
                    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f y x
                      (RealTheory.sub (primitive x) (primitive y)) :=
                  hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_interval_increment h hy hx hyxLe
                have hclose :=
                  hetaLeft.right y
                    (RealTheory.sub (primitive x) (primitive y))
                    hy.left hyx hsmall hvalue
                change
                  F.lt
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                      (F.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))) eps
                change
                  F.lt
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                      (F.sub (primitive x) (primitive y))) eps
                  at hclose
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm F
                  (primitive y) (primitive x)]
                exact hclose
            | inr hxy =>
                have hxyLe : RealTheory.le x y :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxy
                have hsmall :
                    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub y x) etaRight := by
                  change
                    F.lt
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub y x)) eta
                    at hydist
                  have hyxNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hxyLe
                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hyxNonneg]
                    at hydist
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hydist
                    (RealTheory.min_le_right etaLeft etaRight)
                have hvalue :
                    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f x y
                      (RealTheory.sub (primitive y) (primitive x)) :=
                  hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_interval_increment h hx hy hxyLe
                have hclose :=
                  hetaRight.right y
                    (RealTheory.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))
                    hxy hy.right hsmall hvalue
                change
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (RealTheory.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))) eps
                exact hclose
  · intro x hx
    exact False.elim
      (hab (RealTheory.le_trans hx.left hx.right))

name: hkPrimitiveBadWitness_spec
statement:
private theorem hkPrimitiveBadWitness_spec
    {a b x : Point} {primitive f : Point -> Point} {q : Nat}
    {supportGauge : Point -> Point}
    (hsupportGauge : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b supportGauge)
    (hbad : hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet a b primitive f q x) :
    And
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
        (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
          hsupportGauge x))
      (And
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
          (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
            hsupportGauge x))
        (And
          (RealTheory.lt
            (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
              hsupportGauge x) x)
          (And
            (RealTheory.lt x
              (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
                hsupportGauge x))
            (And
              (RealTheory.lt
                (RealFunction.dist
                  (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
                    hsupportGauge x) x)
                (supportGauge x))
              (And
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealFunction.dist
                    (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
                      hsupportGauge x) x)
                  (supportGauge x))
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
                        hsupportGauge x)
                      (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
                        hsupportGauge x)))
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (RealTheory.sub
                        (primitive
                          (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
                            hsupportGauge x))
                        (primitive
                          (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
                            hsupportGauge x)))
                      (RealTheory.mul (f x)
                        (RealTheory.sub
                          (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
                            hsupportGauge x)
                          (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
                            hsupportGauge x)))))))))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hxClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x hbad.left
  have hpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (supportGauge x) :=
    hsupportGauge x hxClosed
  have hw := hbad.right (supportGauge x) hpos
  have hspec :=
    Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec hw)
  simpa [hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft, hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight, hbad]
    using hspec

name: hkPrimitiveBadCoreGauge_gaugeOn
proof:
:= by
  intro x hbad
  have hspec := hkPrimitiveBadWitness_spec hsupportGauge hbad
  unfold hkPrimitiveBadCoreGauge
  unfold RealTheory.min
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hspec.right.right.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hspec.right.right.right.left)

name: hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint_eq_of_some
statement:
private theorem hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint_eq_of_some
    {tag : Nat -> Option Point} {n : Nat} {x : Point}
    (htag : tag n = some x) :
    hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint tag n = x
proof:
:= by
  unfold hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint
  rw [htag]

name: hkPrimitiveBadCoreWitness_finiteIntervalSelectionHypotheses
statement:
private theorem
    hkPrimitiveBadCoreWitness_finiteIntervalSelectionHypotheses
    {a b : Point} {primitive f : Point -> Point} {q : Nat}
    {supportGauge : Point -> Point}
    (hsupportGauge : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b supportGauge)
    {coreLeft coreRight : Nat -> Point}
    {coreTag : Nat -> Option Point}
    (hcover :
      TaggedGaugeCoreCountableCover
        (hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet a b primitive f q)
        (hkPrimitiveBadCoreGauge primitive f q supportGauge hsupportGauge)
        coreLeft coreRight coreTag)
    (N : Nat) :
    FiniteIntervalSelectionHypotheses coreLeft coreRight
      (selectedPrefixIndices coreTag N)
      (fun i : Nat =>
        hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge hsupportGauge
          (hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint coreTag i))
      (fun i : Nat =>
        hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge hsupportGauge
          (hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint coreTag i))
      (selectedPrefixIndices coreTag N)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoreHyp :=
    taggedGaugeCoreCountableCover_selectedPrefix_hypotheses hcover N
  refine And.intro hcoreHyp.left ?_
  refine And.intro hcoreHyp.right.left ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro i hi
    match selectedPrefixIndices_mem_some hi with
    | Exists.intro x htag =>
        have hentry := hcover.left i
        unfold TaggedGaugeCoreEntry at hentry
        rw [htag] at hentry
        have hspec := hkPrimitiveBadWitness_spec hsupportGauge hentry.left
        change
          RealTheory.lt
            (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
              hsupportGauge (hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint coreTag i))
            (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
              hsupportGauge (hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint coreTag i))
        rw [hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint_eq_of_some htag]
        exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            hspec.right.right.left hspec.right.right.right.left
  · intro i hi
    refine Exists.intro i ?_
    refine And.intro hi ?_
    intro y hy
    match selectedPrefixIndices_mem_some hi with
    | Exists.intro x htag =>
        have hentry := hcover.left i
        unfold TaggedGaugeCoreEntry at hentry
        rw [htag] at hentry
        have hspec := hkPrimitiveBadWitness_spec hsupportGauge hentry.left
        have hball := hentry.right.right y hy
        have hdist := RealFunction.dist_lt_of_mem_center_interval hball
        have hwitness :
            RealTheory.OpenInterval
              (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
                hsupportGauge x)
              (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
                hsupportGauge x) y := by
          apply RealFunction.mem_interval_of_dist_lt_min
            hspec.right.right.left hspec.right.right.right.left
          simpa [hkPrimitiveBadCoreGauge] using hdist
        unfold IntervalAt
        change
          RealTheory.OpenInterval
            (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
              hsupportGauge (hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint coreTag i))
            (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
              hsupportGauge (hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint coreTag i)) y
        rw [hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint_eq_of_some htag]
        exact hwitness

name: hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet_selectedPrefixLength_le
statement:
private theorem hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet_selectedPrefixLength_le
    {a b supportBudget : Point} {primitive f : Point -> Point}
    (q : Nat)
    (hmu :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))
    (hprimitive : HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f primitive a b)
    (supportGauge : Point -> Point)
    (hsupportGauge : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b supportGauge)
    (hsupport :
      forall (n : Nat) (left right tag value : Nat -> Point),
        (forall k : Nat, k < n ->
          HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
            f (left k) (right k) (value k)) ->
          PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag ->
            GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
              a b n left right tag supportGauge ->
              RealTheory.lt
                (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f left right tag value n)
                supportBudget)
    {coreLeft coreRight : Nat -> Point}
    {coreTag : Nat -> Option Point}
    (hcover :
      TaggedGaugeCoreCountableCover
        (hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet a b primitive f q)
        (hkPrimitiveBadCoreGauge primitive f q supportGauge hsupportGauge)
        coreLeft coreRight coreTag) :
    forall N : Nat,
      RealTheory.le
        (intervalListLength coreLeft coreRight
          (selectedPrefixIndices coreTag N))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))
            supportBudget))
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  let pointTag : Nat -> Point :=
    fun i : Nat => hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint coreTag i
  let witnessLeft : Nat -> Point :=
    fun i : Nat =>
      hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge hsupportGauge
        (pointTag i)
  let witnessRight : Nat -> Point :=
    fun i : Nat =>
      hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge hsupportGauge
        (pointTag i)
  have hselectionHyp :
      FiniteIntervalSelectionHypotheses coreLeft coreRight
        (selectedPrefixIndices coreTag N)
        witnessLeft witnessRight
        (selectedPrefixIndices coreTag N) := by
    simpa [pointTag, witnessLeft, witnessRight] using
      (hkPrimitiveBadCoreWitness_finiteIntervalSelectionHypotheses
        hsupportGauge hcover N)
  cases exists_spatiallyOrderedFiniteIntervalSelection_of_hypotheses
      hselectionHyp with
  | intro selected hselected =>
      have hselectedMem :
          forall i : Nat, List.Mem i selected ->
            List.Mem i (selectedPrefixIndices coreTag N) :=
        hselected.left.right.left.left
      have hselectedSome :
          forall i : Nat, List.Mem i selected ->
            Exists (fun x : Point => coreTag i = some x) := by
        intro i hi
        exact selectedPrefixIndices_mem_some (hselectedMem i hi)
      have hleftClosed :
          forall i : Nat, List.Mem i selected ->
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (witnessLeft i) := by
        intro i hi
        match hselectedSome i hi with
        | Exists.intro x htag =>
            have hentry := hcover.left i
            unfold TaggedGaugeCoreEntry at hentry
            rw [htag] at hentry
            have hspec := hkPrimitiveBadWitness_spec hsupportGauge hentry.left
            dsimp [witnessLeft, pointTag]
            rw [hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint_eq_of_some htag]
            exact hspec.left
      have hrightClosed :
          forall i : Nat, List.Mem i selected ->
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (witnessRight i) := by
        intro i hi
        match hselectedSome i hi with
        | Exists.intro x htag =>
            have hentry := hcover.left i
            unfold TaggedGaugeCoreEntry at hentry
            rw [htag] at hentry
            have hspec := hkPrimitiveBadWitness_spec hsupportGauge hentry.left
            dsimp [witnessRight, pointTag]
            rw [hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint_eq_of_some htag]
            exact hspec.right.left
      have htagClosed :
          forall i : Nat, List.Mem i selected ->
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval
              (witnessLeft i) (witnessRight i) (pointTag i) := by
        intro i hi
        match hselectedSome i hi with
        | Exists.intro x htag =>
            have hentry := hcover.left i
            unfold TaggedGaugeCoreEntry at hentry
            rw [htag] at hentry
            have hspec := hkPrimitiveBadWitness_spec hsupportGauge hentry.left
            dsimp [witnessLeft, witnessRight, pointTag]
            rw [hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint_eq_of_some htag]
            exact And.intro
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                hspec.right.right.left)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                hspec.right.right.right.left)
      have hfineOnWitness :
          forall i : Nat, List.Mem i selected -> forall y : Point,
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval (witnessLeft i) (witnessRight i) y ->
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y (pointTag i))
                (supportGauge (pointTag i)) := by
        intro i hi y hy
        match hselectedSome i hi with
        | Exists.intro x htag =>
            have hentry := hcover.left i
            unfold TaggedGaugeCoreEntry at hentry
            rw [htag] at hentry
            have hspec := hkPrimitiveBadWitness_spec hsupportGauge hentry.left
            dsimp [witnessLeft, witnessRight, pointTag] at hy ⊢
            rw [hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint_eq_of_some htag] at hy ⊢
            let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            have hleftBall :
                RealTheory.OpenInterval
                  (RealTheory.sub x (supportGauge x))
                  (RealTheory.add x (supportGauge x))
                  (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
                    hsupportGauge x) := by
              have hdist := hspec.right.right.right.right.left
              change
                F.lt
                  (F.abs
                    (F.sub
                      (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
                        hsupportGauge x) x))
                  (supportGauge x) at hdist
              exact And.intro
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hdist)
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hdist)
            have hrightBall :
                RealTheory.OpenInterval
                  (RealTheory.sub x (supportGauge x))
                  (RealTheory.add x (supportGauge x))
                  (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
                    hsupportGauge x) := by
              have hdist := hspec.right.right.right.right.right.left
              change
                F.lt
                  (F.abs
                    (F.sub
                      (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
                        hsupportGauge x) x))
                  (supportGauge x) at hdist
              exact And.intro
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hdist)
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hdist)
            apply RealFunction.dist_lt_of_mem_center_interval
            exact And.intro
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hleftBall.left hy.left)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hy.right hrightBall.right)
      let left : Nat -> Point :=
        fun k : Nat => witnessLeft (selected.getD k 0)
      let right : Nat -> Point :=
        fun k : Nat => witnessRight (selected.getD k 0)
      let tag : Nat -> Point :=
        fun k : Nat => pointTag (selected.getD k 0)
      let value : Nat -> Point :=
        fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.sub (primitive (right k)) (primitive (left k))
      have hlocal :
          forall k : Nat, k < selected.length ->
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
              f (left k) (right k) (value k) := by
        intro k hk
        let i := selected.getD k 0
        have hi : List.Mem i selected :=
          Tautology.List.getD_mem selected 0 hk
        match hselectedSome i hi with
        | Exists.intro x htag =>
            have hentry := hcover.left i
            unfold TaggedGaugeCoreEntry at hentry
            rw [htag] at hentry
            have hspec := hkPrimitiveBadWitness_spec hsupportGauge hentry.left
            have huv :
                RealTheory.le
                  (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
                    hsupportGauge x)
                  (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
                    hsupportGauge x) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                  hspec.right.right.left hspec.right.right.right.left)
            have hcell :=
              hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_interval_increment hprimitive
                (And.intro hspec.left.left
                  (RealTheory.le_trans huv hspec.right.left.right))
                (And.intro
                  (RealTheory.le_trans hspec.left.left huv)
                  hspec.right.left.right)
                huv
            have hpointEq : pointTag i = x := by
              dsimp [pointTag]
              exact hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint_eq_of_some htag
            change
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f
                (witnessLeft i) (witnessRight i)
                (RealTheory.sub (primitive (witnessRight i))
                  (primitive (witnessLeft i)))
            dsimp [witnessLeft, witnessRight]
            rw [hpointEq]
            exact hcell
      have hdivision :
          PartialTaggedDivision a b selected.length left right tag := by
        simpa [left, right, tag] using
          (partialTaggedDivision_of_spatiallyOrderedIntervalList
            selected 0 hleftClosed hrightClosed htagClosed
            hselected.right.right)
      have hgaugeFine :
          GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
            a b selected.length left right tag supportGauge := by
        simpa [left, right, tag] using
          (gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision_of_spatiallyOrderedIntervalList
            selected 0 hleftClosed hrightClosed htagClosed
            hselected.right.right hfineOnWitness)
      have habsError :
          RealTheory.lt
            (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f left right tag value selected.length)
            supportBudget :=
        hsupport selected.length left right tag value
          hlocal hdivision hgaugeFine
      have hpointwise :
          forall k : Nat, k < selected.length ->
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
                (partialCellLength left right k))
              (RealTheory.abs
                (partialTaggedError f left right tag value k)) := by
        intro k hk
        let i := selected.getD k 0
        have hi : List.Mem i selected :=
          Tautology.List.getD_mem selected 0 hk
        match hselectedSome i hi with
        | Exists.intro x htag =>
            have hentry := hcover.left i
            unfold TaggedGaugeCoreEntry at hentry
            rw [htag] at hentry
            have hspec := hkPrimitiveBadWitness_spec hsupportGauge hentry.left
            have hle :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                hspec.right.right.right.right.right.right
            dsimp [partialCellLength, partialTaggedError, left, right, tag,
              value, i, witnessLeft, witnessRight, pointTag]
            rw [hkPrimitiveBadSelectedTagPoint_eq_of_some htag]
            change
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
                (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
                  (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
                  (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub
                    (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
                      hsupportGauge x)
                    (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
                      hsupportGauge x)))
                (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.abs
                  (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub
                    (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul (f x)
                      (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub
                        (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
                          hsupportGauge x)
                        (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
                          hsupportGauge x)))
                    (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub
                      (primitive
                        (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessRight primitive f q supportGauge
                          hsupportGauge x))
                      (primitive
                        (hkPrimitiveBadWitnessLeft primitive f q supportGauge
                          hsupportGauge x)))))
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base]
            exact hle
      have hsum :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
              (RealTheory.finiteSum (partialCellLength left right)
                selected.length))
            (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f left right tag value
              selected.length) := by
        have hraw :=
          RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
                (partialCellLength left right k))
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.abs (partialTaggedError f left right tag value k))
            selected.length hpointwise
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left] at hraw
        exact hraw
      have hlength :
          RealTheory.finiteSum (partialCellLength left right) selected.length =
            intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected := by
        simpa [left, right] using
          (finiteSum_partialCellLength_of_indexList_eq_intervalListLength
            selected 0 witnessLeft witnessRight)
      have hscaledLt :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
              (intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected))
            supportBudget := by
        rw [<- hlength]
        exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsum habsError
      have hscaled :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
              (intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected))
            supportBudget :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hscaledLt
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hmuNe : Not (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q = RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro hzero
        exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hmu hzero.symm
      have hinvNonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hmu)
      have hmul :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F hscaled hinvNonneg
      have hcancel :
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
                (intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected)) =
            intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected := by
        change
          F.mul (F.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))
              (F.mul (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
                (intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected)) =
            intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected
        calc
          F.mul (F.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))
              (F.mul (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
                (intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected)) =
              F.mul
                (F.mul (F.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))
                  (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))
                (intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
          _ = F.mul F.one
                (intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected) := by
            rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hmuNe]
          _ = intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected := by
            rw [F.one_mul]
      have hselectedLength :
          RealTheory.le
            (intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))
              supportBudget) := by
        change
          F.le (intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected)
            (F.mul (F.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)) supportBudget)
        rw [<- hcancel]
        exact hmul
      have hscaledSelected :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
              (intervalListLength witnessLeft witnessRight selected))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))
                supportBudget)) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hselectedLength
          (RealTheory.nat_nonneg 3)
      exact
        RealTheory.le_trans hselected.left.right.right hscaledSelected

name: hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet_null
statement:
private theorem hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet_null
    {a b : Point} {primitive f : Point -> Point}
    (q : Nat)
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hprimitive : HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f primitive a b) :
    RealNegligibility.NullSet (hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet a b primitive f q)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htwo : RealTheory.ValidBase 2 := by
    unfold RealTheory.ValidBase
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
    omega
  have hmu :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q) :=
    RealTheory.baseTail_pos htwo q
  let coefficient :=
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)))
  have hinvNonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hmu)
  have hinnerNonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))) :=
    F.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg 3) hinvNonneg
  have hcoefficientNonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero coefficient := by
    unfold coefficient
    exact F.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg 3) hinnerNonneg
  cases
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F coefficient heps with
  | intro supportBudget hsupportBudget =>
      have hbudgetRaw :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul coefficient supportBudget) eps := by
        have hraw := hsupportBudget.right
        have hcoefficientNonneg' : F.le F.zero coefficient := by
          exact hcoefficientNonneg
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hcoefficientNonneg']
          at hraw
        exact hraw
      have hbudgetEq :
          RealTheory.mul coefficient supportBudget =
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))
                  supportBudget)) := by
        change
          F.mul
              (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
                (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
                  (F.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))))
              supportBudget =
            F.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
              (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
                (F.mul (F.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)) supportBudget))
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
      have hbudget :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))
                  supportBudget))) eps := by
        rw [<- hbudgetEq]
        exact hbudgetRaw
      have hbClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
        RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab
      have hglobal :
          HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b (primitive b) :=
        hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_hasIntegral hprimitive hbClosed
      cases
          exists_henstockAbsErrorSupportGauge_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
            hab hglobal hsupportBudget.left with
      | intro supportGauge hsupportGauge =>
          let badSet : Point -> Prop :=
            hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet a b primitive f q
          let coreGauge : Point -> Point :=
            hkPrimitiveBadCoreGauge primitive f q supportGauge
              hsupportGauge.left
          let coreLeft : Nat -> Point :=
            selectedScanLeft badSet coreGauge
          let coreRight : Nat -> Point :=
            selectedScanRight badSet coreGauge
          let coreTag : Nat -> Option Point :=
            selectedScanTag badSet coreGauge
          have hcoreGauge : GaugeOn badSet coreGauge := by
            simpa [badSet, coreGauge] using
              (hkPrimitiveBadCoreGauge_gaugeOn hsupportGauge.left)
          have hcover :
              TaggedGaugeCoreCountableCover badSet coreGauge
                coreLeft coreRight coreTag := by
            simpa [coreLeft, coreRight, coreTag] using
              (selectedScan_taggedGaugeCoreCountableCover hcoreGauge)
          have hprefix :
              forall N : Nat,
                RealTheory.le
                  (intervalListLength coreLeft coreRight
                    (selectedPrefixIndices coreTag N))
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q))
                      supportBudget)) := by
            intro N
            exact
              hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet_selectedPrefixLength_le
                q hmu hprimitive supportGauge hsupportGauge.left
                hsupportGauge.right hcover N
          have hactive :
              forall n : Nat, forall x : Point,
                coreTag n = some x ->
                  RealTheory.lt (coreLeft n) (coreRight n) := by
            intro n x htag
            dsimp [coreTag, coreLeft, coreRight] at htag ⊢
            exact selectedScan_activeCore_strictOrdered htag
          exact
            exists_taggedGaugeCore_tripleCoverBudgetLt_of_selectedPrefix_length_le
              (B := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)) supportBudget))
              hcover hactive hprefix hbudget

name: primitiveLinearError_le_of_not_hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet
statement:
private theorem primitiveLinearError_le_of_not_hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet
    {a b x : Point} {primitive f : Point -> Point} {q : Nat}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hnot : Not (hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet a b primitive f q x)) :
    Exists
      (fun rho : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rho)
          (forall u v : Point,
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b u ->
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b v ->
                RealTheory.lt u x ->
                  RealTheory.lt x v ->
                    RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist u x) rho ->
                      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist v x) rho ->
                        RealTheory.le
                          (RealTheory.abs
                            (RealTheory.sub
                              (RealTheory.sub
                                (primitive v) (primitive u))
                              (RealTheory.mul (f x)
                                (RealTheory.sub v u))))
                          (RealTheory.mul
                            (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
                            (RealTheory.sub v u))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnotAll :
      Not (forall rho : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rho ->
          Exists (fun u : Point =>
            Exists (fun v : Point =>
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b u ∧
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b v ∧
              RealTheory.lt u x ∧
              RealTheory.lt x v ∧
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist u x) rho ∧
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist v x) rho ∧
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
                  (RealTheory.sub v u))
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealTheory.sub (primitive v) (primitive u))
                    (RealTheory.mul (f x)
                      (RealTheory.sub v u))))))) := by
    intro hall
    exact hnot (And.intro hx hall)
  cases Classical.not_forall.mp hnotAll with
  | intro rho hrho =>
      have hfail := Classical.not_imp.mp hrho
      refine Exists.intro rho ?_
      refine And.intro hfail.left ?_
      intro u v hu hv hux hxv hdu hdv
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      by_cases hle :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub
                (RealTheory.sub (primitive v) (primitive u))
                (RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.sub v u))))
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q) (RealTheory.sub v u))
      case pos =>
        exact hle
      case neg =>
        have hreverse :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q) (RealTheory.sub v u))
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.sub (primitive v) (primitive u))
                  (RealTheory.mul (f x)
                    (RealTheory.sub v u)))) := by
          cases F.le_total
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q) (RealTheory.sub v u))
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.sub (primitive v) (primitive u))
                  (RealTheory.mul (f x)
                    (RealTheory.sub v u)))) with
          | inl h =>
              exact h
          | inr h =>
              exact False.elim (hle h)
        have hstrict :
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q) (RealTheory.sub v u))
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.sub (primitive v) (primitive u))
                  (RealTheory.mul (f x)
                    (RealTheory.sub v u)))) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hreverse hle
        exact False.elim
          (hfail.right
            (Exists.intro u
              (Exists.intro v
                (And.intro hu
                  (And.intro hv
                    (And.intro hux
                      (And.intro hxv
                        (And.intro hdu
                          (And.intro hdv hstrict)))))))))

name: primitiveEndpointRightClosure
statement:
private theorem primitiveEndpointRightClosure
    {a b x y mu rho : Point} {primitive f : Point -> Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y)
    (hyx : RealTheory.lt y x)
    (hyNear : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) rho)
    (hrho : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rho)
    (hcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) primitive)
    (hstrict : forall u v : Point,
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b u ->
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b v ->
          RealTheory.lt u x ->
            RealTheory.lt x v ->
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist u x) rho ->
                RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist v x) rho ->
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (RealTheory.sub
                        (RealTheory.sub (primitive v) (primitive u))
                        (RealTheory.mul (f x)
                          (RealTheory.sub v u))))
                    (RealTheory.mul mu
                      (RealTheory.sub v u))) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))
          (RealTheory.mul (f x)
            (RealTheory.sub y x))))
      (RealTheory.mul mu
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))
proof:
:= by
  let E : RealFunction.Domain := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b
  let err : RealFunction.Map := fun z : Point =>
    RealTheory.sub
      (RealTheory.sub (primitive z) (primitive y))
      (RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.sub z y))
  let bound : RealFunction.Map := fun z : Point =>
    RealTheory.mul mu (RealTheory.sub z y)
  let err0 :=
    RealTheory.sub
      (RealTheory.sub (primitive x) (primitive y))
      (RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.sub x y))
  let bound0 :=
    RealTheory.mul mu (RealTheory.sub x y)
  have hprimR :
      RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
        E primitive x (primitive x) := by
    unfold RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
    intro eps heps
    have hxClosed :=
      RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x hx
    cases (hcont x hxClosed).right eps heps with
    | intro delta hdelta =>
        refine Exists.intro delta ?_
        refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
        intro z hz hzne hzd
        exact hdelta.right z
          (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval
            a b z hz.left)
          hzne hzd
  have hidR :
      RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
        E (fun z : Point => z) x x := by
    unfold RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
    exact RealDerivative.tendstoWithin_id
      (RealFunction.RightDomain E x) x
  have hconstY :
      RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
        E (fun _ : Point => y) x y := by
    unfold RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
      (RealFunction.RightDomain E x) y x
  have hconstFY :
      RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
        E (fun _ : Point => primitive y) x (primitive y) := by
    unfold RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
      (RealFunction.RightDomain E x) (primitive y) x
  have hconstC :
      RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
        E (fun _ : Point => f x) x (f x) := by
    unfold RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
      (RealFunction.RightDomain E x) (f x) x
  have hconstMu :
      RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
        E (fun _ : Point => mu) x mu := by
    unfold RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin
    exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
      (RealFunction.RightDomain E x) mu x
  have hsubZY :=
    RealFunction.rightTendstoWithin_sub hidR hconstY
  have hmulC :=
    RealFunction.rightTendstoWithin_mul hconstC hsubZY
  have hsubF :=
    RealFunction.rightTendstoWithin_sub hprimR hconstFY
  have herr :
      RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin E err x err0 := by
    simpa [err, err0,
      RealFunction.SubFun, RealFunction.MulFun] using
      (RealFunction.rightTendstoWithin_sub hsubF hmulC)
  have hbound :
      RealFunction.RightTendstoWithin E bound x bound0 := by
    simpa [bound, bound0, RealFunction.MulFun] using
      (RealFunction.rightTendstoWithin_mul hconstMu hsubZY)
  have heventAbs :
      RealFunction.RightEventuallyWithin E x
        (fun z : Point =>
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (err z)) (bound z)) := by
    unfold RealFunction.RightEventuallyWithin
    refine Exists.intro rho ?_
    refine And.intro hrho ?_
    intro z hz hzne hzd
    exact hstrict y z
      (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b y hy)
      (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b z hz.left)
      hyx hz.right hyNear hzd
  have heventUpper :
      RealFunction.RightEventuallyWithin E x
        (fun z : Point =>
          RealTheory.le (err z) (bound z)) := by
    unfold RealFunction.RightEventuallyWithin at heventAbs ⊢
    exact RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_mono
      (fun z hz =>
        RealTheory.le_trans
          (RealTheory.le_abs_self (err z)) hz)
      heventAbs
  have heventLower :
      RealFunction.RightEventuallyWithin E x
        (fun z : Point =>
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg (err z)) (bound z)) := by
    unfold RealFunction.RightEventuallyWithin at heventAbs ⊢
    exact RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_mono
      (fun z hz =>
        RealTheory.le_trans
          (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self (err z)) hz)
      heventAbs
  have hcluster :
      RealFunction.RightClusterPoint E x :=
    RealDerivative.openInterval_rightClusterPoint hx
  have hupper :
      RealTheory.le err0 bound0 :=
    RealFunction.rightTendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
      hcluster herr hbound heventUpper
  have hlower :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg err0) bound0 :=
    RealFunction.rightTendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
      hcluster
      (RealFunction.rightTendstoWithin_neg herr)
      hbound heventLower
  have habs :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs err0) bound0 :=
    RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hupper hlower
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htargetNeg :
      RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))
          (RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.sub y x)) =
        RealTheory.neg err0 := by
    unfold err0
    change
      F.sub
          (F.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))
          (F.mul (f x) (F.sub y x)) =
        F.neg
          (F.sub
            (F.sub (primitive x) (primitive y))
            (F.mul (f x) (F.sub x y)))
    have hreversePrimitive :
        F.sub (primitive x) (primitive y) =
          F.neg (F.sub (primitive y) (primitive x)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
        F (primitive y) (primitive x)
    have hreversePoint :
        F.sub x y = F.neg (F.sub y x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F y x
    rw [hreversePrimitive, hreversePoint]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F]
  rw [htargetNeg]
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.neg err0))
      (F.mul mu
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub y x)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F]
  have habsYX :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub y x) =
        F.sub x y := by
    have hyxNonpos : F.le (F.sub y x) F.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hyx)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F hyxNonpos]
    exact Eq.symm
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F y x)
  rw [habsYX]
  exact habs

name: primitiveEndpointLeftClosure

                  RealTheory.le

  let E : RealFunction.Domain := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b

    RealTheory.sub

  let bound : RealFunction.Map := fun z : Point =>

    RealTheory.sub
      (RealTheory.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))

    RealTheory.mul mu (RealTheory.sub y x)
  have hprimL :

    intro eps heps

      (RealFunction.LeftDomain E x) (f x) x
  have hconstMu :

  have hsubYZ :=
    RealFunction.leftTendstoWithin_sub hconstY hidL
  have hmulC :=
    RealFunction.leftTendstoWithin_mul hconstC hsubYZ

  have herr :

  have hbound :

  have heventAbs :
      RealFunction.LeftEventuallyWithin E x
        (fun z : Point =>
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (err z)) (bound z)) := by
    unfold RealFunction.LeftEventuallyWithin
    refine Exists.intro rho ?_
    refine And.intro hrho ?_
    intro z hz hzne hzd
    exact hstrict z y
      (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b z hz.left)
      (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b y hy)
      hz.right hxy hzd hyNear
  have heventUpper :
      RealFunction.LeftEventuallyWithin E x
        (fun z : Point =>
          RealTheory.le (err z) (bound z)) := by
    unfold RealFunction.LeftEventuallyWithin at heventAbs ⊢
    exact RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_mono

  have heventLower :
      RealFunction.LeftEventuallyWithin E x

    exact RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_mono
      (fun z hz =>
        RealTheory.le_trans
          (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self (err z)) hz)
      heventAbs
  have hcluster :
      RealFunction.LeftClusterPoint E x :=
    RealDerivative.openInterval_leftClusterPoint hx
  have hupper :
      RealTheory.le err0 bound0 :=
    RealFunction.leftTendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
      hcluster herr hbound heventUpper
  have hlower :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg err0) bound0 :=
    RealFunction.leftTendstoWithin_le_of_eventually_le
      hcluster
      (RealFunction.leftTendstoWithin_neg herr)
      hbound heventLower
  have habs :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs err0) bound0 :=
    RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hupper hlower
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxyNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxy)
  have habsYX :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub y x) =
        F.sub y x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hxyNonneg
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.sub
          (F.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))
          (F.mul (f x) (F.sub y x))))
      (F.mul mu
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub y x)))
  rw [habsYX]
  exact habs

name: primitiveEndpointLinearError_le_of_not_hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet
statement:
private theorem
    primitiveEndpointLinearError_le_of_not_hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet
    {a b x mu rho : Point} {primitive f : Point -> Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hrho : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rho)
    (hcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) primitive)
    (hstrict : forall u v : Point,
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b u ->
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b v ->
          RealTheory.lt u x ->
            RealTheory.lt x v ->
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist u x) rho ->
                RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist v x) rho ->
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (RealTheory.sub
                        (RealTheory.sub (primitive v) (primitive u))
                        (RealTheory.mul (f x)
                          (RealTheory.sub v u))))
                    (RealTheory.mul mu
                      (RealTheory.sub v u))) :
    forall y : Point,
      RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y ->
        Not (y = x) ->
          RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) rho ->
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))
                  (RealTheory.mul (f x)
                    (RealTheory.sub y x))))
              (RealTheory.mul mu
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy hyne hyNear
  cases
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hyne with
  | inl hyx =>
      exact primitiveEndpointRightClosure
        hx hy hyx hyNear hrho hcont hstrict
  | inr hxy =>
      exact primitiveEndpointLeftClosure
        hx hy hxy hyNear hrho hcont hstrict

name: differenceQuotient_close_of_linearError_le
statement:
private theorem differenceQuotient_close_of_linearError_le
    {primitive : Point -> Point} {x y c mu : Point}
    (hyx : Not (y = x))
    (hlinear :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))
            (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub y x))))
        (RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealFunction.dist
        (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient primitive x y) c)
      mu
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.le
      (F.abs
        (F.sub
          (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient primitive x y) c))
      mu
  by_cases hclose :
      F.le
        (F.abs
          (F.sub
            (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient primitive x y) c))
        mu
  · exact hclose
  · have hreverse :
        F.le mu
          (F.abs
            (F.sub
              (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient primitive x y) c)) := by
      cases F.le_total mu
          (F.abs
            (F.sub
              (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient primitive x y) c)) with
      | inl h =>
          exact h
      | inr h =>
          exact False.elim (hclose h)
    have hstrict :
        F.lt mu
          (F.abs
            (F.sub
              (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient primitive x y) c)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
        F hreverse hclose
    have hdxPos :
        F.lt F.zero (F.abs (F.sub y x)) := by
      change F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.dist y x)
      exact RealFunction.dist_pos_of_ne hyx
    have hmulStrict :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right
        F hstrict hdxPos
    have hprod :=
      RealDerivative.differenceQuotient_linearError_abs_mul_abs_sub_eq_abs
        (f := primitive) (x := x) (y := y)
        (L := c) hyx
    change
      F.mul
          (F.abs
            (F.sub
              (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient primitive x y) c))
          (F.abs (F.sub y x)) =
        F.abs
          (F.sub
            (F.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))
            (F.mul c (F.sub y x)))
      at hprod
    change
      F.le
        (F.abs
          (F.sub
            (F.sub (primitive y) (primitive x))
            (F.mul c (F.sub y x))))
        (F.mul mu (F.abs (F.sub y x)))
      at hlinear
    have himpossible :
        F.lt
          (F.mul mu (F.abs (F.sub y x)))
          (F.mul mu (F.abs (F.sub y x))) := by
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
        F hmulStrict
      rw [hprod]
      exact hlinear
    exact False.elim
      ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F
        (F.mul mu (F.abs (F.sub y x))))
        himpossible)

name: differenceQuotient_close_of_not_mem_hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSets
statement:
private theorem differenceQuotient_close_of_not_mem_hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSets
    {a b x : Point} {primitive f : Point -> Point} {q : Nat}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hcont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) primitive)
    (hnot :
      Not (hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet
        a b primitive f q x)) :
    Exists
      (fun rho : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rho)
          (forall y : Point,
            RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y ->
              Not (y = x) ->
                RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) rho ->
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealFunction.dist
                      (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient
                        primitive x y)
                      (f x))
                    (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)))
proof:
:= by
  cases
      primitiveLinearError_le_of_not_hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet
        hx hnot with
  | intro rho hrho =>
      refine Exists.intro rho ?_
      refine And.intro hrho.left ?_
      intro y hy hyne hyNear
      have hendpoint :=
        primitiveEndpointLinearError_le_of_not_hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet
          (mu := RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
          hx hrho.left hcont hrho.right
          y hy hyne hyNear
      exact differenceQuotient_close_of_linearError_le
        hyne hendpoint

name: hasDerivWithin_of_not_mem_hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSets
statement:
private theorem hasDerivWithin_of_not_mem_hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSets
    {a b x : Point} {primitive f : Point -> Point}
    (hprimitive :
      HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f primitive a b)
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hnot : forall q : Nat,
      Not (hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet
        a b primitive f q x)) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
      (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      primitive x (f x)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) primitive :=
    continuousOn_of_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn hprimitive
  refine And.intro hx ?_
  intro eps heps
  have htwo : RealTheory.ValidBase 2 := by
    unfold RealTheory.ValidBase
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
    omega
  have htail :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun q : Nat => RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
        RealTheory.zero :=
    RealTheory.baseTail_tendsto_zero_all htwo
  cases htail eps heps with
  | intro q hq =>
      have hclose :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
                RealTheory.zero))
            eps :=
        hq q (Nat.le_refl q)
      have htailLeAbs :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
                RealTheory.zero)) := by
        let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        change
          F.le (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
            (RealTheory.abs
              (F.sub (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q) F.zero))
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F]
        exact RealTheory.le_abs_self (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q)
      have hmuLt :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.baseTail 2 q) eps :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base htailLeAbs hclose
      cases
          differenceQuotient_close_of_not_mem_hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSets
            hx hcont (hnot q) with
      | intro rho hrho =>
          refine Exists.intro rho ?_
          refine And.intro hrho.left ?_
          intro y hy hyne hyNear
          exact
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (hrho.right y hy hyne hyNear)
              hmuLt

name: hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_of_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_of_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn
    {a b : Point} {primitive f : Point -> Point}
    (hprimitive : HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f primitive a b) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
      a b primitive f
proof:
:= by
  apply
    RealDerivative.hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_of_exceptionalSet_null
  by_cases hab : RealTheory.le a b
  · let badLevel : Nat -> Point -> Prop :=
      fun q : Nat => hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet a b primitive f q
    have hbadLevelNull :
        forall q : Nat, RealNegligibility.NullSet (badLevel q) := by
      intro q
      simpa [badLevel] using
        (hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet_null q hab hprimitive)
    have hunionNull :
        RealNegligibility.NullSet (RealNegligibility.CountableUnion badLevel) :=
      RealNegligibility.nullSet_countableUnion hbadLevelNull
    apply RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono ?_ hunionNull
    intro x hxExceptional
    unfold RealNegligibility.CountableUnion
    unfold Foundation.Cardinal.CountableUnion
    by_cases hUnion : Exists (fun q : Nat => badLevel q x)
    · exact hUnion
    · have hnotBad :
          forall q : Nat,
            Not (hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSet a b primitive f q x) := by
        intro q hbad
        apply hUnion
        refine Exists.intro q ?_
        simpa [badLevel] using hbad
      have hderiv :
          RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
            (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) primitive x (f x) :=
        hasDerivWithin_of_not_mem_hkPrimitiveDerivativeBadSets
          hprimitive hxExceptional.left hnotBad
      exact False.elim (hxExceptional.right hderiv)
  · apply RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono ?_ RealNegligibility.nullSet_empty
    intro x hxExceptional
    have habFromOpen : RealTheory.le a b :=
      RealTheory.le_trans
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hxExceptional.left.left)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hxExceptional.left.right)
    exact hab habFromOpen

name: list_getD_append_left
statement:
private theorem list_getD_append_left
    {α : Type} (xs ys : List α) (fallback : α) :
    forall {k : Nat},
      k < xs.length ->
        (xs ++ ys).getD k fallback = xs.getD k fallback
  | 0, hk => by
      cases xs with
      | nil => exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hk)
      | cons _ _ => rfl
  | k + 1, hk => by
      cases xs with
      | nil => exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero (k + 1) hk)
      | cons _ tail =>
          exact
            list_getD_append_left tail ys fallback
              (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk)

private theorem list_getD_append_last
    {α : Type} (xs : List α) (fallback last : α) :
    (xs ++ [last]).getD xs.length fallback = last
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ tail ih =>
      change (tail ++ [last]).getD tail.length fallback = last
      exact ih

name: badCellIndex_strict
statement:
private theorem badCellIndex_strict
    {S : Point -> Prop} {tag : Nat -> Point} :
    forall {total k : Nat},
      k + 1 < badCellCount S tag total ->
        badCellIndex S tag total k <
          badCellIndex S tag total (k + 1)
  | 0, k, hk => by
      unfold badCellCount badCellIndices at hk
      simp at hk
  | total + 1, k, hk => by
      classical
      by_cases hlast : S (tag total)
      case pos =>
        have hcount :
            badCellCount S tag (total + 1) =
              badCellCount S tag total + 1
proof:
:=
          badCellCount_succ_of_mem
            (S := S) (tag := tag) hlast
        by_cases hend : k + 1 = badCellCount S tag total
        case pos =>
          have hkold : k < badCellCount S tag total := by omega
          rw [badCellIndex_succ_preserve
            (S := S) (tag := tag) (total := total) hkold]
          rw [hend]
          rw [badCellIndex_succ_last (S := S) (tag := tag) hlast]
          exact badCellIndex_lt_total
            (S := S) (tag := tag) (total := total) hkold
        case neg =>
          have hkold_succ : k + 1 < badCellCount S tag total := by
            rw [hcount] at hk
            omega
          have hkold : k < badCellCount S tag total := by omega
          rw [badCellIndex_succ_preserve
            (S := S) (tag := tag) (total := total) hkold]
          rw [badCellIndex_succ_preserve
            (S := S) (tag := tag) (total := total) hkold_succ]
          exact badCellIndex_strict
            (S := S) (tag := tag) hkold_succ
      case neg =>
        have hcount :
            badCellCount S tag (total + 1) =
              badCellCount S tag total :=
          badCellCount_succ_of_not_mem
            (S := S) (tag := tag) hlast
        rw [hcount] at hk
        have hkold : k < badCellCount S tag total := by omega
        rw [badCellIndex_succ_preserve
          (S := S) (tag := tag) (total := total) hkold]
        rw [badCellIndex_succ_preserve
          (S := S) (tag := tag) (total := total) hk]
        exact badCellIndex_strict
          (S := S) (tag := tag) hk

name: badCellIndex_taggedCellSubpartition
statement:
private theorem badCellIndex_taggedCellSubpartition
    {S : Point -> Prop} {tag : Nat -> Point} {total : Nat} :
    TaggedCellSubpartition total

      (badCellIndex S tag total)
proof:
:= by
  exact And.intro
    (fun k hk =>
      badCellIndex_lt_total
        (S := S) (tag := tag) (total := total) hk)
    (fun k hk =>
      badCellIndex_strict
        (S := S) (tag := tag) hk)

name: badCellIndex_partialPrimitiveVariationSum_eq_sideZero
statement:
private theorem badCellIndex_partialPrimitiveVariationSum_eq_sideZero
    {S : Point -> Prop} {Fmap : Point -> Point}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point} :
    forall total : Nat,
      partialPrimitiveVariationSum Fmap
          (subpartitionLeft p (badCellIndex S tag total))
          (subpartitionRight p (badCellIndex S tag total))
          (badCellCount S tag total) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum (badPrimitiveVariationTerm S Fmap p tag) total
  | 0 => by
      have hcount : badCellCount S tag 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
        unfold badCellCount badCellIndices
        simp
      rw [hcount]
      unfold partialPrimitiveVariationSum
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  | total + 1 => by
      classical
      by_cases hlast : S (tag total)
      case pos =>
        rw [badCellCount_succ_of_mem (S := S) (tag := tag) hlast]
        unfold partialPrimitiveVariationSum
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
        have hprefix :
            RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat =>
                  RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (Fmap
                        (subpartitionRight p
                          (badCellIndex S tag (total + 1)) k))
                      (Fmap
                        (subpartitionLeft p
                          (badCellIndex S tag (total + 1)) k))))
                (badCellCount S tag total) =
              partialPrimitiveVariationSum Fmap
                (subpartitionLeft p (badCellIndex S tag total))
                (subpartitionRight p (badCellIndex S tag total))
                (badCellCount S tag total) := by
          unfold partialPrimitiveVariationSum
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
          intro k hk
          unfold subpartitionLeft subpartitionRight
          rw [badCellIndex_succ_preserve
            (S := S) (tag := tag) (total := total) hk]
        rw [hprefix]
        rw [badCellIndex_partialPrimitiveVariationSum_eq_sideZero
          (S := S) (Fmap := Fmap) (p := p) (tag := tag) total]
        unfold subpartitionLeft subpartitionRight
        rw [badCellIndex_succ_last (S := S) (tag := tag) hlast]
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
        unfold badPrimitiveVariationTerm
        simp [hlast]
      case neg =>
        rw [badCellCount_succ_of_not_mem (S := S) (tag := tag) hlast]
        have hprefix :
            partialPrimitiveVariationSum Fmap
                (subpartitionLeft p (badCellIndex S tag (total + 1)))
                (subpartitionRight p (badCellIndex S tag (total + 1)))
                (badCellCount S tag total) =
              partialPrimitiveVariationSum Fmap
                (subpartitionLeft p (badCellIndex S tag total))
                (subpartitionRight p (badCellIndex S tag total))
                (badCellCount S tag total) := by
          unfold partialPrimitiveVariationSum
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
          intro k hk
          unfold subpartitionLeft subpartitionRight
          rw [badCellIndex_succ_preserve
            (S := S) (tag := tag) (total := total) hk]
        rw [hprefix]
        rw [badCellIndex_partialPrimitiveVariationSum_eq_sideZero
          (S := S) (Fmap := Fmap) (p := p) (tag := tag) total]
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
        unfold badPrimitiveVariationTerm
        simp [hlast]
        rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

    {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b eta rho : Point}

      (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
  exact
    primitiveCellErrorAbs_le_eta_mul_cellLength_of_interiorDerivativeGauge
      htagged hk htagOpen hclose hfine hdelta
