name: exceptionalErrorAbsSum_le_goodBudget_add_badVariation
statement:
private theorem exceptionalErrorAbsSum_le_goodBudget_add_badVariation
    {S : Point -> Prop} {Fmap f : Point -> Point}
    {eta : Point} {p tag : Nat -> Point} {total : Nat}
    (hgood :
      forall k : Nat, k < total -> Not (S (tag k)) ->
        RealTheory.le
          (exceptionalPrimitiveCellErrorAbs Fmap f
            p (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag k)
          (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))) :
    RealTheory.le
      (exceptionalPrimitiveCellErrorAbsSum
        Fmap (exceptionalZeroExtension S f)
        p (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag total)
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (goodErrorBudgetTerm S eta p tag) total)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (badPrimitiveVariationTerm S Fmap p tag) total))
proof:
:= by
  unfold exceptionalPrimitiveCellErrorAbsSum
  have hpoint :
      forall k : Nat, k < total ->
        RealTheory.le
          (exceptionalPrimitiveCellErrorAbs
            Fmap (exceptionalZeroExtension S f)
            p (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag k)
          (RealTheory.add
            (goodErrorBudgetTerm S eta p tag k)
            (badPrimitiveVariationTerm S Fmap p tag k)) := by
    intro k hk
    classical
    by_cases hbad : S (tag k)
    case pos =>
      rw [exceptionalPrimitiveCellErrorAbs_bad_eq_variationTerm
        (S := S) (Fmap := Fmap) (f := f)
        (p := p) (tag := tag) hbad]
      unfold goodErrorBudgetTerm
      simp [hbad]
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl
        (badPrimitiveVariationTerm S Fmap p tag k)
    case neg =>
      rw [exceptionalPrimitiveCellErrorAbs_good_eq_original
        (S := S) (Fmap := Fmap) (f := f)
        (p := p) (tag := tag) hbad]
      unfold goodErrorBudgetTerm badPrimitiveVariationTerm
      simp [hbad]
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
      exact hgood k hk hbad
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            exceptionalPrimitiveCellErrorAbs
              Fmap (exceptionalZeroExtension S f)
              p (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag k)
          total)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.add
              (goodErrorBudgetTerm S eta p tag k)
              (badPrimitiveVariationTerm S Fmap p tag k))
          total) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun k : Nat =>
        exceptionalPrimitiveCellErrorAbs
          Fmap (exceptionalZeroExtension S f)
          p (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag k)
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.add
          (goodErrorBudgetTerm S eta p tag k)
          (badPrimitiveVariationTerm S Fmap p tag k))
      total
      hpoint
  rwa [RealTheory.finiteSum_add] at hsum

name: goodErrorBudgetSum_le_eta_mul_endpointLength
statement:
private theorem goodErrorBudgetSum_le_eta_mul_endpointLength
    {S : Point -> Prop} {eta a b : Point}
    {total : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b total p tag)
    (heta : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (goodErrorBudgetTerm S eta p tag) total)
      (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpoint :
      forall k : Nat, k < total ->
        RealTheory.le
          (goodErrorBudgetTerm S eta p tag k)
          (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k)) := by
    intro k hk
    classical
    by_cases hbad : S (tag k)
    case pos =>
      unfold goodErrorBudgetTerm
      simp [hbad]
      exact F.mul_nonneg heta
        (cellLength_nonnegative htag.left hk)
    case neg =>
      unfold goodErrorBudgetTerm
      simp [hbad]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (goodErrorBudgetTerm S eta p tag) total)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
          total) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (goodErrorBudgetTerm S eta p tag)
      (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
      total
      hpoint
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
          total =
        RealTheory.mul eta
          (RealTheory.finiteSum (cellLength p) total) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left eta (cellLength p) total
  rw [hmul] at hsum
  rw [intervalPartition_finiteSum_cellLength htag.left] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_exceptionalZeroExtension_derivative_eq_sub
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_exceptionalZeroExtension_derivative_eq_sub
    {S : Point -> Prop} {Fmap f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hleab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (_hFcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) Fmap)
    (_hNull :
      RealNegligibility.NullSet
        (fun x : Point => And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x)))
    (hendpoint :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          Not (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x) -> S x)
    (hNV : NegligibleVariationOn Fmap S a b)
    (hFderiv :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          Not (S x) ->
            RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
              (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) Fmap x (f x)) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn (exceptionalZeroExtension S f) a b
      (RealTheory.sub (Fmap b) (Fmap a))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hba : b = a
  case pos =>
    rw [hba]
    change
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (exceptionalZeroExtension S f) a a
        (F.sub (Fmap a) (Fmap a))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F (Fmap a)]
    exact
      hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_degenerate
        (exceptionalZeroExtension S f) a
  case neg =>
    refine And.intro hleab ?_
    intro eps heps
    classical
    let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
    have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
    cases
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F
          (RealTheory.sub b a) he2_pos with
    | intro eta hetaData =>
        have heta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta :=
          hetaData.left
        have hsub_nonneg :
            RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hleab
        have hgoodBudget_lt :
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a)) e2 := by
          have hraw := hetaData.right
          have hsub_nonneg' :
              F.le F.zero (F.sub b a) := by
            exact hsub_nonneg
          change
            F.lt (F.mul (F.abs (F.sub b a)) eta) e2 at hraw
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hsub_nonneg'] at hraw
          rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub b a) eta] at hraw
          exact hraw
        have hradiusExists :
            forall x : Point,
              Exists
                (fun rho : Point =>
                  And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rho)
                    (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
                      Not (S x) ->
                        forall z : Point,
                          RealTheory.OpenInterval a b z ->
                            Not (z = x) ->
                              RealTheory.lt
                                  (RealFunction.dist z x) rho ->
                                RealTheory.lt
                                  (RealFunction.dist
                                    (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient
                                      Fmap x z)
                                    (f x))
                                  eta)) := by
          intro x
          by_cases hxgood :
              And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (Not (S x))
          case pos =>
            have hxOpen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x := by
              by_cases hxOpen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x
              case pos => exact hxOpen
              case neg =>
                exact False.elim
                  (hxgood.right (hendpoint x hxgood.left hxOpen))
            cases
                exists_openInterval_differenceQuotient_close_radius_of_hasDerivWithin
                  (hFderiv x hxOpen hxgood.right) heta_pos with
            | intro rho hrho =>
                refine Exists.intro rho ?_
                refine And.intro hrho.left ?_
                intro _hxClosed _hxNotS
                exact hrho.right
          case neg =>
            refine Exists.intro RealTheory.one ?_
            refine And.intro RealTheory.zero_lt_one ?_
            intro hxClosed hxNotS
            exact False.elim
              (hxgood (And.intro hxClosed hxNotS))
        let goodRadius : Point -> Point :=
          fun x : Point => Classical.choose (hradiusExists x)
        have hgoodRadiusSpec :
            forall x : Point,
              And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (goodRadius x))
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
                  Not (S x) ->
                    forall z : Point,
                      RealTheory.OpenInterval a b z ->
                        Not (z = x) ->
                          RealTheory.lt
                              (RealFunction.dist z x) (goodRadius x) ->
                            RealTheory.lt
                              (RealFunction.dist
                                (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient Fmap x z)
                                (f x))
                              eta) := by
          intro x
          dsimp [goodRadius]
          exact Classical.choose_spec (hradiusExists x)
        let derivativeGauge : Point -> Point :=
          fun x : Point =>
            if S x then
              RealTheory.one
            else
              interiorDerivativeRadius a b x (goodRadius x)
        have hderivativeGauge :
            ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b derivativeGauge := by
          intro x hxClosed
          by_cases hxS : S x
          case pos =>
            dsimp [derivativeGauge]
            rw [if_pos hxS]
            exact RealTheory.zero_lt_one
          case neg =>
            have hxOpen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x := by
              by_cases hxOpen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x
              case pos => exact hxOpen
              case neg =>
                exact False.elim
                  (hxS (hendpoint x hxClosed hxOpen))
            dsimp [derivativeGauge]
            rw [if_neg hxS]
            exact interiorDerivativeRadius_pos hxOpen
              (hgoodRadiusSpec x).left
        cases hNV e2 he2_pos with
        | intro badGauge hbadGaugeData =>
            let delta : Point -> Point :=
              fun x : Point =>
                RealTheory.min (badGauge x) (derivativeGauge x)
            refine Exists.intro delta ?_
            refine And.intro
              (closedIntervalGaugeOn_min
                hbadGaugeData.left hderivativeGauge) ?_
            · intro total p tag hfine
              have hfineBad :
                  GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b total p tag badGauge :=
                gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le hfine
                  (fun x : Point => by
                    dsimp [delta]
                    exact RealTheory.min_le_left
                      (badGauge x) (derivativeGauge x))
              have hfineGood :
                  GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b total p tag
                    derivativeGauge :=
                gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le hfine
                  (fun x : Point => by
                    dsimp [delta]
                    exact RealTheory.min_le_right
                      (badGauge x) (derivativeGauge x))
              have hbadPackage :=
                taggedCellSubpartition_bad_gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
                  (S := S) hfineBad
                  (badCellIndex_taggedCellSubpartition
                    (S := S) (tag := tag) (total := total))
                  (fun k hk =>
                    badCellIndex_tags_mem
                      (S := S) (tag := tag) (total := total) hk)
              have hbadVariation_lt :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (partialPrimitiveVariationSum Fmap
                      (subpartitionLeft p
                        (badCellIndex S tag total))
                      (subpartitionRight p
                        (badCellIndex S tag total))
                      (badCellCount S tag total))
                    e2 :=
                hbadGaugeData.right
                  (badCellCount S tag total)
                  (subpartitionLeft p (badCellIndex S tag total))
                  (subpartitionRight p (badCellIndex S tag total))
                  (subpartitionTags tag (badCellIndex S tag total))
                  hbadPackage.left.left hbadPackage.right hbadPackage.left
              have hbadSum_lt :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.finiteSum
                      (badPrimitiveVariationTerm S Fmap p tag) total)
                    e2 := by
                rw [<-
                  badCellIndex_partialPrimitiveVariationSum_eq_sideZero
                    (S := S) (Fmap := Fmap) (p := p) (tag := tag) total]
                exact hbadVariation_lt
              have hgoodPoint :
                  forall k : Nat, k < total -> Not (S (tag k)) ->
                    RealTheory.le
                      (exceptionalPrimitiveCellErrorAbs Fmap f
                        p (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag k)
                      (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k)) := by
                intro k hk hkGood
                have htagClosed :
                    RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (tag k) :=
                  taggedPartition_tag_mem_closedInterval hfine.left hk
                have htagOpen :
                    RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (tag k) := by
                  by_cases htagOpen :
                      RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (tag k)
                  case pos => exact htagOpen
                  case neg =>
                    exact False.elim
                      (hkGood (hendpoint (tag k) htagClosed htagOpen))
                have hcellFine :
                    GaugeFineCell p tag derivativeGauge k :=
                  gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cell_fine hfineGood hk
                have hdeltaGood :
                    RealTheory.le (derivativeGauge (tag k))
                      (interiorDerivativeRadius a b (tag k)
                        (goodRadius (tag k))) := by
                  dsimp [derivativeGauge]
                  rw [if_neg hkGood]
                  exact RealTheory.le_refl
                    (interiorDerivativeRadius a b (tag k)
                      (goodRadius (tag k)))
                exact
                  exceptionalPrimitiveCellErrorAbs_le_eta_mul_cellLength_of_interiorDerivativeGauge
                    (rho := goodRadius (tag k))
                    hfine.left hk htagOpen
                    ((hgoodRadiusSpec (tag k)).right
                      htagClosed hkGood)
                    hcellFine hdeltaGood
              have herrorBudget_le :=
                exceptionalErrorAbsSum_le_goodBudget_add_badVariation
                  (S := S) (Fmap := Fmap) (f := f) (eta := eta)
                  (p := p) (tag := tag) (total := total) hgoodPoint
              have hgoodSum_le :
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.finiteSum
                      (goodErrorBudgetTerm S eta p tag) total)
                    (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a)) :=
                goodErrorBudgetSum_le_eta_mul_endpointLength
                  hfine.left
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heta_pos)
              have hcombined_le :
                  RealTheory.le
                    (exceptionalPrimitiveCellErrorAbsSum
                      Fmap (exceptionalZeroExtension S f)
                      p (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag total)
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a))
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum
                        (badPrimitiveVariationTerm S Fmap p tag) total)) :=
                F.le_trans herrorBudget_le
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hgoodSum_le
                    (F.le_refl
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum
                        (badPrimitiveVariationTerm S Fmap p tag) total)))
              have hcombined_lt_half_add_half :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a))
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum
                        (badPrimitiveVariationTerm S Fmap p tag) total))
                    (RealTheory.add e2 e2) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
                  hgoodBudget_lt hbadSum_lt
              have hcombined_lt :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a))
                    (RealTheory.finiteSum
                        (badPrimitiveVariationTerm S Fmap p tag) total))
                    eps := by
                have hhalf : RealTheory.add e2 e2 = eps := by
                  dsimp [e2]
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps
                rw [hhalf] at hcombined_lt_half_add_half
                exact hcombined_lt_half_add_half
              have htaggedError_le :=
                exceptional_abs_taggedSum_sub_endpoint_le_errorAbsSum
                  (Fmap := Fmap)
                  (g := exceptionalZeroExtension S f)
                  hfine.left
              exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt
                (F.le_trans htaggedError_le hcombined_le) hcombined_lt

name: nivenCoeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
statement:
private theorem nivenCoeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n j : Nat) (hj : 4 * n < j) :
    nivenCoeff S b n j = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold nivenCoeff
  split
  case isTrue h => omega
  case isFalse => rfl

name: binomialTerm_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
private theorem binomialTerm_eq_zero_of_lt
    (x y : RealDerivative.Point) (N t : Nat) (hNt : N < t) :
    binomialTerm x y N t = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold binomialTerm
  rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_eq_zero_of_lt hNt]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_zero]
  change RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero _ = RealTheory.zero
  exact RealTheory.zero_mul _

name: binomialTerm_succ
statement:
private theorem binomialTerm_succ
    (x y : RealDerivative.Point) (N t : Nat) (ht : t < N + 2) :
    binomialTerm x y (N + 1) t =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul y
          (previousTerm (binomialTerm x y N) t))
        (RealTheory.mul x (binomialTerm x y N t))
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | zero =>
      unfold binomialTerm previousTerm
      rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_succ_zero, Tautology.Nat.binom_zero]
      rw [Nat.sub_zero, RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
      change
        RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x (N + 1))
              RealTheory.one) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul y RealTheory.zero)
            (RealTheory.mul x
              (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
                (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x N)
                  RealTheory.one)))
      rw [RealTheory.one_mul, RealTheory.mul_one]
      rw [RealTheory.mul_zero, RealTheory.zero_add]
      rw [RealTheory.one_mul, RealTheory.mul_one]
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
      exact RealTheory.mul_comm _ _
  | succ k =>
      have hk : k <= N := by omega
      by_cases htop : k = N
      · subst k
        change
          binomialTerm x y (N + 1) (N + 1) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul y (binomialTerm x y N N))
              (RealTheory.mul x (binomialTerm x y N (N + 1)))
        unfold binomialTerm
        rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_self (N + 1)]
        rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_self N]
        rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_eq_zero_of_lt
          (Nat.lt_succ_self N)]
        rw [Nat.sub_self, show N - N = 0 by omega,
          show N - (N + 1) = 0 by omega]
        rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
        rw [RealTheory.nat_one, RealTheory.nat_zero]
        change
          RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
              (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
                (RealFunction.powNat y (N + 1))) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul y
                (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
                  (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
                    (RealFunction.powNat y N))))
              (RealTheory.mul x
                (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
                  (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
                    (RealFunction.powNat y (N + 1)))))
        simp only [RealTheory.one_mul, RealTheory.zero_mul,
          RealTheory.mul_zero, RealTheory.add_zero]
        rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
        exact RealTheory.mul_comm _ _
      · have hklt : k < N := by omega
        unfold binomialTerm previousTerm
        rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_succ_succ]
        rw [show N + 1 - (k + 1) = N - k by omega]
        rw [RealTheory.nat_add]
        change
          RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom N k))
                (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom N (k + 1))))
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealFunction.powNat x (N - k))
                (RealFunction.powNat y (k + 1))) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul y
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom N k))
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealFunction.powNat x (N - k))
                    (RealFunction.powNat y k))))
              (RealTheory.mul x
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom N (k + 1)))
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealFunction.powNat x (N - (k + 1)))
                    (RealFunction.powNat y (k + 1)))))
        rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
        congr 1
        · rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
          simp only [RealTheory.mul_assoc, RealTheory.mul_comm,
            RealTheory.mul_left_comm]
        · have hexponent : N - k = (N - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
          rw [hexponent, RealFunction.powNat_succ]
          simp only [RealTheory.mul_assoc, RealTheory.mul_comm,
            RealTheory.mul_left_comm]

name: binomialExpansion
statement:
private theorem binomialExpansion
    (x y : RealDerivative.Point) :
    forall N : Nat,
      RealTheory.finiteSum (binomialTerm x y N) (N + 1) =
        RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.add x y) N
  | 0 => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
      unfold binomialTerm
      rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_zero_zero]
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
      change
        RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one RealTheory.one) =
          RealTheory.one
      rw [RealTheory.one_mul, RealTheory.one_mul]
  | N + 1 => by
      change
        RealTheory.finiteSum (binomialTerm x y (N + 1)) (N + 2) =
          RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.add x y) (N + 1)
      let term
proof:
:= binomialTerm x y N
      have hprevious :
          RealTheory.finiteSum (previousTerm term) (N + 2) =
            RealTheory.finiteSum term (N + 1) := by
        rw [show N + 2 = (N + 1) + 1 by omega]
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first]
        change
          RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
              (RealTheory.finiteSum term (N + 1)) =
            RealTheory.finiteSum term (N + 1)
        exact RealTheory.zero_add _
      have happend :
          RealTheory.finiteSum term (N + 2) =
            RealTheory.finiteSum term (N + 1) := by
        rw [show N + 2 = (N + 1) + 1 by omega]
        exact RealTheory.finiteSum_append_zero term
          (h := binomialTerm_eq_zero_of_lt x y N (N + 1)
            (Nat.lt_succ_self N))
      calc
        RealTheory.finiteSum (binomialTerm x y (N + 1)) (N + 2) =
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun t : Nat =>
                RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.mul y (previousTerm term t))
                  (RealTheory.mul x (term t)))
              (N + 2) := by
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt (N + 2)
          intro t ht
          exact binomialTerm_succ x y N t ht
        _ = RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun t : Nat =>
                  RealTheory.mul y (previousTerm term t))
                (N + 2))
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun t : Nat => RealTheory.mul x (term t))
                (N + 2)) :=
          RealTheory.finiteSum_add _ _ _
        _ = RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.finiteSum term (N + 1)))
              (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.finiteSum term (N + 1))) := by
          rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left,
            RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left, hprevious, happend]
        _ = RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add x y)
              (RealTheory.finiteSum term (N + 1)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_comm x y]
          exact (RealTheory.add_mul y x
            (RealTheory.finiteSum term (N + 1))).symm
        _ = RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add x y)
              (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.add x y) N) := by
          rw [binomialExpansion x y N]
        _ = RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.add x y) (N + 1) := by
          rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
          exact RealTheory.mul_comm _ _

name: powNat_neg_eq_sign_mul
statement:
private theorem powNat_neg_eq_sign_mul
    (x : RealDerivative.Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.neg x) k =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) k)
        (RealFunction.powNat x k)
proof:
:= by
  have hneg :
      RealTheory.neg x =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) x := by
    change
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.neg x =
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.neg
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one) x
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_eq_neg_one_mul
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x
  rw [hneg]
  exact RealFunction.powNat_mul
    (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) x k

name: nivenCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt_base_degree
statement:
private theorem nivenCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt_base_degree
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n j : Nat) (hj : j < 2 * n) :
    nivenCoeff S b n j = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold nivenCoeff
  split
  case isTrue h => omega
  case isFalse => rfl

name: nivenCoeff_shift
statement:
private theorem nivenCoeff_shift
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n t : Nat) (ht : t <= 2 * n) :
    nivenCoeff S b n (2 * n + t) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) t)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat
            (b ^ (2 * n) * Tautology.Nat.binom (2 * n) t))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealFunction.powNat
              (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
              (2 * n - t))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealTheory.nat
                (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))))))
proof:
:= by
  unfold nivenCoeff
  rw [if_pos (by omega)]
  dsimp
  rw [show 2 * n + t - 2 * n = t by omega]

name: nivenRawTerm_shift
statement:
private theorem nivenRawTerm_shift
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n t : Nat) (ht : t <= 2 * n)
    (x : RealDerivative.Point) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (nivenCoeff S b n (2 * n + t))
        (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * n + t)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat b) (2 * n))
            (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * n)))
          (binomialTerm
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
            (RealTheory.neg x) (2 * n) t))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [nivenCoeff_shift S b n t ht]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_add]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_nat b (2 * n)]
  have hnatMul :
      RealTheory.nat
          (b ^ (2 * n) * Tautology.Nat.binom (2 * n) t) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (b ^ (2 * n)))
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom (2 * n) t)) := by
    change
      RealTheory.nat
          (b ^ (2 * n) * Tautology.Nat.binom (2 * n) t) =
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (b ^ (2 * n)))
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom (2 * n) t))
    exact RealTheory.nat_mul _ _
  rw [hnatMul]
  unfold binomialTerm
  rw [powNat_neg_eq_sign_mul x t]
  simp only [RealTheory.mul_assoc, RealTheory.mul_comm,
    RealTheory.mul_left_comm]

name: rawTaylorPolynomial_nivenCoeff_eq
statement:
private theorem rawTaylorPolynomial_nivenCoeff_eq
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n : Nat) (x : RealDerivative.Point) :
    RealDerivative.RawTaylorPolynomial
        (nivenCoeff S b n) (4 * n) x =
      nivenPolynomialAt S b n x
proof:
:= by
  unfold RealDerivative.RawTaylorPolynomial
  rw [show 4 * n + 1 = 2 * n + (2 * n + 1) by omega]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length]
  have hzero :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (nivenCoeff S b n j)
              (RealFunction.powNat x j))
          (2 * n) = RealTheory.zero := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    rw [nivenCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt_base_degree S b n j hj]
    exact RealTheory.zero_mul _
  rw [hzero, RealTheory.zero_add]
  let common :=
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat b) (2 * n))
      (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * n))
  let inverseFactorial :=
    RealTheory.inv
      (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)))
  let expansionTerm :=
    binomialTerm
      (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
      (RealTheory.neg x) (2 * n)
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (nivenCoeff S b n (2 * n + j))
            (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * n + j)))
        (2 * n + 1) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul common (expansionTerm j))
            inverseFactorial)
        (2 * n + 1) := by
      apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt (2 * n + 1)
      intro j hj
      exact nivenRawTerm_shift S b n j (by omega) x
    _ = RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul common (expansionTerm j))
            (2 * n + 1))
          inverseFactorial :=
      RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_right _ _ _
    _ = RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul common
            (RealTheory.finiteSum expansionTerm (2 * n + 1)))
          inverseFactorial := by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left]
    _ = RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul common
            (RealFunction.powNat
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
                (RealTheory.neg x))
              (2 * n)))
          inverseFactorial := by
      rw [binomialExpansion]
    _ = RealTheory.mul
          (RealFunction.powNat
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b) x)
              (RealTheory.sub
                (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S) x))
            (2 * n))
          inverseFactorial := by
      unfold common
      rw [<- RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
      rw [<- RealFunction.powNat_mul
        (RealTheory.nat b) x (2 * n)]
      rw [<- RealFunction.powNat_mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b) x)
        (RealTheory.sub (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S) x)
        (2 * n)]
    _ = nivenPolynomialAt S b n x := by
      rfl

name: iterCoeff_eq_zero_of_add_degree_lt
statement:
private theorem iterCoeff_eq_zero_of_add_degree_lt
    (c : Nat -> RealDerivative.Point) (d : Nat)
    (hc : forall j : Nat, d < j -> c j = RealTheory.zero) :
    forall r j : Nat,
      d < j + r -> iterCoeff c r j = RealTheory.zero
  | 0, j, hj => by
      exact hc j (by omega)
  | r + 1, j, hj => by
      rw [iterCoeff]
      unfold coeffDeriv
      have hprev : d < (j + 1) + r
proof:
:= by omega
      rw [iterCoeff_eq_zero_of_add_degree_lt c d hc r (j + 1) hprev]
      exact RealTheory.mul_zero _

name: nivenIterCoeff_eq_zero_of_add_degree_lt
statement:
private theorem nivenIterCoeff_eq_zero_of_add_degree_lt
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n r j : Nat) (hj : 4 * n < j + r) :
    iterCoeff (nivenCoeff S b n) r j = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:=
  iterCoeff_eq_zero_of_add_degree_lt
    (nivenCoeff S b n) (4 * n)
    (nivenCoeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt S b n) r j hj

name: factorialTail_shift
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      rfl
  | succ r ih =>
      rw [Tautology.Nat.factorialTail,
        Tautology.Nat.factorialTail]
      rw [<- ih]
      have hfactor : j + 1 + r + 1 = j + (r + 1) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hfactor]
      exact Nat.mul_left_comm _ _ _

name: iterCoeff_eq_factorialTail_mul
statement:
private theorem iterCoeff_eq_factorialTail_mul
    (c : Nat -> RealDerivative.Point) :
    forall r j : Nat,
      iterCoeff c r j =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorialTail j r))
          (c (j + r))
  | 0, j => by
      unfold iterCoeff Tautology.Nat.factorialTail
      rw [Nat.add_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
      change c j = RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one (c j)
      exact (RealTheory.one_mul _).symm
  | r + 1, j => by
      rw [iterCoeff]
      unfold coeffDeriv
      rw [iterCoeff_eq_factorialTail_mul c r (j + 1)]
      have hnatMul :
          RealTheory.nat
              ((j + 1) * Tautology.Nat.factorialTail (j + 1) r) =
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (j + 1))
              (RealTheory.nat
                (Tautology.Nat.factorialTail (j + 1) r))
proof:
:= by
        change
          RealTheory.nat
              ((j + 1) * Tautology.Nat.factorialTail (j + 1) r) =
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
              (RealTheory.nat (j + 1))
              (RealTheory.nat
                (Tautology.Nat.factorialTail (j + 1) r))
        exact RealTheory.nat_mul _ _
      calc
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (j + 1))
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.nat
                (Tautology.Nat.factorialTail (j + 1) r))
              (c (j + 1 + r))) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (j + 1))
              (RealTheory.nat
                (Tautology.Nat.factorialTail (j + 1) r)))
            (c (j + 1 + r)) := by
              rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
        _ = RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat
              ((j + 1) * Tautology.Nat.factorialTail (j + 1) r))
            (c (j + 1 + r)) := by
              rw [hnatMul]
        _ = RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat
              (Tautology.Nat.factorialTail j (r + 1)))
            (c (j + (r + 1))) := by
              rw [factorialTail_shift]
              congr 2 <;> omega

name: constMul_powerDerivative_succ
statement:
private theorem constMul_powerDerivative_succ
    (c : Nat -> RealDerivative.Point) (j : Nat)
    (x : RealDerivative.Point) :
    RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (c (j + 1))
        (RealDerivative.PowerDerivative (j + 1)) x =
      RealTheory.mul (coeffDeriv c j) (RealFunction.powNat x j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold RealDerivative.ConstMulFun RealDerivative.PowerDerivative
  unfold RealDerivative.ConstMulFun RealFunction.PowerFun coeffDeriv
  change
    RealTheory.mul (c (j + 1))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (j + 1))
          (RealFunction.powNat x j)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (j + 1)) (c (j + 1)))
        (RealFunction.powNat x j)
  rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_comm (c (j + 1)) (RealTheory.nat (j + 1))]

name: rawTaylorDerivative_eq
statement:
private theorem rawTaylorDerivative_eq
    (c : Nat -> RealDerivative.Point) (d : Nat)
    (hc : c (d + 1) = RealTheory.zero)
    (x : RealDerivative.Point) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (c k)
            (RealDerivative.PowerDerivative k) x)
        (d + 1) =
      RealDerivative.RawTaylorPolynomial (coeffDeriv c) d x
proof:
:= by
  let derivativeTerm := fun k : Nat =>
    RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (c k)
      (RealDerivative.PowerDerivative k) x
  let nextTerm := fun j : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul (coeffDeriv c j) (RealFunction.powNat x j)
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum derivativeTerm (d + 1) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => derivativeTerm (j + 1)) d := by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first]
      change
        RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (c 0) RealTheory.zero)
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun j : Nat => derivativeTerm (j + 1)) d) =
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => derivativeTerm (j + 1)) d
      rw [RealTheory.mul_zero, RealTheory.zero_add]
    _ = RealTheory.finiteSum nextTerm d := by
      apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
      intro j
      exact constMul_powerDerivative_succ c j x
    _ = RealTheory.finiteSum nextTerm (d + 1) := by
      symm
      apply RealTheory.finiteSum_append_zero
      unfold nextTerm coeffDeriv
      rw [hc, RealTheory.mul_zero, RealTheory.zero_mul]
    _ = RealDerivative.RawTaylorPolynomial (coeffDeriv c) d x := by
      rfl

name: nivenPolynomialAt_eq_nivenDerivativeAt_zero
statement:
private theorem nivenPolynomialAt_eq_nivenDerivativeAt_zero
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n : Nat) :
    nivenPolynomialAt S b n = nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  unfold nivenDerivativeAt iterCoeff
  exact (rawTaylorPolynomial_nivenCoeff_eq S b n x).symm

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenDerivativeAt
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenDerivativeAt
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain)
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n r : Nat) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (nivenDerivativeAt S b n r)
      (nivenDerivativeAt S b n (r + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold nivenDerivativeAt
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (f' := fun x : RealDerivative.Point =>
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
            (iterCoeff (nivenCoeff S b n) r k)
            (RealDerivative.PowerDerivative k) x)
        (4 * n + 1))
  · intro x _hx
    rw [iterCoeff]
    exact rawTaylorDerivative_eq
      (iterCoeff (nivenCoeff S b n) r) (4 * n)
      (nivenIterCoeff_eq_zero_of_add_degree_lt
        S b n r (4 * n + 1) (by omega)) x
  · exact RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_rawTaylorPolynomial
      E (iterCoeff (nivenCoeff S b n) r) (4 * n)

name: nivenDerivativeAt_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
statement:
private theorem nivenDerivativeAt_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n r : Nat) (hr : 4 * n < r) :
    nivenDerivativeAt S b n r =
      (fun _x : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  unfold nivenDerivativeAt RealDerivative.RawTaylorPolynomial
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero
  intro j hj
  rw [nivenIterCoeff_eq_zero_of_add_degree_lt
    S b n r j (by omega)]
  exact RealTheory.zero_mul _

name: nat_mul_real
proof:
:= by
  change
    RealTheory.nat (u * v) =
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
        (RealTheory.nat u) (RealTheory.nat v)
  exact RealTheory.nat_mul u v

name: factorialTail_zero_eq_factorial
statement:
private theorem factorialTail_zero_eq_factorial (r : Nat) :
    Tautology.Nat.factorialTail 0 r = Tautology.Nat.factorial r
proof:
:= by
  have h := Tautology.Nat.factorial_add_eq_factorialTail_mul 0 r
  rw [Nat.zero_add, Tautology.Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.mul_one] at h
  exact h.symm

name: nivenDerivativeAt_zero_eq_iterCoeff
statement:
private theorem nivenDerivativeAt_zero_eq_iterCoeff
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n r : Nat) :
    nivenDerivativeAt S b n r RealTheory.zero =
      iterCoeff (nivenCoeff S b n) r 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold nivenDerivativeAt
  exact RealDerivative.rawTaylorPolynomial_at_zero _ _

name: alternatingSign_succ
statement:
private theorem alternatingSign_succ (k : Nat) :
    alternatingSign (k + 1) = RealTheory.neg (alternatingSign k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold alternatingSign
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_neg, RealTheory.mul_one]

name: alternatingSign_two_mul
statement:
private theorem alternatingSign_two_mul (k : Nat) :
    alternatingSign (2 * k) = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      unfold alternatingSign
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [show 2 * (k + 1) = (2 * k + 1) + 1 by omega]
      rw [alternatingSign_succ, alternatingSign_succ]
      rw [RealTheory.neg_neg, ih]

name: nivenPower_relation
statement:
private theorem nivenPower_relation
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    {a b n k : Nat}
    (hrel :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)) =
        RealTheory.nat a)
    (hk : k <= 2 * n) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (b ^ (2 * n)))
        (RealFunction.powNat
          (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S) (4 * n - 2 * k)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (b ^ k))
        (RealTheory.nat (a ^ (2 * n - k)))
proof:
:= by
  let p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  let m := 2 * n - k
  rw [<- RealFunction.powNat_nat b (2 * n)]
  rw [<- RealFunction.powNat_nat b k]
  rw [<- RealFunction.powNat_nat a m]
  change
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat b) (2 * n))
        (RealFunction.powNat p (4 * n - 2 * k)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat b) k)
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat a) m)
  rw [show 2 * n = k + m by omega]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_add]
  rw [show 4 * n - 2 * k = m + m by omega]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_add]
  rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
  rw [<- RealFunction.powNat_mul p p m]
  rw [<- RealFunction.powNat_mul
    (RealTheory.nat b) (RealTheory.mul p p) m]
  rw [hrel]

name: nivenDerivativeAt_even_zero_formula
statement:
private theorem nivenDerivativeAt_even_zero_formula
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    {a b : Nat}
    (hrel :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)) =
        RealTheory.nat a)
    (n k : Nat) (hnk : n <= k) (hk : k <= 2 * n) :
    nivenDerivativeAt S b n (2 * k) RealTheory.zero =
      RealTheory.nat
        (Tautology.Nat.factorialTail (2 * n) (2 * k - 2 * n) *
          Tautology.Nat.binom (2 * n) (2 * k - 2 * n) *
          a ^ (2 * n - k) * b ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  let p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  let t := 2 * k - 2 * n
  let tail := Tautology.Nat.factorialTail (2 * n) t
  let choose := Tautology.Nat.binom (2 * n) t
  have ht : t <= 2 * n := by omega
  have hindex : 2 * n + t = 2 * k := by omega
  have htEven : t = 2 * (k - n) := by omega
  have hpowerIndex : 2 * n - t = 4 * n - 2 * k := by omega
  have hfactorialNat :
      Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * k) =
        tail * Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n) := by
    rw [<- hindex]
    exact Tautology.Nat.factorial_add_eq_factorialTail_mul (2 * n) t
  have hfactorialCast :
      RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * k)) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat tail)
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))) := by
    rw [hfactorialNat]
    exact nat_mul_real _ _
  have hfactorialNe :
      Not
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)) =
          RealTheory.zero) := by
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (Tautology.Nat.factorial_ne_zero (2 * n))
  have hfactorialCancel :
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)))) =
        RealTheory.one :=
    RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hfactorialNe
  rw [nivenDerivativeAt_zero_eq_iterCoeff]
  rw [iterCoeff_eq_factorialTail_mul]
  rw [Nat.zero_add, factorialTail_zero_eq_factorial]
  have hcoeff := nivenCoeff_shift S b n t ht
  rw [hindex] at hcoeff
  rw [hcoeff]
  have hsign :
      RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) t =
        RealTheory.one := by
    change alternatingSign t = RealTheory.one
    rw [htEven, alternatingSign_two_mul]
  rw [hsign]
  change
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * k)))
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (b ^ (2 * n) * choose))
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealFunction.powNat p (2 * n - t))
              (RealTheory.inv
                (RealTheory.nat
                  (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))))))) =
      RealTheory.nat (tail * choose * a ^ (2 * n - k) * b ^ k)
  rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
  have hcancelled :
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * k)))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (b ^ (2 * n) * choose))
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealFunction.powNat p (2 * n - t))
              (RealTheory.inv
                (RealTheory.nat
                  (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)))))) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat tail)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (b ^ (2 * n) * choose))
            (RealFunction.powNat p (2 * n - t))) := by
    rw [hfactorialCast]
    calc
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat tail)
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (b ^ (2 * n) * choose))
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealFunction.powNat p (2 * n - t))
              (RealTheory.inv
                (RealTheory.nat
                  (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)))))) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (b ^ (2 * n) * choose))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)))
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.inv
                (RealTheory.nat
                  (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))))
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat tail)
                (RealFunction.powNat p (2 * n - t))))) := by
          simp only [RealTheory.mul_assoc, RealTheory.mul_comm,
            RealTheory.mul_left_comm]
      _ = RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (b ^ (2 * n) * choose))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat tail)
            (RealFunction.powNat p (2 * n - t))) := by
          rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc
            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))))]
          rw [hfactorialCancel, RealTheory.one_mul]
      _ = RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat tail)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (b ^ (2 * n) * choose))
            (RealFunction.powNat p (2 * n - t))) := by
          simp only [RealTheory.mul_left_comm]
  rw [hcancelled]
  rw [nat_mul_real (b ^ (2 * n)) choose]
  rw [hpowerIndex]
  have hpower := nivenPower_relation S hrel hk
  calc
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat tail)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (b ^ (2 * n)))
            (RealTheory.nat choose))
          (RealFunction.powNat p (4 * n - 2 * k))) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat tail)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat choose)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (b ^ (2 * n)))
            (RealFunction.powNat p (4 * n - 2 * k)))) := by
        simp only [RealTheory.mul_assoc,
          RealTheory.mul_left_comm]
    _ = RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat tail)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat choose)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (b ^ k))
            (RealTheory.nat (a ^ (2 * n - k))))) := by
        rw [hpower]
    _ = RealTheory.nat
        (tail * choose * a ^ (2 * n - k) * b ^ k) := by
      rw [nat_mul_real (tail * choose * a ^ (2 * n - k)) (b ^ k)]
      rw [nat_mul_real (tail * choose) (a ^ (2 * n - k))]
      rw [nat_mul_real tail choose]
      simp only [RealTheory.mul_assoc, RealTheory.mul_comm]

name: nivenDerivativeAt_even_zero_of_lt
statement:
private theorem nivenDerivativeAt_even_zero_of_lt
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n k : Nat) (hk : k < n) :
    nivenDerivativeAt S b n (2 * k) RealTheory.zero =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [nivenDerivativeAt_zero_eq_iterCoeff]
  rw [iterCoeff_eq_factorialTail_mul]
  rw [Nat.zero_add]
  rw [nivenCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt_base_degree S b n (2 * k) (by omega)]
  exact RealTheory.mul_zero _

name: nivenDerivativeAt_even_zero_internalInt
statement:
private theorem nivenDerivativeAt_even_zero_internalInt
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    {a b : Nat}
    (hrel :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)) =
        RealTheory.nat a)
    (n k : Nat) (hk : k <= 2 * n) :
    RealTheory.InternalInt
      (nivenDerivativeAt S b n (2 * k) RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnk : n <= k
  · rw [nivenDerivativeAt_even_zero_formula S hrel n k hnk hk]
    exact RealTheory.internalInt_of_internalNat
      (RealTheory.internalNat_of_nat _)
  · have hklt : k < n := by omega
    rw [nivenDerivativeAt_even_zero_of_lt S b n k hklt]
    exact RealTheory.internalInt_zero

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenReflection
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenReflection
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      (nivenReflection S)
      (fun _x : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  have hraw := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_sub
    (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_const
      RealFunction.UniversalDomain (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S))
    (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_id RealFunction.UniversalDomain)
  unfold nivenReflection
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (f' := RealFunction.SubFun
      (fun _x : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.zero)
      (fun _x : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.one))
  · intro x _hx
    unfold RealFunction.SubFun
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg, RealTheory.zero_add]
  · exact hraw

name: nivenPolynomialAt_reflection
statement:
private theorem nivenPolynomialAt_reflection
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n : Nat) (x : RealDerivative.Point) :
    nivenPolynomialAt S b n (nivenReflection S x) =
      nivenPolynomialAt S b n x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  unfold nivenPolynomialAt nivenReflection
  change
    F.mul
        (RealFunction.powNat
          (F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) (F.sub p x))
            (F.sub p (F.sub p x)))
          (2 * n))
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)))) =
      F.mul
        (RealFunction.powNat
          (F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) x) (F.sub p x))
          (2 * n))
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F p x]
  have hbase :
      F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) (F.sub p x)) x =
        F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) x) (F.sub p x) := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) (F.sub p x)) x =
          F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) (F.mul (F.sub p x) x) :=
        F.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) (F.mul x (F.sub p x)) := by
        rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub p x) x]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) x) (F.sub p x) :=
        (F.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
  rw [hbase]

name: universal_clusterPoint
statement:
private theorem universal_clusterPoint
    (x0 : RealDerivative.Point) :
    RealFunction.ClusterPoint RealFunction.UniversalDomain x0
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := RealFunction.universal_leftClusterPoint x0
  unfold RealFunction.LeftClusterPoint at hleft
  intro eps heps
  cases hleft eps heps with
  | intro x hx =>
      exact Exists.intro x
        (And.intro trivial
          (And.intro hx.right.left hx.right.right))

name: nivenDerivativeAt_reflection
statement:
private theorem nivenDerivativeAt_reflection
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n : Nat) :
    forall r : Nat,
      forall x : RealDerivative.Point,
        nivenDerivativeAt S b n r (nivenReflection S x) =
          RealTheory.mul (alternatingSign r)
            (nivenDerivativeAt S b n r x)
  | 0, x => by
      unfold alternatingSign
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero, RealTheory.one_mul]
      rw [<- congrFun
        (nivenPolynomialAt_eq_nivenDerivativeAt_zero S b n)
        (nivenReflection S x)]
      rw [<- congrFun
        (nivenPolynomialAt_eq_nivenDerivativeAt_zero S b n) x]
      exact nivenPolynomialAt_reflection S b n x
  | r + 1, x => by
      have hreflection
proof:
:= hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenReflection S
      have hderivative := hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenDerivativeAt
        RealFunction.UniversalDomain S b n r
      have hcomp := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_comp
        hreflection hderivative
        (fun _y _hy => trivial)
      have hscaled := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul
        hderivative (c := alternatingSign r)
      have hsame :
          RealFunction.SameOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
            (RealFunction.CompFun (nivenDerivativeAt S b n r)
              (nivenReflection S))
            (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (alternatingSign r)
              (nivenDerivativeAt S b n r)) := by
        intro y _hy
        exact nivenDerivativeAt_reflection S b n r y
      have hcompScaled := RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_congr
        hsame (hcomp x trivial)
      have heq := RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
        (universal_clusterPoint x) hcompScaled (hscaled x trivial)
      change
        RealTheory.mul
            (nivenDerivativeAt S b n (r + 1) (nivenReflection S x))
            (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) =
          RealTheory.mul (alternatingSign r)
            (nivenDerivativeAt S b n (r + 1) x) at heq
      rw [RealTheory.mul_neg, RealTheory.mul_one] at heq
      have hneg := congrArg RealTheory.neg heq
      rw [RealTheory.neg_neg] at hneg
      rw [alternatingSign_succ, RealTheory.neg_mul]
      exact hneg

name: nivenDerivativeAt_even_pi_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem nivenDerivativeAt_even_pi_eq_zero
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n k : Nat) :
    nivenDerivativeAt S b n (2 * k)
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S) =
      nivenDerivativeAt S b n (2 * k) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hreflect := nivenDerivativeAt_reflection
    S b n (2 * k) RealTheory.zero
  unfold nivenReflection at hreflect
  rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg, RealTheory.neg_zero,
    RealTheory.add_zero] at hreflect
  rw [alternatingSign_two_mul, RealTheory.one_mul] at hreflect
  exact hreflect

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenEvenSumAt
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenEvenSumAt
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain)
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n : Nat) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (nivenEvenSumAt S b n) (nivenOddSumAt S b n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold nivenEvenSumAt nivenOddSumAt
  exact RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum
    (2 * n + 1)
    (fun k _hk =>
      RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul
        (hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenDerivativeAt E S b n (2 * k)))

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenOddSumAt
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenOddSumAt
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain)
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n : Nat) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (nivenOddSumAt S b n) (nivenOddDerivativeAt S b n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold nivenOddSumAt nivenOddDerivativeAt
  exact RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum
    (2 * n + 1)
    (fun k _hk =>
      RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul
        (hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenDerivativeAt E S b n (2 * k + 1)))

name: nivenOddDerivative_add_even
statement:
private theorem nivenOddDerivative_add_even
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n : Nat) (x : RealDerivative.Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (nivenOddDerivativeAt S b n x)
        (nivenEvenSumAt S b n x) =
      nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x
proof:
:= by
  let evenTerm := fun k : Nat =>
    RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (alternatingSign k)
      (nivenDerivativeAt S b n (2 * k)) x
  let oddDerivativeTerm := fun k : Nat =>
    RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (alternatingSign k)
      (nivenDerivativeAt S b n ((2 * k + 1) + 1)) x
  have hpair : forall k : Nat,
      oddDerivativeTerm k = RealTheory.neg (evenTerm (k + 1)) := by
    intro k
    unfold oddDerivativeTerm evenTerm RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
    rw [alternatingSign_succ]
    rw [show 2 * (k + 1) = (2 * k + 1) + 1 by omega]
    rw [RealTheory.neg_mul, RealTheory.neg_neg]
  have hlast : oddDerivativeTerm (2 * n) = RealTheory.zero := by
    unfold oddDerivativeTerm RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
    have hz := congrFun
      (nivenDerivativeAt_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
        S b n ((2 * (2 * n) + 1) + 1) (by omega)) x
    rw [hz, RealTheory.mul_zero]
  have hodd :
      RealTheory.finiteSum oddDerivativeTerm (2 * n + 1) =
        RealTheory.neg
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => evenTerm (k + 1)) (2 * n)) := by
    calc
      RealTheory.finiteSum oddDerivativeTerm (2 * n + 1) =
          RealTheory.finiteSum oddDerivativeTerm (2 * n) :=
        RealTheory.finiteSum_append_zero oddDerivativeTerm (h := hlast)
      _ = RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.neg (evenTerm (k + 1)))
            (2 * n) := by
        apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
        exact hpair
      _ = RealTheory.neg
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat => evenTerm (k + 1)) (2 * n)) :=
        RealTheory.finiteSum_neg _ _
  have heven :
      RealTheory.finiteSum evenTerm (2 * n + 1) =
        RealTheory.add (evenTerm 0)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => evenTerm (k + 1)) (2 * n)) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first evenTerm (2 * n)
  have hevenZero : evenTerm 0 = nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x := by
    unfold evenTerm RealDerivative.ConstMulFun alternatingSign
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero, RealTheory.one_mul]
  unfold nivenOddDerivativeAt nivenEvenSumAt
  change
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum oddDerivativeTerm (2 * n + 1))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum evenTerm (2 * n + 1)) =
      nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x
  rw [hodd, heven, hevenZero]
  let tail :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat => evenTerm (k + 1)) (2 * n)
  change
    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg tail)
        (RealTheory.add (nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x) tail) =
      nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x
  calc
    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg tail)
        (RealTheory.add (nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x) tail) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg tail)
          (nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x)) tail := by
        rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc]
    _ = RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add (nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x)
            (RealTheory.neg tail)) tail := by
        rw [RealTheory.add_comm (RealTheory.neg tail)]
    _ = RealTheory.add (nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x)
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg tail) tail) := by
        rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
    _ = RealTheory.add (nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x)
          RealTheory.zero := by
        rw [RealTheory.neg_add]
    _ = nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x :=
      RealTheory.add_zero _

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenPrimitiveAt
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenPrimitiveAt
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n : Nat) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      (nivenPrimitiveAt S b n)
      (fun x : RealDerivative.Point =>
        RealTheory.mul (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) (S.sin x))
proof:
:= by
  have hodd := hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenOddSumAt
    RealFunction.UniversalDomain S b n
  have heven := hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenEvenSumAt
    RealFunction.UniversalDomain S b n
  have hsin :=
    RealDerivative.Trigonometric.hasDerivativeWithinOn_sin_universal S
  have hcos :=
    RealDerivative.Trigonometric.hasDerivativeWithinOn_cos_universal S
  have hleft := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_mul hodd hsin
  have hright := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_mul heven hcos
  unfold nivenPrimitiveAt
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (f' := RealFunction.SubFun
      (RealFunction.AddFun
        (RealFunction.MulFun (nivenOddDerivativeAt S b n) S.sin)
        (RealFunction.MulFun (nivenOddSumAt S b n) S.cos))
      (RealFunction.AddFun
        (RealFunction.MulFun (nivenOddSumAt S b n) S.cos)
        (RealFunction.MulFun (nivenEvenSumAt S b n)
          (fun x : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.neg (S.sin x)))))
  · intro x _hx
    unfold RealFunction.SubFun RealFunction.AddFun RealFunction.MulFun
    let A := nivenOddDerivativeAt S b n x
    let B := nivenOddSumAt S b n x
    let C := nivenEvenSumAt S b n x
    let sine := S.sin x
    let cosine := S.cos x
    change
      RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul A sine) (RealTheory.mul B cosine))
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul B cosine)
            (RealTheory.mul C (RealTheory.neg sine))) =
        RealTheory.mul (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) sine
    have hsum :
        RealTheory.add A C = nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x :=
      nivenOddDerivative_add_even S b n x
    have hpoly :
        nivenPolynomialAt S b n x = nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x :=
      congrFun (nivenPolynomialAt_eq_nivenDerivativeAt_zero S b n) x
    rw [hpoly]
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
    have hnegAdd :
        RealTheory.neg
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul B cosine)
              (RealTheory.mul C (RealTheory.neg sine))) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul B cosine))
            (RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.mul C (RealTheory.neg sine))) := by
      change
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.neg
            (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.add
              (RealTheory.mul B cosine)
              (RealTheory.mul C (RealTheory.neg sine))) =
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.add
            (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.neg
              (RealTheory.mul B cosine))
            (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.neg
              (RealTheory.mul C (RealTheory.neg sine)))
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base _ _
    rw [hnegAdd]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_neg, RealTheory.neg_neg]
    calc
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul A sine) (RealTheory.mul B cosine))
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul B cosine))
            (RealTheory.mul C sine)) =
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul A sine)
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul B cosine)
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul B cosine))
              (RealTheory.mul C sine))) := by
          exact RealTheory.add_assoc
            (RealTheory.mul A sine) (RealTheory.mul B cosine)
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul B cosine))
              (RealTheory.mul C sine))
      _ = RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul A sine)
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul B cosine)
              (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul B cosine)))
            (RealTheory.mul C sine)) := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun z : RealDerivative.Point =>
              RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul A sine) z)
            (RealTheory.add_assoc
              (RealTheory.mul B cosine)
              (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul B cosine))
              (RealTheory.mul C sine)).symm
      _ = RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul A sine)
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul C sine)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_neg]
      _ = RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul A sine)
          (RealTheory.mul C sine) := by
          rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
      _ = RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add A C) sine :=
        (RealTheory.add_mul A C sine).symm
      _ = RealTheory.mul (nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0 x) sine := by
        rw [hsum]
  · exact RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_sub hleft hright

name: internalRat_pi_sq_normalization
statement:
private theorem internalRat_pi_sq_normalization
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (hq : RealTheory.InternalRat
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S))) :
    Exists (fun a : Nat =>
      Exists (fun b : Nat =>
        And (0 < a)
          (And (0 < b)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b)
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
                (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)) =
              RealTheory.nat a))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  have hp : F.lt F.zero p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi_pos S
  have hpSq : F.lt F.zero (F.mul p p) := F.mul_pos hp hp
  change IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalRat F (F.mul p p) at hq
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.InternalRat at hq
  cases hq with
  | intro z hz =>
      cases hz with
      | intro d hd =>
          have hzInt := hd.left
          have hdNat := hd.right.left
          have hdNe := hd.right.right.left
          have hvalue := hd.right.right.right
          cases RealTheory.internalNat_exists_nat hdNat with
          | intro b hdb =>
              rw [hdb] at hdNe hvalue
              have hbNe : Not (b = 0) := by
                intro hb0
                subst b
                rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at hdNe
                exact hdNe rfl
              have hb : 0 < b := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hbNe
              have hbReal : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat b) :=
                RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hbNe
              have hrelationZ :
                  F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) (F.mul p p) = z := by
                rw [F.mul_comm (RealTheory.nat b) (F.mul p p)]
                rw [hvalue]
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
                  F z hdNe
              have hzPos : F.lt F.zero z := by
                rw [<- hrelationZ]
                exact F.mul_pos hbReal hpSq
              cases RealTheory.internalInt_exists_int hzInt with
              | intro w hzw =>
                  cases w with
                  | ofNat a =>
                      rw [RealTheory.int_ofNat] at hzw
                      have haNe : Not (a = 0) := by
                        intro ha0
                        subst a
                        rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at hzw
                        rw [hzw] at hzPos
                        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F F.zero) hzPos
                      have ha : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero haNe
                      refine Exists.intro a ?_
                      refine Exists.intro b ?_
                      exact And.intro ha (And.intro hb (by
                        change F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) (F.mul p p) =
                          RealTheory.nat a
                        rw [hrelationZ, hzw]))
                  | negSucc a =>
                      rw [RealTheory.int_negSucc] at hzw
                      have hnonpos :
                          F.le (F.neg (RealTheory.nat (a + 1))) F.zero := by
                        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F
                          (RealTheory.nat_nonneg (a + 1))
                        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h
                      rw [hzw] at hzPos
                      exact False.elim
                        ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hzPos) hnonpos)

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_nivenIntegralValue
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_nivenIntegralValue
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n : Nat) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : RealDerivative.Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealFunction.powNat
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b) x)
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S) x))
              (2 * n))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealTheory.nat
                (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)))))
          (S.sin x))
      RealTheory.zero
      (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
      (NivenIntegralValue S b n)
proof:
:= by
  let p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  let integrand := fun x : RealDerivative.Point =>
    RealTheory.mul (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) (S.sin x)
  have hpi : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero p :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi_pos S)
  have hDzero := hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenDerivativeAt
    RealFunction.UniversalDomain S b n 0
  have hpolyDerivative :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (nivenPolynomialAt S b n) (nivenDerivativeAt S b n 1) := by
    apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left
      (f := nivenDerivativeAt S b n 0)
    · intro x _hx
      exact (congrFun
        (nivenPolynomialAt_eq_nivenDerivativeAt_zero S b n) x).symm
    · exact hDzero
  have hsinDerivative :=
    RealDerivative.Trigonometric.hasDerivativeWithinOn_sin_universal S
  have hpolyContinuous :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero p)
        (nivenPolynomialAt S b n) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun _x _hx => trivial)
      (RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn hpolyDerivative)
  have hsinContinuous :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero p)
        S.sin :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun _x _hx => trivial)
      (RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn hsinDerivative)
  have hintegrandContinuous :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero p) integrand := by
    change
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero p)
        (RealFunction.MulFun (nivenPolynomialAt S b n) S.sin)
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_mul hpolyContinuous hsinContinuous
  have hprimitiveDerivative := hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenPrimitiveAt S b n
  have hprimitiveContinuous :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero p)
        (nivenPrimitiveAt S b n) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun _x _hx => trivial)
      (RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        hprimitiveDerivative)
  have hprimitiveOpen :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero p)
        (nivenPrimitiveAt S b n) integrand := by
    intro x hx
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
      (fun _y _hy => trivial) hx (hprimitiveDerivative x trivial)
  change
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      integrand RealTheory.zero p
      (RealTheory.sub
        (nivenPrimitiveAt S b n p)
        (nivenPrimitiveAt S b n RealTheory.zero))
  exact
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      hpi hintegrandContinuous hprimitiveContinuous hprimitiveOpen

name: nivenIntegralValue_eq_even_endpoint_sum
statement:
private theorem nivenIntegralValue_eq_even_endpoint_sum
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (b n : Nat) :
    NivenIntegralValue S b n =
      RealTheory.add
        (nivenEvenSumAt S b n (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S))
        (nivenEvenSumAt S b n RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  unfold NivenIntegralValue nivenPrimitiveAt
  unfold RealFunction.SubFun RealFunction.MulFun
  rw [RealDerivative.Trigonometric.sin_pi_eq_zero S]
  rw [RealDerivative.Trigonometric.cos_pi_eq_neg_one S]
  rw [RealFunction.Trigonometric.Derived.sin_zero S]
  rw [RealFunction.Trigonometric.Derived.cos_zero S]
  simp only [RealTheory.mul_zero, RealTheory.mul_neg, RealTheory.mul_one]
  have hsubNeg (u : RealDerivative.Point) :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.neg u) = u := by
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg, RealTheory.neg_neg,
      RealTheory.zero_add]
  have hzeroSub (u : RealDerivative.Point) :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero u = RealTheory.neg u := by
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg, RealTheory.zero_add]
  rw [hsubNeg, hzeroSub]
  rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg, RealTheory.neg_neg]

name: alternatingSign_mul_internalInt
statement:
private theorem alternatingSign_mul_internalInt
    {x : RealDerivative.Point} (hx : RealTheory.InternalInt x) :
    forall k : Nat,
      RealTheory.InternalInt
        (RealTheory.mul (alternatingSign k) x)
  | 0 => by
      unfold alternatingSign
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero, RealTheory.one_mul]
      exact hx
  | k + 1 => by
      rw [alternatingSign_succ, RealTheory.neg_mul]
      exact RealTheory.internalInt_neg
        (alternatingSign_mul_internalInt hx k)

private theorem finiteSum_internalInt
    (term : Nat -> RealDerivative.Point) :
    forall m : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k < m -> RealTheory.InternalInt (term k)) ->
        RealTheory.InternalInt (RealTheory.finiteSum term m)
  | 0, _h => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      exact RealTheory.internalInt_zero
  | m + 1, h => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      exact RealTheory.internalInt_add
        (finiteSum_internalInt term m
          (fun k hk => h k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self m))))
        (h m (Nat.lt_succ_self m))

private theorem nivenEvenSumAt_zero_internalInt
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    {a b : Nat}
    (hrel :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)) =
        RealTheory.nat a)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.InternalInt (nivenEvenSumAt S b n RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  unfold nivenEvenSumAt
  apply finiteSum_internalInt
  intro k hk
  change RealTheory.InternalInt
    (RealTheory.mul (alternatingSign k)
      (nivenDerivativeAt S b n (2 * k) RealTheory.zero))
  exact alternatingSign_mul_internalInt
    (nivenDerivativeAt_even_zero_internalInt S hrel n k (by omega)) k

  | 0, _h => by

  | m + 1, h => by

statement:

      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b)

statement:
private theorem nivenEvenSumAt_pi_internalInt
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)

      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b)
