name: nivenIntegrand_pos
statement:
private theorem nivenIntegrand_pos
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    {b : Nat} (hb : 0 < b) (n : Nat)
    {x : RealDerivative.Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero
      (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S) x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.mul (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) (S.sin x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  have hbNe : Not (b = 0) := by omega
  have hbReal : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat b) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hbNe
  have hbx : F.lt F.zero (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) x) :=
    F.mul_pos hbReal hx.left
  have hpx : F.lt F.zero (F.sub p x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx.right
  have hq :
      F.lt F.zero (F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) x) (F.sub p x)) :=
    F.mul_pos hbx hpx
  have hpow :
      F.lt F.zero
        (RealFunction.powNat
          (F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) x) (F.sub p x)) (2 * n)) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_pos hq (2 * n)
  have hfactorialNe : Not (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n) = 0) :=
    Tautology.Nat.factorial_ne_zero (2 * n)
  have hfactorialPos :
      F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hfactorialNe
  have hinv :
      F.lt F.zero
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hfactorialPos
  have hpoly : F.lt F.zero (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) := by
    unfold nivenPolynomialAt
    exact F.mul_pos hpow hinv
  have hsin : F.lt F.zero (S.sin x) :=
    RealDerivative.Trigonometric.sin_pos_openInterval_zero_pi S hx
  exact F.mul_pos hpoly hsin

name: nivenIntegralValue_pos
statement:
theorem nivenIntegralValue_pos
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    {b : Nat} (hb : 0 < b) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (NivenIntegralValue S b n)
proof:
:= by
  let p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  let integrand := fun x : RealDerivative.Point =>
    RealTheory.mul (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) (S.sin x)
  have hprimitiveDerivative := hasDerivativeWithinOn_nivenPrimitiveAt S b n
  have hprimitiveContinuous :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero p)
        (nivenPrimitiveAt S b n) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun _x _hx => trivial)
      (RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        hprimitiveDerivative)
  have hdifferentiable :
      RealDerivative.DifferentiableOnOpenInterval
        RealTheory.zero p (nivenPrimitiveAt S b n) := by
    intro x hx
    refine Exists.intro (integrand x) ?_
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
      (fun _y _hy => trivial) hx (hprimitiveDerivative x trivial)
  have hpositive :
      RealDerivative.DerivativePositiveOnOpenInterval
        RealTheory.zero p (nivenPrimitiveAt S b n) := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hcanonical :
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
          (RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero p)
          (nivenPrimitiveAt S b n) x (integrand x) :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
        (fun _y _hy => trivial) hx (hprimitiveDerivative x trivial)
    have heq := RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
      (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA hcanonical
    rw [heq]
    exact nivenIntegrand_pos S hb n hx
  have hmono :
      RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero p)
        (nivenPrimitiveAt S b n) :=
    RealDerivative.strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_positive
      hprimitiveContinuous hdifferentiable hpositive
  have hpiPos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero p :=
    RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi_pos S
  have hzeroMem :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero p RealTheory.zero :=
    And.intro
      (RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hpiPos)
  have hpiMem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero p p :=
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hpiPos)
      (RealTheory.le_refl p)
  have hendpoint := hmono RealTheory.zero p hzeroMem hpiMem hpiPos
  unfold NivenIntegralValue
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hendpoint

name: nivenIntegrand_abs_le
statement:
private theorem nivenIntegrand_abs_le
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    {a b : Nat}
    (hrel :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)) =
        RealTheory.nat a)
    (n : Nat) {x : RealDerivative.Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero
      (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S) x) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.mul (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) (S.sin x)))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (a ^ (2 * n)))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  let q := F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) x) (F.sub p x)
  let inverseFactorial :=
    F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)))
  have hbNonneg : F.le F.zero (RealTheory.nat b) :=
    RealTheory.nat_nonneg b
  have hsubNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub p x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hx.right
  have hqNonneg : F.le F.zero q := by
    unfold q
    exact F.mul_nonneg (F.mul_nonneg hbNonneg hx.left) hsubNonneg
  have hbxLe :
      F.le (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) x)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) p) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
      F hx.right hbNonneg
  have hsubLe : F.le (F.sub p x) p :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic F hx.left
  have hbpNonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) p) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hbNonneg
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi_pos S))
  have hqLe : F.le q (RealTheory.nat a) := by
    have hstep1 :
        F.le q (F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) p) (F.sub p x)) := by
      unfold q
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
        F hbxLe hsubNonneg
    have hstep2 :
        F.le (F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) p) (F.sub p x))
          (F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) p) p) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
        F hsubLe hbpNonneg
    have hright :
        F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) p) p = RealTheory.nat a := by
      calc
        F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) p) p =
            F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) (F.mul p p) :=
          F.mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ = RealTheory.nat a := hrel
    have hstep2a :
        F.le (F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat b) p) (F.sub p x))
          (RealTheory.nat a) := by
      rw [hright] at hstep2
      exact hstep2
    exact F.le_trans hstep1 hstep2a
  have hpowLe :
      F.le (RealFunction.powNat q (2 * n))
        (RealTheory.nat (a ^ (2 * n))) := by
    have h := RealFunction.powNat_mono_nonneg hqNonneg hqLe (2 * n)
    rwa [RealFunction.powNat_nat] at h
  have hfactorialPos :
      F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero
      (Tautology.Nat.factorial_ne_zero (2 * n))
  have hinvNonneg : F.le F.zero inverseFactorial :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hfactorialPos)
  have hpolyNonneg :
      F.le F.zero (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) := by
    unfold nivenPolynomialAt
    change F.le F.zero (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat q (2 * n)) inverseFactorial)
    exact F.mul_nonneg (RealFunction.powNat_nonneg hqNonneg (2 * n))
      hinvNonneg
  have hpolyLe :
      F.le (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (a ^ (2 * n))) inverseFactorial) := by
    unfold nivenPolynomialAt
    change
      F.le (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat q (2 * n)) inverseFactorial)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (a ^ (2 * n))) inverseFactorial)
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hpowLe hinvNonneg
  have habsMul :
      RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.mul (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) (S.sin x)) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.abs (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x))
          (RealTheory.abs (S.sin x)) := by
    change
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
          (F.mul (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) (S.sin x)) =
        F.mul
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (S.sin x))
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F _ _
  rw [habsMul]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hpolyNonneg]
  have hsin := RealFunction.Trigonometric.Derived.abs_sin_le_one S x
  have hsinProduct := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
    F hsin hpolyNonneg
  change
    F.le
      (F.mul (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) (RealTheory.abs (S.sin x)))
      (F.mul (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) F.one) at hsinProduct
  rw [F.mul_one] at hsinProduct
  exact F.le_trans hsinProduct hpolyLe

name: nivenIntegralValue_abs_le_of_relation
statement:
theorem nivenIntegralValue_abs_le_of_relation
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    {a b : Nat}
    (hrel :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)) =
        RealTheory.nat a)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (NivenIntegralValue S b n))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (Nat.pow a (2 * n)))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.nat
              (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  let integrand := fun x : RealDerivative.Point =>
    RealTheory.mul (nivenPolynomialAt S b n x) (S.sin x)
  let M := RealTheory.mul
    (RealTheory.nat (a ^ (2 * n)))
    (RealTheory.inv
      (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))))
  let endpointValue := fun z : RealDerivative.Point =>
    F.mul (F.mul z (F.inv p)) (NivenIntegralValue S b n)
  have hp : F.lt F.zero p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi_pos S
  have hpLe : F.le F.zero p := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hp
  have hpNe : Not (p = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hp0
    rw [hp0] at hp
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F F.zero) hp
  have hendpointZero : endpointValue RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero := by
    unfold endpointValue
    change
      F.mul (F.mul F.zero (F.inv p)) (NivenIntegralValue S b n) =
        F.zero
    rw [F.zero_mul, F.zero_mul]
  have hendpointPi : endpointValue p = NivenIntegralValue S b n := by
    unfold endpointValue
    rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hpNe, F.one_mul]
  have hzeroIntegral :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        integrand RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
        (endpointValue RealTheory.zero) := by
    rw [hendpointZero]
    exact RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_degenerate
      integrand RealTheory.zero
  have hpiIntegral :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        integrand RealTheory.zero p (endpointValue p) := by
    rw [hendpointPi]
    exact hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_nivenIntegralValue S b n
  have hforward :
      forall z : RealDerivative.Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero p z ->
          F.le (RealTheory.abs (integrand z)) M := by
    intro z hz
    exact nivenIntegrand_abs_le S hrel n hz
  have hreverse :
      forall z : RealDerivative.Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval p RealTheory.zero z ->
          F.le (RealTheory.abs (integrand z)) M := by
    intro z hz
    have hpZero : F.le p F.zero := F.le_trans hz.left hz.right
    exact False.elim ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hp) hpZero)
  have hbound :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.orientedEndpoint_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub_base_right
      (f := integrand) (F := endpointValue)
      (a := RealTheory.zero) (x := RealTheory.zero) (y := p) (M := M)
      (F.le_refl F.zero) hpLe hzeroIntegral hpiIntegral hforward hreverse
  rw [hendpointPi, hendpointZero] at hbound
  have hsubZero (u : RealDerivative.Point) :
      F.sub u F.zero = u := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F, F.add_zero]
  change
    F.le
      (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (NivenIntegralValue S b n) F.zero))
      (F.mul M (RealTheory.abs (F.sub p F.zero))) at hbound
  rw [hsubZero, hsubZero, RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hpLe] at hbound
  change
    F.le (RealTheory.abs (NivenIntegralValue S b n)) (F.mul p M)
  rw [F.mul_comm p M]
  exact hbound

name: exists_nivenIntegralValue_lt_one_of_relation
statement:
theorem exists_nivenIntegralValue_lt_one_of_relation
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    {a b : Nat} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hrel :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat b)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)) =
        RealTheory.nat a) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat =>
      And (0 < n)
        (RealTheory.lt (NivenIntegralValue S b n) RealTheory.one))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  have hp : F.lt F.zero p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi_pos S
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_gt p with
  | intro m hpm =>
      have hmNe : Not (m = 0) := by
        intro hm0
        subst m
        rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at hpm
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_asymm F hp) hpm
      have hm : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hmNe
      cases Tautology.Nat.exists_mul_pow_two_mul_lt_factorial_two_mul
          a m ha hm with
      | intro n hn =>
          refine Exists.intro n ?_
          refine And.intro hn.left ?_
          let numerator := a ^ (2 * n)
          let denominator := Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n)
          let scale := F.mul (RealTheory.nat numerator)
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat denominator))
          have hnumPosNat : 0 < numerator := Nat.pow_pos ha
          have hnumPos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat numerator) :=
            RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hnumPosNat)
          have hdenNeNat : Not (denominator = 0) :=
            Tautology.Nat.factorial_ne_zero (2 * n)
          have hdenPos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat denominator) :=
            RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hdenNeNat
          have hinvPos :
              F.lt F.zero (F.inv (RealTheory.nat denominator)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hdenPos
          have hscalePos : F.lt F.zero scale :=
            F.mul_pos hnumPos hinvPos
          have hpScale : F.lt (F.mul p scale)
              (F.mul (RealTheory.nat m) scale) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hpm hscalePos
          have hcast :
              F.lt (RealTheory.nat (m * numerator))
                (RealTheory.nat denominator) :=
            RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn.right
          rw [nat_mul_real] at hcast
          have hscaledNat := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right
            F hcast hinvPos
          change
            F.lt
              (F.mul
                (F.mul (RealTheory.nat m) (RealTheory.nat numerator))
                (F.inv (RealTheory.nat denominator)))
              (F.mul (RealTheory.nat denominator)
                (F.inv (RealTheory.nat denominator))) at hscaledNat
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel
            (RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hdenNeNat)] at hscaledNat
          rw [F.mul_assoc] at hscaledNat
          have hscaleLtOne : F.lt (F.mul p scale) F.one :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hpScale hscaledNat
          have hvalueBound := nivenIntegralValue_abs_le_of_relation
            S hrel n
          have hvaluePos := nivenIntegralValue_pos S hb n
          have hvalueNonneg :
              F.le F.zero (NivenIntegralValue S b n) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hvaluePos
          rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hvalueNonneg] at hvalueBound
          change
            F.le (NivenIntegralValue S b n) (F.mul p scale) at hvalueBound
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
            F hvalueBound hscaleLtOne

name: pi_sq_not_internalRat
statement:
theorem pi_sq_not_internalRat
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec) :
    Not (RealTheory.InternalRat
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)))
proof:
:= by
  intro hrat
  cases internalRat_pi_sq_normalization S hrat with
  | intro a haData =>
      cases haData with
      | intro b hab =>
          have ha := hab.left
          have hb := hab.right.left
          have hrel := hab.right.right
          cases exists_nivenIntegralValue_lt_one_of_relation
              S ha hb hrel with
          | intro n hn =>
              have hInt := nivenIntegralValue_internalInt_of_relation
                S hrel n
              have hPos := nivenIntegralValue_pos S hb n
              exact
                (RealTheory.not_internalInt_of_zero_lt_of_lt_one
                  hPos hn.right) hInt

name: baseTail_eq_inv_powNat_nat
proof:
:= by
  unfold RealTheory.baseTail IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.basePow
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_nat]
  change RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (a ^ k)) =
    RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (a ^ k))
  rfl

name: powNat_inv_eq_inv_powNat
statement:
private theorem powNat_inv_eq_inv_powNat
    {x : RealTheory.Carrier} (hx : x ≠ RealTheory.zero) (n : Nat) :
    RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.inv x) n =
      RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat x n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero, RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      have h := RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel RealTheory.one_ne_zero
      have h' : RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one := by
        rwa [RealTheory.mul_one] at h
      exact h'.symm
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ, RealFunction.powNat_succ, ih]
      exact (RealTheory.inv_mul
        (RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hx n) hx).symm

name: two_mul_le_two_pow
statement:
private theorem two_mul_le_two_pow (r : Nat) (hr : 1 <= r) :
    2 * r <= 2 ^ r
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => omega
  | succ r ih =>
      by_cases hr0 : r = 0
      · subst r
        decide
      · have hr1 : 1 <= r := by omega
        have hrec : 2 * r <= 2 ^ r := ih hr1
        have htwo : 2 <= 2 ^ r := by omega
        rw [Nat.pow_succ]
        omega

name: exists_pos_nat_mul_powNat_lt_of_unitInterval
statement:
private theorem exists_pos_nat_mul_powNat_lt_of_unitInterval
    {q A epsilon : RealTheory.Carrier}
    (hq_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero q)
    (hq_lt_one : RealTheory.lt q RealTheory.one)
    (hA_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero A)
    (hepsilon : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero epsilon) :
    Exists fun n : Nat =>
      And (0 < n)
        (RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat n))
            (RealFunction.powNat q n))
          epsilon)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hA_zero : A = RealTheory.zero
  · refine Exists.intro 1 (And.intro (by decide) ?_)
    simpa [hA_zero, RealTheory.zero_mul] using hepsilon
  by_cases hq_zero : q = RealTheory.zero
  · refine Exists.intro 1 (And.intro (by decide) ?_)
    simpa [hq_zero, RealFunction.powNat_one, RealTheory.mul_zero]
      using hepsilon
  have hq_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero q := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hq_nonneg
    intro hq_nonpos
    exact hq_zero (F.le_antisymm hq_nonpos hq_nonneg)
  have hA_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero A := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hA_nonneg
    intro hA_nonpos
    exact hA_zero (F.le_antisymm hA_nonpos hA_nonneg)
  have hinv_one : RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one := by
    have h := RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel RealTheory.one_ne_zero
    rwa [RealTheory.mul_one] at h
  have hq_inv_gt_one :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv q) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos F
      hq_pos RealTheory.zero_lt_one hq_lt_one
    change RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one)
      (RealTheory.inv q) at h
    rwa [hinv_one] at h
  let d := RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.inv q) RealTheory.one
  have hd_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero d := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hq_inv_gt_one
  have hd_ne : d ≠ RealTheory.zero := by
    intro hd_zero
    exact F.ne_of_lt hd_pos hd_zero.symm
  have hinv_d_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv d) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hd_pos
  rcases RealTheory.exists_nat_gt (RealTheory.inv d) with
    ⟨m, hm⟩
  have hm_real_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat m) :=
    F.lt_trans hinv_d_pos hm
  have hm_pos : 0 < m := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro hm_zero
    subst m
    rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at hm_real_pos
    exact (F.lt_irrefl RealTheory.zero) hm_real_pos
  have hone_lt_nat_mul_d :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) d) := by
    have hmul := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hm hd_pos
    change RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv d) d)
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) d) at hmul
    rwa [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hd_ne] at hmul
  have htwo_eq :
      RealTheory.nat 2 =
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one := by
    change F.nat 2 = F.add F.one F.one
    rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, F.nat_add, F.nat_one]
  have htwo_lt_one_add_nat_mul_d :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.nat 2)
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) d)) := by
    have h := F.add_lt_add_left hone_lt_nat_mul_d RealTheory.one
    change RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one)
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) d)) at h
    rwa [← htwo_eq] at h
  have hd_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero d :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hd_pos
  have hbernoulli :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat m) d))
        (RealFunction.powNat
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one d) m) :=
    RealFunction.one_add_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_add hd_nonneg m
  have hone_add_d :
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one d = RealTheory.inv q := by
    calc
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one d =
          RealTheory.add d RealTheory.one := RealTheory.add_comm _ _
      _ = RealTheory.inv q := by
        exact F.sub_add_cancel (RealTheory.inv q) RealTheory.one
  have htwo_lt_inv_qpow :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.nat 2)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat q m)) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
      htwo_lt_one_add_nat_mul_d hbernoulli
    rw [hone_add_d, powNat_inv_eq_inv_powNat hq_zero m] at h
    exact h
  have htwo_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 2) := by
    have h := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt (show 0 < 2 by omega)
    rwa [RealTheory.nat_zero] at h
  have hqpow_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealFunction.powNat q m) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_pos hq_pos m
  have hinv_qpow_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat q m)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hqpow_pos
  have hqpow_ne : RealFunction.powNat q m ≠ RealTheory.zero :=
    RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hq_zero m
  have hinv_qpow_ne :
      RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat q m) ≠ RealTheory.zero := by
    intro hinv_zero
    have hcancel := RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hqpow_ne
    rw [hinv_zero, RealTheory.zero_mul] at hcancel
    exact RealTheory.one_ne_zero hcancel.symm
  have hinv_inv_qpow :
      RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat q m)) =
        RealFunction.powNat q m := by
    calc
      RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat q m)) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat q m)))
            RealTheory.one := (RealTheory.mul_one _).symm
      _ = RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat q m)))
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat q m))
              (RealFunction.powNat q m)) := by
        rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hqpow_ne]
      _ = RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat q m)))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat q m)))
            (RealFunction.powNat q m) := by
        rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      _ = RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
            (RealFunction.powNat q m) := by
        rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hinv_qpow_ne]
      _ = RealFunction.powNat q m := RealTheory.one_mul _
  have hqpow_lt_half :
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.powNat q m)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos F
      htwo_pos hinv_qpow_pos htwo_lt_inv_qpow
    change RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.inv
        (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat q m)))
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)) at h
    rwa [hinv_inv_qpow] at h
  have hbase_two : RealTheory.ValidBase 2 := by
    unfold RealTheory.ValidBase IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
    omega
  have htail_zero :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun r : Nat => RealTheory.baseTail 2 r)
        RealTheory.zero :=
    RealTheory.baseTail_tendsto_zero_all hbase_two
  have hconst :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun _ : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m))
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m)) :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_const _
  have hscaled_tail :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun r : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m))
            (RealTheory.baseTail 2 r))
        RealTheory.zero := by
    have h := RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul hconst htail_zero
    change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun r : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m))
          (RealTheory.baseTail 2 r))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m))
        RealTheory.zero) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.mul_zero] at h
  rcases RealTheory.seqTendsto_eventually hscaled_tail hepsilon with
    ⟨N, hN⟩
  let r := N + 1
  have hr_pos : 1 <= r := by
    dsimp [r]
    omega
  have hsmall_abs := hN r (by
    dsimp [r]
    omega)
  have hAm_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hA_nonneg (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hm_real_pos)
  have htail_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.baseTail 2 r) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (RealTheory.baseTail_pos hbase_two r)
  have hscaled_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m))
          (RealTheory.baseTail 2 r)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hAm_nonneg htail_nonneg
  have hsmall :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m))
          (RealTheory.baseTail 2 r))
        epsilon := by
    change F.lt
      (F.abs
        (F.sub
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m))
            (RealTheory.baseTail 2 r))
          F.zero)) epsilon at hsmall_abs
    rw [F.sub_zero,
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hscaled_nonneg] at hsmall_abs
    exact hsmall_abs
  let n := m * (2 * r)
  have hn_pos : 0 < n := by
    have hr_nat_pos : 0 < r := by omega
    dsimp [n]
    exact Nat.mul_pos hm_pos (Nat.mul_pos (by decide) hr_nat_pos)
  refine Exists.intro n (And.intro hn_pos ?_)
  have hqpow_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealFunction.powNat q m) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_nonneg hq_nonneg m
  have hqpow_bound :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealFunction.powNat q n)
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) (2 * r))) := by
    have hpow := RealFunction.powNat_mono_nonneg
      hqpow_nonneg
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hqpow_lt_half)
      (2 * r)
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_powNat] at hpow
    rw [powNat_inv_eq_inv_powNat
      (show RealTheory.nat 2 ≠ RealTheory.zero by
        intro htwo_zero
        exact F.ne_of_lt htwo_pos htwo_zero.symm)
      (2 * r)] at hpow
    dsimp [n]
    exact hpow
  have hn_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat n) :=
    F.nat_nonneg n
  have hcoefficient_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat n)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hA_nonneg hn_nonneg
  have hfirst := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F
    hqpow_bound hcoefficient_nonneg
  have htwo_r_le_pow : 2 * r <= 2 ^ r :=
    two_mul_le_two_pow r hr_pos
  have htwo_r_real_le_pow :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat (2 * r))
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r) := by
    have h := RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le htwo_r_le_pow
    rwa [← RealFunction.powNat_nat] at h
  have hpow_two_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_pos htwo_pos r
  have hpow_two_ne :
      RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r ≠ RealTheory.zero :=
    RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (by
        intro htwo_zero
        exact F.ne_of_lt htwo_pos htwo_zero.symm)
      r
  have hinv_pow_two_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hpow_two_pos)
  have hfactor :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (2 * r))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r)))
        RealTheory.one := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F
      htwo_r_real_le_pow hinv_pow_two_nonneg
    change RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (2 * r))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r)))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r)
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r))) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hpow_two_ne] at h
  have hfactor_scaled := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F
    hfactor hAm_nonneg
  have hfactor_scaled_tail :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F
      hfactor_scaled hinv_pow_two_nonneg
  have hdecompose :
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat n))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) (2 * r))) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m))
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.nat (2 * r))
              (RealTheory.inv
                (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r))))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r)) := by
    dsimp [n]
    rw [RealTheory.nat_mul]
    rw [show 2 * r = r + r by omega]
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_add]
    rw [RealTheory.inv_mul hpow_two_ne hpow_two_ne]
    change F.mul
        (F.mul A (F.mul (F.nat m) (F.nat (r + r))))
        (F.mul
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r))) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul A (F.nat m))
          (F.mul
            (F.nat (r + r))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r))))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r))
    rw [← F.mul_assoc A (F.nat m) (F.nat (r + r))]
    rw [← F.mul_assoc
      (F.mul (F.mul A (F.nat m)) (F.nat (r + r)))
      (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r))
      (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r))]
    rw [F.mul_assoc
      (F.mul A (F.nat m))
      (F.nat (r + r))
      (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r))]
  change RealTheory.le
    (RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat n))
      (RealFunction.powNat q n))
    (RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat n))
      (RealTheory.inv
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) (2 * r)))) at hfirst
  rw [hdecompose] at hfirst
  change RealTheory.le
    (RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (2 * r))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r))))
      (RealTheory.inv
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r)))
    (RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m))
        RealTheory.one)
      (RealTheory.inv
        (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r))) at hfactor_scaled_tail
  have hle_tail : RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat n))
          (RealFunction.powNat q n))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.nat m))
            RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat 2) r))) :=
    F.le_trans hfirst hfactor_scaled_tail
  rw [RealTheory.mul_one,
    (baseTail_eq_inv_powNat_nat 2 r).symm] at hle_tail
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle_tail hsmall

name: unitEndpointAdjusted_zero
statement:
private theorem unitEndpointAdjusted_zero (f : RealFunction.Map) :
    unitEndpointAdjusted f RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold unitEndpointAdjusted
  change F.sub
    (F.sub (f F.zero) (f F.zero))
    (F.mul F.zero (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero))) = F.zero
  rw [F.sub_self, F.zero_mul, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F]

name: unitEndpointAdjusted_one
statement:
private theorem unitEndpointAdjusted_one (f : RealFunction.Map) :
    unitEndpointAdjusted f RealTheory.one = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold unitEndpointAdjusted
  change F.sub
    (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero))
    (F.mul F.one (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero))) = F.zero
  rw [F.one_mul, F.sub_self]

name: continuousOn_unitEndpointAdjusted
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_unitEndpointAdjusted
    {f : RealFunction.Map}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one) f) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one)
      (unitEndpointAdjusted f)
proof:
:= by
  unfold unitEndpointAdjusted
  change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
    (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one)
    (RealFunction.SubFun
      (RealFunction.SubFun f (fun _ => f RealTheory.zero))
      (RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.IdentityFun
        (fun _ =>
          RealTheory.sub (f RealTheory.one) (f RealTheory.zero))))
  exact RealFunction.continuousOn_sub
    (RealFunction.continuousOn_sub hf RealFunction.continuousOn_const)
    (RealFunction.continuousOn_mul
      RealFunction.continuousOn_identity RealFunction.continuousOn_const)

name: unitZeroExtension_eq_on
statement:
private theorem unitZeroExtension_eq_on
    (g : RealFunction.Map) {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one x) :
    unitZeroExtension g x = g x
proof:
:= by
  unfold unitZeroExtension
  rw [if_pos hx]

name: unitZeroExtension_eq_zero_off
statement:
private theorem unitZeroExtension_eq_zero_off
    (g : RealFunction.Map) {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : Not
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one x)) :
    unitZeroExtension g x = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold unitZeroExtension
  rw [if_neg hx]

name: uniformContinuousOn_unitZeroExtension
statement:
private theorem uniformContinuousOn_unitZeroExtension
    {g : RealFunction.Map}
    (hg : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one) g)
    (hg0 : g RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero)
    (hg1 : g RealTheory.one = RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn
      (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => True)
      (unitZeroExtension g)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hzero_le_one : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  have hzero_mem :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
        RealTheory.zero :=
    And.intro (F.le_refl F.zero) hzero_le_one
  have hone_mem :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
        RealTheory.one :=
    And.intro hzero_le_one (F.le_refl F.one)
  have huc :
      RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one) g :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_compact_uniformContinuousOn.{0}
      (RealFunction.closedInterval_compact.{0} hzero_le_one) hg
  have dist_to_zero_le
      (x y : RealFunction.Point)
      (hx0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x)
      (hy0 : RealTheory.le y RealTheory.zero) :
      RealTheory.le (RealFunction.dist x RealTheory.zero)
        (RealFunction.dist x y) := by
    change F.le F.zero x at hx0
    change F.le y F.zero at hy0
    have hyx : F.le y x := F.le_trans hy0 hx0
    change F.le
      (F.abs (F.sub x F.zero))
      (F.abs (F.sub x y))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hx0)]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hyx)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
      (F.le_refl x) hy0
  have dist_to_one_le
      (x y : RealFunction.Point)
      (hx1 : RealTheory.le x RealTheory.one)
      (h1y : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one y) :
      RealTheory.le (RealFunction.dist x RealTheory.one)
        (RealFunction.dist x y) := by
    change F.le x F.one at hx1
    change F.le F.one y at h1y
    have hxy : F.le x y := F.le_trans hx1 h1y
    change F.le
      (F.abs (F.sub x F.one))
      (F.abs (F.sub x y))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hx1)]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hxy)]
    rw [(IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x F.one).symm]
    rw [(IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x y).symm]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
      h1y (F.le_refl x)
  have off_cases
      (z : RealFunction.Point)
      (hz : Not
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one z)) :
      Or (RealTheory.le z RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.le RealTheory.one z) := by
    by_cases h0z : F.le F.zero z
    · cases F.le_total F.one z with
      | inl h1z => exact Or.inr h1z
      | inr hz1 =>
          exact False.elim (hz (And.intro h0z hz1))
    · exact Or.inl
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F h0z)
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  cases huc epsilon hepsilon with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta (And.intro hdelta.left ?_)
      intro x y _ _ hxy
      by_cases hx :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one x
      · by_cases hy :
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one y
        · rw [unitZeroExtension_eq_on g hx,
            unitZeroExtension_eq_on g hy]
          exact hdelta.right x y hx hy hxy
        · rw [unitZeroExtension_eq_on g hx,
            unitZeroExtension_eq_zero_off g hy]
          cases off_cases y hy with
          | inl hy0 =>
              have hdist :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealFunction.dist x RealTheory.zero) delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                  (dist_to_zero_le x y hx.left hy0) hxy
              have hclose :=
                hdelta.right x RealTheory.zero hx hzero_mem hdist
              rwa [hg0] at hclose
          | inr h1y =>
              have hdist :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealFunction.dist x RealTheory.one) delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                  (dist_to_one_le x y hx.right h1y) hxy
              have hclose :=
                hdelta.right x RealTheory.one hx hone_mem hdist
              rwa [hg1] at hclose
      · by_cases hy :
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one y
        · rw [unitZeroExtension_eq_zero_off g hx,
            unitZeroExtension_eq_on g hy]
          cases off_cases x hx with
          | inl hx0 =>
              have hdist_le := dist_to_zero_le y x hy.left hx0
              rw [RealFunction.dist_comm y RealTheory.zero,
                RealFunction.dist_comm y x] at hdist_le
              have hdist :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealFunction.dist RealTheory.zero y) delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hdist_le hxy
              have hclose :=
                hdelta.right RealTheory.zero y hzero_mem hy hdist
              rwa [hg0] at hclose
          | inr h1x =>
              have hdist_le := dist_to_one_le y x hy.right h1x
              rw [RealFunction.dist_comm y RealTheory.one,
                RealFunction.dist_comm y x] at hdist_le
              have hdist :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealFunction.dist RealTheory.one y) delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hdist_le hxy
              have hclose :=
                hdelta.right RealTheory.one y hone_mem hy hdist
              rwa [hg1] at hclose
        · rw [unitZeroExtension_eq_zero_off g hx,
            unitZeroExtension_eq_zero_off g hy,
            RealFunction.dist_self]
          exact hepsilon

name: exists_pos_abs_unitZeroExtension_le
statement:
private theorem exists_pos_abs_unitZeroExtension_le
    {g : RealFunction.Map}
    (hg : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one) g) :
    Exists fun M : RealFunction.Point =>
      And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M)
        (forall x : RealFunction.Point,
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (unitZeroExtension g x)) M)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hzero_le_one : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  cases RealFunction.continuousOn_closedInterval_bounded hzero_le_one hg with
  | intro lower hbounded_lower =>
      cases hbounded_lower with
      | intro upper hbounds =>
          let M := RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs lower) (RealTheory.abs upper))
            RealTheory.one
          have hM_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M := by
            unfold M
            change F.lt F.zero
              (F.add (F.add (F.abs lower) (F.abs upper)) F.one)
            have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
              (F.add (F.abs lower) (F.abs upper))
            rw [F.add_zero] at h
            have hsum_nonneg :
                F.le F.zero (F.add (F.abs lower) (F.abs upper)) := by
              have hsum := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F lower)
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F upper)
              rwa [F.zero_add] at hsum
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
              hsum_nonneg h
          refine Exists.intro M (And.intro hM_pos ?_)
          intro x
          by_cases hx :
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one x
          · rw [unitZeroExtension_eq_on g hx]
            have hx_bounds := hbounds x hx
            have hupper_abs :
                F.le (g x) (F.add (F.abs lower) (F.abs upper)) := by
              have hu_abs : F.le upper (F.abs upper) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_abs_self F upper
              have habs_upper_sum :
                  F.le (F.abs upper)
                    (F.add (F.abs lower) (F.abs upper)) := by
                have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F lower)
                  (F.abs upper)
                rwa [F.add_zero,
                  F.add_comm (F.abs upper) (F.abs lower)] at h
              exact F.le_trans hx_bounds.right
                (F.le_trans hu_abs habs_upper_sum)
            have hneg_lower_abs :
                F.le (F.neg (g x))
                  (F.add (F.abs lower) (F.abs upper)) := by
              have hneg : F.le (F.neg (g x)) (F.neg lower) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hx_bounds.left
              have hneg_abs : F.le (F.neg lower) (F.abs lower) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_abs_self F lower
              have habs_lower_sum :
                  F.le (F.abs lower)
                    (F.add (F.abs lower) (F.abs upper)) := by
                have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_right F
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F upper)
                  (F.abs lower)
                rw [F.zero_add,
                  F.add_comm (F.abs upper) (F.abs lower)] at h
                exact h
              exact F.le_trans hneg
                (F.le_trans hneg_abs habs_lower_sum)
            have habs_le_sum :
                F.le (F.abs (g x))
                  (F.add (F.abs lower) (F.abs upper)) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_le_of_bounds F
                hupper_abs hneg_lower_abs
            have hsum_le_M :
                F.le (F.add (F.abs lower) (F.abs upper)) M := by
              unfold M
              change F.le
                (F.add (F.abs lower) (F.abs upper))
                (F.add (F.add (F.abs lower) (F.abs upper)) F.one)
              have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F))
                (F.add (F.abs lower) (F.abs upper))
              rwa [F.add_zero] at h
            exact F.le_trans habs_le_sum hsum_le_M
          · rw [unitZeroExtension_eq_zero_off g hx]
            change F.le (F.abs F.zero) M
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_zero F]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hM_pos

name: continuousOn_rudinKernelBase
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_rudinKernelBase
    (E : RealFunction.Domain) (n : Nat) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn E (rudinKernelBase n)

:= by

      RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
        (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
          RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealFunction.powNat t 2)) := by

      (RealFunction.SubFun (fun _ => RealTheory.one)
        (RealFunction.PowerFun 2))
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_sub
      RealFunction.continuousOn_const
      (RealFunction.continuousOn_powerFun 2)
  unfold rudinKernelBase
  change RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
    (RealFunction.CompFun (RealFunction.PowerFun n)
      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealFunction.powNat t 2)))
  exact RealFunction.continuousOn_comp hquadratic
    (G := fun _ : RealFunction.Point => True)
    (RealFunction.continuousOn_powerFun n)
    (fun _ _ => True.intro)

name: square_nonneg
statement:
private theorem square_nonneg (x : RealFunction.Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl hx => exact F.mul_nonneg hx hx
  | inr hx =>
      have hneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx
      have hprod : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) :=
        F.mul_nonneg hneg hneg
      rwa [F.neg_mul_neg] at hprod

name: square_le_square_of_mem_symmetric
statement:
private theorem square_le_square_of_mem_symmetric
    {a x : RealFunction.Point}
    (ha_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero a)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval (RealTheory.neg a) a x) :
    RealTheory.le (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
      (RealFunction.powNat a 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_two, RealFunction.powNat_two]
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl hx0 =>
      have hmul := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F
        hx.right hx0
      change F.le (F.mul x x) (F.mul a x) at hmul
      exact F.le_trans hmul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F hx.right ha_nonneg)
  | inr hx0 =>
      have hneg_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx0
      have hneg_le_a : F.le (F.neg x) a := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hx.left
        change F.le (F.neg x) (F.neg (F.neg a)) at h
        rw [F.neg_neg] at h
        exact h
      have hmul := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F
        hneg_le_a hneg_nonneg
      change F.le (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x))
        (F.mul a (F.neg x)) at hmul
      rw [F.neg_mul_neg] at hmul
      exact F.le_trans hmul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F hneg_le_a ha_nonneg)

name: half_inv_nat_le_rudinKernelBase_on_radius
statement:
private theorem half_inv_nat_le_rudinKernelBase_on_radius
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n)
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval
      (RealTheory.neg
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))) x) :
    RealTheory.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.one)
      (rudinKernelBase n x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let nval := F.nat n
  let a := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.inv nval)
  let halfOne := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
  have hnval_pos : F.lt F.zero nval := by
    dsimp [nval]
    have h := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
    rwa [RealTheory.nat_zero] at h
  have hnval_nonneg : F.le F.zero nval := F.le_of_lt hnval_pos
  have hnval_ne : nval ≠ F.zero := by
    intro hzero
    exact F.ne_of_lt hnval_pos hzero.symm
  have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv nval) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hnval_pos
  have ha_pos : F.lt F.zero a := by
    dsimp [a]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hinv_pos
  have ha_nonneg : F.le F.zero a := F.le_of_lt ha_pos
  have hone_le_nval : F.le F.one nval := by
    dsimp [nval]
    have h := RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (show 1 <= n by omega)
    rwa [RealTheory.nat_one] at h
  have hinv_le_one : F.le (F.inv nval) F.one := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos F
      F.zero_lt_one hnval_pos hone_le_nval
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at h
  have ha_le_one : F.le a F.one :=
    F.le_trans
      (F.le_of_lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hinv_pos))
      hinv_le_one
  have hx' : RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.neg a) a x := by
    simpa only [a] using hx
  have hx_square_le_a_square :=
    square_le_square_of_mem_symmetric ha_nonneg hx'
  have ha_square_le_a :
      F.le (RealFunction.powNat a 2) a := by
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F
      ha_le_one ha_nonneg
    change F.le (F.mul a a) (F.mul F.one a) at h
    rwa [F.one_mul] at h
  have hx_square_le_a : F.le (RealFunction.powNat x 2) a :=
    F.le_trans hx_square_le_a_square ha_square_le_a
  have hn_mul_square_le :
      F.le (F.mul nval (RealFunction.powNat x 2))
        (F.mul nval a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F
      hx_square_le_a hnval_nonneg
  have hn_mul_a : F.mul nval a = halfOne := by
    dsimp [a, halfOne]
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
    rw [← F.mul_assoc, F.mul_inv_cancel hnval_ne,
      F.one_mul]
  have hn_mul_square_le_half :
      F.le (F.mul nval (RealFunction.powNat x 2)) halfOne := by
    rwa [hn_mul_a] at hn_mul_square_le
  have hhalf_le_comparison :
      F.le halfOne
        (F.sub F.one (F.mul nval (RealFunction.powNat x 2))) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
      (F.le_refl F.one) hn_mul_square_le_half
    change F.le (F.sub F.one halfOne)
      (F.sub F.one (F.mul nval (RealFunction.powNat x 2))) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_half_self F F.one] at h
  have hx_square_le_one : F.le (RealFunction.powNat x 2) F.one :=
    F.le_trans hx_square_le_a ha_le_one
  have hcomparison_le :
      F.le
        (F.sub F.one (F.mul nval (RealFunction.powNat x 2)))
        (rudinKernelBase n x) := by
    unfold rudinKernelBase
    exact RealFunction.one_sub_nat_mul_le_powNat_one_sub
      (square_nonneg x)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hx_square_le_one) n
  change F.le halfOne (rudinKernelBase n x)
  exact F.le_trans hhalf_le_comparison hcomparison_le

name: rudinKernelBase_nonneg_on_unit
statement:
private theorem rudinKernelBase_nonneg_on_unit
    (n : Nat) {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval
      (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (rudinKernelBase n x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hx_square_le_one :
      F.le (RealFunction.powNat x 2) F.one := by
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
    cases F.le_total F.zero x with
    | inl hx0 =>
        have hmul := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F
          hx.right hx0
        change F.le (F.mul x x) (F.mul F.one x) at hmul
        rw [F.one_mul] at hmul
        exact F.le_trans hmul hx.right
    | inr hx0 =>
        have hneg_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx0
        have hneg_le_one : F.le (F.neg x) F.one := by
          have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hx.left
          change F.le (F.neg x) (F.neg (F.neg F.one)) at h
          rwa [F.neg_neg] at h
        have hmul := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F
          hneg_le_one hneg_nonneg
        change F.le (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x))
          (F.mul F.one (F.neg x)) at hmul
        rw [F.neg_mul_neg, F.one_mul] at hmul
        exact F.le_trans hmul hneg_le_one
  unfold rudinKernelBase
  exact RealFunction.powNat_nonneg
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hx_square_le_one) n

name: half_inv_nat_le_rudinKernelMass
statement:
private theorem half_inv_nat_le_rudinKernelMass
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)))
      (rudinKernelMass n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let nval := F.nat n
  let a := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.inv nval)
  let halfOne := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
  have hnval_pos : F.lt F.zero nval := by
    dsimp [nval]
    have h := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
    rwa [RealTheory.nat_zero] at h
  have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv nval) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hnval_pos
  have ha_pos : F.lt F.zero a := by
    dsimp [a]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hinv_pos
  have ha_nonneg : F.le F.zero a := F.le_of_lt ha_pos
  have hneg_a_le_zero : F.le (F.neg a) F.zero := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F ha_nonneg
    rwa [F.neg_zero] at h
  have hneg_a_le_a : F.le (F.neg a) a :=
    F.le_trans hneg_a_le_zero ha_nonneg
  have hone_le_nval : F.le F.one nval := by
    dsimp [nval]
    have h := RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (show 1 <= n by omega)
    rwa [RealTheory.nat_one] at h
  have hinv_le_one : F.le (F.inv nval) F.one := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos F
      F.zero_lt_one hnval_pos hone_le_nval
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at h
  have ha_le_one : F.le a F.one :=
    F.le_trans
      (F.le_of_lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hinv_pos))
      hinv_le_one
  have hneg_one_le_neg_a : F.le (F.neg F.one) (F.neg a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F ha_le_one
  have hneg_one_le_one : F.le (F.neg F.one) F.one :=
    F.le_trans hneg_one_le_neg_a
      (F.le_trans hneg_a_le_a ha_le_one)
  have hneg_one_lt_one : F.lt (F.neg F.one) F.one := by
    have hneg_one_le_zero : F.le (F.neg F.one) F.zero := by
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F
        (F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one)
      rwa [F.neg_zero] at h
    exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hneg_one_le_zero F.zero_lt_one
  have hconst_value :
      F.mul halfOne (F.sub a (F.neg a)) = a := by
    dsimp [halfOne]
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, F.neg_neg, F.mul_add,
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_one_mul F a,
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F a]
  have hconst_darboux :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
        (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => halfOne)
        (F.neg a) a a := by
    have h := RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_const_of_le
      (a := F.neg a) (b := a) (c := halfOne) hneg_a_le_a
    change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
      (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => halfOne) (F.neg a) a
      (F.mul halfOne (F.sub a (F.neg a))) at h
    rwa [hconst_value] at h
  have hmid_integrable :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.RiemannIntegrableOn
        (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg a) a :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.riemannIntegrableOn_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hneg_a_le_a
      (continuousOn_rudinKernelBase
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.neg a) a) n)
  let mid := Classical.choose hmid_integrable
  have hmid_spec :
      And
        (RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded
          (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg a) a)
        (RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
          (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg a) a mid) :=
    Classical.choose_spec hmid_integrable
  have ha_le_mid : F.le a mid := by
    apply RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      (f := fun _ : RealFunction.Point => halfOne)
      (g := rudinKernelBase n) hneg_a_le_a
    · intro x hx
      change F.le halfOne (rudinKernelBase n x)
      simpa only [a, halfOne, nval] using
        (half_inv_nat_le_rudinKernelBase_on_radius n hn hx)
    · exact RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_const
        halfOne (F.neg a) a
    · exact hconst_darboux
    · exact hmid_spec.left
    · exact hmid_spec.right
  have hleft_integrable :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.RiemannIntegrableOn
        (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg F.one) (F.neg a) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.riemannIntegrableOn_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hneg_one_le_neg_a
      (continuousOn_rudinKernelBase
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.neg F.one) (F.neg a)) n)
  let leftValue := Classical.choose hleft_integrable
  have hleft_spec :
      And
        (RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded
          (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg F.one) (F.neg a))
        (RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
          (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg F.one) (F.neg a) leftValue) :=
    Classical.choose_spec hleft_integrable
  have hright_integrable :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.RiemannIntegrableOn
        (rudinKernelBase n) a F.one :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.riemannIntegrableOn_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      ha_le_one
      (continuousOn_rudinKernelBase
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a F.one) n)
  let rightValue := Classical.choose hright_integrable
  have hright_spec :
      And
        (RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded
          (rudinKernelBase n) a F.one)
        (RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
          (rudinKernelBase n) a F.one rightValue) :=
    Classical.choose_spec hright_integrable
  have hleft_nonneg : F.le F.zero leftValue := by
    apply RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      hneg_one_le_neg_a
    · intro x hx
      exact rudinKernelBase_nonneg_on_unit n
        (And.intro hx.left
          (F.le_trans hx.right (F.le_trans hneg_a_le_a ha_le_one)))
    · exact RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
        hneg_one_le_neg_a RealFunction.continuousOn_const
    · exact RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_zero_of_le
        hneg_one_le_neg_a
    · exact hleft_spec.left
    · exact hleft_spec.right
  have hright_nonneg : F.le F.zero rightValue := by
    apply RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      ha_le_one
    · intro x hx
      exact rudinKernelBase_nonneg_on_unit n
        (And.intro
          (F.le_trans hneg_one_le_neg_a
            (F.le_trans hneg_a_le_a hx.left)) hx.right)
    · exact RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
        ha_le_one RealFunction.continuousOn_const
    · exact RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_zero_of_le ha_le_one
    · exact hright_spec.left
    · exact hright_spec.right
  have hleft_mid :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
        (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg F.one) a
        (F.add leftValue mid) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_ordered
      hneg_one_le_neg_a hneg_a_le_a
      hleft_spec.left hleft_spec.right hmid_spec.left hmid_spec.right
  have hleft_mid_bdd :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded
        (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg F.one) a :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      (F.le_trans hneg_one_le_neg_a hneg_a_le_a)
      (continuousOn_rudinKernelBase
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.neg F.one) a) n)
  have hjoined :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
        (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg F.one) F.one
        (F.add (F.add leftValue mid) rightValue) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_ordered
      (F.le_trans hneg_one_le_neg_a hneg_a_le_a) ha_le_one
      hleft_mid_bdd hleft_mid hright_spec.left hright_spec.right
  have hmass_bdd :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded
        (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg F.one) F.one :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hneg_one_le_one
      (continuousOn_rudinKernelBase
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.neg F.one) F.one) n)
  have hmass_darboux :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
        (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg F.one) F.one
        (rudinKernelMass n) := by
    cases hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_rudinKernelBase_mass n with
    | inl hleft => exact hleft.right.right
    | inr hright =>
        cases hright with
        | intro J hJ =>
            exact False.elim ((F.not_le_of_lt hneg_one_lt_one) hJ.left)
  have hmass_eq :
      rudinKernelMass n = F.add (F.add leftValue mid) rightValue :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_unique
      (RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
        hmass_bdd hmass_darboux)
      (RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
        hmass_bdd hjoined)
  have hmid_le_left_mid : F.le mid (F.add leftValue mid) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_right F hleft_nonneg mid
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have hleft_mid_le_joined :
      F.le (F.add leftValue mid)
        (F.add (F.add leftValue mid) rightValue) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hright_nonneg
      (F.add leftValue mid)
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  change F.le a (rudinKernelMass n)
  rw [hmass_eq]
  exact F.le_trans ha_le_mid
    (F.le_trans hmid_le_left_mid hleft_mid_le_joined)

name: rudinKernelScale_pos
statement:
private theorem rudinKernelScale_pos (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (rudinKernelScale n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let radius := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.inv (F.nat n))
  have hn_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat n) := by
    have h := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
    rwa [RealTheory.nat_zero] at h
  have hradius_pos : F.lt F.zero radius := by
    dsimp [radius]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hn_pos)
  have hmass_pos : F.lt F.zero (rudinKernelMass n) :=
    F.lt_of_lt_of_le hradius_pos (half_inv_nat_le_rudinKernelMass n hn)
  unfold rudinKernelScale
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hmass_pos

name: rudinKernelScale_le_two_mul_nat
statement:
private theorem rudinKernelScale_le_two_mul_nat
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.le (rudinKernelScale n)
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (RealTheory.nat n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let nval := F.nat n
  let radius := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.inv nval)
  have hnval_pos : F.lt F.zero nval := by
    dsimp [nval]
    have h := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
    rwa [RealTheory.nat_zero] at h
  have hnval_ne : nval ≠ F.zero := by
    intro hzero
    exact F.ne_of_lt hnval_pos hzero.symm
  have hinv_nval_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv nval) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hnval_pos
  have hradius_pos : F.lt F.zero radius := by
    dsimp [radius]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hinv_nval_pos
  have hmass_pos : F.lt F.zero (rudinKernelMass n) :=
    F.lt_of_lt_of_le hradius_pos (half_inv_nat_le_rudinKernelMass n hn)
  have hinv_order :
      F.le (F.inv (rudinKernelMass n)) (F.inv radius) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos F
      hradius_pos hmass_pos (half_inv_nat_le_rudinKernelMass n hn)
  have htwo_ne : F.two ≠ F.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two_ne_zero F
  have hinv_nval_ne : F.inv nval ≠ F.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F hnval_ne
  have hinv_two_ne : F.inv F.two ≠ F.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F htwo_ne
  have hinv_radius : F.inv radius = F.mul F.two nval := by
    dsimp [radius]
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hinv_nval_ne hinv_two_ne]
    change RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv F.two))
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv nval)) = F.mul F.two nval
    have htwo_inv :
        RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv F.two) = F.two :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_inv_of_ne_zero
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base htwo_ne
    have hnval_inv :
        RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv nval) = nval :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_inv_of_ne_zero
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hnval_ne
    rw [htwo_inv, hnval_inv]
    rfl
  change F.le (F.inv (rudinKernelMass n)) (F.mul (F.nat 2) nval)
  rw [show F.nat 2 = F.two by
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two
    rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, F.nat_add, F.nat_one]]
  rwa [hinv_radius] at hinv_order

name: rudinKernel_nonneg
statement:
private theorem rudinKernel_nonneg
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) {t : RealFunction.Point}
    (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval
      (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) RealTheory.one t) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (rudinKernel n t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold rudinKernel
  exact F.mul_nonneg
    (F.le_of_lt (rudinKernelScale_pos n hn))
    (rudinKernelBase_nonneg_on_unit n ht)

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_rudinKernel_one
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_rudinKernel_one
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (rudinKernel n)
      (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) RealTheory.one
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hneg_one_le_one : F.le (F.neg F.one) F.one := by
    have hzero_le_one : F.le F.zero F.one := F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one
    have hneg_one_le_zero := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hzero_le_one
    rw [F.neg_zero] at hneg_one_le_zero
    exact F.le_trans hneg_one_le_zero hzero_le_one
  have hneg_one_lt_one : F.lt (F.neg F.one) F.one := by
    have hneg_one_le_zero : F.le (F.neg F.one) F.zero := by
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F
        (F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one)
      rwa [F.neg_zero] at h
    exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hneg_one_le_zero F.zero_lt_one
  have hbase_bdd :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded
        (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg F.one) F.one :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hneg_one_le_one
      (continuousOn_rudinKernelBase
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.neg F.one) F.one) n)
  have hbase_darboux :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
        (rudinKernelBase n) (F.neg F.one) F.one
        (rudinKernelMass n) := by
    cases hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_rudinKernelBase_mass n with
    | inl hleft => exact hleft.right.right
    | inr hright =>
        cases hright with
        | intro J hJ =>
            exact False.elim ((F.not_le_of_lt hneg_one_lt_one) hJ.left)
  have hscaled :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_left_of_le
      (rudinKernelScale n) hneg_one_le_one hbase_bdd hbase_darboux
  let radius := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.inv (F.nat n))
  have hn_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat n) := by
    have h := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
    rwa [RealTheory.nat_zero] at h
  have hradius_pos : F.lt F.zero radius := by
    dsimp [radius]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hn_pos)
  have hmass_pos : F.lt F.zero (rudinKernelMass n) :=
    F.lt_of_lt_of_le hradius_pos (half_inv_nat_le_rudinKernelMass n hn)
  have hmass_ne : rudinKernelMass n ≠ F.zero := by
    intro hmass_zero
    exact F.ne_of_lt hmass_pos hmass_zero.symm
  have hnormalize :
      F.mul (rudinKernelScale n) (rudinKernelMass n) = F.one := by
    unfold rudinKernelScale
    exact F.inv_mul_cancel hmass_ne
  unfold rudinKernel
  change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
    (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
      F.mul (rudinKernelScale n) (rudinKernelBase n t))
    (F.neg F.one) F.one F.one
  change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
    (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
      F.mul (rudinKernelScale n) (rudinKernelBase n t))
    (F.neg F.one) F.one
    (F.mul (rudinKernelScale n) (rudinKernelMass n)) at hscaled
  rw [hnormalize] at hscaled
  exact hscaled

name: rudinKernel_le_two_mul_nat_mul_powNat_tail
statement:
private theorem rudinKernel_le_two_mul_nat_mul_powNat_tail
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n)
    {delta t : RealFunction.Point}
    (hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
    (hdelta_le_one : RealTheory.le delta RealTheory.one)
    (hdelta_le_abs : RealTheory.le delta (RealTheory.abs t))
    (habs_le_one : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs t) RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.le
      (rudinKernel n t)
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (RealTheory.nat n))
        (RealFunction.powNat
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealFunction.powNat delta 2))
          n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hdelta_nonneg : F.le F.zero delta := F.le_of_lt hdelta_pos
  have habs_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.abs t) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_nonneg F t
  have habs_square_eq :
      RealFunction.powNat (F.abs t) 2 =
        RealFunction.powNat t 2 := by
    cases F.le_total F.zero t with
    | inl ht_nonneg =>
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F ht_nonneg]
    | inr ht_nonpos =>
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F ht_nonpos,
          RealFunction.powNat_two, RealFunction.powNat_two]
        change F.mul (F.neg t) (F.neg t) = F.mul t t
        exact F.neg_mul_neg t t
  have hdelta_square_le_t_square :
      F.le (RealFunction.powNat delta 2)
        (RealFunction.powNat t 2) := by
    have h := RealFunction.powNat_mono_nonneg
      hdelta_nonneg hdelta_le_abs 2
    change F.le (RealFunction.powNat delta 2)
      (RealFunction.powNat (F.abs t) 2) at h
    rwa [habs_square_eq] at h
  have ht_square_le_one :
      F.le (RealFunction.powNat t 2) F.one := by
    have h := RealFunction.powNat_mono_nonneg
      habs_nonneg habs_le_one 2
    rw [habs_square_eq, RealFunction.powNat_one_base] at h
    exact h
  have hdelta_square_le_one :
      F.le (RealFunction.powNat delta 2) F.one := by
    have h := RealFunction.powNat_mono_nonneg
      hdelta_nonneg hdelta_le_one 2
    rwa [RealFunction.powNat_one_base] at h
  have ht_base_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero
        (F.sub F.one (RealFunction.powNat t 2)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F ht_square_le_one
  have hdelta_base_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero
        (F.sub F.one (RealFunction.powNat delta 2)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hdelta_square_le_one
  have hbase_le :
      F.le
        (F.sub F.one (RealFunction.powNat t 2))
        (F.sub F.one (RealFunction.powNat delta 2)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
      (F.le_refl F.one) hdelta_square_le_t_square
  have hpow_le := RealFunction.powNat_mono_nonneg
    ht_base_nonneg hbase_le n
  have ht_pow_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero
        (RealFunction.powNat
          (F.sub F.one (RealFunction.powNat t 2)) n) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_nonneg ht_base_nonneg n
  have htwo_nat_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat n)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg (F.nat_nonneg 2) (F.nat_nonneg n)
  have hscale_le :
      F.le (rudinKernelScale n) (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat n)) :=
    rudinKernelScale_le_two_mul_nat n hn
  have hscale_bound := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F
    hscale_le ht_pow_nonneg
  have htail_bound := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F
    hpow_le htwo_nat_nonneg
  unfold rudinKernel rudinKernelBase
  exact F.le_trans hscale_bound htail_bound

name: exists_rudinKernel_tail_budget
statement:
private theorem exists_rudinKernel_tail_budget
    {epsilon delta M : RealFunction.Point}
    (hepsilon : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero epsilon)
    (hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
    (hdelta_le_one : RealTheory.le delta RealTheory.one)
    (hM_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M) :
    Exists fun n : Nat =>
      And (0 < n)
        (RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 4) M)
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (RealTheory.nat n)))
            (RealFunction.powNat
              (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                (RealFunction.powNat delta 2))
              n))
          (RealTheory.mul epsilon
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := F.sub F.one (RealFunction.powNat delta 2)
  have hdelta_nonneg : F.le F.zero delta := F.le_of_lt hdelta_pos
  have hdelta_square_le_one :
      F.le (RealFunction.powNat delta 2) F.one := by
    have h := RealFunction.powNat_mono_nonneg
      hdelta_nonneg hdelta_le_one 2
    rwa [RealFunction.powNat_one_base] at h
  have hq_nonneg : F.le F.zero q := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hdelta_square_le_one
  have hdelta_square_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.powNat delta 2) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_pos hdelta_pos 2
  have hq_lt_one : F.lt q F.one := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hdelta_square_pos
  have hfour_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.nat 4) := F.nat_nonneg 4
  have htwo_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.nat 2) := F.nat_nonneg 2
  have hA_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 4) M) (F.nat 2)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg
      (F.mul_nonneg hfour_nonneg (F.le_of_lt hM_pos)) htwo_nonneg
  have htwo_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat 2) := by
    have h := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt (show 0 < 2 by omega)
    rwa [RealTheory.nat_zero] at h
  have hhalf_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.mul epsilon (F.inv (F.nat 2))) :=
    F.mul_pos hepsilon (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F htwo_pos)
  rcases exists_pos_nat_mul_powNat_lt_of_unitInterval
      (q := q)
      (A := F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 4) M) (F.nat 2))
      (epsilon := F.mul epsilon (F.inv (F.nat 2)))
      hq_nonneg hq_lt_one hA_nonneg hhalf_pos with
    ⟨n, hn, hstrong⟩
  refine ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
  have hcoefficient :
      F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 4) M) (F.nat 2))
          (F.nat n) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (F.nat 4) M)
          (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat n)) :=
    F.mul_assoc _ _ _
  change F.lt
    (F.mul
      (F.mul
        (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 4) M) (F.nat 2)) (F.nat n))
      (RealFunction.powNat q n))
    (F.mul epsilon (F.inv (F.nat 2))) at hstrong
  rw [hcoefficient] at hstrong
  dsimp [q] at hstrong
  exact hstrong

name: rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff_eq_zero_of_two_mul_lt
statement:
private theorem rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff_eq_zero_of_two_mul_lt
    (t : RealFunction.Point) (n k : Nat) (hk : 2 * n < k) :
    rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n k = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero =>
      cases k with
      | zero => omega
      | succ k => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      cases k with
      | zero => omega
      | succ k =>
          cases k with
          | zero => omega
          | succ j =>
              have hnext : 2 * n < j + 2 := by omega
              have hcurrent : 2 * n < j + 1 := by omega
              have hprevious : 2 * n < j := by omega
              rw [rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff, ih (j + 2) hnext,
                ih (j + 1) hcurrent, ih j hprevious,
                RealTheory.mul_zero, RealTheory.mul_zero,
                RealTheory.neg_zero, RealTheory.add_zero]
              exact RealTheory.add_zero RealTheory.zero

name: continuousOn_rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff
    (E : RealFunction.Domain) (n k : Nat) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
      (fun t : RealFunction.Point => rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n k)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero =>
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          change RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
            (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.one)
          exact RealFunction.continuousOn_const
      | succ k =>
          change RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
            (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.zero)
          exact RealFunction.continuousOn_const
  | succ n ih =>
      have ha :
          RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
            (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
              RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealFunction.powNat t 2)) := by
        change RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
          (RealFunction.SubFun (fun _ => RealTheory.one)
            (RealFunction.PowerFun 2))
        exact RealFunction.continuousOn_sub
          RealFunction.continuousOn_const
          (RealFunction.continuousOn_powerFun 2)
      have hb :
          RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
            (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
              RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) t) := by
        change RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
          (RealFunction.MulFun (fun _ => RealTheory.nat 2)
            RealFunction.IdentityFun)
        exact RealFunction.continuousOn_mul
          RealFunction.continuousOn_const
          RealFunction.continuousOn_identity
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          change RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
            (RealFunction.MulFun
              (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
                RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealFunction.powNat t 2))
              (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
