                rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0))
          exact RealFunction.continuousOn_mul ha (ih 0)
      | succ k =>
          cases k with
          | zero =>
              change RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
                (RealFunction.AddFun
                  (RealFunction.AddFun
                    (RealFunction.MulFun
                      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
                        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                          (RealFunction.powNat t 2))
                      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
                        rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 1))
                    (RealFunction.MulFun
                      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
                        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) t)
                      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
                        rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0)))
                  (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.zero))
              exact RealFunction.continuousOn_add
                (RealFunction.continuousOn_add
                  (RealFunction.continuousOn_mul ha (ih 1))
                  (RealFunction.continuousOn_mul hb (ih 0)))
                RealFunction.continuousOn_const
          | succ j =>
              change RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
                (RealFunction.AddFun
                  (RealFunction.AddFun
                    (RealFunction.MulFun
                      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
                        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                          (RealFunction.powNat t 2))
                      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
                        rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n (j + 2)))
                    (RealFunction.MulFun
                      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
                        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) t)
                      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
                        rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n (j + 1))))
                  (RealFunction.NegFun
                    (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
                      rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n j)))
              exact RealFunction.continuousOn_add
                (RealFunction.continuousOn_add
                  (RealFunction.continuousOn_mul ha (ih (j + 2)))
                  (RealFunction.continuousOn_mul hb (ih (j + 1))))
                (RealFunction.continuousOn_neg (ih j))

name: powNat_one_sub_powNat_sub_eq_polySum_rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff
statement:
private theorem powNat_one_sub_powNat_sub_eq_polySum_rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff
    (t x : RealFunction.Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealFunction.powNat
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub t x) 2))
        n =
      RealFunction.polySum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n k)
            (RealFunction.powNat x k))
        (2 * n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ, RealFunction.polySum_zero,
        rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff, RealFunction.powNat_zero,
        RealTheory.zero_add, RealTheory.mul_one]
  | succ n ih =>
      let a := RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealFunction.powNat t 2)
      let b := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) t
      let oldTerm := fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n k)
          (RealFunction.powNat x k)
      let newTerm := fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t (n + 1) k)
          (RealFunction.powNat x k)
      have hneg_add (u v : RealFunction.Point) :
          RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.add u v) =
            RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg u) (RealTheory.neg v) := by
        let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        change F.neg (F.add u v) = F.add (F.neg u) (F.neg v)
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F u v
      have hquadratic :
          RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
              (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub t x) 2) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add a (RealTheory.mul b x))
              (RealTheory.neg (RealFunction.powNat x 2)) := by
        have htwo_mul (z : RealFunction.Point) :
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) z =
              RealTheory.add z z := by
          let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          change F.mul (F.nat 2) z = F.add z z
          rw [show F.nat 2 = F.add F.one F.one by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ F 1]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ F 0]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero F]
            rw [F.zero_add]]
          rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
        dsimp [a, b]
        rw [RealFunction.powNat_two (RealTheory.sub t x),
          RealFunction.powNat_two t, RealFunction.powNat_two x,
          RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg, RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg,
          RealTheory.add_mul, RealTheory.mul_add, RealTheory.mul_add,
          RealTheory.mul_neg, RealTheory.neg_mul,
          RealTheory.neg_mul_neg, hneg_add, hneg_add, hneg_add,
          RealTheory.neg_neg, htwo_mul t,
          RealTheory.add_mul, RealTheory.mul_comm x t]
        simp only [RealTheory.neg_neg, RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
        let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        change F.add F.one
            (F.add
              (F.add (F.neg (F.mul t t)) (F.mul t x))
              (F.add (F.mul t x) (F.neg (F.mul x x)))) =
          F.add
            (F.add
              (F.add F.one (F.neg (F.mul t t)))
            (F.add (F.mul t x) (F.mul t x)))
            (F.neg (F.mul x x))
        simp only [F.add_assoc]
      have hsum : forall m : Nat,
          RealFunction.polySum newTerm (m + 2) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.mul a
                  (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (m + 2)))
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b x)
                  (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (m + 1))))
              (RealTheory.neg
                (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
                  (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm m))) := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero =>
            change RealFunction.polySum newTerm 2 =
              RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.mul a
                    (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm 2))
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b x)
                    (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm 1)))
                (RealTheory.neg
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
                    (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm 0)))
            rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ newTerm 1,
              RealFunction.polySum_succ newTerm 0,
              RealFunction.polySum_zero newTerm,
              RealFunction.polySum_succ oldTerm 1,
              RealFunction.polySum_succ oldTerm 0,
              RealFunction.polySum_zero oldTerm]
            dsimp only [newTerm, oldTerm]
            rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero, RealFunction.powNat_one]
            change RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.mul a
                      (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0))
                    RealTheory.one))
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.mul a
                        (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 1))
                      (RealTheory.mul b
                        (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0)))
                    RealTheory.zero)
                  x) =
              RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.mul a
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
                        (RealTheory.mul
                          (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0)
                          RealTheory.one))
                      (RealTheory.mul
                        (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 1) x)))
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b x)
                    (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
                      (RealTheory.mul
                        (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0)
                        RealTheory.one))))
                (RealTheory.neg
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
                    RealTheory.zero))
            simp only [RealTheory.mul_one, RealTheory.mul_zero,
              RealTheory.zero_add, RealTheory.add_zero,
              RealTheory.neg_zero, RealTheory.mul_add,
              RealTheory.add_mul]
            let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            change F.add
                (F.mul a (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0))
                (F.add
                  (F.mul (F.mul a
                    (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 1)) x)
                  (F.mul (F.mul b
                    (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0)) x)) =
              F.add
                (F.add
                  (F.mul a (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0))
                  (F.mul a
                    (F.mul (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 1) x)))
                (F.mul (F.mul b x)
                  (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0))
            have hbc :
                F.mul (F.mul b (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0)) x =
                  F.mul (F.mul b x)
                    (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0) := by
              rw [F.mul_assoc b (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0) x,
                F.mul_assoc b x (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0),
                F.mul_comm (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 0) x]
            rw [F.mul_assoc a (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n 1) x,
              hbc, F.add_assoc]
        | succ m ihsum =>
            have hshift_one (c : RealFunction.Point) :
                RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b x)
                    (RealTheory.mul c
                      (RealFunction.powNat x (m + 1))) =
                  RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b c)
                    (RealFunction.powNat x (m + 2)) := by
              calc
                RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b x)
                    (RealTheory.mul c
                      (RealFunction.powNat x (m + 1))) =
                    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b x)
                      (RealTheory.mul c
                        (RealTheory.mul
                          (RealFunction.powNat x m) x)) := by
                          rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ x m]
                _ = RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b c)
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m)
                      (RealFunction.powNat x 2)) := by
                        rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
                        let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                        change F.mul (F.mul b x)
                            (F.mul c
                              (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m) x)) =
                          F.mul (F.mul b c)
                            (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m)
                              (F.mul x x))
                        have hswap (u v w : RealFunction.Point) :
                            F.mul u (F.mul v w) =
                              F.mul v (F.mul u w) := by
                          rw [← F.mul_assoc, F.mul_comm u v,
                            F.mul_assoc]
                        calc
                          F.mul (F.mul b x)
                              (F.mul c
                                (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m) x)) =
                              F.mul b
                                (F.mul x
                                  (F.mul c
                                    (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m) x))) :=
                            F.mul_assoc b x _
                          _ = F.mul b
                              (F.mul c
                                (F.mul x
                                  (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m) x))) := by
                            rw [hswap x c]
                          _ = F.mul b
                              (F.mul c
                                (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m)
                                  (F.mul x x))) := by
                            rw [hswap x
                              (RealFunction.powNat x m)]
                          _ = F.mul (F.mul b c)
                              (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m)
                                (F.mul x x)) :=
                            (F.mul_assoc b c _).symm
                _ = RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b c)
                    (RealFunction.powNat x (m + 2)) := by
                      rw [RealFunction.powNat_add x m 2]
            have hshift_two (c : RealFunction.Point) :
                RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
                    (RealTheory.mul c (RealFunction.powNat x m)) =
                  RealTheory.mul c
                    (RealFunction.powNat x (m + 2)) := by
              calc
                RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
                    (RealTheory.mul c (RealFunction.powNat x m)) =
                    RealTheory.mul c
                      (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m)
                        (RealFunction.powNat x 2)) := by
                          let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                          change F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
                              (F.mul c (RealFunction.powNat x m)) =
                            F.mul c
                              (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m)
                                (RealFunction.powNat x 2))
                          have hswap (u v w : RealFunction.Point) :
                              F.mul u (F.mul v w) =
                                F.mul v (F.mul u w) := by
                            rw [← F.mul_assoc, F.mul_comm u v,
                              F.mul_assoc]
                          calc
                            F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
                                (F.mul c (RealFunction.powNat x m)) =
                                F.mul c
                                  (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
                                    (RealFunction.powNat x m)) :=
                              hswap _ _ _
                            _ = F.mul c
                                (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m)
                                  (RealFunction.powNat x 2)) := by
                              rw [F.mul_comm (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
                                (RealFunction.powNat x m)]
                _ = RealTheory.mul c
                    (RealFunction.powNat x (m + 2)) := by
                      rw [RealFunction.powNat_add x m 2]
            change RealTheory.add
                (RealFunction.polySum newTerm (m + 2))
                (newTerm (m + 2)) =
              RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.mul a
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (m + 2))
                      (oldTerm (m + 2))))
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b x)
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (m + 1))
                      (oldTerm (m + 1)))))
                (RealTheory.neg
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm m)
                      (oldTerm m))))
            rw [ihsum]
            dsimp only [newTerm, oldTerm]
            rw [show m + 2 = (m + 1) + 1 by omega,
              rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff]
            rw [show RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
                  (RealFunction.powNat t 2) = a by rfl,
              show RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) t = b by rfl]
            rw [
              RealTheory.mul_add, RealTheory.mul_add,
              RealTheory.mul_add,
              hneg_add, RealTheory.add_mul,
              RealTheory.add_mul, RealTheory.neg_mul,
              hshift_one, hshift_two]
            rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc a
              (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n (m + 2))
              (RealFunction.powNat x (m + 2))]
            have hm_two : m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 := by omega
            have hm_succ : m.succ = m + 1 := by omega
            rw [hm_two, hm_succ]
            let A := RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.mul (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n m)
                (RealFunction.powNat x (m + 2)))
            let B := RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul b
                (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n (m + 1)))
              (RealFunction.powNat x (m + 2))
            let C := RealTheory.mul a
              (RealTheory.mul
                (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n (m + 2))
                (RealFunction.powNat x (m + 2)))
            let D := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b x)
              (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (m + 1))
            let E := RealTheory.mul a
              (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (m + 2))
            let G := RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
                (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm m))
            let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            change F.add (F.add (F.add E D) G)
                (F.add (F.add C B) A) =
              F.add (F.add (F.add E C) (F.add D B))
                (F.add G A)
            simp only [F.add_assoc, F.add_comm]
            have hswap_add (u v w : RealFunction.Point) :
                F.add u (F.add v w) = F.add v (F.add u w) := by
              rw [← F.add_assoc, F.add_comm u v, F.add_assoc]
            rw [hswap_add A C, hswap_add B C,
              hswap_add E C, hswap_add D C,
              hswap_add D E, hswap_add D B]
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ, ih]
      change RealTheory.mul
          (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (2 * n + 1))
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub t x) 2)) =
        RealFunction.polySum newTerm (2 * (n + 1) + 1)
      rw [hquadratic]
      change RealTheory.mul
          (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (2 * n + 1))
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add a (RealTheory.mul b x))
            (RealTheory.neg (RealFunction.powNat x 2))) =
        RealFunction.polySum newTerm (2 * (n + 1) + 1)
      rw [show 2 * (n + 1) + 1 = (2 * n + 1) + 2 by omega,
        hsum (2 * n + 1)]
      have hfar :
          rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n (2 * n + 2) =
            RealTheory.zero :=
        rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff_eq_zero_of_two_mul_lt
          t n (2 * n + 2) (by omega)
      have hnext :
          rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n (2 * n + 1) =
            RealTheory.zero :=
        rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff_eq_zero_of_two_mul_lt
          t n (2 * n + 1) (by omega)
      change RealTheory.mul
          (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (2 * n + 1))
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add a (RealTheory.mul b x))
            (RealTheory.neg (RealFunction.powNat x 2))) =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul a
              (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm ((2 * n + 1) + 2)))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b x)
              (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm ((2 * n + 1) + 1))))
          (RealTheory.neg
            (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x 2)
              (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (2 * n + 1))))
      rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ oldTerm (2 * n + 2),
        RealFunction.polySum_succ oldTerm (2 * n + 1)]
      dsimp only [oldTerm]
      rw [hfar, hnext]
      simp only [RealTheory.zero_mul, RealTheory.add_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.mul_add, RealTheory.mul_add, RealTheory.mul_neg]
      simp only [RealTheory.mul_comm, RealTheory.add_assoc]

name: rudinConvolutionCoefficientIntegrable
statement:
private theorem rudinConvolutionCoefficientIntegrable
    (g : RealFunction.Map)
    (hg : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one) g)
    (n : Nat) (_hn : 0 < n) (k : Nat) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.OrientedRiemannIntegrableOn
      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (g t) (rudinKernelScale n))
          (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n k))
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hzero_le_one : F.le F.zero F.one := F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one
  have hcontinuous :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one)
        (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (g t) (rudinKernelScale n))
            (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n k)) := by
    change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one)
      (RealFunction.MulFun
        (RealFunction.MulFun g
          (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => rudinKernelScale n))
        (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
          rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n k))
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_mul
      (RealFunction.continuousOn_mul hg
        RealFunction.continuousOn_const)
      (continuousOn_rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one) n k)
  exact RealIntegral.Riemann.orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_of_le_riemannIntegrableOn
    hzero_le_one
    (RealIntegral.Riemann.riemannIntegrableOn_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hzero_le_one hcontinuous)

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_rudinConvolutionPolynomial_eval
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_rudinConvolutionPolynomial_eval
    (g : RealFunction.Map)
    (hg : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one) g)
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (x : RealFunction.Point) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
        RealTheory.mul (g t)
          (rudinKernel n (RealTheory.sub t x)))
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
      ((rudinConvolutionPolynomial g hg n hn).eval x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hzero_le_one : F.le F.zero F.one := F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one
  have hzero_lt_one : F.lt F.zero F.one := F.zero_lt_one
  have orderedData
      {f : RealFunction.Map} {I : RealFunction.Point}
      (hI : RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        f F.zero F.one I) :
      And
        (RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded
          f F.zero F.one)
        (RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
          f F.zero F.one I) := by
    cases hI with
    | inl hforward => exact hforward.right
    | inr hreverse =>
        cases hreverse with
        | intro J hJ =>
            exact False.elim ((F.not_le_of_lt hzero_lt_one) hJ.left)
  have hfinite : forall m : Nat,
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
          RealFunction.polySum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul (g t) (rudinKernelScale n))
                  (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n k))
                (RealFunction.powNat x k))
            m)
        F.zero F.one
        (RealFunction.polySum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (rudinConvolutionCoefficient g hg n hn k)
              (RealFunction.powNat x k))
          m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
          (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => F.zero)
          F.zero F.one F.zero
        exact RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_zero_of_le
          hzero_le_one
    | succ m ih =>
        have hcoefficient :
            RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
              (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul (g t) (rudinKernelScale n))
                  (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n m))
              F.zero F.one
              (rudinConvolutionCoefficient g hg n hn m) := by
          unfold rudinConvolutionCoefficient
          exact RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf
            _
        have hcoefficientData := orderedData hcoefficient
        have hscaled :=
          RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_left_of_le
            (RealFunction.powNat x m) hzero_le_one
            hcoefficientData.left hcoefficientData.right
        have hintegrand_comm :
            (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
              RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m)
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul (g t) (rudinKernelScale n))
                  (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n m))) =
              (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.mul (g t) (rudinKernelScale n))
                    (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n m))
                  (RealFunction.powNat x m)) := by
          funext t
          exact RealTheory.mul_comm _ _
        have hvalue_comm :
            RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m)
                (rudinConvolutionCoefficient g hg n hn m) =
              RealTheory.mul
                (rudinConvolutionCoefficient g hg n hn m)
                (RealFunction.powNat x m) :=
          RealTheory.mul_comm _ _
        rw [hintegrand_comm, hvalue_comm] at hscaled
        have ihData := orderedData ih
        have hscaledData := orderedData hscaled
        have hadd :=
          RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_add_of_le
            hzero_le_one ihData.left ihData.right
            hscaledData.left hscaledData.right
        change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
          (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
            RealTheory.add
              (RealFunction.polySum
                (fun k : Nat =>
                  RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.mul (g t) (rudinKernelScale n))
                      (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n k))
                    (RealFunction.powNat x k))
                m)
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul (g t) (rudinKernelScale n))
                  (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n m))
                (RealFunction.powNat x m)))
          F.zero F.one
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealFunction.polySum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                RealTheory.mul
                  (rudinConvolutionCoefficient g hg n hn k)
                  (RealFunction.powNat x k))
              m)
            (RealTheory.mul
              (rudinConvolutionCoefficient g hg n hn m)
              (RealFunction.powNat x m)))
        exact hadd
  have hmul_polySum
      (c : RealFunction.Point) (term : Nat -> RealFunction.Point) :
      forall m : Nat,
        RealTheory.mul c (RealFunction.polySum term m) =
          RealFunction.polySum
            (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul c (term k)) m := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_zero, RealFunction.polySum_zero,
          RealTheory.mul_zero]
    | succ m ih =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ, RealTheory.mul_add, ih,
          RealFunction.polySum_succ]
  have hintegrand_eq :
      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
        RealTheory.mul (g t)
          (rudinKernel n (RealTheory.sub t x))) =
        (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
          RealFunction.polySum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul (g t) (rudinKernelScale n))
                  (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n k))
                (RealFunction.powNat x k))
            (2 * n + 1)) := by
    funext t
    unfold rudinKernel rudinKernelBase
    rw [powNat_one_sub_powNat_sub_eq_polySum_rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff]
    rw [← RealTheory.mul_assoc]
    rw [hmul_polySum]
    have hterms :
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (g t) (rudinKernelScale n))
            (RealTheory.mul (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n k)
              (RealFunction.powNat x k))) =
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul (g t) (rudinKernelScale n))
                (rudinQuadraticPowerCoeff t n k))
              (RealFunction.powNat x k)) := by
      funext k
      exact (RealTheory.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    rw [hterms]
  rw [hintegrand_eq]
  unfold rudinConvolutionPolynomial RealFunction.Polynomial.eval
  exact hfinite (2 * n + 1)

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_rudinShiftedConvolution
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_rudinShiftedConvolution
    (g : RealFunction.Map)
    (hg : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one) g)
    (hg0 : g RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero)
    (hg1 : g RealTheory.one = RealTheory.zero)
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n)
    (x : RealFunction.Point)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one x) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (unitZeroExtension g (RealTheory.add x t))
          (rudinKernel n t))
      (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) RealTheory.one
      ((rudinConvolutionPolynomial g hg n hn).eval x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change g F.zero = F.zero at hg0
  change g F.one = F.zero at hg1
  let all : RealFunction.Domain := fun _ : RealFunction.Point => True
  let target : RealFunction.Map := fun u : RealFunction.Point =>
    F.mul (unitZeroExtension g u)
      (rudinKernel n (F.sub u x))
  let phi : RealFunction.Map := fun t : RealFunction.Point => F.add x t
  let phi' : RealFunction.Map := fun _ : RealFunction.Point => F.one
  have hzero_le_one : F.le F.zero F.one := F.le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one
  have hneg_one_le_zero : F.le (F.neg F.one) F.zero := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hzero_le_one
    rwa [F.neg_zero] at h
  have hneg_one_le_one : F.le (F.neg F.one) F.one :=
    F.le_trans hneg_one_le_zero hzero_le_one
  have hx_sub_one_le_zero : F.le (F.sub x F.one) F.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hx.right
  have hone_le_x_add_one : F.le F.one (F.add x F.one) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_right F hx.left F.one
    change F.le (F.add F.zero F.one) (F.add x F.one) at h
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have htarget_order : F.le (F.sub x F.one) (F.add x F.one) :=
    F.le_trans hx_sub_one_le_zero
      (F.le_trans hzero_le_one hone_le_x_add_one)
  have hhat_cont_all : RealFunction.ContinuousOn all (unitZeroExtension g) :=
    RealFunction.uniformContinuousOn_to_continuousOn
      (uniformContinuousOn_unitZeroExtension hg hg0 hg1)
  have hshift_cont_all :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn all
        (fun u : RealFunction.Point => F.sub u x) := by
    change RealFunction.ContinuousOn all
      (RealFunction.SubFun RealFunction.IdentityFun
        (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => x))
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_sub
      RealFunction.continuousOn_identity RealFunction.continuousOn_const
  have hkernel_shift_cont_all :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn all
        (fun u : RealFunction.Point => rudinKernel n (F.sub u x)) := by
    unfold rudinKernel
    change RealFunction.ContinuousOn all
      (RealFunction.MulFun
        (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => rudinKernelScale n)
        (RealFunction.CompFun (rudinKernelBase n)
          (fun u : RealFunction.Point => F.sub u x)))
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_mul RealFunction.continuousOn_const
      (RealFunction.continuousOn_comp hshift_cont_all
        (continuousOn_rudinKernelBase all n)
        (fun _ _ => True.intro))
  have htarget_cont_all : RealFunction.ContinuousOn all target := by
    unfold target
    change RealFunction.ContinuousOn all
      (RealFunction.MulFun (unitZeroExtension g)
        (fun u : RealFunction.Point => rudinKernel n (F.sub u x)))
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_mul
      hhat_cont_all hkernel_shift_cont_all
  have targetContinuousOn (a b : RealFunction.Point) :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) target :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun _ _ => True.intro) htarget_cont_all
  have hasRiemannIntegral_congr_closed
      {f h : RealFunction.Map} {a b I : RealFunction.Point}
      (hfh : forall z : RealFunction.Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z -> f z = h z)
      (hf : RealIntegral.Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral h a b I := by
    refine And.intro hf.left ?_
    intro epsilon hepsilon
    cases hf.right epsilon hepsilon with
    | intro delta hdelta =>
        refine Exists.intro delta (And.intro hdelta.left ?_)
        intro m p tag htag hmesh
        have hsum_le :=
          RealIntegral.Riemann.taggedSum_le_of_pointwise_le
            (f := f) (g := h) htag
            (fun z hz => by
              rw [hfh z hz]
              exact F.le_refl (h z))
        have hsum_ge :=
          RealIntegral.Riemann.taggedSum_le_of_pointwise_le
            (f := h) (g := f) htag
            (fun z hz => by
              rw [hfh z hz]
              exact F.le_refl (h z))
        have hsum_eq :
            RealIntegral.Riemann.taggedSum f p tag m =
              RealIntegral.Riemann.taggedSum h p tag m :=
          F.le_antisymm hsum_le hsum_ge
        rw [<- hsum_eq]
        exact hdelta.right m p tag htag hmesh
  have hphi_cont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.neg F.one) F.one) phi := by
    unfold phi
    change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.neg F.one) F.one)
      (RealFunction.AddFun (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => x)
        RealFunction.IdentityFun)
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_add
      RealFunction.continuousOn_const RealFunction.continuousOn_identity
  have hphi'_cont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.neg F.one) F.one) phi' := by
    unfold phi'
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_const
  have hphi_derivative :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval (F.neg F.one) F.one) phi phi' := by
    have hraw := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_add
      (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_const
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval (F.neg F.one) F.one) x)
      (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_id
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval (F.neg F.one) F.one))
    have hderivative_eq :
        RealFunction.AddFun
            (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => F.zero)
            (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => F.one) =
          (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => F.one) := by
      funext t
      exact F.zero_add F.one
    unfold phi phi'
    rw [<- hderivative_eq]
    exact hraw
  have hmaps_closed :
      RealFunction.MapsInto
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.neg F.one) F.one)
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.sub x F.one) (F.add x F.one))
        phi := by
    intro t ht
    unfold phi
    have hleft := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F ht.left x
    have hright := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F ht.right x
    rw [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg] at hleft
    exact And.intro hleft hright
  have hmaps_open :
      RealFunction.MapsInto
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval (F.neg F.one) F.one)
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval (F.sub x F.one) (F.add x F.one))
        phi := by
    intro t ht
    unfold phi
    have hleft := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F ht.left x
    have hright := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F ht.right x
    rw [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg] at hleft
    exact And.intro hleft hright
  let data : RealIntegral.Riemann.C1SubstitutionData
      target phi phi'
      (F.neg F.one) F.one (F.sub x F.one) (F.add x F.one) :=
    { domain_order := hneg_one_le_one
      target_order := htarget_order
      f_continuous := targetContinuousOn (F.sub x F.one) (F.add x F.one)
      phi_continuous := hphi_cont
      derivative_continuous := hphi'_cont
      phi_derivative := hphi_derivative
      maps_closed := hmaps_closed
      maps_open := hmaps_open }
  have hsubstitution :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_c1_ordered
      data
  have hsource := hsubstitution.left
  have htarget := hsubstitution.right
  have hsource_integrand :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.substitutionIntegrand target phi phi' =
        (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
          F.mul (unitZeroExtension g (F.add x t)) (rudinKernel n t)) := by
    funext t
    unfold RealIntegral.Riemann.substitutionIntegrand target phi phi'
    change F.mul
      (F.mul (unitZeroExtension g (F.add x t))
        (rudinKernel n (F.sub (F.add x t) x))) F.one =
      F.mul (unitZeroExtension g (F.add x t)) (rudinKernel n t)
    rw [F.mul_one]
    have hcancel : F.sub (F.add x t) x = t := by
      rw [F.add_comm x t]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F t x
    rw [hcancel]
  rw [hsource_integrand] at hsource
  change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
    target (F.add x (F.neg F.one)) (F.add x F.one) data.value at htarget
  rw [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg] at htarget
  have hpoly :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_rudinConvolutionPolynomial_eval
      g hg n hn x
  have hpoly_data :
      And
        (RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded
          (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
            F.mul (g t) (rudinKernel n (F.sub t x))) F.zero F.one)
        (RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
          (fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
            F.mul (g t) (rudinKernel n (F.sub t x))) F.zero F.one
          ((rudinConvolutionPolynomial g hg n hn).eval x)) := by
    cases hpoly with
    | inl hforward => exact hforward.right
    | inr hreverse =>
        cases hreverse with
        | intro J hJ =>
            exact False.elim ((F.not_le_of_lt F.zero_lt_one) hJ.left)
  have hcentral_eq
      (t : RealFunction.Point)
      (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero F.one t) :
      (fun u : RealFunction.Point =>
        F.mul (g u) (rudinKernel n (F.sub u x))) t = target t := by
    unfold target
    rw [unitZeroExtension_eq_on g ht]
  have hcentral_riemann :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral target F.zero F.one
        ((rudinConvolutionPolynomial g hg n hn).eval x) :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_congr_closed hcentral_eq
      (RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
        hpoly_data.left hpoly_data.right)
  have hcentral_darboux :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral target F.zero F.one
        ((rudinConvolutionPolynomial g hg n hn).eval x) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral
      hzero_le_one hcentral_riemann
  have hleft_eq
      (t : RealFunction.Point)
      (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.sub x F.one) F.zero t) :
      (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => F.zero) t = target t := by
    have ht_le_zero : F.le t F.zero := ht.right
    have hhat_zero : unitZeroExtension g t = F.zero := by
      by_cases ht_unit : RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero F.one t
      · have ht_eq_zero : t = F.zero := F.le_antisymm ht_le_zero ht_unit.left
        rw [unitZeroExtension_eq_on g ht_unit, ht_eq_zero, hg0]
      · exact unitZeroExtension_eq_zero_off g ht_unit
    unfold target
    change F.zero = F.mul (unitZeroExtension g t)
      (rudinKernel n (F.sub t x))
    rw [hhat_zero, F.zero_mul]
  have hright_eq
      (t : RealFunction.Point)
      (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.one (F.add x F.one) t) :
      (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => F.zero) t = target t := by
    have hone_le_t : F.le F.one t := ht.left
    have hhat_zero : unitZeroExtension g t = F.zero := by
      by_cases ht_unit : RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero F.one t
      · have ht_eq_one : t = F.one := F.le_antisymm ht_unit.right hone_le_t
        rw [unitZeroExtension_eq_on g ht_unit, ht_eq_one, hg1]
      · exact unitZeroExtension_eq_zero_off g ht_unit
    unfold target
    change F.zero = F.mul (unitZeroExtension g t)
      (rudinKernel n (F.sub t x))
    rw [hhat_zero, F.zero_mul]
  have hleft_riemann :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral target
        (F.sub x F.one) F.zero F.zero :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_congr_closed hleft_eq
      (RealIntegral.Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_zero_of_le
        (F.sub x F.one) F.zero hx_sub_one_le_zero)
  have hright_riemann :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral target
        F.one (F.add x F.one) F.zero :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_congr_closed hright_eq
      (RealIntegral.Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_zero_of_le
        F.one (F.add x F.one) hone_le_x_add_one)
  have hleft_darboux :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral target
        (F.sub x F.one) F.zero F.zero :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral
      hx_sub_one_le_zero hleft_riemann
  have hright_darboux :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral target
        F.one (F.add x F.one) F.zero :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral
      hone_le_x_add_one hright_riemann
  have hleft_bdd :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded target
        (F.sub x F.one) F.zero :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hx_sub_one_le_zero (targetContinuousOn (F.sub x F.one) F.zero)
  have hcentral_bdd :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded target F.zero F.one :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hzero_le_one (targetContinuousOn F.zero F.one)
  have hright_bdd :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded target
        F.one (F.add x F.one) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hone_le_x_add_one (targetContinuousOn F.one (F.add x F.one))
  have hleft_central_raw :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_ordered
      hx_sub_one_le_zero hzero_le_one
      hleft_bdd hleft_darboux hcentral_bdd hcentral_darboux
  have hleft_central :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral target
        (F.sub x F.one) F.one
        ((rudinConvolutionPolynomial g hg n hn).eval x) := by
    change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral target
      (F.sub x F.one) F.one
      (F.add F.zero ((rudinConvolutionPolynomial g hg n hn).eval x))
      at hleft_central_raw
    rw [F.zero_add] at hleft_central_raw
    exact hleft_central_raw
  have hleft_central_bdd :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded target
        (F.sub x F.one) F.one :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      (F.le_trans hx_sub_one_le_zero hzero_le_one)
      (targetContinuousOn (F.sub x F.one) F.one)
  have hjoined_raw :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_ordered
      (F.le_trans hx_sub_one_le_zero hzero_le_one) hone_le_x_add_one
      hleft_central_bdd hleft_central hright_bdd hright_darboux
  have hjoined :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral target
        (F.sub x F.one) (F.add x F.one)
        ((rudinConvolutionPolynomial g hg n hn).eval x) := by
    change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral target
      (F.sub x F.one) (F.add x F.one)
      (F.add ((rudinConvolutionPolynomial g hg n hn).eval x) F.zero)
      at hjoined_raw
    rw [F.add_zero] at hjoined_raw
    exact hjoined_raw
  have htotal_bdd :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded target
        (F.sub x F.one) (F.add x F.one) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      htarget_order
      (targetContinuousOn (F.sub x F.one) (F.add x F.one))
  have htarget_darboux :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral target
        (F.sub x F.one) (F.add x F.one) data.value := by
    cases htarget with
    | inl hforward => exact hforward.right.right
    | inr hreverse =>
        cases hreverse with
        | intro J hJ =>
            have htarget_lt : F.lt (F.sub x F.one) (F.add x F.one) := by
              exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hx_sub_one_le_zero
                (F.lt_of_lt_of_le F.zero_lt_one hone_le_x_add_one)
            exact False.elim ((F.not_le_of_lt htarget_lt) hJ.left)
  have hvalue_eq :
      data.value = (rudinConvolutionPolynomial g hg n hn).eval x :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_unique
      (RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
        htotal_bdd htarget_darboux)
      (RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
        htotal_bdd hjoined)
  rw [hvalue_eq] at hsource
  exact hsource

name: abs_darbouxIntegral_le_darbouxIntegral_abs
statement:
private theorem abs_darbouxIntegral_le_darbouxIntegral_abs
    {f : RealFunction.Map} {a b I J : RealFunction.Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hI : RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I)
    (hJ : RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
      (fun t : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.abs (f t)) a b J) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs I) J
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hf_bdd : RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hab hf
  have hneg_cont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (fun t : RealFunction.Point => F.neg (f t)) := by
    change RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (RealFunction.NegFun f)
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_neg hf
  have hneg_bdd :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded
        (fun t : RealFunction.Point => F.neg (f t)) a b :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hab hneg_cont
  have habs_cont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (fun t : RealFunction.Point => F.abs (f t)) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_abs hf
  have habs_bdd :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded
        (fun t : RealFunction.Point => F.abs (f t)) a b :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hab habs_cont
  have hnegI :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasDarbouxIntegral
        (fun t : RealFunction.Point => F.neg (f t))
        a b (F.neg I) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_neg_of_le
      hab hf_bdd hI
  have hupper : F.le I J :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      hab
      (fun t _ => IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_abs_self F (f t))
      hf_bdd hI habs_bdd hJ
  have hneg_lower : F.le (F.neg I) J :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      hab
      (fun t _ => IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_abs_self F (f t))
      hneg_bdd hnegI habs_bdd hJ
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_le_of_bounds F hupper hneg_lower

name: addEndpointAffinePolynomial_eval
statement:
private theorem addEndpointAffinePolynomial_eval
    (P : RealFunction.Polynomial)
    (constant slope x : RealFunction.Point)
    (hP_length : 2 <= P.length) :
    (addEndpointAffinePolynomial P constant slope).eval x =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add (P.eval x) constant)
        (RealTheory.mul slope x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let correction : Nat -> RealFunction.Point := fun k : Nat =>
    match k with
    | 0 => constant
    | 1 => slope
    | _ + 2 => F.zero
  have hpolySum_add
      (u v : Nat -> RealFunction.Point) : forall m : Nat,
      RealFunction.polySum (fun k : Nat => F.add (u k) (v k)) m =
        F.add (RealFunction.polySum u m) (RealFunction.polySum v m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_zero, RealFunction.polySum_zero,
          RealFunction.polySum_zero]
        change F.zero = F.add F.zero F.zero
        rw [F.zero_add]
    | succ m ih =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ, RealFunction.polySum_succ,
          RealFunction.polySum_succ, ih]
        change F.add
          (F.add (RealFunction.polySum u m) (RealFunction.polySum v m))
          (F.add (u m) (v m)) =
          F.add
            (F.add (RealFunction.polySum u m) (u m))
            (F.add (RealFunction.polySum v m) (v m))
        rw [F.add_assoc (RealFunction.polySum u m)
          (RealFunction.polySum v m) (F.add (u m) (v m))]
        rw [<- F.add_assoc (RealFunction.polySum v m) (u m) (v m)]
        rw [F.add_comm (RealFunction.polySum v m) (u m)]
        rw [F.add_assoc (u m) (RealFunction.polySum v m) (v m)]
        rw [<- F.add_assoc (RealFunction.polySum u m) (u m)
          (F.add (RealFunction.polySum v m) (v m))]
  have hcorrection : forall m : Nat,
      RealFunction.polySum
          (fun k : Nat => F.mul (correction k)
            (RealFunction.powNat x k))
          (m + 2) =
        F.add constant (F.mul slope x) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        change RealFunction.polySum
          (fun k : Nat => F.mul (correction k)
            (RealFunction.powNat x k)) 2 =
          F.add constant (F.mul slope x)
        rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, RealFunction.polySum_succ,
          RealFunction.polySum_succ, RealFunction.polySum_zero]
        dsimp [correction]
        change F.add (F.add F.zero
          (F.mul constant (RealFunction.powNat x 0)))
          (F.mul slope (RealFunction.powNat x 1)) =
          F.add constant (F.mul slope x)
        rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero, RealFunction.powNat_one]
        change F.add (F.add F.zero (F.mul constant F.one))
          (F.mul slope x) = F.add constant (F.mul slope x)
        rw [F.mul_one, F.zero_add]
    | succ m ih =>
        rw [show (m + 1) + 2 = (m + 2) + 1 by omega,
          RealFunction.polySum_succ, ih]
        change F.add (F.add constant (F.mul slope x))
          (F.mul F.zero (RealFunction.powNat x (m + 2))) =
          F.add constant (F.mul slope x)
        rw [F.zero_mul, F.add_zero]
  let m := P.length - 2
  have hlength : P.length = m + 2 := by
    dsimp [m]
    omega
  unfold addEndpointAffinePolynomial RealFunction.Polynomial.eval
  change RealFunction.polySum
      (fun k : Nat =>
        F.mul (F.add (P.coeff k) (correction k))
          (RealFunction.powNat x k))
      P.length =
    F.add
      (F.add
        (RealFunction.polySum
          (fun k : Nat => F.mul (P.coeff k) (RealFunction.powNat x k))
          P.length)
        constant)
      (F.mul slope x)
  have hterms :
      (fun k : Nat =>
        F.mul (F.add (P.coeff k) (correction k))
          (RealFunction.powNat x k)) =
      (fun k : Nat =>
        F.add
          (F.mul (P.coeff k) (RealFunction.powNat x k))
          (F.mul (correction k) (RealFunction.powNat x k))) := by
    funext k
    exact F.add_mul (P.coeff k) (correction k)
      (RealFunction.powNat x k)
  rw [hterms, hpolySum_add]
  rw [hlength, hcorrection]
  rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: exists_polynomial_uniformApproximation_unitInterval
statement:
private theorem exists_polynomial_uniformApproximation_unitInterval
    {f : RealFunction.Map} {epsilon : RealFunction.Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one) f)
    (hepsilon : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero epsilon) :
    Exists fun P : RealFunction.Polynomial =>
      forall x : RealFunction.Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one x ->
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (P.eval x))) epsilon
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let all : RealFunction.Domain := fun _ : RealFunction.Point => True
  let g : RealFunction.Map := unitEndpointAdjusted f
  have hg : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero F.one) g := by
    unfold g
    exact continuousOn_unitEndpointAdjusted hf
  have hg0 : g F.zero = F.zero := by
    unfold g
    exact unitEndpointAdjusted_zero f
  have hg1 : g F.one = F.zero := by
    unfold g
    exact unitEndpointAdjusted_one f
  let ghat : RealFunction.Map := unitZeroExtension g
  have hghat_uc : RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn all ghat := by
    unfold ghat
    exact uniformContinuousOn_unitZeroExtension hg hg0 hg1
  have hghat_cont_all : RealFunction.ContinuousOn all ghat :=
    RealFunction.uniformContinuousOn_to_continuousOn hghat_uc
  let halfE := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F epsilon
  have hhalfE_pos : F.lt F.zero halfE :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hepsilon
  have heta_exists := hghat_uc halfE hhalfE_pos
  let eta := Classical.choose heta_exists
  have heta_spec := Classical.choose_spec heta_exists
  let minRadius := F.min F.one eta
  have hminRadius_pos : F.lt F.zero minRadius := by
    unfold minRadius
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_min2 F F.zero_lt_one heta_spec.left
  let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F minRadius
  have hdelta_pos : F.lt F.zero delta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hminRadius_pos
  have hdelta_lt_min : F.lt delta minRadius :=
