    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length
      hdelta_le_one hrightAbs_spec.left hrightAbs_spec.right hrightPoint
  have hrightLength_le_one : F.le (F.sub F.one delta) F.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic F hzero_le_delta
  have hleftLength_eq : F.sub (F.neg delta) (F.neg F.one) =
      F.sub F.one delta := by
    calc
      F.sub (F.neg delta) (F.neg F.one) = F.neg (F.sub delta F.one) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F delta F.one
      _ = F.sub F.one delta :=
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F delta F.one).symm
  have hleft_bound : F.le leftValue tailConstant := by
    have hvalue_abs : F.le leftValue (F.abs leftValue) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_abs_self F leftValue
    have hlength_scaled := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F
      hrightLength_le_one htailConstant_nonneg
    change F.le (F.mul tailConstant (F.sub F.one delta))
      (F.mul tailConstant F.one) at hlength_scaled
    rw [F.mul_one] at hlength_scaled
    have hleftLength_eq' :
        RealTheory.sub (F.neg delta) (F.neg F.one) =
          F.sub F.one delta := by
      exact hleftLength_eq
    rw [hleftLength_eq'] at hleftAbsBound
    change F.le (F.abs leftValue)
      (F.mul tailConstant (F.sub F.one delta)) at hleftAbsBound
    exact F.le_trans hvalue_abs (F.le_trans hleftAbsBound hlength_scaled)
  have hright_bound : F.le rightValue tailConstant := by
    have hvalue_abs : F.le rightValue (F.abs rightValue) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_abs_self F rightValue
    have hlength_scaled := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F
      hrightLength_le_one htailConstant_nonneg
    change F.le (F.mul tailConstant (F.sub F.one delta))
      (F.mul tailConstant F.one) at hlength_scaled
    rw [F.mul_one] at hlength_scaled
    exact F.le_trans hvalue_abs (F.le_trans hrightAbsBound hlength_scaled)
  have habs_left_center :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_ordered
      hneg_one_le_neg_delta hneg_delta_le_delta
      hleftAbs_spec.left hleftAbs_spec.right
      hcenterAbs_spec.left hcenterAbs_spec.right
  have habs_left_center_bdd :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.ClosedIntervalBounded absError
        (F.neg F.one) delta :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      (F.le_trans hneg_one_le_neg_delta hneg_delta_le_delta)
      (restrictContinuous habsError_cont_all (F.neg F.one) delta)
  have habs_joined :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_ordered
      (F.le_trans hneg_one_le_neg_delta hneg_delta_le_delta)
      hdelta_le_one
      habs_left_center_bdd habs_left_center
      hrightAbs_spec.left hrightAbs_spec.right
  have habs_total_bound :
      F.le (F.abs (F.sub (baseP.eval x) (g x)))
        (F.add (F.add leftValue centerValue) rightValue) :=
    abs_darbouxIntegral_le_darbouxIntegral_abs
      hneg_one_le_one
      (restrictContinuous herror_cont_all (F.neg F.one) F.one)
      herror_data.right habs_joined
  have hfour : F.nat 4 = F.add (F.nat 2) (F.nat 2) := by
    rw [show 4 = 2 + 2 by omega, F.nat_add]
  have htail_twice : F.add tailConstant tailConstant =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 4) M) (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat n)))
        tailPower := by
    unfold tailConstant tailBound
    rw [<- F.add_mul]
    rw [<- F.add_mul]
    rw [<- hfour]
    rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
  have hpieces :
      F.le (F.add (F.add leftValue centerValue) rightValue)
        (F.add
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 4) M) (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat n)))
            tailPower)
          halfE) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hleft_bound hcenter_bound)
      hright_bound
    change F.le
      (F.add (F.add leftValue centerValue) rightValue)
      (F.add (F.add tailConstant halfE) tailConstant) at h
    have hrearrange : F.add (F.add tailConstant halfE) tailConstant =
        F.add (F.add tailConstant tailConstant) halfE := by
      rw [F.add_assoc, F.add_comm halfE tailConstant, <- F.add_assoc]
    rw [hrearrange, htail_twice] at h
    exact h
  have hbase_error_le :
      F.le (F.abs (F.sub (baseP.eval x) (g x)))
        (F.add
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 4) M) (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat n)))
            tailPower)
          halfE) :=
    F.le_trans habs_total_bound hpieces
  have htail_budget :
      F.lt
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 4) M) (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat n)))
          tailPower)
        halfE := by
    unfold tailPower halfE
    have htwo_eq_nat_two : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F = F.nat 2 := by
      symm
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ,
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_one]
      rfl
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half, htwo_eq_nat_two]
    exact hn_spec.right
  have hbudget_sum :
      F.lt
        (F.add
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 4) M) (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat n)))
            tailPower)
          halfE)
        epsilon := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F htail_budget halfE
    change F.lt
      (F.add
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 4) M) (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat n)))
          tailPower)
        halfE)
      (F.add halfE halfE) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F epsilon] at h
  have hbase_approx :
      F.lt (F.abs (F.sub (g x) (baseP.eval x))) epsilon := by
    have habs_comm :
        F.abs (F.sub (g x) (baseP.eval x)) =
          F.abs (F.sub (baseP.eval x) (g x)) := by
      exact RealTheory.abs_sub_comm (g x) (baseP.eval x)
    rw [habs_comm]
    exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hbase_error_le hbudget_sum
  have hbase_length : 2 <= baseP.length := by
    unfold baseP rudinConvolutionPolynomial
    change 2 <= 2 * n + 1
    omega
  have hP_eval := addEndpointAffinePolynomial_eval
    baseP (f F.zero) slope x hbase_length
  change P.eval x = F.add (F.add (baseP.eval x) (f F.zero))
    (F.mul slope x) at hP_eval
  have herror_identity : F.sub (f x) (P.eval x) =
      F.sub (g x) (baseP.eval x) := by
    rw [hP_eval]
    unfold g unitEndpointAdjusted slope
    change F.sub (f x)
        (F.add (F.add (baseP.eval x) (f F.zero))
          (F.mul (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero)) x)) =
      F.sub
        (F.sub
          (F.sub (f x) (f F.zero))
          (F.mul x (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero))))
        (baseP.eval x)
    calc
      F.sub (f x)
          (F.add (F.add (baseP.eval x) (f F.zero))
            (F.mul (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero)) x)) =
        F.sub (f x)
          (F.add (f F.zero)
            (F.add (F.mul x (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero)))
              (baseP.eval x))) := by
            congr 1
            calc
              F.add (F.add (baseP.eval x) (f F.zero))
                  (F.mul (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero)) x) =
                F.add (baseP.eval x)
                  (F.add (f F.zero)
                    (F.mul (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero)) x)) :=
                  F.add_assoc _ _ _
              _ = F.add
                  (F.add (f F.zero)
                    (F.mul (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero)) x))
                  (baseP.eval x) := F.add_comm _ _
              _ = F.add
                  (F.add (f F.zero)
                    (F.mul x (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero))))
                  (baseP.eval x) := by rw [F.mul_comm]
              _ = F.add (f F.zero)
                  (F.add (F.mul x (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero)))
                    (baseP.eval x)) := F.add_assoc _ _ _
      _ = F.sub (F.sub (f x) (f F.zero))
          (F.add (F.mul x (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero)))
            (baseP.eval x)) :=
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add F
          (f x) (f F.zero)
          (F.add (F.mul x (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero)))
            (baseP.eval x))).symm
      _ = F.sub
          (F.sub
            (F.sub (f x) (f F.zero))
            (F.mul x (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero))))
          (baseP.eval x) :=
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add F
          (F.sub (f x) (f F.zero))
          (F.mul x (F.sub (f F.one) (f F.zero)))
          (baseP.eval x)).symm
  change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (P.eval x))) epsilon
  rw [herror_identity]
  exact hbase_approx

name: affinePowerCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
private theorem affinePowerCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt
    (alpha beta : RealFunction.Point) (k j : Nat) (hkj : k < j) :
    affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing j with
  | zero =>
      cases j with
      | zero => omega
      | succ j => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      cases j with
      | zero => omega
      | succ j =>
          rw [affinePowerCoeff,
            ih (j + 1) (by omega), ih j (by omega),
            RealTheory.mul_zero, RealTheory.mul_zero,
            RealTheory.zero_add]

name: powNat_affine_eq_polySum_affinePowerCoeff
statement:
private theorem powNat_affine_eq_polySum_affinePowerCoeff
    (alpha beta x : RealFunction.Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealFunction.powNat
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul alpha x) beta) k =
      RealFunction.polySum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
            (RealFunction.powNat x j))
        (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero,
        RealFunction.polySum_succ, RealFunction.polySum_zero,
        affinePowerCoeff, RealFunction.powNat_zero,
        RealTheory.zero_add, RealTheory.mul_one]
  | succ k ih =>
      let oldTerm := fun j : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
          (RealFunction.powNat x j)
      let newTerm := fun j : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta (k + 1) j)
          (RealFunction.powNat x j)
      have hsum : forall m : Nat,
          RealFunction.polySum newTerm (m + 1) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul beta
                (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (m + 1)))
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul alpha x)
                (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm m)) := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero =>
            rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ newTerm 0,
              RealFunction.polySum_zero newTerm,
              RealFunction.polySum_succ oldTerm 0,
              RealFunction.polySum_zero oldTerm]
            dsimp only [newTerm, oldTerm]
            rw [affinePowerCoeff, RealFunction.powNat_zero]
            simp only [RealTheory.zero_add, RealTheory.mul_one,
              RealTheory.mul_zero, RealTheory.add_zero]
        | succ m ihm =>
            change RealTheory.add
                (RealFunction.polySum newTerm (m + 1))
                (newTerm (m + 1)) =
              RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.mul beta
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (m + 1))
                    (oldTerm (m + 1))))
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul alpha x)
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm m)
                    (oldTerm m)))
            rw [ihm]
            dsimp only [newTerm, oldTerm]
            rw [affinePowerCoeff, RealFunction.powNat_succ]
            let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            change F.add
                (F.add
                  (F.mul beta
                    (RealFunction.polySum
                      (fun j => F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
                        (RealFunction.powNat x j))
                      (m + 1)))
                  (F.mul (F.mul alpha x)
                    (RealFunction.polySum
                      (fun j => F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
                        (RealFunction.powNat x j)) m)))
                (F.mul
                  (F.add
                    (F.mul beta (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k (m + 1)))
                    (F.mul alpha (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m)))
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m) x)) =
              F.add
                (F.mul beta
                  (F.add
                    (RealFunction.polySum
                      (fun j => F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
                        (RealFunction.powNat x j))
                      (m + 1))
                    (F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k (m + 1))
                      (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m) x))))
                (F.mul (F.mul alpha x)
                  (F.add
                    (RealFunction.polySum
                      (fun j => F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
                        (RealFunction.powNat x j)) m)
                    (F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m)
                      (RealFunction.powNat x m))))
            simp only [F.mul_add, F.add_mul]
            have htailBeta :
                F.mul
                    (F.mul beta
                      (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k (m + 1)))
                    (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m) x) =
                  F.mul beta
                    (F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k (m + 1))
                      (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m) x)) :=
              F.mul_assoc beta (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k (m + 1)) _
            have htailAlpha :
                F.mul
                    (F.mul alpha (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m))
                    (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m) x) =
                  F.mul (F.mul alpha x)
                    (F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m)
                      (RealFunction.powNat x m)) := by
              calc
                F.mul
                    (F.mul alpha (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m))
                    (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m) x) =
                  F.mul alpha
                    (F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m)
                      (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m) x)) :=
                    F.mul_assoc alpha
                      (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m) _
                _ = F.mul alpha
                    (F.mul x
                      (F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m)
                        (RealFunction.powNat x m))) := by
                      congr 1
                      calc
                        F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m)
                            (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x m) x) =
                          F.mul
                            (F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m)
                              (RealFunction.powNat x m)) x :=
                            (F.mul_assoc
                              (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m)
                              (RealFunction.powNat x m) x).symm
                        _ = F.mul x
                            (F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m)
                              (RealFunction.powNat x m)) := F.mul_comm _ _
                _ = F.mul (F.mul alpha x)
                    (F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k m)
                      (RealFunction.powNat x m)) :=
                  (F.mul_assoc alpha x _).symm
            rw [htailBeta, htailAlpha]
            have hswap_add (u v w : RealFunction.Point) :
                F.add u (F.add v w) = F.add v (F.add u w) := by
              rw [<- F.add_assoc, F.add_comm u v, F.add_assoc]
            have hswap_middle (u v w z : RealFunction.Point) :
                F.add (F.add u v) (F.add w z) =
                  F.add (F.add u w) (F.add v z) := by
              calc
                F.add (F.add u v) (F.add w z) =
                    F.add u (F.add v (F.add w z)) :=
                  F.add_assoc u v (F.add w z)
                _ = F.add u (F.add w (F.add v z)) := by
                  rw [hswap_add v w z]
                _ = F.add (F.add u w) (F.add v z) :=
                  (F.add_assoc u w (F.add v z)).symm
            exact hswap_middle _ _ _ _
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ, ih]
      change RealTheory.mul
          (RealFunction.polySum oldTerm (k + 1))
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul alpha x) beta) =
        RealFunction.polySum newTerm (k + 2)
      rw [hsum (k + 1)]
      have hfar : affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k (k + 1) =
          RealTheory.zero :=
        affinePowerCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt alpha beta k (k + 1) (by omega)
      rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ oldTerm (k + 1)]
      dsimp only [oldTerm]
      rw [hfar, RealTheory.zero_mul, RealTheory.add_zero]
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change F.mul
          (RealFunction.polySum
            (fun j => F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
              (RealFunction.powNat x j))
            (k + 1))
          (F.add (F.mul alpha x) beta) =
        F.add
          (F.mul beta
            (RealFunction.polySum
              (fun j => F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
                (RealFunction.powNat x j))
              (k + 1)))
          (F.mul (F.mul alpha x)
            (RealFunction.polySum
              (fun j => F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
                (RealFunction.powNat x j))
              (k + 1)))
      let S := RealFunction.polySum
        (fun j => F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
          (RealFunction.powNat x j))
        (k + 1)
      change F.mul S (F.add (F.mul alpha x) beta) =
        F.add (F.mul beta S) (F.mul (F.mul alpha x) S)
      rw [F.mul_add, F.mul_comm S (F.mul alpha x),
        F.mul_comm S beta, F.add_comm]

name: affinePullbackPolynomial_eval
statement:
private theorem affinePullbackPolynomial_eval
    (R : RealFunction.Polynomial)
    (alpha beta x : RealFunction.Point) :
    (affinePullbackPolynomial R alpha beta).eval x =
      R.eval (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul alpha x) beta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have polySum_zero_terms : forall n : Nat,
      RealFunction.polySum (fun _ : Nat => F.zero) n = F.zero := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ, ih]
        change RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero =
          RealTheory.zero
        rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  have polySum_congr : forall (u v : Nat -> RealFunction.Point) (n : Nat),
      (forall i : Nat, i < n -> u i = v i) ->
        RealFunction.polySum u n = RealFunction.polySum v n := by
    intro u v n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro _
        rfl
    | succ n ih =>
        intro huv
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ, RealFunction.polySum_succ,
          ih (fun i hi => huv i (by omega)), huv n (by omega)]
  have polySum_add : forall (u v : Nat -> RealFunction.Point) (n : Nat),
      RealFunction.polySum (fun i : Nat => F.add (u i) (v i)) n =
        F.add (RealFunction.polySum u n) (RealFunction.polySum v n) := by
    intro u v n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_zero, RealFunction.polySum_zero,
          RealFunction.polySum_zero]
        change RealTheory.zero =
          RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
        rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ, RealFunction.polySum_succ,
          RealFunction.polySum_succ, ih]
        calc
          F.add
              (F.add (RealFunction.polySum u n)
                (RealFunction.polySum v n))
              (F.add (u n) (v n)) =
            F.add
              (F.add (RealFunction.polySum u n) (u n))
              (F.add (RealFunction.polySum v n) (v n)) := by
                have hswap_middle (p q r s : RealFunction.Point) :
                    F.add (F.add p q) (F.add r s) =
                      F.add (F.add p r) (F.add q s) := by
                  calc
                    F.add (F.add p q) (F.add r s) =
                        F.add p (F.add q (F.add r s)) :=
                      F.add_assoc p q (F.add r s)
                    _ = F.add p (F.add r (F.add q s)) := by
                      rw [<- F.add_assoc q r s, F.add_comm q r,
                        F.add_assoc r q s]
                    _ = F.add (F.add p r) (F.add q s) :=
                      (F.add_assoc p r (F.add q s)).symm
                exact hswap_middle _ _ _ _
          _ = F.add
              (RealFunction.polySum u (n + 1))
              (RealFunction.polySum v (n + 1)) := rfl
  have polySum_mul_right : forall
      (u : Nat -> RealFunction.Point) (c : RealFunction.Point) (n : Nat),
      F.mul (RealFunction.polySum u n) c =
        RealFunction.polySum (fun i : Nat => F.mul (u i) c) n := by
    intro u c n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_zero, RealFunction.polySum_zero]
        change RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero c = RealTheory.zero
        rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ, RealFunction.polySum_succ]
        change RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.add (RealFunction.polySum u n) (u n)) c =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealFunction.polySum (fun i => F.mul (u i) c) n)
            (F.mul (u n) c)
        rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
        change RealTheory.add
            (F.mul (RealFunction.polySum u n) c) (F.mul (u n) c) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealFunction.polySum (fun i => F.mul (u i) c) n)
            (F.mul (u n) c)
        rw [ih]
  have polySum_mul_left : forall
      (c : RealFunction.Point) (u : Nat -> RealFunction.Point) (n : Nat),
      F.mul c (RealFunction.polySum u n) =
        RealFunction.polySum (fun i : Nat => F.mul c (u i)) n := by
    intro c u n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_zero, RealFunction.polySum_zero]
        change RealTheory.mul c RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
        rw [RealTheory.mul_zero]
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ, RealFunction.polySum_succ]
        change RealTheory.mul c
            (RealTheory.add (RealFunction.polySum u n) (u n)) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealFunction.polySum (fun i => F.mul c (u i)) n)
            (F.mul c (u n))
        rw [RealTheory.mul_add]
        change RealTheory.add
            (F.mul c (RealFunction.polySum u n)) (F.mul c (u n)) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealFunction.polySum (fun i => F.mul c (u i)) n)
            (F.mul c (u n))
        rw [ih]
  have polySum_swap : forall
      (u : Nat -> Nat -> RealFunction.Point) (m n : Nat),
      RealFunction.polySum
          (fun j : Nat => RealFunction.polySum (fun k : Nat => u k j) m) n =
        RealFunction.polySum
          (fun k : Nat => RealFunction.polySum (fun j : Nat => u k j) n) m := by
    intro u m n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_zero]
        have hzero :
            (fun k : Nat =>
                RealFunction.polySum (fun j : Nat => u k j) 0) =
              (fun _ : Nat => F.zero) := by
          funext k
          rfl
        rw [hzero, polySum_zero_terms]
        change RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
        rfl
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ, ih]
        change F.add
            (RealFunction.polySum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                RealFunction.polySum (fun j : Nat => u k j) n) m)
            (RealFunction.polySum (fun k : Nat => u k n) m) =
          RealFunction.polySum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              F.add
                (RealFunction.polySum (fun j : Nat => u k j) n)
                (u k n)) m
        rw [polySum_add]
  have hinner_power (k : Nat) (hk : k < R.length) :
      RealFunction.polySum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
              (RealFunction.powNat x j))
          R.length =
        RealFunction.powNat (F.add (F.mul alpha x) beta) k := by
    let term := fun j : Nat =>
      F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j) (RealFunction.powNat x j)
    have hpadding : forall extra : Nat,
        RealFunction.polySum term (k + 1 + extra) =
          RealFunction.polySum term (k + 1) := by
      intro extra
      induction extra with
      | zero =>
          rw [Nat.add_zero]
      | succ extra ih =>
          rw [show k + 1 + (extra + 1) = (k + 1 + extra) + 1 by omega,
            RealFunction.polySum_succ, ih]
          dsimp only [term]
          rw [affinePowerCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt alpha beta k
              (k + 1 + extra) (by omega)]
          have hzero_mul :
              F.mul RealTheory.zero
                  (RealFunction.powNat x (k + 1 + extra)) =
                RealTheory.zero := by
            change RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
                (RealFunction.powNat x (k + 1 + extra)) =
              RealTheory.zero
            exact RealTheory.zero_mul _
          rw [hzero_mul, RealTheory.add_zero]
    have hlength : k + 1 + (R.length - (k + 1)) = R.length := by
      omega
    change RealFunction.polySum term R.length =
      RealFunction.powNat (F.add (F.mul alpha x) beta) k
    rw [<- hlength, hpadding]
    exact (powNat_affine_eq_polySum_affinePowerCoeff
      alpha beta x k).symm
  unfold affinePullbackPolynomial RealFunction.Polynomial.eval
  change RealFunction.polySum
      (fun j : Nat =>
        F.mul
          (RealFunction.polySum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              F.mul (R.coeff k) (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j))
            R.length)
          (RealFunction.powNat x j))
      R.length =
    RealFunction.polySum
      (fun k : Nat =>
        F.mul (R.coeff k)
          (RealFunction.powNat (F.add (F.mul alpha x) beta) k))
      R.length
  calc
    RealFunction.polySum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          F.mul
            (RealFunction.polySum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                F.mul (R.coeff k) (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j))
              R.length)
            (RealFunction.powNat x j))
        R.length =
      RealFunction.polySum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          RealFunction.polySum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              F.mul
                (F.mul (R.coeff k) (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j))
                (RealFunction.powNat x j))
            R.length)
        R.length := by
          apply polySum_congr
          intro j hj
          exact polySum_mul_right
            (fun k : Nat =>
              F.mul (R.coeff k) (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j))
            (RealFunction.powNat x j) R.length
    _ = RealFunction.polySum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealFunction.polySum
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul
                (F.mul (R.coeff k) (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j))
                (RealFunction.powNat x j))
            R.length)
        R.length := by
          exact polySum_swap
            (fun k j : Nat =>
              F.mul
                (F.mul (R.coeff k) (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j))
                (RealFunction.powNat x j))
            R.length R.length
    _ = RealFunction.polySum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          F.mul (R.coeff k)
            (RealFunction.polySum
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
                  (RealFunction.powNat x j))
              R.length))
        R.length := by
          apply polySum_congr
          intro k hk
          calc
            RealFunction.polySum
                (fun j : Nat =>
                  F.mul
                    (F.mul (R.coeff k)
                      (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j))
                    (RealFunction.powNat x j))
                R.length =
              RealFunction.polySum
                (fun j : Nat =>
                  F.mul (R.coeff k)
                    (F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
                      (RealFunction.powNat x j)))
                R.length := by
                  apply polySum_congr
                  intro j hj
                  exact F.mul_assoc _ _ _
            _ = F.mul (R.coeff k)
                (RealFunction.polySum
                  (fun j : Nat =>
                    F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
                      (RealFunction.powNat x j))
                  R.length) :=
              (polySum_mul_left (R.coeff k)
                (fun j : Nat =>
                  F.mul (affinePowerCoeff alpha beta k j)
                    (RealFunction.powNat x j)) R.length).symm
    _ = RealFunction.polySum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          F.mul (R.coeff k)
            (RealFunction.powNat (F.add (F.mul alpha x) beta) k))
        R.length := by
          apply polySum_congr
          intro k hk
          rw [hinner_power k hk]

name: exists_polynomial_uniformApproximation_closedInterval
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_uniformApproximation_closedInterval
    {a b : RealFunction.Point}
    {f : RealFunction.Point -> RealFunction.Point}
    {epsilon : RealFunction.Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hepsilon : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero epsilon) :
    Exists fun P : RealFunction.Polynomial =>
      forall x : RealFunction.Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub (f x) (RealFunction.Polynomial.eval P x)))
            epsilon
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hab_eq : a = b
  · subst b
    let P : RealFunction.Polynomial :=
      { coeff := fun k : Nat =>
          match k with
          | 0 => f a
          | _ + 1 => F.zero
        length := 1 }
    refine Exists.intro P ?_
    intro x hx
    have hx_eq : x = a := F.le_antisymm hx.right hx.left
    rw [hx_eq]
    have hP_eval : P.eval a = f a := by
      unfold P RealFunction.Polynomial.eval
      rw [RealFunction.polySum_succ, RealFunction.polySum_zero,
        RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      change RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.mul (f a) RealTheory.one) = f a
      rw [RealTheory.mul_one, RealTheory.zero_add]
    rw [hP_eval]
    have hsub : RealTheory.sub (f a) (f a) = RealTheory.zero := by
      exact F.sub_self (f a)
    rw [hsub]
    have habs_zero : RealTheory.abs RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero := by
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_zero F
    rw [habs_zero]
    exact hepsilon
  · have hba_not : Not (F.le b a) := by
      intro hba
      exact hab_eq (F.le_antisymm hab hba)
    have hab_lt : F.lt a b :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hab hba_not
    let d := F.sub b a
    have hd_pos : F.lt F.zero d := by
      unfold d
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hab_lt
    have hd_nonneg : F.le F.zero d := F.le_of_lt hd_pos
    have hd_ne : Not (d = F.zero) := by
      intro hd
      exact F.ne_of_lt hd_pos hd.symm
    let forward : RealFunction.Map := fun t : RealFunction.Point =>
      F.add a (F.mul d t)
    have hforward_continuous :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero F.one) forward := by
      change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero F.one)
        (RealFunction.AddFun
          (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => a)
          (RealFunction.MulFun
            (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => d)
            RealFunction.IdentityFun))
      exact RealFunction.continuousOn_add
        RealFunction.continuousOn_const
        (RealFunction.continuousOn_mul
          RealFunction.continuousOn_const
          RealFunction.continuousOn_identity)
    have hforward_maps : RealFunction.MapsInto
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero F.one)
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) forward := by
      intro t ht
      have hproduct_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul d t) :=
        F.mul_nonneg hd_nonneg ht.left
      have hlower := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F
        hproduct_nonneg a
      rw [F.add_zero] at hlower
      have hproduct_upper :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F ht.right hd_nonneg
      change F.le (F.mul d t) (F.mul d F.one) at hproduct_upper
      rw [F.mul_one] at hproduct_upper
      have hupper := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F
        hproduct_upper a
      have ha_add_d : F.add a d = b := by
        unfold d
        rw [F.add_comm, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b a]
      rw [ha_add_d] at hupper
      exact And.intro hlower hupper
    let h : RealFunction.Map := fun t : RealFunction.Point => f (forward t)
    have hh : RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero F.one) h := by
      change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero F.one)
        (RealFunction.CompFun f forward)
      exact RealFunction.continuousOn_comp
        hforward_continuous hf hforward_maps
    rcases exists_polynomial_uniformApproximation_unitInterval
      (f := h) (epsilon := epsilon) hh hepsilon with ⟨R, hR⟩
    let alpha := F.inv d
    let beta := F.neg (F.mul alpha a)
    let P := affinePullbackPolynomial R alpha beta
    refine Exists.intro P ?_
    intro x hx
    let z := F.add (F.mul alpha x) beta
    have halpha_pos : F.lt F.zero alpha := by
      unfold alpha
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hd_pos
    have halpha_nonneg : F.le F.zero alpha := F.le_of_lt halpha_pos
    have hz_factor : z = F.mul alpha (F.sub x a) := by
      unfold z beta
      rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, F.mul_add, F.mul_neg]
    have hx_sub_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub x a) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hx.left
    have hx_sub_le_d : F.le (F.sub x a) d := by
      unfold d
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
        hx.right (F.le_refl a)
    have hz_unit : RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero F.one z := by
      rw [hz_factor]
      constructor
      · exact F.mul_nonneg halpha_nonneg hx_sub_nonneg
      · have hscaled :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F
            hx_sub_le_d halpha_nonneg
        change F.le (F.mul alpha (F.sub x a)) (F.mul alpha d)
          at hscaled
        unfold alpha at hscaled
        rwa [F.inv_mul_cancel hd_ne] at hscaled
    have hforward_z : forward z = x := by
      unfold forward
      rw [hz_factor]
      change F.add a
          (F.mul d (F.mul (F.inv d) (F.sub x a))) = x
      rw [<- F.mul_assoc, F.mul_inv_cancel hd_ne, F.one_mul,
        F.add_comm, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x a]
    have hunit := hR z hz_unit
    have hP_eval := affinePullbackPolynomial_eval R alpha beta x
    change P.eval x = R.eval z at hP_eval
    have hh_z : h z = f x := by
      unfold h
      rw [hforward_z]
    change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (P.eval x))) epsilon
    rw [hP_eval, <- hh_z]
    exact hunit

name: ac_planeCurve_length_formula
statement:
theorem ac_planeCurve_length_formula
    {a b : RealDerivative.Point} {x y u v : RealDerivative.Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hxAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval x a b)
    (hyAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval y a b)
    (hu :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b x u)
    (hv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b y v) :
    And
      (HKAbsolutelyIntegrableOn
        (fun t => PlaneNorm (u t) (v t)) a b)
      (HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (fun t => PlaneNorm (u t) (v t)) a b
        (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsAC :
      AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
        (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) a b :=
    planeCurveLengthFrom_absolutelyContinuous_of_coordinates hxAC hyAC
  have hsDeriv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b
        (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y) (planeCurveSpeed u v) :=
    planeCurveLengthFrom_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE_planeCurveSpeed
      hxAC hyAC hu hv
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · simpa [planeCurveSpeed] using
      (hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE
        hab hsAC hsDeriv)
  · have hIntegral :=
      hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAE
        hab hsAC hsDeriv
    change
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn (planeCurveSpeed u v) a b
        (F.sub
          (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y b)
          (planeCurveLengthFrom a x y a)) at hIntegral
    rw [planeCurveLengthFrom_right, planeCurveLengthFrom_self] at hIntegral
    change
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn (planeCurveSpeed u v) a b
        (F.sub (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y) F.zero) at hIntegral
    rw [F.sub_zero] at hIntegral
    simpa [planeCurveSpeed] using hIntegral

theorem planeCurveSpeed_hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn
    {a b : RealDerivative.Point} {x y u v : RealDerivative.Map}

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_planeCurveSpeed
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_planeCurveSpeed
    {a b : RealDerivative.Point} {x y u v : RealDerivative.Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hxAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval x a b)
    (hyAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval y a b)
    (hu :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b x u)
    (hv :

name: exists_planeCurveDerivativeRepresentatives_length_formula
statement:
theorem exists_planeCurveDerivativeRepresentatives_length_formula
    {a b : RealDerivative.Point} {x y : RealDerivative.Map}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hxAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval x a b)
    (hyAC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval y a b) :
    Exists (fun u : RealDerivative.Map =>
      Exists (fun v : RealDerivative.Map =>
        And
          (HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
            a b x u)
          (And
            (HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
              a b y v)
            (And
              (HKAbsolutelyIntegrableOn (planeCurveSpeed u v) a b)
              (HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn (planeCurveSpeed u v) a b
                (planeCurveLengthOn a b x y))))))
proof:
:= by
  cases
      exists_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
        hxAC with
  | intro u hu =>
      cases
          exists_hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
            hyAC with
      | intro v hv =>
          have hformula :=
            ac_planeCurve_length_formula hab hxAC hyAC hu hv
          exact Exists.intro u
            (Exists.intro v
              (And.intro hu
                (And.intro hv
                  (And.intro
                    (by simpa [planeCurveSpeed] using hformula.left)
                    (by simpa [planeCurveSpeed] using hformula.right)))))

name: cantorGraph_speed_hasIntegral_one
statement:
theorem cantorGraph_speed_hasIntegral_one :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
      (planeCurveSpeed
        (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.one)
        (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.zero))
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hconst :=
    hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_const_of_le
      (a := RealTheory.zero) (b := RealTheory.one)
      (c := RealTheory.one)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
  have hconstOne :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one RealTheory.one := by
    change
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => F.one)
        F.zero F.one F.one
    change
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => F.one)
        F.zero F.one (F.mul F.one (F.sub F.one F.zero)) at hconst
    rw [F.sub_zero, F.one_mul] at hconst
    exact hconst
  apply hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_congr_fun
    (f := fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.one)
    (g := planeCurveSpeed
      (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.one)
      (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.zero))
  · intro t
    exact (cantorGraph_planeSpeed_eq_one t).symm
  · exact hconstOne

name: cantorGraph_speedIntegral_ne_length
statement:
theorem cantorGraph_speedIntegral_ne_length :
    Not
      (HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
        (planeCurveLengthOn RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
          IdentityFun cantorStaircase))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro hLength
  have hSpeedLength :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (planeCurveSpeed
          (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => F.one)
          (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => F.zero))
        F.zero F.one
        (planeCurveLengthOn F.zero F.one IdentityFun cantorStaircase) := by
    apply hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_congr_fun
      (f := fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => F.one)
      (g := planeCurveSpeed
        (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => F.one)
        (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => F.zero))
    · intro t
      exact (cantorGraph_planeSpeed_eq_one t).symm
    · exact hLength
  have hValue :=
    hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
      hSpeedLength cantorGraph_speed_hasIntegral_one
  change
    planeCurveLengthOn RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
      IdentityFun cantorStaircase = RealTheory.one at hValue
  rw [cantorGraph_length_eq_two] at hValue
  have hcancel : F.add F.one F.one = F.add F.one F.zero := by
    rw [F.add_zero]
    exact hValue
  exact RealTheory.one_ne_zero (F.add_left_cancel hcancel)

name: identityIncrementSum_eq_intervalListLength
statement:
private theorem identityIncrementSum_eq_intervalListLength
    {iota : Type u}
    (l r : iota -> RealDerivative.Point) :
    forall js : List iota,
      RealInterval.IntervalListOrdered l r js ->
        acIntervalIncrementSum IdentityFun l r js =
          RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js
  | [], _ => rfl
  | i :: rest, hordered => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hi : F.le (l i) (r i) :=
        hordered i (List.Mem.head rest)
      have hrest : RealInterval.IntervalListOrdered l r rest := by
        intro j hj
        exact hordered j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
      unfold acIntervalIncrementSum RealInterval.intervalListLength
      unfold acIntervalIncrement IdentityFun RealInterval.IntervalLengthAt
      change
        F.add (F.abs (F.sub (r i) (l i)))
            (acIntervalIncrementSum (fun x => x) l r rest) =
          F.add (F.sub (r i) (l i))
            (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r rest)
      rw [F.abs_of_nonneg (F.sub_nonneg_of_le hi)]
      have hrestEq :=
        identityIncrementSum_eq_intervalListLength l r rest hrest
      unfold IdentityFun at hrestEq
      rw [hrestEq]
