statement:
private theorem identityFun_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
    {a b : RealDerivative.Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval IdentityFun a b
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hab ?_
  intro eps heps
  refine Exists.intro eps ?_
  refine And.intro heps ?_
  intro iota l r js hfamily hlength
  rw [identityIncrementSum_eq_intervalListLength
    l r js hfamily.right.left]
  exact hlength

name: cantorStaircase_not_absolutelyContinuous
statement:
theorem cantorStaircase_not_absolutelyContinuous :
    Not
      (AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval cantorStaircase
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  intro hCantorAC
  have hIdentityAC :
      AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval IdentityFun
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one :=
    identityFun_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
  have hrepresentatives := cantorGraph_hasDerivativeRepresentativesAE
  have hformula :=
    ac_planeCurve_length_formula
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
      hIdentityAC hCantorAC hrepresentatives.left hrepresentatives.right
  have hconstantAtLength :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
        (planeCurveLengthOn RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
          IdentityFun cantorStaircase) := by
    apply hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_congr_fun
      (f := fun _ : RealDerivative.Point =>
        PlaneNorm RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero)
      (g := fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.one)
    · intro t
      exact cantorGraph_planeSpeed_eq_one t
    · exact hformula.right
  exact cantorGraph_speedIntegral_ne_length hconstantAtLength

name: intervalIncrement_le_intervalLength_of_derivativeAbsBound_one
statement:
private theorem intervalIncrement_le_intervalLength_of_derivativeAbsBound_one
    (f f' : RealDerivative.Map)
    (hderiv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        RealFunction.UniversalDomain f f')
    (hbound :
      forall z : RealDerivative.Point,
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f' z)) RealTheory.one)
    {u v : RealDerivative.Point}
    (huv : RealTheory.le u v) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)))
      (RealTheory.sub v u)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hvu : F.le v u
  · have huvEq : u = v := F.le_antisymm huv hvu
    change
      F.le (F.abs (F.sub (f v) (f u))) (F.sub v u)
    rw [huvEq, F.sub_self, F.abs_zero, F.sub_self]
    exact F.le_refl F.zero
  · have huvLt : F.lt u v :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F huv hvu
    have hsub :
        forall z : RealDerivative.Point,
          RealTheory.OpenInterval u v z -> RealFunction.UniversalDomain z := by
      intro z hz
      trivial
    have hcont :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v) f :=
      RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
        (fun z hz => trivial)
        (RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn hderiv)
    have hdiff : RealDerivative.DifferentiableOnOpenInterval u v f :=
      RealDerivative.differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn_subset
        hsub hderiv
    have hboundSmall :
        RealDerivative.DerivativeAbsBoundOnOpenInterval
          u v f RealTheory.one := by
      intro z A hz hA
      have hA' :
          RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
            (RealTheory.OpenInterval u v) f z (f' z) :=
        RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset hsub hz
          (hderiv z trivial)
      have hAeq : A = f' z :=
        RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
          (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint hz) hA hA'
      rw [hAeq]
      exact hbound z
    have hboundIncrement :=
      RealDerivative.finiteIncrementBound_of_derivativeAbsBound
        u v RealTheory.one f huvLt hcont hdiff hboundSmall
    change
      F.le (F.abs (F.sub (f v) (f u)))
        (F.mul F.one (F.abs (F.sub v u))) at hboundIncrement
    rw [F.one_mul, F.abs_of_nonneg (F.sub_nonneg_of_le huv)] at hboundIncrement
    exact hboundIncrement

name: acIntervalIncrementSum_le_intervalListLength_of_increment_le
statement:
private theorem acIntervalIncrementSum_le_intervalListLength_of_increment_le
    (f : RealDerivative.Map)
    (hincrement :
      forall u v : RealDerivative.Point,
        RealTheory.le u v ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f v) (f u)))
            (RealTheory.sub v u))
    {iota : Type u} (l r : iota -> RealDerivative.Point) :
    forall js : List iota,
      RealInterval.IntervalListOrdered l r js ->
        RealTheory.le
          (acIntervalIncrementSum f l r js)
          (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js)
  | [], _ => RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  | i :: rest, hordered => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hi : F.le (l i) (r i) :=
        hordered i (List.Mem.head rest)
      have hrest : RealInterval.IntervalListOrdered l r rest := by
        intro j hj
        exact hordered j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
      unfold acIntervalIncrementSum RealInterval.intervalListLength
      unfold acIntervalIncrement RealInterval.IntervalLengthAt
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
        (hincrement (l i) (r i) hi)
        (acIntervalIncrementSum_le_intervalListLength_of_increment_le
          f hincrement l r rest hrest)

name: absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_of_derivativeAbsBound_one
statement:
private theorem absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_of_derivativeAbsBound_one
    (f f' : RealDerivative.Map)
    (hderiv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        RealFunction.UniversalDomain f f')
    (hbound :
      forall z : RealDerivative.Point,
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f' z)) RealTheory.one)
    {a b : RealDerivative.Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval f a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro hab ?_
  intro eps heps
  refine Exists.intro eps ?_
  refine And.intro heps ?_
  intro iota l r js hfamily hlength
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
    (acIntervalIncrementSum_le_intervalListLength_of_increment_le
      f
      (fun u v huv =>
        intervalIncrement_le_intervalLength_of_derivativeAbsBound_one
          f f' hderiv hbound huv)
      l r js hfamily.right.left)
    hlength

name: circularThinSpec_planeSpeed_eq_one
statement:
private theorem circularThinSpec_planeSpeed_eq_one
    (S : CircularThinSpec) (t : RealDerivative.Point) :
    PlaneNorm (RealTheory.neg (S.sin t)) (S.cos t) = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PlaneNorm
  change
    Elementary.nthRoot 2
      (F.add
        (F.mul (F.neg (S.sin t)) (F.neg (S.sin t)))
        (F.mul (S.cos t) (S.cos t))) = F.one
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F]
  have hunit := sin_sq_add_cos_sq S t
  change
    F.add (F.mul (S.sin t) (S.sin t))
      (F.mul (S.cos t) (S.cos t)) = F.one at hunit
  rw [hunit]
  apply Elementary.nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ (n := 1)
  refine And.intro
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one) ?_
  rw [powNat_two]
  change F.mul F.one F.one = F.one
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: unitCircle_minorArc_length_eq
statement:
theorem unitCircle_minorArc_length_eq
    (S : CircularThinSpec) {theta : RealDerivative.Point}
    (h0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero theta)
    (_hpi : RealTheory.le theta (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)) :
    planeCurveLengthOn RealTheory.zero theta S.cos S.sin = theta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcosAC :
      AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
        S.cos RealTheory.zero theta :=
    absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_of_derivativeAbsBound_one
      S.cos (fun z => RealTheory.neg (S.sin z))
      (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.hasDerivativeWithinOn_cos_universal S)
      (fun z => by
        change F.le (F.abs (F.neg (S.sin z))) F.one
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F]
        exact abs_sin_le_one S z)
      h0
  have hsinAC :
      AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval
        S.sin RealTheory.zero theta :=
    absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_of_derivativeAbsBound_one
      S.sin S.cos
      (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.hasDerivativeWithinOn_sin_universal S)
      (abs_cos_le_one S) h0
  have hsub :
      forall z : RealDerivative.Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero theta z ->
          RealFunction.UniversalDomain z := by
    intro z hz
    trivial
  have hcosDerivative :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
        RealTheory.zero theta S.cos
        (fun t => RealTheory.neg (S.sin t)) := by
    unfold HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
    apply RealNegligibility.almostEverywhereOn_of_forall
    intro t ht
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset hsub ht
      ((RealDerivative.Trigonometric.hasDerivativeWithinOn_cos_universal S)
        t trivial)
  have hsinDerivative :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
        RealTheory.zero theta S.sin S.cos := by
    unfold HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
    apply RealNegligibility.almostEverywhereOn_of_forall
    intro t ht
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset hsub ht
      ((RealDerivative.Trigonometric.hasDerivativeWithinOn_sin_universal S)
        t trivial)
  have hformula :=
    ac_planeCurve_length_formula h0 hcosAC hsinAC
      hcosDerivative hsinDerivative
  have hspeedAtLength :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.zero theta
        (planeCurveLengthOn RealTheory.zero theta S.cos S.sin) := by
    apply hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_congr_fun
      (f := fun t : RealDerivative.Point =>
        PlaneNorm (RealTheory.neg (S.sin t)) (S.cos t))
      (g := fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.one)
    · intro t
      exact circularThinSpec_planeSpeed_eq_one S t
    · exact hformula.right
  have hconstant :=
    hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_const_of_le
      (a := RealTheory.zero) (b := theta) (c := RealTheory.one) h0
  have hconstantAtTheta :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.zero theta theta := by
    change
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (fun _ : RealDerivative.Point => F.one)
        F.zero theta (F.mul F.one (F.sub theta F.zero)) at hconstant
    rw [F.sub_zero, F.one_mul] at hconstant
    exact hconstant
  exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
    hspeedAtLength hconstantAtTheta

name: unitCircle_minorChord_length_eq_two_mul_sin_half
statement:
theorem unitCircle_minorChord_length_eq_two_mul_sin_half
    (S : CircularThinSpec) {theta : RealDerivative.Point}
    (h0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero theta)
    (hpi : RealTheory.le theta (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)) :
    unitCircleChordLength S theta =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one)
        (S.sin (trigHalf theta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := trigHalf theta
  let s := S.sin h
  let c := S.cos h
  let q := F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul s s)
  let factor := F.add s s
  have hdouble : F.add h h = theta := by
    unfold h
    exact trigHalf_add_self theta
  have hsinNonneg : F.le F.zero s := by
    unfold s h
    exact RealDerivative.Trigonometric.sin_trigHalf_nonneg_of_mem_closedInterval_zero_pi
      S (And.intro h0 hpi)
  have hfactorNonneg : F.le F.zero factor := by
    unfold factor
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hsinNonneg hsinNonneg
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have hcosDouble := cos_add_self_one_sub_two_sin_sq S h
  have hsinDouble := sin_add_self S h
  change S.cos (F.add h h) = F.sub F.one q at hcosDouble
  change S.sin (F.add h h) = F.add (F.mul s c) (F.mul s c) at hsinDouble
  have hsubCancel : F.sub (F.sub F.one q) F.one = F.neg q := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg F.one q]
    calc
      F.add (F.add F.one (F.neg q)) (F.neg F.one) =
          F.add F.one (F.add (F.neg q) (F.neg F.one)) :=
        F.add_assoc F.one (F.neg q) (F.neg F.one)
      _ = F.add F.one (F.add (F.neg F.one) (F.neg q)) := by
        rw [F.add_comm (F.neg q) (F.neg F.one)]
      _ = F.add (F.add F.one (F.neg F.one)) (F.neg q) :=
        (F.add_assoc F.one (F.neg F.one) (F.neg q)).symm
      _ = F.add F.zero (F.neg q) := by rw [F.add_neg]
      _ = F.neg q := F.zero_add (F.neg q)
  have hfactorSq : F.mul factor s = q := by
    unfold factor q
    exact F.add_mul s s s
  have hfactorSinCos :
      F.mul factor c = F.add (F.mul s c) (F.mul s c) := by
    unfold factor
    exact F.add_mul s s c
  have hfirst :
      F.sub (S.cos theta) F.one = F.mul factor (F.neg s) := by
    rw [<- hdouble, hcosDouble, hsubCancel]
    rw [<- hfactorSq]
    exact (F.mul_neg factor s).symm
  have hsecond :
      F.sub (S.sin theta) F.zero = F.mul factor c := by
    rw [F.sub_zero, <- hdouble, hsinDouble]
    exact hfactorSinCos.symm
  unfold unitCircleChordLength PlaneDistance
  change
    PlaneNorm
        (F.sub (S.cos theta) F.one)
        (F.sub (S.sin theta) F.zero) =
      F.mul (F.add F.one F.one) s
  rw [hfirst, hsecond]
  have hnormMul := planeNorm_mul factor (F.neg s) c
  change
    PlaneNorm (F.mul factor (F.neg s)) (F.mul factor c) =
      F.mul (F.abs factor) (PlaneNorm (F.neg s) c) at hnormMul
  rw [hnormMul]
  rw [F.abs_of_nonneg hfactorNonneg]
  have hspeed := circularThinSpec_planeSpeed_eq_one S h
  change PlaneNorm (F.neg s) c = F.one at hspeed
  rw [hspeed, F.mul_one]
  unfold factor
  rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]

name: EulerMaclaurinInternal.naturalSampleSum_zero
statement:
theorem EulerMaclaurinInternal.naturalSampleSum_zero
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (a : Nat) :
    naturalSampleSum f a 0 = f (RealTheory.nat a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold naturalSampleSum
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
  rw [Nat.add_zero]

name: EulerMaclaurinInternal.naturalSampleSum_succ
statement:
theorem EulerMaclaurinInternal.naturalSampleSum_succ
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (a n : Nat) :
    naturalSampleSum f a (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.add
        (naturalSampleSum f a n)
        (f (RealTheory.nat (a + (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  unfold naturalSampleSum
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]

name: eulerMaclaurinNode_nat_one
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinNode_nat_one
    (a k : Nat) :
    eulerMaclaurinNode (RealTheory.nat a) RealTheory.one k =
      RealTheory.nat (a + k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinNode
  change
    F.add (RealTheory.nat a) (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) F.one) =
      RealTheory.nat (a + k)
  rw [F.mul_one]
  exact (RealTheory.nat_add a k).symm

name: eulerMaclaurin_natMesh_eq_one
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurin_natMesh_eq_one
    (a n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) (RealTheory.nat a))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnNe : Not (n = 0) := by omega
  change
    F.mul
        (F.sub (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) (RealTheory.nat a))
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) = F.one
  rw [RealTheory.nat_add]
  rw [F.add_comm (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat n)]
  rw [F.add_sub_cancel]
  exact F.mul_inv_cancel (RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hnNe)

name: periodicBernoulli_sub_nat
statement:
private theorem periodicBernoulli_sub_nat
    (m a : Nat) (x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    periodicBernoulli m
        (RealTheory.sub x (RealTheory.nat a)) =
      periodicBernoulli m x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    periodicBernoulli m (F.sub x (RealTheory.nat a)) =
      periodicBernoulli m x
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact periodicBernoulli_add_internalInt
    (RealTheory.internalInt_neg_nat a)

name: eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand_nat_one
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand_nat_one
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map) (a m : Nat)
    (x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand
        D (RealTheory.nat a) RealTheory.one m x =
      RealTheory.mul (periodicBernoulli m x) (D m x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand
  change
    F.mul
        (periodicBernoulli m
          (F.mul
            (F.sub x (RealTheory.nat a)) (F.inv F.one)))
        (D m x) =
      F.mul (periodicBernoulli m x) (D m x)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F]
  rw [F.mul_one]
  have hshift := periodicBernoulli_sub_nat m a x
  change
    periodicBernoulli m (F.sub x (RealTheory.nat a)) =
      periodicBernoulli m x at hshift
  exact congrArg (fun q : RealTheory.Carrier => F.mul q (D m x)) hshift

name: half_endpoint_step
statement:
private theorem half_endpoint_step
    (x y z : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    RealTheory.add
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (RealTheory.add x y)) z =
      RealTheory.add
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (RealTheory.add y z))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (RealTheory.add x z))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add x y)) z =
      F.add
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add y z))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add x z))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add F x y,
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add F y z,
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add F x z]
  calc
    F.add
        (F.add
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F y)) z =
        F.add
          (F.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F y))
          (F.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F z)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F z)) := by
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F z]
    _ = F.add
          (F.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F z))
          (F.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F y)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F z)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_add_add_comm F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F y)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F z)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F z)
    _ = F.add
          (F.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F y)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F z))
          (F.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F x)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F z)) := F.add_comm _ _

name: eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid_nat_one
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid_nat_one
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (a k : Nat) :
    eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid
        f (RealTheory.nat (a + k)) RealTheory.one =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (RealTheory.add
          (f (RealTheory.nat (a + k)))
          (f (RealTheory.nat (a + (k + 1)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnext :
      F.add (RealTheory.nat (a + k)) F.one =
        RealTheory.nat (a + (k + 1)) := by
    have hs := RealTheory.nat_succ (a + k)
    have hindex : (a + k) + 1 = a + (k + 1) := by omega
    rw [hindex] at hs
    exact hs.symm
  have htwo :
      RealTheory.nat 2 = F.add F.one F.one := by
    have hs := RealTheory.nat_succ 1
    rw [RealTheory.nat_one] at hs
    exact hs
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul F.one (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)))
        (F.add
          (f (RealTheory.nat (a + k)))
          (f (F.add (RealTheory.nat (a + k)) F.one))) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
        (F.add
          (f (RealTheory.nat (a + k)))
          (f (RealTheory.nat (a + (k + 1)))))
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [hnext]
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two
  rw [htwo]
  rw [F.mul_comm]

name: naturalSampleSum_eq_composite_add_endpointHalf
statement:
private theorem naturalSampleSum_eq_composite_add_endpointHalf
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (a : Nat) :
    forall n : Nat,
      naturalSampleSum f a n =
        RealTheory.add
          (compositeTrapezoidValue
            f (RealTheory.nat a) RealTheory.one n)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            (RealTheory.add
              (f (RealTheory.nat a))
              (f (RealTheory.nat (a + n)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [naturalSampleSum_zero]
      unfold compositeTrapezoidValue
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
      rw [Nat.add_zero]
      change
        f (F.nat a) =
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
            (F.add (f (F.nat a)) (f (F.nat a)))
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add F]
      exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
        F (f (RealTheory.nat a))).symm
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [naturalSampleSum_succ]
      rw [compositeTrapezoidValue_succ]
      rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_nat_one]
      rw [eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid_nat_one]
      rw [ih]
      let T := compositeTrapezoidValue
        f (RealTheory.nat a) F.one n
      let x := f (RealTheory.nat a)
      let y := f (RealTheory.nat (a + n))
      let z := f (RealTheory.nat (a + (n + 1)))
      change
        F.add
            (F.add T (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add x y))) z =
          F.add
            (F.add T (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add y z)))
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add x z))
      calc
        F.add
            (F.add T (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add x y))) z =
            F.add T
              (F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add x y)) z) :=
          F.add_assoc _ _ _
        _ = F.add T
              (F.add
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add y z))
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add x z))) := by
          have hstep := half_endpoint_step x y z
          change
            F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add x y)) z =
              F.add
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add y z))
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add x z)) at hstep
          exact congrArg (fun w : RealTheory.Carrier => F.add T w) hstep
        _ = F.add
              (F.add T (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add y z)))
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.add x z)) :=
          (F.add_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: eulerMaclaurin_neg_scaledRemainder
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurin_neg_scaledRemainder
    (m : Nat) (q J : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m) q) J) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign (m + 1)) q) J
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  calc
    F.neg (F.mul (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m) q) J) =
        F.mul (F.neg (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m) q)) J :=
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F
        (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m) q) J).symm
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.neg (eulerMaclaurinSign m)) q) J := by
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F (eulerMaclaurinSign m) q]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign (m + 1)) q) J := by
      have hsign := eulerMaclaurinSign_succ m
      change
        eulerMaclaurinSign (m + 1) =
          F.neg (eulerMaclaurinSign m) at hsign
      rw [hsign]

name: eulerMaclaurin_solve_natSum
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurin_solve_natSum
    (I T H C R : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hI :
      I = RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub T C) R) :
    RealTheory.add T H =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add I H) C)
        (RealTheory.neg R)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.add T H =
      F.add (F.add (F.add I H) C) (F.neg R)
  rw [hI]
  symm
  let A := F.sub T C
  calc
    F.add (F.add (F.add (F.add A R) H) C) (F.neg R) =
        F.add (F.add (F.add A R) (F.add H C)) (F.neg R) := by
      rw [F.add_assoc (F.add A R) H C]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.add A R) (F.add C H)) (F.neg R) := by
      rw [F.add_comm H C]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.add A C) (F.add R H)) (F.neg R) := by
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_add_add_comm F A R C H]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.add A C) (F.add H R)) (F.neg R) := by
      rw [F.add_comm R H]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.add (F.add A C) H) R) (F.neg R) := by
      rw [← F.add_assoc (F.add A C) H R]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.add A C) H) (F.add R (F.neg R)) := by
      rw [F.add_assoc (F.add (F.add A C) H) R (F.neg R)]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.add A C) H) F.zero := by
      rw [F.add_neg]
    _ = F.add (F.add A C) H := by
      rw [F.add_zero]
    _ = F.add T H := by
      unfold A
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F T C]

name: eulerMaclaurin_composite_nat_one
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurin_composite_nat_one
    (a : Nat)
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (I : RealTheory.Carrier) (m n : Nat)
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (hm : 2 <= m)
    (hD :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n))) f D m)
    (hDm :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n))) (D m))
    (hI :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f
        (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) I) :
    Exists fun J : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      Exists fun A : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand
              D (RealTheory.nat a) RealTheory.one m)
            (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) J /\
        RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.abs (D m x))
            (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) A /\
        I = RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub
            (compositeTrapezoidValue
              f (RealTheory.nat a) RealTheory.one n)
            (eulerMaclaurinCorrection D
              (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n))
              RealTheory.one m))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m)
              (RealTheory.inv
                (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)))) J) /\
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m)
                (RealTheory.inv
                  (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)))) J))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.inv
                (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)))
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base m)) A)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab : F.lt (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt (by omega)
  have hmain := eulerMaclaurin_composite
    (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n))
    f D I m n hab hn hm hD hDm hI
  have hmesh := eulerMaclaurin_natMesh_eq_one a n hn
  rw [hmesh] at hmain
  dsimp only at hmain
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_one_base] at hmain
  rw [RealTheory.one_mul] at hmain
  exact hmain

name: eulerMaclaurin_natSum
statement:
theorem eulerMaclaurin_natSum
    (a : Nat)
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (I : RealTheory.Carrier) (m n : Nat)
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (hm : 2 <= m)
    (hD :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n))) f D m)
    (hDm :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n))) (D m))
    (hI :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f
        (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) I) :
    let scaleAbs
proof:
:= RealTheory.inv
      (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
    let scale := RealTheory.mul
      (Nat.rec RealTheory.one
        (fun (_ : Nat) (s : RealTheory.Carrier) => RealTheory.neg s)
        (m + 1))
      scaleAbs
    Exists fun J : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      Exists fun A : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
              RealTheory.mul (periodicBernoulli m x) (D m x))
            (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) J /\
        RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.abs (D m x))
            (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) A /\
        naturalSampleSum f a n =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add I
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (f (RealTheory.nat a))
                    (f (RealTheory.nat (a + n))))))
              (eulerMaclaurinCorrection D
                (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n))
                RealTheory.one m))
            (RealTheory.mul scale J) /\
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.mul scale J))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul scaleAbs
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base m)) A) := by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
  let T := compositeTrapezoidValue
    f (RealTheory.nat a) F.one n
  let H := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
    (F.add (f (RealTheory.nat a)) (f (RealTheory.nat (a + n))))
  let C := eulerMaclaurinCorrection D
    (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) F.one m
  have hab : F.lt (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt (by omega)
  have habLe : F.le (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) :=
    F.le_of_lt hab
  cases eulerMaclaurin_composite_nat_one
      a f D I m n hn hm hD hDm hI with
  | intro J hJA =>
      cases hJA with
      | intro A hdata =>
          have hJ := hdata.left
          have hA := hdata.right.left
          have hFormula := hdata.right.right.left
          have hBound := hdata.right.right.right
          have hJliteral :
              RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
                (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
                  F.mul (periodicBernoulli m x) (D m x))
                (RealTheory.nat a) (RealTheory.nat (a + n)) J :=
            RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
              habLe
              (fun x _hx =>
                eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand_nat_one
                  D a m x)
              hJ
          have hSample :=
            naturalSampleSum_eq_composite_add_endpointHalf f a n
          change naturalSampleSum f a n = F.add T H at hSample
          change
            I = F.add (F.sub T C)
              (F.mul (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m) q) J) at hFormula
          have hSolved := eulerMaclaurin_solve_natSum
            I T H C
            (F.mul (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m) q) J)
            hFormula
          have hFormulaNat := Eq.trans hSample hSolved
          have hneg := eulerMaclaurin_neg_scaledRemainder m q J
          change
            F.neg (F.mul (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m) q) J) =
              F.mul (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign (m + 1)) q) J at hneg
          change
            naturalSampleSum f a n =
              F.add (F.add (F.add I H) C)
                (F.neg
                  (F.mul (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m) q) J))
            at hFormulaNat
          rw [hneg] at hFormulaNat
          have hAbsEq :
              F.abs
                  (F.mul (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign (m + 1)) q) J) =
                F.abs
                  (F.mul (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m) q) J) := by
            rw [← hneg]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F
              (F.mul (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m) q) J)
          change
            F.le
              (F.abs (F.mul (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m) q) J))
              (F.mul
                (F.mul q
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F m)) A)
            at hBound
          refine Exists.intro J ?_
          refine Exists.intro A ?_
          refine And.intro hJliteral ?_
          refine And.intro hA ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact hFormulaNat
          · change
              F.le
                (F.abs
                  (F.mul
                    (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign (m + 1)) q) J))
                (F.mul
                  (F.mul q
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F m)) A)
            rw [hAbsEq]
            exact hBound

name: bernoulliPolynomialValue_eq_finiteSum_powNat
statement:
private theorem bernoulliPolynomialValue_eq_finiteSum_powNat
    (m : Nat) (t : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base m t =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom m k))
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base k))
            (RealFunction.powNat t (m - k)))
        (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
  intro k hk
  apply congrArg
    (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom m k))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F k))
        z)
  generalize hq : m - k = q
  clear hq
  induction q with
  | zero =>
      rfl
  | succ q ih =>
      change
        RealTheory.mul t
            (Nat.rec RealTheory.one
              (fun _ previous => RealTheory.mul t previous) q) =
          RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat t q) t
      change
        Nat.rec RealTheory.one
            (fun _ previous => RealTheory.mul t previous) q =
          RealFunction.powNat t q at ih
      rw [ih]
      exact RealTheory.mul_comm t (RealFunction.powNat t q)

name: bernoulliPolynomialMap_sameOn_finiteSum
statement:
private theorem bernoulliPolynomialMap_sameOn_finiteSum
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (m : Nat) :
    RealFunction.SameOn E
      (fun t : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom m k))
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base k))
              (RealFunction.powNat t (m - k)))
          (m + 1))
      (bernoulliPolynomialMap m)
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  exact (bernoulliPolynomialValue_eq_finiteSum_powNat m t).symm

name: bernoulliPolynomialMap_continuousOn
statement:
private theorem bernoulliPolynomialMap_continuousOn
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (m : Nat) :
    RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E (bernoulliPolynomialMap m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
  apply RealFunction.continuousOn_congr
    (bernoulliPolynomialMap_sameOn_finiteSum E m)
  apply RealFunction.continuousOn_finiteSum (m + 1)
  intro k hk
  change RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
    (RealFunction.MulFun
      (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom m k))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base k))
      (RealFunction.PowerFun (m - k)))
  exact RealFunction.continuousOn_mul
    RealFunction.continuousOn_const
    (RealFunction.continuousOn_powerFun (m - k))

name: sub_mul_binom_succ
statement:
private theorem sub_mul_binom_succ
    {m k : Nat} (hk : k <= m) :
    (m + 1 - k) * Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) k =
      (m + 1) * Tautology.Nat.binom m k
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : m + 1 - k = (m - k) + 1 := by omega
  calc
    (m + 1 - k) * Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) k =
        ((m - k) + 1) *
          Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) ((m - k) + 1) := by
            rw [hsub]
            rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_symm_of_le
              (n := m + 1) (k := k) (by omega)]
            rw [hsub]
    _ = (m + 1) * Tautology.Nat.binom m (m - k) :=
          Tautology.Nat.succ_mul_binom_succ
            (n := m) (k := m - k) (by omega)
    _ = (m + 1) * Tautology.Nat.binom m k := by
          rw [<- Tautology.Nat.binom_symm_of_le
            (n := m) (k := k) hk]

name: bernoulliPowerSumMap_sameOn_polynomial
statement:
private theorem bernoulliPowerSumMap_sameOn_polynomial
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (m : Nat) :
    RealFunction.SameOn E
      (bernoulliPowerSumMap m) (bernoulliPolynomialMap m)
proof:
:= by
  exact bernoulliPolynomialMap_sameOn_finiteSum E m

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_bernoulliPowerSumMap
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_bernoulliPowerSumMap
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (m : Nat) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (bernoulliPowerSumMap m)
      (bernoulliPowerSumDerivativeMap m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bernoulliPowerSumMap bernoulliPowerSumDerivativeMap
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum (m + 1)
  intro k hk
  change RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
    (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
      (bernoulliRawCoefficient m k)
      (RealFunction.PowerFun (m - k)))
    (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
      (bernoulliRawCoefficient m k)
      (RealDerivative.PowerDerivative (m - k)))
  exact RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul
    (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_powerFun E (m - k))

name: bernoulliPowerSumDerivativeMap_succ
statement:
private theorem bernoulliPowerSumDerivativeMap_succ
    (m : Nat) (t : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    bernoulliPowerSumDerivativeMap (m + 1) t =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
        (bernoulliPolynomialMap m t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold bernoulliPowerSumDerivativeMap
  unfold RealTheory.finiteSum
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_succ]
  have hlast :
      RealTheory.mul (bernoulliRawCoefficient (m + 1) (m + 1))
          (RealDerivative.PowerDerivative (m + 1 - (m + 1)) t) =
        RealTheory.zero := by
    rw [Nat.sub_self]
    unfold RealDerivative.PowerDerivative
    exact RealTheory.mul_zero
      (bernoulliRawCoefficient (m + 1) (m + 1))
  rw [hlast]
  change F.add
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (bernoulliRawCoefficient (m + 1) k)
            (RealDerivative.PowerDerivative (m + 1 - k) t))
        (m + 1))
      F.zero =
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
      (bernoulliPolynomialMap m t)
  rw [F.add_zero]
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (bernoulliRawCoefficient (m + 1) k)
            (RealDerivative.PowerDerivative (m + 1 - k) t))
        (m + 1) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
              (RealTheory.mul (bernoulliRawCoefficient m k)
                (RealFunction.powNat t (m - k))))
          (m + 1) := by
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
            intro k hk
            have hkm : k <= m := by omega
            have hdegree : m + 1 - k = (m - k) + 1 := by omega
            have hpower :
                RealDerivative.PowerDerivative (m + 1 - k) t =
                  RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1 - k))
                    (RealFunction.powNat t (m - k)) := by
              rw [hdegree]
              unfold RealDerivative.PowerDerivative
              unfold RealDerivative.ConstMulFun RealFunction.PowerFun
              rfl
            rw [hpower]
            unfold bernoulliRawCoefficient
            let A := RealTheory.nat
              (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) k)
            let B := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F k
            let C := RealTheory.nat (m + 1 - k)
            let D := RealFunction.powNat t (m - k)
            have hweighted :
                RealTheory.mul A C =
                  RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
                    (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom m k)) := by
              calc
                RealTheory.mul A C = RealTheory.mul C A :=
                  RealTheory.mul_comm A C
                _ = RealTheory.nat
                    ((m + 1 - k) *
                      Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) k) := by
                        change F.mul
                          (RealTheory.nat (m + 1 - k))
                          (RealTheory.nat
                            (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) k)) =
                          RealTheory.nat
                            ((m + 1 - k) *
                              Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) k)
                        exact (RealTheory.nat_mul
                          (m + 1 - k)
                          (Tautology.Nat.binom (m + 1) k)).symm
                _ = RealTheory.nat
                    ((m + 1) * Tautology.Nat.binom m k) := by
                        rw [sub_mul_binom_succ hkm]
                _ = RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
                    (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom m k)) := by
                        change RealTheory.nat
                            ((m + 1) * Tautology.Nat.binom m k) =
                          F.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
                            (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom m k))
                        exact RealTheory.nat_mul
                          (m + 1) (Tautology.Nat.binom m k)
            change
              RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul A B)
                  (RealTheory.mul C D) =
                RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom m k)) B)
                    D)
            calc
              RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul A B)
                  (RealTheory.mul C D) =
                  RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul A C)
                    (RealTheory.mul B D) :=
                    RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm A B C D
              _ = RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
                    (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom m k)))
                  (RealTheory.mul B D) := by rw [hweighted]
              _ = RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.binom m k)) B)
                    D) := by
                      rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
                      rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
    _ = RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
          (bernoulliPowerSumMap m t) := by
            unfold bernoulliPowerSumMap
            unfold RealTheory.finiteSum RealTheory.mul
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_left F
              (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
              (fun k : Nat =>
                F.mul (bernoulliRawCoefficient m k)
                  (RealFunction.powNat t (m - k)))
              (m + 1)
    _ = RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
          (bernoulliPolynomialMap m t) := by
            rw [bernoulliPowerSumMap_sameOn_polynomial
              RealTheory.FunctionUniversalDomain m t (by trivial)]

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_bernoulliPolynomialMap_succ
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_bernoulliPolynomialMap_succ
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (m : Nat) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (bernoulliPolynomialMap (m + 1))
      (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
        (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
        (bernoulliPolynomialMap m))
proof:
:= by
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
  · intro t ht
    exact bernoulliPowerSumDerivativeMap_succ m t
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left
    (bernoulliPowerSumMap_sameOn_polynomial E (m + 1))
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_bernoulliPowerSumMap E (m + 1)

name: periodicBernoulli_abs_le
statement:
theorem periodicBernoulli_abs_le
    (m : Nat) (x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (periodicBernoulli m x))

        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base m)

        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (RealTheory.fractionalPart_lt_one x))

name: EulerMaclaurinInternal.periodicBernoulli_add_internalInt
statement:
theorem EulerMaclaurinInternal.periodicBernoulli_add_internalInt

name: periodicBernoulli_eq_on_internalInt_cell
statement:
private theorem periodicBernoulli_eq_on_internalInt_cell

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate u h)
      (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv h)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_sub
    (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_id E)
    (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_const E u)
  have hscaled := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul
    (c := RealTheory.inv h) hsub
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (f' := RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (RealTheory.inv h)
      (RealFunction.SubFun
        (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.one)
        (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.zero)))
  case hfg =>
    intro x hx
    unfold RealDerivative.ConstMulFun RealFunction.SubFun
    change F.mul (F.inv h) (F.sub F.one F.zero) = F.inv h
    rw [F.sub_zero, F.mul_one]
  case hf =>
    unfold eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate
    exact hscaled

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate u h)
      (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.inv h))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_sub
    (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_const E RealTheory.one)
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate E u h)
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (f' := RealFunction.SubFun
      (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.zero)
      (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv h))
  case hfg =>
    intro x hx
    unfold RealFunction.SubFun
    change F.sub F.zero (F.inv h) = F.neg (F.inv h)
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F (F.inv h)
  case hf =>
    unfold eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate
    exact hsub

name: eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate_left
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate_left
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate u h u = RealTheory.zero

  unfold eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate
    RealDerivative.ConstMulFun RealFunction.SubFun

name: eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate_right
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate_right
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) :
    eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate u h (RealTheory.add u h) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate
    RealDerivative.ConstMulFun RealFunction.SubFun
  calc
    F.mul (F.inv h) (F.sub (F.add u h) u) =
        F.mul (F.inv h) (F.sub (F.add h u) u) := by
          rw [F.add_comm u h]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv h) h := by rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel]
    _ = F.one := F.inv_mul_cancel hh

name: eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate_left
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate_left

name: eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate_right
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate_right

name: eulerMaclaurinCellScale_zero
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellScale_zero
    (h : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    eulerMaclaurinCellScale h 0 = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellScale
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
  change F.mul F.one (F.inv F.one) = F.one
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F]
  exact F.one_mul F.one

name: eulerMaclaurinCellScale_succ_mul_nat_mul_inv
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellScale_succ_mul_nat_mul_inv
    (h : RealTheory.Carrier) (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero))
    (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.mul
        (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h (k + 1))
        (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))
      (RealTheory.inv h) =
      eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsucc : Not (RealTheory.nat (k + 1) = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
  have hfact :
      Not (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k) =
        RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (Tautology.Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellScale
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_mul]
  change
    F.mul
      (F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat h k) h)
          (F.inv
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
              (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)))))
        (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))
      (F.inv h) =
      F.mul (RealFunction.powNat h k)
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hsucc hfact]
  rw [F.mul_comm
    (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)))
    (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))]
  let p := RealFunction.powNat h k
  let n := RealTheory.nat (k + 1)
  let q := RealTheory.inv
    (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k))
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul p h) (F.mul (F.inv n) q)) n)
        (F.inv h) =
      F.mul p q
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul p h) (F.mul (F.inv n) q)) n)
        (F.inv h) =
        F.mul (F.mul p h)
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv n) q) (F.mul n (F.inv h))) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul p h)
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv n) n) (F.mul q (F.inv h))) := by
            apply congrArg (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier => F.mul (F.mul p h) z)
            change
              RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv n) q)
                  (RealTheory.mul n (RealTheory.inv h)) =
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv n) n)
                  (RealTheory.mul q (RealTheory.inv h))
            exact RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm
              (RealTheory.inv n) q n (RealTheory.inv h)
    _ = F.mul (F.mul p h) (F.mul F.one (F.mul q (F.inv h))) := by
            rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hsucc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul p h) (F.mul q (F.inv h)) := by
            rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul p q) (F.mul h (F.inv h)) := by
            exact RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm p h q (F.inv h)
    _ = F.mul (F.mul p q) F.one := by rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hh]
    _ = F.mul p q := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: eulerMaclaurinCellScale_one
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellScale_one
    (h : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    eulerMaclaurinCellScale h 1 = h
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellScale
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_one]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_one]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
  change F.mul h (F.inv F.one) = h
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F]
  exact F.mul_one h

name: eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_continuousOn
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_continuousOn
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat) :
    RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E
      (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h m)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord := RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate E u h)
  have hpoly := bernoulliPolynomialMap_continuousOn
    RealTheory.FunctionUniversalDomain m
  have hcomp := RealTheory.function_continuousOn_comp hcoord hpoly
    (fun _ _ => by trivial)
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellFactor RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
  exact RealFunction.continuousOn_mul
    RealFunction.continuousOn_const hcomp

name: eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand_continuousOn
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand_continuousOn
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat)
    (hDm : RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E (D m)) :
    RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E
      (eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand D u h m)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E
        (RealTheory.FunctionSubFun RealTheory.FunctionIdentityFun
          (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => u)) :=
    RealTheory.function_continuousOn_sub
      RealTheory.function_continuousOn_identity
      RealTheory.function_continuousOn_const
  have hcoord :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E
        (RealTheory.FunctionMulFun
          (RealTheory.FunctionSubFun RealTheory.FunctionIdentityFun
            (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => u))
          (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv h)) :=
    RealTheory.function_continuousOn_mul hsub
      RealTheory.function_continuousOn_const
  have hpoly := bernoulliPolynomialMap_continuousOn
    RealTheory.FunctionUniversalDomain m
  have hcomp := RealTheory.function_continuousOn_comp hcoord hpoly
    (fun _ _ => by trivial)
  unfold eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand
  exact RealFunction.continuousOn_mul hcomp hDm

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_succ
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_succ
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (u h : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) (k : Nat) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h (k + 1))
      (RealFunction.NegFun (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h k))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpoly := hasDerivativeWithinOn_bernoulliPolynomialMap_succ
    RealTheory.FunctionUniversalDomain k
  have hcoord :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate E u h
  have hcomp := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_comp
    hcoord hpoly
    (fun _ _ => by trivial)
  have hscaled := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul
    (c := eulerMaclaurinCellScale h (k + 1)) hcomp
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (f' := RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
      (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h (k + 1))
      (RealFunction.MulFun
        (RealFunction.CompFun
          (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
            (bernoulliPolynomialMap k))
          (eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate u h))
        (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.inv h))))
  case hfg =>
    intro x hx
    let s := eulerMaclaurinCellScale h (k + 1)
    let n := RealTheory.nat (k + 1)
    let B := bernoulliPolynomialMap k
      (eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate u h x)
    let q := RealTheory.inv h
    change
      F.mul s (F.mul (F.mul n B) (F.neg q)) =
        F.neg (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k) B)
    have hscale :
        F.mul (F.mul s n) q = eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k := by
      exact eulerMaclaurinCellScale_succ_mul_nat_mul_inv h hh k
    calc
      F.mul s (F.mul (F.mul n B) (F.neg q)) =
          F.neg (F.mul s (F.mul (F.mul n B) q)) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F]
      _ = F.neg (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul s n) q) B) := by
            congr 1
            calc
              F.mul s (F.mul (F.mul n B) q) =
                  F.mul (F.mul s (F.mul n B)) q := by
                    rw [<- F.mul_assoc s (F.mul n B) q]
              _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul s n) B) q := by
                    rw [F.mul_assoc s n B]
              _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul s n) q) B := by
                    rw [F.mul_assoc]
                    rw [F.mul_comm B q]
                    rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.neg (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k) B) := by
            rw [hscale]
  case hf =>
    unfold eulerMaclaurinCellFactor
    exact hscaled

name: eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_left
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_left
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (k : Nat) (hk : 2 <= k) :
    eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h k u =
      RealTheory.mul
        (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellFactor RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
    RealFunction.CompFun
  rw [eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate_left]
  unfold bernoulliPolynomialMap
  change
    F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue F k F.one) =
      F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F k)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue_one_eq F hk]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue_zero]

name: eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_right
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_right
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero))
    (k : Nat) :
    eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h k (RealTheory.add u h) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellFactor RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
    RealFunction.CompFun
  rw [eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate_right u h hh]
  unfold bernoulliPolynomialMap
  change
    F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue F k F.zero) =
      F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F k)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue_zero]

name: bernoulliPolynomialMap_one_at_one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hreflection :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue_reflection
      F 1 F.zero
  rw [F.sub_zero] at hreflection
  change
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue F 1 F.one =
      F.mul (F.neg F.one)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue F 1 F.zero)
      at hreflection
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue_zero] at hreflection
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber_one] at hreflection
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F] at hreflection
  rw [F.one_mul] at hreflection
  rw [F.neg_neg] at hreflection
  unfold bernoulliPolynomialMap
  exact hreflection

name: eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_one_left
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_one_left
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h 1 u =
      RealTheory.mul h (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))
proof:
:= by
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellFactor RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
    RealFunction.CompFun
  rw [eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate_left]
  rw [eulerMaclaurinCellScale_one]
  rw [bernoulliPolynomialMap_one_at_one]

name: eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_one_right
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_one_right
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) :
    eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h 1 (RealTheory.add u h) =
      RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul h (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellFactor RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
    RealFunction.CompFun
  rw [eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate_right u h hh]
  rw [eulerMaclaurinCellScale_one]
  unfold bernoulliPolynomialMap
  change
    F.mul h
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue F 1 F.zero) =
      F.neg (F.mul h (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue_zero]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber_one]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F h (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))

name: eulerMaclaurinCellEndpoint_eq_correctionSummand
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellEndpoint_eq_correctionSummand
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map) (u h : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) (k : Nat) (hk : 2 <= k) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsEndpointTerm
        (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h k) (D (k - 1))
        u (RealTheory.add u h) =
      eulerMaclaurinCorrectionSummand D u h k
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsEndpointTerm
  rw [eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_right u h hh k]
  rw [eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_left u h k hk]
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCorrectionSummand
  change
    F.sub
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F k))
          (D (k - 1) (F.add u h)))
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F k))
          (D (k - 1) u)) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h k)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F k))
        (F.sub (D (k - 1) (F.add u h)) (D (k - 1) u))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F]

name: neg_mul_sub_mul_eq_neg_mul_add
statement:
private theorem neg_mul_sub_mul_eq_neg_mul_add
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (c a b : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    F.sub (F.mul (F.neg c) b) (F.mul c a) =
      F.neg (F.mul c (F.add a b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F]
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [F.add_comm (F.mul c b) (F.mul c a)]

name: eulerMaclaurinCell_pos_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCell_pos_ne_zero
    {h : RealTheory.Carrier}
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h) :
    Not (h = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro hzero
  rw [hzero] at hh
  exact F.lt_asymm hh hh

name: eulerMaclaurinCell_interval
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCell_interval
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h) :
    RealTheory.le u (RealTheory.add u h)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h0h : F.le F.zero h := F.le_of_lt hh
  have hadd := F.add_le_add_left h0h u
  rw [F.add_zero] at hadd
  exact hadd

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_openCell_of_closedCell
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_openCell_of_closedCell
    {u h : RealTheory.Carrier} {f f' : RealDerivative.Map}
    (hf :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) f f') :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      (RealTheory.OpenInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) f f'
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxclosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h) x :=
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx.right)
  exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
    (fun y hy =>
      And.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hy.left)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hy.right))
    hx (hf x hxclosed)

name: eulerMaclaurinCellEndpoint_one_eq_neg_trapezoid
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellEndpoint_one_eq_neg_trapezoid
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hD0 :
      RealFunction.SameOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) (D 0) f) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsEndpointTerm
        (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h 1) (D 0)
        u (RealTheory.add u h) =
      RealTheory.neg (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hhne : Not (h = RealTheory.zero) :=
    eulerMaclaurinCell_pos_ne_zero hh
  have hab : F.le u (F.add u h) := eulerMaclaurinCell_interval u h hh
  have hu : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (F.add u h) u :=
    And.intro (F.le_refl u) hab
  have hv : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (F.add u h) (F.add u h) :=
    And.intro hab (F.le_refl (F.add u h))
  unfold RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsEndpointTerm
  rw [eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_one_right u h hhne]
  rw [eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_one_left]
  have hDright : D 0 (RealTheory.add u h) = f (RealTheory.add u h) :=
    hD0 (RealTheory.add u h) hv
  have hDleft : D 0 u = f u := hD0 u hu
  rw [hDright]
  rw [hDleft]
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid
  exact neg_mul_sub_mul_eq_neg_mul_add F
    (F.mul h (F.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)))
    (f u) (f (F.add u h))

name: bernoulliPolynomialMap_zero_eq_one
statement:
private theorem bernoulliPolynomialMap_zero_eq_one
    (t : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    bernoulliPolynomialMap 0 t = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold bernoulliPolynomialMap
  rw [bernoulliPolynomialValue_eq_finiteSum_powNat]
  unfold RealTheory.finiteSum
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_one]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_zero]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber_zero]
  rw [Nat.zero_sub]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
  change F.mul (F.mul F.one F.one) F.one = F.one
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_zero
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_zero
    (u h x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h 0 x = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellFactor RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
    RealFunction.CompFun
  rw [eulerMaclaurinCellScale_zero]
  rw [bernoulliPolynomialMap_zero_eq_one]
  exact F.one_mul F.one

name: eulerMaclaurinDerivativeChain_continuousOn
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinDerivativeChain_continuousOn
    {E : RealDerivative.Domain} {f : RealDerivative.Map}
    {D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map} {m k : Nat}
    (hD : RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D m)
    (hDm : RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E (D m))
    (hk : k <= m) :
    RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E (D k)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hkm : k = m
  case pos =>
    subst k
    exact hDm
  case neg =>
    have hlt : k < m := by omega
    exact RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      (hD.right k hlt)

name: eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand_eq_signed_raw
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand_eq_signed_raw
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map) (u h : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (m : Nat) (x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h m x =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (eulerMaclaurinSign m)
          (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m))
        (eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand D u h m x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand eulerMaclaurinCellFactor
    eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand
    eulerMaclaurinReverseCoordinate eulerMaclaurinForwardCoordinate
    eulerMaclaurinSign bernoulliPolynomialMap
    RealDerivative.ConstMulFun RealFunction.CompFun
    RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.SubFun
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue F m
            (F.sub F.one (F.mul (F.inv h) (F.sub x u)))))
        (D m x) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul
          (Nat.rec F.one (fun (_ : Nat) (s : RealTheory.Carrier) => F.neg s) m)
          (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m))
        (F.mul
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue F m
            (F.mul (F.sub x u) (F.inv h)))
          (D m x))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue_reflection]
  rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv h) (F.sub x u)]
  let s := eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m
  let sign : RealTheory.Carrier :=
    Nat.rec F.one (fun (_ : Nat) (z : RealTheory.Carrier) => F.neg z) m
  let B := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue F m
    (F.mul (F.sub x u) (F.inv h))
  let d := D m x
  change F.mul (F.mul s (F.mul sign B)) d =
    F.mul (F.mul sign s) (F.mul B d)
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul s (F.mul sign B)) d =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.mul s sign) B) d := by
          exact congrArg (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier => F.mul z d)
            (Eq.symm (F.mul_assoc s sign B))
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul sign s) B) d := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier => F.mul (F.mul z B) d)
            (F.mul_comm s sign)
    _ = F.mul (F.mul sign s) (F.mul B d) := by
          exact F.mul_assoc (F.mul sign s) B d

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (r : Nat)
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero))
    (hDr :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E (D r) (D (r + 1))) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r)
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealTheory.sub
          (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h (r + 1) x)
          (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h r x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hraw := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_mul
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_succ E u h hh r)
    hDr
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right _ hraw
  intro x _hx
  unfold RealFunction.AddFun RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.NegFun
    eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand
  change
    F.add
        (F.mul
          (F.neg (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h r x)) (D r x))
        (F.mul
          (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h (r + 1) x) (D (r + 1) x)) =
      F.sub
        (F.mul
          (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h (r + 1) x) (D (r + 1) x))
        (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h r x) (D r x))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.add_comm]

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (f : RealDerivative.Map)
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map) (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat)
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero))
    (hD : RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D m) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive D u h m)
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealTheory.sub
          (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h m x)
          (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h 0 x))
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive D u h m)
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun r : Nat =>
              RealTheory.sub
                (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h (r + 1) x)
                (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h r x))
            m) := by
    unfold eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive
    apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum m
    intro r hr
    exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm
      E D u h r hh (hD.right r hr)
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right _ hsum
  intro x _hx
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_telescope_sub
    (fun k : Nat => eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h k x) m

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinCellPrimitiveSub
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinCellPrimitiveSub
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) (f : RealDerivative.Map)
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map) (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat)
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero))
    (hD : RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D m) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive D u h m)
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealTheory.sub (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h m x) (f x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hraw :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive
      E f D u h m hh hD
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right _ hraw
  intro x hx
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand RealFunction.MulFun
  change
    F.sub
        (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h m x) (D m x))
        (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h 0 x) (D 0 x)) =
      F.sub
        (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h m x) (D m x)) (f x)
  rw [eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_zero]
  change
    F.sub
        (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h m x) (D m x))
        (F.mul F.one (D 0 x)) =
      F.sub
        (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h m x) (D m x)) (f x)
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [hD.left x hx]

name: eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTermEndpointZero
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTermEndpointZero
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hD0 :
      RealFunction.SameOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) (D 0) f) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h 0
          (RealTheory.add u h))
        (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h 0 u) =
      RealTheory.neg (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h)
proof:
:= by
  change
    RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsEndpointTerm
        (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h 1) (D 0)
        u (RealTheory.add u h) =
      RealTheory.neg (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h)
  exact eulerMaclaurinCellEndpoint_one_eq_neg_trapezoid
    f D u h hh hD0

name: eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTermEndpointSucc
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTermEndpointSucc
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map) (u h : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) (r : Nat) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h (r + 1)
          (RealTheory.add u h))
        (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h (r + 1) u) =
      eulerMaclaurinCorrectionSummand D u h (r + 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hendpoint :=
    eulerMaclaurinCellEndpoint_eq_correctionSummand
      D u h hh (r + 2) (by omega)
  have hindex : r + 1 + 1 = r + 2 := by omega
  have hpred : r + 2 - 1 = r + 1 := by omega
  rw [hpred] at hendpoint
  change
    RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsEndpointTerm
        (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor u h (r + 1 + 1)) (D (r + 1))
        u (RealTheory.add u h) =
      eulerMaclaurinCorrectionSummand D u h (r + 2)
  rw [hindex]
  exact hendpoint

name: eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitiveEndpoint
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitiveEndpoint
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hm : 2 <= m)
    (hD0 :
      RealFunction.SameOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) (D 0) f) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive D u h m
          (RealTheory.add u h))
        (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive D u h m u) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.neg (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h))
        (eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection D u h m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hhne : Not (h = F.zero) := eulerMaclaurinCell_pos_ne_zero hh
  have hmr : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive
  change
    F.sub
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat =>
            eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r (F.add u h))
          m)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat =>
            eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r u)
          m) =
      F.add (F.neg (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h))
        (eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection D u h m)
  calc
    F.sub
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat =>
            eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r (F.add u h))
          m)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat =>
            eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r u)
          m) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat =>
            F.sub
              (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r (F.add u h))
              (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r u))
          m := by
            exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.finiteSum_sub
              (fun r : Nat =>
                eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r (F.add u h))
              (fun r : Nat =>
                eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r u) m)
    _ = RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat =>
            F.sub
              (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r (F.add u h))
              (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r u))
          (m - 1 + 1) := by rw [hmr]
    _ = F.add
          (F.sub
            (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h 0 (F.add u h))
            (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h 0 u))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun r : Nat =>
              F.sub
                (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h (r + 1)
                  (F.add u h))
                (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h (r + 1) u))
            (m - 1)) := by
              exact RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first
                (fun r : Nat =>
                  F.sub
                    (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r
                      (F.add u h))
                    (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h r u))
                (m - 1)
    _ = F.add (F.neg (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h))
          (eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection D u h m) := by
            have hzero :=
              eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTermEndpointZero
                f D u h hh hD0
            change
              F.sub
                  (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h 0
                    (F.add u h))
                  (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h 0 u) =
                F.neg (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h) at hzero
            rw [hzero]
            unfold eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection
            apply congrArg
              (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier =>
                F.add (F.neg (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h)) z)
            apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
            intro r _hr
            have hsucc :=
              eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTermEndpointSucc
                D u h hhne r
