            change
              F.sub
                  (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h (r + 1)
                    (F.add u h))
                  (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryTerm D u h (r + 1) u) =
                eulerMaclaurinCorrectionSummand D u h (r + 2) at hsucc
            exact hsucc

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_eulerMaclaurinCellDifference
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_eulerMaclaurinCellDifference
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat)
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hm : 2 <= m)
    (hD :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) f D m)
    (hDm :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) (D m)) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealTheory.sub (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h m x) (f x))
      u (RealTheory.add u h)
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.neg (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h))
        (eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection D u h m))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (F.add u h)
  have hab : F.le u (F.add u h) := eulerMaclaurinCell_interval u h hh
  have hhne : Not (h = F.zero) := eulerMaclaurinCell_pos_ne_zero hh
  have hderivativeClosed :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_eulerMaclaurinCellPrimitiveSub
      E f D u h m hhne hD
  have hderivativeOpen :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_openCell_of_closedCell hderivativeClosed
  have hprimitiveContinuous :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E
        (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive D u h m) :=
    RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn hderivativeClosed
  have hcellContinuous :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E
        (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h m) := by
    unfold eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_mul
      (eulerMaclaurinCellFactor_continuousOn E u h m) hDm
  have hDzeroContinuous :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E (D 0) :=
    eulerMaclaurinDerivativeChain_continuousOn hD hDm (by omega)
  have hfContinuous : RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E f :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_congr hD.left hDzeroContinuous
  have hintegrandContinuous :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.sub (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h m x) (f x)) :=
    RealTheory.function_continuousOn_sub hcellContinuous hfContinuous
  have hnewton :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      hab hintegrandContinuous hprimitiveContinuous hderivativeOpen
  have hendpoint :=
    eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitiveEndpoint
      f D u h m hh hm hD.left
  change
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        F.sub (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h m x) (f x))
      u (F.add u h)
      (F.sub
        (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive D u h m (F.add u h))
        (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive D u h m u)) at hnewton
  change
    F.sub
        (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive D u h m (F.add u h))
        (eulerMaclaurinCellBoundaryPrimitive D u h m u) =
      F.add (F.neg (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h))
        (eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection D u h m) at hendpoint
  rw [hendpoint] at hnewton
  exact hnewton

name: eulerMaclaurinCellSolveValue
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellSolveValue
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (I T C K : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hvalue : F.sub K I = F.add (F.neg T) C) :
    I = F.add (F.sub T C) K
proof:
:= by
  have hK : K = F.add (F.add (F.neg T) C) I := by
    calc
      K = F.add (F.sub K I) I := by
            exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F K I)
      _ = F.add (F.add (F.neg T) C) I := by rw [hvalue]
  have hcancel :
      F.add (F.sub T C) (F.add (F.neg T) C) = F.zero := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_add_add_comm F]
    rw [F.add_neg]
    rw [F.neg_add]
    rw [F.zero_add]
  symm
  calc
    F.add (F.sub T C) K =
        F.add (F.sub T C) (F.add (F.add (F.neg T) C) I) := by
          rw [hK]
    _ = F.add
          (F.add (F.sub T C) (F.add (F.neg T) C)) I := by
            exact Eq.symm
              (F.add_assoc (F.sub T C) (F.add (F.neg T) C) I)
    _ = F.add F.zero I := by rw [hcancel]
    _ = I := F.zero_add I

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_eulerMaclaurinCell
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_eulerMaclaurinCell
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat)
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (I : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hm : 2 <= m)
    (hD :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) f D m)
    (hDm :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) (D m))
    (hI :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        f u (RealTheory.add u h) I) :
    Exists fun J : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand D u h m)
        u (RealTheory.add u h) J /\
      I = RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.sub
          (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h)
          (eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection D u h m))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (Nat.rec RealTheory.one
              (fun (_ : Nat) (s : RealTheory.Carrier) => RealTheory.neg s) m)
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealFunction.powNat h m)
              (RealTheory.inv
                (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)))))
          J)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab : F.le u (F.add u h) := eulerMaclaurinCell_interval u h hh
  have hrawContinuous :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (F.add u h))
        (eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand D u h m) :=
    eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand_continuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (F.add u h)) D u h m hDm
  have hright : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (F.add u h) (F.add u h) :=
    And.intro hab (F.le_refl (F.add u h))
  let hrawIntegrable :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.OrientedRiemannIntegrableOn
        (eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand D u h m)
        u (F.add u h) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_upperEndpoint_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hrawContinuous hright
  let J : RealTheory.Carrier :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf hrawIntegrable
  have hJ :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand D u h m)
        u (F.add u h) J :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf
      hrawIntegrable
  have hJforward :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hJ
  let c := F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m)
    (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m)
  have hscaled :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_left_of_le
      c hab hJforward.left hJforward.right
  have hscaledCell :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h m)
        u (F.add u h) (F.mul c J) := by
    apply RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le hab
      (hf := hscaled)
    intro x _hx
    unfold c
    exact (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand_eq_signed_raw D u h m x).symm
  have hscaledForward :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      hab hscaledCell
  have hIforward :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hI
  have hdifferenceFromValues :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.sub (eulerMaclaurinCellIntegrand D u h m x) (f x))
        u (F.add u h) (F.sub (F.mul c J) I) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_sub_of_le
      hab
      hscaledForward.left hscaledForward.right
      hIforward.left hIforward.right
  have hdifferenceFromNewton :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_eulerMaclaurinCellDifference
      u h m f D hh hm hD hDm
  have hvalue :
      F.sub (F.mul c J) I =
        F.add (F.neg (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h))
          (eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection D u h m) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
      hdifferenceFromValues hdifferenceFromNewton
  refine Exists.intro J ?_
  refine And.intro hJ ?_
  have hformula := eulerMaclaurinCellSolveValue F I
    (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f u h)
    (eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection D u h m)
    (F.mul c J) hvalue
  unfold c eulerMaclaurinSign eulerMaclaurinCellScale at hformula
  exact hformula

name: eulerMaclaurinNode_zero
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinNode_zero
    (a h : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinNode
  change F.add a (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F 0) h) = a
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero]
  rw [F.zero_mul]
  rw [F.add_zero]

name: eulerMaclaurinNode_succ
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinNode_succ
    (a h : RealTheory.Carrier) (k : Nat) :
    eulerMaclaurinNode a h (k + 1) =
      RealTheory.add (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinNode
  change
    F.add a (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (k + 1)) h) =
      F.add (F.add a (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F k) h)) h
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [F.add_assoc]

name: eulerMaclaurinNode_rightEndpoint
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinNode_rightEndpoint
    (a b : RealTheory.Carrier) (n : Nat)
    (hn : Not (n = 0)) :
    eulerMaclaurinNode a
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub b a)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)))
        n = b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnReal : Not (RealTheory.nat n = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn
  unfold eulerMaclaurinNode
  change
    F.add a
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
          (F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (RealTheory.nat n)))) = b
  rw [← F.mul_assoc]
  rw [F.mul_comm (RealTheory.nat n) (F.sub b a)]
  rw [F.mul_assoc]
  rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hnReal]
  rw [F.mul_one]
  rw [F.add_comm]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b a

name: eulerMaclaurinNode_le_of_le
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinNode_le_of_le
    (a h : RealTheory.Carrier) {i j : Nat}
    (hh : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero h)
    (hij : i <= j) :
    RealTheory.le
      (eulerMaclaurinNode a h i)
      (eulerMaclaurinNode a h j)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnat : F.le (RealTheory.nat i) (RealTheory.nat j) :=
    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hij
  have hmul :
      F.le
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat i) h)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat j) h) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hnat hh
  unfold eulerMaclaurinNode
  exact F.add_le_add_left hmul a

name: eulerMaclaurinCell_subset
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCell_subset
    (a h : RealTheory.Carrier) (n k : Nat)
    (hh : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero h)
    (hk : k + 1 <= n) :
    forall x : RealTheory.Carrier,
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k)
          (eulerMaclaurinNode a h (k + 1)) x ->
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
          (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n) x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact RealTheory.le_trans
      (eulerMaclaurinNode_le_of_le a h hh (Nat.zero_le k)) hx.left
  · exact RealTheory.le_trans hx.right
      (eulerMaclaurinNode_le_of_le a h hh hk)

name: eulerMaclaurinCorrection_cell
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCorrection_cell
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat) :
    eulerMaclaurinCorrection D u (RealTheory.add u h) h m =
      eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection D u h m
proof:
:= by
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCorrection eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
  intro r
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCorrectionSummand eulerMaclaurinCellScale
  have hindex : r + 2 - 1 = r + 1 := by omega
  rw [hindex]

name: eulerMaclaurinCorrection_concat
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCorrection_concat
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (a c b h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat) :
    eulerMaclaurinCorrection D a b h m =
      RealTheory.add
        (eulerMaclaurinCorrection D a c h m)
        (eulerMaclaurinCorrection D c b h m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCorrection
  rw [← RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
  intro r
  let q := F.mul
    (F.mul
      (RealFunction.powNat h (r + 2))
      (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (r + 2)))))
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F (r + 2))
  change
    F.mul q (F.sub (D (r + 1) b) (D (r + 1) a)) =
      F.add
        (F.mul q (F.sub (D (r + 1) c) (D (r + 1) a)))
        (F.mul q (F.sub (D (r + 1) b) (D (r + 1) c)))
  rw [← F.mul_add]
  rw [F.add_comm
    (F.sub (D (r + 1) c) (D (r + 1) a))
    (F.sub (D (r + 1) b) (D (r + 1) c))]
  rw [F.sub_add_sub_cancel]

name: eulerMaclaurinCorrection_succ
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCorrection_succ
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (a h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m k : Nat) :
    eulerMaclaurinCorrection
        D a (eulerMaclaurinNode a h (k + 1)) h m =
      RealTheory.add
        (eulerMaclaurinCorrection D a (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h m)
        (eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection
          D (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_succ]
  rw [eulerMaclaurinCorrection_concat
    D a (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k)
      (RealTheory.add (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h) h m]
  rw [eulerMaclaurinCorrection_cell]

name: exists_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_derivativeChain_cell
statement:
private theorem exists_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_derivativeChain_cell
    (u h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat)
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hm : 2 <= m)
    (hD :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) f D m) :
    Exists fun I : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        f u (RealTheory.add u h) I
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : 0 < m := by omega
  have hDzero := hD.right 0 hzero
  have hDzeroContinuous :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) (D 0) :=
    RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn hDzero
  have hfContinuous :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) f := by
    change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) f
    change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h)) (D 0)
      at hDzeroContinuous
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_congr hD.left hDzeroContinuous
  have hab := eulerMaclaurinCell_interval u h hh
  let I :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
      f u (RealTheory.add u h) hfContinuous (RealTheory.add u h)
  refine Exists.intro I ?_
  unfold I
  exact
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
      hfContinuous (And.intro hab (RealTheory.le_refl _))

name: eulerMaclaurinLocalCoordinate_mem_closedUnit
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinLocalCoordinate_mem_closedUnit
    (u h x : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval u (RealTheory.add u h) x) :
    RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x u) (RealTheory.inv h))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hhInv : F.lt F.zero (F.inv h) := F.inv_pos hh
  have hhInvNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv h) := F.le_of_lt hhInv
  have hleft : F.le F.zero (F.sub x u) :=
    F.sub_nonneg_of_le hx.left
  have hright : F.le (F.sub x u) h := by
    have hsub := F.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le hx.right (F.le_refl u)
    change F.le (F.sub x u) (F.sub (F.add u h) u) at hsub
    rw [F.add_comm u h] at hsub
    rw [F.add_sub_cancel] at hsub
    exact hsub
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · have hmul := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hleft hhInvNonneg
    rw [F.zero_mul] at hmul
    exact hmul
  · have hmul := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hright hhInvNonneg
    have hhne := eulerMaclaurinCell_pos_ne_zero hh
    rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hhne] at hmul
    exact hmul

name: periodicBernoulli_eq_bernoulliPolynomialMap_closedUnit
statement:
private theorem periodicBernoulli_eq_bernoulliPolynomialMap_closedUnit
    (m : Nat) (t : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hm : 2 <= m)
    (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one t) :
    periodicBernoulli m t = bernoulliPolynomialMap m t
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases htOne : t = F.one
  case pos =>
    rw [htOne]
    unfold periodicBernoulli bernoulliPolynomialMap
    rw [RealTheory.fractionalPart_internalInt RealTheory.internalInt_one]
    exact
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliPolynomialValue_one_eq F hm).symm
  case neg =>
    have htlt : F.lt t F.one := by
      apply F.lt_of_le_of_not_le ht.right
      intro hone
      exact htOne (F.le_antisymm ht.right hone)
    have hvalue := periodicBernoulli_eq_on_internalInt_cell
      (m := m) (x := t) (z := F.zero)
      RealTheory.internalInt_zero ht.left
      (by
        change F.lt t (F.add F.zero F.one)
        rw [F.zero_add]
        exact htlt)
    change
      periodicBernoulli m t =
        bernoulliPolynomialMap m (F.sub t F.zero) at hvalue
    rw [F.sub_zero] at hvalue
    exact hvalue

name: eulerMaclaurinGlobalCoordinate_eq
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinGlobalCoordinate_eq
    (a h x : RealTheory.Carrier) (k : Nat)
    (hh : Not (h = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x a) (RealTheory.inv h) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub x (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k))
          (RealTheory.inv h))
        (RealTheory.nat k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := RealTheory.nat k
  have hnodeSub :
      F.sub (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) a = F.mul q h := by
    unfold eulerMaclaurinNode
    change F.sub (F.add a (F.mul q h)) a = F.mul q h
    rw [F.add_comm a (F.mul q h)]
    exact F.add_sub_cancel (F.mul q h) a
  calc
    F.mul (F.sub x a) (F.inv h) =
        F.mul
          (F.add
            (F.sub x (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k))
            (F.sub (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) a))
          (F.inv h) := by
            rw [F.sub_add_sub_cancel]
    _ = F.add
          (F.mul
            (F.sub x (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k))
            (F.inv h))
          (F.mul
            (F.sub (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) a)
            (F.inv h)) := by
            rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.add
          (F.mul
            (F.sub x (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k))
            (F.inv h))
          (F.mul (F.mul q h) (F.inv h)) := by
            rw [hnodeSub]
    _ = F.add
          (F.mul
            (F.sub x (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k))
            (F.inv h))
          (F.mul q (F.mul h (F.inv h))) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.add
          (F.mul
            (F.sub x (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k))
            (F.inv h)) q := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hh]
            rw [F.mul_one]

name: eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand_eq_periodic
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand_eq_periodic
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (a h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m k : Nat)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hm : 2 <= m)
    (x : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hx :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval
        (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k)
        (RealTheory.add (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h) x) :
    eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand
        D (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h m x =
      eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand D a h m x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let t := F.mul
    (F.sub x (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k)) (F.inv h)
  have ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero F.one t :=
    eulerMaclaurinLocalCoordinate_mem_closedUnit
      (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h x hh hx
  have hlocal : periodicBernoulli m t = bernoulliPolynomialMap m t :=
    periodicBernoulli_eq_bernoulliPolynomialMap_closedUnit m t hm ht
  have hkInt : RealTheory.InternalInt (RealTheory.nat k) :=
    RealTheory.internalInt_of_internalNat (RealTheory.internalNat_of_nat k)
  have hcoord := eulerMaclaurinGlobalCoordinate_eq
    a h x k (eulerMaclaurinCell_pos_ne_zero hh)
  have hperiodic :
      periodicBernoulli m
          (F.mul (F.sub x a) (F.inv h)) =
        bernoulliPolynomialMap m t := by
    change
      F.mul (F.sub x a) (F.inv h) =
        F.add
          (F.mul
            (F.sub x (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k)) (F.inv h))
          (RealTheory.nat k) at hcoord
    rw [hcoord]
    have hadd := periodicBernoulli_add_internalInt
      (m := m) (x := t) (z := RealTheory.nat k) hkInt
    change
      periodicBernoulli m (F.add t (RealTheory.nat k)) =
        periodicBernoulli m t at hadd
    change
      periodicBernoulli m (F.add t (RealTheory.nat k)) =
        bernoulliPolynomialMap m t
    rw [hadd]
    exact hlocal
  unfold eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand
    eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand
    RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.CompFun
  unfold t at hperiodic
  change
    F.mul
        (bernoulliPolynomialMap m
          (F.mul
            (F.sub x (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k)) (F.inv h)))
        (D m x) =
      F.mul
        (periodicBernoulli m (F.mul (F.sub x a) (F.inv h)))
        (D m x)
  rw [hperiodic]

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_eulerMaclaurinCell_periodic
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_eulerMaclaurinCell_periodic
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (a h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m k : Nat)
    (J : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hm : 2 <= m)
    (hJ :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand
          D (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h m)
        (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k)
        (RealTheory.add (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h) J) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand D a h m)
      (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k)
      (RealTheory.add (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h) J
proof:
:= by
  apply RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
    (eulerMaclaurinCell_interval (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h hh)
    (hf := hJ)
  intro x hx
  exact eulerMaclaurinRawRemainderIntegrand_eq_periodic
    D a h m k hh hm x hx

name: eulerMaclaurinFormula_combine
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinFormula_combine
    (T₀ C₀ J₀ T₁ C₁ J₁ s : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub T₀ C₀) (RealTheory.mul s J₀))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub T₁ C₁) (RealTheory.mul s J₁)) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.add T₀ T₁) (RealTheory.add C₀ C₁))
        (RealTheory.mul s (RealTheory.add J₀ J₁))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.add (F.add (F.sub T₀ C₀) (F.mul s J₀))
        (F.add (F.sub T₁ C₁) (F.mul s J₁)) =
      F.add (F.sub (F.add T₀ T₁) (F.add C₀ C₁))
        (F.mul s (F.add J₀ J₁))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_add_add_comm]
  rw [← F.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub]
  rw [F.mul_add]

name: EulerMaclaurinInternal.compositeTrapezoidValue_succ
statement:
theorem EulerMaclaurinInternal.compositeTrapezoidValue_succ
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (a h : RealTheory.Carrier) (k : Nat) :
    compositeTrapezoidValue f a h (k + 1) =
      RealTheory.add
        (compositeTrapezoidValue f a h k)
        (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid
          f (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold compositeTrapezoidValue
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
  congr 1
  change
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul h (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)))
        (RealTheory.add
          (f (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k))
          (f (eulerMaclaurinNode a h (k + 1)))) =
      eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f (eulerMaclaurinNode a h k) h
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid
  rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_succ]

name: compositeTrapezoidValue_one
statement:
private theorem compositeTrapezoidValue_one
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (a h : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    compositeTrapezoidValue f a h 1 =
      eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f a h
proof:
:= by
  unfold compositeTrapezoidValue
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
  change
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul h (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)))
        (RealTheory.add
          (f (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0))
          (f (eulerMaclaurinNode a h (0 + 1)))) =
      eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid f a h
  rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_zero]
  rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_succ]
  rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_zero]
  rfl

name: exists_eulerMaclaurinPrefix
statement:
private theorem exists_eulerMaclaurinPrefix
    (a h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat)
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hm : 2 <= m) :
    forall n : Nat,
      0 < n ->
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
          (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n)) f D m ->
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
          (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n)) (D m) ->
      Exists fun J : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        Exists fun K : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
              (eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand D a h m)
              (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
              (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n) J /\
          RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
              f (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
              (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n) K /\
          K = RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.sub
              (compositeTrapezoidValue f a h n)
              (eulerMaclaurinCorrection D
                a (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n) h m))
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.mul
                (eulerMaclaurinSign m)
                (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m)) J)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hhNonneg : F.le F.zero h := F.le_of_lt hh
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro hn _hD _hDm
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
      intro hn hD hDm
      by_cases hnZero : n = 0
      case pos =>
        subst n
        have hnodeOne := eulerMaclaurinNode_succ a h 0
        have hDcell := hD
        have hDmcell := hDm
        rw [hnodeOne] at hDcell hDmcell
        cases exists_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_derivativeChain_cell
            (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0) h m f D hh hm hDcell with
        | intro I hI =>
          cases hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_eulerMaclaurinCell
              (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0) h m f D I
              hh hm hDcell hDmcell hI with
          | intro J hJ =>
            have hJperiodic :=
              hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_eulerMaclaurinCell_periodic
                D a h m 0 J hh hm hJ.left
            refine Exists.intro J ?_
            refine Exists.intro I ?_
            refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · rw [hnodeOne]
              exact hJperiodic
            · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
              · rw [hnodeOne]
                exact hI
              · have hEq := hJ.right
                change
                  I = F.add
                    (F.sub
                      (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid
                        f (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0) h)
                      (eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection
                        D (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0) h m))
                    (F.mul
                      (F.mul
                        (eulerMaclaurinSign m)
                        (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m)) J) at hEq
                rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_zero] at hEq
                rw [compositeTrapezoidValue_one]
                rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_succ]
                rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_zero]
                rw [eulerMaclaurinCorrection_cell]
                exact hEq
      case neg =>
        have hnPos : 0 < n := by omega
        have hprefixSubset :
            forall x : RealTheory.Carrier,
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval
                  (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
                  (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n) x ->
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval
                  (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
                  (eulerMaclaurinNode a h (n + 1)) x := by
          intro x hx
          exact And.intro hx.left
            (F.le_trans hx.right
              (eulerMaclaurinNode_le_of_le
                a h hhNonneg (Nat.le_succ n)))
        have hcellSubset :=
          eulerMaclaurinCell_subset a h (n + 1) n hhNonneg (by omega)
        have hDprefix :=
          RealDerivative.hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_subset hprefixSubset hD
        have hDmprefix :
            RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
              (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
                (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
                (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n)) (D m) := by
          change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
              (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
              (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n)) (D m)
          change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
              (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
              (eulerMaclaurinNode a h (n + 1))) (D m) at hDm
          exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hprefixSubset hDm
        cases ih hnPos hDprefix hDmprefix with
        | intro J₀ hJ₀ =>
          cases hJ₀ with
          | intro K₀ hprefix =>
            have hDcellNode :=
              RealDerivative.hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_subset hcellSubset hD
            have hDmcellNode :
                RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
                  (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
                    (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n)
                    (eulerMaclaurinNode a h (n + 1))) (D m) := by
              change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
                  (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n)
                  (eulerMaclaurinNode a h (n + 1))) (D m)
              change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
                  (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
                  (eulerMaclaurinNode a h (n + 1))) (D m) at hDm
              exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hcellSubset hDm
            have hnodeSucc := eulerMaclaurinNode_succ a h n
            rw [hnodeSucc] at hDcellNode hDmcellNode
            cases exists_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_derivativeChain_cell
                (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n) h m f D
                hh hm hDcellNode with
            | intro I₁ hI₁ =>
              cases hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_eulerMaclaurinCell
                  (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n) h m f D I₁
                  hh hm hDcellNode hDmcellNode hI₁ with
              | intro J₁ hJ₁ =>
                have hJ₁periodic :=
                  hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_eulerMaclaurinCell_periodic
                    D a h m n J₁ hh hm hJ₁.left
                rw [← hnodeSucc] at hJ₁periodic hI₁
                have hleftOrder := eulerMaclaurinNode_le_of_le
                  a h hhNonneg (Nat.zero_le n)
                have hrightOrder := eulerMaclaurinNode_le_of_le
                  a h hhNonneg (Nat.le_succ n)
                have hJ₀data :=
                  RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
                    hleftOrder hprefix.left
                have hJ₁data :=
                  RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
                    hrightOrder hJ₁periodic
                have hJtotal :=
                  RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_adjacent_ordered
                    hleftOrder hrightOrder
                    hJ₀data.left hJ₀data.right
                    hJ₁data.left hJ₁data.right
                have hK₀data :=
                  RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
                    hleftOrder hprefix.right.left
                have hI₁data :=
                  RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
                    hrightOrder hI₁
                have hKtotal :=
                  RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_adjacent_ordered
                    hleftOrder hrightOrder
                    hK₀data.left hK₀data.right
                    hI₁data.left hI₁data.right
                refine Exists.intro (F.add J₀ J₁) ?_
                refine Exists.intro (F.add K₀ I₁) ?_
                refine And.intro hJtotal ?_
                refine And.intro hKtotal ?_
                have hcellEq := hJ₁.right
                change
                  I₁ = F.add
                    (F.sub
                      (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid
                        f (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n) h)
                      (eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection
                        D (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n) h m))
                    (F.mul
                      (F.mul
                        (eulerMaclaurinSign m)
                        (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m)) J₁) at hcellEq
                rw [hprefix.right.right, hcellEq]
                rw [compositeTrapezoidValue_succ]
                rw [eulerMaclaurinCorrection_succ]
                exact eulerMaclaurinFormula_combine
                  (compositeTrapezoidValue f a h n)
                  (eulerMaclaurinCorrection D
                    a (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n) h m)
                  J₀
                  (eulerMaclaurinCellTrapezoid
                    f (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n) h)
                  (eulerMaclaurinCellCorrection
                    D (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n) h m)
                  J₁
                  (F.mul
                    (eulerMaclaurinSign m)
                    (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m))

name: eulerMaclaurinSign_abs
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinSign_abs (m : Nat) :
    RealTheory.abs (eulerMaclaurinSign m) = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      unfold eulerMaclaurinSign
      exact RealTheory.abs_one
  | succ m ih =>
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change
        F.abs
            (F.neg
              (Nat.rec RealTheory.one
                (fun (_ : Nat) (s : RealTheory.Carrier) =>
                  RealTheory.neg s) m)) =
          F.one
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg]
      unfold eulerMaclaurinSign at ih
      change
        F.abs
            (Nat.rec RealTheory.one
              (fun (_ : Nat) (s : RealTheory.Carrier) =>
                RealTheory.neg s) m) = F.one at ih
      exact ih

name: eulerMaclaurinCellScale_nonneg
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinCellScale_nonneg
    (h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpow : F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.powNat h m) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_pos hh m
  have hfactorial :
      F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (Tautology.Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)
  have hinv :
      F.lt F.zero
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))) :=
    F.inv_pos hfactorial
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCellScale
  exact F.le_of_lt (F.mul_pos hpow hinv)

name: eulerMaclaurinPeriodic_abs_le_major
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinPeriodic_abs_le_major
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (a h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat)
    (x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand D a h m x))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base m)
        (RealTheory.abs (D m x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand
  change
    F.le
      (F.abs
        (F.mul
          (periodicBernoulli m
            (F.mul (F.sub x a) (F.inv h)))
          (D m x)))
      (F.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F m)
        (F.abs (D m x)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul]
  exact F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
    (periodicBernoulli_abs_le m
      (F.mul (F.sub x a) (F.inv h)))
    (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (D m x))

name: eulerMaclaurin_fullRemainder_bound
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurin_fullRemainder_bound
    (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (a b h : RealTheory.Carrier) (m : Nat)
    (J A : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hh : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h)
    (hJ :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand D a h m)
        a b J)
    (hA :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.abs (D m x))
        a b A) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (eulerMaclaurinSign m)
            (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m)) J))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base m)) A)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let E := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F m
  have hJdata :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      hab hJ
  have hAdata :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      hab hA
  have hmajor :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.mul E (F.abs (D m x)))
        a b (F.mul E A) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_left_of_le
      E hab hAdata.left hAdata.right
  have hmajorData :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      hab hmajor
  have hpointUpper :
      forall x : RealTheory.Carrier,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
        F.le
          (eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand D a h m x)
          (F.mul E (F.abs (D m x))) := by
    intro x _hx
    exact F.le_trans
      (RealTheory.le_abs_self
        (eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand D a h m x))
      (eulerMaclaurinPeriodic_abs_le_major D a h m x)
  have hJupper : F.le J (F.mul E A) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      hab hpointUpper
      hJdata.left hJdata.right
      hmajorData.left hmajorData.right
  have hnegJ :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.neg (eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand D a h m x))
        a b (F.neg J) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_neg_of_le
      hab hJdata.left hJdata.right
  have hnegJdata :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      hab hnegJ
  have hpointLower :
      forall x : RealTheory.Carrier,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
        F.le
          (F.neg (eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand D a h m x))
          (F.mul E (F.abs (D m x))) := by
    intro x _hx
    exact F.le_trans
      (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self
        (eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand D a h m x))
      (eulerMaclaurinPeriodic_abs_le_major D a h m x)
  have hJlower : F.le (F.neg J) (F.mul E A) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      hab hpointLower
      hnegJdata.left hnegJdata.right
      hmajorData.left hmajorData.right
  have hJabs : F.le (F.abs J) (F.mul E A) :=
    RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hJupper hJlower
  have hscaleNonneg := eulerMaclaurinCellScale_nonneg h m hh
  have hscaled := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hJabs hscaleNonneg
  change
    F.le
      (F.abs
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m)
            (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m)) J))
      (F.mul
        (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m) E) A)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul]
  have hsignAbs := eulerMaclaurinSign_abs m
  change F.abs (eulerMaclaurinSign m) = F.one at hsignAbs
  rw [hsignAbs]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  have hscaleAbs := RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hscaleNonneg
  change
    F.abs (eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m) =
      eulerMaclaurinCellScale h m at hscaleAbs
  rw [hscaleAbs]
  rw [F.mul_assoc]
  exact hscaled

name: eulerMaclaurin_composite
statement:
theorem eulerMaclaurin_composite
    (a b : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (f : RealDerivative.Map) (D : Nat -> RealDerivative.Map)
    (I : RealTheory.Carrier) (m n : Nat)
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (hm : 2 <= m)
    (hD :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f D m)
    (hDm :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) (D m))
    (hI :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    let h
proof:
:= RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.sub b a) (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))
    let scaleAbs := RealTheory.mul
      (RealFunction.powNat h m)
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)))
    let scale := RealTheory.mul
      (Nat.rec RealTheory.one
        (fun (_ : Nat) (s : RealTheory.Carrier) => RealTheory.neg s) m)
      scaleAbs
    Exists fun J : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      Exists fun A : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (periodicBernoulli m
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.sub x a) (RealTheory.inv h)))
                (D m x)) a b J /\
        RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.abs (D m x))
            a b A /\
        I = RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub
            (compositeTrapezoidValue f a h n)
            (eulerMaclaurinCorrection D a b h m))
          (RealTheory.mul scale J) /\
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.mul scale J))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul scaleAbs
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base m)) A) := by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (RealTheory.nat n))
  let scaleAbs := F.mul
    (RealFunction.powNat h m)
    (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)))
  let scale := F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign m) scaleAbs
  change
    Exists fun J : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      Exists fun A : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
              F.mul
                (periodicBernoulli m
                  (F.mul (F.sub x a) (F.inv h)))
                (D m x)) a b J /\
        RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.abs (D m x)) a b A /\
        I = F.add
          (F.sub
            (compositeTrapezoidValue f a h n)
            (eulerMaclaurinCorrection D a b h m))
          (F.mul scale J) /\
        F.le
          (F.abs (F.mul scale J))
          (F.mul
            (F.mul scaleAbs
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F m)) A)
  have hnNe : Not (n = 0) := by omega
  have hsubPos : F.lt F.zero (F.sub b a) :=
    F.sub_pos_of_lt hab
  have hnRealPos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat n) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hnNe
  have hh : F.lt F.zero h := by
    unfold h
    exact F.mul_pos hsubPos (F.inv_pos hnRealPos)
  have hnodeEndRaw := eulerMaclaurinNode_rightEndpoint a b n hnNe
  have hnodeEnd : eulerMaclaurinNode a h n = b := by
    unfold h
    exact hnodeEndRaw
  have hDnodes :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
          (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n)) f D m := by
    rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_zero, hnodeEnd]
    exact hD
  have hDmnodes :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (eulerMaclaurinNode a h 0)
          (eulerMaclaurinNode a h n)) (D m) := by
    rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_zero, hnodeEnd]
    exact hDm
  cases exists_eulerMaclaurinPrefix
      a h m f D hh hm n hn hDnodes hDmnodes with
  | intro J hJK =>
    cases hJK with
    | intro K hprefix =>
      have hJab := hprefix.left
      rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_zero, hnodeEnd] at hJab
      have hKab := hprefix.right.left
      rw [eulerMaclaurinNode_zero, hnodeEnd] at hKab
      have habLe : F.le a b := F.le_of_lt hab
      have hIK : I = K :=
        RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
          hI hKab
      have hFormula := hprefix.right.right
      rw [hnodeEnd] at hFormula
      have hFormulaI := Eq.trans hIK hFormula
      change
        I = F.add
          (F.sub
            (compositeTrapezoidValue f a h n)
            (eulerMaclaurinCorrection D a b h m))
          (F.mul scale J) at hFormulaI
      have hAbsContinuous := RealFunction.continuousOn_abs hDm
      have hbMem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
        And.intro habLe (F.le_refl b)
      let A :=
        RealIntegral.Riemann.closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
          (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.abs (D m x))
          a b hAbsContinuous b
      have hA :
          RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.abs (D m x))
            a b A := by
        unfold A
        exact
          RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
            hAbsContinuous hbMem
      have hBound := eulerMaclaurin_fullRemainder_bound
        D a b h m J A habLe hh hJab hA
      change
        F.le
          (F.abs (F.mul scale J))
          (F.mul
            (F.mul scaleAbs
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F m)) A)
        at hBound
      refine Exists.intro J ?_
      refine Exists.intro A ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · change
          RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (eulerMaclaurinPeriodicRemainderIntegrand D a h m)
            a b J
        exact hJab
      · exact And.intro hA (And.intro hFormulaI hBound)

name: EulerMaclaurinInternal.eulerMaclaurinSign_succ
statement:
theorem EulerMaclaurinInternal.eulerMaclaurinSign_succ
    (m : Nat) :
    eulerMaclaurinSign (m + 1) =
      RealTheory.neg (eulerMaclaurinSign m)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: wallisCentralFactorialNumerator_succ
statement:
private theorem wallisCentralFactorialNumerator_succ
    (n : Nat) :
    wallisCentralFactorialNumerator (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (2 * n + 2))
          (RealTheory.nat (2 * n + 2)))
        (wallisCentralFactorialNumerator n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := RealFunction.powNat (F.nat 2) (2 * n)
  let f := F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial n)
  let u := F.nat (n + 1)
  let b := F.nat (2 * n + 2)
  have hpowIndex : 2 * (n + 1) = ((2 * n) + 1) + 1 := by omega
  have hb : b = F.mul (F.nat 2) u := by
    unfold b u
    change RealTheory.nat (2 * n + 2) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
    have hindex : 2 * n + 2 = 2 * (n + 1) := by omega
    rw [hindex, RealTheory.nat_mul]
    rfl
  unfold wallisCentralFactorialNumerator
  rw [hpowIndex, RealFunction.powNat_succ, RealFunction.powNat_succ]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_succ, RealTheory.nat_mul]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul p (F.nat 2)) (F.nat 2))
          (F.mul u f))
        (F.mul u f) =
      F.mul (F.mul b b) (F.mul (F.mul p f) f)
  rw [hb]
  have hmulLeftComm (x y z : RealTheory.Carrier) :
      F.mul x (F.mul y z) = F.mul y (F.mul x z) :=
    RealTheory.mul_left_comm x y z
  simp only [F.mul_assoc, hmulLeftComm, F.mul_comm]

name: wallisCentralFactorialDenominator_succ
statement:
private theorem wallisCentralFactorialDenominator_succ
    (n : Nat) :
    wallisCentralFactorialDenominator (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (2 * n + 2))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (2 * n + 1))
          (wallisCentralFactorialDenominator n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hindex : 2 * (n + 1) = (2 * n + 1) + 1 := by omega
  have hsucc : 2 * n + 1 + 1 = 2 * n + 2 := by omega
  unfold wallisCentralFactorialDenominator
  rw [hindex, Tautology.Nat.factorial_succ, RealTheory.nat_mul]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_succ, RealTheory.nat_mul]
  rw [hsucc]
  rfl

name: wallisCentralFactorialExpression_succ
statement:
private theorem wallisCentralFactorialExpression_succ
    (n : Nat) :
    wallisCentralFactorialExpression (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (2 * n + 2))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (2 * n + 1))))
        (wallisCentralFactorialExpression n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a := F.nat (2 * n + 1)
  let b := F.nat (2 * n + 2)
  let N := wallisCentralFactorialNumerator n
  let D := wallisCentralFactorialDenominator n
  have ha : Not (a = F.zero) := by
    unfold a
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hb : Not (b = F.zero) := by
    unfold b
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hDpos : F.lt F.zero D := by
    unfold D wallisCentralFactorialDenominator
    exact nat_factorial_pos (2 * n)
  have hD : Not (D = F.zero) := fun hz =>
    (F.ne_of_lt hDpos) hz.symm
  have haDpos : F.lt F.zero (F.mul a D) :=
    F.mul_pos (ia4_nat_pos_of_pos (by omega)) hDpos
  have haD : Not (F.mul a D = F.zero) := fun hz =>
    (F.ne_of_lt haDpos) hz.symm
  have hnum := wallisCentralFactorialNumerator_succ n
  have hden := wallisCentralFactorialDenominator_succ n
  change wallisCentralFactorialNumerator (n + 1) =
    F.mul (F.mul b b) N at hnum
  change wallisCentralFactorialDenominator (n + 1) =
    F.mul b (F.mul a D) at hden
  have hinv : F.inv (F.mul b (F.mul a D)) =
      F.mul (F.mul (F.inv D) (F.inv a)) (F.inv b) := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hb haD]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F ha hD]
  unfold wallisCentralFactorialExpression
  rw [hnum, hden]
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (F.mul b b) N)
        (F.inv (F.mul b (F.mul a D))) =
      F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv a)) (F.mul N (F.inv D))
  rw [hinv]
  have hmulLeftComm (x y z : RealTheory.Carrier) :
      F.mul x (F.mul y z) = F.mul y (F.mul x z) :=
    RealTheory.mul_left_comm x y z
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.mul b b) N)
        (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv D) (F.inv a)) (F.inv b)) =
        F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv b))
          (F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv a)) (F.mul N (F.inv D))) := by
      simp only [F.mul_assoc, hmulLeftComm, F.mul_comm]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv a)) (F.mul N (F.inv D)) := by
      rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hb, F.one_mul]

name: wallisCentralFactorialExpression_eq_central
statement:
private theorem wallisCentralFactorialExpression_eq_central :
    forall n : Nat,
      wallisCentralFactorialExpression n = wallisCentralRatio n
  | 0 => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      unfold wallisCentralFactorialExpression
        wallisCentralFactorialNumerator
        wallisCentralFactorialDenominator wallisCentralRatio
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      change RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.nat 1)) (RealTheory.nat 1))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 1)) = RealTheory.one
      rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
      change F.mul (F.mul (F.mul F.one F.one) F.one) (F.inv F.one) =
        F.one
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one, F.one_mul, F.mul_one]
      exact F.one_mul F.one
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [wallisCentralFactorialExpression_succ n]
      rw [wallisCentralFactorialExpression_eq_central n]
      rfl

name: ia4_log_powNat
statement:
private theorem ia4_log_powNat
    {x : RealTheory.Carrier}
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (RealFunction.powNat x n) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log x)
  | 0 => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      have hone := RealTheory.elementaryFunction_log_one_value
      change Ielem.logSpec.log F.one = F.zero at hone
      change Ielem.logSpec.log F.one =
        F.mul (F.nat 0) (Ielem.logSpec.log x)
      have hnatZero := RealTheory.nat_zero
      change F.nat 0 = F.zero at hnatZero
      rw [hone, hnatZero, F.zero_mul]
  | n + 1 => by
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
      let l := Ielem.logSpec.log x
      have hpowPos : F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.powNat x n) :=
        RealFunction.powNat_pos hx n
      have hmul := Ielem.logSpec.mul_law
        (RealFunction.powNat x n) x hpowPos hx
      change Ielem.logSpec.log
          (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x n) x) =
        F.add (Ielem.logSpec.log (RealFunction.powNat x n)) l at hmul
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
      change Ielem.logSpec.log
          (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x n) x) =
        F.mul (F.nat (n + 1)) l
      rw [hmul]
      have ih := ia4_log_powNat hx n
      change Ielem.logSpec.log (RealFunction.powNat x n) =
        F.mul (F.nat n) l at ih
      rw [ih]
      have hsucc := RealTheory.nat_succ n
      change F.nat (n + 1) = F.add (F.nat n) F.one at hsucc
      rw [hsucc, F.add_mul, F.one_mul]

name: log_wallisCentralRatio
statement:
private theorem log_wallisCentralRatio
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
        (wallisCentralRatio n) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (2 * n))
            (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
              (RealTheory.nat 2)))
          (RealTheory.add (logFactorial n) (logFactorial n)))
        (logFactorial (2 * n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  let t := F.nat 2
  let f := F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial n)
  let f2 := F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * n))
  let P := RealFunction.powNat t (2 * n)
  let N := F.mul (F.mul P f) f
  let A := F.mul N (F.inv f2)
  let l2 := Ielem.logSpec.log t
  let L := logFactorial n
  let L2 := logFactorial (2 * n)
  have ht : F.lt F.zero t := ia4_nat_pos_of_pos (by omega)
  have hf : F.lt F.zero f := nat_factorial_pos n
  have hf2 : F.lt F.zero f2 := nat_factorial_pos (2 * n)
  have hP : F.lt F.zero P := RealFunction.powNat_pos ht (2 * n)
  have hN : F.lt F.zero N := F.mul_pos (F.mul_pos hP hf) hf
  have hlogPow := ia4_log_powNat ht (2 * n)
  change Ielem.logSpec.log P = F.mul (F.nat (2 * n)) l2 at hlogPow
  have hlogFirst := Ielem.logSpec.mul_law P f hP hf
  change Ielem.logSpec.log (F.mul P f) =
    F.add (Ielem.logSpec.log P) (Ielem.logSpec.log f) at hlogFirst
  have hlogN := Ielem.logSpec.mul_law (F.mul P f) f
    (F.mul_pos hP hf) hf
  change Ielem.logSpec.log N =
    F.add (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.mul P f)) (Ielem.logSpec.log f) at hlogN
  rw [hlogFirst, hlogPow] at hlogN
  have hLf : Ielem.logSpec.log f = L := by rfl
  have hLf2 : Ielem.logSpec.log f2 = L2 := by rfl
  rw [hLf] at hlogN
  have hlogInv := Ielem.logSpec.inv_eq_neg hf2
  change Ielem.logSpec.log (F.inv f2) =
    F.neg (Ielem.logSpec.log f2) at hlogInv
  rw [hLf2] at hlogInv
  have hlogA := Ielem.logSpec.mul_law N (F.inv f2)
    hN (F.inv_pos hf2)
  change Ielem.logSpec.log A =
    F.add (Ielem.logSpec.log N) (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.inv f2)) at hlogA
  rw [hlogN, hlogInv] at hlogA
  have hcentral := wallisCentralFactorialExpression_eq_central n
  unfold wallisCentralFactorialExpression wallisCentralFactorialNumerator
    wallisCentralFactorialDenominator at hcentral
  change A = wallisCentralRatio n at hcentral
  rw [<- hcentral]
  change Ielem.logSpec.log A =
    F.sub (F.add (F.mul (F.nat (2 * n)) l2) (F.add L L)) L2
  rw [hlogA, F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.add_assoc (F.mul (F.nat (2 * n)) l2) L L]

name: log_wallisCentralNormalizedSq
statement:
private theorem log_wallisCentralNormalizedSq
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
        (wallisCentralNormalizedSq n) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (wallisCentralRatio n))
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (wallisCentralRatio n)))
        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (RealTheory.nat n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  let A := wallisCentralRatio n
  let q := F.nat n
  let V := wallisCentralNormalizedSq n
  have hA : F.lt F.zero A := wallisCentralRatio_pos n
  have hq : F.lt F.zero q := ia4_nat_pos_of_pos hn
  have hAA : F.lt F.zero (F.mul A A) := F.mul_pos hA hA
  have hlogAA := Ielem.logSpec.mul_law A A hA hA
  change Ielem.logSpec.log (F.mul A A) =
    F.add (Ielem.logSpec.log A) (Ielem.logSpec.log A) at hlogAA
  have hlogInv := Ielem.logSpec.inv_eq_neg hq
  change Ielem.logSpec.log (F.inv q) = F.neg (Ielem.logSpec.log q)
    at hlogInv
  have hlogV := Ielem.logSpec.mul_law (F.mul A A) (F.inv q)
    hAA (F.inv_pos hq)
  change Ielem.logSpec.log (F.mul (F.mul A A) (F.inv q)) =
    F.add (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.mul A A))
      (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.inv q)) at hlogV
  unfold wallisCentralNormalizedSq
  change Ielem.logSpec.log (F.mul (F.mul A A) (F.inv q)) =
    F.sub
      (F.add (Ielem.logSpec.log A) (Ielem.logSpec.log A))
      (Ielem.logSpec.log q)
  rw [hlogV, hlogAA, hlogInv, F.sub_eq_add_neg]

name: centeredLogFactorialSequence_double_tendsto_stirlingConstant
statement:
private theorem
    centeredLogFactorialSequence_double_tendsto_stirlingConstant :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat => centeredLogFactorialSequence (2 * k + 1))
      stirlingConstant
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seqTendsto_of_subsequenceIndex
      F
      (u := centeredLogFactorialSequence)
      (phi := fun k : Nat => 2 * k + 1)
      centeredLogFactorialSequence_tendsto_stirlingConstant
      (by
        intro k
        change 2 * k + 1 < 2 * (k + 1) + 1
        omega)
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.subsequence at hsub
  exact hsub

name: centeredLogFactorialSequence_duplication_eq_log_central
statement:
private theorem
    centeredLogFactorialSequence_duplication_eq_log_central
    (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.add
          (centeredLogFactorialSequence k)
          (centeredLogFactorialSequence k))
        (centeredLogFactorialSequence (2 * k + 1)) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (wallisCentralRatio (k + 1)))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
              (RealTheory.nat 2))
            (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
              (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  let n := k + 1
  let q := F.nat n
  let q2 := F.nat (2 * n)
  let t := F.nat 2
  let l := Ielem.logSpec.log q
  let l2 := Ielem.logSpec.log t
  let lq2 := Ielem.logSpec.log q2
  let L := logFactorial n
  let L2 := logFactorial (2 * n)
  let C := centeredLogFactorialSequence k
  let C2 := centeredLogFactorialSequence (2 * k + 1)
  let A := wallisCentralRatio n
  have hq : F.lt F.zero q := ia4_nat_pos_of_pos (by unfold n; omega)
  have ht : F.lt F.zero t := ia4_nat_pos_of_pos (by omega)
  have hq2Cast : q2 = F.mul t q := by
    unfold q2 t q
    exact RealTheory.nat_mul 2 n
  have htAdd : t = F.add F.one F.one := by
    unfold t
    have hsucc := RealTheory.nat_succ 1
    rw [RealTheory.nat_one] at hsucc
    exact hsucc
  have hq2Add : q2 = F.add q q := by
    rw [hq2Cast, htAdd, F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
  have hlogQ2Mul := Ielem.logSpec.mul_law t q ht hq
  change Ielem.logSpec.log (F.mul t q) = F.add l2 l at hlogQ2Mul
  have hlogQ2 : lq2 = F.add l2 l := by
    unfold lq2
    rw [hq2Cast, hlogQ2Mul]
  have hlogA := log_wallisCentralRatio n
  change Ielem.logSpec.log A =
    F.sub (F.add (F.mul q2 l2) (F.add L L)) L2 at hlogA
  have hindex : (2 * k + 1) + 1 = 2 * n := by
    unfold n
    omega
  have hC : C =
      F.add
        (F.sub L (F.mul (F.add q (F.half F.one)) l)) q := by
    rfl
  have hC2 : C2 =
      F.add
        (F.sub L2 (F.mul (F.add q2 (F.half F.one)) lq2)) q2 := by
    unfold C2 centeredLogFactorialSequence
    rw [hindex]
    rfl
  have hhalfNeg (x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
      F.half (F.neg x) = F.neg (F.half x) := by
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
    exact F.neg_mul x (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F))
  have haddLeftComm (a b c : RealTheory.Carrier) :
      F.add a (F.add b c) = F.add b (F.add a c) := by
    calc
      F.add a (F.add b c) = F.add (F.add a b) c := by rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add (F.add b a) c := by rw [F.add_comm a b]
      _ = F.add b (F.add a c) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
  have haddPair (a b c d : RealTheory.Carrier) :
      F.add (F.add a b) (F.add c d) =
        F.add (F.add a c) (F.add b d) := by
    exact RealTheory.add_add_add_comm a b c d
  have hhalfOneMul (x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
      F.mul (F.half F.one) x = F.half x := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_one_mul F x
  have hhalfAdd (x y : RealTheory.Carrier) :
      F.half (F.add x y) = F.add (F.half x) (F.half y) := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add F x y
  have hmulSingle :
      F.mul (F.add q (F.half F.one)) l =
        F.add (F.mul q l) (F.half l) := by
    rw [F.add_mul, hhalfOneMul]
  have hmulDouble :
      F.mul (F.add (F.add q q) (F.half F.one)) (F.add l2 l) =
        F.add
          (F.add (F.add (F.mul q l2) (F.mul q l2)) (F.half l2))
          (F.add (F.add (F.mul q l) (F.mul q l)) (F.half l)) := by
    simp only [F.add_mul, F.mul_add, hhalfOneMul]
    calc
      F.add
          (F.add (F.add (F.mul q l2) (F.mul q l))
            (F.add (F.mul q l2) (F.mul q l)))
          (F.add (F.half l2) (F.half l)) =
          F.add
            (F.add (F.add (F.mul q l2) (F.mul q l2))
              (F.add (F.mul q l) (F.mul q l)))
            (F.add (F.half l2) (F.half l)) := by
        rw [haddPair
          (F.mul q l2) (F.mul q l) (F.mul q l2) (F.mul q l)]
      _ = F.add
          (F.add (F.add (F.mul q l2) (F.mul q l2)) (F.half l2))
          (F.add (F.add (F.mul q l) (F.mul q l)) (F.half l)) := by
        exact haddPair
          (F.add (F.mul q l2) (F.mul q l2))
          (F.add (F.mul q l) (F.mul q l))
          (F.half l2) (F.half l)
  have hmulQ2L2 :
      F.mul (F.add q q) l2 = F.add (F.mul q l2) (F.mul q l2) := by
    rw [F.add_mul]
  have hhalfSub :
      F.half (F.sub l2 l) = F.sub (F.half l2) (F.half l) := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, hhalfAdd, hhalfNeg, F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  change F.sub (F.add C C) C2 =
    F.add (Ielem.logSpec.log A) (F.half (F.sub l2 l))
  rw [hC, hC2, hlogA, hq2Add, hlogQ2]
  rw [hmulSingle, hmulDouble, hmulQ2L2, hhalfSub]
  simp only [F.sub_eq_add_neg, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F,
    F.neg_neg]
  let x := F.mul q l
  let y := F.half l
  let a := F.mul q l2
  let b := F.half l2
  let LL := F.add L L
  let AA := F.add a a
  let Nx := F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg x)
  let Ny := F.add (F.neg y) (F.neg y)
  let Px := F.add x x
  let PosA := F.add AA b
  let PosXY := F.add Px y
  let B := F.add L (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y))
  let Big := F.add LL (F.add Nx Ny)
  let E := F.add (F.neg L2) (F.add PosA PosXY)
  change F.add
      (F.add (F.add B q) (F.add B q))
      (F.add E (F.add (F.neg q) (F.neg q))) =
    F.add (F.add (F.add AA LL) (F.neg L2)) (F.add b (F.neg y))
  have hDouble :
      F.add (F.add B q) (F.add B q) = F.add Big (F.add q q) := by
    unfold Big B LL Nx Ny
    calc
      F.add
          (F.add (F.add L (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y))) q)
          (F.add (F.add L (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y))) q) =
          F.add
            (F.add
              (F.add L (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y)))
              (F.add L (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y))))
            (F.add q q) :=
        haddPair
          (F.add L (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y))) q
          (F.add L (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y))) q
      _ = F.add
          (F.add (F.add L L)
            (F.add
              (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y))
              (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y))))
          (F.add q q) := by
        rw [haddPair L (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y))
          L (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg y))]
      _ = F.add
          (F.add (F.add L L)
            (F.add
              (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg x))
              (F.add (F.neg y) (F.neg y))))
          (F.add q q) := by
        rw [haddPair (F.neg x) (F.neg y) (F.neg x) (F.neg y)]
  have hqCancel :
      F.add (F.add q q) (F.add (F.neg q) (F.neg q)) = F.zero := by
    calc
      F.add (F.add q q) (F.add (F.neg q) (F.neg q)) =
          F.add (F.add q (F.neg q)) (F.add q (F.neg q)) :=
        haddPair q q (F.neg q) (F.neg q)
      _ = F.add F.zero F.zero := by rw [F.add_neg]
      _ = F.zero := by rw [F.zero_add]
  have hremoveQ :
      F.add (F.add Big (F.add q q))
          (F.add E (F.add (F.neg q) (F.neg q))) =
        F.add Big E := by
    calc
      F.add (F.add Big (F.add q q))
          (F.add E (F.add (F.neg q) (F.neg q))) =
          F.add (F.add Big E)
            (F.add (F.add q q) (F.add (F.neg q) (F.neg q))) :=
        haddPair Big (F.add q q) E (F.add (F.neg q) (F.neg q))
      _ = F.add (F.add Big E) F.zero := by rw [hqCancel]
      _ = F.add Big E := by rw [F.add_zero]
  have hxCancel : F.add Nx Px = F.zero := by
    unfold Nx Px
    calc
      F.add (F.add (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) (F.add x x) =
          F.add (F.add (F.neg x) x) (F.add (F.neg x) x) :=
        haddPair (F.neg x) (F.neg x) x x
      _ = F.add F.zero F.zero := by rw [F.neg_add]
      _ = F.zero := by rw [F.zero_add]
  have hyCancel : F.add y Ny = F.neg y := by
    unfold Ny
    calc
      F.add y (F.add (F.neg y) (F.neg y)) =
          F.add (F.add y (F.neg y)) (F.neg y) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add F.zero (F.neg y) := by rw [F.add_neg]
      _ = F.neg y := by rw [F.zero_add]
  have hcancelBlock :
      F.add (F.add Nx Ny) (F.add PosA PosXY) =
        F.add PosA (F.neg y) := by
    calc
      F.add (F.add Nx Ny) (F.add PosA PosXY) =
          F.add (F.add Nx Ny) (F.add PosXY PosA) := by
        rw [F.add_comm PosA PosXY]
      _ = F.add (F.add Nx PosXY) (F.add Ny PosA) :=
        haddPair Nx Ny PosXY PosA
      _ = F.add (F.add (F.add Nx Px) y) (F.add Ny PosA) := by
        unfold PosXY
        exact congrArg (fun z => F.add z (F.add Ny PosA))
          (F.add_assoc Nx Px y).symm
      _ = F.add y (F.add Ny PosA) := by rw [hxCancel, F.zero_add]
      _ = F.add (F.add y Ny) PosA := by rw [<- F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add (F.neg y) PosA := by rw [hyCancel]
      _ = F.add PosA (F.neg y) := by rw [F.add_comm]
  have houter :
      F.add Big E =
        F.add (F.add LL (F.neg L2))
          (F.add (F.add Nx Ny) (F.add PosA PosXY)) := by
    unfold Big E
    exact haddPair LL (F.add Nx Ny) (F.neg L2) (F.add PosA PosXY)
  have hfinal :
      F.add (F.add LL (F.neg L2)) (F.add PosA (F.neg y)) =
        F.add (F.add (F.add AA LL) (F.neg L2))
          (F.add b (F.neg y)) := by
    unfold PosA
    calc
      F.add (F.add LL (F.neg L2)) (F.add (F.add AA b) (F.neg y)) =
          F.add (F.add LL (F.add AA b))
            (F.add (F.neg L2) (F.neg y)) :=
        haddPair LL (F.neg L2) (F.add AA b) (F.neg y)
      _ = F.add (F.add (F.add LL AA) b)
          (F.add (F.neg L2) (F.neg y)) := by
        exact congrArg
          (fun z => F.add z (F.add (F.neg L2) (F.neg y)))
          (F.add_assoc LL AA b).symm
      _ = F.add (F.add (F.add AA LL) b)
          (F.add (F.neg L2) (F.neg y)) := by rw [F.add_comm LL AA]
      _ = F.add (F.add (F.add AA LL) (F.neg L2))
          (F.add b (F.neg y)) :=
        haddPair (F.add AA LL) b (F.neg L2) (F.neg y)
  rw [hDouble, hremoveQ, houter, hcancelBlock, hfinal]

name: centeredLogFactorialSequence_wallis_identity
statement:
private theorem centeredLogFactorialSequence_wallis_identity
    (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.add
          (centeredLogFactorialSequence k)
          (centeredLogFactorialSequence k))
        (centeredLogFactorialSequence (2 * k + 1)) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (RealTheory.nat 2))
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (wallisCentralNormalizedSq (k + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  let n := k + 1
  let l2 := Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat 2)
  let l := Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n)
  let LA := Ielem.logSpec.log (wallisCentralRatio n)
  let LV := Ielem.logSpec.log (wallisCentralNormalizedSq n)
  have hdup :=
    centeredLogFactorialSequence_duplication_eq_log_central k
  change F.sub
      (F.add (centeredLogFactorialSequence k)
        (centeredLogFactorialSequence k))
      (centeredLogFactorialSequence (2 * k + 1)) =
    F.add LA (F.half (F.sub l2 l)) at hdup
  have hlogV := log_wallisCentralNormalizedSq n (by unfold n; omega)
  change LV = F.sub (F.add LA LA) l at hlogV
  have hhalfAdd (x y : RealTheory.Carrier) :
      F.half (F.add x y) = F.add (F.half x) (F.half y) := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add F x y
  have hhalfNeg (x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
      F.half (F.neg x) = F.neg (F.half x) := by
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
    exact F.neg_mul x (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F))
  have hhalfDouble : F.half (F.add LA LA) = LA := by
    rw [hhalfAdd, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F]
  have hhalfSub :
      F.half (F.sub l2 l) = F.add (F.half l2) (F.neg (F.half l)) := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, hhalfAdd, hhalfNeg]
  have hright :
      F.half (F.add l2 (F.sub (F.add LA LA) l)) =
        F.add (F.half l2) (F.add LA (F.neg (F.half l))) := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, hhalfAdd, hhalfAdd, hhalfDouble, hhalfNeg]
  change F.sub
      (F.add (centeredLogFactorialSequence k)
        (centeredLogFactorialSequence k))
      (centeredLogFactorialSequence (2 * k + 1)) =
    F.half (F.add l2 LV)
  rw [hdup, hlogV, hhalfSub, hright]
  calc
    F.add LA (F.add (F.half l2) (F.neg (F.half l))) =
        F.add (F.half l2) (F.add LA (F.neg (F.half l))) := by
      calc
        F.add LA (F.add (F.half l2) (F.neg (F.half l))) =
            F.add (F.add LA (F.half l2)) (F.neg (F.half l)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
        _ = F.add (F.add (F.half l2) LA) (F.neg (F.half l)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm LA (F.half l2)]
        _ = F.add (F.half l2) (F.add LA (F.neg (F.half l))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]

name: stirlingConstant_eq_half_log_two_pi
statement:
private theorem stirlingConstant_eq_half_log_two_pi
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec) :
    stirlingConstant =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
            (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  let C := stirlingConstant
  let p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  let l2 := Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat 2)
  let lp := Ielem.logSpec.log p
  have hC := centeredLogFactorialSequence_tendsto_stirlingConstant
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto centeredLogFactorialSequence C at hC
  have hdouble :=
    centeredLogFactorialSequence_double_tendsto_stirlingConstant
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat => centeredLogFactorialSequence (2 * k + 1)) C at hdouble
  have hleft := RealTheory.seqTendsto_sub
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_add hC hC) hdouble
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.sub
        (F.add (centeredLogFactorialSequence k)
          (centeredLogFactorialSequence k))
        (centeredLogFactorialSequence (2 * k + 1)))
    (F.sub (F.add C C) C) at hleft
  have hleftLimit : F.sub (F.add C C) C = C := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg, F.add_assoc, F.add_neg, F.add_zero]
  rw [hleftLimit] at hleft
  have hlogV := log_wallisCentralNormalizedSq_tendsto_log_pi S
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat => Ielem.logSpec.log (wallisCentralNormalizedSq (k + 1)))
    lp at hlogV
  have hsum := RealTheory.seqTendsto_add
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const l2) hlogV
  have hhalf := RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul hsum
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const
      (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F)))
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.half
        (F.add l2
          (Ielem.logSpec.log (wallisCentralNormalizedSq (k + 1)))))
    (F.half (F.add l2 lp)) at hhalf
  have hidentified : RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat =>
        F.sub
          (F.add (centeredLogFactorialSequence k)
            (centeredLogFactorialSequence k))
          (centeredLogFactorialSequence (2 * k + 1)))
      (F.half (F.add l2 lp)) :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hhalf
      (Exists.intro 0 (fun k _hk =>
        centeredLogFactorialSequence_wallis_identity k))
  have hconstant : C = F.half (F.add l2 lp) :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hleft hidentified
  have htwo : F.lt F.zero (F.nat 2) := ia4_nat_pos_of_pos (by omega)
  have hpi : F.lt F.zero p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi_pos S
  have hlogMul := Ielem.logSpec.mul_law (F.nat 2) p htwo hpi
  change Ielem.logSpec.log (F.mul (F.nat 2) p) = F.add l2 lp at hlogMul
  change C = F.half (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.mul (F.nat 2) p))
  rw [hlogMul]
  exact hconstant

name: stirling_log_fixedOrder
statement:
theorem stirling_log_fixedOrder
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (m : Nat) {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) :
    let p
proof:
:= 2 * m + 2
    Exists fun R : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      logFactorial n =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                    (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                      (RealTheory.nat n)))
                  (RealTheory.nat n))
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                  (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                    (RealTheory.nat n))))
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
                    (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)))))
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat =>
                let q := 2 * (r + 1)
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
                        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base q)
                      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q)))
                    (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (q - 1))))
                  (RealTheory.inv
                    (RealFunction.powNat
                      (RealTheory.nat n) (q - 1))))
              m)) R /\
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs R)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
                    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base p))
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base p))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat p)))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (p - 1))))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) (p - 1)))) := by
  dsimp only
  have hmain := logFactorial_fixedOrder_with_stirlingConstant m n hn
  dsimp only at hmain
  rw [stirlingConstant_eq_half_log_two_pi S] at hmain
  exact hmain

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_reciprocalPowerMap_succ
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_reciprocalPowerMap_succ
    (q : Nat) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain
      (reciprocalPowerMap (q + 1))
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealTheory.neg
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (q + 1))
            (reciprocalPowerMap (q + 2) x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hraw := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_inv
    (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_powerFun
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain (q + 1))
    (fun x hx => by
      have hx0 : Not (x = F.zero) := by
        intro hzero
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hzero.symm
      exact RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hx0 (q + 1))
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain
        (RealFunction.InvFun (RealFunction.PowerFun (q + 1)))
        (reciprocalPowerMap (q + 1)) := by
    intro x hx
    rfl
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain
        (RealDerivative.InvDerivativeFormula
          (RealFunction.PowerFun (q + 1))
          (RealDerivative.PowerDerivative (q + 1)))
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.neg (F.mul (F.nat (q + 1))
            (reciprocalPowerMap (q + 2) x))) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : Not (x = F.zero) :=
      fun hzero => (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hzero.symm
    let A := F.nat (q + 1)
    have hcancel :
        F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x q)
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1))) =
          F.inv x := by
      exact RealFunction.powNat_mul_inv_powNat_succ hx0 q
    have hinside :
        F.mul
            (F.mul
              (F.mul A (RealFunction.powNat x q))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1))))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1))) =
          F.mul A (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 2))) := by
      calc
        F.mul
            (F.mul
