              (F.mul A (RealFunction.powNat x q))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1))))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1))) =
            F.mul A
              (F.mul
                (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x q)
                  (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1))))
                (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1)))) := by
              rw [F.mul_assoc A (RealFunction.powNat x q)
                (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1)))]
              rw [F.mul_assoc A
                (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat x q)
                  (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1))))
                (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1)))]
        _ = F.mul A
              (F.mul (F.inv x)
                (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1)))) := by
              rw [hcancel]
        _ = F.mul A
              (F.mul (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1)))
                (F.inv x)) := by
              rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv x)
                (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1)))]
        _ = F.mul A
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x ((q + 1) + 1))) := by
              exact congrArg (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier => F.mul A z)
                (RealFunction.inv_powNat_succ_of_ne_zero
                  hx0 (q + 1)).symm
        _ = F.mul A (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 2))) := by
              congr
    unfold RealDerivative.InvDerivativeFormula RealFunction.PowerFun
      RealDerivative.PowerDerivative reciprocalPowerMap
    change
      F.neg (F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul A (RealFunction.powNat x q))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1))))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 1)))) =
        F.neg (F.mul A
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (q + 2))))
    exact congrArg F.neg hinside
  exact RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hraw)

name: reciprocalDerivativeAt_zero_sameOn
statement:
private theorem reciprocalDerivativeAt_zero_sameOn
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) :
    RealFunction.SameOn E
      (reciprocalDerivativeAt 0)
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold reciprocalDerivativeAt reciprocalPowerMap
    eulerMaclaurinSign RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
  change
    F.mul (F.mul F.one (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial 0)))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x 1)) =
      F.inv x
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_zero]
  have hone : F.nat 1 = F.one := by
    exact RealTheory.nat_one
  rw [hone]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_one]

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_reciprocalDerivativeAt_step
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_reciprocalDerivativeAt_step
    (k : Nat) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain
      (reciprocalDerivativeAt k)
      (reciprocalDerivativeAt (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbase := hasDerivativeWithinOn_reciprocalPowerMap_succ k
  have hscaled := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul
    (c := F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign k)
      (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k))) hbase
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
  · intro x hx
    let s := eulerMaclaurinSign k
    let f := F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)
    let a := F.nat (k + 1)
    let v := reciprocalPowerMap (k + 2) x
    have hsign : eulerMaclaurinSign (k + 1) = F.neg s := by
      exact eulerMaclaurinSign_succ k
    have hfact :
        F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (k + 1)) =
          F.mul a f := by
      rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_succ]
      change F.nat ((k + 1) * Tautology.Nat.factorial k) =
        F.mul (F.nat (k + 1))
          (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k))
      exact RealTheory.nat_mul (k + 1) (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)
    unfold reciprocalDerivativeAt RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
    change
      F.mul (F.mul s f) (F.neg (F.mul a v)) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign (k + 1))
            (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (k + 1)))) v
    rw [hsign, hfact]
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul s f) (F.neg (F.mul a v)) =
          F.neg (F.mul (F.mul s f) (F.mul a v)) := by
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F _ _
      _ = F.neg (F.mul (F.mul s (F.mul f a)) v) := by
            congr 1
            rw [F.mul_assoc s f (F.mul a v)]
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc f a v]
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc s (F.mul f a) v]
      _ = F.neg (F.mul (F.mul s (F.mul a f)) v) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm f a]
      _ = F.mul (F.neg (F.mul s (F.mul a f))) v := by
            exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F _ _).symm
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.neg s) (F.mul a f)) v := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F s (F.mul a f)]
  · change RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain
      (reciprocalDerivativeAt k)
      (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
        (F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign k)
          (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)))
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.neg (F.mul (F.nat (k + 1))
            (reciprocalPowerMap (k + 2) x)))) at hscaled
    exact hscaled

name: reciprocalDerivative_hasDerivativeChainWithinOn
statement:
private theorem reciprocalDerivative_hasDerivativeChainWithinOn
    (p : Nat) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
      reciprocalDerivativeAt p
proof:
:= by
  exact And.intro
    (reciprocalDerivativeAt_zero_sameOn
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain)
    (fun k hk => hasDerivativeWithinOn_reciprocalDerivativeAt_step k)

name: nat_interval_subset_positive
statement:
theorem nat_interval_subset_positive
    {n N : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) :
    forall x : RealTheory.Carrier,
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N) x ->
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnPos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat n) := by
    have hraw := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
    change F.lt (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n) at hraw
    rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at hraw
    exact hraw
  intro x hx
  exact F.lt_of_lt_of_le hnPos hx.left

name: reciprocalDerivative_hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_natInterval
statement:
theorem reciprocalDerivative_hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_natInterval
    (n N p : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N))
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
      reciprocalDerivativeAt p
proof:
:= by
  exact RealDerivative.hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_subset
    (nat_interval_subset_positive hn)
    (reciprocalDerivative_hasDerivativeChainWithinOn p)

name: reciprocalDerivativeAt_continuousOn_natInterval
statement:
theorem reciprocalDerivativeAt_continuousOn_natInterval
    (n N p : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N))
      (reciprocalDerivativeAt p)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N)
  have hnPos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat n) := by
    have hraw := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
    change F.lt (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n) at hraw
    rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at hraw
    exact hraw
  have hpow :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealFunction.powNat x (p + 1)) := by
    have hraw := RealTheory.function_continuousOn_powerFun
      (E := E) (p + 1)
    change RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealFunction.powNat x (p + 1)) at hraw
    exact hraw
  have hinv :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (p + 1))) := by
    exact RealTheory.function_continuousOn_inv hpow
      (fun x hx => by
        have hxPos : F.lt F.zero x := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hnPos hx.left
        have hx0 : Not (x = F.zero) := by
          intro hzero
          exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxPos) hzero.symm
        exact RealFunction.powNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hx0 (p + 1))
  have hmul := RealTheory.function_continuousOn_mul
    (E := E)
    (RealTheory.function_continuousOn_const
      (c := F.mul (eulerMaclaurinSign p)
        (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial p))))
    hinv
  change RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn E
    (reciprocalDerivativeAt p) at hmul
  exact hmul

name: eulerMaclaurinSign_even
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinSign_even
    (r : Nat) :
    eulerMaclaurinSign (2 * r) = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      rfl
  | succ r ih =>
      have hfirst := eulerMaclaurinSign_succ (2 * r)
      have hsecond := eulerMaclaurinSign_succ (2 * r + 1)
      have hindex : 2 * (r + 1) = (2 * r + 1) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hindex]
      rw [hsecond]
      rw [hfirst]
      rw [ih]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F F.one

name: eulerMaclaurinSign_odd
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurinSign_odd
    (r : Nat) :
    eulerMaclaurinSign (2 * r + 1) = RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have h := eulerMaclaurinSign_succ (2 * r)
  rw [eulerMaclaurinSign_even r] at h
  exact h

name: factorialInverse_mul_previous
statement:
theorem factorialInverse_mul_previous
    (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (k + 1))))
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)) =
      RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hk : Not (F.nat (k + 1) = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
  have hfact :
      Not (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k) = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (Tautology.Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_mul]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.inv
          (F.mul (F.nat (k + 1))
            (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k))))
        (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)) =
      F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hk hfact]
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)))
          (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))))
        (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)))
            (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k))))
          (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)) := by
      rw [F.mul_comm
        (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)))
        (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)))]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)))
          (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)))
            (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k))) := by
      rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))) F.one := by
      rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hfact]
    _ = F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)) := by
      rw [F.mul_one]

name: reciprocalDerivativeAt_odd_value
statement:
theorem reciprocalDerivativeAt_odd_value
    (r : Nat) (x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * r + 1) x =
      RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat
            (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * r + 1)))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * r + 2))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold reciprocalDerivativeAt reciprocalPowerMap
    RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
  rw [eulerMaclaurinSign_odd r]
  have hindex : 2 * r + 1 + 1 = 2 * r + 2 := by omega
  rw [hindex]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul (F.neg F.one)
          (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * r + 1))))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * r + 2))) =
      F.neg
        (F.mul
          (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * r + 1)))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * r + 2))))
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (F.neg F.one)
          (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * r + 1))))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * r + 2))) =
        F.mul
          (F.neg
            (F.mul F.one
              (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * r + 1)))))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * r + 2))) := by
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F F.one
        (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * r + 1)))]
    _ = F.mul
          (F.neg (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * r + 1))))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * r + 2))) := by
      rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.neg
          (F.mul
            (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * r + 1)))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * r + 2)))) := by
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F _ _

name: reciprocalDerivativeAt_even_value
statement:
theorem reciprocalDerivativeAt_even_value
    (r : Nat) (x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * r) x =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * r)))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * r + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold reciprocalDerivativeAt reciprocalPowerMap
    RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
  rw [eulerMaclaurinSign_even r]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul F.one
          (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * r))))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * r + 1))) =
      F.mul
        (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * r)))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * r + 1)))
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: logDerivativeAt_zero_sameOn
statement:
private theorem logDerivativeAt_zero_sameOn
    (E : RealDerivative.Domain) :
    RealFunction.SameOn E
      (logDerivativeAt 0)
      RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rfl

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_logDerivativeAt_step
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_logDerivativeAt_step
    (k : Nat) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain
      (logDerivativeAt k)
      (logDerivativeAt (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
      have hlog :=
        RealDerivative.NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface.hasDerivativeWithinOn_log
          Ielem
      apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
      · intro x hx
        exact (reciprocalDerivativeAt_zero_sameOn
          RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain x hx).symm
      · change RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
          RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain Ielem.logSpec.log
          (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
        exact hlog
  | succ q =>
      change RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain
        (reciprocalDerivativeAt q)
        (reciprocalDerivativeAt (q + 1))
      exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_reciprocalDerivativeAt_step q

name: logDerivative_hasDerivativeChainWithinOn
statement:
private theorem logDerivative_hasDerivativeChainWithinOn
    (p : Nat) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain
      RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
      logDerivativeAt p
proof:
:= by
  exact And.intro
    (logDerivativeAt_zero_sameOn RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain)
    (fun k hk => hasDerivativeWithinOn_logDerivativeAt_step k)

name: logDerivative_hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_natInterval
statement:
theorem logDerivative_hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_natInterval
    (n N p : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N))
      RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
      logDerivativeAt p
proof:
:= by
  exact RealDerivative.hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_subset
    (nat_interval_subset_positive hn)
    (logDerivative_hasDerivativeChainWithinOn p)

name: logDerivativeAt_continuousOn_natInterval
statement:
theorem logDerivativeAt_continuousOn_natInterval
    (n N p : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N))
      (logDerivativeAt p)
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | zero =>
      have hlog := RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
        (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N))
        (G := RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain)
        (nat_interval_subset_positive hn)
        RealTheory.elementaryFunction_log_continuousOn
      change RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N))
        (logDerivativeAt 0)
      exact hlog
  | succ q =>
      change RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N))
        (reciprocalDerivativeAt q)
      exact reciprocalDerivativeAt_continuousOn_natInterval n N q hn

name: harmonicNumber_zero
statement:
private theorem harmonicNumber_zero :
    harmonicNumber 0 = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold harmonicNumber
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_zero _

name: harmonicNumber_succ
statement:
private theorem harmonicNumber_succ
    (n : Nat) :
    harmonicNumber (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.add
        (harmonicNumber n)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold harmonicNumber
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_succ _ n

name: nat_succ_interval_length_one
statement:
private theorem nat_succ_interval_length_one
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsucc := RealTheory.nat_succ (n + 1)
  have hindex : (n + 1) + 1 = n + 2 := by omega
  rw [hindex] at hsucc
  change
    F.sub (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) =
      F.one
  rw [hsucc]
  rw [F.add_comm (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) F.one]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F F.one
    (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_inv_nat_succ
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_inv_nat_succ
    (n : Nat) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
        (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)))
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  let a := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  let b := RealTheory.nat (n + 2)
  have haPos : F.lt F.zero a := by
    unfold a
    exact RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
  have hab : F.le a b :=
    F.le_of_lt (RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt (by omega))
  have hInvCont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x) := by
    have hraw := RealTheory.function_continuousOn_inv
      (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      RealTheory.function_continuousOn_identity
      (fun x hx => by
        have hxPos : F.lt F.zero x := F.lt_of_lt_of_le haPos hx.left
        intro hxZero
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxPos) hxZero.symm)
    exact hraw
  have hLogCont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) Ielem.logSpec.log := by
    have hraw := RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (G := RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain)
      (fun x hx => F.lt_of_lt_of_le haPos hx.left)
      RealTheory.elementaryFunction_log_continuousOn
    change
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) Ielem.logSpec.log at hraw
    exact hraw
  have hLogDeriv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) Ielem.logSpec.log
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxPos : F.lt F.zero x :=
      F.lt_trans haPos hx.left
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
      (fun y hy => F.lt_trans haPos hy.left)
      hx
      ((RealDerivative.NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface.hasDerivativeWithinOn_log
        Ielem) x hxPos)
  change
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x) a b
      (F.sub (Ielem.logSpec.log b) (Ielem.logSpec.log a))
  exact
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      hab hInvCont hLogCont hLogDeriv

name: inv_nat_succ_log_increment_bounds
statement:
private theorem inv_nat_succ_log_increment_bounds
    (n : Nat) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)))
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))))
      (RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (RealTheory.nat (n + 2)))
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  let a := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  let b := RealTheory.nat (n + 2)
  let L := F.sub (Ielem.logSpec.log b) (Ielem.logSpec.log a)
  have haPos : F.lt F.zero a := by
    unfold a
    exact RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
  have hbPos : F.lt F.zero b := by
    unfold b
    have hindex : n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hindex]
    exact RealTheory.nat_succ_pos (n + 1)
  have hab : F.le a b :=
    F.le_of_lt (RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt (by omega))
  have hLength := nat_succ_interval_length_one n
  change F.sub b a = F.one at hLength
  have hInv := hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_inv_nat_succ n
  change
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x) a b L at hInv
  have hLower :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_const_of_le
      (a := a) (b := b) (c := F.inv b) hab
  change
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv b) a b
      (F.mul (F.inv b) (F.sub b a)) at hLower
  rw [hLength, F.mul_one] at hLower
  have hUpper :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_const_of_le
      (a := a) (b := b) (c := F.inv a) hab
  change
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv a) a b
      (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.sub b a)) at hUpper
  rw [hLength, F.mul_one] at hUpper
  have hLowerData :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      hab hLower
  have hInvData :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      hab hInv
  have hUpperData :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      hab hUpper
  have hLowerPoint :
      forall x : RealTheory.Carrier,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          F.le (F.inv b) (F.inv x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxPos : F.lt F.zero x := F.lt_of_lt_of_le haPos hx.left
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
      F hxPos hbPos hx.right
  have hUpperPoint :
      forall x : RealTheory.Carrier,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          F.le (F.inv x) (F.inv a) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxPos : F.lt F.zero x := F.lt_of_lt_of_le haPos hx.left
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
      F haPos hxPos hx.left
  have hLowerBound : F.le (F.inv b) L :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      hab hLowerPoint
      hLowerData.left hLowerData.right
      hInvData.left hInvData.right
  have hUpperBound : F.le L (F.inv a) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      hab hUpperPoint
      hInvData.left hInvData.right
      hUpperData.left hUpperData.right
  exact And.intro hLowerBound hUpperBound

name: eulerGamma_step_algebra
statement:
private theorem eulerGamma_step_algebra
    (H c y x : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hc : RealTheory.le c (RealTheory.sub y x)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add H c) y)
      (RealTheory.sub H x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hc H
  have hshift := F.add_le_add_right hadd (F.neg y)
  have hright :
      F.add (F.add H (F.sub y x)) (F.neg y) =
        F.sub H x := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg y x]
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg H x]
    calc
      F.add (F.add H (F.add y (F.neg x))) (F.neg y) =
          F.add H (F.add (F.add y (F.neg x)) (F.neg y)) :=
        F.add_assoc _ _ _
      _ = F.add H (F.add (F.add (F.neg x) y) (F.neg y)) := by
        rw [F.add_comm y (F.neg x)]
      _ = F.add H (F.add (F.neg x) (F.add y (F.neg y))) := by
        rw [F.add_assoc (F.neg x) y (F.neg y)]
      _ = F.add H (F.add (F.neg x) F.zero) := by
        rw [F.add_neg]
      _ = F.add H (F.neg x) := by
        rw [F.add_zero]
  change
    F.le
      (F.add (F.add H c) (F.neg y))
      (F.add H (F.neg x))
  change
    F.le
      (F.add (F.add H c) (F.neg y))
      (F.add (F.add H (F.sub y x)) (F.neg y)) at hshift
  rw [hright] at hshift
  change
    F.le
      (F.add (F.add H c) (F.neg y))
      (F.add H (F.neg x)) at hshift
  exact hshift

name: harmonicNumber_sub_log_step_decreasing
statement:
private theorem harmonicNumber_sub_log_step_decreasing
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub
        (harmonicNumber (n + 2))
        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))))
      (RealTheory.sub
        (harmonicNumber (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  let H := harmonicNumber (n + 1)
  let c := F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))
  let y := Ielem.logSpec.log (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))
  let x := Ielem.logSpec.log (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
  have hrec := harmonicNumber_succ (n + 1)
  have hindex : (n + 1) + 1 = n + 2 := by omega
  rw [hindex] at hrec
  change harmonicNumber (n + 2) = F.add H c at hrec
  have hbound := (inv_nat_succ_log_increment_bounds n).left
  change F.le c (F.sub y x) at hbound
  change
    F.le
      (F.sub (harmonicNumber (n + 2)) y)
      (F.sub H x)
  rw [hrec]
  exact eulerGamma_step_algebra H c y x hbound

name: log_nat_succ_le_harmonicNumber
statement:
private theorem log_nat_succ_le_harmonicNumber :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
        (harmonicNumber n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hlogOne := RealTheory.elementaryFunction_log_one_value
      change Ielem.logSpec.log F.one = F.zero at hlogOne
      change
        F.le (Ielem.logSpec.log (RealTheory.nat (0 + 1)))
          (harmonicNumber 0)
      rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
      rw [hlogOne]
      rw [harmonicNumber_zero]
      exact F.le_refl F.zero
  | succ n ih =>
      let x := Ielem.logSpec.log (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
      let y := Ielem.logSpec.log (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))
      let H := harmonicNumber n
      let c := F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
      change F.le x H at ih
      have hstep := (inv_nat_succ_log_increment_bounds n).right
      change F.le (F.sub y x) c at hstep
      have hrec := harmonicNumber_succ n
      change harmonicNumber (n + 1) = F.add H c at hrec
      change F.le y (harmonicNumber (n + 1))
      have hy : y = F.add x (F.sub y x) := by
        calc
        y = F.add (F.sub y x) x :=
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y x).symm
        _ = F.add x (F.sub y x) := F.add_comm _ _
      rw [hrec, hy]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F ih hstep

name: harmonicNumber_sub_log_nonneg
statement:
private theorem harmonicNumber_sub_log_nonneg
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.sub
        (harmonicNumber (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  let H := harmonicNumber n
  let L := Ielem.logSpec.log (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
  let c := F.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
  have hlog := log_nat_succ_le_harmonicNumber n
  change F.le L H at hlog
  have hcPos : F.lt F.zero c := by
    unfold c
    exact F.inv_pos (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)
  have hcNonneg : F.le F.zero c := F.le_of_lt hcPos
  have hHstep : F.le H (harmonicNumber (n + 1)) := by
    have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hcNonneg H
    change F.le (F.add H F.zero) (F.add H c) at hadd
    rw [F.add_zero] at hadd
    have hrec := harmonicNumber_succ n
    change harmonicNumber (n + 1) = F.add H c at hrec
    rw [← hrec] at hadd
    exact hadd
  have htotal : F.le L (harmonicNumber (n + 1)) :=
    F.le_trans hlog hHstep
  change F.le F.zero (F.sub (harmonicNumber (n + 1)) L)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F htotal

name: harmonicNumber_sub_log_monotoneDecreasing
statement:
private theorem harmonicNumber_sub_log_monotoneDecreasing :
    RealTheory.MonotoneDecreasing
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.sub
          (harmonicNumber (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  let u : Nat -> RealTheory.Carrier := fun n : Nat =>
    F.sub
      (harmonicNumber (n + 1))
      (Ielem.logSpec.log (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
  change IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.MonotoneDecreasing F u
  intro n m hnm
  have htail :
      forall k : Nat, F.le (u (n + k)) (u n) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        rw [Nat.add_zero]
        exact F.le_refl (u n)
    | succ k ih =>
        have hstepRaw :=
          harmonicNumber_sub_log_step_decreasing (n + k)
        have hstep : F.le (u ((n + k) + 1)) (u (n + k)) := by
          unfold u
          exact hstepRaw
        have htrans : F.le (u ((n + k) + 1)) (u n) :=
          F.le_trans hstep ih
        have hindex : n + (k + 1) = (n + k) + 1 := by omega
        rw [hindex]
        exact htrans
  have hm : n + (m - n) = m := by omega
  rw [← hm]
  exact htail (m - n)

name: harmonicNumber_sub_log_boundedBelow
statement:
private theorem harmonicNumber_sub_log_boundedBelow :
    RealTheory.SeqBoundedBelow
      (fun n : Nat =>

          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))
proof:

    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.SeqBoundedBelow F
      (fun n : Nat =>

          (harmonicNumber (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))
  refine Exists.intro F.zero ?_
  intro n
  exact harmonicNumber_sub_log_nonneg n

name: exists_harmonicNumber_sub_log_limit
statement:
private theorem exists_harmonicNumber_sub_log_limit :
    Exists fun gamma : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (harmonicNumber (n + 1))

              (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))))

proof:

  RealTheory.monotone_decreasing_converges

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_inv_nat_interval
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_inv_nat_interval
    (n N : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n <= N) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
      (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N)
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (RealTheory.nat N))
        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (RealTheory.nat n)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  let a := RealTheory.nat n
  let b := RealTheory.nat N
  have haPos : F.lt F.zero a := by
    unfold a
    have hraw := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
    change F.lt (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n) at hraw
    rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at hraw
    exact hraw
  have hab : F.le a b := RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hnN
  have hInvCont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x) := by
    exact RealTheory.function_continuousOn_inv
      RealTheory.function_continuousOn_identity
      (fun x hx => by
        have hxPos : F.lt F.zero x := F.lt_of_lt_of_le haPos hx.left
        intro hxZero
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxPos) hxZero.symm)
  have hLogCont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) Ielem.logSpec.log := by
    have hraw := RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (G := RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain)
      (fun x hx => F.lt_of_lt_of_le haPos hx.left)
      RealTheory.elementaryFunction_log_continuousOn
    change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) Ielem.logSpec.log at hraw
    exact hraw
  have hLogDeriv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) Ielem.logSpec.log
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxPos : F.lt F.zero x := F.lt_trans haPos hx.left
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
      (fun y hy => F.lt_trans haPos hy.left)
      hx
      ((RealDerivative.NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface.hasDerivativeWithinOn_log
        Ielem) x hxPos)
  change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
    (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x) a b
    (F.sub (Ielem.logSpec.log b) (Ielem.logSpec.log a))
  exact
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      hab hInvCont hLogCont hLogDeriv

name: naturalSampleSum_inv_sub_first_eq_harmonic_add
statement:
private theorem naturalSampleSum_inv_sub_first_eq_harmonic_add
    (n d : Nat) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (naturalSampleSum
          (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x) n d)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) =
      RealTheory.sub (harmonicNumber (n + d)) (harmonicNumber n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  induction d with
  | zero =>
      rw [naturalSampleSum_zero]
      rw [Nat.add_zero]
      change
        F.sub (F.inv (RealTheory.nat n))
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) =
          F.sub (harmonicNumber n) (harmonicNumber n)
      rw [F.sub_self]
      rw [F.sub_self]
  | succ d ih =>
      rw [naturalSampleSum_succ]
      have hharm := harmonicNumber_succ (n + d)
      have hindex : n + (d + 1) = (n + d) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hindex]
      rw [hharm]
      change
        F.sub
            (naturalSampleSum
              (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x) n d)
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) =
          F.sub (harmonicNumber (n + d)) (harmonicNumber n) at ih
      calc
        F.sub
            (F.add
              (naturalSampleSum
                (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x) n d)
              (F.inv (RealTheory.nat ((n + d) + 1))))
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) =
            F.add
              (F.sub
                (naturalSampleSum
                  (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x) n d)
                (F.inv (RealTheory.nat n)))
              (F.inv (RealTheory.nat ((n + d) + 1))) := by
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_right_reassociate F _ _ _
        _ = F.add
              (F.sub (harmonicNumber (n + d)) (harmonicNumber n))
              (F.inv (RealTheory.nat ((n + d) + 1))) := by
                rw [ih]
        _ = F.sub
              (F.add (harmonicNumber (n + d))
                (F.inv (RealTheory.nat ((n + d) + 1))))
              (harmonicNumber n) := by
                exact
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_right_reassociate
                    F _ _ _).symm

name: naturalSampleSum_inv_sub_first_eq_harmonic_sub
statement:
private theorem naturalSampleSum_inv_sub_first_eq_harmonic_sub
    (n N : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n <= N) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (naturalSampleSum
          (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
          n (N - n))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) =
      RealTheory.sub (harmonicNumber N) (harmonicNumber n)
proof:
:= by
  have hnNe : Not (n = 0) := by omega
  have h := naturalSampleSum_inv_sub_first_eq_harmonic_add n (N - n)
  have hindex : n + (N - n) = N := by omega
  rw [hindex] at h
  clear hnNe
  exact h

name: sub_neg_mul_rev
statement:
private theorem sub_neg_mul_rev
    (c x y : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul c y))
        (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul c x)) =
      RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.sub (F.neg (F.mul c y)) (F.neg (F.mul c x)) =
      F.mul c (F.sub x y)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F]
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F
    (F.mul c y) (F.mul c x)]
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F c x y).symm

name: reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_odd
statement:
private theorem reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_odd
    (n N r : Nat) :
    reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * r + 1) =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm
  have hindex : 2 * r + 1 + 2 = 2 * (r + 1) + 1 := by omega
  rw [hindex]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber_odd_eq_zero F
    (show 0 < r + 1 by omega)]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat F.one (2 * (r + 1) + 1))
            (F.inv (F.nat
              (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * (r + 1) + 1)))))
          F.zero)
        (F.sub
          (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * r + 1 + 1) (F.nat N))
          (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * r + 1 + 1) (F.nat n))) =
      F.zero
  rw [F.mul_zero]
  rw [F.zero_mul]

name: reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_even
statement:
private theorem reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_even
    (n N r : Nat) :
    reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * r) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
        (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := 2 * (r + 1)
  let c := F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (q - 1))
  let xn := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) q)
  let xN := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat N) q)
  let B := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F q
  have hq : 0 < q := by omega
  have hqIndex : q - 1 = 2 * r + 1 := by
    unfold q
    omega
  have hqSucc : (q - 1) + 1 = q := by omega
  have hfactorial :
      F.mul
          (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial q))) c =
        F.inv (F.nat q) := by
    rw [<- hqSucc]
    unfold c
    exact factorialInverse_mul_previous (q - 1)
  have hN := reciprocalDerivativeAt_odd_value r (RealTheory.nat N)
  have hn := reciprocalDerivativeAt_odd_value r (RealTheory.nat n)
  change reciprocalDerivativeAt (q - 1) (F.nat N) =
      F.neg (F.mul c xN) at hN
  change reciprocalDerivativeAt (q - 1) (F.nat n) =
      F.neg (F.mul c xn) at hn
  unfold reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm
  have hrawIndex : 2 * r + 2 = q := by
    unfold q
    omega
  rw [hrawIndex]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_one_base]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul F.one
            (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial q)))) B)
        (F.sub
          (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * r + 1) (F.nat N))
          (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * r + 1) (F.nat n))) =
      F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
        (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r)
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [<- hqIndex]
  rw [hN, hn]
  have hsub :
      F.sub (F.neg (F.mul c xN)) (F.neg (F.mul c xn)) =
        F.mul c (F.sub xn xN) := by
    exact sub_neg_mul_rev c xn xN
  rw [hsub]
  unfold eulerGammaCorrectionTerm
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial q))) B)
        (F.mul c (F.sub xn xN)) =
      F.sub
        (F.mul (F.mul B (F.inv (F.nat q))) xn)
        (F.mul (F.mul B (F.inv (F.nat q))) xN)
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial q))) B)
        (F.mul c (F.sub xn xN)) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial q))) c)
          (F.mul B (F.sub xn xN)) :=
      RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm _ _ _ _
    _ = F.mul (F.inv (F.nat q))
          (F.mul B (F.sub xn xN)) := by
      rw [hfactorial]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul B (F.inv (F.nat q)))
          (F.sub xn xN) := by
      rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv (F.nat q)) B]
    _ = F.sub
          (F.mul (F.mul B (F.inv (F.nat q))) xn)
          (F.mul (F.mul B (F.inv (F.nat q))) xN) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F _ _ _

name: reciprocal_eulerMaclaurinCorrection_eq_gammaCorrectionSum
statement:
private theorem reciprocal_eulerMaclaurinCorrection_eq_gammaCorrectionSum
    (n N m : Nat) :
    eulerMaclaurinCorrection reciprocalDerivativeAt
        (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N) RealTheory.one
        (2 * m + 2) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun r : Nat =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
            (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r))
        (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCorrection
  change
    F.finiteSum
        (reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N)
        (2 * m + 2 - 1) =
      F.finiteSum
        (fun r : Nat =>
          F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
            (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r))
        (m + 1)
  have hlength : 2 * m + 2 - 1 = 2 * m + 1 := by omega
  rw [hlength]
  calc
    F.finiteSum (reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N)
        (2 * m + 1) =
        F.add
          (F.finiteSum
            (reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N) (2 * m))
          (reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * m)) := by
      exact RealTheory.finiteSum_succ _ (2 * m)
    _ = F.add
          (F.finiteSum
            (fun r : Nat =>
              F.add
                (reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * r))
                (reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N
                  (2 * r + 1))) m)
          (reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * m)) := by
      have hpair :=
        RealTheory.finiteSum_pair_even_odd
          (reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N) m
      exact congrArg
        (fun s : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.add s
            (reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * m)))
        hpair
    _ = F.add
          (F.finiteSum
            (fun r : Nat =>
              F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
                (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r)) m)
          (F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n m)
            (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N m)) := by
      have hsum :
          F.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat =>
                F.add
                  (reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * r))
                  (reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N
                    (2 * r + 1))) m =
            F.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat =>
                F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
                  (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r)) m := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
        intro r hr
        rw [reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_even]
        rw [reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_odd]
        change F.add
            (F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
              (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r)) F.zero =
          F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
            (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r)
        rw [F.add_zero]
      have hlast :
          reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * m) =
            F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n m)
              (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N m) :=
        reciprocalEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_even n N m
      rw [hsum, hlast]
    _ = F.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat =>
            F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
              (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r))
          (m + 1) := by
      exact (RealTheory.finiteSum_succ _ m).symm

name: eulerMaclaurin_reciprocal_nat_interval_raw
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurin_reciprocal_nat_interval_raw
    (n N p : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n < N) (hp : 2 <= p) :
    let scaleAbs
proof:
:= RealTheory.inv
      (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial p))
    let scale := RealTheory.mul
      (Nat.rec RealTheory.one
        (fun (_ : Nat) (s : RealTheory.Carrier) => RealTheory.neg s)
        (p + 1))
      scaleAbs
    Exists fun J : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      Exists fun A : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
              RealTheory.mul (periodicBernoulli p x)
                (reciprocalDerivativeAt p x))
            (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N) J /\
        RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
              RealTheory.abs (reciprocalDerivativeAt p x))
            (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N) A /\
        naturalSampleSum
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
            n (N - n) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                    (RealTheory.nat N))
                  (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                    (RealTheory.nat n)))
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))
                    (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N)))))
              (eulerMaclaurinCorrection reciprocalDerivativeAt
                (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N)
                RealTheory.one p))
            (RealTheory.mul scale J) /\
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.mul scale J))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul scaleAbs
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base p)) A) := by
  have hcount : 0 < N - n := by omega
  have hend : n + (N - n) = N := by omega
  have hD :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat (n + (N - n))))
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
        reciprocalDerivativeAt p := by
    rw [hend]
    exact reciprocalDerivative_hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_natInterval
      n N p hn
  have hDp :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat (n + (N - n))))
        (reciprocalDerivativeAt p) := by
    rw [hend]
    exact reciprocalDerivativeAt_continuousOn_natInterval n N p hn
  have hI :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
        (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat (n + (N - n)))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (RealTheory.nat (n + (N - n))))
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (RealTheory.nat n))) := by
    rw [hend]
    exact hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_inv_nat_interval n N hn (by omega)
  have hmain := eulerMaclaurin_natSum
    n (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
    reciprocalDerivativeAt
    (RealTheory.sub
      (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
        (RealTheory.nat (n + (N - n))))
      (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
        (RealTheory.nat n)))
    p (N - n) hcount hp hD hDp hI
  rw [hend] at hmain
  exact hmain

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reciprocalDerivativeAt_even
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reciprocalDerivativeAt_even
    (n N m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n <= N) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 2))
      (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N)
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 1)))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) (2 * m + 2)))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat N) (2 * m + 2)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a := RealTheory.nat n
  let b := RealTheory.nat N
  have hab : F.le a b := RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hnN
  have haPos : F.lt F.zero a := by
    unfold a
    have hraw := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
    change F.lt (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n) at hraw
    rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at hraw
    exact hraw
  have hIntegrandCont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 2)) := by
    exact reciprocalDerivativeAt_continuousOn_natInterval
      n N (2 * m + 2) hn
  have hPrimitiveCont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1)) := by
    exact reciprocalDerivativeAt_continuousOn_natInterval
      n N (2 * m + 1) hn
  have hDerivative :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
        (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1))
        (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 2)) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxPos : F.lt F.zero x := F.lt_trans haPos hx.left
    have hraw :=
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_reciprocalDerivativeAt_step (2 * m + 1))
        x hxPos
    have hindex : 2 * m + 1 + 1 = 2 * m + 2 := by omega
    rw [hindex] at hraw
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
      (fun y hy => F.lt_trans haPos hy.left) hx hraw
  have hraw :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      hab hIntegrandCont hPrimitiveCont hDerivative
  have hleft := reciprocalDerivativeAt_odd_value m b
  have hright := reciprocalDerivativeAt_odd_value m a
  change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
    (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 2)) a b
    (F.sub (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1) b)
      (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1) a)) at hraw
  rw [hleft, hright] at hraw
  change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
    (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 2)) a b
    (RealTheory.sub
      (RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 1)))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat b (2 * m + 2)))))
      (RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 1)))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealFunction.powNat a (2 * m + 2)))))) at hraw
  rw [sub_neg_mul_rev] at hraw
  exact hraw

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_reciprocalDerivativeAt_even
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_reciprocalDerivativeAt_even
    (n N m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n <= N) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealTheory.abs (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 2) x))
      (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N)
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 1)))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) (2 * m + 2)))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat N) (2 * m + 2)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab : F.le (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N) :=
    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hnN
  have hnPos : F.lt F.zero (RealTheory.nat n) := by
    have hraw := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
    change F.lt (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n) at hraw
    rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at hraw
    exact hraw
  have hraw := hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reciprocalDerivativeAt_even
    n N m hn hnN
  exact RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le hab
    (fun x hx => by
      have hxPos : F.lt F.zero x := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hnPos hx.left
      have hpowPos :
          F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * m + 2 + 1)) :=
        RealFunction.powNat_pos hxPos (2 * m + 2 + 1)
      have hinvNonneg :
          F.le F.zero
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * m + 2 + 1))) :=
        F.le_of_lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hpowPos)
      have hnonneg : F.le F.zero (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 2) x) := by
        have hindex : 2 * m + 2 = 2 * (m + 1) := by omega
        rw [hindex]
        rw [reciprocalDerivativeAt_even_value]
        exact F.mul_nonneg
          (RealTheory.nat_nonneg
            (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * (m + 1))))
          hinvNonneg
      exact (RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hnonneg).symm)
    hraw

name: reciprocal_eulerMaclaurin_finite_error
statement:
private theorem reciprocal_eulerMaclaurin_finite_error
    (n N m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n < N) :
    Exists fun R : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      naturalSampleSum
          (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
          n (N - n) =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.sub
                (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                  (RealTheory.nat N))
                (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                  (RealTheory.nat n)))
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N)))))
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat =>
                RealTheory.sub
                  (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
                  (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r))
              (m + 1)))
          R /\
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs R)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (2 * m + 2)))
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (2 * m + 2)))
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) (2 * m + 2)))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat N) (2 * m + 2)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hmain := eulerMaclaurin_reciprocal_nat_interval_raw
    n N (2 * m + 2) hn hnN (by omega)
  dsimp only at hmain
  cases hmain with
  | intro J hJA =>
      cases hJA with
      | intro A hdata =>
          have hJ := hdata.left
          have hA := hdata.right.left
          have hFormula := hdata.right.right.left
          have hBound := hdata.right.right.right
          let R := F.mul
            (F.mul
              (Nat.rec F.one
                (fun (_ : Nat) (s : RealTheory.Carrier) => F.neg s)
                (2 * m + 2 + 1))
              (F.inv
                (F.nat
                  (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 2))))) J
          refine Exists.intro R ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · rw [reciprocal_eulerMaclaurinCorrection_eq_gammaCorrectionSum
              n N m] at hFormula
            change naturalSampleSum
                (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x) n (N - n) =
              F.add
                (F.add
                  (F.add
                    (F.sub
                      (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                        (F.nat N))
                      (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                        (F.nat n)))
                    (F.half
                      (F.add (F.inv (F.nat n)) (F.inv (F.nat N)))))
                  (F.finiteSum
                    (fun r : Nat =>
                      F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
                        (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r))
                    (m + 1))) R
            unfold R
            exact hFormula
          · have hAexact :=
              hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_reciprocalDerivativeAt_even
                n N m hn (by omega)
            have hAvalue :=
              RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
                hA hAexact
            rw [hAvalue] at hBound
            have hsucc : 2 * m + 1 + 1 = 2 * m + 2 := by omega
            have hfactor := factorialInverse_mul_previous (2 * m + 1)
            rw [hsucc] at hfactor
            have hfactorF :
                F.mul
                    (F.inv
                      (F.nat
                        (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 2))))
                    (F.nat
                      (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 1))) =
                  F.inv (F.nat (2 * m + 2)) :=
              hfactor
            let q := F.inv
              (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 2)))
            let E := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F
              (2 * m + 2)
            let c := F.nat
              (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 1))
            let d := F.sub
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) (2 * m + 2)))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat N) (2 * m + 2)))
            have hrhs :
                F.mul (F.mul q E) (F.mul c d) =
                  F.mul
                    (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (2 * m + 2))) E) d := by
              calc
                F.mul (F.mul q E) (F.mul c d) =
                    F.mul (F.mul q c) (F.mul E d) :=
                      RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm q E c d
                _ = F.mul
                      (F.inv (F.nat (2 * m + 2))) (F.mul E d) := by
                    unfold q c
                    rw [hfactorF]
                _ = F.mul
                      (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (2 * m + 2))) E) d := by
                    rw [F.mul_assoc]
            change F.le (F.abs R) (F.mul (F.mul q E) (F.mul c d)) at hBound
            rw [hrhs] at hBound
            exact hBound

name: reciprocalEulerFinite_formula_and_bound
statement:
private theorem reciprocalEulerFinite_formula_and_bound
    (n N m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n < N) :
    And
      (naturalSampleSum
          (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.inv x)
          n (N - n) =
        RealTheory.add
          (reciprocalEulerFiniteMain n N m)
          (reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder n N m))
      (RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder n N m))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (2 * m + 2)))
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (2 * m + 2)))
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) (2 * m + 2)))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat N) (2 * m + 2))))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let S := naturalSampleSum
    (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x) n (N - n)
  let M := reciprocalEulerFiniteMain n N m
  have hraw := reciprocal_eulerMaclaurin_finite_error n N m hn hnN
  cases hraw with
  | intro R hR =>
      have hFormula := hR.left
      have hBound := hR.right
      have hmainLiteral :
          reciprocalEulerFiniteMain n N m =
            F.add
              (F.add
                (F.add
                  (F.sub
                    (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                      (F.nat N))
                    (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                      (F.nat n)))
                  (F.half
                    (F.add (F.inv (F.nat n)) (F.inv (F.nat N)))))
                (F.finiteSum
                  (fun r : Nat =>
                    F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
                      (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r))
                  (m + 1))) F.zero := rfl
      have hzeroMain :
          reciprocalEulerFiniteMain n N m =
            F.add
              (F.add
                (F.sub
                  (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                    (F.nat N))
                  (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                    (F.nat n)))
                (F.half
                  (F.add (F.inv (F.nat n)) (F.inv (F.nat N)))))
              (F.finiteSum
                (fun r : Nat =>
                  F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
                    (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r))
                (m + 1)) := by
        rw [hmainLiteral, F.add_zero]
      have hremEq : reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder n N m = R := by
        unfold reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder
        rw [hzeroMain]
        rw [hFormula]
        let B := F.add
          (F.add
            (F.sub
              (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                (F.nat N))
              (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                (F.nat n)))
            (F.half (F.add (F.inv (F.nat n)) (F.inv (F.nat N)))))
          (F.finiteSum
            (fun r : Nat =>
              F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
                (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r))
            (m + 1))
        change F.sub (F.add B R) B = R
        rw [F.add_comm B R]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F R B
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · unfold reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder
        change S = F.add M (F.sub S M)
        calc
          S = F.add (F.sub S M) M :=
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F S M).symm
          _ = F.add M (F.sub S M) := by rw [F.add_comm]
      · rw [hremEq]
        exact hBound

name: eulerGammaCorrectionTerm_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem eulerGammaCorrectionTerm_tendsto_zero
    (r : Nat) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r)
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := 2 * (r + 1)
  let c := F.mul
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F q)
    (F.inv (F.nat q))
  have hq : 0 < q := by unfold q; omega
  have hpower :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.seqTendsto_inv_powNat_nat_succ_zero q hq
  have hmul := RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const c) hpower
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r)
    (F.mul c F.zero) at hmul
  rw [F.mul_zero] at hmul
  exact hmul

name: eulerGammaCorrectionSum_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem eulerGammaCorrectionSum_tendsto_zero
    (s : Nat) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r) s)
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  induction s with
  | zero =>
      have hzero := RealTheory.seqTendsto_const F.zero
      exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hzero
        (Exists.intro 0 (fun k _hk => by
          change F.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r) 0 =
            F.zero
          exact RealTheory.finiteSum_zero _))
  | succ s ih =>
      have hterm := eulerGammaCorrectionTerm_tendsto_zero s
      have hadd := RealTheory.seqTendsto_add ih hterm
      change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun k : Nat =>
          F.add
            (F.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r) s)
            (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm (k + 1) s))
        (F.add F.zero F.zero) at hadd
      rw [F.zero_add] at hadd
      exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hadd
        (Exists.intro 0 (fun k _hk => by
          change F.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r)
              (s + 1) =
            F.add
              (F.finiteSum
                (fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r) s)
              (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm (k + 1) s)
          exact RealTheory.finiteSum_succ _ s))

name: half_inv_nat_succ_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem half_inv_nat_succ_tendsto_zero :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat =>
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))))
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv := RealFunction.Elementary.seqTendsto_inv_nat_succ
  have hscale := RealTheory.seqTendsto_const
    (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F))
  have hmul := RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul hinv hscale
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)))
        (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F)))
    (F.mul F.zero (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F))) at hmul
  rw [F.zero_mul] at hmul
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat => F.half (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)))) F.zero
  exact hmul

name: reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder_eq_normalForm
statement:
private theorem reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder_eq_normalForm
    (n N m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n < N) :
    reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder n N m =
      reciprocalEulerFiniteNormalForm n N m
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let HN := harmonicNumber N
  let Hn := harmonicNumber n
  let LN := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log (F.nat N)
  let Ln := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log (F.nat n)
  let a := F.inv (F.nat n)
  let b := F.inv (F.nat N)
  let Cn := F.finiteSum
    (fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r) (m + 1)
  let CN := F.finiteSum
    (fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r) (m + 1)
  have hsampleSub := naturalSampleSum_inv_sub_first_eq_harmonic_sub
    n N hn (by omega)
  change F.sub
      (naturalSampleSum (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x)
        n (N - n)) a =
    F.sub HN Hn at hsampleSub
  have hsample :
      naturalSampleSum (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x)
          n (N - n) =
        F.add (F.sub HN Hn) a := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier => F.add z a) hsampleSub
    change F.add
        (F.sub
          (naturalSampleSum (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x)
            n (N - n)) a) a =
      F.add (F.sub HN Hn) a at h
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F] at h
    exact h
  have hsum := RealTheory.finiteSum_sub
    (fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
    (fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r) (m + 1)
  change F.finiteSum
      (fun r : Nat =>
        F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
          (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r)) (m + 1) =
    F.sub Cn CN at hsum
  unfold reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder reciprocalEulerFiniteMain
    reciprocalEulerFiniteNormalForm
  change F.sub
      (naturalSampleSum (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x)
        n (N - n))
      (F.add
        (F.add (F.add (F.sub LN Ln) (F.half (F.add a b)))
          (F.finiteSum
            (fun r : Nat =>
              F.sub (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r)
                (eulerGammaCorrectionTerm N r)) (m + 1)))
        F.zero) =
    F.add
      (F.add (F.sub HN LN)
        (F.sub (F.neg Hn)
          (F.add (F.neg Ln) (F.half (F.add a b)))))
      (F.sub a (F.sub Cn CN))
  rw [hsample]
  rw [F.add_zero]
  rw [hsum]
  change F.sub
      (F.add (F.sub HN Hn) a)
      (F.add
        (F.add (F.sub LN Ln) (F.half (F.add a b)))
        (F.sub Cn CN)) =
    F.add
      (F.add (F.sub HN LN)
        (F.sub (F.neg Hn)
          (F.add (F.neg Ln) (F.half (F.add a b)))))
      (F.sub a (F.sub Cn CN))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg HN Hn]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg LN Ln]
  rw [F.add_assoc LN (F.neg Ln) (F.half (F.add a b))]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F]

name: reciprocalEulerFiniteNormalForm_tendsto
statement:
private theorem reciprocalEulerFiniteNormalForm_tendsto
    (n m : Nat) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat => reciprocalEulerFiniteNormalForm n (k + 1) m)
      (reciprocalEulerFiniteLimit n m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Hn := harmonicNumber n
  let Ln := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log (F.nat n)
  let a := F.inv (F.nat n)
  let Cn := F.finiteSum
    (fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r) (m + 1)
  have hgamma := harmonicNumber_sub_log_tendsto_eulerGamma
  have hhalfEndpoint := half_inv_nat_succ_tendsto_zero
  have hhalfRaw := RealTheory.seqTendsto_add
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const (F.half a)) hhalfEndpoint
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.add (F.half a) (F.half (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)))))
    (F.add (F.half a) F.zero) at hhalfRaw
  rw [F.add_zero] at hhalfRaw
  have hhalf :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun k : Nat => F.half (F.add a (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)))))
        (F.half a) :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hhalfRaw
      (Exists.intro 0 (fun k _hk => by
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add
          F a (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)))))
  have hinner := RealTheory.seqTendsto_add
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const (F.neg Ln)) hhalf
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.add (F.neg Ln)
        (F.half (F.add a (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))))))
    (F.add (F.neg Ln) (F.half a)) at hinner
  have hconstantSub := RealTheory.seqTendsto_sub
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const (F.neg Hn)) hinner
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.sub (F.neg Hn)
        (F.add (F.neg Ln)
          (F.half (F.add a (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)))))))
    (F.sub (F.neg Hn) (F.add (F.neg Ln) (F.half a))) at hconstantSub
  have hfirst := RealTheory.seqTendsto_add hgamma hconstantSub
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.add
        (F.sub (harmonicNumber (k + 1))
          (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            (F.nat (k + 1))))
        (F.sub (F.neg Hn)
          (F.add (F.neg Ln)
            (F.half (F.add a (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))))))))
    (F.add eulerGamma
      (F.sub (F.neg Hn) (F.add (F.neg Ln) (F.half a)))) at hfirst
  have hcorrection := eulerGammaCorrectionSum_tendsto_zero (m + 1)
  have hcorrectionSub := RealTheory.seqTendsto_sub
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const Cn) hcorrection
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.sub Cn
        (F.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r)
          (m + 1)))
    (F.sub Cn F.zero) at hcorrectionSub
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F] at hcorrectionSub
  have hsecond := RealTheory.seqTendsto_sub
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const a) hcorrectionSub
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.sub a
        (F.sub Cn
          (F.finiteSum
            (fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r)
            (m + 1))))
    (F.sub a Cn) at hsecond
  have hall := RealTheory.seqTendsto_add hfirst hsecond
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat => reciprocalEulerFiniteNormalForm n (k + 1) m)
    (reciprocalEulerFiniteLimit n m) at hall
  exact hall

name: reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder_tendsto
statement:
private theorem reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder_tendsto
    (n m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat => reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder n (k + 1) m)
      (reciprocalEulerFiniteLimit n m)
proof:
:= by
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually
    (reciprocalEulerFiniteNormalForm_tendsto n m)
    (Exists.intro n (fun k hk => by
      exact reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder_eq_normalForm
        n (k + 1) m hn (by omega)))

name: reciprocalEulerFiniteBound_tendsto
statement:
private theorem reciprocalEulerFiniteBound_tendsto
    (n m : Nat) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat => reciprocalEulerFiniteBound n (k + 1) m)
      (reciprocalEulerLimitBound n m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := 2 * m + 2
  let c := F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p))
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F p)
  let x := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) p)
  have hp : 0 < p := by unfold p; omega
  have htail :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.seqTendsto_inv_powNat_nat_succ_zero p hp
  have hdiff := RealTheory.seqTendsto_sub
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const x) htail
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.sub x
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat (k + 1)) p)))
    (F.sub x F.zero) at hdiff
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F] at hdiff
  have hscaled := RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const c) hdiff
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat => reciprocalEulerFiniteBound n (k + 1) m)
    (reciprocalEulerLimitBound n m) at hscaled
  exact hscaled

name: reciprocalEulerFiniteLimit_abs_bound
statement:
private theorem reciprocalEulerFiniteLimit_abs_bound
    (n m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (reciprocalEulerFiniteLimit n m))
      (reciprocalEulerLimitBound n m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Rseq := fun k : Nat => reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder n (k + 1) m
  let Bseq := fun k : Nat => reciprocalEulerFiniteBound n (k + 1) m
  have hR := reciprocalEulerFiniteRemainder_tendsto n m hn
  have hB := reciprocalEulerFiniteBound_tendsto n m
  have hAbsBound :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun k : Nat => F.le (F.abs (Rseq k)) (Bseq k)) := by
    refine Exists.intro n ?_
    intro k hk
    have hfinite := reciprocalEulerFinite_formula_and_bound
      n (k + 1) m hn (by omega)
    exact hfinite.right
  have hUpper :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun k : Nat => F.le (Rseq k) (Bseq k)) := by
    cases hAbsBound with
    | intro K hK =>
        refine Exists.intro K ?_
        intro k hk
        exact F.le_trans (RealTheory.le_abs_self (Rseq k)) (hK k hk)
  have hNegUpper :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun k : Nat => F.le (F.neg (Rseq k)) (Bseq k)) := by
    cases hAbsBound with
    | intro K hK =>
        refine Exists.intro K ?_
        intro k hk
        exact F.le_trans (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self (Rseq k)) (hK k hk)
  have hLimitUpper :
      F.le (reciprocalEulerFiniteLimit n m)
        (reciprocalEulerLimitBound n m) :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le hR hB hUpper
  have hNegR := RealTheory.seqTendsto_neg hR
  have hNegLimitUpper :
      F.le (F.neg (reciprocalEulerFiniteLimit n m))
        (reciprocalEulerLimitBound n m) :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le hNegR hB hNegUpper
  exact RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hLimitUpper hNegLimitUpper

name: eulerGamma_final_algebra
statement:
private theorem eulerGamma_final_algebra
    (H l g h a C c L : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hhalf : RealTheory.add h h = a)
    (hL :
      L = RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add g
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.neg H)
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg l) h)))
        (RealTheory.sub a (RealTheory.add C c))) :
    RealTheory.add L c =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add l g) h) C)
        H
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hhalfF : F.add h h = a := hhalf
  have htail :
      F.add (F.sub a (F.add C c)) c = F.sub a C := by
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add F a C c]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F (F.sub a C) c
  have hx :
      F.sub (F.neg H) (F.add (F.neg l) h) =
        F.sub (F.sub l H) h := by
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add F
      (F.neg H) (F.neg l) h]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F H l]
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F H l]
  have hsplit : F.sub (F.add h h) C = F.add h (F.sub h C) := by
    have hpair := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
      F h h F.zero C
    rw [F.zero_add, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F] at hpair
    exact hpair
  have hgSplit : F.add g (F.sub h C) = F.sub (F.add g h) C := by
    have hpair := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
      F g h F.zero C
    rw [F.zero_add, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F] at hpair
    exact hpair.symm
  rw [hL]
  calc
    F.add
        (F.add
          (F.add g (F.sub (F.neg H) (F.add (F.neg l) h)))
          (F.sub a (F.add C c))) c =
        F.add
          (F.add g (F.sub (F.neg H) (F.add (F.neg l) h)))
          (F.add (F.sub a (F.add C c)) c) := by
      rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add
          (F.add g (F.sub (F.neg H) (F.add (F.neg l) h)))
          (F.sub a C) := by rw [htail]
    _ = F.add
          (F.add g (F.sub (F.sub l H) h))
          (F.sub (F.add h h) C) := by rw [hx, <- hhalfF]
    _ = F.add
          (F.add g (F.sub (F.sub l H) h))
          (F.add h (F.sub h C)) := by rw [hsplit]
    _ = F.add g
          (F.add
            (F.sub (F.sub l H) h)
            (F.add h (F.sub h C))) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add g
          (F.add
            (F.add (F.sub (F.sub l H) h) h)
            (F.sub h C)) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc
        (F.sub (F.sub l H) h) h (F.sub h C)]
    _ = F.add g
          (F.add (F.sub l H) (F.sub h C)) := by
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F]
    _ = F.add (F.sub l H) (F.add g (F.sub h C)) := by
      calc
        F.add g (F.add (F.sub l H) (F.sub h C)) =
            F.add (F.add g (F.sub l H)) (F.sub h C) := by
              rw [<- F.add_assoc]
        _ = F.add (F.add (F.sub l H) g) (F.sub h C) := by
              rw [F.add_comm g (F.sub l H)]
        _ = F.add (F.sub l H) (F.add g (F.sub h C)) := by
              rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.sub l H) (F.sub (F.add g h) C) := by
      rw [hgSplit]
    _ = F.sub (F.add l (F.add g h)) (F.add H C) := by
      exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
        F l (F.add g h) H C).symm
    _ = F.sub (F.add (F.add l g) h) (F.add C H) := by
      rw [F.add_assoc l g h]
      rw [F.add_comm H C]
    _ = F.sub (F.sub (F.add (F.add l g) h) C) H := by
      exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add F
        (F.add (F.add l g) h) C H).symm

name: eulerGamma_fixedOrder
statement:
theorem eulerGamma_fixedOrder
    (m n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    let p
proof:
:= 2 * m + 2
    Exists fun R : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      harmonicNumber n =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                  (RealTheory.nat n))
                eulerGamma)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))))
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat =>
                let q := 2 * (r + 1)
                RealTheory.mul
