                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
                      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base q)
                    (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q)))
                  (RealTheory.inv
                    (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) q)))
              m))
          R /\
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs R)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base p))
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base p))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat p)))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) p))) := by
  dsimp only
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := 2 * m + 2
  let H := harmonicNumber n
  let l := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log (F.nat n)
  let h := F.half (F.inv (F.nat n))
  let a := F.inv (F.nat n)
  let term := fun r : Nat => eulerGammaCorrectionTerm n r
  let C := F.finiteSum term m
  let c := term m
  let L := reciprocalEulerFiniteLimit n m
  let B := F.sub (F.add (F.add l eulerGamma) h) C
  let R := F.sub (F.neg L) c
  have hhalf : F.add h h = a := by
    unfold h a
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F (F.inv (F.nat n))
  have hsum := RealTheory.finiteSum_succ term m
  change F.finiteSum term (m + 1) = F.add C c at hsum
  have hL :
      L = F.add
        (F.add eulerGamma
          (F.sub (F.neg H) (F.add (F.neg l) h)))
        (F.sub a (F.add C c)) := by
    unfold L reciprocalEulerFiniteLimit
    change F.add
        (F.add eulerGamma
          (F.sub (F.neg H) (F.add (F.neg l) h)))
        (F.sub a (F.finiteSum term (m + 1))) =
      F.add
        (F.add eulerGamma
          (F.sub (F.neg H) (F.add (F.neg l) h)))
        (F.sub a (F.add C c))
    rw [hsum]
  have hLc : F.add L c = F.sub B H := by
    unfold B
    exact eulerGamma_final_algebra H l eulerGamma h a C c L hhalf hL
  have hR : R = F.sub H B := by
    unfold R
    calc
      F.sub (F.neg L) c = F.neg (F.add L c) := by
        rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F L c).symm
      _ = F.neg (F.sub B H) := by rw [hLc]
      _ = F.sub H B :=
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F B H).symm
  refine Exists.intro R ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · change H = F.add B R
    rw [hR]
    calc
      H = F.add (F.sub H B) B :=
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F H B).symm
      _ = F.add B (F.sub H B) := by rw [F.add_comm]
  · have hLimit := reciprocalEulerFiniteLimit_abs_bound n m hn
    let E := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F p
    let x := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) p)
    have hpPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat p) := by
      exact RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by unfold p; omega)
    have hInvPNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv (F.nat p)) :=
      F.le_of_lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hpPos)
    have hnPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat n) := by
      exact RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by omega)
    have hpowPos : F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) p) :=
      RealFunction.powNat_pos hnPos p
    have hxNonneg : F.le F.zero x := by
      unfold x
      exact F.le_of_lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hpowPos)
    change F.le (F.abs L) (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p)) E) x)
      at hLimit
    have hpindex : 2 * (m + 1) = p := by unfold p; omega
    have hcLiteral :
        c = F.mul
          (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p)
            (F.inv (F.nat p))) x := by
      unfold c term eulerGammaCorrectionTerm x
      rw [hpindex]
      rfl
    have hcAbs :
        F.abs c =
          F.mul
            (F.mul
              (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p))
              (F.inv (F.nat p))) x := by
      have houter :
          F.abs
              (F.mul
                (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p)
                  (F.inv (F.nat p))) x) =
            F.mul
              (F.abs
                (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p)
                  (F.inv (F.nat p))))
              (F.abs x) :=
        RealTheory.abs_mul
          (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p)
            (F.inv (F.nat p))) x
      have hinner :
          F.abs
              (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p)
                (F.inv (F.nat p))) =
            F.mul
              (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p))
              (F.abs (F.inv (F.nat p))) :=
        RealTheory.abs_mul
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p)
          (F.inv (F.nat p))
      have hInvPAbs : F.abs (F.inv (F.nat p)) = F.inv (F.nat p) :=
        RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hInvPNonneg
      have hxAbs : F.abs x = x := RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hxNonneg
      calc
        F.abs c =
            F.abs
              (F.mul
                (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p)
                  (F.inv (F.nat p))) x) := by rw [hcLiteral]
        _ = F.mul
              (F.abs
                (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p)
                  (F.inv (F.nat p))))
              (F.abs x) := houter
        _ = F.mul
              (F.mul
                (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p))
                (F.abs (F.inv (F.nat p))))
              (F.abs x) := by rw [hinner]
        _ = F.mul
              (F.mul
                (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p))
                (F.inv (F.nat p))) x := by rw [hInvPAbs, hxAbs]
    have htriangle : F.le (F.abs R) (F.add (F.abs L) (F.abs c)) := by
      unfold R
      rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
      have hraw := RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs (F.neg L) (F.neg c)
      rw [RealTheory.abs_neg, RealTheory.abs_neg] at hraw
      exact hraw
    have hcBound :
        F.le (F.abs c)
          (F.mul
            (F.mul
              (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p))
              (F.inv (F.nat p))) x) := by
      rw [hcAbs]
      exact F.le_refl _
    have hsumBound := F.add_le_add hLimit hcBound
    have hbound := F.le_trans htriangle hsumBound
    have hrhs :
        F.add
            (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p)) E) x)
            (F.mul
              (F.mul
                (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p))
                (F.inv (F.nat p))) x) =
          F.mul
            (F.mul
              (F.add
                (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p)) E)
              (F.inv (F.nat p))) x := by
      calc
        F.add
            (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p)) E) x)
            (F.mul
              (F.mul
                (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p))
                (F.inv (F.nat p))) x) =
            F.mul
              (F.add
                (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p)) E)
                (F.mul
                  (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p))
                  (F.inv (F.nat p)))) x := by
          exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_mul F
            (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p)) E)
            (F.mul
              (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p))
              (F.inv (F.nat p))) x).symm
        _ = F.mul
              (F.add
                (F.mul
                  (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p))
                  (F.inv (F.nat p)))
                (F.mul E (F.inv (F.nat p)))) x := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv (F.nat p)) E]
          rw [F.add_comm]
        _ = F.mul
              (F.mul
                (F.add
                  (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p)) E)
                (F.inv (F.nat p))) x := by
          exact congrArg (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier => F.mul z x)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_mul F
              (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p)) E
              (F.inv (F.nat p))).symm
    rw [hrhs] at hbound
    exact hbound

name: EulerMaclaurinInternal.nat_factorial_pos
statement:
theorem EulerMaclaurinInternal.nat_factorial_pos
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnat : 0 < Tautology.Nat.factorial n := by
    have hne := Tautology.Nat.factorial_ne_zero n
    omega
  have hcast := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hnat
  change F.lt F.zero (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial n)) at hcast
  exact hcast

name: logFactorial_succ
statement:
private theorem logFactorial_succ
    (n : Nat) :
    logFactorial (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.add
        (logFactorial n)
        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  have hnPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (n + 1)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n
  have hfactPos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial n)) :=
    nat_factorial_pos n
  have hmul := Ielem.logSpec.mul_law
    (F.nat (n + 1))
    (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial n))
    hnPos hfactPos
  change
    Ielem.logSpec.log
        (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1))
          (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial n))) =
      F.add
        (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat (n + 1)))
        (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial n))) at hmul
  unfold logFactorial
  rw [Tautology.Nat.factorial_succ]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_mul]
  change
    Ielem.logSpec.log
        (F.mul (F.nat (n + 1))
          (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial n))) =
      F.add
        (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial n)))
        (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat (n + 1)))
  rw [hmul]
  exact F.add_comm _ _

name: naturalSampleSum_log_sub_first_eq_logFactorial_add
statement:
private theorem naturalSampleSum_log_sub_first_eq_logFactorial_add
    (n d : Nat) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (naturalSampleSum
          RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log n d)
        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (RealTheory.nat n)) =
      RealTheory.sub (logFactorial (n + d)) (logFactorial n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  induction d with
  | zero =>
      rw [naturalSampleSum_zero]
      rw [Nat.add_zero]
      change
        F.sub (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n))
            (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n)) =
          F.sub (logFactorial n) (logFactorial n)
      rw [F.sub_self]
      rw [F.sub_self]
  | succ d ih =>
      rw [naturalSampleSum_succ]
      have hfactorial := logFactorial_succ (n + d)
      have hindex : n + (d + 1) = (n + d) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hindex]
      rw [hfactorial]
      change
        F.sub
            (naturalSampleSum Ielem.logSpec.log n d)
            (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n)) =
          F.sub (logFactorial (n + d)) (logFactorial n) at ih
      calc
        F.sub
            (F.add
              (naturalSampleSum Ielem.logSpec.log n d)
              (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat ((n + d) + 1))))
            (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n)) =
            F.add
              (F.sub
                (naturalSampleSum Ielem.logSpec.log n d)
                (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n)))
              (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat ((n + d) + 1))) := by
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_right_reassociate F _ _ _
        _ = F.add
              (F.sub (logFactorial (n + d)) (logFactorial n))
              (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat ((n + d) + 1))) := by
                rw [ih]
        _ = F.sub
              (F.add (logFactorial (n + d))
                (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat ((n + d) + 1))))
              (logFactorial n) := by
                exact
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_right_reassociate
                    F _ _ _).symm

name: naturalSampleSum_log_sub_first_eq_logFactorial_sub
statement:
private theorem naturalSampleSum_log_sub_first_eq_logFactorial_sub
    (n N : Nat) (hnN : n <= N) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (naturalSampleSum
          RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          n (N - n))
        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (RealTheory.nat n)) =
      RealTheory.sub (logFactorial N) (logFactorial n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := naturalSampleSum_log_sub_first_eq_logFactorial_add n (N - n)
  have hindex : n + (N - n) = N := by omega
  rw [hindex] at h
  exact h

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_logIntegralPrimitive
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_logIntegralPrimitive :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain
      logIntegralPrimitive
      RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  have hproduct := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_mul
    (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_id
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain)
    (RealDerivative.NaturalExpLogPowerThinInterface.hasDerivativeWithinOn_log
      Ielem)
  have hsub := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_sub hproduct
    (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_id
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain)
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain
        (RealFunction.SubFun
          (RealFunction.AddFun
            (RealFunction.MulFun (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => F.one)
              Ielem.logSpec.log)
            (RealFunction.MulFun (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => x)
              (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x)))
          (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => F.one))
        Ielem.logSpec.log := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : Not (x = F.zero) := by
      intro hzero
      exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hzero.symm
    unfold RealFunction.SubFun RealFunction.AddFun RealFunction.MulFun
    change
      F.sub
          (F.add
            (F.mul F.one (Ielem.logSpec.log x))
            (F.mul x (F.inv x))) F.one =
        Ielem.logSpec.log x
    rw [F.one_mul]
    rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hx0]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F]
  have hsubLiteral : RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      RealTheory.ElementaryPositiveDomain logIntegralPrimitive
      (RealFunction.SubFun
        (RealFunction.AddFun
          (RealFunction.MulFun (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => F.one)
            Ielem.logSpec.log)
          (RealFunction.MulFun (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => x)
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.inv x)))
        (fun _ : RealTheory.Carrier => F.one)) := by
    exact hsub
  exact RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright hsubLiteral

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_log_nat_interval
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_log_nat_interval
    (n N : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n <= N) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
      (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N)
      (RealTheory.sub
        (logIntegralPrimitive (RealTheory.nat N))
        (logIntegralPrimitive (RealTheory.nat n)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  let a := RealTheory.nat n
  let b := RealTheory.nat N
  have hab : F.le a b := RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hnN
  have hLogCont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) Ielem.logSpec.log := by
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (nat_interval_subset_positive hn)
      RealTheory.elementaryFunction_log_continuousOn
  have hPrimitiveCont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) logIntegralPrimitive := by
    have hmul := RealTheory.function_continuousOn_mul
      (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      RealTheory.function_continuousOn_identity hLogCont
    exact RealTheory.function_continuousOn_sub hmul
      RealTheory.function_continuousOn_identity
  have hDerivative :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
        logIntegralPrimitive Ielem.logSpec.log := by
    intro x hx
    have hxPos : F.lt F.zero x := by
      have haPos : F.lt F.zero a := by
        unfold a
        have hraw := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
        change F.lt F.zero (F.nat n) at hraw
        exact hraw
      exact F.lt_trans haPos hx.left
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
      (fun y hy => by
        have haPos : F.lt F.zero a := by
          unfold a
          have hraw := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
          change F.lt F.zero (F.nat n) at hraw
          exact hraw
        exact F.lt_trans haPos hy.left)
      hx
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_logIntegralPrimitive x hxPos)
  change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
    Ielem.logSpec.log a b
    (F.sub (logIntegralPrimitive b) (logIntegralPrimitive a))
  exact
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      hab hLogCont hPrimitiveCont hDerivative

name: factorialInverse_mul_two_previous
statement:
private theorem factorialInverse_mul_two_previous
    (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (k + 2))))
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (k + 2)))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a := F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (k + 2)))
  let b := F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (k + 1))
  let c := F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (k + 1)))
  let d := F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)
  have hb : Not (b = F.zero) := by
    unfold b
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      (Tautology.Nat.factorial_ne_zero (k + 1))
  have hbig := factorialInverse_mul_previous (k + 1)
  have hsmall := factorialInverse_mul_previous k
  change F.mul a b = F.inv (F.nat (k + 2)) at hbig
  change F.mul c d = F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)) at hsmall
  change F.mul a d =
    F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (k + 2))) (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)))
  calc
    F.mul a d = F.mul a (F.mul F.one d) := by rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul (F.mul b c) d) := by
      rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hb]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul b (F.mul c d)) := by
      rw [F.mul_assoc b c d]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) := by
      rw [F.mul_assoc a b (F.mul c d)]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (k + 2)))
          (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))) := by
      rw [hbig, hsmall]

name: logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_odd
statement:
private theorem logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_odd
    (n N r : Nat) :
    logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * r + 1) =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm
  have hindex : 2 * r + 1 + 2 = 2 * (r + 1) + 1 := by omega
  rw [hindex]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber_odd_eq_zero F
    (show 0 < r + 1 by omega)]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat F.one (2 * (r + 1) + 1))
            (F.inv (F.nat
              (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * (r + 1) + 1)))))
          F.zero)
        (F.sub
          (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * r + 1) (F.nat N))
          (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * r + 1) (F.nat n))) =
      F.zero
  rw [F.mul_zero]
  rw [F.zero_mul]

name: logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_even
statement:
private theorem logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_even
    (n N r : Nat) :
    logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * r) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
        (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := 2 * (r + 1)
  let c := F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (q - 2))
  let xN := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat N) (q - 1))
  let xn := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) (q - 1))
  let B := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F q
  have hqIndex : q - 2 = 2 * r := by
    unfold q
    omega
  have hqPower : q - 1 = 2 * r + 1 := by
    unfold q
    omega
  have hfactor :
      F.mul
          (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial q))) c =
        F.mul (F.inv (F.nat q)) (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1))) := by
    have hraw := factorialInverse_mul_two_previous (q - 2)
    have hfirst : q - 2 + 2 = q := by omega
    have hsecond : q - 2 + 1 = q - 1 := by omega
    rw [hfirst, hsecond] at hraw
    exact hraw
  have hN := reciprocalDerivativeAt_even_value r (F.nat N)
  have hn := reciprocalDerivativeAt_even_value r (F.nat n)
  change reciprocalDerivativeAt (q - 2) (F.nat N) = F.mul c xN at hN
  change reciprocalDerivativeAt (q - 2) (F.nat n) = F.mul c xn at hn
  unfold logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm
  have hrawIndex : 2 * r + 2 = q := by
    unfold q
    omega
  rw [hrawIndex]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_one_base]
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul
          (F.mul F.one
            (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial q)))) B)
        (F.sub
          (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * r) (F.nat N))
          (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * r) (F.nat n))) =
      F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
        (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r)
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [<- hqIndex]
  rw [hN, hn]
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F c xN xn]
  unfold stirlingCorrectionTerm
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial q))) B)
        (F.mul c (F.sub xN xn)) =
      F.sub
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul B (F.inv (F.nat q)))
            (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1)))) xN)
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul B (F.inv (F.nat q)))
            (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1)))) xn)
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial q))) B)
        (F.mul c (F.sub xN xn)) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial q))) c)
          (F.mul B (F.sub xN xn)) :=
      RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm _ _ _ _
    _ = F.mul
          (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat q)) (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1))))
          (F.mul B (F.sub xN xn)) := by
      rw [hfactor]
    _ = F.mul
          (F.mul
            (F.mul B (F.inv (F.nat q)))
            (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1))))
          (F.sub xN xn) := by
      calc
        F.mul
            (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat q)) (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1))))
            (F.mul B (F.sub xN xn)) =
            F.mul
              (F.mul
                (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat q))
                  (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1)))) B)
              (F.sub xN xn) :=
          (F.mul_assoc
            (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat q)) (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1))))
            B (F.sub xN xn)).symm
        _ = F.mul
              (F.mul
                (F.mul B (F.inv (F.nat q)))
                (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1))))
              (F.sub xN xn) := by
                congr 1
                calc
                  F.mul
                      (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat q))
                        (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1)))) B =
                      F.mul B
                        (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat q))
                          (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1)))) := by
                            rw [F.mul_comm]
                  _ = F.mul
                        (F.mul B (F.inv (F.nat q)))
                        (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1))) := by
                          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.sub
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (F.mul B (F.inv (F.nat q)))
              (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1)))) xN)
          (F.mul
            (F.mul (F.mul B (F.inv (F.nat q)))
              (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1)))) xn) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F _ _ _

name: log_eulerMaclaurinCorrection_eq_stirlingCorrectionSum
statement:
private theorem log_eulerMaclaurinCorrection_eq_stirlingCorrectionSum
    (n N m : Nat) :
    eulerMaclaurinCorrection logDerivativeAt
        (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N) RealTheory.one
        (2 * m + 2) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun r : Nat =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
            (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r))
        (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold eulerMaclaurinCorrection
  change
    F.finiteSum
        (logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N)
        (2 * m + 2 - 1) =
      F.finiteSum
        (fun r : Nat =>
          F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
            (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r))
        (m + 1)
  have hlength : 2 * m + 2 - 1 = 2 * m + 1 := by omega
  rw [hlength]
  calc
    F.finiteSum (logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N)
        (2 * m + 1) =
        F.add
          (F.finiteSum
            (logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N) (2 * m))
          (logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * m)) := by
      exact RealTheory.finiteSum_succ _ (2 * m)
    _ = F.add
          (F.finiteSum
            (fun r : Nat =>
              F.add
                (logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * r))
                (logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N
                  (2 * r + 1))) m)
          (logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * m)) := by
      have hpair := RealTheory.finiteSum_pair_even_odd
        (logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N) m
      exact congrArg
        (fun s : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.add s (logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * m)))
        hpair
    _ = F.add
          (F.finiteSum
            (fun r : Nat =>
              F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
                (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r)) m)
          (F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N m)
            (stirlingCorrectionTerm n m)) := by
      have hsum :
          F.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat =>
                F.add
                  (logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * r))
                  (logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N
                    (2 * r + 1))) m =
            F.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat =>
                F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
                  (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r)) m := by
        apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
        intro r hr
        rw [logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_even]
        rw [logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_odd]
        change F.add
            (F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
              (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r)) F.zero =
          F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
            (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r)
        rw [F.add_zero]
      have hlast := logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm_even n N m
      change logEulerMaclaurinRawCorrectionTerm n N (2 * m) =
        F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N m)
          (stirlingCorrectionTerm n m) at hlast
      rw [hsum, hlast]
    _ = F.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat =>
            F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
              (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r))
          (m + 1) := by
      exact (RealTheory.finiteSum_succ _ m).symm

name: eulerMaclaurin_log_nat_interval_raw
statement:
private theorem eulerMaclaurin_log_nat_interval_raw
    (n N p : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n < N) (hp : 2 <= p) :
    let scaleAbs
proof:
:= RealTheory.inv
      (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial p))
    let scale := RealTheory.mul
      (Nat.rec RealTheory.one
        (fun (_ : Nat) (s : RealTheory.Carrier) => RealTheory.neg s)
        (p + 1))
      scaleAbs
    Exists fun J : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      Exists fun A : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
              RealTheory.mul (periodicBernoulli p x)
                (logDerivativeAt p x))
            (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N) J /\
        RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
              RealTheory.abs (logDerivativeAt p x))
            (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N) A /\
        naturalSampleSum
            RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
            n (N - n) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (logIntegralPrimitive (RealTheory.nat N))
                  (logIntegralPrimitive (RealTheory.nat n)))
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                      (RealTheory.nat n))
                    (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                      (RealTheory.nat N)))))
              (eulerMaclaurinCorrection logDerivativeAt
                (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N)
                RealTheory.one p))
            (RealTheory.mul scale J) /\
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.mul scale J))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul scaleAbs
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base p)) A) := by
  have hcount : 0 < N - n := by omega
  have hend : n + (N - n) = N := by omega
  have hD :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeChainWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat (n + (N - n))))
        RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
        logDerivativeAt p := by
    rw [hend]
    exact logDerivative_hasDerivativeChainWithinOn_natInterval n N p hn
  have hDp :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat (n + (N - n))))
        (logDerivativeAt p) := by
    rw [hend]
    exact logDerivativeAt_continuousOn_natInterval n N p hn
  have hI :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
        (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat (n + (N - n)))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (logIntegralPrimitive (RealTheory.nat (n + (N - n))))
          (logIntegralPrimitive (RealTheory.nat n))) := by
    rw [hend]
    exact hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_log_nat_interval n N hn (by omega)
  have hmain := eulerMaclaurin_natSum
    n RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
    logDerivativeAt
    (RealTheory.sub
      (logIntegralPrimitive (RealTheory.nat (n + (N - n))))
      (logIntegralPrimitive (RealTheory.nat n)))
    p (N - n) hcount hp hD hDp hI
  rw [hend] at hmain
  exact hmain

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reciprocalDerivativeAt_odd
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reciprocalDerivativeAt_odd
    (n N m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n <= N) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1))
      (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N)
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m)))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat N) (2 * m + 1)))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) (2 * m + 1)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a := RealTheory.nat n
  let b := RealTheory.nat N
  have hab : F.le a b := RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hnN
  have hIntegrandCont :=
    reciprocalDerivativeAt_continuousOn_natInterval n N (2 * m + 1) hn
  have hPrimitiveCont :=
    reciprocalDerivativeAt_continuousOn_natInterval n N (2 * m) hn
  have hDerivative :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
        (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m))
        (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1)) := by
    intro x hx
    have haPos : F.lt F.zero a := by
      unfold a
      have hraw := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
      change F.lt F.zero (F.nat n) at hraw
      exact hraw
    have hxPos : F.lt F.zero x := F.lt_trans haPos hx.left
    have hraw :=
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_reciprocalDerivativeAt_step (2 * m)) x hxPos
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
      (fun y hy => F.lt_trans haPos hy.left) hx hraw
  have hraw :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      hab hIntegrandCont hPrimitiveCont hDerivative
  have hleft := reciprocalDerivativeAt_even_value m b
  have hright := reciprocalDerivativeAt_even_value m a
  change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
    (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1)) a b
    (F.sub (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m) b)
      (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m) a)) at hraw
  rw [hleft, hright] at hraw
  change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
    (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1)) a b
    (F.sub
      (F.mul (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m)))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat b (2 * m + 1))))
      (F.mul (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m)))
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat a (2 * m + 1))))) at hraw
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F] at hraw
  exact hraw

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_logDerivativeAt_even
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_logDerivativeAt_even
    (n N m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n <= N) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        RealTheory.abs (logDerivativeAt (2 * m + 2) x))
      (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat N)
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m)))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) (2 * m + 1)))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat N) (2 * m + 1)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab : F.le (F.nat n) (F.nat N) :=
    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hnN
  have hraw := hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reciprocalDerivativeAt_odd
    n N m hn hnN
  have hrawData :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hraw
  have hneg := RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_neg_of_le
    hab hrawData.left hrawData.right
  have hpoint :
      forall x : RealTheory.Carrier,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval (F.nat n) (F.nat N) x ->
          F.neg (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1) x) =
            F.abs (logDerivativeAt (2 * m + 2) x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hnPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat n) := by
      have hcast := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
      change F.lt F.zero (F.nat n) at hcast
      exact hcast
    have hxPos : F.lt F.zero x := F.lt_of_lt_of_le hnPos hx.left
    have hvalue := reciprocalDerivativeAt_odd_value m x
    change
      F.neg (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1) x) =
        F.abs (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1) x)
    rw [hvalue]
    change
      F.neg
          (F.neg
            (F.mul
              (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 1)))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * m + 2))))) =
        F.abs
          (F.neg
            (F.mul
              (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 1)))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * m + 2)))))
    rw [F.neg_neg]
    have hpowPos :
        F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * m + 2)) :=
      RealFunction.powNat_pos hxPos (2 * m + 2)
    have hnonneg :
        F.le F.zero
          (F.mul
            (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 1)))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * m + 2)))) :=
      F.mul_nonneg
        (RealTheory.nat_nonneg (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 1)))
        (F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos hpowPos))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F]
    have habs := RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hnonneg
    change
      F.abs
          (F.mul
            (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 1)))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * m + 2)))) =
        F.mul
          (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m + 1)))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat x (2 * m + 2))) at habs
    exact habs.symm
  have hnegLiteral : RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        F.neg (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1) x))
      (F.nat n) (F.nat N)
      (F.mul
        (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m)))
        (F.sub
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) (2 * m + 1)))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat N) (2 * m + 1)))))
      := by
    change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        F.neg (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1) x))
      (F.nat n) (F.nat N)
      (F.neg
        (F.mul
          (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m)))
          (F.sub
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat N) (2 * m + 1)))
            (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) (2 * m + 1)))))) at hneg
    let c := F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m))
    let xN := F.inv
      (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat N) (2 * m + 1))
    let xn := F.inv
      (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) (2 * m + 1))
    have hvalue :
        F.neg (F.mul c (F.sub xN xn)) =
          F.mul c (F.sub xn xN) := by
      calc
        F.neg (F.mul c (F.sub xN xn)) =
            F.mul c (F.neg (F.sub xN xn)) :=
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F c (F.sub xN xn)).symm
        _ = F.mul c (F.sub xn xN) := by
          rw [(IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F xN xn).symm]
    change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        F.neg (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1) x))
      (F.nat n) (F.nat N)
      (F.neg (F.mul c (F.sub xN xn))) at hneg
    rw [hvalue] at hneg
    change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        F.neg (reciprocalDerivativeAt (2 * m + 1) x))
      (F.nat n) (F.nat N)
      (F.mul
        (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (2 * m)))
        (F.sub
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) (2 * m + 1)))
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat N) (2 * m + 1))))) at hneg
    exact hneg
  exact RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
    hab hpoint hnegLiteral

name: log_eulerMaclaurin_finite_error
statement:
private theorem log_eulerMaclaurin_finite_error
    (n N m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n < N) :
    Exists fun R : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      naturalSampleSum
          RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          n (N - n) =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.sub
                (logIntegralPrimitive (RealTheory.nat N))
                (logIntegralPrimitive (RealTheory.nat n)))
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                    (RealTheory.nat n))
                  (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                    (RealTheory.nat N)))))
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat =>
                RealTheory.sub
                  (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
                  (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r))
              (m + 1)))
          R /\
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs R)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (2 * m + 2)))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (2 * m + 1))))
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (2 * m + 2)))
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealFunction.powNat
                (RealTheory.nat n) (2 * m + 1)))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealFunction.powNat
                (RealTheory.nat N) (2 * m + 1)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := 2 * m + 2
  have hmain := eulerMaclaurin_log_nat_interval_raw
    n N p hn hnN (by unfold p; omega)
  dsimp only at hmain
  cases hmain with
  | intro J hJA =>
      cases hJA with
      | intro A hdata =>
          have hA := hdata.right.left
          have hFormula := hdata.right.right.left
          have hBound := hdata.right.right.right
          let R := F.mul
            (F.mul
              (Nat.rec F.one
                (fun (_ : Nat) (s : RealTheory.Carrier) => F.neg s)
                (p + 1))
              (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial p)))) J
          refine Exists.intro R ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · rw [log_eulerMaclaurinCorrection_eq_stirlingCorrectionSum
                n N m] at hFormula
            change naturalSampleSum
                RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                n (N - n) =
              F.add
                (F.add
                  (F.add
                    (F.sub
                      (logIntegralPrimitive (F.nat N))
                      (logIntegralPrimitive (F.nat n)))
                    (F.half
                      (F.add
                        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                          (F.nat n))
                        (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                          (F.nat N)))))
                  (F.finiteSum
                    (fun r : Nat =>
                      F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
                        (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r))
                    (m + 1))) R
            unfold R p
            exact hFormula
          · have hAexact :=
              hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_logDerivativeAt_even
                n N m hn (by omega)
            have hAvalue :=
              RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
                hA hAexact
            rw [hAvalue] at hBound
            have hfactor := factorialInverse_mul_two_previous (2 * m)
            have hfirst : 2 * m + 2 = p := by unfold p; omega
            have hsecond : 2 * m + 1 = p - 1 := by unfold p; omega
            change
              F.mul
                  (F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial p)))
                  (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (p - 2))) =
                F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p))
                  (F.inv (F.nat (p - 1))) at hfactor
            let q := F.inv (F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial p))
            let c := F.nat (Tautology.Nat.factorial (p - 2))
            let E := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F p
            let d := F.sub
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) (p - 1)))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat N) (p - 1)))
            have hrhs :
                F.mul (F.mul q E) (F.mul c d) =
                  F.mul
                    (F.mul
                      (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p))
                        (F.inv (F.nat (p - 1)))) E) d := by
              calc
                F.mul (F.mul q E) (F.mul c d) =
                    F.mul (F.mul q c) (F.mul E d) :=
                  RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm q E c d
                _ = F.mul
                      (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p))
                        (F.inv (F.nat (p - 1))))
                      (F.mul E d) := by
                    unfold q c
                    rw [hfactor]
                _ = F.mul
                      (F.mul
                        (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p))
                          (F.inv (F.nat (p - 1)))) E) d := by
                    exact
                      (F.mul_assoc
                        (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p))
                          (F.inv (F.nat (p - 1)))) E d).symm
            change
              F.le (F.abs R)
                (F.mul (F.mul q E) (F.mul c d)) at hBound
            rw [hrhs] at hBound
            unfold p at hBound
            exact hBound

name: logEulerFinite_formula_and_bound
statement:
private theorem logEulerFinite_formula_and_bound
    (n N m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n < N) :
    And
      (naturalSampleSum
          RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          n (N - n) =
        RealTheory.add
          (logEulerFiniteMain n N m)
          (logEulerFiniteRemainder n N m))
      (RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (logEulerFiniteRemainder n N m))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (2 * m + 2)))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (2 * m + 1))))
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (2 * m + 2)))
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealFunction.powNat
                (RealTheory.nat n) (2 * m + 1)))
            (RealTheory.inv
              (RealFunction.powNat
                (RealTheory.nat N) (2 * m + 1))))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let S := naturalSampleSum
    RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log n (N - n)
  let M := logEulerFiniteMain n N m
  have hraw := log_eulerMaclaurin_finite_error n N m hn hnN
  cases hraw with
  | intro R hR =>
      have hFormula := hR.left
      have hBound := hR.right
      have hmainLiteral :
          logEulerFiniteMain n N m =
            F.add
              (F.add
                (F.add
                  (F.sub
                    (logIntegralPrimitive (F.nat N))
                    (logIntegralPrimitive (F.nat n)))
                  (F.half
                    (F.add
                      (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                        (F.nat n))
                      (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                        (F.nat N)))))
                (F.finiteSum
                  (fun r : Nat =>
                    F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
                      (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r))
                  (m + 1))) F.zero := rfl
      have hzeroMain :
          logEulerFiniteMain n N m =
            F.add
              (F.add
                (F.sub
                  (logIntegralPrimitive (F.nat N))
                  (logIntegralPrimitive (F.nat n)))
                (F.half
                  (F.add
                    (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                      (F.nat n))
                    (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                      (F.nat N)))))
              (F.finiteSum
                (fun r : Nat =>
                  F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
                    (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r))
                (m + 1)) := by
        rw [hmainLiteral, F.add_zero]
      have hremEq : logEulerFiniteRemainder n N m = R := by
        unfold logEulerFiniteRemainder
        rw [hzeroMain]
        rw [hFormula]
        let B := F.add
          (F.add
            (F.sub
              (logIntegralPrimitive (F.nat N))
              (logIntegralPrimitive (F.nat n)))
            (F.half
              (F.add
                (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                  (F.nat n))
                (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                  (F.nat N)))))
          (F.finiteSum
            (fun r : Nat =>
              F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
                (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r))
            (m + 1))
        change F.sub (F.add B R) B = R
        rw [F.add_comm B R]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F R B
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · unfold logEulerFiniteRemainder
        change S = F.add M (F.sub S M)
        calc
          S = F.add (F.sub S M) M :=
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F S M).symm
          _ = F.add M (F.sub S M) := by rw [F.add_comm]
      · rw [hremEq]
        exact hBound

name: centeredLogFactorialSequence_eq_at
statement:
private theorem centeredLogFactorialSequence_eq_at
    (k : Nat) :
    centeredLogFactorialSequence k =
      centeredLogFactorialAt (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let x := F.nat (k + 1)
  let l := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log x
  let L := logFactorial (k + 1)
  unfold centeredLogFactorialSequence centeredLogFactorialAt
    logIntegralPrimitive
  change
    F.add (F.sub L (F.mul (F.add x (F.half F.one)) l)) x =
      F.sub (F.sub L (F.sub (F.mul x l) x)) (F.half l)
  rw [F.add_mul]
  have hhalfMul := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_one_mul F l
  change F.mul (F.half F.one) l = F.half l at hhalfMul
  rw [hhalfMul]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F]
  rw [F.neg_neg]
  calc
    F.add (F.add L (F.add (F.neg (F.mul x l)) (F.neg (F.half l)))) x =
        F.add
          (F.add (F.add L (F.neg (F.mul x l))) x)
          (F.neg (F.half l)) := by
      calc
        F.add (F.add L
            (F.add (F.neg (F.mul x l)) (F.neg (F.half l)))) x =
            F.add
              (F.add
                (F.add L (F.neg (F.mul x l)))
                (F.neg (F.half l))) x := by
                  rw [<- F.add_assoc L _ _]
        _ = F.add
              (F.add (F.add L (F.neg (F.mul x l))) x)
              (F.neg (F.half l)) := by
                let A := F.add L (F.neg (F.mul x l))
                let B := F.neg (F.half l)
                change F.add (F.add A B) x = F.add (F.add A x) B
                calc
                  F.add (F.add A B) x = F.add A (F.add B x) :=
                    F.add_assoc A B x
                  _ = F.add A (F.add x B) := by rw [F.add_comm B x]
                  _ = F.add (F.add A x) B :=
                    (F.add_assoc A x B).symm
    _ = F.add
          (F.add L (F.add (F.neg (F.mul x l)) x))
          (F.neg (F.half l)) := by
      rw [F.add_assoc L (F.neg (F.mul x l)) x]

name: log_centered_difference_algebra
statement:
private theorem log_centered_difference_algebra
    (S LN Ln PN Pn lN ln C R : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hbridge : RealTheory.sub S ln = RealTheory.sub LN Ln)
    (hformula :
      S = RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.sub PN Pn)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (RealTheory.add ln lN))) C) R) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub LN PN)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base lN))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub Ln Pn)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base ln)) =
      RealTheory.add C R
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.sub S ln = F.sub LN Ln at hbridge
  change S = F.add (F.add (F.add (F.sub PN Pn)
    (F.half (F.add ln lN))) C) R at hformula
  rw [hformula] at hbridge
  have hhalf := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add F ln lN
  change F.half (F.add ln lN) = F.add (F.half ln) (F.half lN)
    at hhalf
  rw [hhalf] at hbridge
  change
    F.sub
        (F.sub (F.sub LN PN) (F.half lN))
        (F.sub (F.sub Ln Pn) (F.half ln)) =
      F.add C R
  have hmain :
      F.sub LN Ln =
        F.sub
          (F.add
            (F.add
              (F.add (F.sub PN Pn)
                (F.add (F.half ln) (F.half lN))) C) R)
          ln := hbridge.symm
  have haddLeftComm (a b c : RealTheory.Carrier) :
      F.add a (F.add b c) = F.add b (F.add a c) := by
    calc
      F.add a (F.add b c) = F.add (F.add a b) c := by
        rw [<- F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add (F.add b a) c := by rw [F.add_comm a b]
      _ = F.add b (F.add a c) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
  have hcancelAdjacent (a c : RealTheory.Carrier) :
      F.add a (F.add (F.neg a) c) = c := by
    calc
      F.add a (F.add (F.neg a) c) =
          F.add (F.add a (F.neg a)) c := by
        rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add F.zero c := by rw [F.add_neg]
      _ = c := by rw [F.zero_add]
  let D := F.add (F.neg PN)
    (F.add Pn
      (F.add (F.neg (F.half lN))
        (F.sub ln (F.half ln))))
  have hshift := congrArg (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.add x D) hmain
  have hright :
      F.add
          (F.sub
            (F.add
              (F.add
                (F.add (F.sub PN Pn)
                  (F.add (F.half ln) (F.half lN))) C) R)
            ln)
          D =
        F.add C R := by
    unfold D
    simp only [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp only [F.add_assoc, haddLeftComm, F.add_comm]
    rw [haddLeftComm (F.half ln) (F.neg PN),
      haddLeftComm (F.half lN) (F.neg PN),
      haddLeftComm R (F.neg PN),
      haddLeftComm C (F.neg PN),
      haddLeftComm ln (F.neg PN),
      haddLeftComm Pn (F.neg PN), hcancelAdjacent PN,
      haddLeftComm (F.half ln) (F.neg Pn),
      haddLeftComm (F.half lN) (F.neg Pn),
      haddLeftComm R (F.neg Pn),
      haddLeftComm C (F.neg Pn),
      haddLeftComm ln (F.neg Pn), hcancelAdjacent Pn,
      haddLeftComm (F.half ln) (F.neg ln),
      haddLeftComm (F.half lN) (F.neg ln),
      haddLeftComm R (F.neg ln),
      haddLeftComm C (F.neg ln), hcancelAdjacent ln,
      haddLeftComm (F.half ln) (F.neg (F.half lN)),
      hcancelAdjacent (F.half lN), F.add_neg, F.add_zero]
  have hleft :
      F.add (F.sub LN Ln) D = F.add C R := hshift.trans hright
  have hlnSubHalf : F.sub ln (F.half ln) = F.half ln := by
    calc
      F.sub ln (F.half ln) =
          F.sub (F.add (F.half ln) (F.half ln)) (F.half ln) := by
        exact congrArg (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.sub x (F.half ln))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F ln).symm
      _ = F.half ln :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F (F.half ln) (F.half ln)
  unfold D at hleft
  rw [hlnSubHalf] at hleft
  simp only [F.sub_eq_add_neg] at hleft ⊢
  simp only [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F, F.neg_neg]
    at hleft ⊢
  simp only [F.add_assoc, haddLeftComm, F.add_comm] at hleft ⊢
  exact hleft

name: centeredLogFactorialAt_difference_formula
statement:
private theorem centeredLogFactorialAt_difference_formula
    (n N m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n < N) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (centeredLogFactorialAt N)
        (centeredLogFactorialAt n) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub
              (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
              (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r))
          (m + 1))
        (logEulerFiniteRemainder n N m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  have hfinite := logEulerFinite_formula_and_bound n N m hn hnN
  have hformula := hfinite.left
  unfold logEulerFiniteMain at hformula
  change naturalSampleSum Ielem.logSpec.log n (N - n) =
    F.add
      (F.add
        (F.add
          (F.add
            (F.sub
              (logIntegralPrimitive (F.nat N))
              (logIntegralPrimitive (F.nat n)))
            (F.half
              (F.add
                (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n))
                (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat N)))))
          (F.finiteSum
            (fun r : Nat =>
              F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
                (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r)) (m + 1))) F.zero)
      (logEulerFiniteRemainder n N m) at hformula
  rw [F.add_zero] at hformula
  have hbridge := naturalSampleSum_log_sub_first_eq_logFactorial_sub
    n N (by omega)
  change
    F.sub
        (naturalSampleSum Ielem.logSpec.log n (N - n))
        (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n)) =
      F.sub (logFactorial N) (logFactorial n) at hbridge
  unfold centeredLogFactorialAt
  exact log_centered_difference_algebra
    (naturalSampleSum Ielem.logSpec.log n (N - n))
    (logFactorial N) (logFactorial n)
    (logIntegralPrimitive (F.nat N))
    (logIntegralPrimitive (F.nat n))
    (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat N))
    (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n))
    (F.finiteSum
      (fun r : Nat =>
        F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
          (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r)) (m + 1))
    (logEulerFiniteRemainder n N m)
    hbridge hformula

name: stirlingCorrectionTerm_abs
statement:
private theorem stirlingCorrectionTerm_abs
    (n r : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    let q
proof:
:= 2 * (r + 1)
    RealTheory.abs (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.abs
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base q))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q)))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (q - 1))))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) (q - 1))) := by
  dsimp only
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := 2 * (r + 1)
  let B := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F q
  let iq := F.inv (F.nat q)
  let iqm := F.inv (F.nat (q - 1))
  let x := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) (q - 1))
  have hqPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat q) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by unfold q; omega)
  have hqmPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (q - 1)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by unfold q; omega)
  have hnPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat n) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hpowPos :
      F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) (q - 1)) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_pos hnPos (q - 1)
  have hiqNonneg : F.le F.zero iq :=
    F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos hqPos)
  have hiqmNonneg : F.le F.zero iqm :=
    F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos hqmPos)
  have hxNonneg : F.le F.zero x :=
    F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos hpowPos)
  have hiqAbs : F.abs iq = iq := RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hiqNonneg
  have hiqmAbs : F.abs iqm = iqm := RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hiqmNonneg
  have hxAbs : F.abs x = x := RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hxNonneg
  unfold stirlingCorrectionTerm
  change F.abs (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul B iq) iqm) x) =
    F.mul (F.mul (F.mul (F.abs B) iq) iqm) x
  calc
    F.abs (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul B iq) iqm) x) =
        F.mul (F.abs (F.mul (F.mul B iq) iqm)) (F.abs x) :=
      RealTheory.abs_mul _ _
    _ = F.mul
          (F.mul (F.abs (F.mul B iq)) (F.abs iqm))
          (F.abs x) := by
      exact congrArg (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier => F.mul z (F.abs x))
        (RealTheory.abs_mul (F.mul B iq) iqm)
    _ = F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.abs B) (F.abs iq)) (F.abs iqm))
          (F.abs x) := by
      exact congrArg (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier =>
        F.mul (F.mul z (F.abs iqm)) (F.abs x))
        (RealTheory.abs_mul B iq)
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul (F.abs B) iq) iqm) x := by
      rw [hiqAbs, hiqmAbs, hxAbs]

name: logEulerFiniteRemainder_coarse_bound
statement:
private theorem logEulerFiniteRemainder_coarse_bound
    (n N m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n < N) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (logEulerFiniteRemainder n N m))
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (2 * m + 2)))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (2 * m + 1))))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (2 * m + 2)))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat
              (RealTheory.nat n) (2 * m + 1)))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat
              (RealTheory.nat N) (2 * m + 1)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := 2 * m + 2
  let c := F.mul
    (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p)) (F.inv (F.nat (p - 1))))
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F p)
  let xn := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) (p - 1))
  let xN := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat N) (p - 1))
  have hraw := (logEulerFinite_formula_and_bound n N m hn hnN).right
  change F.le (F.abs (logEulerFiniteRemainder n N m))
    (F.mul c (F.sub xn xN)) at hraw
  have hpPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat p) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by unfold p; omega)
  have hpmPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (p - 1)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by unfold p; omega)
  have hcNonneg : F.le F.zero c := by
    unfold c
    exact F.mul_nonneg
      (F.mul_nonneg
        (F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos hpPos))
        (F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos hpmPos)))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope_nonneg F p)
  have hNPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat N) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hpowNPos :
      F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat N) (p - 1)) :=
    RealFunction.powNat_pos hNPos (p - 1)
  have hxNNonneg : F.le F.zero xN := by
    unfold xN
    exact F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos hpowNPos)
  have hsub : F.le (F.sub xn xN) xn := by
    have h := F.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le (F.le_refl xn) hxNNonneg
    change F.le (F.sub xn xN) (F.sub xn F.zero) at h
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F] at h
  have hxadd : F.le xn (F.add xn xN) := by
    have h := F.add_le_add_left hxNNonneg xn
    change F.le (F.add xn F.zero) (F.add xn xN) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hdiff : F.le (F.sub xn xN) (F.add xn xN) :=
    F.le_trans hsub hxadd
  exact F.le_trans hraw (F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hdiff hcNonneg)

name: centeredLogFactorialAt_difference_coarse_bound
statement:
private theorem centeredLogFactorialAt_difference_coarse_bound
    (n N : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n < N) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (centeredLogFactorialAt N)
          (centeredLogFactorialAt n)))
      (RealTheory.mul stirlingCauchyCoefficient
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) 1))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat N) 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := F.mul
    (F.mul (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F 2))
      (F.inv (F.nat 2)))
    (F.inv (F.nat 1))
  let E := F.mul
    (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat 2)) (F.inv (F.nat 1)))
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F 2)
  let xn := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) 1)
  let xN := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat N) 1)
  let R := logEulerFiniteRemainder n N 0
  have hformula := centeredLogFactorialAt_difference_formula n N 0 hn hnN
  rw [Nat.zero_add] at hformula
  change F.sub (centeredLogFactorialAt N) (centeredLogFactorialAt n) =
    F.add
      (F.finiteSum
        (fun r : Nat =>
          F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
            (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r)) 1) R at hformula
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_one F] at hformula
  change F.sub (centeredLogFactorialAt N) (centeredLogFactorialAt n) =
    F.add
      (F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N 0)
        (stirlingCorrectionTerm n 0)) R at hformula
  have htriangle := RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
    (F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N 0) (stirlingCorrectionTerm n 0)) R
  change F.le
    (F.abs (F.sub (centeredLogFactorialAt N) (centeredLogFactorialAt n)))
    (F.mul stirlingCauchyCoefficient (F.add xn xN))
  rw [hformula]
  have hcorrTriangle :
      F.le
        (F.abs
          (F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N 0)
            (stirlingCorrectionTerm n 0)))
        (F.add
          (F.abs (stirlingCorrectionTerm N 0))
          (F.abs (stirlingCorrectionTerm n 0))) := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    have h := RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
      (stirlingCorrectionTerm N 0) (F.neg (stirlingCorrectionTerm n 0))
    rw [RealTheory.abs_neg] at h
    exact h
  have hNAbs := stirlingCorrectionTerm_abs N 0 (by omega)
  have hnAbs := stirlingCorrectionTerm_abs n 0 hn
  dsimp only at hNAbs hnAbs
  change F.abs (stirlingCorrectionTerm N 0) = F.mul A xN at hNAbs
  change F.abs (stirlingCorrectionTerm n 0) = F.mul A xn at hnAbs
  rw [hNAbs, hnAbs] at hcorrTriangle
  have hcorr :
      F.le
        (F.abs
          (F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N 0)
            (stirlingCorrectionTerm n 0)))
        (F.mul A (F.add xn xN)) := by
    have h := hcorrTriangle
    rw [F.add_comm (F.mul A xN) (F.mul A xn)] at h
    rw [<- F.mul_add] at h
    exact h
  have hrem := logEulerFiniteRemainder_coarse_bound n N 0 hn hnN
  change F.le (F.abs R) (F.mul E (F.add xn xN)) at hrem
  have hsum := F.add_le_add hcorr hrem
  have htotal := F.le_trans htriangle hsum
  change F.le
    (F.abs
      (F.add
        (F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N 0)
          (stirlingCorrectionTerm n 0)) R))
    (F.mul stirlingCauchyCoefficient (F.add xn xN))
  unfold stirlingCauchyCoefficient
  change F.le _ (F.mul (F.add A E) (F.add xn xN))
  rw [F.add_mul]
  exact htotal

name: stirlingCauchyCoefficient_nonneg
statement:
private theorem stirlingCauchyCoefficient_nonneg :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero stirlingCauchyCoefficient
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := F.mul
    (F.mul (F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F 2))
      (F.inv (F.nat 2)))
    (F.inv (F.nat 1))
  let E := F.mul
    (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat 2)) (F.inv (F.nat 1)))
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F 2)
  have h2Pos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat 2) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have h1Pos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat 1) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hA : F.le F.zero A := by
    unfold A
    exact F.mul_nonneg
      (F.mul_nonneg
        (RealTheory.abs_nonneg
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F 2))
        (F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos h2Pos)))
      (F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos h1Pos))
  have hE : F.le F.zero E := by
    unfold E
    exact F.mul_nonneg
      (F.mul_nonneg
        (F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos h2Pos))
        (F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos h1Pos)))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope_nonneg F 2)
  unfold stirlingCauchyCoefficient
  change F.le F.zero (F.add A E)
  have h := F.add_le_add hA hE
  change F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero) (F.add A E) at h
  rwa [F.zero_add] at h

name: stirlingCauchyControl_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem stirlingCauchyControl_tendsto_zero :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul stirlingCauchyCoefficient
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) 1)))
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htail :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.seqTendsto_inv_powNat_nat_succ_zero 1 (by omega)
  have hscaled := RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const stirlingCauchyCoefficient) htail
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.mul stirlingCauchyCoefficient
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat (k + 1)) 1)))
    (F.mul stirlingCauchyCoefficient F.zero) at hscaled
  rw [F.mul_zero] at hscaled
  exact hscaled

name: centeredLogFactorialSequence_seqCauchy
statement:
private theorem centeredLogFactorialSequence_seqCauchy :
    RealTheory.SeqCauchy centeredLogFactorialSequence
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.SeqCauchy F centeredLogFactorialSequence
  intro eps heps
  let e2 := F.half eps
  have he2 : F.lt F.zero e2 := F.half_pos heps
  have hcontrol := stirlingCauchyControl_tendsto_zero
  cases hcontrol e2 he2 with
  | intro K hK =>
      refine Exists.intro K ?_
      intro i j hi hj
      let control := fun k : Nat =>
        F.mul stirlingCauchyCoefficient
          (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat (k + 1)) 1))
      have hcontrolNonneg :
          forall k : Nat, F.le F.zero (control k) := by
        intro k
        unfold control
        have hkPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (k + 1)) :=
          RealTheory.nat_succ_pos k
        have hpowPos :
            F.lt F.zero (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat (k + 1)) 1) :=
          RealFunction.powNat_pos hkPos 1
        exact F.mul_nonneg stirlingCauchyCoefficient_nonneg
          (F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos hpowPos))
      have hcontrolLt :
          forall k : Nat, K <= k -> F.lt (control k) e2 := by
        intro k hk
        have hclose := hK k hk
        change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub (control k) F.zero)) e2 at hclose
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F] at hclose
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F (hcontrolNonneg k)] at hclose
        exact hclose
      have hordered :
          forall a b : Nat, K <= a -> K <= b -> a < b ->
            F.lt
              (F.abs
                (F.sub
                  (centeredLogFactorialSequence a)
                  (centeredLogFactorialSequence b))) eps := by
        intro a b ha hb hab
        have hbound := centeredLogFactorialAt_difference_coarse_bound
          (a + 1) (b + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        change F.le
          (F.abs
            (F.sub (centeredLogFactorialAt (b + 1))
              (centeredLogFactorialAt (a + 1))))
          (F.mul stirlingCauchyCoefficient
            (F.add
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat (a + 1)) 1))
              (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat (b + 1)) 1))))
            at hbound
        rw [F.mul_add] at hbound
        change F.le
          (F.abs
            (F.sub (centeredLogFactorialAt (b + 1))
              (centeredLogFactorialAt (a + 1))))
          (F.add (control a) (control b)) at hbound
        have hsumLt := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
          (hcontrolLt a ha) (hcontrolLt b hb)
        change F.lt (F.add (control a) (control b)) (F.add e2 e2)
          at hsumLt
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hsumLt
        rw [centeredLogFactorialSequence_eq_at a,
          centeredLogFactorialSequence_eq_at b]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm F]
        exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt hbound hsumLt
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · rw [hij, F.sub_self, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_zero F]
        exact heps
      · by_cases hijlt : i < j
        · exact hordered i j hi hj hijlt
        · have hjilt : j < i := by omega
          have hreverse := hordered j i hj hi hjilt
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm F] at hreverse
          exact hreverse

name: exists_centeredLogFactorialSequence_limit
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.seqCauchy_converges centeredLogFactorialSequence_seqCauchy

name: EulerMaclaurinInternal.centeredLogFactorialSequence_tendsto_stirlingConstant
statement:
theorem EulerMaclaurinInternal.centeredLogFactorialSequence_tendsto_stirlingConstant :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto centeredLogFactorialSequence stirlingConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold stirlingConstant
  exact Classical.choose_spec exists_centeredLogFactorialSequence_limit

name: stirlingCorrectionTerm_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem stirlingCorrectionTerm_tendsto_zero
    (r : Nat) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r)
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := 2 * (r + 1)
  let c := F.mul
    (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F q)
      (F.inv (F.nat q)))
    (F.inv (F.nat (q - 1)))
  have hq : 0 < q - 1 := by unfold q; omega
  have hpower :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.seqTendsto_inv_powNat_nat_succ_zero
      (q - 1) hq
  have hmul := RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const c) hpower
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r)
    (F.mul c F.zero) at hmul
  rw [F.mul_zero] at hmul
  exact hmul

name: stirlingCorrectionSum_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem stirlingCorrectionSum_tendsto_zero
    (s : Nat) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r) s)
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  induction s with
  | zero =>
      have hzero := RealTheory.seqTendsto_const F.zero
      exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hzero
        (Exists.intro 0 (fun k _hk => by
          change F.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r) 0 =
            F.zero
          exact RealTheory.finiteSum_zero _))
  | succ s ih =>
      have hterm := stirlingCorrectionTerm_tendsto_zero s
      have hadd := RealTheory.seqTendsto_add ih hterm
      change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun k : Nat =>
          F.add
            (F.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r) s)
            (stirlingCorrectionTerm (k + 1) s))
        (F.add F.zero F.zero) at hadd
      rw [F.zero_add] at hadd
      exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hadd
        (Exists.intro 0 (fun k _hk => by
          change F.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r) (s + 1) =
            F.add
              (F.finiteSum
                (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r) s)
              (stirlingCorrectionTerm (k + 1) s)
          exact RealTheory.finiteSum_succ _ s))

name: logEulerFiniteRemainder_eq_normalForm
statement:
private theorem logEulerFiniteRemainder_eq_normalForm
    (n N m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n < N) :
    logEulerFiniteRemainder n N m =
      logStirlingFiniteNormalForm n N m
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let CN := F.finiteSum
    (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm N r) (m + 1)
  let Cn := F.finiteSum
    (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm n r) (m + 1)
  let R := logEulerFiniteRemainder n N m
  have hformula := centeredLogFactorialAt_difference_formula n N m hn hnN
  have hsum := RealTheory.finiteSum_sub
    (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
    (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm n r) (m + 1)
  change F.finiteSum
      (fun r : Nat =>
        F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
          (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r)) (m + 1) =
    F.sub CN Cn at hsum
  change F.sub (centeredLogFactorialAt N) (centeredLogFactorialAt n) =
    F.add
      (F.finiteSum
        (fun r : Nat =>
          F.sub (stirlingCorrectionTerm N r)
            (stirlingCorrectionTerm n r)) (m + 1)) R at hformula
  rw [hsum] at hformula
  unfold logStirlingFiniteNormalForm
  change R = F.sub
    (F.sub (centeredLogFactorialAt N) (centeredLogFactorialAt n))
    (F.sub CN Cn)
  rw [hformula]
  rw [F.add_comm (F.sub CN Cn) R]
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F R (F.sub CN Cn)).symm

name: logStirlingFiniteNormalForm_tendsto
statement:
private theorem logStirlingFiniteNormalForm_tendsto
    (n m : Nat) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat => logStirlingFiniteNormalForm n (k + 1) m)
      (logStirlingFiniteLimit n m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Cn := centeredLogFactorialAt n
  let Sn := F.finiteSum
    (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm n r) (m + 1)
  have hcenterAt :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun k : Nat => centeredLogFactorialAt (k + 1))
        stirlingConstant :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually
      centeredLogFactorialSequence_tendsto_stirlingConstant
      (Exists.intro 0 (fun k _hk =>
        (centeredLogFactorialSequence_eq_at k).symm))
  have hcenterSub := RealTheory.seqTendsto_sub hcenterAt
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const Cn)
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat => F.sub (centeredLogFactorialAt (k + 1)) Cn)
    (F.sub stirlingConstant Cn) at hcenterSub
  have hsum := stirlingCorrectionSum_tendsto_zero (m + 1)
  have hsumSub := RealTheory.seqTendsto_sub hsum
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const Sn)
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.sub
        (F.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm (k + 1) r) (m + 1))
        Sn)
    (F.sub F.zero Sn) at hsumSub
  have hall := RealTheory.seqTendsto_sub hcenterSub hsumSub
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat => logStirlingFiniteNormalForm n (k + 1) m)
    (F.sub (F.sub stirlingConstant Cn) (F.sub F.zero Sn)) at hall
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F, F.sub_eq_add_neg, F.neg_neg]
    at hall
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat => logStirlingFiniteNormalForm n (k + 1) m)
    (logStirlingFiniteLimit n m)
  exact hall

name: logEulerFiniteRemainder_tendsto
statement:
private theorem logEulerFiniteRemainder_tendsto
    (n m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat => logEulerFiniteRemainder n (k + 1) m)
      (logStirlingFiniteLimit n m)
proof:
:= by
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually
    (logStirlingFiniteNormalForm_tendsto n m)
    (Exists.intro n (fun k hk => by
      exact logEulerFiniteRemainder_eq_normalForm
        n (k + 1) m hn (by omega)))

name: logEulerFiniteBound_tendsto
statement:
private theorem logEulerFiniteBound_tendsto
    (n m : Nat) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat => logEulerFiniteBound n (k + 1) m)
      (logEulerLimitBound n m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := 2 * m + 2
  let c := F.mul
    (F.mul (F.inv (F.nat p)) (F.inv (F.nat (p - 1))))
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F p)
  let x := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) (p - 1))
  have hp : 0 < p - 1 := by unfold p; omega
  have htail :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.seqTendsto_inv_powNat_nat_succ_zero
      (p - 1) hp
  have hdiff := RealTheory.seqTendsto_sub
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const x) htail
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat =>
      F.sub x
        (F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat (k + 1)) (p - 1))))
    (F.sub x F.zero) at hdiff
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F] at hdiff
  have hscaled := RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const c) hdiff
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto
    (fun k : Nat => logEulerFiniteBound n (k + 1) m)
    (logEulerLimitBound n m) at hscaled
  exact hscaled

name: logStirlingFiniteLimit_abs_bound
statement:
private theorem logStirlingFiniteLimit_abs_bound
    (n m : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (logStirlingFiniteLimit n m))
      (logEulerLimitBound n m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Rseq := fun k : Nat => logEulerFiniteRemainder n (k + 1) m
  let Bseq := fun k : Nat => logEulerFiniteBound n (k + 1) m
  have hR := logEulerFiniteRemainder_tendsto n m hn
  have hB := logEulerFiniteBound_tendsto n m
  have hAbsBound :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun k : Nat => F.le (F.abs (Rseq k)) (Bseq k)) := by
    refine Exists.intro n ?_
    intro k hk
    have hfinite := logEulerFinite_formula_and_bound
      n (k + 1) m hn (by omega)
    change F.le (F.abs (Rseq k)) (Bseq k)
    exact hfinite.right
  have hUpper :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun k : Nat => F.le (Rseq k) (Bseq k)) := by
    cases hAbsBound with
    | intro K hK =>
        refine Exists.intro K ?_
        intro k hk
        exact F.le_trans (RealTheory.le_abs_self (Rseq k)) (hK k hk)
  have hNegUpper :
      RealTheory.Eventually
        (fun k : Nat => F.le (F.neg (Rseq k)) (Bseq k)) := by
    cases hAbsBound with
    | intro K hK =>
        refine Exists.intro K ?_
        intro k hk
        exact F.le_trans (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self (Rseq k)) (hK k hk)
  have hLimitUpper :
      F.le (logStirlingFiniteLimit n m) (logEulerLimitBound n m) :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le hR hB hUpper
  have hNegR := RealTheory.seqTendsto_neg hR
  have hNegLimitUpper :
      F.le (F.neg (logStirlingFiniteLimit n m))
        (logEulerLimitBound n m) :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le hNegR hB hNegUpper
  exact RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hLimitUpper hNegLimitUpper

name: centeredLogFactorialAt_fixedOrder_with_stirlingConstant
statement:
private theorem centeredLogFactorialAt_fixedOrder_with_stirlingConstant
    (m n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    let p
proof:
:= 2 * m + 2
    Exists fun R : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      centeredLogFactorialAt n =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add stirlingConstant
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm n r) m)) R /\
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs R)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add
