                (RealTheory.abs
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
                    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base p))
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base p))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat p)))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (p - 1))))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) (p - 1)))) := by
  dsimp only
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := 2 * m + 2
  let H := centeredLogFactorialAt n
  let C := stirlingConstant
  let S := F.finiteSum (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm n r) m
  let c := stirlingCorrectionTerm n m
  let L := logStirlingFiniteLimit n m
  let R := F.sub c L
  have hsum := RealTheory.finiteSum_succ
    (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm n r) m
  change F.finiteSum (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm n r) (m + 1) =
    F.add S c at hsum
  have hL : L = F.add (F.sub C H) (F.add S c) := by
    unfold L logStirlingFiniteLimit C H
    change F.add (F.sub stirlingConstant (centeredLogFactorialAt n))
        (F.finiteSum
          (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm n r) (m + 1)) =
      F.add (F.sub stirlingConstant (centeredLogFactorialAt n))
        (F.add S c)
    rw [hsum]
  have hLH : F.add L H = F.add C (F.add S c) := by
    rw [hL]
    calc
      F.add (F.add (F.sub C H) (F.add S c)) H =
          F.add (F.sub C H) (F.add (F.add S c) H) := by
        rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add (F.sub C H) (F.add H (F.add S c)) := by
        rw [F.add_comm (F.add S c) H]
      _ = F.add (F.add (F.sub C H) H) (F.add S c) := by
        rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add C (F.add S c) := by
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F]
  have hFormula : H = F.add (F.add C S) R := by
    unfold R
    calc
      H = F.sub (F.add L H) L := by
        rw [F.add_comm L H]
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F H L).symm
      _ = F.sub (F.add C (F.add S c)) L := by rw [hLH]
      _ = F.sub (F.add (F.add C S) c) L := by
        rw [F.add_assoc C S c]
      _ = F.add (F.add C S) (F.sub c L) := by
        have hpair := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
          F (F.add C S) c F.zero L
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F, F.zero_add] at hpair
        exact hpair
  refine Exists.intro R ?_
  refine And.intro hFormula ?_
  have hLimit := logStirlingFiniteLimit_abs_bound n m hn
  let E := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope F p
  let x := F.inv (RealFunction.powNat (F.nat n) (p - 1))
  let B := F.abs (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber F p)
  let ip := F.inv (F.nat p)
  let ipm := F.inv (F.nat (p - 1))
  change F.le (F.abs L) (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul ip ipm) E) x)
    at hLimit
  have hcAbs := stirlingCorrectionTerm_abs n m hn
  dsimp only at hcAbs
  change F.abs c = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul B ip) ipm) x at hcAbs
  have htriangle : F.le (F.abs R) (F.add (F.abs c) (F.abs L)) := by
    unfold R
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    have hraw := RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs c (F.neg L)
    rw [RealTheory.abs_neg] at hraw
    exact hraw
  have hsumBound := F.add_le_add
    (show F.le (F.abs c) (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul B ip) ipm) x) by
      rw [hcAbs]
      exact F.le_refl _)
    hLimit
  have hbound := F.le_trans htriangle hsumBound
  have hEnvelopeReorder : F.mul (F.mul ip ipm) E = F.mul (F.mul E ip) ipm := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul ip ipm) E = F.mul E (F.mul ip ipm) := by
        rw [F.mul_comm]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul E ip) ipm := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
  have hrhs :
      F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul B ip) ipm) x)
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul ip ipm) E) x) =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.mul (F.add B E) ip) ipm) x := by
    rw [hEnvelopeReorder]
    calc
      F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul B ip) ipm) x)
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul E ip) ipm) x) =
          F.mul
            (F.add (F.mul (F.mul B ip) ipm)
              (F.mul (F.mul E ip) ipm)) x := by
        exact (F.add_mul _ _ x).symm
      _ = F.mul
          (F.mul (F.add (F.mul B ip) (F.mul E ip)) ipm) x := by
        exact congrArg (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier => F.mul z x)
          (F.add_mul (F.mul B ip) (F.mul E ip) ipm).symm
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul (F.add B E) ip) ipm) x := by
        exact congrArg (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.mul (F.mul z ipm) x)
          (F.add_mul B E ip).symm
  rw [hrhs] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: logFactorial_centered_reassemble
statement:
private theorem logFactorial_centered_reassemble
    (L P h C S R : RealTheory.Carrier)
    (hcenter :
      RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub L P) h =
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add C S) R) :
    L =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add P h) C) S) R
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hrecover : L = F.add (F.add (F.sub (F.sub L P) h) h) P := by
    calc
      L = F.add (F.sub L P) P :=
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F L P).symm
      _ = F.add (F.add (F.sub (F.sub L P) h) h) P := by
        exact congrArg (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier => F.add z P)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F (F.sub L P) h).symm
  change F.sub (F.sub L P) h = F.add (F.add C S) R at hcenter
  rw [hrecover, hcenter]
  change F.add (F.add (F.add (F.add C S) R) h) P =
    F.add (F.add (F.add (F.add P h) C) S) R
  have haddLeftComm (a b c : RealTheory.Carrier) :
      F.add a (F.add b c) = F.add b (F.add a c) := by
    calc
      F.add a (F.add b c) = F.add (F.add a b) c := by
        rw [<- F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add (F.add b a) c := by rw [F.add_comm a b]
      _ = F.add b (F.add a c) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
  simp only [F.add_assoc, haddLeftComm, F.add_comm]

name: EulerMaclaurinInternal.logFactorial_fixedOrder_with_stirlingConstant
statement:
theorem EulerMaclaurinInternal.logFactorial_fixedOrder_with_stirlingConstant
    (m n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    let p
proof:
:= 2 * m + 2
    Exists fun R : RealTheory.Carrier =>
      logFactorial n =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                    (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                      (RealTheory.nat n)))
                  (RealTheory.nat n))
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                  (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
                    (RealTheory.nat n))))
              stirlingConstant)
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat =>
                let q := 2 * (r + 1)
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
                        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base q)
                      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat q)))
                    (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (q - 1))))
                  (RealTheory.inv
                    (RealFunction.powNat
                      (RealTheory.nat n) (q - 1))))
              m)) R /\
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs R)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliNumber
                    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base p))
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.bernoulliAbsEnvelope
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base p))
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat p)))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (p - 1))))
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.nat n) (p - 1)))) := by
  dsimp only
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  have hmain := centeredLogFactorialAt_fixedOrder_with_stirlingConstant
    m n hn
  dsimp only at hmain
  cases hmain with
  | intro R hR =>
      refine Exists.intro R ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ hR.right
      have hcenter := hR.left
      unfold centeredLogFactorialAt logIntegralPrimitive at hcenter
      change F.sub
          (F.sub (logFactorial n)
            (F.sub (F.mul (F.nat n) (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n)))
              (F.nat n)))
          (F.half (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n))) =
        F.add
          (F.add stirlingConstant
            (F.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm n r) m)) R at hcenter
      change logFactorial n =
        F.add
          (F.add
            (F.add
              (F.add
                (F.sub (F.mul (F.nat n) (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n)))
                  (F.nat n))
                (F.half (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n))))
              stirlingConstant)
            (F.finiteSum
              (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm n r) m)) R
      exact logFactorial_centered_reassemble
        (logFactorial n)
        (F.sub (F.mul (F.nat n) (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n)))
          (F.nat n))
        (F.half (Ielem.logSpec.log (F.nat n)))
        stirlingConstant
        (F.finiteSum (fun r : Nat => stirlingCorrectionTerm n r) m)
        R hcenter

private theorem wallisSinPowerIntegrationByPartsData

      (wallisSinPowerSuccDerivativeMap S n)
      (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.neg (S.sin x))
      RealTheory.zero (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero
    (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
  let G := RealTheory.OpenInterval F.zero
    (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)

  refine
    { interval := hhalf
      u_continuous := wallisSinPowerMap_continuousOn S E (n + 1)

  · intro x hx

      (fun _y _hy => trivial) hx
      (wallisSinPowerMap_hasDerivativeWithinOn_universal S n x trivial)
  · intro x hx

        S x trivial)

name: wallisIntegrationByPartsRightIntegrand_eq
statement:
private theorem wallisIntegrationByPartsRightIntegrand_eq
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) (x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsRightIntegrand
        S.cos (wallisSinPowerSuccDerivativeMap S n) x =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (wallisSinPowerMap S n x)
          (wallisSinPowerMap S (n + 2) x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := S.sin x
  let c := S.cos x
  let p := RealFunction.powNat s n
  let N := F.nat (n + 1)
  have htrig : F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul c c) = F.one := by
    exact S.pythagorean x
  have hcosSq : F.mul c c = F.sub F.one (F.mul s s) := by
    calc
      F.mul c c = F.sub (F.add (F.mul c c) (F.mul s s))
          (F.mul s s) :=
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F
          (F.mul c c) (F.mul s s)).symm
      _ = F.sub (F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul c c))
          (F.mul s s) := by rw [F.add_comm]
      _ = F.sub F.one (F.mul s s) := by rw [htrig]
  have hpow :
      RealFunction.powNat s (n + 2) =
        F.mul p (F.mul s s) := by
    change RealFunction.powNat s ((n + 1) + 1) =
      F.mul (RealFunction.powNat s n) (F.mul s s)
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ, RealFunction.powNat_succ]
    exact F.mul_assoc (RealFunction.powNat s n) s s
  unfold RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsRightIntegrand
  unfold RealFunction.MulFun wallisSinPowerSuccDerivativeMap
  unfold wallisSinPowerMap RealFunction.CompFun RealFunction.PowerFun
  change F.mul c (F.mul (F.mul N p) c) =
    F.mul N (F.sub p (RealFunction.powNat s (n + 2)))
  have hinner :
      F.mul c (F.mul p c) = F.mul p (F.mul c c) := by
    calc
      F.mul c (F.mul p c) = F.mul (F.mul c p) c := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul p c) c := by rw [F.mul_comm c p]
      _ = F.mul p (F.mul c c) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
  calc
    F.mul c (F.mul (F.mul N p) c) =
        F.mul N (F.mul c (F.mul p c)) := by
      rw [F.mul_assoc N p c]
      rw [<- F.mul_assoc c N (F.mul p c)]
      rw [F.mul_comm c N]
      rw [F.mul_assoc N c (F.mul p c)]
    _ = F.mul N (F.mul p (F.mul c c)) := by rw [hinner]
    _ = F.mul N (F.mul p (F.sub F.one (F.mul s s))) := by
      rw [hcosSq]
    _ = F.mul N (F.sub p (F.mul p (F.mul s s))) := by
      apply congrArg (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier => F.mul N z)
      calc
        F.mul p (F.sub F.one (F.mul s s)) =
            F.sub (F.mul p F.one) (F.mul p (F.mul s s)) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F p F.one (F.mul s s)
        _ = F.sub p (F.mul p (F.mul s s)) := by rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = F.mul N (F.sub p (RealFunction.powNat s (n + 2))) := by
      rw [hpow]

name: wallisIntegrationByPartsLeftIntegrand_eq
statement:
private theorem wallisIntegrationByPartsLeftIntegrand_eq
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) (x : RealTheory.Carrier) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsLeftIntegrand
        (wallisSinPowerMap S (n + 1))
        (fun y : RealTheory.Carrier => RealTheory.neg (S.sin y)) x =
      RealTheory.neg (wallisSinPowerMap S (n + 2) x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsLeftIntegrand
  unfold RealFunction.MulFun wallisSinPowerMap
  unfold RealFunction.CompFun RealFunction.PowerFun
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F
    (RealFunction.powNat (S.sin x) (n + 1)) (S.sin x)

name: wallisIntegrationByPartsEndpointTerm_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem wallisIntegrationByPartsEndpointTerm_eq_zero
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsEndpointTerm
        (wallisSinPowerMap S (n + 1)) S.cos
        RealTheory.zero (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S) =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsEndpointTerm
  unfold wallisSinPowerMap RealFunction.CompFun RealFunction.PowerFun
  rw [RealDerivative.Trigonometric.cos_halfPi_eq_zero]
  change F.sub
      (F.mul
        (RealFunction.powNat
          (S.sin (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)) (n + 1))
        F.zero)
      (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat (S.sin F.zero) (n + 1))
        (S.cos F.zero)) = F.zero
  rw [F.mul_zero]
  have hsin0 := RealFunction.Trigonometric.Derived.sin_zero S
  change S.sin F.zero = F.zero at hsin0
  rw [hsin0]
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
  have hmulZero :
      RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.powNat F.zero n) F.zero = F.zero := by
    change F.mul (RealFunction.powNat F.zero n) F.zero = F.zero
    exact F.mul_zero _
  rw [hmulZero, F.zero_mul]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F F.zero

name: wallisSinPowerIntegral_recurrence
statement:
private theorem wallisSinPowerIntegral_recurrence
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))
        (wallisSinPowerIntegral S (n + 2)) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (wallisSinPowerIntegral S n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S
  let A := wallisSinPowerIntegral S (n + 2)
  let B := wallisSinPowerIntegral S n
  let N := F.nat (n + 1)
  let J := F.mul N (F.sub B A)
  have hhalf : F.le F.zero h :=
    F.le_of_lt (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi_pos S)
  have hBdata := wallisSinPowerIntegral_forwardData S n
  have hAdata := wallisSinPowerIntegral_forwardData S (n + 2)
  have hsub :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.sub (wallisSinPowerMap S n x)
            (wallisSinPowerMap S (n + 2) x))
        F.zero h (F.sub B A) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_sub_of_le
      hhalf hBdata.left hBdata.right hAdata.left hAdata.right
  have hsubData :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      hhalf hsub
  have hscaled :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.mul N
            (F.sub (wallisSinPowerMap S n x)
              (wallisSinPowerMap S (n + 2) x)))
        F.zero h J :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_left_of_le
      N hhalf hsubData.left hsubData.right
  have hright :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsRightIntegrand
          S.cos (wallisSinPowerSuccDerivativeMap S n))
        F.zero h J :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
      hhalf
      (fun x _hx => (wallisIntegrationByPartsRightIntegrand_eq S n x).symm)
      hscaled
  have hibp :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.IntegrationByPartsC1Data.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_left_of_right
      (wallisSinPowerIntegrationByPartsData S n) hright
  have hneg :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier =>
          F.neg (wallisSinPowerMap S (n + 2) x))
        F.zero h (F.neg A) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_neg_of_le
      hhalf hAdata.left hAdata.right
  have hleft :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsLeftIntegrand
          (wallisSinPowerMap S (n + 1))
          (fun x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.neg (S.sin x)))
        F.zero h (F.neg A) :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
      hhalf
      (fun x _hx => (wallisIntegrationByPartsLeftIntegrand_eq S n x).symm)
      hneg
  have hunique :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
      hleft hibp
  have hendpoint := wallisIntegrationByPartsEndpointTerm_eq_zero S n
  change
    RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsEndpointTerm
        (wallisSinPowerMap S (n + 1)) S.cos F.zero h =
      F.zero at hendpoint
  change F.neg A =
    F.sub
      (RealIntegral.Riemann.integrationByPartsEndpointTerm
        (wallisSinPowerMap S (n + 1)) S.cos F.zero h) J at hunique
  rw [hendpoint, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F] at hunique
  have hAeqJ : A = J := by
    have hnegUnique := congrArg F.neg hunique
    rw [F.neg_neg, F.neg_neg] at hnegUnique
    exact hnegUnique
  have hsum : F.add (F.mul N A) A = F.mul N B := by
    calc
      F.add (F.mul N A) A = F.add A (F.mul N A) := by
        rw [F.add_comm]
      _ = F.add J (F.mul N A) :=
        congrArg (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier => F.add z (F.mul N A)) hAeqJ
      _ = F.add (F.mul N (F.sub B A)) (F.mul N A) := by rfl
      _ = F.add (F.sub (F.mul N B) (F.mul N A)) (F.mul N A) := by
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F]
      _ = F.mul N B :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F (F.mul N B) (F.mul N A)
  change F.mul (F.nat (n + 2)) A = F.mul N B
  have hindex : n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 := by omega
  rw [hindex]
  have hnat := RealTheory.nat_succ (n + 1)
  change F.nat ((n + 1) + 1) = F.add (F.nat (n + 1)) F.one at hnat
  rw [hnat]
  rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
  exact hsum

name: wallisSinPowerIntegral_zero
statement:
private theorem wallisSinPowerIntegral_zero
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec) :
    wallisSinPowerIntegral S 0 =
      RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S
  have hhalf : F.le F.zero h :=
    F.le_of_lt (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi_pos S)
  have hconst :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_const_of_le
      (a := F.zero) (b := h) (c := F.one) hhalf
  change
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (fun _x : RealTheory.Carrier => F.one) F.zero h
      (F.mul F.one (F.sub h F.zero)) at hconst
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F, F.one_mul] at hconst
  have hpow :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (wallisSinPowerMap S 0) F.zero h h :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
      hhalf
      (fun x _hx => by
        unfold wallisSinPowerMap RealFunction.CompFun RealFunction.PowerFun
        exact (RealFunction.powNat_zero (S.sin x)).symm)
      hconst
  exact RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
    (wallisSinPowerIntegral_certificate S 0) hpow

name: wallisSinPrimitive_hasDerivativeWithinOn_universal
statement:
private theorem wallisSinPrimitive_hasDerivativeWithinOn_universal
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
      (wallisSinPrimitive S) S.sin
proof:
:= by
  have hraw := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_neg
    (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.hasDerivativeWithinOn_cos_universal S)
  apply RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right _ hraw
  intro x _hx
  unfold RealFunction.NegFun
  exact RealTheory.neg_neg (S.sin x)

name: wallisSinPowerIntegral_one
statement:
private theorem wallisSinPowerIntegral_one
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec) :
    wallisSinPowerIntegral S 1 = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S
  let E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero h
  let G := RealTheory.OpenInterval F.zero h
  have hhalf : F.le F.zero h :=
    F.le_of_lt (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi_pos S)
  have hsinCont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn E S.sin :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun _x _hx => trivial)
      (RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.hasDerivativeWithinOn_sin_universal S))
  have hprimCont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn E (wallisSinPrimitive S) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun _x _hx => trivial)
      (RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        (wallisSinPrimitive_hasDerivativeWithinOn_universal S))
  have hprimDeriv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn G (wallisSinPrimitive S) S.sin := by
    intro x hx
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
      (fun _y _hy => trivial) hx
      (wallisSinPrimitive_hasDerivativeWithinOn_universal S x trivial)
  have hsin :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      hhalf hsinCont hprimCont hprimDeriv
  have hcosHalf := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.cos_halfPi_eq_zero S
  have hcosZero := RealFunction.Trigonometric.Derived.cos_zero S
  change S.cos h = F.zero at hcosHalf
  change S.cos F.zero = F.one at hcosZero
  change RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral S.sin F.zero h
    (F.sub (F.neg (S.cos h)) (F.neg (S.cos F.zero))) at hsin
  rw [hcosHalf, hcosZero]
    at hsin
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F,
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F, F.neg_neg] at hsin
  have hpow :
      RealIntegral.Riemann.HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (wallisSinPowerMap S 1) F.zero h F.one :=
    RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
      hhalf
      (fun x _hx => by
        unfold wallisSinPowerMap RealFunction.CompFun RealFunction.PowerFun
        exact (RealFunction.powNat_one (S.sin x)).symm)
      hsin
  exact RealIntegral.Riemann.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
    (wallisSinPowerIntegral_certificate S 1) hpow

name: wallis_sin_nonneg_le_one
statement:
private theorem wallis_sin_nonneg_le_one
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    {x : RealTheory.Carrier}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero
      (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S) x) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (S.sin x) /\
      RealTheory.le (S.sin x) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S
  have hhpos : F.lt F.zero h := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi_pos S
  have hhnonneg : F.le F.zero h := F.le_of_lt hhpos
  have hhpi : F.lt h (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S) := by
    unfold RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi
    have hadd := F.add_lt_add_left hhpos h
    rw [F.add_zero] at hadd
    exact hadd
  have hsinNonneg : F.le F.zero (S.sin x) := by
    by_cases hx0 : x = F.zero
    · rw [hx0]
      have hzero := RealFunction.Trigonometric.Derived.sin_zero S
      change S.sin F.zero = F.zero at hzero
      rw [hzero]
      exact F.le_refl F.zero
    · have hnot : Not (F.le x F.zero) := by
        intro hxle
        exact hx0 (F.le_antisymm hxle hx.left)
      have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x :=
        F.lt_of_le_of_not_le hx.left hnot
      have hxpi : F.lt x (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S) :=
        F.lt_of_le_of_lt hx.right hhpi
      exact F.le_of_lt
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.sin_pos_openInterval_zero_pi S
          (And.intro hxpos hxpi))
  have hsinLe : F.le (S.sin x) F.one := by
    by_cases hxh : x = h
    · rw [hxh]
      rw [RealDerivative.Trigonometric.sin_halfPi_eq_one]
      exact F.le_refl F.one
    · have hnot : Not (F.le h x) := by
        intro hle
        exact hxh (F.le_antisymm hx.right hle)
      have hxhLt : F.lt x h := F.lt_of_le_of_not_le hx.right hnot
      have hmono :=
        RealDerivative.Trigonometric.sin_strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
          S x h hx (And.intro hhnonneg (F.le_refl h)) hxhLt
      rw [RealDerivative.Trigonometric.sin_halfPi_eq_one] at hmono
      exact F.le_of_lt hmono
  exact And.intro hsinNonneg hsinLe

name: wallisSinPowerMap_step_le
statement:
private theorem wallisSinPowerMap_step_le
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) {x : RealTheory.Carrier}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero
      (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S) x) :
    RealTheory.le (wallisSinPowerMap S (n + 1) x)
      (wallisSinPowerMap S n x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hs := wallis_sin_nonneg_le_one S hx
  unfold wallisSinPowerMap RealFunction.CompFun RealFunction.PowerFun
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
  have hmul := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hs.right
    (RealFunction.powNat_nonneg hs.left n)
  change F.le
    (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat (S.sin x) n) (S.sin x))
    (RealFunction.powNat (S.sin x) n)
  change F.le
      (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat (S.sin x) n) (S.sin x))
      (F.mul (RealFunction.powNat (S.sin x) n) F.one) at hmul
  rw [F.mul_one] at hmul
  exact hmul

name: wallisSinPowerIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
statement:
private theorem wallisSinPowerIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealIntegral.Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral
      (wallisSinPowerMap S n) RealTheory.zero
      (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
      (wallisSinPowerIntegral S n)
proof:
:= by
  have hdata := wallisSinPowerIntegral_forwardData S n
  exact RealIntegral.Riemann.hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
    hdata.left hdata.right

name: wallisSinPowerIntegral_step_le
statement:
private theorem wallisSinPowerIntegral_step_le
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le (wallisSinPowerIntegral S (n + 1))
      (wallisSinPowerIntegral S n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hhalf : F.le F.zero (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S) :=
    F.le_of_lt (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi_pos S)
  exact RealIntegral.Riemann.hasRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
    hhalf (fun x hx => wallisSinPowerMap_step_le S n hx)
    (wallisSinPowerIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral S (n + 1))
    (wallisSinPowerIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral S n)

name: wallisSinPowerIntegral_recurrence_div
statement:
private theorem wallisSinPowerIntegral_recurrence_div
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) :
    wallisSinPowerIntegral S (n + 2) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (n + 2))))
        (wallisSinPowerIntegral S n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := F.nat (n + 2)
  let c := F.nat (n + 1)
  let A := wallisSinPowerIntegral S (n + 2)
  let B := wallisSinPowerIntegral S n
  have hd : Not (d = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hrec := wallisSinPowerIntegral_recurrence S n
  change F.mul d A = F.mul c B at hrec
  change A = F.mul (F.mul c (F.inv d)) B
  calc
    A = F.mul F.one A := by rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.inv d) d) A := by
      rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hd]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv d) (F.mul d A) := by
      rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv d) (F.mul c B) := by rw [hrec]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.inv d) c) B := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul c (F.inv d)) B := by
      rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv d) c]

name: wallisSinPowerIntegral_even_value
statement:
private theorem wallisSinPowerIntegral_even_value
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec) :
    forall n : Nat,
      wallisSinPowerIntegral S (2 * n) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
          (wallisEvenCoefficient n)
  | 0 => by
      rw [wallisSinPowerIntegral_zero]
      unfold wallisEvenCoefficient
      rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  | n + 1 => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let h := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S
      let q := F.mul (F.nat (2 * n + 1)) (F.inv (F.nat (2 * n + 2)))
      have hindex : 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2 := by omega
      rw [hindex]
      have hrec := wallisSinPowerIntegral_recurrence_div S (2 * n)
      have hcoeff :
          wallisEvenCoefficient (n + 1) =
            F.mul q (wallisEvenCoefficient n) := rfl
      change wallisSinPowerIntegral S (2 * n + 2) =
        F.mul q (wallisSinPowerIntegral S (2 * n)) at hrec
      rw [hrec, wallisSinPowerIntegral_even_value S n, hcoeff]
      change F.mul q (F.mul h (wallisEvenCoefficient n)) =
        F.mul h (F.mul q (wallisEvenCoefficient n))
      calc
        F.mul q (F.mul h (wallisEvenCoefficient n)) =
            F.mul (F.mul q h) (wallisEvenCoefficient n) := by
          exact (F.mul_assoc q h (wallisEvenCoefficient n)).symm
        _ = F.mul (F.mul h q) (wallisEvenCoefficient n) := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun z : RealTheory.Carrier =>
              F.mul z (wallisEvenCoefficient n))
            (F.mul_comm q h)
        _ = F.mul h (F.mul q (wallisEvenCoefficient n)) := by
          exact F.mul_assoc h q (wallisEvenCoefficient n)

name: wallisSinPowerIntegral_odd_value
statement:
private theorem wallisSinPowerIntegral_odd_value
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec) :
    forall n : Nat,
      wallisSinPowerIntegral S (2 * n + 1) = wallisOddCoefficient n
  | 0 => by
      rw [wallisSinPowerIntegral_one]
      rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let q := F.mul (F.nat (2 * n + 2)) (F.inv (F.nat (2 * n + 3)))
      have hindex : 2 * (n + 1) + 1 = (2 * n + 1) + 2 := by omega
      rw [hindex]
      have hrec := wallisSinPowerIntegral_recurrence_div S (2 * n + 1)
      have hcoeff :
          wallisOddCoefficient (n + 1) =
            F.mul q (wallisOddCoefficient n) := rfl
      change wallisSinPowerIntegral S ((2 * n + 1) + 2) =
        F.mul q (wallisSinPowerIntegral S (2 * n + 1)) at hrec
      rw [hrec, wallisSinPowerIntegral_odd_value S n, hcoeff]

name: EulerMaclaurinInternal.ia4_nat_pos_of_pos
statement:
theorem EulerMaclaurinInternal.ia4_nat_pos_of_pos
    {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat n)
proof:
:= by
  have hcast := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt hn
  change RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat n) at hcast
  exact hcast

name: EulerMaclaurinInternal.wallisCentralRatio_pos
statement:
theorem EulerMaclaurinInternal.wallisCentralRatio_pos :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (wallisCentralRatio n)
  | 0 => by
      unfold wallisCentralRatio
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  | n + 1 => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hnum : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (2 * n + 2)) :=
        ia4_nat_pos_of_pos (by omega)
      have hden : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (2 * n + 1)) :=
        ia4_nat_pos_of_pos (by omega)
      change F.lt F.zero
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.nat (2 * n + 2))
            (F.inv (F.nat (2 * n + 1))))
          (wallisCentralRatio n))
      exact F.mul_pos (F.mul_pos hnum (F.inv_pos hden))
        (wallisCentralRatio_pos n)

name: wallisEvenCoefficient_mul_central_eq_one
statement:
private theorem wallisEvenCoefficient_mul_central_eq_one :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.mul (wallisEvenCoefficient n) (wallisCentralRatio n) =
        RealTheory.one
  | 0 => by
      unfold wallisEvenCoefficient wallisCentralRatio
      rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
  | n + 1 => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let a := F.nat (2 * n + 1)
      let b := F.nat (2 * n + 2)
      let e := F.mul a (F.inv b)
      let r := F.mul b (F.inv a)
      have ha : Not (a = F.zero) := by
        unfold a
        exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
      have hb : Not (b = F.zero) := by
        unfold b
        exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
      have hfactor : F.mul e r = F.one := by
        unfold e r
        calc
          F.mul (F.mul a (F.inv b)) (F.mul b (F.inv a)) =
              F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul (F.inv b) (F.inv a)) :=
            RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm a (F.inv b) b (F.inv a)
          _ = F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul (F.inv a) (F.inv b)) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv b) (F.inv a)]
          _ = F.mul (F.mul a (F.inv a)) (F.mul b (F.inv b)) := by
            exact RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm a b (F.inv a) (F.inv b)
          _ = F.mul F.one F.one := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel ha, F.mul_inv_cancel hb]
          _ = F.one := by rw [F.one_mul]
      have hprev := wallisEvenCoefficient_mul_central_eq_one n
      change F.mul (wallisEvenCoefficient n) (wallisCentralRatio n) =
        F.one at hprev
      change F.mul
          (F.mul e (wallisEvenCoefficient n))
          (F.mul r (wallisCentralRatio n)) = F.one
      calc
        F.mul (F.mul e (wallisEvenCoefficient n))
            (F.mul r (wallisCentralRatio n)) =
            F.mul (F.mul e r)
              (F.mul (wallisEvenCoefficient n) (wallisCentralRatio n)) :=
          RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm e (wallisEvenCoefficient n) r
            (wallisCentralRatio n)
        _ = F.mul F.one F.one := by rw [hfactor, hprev]
        _ = F.one := by rw [F.one_mul]

name: wallisOddCoefficient_mul_index_eq_central
statement:
private theorem wallisOddCoefficient_mul_index_eq_central :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.mul (wallisOddCoefficient n)
          (RealTheory.nat (2 * n + 1)) =
        wallisCentralRatio n
  | 0 => by
      change RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one (RealTheory.nat 1) =
        RealTheory.one
      rw [RealTheory.nat_one, RealTheory.one_mul]
      rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let a := F.nat (2 * n + 1)
      let b := F.nat (2 * n + 2)
      let c := F.nat (2 * n + 3)
      let O := wallisOddCoefficient n
      let A := wallisCentralRatio n
      have ha : Not (a = F.zero) := by
        unfold a
        exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
      have hc : Not (c = F.zero) := by
        unfold c
        exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
      have hprev := wallisOddCoefficient_mul_index_eq_central n
      change F.mul O a = A at hprev
      have hO : O = F.mul A (F.inv a) := by
        calc
          O = F.mul O F.one := by rw [F.mul_one]
          _ = F.mul O (F.mul a (F.inv a)) := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel ha]
          _ = F.mul (F.mul O a) (F.inv a) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
          _ = F.mul A (F.inv a) := by rw [hprev]
      change F.mul (F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv c)) O) c =
        F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv a)) A
      calc
        F.mul (F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv c)) O) c =
            F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv c)) (F.mul O c) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
        _ =
            F.mul (F.mul b O) (F.mul (F.inv c) c) := by
          exact RealTheory.mul_mul_mul_comm b (F.inv c) O c
        _ = F.mul (F.mul b O) F.one := by rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hc]
        _ = F.mul b O := by rw [F.mul_one]
        _ = F.mul b (F.mul A (F.inv a)) := by rw [hO]
        _ = F.mul (F.mul b A) (F.inv a) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv a)) A := by
          calc
            F.mul (F.mul b A) (F.inv a) =
                F.mul b (F.mul A (F.inv a)) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
            _ = F.mul b (F.mul (F.inv a) A) := by
              rw [F.mul_comm A (F.inv a)]
            _ = F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv a)) A := by rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: wallisOddPrevious_mul_evenIndex_eq_central
statement:
private theorem wallisOddPrevious_mul_evenIndex_eq_central
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (wallisOddCoefficient n)
        (RealTheory.nat (2 * n + 2)) =
      wallisCentralRatio (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a := F.nat (2 * n + 1)
  let b := F.nat (2 * n + 2)
  let O := wallisOddCoefficient n
  let A := wallisCentralRatio n
  have ha : Not (a = F.zero) := by
    unfold a
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hprev := wallisOddCoefficient_mul_index_eq_central n
  change F.mul O a = A at hprev
  change F.mul O b = F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv a)) A
  calc
    F.mul O b = F.mul b O := by rw [F.mul_comm]
    _ = F.mul b (F.mul A (F.inv a)) := by
      calc
        F.mul b O = F.mul b (F.mul (F.mul O a) (F.inv a)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc, F.mul_inv_cancel ha, F.mul_one]
        _ = F.mul b (F.mul A (F.inv a)) := by rw [hprev]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv a)) A := by
      calc
        F.mul b (F.mul A (F.inv a)) =
            F.mul b (F.mul (F.inv a) A) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm A (F.inv a)]
        _ = F.mul (F.mul b (F.inv a)) A := by rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: wallisCentralRatio_sq_le_halfPi_odd
statement:
private theorem wallisCentralRatio_sq_le_halfPi_odd
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul (wallisCentralRatio n) (wallisCentralRatio n))
      (RealTheory.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
        (RealTheory.nat (2 * n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S
  let E := wallisEvenCoefficient n
  let O := wallisOddCoefficient n
  let A := wallisCentralRatio n
  let q := F.nat (2 * n + 1)
  have hmono := wallisSinPowerIntegral_step_le S (2 * n)
  have heven := wallisSinPowerIntegral_even_value S n
  have hodd := wallisSinPowerIntegral_odd_value S n
  rw [hodd, heven] at hmono
  change F.le O (F.mul h E) at hmono
  have hA : F.le F.zero A := F.le_of_lt (wallisCentralRatio_pos n)
  have hq : F.le F.zero q := by
    exact F.le_of_lt (ia4_nat_pos_of_pos (by omega))
  have hscale : F.le F.zero (F.mul A q) := F.mul_nonneg hA hq
  have hscaled := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hmono hscale
  have hEA := wallisEvenCoefficient_mul_central_eq_one n
  have hOq := wallisOddCoefficient_mul_index_eq_central n
  change F.mul E A = F.one at hEA
  change F.mul O q = A at hOq
  change F.le (F.mul A A) (F.mul h q)
  have hleft : F.mul A A = F.mul O (F.mul A q) := by
    calc
      F.mul A A = F.mul (F.mul O q) A := by rw [hOq]
      _ = F.mul O (F.mul q A) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul O (F.mul A q) := by rw [F.mul_comm q A]
  have hright : F.mul (F.mul h E) (F.mul A q) = F.mul h q := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul h E) (F.mul A q) =
          F.mul h (F.mul E (F.mul A q)) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul h (F.mul (F.mul E A) q) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc E A q]
      _ = F.mul h (F.mul F.one q) := by rw [hEA]
      _ = F.mul h q := by rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [hleft, <- hright]
  exact hscaled

name: halfPi_even_le_wallisCentralRatio_succ_sq
statement:
private theorem halfPi_even_le_wallisCentralRatio_succ_sq
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
        (RealTheory.nat (2 * n + 2)))
      (RealTheory.mul (wallisCentralRatio (n + 1))
        (wallisCentralRatio (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S
  let E := wallisEvenCoefficient (n + 1)
  let O := wallisOddCoefficient n
  let A := wallisCentralRatio (n + 1)
  let q := F.nat (2 * n + 2)
  have hmono := wallisSinPowerIntegral_step_le S (2 * n + 1)
  have heven := wallisSinPowerIntegral_even_value S (n + 1)
  have hodd := wallisSinPowerIntegral_odd_value S n
  have hindex : (2 * n + 1) + 1 = 2 * (n + 1) := by omega
  rw [hindex, heven] at hmono
  rw [hodd] at hmono
  change F.le (F.mul h E) O at hmono
  have hA : F.le F.zero A := F.le_of_lt (wallisCentralRatio_pos (n + 1))
  have hq : F.le F.zero q := by
    exact F.le_of_lt (ia4_nat_pos_of_pos (by omega))
  have hscale : F.le F.zero (F.mul A q) := F.mul_nonneg hA hq
  have hscaled := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hmono hscale
  have hEA := wallisEvenCoefficient_mul_central_eq_one (n + 1)
  have hOq := wallisOddPrevious_mul_evenIndex_eq_central n
  change F.mul E A = F.one at hEA
  change F.mul O q = A at hOq
  change F.le (F.mul h q) (F.mul A A)
  have hleft : F.mul h q = F.mul (F.mul h E) (F.mul A q) := by
    calc
      F.mul h q = F.mul h (F.mul F.one q) := by rw [F.one_mul]
      _ = F.mul h (F.mul (F.mul E A) q) := by rw [hEA]
      _ = F.mul h (F.mul E (F.mul A q)) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc E A q]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul h E) (F.mul A q) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
  have hright : F.mul O (F.mul A q) = F.mul A A := by
    calc
      F.mul O (F.mul A q) = F.mul O (F.mul q A) := by
        rw [F.mul_comm A q]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul O q) A := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul A A := by rw [hOq]
  rw [hleft, <- hright]
  exact hscaled

name: halfPi_mul_two_eq_pi
statement:
private theorem halfPi_mul_two_eq_pi
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
        (RealTheory.nat 2) =
      RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S
  have htwo : F.nat 2 = F.add F.one F.one := by
    have hs := RealTheory.nat_succ 1
    rw [RealTheory.nat_one] at hs
    change F.nat 2 = F.add F.one F.one at hs
    exact hs
  change F.mul h (F.nat 2) = RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  rw [htwo, F.mul_add, F.mul_one]
  exact (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi_eq_halfPi_add_halfPi S).symm

name: halfPi_even_mul_inv_nat_eq_pi
statement:
private theorem halfPi_even_mul_inv_nat_eq_pi
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
          (RealTheory.nat (2 * n)))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) =
      RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S
  let q := F.nat n
  have hq : Not (q = F.zero) := by
    unfold q
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (by omega)
  have hcast := RealTheory.nat_mul 2 n
  change F.nat (2 * n) = F.mul (F.nat 2) q at hcast
  have hperm :
      F.mul (F.mul h (F.mul (F.nat 2) q)) (F.inv q) =
        F.mul (F.mul h (F.nat 2)) (F.mul q (F.inv q)) := by
    have hmulLeftComm (x y z : RealTheory.Carrier) :
        F.mul x (F.mul y z) = F.mul y (F.mul x z) :=
      RealTheory.mul_left_comm x y z
    simp only [F.mul_assoc, hmulLeftComm, F.mul_comm]
  change F.mul (F.mul h (F.nat (2 * n))) (F.inv q) =
    RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  rw [hcast, hperm, F.mul_inv_cancel hq, F.mul_one]
  exact halfPi_mul_two_eq_pi S

name: halfPi_odd_mul_inv_nat_eq_pi_add_error
statement:
private theorem halfPi_odd_mul_inv_nat_eq_pi_add_error
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
          (RealTheory.nat (2 * n + 1)))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)) =
      RealTheory.add (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S
  let q := F.nat n
  have hsum := RealTheory.nat_add (2 * n) 1
  change F.nat (2 * n + 1) = F.add (F.nat (2 * n)) (F.nat 1) at hsum
  have hone := RealTheory.nat_one
  change F.nat 1 = F.one at hone
  change
    F.mul (F.mul h (F.nat (2 * n + 1))) (F.inv q) =
      F.add (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S) (F.mul h (F.inv q))
  rw [hsum, hone, F.mul_add, F.add_mul, F.mul_one]
  have heven := halfPi_even_mul_inv_nat_eq_pi S n hn
  change F.mul (F.mul h (F.nat (2 * n))) (F.inv q) =
    RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S at heven
  rw [heven]

name: wallisCentralNormalizedSq_pos
statement:
private theorem wallisCentralNormalizedSq_pos
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (wallisCentralNormalizedSq n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hratio : F.lt F.zero (wallisCentralRatio n) :=
    wallisCentralRatio_pos n
  have hnat : F.lt F.zero (F.nat n) := ia4_nat_pos_of_pos hn
  unfold wallisCentralNormalizedSq
  exact F.mul_pos (F.mul_pos hratio hratio) (F.inv_pos hnat)

name: pi_le_wallisCentralNormalizedSq
statement:
private theorem pi_le_wallisCentralNormalizedSq
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.le (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
      (wallisCentralNormalizedSq n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k =>
      have hraw := halfPi_even_le_wallisCentralRatio_succ_sq S k
      have hqPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat (k + 1)) :=
        ia4_nat_pos_of_pos (by omega)
      have hscaled := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hraw
        (F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos hqPos))
      change F.le
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
            (F.nat (2 * k + 2)))
          (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))))
        (wallisCentralNormalizedSq (k + 1)) at hscaled
      have hleft := halfPi_even_mul_inv_nat_eq_pi S (k + 1) (by omega)
      change F.mul
          (F.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
            (F.nat (2 * (k + 1))))
          (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1))) =
        RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S at hleft
      have hindex : 2 * k + 2 = 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
      rw [hindex, hleft] at hscaled
      exact hscaled

name: wallisCentralNormalizedSq_le_pi_add_error
statement:
private theorem wallisCentralNormalizedSq_le_pi_add_error
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec)
    (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (wallisCentralNormalizedSq n)
      (RealTheory.add (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat n))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hraw := wallisCentralRatio_sq_le_halfPi_odd S n
  have hqPos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat n) := ia4_nat_pos_of_pos hn
  have hscaled := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hraw
    (F.le_of_lt (F.inv_pos hqPos))
  change F.le
    (wallisCentralNormalizedSq n)
    (F.mul
      (F.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
        (F.nat (2 * n + 1)))
      (F.inv (F.nat n))) at hscaled
  have hright := halfPi_odd_mul_inv_nat_eq_pi_add_error S n hn
  change F.mul
      (F.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
        (F.nat (2 * n + 1)))
      (F.inv (F.nat n)) =
    F.add (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
      (F.mul (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S)
        (F.inv (F.nat n))) at hright
  rw [hright] at hscaled
  exact hscaled

name: wallisCentralNormalizedSq_tendsto_pi
statement:
private theorem wallisCentralNormalizedSq_tendsto_pi
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat => wallisCentralNormalizedSq (k + 1))
      (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi S
  let p := RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S
  let err : Nat -> RealTheory.Carrier := fun k =>
    F.mul h (F.inv (F.nat (k + 1)))
  let upper : Nat -> RealTheory.Carrier := fun k => F.add p (err k)
  have hinv := RealFunction.Elementary.seqTendsto_inv_nat_succ
  have herr := RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const h) hinv
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto err (F.mul h F.zero) at herr
  rw [F.mul_zero] at herr
  have hupper := RealTheory.seqTendsto_add (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const p) herr
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto upper (F.add p F.zero) at hupper
  rw [F.add_zero] at hupper
  have hlower : RealTheory.Eventually fun k : Nat =>
      F.le p (wallisCentralNormalizedSq (k + 1)) :=
    Exists.intro 0 (fun k _hk =>
      pi_le_wallisCentralNormalizedSq S (k + 1) (by omega))
  have hupperBound : RealTheory.Eventually fun k : Nat =>
      F.le (wallisCentralNormalizedSq (k + 1)) (upper k) :=
    Exists.intro 0 (fun k _hk =>
      wallisCentralNormalizedSq_le_pi_add_error S (k + 1) (by omega))
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_squeeze
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const p) hupper hlower hupperBound

name: EulerMaclaurinInternal.log_wallisCentralNormalizedSq_tendsto_log_pi
statement:
theorem EulerMaclaurinInternal.log_wallisCentralNormalizedSq_tendsto_log_pi
    (S : RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularThinSpec) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
          (wallisCentralNormalizedSq (k + 1)))
      (RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface.logSpec.log
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi S))
proof:
:= by
  let Ielem := RealTheory.elementaryFunctionThinInterface
  have hcont := Ielem.logSpec.continuousAtOn
    (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi_pos S)
  have hseq := RealFunction.continuousAtOn_to_sequential hcont
  exact hseq.right
    (fun k : Nat => wallisCentralNormalizedSq (k + 1))
    (fun k : Nat => wallisCentralNormalizedSq_pos (k + 1) (by omega))
    (wallisCentralNormalizedSq_tendsto_pi S)

name: linearError_le_eta_mul_abs_sub_of_differenceQuotient_dist_lt
statement:
private theorem linearError_le_eta_mul_abs_sub_of_differenceQuotient_dist_lt
    {Fmap : Point -> Point} {x y L eta : Point}
    (hyx : Not (y = x))
    (hclose :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist
          (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient Fmap x y) L)
        eta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap y) (Fmap x))
          (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub y x))))
      (RealTheory.mul eta
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hquot_le :
      F.le
        (F.abs
          (F.sub (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient Fmap x y) L))
        eta := by
    unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hclose
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hclose
  have hdx_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.abs (F.sub y x)) :=
    RealTheory.abs_nonneg (RealTheory.sub y x)
  have hmul :
      F.le
        (F.mul
          (F.abs
            (F.sub (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient Fmap x y) L))
          (F.abs (F.sub y x)))
        (F.mul eta (F.abs (F.sub y x))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hquot_le hdx_nonneg
  have hprod :=
    RealDerivative.differenceQuotient_linearError_abs_mul_abs_sub_eq_abs
      (f := Fmap) (x := x) (y := y) (L := L) hyx
  change
    F.mul
        (F.abs
          (F.sub (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient Fmap x y) L))
        (F.abs (F.sub y x)) =
      F.abs
        (F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap y) (Fmap x))
          (F.mul L (F.sub y x))) at hprod
  change
    F.le
      (F.abs
        (F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap y) (Fmap x))
          (F.mul L (F.sub y x))))
      (F.mul eta (F.abs (F.sub y x)))
  rwa [hprod] at hmul

name: right_linearError_le_eta_mul_sub_of_interiorRadius
statement:
private theorem right_linearError_le_eta_mul_sub_of_interiorRadius
    {Fmap : Point -> Point} {a b x y L eta rho : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hclose :
      forall z : Point, RealTheory.OpenInterval a b z ->
        Not (z = x) ->
          RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist z x) rho ->
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealFunction.dist
                (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient Fmap x z) L)
              eta)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hydist :
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x)
        (interiorDerivativeRadius a b x rho)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap y) (Fmap x))
          (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub y x))))
      (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub y x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hyx : y = x
  case pos =>
    subst y
    change
      F.le
        (F.abs
          (F.sub
            (F.sub (Fmap x) (Fmap x))
            (F.mul L (F.sub x x))))
        (F.mul eta (F.sub x x))
    rw [F.sub_self (Fmap x)]
    rw [F.sub_self x]
    rw [F.mul_zero]
    rw [F.sub_self F.zero]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_zero F]
    rw [F.mul_zero]
    exact F.le_refl F.zero
  case neg =>
    have hy_open : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y :=
      openInterval_of_dist_lt_interiorDerivativeRadius hx hydist
    have hydist_rho : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) rho :=
      dist_lt_of_dist_lt_interiorDerivativeRadius hydist
    have hlocal :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (Fmap y) (Fmap x))
              (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub y x))))
          (RealTheory.mul eta
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x))) :=
      local_linearError_le_eta_mul_abs_sub
        hclose hy_open hyx hydist_rho
    have hdx_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub y x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hxy
    rwa [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hdx_nonneg] at hlocal

name: linearError_abs_symm
statement:
private theorem linearError_abs_symm
    (Fmap : Point -> Point) (x y L : Point) :
    RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap x) (Fmap y))
          (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub x y))) =
      RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap y) (Fmap x))
          (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub y x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := F.sub (Fmap y) (Fmap x)
  let B := F.mul L (F.sub y x)
  have hA :
      F.sub (Fmap x) (Fmap y) = F.neg A := by
    dsimp [A]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (Fmap y) (Fmap x)
  have hdx :
      F.sub x y = F.neg (F.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F y x
  have hB :
      F.mul L (F.sub x y) = F.neg B := by
    dsimp [B]
    rw [hdx]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F L (F.sub y x)
  change
    F.abs
        (F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap x) (Fmap y))
          (F.mul L (F.sub x y))) =
      F.abs
        (F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap y) (Fmap x))
          (F.mul L (F.sub y x)))
  rw [hA, hB]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F A B]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F (F.sub A B)

name: linearError_straddle_eq_add
statement:
private theorem linearError_straddle_eq_add
    (Fmap : Point -> Point) (u x v L : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap u))
        (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub v u)) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap x))
          (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub v x)))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap x) (Fmap u))
          (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub x u)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.sub
        (F.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap u))
        (F.mul L (F.sub v u)) =
      F.add
        (F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap x))
          (F.mul L (F.sub v x)))
        (F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap x) (Fmap u))
          (F.mul L (F.sub x u)))
  symm
  calc
    F.add
        (F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap x))
          (F.mul L (F.sub v x)))
        (F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap x) (Fmap u))
          (F.mul L (F.sub x u))) =
        F.sub
          (F.add
            (F.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap x))
            (F.sub (Fmap x) (Fmap u)))
          (F.add
            (F.mul L (F.sub v x))
            (F.mul L (F.sub x u))) := by
          rw [<-
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
              F
              (F.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap x))
              (F.sub (Fmap x) (Fmap u))
              (F.mul L (F.sub v x))
              (F.mul L (F.sub x u))]
    _ =
        F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap u))
          (F.add
            (F.mul L (F.sub v x))
            (F.mul L (F.sub x u))) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
            F (Fmap v) (Fmap x) (Fmap u)]
    _ =
        F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap u))
          (F.mul L (F.add (F.sub v x) (F.sub x u))) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
    _ =
        F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap u))
          (F.mul L (F.sub v u)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel F v x u]

name: eta_mul_straddling_lengths_eq
statement:
private theorem eta_mul_straddling_lengths_eq
    (eta u x v : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub v x))
        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub x u)) =
      RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub v u)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.add
        (F.mul eta (F.sub v x))
        (F.mul eta (F.sub x u)) =
      F.mul eta (F.sub v u)
  calc
    F.add
        (F.mul eta (F.sub v x))
        (F.mul eta (F.sub x u)) =
        F.mul eta (F.add (F.sub v x) (F.sub x u)) := by
          exact Eq.symm (F.mul_add eta (F.sub v x) (F.sub x u))
    _ = F.mul eta (F.sub v u) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel F v x u]

name: left_linearError_le_eta_mul_sub_of_interiorRadius
statement:
private theorem left_linearError_le_eta_mul_sub_of_interiorRadius
    {Fmap : Point -> Point} {a b x y L eta rho : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hclose :
      forall z : Point, RealTheory.OpenInterval a b z ->
        Not (z = x) ->
          RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist z x) rho ->
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealFunction.dist
                (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient Fmap x z) L)
              eta)
    (hyx_le : RealTheory.le y x)
    (hydist :
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x)
        (interiorDerivativeRadius a b x rho)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap x) (Fmap y))
          (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub x y))))
      (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub x y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hyx : y = x
  case pos =>
    subst y
    change
      F.le
        (F.abs
          (F.sub
            (F.sub (Fmap x) (Fmap x))
            (F.mul L (F.sub x x))))
        (F.mul eta (F.sub x x))
    rw [F.sub_self (Fmap x)]
    rw [F.sub_self x]
    rw [F.mul_zero]
    rw [F.sub_self F.zero]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_zero F]
    rw [F.mul_zero]
    exact F.le_refl F.zero
  case neg =>
    have hy_open : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y :=
      openInterval_of_dist_lt_interiorDerivativeRadius hx hydist
    have hydist_rho : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) rho :=
      dist_lt_of_dist_lt_interiorDerivativeRadius hydist
    have hlocal :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (Fmap y) (Fmap x))
              (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub y x))))
          (RealTheory.mul eta
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x))) :=
      local_linearError_le_eta_mul_abs_sub
        hclose hy_open hyx hydist_rho
    have hlength_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub x y) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hyx_le
    have habs_length :
        RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x) =
          RealTheory.sub x y := by
      change F.abs (F.sub y x) = F.sub x y
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm F y x]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hlength_nonneg
    rw [habs_length] at hlocal
    rw [linearError_abs_symm Fmap x y L]
    exact hlocal

name: FundamentalTheoremInternal.straddling_linearError_le_eta_mul_sub_of_interiorRadius
statement:
theorem FundamentalTheoremInternal.straddling_linearError_le_eta_mul_sub_of_interiorRadius
    {Fmap : Point -> Point} {a b u x v L eta rho : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hclose :
      forall z : Point, RealTheory.OpenInterval a b z ->
        Not (z = x) ->
          RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist z x) rho ->
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealFunction.dist
                (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient Fmap x z) L)
              eta)
    (hux : RealTheory.le u x)
    (hxv : RealTheory.le x v)
    (hudist :
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist u x)
        (interiorDerivativeRadius a b x rho))
    (hvdist :
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist v x)
        (interiorDerivativeRadius a b x rho)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap u))
          (RealTheory.mul L (RealTheory.sub v u))))
      (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub v u))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let rightErr :=
    F.sub
      (F.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap x))
      (F.mul L (F.sub v x))
  let leftErr :=
    F.sub
      (F.sub (Fmap x) (Fmap u))
      (F.mul L (F.sub x u))
  have hright :
      F.le (F.abs rightErr) (F.mul eta (F.sub v x)) := by
    dsimp [rightErr]
    exact right_linearError_le_eta_mul_sub_of_interiorRadius
      (Fmap := Fmap) (a := a) (b := b) (x := x) (y := v)
      (L := L) (eta := eta) (rho := rho)
      hx hclose hxv hvdist
  have hleft :
      F.le (F.abs leftErr) (F.mul eta (F.sub x u)) := by
    dsimp [leftErr]
    exact left_linearError_le_eta_mul_sub_of_interiorRadius
      (Fmap := Fmap) (a := a) (b := b) (x := x) (y := u)
      (L := L) (eta := eta) (rho := rho)
      hx hclose hux hudist
  have htri :
      F.le
        (F.abs (F.add rightErr leftErr))
        (F.add (F.abs rightErr) (F.abs leftErr)) :=
    RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs rightErr leftErr
  have hsplit :
      F.sub
          (F.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap u))
          (F.mul L (F.sub v u)) =
        F.add rightErr leftErr := by
    dsimp [rightErr, leftErr]
    exact linearError_straddle_eq_add Fmap u x v L
  have htri_total :
      F.le
        (F.abs
          (F.sub
            (F.sub (Fmap v) (Fmap u))
            (F.mul L (F.sub v u))))
        (F.add (F.abs rightErr) (F.abs leftErr)) := by
    rw [hsplit]
    exact htri
  have hbudget_add :
      F.le
        (F.add (F.abs rightErr) (F.abs leftErr))
        (F.add
          (F.mul eta (F.sub v x))
          (F.mul eta (F.sub x u))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hright hleft
  have hbudget :
      F.le
        (F.add (F.abs rightErr) (F.abs leftErr))
        (F.mul eta (F.sub v u)) := by
    have hbudget_eq :
        F.add
            (F.mul eta (F.sub v x))
            (F.mul eta (F.sub x u)) =
          F.mul eta (F.sub v u) := by
      exact eta_mul_straddling_lengths_eq eta u x v
    rw [hbudget_eq] at hbudget_add
    exact hbudget_add
  exact F.le_trans htri_total hbudget

name: primitiveCellErrorAbs_le_eta_mul_cellLength_of_interiorDerivativeGauge
statement:
theorem primitiveCellErrorAbs_le_eta_mul_cellLength_of_interiorDerivativeGauge
    {Fmap : Point -> Point} {a b L eta rho : Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point} {delta : Point -> Point}
    (htagged : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hk : k < n)
    (htagOpen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (tag k))
    (hclose :
      forall z : Point, RealTheory.OpenInterval a b z ->
        Not (z = tag k) ->
          RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist z (tag k)) rho ->
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealFunction.dist
                (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient Fmap (tag k) z) L)
              eta)
    (hfine : GaugeFineCell p tag delta k)
    (hdelta :
      RealTheory.le (delta (tag k))
        (interiorDerivativeRadius a b (tag k) rho)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (Fmap (p (k + 1))) (Fmap (p k)))
          (RealTheory.mul L (cellLength p k))))
      (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
proof:
:= by
  have hcell : PartitionCell p k (tag k) :=
    taggedPartition_tag_mem_cell htagged hk
  have hleftMem : PartitionCell p k (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_left_mem htagged.left hk
  have hrightMem : PartitionCell p k (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_right_mem htagged.left hk
  have hfineInterior :
      GaugeFineCell p tag
        (fun _ : Point =>
          interiorDerivativeRadius a b (tag k) rho)
        k := by
    exact gaugeFineCell_of_gauge_le hfine hdelta
  have hleftDist :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (p k) (tag k))
        (interiorDerivativeRadius a b (tag k) rho) :=
    hfineInterior (p k) hleftMem
  have hrightDist :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (tag k))
        (interiorDerivativeRadius a b (tag k) rho) :=
    hfineInterior (p (k + 1)) hrightMem
  unfold cellLength

    (Fmap := Fmap) (a := a) (b := b)

name: integrationByParts_add_sub_cancel_left_base
statement:
private theorem integrationByParts_add_sub_cancel_left_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike Point) (A B : Point) :
    F.sub (F.add A B) A = B
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]

name: IntegrationByPartsC1Data.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_left_of_right
statement:
theorem IntegrationByPartsC1Data.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_left_of_right
    {u v u' v' : Point -> Point} {a b J : Point}
    (data : IntegrationByPartsC1Data u v u' v' a b)
    (hJ :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (integrationByPartsRightIntegrand v u') a b J) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (integrationByPartsLeftIntegrand u v') a b
      (RealTheory.sub (integrationByPartsEndpointTerm u v a b) J)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (integrationByPartsDerivativeSum u v u' v')
        a b (integrationByPartsEndpointTerm u v a b) :=
    data.product_newtonLeibniz
  have hsum_forward :
      And
        (ClosedIntervalBounded
          (integrationByPartsDerivativeSum u v u' v') a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral
          (integrationByPartsDerivativeSum u v u' v') a b
          (integrationByPartsEndpointTerm u v a b)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le data.interval hsum
  have hright_forward :
      And
        (ClosedIntervalBounded
          (integrationByPartsRightIntegrand v u') a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral
          (integrationByPartsRightIntegrand v u') a b J) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le data.interval hJ
  have hsub :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (integrationByPartsDerivativeSum u v u' v' x)
            (integrationByPartsRightIntegrand v u' x))
        a b
        (RealTheory.sub (integrationByPartsEndpointTerm u v a b) J) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_sub_of_le
      data.interval
      hsum_forward.left hsum_forward.right
      hright_forward.left hright_forward.right
  refine
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
      data.interval ?_ hsub
  intro x _hx
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold integrationByPartsDerivativeSum
  unfold integrationByPartsRightIntegrand
  unfold integrationByPartsLeftIntegrand
  unfold AddFun MulFun
  change
    F.sub
      (F.add (F.mul (v x) (u' x)) (F.mul (u x) (v' x)))
      (F.mul (v x) (u' x)) =
      F.mul (u x) (v' x)
  exact integrationByParts_add_sub_cancel_left_base
    F (F.mul (v x) (u' x)) (F.mul (u x) (v' x))

name: IntegrationByPartsC1Data.exists_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_parts

name: IntegrationByPartsLCData.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_left_of_right
statement:
theorem IntegrationByPartsLCData.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_left_of_right
    {F G f g : Point -> Point} {a b J : Point}
    (data : IntegrationByPartsLCData F G f g a b)
    (hJ :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (integrationByPartsRightIntegrand G f) a b J) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (integrationByPartsLeftIntegrand F g) a b
      (RealTheory.sub (integrationByPartsEndpointTerm F G a b) J)
proof:
:= by
  have hJ_first :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (MulFun f G) a b J := by
    refine
      hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
        data.interval ?_ hJ
    intro x _hx
    let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    unfold integrationByPartsRightIntegrand
    unfold MulFun
    change C.mul (G x) (f x) = C.mul (f x) (G x)
    rw [C.mul_comm]
  have hsum :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (AddFun
          (MulFun f G)
          (integrationByPartsLeftIntegrand F g))
        a b (integrationByPartsEndpointTerm F G a b) :=
    data.product_lcftc
  have hsum_forward :
      And
        (ClosedIntervalBounded
          (AddFun
            (MulFun f G)
            (integrationByPartsLeftIntegrand F g)) a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral
          (AddFun
            (MulFun f G)
            (integrationByPartsLeftIntegrand F g)) a b
          (integrationByPartsEndpointTerm F G a b)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le data.interval hsum
  have hright_forward :
      And
        (ClosedIntervalBounded (MulFun f G) a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral (MulFun f G) a b J) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le data.interval hJ_first
  have hsub :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.sub
            ((AddFun
              (MulFun f G)
              (integrationByPartsLeftIntegrand F g)) x)
            ((MulFun f G) x))
        a b
        (RealTheory.sub (integrationByPartsEndpointTerm F G a b) J) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_sub_of_le
      data.interval
      hsum_forward.left hsum_forward.right
      hright_forward.left hright_forward.right
  refine
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
      data.interval ?_ hsub
  intro x _hx
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold integrationByPartsLeftIntegrand
  unfold AddFun MulFun
  change
    C.sub
      (C.add (C.mul (f x) (G x)) (C.mul (F x) (g x)))
      (C.mul (f x) (G x)) =
      C.mul (F x) (g x)
  exact integrationByParts_add_sub_cancel_left_base
    C (C.mul (f x) (G x)) (C.mul (F x) (g x))

name: IntegrationByPartsLCData.exists_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_parts
statement:
theorem IntegrationByPartsLCData.exists_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_parts

name: closedInterval_dist_le_length
statement:
theorem closedInterval_dist_le_length
    {a b x y : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y) :
    RealTheory.le (RealFunction.dist x y) (RealTheory.sub b a)
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealFunction.dist
  exact
    RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le C
        hx.right hy.left)
      (by
        change C.le (C.neg (C.sub x y)) (C.sub b a)
        rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub C x y]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le C
          hy.right hx.left)

name: lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_abs_le_endpoint_add
statement:
theorem lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_abs_le_endpoint_add
    {F : Point -> Point} {a b K x : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hK : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K)
    (hF : LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval F a b K)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (F x))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.abs (F a))
        (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.sub b a)))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have ha : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab
  have hLip :
      C.le (RealFunction.dist (F x) (F a))
        (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist x a)) :=
    hF a x ha hx
  have hdist :
      C.le (RealFunction.dist x a) (C.sub b a) :=
    closedInterval_dist_le_length hx ha
  have hdist_mul :
      C.le (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist x a))
        (C.mul K (C.sub b a)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left C hdist hK
  have hLip_bound :
      C.le (RealFunction.dist (F x) (F a))
        (C.mul K (C.sub b a)) :=
    C.le_trans hLip hdist_mul
  have htri :
      C.le (C.abs (F x))
        (C.add (RealFunction.dist (F x) (F a)) (C.abs (F a))) := by
    have h := abs_le_abs_sub_add_abs_right (F x) (F a)
    unfold RealFunction.dist
    exact h
  have hsum :
      C.le
        (C.add (RealFunction.dist (F x) (F a)) (C.abs (F a)))
        (C.add (C.abs (F a)) (C.mul K (C.sub b a))) := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add C
        hLip_bound (C.le_refl (C.abs (F a)))
    change
      C.le
        (C.add (RealFunction.dist (F x) (F a)) (C.abs (F a)))
        (C.add (C.mul K (C.sub b a)) (C.abs (F a))) at h
    rwa [C.add_comm (C.mul K (C.sub b a)) (C.abs (F a))] at h
  exact C.le_trans htri hsum

name: closedIntervalBounded_of_lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_ordered
statement:
theorem closedIntervalBounded_of_lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_ordered
    {F : Point -> Point} {a b K : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hK : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K)
    (hF : LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval F a b K) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded F a b
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let B :=
    RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.abs (F a))
      (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.sub b a))
  have hlen_nonneg : C.le C.zero (C.sub b a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hab
  have hmul_nonneg : C.le C.zero (C.mul K (C.sub b a)) :=
    C.mul_nonneg hK hlen_nonneg
  have hB_nonneg : C.le C.zero B := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add C
        (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (F a)) hmul_nonneg
    change C.le (C.add C.zero C.zero) B at h
    rwa [C.zero_add] at h
  refine closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le (B := B) hB_nonneg ?_
  intro x hx
  dsimp [B]
  exact
    lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_abs_le_endpoint_add
      hab hK hF hx

name: closedIntervalBounded_of_lipschitzOnClosedInterval
statement:
theorem closedIntervalBounded_of_lipschitzOnClosedInterval
    {F : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hF : LipschitzOnClosedInterval F a b) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded F a b
proof:
:= by
  cases hF with
  | intro K hK =>
      cases RealTheory.le_total a b with
      | inl hab =>
          exact
            closedIntervalBounded_of_lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_ordered
              hab hK.left hK.right
      | inr hba =>
          exact closedIntervalBounded_of_right_le_left F hba

name: continuousAtOn_of_lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval
statement:
theorem continuousAtOn_of_lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval
    {F : Point -> Point} {a b K x : Point}
    (hKnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K)
    (hF : LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval F a b K)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F x
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro hx ?_
  intro eps heps
  let scale := RealTheory.add K RealTheory.one
  let delta := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv scale) eps
  have hK_lt_scale : RealTheory.lt K scale := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left C
        RealTheory.zero_lt_one K
    change C.lt (C.add K C.zero) (C.add K C.one) at h
    rwa [C.add_zero] at h
  have hscale_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero scale :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hKnonneg hK_lt_scale
  have hscale_ne : Not (scale = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt C hscale_pos h.symm
  have hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta := by
    dsimp [delta]
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos C hscale_pos) heps
  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
  refine And.intro hdelta_pos ?_
  intro y hy _hyne hydist
  have hdist_le_delta : RealTheory.le (RealFunction.dist y x) delta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hydist
  have hmul_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x))
        (RealTheory.mul K delta) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hdist_le_delta hKnonneg
  have hmul_lt_scale :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul K delta)
        (RealTheory.mul scale delta) :=
    RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hK_lt_scale hdelta_pos
  have hscale_delta : RealTheory.mul scale delta = eps := by
    dsimp [delta]
    change C.mul scale (C.mul (C.inv scale) eps) = eps
    rw [<- C.mul_assoc scale (C.inv scale) eps]
    rw [C.mul_inv_cancel hscale_ne]
    rw [C.one_mul]
  have hF_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealFunction.dist (F y) (F x))
        (RealTheory.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x)) :=
    hF x y hx hy
  have hF_le_delta :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealFunction.dist (F y) (F x))
        (RealTheory.mul K delta) :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hF_le hmul_le
  have hF_lt_scale :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealFunction.dist (F y) (F x))
        (RealTheory.mul scale delta) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hF_le_delta hmul_lt_scale
  rwa [hscale_delta] at hF_lt_scale
