name: lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_mul_of_bounds
statement:
theorem lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_mul_of_bounds
    {F G : Point -> Point} {a b K L Bf Bg : Point}
    (hK : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K)
    (hL : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero L)
    (hFbound :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (F z)) Bf)
    (hGbound :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (G z)) Bg)
    (hF : LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval F a b K)
    (hG : LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval G a b L) :
    LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval
      (RealFunction.MulFun F G) a b
      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul K Bg) (RealTheory.mul L Bf))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hd_nonneg :
      C.le C.zero (RealFunction.dist y x) := by
    unfold RealFunction.dist
    exact RealTheory.abs_nonneg (C.sub y x)
  have hFxy :
      C.le (RealFunction.dist (F y) (F x))
        (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x)) :=
    hF x y hx hy
  have hGxy :
      C.le (RealFunction.dist (G y) (G x))
        (C.mul L (RealFunction.dist y x)) :=
    hG x y hx hy
  have hKdist_nonneg :
      C.le C.zero (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x)) :=
    C.mul_nonneg hK hd_nonneg
  have hLdist_nonneg :
      C.le C.zero (C.mul L (RealFunction.dist y x)) :=
    C.mul_nonneg hL hd_nonneg
  have htri :
      C.le
        (RealFunction.dist
          (RealFunction.MulFun F G y) (RealFunction.MulFun F G x))
        (C.add
          (C.abs (C.mul (C.sub (F y) (F x)) (G y)))
          (C.abs (C.mul (F x) (C.sub (G y) (G x))))) := by
    unfold RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.dist
    change
      C.le
        (C.abs (C.sub (C.mul (F y) (G y)) (C.mul (F x) (G x))))
        (C.add
          (C.abs (C.mul (C.sub (F y) (F x)) (G y)))
          (C.abs (C.mul (F x) (C.sub (G y) (G x)))))
    have h :=
      RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
        (C.mul (C.sub (F y) (F x)) (G y))
        (C.mul (F x) (C.sub (G y) (G x)))
    rwa [<-
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub
        C (F y) (G y) (F x) (G x)] at h
  have htermF :
      C.le
        (C.abs (C.mul (C.sub (F y) (F x)) (G y)))
        (C.mul (C.mul K Bg) (RealFunction.dist y x)) := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul C (C.sub (F y) (F x)) (G y)]
    change
      C.le
        (C.mul (RealFunction.dist (F y) (F x))
          (C.abs (G y)))
        (C.mul (C.mul K Bg) (RealFunction.dist y x))
    have hstep1 :
        C.le
          (C.mul (RealFunction.dist (F y) (F x))
            (C.abs (G y)))
          (C.mul (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x))
            (C.abs (G y))) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right C
        hFxy (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (G y))
    have hstep2 :
        C.le
          (C.mul (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x))
            (C.abs (G y)))
          (C.mul (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x)) Bg) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left C
        (hGbound y hy) hKdist_nonneg
    have htarget :
        C.mul (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x)) Bg =
          C.mul (C.mul K Bg) (RealFunction.dist y x) := by
      calc
        C.mul (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x)) Bg =
            C.mul K (C.mul (RealFunction.dist y x) Bg) := by
              rw [C.mul_assoc]
        _ = C.mul K (C.mul Bg (RealFunction.dist y x)) := by
              rw [C.mul_comm (RealFunction.dist y x) Bg]
        _ = C.mul (C.mul K Bg) (RealFunction.dist y x) := by
              rw [<- C.mul_assoc]
    rw [<- htarget]
    exact C.le_trans hstep1 hstep2
  have htermG :
      C.le
        (C.abs (C.mul (F x) (C.sub (G y) (G x))))
        (C.mul (C.mul L Bf) (RealFunction.dist y x)) := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul C (F x) (C.sub (G y) (G x))]
    change
      C.le
        (C.mul (C.abs (F x)) (RealFunction.dist (G y) (G x)))
        (C.mul (C.mul L Bf) (RealFunction.dist y x))
    have hstep1 :
        C.le
          (C.mul (C.abs (F x)) (RealFunction.dist (G y) (G x)))
          (C.mul (C.abs (F x))
            (C.mul L (RealFunction.dist y x))) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left C
        hGxy (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (F x))
    have hstep2 :
        C.le
          (C.mul (C.abs (F x))
            (C.mul L (RealFunction.dist y x)))
          (C.mul Bf (C.mul L (RealFunction.dist y x))) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right C
        (hFbound x hx) hLdist_nonneg
    have htarget :
        C.mul Bf (C.mul L (RealFunction.dist y x)) =
          C.mul (C.mul L Bf) (RealFunction.dist y x) := by
      calc
        C.mul Bf (C.mul L (RealFunction.dist y x)) =
            C.mul (C.mul Bf L) (RealFunction.dist y x) := by
              rw [<- C.mul_assoc]
        _ = C.mul (C.mul L Bf) (RealFunction.dist y x) := by
              rw [C.mul_comm Bf L]
    rw [<- htarget]
    exact C.le_trans hstep1 hstep2
  have hsum :
      C.le
        (C.add
          (C.abs (C.mul (C.sub (F y) (F x)) (G y)))
          (C.abs (C.mul (F x) (C.sub (G y) (G x)))))
        (C.add
          (C.mul (C.mul K Bg) (RealFunction.dist y x))
          (C.mul (C.mul L Bf) (RealFunction.dist y x))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add C htermF htermG
  change
    C.le
      (RealFunction.dist
        (RealFunction.MulFun F G y) (RealFunction.MulFun F G x))
      (C.mul (C.add (C.mul K Bg) (C.mul L Bf))
        (RealFunction.dist y x))
  rw [C.add_mul]
  exact C.le_trans htri hsum

name: lipschitzOnClosedInterval_mul
statement:
theorem lipschitzOnClosedInterval_mul
    {F G : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hF : LipschitzOnClosedInterval F a b)
    (hG : LipschitzOnClosedInterval G a b) :
    LipschitzOnClosedInterval (RealFunction.MulFun F G) a b
proof:
:= by
  cases hF with
  | intro K hK =>
      cases hG with
      | intro L hL =>
          cases
              closedIntervalBounded_of_lipschitzOnClosedInterval
                (F := F) (a := a) (b := b) (Exists.intro K hK) with
          | intro Bf hBf =>
              cases
                  closedIntervalBounded_of_lipschitzOnClosedInterval
                    (F := G) (a := a) (b := b) (Exists.intro L hL) with
              | intro Bg hBg =>
                  refine
                    Exists.intro
                      (RealTheory.add
                        (RealTheory.mul K Bg)
                        (RealTheory.mul L Bf)) ?_
                  constructor
                  · let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                    have hleft : C.le C.zero (C.mul K Bg) :=
                      C.mul_nonneg hK.left hBg.left
                    have hright : C.le C.zero (C.mul L Bf) :=
                      C.mul_nonneg hL.left hBf.left
                    have h :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add C hleft hright
                    change
                      C.le C.zero
                        (C.add (C.mul K Bg) (C.mul L Bf))
                    change
                      C.le (C.add C.zero C.zero)
                        (C.add (C.mul K Bg) (C.mul L Bf)) at h
                    rwa [C.zero_add] at h
                  · exact
                      lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_mul_of_bounds
                        hK.left hL.left hBf.right hBg.right
                        hK.right hL.right

name: almostEverywhereOn_and
statement:
private theorem almostEverywhereOn_and
    {E P Q : Point -> Prop}
    (hP : RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn E P)
    (hQ : RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn E Q) :
    RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn E
      (fun x : Point => And (P x) (Q x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact
    RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
      (E := fun x : Point => And (E x) (Not (And (P x) (Q x))))
      (F :=
        Foundation.Cardinal.SetUnion
          (fun x : Point => And (E x) (Not (P x)))
          (fun x : Point => And (E x) (Not (Q x))))
      (fun x hx => by
        by_cases hPx : P x
        · have hQx_not : Not (Q x) := by
            intro hQx
            exact hx.right (And.intro hPx hQx)
          exact Or.inr (And.intro hx.left hQx_not)
        · exact Or.inl (And.intro hx.left hPx))
      (RealNegligibility.nullSet_union hP hQ)

name: lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_sub
statement:
theorem lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_sub
    {F G : Point -> Point} {a b K L : Point}
    (hF : LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval F a b K)
    (hG : LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval G a b L) :
    LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval
      (RealFunction.SubFun F G) a b (RealTheory.add K L)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htri :
      C.le
        (RealFunction.dist
          (RealFunction.SubFun F G y) (RealFunction.SubFun F G x))
        (C.add (RealFunction.dist (F y) (F x))
          (RealFunction.dist (G y) (G x))) := by
    unfold RealFunction.SubFun
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg (F y) (G y)]
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg (F x) (G x)]
    have h :=
      RealFunction.dist_add_le
        (F y) (RealTheory.neg (G y))
        (F x) (RealTheory.neg (G x))
    rwa [RealFunction.dist_neg_neg] at h
  have hsum :
      C.le
        (C.add (RealFunction.dist (F y) (F x))
          (RealFunction.dist (G y) (G x)))
        (C.add (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x))
          (C.mul L (RealFunction.dist y x))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add C
      (hF x y hx hy) (hG x y hx hy)
  have hdist :
      C.add (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x))
          (C.mul L (RealFunction.dist y x)) =
        C.mul (C.add K L) (RealFunction.dist y x) := by
    rw [C.add_mul]
  change
    C.le
      (RealFunction.dist
        (RealFunction.SubFun F G y) (RealFunction.SubFun F G x))
      (C.mul (C.add K L) (RealFunction.dist y x))
  rw [<- hdist]
  exact C.le_trans htri hsum

name: lipschitzOnClosedInterval_sub
statement:
theorem lipschitzOnClosedInterval_sub
    {F G : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hF : LipschitzOnClosedInterval F a b)
    (hG : LipschitzOnClosedInterval G a b) :
    LipschitzOnClosedInterval (RealFunction.SubFun F G) a b
proof:
:= by
  cases hF with
  | intro K hK =>
      cases hG with
      | intro L hL =>
          refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.add K L) ?_
          constructor
          · let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            have h :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add C hK.left hL.left
            change C.le C.zero (C.add K L)
            change C.le (C.add C.zero C.zero) (C.add K L) at h
            rwa [C.zero_add] at h
          · exact lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_sub
              hK.right hL.right

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_equalPartition_hasIntegral_ordered
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_equalPartition_hasIntegral_ordered
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hI : EqualPartition.HasIntegral f a b I) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I
proof:
:= by
  let G :=
    EqualPartition.UpperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn f a b hf hab
  have hbClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    And.intro hab (RealTheory.le_refl b)
  have haClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab
  have hGspec :
      EqualPartition.UpperIntegralPrimitiveOn f a b G := by
    unfold G
    exact
      EqualPartition.upperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn_spec
        (f := f) (a := a) (c := b) hf hab
  have hGbInt : EqualPartition.HasIntegral f a b (G b) :=
    hGspec b hbClosed
  have hGaInt : EqualPartition.HasIntegral f a a (G a) :=
    hGspec a haClosed
  have hI_eq_Gb : I = G b :=
    EqualPartition.hasIntegral_unique hI hGbInt
  have hGa_zero : G a = RealTheory.zero :=
    EqualPartition.hasIntegral_same_endpoint_eq_zero hGaInt
  have hGclosed :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) G f := by
    unfold G
    exact
      EqualPartition.hasDerivativeWithinOn_upperIntegralPrimitiveFromContinuousOn
        (f := f) (a := a) (c := b) hf hab
  have hGcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) G := by
    intro x hx
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_continuousAtOn (hGclosed x hx)
  have hGopen :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) G f := by
    intro x hx
    exact
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
        (fun y hy => RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b y hy)
        hx
        (hGclosed x (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x hx))
  have hFormal :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b
        (RealTheory.sub (G b) (G a)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      (f := f) (F := G) (a := a) (b := b) hab hf hGcont hGopen
  have hsub_eq : RealTheory.sub (G b) (G a) = G b := by
    rw [hGa_zero]
    change
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub (G b)
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.zero = G b
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (G b)
  rw [hI_eq_Gb]
  rwa [hsub_eq] at hFormal

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_equalPartition_hasIntegral
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_equalPartition_hasIntegral
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hf : EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment f a b)
    (hI : EqualPartition.HasIntegral f a b I) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.le_total a b with
  | inl hab =>
      exact
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_equalPartition_hasIntegral_ordered
          (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (I := I)
          hab (hf.left hab) hI
  | inr hba =>
      have hIba :
          EqualPartition.HasIntegral f b a (RealTheory.neg I) :=
        EqualPartition.hasIntegral_reverse hI
      have hFormalBA :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f b a (RealTheory.neg I) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_equalPartition_hasIntegral_ordered
          (f := f) (a := b) (b := a) (I := RealTheory.neg I)
          hba (hf.right hba) hIba
      have hBA :
          And (ClosedIntervalBounded f b a)
            (HasDarbouxIntegral f b a (RealTheory.neg I)) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hba hFormalBA
      have hReverse :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.neg I)) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reverse_of_le
          (f := f) (a := b) (b := a) (I := RealTheory.neg I)
          hba hBA.left hBA.right
      have hnegneg :
          RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.neg I) = I := by
        change C.neg (C.neg I) = I
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg C I
      rwa [hnegneg] at hReverse

name: eq_endpoints_of_continuousOn_hasDerivWithin_zero_off_pointList
statement:
private theorem eq_endpoints_of_continuousOn_hasDerivWithin_zero_off_pointList
    {F : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (bad : List Point)
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hcont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F)
    (hderiv :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          Not (PointListSet bad x) ->
            RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
              (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) F x RealTheory.zero) :
    F b = F a
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  induction bad generalizing a b with
  | nil =>
      have hdiff :
          RealDerivative.DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b F := by
        intro x hx
        exact Exists.intro RealTheory.zero
          (hderiv x hx (not_pointListSet_nil x))
      have hnonneg :
          RealDerivative.DerivativeNonnegativeOnOpenInterval a b F := by
        intro x A hx hA
        have hA_eq : A = RealTheory.zero :=
          RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
            (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint hx)
            hA (hderiv x hx (not_pointListSet_nil x))
        rw [hA_eq]
        exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
      have hnonpos :
          RealDerivative.DerivativeNonpositiveOnOpenInterval a b F := by
        intro x A hx hA
        have hA_eq : A = RealTheory.zero :=
          RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
            (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint hx)
            hA (hderiv x hx (not_pointListSet_nil x))
        rw [hA_eq]
        exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
      have hmono :
          RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F :=
        RealDerivative.monotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonnegative
          hcont hdiff hnonneg
      have hdecr :
          RealFunction.DecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F :=
        RealDerivative.decreasingOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonpositive
          hcont hdiff hnonpos
      have ha : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
        And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab
      have hb : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
        And.intro hab (RealTheory.le_refl b)
      exact RealTheory.le_antisymm
        (hdecr a b ha hb hab)
        (hmono a b ha hb hab)
  | cons c cs ih =>
      by_cases hca : RealTheory.le c a
      · apply ih hab hcont
        intro x hx hnot
        apply hderiv x hx
        intro hbad
        cases List.mem_cons.mp hbad with
        | inl hxc =>
            rw [hxc] at hx
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl C c
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hca hx.left)
        | inr hcs =>
            exact hnot hcs
      · by_cases hbc : RealTheory.le b c
        · apply ih hab hcont
          intro x hx hnot
          apply hderiv x hx
          intro hbad
          cases List.mem_cons.mp hbad with
          | inl hxc =>
              rw [hxc] at hx
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl C c
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C hx.right hbc)
          | inr hcs =>
              exact hnot hcs
        · have hac_le : RealTheory.le a c := by
            cases C.le_total a c with
            | inl hac => exact hac
            | inr hca' => exact False.elim (hca hca')
          have hcb_le : RealTheory.le c b := by
            cases C.le_total c b with
            | inl hcb => exact hcb
            | inr hbc' => exact False.elim (hbc hbc')
          have hac : RealTheory.lt a c :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le C hac_le hca
          have hcb : RealTheory.lt c b :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le C hcb_le hbc
          have hcont_left :
              RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) F :=
            RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
              (fun z hz =>
                And.intro hz.left
                  (RealTheory.le_trans hz.right hcb_le))
              hcont
          have hcont_right :
              RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c b) F :=
            RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
              (fun z hz =>
                And.intro
                  (RealTheory.le_trans hac_le hz.left) hz.right)
              hcont
          have hderiv_left :
              forall x : Point,
                RealTheory.OpenInterval a c x ->
                  Not (PointListSet cs x) ->
                    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
                      (RealTheory.OpenInterval a c) F x RealTheory.zero := by
            intro x hx hnot
            have hx_ab : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x :=
              And.intro hx.left
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C hx.right hcb_le)
            have hnot_cons : Not (PointListSet (c :: cs) x) := by
              intro hbad
              cases List.mem_cons.mp hbad with
              | inl hxc =>
                  rw [hxc] at hx
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl C c hx.right
              | inr hcs =>
                  exact hnot hcs
            exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
              (fun z hz =>
                And.intro hz.left
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C hz.right hcb_le))
              hx (hderiv x hx_ab hnot_cons)
          have hderiv_right :
              forall x : Point,
                RealTheory.OpenInterval c b x ->
                  Not (PointListSet cs x) ->
                    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
                      (RealTheory.OpenInterval c b) F x RealTheory.zero := by
            intro x hx hnot
            have hx_ab : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x :=
              And.intro
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hac_le hx.left)
                hx.right
            have hnot_cons : Not (PointListSet (c :: cs) x) := by
              intro hbad
              cases List.mem_cons.mp hbad with
              | inl hxc =>
                  rw [hxc] at hx
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl C c hx.left
              | inr hcs =>
                  exact hnot hcs
            exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
              (fun z hz =>
                And.intro
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hac_le hz.left)
                  hz.right)
              hx (hderiv x hx_ab hnot_cons)
          have hleft : F c = F a :=
            ih hac_le hcont_left hderiv_left
          have hright : F b = F c :=
            ih hcb_le hcont_right hderiv_right
          exact hright.trans hleft

name: generalizedClosedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive_isGeneralizedPrimitive
statement:
theorem generalizedClosedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive_isGeneralizedPrimitive
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point} {bad : List Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hcont : FunctionContinuousOffPointListOnClosedInterval f a b bad) :
    GeneralizedPrimitiveOnClosedInterval f
      (generalizedClosedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
        f a b bad hab hbdd hcont)
      a b bad
proof:
:= by
  let hI : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_of_closedIntervalBounded_continuousOffPointListOnClosedInterval
      hab hbdd hcont
  change
    GeneralizedPrimitiveOnClosedInterval f
      (closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable f a b hI)
      a b bad
  refine And.intro
    (closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable_continuousOn
      hab hI) ?_
  intro x hx hnot
  have hxClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx.right)
  exact
    hasDerivWithin_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
      hI (hcont x (And.intro hxClosed hnot)) hx

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_finiteDiscontinuities
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_finiteDiscontinuities
    {f F : Point -> Point} {a b : Point} {bad : List Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hcont : FunctionContinuousOffPointListOnClosedInterval f a b bad)
    (hF : GeneralizedPrimitiveOnClosedInterval f F a b bad) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b
      (RealTheory.sub (F b) (F a))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let hI : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_of_closedIntervalBounded_continuousOffPointListOnClosedInterval
      hab hbdd hcont
  let G :=
    closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable f a b hI
  let H := RealFunction.SubFun F G
  have hGcont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) G :=
    closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable_continuousOn
      hab hI
  have hHcont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) H :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_sub hF.left hGcont
  have hHderiv :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x ->
          Not (PointListSet bad x) ->
            RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
              (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) H x RealTheory.zero := by
    intro x hx hnot
    have hxClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
      And.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hx.left)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hx.right)
    have hGderiv :
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
          (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) G x (f x) :=
      hasDerivWithin_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
        hI (hcont x (And.intro hxClosed hnot)) hx
    have hsub :
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
          (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) H x
          (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f x)) :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_sub (hF.right x hx hnot) hGderiv
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_congr_value
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self C (f x)) hsub
  have hH_eq : H b = H a :=
    eq_endpoints_of_continuousOn_hasDerivWithin_zero_off_pointList
      bad hab hHcont hHderiv
  have haClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab
  have hbClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    And.intro hab (RealTheory.le_refl b)
  have hGaI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a a (G a) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
      hI haClosed
  have hGa_zero : G a = RealTheory.zero :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate hGaI
  have hGb_eq : G b = C.sub (F b) (F a) := by
    change C.sub (F b) (G b) = C.sub (F a) (G a) at hH_eq
    change G a = C.zero at hGa_zero
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.value_sub_left_of_eq_add C
    calc
      F b = C.add (C.sub (F b) (G b)) (G b) := by
        exact Eq.symm
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel C (F b) (G b))
      _ = C.add (C.sub (F a) (G a)) (G b) := by rw [hH_eq]
      _ = C.add (F a) (G b) := by
        rw [hGa_zero, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero C (F a)]
  have hIab : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b (G b) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
      hI hbClosed
  rwa [hGb_eq] at hIab

statement:
theorem StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.phi_le_of_le
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I x y : Point}
    (data :
      StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta a b I)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta y)

    RealTheory.le (phi x) (phi y)
proof:
:= by

      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hyx

name: substitution_sample_error_add_eq_source
statement:
private theorem substitution_sample_error_add_eq_source
    (A B C L : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.mul C L))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.sub B C)) L) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul A B) L
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.add (F.mul A (F.mul C L))
        (F.mul (F.mul A (F.sub B C)) L) =
      F.mul (F.mul A B) L
  calc
    F.add (F.mul A (F.mul C L))
        (F.mul (F.mul A (F.sub B C)) L) =
        F.add (F.mul (F.mul A C) L)
          (F.mul (F.mul A (F.sub B C)) L) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc A C L]
    _ = F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul A C) (F.mul A (F.sub B C))) L := by
          rw [<- F.add_mul]
    _ = F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul A C)
          (F.sub (F.mul A B) (F.mul A C))) L := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F A B C]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul A B) L := by
          rw [F.add_comm (F.mul A C)
            (F.sub (F.mul A B) (F.mul A C))]
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F
            (F.mul A B) (F.mul A C)]

name: abs_sub_add_error_le
statement:
private theorem abs_sub_add_error_le
    (target error I : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add target error) I))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub target I))
        (RealTheory.abs error))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub :
      RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add target error) I =
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub target I) error := by
    change
      F.sub (F.add target error) I =
        F.add (F.sub target I) error
    calc
      F.sub (F.add target error) I =
          F.add (F.add target error) (F.neg I) := by
            rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
      _ = F.add target (F.add error (F.neg I)) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add target (F.add (F.neg I) error) := by
            rw [F.add_comm error (F.neg I)]
      _ = F.add (F.add target (F.neg I)) error := by
            rw [<- F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add (F.sub target I) error := by
            rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [hsub]
  exact RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
    (RealTheory.sub target I) error

name: abs_sub_neg_le_add_error_target
statement:
private theorem abs_sub_neg_le_add_error_target
    (source target I : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub source (RealTheory.neg I)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.add source target))
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub target I)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub :
      RealTheory.sub source (RealTheory.neg I) =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add source target)
          (RealTheory.sub I target) := by
    change
      F.sub source (F.neg I) =
        F.add (F.add source target) (F.sub I target)
    calc
      F.sub source (F.neg I) =
          F.add source (F.neg (F.neg I)) := by
            rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
      _ = F.add source I := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F I]
      _ = F.add source (F.add (F.sub I target) target) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F I target]
      _ = F.add source (F.add target (F.sub I target)) := by
            rw [F.add_comm (F.sub I target) target]
      _ = F.add (F.add source target) (F.sub I target) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
  have htri :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add source target)
            (RealTheory.sub I target)))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.add source target))
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I target))) :=
    RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
      (RealTheory.add source target) (RealTheory.sub I target)
  have hcomm :
      RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I target) =
        RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub target I) :=
    RealTheory.abs_sub_comm I target
  rw [hsub]
  rwa [hcomm] at htri

name: mul_oscillation_lt_of_safe_bound_budget
statement:
private theorem mul_oscillation_lt_of_safe_bound_budget
    {C C1 eta omegaSum eps : Point}
    (hC_le_C1 : RealTheory.le C C1)
    (hC1_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C1)
    (homega_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero omegaSum)
    (homega_lt_eta : RealTheory.lt omegaSum eta)
    (hC1_eta_lt : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul C1 eta) eps) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul C omegaSum) eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul C omegaSum)
        (RealTheory.mul C1 omegaSum) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hC_le_C1 homega_nonneg
  have homega_le_eta : RealTheory.le omegaSum eta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F homega_lt_eta
  have hright :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul C1 omegaSum)
        (RealTheory.mul C1 eta) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left homega_le_eta hC1_nonneg
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F

name: StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.imagePartitionIncreasing_mesh_transfer
statement:
private theorem StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.imagePartitionIncreasing_mesh_transfer
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I eta : Point}
    (data :
      StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta a b I)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall (n : Nat) (p : Nat -> Point),
            IntervalPartition alpha beta n p ->
            RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta ->
              RealTheory.lt
                (mesh (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p) n) eta))
proof:
:= by
  have hcompact :
      RealTheory.IsCompact.{0} (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) :=
    RealFunction.closedInterval_compact.{0} data.source_order
  have huc :
      RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) phi :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_compact_uniformContinuousOn.{0}
      hcompact data.phi_continuous
  cases huc eta heta with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro n p hp hmesh
      refine
        mesh_lt_of_cellLength_lt
          (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p) n eta heta ?_
      intro k hk
      have hleftClosed :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta (p k) :=
        intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left hp hk
      have hrightClosed :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta (p (k + 1)) :=
        intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right hp hk
      have hstep : RealTheory.le (p k) (p (k + 1)) :=
        intervalPartition_step_le hp hk
      have hcell_lt :
          RealTheory.lt (cellLength p k) delta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (cellLength_le_mesh p n k hk) hmesh
      have hdist_source :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (p k)) delta := by
        have hdist_eq :
            RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (p k) = cellLength p k := by
          let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist cellLength
          change
            F.abs (F.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k)) =
              F.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k)
          exact
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hstep)
        rwa [hdist_eq]
      have hdist_image :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealFunction.dist (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k))) eta :=
        hdelta.right
          (p (k + 1)) (p k)
          hrightClosed hleftClosed hdist_source
      have hphi_step :
          RealTheory.le (phi (p k)) (phi (p (k + 1))) :=
        data.phi_le_of_le hleftClosed hrightClosed hstep
      have hdist_image_eq :
          RealFunction.dist (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k)) =
            cellLength (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p) k := by
          let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
          unfold cellLength imagePartitionIncreasing
          change
            F.abs (F.sub (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k))) =
              F.sub (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k))
          exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hphi_step)
      rwa [<- hdist_image_eq]

name: StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.exists_target_abs_bound_with_positive_shift
statement:
private theorem StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.exists_target_abs_bound_with_positive_shift
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I : Point}
    (data :
      StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta a b I) :
    Exists
      (fun C : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C)
          (And
            (forall x : Point,
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
                RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) C)
            (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
              (RealTheory.add C RealTheory.one))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
      (Exists.intro I data.target_integral)
  cases hbdd with
  | intro C hC =>
      refine Exists.intro C ?_
      refine And.intro hC.left ?_
      refine And.intro hC.right ?_
      have hone_le_Cadd_one :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.one (RealTheory.add C RealTheory.one) := by
        have h :=
          RealTheory.add_le_add_right hC.left RealTheory.one
        change
          F.le (F.add F.zero F.one) (F.add C F.one) at h
        rwa [F.zero_add] at h
      exact
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
          RealTheory.zero_lt_one hone_le_Cadd_one

name: StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.exists_cell_lagrange_sample
statement:
private theorem StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.exists_cell_lagrange_sample
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I : Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (data :
      StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta a b I)
    (hp : IntervalPartition alpha beta n p)
    (hk : k < n) :
    Exists
      (fun theta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)) theta)
          (RealTheory.sub (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k)) =
            RealTheory.mul (phi' theta) (cellLength p k)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleftClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left hp hk
  have hrightClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right hp hk
  have hstep : RealTheory.le (p k) (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_step_le hp hk
  by_cases hlt : RealTheory.lt (p k) (p (k + 1))
  case pos =>
    let hclosedSub :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset
        F hleftClosed.left hrightClosed.right
    let hopenSub :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.openInterval_subset
        F hleftClosed.left hrightClosed.right
    have hcontSmall :
        RealFunction.ContinuousOn
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (p k) (p (k + 1))) phi :=
      RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hclosedSub data.phi_continuous
    have hdiffSmall :
        RealDerivative.DifferentiableOnOpenInterval
          (p k) (p (k + 1)) phi := by
      intro z hz
      exact Exists.intro (phi' z)
        (RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
          hopenSub hz (data.phi_derivative z (hopenSub z hz)))
    cases
        RealDerivative.lagrange_mean_value_theorem
          (p k) (p (k + 1)) phi hlt hcontSmall hdiffSmall with
    | intro theta htheta =>
        refine Exists.intro theta ?_
        refine
          And.intro
            (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval
              (p k) (p (k + 1)) theta htheta.left) ?_
        exact by
          have hthetaDerivSmall :
              RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
                (RealTheory.OpenInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)))
                phi theta (phi' theta) :=
            RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
              hopenSub htheta.left
              (data.phi_derivative theta
                (hopenSub theta htheta.left))
          have hsec_eq :
              RealDerivative.SecantSlope phi (p k) (p (k + 1)) =
                phi' theta :=
            RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
              (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint htheta.left)
              htheta.right hthetaDerivSmall
          have hsec_mul :
              RealTheory.mul
                  (RealDerivative.SecantSlope phi (p k) (p (k + 1)))
                  (RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k)) =
                RealTheory.sub (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k)) :=
            RealDerivative.secantSlope_mul_intervalLength
              (f := phi) hlt
          unfold cellLength
          rw [<- hsec_mul, hsec_eq]
  case neg =>
    have hright_le_left : RealTheory.le (p (k + 1)) (p k) := by
      by_cases hrev : RealTheory.le (p (k + 1)) (p k)
      case pos =>
        exact hrev
      case neg =>
        exact False.elim
          (hlt
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hstep hrev))
    have hcell_eq : p (k + 1) = p k :=
      RealTheory.le_antisymm hright_le_left hstep
    refine Exists.intro (p k) ?_
    refine
      And.intro
        (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl (p k)) hstep) ?_
    exact by
      unfold cellLength
      rw [hcell_eq]
      change
        F.sub (phi (p k)) (phi (p k)) =
          F.mul (phi' (p k)) (F.sub (p k) (p k))
      rw [F.sub_self, F.sub_self, F.mul_zero]

        F.sub (phi (p k)) (phi (p k)) =

      rw [F.sub_self, F.sub_self, F.mul_zero]

name: substitution_term_decomposition
statement:
private theorem substitution_term_decomposition
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {theta p tag : Nat -> Point}
    {k : Nat}
    (hsample :
      RealTheory.sub (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k)) =
        RealTheory.mul (phi' (theta k)) (cellLength p k)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi' (tag k))
        (cellLength p k) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (f (imageTagIncreasing phi tag k))
          (cellLength (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p) k))
        (substitutionErrorTerm f phi phi' theta p tag k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := f (phi (tag k))
  let B := phi' (tag k)
  let C := phi' (theta k)
  let L := cellLength p k
  have himage_len :
      cellLength (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p) k =
        RealTheory.mul C L := by
    unfold cellLength imagePartitionIncreasing C L
    exact hsample
  unfold substitutionIntegrand substitutionErrorTerm imageTagIncreasing
  change
    F.mul (F.mul A B) L =
      F.add (F.mul A (cellLength (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p) k))
        (F.mul (F.mul A (F.sub B C)) L)
  rw [himage_len]
  exact Eq.symm (substitution_sample_error_add_eq_source A B C L)

name: StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.finiteSum_decomposition
statement:
private theorem StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.finiteSum_decomposition
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag theta : Nat -> Point}
    (_data :
      StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta a b I)
    (hsample :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)) (theta k))
          (RealTheory.sub (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k)) =
            RealTheory.mul (phi' (theta k)) (cellLength p k))) :
    taggedSum (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') p tag n =
      RealTheory.add
        (taggedSum f
          (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p)
          (imageTagIncreasing phi tag) n)
        (substitutionErrorSum f phi phi' theta p tag n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold taggedSum substitutionErrorSum
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
  exact
    RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt n
      (fun k hk =>
        substitution_term_decomposition
          (f := f) (phi := phi) (phi' := phi')
          (theta := theta) (p := p) (tag := tag)
          (k := k) (hsample k hk).right)

name: decreasing_image_taggedSum_reversal
statement:
private theorem decreasing_image_taggedSum_reversal
    {f phi : Point -> Point} {p tag : Nat -> Point} (n : Nat) :
    taggedSum f
        (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
        (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n) n =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul (f (phi (tag i)))
            (RealTheory.sub (phi (p i)) (phi (p (i + 1))))) n
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      unfold taggedSum
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero, RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  | succ m =>
      unfold taggedSum
      unfold RealTheory.finiteSum
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_reverse F
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (f (imageTagDecreasing phi tag (m + 1) k))
            (cellLength (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p (m + 1)) k))
        m]
      apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
      intro i hi
      have hleft : m + 1 - (m - i + 1) = i := by
        omega
      have hright : m + 1 - (m - i) = i + 1 := by
        omega
      unfold imageTagDecreasing cellLength imagePartitionDecreasing
      rw [hleft, hright]

name: substitution_decreasing_sample_add_eq_error
statement:
private theorem substitution_decreasing_sample_add_eq_error
    (A B C L : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul A B) L)
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul C L))) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.sub B C)) L
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.mul A B) L)
        (F.mul A (F.neg (F.mul C L))) =
      F.mul (F.mul A (F.sub B C)) L
  rw [F.mul_neg]
  rw [<- F.mul_assoc A C L]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F A B C]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
    F (F.mul A B) (F.mul A C) L]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]

name: substitution_decreasing_term_decomposition
statement:
private theorem substitution_decreasing_term_decomposition
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {theta p tag : Nat -> Point}
    {k : Nat}
    (hsample :
      RealTheory.sub (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k)) =
        RealTheory.mul (phi' (theta k)) (cellLength p k)) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi' (tag k))
          (cellLength p k))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (f (phi (tag k)))
          (RealTheory.sub (phi (p k)) (phi (p (k + 1))))) =
      substitutionErrorTerm f phi phi' theta p tag k
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let A := f (phi (tag k))
  let B := phi' (tag k)
  let C := phi' (theta k)
  let L := cellLength p k
  have hreverse_len :
      F.sub (phi (p k)) (phi (p (k + 1))) =
        F.neg (F.mul C L) := by
    have hsampleF :
        F.sub (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k)) =
          F.mul C L := by
      unfold C L
      exact hsample
    unfold C L
    change
      F.sub (phi (p k)) (phi (p (k + 1))) =
        F.neg (F.mul (phi' (theta k)) (cellLength p k))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
      F (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k))]
    rw [hsampleF]
  unfold substitutionIntegrand substitutionErrorTerm
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.mul A B) L)
        (F.mul A
          (F.sub (phi (p k)) (phi (p (k + 1))))) =
      F.mul (F.mul A (F.sub B C)) L
  rw [hreverse_len]
  exact substitution_decreasing_sample_add_eq_error A B C L

name: StrictDecreasingC1SubstitutionData.finiteSum_decomposition
statement:
private theorem StrictDecreasingC1SubstitutionData.finiteSum_decomposition
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag theta : Nat -> Point}
    (_data :
      StrictDecreasingC1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta a b I)
    (hsample :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)) (theta k))
          (RealTheory.sub (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k)) =
            RealTheory.mul (phi' (theta k)) (cellLength p k))) :
    RealTheory.add
        (taggedSum (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') p tag n)
        (taggedSum f
          (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
          (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n) n) =
      substitutionErrorSum f phi phi' theta p tag n
proof:
:= by
  rw [decreasing_image_taggedSum_reversal
    (f := f) (phi := phi) (p := p) (tag := tag) n]
  unfold taggedSum substitutionErrorSum
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
  exact
    RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt n
      (fun k hk =>
        substitution_decreasing_term_decomposition
          (f := f) (phi := phi) (phi' := phi')
          (theta := theta) (p := p) (tag := tag)
          (k := k) (hsample k hk).right)

name: errorSum_abs_le_bound_mul_oscillationWeightedSum_of_maps_closed
statement:
private theorem errorSum_abs_le_bound_mul_oscillationWeightedSum_of_maps_closed
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b C : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag theta : Nat -> Point} {omega : Nat -> Point}
    (hmaps_closed :
      RealFunction.MapsInto
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) phi)
    (htag : TaggedPartition alpha beta n p tag)
    (hsample :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (p k) (p (k + 1)) (theta k))
          (RealTheory.sub (phi (p (k + 1))) (phi (p k)) =
            RealTheory.mul (phi' (theta k)) (cellLength p k)))
    (homega :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        IsCellOscillation phi' p k (omega k))
    (hC_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C)
    (hC_bound :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) C) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (substitutionErrorSum f phi phi' theta p tag n))
      (RealTheory.mul C (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega))
proof:
:= by
  have habs_sum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (substitutionErrorSum f phi phi' theta p tag n))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.abs
              (substitutionErrorTerm f phi phi' theta p tag k)) n) := by
    unfold substitutionErrorSum
    exact
      RealTheory.abs_finiteSum_le_finiteSum_abs
        (substitutionErrorTerm f phi phi' theta p tag) n
  have hpoint_sum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.abs
              (substitutionErrorTerm f phi phi' theta p tag k)) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul C
              (RealTheory.mul (omega k) (cellLength p k))) n) := by
    refine
      RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.abs
            (substitutionErrorTerm f phi phi' theta p tag k))
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul C
            (RealTheory.mul (omega k) (cellLength p k)))
        n ?_
    intro k hk
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    let A := f (phi (tag k))
    let D := RealTheory.sub (phi' (tag k)) (phi' (theta k))
    let L := cellLength p k
    have htagCell : PartitionCell p k (tag k) :=
      htag.right k hk
    have hthetaCell : PartitionCell p k (theta k) :=
      (hsample k hk).left
    have htagSourceClosed :
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta (tag k) :=
      intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
        htag.left hk htagCell
    have htagTargetClosed :
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (phi (tag k)) :=
      hmaps_closed (tag k) htagSourceClosed
    have hA_bound : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs A) C := by
      unfold A
      exact hC_bound (phi (tag k)) htagTargetClosed
    have hD_bound : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs D) (omega k) := by
      unfold D
      exact
        le_of_isCellOscillation (homega k hk)
          htagCell hthetaCell
    have hD_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.abs D) :=
      RealTheory.abs_nonneg D
    have hL_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero L := by
      unfold L
      exact cellLength_nonnegative htag.left hk
    have hfirst :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs A) (RealTheory.abs D))
          (RealTheory.mul C (RealTheory.abs D)) :=
      RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hA_bound hD_nonneg
    have hsecond :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul C (RealTheory.abs D))
          (RealTheory.mul C (omega k)) :=
      RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hD_bound hC_nonneg
    have hprod :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs A) (RealTheory.abs D))
          (RealTheory.mul C (omega k)) :=
      RealTheory.le_trans hfirst hsecond
    have hterm :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs A) (RealTheory.abs D)) L)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul C (omega k)) L) :=
      RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hprod hL_nonneg
    have hterm_abs :
        RealTheory.abs
            (substitutionErrorTerm f phi phi' theta p tag k) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs A) (RealTheory.abs D)) L := by
      unfold substitutionErrorTerm A D L
      change
        F.abs (F.mul (F.mul A D) L) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.abs A) (F.abs D)) L
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F (F.mul A D) L]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F A D]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hL_nonneg]
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (substitutionErrorTerm f phi phi' theta p tag k))
        (RealTheory.mul C (RealTheory.mul (omega k) (cellLength p k)))
    rw [hterm_abs]
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs A) (RealTheory.abs D)) L)
        (RealTheory.mul C (RealTheory.mul (omega k) L))
    rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc C (omega k) L]
    exact hterm
  have hweighted :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul C
              (RealTheory.mul (omega k) (cellLength p k))) n =
        RealTheory.mul C (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega) := by
    unfold oscillationWeightedSum
    exact
      RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left C
        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (omega k) (cellLength p k)) n
  have hsum_bound :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.abs
              (substitutionErrorTerm f phi phi' theta p tag k)) n)
        (RealTheory.mul C (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega)) := by
    rwa [hweighted] at hpoint_sum
  exact RealTheory.le_trans habs_sum hsum_bound

name: StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.errorSum_abs_le_bound_mul_oscillationWeightedSum
statement:
private theorem StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.errorSum_abs_le_bound_mul_oscillationWeightedSum
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I C : Point}

statement:

    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I C : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag theta : Nat -> Point} {omega : Nat -> Point}
