name: StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.hasRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictIncreasing_raw
statement:
private theorem StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData.hasRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictIncreasing_raw
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I : Point}
    (data :
      StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta a b I) :
    HasRiemannIntegral
      (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hbeta_alpha : RealTheory.le beta alpha
  case pos =>
    have hsource_eq : beta = alpha :=
      RealTheory.le_antisymm hbeta_alpha data.source_order
    have htarget_eq : b = a := by
      rw [<- data.right_endpoint, <- data.left_endpoint, hsource_eq]
    have htarget_integral_degenerate :
        HasRiemannIntegral f a a I := by
      have htarget_integral := data.target_integral
      rwa [htarget_eq] at htarget_integral
    have hI_zero : I = RealTheory.zero :=
      hasRiemannIntegral_unique
        htarget_integral_degenerate
        (hasRiemannIntegral_degenerate f a)
    rw [hsource_eq, hI_zero]
    exact
      hasRiemannIntegral_degenerate
        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha
  case neg =>
    have halpha_beta_lt : RealTheory.lt alpha beta :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
        F data.source_order hbeta_alpha
    have hcrit :
        RiemannOscillationCriterion phi' alpha beta :=
      riemannOscillationCriterion_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval_of_lt
        halpha_beta_lt data.derivative_continuous
    refine And.intro data.source_order ?_
    intro eps heps
    let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
    have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
    cases data.target_integral.right e2 he2_pos with
    | intro deltaTarget hdeltaTarget =>
        cases
            data.imagePartitionIncreasing_mesh_transfer
              hdeltaTarget.left with
        | intro deltaImage hdeltaImage =>
            cases
                data.exists_target_abs_bound_with_positive_shift with
            | intro C hC =>
                let C1 := RealTheory.add C RealTheory.one
                have hC1_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero C1 := by
                  unfold C1
                  exact hC.right.right
                have hC1_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C1 :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hC1_pos
                have hC_le_C1 : RealTheory.le C C1 := by
                  unfold C1
                  exact RealTheory.le_add_one C
                cases
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt
                      F C1 he2_pos with
                | intro eta heta =>
                    have hC1_eta_lt :
                        RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul C1 eta) e2 := by
                      have hbudget := heta.right
                      have hC1_nonneg' : F.le F.zero C1 := by
                        exact hC1_nonneg
                      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hC1_nonneg']
                        at hbudget
                      exact hbudget
                    cases hcrit eta heta.left with
                    | intro deltaOsc hdeltaOsc =>
                        let delta :=
                          RealTheory.min deltaImage deltaOsc
                        refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                        refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                        ·
                          unfold delta
                          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_min2 F
                            hdeltaImage.left hdeltaOsc.left
                        ·
                          intro n p tag htag hmesh
                          have hp : IntervalPartition alpha beta n p :=
                            htag.left
                          have hmeshImage :
                              RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaImage :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                              hmesh
                              (by
                                unfold delta
                                exact
                                  RealTheory.min_le_left
                                    deltaImage deltaOsc)
                          have hmeshOsc :
                              RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaOsc :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                              hmesh
                              (by
                                unfold delta
                                exact
                                  RealTheory.min_le_right
                                    deltaImage deltaOsc)
                          have himageTagged :
                              TaggedPartition a b n
                                (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p)
                                (imageTagIncreasing phi tag) :=
                            data.imageTaggedPartitionIncreasing htag
                          have himageMesh :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (mesh (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p) n)
                                deltaTarget :=
                            hdeltaImage.right n p hp hmeshImage
                          have htargetClose :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub
                                    (taggedSum f
                                      (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p)
                                      (imageTagIncreasing phi tag) n)
                                    I))
                                e2 :=
                            hdeltaTarget.right n
                              (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p)
                              (imageTagIncreasing phi tag)
                              himageTagged himageMesh
                          cases hdeltaOsc.right n p hp hmeshOsc with
                          | intro omega homegaPack =>
                              let theta : Nat -> Point := fun k =>
                                if hk : k < n then
                                  Classical.choose
                                    (data.exists_cell_lagrange_sample
                                      hp hk)
                                else
                                  p k
                              have hsample :
                                  forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                                    And
                                      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
                                        (p k) (p (k + 1)) (theta k))
                                      (RealTheory.sub
                                          (phi (p (k + 1)))
                                          (phi (p k)) =
                                        RealTheory.mul
                                          (phi' (theta k))
                                          (cellLength p k)) := by
                                intro k hk
                                unfold theta
                                simp [hk]
                                exact Classical.choose_spec
                                  (data.exists_cell_lagrange_sample
                                    hp hk)
                              have hdecomp :
                                  taggedSum
                                      (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi')
                                      p tag n =
                                    RealTheory.add
                                      (taggedSum f
                                        (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p)
                                        (imageTagIncreasing phi tag) n)
                                      (substitutionErrorSum
                                        f phi phi' theta p tag n) :=
                                data.finiteSum_decomposition hsample
                              have herror_le :
                                  RealTheory.le
                                    (RealTheory.abs
                                      (substitutionErrorSum
                                        f phi phi' theta p tag n))
                                    (RealTheory.mul C
                                      (oscillationWeightedSum
                                        p n omega)) :=
                                data.errorSum_abs_le_bound_mul_oscillationWeightedSum
                                  htag hsample homegaPack.left
                                  hC.left hC.right.left
                              have homegaSum_nonneg :
                                  RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
                                    (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega) :=
                                oscillationWeightedSum_nonnegative_of_cellOscillation
                                  hp homegaPack.left
                              have hCosc_lt :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealTheory.mul C
                                      (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega))
                                    e2 :=
                                mul_oscillation_lt_of_safe_bound_budget
                                  hC_le_C1 hC1_nonneg
                                  homegaSum_nonneg
                                  homegaPack.right hC1_eta_lt
                              have herror_lt :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealTheory.abs
                                      (substitutionErrorSum
                                        f phi phi' theta p tag n))
                                    e2 :=
                                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                  F herror_le hCosc_lt
                              have htri :
                                  RealTheory.le
                                    (RealTheory.abs
                                      (RealTheory.sub
                                        (taggedSum
                                          (substitutionIntegrand
                                            f phi phi') p tag n)
                                        I))
                                    (RealTheory.add
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (RealTheory.sub
                                          (taggedSum f
                                            (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p)
                                            (imageTagIncreasing phi tag) n)
                                          I))
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (substitutionErrorSum
                                          f phi phi' theta p tag n))) := by
                                rw [hdecomp]
                                exact abs_sub_add_error_le
                                  (taggedSum f
                                    (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p)
                                    (imageTagIncreasing phi tag) n)
                                  (substitutionErrorSum
                                    f phi phi' theta p tag n)
                                  I
                              have hsum_lt :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealTheory.add
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (RealTheory.sub
                                          (taggedSum f
                                            (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p)
                                            (imageTagIncreasing phi tag) n)
                                          I))
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (substitutionErrorSum
                                          f phi phi' theta p tag n)))
                                    eps := by
                                have hadd :=
                                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
                                    htargetClose herror_lt
                                change
                                  F.lt
                                    (F.add
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (RealTheory.sub
                                          (taggedSum f
                                            (imagePartitionIncreasing phi p)
                                            (imageTagIncreasing phi tag) n)
                                          I))
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (substitutionErrorSum
                                          f phi phi' theta p tag n)))
                                    (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                                rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                                  F eps] at hadd
                              exact
                                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                  F htri hsum_lt

name: StrictDecreasingC1SubstitutionData.hasRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictDecreasing_raw
statement:
private theorem StrictDecreasingC1SubstitutionData.hasRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictDecreasing_raw
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I : Point}
    (data :
      StrictDecreasingC1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta a b I) :
    HasRiemannIntegral
      (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta
      (RealTheory.neg I)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hbeta_alpha : RealTheory.le beta alpha
  case pos =>
    have hsource_eq : beta = alpha :=
      RealTheory.le_antisymm hbeta_alpha data.source_order
    have htarget_eq : b = a := by
      rw [<- data.left_endpoint, <- data.right_endpoint, hsource_eq]
    have htarget_integral_degenerate :
        HasRiemannIntegral f a a I := by
      have htarget_integral := data.target_integral
      rwa [htarget_eq] at htarget_integral
    have hI_zero : I = RealTheory.zero :=
      hasRiemannIntegral_unique
        htarget_integral_degenerate
        (hasRiemannIntegral_degenerate f a)
    rw [hsource_eq, hI_zero, RealTheory.neg_zero]
    exact
      hasRiemannIntegral_degenerate
        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha
  case neg =>
    have halpha_beta_lt : RealTheory.lt alpha beta :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
        F data.source_order hbeta_alpha
    have hcrit :
        RiemannOscillationCriterion phi' alpha beta :=
      riemannOscillationCriterion_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval_of_lt
        halpha_beta_lt data.derivative_continuous
    refine And.intro data.source_order ?_
    intro eps heps
    let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
    have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
    cases data.target_integral.right e2 he2_pos with
    | intro deltaTarget hdeltaTarget =>
        cases
            data.imagePartitionDecreasing_mesh_transfer
              hdeltaTarget.left with
        | intro deltaImage hdeltaImage =>
            cases
                data.exists_target_abs_bound_with_positive_shift with
            | intro C hC =>
                let C1 := RealTheory.add C RealTheory.one
                have hC1_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero C1 := by
                  unfold C1
                  exact hC.right.right
                have hC1_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C1 :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hC1_pos
                have hC_le_C1 : RealTheory.le C C1 := by
                  unfold C1
                  exact RealTheory.le_add_one C
                cases
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt
                      F C1 he2_pos with
                | intro eta heta =>
                    have hC1_eta_lt :
                        RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul C1 eta) e2 := by
                      have hbudget := heta.right
                      have hC1_nonneg' : F.le F.zero C1 := by
                        exact hC1_nonneg
                      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hC1_nonneg']
                        at hbudget
                      exact hbudget
                    cases hcrit eta heta.left with
                    | intro deltaOsc hdeltaOsc =>
                        let delta :=
                          RealTheory.min deltaImage deltaOsc
                        refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                        refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                        ·
                          unfold delta
                          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_min2 F
                            hdeltaImage.left hdeltaOsc.left
                        ·
                          intro n p tag htag hmesh
                          have hp : IntervalPartition alpha beta n p :=
                            htag.left
                          have hmeshImage :
                              RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaImage :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                              hmesh
                              (by
                                unfold delta
                                exact
                                  RealTheory.min_le_left
                                    deltaImage deltaOsc)
                          have hmeshOsc :
                              RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaOsc :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                              hmesh
                              (by
                                unfold delta
                                exact
                                  RealTheory.min_le_right
                                    deltaImage deltaOsc)
                          have himageTagged :
                              TaggedPartition a b n
                                (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
                                (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n) :=
                            data.imageTaggedPartitionDecreasing htag
                          have himageMesh :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (mesh
                                  (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n) n)
                                deltaTarget :=
                            hdeltaImage.right n p hp hmeshImage
                          have htargetClose :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub
                                    (taggedSum f
                                      (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
                                      (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n) n)
                                    I))
                                e2 :=
                            hdeltaTarget.right n
                              (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
                              (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n)
                              himageTagged himageMesh
                          cases hdeltaOsc.right n p hp hmeshOsc with
                          | intro omega homegaPack =>
                              let theta : Nat -> Point := fun k =>
                                if hk : k < n then
                                  Classical.choose
                                    (data.exists_cell_lagrange_sample
                                      hp hk)
                                else
                                  p k
                              have hsample :
                                  forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                                    And
                                      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval
                                        (p k) (p (k + 1)) (theta k))
                                      (RealTheory.sub
                                          (phi (p (k + 1)))
                                          (phi (p k)) =
                                        RealTheory.mul
                                          (phi' (theta k))
                                          (cellLength p k)) := by
                                intro k hk
                                unfold theta
                                simp [hk]
                                exact Classical.choose_spec
                                  (data.exists_cell_lagrange_sample
                                    hp hk)
                              have hdecomp :
                                  RealTheory.add
                                      (taggedSum
                                        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi')
                                        p tag n)
                                      (taggedSum f
                                        (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
                                        (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n) n) =
                                    substitutionErrorSum
                                      f phi phi' theta p tag n :=
                                data.finiteSum_decomposition hsample
                              have herror_le :
                                  RealTheory.le
                                    (RealTheory.abs
                                      (substitutionErrorSum
                                        f phi phi' theta p tag n))
                                    (RealTheory.mul C
                                      (oscillationWeightedSum
                                        p n omega)) :=
                                data.errorSum_abs_le_bound_mul_oscillationWeightedSum
                                  htag hsample homegaPack.left
                                  hC.left hC.right.left
                              have homegaSum_nonneg :
                                  RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
                                    (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega) :=
                                oscillationWeightedSum_nonnegative_of_cellOscillation
                                  hp homegaPack.left
                              have hCosc_lt :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealTheory.mul C
                                      (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega))
                                    e2 :=
                                mul_oscillation_lt_of_safe_bound_budget
                                  hC_le_C1 hC1_nonneg
                                  homegaSum_nonneg
                                  homegaPack.right hC1_eta_lt
                              have herror_lt :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealTheory.abs
                                      (substitutionErrorSum
                                        f phi phi' theta p tag n))
                                    e2 :=
                                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                  F herror_le hCosc_lt
                              have hsourceTarget_lt :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealTheory.abs
                                      (RealTheory.add
                                        (taggedSum
                                          (substitutionIntegrand
                                            f phi phi') p tag n)
                                        (taggedSum f
                                          (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
                                          (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n)
                                          n)))
                                    e2 := by
                                rw [hdecomp]
                                exact herror_lt
                              have htri :
                                  RealTheory.le
                                    (RealTheory.abs
                                      (RealTheory.sub
                                        (taggedSum
                                          (substitutionIntegrand
                                            f phi phi') p tag n)
                                        (RealTheory.neg I)))
                                    (RealTheory.add
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (RealTheory.add
                                          (taggedSum
                                            (substitutionIntegrand
                                              f phi phi') p tag n)
                                          (taggedSum f
                                            (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
                                            (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n)
                                            n)))
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (RealTheory.sub
                                          (taggedSum f
                                            (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
                                            (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n)
                                            n)
                                          I))) :=
                                abs_sub_neg_le_add_error_target
                                  (taggedSum
                                    (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi')
                                    p tag n)
                                  (taggedSum f
                                    (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
                                    (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n) n)
                                  I
                              have hsum_lt :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealTheory.add
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (RealTheory.add
                                          (taggedSum
                                            (substitutionIntegrand
                                              f phi phi') p tag n)
                                          (taggedSum f
                                            (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
                                            (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n)
                                            n)))
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (RealTheory.sub
                                          (taggedSum f
                                            (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
                                            (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n)
                                            n)
                                          I)))
                                    eps := by
                                have hadd :=
                                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
                                    hsourceTarget_lt htargetClose
                                change
                                  F.lt
                                    (F.add
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (RealTheory.add
                                          (taggedSum
                                            (substitutionIntegrand
                                              f phi phi') p tag n)
                                          (taggedSum f
                                            (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
                                            (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n)
                                            n)))
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (RealTheory.sub
                                          (taggedSum f
                                            (imagePartitionDecreasing phi p n)
                                            (imageTagDecreasing phi tag n)
                                            n)
                                          I)))
                                    (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                                rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                                  F eps] at hadd
                              exact
                                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                  F htri hsum_lt

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictIncreasing
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictIncreasing
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I : Point}
    (data :
      StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta a b I) :
    And
      (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta I)
      (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I)
proof:
:= by
  have hsourceRaw :
      HasRiemannIntegral
        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta I :=
    data.hasRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictIncreasing_raw
  have hsourceBdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded
        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta :=
    taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
      (Exists.intro I hsourceRaw)
  have hsourceDarboux :
      HasDarbouxIntegral
        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta I :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral
      data.source_order hsourceRaw
  have htargetBdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
      (Exists.intro I data.target_integral)
  have htargetDarboux : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral
      data.target_order data.target_integral
  exact And.intro
    (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_le_hasDarbouxIntegral
      data.source_order hsourceBdd hsourceDarboux)
    (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_le_hasDarbouxIntegral
      data.target_order htargetBdd htargetDarboux)

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictDecreasing
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictDecreasing
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I : Point}
    (data :
      StrictDecreasingC1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta a b I) :
    And
      (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta
        (RealTheory.neg I))
      (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I)
proof:
:= by
  have hsourceRaw :
      HasRiemannIntegral
        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta
        (RealTheory.neg I) :=
    data.hasRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictDecreasing_raw
  have hsourceBdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded
        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta :=
    taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
      (Exists.intro (RealTheory.neg I) hsourceRaw)
  have hsourceDarboux :
      HasDarbouxIntegral
        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta
        (RealTheory.neg I) :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral
      data.source_order hsourceRaw
  have htargetBdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
      (Exists.intro I data.target_integral)
  have htargetDarboux : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral
      data.target_order data.target_integral
  exact And.intro
    (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_le_hasDarbouxIntegral
      data.source_order hsourceBdd hsourceDarboux)
    (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_le_hasDarbouxIntegral
      data.target_order htargetBdd htargetDarboux)

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictMonotone
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictMonotone
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b I : Point}
    (data :
      StrictMonotoneC1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta a b I) :
    Exists
      (fun J : Point =>
        And
          (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta J)
          (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            f (phi alpha) (phi beta) J))
proof:
:= by
  cases data with
  | inl increasing =>
      have hbranch :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictIncreasing
          increasing
      refine Exists.intro I ?_
      refine And.intro hbranch.left ?_
      simpa [increasing.left_endpoint, increasing.right_endpoint]
        using hbranch.right
  | inr decreasing =>
      have hbranch :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictDecreasing
          decreasing
      have htargetReverse :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f b a (RealTheory.neg I) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reverse hbranch.right
      refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.neg I) ?_
      refine And.intro hbranch.left ?_
      simpa [decreasing.left_endpoint, decreasing.right_endpoint]
        using htargetReverse

name: C1SubstitutionData.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_target_value
statement:
theorem C1SubstitutionData.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_target_value
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta u v : Point}
    (data : C1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta u v) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f (phi alpha) (phi beta) data.value
proof:
:= by
  let P := data.primitive
  have hAlpha :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f u (phi alpha) (P (phi alpha)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
      (f := f) (a := u) (b := v) (x := phi alpha)
      data.f_continuous data.phi_alpha_mem
  have hBeta :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f u (phi beta) (P (phi beta)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
      (f := f) (a := u) (b := v) (x := phi beta)
      data.f_continuous data.phi_beta_mem
  cases RealTheory.le_total (phi alpha) (phi beta) with
  | inl hforward =>
      have htarget :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f (phi alpha) (phi beta)
            (RealTheory.sub (P (phi beta)) (P (phi alpha))) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
          (f := f) (F := P) (a := u)
          (x := phi alpha) (y := phi beta)
          data.phi_alpha_mem.left hforward hAlpha hBeta
      exact htarget
  | inr hreverse =>
      have hordered :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f (phi beta) (phi alpha)
            (RealTheory.sub (P (phi alpha)) (P (phi beta))) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
          (f := f) (F := P) (a := u)
          (x := phi beta) (y := phi alpha)
          data.phi_beta_mem.left hreverse hBeta hAlpha
      have htarget :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f (phi alpha) (phi beta)
            (RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.sub (P (phi alpha)) (P (phi beta)))) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reverse hordered
      have hnorm :
          RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.sub (P (phi alpha)) (P (phi beta))) =
            RealTheory.sub (P (phi beta)) (P (phi alpha)) := by
        exact
          Eq.symm
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (P (phi alpha)) (P (phi beta)))
      rwa [hnorm] at htarget

name: C1SubstitutionData.substitutionIntegrand_continuous
statement:
theorem C1SubstitutionData.substitutionIntegrand_continuous
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta u v : Point}

      (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi')
proof:
:= by
  unfold substitutionIntegrand
  change
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
      (RealFunction.MulFun (RealFunction.CompFun f phi) phi')
  exact
    RealFunction.continuousOn_mul
      (RealFunction.continuousOn_comp
        data.phi_continuous data.f_continuous data.maps_closed)
      data.derivative_continuous

name: C1SubstitutionData.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_source_value
statement:
theorem C1SubstitutionData.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_source_value
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta u v : Point}
    (data : C1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta u v) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta data.value
proof:
:= by
  have hNL :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta
        (RealTheory.sub
          ((RealFunction.CompFun data.primitive phi) beta)
          ((RealFunction.CompFun data.primitive phi) alpha)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      (f := substitutionIntegrand f phi phi')
      (F := RealFunction.CompFun data.primitive phi)
      (a := alpha) (b := beta)
      data.domain_order
      data.substitutionIntegrand_continuous
      data.primitive_comp_continuous
      data.primitive_comp_derivative
  unfold C1SubstitutionData.value
  change
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta
      (RealTheory.sub
        ((RealFunction.CompFun data.primitive phi) beta)
        ((RealFunction.CompFun data.primitive phi) alpha))

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_c1
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_c1
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta u v : Point}
    (data : C1SubstitutionSegmentData f phi phi' alpha beta u v) :
    Exists
      (fun I : Point =>
        And
          (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta I)
          (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            f (phi alpha) (phi beta) I))
proof:
:= by

            (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reverse hordered.right))

name: lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_comp
statement:
private theorem lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_comp
    {F phi : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b K L : Point}
    (hKnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K)
    (hF : LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval F a b K)
    (hphi : LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval phi alpha beta L)
    (hmaps :
      RealFunction.MapsInto
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) phi) :
    LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval
      (RealFunction.CompFun F phi) alpha beta
      (RealTheory.mul K L)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hFxy :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub
            ((RealFunction.CompFun F phi) y)
            ((RealFunction.CompFun F phi) x)))
        (RealTheory.mul K
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (phi y) (phi x)))) := by
    exact hF (phi x) (phi y) (hmaps x hx) (hmaps y hy)
  have hphixy :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (phi y) (phi x)))
        (RealTheory.mul L
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x))) :=
    hphi x y hx hy
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul K
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (phi y) (phi x))))
        (RealTheory.mul K
          (RealTheory.mul L
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hphixy hKnonneg
  have hmul' :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul K
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (phi y) (phi x))))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul K L)
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x))) := by
    change
      C.le
        (C.mul K
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (phi y) (phi x))))
        (C.mul (C.mul K L)
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))
    rw [C.mul_assoc K L (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x))]
    exact hmul
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hFxy hmul'

name: lipschitzOnClosedInterval_comp
statement:
theorem lipschitzOnClosedInterval_comp
    {F phi : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b : Point}
    (hF : LipschitzOnClosedInterval F a b)
    (hphi : LipschitzOnClosedInterval phi alpha beta)
    (hmaps :
      RealFunction.MapsInto
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) phi) :
    LipschitzOnClosedInterval (RealFunction.CompFun F phi) alpha beta
proof:
:= by
  cases hF with
  | intro K hK =>
      cases hphi with
      | intro L hL =>
          exact Exists.intro (RealTheory.mul K L)
            (And.intro
              (RealTheory.mul_nonneg hK.left hL.left)
              (lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_comp
                hK.left hK.right hL.right hmaps))

name: hasDerivWithin_zero_of_forall_local_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_abs_sub
statement:
private theorem hasDerivWithin_zero_of_forall_local_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_abs_sub
    {E : RealFunction.Domain} {F : Point -> Point} {x : Point}
    (hx : E x)
    (hlocal :
      forall eta : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta ->
          Exists
            (fun delta : Point =>
              And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
                (forall y : Point,
                  E y ->
                    Not (y = x) ->
                      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) delta ->
                        RealTheory.le
                          (RealTheory.abs
                            (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)))
                          (RealTheory.mul eta
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub y x)))))) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E F x RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hx ?_
  intro eps heps
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half C eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos C heps
  cases hlocal e2 he2 with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro y hy hyx hdist
      have hrem :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)))
            (RealTheory.mul e2
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x))) :=
        hdelta.right y hy hyx hdist
      have hsub_ne : Not (RealTheory.sub y x = RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro hsub
        have hEq : y = x :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero C hsub
        exact hyx hEq
      have hquot_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y))
            e2 := by
        unfold RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient
        exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul_inv_le_of_abs_le_mul_abs
            C hsub_ne hrem
      have hquot_lt :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y))
            eps :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hquot_le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self C heps)
      change
        C.lt
          (RealFunction.dist
            (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y) C.zero)
          eps
      unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
      change
        C.lt
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C
            (C.sub (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y) C.zero))
          eps
      rw [C.sub_zero]
      exact hquot_lt

name: mul_inv_add_one_mul_le_self
statement:
private theorem mul_inv_add_one_mul_le_self
    {K eta : Point}
    (hKnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K)
    (heta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul K
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.add K RealTheory.one))) eta)
      eta
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let scale := RealTheory.add K RealTheory.one
  have hK_le_scale : RealTheory.le K scale := by
    dsimp [scale]
    exact RealTheory.le_add_one K
  have hK_lt_scale : RealTheory.lt K scale := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left C
        RealTheory.zero_lt_one K
    change C.lt (C.add K C.zero) (C.add K C.one) at h
    rwa [C.add_zero] at h
  have hscale_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero scale :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hKnonneg hK_lt_scale
  have hzero_ne_scale : Not (RealTheory.zero = scale) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt C hscale_pos
  have hscale_ne : Not (scale = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact hzero_ne_scale h.symm
  have hinv_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv scale) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos C hscale_pos)
  have hfrac :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.inv scale))
        (RealTheory.mul scale (RealTheory.inv scale)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hK_le_scale hinv_nonneg
  have hfrac_one :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.inv scale))
        RealTheory.one := by
    change
      C.le (C.mul K (C.inv scale))
        (C.mul scale (C.inv scale)) at hfrac
    rw [C.mul_inv_cancel hscale_ne] at hfrac
    exact hfrac
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.inv scale)) eta)
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one eta) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hfrac_one heta_nonneg
  change
    C.le (C.mul (C.mul K (C.inv scale)) eta)
      (C.mul C.one eta) at hmul
  rw [C.one_mul] at hmul
  change
    C.le (C.mul (C.mul K (C.inv scale)) eta) eta
  exact hmul

name: hasDerivWithin_comp_lipschitz_zero
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_comp_lipschitz_zero
    {F phi : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b K t : Point}
    (hKnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K)
    (hF :
      LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval F a b K)
    (hmaps :
      RealFunction.MapsInto
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) phi)
    (ht : RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta t)
    (hphi :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta) phi t RealTheory.zero) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
      (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta)
      (RealFunction.CompFun F phi) t RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply
    hasDerivWithin_zero_of_forall_local_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_abs_sub
      (F := RealFunction.CompFun F phi)
      (x := t)
      ht
  intro eta heta
  let scale := RealTheory.add K RealTheory.one
  let eta0 := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv scale) eta
  have hK_lt_scale : RealTheory.lt K scale := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left C
        RealTheory.zero_lt_one K
    change C.lt (C.add K C.zero) (C.add K C.one) at h
    rwa [C.add_zero] at h
  have hscale_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero scale :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hKnonneg hK_lt_scale
  have heta0 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta0 := by
    dsimp [eta0]
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos C hscale_pos) heta
  have heta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C heta
  have hKeta_le_eta :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul K eta0) eta := by
    have hscaled :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.inv scale)) eta)
          eta := by
      dsimp [scale]
      exact mul_inv_add_one_mul_le_self hKnonneg heta_nonneg
    dsimp [eta0]
    change
      C.le (C.mul K (C.mul (C.inv scale) eta)) eta
    rw [<- C.mul_assoc K (C.inv scale) eta]
    exact hscaled
  cases
      exists_local_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_abs_sub_of_hasDerivWithin_zero
        hphi heta0 with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro y hy hyne hydist
      have htClosed :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta t :=
        RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta t ht
      have hyClosed :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta y :=
        RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta y hy
      have hphiSmall :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (phi y) (phi t)))
            (RealTheory.mul eta0
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y t))) :=
        hdelta.right y hy hyne hydist
      have hFsmall :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub
                ((RealFunction.CompFun F phi) y)
                ((RealFunction.CompFun F phi) t)))
            (RealTheory.mul K
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (phi y) (phi t)))) := by
        exact hF (phi t) (phi y)
          (hmaps t htClosed) (hmaps y hyClosed)
      have hmulPhi :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul K
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (phi y) (phi t))))
            (RealTheory.mul K
              (RealTheory.mul eta0
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y t)))) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hphiSmall hKnonneg
      have hraw :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub
                ((RealFunction.CompFun F phi) y)
                ((RealFunction.CompFun F phi) t)))
            (RealTheory.mul K
              (RealTheory.mul eta0
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y t)))) :=
        RealTheory.le_trans hFsmall hmulPhi
      have hrawAssoc :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub
                ((RealFunction.CompFun F phi) y)
                ((RealFunction.CompFun F phi) t)))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul K eta0)
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y t))) := by
        change
          C.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub
                ((RealFunction.CompFun F phi) y)
                ((RealFunction.CompFun F phi) t)))
            (C.mul (C.mul K eta0)
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y t)))
        rw [C.mul_assoc K eta0 (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y t))]
        exact hraw
      have hdist_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y t)) :=
        RealTheory.abs_nonneg (RealTheory.sub y t)
      have hmulEta :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul K eta0)
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y t)))
            (RealTheory.mul eta
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y t))) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hKeta_le_eta hdist_nonneg
      exact RealTheory.le_trans hrawAssoc hmulEta

name: hasDerivWithin_of_eventuallyWithin_subset
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_of_eventuallyWithin_subset
    {E G : RealFunction.Domain} {F : Point -> Point} {x A : Point}
    (hxE : E x)
    (hlocal : RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin G F x A)
    (hevent : RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E x G) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E F x A
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hxE ?_
  intro eps heps
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hlocal.right eps heps with
  | intro deltaD hdeltaD =>
      cases hevent with
      | intro deltaG hdeltaG =>
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 C deltaD deltaG
          have hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
              C hdeltaD.left hdeltaG.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta ?_
          intro y hy hyne hydist
          have hydistD : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) deltaD :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C hydist
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left C deltaD deltaG)
          have hydistG : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) deltaG :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C hydist
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right C deltaD deltaG)
          have hyG : G y := hdeltaG.right y hy hyne hydistG
          exact hdeltaD.right y hyG hyne hydistD

name: eventuallyWithin_maps_openInterval_of_continuousAtOn
statement:
theorem eventuallyWithin_maps_openInterval_of_continuousAtOn
    {E : RealFunction.Domain} {phi : Point -> Point} {a b t : Point}
    (hphi : RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn E phi t)
    (hopen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (phi t)) :
    RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E t
      (fun y : Point => RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (phi y))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 C
      (RealTheory.sub (phi t) a)
      (RealTheory.sub b (phi t))
  have heps_left :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub (phi t) a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt C hopen.left
  have heps_right :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b (phi t)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt C hopen.right
  have heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos C heps_left heps_right
  cases hphi.right eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro y hy hyne hydist
      have hclose :
          RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (phi y) (phi t)) eps :=
        hdelta.right y hy hyne hydist
      exact
        RealFunction.mem_interval_of_dist_lt_min
          (left := a) (center := phi t) (right := b)
          (x := phi y) hopen.left hopen.right hclose

name: add_le_of_le_sub_right_local
statement:
private theorem add_le_of_le_sub_right_local
    {x b delta : Point}
    (hdelta : RealTheory.le delta (RealTheory.sub b x)) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.add x delta) b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h :=
    RealTheory.add_le_add_left hdelta x
  have hright :
      RealTheory.add x (RealTheory.sub b x) = b := by
    rw [RealTheory.add_comm]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b x
  rwa [hright] at h

name: le_sub_of_le_sub_left_local
statement:
private theorem le_sub_of_le_sub_left_local
    {a x delta : Point}
    (hdelta : RealTheory.le delta (RealTheory.sub x a)) :
    RealTheory.le a (RealTheory.sub x delta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub x (RealTheory.sub x a))
        (RealTheory.sub x delta) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F (F.le_refl x) hdelta
  change F.le (F.sub x (F.sub x a)) (F.sub x delta) at hsub
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F x a] at hsub

name: exists_substitutionDerivativeThreshold_le_abs
statement:
theorem exists_substitutionDerivativeThreshold_le_abs
    {x : Point} (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.le (substitutionDerivativeThreshold n)
          (RealTheory.abs x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.abs x) :=
    RealTheory.abs_pos_of_ne_zero hx
  cases RealTheory.exists_inv_nat_lt hpos with
  | intro N hN =>
      cases N with
      | zero =>
          exact False.elim (hN.left rfl)
      | succ n =>
          refine Exists.intro n ?_
          unfold substitutionDerivativeThreshold
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hN.right

name: substitutionEndpointMargin_le_gaps
statement:
theorem substitutionEndpointMargin_le_gaps
    {alpha beta t : Point}
    (ht : RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta t) :
    Exists
      (fun m : Nat =>
        And
          (RealTheory.le (substitutionEndpointMargin alpha beta m)
            (RealTheory.sub t alpha))
          (RealTheory.le (substitutionEndpointMargin alpha beta m)
            (RealTheory.sub beta t)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let leftGap := RealTheory.sub t alpha
  let rightGap := RealTheory.sub beta t
  let gap := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F leftGap rightGap
  let length := RealTheory.sub beta alpha
  have hleftGap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero leftGap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F ht.left
  have hrightGap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rightGap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F ht.right
  have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hleftGap_pos hrightGap_pos
  have halpha_beta : RealTheory.lt alpha beta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F ht.left ht.right
  have hlength_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero length :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F halpha_beta
  have hlength_ne : Not (length = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hlength_pos hzero.symm
  have hinv_length_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv length) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hlength_pos
  have heps_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul gap (RealTheory.inv length)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hgap_pos hinv_length_pos
  cases RealTheory.exists_inv_nat_lt heps_pos with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      have hNpos :
          RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat N) :=
        RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hN.left
      have hN3pos :
          RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat (N + 3)) := by
        have hraw : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat ((N + 2) + 1)) :=
          RealTheory.nat_succ_pos (N + 2)
        have hnat : (N + 2) + 1 = N + 3 := by omega
        rwa [hnat] at hraw
      have hN_le_N3 :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat N) (RealTheory.nat (N + 3)) :=
        RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (by omega)
      have hinv_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (N + 3)))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
          F hNpos hN3pos hN_le_N3
      have hlength_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero length :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlength_pos
      have hmargin_le_N :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul length
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (N + 3))))
            (RealTheory.mul length
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N))) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hinv_le hlength_nonneg
      have hNmul_raw :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul length
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N)))
            (RealTheory.mul length
              (RealTheory.mul gap (RealTheory.inv length))) :=
        RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hN.right hlength_pos
      have hmul_cancel :
          RealTheory.mul length
              (RealTheory.mul gap (RealTheory.inv length)) =
            gap := by
        calc
          RealTheory.mul length
              (RealTheory.mul gap (RealTheory.inv length)) =
              RealTheory.mul gap
                (RealTheory.mul length (RealTheory.inv length)) := by
                rw [RealTheory.mul_left_comm]
          _ = RealTheory.mul gap RealTheory.one := by
                rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hlength_ne]
          _ = gap := by
                rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
      have hNmul :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul length
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat N))) gap := by
        rwa [hmul_cancel] at hNmul_raw
      have hmargin_lt_gap :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul length
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (N + 3)))) gap :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hmargin_le_N hNmul
      have hgap_le_left :
          RealTheory.le gap leftGap :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F leftGap rightGap
      have hgap_le_right :
          RealTheory.le gap rightGap :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F leftGap rightGap
      have hmargin_le_left :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul length
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (N + 3)))) leftGap :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
            hmargin_lt_gap hgap_le_left)
      have hmargin_le_right :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul length
              (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (N + 3)))) rightGap :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
            hmargin_lt_gap hgap_le_right)
      unfold substitutionEndpointMargin
      exact And.intro hmargin_le_left hmargin_le_right

name: substitutionSourceInnerStrip_of_margin_le_gaps
statement:
theorem substitutionSourceInnerStrip_of_margin_le_gaps
    {alpha beta t : Point} {m : Nat}
    (hleft :
      RealTheory.le (substitutionEndpointMargin alpha beta m)
        (RealTheory.sub t alpha))
    (hright :
      RealTheory.le (substitutionEndpointMargin alpha beta m)
        (RealTheory.sub beta t)) :
    substitutionSourceInnerStrip alpha beta m t
proof:
:= by
  unfold substitutionSourceInnerStrip
  change
    And
      (RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add alpha (substitutionEndpointMargin alpha beta m)) t)
      (RealTheory.le t
        (RealTheory.sub beta (substitutionEndpointMargin alpha beta m)))
  exact
    And.intro
      (add_le_of_le_sub_right_local hleft)
      (le_sub_of_le_sub_left_local hright)

name: halfThreshold_pos
statement:
theorem halfThreshold_pos
    {eta : Point} (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (substitutionHalfThreshold eta)
proof:
:= by
  unfold substitutionHalfThreshold
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base heta

name: halfThreshold_lt_self
statement:
theorem halfThreshold_lt_self
    {eta : Point} (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    RealTheory.lt (substitutionHalfThreshold eta) eta
proof:
:= by
  unfold substitutionHalfThreshold
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base heta

name: le_sub_halfThreshold_of_threshold_le
statement:
private theorem le_sub_halfThreshold_of_threshold_le
    {eta x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.le eta x) :
    RealTheory.le (substitutionHalfThreshold eta)
      (RealTheory.sub x (substitutionHalfThreshold eta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := substitutionHalfThreshold eta
  have hsum_le :
      F.le (F.add h h) x := by
    have hhalf : F.add h h = eta := by
      unfold h substitutionHalfThreshold
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eta
    rwa [hhalf]
  have hshift := F.add_le_add_right hsum_le (F.neg h)
  have hleft :
      F.add (F.add h h) (F.neg h) = h := by
    calc
      F.add (F.add h h) (F.neg h) =
          F.add h (F.add h (F.neg h)) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add h F.zero := by
            rw [F.add_neg]
      _ = h := by
            rw [F.add_zero]
  have hright :
      F.add x (F.neg h) = F.sub x h := by
    exact Eq.symm (F.sub_eq_add_neg x h)
  rwa [hleft, hright] at hshift

name: neg_threshold_add_halfThreshold_eq_neg_halfThreshold
statement:
private theorem neg_threshold_add_halfThreshold_eq_neg_halfThreshold
    (eta : Point) :
    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg eta) (substitutionHalfThreshold eta) =
      RealTheory.neg (substitutionHalfThreshold eta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := substitutionHalfThreshold eta
  have heta : eta = F.add h h := by
    unfold h substitutionHalfThreshold
    exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eta)
  calc
    F.add (F.neg eta) h =
        F.add (F.neg (F.add h h)) h := by
          rw [heta]
    _ = F.add (F.add (F.neg h) (F.neg h)) h := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F h h]
    _ = F.add (F.neg h) (F.add (F.neg h) h) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.neg h) F.zero := by
          rw [F.neg_add]
    _ = F.neg h := by
          rw [F.add_zero]

name: halfThreshold_le_of_threshold_le_of_dist_lt_half
statement:
theorem halfThreshold_le_of_threshold_le_of_dist_lt_half
    {eta x y : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.le eta x)
    (hclose :
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) (substitutionHalfThreshold eta)) :
    RealTheory.le (substitutionHalfThreshold eta) y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hclose' :
      F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub y x))
        (substitutionHalfThreshold eta) := by
    unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hclose
    exact hclose
  have hleft :
      F.lt (F.sub x (substitutionHalfThreshold eta)) y :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hclose'
  exact F.le_trans
    (le_sub_halfThreshold_of_threshold_le hx)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hleft)

name: le_neg_halfThreshold_of_le_neg_threshold_of_dist_lt_half
statement:
theorem le_neg_halfThreshold_of_le_neg_threshold_of_dist_lt_half
    {eta x y : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.le x (RealTheory.neg eta))
    (hclose :
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) (substitutionHalfThreshold eta)) :
    RealTheory.le y (RealTheory.neg (substitutionHalfThreshold eta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hclose' :
      F.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub y x))
        (substitutionHalfThreshold eta) := by
    unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hclose
    exact hclose
  have hright :
      F.lt y (F.add x (substitutionHalfThreshold eta)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hclose'
  have hcenter :
      F.le (F.add x (substitutionHalfThreshold eta))
        (F.neg (substitutionHalfThreshold eta)) := by
    have hshift :
        F.le (F.add x (substitutionHalfThreshold eta))
          (F.add (F.neg eta) (substitutionHalfThreshold eta)) :=
      F.add_le_add_right hx (substitutionHalfThreshold eta)
    have hneg :
        F.add (F.neg eta) (substitutionHalfThreshold eta) =
          F.neg (substitutionHalfThreshold eta) :=
      neg_threshold_add_halfThreshold_eq_neg_halfThreshold eta
    rwa [hneg] at hshift
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hright hcenter)

name: substitutionDerivativeThreshold_pos
statement:
theorem substitutionDerivativeThreshold_pos (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (substitutionDerivativeThreshold n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold substitutionDerivativeThreshold
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos n)

name: le_abs_or_le_neg_of_le_abs
statement:
theorem le_abs_or_le_neg_of_le_abs
    {eta x : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.le eta (RealTheory.abs x)) :
    Or (RealTheory.le eta x) (RealTheory.le x (RealTheory.neg eta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hx_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x
  · left
    rwa [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hx_nonneg] at h
  · right
    have hx_nonpos : RealTheory.le x RealTheory.zero := by
      cases F.le_total x RealTheory.zero with
      | inl hx => exact hx
      | inr hzero_x => exact False.elim (hx_nonneg hzero_x)
    have heta_negx : RealTheory.le eta (RealTheory.neg x) := by
      rwa [RealTheory.abs_of_nonpos hx_nonpos] at h
    have hneg :
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.neg x))
          (RealTheory.neg eta) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F heta_negx
    rwa [RealTheory.neg_neg] at hneg

name: le_inv_mul_of_mul_le
statement:
private theorem le_inv_mul_of_mul_le
    {c d e : Point}
    (hc_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c)
    (h : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul c d) e) :
    RealTheory.le d (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) e)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hc_ne : Not (c = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hc_pos hzero.symm
  have hinv_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv c) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hc_pos)
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) (RealTheory.mul c d))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) e) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left h hinv_nonneg
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) (RealTheory.mul c d) = d := by
    calc
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) (RealTheory.mul c d) =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) c) d := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      _ = RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one d := by
          rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hc_ne]
      _ = d := by
          rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
  rwa [hleft] at hmul

name: lipschitzWithConstantOn_inverse_of_coLipschitz
statement:
theorem lipschitzWithConstantOn_inverse_of_coLipschitz
    {E : Point -> Prop} {f : Point -> Point} {c : Point}
    (hc_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c)
    (hco : CoLipschitzWithConstantOn E f c) :
    LipschitzWithConstantOn
      (RealFunction.Image E f) (RealFunction.InverseOn E f)
      (RealTheory.inv c)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hinvx : E (RealFunction.InverseOn E f x) :=
    RealFunction.inverseOn_mem hx
  have hinvy : E (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y) :=
    RealFunction.inverseOn_mem hy
  have hcoxy :=
    hco (RealFunction.InverseOn E f x)
      (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y) hinvx hinvy
  have hdist :
      RealFunction.dist
          (f (RealFunction.InverseOn E f y))
          (f (RealFunction.InverseOn E f x)) =
        RealFunction.dist y x := by
    rw [RealFunction.inverseOn_value hy,
      RealFunction.inverseOn_value hx]
  rw [hdist] at hcoxy
  exact le_inv_mul_of_mul_le hc_pos hcoxy

name: lipschitzImageCoverRepresentative_mem
statement:
private theorem lipschitzImageCoverRepresentative_mem
    {E : Point -> Prop} {a b : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}

name: lipschitzImageCoverRepresentative_interval
statement:
private theorem lipschitzImageCoverRepresentative_interval
    {E : Point -> Prop} {a b : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (h : lipschitzImageCoverHit E a b n) :
