name: centeredInterval_ordered_of_radius_nonnegative
statement:
private theorem centeredInterval_ordered_of_radius_nonnegative
    {x r : Point} (hr : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero r) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub x r) (RealTheory.add x r)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft : F.le (F.sub x r) x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic F hr
  have hright : F.le x (F.add x r) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hr x
    change F.le (F.add x F.zero) (F.add x r) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  exact F.le_trans hleft hright

name: intervalLength_pos_of_mem_openInterval
statement:
private theorem intervalLength_pos_of_mem_openInterval
    {a b x : Point}
    (hx : RealNegligibility.OpenInterval a b x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealNegligibility.intervalLength a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealNegligibility.intervalLength
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx.left hx.right)

name: dist_lt_intervalLength_of_mem_openInterval
statement:
private theorem dist_lt_intervalLength_of_mem_openInterval
    {a b x y : Point}
    (hx : RealNegligibility.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealNegligibility.OpenInterval a b y) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x y) (RealNegligibility.intervalLength a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases F.le_total y x with
  | inl hyx =>
      have hsub_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub x y) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hyx
      have hdist : RealFunction.dist x y = F.sub x y := by
        unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
        exact RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hsub_nonneg
      have hx_b_y : F.lt (F.sub x y) (F.sub b y) := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F hx.right (F.neg y)
        change F.lt (F.add x (F.neg y)) (F.add b (F.neg y)) at h
        rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg x y, <- F.sub_eq_add_neg b y] at h
      have hb_y_b_a : F.lt (F.sub b y) (F.sub b a) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt F hy.left
      unfold RealNegligibility.intervalLength
      rw [hdist]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx_b_y hb_y_b_a
  | inr hxy =>
      have hsub_nonpos : F.le (F.sub x y) F.zero :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hxy
      have hdist : RealFunction.dist x y = F.sub y x := by
        unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonpos F hsub_nonpos]
        exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x y)
      have hy_b_x : F.lt (F.sub y x) (F.sub b x) := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F hy.right (F.neg x)
        change F.lt (F.add y (F.neg x)) (F.add b (F.neg x)) at h
        rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg y x, <- F.sub_eq_add_neg b x] at h
      have hb_x_b_a : F.lt (F.sub b x) (F.sub b a) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt F hx.left
      unfold RealNegligibility.intervalLength
      rw [hdist]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hy_b_x hb_x_b_a

name: lipschitzImageCoverLength_eq
statement:
private theorem lipschitzImageCoverLength_eq
    (E : Point -> Prop) (psi : Point -> Point) (L : Point)
    (a b : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealNegligibility.coverLength
        (lipschitzImageCoverLeft E psi L a b)
        (lipschitzImageCoverRight E psi L a b) n =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add L RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.add L RealTheory.one))
        (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n)
proof:
:= by
  let K := RealTheory.add L RealTheory.one
  let ell := RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n
  let center := psi (lipschitzImageCoverRepresentative E a b n)
  change
    RealNegligibility.intervalLength
      (RealTheory.sub center (RealTheory.mul K ell))
      (RealTheory.add center (RealTheory.mul K ell)) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add K K) ell
  rw [RealNegligibility.centeredInterval_length]
  change
    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul K ell) (RealTheory.mul K ell) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add K K) ell
  exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.add_mul K K ell)

name: nullSet_image_of_lipschitzWithConstantOn
statement:
theorem nullSet_image_of_lipschitzWithConstantOn
    {E D : Point -> Prop} {psi : Point -> Point} {L : Point}
    (hnull : RealNegligibility.NullSet E)
    (hED : forall x : Point, E x -> D x)
    (hL_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero L)
    (hpsi : LipschitzWithConstantOn D psi L) :
    RealNegligibility.NullSet (RealFunction.Image E psi)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let K := RealTheory.add L RealTheory.one
  let M := RealTheory.add K K
  let scale := RealTheory.add M RealTheory.one
  let eps0 := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv scale) eps
  have hL_lt_K : RealTheory.lt L K := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one L
    change F.lt (F.add L F.zero) (F.add L F.one) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hK_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero K :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hL_nonneg hL_lt_K
  have hK_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hK_pos
  have hM_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero M := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hK_pos hK_pos
    change F.lt (F.add F.zero F.zero) (F.add K K) at h
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hM_pos
  have hM_lt_scale : RealTheory.lt M scale := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one M
    change F.lt (F.add M F.zero) (F.add M F.one) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hscale_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero scale :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hM_nonneg hM_lt_scale
  have heps0_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps0 := by
    unfold eps0
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hscale_pos) heps
  cases hnull eps0 heps0_pos with
  | intro a ha =>
      cases ha with
      | intro b hb =>
          let left := lipschitzImageCoverLeft E psi L a b
          let right := lipschitzImageCoverRight E psi L a b
          refine Exists.intro left ?_
          refine Exists.intro right ?_
          refine And.intro ?cover ?budget
          · constructor
            · intro n
              have hell_nonneg :
                  RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
                    (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n) :=
                RealNegligibility.coverLength_nonnegative_of_cover hb.left n
              have hr_nonneg :
                  RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
                    (lipschitzImageCoverRadius L a b n) :=
                F.mul_nonneg hK_nonneg hell_nonneg
              unfold left right lipschitzImageCoverLeft
                lipschitzImageCoverRight
              exact centeredInterval_ordered_of_radius_nonnegative hr_nonneg
            · intro y hy
              cases hy with
              | intro x hx =>
                  cases hb.left.right x hx.left with
                  | intro n hxn =>
                      have hhit : lipschitzImageCoverHit E a b n :=
                        Exists.intro x (And.intro hx.left hxn)
                      let r := lipschitzImageCoverRepresentative E a b n
                      have hrE : E r := by
                        unfold r
                        exact lipschitzImageCoverRepresentative_mem hhit
                      have hrI :
                          RealNegligibility.OpenInterval (a n) (b n) r := by
                        unfold r
                        exact lipschitzImageCoverRepresentative_interval hhit
                      have hxD : D x := hED x hx.left
                      have hrD : D r := hED r hrE
                      have hell_pos :
                          RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                            (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n) := by
                        unfold RealNegligibility.coverLength
                        exact intervalLength_pos_of_mem_openInterval hxn
                      have hsrc_lt :
                          RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x r)
                            (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n) := by
                        unfold RealNegligibility.coverLength
                        exact dist_lt_intervalLength_of_mem_openInterval
                          hxn hrI
                      have himg_le :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealFunction.dist (psi x) (psi r))
                            (RealTheory.mul L (RealFunction.dist x r)) :=
                        hpsi r x hrD hxD
                      have hLdist_le_Lell :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealTheory.mul L (RealFunction.dist x r))
                            (RealTheory.mul L
                              (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n)) :=
                        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsrc_lt)
                          hL_nonneg
                      have hLell_lt_Kell :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.mul L
                              (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n))
                            (RealTheory.mul K
                              (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n)) :=
                        RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hL_lt_K hell_pos
                      have himg_lt_radius :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealFunction.dist (psi x) (psi r))
                            (lipschitzImageCoverRadius L a b n) := by
                        unfold lipschitzImageCoverRadius
                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                          (F.le_trans himg_le hLdist_le_Lell)
                          hLell_lt_Kell
                      refine Exists.intro n ?_
                      unfold left right lipschitzImageCoverLeft
                        lipschitzImageCoverRight
                      rw [<- hx.right]
                      have hclose :
                          F.lt
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                              (F.sub (psi x) (psi r)))
                            (lipschitzImageCoverRadius L a b n) := by
                        unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
                          at himg_lt_radius
                        exact himg_lt_radius
                      exact And.intro
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hclose)
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hclose)
          · intro N
            have hpoint :
                forall n : Nat,
                  F.le
                    (RealNegligibility.coverLength left right n)
                    (F.mul M (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n)) := by
              intro n
              have hlen := lipschitzImageCoverLength_eq E psi L a b n
              change
                F.le
                  (RealNegligibility.coverLength left right n)
                  (F.mul M (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n))
              unfold left right M K
              rw [hlen]
              exact F.le_refl
                (F.mul (F.add (F.add L F.one) (F.add L F.one))
                  (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n))
            have hsum_le :
                F.le
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
                    (RealNegligibility.coverLength left right) N)
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
                    (fun n : Nat =>
                      F.mul M (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n)) N) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum_le_of_pointwise_le
                F hpoint N
            have hscaled_sum :
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
                    (fun n : Nat =>
                      F.mul M (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b n)) N =
                  F.mul M
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
                      (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b) N) := by
              unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_left
                F M (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b) N
            have hold_lt : F.lt
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
                  (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b) N) eps0 :=
              hb.right N
            have hscaled_lt :
                F.lt
                  (F.mul M
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
                      (RealNegligibility.coverLength a b) N))
                  (F.mul M eps0) :=
              RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hold_lt hM_pos
            have heps_nonneg : F.le F.zero eps :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heps
            have hscaled_budget :
                F.le (F.mul M eps0) eps := by
              unfold eps0 scale
              change
                F.le (F.mul M (F.mul (F.inv (F.add M F.one)) eps)) eps
              rw [<- F.mul_assoc M (F.inv (F.add M F.one)) eps]
              exact mul_inv_add_one_mul_le_self hM_nonneg heps_nonneg
            rw [hscaled_sum] at hsum_le
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hsum_le
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                hscaled_lt hscaled_budget)

name: tendstoWithin_pos_const_mul_abs_zero
statement:
theorem tendstoWithin_pos_const_mul_abs_zero
    {E : RealFunction.Domain} {g : Point -> Point} {x0 K : Point}
    (hKpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero K)
    (hg : RealFunction.TendstoWithin E g x0 RealTheory.zero) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.abs (g x)))
      x0 RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F K heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      have hK_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hKpos
      have hKeta_lt :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul K eta) eps := by
        have h := heta.right
        have hK_nonneg' : F.le F.zero K := by
          exact hK_nonneg
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hK_nonneg'] at h
        exact h
      cases hg eta heta.left with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          intro x hx hxne hxd
          have hgclose := hdelta.right x hx hxne hxd
          have hgabs_lt :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs (g x)) eta := by
            unfold RealFunction.dist at hgclose
            change
              F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (g x) F.zero)) eta
              at hgclose
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (g x)] at hgclose
            exact hgclose
          have hmul_lt :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.abs (g x)))
                (RealTheory.mul K eta) :=
            RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hgabs_lt hKpos
          have hbound_nonneg :
              RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.abs (g x))) :=
            F.mul_nonneg hK_nonneg (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (g x))
          unfold RealFunction.dist
          change
            F.lt
              (RealTheory.abs
                (F.sub (F.mul K (RealTheory.abs (g x))) F.zero))
              eps
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F
            (F.mul K (RealTheory.abs (g x)))]
          change F.lt (F.abs (F.mul K (F.abs (g x)))) eps
          have hbound_nonneg' :
              F.le F.zero (F.mul K (F.abs (g x))) := by
            exact hbound_nonneg
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hbound_nonneg']
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hmul_lt hKeta_lt

name: substitutionIntegrand_abs_le_bounded_target_mul_abs_derivative
statement:
theorem substitutionIntegrand_abs_le_bounded_target_mul_abs_derivative
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point}
    {alpha beta a b B K x : Point}
    (hB :
      And (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero B)
        (forall y : Point,
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y ->
            RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f y)) B))
    (hB_le_K : RealTheory.le B K)
    (hmaps :
      RealFunction.MapsInto
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) phi)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta x) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi' x))
      (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.abs (phi' x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hfB :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f (phi x))) B :=
    hB.right (phi x) (hmaps x hx)
  have hfK :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f (phi x))) K :=
    F.le_trans hfB hB_le_K
  unfold substitutionIntegrand
  change
    F.le (F.abs (F.mul (f (phi x)) (phi' x)))
      (F.mul K (F.abs (phi' x)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F (f (phi x)) (phi' x)]
  exact
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      hfK (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (phi' x))

name: substitution_openInterval_of_closedInterval_not_endpoints

theorem substitution_openInterval_of_closedInterval_not_endpoints
    {alpha beta t : Point}
    (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta t)

proof:
:= by

  have hnot_t_le_alpha : Not (RealTheory.le t alpha) := by

  have hnot_beta_le_t : Not (RealTheory.le beta t) := by
    intro hbetat
    have hbeta_t : beta = t :=
      F.le_antisymm hbetat ht.right
    exact hright hbeta_t.symm
  exact And.intro
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F ht.left hnot_t_le_alpha)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F ht.right hnot_beta_le_t)

statement:
private theorem lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_add_const_left
    {F : Point -> Point} {a b c K : Point}
    (hF : LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval F a b K) :
    LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval
      (fun t => RealTheory.add c (F t)) a b K
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub :
      RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add c (F y)) (RealTheory.add c (F x)) =
        RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x) := by
    change C.sub (C.add c (F y)) (C.add c (F x)) = C.sub (F y) (F x)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub C c (F y) c (F x)]
    rw [C.sub_self, C.zero_add]
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add c (F y)) (RealTheory.add c (F x))))
      (RealTheory.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x))
  rw [hsub]
  exact hF x y hx hy

private theorem exists_primitiveSubstitutionPositiveRadiusControl

    (huAt :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) u t)
    (hpos :
      RealTheory.le (substitutionDerivativeThreshold n) (u t)) :
    Exists
      (fun k : Nat =>
        primitiveSubstitutionPositiveRadiusControl
          u alpha beta n k t)
proof:
:= by
  let eta := substitutionDerivativeThreshold n
  let halfEta := substitutionHalfThreshold eta
  have heta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta := by
    dsimp [eta]
    exact substitutionDerivativeThreshold_pos n
  have hhalf_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero halfEta := by
    dsimp [halfEta]
    exact halfThreshold_pos heta_pos
  cases huAt.right halfEta hhalf_pos with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases RealTheory.exists_inv_nat_lt hdelta.left with
      | intro N hN =>
          cases N with
          | zero =>
              exact False.elim (hN.left rfl)
          | succ k =>
              have hradius_lt_delta :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (primitiveSubstitutionSignRadius k) delta := by
                unfold primitiveSubstitutionSignRadius
                  substitutionDerivativeThreshold
                exact hN.right
              refine Exists.intro k ?_
              intro y hy hydist
              by_cases hyt : y = t
              · rw [hyt]
                have hhalf_le_eta :
                    RealTheory.le halfEta eta :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                    (by
                      dsimp [halfEta]
                      exact halfThreshold_lt_self heta_pos)
                exact RealTheory.le_trans hhalf_le_eta hpos
              · have hydelta : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y t) delta :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
                    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                    hydist hradius_lt_delta
                have hclose :
                    RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (u y) (u t))
                      halfEta :=
                  hdelta.right y hy hyt hydelta
                dsimp [eta, halfEta] at hclose
                exact
                  halfThreshold_le_of_threshold_le_of_dist_lt_half
                    hpos hclose

name: exists_primitiveSubstitutionNegativeRadiusControl
statement:
private theorem exists_primitiveSubstitutionNegativeRadiusControl
    {u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta t : Point} {n : Nat}
    (huAt :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) u t)
    (hneg :
      RealTheory.le (u t)
        (RealTheory.neg (substitutionDerivativeThreshold n))) :
    Exists
      (fun k : Nat =>
        primitiveSubstitutionNegativeRadiusControl
          u alpha beta n k t)
proof:
:= by
  let eta := substitutionDerivativeThreshold n
  let halfEta := substitutionHalfThreshold eta
  have heta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta := by
    dsimp [eta]
    exact substitutionDerivativeThreshold_pos n
  have hhalf_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero halfEta := by
    dsimp [halfEta]
    exact halfThreshold_pos heta_pos
  cases huAt.right halfEta hhalf_pos with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases RealTheory.exists_inv_nat_lt hdelta.left with
      | intro N hN =>
          cases N with
          | zero =>
              exact False.elim (hN.left rfl)
          | succ k =>
              have hradius_lt_delta :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (primitiveSubstitutionSignRadius k) delta := by
                unfold primitiveSubstitutionSignRadius
                  substitutionDerivativeThreshold
                exact hN.right
              refine Exists.intro k ?_
              intro y hy hydist
              by_cases hyt : y = t
              · rw [hyt]
                have hself :
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealFunction.dist (u t) (u t)) halfEta := by
                  rw [RealFunction.dist_self]
                  exact hhalf_pos
                dsimp [eta, halfEta] at hself
                exact
                  le_neg_halfThreshold_of_le_neg_threshold_of_dist_lt_half
                    hneg hself
              · have hydelta : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y t) delta :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
                    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                    hydist hradius_lt_delta
                have hclose :
                    RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (u y) (u t))
                      halfEta :=
                  hdelta.right y hy hyt hydelta
                dsimp [eta, halfEta] at hclose
                exact
                  le_neg_halfThreshold_of_le_neg_threshold_of_dist_lt_half
                    hneg hclose

name: primitiveSubstitutionD2Set_subset_radiusCover
statement:
private theorem primitiveSubstitutionD2Set_subset_radiusCover
    {f phi u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b t : Point}
    (ht : primitiveSubstitutionD2Set f phi u alpha beta a b t) :
    primitiveSubstitutionD2RadiusCover f phi u alpha beta a b t
proof:
:= by
  have huAt :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) u t :=
    primitiveSubstitutionContinuousAt_of_not_derivativeDiscontinuity
      ht.left ht.right.right.left
  cases exists_substitutionDerivativeThreshold_le_abs
      (x := u t) ht.right.right.right with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases substitutionEndpointMargin_le_gaps ht.left with
      | intro m hm =>
          have hstrip : substitutionSourceInnerStrip alpha beta m t :=
            substitutionSourceInnerStrip_of_margin_le_gaps
              hm.left hm.right
          cases le_abs_or_le_neg_of_le_abs hn with
          | inl hpos =>
              cases
                  exists_primitiveSubstitutionPositiveRadiusControl
                    huAt hpos with
              | intro k hcontrol =>
                  apply primitiveSubstitutionD2RadiusSet_mem_cover
                  exact Or.inl
                    (And.intro ht
                      (And.intro hstrip
                        (And.intro hpos hcontrol)))
          | inr hneg =>
              cases
                  exists_primitiveSubstitutionNegativeRadiusControl
                    huAt hneg with
              | intro k hcontrol =>
                  apply primitiveSubstitutionD2RadiusSet_mem_cover
                  exact Or.inr
                    (And.intro ht
                      (And.intro hstrip
                        (And.intro hneg hcontrol)))

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_target_value
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_target_value
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      f (data.phi alpha) (data.phi beta) data.value
proof:
:= by
  let P := data.primitive
  have hAlpha :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a (data.phi alpha) (P (data.phi alpha)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (x := data.phi alpha)
      data.f_integrable data.phi_alpha_mem
  have hBeta :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a (data.phi beta) (P (data.phi beta)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (x := data.phi beta)
      data.f_integrable data.phi_beta_mem
  cases RealTheory.le_total (data.phi alpha) (data.phi beta) with
  | inl hforward =>
      have htarget :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f (data.phi alpha) (data.phi beta)
            (RealTheory.sub (P (data.phi beta)) (P (data.phi alpha))) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
          (f := f) (F := P) (a := a)
          (x := data.phi alpha) (y := data.phi beta)
          data.phi_alpha_mem.left hforward hAlpha hBeta
      exact htarget
  | inr hreverse =>
      have hordered :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f (data.phi beta) (data.phi alpha)
            (RealTheory.sub (P (data.phi alpha)) (P (data.phi beta))) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
          (f := f) (F := P) (a := a)
          (x := data.phi beta) (y := data.phi alpha)
          data.phi_beta_mem.left hreverse hBeta hAlpha
      have htarget :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f (data.phi alpha) (data.phi beta)
            (RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.sub (P (data.phi alpha)) (P (data.phi beta)))) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reverse hordered
      have hnorm :
          RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.sub (P (data.phi alpha)) (P (data.phi beta))) =
            RealTheory.sub (P (data.phi beta)) (P (data.phi alpha)) := by
        exact
          Eq.symm
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (P (data.phi alpha)) (P (data.phi beta)))
      rwa [hnorm] at htarget

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourcePrimitive_increment_ge_const_ordered
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourcePrimitive_increment_ge_const_ordered
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 c x y : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta y)
    (hlower :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z -> RealTheory.le c (u z)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub y x))
      (RealTheory.sub (data.sourcePrimitive y) (data.sourcePrimitive x))
proof:
:= by
  have hUx :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral u alpha x (data.sourcePrimitive x) := by
    unfold RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourcePrimitive
    exact
      hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
        (f := u) (a := alpha) (b := beta) (x := x)
        data.u_integrable hx
  have hUy :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral u alpha y (data.sourcePrimitive y) := by
    unfold RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourcePrimitive
    exact
      hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
        (f := u) (a := alpha) (b := beta) (x := y)
        data.u_integrable hy
  have hsource :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral u x y
        (RealTheory.sub (data.sourcePrimitive y)
          (data.sourcePrimitive x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
      hx.left hxy hUx hUy
  have hconst :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (fun _ : Point => c) x y
        (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_const_of_le (c := c) hxy
  have hconstData :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hxy hconst
  have hsourceData :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hxy hsource
  exact
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      hxy
      (fun z hz => hlower z hz)
      hconstData.left hconstData.right
      hsourceData.left hsourceData.right

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourcePrimitive_neg_increment_ge_const_ordered
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourcePrimitive_neg_increment_ge_const_ordered
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 c x y : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta y)
    (hupper :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
          RealTheory.le (u z) (RealTheory.neg c)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub y x))
      (RealTheory.sub (data.sourcePrimitive x) (data.sourcePrimitive y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hUx :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral u alpha x (data.sourcePrimitive x) := by
    unfold RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourcePrimitive
    exact
      hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
        (f := u) (a := alpha) (b := beta) (x := x)
        data.u_integrable hx
  have hUy :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral u alpha y (data.sourcePrimitive y) := by
    unfold RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourcePrimitive
    exact
      hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
        (f := u) (a := alpha) (b := beta) (x := y)
        data.u_integrable hy
  have hsource :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral u x y
        (RealTheory.sub (data.sourcePrimitive y)
          (data.sourcePrimitive x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
      hx.left hxy hUx hUy
  have hconst :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.neg c) x y
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg c) (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_const_of_le (c := RealTheory.neg c) hxy
  have hsourceData :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hxy hsource
  have hconstData :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hxy hconst
  have hupperIntegral :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub (data.sourcePrimitive y)
          (data.sourcePrimitive x))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg c) (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      hxy
      (fun z hz => hupper z hz)
      hsourceData.left hsourceData.right
      hconstData.left hconstData.right
  have hneg := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hupperIntegral
  change
    F.le
      (F.neg (F.mul (F.neg c) (F.sub y x)))
      (F.neg (F.sub (data.sourcePrimitive y)
        (data.sourcePrimitive x))) at hneg
  have hleft :
      F.neg (F.mul (F.neg c) (F.sub y x)) =
        F.mul c (F.sub y x) := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F c (F.sub y x)]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F]
  have hright :
      F.neg (F.sub (data.sourcePrimitive y)
        (data.sourcePrimitive x)) =
        F.sub (data.sourcePrimitive x) (data.sourcePrimitive y) := by
    exact Eq.symm
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F
        (data.sourcePrimitive y) (data.sourcePrimitive x))
  rwa [hleft, hright] at hneg

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.phi_hasDerivWithin_at_continuity
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.phi_hasDerivWithin_at_continuity
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 t : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (ht : RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta t)

      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) u t) :

      (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta) data.phi t (u t)
proof:
:= by
  have hsource :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta)
        data.sourcePrimitive t (u t) :=
    hasDerivWithin_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable

      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta)

  have hadd :

        (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta)
        (RealFunction.AddFun (fun _ : Point => phi0) data.sourcePrimitive)
        t (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero (u t)) :=

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.phi_dist_eq_sourcePrimitive_dist
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.phi_dist_eq_sourcePrimitive_dist
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 x y : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0) :
    RealFunction.dist (data.phi y) (data.phi x) =
      RealFunction.dist (data.sourcePrimitive y) (data.sourcePrimitive x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  have hsub :
      F.sub (data.phi y) (data.phi x) =
        F.sub (data.sourcePrimitive y) (data.sourcePrimitive x) := by
    unfold RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.phi
    change
      F.sub (F.add phi0 (data.sourcePrimitive y))
          (F.add phi0 (data.sourcePrimitive x)) =
        F.sub (data.sourcePrimitive y) (data.sourcePrimitive x)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
      F phi0 (data.sourcePrimitive y) phi0 (data.sourcePrimitive x)]
    rw [F.sub_self, F.zero_add]
  rw [hsub]

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.positiveRadiusCell_coLipschitz
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.positiveRadiusCell_coLipschitz
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 : Point}
    {N n m k j : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (hp : IntervalPartition alpha beta N p)
    (hj : j < N)
    (hmesh :
      RealTheory.lt (mesh p N)
        (primitiveSubstitutionSignRadius k)) :
    CoLipschitzWithConstantOn
      (primitiveSubstitutionD2PositiveRadiusCellSet
        f data.phi u alpha beta a b n m k p j)
      data.phi
      (substitutionHalfThreshold
        (substitutionDerivativeThreshold n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let c := substitutionHalfThreshold (substitutionDerivativeThreshold n)
  change
    CoLipschitzWithConstantOn
      (primitiveSubstitutionD2PositiveRadiusCellSet
        f data.phi u alpha beta a b n m k p j)
      data.phi c
  have hc_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c := by
    dsimp [c]
    exact halfThreshold_pos (substitutionDerivativeThreshold_pos n)
  have hc_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero c :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hc_pos
  have hordered :
      forall x y : Point,
        primitiveSubstitutionD2PositiveRadiusCellSet
          f data.phi u alpha beta a b n m k p j x ->
        primitiveSubstitutionD2PositiveRadiusCellSet
          f data.phi u alpha beta a b n m k p j y ->
        RealTheory.le x y ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul c (RealFunction.dist y x))
            (RealFunction.dist (data.phi y) (data.phi x)) := by
    intro x y hxE hyE hxy
    have hxD2 :
        primitiveSubstitutionD2Set f data.phi u alpha beta a b x :=
      hxE.left.left
    have hyD2 :
        primitiveSubstitutionD2Set f data.phi u alpha beta a b y :=
      hyE.left.left
    have hxSource : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta x :=
      RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta x hxD2.left
    have hySource : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta y :=
      RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta y hyD2.left
    have hcontrol :
        primitiveSubstitutionPositiveRadiusControl
          u alpha beta n k x :=
      hxE.left.right.right.right
    have hlower :
        forall z : Point,
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z -> RealTheory.le c (u z) := by
      intro z hz
      have hzSource : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta z :=
        closedInterval_between_mem_source hxSource hySource hz
      have hzCell : PartitionCell p j z :=
        partitionCell_between_mem hxE.right hyE.right hz
      have hdist : RealTheory.lt
          (RealFunction.dist z x)
          (primitiveSubstitutionSignRadius k) :=
        dist_lt_radius_of_same_partitionCell
          hp hj hmesh hzCell hxE.right
      exact hcontrol z hzSource hdist
    have hraw :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub y x))
          (RealTheory.sub (data.sourcePrimitive y)
            (data.sourcePrimitive x)) :=
      data.sourcePrimitive_increment_ge_const_ordered
        hxy hxSource hySource hlower
    have hdom_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub y x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hxy
    have hleft_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
      F.mul_nonneg hc_nonneg hdom_nonneg
    have hcod_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.sub (data.sourcePrimitive y)
            (data.sourcePrimitive x)) :=
      RealTheory.le_trans hleft_nonneg hraw
    have hdom_dist :
        RealFunction.dist y x = RealTheory.sub y x := by
      unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
      exact RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hdom_nonneg
    have hsource_dist :
        RealFunction.dist (data.sourcePrimitive y)
            (data.sourcePrimitive x) =
          RealTheory.sub (data.sourcePrimitive y)
            (data.sourcePrimitive x) := by
      unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
      exact RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hcod_nonneg
    have hphi_dist :
        RealFunction.dist (data.phi y) (data.phi x) =
          RealFunction.dist (data.sourcePrimitive y)
            (data.sourcePrimitive x) :=
      data.phi_dist_eq_sourcePrimitive_dist
    rw [hdom_dist, hphi_dist, hsource_dist]
    exact hraw
  intro x y hxE hyE
  cases F.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact hordered x y hxE hyE hxy
  | inr hyx =>
      rw [RealFunction.dist_comm y x]
      rw [RealFunction.dist_comm (data.phi y) (data.phi x)]
      exact hordered y x hyE hxE hyx

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.negativeRadiusCell_coLipschitz
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.negativeRadiusCell_coLipschitz
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 : Point}
    {N n m k j : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (hp : IntervalPartition alpha beta N p)
    (hj : j < N)
    (hmesh :
      RealTheory.lt (mesh p N)
        (primitiveSubstitutionSignRadius k)) :
    CoLipschitzWithConstantOn
      (primitiveSubstitutionD2NegativeRadiusCellSet
        f data.phi u alpha beta a b n m k p j)
      data.phi
      (substitutionHalfThreshold
        (substitutionDerivativeThreshold n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let c := substitutionHalfThreshold (substitutionDerivativeThreshold n)
  change
    CoLipschitzWithConstantOn
      (primitiveSubstitutionD2NegativeRadiusCellSet
        f data.phi u alpha beta a b n m k p j)
      data.phi c
  have hc_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c := by
    dsimp [c]
    exact halfThreshold_pos (substitutionDerivativeThreshold_pos n)
  have hc_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero c :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hc_pos
  have hordered :
      forall x y : Point,
        primitiveSubstitutionD2NegativeRadiusCellSet
          f data.phi u alpha beta a b n m k p j x ->
        primitiveSubstitutionD2NegativeRadiusCellSet
          f data.phi u alpha beta a b n m k p j y ->
        RealTheory.le x y ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul c (RealFunction.dist y x))
            (RealFunction.dist (data.phi y) (data.phi x)) := by
    intro x y hxE hyE hxy
    have hxD2 :
        primitiveSubstitutionD2Set f data.phi u alpha beta a b x :=
      hxE.left.left
    have hyD2 :
        primitiveSubstitutionD2Set f data.phi u alpha beta a b y :=
      hyE.left.left
    have hxSource : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta x :=
      RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta x hxD2.left
    have hySource : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta y :=
      RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta y hyD2.left
    have hcontrol :
        primitiveSubstitutionNegativeRadiusControl
          u alpha beta n k x :=
      hxE.left.right.right.right
    have hupper :
        forall z : Point,
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
            RealTheory.le (u z) (RealTheory.neg c) := by
      intro z hz
      have hzSource : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta z :=
        closedInterval_between_mem_source hxSource hySource hz
      have hzCell : PartitionCell p j z :=
        partitionCell_between_mem hxE.right hyE.right hz
      have hdist : RealTheory.lt
          (RealFunction.dist z x)
          (primitiveSubstitutionSignRadius k) :=
        dist_lt_radius_of_same_partitionCell
          hp hj hmesh hzCell hxE.right
      exact hcontrol z hzSource hdist
    have hraw :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub y x))
          (RealTheory.sub (data.sourcePrimitive x)
            (data.sourcePrimitive y)) :=
      data.sourcePrimitive_neg_increment_ge_const_ordered
        hxy hxSource hySource hupper
    have hdom_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub y x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hxy
    have hleft_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
      F.mul_nonneg hc_nonneg hdom_nonneg
    have hcod_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.sub (data.sourcePrimitive x)
            (data.sourcePrimitive y)) :=
      RealTheory.le_trans hleft_nonneg hraw
    have hdom_dist :
        RealFunction.dist y x = RealTheory.sub y x := by
      unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
      exact RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hdom_nonneg
    have hsource_dist :
        RealFunction.dist (data.sourcePrimitive x)
            (data.sourcePrimitive y) =
          RealTheory.sub (data.sourcePrimitive x)
            (data.sourcePrimitive y) := by
      unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
      exact RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hcod_nonneg
    have hphi_dist :
        RealFunction.dist (data.phi y) (data.phi x) =
          RealFunction.dist (data.sourcePrimitive y)
            (data.sourcePrimitive x) :=
      data.phi_dist_eq_sourcePrimitive_dist
    rw [hdom_dist, hphi_dist]
    rw [RealFunction.dist_comm (data.sourcePrimitive y)
      (data.sourcePrimitive x)]
    rw [hsource_dist]
    exact hraw
  intro x y hxE hyE
  cases F.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact hordered x y hxE hyE hxy
  | inr hyx =>
      rw [RealFunction.dist_comm y x]
      rw [RealFunction.dist_comm (data.phi y) (data.phi x)]
      exact hordered y x hyE hxE hyx

name: injectiveOn_of_coLipschitzWithConstantOn
statement:
private theorem injectiveOn_of_coLipschitzWithConstantOn
    {E : Point -> Prop} {phi : Point -> Point} {c : Point}
    (hc_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c)
    (hco : CoLipschitzWithConstantOn E phi c) :
    RealFunction.InjectiveOn E phi
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hEq : x = y
  · exact hEq
  · have hyx_ne : Not (y = x) := by
      intro hyx
      exact hEq hyx.symm
    have hdist_pos :
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealFunction.dist y x) :=
      RealFunction.dist_pos_of_ne hyx_ne
    have hmul_pos :
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.mul c (RealFunction.dist y x)) :=
      RealTheory.mul_pos hc_pos hdist_pos
    have hcoxy := hco x y hx hy
    rw [hxy, RealFunction.dist_self] at hcoxy
    have hbad :
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hmul_pos hcoxy
    exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.zero hbad)

    {f phi : Point -> Point} {a b : Point} {E : Point -> Prop}

name: primitiveSubstitutionCellSource_null_of_coLipschitz
statement:
private theorem primitiveSubstitutionCellSource_null_of_coLipschitz
    {f phi : Point -> Point} {a b c : Point} {E : Point -> Prop}
    (hDfNull :
      RealNegligibility.NullSet (substitutionTargetDiscontinuitySet f a b))
    (hbad :
      forall x : Point,
        E x -> substitutionTargetDiscontinuitySet f a b (phi x))
    (hc_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c)
    (hco : CoLipschitzWithConstantOn E phi c) :
    RealNegligibility.NullSet E
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinj : RealFunction.InjectiveOn E phi :=
    injectiveOn_of_coLipschitzWithConstantOn hc_pos hco
  have htargetNull :
      RealNegligibility.NullSet
        (primitiveSubstitutionCellTargetBadSet f phi a b E) :=
    RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
      (fun _ hy => hy.left)
      hDfNull
  have hL_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv c) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hc_pos)
  have hinvLip :
      LipschitzWithConstantOn
        (RealFunction.Image E phi)
        (RealFunction.InverseOn E phi)
        (RealTheory.inv c) :=
    lipschitzWithConstantOn_inverse_of_coLipschitz hc_pos hco
  have himageNull :
      RealNegligibility.NullSet
        (RealFunction.Image
          (primitiveSubstitutionCellTargetBadSet f phi a b E)
          (RealFunction.InverseOn E phi)) :=
    nullSet_image_of_lipschitzWithConstantOn
      htargetNull
      (fun _ hy => hy.right)
      hL_nonneg
      hinvLip
  exact
    RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
      (fun _ ht =>
        primitiveSubstitutionCellSource_subset_inverseImage
          hinj hbad ht)
      himageNull

    unfold primitiveSubstitutionSignRadius

        dsimp [step]

      cases exists_leftTaggedUniformPartition_mesh_lt
          (a := alpha) (b := beta) (step := step)

                    (primitiveSubstitutionSignRadius k) :=
                htag.right

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.substitutionIntegrand_continuousAtOn_zero_derivative
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.substitutionIntegrand_continuousAtOn_zero_derivative
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 t : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (ht : RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta t)
    (hnotDu :
      Not
        (primitiveSubstitutionDerivativeDiscontinuitySet
          u alpha beta t))
    (hzero : u t = RealTheory.zero) :
    RealTheory.FunctionContinuousAtOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
      (substitutionIntegrand f data.phi u) t
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta t :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta t ht
  have huCont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) u t :=
    primitiveSubstitutionContinuousAt_of_not_derivativeDiscontinuity
      ht hnotDu
  cases data.f_integrable with
  | intro _ hI =>
      cases hI.left with
      | intro B hB =>
          let K := RealTheory.add B RealTheory.one
          have hzero_le_one : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one
          have hB_le_K : RealTheory.le B K := by
            have h :=
              RealTheory.add_le_add_left hzero_le_one B
            change F.le (F.add B F.zero) (F.add B F.one) at h
            rwa [F.add_zero] at h
          have hB_lt_K : RealTheory.lt B K := by
            have h :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
                F RealTheory.zero_lt_one B
            change F.lt (F.add B F.zero) (F.add B F.one) at h
            rwa [F.add_zero] at h
          have hKpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero K :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hB.left hB_lt_K
          have huTendstoZero :
              RealFunction.TendstoWithin
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) u t
                RealTheory.zero :=
            RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
              hzero huCont.right
          have hboundTendsto :
              RealFunction.TendstoWithin
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
                (fun x : Point =>
                  RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.abs (u x)))
                t RealTheory.zero :=
            tendstoWithin_pos_const_mul_abs_zero hKpos huTendstoZero
          have hboundEvent :
              RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) t
                (fun x : Point =>
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (substitutionIntegrand f data.phi u x))
                    (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.abs (u x)))) :=
            RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_of_forall
              (fun x hx _ =>
                substitutionIntegrand_abs_le_bounded_target_mul_abs_derivative
                  hB hB_le_K data.maps_closed hx)
          have hlimZero :
              RealFunction.TendstoWithin
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
                (substitutionIntegrand f data.phi u) t RealTheory.zero :=
            RealFunction.tendstoWithin_zero_of_eventually_abs_le
              hboundEvent hboundTendsto
          have hg_t_zero :
              substitutionIntegrand f data.phi u t = RealTheory.zero := by
            unfold substitutionIntegrand
            rw [hzero]
            exact F.mul_zero (f (data.phi t))
          exact And.intro htClosed
            (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
              hg_t_zero.symm hlimZero)

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.substitutionIntegrand_continuousAtOn_good_nonzero
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.substitutionIntegrand_continuousAtOn_good_nonzero
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 t : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (ht : RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta t)
    (hnotDu :
      Not
        (primitiveSubstitutionDerivativeDiscontinuitySet
          u alpha beta t))
    (hne : Not (u t = RealTheory.zero))
    (hnotD2 :
      Not
        (primitiveSubstitutionD2Set f data.phi u alpha beta a b t)) :
    RealTheory.FunctionContinuousAtOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
      (substitutionIntegrand f data.phi u) t
proof:
:= by
  have htClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta t :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta t ht
  have hphiClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (data.phi t) :=
    data.maps_closed t htClosed
  have huCont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) u t :=
    primitiveSubstitutionContinuousAt_of_not_derivativeDiscontinuity
      ht hnotDu
  have hfCont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f (data.phi t) := by
    by_cases hf :
        RealTheory.FunctionContinuousAtOn
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f (data.phi t)
    case pos =>
      exact hf
    case neg =>
      exact False.elim
        (hnotD2
          (And.intro ht
            (And.intro
              (And.intro hphiClosed hf)
              (And.intro hnotDu hne))))
  have hcomp :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
        (RealFunction.CompFun f data.phi) t :=
    RealFunction.continuousAtOn_comp
      (data.phi_continuous t htClosed)
      hfCont
      data.maps_closed
  have hmul :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
        (RealFunction.MulFun (RealFunction.CompFun f data.phi) u) t :=
    RealFunction.continuousAtOn_mul hcomp huCont
  unfold substitutionIntegrand
  change
    RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
      (RealFunction.MulFun (RealFunction.CompFun f data.phi) u) t
  exact hmul

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourceDiscontinuitySet_subset_badContinuitySet
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourceDiscontinuitySet_subset_badContinuitySet
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 t : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (htDg :
      primitiveSubstitutionSourceDiscontinuitySet
        f data.phi u alpha beta t) :
    primitiveSubstitutionSourceBadContinuitySet
      f data.phi u alpha beta a b t
proof:
:= by
  unfold primitiveSubstitutionSourceBadContinuitySet
  unfold primitiveSubstitutionSourceDiscontinuitySet
    ClosedIntervalDiscontinuitySet FunctionDiscontinuousAtOn at htDg
  by_cases hleft : t = alpha
  case pos =>
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hleft))
  case neg =>
    by_cases hright : t = beta
    case pos =>
      exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr hright))
    case neg =>
      have htOpen :
          RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta t :=
        substitution_openInterval_of_closedInterval_not_endpoints
          htDg.left hleft hright
      by_cases hDu :
          primitiveSubstitutionDerivativeDiscontinuitySet
            u alpha beta t
      case pos =>
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl hDu)
      case neg =>
        by_cases hzero : u t = RealTheory.zero
        case pos =>
          have hcont :
              RealTheory.FunctionContinuousAtOn
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
                (substitutionIntegrand f data.phi u) t :=
            data.substitutionIntegrand_continuousAtOn_zero_derivative
              htOpen hDu hzero
          exact False.elim (htDg.right hcont)
        case neg =>
          by_cases hD2 :
              primitiveSubstitutionD2Set
                f data.phi u alpha beta a b t
          case pos =>
            exact Or.inl hD2
          case neg =>
            have hcont :
                RealTheory.FunctionContinuousAtOn
                  (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta)
                  (substitutionIntegrand f data.phi u) t :=
              data.substitutionIntegrand_continuousAtOn_good_nonzero
                htOpen hDu hzero hD2
            exact False.elim (htDg.right hcont)

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.substitutionIntegrand_closedIntervalBounded
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.substitutionIntegrand_closedIntervalBounded
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded
      (substitutionIntegrand f data.phi u) alpha beta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded data.f_integrable
  have hu_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded u alpha beta :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded data.u_integrable
  cases hf_bdd with
  | intro Bf hBf =>
      cases hu_bdd with
      | intro Bu hBu =>
          refine closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le
            (B := RealTheory.mul Bf Bu)
            (RealTheory.mul_nonneg hBf.left hBu.left) ?_
          intro x hx
          have hfx :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.abs (f (data.phi x))) Bf :=
            hBf.right (data.phi x) (data.maps_closed x hx)
          have hux :
              RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (u x)) Bu :=
            hBu.right x hx
          have hleft :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.abs (f (data.phi x)))
                  (RealTheory.abs (u x)))
                (RealTheory.mul Bf (RealTheory.abs (u x))) :=
            RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hfx
              (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (u x))
          have hright :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.mul Bf (RealTheory.abs (u x)))
                (RealTheory.mul Bf Bu) :=
            RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hux hBf.left
          have hmul :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.abs (f (data.phi x)))
                  (RealTheory.abs (u x)))
                (RealTheory.mul Bf Bu) :=
            F.le_trans hleft hright
          have habs_mul :
              RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.mul (f (data.phi x)) (u x)) =
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.abs (f (data.phi x)))
                  (RealTheory.abs (u x)) := by
            unfold RealTheory.mul
            exact RealTheory.abs_mul (f (data.phi x)) (u x)
          unfold substitutionIntegrand
          rw [habs_mul]
          exact hmul

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourceBadContinuitySet_null
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourceBadContinuitySet_null
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 : Point}

        (primitiveSubstitutionDerivativeDiscontinuitySet u alpha beta)
        (substitutionSourceEndpointSet alpha beta)))
    (fun t ht => by
      unfold primitiveSubstitutionSourceBadContinuitySet at ht
      exact ht)
    (RealNegligibility.nullSet_union
      data.d2Set_null

        data.derivativeDiscontinuitySet_null
        (substitutionSourceEndpointSet_null alpha beta)))

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourceDiscontinuitySet_null
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.sourceDiscontinuitySet_null
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 : Point}

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.phi_derivative_eq_zero_of_phi_eq_left_endpoint
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.phi_derivative_eq_zero_of_phi_eq_left_endpoint
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 t : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (ht : RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta t)
    (hnotDu :
      Not
        (primitiveSubstitutionDerivativeDiscontinuitySet
          u alpha beta t))
    (hleft : data.phi t = a) :
    u t = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have huAt :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) u t :=
    primitiveSubstitutionContinuousAt_of_not_derivativeDiscontinuity
      ht hnotDu
  have hmin :
      RealDerivative.LocalMinimumAt
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta) data.phi t := by
    refine And.intro ht ?_
    apply RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_of_forall
    intro y hy _hyne
    have hyClosed :
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta y :=
      RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta y hy
    have hymap : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (data.phi y) :=
      data.maps_closed y hyClosed
    rw [hleft]
    exact hymap.left
  exact
    RealDerivative.fermat_localMinimum
      (RealDerivative.openInterval_leftClusterPoint ht)
      (RealDerivative.openInterval_rightClusterPoint ht)
      hmin (data.phi_hasDerivWithin_at_continuity ht huAt)

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.phi_derivative_eq_zero_of_phi_eq_right_endpoint

    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 t : Point}

      Not
        (primitiveSubstitutionDerivativeDiscontinuitySet

    u t = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have huAt :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) u t :=
    primitiveSubstitutionContinuousAt_of_not_derivativeDiscontinuity
      ht hnotDu
  have hmax :
      RealDerivative.LocalMaximumAt
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta) data.phi t := by
    refine And.intro ht ?_
    apply RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_of_forall
    intro y hy _hyne
    have hyClosed :
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta y :=
      RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta y hy
    have hymap : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (data.phi y) :=
      data.maps_closed y hyClosed
    rw [hright]
    exact hymap.right
  exact
    RealDerivative.fermat_localMaximum
      (RealDerivative.openInterval_leftClusterPoint ht)

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.phi_open_mem_of_u_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.phi_open_mem_of_u_ne_zero
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 t : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (ht : RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta t)
    (hnotDu :
      Not
        (primitiveSubstitutionDerivativeDiscontinuitySet
          u alpha beta t))
    (hne : Not (u t = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (data.phi t)
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta t :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta t ht
  have hclosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (data.phi t) :=
    data.maps_closed t htClosed
  have hnot_left : Not (RealTheory.le (data.phi t) a) := by
    intro hle
    have hEq : data.phi t = a :=
      RealTheory.le_antisymm hle hclosed.left
    exact hne
      (data.phi_derivative_eq_zero_of_phi_eq_left_endpoint
        ht hnotDu hEq)
  have hnot_right : Not (RealTheory.le b (data.phi t)) := by
    intro hle
    have hEq : data.phi t = b :=
      RealTheory.le_antisymm hclosed.right hle
    exact hne
      (data.phi_derivative_eq_zero_of_phi_eq_right_endpoint
        ht hnotDu hEq)
  exact And.intro
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
      C hclosed.left hnot_left)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
      C hclosed.right hnot_right)

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.primitive_comp_hasDerivWithin_zero
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.primitive_comp_hasDerivWithin_zero
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 t : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (ht : RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta t)
    (hnotDu :
      Not
        (primitiveSubstitutionDerivativeDiscontinuitySet
          u alpha beta t))
    (hzero : u t = RealTheory.zero) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
      (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta)
      (RealFunction.CompFun data.primitive data.phi) t
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have huAt :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) u t :=
    primitiveSubstitutionContinuousAt_of_not_derivativeDiscontinuity
      ht hnotDu
  cases data.primitive_lipschitz with
  | intro K hK =>
      have hphi :
          RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
            (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta)
            data.phi t RealTheory.zero := by
        have hraw :=
          data.phi_hasDerivWithin_at_continuity ht huAt
        rwa [hzero] at hraw
      exact
        hasDerivWithin_comp_lipschitz_zero
          hK.left hK.right data.maps_closed ht hphi

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.primitive_comp_hasDerivWithin_good_point
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.primitive_comp_hasDerivWithin_good_point
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 t : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (ht : RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta t)
    (hnotDu :
      Not
        (primitiveSubstitutionDerivativeDiscontinuitySet
          u alpha beta t))
    (hphiOpen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (data.phi t))
    (hfAt :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f (data.phi t)) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
      (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta)
      (RealFunction.CompFun data.primitive data.phi) t
      (substitutionIntegrand f data.phi u t)
proof:
:= by
  let E : RealFunction.Domain :=
    fun y : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta y)
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (data.phi y))
  have huAt :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) u t :=
    primitiveSubstitutionContinuousAt_of_not_derivativeDiscontinuity
      ht hnotDu
  have hlocal :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
        (RealFunction.CompFun data.primitive data.phi) t
        (substitutionIntegrand f data.phi u t) := by
    have hphiLocal :
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E data.phi t (u t) :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
        (fun y hy => hy.left)
        (And.intro ht hphiOpen)
        (data.phi_hasDerivWithin_at_continuity ht huAt)
    have hprim :
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
          (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) data.primitive
          (data.phi t) (f (data.phi t)) :=
      hasDerivWithin_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
        data.f_integrable hfAt hphiOpen
    have hcomp :
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
          (RealFunction.CompFun data.primitive data.phi) t
          (RealTheory.mul (f (data.phi t)) (u t)) :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_comp
        hphiLocal hprim
        (fun y hy _hyne _hneq => hy.right)
    unfold substitutionIntegrand
    exact hcomp
  have htClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta t :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta t ht
  have hphiContOpen :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta) data.phi t := by
    refine And.intro ht ?_
    exact
      RealDerivative.tendstoWithin_of_subset
        (fun y hy =>
          RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval alpha beta y hy)
        (data.phi_continuous t htClosed).right
  have heventOpen :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta) t
        (fun y : Point => RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (data.phi y)) :=
    eventuallyWithin_maps_openInterval_of_continuousAtOn
      hphiContOpen hphiOpen
  have heventLocal :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta) t E := by
    cases heventOpen with
    | intro delta hdelta =>
        refine Exists.intro delta ?_
        refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
        intro y hy hyne hydist
        exact And.intro hy (hdelta.right y hy hyne hydist)
  exact
    hasDerivWithin_of_eventuallyWithin_subset
      (E := RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta)
      (G := E)
      ht hlocal heventLocal

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.primitive_comp_hasDerivWithin_offD2
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.primitive_comp_hasDerivWithin_offD2
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 t : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0)
    (ht : RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta t)
    (hnotDu :
      Not
        (primitiveSubstitutionDerivativeDiscontinuitySet
          u alpha beta t))
    (hnotD2 :
      Not
        (primitiveSubstitutionD2Set f data.phi u alpha beta a b t)) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
      (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta)
      (RealFunction.CompFun data.primitive data.phi) t
      (substitutionIntegrand f data.phi u t)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : u t = RealTheory.zero
  case pos =>
    have hderiv :
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
          (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta)
          (RealFunction.CompFun data.primitive data.phi) t
          RealTheory.zero :=
      data.primitive_comp_hasDerivWithin_zero ht hnotDu hzero
    unfold substitutionIntegrand
    rw [hzero, RealTheory.mul_zero]
    exact hderiv
  case neg =>
    have hphiOpen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b (data.phi t) :=
      data.phi_open_mem_of_u_ne_zero ht hnotDu hzero
    have hnotTarget :
        Not (substitutionTargetDiscontinuitySet f a b (data.phi t)) := by
      intro htarget
      exact hnotD2
        (And.intro ht
          (And.intro htarget
            (And.intro hnotDu hzero)))
    have hphiClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (data.phi t) :=
      RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval
        a b (data.phi t) hphiOpen
    have hfAt :
        RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f (data.phi t) := by
      unfold substitutionTargetDiscontinuitySet
        ClosedIntervalDiscontinuitySet FunctionDiscontinuousAtOn at hnotTarget
      by_cases hcont :
          RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f (data.phi t)
      case pos =>
        exact hcont
      case neg =>
        exact False.elim (hnotTarget (And.intro hphiClosed hcont))
    exact
      data.primitive_comp_hasDerivWithin_good_point
        ht hnotDu hphiOpen hfAt

name: RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.primitive_comp_hasDerivativeRepresentative
statement:
private theorem RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData.primitive_comp_hasDerivativeRepresentative
    {f u : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b phi0 : Point}
    (data :
      RiemannPrimitiveSubstitutionData f u alpha beta a b phi0) :
    HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval alpha beta
      (RealFunction.CompFun data.primitive data.phi)
      (substitutionIntegrand f data.phi u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval
  unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn
  exact
    RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
      (E := fun t : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta t)
          (Not

proof:

name: RiemannC1SubstitutionData.add_sourcePrimitive_eq_phi
statement:
private theorem RiemannC1SubstitutionData.add_sourcePrimitive_eq_phi
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b t : Point}
    (data : RiemannC1SubstitutionData f phi phi' alpha beta a b)
    (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta t) :
    RealTheory.add (phi alpha)
        (closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
          phi' alpha beta data.derivativeIntegrable t) =
      phi t
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let P :=
    closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
      phi' alpha beta data.derivativeIntegrable
  have hprimitive :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral phi' alpha t (P t) := by
    dsimp [P]
    exact
      hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
        data.derivativeIntegrable ht
  have hclosedSubset :
      SetPred.Subset
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha t)
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval alpha beta) := by
    intro x hx
    exact And.intro hx.left (F.le_trans hx.right ht.right)
  have hopenSubset :
      SetPred.Subset
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha t)
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval alpha beta) := by
    intro x hx
    exact And.intro hx.left (F.lt_of_lt_of_le hx.right ht.right)
  have hnewton :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral phi' alpha t
        (RealTheory.sub (phi t) (phi alpha)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      ht.left
      (RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
        hclosedSubset data.derivative_continuous)
      (RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
        hclosedSubset data.phi_continuous)
      (by
        intro x hx
        exact
          RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
            hopenSubset hx (data.phi_derivative x (hopenSubset x hx)))
  have hvalue : P t = RealTheory.sub (phi t) (phi alpha) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique hprimitive hnewton
  change F.add (phi alpha) (P t) = phi t
  rw [hvalue, F.add_comm]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F (phi t) (phi alpha)

    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {alpha beta a b : Point}

proof:

  rw [hvalue] at hsource
  exact And.intro hsource data.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_target_value

name: improperIntegrationByParts_iff
statement:
private theorem improperIntegrationByParts_iff
    {rightIntegrand leftIntegrand endpoint lower upper : Point -> Point}
    {D : Domain} {Tendsto : (Point -> Point) -> Point -> Prop}
    {E J : Point}
    (hleft :
      forall x : Point, D x -> forall K : Point,
        HasOrientedRiemannIntegral rightIntegrand (lower x) (upper x) K ->
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral leftIntegrand (lower x) (upper x)
            (RealTheory.sub (endpoint x) K))
    (hparts :
      forall x : Point, D x ->
        Exists fun K : Point => And
          (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral rightIntegrand (lower x) (upper x) K)
          (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral leftIntegrand (lower x) (upper x)
            (RealTheory.sub (endpoint x) K)))
    (hsub : forall {P : Point -> Point} {I : Point},
      Tendsto P I -> Tendsto (SubFun endpoint P) (RealTheory.sub E I)) :
    Iff
      (Exists fun P : Point -> Point => And
        (forall x : Point, D x ->
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral rightIntegrand (lower x) (upper x) (P x))
        (Tendsto P J))
      (Exists fun Q : Point -> Point => And
        (forall x : Point, D x ->
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral leftIntegrand (lower x) (upper x) (Q x))
        (Tendsto Q (RealTheory.sub E J)))
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · rintro ⟨P, hP⟩
    refine ⟨SubFun endpoint P, ?_, hsub hP.right⟩
    intro x hx
    exact hleft x hx (P x) (hP.left x hx)
  · rintro ⟨Q, hQ⟩
    refine ⟨SubFun endpoint Q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨K, hKright, hKleft⟩ := hparts x hx
      have hvalue : RealTheory.sub (endpoint x) K = Q x :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique hKleft (hQ.left x hx)
      have hcongr := congrArg (fun z : Point => RealTheory.sub (endpoint x) z) hvalue
      change RealTheory.sub (endpoint x) (RealTheory.sub (endpoint x) K) =
        RealTheory.sub (endpoint x) (Q x) at hcongr
      unfold RealTheory.sub at hcongr
      rw [RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub_self_sub] at hcongr
      change K = RealTheory.sub (endpoint x) (Q x) at hcongr
      change HasOrientedRiemannIntegral rightIntegrand (lower x) (upper x)
        (RealTheory.sub (endpoint x) (Q x))
      rw [<- hcongr]
      exact hKright
    · have hlimit := hsub hQ.right
      unfold RealTheory.sub at hlimit
      rw [RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub_self_sub] at hlimit
      exact hlimit

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_negReciprocal_reciprocalSquare
statement:
private theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_negReciprocal_reciprocalSquare :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
      negReciprocal reciprocalSquareKernel
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hraw := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_neg
    RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_inv_positive
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn
        (fun x : Point => F.lt F.zero x)
        (RealFunction.NegFun (fun x : Point => F.inv x))
        negReciprocal := by
    intro x hx
    rfl
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn
        (fun x : Point => F.lt F.zero x)
        (RealFunction.NegFun
          (fun x : Point => F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))))
        reciprocalSquareKernel := by
    intro x hx
    have hxne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
      intro hzero
      exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hzero.symm
    unfold RealFunction.NegFun reciprocalSquareKernel
    change F.neg (F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))) =
      F.inv (F.mul x x)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F]
    exact (F.inv_mul hxne hxne).symm
  exact RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hraw)

name: reciprocalSquareKernel_continuousOn_positive

:= by

  have hinv :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (fun x : Point => F.lt F.zero x)
        (fun x : Point => F.inv x) :=
    RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_inv_positive
  have hmul := RealFunction.continuousOn_mul hinv hinv
  apply RealFunction.continuousOn_congr _ hmul
  intro x hx
  have hxne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hzero.symm
  unfold RealFunction.MulFun reciprocalSquareKernel
  exact (F.inv_mul hxne hxne).symm

proof:

  apply riemannIntegrableOn_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval hab
  exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
