name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reciprocalSquareKernel
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reciprocalSquareKernel
    {a x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral reciprocalSquareKernel a x
      (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.inv a) (RealTheory.inv x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a x
  let G := RealTheory.OpenInterval a x
  have hpositiveClosed :
      forall y : Point, E y -> F.lt F.zero y := by
    intro y hy
    exact F.lt_of_lt_of_le ha hy.left
  have hkernelCont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn E reciprocalSquareKernel :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hpositiveClosed
      reciprocalSquareKernel_continuousOn_positive
  have hprimCont : RealFunction.ContinuousOn E negReciprocal :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hpositiveClosed
      (RealDerivative.continuousOn_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
        hasDerivativeWithinOn_negReciprocal_reciprocalSquare)
  have hprimDeriv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn G
        negReciprocal reciprocalSquareKernel := by
    intro y hy
    have hypos : F.lt F.zero y :=
      F.lt_trans ha hy.left
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
      (fun z hz => F.lt_trans ha hz.left) hy
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_negReciprocal_reciprocalSquare y hypos)
  have hnewton :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_newtonLeibniz_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
      hax hkernelCont hprimCont hprimDeriv
  change HasOrientedRiemannIntegral reciprocalSquareKernel a x
    (F.sub (F.neg (F.inv x)) (F.neg (F.inv a))) at hnewton
  have hvalue :
      F.sub (F.neg (F.inv x)) (F.neg (F.inv a)) =
        F.sub (F.inv a) (F.inv x) := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F]
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F
      (F.inv x) (F.inv a)).symm
  rwa [hvalue] at hnewton

name: tendstoAtPosInf_inv_zero
statement:
private theorem tendstoAtPosInf_inv_zero (a : Point) :
    RealFunction.TendstoAtPosInf
      (RightHalfLine a) (fun x : Point => RealTheory.inv x)
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let threshold := F.inv eps
  have hthresholdPos : F.lt F.zero threshold :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F heps
  refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
  intro x hx hlarge
  have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x := F.lt_trans hthresholdPos hlarge
  have hinvLt : F.lt (F.inv x) (F.inv threshold) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
      F hthresholdPos hxpos hlarge
  have hepsNe : Not (eps = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F heps) hzero.symm
  have hthresholdInv : F.inv threshold = eps := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_inv_of_ne_zero F hepsNe
  rw [hthresholdInv] at hinvLt
  unfold RealFunction.dist
  change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub (F.inv x) F.zero)) eps
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hxpos))]
  exact hinvLt

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_reciprocalSquareKernel
statement:
theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_reciprocalSquareKernel
    {a : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf reciprocalSquareKernel a
      (RealTheory.inv a)
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro (reciprocalSquarePrimitive a) ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx
    unfold reciprocalSquarePrimitive
    exact hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reciprocalSquareKernel ha hx
  · unfold reciprocalSquarePrimitive
    have hsub := RealFunction.tendstoAtPosInf_sub
      (RealFunction.tendstoAtPosInf_const (RightHalfLine a) (RealTheory.inv a))
      (tendstoAtPosInf_inv_zero a)
    unfold RealFunction.SubFun at hsub
    change RealFunction.TendstoAtPosInf (RightHalfLine a)
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.inv a) (RealTheory.inv x))
      (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.inv a) RealTheory.zero) at hsub
    have hvalue :
        RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.inv a) RealTheory.zero =
          RealTheory.inv a := by
      change RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub
        (RealTheory.inv a) RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.zero =
        RealTheory.inv a
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (RealTheory.inv a)
    rw [hvalue] at hsub
    exact hsub

name: tendstoAtPosInf_comp_leftEndpoint
statement:
private theorem tendstoAtPosInf_comp_leftEndpoint
    {P phi : Point -> Point} {a alpha beta I : Point}
    (hP : TendstoAtPosInf (RightHalfLine a) P I)
    (hphi :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithinToPosInf
        (RealFunction.LeftDomain (RightHalfOpenInterval alpha beta) beta)
        phi beta)
    (hmap :
      forall t : Point,
        RightHalfOpenInterval alpha beta t ->
          RightHalfLine a (phi t)) :
    LeftTendstoWithin (RightHalfOpenInterval alpha beta)
      (RealFunction.CompFun P phi) beta I
proof:
:= by
  unfold LeftTendstoWithin
  intro eps heps
  cases hP eps heps with
  | intro threshold hthreshold =>
      cases hphi threshold with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          intro t ht htne htd
          have hphi_large :
              RealTheory.lt threshold (phi t) :=
            hdelta.right t ht htne htd
          have hphi_domain :
              RightHalfLine a (phi t) :=
            hmap t ht.left
          unfold RealFunction.CompFun
          exact hthreshold (phi t) hphi_domain hphi_large

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_substitution_strictIncreasing_atPosInf
statement:
theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_substitution_strictIncreasing_atPosInf
    {f phi phi' : Point -> Point} {a alpha beta I : Point}
    (data :
      ImproperAtPosInfToRightEndpointStrictIncreasingSubstitutionData
        f phi phi' a alpha beta)
    (hI : HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf f a I) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint
      (substitutionIntegrand f phi phi') alpha beta I
proof:
:= by
  cases hI with
  | intro P hP =>
      let Q : Point -> Point := RealFunction.CompFun P phi
      refine Exists.intro Q ?_
      constructor
      case left =>
        intro t ht
        have hphi_domain :
            RightHalfLine a (phi t) :=
          data.maps_target t ht
        have htarget :
            HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a (phi t) (P (phi t)) :=
          hP.left (phi t) hphi_domain
        have htarget_data :
            And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a (phi t))
              (HasDarbouxIntegral f a (phi t) (P (phi t))) :=
          hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
            hphi_domain htarget
        have htarget_raw :
            HasRiemannIntegral f a (phi t) (P (phi t)) :=
          hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
            htarget_data.left htarget_data.right
        have htrunc :
            StrictIncreasingC1SubstitutionData
              f phi phi' alpha t a (phi t) (P (phi t)) :=
          data.truncation_data t (P (phi t)) ht htarget_raw
        have hsubst :=
          hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_substitution_strictIncreasing
            htrunc
        exact hsubst.left
      case right =>
        exact
          tendstoAtPosInf_comp_leftEndpoint
            hP.right data.phi_tendsto_posInf data.maps_target

name: differenceQuotient_abs_mul_abs_sub_eq_abs_sub
statement:
private theorem differenceQuotient_abs_mul_abs_sub_eq_abs_sub
    {F : Point -> Point} {x y : Point}
    (hyx : Not (y = x)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.abs (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y))
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)) =
      RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hden : Not (C.sub y x = C.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact hyx (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero C hzero)
  have hprod :
      C.mul (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y) (C.sub y x) =
        C.sub (F y) (F x) := by
    unfold RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient
    calc
      C.mul (C.mul (C.sub (F y) (F x)) (C.inv (C.sub y x)))
          (C.sub y x) =
          C.mul (C.sub (F y) (F x))
            (C.mul (C.inv (C.sub y x)) (C.sub y x)) := by
            rw [C.mul_assoc]
      _ = C.mul (C.sub (F y) (F x)) C.one := by
            rw [C.inv_mul_cancel hden]
      _ = C.sub (F y) (F x) := by
            rw [C.mul_one]
  change
    C.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C
          (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub y x)) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub (F y) (F x))
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul C
    (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y) (C.sub y x)]
  rw [hprod]

name: exists_local_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_abs_sub_of_hasDerivWithin_zero
statement:
theorem exists_local_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_abs_sub_of_hasDerivWithin_zero
    {E : RealFunction.Domain} {F : Point -> Point} {x eta : Point}
    (hF : RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E F x RealTheory.zero)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall y : Point,
            E y ->
              Not (y = x) ->
                RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) delta ->
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)))
                    (RealTheory.mul eta
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hF.right eta heta with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro y hy hyx hydist
      have hclose := hdelta.right y hy hyx hydist
      change
        C.lt
          (RealFunction.dist
            (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y) C.zero)
          eta at hclose
      unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hclose
      change
        C.lt
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C
            (C.sub (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y) C.zero))
          eta at hclose
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero C
        (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y)] at hclose
      have hquot_le :
          C.le
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C
              (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y)) eta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hclose
      have hdx_nonneg :
          C.le C.zero (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
        RealTheory.abs_nonneg (RealTheory.sub y x)
      have hmul :
          C.le
            (C.mul
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C
                (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y))
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))
            (C.mul eta (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x))) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
          C hquot_le hdx_nonneg
      have hprod :=
        differenceQuotient_abs_mul_abs_sub_eq_abs_sub
          (F := F) (x := x) (y := y) hyx
      change
        C.mul
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C
              (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y))
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub y x)) =
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub (F y) (F x)) at hprod
      change
        C.le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub (F y) (F x)))
          (C.mul eta (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub y x)))
      change
        C.le
          (C.mul
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C
              (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y))
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub y x)))
          (C.mul eta (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub y x))) at hmul
      rwa [hprod] at hmul

name: exists_local_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_abs_sub_of_not_zeroDerivativeExceptionalSet
statement:
private theorem exists_local_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_abs_sub_of_not_zeroDerivativeExceptionalSet
    {a b : Point} {F : Point -> Point} {x eta : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x)
    (hgood : Not (ZeroDerivativeExceptionalSet a b F x))
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall y : Point,
            RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y ->
              Not (y = x) ->
                RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) delta ->
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)))
                    (RealTheory.mul eta
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hderiv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) F x RealTheory.zero := by
    by_cases h :
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
          (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) F x RealTheory.zero
    · exact h
    · exact False.elim (hgood (And.intro hx h))
  exact
    exists_local_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_abs_sub_of_hasDerivWithin_zero
      hderiv heta

name: dist_le_intervalLength_of_mem_openInterval
statement:
private theorem dist_le_intervalLength_of_mem_openInterval
    {l r x y : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval l r x)
    (hy : RealTheory.OpenInterval l r y) :
    RealTheory.le (RealFunction.dist y x)
      (RealNegligibility.intervalLength l r)
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  unfold RealNegligibility.intervalLength
  change
    C.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub y x)) (C.sub r l)
  cases C.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      have hnonneg : C.le C.zero (C.sub y x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hxy
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg C hnonneg]
      exact
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
          C (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hy.right)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hx.left)
  | inr hyx =>
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm C y x]
      have hnonneg : C.le C.zero (C.sub x y) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hyx
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg C hnonneg]
      exact
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
          C (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hx.right)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hy.left)

name: lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_abs_sub_le_mul_intervalLength_of_mem_openInterval
statement:
theorem lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_abs_sub_le_mul_intervalLength_of_mem_openInterval
    {F : Point -> Point} {a b K l r x y : Point}
    (hKnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K)
    (hLip : LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval F a b K)
    (hxClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hyClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y)
    (hxCover : RealTheory.OpenInterval l r x)
    (hyCover : RealTheory.OpenInterval l r y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)))
      (RealTheory.mul K (RealNegligibility.intervalLength l r))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hLipxy := hLip x y hxClosed hyClosed
  change
    C.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub (F y) (F x)))
      (C.mul K (RealNegligibility.intervalLength l r))
  change
    C.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub (F y) (F x)))
      (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x)) at hLipxy
  have hdist :
      C.le (RealFunction.dist y x) (RealNegligibility.intervalLength l r) :=
    dist_le_intervalLength_of_mem_openInterval hxCover hyCover
  have hmul :
      C.le (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist y x))
        (C.mul K (RealNegligibility.intervalLength l r)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left C hdist hKnonneg
  exact C.le_trans hLipxy hmul

name: zeroDerivativeGoodGaugeRadius_control
statement:
private theorem zeroDerivativeGoodGaugeRadius_control
    {a b eta : Point} {F : Point -> Point}

name: zeroDerivativeSQLiuGauge_closedIntervalGaugeOn
statement:
private theorem zeroDerivativeSQLiuGauge_closedIntervalGaugeOn
    {a b eta rho : Point} {F : Point -> Point}
    {badLeft badRight : Nat -> Point}
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hrho : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rho)
    (hcover :
      RealNegligibility.CountableOpenIntervalCover
        (ZeroDerivativeExceptionalSet a b F) badLeft badRight) :
    ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b
      (zeroDerivativeSQLiuGauge
        a b F eta rho badLeft badRight heta)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x _hxClosed
  unfold zeroDerivativeSQLiuGauge
  by_cases hxa : x = a
  · simp [hxa]
    exact hrho
  · simp [hxa]
    by_cases hxb : x = b
    · simp [hxb]
      exact hrho
    · simp [hxb]
      by_cases hxBad : ZeroDerivativeExceptionalSet a b F x
      · simp [hxBad]
        exact zeroDerivativeBadRadius_pos hcover hxBad
      · simp [hxBad]
        by_cases hxOpen : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x
        · simp [hxOpen]
          exact
            zeroDerivativeGoodGaugeRadius_pos
              (a := a) (b := b) (F := F) (eta := eta)
              heta ⟨x, And.intro hxOpen hxBad⟩
        · simp [hxOpen]
          exact hrho

private theorem closedInterval_openInterval_of_ne_endpoints

    RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x

  have hright_not : Not (RealTheory.le b x) := by
    intro hle
    exact hxb (C.le_antisymm hx.right hle)
  exact And.intro
    ((RealTheory.lt_def).mpr (And.intro hx.left hleft_not))
    ((RealTheory.lt_def).mpr (And.intro hx.right hright_not))

statement:
private theorem zeroDerivative_goodCell_control_inputs
    {a b eta rho : Point} {F : Point -> Point}
    {badLeft badRight : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
        (zeroDerivativeSQLiuGauge
          a b F eta rho badLeft badRight heta))
    (hk : k < n)
    (hkind :
      zeroDerivativeCellKind a b F badLeft badRight tag k =
        ZeroDerivativeCellKind.good)
    {y : Point}
    (hycell : PartitionCell p k y) :
    And
      (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b y)
      (RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y (tag k))
        (zeroDerivativeGoodGaugeRadius heta
          ⟨tag k,
            zeroDerivativeCellKind_good_goodPoint
              (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_taggedPartition hfine)
              hk hkind⟩))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let i : ZeroDerivativeGoodPointIndex a b F :=
    ⟨tag k,
      zeroDerivativeCellKind_good_goodPoint
        (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_taggedPartition hfine) hk hkind⟩
  have hgood : ZeroDerivativeGoodPoint a b F (tag k) := i.property
  have hnotEndpoint :
      Not (ZeroDerivativeEndpointTag a b tag k) :=
    zeroDerivativeCellKind_good_not_endpoint hkind
  have hnot_a : Not (tag k = a) := by
    intro h
    exact hnotEndpoint (Or.inl h)
  have hnot_b : Not (tag k = b) := by
    intro h
    exact hnotEndpoint (Or.inr h)
  have hi_eq :
      (⟨tag k, And.intro hgood.left hgood.right⟩ :
        ZeroDerivativeGoodPointIndex a b F) = i := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  have hgauge_eq :
      zeroDerivativeSQLiuGauge
          a b F eta rho badLeft badRight heta (tag k) =
        zeroDerivativeGoodGaugeRadius heta i := by
    unfold zeroDerivativeSQLiuGauge
    simp [hnot_a, hnot_b, hgood.left, hgood.right, hi_eq]
  have hdist :
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y (tag k))
        (zeroDerivativeGoodGaugeRadius heta i) := by
    have hfineCell := gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cell_fine hfine hk
    have hdistGauge := hfineCell y hycell
    rwa [hgauge_eq] at hdistGauge
  exact And.intro
    (zeroDerivativeGoodGaugeRadius_mem_openInterval_of_dist_lt
      heta i hdist)
    hdist

name: zeroDerivative_badCell_subset_selectedCover

private theorem zeroDerivative_badCell_subset_selectedCover

proof:
:= by

name: partitionCell_endpoint_dist_add_eq_cellLength
statement:
private theorem partitionCell_endpoint_dist_add_eq_cellLength
    {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat} {x : Point}
    (hx : PartitionCell p k x) :
    RealTheory.add
      (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) x)
      (RealFunction.dist (p k) x) =
        cellLength p k
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hright_nonneg :
      C.le C.zero (C.sub (p (k + 1)) x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hx.right
  have hleft_nonneg :
      C.le C.zero (C.sub x (p k)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hx.left
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist cellLength
  change
    C.add
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub (p (k + 1)) x))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub (p k) x)) =
        C.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg C hright_nonneg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm C (p k) x]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg C hleft_nonneg]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel C (p (k + 1)) x (p k)

name: zeroDerivative_goodCell_endpoint_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_dist
statement:
private theorem zeroDerivative_goodCell_endpoint_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_dist
    {a b eta rho : Point} {F : Point -> Point}
    {badLeft badRight : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
        (zeroDerivativeSQLiuGauge
          a b F eta rho badLeft badRight heta))
    (hk : k < n)
    (hkind :
      zeroDerivativeCellKind a b F badLeft badRight tag k =
        ZeroDerivativeCellKind.good)
    {y : Point}
    (hycell : PartitionCell p k y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F (tag k))))
      (RealTheory.mul eta (RealFunction.dist y (tag k)))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinputs :=
    zeroDerivative_goodCell_control_inputs
      (a := a) (b := b) (eta := eta) (rho := rho)
      (F := F) (badLeft := badLeft) (badRight := badRight)
      (n := n) (k := k) (p := p) (tag := tag)
      heta hfine hk hkind hycell
  by_cases hytag : y = tag k
  · rw [hytag]
    change
      C.le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C
          (C.sub (F (tag k)) (F (tag k))))
        (C.mul eta (RealFunction.dist (tag k) (tag k)))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_self C (F (tag k))]
    rw [RealFunction.dist_self]
    change C.le C.zero (C.mul eta C.zero)
    rw [C.mul_zero]
    exact C.le_refl C.zero
  · let i : ZeroDerivativeGoodPointIndex a b F :=
      ⟨tag k,
        zeroDerivativeCellKind_good_goodPoint
          (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_taggedPartition hfine) hk hkind⟩
    have hcontrol :=
      zeroDerivativeGoodGaugeRadius_control
        (a := a) (b := b) (eta := eta) (F := F)
        heta i y hinputs.left hytag hinputs.right
    change
      C.le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C (C.sub (F y) (F (tag k))))
        (C.mul eta (RealFunction.dist y (tag k)))
    exact hcontrol

name: zeroDerivative_goodCell_abs_increment_le_eta_mul_cellLength
statement:
private theorem zeroDerivative_goodCell_abs_increment_le_eta_mul_cellLength
    {a b eta rho : Point} {F : Point -> Point}
    {badLeft badRight : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
        (zeroDerivativeSQLiuGauge
          a b F eta rho badLeft badRight heta))
    (hk : k < n)
    (hkind :
      zeroDerivativeCellKind a b F badLeft badRight tag k =
        ZeroDerivativeCellKind.good) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (F (p (k + 1))) (F (p k))))
      (RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htagCell :
      PartitionCell p k (tag k) :=
    gaugeFineTaggedPartition_tag_mem_cell hfine hk
  have hleftCell :
      PartitionCell p k (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_left_mem
      (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_taggedPartition hfine).left hk
  have hrightCell :
      PartitionCell p k (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_right_mem
      (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_taggedPartition hfine).left hk
  have hright :=
    zeroDerivative_goodCell_endpoint_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_dist
      (a := a) (b := b) (eta := eta) (rho := rho)
      (F := F) (badLeft := badLeft) (badRight := badRight)
      (n := n) (k := k) (p := p) (tag := tag)
      heta hfine hk hkind hrightCell
  have hleft :=
    zeroDerivative_goodCell_endpoint_abs_sub_le_eta_mul_dist
      (a := a) (b := b) (eta := eta) (rho := rho)
      (F := F) (badLeft := badLeft) (badRight := badRight)
      (n := n) (k := k) (p := p) (tag := tag)
      heta hfine hk hkind hleftCell
  have htri :
      C.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub (F (p (k + 1))) (F (p k))))
        (C.add
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub (F (p (k + 1))) (F (tag k))))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub (F (p k)) (F (tag k))))) := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs C
        (C.sub (F (p (k + 1))) (F (tag k)))
        (C.sub (F (tag k)) (F (p k)))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
      C (F (p (k + 1))) (F (tag k)) (F (p k))] at h
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm C (F (tag k)) (F (p k))] at h
    exact h
  have hlegs :
      C.le
        (C.add
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub (F (p (k + 1))) (F (tag k))))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub (F (p k)) (F (tag k)))))
        (C.add
          (C.mul eta (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (tag k)))
          (C.mul eta (RealFunction.dist (p k) (tag k)))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add C hright hleft
  have htotal :
      C.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub (F (p (k + 1))) (F (p k))))
        (C.add
          (C.mul eta (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (tag k)))
          (C.mul eta (RealFunction.dist (p k) (tag k)))) :=
    C.le_trans htri hlegs
  have hdist_sum :
      C.add
          (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (tag k))
          (RealFunction.dist (p k) (tag k)) =
        cellLength p k :=
    partitionCell_endpoint_dist_add_eq_cellLength htagCell
  have hmul_sum :
      C.add
          (C.mul eta (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (tag k)))
          (C.mul eta (RealFunction.dist (p k) (tag k))) =
        C.mul eta (cellLength p k) := by
    rw [<- C.mul_add]
    rw [hdist_sum]
  rwa [hmul_sum] at htotal

name: lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_abs_cellIncrement_le_mul_cellLength
statement:
private theorem lipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval_abs_cellIncrement_le_mul_cellLength
    {a b K : Point} {F : Point -> Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hKnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K)
    (hLip : LipschitzWithConstantOnClosedInterval F a b K)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (F (p (k + 1))) (F (p k))))
      (RealTheory.mul K (cellLength p k))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleftCell :
      PartitionCell p k (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hp hk
  have hrightCell :
      PartitionCell p k (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_right_mem hp hk
  have hleftClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left hp hk
  have hrightClosed :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right hp hk
  have hLipCell := hLip (p k) (p (k + 1)) hleftClosed hrightClosed
  change
    C.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (F (p (k + 1))) (F (p k))))
      (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (p k))) at hLipCell
  have hdist :
      C.le (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (p k))
        (cellLength p k) :=
    dist_le_cellLength_of_partitionCell hrightCell hleftCell
  have hmul :
      C.le (C.mul K (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (p k)))
        (C.mul K (cellLength p k)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left C hdist hKnonneg
  exact C.le_trans hLipCell hmul

name: intervalListLength_zeroDerivativeBadCellIndices_eq_finiteSum
statement:
private theorem intervalListLength_zeroDerivativeBadCellIndices_eq_finiteSum
    {a b : Point} {F : Point -> Point}
    {badLeft badRight : Nat -> Point} {p tag : Nat -> Point} :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealInterval.intervalListLength
          (fun k : Nat => p k)
          (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1))
          (zeroDerivativeBadCellIndices a b F badLeft badRight tag n) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            zeroDerivativeBadCellLengthTerm
              a b F badLeft badRight p tag k)
          n
  | 0 => by
      unfold zeroDerivativeBadCellIndices
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      classical
      rw [zeroDerivativeBadCellIndices_succ (a := a) (b := b) (F := F)
        (badLeft := badLeft) (badRight := badRight) (tag := tag) n]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      by_cases hkind :
          zeroDerivativeCellKind a b F badLeft badRight tag n =
            ZeroDerivativeCellKind.bad
      · rw [dif_pos hkind]
        rw [RealInterval.intervalListLength_append]
        rw [intervalListLength_zeroDerivativeBadCellIndices_eq_finiteSum
          (a := a) (b := b) (F := F)
          (badLeft := badLeft) (badRight := badRight)
          (p := p) (tag := tag) n]
        rw [show
          RealInterval.intervalListLength
              (fun k : Nat => p k)
              (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) [n] =
            cellLength p n by
              unfold RealInterval.intervalListLength
              unfold RealInterval.IntervalLengthAt
              unfold cellLength
              rw [show
                RealInterval.intervalListLength
                    (fun k : Nat => p k)
                    (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) [] =
                  RealTheory.zero from rfl]
              rw [RealTheory.add_zero]]
        unfold zeroDerivativeBadCellLengthTerm
        simp [hkind, cellLength]
      · rw [dif_neg hkind]
        rw [intervalListLength_zeroDerivativeBadCellIndices_eq_finiteSum
          (a := a) (b := b) (F := F)
          (badLeft := badLeft) (badRight := badRight)
          (p := p) (tag := tag) n]
        unfold zeroDerivativeBadCellLengthTerm
        simp [hkind]
        rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

name: intervalPartition_openCell_disjoint_of_lt
statement:
private theorem intervalPartition_openCell_disjoint_of_lt
    {a b : Point} {n i j : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hij : i < j)
    (hj : j < n) :
    SetPred.Disjoint
      (RealInterval.IntervalAt
        (fun k : Nat => p k) (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) i)
      (RealInterval.IntervalAt
        (fun k : Nat => p k) (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) j)
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro x hxi hxj
  have hi_succ_le_j : i + 1 <= j := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hij
  have hp_right_le_left :
      RealTheory.le (p (i + 1)) (p j) :=
    intervalPartition_le_of_le hp (i + 1) j hi_succ_le_j

private theorem intervalPartition_intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_of_mem_lt
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    forall xs : List Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, List.Mem k xs -> k < n) ->
        List.Nodup xs ->
          RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
            (fun k : Nat => p k)
            (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) xs
  | [], _hmem, _hnodup => by
      unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
      exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | head :: tail, hmem, hnodup => by
      have hhead_lt : head < n
proof:
:=
        hmem head (List.Mem.head tail)
      have htail_mem :
          forall k : Nat, List.Mem k tail -> k < n := by
        intro k hk
        exact hmem k (List.Mem.tail head hk)
      have hnot_mem : Not (List.Mem head tail) :=
        (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).left
      have htail_nodup : List.Nodup tail :=
        (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).right
      have htail_pair :
          RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
            (fun k : Nat => p k)
            (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) tail :=
        intervalPartition_intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_of_mem_lt
          hp tail htail_mem htail_nodup
      unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
      apply List.Pairwise.cons
      · intro y hy
        have hy_lt : y < n := htail_mem y hy
        have hne : Not (head = y) := by
          intro h
          exact hnot_mem (by rw [h]; exact hy)
        exact intervalPartition_openCell_disjoint_of_ne
          hp hhead_lt hy_lt hne
      · unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint at htail_pair
        exact htail_pair

          (center := center) (tag := tag) htag]

          (center := center) (p := p) (tag := tag) n]

              (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) [n] =
            cellLength p n by

      · rw [zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellIndices_succ_of_not_tag
          (center := center) (tag := tag) htag]
        rw [intervalListLength_zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellIndices_eq_finiteSum
          (center := center) (p := p) (tag := tag) n]
        unfold zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm

name: zeroDerivativeEndpointCellLengthTerm_le_endpointTaggedCellLengthTerms
statement:
private theorem zeroDerivativeEndpointCellLengthTerm_le_endpointTaggedCellLengthTerms
    {a b : Point} {F : Point -> Point}
    {badLeft badRight : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (zeroDerivativeEndpointCellLengthTerm a b F badLeft badRight p tag k)
      (RealTheory.add
        (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm a p tag k)
        (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm b p tag k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hkind :
      zeroDerivativeCellKind a b F badLeft badRight tag k =
        ZeroDerivativeCellKind.endpoint
  · have hEndpoint : ZeroDerivativeEndpointTag a b tag k :=
      zeroDerivativeCellKind_endpoint_cases hkind
    cases hEndpoint with
    | inl htag_a =>
        have hright_nonneg :
            RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
              (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm b p tag k) :=
          zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm_nonnegative
            (a := a) (b := b) (center := b)
            (n := n) (k := k) (p := p) (tag := tag) hp hk
        have hle :=
          RealTheory.add_le_add_left hright_nonneg (cellLength p k)
        rw [RealTheory.add_zero] at hle
        simpa [zeroDerivativeEndpointCellLengthTerm,
          zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm, hkind, htag_a]
          using hle
    | inr htag_b =>
        have hleft_nonneg :
            RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
              (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm a p tag k) :=
          zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm_nonnegative
            (a := a) (b := b) (center := a)
            (n := n) (k := k) (p := p) (tag := tag) hp hk
        have hle :=
          RealTheory.add_le_add_right hleft_nonneg (cellLength p k)
        rw [RealTheory.zero_add] at hle
        simpa [zeroDerivativeEndpointCellLengthTerm,
          zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm, hkind, htag_b]
          using hle
  · have hleft_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm a p tag k) :=
      zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm_nonnegative
        (a := a) (b := b) (center := a)
        (n := n) (k := k) (p := p) (tag := tag) hp hk
    have hright_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm b p tag k) :=
      zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm_nonnegative
        (a := a) (b := b) (center := b)
        (n := n) (k := k) (p := p) (tag := tag) hp hk
    have hsum_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)
          (RealTheory.add
            (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm a p tag k)
            (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm b p tag k)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add C hleft_nonneg hright_nonneg
    rw [RealTheory.zero_add] at hsum_nonneg
    simpa [zeroDerivativeEndpointCellLengthTerm, hkind] using hsum_nonneg

:= by

proof:
:= by

  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let coeff := RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.nat 4)
  have hcoeff_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero coeff := by
    dsimp [coeff]

  cases exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
      (C := coeff) (eps := eps) hcoeff_nonneg heps with
  | intro rho hrho =>
      refine Exists.intro rho ?_
      refine And.intro hrho.left ?_
      have hlt := hrho.right
      dsimp [coeff] at hlt
      rw [zeroDerivativeEndpointBufferLengthSum_eq_four_mul_radius]

        C.lt
          (C.mul K (C.mul (RealTheory.nat 4) rho)) eps

name: zeroDerivative_leftEndpointTaggedCellLengthSum_le_bufferLength
statement:
private theorem zeroDerivative_leftEndpointTaggedCellLengthSum_le_bufferLength
    {a b eta rho : Point} {F : Point -> Point}
    {badLeft badRight : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hrho : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rho)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
        (zeroDerivativeSQLiuGauge
          a b F eta rho badLeft badRight heta)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellLengthTerm a p tag k)
        n)
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.add a rho)
        (RealTheory.sub a rho))
proof:
:= by
  have htagged : TaggedPartition a b n p tag :=
    gaugeFineTaggedPartition_taggedPartition hfine
  have hsourceOrdered :
      RealInterval.IntervalListOrdered
        (fun k : Nat => p k)
        (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1))
        (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellIndices a tag n) := by
    intro k hmem
    exact intervalPartition_step_le htagged.left
      (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellIndices_mem_lt hmem)
  have hsourceFinite :
      RealInterval.FiniteDisjointSubfamily
        (fun k : Nat => p k)
        (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1))
        (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellIndices a tag n) := by
    have hnodup :
        List.Nodup (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellIndices a tag n) :=
      zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellIndices_nodup
    exact And.intro hnodup
      (intervalPartition_intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_of_mem_lt
        htagged.left
        (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellIndices a tag n)
        (fun k hmem => zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellIndices_mem_lt hmem)
        hnodup)
  have hcoverOpen :
      RealInterval.IntervalListOpen
        (fun _j : Nat => RealTheory.sub a rho)
        (fun _j : Nat => RealTheory.add a rho) [0] := by
    intro j hj
    cases hj with
    | head =>
        exact zeroDerivative_endpointBuffer_open (center := a) hrho
    | tail _ hjtail =>
        cases hjtail
  have hcontained :
      RealInterval.ClosedIntervalListContainedByList
        (fun k : Nat => p k)
        (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1))
        (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellIndices a tag n)
        (fun _j : Nat => RealTheory.sub a rho)
        (fun _j : Nat => RealTheory.add a rho) [0] := by
    intro k hmem
    refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
    exact And.intro (List.Mem.head [])
      (zeroDerivative_leftEndpointTaggedCell_closedContained
        (a := a) (b := b) (eta := eta) (rho := rho) (F := F)
        (badLeft := badLeft) (badRight := badRight)
        (n := n) (k := k) (p := p) (tag := tag)
        heta hfine hmem)
  have hhyp :
      RealInterval.ClosedIntervalListContainmentLengthHypotheses
        (fun k : Nat => p k)
        (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1))
        (zeroDerivativeEndpointTaggedCellIndices a tag n)
        (fun _j : Nat => RealTheory.sub a rho)

        | intro eta heta =>
            cases exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
                (C := K) (eps := e4) hK.left he4_pos with
            | intro beta hbeta =>
                cases hnull beta hbeta.left with
                | intro badLeft hbadLeft =>
                    cases hbadLeft with

                        cases exists_pos_rho_mul_zeroDerivativeEndpointBufferLengthSum_lt
                            (a := a) (b := b) (K := K) (eps := e4)
                            hK.left he4_pos with
                        | intro rho hrho =>
                            cases exists_zeroDerivativeSQLiuGaugeFineTaggedPartition

                                (rho := rho) (F := F)
                                (badLeft := badLeft)
                                (badRight := badRight)
                                hab heta.left hrho.left hbad.left with
                            | intro n hn =>
                                cases hn with
                                | intro p hp =>
                                    cases hp with
                                    | intro tag hfine =>
                                        have hbound :
                                            RealTheory.le
                                              (RealTheory.abs
                                                (RealTheory.sub (F b) (F a)))
                                              (RealTheory.add
                                                (RealTheory.mul eta
                                                  (RealTheory.sub b a))
                                                (RealTheory.add
                                                  (RealTheory.mul K beta)
                                                  (RealTheory.mul K
                                                    (zeroDerivativeEndpointBufferLengthSum
                                                      a b rho)))) :=
                                          zeroDerivative_partitionEndpointOscillation_le
                                            (a := a) (b := b) (eta := eta)
                                            (rho := rho) (K := K)
                                            (beta := beta) (F := F)
                                            (badLeft := badLeft)

                                                (RealTheory.add
                                                  (RealTheory.mul K beta)

  have hHLip : LipschitzOnClosedInterval H a b := by
    dsimp [H]
    exact lipschitzOnClosedInterval_sub hFLip hGLip
  have hGderiv :
      HasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b G g := by
    dsimp [G]
    exact
      hasDerivativeRepresentativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
        (g := g) (a := a) (b := b) hI
  have hHzero :
      HasZeroDerivativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval a b H := by
    dsimp [H]
    exact
      hasZeroDerivativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_sub_of_same_representative
        hFderiv hGderiv
  have hH_eq : H b = H a :=
    RiemannInternal.eq_endpoint_of_lipschitzOnClosedInterval_hasZeroDerivativeAlmostEverywhereOnOpenInterval_ordered
      (a := a) (b := b) (F := H) hab hHLip hHzero
  have haClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab
  have hGaI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral g a a (G a) := by
    dsimp [G]

      hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
        (f := g) (a := a) (b := b) (x := a) hI haClosed
  have hGa_zero : G a = RealTheory.zero :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate hGaI
  change C.sub (F b) (G b) = C.sub (F a) (G a) at hH_eq
  change G a = C.zero at hGa_zero
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.value_sub_left_of_eq_add C
  calc
    F b = C.add (C.sub (F b) (G b)) (G b) := by
      exact Eq.symm
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel C (F b) (G b))
    _ = C.add (C.sub (F a) (G a)) (G b) := by rw [hH_eq]
    _ = C.add (F a) (G b) := by
      rw [hGa_zero, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero C (F a)]

name: continuousOn_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
statement:
theorem continuousOn_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive f a b hf)
proof:
:= by
  let G := closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive f a b hf
  have hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval hab hf
  cases hbdd with
  | intro M hM =>
      intro x hx
      refine And.intro hx ?_
      intro eps heps
      let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let D := C.add M C.one
      let delta := C.mul eps (C.inv D)
      have hM_nonneg : C.le C.zero M := hM.left
      have hM_lt_D : C.lt M D := by
        unfold D
        have h :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
            C (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one C) M
        rwa [C.add_zero] at h
      have hD_pos : C.lt C.zero D :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hM_nonneg hM_lt_D
      have hD_ne : Not (D = C.zero) := by
        intro hD
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt C hD_pos hD.symm
      have hdelta_pos : C.lt C.zero delta := by
        unfold delta
        exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos C heps
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos C hD_pos)
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta_pos ?_
      intro y hy _hyne hdist
      have hFx :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a x (G x) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
          (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (x := x) hf hx
      have hFy :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y (G y) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
          (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (x := y) hf hy
      have hM_forward :
          forall z : Point,
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
              RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M := by
        intro z hz
        exact hM.right z
          (And.intro
            (RealTheory.le_trans hx.left hz.left)
            (RealTheory.le_trans hz.right hy.right))
      have hM_reverse :
          forall z : Point,
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval y x z ->
              RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M := by
        intro z hz
        exact hM.right z
          (And.intro
            (RealTheory.le_trans hy.left hz.left)
            (RealTheory.le_trans hz.right hx.right))
      have hbound :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (G y) (G x)))
            (RealTheory.mul M
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x))) :=
        orientedEndpoint_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub_base_right
          (f := f) (F := G) (a := a) (x := x) (y := y) (M := M)
          hx.left hy.left hFx hFy hM_forward hM_reverse
      have habs_lt_delta :
          C.lt (RealTheory.abs (C.sub y x)) delta := by
        unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hdist
        exact hdist
      have hmul_le :
          C.le
            (C.mul M (RealTheory.abs (C.sub y x)))
            (C.mul M delta) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
          C (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C habs_lt_delta) hM_nonneg
      have hMdelta_lt_Ddelta :
          C.lt (C.mul M delta) (C.mul D delta) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right C hM_lt_D hdelta_pos
      have hDdelta_eq : C.mul D delta = eps := by
        calc
          C.mul D delta =
              C.mul D (C.mul eps (C.inv D)) := by rfl
          _ = C.mul eps (C.mul D (C.inv D)) := by
              rw [<- C.mul_assoc]
              rw [C.mul_comm D eps]
              rw [C.mul_assoc]
          _ = C.mul eps C.one := by
              rw [C.mul_inv_cancel hD_ne]
          _ = eps := by rw [C.mul_one]
      have hmul_lt_eps :
          C.lt
            (C.mul M (RealTheory.abs (C.sub y x))) eps := by
        have hMdelta_lt_eps :
            C.lt (C.mul M delta) eps := by
          rwa [hDdelta_eq] at hMdelta_lt_Ddelta
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hmul_le hMdelta_lt_eps
      unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
      change
        C.lt
          (RealTheory.abs
            (C.sub (G y) (G x)))
          eps
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hbound hmul_lt_eps

name: closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive_right_eq_sub_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
private theorem closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive_right_eq_sub_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn
    {f F : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hFcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F)
    (hFderiv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) F f) :
    closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive f a b hf b =
      RealTheory.sub (F b) (F a)
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let G := closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive f a b hf
  let H := RealFunction.SubFun F G
  have haClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab
  have hbClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    And.intro hab (RealTheory.le_refl b)
  have hGcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) G :=
    continuousOn_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) hab hf
  have hHcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) H :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_sub hFcont hGcont
  have hGderiv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) G f := by
    intro x hx
    exact
      hasDerivWithin_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
        (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (x := x) hf hx
  have hHderiv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) H (RealFunction.SubFun f f) :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_sub hFderiv hGderiv
  have hHdiff : RealDerivative.DifferentiableOnOpenInterval a b H := by
    intro x hx
    exact Exists.intro (RealFunction.SubFun f f x) (hHderiv x hx)
  have hH_nonneg :
      RealDerivative.DerivativeNonnegativeOnOpenInterval a b H := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hA_eq : A = RealFunction.SubFun f f x :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
        (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA (hHderiv x hx)
    have hsub_zero : RealFunction.SubFun f f x = RealTheory.zero := by
      unfold RealFunction.SubFun
      change C.sub (f x) (f x) = C.zero
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self C (f x)
    rw [hA_eq, hsub_zero]
    exact C.le_refl C.zero
  have hH_nonpos :
      RealDerivative.DerivativeNonpositiveOnOpenInterval a b H := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hA_eq : A = RealFunction.SubFun f f x :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
        (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA (hHderiv x hx)
    have hsub_zero : RealFunction.SubFun f f x = RealTheory.zero := by
      unfold RealFunction.SubFun
      change C.sub (f x) (f x) = C.zero
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self C (f x)
    rw [hA_eq, hsub_zero]
    exact C.le_refl C.zero
  have hH_mono :
      RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) H :=
    RealDerivative.monotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonnegative
      hHcont hHdiff hH_nonneg
  have hH_decr :
      RealFunction.DecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) H :=
    RealDerivative.decreasingOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_nonpositive
      hHcont hHdiff hH_nonpos
  have hH_eq : H b = H a := by
    have hle_ab : RealTheory.le (H a) (H b) :=
      hH_mono a b haClosed hbClosed hab
    have hle_ba : RealTheory.le (H b) (H a) :=
      hH_decr a b haClosed hbClosed hab
    exact RealTheory.le_antisymm hle_ba hle_ab
  have hGaI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a a (G a) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (x := a) hf haClosed
  have hGa_zero : G a = RealTheory.zero :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate hGaI
  change C.sub (F b) (G b) = C.sub (F a) (G a) at hH_eq
  change G a = C.zero at hGa_zero
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.value_sub_left_of_eq_add C
  calc
    F b = C.add (C.sub (F b) (G b)) (G b) := by
      exact Eq.symm
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel C (F b) (G b))
    _ = C.add (C.sub (F a) (G a)) (G b) := by rw [hH_eq]
    _ = C.add (F a) (G b) := by
      rw [hGa_zero, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero C (F a)]

name: eventuallyWithin_localOscillationBound_of_continuousAtOn_segment
statement:
private theorem eventuallyWithin_localOscillationBound_of_continuousAtOn_segment
    {E D : RealFunction.Domain} {f : Point -> Point} {x eps : Point}
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn D f x)
    (hsegment :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E x
        (fun y : Point =>
          And
            (forall z : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z -> D z)
            (forall z : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval y x z -> D z)))
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E x
      (fun y : Point => LocalOscillationBound f x y eps)
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hf.right eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases hsegment with
      | intro deltaSeg hdeltaSeg =>
          let delta' := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 C delta deltaSeg
          have hdelta' : C.lt C.zero delta' :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
              C hdelta.left hdeltaSeg.left
          refine Exists.intro delta' ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta' ?_
          intro y hy hyne hyd
          have hyd_cont : C.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C hyd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left C delta deltaSeg)
          have hyd_seg : C.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) deltaSeg :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C hyd
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right C delta deltaSeg)
          have hseg := hdeltaSeg.right y hy hyne hyd_seg
          refine And.intro ?forward ?reverse
          · intro z hz
            by_cases hzx : z = x
            · subst z
              change
                C.le (RealTheory.abs (C.sub (f x) (f x))) eps
              rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_self]
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C heps
            · have hzD : D z := hseg.left z hz
              have hzdist_le :
                  C.le (RealFunction.dist z x) (RealFunction.dist y x) :=
                RealFunction.dist_left_endpoint_le_of_closedInterval hz
              have hzdist_lt : C.lt (RealFunction.dist z x) delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hzdist_le hyd_cont
              have hclose := hdelta.right z hzD hzx hzdist_lt
              change
                C.lt (RealTheory.abs (C.sub (f z) (f x))) eps at hclose
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hclose
          · intro z hz
            by_cases hzx : z = x
            · subst z
              change
                C.le (RealTheory.abs (C.sub (f x) (f x))) eps
              rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_self]
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C heps
            · have hzD : D z := hseg.right z hz
              have hzdist_le :
                  C.le (RealFunction.dist z x) (RealFunction.dist y x) :=
                RealFunction.dist_right_endpoint_le_of_closedInterval hz
              have hzdist_lt : C.lt (RealFunction.dist z x) delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hzdist_le hyd_cont
              have hclose := hdelta.right z hzD hzx hzdist_lt
              change
                C.lt (RealTheory.abs (C.sub (f z) (f x))) eps at hclose
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hclose

name: tendstoWithin_differenceQuotient_of_endpointValues_continuousAtOn_segment
statement:
private theorem tendstoWithin_differenceQuotient_of_endpointValues_continuousAtOn_segment
    {E D : RealFunction.Domain} {f F : Point -> Point} {a x : Point}
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x)
    (hFx : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a x (F x))
    (hbase :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E x
        (fun y : Point => RealTheory.le a y))
    (hFy :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E x
        (fun y : Point => HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y (F y)))
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn D f x)
    (hsegment :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E x
        (fun y : Point =>
          And
            (forall z : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z -> D z)
            (forall z : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval y x z -> D z))) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin E
      (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x) x (f x)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let eta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half C eps
  have heta_pos : C.lt C.zero eta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos C heps
  have heta_lt_eps : C.lt eta eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self C heps
  have hosc :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E x
        (fun y : Point => LocalOscillationBound f x y eta) :=
    eventuallyWithin_localOscillationBound_of_continuousAtOn_segment
      (f := f) (x := x) hf hsegment heta_pos
  have hbase_integral :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E x
        (fun y : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.le a y)
            (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y (F y))) :=
    RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_and hbase hFy
  have hdata :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin E x
        (fun y : Point =>
          And
            (And (RealTheory.le a y)
              (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y (F y)))
            (LocalOscillationBound f x y eta)) :=
    RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_and hbase_integral hosc
  cases hdata with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro y hy hyne hyd
      have hydata := hdelta.right y hy hyne hyd
      have hay : RealTheory.le a y := hydata.left.left
      have hFyY : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y (F y) := hydata.left.right
      have hoscY : LocalOscillationBound f x y eta := hydata.right
      have hle :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
                  (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub y x)))
                (f x)))
            eta :=
        orientedEndpoint_base_right_quotient_error_abs_le_bound
          (f := f) (F := F) (a := a) (x := x) (y := y) (M := eta)
          hax hay hyne hFx hFyY hoscY.left hoscY.right
      have hlt :
          C.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (C.sub
                (C.mul (C.sub (F y) (F x))
                  (C.inv (C.sub y x)))
                (f x)))
            eps :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hle heta_lt_eps
      unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
      change
        C.lt
          (RealTheory.abs
            (C.sub (RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient F x y) (f x)))
          eps
      unfold RealDerivative.DifferenceQuotient
      exact hlt

name: hasDerivWithin_of_endpointValues_continuousAtOn_segment
statement:
private theorem hasDerivWithin_of_endpointValues_continuousAtOn_segment

name: hasDerivWithin_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
statement:
theorem hasDerivWithin_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b x : Point}
    (hf :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hx : RealTheory.OpenInterval a b x) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
      (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive f a b hf) x (f x)
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxClosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b x hx
  have hax : RealTheory.le a x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hx.left
  have hFx :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a x
        (closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive f a b hf x) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (x := x) hf hxClosed
  have hbase :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x
        (fun y : Point => RealTheory.le a y) :=
    RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_of_forall
      (fun y hy _hyne => IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hy.left)
  have hFy :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x
        (fun y : Point =>
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y
            (closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive f a b hf y)) :=
    RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_of_forall
      (fun y hy _hyne =>
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive
          (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (x := y) hf
          (RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval a b y hy))
  have hfOn :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f := by
    change RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f
    exact hf
  have hfAt :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f x :=
    hfOn x hxClosed
  have hsegment :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b) x
        (fun y : Point =>
          And
            (forall z : Point,
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
                RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z)
            (forall z : Point,
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval y x z ->
                RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z)) :=
    RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_of_forall
      (fun y hy _hyne => by
        refine And.intro ?_ ?_
        · intro z hz
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact
              RealTheory.le_trans
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hx.left) hz.left
          · exact
              RealTheory.le_trans hz.right
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hy.right)
        · intro z hz
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact
              RealTheory.le_trans
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hy.left) hz.left
          · exact
              RealTheory.le_trans hz.right
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hx.right))
  exact
    hasDerivWithin_of_endpointValues_continuousAtOn_segment
      (E := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (D := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (f := f)
      (F := closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitive f a b hf)
      (a := a)
      (x := x)
      hx hax hFx hbase hFy hfAt hsegment

        (fun y : Point =>
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y
            (closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
              f a b hI y)) :=

      (fun y hy _hyne =>
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable

          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact
              RealTheory.le_trans
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hx.left) hz.left
          · exact
              RealTheory.le_trans hz.right
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hy.right)
        · intro z hz
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact
              RealTheory.le_trans
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hy.left) hz.left
          · exact
              RealTheory.le_trans hz.right
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hx.right))
  exact
    hasDerivWithin_of_endpointValues_continuousAtOn_segment
      (E := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (D := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (f := f)
      (F := closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable f a b hI)

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_centerSubMap
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_centerSubMap
    (E : Domain) (x : Point) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (CenterSubMap x)
      (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  have hraw :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (RealFunction.SubFun
          (fun _ : Point => x)
          (fun t : Point => t))
        (RealFunction.SubFun
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_sub
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_const E x)
      (hasDerivativeWithinOn_id E)
  change HasDerivativeWithinOn E (CenterSubMap x)
    (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one)
  apply hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (E := E)
    (f := CenterSubMap x)
    (f' :=
      RealFunction.SubFun
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one))
    (g' := fun _ : Point => RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one)
  · intro t _ht
    unfold RealFunction.SubFun
    change RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one =
      RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  · exact hraw

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_centerSubPower_succ
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_centerSubPower_succ
    (E : Domain) (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (CenterSubPower x (n + 1))
      (CenterSubPowerDerivative x n)
proof:
:= by
  have hinner :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (CenterSubMap x)
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_centerSubMap E x
  have houter :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (RealFunction.PowerFun (n + 1))
        (PowerDerivative (n + 1)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_powerFun RealFunction.UniversalDomain (n + 1)
  have hbase :
      RealFunction.MapsInto E RealFunction.UniversalDomain
        (CenterSubMap x) := by
    intro t ht
    exact True.intro
  have hcomp :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (RealFunction.CompFun
          (RealFunction.PowerFun (n + 1))
          (CenterSubMap x))
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (RealFunction.CompFun
            (PowerDerivative (n + 1))
            (CenterSubMap x))
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_comp hinner houter hbase
  change HasDerivativeWithinOn E
    (RealFunction.CompFun
      (RealFunction.PowerFun (n + 1))
      (CenterSubMap x))
    (CenterSubPowerDerivative x n)
  apply hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (E := E)
    (f :=
      RealFunction.CompFun
        (RealFunction.PowerFun (n + 1))
        (CenterSubMap x))
    (f' :=
      RealFunction.MulFun
        (RealFunction.CompFun
          (PowerDerivative (n + 1))
          (CenterSubMap x))
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one))
    (g' := CenterSubPowerDerivative x n)
  · intro t _ht
    unfold RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.CompFun
    unfold PowerDerivative ConstMulFun
    unfold CenterSubPowerDerivative CenterSubPower CenterSubMap
    change
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x t) n))
          (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) =
        RealTheory.neg
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x t) n))
    rw [RealTheory.mul_neg]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  · exact hcomp

name: neg_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hneg := congrArg RealTheory.neg h
  rw [RealTheory.neg_neg] at hneg
  rw [RealTheory.neg_zero] at hneg
