name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorCoeff
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorCoeff
    {E : Domain} {D : Nat -> Map} {k : Nat}
    (hD : HasDerivativeWithinOn E (D k) (D (k + 1))) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (fun t : Point => TaylorCoeff D t k)
      (fun t : Point => TaylorCoeff (DerivativeChainShift D) t k)
proof:
:= by
  let c := RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (Nat.factorial k))
  have hscale :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (ConstMulFun c (D k))
        (ConstMulFun c (D (k + 1))) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_constMul hD
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (ConstMulFun c (D k))
        (fun t : Point => TaylorCoeff D t k) := by
    intro t _ht
    unfold ConstMulFun TaylorCoeff c
    rw [RealTheory.mul_comm]
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (ConstMulFun c (D (k + 1)))
        (fun t : Point => TaylorCoeff (DerivativeChainShift D) t k) := by
    intro t _ht
    unfold ConstMulFun TaylorCoeff DerivativeChainShift c
    rw [RealTheory.mul_comm]
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hscale)

name: taylorCoeff_mul_centerSubPowerDerivative_succ
statement:
theorem taylorCoeff_mul_centerSubPowerDerivative_succ
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x t : Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (TaylorCoeff D t (k + 1))
        (CenterSubPowerDerivative x k t) =
      RealTheory.neg
        (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x k t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold CenterSubPowerDerivative CenterSubPower
  unfold TaylorTransportTerm
  change
    RealTheory.mul
        (TaylorCoeff D t (k + 1))
        (RealTheory.neg
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
            (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x t) k))) =
      RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul
          (TaylorCoeff (DerivativeChainShift D) t k)
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x t) k))
  rw [RealTheory.mul_neg]
  congr 1
  calc
    RealTheory.mul
        (TaylorCoeff D t (k + 1))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x t) k)) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul
            (TaylorCoeff D t (k + 1))
            (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x t) k) := by
          rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        RealTheory.mul
          (TaylorCoeff (DerivativeChainShift D) t k)
          (RealFunction.powNat (RealTheory.sub x t) k) := by
          rw [taylorCoeff_succ_mul_nat_succ D t k]

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportTerm_zero
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportTerm_zero
    {E : Domain} {D : Nat -> Map} {x : Point}
    (hD0 : HasDerivativeWithinOn E (D 0) (D 1)) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (TaylorTransportTerm D x 0)
      (TaylorTransportTermRawDerivative D x 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (D 0)
        (TaylorTransportTerm D x 0) := by
    intro t _ht
    unfold TaylorTransportTerm TaylorCoeff
    rw [Nat.factorial_zero]
    rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
    change
      D 0 t =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (D 0 t) (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one))
          RealTheory.one
    have hinv : RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one := by
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    rw [hinv]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  have hright :
      RealFunction.SameOn E
        (D 1)
        (TaylorTransportTermRawDerivative D x 0) := by
    intro t _ht
    change D 1 t = TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x 0 t
    unfold TaylorTransportTerm TaylorCoeff DerivativeChainShift
    rw [Nat.factorial_zero]
    rw [RealTheory.nat_one]
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
    change
      D 1 t =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (D 1 t) (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one))
          RealTheory.one
    have hinv : RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one = RealTheory.one := by
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    rw [hinv]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right hright
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_left hleft hD0)

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportTerm_succ
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportTerm_succ
    {E : Domain} {D : Nat -> Map} {x : Point} {k : Nat}
    (hDsucc : HasDerivativeWithinOn E (D (k + 1)) (D (k + 2))) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (TaylorTransportTerm D x (k + 1))
      (TaylorTransportTermRawDerivative D x (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeff :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun t : Point => TaylorCoeff D t (k + 1))
        (fun t : Point => TaylorCoeff (DerivativeChainShift D) t (k + 1)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorCoeff
      (E := E) (D := D) (k := k + 1) hDsucc
  have hpow :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (CenterSubPower x (k + 1))
        (CenterSubPowerDerivative x k) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_centerSubPower_succ E x k
  have hprod :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (fun t : Point => TaylorCoeff D t (k + 1))
          (CenterSubPower x (k + 1)))
        (RealFunction.AddFun
          (RealFunction.MulFun
            (fun t : Point => TaylorCoeff (DerivativeChainShift D) t (k + 1))
            (CenterSubPower x (k + 1)))
          (RealFunction.MulFun
            (fun t : Point => TaylorCoeff D t (k + 1))
            (CenterSubPowerDerivative x k))) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_mul hcoeff hpow
  change HasDerivativeWithinOn E
    (TaylorTransportTerm D x (k + 1))
    (TaylorTransportTermRawDerivative D x (k + 1))
  apply hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (E := E)
    (f := TaylorTransportTerm D x (k + 1))
    (f' :=
      RealFunction.AddFun
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (fun t : Point => TaylorCoeff (DerivativeChainShift D) t (k + 1))
          (CenterSubPower x (k + 1)))
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (fun t : Point => TaylorCoeff D t (k + 1))
          (CenterSubPowerDerivative x k)))
    (g' := TaylorTransportTermRawDerivative D x (k + 1))
  · intro t _ht
    unfold TaylorTransportTermRawDerivative
    unfold RealFunction.AddFun RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.SubFun
    change
      RealTheory.add
          (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x (k + 1) t)
          (RealTheory.mul
            (TaylorCoeff D t (k + 1))
            (CenterSubPowerDerivative x k t)) =
        RealTheory.sub
          (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x (k + 1) t)
          (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x k t)
    rw [taylorCoeff_mul_centerSubPowerDerivative_succ D x t k]
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
  · exact hprod

name: finiteSum_taylorTransportTermRawDerivative
statement:
theorem finiteSum_taylorTransportTermRawDerivative
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x t : Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            TaylorTransportTermRawDerivative D x k t)
          (n + 1) =
        TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n t
  | 0 => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_one]
      rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_taylorTransportTermRawDerivative D x t n]
      unfold TaylorTransportTermRawDerivative
      unfold RealFunction.SubFun
      change
        RealTheory.add
          (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n t)
          (RealTheory.sub
            (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x (n + 1) t)
            (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n t)) =
        TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x (n + 1) t
      rw [RealTheory.add_comm
        (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n t)
        (RealTheory.sub
          (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x (n + 1) t)
          (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n t))]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x (n + 1) t)
        (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n t)

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportPolynomial_raw
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportPolynomial_raw
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D (n + 1)) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (TaylorTransportPolynomial D x n)
      (fun t : Point =>
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            TaylorTransportTermRawDerivative D x k t)
          (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorTransportPolynomial
  exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_finiteSum
    (E := E)
    (term := fun k : Nat => TaylorTransportTerm D x k)
    (term' := fun k : Nat => TaylorTransportTermRawDerivative D x k)
    (n + 1)
    (fun k hk => by
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportTerm_zero
            (E := E) (D := D) (x := x)
            (hD.right 0 hk)
      | succ j =>
          exact hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportTerm_succ
            (E := E) (D := D) (x := x) (k := j)
            (hD.right (j + 1) hk))

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportPolynomial
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportPolynomial
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D (n + 1)) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (TaylorTransportPolynomial D x n)
      (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n)
proof:
:= by
  have hraw :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (TaylorTransportPolynomial D x n)
        (fun t : Point =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              TaylorTransportTermRawDerivative D x k t)
            (n + 1)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportPolynomial_raw
      (E := E) (f := f) (D := D) (x := x) (n := n) hD
  apply hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (E := E)
    (f := TaylorTransportPolynomial D x n)
    (f' := fun t : Point =>
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          TaylorTransportTermRawDerivative D x k t)
        (n + 1))
    (g' := TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n)
  · intro t _ht
    exact finiteSum_taylorTransportTermRawDerivative D x t n
  · exact hraw

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportRemainder
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportRemainder
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {D : Nat -> Map} {x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hD : HasDerivativeChainWithinOn E f D (n + 1)) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn E
      (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n)
      (TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (fun _ : Point => f x)
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_const E (f x)
  have hpoly :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (TaylorTransportPolynomial D x n)
        (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportPolynomial
      (E := E) (f := f) (D := D) (x := x) (n := n) hD
  have hsub :
      HasDerivativeWithinOn E
        (RealFunction.SubFun
          (fun _ : Point => f x)
          (TaylorTransportPolynomial D x n))
        (RealFunction.SubFun
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
          (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n)) :=
    hasDerivativeWithinOn_sub hconst hpoly
  change HasDerivativeWithinOn E
    (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n)
    (TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n)
  apply hasDerivativeWithinOn_congr_right
    (E := E)
    (f := TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n)
    (f' :=
      RealFunction.SubFun
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
        (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n))
    (g' := TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n)
  · intro t _ht
    unfold TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative
    unfold RealFunction.SubFun RealFunction.NegFun
    change
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero
          (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n t) =
        RealTheory.neg
          (TaylorTransportTerm (DerivativeChainShift D) x n t)
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  · exact hsub

name: hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportRemainder_open_of_intervalData
statement:
theorem hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportRemainder_open_of_intervalData
    {D : Nat -> Map} {f : Map} {n : Nat}
    {a b x : Point}
    (hData : TaylorRemainderIntervalData D f n a b) :
    HasDerivativeWithinOn (RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
      (TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n)
      (TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n)
proof:
:=
  hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportRemainder
    (E := RealTheory.OpenInterval a b)
    (f := f) (D := D) (x := x) (n := n)
    (taylorRemainderIntervalData_chain_open hData)

name: differentiableOnOpenInterval_taylorTransportRemainder_of_intervalData
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  exact Exists.intro
    (TaylorTransportRemainderDerivative D x n t)
    (hasDerivativeWithinOn_taylorTransportRemainder_open_of_intervalData
      (D := D) (f := f) (n := n) (a := a) (b := b) (x := x)
      hData t ht)

name: taylorPointRemainder_eq_taylorRemainder
statement:
theorem taylorPointRemainder_eq_taylorRemainder
    (D : Nat -> Map) (f : Map) (x0 : Point) (n : Nat)
    (x : Point) :
    TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x =
      TaylorRemainder D f x0 n (RealTheory.sub x x0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorPointRemainder TaylorRemainder
  unfold IncrementLift IncrementMap
  rw [add_sub_center x0 x]

name: taylorTransportRemainder_at_base
statement:
theorem taylorTransportRemainder_at_base
    (D : Nat -> Map) (f : Map) (x0 : Point) (n : Nat)
    (x : Point) :
    TaylorTransportRemainder D f x n x0 =
      TaylorPointRemainder D f x0 n x
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorTransportRemainder TaylorPointRemainder
  unfold TaylorTransportPolynomial TaylorPolynomial
  unfold TaylorTransportTerm TaylorTerm
  rfl

name: taylorTransportPolynomial_at_endpoint
statement:
theorem taylorTransportPolynomial_at_endpoint
    (D : Nat -> Map) (x : Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      TaylorTransportPolynomial D x n x = D 0 x
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  change
    TaylorPolynomial D x n (RealTheory.sub x x) = D 0 x
  rw [centerSub_self]
  exact TaylorPolynomial_at_zero D x n

name: taylorTransportRemainder_at_endpoint
proof:
:= by
  unfold TaylorTransportRemainder
  rw [taylorTransportPolynomial_at_endpoint D x n]
  rw [hD0 x hx]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (f x)

name: lt_eq_gt
statement:
private theorem lt_eq_gt (a b : _root_.Rat) :
    Or (a < b) (Or (a = b) (b < a))
proof:
:= by
  cases _root_.Rat.le_total (a := a) (b := b) with
  | inl hab =>
      cases le_cases hab with
      | inl hlt =>
          exact Or.inl hlt
      | inr heq =>
          exact Or.inr (Or.inl heq)
  | inr hba =>
      cases le_cases hba with
      | inl hlt =>
          exact Or.inr (Or.inr hlt)
      | inr heq =>
          exact Or.inr (Or.inl heq.symm)

name: nonpos_of_not_nonneg
proof:
:=
  _root_.Rat.le_of_lt (_root_.Rat.not_le.mp h)

name: two_eq_one_add_one
statement: private theorem two_eq_one_add_one : (2 : _root_.Rat) = 1 + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [_root_.Rat.add_def']
  rfl

name: step_eq
statement:
private theorem step_eq (a δ : _root_.Rat) (n : Nat) :
    step a δ n = a + (n : _root_.Rat) * δ
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp [step, _root_.Rat.add_zero, _root_.Rat.zero_mul]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [step, ih]
      rw [_root_.Rat.natCast_add]
      rw [_root_.Rat.add_mul]
      change a + ↑n * δ + δ = a + (↑n * δ + 1 * δ)
      rw [_root_.Rat.one_mul]
      rw [_root_.Rat.add_assoc]

name: mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos
statement:
private theorem mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos {a b : _root_.Rat}
    (ha : 0 <= a)
    (hb : b <= 0) :
    a * b <= 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : a * b <= a * 0 :=
    _root_.Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb ha
  simpa [_root_.Rat.mul_zero] using h

name: mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
statement:
private theorem mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg {a b : _root_.Rat}
    (ha : a <= 0)
    (hb : 0 <= b) :
    a * b <= 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : a * b <= 0 * b :=
    _root_.Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha hb
  simpa [_root_.Rat.zero_mul] using h

name: mul_eq_neg_neg_mul
statement:
private theorem mul_eq_neg_neg_mul (a b : _root_.Rat) :
    a * b = (-a) * (-b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.Rat.neg_mul, _root_.Rat.mul_neg, _root_.Rat.neg_neg]

name: mul_inv_cancel_of_pos
statement:
private theorem mul_inv_cancel_of_pos {a : _root_.Rat} (ha : 0 < a) :
    a * a⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:=
  _root_.Rat.mul_inv_cancel a (_root_.Rat.ne_of_gt ha)

name: sub_sub_self
statement:
private theorem sub_sub_self (b c : _root_.Rat) :
    b - (b - c) = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [_root_.Rat.neg_add]
  rw [← _root_.Rat.add_assoc]
  rw [_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel]
  rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add]
  rw [_root_.Rat.neg_neg]

name: mul_complement
statement:
private theorem mul_complement (q b : _root_.Rat) :
    q * b + (1 - q) * b = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← _root_.Rat.add_mul]
  have h : q + (1 - q) = 1 := by
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [← _root_.Rat.add_assoc]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm q 1]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_assoc]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_zero]
  rw [h]
  rw [_root_.Rat.one_mul]

name: neg_mul
statement: theorem neg_mul (x y : Cut) : (-x) * y = -(x * y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0x : 0 <= x
  · by_cases h0nx : 0 <= -x
    · have hx0 : x = 0 := eq_zero_of_nonneg_of_neg_nonneg h0x h0nx
      rw [hx0, neg_zero, zero_mul, neg_zero]
    · by_cases h0y : 0 <= y
      · rw [mul_of_not_nonneg_of_nonneg h0nx h0y]
        rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x h0y]
        have h0x' : 0 <= x := by
          rw [← neg_neg x]
          exact neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0nx
        have hmul :=
          congrArg Neg.neg (mulNonneg_proof_irrel x y h0x' h0x h0y h0y)
        simpa [neg_neg x] using hmul
      · rw [mul_of_not_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0nx h0y]
        rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x h0y]
        rw [neg_neg (mulNonneg x (-y) h0x (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0y))]
        have h0x' : 0 <= x := by
          rw [← neg_neg x]
          exact neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0nx
        simpa [neg_neg x] using
          (mulNonneg_proof_irrel x (-y)
            h0x' h0x
            (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0y) (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0y))
  · have h0nx : 0 <= -x := neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x
    by_cases h0y : 0 <= y
    · rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0nx h0y]
      rw [mul_of_not_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x h0y]
      rw [neg_neg (mulNonneg (-x) y h0nx h0y)]
    · rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0nx h0y]
      rw [mul_of_not_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x h0y]

name: mul_neg
statement: theorem mul_neg (x y : Cut) : x * (-y) = -(x * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm x (-y)]
  rw [neg_mul y x]
  rw [mul_comm y x]

name: neg_mul_neg
statement: theorem neg_mul_neg (x y : Cut) : (-x) * (-y) = x * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_mul x (-y)]
  rw [mul_neg x y]
  rw [neg_neg (x * y)]

name: mem_mulNonneg
statement:
theorem mem_mulNonneg {x y : Cut} {h0x : 0 <= x} {h0y : 0 <= y} {q : Rat} :
    (mulNonneg x y h0x h0y).mem q <-> Or (q < 0) (posMulMem x y q)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: mulNonneg_proof_irrel
statement:
theorem mulNonneg_proof_irrel (x y : Cut)
    (h0x h0x' : 0 <= x) (h0y h0y' : 0 <= y) :
    mulNonneg x y h0x h0y = mulNonneg x y h0x' h0y'
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    exact hq
  · intro hq
    exact hq

name: posMulMem_comm
statement:
theorem posMulMem_comm {x y : Cut} {q : Rat} :
    posMulMem x y q -> posMulMem y x q
proof:
:= by
  intro hq
  cases hq with
  | intro a ha =>
      cases ha.right.right with
      | intro b hb =>
          have hqba : q < b * a := by
            rw [_root_.Rat.mul_comm]
            exact hb.right.right
          exact Exists.intro b
            (And.intro hb.left
              (And.intro hb.right.left
                (Exists.intro a
                  (And.intro ha.left
                    (And.intro ha.right.left hqba)))))

name: mulNonneg_comm
statement:
theorem mulNonneg_comm (x y : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) (h0y : 0 <= y) :
    mulNonneg x y h0x h0y = mulNonneg y x h0y h0x
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | inl hq0 => exact Or.inl hq0
    | inr hpos => exact Or.inr (posMulMem_comm hpos)
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | inl hq0 => exact Or.inl hq0
    | inr hpos => exact Or.inr (posMulMem_comm hpos)

name: zero_le_mulNonneg
statement:
theorem zero_le_mulNonneg (x y : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) (h0y : 0 <= y) :
    0 <= mulNonneg x y h0x h0y
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq0
  exact Or.inl ((Cut.mem_zero (q := q)).mp hq0)

name: mulNonneg_zero_left
statement:
theorem mulNonneg_zero_left (y : Cut) (h0y : 0 <= y) :
    mulNonneg 0 y (Cut.le_refl 0) h0y = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | inl hq0 =>
        exact (Cut.mem_zero (q := q)).mpr hq0
    | inr hpos =>
        cases hpos with
        | intro a ha =>
            have ha0 : a < 0 := (Cut.mem_zero (q := a)).mp ha.left
            exact False.elim
              (_root_.Rat.lt_irrefl
                (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                  ha.right.left ha0))
  · intro hq0
    exact Or.inl ((Cut.mem_zero (q := q)).mp hq0)

name: mulNonneg_zero_right
statement:
theorem mulNonneg_zero_right (x : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) :
    mulNonneg x 0 h0x (Cut.le_refl 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulNonneg_comm x 0 h0x (Cut.le_refl 0)]
  exact mulNonneg_zero_left x h0x

name: mulNonneg_one_left
statement:
theorem mulNonneg_one_left (x : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) :
    mulNonneg 1 x Cut.zero_le_one h0x = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | inl hq0 =>
        exact h0x q ((Cut.mem_zero (q := q)).mpr hq0)
    | inr hpos =>
        cases hpos with
        | intro a ha =>
            cases ha.right.right with
            | intro b hb =>
                have ha1 : a < 1 := (Cut.mem_one (q := a)).mp ha.left
                have hab_lt_b : a * b < b :=
                  Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.mul_lt_of_lt_one_of_pos
                    ha1 hb.right.left
                exact x.downward
                  (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                    hb.right.right hab_lt_b)
                  hb.left
  · intro hxq
    by_cases hq0 : q < 0
    · exact Or.inl hq0
    · have h0q : 0 <= q := _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hq0
      cases x.no_greatest hxq with
      | intro r hr =>
          have h0r : 0 < r :=
            Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt h0q hr.right
          cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_pos_lt_one_mul_gt
              h0q hr.right with
          | intro a ha =>
              exact Or.inr
                (Exists.intro a
                  (And.intro ((Cut.mem_one (q := a)).mpr ha.right.left)
                    (And.intro ha.left
                      (Exists.intro r
                        (And.intro hr.left
                          (And.intro h0r ha.right.right))))))

name: mulNonneg_one_right
statement:
theorem mulNonneg_one_right (x : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) :
    mulNonneg x 1 h0x Cut.zero_le_one = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulNonneg_comm x 1 h0x Cut.zero_le_one]
  exact mulNonneg_one_left x h0x

name: mulNonneg_assoc
statement:
theorem mulNonneg_assoc (x y z : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) (h0y : 0 <= y) (h0z : 0 <= z) :
    mulNonneg (mulNonneg x y h0x h0y) z
        (zero_le_mulNonneg x y h0x h0y) h0z =
      mulNonneg x (mulNonneg y z h0y h0z) h0x
        (zero_le_mulNonneg y z h0y h0z)
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | inl hq0 =>
        exact Or.inl hq0
    | inr hpos =>
        by_cases hq0 : q < 0
        · exact Or.inl hq0
        · have h0q : 0 <= q := _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hq0
          cases hpos with
          | intro p hp =>
              cases hp.right.right with
              | intro c hc =>
                  have hpxy : posMulMem x y p := by
                    cases hp.left with
                    | inl hp0 =>
                        exact False.elim
                          (_root_.Rat.lt_irrefl
                            (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                              hp.right.left hp0))
                    | inr hpxy =>
                        exact hpxy
                  cases hpxy with
                  | intro a ha =>
                      cases ha.right.right with
                      | intro b hb =>
                          have hpabc : p * c < (a * b) * c :=
                            _root_.Rat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
                              (a := p) (b := a * b) (c := c)
                              hb.right.right hc.right.left
                          have hqabc : q < a * (b * c) := by
                            have hqabc' : q < (a * b) * c :=
                              Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                                hc.right.right hpabc
                            rw [_root_.Rat.mul_assoc] at hqabc'
                            exact hqabc'
                          cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_pos_lt_of_lt_mul_left
                              (q := q) (a := a) (t := b * c)
                              h0q ha.right.left hqabc with
                          | intro d hd =>
                              have hdyz : (mulNonneg y z h0y h0z).mem d :=
                                Or.inr
                                  (Exists.intro b
                                    (And.intro hb.left
                                      (And.intro hb.right.left
                                        (Exists.intro c
                                          (And.intro hc.left
                                            (And.intro hc.right.left
                                              hd.right.right))))))
                              exact Or.inr
                                (Exists.intro a
                                  (And.intro ha.left
                                    (And.intro ha.right.left
                                      (Exists.intro d
                                        (And.intro hdyz
                                          (And.intro hd.left
                                            hd.right.left))))))
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | inl hq0 =>
        exact Or.inl hq0
    | inr hpos =>
        by_cases hq0 : q < 0
        · exact Or.inl hq0
        · have h0q : 0 <= q := _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hq0
          cases hpos with
          | intro a ha =>
              cases ha.right.right with
              | intro p hp =>
                  have hpyz : posMulMem y z p := by
                    cases hp.left with
                    | inl hp0 =>
                        exact False.elim
                          (_root_.Rat.lt_irrefl
                            (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                              hp.right.left hp0))
                    | inr hpyz =>
                        exact hpyz
                  cases hpyz with
                  | intro b hb =>
                      cases hb.right.right with
                      | intro c hc =>
                          have hapbc : a * p < a * (b * c) :=
                            _root_.Rat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left
                              (a := p) (b := b * c) (c := a)
                              hc.right.right ha.right.left
                          have hqab_c : q < (a * b) * c := by
                            have hqabc : q < a * (b * c) :=
                              Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                                hp.right.right hapbc
                            rw [← _root_.Rat.mul_assoc] at hqabc
                            exact hqabc
                          cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_pos_lt_of_lt_mul_right
                              (q := q) (t := a * b) (c := c)
                              h0q hc.right.left hqab_c with
                          | intro d hd =>
                              have hdxy : (mulNonneg x y h0x h0y).mem d :=
                                Or.inr
                                  (Exists.intro a
                                    (And.intro ha.left
                                      (And.intro ha.right.left
                                        (Exists.intro b
                                          (And.intro hb.left
                                            (And.intro hb.right.left
                                              hd.right.right))))))
                              exact Or.inr
                                (Exists.intro d
                                  (And.intro hdxy
                                    (And.intro hd.left
                                      (Exists.intro c
                                        (And.intro hc.left
                                          (And.intro hc.right.left
                                            hd.right.left))))))

name: add_le_add_right
statement:
theorem add_le_add_right {x y : Cut} (hxy : x <= y) (z : Cut) :
    x + z <= y + z
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  cases hq with
  | intro a ha =>
      cases ha.right with
      | intro b hb =>
          exact Exists.intro a
            (And.intro (hxy a ha.left)
              (Exists.intro b
                (And.intro hb.left hb.right)))

name: add_le_add_left
statement:
theorem add_le_add_left {x y : Cut} (hxy : x <= y) (z : Cut) :
    z + x <= z + y
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm z x]
  rw [add_comm z y]
  exact add_le_add_right hxy z

name: add_le_add
statement:
theorem add_le_add {w x y z : Cut} (hwx : w <= x) (hyz : y <= z) :
    w + y <= x + z
proof:
:= by
  exact le_trans (add_le_add_right hwx y) (add_le_add_left hyz x)

name: add_nonneg
statement:
theorem add_nonneg {x y : Cut} (h0x : 0 <= x) (h0y : 0 <= y) :
    0 <= x + y
proof:
:= by
  have h : (0 : Cut) + 0 <= x + y := add_le_add h0x h0y
  rw [zero_add (0 : Cut)] at h
  exact h

name: le_of_add_le_add_right
statement:
theorem le_of_add_le_add_right {x y z : Cut} (h : x + z <= y + z) :
    x <= y
proof:
:= by
  have hcancel : (x + z) + (-z) <= (y + z) + (-z) :=
    add_le_add_right h (-z)
  have hx : (x + z) + (-z) = x := by
    rw [add_assoc x z (-z)]
    rw [add_neg z]
    rw [add_zero x]
  have hy : (y + z) + (-z) = y := by
    rw [add_assoc y z (-z)]
    rw [add_neg z]
    rw [add_zero y]
  rw [hx, hy] at hcancel
  exact hcancel

name: le_of_add_le_add_left
statement:
theorem le_of_add_le_add_left {x y z : Cut} (h : z + x <= z + y) :
    x <= y
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_add_le_add_right (z := z)
  rw [add_comm x z]
  rw [add_comm y z]
  exact h

name: add_lt_add_right
statement:
theorem add_lt_add_right {x y : Cut} (hxy : x < y) (z : Cut) :
    x + z < y + z
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact add_le_add_right hxy.left z
  · intro hyx
    exact hxy.right (le_of_add_le_add_right hyx)

name: add_lt_add_left
statement:
theorem add_lt_add_left {x y : Cut} (hxy : x < y) (z : Cut) :
    z + x < z + y
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact add_le_add_left hxy.left z
  · intro hyx
    exact hxy.right (le_of_add_le_add_left hyx)

name: add_lt_add
statement:
theorem add_lt_add {w x y z : Cut} (hwx : w < x) (hyz : y < z) :
    w + y < x + z
proof:
:= by
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (add_lt_add_right hwx y) (add_le_add_left hyz.left x)

name: lt_of_add_lt_add_right
statement:
theorem lt_of_add_lt_add_right {x y z : Cut} (h : x + z < y + z) :
    x < y
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact le_of_add_le_add_right h.left
  · intro hyx
    exact h.right (add_le_add_right hyx z)

name: lt_of_add_lt_add_left
statement:
theorem lt_of_add_lt_add_left {x y z : Cut} (h : z + x < z + y) :
    x < y
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_add_lt_add_right (z := z)
  rw [add_comm x z]
  rw [add_comm y z]
  exact h

name: exists_inner_outer_gap_lt
statement:
theorem exists_inner_outer_gap_lt (x : Cut) {ε : Rat} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Exists (fun a => And (x.mem a)
      (Exists (fun b => And (Not (x.mem b)) (b - a < ε))))
proof:
:= by
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hnone
  cases x.nonempty with
  | intro a0 ha0 =>
      cases x.proper with
      | intro b0 hb0 =>
          let δ : Rat := ε / 2
          have hδpos : 0 < δ := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.half_pos hε
          have hδlt : δ < ε := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.half_lt hε
          have hstep : forall a, x.mem a -> x.mem (a + δ) := by
            intro a ha
            by_cases hmem : x.mem (a + δ)
            · exact hmem
            · have hgap : (a + δ) - a < ε := by
                have hcancel : (a + δ) - a = δ := by
                  rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm]
                  rw [_root_.Rat.add_sub_cancel]
                rw [hcancel]
                exact hδlt
              exact False.elim
                (hnone
                  (Exists.intro a
                    (And.intro ha
                      (Exists.intro (a + δ)
                        (And.intro hmem hgap)))))
          have hsteps :
              forall n, x.mem (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.step a0 δ n) := by
            intro n
            induction n with
            | zero =>
                exact ha0
            | succ n ih =>
                exact hstep
                  (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.step a0 δ n) ih
          cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_step_gt a0 b0 δ hδpos with
          | intro n hbn =>
              exact hb0 (x.downward hbn (hsteps n))

name: zero_le_one
statement: theorem zero_le_one : (0 : Cut) <= 1
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq0
  have hq0Rat : q < 0 := (Cut.mem_zero (q := q)).mp hq0
  have h01Rat : (0 : Rat) <= 1 := by decide
  exact (Cut.mem_one (q := q)).mpr
    (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le hq0Rat h01Rat)

name: zero_lt_one
statement: theorem zero_lt_one : (0 : Cut) < 1
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact zero_le_one
  · intro h10
    have h0mem1 : (1 : Cut).mem 0 := (Cut.mem_one (q := 0)).mpr (by decide)
    have h0mem0 : (0 : Cut).mem 0 := h10 0 h0mem1
    have h00 : (0 : Rat) < 0 := (Cut.mem_zero (q := 0)).mp h0mem0
    exact _root_.Rat.lt_irrefl h00

name: zero_ne_one
statement: theorem zero_ne_one : (0 : Cut) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h01
  have hlt : (1 : Cut) < 1 := by
    simpa [h01] using zero_lt_one
  exact Cut.lt_irrefl 1 hlt

name: one_ne_zero
statement: theorem one_ne_zero : (1 : Cut) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h10
  exact zero_ne_one h10.symm

name: nonneg_of_nonneg_cut_not_mem
statement:
theorem nonneg_of_nonneg_cut_not_mem {x : Cut} {u : Rat}
    (h0x : 0 <= x)
    (hu : Not (x.mem u)) :
    0 <= u
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu0 : u < 0
  · exact False.elim (hu (h0x u ((Cut.mem_zero (q := u)).mpr hu0)))
  · exact _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hu0

name: pos_of_pos_mem_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem pos_of_pos_mem_of_not_mem {x : Cut} {a u : Rat}
    (ha : x.mem a)
    (hapos : 0 < a)
    (hu : Not (x.mem u)) :
    0 < u
proof:
:=
  Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le hapos
    (Cut.le_of_mem_of_not_mem ha hu)

name: exists_neg_mem_between
proof:
:= by
  cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_between ht with
  | intro c hc =>
      exact Exists.intro c
        (And.intro (h0x c ((Cut.mem_zero (q := c)).mpr hc.right))
          (And.intro hc.left hc.right))

name: exists_pos_mem_of_pos
statement:
theorem exists_pos_mem_of_pos {x : Cut} (hx : 0 < x) :
    Exists (fun a => And (x.mem a) (0 < a))
proof:
:= by
  have hnot : Not (x <= 0) := hx.right
  have hnot_forall : Not (forall q : Rat, x.mem q -> (0 : Cut).mem q) := hnot
  cases Classical.not_forall.mp hnot_forall with
  | intro q hq_not_imp =>
      have hq_pair : And (x.mem q) (Not ((0 : Cut).mem q)) :=
        Classical.not_imp.mp hq_not_imp
      cases x.no_greatest hq_pair.left with
      | intro r hr =>
          have hq_nonneg : 0 <= q := by
            have hnlt : Not (q < 0) := by
              intro hq0
              exact hq_pair.right ((Cut.mem_zero (q := q)).mpr hq0)
            exact _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hnlt
          exact Exists.intro r
            (And.intro hr.left
              (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt
                hq_nonneg hr.right))

name: exists_pos_not_mem_of_pos
statement:
theorem exists_pos_not_mem_of_pos {x : Cut} (hx : 0 < x) :
    Exists (fun b => And (Not (x.mem b)) (0 < b))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_pos_mem_of_pos hx with
  | intro a ha =>
      cases x.proper with
      | intro u hu =>
          have hau : a <= u := Cut.le_of_mem_of_not_mem ha.left hu
          exact Exists.intro u
            (And.intro hu
              (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le
                ha.right hau))

name: sub_nonneg_of_le
statement: theorem sub_nonneg_of_le {x y : Cut} (hxy : x <= y) : 0 <= y - x
proof:
:= by
  have h : x + (-x) <= y + (-x) := add_le_add_right hxy (-x)
  rw [add_neg x] at h
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg y x]
  exact h

name: le_of_sub_nonneg
statement: theorem le_of_sub_nonneg {x y : Cut} (h : 0 <= y - x) : x <= y
proof:
:= by
  have h' : 0 + x <= (y - x) + x := add_le_add_right h x
  rw [zero_add x] at h'
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg y x] at h'
  rw [add_neg_add_cancel y x] at h'
  exact h'

name: sub_nonpos_of_le
statement: theorem sub_nonpos_of_le {x y : Cut} (hyx : y <= x) : y - x <= 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : y + (-x) <= x + (-x) := add_le_add_right hyx (-x)
  rw [add_neg x] at h
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg y x]
  exact h

name: le_of_sub_nonpos
statement: theorem le_of_sub_nonpos {x y : Cut} (h : y - x <= 0) : y <= x
proof:
:= by
  have h' : (y - x) + x <= 0 + x := add_le_add_right h x
  rw [zero_add x] at h'
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg y x] at h'
  rw [add_neg_add_cancel y x] at h'
  exact h'

name: sub_pos_of_lt
statement: theorem sub_pos_of_lt {x y : Cut} (hxy : x < y) : 0 < y - x
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact sub_nonneg_of_le hxy.left
  · intro hnonpos
    exact hxy.right (le_of_sub_nonpos hnonpos)

name: lt_of_sub_pos
statement: theorem lt_of_sub_pos {x y : Cut} (h : 0 < y - x) : x < y
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact le_of_sub_nonneg h.left
  · intro hyx
    exact h.right (sub_nonpos_of_le hyx)

name: sub_neg_of_lt
statement: theorem sub_neg_of_lt {x y : Cut} (hyx : y < x) : y - x < 0
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact sub_nonpos_of_le hyx.left
  · intro h0
    exact hyx.right (le_of_sub_nonneg h0)

name: lt_of_sub_neg
statement: theorem lt_of_sub_neg {x y : Cut} (h : y - x < 0) : y < x
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact le_of_sub_nonpos h.left
  · intro hxy
    exact h.right (sub_nonneg_of_le hxy)

name: mem_neg
statement:
theorem mem_neg {x : Cut} {q : Rat} :
    (-x).mem q <->
      Exists (fun r : Rat => And (Not (x.mem r)) (q < -r))
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: neg_zero
statement: theorem neg_zero : -(0 : Cut) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | intro r hr =>
        have hnlt : Not (r < 0) := by
          intro hr0
          exact hr.left ((Cut.mem_zero (q := r)).mpr hr0)
        have h0r : (0 : Rat) <= r := _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hnlt
        have hneg : -r <= 0 :=
          (_root_.Rat.neg_le_iff (a := r) (b := 0)).mpr (by simpa using h0r)
        exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le
          hr.right hneg
  · intro hq
    refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
    constructor
    · intro h0
      exact _root_.Rat.lt_irrefl ((Cut.mem_zero (q := 0)).mp h0)
    · simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_zero] using hq

name: neg_neg
statement: theorem neg_neg (x : Cut) : -(-x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | intro r hr =>
        cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_between
            hr.right with
        | intro s hs =>
            have hrs : r < -s :=
              (_root_.Rat.lt_neg_iff (a := s) (b := r)).mp hs.right
            have hxs : x.mem s := by
              by_cases h : x.mem s
              · exact h
              · exact False.elim (hr.left (Exists.intro s (And.intro h hrs)))
            exact x.downward hs.left hxs
  · intro hxq
    cases x.no_greatest hxq with
    | intro r hr =>
        refine Exists.intro (-r) ?_
        constructor
        · intro hneg
          cases hneg with
          | intro s hs =>
              have hsr : s < r :=
                (_root_.Rat.neg_lt_neg_iff (a := r) (b := s)).mp hs.right
              exact hs.left (x.downward hsr hr.left)
        · simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_neg] using hr.right

name: sub_eq_add_neg
statement: theorem sub_eq_add_neg (x y : Cut) : x - y = x + (-y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: mem_add
statement:
theorem mem_add {x y : Cut} {q : Rat} :
    (x + y).mem q <->
      Exists fun a : Rat =>
        And (x.mem a)
          (Exists fun b : Rat => And (y.mem b) (q = a + b))
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: add_comm
statement: theorem add_comm (x y : Cut) : x + y = y + x
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | intro a ha =>
        cases ha.right with
        | intro b hb =>
            refine Exists.intro b ?_
            refine And.intro hb.left ?_
            refine Exists.intro a ?_
            refine And.intro ha.left ?_
            rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm]
            exact hb.right
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | intro b hb =>
        cases hb.right with
        | intro a ha =>
            refine Exists.intro a ?_
            refine And.intro ha.left ?_
            refine Exists.intro b ?_
            refine And.intro hb.left ?_
            rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm]
            exact ha.right

name: add_assoc
statement:
theorem add_assoc (x y z : Cut) :
    (x + y) + z = x + (y + z)
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | intro s hs =>
        cases hs.right with
        | intro c hc =>
            cases hs.left with
            | intro a ha =>
                cases ha.right with
                | intro b hb =>
                    refine Exists.intro a ?_
                    refine And.intro ha.left ?_
                    refine Exists.intro (b + c) ?_
                    constructor
                    · exact Exists.intro b
                        (And.intro hb.left
                          (Exists.intro c (And.intro hc.left rfl)))
                    · calc
                        q = s + c := hc.right
                        _ = (a + b) + c := by rw [hb.right]
                        _ = a + (b + c) := by rw [_root_.Rat.add_assoc]
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | intro a ha =>
        cases ha.right with
        | intro t ht =>
            cases ht.left with
            | intro b hb =>
                cases hb.right with
                | intro c hc =>
                    refine Exists.intro (a + b) ?_
                    constructor
                    · exact Exists.intro a
                        (And.intro ha.left
                          (Exists.intro b (And.intro hb.left rfl)))
                    · exact Exists.intro c
                        (And.intro hc.left (by
                          calc
                            q = a + t := ht.right
                            _ = a + (b + c) := by rw [hc.right]
                            _ = (a + b) + c := by rw [← _root_.Rat.add_assoc]))

name: add_zero
statement:
theorem add_zero (x : Cut) :
    x + 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | intro a ha =>
        cases ha.right with
        | intro b hb =>
            have hb0 : b < 0 := (Cut.mem_zero (q := b)).mp hb.left
            have hab : a + b < a + 0 :=
              (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_left
                (a := b) (b := 0) (c := a)).mpr hb0
            have hqa : q < a := by
              rw [hb.right]
              rw [_root_.Rat.add_zero] at hab
              exact hab
            exact x.downward hqa ha.left
  · intro hxq
    cases x.no_greatest hxq with
    | intro r hr =>
        have hb0 : q - r < 0 := by
          apply (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
            (a := q) (b := 0) (c := r)).mpr
          rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add]
          exact hr.right
        have heq : r + (q - r) = q := by
          rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
          rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm q (-r)]
          rw [← _root_.Rat.add_assoc]
          rw [_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel]
          rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add]
        exact Exists.intro r
          (And.intro hr.left
            (Exists.intro (q - r)
              (And.intro ((Cut.mem_zero (q := q - r)).mpr hb0)
                heq.symm)))

name: zero_add
statement: theorem zero_add (x : Cut) : 0 + x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm (0 : Cut) x]
  exact add_zero x

name: eq_of_add_eq_add_left
statement:
theorem eq_of_add_eq_add_left {x y z : Cut} (h : z + x = z + y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_of_add_le_add_left (by
      rw [h]
      exact le_refl (z + y))
  · exact le_of_add_le_add_left (by
      rw [h]
      exact le_refl (z + y))

name: eq_of_add_eq_add_right
statement:
theorem eq_of_add_eq_add_right {x y z : Cut} (h : x + z = y + z) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_of_add_le_add_right (by
      rw [h]
      exact le_refl (y + z))
  · exact le_of_add_le_add_right (by
      rw [h]
      exact le_refl (y + z))

name: add_neg_cancel_right
statement: theorem add_neg_cancel_right (x y : Cut) : (x + y) + (-y) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc x y (-y)]
  rw [add_neg y]
  rw [add_zero x]

name: neg_add_cancel_left
statement: theorem neg_add_cancel_left (x y : Cut) : -x + (x + y) = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_assoc (-x) x y]
  rw [neg_add x]
  rw [zero_add y]

name: add_neg_eq_of_eq_add
statement:
theorem add_neg_eq_of_eq_add {a b d : Cut} (h : b = a + d) :
    a = b + (-d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h]
  rw [add_neg_cancel_right a d]

name: eq_add_of_eq_neg_add
statement:
theorem eq_add_of_eq_neg_add {a b d : Cut} (h : d = -a + b) :
    b = a + d
proof:
:= by
  rw [h]
  rw [← add_assoc a (-a) b]
  rw [add_neg a]
  rw [zero_add b]

name: add_add_neg_swap
statement: theorem add_add_neg_swap (x y : Cut) : (x + y) + (-x) = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm x y]
  exact add_neg_cancel_right y x

name: add_neg_add_cancel
statement: theorem add_neg_add_cancel (x y : Cut) : (x + (-y)) + y = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc x (-y) y]
  rw [neg_add y]
  rw [add_zero x]

name: neg_add_distrib
statement: theorem neg_add_distrib (x y : Cut) : -(x + y) = -x + -y
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_add_eq_add_left (z := x + y)
  rw [add_neg (x + y)]
  have hright : (x + y) + (-x + -y) = 0 := by
    rw [← add_assoc (x + y) (-x) (-y)]
    rw [add_add_neg_swap x y]
    rw [add_neg y]
  exact hright.symm

name: neg_add_add_left
statement: theorem neg_add_add_left (x y : Cut) : -(x + y) + x = -y
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_add_distrib x y]
  rw [add_comm (-x) (-y)]
  rw [add_assoc (-y) (-x) x]
  rw [neg_add x]
  rw [add_zero (-y)]

name: mem_invPos
statement:
theorem mem_invPos {x : Cut} {hx : 0 < x} {q : Rat} :
    (invPos x hx).mem q <-> invPosMem x q
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: invPos_nonneg
statement: theorem invPos_nonneg (x : Cut) (hx : 0 < x) : 0 <= invPos x hx
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq0
  exact Or.inl ((Cut.mem_zero (q := q)).mp hq0)

name: mulNonneg_invPos_le_one
statement:
theorem mulNonneg_invPos_le_one (x : Cut) (hx : 0 < x) :
    mulNonneg x (invPos x hx) hx.left (invPos_nonneg x hx) <= 1
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  cases hq with
  | inl hq0 =>
      exact (Cut.mem_one (q := q)).mpr
        (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le hq0 (by decide))
  | inr hpos =>
      cases hpos with
      | intro a ha =>
          cases ha.right.right with
          | intro b hb =>
              cases hb.left with
              | inl hb0 =>
                  exact False.elim
                    (_root_.Rat.lt_irrefl
                      (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                        hb.right.left hb0))
              | inr hbinv =>
                  cases hbinv with
                  | intro r hr =>
                      have har : a <= r := Cut.le_of_mem_of_not_mem ha.left hr.left
                      have hab1 : a * b < 1 :=
                        Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.mul_lt_one_of_le_of_pos_of_lt_inv
                          har hb.right.left hr.right.left hr.right.right
                      exact (Cut.mem_one (q := q)).mpr
                        (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                          hb.right.right hab1)

name: exists_pos_inner_outer_gap_lt_with_lower
statement:
theorem exists_pos_inner_outer_gap_lt_with_lower
    (x : Cut) {l ε : Rat}
    (hlx : x.mem l) (hlpos : 0 < l) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Exists (fun a => And (x.mem a) (And (0 < a) (And (l < a)
      (Exists (fun b => And (Not (x.mem b))
        (And (0 < b) (And (l < b) (b - a < ε))))))))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_inner_outer_gap_lt x hε with
  | intro a0 ha0 =>
      cases ha0.right with
      | intro b hb =>
          cases Cut.exists_mem_gt_of_mem_of_mem ha0.left hlx with
          | intro a ha =>
              have hab_le : a <= b := Cut.le_of_mem_of_not_mem ha.left hb.left
              have hgap : b - a < ε := by
                cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.le_cases hab_le with
                | inl hab_lt =>
                    have hsub : b - a < b - a0 :=
                      Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt
                        ha.right.left
                    exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                      hsub hb.right
                | inr hab_eq =>
                    rw [← hab_eq, _root_.Rat.sub_self]
                    exact hε
              have hbpos : 0 < b :=
                Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                    hlpos ha.right.right)
                  hab_le
              have hlb : l < b :=
                Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  ha.right.right hab_le
              exact Exists.intro a
                (And.intro ha.left
                  (And.intro
                    (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                      hlpos ha.right.right)
                    (And.intro ha.right.right
                      (Exists.intro b
                        (And.intro hb.left
                          (And.intro hbpos
                            (And.intro hlb hgap)))))))

name: one_le_mulNonneg_invPos
statement:
theorem one_le_mulNonneg_invPos (x : Cut) (hx : 0 < x) :
    1 <= mulNonneg x (invPos x hx) hx.left (invPos_nonneg x hx)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq1mem
  have hq1 : q < 1 := (Cut.mem_one (q := q)).mp hq1mem
  by_cases hq0 : q < 0
  · exact Or.inl hq0
  · have h0q : 0 <= q := _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hq0
    cases exists_pos_mem_of_pos hx with
    | intro l hl =>
        have h1q : 0 < 1 - q := (_root_.Rat.lt_iff_sub_pos q 1).mp hq1
        have hε : 0 < (1 - q) * l := _root_.Rat.mul_pos h1q hl.right
        cases exists_pos_inner_outer_gap_lt_with_lower
            x hl.left hl.right hε with
        | intro a ha =>
            cases ha.right.right.right with
            | intro b hb =>
                have hqb : q * b < a :=
                  Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.mul_lt_of_gap
                    hq1 hb.right.right.left hb.right.right.right
                have hqainv : q < a * b⁻¹ := by
                  have hqdiv : q < a / b := (_root_.Rat.lt_div_iff hb.right.left).mpr hqb
                  rw [_root_.Rat.div_def] at hqdiv
                  exact hqdiv
                cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_pos_lt_of_lt_mul_left
                    (q := q) (a := a) (t := b⁻¹) h0q ha.right.left hqainv with
                | intro d hd =>
                    exact Or.inr
                      (Exists.intro a
                        (And.intro ha.left
                          (And.intro ha.right.left
                            (Exists.intro d
                              (And.intro
                                (Or.inr
                                  (Exists.intro b
                                    (And.intro hb.left
                                      (And.intro hb.right.left
                                        hd.right.right))))
                                (And.intro hd.left hd.right.left))))))

name: mulNonneg_invPos
statement:
theorem mulNonneg_invPos (x : Cut) (hx : 0 < x) :
    mulNonneg x (invPos x hx) hx.left (invPos_nonneg x hx) = 1
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (mulNonneg_invPos_le_one x hx) (one_le_mulNonneg_invPos x hx)

name: mul_invPos
statement: theorem mul_invPos (x : Cut) (hx : 0 < x) : x * invPos x hx = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg hx.left (invPos_nonneg x hx)]
  exact mulNonneg_invPos x hx

name: add_neg
statement: theorem add_neg (x : Cut) : x + (-x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | intro a ha =>
        cases ha.right with
        | intro b hb =>
            cases hb.left with
            | intro r hr =>
                have har : a <= r := by
                  have hnlt : Not (r < a) := by
                    intro hra
                    exact hr.left (x.downward hra ha.left)
                  exact _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hnlt
                have hbneg : a + b < a + -r :=
                  (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_left (a := b) (b := -r) (c := a)).mpr
                    hr.right
                have hqneg : q < a + -r :=
                  by
                    rw [hb.right]
                    exact hbneg
                have haneg : a + -r <= 0 := by
                  have h : a + -r <= r + -r :=
                    (_root_.Rat.add_le_add_right (a := a) (b := r) (c := -r)).mpr har
                  rw [_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel] at h
                  exact h
                exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le hqneg haneg
  · intro hq0
    have hnegq : 0 < -q := by
      simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_zero] using
        (_root_.Rat.neg_lt_neg (a := q) (b := 0) hq0)
    cases exists_inner_outer_gap_lt x hnegq with
    | intro a ha =>
        cases ha.right with
        | intro b hb =>
            have hq_negdiff : q < -(b - a) :=
              (_root_.Rat.lt_neg_iff (a := b - a) (b := q)).mp hb.right
            have hq_diff : q < a - b := by
              rw [_root_.Rat.neg_sub] at hq_negdiff
              exact hq_negdiff
            have hq_add : q < -b + a := by
              rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg] at hq_diff
              rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm] at hq_diff
              exact hq_diff
            have hq_sub : q - a < -b :=
              (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff (a := q) (b := -b) (c := a)).mpr hq_add
            have heq : a + (q - a) = q := by
              rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
              rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm q (-a)]
              rw [← _root_.Rat.add_assoc]
              rw [_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel]
              rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add]
            exact Exists.intro a
              (And.intro ha.left
                (Exists.intro (q - a)
                  (And.intro
                    (Exists.intro b (And.intro hb.left hq_sub))
                    heq.symm)))

name: neg_add
statement: theorem neg_add (x : Cut) : -x + x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm (-x) x]
  exact add_neg x

name: le_def
statement:
theorem le_def {x y : Cut} :
    x <= y <-> forall q : Rat, x.mem q -> y.mem q
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: le_refl
statement: theorem le_refl (x : Cut) : x <= x
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  exact hq

name: le_trans
statement:
theorem le_trans {x y z : Cut} (hxy : x <= y) (hyz : y <= z) :
    x <= z
proof:
:= by
  intro q hxq
  exact hyz q (hxy q hxq)

name: le_antisymm
statement:
theorem le_antisymm {x y : Cut} (hxy : x <= y) (hyx : y <= x) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hxq
    exact hxy q hxq
  · intro hyq
    exact hyx q hyq

name: le_total
statement: theorem le_total (x y : Cut) : Or (x <= y) (y <= x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : x <= y
  · exact Or.inl hxy
  · apply Or.inr
    have hnot : Not (forall q : Rat, x.mem q -> y.mem q) := hxy
    cases Classical.not_forall.mp hnot with
    | intro a ha_not_imp =>
        have ha_pair : And (x.mem a) (Not (y.mem a)) :=
          Classical.not_imp.mp ha_not_imp
        intro b hyb
        cases _root_.Rat.le_total (a := b) (b := a) with
        | inl hba =>
            cases _root_.Rat.le_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hba with
            | inl hb_lt_a =>
                exact x.downward hb_lt_a ha_pair.left
            | inr hb_eq_a =>
                rw [hb_eq_a]
                exact ha_pair.left
        | inr hab =>
            have hya : y.mem a := by
              cases _root_.Rat.le_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hab with
              | inl ha_lt_b =>
                  exact y.downward ha_lt_b hyb
              | inr ha_eq_b =>
                  rw [ha_eq_b]
                  exact hyb
            exact False.elim (ha_pair.right hya)

name: lt_def
statement:
theorem lt_def {x y : Cut} :
    x < y <-> And (x <= y) (Not (y <= x))
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: lt_of_le_of_not_le
proof:
:=
  And.intro hxy hyx

name: le_of_lt
statement: theorem le_of_lt {x y : Cut} (hxy : x < y) : x <= y
proof:
:=
  hxy.left

name: not_le_of_lt
statement: theorem not_le_of_lt {x y : Cut} (hxy : x < y) : Not (y <= x)
proof:
:=
  hxy.right

name: not_lt_of_le
statement: theorem not_lt_of_le {x y : Cut} (hxy : x <= y) : Not (y < x)
proof:
:= by
  intro hyx
  exact hyx.right hxy

name: lt_irrefl
statement: theorem lt_irrefl (x : Cut) : Not (x < x)
proof:
:= by
  intro hxx
  exact hxx.right hxx.left

name: lt_trans
statement:
theorem lt_trans {x y z : Cut} (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y < z) :
    x < z
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact le_trans hxy.left hyz.left
  · intro hzx
    have hyx : y <= x := le_trans hyz.left hzx
    exact hxy.right hyx

name: lt_of_lt_of_le
statement:
theorem lt_of_lt_of_le {x y z : Cut} (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y <= z) :
    x < z
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact le_trans hxy.left hyz
  · intro hzx
    have hyx : y <= x := le_trans hyz hzx
    exact hxy.right hyx

name: lt_of_le_of_lt
statement:
theorem lt_of_le_of_lt {x y z : Cut} (hxy : x <= y) (hyz : y < z) :
    x < z
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact le_trans hxy hyz.left
  · intro hzx
    have hzy : z <= y := le_trans hzx hxy
    exact hyz.right hzy

name: le_cases
statement: theorem le_cases {x y : Cut} (hxy : x <= y) : Or (x < y) (x = y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hyx : y <= x
  · exact Or.inr (le_antisymm hxy hyx)
  · exact Or.inl (lt_of_le_of_not_le hxy hyx)

name: lt_eq_gt
statement: theorem lt_eq_gt (x y : Cut) : Or (x < y) (Or (x = y) (y < x))
proof:
:= by
  cases le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      cases le_cases hxy with
      | inl hlt =>
          exact Or.inl hlt
      | inr heq =>
          exact Or.inr (Or.inl heq)
  | inr hyx =>
      cases le_cases hyx with
      | inl hlt =>
          exact Or.inr (Or.inr hlt)
      | inr heq =>
          exact Or.inr (Or.inl heq.symm)

name: sup_isUpperBound
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxS q hxq
  exact Exists.intro x (And.intro hxS hxq)

name: sup_least
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  cases hq with
  | intro x hx =>
      exact hu x hx.left q hx.right

name: sup_isLeastUpperBound
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact sup_isUpperBound
  · intro u hu
    exact sup_least hu

name: exists_lub
statement:
theorem exists_lub (S : Cut -> Prop) (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound S)) :
    Exists (fun s : Cut => IsLeastUpperBound S s)
proof:
:=
  Exists.intro (sup S hne hbdd) sup_isLeastUpperBound

name: mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg {x y : Cut} (h0x : 0 <= x) (h0y : 0 <= y) :
    x * y = mulNonneg x y h0x h0y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change mul x y = mulNonneg x y h0x h0y
  unfold mul
  simp [h0x, h0y]

name: mul_of_nonneg_of_not_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_of_nonneg_of_not_nonneg {x y : Cut} (h0x : 0 <= x)
    (hny : Not (0 <= y)) :
    x * y = -(mulNonneg x (-y) h0x (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg hny))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change mul x y = -(mulNonneg x (-y) h0x (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg hny))
  unfold mul
  simp [h0x, hny]

name: mul_of_not_nonneg_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_of_not_nonneg_of_nonneg {x y : Cut} (hnx : Not (0 <= x))
    (h0y : 0 <= y) :
    x * y = -(mulNonneg (-x) y (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg hnx) h0y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change mul x y = -(mulNonneg (-x) y (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg hnx) h0y)
  unfold mul
  simp [hnx, h0y]

name: mul_of_not_nonneg_of_not_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_of_not_nonneg_of_not_nonneg {x y : Cut}
    (hnx : Not (0 <= x)) (hny : Not (0 <= y)) :
    x * y =
      mulNonneg (-x) (-y)
        (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg hnx) (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg hny)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change mul x y =
    mulNonneg (-x) (-y)
      (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg hnx) (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg hny)
  unfold mul
  simp [hnx, hny]

name: mul_zero
statement: theorem mul_zero (x : Cut) : x * 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0x : 0 <= x
  · rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x (Cut.le_refl 0)]
    exact mulNonneg_zero_right x h0x
  · rw [mul_of_not_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x (Cut.le_refl 0)]
    rw [mulNonneg_zero_right (-x) (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x)]
    exact neg_zero

name: zero_mul
statement: theorem zero_mul (x : Cut) : 0 * x = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0x : 0 <= x
  · rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg (Cut.le_refl 0) h0x]
    exact mulNonneg_zero_left x h0x
  · rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_not_nonneg (Cut.le_refl 0) h0x]
    rw [mulNonneg_zero_left (-x) (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x)]
    exact neg_zero

name: mul_one
statement: theorem mul_one (x : Cut) : x * 1 = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0x : 0 <= x
  · rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x Cut.zero_le_one]
    exact mulNonneg_one_right x h0x
  · rw [mul_of_not_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x Cut.zero_le_one]
    rw [mulNonneg_one_right (-x) (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x)]
    exact neg_neg x

name: one_mul
statement: theorem one_mul (x : Cut) : 1 * x = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0x : 0 <= x
  · rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg Cut.zero_le_one h0x]
    exact mulNonneg_one_left x h0x
  · rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_not_nonneg Cut.zero_le_one h0x]
    rw [mulNonneg_one_left (-x) (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x)]
    exact neg_neg x

name: mul_comm
statement: theorem mul_comm (x y : Cut) : x * y = y * x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0x : 0 <= x
  · by_cases h0y : 0 <= y
    · rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x h0y]
      rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0y h0x]
      exact mulNonneg_comm x y h0x h0y
    · rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x h0y]
      rw [mul_of_not_nonneg_of_nonneg h0y h0x]
      rw [mulNonneg_comm x (-y) h0x (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0y)]
  · by_cases h0y : 0 <= y
    · rw [mul_of_not_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x h0y]
      rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0y h0x]
      rw [mulNonneg_comm (-x) y (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x) h0y]
    · rw [mul_of_not_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x h0y]
      rw [mul_of_not_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0y h0x]
      exact mulNonneg_comm (-x) (-y)
        (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x) (neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0y)

name: ext
statement:
theorem ext {x y : Cut} (h : forall q : Rat, x.mem q <-> y.mem q) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | mk xmem xnonempty xproper xdownward xno_greatest =>
      cases y with
      | mk ymem ynonempty yproper ydownward yno_greatest =>
          dsimp at h
          have hmem : xmem = ymem := funext (fun q => propext (h q))
          subst hmem
          rfl

name: mem_ofRat
statement: theorem mem_ofRat {a q : Rat} : (ofRat a).mem q <-> q < a
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: mem_zero
statement: theorem mem_zero {q : Rat} : (0 : Cut).mem q <-> q < 0
proof:
:=

name: mem_one
statement: theorem mem_one {q : Rat} : (1 : Cut).mem q <-> q < 1
proof:
:=

name: zero_eq_ofRat
statement: theorem zero_eq_ofRat : (0 : Cut) = ofRat 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: one_eq_ofRat
statement: theorem one_eq_ofRat : (1 : Cut) = ofRat 1
