name: le_of_mem_of_not_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hnlt : Not (b < a) := by
    intro hba
    exact hb (x.downward hba ha)
  exact _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hnlt

name: exists_mem_gt_of_mem_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  cases _root_.Rat.le_total (a := a) (b := b) with
  | inl hab =>
      cases x.no_greatest hb with
      | intro c hc =>
          exact Exists.intro c
            (And.intro hc.left
              (And.intro
                (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt
                  hab hc.right)
                hc.right))
  | inr hba =>
      cases x.no_greatest ha with
      | intro c hc =>
          exact Exists.intro c
            (And.intro hc.left
              (And.intro hc.right
                (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt
                  hba hc.right)))

name: mul_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_nonneg {x y : Cut} (h0x : 0 <= x) (h0y : 0 <= y) :
    0 <= x * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x h0y]
  exact zero_le_mulNonneg x y h0x h0y

name: mul_pos
statement:
theorem mul_pos {x y : Cut} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    0 < x * y
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact mul_nonneg hx.left hy.left
  · intro hmul0
    cases exists_pos_mem_of_pos hx with
    | intro a ha =>
        cases exists_pos_mem_of_pos hy with
        | intro b hb =>
            have hab_pos : 0 < a * b := _root_.Rat.mul_pos ha.right hb.right
            have hq_pos : 0 < (a * b) / 2 :=
              Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.half_pos hab_pos
            have hq_lt : (a * b) / 2 < a * b :=
              Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.half_lt hab_pos
            have hqmem : (x * y).mem ((a * b) / 2) := by
              rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg hx.left hy.left]
              exact Or.inr
                (Exists.intro a
                  (And.intro ha.left
                    (And.intro ha.right
                      (Exists.intro b
                        (And.intro hb.left
                          (And.intro hb.right hq_lt))))))
            have hq0mem : (0 : Cut).mem ((a * b) / 2) :=
              hmul0 ((a * b) / 2) hqmem
            have hq_neg : (a * b) / 2 < 0 :=
              (Cut.mem_zero (q := (a * b) / 2)).mp hq0mem
            exact _root_.Rat.lt_irrefl
              (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hq_pos hq_neg)

name: sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
statement:
theorem sub_mul_eq_sub_mul (x y z : Cut) :
    (y - x) * z = y * z - x * z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (y - x) * z = (y + (-x)) * z := by rw [sub_eq_add_neg y x]
    _ = y * z + (-x) * z := by rw [add_mul y (-x) z]
    _ = y * z + -(x * z) := by rw [neg_mul x z]
    _ = y * z - x * z := by rw [sub_eq_add_neg (y * z) (x * z)]

name: mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
statement:
theorem mul_sub_eq_mul_sub (x y z : Cut) :
    z * (y - x) = z * y - z * x
proof:
:= by
  calc
    z * (y - x) = (y - x) * z := by rw [mul_comm z (y - x)]
    _ = y * z - x * z := sub_mul_eq_sub_mul x y z
    _ = z * y - z * x := by
      rw [mul_comm y z]
      rw [mul_comm x z]

name: mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
statement:
theorem mul_le_mul_nonneg_right {x y z : Cut} (hxy : x <= y) (h0z : 0 <= z) :
    x * z <= y * z
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : 0 <= y - x := sub_nonneg_of_le hxy
  have hprod : 0 <= (y - x) * z := mul_nonneg hdiff h0z
  rw [sub_mul_eq_sub_mul x y z] at hprod
  exact le_of_sub_nonneg hprod

name: mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
statement:
theorem mul_le_mul_nonneg_left {x y z : Cut} (hxy : x <= y) (h0z : 0 <= z) :
    z * x <= z * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm z x]
  rw [mul_comm z y]
  exact mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hxy h0z

name: mul_lt_mul_pos_right
statement:
theorem mul_lt_mul_pos_right {x y z : Cut} (hxy : x < y) (hz : 0 < z) :
    x * z < y * z
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : 0 < y - x := sub_pos_of_lt hxy
  have hprod : 0 < (y - x) * z := mul_pos hdiff hz
  rw [sub_mul_eq_sub_mul x y z] at hprod
  exact lt_of_sub_pos hprod

name: mul_lt_mul_pos_left
statement:
theorem mul_lt_mul_pos_left {x y z : Cut} (hxy : x < y) (hz : 0 < z) :
    z * x < z * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm z x]
  rw [mul_comm z y]
  exact mul_lt_mul_pos_right hxy hz

name: exists_lt_mem_mulNonneg_of_lt_mul
statement:
theorem exists_lt_mem_mulNonneg_of_lt_mul {x y : Cut} {h0x : 0 <= x} {h0y : 0 <= y}
    {a b t : Rat} (hxa : x.mem a) (ha : 0 < a) (hyb : y.mem b)
    (ht : t < a * b) :
    Exists (fun p => And ((mulNonneg x y h0x h0y).mem p) (t < p))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : 0 < b
  · cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_between ht with
    | intro p hp =>
        exact Exists.intro p
          (And.intro
            (Or.inr
              (Exists.intro a
                (And.intro hxa
                  (And.intro ha
                    (Exists.intro b
                      (And.intro hyb
                        (And.intro hb hp.right)))))))
            hp.left)
  · have hb0 : b <= 0 := _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hb
    have hab0 : a * b <= 0 := by
      have h :=
        _root_.Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (a := b) (b := 0) (c := a)
          hb0 (_root_.Rat.le_of_lt ha)
      rw [_root_.Rat.mul_zero] at h
      exact h
    have ht0 : t < 0 :=
      Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le ht hab0
    cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_between ht0 with
    | intro p hp =>
        exact Exists.intro p (And.intro (Or.inl hp.right) hp.left)

name: mem_add_of_lt_sum
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : s - c < b :=
    (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff (a := s) (b := b) (c := c)).mpr hs
  have heq : (s - c) + c = s := by
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_assoc]
    rw [_root_.Rat.neg_add_cancel]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_zero]
  exact Exists.intro (s - c)
    (And.intro (y.downward hleft hyb)
      (Exists.intro c (And.intro hzc heq.symm)))

name: mem_add_of_left_slack
statement:
theorem mem_add_of_left_slack {y z : Cut} (h0z : 0 <= z) {b s : Rat}
    (hyb : y.mem b) (hsb : s < b) : (y + z).mem s
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : s - b < 0 := by
    apply (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff (a := s) (b := 0) (c := b)).mpr
    rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add]
    exact hsb
  have hzc : z.mem (s - b) :=
    h0z (s - b) ((Cut.mem_zero (q := s - b)).mpr hdiff)
  have heq : b + (s - b) = s := by
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm s (-b)]
    rw [← _root_.Rat.add_assoc]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel]
    rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add]
  exact Exists.intro b
    (And.intro hyb
      (Exists.intro (s - b) (And.intro hzc heq.symm)))

name: mem_add_of_right_slack
statement:
theorem mem_add_of_right_slack {y z : Cut} (h0y : 0 <= y) {c s : Rat}
    (hzc : z.mem c) (hsc : s < c) : (y + z).mem s
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : s - c < 0 := by
    apply (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff (a := s) (b := 0) (c := c)).mpr
    rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add]
    exact hsc
  have hyb : y.mem (s - c) :=
    h0y (s - c) ((Cut.mem_zero (q := s - c)).mpr hdiff)
  have heq : (s - c) + c = s := by
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_assoc]
    rw [_root_.Rat.neg_add_cancel]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_zero]
  exact Exists.intro (s - c)
    (And.intro hyb
      (Exists.intro c (And.intro hzc heq.symm)))

name: mulNonneg_add_left
statement:
theorem mulNonneg_add_left (x y z : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) (h0y : 0 <= y)
    (h0z : 0 <= z) :
    mulNonneg x (y + z) h0x (add_nonneg h0y h0z) =
      mulNonneg x y h0x h0y + mulNonneg x z h0x h0z
proof:
:= by
  apply Cut.ext
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    have h0xy : 0 <= mulNonneg x y h0x h0y := zero_le_mulNonneg x y h0x h0y
    have h0xz : 0 <= mulNonneg x z h0x h0z := zero_le_mulNonneg x z h0x h0z
    have h0rhs : 0 <= mulNonneg x y h0x h0y + mulNonneg x z h0x h0z :=
      add_nonneg h0xy h0xz
    cases hq with
    | inl hq0 =>
        exact h0rhs q ((Cut.mem_zero (q := q)).mpr hq0)
    | inr hpos =>
        cases hpos with
        | intro a ha =>
            cases ha.right.right with
            | intro s hs =>
                cases hs.left with
                | intro b hb =>
                    cases hb.right with
                    | intro c hc =>
                        have hqsum : q < a * b + a * c := by
                          have hqraw : q < a * (b + c) :=
                            by
                              rw [← hc.right]
                              exact hs.right.right
                          rw [_root_.Rat.mul_add] at hqraw
                          exact hqraw
                        have hleft_target : q - a * c < a * b :=
                          (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
                            (a := q) (b := a * b) (c := a * c)).mpr
                            hqsum
                        cases exists_lt_mem_mulNonneg_of_lt_mul
                            (x := x) (y := y) (h0x := h0x) (h0y := h0y)
                            ha.left ha.right.left hb.left hleft_target with
                        | intro p hp =>
                            have hq_p_ac : q < p + a * c :=
                              (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
                                (a := q) (b := p) (c := a * c)).mp
                                hp.right
                            have hq_sub_p : q - p < a * c := by
                              apply
                                (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
                                  (a := q) (b := a * c) (c := p)).mpr
                              have hq_ac_p : q < a * c + p := by
                                rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm]
                                exact hq_p_ac
                              exact hq_ac_p
                            cases exists_lt_mem_mulNonneg_of_lt_mul
                                (x := x) (y := z) (h0x := h0x) (h0y := h0z)
                                ha.left ha.right.left hc.left hq_sub_p with
                            | intro r hr =>
                                have hrExact :
                                    (mulNonneg x z h0x h0z).mem (q - p) :=
                                  (mulNonneg x z h0x h0z).downward
                                    hr.right hr.left
                                have heq : p + (q - p) = q := by
                                  rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
                                  rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm q (-p)]
                                  rw [← _root_.Rat.add_assoc]
                                  rw [_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel]
                                  rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add]
                                exact Exists.intro p
                                  (And.intro hp.left
                                    (Exists.intro (q - p)
                                      (And.intro hrExact heq.symm)))
  · intro hq
    cases hq with
    | intro p hp =>
        cases hp.right with
        | intro r hr =>
            by_cases hq0 : q < 0
            · exact Or.inl hq0
            · have h0q : 0 <= q := _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hq0
              cases hp.left with
              | inl hp0 =>
                  cases hr.left with
                  | inl hr0 =>
                      have hprp : p + r < r := by
                        have h :=
                          (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_right
                            (a := p) (b := 0) (c := r)).mpr hp0
                        rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add] at h
                        exact h
                      have hpr0 : p + r < 0 :=
                        Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hprp hr0
                      have hqneg : q < 0 := by
                        rw [hr.right]
                        exact hpr0
                      exact False.elim ((_root_.Rat.not_lt.mpr h0q) hqneg)
                  | inr hrpos =>
                      cases hrpos with
                      | intro a ha =>
                          cases ha.right.right with
                          | intro c hc =>
                              have hprr : p + r < r := by
                                have h :=
                                  (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_right
                                    (a := p) (b := 0) (c := r)).mpr hp0
                                rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add] at h
                                exact h
                              have hqac : q < a * c :=
                                Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                                  (by
                                    rw [hr.right]
                                    exact hprr)
                                  hc.right.right
                              cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_pos_lt_of_lt_mul_left
                                  (q := q) (a := a) (t := c) h0q ha.right.left hqac with
                              | intro s hs =>
                                  exact Or.inr
                                    (Exists.intro a
                                      (And.intro ha.left
                                        (And.intro ha.right.left
                                          (Exists.intro s
                                            (And.intro
                                              (mem_add_of_right_slack h0y hc.left
                                                hs.right.right)
                                              (And.intro hs.left hs.right.left))))))
              | inr hppos =>
                  cases hppos with
                  | intro a1 ha1 =>
                      cases ha1.right.right with
                      | intro b hb =>
                          cases hr.left with
                          | inl hr0 =>
                              have hprp : p + r < p := by
                                have h :=
                                  (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_left
                                    (a := r) (b := 0) (c := p)).mpr hr0
                                rw [_root_.Rat.add_zero] at h
                                exact h
                              have hqab : q < a1 * b :=
                                Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                                  (by
                                    rw [hr.right]
                                    exact hprp)
                                  hb.right.right
                              cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_pos_lt_of_lt_mul_left
                                  (q := q) (a := a1) (t := b) h0q
                                  ha1.right.left hqab with
                              | intro s hs =>
                                  exact Or.inr
                                    (Exists.intro a1
                                      (And.intro ha1.left
                                        (And.intro ha1.right.left
                                          (Exists.intro s
                                            (And.intro
                                              (mem_add_of_left_slack h0z hb.left
                                                hs.right.right)
                                              (And.intro hs.left hs.right.left))))))
                          | inr hrpos =>
                              cases hrpos with
                              | intro a2 ha2 =>
                                  cases ha2.right.right with
                                  | intro c hc =>
                                      cases Cut.exists_mem_gt_of_mem_of_mem
                                          ha1.left ha2.left with
                                      | intro a ha =>
                                          have h0a : 0 < a :=
                                            Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                                              ha1.right.left ha.right.left
                                          have hpb : p < a * b := by
                                            have hmul : a1 * b < a * b :=
                                              _root_.Rat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
                                                (a := a1) (b := a) (c := b)
                                                ha.right.left hb.right.left
                                            exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                                              hb.right.right hmul
                                          have hrc : r < a * c := by
                                            have hmul : a2 * c < a * c :=
                                              _root_.Rat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
                                                (a := a2) (b := a) (c := c)
                                                ha.right.right hc.right.left
                                            exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
                                              hc.right.right hmul
                                          have hpqsum : p + r < a * b + a * c :=
                                            Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_lt_add hpb hrc
                                          have hqsum : q < a * (b + c) := by
                                            have hqsum' : q < a * b + a * c :=
                                              by
                                                rw [hr.right]
                                                exact hpqsum
                                            rw [_root_.Rat.mul_add]
                                            exact hqsum'
                                          cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_pos_lt_of_lt_mul_left
                                              (q := q) (a := a) (t := b + c)
                                              h0q h0a hqsum with
                                          | intro s hs =>
                                              exact Or.inr
                                                (Exists.intro a
                                                  (And.intro ha.left
                                                    (And.intro h0a
                                                      (Exists.intro s
                                                        (And.intro
                                                          (mem_add_of_lt_sum
                                                            hb.left hc.left
                                                            hs.right.right)
                                                          (And.intro hs.left
                                                            hs.right.left))))))

name: mulNonneg_add_right
statement:
theorem mulNonneg_add_right (x y z : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) (h0y : 0 <= y)
    (h0z : 0 <= z) :
    mulNonneg (x + y) z (add_nonneg h0x h0y) h0z =
      mulNonneg x z h0x h0z + mulNonneg y z h0y h0z
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulNonneg_comm (x + y) z (add_nonneg h0x h0y) h0z]
  rw [mulNonneg_comm x z h0x h0z]
  rw [mulNonneg_comm y z h0y h0z]
  exact mulNonneg_add_left z x y h0z h0x h0y

name: mul_add_nonneg_all
statement:
theorem mul_add_nonneg_all (x y z : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) (h0y : 0 <= y)
    (h0z : 0 <= z) :
    x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x (add_nonneg h0y h0z)]
  rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x h0y]
  rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x h0z]
  exact mulNonneg_add_left x y z h0x h0y h0z

name: mul_add_nonneg_left_of_nonneg_of_not_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_add_nonneg_left_of_nonneg_of_not_nonneg
    (x y z : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) (h0y : 0 <= y) (hnz : Not (0 <= z)) :
    x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z
proof:
:= by
  have h0nz : 0 <= -z := neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg hnz
  by_cases h0sum : 0 <= y + z
  · have hyza : (y + z) + (-z) = y := by
      rw [add_assoc y z (-z)]
      rw [add_neg z]
      rw [add_zero y]
    have hdist : x * ((y + z) + (-z)) = x * (y + z) + x * (-z) :=
      mul_add_nonneg_all x (y + z) (-z) h0x h0sum h0nz
    rw [hyza] at hdist
    have hmain : x * (y + z) = x * y + (-(x * (-z))) :=
      add_neg_eq_of_eq_add hdist
    calc
      x * (y + z) = x * y + (-(x * (-z))) := hmain
      _ = x * y + x * z := by
        rw [← mul_neg x (-z)]
        rw [neg_neg z]
  · have h0nsum : 0 <= -(y + z) := neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0sum
    have hnyy : -(y + z) + y = -z := neg_add_add_left y z
    have hdist : x * (-(y + z) + y) = x * (-(y + z)) + x * y :=
      mul_add_nonneg_all x (-(y + z)) y h0x h0nsum h0y
    rw [hnyy] at hdist
    rw [mul_neg x (y + z)] at hdist
    have hadd : x * y = x * (y + z) + x * (-z) :=
      eq_add_of_eq_neg_add hdist
    have hmain : x * (y + z) = x * y + (-(x * (-z))) :=
      add_neg_eq_of_eq_add hadd
    calc
      x * (y + z) = x * y + (-(x * (-z))) := hmain
      _ = x * y + x * z := by
        rw [← mul_neg x (-z)]
        rw [neg_neg z]

name: mul_add_nonneg_left_of_not_nonneg_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_add_nonneg_left_of_not_nonneg_of_nonneg
    (x y z : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) (hny : Not (0 <= y)) (h0z : 0 <= z) :
    x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_add_nonneg_left_of_nonneg_of_not_nonneg x z y h0x h0z hny
  rw [add_comm y z]
  rw [add_comm (x * z) (x * y)] at h
  exact h

name: mul_add_nonneg_left_of_not_nonneg_of_not_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_add_nonneg_left_of_not_nonneg_of_not_nonneg
    (x y z : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) (hny : Not (0 <= y))
    (hnz : Not (0 <= z)) :
    x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z
proof:
:= by
  have h0ny : 0 <= -y := neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg hny
  have h0nz : 0 <= -z := neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg hnz
  have hbase : x * ((-y) + (-z)) = x * (-y) + x * (-z) :=
    mul_add_nonneg_all x (-y) (-z) h0x h0ny h0nz
  calc
    x * (y + z) = x * (-(-(y + z))) := by rw [neg_neg (y + z)]
    _ = -(x * (-(y + z))) := by rw [mul_neg x (-(y + z))]
    _ = -(x * ((-y) + (-z))) := by rw [neg_add_distrib y z]
    _ = -(x * (-y) + x * (-z)) := by rw [hbase]
    _ = -(x * (-y)) + -(x * (-z)) := by
      rw [neg_add_distrib (x * (-y)) (x * (-z))]
    _ = x * y + -(x * (-z)) := by
      rw [← mul_neg x (-y)]
      rw [neg_neg y]
    _ = x * y + x * z := by
      rw [← mul_neg x (-z)]
      rw [neg_neg z]

name: mul_add_nonneg_left
statement:
theorem mul_add_nonneg_left (x y z : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) :
    x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0y : 0 <= y
  · by_cases h0z : 0 <= z
    · exact mul_add_nonneg_all x y z h0x h0y h0z
    · exact mul_add_nonneg_left_of_nonneg_of_not_nonneg x y z h0x h0y h0z
  · by_cases h0z : 0 <= z
    · exact mul_add_nonneg_left_of_not_nonneg_of_nonneg x y z h0x h0y h0z
    · exact mul_add_nonneg_left_of_not_nonneg_of_not_nonneg x y z h0x h0y h0z

name: mul_add
statement: theorem mul_add (x y z : Cut) : x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0x : 0 <= x
  · exact mul_add_nonneg_left x y z h0x
  · have h0nx : 0 <= -x := neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x
    have hbase : (-x) * (y + z) = (-x) * y + (-x) * z :=
      mul_add_nonneg_left (-x) y z h0nx
    calc
      x * (y + z) = (-(-x)) * (y + z) := by rw [neg_neg x]
      _ = -((-x) * (y + z)) := by rw [neg_mul (-x) (y + z)]
      _ = -((-x) * y + (-x) * z) := by rw [hbase]
      _ = -((-x) * y) + -((-x) * z) := by
        rw [neg_add_distrib ((-x) * y) ((-x) * z)]
      _ = x * y + -((-x) * z) := by
        rw [← neg_mul (-x) y]
        rw [neg_neg x]
      _ = x * y + x * z := by
        rw [← neg_mul (-x) z]
        rw [neg_neg x]

name: add_mul
statement: theorem add_mul (x y z : Cut) : (x + y) * z = x * z + y * z
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm (x + y) z]
  rw [mul_add z x y]
  rw [mul_comm z x]
  rw [mul_comm z y]

name: neg_le_neg
statement: theorem neg_le_neg {x y : Cut} (hxy : x <= y) : -y <= -x
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_add_le_add_right (z := y)
  have h0 : 0 <= -x + y := by
    have h : x + (-x) <= y + (-x) := add_le_add_right hxy (-x)
    rw [add_neg x] at h
    rw [add_comm y (-x)] at h
    exact h
  rw [neg_add y]
  exact h0

name: le_of_neg_le_neg
statement: theorem le_of_neg_le_neg {x y : Cut} (h : -y <= -x) : x <= y
proof:
:= by
  have h' : -(-x) <= -(-y) := neg_le_neg h
  rw [neg_neg x, neg_neg y] at h'
  exact h'

name: neg_nonneg_of_nonpos
statement: theorem neg_nonneg_of_nonpos {x : Cut} (hx : x <= 0) : 0 <= -x
proof:
:= by
  have h : -(0 : Cut) <= -x := neg_le_neg hx
  rw [neg_zero] at h
  exact h

name: neg_nonpos_of_nonneg
statement: theorem neg_nonpos_of_nonneg {x : Cut} (hx : 0 <= x) : -x <= 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : -x <= -(0 : Cut) := neg_le_neg hx
  rw [neg_zero] at h
  exact h

name: nonpos_of_not_nonneg
statement: theorem nonpos_of_not_nonneg {x : Cut} (h : Not (0 <= x)) : x <= 0
proof:
:= by
  cases le_total x 0 with
  | inl hx0 => exact hx0
  | inr h0x => exact False.elim (h h0x)

name: eq_zero_of_nonneg_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_nonneg_of_nonpos {x : Cut} (h0x : 0 <= x) (hx0 : x <= 0) :
    x = 0
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm hx0 h0x

name: neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg
statement: theorem neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg {x : Cut} (h : Not (0 <= x)) : 0 <= -x
proof:
:=
  neg_nonneg_of_nonpos (nonpos_of_not_nonneg h)

name: nonneg_of_neg_nonpos
statement: theorem nonneg_of_neg_nonpos {x : Cut} (h : -x <= 0) : 0 <= x
proof:
:= by
  have h' : -(0 : Cut) <= -(-x) := neg_le_neg h
  rw [neg_zero, neg_neg x] at h'
  exact h'

name: nonpos_of_neg_nonneg
statement: theorem nonpos_of_neg_nonneg {x : Cut} (h : 0 <= -x) : x <= 0
proof:
:= by
  have h' : -(-x) <= -(0 : Cut) := neg_le_neg h
  rw [neg_zero, neg_neg x] at h'
  exact h'

name: eq_zero_of_nonneg_of_neg_nonneg
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_nonneg_of_neg_nonneg {x : Cut} (h0x : 0 <= x)
    (h0nx : 0 <= -x) :
    x = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_of_nonneg_of_nonpos h0x (nonpos_of_neg_nonneg h0nx)

name: neg_pos_of_neg
statement: theorem neg_pos_of_neg {x : Cut} (hx : x < 0) : 0 < -x
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact neg_nonneg_of_nonpos hx.left
  · intro hnx0
    exact hx.right (nonneg_of_neg_nonpos hnx0)

name: neg_of_pos_neg
statement: theorem neg_of_pos_neg {x : Cut} (hx : 0 < -x) : x < 0
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le
  · exact nonpos_of_neg_nonneg hx.left
  · intro h0x
    exact hx.right (neg_nonpos_of_nonneg h0x)

name: inv_of_pos
statement: theorem inv_of_pos {x : Cut} (hx : 0 < x) : x⁻¹ = invPos x hx
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change inv x = invPos x hx
  unfold inv
  simp [hx]

name: inv_of_neg
statement:
theorem inv_of_neg {x : Cut} (hx : x < 0) :
    x⁻¹ = -(invPos (-x) (neg_pos_of_neg hx))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change inv x = -(invPos (-x) (neg_pos_of_neg hx))
  unfold inv
  have hnpos : Not (0 < x) := by
    intro hpos
    exact hx.right hpos.left
  simp [hnpos, hx]

name: inv_of_not_pos_of_not_neg
statement:
theorem inv_of_not_pos_of_not_neg {x : Cut} (hnpos : Not (0 < x))
    (hnneg : Not (x < 0)) :
    x⁻¹ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change inv x = 0
  unfold inv
  simp [hnpos, hnneg]

name: inv_zero
statement: theorem inv_zero : (0 : Cut)⁻¹ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply inv_of_not_pos_of_not_neg
  · exact lt_irrefl 0
  · exact lt_irrefl 0

name: mul_inv_cancel_of_pos
statement: theorem mul_inv_cancel_of_pos {x : Cut} (hx : 0 < x) : x * x⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_of_pos hx]
  exact mul_invPos x hx

name: mul_inv_cancel_of_neg
statement: theorem mul_inv_cancel_of_neg {x : Cut} (hx : x < 0) : x * x⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_of_neg hx]
  have hpos : 0 < -x := neg_pos_of_neg hx
  calc
    x * (-(invPos (-x) hpos)) = (-(-x)) * (-(invPos (-x) hpos)) := by
      rw [neg_neg x]
    _ = (-x) * invPos (-x) hpos := by
      rw [neg_mul_neg (-x) (invPos (-x) hpos)]
    _ = 1 := mul_invPos (-x) hpos

name: mul_inv_cancel
statement: theorem mul_inv_cancel {x : Cut} (hx : x ≠ 0) : x * x⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases lt_eq_gt x 0 with
  | inl hxneg =>
      exact mul_inv_cancel_of_neg hxneg
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hxzero =>
          exact False.elim (hx hxzero)
      | inr hxpos =>
          exact mul_inv_cancel_of_pos hxpos

name: inv_mul_cancel
statement: theorem inv_mul_cancel {x : Cut} (hx : x ≠ 0) : x⁻¹ * x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm x⁻¹ x]
  exact mul_inv_cancel hx

name: mul_assoc_nonneg_all
statement:
theorem mul_assoc_nonneg_all (x y z : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) (h0y : 0 <= y)
    (h0z : 0 <= z) :
    (x * y) * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x h0y]
  rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg (zero_le_mulNonneg x y h0x h0y) h0z]
  rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0y h0z]
  rw [mul_of_nonneg_of_nonneg h0x (zero_le_mulNonneg y z h0y h0z)]
  exact mulNonneg_assoc x y z h0x h0y h0z

name: mul_assoc_nonneg_left_two
statement:
theorem mul_assoc_nonneg_left_two (x y z : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x)
    (h0y : 0 <= y) :
    (x * y) * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0z : 0 <= z
  · exact mul_assoc_nonneg_all x y z h0x h0y h0z
  · have h0nz : 0 <= -z := neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0z
    have hbase : (x * y) * (-z) = x * (y * (-z)) :=
      mul_assoc_nonneg_all x y (-z) h0x h0y h0nz
    calc
      (x * y) * z = (x * y) * (-(-z)) := by rw [neg_neg z]
      _ = -((x * y) * (-z)) := by rw [mul_neg (x * y) (-z)]
      _ = -(x * (y * (-z))) := by rw [hbase]
      _ = x * (-(y * (-z))) := by rw [← mul_neg x (y * (-z))]
      _ = x * (y * (-(-z))) := by rw [← mul_neg y (-z)]
      _ = x * (y * z) := by rw [neg_neg z]

name: mul_assoc_nonneg_left
statement:
theorem mul_assoc_nonneg_left (x y z : Cut) (h0x : 0 <= x) :
    (x * y) * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0y : 0 <= y
  · exact mul_assoc_nonneg_left_two x y z h0x h0y
  · have h0ny : 0 <= -y := neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0y
    have hbase : (x * (-y)) * z = x * ((-y) * z) :=
      mul_assoc_nonneg_left_two x (-y) z h0x h0ny
    calc
      (x * y) * z = (x * (-(-y))) * z := by rw [neg_neg y]
      _ = (-(x * (-y))) * z := by rw [mul_neg x (-y)]
      _ = -((x * (-y)) * z) := by rw [neg_mul (x * (-y)) z]
      _ = -(x * ((-y) * z)) := by rw [hbase]
      _ = x * (-((-y) * z)) := by rw [← mul_neg x ((-y) * z)]
      _ = x * ((-(-y)) * z) := by rw [← neg_mul (-y) z]
      _ = x * (y * z) := by rw [neg_neg y]

name: mul_assoc
statement: theorem mul_assoc (x y z : Cut) : (x * y) * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0x : 0 <= x
  · exact mul_assoc_nonneg_left x y z h0x
  · have h0nx : 0 <= -x := neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0x
    have hbase : ((-x) * y) * z = (-x) * (y * z) :=
      mul_assoc_nonneg_left (-x) y z h0nx
    calc
      (x * y) * z = ((-(-x)) * y) * z := by rw [neg_neg x]
      _ = (-((-x) * y)) * z := by rw [neg_mul (-x) y]
      _ = -(((-x) * y) * z) := by rw [neg_mul ((-x) * y) z]
      _ = -((-x) * (y * z)) := by rw [hbase]
      _ = (-(-x)) * (y * z) := by rw [← neg_mul (-x) (y * z)]
      _ = x * (y * z) := by rw [neg_neg x]

name: neg_add_value_finite
statement:
theorem neg_add_value_finite (f : AHom) :
    FiniteError (fun a : Int => f (-a) + f a)
proof:
:= by
  cases neg_add_value_natAbs_bound f.almost with
  | intro B hB =>
      exact FiniteError.of_natAbs_bound (B := B + B) hB

name: neg_mul_mk
statement:
theorem neg_mul_mk (f g : AHom) :
    -mk f * mk g = -(mk f * mk g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_mk, mul_mk, mul_mk, neg_mk]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change -(f (g n)) = -(f (g n))
  rfl

name: mul_neg_mk
statement:
theorem mul_neg_mk (f g : AHom) :
    mk f * -mk g = -(mk f * mk g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_mk, mul_mk, mul_mk, neg_mk]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun n : Int => f (-(g n)) + f (g n))
  · intro n
    change f (-(g n)) + f (g n) =
      f (-(g n)) - (-(f (g n)))
    rw [_root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [_root_.Int.neg_neg]
  · exact FiniteError.reindex (neg_add_value_finite f)
      (fun n : Int => g n)

name: neg_mul
statement:
theorem neg_mul (x y : EudoxusReal) :
    (-x) * y = -(x * y)
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
  intro f g
  exact neg_mul_mk f g

name: mul_neg
statement:
theorem mul_neg (x y : EudoxusReal) :
    x * (-y) = -(x * y)
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
  intro f g
  exact mul_neg_mk f g

name: neg_mul_neg
statement:
theorem neg_mul_neg (x y : EudoxusReal) :
    (-x) * (-y) = x * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_mul]
  rw [mul_neg]
  rw [neg_neg]

name: lt_of_lt_of_le
statement:
theorem lt_of_lt_of_le {x y z : EudoxusReal}
    (hxy : x < y)
    (hyz : y <= z) :
    x < z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff_le_and_not_le]
  constructor
  · exact le_trans (le_of_lt hxy) hyz
  · intro hzx
    exact (not_le_of_lt hxy) (le_trans hyz hzx)

name: lt_of_le_of_lt
statement:
theorem lt_of_le_of_lt {x y z : EudoxusReal}
    (hxy : x <= y)
    (hyz : y < z) :
    x < z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff_le_and_not_le]
  constructor
  · exact le_trans hxy (le_of_lt hyz)
  · intro hzx
    exact (not_le_of_lt hyz) (le_trans hzx hxy)

name: neg_of_lt_neg
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (0 : EudoxusReal) < x + y := by
    have h1 := add_lt_add_left h x
    rw [add_neg] at h1
    exact h1
  have h2 := add_lt_add_right h0 (-y)
  have hleft : (0 : EudoxusReal) + -y = -y := by
    rw [zero_add]
  have hright : (x + y) + -y = x := by
    rw [add_assoc]
    rw [add_neg]
    rw [add_zero]
  rwa [hleft, hright] at h2

name: scaledUpper_exists
statement:
theorem scaledUpper_exists (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    (n : Nat) :
    Exists (ScaledUpper S n)
proof:
:= by
  cases hbdd with
  | intro U hU =>
      cases exists_nat_gt (ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * U) with
      | intro K hK =>
          refine Exists.intro ((K : Nat) : Int) ?_
          intro x hx
          have hxU : x <= U := hU x hx
          have hn_nonneg :
              (0 : EudoxusReal) <= ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) :=
            ofInt_nonneg_of_int_nonneg (_root_.Int.natCast_nonneg n)
          have hmul :
              ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * x <=
                ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * U :=
            mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hxU hn_nonneg
          exact le_trans hmul (le_of_lt hK)

name: scaledUpper_lower_bound_exists
statement:
theorem scaledUpper_lower_bound_exists (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (n : Nat) :
    Exists (fun L : Int => forall k : Int, ScaledUpper S n k -> L <= k)
proof:
:= by
  cases hne with
  | intro x hx =>
      cases exists_nat_gt (-(ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * x)) with
      | intro M hM =>
          refine Exists.intro (-((M : Nat) : Int)) ?_
          intro k hk
          have hbelow :
              ofInt (-((M : Nat) : Int)) <
                ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * x := by
            have hneg :
                -ofInt ((M : Nat) : Int) <
                  ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * x :=
              neg_of_lt_neg hM
            rwa [<- ofInt_neg] at hneg
          have hxk : ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * x <= ofInt k :=
            hk x hx
          have hlt : ofInt (-((M : Nat) : Int)) < ofInt k :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le hbelow hxk
          have hint : -((M : Nat) : Int) < k :=
            int_lt_of_ofInt_lt hlt
          omega

name: scaledCeil_upper
statement:
theorem scaledCeil_upper (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    (n : Nat) :
    ScaledUpper S n (scaledCeil S hne hbdd n)
proof:
:=
  Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Int.least_spec (ScaledUpper S n)
    (scaledUpper_exists S hbdd n)
    (scaledUpper_lower_bound_exists S hne n)

name: scaledCeil_min
statement:
theorem scaledCeil_min (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    {n : Nat} {k : Int}
    (hk : ScaledUpper S n k) :
    scaledCeil S hne hbdd n <= k
proof:
:=
  Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Int.least_min (ScaledUpper S n)
    (scaledUpper_exists S hbdd n)
    (scaledUpper_lower_bound_exists S hne n) hk

name: not_scaledUpper_pred_scaledCeil
statement:
theorem not_scaledUpper_pred_scaledCeil (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    (n : Nat) :
    Not (ScaledUpper S n (scaledCeil S hne hbdd n - 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro hpred
  have hmin := scaledCeil_min S hne hbdd (n := n) hpred
  omega

name: exists_lt_of_not_scaledUpper
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex :
      Exists (fun x : EudoxusReal =>
        And (S x) (Not (ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * x <= ofInt k))) := by
    exact Classical.byContradiction (by
      intro hnone
      apply hnot
      intro x hx
      by_cases hxk : ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * x <= ofInt k
      · exact hxk
      · exact False.elim (hnone (Exists.intro x (And.intro hx hxk))))
  cases hex with
  | intro x hx =>
      refine Exists.intro x ?_
      constructor
      · exact hx.left
      · cases le_total (ofInt k) (ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * x) with
        | inl hkx =>
            rw [lt_iff_le_and_not_le]
            exact And.intro hkx hx.right
        | inr hxk =>
            exact False.elim (hx.right hxk)

name: scaledCeil_pred_witness
statement:
theorem scaledCeil_pred_witness (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    (n : Nat) :
    Exists (fun x : EudoxusReal =>
      And (S x)
        (ofInt (scaledCeil S hne hbdd n - 1) <
          ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * x))
proof:
:=
  exists_lt_of_not_scaledUpper
    (not_scaledUpper_pred_scaledCeil S hne hbdd n)

name: ofInt_nat_add_mul
statement:
theorem ofInt_nat_add_mul (m n : Nat) (x : EudoxusReal) :
    ofInt (((m + n : Nat) : Int)) * x =
      ofInt ((m : Nat) : Int) * x + ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * x
proof:
:= by
  have hcast :
      (((m + n : Nat) : Int)) =
        ((m : Nat) : Int) + ((n : Nat) : Int) := by
    simp
  rw [hcast]
  rw [ofInt_add]
  rw [add_mul]

name: ofInt_pred_add_pred
statement:
theorem ofInt_pred_add_pred (a b : Int) :
    ofInt (a - 1) + ofInt (b - 1) =
      ofInt (a + b - 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [<- ofInt_add]
  have hcalc : (a - 1) + (b - 1) = a + b - 2 := by
    omega
  rw [hcalc]

name: scaledUpper_add
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hsum := add_le_add (ha x hx) (hb x hx)
  rw [ofInt_nat_add_mul m n x]
  rw [ofInt_add]
  exact hsum

name: scaledCeil_add_upper
statement:
theorem scaledCeil_add_upper (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    (m n : Nat) :
    scaledCeil S hne hbdd (m + n) <=
      scaledCeil S hne hbdd m + scaledCeil S hne hbdd n
proof:
:= by
  apply scaledCeil_min S hne hbdd
  exact scaledUpper_add
    (scaledCeil_upper S hne hbdd m)
    (scaledCeil_upper S hne hbdd n)

name: scaledValue_mono_of_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  have hn_nonneg :
      (0 : EudoxusReal) <= ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) :=
    ofInt_nonneg_of_int_nonneg (_root_.Int.natCast_nonneg n)
  exact mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hxy hn_nonneg

name: scaledCeil_pred_lt_at_larger
statement:
theorem scaledCeil_pred_lt_at_larger {S : EudoxusReal -> Prop}
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    {n : Nat} {x y : EudoxusReal}
    (hxy : x <= y)
    (hpred :
      ofInt (scaledCeil S hne hbdd n - 1) <
        ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * x) :
    ofInt (scaledCeil S hne hbdd n - 1) <
      ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * y
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le hpred (scaledValue_mono_of_nonneg hxy)

name: scaledCeil_add_lower
statement:
theorem scaledCeil_add_lower (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    (m n : Nat) :
    scaledCeil S hne hbdd m + scaledCeil S hne hbdd n - 1 <=
      scaledCeil S hne hbdd (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  let cm : Int := scaledCeil S hne hbdd m
  let cn : Int := scaledCeil S hne hbdd n
  let cmn : Int := scaledCeil S hne hbdd (m + n)
  by_cases hle : cm + cn - 1 <= cmn
  · exact hle
  · have hcmn_le : cmn <= cm + cn - 2 := by
      omega
    cases scaledCeil_pred_witness S hne hbdd m with
    | intro xm hxm =>
        cases scaledCeil_pred_witness S hne hbdd n with
        | intro xn hxn =>
            cases le_total xm xn with
            | inl hxm_xn =>
                have hm_lt :
                    ofInt (cm - 1) <
                      ofInt ((m : Nat) : Int) * xn := by
                  unfold cm
                  exact scaledCeil_pred_lt_at_larger (S := S)
                    hne hbdd hxm_xn hxm.right
                have hn_lt :
                    ofInt (cn - 1) <
                      ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * xn := by
                  unfold cn
                  exact hxn.right
                have hadd := add_lt_add hm_lt hn_lt
                have hleft :
                    ofInt (cm - 1) + ofInt (cn - 1) =
                      ofInt (cm + cn - 2) :=
                  ofInt_pred_add_pred cm cn
                have hright :
                    ofInt ((m : Nat) : Int) * xn +
                        ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * xn =
                      ofInt (((m + n : Nat) : Int)) * xn :=
                  (ofInt_nat_add_mul m n xn).symm
                rw [hleft, hright] at hadd
                have hupper :
                    ofInt (((m + n : Nat) : Int)) * xn <= ofInt cmn := by
                  unfold cmn
                  exact scaledCeil_upper S hne hbdd (m + n) xn hxn.left
                have hlt_cmn : ofInt (cm + cn - 2) < ofInt cmn :=
                  lt_of_lt_of_le hadd hupper
                have hint : cm + cn - 2 < cmn :=
                  int_lt_of_ofInt_lt hlt_cmn
                omega
            | inr hxn_xm =>
                have hm_lt :
                    ofInt (cm - 1) <
                      ofInt ((m : Nat) : Int) * xm := by
                  unfold cm
                  exact hxm.right
                have hn_lt :
                    ofInt (cn - 1) <
                      ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * xm := by
                  unfold cn
                  exact scaledCeil_pred_lt_at_larger (S := S)
                    hne hbdd hxn_xm hxn.right
                have hadd := add_lt_add hm_lt hn_lt
                have hleft :
                    ofInt (cm - 1) + ofInt (cn - 1) =
                      ofInt (cm + cn - 2) :=
                  ofInt_pred_add_pred cm cn
                have hright :
                    ofInt ((m : Nat) : Int) * xm +
                        ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int) * xm =
                      ofInt (((m + n : Nat) : Int)) * xm :=
                  (ofInt_nat_add_mul m n xm).symm
                rw [hleft, hright] at hadd
                have hupper :
                    ofInt (((m + n : Nat) : Int)) * xm <= ofInt cmn := by
                  unfold cmn
                  exact scaledCeil_upper S hne hbdd (m + n) xm hxm.left
                have hlt_cmn : ofInt (cm + cn - 2) < ofInt cmn :=
                  lt_of_lt_of_le hadd hupper
                have hint : cm + cn - 2 < cmn :=
                  int_lt_of_ofInt_lt hlt_cmn
                omega

name: scaledCeil_add_error_bounds
statement:
theorem scaledCeil_add_error_bounds (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    (m n : Nat) :
    And
      (scaledCeil S hne hbdd (m + n) -
          scaledCeil S hne hbdd m -
          scaledCeil S hne hbdd n <= 0)
      (-(scaledCeil S hne hbdd (m + n) -
          scaledCeil S hne hbdd m -
          scaledCeil S hne hbdd n) <= 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hupper := scaledCeil_add_upper S hne hbdd m n
  have hlower := scaledCeil_add_lower S hne hbdd m n
  constructor <;> omega

name: scaledCeil_sub_error_bounds
statement:
theorem scaledCeil_sub_error_bounds (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    {m n : Nat} (hnm : n <= m) :
    And
      (scaledCeil S hne hbdd (m - n) -
          scaledCeil S hne hbdd m +
          scaledCeil S hne hbdd n <= 1)
      (-(scaledCeil S hne hbdd (m - n) -
          scaledCeil S hne hbdd m +
          scaledCeil S hne hbdd n) <= 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := scaledCeil_add_error_bounds S hne hbdd (m - n) n
  have hsum : m - n + n = m := by
    omega
  rw [hsum] at h
  constructor <;> omega

name: supProfileRaw_nonneg
statement:
theorem supProfileRaw_nonneg (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)

name: supProfileRaw_neg
statement:
theorem supProfileRaw_neg (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)

name: int_toNat_add_of_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.Int.ofNat_inj.mp
  rw [_root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega : 0 <= m + n)]
  rw [_root_.Int.natCast_add]
  rw [_root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hm]
  rw [_root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn]

name: int_toNat_sub_of_nonneg_add
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.Int.ofNat_inj.mp
  rw [_root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hmn]
  rw [_root_.Int.natCast_sub]
  · rw [_root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hm]
    rw [_root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega : 0 <= -n)]
    omega
  · exact _root_.Int.toNat_le_toNat (by omega)

name: int_toNat_neg_add_of_neg_add
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.Int.ofNat_inj.mp
  rw [_root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega : 0 <= -(m + n))]
  rw [_root_.Int.natCast_sub]
  · rw [_root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega : 0 <= -n)]
    rw [_root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hm]
    omega
  · exact _root_.Int.toNat_le_toNat (by omega)

name: defect_comm
statement:
theorem defect_comm (f : Raw) (m n : Int) :
    defect f m n = defect f n m
proof:
:= by
  unfold defect

name: supProfileRaw_defect_bounds_nonneg_nonneg
statement:
theorem supProfileRaw_defect_bounds_nonneg_nonneg
    (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    {m n : Int} (hm : 0 <= m) (hn : 0 <= n) :
    And
      (defect (supProfileRaw S hne hbdd) m n <= 1)
      (-(defect (supProfileRaw S hne hbdd) m n) <= 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmn : 0 <= m + n := by
    omega
  have hsum := int_toNat_add_of_nonneg hm hn
  unfold defect
  rw [supProfileRaw_nonneg S hne hbdd hmn]
  rw [supProfileRaw_nonneg S hne hbdd hm]
  rw [supProfileRaw_nonneg S hne hbdd hn]
  rw [hsum]
  have h := scaledCeil_add_error_bounds S hne hbdd m.toNat n.toNat
  constructor <;> omega

name: supProfileRaw_defect_bounds_neg_neg
statement:
theorem supProfileRaw_defect_bounds_neg_neg
    (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    {m n : Int} (hm : Not (0 <= m)) (hn : Not (0 <= n)) :
    And
      (defect (supProfileRaw S hne hbdd) m n <= 1)
      (-(defect (supProfileRaw S hne hbdd) m n) <= 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmn : Not (0 <= m + n) := by
    omega
  have hsum :
      (-(m + n)).toNat = (-m).toNat + (-n).toNat := by
    have hmneg : 0 <= -m := by omega
    have hnneg : 0 <= -n := by omega
    have hraw := int_toNat_add_of_nonneg hmneg hnneg
    have harg : -m + -n = -(m + n) := by
      omega
    rwa [harg] at hraw
  unfold defect
  rw [supProfileRaw_neg S hne hbdd hmn]
  rw [supProfileRaw_neg S hne hbdd hm]
  rw [supProfileRaw_neg S hne hbdd hn]
  rw [hsum]
  have h := scaledCeil_add_error_bounds S hne hbdd (-m).toNat (-n).toNat
  constructor <;> omega

name: supProfileRaw_defect_bounds_nonneg_neg
statement:
theorem supProfileRaw_defect_bounds_nonneg_neg
    (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    {m n : Int} (hm : 0 <= m) (hn : Not (0 <= n)) :
    And
      (defect (supProfileRaw S hne hbdd) m n <= 1)
      (-(defect (supProfileRaw S hne hbdd) m n) <= 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hmn : 0 <= m + n
  · have hle : (-n).toNat <= m.toNat :=
      _root_.Int.toNat_le_toNat (by omega)
    have hdiff := int_toNat_sub_of_nonneg_add hm hn hmn
    unfold defect
    rw [supProfileRaw_nonneg S hne hbdd hmn]
    rw [supProfileRaw_nonneg S hne hbdd hm]
    rw [supProfileRaw_neg S hne hbdd hn]
    rw [hdiff]
    have h := scaledCeil_sub_error_bounds S hne hbdd hle
    constructor <;> omega
  · have hle : m.toNat <= (-n).toNat :=
      _root_.Int.toNat_le_toNat (by omega)
    have hdiff := int_toNat_neg_add_of_neg_add hm hn hmn
    unfold defect
    rw [supProfileRaw_neg S hne hbdd hmn]
    rw [supProfileRaw_nonneg S hne hbdd hm]
    rw [supProfileRaw_neg S hne hbdd hn]
    rw [hdiff]
    have h := scaledCeil_sub_error_bounds S hne hbdd hle
    constructor <;> omega

name: supProfileRaw_defect_bounds
statement:
theorem supProfileRaw_defect_bounds (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    (m n : Int) :
    And
      (defect (supProfileRaw S hne hbdd) m n <= 1)
      (-(defect (supProfileRaw S hne hbdd) m n) <= 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : 0 <= m
  · by_cases hn : 0 <= n
    · exact supProfileRaw_defect_bounds_nonneg_nonneg S hne hbdd hm hn
    · exact supProfileRaw_defect_bounds_nonneg_neg S hne hbdd hm hn
  · by_cases hn : 0 <= n
    · have hswap :=
        supProfileRaw_defect_bounds_nonneg_neg S hne hbdd hn hm
      rw [defect_comm (supProfileRaw S hne hbdd) m n]
      exact hswap
    · exact supProfileRaw_defect_bounds_neg_neg S hne hbdd hm hn

name: supProfileRaw_almost
statement:
theorem supProfileRaw_almost (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S)) :
    AlmostHom (supProfileRaw S hne hbdd)
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro 1 ?_
  constructor
  · omega
  · intro p
    exact supProfileRaw_defect_bounds S hne hbdd p.fst p.snd

name: supCandidate_is_upper
statement:
theorem supCandidate_is_upper (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S)) :
    IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S
      (supCandidate S hne hbdd)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine @_root_.Quot.ind AHom ahomSetoid.r
    (fun x => S x -> x <= supCandidate S hne hbdd)
    ?_ x hx
  intro f hfS
  rw [le_def]
  change Not (PositiveAHom (sub f (supProfileAHom S hne hbdd)))
  cases slope_lower_bound f with
  | intro C hC =>
      apply not_positiveAHom_of_nat_upper (B := ((C : Nat) : Int))
      intro n
      let z : Int := ((n : Nat) : Int)
      let c : Int := scaledCeil S hne hbdd n
      have hscaled :
          ofInt z * mk f <= ofInt c := by
        unfold c z
        exact scaledCeil_upper S hne hbdd n (mk f) hfS
      have hslope := hC z
      change ofInt (f z - ((C : Nat) : Int)) <= ofInt z * mk f at hslope
      have hleReal :
          ofInt (f z - ((C : Nat) : Int)) <= ofInt c :=
        le_trans hslope hscaled
      have hleInt : f z - ((C : Nat) : Int) <= c :=
        int_le_of_ofInt_le hleReal
      change f z + -(supProfileRaw S hne hbdd z) <= ((C : Nat) : Int)
      have hz_nonneg : 0 <= z := by
        unfold z
        exact _root_.Int.natCast_nonneg n
      rw [supProfileRaw_nonneg S hne hbdd hz_nonneg]
      have hz_toNat : z.toNat = n := by
        unfold z
        simp
      rw [hz_toNat]
      unfold c at hleInt
      omega

name: supCandidate_le_upper
statement:
theorem supCandidate_le_upper (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S))
    (U : EudoxusReal)
    (hU : IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S U) :
    supCandidate S hne hbdd <= U
proof:
:= by
  refine @_root_.Quot.ind AHom ahomSetoid.r
    (fun U => IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S U ->
      supCandidate S hne hbdd <= U)
    ?_ U hU
  intro f hfU
  rw [le_def]
  change Not (PositiveAHom (sub (supProfileAHom S hne hbdd) f))
  cases slope_upper_bound f with
  | intro C hC =>
      apply not_positiveAHom_of_nat_upper
        (B := (((C + 1 : Nat) : Int)))
      intro n
      let z : Int := ((n : Nat) : Int)
      let c : Int := scaledCeil S hne hbdd n
      cases scaledCeil_pred_witness S hne hbdd n with
      | intro x hx =>
          have hxU : x <= mk f := hfU x hx.left
          have hscaled_xU :
              ofInt z * x <= ofInt z * mk f := by
            unfold z
            exact scaledValue_mono_of_nonneg hxU
          have hslope := hC z
          change ofInt z * mk f <= ofInt (f z + ((C : Nat) : Int)) at hslope
          have hlt1 :
              ofInt (c - 1) < ofInt z * x := by
            unfold c z
            exact hx.right
          have hlt2 :
              ofInt (c - 1) < ofInt (f z + ((C : Nat) : Int)) :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hlt1 hscaled_xU) hslope
          have hint : c - 1 < f z + ((C : Nat) : Int) :=
            int_lt_of_ofInt_lt hlt2
          change supProfileRaw S hne hbdd z + -(f z) <=
            (((C + 1 : Nat) : Int))
          have hz_nonneg : 0 <= z := by
            unfold z
            exact _root_.Int.natCast_nonneg n
          rw [supProfileRaw_nonneg S hne hbdd hz_nonneg]
          have hz_toNat : z.toNat = n := by
            unfold z
            simp
          rw [hz_toNat]
          unfold c at hint
          omega

name: supCandidate_is_lub
statement:
theorem supCandidate_is_lub (S : EudoxusReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S)) :
    IsLeastUpperBound (fun x y : EudoxusReal => x <= y) S
      (supCandidate S hne hbdd)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact supCandidate_is_upper S hne hbdd
  · intro U hU
    exact supCandidate_le_upper S hne hbdd U hU

name: exists_large_ofInt_sub_positiveAHom
statement:
theorem exists_large_ofInt_sub_positiveAHom (f : AHom) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat =>
      PositiveAHom (sub (ofIntAHom ((n : Nat) : Int)) f))
proof:
:= by
  cases value_natAbs_linear_bound f.almost with
  | intro B hB =>
      let N : Nat := B + 2
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro M
      let k : Nat := (M + ((B : Nat) : Int)).toNat + 1
      refine Exists.intro k ?_
      have hk_gt : M + ((B : Nat) : Int) < ((k : Nat) : Int) := by
        unfold k
        exact int_lt_toNat_add_one (M + ((B : Nat) : Int))
      have hfkNat :
          (f ((k : Nat) : Int)).natAbs <= B * (k + 1) := by
        have h := hB ((k : Nat) : Int)
        simpa using h
      have hfUpper :
          f ((k : Nat) : Int) <= (((B * (k + 1) : Nat) : Int)) :=
        _root_.Int.le_trans _root_.Int.le_natAbs
          (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hfkNat)
      have hcalc :
          ((N : Nat) : Int) * ((k : Nat) : Int) -
              (((B * (k + 1) : Nat) : Int)) =
            2 * ((k : Nat) : Int) - ((B : Nat) : Int) := by
        unfold N
        simp [_root_.Int.add_mul, _root_.Int.mul_add]
        omega
      have hstrict :
          M <
            ((N : Nat) : Int) * ((k : Nat) : Int) -
              (((B * (k + 1) : Nat) : Int)) := by
        rw [hcalc]
        omega
      change
        M <
          ((N : Nat) : Int) * ((k : Nat) : Int) +
            -f ((k : Nat) : Int)
      omega

name: exists_nat_gt_mk
statement:
theorem exists_nat_gt_mk (f : AHom) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat => mk f < ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_large_ofInt_sub_positiveAHom f with
  | intro n hn =>
      refine Exists.intro n ?_
      rw [lt_def]
      change PositiveAHom (sub (ofIntAHom ((n : Nat) : Int)) f)
      exact hn

name: exists_nat_gt
statement:
theorem exists_nat_gt (x : EudoxusReal) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat => x < ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int))
proof:
:= by
  refine @_root_.Quot.ind AHom ahomSetoid.r
    (fun x => Exists (fun n : Nat => x < ofInt ((n : Nat) : Int)))
    ?_ x
  intro f
  exact exists_nat_gt_mk f

name: zero_add_mk
statement:
theorem zero_add_mk (f : AHom) :
    (0 : EudoxusReal) + mk f = mk f
proof:
:= by
  change mk (add zero f) = mk f
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change (0 : Int) + f n = f n
  rw [_root_.Int.zero_add]

name: add_zero_mk
statement:
theorem add_zero_mk (f : AHom) :
    mk f + (0 : EudoxusReal) = mk f
proof:
:= by
  change mk (add f zero) = mk f
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change f n + (0 : Int) = f n
  rw [_root_.Int.add_zero]

name: add_comm_mk
statement:
theorem add_comm_mk (f g : AHom) :
    mk f + mk g = mk g + mk f
proof:
:= by
  change mk (add f g) = mk (add g f)
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change f n + g n = g n + f n
  rw [_root_.Int.add_comm]

name: add_assoc_mk
statement:
theorem add_assoc_mk (f g h : AHom) :
    (mk f + mk g) + mk h = mk f + (mk g + mk h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_mk, add_mk, add_mk, add_mk]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change (f n + g n) + h n = f n + (g n + h n)
  rw [_root_.Int.add_assoc]

name: add_neg_mk
statement:
theorem add_neg_mk (f : AHom) :
    mk f + -mk f = (0 : EudoxusReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_mk]
  change mk (add f (neg f)) = mk zero
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change f n + -(f n) = (0 : Int)
  have hcancel := _root_.Int.add_neg_cancel_right 0 (f n)
  simpa [_root_.Int.zero_add] using hcancel

name: neg_add_mk
statement:
theorem neg_add_mk (f : AHom) :
    -mk f + mk f = (0 : EudoxusReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_mk]
  change mk (add (neg f) f) = mk zero
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change -(f n) + f n = (0 : Int)
  have hcancel := _root_.Int.neg_add_cancel_right 0 (f n)
  simpa [_root_.Int.zero_add] using hcancel

name: neg_neg_mk
statement:
theorem neg_neg_mk (f : AHom) :
    -(-mk f) = mk f
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_mk, neg_mk]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change -(-(f n)) = f n
  rw [_root_.Int.neg_neg]

name: neg_add_distrib_mk
statement:
theorem neg_add_distrib_mk (f g : AHom) :
    -(mk f + mk g) = -mk f + -mk g
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_mk, neg_mk, neg_mk, neg_mk, add_mk]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change -(f n + g n) = -f n + -g n
  rw [_root_.Int.neg_add]

name: neg_sub_mk
statement:
theorem neg_sub_mk (f g : AHom) :
    -(mk f - mk g) = mk g - mk f
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mk]
  rw [neg_mk]
  rw [sub_mk]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change -(f n + -g n) = g n + -f n
  rw [_root_.Int.neg_add]
  rw [_root_.Int.neg_neg]
  rw [_root_.Int.add_comm]

name: neg_zero
statement: theorem neg_zero : -(0 : EudoxusReal) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change -mk zero = mk zero
  rw [neg_mk]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change -((0 : Int)) = (0 : Int)
  rw [_root_.Int.neg_zero]

name: zero_add
statement:
theorem zero_add (x : EudoxusReal) :
    (0 : EudoxusReal) + x = x
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quot.ind
    (β := fun x => (0 : EudoxusReal) + x = x) ?_ x
  intro f
  exact zero_add_mk f

name: add_zero
statement:
theorem add_zero (x : EudoxusReal) :

proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quot.ind
    (β := fun x => x + (0 : EudoxusReal) = x) ?_ x

name: add_comm
statement:
theorem add_comm (x y : EudoxusReal) :

proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
  intro f g

name: add_assoc
statement:
theorem add_assoc (x y z : EudoxusReal) :

proof:
:= by

  intro f g h
  exact add_assoc_mk f g h

name: add_neg
statement:
theorem add_neg (x : EudoxusReal) :
    x + -x = (0 : EudoxusReal)
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quot.ind
    (β := fun x => x + -x = (0 : EudoxusReal)) ?_ x

statement:
theorem neg_add (x : EudoxusReal) :

    (β := fun x => -x + x = (0 : EudoxusReal)) ?_ x

statement:
theorem neg_add_distrib (x y : EudoxusReal) :

statement:

name: sub_eq_add_neg
statement:
theorem sub_eq_add_neg (x y : EudoxusReal) :
    x - y = x + -y
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: sub_self
statement:
theorem sub_self (x : EudoxusReal) :
    x - x = (0 : EudoxusReal)
proof:
:= by
  change x + -x = (0 : EudoxusReal)
  exact add_neg x

name: sub_zero
statement:
theorem sub_zero (x : EudoxusReal) :
    x - 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  change x + -(0 : EudoxusReal) = x
  rw [neg_zero]
  rw [add_zero]

name: zero_sub
statement:
theorem zero_sub (x : EudoxusReal) :
    0 - x = -x
proof:
:= by
  change (0 : EudoxusReal) + -x = -x
  rw [zero_add]

name: add_neg_cancel_right
statement:
theorem add_neg_cancel_right (x y : EudoxusReal) :
    (x + -y) + y = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc]
  rw [neg_add]
  rw [add_zero]

name: neg_add_cancel_left
statement:
theorem neg_add_cancel_left (x y : EudoxusReal) :
    -x + (x + y) = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [<- add_assoc]
  rw [neg_add]
  rw [zero_add]

name: eq_of_sub_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h' : (x - y) + y = (0 : EudoxusReal) + y := by
    rw [h]
  rw [zero_add] at h'
  change (x + -y) + y = y at h'
  rw [add_neg_cancel_right] at h'
  exact h'

name: sub_add_sub_cancel
statement:
theorem sub_add_sub_cancel (x y z : EudoxusReal) :
    (y - x) + (z - y) = z - x
proof:
:= by
  change (y + -x) + (z + -y) = z + -x
  calc
    (y + -x) + (z + -y)
        = (z + -y) + (y + -x) := by
          rw [add_comm]
    _ = z + (-y + (y + -x)) := by
          rw [add_assoc]
    _ = z + ((-y + y) + -x) := by
          rw [<- add_assoc (-y) y (-x)]
    _ = z + ((0 : EudoxusReal) + -x) := by
          rw [neg_add]
    _ = z + -x := by
          rw [zero_add]

name: sub_add_cancel_right
statement:
theorem sub_add_cancel_right (x y z : EudoxusReal) :
    (y + z) - (x + z) = y - x
proof:
:= by
  change (y + z) + -(x + z) = y + -x
  rw [neg_add_distrib x z]
  calc
    (y + z) + (-x + -z)
        = y + (z + (-x + -z)) := by
          rw [add_assoc]
    _ = y + ((-x + -z) + z) := by
          rw [add_comm z (-x + -z)]
    _ = y + (-x + (-z + z)) := by
          rw [add_assoc]
    _ = y + (-x + (0 : EudoxusReal)) := by
          rw [neg_add]
    _ = y + -x := by
          rw [add_zero]

name: sub_add_cancel_left
statement:
theorem sub_add_cancel_left (x y z : EudoxusReal) :
    (z + y) - (z + x) = y - x
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm z y]
  rw [add_comm z x]
  exact sub_add_cancel_right x y z

name: commutator_mul_self_eq
statement:
theorem commutator_mul_self_eq (f g : Raw) (n : Int) :
    n * (f (g n) - g (f n)) =
      scaledErrorInt f (g n) n - scaledErrorInt f n (g n) -
        scaledErrorInt g (f n) n + scaledErrorInt g n (f n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaledErrorInt
  rw [_root_.Int.mul_comm n (g n)]
  rw [_root_.Int.mul_comm n (f n)]
  rw [_root_.Int.mul_comm (g n) (f n)]
  rw [_root_.Int.mul_sub]
  omega

name: natAbs_sub_sub_add_le
statement:
theorem natAbs_sub_sub_add_le (a b c d : Int) :
    (a - b - c + d).natAbs <=
      ((a.natAbs + b.natAbs) + c.natAbs) + d.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (a - b - c + d).natAbs
        <= (a - b - c).natAbs + d.natAbs :=
      _root_.Int.natAbs_add_le (a - b - c) d
    _ <= ((a - b).natAbs + c.natAbs) + d.natAbs :=
      _root_.Nat.add_le_add_right
        (_root_.Int.natAbs_sub_le (a - b) c) d.natAbs
    _ <= ((a.natAbs + b.natAbs) + c.natAbs) + d.natAbs :=
      _root_.Nat.add_le_add_right
        (_root_.Nat.add_le_add_right
          (_root_.Int.natAbs_sub_le a b) c.natAbs)
        d.natAbs

name: scaledErrorNat_succ
statement:
theorem scaledErrorNat_succ (f : Raw) (k : Nat) (a : Int) :
    scaledErrorNat f (k + 1) a =
      scaledErrorNat f k a + defect f (((k : Nat) : Int) * a) a
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaledErrorNat defect
  simp [_root_.Int.add_mul, _root_.Int.one_mul]
  omega

name: scaledErrorNegNat_succ
statement:
theorem scaledErrorNegNat_succ (f : Raw) (k : Nat) (a : Int) :
    scaledErrorNegNat f (k + 1) a =
      scaledErrorNegNat f k a +
        defect f (-(((k : Nat) : Int) * a)) (-a) +
        (f (-a) + f a)
proof:
:= by
  have harg :
      -(((k + 1 : Nat) : Int) * a) =
        -(((k : Nat) : Int) * a) + -a := by
    simp [_root_.Int.add_mul, _root_.Int.one_mul]
    omega
  unfold scaledErrorNegNat defect
  rw [harg]
  simp [_root_.Int.add_mul, _root_.Int.one_mul]
  omega

name: defectNatAbsBound_evidence
statement:
private theorem defectNatAbsBound_evidence {f : Raw} {B : Nat}
    (hB : forall p : Int × Int, (defect f p.fst p.snd).natAbs <= B) :
    And ((f 0).natAbs <= B)
      (forall a : Int, (f (-a) + f a).natAbs <= B + B)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : (f 0).natAbs <= B := by
    have h := hB (0, 0)
    change (defect f 0 0).natAbs <= B at h
    unfold defect at h
    simp at h
    exact h
  refine And.intro hzero ?_
  intro a
  have hdef : (defect f (-a) a).natAbs <= B := by
    simpa using hB ((-a), a)
  have hrewrite :
      f (-a) + f a = f 0 - defect f (-a) a := by
    unfold defect
    have hsum : -a + a = 0 := by
      omega
    rw [hsum]
    omega
  rw [hrewrite]
  exact _root_.Nat.le_trans
    (_root_.Int.natAbs_sub_le (f 0) (defect f (-a) a))
    (_root_.Nat.add_le_add hzero hdef)

name: scaledErrorNat_bound
statement:
theorem scaledErrorNat_bound {f : Raw}
    (hf : AlmostHom f) :
    Exists
      (fun B : Nat =>
        forall (k : Nat) (a : Int),
          (scaledErrorNat f k a).natAbs <= B * (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  cases FiniteError.natAbs_bound hf with
  | intro B hB =>
      refine Exists.intro B ?_
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
          intro a
          change (scaledErrorNat f 0 a).natAbs <= B * (0 + 1)
          unfold scaledErrorNat
          simp
          exact (defectNatAbsBound_evidence hB).left
      | succ k ih =>
          intro a
          have hrec := scaledErrorNat_succ f k a
          have htri :
              (scaledErrorNat f (k + 1) a).natAbs <=
                (scaledErrorNat f k a).natAbs +
                  (defect f (((k : Nat) : Int) * a) a).natAbs := by
            rw [hrec]
            exact _root_.Int.natAbs_add_le
              (scaledErrorNat f k a)
              (defect f (((k : Nat) : Int) * a) a)
          have hih := ih a
          have hd : (defect f (((k : Nat) : Int) * a) a).natAbs <= B := by
            simpa using hB ((((k : Nat) : Int) * a), a)
          calc
            (scaledErrorNat f (k + 1) a).natAbs
                <= (scaledErrorNat f k a).natAbs +
                  (defect f (((k : Nat) : Int) * a) a).natAbs := htri
            _ <= B * (k + 1) + B := _root_.Nat.add_le_add hih hd
            _ = B * ((k + 1) + 1) := by
                conv => rhs; rw [_root_.Nat.mul_add, _root_.Nat.mul_one]

name: neg_add_value_natAbs_bound
statement:
theorem neg_add_value_natAbs_bound {f : Raw}
    (hf : AlmostHom f) :
    Exists
      (fun B : Nat =>
        forall a : Int, (f (-a) + f a).natAbs <= B + B)
proof:
:= by
  cases FiniteError.natAbs_bound hf with
  | intro B hB =>
      refine Exists.intro B ?_
      exact (defectNatAbsBound_evidence hB).right

name: scaledErrorNegNat_bound
statement:
theorem scaledErrorNegNat_bound {f : Raw}
    (hf : AlmostHom f) :
    Exists
      (fun B : Nat =>
        forall (k : Nat) (a : Int),
          (scaledErrorNegNat f k a).natAbs <= B * (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  cases FiniteError.natAbs_bound hf with
  | intro B hB =>
      let C : Nat := B + B + B
      refine Exists.intro C ?_
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
          intro a
          change (scaledErrorNegNat f 0 a).natAbs <= C * (0 + 1)
          unfold scaledErrorNegNat C
          simp
          calc
            (f 0).natAbs <= B := (defectNatAbsBound_evidence hB).left
            _ <= B + B + B := by omega
      | succ k ih =>
          intro a
          have hrec := scaledErrorNegNat_succ f k a
          have htri :
              (scaledErrorNegNat f (k + 1) a).natAbs <=
                ((scaledErrorNegNat f k a).natAbs +
                  (defect f (-(((k : Nat) : Int) * a)) (-a)).natAbs) +
                  (f (-a) + f a).natAbs := by
            rw [hrec]
            have h1 := _root_.Int.natAbs_add_le
              (scaledErrorNegNat f k a +
                defect f (-(((k : Nat) : Int) * a)) (-a))
              (f (-a) + f a)
            have h2 := _root_.Int.natAbs_add_le
              (scaledErrorNegNat f k a)
              (defect f (-(((k : Nat) : Int) * a)) (-a))
            exact _root_.Nat.le_trans h1
              (_root_.Nat.add_le_add_right h2 (f (-a) + f a).natAbs)
          have hih := ih a
          have hd : (defect f (-(((k : Nat) : Int) * a)) (-a)).natAbs <= B := by
            simpa using hB ((-(((k : Nat) : Int) * a)), -a)
          have hn := (defectNatAbsBound_evidence hB).right a
          calc
            (scaledErrorNegNat f (k + 1) a).natAbs
                <= ((scaledErrorNegNat f k a).natAbs +
                  (defect f (-(((k : Nat) : Int) * a)) (-a)).natAbs) +
                  (f (-a) + f a).natAbs := htri
            _ <= (C * (k + 1) + B) + (B + B) :=
              _root_.Nat.add_le_add
                (_root_.Nat.add_le_add hih hd)
                hn
            _ <= C * ((k + 1) + 1) := by
              unfold C
              conv => rhs; rw [_root_.Nat.mul_add, _root_.Nat.mul_one]
              omega

name: scaledErrorInt_of_nat
statement:
theorem scaledErrorInt_of_nat (f : Raw) (k : Nat) (a : Int) :
    scaledErrorInt f ((k : Nat) : Int) a =
      scaledErrorNat f k a
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaledErrorInt scaledErrorNat
  rfl

name: scaledErrorInt_of_neg_nat
statement:
theorem scaledErrorInt_of_neg_nat (f : Raw) (k : Nat) (a : Int) :
    scaledErrorInt f (-((k : Nat) : Int)) a =
      scaledErrorNegNat f k a
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaledErrorInt scaledErrorNegNat
  rw [_root_.Int.neg_mul, _root_.Int.neg_mul]
  rw [_root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg]
  simp

name: scaledErrorInt_bound
statement:
theorem scaledErrorInt_bound {f : Raw}
    (hf : AlmostHom f) :
    Exists
      (fun B : Nat =>
        forall (k a : Int),
          (scaledErrorInt f k a).natAbs <= B * (k.natAbs + 1))
proof:
:= by
  cases scaledErrorNat_bound hf with
  | intro Bpos hBpos =>
      cases scaledErrorNegNat_bound hf with
      | intro Bneg hBneg =>
          let B : Nat := Bpos + Bneg
          refine Exists.intro B ?_
          intro k a
          cases _root_.Int.natAbs_eq k with
          | inl hk =>
              rw [hk]
              have hmain :
                  (scaledErrorInt f ((k.natAbs : Nat) : Int) a).natAbs <=
                    Bpos * (k.natAbs + 1) := by
                rw [scaledErrorInt_of_nat]
                exact hBpos k.natAbs a
              exact _root_.Nat.le_trans hmain (by
                unfold B
                exact _root_.Nat.mul_le_mul_right (k.natAbs + 1)
                  (_root_.Nat.le_add_right Bpos Bneg))
          | inr hk =>
              rw [hk]
              have hmain :
                  (scaledErrorInt f (-((k.natAbs : Nat) : Int)) a).natAbs <=
                    Bneg * (k.natAbs + 1) := by
                rw [scaledErrorInt_of_neg_nat]
                exact hBneg k.natAbs a
              simpa using _root_.Nat.le_trans hmain (by
                unfold B
                exact _root_.Nat.mul_le_mul_right (k.natAbs + 1)
                  (_root_.Nat.le_add_left Bneg Bpos))

name: value_natAbs_linear_bound
statement:
theorem value_natAbs_linear_bound {f : Raw}
    (hf : AlmostHom f) :
    Exists
      (fun B : Nat =>
        forall n : Int, (f n).natAbs <= B * (n.natAbs + 1))
proof:
:= by
  cases scaledErrorInt_bound hf with
  | intro B hB =>
      let C : Nat := B + (f 1).natAbs
      refine Exists.intro C ?_
      intro n
      have hscaled :
          (scaledErrorInt f n 1).natAbs <= B * (n.natAbs + 1) :=
        hB n 1
      have hrewrite :
          f n = scaledErrorInt f n 1 + n * f 1 := by
        unfold scaledErrorInt
        have hone : n * 1 = n := by
          omega
        rw [hone]
        omega
      rw [hrewrite]
      have hmul :
          (n * f 1).natAbs <= (f 1).natAbs * (n.natAbs + 1) := by
        rw [_root_.Int.natAbs_mul, _root_.Nat.mul_comm n.natAbs (f 1).natAbs]
        exact _root_.Nat.mul_le_mul_left (f 1).natAbs
          (_root_.Nat.le_succ n.natAbs)
      calc
        (scaledErrorInt f n 1 + n * f 1).natAbs
            <= (scaledErrorInt f n 1).natAbs + (n * f 1).natAbs :=
          _root_.Int.natAbs_add_le (scaledErrorInt f n 1) (n * f 1)
        _ <= B * (n.natAbs + 1) + (f 1).natAbs * (n.natAbs + 1) :=
          _root_.Nat.add_le_add hscaled hmul
        _ = C * (n.natAbs + 1) := by
          unfold C
          rw [_root_.Nat.add_mul]

name: scaledErrorInt_reindex_linear
statement:
theorem scaledErrorInt_reindex_linear {f : Raw}
    (hf : AlmostHom f)
    {phi : Int -> Int}
    (hphi :
      Exists
        (fun G : Nat =>
          forall n : Int, (phi n).natAbs <= G * (n.natAbs + 1))) :
    Exists
      (fun C : Nat =>
        forall (n a : Int),
          (scaledErrorInt f (phi n) a).natAbs <= C * (n.natAbs + 1))
proof:
:= by
  cases scaledErrorInt_bound hf with
  | intro B hB =>
      cases hphi with
      | intro G hG =>
          refine Exists.intro (B * (G + 1)) ?_
          intro n a
          have hmain := hB (phi n) a
          let t : Nat := n.natAbs + 1
          have ht : 1 <= t := by
            unfold t
            omega
          have harg : (phi n).natAbs + 1 <= (G + 1) * t := by
            calc
              (phi n).natAbs + 1 <= G * t + 1 :=
                _root_.Nat.add_le_add_right (by
                  unfold t
                  exact hG n) 1
              _ <= G * t + t := _root_.Nat.add_le_add_left ht (G * t)
              _ = (G + 1) * t := by
                rw [_root_.Nat.add_mul, _root_.Nat.one_mul]
          calc
            (scaledErrorInt f (phi n) a).natAbs
                <= B * ((phi n).natAbs + 1) := hmain
            _ <= B * ((G + 1) * t) := _root_.Nat.mul_le_mul_left B harg
            _ = (B * (G + 1)) * (n.natAbs + 1) := by
              unfold t
              rw [_root_.Nat.mul_assoc]

name: finiteError_of_mul_self_linear
statement:
theorem finiteError_of_mul_self_linear {h : Int -> Int}
    (hh :
      Exists
        (fun C : Nat =>
          forall n : Int,
            (n * h n).natAbs <= C * (n.natAbs + 1))) :
    FiniteError h
proof:
:= by
  cases hh with
  | intro C hC =>
      let B : Nat := C + C + (h 0).natAbs
      apply FiniteError.of_natAbs_bound (B := B)
      intro n
      by_cases hnzero : n.natAbs = 0
      · have hz : n = 0 := _root_.Int.natAbs_eq_zero.mp hnzero
        rw [hz]
        unfold B
        omega
      · have hnpos : 0 < n.natAbs := _root_.Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hnzero
        have hn := hC n
        rw [_root_.Int.natAbs_mul] at hn
        have hscale : C * (n.natAbs + 1) <= (C + C) * n.natAbs := by
          have hone : 1 <= n.natAbs := hnpos
          have harg : n.natAbs + 1 <= n.natAbs + n.natAbs :=
            _root_.Nat.add_le_add_left hone n.natAbs
          have hmul := _root_.Nat.mul_le_mul_left C harg
          exact _root_.Nat.le_trans hmul (by
            simp [_root_.Nat.mul_add, _root_.Nat.add_mul])
        have hprod :
            n.natAbs * (h n).natAbs <= n.natAbs * (C + C) := by
          calc
            n.natAbs * (h n).natAbs
                <= C * (n.natAbs + 1) := hn
            _ <= (C + C) * n.natAbs := hscale
            _ = n.natAbs * (C + C) := _root_.Nat.mul_comm (C + C) n.natAbs
        have hcancel :
            (h n).natAbs <= C + C :=
          _root_.Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hprod hnpos
        unfold B
        omega

name: commutator_mul_self_linear
statement:
theorem commutator_mul_self_linear (f g : AHom) :
    Exists
      (fun K : Nat =>
        forall n : Int,
          (n * (f (g n) - g (f n))).natAbs <= K * (n.natAbs + 1))
proof:
:= by
  cases scaledErrorInt_bound f.almost with
  | intro Bf hBf =>
      cases scaledErrorInt_bound g.almost with
      | intro Bg hBg =>
          cases scaledErrorInt_reindex_linear f.almost
              (value_natAbs_linear_bound g.almost) with
          | intro Bfg hBfg =>
              cases scaledErrorInt_reindex_linear g.almost
                  (value_natAbs_linear_bound f.almost) with
              | intro Bgf hBgf =>
                  let K : Nat := ((Bfg + Bf) + Bgf) + Bg
                  refine Exists.intro K ?_
                  intro n
                  let t : Nat := n.natAbs + 1
                  have hrewrite := commutator_mul_self_eq f.toFun g.toFun n
                  rw [hrewrite]
                  have htri := natAbs_sub_sub_add_le
                    (scaledErrorInt f.toFun (g n) n)
                    (scaledErrorInt f.toFun n (g n))
                    (scaledErrorInt g.toFun (f n) n)
                    (scaledErrorInt g.toFun n (f n))
                  have hBfgN :
                      (scaledErrorInt f.toFun (g n) n).natAbs <= Bfg * t := by
                    unfold t
                    exact hBfg n n
                  have hBfN :
                      (scaledErrorInt f.toFun n (g n)).natAbs <= Bf * t := by
                    unfold t
                    exact hBf n (g n)
                  have hBgfN :
                      (scaledErrorInt g.toFun (f n) n).natAbs <= Bgf * t := by
                    unfold t
                    exact hBgf n n
                  have hBgN :
                      (scaledErrorInt g.toFun n (f n)).natAbs <= Bg * t := by
                    unfold t
                    exact hBg n (f n)
                  calc
                    (scaledErrorInt f.toFun (g n) n -
                        scaledErrorInt f.toFun n (g n) -
                        scaledErrorInt g.toFun (f n) n +
                        scaledErrorInt g.toFun n (f n)).natAbs
                        <=
                          (((scaledErrorInt f.toFun (g n) n).natAbs +
                            (scaledErrorInt f.toFun n (g n)).natAbs) +
                            (scaledErrorInt g.toFun (f n) n).natAbs) +
                            (scaledErrorInt g.toFun n (f n)).natAbs := htri
                    _ <= ((Bfg * t + Bf * t) + Bgf * t) + Bg * t :=
                      _root_.Nat.add_le_add
                        (_root_.Nat.add_le_add
                          (_root_.Nat.add_le_add hBfgN hBfN)
                          hBgfN)
                        hBgN
                    _ = K * (n.natAbs + 1) := by
                      unfold K t
                      rw [_root_.Nat.add_mul, _root_.Nat.add_mul,
                        _root_.Nat.add_mul]

name: commutator_finite
statement:
theorem commutator_finite (f g : AHom) :
    FiniteError (fun n : Int => f (g n) - g (f n))
proof:
:=
  finiteError_of_mul_self_linear (commutator_mul_self_linear f g)

name: positiveAHom_of_equiv
statement:
theorem positiveAHom_of_equiv {f g : AHom}
    (hfg : Equiv f g)
    (hf : PositiveAHom f) :
    PositiveAHom g
proof:
:= by
  cases hfg with
  | intro C hC =>
      intro B
      cases hf (B + C) with
      | intro n hn =>
          refine Exists.intro n ?_
          have hdiff : f ((n : Nat) : Int) - g ((n : Nat) : Int) <= C :=
            (hC.right ((n : Nat) : Int)).left
          omega

name: positiveAHom_iff_of_equiv
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (positiveAHom_of_equiv hfg)
    (positiveAHom_of_equiv (equiv_symm hfg))

name: positive_mk

name: not_positiveAHom_zero

name: not_positive_zero
statement: theorem not_positive_zero : Not (Positive (0 : EudoxusReal))

name: bounded_above_of_not_positiveAHom
proof:
:= by
  exact Classical.byContradiction (by
    intro hb
    apply h
    intro B
    exact Classical.byContradiction (by
      intro hB

name: bounded_below_of_not_positiveAHom_neg
