name: int_lt_toNat_add_one
statement:
theorem int_lt_toNat_add_one (z : Int) :
    z < (((z.toNat + 1 : Nat) : Int))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : z < 0
  · have hpos : (0 : Int) < (((z.toNat + 1 : Nat) : Int)) :=
      _root_.Int.natCast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos z.toNat)
    omega
  · have hznonneg : 0 <= z := _root_.Int.not_lt.mp hz
    have hcast : ((z.toNat : Nat) : Int) = z :=
      _root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hznonneg
    rw [_root_.Int.natCast_add, _root_.Int.ofNat_one, hcast]
    omega

name: neg_le_natAbs_cast
statement:
theorem neg_le_natAbs_cast (z : Int) :
    -z <= ((z.natAbs : Nat) : Int)
proof:
:= by
  have h := _root_.Int.le_natAbs (a := -z)
  rw [_root_.Int.natAbs_neg] at h
  exact h

name: positiveAHom_of_scaled_gt
statement:
theorem positiveAHom_of_scaled_gt {f : AHom} {B a : Nat}
    (hB : forall (k : Nat) (x : Int),
      (scaledErrorNat f.toFun k x).natAbs <= B * (k + 1))
    (hval : ((B : Nat) : Int) < f ((a : Nat) : Int)) :
    PositiveAHom f
proof:
:= by
  intro M
  let k : Nat := (M + ((B : Nat) : Int)).toNat + 1
  refine Exists.intro (k * a) ?_
  have hk_gt : M + ((B : Nat) : Int) < ((k : Nat) : Int) := by
    unfold k
    exact int_lt_toNat_add_one (M + ((B : Nat) : Int))
  let err : Int := scaledErrorNat f.toFun k ((a : Nat) : Int)
  have herrNat : err.natAbs <= B * (k + 1) := by
    unfold err
    exact hB k ((a : Nat) : Int)
  have herrNeg : -err <= (((B * (k + 1) : Nat) : Int)) :=
    _root_.Int.le_trans (neg_le_natAbs_cast err)
      (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr herrNat)
  have herrLower : -(((B * (k + 1) : Nat) : Int)) <= err := by
    omega
  have hfa : ((B : Nat) : Int) + 1 <= f ((a : Nat) : Int) := by
    omega
  have hkNonneg : 0 <= ((k : Nat) : Int) :=
    _root_.Int.natCast_nonneg k
  have hmul :
      ((k : Nat) : Int) * (((B : Nat) : Int) + 1) <=
        ((k : Nat) : Int) * f ((a : Nat) : Int) :=
    _root_.Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfa hkNonneg
  have hcastArg :
      (((k * a : Nat) : Int)) =
        ((k : Nat) : Int) * ((a : Nat) : Int) := by
    simp
  change M < f (((k * a : Nat) : Int))
  rw [hcastArg]
  have herrEq :
      err =
        f (((k : Nat) : Int) * ((a : Nat) : Int)) -
          ((k : Nat) : Int) * f ((a : Nat) : Int) := by
    rfl
  have hfEq :
      f (((k : Nat) : Int) * ((a : Nat) : Int)) =
        ((k : Nat) : Int) * f ((a : Nat) : Int) + err := by
    rw [herrEq]
    omega
  rw [hfEq]
  have hboundCast :
      (((B * (k + 1) : Nat) : Int)) =
        ((B : Nat) : Int) * (((k + 1 : Nat) : Int)) := by
    simp
  rw [hboundCast] at herrLower
  have hcalc :
      ((k : Nat) : Int) * (((B : Nat) : Int) + 1) -
        ((B : Nat) : Int) * (((k + 1 : Nat) : Int)) =
      ((k : Nat) : Int) - ((B : Nat) : Int) := by
    have hsucc :
        (((k + 1 : Nat) : Int)) = ((k : Nat) : Int) + 1 := by
      simp
    rw [hsucc]
    rw [_root_.Int.mul_add, _root_.Int.mul_add]
    rw [_root_.Int.mul_one, _root_.Int.mul_one]
    rw [_root_.Int.mul_comm ((k : Nat) : Int) ((B : Nat) : Int)]
    omega
  have hcomm :
      ((k : Nat) : Int) * ((B : Nat) : Int) =
        ((B : Nat) : Int) * ((k : Nat) : Int) := by
    rw [_root_.Int.mul_comm]
  omega

name: finiteError_of_nonneg_bounds
statement:
theorem finiteError_of_nonneg_bounds {f : AHom} {B C : Nat}
    (hupper : forall n : Nat, f ((n : Nat) : Int) <= ((B : Nat) : Int))
    (hlower : forall n : Nat, -f ((n : Nat) : Int) <= ((C : Nat) : Int)) :
    FiniteError (fun z : Int => f z)
proof:
:= by
  cases neg_add_value_natAbs_bound f.almost with
  | intro D hD =>
      let E : Nat := B + C + (D + D)
      apply FiniteError.of_natAbs_bound (B := E)
      intro z
      by_cases hz : 0 <= z
      · let n : Nat := z.toNat
        have hn : ((n : Nat) : Int) = z := by
          unfold n
          exact _root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hz
        have hup : f z <= ((B : Nat) : Int) := by
          rw [<- hn]
          exact hupper n
        have hlo : -f z <= ((C : Nat) : Int) := by
          rw [<- hn]
          exact hlower n
        have hmain := FiniteError.natAbs_le_of_bounds
          (z := f z) (B := ((E : Nat) : Int))
          (_root_.Int.natCast_nonneg E)
          (by
            unfold E
            omega)
          (by
            unfold E
            omega)
        have hcast : (((E : Nat) : Int).toNat) = E := by
          simp
        simpa [hcast] using hmain
      · have hnegz : 0 <= -z := by
          omega
        let n : Nat := (-z).toNat
        have hn : ((n : Nat) : Int) = -z := by
          unfold n
          exact _root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnegz
        have hzEq : z = -((n : Nat) : Int) := by
          rw [hn]
          omega
        let s : Int := f (-((n : Nat) : Int)) + f ((n : Nat) : Int)
        have hsNat : s.natAbs <= D + D := by
          unfold s
          exact hD ((n : Nat) : Int)
        have hsUp : s <= (((D + D : Nat) : Int)) :=
          _root_.Int.le_trans _root_.Int.le_natAbs
            (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hsNat)
        have hsLow : -s <= (((D + D : Nat) : Int)) :=
          _root_.Int.le_trans (neg_le_natAbs_cast s)
            (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hsNat)
        have hupPos : f ((n : Nat) : Int) <= ((B : Nat) : Int) :=
          hupper n
        have hloPos : -f ((n : Nat) : Int) <= ((C : Nat) : Int) :=
          hlower n
        have hup : f z <= ((E : Nat) : Int) := by
          rw [hzEq]
          unfold s at hsUp
          unfold E
          omega
        have hlo : -f z <= ((E : Nat) : Int) := by
          rw [hzEq]
          unfold s at hsLow
          unfold E
          omega
        have hmain := FiniteError.natAbs_le_of_bounds
          (z := f z) (B := ((E : Nat) : Int))
          (_root_.Int.natCast_nonneg E) hup hlo
        have hcast : (((E : Nat) : Int).toNat) = E := by
          simp
        simpa [hcast] using hmain

name: nonpos_on_nat_of_no_scaled_gt
statement:
theorem nonpos_on_nat_of_no_scaled_gt {f : AHom} {B : Nat}
    (h : Not (Exists (fun a : Nat =>
      ((B : Nat) : Int) < f ((a : Nat) : Int)))) :
    forall a : Nat, f ((a : Nat) : Int) <= ((B : Nat) : Int)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  apply _root_.Int.not_lt.mp
  intro ha
  exact h (Exists.intro a ha)

name: equiv_zero_of_nonneg_bounds
statement:
theorem equiv_zero_of_nonneg_bounds {f : AHom} {B C : Nat}
    (hupper : forall n : Nat, f ((n : Nat) : Int) <= ((B : Nat) : Int))
    (hlower : forall n : Nat, -f ((n : Nat) : Int) <= ((C : Nat) : Int)) :
    Equiv f zero
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun z : Int => f z)
  · intro z
    change f z = f z - (0 : Int)
    omega
  · exact finiteError_of_nonneg_bounds hupper hlower

name: positive_neg_mk_iff
statement:
theorem positive_neg_mk_iff (f : AHom) :
    Positive (-mk f) <-> PositiveAHom (neg f)
proof:
:= by

name: positive_zero_negative_trichotomy_mk
statement:
theorem positive_zero_negative_trichotomy_mk (f : AHom) :
    Or (Positive (mk f))
      (Or (mk f = (0 : EudoxusReal)) (Positive (-mk f)))
proof:
:= by
  cases scaledErrorNat_bound f.almost with
  | intro B hB =>
      by_cases hpos : Exists (fun a : Nat =>
        ((B : Nat) : Int) < f ((a : Nat) : Int))
      · cases hpos with
        | intro a ha =>
            exact Or.inl (positiveAHom_of_scaled_gt hB ha)
      · cases scaledErrorNat_bound (neg f).almost with
        | intro C hC =>
            by_cases hneg : Exists (fun a : Nat =>
              ((C : Nat) : Int) < (neg f) ((a : Nat) : Int))
            · cases hneg with
              | intro a ha =>
                  exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by
                    rw [positive_neg_mk_iff]
                    exact positiveAHom_of_scaled_gt hC ha))
            · have hupper :
                  forall n : Nat,
                    f ((n : Nat) : Int) <= ((B : Nat) : Int) :=
                nonpos_on_nat_of_no_scaled_gt hpos
              have hlower :
                  forall n : Nat,
                    -f ((n : Nat) : Int) <= ((C : Nat) : Int) := by
                intro n
                have hn := nonpos_on_nat_of_no_scaled_gt
                  (f := neg f) (B := C) hneg n
                exact hn
              exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by
                change mk f = mk zero
                exact mk_eq_mk (equiv_zero_of_nonneg_bounds hupper hlower)))

name: not_positiveAHom_and_neg
statement:
theorem not_positiveAHom_and_neg (f : AHom) :
    Not (And (PositiveAHom f) (PositiveAHom (neg f)))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  cases scaledErrorNat_bound f.almost with
  | intro B hB =>
      let T : Int := ((3 * B + 1 : Nat) : Int)
      cases h.left T with
      | intro a ha =>
          cases h.right T with
          | intro b hb =>
              have hf0Nat : (f 0).natAbs <= B := by
                have h0 := hB 0 0
                unfold scaledErrorNat at h0
                simp at h0
                exact h0
              have hf0Up : f 0 <= ((B : Nat) : Int) :=
                _root_.Int.le_trans _root_.Int.le_natAbs
                  (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hf0Nat)
              have hf0Low : -f 0 <= ((B : Nat) : Int) :=
                _root_.Int.le_trans (neg_le_natAbs_cast (f 0))
                  (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hf0Nat)
              have haPos : 0 < a := by
                cases a with
                | zero =>
                    change T < f 0 at ha
                    unfold T at ha
                    omega
                | succ a =>
                    exact Nat.succ_pos a
              have hbPos : 0 < b := by
                cases b with
                | zero =>
                    change T < (neg f) 0 at hb
                    change T < -f 0 at hb
                    unfold T at hb
                    omega
                | succ b =>
                    exact Nat.succ_pos b
              let errA : Int := scaledErrorNat f.toFun b ((a : Nat) : Int)
              let errB : Int := scaledErrorNat f.toFun a ((b : Nat) : Int)
              have herrANat : errA.natAbs <= B * (b + 1) := by
                unfold errA
                exact hB b ((a : Nat) : Int)
              have herrBNat : errB.natAbs <= B * (a + 1) := by
                unfold errB
                exact hB a ((b : Nat) : Int)
              have herrALower :
                  -(((B * (b + 1) : Nat) : Int)) <= errA := by
                have hneg : -errA <= (((B * (b + 1) : Nat) : Int)) :=
                  _root_.Int.le_trans (neg_le_natAbs_cast errA)
                    (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr herrANat)
                omega
              have herrBUpper :
                  errB <= (((B * (a + 1) : Nat) : Int)) :=
                _root_.Int.le_trans _root_.Int.le_natAbs
                  (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr herrBNat)
              have herrAEq :
                  errA =
                    f (((b : Nat) : Int) * ((a : Nat) : Int)) -
                      ((b : Nat) : Int) * f ((a : Nat) : Int) := by
                rfl
              have herrBEq :
                  errB =
                    f (((a : Nat) : Int) * ((b : Nat) : Int)) -
                      ((a : Nat) : Int) * f ((b : Nat) : Int) := by
                rfl
              have hleftEq :
                  f (((b : Nat) : Int) * ((a : Nat) : Int)) =
                    ((b : Nat) : Int) * f ((a : Nat) : Int) + errA := by
                rw [herrAEq]
                omega
              have hrightEq :
                  f (((a : Nat) : Int) * ((b : Nat) : Int)) =
                    ((a : Nat) : Int) * f ((b : Nat) : Int) + errB := by
                rw [herrBEq]
                omega
              have hsame :
                  ((b : Nat) : Int) * f ((a : Nat) : Int) + errA =
                    ((a : Nat) : Int) * f ((b : Nat) : Int) + errB := by
                have harg :
                    ((b : Nat) : Int) * ((a : Nat) : Int) =
                      ((a : Nat) : Int) * ((b : Nat) : Int) := by
                  rw [_root_.Int.mul_comm]
                rw [<- hleftEq, <- hrightEq]
                rw [harg]
              have hfaLower : T + 1 <= f ((a : Nat) : Int) := by
                omega
              have hfbUpper : f ((b : Nat) : Int) <= -(T + 1) := by
                change T < -f ((b : Nat) : Int) at hb
                omega
              have hmulLower :
                  ((b : Nat) : Int) * (T + 1) <=
                    ((b : Nat) : Int) * f ((a : Nat) : Int) :=
                _root_.Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                  hfaLower (_root_.Int.natCast_nonneg b)
              have hmulUpper :
                  ((a : Nat) : Int) * f ((b : Nat) : Int) <=
                    ((a : Nat) : Int) * (-(T + 1)) :=
                _root_.Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                  hfbUpper (_root_.Int.natCast_nonneg a)
              have hboundA :
                  (((B * (b + 1) : Nat) : Int)) =
                    ((B : Nat) : Int) * (((b + 1 : Nat) : Int)) := by
                simp
              have hboundB :
                  (((B * (a + 1) : Nat) : Int)) =
                    ((B : Nat) : Int) * (((a + 1 : Nat) : Int)) := by
                simp
              rw [hboundA] at herrALower
              rw [hboundB] at herrBUpper
              have hsuccA :
                  (((a + 1 : Nat) : Int)) = ((a : Nat) : Int) + 1 := by
                simp
              have hsuccB :
                  (((b + 1 : Nat) : Int)) = ((b : Nat) : Int) + 1 := by
                simp
              rw [hsuccA] at herrBUpper
              rw [hsuccB] at herrALower
              rw [_root_.Int.mul_add, _root_.Int.mul_one] at herrALower
              rw [_root_.Int.mul_add, _root_.Int.mul_one] at herrBUpper
              have hcommA :
                  ((a : Nat) : Int) * ((B : Nat) : Int) =
                    ((B : Nat) : Int) * ((a : Nat) : Int) := by
                rw [_root_.Int.mul_comm]
              have hcommB :
                  ((b : Nat) : Int) * ((B : Nat) : Int) =
                    ((B : Nat) : Int) * ((b : Nat) : Int) := by
                rw [_root_.Int.mul_comm]
              have hleftS :
                  ((b : Nat) : Int) * f ((a : Nat) : Int) + errA =
                    f (((a : Nat) : Int) * ((b : Nat) : Int)) := by
                calc
                  ((b : Nat) : Int) * f ((a : Nat) : Int) + errA =
                      ((a : Nat) : Int) * f ((b : Nat) : Int) + errB := hsame
                  _ = f (((a : Nat) : Int) * ((b : Nat) : Int)) := hrightEq.symm
              have hlowerRaw :
                  ((b : Nat) : Int) * (T + 1) -
                    (((B : Nat) : Int) * ((b : Nat) : Int) + ((B : Nat) : Int))
                    <=
                  ((b : Nat) : Int) * f ((a : Nat) : Int) + errA := by
                omega
              have hlowerPos :
                  0 <
                    ((b : Nat) : Int) * (T + 1) -
                      (((B : Nat) : Int) * ((b : Nat) : Int) + ((B : Nat) : Int)) := by
                have hcalc :
                    ((b : Nat) : Int) * (T + 1) -
                      (((B : Nat) : Int) * ((b : Nat) : Int) + ((B : Nat) : Int)) =
                    ((b : Nat) : Int) * (((2 * B + 2 : Nat) : Int)) -
                      ((B : Nat) : Int) := by
                  unfold T
                  simp
                  have hcoef :
                      (3 * ((B : Nat) : Int) + 1 + 1) =
                        (2 * ((B : Nat) : Int) + 2) + ((B : Nat) : Int) := by
                    omega
                  rw [hcoef]
                  rw [_root_.Int.mul_add]
                  rw [_root_.Int.mul_comm ((B : Nat) : Int) ((b : Nat) : Int)]
                  omega
                rw [hcalc]
                have hb1 : (1 : Int) <= ((b : Nat) : Int) :=
                  _root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hbPos
                have hcoefNonneg : 0 <= (((2 * B + 2 : Nat) : Int)) :=
                  _root_.Int.natCast_nonneg (2 * B + 2)
                have hmul :
                    (1 : Int) * (((2 * B + 2 : Nat) : Int)) <=
                      ((b : Nat) : Int) * (((2 * B + 2 : Nat) : Int)) :=
                  _root_.Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb1 hcoefNonneg
                have hcoefCast : (((2 * B + 2 : Nat) : Int)) =
                    2 * ((B : Nat) : Int) + 2 := by
                  simp
                have hprodCast :
                    ((b : Nat) : Int) * (((2 * B + 2 : Nat) : Int)) =
                      ((b : Nat) : Int) * (2 * ((B : Nat) : Int) + 2) := by
                  rw [hcoefCast]
                rw [hcoefCast] at hmul
                simp at hmul
                omega
              have hSpos :
                  0 < f (((a : Nat) : Int) * ((b : Nat) : Int)) := by
                rw [<- hleftS]
                omega
              have hrightS :
                  f (((a : Nat) : Int) * ((b : Nat) : Int)) =
                    ((a : Nat) : Int) * f ((b : Nat) : Int) + errB :=
                hrightEq
              have hupperRaw :
                  ((a : Nat) : Int) * f ((b : Nat) : Int) + errB <=
                    ((a : Nat) : Int) * (-(T + 1)) +
                      (((B : Nat) : Int) * ((a : Nat) : Int) + ((B : Nat) : Int)) := by
                omega
              have hupperNeg :
                  ((a : Nat) : Int) * (-(T + 1)) +
                      (((B : Nat) : Int) * ((a : Nat) : Int) + ((B : Nat) : Int)) <
                    0 := by
                have hcalc :
                    ((a : Nat) : Int) * (-(T + 1)) +
                        (((B : Nat) : Int) * ((a : Nat) : Int) + ((B : Nat) : Int)) =
                    -(((a : Nat) : Int) * (((2 * B + 2 : Nat) : Int))) +
                      ((B : Nat) : Int) := by
                  unfold T
                  simp
                  have hcoef :
                      (3 * ((B : Nat) : Int) + 1 + 1) =
                        (2 * ((B : Nat) : Int) + 2) + ((B : Nat) : Int) := by
                    omega
                  rw [hcoef]
                  rw [_root_.Int.neg_add]
                  rw [_root_.Int.mul_add]
                  rw [_root_.Int.mul_neg, _root_.Int.mul_neg]
                  rw [_root_.Int.mul_comm ((B : Nat) : Int) ((a : Nat) : Int)]
                  omega
                rw [hcalc]
                have ha1 : (1 : Int) <= ((a : Nat) : Int) :=
                  _root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr haPos
                have hcoefNonneg : 0 <= (((2 * B + 2 : Nat) : Int)) :=
                  _root_.Int.natCast_nonneg (2 * B + 2)
                have hmul :
                    (1 : Int) * (((2 * B + 2 : Nat) : Int)) <=
                      ((a : Nat) : Int) * (((2 * B + 2 : Nat) : Int)) :=
                  _root_.Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 hcoefNonneg
                have hcoefCast : (((2 * B + 2 : Nat) : Int)) =
                    2 * ((B : Nat) : Int) + 2 := by
                  simp
                have hprodCast :
                    ((a : Nat) : Int) * (((2 * B + 2 : Nat) : Int)) =
                      ((a : Nat) : Int) * (2 * ((B : Nat) : Int) + 2) := by
                  rw [hcoefCast]
                rw [hcoefCast] at hmul
                simp at hmul
                omega
              have hSneg :
                  f (((a : Nat) : Int) * ((b : Nat) : Int)) < 0 := by
                rw [hrightS]
                omega
              omega

name: positive_zero_negative_trichotomy
statement:
theorem positive_zero_negative_trichotomy (x : EudoxusReal) :
    Or (Positive x) (Or (x = (0 : EudoxusReal)) (Positive (-x)))
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quot.ind
    (β := fun x =>
      Or (Positive x) (Or (x = (0 : EudoxusReal)) (Positive (-x)))) ?_ x
  intro f
  exact positive_zero_negative_trichotomy_mk f

name: not_positive_and_negative_mk
statement:
theorem not_positive_and_negative_mk (f : AHom) :
    Not (And (Positive (mk f)) (Positive (-mk f)))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hf : PositiveAHom f := h.left
  have hneg : PositiveAHom (neg f) := by
    rw [positive_neg_mk_iff] at h
    exact h.right
  exact not_positiveAHom_and_neg f (And.intro hf hneg)

name: not_positive_and_negative
statement:
theorem not_positive_and_negative (x : EudoxusReal) :
    Not (And (Positive x) (Positive (-x)))
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quot.ind
    (β := fun x => Not (And (Positive x) (Positive (-x)))) ?_ x
  intro f
  exact not_positive_and_negative_mk f

name: positiveAHom_add
statement:
theorem positiveAHom_add {f g : AHom}
    (hf : PositiveAHom f)
    (hg : PositiveAHom g) :
    PositiveAHom (add f g)
proof:
:= by
  have hnotNeg : Not (PositiveAHom (neg g)) := by
    intro hneg
    exact not_positiveAHom_and_neg g (And.intro hg hneg)
  cases bounded_above_of_not_positiveAHom hnotNeg with
  | intro C hC =>
      intro B
      cases hf (B + C) with
      | intro n hn =>
          refine Exists.intro n ?_
          have hgLower : -g ((n : Nat) : Int) <= C := by
            have hCn := hC n
            change (neg g) ((n : Nat) : Int) <= C at hCn
            exact hCn
          change B < f ((n : Nat) : Int) + g ((n : Nat) : Int)
          omega

name: positive_add
statement:
theorem positive_add {x y : EudoxusReal}
    (hx : Positive x)
    (hy : Positive y) :
    Positive (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quot.ind
    (β := fun x => forall y : EudoxusReal,
      Positive x -> Positive y -> Positive (x + y)) ?_ x y hx hy
  intro f y
  refine _root_.Quot.ind
    (β := fun y =>
      Positive (mk f) -> Positive y -> Positive (mk f + y)) ?_ y
  intro g hf hg
  change PositiveAHom f at hf
  change PositiveAHom g at hg
  change PositiveAHom (add f g)
  exact positiveAHom_add hf hg

name: positiveAHom_eventually_gt
statement:
theorem positiveAHom_eventually_gt {f : AHom}
    (hf : PositiveAHom f) (B : Int) :
    Exists (fun N : Nat =>
      forall n : Nat, N <= n -> B < f ((n : Nat) : Int))
proof:
:= by
  have hnotNeg : Not (PositiveAHom (neg f)) := by
    intro hneg
    exact not_positiveAHom_and_neg f (And.intro hf hneg)
  cases bounded_above_of_not_positiveAHom hnotNeg with
  | intro C hC =>
      cases FiniteError.natAbs_bound f.almost with
      | intro D hD =>
          cases hf (B + C + ((D : Nat) : Int)) with
          | intro a ha =>
              refine Exists.intro a ?_
              intro n han
              let m : Nat := n - a
              have hsumNat : a + m = n := by
                unfold m
                exact Nat.add_sub_of_le han
              have harg :
                  ((a : Nat) : Int) + ((m : Nat) : Int) =
                    ((n : Nat) : Int) := by
                rw [<- _root_.Int.natCast_add]
                rw [hsumNat]
              have hmLower : -f ((m : Nat) : Int) <= C := by
                have hm := hC m
                change (neg f) ((m : Nat) : Int) <= C at hm
                exact hm
              have hdNat :
                  (defect f.toFun ((a : Nat) : Int) ((m : Nat) : Int)).natAbs <= D := by
                simpa using hD (((a : Nat) : Int), ((m : Nat) : Int))
              have hdLower :
                  -((D : Nat) : Int) <=
                    defect f.toFun ((a : Nat) : Int) ((m : Nat) : Int) := by
                have hneg :
                    -(defect f.toFun ((a : Nat) : Int) ((m : Nat) : Int)) <=
                      ((D : Nat) : Int) :=
                  _root_.Int.le_trans
                    (neg_le_natAbs_cast
                      (defect f.toFun ((a : Nat) : Int) ((m : Nat) : Int)))
                    (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hdNat)
                omega
              unfold defect at hdLower
              rw [harg] at hdLower
              omega

name: lt_def
statement:
theorem lt_def (x y : EudoxusReal) :
    x < y <-> Positive (y - x)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: le_def
statement:
theorem le_def (x y : EudoxusReal) :
    x <= y <-> Not (Positive (x - y))
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: lt_trichotomy
statement:
theorem lt_trichotomy (x y : EudoxusReal) :
    Or (x < y) (Or (x = y) (y < x))
proof:
:= by
  cases positive_zero_negative_trichotomy (y - x) with
  | inl hpos =>
      exact Or.inl hpos
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hzero =>
          exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by
            have hyx : y = x := eq_of_sub_eq_zero hzero
            exact hyx.symm))
      | inr hneg =>
          exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by
            rw [lt_def]
            rw [<- neg_sub y x]
            exact hneg))

name: lt_irrefl
statement: theorem lt_irrefl (x : EudoxusReal) : Not (x < x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def]
  rw [sub_self]
  exact not_positive_zero

name: le_refl
statement: theorem le_refl (x : EudoxusReal) : x <= x
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def]
  rw [sub_self]
  exact not_positive_zero

name: lt_asymm
statement:
theorem lt_asymm {x y : EudoxusReal} (hxy : x < y) :
    Not (y < x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at hxy
  intro hyx
  rw [lt_def] at hyx
  have hneg : Positive (-(y - x)) := by
    rw [neg_sub y x]
    exact hyx
  exact not_positive_and_negative (y - x) (And.intro hxy hneg)

name: lt_trans
statement:
theorem lt_trans {x y z : EudoxusReal}
    (hxy : x < y)
    (hyz : y < z) :
    x < z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at hxy hyz ⊢
  have hsum : Positive ((y - x) + (z - y)) :=
    positive_add hxy hyz
  rw [sub_add_sub_cancel x y z] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: lt_ne
statement: theorem lt_ne {x y : EudoxusReal} (hxy : x < y) : x ≠ y
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  subst h
  exact lt_irrefl x hxy

name: le_iff_not_gt
statement:
theorem le_iff_not_gt (x y : EudoxusReal) :
    x <= y <-> Not (y < x)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: le_total
statement:
theorem le_total (x y : EudoxusReal) :
    Or (x <= y) (y <= x)
proof:
:= by
  cases lt_trichotomy x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact Or.inl (by
        rw [le_iff_not_gt]
        exact lt_asymm hxy)
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hxy_eq =>
          exact Or.inl (by
            rw [hxy_eq]
            exact le_refl y)
      | inr hyx =>
          exact Or.inr (by
            rw [le_iff_not_gt]
            exact lt_asymm hyx)

name: not_le_of_lt
statement:
theorem not_le_of_lt {x y : EudoxusReal} (h : x < y) :
    Not (y <= x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_not_gt y x]
  intro hyx
  exact hyx h

name: le_of_lt
statement:
theorem le_of_lt {x y : EudoxusReal} (h : x < y) :
    x <= y
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_not_gt]
  exact lt_asymm h

name: not_lt_of_le
statement:
theorem not_lt_of_le {x y : EudoxusReal} (h : x <= y) :
    Not (y < x)
proof:
:=
  (le_iff_not_gt x y).mp h

name: le_trans
statement:
theorem le_trans {x y z : EudoxusReal}
    (hxy : x <= y)
    (hyz : y <= z) :
    x <= z
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_not_gt] at hxy hyz ⊢
  intro hzx
  cases lt_trichotomy y z with
  | inl hyzlt =>
      exact hxy (lt_trans hyzlt hzx)
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hyz_eq =>
          rw [<- hyz_eq] at hzx
          exact hxy hzx
      | inr hzy =>
          exact hyz hzy

name: le_antisymm
statement:
theorem le_antisymm {x y : EudoxusReal}
    (hxy : x <= y)
    (hyx : y <= x) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  cases lt_trichotomy x y with
  | inl hlt =>
      exact False.elim ((not_le_of_lt hlt) hyx)
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl heq =>
          exact heq
      | inr hgt =>
          exact False.elim ((not_le_of_lt hgt) hxy)

name: lt_iff_le_and_not_le
statement:
theorem lt_iff_le_and_not_le {x y : EudoxusReal} :
    x < y <-> And (x <= y) (Not (y <= x))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hxy
    exact And.intro (le_of_lt hxy) (not_le_of_lt hxy)
  · intro h
    by_cases hxy : x < y
    · exact hxy
    · exact False.elim (h.right (by
        rw [le_iff_not_gt]
        exact hxy))

name: add_lt_add_right
statement:
theorem add_lt_add_right {x y : EudoxusReal}
    (h : x < y)
    (z : EudoxusReal) :
    x + z < y + z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at h ⊢
  rw [sub_add_cancel_right x y z]
  exact h

name: add_lt_add_left
statement:
theorem add_lt_add_left {x y : EudoxusReal}
    (h : x < y)

proof:
:= by

name: add_le_add_right
statement:
theorem add_le_add_right {x y : EudoxusReal}
    (h : x <= y)
    (z : EudoxusReal) :
    x + z <= y + z
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def] at h ⊢
  rw [sub_add_cancel_right y x z]

name: add_le_add_left
statement:
theorem add_le_add_left {x y : EudoxusReal}
    (h : x <= y)
    (z : EudoxusReal) :

proof:
:= by

name: add_lt_add
statement:
theorem add_lt_add {w x y z : EudoxusReal}
    (hwx : w < x)
    (hyz : y < z) :
    w + y < x + z
proof:
:=
  lt_trans (add_lt_add_right hwx y) (add_lt_add_left hyz x)

name: add_le_add
statement:
theorem add_le_add {w x y z : EudoxusReal}
    (hwx : w <= x)
    (hyz : y <= z) :
    w + y <= x + z
proof:
:=
  le_trans (add_le_add_right hwx y) (add_le_add_left hyz x)

name: lt_of_add_lt_add_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at h ⊢
  rw [sub_add_cancel_right x y z] at h
  exact h

name: lt_of_add_lt_add_left
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at h ⊢
  rw [sub_add_cancel_left x y z] at h
  exact h

name: le_of_add_le_add_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def] at h ⊢
  rw [sub_add_cancel_right y x z] at h
  exact h

name: le_of_add_le_add_left
proof:
:= by

name: positive_one
statement: theorem positive_one : Positive (1 : EudoxusReal)
proof:
:= by
  change Positive (mk (ofIntAHom 1))
  intro B
  refine Exists.intro (B.toNat + 1) ?_
  change B < (1 : Int) * (((B.toNat + 1 : Nat) : Int))
  rw [_root_.Int.one_mul]
  exact int_lt_toNat_add_one B

name: zero_lt_one
statement: theorem zero_lt_one : (0 : EudoxusReal) < (1 : EudoxusReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def]
  rw [sub_zero]
  exact positive_one

name: zero_ne_one
statement: theorem zero_ne_one : (0 : EudoxusReal) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hlt : (0 : EudoxusReal) < 0 := by
    simpa [<- h] using zero_lt_one
  exact lt_irrefl 0 hlt

name: one_ne_zero
statement: theorem one_ne_zero : (1 : EudoxusReal) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact zero_ne_one h.symm

name: ofInt_sub
statement:
theorem ofInt_sub (a b : Int) :
    ofInt (a - b) = ofInt a - ofInt b
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [ofInt_add]
  rw [ofInt_neg]
  rfl

name: positive_ofInt_of_pos
statement:
theorem positive_ofInt_of_pos {a : Int} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Positive (ofInt a)
proof:
:= by
  change Positive (mk (ofIntAHom a))
  change PositiveAHom (ofIntAHom a)
  intro B
  refine Exists.intro (B.toNat + 1) ?_
  change B < a * (((B.toNat + 1 : Nat) : Int))
  have hBlt : B < (((B.toNat + 1 : Nat) : Int)) :=
    int_lt_toNat_add_one B
  have haOne : (1 : Int) <= a := by
    omega
  have hnonneg : 0 <= (((B.toNat + 1 : Nat) : Int)) :=
    _root_.Int.natCast_nonneg (B.toNat + 1)
  have hle_mul :
      (((B.toNat + 1 : Nat) : Int)) <=
        a * (((B.toNat + 1 : Nat) : Int)) := by
    have hmul :=
      _root_.Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right haOne hnonneg
    simpa [_root_.Int.one_mul] using hmul
  exact _root_.Int.lt_of_lt_of_le hBlt hle_mul

name: ofInt_lt_of_int_lt
statement:
theorem ofInt_lt_of_int_lt {a b : Int} (h : a < b) :
    ofInt a < ofInt b
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def]
  have hposInt : 0 < b - a := by
    omega
  have hpos := positive_ofInt_of_pos (a := b - a) hposInt
  have heq :
      ofInt b - ofInt a = ofInt (b - a) := by
    rw [ofInt_sub]
  rwa [heq]

name: int_pos_of_positive_ofInt
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : 0 < a
  · exact ha
  · have hanonpos : a <= 0 := _root_.Int.not_lt.mp ha
    change PositiveAHom (ofIntAHom a) at h
    cases h 0 with
    | intro n hn =>
        change (0 : Int) < a * (((n : Nat) : Int)) at hn
        have hnnonneg : 0 <= (((n : Nat) : Int)) :=
          _root_.Int.natCast_nonneg n
        have hnonpos :
            a * (((n : Nat) : Int)) <= 0 :=
          _root_.Int.mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hanonpos hnnonneg
        omega

name: int_lt_of_ofInt_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at h
  have hpos : 0 < b - a := by
    apply int_pos_of_positive_ofInt
    have heq :
        ofInt b - ofInt a = ofInt (b - a) := by
      rw [ofInt_sub]
    rwa [<- heq]
  omega

name: ofInt_lt_iff_lt
statement:
theorem ofInt_lt_iff_lt {a b : Int} :
    ofInt a < ofInt b <-> a < b
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro int_lt_of_ofInt_lt ofInt_lt_of_int_lt

name: ofInt_le_of_int_le
statement:
theorem ofInt_le_of_int_le {a b : Int} (h : a <= b) :
    ofInt a <= ofInt b
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_not_gt]
  intro hgt
  have hb_lt_a : b < a := int_lt_of_ofInt_lt hgt
  omega

name: int_le_of_ofInt_le
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hab : a <= b
  · exact hab
  · have hba : b < a := by
      omega
    have hgt : ofInt b < ofInt a :=
      ofInt_lt_of_int_lt hba
    exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_le h) hgt)

name: ofInt_le_iff_le
statement:
theorem ofInt_le_iff_le {a b : Int} :
    ofInt a <= ofInt b <-> a <= b
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro int_le_of_ofInt_le ofInt_le_of_int_le

name: ofInt_nonneg_of_int_nonneg
statement:
theorem ofInt_nonneg_of_int_nonneg {a : Int} (h : 0 <= a) :
    (0 : EudoxusReal) <= ofInt a
proof:
:= by
  rw [<- ofInt_zero]
  exact ofInt_le_of_int_le h

name: ofInt_pos_of_int_pos
statement:
theorem ofInt_pos_of_int_pos {a : Int} (h : 0 < a) :
    (0 : EudoxusReal) < ofInt a
proof:
:= by
  rw [<- ofInt_zero]
  exact ofInt_lt_of_int_lt h

name: defect_mulRaw_eq
statement:
theorem defect_mulRaw_eq (f g : Raw) (m n : Int) :
    defect (mulRaw f g) m n =
      (let dg : Int := defect g m n
       defect f (g m + g n) dg +
        defect f (g m) (g n) +
        f dg)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : g m + g n + (g (m + n) - g m - g n) = g (m + n) := by
    omega
  unfold defect mulRaw
  dsimp
  rw [hg]
  omega

name: comp_almost
statement:
theorem comp_almost (f g : AHom) :
    AlmostHom (mulRaw f.toFun g.toFun)
proof:
:= by
  let term1 : Int × Int -> Int :=
    fun p =>
      let dg : Int := defect g.toFun p.fst p.snd
      defect f.toFun (g p.fst + g p.snd) dg
  let term2 : Int × Int -> Int :=
    fun p => defect f.toFun (g p.fst) (g p.snd)
  let term3 : Int × Int -> Int :=
    fun p => f (defect g.toFun p.fst p.snd)
  have hterm1 : FiniteError term1 := by
    have h := FiniteError.reindex f.almost
      (fun p : Int × Int =>
        (g p.fst + g p.snd, defect g.toFun p.fst p.snd))
    exact h
  have hterm2 : FiniteError term2 := by
    have h := FiniteError.reindex f.almost
      (fun p : Int × Int => (g p.fst, g p.snd))
    exact h
  have hterm3 : FiniteError term3 :=
    FiniteError.map_int f.toFun g.almost
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun p : Int × Int => (term1 p + term2 p) + term3 p)
  · intro p
    have h := defect_mulRaw_eq f.toFun g.toFun p.fst p.snd
    unfold term1 term2 term3
    dsimp
    exact h.symm
  · exact FiniteError.add (FiniteError.add hterm1 hterm2) hterm3

name: mulRaw_diff_eq
statement:
theorem mulRaw_diff_eq (f1 f2 g1 g2 : Raw) (n : Int) :
    mulRaw f1 g1 n - mulRaw f2 g2 n =
      (let e : Int := g1 n - g2 n
       defect f1 (g2 n) e + f1 e + (f1 (g2 n) - f2 (g2 n)))
proof:
:= by
  have hg : g2 n + (g1 n - g2 n) = g1 n := by
    omega
  unfold mulRaw defect
  dsimp
  rw [hg]
  omega

name: comp_respects
statement:
theorem comp_respects {f1 f2 g1 g2 : AHom}
    (hf : Equiv f1 f2)
    (hg : Equiv g1 g2) :
    Equiv (mul f1 g1) (mul f2 g2)
proof:
:= by
  let term1 : Int -> Int :=
    fun n =>
      let e : Int := g1 n - g2 n
      defect f1.toFun (g2 n) e
  let term2 : Int -> Int :=
    fun n => f1 (g1 n - g2 n)
  let term3 : Int -> Int :=
    fun n => f1 (g2 n) - f2 (g2 n)
  have hterm1 : FiniteError term1 := by
    have h := FiniteError.reindex f1.almost
      (fun n : Int => (g2 n, g1 n - g2 n))
    exact h
  have hterm2 : FiniteError term2 :=
    FiniteError.map_int f1.toFun hg
  have hterm3 : FiniteError term3 := by
    have h := FiniteError.reindex hf (fun n : Int => g2 n)
    exact h
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun n => (term1 n + term2 n) + term3 n)
  · intro n
    have h := mulRaw_diff_eq f1.toFun f2.toFun g1.toFun g2.toFun n
    unfold term1 term2 term3 diff mul
    dsimp
    exact h.symm
  · exact FiniteError.add (FiniteError.add hterm1 hterm2) hterm3

name: mul_mk
statement: theorem mul_mk (f g : AHom) : mk f * mk g = mk (mul f g)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: ofInt_mul
statement:
theorem ofInt_mul (a b : Int) :
    ofInt (a * b) = ofInt a * ofInt b
proof:
:= by
  change mk (ofIntAHom (a * b)) = mk (mul (ofIntAHom a) (ofIntAHom b))
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun _ : Int => (0 : Int))
  · intro n
    change (0 : Int) = (a * b) * n - a * (b * n)
    rw [_root_.Int.mul_assoc]
    rw [_root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg]
    have hcancel := _root_.Int.add_neg_cancel_right 0 (a * (b * n))
    simpa [_root_.Int.zero_add] using hcancel.symm
  · exact FiniteError.zero

name: defect_zero
statement: theorem defect_zero : AlmostHom zeroRaw
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun _ : Int × Int => (0 : Int))
  · intro p
    unfold defect zeroRaw
    simp
  · exact FiniteError.zero

name: defect_add
statement:
theorem defect_add {f g : Raw}
    (hf : AlmostHom f)
    (hg : AlmostHom g) :
    AlmostHom (addRaw f g)
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun p : Int × Int => defect f p.fst p.snd + defect g p.fst p.snd)
  · intro p
    unfold defect addRaw
    simp [_root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Int.neg_add, _root_.Int.add_assoc,
      _root_.Int.add_left_comm]
  · exact FiniteError.add hf hg

name: defect_neg
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun p : Int × Int => -(defect f p.fst p.snd))
  · intro p
    unfold defect negRaw
    simp [_root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Int.neg_add, _root_.Int.add_assoc,
      _root_.Int.add_left_comm]
  · exact FiniteError.neg hf

name: equiv_refl
statement: theorem equiv_refl (f : AHom) : Equiv f f
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun _ : Int => (0 : Int))
  · intro n
    unfold diff
    rw [_root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg]
    have hcancel := _root_.Int.add_neg_cancel_right 0 (f n)
    simpa [_root_.Int.zero_add] using hcancel.symm
  · exact FiniteError.zero

name: equiv_of_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun _ : Int => (0 : Int))
  · intro n
    unfold diff
    rw [h n]
    rw [_root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg]
    have hcancel := _root_.Int.add_neg_cancel_right 0 (g n)
    simpa [_root_.Int.zero_add] using hcancel.symm
  · exact FiniteError.zero

name: equiv_symm
statement: theorem equiv_symm {f g : AHom} (h : Equiv f g) : Equiv g f
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun n => -(diff f g n))
  · intro n
    unfold diff
    rw [_root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp [_root_.Int.neg_add, _root_.Int.add_comm]
  · exact FiniteError.neg h

name: equiv_trans
statement:
theorem equiv_trans {f g h : AHom}
    (hfg : Equiv f g)
    (hgh : Equiv g h) :
    Equiv f h
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun n => diff f g n + diff g h n)
  · intro n
    unfold diff
    rw [_root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg]
    have hcancel : -g.toFun n + g.toFun n = 0 := by
      simpa [_root_.Int.zero_add] using (_root_.Int.neg_add_cancel_right 0 (g.toFun n))
    rw [_root_.Int.add_assoc (f.toFun n) (-g.toFun n) (g.toFun n + -h.toFun n)]
    rw [← _root_.Int.add_assoc (-g.toFun n) (g.toFun n) (-h.toFun n)]
    rw [hcancel, _root_.Int.zero_add]
  · exact FiniteError.add hfg hgh

    simp [_root_.Int.neg_add, _root_.Int.add_assoc, _root_.Int.add_left_comm]
  · exact FiniteError.add hf hg

statement: theorem ofInt_almost (a : Int) : AlmostHom (ofIntRaw a)

  · intro p

    rw [_root_.Int.add_neg_cancel_left]
    have hcancel := _root_.Int.add_neg_cancel_right 0 (a * p.snd)
    simpa [_root_.Int.zero_add] using hcancel.symm
  · exact FiniteError.zero

name: slope_upper_bound
statement:
theorem slope_upper_bound (f : AHom) :
    Exists (fun C : Nat =>
      forall n : Int,
        mk (mul (ofIntAHom n) f) <= ofInt (f n + ((C : Nat) : Int)))
proof:
:= by
  cases scaledErrorInt_bound f.almost with
  | intro D hD =>
      let C : Nat := D + 1
      refine Exists.intro C ?_
      intro n
      rw [le_def]
      change Not
        (PositiveAHom
          (sub (mul (ofIntAHom n) f)
            (ofIntAHom (f n + ((C : Nat) : Int)))))
      apply not_positiveAHom_of_nat_upper
      intro k
      let z : Int := ((k : Nat) : Int)
      let lhs : Int :=
        (sub (mul (ofIntAHom n) f)
          (ofIntAHom (f n + ((C : Nat) : Int)))) z
      let Bound : Int :=
        ((D * (n.natAbs + 1) + D : Nat) : Int)
      have herr1Nat :
          (scaledErrorInt f.toFun n z).natAbs <= D * (n.natAbs + 1) := by
        exact hD n z
      have herr1Lower :
          -(((D * (n.natAbs + 1) : Nat) : Int)) <=
            scaledErrorInt f.toFun n z := by
        have hneg :
            -(scaledErrorInt f.toFun n z) <=
              ((D * (n.natAbs + 1) : Nat) : Int) :=
          _root_.Int.le_trans
            (neg_le_natAbs_cast (scaledErrorInt f.toFun n z))
            (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr herr1Nat)
        omega
      have herr2Nat :
          (scaledErrorInt f.toFun z n).natAbs <= D * (z.natAbs + 1) := by
        exact hD z n
      have herr2Upper :
          scaledErrorInt f.toFun z n <=
            ((D * (k + 1) : Nat) : Int) := by
        have hzAbs : z.natAbs = k := by
          unfold z
          simp
        have hupper :
            scaledErrorInt f.toFun z n <=
              ((D * (z.natAbs + 1) : Nat) : Int) :=
          _root_.Int.le_trans _root_.Int.le_natAbs
            (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr herr2Nat)
        rw [hzAbs] at hupper
        exact hupper
      have hcomm : z * n = n * z := by
        rw [_root_.Int.mul_comm]
      have hrewrite :
          lhs =
            -scaledErrorInt f.toFun n z +
              scaledErrorInt f.toFun z n -
              ((C : Nat) : Int) * z := by
        unfold lhs
        change
          n * f.toFun z + -((f.toFun n + ((C : Nat) : Int)) * z) =
            -scaledErrorInt f.toFun n z +
              scaledErrorInt f.toFun z n -
              ((C : Nat) : Int) * z
        unfold scaledErrorInt
        rw [hcomm]
        rw [_root_.Int.add_mul]
        rw [_root_.Int.mul_comm z (f.toFun n)]
        omega
      have hcast :
          ((D * (k + 1) : Nat) : Int) -
              ((C : Nat) : Int) * z <=
            ((D : Nat) : Int) := by
        unfold C z
        rw [_root_.Nat.mul_add, _root_.Nat.mul_one]
        have hmul :
            (((D + 1 : Nat) : Int) * ((k : Nat) : Int)) =
              ((D * k + k : Nat) : Int) := by
          rw [<- _root_.Int.natCast_mul]
          congr
          rw [_root_.Nat.add_mul, _root_.Nat.one_mul]
        rw [hmul]
        simp
        omega
      change lhs <= Bound
      rw [hrewrite]
      unfold Bound
      have hleft :
          -scaledErrorInt f.toFun n z <=
            ((D * (n.natAbs + 1) : Nat) : Int) := by
        omega
      have hright :
          scaledErrorInt f.toFun z n -
              ((C : Nat) : Int) * z <=
            ((D : Nat) : Int) := by
        calc
          scaledErrorInt f.toFun z n - ((C : Nat) : Int) * z
              <= ((D * (k + 1) : Nat) : Int) -
                  ((C : Nat) : Int) * z := by
                exact _root_.Int.sub_le_sub_right herr2Upper
                  (((C : Nat) : Int) * z)
          _ <= ((D : Nat) : Int) := hcast
      omega

name: slope_lower_bound
statement:
theorem slope_lower_bound (f : AHom) :
    Exists (fun C : Nat =>
      forall n : Int,
        ofInt (f n - ((C : Nat) : Int)) <= mk (mul (ofIntAHom n) f))
proof:
:= by
  cases slope_upper_bound (neg f) with
  | intro C hC =>
      refine Exists.intro C ?_
      intro n
      have hneg :
          -(ofInt ((neg f) n + ((C : Nat) : Int))) <=
            -(mk (mul (ofIntAHom n) (neg f))) := by
        have hbase := hC n
        rw [le_def] at hbase ⊢
        simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_neg, add_comm] using hbase
      have hmulneg :
          mk (mul (ofIntAHom n) (neg f)) =
            -(mk (mul (ofIntAHom n) f)) := by
        rw [neg_mk]
        apply mk_eq_mk
        apply equiv_of_eq
        intro z
        change n * -(f z) = -(n * f z)
        rw [_root_.Int.mul_neg]
      rw [hmulneg, neg_neg] at hneg
      rw [<- ofInt_neg] at hneg
      have harg :
          -((neg f) n + ((C : Nat) : Int)) =
            f n - ((C : Nat) : Int) := by
        change -(-(f n) + ((C : Nat) : Int)) =
          f n - ((C : Nat) : Int)
        omega
      rw [harg] at hneg
      change
        ofInt (f n - ((C : Nat) : Int)) <=
          mk (mul (ofIntAHom n) f)
      exact hneg

name: finiteRangeBound_spec
statement:
theorem finiteRangeBound_spec (f : Int -> Int) :
    forall n (z : Int),
      z <= ((n : Nat) : Int) ->
      -z <= ((n : Nat) : Int) ->
      And (f z <= finiteRangeBound f n)
        (-f z <= finiteRangeBound f n)
  | 0, z, hz, hnz => by
      have hz0 : z = 0
proof:
:= by
        omega
      rw [hz0]
      exact And.intro (le_intAbs (f 0)) (neg_le_intAbs (f 0))
  | n + 1, z, hz, hnz => by
      by_cases hle_pos : z <= ((n : Nat) : Int)
      · by_cases hle_neg : -z <= ((n : Nat) : Int)
        · have ih := finiteRangeBound_spec f n z hle_pos hle_neg
          have hstep :
              finiteRangeBound f n <= finiteRangeBound f (n + 1) := by
            change finiteRangeBound f n <=
              finiteRangeBound f n +
                intAbs (f (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))) +
                intAbs (f (-(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))))
            have h1 := intAbs_nonneg (f (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int)))
            have h2 := intAbs_nonneg (f (-(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))))
            omega
          exact And.intro
            (_root_.Int.le_trans ih.left hstep)
            (_root_.Int.le_trans ih.right hstep)
        · have hzneg : z = -(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int)) := by
            omega
          constructor
          · rw [hzneg]
            change f (-(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))) <=
              finiteRangeBound f n +
                intAbs (f (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))) +
                intAbs (f (-(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))))
            have h0 := finiteRangeBound_nonneg f n
            have h1 := intAbs_nonneg (f (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int)))
            have hle := le_intAbs (f (-(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))))
            omega
          · rw [hzneg]
            change -f (-(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))) <=
              finiteRangeBound f n +
                intAbs (f (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))) +
                intAbs (f (-(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))))
            have h0 := finiteRangeBound_nonneg f n
            have h1 := intAbs_nonneg (f (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int)))
            have hle := neg_le_intAbs (f (-(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))))
            omega
      · have hzpos : z = (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int)) := by
          omega
        constructor
        · rw [hzpos]
          change f (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int)) <=
            finiteRangeBound f n +
              intAbs (f (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))) +
              intAbs (f (-(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))))
          have h0 := finiteRangeBound_nonneg f n
          have h2 := intAbs_nonneg (f (-(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))))
          have hle := le_intAbs (f (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int)))
          omega
        · rw [hzpos]
          change -f (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int)) <=
            finiteRangeBound f n +
              intAbs (f (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))) +
              intAbs (f (-(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))))
          have h0 := finiteRangeBound_nonneg f n
          have h2 := intAbs_nonneg (f (-(((n + 1 : Nat) : Int))))
          have hle := neg_le_intAbs (f (((n + 1 : Nat) : Int)))
          omega

name: map_int
proof:
:= by
  cases he with
  | intro B hB =>
      let n : Nat := B.toNat
      refine Exists.intro (finiteRangeBound f n)
        (And.intro (finiteRangeBound_nonneg f n) ?_)
      intro x
      have hBcast : ((n : Nat) : Int) = B := by
        unfold n
        exact _root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hB.left
      have hx_upper : e x <= ((n : Nat) : Int) := by
        rw [hBcast]
        exact (hB.right x).left
      have hx_lower : -e x <= ((n : Nat) : Int) := by
        rw [hBcast]
        exact (hB.right x).right
      exact finiteRangeBound_spec f n (e x) hx_upper hx_lower

name: sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
statement:
theorem sub_mul_eq_sub_mul (x y z : EudoxusReal) :
    (y - x) * z = y * z - x * z
proof:
:= by
  change (y + -x) * z = y * z + -(x * z)
  rw [add_mul]
  rw [neg_mul]

name: mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
statement:
theorem mul_sub_eq_mul_sub (x y z : EudoxusReal) :
    z * (y - x) = z * y - z * x
proof:
:= by
  change z * (y + -x) = z * y + -(z * x)
  rw [mul_add]
  rw [mul_neg]

name: positiveAHom_mul
statement:
theorem positiveAHom_mul {f g : AHom}
    (hf : PositiveAHom f)
    (hg : PositiveAHom g) :
    PositiveAHom (mul f g)
proof:
:= by
  intro B
  cases positiveAHom_eventually_gt hf B with
  | intro N hN =>
      cases hg ((N : Nat) : Int) with
      | intro n hn =>
          have hgn_nonneg : 0 <= g ((n : Nat) : Int) := by
            have hN_nonneg : 0 <= ((N : Nat) : Int) :=
              _root_.Int.natCast_nonneg N
            omega
          let m : Nat := (g ((n : Nat) : Int)).toNat
          have hm_cast : ((m : Nat) : Int) = g ((n : Nat) : Int) := by
            unfold m
            exact _root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hgn_nonneg
          have hNm : N <= m := by
            apply _root_.Int.ofNat_le.mp
            rw [hm_cast]
            exact _root_.Int.le_of_lt hn
          refine Exists.intro n ?_
          change B < f (g ((n : Nat) : Int))
          have hfm := hN m hNm
          rw [hm_cast] at hfm
          exact hfm

name: positive_mul
statement:
theorem positive_mul {x y : EudoxusReal}
    (hx : Positive x)
    (hy : Positive y) :
    Positive (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_ hx hy
  intro f g hf hg
  change PositiveAHom f at hf
  change PositiveAHom g at hg
  change PositiveAHom (mul f g)
  exact positiveAHom_mul hf hg

name: positive_of_zero_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at h
  rw [sub_zero] at h
  exact h

name: zero_lt_of_positive
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def]
  rw [sub_zero]
  exact h

name: mul_pos
statement:
theorem mul_pos {x y : EudoxusReal}
    (hx : (0 : EudoxusReal) < x)
    (hy : (0 : EudoxusReal) < y) :
    (0 : EudoxusReal) < x * y
proof:
:=
  zero_lt_of_positive
    (positive_mul (positive_of_zero_lt hx) (positive_of_zero_lt hy))

name: mul_lt_mul_pos_right
statement:
theorem mul_lt_mul_pos_right {x y z : EudoxusReal}
    (hxy : x < y)
    (hz : (0 : EudoxusReal) < z) :
    x * z < y * z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at hxy ⊢
  rw [<- sub_mul_eq_sub_mul x y z]
  exact positive_mul hxy (positive_of_zero_lt hz)

name: mul_lt_mul_pos_left
statement:
theorem mul_lt_mul_pos_left {x y z : EudoxusReal}
    (hxy : x < y)
    (hz : (0 : EudoxusReal) < z) :
    z * x < z * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm z x]
  rw [mul_comm z y]
  exact mul_lt_mul_pos_right hxy hz

name: lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right
statement:
theorem lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right {x y z : EudoxusReal}
    (h : x * z < y * z)
    (hz : (0 : EudoxusReal) < z) :
    x < y
proof:
:= by
  cases lt_trichotomy x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact hxy
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hxy_eq =>
          rw [hxy_eq] at h
          exact False.elim (lt_irrefl (y * z) h)
      | inr hyx =>
          have hyxz : y * z < x * z :=
            mul_lt_mul_pos_right hyx hz
          exact False.elim (lt_asymm hyxz h)

name: lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_left
statement:
theorem lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_left {x y z : EudoxusReal}
    (h : z * x < z * y)
    (hz : (0 : EudoxusReal) < z) :
    x < y
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right (z := z)
  · simpa [mul_comm x z, mul_comm y z] using h
  · exact hz

name: mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
statement:
theorem mul_le_mul_nonneg_right {x y z : EudoxusReal}
    (hxy : x <= y)
    (hz : (0 : EudoxusReal) <= z) :
    x * z <= y * z
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def] at hxy hz ⊢
  rw [<- sub_mul_eq_sub_mul y x z]
  intro hprod
  cases positive_zero_negative_trichotomy z with
  | inl hzpos =>
      cases positive_zero_negative_trichotomy (x - y) with
      | inl hdiffpos =>
          exact hxy hdiffpos
      | inr hrest =>
          cases hrest with
          | inl hzero =>
              rw [hzero] at hprod
              rw [zero_mul] at hprod
              exact not_positive_zero hprod
          | inr hdiffneg =>
              have hnegprod : Positive (-((x - y) * z)) := by
                rw [<- neg_mul]
                exact positive_mul hdiffneg hzpos
              exact not_positive_and_negative ((x - y) * z)
                (And.intro hprod hnegprod)
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hzero =>
          rw [hzero] at hprod
          rw [mul_zero] at hprod
          exact not_positive_zero hprod
      | inr hzneg =>
          exact hz (by
            rw [zero_sub]
            exact hzneg)

name: mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
statement:
theorem mul_le_mul_nonneg_left {x y z : EudoxusReal}
    (hxy : x <= y)
    (hz : (0 : EudoxusReal) <= z) :
    z * x <= z * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm z x]
  rw [mul_comm z y]
  exact mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hxy hz

name: mul_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_nonneg {x y : EudoxusReal}
    (hx : (0 : EudoxusReal) <= x)
    (hy : (0 : EudoxusReal) <= y) :
    (0 : EudoxusReal) <= x * y
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_le_mul_nonneg_right (x := 0) (y := x) (z := y) hx hy
  rw [zero_mul] at h
  exact h

name: threshold_spec
statement:
theorem threshold_spec (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f)
    (B : Int) :
    EventuallyAbove f B (threshold f hf B)
proof:
:= by
  unfold threshold
  exact Tautology.Nat.least_spec (EventuallyAbove f B)
    (positiveAHom_eventually_gt hf B)

name: threshold_min
statement:
theorem threshold_min (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f)
    (B : Int) {N : Nat}
    (hN : EventuallyAbove f B N) :
    threshold f hf B <= N
proof:
:= by
  unfold threshold
  exact Tautology.Nat.least_min (EventuallyAbove f B)
    (positiveAHom_eventually_gt hf B) hN

name: threshold_value_gt
statement:
theorem threshold_value_gt (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f)
    (B : Int) :
    B < f (((threshold f hf B : Nat) : Int))
proof:
:= by
  exact threshold_spec f hf B (threshold f hf B) (_root_.Nat.le_refl _)

name: threshold_prev_le
statement:
theorem threshold_prev_le (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f)
    (B : Int)
    (hpos : 0 < threshold f hf B) :
    f ((((threshold f hf B - 1 : Nat) : Nat) : Int)) <= B
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.Int.not_lt.mp
  intro hgt
  let N : Nat := threshold f hf B
  let M : Nat := N - 1
  have hgtM : B < f ((M : Nat) : Int) := by
    unfold M N
    exact hgt
  have hMprop : EventuallyAbove f B M := by
    intro n hMn
    by_cases hnM : n = M
    · rw [hnM]
      exact hgtM
    · have hNn : N <= n := by
        unfold M at hMn
        omega
      exact threshold_spec f hf B n hNn
  have hleast : N <= M := by
    unfold N
    exact threshold_min f hf B hMprop
  have hMlt : M < N := by
    unfold M
    omega
  have hcontra : False := by omega
  exact False.elim hcontra

name: threshold_value_upper_nonneg
statement:
theorem threshold_value_upper_nonneg (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f) :
    Exists (fun C : Nat =>
      forall B : Int,
        0 <= B ->
        f (((threshold f hf B : Nat) : Int)) <= B + ((C : Nat) : Int))
proof:
:= by
  cases FiniteError.natAbs_bound f.almost with
  | intro D hD =>
      let C : Nat := D + (f 1).natAbs + (f 0).natAbs
      refine Exists.intro C ?_
      intro B hBnonneg
      let N : Nat := threshold f hf B
      change f ((N : Nat) : Int) <= B + ((C : Nat) : Int)
      by_cases hNzero : N = 0
      · rw [hNzero]
        change f 0 <= B + ((C : Nat) : Int)
        have hf0_up : f 0 <= (((f 0).natAbs : Nat) : Int) :=
          _root_.Int.le_natAbs
        unfold C
        omega
      · have hNpos : 0 < N := _root_.Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hNzero
        let M : Nat := N - 1
        have hMN : M + 1 = N := by
          unfold M
          omega
        have hprev : f (((M : Nat) : Int)) <= B := by
          unfold M N
          exact threshold_prev_le f hf B hNpos
        have hdefNat :
            (defect f.toFun ((M : Nat) : Int) 1).natAbs <= D := by
          simpa using hD (((M : Nat) : Int), (1 : Int))
        have hdefUp :
            defect f.toFun ((M : Nat) : Int) 1 <= ((D : Nat) : Int) :=
          _root_.Int.le_trans _root_.Int.le_natAbs
            (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hdefNat)
        have harg :
            ((N : Nat) : Int) = ((M : Nat) : Int) + 1 := by
          rw [<- hMN]
          simp
        have hf1_up : f 1 <= (((f 1).natAbs : Nat) : Int) :=
          _root_.Int.le_natAbs
        unfold defect at hdefUp
        rw [<- harg] at hdefUp
        unfold C
        omega

name: threshold_error_bound_nonneg
statement:
theorem threshold_error_bound_nonneg (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f) :
    Exists (fun C : Nat =>
      forall B : Int,
        0 <= B ->
        And
          (f (((threshold f hf B : Nat) : Int)) - B <= ((C : Nat) : Int))
          (-(f (((threshold f hf B : Nat) : Int)) - B) <=
            ((C : Nat) : Int)))
proof:
:= by
  cases threshold_value_upper_nonneg f hf with
  | intro C hC =>
      refine Exists.intro C ?_
      intro B hB
      have hupper := hC B hB
      have hlower := threshold_value_gt f hf B
      constructor
      · omega
      · omega

name: invPosRaw_nonneg_value
statement:
theorem invPosRaw_nonneg_value (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f)
    {z : Int} (hz : 0 <= z) :
    invPosRaw f hf z = ((threshold f hf z : Nat) : Int)
proof:
:= by
  unfold invPosRaw
  simp [hz]

name: invPosRaw_neg_value
statement:
theorem invPosRaw_neg_value (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f)
    {z : Int} (hz : Not (0 <= z)) :
    invPosRaw f hf z = -(((threshold f hf (-z) : Nat) : Int))
proof:
:= by
  unfold invPosRaw
  simp [hz]

name: invPosRaw_comp_error_finite
statement:
theorem invPosRaw_comp_error_finite (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f) :
    FiniteError (fun z : Int => f (invPosRaw f hf z) - z)
proof:
:= by
  cases threshold_error_bound_nonneg f hf with
  | intro C hC =>
      cases neg_add_value_natAbs_bound f.almost with
      | intro D hD =>
          let K : Nat := C + (D + D)
          apply FiniteError.of_natAbs_bound (B := K)
          intro z
          by_cases hz : 0 <= z
          · have hraw := invPosRaw_nonneg_value f hf hz
            have hbound := hC z hz
            rw [hraw]
            have hmain :=
              FiniteError.natAbs_le_of_bounds
                (z := f (((threshold f hf z : Nat) : Int)) - z)
                (B := ((K : Nat) : Int))
                (_root_.Int.natCast_nonneg K)
                (by
                  unfold K
                  omega)
                (by
                  unfold K
                  omega)
            have hcast : (((K : Nat) : Int).toNat) = K := by
              simp
            simpa [hcast] using hmain
          · have hneg_nonneg : 0 <= -z := by omega
            let N : Nat := threshold f hf (-z)
            let s : Int := f (-((N : Nat) : Int)) + f ((N : Nat) : Int)
            let e : Int := f ((N : Nat) : Int) - (-z)
            have hraw := invPosRaw_neg_value f hf hz
            have hbound := hC (-z) hneg_nonneg
            have hsNat : s.natAbs <= D + D := by
              unfold s N
              exact hD (((threshold f hf (-z) : Nat) : Int))
            have hsUp : s <= (((D + D : Nat) : Int)) :=
              _root_.Int.le_trans _root_.Int.le_natAbs
                (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hsNat)
            have hsLow : -s <= (((D + D : Nat) : Int)) :=
              _root_.Int.le_trans (neg_le_natAbs_cast s)
                (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hsNat)
            have heUp : e <= ((C : Nat) : Int) := by
              unfold e N
              exact hbound.left
            have heLow : -e <= ((C : Nat) : Int) := by
              unfold e N
              exact hbound.right
            have hrewrite :
                f (invPosRaw f hf z) - z = s - e := by
              rw [hraw]
              unfold s e N
              omega
            rw [hrewrite]
            have hmain :=
              FiniteError.natAbs_le_of_bounds
                (z := s - e)
                (B := ((K : Nat) : Int))
                (_root_.Int.natCast_nonneg K)
                (by
                  unfold K
                  omega)
                (by
                  unfold K
                  omega)
            have hcast : (((K : Nat) : Int).toNat) = K := by
              simp
            simpa [hcast] using hmain

name: positiveAHom_preimage_bounds
statement:
theorem positiveAHom_preimage_bounds (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f)
    (C : Nat) :
    Exists (fun N : Nat =>
      forall z : Int,
        f z <= ((C : Nat) : Int) ->
        -f z <= ((C : Nat) : Int) ->
        And (z <= ((N : Nat) : Int)) (-z <= ((N : Nat) : Int)))
proof:
:= by
  cases neg_add_value_natAbs_bound f.almost with
  | intro D hD =>
      let S : Nat := D + D
      cases positiveAHom_eventually_gt (f := f) hf ((C : Nat) : Int) with
      | intro Npos hNpos =>
          cases positiveAHom_eventually_gt (f := f) hf (((C + S : Nat) : Int)) with
          | intro Nneg hNneg =>
              let N : Nat := Npos + Nneg
              refine Exists.intro N ?_
              intro z hzUpper hzLower
              constructor
              · by_cases hzN : z <= ((N : Nat) : Int)
                · exact hzN
                · have hzPos : 0 <= z := by
                    have hNnonneg : 0 <= ((N : Nat) : Int) :=
                      _root_.Int.natCast_nonneg N
                    omega
                  let n : Nat := z.toNat
                  have hnCast : ((n : Nat) : Int) = z := by
                    unfold n
                    exact _root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hzPos
                  have hNpos_le : Npos <= n := by
                    apply _root_.Int.ofNat_le.mp
                    rw [hnCast]
                    unfold N at hzN
                    omega
                  have hbig := hNpos n hNpos_le
                  rw [hnCast] at hbig
                  exact False.elim (by omega)
              · by_cases hnegN : -z <= ((N : Nat) : Int)
                · exact hnegN
                · have hnegPos : 0 <= -z := by
                    have hNnonneg : 0 <= ((N : Nat) : Int) :=
                      _root_.Int.natCast_nonneg N
                    omega
                  let n : Nat := (-z).toNat
                  have hnCast : ((n : Nat) : Int) = -z := by
                    unfold n
                    exact _root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnegPos
                  have hzEq : z = -((n : Nat) : Int) := by
                    rw [hnCast]
                    omega
                  have hNneg_le : Nneg <= n := by
                    apply _root_.Int.ofNat_le.mp
                    rw [hnCast]
                    unfold N at hnegN
                    omega
                  have hbig := hNneg n hNneg_le
                  let s : Int := f (-((n : Nat) : Int)) + f ((n : Nat) : Int)
                  have hsNat : s.natAbs <= S := by
                    unfold s S
                    exact hD ((n : Nat) : Int)
                  have hsUp : s <= ((S : Nat) : Int) :=
                    _root_.Int.le_trans _root_.Int.le_natAbs
                      (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hsNat)
                  have hzLower' : -((C : Nat) : Int) <= f z := by
                    omega
                  have hsumGt : ((S : Nat) : Int) < s := by
                    unfold s
                    rw [<- hzEq]
                    have hCS :
                        (((C + S : Nat) : Int)) =
                          ((C : Nat) : Int) + ((S : Nat) : Int) := by
                      simp
                    rw [hCS] at hbig
                    omega
                  exact False.elim (by omega)

name: finiteError_of_positiveAHom_comp
proof:
:= by
  cases FiniteError.natAbs_bound hh with
  | intro C hC =>
      cases positiveAHom_preimage_bounds f hf C with
      | intro N hN =>
          apply FiniteError.of_natAbs_bound (B := N)
          intro x
          have hfx := hC x
          have hUpper : f (h x) <= ((C : Nat) : Int) :=
            _root_.Int.le_trans _root_.Int.le_natAbs
              (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hfx)
          have hLower : -f (h x) <= ((C : Nat) : Int) :=
            _root_.Int.le_trans (neg_le_natAbs_cast (f (h x)))
              (_root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hfx)
          have hb := hN (h x) hUpper hLower
          have hmain := FiniteError.natAbs_le_of_bounds
            (z := h x) (B := ((N : Nat) : Int))
            (_root_.Int.natCast_nonneg N) hb.left hb.right
          have hcast : (((N : Nat) : Int).toNat) = N := by
            simp
          simpa [hcast] using hmain

name: invPosRaw_defect_comp_finite
statement:
theorem invPosRaw_defect_comp_finite (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f) :
    FiniteError
      (fun p : Prod Int Int =>
        f (defect (invPosRaw f hf) p.fst p.snd))
proof:
:= by
  let h : Raw := invPosRaw f hf
  let e : Int -> Int := fun n => f (h n) - n
  let term : Prod Int Int -> Int :=
    fun p =>
      e (p.fst + p.snd) - e p.fst - e p.snd -
        defect f.toFun (h p.fst) (h p.snd) -
        defect f.toFun (h p.fst + h p.snd) (defect h p.fst p.snd)
  have he : FiniteError e := by
    unfold e h
    exact invPosRaw_comp_error_finite f hf
  have hterm : FiniteError term := by
    have h1 : FiniteError (fun p : Prod Int Int => e (p.fst + p.snd)) :=
      FiniteError.reindex he (fun p : Prod Int Int => p.fst + p.snd)
    have h2 : FiniteError (fun p : Prod Int Int => e p.fst) :=
      FiniteError.reindex he (fun p : Prod Int Int => p.fst)
    have h3 : FiniteError (fun p : Prod Int Int => e p.snd) :=
      FiniteError.reindex he (fun p : Prod Int Int => p.snd)
    have h4 :
        FiniteError
          (fun p : Prod Int Int =>
            defect f.toFun (h p.fst) (h p.snd)) :=
      FiniteError.reindex f.almost
        (fun p : Prod Int Int => (h p.fst, h p.snd))
    have h5 :
        FiniteError
          (fun p : Prod Int Int =>
            defect f.toFun (h p.fst + h p.snd)
              (defect h p.fst p.snd)) :=
      FiniteError.reindex f.almost
        (fun p : Prod Int Int =>
          (h p.fst + h p.snd, defect h p.fst p.snd))
    exact FiniteError.sub
      (FiniteError.sub
        (FiniteError.sub
          (FiniteError.sub h1 h2)
          h3)
        h4)
      h5
  apply FiniteError.congr (e := term)
  · intro p
    change term p = f (defect h p.fst p.snd)
    have harg :
        h p.fst + h p.snd +
            (h (p.fst + p.snd) - h p.fst - h p.snd) =
          h (p.fst + p.snd) := by
      omega
    unfold term e defect
    rw [harg]
    omega
  · exact hterm

name: invPosRaw_almost
statement:
theorem invPosRaw_almost (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f) :
    AlmostHom (invPosRaw f hf)
proof:
:= by
  exact finiteError_of_positiveAHom_comp
    (alpha := Prod Int Int) f hf
    (h := fun p : Prod Int Int => defect (invPosRaw f hf) p.fst p.snd)
    (invPosRaw_defect_comp_finite f hf)

name: mul_invPosAHom_equiv_one
statement:
theorem mul_invPosAHom_equiv_one (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f) :
    Equiv (mul f (invPosAHom f hf)) (ofIntAHom 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteError.congr
    (e := fun n : Int => f (invPosRaw f hf n) - n)
  · intro n
    change
      f (invPosRaw f hf n) - n =
        f (invPosRaw f hf n) - ((1 : Int) * n)
    rw [_root_.Int.one_mul]
  · exact invPosRaw_comp_error_finite f hf

name: mul_invPosAHom_mk
statement:
theorem mul_invPosAHom_mk (f : AHom) (hf : PositiveAHom f) :
    mk f * mk (invPosAHom f hf) = (1 : EudoxusReal)
proof:
:= by
  change mk (mul f (invPosAHom f hf)) = (1 : EudoxusReal)
  rw [<- ofInt_one]
  change mk (mul f (invPosAHom f hf)) = mk (ofIntAHom 1)
  exact mk_eq_mk (mul_invPosAHom_equiv_one f hf)

name: exists_right_inv_of_positive
proof:
:= by
  refine @_root_.Quot.ind AHom ahomSetoid.r
    (fun x => Positive x -> Exists (fun y : EudoxusReal => x * y = 1))
    ?_ x hx
  intro f hf
  change PositiveAHom f at hf
  exact Exists.intro (mk (invPosAHom f hf))
    (mul_invPosAHom_mk f hf)

name: exists_right_inv_of_negative
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_right_inv_of_positive hx with
  | intro y hy =>
      refine Exists.intro (-y) ?_
      calc
        x * (-y) = -(x * y) := by rw [mul_neg]
        _ = (-x) * y := by rw [neg_mul]
        _ = 1 := hy

name: exists_mul_inverse_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  cases positive_zero_negative_trichotomy x with
  | inl hpos =>
      cases exists_right_inv_of_positive hpos with
      | intro y hy =>
          exact Exists.intro y (And.intro hy (by
            rw [mul_comm]
            exact hy))
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hzero =>
          exact False.elim (hx hzero)
      | inr hneg =>
          cases exists_right_inv_of_negative hneg with
          | intro y hy =>
              exact Exists.intro y (And.intro hy (by
                rw [mul_comm]
                exact hy))

name: inv_zero
statement: theorem inv_zero : Inv.inv (0 : EudoxusReal) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change inv 0 = 0
  unfold inv
  simp

name: mul_inv_cancel
statement:
theorem mul_inv_cancel {x : EudoxusReal} (hx : Not (x = 0)) :
    x * Inv.inv x = 1
proof:
:= by
  change x * inv x = 1
  unfold inv
  simp [hx, (Classical.choose_spec (exists_mul_inverse_of_ne_zero hx)).left]

name: inv_mul_cancel
statement:
theorem inv_mul_cancel {x : EudoxusReal} (hx : Not (x = 0)) :
    Inv.inv x * x = 1
proof:
:= by
  change inv x * x = 1
  unfold inv
  simp [hx, (Classical.choose_spec (exists_mul_inverse_of_ne_zero hx)).right]

name: neg_mul_mk
statement:
theorem neg_mul_mk (u v : RegularSeq) :
    (-mk u) * mk v = -(mk u * mk v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_neg]
  rw [mk_mul]
  rw [mk_mul]
  rw [mk_neg]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  have hleft :
      Equiv (mulRegularSeq (negRegularSeq u) v).seq
        (mulSeq (negSeq u.seq) v.seq) :=
    productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise (negRegularSeq u) v
  have hpoint :
      Equiv (mulSeq (negSeq u.seq) v.seq)
        (negSeq (mulSeq u.seq v.seq)) := by
    apply equiv_of_eq
    intro n
    unfold mulSeq negSeq
    rw [_root_.Rat.neg_mul]
  have hright :
      Equiv (negSeq (mulSeq u.seq v.seq))
        (negRegularSeq (mulRegularSeq u v)).seq :=
    equiv_symm (negSeq_respects (productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise u v))
  exact equiv_trans hleft (equiv_trans hpoint hright)

name: neg_mul
statement:
theorem neg_mul (x y : CauchyReal) :
    (-x) * y = -(x * y)
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
  intro u v
  change (-mk u) * mk v = -(mk u * mk v)
  exact neg_mul_mk u v

name: mul_neg
statement:
theorem mul_neg (x y : CauchyReal) :
    x * (-y) = -(x * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm x (-y)]
  rw [neg_mul y x]
  rw [mul_comm y x]

name: neg_mul_neg
statement:
theorem neg_mul_neg (x y : CauchyReal) :
    (-x) * (-y) = x * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_mul x (-y)]
  rw [mul_neg x y]
  rw [neg_neg]

name: lt_add_of_sub_lt
proof:
:= by
  have h' := add_lt_add_right h y
  have hleft : (x - y) + y = x := by
    change (x + -y) + y = x
    exact add_neg_cancel_right x y
  have hright : z + y = y + z := by
    rw [add_comm]
  rwa [hleft, hright] at h'

name: exists_rat_below
statement:
theorem exists_rat_below (x : CauchyReal) :
    Exists (fun q : Rat => ofRat q < x)
proof:
:= by
  let u := rep x
  refine Exists.intro (u.seq 0 - (2 : Rat) * gauge 0) ?_
  have hmk : mk u = x := by
    unfold u
    exact mk_rep x
  have h := term_sub_two_gauge_lt_mk u 0
  rwa [hmk] at h

name: exists_rat_above
statement:
theorem exists_rat_above (x : CauchyReal) :

  rwa [hmk] at h

name: lower_downward
proof:
:= by
  cases hq with

name: lower_no_greatest
proof:
:= by
  cases hq with
  | intro x hx =>
      cases exists_rat_between hx.right with
      | intro r hr =>
          exact Exists.intro r
            (And.intro (Exists.intro x (And.intro hx.left hr.right))

name: not_ratUpper_of_lower
proof:
:= by
  intro hu
  cases hq with
  | intro x hx =>
      exact not_le_of_lt hx.right (hu x hx.left)

name: lower_of_not_ratUpper
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hLower : LowerMem S q
  · exact hLower
  · exact False.elim (hnot (by
      intro x hx
      by_cases hxq : x <= ofRat q
      · exact hxq
      · cases le_total (ofRat q) x with
        | inl hqx =>
            have hlt : ofRat q < x := by
              rw [lt_iff_le_and_not_le]
              exact And.intro hqx hxq
            exact False.elim
              (hLower (Exists.intro x (And.intro hx hlt)))
        | inr hxq' =>
            exact hxq'))

name: ratUpper_of_not_lower
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_cases hxq : x <= ofRat q
  · exact hxq
  · cases le_total (ofRat q) x with
    | inl hqx =>
        have hlt : ofRat q < x := by
          rw [lt_iff_le_and_not_le]
          exact And.intro hqx hxq
        exact False.elim (hnot (Exists.intro x (And.intro hx hlt)))
    | inr hxq' =>
        exact hxq'

name: rat_step_succ_sub
proof:
:= by
  rw [<- hk]
  change (Rat.step l delta k + delta) - Rat.step l delta k = delta
  rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm (Rat.step l delta k + delta)
    (-(Rat.step l delta k))]
  rw [<- _root_.Rat.add_assoc]
  rw [_root_.Rat.neg_add_cancel]
  rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add]

name: exists_ratApprox
statement:
theorem exists_ratApprox (S : CauchyReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : CauchyReal => x <= y) S))
    {eps : Rat} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    Exists (fun _ : RatApprox S eps => True)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases hne with
  | intro x0 hx0 =>
      cases exists_rat_below x0 with
      | intro l hlx =>
          cases hbdd with
          | intro U hU =>
              cases exists_rat_above U with
              | intro u hUu =>
                  have hlower : LowerMem S l :=
                    Exists.intro x0 (And.intro hx0 hlx)
                  have hupper : RatUpper S u := by
                    intro x hx
                    exact le_trans (hU x hx) (le_of_lt hUu)
                  let delta : Rat := eps / 2
                  have hdelta_pos : 0 < delta :=
                    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.half_pos heps
                  have hdelta_lt : delta < eps :=
                    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.half_lt heps
                  have hstep_exists :
                      Exists (fun k : Nat => u < Rat.step l delta k) :=
                    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_step_gt l u delta hdelta_pos
                  let P : Nat -> Prop :=
                    fun k => RatUpper S (Rat.step l delta k)
                  have hP_exists : Exists P := by
                    cases hstep_exists with
                    | intro K hK =>
                        refine Exists.intro K ?_
                        intro x hx
                        have hxU : x <= ofRat u := hupper x hx
                        have huK : ofRat u < ofRat (Rat.step l delta K) :=
                          ofRat_lt_of_lt hK
                        exact le_trans hxU (le_of_lt huK)
                  let K := Tautology.Nat.least P hP_exists
                  have hK : P K := Tautology.Nat.least_spec P hP_exists
                  have hKmin : forall k : Nat, P k -> K <= k := by
                    intro k hk
                    exact Tautology.Nat.least_min P hP_exists hk
                  have hKne : Not (K = 0) := by
                    intro hK0
                    have hP0 : P 0 := by
                      rw [hK0] at hK
                      exact hK
                    have hstep0 : Rat.step l delta 0 = l := rfl
                    have hupper_l : RatUpper S l := by
                      intro x hx
                      have h := hP0 x hx
                      rwa [hstep0] at h
                    exact not_ratUpper_of_lower hlower hupper_l
                  have hKpos : 0 < K := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hKne
                  let k : Nat := K - 1
                  have hk_succ : k + 1 = K := by
                    dsimp [k]
                    omega
                  have hprev_not : Not (P k) := by
                    intro hkP
                    have hmin := hKmin k hkP
                    dsimp [k] at hmin
                    omega
                  have hprev_lower :
                      LowerMem S (Rat.step l delta k) :=
                    lower_of_not_ratUpper hprev_not
                  have hgap :
                      Rat.step l delta K - Rat.step l delta k < eps := by
                    rw [rat_step_succ_sub l delta hk_succ]
                    exact hdelta_lt
                  refine Exists.intro
                    { lower := Rat.step l delta k
                      upper := Rat.step l delta K
                      lower_mem := hprev_lower
                      upper_bound := hK
                      gap_lt := hgap } ?_
                  exact True.intro

name: approxLower_mem
statement:
theorem approxLower_mem (S : CauchyReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)

statement:
theorem approxUpper_bound (S : CauchyReal -> Prop)
