name: approx_gap_lt
statement:
theorem approx_gap_lt (S : CauchyReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : CauchyReal => x <= y) S))
    (n : Nat) :
    approxUpper S hne hbdd n - approxLower S hne hbdd n < gauge n
proof:
:=
  (ratApprox S hne hbdd n).gap_lt

name: lower_lt_upper
proof:
:= by
  cases ha with
  | intro x hx =>
      have hlt : ofRat a < ofRat b :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hx.right (hb x hx.left)
      exact (ofRat_lt_iff_lt).mp hlt

name: approx_lower_sub_lt
statement:
theorem approx_lower_sub_lt (S : CauchyReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : CauchyReal => x <= y) S))
    (n m : Nat) :
    approxLower S hne hbdd n - approxLower S hne hbdd m <
      gauge n + gauge m
proof:
:= by
  let an := approxLower S hne hbdd n
  let am := approxLower S hne hbdd m
  let bm := approxUpper S hne hbdd m
  have han_bm : an < bm :=
    lower_lt_upper
      (approxLower_mem S hne hbdd n)
      (approxUpper_bound S hne hbdd m)
  have hsub_lt :
      an - am < bm - am := by
    have h :=
      (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_right
        (a := an) (b := bm) (c := -am)).mpr han_bm
    simpa [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg] using h
  have hgap : bm - am < gauge m := by
    change approxUpper S hne hbdd m -
      approxLower S hne hbdd m < gauge m
    exact approx_gap_lt S hne hbdd m
  have hgm_lt : gauge m < gauge n + gauge m := by
    have h := (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_right
      (a := 0) (b := gauge n) (c := gauge m)).mpr (gauge_pos n)
    simpa [_root_.Rat.zero_add, _root_.Rat.add_comm] using h
  exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans
    (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hsub_lt hgap) hgm_lt

name: lower_lt_approxUpper
statement:
theorem lower_lt_approxUpper {S : CauchyReal -> Prop}
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : CauchyReal => x <= y) S))
    {q : Rat} (hq : LowerMem S q) (n : Nat) :
    q < approxUpper S hne hbdd n
proof:
:=
  lower_lt_upper hq (approxUpper_bound S hne hbdd n)

name: approxLower_lt_upper
statement:
theorem approxLower_lt_upper {S : CauchyReal -> Prop}
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : CauchyReal => x <= y) S))
    {q : Rat} (hq : RatUpper S q) (n : Nat) :
    approxLower S hne hbdd n < q
proof:
:=
  lower_lt_upper (approxLower_mem S hne hbdd n) hq

name: lower_le_approxLimit
statement:
theorem lower_le_approxLimit {S : CauchyReal -> Prop}
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : CauchyReal => x <= y) S))
    {q : Rat} (hq : LowerMem S q) :
    ofRat q <= approxLimit S hne hbdd
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_not_gt]
  intro hs_q
  cases exists_rat_between hs_q with
  | intro r hr =>
      have hqr : q - r > 0 := by
        exact (_root_.Rat.lt_iff_sub_pos r q).mp
          ((ofRat_lt_iff_lt).mp hr.right)
      cases exists_mul_gauge_lt 3 (q - r) hqr with
      | intro n hn =>
          let a := approxLower S hne hbdd n
          let b := approxUpper S hne hbdd n
          have hq_b : q < b :=
            lower_lt_approxUpper hne hbdd hq n
          have hq_sub :
              q - a < b - a := by
            have h :=
              (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_right
                (a := q) (b := b) (c := -a)).mpr hq_b
            simpa [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg] using h
          have hq_gap : q - a < gauge n :=
            Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hq_sub
              (by
                change b - a < gauge n
                exact approx_gap_lt S hne hbdd n)
          have hq_a_g : q < a + gauge n := by
            have htmp :=
              (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
                (a := q) (b := gauge n) (c := a)).mp hq_gap
            simpa [_root_.Rat.add_comm] using htmp
          have htend :=
            rationalRealSeq_tendsto_mk
              (approxRegularSeq S hne hbdd) n
          have ha_sub_s :
              ofRat a - approxLimit S hne hbdd <
                ofRat ((2 : Rat) * gauge n) := by
            change
              ofRat (approxLower S hne hbdd n) -
                  mk (approxRegularSeq S hne hbdd) <
                ofRat ((2 : Rat) * gauge n)
            exact htend.left
          have ha_lt_s_add :
              ofRat a <
                approxLimit S hne hbdd +
                  ofRat ((2 : Rat) * gauge n) :=
            lt_add_of_sub_lt ha_sub_s
          have hs_add_lt :
              approxLimit S hne hbdd +
                  ofRat ((2 : Rat) * gauge n) <
                ofRat r + ofRat ((2 : Rat) * gauge n) :=
            add_lt_add_right hr.left (ofRat ((2 : Rat) * gauge n))
          have ha_lt_r_add_real :
              ofRat a < ofRat (r + (2 : Rat) * gauge n) := by
            have h := lt_trans ha_lt_s_add hs_add_lt
            rwa [<- ofRat_add] at h
          have ha_lt_r_add :
              a < r + (2 : Rat) * gauge n :=
            (ofRat_lt_iff_lt).mp ha_lt_r_add_real
          have ha_g_lt :
              a + gauge n <
                r + (3 : Rat) * gauge n := by
            have h :=
              (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_right
                (a := a)
                (b := r + (2 : Rat) * gauge n)
                (c := gauge n)).mpr ha_lt_r_add
            have htarget :
                (r + (2 : Rat) * gauge n) + gauge n =
                  r + (3 : Rat) * gauge n := by
              rw [_root_.Rat.add_assoc]
              rw [two_mul_add_eq_three_mul]
            rwa [htarget] at h
          have hq_lt_r3 :
              q < r + (3 : Rat) * gauge n :=
            Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hq_a_g ha_g_lt
          have hr3_lt_q : r + (3 : Rat) * gauge n < q := by
            have h :=
              (_root_.Rat.lt_sub_right_iff_add_lt
                (a := (3 : Rat) * gauge n) (b := r) (c := q)).mp hn
            simpa [_root_.Rat.add_comm] using h
          exact _root_.Rat.lt_irrefl
            (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hq_lt_r3 hr3_lt_q)

name: ofRat_lt_limit_of_lower
statement:
theorem ofRat_lt_limit_of_lower {S : CauchyReal -> Prop}
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : CauchyReal => x <= y) S))
    {q : Rat} (hq : LowerMem S q) :
    ofRat q < approxLimit S hne hbdd
proof:
:= by
  cases lower_no_greatest hq with
  | intro r hr =>
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le
        (ofRat_lt_of_lt hr.right)
        (lower_le_approxLimit hne hbdd hr.left)

name: lower_of_ofRat_lt_limit
statement:
theorem lower_of_ofRat_lt_limit {S : CauchyReal -> Prop}
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : CauchyReal => x <= y) S))
    {q : Rat} (hq : ofRat q < approxLimit S hne hbdd) :
    LowerMem S q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hLower : LowerMem S q
  · exact hLower
  · have hupper : RatUpper S q :=
      ratUpper_of_not_lower hLower
    cases exists_rat_between hq with
    | intro r hr =>
        have hrq_pos : 0 < r - q := by
          exact (_root_.Rat.lt_iff_sub_pos q r).mp
            ((ofRat_lt_iff_lt).mp hr.left)
        cases exists_mul_gauge_lt 3 (r - q) hrq_pos with
        | intro n hn =>
            let a := approxLower S hne hbdd n
            have ha_q : a < q :=
              approxLower_lt_upper hne hbdd hupper n
            have htend :=
              rationalRealSeq_tendsto_mk
                (approxRegularSeq S hne hbdd) n
            have hs_sub_a :
                approxLimit S hne hbdd - ofRat a <
                  ofRat ((2 : Rat) * gauge n) := by
              change
                mk (approxRegularSeq S hne hbdd) -
                    ofRat (approxLower S hne hbdd n) <
                  ofRat ((2 : Rat) * gauge n)
              exact htend.right
            have hs_lt_a_add :
                approxLimit S hne hbdd <
                  ofRat a + ofRat ((2 : Rat) * gauge n) :=
              lt_add_of_sub_lt hs_sub_a
            have hr_lt_a_add_real :
                ofRat r < ofRat (a + (2 : Rat) * gauge n) := by
              have h := lt_trans hr.right hs_lt_a_add
              rwa [<- ofRat_add] at h
            have hr_lt_a_add :
                r < a + (2 : Rat) * gauge n :=
              (ofRat_lt_iff_lt).mp hr_lt_a_add_real
            have ha2_lt_q2 :
                a + (2 : Rat) * gauge n <
                  q + (2 : Rat) * gauge n :=
              (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_right
                (a := a) (b := q)
                (c := (2 : Rat) * gauge n)).mpr ha_q
            have hr_lt_q2 :
                r < q + (2 : Rat) * gauge n :=
              Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hr_lt_a_add ha2_lt_q2
            have hq2_lt_q3 :
                q + (2 : Rat) * gauge n <
                  q + (3 : Rat) * gauge n := by
              apply (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_left
                (a := (2 : Rat) * gauge n)
                (b := (3 : Rat) * gauge n)
                (c := q)).mpr
              have h23 : (2 : Rat) * gauge n < (3 : Rat) * gauge n := by
                have h23rat : (2 : Rat) < 3 := by decide
                exact _root_.Rat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
                  (a := (2 : Rat)) (b := 3)
                  (c := gauge n) h23rat (gauge_pos n)
              exact h23
            have hr_lt_q3 :
                r < q + (3 : Rat) * gauge n :=
              Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hr_lt_q2 hq2_lt_q3
            have hq3_lt_r : q + (3 : Rat) * gauge n < r := by
              have h :=
                (_root_.Rat.lt_sub_right_iff_add_lt
                  (a := (3 : Rat) * gauge n) (b := q) (c := r)).mp hn
              simpa [_root_.Rat.add_comm] using h
            exact False.elim
              (_root_.Rat.lt_irrefl
                (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hr_lt_q3 hq3_lt_r))

name: lowerMem_iff_ofRat_lt_approxLimit
statement:
theorem lowerMem_iff_ofRat_lt_approxLimit
    (S : CauchyReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : CauchyReal => x <= y) S))
    (q : Rat) :
    LowerMem S q <-> ofRat q < approxLimit S hne hbdd
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (ofRat_lt_limit_of_lower hne hbdd)
    (lower_of_ofRat_lt_limit hne hbdd)

name: approxLimit_is_lub
statement:
theorem approxLimit_is_lub
    (S : CauchyReal -> Prop)
    (hne : Exists S)
    (hbdd : Exists (IsUpperBound (fun x y : CauchyReal => x <= y) S)) :
    IsLeastUpperBound (fun x y : CauchyReal => x <= y) S
      (approxLimit S hne hbdd)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    rw [le_iff_not_gt]
    intro hsx
    cases exists_rat_between hsx with
    | intro q hq =>
        have hLower : LowerMem S q :=
          Exists.intro x (And.intro hx hq.right)
        have hq_s :
            ofRat q < approxLimit S hne hbdd :=
          (lowerMem_iff_ofRat_lt_approxLimit S hne hbdd q).mp hLower
        exact lt_irrefl (approxLimit S hne hbdd)
          (lt_trans hq.left hq_s)
  · intro U hU
    rw [le_iff_not_gt]
    intro hUs
    cases exists_rat_between hUs with
    | intro q hq =>
        have hLower : LowerMem S q :=
          (lowerMem_iff_ofRat_lt_approxLimit S hne hbdd q).mpr hq.right
        cases hLower with
        | intro x hx =>
            have hqU : ofRat q < U :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le hx.right (hU x hx.left)
            exact lt_irrefl U (lt_trans hq.left hqU)

name: eight_mul_gauge_completeIndex
statement:
theorem eight_mul_gauge_completeIndex (n : Nat) :
    (8 : Rat) * gauge (completeIndex n) = gauge n
proof:
:= by
  unfold completeIndex
  simpa using factor_mul_gauge_scaleIndex 7 n

name: three_mul_gauge_completeIndex_lt
statement:
theorem three_mul_gauge_completeIndex_lt (n : Nat) :
    (3 : Rat) * gauge (completeIndex n) < gauge n
proof:
:= by
  have h38 : (3 : Rat) < 8 := by decide
  have hpos : 0 < gauge (completeIndex n) :=
    gauge_pos (completeIndex n)
  have hmul :
      (3 : Rat) * gauge (completeIndex n) <
        (8 : Rat) * gauge (completeIndex n) :=
    _root_.Rat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
      (a := (3 : Rat)) (b := 8)
      (c := gauge (completeIndex n)) h38 hpos
  simpa [eight_mul_gauge_completeIndex n] using hmul

name: diagonalSeq_regular
proof:
:= by
  intro n m
  let i : Nat := completeIndex n
  let j : Nat := completeIndex m
  have hleft :
      RealClose ((2 : Rat) * gauge i)
        (ofRat (diagonalSeq x n)) (x i) := by
    unfold diagonalSeq
    change RealClose ((2 : Rat) * gauge i)
      (ofRat ((rep (x i)).seq i)) (x i)
    exact rep_term_close (x i) i
  have hmid : RealClose (gauge i + gauge j) (x i) (x j) :=
    hx i j
  have hright :
      RealClose ((2 : Rat) * gauge j)
        (x j) (ofRat (diagonalSeq x m)) := by
    apply RealClose.symm
    unfold diagonalSeq
    change RealClose ((2 : Rat) * gauge j)
      (ofRat ((rep (x j)).seq j)) (x j)
    exact rep_term_close (x j) j
  have hclose1 :
      RealClose (((2 : Rat) * gauge i) + (gauge i + gauge j))
        (ofRat (diagonalSeq x n)) (x j) :=
    RealClose.triangle hleft hmid
  have hclose :
      RealClose
        ((((2 : Rat) * gauge i) + (gauge i + gauge j)) +
          ((2 : Rat) * gauge j))
        (ofRat (diagonalSeq x n)) (ofRat (diagonalSeq x m)) :=
    RealClose.triangle hclose1 hright
  have habs :
      ratAbs (diagonalSeq x n - diagonalSeq x m) <
        ((((2 : Rat) * gauge i) + (gauge i + gauge j)) +
          ((2 : Rat) * gauge j)) :=
    ratAbs_lt_of_ofRat_close hclose
  have htotal :
      ((((2 : Rat) * gauge i) + (gauge i + gauge j)) +
          ((2 : Rat) * gauge j)) =
        (3 : Rat) * gauge i + (3 : Rat) * gauge j := by
    calc
      (((2 : Rat) * gauge i + (gauge i + gauge j)) +
          (2 : Rat) * gauge j)
          = (((2 : Rat) * gauge i + gauge i) +
              (gauge j + (2 : Rat) * gauge j)) := by
            simp [_root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_comm,
              _root_.Rat.add_left_comm]
      _ = (3 : Rat) * gauge i + (3 : Rat) * gauge j := by
            rw [two_mul_add_eq_three_mul]
            rw [add_two_mul_eq_three_mul]
  have htotal_lt :
      ((((2 : Rat) * gauge i) + (gauge i + gauge j)) +
          ((2 : Rat) * gauge j)) <
        gauge n + gauge m := by
    rw [htotal]
    unfold i j
    exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_lt_add
      (three_mul_gauge_completeIndex_lt n)
      (three_mul_gauge_completeIndex_lt m)
  exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans habs htotal_lt

name: convergence_tail_lt
statement:
theorem convergence_tail_lt (n : Nat) :
    (3 : Rat) * gauge (completeIndex (completeIndex n)) +
        (2 : Rat) * gauge (completeIndex n) <
      gauge n
proof:
:= by
  let k : Nat := completeIndex n
  let i : Nat := completeIndex k
  have hi_lt_k : (3 : Rat) * gauge i < gauge k := by
    unfold i
    exact three_mul_gauge_completeIndex_lt k
  have htail1 :
      (3 : Rat) * gauge i + (2 : Rat) * gauge k <
        gauge k + (2 : Rat) * gauge k :=
    (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_right
      (a := (3 : Rat) * gauge i) (b := gauge k)
      (c := (2 : Rat) * gauge k)).mpr hi_lt_k
  have htail2 :
      (3 : Rat) * gauge i + (2 : Rat) * gauge k <
        (3 : Rat) * gauge k := by
    simpa [add_two_mul_eq_three_mul] using htail1
  have hk_lt_n : (3 : Rat) * gauge k < gauge n := by
    unfold k
    exact three_mul_gauge_completeIndex_lt n
  have htail : (3 : Rat) * gauge i + (2 : Rat) * gauge k < gauge n :=
    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans htail2 hk_lt_n
  simpa [i, k] using htail

name: convergenceBudget_lt
statement:
theorem convergenceBudget_lt (n : Nat) :
    (((gauge n + gauge (completeIndex (completeIndex n))) +
        (2 : Rat) * gauge (completeIndex (completeIndex n))) +
        (2 : Rat) * gauge (completeIndex n)) <
      (2 : Rat) * gauge n
proof:
:= by
  let k : Nat := completeIndex n
  let i : Nat := completeIndex k
  have htail : (3 : Rat) * gauge i + (2 : Rat) * gauge k < gauge n := by
    unfold i k
    exact convergence_tail_lt n
  have hsum :
      gauge n + ((3 : Rat) * gauge i + (2 : Rat) * gauge k) <
        gauge n + gauge n :=
    (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_left
      (a := (3 : Rat) * gauge i + (2 : Rat) * gauge k)
      (b := gauge n) (c := gauge n)).mpr htail
  have htotal :
      (((gauge n + gauge i) + (2 : Rat) * gauge i) +
          (2 : Rat) * gauge k) =
        gauge n + ((3 : Rat) * gauge i + (2 : Rat) * gauge k) := by
    calc
      ((gauge n + gauge i) + (2 : Rat) * gauge i) +
          (2 : Rat) * gauge k
          = gauge n + (gauge i + (2 : Rat) * gauge i) +
              (2 : Rat) * gauge k := by
            simp [_root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_comm,
              _root_.Rat.add_left_comm]
      _ = gauge n + ((gauge i + (2 : Rat) * gauge i) +
              (2 : Rat) * gauge k) := by
            rw [_root_.Rat.add_assoc]
      _ = gauge n + ((3 : Rat) * gauge i +
              (2 : Rat) * gauge k) := by
            rw [add_two_mul_eq_three_mul]
  have htwice : gauge n + gauge n = (2 : Rat) * gauge n :=
    rat_add_self_eq_two_mul (gauge n)
  simpa [i, k, htotal, htwice] using hsum

name: regularRealSeq_tendsto_diagonalLimit
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  let k : Nat := completeIndex n
  let i : Nat := completeIndex k
  have hseq : RealClose (gauge n + gauge i) (x n) (x i) :=
    hx n i
  have hrep :
      RealClose ((2 : Rat) * gauge i)
        (x i) (ofRat (diagonalSeq x k)) := by
    apply RealClose.symm
    unfold diagonalSeq
    change RealClose ((2 : Rat) * gauge i)
      (ofRat ((rep (x i)).seq i)) (x i)
    exact rep_term_close (x i) i
  have hlim :
      RealClose ((2 : Rat) * gauge k)
        (ofRat (diagonalSeq x k)) (diagonalLimit x hx) := by
    unfold diagonalLimit
    have h := rationalRealSeq_tendsto_mk (diagonalRegularSeq x hx) k
    unfold rationalRealSeq diagonalRegularSeq at h
    exact h
  have hclose1 :
      RealClose ((gauge n + gauge i) + (2 : Rat) * gauge i)
        (x n) (ofRat (diagonalSeq x k)) :=
    RealClose.triangle hseq hrep
  have hclose :
      RealClose
        (((gauge n + gauge i) + (2 : Rat) * gauge i) +
          (2 : Rat) * gauge k)
        (x n) (diagonalLimit x hx) :=
    RealClose.triangle hclose1 hlim
  apply RealClose.weaken_lt
  · change
      (((gauge n + gauge (completeIndex (completeIndex n))) +
          (2 : Rat) * gauge (completeIndex (completeIndex n))) +
          (2 : Rat) * gauge (completeIndex n)) <
        (2 : Rat) * gauge n
    exact convergenceBudget_lt n
  · exact hclose

name: two_mul_add_eq_three_mul
statement:
theorem two_mul_add_eq_three_mul (a : Rat) :
    (2 : Rat) * a + a = (3 : Rat) * a
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : (3 : Rat) = (2 : Rat) + 1 := by
    change (((3 : Nat) : Rat) =
      ((2 : Nat) : Rat) + ((1 : Nat) : Rat))
    rw [<- _root_.Rat.natCast_add]
  rw [h3]
  rw [_root_.Rat.add_mul]
  rw [_root_.Rat.one_mul]

name: add_two_mul_eq_three_mul
statement:

    a + (2 : Rat) * a = (3 : Rat) * a

name: ofRat_close_of_ratAbs_lt
proof:
:= by

  · rw [<- ofRat_sub a b]
    exact ofRat_lt_of_lt (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt
      (le_ratAbs (a - b)) h)
  · rw [<- ofRat_sub b a]
    have hba : ratAbs (b - a) < eps := by

name: lt_of_ofRat_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at h
  change Positive (ofRat b - ofRat a) at h
  rw [<- ofRat_sub b a] at h
  change SeqPos (ofRatSeq (b - a)).seq at h
  cases h with
  | intro n hn =>
      have h0 : 0 < b - a :=
        Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans (gauge_pos n) hn
      exact (_root_.Rat.lt_iff_sub_pos a b).mpr h0

statement:

    (hnq : -q < B) :

proof:
:= by
  unfold ratAbs
  by_cases hq0 : q < 0
  · simp [hq0]
    exact hnq
  · simp [hq0]

name: ratAbs_lt_of_ofRat_close
proof:
:= by
  have hab : a - b < eps := by
    apply lt_of_ofRat_lt
    rw [ofRat_sub]
    exact h.left
  have hba : b - a < eps := by
    apply lt_of_ofRat_lt
    rw [ofRat_sub]
    exact h.right
  apply ratAbs_lt_of_bounds_lt hab
  have hneg : -(a - b) = b - a := by
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp [_root_.Rat.neg_add, _root_.Rat.add_comm]
  simpa [hneg] using hba

name: RealClose.symm
proof:
:=
  And.intro h.right h.left

name: RealClose.triangle
statement:
theorem RealClose.triangle {eps delta : Rat} {x y z : CauchyReal}
    (hxy : RealClose eps x y)
    (hyz : RealClose delta y z) :
    RealClose (eps + delta) x z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hsum := add_lt_add hxy.left hyz.left
    rw [add_comm (x - y) (y - z)] at hsum
    rw [sub_add_sub_cancel z y x] at hsum
    have hbound : ofRat eps + ofRat delta = ofRat (eps + delta) := by
      rw [<- ofRat_add]
    rwa [hbound] at hsum
  · have hsum := add_lt_add hyz.right hxy.right
    rw [add_comm (z - y) (y - x)] at hsum
    rw [sub_add_sub_cancel x y z] at hsum
    have hbound : ofRat delta + ofRat eps = ofRat (eps + delta) := by
      rw [<- ofRat_add]
      rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm]
    rwa [hbound] at hsum

name: RealClose.weaken_lt
statement:
theorem RealClose.weaken_lt {eps delta : Rat} {x y : CauchyReal}
    (heps : eps < delta)
    (h : RealClose eps x y) :
    RealClose delta x y
proof:
:=
  And.intro
    (lt_trans h.left (ofRat_lt_of_lt heps))
    (lt_trans h.right (ofRat_lt_of_lt heps))

name: mk_lt_of_term_add_two_gauge
statement:
theorem mk_lt_of_term_add_two_gauge (u : RegularSeq) (n : Nat) :
    mk u < ofRat (u.seq n + (2 : Rat) * gauge n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def]
  change Positive (ofRat (u.seq n + (2 : Rat) * gauge n) - mk u)
  change
    SeqPos
      (addRegularSeq
        (ofRatSeq (u.seq n + (2 : Rat) * gauge n))
        (negRegularSeq u)).seq
  cases exists_mul_gauge_lt 2 (gauge n) (gauge_pos n) with
  | intro k hk =>
      let i : Nat := doubleIndex k
      refine Exists.intro k ?_
      have hi_le : gauge i <= gauge k := by
        unfold i
        exact gauge_doubleIndex_le k
      have hsum_le :
          gauge i + gauge k <= gauge k + gauge k :=
        Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add hi_le _root_.Rat.le_refl
      have htwice_k : gauge k + gauge k = (2 : Rat) * gauge k :=
        rat_add_self_eq_two_mul (gauge k)
      have hsmall : gauge i + gauge k < gauge n :=
        Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt hsum_le (by
          simpa [htwice_k] using hk)
      have hreg_abs :
          ratAbs (u.seq i - u.seq n) < gauge i + gauge n :=
        u.regular i n
      have hdiff_lt :
          u.seq i - u.seq n < gauge i + gauge n :=
        Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt
          (le_ratAbs (u.seq i - u.seq n)) hreg_abs
      have hui_lt :
          u.seq i < (gauge i + gauge n) + u.seq n :=
        (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
          (a := u.seq i) (b := gauge i + gauge n)
          (c := u.seq n)).mp hdiff_lt
      have hleft :
          gauge k + u.seq i <
            gauge k + ((gauge i + gauge n) + u.seq n) :=
        (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_left
          (a := u.seq i)
          (b := (gauge i + gauge n) + u.seq n)
          (c := gauge k)).mpr hui_lt
      have hmid :
          gauge k + u.seq i <
            u.seq n + gauge n + (gauge i + gauge k) := by
        simpa [_root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_comm,
          _root_.Rat.add_left_comm] using hleft
      have hright :
          u.seq n + gauge n + (gauge i + gauge k) <
            u.seq n + gauge n + gauge n :=
        (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_left
          (a := gauge i + gauge k) (b := gauge n)
          (c := u.seq n + gauge n)).mpr hsmall
      have htarget_add :
          gauge k + u.seq i < u.seq n + gauge n + gauge n :=
        Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hmid hright
      have htarget :
          gauge k < (u.seq n + (2 : Rat) * gauge n) - u.seq i := by
        apply (_root_.Rat.lt_sub_right_iff_add_lt
          (a := gauge k) (b := u.seq i)
          (c := u.seq n + (2 : Rat) * gauge n)).mpr
        have htwice_n : gauge n + gauge n = (2 : Rat) * gauge n :=
          rat_add_self_eq_two_mul (gauge n)
        have htarget_add' :
            gauge k + u.seq i < (2 : Rat) * gauge n + u.seq n := by
          calc
            gauge k + u.seq i < u.seq n + gauge n + gauge n :=
              htarget_add
            _ = (gauge n + gauge n) + u.seq n := by
              simp [_root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_comm]
            _ = (2 : Rat) * gauge n + u.seq n := by
              rw [htwice_n]
        simpa [_root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_comm,
          _root_.Rat.add_left_comm] using htarget_add'
      simpa [addRegularSeq, addSeq, doubleSeq, reindexSeq, negRegularSeq,
        negSeq, ofRatSeq, i, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg] using htarget

name: lt_of_neg_lt_neg
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at h
  rw [lt_def]
  have heq : (-y) - (-x) = x - y := by
    change (-y) + -(-x) = x + -y
    rw [neg_neg]
    rw [add_comm]
  rwa [heq] at h

name: term_sub_two_gauge_lt_mk
statement:
theorem term_sub_two_gauge_lt_mk (u : RegularSeq) (n : Nat) :
    ofRat (u.seq n - (2 : Rat) * gauge n) < mk u
proof:
:= by
  have hupper := mk_lt_of_term_add_two_gauge (negRegularSeq u) n
  rw [<- mk_neg u] at hupper
  have hright :
      ofRat ((negRegularSeq u).seq n + (2 : Rat) * gauge n) =
        -ofRat (u.seq n - (2 : Rat) * gauge n) := by
    change ofRat ((-u.seq n) + (2 : Rat) * gauge n) =
      -ofRat (u.seq n - (2 : Rat) * gauge n)
    have hrat :
        (-u.seq n) + (2 : Rat) * gauge n =
          -(u.seq n - (2 : Rat) * gauge n) := by
      rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
      rw [_root_.Rat.neg_add]
      rw [_root_.Rat.neg_neg]
    rw [hrat]
    rw [ofRat_neg]
  rw [hright] at hupper
  exact lt_of_neg_lt_neg hupper

name: sub_lt_of_lt_add
proof:
:= by
  have h' := add_lt_add_right h (-y)
  change x + -y < z
  have hrhs : (y + z) + -y = z := by
    calc
      (y + z) + -y = (z + y) + -y := by
        rw [add_comm y z]
      _ = z + (y + -y) := by
        rw [add_assoc]
      _ = z + 0 := by
        rw [add_neg]
      _ = z := by
        rw [add_zero]
  rw [hrhs] at h'
  exact h'

name: rationalRealSeq_tendsto_mk
statement:
theorem rationalRealSeq_tendsto_mk (u : RegularSeq) :
    RegularTendsto (rationalRealSeq u) (mk u)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  let eps : Rat := (2 : Rat) * gauge n
  constructor
  · have hlo : ofRat (u.seq n - eps) < mk u := by
      unfold eps
      exact term_sub_two_gauge_lt_mk u n
    have hplus := add_lt_add_right hlo (ofRat eps)
    have hleft : ofRat (u.seq n - eps) + ofRat eps = ofRat (u.seq n) := by
      rw [<- ofRat_add]
      have hrat : (u.seq n - eps) + eps = u.seq n := by
        rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
        rw [_root_.Rat.add_assoc]
        rw [_root_.Rat.neg_add_cancel]
        rw [_root_.Rat.add_zero]
      rw [hrat]
    rw [hleft] at hplus
    exact sub_lt_of_lt_add hplus
  · have hhi : mk u < ofRat (u.seq n + eps) := by
      unfold eps
      exact mk_lt_of_term_add_two_gauge u n
    have hhi' : mk u < ofRat (u.seq n) + ofRat eps := by
      rw [<- ofRat_add]
      exact hhi
    exact sub_lt_of_lt_add hhi'

name: rep_term_close
statement:
theorem rep_term_close (x : CauchyReal) (n : Nat) :
    RealClose ((2 : Rat) * gauge n)

:= by

  unfold rationalRealSeq at h

name: negSeq_regular
statement:
theorem negSeq_regular {u : Seq} (hu : Regular u) :
    Regular (negSeq u)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m
  unfold negSeq
  have hdiff :
      (-(u n)) - (-(u m)) = -(u n - u m) := by
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp [_root_.Rat.neg_add, _root_.Rat.add_comm]
  rw [hdiff, ratAbs_neg]
  exact hu n m

name: addDoubleSeq_regular
statement:
theorem addDoubleSeq_regular {u v : Seq}
    (hu : Regular u)
    (hv : Regular v) :
    Regular (addSeq (doubleSeq u) (doubleSeq v))
proof:
:= by
  intro n m
  let du : Rat := u (doubleIndex n) - u (doubleIndex m)
  let dv : Rat := v (doubleIndex n) - v (doubleIndex m)
  have hdiff :
      addSeq (doubleSeq u) (doubleSeq v) n -
          addSeq (doubleSeq u) (doubleSeq v) m =
        du + dv := by
    unfold du dv addSeq doubleSeq reindexSeq
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg,
      _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp [_root_.Rat.neg_add, _root_.Rat.add_assoc,
      _root_.Rat.add_left_comm]
  have habs_le :
      ratAbs
          (addSeq (doubleSeq u) (doubleSeq v) n -
            addSeq (doubleSeq u) (doubleSeq v) m) <=
        ratAbs du + ratAbs dv := by
    rw [hdiff]
    exact ratAbs_add_le du dv
  have hsum_lt :
      ratAbs du + ratAbs dv <
        (gauge (doubleIndex n) + gauge (doubleIndex m)) +
          (gauge (doubleIndex n) + gauge (doubleIndex m)) :=
    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_lt_add
      (hu (doubleIndex n) (doubleIndex m))
      (hv (doubleIndex n) (doubleIndex m))
  exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt habs_le (by
    simpa [gauge_doubleIndex_pair_sum n m] using hsum_lt)

statement:

name: ofRat_sub
statement:
theorem ofRat_sub (a b : Rat) :
    ofRat (a - b) = ofRat a - ofRat b
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
  change ofRat (a + -b) = ofRat a + -(ofRat b)
  rw [ofRat_add, ofRat_neg]

name: zero_add_mk
statement:
theorem zero_add_mk (u : RegularSeq) :
    (0 : CauchyReal) + mk u = mk u
proof:
:= by
  change mk (addRegularSeq (ofRatSeq 0) u) = mk u
  apply mk_eq_mk
  have hzero :
      Equiv (addRegularSeq (ofRatSeq 0) u).seq (doubleSeq u.seq) := by
    apply equiv_of_eq
    intro n
    change (0 : Rat) + u.seq (doubleIndex n) = u.seq (doubleIndex n)
    rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add]
  exact equiv_trans hzero (doubleSeq_equiv_self u)

name: add_zero_mk
statement:
theorem add_zero_mk (u : RegularSeq) :
    mk u + (0 : CauchyReal) = mk u
proof:
:= by
  change mk (addRegularSeq u (ofRatSeq 0)) = mk u
  apply mk_eq_mk
  have hzero :
      Equiv (addRegularSeq u (ofRatSeq 0)).seq (doubleSeq u.seq) := by
    apply equiv_of_eq
    intro n
    change u.seq (doubleIndex n) + (0 : Rat) = u.seq (doubleIndex n)
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_zero]
  exact equiv_trans hzero (doubleSeq_equiv_self u)

name: add_comm_mk
statement:
theorem add_comm_mk (u v : RegularSeq) :
    mk u + mk v = mk v + mk u
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_add, mk_add]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change doubleSeq u.seq n + doubleSeq v.seq n =
    doubleSeq v.seq n + doubleSeq u.seq n
  rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm]

name: neg_neg_mk
statement:
theorem neg_neg_mk (u : RegularSeq) :

proof:
:= by

  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n

  rw [_root_.Rat.neg_neg]

name: add_neg_mk
statement:
theorem add_neg_mk (u : RegularSeq) :
    mk u + (-mk u) = (0 : CauchyReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_neg, mk_add]
  change mk (addRegularSeq u (negRegularSeq u)) = mk (ofRatSeq 0)
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change u.seq (doubleIndex n) + (-(u.seq (doubleIndex n))) = (0 : Rat)
  rw [_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel]

name: neg_add_mk
statement:
theorem neg_add_mk (u : RegularSeq) :

proof:
:= by

  change mk (addRegularSeq (negRegularSeq u) u) = mk (ofRatSeq 0)
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change (-(u.seq (doubleIndex n))) + u.seq (doubleIndex n) = (0 : Rat)

name: neg_addRegularSeq_equiv_pointwise
statement:
theorem neg_addRegularSeq_equiv_pointwise (u v : RegularSeq) :
    Equiv (negRegularSeq (addRegularSeq u v)).seq
      (negSeq (addSeq u.seq v.seq))

:=
  negSeq_respects (addRegularSeq_equiv_pointwise u v)

name: neg_addSeq_eq_add_negSeq
statement:
theorem neg_addSeq_eq_add_negSeq (u v : Seq) :

proof:
:= by
  funext n
  unfold negSeq addSeq

name: neg_add_distrib_mk
statement:
theorem neg_add_distrib_mk (u v : RegularSeq) :
    -(mk u + mk v) = -mk u + -mk v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_add]
  rw [mk_neg]
  rw [mk_neg]
  rw [mk_neg]
  rw [mk_add]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  have hleft :
      Equiv (negRegularSeq (addRegularSeq u v)).seq
        (negSeq (addSeq u.seq v.seq)) :=
    neg_addRegularSeq_equiv_pointwise u v
  have hpoint :
      Equiv (negSeq (addSeq u.seq v.seq))
        (addSeq (negSeq u.seq) (negSeq v.seq)) := by
    apply equiv_of_eq
    intro n
    rw [neg_addSeq_eq_add_negSeq]
  have hright :
      Equiv (addSeq (negSeq u.seq) (negSeq v.seq))
        (addRegularSeq (negRegularSeq u) (negRegularSeq v)).seq :=
    equiv_symm (addRegularSeq_equiv_pointwise (negRegularSeq u) (negRegularSeq v))
  exact equiv_trans hleft (equiv_trans hpoint hright)

name: neg_sub_mk
statement:
theorem neg_sub_mk (u v : RegularSeq) :
    -(mk u - mk v) = mk v - mk u
proof:
:= by
  change -(mk u + -mk v) = mk v + -mk u
  rw [mk_neg v]
  rw [mk_add u (negRegularSeq v)]
  rw [mk_neg (addRegularSeq u (negRegularSeq v))]
  rw [mk_neg u]
  rw [mk_add v (negRegularSeq u)]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  have hleft :
      Equiv (negRegularSeq (addRegularSeq u (negRegularSeq v))).seq
        (negSeq (addSeq u.seq (negSeq v.seq))) :=
    neg_addRegularSeq_equiv_pointwise u (negRegularSeq v)
  have hpoint :
      Equiv (negSeq (addSeq u.seq (negSeq v.seq)))
        (addSeq v.seq (negSeq u.seq)) := by
    apply equiv_of_eq
    intro n
    unfold negSeq addSeq
    rw [_root_.Rat.neg_add]
    rw [_root_.Rat.neg_neg]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm]
  have hright :
      Equiv (addSeq v.seq (negSeq u.seq))
        (addRegularSeq v (negRegularSeq u)).seq :=
    equiv_symm (addRegularSeq_equiv_pointwise v (negRegularSeq u))
  exact equiv_trans hleft (equiv_trans hpoint hright)

name: add_assoc_mk
statement:
theorem add_assoc_mk (u v w : RegularSeq) :
    (mk u + mk v) + mk w = mk u + (mk v + mk w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_add, mk_add, mk_add, mk_add]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  have hu :
      Equiv (doubleSeq (doubleSeq u.seq)) (doubleSeq u.seq) :=
    doubleSeq_equiv_self (doubleRegularSeq u)
  have hv :
      Equiv (doubleSeq (doubleSeq v.seq)) (doubleSeq (doubleSeq v.seq)) :=
    equiv_refl (doubleSeq (doubleSeq v.seq))
  have hw :
      Equiv (doubleSeq w.seq) (doubleSeq (doubleSeq w.seq)) :=
    equiv_symm (doubleSeq_equiv_self (doubleRegularSeq w))
  have hmain :
      Equiv
        (addSeq
          (addSeq (doubleSeq (doubleSeq u.seq))
            (doubleSeq (doubleSeq v.seq)))
          (doubleSeq w.seq))
        (addSeq
          (addSeq (doubleSeq u.seq) (doubleSeq (doubleSeq v.seq)))
          (doubleSeq (doubleSeq w.seq))) :=
    addSeq_respects (addSeq_respects hu hv) hw
  have hleft :
      Equiv (addRegularSeq (addRegularSeq u v) w).seq
        (addSeq
          (addSeq (doubleSeq (doubleSeq u.seq))
            (doubleSeq (doubleSeq v.seq)))
          (doubleSeq w.seq)) := by
    apply equiv_of_eq
    intro n
    rfl
  have hright :
      Equiv
        (addSeq
          (addSeq (doubleSeq u.seq) (doubleSeq (doubleSeq v.seq)))
          (doubleSeq (doubleSeq w.seq)))
        (addRegularSeq u (addRegularSeq v w)).seq := by
    apply equiv_of_eq
    intro n
    change
      (doubleSeq u.seq n + doubleSeq (doubleSeq v.seq) n) +
          doubleSeq (doubleSeq w.seq) n =
        doubleSeq u.seq n +
          (doubleSeq (doubleSeq v.seq) n +
            doubleSeq (doubleSeq w.seq) n)
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_assoc]
  exact equiv_trans hleft (equiv_trans hmain hright)

statement:

name: sub_zero
statement:

statement:
theorem zero_sub (x : CauchyReal) :
    0 - x = -x
proof:

name: add_neg_cancel_right
statement:
theorem add_neg_cancel_right (x y : CauchyReal) :
    (x + -y) + y = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc]
  rw [neg_add]
  rw [add_zero]

name: neg_add_cancel_left
statement:
theorem neg_add_cancel_left (x y : CauchyReal) :
    -x + (x + y) = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [<- add_assoc]
  rw [neg_add]
  rw [zero_add]

name: eq_of_sub_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h' : (x - y) + y = (0 : CauchyReal) + y := by
    rw [h]
  rw [zero_add] at h'
  change (x + -y) + y = y at h'
  rw [add_neg_cancel_right] at h'
  exact h'

name: sub_add_sub_cancel
statement:
theorem sub_add_sub_cancel (x y z : CauchyReal) :
    (y - x) + (z - y) = z - x
proof:
:= by
  change (y + -x) + (z + -y) = z + -x
  calc
    (y + -x) + (z + -y)
        = (z + -y) + (y + -x) := by
          rw [add_comm]
    _ = z + (-y + (y + -x)) := by
          rw [add_assoc]
    _ = z + ((-y + y) + -x) := by
          rw [<- add_assoc (-y) y (-x)]
    _ = z + ((0 : CauchyReal) + -x) := by
          rw [neg_add]
    _ = z + -x := by
          rw [zero_add]

name: sub_add_cancel_right
statement:
theorem sub_add_cancel_right (x y z : CauchyReal) :
    (y + z) - (x + z) = y - x
proof:
:= by
  change (y + z) + -(x + z) = y + -x
  rw [neg_add_distrib x z]
  calc
    (y + z) + (-x + -z)
        = y + (z + (-x + -z)) := by
          rw [add_assoc]
    _ = y + ((-x + -z) + z) := by
          rw [add_comm z (-x + -z)]
    _ = y + (-x + (-z + z)) := by
          rw [add_assoc]
    _ = y + (-x + (0 : CauchyReal)) := by
          rw [neg_add]
    _ = y + -x := by
          rw [add_zero]

name: sub_add_cancel_left
statement:
theorem sub_add_cancel_left (x y z : CauchyReal) :
    (z + y) - (z + x) = y - x
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm z y]
  rw [add_comm z x]
  exact sub_add_cancel_right x y z

name: mk_lt_of_regularBound_add_one_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def]
  change Positive (ofRat q - mk u)
  change SeqPos (addRegularSeq (ofRatSeq q) (negRegularSeq u)).seq
  refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
  have hu : u.seq (doubleIndex 0) <= regularBound u :=
    (regularBound_spec u (doubleIndex 0)).left
  have hsum_le : (1 : Rat) + u.seq (doubleIndex 0) <= regularBound u + 1 := by
    have h := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add
      (a := (1 : Rat)) (b := u.seq (doubleIndex 0))
      (c := (1 : Rat)) (d := regularBound u)
      _root_.Rat.le_refl hu
    simpa [_root_.Rat.add_comm] using h
  have hsum_lt : (1 : Rat) + u.seq (doubleIndex 0) < q :=
    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt hsum_le hq
  have hgap : (1 : Rat) < q + -(u.seq (doubleIndex 0)) := by
    have hgap_sub : (1 : Rat) < q - u.seq (doubleIndex 0) :=
      (_root_.Rat.lt_sub_right_iff_add_lt
        (a := (1 : Rat)) (b := u.seq (doubleIndex 0)) (c := q)).mpr
        hsum_lt
    simpa [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg] using hgap_sub
  simpa [addRegularSeq, addSeq, doubleSeq, reindexSeq, negRegularSeq,
    negSeq, ofRatSeq, gauge_zero] using hgap

name: exists_mul_gauge_lt
statement:
theorem exists_mul_gauge_lt (A δ : Rat) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat => A * gauge n < δ)
proof:
:= by
  cases Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.exists_nat_gt (A / δ) with
  | intro n hn =>
      refine Exists.intro n ?_
      have hn_succ :
          A / δ < (((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat)) := by
        have hcast :
            ((n : Nat) : Rat) < (((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat)) :=
          _root_.Rat.natCast_lt_natCast.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
        exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hn hcast
      have hA_lt : A < (((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat)) * δ :=
        (_root_.Rat.div_lt_iff hδ).mp hn_succ
      have hden : (0 : Rat) < (((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat)) :=
        _root_.Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n)
      unfold gauge
      rw [<- _root_.Rat.div_def]
      apply (_root_.Rat.div_lt_iff hden).mpr
      rw [_root_.Rat.mul_comm]
      exact hA_lt

name: gauge_lt_value_of_two_mul_gauge_lt_gap
proof:
:= by
  let delta : Rat := u.seq n - gauge n
  have hreg_abs : ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq m) < gauge n + gauge m :=
    u.regular n m
  have hdiff_lt : u.seq n - u.seq m < gauge n + gauge m :=
    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt
      (le_ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq m)) hreg_abs
  have h_un_lt : u.seq n < (gauge n + gauge m) + u.seq m :=
    (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
      (a := u.seq n) (b := gauge n + gauge m)
      (c := u.seq m)).mp hdiff_lt
  have hdelta_lt : delta < u.seq m + gauge m := by
    unfold delta
    apply (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
      (a := u.seq n) (b := u.seq m + gauge m)
      (c := gauge n)).mpr
    simpa [_root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_comm,
      _root_.Rat.add_left_comm] using h_un_lt
  have hlower : delta - gauge m < u.seq m :=
    (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
      (a := delta) (b := u.seq m) (c := gauge m)).mpr hdelta_lt
  have hg_lower : gauge m < delta - gauge m := by
    apply (_root_.Rat.lt_sub_right_iff_add_lt
      (a := gauge m) (b := gauge m) (c := delta)).mpr
    have htwice : gauge m + gauge m = (2 : Rat) * gauge m :=
      rat_add_self_eq_two_mul (gauge m)
    have hm_delta : (2 : Rat) * gauge m < delta := by
      unfold delta
      exact hm
    simpa [htwice] using hm_delta
  exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hg_lower hlower

name: seqPos_of_regularSeqEquiv
statement:
theorem seqPos_of_regularSeqEquiv {u v : RegularSeq}
    (h : regularSeqEquiv u v)
    (hu : SeqPos u.seq) :
    SeqPos v.seq
proof:
:= by
  cases hu with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases h with
      | intro C hC =>
          let δ : Rat := u.seq n - gauge n
          have hδ : 0 < δ := by
            unfold δ
            exact (_root_.Rat.lt_iff_sub_pos (gauge n) (u.seq n)).mp hn
          let A : Rat := C + 2
          have hAδ : Exists (fun m : Nat => A * gauge m < δ) :=
            exists_mul_gauge_lt A δ hδ
          cases hAδ with
          | intro m hm =>
              refine Exists.intro m ?_
              have hreg_abs : ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq m) < gauge n + gauge m :=
                u.regular n m
              have hdiff_lt :
                  u.seq n - u.seq m < gauge n + gauge m :=
                Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt
                  (le_ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq m)) hreg_abs
              have h_un_lt :
                  u.seq n < (gauge n + gauge m) + u.seq m :=
                (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
                  (a := u.seq n) (b := gauge n + gauge m)
                  (c := u.seq m)).mp hdiff_lt
              have hδ_lt :
                  δ < u.seq m + gauge m := by
                unfold δ
                apply (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
                  (a := u.seq n) (b := u.seq m + gauge m)
                  (c := gauge n)).mpr
                simpa [_root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_comm,
                  _root_.Rat.add_left_comm] using h_un_lt
              have hu_lower : δ - gauge m < u.seq m :=
                (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
                  (a := δ) (b := u.seq m) (c := gauge m)).mpr hδ_lt
              have huv_le : u.seq m - v.seq m <= C * gauge m :=
                (hC.right m).left
              have hu_le_v_add :
                  u.seq m <= v.seq m + C * gauge m := by
                have htmp :
                    u.seq m <= C * gauge m + v.seq m :=
                  (_root_.Rat.sub_right_le_iff_le_add
                    (a := u.seq m) (b := C * gauge m)
                    (c := v.seq m)).mp huv_le
                simpa [_root_.Rat.add_comm] using htmp
              have hu_sub_le_v :
                  u.seq m - C * gauge m <= v.seq m :=
                (_root_.Rat.sub_right_le_iff_le_add
                  (a := u.seq m) (b := v.seq m)
                  (c := C * gauge m)).mpr hu_le_v_add
              have h_lower_sub :
                  (δ - gauge m) - C * gauge m <
                    u.seq m - C * gauge m := by
                have htmp :
                    (δ - gauge m) + (-(C * gauge m)) <
                      u.seq m + (-(C * gauge m)) :=
                  (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_right
                    (a := δ - gauge m) (b := u.seq m)
                    (c := -(C * gauge m))).mpr hu_lower
                simpa [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg] using htmp
              have h_lower_v :
                  (δ - gauge m) - C * gauge m < v.seq m :=
                Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le h_lower_sub hu_sub_le_v
              have hsum_eq :
                  (gauge m + C * gauge m) + gauge m =
                    (C + 2) * gauge m := by
                calc
                  (gauge m + C * gauge m) + gauge m =
                      C * gauge m + (gauge m + gauge m) := by
                    simp [_root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_comm]
                  _ = C * gauge m + (2 : Rat) * gauge m := by
                    rw [rat_add_self_eq_two_mul]
                  _ = (C + 2) * gauge m := by
                    rw [_root_.Rat.add_mul]
              have hsum_lt :
                  (gauge m + C * gauge m) + gauge m < δ := by
                unfold A at hm
                simpa [hsum_eq] using hm
              have hmid :
                  gauge m + C * gauge m < δ - gauge m :=
                (_root_.Rat.lt_sub_right_iff_add_lt
                  (a := gauge m + C * gauge m)
                  (b := gauge m) (c := δ)).mpr hsum_lt
              have hg_lt_lower :
                  gauge m < (δ - gauge m) - C * gauge m :=
                (_root_.Rat.lt_sub_right_iff_add_lt
                  (a := gauge m) (b := C * gauge m)
                  (c := δ - gauge m)).mpr hmid
              exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hg_lt_lower h_lower_v

name: seqPos_equiv_iff
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (seqPos_of_regularSeqEquiv h)
    (seqPos_of_regularSeqEquiv (regularSeqEquiv_symm h))

name: seqPos_addRegularSeq
statement:
theorem seqPos_addRegularSeq {u v : RegularSeq}
    (hu : SeqPos u.seq)
    (hv : SeqPos v.seq) :
    SeqPos (addRegularSeq u v).seq
proof:
:= by
  cases hu with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases hv with
      | intro m hm =>
          let du : Rat := u.seq n - gauge n
          let dv : Rat := v.seq m - gauge m
          have hdu : 0 < du := by
            unfold du
            exact (_root_.Rat.lt_iff_sub_pos (gauge n) (u.seq n)).mp hn
          have hdv : 0 < dv := by
            unfold dv
            exact (_root_.Rat.lt_iff_sub_pos (gauge m) (v.seq m)).mp hm
          have hdelta :
              Exists (fun delta : Rat =>
                And (0 < delta) (And (delta <= du) (delta <= dv))) := by
            cases _root_.Rat.le_total (a := du) (b := dv) with
            | inl hduv =>
                exact Exists.intro du
                  (And.intro hdu (And.intro _root_.Rat.le_refl hduv))
            | inr hvdu =>
                exact Exists.intro dv
                  (And.intro hdv (And.intro hvdu _root_.Rat.le_refl))
          cases hdelta with
          | intro delta hdelta =>
              cases exists_mul_gauge_lt 1 delta hdelta.left with
              | intro k hk =>
                  let i : Nat := doubleIndex k
                  refine Exists.intro k ?_
                  have hkg_delta : gauge k < delta := by
                    simpa [_root_.Rat.one_mul] using hk
                  have hi_delta : (2 : Rat) * gauge i < delta := by
                    unfold i
                    simpa [two_mul_gauge_doubleIndex] using hkg_delta
                  have hi_du : (2 : Rat) * gauge i < du :=
                    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi_delta hdelta.right.left
                  have hi_dv : (2 : Rat) * gauge i < dv :=
                    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi_delta hdelta.right.right
                  have hui : gauge i < u.seq i := by
                    unfold du at hi_du
                    exact gauge_lt_value_of_two_mul_gauge_lt_gap
                      (u := u) (n := n) (m := i) hi_du
                  have hvi : gauge i < v.seq i := by
                    unfold dv at hi_dv
                    exact gauge_lt_value_of_two_mul_gauge_lt_gap
                      (u := v) (n := m) (m := i) hi_dv
                  have hsum :
                      gauge i + gauge i < u.seq i + v.seq i :=
                    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_lt_add hui hvi
                  have htwice : gauge i + gauge i = gauge k := by
                    unfold i
                    rw [rat_add_self_eq_two_mul]
                    rw [two_mul_gauge_doubleIndex]
                  change gauge k <
                    addSeq (doubleSeq u.seq) (doubleSeq v.seq) k
                  simpa [addSeq, doubleSeq, reindexSeq, i, htwice] using hsum

name: positive_mk
statement:
theorem positive_mk (u : RegularSeq) :
    Positive (mk u) ↔ SeqPos u.seq
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: positive_add
statement:
theorem positive_add {x y : CauchyReal}
    (hx : Positive x)
    (hy : Positive y) :
    Positive (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quot.ind
    (β := fun x => forall y : CauchyReal,
      Positive x -> Positive y -> Positive (x + y)) ?_ x y hx hy
  intro u y
  refine _root_.Quot.ind
    (β := fun y =>
      Positive (mk u) -> Positive y -> Positive (mk u + y)) ?_ y
  intro v hu hv
  change SeqPos u.seq at hu
  change SeqPos v.seq at hv
  change SeqPos (addRegularSeq u v).seq
  exact seqPos_addRegularSeq hu hv

name: lt_def
statement:
theorem lt_def (x y : CauchyReal) :
    x < y ↔ Positive (y - x)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: le_def
statement:
theorem le_def (x y : CauchyReal) :
    x <= y ↔ Not (Positive (x - y))
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: exists_gauge_lt
statement:
theorem exists_gauge_lt {q : Rat} (hq : 0 < q) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat => gauge n < q)
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_mul_gauge_lt 1 q hq with
  | intro n hn =>
      refine Exists.intro n ?_
      simpa [_root_.Rat.one_mul] using hn

name: seqPos_constSeq_of_pos
statement:
theorem seqPos_constSeq_of_pos {q : Rat} (hq : 0 < q) :
    SeqPos (constSeq q)
proof:
:=
  exists_gauge_lt hq

name: positive_ofRat_of_pos
statement:
theorem positive_ofRat_of_pos {q : Rat} (hq : 0 < q) :
    Positive (ofRat q)
proof:
:= by
  change SeqPos (ofRatSeq q).seq
  exact seqPos_constSeq_of_pos hq

name: ofRat_lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem ofRat_lt_of_lt {a b : Rat} (h : a < b) :
    ofRat a < ofRat b
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def]
  change Positive (ofRat b - ofRat a)
  rw [<- ofRat_sub b a]
  exact positive_ofRat_of_pos ((_root_.Rat.lt_iff_sub_pos a b).mp h)

name: zero_lt_one
statement: theorem zero_lt_one : (0 : CauchyReal) < (1 : CauchyReal)
proof:
:= by
  change ofRat 0 < ofRat 1
  exact ofRat_lt_of_lt (by decide)

name: not_seqPos_const_zero
statement: theorem not_seqPos_const_zero : Not (SeqPos (constSeq 0))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  cases h with
  | intro n hn =>
      have h00 : (0 : Rat) < 0 :=
        Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans (gauge_pos n) hn
      exact _root_.Rat.lt_irrefl h00

name: not_seqPos_and_negSeq
statement:
theorem not_seqPos_and_negSeq (u : RegularSeq) :
    Not (And (SeqPos u.seq) (SeqPos (negSeq u.seq)))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  cases h.left with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases h.right with
      | intro m hm =>
          have hsum_pos :
              gauge n + gauge m < u.seq n + (-(u.seq m)) :=
            Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_lt_add hn hm
          have hdiff_pos :
              gauge n + gauge m < u.seq n - u.seq m := by
            simpa [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, negSeq] using hsum_pos
          have hdiff_abs :
              u.seq n - u.seq m <= ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq m) :=
            le_ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq m)
          have hsum_abs :
              gauge n + gauge m < ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq m) :=
            Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le hdiff_pos hdiff_abs
          have habs_sum :
              ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq m) < gauge n + gauge m :=
            u.regular n m
          have hbad :
              gauge n + gauge m < gauge n + gauge m :=
            Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hsum_abs habs_sum
          exact _root_.Rat.lt_irrefl hbad

name: le_gauge_of_not_seqPos
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp
  intro hn
  exact h (Exists.intro n hn)

name: neg_le_gauge_of_not_negSeqPos
proof:
:= by
  have hn : negSeq u n <= gauge n :=
    le_gauge_of_not_seqPos h n
  simpa [negSeq] using hn

name: equiv_zero_of_not_seqPos_of_not_negSeqPos
statement:
theorem equiv_zero_of_not_seqPos_of_not_negSeqPos (u : RegularSeq)
    (hpos : Not (SeqPos u.seq))
    (hneg : Not (SeqPos (negSeq u.seq))) :
    Equiv u.seq (constSeq 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro 1 (And.intro (by decide) ?_)
  intro n
  have hu : u.seq n <= gauge n :=
    le_gauge_of_not_seqPos hpos n
  have hnu : -u.seq n <= gauge n :=
    neg_le_gauge_of_not_negSeqPos hneg n
  constructor
  · unfold constSeq
    simpa [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.add_zero,
      _root_.Rat.one_mul] using hu
  · unfold constSeq
    simpa [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.add_zero,
      _root_.Rat.one_mul] using hnu

name: seqPos_trichotomy
statement:
theorem seqPos_trichotomy (u : RegularSeq) :
    Or (SeqPos u.seq) (Or (Equiv u.seq (constSeq 0)) (SeqPos (negSeq u.seq)))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpos : SeqPos u.seq
  · exact Or.inl hpos
  · by_cases hneg : SeqPos (negSeq u.seq)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hneg)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl
        (equiv_zero_of_not_seqPos_of_not_negSeqPos u hpos hneg))

name: not_positive_zero
statement: theorem not_positive_zero : Not (Positive (0 : CauchyReal))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  change SeqPos (ofRatSeq 0).seq at h
  exact not_seqPos_const_zero h

name: not_positive_and_negative_mk
statement:
theorem not_positive_and_negative_mk (u : RegularSeq) :
    Not (And (Positive (mk u)) (Positive (-(mk u))))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hpos : SeqPos u.seq := by
    exact h.left
  have hneg : SeqPos (negSeq u.seq) := by
    rw [mk_neg] at h
    exact h.right
  exact not_seqPos_and_negSeq u (And.intro hpos hneg)

name: positive_neg_mk_iff
statement:
theorem positive_neg_mk_iff (u : RegularSeq) :
    Positive (-(mk u)) ↔ SeqPos (negSeq u.seq)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_neg]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: not_positive_and_negative
statement:
theorem not_positive_and_negative (x : CauchyReal) :
    Not (And (Positive x) (Positive (-x)))
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quot.ind
    (β := fun x => Not (And (Positive x) (Positive (-x)))) ?_ x
  intro u
  change Not (And (Positive (mk u)) (Positive (-(mk u))))
  exact not_positive_and_negative_mk u

name: positive_zero_negative_trichotomy
statement:
theorem positive_zero_negative_trichotomy (x : CauchyReal) :
    Or (Positive x) (Or (x = (0 : CauchyReal)) (Positive (-x)))
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quot.ind
    (β := fun x =>
      Or (Positive x) (Or (x = (0 : CauchyReal)) (Positive (-x)))) ?_ x
  intro u
  cases seqPos_trichotomy u with
  | inl hpos =>
      exact Or.inl hpos
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hzero =>
          exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by
            change mk u = mk (ofRatSeq 0)
            exact mk_eq_mk hzero))
      | inr hneg =>
          exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by
            change Positive (-(mk u))
            rw [positive_neg_mk_iff]
            exact hneg))

name: lt_trichotomy
statement:
theorem lt_trichotomy (x y : CauchyReal) :
    Or (x < y) (Or (x = y) (y < x))
proof:
:= by
  cases positive_zero_negative_trichotomy (y - x) with
  | inl hpos =>
      exact Or.inl hpos
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hzero =>
          exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by
            have hyx : y = x := eq_of_sub_eq_zero hzero
            exact hyx.symm))
      | inr hneg =>
          exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by
            rw [lt_def]
            rw [<- neg_sub y x]
            exact hneg))

name: lt_irrefl
statement: theorem lt_irrefl (x : CauchyReal) : Not (x < x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def]
  rw [sub_self]
  exact not_positive_zero

name: zero_ne_one
statement: theorem zero_ne_one : (0 : CauchyReal) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hlt : (0 : CauchyReal) < 0 := by
    simpa [<- h] using zero_lt_one
  exact lt_irrefl 0 hlt

name: one_ne_zero
statement: theorem one_ne_zero : (1 : CauchyReal) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact zero_ne_one h.symm

name: le_refl
statement: theorem le_refl (x : CauchyReal) : x <= x
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def]
  rw [sub_self]
  exact not_positive_zero

name: le_iff_not_gt
statement:
theorem le_iff_not_gt (x y : CauchyReal) :
    x <= y ↔ Not (y < x)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: lt_asymm
statement:
theorem lt_asymm {x y : CauchyReal} (hxy : x < y) :
    Not (y < x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at hxy
  intro hyx
  rw [lt_def] at hyx
  have hneg : Positive (-(y - x)) := by
    rw [neg_sub y x]
    exact hyx
  exact not_positive_and_negative (y - x) (And.intro hxy hneg)

name: lt_trans
statement:
theorem lt_trans {x y z : CauchyReal}
    (hxy : x < y)
    (hyz : y < z) :
    x < z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at hxy hyz ⊢
  have hsum : Positive ((y - x) + (z - y)) :=
    positive_add hxy hyz
  rw [sub_add_sub_cancel x y z] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: lt_ne
statement: theorem lt_ne {x y : CauchyReal} (hxy : x < y) : x ≠ y
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  subst h
  exact lt_irrefl x hxy

name: le_total
statement:
theorem le_total (x y : CauchyReal) :
    Or (x <= y) (y <= x)
proof:
:= by
  cases lt_trichotomy x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact Or.inl (by
        rw [le_iff_not_gt]
        exact lt_asymm hxy)
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hxy_eq =>
          exact Or.inl (by
            rw [hxy_eq]
            exact le_refl y)
      | inr hyx =>
          exact Or.inr (by
            rw [le_iff_not_gt]
            exact lt_asymm hyx)

name: not_le_of_lt
statement:
theorem not_le_of_lt {x y : CauchyReal} (h : x < y) :
    Not (y <= x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_not_gt y x]
  intro hyx
  exact hyx h

name: le_of_lt
statement:
theorem le_of_lt {x y : CauchyReal} (h : x < y) :
    x <= y
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_not_gt]
  exact lt_asymm h

name: not_lt_of_le
statement:
theorem not_lt_of_le {x y : CauchyReal} (h : x <= y) :
    Not (y < x)
proof:
:= by
  exact (le_iff_not_gt x y).mp h

name: le_trans
statement:
theorem le_trans {x y z : CauchyReal}
    (hxy : x <= y)
    (hyz : y <= z) :
    x <= z
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_not_gt] at hxy hyz ⊢
  intro hzx
  cases lt_trichotomy y z with
  | inl hyzlt =>
      exact hxy (lt_trans hyzlt hzx)
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hyz_eq =>
          rw [<- hyz_eq] at hzx
          exact hxy hzx
      | inr hzy =>
          exact hyz hzy

name: add_lt_add_right
statement:
theorem add_lt_add_right {x y : CauchyReal}
    (h : x < y)
    (z : CauchyReal) :
    x + z < y + z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at h ⊢
  rw [sub_add_cancel_right x y z]
  exact h

name: add_lt_add_left
statement:
theorem add_lt_add_left {x y : CauchyReal}
    (h : x < y)
    (z : CauchyReal) :
    z + x < z + y
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at h ⊢
  rw [sub_add_cancel_left x y z]
  exact h

name: add_le_add_right
statement:
theorem add_le_add_right {x y : CauchyReal}
    (h : x <= y)
    (z : CauchyReal) :
    x + z <= y + z
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def] at h ⊢
  rw [sub_add_cancel_right y x z]
  exact h

name: add_le_add_left
statement:
theorem add_le_add_left {x y : CauchyReal}
    (h : x <= y)
    (z : CauchyReal) :
    z + x <= z + y
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def] at h ⊢

name: add_lt_add
statement:
theorem add_lt_add {w x y z : CauchyReal}
    (hwx : w < x)
    (hyz : y < z) :
    w + y < x + z
proof:
:=
  lt_trans (add_lt_add_right hwx y) (add_lt_add_left hyz x)

name: add_le_add
statement:
theorem add_le_add {w x y z : CauchyReal}
    (hwx : w <= x)
    (hyz : y <= z) :
    w + y <= x + z
proof:
:=
  le_trans (add_le_add_right hwx y) (add_le_add_left hyz x)

name: lt_of_add_lt_add_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at h ⊢
  rw [sub_add_cancel_right x y z] at h
  exact h

name: lt_of_add_lt_add_left
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at h ⊢
  rw [sub_add_cancel_left x y z] at h
  exact h

name: le_of_add_le_add_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def] at h ⊢
  rw [sub_add_cancel_right y x z] at h
  exact h

name: le_of_add_le_add_left
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def] at h ⊢
  rw [sub_add_cancel_left y x z] at h
  exact h

name: le_antisymm
statement:
theorem le_antisymm {x y : CauchyReal}
    (hxy : x <= y)
    (hyx : y <= x) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  cases lt_trichotomy x y with
  | inl hlt =>
      exact False.elim ((not_le_of_lt hlt) hyx)
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl heq =>
          exact heq
      | inr hgt =>
          exact False.elim ((not_le_of_lt hgt) hxy)

name: lt_iff_le_and_not_le
statement:
theorem lt_iff_le_and_not_le {x y : CauchyReal} :
    x < y ↔ And (x <= y) (Not (y <= x))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hxy
    exact And.intro (le_of_lt hxy) (not_le_of_lt hxy)
  · intro h
    by_cases hxy : x < y
    · exact hxy
    · exact False.elim (h.right (by
        rw [le_iff_not_gt]
        exact hxy))

name: lt_of_lt_of_le
statement:
theorem lt_of_lt_of_le {x y z : CauchyReal}
    (hxy : x < y)
    (hyz : y <= z) :
    x < z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff_le_and_not_le]
  constructor
  · exact le_trans (le_of_lt hxy) hyz
  · intro hzx
    exact (not_le_of_lt hxy) (le_trans hyz hzx)

name: lt_of_le_of_lt
statement:
theorem lt_of_le_of_lt {x y z : CauchyReal}
    (hxy : x <= y)
    (hyz : y < z) :
    x < z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff_le_and_not_le]
  constructor
  · exact le_trans hxy (le_of_lt hyz)
  · intro hzx
    exact (not_le_of_lt hyz) (le_trans hzx hxy)

name: ratAbs_mul_le_of_bounds
statement:
theorem ratAbs_mul_le_of_bounds {a b A B : Rat}
    (hA0 : 0 <= A)
    (hB0 : 0 <= B)
    (ha : a <= A)
    (hna : -a <= A)
    (hb : b <= B)
    (hnb : -b <= B) :
    ratAbs (a * b) <= A * B
proof:
:= by
  apply ratAbs_le_of_bounds
  · exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.mul_upper_of_box hA0 hB0 ha hna hb hnb
  · exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.neg_mul_upper_of_box hA0 hB0 ha hna hb hnb

name: ratAbs_mul_le_right_bound
statement:
theorem ratAbs_mul_le_right_bound {a b B : Rat}
    (hB0 : 0 <= B)
    (hb : b <= B)
    (hnb : -b <= B) :
    ratAbs (a * b) <= ratAbs a * B
proof:
:=
  ratAbs_mul_le_of_bounds
    (ratAbs_nonneg a) hB0 (le_ratAbs a) (neg_le_ratAbs a) hb hnb

name: ratAbs_mul_le_left_bound
statement:
theorem ratAbs_mul_le_left_bound {a b A : Rat}
    (hA0 : 0 <= A)
    (ha : a <= A)
    (hna : -a <= A) :
    ratAbs (a * b) <= A * ratAbs b
proof:
:= by
  have h := ratAbs_mul_le_right_bound
    (a := b) (b := a) (B := A) hA0 ha hna
  simpa [_root_.Rat.mul_comm] using h

name: mul_sub_mul_decomp
statement:
theorem mul_sub_mul_decomp (a b c d : Rat) :
    a * b - c * d = (a - c) * b + c * (b - d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg,
    _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
  simp [_root_.Rat.add_mul, _root_.Rat.mul_add, _root_.Rat.neg_mul,
    _root_.Rat.mul_neg, _root_.Rat.add_assoc,
    _root_.Rat.add_left_comm]
  rw [<- _root_.Rat.add_assoc (c * b) (-(c * b)) (-(c * d))]
  rw [_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel]
  rw [_root_.Rat.zero_add]

name: ratAbs_mul_sub_mul_le_bound
statement:
theorem ratAbs_mul_sub_mul_le_bound {a b c d B C eps : Rat}
    (hB0 : 0 <= B)
    (hC0 : 0 <= C)
    (hc : c <= B)
    (hnc : -c <= B)
    (hb : b <= C)
    (hnb : -b <= C)
    (haDiff : ratAbs (a - c) <= eps)
    (hbDiff : ratAbs (b - d) <= eps) :
    ratAbs (a * b - c * d) <= (B + C) * eps
proof:
:= by
  have hterm1 :
      ratAbs ((a - c) * b) <= eps * C := by
    have hbox := ratAbs_mul_le_right_bound
      (a := a - c) (b := b) (B := C) hC0 hb hnb
    have hmul :
        ratAbs (a - c) * C <= eps * C :=
      _root_.Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right haDiff hC0
    exact _root_.Rat.le_trans hbox hmul
  have hterm2 :
      ratAbs (c * (b - d)) <= B * eps := by
    have hbox := ratAbs_mul_le_left_bound
      (a := c) (b := b - d) (A := B) hB0 hc hnc
    have hmul :
        B * ratAbs (b - d) <= B * eps :=
      _root_.Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbDiff hB0
    exact _root_.Rat.le_trans hbox hmul
  rw [mul_sub_mul_decomp]
  have htri := ratAbs_add_le ((a - c) * b) (c * (b - d))
  have hsum :
      ratAbs ((a - c) * b) + ratAbs (c * (b - d)) <=
        eps * C + B * eps :=
    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add hterm1 hterm2
  have halg : eps * C + B * eps = (B + C) * eps := by
    calc
      eps * C + B * eps = C * eps + B * eps := by
        rw [_root_.Rat.mul_comm eps C]
      _ = B * eps + C * eps := by
        rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm]
      _ = (B + C) * eps := by
        rw [_root_.Rat.add_mul]
  exact _root_.Rat.le_trans htri (by
    simpa [halg] using hsum)

name: productRawSeq_regular
statement:
theorem productRawSeq_regular (u v : RegularSeq) :
    Regular (productRawSeq u v)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m
  let k : Nat := productSpeed u v
  let i : Nat := scaleIndex k n
  let j : Nat := scaleIndex k m
  let B : Rat := regularBound u
  let C : Rat := regularBound v
  let eps : Rat := gauge i + gauge j
  have hB0 : 0 <= B := regularBound_nonneg u
  have hC0 : 0 <= C := regularBound_nonneg v
  have hui := regularBound_spec u i
  have huj := regularBound_spec u j
  have hvi := regularBound_spec v i
  have hdu : ratAbs (u.seq i - u.seq j) <= eps := by
    exact _root_.Rat.le_of_lt (u.regular i j)
  have hdv : ratAbs (v.seq i - v.seq j) <= eps := by
    exact _root_.Rat.le_of_lt (v.regular i j)
  have hprod :
      ratAbs (u.seq i * v.seq i - u.seq j * v.seq j) <=
        (B + C) * eps :=
    ratAbs_mul_sub_mul_le_bound
      (a := u.seq i) (b := v.seq i) (c := u.seq j) (d := v.seq j)
      (B := B) (C := C) (eps := eps)
      hB0 hC0 huj.left huj.right hvi.left hvi.right hdu hdv
  have hfactor :
      B + C < (((k + 1 : Nat) : Rat)) := by
    unfold B C k
    simpa [boundSum] using boundSum_lt_productFactor u v
  have hscale :
      (B + C) * eps < gauge n + gauge m := by
    have hin :
        (B + C) * gauge i <
          (((k + 1 : Nat) : Rat) * gauge i) :=
      _root_.Rat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hfactor (gauge_pos i)
    have hjn :
        (B + C) * gauge j <
          (((k + 1 : Nat) : Rat) * gauge j) :=
      _root_.Rat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hfactor (gauge_pos j)
    have hsum := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_lt_add hin hjn
    have hki : ((((k : Nat) : Rat) + 1) * gauge i) = gauge n := by
      unfold i k
      simpa [_root_.Rat.natCast_add] using
        factor_mul_gauge_scaleIndex (productSpeed u v) n
    have hkj : ((((k : Nat) : Rat) + 1) * gauge j) = gauge m := by
      unfold j k
      simpa [_root_.Rat.natCast_add] using
        factor_mul_gauge_scaleIndex (productSpeed u v) m
    unfold eps
    rw [_root_.Rat.mul_add]
    simpa [hki, hkj] using hsum
  unfold productRawSeq productScaleSeq scaleSeq reindexSeq mulSeq
  change ratAbs (u.seq i * v.seq i - u.seq j * v.seq j) <
    gauge n + gauge m
  exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt hprod hscale

name: Bounded.mul
statement:
theorem Bounded.mul {u v : Seq}
    (hu : Bounded u)
    (hv : Bounded v) :
    Bounded (mulSeq u v)
proof:
:= by
  cases hu with
  | intro B hB =>
      cases hv with
      | intro C hC =>
          exact Exists.intro (B * C) (And.intro (_root_.Rat.mul_nonneg hB.left hC.left) (by
            intro n
            constructor
            · have h := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.mul_upper_of_box
                (a := u n) (b := v n) (A := B) (B := C)
                hB.left hC.left (hB.right n).left (hB.right n).right
                (hC.right n).left (hC.right n).right
              simpa [mulSeq] using h
            · have h := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.neg_mul_upper_of_box
                (a := u n) (b := v n) (A := B) (B := C)
                hB.left hC.left (hB.right n).left (hB.right n).right
                (hC.right n).left (hC.right n).right
              simpa [mulSeq] using h))

name: rateNull_mul_bounded
statement:
theorem rateNull_mul_bounded {u v : Seq}
    (hu : RateNull u)
    (hv : Bounded v) :
    RateNull (mulSeq u v)
proof:
:= by
  cases hu with
  | intro C hC =>
      cases hv with
      | intro B hB =>
          exact Exists.intro (C * B) (And.intro (_root_.Rat.mul_nonneg hC.left hB.left) (by
            intro n
            have hCg0 : 0 <= C * gauge n :=
              _root_.Rat.mul_nonneg hC.left (_root_.Rat.le_of_lt (gauge_pos n))
            constructor
            · have h := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.mul_upper_of_box
                (a := u n) (b := v n) (A := C * gauge n) (B := B)
                hCg0 hB.left (hC.right n).left (hC.right n).right
                (hB.right n).left (hB.right n).right
              have hswap : C * gauge n * B = C * B * gauge n := by
                rw [_root_.Rat.mul_assoc]
                rw [_root_.Rat.mul_comm (gauge n) B]
                rw [← _root_.Rat.mul_assoc]
              simpa [mulSeq, hswap] using h
            · have h := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.neg_mul_upper_of_box
                (a := u n) (b := v n) (A := C * gauge n) (B := B)
                hCg0 hB.left (hC.right n).left (hC.right n).right
                (hB.right n).left (hB.right n).right
              have hswap : C * gauge n * B = C * B * gauge n := by
                rw [_root_.Rat.mul_assoc]
                rw [_root_.Rat.mul_comm (gauge n) B]
                rw [← _root_.Rat.mul_assoc]
              simpa [mulSeq, hswap] using h))

name: bounded_mul_rateNull
statement:
theorem bounded_mul_rateNull {u v : Seq}
    (hu : Bounded u)
    (hv : RateNull v) :
    RateNull (mulSeq u v)
proof:
:= by
  apply RateBounded.congr (u := mulSeq v u)
  · intro n
    unfold mulSeq
    rw [_root_.Rat.mul_comm]
  · exact rateNull_mul_bounded hv hu

name: mulSeq_respects_of_bounded
statement:
theorem mulSeq_respects_of_bounded {u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : Seq}
    (hu₂ : Bounded u₂)
    (hv₁ : Bounded v₁)
    (hu : Equiv u₁ u₂)
    (hv : Equiv v₁ v₂) :
    Equiv (mulSeq u₁ v₁) (mulSeq u₂ v₂)
proof:
:= by
  apply RateBounded.congr
    (u := fun n => mulSeq (fun k => u₁ k - u₂ k) v₁ n +
      mulSeq u₂ (fun k => v₁ k - v₂ k) n)
  · intro n
    unfold mulSeq
    change (u₁ n - u₂ n) * v₁ n + u₂ n * (v₁ n - v₂ n) =
      u₁ n * v₁ n - u₂ n * v₂ n
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp [_root_.Rat.mul_add, _root_.Rat.add_mul, _root_.Rat.neg_mul, _root_.Rat.mul_neg,
      _root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_left_comm]
    rw [← _root_.Rat.add_assoc (u₂ n * v₁ n)
      (-(u₂ n * v₁ n)) (-(u₂ n * v₂ n))]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel, _root_.Rat.zero_add]
  · exact RateBounded.add
      (rateNull_mul_bounded hu hv₁)
      (bounded_mul_rateNull hu₂ hv)

name: productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise
statement:
theorem productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise (u v : RegularSeq) :
    Equiv (productRawSeq u v) (mulSeq u.seq v.seq)
proof:
:= by
  let k : Nat := productSpeed u v
  have huBound : Bounded (scaleSeq k u.seq) :=
    regular_bounded (scaleSeq_regular (k := k) u.regular)
  have hvBound : Bounded (scaleSeq k v.seq) :=
    regular_bounded (scaleSeq_regular (k := k) v.regular)
  have huTargetBound : Bounded u.seq :=
    regular_bounded u.regular
  have huEquiv : Equiv (scaleSeq k u.seq) u.seq :=
    scaleSeq_equiv_self k u
  have hvEquiv : Equiv (scaleSeq k v.seq) v.seq :=
    scaleSeq_equiv_self k v
  have hmul :
      Equiv (mulSeq (scaleSeq k u.seq) (scaleSeq k v.seq))
        (mulSeq u.seq v.seq) :=
    mulSeq_respects_of_bounded
      huTargetBound hvBound huEquiv hvEquiv
  unfold productRawSeq productScaleSeq
  exact hmul

name: mulRegularSeq_respects
statement:
theorem mulRegularSeq_respects {u1 u2 v1 v2 : RegularSeq}
    (hu : regularSeqEquiv u1 u2)
    (hv : regularSeqEquiv v1 v2) :
    regularSeqEquiv (mulRegularSeq u1 v1) (mulRegularSeq u2 v2)
proof:
:=
  let hpoint :
      Equiv (mulSeq u1.seq v1.seq) (mulSeq u2.seq v2.seq) :=
    mulSeq_respects_of_bounded
      (regular_bounded u2.regular) (regular_bounded v1.regular) hu hv
  equiv_trans (productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise u1 v1)
    (equiv_trans hpoint
      (equiv_symm (productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise u2 v2)))

name: mk_mul
statement:
theorem mk_mul (u v : RegularSeq) :
    mk u * mk v = mk (mulRegularSeq u v)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: ofRat_mul
statement:
theorem ofRat_mul (a b : Rat) :
    ofRat (a * b) = ofRat a * ofRat b
proof:
:= by
  change mk (ofRatSeq (a * b)) =
    mk (mulRegularSeq (ofRatSeq a) (ofRatSeq b))
  apply mk_eq_mk
  apply equiv_of_eq
  intro n
  change a * b = a * b
  rfl

name: mul_comm_mk
statement:
theorem mul_comm_mk (u v : RegularSeq) :
    mk u * mk v = mk v * mk u
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_mul, mk_mul]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  exact equiv_trans (productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise u v)
    (equiv_trans
      (equiv_of_eq (by
        intro n
        unfold mulSeq
        rw [_root_.Rat.mul_comm]))
      (equiv_symm (productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise v u)))

name: one_mul_mk
statement:
theorem one_mul_mk (u : RegularSeq) :
    (1 : CauchyReal) * mk u = mk u
proof:
:= by
  change mk (ofRatSeq 1) * mk u = mk u
  rw [mk_mul]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  exact equiv_trans (productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise (ofRatSeq 1) u)
    (equiv_of_eq (by
      intro n
      unfold mulSeq
      change (1 : Rat) * u.seq n = u.seq n
      rw [_root_.Rat.one_mul]))

name: mul_one_mk
statement:
theorem mul_one_mk (u : RegularSeq) :
    mk u * (1 : CauchyReal) = mk u
proof:
:= by
  change mk u * mk (ofRatSeq 1) = mk u
  rw [mk_mul]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  exact equiv_trans (productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise u (ofRatSeq 1))
    (equiv_of_eq (by
      intro n
      unfold mulSeq
      change u.seq n * (1 : Rat) = u.seq n
      rw [_root_.Rat.mul_one]))

name: zero_mul_mk
statement:
theorem zero_mul_mk (u : RegularSeq) :
    (0 : CauchyReal) * mk u = (0 : CauchyReal)
proof:
:= by
  change mk (ofRatSeq 0) * mk u = mk (ofRatSeq 0)
  rw [mk_mul]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  exact equiv_trans (productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise (ofRatSeq 0) u)
    (equiv_of_eq (by
      intro n
      unfold mulSeq
      change (0 : Rat) * u.seq n = (0 : Rat)
      rw [_root_.Rat.zero_mul]))

name: mul_zero_mk
statement:
theorem mul_zero_mk (u : RegularSeq) :
    mk u * (0 : CauchyReal) = (0 : CauchyReal)
proof:
:= by
  change mk u * mk (ofRatSeq 0) = mk (ofRatSeq 0)
  rw [mk_mul]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  exact equiv_trans (productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise u (ofRatSeq 0))
    (equiv_of_eq (by
      intro n
      unfold mulSeq
      change u.seq n * (0 : Rat) = (0 : Rat)
      rw [_root_.Rat.mul_zero]))

name: mul_assoc_mk
statement:
theorem mul_assoc_mk (u v w : RegularSeq) :
    (mk u * mk v) * mk w = mk u * (mk v * mk w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_mul, mk_mul, mk_mul, mk_mul]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  let uv : RegularSeq := mulRegularSeq u v
  let vw : RegularSeq := mulRegularSeq v w
  have hLeft0 :
      Equiv (mulRegularSeq uv w).seq (mulSeq uv.seq w.seq) :=
    productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise uv w
  have hUv :
      Equiv uv.seq (mulSeq u.seq v.seq) :=
    productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise u v
  have hLeft1 :
      Equiv (mulSeq uv.seq w.seq) (mulSeq (mulSeq u.seq v.seq) w.seq) :=
    mulSeq_respects_of_bounded
      (Bounded.mul (regular_bounded u.regular) (regular_bounded v.regular))
      (regular_bounded w.regular)
      hUv (equiv_refl w.seq)
  have hAssoc :
      Equiv (mulSeq (mulSeq u.seq v.seq) w.seq)
        (mulSeq u.seq (mulSeq v.seq w.seq)) := by
    apply equiv_of_eq
    intro n
    unfold mulSeq
    rw [_root_.Rat.mul_assoc]
  have hVw :
      Equiv vw.seq (mulSeq v.seq w.seq) :=
    productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise v w
  have hRight1 :
      Equiv (mulSeq u.seq (mulSeq v.seq w.seq)) (mulSeq u.seq vw.seq) :=
    mulSeq_respects_of_bounded
      (regular_bounded u.regular)
      (Bounded.mul (regular_bounded v.regular) (regular_bounded w.regular))
      (equiv_refl u.seq) (equiv_symm hVw)
  have hRight2 :
      Equiv (mulSeq u.seq vw.seq) (mulRegularSeq u vw).seq :=
    equiv_symm (productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise u vw)
  exact equiv_trans hLeft0
    (equiv_trans hLeft1
      (equiv_trans hAssoc
        (equiv_trans hRight1 hRight2)))

name: mul_add_mk
statement:
theorem mul_add_mk (u v w : RegularSeq) :
    mk u * (mk v + mk w) = mk u * mk v + mk u * mk w
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_add, mk_mul, mk_mul, mk_mul, mk_add]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  let vwAdd : RegularSeq := addRegularSeq v w
  let uv : RegularSeq := mulRegularSeq u v
  let uw : RegularSeq := mulRegularSeq u w
  have hLeft0 :
      Equiv (mulRegularSeq u vwAdd).seq (mulSeq u.seq vwAdd.seq) :=
    productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise u vwAdd
  have hVwAdd :
      Equiv vwAdd.seq (addSeq v.seq w.seq) :=
    addRegularSeq_equiv_pointwise v w
  have hLeft1 :
      Equiv (mulSeq u.seq vwAdd.seq) (mulSeq u.seq (addSeq v.seq w.seq)) :=
    mulSeq_respects_of_bounded
      (regular_bounded u.regular)
      (regular_bounded vwAdd.regular)
      (equiv_refl u.seq) hVwAdd
  have hDistrib :
      Equiv (mulSeq u.seq (addSeq v.seq w.seq))
        (addSeq (mulSeq u.seq v.seq) (mulSeq u.seq w.seq)) := by
    apply equiv_of_eq
    intro n
    unfold mulSeq addSeq
    rw [_root_.Rat.mul_add]
  have hUv :
      Equiv uv.seq (mulSeq u.seq v.seq) :=
    productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise u v
  have hUw :
      Equiv uw.seq (mulSeq u.seq w.seq) :=
    productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise u w
  have hRight1 :
      Equiv (addSeq (mulSeq u.seq v.seq) (mulSeq u.seq w.seq))
        (addSeq uv.seq uw.seq) :=
    addSeq_respects (equiv_symm hUv) (equiv_symm hUw)
  have hRight2 :
      Equiv (addSeq uv.seq uw.seq) (addRegularSeq uv uw).seq :=
    equiv_symm (addRegularSeq_equiv_pointwise uv uw)
  exact equiv_trans hLeft0
    (equiv_trans hLeft1
      (equiv_trans hDistrib
        (equiv_trans hRight1 hRight2)))

name: mul_comm
statement:
theorem mul_comm (x y : CauchyReal) :
    x * y = y * x
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
  intro u v
  exact mul_comm_mk u v

name: mul_assoc
statement:
theorem mul_assoc (x y z : CauchyReal) :
    (x * y) * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quotient.inductionOn₃ x y z ?_
  intro u v w
  exact mul_assoc_mk u v w

name: mul_add
statement:
theorem mul_add (x y z : CauchyReal) :
    x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quotient.inductionOn₃ x y z ?_
  intro u v w
  exact mul_add_mk u v w

name: add_mul
statement:
theorem add_mul (x y z : CauchyReal) :
    (x + y) * z = x * z + y * z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (x + y) * z = z * (x + y) := mul_comm (x + y) z
    _ = z * x + z * y := mul_add z x y
    _ = x * z + y * z := by
      rw [mul_comm z x, mul_comm z y]

name: one_mul
statement:
theorem one_mul (x : CauchyReal) :

proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quot.ind (β := fun x => (1 : CauchyReal) * x = x) ?_ x
  intro u
  exact one_mul_mk u

name: mul_one
statement:
theorem mul_one (x : CauchyReal) :

name: zero_mul
statement:
theorem zero_mul (x : CauchyReal) :

name: mul_zero
statement:
theorem mul_zero (x : CauchyReal) :

statement:
theorem mulSeq_const_zero_left (u : Seq) :

name: mulSeq_const_zero_right
statement:
theorem mulSeq_const_zero_right (u : Seq) :
