name: gauge_pos
statement: theorem gauge_pos (n : Nat) : 0 < gauge n
proof:
:= by
  unfold gauge
  apply _root_.Rat.inv_pos.mpr
  apply _root_.Rat.natCast_pos.mpr
  exact Nat.succ_pos n

name: gauge_zero
statement: theorem gauge_zero : gauge 0 = (1 : Rat)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gauge
  have h : (1 : Rat) * (1 : Rat)⁻¹ = 1 :=
    _root_.Rat.mul_inv_cancel (1 : Rat) (by decide)
  simpa [_root_.Rat.one_mul] using h

name: gauge_add_pos
statement: theorem gauge_add_pos (n m : Nat) : 0 < gauge n + gauge m
proof:
:= by
  have h := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_lt_add (gauge_pos n) (gauge_pos m)
  simpa [_root_.Rat.zero_add] using h

name: gauge_lt_two
statement: theorem gauge_lt_two (n : Nat) : gauge n < 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold gauge
  rw [← _root_.Rat.one_mul (((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat)⁻¹)]
  rw [← _root_.Rat.div_def]
  have hden : (0 : Rat) < ((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat) :=
    _root_.Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n)
  apply (_root_.Rat.div_lt_iff hden).mpr
  rw [_root_.Rat.mul_comm]
  have hnat : (1 : Nat) < (n + 1) * 2 := by
    have h : (1 : Nat) * 1 < (n + 1) * 2 :=
      Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt
        (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)) (by decide) (Nat.succ_pos n)
    simpa using h
  have hrat : (1 : Rat) < (((n + 1) * 2 : Nat) : Rat) :=
    _root_.Rat.natCast_lt_natCast.mpr hnat
  simpa [_root_.Rat.natCast_mul] using hrat

name: gauge_add_lt_four
statement: theorem gauge_add_lt_four (n m : Nat) : gauge n + gauge m < 4
proof:
:= by
  have h := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_lt_add (gauge_lt_two n) (gauge_lt_two m)
  have h24 : (2 : Rat) + 2 = 4 := by
    change (((2 : Nat) : Rat) + ((2 : Nat) : Rat)) = ((4 : Nat) : Rat)
    rw [← _root_.Rat.natCast_add (2) (2)]
  simpa [h24] using h

name: ratAbs_nonneg
statement: theorem ratAbs_nonneg (q : Rat) : 0 <= ratAbs q
proof:
:= by
  unfold ratAbs
  by_cases hq : q < 0
  · simp [hq]
    have hq0 : q <= 0 := _root_.Rat.le_of_lt hq
    have hneg : -0 <= -q := _root_.Rat.neg_le_neg hq0
    simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_zero] using hneg
  · simp [hq]
    exact _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hq

name: le_ratAbs
statement: theorem le_ratAbs (q : Rat) : q <= ratAbs q
proof:
:= by
  unfold ratAbs
  by_cases hq : q < 0
  · simp [hq]
    have hq0 : q <= 0 := _root_.Rat.le_of_lt hq
    have h0neg : 0 <= -q := by
      have hneg : -0 <= -q := _root_.Rat.neg_le_neg hq0
      simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_zero] using hneg
    exact _root_.Rat.le_trans hq0 h0neg
  · simp [hq]

name: neg_le_ratAbs
statement: theorem neg_le_ratAbs (q : Rat) : -q <= ratAbs q
proof:
:= by
  unfold ratAbs
  by_cases hq : q < 0
  · simp [hq]
  · simp [hq]
    have h0q : 0 <= q := _root_.Rat.not_lt.mp hq
    have hnq0 : -q <= -0 := _root_.Rat.neg_le_neg h0q
    exact _root_.Rat.le_trans (by simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_zero] using hnq0) h0q

name: ratAbs_le_of_bounds
statement:
theorem ratAbs_le_of_bounds {q B : Rat}
    (hq : q <= B)
    (hnq : -q <= B) :
    ratAbs q <= B
proof:
:= by
  unfold ratAbs
  by_cases hq0 : q < 0
  · simp [hq0]
    exact hnq
  · simp [hq0]
    exact hq

name: ratAbs_add_le
statement:
theorem ratAbs_add_le (a b : Rat) :
    ratAbs (a + b) <= ratAbs a + ratAbs b
proof:
:= by
  apply ratAbs_le_of_bounds
  · exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add (le_ratAbs a) (le_ratAbs b)
  · have hle := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add (neg_le_ratAbs a) (neg_le_ratAbs b)
    simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_add] using hle

name: ratAbs_neg
statement: theorem ratAbs_neg (q : Rat) : ratAbs (-q) = ratAbs q
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.Rat.le_antisymm
  · apply ratAbs_le_of_bounds
    · exact neg_le_ratAbs q
    · simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_neg] using le_ratAbs q
  · have h := ratAbs_le_of_bounds
      (q := q) (B := ratAbs (-q))
      (by simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_neg] using neg_le_ratAbs (-q))
      (by simpa using le_ratAbs (-q))
    exact h

name: ratAbs_sub_comm
statement:
theorem ratAbs_sub_comm (a b : Rat) :
    ratAbs (a - b) = ratAbs (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  have h : b - a = -(a - b) := by
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp [_root_.Rat.neg_add, _root_.Rat.add_comm]
  rw [h]
  rw [ratAbs_neg]

name: Bounded.congr
statement:
theorem Bounded.congr {u v : Seq}
    (h : forall n, u n = v n)
    (hu : Bounded u) :
    Bounded v
proof:
:= by
  cases hu with
  | intro B hB =>
      exact Exists.intro B (And.intro hB.left (by
        intro n
        rw [← h n]
        exact hB.right n))

name: Bounded.zero
statement: theorem Bounded.zero : Bounded (fun _ : Nat => (0 : Rat))
proof:
:= by
  exact Exists.intro 0 (And.intro (_root_.Rat.le_refl) (by
    intro n
    constructor <;> simp))

name: Bounded.neg
statement:
theorem Bounded.neg {u : Seq} (hu : Bounded u) :
    Bounded (fun n => -u n)
proof:
:= by
  cases hu with
  | intro B hB =>
      exact Exists.intro B (And.intro hB.left (by
        intro n
        constructor
        · exact (hB.right n).right
        · simpa using (hB.right n).left))

name: Bounded.add
statement:
theorem Bounded.add {u v : Seq}
    (hu : Bounded u)
    (hv : Bounded v) :
    Bounded (fun n => u n + v n)
proof:
:= by
  cases hu with
  | intro B hB =>
      cases hv with
      | intro C hC =>
          exact Exists.intro (B + C) (And.intro (_root_.Rat.add_nonneg hB.left hC.left) (by
            intro n
            constructor
            · exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add (hB.right n).left (hC.right n).left
            · have hle := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add (hB.right n).right (hC.right n).right
              simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_add] using hle))

name: Bounded.sub
statement:
theorem Bounded.sub {u v : Seq}
    (hu : Bounded u)
    (hv : Bounded v) :
    Bounded (fun n => u n - v n)
proof:
:= by
  apply Bounded.congr (u := fun n => u n + (-v n))
  · intro n
    exact (_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg (u n) (v n)).symm
  · exact Bounded.add hu (Bounded.neg hv)

name: Bounded.const
statement: theorem Bounded.const (q : Rat) : Bounded (constSeq q)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0q : 0 <= q
  · exact Exists.intro q (And.intro h0q (by
      intro n
      constructor
      · exact _root_.Rat.le_refl
      · exact _root_.Rat.le_trans (_root_.Rat.neg_le_neg h0q) h0q))
  · have hq0lt : q < 0 := _root_.Rat.not_le.mp h0q
    have hq0 : q <= 0 := _root_.Rat.le_of_lt hq0lt
    exact Exists.intro (-q) (And.intro (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0q) (by
      intro n
      constructor
      · exact _root_.Rat.le_trans hq0 (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.neg_nonneg_of_not_nonneg h0q)
      · exact _root_.Rat.le_refl))

name: regular_bounded
statement: theorem regular_bounded {u : Seq} (hu : Regular u) : Bounded u
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro (ratAbs (u 0) + 4) ?_
  constructor
  · exact _root_.Rat.add_nonneg (ratAbs_nonneg (u 0)) (by decide)
  · intro n
    have hg04 : gauge n + gauge 0 <= 4 :=
      _root_.Rat.le_of_lt (gauge_add_lt_four n 0)
    have hg40 : gauge 0 + gauge n <= 4 :=
      _root_.Rat.le_of_lt (gauge_add_lt_four 0 n)
    constructor
    · have hdiff : ratAbs (u n - u 0) <= gauge n + gauge 0 :=
        _root_.Rat.le_of_lt (hu n 0)
      calc
        u n = (u n - u 0) + u 0 := by
          rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
          rw [_root_.Rat.add_assoc]
          rw [_root_.Rat.neg_add_cancel]
          rw [_root_.Rat.add_zero]
        _ <= ratAbs (u n - u 0) + ratAbs (u 0) :=
          Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add (le_ratAbs (u n - u 0)) (le_ratAbs (u 0))
        _ <= (gauge n + gauge 0) + ratAbs (u 0) :=
          Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add hdiff _root_.Rat.le_refl
        _ <= 4 + ratAbs (u 0) :=
          Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add hg04 _root_.Rat.le_refl
        _ = ratAbs (u 0) + 4 := by
          rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm]
    · have hdiff : ratAbs (u 0 - u n) <= gauge 0 + gauge n :=
        _root_.Rat.le_of_lt (hu 0 n)
      calc
        -u n = (u 0 - u n) + -u 0 := by
          rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
          rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm (u 0) (-u n)]
          rw [_root_.Rat.add_assoc]
          rw [_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel]
          rw [_root_.Rat.add_zero]
        _ <= ratAbs (u 0 - u n) + ratAbs (u 0) :=
          Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add (le_ratAbs (u 0 - u n)) (neg_le_ratAbs (u 0))
        _ <= (gauge 0 + gauge n) + ratAbs (u 0) :=
          Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add hdiff _root_.Rat.le_refl
        _ <= 4 + ratAbs (u 0) :=
          Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add hg40 _root_.Rat.le_refl
        _ = ratAbs (u 0) + 4 := by
          rw [_root_.Rat.add_comm]

name: RateBounded.congr
statement:
theorem RateBounded.congr {u v : Seq}
    (h : forall n, u n = v n)
    (hu : RateBounded u) :
    RateBounded v
proof:
:= by
  cases hu with
  | intro C hC =>
      exact Exists.intro C (And.intro hC.left (by
        intro n
        rw [← h n]
        exact hC.right n))

name: RateBounded.zero
statement: theorem RateBounded.zero : RateBounded (fun _ : Nat => (0 : Rat))
proof:
:= by
  exact Exists.intro 0 (And.intro (_root_.Rat.le_refl) (by
    intro n
    constructor <;> simp))

name: RateBounded.neg
statement:
theorem RateBounded.neg {u : Seq} (hu : RateBounded u) :
    RateBounded (fun n => -u n)
proof:
:= by
  cases hu with
  | intro C hC =>
      exact Exists.intro C (And.intro hC.left (by
        intro n
        constructor
        · exact (hC.right n).right
        · simpa using (hC.right n).left))

name: RateBounded.add
statement:
theorem RateBounded.add {u v : Seq}
    (hu : RateBounded u)
    (hv : RateBounded v) :
    RateBounded (fun n => u n + v n)
proof:
:= by
  cases hu with
  | intro C hC =>
      cases hv with
      | intro D hD =>
          exact Exists.intro (C + D) (And.intro (_root_.Rat.add_nonneg hC.left hD.left) (by
            intro n
            constructor
            · have hle := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add (hC.right n).left (hD.right n).left
              simpa [_root_.Rat.add_mul] using hle
            · have hle := Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add (hC.right n).right (hD.right n).right
              simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_add, _root_.Rat.add_mul] using hle))

name: RateBounded.sub
statement:
theorem RateBounded.sub {u v : Seq}
    (hu : RateBounded u)
    (hv : RateBounded v) :
    RateBounded (fun n => u n - v n)
proof:
:= by
  apply RateBounded.congr (u := fun n => u n + (-v n))
  · intro n
    exact (_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg (u n) (v n)).symm
  · exact RateBounded.add hu (RateBounded.neg hv)

name: equiv_refl
statement: theorem equiv_refl (u : Seq) : Equiv u u
proof:
:= by
  apply RateBounded.congr (u := fun _ : Nat => (0 : Rat))
  · intro n
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    exact (_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel (u n)).symm
  · exact RateBounded.zero

name: equiv_of_eq
statement: theorem equiv_of_eq {u v : Seq} (h : forall n, u n = v n) : Equiv u v
proof:
:= by
  apply RateBounded.congr (u := fun _ : Nat => (0 : Rat))
  · intro n
    rw [h n]
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    exact (_root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel (v n)).symm
  · exact RateBounded.zero

name: equiv_symm
statement: theorem equiv_symm {u v : Seq} (h : Equiv u v) : Equiv v u
proof:
:= by
  apply RateBounded.congr (u := fun n => -(u n - v n))
  · intro n
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp [_root_.Rat.neg_add, _root_.Rat.add_comm]
  · exact RateBounded.neg h

name: equiv_trans
statement:
theorem equiv_trans {u v w : Seq}
    (huv : Equiv u v)
    (hvw : Equiv v w) :
    Equiv u w
proof:
:= by
  apply RateBounded.congr (u := fun n => (u n - v n) + (v n - w n))
  · intro n
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [_root_.Rat.add_assoc (u n) (-v n) (v n + -w n)]
    rw [← _root_.Rat.add_assoc (-v n) (v n) (-w n)]
    rw [_root_.Rat.neg_add_cancel, _root_.Rat.zero_add]
  · exact RateBounded.add huv hvw

name: addSeq_respects
statement:
theorem addSeq_respects {u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : Seq}
    (hu : Equiv u₁ u₂)
    (hv : Equiv v₁ v₂) :
    Equiv (addSeq u₁ v₁) (addSeq u₂ v₂)
proof:
:= by
  apply RateBounded.congr
    (u := fun n => (u₁ n - u₂ n) + (v₁ n - v₂ n))
  · intro n
    unfold addSeq
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp [_root_.Rat.neg_add, _root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_left_comm]
  · exact RateBounded.add hu hv

name: negSeq_respects
proof:
:= by
  apply RateBounded.congr (u := fun n => -(u n - v n))
  · intro n
    unfold negSeq
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp [_root_.Rat.neg_add, _root_.Rat.add_comm]
  · exact RateBounded.neg h

name: subSeq_respects
statement:
theorem subSeq_respects {u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : Seq}
    (hu : Equiv u₁ u₂)
    (hv : Equiv v₁ v₂) :
    Equiv (subSeq u₁ v₁) (subSeq u₂ v₂)
proof:
:= by
  apply RateBounded.congr
    (u := fun n => addSeq u₁ (negSeq v₁) n - addSeq u₂ (negSeq v₂) n)
  · intro n
    rfl
  · exact addSeq_respects hu (negSeq_respects hv)

name: constSeq_regular
statement: theorem constSeq_regular (q : Rat) : Regular (constSeq q)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m
  unfold constSeq ratAbs
  have h0 : q - q = 0 := by
    rw [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg]
    exact _root_.Rat.add_neg_cancel q
  rw [h0]
  simp [_root_.Rat.lt_irrefl]
  exact gauge_add_pos n m

name: regularSeqEquiv_refl
statement: theorem regularSeqEquiv_refl (u : RegularSeq) : regularSeqEquiv u u
proof:
:=
  equiv_refl u.seq

name: regularSeqEquiv_symm
proof:
:=
  equiv_symm h

name: regularSeqEquiv_trans
statement:
theorem regularSeqEquiv_trans {u v w : RegularSeq}
    (huv : regularSeqEquiv u v)
    (hvw : regularSeqEquiv v w) :
    regularSeqEquiv u w
proof:
:=
  equiv_trans huv hvw

name: mk_eq_mk
proof:
:=
  _root_.Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Foundation.Setoid.sound (s := regularSeqSetoid) h

name: rat_half_add_half
statement: theorem rat_half_add_half (q : Rat) : q / 2 + q / 2 = q
proof:
:= by
  have h : q / 2 * 2 = q := by
    rw [_root_.Rat.div_mul_cancel]
    decide
  rw [Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.mul_two] at h
  exact h

name: exists_gauge_lt_both
statement:
theorem exists_gauge_lt_both {a b : Rat}
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (hb : 0 < b) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat => And (gauge n < a) (gauge n < b))
proof:
:= by
  cases _root_.Rat.le_total (a := a) (b := b) with
  | inl hab =>
      cases exists_gauge_lt ha with
      | intro n hn =>
          exact Exists.intro n
            (And.intro hn (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn hab))
  | inr hba =>
      cases exists_gauge_lt hb with
      | intro n hn =>
          exact Exists.intro n
            (And.intro (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn hba) hn)

name: half_lt_value_of_gap_bound
statement:
theorem half_lt_value_of_gap_bound {u : RegularSeq} {n m : Nat} {delta : Rat}
    (hdu : delta <= u.seq n - gauge n)
    (hm : gauge m < delta / 2) :
    delta / 2 < u.seq m
proof:
:= by
  have hreg_abs : ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq m) < gauge n + gauge m :=
    u.regular n m
  have hdiff_lt : u.seq n - u.seq m < gauge n + gauge m :=
    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt
      (le_ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq m)) hreg_abs
  have h_un_lt : u.seq n < (gauge n + gauge m) + u.seq m :=
    (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
      (a := u.seq n) (b := gauge n + gauge m)
      (c := u.seq m)).mp hdiff_lt
  have hgap_lt : u.seq n - gauge n < u.seq m + gauge m := by
    apply (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
      (a := u.seq n) (b := u.seq m + gauge m)
      (c := gauge n)).mpr
    simpa [_root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_comm,
      _root_.Rat.add_left_comm] using h_un_lt
  have hdelta_lt : delta < u.seq m + gauge m :=
    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt hdu hgap_lt
  have hlower : delta - gauge m < u.seq m :=
    (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
      (a := delta) (b := u.seq m) (c := gauge m)).mpr hdelta_lt
  have hhalf_lower : delta / 2 < delta - gauge m := by
    apply (_root_.Rat.lt_sub_right_iff_add_lt
      (a := delta / 2) (b := gauge m) (c := delta)).mpr
    have hsum : delta / 2 + gauge m < delta / 2 + delta / 2 :=
      (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_left
        (a := gauge m) (b := delta / 2) (c := delta / 2)).mpr hm
    simpa [rat_half_add_half delta] using hsum
  exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hhalf_lower hlower

name: seqPos_mulRegularSeq
statement:
theorem seqPos_mulRegularSeq {u v : RegularSeq}
    (hu : SeqPos u.seq)
    (hv : SeqPos v.seq) :
    SeqPos (mulRegularSeq u v).seq
proof:
:= by
  cases hu with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases hv with
      | intro m hm =>
          let du : Rat := u.seq n - gauge n
          let dv : Rat := v.seq m - gauge m
          have hdu : 0 < du := by
            unfold du
            exact (_root_.Rat.lt_iff_sub_pos (gauge n) (u.seq n)).mp hn
          have hdv : 0 < dv := by
            unfold dv
            exact (_root_.Rat.lt_iff_sub_pos (gauge m) (v.seq m)).mp hm
          have hdelta :
              Exists (fun delta : Rat =>
                And (0 < delta) (And (delta <= du) (delta <= dv))) := by
            cases _root_.Rat.le_total (a := du) (b := dv) with
            | inl hduv =>
                exact Exists.intro du
                  (And.intro hdu (And.intro _root_.Rat.le_refl hduv))
            | inr hvdu =>
                exact Exists.intro dv
                  (And.intro hdv (And.intro hvdu _root_.Rat.le_refl))
          cases hdelta with
          | intro delta hdelta =>
              let half : Rat := delta / 2
              let eps : Rat := half * half
              have hhalf : 0 < half := by
                unfold half
                exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.half_pos hdelta.left
              have heps : 0 < eps := by
                unfold eps
                exact _root_.Rat.mul_pos hhalf hhalf
              cases exists_gauge_lt_both hhalf heps with
              | intro k hk =>
                  let speed : Nat := productSpeed u v
                  let i : Nat := scaleIndex speed k
                  refine Exists.intro k ?_
                  have hgi_le : gauge i <= gauge k := by
                    unfold i speed
                    exact gauge_scaleIndex_le (productSpeed u v) k
                  have hgi_half : gauge i < half :=
                    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt hgi_le hk.left
                  have hui : half < u.seq i := by
                    unfold half
                    unfold du at hdelta
                    exact half_lt_value_of_gap_bound
                      (u := u) (n := n) (m := i)
                      hdelta.right.left hgi_half
                  have hvi : half < v.seq i := by
                    unfold half
                    unfold dv at hdelta
                    exact half_lt_value_of_gap_bound
                      (u := v) (n := m) (m := i)
                      hdelta.right.right hgi_half
                  have hprod : eps < u.seq i * v.seq i := by
                    unfold eps
                    exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt_of_pos_of_pos
                      hui hvi hhalf (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hhalf hui)
                  have hgprod : gauge k < u.seq i * v.seq i :=
                    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hk.right hprod
                  change gauge k < productRawSeq u v k
                  simpa [productRawSeq, productScaleSeq, scaleSeq, reindexSeq,
                    mulSeq, i, speed] using hgprod

name: positive_mul
statement:
theorem positive_mul {x y : CauchyReal}
    (hx : Positive x)
    (hy : Positive y) :
    Positive (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_ hx hy
  intro u v hu hv
  change SeqPos u.seq at hu
  change SeqPos v.seq at hv
  change SeqPos (mulRegularSeq u v).seq
  exact seqPos_mulRegularSeq hu hv

name: positive_of_zero_lt
statement:
theorem positive_of_zero_lt {x : CauchyReal} (h : 0 < x) :
    Positive x
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at h
  rw [sub_zero] at h
  exact h

name: zero_lt_of_positive
statement:
theorem zero_lt_of_positive {x : CauchyReal} (h : Positive x) :
    0 < x
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def]
  rw [sub_zero]
  exact h

name: mul_pos
statement:
theorem mul_pos {x y : CauchyReal}
    (hx : 0 < x)
    (hy : 0 < y) :
    0 < x * y
proof:
:=
  zero_lt_of_positive
    (positive_mul (positive_of_zero_lt hx) (positive_of_zero_lt hy))

name: sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
statement:
theorem sub_mul_eq_sub_mul (x y z : CauchyReal) :
    (y - x) * z = y * z - x * z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (y - x) * z = (y + (-x)) * z := by rfl
    _ = y * z + (-x) * z := by rw [add_mul]
    _ = y * z + -(x * z) := by rw [neg_mul]
    _ = y * z - x * z := by rfl

name: mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
statement:
theorem mul_sub_eq_mul_sub (x y z : CauchyReal) :
    z * (y - x) = z * y - z * x
proof:
:= by
  calc
    z * (y - x) = (y - x) * z := by rw [mul_comm]
    _ = y * z - x * z := sub_mul_eq_sub_mul x y z
    _ = z * y - z * x := by
      rw [mul_comm y z]
      rw [mul_comm x z]

name: mul_lt_mul_pos_right
statement:
theorem mul_lt_mul_pos_right {x y z : CauchyReal}
    (hxy : x < y)
    (hz : 0 < z) :
    x * z < y * z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_def] at hxy ⊢
  have hprod : Positive ((y - x) * z) :=
    positive_mul hxy (positive_of_zero_lt hz)
  rw [sub_mul_eq_sub_mul x y z] at hprod
  exact hprod

name: mul_lt_mul_pos_left
statement:
theorem mul_lt_mul_pos_left {x y z : CauchyReal}
    (hxy : x < y)
    (hz : 0 < z) :
    z * x < z * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm z x]
  rw [mul_comm z y]
  exact mul_lt_mul_pos_right hxy hz

name: lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right
statement:
theorem lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right {x y z : CauchyReal}
    (h : x * z < y * z)
    (hz : 0 < z) :
    x < y
proof:
:= by
  cases lt_trichotomy x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact hxy
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hxy_eq =>
          rw [hxy_eq] at h
          exact False.elim (lt_irrefl (y * z) h)
      | inr hyx =>
          have hyxz : y * z < x * z :=
            mul_lt_mul_pos_right hyx hz
          exact False.elim (lt_asymm hyxz h)

name: lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_left
statement:
theorem lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_left {x y z : CauchyReal}
    (h : z * x < z * y)
    (hz : 0 < z) :
    x < y
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right (z := z)
  · simpa [mul_comm x z, mul_comm y z] using h
  · exact hz

name: mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
statement:
theorem mul_le_mul_nonneg_right {x y z : CauchyReal}
    (hxy : x <= y)
    (h0z : 0 <= z) :
    x * z <= y * z
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_not_gt] at hxy h0z ⊢
  intro hbad
  cases positive_zero_negative_trichotomy z with
  | inl hzpos =>
      have hz : 0 < z := zero_lt_of_positive hzpos
      cases lt_trichotomy x y with
      | inl hxylt =>
          exact lt_asymm (mul_lt_mul_pos_right hxylt hz) hbad
      | inr hrest =>
          cases hrest with
          | inl hxy_eq =>
              rw [hxy_eq] at hbad
              exact lt_irrefl (y * z) hbad
          | inr hyx =>
              exact hxy hyx
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hz0 =>
          rw [hz0] at hbad
          rw [mul_zero] at hbad
          rw [mul_zero] at hbad
          exact lt_irrefl 0 hbad
      | inr hzneg =>
          have hzlt : z < 0 := by
            rw [lt_def]
            rw [zero_sub]
            exact hzneg
          exact h0z hzlt

name: mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
statement:
theorem mul_le_mul_nonneg_left {x y z : CauchyReal}
    (hxy : x <= y)
    (h0z : 0 <= z) :
    z * x <= z * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm z x]
  rw [mul_comm z y]
  exact mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hxy h0z

name: mul_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_nonneg {x y : CauchyReal}
    (h0x : 0 <= x)
    (h0y : 0 <= y) :
    0 <= x * y
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : 0 * y <= x * y :=
    mul_le_mul_nonneg_right h0x h0y
  rw [zero_mul] at hmul
  exact hmul

name: two_mul_add_two_mul
statement:
theorem two_mul_add_two_mul (a : Rat) :
    (2 : Rat) * a + (2 : Rat) * a = (4 : Rat) * a
proof:
:= by
  have h24 : (2 : Rat) + 2 = 4 := by
    change (((2 : Nat) : Rat) + ((2 : Nat) : Rat) = ((4 : Nat) : Rat))
    rw [<- _root_.Rat.natCast_add]
  calc
    (2 : Rat) * a + (2 : Rat) * a = ((2 : Rat) + 2) * a := by
      rw [<- _root_.Rat.add_mul]
    _ = (4 : Rat) * a := by
      rw [h24]

name: exists_pos_ofRat_lt_of_pos
proof:
:= by
  let u := rep x
  have hmk : mk u = x := by
    unfold u
    exact mk_rep x
  have hpos : SeqPos u.seq := by
    have hxpos : Positive x := by
      rw [lt_def] at hx
      rw [sub_zero] at hx
      exact hx
    change Positive (mk u)
    rw [hmk]
    exact hxpos
  cases hpos with
  | intro n hn =>
      let delta : Rat := u.seq n - gauge n
      have hdelta : 0 < delta := by
        unfold delta
        exact (_root_.Rat.lt_iff_sub_pos (gauge n) (u.seq n)).mp hn
      cases exists_mul_gauge_lt 3 delta hdelta with
      | intro i hi =>
          have hreg_abs :
              ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq i) < gauge n + gauge i :=
            u.regular n i
          have hdiff_lt :
              u.seq n - u.seq i < gauge n + gauge i :=
            Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt
              (le_ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq i)) hreg_abs
          have h_un_lt :
              u.seq n < (gauge n + gauge i) + u.seq i :=
            (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
              (a := u.seq n) (b := gauge n + gauge i)
              (c := u.seq i)).mp hdiff_lt
          have hdelta_lt :
              delta < u.seq i + gauge i := by
            unfold delta
            apply (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
              (a := u.seq n) (b := u.seq i + gauge i)
              (c := gauge n)).mpr
            simpa [_root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_comm,
              _root_.Rat.add_left_comm] using h_un_lt
          have hlower :
              delta - gauge i < u.seq i :=
            (_root_.Rat.sub_lt_iff
              (a := delta) (b := u.seq i) (c := gauge i)).mpr
              hdelta_lt
          have htwo_lt_delta_sub :
              (2 : Rat) * gauge i < delta - gauge i := by
            apply (_root_.Rat.lt_sub_right_iff_add_lt
              (a := (2 : Rat) * gauge i) (b := gauge i)
              (c := delta)).mpr
            simpa [two_mul_add_eq_three_mul] using hi
          have htwo_lt_value :
              (2 : Rat) * gauge i < u.seq i :=
            Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans htwo_lt_delta_sub hlower
          refine Exists.intro
            (u.seq i - (2 : Rat) * gauge i) ?_
          constructor
          · exact
              (_root_.Rat.lt_iff_sub_pos
                ((2 : Rat) * gauge i) (u.seq i)).mp htwo_lt_value
          · have h :=
              term_sub_two_gauge_lt_mk u i
            rwa [hmk] at h

name: exists_rat_between_right_of_pos_gap
statement:
theorem exists_rat_between_right_of_pos_gap
    (x : CauchyReal) {r : Rat} (hr : 0 < r) :
    Exists
      (fun q : Rat => And (x < ofRat q) (ofRat q < x + ofRat r))
proof:
:= by
  let u := rep x
  have hmk : mk u = x := by
    unfold u
    exact mk_rep x
  cases exists_mul_gauge_lt 4 r hr with
  | intro n hn =>
      let lower : Rat := u.seq n - (2 : Rat) * gauge n
      let upper : Rat := u.seq n + (2 : Rat) * gauge n
      have hlower_x : ofRat lower < x := by
        unfold lower
        have h :=
          term_sub_two_gauge_lt_mk u n
        rwa [hmk] at h
      have hx_upper : x < ofRat upper := by
        unfold upper
        have h :=
          mk_lt_of_term_add_two_gauge u n
        rwa [hmk] at h
      have htwo_add_lt :
          (2 : Rat) * gauge n + (2 : Rat) * gauge n < r := by
        simpa [two_mul_add_two_mul] using hn
      have htwo_lt_sub :
          (2 : Rat) * gauge n < r - (2 : Rat) * gauge n :=
        (_root_.Rat.lt_sub_right_iff_add_lt
          (a := (2 : Rat) * gauge n)
          (b := (2 : Rat) * gauge n)
          (c := r)).mpr htwo_add_lt
      have hupper_lt_lower_add_r : upper < lower + r := by
        have htmp :
            u.seq n + (2 : Rat) * gauge n <
              u.seq n + (r - (2 : Rat) * gauge n) :=
          (_root_.Rat.add_lt_add_left
            (a := (2 : Rat) * gauge n)
            (b := r - (2 : Rat) * gauge n)
            (c := u.seq n)).mpr htwo_lt_sub
        unfold upper lower
        simpa [_root_.Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, _root_.Rat.add_assoc,
          _root_.Rat.add_comm, _root_.Rat.add_left_comm] using htmp
      have hupper_real :
          ofRat upper < ofRat lower + ofRat r := by
        have h := ofRat_lt_of_lt hupper_lt_lower_add_r
        have hadd : ofRat (lower + r) = ofRat lower + ofRat r := by
          rw [ofRat_add]
        rwa [hadd] at h
      have hlower_plus :
          ofRat lower + ofRat r < x + ofRat r :=
        add_lt_add_right hlower_x (ofRat r)
      exact Exists.intro upper
        (And.intro hx_upper (lt_trans hupper_real hlower_plus))

name: exists_rat_between
proof:
:= by
  have hgap : (0 : CauchyReal) < y - x := by
    rw [lt_def]
    rw [sub_zero]
    rw [lt_def] at hxy
    exact hxy
  cases exists_pos_ofRat_lt_of_pos hgap with
  | intro r hr =>
      cases exists_rat_between_right_of_pos_gap x hr.left with
      | intro q hq =>
          refine Exists.intro q ?_
          constructor
          · exact hq.left
          · have hxr_y : x + ofRat r < y := by
              have h :=
                add_lt_add_left hr.right x
              have hcancel : x + (y - x) = y := by
                change x + (y + -x) = y
                calc
                  x + (y + -x) = x + (-x + y) := by
                    rw [add_comm y (-x)]
                  _ = (x + -x) + y := by
                    rw [<- add_assoc]
                  _ = (0 : CauchyReal) + y := by
                    rw [add_neg]
                  _ = y := by
                    rw [zero_add]
              rwa [hcancel] at h
            exact lt_trans hq.right hxr_y

name: boundSum_lt_productSpeed
statement:
theorem boundSum_lt_productSpeed (u v : RegularSeq) :

name: boundSum_lt_productFactor
statement:
theorem boundSum_lt_productFactor (u v : RegularSeq) :
    boundSum u v <
      (((productSpeed u v + 1 : Nat) : Rat))
proof:
:= by
  have hspeed := boundSum_lt_productSpeed u v
  have hnat : productSpeed u v < productSpeed u v + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_succ_self (productSpeed u v)
  have hrat :
      ((productSpeed u v : Nat) : Rat) <
        (((productSpeed u v + 1 : Nat) : Rat)) :=
    _root_.Rat.natCast_lt_natCast.mpr hnat
  exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hspeed hrat

name: rat_add_self_eq_two_mul
statement: theorem rat_add_self_eq_two_mul (a : Rat) : a + a = (2 : Rat) * a
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : Rat) = (1 : Rat) + (1 : Rat) := by
    change (((2 : Nat) : Rat) =
      ((1 : Nat) : Rat) + ((1 : Nat) : Rat))
    rw [<- _root_.Rat.natCast_add]
  rw [h2]
  rw [_root_.Rat.add_mul]
  rw [_root_.Rat.one_mul]

name: doubleIndex_succ_cast
statement:
theorem doubleIndex_succ_cast (n : Nat) :
    (((doubleIndex n + 1 : Nat) : Rat) =
      (2 : Rat) * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat))
proof:
:= by
  unfold doubleIndex
  rw [show 2 * n + 1 + 1 = 2 * (n + 1) by omega]
  rw [_root_.Rat.natCast_mul]
  change (((2 : Nat) : Rat) * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat)) =
    (((2 : Nat) : Rat) * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat))
  rfl

name: scaleIndex_succ_cast
statement:
theorem scaleIndex_succ_cast (k n : Nat) :
    (((scaleIndex k n + 1 : Nat) : Rat) =
      (((k + 1 : Nat) : Rat) * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaleIndex
  rw [show k * (n + 1) + n + 1 = (k + 1) * (n + 1) by
    rw [Nat.add_mul]
    rw [Nat.one_mul]
    rw [Nat.add_assoc]]
  rw [_root_.Rat.natCast_mul]

name: two_mul_gauge_doubleIndex
statement:
theorem two_mul_gauge_doubleIndex (n : Nat) :
    (2 : Rat) * gauge (doubleIndex n) = gauge n
proof:
:= by
  unfold gauge
  rw [doubleIndex_succ_cast n]
  rw [_root_.Rat.inv_mul_rev]
  rw [<- _root_.Rat.mul_assoc]
  rw [_root_.Rat.mul_comm (2 : Rat) (((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat)⁻¹)]
  rw [_root_.Rat.mul_assoc]
  rw [_root_.Rat.mul_inv_cancel (2 : Rat) (by decide)]
  rw [_root_.Rat.mul_one]

name: factor_mul_gauge_scaleIndex
statement:
theorem factor_mul_gauge_scaleIndex (k n : Nat) :
    (((k + 1 : Nat) : Rat) * gauge (scaleIndex k n)) = gauge n
proof:
:= by
  unfold gauge
  rw [scaleIndex_succ_cast k n]
  rw [_root_.Rat.inv_mul_rev]
  rw [<- _root_.Rat.mul_assoc]
  rw [_root_.Rat.mul_comm (((k + 1 : Nat) : Rat))
    (((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat)⁻¹)]
  rw [_root_.Rat.mul_assoc]
  have hpos : (0 : Rat) < ((k + 1 : Nat) : Rat) :=
    _root_.Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos k)
  rw [_root_.Rat.mul_inv_cancel (((k + 1 : Nat) : Rat))
    (_root_.Rat.ne_of_gt hpos)]
  rw [_root_.Rat.mul_one]

name: left_factor_mul_gauge_scaleIndex
statement:
theorem left_factor_mul_gauge_scaleIndex (k n : Nat) :
    (((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat) * gauge (scaleIndex k n)) = gauge k
proof:
:= by
  unfold gauge
  rw [scaleIndex_succ_cast k n]
  rw [_root_.Rat.inv_mul_rev]
  rw [<- _root_.Rat.mul_assoc]
  have hpos : (0 : Rat) < ((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat) :=
    _root_.Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n)
  rw [_root_.Rat.mul_inv_cancel (((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat))
    (_root_.Rat.ne_of_gt hpos)]
  rw [_root_.Rat.one_mul]

name: gauge_doubleIndex_le
statement:
theorem gauge_doubleIndex_le (n : Nat) :
    gauge (doubleIndex n) <= gauge n
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : 0 <= gauge (doubleIndex n) :=
    _root_.Rat.le_of_lt (gauge_pos (doubleIndex n))
  have h12 : (1 : Rat) <= 2 := by decide
  have hmul :
      (1 : Rat) * gauge (doubleIndex n) <=
        (2 : Rat) * gauge (doubleIndex n) :=
    _root_.Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h12 hnonneg
  simpa [_root_.Rat.one_mul, two_mul_gauge_doubleIndex n] using hmul

name: gauge_scaleIndex_le
statement:
theorem gauge_scaleIndex_le (k n : Nat) :
    gauge (scaleIndex k n) <= gauge n
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : 0 <= gauge (scaleIndex k n) :=
    _root_.Rat.le_of_lt (gauge_pos (scaleIndex k n))
  have hnat : 1 <= k + 1 :=
    Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le k)
  have h1factor :
      (1 : Rat) <= ((k + 1 : Nat) : Rat) :=
    _root_.Rat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr hnat
  have hmul :
      (1 : Rat) * gauge (scaleIndex k n) <=
        ((k + 1 : Nat) : Rat) * gauge (scaleIndex k n) :=
    _root_.Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1factor hnonneg
  have hfactor' :
      (((k : Nat) : Rat) + 1) * gauge (scaleIndex k n) = gauge n := by
    simpa [_root_.Rat.natCast_add] using factor_mul_gauge_scaleIndex k n
  simpa [_root_.Rat.one_mul, _root_.Rat.natCast_add, hfactor'] using hmul

name: gauge_scaleIndex_le_left
statement:
theorem gauge_scaleIndex_le_left (k n : Nat) :
    gauge (scaleIndex k n) <= gauge k
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : 0 <= gauge (scaleIndex k n) :=
    _root_.Rat.le_of_lt (gauge_pos (scaleIndex k n))
  have hnat : 1 <= n + 1 :=
    Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)
  have h1factor :
      (1 : Rat) <= ((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat) :=
    _root_.Rat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr hnat
  have hmul :
      (1 : Rat) * gauge (scaleIndex k n) <=
        ((n + 1 : Nat) : Rat) * gauge (scaleIndex k n) :=
    _root_.Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1factor hnonneg
  have hfactor' :
      (((n : Nat) : Rat) + 1) * gauge (scaleIndex k n) = gauge k := by
    simpa [_root_.Rat.natCast_add] using left_factor_mul_gauge_scaleIndex k n
  simpa [_root_.Rat.one_mul, _root_.Rat.natCast_add, hfactor'] using hmul

name: gauge_doubleIndex_pair_sum
statement:
theorem gauge_doubleIndex_pair_sum (n m : Nat) :
    (gauge (doubleIndex n) + gauge (doubleIndex m)) +
      (gauge (doubleIndex n) + gauge (doubleIndex m)) =
    gauge n + gauge m
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (gauge (doubleIndex n) + gauge (doubleIndex m)) +
        (gauge (doubleIndex n) + gauge (doubleIndex m))
        = (gauge (doubleIndex n) + gauge (doubleIndex n)) +
            (gauge (doubleIndex m) + gauge (doubleIndex m)) := by
          simp [_root_.Rat.add_assoc, _root_.Rat.add_comm,
            _root_.Rat.add_left_comm]
    _ = (2 : Rat) * gauge (doubleIndex n) +
          (2 : Rat) * gauge (doubleIndex m) := by
          rw [rat_add_self_eq_two_mul, rat_add_self_eq_two_mul]
    _ = gauge n + gauge m := by
          rw [two_mul_gauge_doubleIndex n, two_mul_gauge_doubleIndex m]

name: reindex_regular_of_gauge_le
statement:
theorem reindex_regular_of_gauge_le {phi : Nat -> Nat} {u : Seq}
    (hphi : forall n, gauge (phi n) <= gauge n)
    (hu : Regular u) :
    Regular (reindexSeq phi u)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m
  exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_lt_of_le (hu (phi n) (phi m))
    (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add (hphi n) (hphi m))

name: doubleSeq_regular
statement:
theorem doubleSeq_regular {u : Seq} (hu : Regular u) :

:=
  reindex_regular_of_gauge_le gauge_doubleIndex_le hu

name: scaleSeq_regular

name: RateBounded.reindex_of_gauge_le
statement:
theorem RateBounded.reindex_of_gauge_le {phi : Nat -> Nat} {u : Seq}
    (hphi : forall n, gauge (phi n) <= gauge n)
    (hu : RateBounded u) :
    RateBounded (reindexSeq phi u)
proof:
:= by
  cases hu with
  | intro C hC =>
      exact Exists.intro C (And.intro hC.left (by
        intro n
        have hCg :
            C * gauge (phi n) <= C * gauge n :=
          _root_.Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hphi n) hC.left
        constructor
        case left =>
          exact _root_.Rat.le_trans (hC.right (phi n)).left hCg
        case right =>
          exact _root_.Rat.le_trans (hC.right (phi n)).right hCg))

name: RateBounded.double
proof:
:=
  RateBounded.reindex_of_gauge_le gauge_doubleIndex_le hu

name: equiv_reindex_of_gauge_le
statement:
theorem equiv_reindex_of_gauge_le {phi : Nat -> Nat} {u v : Seq}
    (hphi : forall n, gauge (phi n) <= gauge n)
    (h : Equiv u v) :
    Equiv (reindexSeq phi u) (reindexSeq phi v)
proof:
:= by
  apply RateBounded.congr
    (u := reindexSeq phi (fun n => u n - v n))
  case h =>
    intro n
    rfl
  case hu =>
    exact RateBounded.reindex_of_gauge_le hphi h

name: equiv_double
proof:
:=
  equiv_reindex_of_gauge_le gauge_doubleIndex_le h

name: equiv_scale
proof:
:=
  equiv_reindex_of_gauge_le (gauge_scaleIndex_le k) h

name: doubleSeq_equiv_self
statement:
theorem doubleSeq_equiv_self (u : RegularSeq) :
    Equiv (doubleSeq u.seq) u.seq
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro 2 (And.intro (by decide) ?_)
  intro n
  have habs_lt :
      ratAbs (u.seq (doubleIndex n) - u.seq n) <
        gauge (doubleIndex n) + gauge n :=
    u.regular (doubleIndex n) n
  have habs_le :
      ratAbs (u.seq (doubleIndex n) - u.seq n) <=
        (2 : Rat) * gauge n := by
    have hsum :
        gauge (doubleIndex n) + gauge n <= gauge n + gauge n :=
      Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add (gauge_doubleIndex_le n) _root_.Rat.le_refl
    have htwice : gauge n + gauge n = (2 : Rat) * gauge n :=
      rat_add_self_eq_two_mul (gauge n)
    exact _root_.Rat.le_trans (_root_.Rat.le_of_lt habs_lt) (by
      simpa [htwice] using hsum)
  constructor
  case left =>
    exact _root_.Rat.le_trans
      (le_ratAbs (u.seq (doubleIndex n) - u.seq n)) habs_le
  case right =>
    exact _root_.Rat.le_trans
      (neg_le_ratAbs (u.seq (doubleIndex n) - u.seq n)) habs_le

name: scaleSeq_equiv_self
statement:
theorem scaleSeq_equiv_self (k : Nat) (u : RegularSeq) :
    Equiv (scaleSeq k u.seq) u.seq
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro 2 (And.intro (by decide) ?_)
  intro n
  have habs_lt :
      ratAbs (u.seq (scaleIndex k n) - u.seq n) <
        gauge (scaleIndex k n) + gauge n :=
    u.regular (scaleIndex k n) n
  have habs_le :
      ratAbs (u.seq (scaleIndex k n) - u.seq n) <=
        (2 : Rat) * gauge n := by
    have hsum :
        gauge (scaleIndex k n) + gauge n <= gauge n + gauge n :=
      Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add (gauge_scaleIndex_le k n) _root_.Rat.le_refl
    have htwice : gauge n + gauge n = (2 : Rat) * gauge n :=
      rat_add_self_eq_two_mul (gauge n)
    exact _root_.Rat.le_trans (_root_.Rat.le_of_lt habs_lt) (by
      simpa [htwice] using hsum)
  constructor
  case left =>
    exact _root_.Rat.le_trans
      (le_ratAbs (u.seq (scaleIndex k n) - u.seq n)) habs_le
  case right =>
    exact _root_.Rat.le_trans
      (neg_le_ratAbs (u.seq (scaleIndex k n) - u.seq n)) habs_le

name: invPos_denom_half_lt
statement:
theorem invPos_denom_half_lt (u : RegularSeq) (hu : SeqPos u.seq) (n : Nat) :
    posHalf u hu <
      u.seq (scaleIndex (posInvScale u hu) n)
proof:
:= by
  have hle :
      gauge (scaleIndex (posInvScale u hu) n) <=
        gauge (posInvScale u hu) :=
    gauge_scaleIndex_le_left (posInvScale u hu) n
  have hsmall :
      gauge (scaleIndex (posInvScale u hu) n) < posHalf u hu :=
    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt hle (posInvScale_gauge_lt_half u hu)
  unfold posHalf
  apply half_lt_value_of_gap_bound
    (u := u)
    (n := posWitnessIndex u hu)
    (m := scaleIndex (posInvScale u hu) n)
  · unfold posGap
    exact _root_.Rat.le_refl
  · exact hsmall

name: neg_invPosSeq_le_bound
statement:
theorem neg_invPosSeq_le_bound (u : RegularSeq) (hu : SeqPos u.seq) (n : Nat) :
    -invPosSeq u hu n <= invPosBound u hu
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : 0 <= invPosSeq u hu n :=
    _root_.Rat.le_of_lt (invPosSeq_pos u hu n)
  have hneg_nonpos : -invPosSeq u hu n <= 0 := by
    have h := _root_.Rat.neg_le_neg hnonneg
    simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_zero] using h
  exact _root_.Rat.le_trans hneg_nonpos
    (_root_.Rat.le_of_lt (invPosBound_pos u hu))

name: invPosSeq_bounded
statement:
theorem invPosSeq_bounded (u : RegularSeq) (hu : SeqPos u.seq) :
    Bounded (invPosSeq u hu)
proof:
:=
  Exists.intro (invPosBound u hu)
    (And.intro (_root_.Rat.le_of_lt (invPosBound_pos u hu)) (by
      intro n
      exact And.intro
        (invPosSeq_le_bound u hu n)
        (neg_invPosSeq_le_bound u hu n)))

name: invPosEps_inv_lt_scaleFactor
statement:
theorem invPosEps_inv_lt_scaleFactor (u : RegularSeq) (hu : SeqPos u.seq) :
    (posInvEps u hu)⁻¹ <
      (((posInvScale u hu + 1 : Nat) : Rat))
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.inv_lt_inv_of_pos_lt
      (gauge_pos (posInvScale u hu))
      (posInvEps_pos u hu)
      (posInvScale_gauge_lt_eps u hu)
  have hg :
      (gauge (posInvScale u hu))⁻¹ =
        (((posInvScale u hu + 1 : Nat) : Rat)) := by
    unfold gauge
    rw [_root_.Rat.inv_inv]
  simpa [hg] using h

name: ratAbs_inv_sub_inv_le_mul_inv_eps
statement:
theorem ratAbs_inv_sub_inv_le_mul_inv_eps {a b eps : Rat}
    (heps : 0 < eps)
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (heps_ab : eps < a * b) :
    ratAbs (a⁻¹ - b⁻¹) <= ratAbs (a - b) * eps⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.inv_sub_inv_eq ha hb]
  have hfactor_pos : 0 < (a * b)⁻¹ :=
    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.inv_pos (_root_.Rat.mul_pos ha hb)
  have hfactor_le : (a * b)⁻¹ <= eps⁻¹ :=
    _root_.Rat.le_of_lt
      (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.inv_lt_inv_of_pos_lt
        heps (_root_.Rat.mul_pos ha hb) heps_ab)
  have hneg_factor_le : -((a * b)⁻¹) <= eps⁻¹ := by
    have hnonneg : 0 <= (a * b)⁻¹ :=
      _root_.Rat.le_of_lt hfactor_pos
    have hneg_nonpos : -((a * b)⁻¹) <= 0 := by
      have h := _root_.Rat.neg_le_neg hnonneg
      simpa [_root_.Rat.neg_zero] using h
    exact _root_.Rat.le_trans hneg_nonpos
      (_root_.Rat.le_of_lt (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.inv_pos heps))
  have hbound :
      ratAbs ((b - a) * (a * b)⁻¹) <=
        ratAbs (b - a) * eps⁻¹ :=
    ratAbs_mul_le_right_bound
      (_root_.Rat.le_of_lt (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.inv_pos heps))
      hfactor_le hneg_factor_le
  simpa [ratAbs_sub_comm a b] using hbound

name: scaled_gauge_mul_inv_eps_lt
statement:
theorem scaled_gauge_mul_inv_eps_lt (u : RegularSeq) (hu : SeqPos u.seq)
    (n m : Nat) :
    (gauge (scaleIndex (posInvScale u hu) n) +
        gauge (scaleIndex (posInvScale u hu) m)) *
      (posInvEps u hu)⁻¹ <
    gauge n + gauge m
proof:
:= by
  let k : Nat := posInvScale u hu
  let factor : Rat := (((k + 1 : Nat) : Rat))
  have hfactor :
      (posInvEps u hu)⁻¹ < factor := by
    unfold factor k
    exact invPosEps_inv_lt_scaleFactor u hu
  have hsum_pos :
      0 <
        gauge (scaleIndex k n) + gauge (scaleIndex k m) :=
    gauge_add_pos (scaleIndex k n) (scaleIndex k m)
  have hmul :
      (posInvEps u hu)⁻¹ *
          (gauge (scaleIndex k n) + gauge (scaleIndex k m)) <
        factor *
          (gauge (scaleIndex k n) + gauge (scaleIndex k m)) :=
    _root_.Rat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hfactor hsum_pos
  have hfactor_sum :
      factor *
          (gauge (scaleIndex k n) + gauge (scaleIndex k m)) =
        gauge n + gauge m := by
    unfold factor k
    rw [_root_.Rat.mul_add]
    rw [factor_mul_gauge_scaleIndex]
    rw [factor_mul_gauge_scaleIndex]
  simpa [_root_.Rat.mul_comm, k, hfactor_sum] using hmul

name: invPosSeq_regular
statement:
theorem invPosSeq_regular (u : RegularSeq) (hu : SeqPos u.seq) :
    Regular (invPosSeq u hu)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m
  let k : Nat := posInvScale u hu
  let i : Nat := scaleIndex k n
  let j : Nat := scaleIndex k m
  have hi_pos : 0 < u.seq i := by
    unfold i k
    exact invPos_denom_pos u hu n
  have hj_pos : 0 < u.seq j := by
    unfold j k
    exact invPos_denom_pos u hu m
  have hi_half : posHalf u hu < u.seq i := by
    unfold i k
    exact invPos_denom_half_lt u hu n
  have hj_half : posHalf u hu < u.seq j := by
    unfold j k
    exact invPos_denom_half_lt u hu m
  have heps_prod : posInvEps u hu < u.seq i * u.seq j := by
    unfold posInvEps
    exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt_of_pos_of_pos
      hi_half hj_half (posHalf_pos u hu)
      (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans (posHalf_pos u hu) hi_half)
  have hinv_bound :
      ratAbs ((u.seq i)⁻¹ - (u.seq j)⁻¹) <=
        ratAbs (u.seq i - u.seq j) * (posInvEps u hu)⁻¹ :=
    ratAbs_inv_sub_inv_le_mul_inv_eps
      (posInvEps_pos u hu) hi_pos hj_pos heps_prod
  have hdiff : ratAbs (u.seq i - u.seq j) < gauge i + gauge j :=
    u.regular i j
  have hinv_eps_pos : 0 < (posInvEps u hu)⁻¹ :=
    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.inv_pos (posInvEps_pos u hu)
  have hscaled :
      ratAbs (u.seq i - u.seq j) * (posInvEps u hu)⁻¹ <
        (gauge i + gauge j) * (posInvEps u hu)⁻¹ :=
    _root_.Rat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hdiff hinv_eps_pos
  have hgauge :
      (gauge i + gauge j) * (posInvEps u hu)⁻¹ <
        gauge n + gauge m := by
    unfold i j k
    exact scaled_gauge_mul_inv_eps_lt u hu n m
  have hmain :
      ratAbs ((u.seq i)⁻¹ - (u.seq j)⁻¹) < gauge n + gauge m :=
    Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_of_le_of_lt hinv_bound
      (Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.lt_trans hscaled hgauge)
  unfold invPosSeq
  simpa [i, j, k] using hmain

name: mul_invPosSeq_equiv_one
statement:
theorem mul_invPosSeq_equiv_one (u : RegularSeq) (hu : SeqPos u.seq) :
    Equiv (mulSeq u.seq (invPosSeq u hu)) (constSeq 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro ((2 : Rat) * invPosBound u hu)
    (And.intro (by
      exact _root_.Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide)
        (_root_.Rat.le_of_lt (invPosBound_pos u hu))) ?_)
  intro n
  let k : Nat := posInvScale u hu
  let j : Nat := scaleIndex k n
  let diff : Rat := mulSeq u.seq (invPosSeq u hu) n - constSeq 1 n
  have hj_pos : 0 < u.seq j := by
    unfold j k
    exact invPos_denom_pos u hu n
  have hdiff_eq :
      diff = (u.seq n - u.seq j) * (u.seq j)⁻¹ := by
    unfold diff mulSeq invPosSeq constSeq j k
    exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.mul_inv_sub_one_eq hj_pos
  have hfactor_bound :
      ratAbs diff <= ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq j) * invPosBound u hu := by
    rw [hdiff_eq]
    have hfactor_le : (u.seq j)⁻¹ <= invPosBound u hu := by
      unfold j k
      exact invPosSeq_le_bound u hu n
    have hneg_factor_le : -((u.seq j)⁻¹) <= invPosBound u hu := by
      unfold j k
      exact neg_invPosSeq_le_bound u hu n
    exact ratAbs_mul_le_right_bound
      (_root_.Rat.le_of_lt (invPosBound_pos u hu))
      hfactor_le hneg_factor_le
  have hregular :
      ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq j) < gauge n + gauge j :=
    u.regular n j
  have hregular_le :
      ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq j) <= gauge n + gauge j :=
    _root_.Rat.le_of_lt hregular
  have hsum_le :
      gauge n + gauge j <= gauge n + gauge n := by
    exact Tautology.RealBasic.ModuleBackend.Rat.add_le_add _root_.Rat.le_refl
      (by
        unfold j k
        exact gauge_scaleIndex_le (posInvScale u hu) n)
  have hmul_le :
      ratAbs (u.seq n - u.seq j) * invPosBound u hu <=
        (gauge n + gauge n) * invPosBound u hu := by
    exact _root_.Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (_root_.Rat.le_trans hregular_le hsum_le)
      (_root_.Rat.le_of_lt (invPosBound_pos u hu))
  have hC :
      (gauge n + gauge n) * invPosBound u hu =
        ((2 : Rat) * invPosBound u hu) * gauge n := by
    rw [rat_add_self_eq_two_mul]
    rw [_root_.Rat.mul_assoc]
    rw [_root_.Rat.mul_comm (gauge n) (invPosBound u hu)]
    rw [<- _root_.Rat.mul_assoc]
  have habs_le :
      ratAbs diff <= ((2 : Rat) * invPosBound u hu) * gauge n :=
    _root_.Rat.le_trans hfactor_bound (by
      simpa [hC] using hmul_le)
  constructor
  · exact _root_.Rat.le_trans (le_ratAbs diff) habs_le
  · exact _root_.Rat.le_trans (neg_le_ratAbs diff) habs_le

name: mul_invPosRegularSeq
statement:
theorem mul_invPosRegularSeq (u : RegularSeq) (hu : SeqPos u.seq) :
    mk u * mk (invPosRegularSeq u hu) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change mk u * mk (invPosRegularSeq u hu) = mk (ofRatSeq 1)
  rw [mk_mul]
  apply mk_eq_mk
  exact equiv_trans (productRawSeq_equiv_pointwise u (invPosRegularSeq u hu))
    (mul_invPosSeq_equiv_one u hu)

name: exists_right_inv_of_positive
proof:
:= by
  refine _root_.Quot.ind
    (β := fun x => Positive x -> Exists (fun y : CauchyReal => x * y = 1))
    ?_ x hx
  intro u hu
  change SeqPos u.seq at hu
  exact Exists.intro (mk (invPosRegularSeq u hu))
    (mul_invPosRegularSeq u hu)

name: exists_right_inv_of_negative
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_right_inv_of_positive hx with
  | intro y hy =>
      refine Exists.intro (-y) ?_
      calc
        x * (-y) = -(x * y) := by rw [mul_neg]
        _ = (-x) * y := by rw [neg_mul]
        _ = 1 := hy

name: exists_mul_inverse_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  cases positive_zero_negative_trichotomy x with
  | inl hpos =>
      cases exists_right_inv_of_positive hpos with
      | intro y hy =>
          exact Exists.intro y (And.intro hy (by
            rw [mul_comm]
            exact hy))
  | inr hrest =>
      cases hrest with
      | inl hzero =>
          exact False.elim (hx hzero)
      | inr hneg =>
          cases exists_right_inv_of_negative hneg with
          | intro y hy =>
              exact Exists.intro y (And.intro hy (by
                rw [mul_comm]
                exact hy))

name: inv_zero
statement: theorem inv_zero : (0 : CauchyReal)⁻¹ = 0
proof:
:= by
  change inv 0 = 0
  unfold inv
  simp

name: mul_inv_cancel
statement:
theorem mul_inv_cancel {x : CauchyReal} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    x * x⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  change x * inv x = 1
  unfold inv
  simp [hx, (Classical.choose_spec (exists_mul_inverse_of_ne_zero hx)).left]

name: inv_mul_cancel
statement:
theorem inv_mul_cancel {x : CauchyReal} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    x⁻¹ * x = 1
proof:
:= by
  change inv x * x = 1
  unfold inv
  simp [hx, (Classical.choose_spec (exists_mul_inverse_of_ne_zero hx)).right]

name: exists_shifted
statement:
theorem exists_shifted (P : _root_.Int -> Prop)
    (hex : Exists P)
    (hlower : Exists (fun L : _root_.Int =>
      forall k : _root_.Int, P k -> L <= k)) :
    Exists (fun n : _root_.Nat =>
      P (Classical.choose hlower + ((n : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L : _root_.Int := Classical.choose hlower
  cases hex with
  | intro k hk =>
      have hLk : L <= k := (Classical.choose_spec hlower) k hk
      let n : _root_.Nat := (k - L).toNat
      refine Exists.intro n ?_
      unfold n
      have hnonneg : 0 <= k - L := by
        omega
      have hcast : (((k - L).toNat : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int) = k - L :=
        _root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnonneg
      change P (L + (((k - L).toNat : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int))
      rw [hcast]
      have hsum : L + (k - L) = k := by
        omega
      rw [hsum]
      exact hk

name: least_spec
statement:
theorem least_spec (P : _root_.Int -> Prop)
    (hex : Exists P)
    (hlower : Exists (fun L : _root_.Int =>
      forall k : _root_.Int, P k -> L <= k)) :
    P (least P hex hlower)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold least
  let L : _root_.Int := Classical.choose hlower
  exact
    Tautology.Nat.least_spec
      (fun n : _root_.Nat => P (L + ((n : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int)))
      (exists_shifted P hex hlower)

name: least_min
statement:
theorem least_min (P : _root_.Int -> Prop)
    (hex : Exists P)
    (hlower : Exists (fun L : _root_.Int =>
      forall k : _root_.Int, P k -> L <= k))
    {k : _root_.Int} (hk : P k) :
    least P hex hlower <= k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold least
  let L : _root_.Int := Classical.choose hlower
  have hLk : L <= k := (Classical.choose_spec hlower) k hk
  let nk : _root_.Nat := (k - L).toNat
  have hQk :
      (fun n : _root_.Nat => P (L + ((n : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int))) nk := by
    unfold nk
    have hnonneg : 0 <= k - L := by
      omega
    have hcast : (((k - L).toNat : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int) = k - L :=
      _root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnonneg
    change P (L + (((k - L).toNat : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int))
    rw [hcast]
    have hsum : L + (k - L) = k := by
      omega
    rw [hsum]
    exact hk
  have hmin :=
    Tautology.Nat.least_min
      (fun n : _root_.Nat => P (L + ((n : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int)))
      (exists_shifted P hex hlower) hQk
  have hnk_nonneg : 0 <= k - L := by
    omega
  have hnk_cast : ((nk : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int) = k - L := by
    unfold nk
    exact _root_.Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnk_nonneg
  have hcast_le :
      (((Tautology.Nat.least
          (fun n : _root_.Nat => P (L + ((n : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int)))
          (exists_shifted P hex hlower) : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int)) <=
        ((nk : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int) :=
    _root_.Int.ofNat_le.mpr hmin
  rw [hnk_cast] at hcast_le
  change
    L +
        (((Tautology.Nat.least
          (fun n : _root_.Nat => P (L + ((n : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int)))
          (exists_shifted P hex hlower) : _root_.Nat) : _root_.Int)) <=
      k
  omega

name: congr
statement:
theorem congr {alpha : Type u} {f g : alpha -> _root_.Int}
    (h : forall x, f x = g x)
    (hf : Bounded f) :
    Bounded g
proof:
:= by
  cases hf with
  | intro B hB =>
      exact Exists.intro B (And.intro hB.left (by
        intro x
        rw [← h x]
        exact hB.right x))

name: zero
statement: theorem zero {alpha : Type u} : Bounded (fun _ : alpha => (0 : _root_.Int))
proof:
:= by
  exact Exists.intro 0 (And.intro (_root_.Int.le_refl 0) (by
    intro x
    constructor <;> simp))

name: neg
proof:
:= by
  cases hf with
  | intro B hB =>
      exact Exists.intro B (And.intro hB.left (by
        intro x
        constructor
        · exact (hB.right x).right
        · simpa using (hB.right x).left))

name: add
statement:
theorem add {alpha : Type u} {f g : alpha -> _root_.Int}
    (hf : Bounded f)
    (hg : Bounded g) :
    Bounded (fun x => f x + g x)
proof:
:= by
  cases hf with
  | intro B hB =>
      cases hg with
      | intro C hC =>
          exact Exists.intro (B + C)
            (And.intro (_root_.Int.add_nonneg hB.left hC.left) (by
              intro x
              constructor
              · exact _root_.Int.add_le_add (hB.right x).left (hC.right x).left
              · have hle :=
                  _root_.Int.add_le_add (hB.right x).right (hC.right x).right
                simpa [_root_.Int.neg_add] using hle))

name: sub
statement:
theorem sub {alpha : Type u} {f g : alpha -> _root_.Int}
    (hf : Bounded f)
    (hg : Bounded g) :
    Bounded (fun x => f x - g x)
proof:
:= by
  apply congr (f := fun x => f x + (-g x))
  · intro x
    exact (_root_.Int.sub_eq_add_neg).symm
  · exact add hf (neg hg)

name: finiteSum_zero
statement:
theorem finiteSum_zero (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    finiteSum F term 0 = F.zero
proof: := rfl

name: finiteSum_succ
statement:
theorem finiteSum_succ (term : Nat -> alpha) (n : Nat) :
    finiteSum F term (n + 1) =
      F.add (finiteSum F term n) (term n)
proof: := rfl

name: finiteSum_one
statement:
theorem finiteSum_one (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    finiteSum F term 1 = term 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_zero]
  rw [F.zero_add]

name: finiteSum_congr
statement:
theorem finiteSum_congr
    {term term' : Nat -> alpha}
    (h : forall k : Nat, term k = term' k) :
    forall n : Nat, finiteSum F term n = finiteSum F term' n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_congr h n, h n]

name: finiteSum_congr_lt
statement:
theorem finiteSum_congr_lt
    {term term' : Nat -> alpha} :
    forall n : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k < n -> term k = term' k) ->
      finiteSum F term n = finiteSum F term' n
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, h => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_congr_lt n
        (fun k hk => h k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))]
      rw [h n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]

name: finiteSum_add
statement:
theorem finiteSum_add (u v : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F (fun k : Nat => F.add (u k) (v k)) n =
        F.add (finiteSum F u n) (finiteSum F v n)
  | 0 => by
      rw [finiteSum_zero, finiteSum_zero, finiteSum_zero]
      rw [F.add_zero]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_add u v n]
      exact add_add_add_comm F
        (finiteSum F u n) (finiteSum F v n) (u n) (v n)

name: finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
statement:
theorem finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
    (u v : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k < n -> F.le (u k) (v k)) ->
        F.le (finiteSum F u n) (finiteSum F v n)
  | 0, _ => by
      rw [finiteSum_zero, finiteSum_zero]
      exact F.le_refl F.zero
  | n + 1, hle => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_succ]
      exact add_le_add F
        (finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le u v n
          (fun k hk => hle k
            (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n))))
        (hle n (Nat.lt_succ_self n))

name: finiteSum_mul_left
statement:
theorem finiteSum_mul_left (c : alpha) (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F (fun k : Nat => F.mul c (term k)) n =
        F.mul c (finiteSum F term n)
  | 0 => by
      rw [finiteSum_zero, finiteSum_zero]
      exact Eq.symm (F.mul_zero c)
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_mul_left c term n]
      rw [F.mul_add]

name: finiteSum_mul_right
statement:
theorem finiteSum_mul_right (term : Nat -> alpha) (c : alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F (fun k : Nat => F.mul (term k) c) n =
        F.mul (finiteSum F term n) c
  | 0 => by
      rw [finiteSum_zero, finiteSum_zero]
      exact Eq.symm (zero_mul F c)
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_mul_right term c n]
      rw [F.add_mul]

name: finiteSum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finiteSum_eq_zero
    {term : Nat -> alpha} :
    forall n : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k < n -> term k = F.zero) ->
        finiteSum F term n = F.zero
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, h => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_eq_zero n
        (fun k hk => h k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))]
      rw [h n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]
      rw [F.add_zero]

/
and every other summand below `n` vanishes, the total is `term k` alone. This
is the device that lets a single term be compared against a whole sum, as in
`finiteSum_term_le_of_nonneg` below. -/

name: finiteSum_eq_single_of_eq_zero_off
statement:
theorem finiteSum_eq_single_of_eq_zero_off
    {term : Nat -> alpha} :
    forall {n k : Nat},
      k < n ->
      (forall j : Nat, j < n -> Not (j = k) ->
        term j = F.zero) ->
      finiteSum F term n = term k
  | 0, k, hk, _ => by
      exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk)
  | n + 1, k, hk, hzero => by
      by_cases hkn : k = n
      case pos =>
        rw [hkn]
        rw [finiteSum_succ]
        have hprefix_zero :
            finiteSum F term n = F.zero
proof:
:=
          finiteSum_eq_zero F (term := term) n
            (fun j hj =>
              hzero j (Nat.lt_trans hj (Nat.lt_succ_self n)) (by
                intro hbad
                omega))
        rw [hprefix_zero, F.zero_add]
      case neg =>
        have hk_lt_n : k < n := by
          omega
        rw [finiteSum_succ]
        have hlast_zero : term n = F.zero :=
          hzero n (Nat.lt_succ_self n) (by
            intro hbad
            exact hkn hbad.symm)
        rw [hlast_zero, F.add_zero]
        exact finiteSum_eq_single_of_eq_zero_off hk_lt_n
          (fun j hj hne =>
            hzero j (Nat.lt_trans hj (Nat.lt_succ_self n)) hne)

name: finiteSum_nonneg
statement:
theorem finiteSum_nonneg
    (term : Nat -> alpha) (n : Nat)
    (hnonneg : forall k : Nat, k < n -> F.le F.zero (term k)) :
    F.le F.zero (finiteSum F term n)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero :
      finiteSum F (fun _ : Nat => F.zero) n = F.zero :=
    finiteSum_eq_zero F n (fun _ _ => rfl)
  rw [← hzero]
  exact finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le F
    (fun _ : Nat => F.zero) term n hnonneg

name: finiteSum_term_le_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem finiteSum_term_le_of_nonneg
    (term : Nat -> alpha) {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < n)
    (hnonneg : forall j : Nat, j < n -> F.le F.zero (term j)) :
    F.le (term k) (finiteSum F term n)
proof:
:= by
  let singleton : Nat -> alpha :=
    fun j => if j = k then term k else F.zero
  have hsingleton : finiteSum F singleton n = term k := by
    simpa [singleton] using
      (finiteSum_eq_single_of_eq_zero_off F
        (term := singleton) hk (by
          intro j _hj hne
          simp [singleton, hne]))
  rw [← hsingleton]
  apply finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le F
  intro j hj
  dsimp [singleton]
  by_cases hjk : j = k
  · rw [if_pos hjk, hjk]
    exact F.le_refl (term k)
  · rw [if_neg hjk]
    exact hnonneg j hj

name: finiteSum_eq_zero_of_nonneg_terms
statement:
theorem finiteSum_eq_zero_of_nonneg_terms
    {term : Nat -> alpha} (n : Nat)
    (hnonneg : forall k : Nat, k < n -> F.le F.zero (term k))
    (hsum : finiteSum F term n = F.zero)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < n) :
    term k = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  apply F.le_antisymm
  · rw [← hsum]
    exact finiteSum_term_le_of_nonneg F term hk hnonneg
  · exact hnonneg k hk

name: finiteSum_const
statement:
theorem finiteSum_const (c : alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F (fun _ : Nat => c) n =
        F.mul (nat F n) c
  | 0 => by
      rw [finiteSum_zero, nat_zero]
      exact Eq.symm (F.zero_mul c)
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_const c n]
      rw [nat_succ]
      change
        F.add (F.mul (nat F n) c) c =
          F.mul (F.add (nat F n) F.one) c
      rw [F.add_mul]
      rw [F.one_mul]

/
Triangular windows are not rectangles and are handled separately, by the
reindexing of `finiteSum_triangle_swap` below. -/

name: finiteSum_fubini
statement:
theorem finiteSum_fubini (term : Nat -> Nat -> alpha) :
    forall p q : Nat,
      finiteSum F
        (fun i : Nat => finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term i j) q) p =
      finiteSum F
        (fun j : Nat => finiteSum F (fun i : Nat => term i j) p) q
  | 0, q => by
      rw [finiteSum_zero]
      calc
        F.zero =
            finiteSum F (fun _ : Nat => F.zero) q
proof:
:= by
            rw [finiteSum_const]
            rw [F.mul_zero]
        _ =
            finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                finiteSum F (fun i : Nat => term i j) 0) q := by
            apply finiteSum_congr F
            intro j
            rw [finiteSum_zero]
  | p + 1, q => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_fubini term p q]
      calc
        F.add
            (finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                finiteSum F (fun i : Nat => term i j) p) q)
            (finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term p j) q) =
            finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.add
                  (finiteSum F (fun i : Nat => term i j) p)
                  (term p j)) q := by
            exact Eq.symm
              (finiteSum_add F
                (fun j : Nat =>
                  finiteSum F (fun i : Nat => term i j) p)
                (fun j : Nat => term p j) q)
        _ =
            finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                finiteSum F (fun i : Nat => term i j) (p + 1)) q := by
            apply finiteSum_congr F
            intro j
            rw [finiteSum_succ]

name: finiteSum_triangle_extend
statement:
theorem finiteSum_triangle_extend
    (term : Nat -> Nat -> alpha) (m : Nat) :
    finiteSum F
        (fun j : Nat =>
          finiteSum F (fun h : Nat => term (j + h) j)
            (m + 1 - j))
        (m + 1) =
      F.add
        (finiteSum F
          (fun j : Nat =>
            finiteSum F (fun h : Nat => term (j + h) j)
              (m - j))
          m)
        (finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term m j) (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSum_succ]
  have hprefix :
      finiteSum F
          (fun j : Nat =>
            finiteSum F (fun h : Nat => term (j + h) j)
              (m + 1 - j))
          m =
        F.add
          (finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              finiteSum F (fun h : Nat => term (j + h) j)
                (m - j))
            m)
          (finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term m j) m) := by
    calc
      finiteSum F
          (fun j : Nat =>
            finiteSum F (fun h : Nat => term (j + h) j)
              (m + 1 - j))
          m =
          finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.add
                (finiteSum F (fun h : Nat => term (j + h) j)
                  (m - j))
                (term m j))
            m := by
            apply finiteSum_congr_lt F
            intro j hj
            have hlen : m + 1 - j = (m - j) + 1 := by
              omega
            rw [hlen]
            rw [finiteSum_succ]
            have hidx : j + (m - j) = m := by
              omega
            rw [hidx]
      _ =
          F.add
            (finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                finiteSum F (fun h : Nat => term (j + h) j)
                  (m - j))
              m)
            (finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term m j) m) := by
            rw [finiteSum_add]
  rw [hprefix]
  have hlast :
      finiteSum F (fun h : Nat => term (m + h) m)
          (m + 1 - m) =
        term m m := by
    have hlen : m + 1 - m = 1 := by
      omega
    rw [hlen]
    rw [finiteSum_one]
    have hidx : m + 0 = m := by
      omega
    rw [hidx]
  rw [hlast]
  rw [finiteSum_succ]
  rw [F.add_assoc]

name: finiteSum_triangle_swap
statement:
theorem finiteSum_triangle_swap (term : Nat -> Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F
          (fun i : Nat =>
            finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term i j) (i + 1))
          (n + 1) =
        finiteSum F
          (fun j : Nat =>
            finiteSum F (fun h : Nat => term (j + h) j)
              (n + 1 - j))
          (n + 1)
  | 0 => by
      have houter : 0 + 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
        omega
      rw [houter]
      rw [finiteSum_one (F := F)
        (term := fun i : Nat =>
          finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term i j) (i + 1))]
      rw [finiteSum_one (F := F)
        (term := fun j : Nat => term 0 j)]
      rw [finiteSum_one (F := F)
        (term := fun j : Nat =>
          finiteSum F (fun h : Nat => term (j + h) j) (1 - j))]
      have hlen : 1 - 0 = 1 := by
        omega
      rw [hlen]
      rw [finiteSum_one (F := F)
        (term := fun h : Nat => term (0 + h) 0)]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_triangle_swap term n]
      rw [finiteSum_triangle_extend F term (n + 1)]

name: finiteSum_neg
statement:
theorem finiteSum_neg (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F (fun k : Nat => F.neg (term k)) n =
        F.neg (finiteSum F term n)
  | 0 => by
      rw [finiteSum_zero, finiteSum_zero]
      exact Eq.symm (neg_zero F)
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_neg term n]
      change F.add (F.neg (finiteSum F term n)) (F.neg (term n)) =
        F.neg (F.add (finiteSum F term n) (term n))
      exact Eq.symm
        (neg_add_distrib F (finiteSum F term n) (term n))

name: finiteSum_sub
statement:
theorem finiteSum_sub (u v : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F (fun k : Nat => F.sub (u k) (v k)) n =
        F.sub (finiteSum F u n) (finiteSum F v n)
  | n => by
      calc
        finiteSum F (fun k : Nat => F.sub (u k) (v k)) n =
            finiteSum F
              (fun k : Nat => F.add (u k) (F.neg (v k))) n
proof:
:= by
              apply finiteSum_congr F
              intro k
              exact F.sub_eq_add_neg (u k) (v k)
        _ = F.add (finiteSum F u n)
              (finiteSum F (fun k : Nat => F.neg (v k)) n) := by
              rw [finiteSum_add]
        _ = F.add (finiteSum F u n)
              (F.neg (finiteSum F v n)) := by
              rw [finiteSum_neg]
        _ = F.sub (finiteSum F u n) (finiteSum F v n) := by
              exact Eq.symm
                (F.sub_eq_add_neg (finiteSum F u n) (finiteSum F v n))

name: finiteSum_shift_zero
statement:
theorem finiteSum_shift_zero (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term (0 + j)) 0 = F.zero
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: finiteSum_prepend
statement:
theorem finiteSum_prepend (head : alpha) (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat =>
          match k with
          | 0 => head
          | j + 1 => term j)
        (n + 1) =
        F.add head (finiteSum F term n)
  | 0 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_zero, finiteSum_zero]
      rw [F.zero_add, F.add_zero]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ
        (F := F)
        (term :=
          fun k : Nat =>
            match k with
            | 0 => head
            | j + 1 => term j)
        (n := n + 1)]
      rw [finiteSum_prepend head term n]
      rw [finiteSum_succ (F := F) (term := term) (n := n)]
      rw [F.add_assoc]

name: finiteSum_prepend_zero
statement:
theorem finiteSum_prepend_zero (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat =>
          match k with
          | 0 => F.zero
          | j + 1 => term j)
        (n + 1) =
        finiteSum F term n
  | 0 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_zero, finiteSum_zero]
      rw [F.add_zero]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ
        (F := F)
        (term :=
          fun k : Nat =>
            match k with
            | 0 => F.zero
            | j + 1 => term j)
        (n := n + 1)]
      rw [finiteSum_prepend_zero term n]
      rw [finiteSum_succ (F := F) (term := term) (n := n)]

name: finiteSum_append_zero
statement:
theorem finiteSum_append_zero
    (term : Nat -> alpha) {n : Nat}
    (h : term n = F.zero) :
    finiteSum F term (n + 1) =
      finiteSum F term n
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSum_succ]
  rw [h]
  rw [F.add_zero]

name: finiteSum_telescope_sub
statement:
theorem finiteSum_telescope_sub (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat => F.sub (term (k + 1)) (term k)) n =
        F.sub (term n) (term 0)
  | 0 => by
      rw [finiteSum_zero]
      exact Eq.symm (sub_self F (term 0))
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_telescope_sub term n]
      calc
        F.add (F.sub (term n) (term 0))
            (F.sub (term (n + 1)) (term n)) =
            F.add (F.sub (term (n + 1)) (term n))
              (F.sub (term n) (term 0))
proof:
:= by
            rw [F.add_comm]
        _ = F.sub (term (n + 1)) (term 0) := by
            exact sub_add_sub_cancel F
              (term (n + 1)) (term n) (term 0)

name: finiteSum_add_length
statement:
theorem finiteSum_add_length (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall a b : Nat,
      finiteSum F term (a + b) =
        F.add (finiteSum F term a)
          (finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term (a + j)) b)
  | a, 0 => by
      rw [Nat.add_zero]
      rw [finiteSum_zero]
      rw [F.add_zero]
  | a, b + 1 => by
      rw [Nat.add_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_add_length term a b]
      rw [finiteSum_succ]
      change
        F.add
          (F.add (finiteSum F term a)
            (finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term (a + j)) b))
          (term (a + b)) =
          F.add (finiteSum F term a)
            (F.add
              (finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term (a + j)) b)
              (term (a + b)))
      rw [F.add_assoc]

name: finiteSum_split_first
statement:
theorem finiteSum_split_first (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F term (n + 1) =
        F.add (term 0)
          (finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term (j + 1)) n)
  | n => by
      have hlen : n + 1 = 1 + n
proof:
:= by
        omega
      rw [hlen]
      rw [finiteSum_add_length (F := F) term 1 n]
      rw [finiteSum_one]
      congr 1
      apply finiteSum_congr F
      intro j
      have hidx : 1 + j = j + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [hidx]

name: finiteSum_reverse
statement:
theorem finiteSum_reverse (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F term (n + 1) =
        finiteSum F (fun i : Nat => term (n - i)) (n + 1)
  | 0 => by
      rw [finiteSum_one]
      rw [finiteSum_one]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_reverse term n]
      rw [finiteSum_split_first F
        (fun i : Nat => term (n + 1 - i)) (n + 1)]
      rw [Nat.sub_zero]
      have htail :
          finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat => term (n + 1 - (j + 1))) (n + 1) =
            finiteSum F (fun i : Nat => term (n - i)) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
        apply finiteSum_congr_lt F
        intro i hi
        have hidx : n + 1 - (i + 1) = n - i := by
          omega
        rw [hidx]
      rw [htail]
      rw [F.add_comm]

name: finiteSum_shift_succ
statement:
theorem finiteSum_shift_succ (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term (j + 1)) (n + 1) =
        F.add (term 1)
          (finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term ((j + 1) + 1)) n)
  | n => by
      have hlen : n + 1 = 1 + n
proof:
:= by
        omega
      rw [hlen]
      rw [finiteSum_add_length (F := F)
        (fun j : Nat => term (j + 1)) 1 n]
      rw [finiteSum_one]
      change
        F.add (term (0 + 1))
          (finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term (1 + j + 1)) n) =
        F.add (term 1)
          (finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term (j + 1 + 1)) n)
      have h01 : 0 + 1 = 1 := by
        omega
      rw [h01]
      congr 1
      apply finiteSum_congr F
      intro j
      have hidx : 1 + j + 1 = j + 1 + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [hidx]

name: finiteSum_blocks
statement:
theorem finiteSum_blocks (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall p q : Nat,
      finiteSum F term (p * q) =
        finiteSum F
          (fun k : Nat =>
            finiteSum F (fun j : Nat => term (k * q + j)) q)
          p
  | 0, q => by
      rw [Nat.zero_mul]
      rw [finiteSum_zero, finiteSum_zero]
  | p + 1, q => by
      rw [Nat.succ_mul]
      rw [finiteSum_add_length (F := F) term (p * q) q]
      rw [finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_blocks term p q]

/
odd successor inside a single summand. This is the regrouping step wherever
two consecutive terms have to be handled as a unit. -/

name: finiteSum_pair_even_odd
statement:
theorem finiteSum_pair_even_odd (term : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall n : Nat,
      finiteSum F term (2 * n) =
        finiteSum F
          (fun k : Nat => F.add (term (2 * k)) (term (2 * k + 1)))
          n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  have hblocks := finiteSum_blocks F term n 2
  rw [Nat.mul_comm] at hblocks
  rw [hblocks]
  apply finiteSum_congr F
  intro k
  rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_zero]
  have hzero : k * 2 + 0 = 2 * k := by omega
  have hone : k * 2 + 1 = 2 * k + 1 := by omega
  rw [hzero, hone, F.zero_add]

name: abs_finiteSum_le_finiteSum_abs
statement:
theorem abs_finiteSum_le_finiteSum_abs
    (term : Nat -> alpha) : forall n : Nat,
      F.le (abs F (finiteSum F term n))
        (finiteSum F (fun k : Nat => abs F (term k)) n)
  | 0 => by
      rw [finiteSum_zero, finiteSum_zero]
      rw [abs_zero F]
      exact F.le_refl F.zero
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [finiteSum_succ, finiteSum_succ]
      exact F.le_trans
        (abs_add_le_abs_add_abs F (finiteSum F term n) (term n))
        (add_le_add F
          (abs_finiteSum_le_finiteSum_abs term n)
          (F.le_refl (abs F (term n))))

/
the whole sum by the count of summands times `M`, with the count as the
embedded natural `nat F n`. The nonnegativity hypothesis on `M` is carried by
the statement but not used by the proof. -/

name: finiteSum_le_of_abs_le
statement:
theorem finiteSum_le_of_abs_le
    (term : Nat -> alpha) {M : alpha}
    (hM : F.le F.zero M) :
    forall n : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k < n -> F.le (abs F (term k)) M) ->
      F.le
        (abs F (finiteSum F term n))
        (F.mul (nat F n) M)
  | 0, _ => by
      rw [finiteSum_zero]
      change
        F.le (abs F F.zero)
          (F.mul (nat F 0) M)
      rw [abs_zero F]
      rw [nat_zero]
      rw [F.zero_mul]
      exact F.le_refl F.zero
  | n + 1, hbound => by
      have ih :
          F.le
            (abs F (finiteSum F term n))
            (F.mul (nat F n) M)
proof:
:=
        finiteSum_le_of_abs_le term hM n
          (fun k hk => hbound k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))
      have hlast :
          F.le (abs F (term n)) M :=
        hbound n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
      have htri :
          F.le
            (abs F (finiteSum F term (n + 1)))
            (F.add
              (abs F (finiteSum F term n))
              (abs F (term n))) := by
        rw [finiteSum_succ]
        exact abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
          F (finiteSum F term n) (term n)
      have hsum :
          F.le
            (F.add
              (abs F (finiteSum F term n))
              (abs F (term n)))
            (F.add (F.mul (nat F n) M) M) :=
        add_le_add F ih hlast
      have htarget :
          F.add (F.mul (nat F n) M) M =
            F.mul (nat F (n + 1)) M := by
        rw [nat_succ]
        change
          F.add (F.mul (nat F n) M) M =
            F.mul (F.add (nat F n) F.one) M
        rw [F.add_mul]
        rw [F.one_mul]
      exact F.le_trans htri (by rwa [htarget] at hsum)

name: add_le_add_left
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.add_comm z x, F.add_comm z y]
  exact F.add_le_add_right hxy z

name: add_le_add
proof:
:= by
  exact F.le_trans
    (F.add_le_add_right hwx y)
    (add_le_add_left F hyz x)

name: sub_add_cancel
statement:
theorem sub_add_cancel (x y : alpha) :
    F.add (F.sub x y) y = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    F.add (F.add x (F.neg y)) y =
        F.add x (F.add (F.neg y) y) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add x F.zero := by rw [F.neg_add]
    _ = x := by rw [F.add_zero]

name: add_sub_cancel
statement:
theorem add_sub_cancel (x y : alpha) :
    F.sub (F.add x y) y = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact add_neg_cancel_right F x y

name: sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub
statement:
theorem sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub (x y : alpha) :
    F.sub (F.neg x) (F.neg y) = F.neg (F.sub x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [neg_neg F y]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg x y]
  rw [neg_add_distrib F x (F.neg y)]
  rw [neg_neg F y]

name: sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
statement:
theorem sub_rev_eq_neg_sub (x y : alpha) :
    F.sub y x = F.neg (F.sub x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg y x]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg x y]
  rw [neg_add_distrib F x (F.neg y)]
  rw [neg_neg F y]
  rw [F.add_comm y (F.neg x)]

name: add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
statement:
theorem add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub (x y a b : alpha) :
    F.sub (F.add x y) (F.add a b) =
      F.add (F.sub x a) (F.sub y b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [neg_add_distrib F a b]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg x a]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg y b]
  have hinner :
      F.add y (F.add (F.neg a) (F.neg b)) =
        F.add (F.neg a) (F.add y (F.neg b)) := by
    calc
