      F.add y (F.add (F.neg a) (F.neg b)) =
          F.add (F.add y (F.neg a)) (F.neg b) := by
            rw [<- F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add (F.add (F.neg a) y) (F.neg b) := by
            rw [F.add_comm y (F.neg a)]
      _ = F.add (F.neg a) (F.add y (F.neg b)) := by
            rw [F.add_assoc]
  calc
    F.add (F.add x y) (F.add (F.neg a) (F.neg b)) =
        F.add x (F.add y (F.add (F.neg a) (F.neg b))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add x (F.add (F.neg a) (F.add y (F.neg b))) := by
          rw [hinner]
    _ = F.add (F.add x (F.neg a)) (F.add y (F.neg b)) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: neg_one_lt_zero
statement: theorem neg_one_lt_zero : F.lt (F.neg F.one) F.zero
proof:
:= by
  have h := add_lt_add_right F (zero_lt_one F) (F.neg F.one)
  rwa [F.zero_add, F.add_neg] at h

name: sub_nonneg_of_le
proof:
:= by
  have h := F.add_le_add_right hxy (F.neg x)
  rwa [F.add_neg, <- F.sub_eq_add_neg y x] at h

name: le_of_sub_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  have h' := F.add_le_add_right h x
  rwa [F.zero_add, sub_add_cancel F y x] at h'

name: lt_add_of_sub_lt
proof:
:= by
  have h' := add_lt_add_right F h a
  have hright : F.add eps a = F.add a eps := F.add_comm eps a
  rwa [sub_add_cancel F x a, hright] at h'

name: neg_le_neg
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : F.le F.zero (F.sub y x) :=
    sub_nonneg_of_le F hxy
  apply le_of_sub_nonneg F
  rwa [sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F x y, <- sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x y]

name: sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
statement:
theorem sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le {x y a b : alpha}
    (hxb : F.le x b)
    (hay : F.le a y) :
    F.le (F.sub x y) (F.sub b a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg x y, F.sub_eq_add_neg b a]
  exact add_le_add F hxb (neg_le_neg F hay)

name: mul_pos
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul x y) :=
    F.mul_nonneg (le_of_lt F hx) (le_of_lt F hy)
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le F hnonneg
  intro hle0
  have hzero : F.mul x y = F.zero :=
    F.le_antisymm hle0 hnonneg
  cases mul_eq_zero_cases F hzero with
  | inl hx0 =>
      exact ne_of_lt F hx hx0.symm
  | inr hy0 =>
      exact ne_of_lt F hy hy0.symm

name: inv_pos
proof:
:= by
  have hxne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact ne_of_lt F hx h.symm
  have h0x : F.le F.zero x := le_of_lt F hx
  have hle0inv : F.le F.zero (F.inv x) := by
    by_cases h : F.le F.zero (F.inv x)
    · exact h
    · have hinv0 : F.le (F.inv x) F.zero := by
        cases F.le_total (F.inv x) F.zero with
        | inl hle => exact hle
        | inr h0inv => exact False.elim (h h0inv)
      have hneg_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg (F.inv x)) := by
        have h' := F.add_le_add_right hinv0 (F.neg (F.inv x))
        rwa [F.add_neg, F.zero_add] at h'
      have hprod_nonneg :
          F.le F.zero (F.mul x (F.neg (F.inv x))) :=
        F.mul_nonneg h0x hneg_nonneg
      have hprod :
          F.mul x (F.neg (F.inv x)) = F.neg F.one := by
        rw [mul_neg F, F.mul_inv_cancel hxne]
      have hnegone_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg F.one) := by
        rwa [hprod] at hprod_nonneg
      exact False.elim
        ((not_le_of_lt F (neg_one_lt_zero F)) hnegone_nonneg)
  apply lt_of_le_of_not_le F hle0inv
  intro hinv0
  exact (inv_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F hxne)
    (F.le_antisymm hinv0 hle0inv)

name: zero_lt_two
statement:
theorem zero_lt_two :
    F.lt F.zero (two F)
proof:
:= by
  unfold two
  have hone_two : F.lt F.one (F.add F.one F.one) := by
    have h := add_lt_add_right F (zero_lt_one F) F.one
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  exact lt_trans F (zero_lt_one F) hone_two

name: two_ne_zero
statement:
theorem two_ne_zero :
    Not (two F = F.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact ne_of_lt F (zero_lt_two F) h.symm

name: half_pos
proof:
:= by
  unfold half
  exact mul_pos F heps (inv_pos F (zero_lt_two F))

name: half_add_half
statement:
theorem half_add_half (eps : alpha) :
    F.add (half F eps) (half F eps) = eps
proof:
:= by
  unfold half
  unfold two
  have hmul_two :
      F.mul eps (F.add F.one F.one) = F.add eps eps := by
    rw [F.mul_add]
    rw [F.mul_one]
  have htwo_ne : Not (F.add F.one F.one = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact (two_ne_zero F) h
  calc
    F.add (F.mul eps (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one)))
        (F.mul eps (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one))) =
        F.mul (F.add eps eps) (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one)) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul eps (F.add F.one F.one))
        (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one)) := by
          rw [hmul_two]
    _ = F.mul eps
        (F.mul (F.add F.one F.one) (F.inv (F.add F.one F.one))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul eps F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel htwo_ne]
    _ = eps := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: quarter_pos
proof:
:=
  half_pos F (half_pos F hx)

name: add_lt_quarter_half_quarter
statement:
theorem add_lt_quarter_half_quarter
    {a b c eps : alpha}
    (ha : F.lt a (quarter F eps))
    (hb : F.lt b (half F eps))
    (hc : F.lt c (quarter F eps)) :
    F.lt (F.add a (F.add b c)) eps
proof:
:= by
  let e2 := half F eps
  let e4 := quarter F eps
  have hsum :
      F.lt (F.add a (F.add b c))
        (F.add e4 (F.add e2 e4)) :=
    add_lt_add F ha (add_lt_add F hb hc)
  have htarget : F.add e4 (F.add e2 e4) = eps := by
    unfold e4
    unfold quarter
    calc
      F.add (half F (half F eps))
          (F.add (half F eps) (half F (half F eps))) =
          F.add (half F (half F eps))
            (F.add (half F (half F eps)) (half F eps)) := by
              rw [F.add_comm (half F eps) (half F (half F eps))]
      _ = F.add
            (F.add (half F (half F eps)) (half F (half F eps)))
            (half F eps) := by
              rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add (half F eps) (half F eps) := by
              rw [half_add_half F (half F eps)]
      _ = eps := half_add_half F eps
  rwa [htarget] at hsum

name: nat_two_mul_eq_add_self
statement:
theorem nat_two_mul_eq_add_self (z : alpha) :
    F.mul (F.nat 2) z = F.add z z
proof:
:= by
  have htwo : F.nat 2 = F.add F.one F.one := by
    rw [nat_succ F 1]
    rw [nat_succ F 0]
    rw [nat_zero F]
    change F.add (F.add F.zero F.one) F.one = F.add F.one F.one
    rw [F.zero_add]
  rw [htwo, F.add_mul, F.one_mul]

name: square_mul_inv_eq_mul_inv_square
statement:
theorem square_mul_inv_eq_mul_inv_square
    (a b : alpha) (hb : Not (b = F.zero)) :
    F.mul (F.mul a (F.inv b)) (F.mul a (F.inv b)) =
      F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.inv (F.mul b b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_mul_mul_comm F a (F.inv b) a (F.inv b)]
  rw [<- inv_mul F hb hb]

name: sum_sq_sub_diff_sq_eq_four_mul
statement:
theorem sum_sq_sub_diff_sq_eq_four_mul (a b : alpha) :
    F.sub (F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b))
      (F.mul (F.sub a b) (F.sub a b)) =
      F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat 2)) (F.mul a b)
proof:
:= by
  let A := F.add a b
  let q := F.sub a b
  have hminus : F.sub A q = F.add b b := by
    unfold A q
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg a b]
    rw [add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F a b a (F.neg b)]
    rw [sub_self F a]
    rw [F.zero_add]
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg b (F.neg b)]
    rw [neg_neg F b]
  have hplus : F.add A q = F.add a a := by
    unfold A q
    exact add_add_sub_cancel_same F a a b
  have hsquare (x y : alpha) :
      F.sub (F.mul x x) (F.mul y y) =
        F.mul (F.sub x y) (F.add x y) := by
    rw [mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub F x x y y]
    rw [F.mul_add]
    rw [F.mul_comm y (F.sub x y)]
  calc
    F.sub (F.mul A A) (F.mul q q) =
        F.mul (F.sub A q) (F.add A q) := hsquare A q
    _ = F.mul (F.add b b) (F.add a a) := by rw [hminus, hplus]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 2) b) (F.mul (F.nat 2) a) := by
      rw [nat_two_mul_eq_add_self F b]
      rw [nat_two_mul_eq_add_self F a]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat 2)) (F.mul a b) := by
      rw [mul_mul_mul_comm F (F.nat 2) b (F.nat 2) a]
      rw [F.mul_comm b a]

name: scaledCoeff_eq_factorial_mul_ordinaryCoeff
statement:
theorem scaledCoeff_eq_factorial_mul_ordinaryCoeff
    (X : Nat -> alpha) (m k : Nat) :
    scaledCoeff F X m k =
      F.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
        (Ordinary.coeff F (ordinaryAtom F X) m k)
proof:
:= by
  let fm := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (Tautology.Nat.factorial m)
  let fk := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (Tautology.Nat.factorial k)
  let b := Ordinary.coeff F (ordinaryAtom F X) m k
  have hfk : Not (fk = F.zero) := by
    unfold fk
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero F
      (Tautology.Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
  unfold scaledCoeff
  unfold coeff
  change F.mul fk (F.mul (F.mul fm (F.inv fk)) b) = F.mul fm b
  calc
    F.mul fk (F.mul (F.mul fm (F.inv fk)) b) =
        F.mul (F.mul fk (F.mul fm (F.inv fk))) b := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul fm (F.mul fk (F.inv fk))) b := by
          congr 1
          calc
            F.mul fk (F.mul fm (F.inv fk)) =
                F.mul (F.mul fk fm) (F.inv fk) := by
                  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
            _ = F.mul (F.mul fm fk) (F.inv fk) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm fk fm]
            _ = F.mul fm (F.mul fk (F.inv fk)) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul fm F.one) b := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hfk]
    _ = F.mul fm b := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: factorial_mul_ordinaryCoeff_eq_scaledCoeff
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_ordinaryCoeff_eq_scaledCoeff
    (X : Nat -> alpha) (m k : Nat) :
    F.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (Tautology.Nat.factorial m))
        (Ordinary.coeff F (ordinaryAtom F X) m k) =
      scaledCoeff F X m k
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm (scaledCoeff_eq_factorial_mul_ordinaryCoeff F X m k)

name: alternate_zero
statement:
private theorem alternate_zero (x : alpha) :
    alternate F x 0 = x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: alternate_succ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: alternate_add
statement:
private theorem alternate_add (x y : alpha) :
    forall k : Nat,
      alternate F (F.add x y) k =
        F.add (alternate F x k) (alternate F y k)
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by
      rw [alternate_succ, alternate_succ, alternate_succ]
      rw [alternate_add x y k]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F
        (alternate F x k) (alternate F y k)















/
`binom (q + k) k` under `k` alternations, times the power
`(1 / a0) ^ (q + k + 1)`, times the ordinary coefficient
`Ordinary.coeff c m k`. The index `q` records the negative exponent 
summands build the coefficients of the `q + 1`-st power of the reciprocal
series 
of `1 / a0`. -/
def closedTerm
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha)
    (q m k : Nat) : alpha
proof:
:=
  F.mul
    (F.mul
      (alternate F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F
          (Tautology.Nat.binom (q + k) k))
        k)
      (Ordinary.scalarPow F (F.inv a0) (q + k + 1)))
    (Ordinary.coeff F c m k)

name: closedTerm_eq_closedFactor_mul_coeff
statement:
theorem closedTerm_eq_closedFactor_mul_coeff
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (q m k : Nat) :
    closedTerm F a0 c q m k =
      F.mul (closedFactor F a0 q k) (Ordinary.coeff F c m k)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: closedFactor_succ_power_succ_index
statement:
private theorem closedFactor_succ_power_succ_index
    (a0 : alpha) (q k : Nat) :
    closedFactor F a0 (q + 1) (k + 1) =
      F.mul (F.inv a0)
        (F.add (closedFactor F a0 q (k + 1))
          (F.neg (closedFactor F a0 (q + 1) k)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold closedFactor
  rw [show q + 1 + (k + 1) = (q + k + 1) + 1 by omega]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_succ_succ]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_add]
  rw [show q + (k + 1) = q + k + 1 by omega]
  rw [show q + 1 + k = q + k + 1 by omega]
  rw [show q + k + 1 + 1 + 1 = (q + k + 2) + 1 by omega]
  rw [Ordinary.scalarPow_succ]
  rw [show q + k + 1 + 1 = q + k + 2 by omega]
  let X : alpha :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F (Tautology.Nat.binom (q + k + 1) k)
  let Y : alpha :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F
      (Tautology.Nat.binom (q + k + 1) (k + 1))
  let P : alpha :=
    Ordinary.scalarPow F (F.inv a0) (q + k + 2)
  change
    F.mul (alternate F (F.add X Y) (k + 1))
        (F.mul (F.inv a0) P) =
      F.mul (F.inv a0)
        (F.add (F.mul (alternate F Y (k + 1)) P)
          (F.neg (F.mul (alternate F X k) P)))
  rw [Ordinary.mul_left_commute_three F
    (alternate F (F.add X Y) (k + 1)) (F.inv a0) P]
  congr 1
  rw [alternate_add]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [alternate_succ F X k]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul]
  exact F.add_comm
    (F.neg (F.mul (alternate F X k) P))
    (F.mul (alternate F Y (k + 1)) P)

name: reciprocalSeries_coeff_zero
statement:
private theorem reciprocalSeries_coeff_zero {N : Nat}
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) :
    (reciprocalSeries F (N := N) a0 c).coeff 0 =
      F.inv a0
proof:
:= by
  unfold reciprocalSeries
  rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_zero]
  rw [Ordinary.constantPlusPositive_coeff_zero]

name: reciprocalPowerAtPrecision_zero
statement:
private theorem reciprocalPowerAtPrecision_zero
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) {N : Nat} :
    reciprocalPowerAtPrecision F a0 c (N := N) 0 =
      TruncatedPowerSeries.one F
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: reciprocalPowerAtPrecision_succ
statement:
theorem reciprocalPowerAtPrecision_succ
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) {N : Nat} (r : Nat) :
    reciprocalPowerAtPrecision F a0 c (N := N) (r + 1) =
      TruncatedPowerSeries.mul F
        (reciprocalSeries F (N := N) a0 c)
        (reciprocalPowerAtPrecision F a0 c (N := N) r)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_zero_coeff
statement:
private theorem reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_zero_coeff
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (N r : Nat) :
    reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N 0 r =
      Ordinary.scalarPow F (F.inv a0) r
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      rfl
  | succ r ih =>
      unfold reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision
      rw [reciprocalPowerAtPrecision_succ]
      rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      unfold TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_one]
      change
        F.mul
            ((reciprocalSeries F (N := N) a0 c).coeff 0)
            ((reciprocalPowerAtPrecision F a0 c (N := N) r).coeff 0) =
          Ordinary.scalarPow F (F.inv a0) (r + 1)
      rw [reciprocalSeries_coeff_zero]
      rw [show
        (reciprocalPowerAtPrecision F a0 c (N := N) r).coeff 0 =
          reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N 0 r from rfl]
      rw [ih]
      rw [Ordinary.scalarPow_succ]

name: reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_succ_power_eq_finiteSum
statement:
private theorem reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_succ_power_eq_finiteSum
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (N m r : Nat) :
    reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N m (r + 1) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun i : Nat =>
          F.mul ((reciprocalSeries F (N := N) a0 c).coeff i)
            (reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N (m - i) r))
        (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision
  rw [reciprocalPowerAtPrecision_succ]
  rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  unfold TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
  rfl

name: closedTerm_zero_index
statement:
private theorem closedTerm_zero_index
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (q m : Nat) :
    closedTerm F a0 c q m 0 =
      F.mul
        (Ordinary.scalarPow F (F.inv a0) (q + 1))
        (Ordinary.coeff F c m 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold closedTerm
  rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_zero]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_one]
  rw [alternate_zero]
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: closedTerm_zero_zero_index
statement:
private theorem closedTerm_zero_zero_index
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (q : Nat) :
    closedTerm F a0 c q 0 0 =
      Ordinary.scalarPow F (F.inv a0) (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [closedTerm_zero_index]
  rw [Ordinary.coeff_zero_zero]
  rw [F.mul_one]

name: closedTerm_succ_coeff_zero_index
statement:
private theorem closedTerm_succ_coeff_zero_index
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (q m : Nat) :
    closedTerm F a0 c q (m + 1) 0 = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [closedTerm_zero_index]
  rw [Ordinary.coeff_succ_zero]
  rw [F.mul_zero]

name: closedTerm_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
private theorem closedTerm_eq_zero_of_lt
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (q : Nat)
    {m k : Nat} (hmk : m < k) :
    closedTerm F a0 c q m k = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold closedTerm
  rw [Ordinary.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt F c hmk]
  rw [F.mul_zero]

name: closedCoeff_zero_coeff
statement:
private theorem closedCoeff_zero_coeff
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (q : Nat) :
    closedCoeff F a0 c q 0 =
      Ordinary.scalarPow F (F.inv a0) (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold closedCoeff
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_one]
  exact closedTerm_zero_zero_index F a0 c q

name: closedCoeff_succ_coeff_split
statement:
private theorem closedCoeff_succ_coeff_split
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (q m : Nat) :
    closedCoeff F a0 c q (m + 1) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat => closedTerm F a0 c q (m + 1) (k + 1))
        (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold closedCoeff
  calc
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat => closedTerm F a0 c q (m + 1) k)
        ((m + 1) + 1) =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun k : Nat =>
            match k with
            | 0 => F.zero
            | j + 1 => closedTerm F a0 c q (m + 1) (j + 1))
          ((m + 1) + 1) := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
          intro k
          cases k with
          | zero =>
              rw [closedTerm_succ_coeff_zero_index]
          | succ j =>
              rfl
    _ =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun k : Nat => closedTerm F a0 c q (m + 1) (k + 1))
          (m + 1) := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_prepend_zero F
            (fun k : Nat => closedTerm F a0 c q (m + 1) (k + 1))
            (m + 1)

name: closedCoeff_eq_finiteSum_length_of_lt_succ
statement:
private theorem closedCoeff_eq_finiteSum_length_of_lt_succ
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (q m j : Nat)
    (hj : j < m + 1) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat => closedTerm F a0 c q (m - j) k)
        (m + 1) =
      closedCoeff F a0 c q (m - j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold closedCoeff
  have hlen : m + 1 = (m - j + 1) + j := by
    omega
  rw [hlen]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_add_length]
  have htail :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun t : Nat =>
            closedTerm F a0 c q (m - j) (m - j + 1 + t))
          j =
        F.zero := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_eq_zero F
    intro t ht
    exact closedTerm_eq_zero_of_lt F a0 c q (by omega)
  rw [htail]
  rw [F.add_zero]

name: reciprocalBaseFactor_succ
statement:
private theorem reciprocalBaseFactor_succ
    (a0 : alpha) (k : Nat) :
    reciprocalBaseFactor F a0 (k + 1) =
      F.neg (F.mul (F.inv a0)
        (reciprocalBaseFactor F a0 k))
proof:
:= by
  unfold reciprocalBaseFactor
  rw [alternate_succ]
  have hpow :
      Ordinary.scalarPow F (F.inv a0) (k + 1 + 1) =
        F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (Ordinary.scalarPow F (F.inv a0) (k + 1)) := by
    rw [show k + 1 + 1 = (k + 1) + 1 by omega]
    rw [Ordinary.scalarPow_succ]
  rw [hpow]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul]
  congr 1
  exact Ordinary.mul_left_commute_three F
    (alternate F F.one k) (F.inv a0)
    (Ordinary.scalarPow F (F.inv a0) (k + 1))

name: closedTerm_zero_power_eq_factor
statement:
private theorem closedTerm_zero_power_eq_factor
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (m k : Nat) :
    closedTerm F a0 c 0 m k =
      F.mul (reciprocalBaseFactor F a0 k)
        (Ordinary.coeff F c m k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold closedTerm
  unfold reciprocalBaseFactor
  rw [Nat.zero_add]
  rw [Tautology.Nat.binom_self]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_one]

name: closedTerm_zero_power_succ_succ_recurrence
statement:
private theorem closedTerm_zero_power_succ_succ_recurrence
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha)
    (m k : Nat) :
    closedTerm F a0 c 0 (m + 1) (k + 1) =
      F.neg
        (F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul (c j)
                (closedTerm F a0 c 0 (m - j) k))
            (m + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [closedTerm_zero_power_eq_factor]
  rw [reciprocalBaseFactor_succ]
  rw [Ordinary.coeff_succ_succ]
  have hterms :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.mul (c j) (closedTerm F a0 c 0 (m - j) k))
          (m + 1) =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.mul (c j)
              (F.mul (reciprocalBaseFactor F a0 k)
                (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k)))
          (m + 1) := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
    intro j
    rw [closedTerm_zero_power_eq_factor]
  rw [hterms]
  let A : alpha := F.inv a0
  let B : alpha := reciprocalBaseFactor F a0 k
  let S : alpha :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
      (fun j : Nat =>
        F.mul (c j) (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k))
      (m + 1)
  change
    F.mul (F.neg (F.mul A B)) S =
      F.neg
        (F.mul A
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul (c j)
                (F.mul B (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k)))
            (m + 1)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul]
  congr 1
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul A B) S =
        F.mul A (F.mul B S) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul A
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul B
                (F.mul (c j)
                  (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k)))
            (m + 1)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_left]
    _ =
        F.mul A
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul (c j)
                (F.mul B (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k)))
            (m + 1)) := by
          congr 1
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
          intro j
          exact Ordinary.mul_left_commute_three F
            B (c j) (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k)

name: closedTerm_succ_power_succ_succ_recurrence
statement:
private theorem closedTerm_succ_power_succ_succ_recurrence
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha)
    (q m k : Nat) :
    closedTerm F a0 c (q + 1) (m + 1) (k + 1) =
      F.mul (F.inv a0)
        (F.add (closedTerm F a0 c q (m + 1) (k + 1))
          (F.neg
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.mul (c j)
                  (closedTerm F a0 c (q + 1) (m - j) k))
              (m + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [closedTerm_eq_closedFactor_mul_coeff]
  rw [closedFactor_succ_power_succ_index]
  rw [Ordinary.coeff_succ_succ]
  rw [closedTerm_eq_closedFactor_mul_coeff F a0 c q (m + 1) (k + 1)]
  rw [Ordinary.coeff_succ_succ]
  have hclosed :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.mul (c j)
              (closedTerm F a0 c (q + 1) (m - j) k))
          (m + 1) =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.mul (c j)
              (F.mul (closedFactor F a0 (q + 1) k)
                (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k)))
          (m + 1) := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
    intro j
    rw [closedTerm_eq_closedFactor_mul_coeff]
  rw [hclosed]
  let A : alpha := closedFactor F a0 q (k + 1)
  let B : alpha := closedFactor F a0 (q + 1) k
  let S : alpha :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
      (fun j : Nat =>
        F.mul (c j) (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k))
      (m + 1)
  have hBsum :
      F.mul B S =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.mul (c j)
              (F.mul B (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k)))
          (m + 1) := by
    calc
      F.mul B S =
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul B
                (F.mul (c j)
                  (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k)))
            (m + 1) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_left]
      _ =
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul (c j)
                (F.mul B (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k)))
            (m + 1) := by
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
            intro j
            exact Ordinary.mul_left_commute_three F
              B (c j) (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k)
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (F.inv a0) (F.add A (F.neg B))) S =
      F.mul (F.inv a0)
        (F.add (F.mul A S)
          (F.neg
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.mul (c j)
                  (F.mul B (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k)))
              (m + 1))))
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.inv a0) (F.add A (F.neg B))) S =
        F.mul (F.inv a0) (F.mul (F.add A (F.neg B)) S) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (F.add (F.mul A S) (F.mul (F.neg B) S)) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (F.add (F.mul A S) (F.neg (F.mul B S))) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (F.add (F.mul A S)
            (F.neg
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun j : Nat =>
                  F.mul (c j)
                    (F.mul B (Ordinary.coeff F c (m - j) k)))
                (m + 1)))) := by
          rw [hBsum]

name: closedCoeff_zero_power_succ_recurrence
statement:
private theorem closedCoeff_zero_power_succ_recurrence
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (m : Nat) :
    closedCoeff F a0 c 0 (m + 1) =
      F.neg
        (F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              F.mul (c j)
                (closedCoeff F a0 c 0 (m - j)))
            (m + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [closedCoeff_succ_coeff_split]
  let rect : Nat -> Nat -> alpha :=
    fun k j : Nat =>
      F.mul (c j) (closedTerm F a0 c 0 (m - j) k)
  calc
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat => closedTerm F a0 c 0 (m + 1) (k + 1))
        (m + 1) =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.neg
              (F.mul (F.inv a0)
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                  (fun j : Nat => rect k j) (m + 1))))
          (m + 1) := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
          intro k
          exact closedTerm_zero_power_succ_succ_recurrence F a0 c m k
    _ =
        F.neg
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun k : Nat =>
              F.mul (F.inv a0)
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                  (fun j : Nat => rect k j) (m + 1)))
            (m + 1)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_neg]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.mul (F.inv a0)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun k : Nat =>
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                  (fun j : Nat => rect k j) (m + 1))
              (m + 1))) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_left]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.mul (F.inv a0)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                  (fun k : Nat => rect k j) (m + 1))
              (m + 1))) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_fubini]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.mul (F.inv a0)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.mul (c j)
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                    (fun k : Nat =>
                      closedTerm F a0 c 0 (m - j) k)
                    (m + 1)))
              (m + 1))) := by
          congr 2
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
          intro j
          unfold rect
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_left]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.mul (F.inv a0)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.mul (c j)
                  (closedCoeff F a0 c 0 (m - j)))
              (m + 1))) := by
          congr 2
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
          intro j hj
          rw [closedCoeff_eq_finiteSum_length_of_lt_succ F a0 c 0 m j hj]

name: closedCoeff_succ_power_succ_recurrence
statement:
private theorem closedCoeff_succ_power_succ_recurrence
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (q m : Nat) :
    closedCoeff F a0 c (q + 1) (m + 1) =
      F.mul (F.inv a0)
        (F.add (closedCoeff F a0 c q (m + 1))
          (F.neg
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.mul (c j)
                  (closedCoeff F a0 c (q + 1) (m - j)))
              (m + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [closedCoeff_succ_coeff_split]
  let rect : Nat -> Nat -> alpha :=
    fun k j : Nat =>
      F.mul (c j) (closedTerm F a0 c (q + 1) (m - j) k)
  calc
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun k : Nat => closedTerm F a0 c (q + 1) (m + 1) (k + 1))
        (m + 1) =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun k : Nat =>
            F.mul (F.inv a0)
              (F.add (closedTerm F a0 c q (m + 1) (k + 1))
                (F.neg
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                    (fun j : Nat => rect k j) (m + 1)))))
          (m + 1) := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
          intro k
          exact closedTerm_succ_power_succ_succ_recurrence
            F a0 c q m k
    _ =
        F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun k : Nat =>
              F.add (closedTerm F a0 c q (m + 1) (k + 1))
                (F.neg
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                    (fun j : Nat => rect k j) (m + 1))))
            (m + 1)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_left]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (F.add
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun k : Nat => closedTerm F a0 c q (m + 1) (k + 1))
              (m + 1))
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun k : Nat =>
                F.neg
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                    (fun j : Nat => rect k j) (m + 1)))
              (m + 1))) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_add]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (F.add (closedCoeff F a0 c q (m + 1))
            (F.neg
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun k : Nat =>
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                    (fun j : Nat => rect k j) (m + 1))
                (m + 1)))) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_neg]
          rw [<- closedCoeff_succ_coeff_split]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (F.add (closedCoeff F a0 c q (m + 1))
            (F.neg
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun j : Nat =>
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                    (fun k : Nat => rect k j) (m + 1))
                (m + 1)))) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_fubini]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (F.add (closedCoeff F a0 c q (m + 1))
            (F.neg
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun j : Nat =>
                  F.mul (c j)
                    (closedCoeff F a0 c (q + 1) (m - j)))
                (m + 1)))) := by
          congr 2
          congr 1
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
          intro j hj
          unfold rect
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_left]
          rw [closedCoeff_eq_finiteSum_length_of_lt_succ
            F a0 c (q + 1) m j hj]

name: reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_succ_power_succ_recurrence
statement:
private theorem reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_succ_power_succ_recurrence
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (N r m : Nat) :
    reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N (m + 1) (r + 1) =
      F.mul (F.inv a0)
        (F.add
          (reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N (m + 1) r)
          (F.neg
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun j : Nat =>
                F.mul (c j)
                  (reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N (m - j)
                    (r + 1)))
              (m + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let R : Nat -> alpha :=
    fun k : Nat => (reciprocalSeries F (N := N) a0 c).coeff k
  let P : Nat -> alpha :=
    fun k : Nat => reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N k r
  let Q : Nat -> alpha :=
    fun k : Nat => reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N k (r + 1)
  let conv : alpha :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
      (fun j : Nat => F.mul (c j) (Q (m - j))) (m + 1)
  have hdouble :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun i : Nat =>
            F.mul
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun j : Nat => F.mul (c j) (R (i - j))) (i + 1))
              (P (m - i)))
          (m + 1) =
        conv := by
    calc
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun i : Nat =>
            F.mul
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun j : Nat => F.mul (c j) (R (i - j))) (i + 1))
              (P (m - i)))
          (m + 1) =
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun i : Nat =>
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun j : Nat =>
                  F.mul (F.mul (c j) (R (i - j))) (P (m - i)))
                (i + 1))
            (m + 1) := by
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
            intro i
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_right]
      _ =
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun h : Nat =>
                  F.mul
                    (F.mul (c j) (R (j + h - j)))
                    (P (m - (j + h))))
                (m + 1 - j))
            (m + 1) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_triangle_swap]
      _ = conv := by
            unfold conv
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr_lt F
            intro j hj
            have hlen : m + 1 - j = (m - j) + 1 := by
              omega
            rw [hlen]
            calc
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                  (fun h : Nat =>
                    F.mul
                      (F.mul (c j) (R (j + h - j)))
                      (P (m - (j + h))))
                  ((m - j) + 1) =
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                    (fun h : Nat =>
                      F.mul (c j)
                        (F.mul (R h) (P (m - j - h))))
                    ((m - j) + 1) := by
                    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
                    intro h
                    have hleft : j + h - j = h := by
                      omega
                    have hright : m - (j + h) = m - j - h := by
                      omega
                    rw [hleft, hright]
                    rw [F.mul_assoc]
              _ =
                  F.mul (c j)
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                      (fun h : Nat =>
                        F.mul (R h) (P (m - j - h)))
                      ((m - j) + 1)) := by
                    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_left]
              _ = F.mul (c j) (Q (m - j)) := by
                    unfold Q P R
                    rw [<- reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_succ_power_eq_finiteSum
                      F a0 c N (m - j) r]
  have htail :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun i : Nat => F.mul (R (i + 1)) (P (m - i)))
          (m + 1) =
        F.neg (F.mul (F.inv a0) conv) := by
    calc
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun i : Nat => F.mul (R (i + 1)) (P (m - i)))
          (m + 1) =
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun i : Nat =>
              F.mul
                (F.neg
                  (F.mul (F.inv a0)
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                      (fun j : Nat =>
                        F.mul (c j) (R (i - j)))
                      (i + 1))))
                (P (m - i)))
            (m + 1) := by
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
            intro i
            unfold R reciprocalSeries
            rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_succ]
            rw [Ordinary.constantPlusPositive_coeff_zero]
            congr 1
            congr 1
            congr 1
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
            intro j
            rw [Ordinary.constantPlusPositive_coeff_succ]
      _ =
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun i : Nat =>
              F.neg
                (F.mul (F.inv a0)
                  (F.mul
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                      (fun j : Nat => F.mul (c j) (R (i - j)))
                      (i + 1))
                    (P (m - i)))))
            (m + 1) := by
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
            intro i
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul]
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ =
          F.neg
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
              (fun i : Nat =>
                F.mul (F.inv a0)
                  (F.mul
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                      (fun j : Nat => F.mul (c j) (R (i - j)))
                      (i + 1))
                    (P (m - i))))
              (m + 1)) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_neg]
      _ =
          F.neg
            (F.mul (F.inv a0)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun i : Nat =>
                  F.mul
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                      (fun j : Nat => F.mul (c j) (R (i - j)))
                      (i + 1))
                    (P (m - i)))
                (m + 1))) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_mul_left]
      _ = F.neg (F.mul (F.inv a0) conv) := by
            rw [hdouble]
  calc
    reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N (m + 1) (r + 1) =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun i : Nat =>
            F.mul (R i) (P (m + 1 - i)))
          ((m + 1) + 1) := by
          unfold R P
          rw [reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_succ_power_eq_finiteSum]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul (R 0) (P (m + 1)))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
            (fun i : Nat =>
              F.mul (R (i + 1)) (P (m - i)))
            (m + 1)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_split_first]
          congr 1
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
          intro i
          have hidx : m + 1 - (i + 1) = m - i := by
            omega
          rw [hidx]
    _ =
        F.add (F.mul (F.inv a0) (P (m + 1)))
          (F.neg (F.mul (F.inv a0) conv)) := by
          unfold R
          rw [reciprocalSeries_coeff_zero]
          rw [htail]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (F.add (P (m + 1)) (F.neg conv)) := by
          rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg]
          rw [F.mul_add]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.inv a0)
          (F.add
            (reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N (m + 1) r)
            (F.neg
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
                (fun j : Nat =>
                  F.mul (c j)
                    (reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N (m - j)
                      (r + 1)))
                (m + 1)))) := by
          unfold P conv Q
          rfl

name: reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_zero_coeff_eq_closedCoeff
statement:
private theorem reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_zero_coeff_eq_closedCoeff
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (N q : Nat) :
    reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N 0 (q + 1) =
      closedCoeff F a0 c q 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_zero_coeff]
  rw [closedCoeff_zero_coeff]

name: reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_one_eq_reciprocalSeries_coeff
statement:
private theorem reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_one_eq_reciprocalSeries_coeff
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (N m : Nat) :
    reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N m 1 =
      (reciprocalSeries F (N := N) a0 c).coeff m
proof:
:= by
  unfold reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision
  rw [reciprocalPowerAtPrecision_succ]
  rw [reciprocalPowerAtPrecision_zero]
  rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  exact TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff_one_right
    (F := F) (N := N)
    (reciprocalSeries F (N := N) a0 c).coeff m

name: reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_one_eq_closedCoeff
statement:
private theorem reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_one_eq_closedCoeff
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (N : Nat) :
    forall m : Nat,
      reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N m 1 =
        closedCoeff F a0 c 0 m
  | 0 => by
      exact reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_zero_coeff_eq_closedCoeff
        F a0 c N 0
  | m + 1 => by
      rw [reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_one_eq_reciprocalSeries_coeff]
      unfold reciprocalSeries
      rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_reciprocal_succ]
      rw [Ordinary.constantPlusPositive_coeff_zero]
      rw [closedCoeff_zero_power_succ_recurrence]
      congr 2
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
      intro j
      rw [Ordinary.constantPlusPositive_coeff_succ]
      rw [show
        (TruncatedPowerSeries.reciprocal F
            (Ordinary.constantPlusPositiveSeries F (N := N) a0 c)).coeff
            (m - j) =
          reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision F a0 c N (m - j) 1 by
            rw [reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_one_eq_reciprocalSeries_coeff]
            unfold reciprocalSeries
            rfl]
      rw [reciprocalPowerCoeffAtPrecision_one_eq_closedCoeff a0 c N
        (m - j)]
termination_by m => m
decreasing_by
  omega

/
`q + 1`-st power of the reciprocal series equals the closed form
`closedCoeff F a0 c q m`, for every degree, every exponent and every
precision, and as an equation on individual coefficients rather than
agreement up to a precision. No invertibility hypothesis on `a0` appears:
nothing here claims the reciprocal inverts anything, the proof identifies
two recursions both built from `1 / a0`. The identification runs as a double
induction, on the exponent index and on the degree. -/

name: positiveSeries_coeff_zero
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: positiveSeries_coeff_succ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: powerAtPrecision_zero
statement:
theorem powerAtPrecision_zero
    (c : Nat -> alpha) {N : Nat} :
    powerAtPrecision F c (N := N) 0 =
      TruncatedPowerSeries.one F
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: powerAtPrecision_succ
statement:
theorem powerAtPrecision_succ
    (c : Nat -> alpha) {N : Nat} (k : Nat) :
    powerAtPrecision F c (N := N) (k + 1) =
      TruncatedPowerSeries.mul F
        (positiveSeries F (N := N) c)
        (powerAtPrecision F c (N := N) k)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: coeff_zero_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_zero (c : Nat -> alpha) :
    coeff F c 0 0 = F.one
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: coeff_succ_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_succ_zero (c : Nat -> alpha) (m : Nat) :
    coeff F c (m + 1) 0 = F.zero
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: coeffAtPrecision_succ_succ
statement:
theorem coeffAtPrecision_succ_succ
    (c : Nat -> alpha) (N m k : Nat) :
    coeffAtPrecision F c N (m + 1) (k + 1) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun j : Nat =>
          F.mul (c j) (coeffAtPrecision F c N (m - j) k))
        (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coeffAtPrecision
  rw [powerAtPrecision_succ]
  rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  unfold TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_split_first F
    (fun i : Nat =>
      F.mul
        ((positiveSeries F (N := N) c).coeff i)
        ((powerAtPrecision F c (N := N) k).coeff (m + 1 - i)))
    (m + 1)]
  change
    F.add
        (F.mul
          ((positiveSeries F (N := N) c).coeff 0)
          ((powerAtPrecision F c (N := N) k).coeff (m + 1 - 0)))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
          (fun j : Nat =>
            F.mul
              ((positiveSeries F (N := N) c).coeff (j + 1))
              ((powerAtPrecision F c (N := N) k).coeff
                (m + 1 - (j + 1))))
          (m + 1)) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun j : Nat =>
          F.mul (c j)
            ((powerAtPrecision F c (N := N) k).coeff (m - j)))
        (m + 1)
  rw [Nat.sub_zero]
  rw [positiveSeries_coeff_zero]
  rw [F.zero_mul]
  rw [F.zero_add]
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
  intro j
  rw [positiveSeries_coeff_succ]
  have hidx : m + 1 - (j + 1) = m - j := by
    omega
  rw [hidx]

name: coeff_succ_succ
statement:
theorem coeff_succ_succ
    (c : Nat -> alpha) (m k : Nat) :
    coeff F c (m + 1) (k + 1) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum F
        (fun j : Nat => F.mul (c j) (coeff F c (m - j) k))
        (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coeff
  exact coeffAtPrecision_succ_succ F c 0 m k

name: coeffAtPrecision_one
statement:
theorem coeffAtPrecision_one
    (c : Nat -> alpha) (N m : Nat) :
    coeffAtPrecision F c N m 1 =
      (positiveSeries F (N := N) c).coeff m
proof:
:= by
  unfold coeffAtPrecision
  rw [powerAtPrecision_succ]
  rw [powerAtPrecision_zero]
  rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  exact TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff_one_right
    (F := F) (N := N)
    (positiveSeries F (N := N) c).coeff m

name: coeff_zero_one
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_one (c : Nat -> alpha) :
    coeff F c 0 1 = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold coeff
  rw [coeffAtPrecision_one]
  rw [positiveSeries_coeff_zero]

name: coeff_succ_one
statement:
theorem coeff_succ_one (c : Nat -> alpha) (m : Nat) :
    coeff F c (m + 1) 1 = c m
proof:
:= by
  unfold coeff
  rw [coeffAtPrecision_one]
  rw [positiveSeries_coeff_succ]

name: powerAtPrecision_coeff_independent
statement:
theorem powerAtPrecision_coeff_independent
    (c : Nat -> alpha) (N M m k : Nat) :
    (powerAtPrecision F c (N := N) k).coeff m =
      (powerAtPrecision F c (N := M) k).coeff m
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing N M m with
  | zero =>
      cases m with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ m => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [powerAtPrecision_succ, powerAtPrecision_succ]
      rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul,
        TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      unfold TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_congr F
      intro i
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          rw [positiveSeries_coeff_zero, positiveSeries_coeff_zero]
          rw [ih]
      | succ j =>
          rw [positiveSeries_coeff_succ, positiveSeries_coeff_succ]
          rw [ih]

name: coeffAtPrecision_eq_coeff
statement:
theorem coeffAtPrecision_eq_coeff
    (c : Nat -> alpha) (N m k : Nat) :
    coeffAtPrecision F c N m k = coeff F c m k
proof:
:= by
  unfold coeff coeffAtPrecision
  exact powerAtPrecision_coeff_independent F c N 0 m k

name: coeffAtPrecision_zero_succ
statement:
theorem coeffAtPrecision_zero_succ
    (c : Nat -> alpha) (N k : Nat) :
    coeffAtPrecision F c N 0 (k + 1) = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold coeffAtPrecision
  rw [powerAtPrecision_succ]
  rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  unfold TruncatedPowerSeries.cauchyCoeff
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_one]
  change
    F.mul ((positiveSeries F (N := N) c).coeff 0)
        ((powerAtPrecision F c (N := N) k).coeff 0) =
      F.zero
  rw [positiveSeries_coeff_zero]
  rw [F.zero_mul]

name: coeff_zero_succ
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_succ
    (c : Nat -> alpha) (k : Nat) :
    coeff F c 0 (k + 1) = F.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold coeff
  exact coeffAtPrecision_zero_succ F c 0 k

name: coeff_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_lt
    (c : Nat -> alpha) :
    forall {m k : Nat}, m < k -> coeff F c m k = F.zero
  | m, 0, h => by
      exact False.elim ((_root_.Nat.not_lt_zero m) h)
  | 0, k + 1, _ => by
      exact coeff_zero_succ F c k
  | m + 1, k + 1, h => by
      rw [coeff_succ_succ]
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.finiteSum_eq_zero F
      intro j hj
      rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt c (m := m - j) (k := k)
        (by omega)]
      rw [F.mul_zero]

/
positive series of `c` above it. This is the series the reciprocal-power file
inverts 
describes. -/
def constantPlusPositiveSeries {N : Nat}
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) :
    TruncatedPowerSeries alpha N
proof:
:=
  TruncatedPowerSeries.add F
    (TruncatedPowerSeries.constant F a0)
    (positiveSeries F (N := N) c)

name: constantPlusPositive_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem constantPlusPositive_coeff_zero {N : Nat}
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) :
    (constantPlusPositiveSeries F (N := N) a0 c).coeff 0 =
      a0
proof:
:= by
  unfold constantPlusPositiveSeries
  rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_add]
  rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_constant_zero]
  rw [positiveSeries_coeff_zero]
  rw [F.add_zero]

name: constantPlusPositive_coeff_succ
statement:
theorem constantPlusPositive_coeff_succ {N : Nat}
    (a0 : alpha) (c : Nat -> alpha) (m : Nat) :
    (constantPlusPositiveSeries F (N := N) a0 c).coeff (m + 1) =
      c m
proof:
:= by
  unfold constantPlusPositiveSeries
  rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_add]
  rw [TruncatedPowerSeries.coeff_constant_succ]
  rw [positiveSeries_coeff_succ]
  rw [F.zero_add]

name: scalarPow_zero
statement:
theorem scalarPow_zero (a : alpha) :
    scalarPow F a 0 = F.one
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: scalarPow_succ
statement:
theorem scalarPow_succ (a : alpha) (n : Nat) :
    scalarPow F a (n + 1) =
      F.mul a (scalarPow F a n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: scalarPow_one
statement:
theorem scalarPow_one (a : alpha) :
    scalarPow F a 1 = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [scalarPow_succ, scalarPow_zero]
  rw [F.mul_one]

name: mul_left_commute_three
statement:
theorem mul_left_commute_three
    (a b c : alpha) :
    F.mul a (F.mul b c) =
      F.mul b (F.mul a c)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul a (F.mul b c) =
        F.mul (F.mul a b) c := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul b a) c := by
          rw [F.mul_comm a b]
    _ = F.mul b (F.mul a c) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: newman_square_nonneg
statement:
private theorem newman_square_nonneg (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul x x)
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x

name: newman_sqrt_eq_mul_sqrt_of_eq_sq_mul
statement:
private theorem newman_sqrt_eq_mul_sqrt_of_eq_sq_mul
    {r q s : Point}
    (hr : r = RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul q q) s)
    (hq : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero q)
    (hs : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero s) :
    newmanSqrt r = RealTheory.mul q (newmanSqrt s)
proof:
:= by
  have hqq :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul q q) :=
    newman_square_nonneg q
  have hroot_q_sq :
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
        (RealTheory.mul q q) = q := by
    apply RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
    refine And.intro hq ?_
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
  unfold newmanSqrt
  change
    RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) r =
      RealTheory.mul q
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) s)
  rw [hr]
  rw [RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_mul_succ_of_nonneg 1 hqq hs]
  rw [hroot_q_sq]

name: newman_two_pos
statement:
private theorem newman_two_pos :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.lt F.zero (F.nat 2)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_one]
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
    F RealTheory.zero_lt_one F.one
  change F.lt (F.add F.one F.zero) (F.add F.one F.one) at h
  rw [F.add_zero] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one h

name: newman_two_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem newman_two_ne_zero :
    Not (RealTheory.nat 2 = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  exact
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base newman_two_pos)
      hzero.symm

name: newman_inv_two_pos
statement:
private theorem newman_inv_two_pos :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base newman_two_pos

name: newman_G_sq
statement:
private theorem newman_G_sq
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.mul (gaussGeometricMean a b) (gaussGeometricMean a b) =
      RealTheory.mul a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hb_nonneg : F.le F.zero b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F h.left
  have ha_nonneg : F.le F.zero a := RealTheory.le_trans hb_nonneg h.right
  have hab_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul a b) :=
    F.mul_nonneg ha_nonneg hb_nonneg
  unfold gaussGeometricMean
  change
    F.mul
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (F.mul a b))
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (F.mul a b)) =
      F.mul a b
  have hroot :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg
      (n := 1) (x := F.mul a b) hab_nonneg
  rwa [RealFunction.powNat_two] at hroot

name: newman_mul_left_comm_base
statement:
private theorem newman_mul_left_comm_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x y z : Point) :
    F.mul x (F.mul y z) = F.mul y (F.mul x z)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul x (F.mul y z) = F.mul (F.mul x y) z := by
      rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul y x) z := by rw [F.mul_comm x y]
    _ = F.mul y (F.mul x z) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: newman_mul_mul_pair_eq_base
statement:
private theorem newman_mul_mul_pair_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
      F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d)
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_mul_comm F a b c d

name: newman_add_left_comm_base
statement:
private theorem newman_add_left_comm_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x y z : Point) :
    F.add x (F.add y z) = F.add y (F.add x z)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add x (F.add y z) = F.add (F.add x y) z := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.add y x) z := by rw [F.add_comm x y]
    _ = F.add y (F.add x z) := by rw [F.add_assoc]

name: newman_add_sq_raw_eq_base
statement:
private theorem newman_add_sq_raw_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b) =
      F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a b))
        (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  calc
    F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b a))
        (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b b)) =
        F.add (F.mul a a)
          (F.add (F.mul b a)
            (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b b))) := by
      rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.mul a a)
          (F.add (F.mul a b)
            (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b))) := by
      rw [newman_add_left_comm_base F
        (F.mul b a) (F.mul a b) (F.mul b b)]
    _ = F.add
          (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a b))
          (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b)) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: newman_add_sq_eq_base
statement:
private theorem newman_add_sq_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b) =
      F.add
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))
        (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [newman_add_sq_raw_eq_base F a b]
  let A := F.mul a a
  let B := F.mul a b
  let C := F.mul b a
  let D := F.mul b b
  change F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) =
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C)
  calc
    F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) =
        F.add A (F.add B (F.add C D)) := by
      rw [F.add_assoc A B (F.add C D)]
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.add B C) D) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc B C D]
    _ = F.add A (F.add D (F.add B C)) := by
      rw [F.add_comm (F.add B C) D]
    _ = F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc A D (F.add B C)]

name: newman_sub_sq_eq_base
statement:
private theorem newman_sub_sq_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.mul (F.sub a b) (F.sub a b) =
      F.sub
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))
        (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F]
  let aa := F.mul a a
  let ab := F.mul a b
  let ba := F.mul b a
  let bb := F.mul b b
  change
    F.add (F.add aa (F.neg ab)) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb) =
      F.add (F.add aa bb) (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba))
  calc
    F.add (F.add aa (F.neg ab)) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb) =
        F.add aa (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb)) := by
      rw [F.add_assoc aa (F.neg ab) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb)]
    _ = F.add aa (F.add (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba)) bb) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba) bb]
    _ = F.add aa (F.add bb (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba))) := by
      rw [F.add_comm (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba)) bb]
    _ = F.add (F.add aa bb) (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba)) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc aa bb (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba))]

name: newman_sub_add_add_cancel_same_base
statement:
private theorem newman_sub_add_add_cancel_same_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (A C : Point) :
    F.add (F.sub A C) (F.add C C) = F.add A C
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    F.add (F.add A (F.neg C)) (F.add C C) =
        F.add A (F.add (F.neg C) (F.add C C)) := by
      rw [F.add_assoc A (F.neg C) (F.add C C)]
    _ = F.add A (F.add C (F.add (F.neg C) C)) := by
      rw [newman_add_left_comm_base F (F.neg C) C C]
    _ = F.add A (F.add C F.zero) := by
      rw [F.neg_add C]
    _ = F.add A C := by
      rw [F.add_zero C]

name: newman_add_four_reorder_base
statement:
private theorem newman_add_four_reorder_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (A B C D : Point) :
    F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) =
      F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) =
        F.add A (F.add B (F.add C D)) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.add B C) D) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc B C D]
    _ = F.add A (F.add D (F.add B C)) := by
      rw [F.add_comm (F.add B C) D]
    _ = F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: newman_sub_add_cancel_reassoc_base
statement:
private theorem newman_sub_add_cancel_reassoc_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (A C D : Point) :
    F.add (F.sub A C) (F.add C D) = F.add A D
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    F.add (F.add A (F.neg C)) (F.add C D) =
        F.add A (F.add (F.neg C) (F.add C D)) := by
      rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.add (F.neg C) C) D) := by
      rw [<- F.add_assoc (F.neg C) C D]
    _ = F.add A (F.add F.zero D) := by rw [F.neg_add]
    _ = F.add A D := by rw [F.zero_add]

name: newman_mul_inv_scale_cancel_base
statement:
private theorem newman_mul_inv_scale_cancel_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {c : Point} (u : Point)
    (hc : Not (c = F.zero)) :
    F.mul c (F.mul u (F.inv c)) = u
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul c (F.mul u (F.inv c)) =
        F.mul u (F.mul c (F.inv c)) := by
      exact newman_mul_left_comm_base F c u (F.inv c)
    _ = F.mul u F.one := by rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hc]
    _ = u := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: newman_scaled_t
statement:
private theorem newman_scaled_t
    (a b x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (newmanMap a b x) =
      RealTheory.sub x
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul a b) (RealTheory.inv x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold newmanMap
  exact newman_mul_inv_scale_cancel_base F _ newman_two_ne_zero

name: newman_scaled_tDeriv
statement:
private theorem newman_scaled_tDeriv
    (a b x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (newmanMapDeriv a b x) =
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul a b)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x) (RealTheory.inv x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold newmanMapDeriv
  exact newman_mul_inv_scale_cancel_base F _ newman_two_ne_zero

name: newman_scaled_A
statement:
private theorem newman_scaled_A
    (a b : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (gaussArithmeticMean a b) =
      RealTheory.add a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold gaussArithmeticMean
  exact newman_mul_inv_scale_cancel_base F _ newman_two_ne_zero

name: newman_scaled_G_factor
statement:
private theorem newman_scaled_G_factor
    {a b x : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (RealTheory.nat 2))
        (newmanLineFactor (gaussGeometricMean a b) (newmanMap a b x)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add x
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul a b) (RealTheory.inv x)))
        (RealTheory.add x
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul a b) (RealTheory.inv x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let T := F.nat 2
  let p := F.mul a b
  let y := F.inv x
  let z := F.mul p y
  let t := newmanMap a b x
  let G := gaussGeometricMean a b
  let S := F.mul T T
  have hxy : F.mul x y = F.one := by
    unfold y
    exact F.mul_inv_cancel hx
  have hxz : F.mul x z = p := by
    unfold z
    calc
      F.mul x (F.mul p y) = F.mul p (F.mul x y) :=
        newman_mul_left_comm_base F x p y
      _ = F.mul p F.one := by rw [hxy]
      _ = p := by rw [F.mul_one]
  have hzx : F.mul z x = p := by
    rw [F.mul_comm z x]
    exact hxz
  have hcross :
      F.add (F.mul x z) (F.mul z x) = F.add p p := by
    rw [hxz, hzx]
  have hSp :
      F.mul S p = F.add (F.add p p) (F.add p p) := by
    unfold S
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul T T) p = F.mul T (F.mul T p) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul T (F.add p p) := by
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_two_mul_eq_add_self F p]
      _ = F.add (F.add p p) (F.add p p) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_two_mul_eq_add_self F (F.add p p)
  have ht : F.mul T t = F.sub x z := by
    unfold T t z p y
    exact newman_scaled_t a b x
  have hG : F.mul G G = p := by
    unfold G p
    exact newman_G_sq h
  change
    F.mul S (newmanLineFactor G t) =
      F.mul (F.add x z) (F.add x z)
  unfold newmanLineFactor
  calc
    F.mul S (F.add (F.mul t t) (F.mul G G)) =
        F.add
          (F.mul S (F.mul t t))
          (F.mul S (F.mul G G)) := by rw [F.mul_add]
    _ = F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul T t) (F.mul T t))
          (F.mul S p) := by
        rw [newman_mul_mul_pair_eq_base F T T t t, hG]
    _ = F.add
          (F.mul (F.sub x z) (F.sub x z))
          (F.mul S p) := by rw [ht]
    _ = F.add
          (F.sub
            (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul z z))
            (F.add (F.mul x z) (F.mul z x)))
          (F.add (F.add p p) (F.add p p)) := by
        rw [newman_sub_sq_eq_base F x z, hSp]
    _ = F.add
          (F.sub
            (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul z z))
            (F.add p p))
          (F.add (F.add p p) (F.add p p)) := by rw [hcross]
    _ = F.add
          (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul z z))
          (F.add p p) := by
        exact newman_sub_add_add_cancel_same_base F
          (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul z z)) (F.add p p)
    _ = F.mul (F.add x z) (F.add x z) := by
        rw [<- hcross]
        exact (newman_add_sq_eq_base F x z).symm

name: newman_scaled_A_factor
statement:
private theorem newman_scaled_A_factor
    {a b x : Point}
    (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (RealTheory.nat 2))
        (newmanLineFactor (gaussArithmeticMean a b) (newmanMap a b x)) =
      RealTheory.mul (lineRadicand a b x)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x) (RealTheory.inv x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let T := F.nat 2
  let p := F.mul a b
  let y := F.inv x
  let z := F.mul p y
  let t := newmanMap a b x
  let Amean := gaussArithmeticMean a b
  let S := F.mul T T
  let X := F.mul x x
  let Y := F.mul y y
  let Asq := F.mul a a
  let Bsq := F.mul b b
  let Z := F.mul z z
  have hxy : F.mul x y = F.one := by
    unfold y
    exact F.mul_inv_cancel hx
  have hXY : F.mul X Y = F.one := by
    unfold X Y
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul x x) (F.mul y y) =
          F.mul (F.mul x y) (F.mul x y) :=
        newman_mul_mul_pair_eq_base F x x y y
      _ = F.mul F.one F.one := by rw [hxy]
      _ = F.one := by rw [F.one_mul]
  have hxz : F.mul x z = p := by
    unfold z
    calc
      F.mul x (F.mul p y) = F.mul p (F.mul x y) :=
        newman_mul_left_comm_base F x p y
      _ = F.mul p F.one := by rw [hxy]
      _ = p := by rw [F.mul_one]
  have hzx : F.mul z x = p := by
    rw [F.mul_comm z x]
    exact hxz
  have hcross_xz :
      F.add (F.mul x z) (F.mul z x) = F.add p p := by
    rw [hxz, hzx]
  have hcross_ab :
      F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b a) = F.add p p := by
    unfold p
    rw [F.mul_comm b a]
  have ht : F.mul T t = F.sub x z := by
    unfold T t z p y
    exact newman_scaled_t a b x
  have hA : F.mul T Amean = F.add a b := by
    unfold T Amean
    exact newman_scaled_A a b
  have hABY : F.mul (F.mul Asq Bsq) Y = Z := by
    have hpSq : F.mul Asq Bsq = F.mul p p := by
      unfold Asq Bsq p
      exact newman_mul_mul_pair_eq_base F a a b b
    unfold Z z
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul Asq Bsq) Y = F.mul (F.mul p p) Y := by
        rw [hpSq]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul p p) (F.mul y y) := by rfl
      _ = F.mul (F.mul p y) (F.mul p y) :=
        newman_mul_mul_pair_eq_base F p p y y
  have hXXY : F.mul (F.mul X X) Y = X := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul X X) Y = F.mul X (F.mul X Y) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul X F.one := by rw [hXY]
      _ = X := by rw [F.mul_one]
  have hAXY : F.mul (F.mul Asq X) Y = Asq := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul Asq X) Y = F.mul Asq (F.mul X Y) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul Asq F.one := by rw [hXY]
      _ = Asq := by rw [F.mul_one]
  have hXBY : F.mul (F.mul X Bsq) Y = Bsq := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul X Bsq) Y = F.mul X (F.mul Bsq Y) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul Bsq (F.mul X Y) :=
        newman_mul_left_comm_base F X Bsq Y
      _ = F.mul Bsq F.one := by rw [hXY]
      _ = Bsq := by rw [F.mul_one]
  have hradY :
      F.mul (lineRadicand a b x) Y =
        F.add (F.add X Z) (F.add Asq Bsq) := by
    unfold lineRadicand
    change
      F.mul (F.mul (F.add X Asq) (F.add X Bsq)) Y =
        F.add (F.add X Z) (F.add Asq Bsq)
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul (F.add X Asq) (F.add X Bsq)) Y =
          F.mul
            (F.add
              (F.mul (F.add X Asq) X)
              (F.mul (F.add X Asq) Bsq)) Y := by
        rw [F.mul_add]
      _ = F.mul
            (F.add
              (F.add (F.mul X X) (F.mul Asq X))
              (F.add (F.mul X Bsq) (F.mul Asq Bsq))) Y := by
        rw [F.add_mul X Asq X, F.add_mul X Asq Bsq]
      _ = F.add
            (F.add
              (F.mul (F.mul X X) Y)
              (F.mul (F.mul Asq X) Y))
            (F.add
              (F.mul (F.mul X Bsq) Y)
              (F.mul (F.mul Asq Bsq) Y)) := by
        rw [F.add_mul, F.add_mul, F.add_mul]
      _ = F.add (F.add X Asq) (F.add Bsq Z) := by
        rw [hXXY, hAXY, hXBY, hABY]
      _ = F.add (F.add X Z) (F.add Asq Bsq) :=
        newman_add_four_reorder_base F X Asq Bsq Z
  change
    F.mul S (newmanLineFactor Amean t) =
      F.mul (lineRadicand a b x) Y
  unfold newmanLineFactor
  calc
    F.mul S (F.add (F.mul t t) (F.mul Amean Amean)) =
        F.add
          (F.mul S (F.mul t t))
          (F.mul S (F.mul Amean Amean)) := by rw [F.mul_add]
    _ = F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul T t) (F.mul T t))
          (F.mul (F.mul T Amean) (F.mul T Amean)) := by
        rw [newman_mul_mul_pair_eq_base F T T t t]
        rw [newman_mul_mul_pair_eq_base F T T Amean Amean]
    _ = F.add
          (F.mul (F.sub x z) (F.sub x z))
          (F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b)) := by rw [ht, hA]
    _ = F.add
          (F.sub
            (F.add X Z) (F.add (F.mul x z) (F.mul z x)))
          (F.add
            (F.add Asq Bsq)
            (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b a))) := by
        unfold X Z Asq Bsq
        rw [newman_sub_sq_eq_base F x z,
          newman_add_sq_eq_base F a b]
    _ = F.add
          (F.sub (F.add X Z) (F.add p p))
          (F.add (F.add Asq Bsq) (F.add p p)) := by
        rw [hcross_xz, hcross_ab]
    _ = F.add
          (F.sub (F.add X Z) (F.add p p))
          (F.add (F.add p p) (F.add Asq Bsq)) := by
        rw [F.add_comm (F.add Asq Bsq) (F.add p p)]
    _ = F.add (F.add X Z) (F.add Asq Bsq) :=
        newman_sub_add_cancel_reassoc_base F
          (F.add X Z) (F.add p p) (F.add Asq Bsq)
    _ = F.mul (lineRadicand a b x) Y := hradY.symm

name: newman_lineRad_pullback
statement:
private theorem newman_lineRad_pullback
    {a b x : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    lineRadicand (gaussArithmeticMean a b) (gaussGeometricMean a b)
        (newmanMap a b x) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (newmanMapDeriv a b x)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)))
          (RealTheory.mul (newmanMapDeriv a b x)
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2))))
        (lineRadicand a b x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let T := F.nat 2
  let S := F.mul T T
  let scale := F.mul S S
  let p := F.mul a b
  let y := F.inv x
  let Y := F.mul y y
  let z := F.mul p y
  let u := F.add x z
  let t := newmanMap a b x
  let d := newmanMapDeriv a b x
  let q := F.mul d (F.inv T)
  let rad := lineRadicand a b x
  let fA := newmanLineFactor (gaussArithmeticMean a b) t
  let fG := newmanLineFactor (gaussGeometricMean a b) t
  have hx_ne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hzero.symm
  have hT_ne : Not (T = F.zero) := by
    unfold T
    exact newman_two_ne_zero
  have hS_ne : Not (S = F.zero) := by
    unfold S
    exact F.mul_ne_zero hT_ne hT_ne
  have hscale_ne : Not (scale = F.zero) := by
    unfold scale
    exact F.mul_ne_zero hS_ne hS_ne
  have hyx : F.mul y x = F.one := by
    unfold y
    exact F.inv_mul_cancel hx_ne
  have hyz : F.mul y z = F.mul p Y := by
    unfold z Y
    exact newman_mul_left_comm_base F y p y
  have hyu :
      F.mul y u = F.add F.one (F.mul p Y) := by
    unfold u
    calc
      F.mul y (F.add x z) =
          F.add (F.mul y x) (F.mul y z) := by rw [F.mul_add]
      _ = F.add F.one (F.mul p Y) := by rw [hyx, hyz]
  have hd :
      F.mul T d = F.add F.one (F.mul p Y) := by
    unfold T d p Y y
    exact newman_scaled_tDeriv a b x
  have hSq : F.mul S q = F.mul T d := by
    unfold S q
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul T T) (F.mul d (F.inv T)) =
          F.mul (F.mul T d) (F.mul T (F.inv T)) :=
        newman_mul_mul_pair_eq_base F T T d (F.inv T)
      _ = F.mul (F.mul T d) F.one := by rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hT_ne]
      _ = F.mul T d := by rw [F.mul_one]
  have hfA :
      F.mul S fA = F.mul rad Y := by
    unfold S fA rad Y y t
    exact newman_scaled_A_factor hx_ne
  have hfG : F.mul S fG = F.mul u u := by
    unfold S fG u z p y t
    exact newman_scaled_G_factor h hx_ne
  have hcore :
      F.mul (F.mul rad Y) (F.mul u u) =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.mul T d) (F.mul T d)) rad := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul rad Y) (F.mul u u) =
          F.mul rad (F.mul Y (F.mul u u)) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul rad
          (F.mul (F.mul y u) (F.mul y u)) := by
        unfold Y
        rw [newman_mul_mul_pair_eq_base F y y u u]
      _ = F.mul rad
          (F.mul (F.add F.one (F.mul p Y))
            (F.add F.one (F.mul p Y))) := by rw [hyu]
      _ = F.mul rad (F.mul (F.mul T d) (F.mul T d)) := by
        rw [hd]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul T d) (F.mul T d)) rad := by
        rw [F.mul_comm rad]
  have hscaled_left :
      F.mul scale (F.mul fA fG) =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.mul T d) (F.mul T d)) rad := by
    calc
      F.mul scale (F.mul fA fG) =
          F.mul (F.mul S fA) (F.mul S fG) := by
        unfold scale
        exact newman_mul_mul_pair_eq_base F S S fA fG
      _ = F.mul (F.mul rad Y) (F.mul u u) := by rw [hfA, hfG]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul T d) (F.mul T d)) rad := hcore
  have hscaled_right :
      F.mul scale (F.mul (F.mul q q) rad) =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.mul T d) (F.mul T d)) rad := by
    calc
      F.mul scale (F.mul (F.mul q q) rad) =
          F.mul (F.mul scale (F.mul q q)) rad := by
        exact (F.mul_assoc scale (F.mul q q) rad).symm
      _ = F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul S q) (F.mul S q)) rad := by
        unfold scale
        rw [newman_mul_mul_pair_eq_base F S S q q]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul T d) (F.mul T d)) rad := by
        rw [hSq]
  change F.mul fA fG = F.mul (F.mul q q) rad
  apply F.mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero hscale_ne
  exact hscaled_left.trans hscaled_right.symm

name: newman_lineFactor_pos_of_pos
statement:
private theorem newman_lineFactor_pos_of_pos
    {c x : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (newmanLineFactor c x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcc : F.lt F.zero (F.mul c c) := F.mul_pos hc hc
  have hxx : F.le F.zero (F.mul x x) := F.mul_self_nonneg x
  have hlt :
      F.lt (F.mul x x)
        (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul c c)) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hcc (F.mul x x)
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  unfold newmanLineFactor
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hxx hlt

name: newman_lineRad_pos_of_pos
statement:
private theorem newman_lineRad_pos_of_pos
    {a b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (lineRadicand a b x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lineRadicand
  exact RealTheory.mul_pos
    (newman_lineFactor_pos_of_pos ha)
    (newman_lineFactor_pos_of_pos hb)

name: newman_lineDen_pos_of_pos
statement:
private theorem newman_lineDen_pos_of_pos
    {a b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (newmanLineDen a b x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold newmanLineDen newmanSqrt
  change
    RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
        (lineRadicand a b x))
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos 1
    (newman_lineRad_pos_of_pos ha hb)

name: newman_tDeriv_pos
statement:
private theorem newman_tDeriv_pos
    {a b x : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (newmanMapDeriv a b x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have ha : F.lt F.zero a :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F h.left h.right
  have hp : F.lt F.zero (F.mul a b) := F.mul_pos ha h.left
  have hy : F.lt F.zero (F.inv x) := F.inv_pos hx
  have hY :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy)
  have hterm :
      F.le F.zero
        (F.mul (F.mul a b)
          (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))) :=
    F.mul_nonneg (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hp) hY
  have hsum :
      F.lt F.zero
        (F.add F.one
          (F.mul (F.mul a b)
            (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)))) := by
    have hone_le :
        F.le F.one
          (F.add F.one
            (F.mul (F.mul a b)
              (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)))) := by
      have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hterm F.one
      rwa [F.add_zero] at hadd
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one hone_le
  unfold newmanMapDeriv
  exact F.mul_pos hsum newman_inv_two_pos

name: newman_J_pullback
statement:
private theorem newman_J_pullback
    {a b x : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (lineKernel (gaussArithmeticMean a b) (gaussGeometricMean a b)
          (newmanMap a b x))
        (newmanMapDeriv a b x) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (lineKernel a b x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let T := F.nat 2
  let d := newmanMapDeriv a b x
  let q := F.mul d (F.inv T)
  let den := newmanLineDen a b x
  have ha : F.lt F.zero a :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F h.left h.right
  have hd_pos : F.lt F.zero d := by
    unfold d
    exact newman_tDeriv_pos h hx
  have hq_pos : F.lt F.zero q := by
    unfold q T
    exact F.mul_pos hd_pos newman_inv_two_pos
  have hq_nonneg : F.le F.zero q :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hq_pos
  have hrad_pos : F.lt F.zero (lineRadicand a b x) :=
    newman_lineRad_pos_of_pos ha h.left
  have hrad_nonneg : F.le F.zero (lineRadicand a b x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hrad_pos
  have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero den := by
    unfold den
    exact newman_lineDen_pos_of_pos ha h.left
  have hT_ne : Not (T = F.zero) := by
    unfold T
    exact newman_two_ne_zero
  have hd_ne : Not (d = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hd_pos) hzero.symm
  have hq_ne : Not (q = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hq_pos) hzero.symm
  have hden_ne : Not (den = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hden_pos) hzero.symm
  have hrad := newman_lineRad_pullback h hx
  have hden :
      newmanLineDen (gaussArithmeticMean a b) (gaussGeometricMean a b)
          (newmanMap a b x) =
        F.mul q den := by
    unfold newmanLineDen
    apply newman_sqrt_eq_mul_sqrt_of_eq_sq_mul
    · unfold q T
      exact hrad
    · exact hq_nonneg
    · exact hrad_nonneg
  have hqT : F.mul q T = d := by
    unfold q
    exact F.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right d hT_ne
  have hinv_q_mul_d : F.mul (F.inv q) d = T := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.inv q) d = F.mul (F.inv q) (F.mul q T) := by rw [hqT]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.inv q) q) T := by rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul F.one T := by rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hq_ne]
      _ = T := by rw [F.one_mul]
  unfold lineKernel
  change
    F.mul
        (F.inv
          (newmanLineDen
            (gaussArithmeticMean a b) (gaussGeometricMean a b)
            (newmanMap a b x))) d =
      F.mul T (F.inv den)
  rw [hden]
  calc
    F.mul (F.inv (F.mul q den)) d =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.inv den) (F.inv q)) d := by
      rw [F.inv_mul hq_ne hden_ne]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv den) (F.mul (F.inv q) d) := by
      rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv den) T := by rw [hinv_q_mul_d]
    _ = F.mul T (F.inv den) := by rw [F.mul_comm]

name: newman_G_pos
statement:
private theorem newman_G_pos
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (gaussGeometricMean a b)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base h.left h.right
  unfold gaussGeometricMean
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos 1
    (RealTheory.mul_pos ha h.left)

name: newman_T_continuousOn_positive
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv :
      ContinuousOn (fun x : Point => F.lt F.zero x)
        (InvFun IdentityFun) := by
    apply continuousOn_inv continuousOn_identity
    intro x hx hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hzero.symm
  unfold newmanMap
