  change ContinuousOn (fun x : Point => F.lt F.zero x)
    (MulFun
      (SubFun IdentityFun
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => F.mul a b) (InvFun IdentityFun)))
      (fun _ : Point => F.inv (F.nat 2)))
  exact continuousOn_mul
    (continuousOn_sub continuousOn_identity
      (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const hinv))
    continuousOn_const

name: newman_TDeriv_continuousOn_positive
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv :
      ContinuousOn (fun x : Point => F.lt F.zero x)
        (InvFun IdentityFun) := by
    apply continuousOn_inv continuousOn_identity
    intro x hx hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hzero.symm
  unfold newmanMapDeriv
  change ContinuousOn (fun x : Point => F.lt F.zero x)
    (MulFun
      (AddFun (fun _ : Point => F.one)
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => F.mul a b)
          (MulFun (InvFun IdentityFun) (InvFun IdentityFun))))
      (fun _ : Point => F.inv (F.nat 2)))
  exact continuousOn_mul
    (continuousOn_add continuousOn_const
      (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const
        (continuousOn_mul hinv hinv)))
    continuousOn_const

name: newman_T_hasDerivativeWithinOn_positive
statement:
private theorem newman_T_hasDerivativeWithinOn_positive (a b : Point) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
      (newmanMap a b) (newmanMapDeriv a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro x hx
  have hid := RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_id hx
  have hinv :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_inv_positive x hx
  have habinv :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_constMul
      (c := F.mul a b) hinv
  have hsub := RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_sub hid habinv
  have hhalf := RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_const
    (E := fun y : Point => F.lt F.zero y)
    (c := F.inv (F.nat 2)) hx
  have hraw := RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_mul hsub hhalf
  have hvalue :
      F.add
        (F.mul
          (F.sub F.one
            (F.mul (F.mul a b)
              (F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)))))
          (F.inv (F.nat 2)))
        (F.mul
          (F.sub x (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.inv x))) F.zero) =
      F.mul
        (F.add F.one
          (F.mul (F.mul a b)
            (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))))
        (F.inv (F.nat 2)) := by
    rw [F.mul_zero, F.add_zero]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F]
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [F.neg_neg]
  unfold newmanMap newmanMapDeriv
  change RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
    (fun y : Point => F.lt F.zero y)
    (MulFun
      (SubFun IdentityFun
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => F.mul a b) (InvFun IdentityFun)))
      (fun _ : Point => F.inv (F.nat 2)))
    x
    (F.mul
      (F.add F.one
        (F.mul (F.mul a b)
          (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))))
      (F.inv (F.nat 2)))
  exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_congr_value hvalue hraw

name: newman_T_strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval
statement:
private theorem newman_T_strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval
    {a b u v : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (hu : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero u) :
    StrictMonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v)
      (newmanMap a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpositive :
      forall x : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v x ->
        F.lt F.zero x := by
    intro x hx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hu hx.left
  have hcont :
      ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v) (newmanMap a b) :=
    continuousOn_subset hpositive (newman_T_continuousOn_positive a b)
  have hdiff :
      RealDerivative.DifferentiableOnOpenInterval u v (newmanMap a b) :=
    RealDerivative.differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn_subset
      (fun x hx => IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hu hx.left)
      (newman_T_hasDerivativeWithinOn_positive a b)
  have hderiv :
      RealDerivative.DerivativePositiveOnOpenInterval u v
        (newmanMap a b) := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hu hx.left
    have hcanonical :
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
          (RealTheory.OpenInterval u v) (newmanMap a b) x
          (newmanMapDeriv a b x) :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
        (fun y hy => IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hu hy.left)
        hx (newman_T_hasDerivativeWithinOn_positive a b x hxpos)
    have hEq : A = newmanMapDeriv a b x :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
        (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA hcanonical
    rw [hEq]
    exact newman_tDeriv_pos h hxpos
  exact
    RealDerivative.strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_positive
      hcont hdiff hderiv

name: newman_T_G_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem newman_T_G_eq_zero
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    newmanMap a b (gaussGeometricMean a b) = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let G := gaussGeometricMean a b
  have hGpos : F.lt F.zero G := newman_G_pos h
  have hGne : Not (G = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hGpos) hzero.symm
  have hGsq : F.mul G G = F.mul a b := newman_G_sq h
  have hcancel : F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.inv G) = G := by
    rw [<- hGsq, F.mul_assoc, F.mul_inv_cancel hGne, F.mul_one]
  unfold newmanMap
  change F.mul
    (F.sub G (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.inv G)))
    (F.inv (F.nat 2)) = F.zero
  rw [hcancel, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F G, F.zero_mul]

name: newman_T_le_of_le
statement:
private theorem newman_T_le_of_le
    {a b x y : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    RealTheory.le (newmanMap a b x) (newmanMap a b y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hyx : F.le y x
  case pos =>
    have heq : x = y := F.le_antisymm hxy hyx
    rw [heq]
    exact F.le_refl (newmanMap a b y)
  case neg =>
    have hlt : F.lt x y :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hyx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (newman_T_strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval h hx
        x y
        (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hxy)
        (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hxy) hlt)

name: newman_T_high_nonneg
statement:
private theorem newman_T_high_nonneg
    {a b x : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (hx : RealTheory.le (gaussGeometricMean a b) x) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (newmanMap a b x)
proof:
:= by
  have hle := newman_T_le_of_le h (newman_G_pos h) hx
  rw [newman_T_G_eq_zero h] at hle
  exact hle

name: newman_T_tendstoAtPosInfToPosInf
statement:
private theorem newman_T_tendstoAtPosInfToPosInf
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    TendstoAtPosInfToPosInf
      (RightHalfLine (gaussGeometricMean a b)) (newmanMap a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := F.mul a b
  let T := F.nat 2
  have ha : F.lt F.zero a :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F h.left h.right
  have hp_pos : F.lt F.zero p := by
    unfold p
    exact F.mul_pos ha h.left
  have hp_nonneg : F.le F.zero p :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hp_pos
  have hT_ne : Not (T = F.zero) := by
    unfold T
    exact newman_two_ne_zero
  intro bound
  refine Exists.intro
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.max2 F F.one
      (F.add (F.mul T bound) p)) ?_
  intro x _hx hlarge
  have hone_lt_x : F.lt F.one x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_left F F.one
        (F.add (F.mul T bound) p))
      hlarge
  have hx_pos : F.lt F.zero x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hone_lt_x
  have hone_le_x : F.le F.one x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hone_lt_x
  have hinv_le_one : F.le (F.inv x) F.one := by
    have hinv := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx_pos hone_le_x
    change F.le (F.inv x) (F.inv F.one) at hinv
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at hinv
  have hpinv_le_p : F.le (F.mul p (F.inv x)) p := by
    have hmul := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F
      hinv_le_one hp_nonneg
    rwa [F.mul_one] at hmul
  have hsub_le :
      F.le (F.sub x p) (F.sub x (F.mul p (F.inv x))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
      (F.le_refl x) hpinv_le_p
  have hlinear : F.lt (F.add (F.mul T bound) p) x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_max2_right F F.one
        (F.add (F.mul T bound) p))
      hlarge
  have hTbound_lt_sub :
      F.lt (F.mul T bound) (F.sub x p) := by
    have hshift := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F
      hlinear (F.neg p)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_neg_cancel_right F
      (F.mul T bound) p] at hshift
    rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg x p] at hshift
  have hTbound_lt_pullback :
      F.lt (F.mul T bound)
        (F.sub x (F.mul p (F.inv x))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hTbound_lt_sub hsub_le
  have hscaled := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F
    hTbound_lt_pullback newman_inv_two_pos
  change
    F.lt (F.mul (F.mul T bound) (F.inv T))
      (F.mul (F.sub x (F.mul p (F.inv x))) (F.inv T)) at hscaled
  have hcancel :
      F.mul (F.mul T bound) (F.inv T) = bound := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul T bound) (F.inv T) =
          F.mul (F.mul bound T) (F.inv T) := by
        rw [F.mul_comm T bound]
      _ = bound :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right F bound hT_ne
  rw [hcancel] at hscaled
  unfold newmanMap
  change F.lt bound
    (F.mul (F.sub x (F.mul p (F.inv x))) (F.inv T))
  exact hscaled

name: newman_hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_congr_rightHalfLine
statement:
private theorem
    newman_hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_congr_rightHalfLine
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a I : Point}
    (hfg : forall x : Point, RightHalfLine a x -> f x = g x)
    (hf : HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf f a I) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf g a I
proof:
:= by
  cases hf with
  | intro P hP =>
      refine Exists.intro P ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ hP.right
      intro x hx
      exact
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
          hx (fun y hy => hfg y hy.left) (hP.left x hx)

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_lineKernel_high_pullback
statement:
theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_lineKernel_high_pullback
    {a b I : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (hI :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
        (lineKernel (gaussArithmeticMean a b) (gaussGeometricMean a b))
        RealTheory.zero I) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (lineKernel a b x))
      (gaussGeometricMean a b) I
proof:
:= by
  have hsubst :=
    hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_substitution_strictIncreasing_atPosInf
      (newmanHighSubstitutionData
        (lineKernel (gaussArithmeticMean a b) (gaussGeometricMean a b)) h)
      hI
  apply
    newman_hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_congr_rightHalfLine
      ?_ hsubst
  intro x hx
  unfold substitutionIntegrand
  exact newman_J_pullback h
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (newman_G_pos h) hx)

name: square_nonneg_base
statement:
private theorem square_nonneg_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x : Point) :
    F.le F.zero (F.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl hx =>
      exact F.mul_nonneg hx hx
  | inr hx =>
      have hneg_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx
      have hsq : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) :=
        F.mul_nonneg hneg_nonneg hneg_nonneg
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x x] at hsq

proof:
:= by

      F.lt a (F.add a b) := by
    have hstep := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
      F h.left a
    change F.lt (F.add a F.zero) (F.add a b) at hstep

name: square_le_square_of_nonneg_le_base
statement:
private theorem square_le_square_of_nonneg_le_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x y : Point}
    (h0x : F.le F.zero x)
    (hxy : F.le x y) :
    F.le (F.mul x x) (F.mul y y)
proof:
:= by
  have h0y : F.le F.zero y := F.le_trans h0x hxy
  have hleft : F.le (F.mul x x) (F.mul y x) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hxy h0x
  have hright : F.le (F.mul y x) (F.mul y y) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hxy h0y
  exact F.le_trans hleft hright

name: gaussRadicand_ge_b_sq
statement:
private theorem gaussRadicand_ge_b_sq
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul b b)
      (gaussRadicand a b theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let b2 := F.mul b b
  let a2 := F.mul a a
  let c2 := F.mul (landenCos theta) (landenCos theta)
  let s2 := F.mul (landenSin theta) (landenSin theta)
  have hb2_le_a2 : F.le b2 a2 := by
    unfold b2 a2
    exact h.b_sq_le_a_sq
  have hc2_nonneg : F.le F.zero c2 := by
    unfold c2
    exact landen_cos_sq_nonneg theta
  have hterm :
      F.le (F.mul b2 c2) (F.mul a2 c2) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hb2_le_a2 hc2_nonneg
  have hsum :
      F.le (F.add (F.mul b2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2))
        (F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2)) :=
    F.add_le_add_right hterm (F.mul b2 s2)
  have hpyth_cs : F.add c2 s2 = F.one := by
    unfold c2 s2
    rw [F.add_comm]
    exact landen_sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta
  have hb2_eq :
      b2 = F.add (F.mul b2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2) := by
    calc
      b2 = F.mul b2 F.one := by
        rw [F.mul_one]
      _ = F.mul b2 (F.add c2 s2) := by
        rw [hpyth_cs]
      _ = F.add (F.mul b2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2) := by
        rw [F.mul_add]
  unfold gaussRadicand
  change F.le b2 (F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2))
  have hb2_le_sum :
      F.le b2 (F.add (F.mul b2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2)) :=
    le_of_eq_left_base F hb2_eq
  exact F.le_trans hb2_le_sum hsum

name: gaussRadicand_le_a_sq
statement:
private theorem gaussRadicand_le_a_sq
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le (gaussRadicand a b theta)
      (RealTheory.mul a a)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let b2 := F.mul b b
  let a2 := F.mul a a
  let c2 := F.mul (landenCos theta) (landenCos theta)
  let s2 := F.mul (landenSin theta) (landenSin theta)
  have hb2_le_a2 : F.le b2 a2 := by
    unfold b2 a2
    exact h.b_sq_le_a_sq
  have hs2_nonneg : F.le F.zero s2 := by
    unfold s2
    exact landen_sin_sq_nonneg theta
  have hterm :
      F.le (F.mul b2 s2) (F.mul a2 s2) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hb2_le_a2 hs2_nonneg
  have hsum :
      F.le (F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2))
        (F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul a2 s2)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hterm
      (F.mul a2 c2)
  have hpyth_cs : F.add c2 s2 = F.one := by
    unfold c2 s2
    rw [F.add_comm]
    exact landen_sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta
  have ha2_eq :
      F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul a2 s2) = a2 := by
    calc
      F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul a2 s2) =
          F.mul a2 (F.add c2 s2) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
      _ = F.mul a2 F.one := by
          rw [hpyth_cs]
      _ = a2 := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
  unfold gaussRadicand
  change F.le (F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2)) a2
  have hsum_le_a2 :
      F.le (F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul a2 s2)) a2 := by
    rw [ha2_eq]
    exact F.le_refl a2
  exact F.le_trans hsum hsum_le_a2

name: gaussRadicand_pos
statement:
private theorem gaussRadicand_pos
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (gaussRadicand a b theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hb2_pos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.mul b b) :=
    F.mul_pos h.left h.left
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
    F hb2_pos (gaussRadicand_ge_b_sq h)

name: gaussRadicand_nonneg
statement:
private theorem gaussRadicand_nonneg
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (gaussRadicand a b theta)
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (gaussRadicand_pos h)

name: gaussRadicand_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
statement:
private theorem gaussRadicand_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
    (a b : Point) :
    ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi)
      (gaussRadicand a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussRadicand
  change ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi)
      (AddFun
        (MulFun
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.mul a a)
          (MulFun landenCos landenCos))
        (MulFun
          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.mul b b)
          (MulFun landenSin landenSin)))
  exact continuousOn_add
    (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const
      (continuousOn_mul
        landen_cos_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
        landen_cos_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi))
    (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const
      (continuousOn_mul
        landen_sin_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
        landen_sin_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi))

name: gaussDen_pos
statement:
private theorem gaussDen_pos
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (gaussDen a b theta)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussDen
  change
    RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
        (gaussRadicand a b theta))
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos
    1 (gaussRadicand_pos h)

name: gaussDen_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem gaussDen_ne_zero
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    Not (gaussDen a b theta = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro hzero
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F (gaussDen_pos h)) hzero.symm

name: b_le_gaussDen
statement:
private theorem b_le_gaussDen
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le b (gaussDen a b theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbb_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul b b) :=
    F.mul_nonneg h.b_nonneg h.b_nonneg
  have hrad_nonneg : F.le F.zero (gaussRadicand a b theta) :=
    gaussRadicand_nonneg h
  have hbb_le_rad :
      F.le (F.mul b b) (gaussRadicand a b theta) :=
    gaussRadicand_ge_b_sq h
  have hroot_b :
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (F.mul b b) = b := by
    refine RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
      (n := 1) ?_
    refine And.intro h.b_nonneg ?_
    change RealFunction.powNat b (1 + 1) =
      RealTheory.mul b b
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
  have hmono :
      F.le
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (F.mul b b))
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
          (gaussRadicand a b theta)) := by
    have hmono_raw :=
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRootFun_monotoneOn_nonnegative_succ
        1 (F.mul b b) (gaussRadicand a b theta)
        hbb_nonneg hrad_nonneg hbb_le_rad
    unfold RealFunction.Elementary.NthRootFun at hmono_raw
    exact hmono_raw
  unfold gaussDen
  change
    F.le b
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
        (gaussRadicand a b theta))
  rwa [hroot_b] at hmono

name: gaussDen_le_a
statement:
private theorem gaussDen_le_a
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le (gaussDen a b theta) a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hrad_nonneg : F.le F.zero (gaussRadicand a b theta) :=
    gaussRadicand_nonneg h
  have hbound :
      RealTheory.le (gaussRadicand a b theta)
        (RealFunction.powNat a (1 + 1)) := by
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
    exact gaussRadicand_le_a_sq h
  unfold gaussDen
  change
    F.le
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
        (gaussRadicand a b theta))
      a
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_succ_le_of_powNat_bound
    (n := 1) hrad_nonneg h.a_nonneg hbound

name: gaussDen_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
statement:
private theorem gaussDen_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi)
      (gaussDen a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussDen
  change ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi)
      (CompFun
        (RealFunction.Elementary.NthRootFun 2)
        (gaussRadicand a b))
  have hroot :
      ContinuousOn RealFunction.Elementary.NonnegativeDomain
        (RealFunction.Elementary.NthRootFun 2) := by
    change ContinuousOn RealFunction.Elementary.NonnegativeDomain
      (RealFunction.Elementary.NthRootFun (1 + 1))
    exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRootFun_continuousOn_nonnegative_succ 1
  exact continuousOn_comp
    (gaussRadicand_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi a b)
    hroot
    (fun theta _ => gaussRadicand_nonneg (theta := theta) h)

name: gaussIntegrand_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem gaussIntegrand_lower_bound
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.inv a) (gaussIntegrand a b theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold gaussIntegrand
  change F.le (F.inv a) (F.inv (gaussDen a b theta))
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
    F (gaussDen_pos h) h.a_pos (gaussDen_le_a h)

name: gaussIntegrand_upper_bound
statement:
private theorem gaussIntegrand_upper_bound
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le (gaussIntegrand a b theta) (RealTheory.inv b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold gaussIntegrand
  change F.le (F.inv (gaussDen a b theta)) (F.inv b)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
    F h.left (gaussDen_pos h) (b_le_gaussDen h)

name: gaussIntegrand_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
statement:
private theorem gaussIntegrand_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi)
      (gaussIntegrand a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussIntegrand
  change ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi)
      (InvFun (gaussDen a b))
  exact continuousOn_inv
    (gaussDen_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi h)
    (fun theta _ => gaussDen_ne_zero (theta := theta) h)

name: orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_gaussIntegrand_zero_halfPi
statement:
private theorem orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_gaussIntegrand_zero_halfPi
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    OrientedRiemannIntegrableOn (gaussIntegrand a b)
      RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
proof:
:= by
  exact
    orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_upperEndpoint_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      (f := gaussIntegrand a b)
      (a := RealTheory.zero) (b := landenHalfPi) (x := landenHalfPi)
      (by
        change ContinuousOn
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi)
          (gaussIntegrand a b)
        exact gaussIntegrand_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_halfPi h)
      (And.intro landen_halfPi_nonneg
        (RealTheory.le_refl landenHalfPi))

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_gaussCompleteIntegralWith
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_gaussCompleteIntegralWith
    {a b : Point}
    (hI : OrientedRiemannIntegrableOn (gaussIntegrand a b)
      RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (gaussIntegrand a b)
      RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
      (gaussCompleteIntegralWith a b hI)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussCompleteIntegralWith
  exact
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf
      (f := gaussIntegrand a b)
      (a := RealTheory.zero) (b := landenHalfPi) hI

name: gaussCompleteIntegral_eq_with
statement:
private theorem gaussCompleteIntegral_eq_with
    {a b : Point}
    (hparam : GaussParameter a b)
    (hI : OrientedRiemannIntegrableOn (gaussIntegrand a b)

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_gaussCompleteIntegral
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_gaussCompleteIntegral
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (gaussIntegrand a b)
      RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
      (gaussCompleteIntegral a b)
proof:
:= by
  let hI := orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_gaussIntegrand_zero_halfPi h
  rw [gaussCompleteIntegral_eq_with h hI]

name: constIntegralValue_zero_halfPi_eq_left_mul
statement:
private theorem constIntegralValue_zero_halfPi_eq_left_mul
    (c : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub landenHalfPi RealTheory.zero) =
      RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi c
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.mul c (F.sub landenHalfPi F.zero) =
    F.mul landenHalfPi c
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F]
  rw [F.mul_comm]

name: gaussCompleteIntegral_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem gaussCompleteIntegral_lower_bound
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi (RealTheory.inv a))
      (gaussCompleteIntegral a b)
proof:
:= by
  let c := RealTheory.inv a
  have hconst :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (fun _ : Point => c)
        RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
        (RealTheory.mul c
          (RealTheory.sub landenHalfPi RealTheory.zero)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_const_of_le
      (c := c) landen_halfPi_nonneg
  have hgauss :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (gaussIntegrand a b)
        RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
        (gaussCompleteIntegral a b) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_gaussCompleteIntegral h
  have hconstData :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      landen_halfPi_nonneg hconst
  have hgaussData :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      landen_halfPi_nonneg hgauss
  have hraw :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul c
          (RealTheory.sub landenHalfPi RealTheory.zero))
        (gaussCompleteIntegral a b) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      landen_halfPi_nonneg
      (fun theta _htheta => by
        unfold c
        exact gaussIntegrand_lower_bound (theta := theta) h)
      hconstData.left hconstData.right
      hgaussData.left hgaussData.right
  have hvalue :
      RealTheory.mul c
          (RealTheory.sub landenHalfPi RealTheory.zero) =
        RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi c :=
    constIntegralValue_zero_halfPi_eq_left_mul c
  rw [hvalue] at hraw
  exact hraw

name: gaussCompleteIntegral_upper_bound
statement:
private theorem gaussCompleteIntegral_upper_bound
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le
      (gaussCompleteIntegral a b)
      (RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi (RealTheory.inv b))
proof:
:= by
  let c := RealTheory.inv b
  have hconst :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (fun _ : Point => c)
        RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
        (RealTheory.mul c
          (RealTheory.sub landenHalfPi RealTheory.zero)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_const_of_le
      (c := c) landen_halfPi_nonneg
  have hgauss :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (gaussIntegrand a b)
        RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
        (gaussCompleteIntegral a b) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_gaussCompleteIntegral h
  have hconstData :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      landen_halfPi_nonneg hconst
  have hgaussData :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      landen_halfPi_nonneg hgauss
  have hraw :
      RealTheory.le
        (gaussCompleteIntegral a b)
        (RealTheory.mul c
          (RealTheory.sub landenHalfPi RealTheory.zero)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
      landen_halfPi_nonneg
      (fun theta _htheta => by
        unfold c
        exact gaussIntegrand_upper_bound (theta := theta) h)
      hgaussData.left hgaussData.right
      hconstData.left hconstData.right
  have hvalue :
      RealTheory.mul c
          (RealTheory.sub landenHalfPi RealTheory.zero) =
        RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi c :=
    constIntegralValue_zero_halfPi_eq_left_mul c
  rw [hvalue] at hraw
  exact hraw

name: EllipticModulus.k_nonneg
statement:
private theorem EllipticModulus.k_nonneg
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :

:=

name: EllipticModulus.k_lt_one
statement:
private theorem EllipticModulus.k_lt_one
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    RealTheory.lt k RealTheory.one
proof:
:=
  h.right

name: EllipticModulus.k_sq_lt_one
statement:
private theorem EllipticModulus.k_sq_lt_one
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul k k) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hk_le_one : F.le k F.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F h.k_lt_one
  have hsq_le_k : F.le (F.mul k k) k := by
    have hmul :
        F.le (F.mul k k) (F.mul F.one k) :=
      F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hk_le_one h.k_nonneg
    rwa [F.one_mul] at hmul
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
    F hsq_le_k h.k_lt_one

name: ellipticComplement_radicand_pos
statement:
private theorem ellipticComplement_radicand_pos
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul k k))
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base h.k_sq_lt_one

name: ellipticComplement_pos
statement:
private theorem ellipticComplement_pos
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (ellipticComplement k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ellipticComplement
  change
    RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul k k)))
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos
    1 (ellipticComplement_radicand_pos h)

name: ellipticComplement_le_one
statement:
private theorem ellipticComplement_le_one
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    RealTheory.le (ellipticComplement k) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hrad_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.sub F.one (F.mul k k)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (ellipticComplement_radicand_pos h)
  have hk_sq_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul k k) :=
    landen_square_nonneg k
  have hrad_le_one :
      F.le (F.sub F.one (F.mul k k)) F.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic
      F hk_sq_nonneg
  unfold ellipticComplement
  change
    F.le
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
        (F.sub F.one (F.mul k k)))
      F.one
  have hbound :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul k k))
        (RealFunction.powNat RealTheory.one (1 + 1)) := by
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_one_base]
    exact hrad_le_one
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_succ_le_of_powNat_bound
    1 hrad_nonneg
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
    hbound

name: ellipticComplement_gaussParameter
statement:
private theorem ellipticComplement_gaussParameter
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    GaussParameter RealTheory.one (ellipticComplement k)
proof:
:=
  And.intro (ellipticComplement_pos h) (ellipticComplement_le_one h)

name: completeEllipticK_eq_gaussCompleteIntegral
statement:
private theorem completeEllipticK_eq_gaussCompleteIntegral

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_completeEllipticK
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_completeEllipticK
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (gaussIntegrand RealTheory.one (ellipticComplement k))
      RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
      (completeEllipticK k)
proof:

  rw [completeEllipticK_eq_gaussCompleteIntegral k]
  exact hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_gaussCompleteIntegral
    (ellipticComplement_gaussParameter h)

name: gaussArithmeticMean_pos
statement:
private theorem gaussArithmeticMean_pos
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (gaussArithmeticMean a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htwo_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat 2) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have hinv_two_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv (F.nat 2)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F htwo_pos
  unfold gaussArithmeticMean
  exact F.mul_pos h.a_add_b_pos hinv_two_pos

name: gaussArithmeticMean_nonneg
statement:
private theorem gaussArithmeticMean_nonneg
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (gaussArithmeticMean a b)
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (gaussArithmeticMean_pos h)

name: gaussGeometricMean_pos
statement:
private theorem gaussGeometricMean_pos
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (gaussGeometricMean a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.mul a b) :=
    F.mul_pos h.a_pos h.left
  unfold gaussGeometricMean
  change
    RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (F.mul a b))
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos
    (n := 1) hab_pos

name: gaussGeometricMean_le_arithmeticMean
statement:
private theorem gaussGeometricMean_le_arithmeticMean
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le (gaussGeometricMean a b)
      (gaussArithmeticMean a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let T := F.nat 2
  let TT := F.mul T T
  let A := F.add a b
  let q := F.sub a b
  let M := gaussArithmeticMean a b
  have hT_pos : F.lt F.zero T :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have hT_ne : Not (T = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have hTT_pos : F.lt F.zero TT := by
    unfold TT
    exact F.mul_pos hT_pos hT_pos
  have hTT_ne : Not (TT = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hTT_pos) hzero.symm
  have hinvTT_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv TT) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hTT_pos)
  have hq_sq_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul q q) := by
    unfold q
    exact landen_square_nonneg (F.sub a b)
  have hfour :
      F.sub (F.mul A A) (F.mul q q) =
        F.mul TT (F.mul a b) := by
    unfold A q TT T
    exact LandenInternal.sum_sq_sub_diff_sq_eq_four_mul_base F a b
  have hTTab_le_AA :
      F.le (F.mul TT (F.mul a b)) (F.mul A A) := by
    have hsub_le :
        F.le (F.sub (F.mul A A) (F.mul q q)) (F.mul A A) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic F hq_sq_nonneg
    rwa [hfour] at hsub_le
  have hab_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul a b) :=
    F.mul_nonneg h.a_nonneg h.b_nonneg
  have hleft_cancel :
      F.mul (F.mul TT (F.mul a b)) (F.inv TT) =
        F.mul a b := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul TT (F.mul a b)) (F.inv TT) =
          F.mul TT (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.inv TT)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul TT (F.inv TT)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc TT (F.mul a b) (F.inv TT)]
          rw [F.mul_comm TT (F.mul a b)]
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul a b) F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hTT_ne]
      _ = F.mul a b := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
  have hM_sq :
      F.mul M M = F.mul (F.mul A A) (F.inv TT) := by
    unfold M gaussArithmeticMean A TT T
    exact LandenInternal.square_mul_inv_eq_mul_inv_square_base
      F (F.add a b) (F.nat 2) hT_ne
  have hab_le_M_sq : F.le (F.mul a b) (F.mul M M) := by
    have hscaled :
        F.le
          (F.mul (F.mul TT (F.mul a b)) (F.inv TT))
          (F.mul (F.mul A A) (F.inv TT)) :=
      F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hTTab_le_AA hinvTT_nonneg
    rwa [hleft_cancel, <- hM_sq] at hscaled
  have hM_nonneg : F.le F.zero M := by
    unfold M
    exact gaussArithmeticMean_nonneg h
  have hbound :
      F.le (F.mul a b) (RealFunction.powNat M (1 + 1)) := by
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
    exact hab_le_M_sq
  unfold gaussGeometricMean
  change
    F.le
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (F.mul a b))
      M
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_succ_le_of_powNat_bound
    (n := 1) hab_nonneg hM_nonneg hbound

name: b_le_gaussGeometricMean
statement:
private theorem b_le_gaussGeometricMean
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le b (gaussGeometricMean a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbb_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul b b) :=
    F.mul_nonneg h.b_nonneg h.b_nonneg
  have hab_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul a b) :=
    F.mul_nonneg h.a_nonneg h.b_nonneg
  have hbb_le_ab : F.le (F.mul b b) (F.mul a b) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right h.right h.b_nonneg
  have hroot_b :
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (F.mul b b) = b := by
    refine RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
      (n := 1) ?_
    refine And.intro h.b_nonneg ?_
    change RealFunction.powNat b (1 + 1) =
      RealTheory.mul b b
    rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
  have hmono :
      F.le
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (F.mul b b))
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (F.mul a b)) := by
    have hmono_raw :=
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRootFun_monotoneOn_nonnegative_succ
        1 (F.mul b b) (F.mul a b)
        hbb_nonneg hab_nonneg hbb_le_ab
    unfold RealFunction.Elementary.NthRootFun at hmono_raw
    exact hmono_raw
  unfold gaussGeometricMean
  change
    F.le b
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (F.mul a b))
  rwa [hroot_b] at hmono

name: gaussArithmeticMean_le_a
statement:
private theorem gaussArithmeticMean_le_a
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.le (gaussArithmeticMean a b) a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let T := F.nat 2
  have hT_pos : F.lt F.zero T :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have hT_ne : Not (T = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have hinvT_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv T) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hT_pos)
  have hsum : F.le (F.add a b) (F.add a a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F h.right a
  have hscaled :
      F.le
        (F.mul (F.add a b) (F.inv T))
        (F.mul (F.add a a) (F.inv T)) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hsum hinvT_nonneg
  have hright :
      F.mul (F.add a a) (F.inv T) = a := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.add a a) (F.inv T) =
          F.mul (F.mul T a) (F.inv T) := by
          rw [<- LandenInternal.nat_two_mul_eq_add_self_base F a]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul a T) (F.inv T) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm T a]
      _ = a := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right F a hT_ne
  unfold gaussArithmeticMean
  change F.le (F.mul (F.add a b) (F.inv T)) a
  rwa [hright] at hscaled

name: gaussMean_oneStepBounds
statement:
theorem gaussMean_oneStepBounds
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    And (RealTheory.le b (gaussGeometricMean a b))

        (RealTheory.le (gaussArithmeticMean a b) a))
proof:

name: gaussDen_sq_eq_gaussRadicand
statement:
private theorem gaussDen_sq_eq_gaussRadicand
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.mul (gaussDen a b theta) (gaussDen a b theta) =
      gaussRadicand a b theta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hrad_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (gaussRadicand a b theta) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (gaussRadicand_pos h)
  unfold gaussDen
  change
    F.mul
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
          (gaussRadicand a b theta))
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
          (gaussRadicand a b theta)) =
      gaussRadicand a b theta
  have hpow :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg
      (n := 1) (x := gaussRadicand a b theta) hrad_nonneg
  rwa [RealFunction.powNat_two] at hpow

name: gaussRadicand_mul_left_base
statement:
private theorem gaussRadicand_mul_left_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (c a b co s : Point) :
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul c a) (F.mul c a))
          (F.mul co co))
        (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul c b) (F.mul c b))
          (F.mul s s)) =
      F.mul (F.mul c c)
        (F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul co co))
          (F.mul (F.mul b b) (F.mul s s)))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul c a) (F.mul c a))
          (F.mul co co))
        (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul c b) (F.mul c b))
          (F.mul s s)) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul a a))
            (F.mul co co))
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul b b))
            (F.mul s s)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_mul_comm F c a c a]
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_mul_comm F c b c b]
    _ =
        F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul c c)
            (F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul co co)))
          (F.mul (F.mul c c)
            (F.mul (F.mul b b) (F.mul s s))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc (F.mul c c) (F.mul a a) (F.mul co co)]
          rw [F.mul_assoc (F.mul c c) (F.mul b b) (F.mul s s)]
    _ =
      F.mul (F.mul c c)
        (F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul co co))
          (F.mul (F.mul b b) (F.mul s s))) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_add]

name: gaussRadicand_mul_left
statement:
private theorem gaussRadicand_mul_left
    (c a b theta : Point) :
    gaussRadicand (RealTheory.mul c a) (RealTheory.mul c b) theta =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul c c)
        (gaussRadicand a b theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold gaussRadicand
  change
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul c a) (F.mul c a))
          (F.mul (landenCos theta) (landenCos theta)))
        (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul c b) (F.mul c b))
          (F.mul (landenSin theta) (landenSin theta))) =
      F.mul (F.mul c c)
        (F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul a a)
            (F.mul (landenCos theta) (landenCos theta)))
          (F.mul (F.mul b b)
            (F.mul (landenSin theta) (landenSin theta))))
  exact gaussRadicand_mul_left_base F c a b
    (landenCos theta) (landenSin theta)

name: gaussDen_mul_left
statement:
private theorem gaussDen_mul_left
    {c a b theta : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c)
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    gaussDen (RealTheory.mul c a) (RealTheory.mul c b) theta =
      RealTheory.mul c (gaussDen a b theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := gaussDen a b theta
  have hc_nonneg : F.le F.zero c :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hc
  have hd_pos : F.lt F.zero d := by
    unfold d
    exact gaussDen_pos h
  have hd_nonneg : F.le F.zero d :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hd_pos
  have hcandidate_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul c d) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hc_nonneg hd_nonneg
  have hden_sq :
      F.mul d d = gaussRadicand a b theta := by
    unfold d
    exact gaussDen_sq_eq_gaussRadicand h
  have hcandidate_sq :
      F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.mul c d) =
        gaussRadicand (F.mul c a) (F.mul c b) theta := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.mul c d) =
          F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul d d) := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_mul_comm F c d c d
      _ = F.mul (F.mul c c) (gaussRadicand a b theta) := by
          rw [hden_sq]
      _ = gaussRadicand (F.mul c a) (F.mul c b) theta := by
          exact (gaussRadicand_mul_left c a b theta).symm
  unfold gaussDen
  change
    RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
        (gaussRadicand (F.mul c a) (F.mul c b) theta) =
      F.mul c d
  refine RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
    (n := 1) ?_
  refine And.intro hcandidate_nonneg ?_
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
  exact hcandidate_sq

name: gaussIntegrand_mul_left
statement:
private theorem gaussIntegrand_mul_left
    {c a b theta : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c)
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    gaussIntegrand (RealTheory.mul c a) (RealTheory.mul c b) theta =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) (gaussIntegrand a b theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hc_ne : Not (c = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hc) hzero.symm
  have hd_ne : Not (gaussDen a b theta = F.zero) :=
    gaussDen_ne_zero h
  unfold gaussIntegrand
  rw [gaussDen_mul_left (theta := theta) hc h]
  calc
    F.inv (F.mul c (gaussDen a b theta)) =
        F.mul (F.inv (gaussDen a b theta)) (F.inv c) := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hc_ne hd_ne
    _ = F.mul (F.inv c) (F.inv (gaussDen a b theta)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm]

name: gaussCompleteIntegral_mul_left
statement:
private theorem gaussCompleteIntegral_mul_left
    {c a b : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c)
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    gaussCompleteIntegral (RealTheory.mul c a) (RealTheory.mul c b) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) (gaussCompleteIntegral a b)
proof:
:= by
  let hscaled_param := gaussParameter_mul_left hc h
  have horig :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (gaussIntegrand a b)
        RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
        (gaussCompleteIntegral a b) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_gaussCompleteIntegral h
  have hraw :
      HasRiemannIntegral (gaussIntegrand a b)
        RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
        (gaussCompleteIntegral a b) :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_of_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_le
      landen_halfPi_nonneg horig
  have hbdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded (gaussIntegrand a b)
        RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi :=
    taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
      (Exists.intro (gaussCompleteIntegral a b) hraw)
  have hdarboux :
      HasDarbouxIntegral (gaussIntegrand a b)
        RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
        (gaussCompleteIntegral a b) :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral landen_halfPi_nonneg hraw
  have hmul :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun theta : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) (gaussIntegrand a b theta))
        RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) (gaussCompleteIntegral a b)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_left_of_le
      (RealTheory.inv c) landen_halfPi_nonneg hbdd hdarboux
  have hscaled :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (gaussIntegrand (RealTheory.mul c a) (RealTheory.mul c b))
        RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) (gaussCompleteIntegral a b)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
      landen_halfPi_nonneg
      (fun theta _htheta =>
        (gaussIntegrand_mul_left (theta := theta) hc h).symm)
      hmul
  exact
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
      (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_gaussCompleteIntegral hscaled_param)
      hscaled
