name: newman_value_glue
statement:
private theorem newman_value_glue
    {f : Point -> Point} {s I K J : Point}
    (h0s : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero s)
    (hfull : HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf f RealTheory.zero I)
    (hlow : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f RealTheory.zero s K)
    (hinverse :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.neg (f x)) s
        (RealTheory.neg K))
    (hhigh :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) (f x)) s J) :
    I = J
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let T := F.sub I K
  have htail : HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf f s T := by
    unfold T
    exact hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_tail_of_initialSegment
      h0s hfull hlow
  have hnegRaw :=
    hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_mul_left
      (c := F.neg F.one) htail
  have hnegValue : F.mul (F.neg F.one) T = F.neg T :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_one_mul_eq_neg F T
  change HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
    (MulFun (fun _ : Point => F.neg F.one) f) s
    (F.mul (F.neg F.one) T) at hnegRaw
  rw [hnegValue] at hnegRaw
  have hnegTail :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
        (fun x : Point => F.neg (f x)) s (F.neg T) := by
    apply hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_congr
      (g := fun x : Point => F.neg (f x))
      (fun x => ?_) hnegRaw
    unfold MulFun
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_one_mul_eq_neg F (f x)
  have hnegEq : F.neg K = F.neg T :=
    hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_unique
      (ImproperInternal.rightHalfLine_unboundedAbove s)
      hinverse hnegTail
  have hKT : K = T := by
    have h := congrArg F.neg hnegEq
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F,
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F] at h
  have htwoTail :=
    hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_mul_left
      (c := F.nat 2) htail
  have hhighEq : J = F.mul (F.nat 2) T :=
    hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_unique
      (ImproperInternal.rightHalfLine_unboundedAbove s)
      hhigh htwoTail
  have hjoin :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf f RealTheory.zero
        (F.add K T) :=
    hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_join_initialSegment
      h0s hlow htail
  have hfullEq : I = F.add K T :=
    hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_unique
      (ImproperInternal.rightHalfLine_unboundedAbove RealTheory.zero)
      hfull hjoin
  calc
    I = F.add K T := hfullEq
    _ = F.add T T := by rw [hKT]
    _ = F.mul (F.nat 2) T :=
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_two_mul_eq_add_self F T).symm
    _ = J := hhighEq.symm

name: lineKernel_landen_invariant
statement:
private theorem lineKernel_landen_invariant
    {a b I J : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (hI : HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
      (lineKernel a b) RealTheory.zero I)
    (hJ : HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
      (lineKernel (gaussArithmeticMean a b) (gaussGeometricMean a b))
      RealTheory.zero J) :
    I = J
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let G := gaussGeometricMean a b
  have hmean : GaussParameter (gaussArithmeticMean a b) G := by
    unfold G
    exact landenParameter h
  have hzeroG : F.le F.zero G :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hmean.left
  have hlowExists :
      Exists (fun K : Point =>
        HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (lineKernel a b) F.zero G K) := by
    cases hI with
    | intro P hP =>
        exact Exists.intro (P G) (hP.left G hzeroG)
  cases hlowExists with
  | intro K hlow =>
      have hleftEndpoint :
          HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint
            (lineKernel a b) F.zero G K :=
        hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_of_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral
          hzeroG hlow
      have hinverse :
          HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
            (fun x : Point => F.neg (lineKernel a b x)) G (F.neg K) := by
        unfold G at hleftEndpoint ⊢
        exact
          hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_neg_lineKernel_of_leftEndpoint
            h hleftEndpoint
      have hhigh :
          HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
            (fun x : Point => F.mul (F.nat 2) (lineKernel a b x))
            G J := by
        unfold G
        exact hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_lineKernel_high_pullback h hJ
      exact newman_value_glue hzeroG hI hlow hinverse hhigh

name: gaussIntegralValue_landen_invariant
statement:
private theorem gaussIntegralValue_landen_invariant
    {a b I J : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (gaussIntegrand a b)
      RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi I)
    (hJ : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
      (gaussIntegrand (gaussArithmeticMean a b) (gaussGeometricMean a b))
      RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi J) :
    I = J
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have ha : F.lt F.zero a :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F h.left h.right
  have hmean := landenParameter h
  have hmeanA : F.lt F.zero (gaussArithmeticMean a b) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hmean.left hmean.right
  cases exists_hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_lineKernel_zero ha h.left with
  | intro lineI hlineI =>
      cases exists_hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_lineKernel_zero
          hmeanA hmean.left with
      | intro lineJ hlineJ =>
          have hlineEq : lineI = lineJ :=
            lineKernel_landen_invariant h hlineI hlineJ
          have hbridgeI :=
            lineKernel_hasImproperRightEndpoint_gaussIntegrand h hlineI
          have hbridgeJ :=
            lineKernel_hasImproperRightEndpoint_gaussIntegrand hmean hlineJ
          have hproperI :=
            hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_of_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral
              halfPi_nonneg hI
          have hproperJ :=
            hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_of_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral
              halfPi_nonneg hJ
          have hcluster :=
            ImproperInternal.rightHalfOpenInterval_leftClusterPoint_endpoint
              halfPi_pos
          have hIeq : I = lineI :=
            hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_unique
              hcluster hproperI hbridgeI
          have hJeq : J = lineJ :=
            hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_unique
              hcluster hproperJ hbridgeJ
          exact hIeq.trans (hlineEq.trans hJeq.symm)

name: completeIntegral_landen_invariant
statement:
theorem completeIntegral_landen_invariant
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    completeIntegral a b =
      completeIntegral (gaussArithmeticMean a b)
        (gaussGeometricMean a b)
proof:
:= by
  exact gaussIntegralValue_landen_invariant h
    (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_completeIntegral h)
    (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_completeIntegral (landenParameter h))

name: one_sub_fraction_sq_eq_sub_sq_mul_inv_base
statement:
private theorem one_sub_fraction_sq_eq_sub_sq_mul_inv_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {n d : Point}
    (hd : Not (d = F.zero)) :
    F.sub F.one
        (F.mul (F.mul n (F.inv d)) (F.mul n (F.inv d))) =
      F.mul
        (F.sub (F.mul d d) (F.mul n n))
        (F.inv (F.mul d d))
proof:
:= by
  let dd := F.mul d d
  let nn := F.mul n n
  have hdd : Not (dd = F.zero) := by
    unfold dd
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F hd hd
  calc
    F.sub F.one
        (F.mul (F.mul n (F.inv d)) (F.mul n (F.inv d))) =
        F.sub F.one (F.mul nn (F.inv dd)) := by
          unfold nn dd
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.square_mul_inv_eq_mul_inv_square F n d hd]
    _ = F.sub (F.mul dd (F.inv dd)) (F.mul nn (F.inv dd)) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hdd]
    _ = F.mul (F.sub dd nn) (F.inv dd) := by
          rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
            F dd nn (F.inv dd)]

name: ellipticLandenDen_pos
statement:
private theorem ellipticLandenDen_pos
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (ellipticComplement k))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hstep := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
    F (LandenInternal.ellipticComplement_pos_internal h) F.one
  change F.lt (F.add F.one F.zero)
    (F.add F.one (ellipticComplement k)) at hstep
  rw [F.add_zero] at hstep
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
    (RealTheory.zero_lt_one) hstep

name: ellipticLandenScale_pos
statement:
private theorem ellipticLandenScale_pos
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (ellipticLandenScale k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htwo_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.nat 2) :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have hinv_two_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv (F.nat 2)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F htwo_pos
  unfold ellipticLandenScale
  exact F.mul_pos (ellipticLandenDen_pos h) hinv_two_pos

name: ellipticLandenDen_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem ellipticLandenDen_ne_zero
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    Not (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (ellipticComplement k) =
      RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro hzero
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F
    (ellipticLandenDen_pos h)) hzero.symm

name: ellipticLandenModulus_nonneg
statement:
private theorem ellipticLandenModulus_nonneg
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (ellipticLandenModulus k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnum_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.sub F.one (ellipticComplement k)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F
      (LandenInternal.ellipticComplement_le_one_internal h)
  have hinv_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero
        (F.inv (F.add F.one (ellipticComplement k))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (ellipticLandenDen_pos h))
  unfold ellipticLandenModulus
  exact F.mul_nonneg hnum_nonneg hinv_nonneg

name: ellipticLandenModulus_lt_one
statement:
private theorem ellipticLandenModulus_lt_one
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    RealTheory.lt (ellipticLandenModulus k) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let kp := ellipticComplement k
  let den := F.add F.one kp
  have hsub_lt_one : F.lt (F.sub F.one kp) F.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F
      (LandenInternal.ellipticComplement_pos_internal h)
  have hone_lt_den : F.lt F.one den := by
    unfold den kp
    have hstep := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
      F (LandenInternal.ellipticComplement_pos_internal h) F.one
    change F.lt (F.add F.one F.zero)
      (F.add F.one (ellipticComplement k)) at hstep
    rwa [F.add_zero] at hstep
  have hnum_lt_den : F.lt (F.sub F.one kp) den :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hsub_lt_one hone_lt_den
  have hinv_den_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv den) := by
    unfold den kp
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (ellipticLandenDen_pos h)
  have hlt :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (F.sub F.one kp) (F.inv den))
        (F.mul den (F.inv den)) :=
    F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hnum_lt_den hinv_den_pos
  have hden_ne : Not (den = F.zero) := by
    unfold den kp
    exact ellipticLandenDen_ne_zero h
  have hden_cancel : F.mul den (F.inv den) = F.one :=
    F.mul_inv_cancel hden_ne
  unfold ellipticLandenModulus
  change F.lt (F.mul (F.sub F.one kp) (F.inv den)) F.one
  rwa [hden_cancel] at hlt

name: ellipticLandenModulus_ellipticModulus
statement:
private theorem ellipticLandenModulus_ellipticModulus
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    EllipticModulus (ellipticLandenModulus k)
proof:
:=
  And.intro (ellipticLandenModulus_nonneg h)
    (ellipticLandenModulus_lt_one h)

name: ellipticComplement_sqrt_sq_eq_complement
statement:
private theorem ellipticComplement_sqrt_sq_eq_complement
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 (ellipticComplement k))
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 (ellipticComplement k)) =
      ellipticComplement k
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hkp_nonneg : F.le F.zero (ellipticComplement k) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (LandenInternal.ellipticComplement_pos_internal h)
  change
    F.mul
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
          (ellipticComplement k))
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
          (ellipticComplement k)) =
      ellipticComplement k
  have hpow :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg
      (n := 1) (x := ellipticComplement k) hkp_nonneg
  rwa [RealFunction.powNat_two] at hpow

name: ellipticComplement_landenModulus
statement:
private theorem ellipticComplement_landenModulus
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    ellipticComplement (ellipticLandenModulus k) =
      ellipticLandenComplementTarget k
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let T := F.nat 2
  let kp := ellipticComplement k
  let den := F.add F.one kp
  let num := F.sub F.one kp
  let root := RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 kp
  have hT_pos : F.lt F.zero T :=
    RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have hden_pos : F.lt F.zero den := by
    unfold den kp
    exact ellipticLandenDen_pos h
  have hden_ne : Not (den = F.zero) := by
    unfold den kp
    exact ellipticLandenDen_ne_zero h
  have hinvden_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv den) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos
  have hroot_pos : F.lt F.zero root := by
    unfold root kp
    change
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
          (ellipticComplement k))
    exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos
      1 (LandenInternal.ellipticComplement_pos_internal h)
  have htarget_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.mul T root) (F.inv den)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (F.mul_pos (F.mul_pos hT_pos hroot_pos) hinvden_pos)
  have hroot_sq : F.mul root root = kp := by
    unfold root kp
    exact ellipticComplement_sqrt_sq_eq_complement h
  have hfour :
      F.sub (F.mul den den) (F.mul num num) =
        F.mul (F.mul T T) kp := by
    unfold den num T
    have hraw :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sum_sq_sub_diff_sq_eq_four_mul F F.one kp
    change
      F.sub
          (F.mul (F.add F.one kp) (F.add F.one kp))
          (F.mul (F.sub F.one kp) (F.sub F.one kp)) =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat 2))
          (F.mul F.one kp) at hraw
    rwa [F.one_mul] at hraw
  have htarget_sq :
      F.mul (F.mul (F.mul T root) (F.inv den))
          (F.mul (F.mul T root) (F.inv den)) =
        F.sub F.one
          (F.mul (F.mul num (F.inv den))
            (F.mul num (F.inv den))) := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul (F.mul T root) (F.inv den))
          (F.mul (F.mul T root) (F.inv den)) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.mul T root) (F.mul T root))
            (F.inv (F.mul den den)) := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.square_mul_inv_eq_mul_inv_square
            F (F.mul T root) den hden_ne
      _ =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.mul T T) (F.mul root root))
            (F.inv (F.mul den den)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_mul_comm F T root T root]
      _ =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.mul T T) kp)
            (F.inv (F.mul den den)) := by
          rw [hroot_sq]
      _ =
          F.mul (F.sub (F.mul den den) (F.mul num num))
            (F.inv (F.mul den den)) := by
          rw [hfour]
      _ =
          F.sub F.one
            (F.mul (F.mul num (F.inv den))
              (F.mul num (F.inv den))) := by
          exact (one_sub_fraction_sq_eq_sub_sq_mul_inv_base F hden_ne).symm
  unfold ellipticComplement ellipticLandenComplementTarget
    ellipticLandenModulus
  change
    RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
        (F.sub F.one
          (F.mul (F.mul num (F.inv den))
            (F.mul num (F.inv den)))) =
      F.mul (F.mul T root) (F.inv den)
  refine RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
    (n := 1) ?_
  refine And.intro htarget_nonneg ?_
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
  exact htarget_sq

name: ellipticLandenScale_mul_one
statement:
private theorem ellipticLandenScale_mul_one
    (k : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (ellipticLandenScale k) RealTheory.one =
      ellipticLandenScale k
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  exact F.mul_one (ellipticLandenScale k)

name: ellipticLandenScale_mul_complementTarget
statement:
private theorem ellipticLandenScale_mul_complementTarget
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    RealTheory.mul (ellipticLandenScale k)
        (ellipticLandenComplementTarget k) =
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 (ellipticComplement k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let T := F.nat 2
  let kp := ellipticComplement k
  let den := F.add F.one kp
  let root := RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 kp
  have hT_ne : Not (T = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have hden_ne : Not (den = F.zero) := by
    unfold den kp
    exact ellipticLandenDen_ne_zero h
  unfold ellipticLandenScale ellipticLandenComplementTarget
  change
    F.mul (F.mul den (F.inv T))
        (F.mul (F.mul T root) (F.inv den)) =
      root
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul den (F.inv T))
        (F.mul (F.mul T root) (F.inv den)) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (F.mul den (F.inv T)) (F.mul T root))
          (F.inv den) := by
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul den (F.mul (F.inv T) (F.mul T root)))
          (F.inv den) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc den (F.inv T) (F.mul T root)]
    _ =
        F.mul
          (F.mul den (F.mul (F.mul (F.inv T) T) root))
          (F.inv den) := by
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc (F.inv T) T root]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.mul den (F.mul F.one root)) (F.inv den) := by
        rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hT_ne]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul den root) (F.inv den) := by
        rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul root den) (F.inv den) := by
        rw [F.mul_comm den root]
    _ = root := by
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right
          F root hden_ne

name: ellipticLandenScale_inv
statement:
private theorem ellipticLandenScale_inv
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    RealTheory.inv (ellipticLandenScale k) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (ellipticComplement k)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let T := F.nat 2
  let den := F.add F.one (ellipticComplement k)
  have hT_ne : Not (T = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have hden_ne : Not (den = F.zero) := by
    unfold den
    exact ellipticLandenDen_ne_zero h
  unfold ellipticLandenScale
  change F.inv (F.mul den (F.inv T)) = F.mul T (F.inv den)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul_inv_right F hden_ne hT_ne

name: gaussArithmeticMean_one_ellipticComplement
statement:
private theorem gaussArithmeticMean_one_ellipticComplement
    (k : Point) :
    gaussArithmeticMean RealTheory.one (ellipticComplement k) =
      ellipticLandenScale k
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: gaussGeometricMean_one_ellipticComplement
statement:
private theorem gaussGeometricMean_one_ellipticComplement
    (k : Point) :
    gaussGeometricMean RealTheory.one (ellipticComplement k) =
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 (ellipticComplement k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold gaussGeometricMean
  change
    RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2
        (F.mul F.one (ellipticComplement k)) =
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 (ellipticComplement k)
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: completeEllipticK_landen
statement:
theorem completeEllipticK_landen
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    completeEllipticK k =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
          (RealTheory.inv
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (ellipticComplement k))))
        (completeEllipticK (ellipticLandenModulus k))
proof:
:= by
  let kp := ellipticComplement k
  let scale := ellipticLandenScale k
  let root := RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 kp
  let k1 := ellipticLandenModulus k
  let factor :=
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2)
      (RealTheory.inv
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (ellipticComplement k)))
  have hparam : GaussParameter RealTheory.one kp := by
    unfold kp
    exact LandenInternal.ellipticComplement_gaussParameter_internal h
  have hmean :
      LandenInternal.completeIntegral RealTheory.one kp =
        LandenInternal.completeIntegral
          (gaussArithmeticMean RealTheory.one kp)
          (gaussGeometricMean RealTheory.one kp) :=
    LandenInternal.completeIntegral_landen_invariant hparam
  have hK_to_mean :
      completeEllipticK k =
        LandenInternal.completeIntegral scale root := by
    calc
      completeEllipticK k =
          LandenInternal.completeIntegral RealTheory.one kp := by
          unfold kp
          exact LandenInternal.completeEllipticK_eq_completeIntegral k
      _ =
          LandenInternal.completeIntegral
            (gaussArithmeticMean RealTheory.one kp)
            (gaussGeometricMean RealTheory.one kp) := hmean
      _ = LandenInternal.completeIntegral scale root := by
          unfold scale root kp
          rw [gaussArithmeticMean_one_ellipticComplement]
          rw [gaussGeometricMean_one_ellipticComplement]
  have htarget_param :
      GaussParameter RealTheory.one (ellipticComplement k1) := by
    unfold k1
    exact LandenInternal.ellipticComplement_gaussParameter_internal
      (ellipticLandenModulus_ellipticModulus h)
  have hscale_raw :
      LandenInternal.completeIntegral
          (RealTheory.mul scale RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.mul scale (ellipticComplement k1)) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv scale)
          (LandenInternal.completeIntegral RealTheory.one
            (ellipticComplement k1)) := by
    unfold scale
    exact LandenInternal.completeIntegral_mul_left
      (c := ellipticLandenScale k)
      (a := RealTheory.one)
      (b := ellipticComplement k1)
      (ellipticLandenScale_pos h)
      htarget_param
  have hleft_eq :
      LandenInternal.completeIntegral
          (RealTheory.mul scale RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.mul scale (ellipticComplement k1)) =
        LandenInternal.completeIntegral scale root := by
    unfold scale root k1
    rw [ellipticLandenScale_mul_one k]
    rw [ellipticComplement_landenModulus h]
    rw [ellipticLandenScale_mul_complementTarget h]
  have hright_eq :
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv scale)
          (LandenInternal.completeIntegral RealTheory.one
            (ellipticComplement k1)) =
        RealTheory.mul factor (completeEllipticK k1) := by
    unfold scale factor k1
    rw [ellipticLandenScale_inv h]
    rw [<- LandenInternal.completeEllipticK_eq_completeIntegral
      (ellipticLandenModulus k)]
  have hscaled :
      LandenInternal.completeIntegral scale root =
        RealTheory.mul factor (completeEllipticK k1) := by
    calc
      LandenInternal.completeIntegral scale root =
          LandenInternal.completeIntegral
            (RealTheory.mul scale RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.mul scale (ellipticComplement k1)) := hleft_eq.symm
      _ =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv scale)
            (LandenInternal.completeIntegral RealTheory.one
              (ellipticComplement k1)) := hscale_raw
      _ = RealTheory.mul factor (completeEllipticK k1) := hright_eq
  calc
    completeEllipticK k =
        LandenInternal.completeIntegral scale root := hK_to_mean
    _ = RealTheory.mul factor (completeEllipticK k1) := hscaled

name: gaussIntegrand_eq_landenLineGaussRadicand
statement:
private theorem gaussIntegrand_eq_landenLineGaussRadicand
    (a b theta : Point) :
    gaussIntegrand a b theta =
      RealTheory.inv
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2
          (landenLineGaussRadicand a b theta))
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussIntegrand landenLineGaussRadicand
  rfl

name: landenLine_mul_left_comm
statement:
private theorem landenLine_mul_left_comm
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c : Point) :
    F.mul a (F.mul b c) = F.mul b (F.mul a c)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul a (F.mul b c) = F.mul (F.mul a b) c := by
      rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul b a) c := by rw [F.mul_comm a b]
    _ = F.mul b (F.mul a c) := F.mul_assoc b a c

name: landenLine_mul_mul_pair
statement:
private theorem landenLine_mul_mul_pair
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
      F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
        F.mul a (F.mul b (F.mul c d)) := by rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul c (F.mul b d)) := by
      rw [landenLine_mul_left_comm F b c d]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d) := by
      rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: landenLine_square_nonneg
statement:
private theorem landenLine_square_nonneg (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl hx => exact F.mul_nonneg hx hx
  | inr hx =>
      have hneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx
      have hsquare : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) :=
        F.mul_nonneg hneg hneg
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x x] at hsquare

name: landenLinePhi_mul_cos
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhi_mul_cos
    {b theta : Point}
    (hcos : Not (landenLineSpec.cos theta = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhi b theta)
        (landenLineSpec.cos theta) =
      RealTheory.mul b (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold landenLinePhi tan
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul b
          (F.mul (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
            (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta))))
        (landenLineSpec.cos theta) =
      F.mul b (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul b
          (F.mul (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
            (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta))))
        (landenLineSpec.cos theta) =
      F.mul b
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
            (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta)))
          (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul b
        (F.mul (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
          (F.mul (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
            (landenLineSpec.cos theta))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul b
        (F.mul (landenLineSpec.sin theta) F.one) := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hcos]
    _ = F.mul b (landenLineSpec.sin theta) := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: landenLinePhi_square_mul_cos_square
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhi_square_mul_cos_square
    {b theta : Point}
    (hcos : Not (landenLineSpec.cos theta = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhi b theta)
          (landenLinePhi b theta))
        (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
          (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul b b)
        (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
          (landenLineSpec.sin theta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (landenLinePhi b theta) (landenLinePhi b theta))
        (F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
          (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (landenLinePhi b theta) (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
        (F.mul (landenLinePhi b theta)
          (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) :=
            landenLine_mul_mul_pair F
              (landenLinePhi b theta) (landenLinePhi b theta)
              (landenLineSpec.cos theta) (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
    _ = F.mul
        (F.mul b (landenLineSpec.sin theta))
        (F.mul b (landenLineSpec.sin theta)) := by
          have hphiCos :
              F.mul (landenLinePhi b theta)
                  (landenLineSpec.cos theta) =
                F.mul b (landenLineSpec.sin theta) := by
            change
              RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhi b theta)
                  (landenLineSpec.cos theta) =
                RealTheory.mul b (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
            exact landenLinePhi_mul_cos hcos
          rw [hphiCos]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul b b)
        (F.mul (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
          (landenLineSpec.sin theta)) :=
            landenLine_mul_mul_pair F b
              (landenLineSpec.sin theta) b
              (landenLineSpec.sin theta)

name: landenLinePhiDeriv_mul_cos_square
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhiDeriv_mul_cos_square
    {b theta : Point}
    (hcos : Not (landenLineSpec.cos theta = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
        (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
          (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) = b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold landenLinePhiDeriv
  change
    F.mul
        (F.mul b
          (F.mul (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
            (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta))))
        (F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
          (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) = b
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul b
          (F.mul (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
            (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta))))
        (F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
          (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) =
      F.mul b
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
            (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta)))
          (F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
            (landenLineSpec.cos theta))) := by
              rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul b
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
            (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
          (F.mul (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
            (landenLineSpec.cos theta))) := by
              rw [landenLine_mul_mul_pair]
    _ = F.mul b (F.mul F.one F.one) := by
              rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hcos]
    _ = b := by rw [F.one_mul, F.mul_one]

name: landenLinePhiDeriv_square_mul_cos_fourth
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhiDeriv_square_mul_cos_fourth
    {b theta : Point}
    (hcos : Not (landenLineSpec.cos theta = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
          (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
            (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
          (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
            (landenLineSpec.cos theta))) =
      RealTheory.mul b b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
          (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta))
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
            (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
          (F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
            (landenLineSpec.cos theta))) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
          (F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
            (landenLineSpec.cos theta)))
        (F.mul (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
          (F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
            (landenLineSpec.cos theta))) :=
              landenLine_mul_mul_pair F
                (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
                (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
                (F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
                  (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
                (F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
                  (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
    _ = F.mul b b := by
          have hderivCosSq :
              F.mul (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
                  (F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
                    (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) = b := by
            change
              RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
                  (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
                    (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) = b
            exact landenLinePhiDeriv_mul_cos_square hcos
          rw [hderivCosSq]

name: landenLinePhi_zero
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhi_zero (b : Point) :
    landenLinePhi b RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold landenLinePhi tan
  change F.mul b
    (F.mul (landenLineSpec.sin F.zero)
      (F.inv (landenLineSpec.cos F.zero))) = F.zero
  have hsinZero : landenLineSpec.sin F.zero = F.zero := by
    change landenLineSpec.sin RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
    exact sin_zero landenLineSpec
  rw [hsinZero, F.zero_mul, F.mul_zero]

name: landenLine_cos_pos_of_mem_closedInterval
statement:
private theorem landenLine_cos_pos_of_mem_closedInterval
    {t theta : Point}
    (ht : RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi t)
    (htheta : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero t theta) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnegHalf_lt_zero : F.lt (F.neg landenHalfPi) F.zero := by
    have hneg := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F
      (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi_pos landenLineSpec)
    change F.lt (F.neg landenHalfPi) (F.neg F.zero) at hneg
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at hneg
  have hleft : F.lt (F.neg landenHalfPi) theta :=
    F.lt_of_lt_of_le hnegHalf_lt_zero htheta.left
  have hright : F.lt theta landenHalfPi :=
    F.lt_of_le_of_lt htheta.right ht.right
  exact RealDerivative.Trigonometric.cos_pos_openInterval_neg_halfPi_halfPi
    landenLineSpec (And.intro hleft hright)

name: landenLine_cos_pos_of_mem_rightHalfOpen
statement:
private theorem landenLine_cos_pos_of_mem_rightHalfOpen
    {theta : Point}
    (htheta :
      RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi theta) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
proof:
:= by
  apply landenLine_cos_pos_of_mem_closedInterval
    (t := theta) htheta
  exact And.intro htheta.left
    (RealTheory.le_refl theta)

name: landenLine_first_factor_mul_cos_square
statement:
private theorem landenLine_first_factor_mul_cos_square
    {a b theta : Point}
    (hcos : Not (landenLineSpec.cos theta = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhi b theta)
            (landenLinePhi b theta))
          (RealTheory.mul a a))
        (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
          (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) =
      landenLineGaussRadicand a b theta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let x := landenLinePhi b theta
  let c := landenLineSpec.cos theta
  let s := landenLineSpec.sin theta
  let c2 := F.mul c c
  let s2 := F.mul s s
  let a2 := F.mul a a
  let b2 := F.mul b b
  have hx2c2 : F.mul (F.mul x x) c2 = F.mul b2 s2 := by
    simpa only [x, c2, b2, s2, s, c] using
      (landenLinePhi_square_mul_cos_square (b := b) (theta := theta) hcos)
  change F.mul (F.add (F.mul x x) a2) c2 =
    F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2)
  calc
    F.mul (F.add (F.mul x x) a2) c2 =
        F.add (F.mul (F.mul x x) c2) (F.mul a2 c2) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.add (F.mul b2 s2) (F.mul a2 c2) := by
          rw [hx2c2]
    _ = F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2) :=
          F.add_comm (F.mul b2 s2) (F.mul a2 c2)

name: landenLine_second_factor_mul_cos_square
statement:
private theorem landenLine_second_factor_mul_cos_square
    {b theta : Point}
    (hcos : Not (landenLineSpec.cos theta = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhi b theta)
            (landenLinePhi b theta))
          (RealTheory.mul b b))
        (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
          (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) =
      RealTheory.mul b b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let x := landenLinePhi b theta
  let c := landenLineSpec.cos theta
  let s := landenLineSpec.sin theta
  let c2 := F.mul c c
  let s2 := F.mul s s
  let b2 := F.mul b b
  have hx2c2 : F.mul (F.mul x x) c2 = F.mul b2 s2 := by
    simpa only [x, c2, b2, s2, s, c] using
      (landenLinePhi_square_mul_cos_square (b := b) (theta := theta) hcos)
  have htrig : F.add s2 c2 = F.one := by
    unfold s2 c2 s c
    exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq landenLineSpec theta
  change F.mul (F.add (F.mul x x) b2) c2 = b2
  calc
    F.mul (F.add (F.mul x x) b2) c2 =
        F.add (F.mul (F.mul x x) c2) (F.mul b2 c2) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.add (F.mul b2 s2) (F.mul b2 c2) := by
          rw [hx2c2]
    _ = F.mul b2 (F.add s2 c2) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
    _ = F.mul b2 F.one := by rw [htrig]
    _ = b2 := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: landenLine_radicand_substitution
statement:
private theorem landenLine_radicand_substitution
    {a b theta : Point}
    (htheta :
      RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi theta) :
    lineRadicand a b (landenLinePhi b theta) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
          (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta))
        (landenLineGaussRadicand a b theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let x := landenLinePhi b theta
  let q := landenLinePhiDeriv b theta
  let c := landenLineSpec.cos theta
  let c2 := F.mul c c
  let c4 := F.mul c2 c2
  let G := landenLineGaussRadicand a b theta
  let a2 := F.mul a a
  let b2 := F.mul b b
  have hcosPos := landenLine_cos_pos_of_mem_rightHalfOpen htheta
  have hcos : Not (c = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hcosPos) hzero.symm
  have hc2 : Not (c2 = F.zero) := by
    unfold c2
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F hcos hcos
  have hc4 : Not (c4 = F.zero) := by
    unfold c4
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_ne_zero F hc2 hc2
  have hfirst : F.mul (F.add (F.mul x x) a2) c2 = G := by
    unfold x a2 c2 c G
    change
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhi b theta)
              (landenLinePhi b theta))
            (RealTheory.mul a a))
          (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
            (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) =
        landenLineGaussRadicand a b theta
    exact landenLine_first_factor_mul_cos_square hcos
  have hsecond : F.mul (F.add (F.mul x x) b2) c2 = b2 := by
    unfold x b2 c2 c
    change
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhi b theta)
              (landenLinePhi b theta))
            (RealTheory.mul b b))
          (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
            (landenLineSpec.cos theta)) =
        RealTheory.mul b b
    exact landenLine_second_factor_mul_cos_square hcos
  have hq2c4 : F.mul (F.mul q q) c4 = b2 := by
    unfold q c4 c2 c b2
    change
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
            (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
              (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
            (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
              (landenLineSpec.cos theta))) =
        RealTheory.mul b b
    exact landenLinePhiDeriv_square_mul_cos_fourth hcos
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero F hc4
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (F.add (F.mul x x) a2)
      (F.add (F.mul x x) b2)) c4 =
    F.mul (F.mul (F.mul q q) G) c4
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (F.add (F.mul x x) a2)
          (F.add (F.mul x x) b2)) c4 =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (F.add (F.mul x x) a2) c2)
        (F.mul (F.add (F.mul x x) b2) c2) := by
          unfold c4
          exact landenLine_mul_mul_pair F
            (F.add (F.mul x x) a2)
            (F.add (F.mul x x) b2) c2 c2
    _ = F.mul G b2 := by rw [hfirst, hsecond]
    _ = F.mul b2 G := F.mul_comm G b2
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul q q) c4) G := by rw [hq2c4]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul q q) G) c4 := by
          calc
            F.mul (F.mul (F.mul q q) c4) G =
                F.mul (F.mul q q) (F.mul c4 G) := by
                  rw [F.mul_assoc]
            _ = F.mul (F.mul q q) (F.mul G c4) := by
                  rw [F.mul_comm c4 G]
            _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul q q) G) c4 :=
                  (F.mul_assoc (F.mul q q) G c4).symm

name: landenLineGaussRadicand_nonneg
statement:
private theorem landenLineGaussRadicand_nonneg
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (theta : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (landenLineGaussRadicand a b theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a2 := F.mul a a
  let b2 := F.mul b b
  let c2 := F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
    (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
  let s2 := F.mul (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
    (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
  have hb0 : F.le F.zero b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F h.left
  have ha0 : F.le F.zero a := F.le_trans hb0 h.right
  have ha2 : F.le F.zero a2 := by
    unfold a2
    exact F.mul_nonneg ha0 ha0
  have hb2 : F.le F.zero b2 := by
    unfold b2
    exact F.mul_nonneg hb0 hb0
  have hc2 : F.le F.zero c2 := by
    unfold c2
    change RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
        (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
    exact landenLine_square_nonneg (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
  have hs2 : F.le F.zero s2 := by
    unfold s2
    change RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
        (landenLineSpec.sin theta))
    exact landenLine_square_nonneg (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
  have hleft : F.le F.zero (F.mul a2 c2) :=
    F.mul_nonneg ha2 hc2
  have hright : F.le F.zero (F.mul b2 s2) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hb2 hs2
  have hsum := F.add_le_add hleft hright
  change F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero)
    (landenLineGaussRadicand a b theta) at hsum
  rwa [F.zero_add] at hsum

name: landenLineGaussRadicand_pos
statement:
private theorem landenLineGaussRadicand_pos
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (htheta :
      RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi theta) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (landenLineGaussRadicand a b theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let a2 := F.mul a a
  let b2 := F.mul b b
  let c2 := F.mul (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
    (landenLineSpec.cos theta)
  let s2 := F.mul (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
    (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
  have haPos : F.lt F.zero a :=
    F.lt_of_lt_of_le h.left h.right
  have ha2Pos : F.lt F.zero a2 := by
    unfold a2
    exact F.mul_pos haPos haPos
  have hcosPos := landenLine_cos_pos_of_mem_rightHalfOpen htheta
  have hc2Pos : F.lt F.zero c2 := by
    unfold c2
    exact F.mul_pos hcosPos hcosPos
  have hleftPos : F.lt F.zero (F.mul a2 c2) :=
    F.mul_pos ha2Pos hc2Pos
  have hb0 : F.le F.zero b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F h.left
  have hb2 : F.le F.zero b2 := by
    unfold b2
    exact F.mul_nonneg hb0 hb0
  have hs2 : F.le F.zero s2 := by
    unfold s2
    change RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.mul (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
        (landenLineSpec.sin theta))
    exact landenLine_square_nonneg (landenLineSpec.sin theta)
  have hright : F.le F.zero (F.mul b2 s2) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hb2 hs2
  have hleftLeSum :
      F.le (F.mul a2 c2)
        (F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2)) := by
    have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
      F hright (F.mul a2 c2)
    change
      F.le (F.add (F.mul a2 c2) F.zero)
        (F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2)) at hadd
    rwa [F.add_zero] at hadd
  change
    F.lt F.zero (F.add (F.mul a2 c2) (F.mul b2 s2))
  exact F.lt_of_lt_of_le hleftPos hleftLeSum

name: landenLinePhiDeriv_pos_of_mem
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhiDeriv_pos_of_mem
    {b theta : Point}
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (htheta :
      RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi theta) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcosPos := landenLine_cos_pos_of_mem_rightHalfOpen htheta
  have hinvPos := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hcosPos
  unfold landenLinePhiDeriv
  exact F.mul_pos hb (F.mul_pos hinvPos hinvPos)

name: landenLine_nthRoot_two_square_eq
statement:
private theorem landenLine_nthRoot_two_square_eq
    {x : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2
        (RealTheory.mul x x) = x
proof:
:= by
  change
    RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
        (RealTheory.mul x x) = x
  apply RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
    (n := 1)
  refine And.intro hx ?_
  change RealFunction.powNat x (1 + 1) =
    RealTheory.mul x x
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]

name: lineFactor_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsum :
      F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero)
        (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul c c)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
      (landenLine_square_nonneg x) (landenLine_square_nonneg c)
  rwa [F.zero_add] at hsum

name: lineFactor_pos_of_pos
statement:
private theorem lineFactor_pos_of_pos
    {c x : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul x x) (RealTheory.mul c c))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcc : F.lt F.zero (F.mul c c) := F.mul_pos hc hc
  have hstep :
      F.lt (F.mul x x)
        (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul c c)) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hcc (F.mul x x)
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
    (landenLine_square_nonneg x) hstep

name: lineRadicand_nonneg
statement:
private theorem lineRadicand_nonneg (a b x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (lineRadicand a b x)
proof:
:= by

  exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg
    (lineFactor_nonneg a x) (lineFactor_nonneg b x)

name: lineRadicand_pos_of_pos
statement:
private theorem lineRadicand_pos_of_pos
    {a b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)

    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (lineRadicand a b x)
proof:
:= by

    (lineFactor_pos_of_pos ha) (lineFactor_pos_of_pos hb)

name: lineFactor_continuousOn
statement:
private theorem lineFactor_continuousOn
    (E : Domain) (c : Point) :
    ContinuousOn E (fun x : Point =>
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul x x) (RealTheory.mul c c))
proof:
:= by
  change ContinuousOn E
    (AddFun (MulFun IdentityFun IdentityFun)
      (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.mul c c))
  exact continuousOn_add
    (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_identity continuousOn_identity)
    continuousOn_const

name: lineRadicand_continuousOn
statement:
private theorem lineRadicand_continuousOn
    (E : Domain) (a b : Point) :
    ContinuousOn E (lineRadicand a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lineRadicand
  change ContinuousOn E
    (MulFun
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul x x) (RealTheory.mul a a))
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul x x) (RealTheory.mul b b)))
  exact continuousOn_mul
    (lineFactor_continuousOn E a)
    (lineFactor_continuousOn E b)

name: lineRootRadicand_continuousOn
statement:
private theorem lineRootRadicand_continuousOn
    (E : Domain) (a b : Point) :
    ContinuousOn E (fun x : Point =>
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 (lineRadicand a b x))
proof:
:= by
  change ContinuousOn E
    (CompFun (RealFunction.Elementary.NthRootFun 2)
      (lineRadicand a b))
  have hroot :
      ContinuousOn RealFunction.Elementary.NonnegativeDomain
        (RealFunction.Elementary.NthRootFun 2) := by
    change ContinuousOn RealFunction.Elementary.NonnegativeDomain
      (RealFunction.Elementary.NthRootFun (1 + 1))
    exact
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRootFun_continuousOn_nonnegative_succ 1
  exact continuousOn_comp
    (lineRadicand_continuousOn E a b) hroot
    (fun x _hx => lineRadicand_nonneg a b x)

name: lineRootRadicand_pos_of_pos
statement:
private theorem lineRootRadicand_pos_of_pos
    {a b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)

    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 (lineRadicand a b x))
proof:
:= by

    (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
      (lineRadicand a b x))
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos 1
    (lineRadicand_pos_of_pos ha hb)

name: lineKernel_continuousOn_of_pos
statement:
private theorem lineKernel_continuousOn_of_pos
    (E : Domain) {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    ContinuousOn E (lineKernel a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lineKernel
  change ContinuousOn E
    (InvFun (fun x : Point =>
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 (lineRadicand a b x)))
  exact continuousOn_inv
    (lineRootRadicand_continuousOn E a b)
    (fun x _hx hzero =>
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (lineRootRadicand_pos_of_pos (x := x) ha hb)) hzero.symm)

name: lineKernel_locallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_one

private theorem lineKernel_locallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_one

      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.one x) ha hb)

name: lineRoot_mono
statement:
private theorem lineRoot_mono
    {u v : Point}
    (hu : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero u)
    (hv : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero v)
    (huv : RealTheory.le u v) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 u)
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 v)
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.nthRootFun_monotoneOn_nonnegative_succ
      1 u v hu hv huv
  unfold RealFunction.Elementary.NthRootFun at h
  exact h

name: lineKernel_nonneg_of_pos
statement:
private theorem lineKernel_nonneg_of_pos
    {a b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (lineKernel a b x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold lineKernel
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
      (lineRootRadicand_pos_of_pos (x := x) ha hb))

name: lineKernel_le_reciprocalSquareKernel
statement:
private theorem lineKernel_le_reciprocalSquareKernel
    {a b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.le (lineKernel a b x) (reciprocalSquareKernel x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let X := F.mul x x
  have hXpos : F.lt F.zero X := by
    unfold X
    exact F.mul_pos hx hx
  have hXnonneg : F.le F.zero X :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hXpos
  have hXa :
      F.le X (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul a a)) := by
    unfold X
    have haa : F.le F.zero (F.mul a a) := landenLine_square_nonneg a
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F haa (F.mul x x)
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hXb :
      F.le X (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul b b)) := by
    unfold X
    have hbb : F.le F.zero (F.mul b b) := landenLine_square_nonneg b
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hbb (F.mul x x)
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hprod1 :
      F.le (F.mul X X)
        (F.mul (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul a a)) X) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hXa hXnonneg
  have hprod2 :
      F.le (F.mul (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul a a)) X)
        (F.mul
          (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul a a))
          (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul b b))) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hXb (lineFactor_nonneg a x)
  have hsq_le_rad :
      F.le (F.mul X X) (lineRadicand a b x) := by
    unfold lineRadicand
    exact F.le_trans hprod1 hprod2
  have hroot_le :
      F.le X
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 (lineRadicand a b x)) := by
    have hmono := lineRoot_mono
      (F.mul_nonneg hXnonneg hXnonneg)
      (lineRadicand_nonneg a b x) hsq_le_rad
    have hsqrt :
        RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 (F.mul X X) = X :=
      landenLine_nthRoot_two_square_eq hXnonneg
    rw [hsqrt] at hmono
    exact hmono
  have hinv_le :
      F.le
        (F.inv (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 (lineRadicand a b x)))
        (F.inv X) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos F
      hXpos (lineRootRadicand_pos_of_pos (x := x) ha hb) hroot_le
  unfold lineKernel reciprocalSquareKernel
  exact hinv_le

name: lineKernel_improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_one
statement:
private theorem lineKernel_improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_one
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    ImproperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf (lineKernel a b) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have horder :
      EventuallyAtPosInf (RightHalfLine F.one)
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (F.le F.zero (lineKernel a b x))
            (F.le (lineKernel a b x) (reciprocalSquareKernel x))) := by
    apply eventuallyAtPosInf_of_forall
    intro x hx
    have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx
    exact And.intro
      (lineKernel_nonneg_of_pos ha hb)
      (lineKernel_le_reciprocalSquareKernel ha hb hxpos)
  exact improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_of_eventually_nonnegative_le
    (lineKernel_locallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_one ha hb)
    (locallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_reciprocalSquareKernel
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
    horder
    (improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_reciprocalSquareKernel
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one)

name: exists_hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_lineKernel_zero
statement:
theorem exists_hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_lineKernel_zero
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    Exists (fun I : Point =>
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
        (lineKernel a b) RealTheory.zero I)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hzero_one : F.le F.zero F.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  have hproperIntegrable :
      OrientedRiemannIntegrableOn (lineKernel a b) F.zero F.one :=
    orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_upperEndpoint_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      (lineKernel_continuousOn_of_pos
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero F.one) ha hb)
      (And.intro hzero_one (F.le_refl F.one))
  let K := orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf hproperIntegrable
  have hK :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (lineKernel a b) F.zero F.one K :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf hproperIntegrable
  cases lineKernel_improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_one ha hb with
  | intro I hI =>
      exact Exists.intro (F.add K I)
        (hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_join_initialSegment
          hzero_one hK hI)

name: landenLine_nthRoot_radicand_substitution
statement:
private theorem landenLine_nthRoot_radicand_substitution
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (htheta :
      RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi theta) :
    RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2
        (lineRadicand a b (landenLinePhi b theta)) =
      RealTheory.mul (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2
          (landenLineGaussRadicand a b theta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := landenLinePhiDeriv b theta
  let G := landenLineGaussRadicand a b theta
  have hqPos := landenLinePhiDeriv_pos_of_mem h.left htheta
  have hq0 : F.le F.zero q :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hqPos
  have hq2 : F.le F.zero (F.mul q q) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hq0 hq0
  have hG : F.le F.zero G :=
    landenLineGaussRadicand_nonneg h theta
  have hrad := landenLine_radicand_substitution
    (a := a) (b := b) htheta
  rw [hrad]
  change
    RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
        (F.mul (F.mul q q) G) =
      F.mul q
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) G)
  have hrootMul :
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
          (F.mul (F.mul q q) G) =
        F.mul
          (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
            (F.mul q q))
          (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) G) := by
    change
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
          (RealTheory.mul (F.mul q q) G) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
            (F.mul q q))
          (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) G)
    exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_mul_succ_of_nonneg
      1 hq2 hG
  rw [hrootMul]
  have hrootQ :
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
          (F.mul q q) = q := by
    change
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2
          (RealTheory.mul q q) = q
    exact landenLine_nthRoot_two_square_eq hq0
  rw [hrootQ]

name: landenLine_inv_mul_product_mul_left
statement:
private theorem landenLine_inv_mul_product_mul_left
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {q d : Point}
    (hq : Not (q = F.zero))
    (hd : Not (d = F.zero)) :
    F.mul (F.inv (F.mul q d)) q = F.inv d
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hq hd]
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.inv d) (F.inv q)) q =
        F.mul (F.inv d) (F.mul (F.inv q) q) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv d) F.one := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hq]
    _ = F.inv d := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: landenLine_pullback_identity
statement:
private theorem landenLine_pullback_identity
    {a b theta : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (htheta :
      RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi theta) :
    substitutionIntegrand (lineKernel a b)
        (landenLinePhi b) (landenLinePhiDeriv b) theta =
      gaussIntegrand a b theta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := landenLinePhiDeriv b theta
  let G := landenLineGaussRadicand a b theta
  let d := RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 G
  have hqPos := landenLinePhiDeriv_pos_of_mem h.left htheta
  have hq : Not (q = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hqPos) hzero.symm
  have hGPos := landenLineGaussRadicand_pos h htheta
  have hdPos : F.lt F.zero d := by
    unfold d
    change
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) G)
    exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos 1 hGPos
  have hd : Not (d = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hdPos) hzero.symm
  have hroot := landenLine_nthRoot_radicand_substitution h htheta
  rw [gaussIntegrand_eq_landenLineGaussRadicand]
  unfold substitutionIntegrand lineKernel
  change
    F.mul
        (F.inv
          (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2
            (lineRadicand a b (landenLinePhi b theta)))) q =
      F.inv d
  have hrootFd :
      RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2
          (lineRadicand a b (landenLinePhi b theta)) =
        F.mul q d := by
    unfold q d G
    exact hroot
  rw [hrootFd]
  exact landenLine_inv_mul_product_mul_left F hq hd

name: landenLinePhi_continuousOn
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhi_continuousOn
    {b t : Point}
    (ht : RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi t) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero t) (landenLinePhi b)
proof:
:= by
  let E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero t
  have htan : RealFunction.ContinuousOn E (TanFun landenLineSpec) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
      (fun theta htheta => by
        intro hzero
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (landenLine_cos_pos_of_mem_closedInterval ht htheta))
          hzero.symm)
      (continuousOn_tan_cosNonzero landenLineSpec)
  have hconst : RealFunction.ContinuousOn E (fun _theta : Point => b) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_const
  have hmul := RealFunction.continuousOn_mul hconst htan
  change RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
    (fun theta : Point => RealTheory.mul b (tan landenLineSpec theta)) at hmul
  exact hmul

name: landenLinePhiDeriv_continuousOn
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhiDeriv_continuousOn
    {b t : Point}
    (ht : RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi t) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero t)
      (landenLinePhiDeriv b)
proof:
:= by
  let E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero t
  have hcos : RealFunction.ContinuousOn E landenLineSpec.cos :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset (fun _theta _htheta => trivial)
      (continuousOn_cos_universal landenLineSpec)
  have hinv :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
        (RealFunction.InvFun landenLineSpec.cos) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_inv hcos
      (fun theta htheta => by
        intro hzero
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (landenLine_cos_pos_of_mem_closedInterval ht htheta))
          hzero.symm)
  have hinvSq := RealFunction.continuousOn_mul hinv hinv
  have hconst : RealFunction.ContinuousOn E (fun _theta : Point => b) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_const
  have hmul := RealFunction.continuousOn_mul hconst hinvSq
  change RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
    (fun theta : Point =>
      RealTheory.mul b
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta))
          (RealTheory.inv (landenLineSpec.cos theta)))) at hmul
  exact hmul

name: landenLinePhi_hasDerivativeWithinOn
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhi_hasDerivativeWithinOn
    {b t : Point}
    (ht : RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi t) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      (RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero t)
      (landenLinePhi b) (landenLinePhiDeriv b)
proof:
:= by
  intro theta htheta
  have hclosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero t theta :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval RealTheory.zero t theta htheta
  have hcospos := landenLine_cos_pos_of_mem_closedInterval ht hclosed
  have hcosne : CosNonzero landenLineSpec theta := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hcospos) hzero.symm
  have htan :=
    RealDerivative.Trigonometric.hasDerivWithin_tan_universal_inv_cos_sq
      landenLineSpec hcosne
  have hscaled := RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_constMul (c := b) htan
  have hsmall := RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
    (fun _z _hz => trivial) htheta hscaled
  change RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
    (RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero t)
    (landenLinePhi b) theta (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
  exact hsmall

name: landenLinePhiDeriv_pos
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhiDeriv_pos
    {b t theta : Point}
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (ht : RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi t)
    (htheta : RealTheory.OpenInterval RealTheory.zero t theta) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hclosed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero t theta :=
    RealTheory.openInterval_subset_closedInterval RealTheory.zero t theta htheta
  have hcospos := landenLine_cos_pos_of_mem_closedInterval ht hclosed
  have hinvpos := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hcospos
  unfold landenLinePhiDeriv
  exact F.mul_pos hb (F.mul_pos hinvpos hinvpos)

name: landenLinePhi_strictMonotoneOn
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhi_strictMonotoneOn
    {b t : Point}
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (ht : RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi t) :
    RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero t) (landenLinePhi b)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont := landenLinePhi_continuousOn (b := b) ht
  have hderiv := landenLinePhi_hasDerivativeWithinOn (b := b) ht
  have hdiff : RealDerivative.DifferentiableOnOpenInterval
      RealTheory.zero t (landenLinePhi b) := by
    intro theta htheta
    exact Exists.intro (landenLinePhiDeriv b theta) (hderiv theta htheta)
  have hpos : RealDerivative.DerivativePositiveOnOpenInterval
      RealTheory.zero t (landenLinePhi b) := by
    intro theta A htheta hA
    have hcanonical := hderiv theta htheta
    have hAeq : A = landenLinePhiDeriv b theta :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
        (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint htheta) hA hcanonical
    rw [hAeq]
    exact landenLinePhiDeriv_pos hb ht htheta
  exact RealDerivative.strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_positive
    hcont hdiff hpos

name: landenLinePhi_nonneg
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhi_nonneg
    {b t : Point}
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (ht : RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi t) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (landenLinePhi b t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hstrict := landenLinePhi_strictMonotoneOn hb ht
  have hmono := RealFunction.strictMonotoneOn_monotoneOn hstrict
  have hzeroMem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero t RealTheory.zero :=
    And.intro (F.le_refl F.zero) ht.left
  have htMem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero t t :=
    And.intro ht.left (F.le_refl t)
  have hle := hmono F.zero t hzeroMem htMem ht.left
  have hphiZero : landenLinePhi b F.zero = F.zero := by
    change landenLinePhi b RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
    exact landenLinePhi_zero b
  rwa [hphiZero] at hle

name: landenLinePhi_tendsto_posInf
statement:
private theorem landenLinePhi_tendsto_posInf
    {b : Point}
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithinToPosInf
      (RealFunction.LeftDomain
        (RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi)
        landenHalfPi)
      (landenLinePhi b) landenHalfPi
proof:
:= by
  let E := RealFunction.LeftDomain
    (RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi)
    landenHalfPi
  have htan : RealFunction.TendstoWithinToPosInf E
      (tan landenLineSpec) landenHalfPi := by
    apply RealDerivative.Trigonometric.tendstoWithinToPosInf_tan_halfPi_of_subset
    intro theta htheta
    exact And.intro htheta.left.left
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base htheta.left.right)
  intro bound
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbinv : Not (b = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hb) hzero.symm
  cases htan (F.mul bound (F.inv b)) with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta (And.intro hdelta.left ?_)
      intro theta htheta hthetane hdist
      have hlarge := hdelta.right theta htheta hthetane hdist
      have hscaled := F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hlarge hb
      have hleft : F.mul b (F.mul bound (F.inv b)) = bound := by
        calc
          F.mul b (F.mul bound (F.inv b)) =
              F.mul (F.mul b bound) (F.inv b) :=
                (F.mul_assoc b bound (F.inv b)).symm
          _ = F.mul (F.mul bound b) (F.inv b) := by
                rw [F.mul_comm b bound]
          _ = F.mul bound (F.mul b (F.inv b)) :=
                F.mul_assoc bound b (F.inv b)
          _ = F.mul bound F.one := by rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hbinv]
          _ = bound := by rw [F.mul_one]
      rw [hleft] at hscaled
      change F.lt bound (landenLinePhi b theta)
      exact hscaled

name: landenLine_hparam
statement:
private theorem landenLine_hparam
    (f : Point -> Point)
    {b : Point}
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    ImproperAtPosInfToRightEndpointStrictIncreasingSubstitutionData
      f (landenLinePhi b) (landenLinePhiDeriv b)
      RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { left_endpoint := landenLinePhi_zero b
      maps_target := ?maps_target
      phi_tendsto_posInf := landenLinePhi_tendsto_posInf hb
      truncation_data := ?truncation_data }
  · intro t ht
    exact landenLinePhi_nonneg hb ht
  · intro t J ht hJ
    have hstrict := landenLinePhi_strictMonotoneOn hb ht
    have hmono := RealFunction.strictMonotoneOn_monotoneOn hstrict
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    have hzeroMem :
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero t RealTheory.zero :=
      And.intro (F.le_refl F.zero) ht.left
    have htMem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero t t :=
      And.intro ht.left (F.le_refl t)
    refine
      { source_order := ht.left
        target_order := landenLinePhi_nonneg hb ht
        left_endpoint := landenLinePhi_zero b
        right_endpoint := rfl
        strict_mono := hstrict
        phi_continuous := landenLinePhi_continuousOn ht
        derivative_continuous := landenLinePhiDeriv_continuousOn ht
        phi_derivative := landenLinePhi_hasDerivativeWithinOn ht
        maps_closed := ?maps_closed
        target_integral := hJ }
    intro theta htheta
    have hlower := hmono F.zero theta hzeroMem htheta htheta.left
    have hupper := hmono theta t htheta htMem htheta.right
    have hphiZero : landenLinePhi b F.zero = F.zero := by
      change landenLinePhi b RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
      exact landenLinePhi_zero b
    rw [hphiZero] at hlower
    exact And.intro hlower hupper

name: landenLine_hasImproperRightEndpoint_of_hasAtPosInf
statement:
private theorem landenLine_hasImproperRightEndpoint_of_hasAtPosInf
    (J : Point -> Point)
    {a b I : Point}
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hpullback :
      forall theta : Point,
        RightHalfOpenInterval RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi theta ->
        substitutionIntegrand J (landenLinePhi b)
            (landenLinePhiDeriv b) theta =
          gaussIntegrand a b theta)
    (hI : HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
      J RealTheory.zero I) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint
      (gaussIntegrand a b) RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi I
proof:
:= by
  have hsub :=
    hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_substitution_strictIncreasing_atPosInf
      (landenLine_hparam J hb) hI
  cases hsub with
  | intro P hP =>
      refine Exists.intro P ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ hP.right
      intro t ht
      have htrunc := hP.left t ht
      exact
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
          ht.left
          (fun theta htheta =>
            hpullback theta
              (And.intro htheta.left
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                  htheta.right ht.right)))
          htrunc

name: lineKernel_hasImproperRightEndpoint_gaussIntegrand
statement:
theorem lineKernel_hasImproperRightEndpoint_gaussIntegrand
    {a b I : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (hI : HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
      (lineKernel a b) RealTheory.zero I) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint
      (gaussIntegrand a b) RealTheory.zero landenHalfPi I
proof:
:= by
  exact landenLine_hasImproperRightEndpoint_of_hasAtPosInf
    (lineKernel a b) h.left
    (fun theta htheta => landenLine_pullback_identity h htheta)
    hI

name: nat_two_mul_eq_add_self_base
statement:
theorem nat_two_mul_eq_add_self_base
    {alpha : Type} (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike alpha) (z : alpha) :
    F.mul (F.nat 2) z = F.add z z
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_two_mul_eq_add_self F z

name: square_mul_inv_eq_mul_inv_square_base
statement:
theorem square_mul_inv_eq_mul_inv_square_base
    {alpha : Type} (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike alpha) (a b : alpha)
    (hb : Not (b = F.zero)) :
    F.mul (F.mul a (F.inv b)) (F.mul a (F.inv b)) =
      F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.inv (F.mul b b))
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.square_mul_inv_eq_mul_inv_square F a b hb

name: sum_sq_sub_diff_sq_eq_four_mul_base
statement:
theorem sum_sq_sub_diff_sq_eq_four_mul_base
    {alpha : Type} (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike alpha) (a b : alpha) :
    F.sub (F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b))
      (F.mul (F.sub a b) (F.sub a b)) =
      F.mul (F.mul (F.nat 2) (F.nat 2)) (F.mul a b)
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sum_sq_sub_diff_sq_eq_four_mul F a b

name: monotoneDecreasing_of_step_base
statement:
private theorem monotoneDecreasing_of_step_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {u : Nat -> Point}
    (hstep : forall n : Nat, F.le (u (n + 1)) (u n)) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.MonotoneDecreasing F u
proof:
:= by
  intro n m hnm
  have htail :
      forall k : Nat, F.le (u (n + k)) (u n) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        rw [Nat.add_zero]
        exact F.le_refl (u n)
    | succ k ih =>
        have hnext : F.le (u ((n + k) + 1)) (u (n + k)) :=
          hstep (n + k)
        have htarget :
            n + (k + 1) = (n + k) + 1 := by
          omega
        rw [htarget]
        exact F.le_trans hnext ih
  have hm : n + (m - n) = m := by
    omega
  simpa [hm] using htail (m - n)

name: agmParameter
statement:
private theorem agmParameter
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (n : Nat) :
    GaussParameter (agmA a b n) (agmB a b n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [agmA_zero, agmB_zero]
      exact h
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [agmA_succ, agmB_succ]
      exact LandenInternal.landenParameter ih

statement:
private theorem agmA_monotoneDecreasing
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.MonotoneDecreasing (agmA a b)
proof:
:= by
  change
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.MonotoneDecreasing
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (agmA a b)
  exact monotoneDecreasing_of_step_base
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
