name: agmA_boundedBelow
statement:
private theorem agmA_boundedBelow
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.SeqBoundedBelow (agmA a b)
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro b ?_
  intro n
  have hBmono := agmB_monotoneIncreasing h
  have hb_le_B : RealTheory.le b (agmB a b n) := by
    have hstep := hBmono 0 n (Nat.zero_le n)
    rwa [agmB_zero] at hstep
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hb_le_B (agmB_le_agmA h n)

name: agmB_boundedAbove
statement:
private theorem agmB_boundedAbove
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.SeqBoundedAbove (agmB a b)
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro a ?_
  intro n
  have hAmono := agmA_monotoneDecreasing h
  have hA_le_a : RealTheory.le (agmA a b n) a := by
    have hstep := hAmono 0 n (Nat.zero_le n)
    rwa [agmA_zero] at hstep
  exact RealTheory.le_trans (agmB_le_agmA h n) hA_le_a

name: agmA_converges
statement:
private theorem agmA_converges
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    Exists (fun L : Point => RealTheory.SeqTendsto (agmA a b) L)
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.monotone_decreasing_converges
    (agmA_monotoneDecreasing h) (agmA_boundedBelow h)

name: agmB_converges
statement:
private theorem agmB_converges
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    Exists (fun L : Point => RealTheory.SeqTendsto (agmB a b) L)
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.monotone_increasing_converges
    (agmB_monotoneIncreasing h) (agmB_boundedAbove h)

name: seqTendsto_succ
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hu eps heps with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      exact hN (n + 1) (Nat.le_trans hn (Nat.le_succ n))

name: eq_of_eq_gaussArithmeticMean_self
statement:
private theorem eq_of_eq_gaussArithmeticMean_self
    {x y : Point}
    (h : x = gaussArithmeticMean x y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let T := F.nat 2
  have hT_ne : Not (T = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have hmul :
      F.mul x T = F.mul (gaussArithmeticMean x y) T := by
    exact congrArg (fun z : Point => F.mul z T) h
  have hleft :
      F.mul x T = F.add x x := by
    unfold T
    rw [F.mul_comm x (F.nat 2)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_two_mul_eq_add_self F x
  have hright :
      F.mul (gaussArithmeticMean x y) T = F.add x y := by
    unfold gaussArithmeticMean T
    change
      F.mul (F.mul (F.add x y) (F.inv (F.nat 2)))
          (F.nat 2) =
        F.add x y
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
      F (F.add x y) hT_ne
  have hxxy : F.add x x = F.add x y := by
    calc
      F.add x x = F.mul x T := hleft.symm
      _ = F.mul (gaussArithmeticMean x y) T := hmul
      _ = F.add x y := hright
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_left_cancel F hxxy

name: agmA_succ_tendsto_gaussArithmeticMean
statement:
private theorem agmA_succ_tendsto_gaussArithmeticMean
    {a b LA LB : Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.SeqTendsto (agmA a b) LA)
    (hB : RealTheory.SeqTendsto (agmB a b) LB) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat => agmA a b (n + 1))
      (gaussArithmeticMean LA LB)
proof:
:= by
  have hmean :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          gaussArithmeticMean (agmA a b n) (agmB a b n))
        (gaussArithmeticMean LA LB) := by
    unfold gaussArithmeticMean
    exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul
      (RealTheory.seqTendsto_add hA hB)
      (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat 2)))
  apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_congr_eventually hmean
  refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
  intro n _hn
  rw [agmA_succ]

name: agmLimits_eq_of_tendsto
statement:
private theorem agmLimits_eq_of_tendsto
    {a b LA LB : Point}
    (hA : RealTheory.SeqTendsto (agmA a b) LA)
    (hB : RealTheory.SeqTendsto (agmB a b) LB) :
    LA = LB
proof:
:= by
  have hshift :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat => agmA a b (n + 1)) LA :=
    seqTendsto_succ hA
  have hmean :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat => agmA a b (n + 1))
        (gaussArithmeticMean LA LB) :=
    agmA_succ_tendsto_gaussArithmeticMean hA hB
  have hlimit :
      LA = gaussArithmeticMean LA LB :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hshift hmean
  exact eq_of_eq_gaussArithmeticMean_self hlimit

name: exists_agmConvergesTo
statement:
private theorem exists_agmConvergesTo
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    Exists (fun M : Point => AgmConvergesTo a b M)
proof:
:= by
  cases agmA_converges h with
  | intro LA hA =>
      cases agmB_converges h with
      | intro LB hB =>
          have hEq : LA = LB :=
            agmLimits_eq_of_tendsto hA hB
          have hBLA :
              RealTheory.SeqTendsto (agmB a b) LA := by
            rw [hEq]
            exact hB
          exact Exists.intro LA (And.intro hA hBLA)

name: hasAgmConvergesTo_arithmeticGeometricMean
statement:
private theorem hasAgmConvergesTo_arithmeticGeometricMean
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    AgmConvergesTo a b (arithmeticGeometricMean a b)
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : Exists (fun M : Point => AgmConvergesTo a b M) :=
    exists_agmConvergesTo h
  rw [arithmeticGeometricMean_eq_with h hconv]
  exact arithmeticGeometricMeanWith_spec h hconv

name: completeIntegral_agm_invariant
statement:
private theorem completeIntegral_agm_invariant
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (n : Nat) :
    LandenInternal.completeIntegral (agmA a b n) (agmB a b n) =
      LandenInternal.completeIntegral a b
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [agmA_zero, agmB_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [agmA_succ, agmB_succ]
      calc
        LandenInternal.completeIntegral
            (gaussArithmeticMean (agmA a b n) (agmB a b n))
            (gaussGeometricMean (agmA a b n) (agmB a b n)) =
            LandenInternal.completeIntegral (agmA a b n) (agmB a b n) := by
            exact (LandenInternal.completeIntegral_landen_invariant
              (agmParameter h n)).symm
        _ = LandenInternal.completeIntegral a b := ih

name: completeIntegral_agm_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem completeIntegral_agm_lower_bound
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
        (RealTheory.inv (agmA a b n)))
      (LandenInternal.completeIntegral a b)
proof:
:= by
  have hbound :=
    LandenInternal.completeIntegral_lower_bound (agmParameter h n)
  rw [completeIntegral_agm_invariant h n] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: completeIntegral_agm_upper_bound
statement:
private theorem completeIntegral_agm_upper_bound
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)

      (LandenInternal.completeIntegral a b)
      (RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
        (RealTheory.inv (agmB a b n)))
proof:
:= by
  have hbound :=
    LandenInternal.completeIntegral_upper_bound (agmParameter h n)
  rw [completeIntegral_agm_invariant h n] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: arithmeticGeometricMean_pos
statement:
private theorem arithmeticGeometricMean_pos
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (arithmeticGeometricMean a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hconv :
      AgmConvergesTo a b (arithmeticGeometricMean a b) :=
    hasAgmConvergesTo_arithmeticGeometricMean h
  have hb_le :
      RealTheory.le b (arithmeticGeometricMean a b) := by
    have hconst :
        RealTheory.SeqTendsto (fun _ : Nat => b) b :=
      RealTheory.seqTendsto_const b
    have hevent :
        RealTheory.Eventually
          (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.le b (agmB a b n)) := by
      apply Eventually.of_forall
      intro n
      have hmono := agmB_monotoneIncreasing h
      have hstep := hmono 0 n (Nat.zero_le n)
      rwa [agmB_zero] at hstep
    exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le
      hconst hconv.right hevent
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F h.left hb_le

name: arithmeticGeometricMean_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem arithmeticGeometricMean_ne_zero
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    Not (arithmeticGeometricMean a b = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro hzero
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F
    (arithmeticGeometricMean_pos h)) hzero.symm

name: completeIntegral_agm_lowerEndpoint_tendsto
statement:
private theorem completeIntegral_agm_lowerEndpoint_tendsto
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
          (RealTheory.inv (agmA a b n)))
      (RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
        (RealTheory.inv (arithmeticGeometricMean a b)))
proof:
:= by
  have hconv :
      AgmConvergesTo a b (arithmeticGeometricMean a b) :=
    hasAgmConvergesTo_arithmeticGeometricMean h
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const landenHalfPi)
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_inv hconv.left
      (arithmeticGeometricMean_ne_zero h))

name: completeIntegral_agm_upperEndpoint_tendsto
statement:
private theorem completeIntegral_agm_upperEndpoint_tendsto
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
          (RealTheory.inv (agmB a b n)))
      (RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
        (RealTheory.inv (arithmeticGeometricMean a b)))
proof:
:= by
  have hconv :
      AgmConvergesTo a b (arithmeticGeometricMean a b) :=
    hasAgmConvergesTo_arithmeticGeometricMean h
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const landenHalfPi)
    (RealTheory.seqTendsto_inv hconv.right
      (arithmeticGeometricMean_ne_zero h))

name: completeIntegral_eq_landenHalfPi_mul_inv_agm
statement:
private theorem completeIntegral_eq_landenHalfPi_mul_inv_agm
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    LandenInternal.completeIntegral a b =
      RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
        (RealTheory.inv (arithmeticGeometricMean a b))
proof:
:= by
  let target :=
    RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
      (RealTheory.inv (arithmeticGeometricMean a b))
  have hlower :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
            (RealTheory.inv (agmA a b n)))
        target := by
    unfold target
    exact completeIntegral_agm_lowerEndpoint_tendsto h
  have hupper :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
            (RealTheory.inv (agmB a b n)))
        target := by
    unfold target
    exact completeIntegral_agm_upperEndpoint_tendsto h
  have hconst_to_target :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun _ : Nat => LandenInternal.completeIntegral a b)
        target := by
    apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_of_squeeze
      (u := fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
          (RealTheory.inv (agmA a b n)))
      (w := fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
          (RealTheory.inv (agmB a b n)))
    · exact hlower
    · exact hupper
    · apply Eventually.of_forall
      intro n
      exact completeIntegral_agm_lower_bound h n
    · apply Eventually.of_forall
      intro n
      exact completeIntegral_agm_upper_bound h n
  have hconst :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun _ : Nat => LandenInternal.completeIntegral a b)
        (LandenInternal.completeIntegral a b) :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_const (LandenInternal.completeIntegral a b)
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hconst hconst_to_target

name: completeEllipticK_eq_landenHalfPi_mul_inv_agm
statement:
theorem completeEllipticK_eq_landenHalfPi_mul_inv_agm
    {k : Point}
    (h : EllipticModulus k) :
    completeEllipticK k =
      RealTheory.mul landenHalfPi
        (RealTheory.inv
          (arithmeticGeometricMean RealTheory.one
            (ellipticComplement k)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [LandenInternal.completeEllipticK_eq_completeIntegral k]
  exact completeIntegral_eq_landenHalfPi_mul_inv_agm
    (LandenInternal.ellipticComplement_gaussParameter_internal h)

name: newmanGaussParameter_a_pos
statement:
private theorem newmanGaussParameter_a_pos
    {a b : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base h.left h.right

name: newmanSquare_nonneg
statement:
private theorem newmanSquare_nonneg (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl hx => exact F.mul_nonneg hx hx
  | inr hx =>
      have hneg : F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx
      have hsq : F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) :=
        F.mul_nonneg hneg hneg
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x x] at hsq

name: newmanFactor_nonneg
statement:
private theorem newmanFactor_nonneg (c x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (newmanFactor c x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold newmanFactor
  have h : F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero)
      (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul c c)) :=
    F.add_le_add (newmanSquare_nonneg x) (newmanSquare_nonneg c)
  rwa [F.zero_add] at h

name: newmanFactor_pos_of_pos
statement:
private theorem newmanFactor_pos_of_pos
    {c x : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (newmanFactor c x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcc : F.lt F.zero (F.mul c c) := F.mul_pos hc hc
  unfold newmanFactor
  have hlt : F.lt (F.mul x x)
      (F.add (F.mul x x) (F.mul c c)) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hcc (F.mul x x)
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  exact F.lt_of_le_of_lt (newmanSquare_nonneg x) hlt

name: newmanLineRadicand_nonneg
statement:
private theorem newmanLineRadicand_nonneg
    (a b x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (lineRadicand a b x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lineRadicand
  change RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
    (RealTheory.mul (newmanFactor a x) (newmanFactor b x))
  exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg
    (newmanFactor_nonneg a x) (newmanFactor_nonneg b x)

name: newmanLineRadicand_pos_of_pos
statement:
private theorem newmanLineRadicand_pos_of_pos
    {a b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (lineRadicand a b x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lineRadicand
  change RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
    (RealTheory.mul (newmanFactor a x) (newmanFactor b x))
  exact RealTheory.mul_pos
    (newmanFactor_pos_of_pos ha) (newmanFactor_pos_of_pos hb)

name: newmanSqrtLineRadicand_pos_of_pos
statement:
private theorem newmanSqrtLineRadicand_pos_of_pos
    {a b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (newmanSqrt (lineRadicand a b x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold newmanSqrt
  change RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
    (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
      (lineRadicand a b x))
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos 1
    (newmanLineRadicand_pos_of_pos ha hb)

name: newmanGeometricMean_pos
statement:
private theorem newmanGeometricMean_pos
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (gaussGeometricMean a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussGeometricMean
  change RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
    (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (RealTheory.mul a b))
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_pos_succ_of_pos 1
    (RealTheory.mul_pos ha hb)

name: newmanGeometricMean_sq
statement:
private theorem newmanGeometricMean_sq
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    RealTheory.mul (gaussGeometricMean a b)
        (gaussGeometricMean a b) =
      RealTheory.mul a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussGeometricMean
  have hab_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul a b) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (RealTheory.mul_pos ha hb)
  have h :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg 1 hab_nonneg
  change RealTheory.mul
    (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (RealTheory.mul a b))
    (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) (RealTheory.mul a b)) =
      RealTheory.mul a b
  rw [<- RealFunction.powNat_two]
  exact h

name: newmanInverse_tendstoAtPosInf_zero_on
statement:
private theorem newmanInverse_tendstoAtPosInf_zero_on
    (alpha : Point) :
    TendstoAtPosInf (RightHalfLine alpha)
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.inv x) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro eps heps
  refine Exists.intro (F.inv eps) ?_
  intro x _hx hlarge
  have hinv_eps_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F heps
  have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hinv_eps_pos hlarge
  have hinv_lt : F.lt (F.inv x) (F.inv (F.inv eps)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
      F hinv_eps_pos hxpos hlarge
  have heps_ne : Not (eps = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F heps) hzero.symm
  have hinv_inv : F.inv (F.inv eps) = eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_inv_of_ne_zero F heps_ne
  rw [hinv_inv] at hinv_lt
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hxpos)
  change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub (F.inv x) F.zero)) eps
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F (F.inv x)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hinv_nonneg]
  exact hinv_lt

name: newmanInverseMap_tendstoAtPosInf_zero
statement:
private theorem newmanInverseMap_tendstoAtPosInf_zero
    (a b alpha : Point) :
    TendstoAtPosInf (RightHalfLine alpha)
      (newmanInverseMap a b) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := tendstoAtPosInf_const_mul
    (c := F.mul a b) (newmanInverse_tendstoAtPosInf_zero_on alpha)
  unfold newmanInverseMap
  change TendstoAtPosInf (RightHalfLine alpha)
    (MulFun (fun _ : Point => F.mul a b)
      (fun x : Point => F.inv x)) F.zero
  have hzero : RealTheory.mul (F.mul a b) RealTheory.zero = F.zero := by
    change F.mul (F.mul a b) F.zero = F.zero
    exact F.mul_zero (F.mul a b)
  rw [hzero] at h
  exact h

name: newmanInverseMap_continuousOn_positive
statement:
private theorem newmanInverseMap_continuousOn_positive
    (a b : Point) :
    ContinuousOn (fun x : Point => RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
      (newmanInverseMap a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv :
      ContinuousOn (fun x : Point => F.lt F.zero x)
        (InvFun IdentityFun) := by
    apply continuousOn_inv continuousOn_identity
    intro x hx hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hzero.symm
  unfold newmanInverseMap
  change ContinuousOn (fun x : Point => F.lt F.zero x)
    (MulFun (fun _ : Point => F.mul a b) (InvFun IdentityFun))
  exact continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const hinv

name: newmanInverseMapDeriv_continuousOn_positive
statement:
private theorem newmanInverseMapDeriv_continuousOn_positive
    (a b : Point) :
    ContinuousOn (fun x : Point => RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
      (newmanInverseMapDeriv a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv :
      ContinuousOn (fun x : Point => F.lt F.zero x)
        (InvFun IdentityFun) := by
    apply continuousOn_inv continuousOn_identity
    intro x hx hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hzero.symm
  unfold newmanInverseMapDeriv
  change ContinuousOn (fun x : Point => F.lt F.zero x)
    (NegFun
      (MulFun (fun _ : Point => F.mul a b)
        (MulFun (InvFun IdentityFun) (InvFun IdentityFun))))
  exact continuousOn_neg
    (continuousOn_mul continuousOn_const (continuousOn_mul hinv hinv))

name: newmanInverseMap_hasDerivativeWithinOn_positive
statement:
private theorem newmanInverseMap_hasDerivativeWithinOn_positive
    (a b : Point) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
      (newmanInverseMap a b) (newmanInverseMapDeriv a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro x hx
  have hinv := RealDerivative.hasDerivativeWithinOn_inv_positive x hx
  have hraw := RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_constMul
    (c := F.mul a b) hinv
  have hvalue :
      F.mul (F.mul a b)
        (F.neg (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))) =
      F.neg
        (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F
      (F.mul a b) (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))
  unfold newmanInverseMap newmanInverseMapDeriv
  change RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
    (fun y : Point => F.lt F.zero y)
    (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (F.mul a b) (InvFun IdentityFun)) x
    (F.neg
      (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))))
  exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_congr_value hvalue hraw

name: newmanInverseMapDeriv_neg
statement:
private theorem newmanInverseMapDeriv_neg
    {a b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.lt (newmanInverseMapDeriv a b x) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx
  have hinner :
      F.lt F.zero
        (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))) :=
    F.mul_pos (F.mul_pos ha hb) (F.mul_pos hinv_pos hinv_pos)
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hinner
  rw [F.neg_zero] at h
  exact h

name: newmanInverseMap_strictDecreasingOn_closedInterval
statement:
private theorem newmanInverseMap_strictDecreasingOn_closedInterval
    {a b u v : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hu : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero u) :
    StrictDecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v)
      (newmanInverseMap a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpositive :
      forall x : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v x ->
        F.lt F.zero x := by
    intro x hx
    exact F.lt_of_lt_of_le hu hx.left
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v)
      (newmanInverseMap a b) :=
    continuousOn_subset hpositive
      (newmanInverseMap_continuousOn_positive a b)
  have hdiff :
      RealDerivative.DifferentiableOnOpenInterval u v
        (newmanInverseMap a b) :=
    RealDerivative.differentiableOnOpenInterval_of_hasDerivativeWithinOn_subset
      (fun x hx => F.lt_trans hu hx.left)
      (newmanInverseMap_hasDerivativeWithinOn_positive a b)
  have hderiv :
      RealDerivative.DerivativeNegativeOnOpenInterval u v
        (newmanInverseMap a b) := by
    intro x A hx hA
    have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x := F.lt_trans hu hx.left
    have hcanonical :
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin (RealTheory.OpenInterval u v)
          (newmanInverseMap a b) x (newmanInverseMapDeriv a b x) :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset
        (fun y hy => F.lt_trans hu hy.left)
        hx (newmanInverseMap_hasDerivativeWithinOn_positive a b x hxpos)
    have hEq : A = newmanInverseMapDeriv a b x :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
        (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA hcanonical
    rw [hEq]
    exact newmanInverseMapDeriv_neg ha hb hxpos
  exact RealDerivative.strictDecreasingOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_negative
    hcont hdiff hderiv

name: newmanInverseMap_geometricMean_eq
statement:
private theorem newmanInverseMap_geometricMean_eq
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b) :
    newmanInverseMap a b (gaussGeometricMean a b) =
      gaussGeometricMean a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let g := gaussGeometricMean a b
  have hgpos : F.lt F.zero g := newmanGeometricMean_pos ha hb
  have hgne : Not (g = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hgpos) hzero.symm
  have hsq : F.mul g g = F.mul a b := newmanGeometricMean_sq ha hb
  unfold newmanInverseMap
  change F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.inv g) = g
  rw [<- hsq, F.mul_assoc, F.mul_inv_cancel hgne, F.mul_one]

name: newmanInverseMap_pos
statement:
private theorem newmanInverseMap_pos
    {a b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (newmanInverseMap a b x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold newmanInverseMap
  exact F.mul_pos (F.mul_pos ha hb)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx)

name: newmanInverseMap_reverse_le_of_le
statement:
private theorem newmanInverseMap_reverse_le_of_le
    {a b x y : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    RealTheory.le (newmanInverseMap a b y)
      (newmanInverseMap a b x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hyx : F.le y x
  case pos =>
    have heq : x = y := F.le_antisymm hxy hyx
    rw [heq]
    exact F.le_refl (newmanInverseMap a b y)
  case neg =>
    have hlt : F.lt x y :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy hyx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (newmanInverseMap_strictDecreasingOn_closedInterval ha hb hx
        x y
        (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hxy)
        (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hxy) hlt)

name: newmanInverseMap_high_le_geometricMean
statement:
private theorem newmanInverseMap_high_le_geometricMean
    {a b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hx : RealTheory.le (gaussGeometricMean a b) x) :
    RealTheory.le (newmanInverseMap a b x)
      (gaussGeometricMean a b)
proof:
:= by
  have h := newmanInverseMap_reverse_le_of_le
    ha hb (newmanGeometricMean_pos ha hb) hx
  rw [newmanInverseMap_geometricMean_eq ha hb] at h
  exact h

name: newmanMulMulPair
statement:
private theorem newmanMulMulPair
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
      F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
        F.mul a (F.mul b (F.mul c d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul c (F.mul b d)) := by
          congr 1
          calc
            F.mul b (F.mul c d) = F.mul (F.mul b c) d := by
              rw [F.mul_assoc]
            _ = F.mul (F.mul c b) d := by rw [F.mul_comm b c]
            _ = F.mul c (F.mul b d) := F.mul_assoc c b d
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: newmanFactor_inverse_first
statement:
private theorem newmanFactor_inverse_first
    {a b x : Point}
    (hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    newmanFactor a (newmanInverseMap a b x) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul a a)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x) (RealTheory.inv x))
          (newmanFactor b x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let u := F.inv x
  let aa := F.mul a a
  let bb := F.mul b b
  let xx := F.mul x x
  let uu := F.mul u u
  have hux : F.mul uu xx = F.one := by
    unfold uu xx u
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)) (F.mul x x) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.inv x) x) (F.mul (F.inv x) x) :=
            newmanMulMulPair F (F.inv x) (F.inv x) x x
      _ = F.mul F.one F.one := by rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hxne]
      _ = F.one := by rw [F.one_mul]
  unfold newmanFactor newmanInverseMap
  change
    F.add
      (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a b) u) (F.mul (F.mul a b) u)) aa =
      F.mul aa (F.mul uu (F.add xx bb))
  calc
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a b) u) (F.mul (F.mul a b) u)) aa =
        F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul a b)) uu) aa := by
            rw [newmanMulMulPair F (F.mul a b) u (F.mul a b) u]
    _ = F.add (F.mul (F.mul aa bb) uu) aa := by
          rw [newmanMulMulPair F a b a b]
    _ = F.add (F.mul aa (F.mul bb uu)) aa := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.mul aa (F.mul uu bb)) aa := by
          rw [F.mul_comm bb uu]
    _ = F.mul aa (F.add (F.mul uu bb) F.one) := by
          rw [F.mul_add, F.mul_one]
    _ = F.mul aa (F.add F.one (F.mul uu bb)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm]
    _ = F.mul aa (F.add (F.mul uu xx) (F.mul uu bb)) := by
          rw [hux]
    _ = F.mul aa (F.mul uu (F.add xx bb)) := by
          rw [F.mul_add, F.mul_add, F.mul_add]

name: newmanFactor_inverse_second
statement:
private theorem newmanFactor_inverse_second
    {a b x : Point}
    (hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    newmanFactor b (newmanInverseMap a b x) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul b b)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x) (RealTheory.inv x))
          (newmanFactor a x))
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : newmanInverseMap a b x = newmanInverseMap b a x := by
    unfold newmanInverseMap
    rw [RealTheory.mul_comm a b]
  rw [hmap]
  exact newmanFactor_inverse_first (a := b) (b := a) hxne

name: newmanLineRadicand_inverse
statement:
private theorem newmanLineRadicand_inverse
    {a b x : Point}
    (hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    lineRadicand a b (newmanInverseMap a b x) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul a b)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x) (RealTheory.inv x)))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul a b)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x) (RealTheory.inv x))))
        (lineRadicand a b x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let p := F.mul a b
  let uu := F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x)
  let A := newmanFactor a x
  let B := newmanFactor b x
  change
    F.mul
        (newmanFactor a (newmanInverseMap a b x))
        (newmanFactor b (newmanInverseMap a b x)) =
      F.mul (F.mul (F.mul p uu) (F.mul p uu)) (F.mul A B)
  rw [newmanFactor_inverse_first hxne,
    newmanFactor_inverse_second hxne]
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul uu B))
        (F.mul (F.mul b b) (F.mul uu A)) =
      F.mul (F.mul (F.mul p uu) (F.mul p uu)) (F.mul A B)
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul uu B))
        (F.mul (F.mul b b) (F.mul uu A)) =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))
          (F.mul (F.mul uu B) (F.mul uu A)) :=
            newmanMulMulPair F
              (F.mul a a) (F.mul uu B) (F.mul b b) (F.mul uu A)
    _ = F.mul (F.mul p p)
          (F.mul (F.mul uu B) (F.mul uu A)) := by
          rw [newmanMulMulPair F a a b b]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul p p)
          (F.mul (F.mul uu uu) (F.mul B A)) := by
          rw [newmanMulMulPair F uu B uu A]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul p p)
          (F.mul (F.mul uu uu) (F.mul A B)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm B A]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul p p) (F.mul uu uu))
          (F.mul A B) :=
            (F.mul_assoc (F.mul p p) (F.mul uu uu) (F.mul A B)).symm
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (F.mul p uu) (F.mul p uu))
          (F.mul A B) := by
          rw [newmanMulMulPair F p uu p uu]

name: newmanSqrt_sq
statement:
private theorem newmanSqrt_sq
    {z : Point}
    (hz : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero z) :
    RealTheory.mul (newmanSqrt z) (newmanSqrt z) = z
proof:
:= by
  unfold newmanSqrt
  have h :=
    RealFunction.Elementary.powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg 1 hz
  change
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) z)
      (RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1) z) = z
  rw [<- RealFunction.powNat_two]
  exact h

name: newmanSqrtLineRadicand_inverse
statement:
private theorem newmanSqrtLineRadicand_inverse
    {a b x : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero b)
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    newmanSqrt (lineRadicand a b (newmanInverseMap a b x)) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul a b)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x) (RealTheory.inv x)))
        (newmanSqrt (lineRadicand a b x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))
  let r := newmanSqrt (lineRadicand a b x)
  have hxne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hzero.symm
  have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx
  have hq_pos : F.lt F.zero q := by
    unfold q
    exact F.mul_pos (F.mul_pos ha hb) (F.mul_pos hinv_pos hinv_pos)
  have hr_pos : F.lt F.zero r := by
    unfold r
    exact newmanSqrtLineRadicand_pos_of_pos ha hb
  have hcandidate_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul q r) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (F.mul_pos hq_pos hr_pos)
  have hr_sq : F.mul r r = lineRadicand a b x := by
    unfold r
    exact newmanSqrt_sq (newmanLineRadicand_nonneg a b x)
  change
    RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot (1 + 1)
        (lineRadicand a b (newmanInverseMap a b x)) =
      F.mul q r
  refine RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ
    (n := 1) ?_
  refine And.intro hcandidate_nonneg ?_
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul q r) (F.mul q r) =
        F.mul (F.mul q q) (F.mul r r) :=
          newmanMulMulPair F q r q r
    _ = F.mul (F.mul q q) (lineRadicand a b x) := by
          rw [hr_sq]
    _ = lineRadicand a b (newmanInverseMap a b x) :=
          (newmanLineRadicand_inverse hxne).symm

name: newmanInvProduct_mul_left_cancel
statement:
private theorem newmanInvProduct_mul_left_cancel
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {q r : Point}
    (hq : Not (q = F.zero))
    (hr : Not (r = F.zero)) :
    F.mul (F.inv (F.mul q r)) q = F.inv r
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hq hr]
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.inv r) (F.inv q)) q =
        F.mul (F.inv r) (F.mul (F.inv q) q) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv r) F.one := by rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hq]
    _ = F.inv r := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: newmanInverse_pullback
statement:
private theorem newmanInverse_pullback
    {a b x : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b)
    (hx : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    substitutionIntegrand (lineKernel a b)
        (newmanInverseMap a b) (newmanInverseMapDeriv a b) x =
      RealTheory.neg (lineKernel a b x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let q := F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul (F.inv x) (F.inv x))
  let r := newmanSqrt (lineRadicand a b x)
  have ha : F.lt F.zero a := newmanGaussParameter_a_pos h
  have hb : F.lt F.zero b := h.left
  have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx
  have hq_pos : F.lt F.zero q := by
    unfold q
    exact F.mul_pos (F.mul_pos ha hb) (F.mul_pos hinv_pos hinv_pos)
  have hr_pos : F.lt F.zero r := by
    unfold r
    exact newmanSqrtLineRadicand_pos_of_pos ha hb
  have hqne : Not (q = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hq_pos) hzero.symm
  have hrne : Not (r = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hr_pos) hzero.symm
  unfold substitutionIntegrand lineKernel newmanInverseMapDeriv
  change
    F.mul
        (F.inv (newmanSqrt
          (lineRadicand a b (newmanInverseMap a b x))))
        (F.neg q) =
      F.neg (F.inv r)
  rw [newmanSqrtLineRadicand_inverse ha hb hx]
  change F.mul (F.inv (F.mul q r)) (F.neg q) = F.neg (F.inv r)
  calc
    F.mul (F.inv (F.mul q r)) (F.neg q) =
        F.neg (F.mul (F.inv (F.mul q r)) q) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F (F.inv (F.mul q r)) q
    _ = F.neg (F.inv r) := by
          rw [newmanInvProduct_mul_left_cancel F hqne hrne]

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_neg_lineKernel_of_leftEndpoint
statement:
theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_neg_lineKernel_of_leftEndpoint
    {a b K : Point}
    (h : GaussParameter a b) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint
        (lineKernel a b) RealTheory.zero
        (gaussGeometricMean a b) K ->
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.neg (lineKernel a b x))
        (gaussGeometricMean a b) (RealTheory.neg K)
proof:
:= by
  intro hK
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have ha : F.lt F.zero a := newmanGaussParameter_a_pos h
  have hb : F.lt F.zero b := h.left
  have hpull :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf
        (substitutionIntegrand (lineKernel a b)
          (newmanInverseMap a b) (newmanInverseMapDeriv a b))
        (gaussGeometricMean a b) (F.neg K) :=
    hasImproperRiemannIntegralAtPosInf_substitution_strictDecreasing_leftEndpoint
      (newmanInverseSubstitutionData (lineKernel a b) h) hK
  cases hpull with
  | intro P hP =>
      refine Exists.intro P ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ hP.right
      intro x hx
      exact hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_congr_closedInterval_of_le
        hx
        (fun y hy =>
          newmanInverse_pullback h
            (F.lt_of_lt_of_le
              (newmanGeometricMean_pos ha hb) hy.left))
        (hP.left x hx)

name: binary_two_mul_eq_add_self
statement:
private theorem binary_two_mul_eq_add_self (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul twoPoint x = RealTheory.add x x
proof:
:= by
  unfold twoPoint
  rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.one_mul]

name: add_left_comm_binary_base
statement:
private theorem add_left_comm_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x y z : Point) :
    F.add x (F.add y z) = F.add y (F.add x z)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add x (F.add y z) =
        F.add (F.add x y) z := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.add y x) z := by
          rw [F.add_comm x y]
    _ = F.add y (F.add x z) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]

name: mul_left_comm_binary_base
statement:
private theorem mul_left_comm_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x y z : Point) :
    F.mul x (F.mul y z) = F.mul y (F.mul x z)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul x (F.mul y z) =
        F.mul (F.mul x y) z := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul y x) z := by
          rw [F.mul_comm x y]
    _ = F.mul y (F.mul x z) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: mul_mul_pair_eq_binary_base
statement:
private theorem mul_mul_pair_eq_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
      F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
        F.mul a (F.mul b (F.mul c d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul c (F.mul b d)) := by
          rw [mul_left_comm_binary_base F b c d]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: add_add_sub_cancel_same_binary_base
statement:
private theorem add_add_sub_cancel_same_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (A B C : Point) :
    F.add (F.add A C) (F.sub B C) = F.add A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    F.add (F.add A C) (F.add B (F.neg C)) =
        F.add A (F.add C (F.add B (F.neg C))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc A C (F.add B (F.neg C))]
    _ = F.add A (F.add B (F.add C (F.neg C))) := by
          rw [add_left_comm_binary_base F C B (F.neg C)]
    _ = F.add A (F.add B F.zero) := by
          rw [F.add_neg C]
    _ = F.add A B := by
          rw [F.add_zero B]

name: add_four_reorder_binary_base
statement:
private theorem add_four_reorder_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (A B C D : Point) :
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add C B) =
      F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add C B) =
        F.add A (F.add D (F.add C B)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc A D (F.add C B)]
    _ = F.add A (F.add C (F.add D B)) := by
          rw [add_left_comm_binary_base F D C B]
    _ = F.add A (F.add C (F.add B D)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm D B]
    _ = F.add A (F.add B (F.add C D)) := by
          rw [add_left_comm_binary_base F C B D]
    _ = F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc A B (F.add C D)]

name: add_sq_eq_grouped_binary_base
statement:
private theorem add_sq_eq_grouped_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b) =
      F.add
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))
        (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  let A := F.mul a a
  let B := F.mul a b
  let C := F.mul b a
  let D := F.mul b b
  change F.add (F.add A C) (F.add B D) =
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C)
  calc
    F.add (F.add A C) (F.add B D) =
        F.add A (F.add C (F.add B D)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc A C (F.add B D)]
    _ = F.add A (F.add B (F.add C D)) := by
          rw [add_left_comm_binary_base F C B D]
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.add C D) B) := by
          rw [F.add_comm B (F.add C D)]
    _ = F.add A (F.add C (F.add D B)) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc C D B]
    _ = F.add A (F.add D (F.add C B)) := by
          rw [add_left_comm_binary_base F C D B]
    _ = F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C) := by
          rw [F.add_comm C B]
          rw [<- F.add_assoc A D (F.add B C)]

name: sub_sq_eq_binary_base
statement:
private theorem sub_sq_eq_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.mul (F.sub a b) (F.sub a b) =
      F.sub
        (F.add (F.mul a a)
          (F.mul b b))
        (F.add (F.mul a b)
          (F.mul b a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F]
  let aa := F.mul a a
  let ab := F.mul a b
  let ba := F.mul b a
  let bb := F.mul b b
  change
    F.add (F.add aa (F.neg ab)) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb) =
      F.add (F.add aa bb) (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba))
  calc
    F.add (F.add aa (F.neg ab)) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb) =
        F.add aa (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc aa (F.neg ab) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb)]
    _ = F.add aa (F.add (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba)) bb) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba) bb]
    _ = F.add aa (F.add bb (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba))) := by
          rw [F.add_comm (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba)) bb]
    _ = F.add (F.add aa bb) (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba)) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc aa bb (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba))]

name: cross_terms_eq_binary_base
statement:
private theorem cross_terms_eq_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d))
        (F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.mul a b)) =
      F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul c b) (F.mul a d))
        (F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul c b))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d))
        (F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.mul a b)) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d))
          (F.mul (F.mul c a) (F.mul d b)) := by
          rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_binary_base F a b c d]
          rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_binary_base F c d a b]
    _ = F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d))
          (F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm c a]
          rw [F.mul_comm d b]
    _ = F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul c b) (F.mul a d))
        (F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul c b)) := by
          rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_binary_base F c b a d]
          rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_binary_base F a d c b]
          rw [F.mul_comm c a]
          rw [F.mul_comm d b]

name: sum_squares_pair_identity_binary_base
statement:
private theorem sum_squares_pair_identity_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.add
        (F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul a b))
          (F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.mul c d)))
        (F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul c b) (F.mul c b))
          (F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul a d))) =
      F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_binary_base F a b a b]
  rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_binary_base F c d c d]
  rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_binary_base F c b c b]
  rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_binary_base F a d a d]
  let A := F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b)
  let B := F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul d d)
  let C := F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul b b)
  let D := F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul d d)
  change
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add C B) =
      F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d))
  calc
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add C B) =
        F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) := by
          exact add_four_reorder_binary_base F A B C D
    _ = F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d)) := by
          symm
          rw [F.add_mul]
          rw [F.mul_add]
          rw [F.mul_add]

name: rotation_unit_identity_binary_base
statement:
private theorem rotation_unit_identity_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.add
        (F.mul
          (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d))
          (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d)))
        (F.mul
          (F.sub (F.mul c b) (F.mul a d))
          (F.sub (F.mul c b) (F.mul a d))) =
      F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d))
proof:
:= by
  let p := F.mul a b
  let q := F.mul c d
  let r := F.mul c b
  let s := F.mul a d
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.add p q) (F.add p q))
        (F.mul (F.sub r s) (F.sub r s)) =
      F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d))
  rw [add_sq_eq_grouped_binary_base F p q]
  rw [sub_sq_eq_binary_base F r s]
  rw [<- cross_terms_eq_binary_base F a b c d]
  calc
    F.add
        (F.add
          (F.add (F.mul p p) (F.mul q q))
          (F.add (F.mul p q) (F.mul q p)))
        (F.sub
          (F.add (F.mul r r) (F.mul s s))
          (F.add (F.mul p q) (F.mul q p))) =
        F.add
          (F.add (F.mul p p) (F.mul q q))
          (F.add (F.mul r r) (F.mul s s)) := by
          exact add_add_sub_cancel_same_binary_base F
            (F.add (F.mul p p) (F.mul q q))
            (F.add (F.mul r r) (F.mul s s))
            (F.add (F.mul p q) (F.mul q p))
    _ = F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d)) := by
          exact sum_squares_pair_identity_binary_base F a b c d

name: doubleAnglePair_unit_identity
statement:
private theorem doubleAnglePair_unit_identity
    {s c : Point}
    (hunit :
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul s s)
        (RealTheory.mul c c) =
        RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul twoPoint (RealTheory.mul s c))
          (RealTheory.mul twoPoint (RealTheory.mul s c)))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul c c) (RealTheory.mul s s))
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul c c) (RealTheory.mul s s))) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul c c) = F.one at hunit
  change
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul twoPoint (F.mul s c))
          (F.mul twoPoint (F.mul s c)))
        (F.mul
          (F.sub (F.mul c c) (F.mul s s))
          (F.sub (F.mul c c) (F.mul s s))) =
      F.one
  have htwo :
      F.mul twoPoint (F.mul s c) =
        F.add (F.mul s c) (F.mul c s) := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul twoPoint (RealTheory.mul s c) =
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul s c) (RealTheory.mul c s)
    rw [binary_two_mul_eq_add_self]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_comm c s]
  rw [htwo]
  rw [rotation_unit_identity_binary_base F s c c s]
  rw [hunit]
  have hunitRev :
      F.add (F.mul c c) (F.mul s s) = F.one := by
    rw [F.add_comm (F.mul c c) (F.mul s s)]
    exact hunit
  rw [hunitRev]
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: circularPairAdd_assoc_sin_binary_base
statement:
private theorem circularPairAdd_assoc_sin_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d e f : Point) :
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.add (F.mul a d) (F.mul b c)) f)
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul b d) (F.mul a c)) e) =
      F.add
        (F.mul a (F.sub (F.mul d f) (F.mul c e)))
        (F.mul b (F.add (F.mul c f) (F.mul d e)))
proof:
:= by
  let A := F.mul a (F.mul d f)
  let B := F.mul b (F.mul c f)
  let C := F.mul b (F.mul d e)
  let D := F.mul a (F.mul c e)
  have hleft :
      F.add
          (F.mul (F.add (F.mul a d) (F.mul b c)) f)
          (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul b d) (F.mul a c)) e) =
        F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C (F.neg D)) := by
    unfold A B C D
    rw [F.add_mul]
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [F.add_mul]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F]
    rw [F.mul_assoc a d f]
    rw [F.mul_assoc b c f]
    rw [F.mul_assoc b d e]
    rw [F.mul_assoc a c e]
  have hright :
      F.add
          (F.mul a (F.sub (F.mul d f) (F.mul c e)))
          (F.mul b (F.add (F.mul c f) (F.mul d e))) =
        F.add (F.add A (F.neg D)) (F.add B C) := by
    unfold A B C D
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [F.mul_add]
    rw [F.mul_add]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F]
  have hreorder :
      F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C (F.neg D)) =
        F.add (F.add A (F.neg D)) (F.add B C) := by
    have h := add_four_reorder_binary_base F A (F.neg D) C B
    rwa [F.add_comm C B] at h
  exact Eq.trans hleft (Eq.trans hreorder (Eq.symm hright))

name: circularPairAdd_assoc_cos_binary_base
statement:
private theorem circularPairAdd_assoc_cos_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d e f : Point) :
    F.sub
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul b d) (F.mul a c)) f)
        (F.mul (F.add (F.mul a d) (F.mul b c)) e) =
      F.sub
        (F.mul b (F.sub (F.mul d f) (F.mul c e)))
        (F.mul a (F.add (F.mul c f) (F.mul d e)))
proof:
:= by
  let A := F.mul b (F.mul d f)
  let B := F.mul a (F.mul c f)
  let C := F.mul a (F.mul d e)
  let D := F.mul b (F.mul c e)
  have hleft :
      F.sub
          (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul b d) (F.mul a c)) f)
          (F.mul (F.add (F.mul a d) (F.mul b c)) e) =
        F.add (F.add A (F.neg B))
          (F.add (F.neg C) (F.neg D)) := by
    unfold A B C D
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [F.add_mul]
    rw [F.add_mul]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F]
    rw [F.mul_assoc b d f]
    rw [F.mul_assoc a c f]
    rw [F.mul_assoc a d e]
    rw [F.mul_assoc b c e]
  have hright :
      F.sub
          (F.mul b (F.sub (F.mul d f) (F.mul c e)))
          (F.mul a (F.add (F.mul c f) (F.mul d e))) =
        F.add (F.add A (F.neg D))
          (F.add (F.neg B) (F.neg C)) := by
    unfold A B C D
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [F.mul_add]
    rw [F.mul_add]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F]
  have hreorder :
      F.add (F.add A (F.neg B))
          (F.add (F.neg C) (F.neg D)) =
        F.add (F.add A (F.neg D))
          (F.add (F.neg B) (F.neg C)) := by
    have h :=
      add_four_reorder_binary_base F A (F.neg D) (F.neg C) (F.neg B)
    rwa [F.add_comm (F.neg C) (F.neg B)] at h
  exact Eq.trans hleft (Eq.trans hreorder (Eq.symm hright))

name: circularPairAdd_assoc
statement:
theorem circularPairAdd_assoc
    (p q r : CircularPair) :
    circularPairAdd (circularPairAdd p q) r =
      circularPairAdd p (circularPairAdd q r)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · change
      circularPairSin (circularPairAdd (circularPairAdd p q) r) =
        circularPairSin (circularPairAdd p (circularPairAdd q r))
    rw [circularPairAdd_sin]
    rw [circularPairAdd_cos]
    rw [circularPairAdd_sin]
    rw [circularPairAdd_sin]
    rw [circularPairAdd_cos]
    rw [circularPairAdd_sin]
    exact circularPairAdd_assoc_sin_binary_base
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (circularPairSin p) (circularPairCos p)
      (circularPairSin q) (circularPairCos q)
      (circularPairSin r) (circularPairCos r)
  · change
      circularPairCos (circularPairAdd (circularPairAdd p q) r) =
        circularPairCos (circularPairAdd p (circularPairAdd q r))
    rw [circularPairAdd_cos]
    rw [circularPairAdd_cos]
    rw [circularPairAdd_sin]
    rw [circularPairAdd_cos]
    rw [circularPairAdd_cos]
    rw [circularPairAdd_sin]
    exact circularPairAdd_assoc_cos_binary_base
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (circularPairSin p) (circularPairCos p)
      (circularPairSin q) (circularPairCos q)
      (circularPairSin r) (circularPairCos r)

statement:

name: doubleAnglePair_circularPairAdd
statement:
theorem doubleAnglePair_circularPairAdd
    (p q : CircularPair) :
    doubleAnglePair (circularPairAdd p q) =
      circularPairAdd (doubleAnglePair p) (doubleAnglePair q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [doubleAnglePair_eq_circularPairAdd_self]
  rw [doubleAnglePair_eq_circularPairAdd_self p]
  rw [doubleAnglePair_eq_circularPairAdd_self q]
  calc
    circularPairAdd (circularPairAdd p q) (circularPairAdd p q) =
        circularPairAdd p
          (circularPairAdd q (circularPairAdd p q)) := by
          rw [circularPairAdd_assoc]
    _ = circularPairAdd p
          (circularPairAdd (circularPairAdd p q) q) := by
          rw [circularPairAdd_comm q (circularPairAdd p q)]
    _ = circularPairAdd p
          (circularPairAdd p (circularPairAdd q q)) := by
          rw [circularPairAdd_assoc]
    _ = circularPairAdd (circularPairAdd p p)
          (circularPairAdd q q) := by
          rw [<- circularPairAdd_assoc]

name: double_binaryScale_succ_base
statement:
private theorem double_binaryScale_succ_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x P two : Point)
    (hP : Not (P = F.zero))
    (htwo : Not (two = F.zero)) :
    F.mul two (F.mul x (F.inv (F.mul P two))) =
      F.mul x (F.inv P)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv :
      F.inv (F.mul P two) =
        F.mul (F.inv P) (F.inv two) := by
    have hraw : F.inv (F.mul P two) =
        F.mul (F.inv two) (F.inv P) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hP htwo
    rw [hraw]
    exact F.mul_comm (F.inv two) (F.inv P)
  rw [hinv]
  calc
    F.mul two (F.mul x (F.mul (F.inv P) (F.inv two))) =
        F.mul x (F.mul two (F.mul (F.inv P) (F.inv two))) := by
          rw [mul_left_comm_binary_base F two x
            (F.mul (F.inv P) (F.inv two))]
    _ = F.mul x (F.mul (F.inv P) (F.mul two (F.inv two))) := by
          rw [mul_left_comm_binary_base F two (F.inv P) (F.inv two)]
    _ = F.mul x (F.mul (F.inv P) F.one) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel htwo]
    _ = F.mul x (F.inv P) := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x (twoPow n) twoPoint
    (twoPow_ne_zero n) twoPoint_ne_zero

  | intro n hn =>
      refine Exists.intro n ?_

          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat n) (twoPow n) := by
        unfold twoPow twoPoint

        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hn hnat_le_pow

name: mul_inv_lt_of_mul_inv_lt_binary_base
statement:
private theorem mul_inv_lt_of_mul_inv_lt_binary_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {A eps P : Point}
    (heps : F.lt F.zero eps)
    (hP : F.lt F.zero P)
    (hAP : F.lt (F.mul A (F.inv eps)) P) :
    F.lt (F.mul A (F.inv P)) eps
proof:
:= by
  have heps_ne : Not (eps = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F heps) h.symm
  have hP_ne : Not (P = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hP) h.symm
  have hmul_eps :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (F.mul A (F.inv eps)) eps)
        (F.mul P eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hAP heps
  have hleft :
      F.mul (F.mul A (F.inv eps)) eps = A :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right F A heps_ne
  rw [hleft] at hmul_eps
  have hinvP_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv P) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hP
  have hmul_inv :
      F.lt (F.mul A (F.inv P))
        (F.mul (F.mul P eps) (F.inv P)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hmul_eps hinvP_pos
  have hright :
      F.mul (F.mul P eps) (F.inv P) = eps := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul P eps) (F.inv P) =
          F.mul (F.mul eps P) (F.inv P) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm P eps]
      _ = eps := by
            exact
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_mul_inv_cancel_right
                F eps hP_ne
  rwa [hright] at hmul_inv

name: abs_binaryScale_eq_abs_mul_inv_twoPow
statement:
private theorem abs_binaryScale_eq_abs_mul_inv_twoPow
    (x : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.abs (binaryScale x n) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs x)
        (RealTheory.inv (twoPow n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold binaryScale
  change
    RealTheory.abs (F.mul x (RealTheory.inv (twoPow n))) =
      F.mul (RealTheory.abs x) (RealTheory.inv (twoPow n))
  rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
  have hinv_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv (twoPow n)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (twoPow_pos n)
  have hinv_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv (twoPow n)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hinv_pos
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hinv_nonneg]

name: principalAngle_of_abs_lt_halfPi
statement:
private theorem principalAngle_of_abs_lt_halfPi
    {z : Point}
    (hz : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs z) halfPi) :
    PrincipalAngleInterval z
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PrincipalAngleInterval RealTheory.ClosedInterval
  change And (F.le (F.neg halfPi) z) (F.le z halfPi)
  have hz_upper : F.le z halfPi :=
    F.le_trans (RealTheory.le_abs_self z)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hz)
  have hnegz_upper : F.le (F.neg z) halfPi :=
    F.le_trans (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self z)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hz)
  have hz_lower_raw : F.le (F.neg halfPi) (F.neg (F.neg z)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hnegz_upper
  have hz_lower : F.le (F.neg halfPi) z := by
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F z] at hz_lower_raw
  exact And.intro hz_lower hz_upper

name: principalAngle_of_abs_le_halfPi
statement:
private theorem principalAngle_of_abs_le_halfPi
    {z : Point}
    (hz : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs z) halfPi) :
    PrincipalAngleInterval z
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PrincipalAngleInterval RealTheory.ClosedInterval
  change And (F.le (F.neg halfPi) z) (F.le z halfPi)
  have hz_upper : F.le z halfPi :=
    F.le_trans (RealTheory.le_abs_self z) hz
  have hnegz_upper : F.le (F.neg z) halfPi :=
    F.le_trans (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self z) hz
  have hz_lower_raw : F.le (F.neg halfPi) (F.neg (F.neg z)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hnegz_upper
  have hz_lower : F.le (F.neg halfPi) z := by
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F z] at hz_lower_raw
  exact And.intro hz_lower hz_upper

name: abs_le_halfPi_of_principalAngle
statement:
private theorem abs_le_halfPi_of_principalAngle
    {z : Point}
    (hz : PrincipalAngleInterval z) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs z) halfPi
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PrincipalAngleInterval RealTheory.ClosedInterval at hz
  change And (F.le (F.neg halfPi) z) (F.le z halfPi) at hz
  have hnegz_upper_raw :
      F.le (F.neg z) (F.neg (F.neg halfPi)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hz.left
  have hnegz_upper : F.le (F.neg z) halfPi := by
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F halfPi] at hnegz_upper_raw
  exact RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hz.right hnegz_upper

name: binaryScale_mem_principalAngle_of_twoPow_gt
statement:
theorem binaryScale_mem_principalAngle_of_twoPow_gt
    {x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hpow :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs x) (RealTheory.inv halfPi))
        (twoPow n)) :
    PrincipalAngleInterval (binaryScale x n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hscaled :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (RealTheory.abs x) (F.inv (twoPow n)))
        halfPi :=
    mul_inv_lt_of_mul_inv_lt_binary_base F
      halfPi_pos (twoPow_pos n) hpow
  have habs :
      RealTheory.abs (binaryScale x n) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs x)
          (RealTheory.inv (twoPow n)) :=
    abs_binaryScale_eq_abs_mul_inv_twoPow x n
  have hscale_abs :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs (binaryScale x n)) halfPi := by
    rw [habs]
    exact hscaled
  exact principalAngle_of_abs_lt_halfPi hscale_abs

name: exists_binaryScale_mem_principalAngle
statement:
theorem exists_binaryScale_mem_principalAngle
    (x : Point) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat =>
      PrincipalAngleInterval (binaryScale x n))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_twoPow_gt
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs x) (RealTheory.inv halfPi)) with
  | intro n hpow =>
      exact Exists.intro n
        (binaryScale_mem_principalAngle_of_twoPow_gt hpow)

name: le_add_nonneg_right_binary
statement:
private theorem le_add_nonneg_right_binary
    {a b : Point}
    (hb : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero b) :
    RealTheory.le a (RealTheory.add a b)
proof:
:= by
  have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_left hb a
  rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h

name: le_add_nonneg_left_binary
statement:
private theorem le_add_nonneg_left_binary
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero a) :
    RealTheory.le b (RealTheory.add a b)
proof:
:= by
  have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_right ha b
  rwa [RealTheory.zero_add] at h

name: add_nonneg_binary
statement:
private theorem add_nonneg_binary
    {a b : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero a)
    (hb : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero b) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.add a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.le F.zero (F.add a b)
  have h : F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero) (F.add a b) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F ha hb
  rwa [F.zero_add] at h

name: mul_inv_halfPi_lt_twoPow_of_le_bound
statement:
private theorem mul_inv_halfPi_lt_twoPow_of_le_bound
    {A B P : Point}
    (hAB : RealTheory.le A B)
    (hBP :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul B (RealTheory.inv halfPi)) P) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul A (RealTheory.inv halfPi)) P
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv halfPi) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F halfPi_pos
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv halfPi) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinv_pos
  have hle :
      F.le (F.mul A (F.inv halfPi))
        (F.mul B (F.inv halfPi)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F hAB hinv_nonneg
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle hBP

name: exists_binaryScale_mem_principalAngle_add_common
statement:
theorem exists_binaryScale_mem_principalAngle_add_common
    (x y : Point) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat =>
      And (PrincipalAngleInterval (binaryScale x n))
        (And
          (PrincipalAngleInterval (binaryScale y n))
          (PrincipalAngleInterval
            (binaryScale (RealTheory.add x y) n))))
proof:
:= by
  let B := binaryCommonEntryBound x y
  cases exists_twoPow_gt
      (RealTheory.mul B (RealTheory.inv halfPi)) with
  | intro n hpow =>
      have habsx_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.abs x) :=
        RealTheory.abs_nonneg x
      have habsy_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.abs y) :=
        RealTheory.abs_nonneg y
      have habsxy_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.add x y)) :=
        RealTheory.abs_nonneg (RealTheory.add x y)
      have htail_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs y)
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.add x y))) :=
        add_nonneg_binary habsy_nonneg habsxy_nonneg
      have hx_le_B :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs x) B := by
        unfold B binaryCommonEntryBound
        exact le_add_nonneg_right_binary htail_nonneg
      have hy_le_tail :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs y)
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs y)
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.add x y))) :=
        le_add_nonneg_right_binary habsxy_nonneg
      have htail_le_B :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs y)
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.add x y))) B := by
        unfold B binaryCommonEntryBound
        exact le_add_nonneg_left_binary habsx_nonneg
      have hy_le_B :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs y) B :=
        RealTheory.le_trans hy_le_tail htail_le_B
      have hxy_le_tail :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.add x y))
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs y)
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.add x y))) :=
        le_add_nonneg_left_binary habsy_nonneg
      have hxy_le_B :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.add x y)) B :=
        RealTheory.le_trans hxy_le_tail htail_le_B
      have hxpow :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs x)
              (RealTheory.inv halfPi))
            (twoPow n) :=
        mul_inv_halfPi_lt_twoPow_of_le_bound hx_le_B hpow
      have hypow :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs y)
              (RealTheory.inv halfPi))
            (twoPow n) :=
        mul_inv_halfPi_lt_twoPow_of_le_bound hy_le_B hpow
      have hxypow :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.add x y))
              (RealTheory.inv halfPi))
            (twoPow n) :=
        mul_inv_halfPi_lt_twoPow_of_le_bound hxy_le_B hpow
      exact Exists.intro n
        (And.intro
          (binaryScale_mem_principalAngle_of_twoPow_gt hxpow)
          (And.intro
            (binaryScale_mem_principalAngle_of_twoPow_gt hypow)
            (binaryScale_mem_principalAngle_of_twoPow_gt hxypow)))

name: abs_twoPoint_mul_eq_twoPoint_abs
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    RealTheory.abs (F.mul twoPoint z) =
      F.mul twoPoint (RealTheory.abs z)
  rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
  have htwo_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero twoPoint :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base twoPoint_pos
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg htwo_nonneg]

name: le_twoPoint_mul_of_nonneg
statement:
private theorem le_twoPoint_mul_of_nonneg
    {a : Point}
    (ha : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero a) :
    RealTheory.le a (RealTheory.mul twoPoint a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [binary_two_mul_eq_add_self a]

name: principalAngle_halve_of_double_principal
statement:
private theorem principalAngle_halve_of_double_principal
    {z doubled : Point}
    (hdouble : RealTheory.mul twoPoint z = doubled)
    (hdoubled : PrincipalAngleInterval doubled) :
    PrincipalAngleInterval z
proof:
:= by
  have hdoubled_abs :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs doubled) halfPi :=
    abs_le_halfPi_of_principalAngle hdoubled
  have htwo_abs :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.mul twoPoint z)) halfPi := by
    rw [hdouble]
    exact hdoubled_abs
  have hscaled_abs :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul twoPoint (RealTheory.abs z)) halfPi := by
    rwa [abs_twoPoint_mul_eq_twoPoint_abs z] at htwo_abs
  have hz_le_scaled :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs z)
        (RealTheory.mul twoPoint (RealTheory.abs z)) :=
    le_twoPoint_mul_of_nonneg (RealTheory.abs_nonneg z)
  have hz_abs_le :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs z) halfPi :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hz_le_scaled hscaled_abs
  exact principalAngle_of_abs_le_halfPi hz_abs_le

name: binaryCircularEntry_succ_of_entry
statement:
theorem binaryCircularEntry_succ_of_entry
    {x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hentry : BinaryCircularEntry x n) :
    BinaryCircularEntry x (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold BinaryCircularEntry at hentry ⊢
  exact principalAngle_halve_of_double_principal
    (binaryScale_doubling_step x n) hentry

name: binaryCircularCandidate_succ_eq_of_entry
statement:
theorem binaryCircularCandidate_succ_eq_of_entry
    {x : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hentry : BinaryCircularEntry x n) :
    binaryCircularCandidate x (n + 1) =
      binaryCircularCandidate x n
proof:
:= by
  have hnext : BinaryCircularEntry x (n + 1) :=
    binaryCircularEntry_succ_of_entry hentry
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.add (binaryScale x (n + 1))
          (binaryScale x (n + 1)) =
        binaryScale x n := by
    calc
      RealTheory.add (binaryScale x (n + 1))
          (binaryScale x (n + 1)) =
          RealTheory.mul twoPoint (binaryScale x (n + 1)) := by
            exact Eq.symm
              (binary_two_mul_eq_add_self
                (binaryScale x (n + 1)))
      _ = binaryScale x n := by
            exact binaryScale_doubling_step x n
  have hsumEntry :
      PrincipalAngleInterval
        (RealTheory.add (binaryScale x (n + 1))
          (binaryScale x (n + 1))) := by
    rw [hsum]
    exact hentry
  have hdouble :
      doubleAnglePair
          (principalCircularPair (binaryScale x (n + 1))) =
        principalCircularPair (binaryScale x n) := by
    have hraw :=
      doubleAnglePair_principalCircularPair_eq_principalCircularPair_double
        hnext hsumEntry
    rwa [hsum] at hraw
  unfold binaryCircularCandidate
  rw [doubleAnglePairIter_succ]
  rw [<- doubleAnglePairIter_doubleAnglePair n
    (principalCircularPair (binaryScale x (n + 1)))]
  rw [hdouble]

name: binaryCircularEntry_add_of_entry
statement:
theorem binaryCircularEntry_add_of_entry
    (x : Point) (n k : Nat)
    (hentry : BinaryCircularEntry x n) :
    BinaryCircularEntry x (n + k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      rwa [Nat.add_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [Nat.add_succ]
      exact binaryCircularEntry_succ_of_entry ih

name: binaryCircularCandidate_add_eq_of_entry
statement:
theorem binaryCircularCandidate_add_eq_of_entry
    (x : Point) (n k : Nat)
    (hentry : BinaryCircularEntry x n) :
    binaryCircularCandidate x (n + k) =
      binaryCircularCandidate x n
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      rw [Nat.add_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
      have hentry_nk :
          BinaryCircularEntry x (n + k) :=
        binaryCircularEntry_add_of_entry x n k hentry
      have hsucc :
          binaryCircularCandidate x ((n + k) + 1) =
            binaryCircularCandidate x (n + k) :=
        binaryCircularCandidate_succ_eq_of_entry hentry_nk
      rw [Nat.add_succ]
      exact Eq.trans hsucc ih

name: binaryCircularCandidate_eq_of_entries
statement:
theorem binaryCircularCandidate_eq_of_entries
    {x : Point} {m n : Nat}
    (hm : BinaryCircularEntry x m)
    (hn : BinaryCircularEntry x n) :
    binaryCircularCandidate x m =
      binaryCircularCandidate x n
proof:
:= by
  have hm_ref :
      binaryCircularCandidate x (m + n) =
        binaryCircularCandidate x m :=
    binaryCircularCandidate_add_eq_of_entry x m n hm
  have hn_ref :
      binaryCircularCandidate x (n + m) =
        binaryCircularCandidate x n :=
    binaryCircularCandidate_add_eq_of_entry x n m hn
  have hcommon :
      binaryCircularCandidate x (m + n) =
        binaryCircularCandidate x (n + m) := by
    rw [Nat.add_comm]
  exact Eq.trans (Eq.symm hm_ref) (Eq.trans hcommon hn_ref)

name: binaryCircularCandidate_add_eq_circularPairAdd_of_common_entry
statement:
theorem binaryCircularCandidate_add_eq_circularPairAdd_of_common_entry
    {x y : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hx : BinaryCircularEntry x n)
    (hy : BinaryCircularEntry y n)
    (hxy : BinaryCircularEntry (RealTheory.add x y) n) :
    binaryCircularCandidate (RealTheory.add x y) n =
      circularPairAdd (binaryCircularCandidate x n)
        (binaryCircularCandidate y n)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      PrincipalAngleInterval
        (RealTheory.add (binaryScale x n) (binaryScale y n)) := by
    rw [<- binaryScale_add x y n]
    exact hxy
  have hprincipal :
      principalCircularPair (binaryScale (RealTheory.add x y) n) =
        circularPairAdd (principalCircularPair (binaryScale x n))
          (principalCircularPair (binaryScale y n)) := by
    rw [binaryScale_add x y n]
    exact principalCircularPair_add hx hy hsum
  unfold binaryCircularCandidate
  rw [hprincipal]
  rw [doubleAnglePairIter_circularPairAdd]

name: binaryCircularCandidate_onUnitCircle

theorem binaryCircularCandidate_onUnitCircle
