    (principalCircularPair_onUnitCircle hentry)

name: IsCircularValue_unique
statement:
theorem IsCircularValue_unique
    {x s1 c1 s2 c2 : Point}
    (h1 : IsCircularValue x s1 c1)
    (h2 : IsCircularValue x s2 c2) :
    And (s1 = s2) (c1 = c2)
proof:
:= by
  cases h1 with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases h2 with
      | intro m hm =>
          have hcand :
              binaryCircularCandidate x n =
                binaryCircularCandidate x m :=
            binaryCircularCandidate_eq_of_entries hn.left hm.left
          have hpair : (s1, c1) = (s2, c2) := by
            calc
              (s1, c1) = binaryCircularCandidate x n := by
                  exact Eq.symm hn.right
              _ = binaryCircularCandidate x m := by
                  exact hcand
              _ = (s2, c2) := by
                  exact hm.right
          have hsraw := congrArg Prod.fst hpair
          have hcraw := congrArg Prod.snd hpair
          change s1 = s2 at hsraw
          change c1 = c2 at hcraw
          exact And.intro hsraw hcraw

name: isCircularValue_pair_unique
statement:
theorem isCircularValue_pair_unique
    {x : Point} {p q : CircularPair}
    (hp :
      IsCircularValue x (circularPairSin p) (circularPairCos p))
    (hq :
      IsCircularValue x (circularPairSin q) (circularPairCos q)) :
    p = q
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | mk ps pc =>
      cases q with
      | mk qs qc =>
          have h := IsCircularValue_unique hp hq
          change And (ps = qs) (pc = qc) at h
          cases h.left
          cases h.right
          rfl

name: circularValuePair_spec
statement:
theorem circularValuePair_spec (x : Point) :
    IsCircularValue x
      (circularPairSin (circularValuePair x))
      (circularPairCos (circularValuePair x))
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_isCircularValue x)

name: isCircularValue_sinGeom_cosGeom
statement:
theorem isCircularValue_sinGeom_cosGeom (x : Point) :
    IsCircularValue x (sinGeom x) (cosGeom x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sinGeom cosGeom
  exact circularValuePair_spec x

name: circularValuePair_onUnitCircle
statement:
theorem circularValuePair_onUnitCircle (x : Point) :
    OnUnitCircle (circularValuePair x)
proof:
:= by
  cases circularValuePair_spec x with
  | intro n hn =>
      have hcand :
          OnUnitCircle (binaryCircularCandidate x n) :=
        binaryCircularCandidate_onUnitCircle hn.left
      have hpair :
          binaryCircularCandidate x n = circularValuePair x := by
        calc
          binaryCircularCandidate x n =
              (circularPairSin (circularValuePair x),
                circularPairCos (circularValuePair x)) := hn.right
          _ = circularValuePair x := circularPair_eta (circularValuePair x)
      rwa [hpair] at hcand

name: sinGeom_sq_add_cosGeom_sq
statement:
theorem sinGeom_sq_add_cosGeom_sq (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (sinGeom x) (sinGeom x))
        (RealTheory.mul (cosGeom x) (cosGeom x)) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hunit := circularValuePair_onUnitCircle x
  unfold OnUnitCircle at hunit
  unfold sinGeom cosGeom
  exact hunit

name: circularValuePair_add
statement:
theorem circularValuePair_add (x y : Point) :
    circularValuePair (RealTheory.add x y) =
      circularPairAdd (circularValuePair x) (circularValuePair y)
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_binaryScale_mem_principalAngle_add_common x y with
  | intro n hn =>
      have hx : BinaryCircularEntry x n := hn.left
      have hy : BinaryCircularEntry y n := hn.right.left
      have hxy : BinaryCircularEntry (RealTheory.add x y) n :=
        hn.right.right
      have hxpair :
          circularValuePair x = binaryCircularCandidate x n :=
        isCircularValue_pair_unique
          (circularValuePair_spec x)
          (isCircularValue_of_entry hx)
      have hypair :
          circularValuePair y = binaryCircularCandidate y n :=
        isCircularValue_pair_unique
          (circularValuePair_spec y)
          (isCircularValue_of_entry hy)
      have hxypair :
          circularValuePair (RealTheory.add x y) =
            binaryCircularCandidate (RealTheory.add x y) n :=
        isCircularValue_pair_unique
          (circularValuePair_spec (RealTheory.add x y))
          (isCircularValue_of_entry hxy)
      have hcand :
          binaryCircularCandidate (RealTheory.add x y) n =
            circularPairAdd (binaryCircularCandidate x n)
              (binaryCircularCandidate y n) :=
        binaryCircularCandidate_add_eq_circularPairAdd_of_common_entry
          hx hy hxy
      calc
        circularValuePair (RealTheory.add x y) =
            binaryCircularCandidate (RealTheory.add x y) n := hxypair
        _ = circularPairAdd (binaryCircularCandidate x n)
              (binaryCircularCandidate y n) := hcand
        _ = circularPairAdd (circularValuePair x)
              (circularValuePair y) := by
              rw [<- hxpair, <- hypair]

name: sinGeom_add
statement:
theorem sinGeom_add (x y : Point) :
    sinGeom (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (sinGeom x) (cosGeom y))
        (RealTheory.mul (cosGeom x) (sinGeom y))
proof:
:= by
  unfold sinGeom cosGeom
  have h := congrArg circularPairSin (circularValuePair_add x y)
  rw [circularPairAdd_sin] at h
  exact h

name: cosGeom_add
statement:
theorem cosGeom_add (x y : Point) :
    cosGeom (RealTheory.add x y) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (cosGeom x) (cosGeom y))
        (RealTheory.mul (sinGeom x) (sinGeom y))
proof:
:= by
  unfold sinGeom cosGeom
  have h := congrArg circularPairCos (circularValuePair_add x y)
  rw [circularPairAdd_cos] at h
  exact h

name: sinGeom_eq_sinPrincipal_of_principal
statement:
theorem sinGeom_eq_sinPrincipal_of_principal
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PrincipalAngleInterval x) :
    sinGeom x = sinPrincipal x
proof:
:= by
  have hunique :=
    IsCircularValue_unique
      (isCircularValue_sinGeom_cosGeom x)
      (isCircularValue_principal_of_principalAngle hx)
  exact hunique.left

name: cosGeom_eq_cosPrincipal_of_principal
statement:
theorem cosGeom_eq_cosPrincipal_of_principal
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PrincipalAngleInterval x) :
    cosGeom x = cosPrincipal x
proof:
:= by
  have hunique :=
    IsCircularValue_unique
      (isCircularValue_sinGeom_cosGeom x)
      (isCircularValue_principal_of_principalAngle hx)
  exact hunique.right

name: sinGeom_cosGeom_local_order
statement:
theorem sinGeom_cosGeom_local_order :
    RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularLocalOrder sinGeom cosGeom
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealFunction.Trigonometric.CircularLocalOrder
  refine Exists.intro halfPi ?_
  refine And.intro halfPi_pos ?_
  intro x hx0 hxhalf
  have hxPrincipal : PrincipalAngleInterval x :=
    principalAngle_of_pos_lt_halfPi hx0 hxhalf
  have hcosPos : F.lt F.zero (cosGeom x) := by
    rw [cosGeom_eq_cosPrincipal_of_principal hxPrincipal]
    exact cosPrincipal_pos_of_pos_lt_halfPi hxPrincipal hx0 hxhalf
  have hmulPos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.mul x (cosGeom x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hx0 hcosPos
  have hmulLtSin :
      F.lt (F.mul x (cosGeom x)) (sinGeom x) := by
    rw [cosGeom_eq_cosPrincipal_of_principal hxPrincipal]
    rw [sinGeom_eq_sinPrincipal_of_principal hxPrincipal]
    exact
      self_mul_cosPrincipal_lt_sinPrincipal_of_pos_lt_halfPi
        hxPrincipal hx0 hxhalf
  have hsinLt :
      F.lt (sinGeom x) x := by
    rw [sinGeom_eq_sinPrincipal_of_principal hxPrincipal]
    exact sinPrincipal_lt_self_of_pos_lt_halfPi
      hxPrincipal hx0 hxhalf
  exact And.intro hmulPos (And.intro hmulLtSin hsinLt)

name: add_left_comm_base
statement:
private theorem add_left_comm_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x y z : Point) :
    F.add x (F.add y z) = F.add y (F.add x z)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add x (F.add y z) =
        F.add (F.add x y) z := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.add y x) z := by
          rw [F.add_comm x y]
    _ = F.add y (F.add x z) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]

name: mul_left_comm_base
statement:
private theorem mul_left_comm_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x y z : Point) :
    F.mul x (F.mul y z) = F.mul y (F.mul x z)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul x (F.mul y z) =
        F.mul (F.mul x y) z := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul y x) z := by
          rw [F.mul_comm x y]
    _ = F.mul y (F.mul x z) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: mul_mul_pair_eq_base
statement:
private theorem mul_mul_pair_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
      F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
        F.mul a (F.mul b (F.mul c d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul c (F.mul b d)) := by
          rw [mul_left_comm_base F b c d]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: half_one_mul_add_self_eq_base
statement:
private theorem half_one_mul_add_self_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x : Point) :
    F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one)
      (F.add x x) = x
proof:
:= by
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
  calc
    F.mul h (F.add x x) =
        F.add (F.mul h x) (F.mul h x) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
    _ = F.mul (F.add h h) x := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.mul F.one x := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F F.one]
    _ = x := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: add_add_add_neg_cancel_base
statement:
private theorem add_add_add_neg_cancel_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (y z : Point) :
    F.add (F.add y y) (F.add z (F.neg y)) =
      F.add y z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.add y y) (F.add z (F.neg y)) =
        F.add y (F.add y (F.add z (F.neg y))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add y (F.add z (F.add y (F.neg y))) := by
          rw [add_left_comm_base F y z (F.neg y)]
    _ = F.add y (F.add z F.zero) := by
          rw [F.add_neg]
    _ = F.add y z := by
          rw [F.add_zero]

name: chord_scaled_term_eq_base
statement:
private theorem chord_scaled_term_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {y S : Point}
    (hy_ne : Not (y = F.zero)) :
    let h
proof:
:= IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
    let c := F.mul (F.inv y) (F.sub S F.one)
    F.mul c (F.mul h (F.mul y y)) =
      F.mul h (F.mul y (F.sub S F.one)) := by
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
  let c := F.mul (F.inv y) (F.sub S F.one)
  change
    F.mul c (F.mul h (F.mul y y)) =
      F.mul h (F.mul y (F.sub S F.one))
  calc
    F.mul c (F.mul h (F.mul y y)) =
        F.mul h (F.mul c (F.mul y y)) := by
          rw [mul_left_comm_base F c h (F.mul y y)]
    _ = F.mul h
        (F.mul
          (F.mul (F.inv y) y)
          (F.mul (F.sub S F.one) y)) := by
          unfold c
          rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_base F
            (F.inv y) (F.sub S F.one) y y]
    _ = F.mul h
        (F.mul F.one (F.mul (F.sub S F.one) y)) := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hy_ne]
    _ = F.mul h (F.mul (F.sub S F.one) y) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.mul h (F.mul y (F.sub S F.one)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub S F.one) y]

name: add_half_mul_sub_one_eq_half_mul_add_one_base
statement:
private theorem add_half_mul_sub_one_eq_half_mul_add_one_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (y S : Point) :
    let h
proof:
:= IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
    F.add y (F.mul h (F.mul y (F.sub S F.one))) =
      F.mul h (F.mul y (F.add F.one S)) := by
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
  change
    F.add y (F.mul h (F.mul y (F.sub S F.one))) =
      F.mul h (F.mul y (F.add F.one S))
  have hy_half :
      y = F.mul h (F.add y y) := by
    exact Eq.symm (half_one_mul_add_self_eq_base F y)
  calc
    F.add y (F.mul h (F.mul y (F.sub S F.one))) =
        F.add (F.mul h (F.add y y))
          (F.mul h (F.mul y (F.sub S F.one))) := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun z : Point =>
              F.add z (F.mul h (F.mul y (F.sub S F.one))))
            hy_half
    _ = F.mul h
        (F.add (F.add y y) (F.mul y (F.sub S F.one))) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_add]
    _ = F.mul h (F.mul y (F.add F.one S)) := by
          congr 1
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F y S F.one]
          rw [F.mul_one]
          rw [F.mul_add]
          rw [F.mul_one]
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
          exact add_add_add_neg_cancel_base F y (F.mul y S)

name: add_half_mul_affine_coeff_eq_half_mul_endpoint_base
statement:
private theorem add_half_mul_affine_coeff_eq_half_mul_endpoint_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x c : Point) :
    let h
proof:
:= IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
    F.add x (F.mul c (F.mul h (F.mul x x))) =
      F.mul h
        (F.mul x
          (F.add F.one (F.add F.one (F.mul c x)))) := by
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
  have hx_half :
      x = F.mul h (F.add x x) :=
    Eq.symm (half_one_mul_add_self_eq_base F x)
  have hcoeff :
      F.mul c (F.mul h (F.mul x x)) =
        F.mul h (F.mul x (F.mul c x)) := by
    calc
      F.mul c (F.mul h (F.mul x x)) =
          F.mul (F.mul c h) (F.mul x x) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul h c) (F.mul x x) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm c h]
      _ = F.mul h (F.mul c (F.mul x x)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul h (F.mul (F.mul c x) x) := by
            congr 1
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul h (F.mul x (F.mul c x)) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.mul c x) x]
  have hinner :
      F.add (F.add x x) (F.mul x (F.mul c x)) =
        F.mul x
          (F.add F.one (F.add F.one (F.mul c x))) := by
    have hrev :
        F.mul x
            (F.add F.one (F.add F.one (F.mul c x))) =
          F.add (F.add x x) (F.mul x (F.mul c x)) := by
      calc
        F.mul x
            (F.add F.one (F.add F.one (F.mul c x))) =
            F.add (F.mul x F.one)
              (F.mul x (F.add F.one (F.mul c x))) := by
              rw [F.mul_add]
        _ = F.add x
              (F.mul x (F.add F.one (F.mul c x))) := by
              rw [F.mul_one]
        _ = F.add x
              (F.add (F.mul x F.one)
                (F.mul x (F.mul c x))) := by
              rw [F.mul_add]
        _ = F.add x (F.add x (F.mul x (F.mul c x))) := by
              rw [F.mul_one]
        _ = F.add (F.add x x) (F.mul x (F.mul c x)) := by
              rw [F.add_assoc]
    exact Eq.symm hrev
  calc
    F.add x (F.mul c (F.mul h (F.mul x x))) =
        F.add (F.mul h (F.add x x))
          (F.mul h (F.mul x (F.mul c x))) := by
          calc
            F.add x (F.mul c (F.mul h (F.mul x x))) =
                F.add (F.mul h (F.add x x))
                  (F.mul c (F.mul h (F.mul x x))) := by
                  exact congrArg
                    (fun z : Point =>
                      F.add z
                        (F.mul c (F.mul h (F.mul x x))))
                    hx_half
            _ = F.add (F.mul h (F.add x x))
                  (F.mul h (F.mul x (F.mul c x))) := by
                  exact congrArg
                    (fun z : Point =>
                      F.add (F.mul h (F.add x x)) z)
                    hcoeff
    _ = F.mul h
        (F.add (F.add x x) (F.mul x (F.mul c x))) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_add]
    _ = F.mul h
        (F.mul x
          (F.add F.one (F.add F.one (F.mul c x)))) := by
          rw [hinner]

name: add_sq_eq_base
statement:
private theorem add_sq_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b) =
      F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a b))
        (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  calc
    F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b a))
        (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b b)) =
        F.add (F.mul a a)
          (F.add (F.mul b a)
            (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b b))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.mul a a)
          (F.add (F.mul a b)
            (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b))) := by
          rw [add_left_comm_base F
            (F.mul b a) (F.mul a b) (F.mul b b)]
    _ = F.add
          (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a b))
          (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b)) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: add_sq_eq_grouped_base
statement:
private theorem add_sq_eq_grouped_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b) =
      F.add
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))
        (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_sq_eq_base F a b]
  let A := F.mul a a
  let B := F.mul a b
  let C := F.mul b a
  let D := F.mul b b
  change F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) =
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C)
  calc
    F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) =
        F.add A (F.add B (F.add C D)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc A B (F.add C D)]
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.add B C) D) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc B C D]
    _ = F.add A (F.add D (F.add B C)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm (F.add B C) D]
    _ = F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc A D (F.add B C)]

name: one_sub_square_eq_one_sub_add_mul_one_sub_base
statement:
private theorem one_sub_square_eq_one_sub_add_mul_one_sub_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (k : Point) :
    F.sub F.one (F.mul k k) =
      F.add (F.sub F.one k)
        (F.mul k (F.sub F.one k))
proof:
:= by
  exact Eq.symm <| by
    calc
      F.add (F.sub F.one k)
          (F.mul k (F.sub F.one k)) =
          F.add (F.sub F.one k)
            (F.sub (F.mul k F.one) (F.mul k k)) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F k F.one k]
      _ = F.add (F.sub F.one k)
            (F.sub k (F.mul k k)) := by
            rw [F.mul_one]
      _ = F.sub F.one (F.mul k k) := by
            rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
              F F.one k (F.mul k k)]

name: one_sub_square_eq_chord_group_base
statement:
private theorem one_sub_square_eq_chord_group_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (k : Point) :
    let a
proof:
:= F.sub F.one k
    F.sub F.one (F.mul k k) =
      F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a k))
        (F.mul k a) := by
  let a := F.sub F.one k
  have ha_add_k : F.add a k = F.one := by
    unfold a
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F F.one k
  rw [one_sub_square_eq_one_sub_add_mul_one_sub_base F k]
  change
    F.add a (F.mul k a) =
      F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a k)) (F.mul k a)
  have ha_expand :
      a = F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a k) := by
    calc
      a = F.mul a F.one := by
            rw [F.mul_one]
      _ = F.mul a (F.add a k) := by
            rw [ha_add_k]
      _ = F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a k) := by
            rw [F.mul_add]
  exact congrArg (fun z : Point => F.add z (F.mul k a)) ha_expand

name: one_sub_square_add_square_eq_chord_group_base
statement:
private theorem one_sub_square_add_square_eq_chord_group_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (k b : Point) :
    let a
proof:
:= F.sub F.one k
    F.add (F.sub F.one (F.mul k k)) (F.mul b b) =
      F.add
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))
        (F.add (F.mul a k) (F.mul k a)) := by
  let a := F.sub F.one k
  rw [one_sub_square_eq_chord_group_base F k]
  change
    F.add
      (F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a k)) (F.mul k a))
      (F.mul b b) =
      F.add
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))
        (F.add (F.mul a k) (F.mul k a))
  let A := F.mul a a
  let B := F.mul a k
  let C := F.mul k a
  let D := F.mul b b
  change
    F.add (F.add (F.add A B) C) D =
      F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C)
  calc
    F.add (F.add (F.add A B) C) D =
        F.add A (F.add B (F.add C D)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc A B C]
          rw [F.add_assoc A (F.add B C) D]
          rw [<- F.add_assoc B C D]
    _ = F.add A (F.add D (F.add B C)) := by
          have hinner :
              F.add B (F.add C D) =
                F.add D (F.add B C) := by
            calc
              F.add B (F.add C D) =
                  F.add (F.add B C) D := by
                    rw [<- F.add_assoc]
              _ = F.add D (F.add B C) := by
                    rw [F.add_comm]
          rw [hinner]
    _ = F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc A D (F.add B C)]

name: square_le_square_of_nonneg_le_base
statement:
private theorem square_le_square_of_nonneg_le_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x y : Point}
    (hx0 : F.le F.zero x)
    (hxy : F.le x y) :
    F.le (F.mul x x) (F.mul y y)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :
      F.le (F.mul x x) (F.mul y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hxy hx0
  have hy0 : F.le F.zero y := F.le_trans hx0 hxy
  have hright :
      F.le (F.mul y x) (F.mul y y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
      F hxy hy0
  exact F.le_trans hleft hright

name: le_of_nonneg_square_le_square_base
statement:
private theorem le_of_nonneg_square_le_square_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x y : Point}
    (hy0 : F.le F.zero y)
    (hsq : F.le (F.mul x x) (F.mul y y)) :
    F.le x y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : F.le x y
  · exact hxy
  · have hyx : F.le y x := by
      cases F.le_total x y with
      | inl h => exact False.elim (hxy h)
      | inr h => exact h
    have hyx_lt : F.lt y x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyx hxy
    have hx_pos : F.lt F.zero x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hy0 hyx_lt
    have hleft :
        F.le (F.mul y y) (F.mul x y) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
        F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hyx_lt) hy0
    have hright :
        F.lt (F.mul x y) (F.mul x x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left
        F hyx_lt hx_pos
    have hlt :
        F.lt (F.mul y y) (F.mul x x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hleft hright
    exact False.elim
      ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hlt) hsq)

name: lt_of_nonneg_square_lt_square_base
statement:
private theorem lt_of_nonneg_square_lt_square_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x y : Point}
    (hy0 : F.le F.zero y)
    (hsq : F.lt (F.mul x x) (F.mul y y)) :
    F.lt x y
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F
  · cases F.le_total x y with
    | inl hxy => exact hxy
    | inr hyx =>
        have hy_sq_le_x_sq :
            F.le (F.mul y y) (F.mul x x) :=
          square_le_square_of_nonneg_le_base F hy0 hyx
        exact False.elim
          ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hsq) hy_sq_le_x_sq)
  · intro hyx
    have hy_sq_le_x_sq :
        F.le (F.mul y y) (F.mul x x) :=
      square_le_square_of_nonneg_le_base F hy0 hyx
    exact
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hsq) hy_sq_le_x_sq

name: chord_cross_terms_le_base
statement:
private theorem chord_cross_terms_le_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {k S : Point}
    (hk0 : F.le F.zero k)
    (hk1 : F.le k F.one)
    (hSle1 : F.le S F.one) :
    let a
proof:
:= F.sub F.one k
    let b := F.mul k S
    F.le
      (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b a))
      (F.add (F.mul a k) (F.mul k a)) := by
  let a := F.sub F.one k
  let b := F.mul k S
  have ha0 : F.le F.zero a :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hk1
  have hb_le_k : F.le b k := by
    have hraw :
        F.le (F.mul k S) (F.mul k F.one) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
        F hSle1 hk0
    rwa [F.mul_one] at hraw
  have hleft :
      F.le (F.mul a b) (F.mul a k) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
      F hb_le_k ha0
  have hright :
      F.le (F.mul b a) (F.mul k a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hb_le_k ha0
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hleft hright

name: chord_cross_terms_lt_base
statement:
private theorem chord_cross_terms_lt_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {k S : Point}
    (hkpos : F.lt F.zero k)
    (hklt1 : F.lt k F.one)
    (hSlt1 : F.lt S F.one) :
    let a
proof:
:= F.sub F.one k
    let b := F.mul k S
    F.lt
      (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b a))
      (F.add (F.mul a k) (F.mul k a)) := by
  let a := F.sub F.one k
  let b := F.mul k S
  have ha_pos : F.lt F.zero a :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hklt1
  have hb_lt_k : F.lt b k := by
    have hraw :
        F.lt (F.mul k S) (F.mul k F.one) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left
        F hSlt1 hkpos
    rwa [F.mul_one] at hraw
  have hleft :
      F.lt (F.mul a b) (F.mul a k) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left
      F hb_lt_k ha_pos
  have hright :
      F.lt (F.mul b a) (F.mul k a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right
      F hb_lt_k ha_pos
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hleft hright

name: chord_line_square_le_radial_base
statement:
private theorem chord_line_square_le_radial_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {k S : Point}
    (hk0 : F.le F.zero k)
    (hk1 : F.le k F.one)
    (hSle1 : F.le S F.one) :
    let a
proof:
:= F.sub F.one k
    let b := F.mul k S
    F.le
      (F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b))
      (F.add (F.sub F.one (F.mul k k)) (F.mul b b)) := by
  let a := F.sub F.one k
  let b := F.mul k S
  have hcross :
      F.le
        (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b a))
        (F.add (F.mul a k) (F.mul k a)) :=
    chord_cross_terms_le_base F hk0 hk1 hSle1
  change
    F.le
      (F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b))
      (F.add (F.sub F.one (F.mul k k)) (F.mul b b))
  rw [add_sq_eq_grouped_base F a b]
  rw [one_sub_square_add_square_eq_chord_group_base F k b]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
    F hcross (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))

name: chord_line_square_lt_radial_base
statement:
private theorem chord_line_square_lt_radial_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {k S : Point}
    (hkpos : F.lt F.zero k)

proof:

    F.lt

      (F.add (F.sub F.one (F.mul k k)) (F.mul b b)) := by
  let a := F.sub F.one k

name: one_sub_square_add_scaled_sqrt_square_eq_base
statement:
private theorem one_sub_square_add_scaled_sqrt_square_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {k y S : Point}
    (hSsq :
      F.mul S S =
        F.sub F.one (F.mul y y)) :
    let b
proof:
:= F.mul k S
    F.add (F.sub F.one (F.mul k k)) (F.mul b b) =
      F.sub F.one (F.mul (F.mul k y) (F.mul k y)) := by
  let K := F.mul k k
  let Y := F.mul y y
  let b := F.mul k S
  have hb :
      F.mul b b = F.mul K (F.sub F.one Y) := by
    unfold b K Y
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul k S) (F.mul k S) =
          F.mul (F.mul k k) (F.mul S S) := by
            rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_base F k S k S]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul k k)
            (F.sub F.one (F.mul y y)) := by
            rw [hSsq]
  have hky_sq :
      F.mul (F.mul k y) (F.mul k y) =
        F.mul K Y := by
    unfold K Y
    rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_base F k y k y]
  change
    F.add (F.sub F.one K) (F.mul b b) =
      F.sub F.one (F.mul (F.mul k y) (F.mul k y))
  rw [hb, hky_sq]
  have hscaled :
      F.mul K (F.sub F.one Y) =
        F.sub K (F.mul K Y) := by
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F K F.one Y]
    rw [F.mul_one]
  rw [hscaled]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel F F.one K (F.mul K Y)

theorem hasIntegral_ge_const_of_pointwise_ge
    {f : Map} {a b I c : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hfg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le c (f x))
    (hI : RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral f a b I) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a)) I
proof:
:= by
  let constC : Map := fun _ : Point => c
  have hConst :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral constC a b
        (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a)) :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.hasIntegral_const_ordered
      (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) hab
  exact
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integralOrderPreservation
      constC f a b
      (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a)) I
      hab
      (fun x hx => hfg x hx)
      hConst hI

theorem hasIntegral_le_const_of_pointwise_le

        (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a)) :=

      (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) hab
  exact
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integralOrderPreservation
      f constC a b I
      (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a))
      hab
      (fun x hx => hfg x hx)
      hI hConst

statement:
private theorem squareHalfPrimitiveFun_hasDerivWithin
    {E : Domain} {x : Point}
    (hx : E x) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E squareHalfPrimitiveFun x x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
  have hid :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
        (fun z : Point => z) x F.one :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_id hx
  have hmul :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
        (RealFunction.MulFun (fun z : Point => z) (fun z : Point => z)) x
        (F.add (F.mul F.one x) (F.mul x F.one)) :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_mul hid hid
  have hscale :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E squareHalfPrimitiveFun x
        (F.mul h (F.add (F.mul F.one x) (F.mul x F.one))) := by
    unfold squareHalfPrimitiveFun h
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_constMul hmul
  have hvalue :
      F.mul h (F.add (F.mul F.one x) (F.mul x F.one)) = x := by
    rw [F.one_mul, F.mul_one]
    exact half_one_mul_add_self_eq_base F x
  exact hasDerivWithin_congr_value_local hvalue hscale

name: hasIntegral_identity_zero_right
statement:
private theorem hasIntegral_identity_zero_right
    (y : Point) :
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
      (fun t : Point => t) RealTheory.zero y
      (RealTheory.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.mul y y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
  have hIdCont :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        (fun t : Point => t) F.zero y := by
    refine And.intro ?left ?right
    · intro _h
      exact RealFunction.continuousOn_identity
    · intro _h
      exact RealFunction.continuousOn_identity
  have hPrimCont :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        squareHalfPrimitiveFun F.zero y := by
    exact And.intro
      (fun _h =>
        squareHalfPrimitiveFun_continuousOn
          (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero y))
      (fun _h =>
        squareHalfPrimitiveFun_continuousOn
          (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval y F.zero))
  have hDeriv :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasDerivativeWithinOnOpenSegment
        squareHalfPrimitiveFun (fun t : Point => t) F.zero y := by
    exact And.intro
      (fun _h x hx =>
        squareHalfPrimitiveFun_hasDerivWithin
          (E := RealTheory.OpenInterval F.zero y) hx)
      (fun _h x hx =>
        squareHalfPrimitiveFun_hasDerivWithin
          (E := RealTheory.OpenInterval y F.zero) hx)
  have hI :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        (fun t : Point => t) F.zero y
        (F.sub (squareHalfPrimitiveFun y)
          (squareHalfPrimitiveFun F.zero)) :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.hasIntegral_derivative_eq_sub
      hIdCont hPrimCont hDeriv
  have hendpoint :
      F.sub (squareHalfPrimitiveFun y)
          (squareHalfPrimitiveFun F.zero) =
        F.mul h (F.mul y y) := by
    unfold squareHalfPrimitiveFun RealDerivative.ConstMulFun
      RealFunction.MulFun h
    change
      F.sub (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one)
          (F.mul y y))
        (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one)
          (F.mul F.zero F.zero)) =
        F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one)
          (F.mul y y)
    rw [F.zero_mul]
    rw [F.mul_zero]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F
      (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one)
        (F.mul y y))
  rwa [hendpoint] at hI

        (unitSemicircleBasePrimitive RealTheory.zero)

      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.OrientedIntervalAdditivityStatement :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.orientedIntervalAdditivity
  have hsum :
      unitSemicircleBasePrimitive x =
        RealTheory.add
          (unitSemicircleBasePrimitive RealTheory.zero)
          (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive x) :=
    horient sqrtOneMinusSq
      (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) RealTheory.zero x
      (unitSemicircleBasePrimitive RealTheory.zero)
      (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive x)
      (unitSemicircleBasePrimitive x)
      (sqrtOneMinusSq_continuousOnSegment_of_unitClosed
        neg_one_mem_unitClosedInterval zero_mem_unitClosedInterval)
      (sqrtOneMinusSq_continuousOnSegment_of_unitClosed
        zero_mem_unitClosedInterval hx)
      (sqrtOneMinusSq_continuousOnSegment_of_unitClosed
        neg_one_mem_unitClosedInterval hx)
      (unitSemicircleBasePrimitive_hasIntegral_from_neg_one
        zero_mem_unitClosedInterval)
      (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive_hasIntegral_from_zero hx)
      (unitSemicircleBasePrimitive_hasIntegral_from_neg_one hx)
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.value_sub_left_of_eq_add
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (x := unitSemicircleBasePrimitive x)
      (y := unitSemicircleBasePrimitive RealTheory.zero)

proof:
:= by
  intro x hx

      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
        UnitOpenInterval unitSemicircleBasePrimitive x
        (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
    unitSemicircleBasePrimitive_hasDerivativeOn_unitOpenInterval x hx
  have hconst :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin
        UnitOpenInterval
        (fun _ : Point => unitSemicircleBasePrimitive RealTheory.zero)
        x RealTheory.zero :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_const hx
  have hsub :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
        (RealFunction.SubFun unitSemicircleBasePrimitive
          (fun _ : Point => unitSemicircleBasePrimitive RealTheory.zero))
        x (RealTheory.sub (sqrtOneMinusSq x) RealTheory.zero) :=

name: asinGeom_raw_derivative_eq_inv_sqrt
statement:
theorem asinGeom_raw_derivative_eq_inv_sqrt
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitOpenInterval x) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul twoPoint (sqrtOneMinusSq x))
        (RealTheory.add (sqrtOneMinusSq x)
          (RealTheory.mul x
            (RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.mul x
                (RealTheory.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq x)))))) =
      RealTheory.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := sqrtOneMinusSq x
  have hxClosed : UnitClosedInterval x :=
    unitOpenInterval_subset_unitClosedInterval x hx
  have hspos : F.lt F.zero s := by
    change RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq x)
    exact sqrtOneMinusSq_pos_unitOpenInterval hx
  have hsne : Not (s = F.zero) := by
    intro hs
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hspos) hs.symm
  have hsquare :
      F.mul s s = F.sub F.one (F.mul x x) := by
    change
      RealTheory.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x) =
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul x x)
    exact sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq hxClosed
  have htwo_s :
      F.mul twoPoint s = F.add s s := by
    unfold twoPoint
    change
      F.mul (F.add F.one F.one) s = F.add s s
    rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
  have hxInv_s :
      F.mul (F.mul x (F.inv s)) s = x := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul x (F.inv s)) s =
          F.mul x (F.mul (F.inv s) s) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul x F.one := by
            rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hsne]
      _ = x := by
            rw [F.mul_one]
  have hxNeg_s :
      F.mul
        (F.mul x (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv s)))) s =
      F.neg (F.mul x x) := by
    calc
      F.mul
          (F.mul x (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv s)))) s =
          F.mul x
            (F.mul (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv s))) s) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ =
          F.mul x
            (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul x (F.inv s)) s)) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F
              (F.mul x (F.inv s)) s]
      _ = F.mul x (F.neg x) := by
            rw [hxInv_s]
      _ = F.neg (F.mul x x) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F x x]
  have htwo_s_mul :
      F.mul (F.mul twoPoint s) s =
      F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul s s) := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul twoPoint s) s =
          F.mul (F.add s s) s := by
            rw [htwo_s]
      _ = F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul s s) := by
            rw [F.add_mul]
  have hright_s_mul :
      F.mul
        (F.add s
          (F.mul x (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv s))))) s =
      F.add (F.mul s s) (F.neg (F.mul x x)) := by
    calc
      F.mul
          (F.add s
            (F.mul x (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv s))))) s =
          F.add (F.mul s s)
            (F.mul
              (F.mul x (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv s)))) s) := by
            rw [F.add_mul]
      _ = F.add (F.mul s s) (F.neg (F.mul x x)) := by
            rw [hxNeg_s]
  have hcollapse :
      F.sub
        (F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul s s))
        (F.add (F.mul s s) (F.neg (F.mul x x))) =
      F.one := by
    calc
      F.sub
          (F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul s s))
          (F.add (F.mul s s) (F.neg (F.mul x x))) =
          F.add
            (F.sub (F.mul s s) (F.mul s s))
            (F.sub (F.mul s s) (F.neg (F.mul x x))) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F]
      _ =
          F.add F.zero
            (F.sub (F.mul s s) (F.neg (F.mul x x))) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F]
      _ = F.sub (F.mul s s) (F.neg (F.mul x x)) := by
            rw [F.zero_add]
      _ = F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul x x) := by
            rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F]
      _ = F.one := by
            rw [hsquare]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
              F F.one (F.mul x x)
  have hleft_mul :
      F.mul
        (F.sub (F.mul twoPoint s)
          (F.add s
            (F.mul x (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv s)))))) s =
      F.one := by
    calc
      F.mul
          (F.sub (F.mul twoPoint s)
            (F.add s
              (F.mul x (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv s)))))) s =
          F.sub
            (F.mul (F.mul twoPoint s) s)
            (F.mul
              (F.add s
                (F.mul x (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv s))))) s) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F]
      _ =
          F.sub
            (F.add (F.mul s s) (F.mul s s))
            (F.add (F.mul s s) (F.neg (F.mul x x))) := by
            rw [htwo_s_mul, hright_s_mul]
      _ = F.one := hcollapse
  change
    F.sub
        (F.mul twoPoint s)
        (F.add s
          (F.mul x
            (F.neg
              (F.mul x
                (F.inv s))))) =
      F.inv s
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero
    F (z := s) hsne
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.sub
          (F.mul twoPoint s)
          (F.add s
            (F.mul x
              (F.neg
                (F.mul x
                  (F.inv s)))))) s =
        F.one := hleft_mul
    _ = F.mul (F.inv s) s := by
        rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hsne]

name: sqrt2_zero

proof:

name: ratio_mem_zero_one_of_closedInterval_zero_right
statement:
private theorem ratio_mem_zero_one_of_closedInterval_zero_right
    {y t : Point}
    (hy : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y)
    (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero y t) :
    ZeroOneClosedInterval (RealTheory.mul t (RealTheory.inv y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hy
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinv_pos
  have hnonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul t (F.inv y)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg ht.left hinv_nonneg
  have hle_one :
      F.le (F.mul t (F.inv y)) F.one := by
    have hmul :
        F.le (F.mul t (F.inv y)) (F.mul y (F.inv y)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
        F ht.right hinv_nonneg
    have hy_ne : Not (y = F.zero) := by
      intro h
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hy h.symm
    rwa [F.mul_inv_cancel hy_ne] at hmul
  exact And.intro hnonneg hle_one

name: ratio_mem_zero_one_open_of_openInterval_zero_right
statement:
private theorem ratio_mem_zero_one_open_of_openInterval_zero_right
    {y t : Point}
    (hy : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y)
    (ht0 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero t)
    (hty : RealTheory.lt t y) :
    ZeroOneOpenInterval (RealTheory.mul t (RealTheory.inv y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hy
  have hpos :
      F.lt F.zero (F.mul t (F.inv y)) :=
    F.mul_pos ht0 hinv_pos
  have hlt_one :
      F.lt (F.mul t (F.inv y)) F.one := by
    have hmul :
        F.lt (F.mul t (F.inv y)) (F.mul y (F.inv y)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right
        F hty hinv_pos
    have hy_ne : Not (y = F.zero) := by
      intro h
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hy h.symm
    rwa [F.mul_inv_cancel hy_ne] at hmul
  exact And.intro hpos hlt_one

name: ratio_mul_right_eq
statement:
private theorem ratio_mul_right_eq
    {y t : Point}
    (hy : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul t (RealTheory.inv y)) y = t
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hy_ne : Not (y = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hy h.symm
  change F.mul (F.mul t (F.inv y)) y = t
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul t (F.inv y)) y =
        F.mul t (F.mul (F.inv y) y) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul t F.one := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hy_ne]
    _ = t := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: unitSemicircleChordLine_nonneg
statement:
theorem unitSemicircleChordLine_nonneg
    {y t : Point}
    (hy : ZeroOneClosedInterval y)
    (hypos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y)
    (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero y t) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (unitSemicircleChordLine y t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let k := F.mul t (F.inv y)
  have hk : ZeroOneClosedInterval k :=
    ratio_mem_zero_one_of_closedInterval_zero_right hypos ht
  have hyUnit : UnitClosedInterval y :=
    zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval y hy
  have hS_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq y) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_nonneg_unitClosedInterval hyUnit
  have hone_sub_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.sub F.one k) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hk.right
  have hkS_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul k (sqrtOneMinusSq y)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hk.left hS_nonneg
  unfold unitSemicircleChordLine
  change F.le F.zero
    (F.add (F.sub F.one k)
      (F.mul k (sqrtOneMinusSq y)))
  have hsum :
      F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero)
        (F.add (F.sub F.one k)
          (F.mul k (sqrtOneMinusSq y))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
      hone_sub_nonneg hkS_nonneg
  rwa [F.add_zero] at hsum

name: unitSemicircleChordLine_le_one
statement:
theorem unitSemicircleChordLine_le_one
    {y t : Point}
    (hy : ZeroOneClosedInterval y)
    (hypos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y)
    (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero y t) :
    RealTheory.le (unitSemicircleChordLine y t) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let k := F.mul t (F.inv y)
  have hk : ZeroOneClosedInterval k :=
    ratio_mem_zero_one_of_closedInterval_zero_right hypos ht
  have hyUnit : UnitClosedInterval y :=
    zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval y hy
  have hS_le_one :
      F.le (sqrtOneMinusSq y) F.one :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_le_one_unitClosedInterval hyUnit
  have hkS_le_k :
      F.le (F.mul k (sqrtOneMinusSq y)) (F.mul k F.one) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
      F hS_le_one hk.left
  have hkS_le_k' :
      F.le (F.mul k (sqrtOneMinusSq y)) k := by
    rwa [F.mul_one] at hkS_le_k
  have hline_le :
      F.le
        (F.add (F.sub F.one k)
          (F.mul k (sqrtOneMinusSq y)))
        (F.add (F.sub F.one k) k) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
      F hkS_le_k' (F.sub F.one k)
  have hsum : F.add (F.sub F.one k) k = F.one :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F F.one k
  unfold unitSemicircleChordLine
  change
    F.le
      (F.add (F.sub F.one k)
        (F.mul k (sqrtOneMinusSq y)))
      F.one
  rwa [hsum] at hline_le

name: unitSemicircleChordLine_eq_affine
statement:
theorem unitSemicircleChordLine_eq_affine
    (y t : Point) :
    unitSemicircleChordLine y t =
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul t (RealTheory.inv y))
          (RealTheory.sub (sqrtOneMinusSq y) RealTheory.one))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let k := F.mul t (F.inv y)
  let S := sqrtOneMinusSq y
  unfold unitSemicircleChordLine
  change
    F.add (F.sub F.one k) (F.mul k S) =
      F.add F.one (F.mul k (F.sub S F.one))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F k S F.one]
  rw [F.mul_one]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    F.add (F.add F.one (F.neg k)) (F.mul k S) =
        F.add F.one (F.add (F.neg k) (F.mul k S)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add F.one (F.add (F.mul k S) (F.neg k)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm (F.neg k) (F.mul k S)]

name: unitSemicircleChordLine_continuousOn
statement:
theorem unitSemicircleChordLine_continuousOn
    (y : Point) {E : Domain} :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
      (fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let S := sqrtOneMinusSq y
  let c := F.mul (F.inv y) (F.sub S F.one)
  have haff :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
        (RealFunction.AddFun
          (fun _ : Point => F.one)
          (RealFunction.MulFun
            (fun _ : Point => c)
            RealFunction.IdentityFun)) := by
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_add
      RealFunction.continuousOn_const
      (RealFunction.continuousOn_mul
        RealFunction.continuousOn_const
        RealFunction.continuousOn_identity)
  refine RealFunction.continuousOn_congr
    (E := E)
    (f :=
      RealFunction.AddFun
        (fun _ : Point => F.one)
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (fun _ : Point => c)
          RealFunction.IdentityFun))
    (g := fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t)
    ?_ haff
  intro t _ht
  unfold RealFunction.AddFun RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.IdentityFun
  change
    F.add F.one (F.mul c t) =
      unitSemicircleChordLine y t
  rw [unitSemicircleChordLine_eq_affine y t]
  change
    F.add F.one (F.mul c t) =
      F.add F.one
        (F.mul (F.mul t (F.inv y)) (F.sub S F.one))
  congr 1
  unfold c S
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (F.inv y)
          (F.sub (sqrtOneMinusSq y) F.one)) t =
        F.mul (F.inv y)
          (F.mul (F.sub (sqrtOneMinusSq y) F.one) t) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.inv y)
          (F.mul t (F.sub (sqrtOneMinusSq y) F.one)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub (sqrtOneMinusSq y) F.one) t]
    _ = F.mul
          (F.mul (F.inv y) t)
          (F.sub (sqrtOneMinusSq y) F.one) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul
          (F.mul t (F.inv y))
          (F.sub (sqrtOneMinusSq y) F.one) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv y) t]

name: unitSemicircleChordLine_zero
statement:
theorem unitSemicircleChordLine_zero
    (y : Point) :
    unitSemicircleChordLine y RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold unitSemicircleChordLine
  change
    F.add
      (F.sub F.one (F.mul F.zero (F.inv y)))
      (F.mul (F.mul F.zero (F.inv y)) (sqrtOneMinusSq y)) =
      F.one
  rw [F.zero_mul]
  rw [F.zero_mul]
  rw [F.add_zero]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F F.one

name: unitSemicircleChordLine_right
statement:
theorem unitSemicircleChordLine_right
    {y : Point}
    (hy : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y) :
    unitSemicircleChordLine y y = sqrtOneMinusSq y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hy_ne : Not (y = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hy h.symm
  unfold unitSemicircleChordLine
  change
    F.add
      (F.sub F.one (F.mul y (F.inv y)))
      (F.mul (F.mul y (F.inv y)) (sqrtOneMinusSq y)) =
      sqrtOneMinusSq y
  rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hy_ne]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.one]
  rw [F.zero_add]
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: unitSemicircleChordLine_hasIntegral_raw
statement:
private theorem unitSemicircleChordLine_hasIntegral_raw
    (y : Point) :
    let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
    let S := sqrtOneMinusSq y
    let c := F.mul (F.inv y) (F.sub S F.one)
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
      (fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t)
      F.zero y
      (F.add (F.mul F.one (F.sub y F.zero))
        (F.mul c (F.mul h (F.mul y y)))) := by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
  let S := sqrtOneMinusSq y
  let c := F.mul (F.inv y) (F.sub S F.one)
  have hConst :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        (fun _ : Point => F.one) F.zero y
        (F.mul F.one (F.sub y F.zero)) :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.hasIntegral_const
      (a := F.zero) (b := y) (c := F.one)
  have hId :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        (fun t : Point => t) F.zero y

            (F.mul t (F.inv y))

  have hcx :

        F.mul (F.mul x (F.inv y)) (F.sub S F.one) := by

    calc
      F.mul
          (F.mul (F.inv y)

name: unitSemicircleChordLine_le_sqrtOneMinusSq
statement:
theorem unitSemicircleChordLine_le_sqrtOneMinusSq
    {y t : Point}
    (hy : ZeroOneOpenInterval y)
    (ht : RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero y t) :
    RealTheory.le (unitSemicircleChordLine y t) (sqrtOneMinusSq t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let k := F.mul t (F.inv y)
  let S := sqrtOneMinusSq y
  have hyClosed : ZeroOneClosedInterval y := by
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy.right)
  have hyUnit : UnitClosedInterval y :=
    zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval y hyClosed
  have htZeroOne : ZeroOneClosedInterval t := by
    exact And.intro ht.left
      (F.le_trans ht.right hyClosed.right)
  have htUnit : UnitClosedInterval t :=
    zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval t htZeroOne
  have hk : ZeroOneClosedInterval k :=
    ratio_mem_zero_one_of_closedInterval_zero_right hy.left ht
  have hS_le_one : F.le S F.one := by
    exact sqrtOneMinusSq_le_one_unitClosedInterval hyUnit
  have hline_sq :
      F.le
        (F.mul
          (F.add (F.sub F.one k) (F.mul k S))
          (F.add (F.sub F.one k) (F.mul k S)))
        (F.add (F.sub F.one (F.mul k k))
          (F.mul (F.mul k S) (F.mul k S))) := by
    exact chord_line_square_le_radial_base
      F hk.left hk.right hS_le_one
  have hSsq :
      F.mul S S = F.sub F.one (F.mul y y) := by
    exact sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq hyUnit
  have hrad :
      F.add (F.sub F.one (F.mul k k))
          (F.mul (F.mul k S) (F.mul k S)) =
        F.sub F.one (F.mul t t) := by
    have hbase :=
      one_sub_square_add_scaled_sqrt_square_eq_base
        F (k := k) (y := y) (S := S) hSsq
    change
      F.add (F.sub F.one (F.mul k k))
          (F.mul (F.mul k S) (F.mul k S)) =
        F.sub F.one (F.mul (F.mul k y) (F.mul k y)) at hbase
    have hky : F.mul k y = t := by
      change
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul t (RealTheory.inv y)) y = t
      exact ratio_mul_right_eq hy.left
    rw [hky] at hbase
    exact hbase
  have hline_sq_rad :
      F.le
        (F.mul
          (F.add (F.sub F.one k) (F.mul k S))
          (F.add (F.sub F.one k) (F.mul k S)))
        (F.sub F.one (F.mul t t)) := by
    rwa [hrad] at hline_sq
  have htSq :
      F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq t) (sqrtOneMinusSq t) =
        F.sub F.one (F.mul t t) := by
    exact sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq htUnit
  have hsq :
      F.le
        (F.mul
          (F.add (F.sub F.one k) (F.mul k S))
          (F.add (F.sub F.one k) (F.mul k S)))
        (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq t) (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) := by
    rwa [<- htSq] at hline_sq_rad
  have hsqrt_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq t) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_nonneg_unitClosedInterval htUnit
  unfold unitSemicircleChordLine
  change
    F.le
      (F.add (F.sub F.one k) (F.mul k S))
      (sqrtOneMinusSq t)
  exact le_of_nonneg_square_le_square_base F hsqrt_nonneg hsq

statement:
private theorem chord_mid_integral_value_lt_short_chord_integral_value
    {y : Point}
    (hy : ZeroOneOpenInterval y) :
    let F
proof:
:= RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
    let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F y
    F.lt
      (F.mul h
        (F.mul m
          (F.add F.one (unitSemicircleChordLine y m))))
      (F.mul h
        (F.mul m
          (F.add F.one (sqrtOneMinusSq m)))) := by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base

    unitSemicircleChordLine_mid_lt_sqrtOneMinusSq hy
  have hadd :
      F.lt
        (F.add F.one (unitSemicircleChordLine y m))
        (F.add F.one (sqrtOneMinusSq m)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
      F hmid F.one
  have hhalf_pos : F.lt F.zero h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F RealTheory.zero_lt_one

        (F.mul (F.mul h m)
          (F.add F.one (unitSemicircleChordLine y m)))
        (F.mul (F.mul h m)
          (F.add F.one (sqrtOneMinusSq m))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left
      F hadd hscale_pos
  have hleft :
      F.mul h
          (F.mul m
            (F.add F.one (unitSemicircleChordLine y m))) =
        F.mul (F.mul h m)
          (F.add F.one (unitSemicircleChordLine y m)) := by
    rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

      F.mul h
          (F.mul m
            (F.add F.one (sqrtOneMinusSq m))) =
        F.mul (F.mul h m)

          (F.add F.one (sqrtOneMinusSq m))))

proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hyClosed : ZeroOneClosedInterval y := by
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy.right)
  have hyUnit : UnitClosedInterval y :=
    zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval y hyClosed
  have hChord :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        (fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t)
        F.zero y
        (F.mul
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one)
          (F.mul y (F.add F.one (sqrtOneMinusSq y)))) :=
    unitSemicircleChordLine_hasIntegral_zero_right hy.left
  have hArea :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        sqrtOneMinusSq F.zero y
        (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive y) :=
    unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive_hasIntegral_from_zero hyUnit
  exact
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integralOrderPreservation
      (fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t)
      sqrtOneMinusSq
      F.zero y
      (F.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one)
        (F.mul y (F.add F.one (sqrtOneMinusSq y))))
      (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive y)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy.left)
      (fun t ht =>
        unitSemicircleChordLine_le_sqrtOneMinusSq hy ht)
      hChord hArea

name: unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive_gt_chordTrapezoid_zeroOneOpenInterval
statement:
theorem unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive_gt_chordTrapezoid_zeroOneOpenInterval
    {y : Point}
    (hy : ZeroOneOpenInterval y) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.mul y
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (sqrtOneMinusSq y))))
      (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F F.one
  let m := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F y
  let C0m :=
    F.mul h
      (F.mul m
        (F.add F.one (unitSemicircleChordLine y m)))
  let Cshort :=
    F.mul h
      (F.mul m
        (F.add F.one (sqrtOneMinusSq m)))
  let C0y :=
    F.mul h
      (F.mul y
        (F.add F.one (sqrtOneMinusSq y)))
  have hyClosed : ZeroOneClosedInterval y := by
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy.right)
  have hyUnit : UnitClosedInterval y :=
    zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval y hyClosed
  have hmOpen : ZeroOneOpenInterval m :=
    zeroOneOpen_midpoint_of_zeroOneOpen hy
  have hmClosed : ZeroOneClosedInterval m := by
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hmOpen.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hmOpen.right)
  have hmUnit : UnitClosedInterval m :=
    zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval m hmClosed
  have h0m : F.le F.zero m :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hmOpen.left
  have hmy_lt : F.lt m y :=
    midpoint_lt_self_of_zeroOneOpen hy
  have hmy : F.le m y :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hmy_lt
  have hyEndpoint : RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero y y := by
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy.left)
      (F.le_refl y)
  have hmInZeroY : RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero y m := by
    exact And.intro h0m hmy
  have hLy0m :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        (fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t)
        F.zero m C0m := by
    exact unitSemicircleChordLine_hasIntegral_zero_to y m
  have hLy0y :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        (fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t)
        F.zero y C0y := by
    unfold C0y h
    exact unitSemicircleChordLine_hasIntegral_zero_right hy.left
  have hLyCont_my :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        (fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t) m y := by
    exact
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.continuousOnSegment_of_continuousOn_closedInterval
        (f := fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t)
        (a := F.zero) (c := y)
        (unitSemicircleChordLine_continuousOn y)
        hmInZeroY hyEndpoint
  have hLyInt_my :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.Integrable
        (fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t) m y :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.continuousOnSegment_integrable hLyCont_my
  let Cmy :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integral
      (fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t) m y hLyInt_my
  have hLyMy :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        (fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t) m y Cmy :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integral_spec hLyInt_my
  have hChordSplit :
      C0y = F.add C0m Cmy := by
    exact
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.orderedIntervalAdditivity
        (fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t)
        F.zero m y C0m Cmy C0y
        h0m hmy
        (unitSemicircleChordLine_continuousOn y)
        hLy0m hLyMy hLy0y
  have hSCont_my :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        sqrtOneMinusSq m y :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_continuousOnSegment_of_unitClosed hmUnit hyUnit
  have hSInt_my :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.Integrable
        sqrtOneMinusSq m y :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.continuousOnSegment_integrable hSCont_my
  let Smy :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integral
      sqrtOneMinusSq m y hSInt_my
  have hSMy :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        sqrtOneMinusSq m y Smy :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integral_spec hSInt_my
  have hArea0m :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        sqrtOneMinusSq F.zero m
        (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive m) :=
    unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive_hasIntegral_from_zero hmUnit
  have hArea0y :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        sqrtOneMinusSq F.zero y
        (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive y) :=
    unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive_hasIntegral_from_zero hyUnit
  have hSCont0y :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval F.zero y) sqrtOneMinusSq := by
    refine RealFunction.continuousOn_subset ?_
      sqrtOneMinusSq_continuousOn_unitClosedInterval
    intro t ht
    exact And.intro
      (F.le_trans
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_one_lt_zero F))
        ht.left)
      (F.le_trans ht.right hyClosed.right)
  have hAreaSplit :
      unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive y =
        F.add (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive m) Smy := by
    exact
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.orderedIntervalAdditivity
        sqrtOneMinusSq F.zero m y
        (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive m) Smy
        (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive y)
        h0m hmy hSCont0y
        hArea0m hSMy hArea0y
  have hCmy_le_Smy : F.le Cmy Smy := by
    exact
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.integralOrderPreservation
        (fun t : Point => unitSemicircleChordLine y t)
        sqrtOneMinusSq
        m y Cmy Smy
        hmy
        (fun t ht =>
          unitSemicircleChordLine_le_sqrtOneMinusSq hy
            (And.intro
              (F.le_trans h0m ht.left)
              ht.right))
        hLyMy hSMy
  have hC0m_lt_Cshort : F.lt C0m Cshort := by
    exact chord_mid_integral_value_lt_short_chord_integral_value hy
  have hCshort_le_Area0m :
      F.le Cshort (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive m) := by
    unfold Cshort h
    exact unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive_ge_chordTrapezoid_zeroOneOpenInterval
      hmOpen
  have hsum_left :
      F.lt (F.add C0m Cmy) (F.add Cshort Smy) := by
    have hlt_same :
        F.lt (F.add C0m Cmy) (F.add Cshort Cmy) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right
        F hC0m_lt_Cshort Cmy
    have hle_second :
        F.le (F.add Cshort Cmy) (F.add Cshort Smy) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
        F hCmy_le_Smy Cshort
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
      F hlt_same hle_second
  have hsum_right :
      F.le (F.add Cshort Smy)
        (F.add (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive m) Smy) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_right
      F hCshort_le_Area0m Smy
  have hsum :
      F.lt (F.add C0m Cmy)
        (F.add (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive m) Smy) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
      F hsum_left hsum_right
  change F.lt C0y (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive y)
  rw [hChordSplit, hAreaSplit]
  exact hsum

name: unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive_le_identity_zeroOneClosedInterval
statement:
theorem unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive_le_identity_zeroOneClosedInterval
    {x : Point}
    (hx : ZeroOneClosedInterval x) :
    RealTheory.le (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive x) x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxUnit : UnitClosedInterval x :=
    zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval x hx
  have hI :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.HasIntegral
        sqrtOneMinusSq RealTheory.zero x
        (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive x) :=
    unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive_hasIntegral_from_zero hxUnit
  have hraw :
      F.le (unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive x)
        (F.mul F.one (F.sub x F.zero)) := by
    exact
      hasIntegral_le_const_of_pointwise_le
        (a := F.zero) (b := x)
        (I := unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive x)
        (c := F.one)
        hx.left
        (fun t ht => by
          have htZeroOne : ZeroOneClosedInterval t :=
            And.intro ht.left (F.le_trans ht.right hx.right)
          have htUnit : UnitClosedInterval t :=
            zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval t htZeroOne
          exact sqrtOneMinusSq_le_one_unitClosedInterval htUnit)
        hI
  have hrect :
      F.mul F.one (F.sub x F.zero) = x := by
    rw [F.one_mul]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F x
  rwa [hrect] at hraw

name: one_sub_two_sub_mul_eq_one_sub_sq
statement:
private theorem one_sub_two_sub_mul_eq_one_sub_sq
    (s : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub twoPoint s) s) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one s)
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one s)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold twoPoint
  change
    F.sub F.one (F.mul (F.sub (F.add F.one F.one) s) s) =
      F.mul (F.sub F.one s) (F.sub F.one s)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F
    (F.add F.one F.one) s s]
  rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F
    (F.sub F.one s) F.one s]
  rw [F.mul_one]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F F.one s s]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add F]
  have hinner :
      F.sub (F.add s s) (F.mul s s) =
        F.add s (F.sub s (F.mul s s)) := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg s (F.mul s s)]
    rw [F.add_assoc]
  rw [hinner]

name: two_sub_self_mul_self_lt_one_of_lt_one
statement:
private theorem two_sub_self_mul_self_lt_one_of_lt_one
    {s : Point}
    (hs : RealTheory.lt s RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub twoPoint s) s)
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F
  change
    F.lt F.zero
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub twoPoint s) s))
  rw [one_sub_two_sub_mul_eq_one_sub_sq s]
  have hgap : F.lt F.zero (F.sub F.one s) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hs
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hgap hgap

name: sqrtOneMinusSq_sqrtOneMinusSq_zeroOneClosedInterval
statement:
theorem sqrtOneMinusSq_sqrtOneMinusSq_zeroOneClosedInterval
    {x : Point}
    (hx : ZeroOneClosedInterval x) :
    sqrtOneMinusSq (sqrtOneMinusSq x) = x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxUnit : UnitClosedInterval x :=
    zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval x hx
  change
    RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2
      (F.sub F.one
        (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x))) = x
  refine RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_eq_of_relation_succ (n := 1) ?_
  refine And.intro hx.left ?_
  rw [RealFunction.powNat_two]
  change
    F.mul x x =
      F.sub F.one
        (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x))
  have hsSq :
      F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x) =
        F.sub F.one (F.mul x x) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq hxUnit
  rw [hsSq]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F F.one (F.mul x x)]

name: asinGeom_sub_identity_strictMonotoneOn_zeroOneClosed
proof:
:= by
  have hcont :
      ContinuousOn ZeroOneClosedInterval (SubFun asinGeom IdentityFun) :=
    continuousOn_sub
      asinGeom_continuousOn_zeroOneClosedInterval
      continuousOn_identity
  have hderiv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivativeWithinOn ZeroOneOpenInterval
        (SubFun asinGeom IdentityFun)
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq x))
            RealTheory.one) := by
    intro x hx
    have hasin := asinGeom_hasDerivWithin_zeroOneOpenInterval hx
    have hid :
        RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin ZeroOneOpenInterval
          IdentityFun x RealTheory.one := by
      unfold IdentityFun
      exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_id hx
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_sub hasin hid
  have hdiff :
      RealDerivative.DifferentiableOnOpenInterval
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one (SubFun asinGeom IdentityFun) := by
    intro x hx
    exact Exists.intro
      (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq x)) RealTheory.one)
      (hderiv x hx)
  have hpos :
      RealDerivative.DerivativePositiveOnOpenInterval
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one (SubFun asinGeom IdentityFun) := by
    intro x A hx hA
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    have hAeq :
        A = F.sub (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq x)) F.one :=
      RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
        (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint hx) hA (hderiv x hx)
    have hspos : F.lt F.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
      sqrtOneMinusSq_pos_unitOpenInterval
        (zeroOneOpen_subset_unitOpenInterval x hx)
    have hslt : F.lt (sqrtOneMinusSq x) F.one :=
      sqrtOneMinusSq_lt_one_zeroOneOpenInterval hx
    have hinv : F.lt F.one (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq x)) := by
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos F
        hspos (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) hslt
      rwa [F.inv_one] at h
    rw [hAeq]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hinv
  change StrictMonotoneOn
    (RealTheory.ClosedInterval RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one)
    (SubFun asinGeom IdentityFun)
  exact RealDerivative.strictMonotoneOn_closedInterval_of_derivative_positive
    hcont hdiff hpos

name: asinGeom_gt_identity_zeroOneOpenInterval
statement:
theorem asinGeom_gt_identity_zeroOneOpenInterval
    {x : Point}
    (hx : ZeroOneOpenInterval x) :
    RealTheory.lt x (asinGeom x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hzeroClosed : ZeroOneClosedInterval F.zero :=
    And.intro (F.le_refl F.zero)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F))
  have hxClosed : ZeroOneClosedInterval x :=
    And.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.right)
  have hdiffPos :=
    asinGeom_sub_identity_strictMonotoneOn_zeroOneClosed
      F.zero x hzeroClosed hxClosed hx.left
  unfold SubFun IdentityFun at hdiffPos
  change
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.sub (asinGeom RealTheory.zero) RealTheory.zero)
      (RealTheory.sub (asinGeom x) x) at hdiffPos
  rw [asinGeom_zero] at hdiffPos
  change F.lt (F.sub F.zero F.zero) (F.sub (asinGeom x) x) at hdiffPos
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F] at hdiffPos
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F hdiffPos

name: asinGeom_mul_sqrtOneMinusSq_lt_identity_zeroOneOpenInterval
statement:
theorem asinGeom_mul_sqrtOneMinusSq_lt_identity_zeroOneOpenInterval
    {x : Point}
    (hx : ZeroOneOpenInterval x) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (asinGeom x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x)) x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxClosed : ZeroOneClosedInterval x := by
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.right)
  have hxUnitClosed : UnitClosedInterval x :=
    zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval x hxClosed
  let A := unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive x
  let s := sqrtOneMinusSq x
  have hA_le_x :
      F.le A x :=
    unitSemicircleAreaPrimitive_le_identity_zeroOneClosedInterval hxClosed
  have htwo_pos : F.lt F.zero twoPoint := by
    unfold twoPoint
    change F.lt F.zero (F.add F.one F.one)
    have hsum :
        F.lt (F.add F.zero F.zero)
          (F.add F.one F.one) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
    rwa [F.add_zero] at hsum
  have htwo_nonneg : F.le F.zero twoPoint :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F htwo_pos
  have htwoA_le_twoX :
      F.le (F.mul twoPoint A) (F.mul twoPoint x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
      F hA_le_x htwo_nonneg
  have hs_nonneg : F.le F.zero s :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_nonneg_unitClosedInterval hxUnitClosed
  have hasin_le :
      F.le
        (F.sub (F.mul twoPoint A) (F.mul x s))
        (F.sub (F.mul twoPoint x) (F.mul x s)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F htwoA_le_twoX (F.le_refl (F.mul x s))
  have hmul_le :
      F.le
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul twoPoint A) (F.mul x s)) s)
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul twoPoint x) (F.mul x s)) s) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hasin_le hs_nonneg
  have hfactor_lt :
      F.lt (F.mul (F.sub twoPoint s) s) F.one := by
    exact two_sub_self_mul_self_lt_one_of_lt_one
      (sqrtOneMinusSq_lt_one_zeroOneOpenInterval hx)
  have hupper_eq :
      F.mul (F.sub (F.mul twoPoint x) (F.mul x s)) s =
        F.mul x (F.mul (F.sub twoPoint s) s) := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.sub (F.mul twoPoint x) (F.mul x s)) s =
          F.mul (F.sub (F.mul x twoPoint) (F.mul x s)) s := by
            rw [F.mul_comm twoPoint x]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul x (F.sub twoPoint s)) s := by
            rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
              F x twoPoint s]
      _ = F.mul x (F.mul (F.sub twoPoint s) s) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
  have hupper_lt :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul twoPoint x) (F.mul x s)) s) x := by
    rw [hupper_eq]
    have hlt :
        F.lt
          (F.mul x (F.mul (F.sub twoPoint s) s))
          (F.mul x F.one) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left
        F hfactor_lt hx.left
    rwa [F.mul_one] at hlt
  have hraw :
      F.le (F.mul (asinGeom x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x))
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul twoPoint x) (F.mul x s)) s) := by
    unfold asinGeom
    change
      F.le
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul twoPoint A) (F.mul x s)) s)
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.mul twoPoint x) (F.mul x s)) s)
    exact hmul_le
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hraw hupper_lt

name: asinGeom_comp_sqrtOneMinusSq_hasDerivWithin_zeroOneOpenInterval
statement:
theorem asinGeom_comp_sqrtOneMinusSq_hasDerivWithin_zeroOneOpenInterval
    {x : Point}
    (hx : ZeroOneOpenInterval x) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin ZeroOneOpenInterval
      (CompFun asinGeom sqrtOneMinusSq) x
      (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsqrt :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin ZeroOneOpenInterval
        sqrtOneMinusSq x
        (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq x)))) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_hasDerivWithin_zeroOneOpenInterval hx
  have hsZeroOne : ZeroOneOpenInterval (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_maps_zeroOneOpen_to_zeroOneOpen x hx
  have hasin :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval asinGeom
        (sqrtOneMinusSq x)
        (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq (sqrtOneMinusSq x))) :=
    asinGeom_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval
      (zeroOneOpen_subset_unitOpenInterval
        (sqrtOneMinusSq x) hsZeroOne)
  have hcomp :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin ZeroOneOpenInterval
        (CompFun asinGeom sqrtOneMinusSq) x
        (F.mul (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq (sqrtOneMinusSq x)))
          (F.neg (F.mul x (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq x))))) :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_comp
      hsqrt hasin
      (fun y hy _ _ =>
        zeroOneOpen_subset_unitOpenInterval
          (sqrtOneMinusSq y)
          (sqrtOneMinusSq_maps_zeroOneOpen_to_zeroOneOpen y hy))
  refine And.intro hcomp.left ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
    (M := F.neg (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq x))) ?_ hcomp.right
  have hxClosed : ZeroOneClosedInterval x :=
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx.right)
  have hnested :
      sqrtOneMinusSq (sqrtOneMinusSq x) = x :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_sqrtOneMinusSq_zeroOneClosedInterval hxClosed
  have hxne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x := hx.left
    rw [hzero] at hxpos
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F F.zero) hxpos
  rw [hnested]
  exact inv_mul_neg_mul_inv_cancel_left_base F hxne
