name: add_left_comm_base
statement:
private theorem add_left_comm_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x y z : Point) :
    F.add x (F.add y z) = F.add y (F.add x z)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add x (F.add y z) =
        F.add (F.add x y) z := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.add y x) z := by
          rw [F.add_comm x y]
    _ = F.add y (F.add x z) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]

name: mul_left_comm_base
statement:
private theorem mul_left_comm_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x y z : Point) :
    F.mul x (F.mul y z) = F.mul y (F.mul x z)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul x (F.mul y z) =
        F.mul (F.mul x y) z := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul y x) z := by
          rw [F.mul_comm x y]
    _ = F.mul y (F.mul x z) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: mul_mul_pair_eq_base
statement:
private theorem mul_mul_pair_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
      F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d) =
        F.mul a (F.mul b (F.mul c d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul a (F.mul c (F.mul b d)) := by
          rw [mul_left_comm_base F b c d]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]

name: add_add_sub_cancel_same_base
statement:
private theorem add_add_sub_cancel_same_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (A B C : Point) :
    F.add (F.add A C) (F.sub B C) = F.add A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    F.add (F.add A C) (F.add B (F.neg C)) =
        F.add A (F.add C (F.add B (F.neg C))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc A C (F.add B (F.neg C))]
    _ = F.add A (F.add B (F.add C (F.neg C))) := by
          rw [add_left_comm_base F C B (F.neg C)]
    _ = F.add A (F.add B F.zero) := by
          rw [F.add_neg C]
    _ = F.add A B := by
          rw [F.add_zero B]

name: add_four_reorder_base
statement:
private theorem add_four_reorder_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (A B C D : Point) :
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add C B) =
      F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add C B) =
        F.add A (F.add D (F.add C B)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc A D (F.add C B)]
    _ = F.add A (F.add C (F.add D B)) := by
          rw [add_left_comm_base F D C B]
    _ = F.add A (F.add C (F.add B D)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm D B]
    _ = F.add A (F.add B (F.add C D)) := by
          rw [add_left_comm_base F C B D]
    _ = F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc A B (F.add C D)]

name: le_of_add_le_add_left_base
statement:
private theorem le_of_add_le_add_left_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {a b c : Point}
    (h : F.le (F.add a b) (F.add a c)) :
    F.le b c
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm :
      F.le (F.add b a) (F.add c a) := by
    rwa [F.add_comm a b, F.add_comm a c] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_add_le_add_right F hcomm

name: lt_of_add_lt_add_left_base
statement:
private theorem lt_of_add_lt_add_left_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {a b c : Point}
    (h : F.lt (F.add a b) (F.add a c)) :
    F.lt b c
proof:
:= by
  have hle : F.le b c :=
    le_of_add_le_add_left_base F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F h)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hle
  intro hcb
  have hrev :
      F.le (F.add a c) (F.add a b) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hcb a
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F h) hrev

name: strictMonotoneOn_reflects_le_base
statement:
private theorem strictMonotoneOn_reflects_le_base
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x y : Point}
    (hstrict : StrictMonotoneOn E f)
    (hx : E x) (hy : E y)
    (hfy : RealTheory.le (f x) (f y)) :
    RealTheory.le x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hxy : F.le x y
  · exact hxy
  · have hyx : F.le y x := by
      cases F.le_total x y with
      | inl h => exact False.elim (hxy h)
      | inr h => exact h
    have hyx_lt : F.lt y x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyx hxy
    have hfyx : F.lt (f y) (f x) :=
      hstrict y x hy hx hyx_lt
    exact False.elim
      ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hfyx) hfy)

name: strictMonotoneOn_reflects_lt_base
statement:
private theorem strictMonotoneOn_reflects_lt_base
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {x y : Point}
    (hstrict : StrictMonotoneOn E f)
    (hx : E x) (hy : E y)
    (hfy : RealTheory.lt (f x) (f y)) :
    RealTheory.lt x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxy_le : F.le x y :=
    strictMonotoneOn_reflects_le_base hstrict hx hy
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hfy)
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hxy_le
  intro hyx
  have hxy : x = y := F.le_antisymm hxy_le hyx
  rw [hxy] at hfy
  exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F (f y)) hfy

name: zeroOneClosedInterval_of_unitClosed_nonneg
statement:
theorem zeroOneClosedInterval_of_unitClosed_nonneg
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero x) :
    ZeroOneClosedInterval x
proof:
:=
  And.intro hx0 hx.right

name: neg_mem_zeroOneClosedInterval_of_unitClosed_nonpos
statement:
theorem neg_mem_zeroOneClosedInterval_of_unitClosed_nonpos
    {x : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le x RealTheory.zero) :
    ZeroOneClosedInterval (RealTheory.neg x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft :
      F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx0
  have hright_raw :
      F.le (F.neg x) (F.neg (F.neg F.one)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hx.left
  have hright : F.le (F.neg x) F.one := by
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F F.one] at hright_raw
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: product_le_of_nonneg_bounds_base
statement:
private theorem product_le_of_nonneg_bounds_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x y sx sy : Point}
    (hy0 : F.le F.zero y)
    (hsy0 : F.le F.zero sy)
    (hx_le_sy : F.le x sy)
    (hy_le_sx : F.le y sx) :
    F.le (F.mul x y) (F.mul sx sy)
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst :
      F.le (F.mul x y) (F.mul sy y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F hx_le_sy hy0
  have hfirst' :
      F.le (F.mul x y) (F.mul y sy) := by
    rwa [F.mul_comm sy y] at hfirst
  have hsecond :
      F.le (F.mul y sy) (F.mul sx sy) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right F hy_le_sx hsy0
  exact F.le_trans hfirst' hsecond

name: product_nonpos_of_nonpos_nonneg_base
statement:
private theorem product_nonpos_of_nonpos_nonneg_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x y : Point}
    (hx0 : F.le x F.zero)
    (hy0 : F.le F.zero y) :
    F.le (F.mul x y) F.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hnegx0 :
      F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx0
  have hprod_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) y) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hnegx0 hy0
  have hnonpos :
      F.le (F.neg (F.mul (F.neg x) y)) F.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonpos_of_nonneg F hprod_nonneg
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F x y] at hnonpos
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F (F.mul x y)] at hnonpos

name: product_nonpos_of_nonneg_nonpos_base
statement:
private theorem product_nonpos_of_nonneg_nonpos_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x y : Point}
    (hx0 : F.le F.zero x)
    (hy0 : F.le y F.zero) :
    F.le (F.mul x y) F.zero
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      F.le (F.mul y x) F.zero :=
    product_nonpos_of_nonpos_nonneg_base F hy0 hx0
  rwa [F.mul_comm y x] at h

name: product_lt_of_nonneg_bounds_strict_right_base
statement:
private theorem product_lt_of_nonneg_bounds_strict_right_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x y sx sy : Point}
    (hy0 : F.le F.zero y)
    (hsy_pos : F.lt F.zero sy)
    (hx_le_sy : F.le x sy)
    (hy_lt_sx : F.lt y sx) :
    F.lt (F.mul x y) (F.mul sx sy)
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst :
      F.le (F.mul x y) (F.mul sy y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      F hx_le_sy hy0
  have hfirst' :
      F.le (F.mul x y) (F.mul y sy) := by
    rwa [F.mul_comm sy y] at hfirst
  have hsecond :
      F.lt (F.mul y sy) (F.mul sx sy) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right
      F hy_lt_sx hsy_pos
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hfirst' hsecond

name: neg_pos_of_lt_zero_base
statement:
private theorem neg_pos_of_lt_zero_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x : Point}
    (hx : F.lt x F.zero) :
    F.lt F.zero (F.neg x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hx
  change F.lt (F.neg F.zero) (F.neg x) at h
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h

name: product_neg_of_neg_pos_base
statement:
private theorem product_neg_of_neg_pos_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : F.lt x F.zero)
    (hy : F.lt F.zero y) :
    F.lt (F.mul x y) F.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hnegx_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.neg x) :=
    neg_pos_of_lt_zero_base F hx
  have hprod_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hnegx_pos hy
  have hneg_prod :
      F.lt (F.neg (F.mul (F.neg x) y)) (F.neg F.zero) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hprod_pos
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at hneg_prod
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F x y] at hneg_prod
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F (F.mul x y)] at hneg_prod

name: product_neg_of_pos_neg_base
statement:
private theorem product_neg_of_pos_neg_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : F.lt F.zero x)
    (hy : F.lt y F.zero) :
    F.lt (F.mul x y) F.zero
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      F.lt (F.mul y x) F.zero :=
    product_neg_of_neg_pos_base F hy hx
  rwa [F.mul_comm y x] at h

name: sub_nonneg_of_le_base
statement:
private theorem sub_nonneg_of_le_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x y : Point}
    (hxy : F.le x y) :
    F.le F.zero (F.sub y x)
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hxy

name: principalArcsinAddRange_comm
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddRange_comm
    {x t : Point}
    (hrange : PrincipalArcsinAddRange x t) :
    PrincipalArcsinAddRange t x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PrincipalArcsinAddRange PrincipalAngleInterval
    principalArcsinAngleSum at hrange
  unfold PrincipalArcsinAddRange PrincipalAngleInterval
    principalArcsinAngleSum
  change And
    (F.le (F.neg halfPi) (F.add (asinGeom t) (asinGeom x)))
    (F.le (F.add (asinGeom t) (asinGeom x)) halfPi)
  rwa [F.add_comm (asinGeom t) (asinGeom x)]

name: square_nonneg_base
statement:
private theorem square_nonneg_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (x : Point) :
    F.le F.zero (F.mul x x)
proof:
:= by
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl hx =>
      exact F.mul_nonneg hx hx
  | inr hx =>
      have hneg_nonneg :
          F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx
      have hsq :
          F.le F.zero (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg x)) :=
        F.mul_nonneg hneg_nonneg hneg_nonneg
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x x] at hsq

name: square_le_one_of_square_add_square_eq_one_base
statement:
private theorem square_le_one_of_square_add_square_eq_one_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {z w : Point}
    (hunit : F.add (F.mul z z) (F.mul w w) = F.one) :
    F.le (F.mul z z) F.one
proof:
:= by
  have hw_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.mul w w) :=
    square_nonneg_base F w
  have hle :
      F.le (F.add (F.mul z z) F.zero)
        (F.add (F.mul z z) (F.mul w w)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hw_nonneg (F.mul z z)
  rwa [F.add_zero, hunit] at hle

name: right_bound_of_square_le_one_base
statement:
private theorem right_bound_of_square_le_one_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {z : Point}
    (hsq : F.le (F.mul z z) F.one) :
    F.le z F.one
proof:
:= by
  cases F.le_total F.zero z with
  | inl hz_nonneg =>
      cases F.le_total z F.one with
      | inl hz_le_one =>
          exact hz_le_one
      | inr hone_le_z =>
          have hz_le_sq :
              F.le z (F.mul z z) := by
            have hmul :
                F.le (F.mul F.one z) (F.mul z z) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
                F hone_le_z hz_nonneg
            rwa [F.one_mul] at hmul
          exact F.le_trans hz_le_sq hsq
  | inr hz_nonpos =>
      exact F.le_trans hz_nonpos
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_le_one F)

name: unitClosedInterval_of_square_le_one_base
statement:
private theorem unitClosedInterval_of_square_le_one_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {z : Point}
    (hsq : F.le (F.mul z z) F.one) :
    And (F.le (F.neg F.one) z) (F.le z F.one)
proof:
:= by
  have hright : F.le z F.one :=
    right_bound_of_square_le_one_base F hsq
  have hneg_sq :
      F.le (F.mul (F.neg z) (F.neg z)) F.one := by
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F z z]
  have hneg_right : F.le (F.neg z) F.one :=
    right_bound_of_square_le_one_base F hneg_sq
  have hleft_raw : F.le (F.neg F.one) (F.neg (F.neg z)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hneg_right
  have hleft : F.le (F.neg F.one) z := by
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F z] at hleft_raw
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: unitOpenInterval_of_unitClosed_square_lt_one_base
statement:
private theorem unitOpenInterval_of_unitClosed_square_lt_one_base
    {z : Point}
    (hz : UnitClosedInterval z)
    (hsq : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul z z) RealTheory.one) :
    UnitOpenInterval z
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change And (F.le (F.neg F.one) z) (F.le z F.one) at hz
  have hright : F.lt z F.one := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hz.right
    intro hone_le_z
    have hz0 : F.le F.zero z :=
      F.le_trans (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_le_one F) hone_le_z
    have hz_le_sq : F.le z (F.mul z z) := by
      have hmul :
          F.le (F.mul F.one z) (F.mul z z) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
          F hone_le_z hz0
      rwa [F.one_mul] at hmul
    have hone_le_sq : F.le F.one (F.mul z z) :=
      F.le_trans hone_le_z hz_le_sq
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hsq) hone_le_sq
  have hleft : F.lt (F.neg F.one) z := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hz.left
    intro hz_le_neg_one
    have hone_le_neg_z : F.le F.one (F.neg z) := by
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hz_le_neg_one
      change F.le (F.neg (F.neg F.one)) (F.neg z) at h
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F F.one] at h
    have hneg_z0 : F.le F.zero (F.neg z) :=
      F.le_trans (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_le_one F) hone_le_neg_z
    have hneg_z_le_sq :
        F.le (F.neg z) (F.mul (F.neg z) (F.neg z)) := by
      have hmul :
          F.le (F.mul F.one (F.neg z))
            (F.mul (F.neg z) (F.neg z)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
          F hone_le_neg_z hneg_z0
      rwa [F.one_mul] at hmul
    have hone_le_neg_sq :
        F.le F.one (F.mul (F.neg z) (F.neg z)) :=
      F.le_trans hone_le_neg_z hneg_z_le_sq
    have hone_le_sq : F.le F.one (F.mul z z) := by
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F z z]
        at hone_le_neg_sq
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hsq) hone_le_sq
  unfold UnitOpenInterval RealTheory.OpenInterval
  change And (F.lt (F.neg F.one) z) (F.lt z F.one)
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: add_sq_eq_base
statement:
private theorem add_sq_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b) =
      F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a b))
        (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  calc
    F.add (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b a))
        (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b b)) =
        F.add (F.mul a a)
          (F.add (F.mul b a)
            (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b b))) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add (F.mul a a)
          (F.add (F.mul a b)
            (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b))) := by
          rw [add_left_comm_base F
            (F.mul b a) (F.mul a b) (F.mul b b)]
    _ = F.add
          (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul a b))
          (F.add (F.mul b a) (F.mul b b)) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: add_sq_eq_grouped_base
statement:
private theorem add_sq_eq_grouped_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.mul (F.add a b) (F.add a b) =
      F.add
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b))
        (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul b a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_sq_eq_base F a b]
  let A := F.mul a a
  let B := F.mul a b
  let C := F.mul b a
  let D := F.mul b b
  change F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) =
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C)
  calc
    F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) =
        F.add A (F.add B (F.add C D)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc A B (F.add C D)]
    _ = F.add A (F.add (F.add B C) D) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc B C D]
    _ = F.add A (F.add D (F.add B C)) := by
          rw [F.add_comm (F.add B C) D]
    _ = F.add (F.add A D) (F.add B C) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc A D (F.add B C)]

name: sub_sq_eq_base
statement:
private theorem sub_sq_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b : Point) :
    F.mul (F.sub a b) (F.sub a b) =
      F.sub
        (F.add (F.mul a a)
          (F.mul b b))
        (F.add (F.mul a b)
          (F.mul b a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [F.mul_add]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F]
  let aa := F.mul a a
  let ab := F.mul a b
  let ba := F.mul b a
  let bb := F.mul b b
  change
    F.add (F.add aa (F.neg ab)) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb) =
      F.add (F.add aa bb) (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba))
  calc
    F.add (F.add aa (F.neg ab)) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb) =
        F.add aa (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc aa (F.neg ab) (F.add (F.neg ba) bb)]
    _ = F.add aa (F.add (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba)) bb) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba) bb]
    _ = F.add aa (F.add bb (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba))) := by
          rw [F.add_comm (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba)) bb]
    _ = F.add (F.add aa bb) (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba)) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc aa bb (F.add (F.neg ab) (F.neg ba))]

name: cross_terms_eq_base
statement:
private theorem cross_terms_eq_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d))
        (F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.mul a b)) =
      F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul c b) (F.mul a d))
        (F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul c b))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d))
        (F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.mul a b)) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d))
          (F.mul (F.mul c a) (F.mul d b)) := by
          rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_base F a b c d]
          rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_base F c d a b]
    _ = F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d))
          (F.mul (F.mul a c) (F.mul b d)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm c a]
          rw [F.mul_comm d b]
    _ = F.add
        (F.mul (F.mul c b) (F.mul a d))
        (F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul c b)) := by
          rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_base F c b a d]
          rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_base F a d c b]
          rw [F.mul_comm c a]
          rw [F.mul_comm d b]

name: sum_squares_pair_identity_base
statement:
private theorem sum_squares_pair_identity_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.add
        (F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul a b) (F.mul a b))
          (F.mul (F.mul c d) (F.mul c d)))
        (F.add
          (F.mul (F.mul c b) (F.mul c b))
          (F.mul (F.mul a d) (F.mul a d))) =
      F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_base F a b a b]
  rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_base F c d c d]
  rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_base F c b c b]
  rw [mul_mul_pair_eq_base F a d a d]
  let A := F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul b b)
  let B := F.mul (F.mul a a) (F.mul d d)
  let C := F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul b b)
  let D := F.mul (F.mul c c) (F.mul d d)
  change
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add C B) =
      F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d))
  calc
    F.add (F.add A D) (F.add C B) =
        F.add (F.add A B) (F.add C D) := by
          exact add_four_reorder_base F A B C D
    _ = F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d)) := by
          symm
          rw [F.add_mul]
          rw [F.mul_add]
          rw [F.mul_add]

name: rot_unit_identity_base
statement:
private theorem rot_unit_identity_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    (a b c d : Point) :
    F.add
        (F.mul
          (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d))
          (F.add (F.mul a b) (F.mul c d)))
        (F.mul
          (F.sub (F.mul c b) (F.mul a d))
          (F.sub (F.mul c b) (F.mul a d))) =
      F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d))
proof:
:= by
  let p := F.mul a b
  let q := F.mul c d
  let r := F.mul c b
  let s := F.mul a d
  change
    F.add (F.mul (F.add p q) (F.add p q))
        (F.mul (F.sub r s) (F.sub r s)) =
      F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d))
  rw [add_sq_eq_grouped_base F p q]
  rw [sub_sq_eq_base F r s]
  rw [<- cross_terms_eq_base F a b c d]
  calc
    F.add
        (F.add
          (F.add (F.mul p p) (F.mul q q))
          (F.add (F.mul p q) (F.mul q p)))
        (F.sub
          (F.add (F.mul r r) (F.mul s s))
          (F.add (F.mul p q) (F.mul q p))) =
        F.add
          (F.add (F.mul p p) (F.mul q q))
          (F.add (F.mul r r) (F.mul s s)) := by
          exact add_add_sub_cancel_same_base F
            (F.add (F.mul p p) (F.mul q q))
            (F.add (F.mul r r) (F.mul s s))
            (F.add (F.mul p q) (F.mul q p))
    _ = F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul a a) (F.mul c c))
        (F.add (F.mul b b) (F.mul d d)) := by
          exact sum_squares_pair_identity_base F a b c d

name: principalArcsinAdd_unit_identity
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAdd_unit_identity
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (hy : UnitClosedInterval y) :
    RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)
        (principalArcsinAddRhs x y))
      (RealTheory.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)
        (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxUnit :
      F.add (F.mul x x)
        (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x)) = F.one := by
    have hsq :
        F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x) =
          F.sub F.one (F.mul x x) := by
      change
        RealTheory.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq x) =
          RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul x x)
      exact sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq hx
    rw [hsq]
    change F.add (F.mul x x) (F.sub F.one (F.mul x x)) = F.one
    rw [F.add_comm (F.mul x x) (F.sub F.one (F.mul x x))]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F F.one (F.mul x x)
  have hyUnit :
      F.add
        (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq y))
        (F.mul y y) = F.one := by
    have hsq :
        F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq y) =
          F.sub F.one (F.mul y y) := by
      change
        RealTheory.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq y) =
          RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul y y)
      exact sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq hy
    rw [hsq]
    change F.add (F.sub F.one (F.mul y y)) (F.mul y y) = F.one
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F F.one (F.mul y y)
  unfold principalArcsinAddRhs principalArcsinAddCosFactor
  change
    F.add
      (F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul x (sqrtOneMinusSq y))
          (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) y))
        (F.add (F.mul x (sqrtOneMinusSq y))
          (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) y)))
      (F.mul
        (F.sub
          (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq y))
          (F.mul x y))
        (F.sub
          (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq y))
          (F.mul x y))) =
      F.one
  rw [rot_unit_identity_base F
    x (sqrtOneMinusSq y) (sqrtOneMinusSq x) y]
  rw [hxUnit]
  rw [hyUnit]
  rw [F.one_mul]

name: principalArcsinAddRhs_mem_unitClosedInterval
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddRhs_mem_unitClosedInterval
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (hy : UnitClosedInterval y) :
    UnitClosedInterval (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hunit :
      F.add
        (F.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)
          (principalArcsinAddRhs x y))
        (F.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)
          (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)) =
        F.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)
          (principalArcsinAddRhs x y))
        (RealTheory.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)
          (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact principalArcsinAdd_unit_identity hx hy
  have hsq :
      F.le
        (F.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)
          (principalArcsinAddRhs x y))
        F.one :=
    square_le_one_of_square_add_square_eq_one_base
      F hunit
  change
    And
      (F.le (F.neg F.one) (principalArcsinAddRhs x y))
      (F.le (principalArcsinAddRhs x y) F.one)
  exact unitClosedInterval_of_square_le_one_base F hsq

name: principalArcsinAdd_one_sub_rhs_sq_eq_cosFactor_sq
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAdd_one_sub_rhs_sq_eq_cosFactor_sq
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (hy : UnitClosedInterval y) :
    RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)
          (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)) =
      RealTheory.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)
        (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hunit :
      F.add
        (F.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)
          (principalArcsinAddRhs x y))
        (F.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)
          (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)) =
        F.one := by
    change
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)
          (principalArcsinAddRhs x y))
        (RealTheory.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)
          (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)) =
        RealTheory.one
    exact principalArcsinAdd_unit_identity hx hy
  have hcomm :
      F.one =
        F.add
          (F.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)
            (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y))
          (F.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)
            (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)) := by
    rw [<- hunit]
    rw [F.add_comm]
  have hcos :
      F.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y)
          (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x y) =
        F.sub F.one
        (F.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)
            (principalArcsinAddRhs x y)) :=
    RealTheory.eq_sub_of_eq_add_right hcomm
  exact hcos.symm

name: principalArcsinAddRhs_sq_lt_one_of_cosFactor_pos
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddRhs_sq_lt_one_of_cosFactor_pos
    {x t : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (ht : UnitClosedInterval t)
    (hcos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x t)
        (principalArcsinAddRhs x t))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub_pos :
      F.lt F.zero
        (F.sub F.one
          (F.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x t)
            (principalArcsinAddRhs x t))) := by
    change RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x t)
          (principalArcsinAddRhs x t)))
    rw [principalArcsinAdd_one_sub_rhs_sq_eq_cosFactor_sq hx ht]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hcos hcos
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_sub_pos F hsub_pos

name: principalArcsinAddRhs_mem_unitOpenInterval_of_cosFactor_pos
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddRhs_mem_unitOpenInterval_of_cosFactor_pos
    {x t : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (ht : UnitClosedInterval t)
    (hcos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t)) :
    UnitOpenInterval (principalArcsinAddRhs x t)
proof:
:= by
  have hzClosed :
      UnitClosedInterval (principalArcsinAddRhs x t) :=
    principalArcsinAddRhs_mem_unitClosedInterval hx ht
  have hsq :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (principalArcsinAddRhs x t)
          (principalArcsinAddRhs x t))
        RealTheory.one :=
    principalArcsinAddRhs_sq_lt_one_of_cosFactor_pos
      hx ht hcos
  exact unitOpenInterval_of_unitClosed_square_lt_one_base
    hzClosed hsq

name: principalArcsinAddPath_mem_unitClosedInterval
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddPath_mem_unitClosedInterval
    {y t : Point}
    (hy : UnitClosedInterval y)
    (ht : PrincipalArcsinAddPath y t) :
    UnitClosedInterval t
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases ht with
  | inl h0ty =>
      change And (F.le F.zero t) (F.le t y) at h0ty
      exact And.intro
        (F.le_trans zero_mem_unitClosedInterval.left h0ty.left)
        (F.le_trans h0ty.right hy.right)
  | inr hyt0 =>
      change And (F.le y t) (F.le t F.zero) at hyt0
      exact And.intro
        (F.le_trans hy.left hyt0.left)
        (F.le_trans hyt0.right zero_mem_unitClosedInterval.right)

name: principalArcsinAddOpenPath_to_path
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddOpenPath_to_path
    {y t : Point}
    (ht : PrincipalArcsinAddOpenPath y t) :
    PrincipalArcsinAddPath y t
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PrincipalArcsinAddOpenPath at ht
  change Or
    (And (F.lt F.zero t) (F.lt t y))
    (And (F.lt y t) (F.lt t F.zero)) at ht
  unfold PrincipalArcsinAddPath
  change Or
    (And (F.le F.zero t) (F.le t y))
    (And (F.le y t) (F.le t F.zero))
  cases ht with
  | inl h0ty =>
      exact Or.inl
        (And.intro
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F h0ty.left)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F h0ty.right))
  | inr hyt0 =>
      exact Or.inr
        (And.intro
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hyt0.left)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hyt0.right))

name: principalArcsinAddOpenPath_mem_unitOpenInterval
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddOpenPath_mem_unitOpenInterval
    {y t : Point}
    (hy : UnitClosedInterval y)
    (ht : PrincipalArcsinAddOpenPath y t) :
    UnitOpenInterval t
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PrincipalArcsinAddOpenPath at ht
  change Or
    (And (F.lt F.zero t) (F.lt t y))
    (And (F.lt y t) (F.lt t F.zero)) at ht
  unfold UnitOpenInterval RealTheory.OpenInterval
  change And (F.lt (F.neg F.one) t) (F.lt t F.one)
  cases ht with
  | inl h0ty =>
      exact And.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_one_lt_zero F) h0ty.left)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F h0ty.right hy.right)
  | inr hyt0 =>
      exact And.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hy.left hyt0.left)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hyt0.right RealTheory.zero_lt_one)

name: principalArcsinAdd_pathRange
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAdd_pathRange
    {x y t : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (hy : UnitClosedInterval y)
    (hrange : PrincipalArcsinAddRange x y)
    (ht : PrincipalArcsinAddPath y t) :
    PrincipalArcsinAddRange x t
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxAngle := asinGeom_maps_unitClosed_to_principalAngle x hx
  change And (F.le (F.neg halfPi) (asinGeom x))
    (F.le (asinGeom x) halfPi) at hxAngle
  have htUnit : UnitClosedInterval t :=
    principalArcsinAddPath_mem_unitClosedInterval hy ht
  have hrangeRaw := hrange
  unfold PrincipalArcsinAddRange PrincipalAngleInterval
    principalArcsinAngleSum at hrangeRaw
  change And
    (F.le (F.neg halfPi)
      (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom y)))
    (F.le (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom y)) halfPi)
    at hrangeRaw
  unfold PrincipalArcsinAddRange PrincipalAngleInterval
    principalArcsinAngleSum
  change And
    (F.le (F.neg halfPi)
      (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)))
    (F.le (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) halfPi)
  cases ht with
  | inl h0ty =>
      change And (F.le F.zero t) (F.le t y) at h0ty
      have hzero_le_asin_t :
          F.le F.zero (asinGeom t) := by
        have hmono :=
          asinGeom_monotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
            F.zero t zero_mem_unitClosedInterval htUnit h0ty.left
        change F.le (asinGeom RealTheory.zero) (asinGeom t) at hmono
        rwa [asinGeom_zero] at hmono
      have hasin_t_le_asin_y :
          F.le (asinGeom t) (asinGeom y) :=
        asinGeom_monotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
          t y htUnit hy h0ty.right
      have hx_le_sum :
          F.le (asinGeom x)
            (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) := by
        have h :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
            F hzero_le_asin_t (asinGeom x)
        rwa [F.add_zero] at h
      have hleft :
          F.le (F.neg halfPi)
            (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) :=
        F.le_trans hxAngle.left hx_le_sum
      have hsum_le_endpoint :
          F.le (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t))
            (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom y)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
          F hasin_t_le_asin_y (asinGeom x)
      have hright :
          F.le (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) halfPi :=
        F.le_trans hsum_le_endpoint hrangeRaw.right
      exact And.intro hleft hright
  | inr hyt0 =>
      change And (F.le y t) (F.le t F.zero) at hyt0
      have hasin_y_le_asin_t :
          F.le (asinGeom y) (asinGeom t) :=
        asinGeom_monotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
          y t hy htUnit hyt0.left
      have hasin_t_le_zero :
          F.le (asinGeom t) F.zero := by
        have hmono :=
          asinGeom_monotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
            t F.zero htUnit zero_mem_unitClosedInterval hyt0.right
        change F.le (asinGeom t) (asinGeom RealTheory.zero) at hmono
        rwa [asinGeom_zero] at hmono
      have endpoint_le_sum :
          F.le (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom y))
            (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
          F hasin_y_le_asin_t (asinGeom x)
      have hleft :
          F.le (F.neg halfPi)
            (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) :=
        F.le_trans hrangeRaw.left endpoint_le_sum
      have hsum_le_x :
          F.le (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t))
            (asinGeom x) := by
        have h :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
            F hasin_t_le_zero (asinGeom x)
        rwa [F.add_zero] at h
      have hright :
          F.le (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) halfPi :=
        F.le_trans hsum_le_x hxAngle.right
      exact And.intro hleft hright

name: principalArcsinAdd_openPathRange
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAdd_openPathRange
    {x y t : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (hy : UnitClosedInterval y)
    (hrange : PrincipalArcsinAddRange x y)
    (ht : PrincipalArcsinAddOpenPath y t) :
    PrincipalArcsinAddRange x t
proof:
:=
  principalArcsinAdd_pathRange hx hy hrange
    (principalArcsinAddOpenPath_to_path ht)

name: principalArcsinAdd_openPathStrictRange
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAdd_openPathStrictRange
    {x y t : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (hy : UnitClosedInterval y)
    (hrange : PrincipalArcsinAddRange x y)
    (ht : PrincipalArcsinAddOpenPath y t) :
    PrincipalAngleOpenInterval (principalArcsinAngleSum x t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxAngle := asinGeom_maps_unitClosed_to_principalAngle x hx
  change And (F.le (F.neg halfPi) (asinGeom x))
    (F.le (asinGeom x) halfPi) at hxAngle
  have htClosed : UnitClosedInterval t :=
    principalArcsinAddPath_mem_unitClosedInterval hy
      (principalArcsinAddOpenPath_to_path ht)
  have hrangeRaw := hrange
  unfold PrincipalArcsinAddRange PrincipalAngleInterval
    principalArcsinAngleSum at hrangeRaw
  change And
    (F.le (F.neg halfPi)
      (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom y)))
    (F.le (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom y)) halfPi)
    at hrangeRaw
  unfold PrincipalAngleOpenInterval RealTheory.OpenInterval
    principalArcsinAngleSum
  change And
    (F.lt (F.neg halfPi)
      (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)))
    (F.lt (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) halfPi)
  unfold PrincipalArcsinAddOpenPath at ht
  change Or
    (And (F.lt F.zero t) (F.lt t y))
    (And (F.lt y t) (F.lt t F.zero)) at ht
  cases ht with
  | inl h0ty =>
      have hzero_lt_asin_t :
          F.lt F.zero (asinGeom t) := by
        have hmono :=
          asinGeom_strictMonotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
            F.zero t zero_mem_unitClosedInterval htClosed h0ty.left
        change F.lt (asinGeom RealTheory.zero) (asinGeom t) at hmono
        rwa [asinGeom_zero] at hmono
      have hasin_t_lt_asin_y :
          F.lt (asinGeom t) (asinGeom y) :=
        asinGeom_strictMonotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
          t y htClosed hy h0ty.right
      have hx_lt_sum :
          F.lt (asinGeom x)
            (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) := by
        have h :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
            F hzero_lt_asin_t (asinGeom x)
        rwa [F.add_zero] at h
      have hleft :
          F.lt (F.neg halfPi)
            (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
          hxAngle.left hx_lt_sum
      have hsum_lt_endpoint :
          F.lt (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t))
            (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom y)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
          F hasin_t_lt_asin_y (asinGeom x)
      have hright :
          F.lt (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) halfPi :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
          hsum_lt_endpoint hrangeRaw.right
      exact And.intro hleft hright
  | inr hyt0 =>
      have hasin_y_lt_asin_t :
          F.lt (asinGeom y) (asinGeom t) :=
        asinGeom_strictMonotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
          y t hy htClosed hyt0.left
      have hasin_t_lt_zero :
          F.lt (asinGeom t) F.zero := by
        have hmono :=
          asinGeom_strictMonotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
            t F.zero htClosed zero_mem_unitClosedInterval hyt0.right
        change F.lt (asinGeom t) (asinGeom RealTheory.zero) at hmono
        rwa [asinGeom_zero] at hmono
      have endpoint_lt_sum :
          F.lt (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom y))
            (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
          F hasin_y_lt_asin_t (asinGeom x)
      have hleft :
          F.lt (F.neg halfPi)
            (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
          hrangeRaw.left endpoint_lt_sum
      have hsum_lt_x :
          F.lt (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t))
            (asinGeom x) := by
        have h :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
            F hasin_t_lt_zero (asinGeom x)
        rwa [F.add_zero] at h
      have hright :
          F.lt (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) halfPi :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
          hsum_lt_x hxAngle.right
      exact And.intro hleft hright

name: principalArcsinAdd_nonpos_right_neg_bound
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAdd_nonpos_right_neg_bound
    {x t : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (ht : UnitClosedInterval t)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.le x RealTheory.zero)
    (ht0 : RealTheory.le t RealTheory.zero)
    (hrange : PrincipalArcsinAddRange x t) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg t) (sqrtOneMinusSq x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnegxZeroOne :
      ZeroOneClosedInterval (F.neg x) :=
    neg_mem_zeroOneClosedInterval_of_unitClosed_nonpos hx hx0
  have hnegtZeroOne :
      ZeroOneClosedInterval (F.neg t) :=
    neg_mem_zeroOneClosedInterval_of_unitClosed_nonpos ht ht0
  have hnegxUnit :
      UnitClosedInterval (F.neg x) :=
    zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval (F.neg x) hnegxZeroOne
  have hnegtUnit :
      UnitClosedInterval (F.neg t) :=
    zeroOneClosed_subset_unitClosedInterval (F.neg t) hnegtZeroOne
  have hoddx_raw :=
    asinGeom_neg_zeroOneClosedInterval hnegxZeroOne
  have hoddt_raw :=
    asinGeom_neg_zeroOneClosedInterval hnegtZeroOne
  have hoddx :
      asinGeom x = F.neg (asinGeom (F.neg x)) := by
    change
      asinGeom (F.neg (F.neg x)) =
        F.neg (asinGeom (F.neg x)) at hoddx_raw
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F x] at hoddx_raw
  have hoddt :
      asinGeom t = F.neg (asinGeom (F.neg t)) := by
    change
      asinGeom (F.neg (F.neg t)) =
        F.neg (asinGeom (F.neg t)) at hoddt_raw
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F t] at hoddt_raw
  have hrangeRaw := hrange
  unfold PrincipalArcsinAddRange PrincipalAngleInterval
    principalArcsinAngleSum at hrangeRaw
  change And
    (F.le (F.neg halfPi)
      (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)))
    (F.le (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom t)) halfPi)
    at hrangeRaw
  have hsumNegUpper :
      F.le (principalArcsinAngleSum (F.neg x) (F.neg t))
        halfPi := by
    let A := asinGeom (F.neg x)
    let B := asinGeom (F.neg t)
    have hlower :
        F.le (F.neg halfPi) (F.add (F.neg A) (F.neg B)) := by
      have h := hrangeRaw.left
      rw [hoddx, hoddt] at h
      change
        F.le (F.neg halfPi) (F.add (F.neg A) (F.neg B))
        at h
      exact h
    have hneg :
        F.le (F.neg (F.add (F.neg A) (F.neg B)))
          (F.neg (F.neg halfPi)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hlower
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib F (F.neg A) (F.neg B)]
      at hneg
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F A] at hneg
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F B] at hneg
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F halfPi] at hneg
    unfold principalArcsinAngleSum
    exact hneg
  have hbound :
      F.le (F.neg t) (sqrtOneMinusSq (F.neg x)) :=
    principalArcsinAdd_nonneg_right_bound_of_sum_le_halfPi
      hnegxUnit hnegtUnit hnegxZeroOne.left hnegtZeroOne.left
      hsumNegUpper
  change
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg t)
      (sqrtOneMinusSq (RealTheory.neg x)) at hbound
  rwa [sqrtOneMinusSq_neg x] at hbound

name: principalArcsinAddCosFactor_nonneg
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddCosFactor_nonneg
    {x t : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (ht : UnitClosedInterval t)
    (hrange : PrincipalArcsinAddRange x t) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsx0 :
      F.le F.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_nonneg_unitClosedInterval hx
  have hst0 :
      F.le F.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq t) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_nonneg_unitClosedInterval ht
  have hrootProd0 :
      F.le F.zero
        (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hsx0 hst0
  unfold principalArcsinAddCosFactor
  change
    F.le F.zero
      (F.sub
        (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t))
        (F.mul x t))
  cases F.le_total F.zero x with
  | inl hx_nonneg =>
      cases F.le_total F.zero t with
      | inl ht_nonneg =>
          have ht_le_sx :
              F.le t (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
            principalArcsinAdd_nonneg_right_bound
              hx ht hx_nonneg ht_nonneg hrange
          have hx_le_st :
              F.le x (sqrtOneMinusSq t) :=
            principalArcsinAdd_nonneg_right_bound
              ht hx ht_nonneg hx_nonneg
              (principalArcsinAddRange_comm hrange)
          have hprod_le :
              F.le (F.mul x t)
                (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) :=
            product_le_of_nonneg_bounds_base F
              ht_nonneg hst0 hx_le_st ht_le_sx
          exact sub_nonneg_of_le_base F hprod_le
      | inr ht_nonpos =>
          have hprod_nonpos :
              F.le (F.mul x t) F.zero :=
            product_nonpos_of_nonneg_nonpos_base F
              hx_nonneg ht_nonpos
          have hprod_le_root :
              F.le (F.mul x t)
                (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) :=
            F.le_trans hprod_nonpos hrootProd0
          exact sub_nonneg_of_le_base F hprod_le_root
  | inr hx_nonpos =>
      cases F.le_total F.zero t with
      | inl ht_nonneg =>
          have hprod_nonpos :
              F.le (F.mul x t) F.zero :=
            product_nonpos_of_nonpos_nonneg_base F
              hx_nonpos ht_nonneg
          have hprod_le_root :
              F.le (F.mul x t)
                (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) :=
            F.le_trans hprod_nonpos hrootProd0
          exact sub_nonneg_of_le_base F hprod_le_root
      | inr ht_nonpos =>
          have hnegt_le_sx :
              F.le (F.neg t) (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
            principalArcsinAdd_nonpos_right_neg_bound
              hx ht hx_nonpos ht_nonpos hrange
          have hnegx_le_st :
              F.le (F.neg x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t) :=
            principalArcsinAdd_nonpos_right_neg_bound
              ht hx ht_nonpos hx_nonpos
              (principalArcsinAddRange_comm hrange)
          have hnegx0 :
              F.le F.zero (F.neg x) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hx_nonpos
          have hnegt0 :
              F.le F.zero (F.neg t) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F ht_nonpos
          have hprod_le_neg :
              F.le (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg t))
                (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) :=
            product_le_of_nonneg_bounds_base F
              hnegt0 hst0 hnegx_le_st hnegt_le_sx
          have hprod_le :
              F.le (F.mul x t)
                (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) := by
            rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x t] at hprod_le_neg
          exact sub_nonneg_of_le_base F hprod_le

name: principalArcsinAddCosFactor_pos_on_openPath
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddCosFactor_pos_on_openPath
    {x y t : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (hy : UnitClosedInterval y)
    (hrange : PrincipalArcsinAddRange x y)
    (ht : PrincipalArcsinAddOpenPath y t) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htClosed : UnitClosedInterval t :=
    principalArcsinAddPath_mem_unitClosedInterval hy
      (principalArcsinAddOpenPath_to_path ht)
  have htOpen : UnitOpenInterval t :=
    principalArcsinAddOpenPath_mem_unitOpenInterval hy ht
  have htRange : PrincipalArcsinAddRange x t :=
    principalArcsinAdd_openPathRange hx hy hrange ht
  have hstrictRange :
      PrincipalAngleOpenInterval (principalArcsinAngleSum x t) :=
    principalArcsinAdd_openPathStrictRange hx hy hrange ht
  unfold PrincipalAngleOpenInterval RealTheory.OpenInterval
    at hstrictRange
  change And
    (F.lt (F.neg halfPi) (principalArcsinAngleSum x t))
    (F.lt (principalArcsinAngleSum x t) halfPi)
    at hstrictRange
  have hsx0 :
      F.le F.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_nonneg_unitClosedInterval hx
  have hst0 :
      F.le F.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq t) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_nonneg_unitClosedInterval htClosed
  have hstpos :
      F.lt F.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq t) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_pos_unitOpenInterval htOpen
  have hroot_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero
        (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) :=
    F.mul_nonneg hsx0 hst0
  unfold principalArcsinAddCosFactor
  change
    F.lt F.zero
      (F.sub
        (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t))
        (F.mul x t))
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F
  unfold PrincipalArcsinAddOpenPath at ht
  change Or
    (And (F.lt F.zero t) (F.lt t y))
    (And (F.lt y t) (F.lt t F.zero)) at ht
  cases ht with
  | inl h0ty =>
      have ht_nonneg : F.le F.zero t :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F h0ty.left
      cases F.le_total F.zero x with
      | inl hx_nonneg =>
          have ht_lt_sx :
              F.lt t (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
            principalArcsinAdd_nonneg_right_strict_bound_of_sum_lt_halfPi
              hx htClosed hx_nonneg ht_nonneg hstrictRange.right
          have hx_le_st :
              F.le x (sqrtOneMinusSq t) :=
            principalArcsinAdd_nonneg_right_bound
              htClosed hx ht_nonneg hx_nonneg
              (principalArcsinAddRange_comm htRange)
          exact product_lt_of_nonneg_bounds_strict_right_base
            F ht_nonneg hstpos hx_le_st ht_lt_sx
      | inr hx_nonpos =>
          by_cases hxzero : x = F.zero
          · rw [hxzero, F.zero_mul]
            change F.lt F.zero
              (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq RealTheory.zero)
                (sqrtOneMinusSq t))
            rw [sqrtOneMinusSq_zero]
            change F.lt F.zero
              (F.mul F.one (sqrtOneMinusSq t))
            rw [F.one_mul]
            exact hstpos
          · have hx_lt_zero : F.lt x F.zero := by
              apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx_nonpos
              intro hzero_le_x
              exact hxzero (F.le_antisymm hx_nonpos hzero_le_x)
            have hprod_neg :
                F.lt (F.mul x t) F.zero :=
              product_neg_of_neg_pos_base F hx_lt_zero h0ty.left
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
              F hprod_neg hroot_nonneg
  | inr hyt0 =>
      have ht_nonpos : F.le t F.zero :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hyt0.right
      cases F.le_total F.zero x with
      | inl hx_nonneg =>
          by_cases hxzero : x = F.zero
          · rw [hxzero, F.zero_mul]
            change F.lt F.zero
              (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq RealTheory.zero)
                (sqrtOneMinusSq t))
            rw [sqrtOneMinusSq_zero]
            change F.lt F.zero
              (F.mul F.one (sqrtOneMinusSq t))
            rw [F.one_mul]
            exact hstpos
          · have hx_pos : F.lt F.zero x := by
              apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hx_nonneg
              intro hx_le_zero
              exact hxzero (F.le_antisymm hx_le_zero hx_nonneg)
            have hprod_neg :
                F.lt (F.mul x t) F.zero :=
              product_neg_of_pos_neg_base F hx_pos hyt0.right
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
              F hprod_neg hroot_nonneg
      | inr hx_nonpos =>
          have hnegt0 :
              F.le F.zero (F.neg t) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F ht_nonpos
          have hnegt_lt_sx :
              F.lt (F.neg t) (sqrtOneMinusSq x) :=
            principalArcsinAdd_nonpos_right_strict_neg_bound_of_sum_gt_neg_halfPi
              hx htClosed hx_nonpos ht_nonpos hstrictRange.left
          have hnegx_le_st :
              F.le (F.neg x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t) :=
            principalArcsinAdd_nonpos_right_neg_bound
              htClosed hx ht_nonpos hx_nonpos
              (principalArcsinAddRange_comm htRange)
          have hprod_lt_neg :
              F.lt (F.mul (F.neg x) (F.neg t))
                (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) :=
            product_lt_of_nonneg_bounds_strict_right_base
              F hnegt0 hstpos hnegx_le_st hnegt_lt_sx
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul_neg F x t] at hprod_lt_neg

name: principalArcsinAddRhs_derivative_value_base
statement:
private theorem principalArcsinAddRhs_derivative_value_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {x t sx s : Point}
    (hsne : Not (s = F.zero)) :
    F.add
      (F.mul x (F.neg (F.mul t (F.inv s))))
      (F.mul sx F.one) =
      F.mul (F.sub (F.mul sx s) (F.mul x t)) (F.inv s)
proof:
:= by
  have hsx_as_fraction :
      sx = F.mul (F.mul sx s) (F.inv s) := by
    calc
      sx = F.mul sx F.one := by
        rw [F.mul_one]
      _ = F.mul sx (F.mul s (F.inv s)) := by
        rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hsne]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul sx s) (F.inv s) := by
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
  calc
    F.add
        (F.mul x (F.neg (F.mul t (F.inv s))))
        (F.mul sx F.one) =
        F.add (F.neg (F.mul x (F.mul t (F.inv s)))) sx := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
          rw [F.mul_neg]
    _ = F.add sx
        (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul x t) (F.inv s))) := by
          calc
            F.add (F.neg (F.mul x (F.mul t (F.inv s)))) sx =
                F.add (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul x t) (F.inv s))) sx := by
                  rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
            _ = F.add sx
                (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul x t) (F.inv s))) := by
                  rw [F.add_comm]
    _ = F.add (F.mul (F.mul sx s) (F.inv s))
        (F.neg (F.mul (F.mul x t) (F.inv s))) := by
          rw [<- hsx_as_fraction]
    _ = F.add (F.mul (F.mul sx s) (F.inv s))
        (F.mul (F.neg (F.mul x t)) (F.inv s)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul F]
    _ = F.mul
        (F.add (F.mul sx s) (F.neg (F.mul x t)))
        (F.inv s) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.mul (F.sub (F.mul sx s) (F.mul x t)) (F.inv s) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]

name: inv_mul_mul_inv_cancel_left_base
statement:
private theorem inv_mul_mul_inv_cancel_left_base
    (F : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike RealTheory.Carrier)
    {c s : Point}
    (hcne : Not (c = F.zero)) :
    F.mul (F.inv c) (F.mul c (F.inv s)) = F.inv s
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.mul (F.inv c) (F.mul c (F.inv s)) =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.inv c) c) (F.inv s) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul F.one (F.inv s) := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hcne]
    _ = F.inv s := by
          rw [F.one_mul]

name: principalArcsinAddRhs_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddRhs_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval
    (x : Point)
    {t : Point}
    (ht : UnitOpenInterval t) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
      (fun u : Point => principalArcsinAddRhs x u) t
      (RealTheory.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t)
        (RealTheory.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsqrt :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
        sqrtOneMinusSq t
        (F.neg (F.mul t (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t)))) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval ht
  have hleft :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
        (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun x sqrtOneMinusSq) t
        (F.mul x
          (F.neg (F.mul t (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t))))) :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_constMul hsqrt
  have hid :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
        IdentityFun t F.one := by
    unfold IdentityFun
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_id ht
  have hright :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
        (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (sqrtOneMinusSq x) IdentityFun) t
        (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) F.one) :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_constMul hid
  have hsum :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
        (AddFun
          (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun x sqrtOneMinusSq)
          (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (sqrtOneMinusSq x) IdentityFun)) t
        (F.add
          (F.mul x
            (F.neg (F.mul t (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t)))))
          (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) F.one)) :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_add hleft hright
  have hraw :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
        (fun u : Point => principalArcsinAddRhs x u) t
        (F.add
          (F.mul x
            (F.neg (F.mul t (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t)))))
          (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) F.one)) := by
    apply RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_congr
      (E := UnitOpenInterval)
      (f :=
        AddFun
          (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun x sqrtOneMinusSq)
          (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (sqrtOneMinusSq x) IdentityFun))
      (g := fun u : Point => principalArcsinAddRhs x u)
    · intro u _hu
      unfold AddFun RealDerivative.ConstMulFun IdentityFun
      unfold principalArcsinAddRhs
      rfl
    · exact hsum
  refine And.intro hraw.left ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
    (M := F.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t)
      (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t))) ?_ hraw.right
  have hspos : F.lt F.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq t) :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_pos_unitOpenInterval ht
  have hsne : Not (sqrtOneMinusSq t = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hspos
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F F.zero) hspos
  unfold principalArcsinAddCosFactor
  change
    F.add
      (F.mul x
        (F.neg (F.mul t (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t)))))
      (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) F.one) =
      F.mul
        (F.sub
          (F.mul (sqrtOneMinusSq x) (sqrtOneMinusSq t))
          (F.mul x t))
        (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t))
  exact principalArcsinAddRhs_derivative_value_base F hsne

name: principalArcsinAdd_comp_hasDerivWithin_inv_sqrt
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAdd_comp_hasDerivWithin_inv_sqrt
    (x : Point)
    {E : Domain}
    {t : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (htE : E t)
    (hsub : SetPred.Subset E UnitOpenInterval)
    (hmap :
      forall u : Point, E u ->
        UnitOpenInterval (principalArcsinAddRhs x u))
    (hcos : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t)) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
      (CompFun asinGeom (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x)) t
      (RealTheory.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htOpen : UnitOpenInterval t :=
    hsub t htE
  have htClosed : UnitClosedInterval t :=
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F htOpen.left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F htOpen.right)
  have hzOpen :
      UnitOpenInterval (principalArcsinAddRhs x t) :=
    hmap t htE
  have hsqrtEq :
      sqrtOneMinusSq (principalArcsinAddRhs x t) =
        principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t :=
    sqrtOneMinusSq_principalArcsinAddRhs_eq_cosFactor
      hx htClosed hcos
  have hzDerivUnit :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval
        (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x) t
        (F.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t)
          (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t))) := by
    unfold principalArcsinAddRhsFun
    exact principalArcsinAddRhs_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval x htOpen
  have hzDeriv :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
        (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x) t
        (F.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t)
          (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t))) :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset hsub htE hzDerivUnit
  have hasin :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval asinGeom
        (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x t)
        (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x t))) := by
    unfold principalArcsinAddRhsFun
    exact asinGeom_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval hzOpen
  have hchain :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
        (CompFun asinGeom (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x)) t
        (F.mul
          (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x t)))
          (F.mul (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t)
            (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t)))) :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_comp
      hzDeriv hasin
      (fun u hu _ _ => hmap u hu)
  refine And.intro hchain.left ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
    (M := F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) ?_ hchain.right
  unfold principalArcsinAddRhsFun
  have hcosPos :
      F.lt F.zero (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t) := by
    have hzsqrtPos :
        F.lt F.zero (sqrtOneMinusSq (principalArcsinAddRhs x t)) :=
      sqrtOneMinusSq_pos_unitOpenInterval hzOpen
    rwa [hsqrtEq] at hzsqrtPos
  have hcosNe : Not (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hcosPos
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F F.zero) hcosPos
  rw [hsqrtEq]
  exact inv_mul_mul_inv_cancel_left_base F hcosNe

name: principalArcsinAddDifference_hasDerivWithin_zero
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddDifference_hasDerivWithin_zero
    (x : Point)
    {E : Domain}
    {t : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (htE : E t)
    (hsub : SetPred.Subset E UnitOpenInterval)
    (hmap :
      forall u : Point, E u ->
        UnitOpenInterval (principalArcsinAddRhs x u))

      (principalArcsinAddCosFactor x t)) :
    RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
      (principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun x) t RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcomp :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
        (CompFun asinGeom (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x)) t
        (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) :=
    principalArcsinAdd_comp_hasDerivWithin_inv_sqrt
      x hx htE hsub hmap hcos
  have hconst :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
        (fun _ : Point => asinGeom x) t F.zero :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_const htE
  have htOpen : UnitOpenInterval t :=
    hsub t htE
  have hasinUnit :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin UnitOpenInterval asinGeom t
        (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) :=
    asinGeom_hasDerivWithin_unitOpenInterval htOpen
  have hasin :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E asinGeom t
        (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_subset hsub htE hasinUnit
  have hsumRaw :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
        (AddFun (fun _ : Point => asinGeom x) asinGeom) t
        (F.add F.zero (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t))) :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_add hconst hasin
  have hsum :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
        (AddFun (fun _ : Point => asinGeom x) asinGeom) t
        (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) := by
    refine And.intro hsumRaw.left ?_
    apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      (M := F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t)) ?_ hsumRaw.right
    rw [F.zero_add]
  have hdiffRaw :
      RealDerivative.HasDerivWithin E
        (principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun x) t
        (F.sub (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t))
          (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t))) := by
    unfold principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun
    exact RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_sub hcomp hsum
  refine And.intro hdiffRaw.left ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
    (M := F.zero) ?_ hdiffRaw.right
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F (F.inv (sqrtOneMinusSq t))

        (RealTheory.OpenInterval y RealTheory.zero)

    principalArcsinAddDifference_hasDerivWithin_zero_left_interval
      hx hy hrange hc
  have hAeq : A = RealTheory.zero :=
    RealDerivative.hasDerivWithin_unique
      (RealDerivative.openInterval_clusterPoint hc) hA hzero
  rw [hAeq]
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F F.zero) F.zero
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_zero F]
  exact F.le_refl F.zero

name: principalArcsinAddPath_of_closedInterval_zero_right

name: principalArcsinAddRhsFun_continuousOn_of_subset_unitClosed
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddRhsFun_continuousOn_of_subset_unitClosed
    (x : Point)
    {E : Domain}
    (hsub : SetPred.Subset E UnitClosedInterval) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousOn E (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x)
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn E sqrtOneMinusSq :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hsub
      sqrtOneMinusSq_continuousOn_unitClosedInterval
  have hleft :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
        (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun x sqrtOneMinusSq) :=
    RealDerivative.continuousOn_constMul hsqrt
  have hright :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
        (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (sqrtOneMinusSq x) IdentityFun) :=
    RealDerivative.continuousOn_constMul
      RealFunction.continuousOn_identity
  have hsum :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
        (AddFun
          (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun x sqrtOneMinusSq)
          (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (sqrtOneMinusSq x) IdentityFun)) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_add hleft hright
  apply RealFunction.continuousOn_congr
    (E := E)
    (f :=
      AddFun
        (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun x sqrtOneMinusSq)
        (RealDerivative.ConstMulFun (sqrtOneMinusSq x) IdentityFun))
    (g := principalArcsinAddRhsFun x)
  · intro u _hu
    unfold AddFun RealDerivative.ConstMulFun IdentityFun
    unfold principalArcsinAddRhsFun principalArcsinAddRhs
    rfl
  · exact hsum

      (CompFun asinGeom (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x))
proof:
:= by
  have hrhs :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn E (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x) :=
    principalArcsinAddRhsFun_continuousOn_of_subset_unitClosed
      x hsub
  have hmap :
      MapsInto E UnitClosedInterval (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x) := by
    intro u hu
    unfold principalArcsinAddRhsFun
    exact principalArcsinAddRhs_mem_unitClosedInterval
      hx (hsub u hu)
  exact RealFunction.continuousOn_comp
    hrhs asinGeom_continuousOn_unitClosedInterval hmap

name: principalArcsinAddDifference_continuousOn_of_subset_unitClosed
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
        (CompFun asinGeom (principalArcsinAddRhsFun x)) :=
    principalArcsinAdd_comp_continuousOn_of_subset_unitClosed
      hx hsub
  have hconst :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn E (fun _ : Point => asinGeom x) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_const
  have hasin :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn E asinGeom :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hsub
      asinGeom_continuousOn_unitClosedInterval
  have hsum :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn E
        (AddFun (fun _ : Point => asinGeom x) asinGeom) :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_add hconst hasin
  unfold principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun
  exact RealFunction.continuousOn_sub hcomp hsum

statement:

    principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun x RealTheory.zero =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun
  unfold SubFun CompFun principalArcsinAddRhsFun AddFun
  rw [principalArcsinAddRhs_zero_right]
  rw [asinGeom_zero]

name: principalArcsinAdditionConclusion_of_difference_zero
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAdditionConclusion_of_difference_zero
    {x y : Point}
    (hzero :
      principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun x y = RealTheory.zero) :
    PrincipalArcsinAdditionConclusion x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold PrincipalArcsinAdditionConclusion principalArcsinAngleSum
  unfold principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun at hzero
  unfold SubFun CompFun principalArcsinAddRhsFun AddFun at hzero
  change
    F.sub (asinGeom (principalArcsinAddRhs x y))
      (F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom y)) = F.zero at hzero
  change
    asinGeom (principalArcsinAddRhs x y) =
      F.add (asinGeom x) (asinGeom y)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hzero

name: principalArcsinAddDifference_eq_zero_of_pos
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddDifference_eq_zero_of_pos
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (hy : UnitClosedInterval y)
    (hrange : PrincipalArcsinAddRange x y)
    (hypos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero y) :
    principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun x y = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let H := principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun x
  have hboundAbs :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub (H y) (H RealTheory.zero)))
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y RealTheory.zero))) :=
    RealDerivative.finiteIncrementBound_of_derivativeAbsBound
      RealTheory.zero y RealTheory.zero H hypos
      (principalArcsinAddDifference_continuousOn_closedInterval_zero_right
        hx hy)
      (principalArcsinAddDifference_differentiableOnOpenInterval_zero_right
        hx hy hrange)
      (principalArcsinAddDifference_derivativeAbsBound_zero_right
        hx hy hrange)
  have hleZero :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub (H y) (H RealTheory.zero)))
        RealTheory.zero := by
    rwa [RealTheory.zero_mul] at hboundAbs
  have habsZero :
      RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (H y) (H RealTheory.zero)) =
        RealTheory.zero :=
    RealTheory.le_antisymm hleZero
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg
        (RealTheory.sub (H y) (H RealTheory.zero)))
  have hsubZero :
      RealTheory.sub (H y) (H RealTheory.zero) =
        RealTheory.zero :=
    RealTheory.eq_zero_of_abs_eq_zero habsZero
  have hendEq : H y = H RealTheory.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hsubZero
  change H y = RealTheory.zero
  rw [hendEq]
  change principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun x RealTheory.zero =
    RealTheory.zero
  exact principalArcsinAddDifference_zero_right x

name: principalArcsinAddDifference_eq_zero_of_neg
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAddDifference_eq_zero_of_neg
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (hy : UnitClosedInterval y)
    (hrange : PrincipalArcsinAddRange x y)
    (hyneg : RealTheory.lt y RealTheory.zero) :
    principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun x y = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let H := principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun x
  have hboundAbs :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub (H RealTheory.zero) (H y)))
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero y))) :=
    RealDerivative.finiteIncrementBound_of_derivativeAbsBound
      y RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero H hyneg
      (principalArcsinAddDifference_continuousOn_closedInterval_right_zero
        hx hy)
      (principalArcsinAddDifference_differentiableOnOpenInterval_right_zero
        hx hy hrange)
      (principalArcsinAddDifference_derivativeAbsBound_right_zero
        hx hy hrange)
  have hleZero :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub (H RealTheory.zero) (H y)))
        RealTheory.zero := by
    rwa [RealTheory.zero_mul] at hboundAbs
  have habsZero :
      RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (H RealTheory.zero) (H y)) =
        RealTheory.zero :=
    RealTheory.le_antisymm hleZero
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg
        (RealTheory.sub (H RealTheory.zero) (H y)))
  have hsubZero :
      RealTheory.sub (H RealTheory.zero) (H y) =
        RealTheory.zero :=
    RealTheory.eq_zero_of_abs_eq_zero habsZero
  have hendEq : H RealTheory.zero = H y :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hsubZero
  change H y = RealTheory.zero
  have hbase : H RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero := by
    change principalArcsinAddDifferenceFun x RealTheory.zero =
      RealTheory.zero
    exact principalArcsinAddDifference_zero_right x
  exact Eq.trans (Eq.symm hendEq) hbase

name: principalArcsinAdditionConclusion_of_range
statement:
theorem principalArcsinAdditionConclusion_of_range
    {x y : Point}
    (hx : UnitClosedInterval x)
    (hy : UnitClosedInterval y)
    (hrange : PrincipalArcsinAddRange x y) :
    PrincipalArcsinAdditionConclusion x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases F.le_total F.zero y with
  | inl h0y =>
      by_cases hyzero : y = F.zero
      · rw [hyzero]
        exact principalArcsinAdditionConclusion_zero_right x
      · have hypos : F.lt F.zero y := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F h0y
          intro hy0
          exact hyzero (F.le_antisymm hy0 h0y)
        exact principalArcsinAdditionConclusion_of_difference_zero
          (principalArcsinAddDifference_eq_zero_of_pos
            hx hy hrange hypos)
  | inr hy0 =>
      by_cases hyzero : y = F.zero
      · rw [hyzero]
        exact principalArcsinAdditionConclusion_zero_right x
      · have hyneg : F.lt y F.zero := by
          apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hy0
          intro h0y
          exact hyzero (F.le_antisymm hy0 h0y)
        exact principalArcsinAdditionConclusion_of_difference_zero
          (principalArcsinAddDifference_eq_zero_of_neg
            hx hy hrange hyneg)

name: principalSinAddition
statement:
theorem principalSinAddition
    {u v : Point}
    (hu : PrincipalAngleInterval u)
    (hv : PrincipalAngleInterval v)
    (huv : PrincipalAngleInterval (RealTheory.add u v)) :
    sinPrincipal (RealTheory.add u v) =
      principalSinAddRhs u v
proof:
:= by
  have hx : UnitClosedInterval (sinPrincipal u) :=
    sinPrincipal_mem_unitClosedInterval hu
  have hy : UnitClosedInterval (sinPrincipal v) :=
    sinPrincipal_mem_unitClosedInterval hv
  have hrange :
      PrincipalArcsinAddRange (sinPrincipal u) (sinPrincipal v) :=
    principalArcsinAddRange_of_principalAngle_add hu hv huv
  have hadd :
      PrincipalArcsinAdditionConclusion
        (sinPrincipal u) (sinPrincipal v) :=
    principalArcsinAddition
      (sinPrincipal u) (sinPrincipal v) hx hy hrange
  have haddAngle :
      asinGeom
        (principalArcsinAddRhs (sinPrincipal u) (sinPrincipal v)) =
        RealTheory.add u v := by
    unfold PrincipalArcsinAdditionConclusion at hadd
    unfold principalArcsinAngleSum at hadd
    rwa [asinGeom_sinPrincipal_eq hu,
      asinGeom_sinPrincipal_eq hv] at hadd
  have hrhsMem :
      UnitClosedInterval
        (principalArcsinAddRhs (sinPrincipal u) (sinPrincipal v)) :=
    principalArcsinAddRhs_mem_unitClosedInterval hx hy
  rw [<- haddAngle]
  rw [sinPrincipal_asinGeom_eq hrhsMem]
  exact principalArcsinAddRhs_sinPrincipal_eq_principalSinAddRhs u v

        (principalArcsinAddCosFactor

  unfold cosPrincipal

  rw [sqrtOneMinusSq_principalArcsinAddRhs_eq_cosFactor
