name: derivativeHalfPi_geometricHalfPi_eq
statement:
private theorem derivativeHalfPi_geometricHalfPi_eq :
    RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi geometricCircularThinSpec = halfPi
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let derivativeHalfPi :=
    RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi geometricCircularThinSpec
  have hcosGeomHalfPi :
      geometricCircularThinSpec.cos halfPi = RealTheory.zero := by
    change cosGeom halfPi = RealTheory.zero
    rw [cosGeom_eq_cosPrincipal_of_principal
      halfPi_mem_principalAngleInterval]
    exact cosPrincipal_halfPi
  have hderivativeLeGeometry : F.le derivativeHalfPi halfPi := by
    unfold derivativeHalfPi
    exact
      RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi_le_of_positive_cos_zero
        geometricCircularThinSpec halfPi_pos hcosGeomHalfPi
  have hgeometryLeDerivative : F.le halfPi derivativeHalfPi := by
    by_cases hle : F.le halfPi derivativeHalfPi
    · exact hle
    · have hderivativeLtGeometry : F.lt derivativeHalfPi halfPi :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
          F hderivativeLeGeometry hle
      have hderivativePos : F.lt F.zero derivativeHalfPi := by
        unfold derivativeHalfPi
        exact RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi_pos
          geometricCircularThinSpec
      have hprincipal : PrincipalAngleInterval derivativeHalfPi :=
        principalAngle_of_pos_lt_halfPi
          hderivativePos hderivativeLtGeometry
      have hcosPos :
          F.lt F.zero (geometricCircularThinSpec.cos derivativeHalfPi) := by
        change F.lt F.zero (cosGeom derivativeHalfPi)
        rw [cosGeom_eq_cosPrincipal_of_principal hprincipal]
        exact cosPrincipal_pos_of_pos_lt_halfPi
          hprincipal hderivativePos hderivativeLtGeometry
      have hcosZero :
          geometricCircularThinSpec.cos derivativeHalfPi = F.zero := by
        unfold derivativeHalfPi
        exact RealDerivative.Trigonometric.cos_halfPi_eq_zero
          geometricCircularThinSpec
      rw [hcosZero] at hcosPos
      exact False.elim (F.lt_irrefl F.zero hcosPos)
  exact F.le_antisymm hderivativeLeGeometry hgeometryLeDerivative

name: geometricUnitCircle_chord_arc
statement:
theorem geometricUnitCircle_chord_arc
    {c : RealFunction.Point}
    (h0 : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero c)
    (h2 : RealTheory.le c (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one)) :
    let theta
proof:
:= RealTheory.add
      (asinGeom (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.inv
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one))))
      (asinGeom (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.inv
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one RealTheory.one))))
    And
      (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero theta)
      (And
        (RealTheory.le theta
          (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi geometricCircularThinSpec))
        (And
          (RealIntegral.Applications.unitCircleChordLength
            geometricCircularThinSpec theta = c)
          (RealFunction.Curve.planeCurveLengthOn RealTheory.zero theta
            geometricCircularThinSpec.cos geometricCircularThinSpec.sin =
              theta))) := by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let two := F.add F.one F.one
  let x := F.mul c (F.inv two)
  let alpha := asinGeom x
  let theta := F.add alpha alpha
  change
    And (F.le F.zero theta)
      (And
        (F.le theta
          (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi geometricCircularThinSpec))
        (And
          (RealIntegral.Applications.unitCircleChordLength
            geometricCircularThinSpec theta = c)
          (RealFunction.Curve.planeCurveLengthOn F.zero theta
            geometricCircularThinSpec.cos geometricCircularThinSpec.sin =
              theta)))
  have htwoPos : F.lt F.zero two := by
    unfold two
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F)
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have htwoNe : Not (two = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    have := htwoPos
    rw [hzero] at this
    exact F.lt_irrefl F.zero this
  have hinvTwoPos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv two) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F htwoPos
  have hinvTwoNonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv two) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinvTwoPos
  have hx0 : F.le F.zero x := by
    unfold x
    exact F.mul_nonneg h0 hinvTwoNonneg
  have hx1 : F.le x F.one := by
    have hmul := F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right h2 hinvTwoNonneg
    change F.le (F.mul c (F.inv two)) (F.mul two (F.inv two)) at hmul
    rw [F.mul_inv_cancel htwoNe] at hmul
    exact hmul
  have hnegOneLeZero : F.le (F.neg F.one) F.zero :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_one_lt_zero F)
  have hxUnit : UnitClosedInterval x :=
    And.intro (F.le_trans hnegOneLeZero hx0) hx1
  have halphaPrincipal : PrincipalAngleInterval alpha := by
    unfold alpha
    exact asinGeom_maps_unitClosed_to_principalAngle x hxUnit
  have halphaNonneg : F.le F.zero alpha := by
    have hmono :=
      asinGeom_monotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
        F.zero x zero_mem_unitClosedInterval hxUnit hx0
    change F.le (asinGeom F.zero) (asinGeom x) at hmono
    have hzero := asinGeom_zero
    change asinGeom F.zero = F.zero at hzero
    rw [hzero] at hmono
    unfold alpha
    exact hmono
  have halphaLeDerivativeHalfPi :
      F.le alpha
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.halfPi geometricCircularThinSpec) := by
    rw [derivativeHalfPi_geometricHalfPi_eq]
    exact halphaPrincipal.right
  have hthetaNonneg : F.le F.zero theta := by
    unfold theta
    have hsum := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
      halphaNonneg halphaNonneg
    rwa [F.zero_add] at hsum
  have hthetaLePi :
      F.le theta
        (RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi geometricCircularThinSpec) := by
    unfold theta
    rw [RealDerivative.Trigonometric.pi_eq_halfPi_add_halfPi]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
      halphaLeDerivativeHalfPi halphaLeDerivativeHalfPi
  have hhalfTheta : trigHalf theta = alpha := by
    apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_self_cancel F
    change
      RealTheory.add (trigHalf theta) (trigHalf theta) =
        RealTheory.add alpha alpha
    rw [trigHalf_add_self]
    rfl
  have hsinAlpha : geometricCircularThinSpec.sin alpha = x := by
    change sinGeom alpha = x
    rw [sinGeom_eq_sinPrincipal_of_principal halphaPrincipal]
    unfold alpha
    exact sinPrincipal_asinGeom_eq hxUnit
  have htwoMulX : F.mul two x = c := by
    unfold x
    calc
      F.mul two (F.mul c (F.inv two)) =
          F.mul c (F.mul two (F.inv two)) := by
        rw [<- F.mul_assoc, F.mul_comm two c, F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul c F.one := by rw [F.mul_inv_cancel htwoNe]
      _ = c := F.mul_one c
  have hchordGeneric :=
    RealIntegral.Applications.unitCircle_minorChord_length_eq_two_mul_sin_half
      geometricCircularThinSpec hthetaNonneg hthetaLePi
  have hchord :
      RealIntegral.Applications.unitCircleChordLength
        geometricCircularThinSpec theta = c := by
    change
      RealIntegral.Applications.unitCircleChordLength
          geometricCircularThinSpec theta =
        F.mul two (geometricCircularThinSpec.sin (trigHalf theta))
      at hchordGeneric
    rw [hhalfTheta, hsinAlpha, htwoMulX] at hchordGeneric
    exact hchordGeneric
  have harc :=
    RealIntegral.Applications.unitCircle_minorArc_length_eq
      geometricCircularThinSpec hthetaNonneg hthetaLePi
  exact And.intro hthetaNonneg
    (And.intro hthetaLePi (And.intro hchord harc))

name: one_mem_unitClosedInterval

name: halfPi_nonneg

theorem halfPi_nonneg :

proof:

    RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
    zero_mem_unitClosedInterval one_mem_unitClosedInterval

      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base)

  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_zero F] at h

name: asinGeom_maps_unitClosed_to_principalAngle
statement:
theorem asinGeom_maps_unitClosed_to_principalAngle :
    RealFunction.MapsInto UnitClosedInterval
      PrincipalAngleInterval asinGeom
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hleft :=
    asinGeom_monotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
      (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one) x
      neg_one_mem_unitClosedInterval hx hx.left
  have hright :=
    asinGeom_monotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
      x RealTheory.one
      hx one_mem_unitClosedInterval hx.right
  rw [asinGeom_neg_one_eq_neg_halfPi] at hleft
  rw [asinGeom_one_eq_halfPi] at hright
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: principalAngle_to_asinGeom_image
statement:
theorem principalAngle_to_asinGeom_image :
    SetPred.Subset PrincipalAngleInterval
      (RealFunction.Image UnitClosedInterval asinGeom)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hbetween :
      RealTheory.Between
        (asinGeom (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one))
        y
        (asinGeom RealTheory.one) := by
    change
      RealTheory.le (asinGeom (RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one)) y ∧
        RealTheory.le y (asinGeom RealTheory.one)
    rw [asinGeom_neg_one_eq_neg_halfPi]
    rw [asinGeom_one_eq_halfPi]
    exact hy
  exact
    RealFunction.intermediate_value_closedInterval
      neg_one_le_one
      asinGeom_continuousOn_unitClosedInterval
      hbetween

name: asinGeom_image_to_principalAngle
statement:
theorem asinGeom_image_to_principalAngle :
    SetPred.Subset
      (RealFunction.Image UnitClosedInterval asinGeom)
      PrincipalAngleInterval
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  cases hy with
  | intro x hx =>
      rw [<- hx.right]
      exact asinGeom_maps_unitClosed_to_principalAngle x hx.left

name: principalAngleInterval_same_asinGeom_image
statement:
theorem principalAngleInterval_same_asinGeom_image :
    SetPred.Same PrincipalAngleInterval
      (RealFunction.Image UnitClosedInterval asinGeom)

  intro y
  constructor
  · exact principalAngle_to_asinGeom_image y
  · exact asinGeom_image_to_principalAngle y

    UnitClosedInterval (sinPrincipal x)

name: asinGeom_sinPrincipal_eq

      asinGeom_strictMonotoneOn_unitClosedInterval)
    hx

name: cosPrincipal_nonneg
statement:
theorem cosPrincipal_nonneg
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PrincipalAngleInterval x) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (cosPrincipal x)
proof:
:= by
  have hsin : UnitClosedInterval (sinPrincipal x) :=
    sinPrincipal_mem_unitClosedInterval hx
  unfold cosPrincipal sqrtOneMinusSq sqrt2
  exact RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot_nonneg_succ_of_nonneg
    1 (unitClosedInterval_one_sub_sq_nonneg hsin)

name: sinPrincipal_sq_add_cosPrincipal_sq
statement:
theorem sinPrincipal_sq_add_cosPrincipal_sq
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PrincipalAngleInterval x) :
    RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.mul (sinPrincipal x) (sinPrincipal x))
      (RealTheory.mul (cosPrincipal x) (cosPrincipal x)) =
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsin : UnitClosedInterval (sinPrincipal x) :=
    sinPrincipal_mem_unitClosedInterval hx
  have hcosSq := sqrtOneMinusSq_sq_eq_one_sub_sq hsin
  unfold cosPrincipal
  rw [hcosSq]
  change
    F.add
      (F.mul (sinPrincipal x) (sinPrincipal x))
      (F.sub F.one
        (F.mul (sinPrincipal x) (sinPrincipal x))) = F.one
  rw [F.add_comm]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
    F F.one (F.mul (sinPrincipal x) (sinPrincipal x))

name: sinPrincipal_neg_halfPi
statement:
theorem sinPrincipal_neg_halfPi :
    sinPrincipal (RealTheory.neg halfPi) =
      RealTheory.neg RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by

  exact sinPrincipal_asinGeom_eq neg_one_mem_unitClosedInterval

name: sinPrincipal_zero
statement:
theorem sinPrincipal_zero :
    sinPrincipal RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  calc
    sinPrincipal RealTheory.zero =
        sinPrincipal (asinGeom RealTheory.zero) := by
        rw [asinGeom_zero]
    _ = RealTheory.zero :=
        sinPrincipal_asinGeom_eq zero_mem_unitClosedInterval

name: sinPrincipal_halfPi
statement:
theorem sinPrincipal_halfPi :
    sinPrincipal halfPi = RealTheory.one
proof:

  exact sinPrincipal_asinGeom_eq one_mem_unitClosedInterval

name: sinPrincipal_pos_of_pos_principal
statement:
theorem sinPrincipal_pos_of_pos_principal
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PrincipalAngleInterval x)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (sinPrincipal x)
proof:
:= by
  have hstrict :=
    RealFunction.inverseOn_strictMonotoneOn_image
      asinGeom_strictMonotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
  have h0img :
      RealFunction.Image UnitClosedInterval asinGeom RealTheory.zero :=
    (principalAngleInterval_same_asinGeom_image RealTheory.zero).mp
      zero_mem_principalAngleInterval
  have hximg :
      RealFunction.Image UnitClosedInterval asinGeom x :=
    (principalAngleInterval_same_asinGeom_image x).mp hx
  have hmono := hstrict RealTheory.zero x h0img hximg hx0
  change RealTheory.lt (sinPrincipal RealTheory.zero) (sinPrincipal x) at hmono
  rwa [sinPrincipal_zero] at hmono

name: sinPrincipal_lt_one_of_lt_halfPi
statement:
theorem sinPrincipal_lt_one_of_lt_halfPi
    {x : Point}
    (hx : PrincipalAngleInterval x)
    (hxhalf : RealTheory.lt x halfPi) :
    RealTheory.lt (sinPrincipal x) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  have hstrict :=
    RealFunction.inverseOn_strictMonotoneOn_image
      asinGeom_strictMonotoneOn_unitClosedInterval
  have hximg :
      RealFunction.Image UnitClosedInterval asinGeom x :=
    (principalAngleInterval_same_asinGeom_image x).mp hx
  have hhalfimg :
      RealFunction.Image UnitClosedInterval asinGeom halfPi :=
    (principalAngleInterval_same_asinGeom_image halfPi).mp
      halfPi_mem_principalAngleInterval
  have hmono := hstrict x halfPi hximg hhalfimg hxhalf
  change RealTheory.lt (sinPrincipal x) (sinPrincipal halfPi) at hmono
  rwa [sinPrincipal_halfPi] at hmono

name: sinPrincipal_mem_zeroOneOpen_of_pos_lt_halfPi
statement:
theorem sinPrincipal_mem_zeroOneOpen_of_pos_lt_halfPi

theorem cosPrincipal_pos_of_pos_lt_halfPi

name: sinPrincipal_lt_self_of_pos_lt_halfPi

name: self_mul_cosPrincipal_lt_sinPrincipal_of_pos_lt_halfPi

name: hasIntegral_subinterval_of_leftTruncationValues
statement:
private theorem hasIntegral_subinterval_of_leftTruncationValues
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b u v : Point} {J : Point -> Point}
    (hvalues : HasLeftHKTruncationValues f a b J)
    (hau : RealTheory.lt a u)
    (huv : RealTheory.le u v)
    (hvb : RealTheory.le v b) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f u v
      (RealTheory.sub (J u) (J v))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hub : RealTheory.le u b := RealTheory.le_trans huv hvb
  have hav : RealTheory.lt a v :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hau huv
  have hJu : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f u b (J u) :=
    hvalues u hau hub
  have hJv : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f v b (J v) :=
    hvalues v hav hvb
  cases
      exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_subinterval
        (f := f) (a := u) (c := u) (d := v) (b := b) (I := J u)
        (RealTheory.le_refl u) huv hvb hJu with
  | intro I hI =>
      have hsum : J u = RealTheory.add I (J v) :=
        hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_eq_add_of_adjacent_ordered
          (f := f) (a := u) (c := v) (b := b)
          (K := J u) (I := I) (J := J v)
          huv hvb hJu hI hJv
      have hIeq : I = RealTheory.sub (J u) (J v) :=
        RealTheory.eq_sub_of_eq_add_right hsum
      rwa [<- hIeq]

name: leftTruncationValue_right_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem leftTruncationValue_right_eq_zero
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point} {J : Point -> Point}
    (hvalues : HasLeftHKTruncationValues f a b J)
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b) :
    J b = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
    (hvalues b hab (RealTheory.le_refl b))
    (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_degenerate f b)

name: validBase_two
statement: private theorem validBase_two : RealTheory.ValidBase 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold RealTheory.ValidBase IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
  omega

name: leftCanonicalCofinalCutFamily
statement:
private theorem leftCanonicalCofinalCutFamily
    {a b : Point} (hab : RealTheory.lt a b) :
    LeftCofinalCutFamily a b (leftCanonicalCofinalCut a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hgap : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hab
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  next =>
    intro k
    have htail : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.baseTail 2 k) :=
      RealTheory.baseTail_pos validBase_two k
    have hminPos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.min (RealTheory.sub b a) (RealTheory.baseTail 2 k)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hgap htail
    have hleft : RealTheory.lt a (leftCanonicalCofinalCut a b k) := by
      unfold leftCanonicalCofinalCut
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hminPos a
      change F.lt (F.add a F.zero) _ at h
      rwa [F.add_zero] at h
    have hminLe : RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.min (RealTheory.sub b a) (RealTheory.baseTail 2 k))
        (RealTheory.sub b a) := RealTheory.min_le_left _ _
    have hright : RealTheory.le (leftCanonicalCofinalCut a b k) b := by
      unfold leftCanonicalCofinalCut
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hminLe a
      have habEq : F.add a (F.sub b a) = b := by
        rw [F.add_comm a (F.sub b a)]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b a
      change F.le
        (F.add a (RealTheory.min (RealTheory.sub b a)
          (RealTheory.baseTail 2 k)))
        (F.add a (F.sub b a)) at h
      rw [habEq] at h
      exact h
    exact And.intro hleft hright
  next =>
    intro x hax hxb
    have heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub x a) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hax
    cases baseTail_eventually_lt validBase_two
        (RealTheory.sub x a) heps with
    | intro N hN =>
        refine Exists.intro N ?_
        have htail : RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.baseTail 2 N) (RealTheory.sub x a) :=
          hN N (Nat.le_refl N)
        have hminLe : RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.min (RealTheory.sub b a) (RealTheory.baseTail 2 N))
            (RealTheory.baseTail 2 N) := RealTheory.min_le_right _ _
        have hminLt : RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.min (RealTheory.sub b a) (RealTheory.baseTail 2 N))
            (RealTheory.sub x a) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hminLe htail
        unfold leftCanonicalCofinalCut
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hminLt a
        have haxEq : F.add a (F.sub x a) = x := by
          rw [F.add_comm a (F.sub x a)]
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x a
        change F.lt
          (F.add a (RealTheory.min (RealTheory.sub b a)
            (RealTheory.baseTail 2 N)))
          (F.add a (F.sub x a)) at h
        rw [haxEq] at h
        exact h

name: leftChosenCutLevel_spec
statement:
private theorem leftChosenCutLevel_spec
    {a b x : Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hcut : LeftCofinalCutFamily a b cut)

    RealTheory.lt (cut (leftChosenCutLevel hcut x)) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold leftChosenCutLevel
  rw [dif_pos (And.intro hax hxb)]

name: closedIntervalGaugeOn_leftNestedTailGauge
statement:
private theorem closedIntervalGaugeOn_leftNestedTailGauge
    {a b endpointRadius : Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    {gamma : Nat -> Point -> Point}
    (hcut : LeftCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (hendpoint : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero endpointRadius)
    (hgamma : forall k : Nat,
      ClosedIntervalGaugeOn (cut k) b (gamma k)) :
    ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b
      (leftNestedTailGauge hcut endpointRadius gamma)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  classical
  by_cases hxa : x = a
  case pos =>
    simp [leftNestedTailGauge, hxa]
    exact hendpoint
  case neg =>
    have hax : RealTheory.lt a x := by
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx.left
        (fun hxaLe => hxa (RealTheory.le_antisymm hxaLe hx.left))
    simp [leftNestedTailGauge, hxa, hax]
    split
    case isFalse hxb => exact False.elim (hxb hx.right)
    case isTrue _hxb =>
      let k := leftChosenCutLevel hcut x
      have hkx : RealTheory.lt (cut k) x := by
        dsimp [k]
        exact leftChosenCutLevel_spec hcut hax hx.right
      have hxTail : RealTheory.ClosedInterval (cut k) b x :=
        And.intro
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hkx)
          hx.right
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (hgamma k x hxTail)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hkx)

name: leftNestedTailGauge_at_endpoint
statement:
private theorem leftNestedTailGauge_at_endpoint

name: leftNestedTailGauge_le_tailGauge
statement:
private theorem leftNestedTailGauge_le_tailGauge
    {a b endpointRadius x : Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hcut : LeftCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (gamma : Nat -> Point -> Point)
    (hax : RealTheory.lt a x) (hxb : RealTheory.le x b) :

      (gamma (leftChosenCutLevel hcut x) x)
proof:

name: leftNestedTailGauge_le_cutRadius
statement:
private theorem leftNestedTailGauge_le_cutRadius
    {a b endpointRadius x : Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}

proof:

name: leftNestedTailGauge_cell_left_gt_cut
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htagMem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval partitionA b (tag i) :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_tag_mem_closedInterval
      hfine.left hi
  have hcellLeft : PartitionCell p i (p i) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hfine.left.left hi
  have hfineLeft :
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (p i) (tag i))
        (leftNestedTailGauge hcut endpointRadius gamma (tag i)) :=
    hfine.right i hi (p i) hcellLeft
  have hgaugeLe :=
    leftNestedTailGauge_le_cutRadius
      (endpointRadius := endpointRadius) hcut gamma hax htagMem.right
  have hdistLt :
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (p i) (tag i))
        (RealTheory.sub (tag i)
          (cut (leftChosenCutLevel hcut (tag i)))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hfineLeft hgaugeLe
  have htagCell : PartitionCell p i (tag i) := hfine.left.right i hi
  have hdistEq :
      RealFunction.dist (p i) (tag i) =
        RealTheory.sub (tag i) (p i) := by
    calc
      RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (p i) (tag i)) =
          RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (tag i) (p i)) :=
        RealTheory.abs_sub_comm (p i) (tag i)
      _ = RealTheory.sub (tag i) (p i) :=
        RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F htagCell.left)
  rw [hdistEq] at hdistLt
  have hleft := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right F hdistLt
  have heq :
      F.sub (tag i)
          (F.sub (tag i) (cut (leftChosenCutLevel hcut (tag i)))) =
        cut (leftChosenCutLevel hcut (tag i)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F _ _
  change F.lt
    (F.sub (tag i)
      (F.sub (tag i) (cut (leftChosenCutLevel hcut (tag i)))))
    (p i) at hleft
  rw [heq] at hleft
  exact hleft

name: exists_leftNestedTailAbsGaugeShifted
statement:
private theorem exists_leftNestedTailAbsGaugeShifted
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b eps : Point} {J : Point -> Point}
    {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hvalues : HasLeftHKTruncationValues f a b J)
    (hcut : LeftCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) (k : Nat) :
    Exists (fun gamma : Point -> Point =>
      And (ClosedIntervalGaugeOn (cut k) b gamma)
        (forall (n : Nat) (left right tag value : Nat -> Point),
          (forall i : Nat, i < n ->
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
              f (left i) (right i) (value i)) ->
          PartialTaggedDivision (cut k) b n left right tag ->
          GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
              (cut k) b n left right tag gamma ->
            RealTheory.lt
              (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f left right tag value n)
              (RealTheory.mul eps
                (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2)))))
proof:
:= by
  have hbudget : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base heps
      (RealTheory.baseTail_pos validBase_two (k + 2))
  exact
    exists_henstockAbsErrorSupportGauge_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
      (hcut.left k).right
      (hvalues (cut k) (hcut.left k).left (hcut.left k).right)
      hbudget

name: leftNestedTailAbsGaugeShiftedFamily_spec
statement:
private theorem leftNestedTailAbsGaugeShiftedFamily_spec
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b eps : Point} {J : Point -> Point}
    {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hvalues : HasLeftHKTruncationValues f a b J)
    (hcut : LeftCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) (k : Nat) :
    And
      (ClosedIntervalGaugeOn (cut k) b
        (leftNestedTailAbsGaugeShiftedFamily hvalues hcut heps k))
      (forall (n : Nat) (left right tag value : Nat -> Point),
        (forall i : Nat, i < n ->
          HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
            f (left i) (right i) (value i)) ->
        PartialTaggedDivision (cut k) b n left right tag ->
        GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
            (cut k) b n left right tag
            (leftNestedTailAbsGaugeShiftedFamily hvalues hcut heps k) ->
          RealTheory.lt
            (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f left right tag value n)
            (RealTheory.mul eps
              (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2))))
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec
    (exists_leftNestedTailAbsGaugeShifted hvalues hcut heps k)

name: leftNonEndpointLevel_absError_lt
statement:
private theorem leftNonEndpointLevel_absError_lt
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A eps endpointRadius : Point}
    {J : Point -> Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hvalues : HasLeftHKTruncationValues f a b J)
    (hcut : LeftCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hfine : GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
      (leftNestedTailGauge hcut endpointRadius
        (leftNestedTailAbsGaugeShiftedFamily hvalues hcut heps)))
    (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat =>
          if leftWholeCellLevel hcut tag i = k + 1 then
            RealTheory.abs
              (partialTaggedError f
                (fun j : Nat => p j)
                (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag
                (leftWholeIntegralValue a A J p) i)
          else RealTheory.zero)
        n)
      (RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let level := leftWholeCellLevel hcut tag
  let value := leftWholeIntegralValue a A J p
  let gamma := leftNestedTailAbsGaugeShiftedFamily hvalues hcut heps
  cases exists_levelFiber_taggedCellSubpartition n level (k + 1) with
  | intro selected hselected =>
      cases hselected with
      | intro index hindex =>
          have hsub := hindex.left
          have hlevel := hindex.right.left
          have htagNe : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              Not (tag (index j) = a) := by
            intro j hj htagA
            have hz : level (index j) = 0 := by
              dsimp [level]
              exact (leftWholeCellLevel_eq_zero_iff
                hcut tag (index j)).mpr htagA
            rw [hlevel j hj] at hz
            omega
          have hchosen : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              leftChosenCutLevel hcut (tag (index j)) = k := by
            intro j hj
            have hs := leftWholeCellLevel_eq_succ_of_ne
              hcut tag (htagNe j hj)
            dsimp [level] at hlevel
            rw [hlevel j hj] at hs
            omega
          have htagBounds : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              And (RealTheory.lt a (tag (index j)))
                (RealTheory.le (tag (index j)) b) := by
            intro j hj
            have hidx := hsub.left j hj
            have hmem :=
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_tag_mem_closedInterval
                hfine.left hidx
            have hax : RealTheory.lt a (tag (index j)) := by
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hmem.left
                (fun hle => (htagNe j hj)
                  (RealTheory.le_antisymm hle hmem.left))
            exact And.intro hax hmem.right
          have hleft : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval (cut k) b
                (subpartitionLeft p index j) := by
            intro j hj
            have hidx := hsub.left j hj
            have hgt := leftNestedTailGauge_cell_left_gt_cut
              hcut hfine hidx (htagBounds j hj).left
            rw [hchosen j hj] at hgt
            exact And.intro
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hgt)
              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
                hfine.left.left hidx).right
          have hright : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval (cut k) b
                (subpartitionRight p index j) := by
            intro j hj
            have hidx := hsub.left j hj
            have hstep : RealTheory.le
                (subpartitionLeft p index j)
                (subpartitionRight p index j) := by
              unfold subpartitionLeft subpartitionRight
              exact Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_step_le
                hfine.left.left hidx
            exact And.intro (RealTheory.le_trans (hleft j hj).left hstep)
              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
                hfine.left.left hidx).right
          have hgaugeLe : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              RealTheory.le
                (leftNestedTailGauge hcut endpointRadius gamma
                  (subpartitionTags tag index j))
                (gamma k (subpartitionTags tag index j)) := by
            intro j hj
            have hle := leftNestedTailGauge_le_tailGauge
              (endpointRadius := endpointRadius) hcut gamma
              (htagBounds j hj).left (htagBounds j hj).right
            simpa [subpartitionTags, hchosen j hj] using hle
          have hfineFiber :=
            taggedCellSubpartition_gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivisionOn_of_gauge_le
              hfine hsub hleft hright hgaugeLe
          let selectedValue : Nat -> Point := fun j => value (index j)
          have hlocal : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f
                (subpartitionLeft p index j)
                (subpartitionRight p index j) (selectedValue j) := by
            intro j hj
            have huv := partialTaggedDivision_cell_le hfineFiber.left hj
            have hau : RealTheory.lt a (subpartitionLeft p index j) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                (hcut.left k).left (hleft j hj).left
            have hvb := (hright j hj).right
            have hrightGt : RealTheory.lt a (subpartitionRight p index j) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hau huv
            have hleftNe : Not (subpartitionLeft p index j = a) := by
              intro hEq
              rw [hEq] at hau
              exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base a) hau
            have hrightNe : Not (subpartitionRight p index j = a) := by
              intro hEq
              rw [hEq] at hrightGt
              exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base a) hrightGt
            have hleftNe' : Not (p (index j) = a) := by
              simpa [subpartitionLeft] using hleftNe
            have hrightNe' : Not (p (index j + 1) = a) := by
              simpa [subpartitionRight] using hrightNe
            have hvalueEq : selectedValue j =
                RealTheory.sub
                  (J (subpartitionLeft p index j))
                  (J (subpartitionRight p index j)) := by
              unfold selectedValue value leftWholeIntegralValue
              unfold leftExtendedPrimitive
              simp [subpartitionLeft, subpartitionRight,
                hleftNe', hrightNe']
            rw [hvalueEq]
            exact hasIntegral_subinterval_of_leftTruncationValues
              hvalues hau huv hvb
          have herror :=
            (leftNestedTailAbsGaugeShiftedFamily_spec
              hvalues hcut heps k).right
              selected (subpartitionLeft p index)
              (subpartitionRight p index) (subpartitionTags tag index)
              selectedValue hlocal hfineFiber.left hfineFiber
          have hreindex := hindex.right.right
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.abs
              (partialTaggedError f
                (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1))
                tag value i))
          rw [hreindex]
          simpa [selectedValue, subpartitionLeft, subpartitionRight,
            subpartitionTags] using herror

name: leftEndpointLevel_absError_lt
statement:
private theorem leftEndpointLevel_absError_lt
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A endpointRadius e0 ehalf : Point}
    {J : Point -> Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hcut : LeftCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    {gamma : Nat -> Point -> Point}
    (he0 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e0)
    (hsplit : RealTheory.add ehalf ehalf = e0)
    (hendpoint : forall c : Point,
      RealTheory.le a c ->
        RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c a) endpointRadius ->
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.mul (f a) (RealTheory.sub c a))) ehalf)
    (hlimit : forall c : Point,
      RealTheory.lt a c ->
        RealTheory.le c b ->
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c a) endpointRadius ->
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (J c) A)) ehalf)
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hfine : GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
      (leftNestedTailGauge hcut endpointRadius gamma)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat =>
          if leftWholeCellLevel hcut tag i = 0 then
            RealTheory.abs
              (partialTaggedError f
                (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1))
                tag (leftWholeIntegralValue a A J p) i)
          else RealTheory.zero)
        n)
      e0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let level := leftWholeCellLevel hcut tag
  let value := leftWholeIntegralValue a A J p
  let term : Nat -> Point := fun i => RealTheory.abs
    (partialTaggedError f
      (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag value i)
  cases exists_levelFiber_taggedCellSubpartition n level 0 with
  | intro selected hselected =>
      cases hselected with
      | intro index hindex =>
          have hsub := hindex.left
          have hlevel := hindex.right.left
          have hreindex := hindex.right.right term
          have htagA : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              tag (index j) = a := by
            intro j hj
            exact (leftWholeCellLevel_eq_zero_iff
              hcut tag (index j)).mp (hlevel j hj)
          rw [hreindex]
          by_cases hselectedZero : selected = 0
          next =>
            rw [hselectedZero, RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
            exact he0
          next =>
            let last := selected - 1
            have hlast : last < selected := by
              dsimp [last]
              omega
            have hcellZero : forall j : Nat, j + 1 < selected ->
                Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength
                  p (index j) = RealTheory.zero := by
              intro j hjNext
              have hj : j < selected := by omega
              have hnextLeft : p (index (j + 1)) = a :=
                Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_tag_eq_left_endpoint_cell_left
                  hfine.left (hsub.left (j + 1) hjNext)
                  (htagA (j + 1) hjNext)
              have hrightLe : RealTheory.le
                  (p (index j + 1)) (p (index (j + 1))) :=
                Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
                  hfine.left.left (index j + 1) (index (j + 1))
                  (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (hsub.right j hjNext))
                  (Nat.le_of_lt (hsub.left (j + 1) hjNext))
              have hrightMem :=
                Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
                  hfine.left.left (hsub.left j hj)
              have hrightEq : p (index j + 1) = a :=
                RealTheory.le_antisymm
                  (by rwa [hnextLeft] at hrightLe)
                  hrightMem.left
              exact
                Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_left_endpoint_tag_cellLength_eq_zero_of_cell_right
                  hfine.left (hsub.left j hj) (htagA j hj) hrightEq
            have htermZero : forall j : Nat, j + 1 < selected ->
                term (index j) = RealTheory.zero := by
              intro j hjNext
              have hj : j < selected := by omega
              have hleftEq : p (index j) = a :=
                Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_tag_eq_left_endpoint_cell_left
                  hfine.left (hsub.left j hj) (htagA j hj)
              have hrightEq : p (index j + 1) = a := by
                have hz := hcellZero j hjNext
                unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength at hz
                have hrightMem :=
                  Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
                    hfine.left.left (hsub.left j hj)
                have hsubZero : RealTheory.sub (p (index j + 1)) a =
                    RealTheory.zero := by rwa [hleftEq] at hz
                let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                change F.sub (p (index j + 1)) a = F.zero at hsubZero
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero F hsubZero
              unfold term value partialTaggedError partialCellLength
              unfold leftWholeIntegralValue leftExtendedPrimitive
              simp only [hleftEq, hrightEq, htagA j hj, if_pos]
              let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              change RealTheory.abs
                (F.sub (F.mul (f a) (F.sub a a)) (F.sub A A)) =
                  F.zero
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F a]
              rw [F.mul_zero]
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F A]
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.zero]
              exact RealTheory.abs_zero
            have hsingle :
                RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => term (index j)) selected =
                  term (index last) :=
              RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_single_of_eq_zero_off hlast (by
                intro j hj hjne
                apply htermZero j
                dsimp [last] at hjne
                omega)
            rw [hsingle]
            let i := index last
            let c := p (i + 1)
            have hi : i < n := hsub.left last hlast
            have htagEq : tag i = a := by
              dsimp [i]
              exact htagA last hlast
            have hleftEq : p i = a :=
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_tag_eq_left_endpoint_cell_left
                hfine.left hi htagEq
            have hcMem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c := by
              dsimp [c, i]
              exact Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
                hfine.left.left hi
            by_cases hcEq : c = a
            next =>
              have hcEq' : p (i + 1) = a := by
                simpa [c] using hcEq
              have htermEq : term i = RealTheory.zero := by
                unfold term value partialTaggedError partialCellLength
                unfold leftWholeIntegralValue leftExtendedPrimitive
                simp only [hleftEq, hcEq', htagEq, if_pos]
                let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                change RealTheory.abs
                  (F.sub (F.mul (f a) (F.sub a a)) (F.sub A A)) =
                    F.zero
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F a]
                rw [F.mul_zero]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F A]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.zero]
                exact RealTheory.abs_zero
              dsimp [i] at htermEq
              rw [htermEq]
              exact he0
            next =>
              have hac : RealTheory.lt a c :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hcMem.left
                  (fun hca => hcEq (RealTheory.le_antisymm hca hcMem.left))
              have hcellRight : PartitionCell p i c := by
                dsimp [c]
                exact intervalPartition_cell_right_mem hfine.left.left hi
              have hfineRight := hfine.right i hi c hcellRight
              have hsmall :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c a) endpointRadius := by
                have hdistEq : RealFunction.dist c a =
                    RealTheory.sub c a := by
                  change RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub c a) = _
                  exact RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le
                      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hcMem.left)
                rw [htagEq, leftNestedTailGauge_at_endpoint hcut gamma,
                  hdistEq] at hfineRight
                exact hfineRight
              have hmul := hendpoint c hcMem.left hsmall
              have hlim := hlimit c hac hcMem.right hsmall
              have htri := RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
                (RealTheory.mul (f a) (RealTheory.sub c a))
                (RealTheory.sub (J c) A)
              have hadd : RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (RealTheory.mul (f a) (RealTheory.sub c a)))
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (J c) A))) e0 := by
                have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hmul hlim
                let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                change F.lt
                  (F.add
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (RealTheory.mul (f a) (RealTheory.sub c a)))
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (J c) A)))
                  (F.add ehalf ehalf) at h
                change F.add ehalf ehalf = e0 at hsplit
                rw [hsplit] at h
                exact h
              have hbound := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base htri hadd
              have herrorEq : term i =
                  RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.mul (f a) (RealTheory.sub c a))
                      (RealTheory.sub (J c) A)) := by
                unfold term value
                change
                  RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (RealTheory.mul (f (tag i))
                        (RealTheory.sub (p (i + 1)) (p i)))
                      (RealTheory.sub
                        (leftExtendedPrimitive a A J (p i))
                        (leftExtendedPrimitive a A J (p (i + 1))))) = _
                rw [htagEq, hleftEq]
                change
                  RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (RealTheory.mul (f a) (RealTheory.sub c a))
                      (RealTheory.sub
                        (leftExtendedPrimitive a A J a)
                        (leftExtendedPrimitive a A J c))) = _
                simp only [leftExtendedPrimitive, hcEq, if_pos]
                let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                change
                  RealTheory.abs
                    (F.sub (F.mul (f a) (F.sub c a))
                      (F.sub A (J c))) =
                    RealTheory.abs
                      (F.add (F.mul (f a) (F.sub c a))
                        (F.sub (J c) A))
                rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F A (J c)]
              dsimp [i] at herrorEq
              rw [herrorEq]
              exact hbound

name: exists_leftEndpointTermRadius
statement:
private theorem exists_leftEndpointTermRadius
    (f : Point -> Point) (a : Point) {eps : Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists (fun eta : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
        (forall c : Point,
          RealTheory.le a c ->
            RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c a) eta ->
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.mul (f a) (RealTheory.sub c a))) eps))
proof:
:= by
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (f a) heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      refine Exists.intro eta ?_
      refine And.intro heta.left ?_
      intro c hac hsmall
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hlen : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub c a) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hac
      have hmulLe : RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f a)) (RealTheory.sub c a))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f a)) eta) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsmall)
          (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f a))
      change F.lt
        (RealTheory.abs (F.mul (f a) (F.sub c a))) eps
      rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
      change F.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f a))
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub c a))) eps
      rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hlen]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hmulLe heta.right

name: finiteSum_reverse_telescope_sub
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_reverse_telescope_sub
    (K : Nat -> Point) : forall n : Nat,
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.sub (K i) (K (i + 1))) n =
      RealTheory.sub (K 0) (K n)
  | 0 => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (K 0)).symm
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_reverse_telescope_sub K n]
      exact sub_add_sub_cancel_point (K 0) (K n) (K (n + 1))

private theorem leftWholeIntegralValueSum_eq_target
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A : Point} {J : Point -> Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hvalues : HasLeftHKTruncationValues f a b J)
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag) :
    partialIntegralValueSum (leftWholeIntegralValue a A J p) n = A
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p 0 = a := intervalPartition_left_endpoint htag.left
  have hpn : p n = b := intervalPartition_right_endpoint htag.left
  have hba : Not (b = a) := by
    intro hba
    rw [hba] at hab
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base a) hab
  have hJb := leftTruncationValue_right_eq_zero hvalues hab
  unfold partialIntegralValueSum leftWholeIntegralValue
  rw [finiteSum_reverse_telescope_sub
    (fun i : Nat => leftExtendedPrimitive a A J (p i)) n]
  rw [hp0, hpn]
  simp only [leftExtendedPrimitive, hba, if_pos]
  rw [hJb]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base A

name: leftWholeIntegralValueSum_eq_target
statement:
private theorem leftWholeIntegralValueSum_eq_target

  have hJb := leftTruncationValue_right_eq_zero hvalues hab

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_leftEndpointHakeLimit
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_leftEndpointHakeLimit
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A : Point} {J : Point -> Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hvalues : HasLeftHKTruncationValues f a b J)
    (hlim : LeftHKTruncationTendsTo f a b J A) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b A
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hab) ?_
  intro eps heps
  let cut := leftCanonicalCofinalCut a b
  have hcut : LeftCofinalCutFamily a b cut := by
    dsimp [cut]
    exact leftCanonicalCofinalCutFamily hab
  let e0 := RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.baseTail 2 1)
  have he0 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e0 := by
    dsimp [e0]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base heps
      (RealTheory.baseTail_pos validBase_two 1)
  let ehalf := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base e0
  have hehalf : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero ehalf := by
    dsimp [ehalf]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base he0
  cases exists_leftEndpointTermRadius f a hehalf with
  | intro termRadius htermRadius =>
      cases hlim ehalf hehalf with
      | intro limitRadius hlimitRadius =>
          let endpointRadius := RealTheory.min termRadius limitRadius
          have hendpointRadius :
              RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero endpointRadius := by
            dsimp [endpointRadius]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              htermRadius.left hlimitRadius.left
          let gamma :=
            leftNestedTailAbsGaugeShiftedFamily hvalues hcut heps
          let delta :=
            leftNestedTailGauge hcut endpointRadius gamma
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          next =>
            dsimp [delta]
            apply closedIntervalGaugeOn_leftNestedTailGauge
              hcut hendpointRadius
            intro k
            dsimp [gamma]
            exact (leftNestedTailAbsGaugeShiftedFamily_spec
              hvalues hcut heps k).left
          next =>
            intro n p tag hfine
            have hendpoint : forall c : Point,
                RealTheory.le a c ->
                  RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c a) endpointRadius ->
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.abs
                        (RealTheory.mul (f a) (RealTheory.sub c a)))
                      ehalf := by
              intro c hac hsmall
              apply htermRadius.right c hac
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsmall
                (RealTheory.min_le_left termRadius limitRadius)
            have hlimit : forall c : Point,
                RealTheory.lt a c ->
                  RealTheory.le c b ->
                    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c a) endpointRadius ->
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (J c) A))
                        ehalf := by
              intro c hac hcb hsmall
              apply hlimitRadius.right c hac hcb
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsmall
                (RealTheory.min_le_right termRadius limitRadius)
            have hsplit : RealTheory.add ehalf ehalf = e0 := by
              dsimp [ehalf]
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base e0
            have hfiber : forall k : Nat,
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.finiteSum
                    (fun i : Nat =>
                      if leftWholeCellLevel hcut tag i = k then
                        RealTheory.abs
                          (partialTaggedError f
                            (fun j : Nat => p j)
                            (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag
                            (leftWholeIntegralValue a A J p) i)
                      else RealTheory.zero)
                    n)
                  (RealTheory.mul eps
                    (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1))) := by
              intro k
              cases k with
              | zero =>
                  change RealTheory.lt _ e0
                  exact leftEndpointLevel_absError_lt
                    hcut he0 hsplit hendpoint hlimit hfine
              | succ k =>
                  simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using
                    (leftNonEndpointLevel_absError_lt
                      hvalues hcut heps hfine k)
            have htotal :=
              finiteSum_lt_of_levelFiber_geometric_bounds heps hfiber
            have htotalAbs : RealTheory.lt
                (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f
                  (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1))
                  tag (leftWholeIntegralValue a A J p) n) eps := by
              simpa [partialTaggedAbsErrorSum] using htotal
            have herror : RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (partialTaggedErrorSum f
                    (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1))
                    tag (leftWholeIntegralValue a A J p) n)) eps :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                (abs_partialTaggedErrorSum_le_partialTaggedAbsErrorSum
                  f (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1))
                  tag (leftWholeIntegralValue a A J p) n)
                htotalAbs
            have hvalue := leftWholeIntegralValueSum_eq_target
              (A := A) hab hvalues hfine.left
            rw [partialTaggedErrorSum_of_taggedPartition] at herror
            rw [hvalue] at herror
            exact herror

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_hasLeftEndpointHakeLimit
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_hasLeftEndpointHakeLimit
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A : Point}

    (hlim : HasLeftEndpointHakeLimit f a b A) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b A
proof:
:= by
  cases hlim with
  | intro J hJ =>
      exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_leftEndpointHakeLimit
        (J := J) hab hJ.left hJ.right

name: hasIntegral_subinterval_of_rightTruncationValues
statement:
private theorem hasIntegral_subinterval_of_rightTruncationValues
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b u v : Point} {J : Point -> Point}
    (hvalues : HasRightHKTruncationValues f a b J)
    (hau : RealTheory.le a u)
    (huv : RealTheory.le u v)
    (hvb : RealTheory.lt v b) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f u v
      (RealTheory.sub (J v) (J u))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hav : RealTheory.le a v := RealTheory.le_trans hau huv
  have hub : RealTheory.lt u b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F huv hvb
  have hJu : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a u (J u) :=
    hvalues u hau hub
  have hJv : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a v (J v) :=
    hvalues v hav hvb
  cases
      exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_subinterval
        (f := f) (a := a) (c := u) (d := v) (b := v) (I := J v)
        hau huv (RealTheory.le_refl v) hJv with
  | intro I hI =>
      have hsum : J v = RealTheory.add (J u) I :=
        hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_eq_add_of_adjacent_ordered
          (f := f) (a := a) (c := u) (b := v)
          (K := J v) (I := J u) (J := I)
          hau huv hJv hJu hI
      have hsumComm : J v = RealTheory.add I (J u) := by
        rw [hsum]
        exact RealTheory.add_comm (J u) I
      have hIeq : I = RealTheory.sub (J v) (J u) :=
        RealTheory.eq_sub_of_eq_add_right hsumComm
      rwa [<- hIeq]

name: rightTruncationValue_left_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem rightTruncationValue_left_eq_zero

    J a = RealTheory.zero

name: rightCanonicalCofinalCutFamily
statement:
private theorem rightCanonicalCofinalCutFamily
    {a b : Point} (hab : RealTheory.lt a b) :
    RightCofinalCutFamily a b
      (rightCanonicalCofinalCut a b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hgap : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hab
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  next =>
    intro k
    let m := RealTheory.min
      (RealTheory.sub b a) (RealTheory.baseTail 2 k)
    have htail : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 k) :=
      RealTheory.baseTail_pos validBase_two k
    have hmPos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero m := by
      dsimp [m]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hgap htail
    have hmLe : RealTheory.le m (RealTheory.sub b a) := by
      dsimp [m]
      exact RealTheory.min_le_left _ _
    have hadd : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.add a m) b := by
      have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hmLe a
      have habEq : RealTheory.add a (RealTheory.sub b a) = b := by
        rw [RealTheory.add_comm a (RealTheory.sub b a)]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b a
      change RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add a m)
        (RealTheory.add a (RealTheory.sub b a)) at h
      rwa [habEq] at h
    have hleft : RealTheory.le a (RealTheory.sub b m) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_sub_of_add_le F hadd
    have hright : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b m) b :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hmPos
    simpa [rightCanonicalCofinalCut, m] using
      (And.intro hleft hright)
  next =>
    intro x hax hxb
    have heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b x) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxb
    cases baseTail_eventually_lt validBase_two
        (RealTheory.sub b x) heps with
    | intro N hN =>
        refine Exists.intro N ?_
        let m := RealTheory.min
          (RealTheory.sub b a) (RealTheory.baseTail 2 N)
        have hmLe : RealTheory.le m (RealTheory.baseTail 2 N) := by
          dsimp [m]
          exact RealTheory.min_le_right _ _
        have hmLt : RealTheory.lt m (RealTheory.sub b x) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hmLe
            (hN N (Nat.le_refl N))
        have hadd : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add x m) b := by
          have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hmLt x
          have hright : RealTheory.add x (RealTheory.sub b x) = b := by
            rw [RealTheory.add_comm x (RealTheory.sub b x)]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b x
          change RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.add x m)
            (RealTheory.add x (RealTheory.sub b x)) at h
          rwa [hright] at h
        have hshift :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F hadd (RealTheory.neg m)
        have hleft :
            RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x m) (RealTheory.neg m) = x :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_neg_cancel_right F x m
        change RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add x m) (RealTheory.neg m))
          (RealTheory.add b (RealTheory.neg m)) at hshift
        rw [hleft] at hshift
        change F.lt x (F.sub b m) at hshift
        simpa [rightCanonicalCofinalCut, m] using hshift

name: rightChosenCutLevel_spec
statement:
private theorem rightChosenCutLevel_spec
    {a b x : Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hcut : RightCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x) (hxb : RealTheory.lt x b) :
    RealTheory.lt x (cut (rightChosenCutLevel hcut x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold rightChosenCutLevel
  rw [dif_pos (And.intro hax hxb)]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (hcut.right x hax hxb)

name: closedIntervalGaugeOn_rightNestedPrefixGauge
statement:
private theorem closedIntervalGaugeOn_rightNestedPrefixGauge
    {a b endpointRadius : Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    {gamma : Nat -> Point -> Point}
    (hcut : RightCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (hendpoint : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero endpointRadius)
    (hgamma : forall k : Nat,
      ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a (cut k) (gamma k)) :
    ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b
      (rightNestedPrefixGauge hcut endpointRadius gamma)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  classical
  by_cases hxb : x = b
  next =>
    simp [rightNestedPrefixGauge, hxb]
    exact hendpoint
  next =>
    have hlt : RealTheory.lt x b :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx.right
        (fun hbx => hxb (RealTheory.le_antisymm hx.right hbx))
    unfold rightNestedPrefixGauge
    rw [dif_neg hxb]
    split
    case isFalse hdom =>
      exact False.elim (hdom (And.intro hx.left hlt))
    case isTrue _hdom =>
      let k := rightChosenCutLevel hcut x
      have hxk : RealTheory.lt x (cut k) := by
        dsimp [k]
        exact rightChosenCutLevel_spec hcut hx.left hlt
      have hxPrefix : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a (cut k) x :=
        And.intro hx.left
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hxk)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (hgamma k x hxPrefix)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hxk)

name: rightNestedPrefixGauge_at_endpoint
statement:
private theorem rightNestedPrefixGauge_at_endpoint
    {a b endpointRadius : Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hcut : RightCofinalCutFamily a b cut)

      endpointRadius

:= by
