name: rightNestedPrefixGauge_le_prefixGauge
statement:
private theorem rightNestedPrefixGauge_le_prefixGauge
    {a b endpointRadius x : Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hcut : RightCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (gamma : Nat -> Point -> Point)
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x) (hxb : RealTheory.lt x b) :
    RealTheory.le
      (rightNestedPrefixGauge hcut endpointRadius gamma x)
      (gamma (rightChosenCutLevel hcut x) x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold rightNestedPrefixGauge
  have hxne : Not (x = b) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hxb
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base b) hxb
  simp [hxne, hax, hxb]
  exact RealTheory.min_le_left _ _

name: rightNestedPrefixGauge_le_cutRadius
statement:
private theorem rightNestedPrefixGauge_le_cutRadius
    {a b endpointRadius x : Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hcut : RightCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (gamma : Nat -> Point -> Point)
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x) (hxb : RealTheory.lt x b) :
    RealTheory.le
      (rightNestedPrefixGauge hcut endpointRadius gamma x)
      (RealTheory.sub
        (cut (rightChosenCutLevel hcut x)) x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold rightNestedPrefixGauge
  have hxne : Not (x = b) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hxb
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base b) hxb
  simp [hxne, hax, hxb]
  exact RealTheory.min_le_right _ _

name: rightNestedPrefixGauge_cell_right_lt_cut
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htagMem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a partitionB (tag i) :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_tag_mem_closedInterval
      hfine.left hi
  have hcellRight : PartitionCell p i (p (i + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_right_mem hfine.left.left hi
  have hfineRight :
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (p (i + 1)) (tag i))
        (rightNestedPrefixGauge
          hcut endpointRadius gamma (tag i)) :=
    hfine.right i hi (p (i + 1)) hcellRight
  have hgaugeLe :=
    rightNestedPrefixGauge_le_cutRadius
      (endpointRadius := endpointRadius) hcut gamma htagMem.left hxb
  have hdistLt :
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (p (i + 1)) (tag i))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (cut (rightChosenCutLevel hcut (tag i))) (tag i)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hfineRight hgaugeLe
  have htagCell : PartitionCell p i (tag i) := hfine.left.right i hi
  have hdistEq :
      RealFunction.dist (p (i + 1)) (tag i) =
        RealTheory.sub (p (i + 1)) (tag i) := by
    change RealTheory.abs
      (RealTheory.sub (p (i + 1)) (tag i)) = _
    exact RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F htagCell.right)
  rw [hdistEq] at hdistLt
  have hshift :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F hdistLt (tag i)
  change F.lt
    (F.add (F.sub (p (i + 1)) (tag i)) (tag i))
    (F.add
      (F.sub (cut (rightChosenCutLevel hcut (tag i))) (tag i))
      (tag i)) at hshift
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel,
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel] at hshift

name: rightWholeCellLevel_eq_zero_iff
statement:
private theorem rightWholeCellLevel_eq_zero_iff
    {a b : Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hcut : RightCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (tag : Nat -> Point) (i : Nat) :
    rightWholeCellLevel hcut tag i = 0 <-> tag i = b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold rightWholeCellLevel
  by_cases htag : tag i = b <;> simp [htag]

name: rightWholeCellLevel_eq_succ_of_ne
statement:
private theorem rightWholeCellLevel_eq_succ_of_ne
    {a b : Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hcut : RightCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (tag : Nat -> Point) {i : Nat} (htag : Not (tag i = b)) :
    rightWholeCellLevel hcut tag i =
      rightChosenCutLevel hcut (tag i) + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [rightWholeCellLevel, htag]

name: rightWholeIntegralValue_sum
statement:
private theorem rightWholeIntegralValue_sum
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A : Point} {J : Point -> Point}
    (hvalues : HasRightHKTruncationValues f a b J)
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag) :
    partialIntegralValueSum
      (rightWholeIntegralValue b A J p) n = A
proof:
:= by
  unfold partialIntegralValueSum rightWholeIntegralValue
  have htel :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub
              (rightExtendedPrimitive b A J (p (i + 1)))
              (rightExtendedPrimitive b A J (p i))) n =
        RealTheory.sub
          (rightExtendedPrimitive b A J (p n))
          (rightExtendedPrimitive b A J (p 0)) := by
    simpa using
      (RealTheory.finiteSum_telescope_sub
        (fun i : Nat => rightExtendedPrimitive b A J (p i)) n)
  rw [htel]
  rw [
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_left_endpoint
      htag.left,
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_right_endpoint
      htag.left]
  have hba : Not (a = b) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hab
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base b) hab
  have hJa := rightTruncationValue_left_eq_zero hvalues hab
  simp only [rightExtendedPrimitive, if_pos, hba]
  rw [hJa]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base A

name: exists_rightNestedPrefixAbsGaugeShifted
statement:
private theorem exists_rightNestedPrefixAbsGaugeShifted
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b eps : Point} {J : Point -> Point}
    {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hvalues : HasRightHKTruncationValues f a b J)
    (hcut : RightCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) (k : Nat) :
    Exists (fun gamma : Point -> Point =>
      And (ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a (cut k) gamma)
        (forall (n : Nat) (left right tag value : Nat -> Point),
          (forall i : Nat, i < n ->
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
              f (left i) (right i) (value i)) ->
          PartialTaggedDivision a (cut k) n left right tag ->
          GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
              a (cut k) n left right tag gamma ->
            RealTheory.lt
              (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f left right tag value n)
              (RealTheory.mul eps
                (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2)))))
proof:
:= by
  have hbudget : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base heps
      (RealTheory.baseTail_pos validBase_two (k + 2))
  exact
    exists_henstockAbsErrorSupportGauge_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
      (hcut.left k).left
      (hvalues (cut k) (hcut.left k).left (hcut.left k).right)
      hbudget

name: rightNestedPrefixAbsGaugeShiftedFamily_spec
statement:
private theorem rightNestedPrefixAbsGaugeShiftedFamily_spec
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b eps : Point} {J : Point -> Point}
    {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hvalues : HasRightHKTruncationValues f a b J)
    (hcut : RightCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) (k : Nat) :
    And
      (ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a (cut k)
        (rightNestedPrefixAbsGaugeShiftedFamily
          hvalues hcut heps k))
      (forall (n : Nat) (left right tag value : Nat -> Point),
        (forall i : Nat, i < n ->
          HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
            f (left i) (right i) (value i)) ->
        PartialTaggedDivision a (cut k) n left right tag ->
        GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
            a (cut k) n left right tag
            (rightNestedPrefixAbsGaugeShiftedFamily
              hvalues hcut heps k) ->
          RealTheory.lt
            (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f left right tag value n)
            (RealTheory.mul eps
              (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2))))
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec
    (exists_rightNestedPrefixAbsGaugeShifted
      hvalues hcut heps k)

name: rightNonEndpointLevel_absError_lt
statement:
private theorem rightNonEndpointLevel_absError_lt
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A eps endpointRadius : Point}
    {J : Point -> Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hvalues : HasRightHKTruncationValues f a b J)
    (hcut : RightCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hfine : GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
      (rightNestedPrefixGauge hcut endpointRadius
        (rightNestedPrefixAbsGaugeShiftedFamily
          hvalues hcut heps)))
    (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat =>
          if rightWholeCellLevel hcut tag i = k + 1 then
            RealTheory.abs
              (partialTaggedError f
                (fun j : Nat => p j)
                (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag
                (rightWholeIntegralValue b A J p) i)
          else RealTheory.zero)
        n)
      (RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let level := rightWholeCellLevel hcut tag
  let value := rightWholeIntegralValue b A J p
  let gamma :=
    rightNestedPrefixAbsGaugeShiftedFamily hvalues hcut heps
  cases exists_levelFiber_taggedCellSubpartition n level (k + 1) with
  | intro selected hselected =>
      cases hselected with
      | intro index hindex =>
          have hsub := hindex.left
          have hlevel := hindex.right.left
          have htagNe : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              Not (tag (index j) = b) := by
            intro j hj htagB
            have hz : level (index j) = 0 := by
              dsimp [level]
              exact (rightWholeCellLevel_eq_zero_iff
                hcut tag (index j)).mpr htagB
            rw [hlevel j hj] at hz
            omega
          have hchosen : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              rightChosenCutLevel hcut (tag (index j)) = k := by
            intro j hj
            have hs := rightWholeCellLevel_eq_succ_of_ne
              hcut tag (htagNe j hj)
            dsimp [level] at hlevel
            rw [hlevel j hj] at hs
            omega
          have htagBounds : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              And (RealTheory.le a (tag (index j)))
                (RealTheory.lt (tag (index j)) b) := by
            intro j hj
            have hidx := hsub.left j hj
            have hmem :=
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_tag_mem_closedInterval
                hfine.left hidx
            have hxb : RealTheory.lt (tag (index j)) b :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hmem.right
                (fun hle => (htagNe j hj)
                  (RealTheory.le_antisymm hmem.right hle))
            exact And.intro hmem.left hxb
          have hright : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a (cut k)
                (subpartitionRight p index j) := by
            intro j hj
            have hidx := hsub.left j hj
            have hlt := rightNestedPrefixGauge_cell_right_lt_cut
              hcut hfine hidx (htagBounds j hj).right
            rw [hchosen j hj] at hlt
            exact And.intro
              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
                  hfine.left.left hidx).left
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hlt)
          have hleft : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a (cut k)
                (subpartitionLeft p index j) := by
            intro j hj
            have hidx := hsub.left j hj
            have hstep : RealTheory.le
                (subpartitionLeft p index j)
                (subpartitionRight p index j) := by
              unfold subpartitionLeft subpartitionRight
              exact Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_step_le
                hfine.left.left hidx
            exact And.intro
              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
                  hfine.left.left hidx).left
              (RealTheory.le_trans hstep (hright j hj).right)
          have hgaugeLe : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              RealTheory.le
                (rightNestedPrefixGauge hcut endpointRadius gamma
                  (subpartitionTags tag index j))
                (gamma k (subpartitionTags tag index j)) := by
            intro j hj
            have hle := rightNestedPrefixGauge_le_prefixGauge
              (endpointRadius := endpointRadius) hcut gamma
              (htagBounds j hj).left (htagBounds j hj).right
            simpa [subpartitionTags, hchosen j hj] using hle
          have hfineFiber :=
            taggedCellSubpartition_gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivisionOn_of_gauge_le
              hfine hsub hleft hright hgaugeLe
          let selectedValue : Nat -> Point := fun j => value (index j)
          have hlocal : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f
                (subpartitionLeft p index j)
                (subpartitionRight p index j) (selectedValue j) := by
            intro j hj
            have hau := (hleft j hj).left
            have huv := partialTaggedDivision_cell_le hfineFiber.left hj
            have hvb : RealTheory.lt
                (subpartitionRight p index j) b :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                (hright j hj).right (hcut.left k).right
            have hleftLt : RealTheory.lt
                (subpartitionLeft p index j) b :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base huv hvb
            have hleftNe :
                Not (subpartitionLeft p index j = b) := by
              intro hEq
              rw [hEq] at hleftLt
              exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base b) hleftLt
            have hrightNe :
                Not (subpartitionRight p index j = b) := by
              intro hEq
              rw [hEq] at hvb
              exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base b) hvb
            have hleftNe' : Not (p (index j) = b) := by
              simpa [subpartitionLeft] using hleftNe
            have hrightNe' : Not (p (index j + 1) = b) := by
              simpa [subpartitionRight] using hrightNe
            have hvalueEq : selectedValue j =
                RealTheory.sub
                  (J (subpartitionRight p index j))
                  (J (subpartitionLeft p index j)) := by
              unfold selectedValue value rightWholeIntegralValue
              unfold rightExtendedPrimitive
              simp [subpartitionLeft, subpartitionRight,
                hleftNe', hrightNe']
            rw [hvalueEq]
            exact hasIntegral_subinterval_of_rightTruncationValues
              hvalues hau huv hvb
          have herror :=
            (rightNestedPrefixAbsGaugeShiftedFamily_spec
              hvalues hcut heps k).right
              selected (subpartitionLeft p index)
              (subpartitionRight p index) (subpartitionTags tag index)
              selectedValue hlocal hfineFiber.left hfineFiber
          have hreindex := hindex.right.right
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.abs
              (partialTaggedError f
                (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1))
                tag value i))
          rw [hreindex]
          simpa [selectedValue, subpartitionLeft, subpartitionRight,
            subpartitionTags] using herror

name: rightEndpointLevel_absError_lt
statement:
private theorem rightEndpointLevel_absError_lt
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A endpointRadius e0 ehalf : Point}
    {J : Point -> Point} {cut : Nat -> Point}
    (hcut : RightCofinalCutFamily a b cut)
    {gamma : Nat -> Point -> Point}
    (he0 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e0)
    (hsplit : RealTheory.add ehalf ehalf = e0)
    (hendpoint : forall c : Point,
      RealTheory.le c b ->
        RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b c) endpointRadius ->
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b c))) ehalf)
    (hlimit : forall c : Point,
      RealTheory.le a c ->
        RealTheory.lt c b ->
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b c) endpointRadius ->
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (J c) A)) ehalf)
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hfine : GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
      (rightNestedPrefixGauge hcut endpointRadius gamma)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat =>
          if rightWholeCellLevel hcut tag i = 0 then
            RealTheory.abs
              (partialTaggedError f
                (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1))
                tag (rightWholeIntegralValue b A J p) i)
          else RealTheory.zero)
        n)
      e0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let level := rightWholeCellLevel hcut tag
  let value := rightWholeIntegralValue b A J p
  let term : Nat -> Point := fun i => RealTheory.abs
    (partialTaggedError f
      (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag value i)
  cases exists_levelFiber_taggedCellSubpartition n level 0 with
  | intro selected hselected =>
      cases hselected with
      | intro index hindex =>
          have hsub := hindex.left
          have hlevel := hindex.right.left
          have hreindex := hindex.right.right term
          have htagB : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
              tag (index j) = b := by
            intro j hj
            exact (rightWholeCellLevel_eq_zero_iff
              hcut tag (index j)).mp (hlevel j hj)
          rw [hreindex]
          by_cases hselectedZero : selected = 0
          next =>
            rw [hselectedZero, RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
            exact he0
          next =>
            have hfirst : 0 < selected := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hselectedZero
            have hcellZero : forall j : Nat,
                j < selected -> Not (j = 0) ->
                  Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength
                    p (index j) = RealTheory.zero := by
              intro j hj hjZero
              let prev := j - 1
              have hprevSucc : prev + 1 = j := by
                dsimp [prev]
                omega
              have hprevLt : prev < selected := by
                dsimp [prev]
                omega
              have hprevNext : prev + 1 < selected := by
                rwa [hprevSucc]
              have hprevRight : p (index prev + 1) = b :=
                Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_tag_eq_right_endpoint_cell_right
                    hfine.left (hsub.left prev hprevLt)
                    (htagB prev hprevLt)
              have hrightLe : RealTheory.le
                  (p (index prev + 1)) (p (index j)) := by
                have hindexLe : index prev + 1 <= index j := by
                  rw [<- hprevSucc]
                  exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt
                    (hsub.right prev hprevNext)
                exact Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
                    hfine.left.left
                    (index prev + 1) (index j) hindexLe
                    (Nat.le_of_lt (hsub.left j hj))
              have hleftMem :=
                Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
                    hfine.left.left (hsub.left j hj)
              have hleftEq : p (index j) = b :=
                RealTheory.le_antisymm hleftMem.right
                  (by rwa [hprevRight] at hrightLe)
              exact
                Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_right_endpoint_tag_cellLength_eq_zero_of_cell_left
                    hfine.left (hsub.left j hj) (htagB j hj) hleftEq
            have htermZero : forall j : Nat,
                j < selected -> Not (j = 0) ->
                  term (index j) = RealTheory.zero := by
              intro j hj hjZero
              have hrightEq : p (index j + 1) = b :=
                Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_tag_eq_right_endpoint_cell_right
                    hfine.left (hsub.left j hj) (htagB j hj)
              have hleftEq : p (index j) = b := by
                have hz := hcellZero j hj hjZero
                unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength at hz
                have hsubZero :
                    RealTheory.sub b (p (index j)) = RealTheory.zero := by
                  rwa [hrightEq] at hz
                exact
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero
                    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsubZero).symm
              unfold term value partialTaggedError partialCellLength
              unfold rightWholeIntegralValue
                rightExtendedPrimitive
              simp only [hleftEq, hrightEq, htagB j hj, if_pos]
              let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              change RealTheory.abs
                (F.sub (F.mul (f b) (F.sub b b)) (F.sub A A)) =
                  F.zero
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F b]
              rw [F.mul_zero]
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F A]
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.zero]
              exact RealTheory.abs_zero
            have hsingle :
                RealTheory.finiteSum
                    (fun j : Nat => term (index j)) selected =
                  term (index 0) :=
              RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_single_of_eq_zero_off hfirst (by
                intro j hj hjne
                exact htermZero j hj hjne)
            rw [hsingle]
            let i := index 0
            let c := p i
            have hi : i < n := hsub.left 0 hfirst
            have htagEq : tag i = b := by
              dsimp [i]
              exact htagB 0 hfirst
            have hrightEq : p (i + 1) = b :=
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_tag_eq_right_endpoint_cell_right
                  hfine.left hi htagEq
            have hcMem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c := by
              dsimp [c, i]
              exact Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
                  hfine.left.left hi
            by_cases hcEq : c = b
            next =>
              have hcEq' : p i = b := by simpa [c] using hcEq
              have htermEq : term i = RealTheory.zero := by
                unfold term value partialTaggedError partialCellLength
                unfold rightWholeIntegralValue
                  rightExtendedPrimitive
                simp only [hcEq', hrightEq, htagEq, if_pos]
                let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                change RealTheory.abs
                  (F.sub (F.mul (f b) (F.sub b b)) (F.sub A A)) =
                    F.zero
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F b]
                rw [F.mul_zero]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F A]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.zero]
                exact RealTheory.abs_zero
              dsimp [i] at htermEq
              rw [htermEq]
              exact he0
            next =>
              have hcb : RealTheory.lt c b :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hcMem.right
                  (fun hbc => hcEq
                    (RealTheory.le_antisymm hcMem.right hbc))
              have hcellLeft : PartitionCell p i c := by
                dsimp [c]
                exact intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hfine.left.left hi
              have hfineLeft := hfine.right i hi c hcellLeft
              have hsmall :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b c) endpointRadius := by
                have hdistEq : RealFunction.dist c b =
                    RealTheory.sub b c := by
                  calc
                    RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub c b) =
                        RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b c) :=
                      RealTheory.abs_sub_comm c b
                    _ = RealTheory.sub b c :=
                      RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le
                          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hcMem.right)
                rw [htagEq,
                  rightNestedPrefixGauge_at_endpoint hcut gamma,
                  hdistEq] at hfineLeft
                exact hfineLeft
              have hmul := hendpoint c hcMem.right hsmall
              have hlim := hlimit c hcMem.left hcb hsmall
              have htri := RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
                (RealTheory.mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b c))
                (RealTheory.sub (J c) A)
              have hadd : RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (RealTheory.mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b c)))
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (J c) A))) e0 := by
                have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hmul hlim
                let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                change F.lt
                  (F.add
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (RealTheory.mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b c)))
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (J c) A)))
                  (F.add ehalf ehalf) at h
                change F.add ehalf ehalf = e0 at hsplit
                rw [hsplit] at h
                exact h
              have hbound := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base htri hadd
              have herrorEq : term i =
                  RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b c))
                      (RealTheory.sub (J c) A)) := by
                unfold term value
                change
                  RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (RealTheory.mul (f (tag i))
                        (RealTheory.sub (p (i + 1)) (p i)))
                      (RealTheory.sub
                        (rightExtendedPrimitive b A J (p (i + 1)))
                        (rightExtendedPrimitive b A J (p i)))) = _
                rw [htagEq, hrightEq]
                change
                  RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (RealTheory.mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b c))
                      (RealTheory.sub
                        (rightExtendedPrimitive b A J b)
                        (rightExtendedPrimitive b A J c))) = _
                simp only [rightExtendedPrimitive, hcEq, if_pos]
                let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                change
                  RealTheory.abs
                    (F.sub (F.mul (f b) (F.sub b c))
                      (F.sub A (J c))) =
                    RealTheory.abs
                      (F.add (F.mul (f b) (F.sub b c))
                        (F.sub (J c) A))
                rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F A (J c)]
              dsimp [i] at herrorEq
              rw [herrorEq]
              exact hbound

name: exists_rightEndpointOneCellRadius
statement:
private theorem exists_rightEndpointOneCellRadius
    (f : Point -> Point) (b : Point) {eps : Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists (fun eta : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
        (forall c : Point,
          RealTheory.le c b ->
            RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b c) eta ->
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b c))) eps))
proof:
:= by
  cases
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (f b) heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      refine Exists.intro eta ?_
      refine And.intro heta.left ?_
      intro c hcb hsmall
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hlenNonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b c) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hcb
      have hmulLe :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.abs (f b)) (RealTheory.sub b c))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f b)) eta) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsmall)
          (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f b))
      have habsSub :
          RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b c) = RealTheory.sub b c :=
        RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hlenNonneg
      have habsMul :
          RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b c)) =
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.abs (f b)) (RealTheory.sub b c) := by
        have hraw := RealTheory.abs_mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b c)
        change
          RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b c)) =
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.abs (f b))
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b c)) at hraw
        rw [habsSub] at hraw
        exact hraw
      rw [habsMul]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hmulLe heta.right

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_hasRightEndpointHakeLimit_core
statement:
private theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_hasRightEndpointHakeLimit_core
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hhake : HasRightEndpointHakeLimit f a b A) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases hhake with
  | intro J hJ =>
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hvalues := hJ.left
      have htends := hJ.right
      refine And.intro
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab) ?_
      intro eps heps
      let cut := rightCanonicalCofinalCut a b
      have hcut : RightCofinalCutFamily a b cut := by
        dsimp [cut]
        exact rightCanonicalCofinalCutFamily hab
      let e0 := RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.baseTail 2 1)
      have he0 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e0 := by
        dsimp [e0]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F heps
          (RealTheory.baseTail_pos validBase_two 1)
      let ehalf := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F e0
      have hehalf : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero ehalf :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F he0
      have hsplit : RealTheory.add ehalf ehalf = e0 := by
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F e0
      cases exists_rightEndpointOneCellRadius f b hehalf with
      | intro endpointEta hendpointEta =>
          cases htends ehalf hehalf with
          | intro limitEta hlimitEta =>
              let endpointRadius := RealTheory.min endpointEta limitEta
              have hendpointRadius :
                  RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero endpointRadius := by
                dsimp [endpointRadius]
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
                  hendpointEta.left hlimitEta.left
              have hendpoint : forall c : Point,
                  RealTheory.le c b ->
                    RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.sub b c) endpointRadius ->
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.abs
                          (RealTheory.mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b c)))
                        ehalf := by
                intro c hcb hsmall
                exact hendpointEta.right c hcb
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsmall
                    (RealTheory.min_le_left endpointEta limitEta))
              have hlimit : forall c : Point,
                  RealTheory.le a c ->
                    RealTheory.lt c b ->
                      RealTheory.lt
                          (RealTheory.sub b c) endpointRadius ->
                        RealTheory.lt
                          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (J c) A))
                          ehalf := by
                intro c hac hcb hsmall
                exact hlimitEta.right c hac hcb
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsmall
                    (RealTheory.min_le_right endpointEta limitEta))
              let gamma :=
                rightNestedPrefixAbsGaugeShiftedFamily
                  hvalues hcut heps
              let delta :=
                rightNestedPrefixGauge
                  hcut endpointRadius gamma
              have hgamma : forall k : Nat,
                  ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a (cut k) (gamma k) := by
                intro k
                dsimp [gamma]
                exact
                  (rightNestedPrefixAbsGaugeShiftedFamily_spec
                    hvalues hcut heps k).left
              have hdelta : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta := by
                dsimp [delta]
                exact closedIntervalGaugeOn_rightNestedPrefixGauge
                  hcut hendpointRadius hgamma
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro hdelta ?_
              intro n p tag hfine
              let level := rightWholeCellLevel hcut tag
              let value := rightWholeIntegralValue b A J p
              let term : Nat -> Point := fun i =>
                RealTheory.abs
                  (partialTaggedError f
                    (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1))
                    tag value i)
              have hfine' : GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
                  (rightNestedPrefixGauge
                    hcut endpointRadius gamma) := by
                simpa [delta] using hfine
              have hfiber : forall k : Nat,
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.finiteSum
                      (fun i : Nat =>
                        if level i = k then term i else RealTheory.zero)
                      n)
                    (RealTheory.mul eps
                      (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1))) := by
                intro k
                cases k with
                | zero =>
                    have hz := rightEndpointLevel_absError_lt
                      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (A := A)
                      (endpointRadius := endpointRadius)
                      (e0 := e0) (ehalf := ehalf) (J := J)
                      hcut he0 hsplit hendpoint hlimit hfine'
                    simpa [level, term, value, e0] using hz
                | succ k =>
                    have hs := rightNonEndpointLevel_absError_lt
                      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (A := A)
                      (eps := eps) (endpointRadius := endpointRadius)
                      (J := J) hvalues hcut heps hfine' k
                    simpa [level, term, value, Nat.succ_eq_add_one,
                      Nat.add_assoc] using hs
              have hsum :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.finiteSum term n) eps :=
                finiteSum_lt_of_levelFiber_geometric_bounds heps hfiber
              have habsError :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f
                      (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1))
                      tag value n)
                    eps := by
                simpa [partialTaggedAbsErrorSum, term] using hsum
              have hvalueSum : partialIntegralValueSum value n = A := by
                dsimp [value]
                exact rightWholeIntegralValue_sum
                  hvalues hab hfine.left
              have herrorLe :=
                abs_partialTaggedErrorSum_le_partialTaggedAbsErrorSum
                  f (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1))
                  tag value n
              have herrorEq :
                  partialTaggedErrorSum f
                      (fun j : Nat => p j) (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1))
                      tag value n =
                    RealTheory.sub (taggedSum f p tag n) A := by
                rw [partialTaggedErrorSum_of_taggedPartition]
                rw [hvalueSum]
              rw [herrorEq] at herrorLe
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                herrorLe habsError

name: henstockKurzweilCauchyGaugeOn_left_subinterval_sameGauge
statement:
private theorem henstockKurzweilCauchyGaugeOn_left_subinterval_sameGauge
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b eps : Point} {delta : Point -> Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hdelta : HenstockKurzweilCauchyGaugeOn f a b eps delta) :
    HenstockKurzweilCauchyGaugeOn f a c eps delta
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro
    (closedIntervalGaugeOn_subinterval hdelta.left
      (RealTheory.le_refl a) hcb) ?_
  intro n p tag m q eta hfineP hfineQ
  cases
      exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_completionSides
        (a := a) (c := a) (d := c) (b := b)
        (RealTheory.le_refl a) hac hcb hdelta.left with
  | intro leftCount hleftCount =>
      cases hleftCount with
      | intro left hleft =>
          cases hleft with
          | intro leftTag hleftTag =>
              cases hleftTag with
              | intro rightCount hrightCount =>
                  cases hrightCount with
                  | intro right hright =>
                      cases hright with
                      | intro rightTag hsides =>
                          let wholeP :=
                            adjacentPartition
                              (adjacentPartition left p leftCount)
                              right (leftCount + n)
                          let wholeTagP :=
                            adjacentTags
                              (adjacentTags leftTag tag leftCount)
                              rightTag (leftCount + n)
                          let wholeQ :=
                            adjacentPartition
                              (adjacentPartition left q leftCount)
                              right (leftCount + m)
                          let wholeTagQ :=
                            adjacentTags
                              (adjacentTags leftTag eta leftCount)
                              rightTag (leftCount + m)
                          have hwholeP :
                              GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b
                                ((leftCount + n) + rightCount)
                                wholeP wholeTagP delta := by
                            dsimp [wholeP, wholeTagP]
                            exact
                              gaugeFineTaggedPartition_three_adjacent
                                hsides.left hfineP hsides.right
                          have hwholeQ :
                              GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b
                                ((leftCount + m) + rightCount)
                                wholeQ wholeTagQ delta := by
                            dsimp [wholeQ, wholeTagQ]
                            exact
                              gaugeFineTaggedPartition_three_adjacent
                                hsides.left hfineQ hsides.right
                          have hglobal :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub
                                    (taggedSum f wholeP wholeTagP
                                      ((leftCount + n) + rightCount))
                                    (taggedSum f wholeQ wholeTagQ
                                      ((leftCount + m) + rightCount))))
                                eps :=
                            hdelta.right
                              ((leftCount + n) + rightCount)
                              wholeP wholeTagP
                              ((leftCount + m) + rightCount)
                              wholeQ wholeTagQ
                              hwholeP hwholeQ
                          have hsumP :
                              taggedSum f wholeP wholeTagP
                                  ((leftCount + n) + rightCount) =
                                RealTheory.add
                                  (RealTheory.add
                                    (taggedSum f left leftTag leftCount)
                                    (taggedSum f p tag n))
                                  (taggedSum f right rightTag rightCount) := by
                            dsimp [wholeP, wholeTagP]
                            exact taggedSum_three_adjacent f
                              hsides.left.left hfineP.left
                              hsides.right.left
                          have hsumQ :
                              taggedSum f wholeQ wholeTagQ
                                  ((leftCount + m) + rightCount) =
                                RealTheory.add
                                  (RealTheory.add
                                    (taggedSum f left leftTag leftCount)
                                    (taggedSum f q eta m))
                                  (taggedSum f right rightTag rightCount) := by
                            dsimp [wholeQ, wholeTagQ]
                            exact taggedSum_three_adjacent f
                              hsides.left.left hfineQ.left
                              hsides.right.left
                          rw [hsumP, hsumQ] at hglobal
                          rw [<-
                            sub_add_same_left_right_eq_sub_middle
                              (taggedSum f left leftTag leftCount)
                              (taggedSum f p tag n)
                              (taggedSum f q eta m)
                              (taggedSum f right rightTag rightCount)]
                          exact hglobal

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_left_subinterval_tendsTo_zero
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_left_subinterval_tendsTo_zero
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hA : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b A) :
    forall eps : Point,
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
        Exists
          (fun eta : Point =>
            And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
              (forall c I : Point,
                RealTheory.lt a c ->
                  RealTheory.le c b ->
                    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c a) eta ->
                      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a c I ->
                        RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs I) eps))
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  let e4 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F e2
  have he4 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e4 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F he2
  have hcrit : HenstockKurzweilCauchyOn f a b :=
    henstockKurzweilCauchyOn_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn hA
  cases hcrit.right e4 he4 with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      have hdelta_a : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (delta a) :=
        hdelta.left a (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab)
      cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F (f a) he4 with
      | intro etaMul hetaMul =>
          let eta := RealTheory.min (delta a) etaMul
          have heta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta := by
            dsimp [eta, RealTheory.min]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdelta_a hetaMul.left
          refine Exists.intro eta ?_
          refine And.intro heta_pos ?_
          intro c I hac hcb hsmall hI
          have hac_le : RealTheory.le a c :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hac
          have hsmall_delta :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c a) (delta a) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsmall
              (RealTheory.min_le_left (delta a) etaMul)
          have hsmall_mul :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c a) etaMul :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsmall
              (RealTheory.min_le_right (delta a) etaMul)
          have hright :
              RealTheory.lt c (RealTheory.add a (delta a)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt F hsmall_delta
          let onePartition := twoPointPartition a c
          let oneTag : Nat -> Point := fun _k : Nat => a
          have honeFine :
              GaugeFineTaggedPartition a c 1 onePartition oneTag delta := by
            dsimp [onePartition, oneTag]
            exact
              gaugeFineTaggedPartition_one_of_cell_subset_gaugeBall
                hac_le
                (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hac_le)
                (closedInterval_subset_leftEndpointGaugeBall_of_right_lt
                  hright hdelta_a)
          cases hI.right e2 he2 with
          | intro deltaI hdeltaI =>
              let deltaMin : Point -> Point :=
                fun x : Point => RealTheory.min (deltaI x) (delta x)
              have hdeltaGlobalLocal : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a c delta :=
                closedIntervalGaugeOn_subinterval hdelta.left
                  (RealTheory.le_refl a) hcb
              have hdeltaMin : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a c deltaMin := by
                dsimp [deltaMin]
                exact closedIntervalGaugeOn_min
                  hdeltaI.left hdeltaGlobalLocal
              cases
                  exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_closedIntervalGaugeOn
                    hac_le hdeltaMin with
              | intro n hn =>
                  cases hn with
                  | intro p hp =>
                      cases hp with
                      | intro tag hfineMin =>
                          have hfineI :
                              GaugeFineTaggedPartition a c n p tag deltaI :=
                            gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le
                              hfineMin
                              (fun x : Point =>
                                RealTheory.min_le_left (deltaI x) (delta x))
                          have hfineGlobal :
                              GaugeFineTaggedPartition a c n p tag delta :=
                            gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le
                              hfineMin
                              (fun x : Point =>
                                RealTheory.min_le_right (deltaI x) (delta x))
                          let S := taggedSum f p tag n
                          let T := taggedSum f onePartition oneTag 1
                          have hlocal :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I)) e2 := by
                            dsimp [S]
                            exact hdeltaI.right n p tag hfineI
                          have hleftCauchy :
                              HenstockKurzweilCauchyGaugeOn f a c e4 delta :=
                            henstockKurzweilCauchyGaugeOn_left_subinterval_sameGauge
                              hac_le hcb hdelta
                          have hcauchy :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub T S)) e4 := by
                            dsimp [S, T]
                            exact hleftCauchy.right
                              1 onePartition oneTag
                              n p tag honeFine hfineGlobal
                          have hlen_nonneg :
                              RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
                                (RealTheory.sub c a) :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hac)
                          have honeValue :
                              T =
                                RealTheory.mul (f a)
                                  (RealTheory.sub c a) := by
                            dsimp [T, onePartition, oneTag]
                            change
                              taggedSum f
                                  (twoPointPartition a c)
                                  (fun _k : Nat => a) 1 =
                                RealTheory.mul (f a)
                                  (RealTheory.sub c a)
                            rw [taggedSum_one_eq_partialTaggedTerm
                              f (fun _k : Nat => a)
                                (fun _k : Nat => c)
                                (fun _k : Nat => a) 0]
                            rfl
                          have honeSmall :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub T RealTheory.zero)) e4 := by
                            rw [honeValue]
                            change
                              F.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (F.sub
                                    (F.mul (f a) (F.sub c a))
                                    F.zero))
                                e4
                            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F
                              (F.mul (f a) (F.sub c a))]
                            rw [RealTheory.abs_mul (f a) (F.sub c a)]
                            change
                              F.lt
                                (RealTheory.mul
                                  (RealTheory.abs (f a))
                                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub c a)))
                                e4
                            rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hlen_nonneg]
                            have hmul_le :
                                RealTheory.le
                                  (RealTheory.mul
                                    (RealTheory.abs (f a))
                                    (RealTheory.sub c a))
                                  (RealTheory.mul
                                    (RealTheory.abs (f a)) etaMul) :=
                              RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                                  F hsmall_mul)
                                (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f a))
                            exact
                              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                F hmul_le hetaMul.right
                          have htriS :=
                            RealFunction.dist_triangle S T RealTheory.zero
                          rw [RealFunction.dist_comm S T] at htriS
                          have hsumS :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub T S))
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (RealTheory.sub T RealTheory.zero)))
                                e2 := by
                            have hadd :=
                              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                                F hcauchy honeSmall
                            rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F e2]
                              at hadd
                          have hSsmall :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub S RealTheory.zero)) e2 :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                              F htriS hsumS
                          have htriI :=
                            RealFunction.dist_triangle I S RealTheory.zero
                          rw [RealFunction.dist_comm I S] at htriI
                          have hsumI :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I))
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (RealTheory.sub S RealTheory.zero)))
                                eps := by
                            have hadd :=
                              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                                F hlocal hSsmall
                            rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps]
                              at hadd
                          have hIzero :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub I RealTheory.zero)) eps :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                              F htriI hsumI
                          change F.lt (RealTheory.abs I) eps
                          rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F I]
                          exact hIzero

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_right_subinterval_tendsTo_zero
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_right_subinterval_tendsTo_zero
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hA : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b A) :
    forall eps : Point,
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
        Exists
          (fun eta : Point =>
            And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
              (forall c I : Point,
                RealTheory.le a c ->
                  RealTheory.lt c b ->
                    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b c) eta ->
                      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f c b I ->
                        RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs I) eps))
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  let e4 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F e2
  have he4 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e4 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F he2
  have hcrit : HenstockKurzweilCauchyOn f a b :=
    henstockKurzweilCauchyOn_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn hA
  cases hcrit.right e4 he4 with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      have hdelta_b : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (delta b) :=
        hdelta.left b (And.intro hab (RealTheory.le_refl b))
      cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F (f b) he4 with
      | intro etaMul hetaMul =>
          let eta := RealTheory.min (delta b) etaMul
          have heta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta := by
            dsimp [eta, RealTheory.min]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdelta_b hetaMul.left
          refine Exists.intro eta ?_
          refine And.intro heta_pos ?_
          intro c I hac hcb hsmall hI
          have hcb_le : RealTheory.le c b :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hcb
          have hsmall_delta :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b c) (delta b) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsmall
              (RealTheory.min_le_left (delta b) etaMul)
          have hsmall_mul :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b c) etaMul :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsmall
              (RealTheory.min_le_right (delta b) etaMul)
          have hleft :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b (delta b)) c :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right F hsmall_delta
          let onePartition := twoPointPartition c b
          let oneTag : Nat -> Point := fun _k : Nat => b
          have honeFine :
              GaugeFineTaggedPartition c b 1 onePartition oneTag delta := by
            dsimp [onePartition, oneTag]
            exact
              gaugeFineTaggedPartition_one_of_cell_subset_gaugeBall
                hcb_le
                (And.intro hcb_le (RealTheory.le_refl b))
                (closedInterval_subset_rightEndpointGaugeBall_of_left_gt
                  hleft hdelta_b)
          cases hI.right e2 he2 with
          | intro deltaI hdeltaI =>
              let deltaMin : Point -> Point :=
                fun x : Point => RealTheory.min (deltaI x) (delta x)
              have hdeltaGlobalLocal : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn c b delta :=
                closedIntervalGaugeOn_subinterval hdelta.left
                  hac (RealTheory.le_refl b)
              have hdeltaMin : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn c b deltaMin := by
                dsimp [deltaMin]
                exact closedIntervalGaugeOn_min
                  hdeltaI.left hdeltaGlobalLocal
              cases
                  exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_closedIntervalGaugeOn
                    hcb_le hdeltaMin with
              | intro n hn =>
                  cases hn with
                  | intro p hp =>
                      cases hp with
                      | intro tag hfineMin =>
                          have hfineI :
                              GaugeFineTaggedPartition c b n p tag deltaI :=
                            gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le
                              hfineMin
                              (fun x : Point =>
                                RealTheory.min_le_left (deltaI x) (delta x))
                          have hfineGlobal :
                              GaugeFineTaggedPartition c b n p tag delta :=
                            gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le
                              hfineMin
                              (fun x : Point =>
                                RealTheory.min_le_right (deltaI x) (delta x))
                          let S := taggedSum f p tag n
                          let T := taggedSum f onePartition oneTag 1
                          have hlocal :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I)) e2 := by
                            dsimp [S]
                            exact hdeltaI.right n p tag hfineI
                          have hrightCauchy :
                              HenstockKurzweilCauchyGaugeOn f c b e4 delta :=
                            henstockKurzweilCauchyGaugeOn_right_subinterval_sameGauge
                              hac hcb_le hdelta
                          have hcauchy :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub T S)) e4 := by
                            dsimp [S, T]
                            exact hrightCauchy.right
                              1 onePartition oneTag
                              n p tag honeFine hfineGlobal
                          have hlen_nonneg :
                              RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
                                (RealTheory.sub b c) :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hcb)
                          have honeValue :
                              T =
                                RealTheory.mul (f b)
                                  (RealTheory.sub b c) := by
                            dsimp [T, onePartition, oneTag]
                            change
                              taggedSum f
                                  (twoPointPartition c b)
                                  (fun _k : Nat => b) 1 =
                                RealTheory.mul (f b)
                                  (RealTheory.sub b c)
                            rw [taggedSum_one_eq_partialTaggedTerm
                              f (fun _k : Nat => c)
                                (fun _k : Nat => b)
                                (fun _k : Nat => b) 0]
                            rfl
                          have honeSmall :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub T RealTheory.zero)) e4 := by
                            rw [honeValue]
                            change
                              F.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (F.sub
                                    (F.mul (f b) (F.sub b c))
                                    F.zero))
                                e4
                            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F
                              (F.mul (f b) (F.sub b c))]
                            rw [RealTheory.abs_mul (f b) (F.sub b c)]
                            change
                              F.lt
                                (RealTheory.mul
                                  (RealTheory.abs (f b))
                                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b c)))
                                e4
                            rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hlen_nonneg]
                            have hmul_le :
                                RealTheory.le
                                  (RealTheory.mul
                                    (RealTheory.abs (f b))
                                    (RealTheory.sub b c))
                                  (RealTheory.mul
                                    (RealTheory.abs (f b)) etaMul) :=
                              RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                                  F hsmall_mul)
                                (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f b))
                            exact
                              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                F hmul_le hetaMul.right
                          have htriS :=
                            RealFunction.dist_triangle S T RealTheory.zero
                          rw [RealFunction.dist_comm S T] at htriS
                          have hsumS :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub T S))
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (RealTheory.sub T RealTheory.zero)))
                                e2 := by
                            have hadd :=
                              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                                F hcauchy honeSmall
                            rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F e2]
                              at hadd
                          have hSsmall :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub S RealTheory.zero)) e2 :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                              F htriS hsumS
                          have htriI :=
                            RealFunction.dist_triangle I S RealTheory.zero
                          rw [RealFunction.dist_comm I S] at htriI
                          have hsumI :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I))
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (RealTheory.sub S RealTheory.zero)))
                                eps := by
                            have hadd :=
                              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                                F hlocal hSsmall
                            rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps]
                              at hadd
                          have hIzero :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub I RealTheory.zero)) eps :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                              F htriI hsumI
                          change F.lt (RealTheory.abs I) eps
                          rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F I]
                          exact hIzero

    HasLeftEndpointHakeLimit f a b A
proof:
:= by

  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let J : Point -> Point :=
    fun c : Point =>
      if hc : And (RealTheory.lt a c) (RealTheory.le c b) then
        Classical.choose
          (exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_subinterval
            (f := f) (a := a) (c := c) (d := b) (b := b) (I := A)
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hc.left)
            hc.right
            (RealTheory.le_refl b)
            hA)
      else RealTheory.zero
  have hJ_spec :
      forall c : Point,
        RealTheory.lt a c ->
          RealTheory.le c b ->
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f c b (J c) := by
    intro c hac hcb
    have hc : And (RealTheory.lt a c) (RealTheory.le c b) :=

    have hwitness :
        Exists (fun V : Point => HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f c b V) :=

        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hac)
        hcb
        (RealTheory.le_refl b)
        hA
    dsimp [J]
    simp [hc]
    exact Classical.choose_spec hwitness
  refine Exists.intro J ?_
  refine And.intro hJ_spec ?_
  intro eps heps
  cases
      hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_left_subinterval_tendsTo_zero
        hab hA eps heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      refine Exists.intro eta ?_
      refine And.intro heta.left ?_
      intro c hac hcb hsmall
      have hac_le : RealTheory.le a c :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hac
      have hJc : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f c b (J c) :=
        hJ_spec c hac hcb
      cases
          exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_subinterval
            (f := f) (a := a) (c := a) (d := c) (b := b) (I := A)
            (RealTheory.le_refl a) hac_le hcb hA with
      | intro I hI =>
          have hI_small :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs I) eps :=
            heta.right c I hac hcb hsmall hI
          have hsum :
              A = RealTheory.add I (J c) :=
            hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_eq_add_of_adjacent_ordered
              (f := f) (a := a) (c := c) (b := b)
              (K := A) (I := I) (J := J c)
              hac_le hcb hA hI hJc
          have hI_eq : I = RealTheory.sub A (J c) :=
            RealTheory.eq_sub_of_eq_add_right hsum
          change F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (J c) A)) eps

          change F.lt (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub A (J c))) eps
          rw [<- hI_eq]
          exact hI_small

private def cutCellJoinedPartition
    (p : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (c : Point) : Nat -> Point
proof:
:=
  adjacentPartition
    (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
    (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)

name: cutCellJoinedPartition_blockRefines
statement:
private theorem cutCellJoinedPartition_blockRefines
    {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat} {c : Point}
    (hk : k < n) :
    PartitionBlockRefines
      (cutCellJoinedPartition p k c) (n + 1) p n
      (singleCutBlockCut k)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · unfold singleCutBlockCut
    rw [if_pos (Nat.zero_le k)]
  · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · unfold singleCutBlockCut
      rw [if_neg (Nat.not_le_of_lt hk)]
    · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · intro i hi
        unfold singleCutBlockCut
        by_cases hik : i <= k
        · rw [if_pos hik]
          unfold cutCellJoinedPartition
          rw [adjacentPartition_left_of_lt]
          · exact
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellPrefixPartition_of_le
                p k c hik
          · omega
        · rw [if_neg hik]
          unfold cutCellJoinedPartition
          rw [adjacentPartition_right_of_le]
          · cases i with
            | zero => exact False.elim (hik (Nat.zero_le k))
            | succ i =>
                have hki : k <= i := by omega
                have hsub : i + 1 + 1 - (k + 1) = (i - k) + 1 := by
                  omega
                rw [hsub]
                rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_succ]
                congr 1
                omega
          · omega
      · intro i hi
        unfold singleCutBlockCut
        by_cases hik : i < k
        · rw [if_pos (Nat.le_of_lt hik)]
          rw [if_pos (by omega : i + 1 <= k)]
          omega
        · by_cases hik_eq : i = k
          · subst i
            rw [if_pos (Nat.le_refl k)]
            rw [if_neg (Nat.not_succ_le_self k)]
            omega
          · have hki : k < i := by omega
            rw [if_neg (by omega : Not (i <= k))]
            rw [if_neg (by omega : Not (i + 1 <= k))]
            omega

name: cutCellJoinedTags_ownership
statement:
private theorem cutCellJoinedTags_ownership
    {a c : Point} {p tag : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}
    (hk : k < n)
    (hprefix :
      TaggedPartition a c (k + 1)
        (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
        (cutCellPrefixTags tag k c))
    (hc : PartitionCell p k c)
    (htag : tag k = c) :
    RefinementTagOwnership
      (cutCellJoinedPartition p k c)
      (cutCellJoinedTags tag k c)
      p tag (n + 1) n
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  by_cases hjleft : j < k + 1
  · by_cases hjk : j < k
    · refine Exists.intro j ?_
      refine And.intro (Nat.lt_trans hjk hk) ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · unfold cutCellJoinedTags
        rw [adjacentTags_left_of_lt _ _ hjleft]
        exact cutCellPrefixTags_of_ne (by omega)
      · intro x hx
        have hxPrefix :
            PartitionCell (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c) j x :=
          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionCell_adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
            hprefix.left
            (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_zero
              p k c)
            hjleft).mp hx
        exact
          (partitionCell_cutCellPrefixPartition_of_lt p k c x hjk).mp
            hxPrefix
    · have hjk_eq : j = k := by omega
      subst j
      refine Exists.intro k ?_
      refine And.intro hk ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · unfold cutCellJoinedTags
        rw [adjacentTags_left_of_lt _ _ (Nat.lt_succ_self k)]
        rw [cutCellPrefixTags_split]
        exact Eq.symm htag
      · intro x hx
        have hxPrefix :
            PartitionCell (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c) k x :=
          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionCell_adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
            hprefix.left
            (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_zero
              p k c)
            (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).mp hx
        have hxSplit : RealTheory.ClosedInterval (p k) c x :=
          (partitionCell_cutCellPrefixPartition_split p k c x).mp hxPrefix
        exact And.intro hxSplit.left
          (RealTheory.le_trans hxSplit.right
            hc.right)
  · have hjright : k + 1 <= j := Nat.le_of_not_gt hjleft
    by_cases hj_split : j = k + 1
    · subst j
      refine Exists.intro k ?_
      refine And.intro hk ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · unfold cutCellJoinedTags
        rw [adjacentTags_right_of_le _ _ (Nat.le_refl (k + 1))]
        rw [Nat.sub_self]
        rw [cutCellSuffixTags_zero]
        exact Eq.symm htag
      · intro x hx
        have hxSuffix :
            PartitionCell (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c) 0 x := by
          have hright :=
            (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionCell_adjacentPartition_right
              (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
              (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)
              (k + 1) 0 x).mp
          simpa [Nat.add_zero] using hright hx
        have hxSplit : RealTheory.ClosedInterval c (p (k + 1)) x :=
          (partitionCell_cutCellSuffixPartition_zero p k c x).mp hxSuffix
        exact And.intro
          (RealTheory.le_trans hc.left hxSplit.left)
          hxSplit.right
    · have hj_gt : k + 1 < j := by omega
      let r := j - (k + 2)
      have hj_eq : j = (k + 1) + (r + 1) := by
        unfold r
        omega
      have hi_lt : k + r + 1 < n := by
        unfold r
        omega
      refine Exists.intro (k + r + 1) ?_
      refine And.intro hi_lt ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · unfold cutCellJoinedTags
        rw [hj_eq]
        rw [adjacentTags_right_of_le _ _
          (Nat.le_add_right (k + 1) (r + 1))]
        rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
        rw [cutCellSuffixTags_succ]
      · intro x hx
        have hxSuffix :
            PartitionCell (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c) (r + 1) x := by
          rw [hj_eq] at hx
          exact
            (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionCell_adjacentPartition_right
              (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
              (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)
              (k + 1) (r + 1) x).mp hx
        exact
          (partitionCell_cutCellSuffixPartition_succ p k r c x).mp
            hxSuffix

name: exists_splitPointTaggedRefinement_preserving_coarse_tags
statement:
private theorem exists_splitPointTaggedRefinement_preserving_coarse_tags
    (f : Point -> Point)
    {a b c : Point} {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    {delta : Point -> Point}
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (hfine : GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag delta)
    (hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c)
    (hdeltaCut :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.le (delta x)
          (cutAdaptedGauge c delta delta x))
    (htagCut :
      forall i : Nat,
        i < n -> PartitionCell p i c -> tag i = c) :
    SplitPointTaggedRefinementData f delta a b c n p tag
proof:
:= by
  have hfineCut :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
        (cutAdaptedGauge c delta delta) :=
    gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le hfine hdeltaCut
  cases
      exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cutCellSplit_of_pos
        hfineCut hn hc with
  | intro k hkData =>
      have hk : k < n := hkData.left
      have hcell : PartitionCell p k c := hkData.right.left
      have hprefix := hkData.right.right.left
      have hsuffix := hkData.right.right.right
      have htag : tag k = c := htagCut k hk hcell
      have hjoinedRaw :=
        gaugeFineTaggedPartition_adjacent hprefix hsuffix
      have hcount : (k + 1) + (n - k) = n + 1 := by
        omega
      have hjoined :
          GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b (n + 1)
            (cutCellJoinedPartition p k c)
            (cutCellJoinedTags tag k c) delta := by
        unfold cutCellJoinedPartition cutCellJoinedTags
        rw [<- hcount]
        exact hjoinedRaw
      have href :
          PartitionBlockRefines
            (cutCellJoinedPartition p k c) (n + 1) p n
            (singleCutBlockCut k) :=
        cutCellJoinedPartition_blockRefines hk
      have hownership :
          RefinementTagOwnership
            (cutCellJoinedPartition p k c)
            (cutCellJoinedTags tag k c)
            p tag (n + 1) n :=
        cutCellJoinedTags_ownership hk hprefix.left hcell htag
      have holdEndpoints :
          forall i : Nat,
            i <= n ->
              Exists (fun j : Nat =>
                And (j <= n + 1)
                  (cutCellJoinedPartition p k c j = p i)) := by
        intro i hi
        refine Exists.intro (singleCutBlockCut k i) ?_
        exact And.intro
          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right
            href hi)
          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_endpoint
            href hi)
      have hcutEndpoint :
          Exists (fun j : Nat =>
            And (j <= n + 1)
              (cutCellJoinedPartition p k c j = c)) := by
        refine Exists.intro (k + 1) ?_
        refine And.intro (by omega) ?_
        unfold cutCellJoinedPartition
        rw [adjacentPartition_boundary]
        exact
          Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cutCellSuffixPartition_zero
            p k c
      have hsumSplit :=
        taggedSum_cutCellSplit (HKAbsFun f)
          (p := p) (tag := tag) hk htag
      have hsumAdjacent :=
        taggedSum_adjacent (HKAbsFun f) hprefix.left hsuffix.left
      have hsum :
          taggedSum (HKAbsFun f)
              (cutCellJoinedPartition p k c)
              (cutCellJoinedTags tag k c) (n + 1) =
            taggedSum (HKAbsFun f) p tag n := by
        unfold cutCellJoinedPartition cutCellJoinedTags
        rw [<- hcount]
        exact hsumAdjacent.trans hsumSplit.symm
      refine Exists.intro k ?_
      exact And.intro hk
        (And.intro hjoined
          (And.intro href
            (And.intro hownership
              (And.intro holdEndpoints
                (And.intro hcutEndpoint hsum)))))

name: partitionBlockRefines_trans
statement:
private theorem partitionBlockRefines_trans
    {r q p : Nat -> Point} {l m n : Nat}
    {rqCut qpCut : Nat -> Nat}
    (hrq : PartitionBlockRefines r l q m rqCut)
    (hqp : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n qpCut) :
    PartitionBlockRefines r l p n
      (fun i : Nat => rqCut (qpCut i))
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · change rqCut (qpCut 0) = 0
    rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_left hqp]
    exact
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_left hrq
  · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · change rqCut (qpCut n) = l
      rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_right hqp]
      exact
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_right hrq
    · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · intro i hi
        rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_endpoint
          hrq
          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right
            hqp hi)]
        exact
          Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_endpoint
            hqp hi
      · intro i hi
        exact
          Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono
            hrq (qpCut i) (qpCut (i + 1))
            (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono_step
              hqp hi)
            (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right
              hqp (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi))

name: refinementTagOwnership_trans
statement:
private theorem refinementTagOwnership_trans
    {r rTag q qTag p pTag : Nat -> Point} {l m n : Nat}
    (hrq : RefinementTagOwnership r rTag q qTag l m)
    (hqp : RefinementTagOwnership q qTag p pTag m n) :
    RefinementTagOwnership r rTag p pTag l n
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  cases hrq j hj with
  | intro i hi =>
      cases hqp i hi.left with
      | intro h hh =>
          refine Exists.intro h ?_
          refine And.intro hh.left ?_
          refine And.intro (hi.right.left.trans hh.right.left) ?_
          intro x hx
          exact hh.right.right x (hi.right.right x hx)

name: gauge_le_cutAdaptedGauge_self_of_le_cutOne
statement:
private theorem gauge_le_cutAdaptedGauge_self_of_le_cutOne
    {c : Point} {delta : Point -> Point}
    (hcutOne :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.le (delta x)
          (cutAdaptedGauge c
            (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
            (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one) x)) :
    forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.le (delta x) (cutAdaptedGauge c delta delta x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  classical
  by_cases hxc : x = c
  · unfold cutAdaptedGauge
    rw [if_pos hxc]
    exact RealTheory.le_min
      (RealTheory.le_refl (delta x))
      (RealTheory.le_refl (delta x))
  · have hdist : RealTheory.le (delta x) (RealFunction.dist x c) :=
      RealTheory.le_trans (hcutOne x)
        (cutAdaptedGauge_le_dist_of_ne hxc)
    unfold cutAdaptedGauge
    rw [if_neg hxc]
    by_cases hle : RealTheory.le x c
    · rw [if_pos hle]
      exact RealTheory.le_min (RealTheory.le_refl (delta x)) hdist
    · rw [if_neg hle]
      exact RealTheory.le_min (RealTheory.le_refl (delta x)) hdist
