name: finiteAnchorRefinementInvariant_zero
proof:
:= by
  have href :
      PartitionBlockRefines original originalCount
        original originalCount (fun i : Nat => i) := by
    exact And.intro rfl
      (And.intro rfl
        (And.intro
          (fun _i _hi => rfl)
          (fun i _hi => Nat.le_succ i)))
  have hownership :
      RefinementTagOwnership
        original originalTag original originalTag
        originalCount originalCount := by
    intro j hj

      (And.intro hj
        (And.intro rfl (fun _x hx => hx)))

  refine Exists.intro original ?_
  refine Exists.intro originalTag ?_
  refine Exists.intro (fun i : Nat => i) ?_

name: finiteAnchorRefinementInvariant_succ
statement:
private theorem finiteAnchorRefinementInvariant_succ
    (f : Point -> Point)
    {a b : Point} {anchor : Nat -> Point} {anchorCount : Nat}
    {originalCount : Nat} {original originalTag : Nat -> Point}
    {delta : Point -> Point} {i : Nat}
    (hab_ne : Not (a = b))
    (hanchor : IntervalPartition a b anchorCount anchor)
    (hi : i < anchorCount - 1)
    (hdeltaAnchor :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.le (delta x)
          (cutAdaptedGauge (anchor (i + 1))
            (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
            (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one) x))
    (hinvariant :
      FiniteAnchorRefinementInvariant f delta a b anchor
        originalCount original originalTag i) :
    FiniteAnchorRefinementInvariant f delta a b anchor
      originalCount original originalTag (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold FiniteAnchorRefinementInvariant at hinvariant
  cases hinvariant with
  | intro refinedCount hcount =>
      cases hcount with
      | intro refined hrefined =>
          cases hrefined with
          | intro refinedTag htagged =>
              cases htagged with
              | intro originalCut hstate =>
                  have href := hstate.left
                  have hownership := hstate.right.left
                  have hendpoints := hstate.right.right.left
                  have hfine := hstate.right.right.right.left
                  have hsum := hstate.right.right.right.right
                  let c := anchor (i + 1)
                  have hicount : i + 1 <= anchorCount := by
                    omega
                  have hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c := by
                    unfold c
                    exact
                      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval
                        hanchor hicount
                  have hrefinedPos : 0 < refinedCount :=
                    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_count_pos_of_endpoints_ne
                      hfine.left.left hab_ne
                  have htagCut :
                      forall j : Nat,
                        j < refinedCount ->
                          PartitionCell refined j c -> refinedTag j = c := by
                    intro j hj hcell
                    have hfineAnchor :
                        GaugeFineCell refined refinedTag
                          (cutAdaptedGauge c
                            (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
                            (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)) j :=
                      gaugeFineCell_of_gauge_le
                        (hfine.right j hj)
                        (by
                          unfold c
                          exact hdeltaAnchor (refinedTag j))
                    exact
                      gaugeFineCell_cutAdaptedGauge_tag_eq_of_mem_cut
                        hfineAnchor hcell
                  have hdeltaSelf :
                      forall x : Point,
                        RealTheory.le (delta x)
                          (cutAdaptedGauge c delta delta x) :=
                    gauge_le_cutAdaptedGauge_self_of_le_cutOne hdeltaAnchor
                  have hsplit :=
                    exists_splitPointTaggedRefinement_preserving_coarse_tags
                      f hrefinedPos hfine hc hdeltaSelf htagCut
                  unfold SplitPointTaggedRefinementData at hsplit
                  cases hsplit with
                  | intro k hnew =>
                      have hk := hnew.left
                      have hnewFine := hnew.right.left
                      have hnewRefines := hnew.right.right.left
                      have hnewOwnership := hnew.right.right.right.left
                      have holdEndpoints :=
                        hnew.right.right.right.right.left
                      have hcutEndpoint :=
                        hnew.right.right.right.right.right.left
                      have hnewSum :=
                        hnew.right.right.right.right.right.right
                      let newPartition :=
                        cutCellJoinedPartition refined k c
                      let newTag := cutCellJoinedTags refinedTag k c
                      let newOriginalCut :=
                        fun r : Nat => singleCutBlockCut k (originalCut r)
                      have hcomposedRefines :
                          PartitionBlockRefines
                            newPartition (refinedCount + 1)
                            original originalCount newOriginalCut := by
                        unfold newPartition newOriginalCut
                        exact
                          partitionBlockRefines_trans hnewRefines href
                      have hcomposedOwnership :
                          RefinementTagOwnership
                            newPartition newTag original originalTag
                            (refinedCount + 1) originalCount := by
                        unfold newPartition newTag
                        exact refinementTagOwnership_trans
                          hnewOwnership hownership
                      have hprocessed :
                          forall j : Nat,
                            j < i + 1 ->
                              Exists (fun r : Nat =>
                                And (r <= refinedCount + 1)
                                  (newPartition r = anchor (j + 1))) := by
                        intro j hj
                        by_cases hji : j < i
                        · cases hendpoints j hji with
                          | intro r hr =>
                              cases holdEndpoints r hr.left with
                              | intro s hs =>
                                  refine Exists.intro s ?_
                                  exact And.intro hs.left
                                    (hs.right.trans hr.right)
                        · have hji_eq : j = i := by omega
                          subst j
                          unfold c at hcutEndpoint
                          exact hcutEndpoint
                      unfold FiniteAnchorRefinementInvariant
                      refine Exists.intro (refinedCount + 1) ?_
                      refine Exists.intro newPartition ?_
                      refine Exists.intro newTag ?_
                      refine Exists.intro newOriginalCut ?_
                      exact And.intro hcomposedRefines
                        (And.intro hcomposedOwnership
                          (And.intro hprocessed
                            (And.intro hnewFine
                              (hnewSum.trans hsum))))

name: exists_finiteAnchorTaggedRefinement_preserving_supportData
statement:
private theorem exists_finiteAnchorTaggedRefinement_preserving_supportData
    (f : Point -> Point)
    {a b : Point} {anchor : Nat -> Point} {anchorCount : Nat}
    {originalCount : Nat} {original originalTag : Nat -> Point}
    {delta : Point -> Point}
    (hab_ne : Not (a = b))
    (hanchor : IntervalPartition a b anchorCount anchor)
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b originalCount
        original originalTag delta)
    (hdeltaAnchor :
      forall j : Nat,
        j < anchorCount - 1 ->
          forall x : Point,
            RealTheory.le (delta x)
              (cutAdaptedGauge (anchor (j + 1))
                (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
                (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one) x)) :
    FiniteAnchorRefinementInvariant f delta a b anchor
      originalCount original originalTag (anchorCount - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hall :
      forall r : Nat,
        r <= anchorCount - 1 ->
          FiniteAnchorRefinementInvariant f delta a b anchor
            originalCount original originalTag r := by
    intro r hr
    induction r with
    | zero =>
        exact finiteAnchorRefinementInvariant_zero f hfine
    | succ r ih =>
        exact finiteAnchorRefinementInvariant_succ f
          hab_ne hanchor (by omega)
          (hdeltaAnchor r (by omega))
          (ih (by omega))
  exact hall (anchorCount - 1) (Nat.le_refl (anchorCount - 1))

name: abs_absoluteTaggedCell_sub_variationCell_le_error
statement:
private theorem abs_absoluteTaggedCell_sub_variationCell_le_error
    (f primitive : Point -> Point)
    {a b : Point} {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htagged : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f (tag k)))
            (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength p k))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (primitive (p (k + 1))) (primitive (p k))))))
      (RealTheory.abs
        (partialTaggedError f p (fun j : Nat => p (j + 1)) tag
          (fun j : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub
              (primitive (p (j + 1))) (primitive (p j))) k))
proof:
:= by
  have hreverse := RealTheory.abs_abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub
    (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k))
      (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength p k))
    (RealTheory.sub
      (primitive (p (k + 1))) (primitive (p k)))
  let OF := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    OF.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (OF.sub
          (RealTheory.abs
            (OF.mul (f (tag k))
              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength p k)))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (OF.sub
              (primitive (p (k + 1))) (primitive (p k))))))
      (RealTheory.abs
        (OF.sub
          (OF.mul (f (tag k))
            (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength p k))
          (OF.sub
            (primitive (p (k + 1))) (primitive (p k))))) at hreverse
  rw [RealTheory.abs_mul,
    RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg
      (cellLength_nonnegative htagged.left hk)] at hreverse
  unfold partialTaggedError partialCellLength
  unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength
  exact hreverse

name: abs_absoluteTaggedSum_sub_partitionVariation_le_absErrorSum
statement:
private theorem abs_absoluteTaggedSum_sub_partitionVariation_le_absErrorSum
    (f primitive : Point -> Point)
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htagged : TaggedPartition a b n p tag) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (taggedSum (HKAbsFun f) p tag n)
          (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
            primitive p n)))
      (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f p (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) tag
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (primitive (p (k + 1))) (primitive (p k))) n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold taggedSum HKAbsFun
  unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLengthTagSum
  unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedTagSum
  unfold Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
  unfold Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm
  unfold partialTaggedAbsErrorSum
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_sub]
  exact RealTheory.le_trans
    (RealTheory.abs_finiteSum_le_finiteSum_abs _ n)
    (RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le _ _ n
      (fun k hk =>
        abs_absoluteTaggedCell_sub_variationCell_le_error
          f primitive htagged hk))

name: exists_partitionBlockRefines_of_endpoint_subsequence
statement:
private theorem exists_partitionBlockRefines_of_endpoint_subsequence
    {a b : Point}
    {refined anchor : Nat -> Point}
    {refinedCount anchorCount : Nat}
    (hrefined : IntervalPartition a b refinedCount refined)
    (hanchor : IntervalPartition a b anchorCount anchor)
    (hanchorCount : 0 < anchorCount)
    (hendpoints :
      forall i : Nat,
        i < anchorCount ->
          Exists (fun j : Nat =>
            And (j <= refinedCount) (refined j = anchor i))) :
    Exists (fun cut : Nat -> Nat =>
      PartitionBlockRefines
        refined refinedCount anchor anchorCount cut)
proof:
:= by
  let first :=
    fun i : Nat =>
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.firstIndexGe
        (anchor i) refined
  have hfirstEndpoint :
      forall i : Nat,
        i < anchorCount -> refined (first i) = anchor i := by
    intro i hi
    cases hendpoints i hi with
    | intro j hj =>
        have hex :
            Exists (fun r : Nat => RealTheory.le (anchor i) (refined r)) :=
          Exists.intro j (by
            rw [hj.right]
            exact RealTheory.le_refl (anchor i))
        have hge : RealTheory.le (anchor i) (refined (first i)) := by
          unfold first
          exact
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.firstIndexGe_spec_of_exists
              hex
        have hfirstLe : first i <= j := by
          unfold first
          apply
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.firstIndexGe_le_of_le
          rw [hj.right]
          exact RealTheory.le_refl (anchor i)
        have hle : RealTheory.le (refined (first i)) (refined j) :=
          Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
            hrefined (first i) j hfirstLe hj.left
        rw [hj.right] at hle
        exact RealTheory.le_antisymm hle hge
  refine Exists.intro
    (endpointSubsequenceCut refined anchor refinedCount anchorCount) ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · unfold endpointSubsequenceCut
    rw [if_pos hanchorCount]
    have hle : first 0 <= 0 := by
      unfold first
      apply
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.firstIndexGe_le_of_le
      rw [intervalPartition_left_endpoint hrefined,
        intervalPartition_left_endpoint hanchor]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl a
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hle
  · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · unfold endpointSubsequenceCut
      rw [if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl anchorCount)]
    · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · intro i hi
        unfold endpointSubsequenceCut
        by_cases hit : i < anchorCount
        · rw [if_pos hit]
          exact hfirstEndpoint i hit
        · have hi_eq : i = anchorCount := by omega
          subst i
          rw [if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl anchorCount)]
          exact
            (intervalPartition_right_endpoint hrefined).trans
              (intervalPartition_right_endpoint hanchor).symm
      · intro i hi
        unfold endpointSubsequenceCut
        rw [if_pos hi]
        by_cases hisucc : i + 1 < anchorCount
        · rw [if_pos hisucc]
          apply
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.firstIndexGe_le_of_le
          have hstep : RealTheory.le (anchor i) (anchor (i + 1)) :=
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_step_le
              hanchor hi
          exact RealTheory.le_trans hstep (by
            rw [hfirstEndpoint (i + 1) hisucc]
            exact RealTheory.le_refl (anchor (i + 1)))
        · rw [if_neg hisucc]
          apply
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.firstIndexGe_le_of_le
          have hle : RealTheory.le (anchor i) (anchor anchorCount) :=
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
              hanchor i anchorCount (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
              (Nat.le_refl anchorCount)
          rw [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hanchor] at hle
          rw [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hrefined]
          exact hle

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_hkAbsFun_totalVariationFrom_of_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_boundedVariationOn
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_hkAbsFun_totalVariationFrom_of_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_boundedVariationOn
    {f primitive : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hprimitive : HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f primitive a b)
    (hBV : Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn
      a b primitive) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn (HKAbsFun f) a b
      (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom
        a primitive b)
proof:
:= by
  have hfull :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b (primitive b) :=
    hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_hasIntegral hprimitive
      (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab)
  by_cases hab_eq : a = b
  · subst b
    rw [Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_self_eq_zero_of_boundedVariationOn
      hBV]
    exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_degenerate (HKAbsFun f) a
  · let OF := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    have hab_lt : RealTheory.lt a b := by
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le OF hab
      intro hba
      exact hab_eq (RealTheory.le_antisymm hab hba)
    let V :=
      Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom
        a primitive b
    change HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn (HKAbsFun f) a b V
    refine And.intro hab ?_
    intro eps heps
    let eta :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half OF
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half OF eps)
    have hepsHalf :
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half OF eps) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos OF heps
    have heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta := by
      unfold eta
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos OF hepsHalf
    have htwoEta :
        RealTheory.add eta eta =
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half OF eps := by
      unfold eta
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half OF
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half OF eps)
    have hhalfLt :
        RealTheory.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half OF eps) eps :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self OF heps
    have htwoEtaLt :
        RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add eta eta) eps := by
      rw [htwoEta]
      exact hhalfLt
    have hetaLt : RealTheory.lt eta eps := by
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans OF
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self OF hepsHalf) hhalfLt
    cases
        Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_exists_partitionVariation_gt_sub
          hab_lt hBV heta with
    | intro anchorCount hanchorCount =>
        cases hanchorCount with
        | intro anchor hanchorData =>
            have hanchorStrict := hanchorData.left
            have hanchor : IntervalPartition a b anchorCount anchor :=
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_intervalPartition
                hanchorStrict
            have hanchorNear := hanchorData.right
            have hanchorCountPos : 0 < anchorCount := hanchorStrict.left
            cases
                exists_henstockAbsErrorSupportGauge_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
                  hab hfull heta with
            | intro supportGauge hsupport =>
                let anchorGauge :=
                  finiteAnchorGauge anchor anchorCount
                let delta :=
                  fun x : Point =>
                    RealTheory.min (supportGauge x) (anchorGauge x)
                have hdelta : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta := by
                  unfold delta
                  exact closedIntervalGaugeOn_min hsupport.left
                    (by
                      unfold anchorGauge
                      exact
                        closedIntervalGaugeOn_finiteAnchorGauge hanchor)
                refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                refine And.intro hdelta ?_
                intro originalCount original originalTag hfineOriginal
                have hdeltaAnchor :
                    forall j : Nat,
                      j < anchorCount - 1 ->
                        forall x : Point,
                          RealTheory.le (delta x)
                            (cutAdaptedGauge (anchor (j + 1))
                              (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
                              (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one) x) := by
                  intro j hj x
                  exact RealTheory.le_trans
                    (RealTheory.min_le_right
                      (supportGauge x) (anchorGauge x))
                    (by
                      unfold anchorGauge
                      exact finiteAnchorGauge_le_cut hj x)
                have hfinite :=
                  exists_finiteAnchorTaggedRefinement_preserving_supportData
                    f hab_eq hanchor hfineOriginal hdeltaAnchor
                unfold FiniteAnchorRefinementInvariant at hfinite
                cases hfinite with
                | intro refinedCount hrefinedCount =>
                    cases hrefinedCount with
                    | intro refined hrefined =>
                        cases hrefined with
                        | intro refinedTag hrefinedTag =>
                            cases hrefinedTag with
                            | intro originalCut hstate =>
                                have _hrefOriginal := hstate.left
                                have _hownership := hstate.right.left
                                have hanchorEndpoints :=
                                  hstate.right.right.left
                                have hfineRefined :=
                                  hstate.right.right.right.left
                                have hsumPreserved :=
                                  hstate.right.right.right.right
                                have hendpoints :
                                    forall i : Nat,
                                      i < anchorCount ->
                                        Exists (fun j : Nat =>
                                          And (j <= refinedCount)
                                            (refined j = anchor i)) := by
                                  intro i hi
                                  cases i with
                                  | zero =>
                                      refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
                                      refine And.intro (Nat.zero_le refinedCount) ?_
                                      exact
                                        (intervalPartition_left_endpoint
                                          hfineRefined.left.left).trans
                                          (intervalPartition_left_endpoint
                                            hanchor).symm
                                  | succ i =>
                                      exact hanchorEndpoints i (by omega)
                                cases
                                    exists_partitionBlockRefines_of_endpoint_subsequence
                                      hfineRefined.left.left hanchor
                                      hanchorCountPos hendpoints with
                                | intro anchorCut hanchorRefines =>
                                    have hanchorVariationLe :
                                        RealTheory.le
                                          (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                            primitive anchor anchorCount)
                                          (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                            primitive refined refinedCount) :=
                                      Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation_le_of_partitionBlockRefines
                                        hanchorRefines
                                    have hvariationLower :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (RealTheory.sub V eta)
                                          (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                            primitive refined refinedCount) :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le OF
                                        hanchorNear hanchorVariationLe
                                    have hvariationUpper :
                                        RealTheory.le
                                          (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                            primitive refined refinedCount)
                                          V := by
                                      unfold V
                                      exact
                                        Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_of_intervalPartition
                                          hBV hfineRefined.left.left
                                    let cellValue :=
                                      fun k : Nat =>
                                        RealTheory.sub
                                          (primitive (refined (k + 1)))
                                          (primitive (refined k))
                                    have hlocalIntegral :
                                        forall k : Nat,
                                          k < refinedCount ->
                                            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f
                                              (refined k) (refined (k + 1))
                                              (cellValue k) := by
                                      intro k hk
                                      unfold cellValue
                                      exact
                                        hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_cell_increment
                                          hprimitive hfineRefined.left.left hk
                                    have hfineSupport :
                                        GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b refinedCount
                                          refined refinedTag supportGauge :=
                                      gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le
                                        hfineRefined
                                        (fun x : Point =>
                                          RealTheory.min_le_left
                                            (supportGauge x) (anchorGauge x))
                                    have herror :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f refined
                                            (fun k : Nat => refined (k + 1))
                                            refinedTag cellValue refinedCount)
                                          eta :=
                                      hsupport.right refinedCount refined
                                        (fun k : Nat => refined (k + 1))
                                        refinedTag cellValue hlocalIntegral
                                        (taggedPartition_partialTaggedDivision
                                          hfineRefined.left)
                                        (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
                                          hfineSupport)
                                    have hsumVariation :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (taggedSum (HKAbsFun f)
                                                refined refinedTag refinedCount)
                                              (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                                primitive refined refinedCount)))
                                          eta :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt OF
                                        (by
                                          unfold cellValue at herror
                                          exact
                                            abs_absoluteTaggedSum_sub_partitionVariation_le_absErrorSum
                                              f primitive hfineRefined.left)
                                        herror
                                    have hsumLower :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (RealTheory.sub
                                            (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                              primitive refined refinedCount)
                                            eta)
                                          (taggedSum (HKAbsFun f)
                                            refined refinedTag refinedCount) :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left OF
                                        hsumVariation
                                    have hsumUpper :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (taggedSum (HKAbsFun f)
                                            refined refinedTag refinedCount)
                                          (RealTheory.add
                                            (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                              primitive refined refinedCount)
                                            eta) :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right OF
                                        hsumVariation
                                    have hvariationLowerShift :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right OF
                                        hvariationLower (RealTheory.neg eta)
                                    have hlowerTwo :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (RealTheory.sub V
                                            (RealTheory.add eta eta))
                                          (taggedSum (HKAbsFun f)
                                            refined refinedTag refinedCount) := by
                                      have hshift :
                                          RealTheory.lt
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (RealTheory.sub V eta) eta)
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                                primitive refined refinedCount)
                                              eta) := by
                                        change
                                          OF.lt
                                            (OF.add (OF.sub V eta) (OF.neg eta))
                                            (OF.add
                                              (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                                primitive refined refinedCount)
                                              (OF.neg eta))
                                        exact hvariationLowerShift
                                      have hsubEq :
                                          RealTheory.sub
                                              (RealTheory.sub V eta) eta =
                                            RealTheory.sub V
                                              (RealTheory.add eta eta) := by
                                        change
                                          OF.sub (OF.sub V eta) eta =
                                            OF.sub V (OF.add eta eta)
                                        exact
                                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add
                                            OF V eta eta
                                      rw [<- hsubEq]
                                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans OF
                                        hshift hsumLower
                                    have hlowerTarget :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (RealTheory.sub V eps)
                                          (taggedSum (HKAbsFun f)
                                            refined refinedTag refinedCount) :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans OF
                                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt
                                          OF htwoEtaLt)
                                        hlowerTwo
                                    have hupperV :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (taggedSum (HKAbsFun f)
                                            refined refinedTag refinedCount)
                                          (RealTheory.add V eta) :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le OF
                                        hsumUpper
                                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_right OF
                                          hvariationUpper eta)
                                    have hupperTarget :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (taggedSum (HKAbsFun f)
                                            refined refinedTag refinedCount)
                                          (RealTheory.add V eps) :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans OF hupperV
                                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left OF
                                          hetaLt V)
                                    have htargetRefined :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (taggedSum (HKAbsFun f)
                                                refined refinedTag refinedCount)
                                              V)) eps :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds
                                        OF hlowerTarget hupperTarget
                                    rw [hsumPreserved] at htargetRefined
                                    exact htargetRefined

name: hkNonnegativeFiniteFamilyValueSum_le
statement:
private theorem hkNonnegativeFiniteFamilyValueSum_le
    {h : Point -> Point} {a b H : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hnonneg : forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (h x))
    (hH : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h a b H)
    {iota : Type u} {l r : iota -> Point} {js : List iota}
    (hfamily : RealFunction.ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js)
    (value : iota -> Point)
    (hvalue : forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h (l i) (r i) (value i)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero (List.map value js)) H
proof:
:= by
  have hmain :
      forall n : Nat,
        forall {a b H : Point} {js : List iota},
          js.length = n ->
            RealTheory.le a b ->
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h a b H ->
                RealFunction.ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js ->
                  (forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
                    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h
                      (l i) (r i) (value i)) ->
                    RealTheory.le
                      (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value js) H := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro a b H js hlen hab hH hfamily hvalue
        cases js with
        | nil =>
            change RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero H
            exact
              hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
                hab hnonneg
                (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_zero_of_le hab) hH
        | cons head tail =>
            cases hlen
    | succ n ih =>
        intro a b H js hlen hab hH hfamily hvalue
        cases js with
        | nil =>
            cases hlen
        | cons head tail =>
            have hnonempty :
                Exists (fun i : iota => List.Mem i (head :: tail)) :=
              Exists.intro head (List.Mem.head tail)
            match
                RealInterval.exists_intervalListHeadDecomposition_of_ordered_disjoint
                  hnonempty hfamily.right.left hfamily.right.right.right with
            | Exists.intro j hj =>
                match hj with
                | Exists.intro rest hrest =>
                    have hperm : List.Perm (head :: tail) (j :: rest) :=
                      hrest.left
                    have hrestOrdered :
                        RealInterval.IntervalListOrdered l r rest :=
                      hrest.right.left
                    have hrestFinite :
                        RealInterval.FiniteDisjointSubfamily l r rest :=
                      hrest.right.right.left
                    have hrestLen : rest.length = n := by
                      have hpermLen := hperm.length_eq
                      simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen hpermLen
                      omega
                    have hmemOriginal :
                        forall i : iota,
                          List.Mem i (j :: rest) ->
                            List.Mem i (head :: tail) := by
                      intro i hi
                      exact hperm.mem_iff.mpr hi
                    have hjOriginal : List.Mem j (head :: tail) :=
                      hmemOriginal j (List.Mem.head rest)
                    have hrestOriginal :
                        forall i : iota, List.Mem i rest ->
                          List.Mem i (head :: tail) := by
                      intro i hi
                      exact hmemOriginal i (List.Mem.tail j hi)
                    have hboundsRest :
                        forall i : iota, List.Mem i rest ->
                          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (l i))
                            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (r i)) := by
                      intro i hi
                      exact hfamily.right.right.left i (hrestOriginal i hi)
                    have hvalueRest :
                        forall i : iota, List.Mem i rest ->
                          HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h
                            (l i) (r i) (value i) := by
                      intro i hi
                      exact hvalue i (hrestOriginal i hi)
                    have hsumPerm :
                        hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value (head :: tail) =
                          hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value (j :: rest) :=
                      hkFiniteFamilyValueSum_eq_of_perm value hperm
                    cases hrest.right.right.right with
                    | inl hjDegenerate =>
                        have hjIntegral :
                            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h
                              (l j) (r j) (value j) :=
                          hvalue j hjOriginal
                        rw [hjDegenerate] at hjIntegral
                        have hjZero : value j = RealTheory.zero :=
                          hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
                            hjIntegral
                            (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_degenerate h (r j))
                        have hfamilyRest :
                            RealFunction.ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r rest :=
                          And.intro hab
                            (And.intro hrestOrdered
                              (And.intro hboundsRest hrestFinite))
                        have htailLe :
                            RealTheory.le
                              (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value rest) H :=
                          ih hrestLen hab hH hfamilyRest hvalueRest
                        rw [hsumPerm]
                        change
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealTheory.add (value j)
                              (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value rest)) H
                        rw [hjZero, RealTheory.zero_add]
                        exact htailLe
                    | inr hseparated =>
                        have hjBounds :=
                          hfamily.right.right.left j hjOriginal
                        have hjOrdered : RealTheory.le (l j) (r j) :=
                          hfamily.right.left j hjOriginal
                        have hjIntegral :
                            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h
                              (l j) (r j) (value j) :=
                          hvalue j hjOriginal
                        cases
                            exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_subinterval
                              (RealTheory.le_refl a) hjBounds.left.left
                              hjBounds.left.right hH with
                        | intro leftValue hleftIntegral =>
                            cases
                                exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_subinterval
                                  hjBounds.right.left hjBounds.right.right
                                  (RealTheory.le_refl b) hH with
                            | intro rightValue hrightIntegral =>
                                have hleftNonneg :
                                    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero leftValue :=
                                  hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
                                    hjBounds.left.left hnonneg
                                    (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_zero_of_le
                                      hjBounds.left.left)
                                    hleftIntegral
                                have hrightNonneg :
                                    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero rightValue :=
                                  hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
                                    hjBounds.right.right hnonneg
                                    (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_zero_of_le
                                      hjBounds.right.right)
                                    hrightIntegral
                                have htailBounds :
                                    forall i : iota, List.Mem i rest ->
                                      And
                                        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (r j) b (l i))
                                        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval (r j) b (r i)) := by
                                  intro i hi
                                  have hiBounds := hboundsRest i hi
                                  have hiOrdered := hrestOrdered i hi
                                  exact
                                    And.intro
                                      (And.intro (hseparated i hi)
                                        hiBounds.left.right)
                                      (And.intro
                                        (RealTheory.le_trans
                                          (hseparated i hi) hiOrdered)
                                        hiBounds.right.right)
                                have htailFamily :
                                    RealFunction.ACIntervalFamilyOn
                                      (r j) b l r rest :=
                                  And.intro hjBounds.right.right
                                    (And.intro hrestOrdered
                                      (And.intro htailBounds hrestFinite))
                                have htailLe :
                                    RealTheory.le
                                      (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value rest)
                                      rightValue :=
                                  ih hrestLen hjBounds.right.right
                                    hrightIntegral htailFamily hvalueRest
                                have hleftHead :
                                    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h a (r j)
                                      (RealTheory.add leftValue (value j)) :=
                                  hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_adjacent_ordered
                                    hjBounds.left.left hjOrdered
                                    hleftIntegral hjIntegral
                                have hcombined :
                                    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h a b
                                      (RealTheory.add
                                        (RealTheory.add leftValue (value j))
                                        rightValue) :=
                                  hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_adjacent_ordered
                                    hjBounds.right.left hjBounds.right.right
                                    hleftHead hrightIntegral
                                have hwhole :
                                    H = RealTheory.add
                                      (RealTheory.add leftValue (value j))
                                      rightValue :=
                                  hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
                                    hH hcombined
                                have hheadTail :
                                    RealTheory.le
                                      (RealTheory.add (value j)
                                        (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value rest))
                                      (RealTheory.add (value j) rightValue) :=
                                  RealTheory.add_le_add_left htailLe (value j)
                                have hinsertLeft :
                                    RealTheory.le
                                      (RealTheory.add (value j) rightValue)
                                      (RealTheory.add
                                        (RealTheory.add leftValue (value j))
                                        rightValue) := by
                                  have hadd :=
                                    RealTheory.add_le_add_right hleftNonneg
                                      (RealTheory.add (value j) rightValue)
                                  rw [RealTheory.zero_add] at hadd
                                  rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc] at hadd
                                  exact hadd
                                rw [hsumPerm]
                                change
                                  RealTheory.le
                                    (RealTheory.add (value j)
                                      (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value rest)) H
                                rw [hwhole]
                                exact RealTheory.le_trans hheadTail hinsertLeft
  change RealTheory.le (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value js) H
  exact hmain js.length rfl hab hH hfamily hvalue

name: hkNonnegativeBoundedFiniteFamilyValueSum_le
statement:
private theorem hkNonnegativeBoundedFiniteFamilyValueSum_le
    {h : Point -> Point} {a b K : Point}
    (hbound : forall x : Point, RealTheory.le (h x) K)
    {iota : Type u} {l r : iota -> Point} {js : List iota}
    (hfamily : RealFunction.ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js)
    (value : iota -> Point)
    (hvalue : forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h (l i) (r i) (value i)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero (List.map value js))
      (RealTheory.mul K (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js))
proof:
:= by
  have hfold :
      forall xs : List iota,
        RealInterval.IntervalListOrdered l r xs ->
          (forall i : iota, List.Mem i xs ->
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h
              (l i) (r i) (value i)) ->
            RealTheory.le
              (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value xs)
              (RealTheory.mul K
                (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r xs)) := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        intro hordered hvalue
        change RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.mul K RealTheory.zero)
        rw [RealTheory.mul_zero]
        exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
    | cons i rest ih =>
        intro hordered hvalue
        have hiOrdered : RealTheory.le (l i) (r i) :=
          hordered i (List.Mem.head rest)
        have hiValue :
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h
              (l i) (r i) (value i) :=
          hvalue i (List.Mem.head rest)
        have hiConst :
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
              (fun _ : Point => K) (l i) (r i)
              (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.sub (r i) (l i))) :=
          hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_const_of_le
            (c := K) hiOrdered
        have hiLe :
            RealTheory.le (value i)
              (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.sub (r i) (l i))) :=
          hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
            hiOrdered hbound hiValue hiConst
        have hrestOrdered :
            RealInterval.IntervalListOrdered l r rest := by
          intro j hj
          exact hordered j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
        have hrestValue :
            forall j : iota, List.Mem j rest ->
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h
                (l j) (r j) (value j) := by
          intro j hj
          exact hvalue j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
        have hrestLe := ih hrestOrdered hrestValue
        change
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.add (value i)
              (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value rest))
            (RealTheory.mul K
              (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub (r i) (l i))
                (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r rest)))
        rw [RealTheory.mul_add]
        exact
          RealTheory.le_trans
            (RealTheory.add_le_add_right hiLe
              (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value rest))
            (RealTheory.add_le_add_left hrestLe
              (RealTheory.mul K (RealTheory.sub (r i) (l i))))
  change
    RealTheory.le (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value js)
      (RealTheory.mul K (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js))
  exact hfold js hfamily.right.left hvalue

name: hkFiniteFamilyValueSum_eq_tail_add_trunc
statement:
private theorem hkFiniteFamilyValueSum_eq_tail_add_trunc
    {h tail trunc : Point -> Point}
    {iota : Type u} {l r : iota -> Point} {js : List iota}
    (hordered : RealInterval.IntervalListOrdered l r js)
    (hdecomp : forall x : Point,
      h x = RealTheory.add (tail x) (trunc x))
    (value tailValue truncValue : iota -> Point)
    (hvalue : forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h (l i) (r i) (value i))
    (htail : forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn tail
        (l i) (r i) (tailValue i))
    (htrunc : forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn trunc
        (l i) (r i) (truncValue i)) :
    Eq
      (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero (List.map value js))
      (RealTheory.add
        (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
          (List.map tailValue js))
        (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
          (List.map truncValue js)))
proof:
:= by
  have hfold :
      forall xs : List iota,
        RealInterval.IntervalListOrdered l r xs ->
          (forall i : iota, List.Mem i xs ->
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h
              (l i) (r i) (value i)) ->
            (forall i : iota, List.Mem i xs ->
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn tail
                (l i) (r i) (tailValue i)) ->
              (forall i : iota, List.Mem i xs ->
                HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn trunc
                  (l i) (r i) (truncValue i)) ->
                hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value xs =
                  RealTheory.add
                    (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum tailValue xs)
                    (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum truncValue xs) := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        intro hordered hvalue htail htrunc
        change RealTheory.zero =
          RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
        rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
    | cons i rest ih =>
        intro hordered hvalue htail htrunc
        have hiOrdered : RealTheory.le (l i) (r i) :=
          hordered i (List.Mem.head rest)
        have hiValue :
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h
              (l i) (r i) (value i) :=
          hvalue i (List.Mem.head rest)
        have hiTail :
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn tail
              (l i) (r i) (tailValue i) :=
          htail i (List.Mem.head rest)
        have hiTrunc :
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn trunc
              (l i) (r i) (truncValue i) :=
          htrunc i (List.Mem.head rest)
        have hiSum :
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
              (fun x : Point => RealTheory.add (tail x) (trunc x))
              (l i) (r i)
              (RealTheory.add (tailValue i) (truncValue i)) :=
          hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_add hiTail hiTrunc
        have hiSumAsH :
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h
              (l i) (r i)
              (RealTheory.add (tailValue i) (truncValue i)) :=
          hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_congr_fun
            (fun x : Point => Eq.symm (hdecomp x)) hiSum
        have hiEq :
            value i = RealTheory.add (tailValue i) (truncValue i) :=
          hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
            hiValue hiSumAsH
        have hrestOrdered :
            RealInterval.IntervalListOrdered l r rest := by
          intro j hj
          exact hordered j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
        have hrestValue :
            forall j : iota, List.Mem j rest ->
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h
                (l j) (r j) (value j) := by
          intro j hj
          exact hvalue j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
        have hrestTail :
            forall j : iota, List.Mem j rest ->
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn tail
                (l j) (r j) (tailValue j) := by
          intro j hj
          exact htail j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
        have hrestTrunc :
            forall j : iota, List.Mem j rest ->
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn trunc
                (l j) (r j) (truncValue j) := by
          intro j hj
          exact htrunc j (List.Mem.tail i hj)
        have hrestEq :=
          ih hrestOrdered hrestValue hrestTail hrestTrunc
        change
          RealTheory.add (value i)
              (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value rest) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add (tailValue i)
                (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum tailValue rest))
              (RealTheory.add (truncValue i)
                (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum truncValue rest))
        rw [hiEq, hrestEq]
        rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
        rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc (truncValue i)
          (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum tailValue rest)
          (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum truncValue rest)]
        rw [RealTheory.add_comm (truncValue i)
          (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum tailValue rest)]
        rw [RealTheory.add_assoc (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum tailValue rest)
          (truncValue i) (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum truncValue rest)]
        rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc]
  change
    hkFiniteFamilyValueSum value js =
      RealTheory.add
        (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum tailValue js)
        (hkFiniteFamilyValueSum truncValue js)
  exact hfold js hordered hvalue htail htrunc

name: hkAbsIntegralFiniteFamilySmall_of_hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn
statement:
theorem hkAbsIntegralFiniteFamilySmall_of_hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hAbs : HKAbsolutelyIntegrableOn f a b) :
    forall eps : Point,
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
        Exists (fun delta : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
            (forall {iota : Type} (l r : iota -> Point)
                (js : List iota),
              RealFunction.ACIntervalFamilyOn a b l r js ->
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js) delta ->
                  Exists (fun value : iota -> Point =>
                    And
                      (forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
                        HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
                          (HKAbsFun f) (l i) (r i) (value i))
                      (RealTheory.lt
                        (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
                          (List.map value js))
                        eps))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let h : Point -> Point := HKAbsFun f
  have hnonneg : forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (h x) := by
    intro x
    dsimp [h, HKAbsFun]
    exact RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f x)
  have hhIntegrable : HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn h a b := by
    simpa [h] using hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn_abs_integrable hAbs
  cases hhIntegrable with
  | intro H hH =>
      let halfEps := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
      have hhalfEps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero halfEps :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
      cases exists_hkNonnegativeTruncation_tailIntegral_lt
          hab hnonneg hH hhalfEps with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro E htailData =>
              let trunc : Point -> Point :=
                hkNonnegativeTruncation h n
              let tail : Point -> Point := fun x : Point =>
                RealTheory.sub (h x) (trunc x)
              have htruncIntegrable :
                  HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn trunc a b := by
                simpa [trunc] using htailData.left
              have htailIntegral :
                  HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn tail a b E := by
                simpa [tail, trunc] using htailData.right.left
              have hELtHalf : RealTheory.lt E halfEps :=
                htailData.right.right
              cases htruncIntegrable with
              | intro truncIntegral htruncIntegral =>
                  let K := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
                  have hKPos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero K := by
                    have hnat := RealTheory.nat_lt_nat_of_lt
                      (m := 0) (n := n + 1) (by omega)
                    rw [RealTheory.nat_zero] at hnat
                    exact hnat
                  have hKNonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero K :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hKPos
                  have hKNe : Not (K = RealTheory.zero) := by
                    intro hzero
                    exact
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hKPos)
                        (Eq.symm hzero)
                  let delta := RealTheory.mul halfEps (RealTheory.inv K)
                  have hdeltaPos :
                      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hhalfEps
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hKPos)
                  have hKDelta :
                      RealTheory.mul K delta = halfEps := by
                    change
                      F.mul K (F.mul halfEps (F.inv K)) = halfEps
                    rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
                    rw [F.mul_comm K halfEps]
                    rw [F.mul_assoc]
                    rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hKNe]
                    rw [F.mul_one]
                  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                  refine And.intro hdeltaPos ?_
                  intro iota l r js hfamily hlength
                  have existsSubintervalValue :
                      forall (g : Point -> Point) (G : Point),
                        HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn g a b G ->
                          forall i : iota,
                            Exists (fun v : Point =>
                              List.Mem i js ->
                                HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn g
                                  (l i) (r i) v) := by
                    intro g G hg i
                    by_cases hi : List.Mem i js
                    · have hibounds := hfamily.right.right.left i hi
                      cases
                          exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_subinterval
                            hibounds.left.left
                            (hfamily.right.left i hi)
                            hibounds.right.right hg with
                      | intro v hv =>
                          exact Exists.intro v (fun _hi => hv)
                    · exact Exists.intro RealTheory.zero
                        (fun himem => False.elim (hi himem))
                  let value : iota -> Point := fun i : iota =>
                    Classical.choose (existsSubintervalValue h H hH i)
                  let tailValue : iota -> Point := fun i : iota =>
                    Classical.choose
                      (existsSubintervalValue tail E htailIntegral i)
                  let truncValue : iota -> Point := fun i : iota =>
                    Classical.choose
                      (existsSubintervalValue trunc truncIntegral
                        htruncIntegral i)
                  have hvalue : forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
                      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h
                        (l i) (r i) (value i) := by
                    intro i hi
                    exact
                      Classical.choose_spec
                        (existsSubintervalValue h H hH i) hi
                  have htailValue : forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
                      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn tail
                        (l i) (r i) (tailValue i) := by
                    intro i hi
                    exact
                      Classical.choose_spec
                        (existsSubintervalValue tail E htailIntegral i) hi
                  have htruncValue : forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
                      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn trunc
                        (l i) (r i) (truncValue i) := by
                    intro i hi
                    exact
                      Classical.choose_spec
                        (existsSubintervalValue trunc truncIntegral
                          htruncIntegral i) hi
                  have htailNonneg : forall x : Point,
                      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (tail x) := by
                    intro x
                    dsimp [tail, trunc]
                    exact hkNonnegativeTruncation_tail_nonnegative h n x
                  have htruncNonneg : forall x : Point,
                      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (trunc x) := by
                    intro x
                    dsimp [trunc]
                    exact hkNonnegativeTruncation_nonnegative hnonneg n x
                  have htruncBound : forall x : Point,
                      RealTheory.le (trunc x) K := by
                    intro x
                    dsimp [trunc, K]
                    exact hkNonnegativeTruncation_le_level h n x
                  have htailSumLe :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
                          (List.map tailValue js)) E :=
                    hkNonnegativeFiniteFamilyValueSum_le
                      hab htailNonneg htailIntegral hfamily
                      tailValue htailValue
                  have htruncSumLe :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
                          (List.map truncValue js))
                        (RealTheory.mul K
                          (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js)) :=
                    hkNonnegativeBoundedFiniteFamilyValueSum_le
                      htruncBound hfamily
                      truncValue htruncValue
                  have htailSumLtHalf :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
                          (List.map tailValue js)) halfEps :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                      htailSumLe hELtHalf
                  have hKLengthLtHalf :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.mul K
                          (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js))
                        halfEps := by
                    have hmul :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_left F
                        hlength hKPos
                    change
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.mul K
                          (RealInterval.intervalListLength l r js))
                        (RealTheory.mul K delta) at hmul
                    rw [hKDelta] at hmul
                    exact hmul
                  have htruncSumLtHalf :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
                          (List.map truncValue js)) halfEps :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                      htruncSumLe hKLengthLtHalf
                  have hdecomp : forall x : Point,
                      h x = RealTheory.add (tail x) (trunc x) := by
                    intro x
                    dsimp [tail]
                    exact Eq.symm
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F
                        (h x) (trunc x))
                  have hsumDecomp :=
                    hkFiniteFamilyValueSum_eq_tail_add_trunc
                      hfamily.right.left hdecomp
                      value tailValue truncValue
                      hvalue htailValue htruncValue
                  have hsumLtEps :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
                      htailSumLtHalf htruncSumLtHalf
                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps]
                    at hsumLtEps
                  refine Exists.intro value ?_
                  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                  · intro i hi
                    simpa [h] using hvalue i hi
                  · rw [hsumDecomp]
                    exact hsumLtEps

name: absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_of_hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn
statement:
theorem absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_of_hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn
    {f F : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hAbs : HKAbsolutelyIntegrableOn f a b)
    (hF : HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f F a b) :
    RealFunction.AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval F a b
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hab ?_
  intro eps heps
  cases
      hkAbsIntegralFiniteFamilySmall_of_hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn
        hab hAbs eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro iota l r js hfamily hlength
      cases hdelta.right l r js hfamily hlength with
      | intro value hvalue =>
          have hincrementLe : forall i : iota, List.Mem i js ->
              RealTheory.le
                (RealFunction.acIntervalIncrement F l r i)
                (value i) := by
            intro i hi
            have hibounds := hfamily.right.right.left i hi
            have hiOrdered := hfamily.right.left i hi
            have hiIntegral :
                HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f
                  (l i) (r i)
                  (RealTheory.sub (F (r i)) (F (l i))) :=
              hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_interval_increment
                hF hibounds.left hibounds.right hiOrdered
            unfold RealFunction.acIntervalIncrement
            exact abs_henstockKurzweilIntegral_le_integral_abs
              hiOrdered hiIntegral (hvalue.left i hi)
          have hsumLe : forall xs : List iota,
              (forall i : iota, List.Mem i xs ->
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealFunction.acIntervalIncrement F l r i)
                  (value i)) ->
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealFunction.acIntervalIncrementSum F l r xs)
                  (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
                    (List.map value xs)) := by
            intro xs
            induction xs with
            | nil =>
                intro _hpoint
                exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
            | cons i rest ih =>
                intro hpoint
                change
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealFunction.acIntervalIncrement F l r i)
                      (RealFunction.acIntervalIncrementSum F l r rest))
                    (RealTheory.add (value i)
                      (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
                        (List.map value rest)))
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                  (hpoint i (List.Mem.head rest))
                  (ih (fun j hj => hpoint j (List.Mem.tail i hj)))
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            (hsumLe js hincrementLe) hvalue.right

name: hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn_of_hasIntegral_boundedVariationPrimitive
statement:
theorem hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn_of_hasIntegral_boundedVariationPrimitive
    {f F : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hfull : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b
      (RealTheory.sub (F b) (F a)))
    (hsub : forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
        HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a x
          (RealTheory.sub (F x) (F a)))
    (hBV : RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b F) :
    HKAbsolutelyIntegrableOn f a b
proof:
:= by
  let G : Point -> Point := fun x : Point =>
    RealTheory.sub (F x) (F a)
  have hG : HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f G a b := by
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · dsimp [G]
      exact RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub_self (F a)
    · intro x hx
      by_cases hxb : x = b
      · subst x
        simpa [G] using hfull
      · simpa [G] using hsub x hx
  have hGBV :
      RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b G := by
    simpa [G] using
      (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.boundedVariationOn_sub_const
        (F a) hBV)
  exact
    hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn_of_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_boundedVariationOn
      hab hG hGBV

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_zero_of_eq_zero_off_nullSet
statement:
private theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_zero_of_eq_zero_off_nullSet
    {h : Point -> Point} {S : Point -> Prop} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hNull : RealNegligibility.NullSet
      (fun x : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x)))
    (hoff : forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x -> Not (S x) ->
        h x = RealTheory.zero) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h a b RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro hab ?_
  intro eps heps
  cases
      exists_nullSetPartialTaggedAbsSumGauge_of_eq_zero_off
        hab hNull hoff eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro n p tag hfine
      have hsub :
          TaggedCellSubpartition n n (fun k : Nat => k) := by
        exact And.intro
          (fun _k hk => hk)
          (fun k _hk => Nat.lt_succ_self k)
      have hpartialFine :
          GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b n
            p (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) tag delta := by
        have hselected :=
          taggedCellSubpartition_gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
            hfine hsub
        change
          GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b n
            p (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) tag delta at hselected
        exact hselected
      have habsPartial :=
        hdelta.right n p (fun k : Nat => p (k + 1)) tag hpartialFine
      have habsTagged := habsPartial
      rw [partialTaggedSum_of_taggedPartition] at habsTagged
      have hsigned :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs (taggedSum h p tag n)) eps :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C
          (abs_taggedSum_le_taggedSum_abs hfine.left)
          habsTagged
      change
        C.lt (C.abs (C.sub (taggedSum h p tag n) C.zero)) eps
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero C]
      exact hsigned

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_congr_nullSet
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_congr_nullSet
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hNull : RealNegligibility.NullSet
      (fun x : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (Not (f x = g x))))
    (hf : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b I) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn g a b I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let difference : Point -> Point := fun x : Point =>
    RealTheory.sub (g x) (f x)
  have hzero :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn difference a b RealTheory.zero :=
    hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_zero_of_eq_zero_off_nullSet
      hab hNull
      (fun x _hx hsame => by
        have hfg : f x = g x := Classical.byContradiction hsame
        unfold difference
        rw [<- hfg]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self C (f x))
  have hadd := hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_add hf hzero
  have hcongr :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn g a b
        (RealTheory.add I RealTheory.zero) :=
    hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_congr_fun
      (f := fun x : Point => RealTheory.add (f x) (difference x))
      (g := g)
      (fun x : Point => by
        unfold difference
        change C.add (f x) (C.sub (g x) (f x)) = g x
        rw [C.add_comm]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel C (g x) (f x))
      hadd
  rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at hcongr

name: mesh_lt_of_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_const_half
statement:
private theorem mesh_lt_of_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_const_half
    {a b delta : Point} {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
        (fun _ : Point =>
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base delta)) :
    RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F delta
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hdelta
  exact
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.mesh_lt_of_cellLength_lt
      p n delta hdelta
      (fun k hk => by
        have hpartition : IntervalPartition a b n p := hfine.left.left
        have hleft_mem : PartitionCell p k (p k) :=
          Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_left_mem
            hpartition hk
        have hright_mem : PartitionCell p k (p (k + 1)) :=
          Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_right_mem
            hpartition hk
        have hleft :
            RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (p k) (tag k)) e2 :=
          hfine.right k hk (p k) hleft_mem
        have hright :
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (tag k)) e2 :=
          hfine.right k hk (p (k + 1)) hright_mem
        have hleft' :
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealFunction.dist (tag k) (p k)) e2 := by
          rw [RealFunction.dist_comm (tag k) (p k)]
          exact hleft
        have htri :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (p k))
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (tag k))
                (RealFunction.dist (tag k) (p k))) := by
          change
            F.le
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (p (k + 1)) (p k))
              (F.add
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (p (k + 1)) (tag k))
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (tag k) (p k)))
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle
            F (p (k + 1)) (tag k) (p k)
        have hsum :
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (tag k))
                (RealFunction.dist (tag k) (p k)))
              delta := by
          have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hright hleft'
          change
            F.lt
              (F.add
                (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (tag k))
                (RealFunction.dist (tag k) (p k)))
              (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
          rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F delta] at hadd
        have hdist :
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (p k)) delta :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum
        have hcell_eq :
            cellLength p k = RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) (p k) := by
          unfold cellLength RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
          have hnonneg :
              F.le F.zero (F.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F
              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_step_le
                hpartition hk)
          change
            F.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k) =
              F.abs (F.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k))
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hnonneg]
        rw [hcell_eq]
        exact hdist)

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_hasRiemannIntegral
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_hasRiemannIntegral
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hI : Riemann.HasRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b I
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hI.left ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hI.right eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F delta
      have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hdelta.left
      refine Exists.intro (fun _ : Point => e2) ?_
      refine And.intro (closedIntervalGaugeOn_const he2) ?_
      intro n p tag hfine
      have hmesh :
          RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta :=
        mesh_lt_of_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_const_half
          hdelta.left hfine
      have hri :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub (Riemann.taggedSum f p tag n) I))
            eps :=
        hdelta.right n p tag hfine.left hmesh
      rw [taggedSum_eq_riemann_taggedSum f p tag n]
      exact hri
