name: abs_henstockKurzweilIntegral_lt_integral_abs_add_eps
statement:
private theorem abs_henstockKurzweilIntegral_lt_integral_abs_add_eps
    {f : Point -> Point} {c d I A eps : Point}
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d)
    (hI : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f c d I)
    (hAbs : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn (HKAbsFun f) c d A)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs I) (RealTheory.add A eps)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hI.right e2 he2 with
  | intro deltaI hdeltaI =>
      cases hAbs.right e2 he2 with
      | intro deltaAbs hdeltaAbs =>
          let delta := fun x : Point =>
            RealTheory.min (deltaI x) (deltaAbs x)
          have hdelta :
              ClosedIntervalGaugeOn c d delta :=
            closedIntervalGaugeOn_min hdeltaI.left hdeltaAbs.left
          cases
              exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_closedIntervalGaugeOn
                hcd hdelta with
          | intro n hn =>
              cases hn with
              | intro p hp =>
                  cases hp with
                  | intro tag hfine =>
                      have hfineI :
                          GaugeFineTaggedPartition c d n p tag deltaI :=
                        gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le hfine
                          (fun x : Point =>
                            RealTheory.min_le_left
                              (deltaI x) (deltaAbs x))
                      have hfineAbs :
                          GaugeFineTaggedPartition c d n p tag deltaAbs :=
                        gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le hfine
                          (fun x : Point =>
                            RealTheory.min_le_right
                              (deltaI x) (deltaAbs x))
                      let S := taggedSum f p tag n
                      let Sabs := taggedSum (HKAbsFun f) p tag n
                      have hcloseI :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub S I)) e2 := by
                        exact hdeltaI.right n p tag hfineI
                      have hcloseAbs :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub Sabs A)) e2 := by
                        exact hdeltaAbs.right n p tag hfineAbs
                      have hsumAbs :
                          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs S) Sabs := by
                        change
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (taggedSum f p tag n))
                            (taggedSum
                              (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x))
                              p tag n)
                        exact abs_taggedSum_le_taggedSum_abs hfine.left
                      have htri :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealTheory.abs I)
                            (RealTheory.add
                              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I))
                              (RealTheory.abs S)) := by
                        have hbase :
                            RealTheory.le
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (RealTheory.sub I RealTheory.zero))
                              (RealTheory.add
                                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I))
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub S RealTheory.zero))) :=
                          by
                            change
                              RealTheory.le
                                (RealFunction.dist I RealTheory.zero)
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (RealFunction.dist S I)
                                  (RealFunction.dist S RealTheory.zero))
                            rw [RealFunction.dist_comm S I]
                            exact RealFunction.dist_triangle
                              I S RealTheory.zero
                        change
                          F.le
                            (RealTheory.abs (F.sub I F.zero))
                            (F.add
                              (RealTheory.abs (F.sub S I))
                              (RealTheory.abs (F.sub S F.zero))) at hbase
                        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F I,
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F S] at hbase
                        exact hbase
                      have hsum_le :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealTheory.add
                              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I))
                              (RealTheory.abs S))
                            (RealTheory.add e2 Sabs) :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hcloseI)
                          hsumAbs
                      have hSabs_lt :
                          RealTheory.lt Sabs (RealTheory.add A e2) :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt
                          F hcloseAbs
                      have hmid_lt :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.add e2 Sabs)
                            (RealTheory.add e2 (RealTheory.add A e2)) :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
                          F hSabs_lt e2
                      have htarget :
                          RealTheory.add e2 (RealTheory.add A e2) =
                            RealTheory.add A eps := by
                        change F.add e2 (F.add A e2) = F.add A eps
                        calc
                          F.add e2 (F.add A e2)
                              = F.add (F.add e2 A) e2 := by
                                  rw [<- F.add_assoc]
                          _ = F.add (F.add A e2) e2 := by
                                  rw [F.add_comm e2 A]
                          _ = F.add A (F.add e2 e2) := by
                                  rw [F.add_assoc]
                          _ = F.add A eps := by
                                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                                    F eps]
                      rw [htarget] at hmid_lt
                      exact
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                            hsum_le hmid_lt)

name: abs_henstockKurzweilIntegral_le_integral_abs
statement:
theorem abs_henstockKurzweilIntegral_le_integral_abs
    {f : Point -> Point} {c d I A : Point}
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d)

    (hAbs : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn (HKAbsFun f) c d A) :

    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (fun _ heps =>

        hcd hI hAbs heps)

name: hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_interval_increment
statement:
theorem hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_interval_increment
    {f primitive : Point -> Point} {a b u v : Point}
    (hF : HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f primitive a b)
    (hu : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b u)
    (hv : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b v)
    (huv : RealTheory.le u v) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f u v
      (RealTheory.sub (primitive v) (primitive u))
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a u (primitive u) :=
    hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_hasIntegral hF hu
  have hglobal :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a v (primitive v) :=
    hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_hasIntegral hF hv
  cases
      exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_subinterval
        hu.left huv (RealTheory.le_refl v) hglobal with
  | intro intervalValue hinterval =>
      have hsum :
          primitive v = RealTheory.add (primitive u) intervalValue :=
        hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_eq_add_of_adjacent_ordered
          hu.left huv hglobal hleft hinterval
      have hsumComm :
          primitive v = RealTheory.add intervalValue (primitive u) := by
        rw [hsum]
        exact RealTheory.add_comm (primitive u) intervalValue
      have hvalue :
          intervalValue = RealTheory.sub (primitive v) (primitive u) :=
        RealTheory.eq_sub_of_eq_add_right hsumComm
      rwa [<- hvalue]

name: exists_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_of_henstockKurzweilIntegrableOn
statement:
theorem exists_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_of_henstockKurzweilIntegrableOn
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn f a b) :
    Exists (fun primitive : Point -> Point =>
      HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f primitive a b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases hf with
  | intro I hI =>
      have hvalues :
          forall x : Point,
            Exists
              (fun value : Point =>
                RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
                  HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a x value) := by
        intro x
        by_cases hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x
        · cases
              exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_subinterval
                (RealTheory.le_refl a) hx.left hx.right hI with
          | intro value hvalue =>
              exact Exists.intro value (fun _ => hvalue)
        · exact Exists.intro RealTheory.zero
            (fun hx' => False.elim (hx hx'))
      let primitive :=
        fun x : Point => Classical.choose (hvalues x)
      have hprimitive :
          forall x : Point,
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a x (primitive x) := by
        intro x hx
        exact Classical.choose_spec (hvalues x) hx
      refine Exists.intro primitive ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ hprimitive
      exact
        hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
          (hprimitive a (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab))
          (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_degenerate f a)

name: hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_cell_increment
statement:
theorem hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_cell_increment
    {f primitive : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (h : HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f primitive a b)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)

      (RealTheory.sub (primitive (p (k + 1))) (primitive (p k)))
proof:
:= by

    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
      hp hk
  have hx_right : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
      hp hk
  have hstep : RealTheory.le (p k) (p (k + 1)) :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_step_le hp hk
  exact hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_interval_increment
    h hx_left hx_right hstep

name: hkPrimitive_partitionVariation_le_integral_abs
statement:
theorem hkPrimitive_partitionVariation_le_integral_abs
    {f primitive : Point -> Point} {a b A : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hF : HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f primitive a b)
    (hAbs : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn (HKAbsFun f) a b A)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    RealTheory.le
      (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
        primitive p n)
      A
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_partitionCellHKIntegralValues_sum_eq hAbs hp with
  | intro cellA hcellA =>
      have hsum_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm
                primitive p) n)
            (RealTheory.finiteSum cellA n) :=
        RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
          (Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm
            primitive p)
          cellA n
          (fun k hk => by
            unfold
              Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm
            exact
              abs_henstockKurzweilIntegral_le_integral_abs
                (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_step_le
                  hp hk)
                (hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_cell_increment hF hp hk)
                (hcellA.left k hk))
      unfold Tautology.RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_hkAbsFun_nonnegative_integral
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_hkAbsFun_nonnegative_integral
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hAbs : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn (HKAbsFun f) a b A) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero A
proof:
:= by
  have hAbsAbs :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn (HKAbsFun (HKAbsFun f)) a b A :=
    hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_congr_fun
      (f := HKAbsFun f) (g := HKAbsFun (HKAbsFun f))
      (fun x : Point => by
        unfold HKAbsFun
        exact Eq.symm
          (RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg
            (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f x))))
      hAbs
  have hA_abs_le_A :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs A) A :=
    abs_henstockKurzweilIntegral_le_integral_abs
      hab hAbs hAbsAbs

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
    {p q : Point -> Point} {u v P Q : Point}
    (huv : RealTheory.le u v)
    (hpq : forall x : Point, RealTheory.le (p x) (q x))
    (hp : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn p u v P)
    (hq : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn q u v Q) :
    RealTheory.le P Q
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hdiff :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (q x) (p x))
        u v (RealTheory.sub Q P) :=
    hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_sub hq hp
  have hdiffAbs :
      HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (HKAbsFun
          (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (q x) (p x)))
        u v (RealTheory.sub Q P) :=
    hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_congr_fun
      (f := fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (q x) (p x))
      (g := HKAbsFun
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (q x) (p x)))
      (fun x : Point => by
        unfold HKAbsFun
        exact Eq.symm
          (RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F (hpq x))))
      hdiff
  have hnonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub Q P) :=
    hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_hkAbsFun_nonnegative_integral
      (f := fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (q x) (p x))
      huv hdiffAbs
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_sub_nonneg F hnonneg

name: variationBoundOn_hkIndefinitePrimitive_of_hasIntegral_abs

name: partialTaggedDivision_openCell_disjoint_of_lt
statement:
private theorem partialTaggedDivision_openCell_disjoint_of_lt
    {a b : Point} {n i j : Nat} {left right tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag)
    (hij : i < j) (hj : j < n) :
    SetPred.Disjoint
      (RealInterval.IntervalAt left right i)
      (RealInterval.IntervalAt left right j)
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro x hxi hxj
  have hright_le_left :
      RealTheory.le (right i) (left j) :=
    partialTaggedDivision_right_le_left_of_lt h hij hj
  have hright_lt_x : RealTheory.lt (right i) x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hright_le_left hxj.left
  have hbad : RealTheory.lt (right i) (right i) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans C hright_lt_x hxi.right
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl C (right i) hbad

name: partialTaggedDivision_openCell_disjoint_of_ne
statement:
private theorem partialTaggedDivision_openCell_disjoint_of_ne
    {a b : Point} {n i j : Nat} {left right tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag)
    (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n) (hij : Not (i = j)) :
    SetPred.Disjoint
      (RealInterval.IntervalAt left right i)
      (RealInterval.IntervalAt left right j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlt : i < j
  case pos =>
    exact partialTaggedDivision_openCell_disjoint_of_lt h hlt hj
  case neg =>
    have hjlt : j < i := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne
      (Nat.le_of_not_gt hlt) (fun hji => hij (Eq.symm hji))
    intro x hxi hxj
    exact partialTaggedDivision_openCell_disjoint_of_lt h hjlt hi x hxj hxi

name: partialTaggedDivision_intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_of_mem_lt
statement:
private theorem partialTaggedDivision_intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_of_mem_lt
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {left right tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag) :
    forall xs : List Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, List.Mem k xs -> k < n) ->
        List.Nodup xs ->
          RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint left right xs
  | [], _hmem, _hnodup => by
      unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
      exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | head :: tail, hmem, hnodup => by
      have hhead_lt : head < n
proof:
:=
        hmem head (List.Mem.head tail)
      have htail_mem :
          forall k : Nat, List.Mem k tail -> k < n := by
        intro k hk
        exact hmem k (List.Mem.tail head hk)
      have hnot_mem : Not (List.Mem head tail) :=
        (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).left
      have htail_nodup : List.Nodup tail :=
        (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).right
      have htail_pair :
          RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint left right tail :=
        partialTaggedDivision_intervalListPairwiseDisjoint_of_mem_lt
          h tail htail_mem htail_nodup
      unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint
      exact List.Pairwise.cons
        (by
          intro y hy
          have hy_lt : y < n := htail_mem y hy
          have hne : Not (head = y) := by
            intro hhead_eq
            exact hnot_mem (by rw [hhead_eq]; exact hy)
          exact partialTaggedDivision_openCell_disjoint_of_ne
            h hhead_lt hy_lt hne)
        (by
          unfold RealInterval.IntervalListPairwiseDisjoint at htail_pair
          exact htail_pair)

name: partialTaggedDivision_finiteDisjointSubfamily_range
statement:
private theorem partialTaggedDivision_finiteDisjointSubfamily_range

proof:
:= by
  exact
    And.intro List.nodup_range

        h (List.range n)
        (fun k hmem => List.mem_range.mp hmem)

name: partialTaggedDivision_acIncrementSum_eq_partialPrimitiveVariationSum

/
contains it; `0` off the covered set, so the choice is total. -/

    ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b (nullSetTagCoverGauge hcover)

name: exists_nullSetTagCoverGauge_for_closedInterval
statement:
theorem exists_nullSetTagCoverGauge_for_closedInterval
    {S : Point -> Prop} {a b : Point}
    (hNull :
      RealNegligibility.NullSet
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x)))
    (eps : Point)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists (fun delta : Point -> Point =>
      Exists (fun coverLeft : Nat -> Point =>
        Exists (fun coverRight : Nat -> Point =>
          Exists
            (fun hcover :
              RealNegligibility.CountableOpenIntervalCover
                (fun x : Point =>
                  And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x))
                coverLeft coverRight =>
              And (delta = nullSetTagCoverGauge hcover)
                (And (ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta)
                  (And
                    (RealNegligibility.CoverBudgetLt coverLeft coverRight eps)
                    (forall {x y : Point},
                      And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x) ->
                        RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) (delta x) ->
                          RealInterval.IntervalAt coverLeft coverRight
                            (nullSetCoverIndex hcover x)
                            y)))))))
proof:
:= by
  cases hNull eps heps with
  | intro coverLeft hleft =>
      cases hleft with
      | intro coverRight hspec =>
          let hcover := hspec.left
          let delta := nullSetTagCoverGauge hcover
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine Exists.intro coverLeft ?_
          refine Exists.intro coverRight ?_
          refine Exists.intro hcover ?_
          refine And.intro rfl ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact closedIntervalGaugeOn_nullSetTagCoverGauge hcover
          · refine And.intro hspec.right ?_
            intro x y hx hclose
            exact nullSetTagCoverGauge_mem_cover hcover hx hclose

name: nullCoverGaugeData_exists
statement:
private theorem nullCoverGaugeData_exists
    {S : Point -> Prop} {a b budget : Point}
    (hNull :
      RealNegligibility.NullSet
        (fun x : Point => And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x)))
    (hbudget : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero budget) :
    Nonempty (NullCoverGaugeData S a b budget)
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_nullSetTagCoverGauge_for_closedInterval
      hNull budget hbudget with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases hdelta with
      | intro coverLeft hleft =>
          cases hleft with
          | intro coverRight hright =>
              cases hright with
              | intro cover hspec =>
                  exact Nonempty.intro
                    { delta := delta
                      coverLeft := coverLeft
                      coverRight := coverRight
                      cover := cover
                      delta_eq := hspec.left
                      gauge := hspec.right.left
                      budget_lt := hspec.right.right.left }

name: finiteSum_partialCellLength_eq_intervalListLength_range
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_partialCellLength_eq_intervalListLength_range
    (left right : Nat -> Point) : forall n : Nat,
    RealTheory.finiteSum (partialCellLength left right) n =
      RealInterval.intervalListLength left right (List.range n)
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      rw [List.range_succ]
      rw [RealInterval.intervalListLength_append]
      rw [finiteSum_partialCellLength_eq_intervalListLength_range
        left right n]
      change
        RealTheory.add
            (RealInterval.intervalListLength left right (List.range n))
            (RealTheory.sub (right n) (left n)) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealInterval.intervalListLength left right (List.range n))
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.sub (right n) (left n)) RealTheory.zero)
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

private theorem exists_nat_range_listMembersIn
    (xs : List Nat) :
    Exists (fun N : Nat =>
      RealInterval.ListMembersIn xs (List.range N))
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
      intro x hx
      cases hx
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases ih with
      | intro N hN =>
          refine Exists.intro (Nat.max (x + 1) N) ?_
          intro y hy
          cases hy with
          | head =>
              exact
                List.mem_range.mpr
                  (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
                    (Nat.lt_succ_self x)
                    (Nat.le_max_left (x + 1) N))
          | tail _ hyTail =>
              have hyN_mem : List.Mem y (List.range N) :=
                hN y hyTail
              have hyN : y < N := List.mem_range.mp hyN_mem
              exact
                List.mem_range.mpr
                  (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
                    hyN
                    (Nat.le_max_right (x + 1) N))

name: exists_nat_range_listMembersIn
statement:
private theorem exists_nat_range_listMembersIn
    (xs : List Nat) :
    Exists (fun N : Nat =>
      RealInterval.ListMembersIn xs (List.range N))
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
      intro x hx
      cases hx
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases ih with
      | intro N hN =>
          refine Exists.intro (Nat.max (x + 1) N) ?_
          intro y hy
          cases hy with
          | head =>
              exact
                List.mem_range.mpr
                  (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
                    (Nat.lt_succ_self x)
                    (Nat.le_max_left (x + 1) N))
          | tail _ hyTail =>
              have hyN_mem : List.Mem y (List.range N) :=
                hN y hyTail
              have hyN : y < N := List.mem_range.mp hyN_mem
              exact
                List.mem_range.mpr
                  (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
                    hyN
                    (Nat.le_max_right (x + 1) N))

name: intervalListLength_cover_range_eq_seriesPartialSum
statement:
private theorem intervalListLength_cover_range_eq_seriesPartialSum
    (coverLeft coverRight : Nat -> Point) :
    forall N : Nat,
      RealInterval.intervalListLength coverLeft coverRight (List.range N) =
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (RealNegligibility.coverLength coverLeft coverRight) N
  | 0 => rfl
  | N + 1 => by
      rw [List.range_succ]
      rw [RealInterval.intervalListLength_append]
      rw [intervalListLength_cover_range_eq_seriesPartialSum
        coverLeft coverRight N]
      rw [RealInterval.intervalListLength_singleton_eq_lengthAt]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum_succ]
      unfold RealNegligibility.coverLength RealNegligibility.intervalLength
      unfold RealInterval.IntervalLengthAt
      rfl

private theorem intervalListLength_lt_coverBudget_of_nodup
    {S : Point -> Prop} {a b eps : Point}
    {coverLeft coverRight : Nat -> Point}
    (hcover :
      RealNegligibility.CountableOpenIntervalCover
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x))
        coverLeft coverRight)
    (hbudget : RealNegligibility.CoverBudgetLt coverLeft coverRight eps)
    {selected : List Nat}
    (hnodup : List.Nodup selected) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealInterval.intervalListLength coverLeft coverRight selected)
      eps
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases exists_nat_range_listMembersIn selected with
  | intro N hmembers =>
      have hle :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealInterval.intervalListLength coverLeft coverRight selected)
            (RealInterval.intervalListLength coverLeft coverRight
              (List.range N)) :=
        RealInterval.intervalListLength_le_of_nodup_members_of_ordered
          selected (List.range N) hnodup hmembers
          (by
            intro i _hi
            exact hcover.left i)
      have hprefix :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealInterval.intervalListLength coverLeft coverRight
              (List.range N))
            eps := by
        have hbudgetN := hbudget N
        rw [intervalListLength_cover_range_eq_seriesPartialSum
          coverLeft coverRight N]
        exact hbudgetN
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hle hprefix

name: partialTaggedDivision_tagCoverControls_open
statement:
private theorem partialTaggedDivision_tagCoverControls_open
    {S : Point -> Prop} {a b : Point} {n : Nat}
    {left right tag : Nat -> Point}
    {coverLeft coverRight : Nat -> Point}
    (hcover :
      RealNegligibility.CountableOpenIntervalCover
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x))
        coverLeft coverRight)
    (hdiv : PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag)
    (htag : forall k : Nat, k < n -> S (tag k)) :
    RealInterval.IntervalListOpen coverLeft coverRight
      (partialTaggedDivisionTagCoverControls
        (S := S) (a := a) (b := b) (n := n)
        (tag := tag) hcover)
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  unfold partialTaggedDivisionTagCoverControls at hj
  cases List.mem_map.mp hj with
  | intro k hk =>
      cases hk with
      | intro hkMem hjEq =>
          subst j
          have hk_lt : k < n := List.mem_range.mp hkMem
          exact
            nullSetCoverIndex_interval_open hcover
              (And.intro
                (partialTaggedDivision_tag_mem_closedInterval hdiv hk_lt)
                (htag k hk_lt))

name: partialTaggedDivision_cells_contained_in_tag_cover
statement:
private theorem partialTaggedDivision_cells_contained_in_tag_cover
    {S : Point -> Prop} {a b : Point} {n : Nat}
    {left right tag : Nat -> Point}
    {coverLeft coverRight : Nat -> Point}
    (hcover :
      RealNegligibility.CountableOpenIntervalCover
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x))
        coverLeft coverRight)
    (hdiv : PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag)
    (htag : forall k : Nat, k < n -> S (tag k))
    (hfine :
      GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag
        (nullSetTagCoverGauge hcover)) :
    RealInterval.ClosedIntervalListContainedByList left right (List.range n)
      coverLeft coverRight
      (partialTaggedDivisionTagCoverControls
        (S := S) (a := a) (b := b) (n := n)
        (tag := tag) hcover)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hkMem
  have hk_lt : k < n := List.mem_range.mp hkMem
  refine Exists.intro (nullSetCoverIndex hcover (tag k)) ?_
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · unfold partialTaggedDivisionTagCoverControls
    exact List.mem_map.mpr (Exists.intro k (And.intro hkMem rfl))
  · intro y hy
    have hclose :
        RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y (tag k))
          (nullSetTagCoverGauge hcover (tag k)) :=
      gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision_cell_fine hfine hk_lt y hy
    exact
      nullSetTagCoverGauge_mem_cover hcover
        (And.intro
          (partialTaggedDivision_tag_mem_closedInterval hdiv hk_lt)
          (htag k hk_lt))
        hclose

name: partialTaggedDivision_intervalListLength_le_coverLength
statement:
theorem partialTaggedDivision_intervalListLength_le_coverLength
    {S : Point -> Prop} {a b budget : Point} {n : Nat}
    {left right tag : Nat -> Point}
    {coverLeft coverRight : Nat -> Point}
    (hcover :
      RealNegligibility.CountableOpenIntervalCover
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x))
        coverLeft coverRight)
    (hbudget : RealNegligibility.CoverBudgetLt coverLeft coverRight budget)
    (hdiv : PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag)
    (htag : forall k : Nat, k < n -> S (tag k))
    (hfine :
      GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag
        (nullSetTagCoverGauge hcover)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealInterval.intervalListLength left right (List.range n))
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) budget)
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let controls :=
    partialTaggedDivisionTagCoverControls
      (S := S) (a := a) (b := b) (n := n)
      (tag := tag) hcover
  have hselectionHyp :
      RealInterval.FiniteIntervalSelectionHypotheses
        left right (List.range n) coverLeft coverRight controls := by
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · intro k hkMem
      exact partialTaggedDivision_cell_le hdiv (List.mem_range.mp hkMem)
    · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · exact partialTaggedDivision_finiteDisjointSubfamily_range hdiv
      · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
        · exact
            partialTaggedDivision_tagCoverControls_open
              hcover hdiv htag
        · exact
            partialTaggedDivision_cells_contained_in_tag_cover
              hcover hdiv htag hfine
  have hcontrol :
      RealInterval.FiniteIntervalSelectionLengthControl
        left right (List.range n) coverLeft coverRight controls
        (RealInterval.greedyIntervalSelection coverLeft coverRight
          controls) :=
    RealInterval.finiteIntervalSelectionLengthControl_greedy_of_hypotheses
      hselectionHyp
  have hsource_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealInterval.intervalListLength left right (List.range n))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
          (RealInterval.intervalListLength coverLeft coverRight
            (RealInterval.greedyIntervalSelection coverLeft coverRight
              controls))) :=
    hcontrol.right.right
  have hselected_nodup :
      List.Nodup
        (RealInterval.greedyIntervalSelection coverLeft coverRight
          controls) :=
    hcontrol.right.left.right.left.left
  have hselected_lt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealInterval.intervalListLength coverLeft coverRight
          (RealInterval.greedyIntervalSelection coverLeft coverRight
            controls))
        budget :=
    intervalListLength_lt_coverBudget_of_nodup
      hcover hbudget hselected_nodup
  have hthree_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.nat 3) :=
    RealTheory.nat_succ_pos 2
  have hthree_selected_lt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
          (RealInterval.intervalListLength coverLeft coverRight
            (RealInterval.greedyIntervalSelection coverLeft coverRight
              controls)))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) budget) :=
    RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hselected_lt hthree_pos
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hsource_le hthree_selected_lt

name: thirdBudget_pos
proof:
:= by
  unfold thirdBudget
  exact
    RealTheory.mul_pos heta
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos 2))

name: three_mul_thirdBudget
statement:
theorem three_mul_thirdBudget (eta : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) (thirdBudget eta) = eta
proof:
:= by
  unfold thirdBudget
  let three := RealTheory.nat 3
  have hnat_ne : Not (3 = 0) := by decide
  have hthree_ne : Not (three = RealTheory.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hnat_ne
  calc
    RealTheory.mul three
        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.inv three)) =
        RealTheory.mul eta
          (RealTheory.mul three (RealTheory.inv three)) := by
          exact RealTheory.mul_left_comm three eta (RealTheory.inv three)
    _ = RealTheory.mul eta RealTheory.one := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hthree_ne]
    _ = eta := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_one]

name: gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision_reindex_of_taggedCellSubpartition
statement:
private theorem
    gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision_reindex_of_taggedCellSubpartition
    {a b : Point} {total selected : Nat}
    {left right tag : Nat -> Point} {index : Nat -> Nat}
    {delta : Point -> Point}
    (hfine :
      GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
        a b total left right tag delta)
    (hsub : TaggedCellSubpartition total selected index) :
    GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b selected
      (fun k : Nat => left (index k))
      (fun k : Nat => right (index k))
      (fun k : Nat => tag (index k))
      delta
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · intro k hk
      exact hfine.left.left (index k) (hsub.left k hk)
    · intro k hk
      exact
        partialTaggedDivision_right_le_left_of_lt
          hfine.left
          (hsub.right k hk)
          (hsub.left (k + 1) hk)
  · intro k hk
    exact hfine.right (index k) (hsub.left k hk)

name: exists_nullSetPartialTaggedAbsSumGauge_of_eq_zero_off
statement:
theorem exists_nullSetPartialTaggedAbsSumGauge_of_eq_zero_off
    {h : Point -> Point} {S : Point -> Prop} {a b : Point}
    (_hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hNull :
      RealNegligibility.NullSet
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x)))
    (hoff : forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x -> Not (S x) ->
        h x = RealTheory.zero)
    (eps : Point)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists (fun delta : Point -> Point =>
      And (ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta)
        (forall (n : Nat) (left right tag : Nat -> Point),
          GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
              a b n left right tag delta ->
            RealTheory.lt
              (partialTaggedSum
                (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (h x))
                left right tag n)
              eps))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hvalidTwo : RealTheory.ValidBase 2 := by
    unfold RealTheory.ValidBase IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
    omega
  let amplitudeWitness := fun x : Point =>
    RealTheory.exists_nat_gt (RealTheory.abs (h x))
  let amplitudeLevel : Point -> Nat := fun x : Point =>
    Classical.choose (amplitudeWitness x)
  have hamplitude : forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs (h x))
        (RealTheory.nat (amplitudeLevel x + 1)) := by
    intro x
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C
      (Classical.choose_spec (amplitudeWitness x))
      (RealTheory.nat_le_nat_succ (amplitudeLevel x))
  let rowSet : Nat -> Point -> Prop := fun k x =>
    And (S x) (amplitudeLevel x = k)
  have hrowNull : forall k : Nat,
      RealNegligibility.NullSet
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (rowSet k x)) := by
    intro k
    exact RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
      (E := fun x : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (rowSet k x))
      (F := fun x : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x))
      (fun _x hx => And.intro hx.left hx.right.left)
      hNull
  let rowEta : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2)))
      (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))
  have hrowEta : forall k : Nat,
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (rowEta k) := by
    intro k
    unfold rowEta
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos
      (RealTheory.mul_pos heps
        (RealTheory.baseTail_pos hvalidTwo (k + 2)))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos C
        (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos k))
  let rowBudget : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat =>
    thirdBudget (rowEta k)
  have hrowBudget : forall k : Nat,
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (rowBudget k) := by
    intro k
    unfold rowBudget
    exact thirdBudget_pos (hrowEta k)
  let rowData : forall k : Nat,
      NullCoverGaugeData (rowSet k) a b (rowBudget k) := fun k =>
    Classical.choice
      (nullCoverGaugeData_exists (hrowNull k) (hrowBudget k))
  let delta : Point -> Point := fun x : Point =>
    if S x then (rowData (amplitudeLevel x)).delta x
    else RealTheory.one
  have hdelta : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxS : S x
    · simp [delta, hxS]
      exact (rowData (amplitudeLevel x)).gauge x hx
    · simp [delta, hxS]
      exact RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
  refine And.intro hdelta ?_
  intro n left right tag hfine
  let cellLevel : Nat -> Nat := fun i : Nat =>
    if S (tag i) then amplitudeLevel (tag i) + 1 else 0
  let cellAbsContribution : Nat -> Point := fun i : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (h (tag i)))
      (partialCellLength left right i)
  have habsContribution :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.finiteSum cellAbsContribution n) eps := by
    apply finiteSum_lt_of_levelFiber_geometric_bounds
      (level := cellLevel) heps
    intro row
    cases row with
    | zero =>
        have hzero :
            RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun i : Nat =>
                  if cellLevel i = 0 then cellAbsContribution i
                  else RealTheory.zero)
                n = RealTheory.zero := by
          apply RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero
          intro i hi
          by_cases hiS : S (tag i)
          · have hne : Not (cellLevel i = 0) := by
              unfold cellLevel
              simp [hiS]
            simp [hne]
          · have hzeroTag : h (tag i) = RealTheory.zero :=
              hoff (tag i)
                (partialTaggedDivision_tag_mem_closedInterval
                  hfine.left hi)
                hiS
            have hlevel : cellLevel i = 0 := by
              unfold cellLevel
              simp [hiS]
            rw [if_pos hlevel]
            unfold cellAbsContribution
            rw [hzeroTag]
            change C.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs C C.zero) _ = C.zero
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_zero C, C.zero_mul]
        rw [hzero]
        exact RealTheory.mul_pos heps
          (RealTheory.baseTail_pos hvalidTwo 1)
    | succ k =>
        cases exists_levelFiber_taggedCellSubpartition
            n cellLevel (k + 1) with
        | intro selected hselected =>
            cases hselected with
            | intro index hfiber =>
                have hsub :
                    TaggedCellSubpartition n selected index := hfiber.left
                have hpartialFine :
                    GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b selected
                      (fun j : Nat => left (index j))
                      (fun j : Nat => right (index j))
                      (fun j : Nat => tag (index j))
                      delta :=
                  gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision_reindex_of_taggedCellSubpartition
                    hfine hsub
                have hpartial :
                    PartialTaggedDivision a b selected
                      (fun j : Nat => left (index j))
                      (fun j : Nat => right (index j))
                      (fun j : Nat => tag (index j)) :=
                  hpartialFine.left
                have htagRow : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
                    rowSet k (tag (index j)) := by
                  intro j hj
                  have hlevel : cellLevel (index j) = k + 1 :=
                    hfiber.right.left j hj
                  by_cases htagS : S (tag (index j))
                  · have hamp : amplitudeLevel (tag (index j)) = k := by
                      unfold cellLevel at hlevel
                      simp [htagS] at hlevel
                      omega
                    exact And.intro htagS hamp
                  · unfold cellLevel at hlevel
                    simp [htagS] at hlevel
                have hfineRow :
                    GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b selected
                      (fun j : Nat => left (index j))
                      (fun j : Nat => right (index j))
                      (fun j : Nat => tag (index j))
                      (rowData k).delta := by
                  refine And.intro hpartial ?_
                  intro j hj
                  have hjTotal : index j < n := hsub.left j hj
                  have hrow := htagRow j hj
                  have hworkFine :
                      GaugeFinePartialCell left right tag delta (index j) :=
                    hfine.right (index j) hjTotal
                  have hfixedFine :
                      GaugeFinePartialCell
                        left right tag (rowData k).delta (index j) := by
                    unfold GaugeFinePartialCell at hworkFine
                    unfold GaugeFinePartialCell
                    intro y hy
                    have hclose := hworkFine y hy
                    unfold delta at hclose
                    rw [if_pos hrow.left, hrow.right] at hclose
                    exact hclose
                  exact hfixedFine
                have hfineCover :
                    GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b selected
                      (fun j : Nat => left (index j))
                      (fun j : Nat => right (index j))
                      (fun j : Nat => tag (index j))
                      (nullSetTagCoverGauge (rowData k).cover) := by
                  rw [← (rowData k).delta_eq]
                  exact hfineRow
                have hlengthCover :=
                  partialTaggedDivision_intervalListLength_le_coverLength
                    (rowData k).cover (rowData k).budget_lt
                    hpartial htagRow hfineCover
                have hlength :
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum
                        (partialCellLength
                          (fun j : Nat => left (index j))
                          (fun j : Nat => right (index j)))
                        selected)
                      (RealTheory.mul
                        (RealTheory.nat 3) (rowBudget k)) := by
                  rw [finiteSum_partialCellLength_eq_intervalListLength_range]
                  exact hlengthCover
                let levelValue := RealTheory.nat (k + 1)
                have htermLe : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
                    RealTheory.le
                      (cellAbsContribution (index j))
                      (RealTheory.mul levelValue
                        (partialCellLength
                          (fun i : Nat => left (index i))
                          (fun i : Nat => right (index i)) j)) := by
                  intro j hj
                  have hrow := htagRow j hj
                  have hamp := hamplitude (tag (index j))
                  rw [hrow.right] at hamp
                  have habsLe :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.abs (h (tag (index j))))
                        levelValue :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hamp
                  have hlengthNonneg :
                      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
                        (partialCellLength left right (index j)) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C
                      (partialTaggedDivision_cell_le
                        hfine.left (hsub.left j hj))
                  unfold cellAbsContribution levelValue
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
                    C habsLe hlengthNonneg
                have hsumLeRaw :=
                  RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
                    (fun j : Nat => cellAbsContribution (index j))
                    (fun j : Nat =>
                      RealTheory.mul levelValue
                        (partialCellLength
                          (fun i : Nat => left (index i))
                          (fun i : Nat => right (index i)) j))
                    selected htermLe
                have hsumLe :
                    RealTheory.le
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum
                        (fun j : Nat => cellAbsContribution (index j))
                        selected)
                      (RealTheory.mul levelValue
                        (RealTheory.finiteSum
                          (partialCellLength
                            (fun i : Nat => left (index i))
                            (fun i : Nat => right (index i)))
                          selected)) := by
                  rwa [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left] at hsumLeRaw
                have hscaledLength :
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.mul levelValue
                        (RealTheory.finiteSum
                          (partialCellLength
                            (fun i : Nat => left (index i))
                            (fun i : Nat => right (index i)))
                          selected))
                      (RealTheory.mul levelValue
                        (RealTheory.mul
                          (RealTheory.nat 3) (rowBudget k))) :=
                  RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hlength
                    (RealTheory.nat_succ_pos k)
                have hlevelValueNe :
                    Not (levelValue = RealTheory.zero) := by
                  unfold levelValue
                  exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
                    (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
                have hscaleEq :
                    RealTheory.mul levelValue
                        (RealTheory.mul
                          (RealTheory.nat 3) (rowBudget k)) =
                      RealTheory.mul eps
                        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2)) := by
                  rw [three_mul_thirdBudget (rowEta k)]
                  unfold rowEta
                  change
                    RealTheory.mul levelValue
                        (RealTheory.mul
                          (RealTheory.mul eps
                            (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2)))
                          (RealTheory.inv levelValue)) =
                      RealTheory.mul eps
                        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2))
                  rw [RealTheory.mul_left_comm levelValue
                    (RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2)))
                    (RealTheory.inv levelValue)]
                  rw [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hlevelValueNe]
                  rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
                have hselectedLt :
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum
                        (fun j : Nat => cellAbsContribution (index j))
                        selected)
                      (RealTheory.mul eps
                        (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 2))) := by
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hsumLe
                    (by rwa [hscaleEq] at hscaledLength)
                have hreindex :=
                  hfiber.right.right cellAbsContribution
                rw [hreindex]
                exact hselectedLt
  unfold partialTaggedSum
  exact habsContribution

name: partialPrimitiveVariationSum_le_absError_add_absTaggedSum
statement:
private theorem partialPrimitiveVariationSum_le_absError_add_absTaggedSum
    (f primitive : Point -> Point)
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat}
    {left right tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hdiv : PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag) :
    RealTheory.le
      (partialPrimitiveVariationSum primitive left right n)
      (RealTheory.add
        (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f left right tag
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub
              (primitive (right k)) (primitive (left k)))
          n)
        (partialTaggedSum
          (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x))
          left right tag n))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold partialPrimitiveVariationSum
  unfold partialTaggedAbsErrorSum
  unfold partialTaggedSum
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
  intro k hk
  let value :=
    RealTheory.sub (primitive (right k)) (primitive (left k))
  let taggedTerm :=
    RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (partialCellLength left right k)
  have htriangle :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs value)
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub taggedTerm value))
          (RealTheory.abs taggedTerm)) := by
    have hraw :=
      RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
        (RealTheory.sub value taggedTerm) taggedTerm
    change
      C.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (C.add (C.sub value taggedTerm) taggedTerm))
        (C.add
          (RealTheory.abs (C.sub value taggedTerm))
          (RealTheory.abs taggedTerm)) at hraw
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel C value taggedTerm] at hraw
    rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm value taggedTerm] at hraw
    exact hraw
  have hlengthNonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (partialCellLength left right k) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C
      (partialTaggedDivision_cell_le hdiv hk)
  change
    C.le
      (RealTheory.abs value)
      (C.add
        (RealTheory.abs
          (partialTaggedError f left right tag
            (fun j : Nat =>
              C.sub (primitive (right j)) (primitive (left j)))
            k))
        (C.mul
          (RealTheory.abs (f (tag k)))
          (partialCellLength left right k)))
  change
    C.le
      (C.abs value)
      (C.add
        (C.abs (C.sub taggedTerm value))
        (C.abs
          (C.mul (f (tag k)) (partialCellLength left right k))))
      at htriangle
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul C,
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg C hlengthNonneg] at htriangle
  simpa [value, taggedTerm, partialTaggedError] using htriangle

name: negligibleVariationOn_of_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_of_nullSet
statement:
theorem negligibleVariationOn_of_hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_of_nullSet
    {f primitive : Point -> Point} {S : Point -> Prop} {a b : Point}
    (hF : HKIndefinitePrimitiveOn f primitive a b)
    (hNull :
      RealNegligibility.NullSet
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x))) :
    NegligibleVariationOn primitive S a b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro eps heps
  by_cases hab : RealTheory.le a b
  case neg =>
    refine Exists.intro (fun _x : Point => RealTheory.one) ?_
    refine And.intro
      (closedIntervalGaugeOn_const RealTheory.zero_lt_one) ?_
    intro n left right tag hdiv _htag _hfine
    cases n with
    | zero =>
        unfold partialPrimitiveVariationSum
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
        exact heps
    | succ n =>
        have hleft :
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (left 0) :=
          partialTaggedDivision_left_mem_closedInterval hdiv
            (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)
        exact False.elim
          (hab (RealTheory.le_trans hleft.left hleft.right))
  case pos =>
    let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half C eps
    have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos C heps
    have hfull :
        HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b (primitive b) :=
      hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_hasIntegral hF
        (And.intro hab (RealTheory.le_refl b))
    cases
        exists_henstockAbsErrorSupportGauge_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
          hab hfull he2 with
    | intro errorGauge herrorGauge =>
        let masked : Point -> Point := fun x : Point =>
          if S x then f x else RealTheory.zero
        have hmaskedOff : forall x : Point,
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x -> Not (S x) ->
              masked x = RealTheory.zero := by
          intro x _hx hxS
          simp [masked, hxS]
        cases
            exists_nullSetPartialTaggedAbsSumGauge_of_eq_zero_off
              hab hNull hmaskedOff e2 he2 with
        | intro nullGauge hnullGauge =>
            let delta : Point -> Point := fun x : Point =>
              RealTheory.min (errorGauge x) (nullGauge x)
            refine Exists.intro delta ?_
            have hdelta : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta := by
              unfold delta
              exact
                closedIntervalGaugeOn_min
                  herrorGauge.left hnullGauge.left
            refine And.intro hdelta ?_
            intro n left right tag hdiv htag hfine
            exact by
              let value : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat =>
                RealTheory.sub
                  (primitive (right k)) (primitive (left k))
              have hfineError :
                  GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
                    a b n left right tag errorGauge :=
                And.intro hfine.left
                  (fun k hk y hy =>
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C
                      (hfine.right k hk y hy)
                      (RealTheory.min_le_left
                        (errorGauge (tag k)) (nullGauge (tag k))))
              have hfineNull :
                  GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
                    a b n left right tag nullGauge :=
                And.intro hfine.left
                  (fun k hk y hy =>
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C
                      (hfine.right k hk y hy)
                      (RealTheory.min_le_right
                        (errorGauge (tag k)) (nullGauge (tag k))))
              have hlocal : forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                  HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
                    f (left k) (right k) (value k) := by
                intro k hk
                unfold value
                exact hkIndefinitePrimitiveOn_interval_increment hF
                  (partialTaggedDivision_left_mem_closedInterval hdiv hk)
                  (partialTaggedDivision_right_mem_closedInterval hdiv hk)
                  (partialTaggedDivision_cell_le hdiv hk)
              have herror :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum
                      f left right tag value n)
                    e2 :=
                herrorGauge.right
                  n left right tag value hlocal hdiv hfineError
              have hnullRaw :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (partialTaggedSum
                      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (masked x))
                      left right tag n)
                    e2 :=
                hnullGauge.right n left right tag hfineNull
              have hmaskedSum :
                  partialTaggedSum
                      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (masked x))
                      left right tag n =
                    partialTaggedSum
                      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x))
                      left right tag n := by
                unfold partialTaggedSum
                apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
                intro k hk
                have hkS : S (tag k) := htag k hk
                simp [masked, hkS]
              have hnull :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (partialTaggedSum
                      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x))
                      left right tag n)
                    e2 := by
                rwa [hmaskedSum] at hnullRaw
              have hvariation :
                  RealTheory.le
                    (partialPrimitiveVariationSum
                      primitive left right n)
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum
                        f left right tag value n)
                      (partialTaggedSum
                        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x))
                        left right tag n)) := by
                unfold value
                exact
                  partialPrimitiveVariationSum_le_absError_add_absTaggedSum
                    f primitive hdiv
              have hsum :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum
                        f left right tag value n)
                      (partialTaggedSum
                        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x))
                        left right tag n))
                    (RealTheory.add e2 e2) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add C herror hnull
              have he2sum : RealTheory.add e2 e2 = eps := by
                unfold e2
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half C eps
              rw [he2sum] at hsum
              exact
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C
                  hvariation hsum

name: negligibleVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_of_nullSet
statement:
theorem negligibleVariationOn_of_absolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval_of_nullSet
    {F : Point -> Point} {S : Point -> Prop} {a b : Point}
    (hAC : RealFunction.AbsolutelyContinuousOnClosedInterval F a b)
    (hNull :
      RealNegligibility.NullSet
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) (S x))) :
    NegligibleVariationOn F S a b
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hAC.right eps heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      let budget := thirdBudget eta
      have hbudget_pos :
          RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero budget := by
        exact thirdBudget_pos heta.left
      cases
        exists_nullSetTagCoverGauge_for_closedInterval
          hNull budget hbudget_pos with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          cases hdelta with
          | intro coverLeft hleft =>
              cases hleft with
              | intro coverRight hright =>
                  cases hright with
                  | intro hcover hpack =>
                      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                      refine And.intro hpack.right.left ?_
                      intro n left right tag hdiv htag hfine
                      have hfineCover :
                          GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag
                            (nullSetTagCoverGauge hcover) := by
                        have htmp := hfine
                        rw [hpack.left] at htmp
                        exact htmp
                      have hlength_budget :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealInterval.intervalListLength left right
                              (List.range n))
                            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3) budget) :=
                        partialTaggedDivision_intervalListLength_le_coverLength
                          hcover hpack.right.right.left hdiv htag hfineCover
                      have hlength_eta :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealInterval.intervalListLength left right
                              (List.range n))
                            eta := by
                        have htmp := hlength_budget
                        change
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealInterval.intervalListLength left right
                              (List.range n))
                            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 3)
                              (thirdBudget eta)) at htmp
                        rwa [three_mul_thirdBudget eta] at htmp
                      have hfamily :
                          RealFunction.ACIntervalFamilyOn a b
                            left right (List.range n) :=
                        partialTaggedDivision_acIntervalFamilyOn_range
                          hAC.left hdiv
                      have hACsum :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealFunction.acIntervalIncrementSum F
                              left right (List.range n))
                            eps :=
                        heta.right left right (List.range n)
                          hfamily hlength_eta
                      rwa
                        [partialTaggedDivision_acIncrementSum_eq_partialPrimitiveVariationSum
                          F left right n] at hACsum

name: finiteSum_getD_eq_truncationIndexListSum
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_getD_eq_truncationIndexListSum
    (term : Nat -> Point) (indices : List Nat) (fallback : Nat) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat => term (indices.getD k fallback))
        indices.length =
      truncationIndexListSum term indices
proof:
:= by
  induction indices with
  | nil =>
      change RealTheory.finiteSum _ 0 = RealTheory.zero
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  | cons head tail ih =>
      let projected : Nat -> Point :=
        fun k => term ((head :: tail).getD k fallback)
      let prepended : Nat -> Point := fun k =>
        match k with
        | 0 => term head
        | j + 1 => term (tail.getD j fallback)
      have hterms : forall k : Nat, k < tail.length + 1 ->
          projected k = prepended k := by
        intro k hk
        cases k with
        | zero => simp [projected, prepended, List.getD]
        | succ j => simp [projected, prepended, List.getD]
      have hsum :
          RealTheory.finiteSum projected (tail.length + 1) =
            RealTheory.finiteSum prepended (tail.length + 1) :=
        RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt (tail.length + 1) hterms
      change
        RealTheory.finiteSum projected (tail.length + 1) =
          RealTheory.add (term head)
            (truncationIndexListSum term tail)
      rw [hsum]
      have hprepend :
          RealTheory.finiteSum prepended (tail.length + 1) =
            RealTheory.add (term head)
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat => term (tail.getD k fallback))
                tail.length) := by
        simpa [prepended] using
          (RealTheory.finiteSum_prepend
            (term head)
            (fun k : Nat => term (tail.getD k fallback))
            tail.length)
      rw [hprepend, ih]

name: truncationIndexListSum_append
statement:
private theorem truncationIndexListSum_append
    (term : Nat -> Point) : forall xs ys : List Nat,
    truncationIndexListSum term (xs ++ ys) =
      RealTheory.add
        (truncationIndexListSum term xs)
        (truncationIndexListSum term ys)
  | [], ys => by
      change truncationIndexListSum term ys =
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero (truncationIndexListSum term ys)
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  | x :: xs, ys => by
      change
        RealTheory.add (term x)
            (truncationIndexListSum term (xs ++ ys)) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add (term x) (truncationIndexListSum term xs))
            (truncationIndexListSum term ys)
      rw [truncationIndexListSum_append term xs ys]
      rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]

private theorem truncationIndexListSum_range_eq_finiteSum
    (term : Nat -> Point) : forall n : Nat,
    truncationIndexListSum term (List.range n) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum term n
  | 0 => by
      change RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.finiteSum term 0
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [List.range_succ]
      rw [truncationIndexListSum_append]
      change
        RealTheory.add
            (truncationIndexListSum term (List.range n))
            (RealTheory.add (term n) RealTheory.zero) =
          RealTheory.finiteSum term (n + 1)
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
      rw [truncationIndexListSum_range_eq_finiteSum]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]

name: truncationListFilter_nodup
statement:
private theorem truncationListFilter_nodup
    {alpha : Type u} (predicate : alpha -> Bool) :
    forall {xs : List alpha}, xs.Nodup -> (xs.filter predicate).Nodup
  | [], _hxs => by simp
  | head :: tail, hxs => by
      rw [List.nodup_cons] at hxs
      simp only [List.filter_cons]
      cases hhead : predicate head with
      | false =>
          simpa [hhead] using
            truncationListFilter_nodup predicate hxs.right
      | true =>
          simp only [if_true]
          rw [List.nodup_cons]
          refine And.intro ?_
            (truncationListFilter_nodup predicate hxs.right)
          intro hmem
          exact hxs.left (List.mem_filter.mp hmem).left

private theorem nat_le_foldr_max_of_mem
    {k : Nat} : forall {xs : List Nat}, List.Mem k xs ->
      k <= List.foldr Nat.max 0 xs
  | [], hk => False.elim (List.not_mem_nil hk)
  | head :: tail, hk => by
      cases hk with
      | head => exact Nat.le_max_left _ _
      | tail _ hkTail =>
          exact Nat.le_trans
            (nat_le_foldr_max_of_mem hkTail)
            (Nat.le_max_right _ _)

proof:
:= by

statement:
private theorem binaryMembershipDigit_stream
    (levels : List Nat) :
    RealTheory.BaseDigitStream 2 (binaryMembershipDigit levels)
proof:
:= by
  intro k

name: binaryMembershipPartial_eq_filteredSum
statement:
private theorem binaryMembershipPartial_eq_filteredSum
    (levels : List Nat) : forall n : Nat,
    RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2 (binaryMembershipDigit levels) n =
      truncationIndexListSum
        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1))
        ((List.range n).filter (truncationLevelMember levels))
  | 0 => by
      rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      change
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base 2
            (binaryMembershipDigit levels) (n + 1) = _
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial_succ]
      rw [List.range_succ]
      rw [List.filter_append]
      rw [truncationIndexListSum_append]
      have ih
proof:
:= binaryMembershipPartial_eq_filteredSum levels n
      change
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseExpansionPartial
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base 2
            (binaryMembershipDigit levels) n = _ at ih
      rw [ih]
      by_cases hn : List.Mem n levels
      · have hmember : truncationLevelMember levels n = true := by
          simp [truncationLevelMember, hn]
        unfold binaryMembershipDigit
        rw [hmember]
        simp only [List.filter_cons, List.filter_nil, hmember, if_true]
        change
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.add _
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseWeightedDigit
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base 2 1 n) =
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.add _
              (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.add
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseTail
                  RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base 2 (n + 1))
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.zero)
        rw [RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.add_zero]
        unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseWeightedDigit
        unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseDigitValue
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_one
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base]
        rw [RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one_mul]
      · have hmember : truncationLevelMember levels n = false := by
          simp [truncationLevelMember, hn]
        unfold binaryMembershipDigit
        rw [hmember]
        simp only [List.filter_cons, List.filter_nil, hmember,
          Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        change
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.add _
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseWeightedDigit
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base 2 0 n) =
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.add _
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.zero
        unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseWeightedDigit
        unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.baseDigitValue
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base]
        rw [RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.zero_mul]

name: finiteNodup_binaryBaseTailSum_le_one
statement:
private theorem finiteNodup_binaryBaseTailSum_le_one
    (levels : List Nat) (hlevels : levels.Nodup) :
    RealTheory.le
      (List.foldr RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
        (List.map
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1)) levels))
      RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let maximum := List.foldr Nat.max 0 levels
  let canonical :=
    (List.range (maximum + 1)).filter (truncationLevelMember levels)
  have hcanonicalNodup : canonical.Nodup := by
    unfold canonical
    exact truncationListFilter_nodup
      (truncationLevelMember levels) List.nodup_range
  have hcanonicalMem : forall k : Nat,
      List.Mem k canonical <-> List.Mem k levels := by
    intro k
    constructor
    · intro hk
      unfold canonical at hk
      have hfilter := List.mem_filter.mp hk
      simpa [truncationLevelMember] using hfilter.right
    · intro hk
      unfold canonical
      apply List.mem_filter.mpr
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · apply List.mem_range.mpr
        have hle : k <= maximum := by
          unfold maximum
          exact nat_le_foldr_max_of_mem hk
        omega
      · simp [truncationLevelMember, hk]
  have hperm : levels.Perm canonical := by
    apply List.perm_iff_count.mpr
    intro k
    rw [hlevels.count, hcanonicalNodup.count]
    by_cases hk : k ∈ levels
    · have hkCanonical : k ∈ canonical := (hcanonicalMem k).mpr hk
      simp [hk, hkCanonical]
    · have hkCanonical : Not (k ∈ canonical) := by
        intro hbad
        exact hk ((hcanonicalMem k).mp hbad)
      simp [hk, hkCanonical]
  have hsumPerm :
      truncationIndexListSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1)) levels =
        truncationIndexListSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1)) canonical :=
    truncationIndexListSum_eq_of_perm _ hperm
  have hpartial :
      RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial 2
          (binaryMembershipDigit levels) (maximum + 1) =
        truncationIndexListSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1)) canonical := by
    unfold canonical
    exact binaryMembershipPartial_eq_filteredSum levels (maximum + 1)
  have hvalid : RealTheory.ValidBase 2 := by
    unfold RealTheory.ValidBase IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
    omega
  have hdigits :
      RealTheory.BaseDigitStream 2 (binaryMembershipDigit levels) :=
    binaryMembershipDigit_stream levels
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (truncationIndexListSum
        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1)) levels)
      RealTheory.one
  rw [hsumPerm, <- hpartial]
  exact RealTheory.le_trans
    (RealTheory.baseExpansionPartial_le_maxDigitsPartial
      hvalid hdigits (maximum + 1))
    (by
      rw [RealTheory.maxDigitsPartial_eq_repeatingMaxDigitPartial
        hvalid (maximum + 1)]
      exact RealTheory.repeatingMaxDigitPartial_le_one
        hvalid (maximum + 1))

name: truncationFiberIndices_nodup
statement:
private theorem truncationFiberIndices_nodup
    (total : Nat) (level : Nat -> Nat) (k : Nat) :
    (truncationFiberIndices total level k).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncationFiberIndices
  exact truncationListFilter_nodup
    (truncationFiberMember level k) List.nodup_range

name: truncationFiberIndices_mem_lt_total
statement:
private theorem truncationFiberIndices_mem_lt_total
    {total : Nat} {level : Nat -> Nat} {k i : Nat}
    (hi : List.Mem i (truncationFiberIndices total level k)) :
    i < total
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncationFiberIndices at hi
  exact List.mem_range.mp (List.mem_filter.mp hi).left

name: truncationFiberIndices_mem_level
statement:
private theorem truncationFiberIndices_mem_level
    {total : Nat} {level : Nat -> Nat} {k i : Nat}
    (hi : List.Mem i (truncationFiberIndices total level k)) :
    level i = k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold truncationFiberIndices at hi
  have hmember := (List.mem_filter.mp hi).right
  simpa [truncationFiberMember] using hmember

name: truncationFiberIndices_complete
statement:
private theorem truncationFiberIndices_complete
    {total : Nat} {level : Nat -> Nat} {k i : Nat}
    (hi : i < total) (hilevel : level i = k) :
    List.Mem i (truncationFiberIndices total level k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold truncationFiberIndices
  apply List.mem_filter.mpr
  exact And.intro (List.mem_range.mpr hi)
    (by simp [truncationFiberMember, hilevel])

name: truncationFiberIndices_disjoint
statement:
private theorem truncationFiberIndices_disjoint
    {total : Nat} {level : Nat -> Nat} {k l i : Nat}

    (hil : List.Mem i (truncationFiberIndices total level l)) :

proof:
:= by

  exact truncationFiberIndices_mem_level hil

name: truncationFiber_taggedCellSubpartition
statement:
private theorem truncationFiber_taggedCellSubpartition
    (total : Nat) (level : Nat -> Nat) (k : Nat) :
    TaggedCellSubpartition total
      (truncationFiberCount total level k)
      (truncationFiberIndex total level k)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro j hj
    apply truncationFiberIndices_mem_lt_total
    unfold truncationFiberCount at hj
    unfold truncationFiberIndex
    exact Tautology.List.getD_mem
      (truncationFiberIndices total level k) 0 hj
  · intro j hj
    unfold truncationFiberCount at hj
    unfold truncationFiberIndex
    have hpair :
        List.Pairwise (fun i l : Nat => And (i < l) (l < total))
          (truncationFiberIndices total level k) := by
      unfold truncationFiberIndices
      exact List.Pairwise.filter
        (truncationFiberMember level k)
        (Tautology.List.range_pairwise_lt_lt total)
    exact
      (Tautology.List.getD_step_of_pairwise 0 hpair hj).left

name: truncationFiberIndex_sound
statement:
private theorem truncationFiberIndex_sound
    {total : Nat} {level : Nat -> Nat} {k j : Nat}
    (hj : j < truncationFiberCount total level k) :
    level (truncationFiberIndex total level k j) = k
proof:
:= by
  apply truncationFiberIndices_mem_level
  unfold truncationFiberCount at hj
  unfold truncationFiberIndex
  exact Tautology.List.getD_mem
    (truncationFiberIndices total level k) 0 hj

name: truncationFiberIndex_complete
statement:
private theorem truncationFiberIndex_complete
    {total : Nat} {level : Nat -> Nat} {k i : Nat}
    (hi : i < total) (hilevel : level i = k) :
    Exists (fun j : Nat =>
      And (j < truncationFiberCount total level k)
        (truncationFiberIndex total level k j = i))
proof:
:= by
  have himem :
      List.Mem i (truncationFiberIndices total level k) :=
    truncationFiberIndices_complete hi hilevel
  cases List.mem_iff_getElem.mp himem with
  | intro j hj =>
      cases hj with
      | intro hjlt hjeq =>
          refine Exists.intro j ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · unfold truncationFiberCount
            exact hjlt
          unfold truncationFiberIndex
          rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
          rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hjlt]
          simp [hjeq]

name: truncationOccurringLevels_sound
statement:
private theorem truncationOccurringLevels_sound

proof:

    simpa [truncationLevelMember] using hfilter
  unfold truncationRawLevels at hkRaw

name: truncationOccurringLevels_complete
statement:
private theorem truncationOccurringLevels_complete
    {total : Nat} {level : Nat -> Nat} {i : Nat}
    (hi : i < total) :
    List.Mem (level i) (truncationOccurringLevels total level)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hiRaw :
      List.Mem (level i) (truncationRawLevels total level) :=
    truncationRawLevels_mem hi
  have hle :
      level i <=
        List.foldr Nat.max 0 (truncationRawLevels total level) :=
    nat_le_foldr_max_of_mem hiRaw
  unfold truncationOccurringLevels
  apply List.mem_filter.mpr
  refine And.intro (List.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) ?_
  simp [truncationLevelMember, hiRaw]

name: truncationOccurringLevels_nonempty
