    Not (truncationOccurringLevels total level = [])
proof:
:= by
  intro hempty
  have hmem := truncationOccurringLevels_complete
    (level := level) (i := 0) htotal
  rw [hempty] at hmem
  exact List.not_mem_nil hmem

name: truncationFiberFlatten_mem_iff
statement:
private theorem truncationFiberFlatten_mem_iff
    {total : Nat} {level : Nat -> Nat} {levels : List Nat} {i : Nat} :
    List.Mem i (truncationFiberFlatten total level levels) <->
      And (i < total) (List.Mem (level i) levels)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hi
    unfold truncationFiberFlatten at hi
    cases List.mem_flatten.mp hi with
    | intro fiber hfiber =>
        cases List.mem_map.mp hfiber.left with
        | intro k hk =>
            rw [<- hk.right] at hfiber
            have hiFiber := hfiber.right
            exact And.intro
              (truncationFiberIndices_mem_lt_total hiFiber)
              (by
                rw [truncationFiberIndices_mem_level hiFiber]
                exact hk.left)
  · intro hi
    unfold truncationFiberFlatten
    apply List.mem_flatten.mpr
    refine Exists.intro
      (truncationFiberIndices total level (level i)) ?_
    refine And.intro ?_ ?_
    · apply List.mem_map.mpr
      exact Exists.intro (level i) (And.intro hi.right rfl)
    · exact truncationFiberIndices_complete hi.left rfl

name: truncationFiberFlatten_nodup
statement:
private theorem truncationFiberFlatten_nodup
    (total : Nat) (level : Nat -> Nat) : forall levels : List Nat,
    levels.Nodup ->
      (truncationFiberFlatten total level levels).Nodup
  | [], _hlevels => by
      exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | k :: rest, hlevels => by
      rw [List.nodup_cons] at hlevels
      change
        (truncationFiberIndices total level k ++
          truncationFiberFlatten total level rest).Nodup
      rw [List.nodup_append]
      refine And.intro
        (truncationFiberIndices_nodup total level k) ?_
      refine And.intro
        (truncationFiberFlatten_nodup total level rest hlevels.right) ?_
      intro i hi j hj hij
      subst j
      have hlevelI : level i = k
proof:
:=
        truncationFiberIndices_mem_level hi
      have hiRest := (truncationFiberFlatten_mem_iff.mp hj).right
      exact hlevels.left (by simpa [hlevelI] using hiRest)

name: truncationRange_perm_fiberFlatten
statement:
private theorem truncationRange_perm_fiberFlatten
    {total : Nat} {level : Nat -> Nat} {levels : List Nat}
    (hlevels : levels.Nodup)
    (hcover : forall i : Nat, i < total -> List.Mem (level i) levels) :
    (List.range total).Perm
      (truncationFiberFlatten total level levels)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hflattenNodup :
      (truncationFiberFlatten total level levels).Nodup :=
    truncationFiberFlatten_nodup total level levels hlevels
  apply List.perm_iff_count.mpr
  intro i
  rw [List.nodup_range.count, hflattenNodup.count]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ List.range total
  · have hilt : i < total := List.mem_range.mp hi
    have hiFlatten : i ∈ truncationFiberFlatten total level levels :=
      truncationFiberFlatten_mem_iff.mpr
        (And.intro hilt (hcover i hilt))
    simp [hi, hiFlatten]
  · have hinlt : Not (i < total) := by
      intro hilt
      exact hi (List.mem_range.mpr hilt)
    have hiFlatten : Not (i ∈ truncationFiberFlatten total level levels) := by
      intro hbad
      exact hinlt (truncationFiberFlatten_mem_iff.mp hbad).left
    simp [hi, hiFlatten]

name: truncationIndexListSum_congr
statement:
private theorem truncationIndexListSum_congr
    {term other : Nat -> Point} : forall indices : List Nat,
    (forall i : Nat, List.Mem i indices -> term i = other i) ->
      truncationIndexListSum term indices =
        truncationIndexListSum other indices
  | [], _hterm => rfl
  | i :: rest, hterm => by
      change
        RealTheory.add (term i) (truncationIndexListSum term rest) =
          RealTheory.add (other i) (truncationIndexListSum other rest)
      rw [hterm i (List.Mem.head _)]
      rw [truncationIndexListSum_congr rest
        (fun j hj => hterm j (List.Mem.tail i hj))]

private theorem truncationIndexListSum_flatten_fibers
    (term : Nat -> Point) (total : Nat) (level : Nat -> Nat) :
    forall levels : List Nat,
    truncationIndexListSum term
        (truncationFiberFlatten total level levels) =
      truncationIndexListSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          truncationIndexListSum term
            (truncationFiberIndices total level k))
        levels
  | [] => rfl
  | k :: rest => by
      change
        truncationIndexListSum term
            (truncationFiberIndices total level k ++
              truncationFiberFlatten total level rest) =
          RealTheory.add
            (truncationIndexListSum term
              (truncationFiberIndices total level k))
            (truncationIndexListSum
              (fun l : Nat =>
                truncationIndexListSum term
                  (truncationFiberIndices total level l))
              rest)
      rw [truncationIndexListSum_append]
      rw [truncationIndexListSum_flatten_fibers term total level rest]

private theorem truncationFiber_reindex
    (term : Nat -> Point) (total : Nat) (level : Nat -> Nat)
    (levels : List Nat) (hlevels : levels.Nodup)
    (hcover : forall i : Nat, i < total -> List.Mem (level i) levels) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum term total =
      truncationIndexListSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat =>
              term (truncationFiberIndex total level k j))
            (truncationFiberCount total level k))
        levels
proof:
:= by
  have hperm :
      (List.range total).Perm
        (truncationFiberFlatten total level levels) :=
    truncationRange_perm_fiberFlatten hlevels hcover
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum term total =
        truncationIndexListSum term (List.range total) := by
      exact (truncationIndexListSum_range_eq_finiteSum term total).symm
    _ = truncationIndexListSum term
          (truncationFiberFlatten total level levels) :=
      truncationIndexListSum_eq_of_perm term hperm
    _ = truncationIndexListSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            truncationIndexListSum term
              (truncationFiberIndices total level k)) levels :=
      truncationIndexListSum_flatten_fibers term total level levels
    _ = truncationIndexListSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun j : Nat =>
                term (truncationFiberIndex total level k j))
              (truncationFiberCount total level k)) levels := by
      apply truncationIndexListSum_congr
      intro k _hk
      unfold truncationFiberCount truncationFiberIndex
      exact (finiteSum_getD_eq_truncationIndexListSum
        term (truncationFiberIndices total level k) 0).symm

name: truncationIndexListSum_le
statement:
private theorem truncationIndexListSum_le
    (term bound : Nat -> Point) : forall indices : List Nat,
    (forall i : Nat, List.Mem i indices ->
      RealTheory.le (term i) (bound i)) ->
      RealTheory.le
        (truncationIndexListSum term indices)
        (truncationIndexListSum bound indices)
  | [], _hterm => RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  | i :: rest, hterm => by
      change
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.add (term i) (truncationIndexListSum term rest))
          (RealTheory.add (bound i) (truncationIndexListSum bound rest))
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (hterm i (List.Mem.head _))
        (truncationIndexListSum_le term bound rest
          (fun j hj => hterm j (List.Mem.tail i hj)))

private theorem truncationIndexListSum_lt_of_nonempty
    (term bound : Nat -> Point) {indices : List Nat}
    (hnonempty : Not (indices = []))
    (hterm : forall i : Nat, List.Mem i indices ->
      RealTheory.lt (term i) (bound i)) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (truncationIndexListSum term indices)
      (truncationIndexListSum bound indices)
proof:
:= by
  cases indices with
  | nil => exact False.elim (hnonempty rfl)
  | cons i rest =>
      change
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.add (term i) (truncationIndexListSum term rest))
          (RealTheory.add (bound i) (truncationIndexListSum bound rest))
      have hhead : RealTheory.lt (term i) (bound i) :=
        hterm i (List.Mem.head _)
      have htail :
          RealTheory.le
            (truncationIndexListSum term rest)
            (truncationIndexListSum bound rest) :=
        truncationIndexListSum_le term bound rest
          (fun j hj =>
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
              (hterm j (List.Mem.tail i hj)))
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hhead
          (truncationIndexListSum term rest))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (RealTheory.le_refl (bound i)) htail)

name: truncationIndexListSum_lt_of_nonempty
statement:

name: truncationIndexListSum_mul_left
statement:
private theorem truncationIndexListSum_mul_left
    (c : Point) (term : Nat -> Point) : forall indices : List Nat,
    truncationIndexListSum
        (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul c (term i)) indices =
      RealTheory.mul c (truncationIndexListSum term indices)
  | [] => by
      change RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.mul c RealTheory.zero
      rw [RealTheory.mul_zero]
  | i :: rest => by
      change
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul c (term i))
            (truncationIndexListSum
              (fun j : Nat => RealTheory.mul c (term j)) rest) =
          RealTheory.mul c
            (RealTheory.add (term i) (truncationIndexListSum term rest))
      rw [truncationIndexListSum_mul_left c term rest]
      rw [RealTheory.mul_add]


private theorem truncationIndexListSum_indicator_eq_filter
    (term : Nat -> Point) (level : Nat -> Nat) (k : Nat) :
    forall indices : List Nat,
      truncationIndexListSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            if level i = k then term i else RealTheory.zero)
          indices =
        truncationIndexListSum term
          (indices.filter (truncationFiberMember level k))
  | [] => rfl
  | i :: rest => by
      change
        RealTheory.add
            (if level i = k then term i else RealTheory.zero)
            (truncationIndexListSum
              (fun j : Nat =>
                if level j = k then term j else RealTheory.zero)
              rest) =
          truncationIndexListSum term
            ((i :: rest).filter (truncationFiberMember level k))
      rw [truncationIndexListSum_indicator_eq_filter term level k rest]
      by_cases hi : level i = k
      · have hmember : truncationFiberMember level k i = true
proof:
:= by
          simp [truncationFiberMember, hi]
        simp only [hi, if_true, List.filter_cons, hmember]
        rfl
      · have hmember : truncationFiberMember level k i = false := by
          simp [truncationFiberMember, hi]
        simp only [hi, if_false, List.filter_cons, hmember,
          Bool.false_eq_true]
        rw [RealTheory.zero_add]

name: truncationIndexListSum_indicator_eq_filter
statement:
private theorem truncationIndexListSum_indicator_eq_filter
    (term : Nat -> Point) (level : Nat -> Nat) (k : Nat) :
    forall indices : List Nat,
      truncationIndexListSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            if level i = k then term i else RealTheory.zero)
          indices =
        truncationIndexListSum term
          (indices.filter (truncationFiberMember level k))
  | [] => rfl
  | i :: rest => by
      change
        RealTheory.add
            (if level i = k then term i else RealTheory.zero)
            (truncationIndexListSum
              (fun j : Nat =>
                if level j = k then term j else RealTheory.zero)
              rest) =
          truncationIndexListSum term
            ((i :: rest).filter (truncationFiberMember level k))
      rw [truncationIndexListSum_indicator_eq_filter term level k rest]
      by_cases hi : level i = k
      · have hmember : truncationFiberMember level k i = true
proof:
:= by
          simp [truncationFiberMember, hi]
        simp only [hi, if_true, List.filter_cons, hmember]
        rfl
      · have hmember : truncationFiberMember level k i = false := by
          simp [truncationFiberMember, hi]
        simp only [hi, if_false, List.filter_cons, hmember,
          Bool.false_eq_true]
        rw [RealTheory.zero_add]

name: finiteSum_levelFiber_eq_reindexed
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_levelFiber_eq_reindexed
    (term : Nat -> Point) (total : Nat) (level : Nat -> Nat) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat =>
          if level i = k then term i else RealTheory.zero)
        total =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          term (truncationFiberIndex total level k j))
        (truncationFiberCount total level k)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat =>
          if level i = k then term i else RealTheory.zero)
        total =
        truncationIndexListSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            if level i = k then term i else RealTheory.zero)
          (List.range total) := by
      exact
        (truncationIndexListSum_range_eq_finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            if level i = k then term i else RealTheory.zero)
          total).symm
    _ = truncationIndexListSum term
          (truncationFiberIndices total level k) := by
      exact truncationIndexListSum_indicator_eq_filter
        term level k (List.range total)
    _ = RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            term (truncationFiberIndex total level k j))
          (truncationFiberCount total level k) := by
      unfold truncationFiberCount truncationFiberIndex
      exact
        (finiteSum_getD_eq_truncationIndexListSum
          term (truncationFiberIndices total level k) 0).symm

name: exists_levelFiber_taggedCellSubpartition
statement:
theorem exists_levelFiber_taggedCellSubpartition
    (total : Nat) (level : Nat -> Nat) (k : Nat) :
    Exists (fun selected : Nat =>
      Exists (fun index : Nat -> Nat =>
        And (TaggedCellSubpartition total selected index)
          (And
            (forall j : Nat, j < selected -> level (index j) = k)
            (forall term : Nat -> Point,
              RealTheory.finiteSum
                  (fun i : Nat =>
                    if level i = k then term i else RealTheory.zero)
                  total =
                RealTheory.finiteSum
                  (fun j : Nat => term (index j)) selected))))
proof:
:= by

  refine Exists.intro (truncationFiberCount total level k) ?_
  refine Exists.intro (truncationFiberIndex total level k) ?_
  refine And.intro
    (truncationFiber_taggedCellSubpartition total level k) ?_
  exact And.intro
    (fun _j hj => truncationFiberIndex_sound hj)
    (fun term => finiteSum_levelFiber_eq_reindexed term total level k)

name: taggedCellSubpartition_gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivisionOn_of_gauge_le
statement:
theorem taggedCellSubpartition_gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivisionOn_of_gauge_le
    {a b l r : Point} {total selected : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point} {index : Nat -> Nat}
    {delta gamma : Point -> Point}
    (hfine : GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b total p tag delta)
    (hsub : TaggedCellSubpartition total selected index)
    (hleft :
      forall k : Nat, k < selected ->
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval l r (subpartitionLeft p index k))
    (hright :
      forall k : Nat, k < selected ->
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval l r (subpartitionRight p index k))
    (hgaugeLe :
      forall k : Nat, k < selected ->
        RealTheory.le
          (delta (subpartitionTags tag index k))
          (gamma (subpartitionTags tag index k))) :
    GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision l r selected
      (subpartitionLeft p index)
      (subpartitionRight p index)
      (subpartitionTags tag index) gamma
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro
    (taggedCellSubpartition_partialTaggedDivisionOn
      hfine.left hsub hleft hright) ?_
  intro k hk
  have hidx : index k < total := hsub.left k hk
  unfold GaugeFinePartialCell
  intro y hy
  unfold PartialCell subpartitionLeft subpartitionRight at hy
  unfold subpartitionTags
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (hfine.right (index k) hidx y hy)
    (by simpa [subpartitionTags] using hgaugeLe k hk)

name: finiteSum_lt_of_levelFiber_geometric_bounds
statement:
theorem finiteSum_lt_of_levelFiber_geometric_bounds
    {term : Nat -> Point} {total : Nat} {level : Nat -> Nat}
    {eps : Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    (hfiber : forall k : Nat,
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            if level i = k then term i else RealTheory.zero)
          total)
        (RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1)))) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.finiteSum term total) eps
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases htotal : total = 0
  · rw [htotal, RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
    exact heps
  · have htotalPos : 0 < total := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero htotal
    let levels : List Nat := truncationOccurringLevels total level
    have hlevelsNodup : levels.Nodup := by
      unfold levels
      exact truncationOccurringLevels_nodup total level
    have hlevelsCover : forall i : Nat, i < total ->
        List.Mem (level i) levels := by
      intro i hi
      unfold levels
      exact truncationOccurringLevels_complete hi
    have hlevelsNonempty : Not (levels = []) := by
      unfold levels
      exact truncationOccurringLevels_nonempty htotalPos
    let fiberSum : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat =>
          if level i = k then term i else RealTheory.zero)
        total
    have hsum :
        RealTheory.finiteSum term total =
          truncationIndexListSum fiberSum levels := by
      have hreindex :=
        truncationFiber_reindex
          term total level levels hlevelsNodup hlevelsCover
      rw [hreindex]
      apply truncationIndexListSum_congr
      intro k _hk
      unfold fiberSum
      exact (finiteSum_levelFiber_eq_reindexed
        term total level k).symm
    have hstrict :
        RealTheory.lt
          (truncationIndexListSum fiberSum levels)
          (truncationIndexListSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1)))
            levels) :=
      truncationIndexListSum_lt_of_nonempty
        fiberSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1)))
        hlevelsNonempty
        (fun k _hk => hfiber k)
    have htailLe :=
      finiteNodup_binaryBaseTailSum_le_one levels hlevelsNodup
    have hbudgetEq :=
      truncationIndexListSum_mul_left eps
        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1)) levels
    have hepsNonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base heps
    have hscaledLe :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base htailLe hepsNonneg
    have hbudgetLe :
        RealTheory.le
          (truncationIndexListSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul eps (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1)))
            levels)
          eps := by
      rw [hbudgetEq]
      change
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul eps _) eps
      change
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul eps _)
          (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul eps
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one)
        at hscaledLe
      rwa [RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul_one] at hscaledLe
    rw [hsum]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hstrict hbudgetLe

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_add
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_add
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hf : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b I)
    (hg : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn g a b J) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.add (f x) (g x))
      a b (RealTheory.add I J)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hf.right e2 he2 with
  | intro deltaF hdeltaF =>
      cases hg.right e2 he2 with
      | intro deltaG hdeltaG =>
          let delta :=
            fun x : Point => RealTheory.min (deltaF x) (deltaG x)
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro
            (closedIntervalGaugeOn_min hdeltaF.left hdeltaG.left) ?_
          intro n p tag hfine
          have hfineF :
              GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag deltaF :=
            gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le hfine
              (fun x : Point =>
                RealTheory.min_le_left (deltaF x) (deltaG x))
          have hfineG :
              GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag deltaG :=
            gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le hfine
              (fun x : Point =>
                RealTheory.min_le_right (deltaF x) (deltaG x))
          let Sf := taggedSum f p tag n
          let Sg := taggedSum g p tag n
          have hcloseF :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sf I)) e2 := by
            dsimp [Sf]
            exact hdeltaF.right n p tag hfineF
          have hcloseG :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sg J)) e2 := by
            dsimp [Sg]
            exact hdeltaG.right n p tag hfineG
          rw [taggedSum_add]
          change
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.add Sf Sg)
                  (RealTheory.add I J)))
              eps
          have htri :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealTheory.add Sf Sg)
                    (RealTheory.add I J)))
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sf I))
                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sg J))) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_sub_add_le_abs_sub_add_abs_sub
              F Sf Sg I J
          have hsum :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sf I))
                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sg J)))
                eps := by
            have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hcloseF hcloseG
            change
              F.lt
                (F.add
                  (RealTheory.abs (F.sub Sf I))
                  (RealTheory.abs (F.sub Sg J)))
                (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
            rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hadd
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_mul_left
    (c : Point) {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}

      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul c (f x))
      a b (RealTheory.mul c I)
proof:

  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F c heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases hf.right eta heta.left with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          intro n p tag hfine
          let Sf := taggedSum f p tag n
          have hclose :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sf I)) eta := by
            dsimp [Sf]

          change

            RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hclose)
              (RealTheory.abs_nonneg c)
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hmul_le heta.right

name: exists_adjacent_ordered_positiveGauge
statement:
private theorem exists_adjacent_ordered_positiveGauge
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b I J eps : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hleft : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a c I)
    (hright : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f c b J)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point -> Point =>
        And (ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta)
          (forall (n : Nat) (p tag : Nat -> Point),
            0 < n ->
              GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag delta ->
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (taggedSum f p tag n)
                      (RealTheory.add I J)))
                  eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hleft.right e2 he2 with
  | intro deltaLeft hdeltaLeft =>
      cases hright.right e2 he2 with
      | intro deltaRight hdeltaRight =>
          let delta := cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro
            (closedIntervalGaugeOn_cutAdaptedGauge
              hac hcb hdeltaLeft.left hdeltaRight.left) ?_
          intro n p tag hn hfine
          cases
              exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cutCellSplit_of_pos
                hfine hn (And.intro hac hcb) with
          | intro k hkdata =>
              have hk : k < n := hkdata.left
              have hcut : PartitionCell p k c := hkdata.right.left
              have hleftFine :
                  GaugeFineTaggedPartition a c (k + 1)
                    (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
                    (cutCellPrefixTags tag k c)
                    deltaLeft :=
                hkdata.right.right.left
              have hrightFine :
                  GaugeFineTaggedPartition c b (n - k)
                    (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)
                    (cutCellSuffixTags tag k c)
                    deltaRight :=
                hkdata.right.right.right
              have htagc : tag k = c :=
                gaugeFineCell_cutAdaptedGauge_tag_eq_of_mem_cut
                  (hfine.right k hk) hcut
              let Sleft :=
                taggedSum f
                  (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
                  (cutCellPrefixTags tag k c)
                  (k + 1)
              let Sright :=
                taggedSum f
                  (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)
                  (cutCellSuffixTags tag k c)
                  (n - k)
              have hcloseLeft :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sleft I)) e2 := by
                dsimp [Sleft]
                exact hdeltaLeft.right (k + 1)
                  (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
                  (cutCellPrefixTags tag k c)
                  hleftFine
              have hcloseRight :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sright J)) e2 := by
                dsimp [Sright]
                exact hdeltaRight.right (n - k)
                  (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)
                  (cutCellSuffixTags tag k c)
                  hrightFine
              rw [taggedSum_cutCellSplit f hk htagc]
              change
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (RealTheory.add Sleft Sright)
                      (RealTheory.add I J)))
                  eps
              have htri :
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (RealTheory.sub
                        (RealTheory.add Sleft Sright)
                        (RealTheory.add I J)))
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sleft I))
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sright J))) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_sub_add_le_abs_sub_add_abs_sub
                  F Sleft Sright I J
              have hsum :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sleft I))
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sright J)))
                    eps := by
                have hadd :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                    F hcloseLeft hcloseRight
                change
                  F.lt
                    (F.add
                      (RealTheory.abs (F.sub Sleft I))
                      (RealTheory.abs (F.sub Sright J)))
                    (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hadd
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_adjacent_ordered
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_adjacent_ordered
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b I J : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hleft : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a c I)
    (hright : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f c b J) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b (RealTheory.add I J)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (RealTheory.le_trans hac hcb) ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases
      exists_adjacent_ordered_positiveGauge
        hac hcb hleft hright heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro n p tag hfine
      by_cases hn : 0 < n
      case pos =>
        exact hdelta.right n p tag hn hfine
      case neg =>
        have hn_zero : n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn
        subst n
        have hab_eq : a = b := by
          have hleftEndpoint :
              p 0 = a :=
            intervalPartition_left_endpoint hfine.left.left
          have hrightEndpoint :
              p 0 = b :=
            intervalPartition_right_endpoint hfine.left.left
          rw [<- hleftEndpoint, <- hrightEndpoint]
        have hca : RealTheory.le c a := by
          rwa [hab_eq]
        have hac_eq : a = c :=
          RealTheory.le_antisymm hac hca
        have hcb_eq : c = b := by
          calc
            c = a := Eq.symm hac_eq
            _ = b := hab_eq
        have hI_zero : I = RealTheory.zero := by
          have hleftDeg :
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a a I := by
            rw [<- hac_eq] at hleft
            exact hleft
          exact
            hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
              hleftDeg
              (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_degenerate f a)
        have hJ_zero : J = RealTheory.zero := by
          have hrightDeg :
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f b b J := by
            rw [hcb_eq] at hright
            exact hright
          exact
            hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
              hrightDeg
              (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_degenerate f b)
        have htaggedDeg :
            TaggedPartition a a 0 p tag := by
          have htagged :
              TaggedPartition a b 0 p tag := hfine.left
          rwa [<- hab_eq] at htagged
        rw [taggedSum_eq_zero_of_degenerate htaggedDeg]
        rw [hI_zero, hJ_zero]
        have hzeroAbs :
            RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)) =
              RealTheory.zero := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_zero RealTheory.zero]
          change
            RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub
                RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero) =
              RealTheory.zero
          exact RealTheory.abs_sub_self RealTheory.zero
        rw [hzeroAbs]
        exact heps

name: exists_partitionCellHKIntegralValues_sum_eq
statement:
theorem exists_partitionCellHKIntegralValues_sum_eq
    {g : Point -> Point} {a b A : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hG : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn g a b A)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    Exists
      (fun cellA : Nat -> Point =>
        And
          (forall k : Nat, k < n ->
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn g (p k) (p (k + 1))
              (cellA k))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum cellA n = A))
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing a b A p with
  | zero =>
      let cellA : Nat -> Point := fun _ : Nat => RealTheory.zero
      refine Exists.intro cellA ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · intro k hk
        exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk)
      · have hab_eq : a = b := by
          calc
            a = p 0 := Eq.symm (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hp)
            _ = b := intervalPartition_right_endpoint hp
        have hGdeg :
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn g a a A := by
          rwa [<- hab_eq] at hG
        have hA_zero : A = RealTheory.zero :=
          hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
            hGdeg
            (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_degenerate g a)
        rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
        exact Eq.symm hA_zero
  | succ n ih =>
      have hcut_mem :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p n) :=
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval
          hp (Nat.le_succ n)
      have hp_prefix :
          IntervalPartition a (p n) n p :=
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_prefix
          hp (Nat.le_succ n)
      cases
          exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_subinterval
            (RealTheory.le_refl a) hcut_mem.left hcut_mem.right hG with
      | intro prefixValue hprefix =>
          cases
              exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_subinterval
                hcut_mem.left hcut_mem.right (RealTheory.le_refl b) hG with
          | intro lastValue hlast =>
              cases ih hprefix hp_prefix with
              | intro prefixCell hprefixCell =>
                  let cellA : Nat -> Point :=
                    fun k : Nat =>
                      if h : k < n then prefixCell k else lastValue
                  refine Exists.intro cellA ?_
                  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                  · intro k hk
                    by_cases hkn : k < n
                    · unfold cellA
                      rw [dif_pos hkn]
                      exact hprefixCell.left k hkn
                    · have hk_eq :
                          k = n :=
                        Nat.eq_of_lt_succ_of_not_lt hk hkn
                      subst k
                      unfold cellA
                      rw [dif_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl n)]
                      rw [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hp]
                      exact hlast
                  · have hsum_prefix :
                        RealTheory.finiteSum cellA n = prefixValue := by
                      calc
                        RealTheory.finiteSum cellA n =
                            RealTheory.finiteSum prefixCell n := by
                            exact
                              RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt n
                                (fun k hk => by
                                  unfold cellA
                                  rw [dif_pos hk])
                        _ = prefixValue := hprefixCell.right
                    have hlast_value : cellA n = lastValue := by
                      unfold cellA
                      rw [dif_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl n)]
                    have hA_sum :
                        A = RealTheory.add prefixValue lastValue :=
                      hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_eq_add_of_adjacent_ordered
                        hcut_mem.left hcut_mem.right hG hprefix hlast
                    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
                    rw [hsum_prefix, hlast_value]
                    exact Eq.symm hA_sum

  | inr hreverse =>

name: hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_value_unique
statement:
theorem hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_value_unique
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hI : HasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b I)
    (hJ : HasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b J) :
    I = J
proof:
:= by
  cases hI with
  | inl hIforward =>
      cases hJ with
      | inl hJforward =>
          exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
            hIforward.right hJforward.right
      | inr hJreverse =>
          cases hJreverse with
          | intro K hK =>
              have hab_eq : a = b :=
                RealTheory.le_antisymm hIforward.left hK.left
              subst b
              have hIzero : I = RealTheory.zero :=
                hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                  (Or.inl hIforward)
              have hJzero : J = RealTheory.zero :=
                hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                  (Or.inr (Exists.intro K hK))
              rw [hIzero, hJzero]
  | inr hIreverse =>
      cases hIreverse with
      | intro K hK =>
          cases hJ with
          | inl hJforward =>
              have hab_eq : a = b :=
                RealTheory.le_antisymm hJforward.left hK.left
              subst b
              have hIzero : I = RealTheory.zero :=
                hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                  (Or.inr (Exists.intro K hK))
              have hJzero : J = RealTheory.zero :=
                hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                  (Or.inl hJforward)
              rw [hIzero, hJzero]
          | inr hJreverse =>
              cases hJreverse with
              | intro L hL =>
                  have hKL : K = L :=
                    hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
                      hK.right.left hL.right.left
                  rw [hK.right.right, hL.right.right, hKL]

name: hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_const_of_ge
statement:
theorem hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_const_of_ge
    {a b c : Point} (hba : RealTheory.le b a) :
    HasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
      (fun _ : Point => c) a b
      (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:= by
  have hconst :
      HasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        (fun _ : Point => c) a b
        (RealTheory.neg
          (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub a b))) :=
    hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_ge hba
      (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_const_of_le (c := c) hba)
  have hvalue :
      RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub a b)) =
        RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a) := by
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    change F.neg (F.mul c (F.sub a b)) = F.mul c (F.sub b a)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F a b]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F]
  rwa [hvalue] at hconst

    (a b : Point) :
    OrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn
      (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero) a b

:=
  Exists.intro RealTheory.zero
    (hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_zero a b)

name: hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_adjacent_ordered
statement:
theorem hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_adjacent_ordered

    (hright : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f c b J) :
    HasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
      f a b (RealTheory.add I J)
proof:
:=
  hasOrientedHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_le
    (RealTheory.le_trans hac hcb)
    (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_adjacent_ordered
      hac hcb hleft hright)

name: hkNonnegativeTruncation_nonnegative
statement:
theorem hkNonnegativeTruncation_nonnegative
    {h : Point -> Point}
    (hnonneg : forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (h x))
    (n : Nat) (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (hkNonnegativeTruncation h n x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hkNonnegativeTruncation
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_min2
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (hnonneg x) (RealTheory.nat_nonneg (n + 1))

name: hkNonnegativeTruncation_le_self
statement:
theorem hkNonnegativeTruncation_le_self
    (h : Point -> Point) (n : Nat) (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le (hkNonnegativeTruncation h n x) (h x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hkNonnegativeTruncation
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))

name: hkNonnegativeTruncation_le_level
statement:
theorem hkNonnegativeTruncation_le_level
    (h : Point -> Point) (n : Nat) (x : Point) :

      (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
proof:

    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))

name: hkNonnegativeTruncation_mono
statement:
theorem hkNonnegativeTruncation_mono
    (h : Point -> Point) {m n : Nat}
    (hmn : m <= n) (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le (hkNonnegativeTruncation h m x)
      (hkNonnegativeTruncation h n x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hkNonnegativeTruncation
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_min2
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (h x) (RealTheory.nat (m + 1))
  · exact RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (h x) (RealTheory.nat (m + 1)))
      (RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (by omega))

name: hkNonnegativeTruncation_tail_nonnegative
statement:
theorem hkNonnegativeTruncation_tail_nonnegative
    (h : Point -> Point) (n : Nat) (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.sub (h x) (hkNonnegativeTruncation h n x))
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (hkNonnegativeTruncation_le_self h n x)

name: exists_hkNonnegativeTruncation_eq_value
statement:
private theorem exists_hkNonnegativeTruncation_eq_value
    (h : Point -> Point) (x : Point) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat =>
      hkNonnegativeTruncation h n x = h x)
proof:
:= by
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_gt (h x) with
  | intro n hn =>
      refine Exists.intro n ?_
      unfold hkNonnegativeTruncation
      unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2
      rw [if_pos]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hn
          (RealTheory.nat_le_nat_succ n))

name: add_sub_sub_same_left
statement:
private theorem add_sub_sub_same_left
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add x y) (RealTheory.sub x y) =
      RealTheory.add y y
proof:
:= by
  let OF := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change OF.sub (OF.add x y) (OF.sub x y) = OF.add y y
  rw [OF.sub_eq_add_neg, OF.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib OF x (OF.neg y)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg OF y]
  calc
    OF.add (OF.add x y) (OF.add (OF.neg x) y) =
        OF.add x (OF.add y (OF.add (OF.neg x) y)) := by
      rw [OF.add_assoc]
    _ = OF.add x (OF.add (OF.neg x) (OF.add y y)) := by
      rw [<- OF.add_assoc y (OF.neg x) y]
      rw [OF.add_comm y (OF.neg x)]
      rw [OF.add_assoc]
    _ = OF.add (OF.add x (OF.neg x)) (OF.add y y) := by
      rw [OF.add_assoc]
    _ = OF.add OF.zero (OF.add y y) := by
      rw [OF.add_neg]
    _ = OF.add y y := by
      rw [OF.zero_add]

name: add_sub_sub_same_right
statement:
private theorem add_sub_sub_same_right
    (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.add x y) (RealTheory.sub y x) =
      RealTheory.add x x
proof:
:= by
  let OF := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change OF.sub (OF.add x y) (OF.sub y x) = OF.add x x
  rw [OF.add_comm x y]
  exact add_sub_sub_same_left y x

name: invTwo_mul_add_self
statement:
private theorem invTwo_mul_add_self
    (x : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.inv
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base))
        (RealTheory.add x x) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  let OF := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    OF.mul (OF.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two OF)) (OF.add x x) = x
  rw [OF.mul_add]
  rw [OF.mul_comm (OF.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two OF)) x]
  change
    OF.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half OF x)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half OF x) = x
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half OF x

name: hkNonnegativeTruncation_eq_abs_formula
statement:
private theorem hkNonnegativeTruncation_eq_abs_formula
    (h : Point -> Point) (n : Nat) (x : Point) :
    hkNonnegativeTruncation h n x =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.inv
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base))
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.add (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let OF := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold hkNonnegativeTruncation
  unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2
  change
    (if OF.le (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) then
      h x
    else
      RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) =
      OF.mul (OF.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two OF))
        (OF.sub
          (OF.add (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (OF.sub (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))))
  by_cases hle : OF.le (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
  · rw [if_pos hle]
    have hnonpos :
        OF.le
          (OF.sub (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
          OF.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le OF hle
    rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonpos hnonpos]
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub OF
      (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))]
    have halg :=
      add_sub_sub_same_right (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
    change
      OF.sub (OF.add (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
          (OF.sub (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (h x)) =
        OF.add (h x) (h x) at halg
    rw [halg]
    have hinv := invTwo_mul_add_self (h x)
    change
      OF.mul (OF.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two OF))
          (OF.add (h x) (h x)) = h x at hinv
    exact hinv.symm
  · rw [if_neg hle]
    have hlevel : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (h x) := by
      cases OF.le_total (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (h x) with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr h => exact False.elim (hle h)
    have hnonneg :
        OF.le OF.zero
          (OF.sub (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le OF hlevel
    rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
    have halg :=
      add_sub_sub_same_left (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
    change
      OF.sub (OF.add (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
          (OF.sub (h x) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))) =
        OF.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) at halg
    rw [halg]
    have hinv := invTwo_mul_add_self (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
    change
      OF.mul (OF.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two OF))
          (OF.add (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))) =
        RealTheory.nat (n + 1) at hinv
    exact hinv.symm

name: henstockKurzweilIntegrableOn_hkNonnegativeTruncation
statement:
theorem henstockKurzweilIntegrableOn_hkNonnegativeTruncation
    {h : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hnonneg : forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (h x))
    (hh : HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn h a b)
    (n : Nat) :
    HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn
      (hkNonnegativeTruncation h n) a b
proof:
:= by
  let OF := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let level : Point := RealTheory.nat (n + 1)
  let levelFun := fun _x : Point => level
  have hlevel : HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn levelFun a b := by
    refine Exists.intro
      (RealTheory.mul level (RealTheory.sub b a)) ?_
    unfold levelFun
    exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_const_of_le (c := level) hab
  have habsH : HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn (HKAbsFun h) a b :=
    henstockKurzweilIntegrableOn_congr_fun
      (f := h) (g := HKAbsFun h)
      (fun x : Point => by
        unfold HKAbsFun
        exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg (hnonneg x)))
      hh
  have habsoluteH : HKAbsolutelyIntegrableOn h a b :=
    hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn_intro hh habsH
  have habsLevel :
      HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn (HKAbsFun levelFun) a b :=
    henstockKurzweilIntegrableOn_congr_fun
      (f := levelFun) (g := HKAbsFun levelFun)
      (fun _x : Point => by
        unfold HKAbsFun levelFun level
        exact Eq.symm
          (RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg (n + 1))))
      hlevel
  have habsoluteLevel : HKAbsolutelyIntegrableOn levelFun a b :=
    hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn_intro hlevel habsLevel
  have habsoluteDifference :
      HKAbsolutelyIntegrableOn
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (h x) (levelFun x)) a b :=
    hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn_sub hab habsoluteH habsoluteLevel
  have hsum :
      HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.add (h x) (levelFun x)) a b :=
    henstockKurzweilIntegrableOn_add hh hlevel
  have hcore :
      HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.add (h x) (levelFun x))
            (HKAbsFun
              (fun y : Point => RealTheory.sub (h y) (levelFun y)) x))
        a b :=
    henstockKurzweilIntegrableOn_sub hsum
      (hkAbsolutelyIntegrableOn_abs_integrable habsoluteDifference)
  let halfScalar : Point :=
    RealTheory.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two OF)
  have hscaled :
      HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.mul halfScalar
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.add (h x) (levelFun x))
              (HKAbsFun
                (fun y : Point => RealTheory.sub (h y) (levelFun y)) x)))
        a b :=
    henstockKurzweilIntegrableOn_mul_left halfScalar hcore
  exact henstockKurzweilIntegrableOn_congr_fun
    (f := fun x : Point =>
      RealTheory.mul halfScalar
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.add (h x) (levelFun x))
          (HKAbsFun
            (fun y : Point => RealTheory.sub (h y) (levelFun y)) x)))
    (g := hkNonnegativeTruncation h n)
    (fun x : Point => by
      unfold halfScalar levelFun level HKAbsFun
      exact (hkNonnegativeTruncation_eq_abs_formula h n x).symm)
    hscaled

name: exists_hkNonnegativeTruncation_tailIntegral_lt
statement:
theorem exists_hkNonnegativeTruncation_tailIntegral_lt
    {h : Point -> Point} {a b H eps : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hnonneg : forall x : Point,
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (h x))
    (hH : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn h a b H)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat =>
      Exists (fun E : Point =>
        And
          (HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn
            (hkNonnegativeTruncation h n) a b)
          (And
            (HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
              (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub
                (h x) (hkNonnegativeTruncation h n x))
              a b E)
            (RealTheory.lt E eps))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hh : HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn h a b :=
    Exists.intro H hH
  by_cases habEq : a = b
  · subst b
    refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
    refine Exists.intro RealTheory.zero ?_
    refine And.intro
      (henstockKurzweilIntegrableOn_hkNonnegativeTruncation
        hab hnonneg hh 0) ?_
    exact And.intro
      (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_degenerate
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub
          (h x) (hkNonnegativeTruncation h 0 x)) a)
      heps
  · have htruncIntegrable : forall n : Nat,
        HenstockKurzweilIntegrableOn
          (hkNonnegativeTruncation h n) a b :=
      fun n => henstockKurzweilIntegrableOn_hkNonnegativeTruncation
        hab hnonneg hh n
    let Hn : Nat -> Point := fun n : Nat =>
      Classical.choose (htruncIntegrable n)
    have hHn : forall n : Nat,
        HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
          (hkNonnegativeTruncation h n) a b (Hn n) := by
      intro n
      exact Classical.choose_spec (htruncIntegrable n)
    have hHnMono : RealTheory.MonotoneIncreasing Hn := by
      intro m n hmn
      exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
        hab
        (fun x : Point => hkNonnegativeTruncation_mono h hmn x)
        (hHn m) (hHn n)
    have hHnLeH : forall n : Nat, RealTheory.le (Hn n) H := by
      intro n
      exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
        hab
        (fun x : Point => hkNonnegativeTruncation_le_self h n x)
        (hHn n) hH
    have hHnBounded : RealTheory.SeqBoundedAbove Hn :=
      Exists.intro H hHnLeH
    cases RealTheory.monotone_increasing_converges
        hHnMono hHnBounded with
    | intro L hHnTends =>
      have hHnLeL : forall n : Nat, RealTheory.le (Hn n) L := by
        intro n
        apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le
          (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const (Hn n)) hHnTends
        refine Exists.intro n ?_
        intro m hm
        exact hHnMono n m hm
      have hLLeH : RealTheory.le L H := by
        apply RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le
          hHnTends (RealTheory.seqTendsto_const H)
        refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
        intro n _hn
        exact hHnLeH n
      have hHLtAdd : forall eta : Point,
          RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta ->
            RealTheory.lt H (RealTheory.add L eta) := by
        intro eta heta
        let halfEta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eta
        have hhalfEta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero halfEta :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heta
        have hvalidTwo : RealTheory.ValidBase 2 := by
          unfold RealTheory.ValidBase IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
          omega
        cases hH.right halfEta hhalfEta with
        | intro deltaH hdeltaH =>
          have hsupportBudgetPos : forall k : Nat,
              RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                (RealTheory.mul halfEta
                  (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1))) := by
            intro k
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F hhalfEta
              (RealTheory.baseTail_pos hvalidTwo (k + 1))
          let supportWitness := fun k : Nat =>
            exists_henstockAbsErrorSupportGauge_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
              hab (hHn k) (hsupportBudgetPos k)
          let supportGauge : Nat -> Point -> Point := fun k : Nat =>
            Classical.choose (supportWitness k)
          have hsupportGauge : forall k : Nat,
              ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b (supportGauge k) := by
            intro k
            exact (Classical.choose_spec (supportWitness k)).left
          have hsupportBound : forall k : Nat,
              forall (n : Nat) (left right tag value : Nat -> Point),
                (forall j : Nat, j < n ->
                  HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
                    (hkNonnegativeTruncation h k)
                    (left j) (right j) (value j)) ->
                PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag ->
                GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
                  a b n left right tag (supportGauge k) ->
                RealTheory.lt
                  (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum
                    (hkNonnegativeTruncation h k)
                    left right tag value n)
                  (RealTheory.mul halfEta
                    (RealTheory.baseTail 2 (k + 1))) := by
            intro k
            exact (Classical.choose_spec (supportWitness k)).right
          let levelWitness := fun x : Point =>
            exists_hkNonnegativeTruncation_eq_value h x
          let level : Point -> Nat := fun x : Point =>
            Classical.choose (levelWitness x)
          have hlevel : forall x : Point,
              hkNonnegativeTruncation h (level x) x = h x := by
            intro x
            exact Classical.choose_spec (levelWitness x)
          let selectedSupportGauge : Point -> Point := fun x : Point =>
            supportGauge (level x) x
          have hselectedSupportGauge :
              ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b selectedSupportGauge := by
            intro x hx
            exact hsupportGauge (level x) x hx
          let delta : Point -> Point := fun x : Point =>
            RealTheory.min (deltaH x) (selectedSupportGauge x)
          have hdelta : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta := by
            unfold delta
            exact closedIntervalGaugeOn_min
              hdeltaH.left hselectedSupportGauge
          cases exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_closedIntervalGaugeOn
              hab hdelta with
          | intro total htotalWitness =>
            cases htotalWitness with
            | intro p hpWitness =>
              cases hpWitness with
              | intro tag hfine =>
                let cellLevel : Nat -> Nat := fun i : Nat => level (tag i)
                let levels : List Nat :=
                  List.map cellLevel (List.range total)
                have hlevelsCover : forall i : Nat, i < total ->
                    List.Mem (cellLevel i) levels := by
                  intro i hi
                  unfold levels
                  exact List.mem_map_of_mem (List.mem_range.mpr hi)
                let cellValueWitness := fun k : Nat =>
                  exists_partitionCellHKIntegralValues_sum_eq
                    (hHn k) hfine.left.left
                let cellValue : Nat -> Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat =>
                  Classical.choose (cellValueWitness k)
                have hcellLocal : forall k i : Nat, i < total ->
                    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
                      (hkNonnegativeTruncation h k)
                      (p i) (p (i + 1)) (cellValue k i) := by
                  intro k i hi
                  exact (Classical.choose_spec (cellValueWitness k)).left i hi
                have hcellSum : forall k : Nat,
                    RealTheory.finiteSum (cellValue k) total = Hn k := by
                  intro k
                  exact (Classical.choose_spec (cellValueWitness k)).right
                let variableValue : Nat -> Point := fun i : Nat =>
                  cellValue (cellLevel i) i
                let variableValueSum : Point :=
                  RealTheory.finiteSum variableValue total
                let variableError : Nat -> Point := fun i : Nat =>
                  RealTheory.sub
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (hkNonnegativeTruncation h (cellLevel i) (tag i))
                      (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength p i))
                    (variableValue i)
                let variableAbsError : Nat -> Point := fun i : Nat =>
                  RealTheory.abs (variableError i)
                have hvariableErrorGeometric :
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum variableAbsError total)
                      halfEta := by
                  apply finiteSum_lt_of_levelFiber_geometric_bounds
                    (level := cellLevel) hhalfEta
                  intro k
                  cases
                      exists_levelFiber_taggedCellSubpartition
                        total cellLevel k with
                  | intro selected hselected =>
                      cases hselected with
                      | intro index hfiber =>
                          have hsub :
                              TaggedCellSubpartition total selected index :=
                            hfiber.left
                          have hpartial :
                              PartialTaggedDivision a b selected
                                (subpartitionLeft p index)
                                (subpartitionRight p index)
                                (subpartitionTags tag index) :=
                            taggedCellSubpartition_partialTaggedDivision
                              hfine.left hsub
                          have hlocal : forall j : Nat, j < selected ->
                              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
                                (hkNonnegativeTruncation h k)
                                (subpartitionLeft p index j)
                                (subpartitionRight p index j)
                                (cellValue k (index j)) := by
                            intro j hj
                            unfold subpartitionLeft subpartitionRight
                            exact hcellLocal k (index j) (hsub.left j hj)
                          have hfineFiber :
                              GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b selected
                                (subpartitionLeft p index)
                                (subpartitionRight p index)
                                (subpartitionTags tag index)
                                (supportGauge k) := by
                            refine And.intro hpartial ?_
                            intro j hj
                            have hjTotal : index j < total :=
                              hsub.left j hj
                            have hlevelIndex :
                                cellLevel (index j) = k :=
                              hfiber.right.left j hj
                            have hlevelTag :
                                level (tag (index j)) = k :=
                              hlevelIndex
                            have hworkFine :
                                GaugeFineCell p tag delta (index j) :=
                              hfine.right (index j) hjTotal
                            have hdeltaLe :
                                RealTheory.le (delta (tag (index j)))
                                  (supportGauge k (tag (index j))) := by
                              unfold delta selectedSupportGauge
                              rw [hlevelTag]
                              exact RealTheory.min_le_right
                                (deltaH (tag (index j)))
                                (supportGauge k (tag (index j)))
                            have hfixedFine :
                                GaugeFineCell p tag
                                  (supportGauge k) (index j) :=
                              gaugeFineCell_of_gauge_le hworkFine hdeltaLe
                            unfold GaugeFinePartialCell
                            intro y hy
                            unfold PartialCell subpartitionLeft
                              subpartitionRight at hy
                            unfold subpartitionTags
                            exact hfixedFine y hy
                          have hbound := hsupportBound k selected
                            (subpartitionLeft p index)
                            (subpartitionRight p index)
                            (subpartitionTags tag index)
                            (fun j : Nat => cellValue k (index j))
                            hlocal hpartial hfineFiber
                          have hreindex :=
                            hfiber.right.right variableAbsError
                          rw [hreindex]
                          have hsumEq :
                              RealTheory.finiteSum
                                  (fun j : Nat =>
                                    variableAbsError (index j))
                                  selected =
                                partialTaggedAbsErrorSum
                                  (hkNonnegativeTruncation h k)
                                  (subpartitionLeft p index)
                                  (subpartitionRight p index)
                                  (subpartitionTags tag index)
                                  (fun j : Nat =>
                                    cellValue k (index j))
                                  selected := by
                            unfold partialTaggedAbsErrorSum
                            apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
                            intro j hj
                            have hlevelIndex :
                                cellLevel (index j) = k :=
                              hfiber.right.left j hj
                            unfold variableAbsError variableError variableValue
                            unfold partialTaggedError partialCellLength
                            unfold subpartitionLeft subpartitionRight
                              subpartitionTags
                            unfold
                              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength
                            rw [hlevelIndex]
                          rw [hsumEq]
                          exact hbound
                let maximum := levels.max?.getD 0
                have hvariableLeMaximum : forall i : Nat, i < total ->
                    RealTheory.le (variableValue i) (cellValue maximum i) := by
                  intro i hi
                  have hlevelLe : cellLevel i <= maximum := by
                    unfold maximum
                    exact List.le_max?_getD_of_mem (hlevelsCover i hi)
                  have hcellOrder : RealTheory.le (p i) (p (i + 1)) :=
                    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_step_le
                      hfine.left.left hi
                  unfold variableValue
                  exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
                    hcellOrder
                    (fun x : Point =>
                      hkNonnegativeTruncation_mono h hlevelLe x)
                    (hcellLocal (cellLevel i) i hi)
                    (hcellLocal maximum i hi)
                have hvariableLeHnMaximum :
                    RealTheory.le variableValueSum (Hn maximum) := by
                  unfold variableValueSum
                  have hsumLe := RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
                    variableValue (cellValue maximum) total
                    hvariableLeMaximum
                  rwa [hcellSum maximum] at hsumLe
                have hvariableLeL : RealTheory.le variableValueSum L :=
                  RealTheory.le_trans hvariableLeHnMaximum (hHnLeL maximum)
                have hvariableErrorSum :
                    RealTheory.finiteSum variableError total =
                      RealTheory.sub
                        (taggedSum h p tag total) variableValueSum := by
                  unfold variableError
                  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_sub]
                  have htagged :
                      RealTheory.finiteSum
                          (fun i : Nat =>
                            RealTheory.mul
                              (hkNonnegativeTruncation h
                                (cellLevel i) (tag i))
                              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength p i))
                          total =
                        taggedSum h p tag total := by
                    unfold taggedSum
                    unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLengthTagSum
                    unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedTagSum
                    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
                    intro i _hi
                    rw [hlevel (tag i)]
                  rw [htagged]
                have habsVariableError :
                    RealTheory.le
                      (RealTheory.abs
                        (RealTheory.sub
                          (taggedSum h p tag total) variableValueSum))
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum variableAbsError total) := by
                  rw [<- hvariableErrorSum]
                  unfold variableAbsError
                  exact RealTheory.abs_finiteSum_le_finiteSum_abs
                    variableError total
                have habsVariableErrorLt :
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.abs
                        (RealTheory.sub
                          (taggedSum h p tag total) variableValueSum))
                      halfEta := by
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                    habsVariableError
                    hvariableErrorGeometric
                have hfineH :
                    GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b total p tag deltaH :=
                  gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le hfine
                    (fun x : Point => by
                      unfold delta
                      exact RealTheory.min_le_left
                        (deltaH x) (selectedSupportGauge x))
                have htaggedClose :
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.abs
                        (RealTheory.sub (taggedSum h p tag total) H))
                      halfEta :=
                  hdeltaH.right total p tag hfineH
                have hHltTaggedAdd :
                    RealTheory.lt H
                      (RealTheory.add (taggedSum h p tag total) halfEta) := by
                  have hleft :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F htaggedClose
                  have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right
                    F hleft halfEta
                  rwa [F.sub_add_cancel] at hadd
                have hTaggedLtVariableAdd :
                    RealTheory.lt (taggedSum h p tag total)
                      (RealTheory.add variableValueSum halfEta) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right
                    F habsVariableErrorLt
                have hTaggedAddLt :
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.add (taggedSum h p tag total) halfEta)
                      (RealTheory.add
                        (RealTheory.add variableValueSum halfEta) halfEta) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right
                    F hTaggedLtVariableAdd halfEta
                have hHLtVariableEta :
                    RealTheory.lt H
                      (RealTheory.add variableValueSum eta) := by
                  have hchain := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
                    F hHltTaggedAdd hTaggedAddLt
                  rw [RealTheory.add_assoc] at hchain
                  unfold halfEta at hchain
                  change
                    F.lt H
                      (F.add variableValueSum
                        (F.add (F.half eta) (F.half eta))) at hchain
                  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eta] at hchain
                  exact hchain
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                  hHLtVariableEta
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
                    hvariableLeL (RealTheory.le_refl eta))
      have hHLeL : RealTheory.le H L := by
        by_cases hle : RealTheory.le H L
        · exact hle
        · have hLltH : RealTheory.lt L H :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hLLeH hle
          let eta := RealTheory.sub H L
          have heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hLltH
          have hbad := hHLtAdd eta heta
          have hsum : RealTheory.add L eta = H := by
            unfold eta
            change F.add L (F.sub H L) = H
            rw [F.add_comm]
            rw [F.sub_add_cancel]
          rw [hsum] at hbad
          exact False.elim ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F H) hbad)
      have hHEqL : H = L :=
        RealTheory.le_antisymm hHLeL hLLeH
      have hHnTendsH : RealTheory.SeqTendsto Hn H := by
        rw [hHEqL]
        exact hHnTends
      cases hHnTendsH eps heps with
      | intro N hN =>
        let tailValue := RealTheory.sub H (Hn N)
        have htailIntegral :
            HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
              (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub
                (h x) (hkNonnegativeTruncation h N x))
              a b tailValue := by
          unfold tailValue
          exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_sub hH (hHn N)
        have htailNonnegative : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero tailValue := by
          exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
            hab
            (fun x : Point => hkNonnegativeTruncation_tail_nonnegative h N x)
            (hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_zero_of_le hab)
            htailIntegral
        have hcloseN :
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (Hn N) H)) eps :=
          hN N (Nat.le_refl N)
        have htailLt : RealTheory.lt tailValue eps := by
          rw [<- RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg htailNonnegative]
          unfold tailValue
          change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub H (Hn N))) eps
          rw [show F.abs (F.sub H (Hn N)) =
            F.abs (F.sub (Hn N) H) from
              RealTheory.abs_sub_comm H (Hn N)]
          exact hcloseN
        exact Exists.intro N
          (Exists.intro tailValue
            (And.intro (htruncIntegrable N)
              (And.intro htailIntegral htailLt)))

name: stieltjesTagSum_imagePartitionIncreasing
statement:
private theorem stieltjesTagSum_imagePartitionIncreasing
    (f alpha phi : Point -> Point)
    (p tag : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    stieltjesTagSum
        (RealFunction.CompFun f phi)
        (RealFunction.CompFun alpha phi)
        p tag n =
      stieltjesTagSum f alpha
        (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.imagePartitionIncreasing phi p)
        (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.imageTagIncreasing phi tag) n
proof:

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_comp_strictIncreasing
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_comp_strictIncreasing
    {f alpha phi : Point -> Point} {c d a b I : Point}
    (hsource : RealTheory.lt c d)
    (hleft : phi c = a)
    (hright : phi d = b)
    (hstrict :
      RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hf : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I) :
    HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
      (RealFunction.CompFun f phi)
      (RealFunction.CompFun alpha phi)
      c d I
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcd : RealTheory.le c d :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsource
  refine And.intro hcd ?_
  intro eps heps baseCount base hbase
  let targetBase :=
    RealFunction.IntervalPartition.imagePartitionIncreasing phi base
  have htargetBase : IntervalPartition a b baseCount targetBase := by
    dsimp [targetBase]
    exact
      RealFunction.IntervalPartition.imagePartitionIncreasing_intervalPartition_of_strictMonotoneOn
        hleft hright hstrict hbase
  cases hf.right eps heps baseCount targetBase htargetBase with
  | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
      cases hthresholdCount with
      | intro threshold hthreshold =>
          let sourceThreshold :=
            RealFunction.IntervalPartition.preimagePartitionIncreasing
              phi c d threshold
          have hsourceThreshold :
              IntervalPartition c d thresholdCount sourceThreshold := by
            dsimp [sourceThreshold]
            exact
              RealFunction.IntervalPartition.preimagePartitionIncreasing_intervalPartition_of_endpoint_values
                hcd hleft hright hstrict hcont hthreshold.left
          have hrefSourceBase :
              PartitionRefines sourceThreshold thresholdCount
                base baseCount := by
            dsimp [sourceThreshold, targetBase]
            exact
              RealFunction.IntervalPartition.preimagePartitionIncreasing_partitionRefines_of_imagePartitionIncreasing
                hcd hleft hright hstrict hcont
                hthreshold.left hbase hthreshold.right.left
          refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
          refine Exists.intro sourceThreshold ?_
          refine And.intro hsourceThreshold ?_
          refine And.intro hrefSourceBase ?_
          intro n p tag htag href
          have htargetTagged :
              And
                (TaggedPartition a b n
                  (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.imagePartitionIncreasing
                    phi p)
                  (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.imageTagIncreasing
                    phi tag))
                (PartitionRefines
                  (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.imagePartitionIncreasing
                    phi p)
                  n threshold thresholdCount) :=
            RealFunction.IntervalPartition.imageTaggedPartitionIncreasing_refines_of_preimagePartitionIncreasing
              hcd hleft hright hstrict hcont
              htag hthreshold.left href
          have hcloseTarget :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (stieltjesTagSum f alpha
                      (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.imagePartitionIncreasing
                        phi p)
                      (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.imageTagIncreasing
                        phi tag) n)
                    I))
                eps :=
            hthreshold.right.right n
              (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.imagePartitionIncreasing
                phi p)
              (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.imageTagIncreasing
                phi tag)
              htargetTagged.left htargetTagged.right
          rw [stieltjesTagSum_imagePartitionIncreasing f alpha phi p tag n]
          exact hcloseTarget

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_comp_strictIncreasing
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_comp_strictIncreasing
    {f alpha phi : Point -> Point} {c d a b : Point}
    (hsource : RealTheory.lt c d)
    (hleft : phi c = a)
    (hright : phi d = b)
    (hstrict :
      RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)

    RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
      (RealFunction.CompFun f phi)
      (RealFunction.CompFun alpha phi)
      c d
proof:
:= by
  cases hf with
  | intro I hI =>
      refine Exists.intro I ?_
      exact hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_comp_strictIncreasing
        hsource hleft hright hstrict hcont hI

name: hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_reverse
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_reverse
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I) :
    HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
      f alpha b a (RealTheory.neg I)
proof:

        hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_ge
          (a := b) (b := a)
          hforward.left hforward.right
  | inr hreverse =>
      cases hreverse with
      | intro J hJ =>
          have hbase :
              HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha b a J :=
            hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_le
              hJ.left hJ.right.left
