name: hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a I : Point}
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a a I) :
    I = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  cases hI with
  | inl hforward =>
      exact
        hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
          hforward.right
  | inr hreverse =>
      cases hreverse with
      | intro J hJ =>
          have hJzero : J = RealTheory.zero :=
            hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
              hJ.right.left
          rw [hJ.right.right, hJzero, RealTheory.neg_zero]

name: hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_unique
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_unique
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hJ : HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b J) :
    I = J
proof:
:= by
  cases hI with
  | inl hIforward =>
      cases hJ with
      | inl hJforward =>
          exact hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_unique
            hIforward.right hJforward.right
      | inr hJreverse =>
          cases hJreverse with
          | intro K hK =>
              have hab_eq : a = b :=
                RealTheory.le_antisymm hIforward.left hK.left
              subst b
              have hIzero : I = RealTheory.zero :=
                hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                  (Or.inl hIforward)
              have hJzero : J = RealTheory.zero :=
                hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                  (Or.inr (Exists.intro K hK))
              rw [hIzero, hJzero]
  | inr hIreverse =>
      cases hIreverse with
      | intro K hK =>
          cases hJ with
          | inl hJforward =>
              have hab_eq : a = b :=
                RealTheory.le_antisymm hJforward.left hK.left
              subst b
              have hIzero : I = RealTheory.zero :=
                hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                  (Or.inr (Exists.intro K hK))
              have hJzero : J = RealTheory.zero :=
                hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                  (Or.inl hJforward)
              rw [hIzero, hJzero]
          | inr hJreverse =>
              cases hJreverse with
              | intro L hL =>
                  have hKL : K = L :=
                    hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_unique
                      hK.right.left hL.right.left
                  rw [hK.right.right, hL.right.right, hKL]

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_le
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_le
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_adjacent_ordered
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_adjacent_ordered
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hleft : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a c)
    (hright : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha c b) :
    RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b := RealTheory.le_trans hac hcb
  have hbdd_ac :
      RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f := by
    rcases hbdd with ⟨lower, upper, hbounds⟩
    refine ⟨lower, upper, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    exact hbounds x
      (And.intro hx.left (RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hcb))
  have hbdd_cb :
      RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c b) f := by
    rcases hbdd with ⟨lower, upper, hbounds⟩
    refine ⟨lower, upper, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    exact hbounds x
      (And.intro (RealTheory.le_trans hac hx.left) hx.right)
  have hcell_ab :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_boundedOn_closedInterval
      hbdd
  have hcell_ac :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a c :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_boundedOn_closedInterval
      hbdd_ac
  have hcell_cb :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f c b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_boundedOn_closedInterval
      hbdd_cb
  have hmono_ac : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a c :=
    by
      intro x y hx hy hxy
      exact hmono x y
        (And.intro hx.left (RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hcb))
        (And.intro hy.left (RealTheory.le_trans hy.right hcb))
        hxy
  have hmono_cb : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha c b :=
    by
      intro x y hx hy hxy
      exact hmono x y
        (And.intro (RealTheory.le_trans hac hx.left) hx.right)
        (And.intro (RealTheory.le_trans hac hy.left) hy.right)
        hxy
  have hsmall_ac :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a c :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
      hac hmono_ac hcell_ac hleft
  have hsmall_cb :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha c b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
      hcb hmono_cb hcell_cb hright
  have hsmall_ab :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a b := by
    intro eps heps
    let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
    have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
    rcases hsmall_ac e2 he2 with
      ⟨leftCount, left, hleftPart, hleftGap⟩
    rcases hsmall_cb e2 he2 with
      ⟨rightCount, right, hrightPart, hrightGap⟩
    let adjacent := adjacentPartition left right leftCount
    have hadjacent :
        IntervalPartition a b (leftCount + rightCount) adjacent := by
      dsimp [adjacent]
      exact adjacentPartition_intervalPartition hleftPart hrightPart
    have hleftCell := hcell_ac leftCount left hleftPart
    have hrightCell := hcell_cb rightCount right hrightPart
    have hlower :
        lowerSum f alpha adjacent (leftCount + rightCount) =
          RealTheory.add
            (lowerSum f alpha left leftCount)
            (lowerSum f alpha right rightCount) := by
      dsimp [adjacent]
      exact lowerSum_adjacent f alpha
        hleftPart hrightPart hleftCell.left hrightCell.left
    have hupper :
        upperSum f alpha adjacent (leftCount + rightCount) =
          RealTheory.add
            (upperSum f alpha left leftCount)
            (upperSum f alpha right rightCount) := by
      dsimp [adjacent]
      exact upperSum_adjacent f alpha
        hleftPart hrightPart hleftCell.right hrightCell.right
    refine Exists.intro (leftCount + rightCount) ?_
    refine Exists.intro adjacent ?_
    refine And.intro hadjacent ?_
    rw [hupper, hlower]
    change
      F.lt
        (F.sub
          (F.add
            (upperSum f alpha left leftCount)
            (upperSum f alpha right rightCount))
          (F.add
            (lowerSum f alpha left leftCount)
            (lowerSum f alpha right rightCount)))
        eps
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F]
    have hadd :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hleftGap hrightGap
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hadd
  cases exists_hasRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegrals
      hab hmono hcell_ab with
  | intro Il hIl =>
      cases hIl with
      | intro Iu hIu =>
          exact riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_darbouxGapSmall
            hab hmono hcell_ab hIu.left hIu.right hsmall_ab

    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hI : OrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b) :
    And
      (OrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a c)
      (OrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha c b)
proof:
:= by
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b := RealTheory.le_trans hac hcb
  have hraw : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_orientedRiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_le
      hab hI
  have hrestrict :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_restrict_ordered
      hac hcb hmono hbdd hraw
  exact And.intro
    (orientedRiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_le hac hrestrict.left)
    (orientedRiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_le hcb hrestrict.right)

name: hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_value
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_value
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I) :
    HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn alpha f a b
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
          (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a)))
        I)
proof:
:= by
  cases hI with
  | inl hforward =>
      exact hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_le
        hforward.left
        (hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_value
          hforward.right)
  | inr hreverse =>
      cases hreverse with
      | intro J hJ =>
          have hraw :
              HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn alpha f b a
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a))
                    (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b)))
                  J) :=
            hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_value
              hJ.right.left
          have horiented :
              HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn alpha f a b
                (RealTheory.neg
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a))
                      (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b)))
                    J)) :=
            hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_ge hJ.left hraw
          have hvalue :
              RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
                    (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a)))
                  I =
                RealTheory.neg
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a))
                      (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b)))
                    J) := by
            rw [hJ.right.right]
            let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            let X := RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b)
            let Y := RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a)
            change
              F.sub (F.sub X Y) (F.neg J) =
                F.neg (F.sub (F.sub Y X) J)
            rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.sub X Y) (F.neg J)]
            rw [F.neg_neg]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F X Y]
            rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (F.neg (F.sub X Y)) J]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib
              F (F.neg (F.sub X Y)) (F.neg J)]
            rw [F.neg_neg, F.neg_neg]
          rwa [hvalue]

name: orientedRiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_integrationByParts
statement:
theorem orientedRiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_integrationByParts
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hI : OrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b) :
    OrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn alpha f a b
proof:
:= by
  cases hI with
  | intro I hI =>
      exact Exists.intro
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
            (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a)))
          I)
        (hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_value hI)

name: hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_endpoint_identity
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_endpoint_identity
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hJ : HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn alpha f a b J) :
    RealTheory.add I J =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
        (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a))
proof:
:= by
  let B :=
    RealTheory.sub
      (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
      (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a))
  have hvalue :
      HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn alpha f a b
        (RealTheory.sub B I) := by
    dsimp [B]
    exact
      hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_value hI
  have hJ_eq : J = RealTheory.sub B I :=
    hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_unique hJ hvalue
  dsimp [B] at hJ_eq ⊢
  rw [hJ_eq]
  rw [RealTheory.add_comm I
    (RealTheory.sub
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
        (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a))) I)]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (RealTheory.sub
      (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
      (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a)))
    I

name: hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_comp_strictIncreasing
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_comp_strictIncreasing
    {f alpha phi : Point -> Point} {c d a b I : Point}
    (hsource : RealTheory.lt c d)
    (hleft : phi c = a)
    (hright : phi d = b)
    (hstrict :
      RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hcont :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d) phi)
    (hf : HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I) :
    HasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
      (RealFunction.CompFun f phi)
      (RealFunction.CompFun alpha phi)
      c d I
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcd : RealTheory.le c d :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsource
  have hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d c :=
    And.intro (F.le_refl c) hcd
  have hd : RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d d :=
    And.intro hcd (F.le_refl d)
  have hab_lt : RealTheory.lt a b := by
    rw [<- hleft, <- hright]
    exact hstrict c d hc hd hsource
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab_lt
  have hraw : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I :=
    hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_le
      hab hf
  exact hasOrientedRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_le hcd
    (hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_comp_strictIncreasing
      hsource hleft hright hstrict hcont hraw)

name: orientedRiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_comp_strictIncreasing
statement:
theorem orientedRiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_comp_strictIncreasing
    {f alpha phi : Point -> Point} {c d a b : Point}

name: integratorMonotoneOn_left_of_closedInterval
statement:
private theorem integratorMonotoneOn_left_of_closedInterval

name: sub_left_le_add_sub_add_of_right_nonneg
statement:
private theorem sub_left_le_add_sub_add_of_right_nonneg
    (U L Ur Lr : Point)
    (hright : RealTheory.le Lr Ur) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub U L)
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.add U Ur) (RealTheory.add L Lr))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub Ur Lr) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hright
  have hle :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub U L) RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub U L)
          (RealTheory.sub Ur Lr)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
      F hnonneg (RealTheory.sub U L)
  change
    F.le (F.add (F.sub U L) F.zero)
      (F.add (F.sub U L) (F.sub Ur Lr)) at hle
  rw [F.add_zero] at hle
  change
    F.le (F.sub U L)
      (F.sub (F.add U Ur) (F.add L Lr))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F U Ur L Lr]
  exact hle

name: sub_right_le_add_sub_add_of_left_nonneg
statement:
private theorem sub_right_le_add_sub_add_of_left_nonneg
    (U L Ur Lr : Point)
    (hleft : RealTheory.le L U) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub Ur Lr)
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.add U Ur) (RealTheory.add L Lr))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub U L) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hleft
  have hle :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub Ur Lr))
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub U L)
          (RealTheory.sub Ur Lr)) :=
    F.add_le_add_right hnonneg (RealTheory.sub Ur Lr)
  change
    F.le (F.add F.zero (F.sub Ur Lr))
      (F.add (F.sub U L) (F.sub Ur Lr)) at hle
  rw [F.zero_add] at hle
  change
    F.le (F.sub Ur Lr)
      (F.sub (F.add U Ur) (F.add L Lr))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F U Ur L Lr]
  exact hle

name: riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_left_of_global
statement:
private theorem riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_left_of_global
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hcell_ab : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b)
    (hcell_ac : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a c)
    (hcell_cb : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f c b)
    (hsmall : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a b) :
    RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a c
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hsmall eps heps with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases hn with
      | intro p hp =>
          have hp_part : IntervalPartition a b n p := hp.left
          have hgap_lt :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (upperSum f alpha p n)
                  (lowerSum f alpha p n))
                eps := hp.right
          by_cases hpos : 0 < n
          · let split := splitPointPartition a c b
            let merge := endpointMergePoint p split n 2
            let cut := endpointMergeRightBlockCut p split n 2 1
            have hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c :=
              And.intro hac hcb
            have hsplit : IntervalPartition a b 2 split := by
              dsimp [split]
              exact splitPointPartition_intervalPartition hc
            have hmergeI : IntervalPartition a b (n + 2) merge := by
              dsimp [merge, split]
              exact endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition hp_part hsplit
            have hrefBlock :
                PartitionBlockRefines merge (n + 2) p n
                  (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut p split n 2) := by
              dsimp [merge, split]
              exact endpointMergeLeft_partitionBlockRefines
                hp_part hsplit hpos
            have href : PartitionRefines merge (n + 2) p n :=
              partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines hrefBlock hmergeI
            have hinf_p := (hcell_ab n p hp_part).left
            have hsup_p := (hcell_ab n p hp_part).right
            have hinf_merge := (hcell_ab (n + 2) merge hmergeI).left
            have hsup_merge := (hcell_ab (n + 2) merge hmergeI).right
            have hgap_merge_le :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (upperSum f alpha merge (n + 2))
                    (lowerSum f alpha merge (n + 2)))
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (upperSum f alpha p n)
                    (lowerSum f alpha p n)) :=
              darbouxGap_le_of_partitionRefines
                hmergeI hp_part href hmono
                hinf_p hsup_p hinf_merge hsup_merge
            have hgap_merge_lt :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (upperSum f alpha merge (n + 2))
                    (lowerSum f alpha merge (n + 2)))
                  eps :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                F hgap_merge_le hgap_lt
            have htag : TaggedPartition a b n p (leftTags p) :=
              leftTags_taggedPartition hp_part
            have hprefixI : IntervalPartition a c cut merge := by
              dsimp [merge, cut, split]
              exact
                (endpointMergeSplitPoint_prefix_taggedPartition
                  htag hc).left
            have hsuffixI : IntervalPartition c b ((n + 2) - cut)
                (suffixPartition merge cut) := by
              dsimp [merge, cut, split]
              exact
                (endpointMergeSplitPoint_suffix_taggedPartition
                  htag hc).left
            have hright_ref :
                PartitionBlockRefines merge (n + 2) split 2
                  (endpointMergeRightBlockCut p split n 2) := by
              dsimp [merge, split]
              exact endpointMergeRight_partitionBlockRefines
                hp_part hsplit (by omega : 0 < 2)
            have hcut_le : cut <= n + 2 := by
              dsimp [cut, split]
              exact partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right hright_ref
                (show 1 <= 2 by omega)
            have hupper_cut :=
              upperSum_cut f alpha hmergeI hcut_le hsup_merge
            have hlower_cut :=
              lowerSum_cut f alpha hmergeI hcut_le hinf_merge
            have hmono_cb :
                IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha c b :=
              integratorMonotoneOn_right_of_closedInterval
                hac hmono
            have hright_le :
                RealTheory.le
                  (lowerSum f alpha (suffixPartition merge cut)
                    ((n + 2) - cut))
                  (upperSum f alpha (suffixPartition merge cut)
                    ((n + 2) - cut)) := by
              exact lowerSum_le_upperSum_of_intervalPartition
                hsuffixI hmono_cb
                (hcell_cb ((n + 2) - cut)
                  (suffixPartition merge cut) hsuffixI).left
                (hcell_cb ((n + 2) - cut)
                  (suffixPartition merge cut) hsuffixI).right
            have hleft_gap_le_merge :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (upperSum f alpha merge cut)
                    (lowerSum f alpha merge cut))
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (upperSum f alpha merge (n + 2))
                    (lowerSum f alpha merge (n + 2))) := by
              rw [hupper_cut, hlower_cut]
              exact sub_left_le_add_sub_add_of_right_nonneg
                (upperSum f alpha merge cut)
                (lowerSum f alpha merge cut)
                (upperSum f alpha (suffixPartition merge cut)
                  ((n + 2) - cut))
                (lowerSum f alpha (suffixPartition merge cut)
                  ((n + 2) - cut))
                hright_le
            refine Exists.intro cut ?_
            refine Exists.intro merge ?_
            refine And.intro hprefixI ?_
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
              F hleft_gap_le_merge hgap_merge_lt
          · have hn0 : n = 0 :=
              Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_not_gt hpos)
            subst n
            have hab_eq : a = b := by
              have hleft0 : p 0 = a :=
                intervalPartition_left_endpoint hp_part
              have hright0 : p 0 = b :=
                intervalPartition_right_endpoint hp_part
              exact hleft0.symm.trans hright0
            subst b
            have hca : c = a := by
              have hcb_a : RealTheory.le c a := by
                exact hcb
              exact RealTheory.le_antisymm hcb_a hac
            subst c
            refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
            refine Exists.intro (fun _ : Nat => a) ?_
            refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · refine And.intro rfl ?_
              refine And.intro rfl ?_
              intro k hk
              exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk)
            · unfold upperSum lowerSum
              unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedUpperSum
              unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedLowerSum
              rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
              rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
              change F.lt (F.sub F.zero F.zero) eps
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.zero]
              exact heps

name: riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_right_of_global
statement:
private theorem riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_right_of_global
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hcell_ab : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b)
    (hcell_ac : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a c)
    (hcell_cb : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f c b)
    (hsmall : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a b) :
    RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha c b
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hsmall eps heps with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases hn with
      | intro p hp =>
          have hp_part : IntervalPartition a b n p := hp.left
          have hgap_lt :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (upperSum f alpha p n)
                  (lowerSum f alpha p n))
                eps := hp.right
          by_cases hpos : 0 < n
          · let split := splitPointPartition a c b
            let merge := endpointMergePoint p split n 2
            let cut := endpointMergeRightBlockCut p split n 2 1
            have hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c :=
              And.intro hac hcb
            have hsplit : IntervalPartition a b 2 split := by
              dsimp [split]
              exact splitPointPartition_intervalPartition hc
            have hmergeI : IntervalPartition a b (n + 2) merge := by
              dsimp [merge, split]
              exact endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition hp_part hsplit
            have hrefBlock :
                PartitionBlockRefines merge (n + 2) p n
                  (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut p split n 2) := by
              dsimp [merge, split]
              exact endpointMergeLeft_partitionBlockRefines
                hp_part hsplit hpos
            have href : PartitionRefines merge (n + 2) p n :=
              partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines hrefBlock hmergeI
            have hinf_p := (hcell_ab n p hp_part).left
            have hsup_p := (hcell_ab n p hp_part).right
            have hinf_merge := (hcell_ab (n + 2) merge hmergeI).left
            have hsup_merge := (hcell_ab (n + 2) merge hmergeI).right
            have hgap_merge_le :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (upperSum f alpha merge (n + 2))
                    (lowerSum f alpha merge (n + 2)))
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (upperSum f alpha p n)
                    (lowerSum f alpha p n)) :=
              darbouxGap_le_of_partitionRefines
                hmergeI hp_part href hmono
                hinf_p hsup_p hinf_merge hsup_merge
            have hgap_merge_lt :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (upperSum f alpha merge (n + 2))
                    (lowerSum f alpha merge (n + 2)))
                  eps :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                F hgap_merge_le hgap_lt
            have htag : TaggedPartition a b n p (leftTags p) :=
              leftTags_taggedPartition hp_part
            have hprefixI : IntervalPartition a c cut merge := by
              dsimp [merge, cut, split]
              exact
                (endpointMergeSplitPoint_prefix_taggedPartition
                  htag hc).left
            have hsuffixI : IntervalPartition c b ((n + 2) - cut)
                (suffixPartition merge cut) := by
              dsimp [merge, cut, split]
              exact
                (endpointMergeSplitPoint_suffix_taggedPartition
                  htag hc).left
            have hright_ref :
                PartitionBlockRefines merge (n + 2) split 2
                  (endpointMergeRightBlockCut p split n 2) := by
              dsimp [merge, split]
              exact endpointMergeRight_partitionBlockRefines
                hp_part hsplit (by omega : 0 < 2)
            have hcut_le : cut <= n + 2 := by
              dsimp [cut, split]
              exact partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right hright_ref
                (show 1 <= 2 by omega)
            have hupper_cut :=
              upperSum_cut f alpha hmergeI hcut_le hsup_merge
            have hlower_cut :=
              lowerSum_cut f alpha hmergeI hcut_le hinf_merge
            have hmono_ac :
                IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a c :=
              integratorMonotoneOn_left_of_closedInterval
                hcb hmono
            have hleft_le :
                RealTheory.le
                  (lowerSum f alpha merge cut)
                  (upperSum f alpha merge cut) := by
              exact lowerSum_le_upperSum_of_intervalPartition
                hprefixI hmono_ac
                (hcell_ac cut merge hprefixI).left
                (hcell_ac cut merge hprefixI).right
            have hright_gap_le_merge :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (upperSum f alpha (suffixPartition merge cut)
                      ((n + 2) - cut))
                    (lowerSum f alpha (suffixPartition merge cut)
                      ((n + 2) - cut)))
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (upperSum f alpha merge (n + 2))
                    (lowerSum f alpha merge (n + 2))) := by
              rw [hupper_cut, hlower_cut]
              exact sub_right_le_add_sub_add_of_left_nonneg
                (upperSum f alpha merge cut)
                (lowerSum f alpha merge cut)
                (upperSum f alpha (suffixPartition merge cut)
                  ((n + 2) - cut))
                (lowerSum f alpha (suffixPartition merge cut)
                  ((n + 2) - cut))
                hleft_le
            refine Exists.intro ((n + 2) - cut) ?_
            refine Exists.intro (suffixPartition merge cut) ?_
            refine And.intro hsuffixI ?_
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
              F hright_gap_le_merge hgap_merge_lt
          · have hn0 : n = 0 :=
              Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_not_gt hpos)
            subst n
            have hab_eq : a = b := by
              have hleft0 : p 0 = a :=
                intervalPartition_left_endpoint hp_part
              have hright0 : p 0 = b :=
                intervalPartition_right_endpoint hp_part
              exact hleft0.symm.trans hright0
            subst b
            have hca : c = a := by
              have hcb_a : RealTheory.le c a := by
                exact hcb
              exact RealTheory.le_antisymm hcb_a hac
            subst c
            refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
            refine Exists.intro (fun _ : Nat => a) ?_
            refine And.intro ?_ ?_
            · refine And.intro rfl ?_
              refine And.intro rfl ?_
              intro k hk
              exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk)
            · unfold upperSum lowerSum
              unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedUpperSum
              unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedLowerSum
              rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
              rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
              change F.lt (F.sub F.zero F.zero) eps
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.zero]
              exact heps

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_left_of_integrableOn
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_left_of_integrableOn
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hInt : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b) :
    RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a c
proof:
:= by
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b := RealTheory.le_trans hac hcb
  have hbdd_ac :
      RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f := by
    rcases hbdd with ⟨lower, upper, hbdd⟩
    refine ⟨lower, upper, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    exact hbdd x
      (And.intro hx.left (RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hcb))
  have hbdd_cb :
      RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c b) f := by
    rcases hbdd with ⟨lower, upper, hbdd⟩
    refine ⟨lower, upper, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    exact hbdd x
      (And.intro (RealTheory.le_trans hac hx.left) hx.right)
  have hcell_ab :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_boundedOn_closedInterval
      hbdd
  have hcell_ac :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a c :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_boundedOn_closedInterval
      hbdd_ac
  have hcell_cb :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f c b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_boundedOn_closedInterval
      hbdd_cb
  have hmono_ac :=
    integratorMonotoneOn_left_of_closedInterval hcb hmono
  have hsmall_ab :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
      hab hmono hcell_ab hInt
  have hsmall_ac :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a c :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_left_of_global
      hac hcb hmono hcell_ab hcell_ac hcell_cb hsmall_ab
  cases exists_hasRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegrals
      hac hmono_ac hcell_ac with
  | intro Il hIl =>
      cases hIl with
      | intro Iu hIu =>
          exact riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_darbouxGapSmall
            hac hmono_ac hcell_ac hIu.left hIu.right hsmall_ac

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_restrict_ordered
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_restrict_ordered
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hInt : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b) :
    And
      (RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a c)
      (RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha c b)
proof:
:=
  And.intro
    (riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_left_of_integrableOn

      hac hcb hmono hbdd hInt)

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_eq_add_restrictions_ordered
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_eq_add_restrictions_ordered
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a c b I Il Ir : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hIl : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a c Il)
    (hIr : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha c b Ir) :
    I = RealTheory.add Il Ir
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hac_eq : a = c
  · subst c
    have hIl0 : Il = RealTheory.zero :=
      hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_unique
        hIl
        (hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_degenerate f alpha a)
    have hI_eq_Ir : I = Ir :=
      hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_unique hI hIr
    rw [hI_eq_Ir, hIl0]
    exact Eq.symm (F.zero_add Ir)
  · by_cases hcb_eq : c = b
    · subst b
      have hIr0 : Ir = RealTheory.zero :=
        hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_unique
          hIr
          (hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_degenerate f alpha c)
      have hI_eq_Il : I = Il :=
        hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_unique hI hIl
      rw [hI_eq_Il, hIr0]
      exact Eq.symm (F.add_zero Il)
    · have hab : RealTheory.le a b :=
        RealTheory.le_trans hac hcb
      have hab_ne : Not (a = b) := by
        intro hab_eq
        have hac' : a = c :=
          RealTheory.le_antisymm hac (by simpa [hab_eq] using hcb)
        exact hac_eq hac'
      apply RealFunction.eq_of_forall_dist_lt
      intro eps heps
      let e4 := RealTheory.quarter eps
      let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
      have he4 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e4 := by
        dsimp [e4]
        exact RealTheory.quarter_pos heps
      have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 := by
        dsimp [e2]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
      let globalBase := twoPointPartition a b
      have hglobalBase :
          IntervalPartition a b 1 globalBase := by
        dsimp [globalBase]
        exact twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hab
      rcases hI.right e4 he4 1 globalBase hglobalBase with
        ⟨globalCount, globalThreshold, hglobalPart,
          _hrefGlobalBase, hglobalClose⟩
      let leftBase := twoPointPartition a c
      have hleftBase :
          IntervalPartition a c 1 leftBase := by
        dsimp [leftBase]
        exact twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hac
      rcases hIl.right e2 he2 1 leftBase hleftBase with
        ⟨leftThresholdCount, leftThreshold, hleftThresholdPart,
          _hrefLeftBase, hleftClose⟩
      let rightBase := twoPointPartition c b
      have hrightBase :
          IntervalPartition c b 1 rightBase := by
        dsimp [rightBase]
        exact twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hcb
      rcases hIr.right e4 he4 1 rightBase hrightBase with
        ⟨rightThresholdCount, rightThreshold, hrightThresholdPart,
          _hrefRightBase, hrightClose⟩
      have hglobalPos : 0 < globalCount :=
        RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_count_pos_of_endpoints_ne
          hglobalPart hab_ne
      let split := splitPointPartition a c b
      let merge :=
        endpointMergePoint globalThreshold split globalCount 2
      let cut :=
        endpointMergeRightBlockCut globalThreshold split globalCount 2 1
      have hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c :=
        And.intro hac hcb
      have hsplit : IntervalPartition a b 2 split := by
        dsimp [split]
        exact splitPointPartition_intervalPartition hc
      have hmergePart :
          IntervalPartition a b (globalCount + 2) merge := by
        dsimp [merge]
        exact endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition hglobalPart hsplit
      have hrefMergeThresholdBlock :
          PartitionBlockRefines
            merge (globalCount + 2)
            globalThreshold globalCount
            (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut
              globalThreshold split globalCount 2) := by
        dsimp [merge]
        exact endpointMergeLeft_partitionBlockRefines
          hglobalPart hsplit hglobalPos
      have hrefMergeThreshold :
          PartitionRefines
            merge (globalCount + 2)
            globalThreshold globalCount :=
        partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines
          hrefMergeThresholdBlock hmergePart
      have hglobalTagged :
          TaggedPartition a b globalCount
            globalThreshold (leftTags globalThreshold) :=
        leftTags_taggedPartition hglobalPart
      have hprefixTagged :=
        endpointMergeSplitPoint_prefix_taggedPartition
          hglobalTagged hc
      have hsuffixTagged :=
        endpointMergeSplitPoint_suffix_taggedPartition
          hglobalTagged hc
      have hrightMergeBlock :
          PartitionBlockRefines
            merge (globalCount + 2) split 2
            (endpointMergeRightBlockCut
              globalThreshold split globalCount 2) := by
        dsimp [merge]
        exact endpointMergeRight_partitionBlockRefines
          hglobalPart hsplit (by omega : 0 < 2)
      have hcut_le : cut <= globalCount + 2 := by
        dsimp [cut]
        exact partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right
          hrightMergeBlock (show 1 <= 2 by omega)
      have hleftThresholdTagged :
          TaggedPartition a c leftThresholdCount
            leftThreshold (leftTags leftThreshold) :=
        leftTags_taggedPartition hleftThresholdPart
      rcases exists_commonTaggedBlockRefinement
          hprefixTagged hleftThresholdTagged with
        ⟨leftCount, leftPart, leftTag, leftPrefixCut,
          leftThresholdCut, hleftCommon⟩
      have hleftTagged :
          TaggedPartition a c leftCount leftPart leftTag :=
        hleftCommon.left
      have hrefLeftPrefix :
          PartitionRefines leftPart leftCount merge cut :=
        partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines
          hleftCommon.right.left hleftTagged.left
      have hrefLeftThreshold :
          PartitionRefines leftPart leftCount
            leftThreshold leftThresholdCount :=
        partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines
          hleftCommon.right.right hleftTagged.left
      have hrightThresholdTagged :
          TaggedPartition c b rightThresholdCount
            rightThreshold (leftTags rightThreshold) :=
        leftTags_taggedPartition hrightThresholdPart
      rcases exists_commonTaggedBlockRefinement
          hsuffixTagged hrightThresholdTagged with
        ⟨rightCount, rightPart, rightTag, rightSuffixCut,
          rightThresholdCut, hrightCommon⟩
      have hrightTagged :
          TaggedPartition c b rightCount rightPart rightTag :=
        hrightCommon.left
      have hrefRightSuffix :
          PartitionRefines rightPart rightCount
            (suffixPartition merge cut) ((globalCount + 2) - cut) :=
        partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines
          hrightCommon.right.left hrightTagged.left
      have hrefRightThreshold :
          PartitionRefines rightPart rightCount
            rightThreshold rightThresholdCount :=
        partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines
          hrightCommon.right.right hrightTagged.left
      have hboundary : leftPart leftCount = rightPart 0 :=
        (intervalPartition_right_endpoint hleftTagged.left).trans
          (Eq.symm
            (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hrightTagged.left))
      have hrefAdjacentMerge :
          PartitionRefines
            (adjacentPartition leftPart rightPart leftCount)
            (leftCount + rightCount)
            merge (globalCount + 2) := by
        intro j hj
        by_cases hjLeft : j < leftCount
        · rcases hrefLeftPrefix j hjLeft with
            ⟨i, hi, hleft, hright⟩
          refine Exists.intro i ?_
          refine And.intro (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi hcut_le) ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · rw [adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
              leftPart rightPart hjLeft]
            exact hleft
          · have hnext : j + 1 <= leftCount :=
              Nat.succ_le_of_lt hjLeft
            by_cases hnextLt : j + 1 < leftCount
            · rw [adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
                leftPart rightPart hnextLt]
              exact hright
            · have hnextEq : j + 1 = leftCount := by omega
              rw [hnextEq] at hright
              rw [hnextEq, adjacentPartition_boundary, <- hboundary]
              exact hright
        · have hjRight : leftCount <= j :=
            Nat.le_of_not_gt hjLeft
          let k := j - leftCount
          have hjEq : j = leftCount + k := by
            dsimp [k]
            omega
          have hk : k < rightCount := by
            dsimp [k]
            omega
          rcases hrefRightSuffix k hk with
            ⟨i, hi, hleft, hright⟩
          refine Exists.intro (cut + i) ?_
          refine And.intro (by omega) ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · rw [hjEq, adjacentPartition_right_shift]
            simpa [
              RealFunction.IntervalPartition.suffixPartition_step] using hleft
          · have hnextEq :
                j + 1 = leftCount + (k + 1) := by
              omega
            rw [hnextEq, adjacentPartition_right_shift]
            simpa [
              RealFunction.IntervalPartition.suffixPartition_step] using hright
      let adjacentPart :=
        adjacentPartition leftPart rightPart leftCount
      let adjacentTag :=
        adjacentTags leftTag rightTag leftCount
      have hadjacentTagged :
          TaggedPartition a b (leftCount + rightCount)
            adjacentPart adjacentTag := by
        dsimp [adjacentPart, adjacentTag]
        exact adjacentTaggedPartition hleftTagged hrightTagged
      have hrefAdjacentThreshold :
          PartitionRefines adjacentPart (leftCount + rightCount)
            globalThreshold globalCount := by
        dsimp [adjacentPart]
        exact partitionRefines_trans
          hrefAdjacentMerge hrefMergeThreshold
      let Sl := stieltjesTagSum f alpha leftPart leftTag leftCount
      let Sr := stieltjesTagSum f alpha rightPart rightTag rightCount
      let S :=
        stieltjesTagSum f alpha adjacentPart adjacentTag
          (leftCount + rightCount)
      have hS_eq : S = RealTheory.add Sl Sr := by
        dsimp [S, Sl, Sr, adjacentPart, adjacentTag]
        exact stieltjesTagSum_adjacent
          f alpha hleftTagged hrightTagged
      have hglobalError :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I)) e4 := by
        dsimp [S]
        exact hglobalClose
          (leftCount + rightCount) adjacentPart adjacentTag
          hadjacentTagged hrefAdjacentThreshold
      have hleftError :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sl Il)) e2 := by
        dsimp [Sl]
        exact hleftClose leftCount leftPart leftTag
          hleftTagged hrefLeftThreshold
      have hrightError :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sr Ir)) e4 := by
        dsimp [Sr]
        exact hrightClose rightCount rightPart rightTag
          hrightTagged hrefRightThreshold
      have hglobalErrorRev :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I S)) e4 := by
        change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub I S)) e4
        change F.lt (F.abs (F.sub S I)) e4 at hglobalError
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm F I S]
        exact hglobalError
      have hmiddle :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub S (RealTheory.add Il Ir)))
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sl Il))
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sr Ir))) := by
        rw [hS_eq]
        exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_sub_add_le_abs_sub_add_abs_sub
            F Sl Sr Il Ir
      have houter :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub I (RealTheory.add Il Ir)))
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I S))
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub S (RealTheory.add Il Ir)))) := by
        change
          F.le
            (F.abs (F.sub I (F.add Il Ir)))
            (F.add
              (F.abs (F.sub I S))
              (F.abs (F.sub S (F.add Il Ir))))
        rw [<-
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
            F I S (F.add Il Ir)]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
          F (RealTheory.sub I S)
            (RealTheory.sub S (RealTheory.add Il Ir))
      have htotal :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub I (RealTheory.add Il Ir)))
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I S))
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sl Il))
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sr Ir)))) :=
        RealTheory.le_trans houter
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
            F hmiddle (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I S)))
      have hbudget :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I S))
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sl Il))
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sr Ir))))
            eps := by
        exact RealTheory.add_lt_quarter_half_quarter
          hglobalErrorRev hleftError hrightError
      change
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub I (RealTheory.add Il Ir))) eps
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htotal hbudget

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_restrict_ordered_with_values
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_restrict_ordered_with_values
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a c b I : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I) :
    Exists
      (fun Il : Point =>
        Exists
          (fun Ir : Point =>
            And
              (HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a c Il)
              (And
                (HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha c b Ir)
                (I = RealTheory.add Il Ir))))
proof:
:= by
  have hrestrict :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_restrict_ordered
      hac hcb hmono hbdd (Exists.intro I hI)
  cases hrestrict.left with
  | intro Il hIl =>
      cases hrestrict.right with
      | intro Ir hIr =>
          refine Exists.intro Il ?_
          refine Exists.intro Ir ?_
          refine And.intro hIl ?_
          refine And.intro hIr ?_
          exact
            hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_value_eq_add_restrictions_ordered
              hac hcb hI hIl hIr

name: abs_sub_boundary_value_eq
statement:

    (B S I : Point) :
    RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S (RealTheory.sub B I)) =
      RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub B S) I)
proof:
:= by

  have hsub :
      RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub B I) S =
        RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub B S) I := by

    rw [RealTheory.add_comm I S]

name: twoHalfProductIdentity
statement:
private theorem twoHalfProductIdentity
    (x y u v w : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.sub v u))
        (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.sub w v)) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul y w) (RealTheory.mul x u))
        (RealTheory.mul v (RealTheory.sub y x))
proof:
:= by
  refine RealTheory.eq_sub_of_eq_add_right ?h
  calc
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul y w) (RealTheory.mul x u) =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul y w) (RealTheory.mul x v))
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul x v) (RealTheory.mul x u)) := by
            exact Eq.symm
              (sub_add_sub_cancel_real
                (RealTheory.mul y w) (RealTheory.mul x v)
                (RealTheory.mul x u))
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul x v) (RealTheory.mul x u))
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul y w) (RealTheory.mul x v)) := by
            rw [RealTheory.add_comm]
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul x v) (RealTheory.mul x u))
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul y w) (RealTheory.mul y v))
            (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul y v) (RealTheory.mul x v))) := by
            rw [<- sub_add_sub_cancel_real
              (RealTheory.mul y w) (RealTheory.mul y v)
              (RealTheory.mul x v)]
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul x v) (RealTheory.mul x u))
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.sub w v))
            (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul y v) (RealTheory.mul x v))) := by
            rw [<- mul_sub_eq_mul_sub_real y w v]
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul x v) (RealTheory.mul x u))
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.sub w v))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub y x) v)) := by
            rw [<- sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_real y x v]
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul x v) (RealTheory.mul x u))
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.sub w v))
            (RealTheory.mul v (RealTheory.sub y x))) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_comm (RealTheory.sub y x) v]
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.sub v u))
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.sub w v))
            (RealTheory.mul v (RealTheory.sub y x))) := by
            rw [<- mul_sub_eq_mul_sub_real x v u]
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.sub v u))
            (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.sub w v)))
          (RealTheory.mul v (RealTheory.sub y x)) := by
            rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]

name: tagSplit_twoHalfCell_identity
statement:
theorem tagSplit_twoHalfCell_identity
    (f alpha : Point -> Point) (p tag : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (f (p k))
          (stieltjesIncrement alpha (tagSplitPartition p tag) (2 * k)))
        (RealTheory.mul (f (p (k + 1)))
          (stieltjesIncrement alpha
            (tagSplitPartition p tag) (2 * k + 1))) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.mul (f (p (k + 1))) (alpha (p (k + 1))))
          (RealTheory.mul (f (p k)) (alpha (p k))))
        (RealTheory.mul (alpha (tag k)) (stieltjesIncrement f p k))
proof:
:= by
  unfold stieltjesIncrement
  have hsucc : 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
  rw [tagSplitPartition_even, tagSplitPartition_odd, hsucc,
    tagSplitPartition_even]
  exact
    twoHalfProductIdentity
      (f (p k)) (f (p (k + 1)))
      (alpha (p k)) (alpha (tag k)) (alpha (p (k + 1)))

name: tagSplit_stieltjesTagSum_identity
statement:
theorem tagSplit_stieltjesTagSum_identity
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (h : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (f alpha : Point -> Point) :
    stieltjesTagSum f alpha
        (tagSplitPartition p tag) (tagSplitTags p) (tagSplitCount n) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
          (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a)))
        (stieltjesTagSum alpha f p tag n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold stieltjesTagSum weightedTagSum tagSplitCount
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_pair_even_odd]
  have hpair :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tagSplitTags p (2 * k)))
                (stieltjesIncrement alpha (tagSplitPartition p tag) (2 * k)))
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tagSplitTags p (2 * k + 1)))
                (stieltjesIncrement alpha
                  (tagSplitPartition p tag) (2 * k + 1))))
          n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub
                (RealTheory.mul (f (p (k + 1))) (alpha (p (k + 1))))
                (RealTheory.mul (f (p k)) (alpha (p k))))
              (RealTheory.mul (alpha (tag k)) (stieltjesIncrement f p k)))
          n := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro k
    rw [tagSplitTags_even, tagSplitTags_odd]
    exact tagSplit_twoHalfCell_identity f alpha p tag k
  rw [hpair]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_sub]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_telescope_sub
    (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (f (p k)) (alpha (p k)))]
  rw [h.left.right.left, h.left.left]

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_value
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_value
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I) :
    HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn alpha f a b
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
          (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a)))
        I)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hI.left ?_
  intro eps heps baseCount base hbase
  cases hI.right eps heps baseCount base hbase with
  | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
      cases hthresholdCount with
      | intro threshold hthreshold =>
          refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
          refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
          refine And.intro hthreshold.left ?_
          refine And.intro hthreshold.right.left ?_
          intro n p tag htag href
          let B :=
            RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
              (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a))
          let S := stieltjesTagSum alpha f p tag n
          let splitP := tagSplitPartition p tag
          let splitTag := tagSplitTags p
          have hsplitTagged :
              TaggedPartition a b (tagSplitCount n) splitP splitTag := by
            dsimp [splitP, splitTag]
            exact tagSplitTags_taggedPartition htag
          have hsplitRefines :
              PartitionRefines splitP (tagSplitCount n)
                threshold thresholdCount := by
            dsimp [splitP]
            exact partitionRefines_trans
              (tagSplitPartition_refines htag) href
          have hcloseSplit :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (stieltjesTagSum f alpha splitP splitTag
                      (tagSplitCount n))
                    I))
                eps := by
            exact hthreshold.right.right
              (tagSplitCount n) splitP splitTag hsplitTagged hsplitRefines
          have hsum :
              stieltjesTagSum f alpha splitP splitTag (tagSplitCount n) =
                RealTheory.sub B S := by
            dsimp [B, S, splitP, splitTag]
            exact tagSplit_stieltjesTagSum_identity htag f alpha
          change
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S (RealTheory.sub B I))) eps
          rw [abs_sub_boundary_value_eq B S I]
          rw [<- hsum]
          exact hcloseSplit

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_integrationByParts
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_integrationByParts
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (h : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b) :
    RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn alpha f a b
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | intro I hI =>
      exact Exists.intro
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
            (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a)))
          I)
        (hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_value hI)

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_endpoint_identity
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_endpoint_identity
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hJ : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn alpha f a b J) :
    RealTheory.add I J =
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
        (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a))
proof:
:= by
  let B :=
    RealTheory.sub
      (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
      (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a))
  have hvalue :
      HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn alpha f a b (RealTheory.sub B I) := by
    dsimp [B]
    exact hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrationByParts_value hI
  have hJ_eq : J = RealTheory.sub B I :=
    hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_unique hJ hvalue
  dsimp [B] at hJ_eq ⊢
  rw [hJ_eq]
  rw [RealTheory.add_comm I
    (RealTheory.sub
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
        (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a))) I)]
  exact sub_add_cancel_real
    (RealTheory.sub
      (RealTheory.mul (f b) (alpha b))
      (RealTheory.mul (f a) (alpha a)))
    I

name: exists_refiningPartition_partitionVariation_gt_totalVariationFrom_sub
statement:
private theorem exists_refiningPartition_partitionVariation_gt_totalVariationFrom_sub
    {a b : Point} {alpha : Point -> Point} {eta : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hBV : RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b alpha)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    {baseCount : Nat} {base : Nat -> Point}
    (hbase : IntervalPartition a b baseCount base) :
    Exists
      (fun thresholdCount : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun threshold : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount threshold)
              (And (PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount base baseCount)
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom
                      a alpha b)
                    eta)
                  (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                    alpha threshold thresholdCount)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab_ne : Not (a = b) := by
    intro h
    subst b
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F a hab
  have hbase_pos : 0 < baseCount :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_count_pos_of_endpoints_ne
      hbase hab_ne
  cases
      RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_exists_partitionVariation_gt_sub
        hab hBV heta with
  | intro highCount hhighCount =>
      cases hhighCount with
      | intro high hhigh =>
          let merge :=
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.endpointMergePoint
              base high baseCount highCount
          let mergeCount := baseCount + highCount
          have hhighNeutral :
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.IntervalPartition
                a b highCount high :=
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.strictIntervalPartition_intervalPartition
              hhigh.left
          have hmerge :
              IntervalPartition a b mergeCount merge := by
            dsimp [mergeCount, merge]
            exact
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition
                hbase hhighNeutral
          have hrefBaseBlock :
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
                merge mergeCount base baseCount
                (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.endpointMergeLeftBlockCut
                  base high baseCount highCount) := by
            dsimp [mergeCount, merge]
            exact
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.endpointMergeLeft_partitionBlockRefines
                hbase hhighNeutral hbase_pos
          have hrefBase : PartitionRefines merge mergeCount base baseCount :=
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines
              hrefBaseBlock hmerge
          have hrefHighBlock :
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.PartitionBlockRefines
                merge mergeCount high highCount
                (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.endpointMergeRightBlockCut
                  base high baseCount highCount) := by
            dsimp [mergeCount, merge]
            exact
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.endpointMergeRight_partitionBlockRefines
                hbase hhighNeutral hhigh.left.left
          have hvariation_le :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                  alpha high highCount)
                (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                  alpha merge mergeCount) :=
            RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation_le_of_partitionBlockRefines
              hrefHighBlock
          have hnear :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom
                    a alpha b)
                  eta)
                (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                  alpha merge mergeCount) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hhigh.right hvariation_le
          refine Exists.intro mergeCount ?_
          refine Exists.intro merge ?_
          exact And.intro hmerge (And.intro hrefBase hnear)

name: stieltjesTagSum_sub_tags_finiteSum
statement:
private theorem stieltjesTagSum_sub_tags_finiteSum
    (f alpha : Point -> Point) (p tag tag' : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub (f (tag k)) (f (tag' k)))
              (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
          n =
        RealTheory.sub
          (stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n)
          (stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag' n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  unfold stieltjesTagSum weightedTagSum
  have hterm :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub (f (tag k)) (f (tag' k)))
              (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
          n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tag k))
                (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
              (RealTheory.mul (f (tag' k))
                (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)))
          n := by
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
      (fun k : Nat => by
        rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]
        rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
        rw [RealTheory.neg_mul]
        rw [<- RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg]) n
  rw [hterm]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_sub]

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_tagSum_sub_tags_small
statement:
private theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_tagSum_sub_tags_small
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I eps : Point}
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    {baseCount : Nat} {base : Nat -> Point}
    (hbase : IntervalPartition a b baseCount base) :
    Exists
      (fun thresholdCount : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun threshold : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount threshold)
              (And (PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount base baseCount)
                (forall (n : Nat) (p tag tag' : Nat -> Point),
                  TaggedPartition a b n p tag ->
                  TaggedPartition a b n p tag' ->
                  PartitionRefines p n threshold thresholdCount ->
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.abs
                        (RealTheory.sub
                          (stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n)
                          (stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag' n)))
                      eps))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hI.right e2 he2 baseCount base hbase with
  | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
      cases hthresholdCount with
      | intro threshold hthreshold =>
          cases hthreshold with
          | intro hthreshold_interval hthreshold_tail =>
              cases hthreshold_tail with
              | intro href_threshold_base hclose =>
                  refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
                  refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
                  refine And.intro hthreshold_interval ?_
                  refine And.intro href_threshold_base ?_
                  intro n p tag tag' htag htag' href
                  let S := stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n
                  let S' := stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag' n
                  have hclose_tag :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I)) e2 := by
                    dsimp [S]
                    exact hclose n p tag htag href
                  have hclose_tag' :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S' I)) e2 := by
                    dsimp [S']
                    exact hclose n p tag' htag' href
                  have hclose_tag_rev :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I S)) e2 := by
                    change F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub I S)) e2
                    rwa [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm I S]
                  have hclose_tag'_rev :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I S')) e2 := by
                    change F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub I S')) e2
                    rwa [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm I S']
                  have htri :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S S'))
                        (RealTheory.add
                          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I S))
                          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I S'))) :=
                    by
                      change
                        RealTheory.le
                          (RealFunction.dist S S')
                          (RealTheory.add
                            (RealFunction.dist I S)
                            (RealFunction.dist I S'))
                      rw [RealFunction.dist_comm I S]
                      exact RealFunction.dist_triangle S I S'
                  have hsum :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.add
                          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I S))
                          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I S')))
                        eps := by
                    have hadd :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                        F hclose_tag_rev hclose_tag'_rev
                    change
                      F.lt
                        (F.add
                          (RealTheory.abs (F.sub I S))
                          (RealTheory.abs (F.sub I S')))
                        (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hadd
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_signedTagDifferenceSum_small
statement:
private theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_signedTagDifferenceSum_small
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I eps : Point}
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    {baseCount : Nat} {base : Nat -> Point}
    (hbase : IntervalPartition a b baseCount base) :
    Exists
      (fun thresholdCount : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun threshold : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount threshold)
              (And (PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount base baseCount)
                (forall (n : Nat) (p tag tag' : Nat -> Point),
                  TaggedPartition a b n p tag ->
                  TaggedPartition a b n p tag' ->
                  PartitionRefines p n threshold thresholdCount ->
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.abs
                        (RealTheory.finiteSum
                          (fun k : Nat =>
                            RealTheory.mul
                              (RealTheory.sub
                                (f (tag k)) (f (tag' k)))
                              (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
                          n))
                      eps))))
proof:
:= by
  cases
      hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_tagSum_sub_tags_small
        hI heps hbase with
  | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
      cases hthresholdCount with
      | intro threshold hthreshold =>
          cases hthreshold with
          | intro hthreshold_interval hthreshold_tail =>
              cases hthreshold_tail with
              | intro href_threshold_base hsmall =>
                  refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
                  refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
                  refine And.intro hthreshold_interval ?_
                  refine And.intro href_threshold_base ?_
                  intro n p tag tag' htag htag' href
                  rw [stieltjesTagSum_sub_tags_finiteSum f alpha p tag tag' n]
                  exact hsmall n p tag tag' htag htag' href
