name: cellGap_le_selectedGap_add_two_eta
statement:
private theorem cellGap_le_selectedGap_add_two_eta
    {U L fs fi eta : Point}
    (hU : RealTheory.lt U (RealTheory.add fs eta))
    (hL : RealTheory.lt fi (RealTheory.add L eta)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub U L)
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.sub fs fi)
        (RealTheory.add eta eta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hUle : RealTheory.le U (RealTheory.add fs eta) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hU
  have hFile : RealTheory.le fi (RealTheory.add L eta) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hL
  have hfi_sub_eta_le_L :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub fi eta) L := by
    have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_right hFile (RealTheory.neg eta)
    change
      F.le
        (F.add fi (F.neg eta))
        (F.add (F.add L eta) (F.neg eta)) at h
    rw [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg fi eta] at h
    rw [F.add_assoc L eta (F.neg eta)] at h
    rw [F.add_neg eta] at h
    rw [F.add_zero L] at h
    exact h
  have hsub :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub U L)
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.add fs eta)
          (RealTheory.sub fi eta)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F hUle hfi_sub_eta_le_L
  have hrhs :
      RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.add fs eta)
          (RealTheory.sub fi eta) =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.sub fs fi)
          (RealTheory.add eta eta) := by
    change
      F.sub (F.add fs eta) (F.sub fi eta) =
        F.add (F.sub fs fi) (F.add eta eta)
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg fi eta]
    change
      F.sub (F.add fs eta) (F.add fi (F.neg eta)) =
        F.add (F.sub fs fi) (F.add eta eta)
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
      F fs eta fi (F.neg eta)]
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg eta (F.neg eta)]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F eta]
  rwa [hrhs] at hsub

name: cellGap_mul_absIncrement_le_signSelectedNearTerm_add_error
statement:
private theorem cellGap_mul_absIncrement_le_signSelectedNearTerm_add_error
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {eta : Point}
    {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}
    (hsup :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M))
    (hinf :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m))
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
        (RealTheory.abs (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub
            (f (signSelectedNearUpperTag f alpha p n eta hsup hinf heta k))
            (f (signSelectedNearLowerTag f alpha p n eta hsup hinf heta k)))
          (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add eta eta)
          (RealTheory.abs (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let inc := stieltjesIncrement alpha p k
  let supTag :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.nearCellSupTag
      f p n eta hsup heta
  let infTag :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.nearCellInfTag
      f p n eta hinf heta
  let gap := RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)
  let selectedGap := RealTheory.sub (f (supTag k)) (f (infTag k))
  let error := RealTheory.add eta eta
  have hnearSup :
      RealTheory.lt (cellUpper f p k)
        (RealTheory.add (f (supTag k)) eta) := by
    dsimp [supTag]
    exact
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.nearCellSupTag_property
        hsup heta hk
  have hnearInf :
      RealTheory.lt (f (infTag k))
        (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) eta) := by
    dsimp [infTag]
    exact
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.nearCellInfTag_property
        hinf heta hk
  have hgap :
      RealTheory.le gap (RealTheory.add selectedGap error) := by
    dsimp [gap, selectedGap, error]
    exact cellGap_le_selectedGap_add_two_eta hnearSup hnearInf
  classical
  by_cases hinc : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero inc
  · have hmul :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul gap inc)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add selectedGap error) inc) :=
      RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hgap hinc
    have hdist :
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add selectedGap error) inc =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul selectedGap inc)
            (RealTheory.mul error inc) :=
      RealTheory.add_mul selectedGap error inc
    rw [hdist] at hmul
    dsimp [gap, selectedGap, error, inc] at hmul
    unfold signSelectedNearUpperTag signSelectedNearLowerTag
    rw [if_pos hinc, if_pos hinc]
    rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hinc]
    exact hmul
  · have hinc_nonpos : RealTheory.le inc RealTheory.zero :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hinc
    have hneg_inc_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.neg inc) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F hinc_nonpos
    have hmul :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul gap (RealTheory.neg inc))
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.add selectedGap error)
            (RealTheory.neg inc)) :=
      RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hgap hneg_inc_nonneg
    have hdist :
        RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.add selectedGap error)
            (RealTheory.neg inc) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul selectedGap (RealTheory.neg inc))
            (RealTheory.mul error (RealTheory.neg inc)) :=
      RealTheory.add_mul selectedGap error (RealTheory.neg inc)
    rw [hdist] at hmul
    have hselected :
        RealTheory.mul selectedGap (RealTheory.neg inc) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.sub (f (infTag k)) (f (supTag k))) inc := by
      dsimp [selectedGap]
      change
        F.mul (F.sub (f (supTag k)) (f (infTag k))) (F.neg inc) =
          F.mul (F.sub (f (infTag k)) (f (supTag k))) inc
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg
        F (F.sub (f (supTag k)) (f (infTag k))) inc]
      change
        F.neg (F.mul (F.sub (f (supTag k)) (f (infTag k))) inc) =
          F.mul (F.sub (f (infTag k)) (f (supTag k))) inc
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F
        (f (supTag k)) (f (infTag k))]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul
        F (F.sub (f (supTag k)) (f (infTag k))) inc]
    rw [hselected] at hmul
    dsimp [gap, error, inc, supTag, infTag] at hmul
    unfold signSelectedNearUpperTag signSelectedNearLowerTag
    rw [if_neg hinc, if_neg hinc]
    rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonpos hinc_nonpos]
    exact hmul

name: cellGapAbsIncrementSum_le_signSelectedNearSum_add_error
statement:
private theorem cellGapAbsIncrementSum_le_signSelectedNearSum_add_error
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {eta : Point}
    {p : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hsup :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M))
    (hinf :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m))
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
            (RealTheory.abs (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)))
        n)
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub
                (f (signSelectedNearUpperTag
                  f alpha p n eta hsup hinf heta k))
                (f (signSelectedNearLowerTag
                  f alpha p n eta hsup hinf heta k)))
              (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
          n)
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add eta eta)
          (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
            alpha p n)))
proof:
:= by
  let selectedTerm := fun k : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.sub
        (f (signSelectedNearUpperTag f alpha p n eta hsup hinf heta k))
        (f (signSelectedNearLowerTag f alpha p n eta hsup hinf heta k)))
      (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)
  let errorTerm := fun k : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.add eta eta)
      (RealTheory.abs (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
              (RealTheory.abs (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)))
          n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.add (selectedTerm k) (errorTerm k))
          n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
          (RealTheory.abs (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)))
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.add (selectedTerm k) (errorTerm k))
      n
      (fun k hk =>
        cellGap_mul_absIncrement_le_signSelectedNearTerm_add_error
          hsup hinf heta hk)
  have hsplit :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.add (selectedTerm k) (errorTerm k))
          n =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum selectedTerm n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum errorTerm n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_add selectedTerm errorTerm n
  have hvar :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.abs (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
          n =
        RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation alpha p n := by
    unfold RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
      (fun k : Nat => by
        unfold RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm
        unfold stieltjesIncrement
        rfl) n
  have herror :
      RealTheory.finiteSum errorTerm n =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.add eta eta)
          (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
            alpha p n) := by
    dsimp [errorTerm]
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left]
    rw [hvar]
  rw [hsplit, herror] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_cellGapAbsIncrementSum_small_of_partitionVariationBound
statement:
private theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_cellGapAbsIncrementSum_small_of_partitionVariationBound
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I V eps : Point}
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hV_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero V)
    (hvariationBound :
      forall (n : Nat) (p : Nat -> Point),
        IntervalPartition a b n p ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation alpha p n)
            V)
    (hcell : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    {baseCount : Nat} {base : Nat -> Point}
    (hbase : IntervalPartition a b baseCount base) :
    Exists
      (fun thresholdCount : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun threshold : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount threshold)
              (And (PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount base baseCount)
                (forall (n : Nat) (p : Nat -> Point),
                  IntervalPartition a b n p ->
                  PartitionRefines p n threshold thresholdCount ->
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum
                        (fun k : Nat =>
                          RealTheory.mul
                            (RealTheory.sub
                              (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)))
                        n)
                      eps))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases
      RealTheory.exists_pos_eta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
        hV_nonneg he2 with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      let eta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F delta
      have heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta := by
        dsimp [eta]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hdelta.left
      have heta_add :
          RealTheory.add eta eta = delta := by
        dsimp [eta]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F delta
      cases
          hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_signedTagDifferenceSum_small
            hI he2 hbase with
      | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
          cases hthresholdCount with
          | intro threshold hthreshold =>
              cases hthreshold with
              | intro hthreshold_interval hthreshold_tail =>
                  cases hthreshold_tail with
                  | intro href_threshold_base hsmall =>
                      refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
                      refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
                      refine And.intro hthreshold_interval ?_
                      refine And.intro href_threshold_base ?_
                      intro n p hp href
                      have hcell_p := hcell n p hp
                      let hinf := hcell_p.left
                      let hsup := hcell_p.right
                      let upperTag :=
                        signSelectedNearUpperTag
                          f alpha p n eta hsup hinf heta
                      let lowerTag :=
                        signSelectedNearLowerTag
                          f alpha p n eta hsup hinf heta
                      let signedSum :=
                        RealTheory.finiteSum
                          (fun k : Nat =>
                            RealTheory.mul
                              (RealTheory.sub
                                (f (upperTag k)) (f (lowerTag k)))
                              (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
                          n
                      let error :=
                        RealTheory.mul
                          (RealTheory.add eta eta)
                          (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                            alpha p n)
                      have hupperTag :
                          TaggedPartition a b n p upperTag := by
                        dsimp [upperTag]
                        exact
                          signSelectedNearUpperTag_taggedPartition
                            hp hsup hinf heta
                      have hlowerTag :
                          TaggedPartition a b n p lowerTag := by
                        dsimp [lowerTag]
                        exact
                          signSelectedNearLowerTag_taggedPartition
                            hp hsup hinf heta
                      have hsigned_abs :
                          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs signedSum) e2 := by
                        dsimp [signedSum, upperTag, lowerTag]
                        exact
                          hsmall n p
                            (signSelectedNearUpperTag
                              f alpha p n eta hsup hinf heta)
                            (signSelectedNearLowerTag
                              f alpha p n eta hsup hinf heta)
                            hupperTag hlowerTag href
                      have hsigned_lt :
                          RealTheory.lt signedSum e2 :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                          (RealTheory.le_abs_self signedSum)
                          hsigned_abs
                      have hbridge :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealTheory.finiteSum
                              (fun k : Nat =>
                                RealTheory.mul
                                  (RealTheory.sub
                                    (cellUpper f p k)
                                    (cellLower f p k))
                                  (RealTheory.abs
                                    (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)))
                              n)
                            (RealTheory.add signedSum error) := by
                        dsimp [signedSum, error, upperTag, lowerTag]
                        exact
                          cellGapAbsIncrementSum_le_signSelectedNearSum_add_error
                            hsup hinf heta
                      have hpart_le_total :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                              alpha p n)
                            V :=
                        hvariationBound n p hp
                      have hdelta_nonneg :
                          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero delta :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hdelta.left
                      have herror_le_total :
                          RealTheory.le error
                            (RealTheory.mul delta V) := by
                        dsimp [error]
                        rw [heta_add]
                        exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                          hpart_le_total hdelta_nonneg
                      have herror_lt :
                          RealTheory.lt error e2 :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                          herror_le_total hdelta.right
                      have hsum_lt :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.add signedSum error) eps := by
                        have hadd :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                            F hsigned_lt herror_lt
                        change
                          F.lt (F.add signedSum error) (F.add e2 e2)
                            at hadd
                        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps]
                          at hadd
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                        F hbridge hsum_lt

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_cellGapAbsIncrementSum_small
statement:
private theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_cellGapAbsIncrementSum_small
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I eps : Point}
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hBV : RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b alpha)
    (hcell : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    {baseCount : Nat} {base : Nat -> Point}
    (hbase : IntervalPartition a b baseCount base) :
    Exists
      (fun thresholdCount : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun threshold : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount threshold)
              (And (PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount base baseCount)
                (forall (n : Nat) (p : Nat -> Point),
                  IntervalPartition a b n p ->
                  PartitionRefines p n threshold thresholdCount ->
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum
                        (fun k : Nat =>
                          RealTheory.mul
                            (RealTheory.sub
                              (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)))
                        n)
                      eps))))
proof:
:= by
  let V := RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha b
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b :=
    RealFunction.BoundedVariation.boundedVariationOn_interval_le hBV
  have hb : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab
  have hV_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero V := by
    dsimp [V]
    exact
      RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_nonnegative_of_boundedVariationOn
        hBV hb
  exact
    hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_cellGapAbsIncrementSum_small_of_partitionVariationBound
      (V := V) hI hV_nonneg
      (fun n p hp =>
        RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation_le_totalVariationFrom_of_intervalPartition
          hBV hp)
      hcell heps hbase

name: mul_left_le_mul_left_add_bound_mul_sub
statement:
private theorem mul_left_le_mul_left_add_bound_mul_sub
    {x B y z : Point}
    (hxB : RealTheory.le x B)
    (hzy : RealTheory.le z y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul x y)
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul x z)
        (RealTheory.mul B (RealTheory.sub y z)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := RealTheory.sub y z
  have hsur_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero d :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hzy
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul x d)
        (RealTheory.mul B d) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hxB hsur_nonneg
  have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_right hmul (RealTheory.mul x z)
  have hy_decomp :
      y = RealTheory.add d z := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F y z)
  have hleft_eq :
      RealTheory.mul x y =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul x z)
          (RealTheory.mul x d) := by
    rw [hy_decomp]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_add]
    rw [RealTheory.add_comm
      (RealTheory.mul x d) (RealTheory.mul x z)]
  rw [RealTheory.add_comm
    (RealTheory.mul B d) (RealTheory.mul x z)]
    at h
  rw [RealTheory.add_comm
    (RealTheory.mul x d) (RealTheory.mul x z)]
    at h
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul x y)
      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul x z) (RealTheory.mul B d))
  rw [hleft_eq]
  exact h

name: cellGap_mul_totalVariationIncrement_le_absIncrement_add_deficitTerm
statement:
private theorem cellGap_mul_totalVariationIncrement_le_absIncrement_add_deficitTerm
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b lower upper : Point}
    {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}
    (hBV : RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b alpha)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hinf : Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m))
    (hsup : Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M))
    (hbounds :
      forall x : Point, PartitionCell p k x ->
        And (RealTheory.le lower (f x)) (RealTheory.le (f x) upper))
    (hk : k < n) :
    let V
proof:
:= RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha
    let gap := RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)
    let B := RealTheory.sub upper lower
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul gap (stieltjesIncrement V p k))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul gap
          (RealTheory.abs (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)))
        (RealTheory.mul B
          (RealTheory.sub
            (stieltjesIncrement V p k)
            (RealTheory.abs (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))))) := by
  intro V gap B
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hgap_le :
      RealTheory.le gap B := by
    dsimp [gap, B]
    exact
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellGap_le_of_cell_values_between
        hinf hsup hbounds
  have habs_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
        (stieltjesIncrement V p k) := by
    unfold stieltjesIncrement
    dsimp [V]
    exact
      RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_increment_abs_le
        hBV
        (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
          hp hk)
        (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
          hp hk)
        (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_step_le
          hp hk)
  exact mul_left_le_mul_left_add_bound_mul_sub hgap_le habs_le

name: darbouxGap_totalVariationFrom_le_absIncrementGapSum_add_variationDeficit
statement:
private theorem darbouxGap_totalVariationFrom_le_absIncrementGapSum_add_variationDeficit
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b lower upper : Point}
    {p : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hBV : RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b alpha)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hcell : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b)
    (hbounds :
      forall x : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
        And (RealTheory.le lower (f x)) (RealTheory.le (f x) upper))
    (hB_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub upper lower)) :
    let V
proof:
:= RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha
    let B := RealTheory.sub upper lower
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f V p n) (lowerSum f V p n))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
              (RealTheory.abs (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)))
          n)
        (RealTheory.mul B
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha b)
            (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
              alpha p n)))) := by
  intro V B
  let gap := fun k : Nat =>
    RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)
  let deltaV := fun k : Nat => stieltjesIncrement V p k
  let absDelta := fun k : Nat =>
    RealTheory.abs (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)
  let absTerm := fun k : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul (gap k) (absDelta k)
  let surplusTerm := fun k : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul B (RealTheory.sub (deltaV k) (absDelta k))
  have hgap_eq :
      RealTheory.sub (upperSum f V p n) (lowerSum f V p n) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (gap k) (deltaV k)) n := by
    unfold upperSum lowerSum
    dsimp [gap, deltaV]
    exact
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedDarbouxGap_eq_finiteSum_cellGap_mul_weight
        f (stieltjesIncrement V p) p n

  have hpoint :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul (gap k) (deltaV k))
          (RealTheory.add (absTerm k) (surplusTerm k)) := by
    intro k hk
    dsimp [gap, deltaV, absDelta, absTerm, surplusTerm, B, V]
    exact
      cellGap_mul_totalVariationIncrement_le_absIncrement_add_deficitTerm
        hBV hp (hcellData.left k hk) (hcellData.right k hk)
        (fun x hx =>
          hbounds x
            (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
              hp hk hx))
        hk
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (gap k) (deltaV k)) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.add (absTerm k) (surplusTerm k)) n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (gap k) (deltaV k))
      (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.add (absTerm k) (surplusTerm k))
      n hpoint
  have hsplit :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.add (absTerm k) (surplusTerm k)) n =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum absTerm n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum surplusTerm n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_add absTerm surplusTerm n
  have hsurplus_sum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum surplusTerm n =
        RealTheory.mul B
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.sub (deltaV k) (absDelta k)) n) := by
    dsimp [surplusTerm]
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left]
  have habs_sum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum absDelta n =
        RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation alpha p n := by
    unfold RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
      (fun k : Nat => by
        unfold RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariationTerm
        dsimp [absDelta]
        unfold stieltjesIncrement
        rfl) n
  have hdelta_sum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum deltaV n =
        RealTheory.sub (V (p n)) (V (p 0)) := by
    dsimp [deltaV]
    unfold stieltjesIncrement
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_telescope_sub
      (fun k : Nat => V (p k)) n
  have hdelta_sum_le_total :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum deltaV n)
        (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha b) := by
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    have hab : RealTheory.le a b :=
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_interval_le hp
    have ha : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
      RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab
    have hVa_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (V a) := by
      dsimp [V]
      exact
        RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom_nonnegative_of_boundedVariationOn
          hBV ha
    have hend :
        RealTheory.sub (V (p n)) (V (p 0)) =
          RealTheory.sub
            (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha b)
            (V a) := by
      dsimp [V]
      rw
        [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_right_endpoint
          hp,
         Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_left_endpoint
          hp]
    rw [hdelta_sum, hend]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic
      F hVa_nonneg
  have hsurplus_core :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.sub (deltaV k) (absDelta k)) n =
        RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.finiteSum deltaV n)
          (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation alpha p n) := by
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_sub]
    rw [habs_sum]
  have hsurplus_core_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.sub (deltaV k) (absDelta k)) n)
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha b)
          (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation alpha p n)) := by
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    rw [hsurplus_core]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F hdelta_sum_le_total
      (RealTheory.le_refl
        (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation alpha p n))
  have hsurplus_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum surplusTerm n)
        (RealTheory.mul B
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha b)
            (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation alpha p n))) := by
    rw [hsurplus_sum]
    exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
      hsurplus_core_le hB_nonneg
  have hsum_split :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (gap k) (deltaV k)) n)
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum absTerm n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum surplusTerm n)) := by
    rwa [hsplit] at hsum
  have htotal :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (gap k) (deltaV k)) n)
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum absTerm n)
          (RealTheory.mul B
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha b)
              (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation alpha p n)))) :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hsum_split
      (RealTheory.add_le_add_left hsurplus_le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum absTerm n))
  rwa [hgap_eq]

name: riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_totalVariationFrom_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
statement:
private theorem riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_totalVariationFrom_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hBV : RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b alpha) :
    RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall
      f (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha) a b
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let V := RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hbdd with
  | intro lower hlower =>
      cases hlower with
      | intro upper hbounds =>
          let B := RealTheory.sub upper lower
          have hab_le : RealTheory.le a b :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab
          have hB_nonneg :
              RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero B := by
            have ha : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
              RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab_le
            have hlower_upper : RealTheory.le lower upper :=
              RealTheory.le_trans (hbounds a ha).left (hbounds a ha).right
            dsimp [B]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hlower_upper
          cases
              RealTheory.exists_pos_eta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
                hB_nonneg he2 with
          | intro eta heta =>
              let base := twoPointPartition a b
              have hbase : IntervalPartition a b 1 base :=
                twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hab_le
              cases
                  exists_refiningPartition_partitionVariation_gt_totalVariationFrom_sub
                    hab hBV heta.left hbase with
              | intro nearCount hnearCount =>
                  cases hnearCount with
                  | intro near hnear =>
                      cases hnear with
                      | intro hnear_interval hnear_tail =>
                          cases hnear_tail with
                          | intro _href_near_base hnear_gt =>
                              have hcell :
                                  RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn
                                    f a b :=
                                riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_boundedOn_closedInterval
                                  (Exists.intro lower
                                    (Exists.intro upper hbounds))
                              cases
                                  hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_cellGapAbsIncrementSum_small
                                    hI hBV hcell he2 hnear_interval with
                              | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
                                  cases hthresholdCount with
                                  | intro threshold hthreshold =>
                                      cases hthreshold with
                                      | intro hthreshold_interval hthreshold_tail =>
                                          cases hthreshold_tail with
                                          | intro href_threshold_near habs_small =>
                                              let absSum :=
                                                RealTheory.finiteSum
                                                  (fun k : Nat =>
                                                    RealTheory.mul
                                                      (RealTheory.sub
                                                        (cellUpper f threshold k)
                                                        (cellLower f threshold k))
                                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                                        (stieltjesIncrement
                                                          alpha threshold k)))
                                                  thresholdCount
                                              let surplus :=
                                                RealTheory.mul B
                                                  (RealTheory.sub
                                                    (V b)
                                                    (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                                      alpha threshold
                                                      thresholdCount))
                                              have href_self :
                                                  PartitionRefines threshold
                                                    thresholdCount threshold
                                                    thresholdCount :=
                                                partitionRefines_self
                                                  hthreshold_interval
                                              have habs_lt :
                                                  RealTheory.lt absSum e2 := by
                                                dsimp [absSum]
                                                exact
                                                  habs_small thresholdCount
                                                    threshold
                                                    hthreshold_interval
                                                    href_self
                                              have hpv_near_le_threshold :
                                                  RealTheory.le
                                                    (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                                      alpha near nearCount)
                                                    (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                                      alpha threshold
                                                      thresholdCount) :=
                                                RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation_le_of_partitionRefines
                                                  hthreshold_interval
                                                  hnear_interval
                                                  href_threshold_near
                                              have hnear_threshold :
                                                  RealTheory.lt
                                                    (RealTheory.sub (V b) eta)
                                                    (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                                      alpha threshold
                                                      thresholdCount) := by
                                                exact
                                                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                                                    F hnear_gt
                                                    hpv_near_le_threshold
                                              have hdeficit_lt_eta :
                                                  RealTheory.lt
                                                    (RealTheory.sub
                                                      (V b)
                                                      (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                                        alpha threshold
                                                        thresholdCount))
                                                    eta := by
                                                exact
                                                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_sub_lt_left
                                                    F hnear_threshold
                                              have hdeficit_le_eta :
                                                  RealTheory.le
                                                    (RealTheory.sub
                                                      (V b)
                                                      (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.partitionVariation
                                                        alpha threshold
                                                        thresholdCount))
                                                    eta :=
                                                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                                                  F hdeficit_lt_eta
                                              have hsurplus_le_eta :
                                                  RealTheory.le surplus
                                                    (RealTheory.mul B eta) := by
                                                dsimp [surplus, B]
                                                exact
                                                  RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                                                    hdeficit_le_eta
                                                    hB_nonneg
                                              have heta_right :
                                                  RealTheory.lt
                                                    (RealTheory.mul B eta) e2 := by
                                                rw [RealTheory.mul_comm B eta]
                                                exact heta.right
                                              have hsurplus_lt :
                                                  RealTheory.lt surplus e2 :=
                                                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                                  F hsurplus_le_eta
                                                  heta_right
                                              have hgap_le :
                                                  RealTheory.le
                                                    (RealTheory.sub
                                                      (upperSum f V threshold
                                                        thresholdCount)
                                                      (lowerSum f V threshold
                                                        thresholdCount))
                                                    (RealTheory.add absSum
                                                      surplus) := by
                                                dsimp [absSum, surplus, V, B]
                                                exact
                                                  darbouxGap_totalVariationFrom_le_absIncrementGapSum_add_variationDeficit
                                                    hBV hthreshold_interval hcell
                                                    hbounds hB_nonneg
                                              have hsum_lt :
                                                  RealTheory.lt
                                                    (RealTheory.add absSum
                                                      surplus)
                                                    eps := by
                                                have hadd :=
                                                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                                                    F habs_lt
                                                    hsurplus_lt
                                                change
                                                  F.lt
                                                    (F.add absSum surplus)
                                                    (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                                                rwa
                                                  [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                                                    F eps] at hadd
                                              refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
                                              refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
                                              refine And.intro hthreshold_interval ?_
                                              exact
                                                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                                  F hgap_le hsum_lt

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_totalVariationFrom_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn

theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_totalVariationFrom_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hBV : RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b alpha) :
    RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
      f (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha) a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hba : RealTheory.le b a
  case pos =>
    have hab_eq : a = b := RealTheory.le_antisymm hab hba
    subst b
    exact
      riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_degenerate
        f (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha) a
  case neg =>
    have hab_lt : RealTheory.lt a b :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hab hba
    have hmono :
        IntegratorMonotoneOn
          (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha) a b :=
      integratorMonotoneOn_totalVariationFrom_of_boundedVariationOn hBV
    have hcell :
        RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b :=
      riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_boundedOn_closedInterval
        hbdd
    have hsmall :
        RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall
          f (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha) a b :=
      riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_totalVariationFrom_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
        hab_lt hI hbdd hBV
    cases
        exists_hasRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegrals
          hab hmono hcell with
    | intro Il hIl =>
        cases hIl with
        | intro Iu hIu =>
            exact
              riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_darbouxGapSmall
                hab hmono hcell hIu.left hIu.right hsmall

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_restrict_ordered_of_boundedVariationOn
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_restrict_ordered_of_boundedVariationOn
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hBV : RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b alpha)
    (hInt : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b) :
    And
      (RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a c)
      (RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha c b)
proof:
:= by
  let V := RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha
  let N := RealFunction.SubFun V alpha
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hac hcb
  have hcanonical :=
    (riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_iff_totalVariationFrom_and_totalVariationMinus
      hab hbdd hBV).mp hInt
  have hV :
      RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f V a b := by
    simpa [V] using hcanonical.left
  have hN :
      RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f N a b := by
    simpa [N, V] using hcanonical.right
  have hmonoV : IntegratorMonotoneOn V a b := by
    dsimp [V]
    exact integratorMonotoneOn_totalVariationFrom_of_boundedVariationOn hBV
  have hmonoN : IntegratorMonotoneOn N a b := by
    dsimp [N, V]
    exact integratorMonotoneOn_totalVariationMinus_of_boundedVariationOn hBV
  have hVrestrict :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_restrict_ordered
      hac hcb hmonoV hbdd hV
  have hNrestrict :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_restrict_ordered
      hac hcb hmonoN hbdd hN
  have hleftSub :
      RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f
        (RealFunction.SubFun V N) a c :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_sub_integrator
      hVrestrict.left hNrestrict.left
  have hrightSub :
      RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f
        (RealFunction.SubFun V N) c b :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_sub_integrator
      hVrestrict.right hNrestrict.right
  have hsameGlobal :
      RealFunction.SameOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (RealFunction.SubFun V N) alpha := by
    exact RealFunction.sameOn_symm
      (by
        simpa [N, V] using
          (sameOn_integrator_eq_totalVariationFrom_sub_totalVariationMinus
            (a := a) (b := b) (alpha := alpha)))
  have hsameLeft :
      RealFunction.SameOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c)
        (RealFunction.SubFun V N) alpha := by
    intro x hx
    exact hsameGlobal x
      (And.intro hx.left (RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hcb))
  have hsameRight :
      RealFunction.SameOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c b)
        (RealFunction.SubFun V N) alpha := by
    intro x hx
    exact hsameGlobal x
      (And.intro (RealTheory.le_trans hac hx.left) hx.right)
  exact And.intro
    (riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_integrator_congr hsameLeft hleftSub)
    (riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_integrator_congr hsameRight hrightSub)

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_totalVariationFrom_and_totalVariationMinus_values
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_totalVariationFrom_and_totalVariationMinus_values
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b IV IN : Point}

  let N := RealFunction.SubFun V alpha
  have hsub :
      HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (V x) (N x)) a b
        (RealTheory.sub IV IN) :=
    hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_sub_integrator hV hN
  have hsame :
      RealFunction.SameOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (RealFunction.SubFun V N) alpha :=
    RealFunction.sameOn_symm
      (sameOn_integrator_eq_totalVariationFrom_sub_totalVariationMinus
        (a := a) (b := b) (alpha := alpha))
  exact hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrator_congr hsame hsub

name: exists_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_totalVariationComponents_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
statement:
theorem exists_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_totalVariationComponents_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hBV : RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b alpha) :
    Exists
      (fun IV : Point =>
        Exists
          (fun IN : Point =>
            And
              (HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f
                (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha)
                a b IV)
              (And
                (HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f
                  (RealFunction.SubFun
                    (RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha)
                    alpha) a b IN)
                (RealTheory.sub IV IN = I))))
proof:
:= by
  cases
      riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_totalVariationFrom_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
        hab hI hbdd hBV with
  | intro IV hV =>
      cases
          riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_totalVariationMinus_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
            hab hI hbdd hBV with
      | intro IN hN =>
          refine Exists.intro IV ?_
          refine Exists.intro IN ?_
          refine And.intro hV ?_
          refine And.intro hN ?_
          exact
            hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_unique
              (hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_of_totalVariationFrom_and_totalVariationMinus_values
                hV hN)
              hI

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_continuousOn_closedInterval_boundedVariationOn
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_continuousOn_closedInterval_boundedVariationOn
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hBV : RealFunction.BoundedVariation.BoundedVariationOn a b alpha) :
    RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b
proof:
:= by
  let V := RealFunction.BoundedVariation.totalVariationFrom a alpha
  let N := RealFunction.SubFun V alpha
  have hVmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn V a b := by
    dsimp [V]
    exact integratorMonotoneOn_totalVariationFrom_of_boundedVariationOn hBV
  have hNmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn N a b := by
    dsimp [N, V]
    exact integratorMonotoneOn_totalVariationMinus_of_boundedVariationOn hBV

    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_continuousOn_closedInterval
      hab hVmono hf
  have hN :
      RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f N a b :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_continuousOn_closedInterval
