name: stieltjesTagSum_nonnegative_of_nonnegative_integrand
statement:
private theorem stieltjesTagSum_nonnegative_of_nonnegative_integrand
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hf_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f x)) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold stieltjesTagSum weightedTagSum
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_nonneg
    (fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
    n
    (fun k hk => by
      have htag_mem :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (tag k) :=
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.taggedPartition_tag_mem_closedInterval
          htag hk
      have hf_nonneg' :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f (tag k)) :=
        hf_nonneg (tag k) htag_mem
      have hinc_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k) :=
        stieltjesIncrement_nonnegative_of_monotone htag.left hmono hk
      exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hf_nonneg' hinc_nonneg)

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_nonnegative_of_nonnegative_integrand
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_nonnegative_of_nonnegative_integrand
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hf_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f x)) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero I
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases h0I : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero I
  case pos =>
    exact h0I
  case neg =>
    cases F.le_total I RealTheory.zero with
    | inl hI_nonpos =>
        have hI_neg : RealTheory.lt I RealTheory.zero :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hI_nonpos h0I
        have hnegI_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.neg I) := by
          have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right
            F hI_neg (RealTheory.neg I)
          change
            F.lt (F.add I (F.neg I))
              (F.add F.zero (F.neg I)) at h
          rwa [F.add_neg, F.zero_add] at h
        let eps := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (RealTheory.neg I)
        have heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hnegI_pos
        have heps_lt_negI :
            RealTheory.lt eps (RealTheory.neg I) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hnegI_pos
        have hI_add_eps_neg :
            RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add I eps) RealTheory.zero := by
          have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
            F heps_lt_negI I
          change
            F.lt (F.add I eps) (F.add I (F.neg I)) at h
          rwa [F.add_neg] at h
        let base := twoPointPartition a b
        have hbase : IntervalPartition a b 1 base :=
          twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hab
        cases hI.right eps heps 1 base hbase with
        | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
            cases hthresholdCount with
            | intro threshold hthreshold =>
                let tag := leftTags threshold
                have htag :
                    TaggedPartition a b thresholdCount threshold tag :=
                  leftTags_taggedPartition hthreshold.left
                have href :
                    PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount
                      threshold thresholdCount :=
                  partitionRefines_self hthreshold.left
                let S :=
                  stieltjesTagSum f alpha threshold tag thresholdCount
                have hS_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero S := by
                  dsimp [S]
                  exact
                    stieltjesTagSum_nonnegative_of_nonnegative_integrand
                      htag hmono hf_nonneg
                have hclose :
                    RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I)) eps := by
                  dsimp [S]
                  exact hthreshold.right.right thresholdCount
                    threshold tag htag href
                have hS_lt_I_eps :
                    RealTheory.lt S (RealTheory.add I eps) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt F hclose
                have hS_lt_zero : RealTheory.lt S RealTheory.zero :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
                    F hS_lt_I_eps hI_add_eps_neg
                exact False.elim
                  ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hS_lt_zero)
                    hS_nonneg)
    | inr h0I' =>
        exact h0I'

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
    {f g alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hfg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (f x) (g x))
    (hfI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hgJ : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn g alpha a b J) :
    RealTheory.le I J
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub :
      HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (g x) (f x))
        alpha a b (RealTheory.sub J I) :=
    hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_sub_integrand hgJ hfI
  have hsub_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.sub (g x) (f x)) := by
    intro x hx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F (hfg x hx)
  have hvalue_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub J I) :=
    hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_nonnegative_of_nonnegative_integrand
      hab hmono hsub hsub_nonneg
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_sub_nonneg F hvalue_nonneg

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_abs_le_bound_mul_integrator_increment
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_abs_le_bound_mul_integrator_increment
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I M : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hM :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs I)
      (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub (alpha b) (alpha a)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let deltaAlpha := RealTheory.sub (alpha b) (alpha a)
  let bound := RealTheory.mul M deltaAlpha
  have hconstUpper :
      HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
        (fun _ : Point => M) alpha a b bound := by
    dsimp [bound, deltaAlpha]
    exact hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_const_integrand_of_le M alpha hab
  have hI_le_bound : RealTheory.le I bound := by
    exact hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
      hab hmono
      (fun x hx =>
        RealTheory.le_trans (RealTheory.le_abs_self (f x)) (hM x hx))
      hI hconstUpper
  have hconstLower :
      HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.neg M) alpha a b
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg M) deltaAlpha) := by
    dsimp [deltaAlpha]
    exact hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_const_integrand_of_le
      (RealTheory.neg M) alpha hab
  have hnegM_le_I :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg M) deltaAlpha) I := by
    exact hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_le_of_pointwise_le
      hab hmono
      (fun x hx => by
        have hneg_f_le_M :
            RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg (f x)) M :=
          RealTheory.le_trans (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self (f x)) (hM x hx)
        have hneg := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hneg_f_le_M
        change RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg M)
          (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.neg (f x))) at hneg
        rwa [RealTheory.neg_neg (f x)] at hneg)
      hconstLower hI
  have hnegI_le_bound :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg I) bound := by
    have hneg :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hnegM_le_I
    change
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg I)
        (RealTheory.neg
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg M) deltaAlpha)) at hneg
    have hneg_bound :
        RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg M) deltaAlpha) =
          bound := by
      dsimp [bound, deltaAlpha]
      rw [RealTheory.neg_mul M (RealTheory.sub (alpha b) (alpha a))]
      rw [RealTheory.neg_neg
        (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub (alpha b) (alpha a)))]
    rwa [hneg_bound] at hneg
  exact RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hI_le_bound hnegI_le_bound

name: riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_abs_integrand_of_darbouxGapSmall
statement:
private theorem riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_abs_integrand_of_darbouxGapSmall
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hcell : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b)
    (hcell_abs :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) a b)
    (hsmall : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a b) :
    RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) alpha a b
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hsmall eps heps with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases hn with
      | intro p hp =>
          refine Exists.intro n ?_
          refine Exists.intro p ?_
          refine And.intro hp.left ?_
          let absf := fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)
          have hcell_f := hcell n p hp.left
          have hcell_abs' := hcell_abs n p hp.left
          have hgap_le :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (upperSum absf alpha p n)
                  (lowerSum absf alpha p n))
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (upperSum f alpha p n)
                  (lowerSum f alpha p n)) := by
            simpa [absf, upperSum, lowerSum] using
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedDarbouxGap_abs_le_weightedDarbouxGap
                (f := f) (weight := stieltjesIncrement alpha p)
                (n := n) (p := p)
                (fun k hk =>
                  stieltjesIncrement_nonnegative_of_monotone
                    hp.left hmono hk)
                hcell_f.left hcell_f.right
                hcell_abs'.left hcell_abs'.right
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hgap_le hp.right

name: boundedOn_abs_bound
statement:
private theorem boundedOn_abs_bound
    {E : RealFunction.Domain} {f : Point -> Point}
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn E f) :
    Exists fun M : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
        (forall x : Point, E x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) M)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rcases hbdd with ⟨lower, upper, hbounds⟩
  let M := RealTheory.max (RealTheory.abs lower) (RealTheory.abs upper)
  refine Exists.intro M (And.intro ?_ ?_)
  exact RealTheory.le_trans (RealTheory.abs_nonneg lower)
    (RealTheory.le_max_left (RealTheory.abs lower) (RealTheory.abs upper))
  intro x hx
  exact RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds
    (RealTheory.le_trans
      (RealTheory.le_trans (hbounds x hx).right
        (RealTheory.le_abs_self upper))
      (RealTheory.le_max_right (RealTheory.abs lower) (RealTheory.abs upper)))
    (RealTheory.le_trans
      (RealTheory.le_trans
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F (hbounds x hx).left)
        (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self lower))
      (RealTheory.le_max_left (RealTheory.abs lower) (RealTheory.abs upper)))

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_abs_integrand
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_abs_integrand
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hf : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b) :
    RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) alpha a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases boundedOn_abs_bound hbdd with ⟨M, _hM_nonneg, habs_bound⟩
  have hbdd_abs :
      RealFunction.BoundedOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) := by
    refine Exists.intro RealTheory.zero ?_
    refine Exists.intro M ?_
    intro x hx
    exact And.intro (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f x)) (habs_bound x hx)
  have hcell :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_boundedOn_closedInterval
      hbdd
  have hcell_abs :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) a b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_boundedOn_closedInterval
      hbdd_abs
  have hsmall_f :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
      hab hmono hcell hf
  have hsmall_abs :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.abs (f x)) alpha a b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_abs_integrand_of_darbouxGapSmall
      hmono hcell hcell_abs hsmall_f
  cases exists_hasRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegrals
      hab hmono hcell_abs with
  | intro Il hIl =>
      cases hIl with
      | intro Iu hIu =>
          exact
            riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_darbouxGapSmall
              hab hmono hcell_abs hIu.left hIu.right hsmall_abs

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_square_integrand
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_square_integrand
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hf : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b) :
    RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
      (RealFunction.MulFun f f) alpha a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rcases boundedOn_abs_bound hbdd with ⟨M, hM_nonneg, habs_bound⟩
  have hbdd_square :
      RealFunction.BoundedOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (RealFunction.MulFun f f) := by
    refine Exists.intro RealTheory.zero ?_
    refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.mul M M) ?_
    intro x hx
    have hsq_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.mul (f x) (f x)) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_self_nonneg F (f x)
    have hsq_eq_abs_sq :
        RealTheory.mul (f x) (f x) =
          RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f x)) (RealTheory.abs (f x)) := by
      exact Eq.trans
        (Eq.symm (RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hsq_nonneg))
        (RealTheory.abs_mul (f x) (f x))
    refine And.intro hsq_nonneg ?_
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (f x) (f x))
        (RealTheory.mul M M)
    rw [hsq_eq_abs_sq]
    exact RealTheory.le_trans
      (RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
        (habs_bound x hx) (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f x)))
      (RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
        (habs_bound x hx) hM_nonneg)
  have hcell :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_boundedOn_closedInterval
      hbdd
  have hcell_square :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn
        (RealFunction.MulFun f f) a b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_boundedOn_closedInterval
      hbdd_square
  have hsmall_f :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a b :=
    riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
      hab hmono hcell hf
  have hsmall_square :
      RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall
        (RealFunction.MulFun f f) alpha a b := by
    intro eps heps
    let C := RealTheory.add M M
    have hC_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C := by
      have h :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hM_nonneg hM_nonneg
      change
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero) C at h
      rwa [RealTheory.zero_add] at h
    rcases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F C heps with
      ⟨eta, heta_pos, hCeta_abs⟩
    have hCeta :
        RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul C eta) eps := by
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hC_nonneg] at hCeta_abs
    rcases hsmall_f eta heta_pos with ⟨n, p, hp, hgap_f⟩
    refine Exists.intro n ?_
    refine Exists.intro p ?_
    refine And.intro hp ?_
    have hcell_f := hcell n p hp
    have hcell_sq := hcell_square n p hp
    have hweight :
        forall k : Nat, k < n ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k) :=
      fun k hk =>
        stieltjesIncrement_nonnegative_of_monotone hp hmono hk
    have hcell_gap :
        forall k : Nat, k < n ->
          RealTheory.le
            (cellUpper (RealFunction.MulFun f f) p k)
            (RealTheory.add
              (cellLower (RealFunction.MulFun f f) p k)
              (RealTheory.mul C
                (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)))) := by
      intro k hk
      exact
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellUpper_le_cellLower_add_of_pairwise_sub_le
          (hcell_sq.left k hk) (hcell_sq.right k hk)
          (fun x y hx hy => by
            have hxab :
                RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
                hp hk hx
            have hyab :
                RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y :=
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
                hp hk hy
            have hInf :=
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLower_hasCellInf
                (hcell_f.left k hk)
            have hSup :=
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellUpper_hasCellSup
                (hcell_f.right k hk)
            have hxy :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))
                  (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
                (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.le_of_hasCellSup
                  hSup hx)
                (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.le_of_hasCellInf
                  hInf hy)
            have hyx :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.sub (f y) (f x))
                  (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
                (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.le_of_hasCellSup
                  hSup hy)
                (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.le_of_hasCellInf
                  hInf hx)
            have habs_xy :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))
                  (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)) := by
              apply RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hxy
              change
                F.le (F.neg (F.sub (f x) (f y)))
                  (F.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
              rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F]
              exact hyx
            have hdiff_square :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (RealTheory.mul (f x) (f x))
                      (RealTheory.mul (f y) (f y))))
                  (RealTheory.mul C
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))) := by
              have hdiff_identity :
                  RealTheory.sub
                      (RealTheory.mul (f x) (f x))
                      (RealTheory.mul (f y) (f y)) =
                    RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.mul
                        (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) (f x))
                      (RealTheory.mul
                        (f y) (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub
                  F (f x) (f x) (f y) (f y)
              rw [hdiff_identity]
              have htri :=
                RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) (f x))
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (f y) (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))
              refine RealTheory.le_trans htri ?_
              change
                F.le
                  (F.add
                    (F.abs (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f y)) (f x)))
                    (F.abs (F.mul (f y) (F.sub (f x) (f y)))))
                  (F.mul C (F.abs (F.sub (f x) (f y))))
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F,
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F]
              have hleft :
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))
                      (RealTheory.abs (f x)))
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))) M) :=
                RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                  (habs_bound x hxab)
                  (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))
              have hright :
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f y))
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))))
                    (RealTheory.mul M
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))) :=
                RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
                  (habs_bound y hyab)
                  (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))
              have hadd :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hleft hright
              change
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))
                      (RealTheory.abs (f x)))
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f y))
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))))
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))) M)
                    (RealTheory.mul M
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))))) at hadd
              have hright_eq :
                  RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.mul
                        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))) M)
                      (RealTheory.mul M
                        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))) =
                    RealTheory.mul C
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))) := by
                dsimp [C]
                rw [RealTheory.mul_comm
                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))) M]
                exact Eq.symm
                  (RealTheory.add_mul M M
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))))
              rwa [hright_eq] at hadd
            have hsquare_sub_le :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealTheory.mul (f x) (f x))
                    (RealTheory.mul (f y) (f y)))
                  (RealTheory.mul C
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))) :=
              RealTheory.le_trans
                (RealTheory.le_abs_self
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealTheory.mul (f x) (f x))
                    (RealTheory.mul (f y) (f y))))
                hdiff_square
            change
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.mul (f x) (f x))
                  (RealTheory.mul (f y) (f y)))
                (RealTheory.mul C
                  (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)))
            exact RealTheory.le_trans hsquare_sub_le
              (RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left habs_xy hC_nonneg))
    have hgap_square_le :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.sub
            (upperSum (RealFunction.MulFun f f) alpha p n)
            (lowerSum (RealFunction.MulFun f f) alpha p n))
          (RealTheory.mul C
            (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f alpha p n)
              (lowerSum f alpha p n))) := by
      have h :=
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedDarbouxGap_le_errorSum_of_cellUpper_le
          hweight hcell_gap
      change
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.sub
            (upperSum (RealFunction.MulFun f f) alpha p n)
            (lowerSum (RealFunction.MulFun f f) alpha p n))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.mul C
                  (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)))
                (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
            n) at h
      refine RealTheory.le_trans h ?_
      have hterms :
          RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul C
                    (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)))
                  (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
              n =
            RealTheory.mul C
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat =>
                  RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
                    (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
                n) := by
        calc
          RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.mul C
                    (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)))
                  (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
              n =
              RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat =>
                  RealTheory.mul C
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.sub
                        (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
                      (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)))
                n := by
            exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt (n := n)
              (fun k _hk =>
                RealTheory.mul_assoc C
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
                  (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
          _ = RealTheory.mul C
                (RealTheory.finiteSum
                  (fun k : Nat =>
                    RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.sub
                        (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
                      (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
                  n) :=
            RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left C
              (fun k : Nat =>
                RealTheory.mul
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
                  (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k))
              n
      rw [hterms]
      rw [
        <-
          Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedDarbouxGap_eq_finiteSum_cellGap_mul_weight
            f (stieltjesIncrement alpha p) p n]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl
        (RealTheory.mul C
          (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f alpha p n) (lowerSum f alpha p n)))
    have hscaled_gap :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul C
            (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f alpha p n)
              (lowerSum f alpha p n)))
          (RealTheory.mul C eta) :=
      RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hgap_f) hC_nonneg
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
      (RealTheory.le_trans hgap_square_le hscaled_gap) hCeta
  rcases exists_hasRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegrals
      hab hmono hcell_square with
    ⟨Il, Iu, hIl, hIu⟩
  exact
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_of_darbouxGapSmall
      hab hmono hcell_square hIl hIu hsmall_square

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_mul_integrand
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_mul_integrand
    {f g alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hbdd_f : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hbdd_g : RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g)
    (hf : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b)
    (hg : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn g alpha a b) :
    RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
      (RealFunction.MulFun f g) alpha a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hf_square :
      RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
        (RealFunction.MulFun f f) alpha a b :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_square_integrand
      hab hmono hbdd_f hf
  have hg_square :
      RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
        (RealFunction.MulFun g g) alpha a b :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_square_integrand
      hab hmono hbdd_g hg
  have hsum :
      RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
        (RealFunction.AddFun f g) alpha a b :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_add_integrand hf hg
  rcases hbdd_f with ⟨lower_f, upper_f, hbounds_f⟩
  rcases hbdd_g with ⟨lower_g, upper_g, hbounds_g⟩
  have hbdd_sum :
      RealFunction.BoundedOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (RealFunction.AddFun f g) := by
    refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.add lower_f lower_g) ?_
    refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.add upper_f upper_g) ?_
    intro x hx
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
        (hbounds_f x hx).left (hbounds_g x hx).left)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
        (hbounds_f x hx).right (hbounds_g x hx).right)
  have hsum_square :
      RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
        (RealFunction.MulFun
          (RealFunction.AddFun f g) (RealFunction.AddFun f g))
        alpha a b :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_square_integrand
      hab hmono hbdd_sum hsum
  have hfirst_sub :
      RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (RealFunction.MulFun
              (RealFunction.AddFun f g) (RealFunction.AddFun f g) x)
            (RealFunction.MulFun f f x))
        alpha a b :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_sub_integrand
      hsum_square hf_square
  have htwice_product :
      RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn
        (fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealFunction.MulFun
                (RealFunction.AddFun f g) (RealFunction.AddFun f g) x)
              (RealFunction.MulFun f f x))
            (RealFunction.MulFun g g x))
        alpha a b :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_sub_integrand
      hfirst_sub hg_square
  let halfCoefficient := F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F)
  have hscaled :=
    riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_mul_left_integrand
      halfCoefficient htwice_product
  have hidentity :
      (fun x : Point =>
        RealTheory.mul halfCoefficient
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealFunction.MulFun
                (RealFunction.AddFun f g) (RealFunction.AddFun f g) x)
              (RealFunction.MulFun f f x))
            (RealFunction.MulFun g g x))) =
        RealFunction.MulFun f g := by
    funext x
    let fx := f x
    let gx := g x
    have htwice :
        F.sub
            (F.sub
              (F.mul (F.add fx gx) (F.add fx gx))
              (F.mul fx fx))
            (F.mul gx gx) =
          F.add (F.mul fx gx) (F.mul fx gx) := by
      calc
        F.sub
            (F.sub
              (F.mul (F.add fx gx) (F.add fx gx))
              (F.mul fx fx))
            (F.mul gx gx) =
            F.sub
              (F.sub
                (F.add
                  (F.add (F.mul fx fx) (F.mul fx gx))
                  (F.add (F.mul gx fx) (F.mul gx gx)))
                (F.mul fx fx))
              (F.mul gx gx) := by
                rw [F.add_mul, F.mul_add, F.mul_add]
        _ =
            F.sub
              (F.sub
                (F.add
                  (F.mul fx fx)
                  (F.add (F.mul fx gx)
                    (F.add (F.mul gx fx) (F.mul gx gx))))
                (F.mul fx fx))
              (F.mul gx gx) := by
                rw [F.add_assoc]
        _ =
            F.sub
              (F.add (F.mul fx gx)
                (F.add (F.mul gx fx) (F.mul gx gx)))
              (F.mul gx gx) := by
                rw [F.add_comm
                  (F.mul fx fx)
                  (F.add (F.mul fx gx)
                    (F.add (F.mul gx fx) (F.mul gx gx)))]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel]
        _ = F.add (F.mul fx gx) (F.mul gx fx) := by
              rw [<- F.add_assoc]
              rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel]
        _ = F.add (F.mul fx gx) (F.mul fx gx) := by
              rw [F.mul_comm gx fx]
    change
      F.mul halfCoefficient
          (F.sub
            (F.sub
              (F.mul (F.add fx gx) (F.add fx gx))
              (F.mul fx fx))
            (F.mul gx gx)) =
        F.mul fx gx
    rw [htwice]
    dsimp [halfCoefficient]
    rw [F.mul_add]
    rw [F.mul_comm
      (F.inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F)) (F.mul fx gx)]
    change
      F.add
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.mul fx gx))
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.mul fx gx)) =
        F.mul fx gx
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F (F.mul fx gx)
  rw [hidentity] at hscaled
  exact hscaled

name: stieltjesIncrement_rightJumpStepIntegrator_zero_of_le_le
statement:
theorem stieltjesIncrement_rightJumpStepIntegrator_zero_of_le_le
    {c w : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    (hleft : RealTheory.le (p k) c)
    (hright : RealTheory.le (p (k + 1)) c) :
    stieltjesIncrement (rightJumpStepIntegrator c w) p k =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold stieltjesIncrement
  rw [rightJumpStepIntegrator_of_le hright]
  rw [rightJumpStepIntegrator_of_le hleft]
  change
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub
        RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero =
      RealTheory.zero
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.zero

name: stieltjesIncrement_rightJumpStepIntegrator_zero_of_lt_lt
statement:
theorem stieltjesIncrement_rightJumpStepIntegrator_zero_of_lt_lt
    {c w : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    (hleft : RealTheory.lt c (p k))
    (hright : RealTheory.lt c (p (k + 1))) :
    stieltjesIncrement (rightJumpStepIntegrator c w) p k =
      RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold stieltjesIncrement
  rw [rightJumpStepIntegrator_of_lt hright]
  rw [rightJumpStepIntegrator_of_lt hleft]
  change
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub w w =
      RealTheory.zero
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base w

name: stieltjesIncrement_rightJumpStepIntegrator_of_left_eq_right_lt
statement:
theorem stieltjesIncrement_rightJumpStepIntegrator_of_left_eq_right_lt
    {c w : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    (hleft : p k = c)
    (hright : RealTheory.lt c (p (k + 1))) :
    stieltjesIncrement (rightJumpStepIntegrator c w) p k = w
proof:
:= by
  unfold stieltjesIncrement
  rw [rightJumpStepIntegrator_of_lt hright]
  have hleft_le : RealTheory.le (p k) c := by
    rw [hleft]
    exact RealTheory.le_refl c
  rw [rightJumpStepIntegrator_of_le hleft_le]
  change
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub w RealTheory.zero = w
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base w

name: rightJumpBracketPartition_intervalPartition
statement:
private theorem rightJumpBracketPartition_intervalPartition
    {a c r b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.lt a c)
    (hcr : RealTheory.lt c r)
    (hrb : RealTheory.le r b) :
    IntervalPartition a b 3 (rightJumpBracketPartition a c r b)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro rfl ?_
  refine And.intro rfl ?_
  intro k hk
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hac
  | succ k =>
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hcr
      | succ k =>
          cases k with
          | zero =>
              exact hrb
          | succ k =>
              have hk_bad : k < 0 := by
                omega
              exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk_bad)

name: exists_rightJumpBracketThreshold
statement:
private theorem exists_rightJumpBracketThreshold
    {a c r b : Point} {baseCount : Nat} {base : Nat -> Point}
    (hbase : IntervalPartition a b baseCount base)
    (hac : RealTheory.lt a c)
    (hcr : RealTheory.lt c r)
    (hrb : RealTheory.le r b) :
    Exists
      (fun thresholdCount : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun threshold : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount threshold)
              (And
                (PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount base baseCount)
                (PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount
                  (rightJumpBracketPartition a c r b) 3))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let bracket := rightJumpBracketPartition a c r b
  let thresholdCount := baseCount + 3
  let threshold := endpointMergePoint base bracket baseCount 3
  have hbracket : IntervalPartition a b 3 bracket := by
    dsimp [bracket]
    exact rightJumpBracketPartition_intervalPartition hac hcr hrb
  have hcb : RealTheory.lt c b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hcr hrb
  have hab : RealTheory.lt a b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hac hcb
  have hbase_pos : 0 < baseCount := by
    exact
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_count_pos_of_endpoints_ne
        hbase
        (fun h_eq : a = b => by
          subst b
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F a hab)
  have hthreshold :
      IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount threshold := by
    dsimp [thresholdCount, threshold, bracket]
    exact endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition hbase hbracket
  have hrefBaseBlock :
      PartitionBlockRefines threshold thresholdCount base baseCount
        (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut base bracket baseCount 3) := by
    dsimp [thresholdCount, threshold]
    exact endpointMergeLeft_partitionBlockRefines hbase hbracket hbase_pos
  have hrefBase :
      PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount base baseCount :=
    partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines hrefBaseBlock hthreshold
  have hrefBracketBlock :
      PartitionBlockRefines threshold thresholdCount bracket 3
        (endpointMergeRightBlockCut base bracket baseCount 3) := by
    dsimp [thresholdCount, threshold]
    exact endpointMergeRight_partitionBlockRefines hbase hbracket
      (by omega : 0 < 3)
  have hrefBracket :
      PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount bracket 3 :=
    partitionBlockRefines_partitionRefines hrefBracketBlock hthreshold
  refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
  refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
  exact And.intro hthreshold (And.intro hrefBase hrefBracket)

name: rightJumpBracketPartition_block_tag_mem_control
statement:
private theorem rightJumpBracketPartition_block_tag_mem_control
    {a c r b : Point} {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (href :
      PartitionBlockRefines p n
        (rightJumpBracketPartition a c r b) 3 cut)
    {j : Nat}
    (hj : j < n)
    (hj_left : cut 1 <= j)
    (hj_right : j < cut 2) :
    RealTheory.ClosedInterval c r (tag j)
proof:
:= by
  let h := j - cut 1
  have hj_eq : cut 1 + h = j := by
    dsimp [h]
    exact Nat.add_sub_of_le hj_left
  have hh :
      h < refinementBlockLength cut 1 := by
    dsimp [h, refinementBlockLength]
    omega
  have hcell :
      PartitionCell p (cut 1 + h) (tag j) := by
    rw [hj_eq]
    exact taggedPartition_tag_mem_cell htag hj
  have hcoarse :
      PartitionCell (rightJumpBracketPartition a c r b) 1 (tag j) :=
    refinementBlockFineCell_mem_coarseCell
      href htag.left (i := 1) (h := h)
      (by omega : 1 < 3) hh hcell
  unfold PartitionCell at hcoarse
  rw [rightJumpBracketPartition_one,
    rightJumpBracketPartition_two] at hcoarse
  exact hcoarse

name: exists_rightJumpBracketBlock_of_refines_threshold
statement:
private theorem exists_rightJumpBracketBlock_of_refines_threshold
    {a c r b : Point}
    {thresholdCount n : Nat}
    {threshold p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.lt a c)
    (hcr : RealTheory.lt c r)
    (hrb : RealTheory.le r b)
    (hrefThreshold :
      PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount
        (rightJumpBracketPartition a c r b) 3)
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hrefFine : PartitionRefines p n threshold thresholdCount) :
    Exists
      (fun cut : Nat -> Nat =>
        And
          (PartitionBlockRefines p n
            (rightJumpBracketPartition a c r b) 3 cut)
          (forall j : Nat,
            j < n ->
              cut 1 <= j ->
                j < cut 2 ->
                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval c r (tag j)))
proof:
:= by
  have hbracket :
      IntervalPartition a b 3 (rightJumpBracketPartition a c r b) :=
    rightJumpBracketPartition_intervalPartition hac hcr hrb
  have hrefBracket :
      PartitionRefines p n (rightJumpBracketPartition a c r b) 3 :=
    partitionRefines_trans hrefFine hrefThreshold
  cases
      exists_partitionBlockRefines_of_partitionRefines
        htag.left hbracket hrefBracket with
  | intro cut hcut =>
      refine Exists.intro cut ?_
      refine And.intro hcut ?_
      intro j hj hj_left hj_right
      exact
        rightJumpBracketPartition_block_tag_mem_control
          htag hcut hj hj_left hj_right

name: stieltjesTagSum_rightJumpStepIntegrator_eq_single_of_jumpCell
statement:
theorem stieltjesTagSum_rightJumpStepIntegrator_eq_single_of_jumpCell
    {a b c w : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hleft : p k = c)
    (hright : RealTheory.lt c (p (k + 1)))
    (hbefore :
      forall j : Nat, j < k -> RealTheory.le (p (j + 1)) c)
    (hafter :
      forall j : Nat, k < j -> j < n -> RealTheory.lt c (p j)) :
    stieltjesTagSum f (rightJumpStepIntegrator c w) p tag n =
      RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) w
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let term := fun j : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul (f (tag j))
      (stieltjesIncrement (rightJumpStepIntegrator c w) p j)
  have hsingle :
      RealTheory.finiteSum term n = term k :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_single_of_eq_zero_off
      (n := n) (k := k)
      hk
      (fun j hj hne => by
        dsimp [term]
        by_cases hjk : j < k
        · have hright_le : RealTheory.le (p (j + 1)) c :=
            hbefore j hjk
          have hleft_le : RealTheory.le (p j) c := by
            have hstep : RealTheory.le (p j) (p (j + 1)) :=
              intervalPartition_step_le htag.left hj
            exact RealTheory.le_trans hstep hright_le
          have hinc :
              stieltjesIncrement (rightJumpStepIntegrator c w) p j =
                RealTheory.zero :=
            stieltjesIncrement_rightJumpStepIntegrator_zero_of_le_le
              hleft_le hright_le
          rw [hinc]
          exact RealTheory.mul_zero (f (tag j))
        · have hkj : k < j := by
            omega
          have hleft_lt : RealTheory.lt c (p j) :=
            hafter j hkj hj
          have hright_lt : RealTheory.lt c (p (j + 1)) := by
            have hstep : RealTheory.le (p j) (p (j + 1)) :=
              intervalPartition_step_le htag.left hj
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hleft_lt hstep
          have hinc :
              stieltjesIncrement (rightJumpStepIntegrator c w) p j =
                RealTheory.zero :=
            stieltjesIncrement_rightJumpStepIntegrator_zero_of_lt_lt
              hleft_lt hright_lt
          rw [hinc]
          exact RealTheory.mul_zero (f (tag j)))
  unfold stieltjesTagSum weightedTagSum
  change RealTheory.finiteSum term n =
    RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) w
  rw [hsingle]
  dsimp [term]
  rw [stieltjesIncrement_rightJumpStepIntegrator_of_left_eq_right_lt
    hleft hright]

name: exists_rightJumpStepIntegrator_singleContribution_of_bracketBlock
statement:
private theorem exists_rightJumpStepIntegrator_singleContribution_of_bracketBlock
    {a c r b w : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (href :
      PartitionBlockRefines p n
        (rightJumpBracketPartition a c r b) 3 cut)
    (hcr : RealTheory.lt c r) :
    Exists
      (fun k : Nat =>
        And (k < n)
          (And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval c r (tag k))
            (stieltjesTagSum f (rightJumpStepIntegrator c w) p tag n =
              RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) w)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let P := fun j : Nat =>
    And (cut 1 <= j)
      (And (j < cut 2) (RealTheory.lt c (p (j + 1))))
  have hcut_mono : cut 1 <= cut 2 :=
    partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono_step href (by omega : 1 < 3)
  have hcut_ne : Not (cut 1 = cut 2) := by
    intro hcut_eq
    have hleft_endpoint :
        p (cut 1) = c := by
      have h :=
        partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (by omega : 1 <= 3)
      rwa [rightJumpBracketPartition_one] at h
    have hright_endpoint :
        p (cut 2) = r := by
      have h :=
        partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (by omega : 2 <= 3)
      rwa [rightJumpBracketPartition_two] at h
    have hcr_eq : c = r := by
      rw [<- hleft_endpoint]
      rw [<- hright_endpoint]
      rw [hcut_eq]
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F r) (by
      rwa [hcr_eq] at hcr)
  have hcut_lt : cut 1 < cut 2 := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hcut_mono hcut_ne
  let last := cut 2 - 1
  have hlast_left : cut 1 <= last := by
    dsimp [last]
    omega
  have hlast_lt : last < cut 2 := by
    dsimp [last]
    omega
  have hlast_succ : last + 1 = cut 2 := by
    dsimp [last]
    omega
  have hlast_right : RealTheory.lt c (p (last + 1)) := by
    rw [hlast_succ]
    have hendpoint :
        p (cut 2) = r := by
      have h :=
        partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (by omega : 2 <= 3)
      rwa [rightJumpBracketPartition_two] at h
    rwa [hendpoint]
  have hex : Exists P :=
    Exists.intro last (And.intro hlast_left (And.intro hlast_lt hlast_right))
  let k := Tautology.Nat.least P hex
  have hk_spec : P k := Tautology.Nat.least_spec P hex
  have hk_lower : cut 1 <= k := hk_spec.left
  have hk_lt_cut2 : k < cut 2 := hk_spec.right.left
  have hk_right : RealTheory.lt c (p (k + 1)) := hk_spec.right.right
  have hcut2_le_n : cut 2 <= n :=
    partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right href (by omega : 2 <= 3)
  have hk_lt_n : k < n := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk_lt_cut2 hcut2_le_n
  have hk_left_endpoint : p (cut 1) = c := by
    have h :=
      partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (by omega : 1 <= 3)
    rwa [rightJumpBracketPartition_one] at h
  have hk_left : p k = c := by
    apply RealTheory.le_antisymm
    · have hkle : RealTheory.le (p k) (p (cut 1)) := by
        by_cases hk_eq : k = cut 1
        · rw [hk_eq]
          exact RealTheory.le_refl (p (cut 1))
        · have hk_gt : cut 1 < k := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hk_lower
            (fun h => hk_eq h.symm)
          have k_pred_lt : k - 1 < k := by
            omega
          have hk_pred_not : Not (P (k - 1)) := by
            intro hP
            have hmin := Tautology.Nat.least_min P hex hP
            change k <= k - 1 at hmin
            omega
          have hpred_lower : cut 1 <= k - 1 := by
            omega
          have hpred_upper : k - 1 < cut 2 := by
            omega
          have hpred_not_right :
              Not (RealTheory.lt c (p ((k - 1) + 1))) := by
            intro hright_bad
            exact hk_pred_not
              (And.intro hpred_lower
                (And.intro hpred_upper hright_bad))
          have hpred_le :
              RealTheory.le (p k) c := by
            have hidx : (k - 1) + 1 = k := by
              omega
            have hnot : Not (RealTheory.lt c (p k)) := by
              rwa [hidx] at hpred_not_right
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hnot
          simpa [hk_left_endpoint] using hpred_le
      simpa [hk_left_endpoint] using hkle
    · have hleft_le_pk : RealTheory.le (p (cut 1)) (p k) :=
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
          htag.left (cut 1) k
          hk_lower (Nat.le_of_lt hk_lt_n)
      rwa [hk_left_endpoint] at hleft_le_pk
  have hbefore :
      forall j : Nat, j < k -> RealTheory.le (p (j + 1)) c := by
    intro j hjk
    by_cases hle_cut : j + 1 <= cut 1
    · have hle_endpoint :
          RealTheory.le (p (j + 1)) (p (cut 1)) :=
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
          htag.left (j + 1) (cut 1)
          hle_cut (Nat.le_trans hcut_mono hcut2_le_n)
      rwa [hk_left_endpoint] at hle_endpoint
    · have hj_lower : cut 1 <= j := by
        omega
      have hj_upper : j < cut 2 := Nat.lt_trans hjk hk_lt_cut2
      have hj_not : Not (P j) := by
        intro hP
        have hmin := Tautology.Nat.least_min P hex hP
        change k <= j at hmin
        omega
      have hnot_right : Not (RealTheory.lt c (p (j + 1))) := by
        intro hright_bad
        exact hj_not
          (And.intro hj_lower (And.intro hj_upper hright_bad))
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hnot_right
  have hafter :
      forall j : Nat, k < j -> j < n -> RealTheory.lt c (p j) := by
    intro j hkj hjn
    have hsucc_le_j : k + 1 <= j := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hkj
    have hle : RealTheory.le (p (k + 1)) (p j) :=
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
        htag.left (k + 1) j
        hsucc_le_j (Nat.le_of_lt hjn)
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hk_right hle
  have htag_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval c r (tag k) :=
    rightJumpBracketPartition_block_tag_mem_control
      htag href hk_lt_n hk_lower hk_lt_cut2
  have hsum :
      stieltjesTagSum f (rightJumpStepIntegrator c w) p tag n =
        RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) w :=
    stieltjesTagSum_rightJumpStepIntegrator_eq_single_of_jumpCell
      htag hk_lt_n hk_left hk_right hbefore hafter
  exact Exists.intro k (And.intro hk_lt_n (And.intro htag_mem hsum))

name: exists_rightControlPoint_within_delta
statement:
private theorem exists_rightControlPoint_within_delta
    {c b delta : Point}
    (hcb : RealTheory.lt c b)
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta) :
    Exists
      (fun r : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt c r)
          (And (RealTheory.le r b)
            (forall x : Point,
              RealTheory.ClosedInterval c r x ->
                RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x c) delta)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let bGap := RealTheory.sub b c
  have hbGap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero bGap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hcb
  let gap := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F delta bGap
  have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdelta hbGap_pos
  cases RealTheory.exists_internalRat_between_self_add
      (x := c) hgap_pos with
  | intro r hr =>
      have hcr : RealTheory.lt c r := hr.right.left
      have hr_lt_cgap : RealTheory.lt r (RealTheory.add c gap) :=
        hr.right.right
      have hgap_le_delta : RealTheory.le gap delta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F delta bGap
      have hgap_le_bGap : RealTheory.le gap bGap :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F delta bGap
      have hcgap_le_b : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.add c gap) b := by
        have hle :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.add c gap)
              (RealTheory.add c bGap) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hgap_le_bGap c
        have hcancel : RealTheory.add c bGap = b := by
          dsimp [bGap]
          change F.add c (F.sub b c) = b
          rw [F.add_comm c (F.sub b c)]
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b c
        rwa [hcancel] at hle
      have hrb : RealTheory.le r b :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hr_lt_cgap hcgap_le_b)
      refine Exists.intro r ?_
      refine And.intro hcr ?_
      refine And.intro hrb ?_
      intro x hx
      have hleft : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c delta) x := by
        have hsub_lt_c : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c delta) c :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hdelta
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsub_lt_c hx.left
      have hright : RealTheory.lt x (RealTheory.add c delta) := by
        have hcgap_le_cdelta :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.add c gap)
              (RealTheory.add c delta) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hgap_le_delta c
        have hr_lt_cdelta :
            RealTheory.lt r (RealTheory.add c delta) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
            F hr_lt_cgap hcgap_le_cdelta
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hx.right hr_lt_cdelta
      unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds F hleft hright

name: abs_sub_mul_right_lt_of_dist_lt
statement:
private theorem abs_sub_mul_right_lt_of_dist_lt
    {x y w eta eps : Point}
    (hclose : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x y) eta)
    (hscale :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs w) eta) eps) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul x w) (RealTheory.mul y w)))
      eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hclose_abs :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub x y)) eta := by
    unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hclose
    exact hclose
  change
    F.lt
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.sub (F.mul x w) (F.mul y w)))
      eps
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F x y w]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F (F.sub x y) w]
  rw [F.mul_comm
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub x y))
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F w)]
  have hmul_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.abs w)
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub x y)))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs w) eta) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hclose_abs)
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg w)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hmul_le hscale

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_rightJumpStepIntegrator
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_rightJumpStepIntegrator
    {a c b w : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.lt a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.lt c b)
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f c) :
    HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f (rightJumpStepIntegrator c w) a b
      (RealTheory.mul (f c) w)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b :=
    RealTheory.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hac)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hcb)
  refine And.intro hab ?_
  intro eps heps baseCount base hbase
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F w heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases hf.right eta heta.left with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          cases exists_rightControlPoint_within_delta hcb hdelta.left with
          | intro r hr =>
              have hcr : RealTheory.lt c r := hr.left
              have hrb : RealTheory.le r b := hr.right.left
              have htag_radius :
                  forall x : Point,
                    RealTheory.ClosedInterval c r x ->
                      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x c) delta :=
                hr.right.right
              cases
                  exists_rightJumpBracketThreshold
                    hbase hac hcr hrb with
              | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
                  cases hthresholdCount with
                  | intro threshold hthreshold =>
                      refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
                      refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
                      refine And.intro hthreshold.left ?_
                      refine And.intro hthreshold.right.left ?_
                      intro n p tag htag hrefFine
                      have hrefBracket :
                          PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount
                            (rightJumpBracketPartition a c r b) 3 :=
                        hthreshold.right.right
                      cases
                          exists_rightJumpBracketBlock_of_refines_threshold
                            hac hcr hrb hrefBracket htag hrefFine with
                      | intro cut hcut =>
                          cases
                              exists_rightJumpStepIntegrator_singleContribution_of_bracketBlock
                                (a := a) (c := c) (r := r) (b := b)
                                (w := w) (f := f)
                                htag hcut.left hcr with
                          | intro k hk =>
                              have hk_lt_n : k < n := hk.left
                              have htag_mem :
                                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval c r (tag k) :=
                                hk.right.left
                              have hsum :
                                  stieltjesTagSum f
                                      (rightJumpStepIntegrator c w) p tag n =
                                    RealTheory.mul (f (tag k)) w :=
                                hk.right.right
                              have htag_domain :
                                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (tag k) := by
                                refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                                · exact RealTheory.le_trans
                                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hac)
                                    htag_mem.left
                                · exact RealTheory.le_trans htag_mem.right hrb
                              have htag_delta :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealFunction.dist (tag k) c) delta :=
                                htag_radius (tag k) htag_mem
                              have hclose :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealFunction.dist (f (tag k)) (f c))
                                    eta := by
                                by_cases htag_eq : tag k = c
                                · rw [htag_eq, RealFunction.dist_self]
                                  exact heta.left
                                · exact
                                    hdelta.right
                                      (tag k) htag_domain htag_eq htag_delta
                              rw [hsum]
                              exact
                                abs_sub_mul_right_lt_of_dist_lt
                                  (x := f (tag k)) (y := f c)
                                  (w := w) hclose heta.right

name: riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_rightJumpStepIntegrator
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesIntegrableOn_rightJumpStepIntegrator
    {a c b w : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.lt a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.lt c b)
    (hf : RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f c) :
    RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f (rightJumpStepIntegrator c w) a b
proof:
:= by
  exact Exists.intro (RealTheory.mul (f c) w)
    (hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_rightJumpStepIntegrator
      hac hcb hf)

name: countStep_mul_countDenom
statement:
private theorem countStep_mul_countDenom
    (a b : Point) {r : Nat}
    (hr : Not (r = 0)) :
    RealTheory.mul (countStep a b r) (countDenom r) =
      RealTheory.sub b a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hrden : Not (countDenom r = F.zero) := by
    unfold countDenom
    exact RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hr
  unfold countStep
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (countDenom r)))
        (countDenom r) =
        F.mul (F.sub b a)
          (F.mul (F.inv (countDenom r)) (countDenom r)) := by
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.sub b a) F.one := by
        rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hrden]
    _ = F.sub b a := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: countGridPoint_zero
statement:
private theorem countGridPoint_zero (a c : Point) (r : Nat) :
    countGridPoint a c r 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold countGridPoint
  rw [RealTheory.nat_zero]
  change F.add a (F.mul F.zero (countStep a c r)) = a
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F]
  rw [F.add_zero]

name: countGridPoint_count
statement:
private theorem countGridPoint_count
    (a c : Point) {r : Nat}
    (hr : Not (r = 0)) :
    countGridPoint a c r r = c
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold countGridPoint
  change
    F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat r) (countStep a c r)) = c
  have hstep := countStep_mul_countDenom a c hr
  unfold countDenom at hstep
  have hmul :
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat r) (countStep a c r) =
        F.sub c a := by
    rw [F.mul_comm]
    exact hstep
  rw [hmul]
  rw [F.add_comm a (F.sub c a)]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F c a

name: countGridPoint_succ
statement:
private theorem countGridPoint_succ
    (a c : Point) (r k : Nat) :
    countGridPoint a c r (k + 1) =
      RealTheory.add (countGridPoint a c r k) (countStep a c r)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold countGridPoint
  rw [RealTheory.nat_succ]
  change
    F.add a
        (F.mul (F.add (RealTheory.nat k) F.one)
          (countStep a c r)) =
      F.add
        (F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (countStep a c r)))
        (countStep a c r)
  rw [F.add_mul]
  rw [F.one_mul]
  rw [F.add_assoc]

name: countGridPoint_pred_add_step
statement:
private theorem countGridPoint_pred_add_step
    (a c : Point) {r p : Nat}
    (hp : 0 < p) :
    countGridPoint a c r p =
      RealTheory.add
        (countGridPoint a c r (p - 1))
        (countStep a c r)
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : p - 1 + 1 = p := by omega
  rw [<- hsucc]
  exact countGridPoint_succ a c r (p - 1)

name: countStep_nonneg_of_le
statement:
private theorem countStep_nonneg_of_le
    {a c : Point} {r : Nat}
    (hr : Not (r = 0))
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (countStep a c r)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold countStep
  exact F.mul_nonneg
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hac)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F
        (RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hr)))

name: countGridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_le
statement:
private theorem countGridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_le
    {a c : Point} {r k : Nat}
    (hr : Not (r = 0))
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hk : k <= r) :
    RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c (countGridPoint a c r k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := countStep a c r
  have hs_nonneg : F.le F.zero s :=
    countStep_nonneg_of_le (r := r) hr hac
  have hprod_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) s) :=
    F.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg k) hs_nonneg
  have hleft :
      F.le a (countGridPoint a c r k) := by
    unfold countGridPoint
    change F.le a (F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) s))
    have h := F.add_le_add_left hprod_nonneg a
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hnat_le :
      F.le (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat r) :=
    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hk
  have hprod_le :
      F.le (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) s)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat r) s) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hnat_le hs_nonneg
  have hstep := countStep_mul_countDenom a c hr
  unfold countDenom at hstep
  have hdenom :
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat r) s = F.sub c a := by
    rw [F.mul_comm]
    exact hstep
  have hprod_le_len :
      F.le (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) s) (F.sub c a) := by
    rwa [hdenom] at hprod_le
  have hright :
      F.le (countGridPoint a c r k) c := by
    unfold countGridPoint
    change F.le (F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) s)) c
    have h := F.add_le_add_left hprod_le_len a
    have hright_eq : F.add a (F.sub c a) = c := by
      rw [F.add_comm a (F.sub c a)]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F c a
    rwa [hright_eq] at h
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: countGridPoint_pred_count_eq_sub_step
statement:
private theorem countGridPoint_pred_count_eq_sub_step
    (a c : Point) {r : Nat}
    (hr : 0 < r) :
    countGridPoint a c r (r - 1) =
      RealTheory.sub c (countStep a c r)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hrne : Not (r = 0) := Nat.ne_of_gt hr
  have hsucc : r - 1 + 1 = r := by omega
  have hsuccGrid :
      countGridPoint a c r r =
        F.add (countGridPoint a c r (r - 1))
          (countStep a c r) := by
    simpa [hsucc] using countGridPoint_succ a c r (r - 1)
  rw [countGridPoint_count a c hrne] at hsuccGrid
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_right_cancel F
    (a := countStep a c r)
  calc
    F.add (countGridPoint a c r (r - 1)) (countStep a c r) =
        c := hsuccGrid.symm
    _ = F.add (F.sub c (countStep a c r)) (countStep a c r) := by
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F c (countStep a c r)]

name: countStep_lt_of_large_mul
statement:
private theorem countStep_lt_of_large_mul
    {a c eps : Point} {r : Nat}
    (hr : Not (r = 0))
    (hlarge :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub c a)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat r) eps)) :
    RealTheory.lt (countStep a c r) eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hmul :
      F.lt
        (F.mul (countStep a c r) (RealTheory.nat r))
        (F.mul eps (RealTheory.nat r)) := by
    have hstep := countStep_mul_countDenom a c hr
    unfold countDenom at hstep
    have hlarge' :
        F.lt (F.sub c a) (F.mul eps (RealTheory.nat r)) := by
      change F.lt (F.sub c a) (F.mul (RealTheory.nat r) eps) at hlarge
      rwa [F.mul_comm (RealTheory.nat r) eps] at hlarge
    change F.mul (countStep a c r) (RealTheory.nat r) = F.sub c a at hstep
    rw [hstep]
    exact hlarge'
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right
    F hmul (RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero hr)

name: exists_countStep_lt
statement:
private theorem exists_countStep_lt
    {a c eps : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists (fun r : Nat =>
      And (Not (r = 0))
        (RealTheory.lt (countStep a c r) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hL_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub c a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hac
  cases RealTheory.linearArchimedeanPrinciple.large_nat_mul
      hL_nonneg heps with
  | intro r hrlarge =>
      have hrne : Not (r = 0) := by
        intro h0
        subst h0
        have hbad : F.lt (F.sub c a) F.zero := by
          change
            F.lt (F.sub c a)
              (F.mul (RealTheory.nat 0) eps) at hrlarge
          rwa [RealTheory.nat_zero, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F] at hrlarge
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hbad) hL_nonneg
      exact Exists.intro r
        (And.intro hrne
          (countStep_lt_of_large_mul
            (a := a) (c := c) (eps := eps)
            (r := r) hrne hrlarge))

name: le_sub_of_lt_sub_right
statement:
private theorem le_sub_of_lt_sub_right
    {b c step : Point}
    (hstep : RealTheory.lt step (RealTheory.sub c b)) :
    RealTheory.le b (RealTheory.sub c step)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hadd : F.lt (F.add b step) c := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hstep b
    change F.lt (F.add b step) (F.add b (F.sub c b)) at h
    have hright : F.add b (F.sub c b) = c := by
      rw [F.add_comm b (F.sub c b)]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F c b
    rwa [hright] at h
  have hle : F.le (F.add b step) c :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hadd
  have hshift := F.add_le_add_right hle (F.neg step)
  have hleft : F.add (F.add b step) (F.neg step) = b :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_neg_cancel_right F b step
  have hright : F.add c (F.neg step) = F.sub c step := by
    rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rwa [hleft, hright] at hshift

name: dist_le_step_of_between_successive
statement:
private theorem dist_le_step_of_between_successive
    {prev b g step : Point}
    (hprev : RealTheory.le prev b)
    (hbg : RealTheory.le b g)
    (hg : g = RealTheory.add prev step) :
    RealTheory.le (RealFunction.dist g b) step
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub g b)) step
  have hnonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub g b) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hbg
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hnonneg]
  have hle :
      F.le (F.sub g b) (F.sub g prev) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F (F.le_refl g) hprev
  have hdiff : F.sub g prev = step := by
    rw [hg]
    change F.sub (F.add prev step) prev = step
    rw [F.add_comm prev step]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F step prev
  rwa [hdiff] at hle

name: exists_countGridPoint_near
statement:
private theorem exists_countGridPoint_near
    {a b c delta : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hbc : RealTheory.lt b c)
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta) :
    Exists (fun p : Nat =>
      Exists (fun q : Nat =>
        And (Not (p = 0))
          (And (Not (q = 0))
            (And
              (RealTheory.le a (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p))
              (And
                (RealTheory.le (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) c)
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealFunction.dist
                    (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) b)
                  delta))))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hac : F.le a c :=
    F.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hbc)
  let gap := F.sub c b
  let eps0 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F delta gap
  have hgap_pos : F.lt F.zero gap := by
    unfold gap
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hbc
  have heps0_pos : F.lt F.zero eps0 := by
    unfold eps0
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdelta hgap_pos
  cases exists_countStep_lt (a := a) (c := c)
      (eps := eps0) hac heps0_pos with
  | intro r hrdata =>
      let step := countStep a c r
      have hrne : Not (r = 0) := hrdata.left
      have hrpos : 0 < r := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hrne
      have hstep_small : F.lt step eps0 := by
        dsimp [step]
        exact hrdata.right
      have hstep_delta : F.lt step delta := by
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hstep_small
          (by
            unfold eps0
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F delta gap)
      have hstep_gap : F.lt step gap := by
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hstep_small
          (by
            unfold eps0
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F delta gap)
      let P : Nat -> Prop :=
        fun k => F.le b (countGridPoint a c r k)
      have hPr : P r := by
        dsimp [P]
        rw [countGridPoint_count a c hrne]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hbc
      let p := Tautology.Nat.least P (Exists.intro r hPr)
      have hpP : P p :=
        Tautology.Nat.least_spec P (Exists.intro r hPr)
      have hpmin : forall k : Nat, P k -> p <= k := by
        intro k hk
        exact Tautology.Nat.least_min P (Exists.intro r hPr) hk
      have hpne : Not (p = 0) := by
        intro hp0
        have hba : F.le b a := by
          have h := hpP
          dsimp [P] at h
          rw [hp0, countGridPoint_zero] at h
          exact h
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hab) hba
      have hp_pos : 0 < p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hpne
      have hPpredR : P (r - 1) := by
        dsimp [P]
        have hprev :
            countGridPoint a c r (r - 1) =
              F.sub c step := by
          dsimp [step]
          exact countGridPoint_pred_count_eq_sub_step a c hrpos
        have hle : F.le b (F.sub c step) := by
          unfold gap at hstep_gap
          exact le_sub_of_lt_sub_right (b := b) (c := c)
            (step := step) hstep_gap
        rwa [hprev]
      have hp_le_predR : p <= r - 1 := hpmin (r - 1) hPpredR
      have hp_lt_r : p < r := by omega
      let q := r - p
      have hqne : Not (q = 0) := by
        dsimp [q]
        omega
      have hpq : p + q = r := by
        dsimp [q]
        omega
      have hp_le_r : p <= r := by omega
      have hmem :
          And
            (F.le a (countGridPoint a c r p))
            (F.le (countGridPoint a c r p) c) :=
        countGridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_le
          (a := a) (c := c) (r := r) (k := p)
          hrne hac hp_le_r
      let prev := countGridPoint a c r (p - 1)
      let g := countGridPoint a c r p
      have hsuccp : p - 1 + 1 = p := by omega
      have hg_succ : g = F.add prev step := by
        dsimp [g, prev, step]
        simpa [hsuccp] using countGridPoint_succ a c r (p - 1)
      have hprev_not : Not (P (p - 1)) := by
        intro hPprev
        have hmin := hpmin (p - 1) hPprev
        omega
      have hprev_le_b : F.le prev b := by
        by_cases hle : F.le prev b
        · exact hle
        · cases F.le_total b prev with
          | inl hbprev =>
              have hPprev : P (p - 1) := by
                dsimp [P, prev] at hbprev
                exact hbprev
              exact False.elim (hprev_not hPprev)
          | inr hprevb =>
              exact hprevb
      have hbg : F.le b g := by
        change F.le b g
        exact hpP
      have hdist_le_step :
          F.le (RealFunction.dist g b) step :=
        dist_le_step_of_between_successive
          (prev := prev) (b := b) (g := g) (step := step)
          hprev_le_b hbg hg_succ
      have hdist_delta : F.lt (RealFunction.dist g b) delta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
          hdist_le_step hstep_delta
      refine Exists.intro p ?_
      refine Exists.intro q ?_
      refine And.intro hpne ?_
      refine And.intro hqne ?_
      have hgrid :
          countGridPoint a c (p + q) p =
            countGridPoint a c r p := by
        rw [hpq]
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · rw [hgrid]
        exact hmem.left
      · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
        · rw [hgrid]
          exact hmem.right
        · rw [hgrid]
          exact hdist_delta

name: orderedIntervalAdditivity_strict
statement:
private theorem orderedIntervalAdditivity_strict
    {f : Map} {a b c Iab Ibc Iac : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hbc : RealTheory.lt b c)
    (hf :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f)
    (hIab : HasIntegral f a b Iab)
    (hIbc : HasIntegral f b c Ibc)
    (hIac : HasIntegral f a c Iac) :
    Iac = RealTheory.add Iab Ibc
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hac : F.le a c :=
    F.le_trans
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hbc)
  have hb_closed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c b :=
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hbc)
  apply RealFunction.eq_of_forall_dist_lt
  intro eps heps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : F.lt F.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases upperEndpointContinuity
      (f := f) (a := a) (c := c)
      hac hf b hb_closed e2 he2 with
  | intro deltaU hdeltaU =>
      cases lowerEndpointContinuity
          (f := f) (a := a) (c := c)
          hac hf b hb_closed e2 he2 with
      | intro deltaL hdeltaL =>
          let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F deltaU deltaL
          have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
              F hdeltaU.left hdeltaL.left
          cases exists_countGridPoint_near
              (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)
              (delta := delta) hab hbc hdelta with
          | intro p hpdata =>
              cases hpdata with
              | intro q hqdata =>
                  let g := countGridPoint a c (p + q) p
                  have hp : Not (p = 0) := hqdata.left
                  have hq : Not (q = 0) := hqdata.right.left
                  have hag : F.le a g := by
                    dsimp [g]
                    exact hqdata.right.right.left
                  have hgc : F.le g c := by
                    dsimp [g]
                    exact hqdata.right.right.right.left
                  have hgb_delta :
                      F.lt (RealFunction.dist g b) delta := by
                    dsimp [g]
                    exact hqdata.right.right.right.right
                  have hgb_deltaU :
                      F.lt (RealFunction.dist g b) deltaU :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                      F hgb_delta
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                        F deltaU deltaL)
                  have hgb_deltaL :
                      F.lt (RealFunction.dist g b) deltaL :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                      F hgb_delta
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                        F deltaU deltaL)
                  have hg_closed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c g :=
                    And.intro hag hgc
                  have hf_ag :
                      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
                        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a g) f :=
                    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset
                        F (a := a) (b := g) (c := a) (d := c)
                        (F.le_refl a) hgc)
                      hf
                  have hf_gc :
                      RealFunction.ContinuousOn
                        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval g c) f :=
                    RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset
                        F (a := g) (b := c) (c := a) (d := c)
                        hag (F.le_refl c))
                      hf
                  have hint_ag : Integrable f a g :=
                    integrable_ordered_of_continuousOn
                      (f := f) hag hf_ag
                  have hint_gc : Integrable f g c :=
                    integrable_ordered_of_continuousOn
                      (f := f) hgc hf_gc
                  cases hint_ag with
                  | intro Iag hIag =>
                      cases hint_gc with
                      | intro Igc hIgc =>
                          have hgrid_add :
                              Iac = RealTheory.add Iag Igc :=
                            orderedIntervalAdditivity_countGridPoint
                              (f := f) (a := a) (c := c)
                              (Iab := Iag) (Ibc := Igc)
                              (Iac := Iac) (p := p) (q := q)
                              hp hq hag hgc hIag hIgc hIac
                          have hupper :
                              F.lt (RealFunction.dist Iag Iab) e2 :=
                            hdeltaU.right g Iag Iab
