                              hg_closed hgb_deltaU hIag hIab
                          have hlower :
                              F.lt (RealFunction.dist Igc Ibc) e2 :=
                            hdeltaL.right g Igc Ibc
                              hg_closed hgb_deltaL hIgc hIbc
                          have hdist_le :
                              F.le
                                (RealFunction.dist
                                  (RealTheory.add Iag Igc)
                                  (RealTheory.add Iab Ibc))
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (RealFunction.dist Iag Iab)
                                  (RealFunction.dist Igc Ibc)) :=
                            RealFunction.dist_add_le
                              Iag Igc Iab Ibc
                          have hsum_lt :
                              F.lt
                                (RealTheory.add
                                  (RealFunction.dist Iag Iab)
                                  (RealFunction.dist Igc Ibc))
                                eps := by
                            have hsum :
                                F.lt
                                  (F.add
                                    (RealFunction.dist Iag Iab)
                                    (RealFunction.dist Igc Ibc))
                                  (F.add e2 e2) :=
                              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                                F hupper hlower
                            rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                              F eps] at hsum
                          have hdist :
                              F.lt
                                (RealFunction.dist
                                  (RealTheory.add Iag Igc)
                                  (RealTheory.add Iab Ibc))
                                eps :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                              F hdist_le hsum_lt
                          rwa [hgrid_add]

name: orderedIntervalAdditivity
statement:
theorem orderedIntervalAdditivity :
    OrderedIntervalAdditivityStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro f a b c Iab Ibc Iac hab hbc hf hIab hIbc hIac
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hba : RealTheory.le b a
  · have hEq : a = b := RealTheory.le_antisymm hab hba
    subst b
    have hIab0 : Iab = RealTheory.zero :=
      hasIntegral_same_endpoint_eq_zero hIab
    have hIeq : Iac = Ibc :=
      hasIntegral_unique hIac hIbc
    rw [hIeq, hIab0]
    exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.zero_add Ibc)
  · by_cases hcb : RealTheory.le c b
    · have hEq : b = c := RealTheory.le_antisymm hbc hcb
      subst c
      have hIbc0 : Ibc = RealTheory.zero :=
        hasIntegral_same_endpoint_eq_zero hIbc
      have hIeq : Iac = Iab :=
        hasIntegral_unique hIac hIab
      rw [hIeq, hIbc0]
      exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.add_zero Iab)
    · have hab_lt : RealTheory.lt a b :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
          F hab hba
      have hbc_lt : RealTheory.lt b c :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
          F hbc hcb
      exact orderedIntervalAdditivity_strict
        (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)
        (Iab := Iab) (Ibc := Ibc) (Iac := Iac)
        hab_lt hbc_lt hf hIab hIbc hIac

name: orientedIntervalAdditivity
statement:
theorem orientedIntervalAdditivity :
    OrientedIntervalAdditivityStatement
proof:
:=
  orientedIntervalAdditivity_from_ordered orderedIntervalAdditivity

name: countDenom_partitions
statement:
private theorem countDenom_partitions (n : Nat) :
    countDenom (partitions n) = denom n
proof: := rfl

name: countStep_partitions
statement:
private theorem countStep_partitions (a b : Point) (n : Nat) :
    countStep a b (partitions n) = step a b n
proof: := rfl

name: countGridPoint_partitions
statement:
private theorem countGridPoint_partitions
    (a b : Point) (n k : Nat) :
    countGridPoint a b (partitions n) k = gridPoint a b n k
proof: := rfl

name: leftSumCount_partitions
statement:
private theorem leftSumCount_partitions
    (f : Map) (a b : Point) (n : Nat) :
    leftSumCount f a b (partitions n) = leftSum f a b n
proof:
:= by
  unfold leftSumCount leftSum countStep countGridPoint countDenom
  unfold step gridPoint denom
  unfold partitions
  rfl

name: leftSumCount_zero_count
statement:
private theorem leftSumCount_zero_count
    (f : Map) (a b : Point) :
    leftSumCount f a b 0 = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold leftSumCount
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  exact RealTheory.mul_zero (countStep a b 0)

name: countGridPoint_as_start_add_step
statement:
private theorem countGridPoint_as_start_add_step
    (a b : Point) (r k : Nat) :
    countGridPoint a b r k =
      RealTheory.add a
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (countStep a b r))
proof: := rfl

name: countGridPoint_split_point
statement:
private theorem countGridPoint_split_point
    (a c : Point) (p q : Nat) :
    countGridPoint a c (p + q) p =
      RealTheory.add a
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat p) (countStep a c (p + q)))
proof: := rfl

name: countStep_of_gridPoint
statement:
private theorem countStep_of_gridPoint
    {a b s : Point} {p : Nat}
    (hp : Not (p = 0))
    (hb : b = RealTheory.add a (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s)) :
    countStep a b p = s
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hpden : Not (RealTheory.nat p = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hp
  unfold countStep countDenom
  change F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (RealTheory.nat p)) = s
  have hsub :
      F.sub b a = F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s := by
    rw [hb]
    calc
      F.sub (F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s)) a =
          F.sub (F.add (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s) a) a := by
          rw [F.add_comm a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s)]
      _ = F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s := by
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel
            F (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s) a
  rw [hsub]
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s)
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat p)) =
        F.mul s
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p)
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat p))) := by
        rw [F.mul_comm (RealTheory.nat p) s]
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul s F.one := by
        rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hpden]
    _ = s := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: countStep_left_of_split
statement:
private theorem countStep_left_of_split
    {a c : Point} {p q : Nat}
    (hp : Not (p = 0)) :
    countStep a (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) p =
      countStep a c (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  exact countStep_of_gridPoint
    (a := a) (b := countGridPoint a c (p + q) p)
    (s := countStep a c (p + q)) hp
    (countGridPoint_split_point a c p q)

name: countStep_right_of_split
statement:
private theorem countStep_right_of_split
    {a c : Point} {p q : Nat}
    (hq : Not (q = 0)) :
    countStep (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) c q =
      countStep a c (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := countStep a c (p + q)
  let b := countGridPoint a c (p + q) p
  have hqden : Not (RealTheory.nat q = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hq
  unfold countStep countDenom
  change F.mul (F.sub c b) (F.inv (RealTheory.nat q)) = s
  have htotal :
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat (p + q)) s = F.sub c a := by
    unfold s countStep countDenom
    have hden_ne :
        Not (RealTheory.nat (p + q) = F.zero) := by
      apply RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
      intro hpq
      have hq0 : q = 0 := by omega
      exact hq hq0
    calc
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat (p + q))
          (F.mul (F.sub c a) (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (p + q)))) =
          F.mul (F.sub c a)
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (p + q))
              (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (p + q)))) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
          rw [F.mul_comm (RealTheory.nat (p + q)) (F.sub c a)]
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.sub c a) F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hden_ne]
      _ = F.sub c a := by rw [F.mul_one]
  have hb :
      b = F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s) := rfl
  have hc :
      c = F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (p + q)) s) := by
    calc
      c = F.add (F.sub c a) a := by
          exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F c a)
      _ = F.add (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (p + q)) s) a := by
          rw [<- htotal]
      _ = F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (p + q)) s) := by
          rw [F.add_comm]
  have hsub :
      F.sub c b = F.mul (RealTheory.nat q) s := by
    rw [hc, hb]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
      F a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (p + q)) s)
        a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s)]
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F a]
    rw [F.zero_add]
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
      F (RealTheory.nat (p + q)) (RealTheory.nat p) s]
    have hnat :
        F.sub (RealTheory.nat (p + q)) (RealTheory.nat p) =
          RealTheory.nat q := by
      have hsum :
          RealTheory.nat (p + q) =
            F.add (RealTheory.nat p) (RealTheory.nat q) := by
        rw [RealTheory.nat_add]
      rw [hsum]
      rw [F.add_comm (RealTheory.nat p) (RealTheory.nat q)]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel
        F (RealTheory.nat q) (RealTheory.nat p)
    rw [hnat]
  rw [hsub]
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat q) s)
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat q)) =
        F.mul s
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat q)
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat q))) := by
        rw [F.mul_comm (RealTheory.nat q) s]
        rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul s F.one := by
        rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hqden]
    _ = s := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: countGridPoint_left_of_split
statement:
private theorem countGridPoint_left_of_split
    {a c : Point} {p q k : Nat}
    (hp : Not (p = 0)) :
    countGridPoint a (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) p k =
      countGridPoint a c (p + q) k
proof:
:= by
  unfold countGridPoint
  change
    RealTheory.add a
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
          (countStep a (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) p)) =
      RealTheory.add a
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (countStep a c (p + q)))
  rw [countStep_left_of_split (a := a) (c := c) (p := p) (q := q) hp]

name: countGridPoint_right_of_split
statement:
private theorem countGridPoint_right_of_split
    {a c : Point} {p q j : Nat}
    (hq : Not (q = 0)) :
    countGridPoint (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) c q j =
      countGridPoint a c (p + q) (p + j)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := countStep a c (p + q)
  let b := countGridPoint a c (p + q) p
  unfold countGridPoint
  change
    RealTheory.add
        (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat j)
          (countStep (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) c q)) =
      RealTheory.add a
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (p + j))
          (countStep a c (p + q)))
  rw [countStep_right_of_split (a := a) (c := c) (p := p) (q := q) hq]
  change
    F.add b (F.mul (RealTheory.nat j) s) =
      F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (p + j)) s)
  unfold b countGridPoint
  change
    F.add (F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat j) s) =
      F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (p + j)) s)
  calc
    F.add (F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat j) s) =
        F.add a
          (F.add (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s)
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat j) s)) := by
        rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add a
          (F.mul
            (F.add (RealTheory.nat p) (RealTheory.nat j)) s) := by
        rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (p + j)) s) := by
        rw [RealTheory.nat_add]

name: leftSumCount_split_at_grid
statement:
private theorem leftSumCount_split_at_grid
    (f : Map) (a c : Point) {p q : Nat}
    (hp : Not (p = 0)) (hq : Not (q = 0)) :
    leftSumCount f a c (p + q) =
      RealTheory.add
        (leftSumCount f a (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) p)
        (leftSumCount f (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) c q)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let b := countGridPoint a c (p + q) p
  let s := countStep a c (p + q)
  unfold leftSumCount
  change
    F.mul s
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => f (countGridPoint a c (p + q) k))
          (p + q)) =
      F.add
        (F.mul (countStep a b p)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (countGridPoint a b p k)) p))
        (F.mul (countStep b c q)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (countGridPoint b c q k)) q))
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length
    (fun k : Nat => f (countGridPoint a c (p + q) k)) p q]
  rw [countStep_left_of_split (a := a) (c := c) (p := p) (q := q) hp]
  rw [countStep_right_of_split (a := a) (c := c) (p := p) (q := q) hq]
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => f (countGridPoint a c (p + q) k)) p =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => f (countGridPoint a b p k)) p := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro k
    rw [countGridPoint_left_of_split
      (a := a) (c := c) (p := p) (q := q) hp]
  have hright :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => f (countGridPoint a c (p + q) (p + j))) q =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => f (countGridPoint b c q j)) q := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro j
    rw [countGridPoint_right_of_split
      (a := a) (c := c) (p := p) (q := q) hq]
  rw [hleft, hright]
  change
    F.mul s
        (F.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (countGridPoint a b p k)) p)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => f (countGridPoint b c q j)) q)) =
      F.add
        (F.mul s
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (countGridPoint a b p k)) p))
        (F.mul s
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (countGridPoint b c q k)) q))
  rw [F.mul_add]

name: countStep_scale
statement:
private theorem countStep_scale
    (a b : Point) {r d : Nat}
    (hr : Not (r = 0)) (hd : Not (d = 0)) :
    countStep a b (r * d) =
      RealTheory.mul (countStep a b r)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.nat d))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hrnat : Not (RealTheory.nat r = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hr
  have hdnat : Not (RealTheory.nat d = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hd
  unfold countStep countDenom
  change
    F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (RealTheory.nat (r * d))) =
      F.mul
        (F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (RealTheory.nat r)))
        (F.inv (RealTheory.nat d))
  rw [RealTheory.nat_mul]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hrnat hdnat]
  rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv (RealTheory.nat d))
    (F.inv (RealTheory.nat r))]
  rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: countGridPoint_scale
statement:
private theorem countGridPoint_scale
    (a c : Point) {p r d : Nat}
    (hr : Not (r = 0)) (hd : Not (d = 0)) :
    countGridPoint a c (r * d) (p * d) =
      countGridPoint a c r p
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := countStep a c r
  unfold countGridPoint
  rw [RealTheory.nat_mul]
  rw [countStep_scale (a := a) (b := c) (r := r) (d := d) hr hd]
  change
    F.add a
        (F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) (RealTheory.nat d))
          (F.mul s (F.inv (RealTheory.nat d)))) =
      F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s)
  have hdnat : Not (RealTheory.nat d = F.zero) :=
    RealTheory.nat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hd
  have hprod :
      F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) (RealTheory.nat d))
          (F.mul s (F.inv (RealTheory.nat d))) =
        F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) (RealTheory.nat d))
          (F.mul s (F.inv (RealTheory.nat d))) =
          F.mul (RealTheory.nat p)
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat d)
              (F.mul s (F.inv (RealTheory.nat d)))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (RealTheory.nat p)
            (F.mul s
              (F.mul (RealTheory.nat d)
                (F.inv (RealTheory.nat d)))) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc (RealTheory.nat d) s
            (F.inv (RealTheory.nat d))]
          rw [F.mul_comm (RealTheory.nat d) s]
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (RealTheory.nat p)
            (F.mul s F.one) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hdnat]
      _ = F.mul (RealTheory.nat p) s := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
  rw [hprod]

name: leftSumCount_split_at_grid_scaled
statement:
private theorem leftSumCount_split_at_grid_scaled
    (f : Map) (a c : Point) {p q d : Nat}
    (hp : Not (p = 0)) (hq : Not (q = 0)) (hd : Not (d = 0)) :
    leftSumCount f a c ((p + q) * d) =
      RealTheory.add
        (leftSumCount f a (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) (p * d))
        (leftSumCount f (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) c (q * d))
proof:
:= by
  have hpd : Not (p * d = 0) := by
    exact Nat.ne_of_gt
      (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp)
        (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd))
  have hqd : Not (q * d = 0) := by
    exact Nat.ne_of_gt
      (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hq)
        (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd))
  have hr : Not (p + q = 0) := by
    intro h
    have hp0 : p = 0 := by omega
    exact hp hp0
  have htotal : p * d + q * d = (p + q) * d := by
    rw [Nat.add_mul]
  have hsplit :=
    leftSumCount_split_at_grid
      (f := f) (a := a) (c := c)
      (p := p * d) (q := q * d) hpd hqd
  have hb :
      countGridPoint a c (p * d + q * d) (p * d) =
        countGridPoint a c (p + q) p := by
    rw [htotal]
    exact countGridPoint_scale
      (a := a) (c := c) (p := p) (r := p + q) (d := d)
      hr hd
  have hb' :
      countGridPoint a c ((p + q) * d) (p * d) =
        countGridPoint a c (p + q) p := by
    rw [<- htotal]
    exact hb
  rwa [htotal, hb'] at hsplit

name: partitions_add_partitions
statement:
private theorem partitions_add_partitions (n m : Nat) :
    partitions (n + m + 1) = partitions n + partitions m
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitions
  omega

name: leftSum_split_at_count_grid_partitions
statement:
private theorem leftSum_split_at_count_grid_partitions
    (f : Map) (a c : Point) (n m : Nat) :
    leftSum f a c (n + m + 1) =
      RealTheory.add
        (leftSum f a
          (countGridPoint a c (partitions n + partitions m)
            (partitions n)) n)
        (leftSum f
          (countGridPoint a c (partitions n + partitions m)
            (partitions n)) c m)
proof:
:= by
  let p := partitions n
  let q := partitions m
  let b := countGridPoint a c (p + q) p
  have hp : Not (p = 0) := by
    unfold p
    exact partitions_ne_zero n
  have hq : Not (q = 0) := by
    unfold q
    exact partitions_ne_zero m
  have hsplit :
      leftSumCount f a c (p + q) =
        RealTheory.add
          (leftSumCount f a b p)
          (leftSumCount f b c q) :=
    leftSumCount_split_at_grid
      (f := f) (a := a) (c := c)
      (p := p) (q := q) hp hq
  have hN :
      p + q = partitions (n + m + 1) := by
    unfold p q
    exact Eq.symm (partitions_add_partitions n m)
  have hbig :
      leftSumCount f a c (p + q) =
        leftSum f a c (n + m + 1) := by
    rw [hN]
    exact leftSumCount_partitions f a c (n + m + 1)
  have hleft :
      leftSumCount f a b p =
        leftSum f a b n := by
    unfold p
    exact leftSumCount_partitions f a b n
  have hright :
      leftSumCount f b c q =
        leftSum f b c m := by
    unfold q
    exact leftSumCount_partitions f b c m
  change
    leftSum f a c (n + m + 1) =
      RealTheory.add (leftSum f a b n) (leftSum f b c m)
  rw [<- hbig, hsplit, hleft, hright]

name: hasIntegral_ordered_leftSum_tendsto
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_ordered_leftSum_tendsto
    {f : Map} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasIntegral f a b I) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto (leftSum f a b) I
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hI eps heps with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have h := hN n hn
      change
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub (orientedSum f a b n) I))
          eps at h
      unfold orientedSum at h
      rwa [if_pos hab] at h

name: partitions_pred_of_pos
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitions
  omega

name: leftSumCount_eq_leftSum_pred
statement:
private theorem leftSumCount_eq_leftSum_pred
    (f : Map) (a b : Point) {r : Nat}
    (hr : 0 < r) :
    leftSumCount f a b r = leftSum f a b (r - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := leftSumCount_partitions f a b (r - 1)
  rwa [partitions_pred_of_pos hr] at h

name: hasIntegral_ordered_leftSumCount_mul_partitions_tendsto
statement:
private theorem hasIntegral_ordered_leftSumCount_mul_partitions_tendsto
    {f : Map} {a b I : Point} {d : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hd : Not (d = 0))
    (hI : HasIntegral f a b I) :
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        leftSumCount f a b (d * partitions n))
      I
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := hasIntegral_ordered_leftSum_tendsto hab hI
  intro eps heps
  cases hleft eps heps with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      let r := d * partitions n
      have hrpos : 0 < r := by
        unfold r
        exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd) (partitions_pos n)
      have hn_le_idx : n <= r - 1 := by
        have hdpos : 1 <= d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd
        have hmul : 1 * (n + 1) <= d * (n + 1) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n + 1) hdpos
        unfold r partitions
        omega
      have hNidx : N <= r - 1 := Nat.le_trans hn hn_le_idx
      have hclose := hN (r - 1) hNidx
      change
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (leftSumCount f a b (d * partitions n)) I))
          eps
      unfold r at hclose
      rw [leftSumCount_eq_leftSum_pred f a b hrpos]
      exact hclose

name: orderedIntervalAdditivity_countGridPoint
statement:
theorem orderedIntervalAdditivity_countGridPoint
    {f : Map} {a c Iab Ibc Iac : Point} {p q : Nat}
    (hp : Not (p = 0)) (hq : Not (q = 0))
    (hab :
      RealTheory.le a (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p))
    (hbc :
      RealTheory.le (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) c)
    (hIab :
      HasIntegral f a (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) Iab)
    (hIbc :
      HasIntegral f (countGridPoint a c (p + q) p) c Ibc)
    (hIac : HasIntegral f a c Iac) :
    Iac = RealTheory.add Iab Ibc
proof:
:= by
  let b := countGridPoint a c (p + q) p
  have hac : RealTheory.le a c := RealTheory.le_trans hab hbc
  have hpq : Not (p + q = 0) := by
    intro h
    have hp0 : p = 0 := by omega
    exact hp hp0
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          leftSumCount f a b (p * partitions n))
        Iab :=
    hasIntegral_ordered_leftSumCount_mul_partitions_tendsto
      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (I := Iab)
      (d := p) hab hp hIab
  have hright :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          leftSumCount f b c (q * partitions n))
        Ibc :=
    hasIntegral_ordered_leftSumCount_mul_partitions_tendsto
      (f := f) (a := b) (b := c) (I := Ibc)
      (d := q) hbc hq hIbc
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.add
            (leftSumCount f a b (p * partitions n))
            (leftSumCount f b c (q * partitions n)))
        (RealTheory.add Iab Ibc) :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_add hleft hright
  have hbig :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun n : Nat =>
          leftSumCount f a c ((p + q) * partitions n))
        Iac :=
    hasIntegral_ordered_leftSumCount_mul_partitions_tendsto
      (f := f) (a := a) (b := c) (I := Iac)
      (d := p + q) hac hpq hIac
  have hseq :
      (fun n : Nat =>
          leftSumCount f a c ((p + q) * partitions n)) =
        (fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.add
            (leftSumCount f a b (p * partitions n))
            (leftSumCount f b c (q * partitions n))) := by
    funext n
    unfold b
    exact leftSumCount_split_at_grid_scaled
      (f := f) (a := a) (c := c)
      (p := p) (q := q) (d := partitions n)
      hp hq (partitions_ne_zero n)
  rw [hseq] at hbig
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hbig hsum

name: step_same
statement:
private theorem step_same (a : Point) (n : Nat) :
    step a a n = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold step
  change F.mul (F.sub a a) (F.inv (denom n)) = F.zero
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F a]
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F (F.inv (denom n))

name: leftSum_same_endpoint
statement:
private theorem leftSum_same_endpoint (f : Map) (a : Point) (n : Nat) :
    leftSum f a a n = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold leftSum
  rw [step_same]
  exact RealTheory.zero_mul
    (RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a a n k)) (n + 1))

name: orientedSum_same_endpoint
statement:
private theorem orientedSum_same_endpoint (f : Map) (a : Point) (n : Nat) :
    orientedSum f a a n = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold orientedSum
  rw [if_pos (RealTheory.le_refl a)]
  exact leftSum_same_endpoint f a n

name: orientedSum_swap
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hab : RealTheory.le a b
  · by_cases hba : RealTheory.le b a
    · have hEq : a = b := RealTheory.le_antisymm hab hba
      subst b
      rw [orientedSum_same_endpoint]
      exact Eq.symm RealTheory.neg_zero
    · unfold orientedSum
      rw [if_neg hba]
      rw [if_pos hab]
  · have hba : RealTheory.le b a := by
      cases RealTheory.le_total a b with
      | inl hab' => exact False.elim (hab hab')
      | inr hba' => exact hba'
    unfold orientedSum
    rw [if_pos hba]
    rw [if_neg hab]
    exact Eq.symm (RealTheory.neg_neg (leftSum f b a n))

name: hasIntegral_same_endpoint_zero
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_same_endpoint_zero
    (f : Map) (a : Point) :
    HasIntegral f a a RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto (orientedSum f a a) RealTheory.zero
  have hseq :
      orientedSum f a a = fun _ : Nat => RealTheory.zero := by
    funext n
    exact orientedSum_same_endpoint f a n
  rw [hseq]
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_const RealTheory.zero

name: hasIntegral_same_endpoint_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_same_endpoint_eq_zero
    {f : Map} {a I : Point}
    (hI : HasIntegral f a a I) :
    I = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  exact hasIntegral_unique hI (hasIntegral_same_endpoint_zero f a)

name: hasIntegral_reverse
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_reverse
    {f : Map} {a b I : Point}
    (hI : HasIntegral f a b I) :
    HasIntegral f b a (RealTheory.neg I)
proof:
:= by
  have hneg := RealTheory.seqTendsto_neg hI
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.neg (orientedSum f a b n))
      (RealTheory.neg I) at hneg
  have hseq :
      (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.neg (orientedSum f a b n)) =
        orientedSum f b a := by
    funext n
    exact Eq.symm (orientedSum_swap f a b n)
  rwa [hseq] at hneg

name: add_eq_of_eq_add_neg_right
statement:
private theorem add_eq_of_eq_add_neg_right
    {x y z : Point}
    (h : z = RealTheory.add x (RealTheory.neg y)) :
    x = RealTheory.add z y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change x = F.add z y
  change z = F.add x (F.neg y) at h
  have hsub : z = F.sub x y := by
    rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg x y] at h
  calc
    x = F.add (F.sub x y) y := by
          exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F x y)
    _ = F.add z y := by rw [<- hsub]

name: add_eq_of_eq_neg_add
statement:
private theorem add_eq_of_eq_neg_add
    {x y z : Point}
    (h : y = RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg x) z) :
    z = RealTheory.add x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change z = F.add x y
  change y = F.add (F.neg x) z at h
  calc
    z = F.add F.zero z := by rw [F.zero_add]
    _ = F.add (F.add x (F.neg x)) z := by rw [F.add_neg]
    _ = F.add x (F.add (F.neg x) z) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add x y := by rw [<- h]

name: add_eq_of_neg_eq_add_neg
statement:
private theorem add_eq_of_neg_eq_add_neg
    {x y z : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.neg x = RealTheory.add y (RealTheory.neg z)) :
    z = RealTheory.add x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hy :
      y = F.add (F.neg x) z :=
    add_eq_of_eq_add_neg_right (x := y) (y := z)
      (z := F.neg x) h
  exact add_eq_of_eq_neg_add (x := x) (y := y) (z := z) hy

name: add_eq_of_neg_eq_neg_add
statement:
private theorem add_eq_of_neg_eq_neg_add
    {x y z : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.neg y = RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg z) x) :
    z = RealTheory.add x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.neg y = F.add (F.neg z) x at h
  have hx :
      x = F.add z (F.neg y) := by
    calc
      x = F.add F.zero x := by rw [F.zero_add]
      _ = F.add (F.add z (F.neg z)) x := by rw [F.add_neg]
      _ = F.add z (F.add (F.neg z) x) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add z (F.neg y) := by rw [<- h]
  exact add_eq_of_eq_add_neg_right (x := z) (y := y)
    (z := x) hx

name: add_eq_of_neg_eq_neg_add_neg
statement:
private theorem add_eq_of_neg_eq_neg_add_neg
    {x y z : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.neg z =
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg y) (RealTheory.neg x)) :
    z = RealTheory.add x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.neg z = F.add (F.neg y) (F.neg x) at h
  calc
    z = F.neg (F.neg z) := by rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F z]
    _ = F.neg (F.add (F.neg y) (F.neg x)) := by rw [h]
    _ = F.add (F.neg (F.neg y)) (F.neg (F.neg x)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib
            F (F.neg y) (F.neg x)]
    _ = F.add y (F.neg (F.neg x)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F y]
    _ = F.add y x := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F x]
    _ = F.add x y := by rw [F.add_comm y x]

name: orientedIntervalAdditivity_from_ordered
statement:
theorem orientedIntervalAdditivity_from_ordered
    (hordered : OrderedIntervalAdditivityStatement) :
    OrientedIntervalAdditivityStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro f a b c Iab Ibc Iac hfab hfbc hfac hIab hIbc hIac
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.le_total a b with
  | inl hab =>
      cases RealTheory.le_total b c with
      | inl hbc =>
          have hac : RealTheory.le a c := RealTheory.le_trans hab hbc
          exact hordered f a b c Iab Ibc Iac
            hab hbc (hfac.left hac) hIab hIbc hIac
      | inr hcb =>
          cases RealTheory.le_total a c with
          | inl hac =>
              have hIcb : HasIntegral f c b (RealTheory.neg Ibc) :=
                hasIntegral_reverse hIbc
              have h :
                  Iab = RealTheory.add Iac (RealTheory.neg Ibc) :=
                hordered f a c b Iac (RealTheory.neg Ibc) Iab
                  hac hcb (hfab.left hab) hIac hIcb hIab
              exact add_eq_of_eq_add_neg_right
                (x := Iac) (y := Ibc) (z := Iab) h
          | inr hca =>
              have hIca : HasIntegral f c a (RealTheory.neg Iac) :=
                hasIntegral_reverse hIac
              have hIcb : HasIntegral f c b (RealTheory.neg Ibc) :=
                hasIntegral_reverse hIbc
              have h :
                  RealTheory.neg Ibc =
                    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg Iac) Iab :=
                hordered f c a b
                  (RealTheory.neg Iac) Iab (RealTheory.neg Ibc)
                  hca hab (hfbc.right hcb) hIca hIab hIcb
              exact add_eq_of_neg_eq_neg_add
                (x := Iab) (y := Ibc) (z := Iac) h
  | inr hba =>
      cases RealTheory.le_total a c with
      | inl hac =>
          have hbc : RealTheory.le b c := RealTheory.le_trans hba hac
          have hIba : HasIntegral f b a (RealTheory.neg Iab) :=
            hasIntegral_reverse hIab
          have h :
              Ibc = RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg Iab) Iac :=
            hordered f b a c
              (RealTheory.neg Iab) Iac Ibc
              hba hac (hfbc.left hbc) hIba hIac hIbc
          exact add_eq_of_eq_neg_add
            (x := Iab) (y := Ibc) (z := Iac) h
      | inr hca =>
          cases RealTheory.le_total b c with
          | inl hbc =>
              have hIba : HasIntegral f b a (RealTheory.neg Iab) :=
                hasIntegral_reverse hIab
              have hIca : HasIntegral f c a (RealTheory.neg Iac) :=
                hasIntegral_reverse hIac
              have h :
                  RealTheory.neg Iab =
                    RealTheory.add Ibc (RealTheory.neg Iac) :=
                hordered f b c a
                  Ibc (RealTheory.neg Iac) (RealTheory.neg Iab)
                  hbc hca (hfab.right hba) hIbc hIca hIba
              exact add_eq_of_neg_eq_add_neg
                (x := Iab) (y := Ibc) (z := Iac) h
          | inr hcb =>
              have hIcb : HasIntegral f c b (RealTheory.neg Ibc) :=
                hasIntegral_reverse hIbc
              have hIba : HasIntegral f b a (RealTheory.neg Iab) :=
                hasIntegral_reverse hIab
              have hIca : HasIntegral f c a (RealTheory.neg Iac) :=
                hasIntegral_reverse hIac
              have h :
                  RealTheory.neg Iac =
                    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg Ibc)
                      (RealTheory.neg Iab) :=
                hordered f c b a
                  (RealTheory.neg Ibc) (RealTheory.neg Iab)
                  (RealTheory.neg Iac)
                  hcb hba (hfac.right hca) hIcb hIba hIca
              exact add_eq_of_neg_eq_neg_add_neg
                (x := Iab) (y := Ibc) (z := Iac) h

name: leftSum_le_of_pointwise_le
statement:
private theorem leftSum_le_of_pointwise_le
    {f g : Map} {a b : Point} (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hfg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (f x) (g x))
    (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le (leftSum f a b n) (leftSum g a b n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold leftSum
  have hsum :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => g (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1)) := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
    intro k hk
    exact hfg (gridPoint a b n k)
      (gridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_lt hab n k hk)
  exact F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
    hsum (step_nonneg_of_le hab n)

name: integralOrderPreservation
statement:
theorem integralOrderPreservation :
    IntegralOrderPreservationStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro f g a b If Ig hab hfg hIf hIg
  have hfleft := hasIntegral_ordered_leftSum_tendsto hab hIf
  have hgleft := hasIntegral_ordered_leftSum_tendsto hab hIg
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le
    hfleft hgleft
    (Tautology.Eventually.of_forall
      (fun n : Nat => leftSum_le_of_pointwise_le hab hfg n))

name: hasIntegral_const_ordered
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_const_ordered
    {a b c : Point}
    (_hab : RealTheory.le a b) :
    HasIntegral (fun _ : Point => c) a b
      (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:= by
  exact hasIntegral_const

name: integralAbsLeIntegralAbs
statement:
theorem integralAbsLeIntegralAbs :
    IntegralAbsLeIntegralAbsStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro f a b I A hab hI hA
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hupper : F.le I A :=
    integralOrderPreservation
      f (RealFunction.AbsFun f) a b I A hab
      (fun x _ => RealTheory.le_abs_self (f x))
      hI hA
  have hnegIntegral :
      HasIntegral (RealFunction.ScaleFun (F.neg F.one) f) a b
        (F.mul (F.neg F.one) I) :=
    scaleLinearity (F.neg F.one) f a b I hI
  have hneg_le_A_raw :
      F.le (F.mul (F.neg F.one) I) A :=
    integralOrderPreservation
      (RealFunction.ScaleFun (F.neg F.one) f) (RealFunction.AbsFun f)
      a b (F.mul (F.neg F.one) I) A hab
      (fun x _ => by
        unfold RealFunction.ScaleFun RealFunction.AbsFun
        change F.le (F.mul (F.neg F.one) (f x))
          (RealTheory.abs (f x))
        rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_eq_neg_one_mul F (f x)]
        exact RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self (f x))
      hnegIntegral hA
  have hnegI :
      F.mul (F.neg F.one) I = F.neg I := by
    exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_eq_neg_one_mul F I)
  have hneg_le_A : F.le (F.neg I) A := by
    rwa [hnegI] at hneg_le_A_raw
  exact RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hupper hneg_le_A

name: integralBoundEstimate
statement:
theorem integralBoundEstimate :
    IntegralBoundEstimateStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro f a b I M hab hM hbound hI
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let constM : Map := fun _ : Point => M
  have hConst :
      HasIntegral constM a b (F.mul M (F.sub b a)) :=
    hasIntegral_const_ordered (a := a) (b := b) (c := M) hab
  have hupper : F.le I (F.mul M (F.sub b a)) :=
    integralOrderPreservation
      f constM a b I (F.mul M (F.sub b a)) hab
      (fun x hx =>
        F.le_trans (RealTheory.le_abs_self (f x)) (hbound x hx))
      hI hConst
  have hnegIntegral :
      HasIntegral (RealFunction.ScaleFun (F.neg F.one) f) a b
        (F.mul (F.neg F.one) I) :=
    scaleLinearity (F.neg F.one) f a b I hI
  have hneg_upper_raw :
      F.le (F.mul (F.neg F.one) I) (F.mul M (F.sub b a)) :=
    integralOrderPreservation
      (RealFunction.ScaleFun (F.neg F.one) f) constM
      a b (F.mul (F.neg F.one) I)
        (F.mul M (F.sub b a)) hab
      (fun x hx => by
        unfold RealFunction.ScaleFun constM
        change F.le (F.mul (F.neg F.one) (f x)) M
        rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_eq_neg_one_mul F (f x)]
        exact F.le_trans
          (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self (f x)) (hbound x hx))
      hnegIntegral hConst
  have hnegI :
      F.mul (F.neg F.one) I = F.neg I := by
    exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_eq_neg_one_mul F I)
  have hneg_upper :
      F.le (F.neg I) (F.mul M (F.sub b a)) := by
    rwa [hnegI] at hneg_upper_raw
  exact RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hupper hneg_upper

name: basicEstimates
statement: theorem basicEstimates : BasicEstimateStatement
proof:
:=
  And.intro integralAbsLeIntegralAbs integralBoundEstimate

name: leftSum_commonIndex_blocks
statement:
private theorem leftSum_commonIndex_blocks
    (f : Map) (a b : Point) (n m : Nat) :
    leftSum f a b (commonIndex n m) =
      refinedBlockSum f a b n m
proof:
:= by
  unfold leftSum refinedBlockSum
  change
    RealTheory.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m) k))
          (partitions (commonIndex n m))) =
      RealTheory.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun j : Nat =>
                f (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m)
                  (refineIndex m k j)))
              (partitions m))
          (partitions n))
  rw [commonIndex_partitions]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_blocks
    (fun r : Nat => f (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m) r))
    (partitions n) (partitions m)]
  rfl

name: repeatedCoarseBlockSum_eq_leftSum
statement:
private theorem repeatedCoarseBlockSum_eq_leftSum
    (f : Map) (a b : Point) (n m : Nat) :
    repeatedCoarseBlockSum f a b n m =
      leftSum f a b n
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold repeatedCoarseBlockSum leftSum
  have hinner :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun _j : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k))
              (partitions m))
          (partitions n) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m))
              (f (gridPoint a b n k)))
          (partitions n) := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro k
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_const
      (f (gridPoint a b n k)) (partitions m)
  rw [hinner]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left]
  change
    F.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1))) =
      F.mul (step a b n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1))
  calc
    F.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1))) =
        F.mul
          (F.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
            (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (step a b n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1)) := by
          have hstep := nat_partitions_mul_step_commonIndex a b n m
          change
            F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m))
              (step a b (commonIndex n m)) =
              step a b n at hstep
          rw [F.mul_comm (step a b (commonIndex n m))
            (RealTheory.nat (partitions m))]
          rw [hstep]

name: leftSum_eq_repeatedCoarseBlockSum
statement:
private theorem leftSum_eq_repeatedCoarseBlockSum
    (f : Map) (a b : Point) (n m : Nat) :
    leftSum f a b n =
      repeatedCoarseBlockSum f a b n m
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm (repeatedCoarseBlockSum_eq_leftSum f a b n m)

name: repeatedCoarseBlockSum_sub_refinedBlockSum
statement:
private theorem repeatedCoarseBlockSum_sub_refinedBlockSum
    (f : Map) (a b : Point) (n m : Nat) :
    RealTheory.sub
      (repeatedCoarseBlockSum f a b n m)
      (refinedBlockSum f a b n m) =
      RealTheory.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun j : Nat =>
                RealTheory.sub
                  (f (gridPoint a b n k))
                  (f (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m)
                    (refineIndex m k j))))
              (partitions m))
          (partitions n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold repeatedCoarseBlockSum refinedBlockSum
  let coarseBlock : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun _j : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k))
        (partitions m)
  let fineBlock : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          f (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m)
            (refineIndex m k j)))
        (partitions m)
  let diffBlock : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          RealTheory.sub
            (f (gridPoint a b n k))
            (f (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m)
              (refineIndex m k j))))
        (partitions m)
  have hblocks :
      RealTheory.finiteSum diffBlock (partitions n) =
        RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.finiteSum coarseBlock (partitions n))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum fineBlock (partitions n)) := by
    calc
      RealTheory.finiteSum diffBlock (partitions n) =
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.sub (coarseBlock k) (fineBlock k))
            (partitions n) := by
            apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
            intro k
            unfold diffBlock coarseBlock fineBlock
            exact RealTheory.finiteSum_sub
              (fun _j : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k))
              (fun j : Nat =>
                f (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m)
                  (refineIndex m k j)))
              (partitions m)
      _ = RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.finiteSum coarseBlock (partitions n))
            (RealTheory.finiteSum fineBlock (partitions n)) := by
            rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_sub]
  change
    F.sub
      (F.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum coarseBlock (partitions n)))
      (F.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum fineBlock (partitions n))) =
      F.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum diffBlock (partitions n))
  rw [hblocks]
  exact Eq.symm
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
      F (step a b (commonIndex n m))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum coarseBlock (partitions n))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum fineBlock (partitions n)))

name: abs_repeatedCoarseBlockSum_sub_refinedBlockSum_le
statement:
private theorem abs_repeatedCoarseBlockSum_sub_refinedBlockSum_le
    {f : Map} {a b M : Point} {n m : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hM : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (hbound :
      forall k j : Nat,
        k < partitions n ->
          j < partitions m ->
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (f (gridPoint a b n k))
                  (f (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m)
                    (refineIndex m k j)))))
              M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (repeatedCoarseBlockSum f a b n m)
          (refinedBlockSum f a b n m)))
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) M)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let sc := step a b (commonIndex n m)
  let diff : Nat -> Nat -> Point :=
    fun k j : Nat =>
      RealTheory.sub
        (f (gridPoint a b n k))
        (f (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m)
          (refineIndex m k j)))
  let block : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => diff k j) (partitions m)
  have hinner :
      forall k : Nat,
        k < partitions n ->
          F.le (RealTheory.abs (block k))
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)) M) := by
    intro k hk
    unfold block
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_abs_le
      (fun j : Nat => diff k j) hM
    intro j hj
    exact hbound k j hk hj
  have hblockBoundNonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)) M) :=
    F.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg (partitions m)) hM
  have houter :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum block (partitions n)))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions n))
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)) M)) := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_abs_le block hblockBoundNonneg
    intro k hk
    exact hinner k hk
  have hsc_nonneg : F.le F.zero sc := by
    unfold sc
    exact step_nonneg_of_le hab (commonIndex n m)
  have hmul :
      F.le
        (F.mul sc
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum block (partitions n))))
        (F.mul sc
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions n))
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)) M))) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left houter hsc_nonneg
  have habs_sc : RealTheory.abs sc = sc := by
    exact RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hsc_nonneg
  have hmain :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (F.mul sc (RealTheory.finiteSum block (partitions n))))
        (F.mul sc
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions n))
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)) M))) := by
    rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
    rw [habs_sc]
    exact hmul
  have htarget :
      F.mul sc
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions n))
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)) M)) =
        F.mul (F.sub b a) M := by
    unfold sc
    calc
      F.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions n))
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)) M)) =
          F.mul
            (F.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
              (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions n))
                (RealTheory.nat (partitions m))))
            M := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc
              (RealTheory.nat (partitions n))
              (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)) M]
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul
            (F.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
              (RealTheory.nat (partitions n * partitions m)))
            M := by
            rw [RealTheory.nat_mul]
      _ = F.mul (F.sub b a) M := by
            have hstep := step_mul_denom a b (commonIndex n m)
            change
              F.mul (step a b (commonIndex n m))
                (RealTheory.nat (partitions (commonIndex n m))) =
                F.sub b a at hstep
            rw [commonIndex_partitions] at hstep
            rw [hstep]
  rw [repeatedCoarseBlockSum_sub_refinedBlockSum]
  change
    F.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (F.mul sc (RealTheory.finiteSum block (partitions n))))
      (F.mul (F.sub b a) M)
  rwa [htarget] at hmain

name: abs_leftSum_sub_commonIndex_le_of_grid_bound
statement:
theorem abs_leftSum_sub_commonIndex_le_of_grid_bound
    {f : Map} {a b M : Point} {n m : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hM : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (hbound :
      forall k j : Nat,
        k < partitions n ->
          j < partitions m ->
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (f (gridPoint a b n k))
                  (f (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m)
                    (refineIndex m k j)))))
              M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (leftSum f a b n)
          (leftSum f a b (commonIndex n m))))
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftSum_eq_repeatedCoarseBlockSum f a b n m]
  rw [leftSum_commonIndex_blocks]
  exact abs_repeatedCoarseBlockSum_sub_refinedBlockSum_le
    hab hM hbound

name: dist_self_add
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [RealFunction.dist_comm]
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  change
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
      (F.sub (F.add x t) x) =
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F t
  rw [F.add_comm x t]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel F t x]

name: dist_gridPoint_refineIndex_le_step
statement:
theorem dist_gridPoint_refineIndex_le_step
    {a b : Point} (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (n m k j : Nat)
    (hj : j < partitions m) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealFunction.dist
        (gridPoint a b n k)
        (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m) (refineIndex m k j)))
      (step a b n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let sc := step a b (commonIndex n m)
  rw [gridPoint_refineIndex]
  rw [dist_self_add]
  have hsc_nonneg : F.le F.zero sc := by
    unfold sc
    exact step_nonneg_of_le hab (commonIndex n m)
  have ht_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul (RealTheory.nat j) sc) := by
    exact F.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg j) hsc_nonneg
  change
    F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.mul (RealTheory.nat j) sc))
      (step a b n)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F ht_nonneg]
  have hjle : j <= partitions m := Nat.le_of_lt hj
  have hnatle :
      F.le (RealTheory.nat j) (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hjle
  have hmul_le :
      F.le
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat j) sc)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)) sc) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hnatle hsc_nonneg
  have hstep := nat_partitions_mul_step_commonIndex a b n m
  change
    F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)) sc =
      step a b n at hstep
  rwa [hstep] at hmul_le

name: gridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_lt
statement:
theorem gridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_lt
    {a b : Point} (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (n k : Nat) (hk : k < partitions n) :
    RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (gridPoint a b n k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := step a b n
  have hs_nonneg : F.le F.zero s := by
    unfold s
    exact step_nonneg_of_le hab n
  have hprod_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) s) :=
    F.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg k) hs_nonneg
  have hleft :
      F.le a (gridPoint a b n k) := by
    unfold gridPoint
    change F.le a (F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) s))
    have h := F.add_le_add_left hprod_nonneg a
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hk_le : k <= partitions n := Nat.le_of_lt hk
  have hnat_le :
      F.le (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (partitions n)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hk_le
  have hprod_le :
      F.le
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) s)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions n)) s) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hnat_le hs_nonneg
  have hstep := step_mul_denom a b n
  change
    F.mul s (RealTheory.nat (partitions n)) =
      F.sub b a at hstep
  have hdenom :
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions n)) s =
        F.sub b a := by
    rw [F.mul_comm]
    exact hstep
  have hprod_le_len :
      F.le (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) s) (F.sub b a) := by
    rwa [hdenom] at hprod_le
  have hright :
      F.le (gridPoint a b n k) b := by
    unfold gridPoint
    change F.le (F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) s)) b
    have h := F.add_le_add_left hprod_le_len a
    have hright_eq : F.add a (F.sub b a) = b := by
      rw [F.add_comm a (F.sub b a)]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b a
    rwa [hright_eq] at h
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: commonIndex_comm
statement:
theorem commonIndex_comm (n m : Nat) :
    commonIndex n m = commonIndex m n
proof:
:= by
  unfold commonIndex
  rw [Nat.mul_comm]

name: partitions_pos
statement:
theorem partitions_pos (n : Nat) :
    0 < partitions n
proof:
:= by
  unfold partitions
  exact Nat.succ_pos n

name: partitions_ne_zero
statement:
theorem partitions_ne_zero (n : Nat) :
    Not (partitions n = 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.ne_of_gt (partitions_pos n)

name: commonIndex_partitions
statement:
theorem commonIndex_partitions (n m : Nat) :
    partitions (commonIndex n m) = partitions n * partitions m
proof:
:= by
  unfold commonIndex partitions
  exact Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos
    (Nat.mul_pos (partitions_pos n) (partitions_pos m))

name: refineIndex_lt_common_partitions
statement:
theorem refineIndex_lt_common_partitions
    {n m k j : Nat}
    (hk : k < partitions n)
    (hj : j < partitions m) :
    refineIndex m k j < partitions (commonIndex n m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold refineIndex
  rw [commonIndex_partitions]
  have hblock :
      k * partitions m + j < (k + 1) * partitions m := by
    have hj' : j < partitions m := hj
    have h := Nat.add_lt_add_left hj' (k * partitions m)
    have hsucc :
        (k + 1) * partitions m =
          k * partitions m + partitions m := by
      rw [Nat.succ_mul]
    rwa [hsucc]
  have hk_succ : k + 1 <= partitions n := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk
  have hle :
      (k + 1) * partitions m <= partitions n * partitions m :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_right (partitions m) hk_succ
  exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hblock hle

name: nat_refineIndex
statement:
theorem nat_refineIndex (m k j : Nat) :
    RealTheory.nat (refineIndex m k j) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)))
        (RealTheory.nat j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold refineIndex
  rw [RealTheory.nat_add]
  rw [RealTheory.nat_mul]
  unfold RealTheory.add RealTheory.mul
  rfl

name: denom_pos
statement:
theorem denom_pos (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (denom n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold denom
  exact RealTheory.nat_pos_of_ne_zero (partitions_ne_zero n)

name: denom_ne_zero
statement:
theorem denom_ne_zero (n : Nat) :
    Not (denom n = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (denom_pos n) h.symm

name: denom_commonIndex
statement:
theorem denom_commonIndex (n m : Nat) :
    denom (commonIndex n m) =
      RealTheory.mul (denom n) (denom m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold denom
  rw [commonIndex_partitions]
  exact RealTheory.nat_mul (partitions n) (partitions m)

name: step_commonIndex
statement:
theorem step_commonIndex
    (a b : Point) (n m : Nat) :
    step a b (commonIndex n m) =
      RealTheory.mul (step a b n) (RealTheory.inv (denom m))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold step
  change
    F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (denom (commonIndex n m))) =
      F.mul (F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (denom n)))
        (F.inv (denom m))
  rw [denom_commonIndex]
  unfold RealTheory.mul
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F
    (denom_ne_zero n) (denom_ne_zero m)]
  rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv (denom m)) (F.inv (denom n))]
  rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: step_nonneg_of_le
statement:
theorem step_nonneg_of_le
    {a b : Point} (hab : RealTheory.le a b) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (step a b n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold step
  change
    F.le F.zero
      (F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (denom n)))
  exact F.mul_nonneg
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hab)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (denom_pos n)))

name: step_mul_denom
statement:
theorem step_mul_denom
    (a b : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (step a b n) (denom n) =
      RealTheory.sub b a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold step
  change
    F.mul (F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (denom n))) (denom n) =
      F.sub b a
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.inv (denom n))) (denom n) =
        F.mul (F.sub b a) (F.mul (F.inv (denom n)) (denom n)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.sub b a) F.one := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel (denom_ne_zero n)]
    _ = F.sub b a := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: denom_mul_step
statement:
theorem denom_mul_step
    (a b : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (denom n) (step a b n) =
      RealTheory.sub b a
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealTheory.mul_comm]
  exact step_mul_denom a b n

name: denom_mul_step_commonIndex
statement:
theorem denom_mul_step_commonIndex
    (a b : Point) (n m : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (denom m) (step a b (commonIndex n m)) =
      step a b n
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  rw [step_commonIndex]
  unfold RealTheory.mul
  calc
    F.mul (denom m) (F.mul (step a b n) (F.inv (denom m))) =
        F.mul (F.mul (denom m) (step a b n)) (F.inv (denom m)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul (step a b n) (denom m)) (F.inv (denom m)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (denom m) (step a b n)]
    _ = F.mul (step a b n) (F.mul (denom m) (F.inv (denom m))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (step a b n) F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel (denom_ne_zero m)]
    _ = step a b n := by rw [F.mul_one]

name: nat_partitions_mul_step_commonIndex
statement:
theorem nat_partitions_mul_step_commonIndex
    (a b : Point) (n m : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m))
        (step a b (commonIndex n m)) =
      step a b n
proof:
:= by
  change RealTheory.mul (denom m) (step a b (commonIndex n m)) =
    step a b n
  exact denom_mul_step_commonIndex a b n m

name: gridPoint_refineIndex
statement:
theorem gridPoint_refineIndex
    (a b : Point) (n m k j : Nat) :
    gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m) (refineIndex m k j) =
      RealTheory.add (gridPoint a b n k)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat j)
          (step a b (commonIndex n m)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold gridPoint
  rw [nat_refineIndex]
  unfold RealTheory.add RealTheory.mul
  calc
    F.add a
        (F.mul
          (F.add
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
              (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)))
            (RealTheory.nat j))
          (step a b (commonIndex n m))) =
        F.add a
          (F.add
            (F.mul
              (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
                (RealTheory.nat (partitions m)))
              (step a b (commonIndex n m)))
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat j)
              (step a b (commonIndex n m)))) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.add a
          (F.add
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
              (step a b n))
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat j)
              (step a b (commonIndex n m)))) := by
          have hM := nat_partitions_mul_step_commonIndex a b n m
          change
            F.mul (RealTheory.nat (partitions m))
              (step a b (commonIndex n m)) =
              step a b n at hM
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
          rw [hM]
    _ = F.add
          (F.add a
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step a b n)))
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat j)
            (step a b (commonIndex n m))) := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]

name: leftSum_add
statement:
theorem leftSum_add
    (f g : Map) (a b : Point) (n : Nat) :
    leftSum (RealFunction.AddFun f g) a b n =
      RealTheory.add (leftSum f a b n) (leftSum g a b n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold leftSum
  unfold RealFunction.AddFun
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
  exact RealTheory.mul_add
    (step a b n)
    (RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1))
    (RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => g (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1))

name: integrable_of_seqCauchy
statement:
theorem integrable_of_seqCauchy
    {f : Map} {a b : Point}
    (h : RealTheory.SeqCauchy (orientedSum f a b)) :
    Integrable f a b
proof:
:= by
  cases RealTheory.seqCauchy_converges h with
  | intro I hI =>
      exact Exists.intro I hI

name: integral_spec
statement:
theorem integral_spec
    {f : Map} {a b : Point} (h : Integrable f a b) :
    HasIntegral f a b (integral f a b h)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec h

name: hasIntegral_unique
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_unique
    {f : Map} {a b I J : Point}
    (hI : HasIntegral f a b I)
    (hJ : HasIntegral f a b J) :
    I = J
proof:
:=
  RealTheory.seqTendsto_unique hI hJ

name: integral_eq_of_hasIntegral
statement:
theorem integral_eq_of_hasIntegral
    {f : Map} {a b I : Point}
    (h : Integrable f a b)
    (hI : HasIntegral f a b I) :
    integral f a b h = I
proof:
:=
  hasIntegral_unique (integral_spec h) hI

name: leftSum_scale
statement:
private theorem leftSum_scale
    (c : Point) (f : Map) (a b : Point) (n : Nat) :
    leftSum (RealFunction.ScaleFun c f) a b n =
      RealTheory.mul c (leftSum f a b n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold leftSum RealFunction.ScaleFun
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left]
  change
    F.mul (step a b n)
        (F.mul c
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1))) =
      F.mul c
        (F.mul (step a b n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1)))
  calc
    F.mul (step a b n)
        (F.mul c
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1))) =
        F.mul (F.mul (step a b n) c)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.mul c (step a b n))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1)) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm (step a b n) c]
    _ = F.mul c
        (F.mul (step a b n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a b n k)) (n + 1))) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: orientedSum_add
statement:
private theorem orientedSum_add
    (f g : Map) (a b : Point) (n : Nat) :
    orientedSum (RealFunction.AddFun f g) a b n =
      RealTheory.add (orientedSum f a b n) (orientedSum g a b n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hab : RealTheory.le a b
  · unfold orientedSum
    rw [if_pos hab, if_pos hab, if_pos hab]
    exact leftSum_add f g a b n
  · unfold orientedSum
    rw [if_neg hab, if_neg hab, if_neg hab]
    rw [leftSum_add f g b a n]
    change
      F.neg (F.add (leftSum f b a n) (leftSum g b a n)) =
        F.add (F.neg (leftSum f b a n))
          (F.neg (leftSum g b a n))
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib
      F (leftSum f b a n) (leftSum g b a n)

name: orientedSum_scale
statement:
private theorem orientedSum_scale
    (c : Point) (f : Map) (a b : Point) (n : Nat) :
    orientedSum (RealFunction.ScaleFun c f) a b n =
      RealTheory.mul c (orientedSum f a b n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hab : RealTheory.le a b
  · unfold orientedSum
    rw [if_pos hab, if_pos hab]
    exact leftSum_scale c f a b n
  · unfold orientedSum
    rw [if_neg hab, if_neg hab]
    rw [leftSum_scale c f b a n]
    change
      F.neg (F.mul c (leftSum f b a n)) =
        F.mul c (F.neg (leftSum f b a n))
    exact Eq.symm
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg F c (leftSum f b a n))

name: leftSum_const
statement:
private theorem leftSum_const
    (c a b : Point) (n : Nat) :
    leftSum (fun _ : Point => c) a b n =
      RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold leftSum
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_const c (n + 1)]
  change
    F.mul (step a b n) (F.mul (denom n) c) =
      F.mul c (F.sub b a)
  calc
    F.mul (step a b n) (F.mul (denom n) c) =
        F.mul (F.mul (step a b n) (denom n)) c := by
          rw [← F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (F.sub b a) c := by
          have hstep := step_mul_denom a b n
          change F.mul (step a b n) (denom n) = F.sub b a at hstep
          rw [hstep]
    _ = F.mul c (F.sub b a) := by
          rw [F.mul_comm]

name: addLinearity
statement:
theorem addLinearity :
    AddLinearityStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro f g a b If Ig hIf hIg
  have hsum := RealTheory.seqTendsto_add hIf hIg
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.add (orientedSum f a b n)
          (orientedSum g a b n))
      (RealTheory.add If Ig) at hsum
  have hseq :
      orientedSum (RealFunction.AddFun f g) a b =
        fun n : Nat =>
          RealTheory.add (orientedSum f a b n)
            (orientedSum g a b n) := by
    funext n
    exact orientedSum_add f g a b n
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (orientedSum (RealFunction.AddFun f g) a b)
      (RealTheory.add If Ig)
  rwa [hseq]

name: scaleLinearity
statement:
theorem scaleLinearity :
    ScaleLinearityStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro c f a b If hIf
  have hconst : RealTheory.SeqTendsto (fun _ : Nat => c) c :=
    RealTheory.seqTendsto_const c
  have hmul := RealTheory.seqTendsto_mul hconst hIf
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul c (orientedSum f a b n))
      (RealTheory.mul c If) at hmul
  have hseq :
      orientedSum (RealFunction.ScaleFun c f) a b =
        fun n : Nat => RealTheory.mul c (orientedSum f a b n) := by
    funext n
    exact orientedSum_scale c f a b n
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (orientedSum (RealFunction.ScaleFun c f) a b)
      (RealTheory.mul c If)
  rwa [hseq]

name: hasIntegral_congr_integrand
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_congr_integrand
    {f g : Map} {a b I : Point}
    (hfg : forall x : Point, f x = g x)
    (hI : HasIntegral f a b I) :
    HasIntegral g a b I
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : orientedSum f a b = orientedSum g a b := by
    funext n
    unfold orientedSum
    by_cases hab : RealTheory.le a b
    · rw [if_pos hab, if_pos hab]
      unfold leftSum
      congr 1
      apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
      intro k
      exact hfg (gridPoint a b n k)
    · rw [if_neg hab, if_neg hab]
      unfold leftSum
      congr 1
      congr 1
      apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
      intro k
      exact hfg (gridPoint b a n k)
  change RealTheory.SeqTendsto (orientedSum g a b) I
  rwa [← hsum]

name: hasIntegral_const
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_const
    {a b c : Point} :
    HasIntegral (fun _ : Point => c) a b
      (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hseq :
      orientedSum (fun _ : Point => c) a b =
        fun _ : Nat => F.mul c (F.sub b a) := by
    funext n
    unfold orientedSum
    by_cases hab : RealTheory.le a b
    · rw [if_pos hab]
      exact leftSum_const c a b n
    · rw [if_neg hab, leftSum_const]
      calc
        F.neg (F.mul c (F.sub a b)) =
            F.mul c (F.neg (F.sub a b)) := by rw [F.mul_neg]
        _ = F.mul c (F.sub b a) := by
            rw [← IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F]
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (orientedSum (fun _ : Point => c) a b)
      (F.mul c (F.sub b a))
  rw [hseq]
  exact RealTheory.seqTendsto_const (F.mul c (F.sub b a))

name: hasIntegral_neg
statement:
theorem hasIntegral_neg
    {f : Map} {a b I : Point}
    (hI : HasIntegral f a b I) :
    HasIntegral (RealFunction.NegFun f) a b (RealTheory.neg I)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hscale :
      HasIntegral
        (RealFunction.ScaleFun (F.neg F.one) f) a b
        (F.mul (F.neg F.one) I) :=
    scaleLinearity (F.neg F.one) f a b I hI
  have hval : F.mul (F.neg F.one) I = F.neg I :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_one_mul_eq_neg F I
  apply hasIntegral_congr_integrand
    (f := RealFunction.ScaleFun (F.neg F.one) f)
    (g := RealFunction.NegFun f)
  · intro x
    unfold RealFunction.ScaleFun RealFunction.NegFun
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_one_mul_eq_neg F (f x)
  · rwa [hval] at hscale

name: linearity
statement: theorem linearity : LinearityStatement
proof:
:=
  And.intro addLinearity scaleLinearity

name: abs_leftSum_sub_commonIndex_le_of_uniform_delta
statement:
theorem abs_leftSum_sub_commonIndex_le_of_uniform_delta
    {f : Map} {a b eta delta : Point} {n m : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hdelta :
      And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
        (forall x y : Point,
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y ->
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x y) delta ->
                RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (f x) (f y)) eta))
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (step a b n) delta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (leftSum f a b n)
          (leftSum f a b (commonIndex n m))))
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply abs_leftSum_sub_commonIndex_le_of_grid_bound
    (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (M := eta)
    hab (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heta)
  intro k j hk hj
  have hx :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (gridPoint a b n k) :=
    gridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_lt hab n k hk
  have hidx :
      refineIndex m k j < partitions (commonIndex n m) :=
    refineIndex_lt_common_partitions hk hj
  have hy :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b
        (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m) (refineIndex m k j)) :=
    gridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_lt hab
      (commonIndex n m) (refineIndex m k j) hidx
  have hdist_le :
      F.le
        (RealFunction.dist
          (gridPoint a b n k)
          (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m) (refineIndex m k j)))
        (step a b n) :=
    dist_gridPoint_refineIndex_le_step hab n m k j hj
  have hdist_lt_delta :
      F.lt
        (RealFunction.dist
          (gridPoint a b n k)
          (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m) (refineIndex m k j)))
        delta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hdist_le hmesh
  have hfclose :
      F.lt
        (RealFunction.dist
          (f (gridPoint a b n k))
          (f (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m) (refineIndex m k j))))
        eta :=
    hdelta.right
      (gridPoint a b n k)
      (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m) (refineIndex m k j))
      hx hy hdist_lt_delta
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.sub
          (f (gridPoint a b n k))
          (f (gridPoint a b (commonIndex n m) (refineIndex m k j)))))
      eta
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hfclose

name: abs_leftSum_sub_commonIndex_le_of_uniform
statement:
theorem abs_leftSum_sub_commonIndex_le_of_uniform
    {f : Map} {a b eta : Point} {n m : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf :
      RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hmesh :
      RealTheory.lt (step a b n)
        (Classical.choose (hf eta heta))) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (leftSum f a b n)
          (leftSum f a b (commonIndex n m))))
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta)
proof:
:= by
