    hab (Classical.choose_spec (hf eta heta)) heta hmesh

name: abs_leftSum_sub_leftSum_le_of_uniform
statement:
theorem abs_leftSum_sub_leftSum_le_of_uniform
    {f : Map} {a b eta : Point} {n m : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf :
      RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hmesh_n :
      RealTheory.lt (step a b n)
        (Classical.choose (hf eta heta)))
    (hmesh_m :
      RealTheory.lt (step a b m)
        (Classical.choose (hf eta heta))) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f a b n) (leftSum f a b m)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let c := commonIndex n m
  have htri :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f a b n) (leftSum f a b m)))
        (F.add
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f a b n) (leftSum f a b c)))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f a b c) (leftSum f a b m)))) :=
    RealFunction.dist_triangle
      (leftSum f a b n) (leftSum f a b c) (leftSum f a b m)
  have hn :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f a b n) (leftSum f a b c)))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta) := by
    unfold c
    exact abs_leftSum_sub_commonIndex_le_of_uniform
      hab hf heta hmesh_n
  have hm_raw :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub
            (leftSum f a b m)
            (leftSum f a b (commonIndex m n))))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta) :=
    abs_leftSum_sub_commonIndex_le_of_uniform
      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (eta := eta)
      (n := m) (m := n) hab hf heta hmesh_m
  have hm_same :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub
            (leftSum f a b m)
            (leftSum f a b c)))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta) := by
    unfold c
    rwa [commonIndex_comm m n] at hm_raw
  have hm :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f a b c) (leftSum f a b m)))
        (F.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta) := by
    change
      F.le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
          (F.sub (leftSum f a b c) (leftSum f a b m)))
        (F.mul (F.sub b a) eta)
    change
      F.le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
          (F.sub (leftSum f a b m) (leftSum f a b c)))
        (F.mul (F.sub b a) eta) at hm_same
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm
      F (leftSum f a b c) (leftSum f a b m)]
  have hsum :
      F.le
        (F.add
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f a b n) (leftSum f a b c)))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f a b c) (leftSum f a b m))))
        (F.add
          (F.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta)
          (F.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hn hm
  exact F.le_trans htri hsum

name: eventually_step_lt
statement:
theorem eventually_step_lt
    {a b delta : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.lt (step a b n) delta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := RealTheory.sub b a
  have hL_nonneg : F.le F.zero L := by
    unfold L
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hab
  cases RealTheory.linearArchimedeanPrinciple.large_nat_mul
      hL_nonneg hdelta with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have hN_le_succ : N <= n + 1 :=
        Nat.le_trans hn (Nat.le_succ n)
      have hnat_le :
          F.le (RealTheory.nat N) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) :=
        RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hN_le_succ
      have hmul_le :
          F.le
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat N) delta)
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) delta) :=
        F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hnat_le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hdelta)
      have hL_lt :
          F.lt L (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) delta) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hN hmul_le
      have hmul_lt :
          F.lt (F.mul (step a b n) (denom n))
            (F.mul delta (denom n)) := by
        have hstep := step_mul_denom a b n
        change
          F.mul (step a b n) (denom n) =
            F.sub b a at hstep
        rw [hstep]
        unfold L at hL_lt
        unfold denom partitions
        rw [F.mul_comm delta (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))]
        exact hL_lt
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right
        F hmul_lt (denom_pos n)

name: leftSum_seqCauchy_of_uniform_with_eta_choice
statement:
theorem leftSum_seqCauchy_of_uniform_with_eta_choice
    {f : Map} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf :
      RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hetaSmall :
      forall eps : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
          Exists
            (fun eta : Point =>
              And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta)
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta))
                  eps))) :
    RealTheory.SeqCauchy (leftSum f a b)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hetaSmall eps heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      let delta := Classical.choose (hf eta heta.left)
      have hdelta := Classical.choose_spec (hf eta heta.left)
      have hsteps := eventually_step_lt hab hdelta.left
      cases hsteps with
      | intro N hN =>
          refine Exists.intro N ?_
          intro n m hn hm
          have hnstep : F.lt (step a b n) delta := hN n hn
          have hmstep : F.lt (step a b m) delta := hN m hm
          have hle :
              F.le
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f a b n) (leftSum f a b m)))
                (F.add
                  (F.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta)
                  (F.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta)) :=
            abs_leftSum_sub_leftSum_le_of_uniform
              hab hf heta.left hnstep hmstep
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle heta.right

name: exists_eta_small_for_interval_length
statement:
theorem exists_eta_small_for_interval_length
    {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b) :
    forall eps : Point,
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
        Exists
          (fun eta : Point =>
            And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
              (RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta)
                  (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub b a) eta))
                eps))
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := F.sub b a
  let pad := F.add L F.one
  let two := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.two F
  let D := F.mul two pad
  let eta := F.mul eps (F.inv D)
  have hL_nonneg : F.le F.zero L := by
    unfold L
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hab
  have hL_lt_pad : F.lt L pad := by
    unfold pad
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
      F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one F) L
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have hpad_pos : F.lt F.zero pad :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hL_nonneg hL_lt_pad
  have htwo_pos : F.lt F.zero two := by
    unfold two
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_two F
  have hD_pos : F.lt F.zero D := by
    unfold D
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F htwo_pos hpad_pos
  have hD_ne : Not (D = F.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hD_pos h.symm
  have heta_pos : F.lt F.zero eta := by
    unfold eta
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F heps
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hD_pos)
  refine Exists.intro eta ?_
  refine And.intro heta_pos ?_
  have hfactor_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.mul two eta) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_pos F htwo_pos heta_pos
  have hscaled :
      F.lt (F.mul L (F.mul two eta))
        (F.mul pad (F.mul two eta)) :=
    F.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hL_lt_pad hfactor_pos
  have hleft :
      F.add (F.mul L eta) (F.mul L eta) =
        F.mul L (F.mul two eta) := by
    have heta_two : F.add eta eta = F.mul two eta := by
      change F.add eta eta = F.mul (F.add F.one F.one) eta
      rw [F.add_mul]
      rw [F.one_mul]
    calc
      F.add (F.mul L eta) (F.mul L eta) =
          F.mul L (F.add eta eta) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]
      _ = F.mul L (F.mul two eta) := by
          rw [heta_two]
  have hright :
      F.mul pad (F.mul two eta) = eps := by
    calc
      F.mul pad (F.mul two eta) =
          F.mul (F.mul pad two) eta := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.mul two pad) eta := by
          rw [F.mul_comm pad two]
      _ = F.mul D eta := by rfl
      _ = F.mul D (F.mul eps (F.inv D)) := by rfl
      _ = F.mul eps (F.mul D (F.inv D)) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
          rw [F.mul_comm D eps]
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul eps F.one := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hD_ne]
      _ = eps := by rw [F.mul_one]
  change
    F.lt
      (F.add (F.mul (F.sub b a) eta) (F.mul (F.sub b a) eta))
      eps
  unfold L at hleft
  unfold L at hscaled
  rwa [<- hleft, hright] at hscaled

statement:

    {f : Map} {a b : Point}

name: seqCauchy_neg
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hu eps heps with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n m hn hm
      have h := hN n m hn hm
      change
        F.lt
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
            (F.sub (F.neg (u n)) (F.neg (u m)))) eps
      simpa [
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F (u n) (u m),
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_neg F (F.sub (u n) (u m))
      ] using h

name: integrable_ordered_of_continuousOn
statement:
theorem integrable_ordered_of_continuousOn
    {f : Map} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf :
      RealFunction.ContinuousOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f) :
    Integrable f a b
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_of_seqCauchy
  have hcauchy := leftSum_seqCauchy_of_continuousOn hab hf
  have horient :
      orientedSum f a b = leftSum f a b := by
    funext n
    unfold orientedSum
    rw [if_pos hab]
  rw [horient]
  exact hcauchy

name: continuousOnSegment_integrable
statement:
theorem continuousOnSegment_integrable
    {f : Map} {a b : Point}
    (hf : ContinuousOnSegment f a b) :
    Integrable f a b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hab : RealTheory.le a b
  · exact integrable_ordered_of_continuousOn hab (hf.left hab)
  · have hba : RealTheory.le b a := by
      cases RealTheory.le_total a b with
      | inl hab' => exact False.elim (hab hab')
      | inr hba' => exact hba'
    apply integrable_of_seqCauchy
    have hcauchy :=
      leftSum_seqCauchy_of_continuousOn hba (hf.right hba)
    have hneg :
        RealTheory.SeqCauchy
          (fun n : Nat => RealTheory.neg (leftSum f b a n)) :=
      seqCauchy_neg hcauchy
    have horient :
        orientedSum f a b =
          fun n : Nat => RealTheory.neg (leftSum f b a n) := by
      funext n
      unfold orientedSum
      rw [if_neg hab]
    rw [horient]
    exact hneg

name: abs_le_of_order_bounds
statement:
private theorem abs_le_of_order_bounds
    {left right y : Point}
    (hleft : RealTheory.le left y)
    (hright : RealTheory.le y right) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs y)
      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs left) (RealTheory.abs right))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let B := F.add (RealTheory.abs left) (RealTheory.abs right)
  have hleft_le_abs_left : F.le left (RealTheory.abs left) :=
    RealTheory.le_abs_self left
  have hright_le_abs_right : F.le right (RealTheory.abs right) :=
    RealTheory.le_abs_self right
  have h_abs_left_le_B : F.le (RealTheory.abs left) B := by
    unfold B
    have hnonneg : F.le F.zero (RealTheory.abs right) :=
      RealTheory.abs_nonneg right
    have h := F.add_le_add_left hnonneg (RealTheory.abs left)
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  have h_abs_right_le_B : F.le (RealTheory.abs right) B := by
    unfold B
    have hnonneg : F.le F.zero (RealTheory.abs left) :=
      RealTheory.abs_nonneg left
    have h := F.add_le_add_right hnonneg (RealTheory.abs right)
    rwa [F.zero_add] at h
  have hy_le_B : F.le y B :=
    F.le_trans hright (F.le_trans hright_le_abs_right h_abs_right_le_B)
  have hneg_y_le_B : F.le (F.neg y) B := by
    have hneg_left_le_neg_y : F.le (F.neg y) (F.neg left) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg F hleft
    have hneg_left_le_abs_left : F.le (F.neg left) (RealTheory.abs left) :=
      RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self left
    exact F.le_trans hneg_left_le_neg_y
      (F.le_trans hneg_left_le_abs_left h_abs_left_le_B)
  change F.le (RealTheory.abs y) B
  exact RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hy_le_B hneg_y_le_B

name: boundedOn_abs_bound
statement:
private theorem boundedOn_abs_bound
    {E : RealFunction.Domain} {f : Map}
    (hbdd : RealFunction.BoundedOn E f) :
    Exists
      (fun M : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
          (forall x : Point, E x ->
            RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) M))
proof:
:= by
  cases hbdd with
  | intro left hleft =>
      cases hleft with
      | intro right hright =>
          let M := RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs left) (RealTheory.abs right)
          refine Exists.intro M ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · unfold M
            let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            have hsum :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
                F
                (RealTheory.abs_nonneg left)
                (RealTheory.abs_nonneg right)
            change
              F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero)
                (F.add (RealTheory.abs left) (RealTheory.abs right)) at hsum
            rwa [F.add_zero] at hsum
          · intro x hx
            exact abs_le_of_order_bounds (hright x hx).left (hright x hx).right

name: sub_sub_same_right
statement:
private theorem sub_sub_same_right
    (x y a : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub y a) (RealTheory.sub x a) =
      RealTheory.sub y x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.sub (F.sub y a) (F.sub x a) = F.sub y x
  calc
    F.sub (F.sub y a) (F.sub x a) =
        F.sub (F.add y (F.neg a)) (F.add x (F.neg a)) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg y a]
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg x a]
    _ = F.add (F.sub y x) (F.sub (F.neg a) (F.neg a)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
            F y (F.neg a) x (F.neg a)]
    _ = F.add (F.sub y x) F.zero := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F (F.neg a)]
    _ = F.sub y x := by
          rw [F.add_zero]

name: step_sub_same_lower
statement:
private theorem step_sub_same_lower
    (a x y : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.sub (step a y n) (step a x n) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub y x) (RealTheory.inv (denom n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold step
  change
    F.sub
      (F.mul (F.sub y a) (F.inv (denom n)))
      (F.mul (F.sub x a) (F.inv (denom n))) =
      F.mul (F.sub y x) (F.inv (denom n))
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
    F (F.sub y a) (F.sub x a) (F.inv (denom n))]
  have hsub : F.sub (F.sub y a) (F.sub x a) = F.sub y x :=
    sub_sub_same_right x y a
  rw [hsub]

name: sub_sub_same_left
statement:
private theorem sub_sub_same_left
    (c x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub c y) (RealTheory.sub c x) =
      RealTheory.sub x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.sub (F.sub c y) (F.sub c x) = F.sub x y
  calc
    F.sub (F.sub c y) (F.sub c x) =
        F.sub (F.add c (F.neg y)) (F.add c (F.neg x)) := by
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg c y]
          rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg c x]
    _ = F.add (F.sub c c) (F.sub (F.neg y) (F.neg x)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
            F c (F.neg y) c (F.neg x)]
    _ = F.add F.zero (F.sub (F.neg y) (F.neg x)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F c]
    _ = F.sub (F.neg y) (F.neg x) := by
          rw [F.zero_add]
    _ = F.sub x y := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F y x]
          exact Eq.symm
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F y x)

name: step_sub_same_upper
statement:
private theorem step_sub_same_upper
    (c x y : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.sub (step y c n) (step x c n) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x y) (RealTheory.inv (denom n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold step
  change
    F.sub
      (F.mul (F.sub c y) (F.inv (denom n)))
      (F.mul (F.sub c x) (F.inv (denom n))) =
      F.mul (F.sub x y) (F.inv (denom n))
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
    F (F.sub c y) (F.sub c x) (F.inv (denom n))]
  have hsub : F.sub (F.sub c y) (F.sub c x) = F.sub x y :=
    sub_sub_same_left c x y
  rw [hsub]

name: gridPoint_sub_same_lower
statement:
private theorem gridPoint_sub_same_lower
    (a x y : Point) (n k : Nat) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (gridPoint a y n k)
        (gridPoint a x n k) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub y x) (RealTheory.inv (denom n)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold gridPoint
  change
    F.sub
      (F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step a y n)))
      (F.add a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step a x n))) =
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
        (F.mul (F.sub y x) (F.inv (denom n)))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
    F a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step a y n))
      a (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step a x n))]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F a]
  rw [F.zero_add]
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
    F (RealTheory.nat k) (step a y n) (step a x n)]
  have hstep :
      F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n) =
        F.mul (F.sub y x) (F.inv (denom n)) :=
    step_sub_same_lower a x y n
  rw [hstep]

name: gridPoint_dist_same_lower_le_endpoint_dist
statement:
private theorem gridPoint_dist_same_lower_le_endpoint_dist
    (a x y : Point) (n k : Nat)
    (hk : k < partitions n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealFunction.dist (gridPoint a x n k) (gridPoint a y n k))
      (RealFunction.dist x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let coeff := F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (F.inv (denom n))
  have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv (denom n)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (denom_pos n)
  have hcoeff_nonneg : F.le F.zero coeff := by
    unfold coeff
    exact F.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg k)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinv_pos)
  have hk_le : k <= partitions n := Nat.le_of_lt hk
  have hnat_le :
      F.le (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (partitions n)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hk_le
  have hcoeff_le_one : F.le coeff F.one := by
    have h :=
      F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hnat_le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinv_pos)
    unfold coeff
    change
      F.le
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (F.inv (denom n)))
        (F.mul (denom n) (F.inv (denom n))) at h
    rwa [F.mul_inv_cancel (denom_ne_zero n)] at h
  change
    F.le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
        (F.sub (gridPoint a x n k) (gridPoint a y n k)))
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F (F.sub x y))
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm
    F (gridPoint a x n k) (gridPoint a y n k)]
  have hgrid :
      F.sub (gridPoint a y n k) (gridPoint a x n k) =
        F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
          (F.mul (F.sub y x) (F.inv (denom n))) :=
    gridPoint_sub_same_lower a x y n k
  rw [hgrid]
  have hmul_shape :
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
          (F.mul (F.sub y x) (F.inv (denom n))) =
        F.mul coeff (F.sub y x) := by
    unfold coeff
    calc
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
          (F.mul (F.sub y x) (F.inv (denom n))) =
          F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
            (F.mul (F.inv (denom n)) (F.sub y x)) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub y x) (F.inv (denom n))]
      _ = F.mul
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (F.inv (denom n)))
            (F.sub y x) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
  rw [hmul_shape]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_mul F coeff (F.sub y x)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg F hcoeff_nonneg]
  have hmain :
      F.le
        (F.mul coeff (RealTheory.abs (F.sub y x)))
        (F.mul F.one (RealTheory.abs (F.sub y x))) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hcoeff_le_one
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (F.sub y x))
  rw [F.one_mul] at hmain
  change
    F.le
      (F.mul coeff (RealTheory.abs (F.sub y x)))
      (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x y))
  rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm y x]
  rwa [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm y x] at hmain

name: abs_step_sub_same_lower_mul_denom
statement:
private theorem abs_step_sub_same_lower_mul_denom
    (a x y : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)))
        (denom n) =
      RealFunction.dist x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hstep :
      F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n) =
        F.mul (F.sub y x) (F.inv (denom n)) :=
    step_sub_same_lower a x y n
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  change
    F.mul (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)))
        (denom n) =
      RealTheory.abs (F.sub x y)
  rw [hstep]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv (denom n)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (denom_pos n))
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hinv_nonneg]
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (RealTheory.abs (F.sub y x)) (F.inv (denom n)))
        (denom n) =
        F.mul (RealTheory.abs (F.sub y x))
          (F.mul (F.inv (denom n)) (denom n)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (RealTheory.abs (F.sub y x)) F.one := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel (denom_ne_zero n)]
    _ = RealTheory.abs (F.sub y x) := by
          rw [F.mul_one]
    _ = RealTheory.abs (F.sub x y) := by
          rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm y x]

name: abs_step_sub_same_upper_mul_denom
statement:
private theorem abs_step_sub_same_upper_mul_denom
    (c x y : Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)))
        (denom n) =
      RealFunction.dist x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hstep :
      F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n) =
        F.mul (F.sub x y) (F.inv (denom n)) :=
    step_sub_same_upper c x y n
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  change
    F.mul (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)))
        (denom n) =
      RealTheory.abs (F.sub x y)
  rw [hstep]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
  have hinv_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.inv (denom n)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (denom_pos n))
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hinv_nonneg]
  calc
    F.mul
        (F.mul (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x y)) (F.inv (denom n)))
        (denom n) =
        F.mul (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x y))
          (F.mul (F.inv (denom n)) (denom n)) := by
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x y)) F.one := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel (denom_ne_zero n)]
    _ = RealTheory.abs (F.sub x y) := by
          rw [F.mul_one]

name: abs_step_upper_sub_mul_finiteSum_le
statement:
private theorem abs_step_upper_sub_mul_finiteSum_le
    {term : Nat -> Point} {M : Point}
    (c x y : Point) (n : Nat)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (hbound :
      forall k : Nat, k < partitions n ->
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (term k)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (step y c n) (step x c n))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum term (partitions n))))
      (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsum :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum term (partitions n)))
        (F.mul (denom n) M) := by
    unfold denom
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_abs_le term hM_nonneg
      (partitions n) hbound
  have hstep_abs_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero
        (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n))) :=
    RealTheory.abs_nonneg (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n))
  have hmul :
      F.le
        (F.mul
          (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)))
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum term (partitions n))))
        (F.mul
          (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)))
          (F.mul (denom n) M)) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hsum hstep_abs_nonneg
  change
    F.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (F.mul
          (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum term (partitions n))))
      (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
  rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
  have htarget :
      F.mul
          (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)))
          (F.mul (denom n) M) =
        F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M := by
    calc
      F.mul
          (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)))
          (F.mul (denom n) M) =
          F.mul
            (F.mul
              (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)))
              (denom n))
            M := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M := by
            have habs :
                F.mul
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)))
                    (denom n) =
                  RealFunction.dist x y :=
              abs_step_sub_same_upper_mul_denom c x y n
            rw [habs]
  rwa [htarget] at hmul

name: dist_add_right
statement:
private theorem dist_add_right (x y z : Point) :
    RealFunction.dist
        (RealTheory.add x z) (RealTheory.add y z) =
      RealFunction.dist x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
  change
    RealTheory.abs (F.sub (F.add x z) (F.add y z)) =
      RealTheory.abs (F.sub x y)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F x z y z]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F z]
  rw [F.add_zero]

name: dist_add_left
statement:
private theorem dist_add_left (x y z : Point) :
    RealFunction.dist
        (RealTheory.add z x) (RealTheory.add z y) =
      RealFunction.dist x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealTheory.add_comm z x, RealTheory.add_comm z y]
  exact dist_add_right x y z

name: scaled_step_same_upper_dist_le_endpoint_dist
statement:
private theorem scaled_step_same_upper_dist_le_endpoint_dist
    (c x y : Point) (n k : Nat)
    (hk : k < partitions n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealFunction.dist
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step y c n))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step x c n)))
      (RealFunction.dist x y)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let coeff := F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (F.inv (denom n))
  have hinv_pos : F.lt F.zero (F.inv (denom n)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F (denom_pos n)
  have hcoeff_nonneg : F.le F.zero coeff := by
    unfold coeff
    exact F.mul_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg k)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinv_pos)
  have hk_le : k <= partitions n := Nat.le_of_lt hk
  have hnat_le :
      F.le (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (partitions n)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le hk_le
  have hcoeff_le_one : F.le coeff F.one := by
    have h :=
      F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hnat_le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hinv_pos)
    unfold coeff
    change
      F.le
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (F.inv (denom n)))
        (F.mul (denom n) (F.inv (denom n))) at h
    rwa [F.mul_inv_cancel (denom_ne_zero n)] at h
  change
    F.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (F.sub
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step y c n))
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step x c n))))
      (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x y))
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
    F (RealTheory.nat k) (step y c n) (step x c n)]
  have hstep :
      F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n) =
        F.mul (F.sub x y) (F.inv (denom n)) :=
    step_sub_same_upper c x y n
  rw [hstep]
  have hmul_shape :
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
          (F.mul (F.sub x y) (F.inv (denom n))) =
        F.mul coeff (F.sub x y) := by
    unfold coeff
    calc
      F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
          (F.mul (F.sub x y) (F.inv (denom n))) =
          F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
            (F.mul (F.inv (denom n)) (F.sub x y)) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub x y) (F.inv (denom n))]
      _ = F.mul
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (F.inv (denom n)))
            (F.sub x y) := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
  rw [hmul_shape]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hcoeff_nonneg]
  have hmain :
      F.le
        (F.mul coeff (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x y)))
        (F.mul F.one (RealTheory.abs (F.sub x y))) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hcoeff_le_one
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (F.sub x y))
  rwa [F.one_mul] at hmain

name: gridPoint_dist_same_upper_le_two_endpoint_dist
statement:
private theorem gridPoint_dist_same_upper_le_two_endpoint_dist
    (c x y : Point) (n k : Nat)
    (hk : k < partitions n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealFunction.dist (gridPoint y c n k) (gridPoint x c n k))
      (RealTheory.add (RealFunction.dist x y) (RealFunction.dist x y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let oy := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step y c n)
  let ox := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step x c n)
  let mid := RealTheory.add y ox
  have htri :
      F.le
        (RealFunction.dist (gridPoint y c n k) (gridPoint x c n k))
        (F.add
          (RealFunction.dist (gridPoint y c n k) mid)
          (RealFunction.dist mid (gridPoint x c n k))) := by
    change
      F.le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (gridPoint y c n k) (gridPoint x c n k))
        (F.add
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (gridPoint y c n k) mid)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F mid (gridPoint x c n k)))
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle
      F (gridPoint y c n k) mid (gridPoint x c n k)
  have hfirst :
      F.le (RealFunction.dist (gridPoint y c n k) mid)
        (RealFunction.dist x y) := by
    unfold gridPoint mid ox
    change
      F.le
        (RealFunction.dist
          (RealTheory.add y
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step y c n)))
          (RealTheory.add y
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step x c n))))
        (RealFunction.dist x y)
    rw [dist_add_left
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step y c n))
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step x c n)) y]
    exact scaled_step_same_upper_dist_le_endpoint_dist c x y n k hk
  have hsecond :
      F.le (RealFunction.dist mid (gridPoint x c n k))
        (RealFunction.dist x y) := by
    unfold gridPoint mid ox
    change
      F.le
        (RealFunction.dist
          (RealTheory.add y
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step x c n)))
          (RealTheory.add x
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step x c n))))
        (RealFunction.dist x y)
    rw [dist_add_right y x
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat k) (step x c n))]
    rw [RealFunction.dist_comm y x]
    exact F.le_refl (RealFunction.dist x y)
  have hsum :
      F.le
        (F.add
          (RealFunction.dist (gridPoint y c n k) mid)
          (RealFunction.dist mid (gridPoint x c n k)))
        (F.add (RealFunction.dist x y) (RealFunction.dist x y)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hfirst hsecond
  exact F.le_trans htri hsum

name: abs_step_sub_mul_finiteSum_le
statement:
private theorem abs_step_sub_mul_finiteSum_le
    {term : Nat -> Point} {M : Point}
    (a x y : Point) (n : Nat)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (hbound :
      forall k : Nat, k < partitions n ->
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (term k)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (step a y n) (step a x n))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum term (partitions n))))
      (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsum :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum term (partitions n)))
        (F.mul (denom n) M) := by
    unfold denom
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_abs_le term hM_nonneg
      (partitions n) hbound
  have hstep_abs_nonneg :
      F.le F.zero
        (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n))) :=
    RealTheory.abs_nonneg (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n))
  have hmul :
      F.le
        (F.mul
          (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)))
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum term (partitions n))))
        (F.mul
          (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)))
          (F.mul (denom n) M)) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hsum hstep_abs_nonneg
  change
    F.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (F.mul
          (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum term (partitions n))))
      (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
  rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
  have htarget :
      F.mul
          (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)))
          (F.mul (denom n) M) =
        F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M := by
    calc
      F.mul
          (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)))
          (F.mul (denom n) M) =
          F.mul
            (F.mul
              (RealTheory.abs (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)))
              (denom n))
            M := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M := by
            have habs :
                F.mul
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)))
                    (denom n) =
                  RealFunction.dist x y :=
              abs_step_sub_same_lower_mul_denom a x y n
            rw [habs]
  rwa [htarget] at hmul

name: abs_step_mul_finiteSum_le
statement:
private theorem abs_step_mul_finiteSum_le
    {term : Nat -> Point} {M : Point}
    (a x : Point) (n : Nat)
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (hbound :
      forall k : Nat, k < partitions n ->
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (term k)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.mul (step a x n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum term (partitions n))))
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x a) M)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsum :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum term (partitions n)))
        (F.mul (denom n) M) := by
    unfold denom
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_abs_le term hM_nonneg
      (partitions n) hbound
  have hs_nonneg : F.le F.zero (step a x n) :=
    step_nonneg_of_le hax n
  have hmul :
      F.le
        (F.mul (step a x n)
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum term (partitions n))))
        (F.mul (step a x n) (F.mul (denom n) M)) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hsum hs_nonneg
  change
    F.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (F.mul (step a x n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum term (partitions n))))
      (F.mul (F.sub x a) M)
  rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hs_nonneg]
  have htarget :
      F.mul (step a x n) (F.mul (denom n) M) =
        F.mul (F.sub x a) M := by
    calc
      F.mul (step a x n) (F.mul (denom n) M) =
          F.mul (F.mul (step a x n) (denom n)) M := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul (F.sub x a) M := by
          have hstep :
              F.mul (step a x n) (denom n) = F.sub x a :=
            step_mul_denom a x n
          rw [hstep]
  rwa [htarget] at hmul

name: leftSum_upper_endpoint_same_partition_bound
statement:
private theorem leftSum_upper_endpoint_same_partition_bound
    {f : Map} {a x y M eta : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (heta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hM :
      forall k : Nat, k < partitions n ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs (f (gridPoint a y n k))) M)
    (heta :
      forall k : Nat, k < partitions n ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (f (gridPoint a y n k))
              (f (gridPoint a x n k))))
          eta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f a y n) (leftSum f a x n)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x a) eta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let sumY : Point :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a y n k)) (partitions n)
  let sumX : Point :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a x n k)) (partitions n)
  let diff : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.sub
        (f (gridPoint a y n k))
        (f (gridPoint a x n k))
  have hsum_sub :
      F.sub sumY sumX = RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n) := by
    unfold sumY sumX diff
    let u : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a y n k)
    let v : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a x n k)
    have h := RealTheory.finiteSum_sub u v (partitions n)
    change
      RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => F.sub (u k) (v k)) (partitions n) =
        F.sub (RealTheory.finiteSum u (partitions n))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum v (partitions n)) at h
    exact h.symm
  have hdecomp :
      F.sub (leftSum f a y n) (leftSum f a x n) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)) sumY)
          (F.mul (step a x n) (RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n))) := by
    unfold leftSum
    change
      F.sub
        (F.mul (step a y n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a y n k)) (partitions n)))
        (F.mul (step a x n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a x n k)) (partitions n))) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)) sumY)
          (F.mul (step a x n) (RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n)))
    unfold sumY
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub
      F (step a y n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a y n k)) (partitions n))
        (step a x n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a x n k)) (partitions n))]
    rw [<- hsum_sub]
  have htri :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (F.sub (leftSum f a y n) (leftSum f a x n)))
        (F.add
          (RealTheory.abs
            (F.mul (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)) sumY))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (F.mul (step a x n)
              (RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n))))) := by
    rw [hdecomp]
    exact RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
      (F.mul (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)) sumY)
      (F.mul (step a x n) (RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n)))
  have hfirst :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (F.mul (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)) sumY))
        (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M) := by
    unfold sumY
    exact abs_step_sub_mul_finiteSum_le
      (term := fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint a y n k))
      (M := M) a x y n hM_nonneg hM
  have hsecond :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (F.mul (step a x n)
            (RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n))))
        (F.mul (F.sub x a) eta) := by
    exact abs_step_mul_finiteSum_le
      (term := diff) (M := eta) a x n
      hax heta_nonneg heta
  have hsum :
      F.le
        (F.add
          (RealTheory.abs
            (F.mul (F.sub (step a y n) (step a x n)) sumY))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (F.mul (step a x n)
              (RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n)))))
        (F.add
          (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
          (F.mul (F.sub x a) eta)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hfirst hsecond
  exact F.le_trans htri hsum

name: leftSum_upper_endpoint_same_partition_uniform_bound
statement:
private theorem leftSum_upper_endpoint_same_partition_uniform_bound
    {f : Map} {a c x y M eta delta : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c y)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (heta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hM :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M)
    (hdelta :
      forall u v : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c u ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c v ->
            RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist u v) delta ->
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (f u) (f v)) eta)
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x y) delta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f a y n) (leftSum f a x n)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub c a) eta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have heta_nonneg : F.le F.zero eta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heta_pos
  have hbase :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (F.sub (leftSum f a y n) (leftSum f a x n)))
        (F.add
          (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
          (F.mul (F.sub x a) eta)) := by
    apply leftSum_upper_endpoint_same_partition_bound
      (f := f) (a := a) (x := x) (y := y)
      (M := M) (eta := eta) (n := n)
      hx.left hM_nonneg heta_nonneg
    · intro k hk
      have hgy_small :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a y (gridPoint a y n k) :=
        gridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_lt hy.left n k hk
      have hgy :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c (gridPoint a y n k) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset
          F (F.le_refl a) hy.right
          (gridPoint a y n k) hgy_small
      exact hM (gridPoint a y n k) hgy
    · intro k hk
      have hgx_small :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a x (gridPoint a x n k) :=
        gridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_lt hx.left n k hk
      have hgy_small :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a y (gridPoint a y n k) :=
        gridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_lt hy.left n k hk
      have hgx :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c (gridPoint a x n k) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset
          F (F.le_refl a) hx.right
          (gridPoint a x n k) hgx_small
      have hgy :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c (gridPoint a y n k) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset
          F (F.le_refl a) hy.right
          (gridPoint a y n k) hgy_small
      have hdist_le :
          F.le
            (RealFunction.dist
              (gridPoint a y n k) (gridPoint a x n k))
            (RealFunction.dist x y) := by
        rw [RealFunction.dist_comm (gridPoint a y n k) (gridPoint a x n k)]
        exact gridPoint_dist_same_lower_le_endpoint_dist a x y n k hk
      have hdist_lt :
          F.lt
            (RealFunction.dist
              (gridPoint a y n k) (gridPoint a x n k))
            delta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hdist_le hxy
      have hclose := hdelta
        (gridPoint a y n k) (gridPoint a x n k)
        hgy hgx hdist_lt
      change
        F.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (F.sub
              (f (gridPoint a y n k))
              (f (gridPoint a x n k))))
          eta
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hclose
  have hlen :
      F.le (F.sub x a) (F.sub c a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F hx.right (F.le_refl a)
  have hlen_mul :
      F.le (F.mul (F.sub x a) eta)
        (F.mul (F.sub c a) eta) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hlen heta_nonneg
  have hadd :
      F.le
        (F.add
          (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
          (F.mul (F.sub x a) eta))
        (F.add
          (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
          (F.mul (F.sub c a) eta)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
      F hlen_mul (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
  exact F.le_trans hbase hadd

name: leftSum_lower_endpoint_same_partition_bound
statement:
private theorem leftSum_lower_endpoint_same_partition_bound
    {f : Map} {c x y M eta : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hxc : RealTheory.le x c)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (heta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hM :
      forall k : Nat, k < partitions n ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs (f (gridPoint y c n k))) M)
    (heta :
      forall k : Nat, k < partitions n ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (f (gridPoint y c n k))
              (f (gridPoint x c n k))))
          eta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f y c n) (leftSum f x c n)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub c x) eta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let sumY : Point :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint y c n k)) (partitions n)
  let sumX : Point :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint x c n k)) (partitions n)
  let diff : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.sub
        (f (gridPoint y c n k))
        (f (gridPoint x c n k))
  have hsum_sub :
      F.sub sumY sumX = RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n) := by
    unfold sumY sumX diff
    let u : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint y c n k)
    let v : Nat -> Point := fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint x c n k)
    have h := RealTheory.finiteSum_sub u v (partitions n)
    change
      RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => F.sub (u k) (v k)) (partitions n) =
        F.sub (RealTheory.finiteSum u (partitions n))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum v (partitions n)) at h
    exact h.symm
  have hdecomp :
      F.sub (leftSum f y c n) (leftSum f x c n) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)) sumY)
          (F.mul (step x c n) (RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n))) := by
    unfold leftSum
    change
      F.sub
        (F.mul (step y c n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint y c n k)) (partitions n)))
        (F.mul (step x c n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint x c n k)) (partitions n))) =
        F.add
          (F.mul (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)) sumY)
          (F.mul (step x c n) (RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n)))
    unfold sumY
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub
      F (step y c n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint y c n k)) (partitions n))
        (step x c n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint x c n k)) (partitions n))]
    rw [<- hsum_sub]
  have htri :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (F.sub (leftSum f y c n) (leftSum f x c n)))
        (F.add
          (RealTheory.abs
            (F.mul (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)) sumY))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (F.mul (step x c n)
              (RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n))))) := by
    rw [hdecomp]
    exact RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
      (F.mul (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)) sumY)
      (F.mul (step x c n) (RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n)))
  have hfirst :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (F.mul (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)) sumY))
        (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M) := by
    unfold sumY
    exact abs_step_upper_sub_mul_finiteSum_le
      (term := fun k : Nat => f (gridPoint y c n k))
      (M := M) c x y n hM_nonneg hM
  have hsecond :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (F.mul (step x c n)
            (RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n))))
        (F.mul (F.sub c x) eta) := by
    exact abs_step_mul_finiteSum_le
      (term := diff) (M := eta) x c n
      hxc heta_nonneg heta
  have hsum :
      F.le
        (F.add
          (RealTheory.abs
            (F.mul (F.sub (step y c n) (step x c n)) sumY))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (F.mul (step x c n)
              (RealTheory.finiteSum diff (partitions n)))))
        (F.add
          (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
          (F.mul (F.sub c x) eta)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hfirst hsecond
  exact F.le_trans htri hsum

name: leftSum_lower_endpoint_same_partition_uniform_bound
statement:
private theorem leftSum_lower_endpoint_same_partition_uniform_bound
    {f : Map} {a c x y M eta delta : Point} {n : Nat}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c y)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (heta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hM :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M)
    (hdelta :
      forall u v : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c u ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c v ->
            RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist u v) delta ->
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (f u) (f v)) eta)
    (hxy2 :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add (RealFunction.dist x y) (RealFunction.dist x y))
        delta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub (leftSum f y c n) (leftSum f x c n)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub c a) eta))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have heta_nonneg : F.le F.zero eta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heta_pos
  have hbase :
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (F.sub (leftSum f y c n) (leftSum f x c n)))
        (F.add
          (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
          (F.mul (F.sub c x) eta)) := by
    apply leftSum_lower_endpoint_same_partition_bound
      (f := f) (c := c) (x := x) (y := y)
      (M := M) (eta := eta) (n := n)
      hx.right hM_nonneg heta_nonneg
    · intro k hk
      have hgy_small :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval y c (gridPoint y c n k) :=
        gridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_lt hy.right n k hk
      have hgy :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c (gridPoint y c n k) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset
          F hy.left (F.le_refl c)
          (gridPoint y c n k) hgy_small
      exact hM (gridPoint y c n k) hgy
    · intro k hk
      have hgx_small :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval x c (gridPoint x c n k) :=
        gridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_lt hx.right n k hk
      have hgy_small :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval y c (gridPoint y c n k) :=
        gridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_lt hy.right n k hk
      have hgx :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c (gridPoint x c n k) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset
          F hx.left (F.le_refl c)
          (gridPoint x c n k) hgx_small
      have hgy :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c (gridPoint y c n k) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closedInterval_subset
          F hy.left (F.le_refl c)
          (gridPoint y c n k) hgy_small
      have hdist_le :
          F.le
            (RealFunction.dist
              (gridPoint y c n k) (gridPoint x c n k))
            (F.add (RealFunction.dist x y) (RealFunction.dist x y)) :=
        gridPoint_dist_same_upper_le_two_endpoint_dist c x y n k hk
      have hdist_lt :
          F.lt
            (RealFunction.dist
              (gridPoint y c n k) (gridPoint x c n k))
            delta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hdist_le hxy2
      have hclose := hdelta
        (gridPoint y c n k) (gridPoint x c n k)
        hgy hgx hdist_lt
      change
        F.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (F.sub
              (f (gridPoint y c n k))
              (f (gridPoint x c n k))))
          eta
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hclose
  have hlen :
      F.le (F.sub c x) (F.sub c a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
      F (F.le_refl c) hx.left
  have hlen_mul :
      F.le (F.mul (F.sub c x) eta)
        (F.mul (F.sub c a) eta) :=
    F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hlen heta_nonneg
  have hadd :
      F.le
        (F.add
          (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
          (F.mul (F.sub c x) eta))
        (F.add
          (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
          (F.mul (F.sub c a) eta)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left
      F hlen_mul (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x y) M)
  exact F.le_trans hbase hadd

name: hasIntegral_ordered_leftSum_eventually
statement:
private theorem hasIntegral_ordered_leftSum_eventually
    {f : Map} {a b I eps : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasIntegral f a b I)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    RealTheory.Eventually
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (leftSum f a b n) I) eps)
proof:
:= by
  cases hI eps heps with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have h := hN n hn
      change
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub (orientedSum f a b n) I)) eps at h
      unfold orientedSum at h
      rw [if_pos hab] at h
      change
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealFunction.dist (leftSum f a b n) I) eps
      exact h

name: dist_le_three
statement:
private theorem dist_le_three
    (w x y z : Point) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealFunction.dist w z)
      (RealTheory.add (RealFunction.dist w x)
        (RealTheory.add (RealFunction.dist x y)
          (RealFunction.dist y z)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h1 :
      F.le (RealFunction.dist w z)
        (F.add (RealFunction.dist w y) (RealFunction.dist y z)) := by
    change
      F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F w z)
        (F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F w y)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F y z))
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle F w y z
  have h2 :
      F.le (RealFunction.dist w y)
        (F.add (RealFunction.dist w x) (RealFunction.dist x y)) := by
    change
      F.le (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F w y)
        (F.add (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F w x)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x y))
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_triangle F w x y
  have h2add :
      F.le
        (F.add (RealFunction.dist w y) (RealFunction.dist y z))
        (F.add
          (F.add (RealFunction.dist w x) (RealFunction.dist x y))
          (RealFunction.dist y z)) :=
    F.add_le_add_right h2 (RealFunction.dist y z)
  have hassoc :
      F.add
          (F.add (RealFunction.dist w x) (RealFunction.dist x y))
          (RealFunction.dist y z) =
      F.add (RealFunction.dist w x)
        (F.add (RealFunction.dist x y) (RealFunction.dist y z)) := by
    rw [F.add_assoc]
  exact F.le_trans h1 (by rwa [hassoc] at h2add)

name: upperEndpointContinuity_core
statement:
private theorem upperEndpointContinuity_core
    {f : Map} {a c x x0 Ix I0 M eta rho deltaU eps : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x0)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (hM :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M)
    (heta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hLeta :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub c a) eta)
        (RealTheory.quarter eps))
    (hrho :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul M rho)
        (RealTheory.quarter eps))
    (hdelta :
      forall u v : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c u ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c v ->
            RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist u v) deltaU ->
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (f u) (f v)) eta)
    (hxdU : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x0 x) deltaU)
    (hxdrho : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x0 x) rho)
    (hIx : HasIntegral f a x Ix)
    (hI0 : HasIntegral f a x0 I0)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist Ix I0) eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e4 := RealTheory.quarter eps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he4 : F.lt F.zero e4 :=
    RealTheory.quarter_pos heps
  have he2 : F.lt F.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hasIntegral_ordered_leftSum_eventually hx.left hIx he4 with
  | intro NX hNX =>
      cases hasIntegral_ordered_leftSum_eventually hx0.left hI0 he4 with
      | intro N0 hN0 =>
          let N := Nat.max NX N0
          let SX := leftSum f a x N
          let S0 := leftSum f a x0 N
          have hNXN : NX <= N := Nat.le_max_left NX N0
          have hN0N : N0 <= N := Nat.le_max_right NX N0
          have hIx_close_raw :
              F.lt (RealFunction.dist SX Ix) e4 := by
            unfold SX
            exact hNX N hNXN
          have hIx_close :
              F.lt (RealFunction.dist Ix SX) e4 := by
            rwa [RealFunction.dist_comm Ix SX]
          have hI0_close :
              F.lt (RealFunction.dist S0 I0) e4 := by
            unfold S0
            exact hN0 N hN0N
          have hmid_le_raw :
              F.le
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (F.sub (leftSum f a x N) (leftSum f a x0 N)))
                (F.add
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x0 x) M)
                  (F.mul (F.sub c a) eta)) :=
            leftSum_upper_endpoint_same_partition_uniform_bound
              (f := f) (a := a) (c := c) (x := x0) (y := x)
              (M := M) (eta := eta) (delta := deltaU) (n := N)
              hx0 hx hM_nonneg heta_pos hM hdelta hxdU
          have hmid_le :
              F.le (RealFunction.dist SX S0)
                (F.add
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x0 x) M)
                  (F.mul (F.sub c a) eta)) := by
            unfold SX S0 RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
            exact hmid_le_raw
          have hdistM_lt :
              F.lt (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x0 x) M) e4 := by
            have hle :
                F.le
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x0 x) M)
                  (F.mul rho M) :=
              F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxdrho) hM_nonneg
            have hrho_comm :
                F.lt (F.mul rho M) e4 := by
              change F.lt (F.mul M rho) e4 at hrho
              rwa [F.mul_comm M rho] at hrho
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
              F hle hrho_comm
          have hmid_rhs_lt :
              F.lt
                (F.add
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x0 x) M)
                  (F.mul (F.sub c a) eta))
                e2 := by
            have hsum :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hdistM_lt hLeta
            have hquarter :
                F.add e4 e4 = e2 := by
              unfold e4 e2 RealTheory.quarter
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps)
            rwa [hquarter] at hsum
          have hmid :
              F.lt (RealFunction.dist SX S0) e2 :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
              F hmid_le hmid_rhs_lt
          have htri :
              F.le (RealFunction.dist Ix I0)
                (F.add (RealFunction.dist Ix SX)
                  (F.add (RealFunction.dist SX S0)
                    (RealFunction.dist S0 I0))) :=
            dist_le_three Ix SX S0 I0
          have hsum_close :
              F.lt
                (F.add (RealFunction.dist Ix SX)
                  (F.add (RealFunction.dist SX S0)
                    (RealFunction.dist S0 I0)))
                eps :=
            RealTheory.add_lt_quarter_half_quarter
              hIx_close hmid hI0_close
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
            F htri hsum_close

name: upperEndpointContinuity
statement:
theorem upperEndpointContinuity :
    UpperEndpointContinuityStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro f a c hac hf x0 hx0 eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e4 := RealTheory.quarter eps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he4 : F.lt F.zero e4 :=
    RealTheory.quarter_pos heps
  have he2 : F.lt F.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have hL_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub c a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hac
  have hbdd :
      RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_closedInterval_bounded hac hf
  cases boundedOn_abs_bound hbdd with
  | intro M hM =>
      cases RealTheory.exists_pos_eta_mul_lt_of_nonneg hL_nonneg he4 with
      | intro eta heta =>
          have hLeta : F.lt (F.mul (F.sub c a) eta) e4 := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub c a) eta]
            exact heta.right
          cases RealTheory.exists_pos_eta_mul_lt_of_nonneg hM.left he4 with
          | intro rho hrho =>
              have hMrho : F.lt (F.mul M rho) e4 := by
                rw [F.mul_comm M rho]
                exact hrho.right
              have hunif :
                  RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn
                    (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f :=
                RealFunction.continuousOn_compact_uniformContinuousOn
                  (RealFunction.closedInterval_compact.{0} hac) hf
              cases hunif eta heta.left with
              | intro deltaU hdeltaU =>
                  cases F.le_total deltaU rho with
                  | inl hdeltaU_le_rho =>
                      refine Exists.intro deltaU ?_
                      refine And.intro hdeltaU.left ?_
                      intro x Ix I0 hx hxd hIx hI0
                      have hxdU :
                          F.lt (RealFunction.dist x0 x) deltaU := by
                        rw [RealFunction.dist_comm x0 x]
                        exact hxd
                      have hxdrho :
                          F.lt (RealFunction.dist x0 x) rho :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                          F hxdU hdeltaU_le_rho
                      exact upperEndpointContinuity_core
                        (f := f) (a := a) (c := c) (x := x)
                        (x0 := x0) (Ix := Ix) (I0 := I0)
                        (M := M) (eta := eta) (rho := rho)
                        hx hx0 hM.left hM.right
                        heta.left hLeta hMrho
                        hdeltaU.right hxdU hxdrho hIx hI0 heps
                  | inr hrho_le_deltaU =>
                      refine Exists.intro rho ?_
                      refine And.intro hrho.left ?_
                      intro x Ix I0 hx hxd hIx hI0
                      have hxdrho :
                          F.lt (RealFunction.dist x0 x) rho := by
                        rw [RealFunction.dist_comm x0 x]
                        exact hxd
                      have hxdU :
                          F.lt (RealFunction.dist x0 x) deltaU :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                          F hxdrho hrho_le_deltaU
                      exact upperEndpointContinuity_core
                        (f := f) (a := a) (c := c) (x := x)
                        (x0 := x0) (Ix := Ix) (I0 := I0)
                        (M := M) (eta := eta) (rho := rho)
                        hx hx0 hM.left hM.right
                        heta.left hLeta hMrho
                        hdeltaU.right hxdU hxdrho hIx hI0 heps

name: lowerEndpointContinuity_core
statement:
private theorem lowerEndpointContinuity_core
    {f : Map} {a c x x0 Ix I0 M eta rho deltaU eps : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x)
    (hx0 : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x0)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (hM :
      forall z : Point,

        (RealTheory.quarter eps))
    (hdelta :
      forall u v : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c u ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c v ->
            RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist u v) deltaU ->
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (f u) (f v)) eta)
    (hxdU2 :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add (RealFunction.dist x0 x)

    (hxdrho : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x0 x) rho)
    (hIx : HasIntegral f x c Ix)
    (hI0 : HasIntegral f x0 c I0)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist Ix I0) eps

  let e4 := RealTheory.quarter eps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he4 : F.lt F.zero e4 :=

  cases hasIntegral_ordered_leftSum_eventually hx.right hIx he4 with
  | intro NX hNX =>
      cases hasIntegral_ordered_leftSum_eventually hx0.right hI0 he4 with
      | intro N0 hN0 =>

          let SX := leftSum f x c N
          let S0 := leftSum f x0 c N
          have hNXN : NX <= N := Nat.le_max_left NX N0

          have hIx_close_raw :
              F.lt (RealFunction.dist SX Ix) e4 := by
            unfold SX
            exact hNX N hNXN
          have hIx_close :
              F.lt (RealFunction.dist Ix SX) e4 := by
            rwa [RealFunction.dist_comm Ix SX]
          have hI0_close :
              F.lt (RealFunction.dist S0 I0) e4 := by

          have hmid_le_raw :

                (F.add
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x0 x) M)
                  (F.mul (F.sub c a) eta)) :=
            leftSum_lower_endpoint_same_partition_uniform_bound
              (f := f) (a := a) (c := c) (x := x0) (y := x)
              (M := M) (eta := eta) (delta := deltaU) (n := N)
              hx0 hx hM_nonneg heta_pos hM hdelta hxdU2
          have hmid_le :
              F.le (RealFunction.dist SX S0)
                (F.add
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x0 x) M)
                  (F.mul (F.sub c a) eta)) := by
            unfold SX S0 RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist
            exact hmid_le_raw
          have hdistM_lt :
              F.lt (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x0 x) M) e4 := by
            have hle :
                F.le
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x0 x) M)
                  (F.mul rho M) :=
              F.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxdrho) hM_nonneg
            have hrho_comm :
                F.lt (F.mul rho M) e4 := by

            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
              F hle hrho_comm
          have hmid_rhs_lt :
              F.lt
                (F.add
                  (F.mul (RealFunction.dist x0 x) M)
                  (F.mul (F.sub c a) eta))

            have hsum :=

            have hquarter :
                F.add e4 e4 = e2 := by
              unfold e4 e2 RealTheory.quarter
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps)
            rwa [hquarter] at hsum
          have hmid :
              F.lt (RealFunction.dist SX S0) e2 :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
              F hmid_le hmid_rhs_lt
          have htri :
              F.le (RealFunction.dist Ix I0)
                (F.add (RealFunction.dist Ix SX)
                  (F.add (RealFunction.dist SX S0)
                    (RealFunction.dist S0 I0))) :=
            dist_le_three Ix SX S0 I0
          have hsum_close :
              F.lt
                (F.add (RealFunction.dist Ix SX)
                  (F.add (RealFunction.dist SX S0)
                    (RealFunction.dist S0 I0)))
                eps :=
            RealTheory.add_lt_quarter_half_quarter
              hIx_close hmid hI0_close
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
            F htri hsum_close

name: lowerEndpointContinuity
statement:
theorem lowerEndpointContinuity :
    LowerEndpointContinuityStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro f a c hac hf x0 hx0 eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e4 := RealTheory.quarter eps
  have he4 : F.lt F.zero e4 :=
    RealTheory.quarter_pos heps
  have hL_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub c a) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hac
  have hbdd :
      RealFunction.BoundedOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f :=
    RealFunction.continuousOn_closedInterval_bounded hac hf
  cases boundedOn_abs_bound hbdd with
  | intro M hM =>
      cases RealTheory.exists_pos_eta_mul_lt_of_nonneg hL_nonneg he4 with
      | intro eta heta =>
          have hLeta : F.lt (F.mul (F.sub c a) eta) e4 := by
            rw [F.mul_comm (F.sub c a) eta]
            exact heta.right
          cases RealTheory.exists_pos_eta_mul_lt_of_nonneg hM.left he4 with
          | intro rho hrho =>
              have hMrho : F.lt (F.mul M rho) e4 := by
                rw [F.mul_comm M rho]
                exact hrho.right
              have hunif :
                  RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn
                    (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c) f :=
                RealFunction.continuousOn_compact_uniformContinuousOn
                  (RealFunction.closedInterval_compact.{0} hac) hf
              cases hunif eta heta.left with
              | intro deltaU hdeltaU =>
                  let tau := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F deltaU
                  have htau : F.lt F.zero tau :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hdeltaU.left
                  let delta := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F rho tau
                  have hdelta_pos : F.lt F.zero delta :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
                      F hrho.left htau
                  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                  refine And.intro hdelta_pos ?_
                  intro x Ix I0 hx hxd hIx hI0
                  have hxd0 :
                      F.lt (RealFunction.dist x0 x) delta := by
                    rwa [RealFunction.dist_comm x0 x]
                  have hxdrho :
                      F.lt (RealFunction.dist x0 x) rho :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                      F hxd0
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F rho tau)
                  have hxdtau :
                      F.lt (RealFunction.dist x0 x) tau :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                      F hxd0
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F rho tau)
                  have hxdU2 :
                      F.lt
                        (F.add (RealFunction.dist x0 x)
                          (RealFunction.dist x0 x))
                        deltaU := by
                    have hsum :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                        F hxdtau hxdtau
                    have htau_add :
                        F.add tau tau = deltaU := by
                      unfold tau
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                        F deltaU
                    rwa [htau_add] at hsum
                  exact lowerEndpointContinuity_core
                    (f := f) (a := a) (c := c) (x := x)
                    (x0 := x0) (Ix := Ix) (I0 := I0)
                    (M := M) (eta := eta) (rho := rho)
                    hx hx0 hM.left hM.right
                    heta.left hLeta hMrho
                    hdeltaU.right hxdU2 hxdrho hIx hI0 heps

name: endpointContinuity
statement:
theorem endpointContinuity :
    EndpointContinuityStatement
proof:
:=
  And.intro upperEndpointContinuity lowerEndpointContinuity

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_unique_of_le
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_unique_of_le
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hJ : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b J) :
    I = J
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply RealFunction.eq_of_forall_dist_lt
  intro eps heps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  let start := twoPointPartition a b
  have hstart : IntervalPartition a b 1 start :=
    twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hab
  cases hI.right e2 he2 1 start hstart with
  | intro countI hcountI =>
      cases hcountI with
      | intro partI hpartI =>
          cases hpartI with
          | intro hpartI_interval hpartI_tail =>
              cases hpartI_tail with
              | intro hrefI_start hcloseI =>
                  cases hJ.right e2 he2 countI partI hpartI_interval with
                  | intro countJ hcountJ =>
                      cases hcountJ with
                      | intro partJ hpartJ =>
                          cases hpartJ with
                          | intro hpartJ_interval hpartJ_tail =>
                              cases hpartJ_tail with
                              | intro hrefJ_I hcloseJ =>
                                  let tagJ := leftTags partJ
                                  have htagJ :
                                      TaggedPartition
                                        a b countJ partJ tagJ :=
                                    leftTags_taggedPartition hpartJ_interval
                                  have hIclose :
                                      RealTheory.lt
                                        (RealTheory.abs
                                          (RealTheory.sub
                                            (stieltjesTagSum
                                              f alpha partJ tagJ countJ) I))
                                        e2 :=
                                    hcloseI countJ partJ tagJ htagJ hrefJ_I
                                  have hJclose :
                                      RealTheory.lt
                                        (RealTheory.abs
                                          (RealTheory.sub
                                            (stieltjesTagSum
                                              f alpha partJ tagJ countJ) J))
                                        e2 :=
                                    hcloseJ countJ partJ tagJ htagJ
                                      (partitionRefines_self
                                        hpartJ_interval)
                                  let S :=
                                    stieltjesTagSum
                                      f alpha partJ tagJ countJ
                                  change F.lt (RealFunction.dist I J) eps
                                  apply RealFunction.dist_lt_of_two_half_steps
                                  · change
                                      F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub I S))
                                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps)
                                    rwa [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm I S]
                                  · exact hJclose

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_cauchyCriterion
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_cauchyCriterion
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I) :
    RiemannStieltjesCauchyCriterionOn f alpha a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro hI.left ?_
  intro eps heps baseCount base hbase
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hI.right e2 he2 baseCount base hbase with
  | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
      cases hthresholdCount with
      | intro threshold hthreshold =>
          cases hthreshold with
          | intro hthreshold_interval hthreshold_tail =>
              cases hthreshold_tail with
              | intro href_threshold_base hclose =>
                  refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
                  refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
                  refine And.intro hthreshold_interval ?_
                  refine And.intro href_threshold_base ?_
                  intro n₁ p₁ tag₁ n₂ p₂ tag₂ htag₁ htag₂ href₁ href₂
                  let S₁ := stieltjesTagSum f alpha p₁ tag₁ n₁
                  let S₂ := stieltjesTagSum f alpha p₂ tag₂ n₂
                  have hclose₁ :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S₁ I)) e2 := by
                    dsimp [S₁]
                    exact hclose n₁ p₁ tag₁ htag₁ href₁
                  have hclose₂ :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S₂ I)) e2 := by
                    dsimp [S₂]
                    exact hclose n₂ p₂ tag₂ htag₂ href₂
                  change F.lt (RealFunction.dist S₁ S₂) eps
                  apply RealFunction.dist_lt_of_two_half_steps
                  · exact hclose₁
                  · change
                      F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub I S₂))
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps)
                    rwa [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm I S₂]

name: lowerSum_adjacent
statement:
theorem lowerSum_adjacent
    (f alpha : Point -> Point)
    {a c b : Point}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a c leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition c b rightCount right)
    (hinfLeft :
      forall k : Nat, k < leftCount ->
        Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f left k m))
    (hinfRight :
      forall k : Nat, k < rightCount ->
        Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f right k m)) :
    lowerSum f alpha
        (adjacentPartition left right leftCount)
        (leftCount + rightCount) =
      RealTheory.add
        (lowerSum f alpha left leftCount)
        (lowerSum f alpha right rightCount)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowerSum
  let adjacent := adjacentPartition left right leftCount
  let splitWeight := fun k : Nat =>
    if _h : k < leftCount then
      stieltjesIncrement alpha left k
    else
      stieltjesIncrement alpha right (k - leftCount)
  have hweight :
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedLowerSum
          f (stieltjesIncrement alpha adjacent) adjacent
          (leftCount + rightCount) =
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedLowerSum
          f splitWeight adjacent (leftCount + rightCount) := by
    unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedLowerSum
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
    intro k hk
    dsimp [splitWeight]
    by_cases hk_left : k < leftCount
    · dsimp [adjacent]
      rw [stieltjesIncrement_adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
        alpha hleft (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright) hk_left]
      simp [hk_left]
    · have hleft_le : leftCount <= k := Nat.le_of_not_gt hk_left
      have hk_eq : k = leftCount + (k - leftCount) := by
        exact (Nat.add_sub_of_le hleft_le).symm
      dsimp [adjacent]
      rw [hk_eq]
      rw [stieltjesIncrement_adjacentPartition_right
        alpha left right leftCount (k - leftCount)]
      have hnot_shift :
          Not (leftCount + (k - leftCount) < leftCount) := by
        omega
      simp [hnot_shift]
  rw [hweight]
  dsimp [splitWeight, adjacent]
  exact
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedLowerSum_adjacent
      f hleft hright hinfLeft hinfRight
