name: lowerSum_cut
statement:
theorem lowerSum_cut
    (f alpha : Point -> Point)
    {a b : Point} {n cut : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hcut : cut <= n)
    (hinf :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m)) :
    lowerSum f alpha p n =
      RealTheory.add
        (lowerSum f alpha p cut)
        (lowerSum f alpha (suffixPartition p cut) (n - cut))
proof:
:= by
  have hprefix : IntervalPartition a (p cut) cut p :=
    intervalPartition_prefix hp hcut
  have hsuffix : IntervalPartition (p cut) b (n - cut)
      (suffixPartition p cut) :=
    intervalPartition_suffix hp hcut
  have hinfPrefix :
      forall k : Nat, k < cut ->
        Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m) := by
    intro k hk
    exact hinf k (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk hcut)
  have hinfSuffix :
      forall k : Nat, k < n - cut ->
        Exists
          (fun m : Point =>
            HasCellInf f (suffixPartition p cut) k m) := by
    intro k hk
    have hidx_lt : cut + k < n := by
      omega
    refine Exists.intro (cellLower f p (cut + k)) ?_
    exact
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.hasCellInf_of_partitionCell_iff
        (fun x : Point => partitionCell_suffixPartition p cut k x)
        (cellLower_hasCellInf (hinf (cut + k) hidx_lt))
  have hsum :=
    lowerSum_adjacent f alpha hprefix hsuffix hinfPrefix hinfSuffix
  have hcount : cut + (n - cut) = n := Nat.add_sub_of_le hcut
  rw [hcount] at hsum
  rw [adjacentPartition_suffix_eq_self p cut] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: stieltjesIncrement_nonnegative_of_monotone
statement:
theorem stieltjesIncrement_nonnegative_of_monotone
    {alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left hp hk
  have hright : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right hp hk
  have hstep : RealTheory.le (p k) (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_step_le hp hk
  have halpha : RealTheory.le (alpha (p k)) (alpha (p (k + 1))) :=
    hmono (p k) (p (k + 1)) hleft hright hstep
  unfold stieltjesIncrement
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F halpha

name: finiteSum_refinementBlockStieltjesIncrement
proof:
:= by
  let start := cut i
  let count := refinementBlockLength cut i
  let r := fun h : Nat => alpha (q (start + h))
  have hterm :
      forall h : Nat,
        stieltjesIncrement alpha q (cut i + h) =
          RealTheory.sub (r (h + 1)) (r h) := by
    intro h
    unfold stieltjesIncrement r start
    have hidx : cut i + h + 1 = cut i + (h + 1) := by
      omega
    rw [hidx]
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun h : Nat => stieltjesIncrement alpha q (cut i + h)) count =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat => RealTheory.sub (r (h + 1)) (r h)) count :=

  rw [hsum]

  unfold count refinementBlockLength r start
  have hmono : cut i <= cut (i + 1) :=
    partitionBlockRefines_cut_mono_step href hi
  have hidx : cut i + (cut (i + 1) - cut i) = cut (i + 1) :=
    Nat.add_sub_of_le hmono

      forall k : Nat, k < m ->

    {i : Nat}
    (hi : i < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul (cellLower f p i) (stieltjesIncrement alpha p i))
      (refinementBlockLowerSum f alpha q cut i)
proof:
:= by
  let count := refinementBlockLength cut i
  let inc := fun h : Nat => stieltjesIncrement alpha q (cut i + h)
  let coarse := fun h : Nat => RealTheory.mul (cellLower f p i) (inc h)
  let fine := fun h : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul (cellLower f q (cut i + h)) (inc h)
  have hcoarse_eq :
      RealTheory.mul (cellLower f p i) (stieltjesIncrement alpha p i) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum coarse count := by
    unfold coarse inc count
    rw [<- finiteSum_refinementBlockStieltjesIncrement
      (alpha := alpha) href hi]
    exact Eq.symm
      (RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left (cellLower f p i)
        (fun h : Nat => stieltjesIncrement alpha q (cut i + h))
        (refinementBlockLength cut i))
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum coarse count)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum fine count) := by
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le coarse fine count
      (fun h hh => by
        have hj : cut i + h < m :=
          partitionBlockRefines_block_index_lt_right_bound href hi hh
        have hsubset :
            forall x : Point,
              PartitionCell q (cut i + h) x -> PartitionCell p i x :=
          fun x hx =>
            refinementBlockFineCell_mem_coarseCell href hq hi hh hx
        have hle :
            RealTheory.le (cellLower f p i)
              (cellLower f q (cut i + h)) :=
          cellLower_le_cellLower_of_cell_subset
            (hinf_coarse i hi) (hinf_fine (cut i + h) hj) hsubset
        have hinc : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (inc h) :=
          stieltjesIncrement_nonnegative_of_monotone hq hmono hj
        unfold coarse fine inc
        exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hle hinc)
  unfold refinementBlockLowerSum
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul (cellLower f p i) (stieltjesIncrement alpha p i))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum fine count)
  rw [hcoarse_eq]
  exact hsum

name: refinementBlockUpperSum_le_coarseUpperContribution

    {a b : Point} {f alpha : Point -> Point}

  have hcoarse_eq :
      RealTheory.mul (cellUpper f p i) (stieltjesIncrement alpha p i) =

    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le fine coarse count

              PartitionCell q (cut i + h) x -> PartitionCell p i x :=

        have hle :

        have hinc : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (inc h) :=

name: riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_uniformContinuousOn_closedInterval
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_uniformContinuousOn_closedInterval
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hf : RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hcell : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b) :
    RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a b
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let total := RealTheory.sub (alpha b) (alpha a)
  have halpha_ab : RealTheory.le (alpha a) (alpha b) :=
    hmono a b
      (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab)
      (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab)
      hab
  have htotal_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero total := by
    dsimp [total]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F halpha_ab
  cases
      RealTheory.exists_pos_eta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
        htotal_nonneg heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases hf eta heta.left with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          cases
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.exists_intervalPartition_mesh_lt
                hab hdelta.left with
          | intro n hn =>
              cases hn with
              | intro p hp =>
                  let weight := stieltjesIncrement alpha p
                  refine Exists.intro n ?_
                  refine Exists.intro p ?_
                  refine And.intro hp.left ?_
                  have hweight :
                      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (weight k) := by
                    intro k hk
                    dsimp [weight]
                    exact stieltjesIncrement_nonnegative_of_monotone
                      hp.left hmono hk
                  have hcellPack := hcell n p hp.left
                  have hcellGap :
                      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                        RealTheory.le (cellUpper f p k)
                          (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) eta) := by
                    intro k hk
                    exact
                      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellUpper_le_cellLower_add_of_pairwise_sub_lt
                        (hcellPack.left k hk)
                        (hcellPack.right k hk)
                        (fun x y hx hy => by
                          have hx_closed :
                              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
                            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
                              hp.left hk hx
                          have hy_closed :
                              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y :=
                            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
                              hp.left hk hy
                          have hdist_cell :
                              RealTheory.le
                                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x y)
                                (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength p k) :=
                            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.dist_le_cellLength_of_partitionCell
                              hx hy
                          have hdist_mesh :
                              RealTheory.le
                                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x y)
                                (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.mesh p n) :=
                            RealTheory.le_trans hdist_cell
                              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength_le_mesh
                                p n k hk)
                          have hxy_delta :
                              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x y) delta := by
                            unfold RealFunction.dist
                            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                              F hdist_mesh hp.right
                          have hfxy :
                              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (f x) (f y))
                                eta :=
                            hdelta.right x y hx_closed hy_closed hxy_delta
                          have hsub_le_dist :
                              RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))
                                (RealFunction.dist (f x) (f y)) := by
                            unfold RealFunction.dist
                            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_abs_self
                              F (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y))
                          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                            F hsub_le_dist hfxy)
                  have hgap_le :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.sub
                          (upperSum f alpha p n)
                          (lowerSum f alpha p n))
                        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n)) := by
                    unfold upperSum lowerSum
                    dsimp [weight]
                    exact
                      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedDarbouxGap_le_error_of_cellUpper_le
                        hweight hcellGap
                  have hsum :
                      RealTheory.finiteSum weight n = total := by
                    dsimp [weight, total]
                    rw [finiteSum_stieltjesIncrement alpha p n]
                    rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_right_endpoint
                      hp.left]
                    rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_left_endpoint
                      hp.left]
                  rw [hsum] at hgap_le
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                    F hgap_le heta.right

name: riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_continuousOn_closedInterval
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_continuousOn_closedInterval
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}

name: riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_monotoneOn_uniformContinuousIntegrator_closedInterval
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_monotoneOn_uniformContinuousIntegrator_closedInterval
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hfmono : RealFunction.MonotoneOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (halphaMono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (halphaUniform : RealFunction.UniformContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha) :
    RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a b
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let total := RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)
  have hf_ab : RealTheory.le (f a) (f b) :=
    hfmono a b
      (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab)
      (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab)
      hab
  have htotal_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero total := by
    dsimp [total]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hf_ab
  cases
      RealTheory.exists_pos_eta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
        htotal_nonneg heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases halphaUniform eta heta.left with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          cases
              Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.exists_intervalPartition_mesh_lt
                hab hdelta.left with
          | intro n hn =>
              cases hn with
              | intro p hp =>
                  let alphaWeight := stieltjesIncrement alpha p
                  let fError := stieltjesIncrement f p
                  refine Exists.intro n ?_
                  refine Exists.intro p ?_
                  refine And.intro hp.left ?_
                  have hcell :=
                    riemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn_of_monotoneOn_closedInterval
                      hab hfmono
                  have hweight :
                      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (alphaWeight k) := by
                    intro k hk
                    dsimp [alphaWeight]
                    exact stieltjesIncrement_nonnegative_of_monotone
                      hp.left halphaMono hk
                  have hcellPack := hcell n p hp.left
                  have hcellGap :
                      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                        RealTheory.le (cellUpper f p k)
                          (RealTheory.add (cellLower f p k) (fError k)) := by
                    intro k hk
                    exact
                      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellUpper_le_cellLower_add_of_pairwise_sub_le
                        (hcellPack.left k hk)
                        (hcellPack.right k hk)
                        (fun x y hx hy => by
                          have hx_closed :
                              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
                            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
                              hp.left hk hx
                          have hy_closed :
                              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y :=
                            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
                              hp.left hk hy
                          have hright_closed :
                              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
                            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
                              hp.left hk
                          have hleft_closed :
                              RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
                            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
                              hp.left hk
                          have hfx_right :
                              RealTheory.le (f x) (f (p (k + 1))) :=
                            hfmono x (p (k + 1)) hx_closed hright_closed
                              hx.right
                          have hleft_fy :
                              RealTheory.le (f (p k)) (f y) :=
                            hfmono (p k) y hleft_closed hy_closed hy.left
                          dsimp [fError]
                          unfold stieltjesIncrement
                          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
                            F hfx_right hleft_fy)
                  have hgap_le_sum :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.sub
                          (upperSum f alpha p n)
                          (lowerSum f alpha p n))
                        (RealTheory.finiteSum
                          (fun k : Nat =>
                            RealTheory.mul (fError k) (alphaWeight k))
                          n) := by
                    unfold upperSum lowerSum
                    dsimp [alphaWeight, fError]
                    exact
                      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedDarbouxGap_le_errorSum_of_cellUpper_le
                        hweight hcellGap
                  have hsum_bound :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.finiteSum
                          (fun k : Nat =>
                            RealTheory.mul (fError k) (alphaWeight k))
                          n)
                        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.finiteSum fError n)) := by
                    have hpoint :
                        forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealTheory.mul (fError k) (alphaWeight k))
                            (RealTheory.mul (fError k) eta) := by
                      intro k hk
                      have hferr_nonneg :
                          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (fError k) := by
                        dsimp [fError]
                        exact stieltjesIncrement_nonnegative_of_monotone
                          hp.left hfmono hk
                      have hleft_mem :
                          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
                        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
                          hp.left hk
                      have hright_mem :
                          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
                        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
                          hp.left hk
                      have hdist_cell :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (p k) (p (k + 1)))
                            (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength p k) :=
                        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.dist_le_cellLength_of_partitionCell
                          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_left_mem
                            hp.left hk)
                          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_right_mem
                            hp.left hk)
                      have hdist_mesh :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F (p k) (p (k + 1)))
                            (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.mesh p n) :=
                        RealTheory.le_trans hdist_cell
                          (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLength_le_mesh
                            p n k hk)
                      have hp_delta :
                          RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (p k) (p (k + 1)))
                            delta := by
                        unfold RealFunction.dist
                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                          F hdist_mesh hp.right
                      have halpha_dist :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealFunction.dist (alpha (p k))
                              (alpha (p (k + 1)))) eta :=
                        hdelta.right (p k) (p (k + 1))
                          hleft_mem hright_mem hp_delta
                      have halpha_dist_rev :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealFunction.dist (alpha (p (k + 1)))
                              (alpha (p k))) eta := by
                        rwa [RealFunction.dist_comm
                          (alpha (p (k + 1))) (alpha (p k))]
                      have hinc_le_dist :
                          RealTheory.le (alphaWeight k)
                            (RealFunction.dist (alpha (p (k + 1)))
                              (alpha (p k))) := by
                        dsimp [alphaWeight]
                        unfold stieltjesIncrement RealFunction.dist
                        exact RealTheory.le_abs_self
                          (RealTheory.sub
                            (alpha (p (k + 1))) (alpha (p k)))
                      have hinc_le_eta :
                          RealTheory.le (alphaWeight k) eta :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                            F hinc_le_dist halpha_dist_rev)
                      exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                        hinc_le_eta hferr_nonneg
                    have hsum_le :
                        RealTheory.le
                          (RealTheory.finiteSum
                            (fun k : Nat =>
                              RealTheory.mul (fError k) (alphaWeight k))
                            n)
                          (RealTheory.finiteSum
                            (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (fError k) eta)
                            n) :=
                      RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
                        (fun k : Nat =>
                          RealTheory.mul (fError k) (alphaWeight k))
                        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (fError k) eta)
                        n hpoint
                    have hcomm :
                        RealTheory.finiteSum
                            (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (fError k) eta)
                            n =
                          RealTheory.finiteSum
                            (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (fError k))
                            n := by
                      exact RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt (n := n)
                        (fun k _hk => RealTheory.mul_comm (fError k) eta)
                    have hmul :
                        RealTheory.finiteSum
                            (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (fError k))
                            n =
                          RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.finiteSum fError n) :=
                      RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left eta fError n
                    rw [hcomm, hmul] at hsum_le
                    exact hsum_le
                  have hf_sum :
                      RealTheory.finiteSum fError n = total := by
                    dsimp [fError, total]
                    rw [finiteSum_stieltjesIncrement f p n]
                    rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_right_endpoint
                      hp.left]
                    rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_left_endpoint
                      hp.left]
                  rw [hf_sum] at hsum_bound
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                    (RealTheory.le_trans hgap_le_sum hsum_bound)
                    heta.right

name: exists_lowerSum_gt_sub_of_hasLowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_lowerSum_gt_sub_of_hasLowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I eps : Point}
    (hI : HasLowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral f alpha a b I)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b n p)
              (And
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.sub I eps) (lowerSum f alpha p n))
                (RealTheory.le (lowerSum f alpha p n) I))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbelow : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub I eps) I :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub F hI hbelow with
  | intro v hv =>
      cases hv.left with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              have hp_part : IntervalPartition a b n p := hp.left
              have hv_eq : v = lowerSum f alpha p n := hp.right
              have hlt : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub I eps)
                  (lowerSum f alpha p n) := by
                have hvlt := hv.right
                rwa [hv_eq] at hvlt
              have hle : RealTheory.le (lowerSum f alpha p n) I := by
                have hmem :
                    LowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet
                      f alpha a b (lowerSum f alpha p n) :=
                  lowerSum_mem_lowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet
                    hp_part
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F hI hmem
              refine Exists.intro n ?_
              refine Exists.intro p ?_
              exact And.intro hp_part (And.intro hlt hle)

name: exists_upperSum_lt_add_of_hasUpperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_upperSum_lt_add_of_hasUpperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I eps : Point}
    (hI : HasUpperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral f alpha a b I)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b n p)
              (And
                (RealTheory.le I (upperSum f alpha p n))
                (RealTheory.lt (upperSum f alpha p n)
                  (RealTheory.add I eps)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have habove : RealTheory.lt I (RealTheory.add I eps) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps I
    change F.lt (F.add I F.zero) (F.add I eps) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_gt_of_glb_lt F hI habove with
  | intro v hv =>
      cases hv.left with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              have hp_part : IntervalPartition a b n p := hp.left
              have hv_eq : v = upperSum f alpha p n := hp.right
              have hle : RealTheory.le I (upperSum f alpha p n) := by
                have hmem :
                    UpperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet
                      f alpha a b (upperSum f alpha p n) :=
                  upperSum_mem_upperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet
                    hp_part
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.glb_le_of_mem F hI hmem
              have hlt : RealTheory.lt (upperSum f alpha p n)
                  (RealTheory.add I eps) := by
                have hvlt := hv.right
                rwa [hv_eq] at hvlt
              refine Exists.intro n ?_
              refine Exists.intro p ?_
              exact And.intro hp_part (And.intro hle hlt)

name: lowerSum_le_upperSum_of_intervalPartitions
statement:
theorem lowerSum_le_upperSum_of_intervalPartitions
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {leftCount rightCount : Nat} {left right : Nat -> Point}
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hcell : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b)
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a b leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition a b rightCount right) :
    RealTheory.le (lowerSum f alpha left leftCount)
      (upperSum f alpha right rightCount)
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_commonTaggedBlockRefinement
      (leftTags_taggedPartition hleft)
      (leftTags_taggedPartition hright) with
  | intro mergeCount hmergeCount =>
      cases hmergeCount with
      | intro merge hmerge =>
          cases hmerge with
          | intro mergeTag hmergeTag =>
              cases hmergeTag with
              | intro leftCut hleftCut =>
                  cases hleftCut with
                  | intro rightCut hcommon =>
                      have hmergeTagged :
                          TaggedPartition a b mergeCount merge mergeTag :=
                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_taggedPartition hcommon
                      have hmergePartition :
                          IntervalPartition a b mergeCount merge :=
                        hmergeTagged.left
                      have hleftRefines :
                          PartitionBlockRefines
                            merge mergeCount left leftCount leftCut :=
                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_left_refines hcommon
                      have hrightRefines :
                          PartitionBlockRefines
                            merge mergeCount right rightCount rightCut :=
                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_right_refines hcommon
                      have hleftExt := hcell leftCount left hleft
                      have hrightExt := hcell rightCount right hright
                      have hmergeExt := hcell mergeCount merge hmergePartition
                      have hleftLe :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (lowerSum f alpha left leftCount)
                            (lowerSum f alpha merge mergeCount) :=
                        lowerSum_le_lowerSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                          hleftRefines hmergePartition hmono
                          hleftExt.left hmergeExt.left
                      have hmiddle :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (lowerSum f alpha merge mergeCount)
                            (upperSum f alpha merge mergeCount) :=
                        lowerSum_le_upperSum_of_intervalPartition
                          hmergePartition hmono hmergeExt.left hmergeExt.right
                      have hrightLe :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (upperSum f alpha merge mergeCount)
                            (upperSum f alpha right rightCount) :=
                        upperSum_le_upperSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                          hrightRefines hmergePartition hmono
                          hrightExt.right hmergeExt.right
                      exact RealTheory.le_trans hleftLe
                        (RealTheory.le_trans hmiddle hrightLe)

name: exists_hasLowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_hasLowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hcell : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b) :
    Exists
      (fun Il : Point =>
        HasLowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral f alpha a b Il)
proof:
:= by
  let base := twoPointPartition a b
  have hbase : IntervalPartition a b 1 base :=
    twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hab
  have hne :
      Exists
        (LowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet f alpha a b) :=
    Exists.intro (lowerSum f alpha base 1)
      (lowerSum_mem_lowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet hbase)
  have hbdd :
      Exists
        (IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (LowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet f alpha a b)) :=
    Exists.intro (upperSum f alpha base 1)
      (upperSum_isUpperBound_lowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet
        hmono hcell hbase)
  exact RealTheory.exists_lub
    (LowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet f alpha a b)
    hne hbdd

name: exists_hasUpperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_hasUpperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hcell : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b) :
    Exists
      (fun Iu : Point =>
        HasUpperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral f alpha a b Iu)
proof:
:= by
  let base := twoPointPartition a b
  have hbase : IntervalPartition a b 1 base :=
    twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hab
  have hne :
      Exists
        (UpperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet f alpha a b) :=
    Exists.intro (upperSum f alpha base 1)
      (upperSum_mem_upperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet hbase)
  have hbdd :
      Exists
        (IsLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (UpperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet f alpha a b)) := by
    refine Exists.intro (lowerSum f alpha base 1) ?_
    intro v hv
    cases hv with

name: upperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral_le_lowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral_of_gapSmall
statement:
theorem upperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral_le_lowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral_of_gapSmall
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b Il Iu : Point}
    (hlower : HasLowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral f alpha a b Il)
    (hupper : HasUpperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral f alpha a b Iu)
    (hsmall : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a b) :
    RealTheory.le Iu Il
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hle : RealTheory.le Iu Il
  case pos =>
    exact hle
  case neg =>
    have hIl_le_Iu : RealTheory.le Il Iu := by
      cases RealTheory.le_total Il Iu with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr hIu_le_Il =>
          exact False.elim (hle hIu_le_Il)
    have hlt : RealTheory.lt Il Iu :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hIl_le_Iu hle
    let gap := RealTheory.sub Iu Il
    have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap := by
      dsimp [gap]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hlt
    cases hsmall gap hgap_pos with
    | intro n hn =>
        cases hn with
        | intro p hp =>
            have hp_part : IntervalPartition a b n p := hp.left
            have hgap_lt :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (upperSum f alpha p n)
                    (lowerSum f alpha p n))
                  gap :=
              hp.right
            have hIu_le_upper :
                RealTheory.le Iu (upperSum f alpha p n) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.glb_le_of_mem F hupper
                (upperSum_mem_upperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet
                  hp_part)
            have hlower_le_Il :
                RealTheory.le (lowerSum f alpha p n) Il :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F hlower
                (lowerSum_mem_lowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet
                  hp_part)
            have hdiff_le :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.sub Iu Il)
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (upperSum f alpha p n)
                    (lowerSum f alpha p n)) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
                hIu_le_upper hlower_le_Il
            have hbad :
                RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub Iu Il) gap :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hdiff_le hgap_lt
            change F.lt gap gap at hbad
            exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F gap hbad)

name: riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_hasRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral
statement:
theorem riemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall_of_hasRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hcell : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral f alpha a b I) :
    RiemannStieltjesDarbouxGapSmall f alpha a b
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases exists_lowerSum_gt_sub_of_hasLowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral
      (f := f) (alpha := alpha) (a := a) (b := b) (I := I)
      hI.left he2_pos with
  | intro lowerCount hlowerChoice =>
      cases hlowerChoice with
      | intro lowerPart hlowerChoice =>
          have hlowerPart :
              IntervalPartition a b lowerCount lowerPart :=
            hlowerChoice.left
          have hnearLower :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub I e2)
                (lowerSum f alpha lowerPart lowerCount) :=
            hlowerChoice.right.left
          cases exists_upperSum_lt_add_of_hasUpperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral
              (f := f) (alpha := alpha) (a := a) (b := b) (I := I)
              hI.right he2_pos with
          | intro upperCount hupperChoice =>
              cases hupperChoice with
              | intro upperPart hupperChoice =>
                  have hupperPart :
                      IntervalPartition a b upperCount upperPart :=
                    hupperChoice.left
                  have hnearUpper :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (upperSum f alpha upperPart upperCount)
                        (RealTheory.add I e2) :=
                    hupperChoice.right.right
                  cases exists_commonTaggedBlockRefinement
                      (leftTags_taggedPartition hlowerPart)
                      (leftTags_taggedPartition hupperPart) with
                  | intro mergeCount hmergeCount =>
                      cases hmergeCount with
                      | intro merge hmerge =>
                          cases hmerge with
                          | intro mergeTag hmergeTag =>
                              cases hmergeTag with
                              | intro lowerCut hlowerCut =>
                                  cases hlowerCut with
                                  | intro upperCut hcommon =>
                                      have hmergeTagged :
                                          TaggedPartition a b mergeCount
                                            merge mergeTag :=
                                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_taggedPartition
                                          hcommon
                                      have hmergePart :
                                          IntervalPartition a b mergeCount
                                            merge :=
                                        hmergeTagged.left
                                      have hlowerRefines :
                                          PartitionBlockRefines
                                            merge mergeCount lowerPart
                                            lowerCount lowerCut :=
                                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_left_refines
                                          hcommon
                                      have hupperRefines :
                                          PartitionBlockRefines
                                            merge mergeCount upperPart
                                            upperCount upperCut :=
                                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_right_refines
                                          hcommon
                                      have hlowerExt :=
                                        hcell lowerCount lowerPart hlowerPart
                                      have hupperExt :=
                                        hcell upperCount upperPart hupperPart
                                      have hmergeExt :=
                                        hcell mergeCount merge hmergePart
                                      have hlowerMono :
                                          RealTheory.le
                                            (lowerSum f alpha lowerPart
                                              lowerCount)
                                            (lowerSum f alpha merge
                                              mergeCount) :=
                                        lowerSum_le_lowerSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                                          hlowerRefines hmergePart hmono
                                          hlowerExt.left hmergeExt.left
                                      have hupperMono :
                                          RealTheory.le
                                            (upperSum f alpha merge
                                              mergeCount)
                                            (upperSum f alpha upperPart
                                              upperCount) :=
                                        upperSum_le_upperSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                                          hupperRefines hmergePart hmono
                                          hupperExt.right hmergeExt.right
                                      have hgapRefines :
                                          RealTheory.le
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (upperSum f alpha merge
                                                mergeCount)
                                              (lowerSum f alpha merge
                                                mergeCount))
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (upperSum f alpha upperPart
                                                upperCount)
                                              (lowerSum f alpha lowerPart
                                                lowerCount)) :=
                                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
                                          F hupperMono hlowerMono
                                      have hI_lt_lower_e2 :
                                          RealTheory.lt I
                                            (RealTheory.add
                                              (lowerSum f alpha lowerPart
                                                lowerCount)
                                              e2) := by
                                        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt
                                          F hnearLower
                                        change F.lt I
                                          (F.add e2
                                            (lowerSum f alpha lowerPart
                                              lowerCount)) at h
                                        rwa [F.add_comm e2
                                          (lowerSum f alpha lowerPart
                                            lowerCount)] at h
                                      have hI_e2_lt_lower_e2_e2 :
                                          RealTheory.lt
                                            (RealTheory.add I e2)
                                            (RealTheory.add
                                              (RealTheory.add
                                                (lowerSum f alpha lowerPart
                                                  lowerCount)
                                                e2)
                                              e2) :=
                                        RealTheory.add_lt_add_right
                                          hI_lt_lower_e2 e2
                                      have hupper_lt_lower_e2_e2 :
                                          RealTheory.lt
                                            (upperSum f alpha upperPart
                                              upperCount)
                                            (RealTheory.add
                                              (RealTheory.add
                                                (lowerSum f alpha lowerPart
                                                  lowerCount)
                                                e2)
                                              e2) :=
                                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                                          hnearUpper hI_e2_lt_lower_e2_e2
                                      have hadd :
                                          RealTheory.add
                                              (RealTheory.add
                                                (lowerSum f alpha lowerPart
                                                  lowerCount)
                                                e2)
                                              e2 =
                                            RealTheory.add
                                              (lowerSum f alpha lowerPart
                                                lowerCount)
                                              eps := by
                                        rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
                                        have he2_add :
                                            RealTheory.add e2 e2 = eps := by
                                          dsimp [e2]
                                          exact
                                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                                              F eps
                                        rw [he2_add]
                                      have hupper_lt_lower_eps :
                                          RealTheory.lt
                                            (upperSum f alpha upperPart
                                              upperCount)
                                            (RealTheory.add
                                              (lowerSum f alpha lowerPart
                                                lowerCount)
                                              eps) := by
                                        rwa [hadd] at hupper_lt_lower_e2_e2
                                      have hbaseGap :
                                          RealTheory.lt
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (upperSum f alpha upperPart
                                                upperCount)
                                              (lowerSum f alpha lowerPart
                                                lowerCount))
                                            eps :=
                                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add
                                          F hupper_lt_lower_eps
                                      refine Exists.intro mergeCount ?_
                                      refine Exists.intro merge ?_
                                      refine And.intro hmergePart ?_
                                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                        F hgapRefines hbaseGap

name: lowerUpperRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral_eq_iff_gapSmall

:= by
  refine And.intro hab ?_
  intro eps heps baseCount base hbase
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base

  have he2_lt_eps : RealTheory.lt e2 eps := by

                    hupperChoice.right.right
                  cases exists_commonTaggedBlockRefinement
                      (leftTags_taggedPartition hlowerPart)

                                                              upperPart

                                                          have hlower_to_gap :

                                                              F

                                                            hthresholdPart ?_
                                                          refine And.intro ?_ ?_

name: hasLowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
statement:
theorem hasLowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral_of_hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
    {f alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : IntegratorMonotoneOn alpha a b)
    (hcell : RiemannStieltjesDarbouxCellExtremaExistOn f a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I) :
    HasLowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxIntegral f alpha a b I
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro v hv
    cases hv with
    | intro n hn =>
        cases hn with
        | intro p hpv =>
            have hp : IntervalPartition a b n p := hpv.left
            have hv_eq : v = lowerSum f alpha p n := hpv.right
            rw [hv_eq]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_forall_pos_le_add F
              (x := lowerSum f alpha p n) (y := I)
              (fun eps heps => by
                cases hI.right eps heps n p hp with
                | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
                    cases hthresholdCount with
                    | intro threshold hthreshold =>
                        have hthresholdPart :
                            IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount threshold :=
                          hthreshold.left
                        have href :
                            PartitionRefines threshold thresholdCount p n :=
                          hthreshold.right.left
                        have hclose := hthreshold.right.right
                        let tag := leftTags threshold
                        have htag :
                            TaggedPartition a b thresholdCount threshold tag :=
                          leftTags_taggedPartition hthresholdPart
                        have htagClose :
                            RealTheory.lt
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (RealTheory.sub
                                  (stieltjesTagSum f alpha threshold tag
                                    thresholdCount) I))
                              eps :=
                          hclose thresholdCount threshold tag htag
                            (partitionRefines_self hthresholdPart)
                        have htag_lt :
                            RealTheory.lt
                              (stieltjesTagSum f alpha threshold tag
                                thresholdCount)
                              (RealTheory.add I eps) :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt
                            F htagClose
                        have hthresholdExt :=
                          hcell thresholdCount threshold hthresholdPart
                        have hlower_le_tag :
                            RealTheory.le
                              (lowerSum f alpha threshold thresholdCount)
                              (stieltjesTagSum f alpha threshold tag
                                thresholdCount) :=
                          lowerSum_le_stieltjesTagSum
                            htag hmono hthresholdExt.left
                        have hbase_le_threshold :
                            RealTheory.le
                              (lowerSum f alpha p n)
                              (lowerSum f alpha threshold thresholdCount) :=
                          lowerSum_le_lowerSum_of_partitionRefines
                            hthresholdPart hp href hmono
                            (hcell n p hp).left hthresholdExt.left
                        have hbase_le_tag :
                            RealTheory.le
                              (lowerSum f alpha p n)
                              (stieltjesTagSum f alpha threshold tag
                                thresholdCount) :=
                          RealTheory.le_trans hbase_le_threshold hlower_le_tag
                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                            F hbase_le_tag htag_lt))
  · intro u hu
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_forall_pos_le_add F
      (x := I) (y := u)
      (fun eps heps => by
        let base := twoPointPartition a b
        have hbase : IntervalPartition a b 1 base :=
          twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hab
        cases hI.right eps heps 1 base hbase with
        | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
            cases hthresholdCount with
            | intro threshold hthreshold =>
                have hthresholdPart :
                    IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount threshold :=
                  hthreshold.left
                have hclose := hthreshold.right.right
                have hthresholdExt :=
                  hcell thresholdCount threshold hthresholdPart
                have hfixedGlb :
                    IsGreatestLowerBound
                      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
                      (FixedRiemannStieltjesTaggedSumValueSet
                        f alpha a b threshold thresholdCount)
                      (lowerSum f alpha threshold thresholdCount) :=
                  lowerSum_isGreatestLowerBound_fixedRiemannStieltjesTaggedSumValueSet
                    hthresholdPart hmono hthresholdExt.left
                have hsub_lower_bound :
                    IsLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
                      (FixedRiemannStieltjesTaggedSumValueSet
                        f alpha a b threshold thresholdCount)
                      (RealTheory.sub I eps) := by
                  intro v hv
                  cases hv with
                  | intro tag htagv =>
                      rw [htagv.right]
                      have htagClose :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub
                                (stieltjesTagSum f alpha threshold tag
                                  thresholdCount) I))
                            eps :=
                        hclose thresholdCount threshold tag htagv.left
                          (partitionRefines_self hthresholdPart)
                      have hI_lt_sum_eps :
                          RealTheory.lt I
                            (RealTheory.add
                              (stieltjesTagSum f alpha threshold tag
                                thresholdCount)
                              eps) :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_left_add_of_abs_sub_lt
                          F htagClose
                      have hsub_I_sum_lt :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.sub I
                              (stieltjesTagSum f alpha threshold tag
                                thresholdCount))
                            eps :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add
                          F hI_lt_sum_eps
                      have hsub_eps_lt_sum :
                          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub I eps)
                            (stieltjesTagSum f alpha threshold tag
                              thresholdCount) :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right
                          F hsub_I_sum_lt
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
                        F hsub_eps_lt_sum
                have hsub_le_lower :
                    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub I eps)
                      (lowerSum f alpha threshold thresholdCount) :=
                  hfixedGlb.right (RealTheory.sub I eps) hsub_lower_bound
                have hlower_le_u :
                    RealTheory.le
                      (lowerSum f alpha threshold thresholdCount) u :=
                  hu (lowerSum f alpha threshold thresholdCount)
                    (lowerSum_mem_lowerRiemannStieltjesDarbouxSumValueSet
                      hthresholdPart)
                have hsub_le_u :
                    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub I eps) u :=
                  RealTheory.le_trans hsub_le_lower hlower_le_u
                have hadd :
                    RealTheory.le
                      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub I eps) eps)
                      (RealTheory.add u eps) :=
                  RealTheory.add_le_add_right hsub_le_u eps
                change F.le I (F.add u eps)
                change F.le (F.add (F.sub I eps) eps) (F.add u eps)
                  at hadd
                rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F I eps] at hadd)

name: stieltjesIncrement_const
statement:
theorem stieltjesIncrement_const
    (c : Point) (p : Nat -> Point) :
    forall k : Nat,
      stieltjesIncrement (fun _ : Point => c) p k = RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  unfold stieltjesIncrement
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.sub c c = F.zero
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F c

name: stieltjesIncrement_add
statement:
theorem stieltjesIncrement_add
    (alpha beta : Point -> Point) (p : Nat -> Point) :
    forall k : Nat,
      stieltjesIncrement
          (fun x : Point => RealTheory.add (alpha x) (beta x)) p k =
        RealTheory.add
          (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)
          (stieltjesIncrement beta p k)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  unfold stieltjesIncrement
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.sub
        (F.add (alpha (p (k + 1))) (beta (p (k + 1))))
        (F.add (alpha (p k)) (beta (p k))) =
      F.add
        (F.sub (alpha (p (k + 1))) (alpha (p k)))
        (F.sub (beta (p (k + 1))) (beta (p k)))
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F
    (alpha (p (k + 1))) (beta (p (k + 1)))
    (alpha (p k)) (beta (p k))

name: stieltjesIncrement_mul_left
statement:

        RealTheory.mul c (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)
proof:
:= by

  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.sub
        (F.mul c (alpha (p (k + 1))))
        (F.mul c (alpha (p k))) =
      F.mul c
        (F.sub (alpha (p (k + 1))) (alpha (p k)))
  exact Eq.symm
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F
      c (alpha (p (k + 1))) (alpha (p k)))

name: stieltjesIncrement_neg
statement:
theorem stieltjesIncrement_neg
    (alpha : Point -> Point) (p : Nat -> Point) :

        RealTheory.neg (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)
proof:
:= by
  intro k

  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.sub
        (F.neg (alpha (p (k + 1))))
        (F.neg (alpha (p k))) =
      F.neg (F.sub (alpha (p (k + 1))) (alpha (p k)))
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F
    (alpha (p (k + 1))) (alpha (p k))

name: stieltjesIncrement_sub
statement:
theorem stieltjesIncrement_sub
    (alpha beta : Point -> Point) (p : Nat -> Point) :
    forall k : Nat,
      stieltjesIncrement
          (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (alpha x) (beta x)) p k =
        RealTheory.sub
          (stieltjesIncrement alpha p k)
          (stieltjesIncrement beta p k)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  unfold stieltjesIncrement
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.sub
        (F.sub (alpha (p (k + 1))) (beta (p (k + 1))))
        (F.sub (alpha (p k)) (beta (p k))) =
      F.sub
        (F.sub (alpha (p (k + 1))) (alpha (p k)))
        (F.sub (beta (p (k + 1))) (beta (p k)))
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (alpha (p (k + 1))) (beta (p (k + 1)))]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (alpha (p k)) (beta (p k))]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F
    (alpha (p (k + 1))) (F.neg (beta (p (k + 1))))
    (alpha (p k)) (F.neg (beta (p k)))]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F
    (beta (p (k + 1))) (beta (p k))]
  rw [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg]

name: stieltjesIncrement_adjacentPartition_left_of_lt

theorem stieltjesIncrement_adjacentPartition_left_of_lt

proof:

  by_cases hk_succ : k + 1 < leftCount
  · rw [adjacentPartition_left_of_lt left right hk_succ]
  · have hk_succ_eq : k + 1 = leftCount := by
      omega

name: stieltjesTagSum_adjacent
statement:
theorem stieltjesTagSum_adjacent
    (f alpha : Point -> Point)
    {a c b : Point}
    {left right leftTag rightTag : Nat -> Point}
    {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    (hleft : TaggedPartition a c leftCount left leftTag)
    (hright : TaggedPartition c b rightCount right rightTag) :
    stieltjesTagSum f alpha
        (adjacentPartition left right leftCount)
        (adjacentTags leftTag rightTag leftCount)
        (leftCount + rightCount) =
      RealTheory.add
        (stieltjesTagSum f alpha left leftTag leftCount)
        (stieltjesTagSum f alpha right rightTag rightCount)
proof:
:= by
  unfold stieltjesTagSum weightedTagSum
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length]
  have hleft_terms :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (f (adjacentTags leftTag rightTag leftCount k))
              (stieltjesIncrement alpha
                (adjacentPartition left right leftCount) k))
          leftCount =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (f (leftTag k))
              (stieltjesIncrement alpha left k))
          leftCount := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
    intro k hk
    rw [adjacentTags_left_of_lt leftTag rightTag hk]
    rw [stieltjesIncrement_adjacentPartition_left_of_lt
      alpha hleft.left (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hright.left) hk]
  have hright_terms :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (f (adjacentTags leftTag rightTag leftCount
                (leftCount + j)))
              (stieltjesIncrement alpha
                (adjacentPartition left right leftCount)
                (leftCount + j)))
          rightCount =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (f (rightTag j))
              (stieltjesIncrement alpha right j))
          rightCount := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro j
    rw [adjacentTags_right_shift leftTag rightTag leftCount j]
    rw [stieltjesIncrement_adjacentPartition_right
      alpha left right leftCount j]
  rw [hleft_terms, hright_terms]

name: stieltjesTagSum_cut
statement:
theorem stieltjesTagSum_cut
    (f alpha : Point -> Point)
    {a b : Point} {n cut : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hcut : cut <= n) :
    stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n =
      RealTheory.add
        (stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag cut)
        (stieltjesTagSum f alpha
          (suffixPartition p cut) (suffixTags tag cut) (n - cut))
proof:
:= by
  have hprefix : TaggedPartition a (p cut) cut p tag :=
    taggedPartition_prefix htag hcut
  have hsuffix : TaggedPartition (p cut) b (n - cut)
      (suffixPartition p cut) (suffixTags tag cut) :=
    taggedPartition_suffix htag hcut
  have hsum :=
    stieltjesTagSum_adjacent f alpha hprefix hsuffix
  have hcount : cut + (n - cut) = n := Nat.add_sub_of_le hcut
  rw [hcount] at hsum
  rw [adjacentPartition_suffix_eq_self p cut] at hsum
  rw [adjacentTags_suffix_eq_self tag cut] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrator_congr
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrator_congr
    {f alpha beta : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hsame :
      RealFunction.SameOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha beta)
    (hI : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I) :
    HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f beta a b I
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hI.left ?_
  intro eps heps baseCount base hbase
  cases hI.right eps heps baseCount base hbase with
  | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
      cases hthresholdCount with
      | intro threshold hthreshold =>
          refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
          refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
          refine And.intro hthreshold.left ?_
          refine And.intro hthreshold.right.left ?_
          intro n p tag htag href
          have hsum :
              stieltjesTagSum f beta p tag n =
                stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n :=
            Eq.symm
              (stieltjesTagSum_eq_of_sameOn_integrator_closedInterval
                hsame htag)
          rw [hsum]
          exact hthreshold.right.right n p tag htag href

      RealFunction.SameOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) alpha beta)
    (h : RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f alpha a b) :
    RiemannStieltjesIntegrableOn f beta a b
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | intro I hI =>
      exact Exists.intro I
        (hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_integrator_congr hsame hI)

name: hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_add_integrand
statement:
theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_add_integrand
    {f g alpha : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hf : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn f alpha a b I)
    (hg : HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn g alpha a b J) :
    HasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.add (f x) (g x))
      alpha a b (RealTheory.add I J)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  intro eps heps baseCount base hbase
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hf.right e2 he2 baseCount base hbase with
  | intro fCount hfCount =>
      cases hfCount with
      | intro fThreshold hfThreshold =>
          cases hfThreshold with
          | intro hfPart hfTail =>
              cases hfTail with
              | intro hrefFBase hcloseF =>
                  cases hg.right e2 he2 fCount fThreshold hfPart with
                  | intro gCount hgCount =>
                      cases hgCount with
                      | intro gThreshold hgThreshold =>
                          cases hgThreshold with
                          | intro hgPart hgTail =>
                              cases hgTail with
                              | intro hrefGF hcloseG =>
                                  refine Exists.intro gCount ?_
                                  refine Exists.intro gThreshold ?_
                                  refine And.intro hgPart ?_
                                  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                                  · exact partitionRefines_trans
                                      hrefGF hrefFBase
                                  · intro n p tag htag href
                                    let Sf :=
                                      stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n
                                    let Sg :=
                                      stieltjesTagSum g alpha p tag n
                                    have hrefF :
                                        PartitionRefines p n
                                          fThreshold fCount :=
                                      partitionRefines_trans href hrefGF
                                    have hcloseF' :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub Sf I))
                                          e2 := by
                                      dsimp [Sf]
                                      exact hcloseF n p tag htag hrefF
                                    have hcloseG' :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub Sg J))
                                          e2 := by
                                      dsimp [Sg]
                                      exact hcloseG n p tag htag href
                                    rw [stieltjesTagSum_add_integrand
                                      f g alpha p tag n]
                                    change
                                      RealTheory.lt
                                        (RealTheory.abs
                                          (RealTheory.sub
                                            (RealTheory.add Sf Sg)
                                            (RealTheory.add I J)))
                                        eps
                                    have htri :
                                        RealTheory.le
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (RealTheory.add Sf Sg)
                                              (RealTheory.add I J)))
                                          (RealTheory.add
                                            (RealTheory.abs
                                              (RealTheory.sub Sf I))
                                            (RealTheory.abs
                                              (RealTheory.sub Sg J))) :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_sub_add_le_abs_sub_add_abs_sub
                                        F Sf Sg I J
                                    have hsum :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (RealTheory.add
                                            (RealTheory.abs
                                              (RealTheory.sub Sf I))
                                            (RealTheory.abs
                                              (RealTheory.sub Sg J)))
                                          eps := by
                                      have hadd :=
                                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                                          F hcloseF' hcloseG'
                                      change
                                        F.lt
                                          (F.add
                                            (RealTheory.abs (F.sub Sf I))
                                            (RealTheory.abs (F.sub Sg J)))
                                          (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                                      rwa
                                        [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                                          F eps] at hadd
                                    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                      F htri hsum

theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_mul_left_integrand

      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul c (f x))
      alpha a b (RealTheory.mul c I)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  intro eps heps baseCount base hbase
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F c heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases hf.right eta heta.left baseCount base hbase with
      | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
          cases hthresholdCount with
          | intro threshold hthreshold =>
              refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
              refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
              refine And.intro hthreshold.left ?_
              refine And.intro hthreshold.right.left ?_
              intro n p tag htag href
              let Sf := stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n
              have hclose :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub Sf I)) eta := by
                dsimp [Sf]
                exact hthreshold.right.right n p tag htag href
              rw [stieltjesTagSum_mul_left_integrand]
              change
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (F.sub (F.mul c Sf) (F.mul c I)))
                  eps
              rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F c Sf I]
              rw [RealTheory.abs_mul c (F.sub Sf I)]
              have hmul_le :
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c)
                      (RealTheory.abs (F.sub Sf I)))
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) eta) :=
                RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hclose)
                  (RealTheory.abs_nonneg c)
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                F hmul_le heta.right

theorem hasRiemannStieltjesIntegralOn_add_integrator

      a b (RealTheory.add I J)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro halpha.left ?_
  intro eps heps baseCount base hbase
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases halpha.right e2 he2 baseCount base hbase with
  | intro alphaCount halphaCount =>
      cases halphaCount with
      | intro alphaThreshold halphaThreshold =>
          cases halphaThreshold with
          | intro halphaPart halphaTail =>
              cases halphaTail with
              | intro hrefAlphaBase hcloseAlpha =>
                  cases hbeta.right e2 he2 alphaCount alphaThreshold halphaPart with
                  | intro betaCount hbetaCount =>
                      cases hbetaCount with
                      | intro betaThreshold hbetaThreshold =>
                          cases hbetaThreshold with
                          | intro hbetaPart hbetaTail =>
                              cases hbetaTail with
                              | intro hrefBetaAlpha hcloseBeta =>
                                  refine Exists.intro betaCount ?_
                                  refine Exists.intro betaThreshold ?_
                                  refine And.intro hbetaPart ?_
                                  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                                  · exact partitionRefines_trans
                                      hrefBetaAlpha hrefAlphaBase
                                  · intro n p tag htag href
                                    let Salpha :=
                                      stieltjesTagSum f alpha p tag n
                                    let Sbeta :=
                                      stieltjesTagSum f beta p tag n
                                    have hrefAlpha :
                                        PartitionRefines p n
                                          alphaThreshold alphaCount :=
                                      partitionRefines_trans href hrefBetaAlpha
                                    have hcloseAlpha' :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub Salpha I))
                                          e2 := by
                                      dsimp [Salpha]
                                      exact hcloseAlpha n p tag htag hrefAlpha
                                    have hcloseBeta' :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub Sbeta J))
                                          e2 := by
                                      dsimp [Sbeta]
                                      exact hcloseBeta n p tag htag href
                                    rw [stieltjesTagSum_add_integrator
                                      f alpha beta p tag n]
                                    change
                                      RealTheory.lt
                                        (RealTheory.abs
                                          (RealTheory.sub
                                            (RealTheory.add Salpha Sbeta)
                                            (RealTheory.add I J)))
                                        eps
                                    have htri :
                                        RealTheory.le
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (RealTheory.add Salpha Sbeta)
                                              (RealTheory.add I J)))
                                          (RealTheory.add
                                            (RealTheory.abs
                                              (RealTheory.sub Salpha I))
                                            (RealTheory.abs
                                              (RealTheory.sub Sbeta J))) :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_sub_add_le_abs_sub_add_abs_sub
                                        F Salpha Sbeta I J
                                    have hsum :
                                        RealTheory.lt
                                          (RealTheory.add
                                            (RealTheory.abs
                                              (RealTheory.sub Salpha I))
                                            (RealTheory.abs
                                              (RealTheory.sub Sbeta J)))
                                          eps := by
                                      have hadd :=
                                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                                          F hcloseAlpha' hcloseBeta'
                                      change
                                        F.lt
                                          (F.add
                                            (RealTheory.abs (F.sub Salpha I))
                                            (RealTheory.abs (F.sub Sbeta J)))
                                          (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                                      rwa
                                        [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                                          F eps] at hadd
                                    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                      F htri hsum

    F (F.add L M) R (F.add L N) R]

  rw [F.add_zero]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F L M L N]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F L]
  rw [F.zero_add]
