  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hI.right e2 he2 with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro n p tag m q eta hfineP hfineQ
      let S := taggedSum f p tag n
      let T := taggedSum f q eta m
      have hcloseP :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I)) e2 :=
        hdelta.right n p tag hfineP
      have hcloseQ :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub T I)) e2 :=
        hdelta.right m q eta hfineQ
      have htri :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S T))
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I))
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub T I))) := by
        change
          RealTheory.le
            (RealFunction.dist S T)
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealFunction.dist S I)
              (RealFunction.dist T I))
        rw [RealFunction.dist_comm T I]
        exact RealFunction.dist_triangle S I T
      have hsum :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I))
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub T I)))
            eps := by
        have hadd :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hcloseP hcloseQ
        change
          F.lt
            (F.add
              (RealTheory.abs (F.sub S I))
              (RealTheory.abs (F.sub T I)))
            (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hadd
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: baseTail_eventually_lt
statement:
theorem baseTail_eventually_lt
    {q : Nat} (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q) :
    forall eps : Point,
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
        RealTheory.Eventually
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.baseTail q k) eps)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htail :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.baseTail q k)
        RealTheory.zero :=
    RealTheory.baseTail_tendsto_zero_all hq
  cases htail eps heps with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro k hk
      have hclose :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.baseTail q k)
                RealTheory.zero))
            eps :=
        hN k hk
      have hle :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.baseTail q k)
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.baseTail q k)
                RealTheory.zero)) := by
        change
          F.le (RealTheory.baseTail q k)
            (RealTheory.abs
              (F.sub (RealTheory.baseTail q k) F.zero))
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F
          (RealTheory.baseTail q k)]
        exact RealTheory.le_abs_self (RealTheory.baseTail q k)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle hclose

name: henstockKurzweilCauchySampleSums_seqCauchy
statement:
private theorem henstockKurzweilCauchySampleSums_seqCauchy
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point} {q : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b) (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q)
    (hcrit : HenstockKurzweilCauchyOn f a b) :
    RealTheory.SeqCauchy
      (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleSum hab hq hcrit)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases baseTail_eventually_lt hq eps heps with
  | intro K hK =>
      refine Exists.intro K ?_
      intro n m hn hm
      have htail_lt :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.baseTail q K) eps :=
        hK K (Nat.le_refl K)
      have hchoice :=
        henstockKurzweilCauchyChoiceGauge_spec hq hcrit K
      have hfineN :
          GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b
            (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleCount hab hq hcrit n)
            (henstockKurzweilCauchySamplePartition hab hq hcrit n)
            (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleTags hab hq hcrit n)
            (henstockKurzweilCauchyChoiceGauge hq hcrit K) :=
        henstockKurzweilCauchySample_fine_choiceGauge
          hab hq hcrit hn
      have hfineM :
          GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b
            (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleCount hab hq hcrit m)
            (henstockKurzweilCauchySamplePartition hab hq hcrit m)
            (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleTags hab hq hcrit m)
            (henstockKurzweilCauchyChoiceGauge hq hcrit K) :=
        henstockKurzweilCauchySample_fine_choiceGauge
          hab hq hcrit hm
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
        (hchoice.right
          (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleCount hab hq hcrit n)
          (henstockKurzweilCauchySamplePartition hab hq hcrit n)
          (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleTags hab hq hcrit n)
          (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleCount hab hq hcrit m)
          (henstockKurzweilCauchySamplePartition hab hq hcrit m)
          (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleTags hab hq hcrit m)
          hfineN hfineM)
        htail_lt

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_cauchyCriterion_seqTendsto
statement:
private theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_cauchyCriterion_seqTendsto
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point} {q : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b) (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q)
    (hcrit : HenstockKurzweilCauchyOn f a b)
    (hsums :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleSum hab hq hcrit) I) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b I
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hab ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases baseTail_eventually_lt hq e2 he2_pos with
  | intro K hK =>
      have htail_lt :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.baseTail q K) e2 :=
        hK K (Nat.le_refl K)
      let delta := henstockKurzweilCauchyChoiceGauge hq hcrit K
      have hdelta_spec :=
        henstockKurzweilCauchyChoiceGauge_spec hq hcrit K
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta_spec.left ?_
      intro n p tag hfine
      cases hsums e2 he2_pos with
      | intro Nclose hNclose =>
          let N := Nat.max K Nclose
          let s := taggedSum f p tag n
          let sample :=
            henstockKurzweilCauchySampleSum hab hq hcrit N
          have hsample_fine :
              GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b
                (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleCount hab hq hcrit N)
                (henstockKurzweilCauchySamplePartition hab hq hcrit N)
                (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleTags hab hq hcrit N)
                delta :=
            henstockKurzweilCauchySample_fine_choiceGauge
              hab hq hcrit (Nat.le_max_left K Nclose)
          have hcauchy :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub s sample))
                e2 := by
            have hcauchy_tail :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.sub s sample))
                  (RealTheory.baseTail q K) := by
              dsimp [s, sample, henstockKurzweilCauchySampleSum]
              exact hdelta_spec.right
                n p tag
                (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleCount hab hq hcrit N)
                (henstockKurzweilCauchySamplePartition hab hq hcrit N)
                (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleTags hab hq hcrit N)
                hfine hsample_fine
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
              hcauchy_tail htail_lt
          have hcauchy_rev :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub sample s))
                e2 := by
            change F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sample s)) e2
            rwa [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm sample s]
          have hsample_close :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub sample I))
                e2 := by
            dsimp [sample, N]
            exact hNclose (Nat.max K Nclose)
              (Nat.le_max_right K Nclose)
          have htri :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub s I))
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sample s))
                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sample I))) :=
            by
              change
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealFunction.dist s I)
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealFunction.dist sample s)
                    (RealFunction.dist sample I))
              rw [RealFunction.dist_comm sample s]
              exact RealFunction.dist_triangle s sample I
          have hsum :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sample s))
                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sample I)))
                eps := by
            have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
              F hcauchy_rev hsample_close
            change
              F.lt
                (F.add
                  (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sample s))
                  (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sample I)))
                (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
            rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hadd
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_cauchyCriterion
statement:
theorem exists_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_cauchyCriterion
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hcrit : HenstockKurzweilCauchyOn f a b) :
    Exists (fun I : Point => HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b I)
proof:
:= by
  have htwo : RealTheory.ValidBase 2 := by
    unfold RealTheory.ValidBase
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
    omega
  have hseq :
      RealTheory.SeqCauchy
        (henstockKurzweilCauchySampleSum hab htwo hcrit) :=
    henstockKurzweilCauchySampleSums_seqCauchy hab htwo hcrit
  cases RealTheory.seqCauchy_converges hseq with
  | intro I hI =>
      refine Exists.intro I ?_
      exact hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_of_cauchyCriterion_seqTendsto
        hab htwo hcrit hI

name: henstockKurzweilCauchyOn_subinterval
statement:
private theorem henstockKurzweilCauchyOn_subinterval
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c d b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d)
    (hdb : RealTheory.le d b)
    (hcrit : HenstockKurzweilCauchyOn f a b) :
    HenstockKurzweilCauchyOn f c d
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hcd ?_
  intro eps heps
  cases hcrit.right eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_completionSides
          hac hcd hdb hdelta.left with
      | intro leftCount hleftCount =>
          cases hleftCount with
          | intro left hleft =>
              cases hleft with
              | intro leftTag hleftTag =>
                  cases hleftTag with
                  | intro rightCount hrightCount =>
                      cases hrightCount with
                      | intro right hright =>
                          cases hright with
                          | intro rightTag hsides =>
                              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                              refine And.intro
                                (closedIntervalGaugeOn_subinterval
                                  hdelta.left hac hdb) ?_
                              intro n p tag m q eta hfineP hfineQ
                              let wholeP :=
                                adjacentPartition
                                  (adjacentPartition left p leftCount)
                                  right (leftCount + n)
                              let wholeTagP :=
                                adjacentTags
                                  (adjacentTags leftTag tag leftCount)
                                  rightTag (leftCount + n)
                              let wholeQ :=
                                adjacentPartition
                                  (adjacentPartition left q leftCount)
                                  right (leftCount + m)
                              let wholeTagQ :=
                                adjacentTags
                                  (adjacentTags leftTag eta leftCount)
                                  rightTag (leftCount + m)
                              have hwholeP :
                                  GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b
                                    ((leftCount + n) + rightCount)
                                    wholeP wholeTagP delta := by
                                dsimp [wholeP, wholeTagP]
                                exact
                                  gaugeFineTaggedPartition_three_adjacent
                                    hsides.left hfineP hsides.right
                              have hwholeQ :
                                  GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b
                                    ((leftCount + m) + rightCount)
                                    wholeQ wholeTagQ delta := by
                                dsimp [wholeQ, wholeTagQ]
                                exact
                                  gaugeFineTaggedPartition_three_adjacent
                                    hsides.left hfineQ hsides.right
                              have hglobal :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealTheory.abs
                                      (RealTheory.sub
                                        (taggedSum f wholeP wholeTagP
                                          ((leftCount + n) + rightCount))
                                        (taggedSum f wholeQ wholeTagQ
                                          ((leftCount + m) + rightCount))))
                                    eps :=
                                hdelta.right
                                  ((leftCount + n) + rightCount)
                                  wholeP wholeTagP
                                  ((leftCount + m) + rightCount)
                                  wholeQ wholeTagQ
                                  hwholeP hwholeQ
                              have hsumP :
                                  taggedSum f wholeP wholeTagP
                                      ((leftCount + n) + rightCount) =
                                    RealTheory.add
                                      (RealTheory.add
                                        (taggedSum f left leftTag leftCount)
                                        (taggedSum f p tag n))
                                      (taggedSum f right rightTag
                                        rightCount) := by
                                dsimp [wholeP, wholeTagP]
                                exact taggedSum_three_adjacent f
                                  hsides.left.left hfineP.left
                                  hsides.right.left
                              have hsumQ :
                                  taggedSum f wholeQ wholeTagQ
                                      ((leftCount + m) + rightCount) =
                                    RealTheory.add
                                      (RealTheory.add
                                        (taggedSum f left leftTag leftCount)
                                        (taggedSum f q eta m))
                                      (taggedSum f right rightTag
                                        rightCount) := by
                                dsimp [wholeQ, wholeTagQ]
                                exact taggedSum_three_adjacent f
                                  hsides.left.left hfineQ.left
                                  hsides.right.left
                              rw [hsumP, hsumQ] at hglobal
                              rw [<-
                                sub_add_same_left_right_eq_sub_middle
                                  (taggedSum f left leftTag leftCount)
                                  (taggedSum f p tag n)
                                  (taggedSum f q eta m)
                                  (taggedSum f right rightTag
                                    rightCount)]
                              exact hglobal

statement:
theorem henstockKurzweilCauchyOn_subinterval_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c d b I : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique_of_le
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique_of_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b I)
    (hJ : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b J) :
    I = J
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply RealFunction.eq_of_forall_dist_lt
  intro eps heps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hI.right e2 he2 with
  | intro deltaI hdeltaI =>
      cases hJ.right e2 he2 with
      | intro deltaJ hdeltaJ =>
          let delta :=
            fun x : Point => RealTheory.min (deltaI x) (deltaJ x)
          have hdelta :
              ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta :=
            closedIntervalGaugeOn_min hdeltaI.left hdeltaJ.left
          cases
              exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_closedIntervalGaugeOn
                hab hdelta with
          | intro n hn =>
              cases hn with
              | intro p hp =>
                  cases hp with
                  | intro tag hfine =>
                      have hfineI :
                          GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag deltaI :=
                        gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le hfine
                          (fun x : Point =>
                            RealTheory.min_le_left
                              (deltaI x) (deltaJ x))
                      have hfineJ :
                          GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag deltaJ :=
                        gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le hfine
                          (fun x : Point =>
                            RealTheory.min_le_right
                              (deltaI x) (deltaJ x))
                      have hcloseI :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub
                                (taggedSum f p tag n) I))
                            e2 :=
                        hdeltaI.right n p tag hfineI
                      have hcloseJ :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub
                                (taggedSum f p tag n) J))
                            e2 :=
                        hdeltaJ.right n p tag hfineJ
                      let S := taggedSum f p tag n
                      have htri :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I J))
                            (RealTheory.add
                              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I))
                              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S J))) :=
                        by
                          change
                            RealTheory.le
                              (RealFunction.dist I J)
                              (RealTheory.add
                                (RealFunction.dist S I)
                                (RealFunction.dist S J))
                          rw [RealFunction.dist_comm S I]
                          exact RealFunction.dist_triangle I S J
                      have hsum :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.add
                              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I))
                              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S J)))
                            eps := by
                        have hadd :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                            F hcloseI hcloseJ
                        change
                          F.lt
                            (F.add
                              (RealTheory.abs (F.sub S I))
                              (RealTheory.abs (F.sub S J)))
                            (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps]
                          at hadd
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hI : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b I)
    (hJ : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b J) :
    I = J
proof:
:=
  hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_unique_of_le hI.left hI hJ

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_zero_of_le
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_zero_of_le
    {a b : Point} (hab : RealTheory.le a b) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
      (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero) a b RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hab ?_
  intro eps heps
  refine Exists.intro (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one) ?_
  refine And.intro (closedIntervalGaugeOn_const RealTheory.zero_lt_one) ?_
  intro n p tag _hfine
  rw [taggedSum_zero p tag n]
  change
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub
          RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero))
      eps
  rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_self RealTheory.zero]
  exact heps

name: hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_degenerate
statement:
theorem hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn_degenerate
    (f : Point -> Point) (a : Point) :
    HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a a RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) ?_
  intro eps heps
  refine Exists.intro (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one) ?_
  refine And.intro (closedIntervalGaugeOn_const RealTheory.zero_lt_one) ?_
  intro n p tag hfine
  rw [taggedSum_eq_zero_of_degenerate hfine.left]
  change
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub
          RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero))
      eps
  rw [RealTheory.abs_sub_self RealTheory.zero]
  exact heps

name: cutAdaptedGauge_le_left_of_le
statement:
theorem cutAdaptedGauge_le_left_of_le
    {c x : Point} {deltaLeft deltaRight : Point -> Point}
    (hxc : RealTheory.le x c) :
    RealTheory.le
      (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight x)
      (deltaLeft x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cutAdaptedGauge
  classical
  by_cases hx : x = c
  case pos =>
    rw [if_pos hx]
    exact RealTheory.min_le_left (deltaLeft x) (deltaRight x)
  case neg =>
    rw [if_neg hx]
    rw [if_pos hxc]
    exact RealTheory.min_le_left (deltaLeft x) (RealFunction.dist x c)

name: cutAdaptedGauge_le_right_of_le
statement:
theorem cutAdaptedGauge_le_right_of_le
    {c x : Point} {deltaLeft deltaRight : Point -> Point}
    (hcx : RealTheory.le c x) :
    RealTheory.le
      (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight x)
      (deltaRight x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cutAdaptedGauge
  classical
  by_cases hx : x = c
  case pos =>
    rw [if_pos hx]
    exact RealTheory.min_le_right (deltaLeft x) (deltaRight x)
  case neg =>
    rw [if_neg hx]
    have hnot : Not (RealTheory.le x c) := by
      intro hxc
      exact hx (RealTheory.le_antisymm hxc hcx)
    rw [if_neg hnot]
    exact RealTheory.min_le_left (deltaRight x) (RealFunction.dist x c)

statement:

proof:

name: closedIntervalGaugeOn_cutAdaptedGauge
statement:
theorem closedIntervalGaugeOn_cutAdaptedGauge
    {a c b : Point} {deltaLeft deltaRight : Point -> Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hleft : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a c deltaLeft)
    (hright : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn c b deltaRight) :
    ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b
      (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold cutAdaptedGauge
  classical
  by_cases hxc_eq : x = c
  case pos =>
    rw [if_pos hxc_eq]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
      (hleft x (by
        rw [hxc_eq]
        exact And.intro hac (RealTheory.le_refl c)))
      (hright x (by
        rw [hxc_eq]
        exact And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl c) hcb))
  case neg =>
    rw [if_neg hxc_eq]
    have hdist_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealFunction.dist x c) :=
      RealFunction.dist_pos_of_ne hxc_eq
    by_cases hxc : RealTheory.le x c
    case pos =>
      rw [if_pos hxc]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
        (hleft x (And.intro hx.left hxc))
        hdist_pos
    case neg =>
      rw [if_neg hxc]
      have hcx : RealTheory.le c x := by
        cases RealTheory.le_total c x with
        | inl h => exact h
        | inr hxle => exact False.elim (hxc hxle)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
        (hright x (And.intro hcx hx.right))
        hdist_pos

name: gaugeFineCell_cutAdaptedGauge_tag_eq_of_mem_cut
statement:
theorem gaugeFineCell_cutAdaptedGauge_tag_eq_of_mem_cut
    {c : Point} {deltaLeft deltaRight : Point -> Point}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineCell p tag
        (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight) k)
    (hcut : PartitionCell p k c) :
    tag k = c
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases htag : tag k = c
  case pos =>
    exact htag
  case neg =>
    have hlt :
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealFunction.dist c (tag k))
          (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight (tag k)) :=
      hfine c hcut
    have hle :
        RealTheory.le
          (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight (tag k))
          (RealFunction.dist (tag k) c) :=
      cutAdaptedGauge_le_dist_of_ne htag
    have hlt_self :
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealFunction.dist (tag k) c)
          (RealFunction.dist (tag k) c) := by
      rw [RealFunction.dist_comm c (tag k)] at hlt
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hlt hle
    exact False.elim
      ((IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F
        (RealFunction.dist (tag k) c)) hlt_self)

name: finiteMinGauge_le
statement:
theorem finiteMinGauge_le
    (delta : Nat -> Point -> Point) :
    forall {n k : Nat},
      k < n ->
        forall x : Point,
          RealTheory.le (finiteMinGauge delta n x) (delta k x)
  | 0, k, hk, _x => by
      exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk)
  | n + 1, k, hk, x => by
      by_cases hkn : k = n
      case pos =>
        rw [hkn]
        change
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.min (finiteMinGauge delta n x) (delta n x))
            (delta n x)
        exact RealTheory.min_le_right
          (finiteMinGauge delta n x) (delta n x)
      case neg =>
        have hk_lt_n : k < n
proof:
:= by
          omega
        have ih :
            RealTheory.le (finiteMinGauge delta n x) (delta k x) :=
          finiteMinGauge_le delta hk_lt_n x
        have hmin :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.min (finiteMinGauge delta n x) (delta n x))
              (finiteMinGauge delta n x) :=
          RealTheory.min_le_left
            (finiteMinGauge delta n x) (delta n x)
        exact RealTheory.le_trans hmin ih

name: closedIntervalGaugeOn_finiteMinGauge
statement:
theorem closedIntervalGaugeOn_finiteMinGauge
    {a b : Point} (delta : Nat -> Point -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k < n -> ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b (delta k)) ->
        ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b (finiteMinGauge delta n)
  | 0, _hgauge => by
      intro _x _hx
      change RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero RealTheory.one
      exact RealTheory.zero_lt_one
  | n + 1, hgauge => by
      change
        ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b
          (fun x : Point =>
            RealTheory.min (finiteMinGauge delta n x) (delta n x))
      exact closedIntervalGaugeOn_min
        (closedIntervalGaugeOn_finiteMinGauge delta n
          (fun k hk =>
            hgauge k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n))))
        (hgauge n (Nat.lt_succ_self n))

name: gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cutCellPrefix
statement:
private theorem gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cutCellPrefix
    {a b c : Point} {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    {deltaLeft deltaRight : Point -> Point}
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
        (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight))
    (hk : k < n)
    (hcut : PartitionCell p k c) :
    GaugeFineTaggedPartition a c (k + 1)
      (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
      (cutCellPrefixTags tag k c)
      deltaLeft
proof:
:= by
  have htagged :
      TaggedPartition a c (k + 1)
        (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
        (cutCellPrefixTags tag k c) :=
    taggedPartition_cutCellPrefix hfine.left hk hcut
  refine And.intro htagged ?_
  intro i hi
  by_cases hik : i < k
  · have hne : Not (i = k) := by
      omega
    have hi_old : i < n := Nat.lt_trans hik hk
    have htag_cell :
        PartitionCell (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c) i
          (cutCellPrefixTags tag k c i) :=
      htagged.right i hi
    have hclosed :
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c
          (cutCellPrefixTags tag k c i) :=
      intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
        htagged.left hi htag_cell
    unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.GaugeFineCell
    intro y hy
    rw [cutCellPrefixTags_of_ne hne]
    have hy_old : PartitionCell p i y :=
      (partitionCell_cutCellPrefixPartition_of_lt p k c y hik).mp hy
    have hlt :
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealFunction.dist y (tag i))
          (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight (tag i)) :=
      hfine.right i hi_old y hy_old
    have hle :
        RealTheory.le
          (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight (tag i))
          (deltaLeft (tag i)) := by
      have htag_eq :
          cutCellPrefixTags tag k c i = tag i :=
        cutCellPrefixTags_of_ne hne
      rw [htag_eq] at hclosed
      exact cutAdaptedGauge_le_left_of_le hclosed.right
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hlt hle
  · have hik_eq : i = k := by
      omega
    subst i
    unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.GaugeFineCell
    intro y hy
    rw [cutCellPrefixTags_split]
    have hy_split :
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval (p k) c y :=
      (partitionCell_cutCellPrefixPartition_split p k c y).mp hy
    have hy_old : PartitionCell p k y :=
      And.intro hy_split.left
        (RealTheory.le_trans hy_split.right hcut.right)
    have htag_eq : tag k = c :=
      gaugeFineCell_cutAdaptedGauge_tag_eq_of_mem_cut
        (hfine.right k hk) hcut
    have hlt :
        RealTheory.lt
          (RealFunction.dist y c)
          (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight c) := by
      have hwhole := hfine.right k hk y hy_old
      rwa [htag_eq] at hwhole
    have hle :
        RealTheory.le
          (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight c)
          (deltaLeft c) :=
      cutAdaptedGauge_le_left_of_le (RealTheory.le_refl c)
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hlt hle

name: gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cutCellSuffix
statement:
private theorem gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cutCellSuffix
    {a b c : Point} {n k : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    {deltaLeft deltaRight : Point -> Point}
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
        (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight))
    (hk : k < n)
    (hcut : PartitionCell p k c) :
    GaugeFineTaggedPartition c b (n - k)
      (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)
      (cutCellSuffixTags tag k c)
      deltaRight
proof:
:= by
  have htagged :
      TaggedPartition c b (n - k)
        (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)
        (cutCellSuffixTags tag k c) :=
    taggedPartition_cutCellSuffix hfine.left hk hcut
  refine And.intro htagged ?_
  intro i hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.GaugeFineCell
      intro y hy
      rw [cutCellSuffixTags_zero]
      have hy_split :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval c (p (k + 1)) y :=
        (partitionCell_cutCellSuffixPartition_zero p k c y).mp hy
      have hy_old : PartitionCell p k y :=
        And.intro
          (RealTheory.le_trans hcut.left hy_split.left)
          hy_split.right
      have htag_eq : tag k = c :=
        gaugeFineCell_cutAdaptedGauge_tag_eq_of_mem_cut
          (hfine.right k hk) hcut
      have hlt :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealFunction.dist y c)
            (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight c) := by
        have hwhole := hfine.right k hk y hy_old
        rwa [htag_eq] at hwhole
      have hle :
          RealTheory.le
            (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight c)
            (deltaRight c) :=
        cutAdaptedGauge_le_right_of_le (RealTheory.le_refl c)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hlt hle
  | succ i =>
      have hold : k + i + 1 < n := by
        omega
      have htag_cell :
          PartitionCell (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c) (i + 1)
            (cutCellSuffixTags tag k c (i + 1)) :=
        htagged.right (i + 1) hi
      have hclosed :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval c b
            (cutCellSuffixTags tag k c (i + 1)) :=
        intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
          htagged.left hi htag_cell
      unfold Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.GaugeFineCell
      intro y hy
      rw [cutCellSuffixTags_succ]
      have hy_old : PartitionCell p (k + i + 1) y :=
        (partitionCell_cutCellSuffixPartition_succ p k i c y).mp hy
      have hlt :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealFunction.dist y (tag (k + i + 1)))
            (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight
              (tag (k + i + 1))) :=
        hfine.right (k + i + 1) hold y hy_old
      have hle :
          RealTheory.le
            (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight
              (tag (k + i + 1)))
            (deltaRight (tag (k + i + 1))) := by
        rw [cutCellSuffixTags_succ] at hclosed
        exact cutAdaptedGauge_le_right_of_le hclosed.left
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hlt hle

name: exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cutCellSplit_of_pos
statement:
theorem exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cutCellSplit_of_pos
    {a b c : Point} {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    {deltaLeft deltaRight : Point -> Point}
    (hfine :
      GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag
        (cutAdaptedGauge c deltaLeft deltaRight))
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c) :
    Exists
      (fun k : Nat =>
        And (k < n)
          (And (PartitionCell p k c)
            (And
              (GaugeFineTaggedPartition a c (k + 1)
                (cutCellPrefixPartition p k c)
                (cutCellPrefixTags tag k c)
                deltaLeft)
              (GaugeFineTaggedPartition c b (n - k)
                (cutCellSuffixPartition p k c)
                (cutCellSuffixTags tag k c)
                deltaRight))))
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hn)
  | succ m =>
      cases intervalPartition_cell_cover_succ
          (n := m) (p := p) hfine.left.left hc with
      | intro k hk =>
          exact
            Exists.intro k
              (And.intro hk.left
                (And.intro hk.right
                  (And.intro
                    (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cutCellPrefix
                      hfine hk.left hk.right)
                    (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_cutCellSuffix
                      hfine hk.left hk.right))))

statement:
theorem gaugeFineTaggedPartition_three_adjacent
    {a c d b : Point}
    {left mid right leftTag midTag rightTag : Nat -> Point}
    {leftCount midCount rightCount : Nat} {delta : Point -> Point}

                GaugeFineTaggedPartition a b n p tag delta)))

name: exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_completionSides
statement:
theorem exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_completionSides
    {a c d b : Point} {delta : Point -> Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcd : RealTheory.le c d)
    (hdb : RealTheory.le d b)
    (hdelta : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta) :
    Exists
      (fun leftCount : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun left : Nat -> Point =>
            Exists
              (fun leftTag : Nat -> Point =>
                Exists
                  (fun rightCount : Nat =>
                    Exists
                      (fun right : Nat -> Point =>
                        Exists
                          (fun rightTag : Nat -> Point =>
                            And
                              (GaugeFineTaggedPartition a c
                                leftCount left leftTag delta)
                              (GaugeFineTaggedPartition d b
                                rightCount right rightTag delta)))))))
proof:
:= by
  have hcb : RealTheory.le c b := RealTheory.le_trans hcd hdb
  have had : RealTheory.le a d := RealTheory.le_trans hac hcd
  have hdelta_left : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a c delta :=
    closedIntervalGaugeOn_subinterval hdelta
      (RealTheory.le_refl a) hcb
  have hdelta_right : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn d b delta :=
    closedIntervalGaugeOn_subinterval hdelta
      had (RealTheory.le_refl b)
  cases exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_closedIntervalGaugeOn
      hac hdelta_left with
  | intro leftCount hleftCount =>
      cases hleftCount with
      | intro left hleft =>
          cases hleft with
          | intro leftTag hleftFine =>
              cases exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_closedIntervalGaugeOn
                  hdb hdelta_right with
              | intro rightCount hrightCount =>
                  cases hrightCount with
                  | intro right hright =>
                      cases hright with
                      | intro rightTag hrightFine =>
                          refine Exists.intro leftCount ?_
                          refine Exists.intro left ?_
                          refine Exists.intro leftTag ?_
                          refine Exists.intro rightCount ?_
                          refine Exists.intro right ?_
                          refine Exists.intro rightTag ?_
                          exact And.intro hleftFine hrightFine

    (hfine : forall i : iota, List.Mem i indices -> forall y : Point,
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval (left i) (right i) y ->
        RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y (tag i)) (delta (tag i))) :

      (fun k => tag (indices.getD k fallback)) delta

name: finiteSum_partialCellLength_of_indexList_eq_intervalListLength
statement:
theorem finiteSum_partialCellLength_of_indexList_eq_intervalListLength
    {iota : Type u} (indices : List iota) (fallback : iota)
    (left right : iota -> Point) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (partialCellLength
          (fun k => left (indices.getD k fallback))
          (fun k => right (indices.getD k fallback)))
        indices.length =
      RealInterval.intervalListLength left right indices
proof:
:= by
  induction indices with
  | nil =>
      change RealTheory.finiteSum _ 0 = RealTheory.zero
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  | cons head tail ih =>
      let projected : Nat -> Point :=
        partialCellLength
          (fun k => left ((head :: tail).getD k fallback))
          (fun k => right ((head :: tail).getD k fallback))
      let prepended : Nat -> Point := fun k =>
        match k with
        | 0 => RealTheory.sub (right head) (left head)
        | j + 1 =>
            partialCellLength
              (fun m => left (tail.getD m fallback))
              (fun m => right (tail.getD m fallback)) j
      have hterms : forall k : Nat, k < tail.length + 1 ->
          projected k = prepended k := by
        intro k hk
        cases k with
        | zero =>
            simp [projected, prepended, partialCellLength, List.getD]
        | succ j =>
            simp [projected, prepended, partialCellLength, List.getD]
      have hsum :
          RealTheory.finiteSum projected (tail.length + 1) =
            RealTheory.finiteSum prepended (tail.length + 1) :=
        RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt (tail.length + 1) hterms
      change
        RealTheory.finiteSum projected (tail.length + 1) =
          RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub (right head) (left head))
            (RealInterval.intervalListLength left right tail)
      rw [hsum]
      have hprepend :
          RealTheory.finiteSum prepended (tail.length + 1) =
            RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub (right head) (left head))
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (partialCellLength
                  (fun m => left (tail.getD m fallback))
                  (fun m => right (tail.getD m fallback)))
                tail.length) := by
        simpa [prepended] using
          (RealTheory.finiteSum_prepend
            (RealTheory.sub (right head) (left head))
            (partialCellLength
              (fun m => left (tail.getD m fallback))
              (fun m => right (tail.getD m fallback)))
            tail.length)
      rw [hprepend, ih]

        exact (partialTaggedDivision_left_mem_closedInterval h hn).left

  | succ j =>

      by_cases hsucc : j + 1 < n
      · rw [partialGapRight_of_lt hsucc]
        exact partialTaggedDivision_step_le h hsucc

name: exists_partialTaggedDivisionGapCompletion
statement:
theorem exists_partialTaggedDivisionGapCompletion
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat}
    {left right tag : Nat -> Point} {delta : Point -> Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hdiv : PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag)
    (hdelta : ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta) :
    Exists
      (fun gapCount : (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun gapPartition :
            (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat -> Point =>
            Exists
              (fun gapTag :
                (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat -> Point =>
                PartialTaggedDivisionGapCompletion
                  a b n left right delta
                  gapCount gapPartition gapTag)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let gapWitness :
      forall (i : Nat) (hi : i <= n),
        Exists
          (fun m : Nat =>
            Exists
              (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
                Exists
                  (fun localTag : Nat -> Point =>
                    GaugeFineTaggedPartition
                      (partialGapLeft a b n left right i)
                      (partialGapRight a b n left right i)
                      m p localTag delta))) :=
    fun i hi =>
      exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_closedIntervalGaugeOn
        (partialTaggedDivision_gap_le hab hdiv hi)
        (closedIntervalGaugeOn_subinterval hdelta
          (partialTaggedDivision_gap_left_lower hdiv hi)
          (partialTaggedDivision_gap_right_upper hdiv))
  let gapCount : (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat :=
    fun i hi => Classical.choose (gapWitness i hi)
  let gapPartition : (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat -> Point :=
    fun i hi => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (gapWitness i hi))
  let gapTag : (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat -> Point :=
    fun i hi =>
      Classical.choose
        (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec (gapWitness i hi)))
  refine Exists.intro gapCount ?_
  refine Exists.intro gapPartition ?_
  refine Exists.intro gapTag ?_
  intro i hi
  dsimp [gapCount, gapPartition, gapTag]
  exact
    Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec (gapWitness i hi)))

name: taggedCellSubpartition_partialTaggedDivision

theorem taggedCellSubpartition_partialTaggedDivision
    {a b : Point} {total selected : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point} {index : Nat -> Nat}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b total p tag)
    (hsub : TaggedCellSubpartition total selected index) :
    PartialTaggedDivision a b selected
      (subpartitionLeft p index)
      (subpartitionRight p index)
      (subpartitionTags tag index)
proof:
:= by
  exact And.intro
    (fun k hk => by
      have hidx : index k < total := hsub.left k hk
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · unfold subpartitionLeft
        exact
          Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left
            htag.left hidx
      · refine And.intro ?_ ?_
        · unfold subpartitionRight
          exact
            Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right
              htag.left hidx
        · unfold PartialCell subpartitionLeft subpartitionRight
          unfold subpartitionTags
          exact taggedPartition_tag_mem_cell htag hidx)
    (fun k hk => by
      have hidx_lt : index k < index (k + 1) :=
        hsub.right k hk
      have hnext_total : index (k + 1) < total :=
        hsub.left (k + 1) hk
      unfold subpartitionRight subpartitionLeft
      exact
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
          htag.left
          (index k + 1)
          (index (k + 1))
          (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hidx_lt)
          (Nat.le_of_lt hnext_total))

name: taggedCellSubpartition_partialTaggedDivisionOn
statement:
theorem taggedCellSubpartition_partialTaggedDivisionOn
    {a b l r : Point} {total selected : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point} {index : Nat -> Nat}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b total p tag)
    (hsub : TaggedCellSubpartition total selected index)
    (hleft :
      forall k : Nat, k < selected ->
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval l r (subpartitionLeft p index k))
    (hright :
      forall k : Nat, k < selected ->
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval l r (subpartitionRight p index k)) :
    PartialTaggedDivision l r selected
      (subpartitionLeft p index)
      (subpartitionRight p index)
      (subpartitionTags tag index)
proof:
:= by
  exact And.intro
    (fun k hk => by
      have hidx : index k < total := hsub.left k hk
      refine And.intro (hleft k hk) ?_
      refine And.intro (hright k hk) ?_
      unfold PartialCell subpartitionLeft subpartitionRight subpartitionTags
      exact taggedPartition_tag_mem_cell htag hidx)
    (fun k hk => by
      have hidx_lt : index k < index (k + 1) :=
        hsub.right k hk
      have hnext_total : index (k + 1) < total :=
        hsub.left (k + 1) hk
      unfold subpartitionRight subpartitionLeft
      exact
        Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.intervalPartition_le_of_le
          htag.left
          (index k + 1)
          (index (k + 1))
          (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hidx_lt)
          (Nat.le_of_lt hnext_total))

name: taggedCellSubpartition_tag_mem_closedIntervalOn
statement:
theorem taggedCellSubpartition_tag_mem_closedIntervalOn
    {a b l r : Point} {total selected : Nat}
    {p tag : Nat -> Point} {index : Nat -> Nat}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b total p tag)
    (hsub : TaggedCellSubpartition total selected index)
    (hleft :
      forall k : Nat, k < selected ->
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval l r (subpartitionLeft p index k))
    (hright :
      forall k : Nat, k < selected ->
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval l r (subpartitionRight p index k)) :
    forall k : Nat, k < selected ->
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval l r (subpartitionTags tag index k)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  have hidx : index k < total := hsub.left k hk
  have htagCell : PartitionCell p (index k) (tag (index k)) :=
    taggedPartition_tag_mem_cell htag hidx
  unfold subpartitionTags
  exact And.intro
    (RealTheory.le_trans (hleft k hk).left htagCell.left)
    (RealTheory.le_trans htagCell.right (hright k hk).right)

name: taggedPartition_one_of_partialCell
statement:
private theorem taggedPartition_one_of_partialCell

      (twoPointPartition (left k) (right k))
      (fun _j : Nat => tag k)

    (twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hle) ?_
  intro j hj

name: gaugeFineTaggedPartition_one_of_gaugeFinePartialCell

    {left right tag : Nat -> Point} {delta : Point -> Point}

name: partialCompletionPrefix_gaugeFineTaggedPartition
statement:
private theorem partialCompletionPrefix_gaugeFineTaggedPartition
    {a b : Point} {n k : Nat}
    {left right tag : Nat -> Point} {delta : Point -> Point}
    {gapCount : (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat}
    {gapPartition gapTag :
      (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat -> Point}
    (hdiv : PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag)
    (hfine :
      GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag delta)
    (hgap : PartialTaggedDivisionGapCompletion
      a b n left right delta gapCount gapPartition gapTag)
    (hk : k <= n) :
    GaugeFineTaggedPartition
      a
      (partialGapRight a b n left right k)
      (partialCompletionPrefixCount gapCount k hk)
      (partialCompletionPrefixPartition
        a b left right gapCount gapPartition k hk)
      (partialCompletionPrefixTags
        a b left right tag gapCount gapTag k hk)
      delta
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      have hzero := hgap 0 hk
      rw [partialGapLeft_zero] at hzero
      simpa [partialCompletionPrefixCount,
        partialCompletionPrefixPartition,
        partialCompletionPrefixTags] using hzero
  | succ k ih =>
      have hk_le : k <= n := Nat.le_of_succ_le hk
      have hk_lt : k < n := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hk
      have hprefix :
          GaugeFineTaggedPartition
            a (left k)
            (partialCompletionPrefixCount gapCount k hk_le)
            (partialCompletionPrefixPartition
              a b left right gapCount gapPartition k hk_le)
            (partialCompletionPrefixTags
              a b left right tag gapCount gapTag k hk_le)
            delta := by
        have hraw := ih hk_le
        rw [partialGapRight_of_lt hk_lt] at hraw
        exact hraw
      have hcell :
          GaugeFineTaggedPartition (left k) (right k) 1
            (twoPointPartition (left k) (right k))
            (fun _j : Nat => tag k) delta :=
        gaugeFineTaggedPartition_one_of_gaugeFinePartialCell
          (partialTaggedDivision_cell_le hdiv hk_lt)
          (partialTaggedDivision_tag_mem_cell hdiv hk_lt)
          (gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision_cell_fine hfine hk_lt)
      have hnext :
          GaugeFineTaggedPartition
            (right k)
            (partialGapRight a b n left right (k + 1))
            (gapCount (k + 1) hk)
            (gapPartition (k + 1) hk)
            (gapTag (k + 1) hk)
            delta := by
        have hraw := hgap (k + 1) hk
        rw [partialGapLeft_of_pos (Nat.succ_pos k)] at hraw
        simpa using hraw
      simpa [partialCompletionPrefixCount,
        partialCompletionPrefixPartition,
        partialCompletionPrefixTags] using
        (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_adjacent
          (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_adjacent hprefix hcell)
          hnext)

name: partialCompletion_gaugeFineTaggedPartition
statement:
private theorem partialCompletion_gaugeFineTaggedPartition
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat}
    {left right tag : Nat -> Point} {delta : Point -> Point}

      (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat -> Point}

      (partialCompletionCount gapCount)
      (partialCompletionPartition a b left right gapCount gapPartition)
      (partialCompletionTags a b left right tag gapCount gapTag)

      (delta := delta)

      (gapTag := gapTag)

name: partialReplacementPrefix_gaugeFineTaggedPartition
statement:
private theorem partialReplacementPrefix_gaugeFineTaggedPartition
    {a b : Point} {n k : Nat}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {delta : Point -> Point}

      (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat -> Point}

      a

        a b left right gapCount gapPartition
        replacementCount replacementPartition k hk)

        a b left right gapCount gapTag
        replacementCount replacementTag k hk)
      delta
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      have hzero := hgap 0 hk

        partialReplacementPrefixPartition,

  | succ k ih =>
      have hk_le : k <= n := Nat.le_of_succ_le hk
      have hk_lt : k < n := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hk

            (gapCount (k + 1) hk)

            (gapTag (k + 1) hk)
            delta := by
        have hraw := hgap (k + 1) hk
        rw [partialGapLeft_of_pos (Nat.succ_pos k)] at hraw
        simpa using hraw
      simpa [partialReplacementPrefixCount,
        partialReplacementPrefixPartition,
        partialReplacementPrefixTags] using
        (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_adjacent
          (gaugeFineTaggedPartition_adjacent hprefix hblock)

statement:
private theorem partialReplacement_gaugeFineTaggedPartition

name: sub_add_same_right_eq_sub
statement:
private theorem sub_add_same_right_eq_sub
    (X Y R : Point) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.add X R)
        (RealTheory.add Y R) =
      RealTheory.sub X Y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.sub (F.add X R) (F.add Y R) = F.sub X Y
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F X R Y R]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F R]
  rw [F.add_zero]

name: add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub_point
statement:
theorem add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub_point
    (X Y A B : Point) :

        (RealTheory.sub X A)
        (RealTheory.sub Y B)
proof:

  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.sub (F.add X Y) (F.add A B) =
    F.add (F.sub X A) (F.sub Y B)

name: partialCompletionReplacementPrefixTaggedSum_sub
statement:
private theorem partialCompletionReplacementPrefixTaggedSum_sub
    (f : Point -> Point)
    {a b : Point} {n k : Nat}
    {left right tag : Nat -> Point} {delta : Point -> Point}
    {gapCount : (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat}
    {gapPartition gapTag :
      (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat -> Point}
    {replacementCount : (j : Nat) -> j < n -> Nat}
    {replacementPartition replacementTag :
      (j : Nat) -> j < n -> Nat -> Point}
    (hdiv : PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag)
    (hfine :
      GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag delta)
    (hgap : PartialTaggedDivisionGapCompletion
      a b n left right delta gapCount gapPartition gapTag)
    (hreplacement : PartialTaggedDivisionReplacement
      n left right delta
      replacementCount replacementPartition replacementTag)
    (hk : k <= n) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (taggedSum f
          (partialCompletionPrefixPartition
            a b left right gapCount gapPartition k hk)
          (partialCompletionPrefixTags
            a b left right tag gapCount gapTag k hk)
          (partialCompletionPrefixCount gapCount k hk))
        (taggedSum f
          (partialReplacementPrefixPartition
            a b left right gapCount gapPartition
            replacementCount replacementPartition k hk)
          (partialReplacementPrefixTags
            a b left right gapCount gapTag
            replacementCount replacementTag k hk)
          (partialReplacementPrefixCount
            gapCount replacementCount k hk)) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (partialTaggedSum f left right tag k)
        (partialReplacementSelectedSum
          f replacementCount replacementPartition replacementTag k hk)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      let G :=
        taggedSum f (gapPartition 0 hk) (gapTag 0 hk) (gapCount 0 hk)
      change RealTheory.sub G G =
        RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change F.sub G G = F.sub F.zero F.zero
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F G]
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.zero]
  | succ k ih =>
      have hk_le : k <= n := Nat.le_of_succ_le hk
      have hk_lt : k < n := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hk
      have hprefixCompletion :
          GaugeFineTaggedPartition
            a (left k)
            (partialCompletionPrefixCount gapCount k hk_le)
            (partialCompletionPrefixPartition
              a b left right gapCount gapPartition k hk_le)
            (partialCompletionPrefixTags
              a b left right tag gapCount gapTag k hk_le)
            delta := by
        have hraw :=
          partialCompletionPrefix_gaugeFineTaggedPartition
            hdiv hfine hgap hk_le
        rw [partialGapRight_of_lt hk_lt] at hraw
        exact hraw
      have hprefixReplacement :
          GaugeFineTaggedPartition
            a (left k)
            (partialReplacementPrefixCount
              gapCount replacementCount k hk_le)
            (partialReplacementPrefixPartition
              a b left right gapCount gapPartition
              replacementCount replacementPartition k hk_le)
            (partialReplacementPrefixTags
              a b left right gapCount gapTag
              replacementCount replacementTag k hk_le)
            delta := by
        have hraw :=
          partialReplacementPrefix_gaugeFineTaggedPartition
            hgap hreplacement hk_le
        rw [partialGapRight_of_lt hk_lt] at hraw
        exact hraw
      have hcell :
          GaugeFineTaggedPartition (left k) (right k) 1
            (twoPointPartition (left k) (right k))
            (fun _j : Nat => tag k) delta :=
        gaugeFineTaggedPartition_one_of_gaugeFinePartialCell
          (partialTaggedDivision_cell_le hdiv hk_lt)
          (partialTaggedDivision_tag_mem_cell hdiv hk_lt)
          (gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision_cell_fine hfine hk_lt)
      have hreplacementBlock :
          GaugeFineTaggedPartition
            (left k) (right k)
            (replacementCount k hk_lt)
            (replacementPartition k hk_lt)
            (replacementTag k hk_lt)
            delta :=
        hreplacement k hk_lt
      have hnext :
          GaugeFineTaggedPartition
            (right k)
            (partialGapRight a b n left right (k + 1))
            (gapCount (k + 1) hk)
            (gapPartition (k + 1) hk)
            (gapTag (k + 1) hk)
            delta := by
        have hraw := hgap (k + 1) hk
        rw [partialGapLeft_of_pos (Nat.succ_pos k)] at hraw
        simpa using hraw
      have hcompletionSum :
          taggedSum f
              (partialCompletionPrefixPartition
                a b left right gapCount gapPartition (k + 1) hk)
              (partialCompletionPrefixTags
                a b left right tag gapCount gapTag (k + 1) hk)
              (partialCompletionPrefixCount gapCount (k + 1) hk) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add
                (taggedSum f
                  (partialCompletionPrefixPartition
                    a b left right gapCount gapPartition k hk_le)
                  (partialCompletionPrefixTags
                    a b left right tag gapCount gapTag k hk_le)
                  (partialCompletionPrefixCount gapCount k hk_le))
                (taggedSum f
                  (twoPointPartition (left k) (right k))
                  (fun _j : Nat => tag k) 1))
              (taggedSum f
                (gapPartition (k + 1) hk)
                (gapTag (k + 1) hk)
                (gapCount (k + 1) hk)) := by
        simpa [partialCompletionPrefixCount,
          partialCompletionPrefixPartition,
          partialCompletionPrefixTags] using
          (taggedSum_three_adjacent f
            hprefixCompletion.left hcell.left hnext.left)
      have hreplacementSum :
          taggedSum f
              (partialReplacementPrefixPartition
                a b left right gapCount gapPartition
                replacementCount replacementPartition (k + 1) hk)
              (partialReplacementPrefixTags
                a b left right gapCount gapTag
                replacementCount replacementTag (k + 1) hk)
              (partialReplacementPrefixCount
                gapCount replacementCount (k + 1) hk) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add
                (taggedSum f
                  (partialReplacementPrefixPartition
                    a b left right gapCount gapPartition
                    replacementCount replacementPartition k hk_le)
                  (partialReplacementPrefixTags
                    a b left right gapCount gapTag
                    replacementCount replacementTag k hk_le)
                  (partialReplacementPrefixCount
                    gapCount replacementCount k hk_le))
                (taggedSum f
                  (replacementPartition k hk_lt)
                  (replacementTag k hk_lt)
                  (replacementCount k hk_lt)))
              (taggedSum f
                (gapPartition (k + 1) hk)
                (gapTag (k + 1) hk)
                (gapCount (k + 1) hk)) := by
        simpa [partialReplacementPrefixCount,
          partialReplacementPrefixPartition,
          partialReplacementPrefixTags] using
          (taggedSum_three_adjacent f
            hprefixReplacement.left hreplacementBlock.left hnext.left)
      rw [hcompletionSum, hreplacementSum]
      rw [partialTaggedSum_succ]
      rw [partialReplacementSelectedSum_succ f hk]
      rw [taggedSum_one_eq_partialTaggedTerm]
      rw [sub_add_same_right_eq_sub]
      rw [add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub_point]
      rw [ih hk_le]
      rw [add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub_point]

name: partialCompletionReplacementTaggedSum_sub
statement:
private theorem partialCompletionReplacementTaggedSum_sub
    (f : Point -> Point)
    {a b : Point} {n : Nat}
    {left right tag : Nat -> Point} {delta : Point -> Point}
    {gapCount : (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat}
    {gapPartition gapTag :
      (i : Nat) -> i <= n -> Nat -> Point}
    {replacementCount : (j : Nat) -> j < n -> Nat}
    {replacementPartition replacementTag :
      (j : Nat) -> j < n -> Nat -> Point}
    (hdiv : PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag)
    (hfine :
      GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag delta)
    (hgap : PartialTaggedDivisionGapCompletion
      a b n left right delta gapCount gapPartition gapTag)
    (hreplacement : PartialTaggedDivisionReplacement
      n left right delta
      replacementCount replacementPartition replacementTag) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (taggedSum f
          (partialCompletionPartition
            a b left right gapCount gapPartition)
          (partialCompletionTags
            a b left right tag gapCount gapTag)
          (partialCompletionCount gapCount))
        (taggedSum f
          (partialReplacementPartition
            a b left right gapCount gapPartition
            replacementCount replacementPartition)
          (partialReplacementTags
            a b left right gapCount gapTag
            replacementCount replacementTag)
          (partialReplacementCount gapCount replacementCount)) =
      RealTheory.sub
        (partialTaggedSum f left right tag n)
        (partialReplacementSelectedSum
          f replacementCount replacementPartition replacementTag
          n (Nat.le_refl n))
proof:
:= by
  unfold partialCompletionPartition
  unfold partialCompletionTags
  unfold partialCompletionCount
  unfold partialReplacementPartition
  unfold partialReplacementTags
  unfold partialReplacementCount
  exact
    partialCompletionReplacementPrefixTaggedSum_sub
      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (n := n) (k := n)
      (left := left) (right := right) (tag := tag)
      (delta := delta)
      (gapCount := gapCount) (gapPartition := gapPartition)
      (gapTag := gapTag)
      (replacementCount := replacementCount)
      (replacementPartition := replacementPartition)
      (replacementTag := replacementTag)
      hdiv hfine hgap hreplacement (Nat.le_refl n)

name: partialReplacementSelectedSum_sub_valueSum_abs_le_budgetSum
statement:
private theorem partialReplacementSelectedSum_sub_valueSum_abs_le_budgetSum
    (f : Point -> Point) {n k : Nat}
    {value budget : Nat -> Point}
    {replacementCount : (j : Nat) -> j < n -> Nat}
    {replacementPartition replacementTag :
      (j : Nat) -> j < n -> Nat -> Point}
    (hk : k <= n)
    (hpoint :
      forall (j : Nat) (hj : j < n),
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (taggedSum f
                (replacementPartition j hj)
                (replacementTag j hj)
                (replacementCount j hj))
              (value j)))
          (budget j)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (partialReplacementSelectedSum
            f replacementCount replacementPartition replacementTag k hk)
          (partialIntegralValueSum value k)))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum budget k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      change
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum budget 0)
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      change F.le (RealTheory.abs (F.sub F.zero F.zero)) F.zero
      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F F.zero]
      rw [RealTheory.abs_zero]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  | succ k ih =>
      have hk_le : k <= n := Nat.le_of_succ_le hk
      have hk_lt : k < n := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hk
      have hprev := ih hk_le
      rw [partialReplacementSelectedSum_succ f hk]
      rw [partialIntegralValueSum_succ]
      rw [add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub_point]
      have htri :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (partialReplacementSelectedSum
                    f replacementCount replacementPartition
                    replacementTag k hk_le)
                  (partialIntegralValueSum value k))
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (taggedSum f
                    (replacementPartition k hk_lt)
                    (replacementTag k hk_lt)
                    (replacementCount k hk_lt))
                  (value k))))
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (partialReplacementSelectedSum
                    f replacementCount replacementPartition
                    replacementTag k hk_le)
                  (partialIntegralValueSum value k)))
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (taggedSum f
                    (replacementPartition k hk_lt)
                    (replacementTag k hk_lt)
                    (replacementCount k hk_lt))
                  (value k)))) :=
        RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs _ _
      have hsum_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (partialReplacementSelectedSum
                    f replacementCount replacementPartition
                    replacementTag k hk_le)
                  (partialIntegralValueSum value k)))
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (taggedSum f
                    (replacementPartition k hk_lt)
                    (replacementTag k hk_lt)
                    (replacementCount k hk_lt))
                  (value k))))
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.finiteSum budget k) (budget k)) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          hprev
          (hpoint k hk_lt)
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      exact RealTheory.le_trans htri hsum_le

name: partialReplacementSelectedSum_sub_valueSum_abs_lt_of_budget
statement:
private theorem partialReplacementSelectedSum_sub_valueSum_abs_lt_of_budget
    (f : Point -> Point) {n : Nat}
    {value budget : Nat -> Point}
    {eps : Point}

proof:
:= by
  have hle :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub
            (partialReplacementSelectedSum
              f replacementCount replacementPartition replacementTag

    partialReplacementSelectedSum_sub_valueSum_abs_le_budgetSum

      (value := value) (budget := budget)
      (replacementCount := replacementCount)
      (replacementPartition := replacementPartition)

      (fun j hj =>

name: exists_finiteLocalErrorBudget
statement:
private theorem exists_finiteLocalErrorBudget
    (n : Nat) {eps : Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun budget : Nat -> Point =>
        FiniteLocalErrorBudget budget n eps)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing eps with
  | zero =>
      refine Exists.intro (fun _k : Nat => RealTheory.one) ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · intro k hk
        exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk)
      · rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
        exact heps
  | succ n ih =>
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
      have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
      cases ih he2 with
      | intro budget hbudget =>
          let budget' : Nat -> Point :=
            fun k : Nat => if hk : k < n then budget k else e2
          refine Exists.intro budget' ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · intro k hk
            by_cases hkn : k < n
            · unfold budget'
              rw [dif_pos hkn]
              exact finiteLocalErrorBudget_positive hbudget k hkn
            · unfold budget'
              rw [dif_neg hkn]
              exact he2
          · unfold budget'
            rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
            have hprefix :
                RealTheory.finiteSum
                    (fun k : Nat =>
                      if hk : k < n then budget k else e2) n =
                  RealTheory.finiteSum budget n := by
              exact
                RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt n
                  (fun k hk => by rw [dif_pos hk])
            have hlast :
                (if hk : n < n then budget n else e2) = e2 := by
              rw [dif_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl n)]
            rw [hprefix, hlast]
            have hadd :
                F.lt
                  (F.add (RealTheory.finiteSum budget n) e2)
                  (F.add e2 e2) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right
                F hbudget.right e2
            rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hadd
