name: exists_saksHenstockSupportGauge_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
statement:
theorem exists_saksHenstockSupportGauge_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b V eps : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hV : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b V)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point -> Point =>
        And (ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta)
          (forall (n : Nat) (left right tag value : Nat -> Point),
            (forall k : Nat, k < n ->
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
                f (left k) (right k) (value k)) ->
              PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag ->
                GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
                  a b n left right tag delta ->
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (partialTaggedErrorSum f left right tag value n))
                    eps))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases (henstockKurzweilCauchyOn_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn hV).right
      e2 he2 with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro n left right tag value hlocal hdiv hfine
      cases exists_finiteLocalErrorBudget n he2 with
      | intro budget hbudget =>
          let localWitness :
              forall (k : Nat) (hk : k < n),
                Exists
                  (fun localDelta : Point -> Point =>
                    And
                      (ClosedIntervalGaugeOn
                        (left k) (right k) localDelta)
                      (forall (m : Nat) (p localTag : Nat -> Point),
                        GaugeFineTaggedPartition
                          (left k) (right k) m p localTag
                          localDelta ->
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub
                                (taggedSum f p localTag m)
                                (value k)))
                            (budget k))) :=
            fun k hk =>
              (hlocal k hk).right (budget k)
                (finiteLocalErrorBudget_positive hbudget k hk)
          let localDelta :
              (k : Nat) -> k < n -> Point -> Point :=
            fun k hk => Classical.choose (localWitness k hk)
          let replacementGauge :
              (k : Nat) -> k < n -> Point -> Point :=
            fun k hk x =>
              RealTheory.min (delta x) (localDelta k hk x)
          have hreplacementGauge :
              forall (k : Nat) (hk : k < n),
                ClosedIntervalGaugeOn
                  (left k) (right k) (replacementGauge k hk) := by
            intro k hk
            have hglobal :
                ClosedIntervalGaugeOn (left k) (right k) delta :=
              closedIntervalGaugeOn_subinterval hdelta.left
                (partialTaggedDivision_left_mem_closedInterval hdiv hk).left
                (partialTaggedDivision_right_mem_closedInterval hdiv hk).right
            have hlocalGauge :
                ClosedIntervalGaugeOn
                  (left k) (right k) (localDelta k hk) := by
              dsimp [localDelta]
              exact (Classical.choose_spec (localWitness k hk)).left
            exact closedIntervalGaugeOn_min hglobal hlocalGauge
          let replacementWitness :
              forall (k : Nat) (hk : k < n),
                Exists
                  (fun m : Nat =>
                    Exists
                      (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
                        Exists
                          (fun localTag : Nat -> Point =>
                            GaugeFineTaggedPartition
                              (left k) (right k) m p localTag
                              (replacementGauge k hk)))) :=
            fun k hk =>
              exists_gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_closedIntervalGaugeOn
                (partialTaggedDivision_cell_le hdiv hk)
                (hreplacementGauge k hk)
          let replacementCount :
              (k : Nat) -> k < n -> Nat :=
            fun k hk => Classical.choose (replacementWitness k hk)
          let replacementPartition :
              (k : Nat) -> k < n -> Nat -> Point :=
            fun k hk =>
              Classical.choose
                (Classical.choose_spec (replacementWitness k hk))
          let replacementTag :
              (k : Nat) -> k < n -> Nat -> Point :=
            fun k hk =>
              Classical.choose
                (Classical.choose_spec
                  (Classical.choose_spec (replacementWitness k hk)))
          have hreplacementDelta :
              PartialTaggedDivisionReplacement
                n left right delta
                replacementCount replacementPartition replacementTag := by
            intro k hk
            have hfineMin :
                GaugeFineTaggedPartition
                  (left k) (right k)
                  (replacementCount k hk)
                  (replacementPartition k hk)
                  (replacementTag k hk)
                  (replacementGauge k hk) := by
              dsimp [replacementCount, replacementPartition,
                replacementTag]
              exact
                Classical.choose_spec
                  (Classical.choose_spec
                    (Classical.choose_spec (replacementWitness k hk)))
            exact gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le hfineMin
              (fun x : Point =>
                RealTheory.min_le_left
                  (delta x) (localDelta k hk x))
          have hreplacementLocalClose :
              forall (k : Nat) (hk : k < n),
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (taggedSum f
                        (replacementPartition k hk)
                        (replacementTag k hk)
                        (replacementCount k hk))
                      (value k)))
                  (budget k) := by
            intro k hk
            have hfineMin :
                GaugeFineTaggedPartition
                  (left k) (right k)
                  (replacementCount k hk)
                  (replacementPartition k hk)
                  (replacementTag k hk)
                  (replacementGauge k hk) := by
              dsimp [replacementCount, replacementPartition,
                replacementTag]
              exact
                Classical.choose_spec
                  (Classical.choose_spec
                    (Classical.choose_spec (replacementWitness k hk)))
            have hfineLocal :
                GaugeFineTaggedPartition
                  (left k) (right k)
                  (replacementCount k hk)
                  (replacementPartition k hk)
                  (replacementTag k hk)
                  (localDelta k hk) :=
              gaugeFineTaggedPartition_of_gauge_le hfineMin
                (fun x : Point =>
                  RealTheory.min_le_right
                    (delta x) (localDelta k hk x))
            have hspec := Classical.choose_spec (localWitness k hk)
            dsimp [localDelta] at hfineLocal
            exact hspec.right
              (replacementCount k hk)
              (replacementPartition k hk)
              (replacementTag k hk)
              hfineLocal
          have hreplacementClose :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (partialReplacementSelectedSum
                      f replacementCount replacementPartition
                      replacementTag n (Nat.le_refl n))
                    (partialIntegralValueSum value n)))
                e2 :=
            partialReplacementSelectedSum_sub_valueSum_abs_lt_of_budget
              (f := f) (n := n) (value := value)
              (budget := budget) (eps := e2)
              (replacementCount := replacementCount)
              (replacementPartition := replacementPartition)
              (replacementTag := replacementTag)
              hreplacementLocalClose
              hbudget
          cases exists_partialTaggedDivisionGapCompletion
              hab hdiv hdelta.left with
          | intro gapCount hgapCount =>
              cases hgapCount with
              | intro gapPartition hgapPartition =>
                  cases hgapPartition with
                  | intro gapTag hgap =>
                      have hcompletionFine :
                          GaugeFineTaggedPartition
                            a b
                            (partialCompletionCount gapCount)
                            (partialCompletionPartition
                              a b left right gapCount gapPartition)
                            (partialCompletionTags
                              a b left right tag gapCount gapTag)
                            delta :=
                        partialCompletion_gaugeFineTaggedPartition
                          hdiv hfine hgap
                      have hreplacementFine :
                          GaugeFineTaggedPartition
                            a b
                            (partialReplacementCount
                              gapCount replacementCount)
                            (partialReplacementPartition
                              a b left right gapCount gapPartition
                              replacementCount replacementPartition)
                            (partialReplacementTags
                              a b left right gapCount gapTag
                              replacementCount replacementTag)
                            delta :=
                        partialReplacement_gaugeFineTaggedPartition
                          hgap hreplacementDelta
                      have hglobalClose :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub
                                (taggedSum f
                                  (partialCompletionPartition
                                    a b left right gapCount gapPartition)
                                  (partialCompletionTags
                                    a b left right tag gapCount gapTag)
                                  (partialCompletionCount gapCount))
                                (taggedSum f
                                  (partialReplacementPartition
                                    a b left right gapCount gapPartition
                                    replacementCount replacementPartition)
                                  (partialReplacementTags
                                    a b left right gapCount gapTag
                                    replacementCount replacementTag)
                                  (partialReplacementCount
                                    gapCount replacementCount))))
                            e2 :=
                        hdelta.right
                          (partialCompletionCount gapCount)
                          (partialCompletionPartition
                            a b left right gapCount gapPartition)
                          (partialCompletionTags
                            a b left right tag gapCount gapTag)
                          (partialReplacementCount
                            gapCount replacementCount)
                          (partialReplacementPartition
                            a b left right gapCount gapPartition
                            replacementCount replacementPartition)
                          (partialReplacementTags
                            a b left right gapCount gapTag
                            replacementCount replacementTag)
                          hcompletionFine hreplacementFine
                      have hcancel :=
                        partialCompletionReplacementTaggedSum_sub
                          (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (n := n)
                          (left := left) (right := right)
                          (tag := tag) (delta := delta)
                          (gapCount := gapCount)
                          (gapPartition := gapPartition)
                          (gapTag := gapTag)
                          (replacementCount := replacementCount)
                          (replacementPartition :=
                            replacementPartition)
                          (replacementTag := replacementTag)
                          hdiv hfine hgap hreplacementDelta
                      rw [hcancel] at hglobalClose
                      have herror_eq :
                          partialTaggedErrorSum
                              f left right tag value n =
                            RealTheory.add
                              (RealTheory.sub
                                (partialTaggedSum
                                  f left right tag n)
                                (partialReplacementSelectedSum
                                  f replacementCount
                                  replacementPartition replacementTag
                                  n (Nat.le_refl n)))
                              (RealTheory.sub
                                (partialReplacementSelectedSum
                                  f replacementCount
                                  replacementPartition replacementTag
                                  n (Nat.le_refl n))
                                (partialIntegralValueSum value n)) := by
                        rw [partialTaggedErrorSum_eq_sub]
                        rw [sub_add_sub_cancel_point]
                      have htri :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (partialTaggedErrorSum
                                f left right tag value n))
                            (RealTheory.add
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (RealTheory.sub
                                  (partialTaggedSum
                                    f left right tag n)
                                  (partialReplacementSelectedSum
                                    f replacementCount
                                    replacementPartition replacementTag
                                    n (Nat.le_refl n))))
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (RealTheory.sub
                                  (partialReplacementSelectedSum
                                    f replacementCount
                                    replacementPartition replacementTag
                                    n (Nat.le_refl n))
                                  (partialIntegralValueSum
                                    value n)))) := by
                        rw [herror_eq]
                        exact RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs _ _
                      have hsumClose :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.add
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (RealTheory.sub
                                  (partialTaggedSum
                                    f left right tag n)
                                  (partialReplacementSelectedSum
                                    f replacementCount
                                    replacementPartition replacementTag
                                    n (Nat.le_refl n))))
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (RealTheory.sub
                                  (partialReplacementSelectedSum
                                    f replacementCount
                                    replacementPartition replacementTag
                                    n (Nat.le_refl n))
                                  (partialIntegralValueSum
                                    value n))))
                            eps := by
                        have hadd :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                            F hglobalClose hreplacementClose
                        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps]
                          at hadd
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                        F htri hsumClose

name: finiteSum_getD_eq_partialErrorIndexListSum
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_getD_eq_partialErrorIndexListSum
    (term : Nat -> Point) (indices : List Nat) (fallback : Nat) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat => term (indices.getD k fallback))
        indices.length =
      partialErrorIndexListSum term indices
proof:
:= by
  induction indices with
  | nil =>
      change RealTheory.finiteSum _ 0 = RealTheory.zero
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  | cons head tail ih =>
      let projected : Nat -> Point :=
        fun k => term ((head :: tail).getD k fallback)
      let prepended : Nat -> Point := fun k =>
        match k with
        | 0 => term head
        | j + 1 => term (tail.getD j fallback)
      have hterms : forall k : Nat, k < tail.length + 1 ->
          projected k = prepended k := by
        intro k hk
        cases k with
        | zero => simp [projected, prepended, List.getD]
        | succ j => simp [projected, prepended, List.getD]
      have hsum :
          RealTheory.finiteSum projected (tail.length + 1) =
            RealTheory.finiteSum prepended (tail.length + 1) :=
        RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt (tail.length + 1) hterms
      change
        RealTheory.finiteSum projected (tail.length + 1) =
          RealTheory.add (term head) (partialErrorIndexListSum term tail)
      rw [hsum]
      have hprepend :
          RealTheory.finiteSum prepended (tail.length + 1) =
            RealTheory.add (term head)
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun k : Nat => term (tail.getD k fallback))
                tail.length) := by
        simpa [prepended] using
          (RealTheory.finiteSum_prepend
            (term head)
            (fun k : Nat => term (tail.getD k fallback))
            tail.length)
      rw [hprepend, ih]

name: partialErrorIndexListSum_append
statement:
private theorem partialErrorIndexListSum_append
    (term : Nat -> Point) : forall xs ys : List Nat,
    partialErrorIndexListSum term (xs ++ ys) =
      RealTheory.add
        (partialErrorIndexListSum term xs)
        (partialErrorIndexListSum term ys)
  | [], ys => by
      change partialErrorIndexListSum term ys =
        RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero (partialErrorIndexListSum term ys)
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  | x :: xs, ys => by
      change
        RealTheory.add (term x)
            (partialErrorIndexListSum term (xs ++ ys)) =
          RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.add (term x) (partialErrorIndexListSum term xs))
            (partialErrorIndexListSum term ys)
      rw [partialErrorIndexListSum_append term xs ys]
      rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]

private theorem partialErrorIndexListSum_range_eq_finiteSum
    (term : Nat -> Point) : forall n : Nat,
    partialErrorIndexListSum term (List.range n) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum term n
  | 0 => by
      change RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.finiteSum term 0
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [List.range_succ]
      rw [partialErrorIndexListSum_append]
      change
        RealTheory.add
            (partialErrorIndexListSum term (List.range n))
            (RealTheory.add (term n) RealTheory.zero) =
          RealTheory.finiteSum term (n + 1)
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
      rw [partialErrorIndexListSum_range_eq_finiteSum]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]

name: partialErrorIndexListSum_abs_sign_split
statement:
private theorem partialErrorIndexListSum_abs_sign_split
    (term : Nat -> Point) : forall indices : List Nat,
    partialErrorIndexListSum (fun i => RealTheory.abs (term i)) indices =
      RealTheory.add
        (partialErrorIndexListSum term
          (indices.filter (fun i => partialErrorSign true (term i))))
        (partialErrorIndexListSum (fun i => RealTheory.neg (term i))
          (indices.filter (fun i => partialErrorSign false (term i))))
  | [] => by
      change RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero
      rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
  | i :: rest => by
      classical
      by_cases hi : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (term i)
      · have habs : RealTheory.abs (term i) = term i
proof:
:=
          RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hi
        simp only [List.filter_cons]
        have hpos : partialErrorSign true (term i) = true := by
          simp [partialErrorSign, partialErrorNonnegative, hi]
        have hneg : partialErrorSign false (term i) = false := by
          simp [partialErrorSign, partialErrorNonnegative, hi]
        rw [hpos, hneg]
        change
          RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs (term i))
              (partialErrorIndexListSum
                (fun j => RealTheory.abs (term j)) rest) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add (term i)
                (partialErrorIndexListSum term
                  (rest.filter
                    (fun j => partialErrorSign true (term j)))))
              (partialErrorIndexListSum (fun j => RealTheory.neg (term j))
                (rest.filter
                  (fun j => partialErrorSign false (term j))))
        rw [habs, partialErrorIndexListSum_abs_sign_split term rest]
        rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
      · let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        have hnonpos : RealTheory.le (term i) RealTheory.zero :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hi
        have habs : RealTheory.abs (term i) = RealTheory.neg (term i) :=
          RealTheory.abs_of_nonpos hnonpos
        simp only [List.filter_cons]
        have hpos : partialErrorSign true (term i) = false := by
          simp [partialErrorSign, partialErrorNonnegative, hi]
        have hneg : partialErrorSign false (term i) = true := by
          simp [partialErrorSign, partialErrorNonnegative, hi]
        rw [hpos, hneg]
        change
          RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs (term i))
              (partialErrorIndexListSum
                (fun j => RealTheory.abs (term j)) rest) =
            RealTheory.add
              (partialErrorIndexListSum term
                (rest.filter
                  (fun j => partialErrorSign true (term j))))
              (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.neg (term i))
                (partialErrorIndexListSum (fun j => RealTheory.neg (term j))
                  (rest.filter
                    (fun j => partialErrorSign false (term j)))))
        rw [habs, partialErrorIndexListSum_abs_sign_split term rest]
        rw [<- RealTheory.add_assoc]
        rw [RealTheory.add_comm (RealTheory.neg (term i))]
        rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]

name: finiteSum_abs_eq_abs_errorSignSums
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_abs_eq_abs_errorSignSums
    (term : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i => RealTheory.abs (term i)) n =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k => term ((errorSignIndices true term n).getD k 0))
            (errorSignCount true term n)))
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k => term ((errorSignIndices false term n).getD k 0))
            (errorSignCount false term n)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let positive := errorSignIndices true term n
  let negative := errorSignIndices false term n
  let positiveSum :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k => term (positive.getD k 0)) positive.length
  let negativeSum :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k => term (negative.getD k 0)) negative.length
  have hpositiveNonnegative :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero positiveSum := by
    unfold positiveSum
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_nonneg
    intro k hk
    apply errorSignIndices_mem_nonnegative
    exact Tautology.List.getD_mem positive 0 hk
  have hnegativeNonpositive :
      RealTheory.le negativeSum RealTheory.zero := by
    have hnegatedNonnegative :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k => RealTheory.neg (term (negative.getD k 0)))
            negative.length) := by
      apply RealTheory.finiteSum_nonneg
      intro k hk
      have hnot :
          Not (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (term (negative.getD k 0))) :=
        errorSignIndices_mem_not_nonnegative
          (Tautology.List.getD_mem negative 0 hk)
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_not_nonneg F hnot)
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_neg] at hnegatedNonnegative
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nonpos_of_neg_nonneg F hnegatedNonnegative
  have hpositiveAbs : RealTheory.abs positiveSum = positiveSum :=
    RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hpositiveNonnegative
  have hnegativeAbs : RealTheory.abs negativeSum = RealTheory.neg negativeSum :=
    RealTheory.abs_of_nonpos hnegativeNonpositive
  have hpositiveFold :
      RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k => term (positive.getD k 0))
          positive.length =
        partialErrorIndexListSum term positive :=
    finiteSum_getD_eq_partialErrorIndexListSum term positive 0
  have hnegativeFold :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k => RealTheory.neg (term (negative.getD k 0)))
          negative.length =
        partialErrorIndexListSum (fun i => RealTheory.neg (term i)) negative :=
    finiteSum_getD_eq_partialErrorIndexListSum
      (fun i => RealTheory.neg (term i)) negative 0
  change
    RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i => RealTheory.abs (term i)) n =
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs positiveSum) (RealTheory.abs negativeSum)
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i => RealTheory.abs (term i)) n =
        partialErrorIndexListSum (fun i => RealTheory.abs (term i))
          (List.range n) := by
      exact (partialErrorIndexListSum_range_eq_finiteSum
        (fun i => RealTheory.abs (term i)) n).symm
    _ = RealTheory.add
          (partialErrorIndexListSum term positive)
          (partialErrorIndexListSum (fun i => RealTheory.neg (term i))
            negative) := by
      simpa [positive, negative, errorSignIndices] using
        (partialErrorIndexListSum_abs_sign_split term (List.range n))
    _ = RealTheory.add positiveSum
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k => RealTheory.neg (term (negative.getD k 0)))
            negative.length) := by
      rw [<- hpositiveFold, <- hnegativeFold]
    _ = RealTheory.add positiveSum (RealTheory.neg negativeSum) := by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_neg]
    _ = RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs positiveSum)
          (RealTheory.abs negativeSum) := by
      rw [hpositiveAbs, hnegativeAbs]

name: partialTaggedAbsErrorSum_eq_abs_partialErrorSignSums
statement:
private theorem partialTaggedAbsErrorSum_eq_abs_partialErrorSignSums
    (f : Point -> Point) (left right tag value : Nat -> Point) (n : Nat) :
    partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f left right tag value n =

name: exists_henstockAbsErrorSupportGauge_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
statement:
theorem exists_henstockAbsErrorSupportGauge_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b V eps : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hV : HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn f a b V)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point -> Point =>
        And (ClosedIntervalGaugeOn a b delta)
          (forall (n : Nat) (left right tag value : Nat -> Point),
            (forall k : Nat, k < n ->
              HasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
                f (left k) (right k) (value k)) ->
              PartialTaggedDivision a b n left right tag ->
                GaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision
                  a b n left right tag delta ->
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (partialTaggedAbsErrorSum f left right tag value n)
                    eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases
      exists_saksHenstockSupportGauge_of_hasHenstockKurzweilIntegralOn
        hab hV he2 with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro n left right tag value hlocal hdiv hfine
      have hpositive :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (partialTaggedErrorSum f
                (fun k => left
                  (partialErrorSignIndex
                    true f left right tag value n k))
                (fun k => right
                  (partialErrorSignIndex
                    true f left right tag value n k))
                (fun k => tag
                  (partialErrorSignIndex
                    true f left right tag value n k))
                (fun k => value
                  (partialErrorSignIndex
                    true f left right tag value n k))
                (partialErrorSignCount true f left right tag value n)))
            e2 :=
        hdelta.right
          (partialErrorSignCount true f left right tag value n)
          (fun k => left
            (partialErrorSignIndex true f left right tag value n k))
          (fun k => right
            (partialErrorSignIndex true f left right tag value n k))
          (fun k => tag
            (partialErrorSignIndex true f left right tag value n k))
          (fun k => value
            (partialErrorSignIndex true f left right tag value n k))
          (partialErrorSign_localIntegrals true hlocal)
          (partialErrorSign_partialTaggedDivision true hdiv)
          (partialErrorSign_gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision true hdiv hfine)
      have hnegative :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (partialTaggedErrorSum f
                (fun k => left
                  (partialErrorSignIndex
                    false f left right tag value n k))
                (fun k => right
                  (partialErrorSignIndex
                    false f left right tag value n k))
                (fun k => tag
                  (partialErrorSignIndex
                    false f left right tag value n k))
                (fun k => value
                  (partialErrorSignIndex
                    false f left right tag value n k))
                (partialErrorSignCount false f left right tag value n)))
            e2 :=
        hdelta.right
          (partialErrorSignCount false f left right tag value n)
          (fun k => left
            (partialErrorSignIndex false f left right tag value n k))
          (fun k => right
            (partialErrorSignIndex false f left right tag value n k))
          (fun k => tag
            (partialErrorSignIndex false f left right tag value n k))
          (fun k => value
            (partialErrorSignIndex false f left right tag value n k))
          (partialErrorSign_localIntegrals false hlocal)
          (partialErrorSign_partialTaggedDivision false hdiv)
          (partialErrorSign_gaugeFinePartialTaggedDivision false hdiv hfine)
      rw [partialTaggedAbsErrorSum_eq_abs_partialErrorSignSums]
      have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hpositive hnegative
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hadd

name: orientedEndpoint_ordered_remainder_const_abs_le_bound_mul_abs_sub
statement:
theorem orientedEndpoint_ordered_remainder_const_abs_le_bound_mul_abs_sub
    {f F : Point -> Point} {a x y c M : Point}
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hFx : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a x (F x))
    (hFy : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y (F y))
    (hM :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f z) c)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
          (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub y x))))
      (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hI :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y
        (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
      hax hxy hFx hFy
  have hForward :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f x y)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f x y
          (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hxy hI
  have hConst_bdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded (fun _ : Point => c) x y :=
    closedIntervalBounded_const c x y
  have hConst :
      HasDarbouxIntegral (fun _ : Point => c) x y
        (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_const_of_le hxy
  have hSub :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun z : Point => RealTheory.sub (f z) c) x y
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
          (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub y x))) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_sub_of_le
      hxy hForward.left hForward.right hConst_bdd hConst
  have hbound :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
            (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub y x))))
        (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length_of_le
      hxy hSub hM
  have hlength_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hxy
  have hlength_abs :
      RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x) =
        RealTheory.sub y x :=
    RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hlength_nonneg

name: orientedEndpoint_base_right_remainder_abs_le_bound_mul_abs_sub
statement:
theorem orientedEndpoint_base_right_remainder_abs_le_bound_mul_abs_sub
    {f F : Point -> Point} {a x y M : Point}
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x)
    (hay : RealTheory.le a y)
    (hFx : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a x (F x))
    (hFy : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y (F y))
    (hM_forward :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f z) (f x))) M)
    (hM_reverse :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval y x z ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f z) (f x))) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
          (RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.sub y x))))
      (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact
        orientedEndpoint_ordered_remainder_abs_le_bound_mul_abs_sub
          hax hxy hFx hFy hM_forward
  | inr hyx =>
      have hbound :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub
                (RealTheory.sub (F x) (F y))
                (RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.sub x y))))
            (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub x y))) :=
        orientedEndpoint_ordered_remainder_const_abs_le_bound_mul_abs_sub
          hay hyx hFy hFx hM_reverse
      have hvalue_abs :
          RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (F x) (F y))
              (RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.sub x y))) =
          RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
              (RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.sub y x))) := by
        change
          RealTheory.abs
            (C.sub (C.sub (F x) (F y))
              (C.mul (f x) (C.sub x y))) =
          RealTheory.abs
            (C.sub (C.sub (F y) (F x))
              (C.mul (f x) (C.sub y x)))
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub C (F y) (F x)]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub C y x]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_neg C (f x) (C.sub y x)]
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub C]
        change
          RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.neg
                (C.sub (C.sub (F y) (F x))
                  (C.mul (f x) (C.sub y x)))) =
            RealTheory.abs
              (C.sub (C.sub (F y) (F x))
                (C.mul (f x) (C.sub y x)))
        exact
          RealTheory.abs_neg
            (C.sub (C.sub (F y) (F x))
              (C.mul (f x) (C.sub y x)))
      have hlength_abs :
          RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub x y) =
            RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x) := by
        change
          RealTheory.abs (C.sub x y) =
            RealTheory.abs (C.sub y x)
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub C y x]
        change
          RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.neg (C.sub y x)) =
            RealTheory.abs (C.sub y x)
        exact RealTheory.abs_neg (C.sub y x)
      rwa [hvalue_abs, hlength_abs] at hbound

theorem indefiniteRiemannIntegral_quotient_error_eq_remainder_mul_inv
    {f F : Point -> Point} {x y : Point}
    (hyx : Not (y = x)) :
    RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub y x)))
        (f x) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
          (RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.sub y x)))
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub y x))
proof:

  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub_ne :
      Not (RealTheory.sub y x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hsub
    have hEq : y = x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero C hsub
    exact hyx hEq
  exact quotient_error_eq_remainder_mul_inv
    (A := RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
    (c := f x)
    (d := RealTheory.sub y x)
    hsub_ne

name: orientedEndpoint_base_right_quotient_error_abs_le_bound
statement:
theorem orientedEndpoint_base_right_quotient_error_abs_le_bound
    {f F : Point -> Point} {a x y M : Point}
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x)
    (hay : RealTheory.le a y)
    (hyx : Not (y = x))
    (hFx : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a x (F x))
    (hFy : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y (F y))
    (hM_forward :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f z) (f x))) M)
    (hM_reverse :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval y x z ->
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f z) (f x))) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub y x)))
          (f x)))
      M
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsub_ne :
      Not (RealTheory.sub y x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hsub
    have hEq : y = x :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_of_sub_eq_zero C hsub
    exact hyx hEq
  have hrem :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
            (RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.sub y x))))
        (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x))) :=
    orientedEndpoint_base_right_remainder_abs_le_bound_mul_abs_sub
      hax hay hFx hFy hM_forward hM_reverse
  have hquot :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
              (RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.sub y x)))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub y x))))
        M :=
    abs_mul_inv_le_of_abs_le_mul_abs hsub_ne hrem
  have hqeq :
      RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
            (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub y x)))
          (f x) =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
            (RealTheory.mul (f x) (RealTheory.sub y x)))
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
    indefiniteRiemannIntegral_quotient_error_eq_remainder_mul_inv
      (f := f) (F := F) hyx
  rwa [hqeq]

name: riemannIntegrableOn_comp_continuousOn_of_le
statement:
theorem riemannIntegrableOn_comp_continuousOn_of_le
    {f phi : Point -> Point} {a b m M : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b)
    (hrange :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          And (RealTheory.le m (f x)) (RealTheory.le (f x) M))
    (hphi :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval m M) phi) :
    RiemannIntegrableOn (fun x : Point => phi (f x)) a b
proof:
:= by
  have hmM : RealTheory.le m M :=
    RealTheory.le_trans
      (hrange a (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab)).left
      (hrange a (And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab)).right
  have hphi_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded phi m M :=
    closedIntervalBounded_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval hmM hphi
  have hcomp_bdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded (fun x : Point => phi (f x)) a b := by
    cases hphi_bdd with
    | intro B hB =>
        exact closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le (B := B) hB.left
          (fun x hx => hB.right (f x) (hrange x hx))
  have hsubset :
      forall x : Point,
        ClosedIntervalDiscontinuitySet
            (fun y : Point => phi (f y)) a b x ->
          ClosedIntervalDiscontinuitySet f a b x := by
    intro x hxD
    unfold ClosedIntervalDiscontinuitySet FunctionDiscontinuousAtOn at *
    exact And.intro hxD.left
      (fun hfcont =>
        hxD.right (by
          have hcomp := RealFunction.continuousAtOn_comp
            hfcont (hphi (f x) (hrange x hxD.left)) hrange
          unfold RealFunction.CompFun at hcomp
          exact hcomp))
  exact
    riemannIntegrableOn_of_closedIntervalBounded_closedIntervalDiscontinuitySet_null
      hab hcomp_bdd
      (RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono hsubset
        (closedIntervalDiscontinuitySet_null_of_riemannIntegrableOn hf))

name: four_mul_radius_eq_double_radius
statement:
theorem four_mul_radius_eq_double_radius (rho : Point) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 4) rho =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add rho rho)
        (RealTheory.add rho rho)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F 4) rho =
    F.add (F.add rho rho) (F.add rho rho)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ F 3]
  rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ F 2]
  rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_succ F 1]
  rw [F.add_mul, F.one_mul]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_one F, F.one_mul]
  rw [F.add_assoc]

name: isCellOscillation_le_of_uniformContinuityModulus
statement:
theorem isCellOscillation_le_of_uniformContinuityModulus
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b delta eta : Point}
    {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat} {omega : Point}
    (hpart : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hcell : RealTheory.lt (cellLength p k) delta)
    (hmod : forall x y : Point,
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y ->
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x y) delta ->
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (f x) (f y)) eta)
    (homega : IsCellOscillation f p k omega) :
    RealTheory.le omega eta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine isCellOscillation_le_of_pairwise_le homega ?_
  intro x y hx hy
  have hxI : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
    intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval hpart hk hx
  have hyI : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y :=
    intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval hpart hk hy
  have hdist_lt : RealTheory.lt
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x y) delta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
      (dist_le_cellLength_of_partitionCell hx hy) hcell
  have hdist_fun : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x y) delta := by
    unfold RealFunction.dist
    exact hdist_lt
  have hvalue : RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (f x) (f y)) eta :=
    hmod x y hxI hyI hdist_fun
  unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hvalue
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hvalue

name: exists_cellOscillation_le_of_functionUniformContinuousOn
statement:
theorem exists_cellOscillation_le_of_functionUniformContinuousOn
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b eta : Point}
    (hf : RealTheory.FunctionUniformContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (heta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eta) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat} {omega : Point},
            IntervalPartition a b n p ->
            k < n ->
            RealTheory.lt (cellLength p k) delta ->
            IsCellOscillation f p k omega ->
            RealTheory.le omega eta))
proof:
:= by
  cases hf eta heta with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro p n k omega hpart hk hcell homega
      exact isCellOscillation_le_of_uniformContinuityModulus
        hpart hk hcell hdelta.right homega

name: abs_sub_le_of_closedInterval_mem

theorem abs_sub_le_of_closedInterval_mem
    {lower upper x y : Point}

name: isCellOscillation_le_endpointSub_of_functionMonotoneOn_closedInterval
statement:
theorem isCellOscillation_le_endpointSub_of_functionMonotoneOn_closedInterval
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat} {omega : Point}
    (hmono : RealTheory.FunctionMonotoneOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n)
    (homega : IsCellOscillation f p k omega) :
    RealTheory.le omega
      (RealTheory.sub (f (p (k + 1))) (f (p k)))
proof:
:= by
  refine isCellOscillation_le_of_pairwise_le homega ?_
  intro x y hx hy
  have hleftI : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left hp hk
  have hrightI : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (k + 1)) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right hp hk
  have hxI : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
    intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval hp hk hx
  have hyI : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y :=
    intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval hp hk hy
  have hfx_left : RealTheory.le (f (p k)) (f x) :=
    hmono (p k) x hleftI hxI hx.left
  have hfx_right : RealTheory.le (f x) (f (p (k + 1))) :=
    hmono x (p (k + 1)) hxI hrightI hx.right
  have hfy_left : RealTheory.le (f (p k)) (f y) :=
    hmono (p k) y hleftI hyI hy.left
  have hfy_right : RealTheory.le (f y) (f (p (k + 1))) :=
    hmono y (p (k + 1)) hyI hrightI hy.right
  exact abs_sub_le_of_closedInterval_mem
    (And.intro hfx_left hfx_right)
    (And.intro hfy_left hfy_right)

name: finiteSum_endpointForwardSub

theorem finiteSum_endpointForwardSub
    (f : Point -> Point) (p : Nat -> Point) :

name: finiteSum_endpointReverseSub
statement:
theorem finiteSum_endpointReverseSub
    (f : Point -> Point) (p : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub (f (p i)) (f (p (i + 1)))) n =
        RealTheory.sub (f (p 0)) (f (p n))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcongr :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.sub (f (p i)) (f (p (i + 1)))) n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i)))) n := by

    intro i
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F
      (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i))
  rw [hcongr]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_neg]
  rw [finiteSum_endpointForwardSub]
  exact Eq.symm
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f (p n)) (f (p 0)))

name: finiteSum_endpointForwardSub_eq_abs_endpointSub_of_monotone

theorem finiteSum_endpointForwardSub_eq_abs_endpointSub_of_monotone
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}

      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)

  have hnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hfab
  rw [finiteSum_endpointForwardSub]
  rw [intervalPartition_right_endpoint hp]
  rw [intervalPartition_left_endpoint hp]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]

name: finiteSum_endpointReverseSub_eq_abs_endpointSub_of_decreasing
statement:
theorem finiteSum_endpointReverseSub_eq_abs_endpointSub_of_decreasing
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}

  have hnonpos : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))

name: oscillationWeightedSum_le_absEndpointSub_mul_mesh_of_monotone
statement:
theorem oscillationWeightedSum_le_absEndpointSub_mul_mesh_of_monotone
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {p omega : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hmono : RealTheory.FunctionMonotoneOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (homega : forall i : Nat, i < n ->
      IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i)) :
    RealTheory.le (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega)
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a)))
        (mesh p n))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold oscillationWeightedSum
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (omega i) (cellLength p i)) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i)))
              (mesh p n)) n) := by
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (omega i) (cellLength p i))
      (fun i : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i)))
          (mesh p n))
      n
      (fun i hi => by
        have homega_le :
            RealTheory.le (omega i)
              (RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i))) :=
          isCellOscillation_le_endpointSub_of_functionMonotoneOn_closedInterval
            hmono hp hi (homega i hi)
        have hcell_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (cellLength p i) :=
          cellLength_nonnegative hp hi
        have hleft :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.mul (omega i) (cellLength p i))
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i)))
                (cellLength p i)) :=
          RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right homega_le hcell_nonneg
        have hpiI : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p i) :=
          intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_left hp hi
        have hpi1I : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (p (i + 1)) :=
          intervalPartition_cell_mem_closedInterval_right hp hi
        have hjump_nonneg :
            RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
              (RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i))) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F
            (hmono (p i) (p (i + 1)) hpiI hpi1I
              (intervalPartition_step_le hp hi))
        have hright :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i)))
                (cellLength p i))
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i)))
                (mesh p n)) :=
          RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
            (cellLength_le_mesh p n i hi) hjump_nonneg
        exact RealTheory.le_trans hleft hright)
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul
              (RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i)))
              (mesh p n)) n =
        RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat =>
              RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i))) n)
          (mesh p n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_right
      (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.sub (f (p (i + 1))) (f (p i)))
      (mesh p n) n
  rwa [hmul,
    finiteSum_endpointForwardSub_eq_abs_endpointSub_of_monotone hmono hp]
    at hsum

name: oscillationWeightedSum_lt_of_functionMonotoneOn_mesh_lt
statement:
theorem oscillationWeightedSum_lt_of_functionMonotoneOn_mesh_lt
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b delta eps : Point}
    {p omega : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hmono : RealTheory.FunctionMonotoneOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)

    (homega : forall i : Nat, i < n ->
      IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i))
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta)
    (hbudget :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))) delta)
        eps) :
    RealTheory.lt (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega) eps
proof:

  let C := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))

      RealTheory.le (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega)
        (RealTheory.mul C (mesh p n)) :=
    oscillationWeightedSum_le_absEndpointSub_mul_mesh_of_monotone

name: closedIntervalBounded_of_functionMonotoneOn_closedInterval
statement:
theorem closedIntervalBounded_of_functionMonotoneOn_closedInterval
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : RealTheory.FunctionMonotoneOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded f a b
proof:
:= by
  let B := RealTheory.max (RealTheory.abs (f a)) (RealTheory.abs (f b))
  refine closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le (B := B) ?_ ?_
  · exact RealTheory.le_trans
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f a))
      (RealTheory.le_max_left (RealTheory.abs (f a)) (RealTheory.abs (f b)))
  · intro x hx
    have hleft : RealTheory.le (f a) (f x) :=
      hmono a x (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab) hx hx.left
    have hright : RealTheory.le (f x) (f b) :=
      hmono x b hx (RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab) hx.right

name: riemannOscillationCriterion_of_functionMonotoneOn_closedInterval
statement:
theorem riemannOscillationCriterion_of_functionMonotoneOn_closedInterval
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hmono : RealTheory.FunctionMonotoneOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f) :
    RiemannOscillationCriterion f a b
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let C := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))
  have hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    closedIntervalBounded_of_functionMonotoneOn_closedInterval hab hmono
  have hC_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C :=
    RealTheory.abs_nonneg (RealTheory.sub (f b) (f a))
  cases exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
      (C := C) (eps := eps) hC_nonneg heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro n p hp hmesh

      have homega :

name: closedIntervalBounded_mul
statement:
theorem closedIntervalBounded_mul
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hf : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hg : ClosedIntervalBounded g a b) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded (MulFun f g) a b
proof:
:= by
  cases hf with
  | intro Bf hBf =>
      cases hg with
      | intro Bg hBg =>
          refine closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le
            (B := RealTheory.mul Bf Bg) ?_ ?_
          exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hBf.left hBg.left
          intro x hx
          unfold MulFun RealTheory.mul
          rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
          have hleft :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (f x))
                  (RealTheory.abs (g x)))
                (RealTheory.mul Bf (RealTheory.abs (g x))) :=
            RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
              (hBf.right x hx)
              (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (g x))
          have hright :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.mul Bf (RealTheory.abs (g x)))
                (RealTheory.mul Bf Bg) :=
            RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
              (hBg.right x hx)
              hBf.left
          exact RealTheory.le_trans hleft hright

name: darbouxGap_mul_le_of_abs_bounds
statement:
private theorem darbouxGap_mul_le_of_abs_bounds
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b Bf Bg : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hBf_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero Bf)
    (hBg_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero Bg)
    (hf_bound :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) Bf)
    (hg_bound :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (g x)) Bg) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub
        (upperSum (MulFun f g) p n)
        (lowerSum (MulFun f g) p n))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul Bf
          (RealTheory.sub (upperSum g p n) (lowerSum g p n)))
        (RealTheory.mul Bg
          (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le (B := Bf) hBf_nonneg hf_bound
  have hg_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded g a b :=
    closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le (B := Bg) hBg_nonneg hg_bound
  have hfg_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded (MulFun f g) a b :=
    closedIntervalBounded_mul hf_bdd hg_bdd
  let gapF := fun k : Nat =>
    RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k)
  let gapG := fun k : Nat =>
    RealTheory.sub (cellUpper g p k) (cellLower g p k)
  let error := fun k : Nat =>
    RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.mul Bf (gapG k))
      (RealTheory.mul Bg (gapF k))
  have hcell :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        RealTheory.le (cellUpper (MulFun f g) p k)
          (RealTheory.add (cellLower (MulFun f g) p k) (error k)) := by
    intro k hk
    have hsupf := exists_hasCellSup_of_closedIntervalBounded hf_bdd hp hk
    have hinff := exists_hasCellInf_of_closedIntervalBounded hf_bdd hp hk
    have hsupg := exists_hasCellSup_of_closedIntervalBounded hg_bdd hp hk
    have hinfg := exists_hasCellInf_of_closedIntervalBounded hg_bdd hp hk
    have hsupfg := exists_hasCellSup_of_closedIntervalBounded hfg_bdd hp hk
    have hinffg := exists_hasCellInf_of_closedIntervalBounded hfg_bdd hp hk
    exact
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellUpper_le_cellLower_add_of_pairwise_sub_le
        hinffg hsupfg
        (fun x y hx hy => by
          have hxab := partitionCell_mem_closedInterval hp hk hx
          have hyab := partitionCell_mem_closedInterval hp hk hy
          have hfxB := hf_bound x hxab
          have hfyB := hf_bound y hyab
          have hgxB := hg_bound x hxab
          have hfy_upper := le_of_hasCellSup (cellUpper_hasCellSup hsupf) hy
          have hfx_upper := le_of_hasCellSup (cellUpper_hasCellSup hsupf) hx
          have hfy_lower := le_of_hasCellInf (cellLower_hasCellInf hinff) hy
          have hfx_lower := le_of_hasCellInf (cellLower_hasCellInf hinff) hx
          have hgx_upper := le_of_hasCellSup (cellUpper_hasCellSup hsupg) hx
          have hgy_upper := le_of_hasCellSup (cellUpper_hasCellSup hsupg) hy
          have hgx_lower := le_of_hasCellInf (cellLower_hasCellInf hinfg) hx
          have hgy_lower := le_of_hasCellInf (cellLower_hasCellInf hinfg) hy
          have hfdiff :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))
                (gapF k) := by
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_le_of_bounds F
            · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
                F hfx_upper hfy_lower
            · change F.le (F.neg (F.sub (f x) (f y))) (gapF k)
              rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F]
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
                F hfy_upper hfx_lower
          have hgdiff :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (g x) (g y)))
                (gapG k) := by
            apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_le_of_bounds F
            · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
                F hgx_upper hgy_lower
            · change F.le (F.neg (F.sub (g x) (g y))) (gapG k)
              rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F]
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
                F hgy_upper hgx_lower
          have htri :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealTheory.mul (f x) (g x))
                    (RealTheory.mul (f y) (g y))))
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) (g x)))
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (f y) (RealTheory.sub (g x) (g y))))) := by
            change
              F.le
                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                  (F.sub (F.mul (f x) (g x)) (F.mul (f y) (g y))))
                (F.add
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                    (F.mul (F.sub (f x) (f y)) (g x)))
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs F
                    (F.mul (f y) (F.sub (g x) (g y)))))
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_mul_eq_sub_mul_add_mul_sub
              F (f x) (g x) (f y) (g y)]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
              F
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) (g x))
              (RealTheory.mul (f y) (RealTheory.sub (g x) (g y)))
          have htermF :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) (g x)))
                (RealTheory.mul Bg (gapF k)) := by
            unfold RealTheory.mul
            rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
            have hfirst := RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
              hgxB (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))
            have hsecond := RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
              hfdiff hBg_nonneg
            have hle := RealTheory.le_trans hfirst hsecond
            rwa [RealTheory.mul_comm (gapF k) Bg] at hle
          have htermG :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.mul
                    (f y) (RealTheory.sub (g x) (g y))))
                (RealTheory.mul Bf (gapG k)) := by
            unfold RealTheory.mul
            rw [RealTheory.abs_mul]
            exact RealTheory.le_trans
              (RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
                hfyB (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (RealTheory.sub (g x) (g y))))
              (RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hgdiff hBf_nonneg)
          have hsum := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F htermF htermG
          have hsum' :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) (g x)))
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.mul
                      (f y) (RealTheory.sub (g x) (g y)))))
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.mul Bf (gapG k))
                  (RealTheory.mul Bg (gapF k))) := by
            change
              F.le
                (F.add
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) (g x)))
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.mul (f y) (RealTheory.sub (g x) (g y)))))
                (F.add (F.mul Bf (gapG k)) (F.mul Bg (gapF k)))
            change
              F.le
                (F.add
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)) (g x)))
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.mul (f y) (RealTheory.sub (g x) (g y)))))
                (F.add (F.mul Bg (gapF k)) (F.mul Bf (gapG k))) at hsum
            rwa [F.add_comm (F.mul Bg (gapF k)) (F.mul Bf (gapG k))]
              at hsum
          have habs :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub
                    (RealTheory.mul (f x) (g x))
                    (RealTheory.mul (f y) (g y))))
                (error k) := by
            unfold error
            exact RealTheory.le_trans htri hsum'
          unfold MulFun
          exact RealTheory.le_trans
            (RealTheory.le_abs_self
              (RealTheory.sub
                (RealTheory.mul (f x) (g x))
                (RealTheory.mul (f y) (g y))))
            habs)
  have hweighted :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub
          (upperSum (MulFun f g) p n)
          (lowerSum (MulFun f g) p n))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (error k) (cellLength p k)) n) := by
    unfold upperSum lowerSum
    exact
      Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedDarbouxGap_le_errorSum_of_cellUpper_le
        (fun k hk => cellLength_nonnegative hp hk) hcell
  have hgapF :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedDarbouxGap_eq_finiteSum_cellGap_mul_weight
      f (cellLength p) p n
  have hgapG :=
    Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedDarbouxGap_eq_finiteSum_cellGap_mul_weight
      g (cellLength p) p n
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (error k) (cellLength p k)) n =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul Bf
            (RealTheory.sub (upperSum g p n) (lowerSum g p n)))
          (RealTheory.mul Bg
            (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))) := by
    calc
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (error k) (cellLength p k)) n =
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.mul Bf
                  (RealTheory.mul (gapG k) (cellLength p k)))
                (RealTheory.mul Bg
                  (RealTheory.mul (gapF k) (cellLength p k)))) n := by
            apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
            intro k
            unfold error
            rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
            change
              F.add
                  (F.mul (F.mul Bf (gapG k)) (cellLength p k))
                  (F.mul (F.mul Bg (gapF k)) (cellLength p k)) =
                F.add
                  (F.mul Bf (F.mul (gapG k) (cellLength p k)))
                  (F.mul Bg (F.mul (gapF k) (cellLength p k)))
            rw [F.mul_assoc, F.mul_assoc]
      _ = RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul Bf
                (RealTheory.mul (gapG k) (cellLength p k))) n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul Bg
                (RealTheory.mul (gapF k) (cellLength p k))) n) := by
            exact RealTheory.finiteSum_add _ _ n
      _ = RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul Bf
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (gapG k) (cellLength p k)) n))
          (RealTheory.mul Bg
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (gapF k) (cellLength p k)) n)) := by
            rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left, RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left]
      _ = RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul Bf
            (RealTheory.sub (upperSum g p n) (lowerSum g p n)))
          (RealTheory.mul Bg
            (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))) := by
            change
              RealTheory.sub (upperSum g p n) (lowerSum g p n) =
                RealTheory.finiteSum
                  (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (gapG k) (cellLength p k)) n
                at hgapG
            change
              RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n) =
                RealTheory.finiteSum
                  (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul (gapF k) (cellLength p k)) n
                at hgapF
            rw [<- hgapG, <- hgapF]
  rwa [hsum] at hweighted

name: riemannIntegrableOn_mul_of_le
statement:
theorem riemannIntegrableOn_mul_of_le
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b)
    (hg : RiemannIntegrableOn g a b) :
    RiemannIntegrableOn (MulFun f g) a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded hf
  have hg_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded g a b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded hg
  have hfg_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded (MulFun f g) a b :=
    closedIntervalBounded_mul hf_bdd hg_bdd
  have hfsmall : DarbouxGapSmall f a b := by
    cases hf with
    | intro I hI =>
        exact darbouxGapSmall_of_hasDarbouxIntegral hI.left hI.right
  have hgsmall : DarbouxGapSmall g a b := by
    cases hg with
    | intro I hI =>
        exact darbouxGapSmall_of_hasDarbouxIntegral hI.left hI.right
  cases hf_bdd with
  | intro Bf hBf =>
      cases hg_bdd with
      | intro Bg hBg =>
          have hfgsmall : DarbouxGapSmall (MulFun f g) a b := by
            intro eps heps
            let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
            have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
            cases exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
                (C := Bf) (eps := e2) hBf.left he2 with
            | intro epsG hepsG =>
                cases exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
                    (C := Bg) (eps := e2) hBg.left he2 with
                | intro epsF hepsF =>
                    cases exists_common_partition_darbouxGaps_lt
                        (Exists.intro Bf hBf)
                        (Exists.intro Bg hBg)
                        hfsmall hgsmall hepsF.left hepsG.left with
                    | intro n hn =>
                        cases hn with
                        | intro p hp =>
                            have hgap_le :=
                              darbouxGap_mul_le_of_abs_bounds
                                hp.left hBf.left hBg.left hBf.right hBg.right
                            have hrightF :
                                RealTheory.lt
                                  (RealTheory.mul Bg
                                    (RealTheory.sub
                                      (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n)))
                                  e2 :=
                              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                                (RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hp.right.left)
                                  hBg.left)
                                hepsF.right
                            have hrightG :
                                RealTheory.lt
                                  (RealTheory.mul Bf
                                    (RealTheory.sub
                                      (upperSum g p n) (lowerSum g p n)))
                                  e2 :=
                              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                                (RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hp.right.right)
                                  hBf.left)
                                hepsG.right
                            have hsum :=
                              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hrightG hrightF
                            have hsum_eps :
                                RealTheory.lt
                                  (RealTheory.add
                                    (RealTheory.mul Bf
                                      (RealTheory.sub
                                        (upperSum g p n) (lowerSum g p n)))
                                    (RealTheory.mul Bg
                                      (RealTheory.sub
                                        (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))))
                                  eps := by
                              change
                                F.lt
                                  (F.add
                                    (F.mul Bf
                                      (F.sub
                                        (upperSum g p n) (lowerSum g p n)))
                                    (F.mul Bg
                                      (F.sub
                                        (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))))
                                  (F.add e2 e2) at hsum
                              rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps]
                                at hsum
                            refine Exists.intro n ?_
                            refine Exists.intro p ?_
                            exact And.intro hp.left
                              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                F hgap_le hsum_eps)
          exact
            riemannIntegrableOn_of_darbouxGapSmall hab hfg_bdd hfgsmall

statement:
theorem orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_upperEndpoint_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval

        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) :

proof:
:= by
  have hsub :
      SetPred.Subset
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a x)
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) := by
    intro z hz
    exact And.intro hz.left (RealTheory.le_trans hz.right hx.right)
  have hf_ax :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a x) f := by
    change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a x) f
    change RealFunction.ContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f at hf
    exact RealFunction.continuousOn_subset hsub hf
  have hI : RiemannIntegrableOn f a x :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hx.left hf_ax
  exact orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_of_le_riemannIntegrableOn
    hx.left hI
