name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length_of_le
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length_of_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I M : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I)
    (hM :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs I)
      (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hI with
  | inl hleft =>
      exact hasDarbouxIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length
        hab hleft.right.left hleft.right.right hM
  | inr hright =>
      cases hright with
      | intro J hJ =>
          have hOrient :
              HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I :=
            Or.inr (Exists.intro J hJ)
          have h_eq : a = b :=
            RealTheory.le_antisymm hab hJ.left
          have hI_zero : I = RealTheory.zero := by
            rw [h_eq] at hOrient
            exact
              hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                hOrient
          have hlength_zero :
              RealTheory.sub b a = RealTheory.zero := by
            rw [h_eq]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F b
          have habs_zero :
              RealTheory.abs RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.zero := by
            change
              RealTheory.abs RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.zero =
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.zero
            exact RealTheory.abs_zero
          rw [hI_zero, habs_zero, hlength_zero, RealTheory.mul_zero]
          exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_abs_length
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_abs_length
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I M : Point}
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I)
    (hM_forward :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) M)
    (hM_reverse :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval b a x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs I)
      (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b a)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hI with
  | inl hleft =>
      have hbound :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs I)
            (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub b a)) :=
        hasDarbouxIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length
          hleft.left hleft.right.left hleft.right.right hM_forward
      have hlength_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub b a) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hleft.left
      have hlength_abs :
          RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b a) =
            RealTheory.sub b a :=
        RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hlength_nonneg
      rwa [hlength_abs]
  | inr hright =>
      cases hright with
      | intro J hJ =>
          have hbound :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.abs J)
                (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub a b)) :=
            hasDarbouxIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length
              hJ.left hJ.right.left hJ.right.right.left hM_reverse
          have hlength_nonpos :
              RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub b a) RealTheory.zero :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hJ.left
          have hlength_abs :
              RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b a) =
                RealTheory.sub a b := by
            rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonpos hlength_nonpos]
            exact Eq.symm
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F b a)
          have habs_neg :
              RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.neg J) = RealTheory.abs J := by
            change
              RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.neg J) =
                RealTheory.abs J
            exact RealTheory.abs_neg J
          rw [hJ.right.right.right, habs_neg, hlength_abs]
          exact hbound

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
      (HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I)
proof:
:= by
  cases hI with
  | inl hleft =>
      exact hleft.right
  | inr hright =>
      cases hright with
      | intro J hJ =>
          have h_eq : a = b :=
            RealTheory.le_antisymm hab hJ.left
          have hOrient :
              HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I :=
            Or.inr (Exists.intro J hJ)
          have hI_zero : I = RealTheory.zero := by
            rw [h_eq] at hOrient
            exact
              hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                hOrient
          rw [h_eq, hI_zero]
          exact And.intro
            (riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
              (riemannIntegrableOn_degenerate f b))
            (hasDarbouxIntegral_degenerate f b)

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
    {f F : Point -> Point} {a x y : Point}
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hFx : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a x (F x))
    (hFy : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y (F y)) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y
      (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x))
proof:
:= by
  have hAy_forward :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a y)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f a y (F y)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      (RealTheory.le_trans hax hxy) hFy
  have hAx_forward :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a x)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f a x (F x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hax hFx
  have hf_ay : RiemannIntegrableOn f a y :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_of_hasDarbouxIntegral
      hAy_forward.left hAy_forward.right
  have hdecomp :
      Exists
        (fun I : Point =>
          Exists
            (fun J : Point =>
              And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a x I)
                (And (HasDarbouxIntegral f x y J)
                  (F y = RealTheory.add I J)))) :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_decomposition_ordered
      hax hxy hf_ay hAy_forward.right
  cases hdecomp with
  | intro I hI =>
      cases hI with
      | intro J hJ =>
          have hI_eq :
              I = F x :=
            hasRiemannIntegral_unique
              (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                hAx_forward.left hJ.left)
              (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                hAx_forward.left hAx_forward.right)
          have hFy_eq :
              F y = RealTheory.add (F x) J := by
            rw [<- hI_eq]
            exact hJ.right.right
          have hFy_eq_comm :
              F y = RealTheory.add J (F x) := by
            rw [hFy_eq, RealTheory.add_comm]
          have hJ_eq :
              J = RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x) :=
            RealTheory.eq_sub_of_eq_add_right hFy_eq_comm
          have hxy_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f x y :=
            riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
              (riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_right hax hxy hf_ay)
          rw [<- hJ_eq]
          exact
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_le_hasDarbouxIntegral
              hxy hxy_bdd hJ.right.left

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_of_isIndefinite_ordered
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_of_isIndefinite_ordered

name: isIndefiniteRiemannIntegral_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub_ordered
statement:
theorem isIndefiniteRiemannIntegral_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub_ordered
    {f F : Point -> Point} {a x y M : Point}
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hF : IsIndefiniteRiemannIntegral f a F)
    (hM :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)))
      (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hI :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y
        (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_of_isIndefinite_ordered
      hax hxy hF
  have hbound :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)))
        (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length_of_le
      hxy hI hM
  have hlength_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hxy
  have hlength_abs :
      RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x) =
        RealTheory.sub y x :=
    RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hlength_nonneg
  rwa [hlength_abs]

name: isIndefiniteRiemannIntegral_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub_base_right
statement:
theorem isIndefiniteRiemannIntegral_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub_base_right
    {f F : Point -> Point} {a x y M : Point}
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x)
    (hay : RealTheory.le a y)
    (hF : IsIndefiniteRiemannIntegral f a F)
    (hM_forward :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M)
    (hM_reverse :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval y x z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)))
      (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact
        isIndefiniteRiemannIntegral_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub_ordered
          hax hxy hF hM_forward
  | inr hyx =>
      have hbound :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F x) (F y)))
            (RealTheory.mul M
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub x y))) :=
        isIndefiniteRiemannIntegral_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub_ordered
          hay hyx hF hM_reverse
      change
        C.le (C.abs (C.sub (F x) (F y)))
          (C.mul M (C.abs (C.sub x y))) at hbound
      change
        C.le (C.abs (C.sub (F y) (F x)))
          (C.mul M (C.abs (C.sub y x)))
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm C (F x) (F y),
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm C x y] at hbound

name: orientedEndpoint_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub_base_right
statement:
theorem orientedEndpoint_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub_base_right
    {f F : Point -> Point} {a x y M : Point}
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x)
    (hay : RealTheory.le a y)
    (hFx : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a x (F x))
    (hFy : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y (F y))
    (hM_forward :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M)
    (hM_reverse :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval y x z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)))
      (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      have hI :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y
            (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
          hax hxy hFx hFy
      have hbound :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F y) (F x)))
            (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length_of_le
          hxy hI hM_forward
      have hlength_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub y x) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hxy
      have hlength_abs :
          RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x) =
            RealTheory.sub y x :=
        RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hlength_nonneg
      rwa [hlength_abs]
  | inr hyx =>
      have hI :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f y x
            (RealTheory.sub (F x) (F y)) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
          hay hyx hFy hFx
      have hbound :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (F x) (F y)))
            (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub x y)) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length_of_le
          hyx hI hM_reverse
      have hlength_nonneg :
          C.le C.zero (C.sub x y) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hyx
      change
        C.le (C.abs (C.sub (F x) (F y)))
          (C.mul M (C.sub x y)) at hbound
      change
        C.le (C.abs (C.sub (F y) (F x)))
          (C.mul M (C.abs (C.sub y x)))
      rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg C hlength_nonneg] at hbound
      rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm C (F x) (F y),
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm C x y] at hbound

name: closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub
statement:
theorem closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b x y M : Point}
    (hf : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y)
    (hM :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable f a b hf y)
          (closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable f a b hf x)))
      (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x)))
proof:
:= by
  let G := closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable f a b hf
  have hGx : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a x (G x) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
      hf hx
  have hGy : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y (G y) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
      hf hy
  have hM_forward :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M := by
    intro z hz
    exact hM z
      (And.intro
        (RealTheory.le_trans hx.left hz.left)
        (RealTheory.le_trans hz.right hy.right))
  have hM_reverse :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval y x z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) M := by
    intro z hz
    exact hM z
      (And.intro
        (RealTheory.le_trans hy.left hz.left)
        (RealTheory.le_trans hz.right hx.right))
  exact
    orientedEndpoint_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub_base_right
      hx.left hy.left hGx hGy hM_forward hM_reverse

name: closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable_continuousOn
statement:
theorem closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable_continuousOn
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (_hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b) :
    RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
        f a b hf)
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let P :=
    closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable f a b hf
  cases riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded hf with
  | intro M hM =>
      intro x hx
      refine And.intro hx ?_
      intro eps heps
      cases exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg hM.left heps with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          intro y hy _hyne hdist
          have hprim_bound :
              RealTheory.le (RealFunction.dist (P y) (P x))
                (RealTheory.mul M (RealFunction.dist y x)) := by
            have hraw :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (RealTheory.sub (P y) (P x)))
                  (RealTheory.mul M
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x))) :=
              closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub
                (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (x := x) (y := y) (M := M)
                hf hx hy hM.right
            have hdist_target :
                RealFunction.dist (P y) (P x) =
                  RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (P y) (P x)) := rfl
            have hdist_source :
                RealFunction.dist y x =
                  RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub y x) := rfl
            rwa [hdist_target, hdist_source]
          have hdist_le_delta :
              RealTheory.le (RealFunction.dist y x) delta :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hdist
          have hmul_le :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.mul M (RealFunction.dist y x))
                (RealTheory.mul M delta) :=
            RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
              hdist_le_delta hM.left
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C
            (RealTheory.le_trans hprim_bound hmul_le)
            hdelta.right

name: hasRiemannIntegral_add
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_add
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hf : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I)
    (hg : HasRiemannIntegral g a b J) :
    HasRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.add (f x) (g x))
      a b (RealTheory.add I J)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hf.right e2 he2_pos with
  | intro deltaF hdeltaF =>
      cases hg.right e2 he2_pos with
      | intro deltaG hdeltaG =>
          refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.min deltaF deltaG) ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_min2 F
              hdeltaF.left hdeltaG.left
          · intro n p tag htag hmesh
            have hmeshF : RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaF :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                hmesh (RealTheory.min_le_left deltaF deltaG)
            have hmeshG : RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaG :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                hmesh (RealTheory.min_le_right deltaF deltaG)
            let sf := taggedSum f p tag n
            let sg := taggedSum g p tag n
            have hfclose :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sf I)) e2 := by
              dsimp [sf]
              exact hdeltaF.right n p tag htag hmeshF
            have hgclose :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sg J)) e2 := by
              dsimp [sg]
              exact hdeltaG.right n p tag htag hmeshG
            rw [taggedSum_add]
            change
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (F.sub (F.add sf sg) (F.add I J)))
                eps
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub F]
            have htri :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.abs
                    (F.add (F.sub sf I) (F.sub sg J)))
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sf I))
                    (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sg J))) :=
              RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
                (F.sub sf I) (F.sub sg J)
            have hsum :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sf I))
                    (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sg J)))
                  eps := by
              have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                F hfclose hgclose
              change
                F.lt
                  (F.add
                    (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sf I))
                    (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sg J)))
                  (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
              rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hadd
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: abs_sub_add_le_refinement_add_left_right
statement:
theorem abs_sub_add_le_refinement_add_left_right
    (s refined left right I J : Point)
    (hrefined : refined = RealTheory.add left right) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub s (RealTheory.add I J)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub refined s))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub left I))
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub right J))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have houter :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub s (RealTheory.add I J)))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub refined s))
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub refined (RealTheory.add I J)))) :=
    by
      change
        RealTheory.le
          (RealFunction.dist s (RealTheory.add I J))
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealFunction.dist refined s)
            (RealFunction.dist refined (RealTheory.add I J)))
      rw [RealFunction.dist_comm refined s]
      exact RealFunction.dist_triangle s refined (RealTheory.add I J)
  have hinner :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (RealTheory.sub refined (RealTheory.add I J)))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub left I))
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub right J))) := by
    rw [hrefined]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_add_sub_add_le_abs_sub_add_abs_sub
      F left right I J
  exact RealTheory.le_trans houter
    (RealTheory.add_le_add_left hinner
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub refined s)))

name: add_three_lt_of_half_quarter_budget
statement:
theorem add_three_lt_of_half_quarter_budget
    {insert left right eps : Point}
    (hinsert :
      RealTheory.lt insert
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps))
    (hleft :
      RealTheory.lt left
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps)))
    (hright :
      RealTheory.lt right
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps))) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add insert (RealTheory.add left right))
      eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbudget :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_quarter_half_quarter F
      (a := left) (b := insert) (c := right) (eps := eps)
      hleft hinsert hright
  have hreorder :
      F.add insert (F.add left right) =
        F.add left (F.add insert right) := by
    calc
      F.add insert (F.add left right) =
          F.add (F.add insert left) right := by rw [F.add_assoc]
      _ = F.add (F.add left insert) right := by
          rw [F.add_comm insert left]
      _ = F.add left (F.add insert right) := by rw [F.add_assoc]
  change F.lt (F.add insert (F.add left right)) eps
  rwa [hreorder]

name: abs_sub_add_lt_of_refinement_error_budget
statement:
theorem abs_sub_add_lt_of_refinement_error_budget
    {s refined left right I J eps : Point}
    (hrefined : refined = RealTheory.add left right)
    (hinsert :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub refined s))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps))
    (hleft :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub left I))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps)))
    (hright :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub right J))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps))) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub s (RealTheory.add I J)))

proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hle :=
    abs_sub_add_le_refinement_add_left_right
      s refined left right I J hrefined
  have hbudget :=
    add_three_lt_of_half_quarter_budget
      (insert := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub refined s))
      (left := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub left I))
      (right := RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub right J))
      (eps := eps) hinsert hleft hright
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hle hbudget

name: abs_le_abs_sub_add_abs_right

theorem abs_le_abs_sub_add_abs_right

name: abs_sub_le_abs_add_abs

theorem abs_sub_le_abs_add_abs

name: le_mul_inv_of_mul_le
statement:
theorem le_mul_inv_of_mul_le
    {x y c : Point}
    (hc : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c)
    (h : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul x c) y) :
    RealTheory.le x (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.inv c))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hc_ne : Not (c = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hc) hzero.symm
  have hinv_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv c) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hc)
  have hmul :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right h hinv_nonneg
  change
    F.le (F.mul (F.mul x c) (F.inv c))
      (F.mul y (F.inv c)) at hmul
  rw [F.mul_assoc x c (F.inv c)] at hmul
  rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hc_ne] at hmul
  rwa [F.mul_one] at hmul

name: hasRiemannIntegral_mul_left
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_mul_left
    (c : Point) {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hf : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    HasRiemannIntegral
      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul c (f x))
      a b (RealTheory.mul c I)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hf.left ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_pos_eta_abs_mul_lt F c heps with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases hf.right eta heta.left with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
          intro n p tag htag hmesh
          let sf := taggedSum f p tag n
          have hclose :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sf I)) eta := by
            dsimp [sf]
            exact hdelta.right n p tag htag hmesh
          rw [taggedSum_mul_left]
          change
            RealTheory.lt
              (RealTheory.abs
                (F.sub (F.mul c sf) (F.mul c I)))
              eps
          rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F c sf I]
          rw [RealTheory.abs_mul c (F.sub sf I)]
          have hmul_le :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c)
                  (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sf I)))
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs c) eta) :=
            RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hclose)
              (RealTheory.abs_nonneg c)
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
            hmul_le heta.right

name: hasRiemannIntegral_unique_of_le
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_unique_of_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I)
    (hJ : HasRiemannIntegral f a b J) :
    I = J
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  apply RealFunction.eq_of_forall_dist_lt
  intro eps heps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hI.right e2 he2 with
  | intro deltaI hdeltaI =>
      cases hJ.right e2 he2 with
      | intro deltaJ hdeltaJ =>
          let delta := RealTheory.min deltaI deltaJ
          have hdelta_pos :
              RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta := by
            unfold delta RealTheory.min
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
              hdeltaI.left hdeltaJ.left
          cases exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt
              (a := a) (b := b) hab hdelta_pos with
          | intro n hn =>
              cases hn with
              | intro p hp =>
                  cases hp with
                  | intro tag htag =>
                      have hmeshI : RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaI := by
                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                          htag.right
                          (RealTheory.min_le_left deltaI deltaJ)
                      have hmeshJ : RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaJ := by
                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                          htag.right
                          (RealTheory.min_le_right deltaI deltaJ)
                      have hcloseI :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub (taggedSum f p tag n) I))
                            e2 :=
                        hdeltaI.right n p tag htag.left hmeshI
                      have hcloseJ :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub (taggedSum f p tag n) J))
                            e2 :=
                        hdeltaJ.right n p tag htag.left hmeshJ
                      have htri :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I J))
                            (RealTheory.add
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (RealTheory.sub (taggedSum f p tag n) I))
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (RealTheory.sub
                                  (taggedSum f p tag n) J))) :=
                        by
                          change
                            RealTheory.le
                              (RealFunction.dist I J)
                              (RealTheory.add
                                (RealFunction.dist
                                  (taggedSum f p tag n) I)
                                (RealFunction.dist
                                  (taggedSum f p tag n) J))
                          rw [RealFunction.dist_comm
                            (taggedSum f p tag n) I]
                          exact RealFunction.dist_triangle
                            I (taggedSum f p tag n) J
                      have hsum :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.add
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (RealTheory.sub (taggedSum f p tag n) I))
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (RealTheory.sub
                                  (taggedSum f p tag n) J)))
                            eps := by
                        have hadd :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                            F hcloseI hcloseJ
                        change
                          F.lt
                            (F.add
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (F.sub (taggedSum f p tag n) I))
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (F.sub (taggedSum f p tag n) J)))
                            (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps]
                          at hadd
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: hasRiemannIntegral_unique
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_unique

proof:

theorem hasRiemannIntegral_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate

name: hasRiemannIntegral_cauchyCriterion
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_cauchyCriterion
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hI : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    RiemannCauchyCriterion f a b
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hI.left ?_
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro eps heps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hI.right e2 he2 with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro n₁ p₁ tag₁ n₂ p₂ tag₂ ht₁ ht₂ hm₁ hm₂
      let s₁ := taggedSum f p₁ tag₁ n₁
      let s₂ := taggedSum f p₂ tag₂ n₂
      have hclose₁ :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub s₁ I)) e2 :=
        hdelta.right n₁ p₁ tag₁ ht₁ hm₁
      have hclose₂ :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub s₂ I)) e2 :=
        hdelta.right n₂ p₂ tag₂ ht₂ hm₂
      have hclose₁' :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I s₁)) e2 := by
        change
          F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub I s₁)) e2
        rwa [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm I s₁]
      have hclose₂' :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I s₂)) e2 := by
        change
          F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub I s₂)) e2
        rwa [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm I s₂]
      have htri :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub s₁ s₂))
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I s₁))
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I s₂))) :=
        by
          change
            RealTheory.le
              (RealFunction.dist s₁ s₂)
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealFunction.dist I s₁)
                (RealFunction.dist I s₂))
          rw [RealFunction.dist_comm I s₁]
          exact RealFunction.dist_triangle s₁ I s₂
      have hsum :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I s₁))
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I s₂)))
            eps := by
        have hadd :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hclose₁' hclose₂'
        change
          F.lt
            (F.add
              (RealTheory.abs (F.sub I s₁))
              (RealTheory.abs (F.sub I s₂)))
            (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hadd
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_cauchyCriterion
statement:
theorem taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_cauchyCriterion
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (h : TaggedRiemannIntegrableOn f a b) :
    RiemannCauchyCriterion f a b
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | intro I hI =>
      exact hasRiemannIntegral_cauchyCriterion hI

name: hasRiemannIntegral_of_cauchyCriterion_seqTendsto
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_of_cauchyCriterion_seqTendsto
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    {countSeq : Nat -> Nat}
    {partitionSeq tagSeq : Nat -> Nat -> Point}
    (hcrit : RiemannCauchyCriterion f a b)
    (hsample :
      forall k : Nat,
        TaggedPartition a b (countSeq k)
          (partitionSeq k) (tagSeq k))
    (hmesh :
      forall delta : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta ->
          RealTheory.Eventually
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.lt
                (mesh (partitionSeq k) (countSeq k)) delta))
    (hsums :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun k : Nat =>
          taggedSum f (partitionSeq k) (tagSeq k) (countSeq k))
        I) :
    HasRiemannIntegral f a b I
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hcrit.left ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases hcrit.right e2 he2_pos with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases hmesh delta hdelta.left with
      | intro Nmesh hNmesh =>
          cases hsums e2 he2_pos with
          | intro Nclose hNclose =>
              let N := Nat.max Nmesh Nclose
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
              intro n p tag htag hmesh_p
              let s := taggedSum f p tag n
              let sample :=
                taggedSum f (partitionSeq N) (tagSeq N)
                  (countSeq N)
              have hsample_mesh :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (mesh (partitionSeq N) (countSeq N)) delta :=
                hNmesh N (Nat.le_max_left Nmesh Nclose)
              have hsample_close :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sample I)) e2 := by
                dsimp [sample, N]
                exact hNclose (Nat.max Nmesh Nclose)
                  (Nat.le_max_right Nmesh Nclose)
              have hcauchy :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub s sample)) e2 := by
                dsimp [s, sample]
                exact hdelta.right n p tag (countSeq N)
                  (partitionSeq N) (tagSeq N)
                  htag (hsample N) hmesh_p hsample_mesh
              have hcauchy_rev :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sample s)) e2 := by
                change F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sample s)) e2
                rwa [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm sample s]
              have htri :
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub s I))
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sample s))
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sample I))) :=
                by
                  change
                    RealTheory.le
                      (RealFunction.dist s I)
                      (RealTheory.add
                        (RealFunction.dist sample s)
                        (RealFunction.dist sample I))
                  rw [RealFunction.dist_comm sample s]
                  exact RealFunction.dist_triangle s sample I
              have hsum :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sample s))
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub sample I)))
                    eps := by
                have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                  F hcauchy_rev hsample_close
                change
                  F.lt
                    (F.add
                      (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sample s))
                      (RealTheory.abs (F.sub sample I)))
                    (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps]
                  at hadd
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: riemannSample_spec
statement:
theorem riemannSample_spec
    {a b : Point} {q : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b) (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q)
    (k : Nat) :
    And
      (TaggedPartition a b (riemannSampleCount hab hq k)
        (riemannSamplePartition hab hq k)
        (riemannSampleTags hab hq k))
      (RealTheory.lt
        (mesh (riemannSamplePartition hab hq k)
          (riemannSampleCount hab hq k))
        (RealTheory.baseTail q k))
proof:
:= by
  unfold riemannSampleCount riemannSamplePartition riemannSampleTags
  exact
    Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec
          (exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt hab
            (RealTheory.baseTail_pos hq k))))

name: riemannSample_taggedPartition
statement:
theorem riemannSample_taggedPartition
    {a b : Point} {q : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b) (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q)

name: riemannSample_mesh_lt_baseTail
statement:
theorem riemannSample_mesh_lt_baseTail
    {a b : Point} {q : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b) (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q)
    (k : Nat) :

name: riemannSample_mesh_eventually_lt
statement:
theorem riemannSample_mesh_eventually_lt
    {a b : Point} {q : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b) (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q) :
    forall delta : Point,
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta ->
        RealTheory.Eventually
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.lt
              (mesh (riemannSamplePartition hab hq k)
                (riemannSampleCount hab hq k))
              delta)
proof:
:= by
  intro delta hdelta
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htail :
      RealTheory.SeqTendsto
        (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.baseTail q k)
        RealTheory.zero :=
    RealTheory.baseTail_tendsto_zero_all hq
  cases htail delta hdelta with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro k hk
      have htail_close :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.baseTail q k) RealTheory.zero))
            delta :=
        hN k hk
      have htail_lt :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.baseTail q k) delta := by
        have hle :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.baseTail q k)
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.baseTail q k)
                  RealTheory.zero)) := by
          change
            F.le (RealTheory.baseTail q k)
              (RealTheory.abs
                (F.sub (RealTheory.baseTail q k) F.zero))
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F
            (RealTheory.baseTail q k)]
          exact RealTheory.le_abs_self (RealTheory.baseTail q k)
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
          hle htail_close
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
        (riemannSample_mesh_lt_baseTail hab hq k)
        htail_lt

name: riemannSampleSums_seqCauchy
statement:
theorem riemannSampleSums_seqCauchy
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point} {q : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q)
    (hcrit : RiemannCauchyCriterion f a b) :
    RealTheory.SeqCauchy
      (fun k : Nat =>
        taggedSum f (riemannSamplePartition hab hq k)
          (riemannSampleTags hab hq k)
          (riemannSampleCount hab hq k))
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hcrit.right eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases riemannSample_mesh_eventually_lt hab hq
          delta hdelta.left with
      | intro N hN =>
          refine Exists.intro N ?_
          intro n m hn hm
          exact hdelta.right
            (riemannSampleCount hab hq n)
            (riemannSamplePartition hab hq n)
            (riemannSampleTags hab hq n)
            (riemannSampleCount hab hq m)
            (riemannSamplePartition hab hq m)
            (riemannSampleTags hab hq m)
            (riemannSample_taggedPartition hab hq n)
            (riemannSample_taggedPartition hab hq m)
            (hN n hn) (hN m hm)

name: exists_hasRiemannIntegral_of_cauchyCriterion
statement:
theorem exists_hasRiemannIntegral_of_cauchyCriterion
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point} {q : Nat}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hq : RealTheory.ValidBase q)
    (hcrit : RiemannCauchyCriterion f a b) :
    Exists (fun I : Point => HasRiemannIntegral f a b I)
proof:
:= by
  let sumSeq := fun k : Nat =>
    taggedSum f (riemannSamplePartition hab hq k)
      (riemannSampleTags hab hq k)
      (riemannSampleCount hab hq k)
  have hseq : RealTheory.SeqCauchy sumSeq := by
    dsimp [sumSeq]
    exact riemannSampleSums_seqCauchy hab hq hcrit
  cases RealTheory.seqCauchy_converges hseq with
  | intro I hI =>
      refine Exists.intro I ?_
      exact hasRiemannIntegral_of_cauchyCriterion_seqTendsto
        (countSeq := riemannSampleCount hab hq)
        (partitionSeq := riemannSamplePartition hab hq)
        (tagSeq := riemannSampleTags hab hq)
        hcrit
        (riemannSample_taggedPartition hab hq)
        (riemannSample_mesh_eventually_lt hab hq)
        hI

name: exists_hasRiemannIntegral_of_cauchyCriterion_baseTwo
statement:
theorem exists_hasRiemannIntegral_of_cauchyCriterion_baseTwo
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hcrit : RiemannCauchyCriterion f a b) :
    Exists (fun I : Point => HasRiemannIntegral f a b I)
proof:
:= by
  have htwo : RealTheory.ValidBase 2 := by
    unfold RealTheory.ValidBase
    unfold IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ValidBase
    omega
  exact exists_hasRiemannIntegral_of_cauchyCriterion
    (q := 2) hab htwo hcrit

name: riemannCauchyCriterion_restrict_left
statement:
theorem riemannCauchyCriterion_restrict_left
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hcrit : RiemannCauchyCriterion f a b) :
    RiemannCauchyCriterion f a c
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hac ?_
  intro eps heps
  cases hcrit.right eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt hcb hdelta.left with
      | intro rightCount hrightCount =>
          cases hrightCount with
          | intro right hright =>
              cases hright with
              | intro rightTag hrightTag =>
                  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                  refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
                  intro leftCount₁ left₁ leftTag₁
                    leftCount₂ left₂ leftTag₂
                    hleft₁ hleft₂ hmesh₁ hmesh₂
                  let whole₁ :=
                    adjacentPartition left₁ right leftCount₁
                  let wholeTag₁ :=
                    adjacentTags leftTag₁ rightTag leftCount₁
                  let whole₂ :=
                    adjacentPartition left₂ right leftCount₂
                  let wholeTag₂ :=
                    adjacentTags leftTag₂ rightTag leftCount₂
                  have hwhole₁ :
                      TaggedPartition a b
                        (leftCount₁ + rightCount) whole₁ wholeTag₁ := by
                    dsimp [whole₁, wholeTag₁]
                    exact adjacentTaggedPartition hleft₁ hrightTag.left
                  have hwhole₂ :
                      TaggedPartition a b
                        (leftCount₂ + rightCount) whole₂ wholeTag₂ := by
                    dsimp [whole₂, wholeTag₂]
                    exact adjacentTaggedPartition hleft₂ hrightTag.left
                  have hwhole_mesh₁ :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (mesh whole₁ (leftCount₁ + rightCount)) delta := by
                    dsimp [whole₁]
                    exact mesh_adjacentPartition_lt
                      hleft₁.left hrightTag.left.left hdelta.left
                      hmesh₁ hrightTag.right
                  have hwhole_mesh₂ :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (mesh whole₂ (leftCount₂ + rightCount)) delta := by
                    dsimp [whole₂]
                    exact mesh_adjacentPartition_lt
                      hleft₂.left hrightTag.left.left hdelta.left
                      hmesh₂ hrightTag.right
                  have hclose :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.abs
                          (RealTheory.sub
                            (taggedSum f whole₁ wholeTag₁
                              (leftCount₁ + rightCount))
                            (taggedSum f whole₂ wholeTag₂
                              (leftCount₂ + rightCount))))
                        eps :=
                    hdelta.right
                      (leftCount₁ + rightCount) whole₁ wholeTag₁
                      (leftCount₂ + rightCount) whole₂ wholeTag₂
                      hwhole₁ hwhole₂ hwhole_mesh₁ hwhole_mesh₂
                  have hsum₁ :
                      taggedSum f whole₁ wholeTag₁
                          (leftCount₁ + rightCount) =
                        RealTheory.add
                          (taggedSum f left₁ leftTag₁ leftCount₁)
                          (taggedSum f right rightTag rightCount) := by
                    dsimp [whole₁, wholeTag₁]
                    exact taggedSum_adjacent f hleft₁ hrightTag.left
                  have hsum₂ :
                      taggedSum f whole₂ wholeTag₂
                          (leftCount₂ + rightCount) =
                        RealTheory.add
                          (taggedSum f left₂ leftTag₂ leftCount₂)
                          (taggedSum f right rightTag rightCount) := by
                    dsimp [whole₂, wholeTag₂]
                    exact taggedSum_adjacent f hleft₂ hrightTag.left
                  rw [hsum₁, hsum₂] at hclose
                  rw [sub_add_same_right] at hclose
                  exact hclose

name: riemannCauchyCriterion_restrict_right
statement:
theorem riemannCauchyCriterion_restrict_right
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hcrit : RiemannCauchyCriterion f a b) :
    RiemannCauchyCriterion f c b
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hcb ?_
  intro eps heps
  cases hcrit.right eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      cases exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt hac hdelta.left with
      | intro leftCount hleftCount =>
          cases hleftCount with
          | intro left hleft =>
              cases hleft with
              | intro leftTag hleftTag =>
                  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                  refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
                  intro rightCount₁ right₁ rightTag₁
                    rightCount₂ right₂ rightTag₂
                    hright₁ hright₂ hmesh₁ hmesh₂
                  let whole₁ :=
                    adjacentPartition left right₁ leftCount
                  let wholeTag₁ :=
                    adjacentTags leftTag rightTag₁ leftCount
                  let whole₂ :=
                    adjacentPartition left right₂ leftCount
                  let wholeTag₂ :=
                    adjacentTags leftTag rightTag₂ leftCount
                  have hwhole₁ :
                      TaggedPartition a b
                        (leftCount + rightCount₁) whole₁ wholeTag₁ := by
                    dsimp [whole₁, wholeTag₁]
                    exact adjacentTaggedPartition hleftTag.left hright₁
                  have hwhole₂ :
                      TaggedPartition a b
                        (leftCount + rightCount₂) whole₂ wholeTag₂ := by
                    dsimp [whole₂, wholeTag₂]
                    exact adjacentTaggedPartition hleftTag.left hright₂
                  have hwhole_mesh₁ :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (mesh whole₁ (leftCount + rightCount₁)) delta := by
                    dsimp [whole₁]
                    exact mesh_adjacentPartition_lt
                      hleftTag.left.left hright₁.left hdelta.left
                      hleftTag.right hmesh₁
                  have hwhole_mesh₂ :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (mesh whole₂ (leftCount + rightCount₂)) delta := by
                    dsimp [whole₂]
                    exact mesh_adjacentPartition_lt
                      hleftTag.left.left hright₂.left hdelta.left
                      hleftTag.right hmesh₂
                  have hclose :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.abs
                          (RealTheory.sub
                            (taggedSum f whole₁ wholeTag₁
                              (leftCount + rightCount₁))
                            (taggedSum f whole₂ wholeTag₂
                              (leftCount + rightCount₂))))
                        eps :=
                    hdelta.right
                      (leftCount + rightCount₁) whole₁ wholeTag₁
                      (leftCount + rightCount₂) whole₂ wholeTag₂
                      hwhole₁ hwhole₂ hwhole_mesh₁ hwhole_mesh₂
                  have hsum₁ :
                      taggedSum f whole₁ wholeTag₁
                          (leftCount + rightCount₁) =
                        RealTheory.add
                          (taggedSum f left leftTag leftCount)
                          (taggedSum f right₁ rightTag₁ rightCount₁) := by
                    dsimp [whole₁, wholeTag₁]
                    exact taggedSum_adjacent f hleftTag.left hright₁
                  have hsum₂ :
                      taggedSum f whole₂ wholeTag₂
                          (leftCount + rightCount₂) =
                        RealTheory.add
                          (taggedSum f left leftTag leftCount)
                          (taggedSum f right₂ rightTag₂ rightCount₂) := by
                    dsimp [whole₂, wholeTag₂]
                    exact taggedSum_adjacent f hleftTag.left hright₂
                  rw [hsum₁, hsum₂] at hclose
                  rw [sub_add_same_left] at hclose
                  exact hclose

name: exists_hasRiemannIntegral_restrict_left
statement:
theorem exists_hasRiemannIntegral_restrict_left
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b I : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hI : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I) :

proof:

  exists_hasRiemannIntegral_of_cauchyCriterion_baseTwo hac

name: exists_hasRiemannIntegral_restrict_right
statement:
theorem exists_hasRiemannIntegral_restrict_right
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b I : Point}

name: taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_restrict_left
statement:
theorem taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_restrict_left
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)

name: taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_restrict_right
statement:
theorem taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_restrict_right
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (h : TaggedRiemannIntegrableOn f a b) :
    TaggedRiemannIntegrableOn f c b
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | intro I hI =>
      exact exists_hasRiemannIntegral_restrict_right hac hcb hI

name: hasRiemannIntegral_bounded_taggedSums
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_bounded_taggedSums
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hI : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall (n : Nat) (p tag : Nat -> Point),
            TaggedPartition a b n p tag ->
            RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta ->
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.abs (taggedSum f p tag n))
                (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.abs I))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hI.right RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero_lt_one with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro n p tag htag hmesh
      let s := taggedSum f p tag n
      have hclose :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub s I))
            RealTheory.one :=
        hdelta.right n p tag htag hmesh
      have htri :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs s)
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub s I))
              (RealTheory.abs I)) :=
        abs_le_abs_sub_add_abs_right s I
      have hclose_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub s I))
            RealTheory.one :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hclose
      have hsum_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub s I))
              (RealTheory.abs I))
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.abs I)) :=
        RealTheory.add_le_add_right hclose_le (RealTheory.abs I)
      exact RealTheory.le_trans htri hsum_le

name: hasRiemannIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I M : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I)
    (hM :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) M) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs I)
      (RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let B := RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.sub b a)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_forall_lt_add_pos F
    (x := RealTheory.abs I) (y := B)
    (fun eps heps => by
      cases hI.right eps heps with
      | intro delta hdelta =>
          cases exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt
              (a := a) (b := b) hab hdelta.left with
          | intro n hn =>
              cases hn with
              | intro p hp =>
                  cases hp with
                  | intro tag htag =>
                      let s := taggedSum f p tag n
                      have hclose :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub s I))
                            eps := by
                        dsimp [s]
                        exact hdelta.right n p tag htag.left htag.right
                      have hclose_rev :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I s))
                            eps := by
                        change
                          F.lt (RealTheory.abs (F.sub I s)) eps
                        rwa [RealTheory.abs_sub_comm I s]
                      have htri :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealTheory.abs I)
                            (RealTheory.add
                              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I s))
                              (RealTheory.abs s)) :=
                        abs_le_abs_sub_add_abs_right I s
                      have hs_bound :
                          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs s) B := by
                        dsimp [s, B]
                        exact abs_taggedSum_le_bound_mul_length
                          htag.left hM
                      have hsum_lt :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.add
                              (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I s))
                              (RealTheory.abs s))
                            (RealTheory.add eps B) := by
                        have hstep_lt :
                            RealTheory.lt
                              (RealTheory.add
                                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I s))
                                (RealTheory.abs s))
                              (RealTheory.add eps (RealTheory.abs s)) :=
                          RealTheory.add_lt_add_right
                            hclose_rev (RealTheory.abs s)
                        have hstep_le :
                            RealTheory.le
                              (RealTheory.add eps (RealTheory.abs s))
                              (RealTheory.add eps B) :=
                          RealTheory.add_le_add_left hs_bound eps
                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                          F hstep_lt hstep_le
                      have hI_lt_eps_B :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs I)
                            (RealTheory.add eps B) :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                          F htri hsum_lt
                      change
                        F.lt (RealTheory.abs I) (F.add B eps)
                      rw [F.add_comm B eps]
                      exact hI_lt_eps_B)

name: closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le
statement:
theorem closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b B : Point}
    (hB : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero B)
    (hbound :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) B) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded f a b
proof:
:=
  Exists.intro B (And.intro hB hbound)

name: closedIntervalBounded_const
statement:
theorem closedIntervalBounded_const
    (c a b : Point) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded (fun _ : Point => c) a b
proof:
:=
  closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le
    (RealTheory.abs_nonneg c)
    (fun _ _ => RealTheory.le_refl (RealTheory.abs c))

name: closedIntervalBounded_of_right_le_left
statement:
theorem closedIntervalBounded_of_right_le_left
    (f : Point -> Point) {a b : Point}
    (hba : RealTheory.le b a) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded f a b
proof:
:=
  closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le
    (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (B := RealTheory.abs (f a))
    (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f a))
    (fun x hx => by
      have hxa : RealTheory.le x a :=
        RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hba
      have hx_eq : x = a :=
        RealTheory.le_antisymm hxa hx.left
      rw [hx_eq]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl (RealTheory.abs (f a)))

name: closedIntervalBounded_of_closedInterval_subset
statement:
theorem closedIntervalBounded_of_closedInterval_subset
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b c d : Point}

      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval c d x ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded f c d
proof:
:= by
  cases hbdd with
  | intro B hB =>
      exact closedIntervalBounded_of_abs_le hB.left
        (fun x hx => hB.right x (hsubset x hx))

name: closedIntervalBounded_restrict_left
statement:
theorem closedIntervalBounded_restrict_left
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}

    ClosedIntervalBounded f a c

name: closedIntervalBounded_restrict_right
statement:
theorem closedIntervalBounded_restrict_right
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)

name: closedIntervalBounded_adjacent
statement:
theorem closedIntervalBounded_adjacent
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hleft : ClosedIntervalBounded f a c)
    (hright : ClosedIntervalBounded f c b) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded f a b
proof:
:= by
  cases hleft with
  | intro BL hBL =>
      cases hright with
      | intro BR hBR =>
          let B := RealTheory.max BL BR
          refine Exists.intro B ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact RealTheory.le_trans hBL.left
              (RealTheory.le_max_left BL BR)
          · intro x hx
            cases RealTheory.le_total x c with
            | inl hxc =>
                have hx_left : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a c x :=
                  And.intro hx.left hxc
                exact RealTheory.le_trans
                  (hBL.right x hx_left)
                  (RealTheory.le_max_left BL BR)
            | inr hcx =>
                have hx_right : RealTheory.ClosedInterval c b x :=
                  And.intro hcx hx.right
                exact RealTheory.le_trans
                  (hBR.right x hx_right)
                  (RealTheory.le_max_right BL BR)

name: hasRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalBounded_of_lt
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalBounded_of_lt
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded f a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hasRiemannIntegral_bounded_taggedSums hI with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      have hab_le : RealTheory.le a b :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab
      cases exists_nat_uniformStep_lt hab_le hdelta.left with
      | intro q hq =>
          cases q with
          | zero =>
              exact False.elim (hq.left rfl)
          | succ m =>
              let q : Nat := m + 1
              let step := uniformStep a b q
              let p := uniformPartition a step
              let tag := leftTags p
              let M := RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.abs I)
              let D := RealTheory.add M M
              let C := RealTheory.mul D (RealTheory.inv step)
              let A := tagAbsSum f tag q
              let B := RealTheory.add C A
              have hq_ne : Not (q = 0) := by
                unfold q
                omega
              have hstep_nonneg :
                  RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero step := by
                unfold step q
                exact uniformStep_nonnegative hab_le hq_ne
              have hstep_pos :
                  RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero step := by
                unfold step q
                exact uniformStep_pos hab hq_ne
              have hspan :
                  RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat q) step =
                    RealTheory.sub b a := by
                unfold step q
                exact nat_mul_uniformStep hq_ne
              have hp : IntervalPartition a b q p := by
                unfold p
                exact uniformPartition_intervalPartition
                  (a := a) (b := b) (step := step) (n := q)
                  hstep_nonneg hspan
              have htag : TaggedPartition a b q p tag := by
                unfold tag
                exact leftTags_taggedPartition hp
              have hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh p q) delta := by
                unfold p step q
                exact mesh_uniformPartition_lt_of_step_lt
                  (a := a) (step := uniformStep a b (m + 1))
                  (delta := delta) (n := m + 1)
                  (uniformStep_nonnegative hab_le hq_ne)
                  hq.right
              have hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M := by
                unfold M
                have h :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                      RealTheory.zero_lt_one)
                    (RealTheory.abs_nonneg I)
                change
                  F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero)
                    (F.add F.one (RealTheory.abs I)) at h
                rwa [F.zero_add] at h
              have hD_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero D := by
                unfold D
                have h :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hM_nonneg hM_nonneg
                change F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero) (F.add M M) at h
                rwa [F.zero_add] at h
              have hC_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C := by
                unfold C
                exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hD_nonneg
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hstep_pos))
              have hA_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero A := by
                unfold A tagAbsSum
                exact RealTheory.finiteSum_nonneg
                  (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.abs (f (tag k))) q
                  (fun k _hk => RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f (tag k)))
              have hB_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero B := by
                unfold B
                have h :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hC_nonneg hA_nonneg
                change F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero) (F.add C A) at h
                rwa [F.zero_add] at h
              refine Exists.intro B ?_
              refine And.intro hB_nonneg ?_
              intro x hx
              cases intervalPartition_cell_cover_succ
                  (n := m) (p := p) hp hx with
              | intro k hkcell =>
                  let tag' := replaceTag tag k x
                  have hk : k < q := by
                    exact hkcell.left
                  have htag' : TaggedPartition a b q p tag' := by
                    unfold tag'
                    exact replaceTag_taggedPartition htag hkcell.right
                  let s := taggedSum f p tag q
                  let s' := taggedSum f p tag' q
                  have hs :
                      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs s) M := by
                    unfold s M
                    exact hdelta.right q p tag htag hmesh
                  have hs' :
                      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs s') M := by
                    unfold s' M
                    exact hdelta.right q p tag' htag' hmesh
                  have hsumdiff :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub s' s))
                        D := by
                    have htri := abs_sub_le_abs_add_abs s' s
                    have hadd :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hs' hs
                    unfold D
                    exact RealTheory.le_trans htri hadd
                  have hreplace :
                      RealTheory.sub s' s =
                        RealTheory.mul
                          (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f (tag k)))
                          (cellLength p k) := by
                    unfold s s' tag'
                    exact taggedSum_replaceTag_sub
                      (f := f) (p := p) (tag := tag)
                      (n := q) (k := k) (x := x) hk
                  have hcell_len : cellLength p k = step := by
                    unfold p
                    exact cellLength_uniformPartition a step k
                  have hprod_abs :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.abs
                          (RealTheory.mul
                            (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f (tag k))) step))
                        D := by
                    rw [hreplace] at hsumdiff
                    rw [hcell_len] at hsumdiff
                    exact hsumdiff
                  have hprod :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.mul
                          (RealTheory.abs
                            (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f (tag k))))
                          step)
                        D := by
                    change
                      F.le
                        (RealTheory.abs
                          (F.mul
                            (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f (tag k)))
                            step))
                        D at hprod_abs
                    rw [RealTheory.abs_mul
                      (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f (tag k))) step] at hprod_abs
                    rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hstep_nonneg] at hprod_abs
                    exact hprod_abs
                  have hdiff :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.abs
                          (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f (tag k))))
                        C := by
                    unfold C
                    exact le_mul_inv_of_mul_le hstep_pos hprod
                  have hbase :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.abs (f (tag k)))
                        A := by
                    unfold A
                    exact tag_abs_le_tagAbsSum f tag hk
                  have htri_fx :=
                    abs_le_abs_sub_add_abs_right (f x) (f (tag k))
                  have hsum_le :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.add
                          (RealTheory.abs
                            (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f (tag k))))
                          (RealTheory.abs (f (tag k))))
                        B := by
                    unfold B
                    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hdiff hbase
                  exact RealTheory.le_trans htri_fx hsum_le

name: taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
statement:
theorem taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (h : TaggedRiemannIntegrableOn f a b) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded f a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases h with
  | intro I hI =>
      cases RealTheory.le_total a b with
      | inl hab =>
          by_cases hba : RealTheory.le b a
          case pos =>
            exact closedIntervalBounded_of_right_le_left f hba
          case neg =>
            have hlt : RealTheory.lt a b :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hab hba
            exact hasRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalBounded_of_lt hlt hI
      | inr hba =>
          exact closedIntervalBounded_of_right_le_left f hba

name: hasRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalBounded_adjacent
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalBounded_adjacent
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b I J : Point}
    (hleft : HasRiemannIntegral f a c I)
    (hright : HasRiemannIntegral f c b J) :
    ClosedIntervalBounded f a b
proof:
:=
  closedIntervalBounded_adjacent
    (taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
      (Exists.intro I hleft))
    (taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
      (Exists.intro J hright))

name: oscillationWeightedSum_le_eta_mul_intervalLength
statement:
theorem oscillationWeightedSum_le_eta_mul_intervalLength
    {a b eta : Point} {n : Nat} {p omega : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (homega : forall i : Nat, i < n ->
      RealTheory.le (omega i) eta) :
    RealTheory.le (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega)
      (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:= by
  unfold oscillationWeightedSum
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (omega i) (cellLength p i)) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p i)) n) := by
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (omega i) (cellLength p i))
      (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p i))
      n
      (fun i hi => by
        exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
          (homega i hi) (cellLength_nonnegative hp hi))
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p i)) n =
        RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.finiteSum (cellLength p) n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left eta (cellLength p) n
  rwa [hmul, intervalPartition_finiteSum_cellLength hp] at hsum

name: oscillationWeightedSum_lt_of_eta_mul_intervalLength_lt
statement:
theorem oscillationWeightedSum_lt_of_eta_mul_intervalLength_lt
    {a b eta eps : Point} {n : Nat} {p omega : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (homega : forall i : Nat, i < n ->
      RealTheory.le (omega i) eta)
    (hbudget :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a)) eps) :
    RealTheory.lt (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega) eps
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    (oscillationWeightedSum_le_eta_mul_intervalLength hp homega)
    hbudget

name: riemannOscillationCriterion_half
statement:
theorem riemannOscillationCriterion_half
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b eps : Point}
    (hcrit : RiemannOscillationCriterion f a b)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (forall (n : Nat) (p : Nat -> Point),
            IntervalPartition a b n p ->
            RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta ->
              Exists
                (fun omega : Nat -> Point =>
                  And
                    (forall i : Nat, i < n ->
                      IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i))
                    (RealTheory.lt
                      (oscillationWeightedSum p n omega)
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
                        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  exact hcrit (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps)

statement:

name: refinementBlockFineTag_mem_coarseCell
proof:
:= by
  let j := cut i + h
  have hj_lt_cut : j < cut (i + 1) :=
    partitionBlockRefines_block_index_lt_right href hi hh
  have hj_lt_m : j < m :=
    partitionBlockRefines_block_index_lt_right_bound href hi hh
  have hcut_i_le_j : cut i <= j := by
    unfold j
    exact Nat.le_add_right (cut i) h
  have hsucc_le_cut : j + 1 <= cut (i + 1) :=
    Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj_lt_cut
  have hcut_succ_le_m : cut (i + 1) <= m :=
    partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right href (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
  have hleft_q : RealTheory.le (q (cut i)) (q j) :=
    intervalPartition_le_of_le hfine.left (cut i) j
      hcut_i_le_j (Nat.le_of_lt hj_lt_m)
  have hright_q : RealTheory.le (q (j + 1)) (q (cut (i + 1))) :=
    intervalPartition_le_of_le hfine.left (j + 1) (cut (i + 1))
      hsucc_le_cut hcut_succ_le_m
  have hpi : q (cut i) = p i :=
    partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
  have hpi_succ : q (cut (i + 1)) = p (i + 1) :=
    partitionBlockRefines_endpoint href (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
  have hfine_cell : PartitionCell q j (fineTag j) :=
    hfine.right j hj_lt_m
  unfold PartitionCell
  have hleft : RealTheory.le (p i) (fineTag j) := by
    have hleft_q' : RealTheory.le (p i) (q j) := by
      rw [<- hpi]
      exact hleft_q
    exact RealTheory.le_trans hleft_q' hfine_cell.left
  have hright : RealTheory.le (fineTag j) (p (i + 1)) := by
    have hright_q' : RealTheory.le (q (j + 1)) (p (i + 1)) := by
      rwa [hpi_succ] at hright_q
    exact RealTheory.le_trans hfine_cell.right hright_q'
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: refinementBlockTaggedSum_sub_coarseContribution
statement:
theorem refinementBlockTaggedSum_sub_coarseContribution
    {f : Point -> Point} {q p fineTag coarseTag : Nat -> Point}
    {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    {i : Nat}
    (hi : i < n) :
    RealTheory.sub
      (refinementBlockTaggedSum f q fineTag cut i)
      (coarseCellContribution f p coarseTag i) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun h : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.sub (f (fineTag (cut i + h))) (f (coarseTag i)))
            (refinementBlockCellLength q cut i h))
        (refinementBlockLength cut i)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let count := refinementBlockLength cut i
  let len := fun h : Nat => refinementBlockCellLength q cut i h
  let u := fun h : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul (f (fineTag (cut i + h))) (len h)
  let v := fun h : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul (f (coarseTag i)) (len h)
  have hcoarse :
      coarseCellContribution f p coarseTag i =
        RealTheory.finiteSum v count := by
    unfold coarseCellContribution v len count
    rw [<- finiteSum_refinementBlockCellLength href hi]
    exact Eq.symm
      (RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left (f (coarseTag i))
        (fun h : Nat => refinementBlockCellLength q cut i h)
        (refinementBlockLength cut i))
  unfold refinementBlockTaggedSum
  change
    RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.finiteSum u count)
      (coarseCellContribution f p coarseTag i) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun h : Nat =>
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.sub (f (fineTag (cut i + h))) (f (coarseTag i)))
            (len h))
        count
  rw [hcoarse]
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_sub u v count]
  apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
  intro h
  unfold u v len
  exact Eq.symm
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F
      (f (fineTag (cut i + h))) (f (coarseTag i))
      (refinementBlockCellLength q cut i h))
