name: abs_refinementBlockTaggedSum_sub_coarseContribution_le
statement:
theorem abs_refinementBlockTaggedSum_sub_coarseContribution_le
    {a b : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {q p fineTag coarseTag : Nat -> Point}
    {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat} {i : Nat} {omega : Point}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    (hfine : TaggedPartition a b m q fineTag)
    (hcoarse : TaggedPartition a b n p coarseTag)
    (hi : i < n)
    (homega : IsCellOscillation f p i omega) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (refinementBlockTaggedSum f q fineTag cut i)
          (coarseCellContribution f p coarseTag i)))
      (RealTheory.mul omega (cellLength p i))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let count := refinementBlockLength cut i
  let len := fun h : Nat => refinementBlockCellLength q cut i h
  let term := fun h : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul
      (RealTheory.sub (f (fineTag (cut i + h))) (f (coarseTag i)))
      (len h)
  let bound := fun h : Nat => RealTheory.mul omega (len h)
  have hformula :
      RealTheory.sub
        (refinementBlockTaggedSum f q fineTag cut i)
        (coarseCellContribution f p coarseTag i) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum term count := by
    unfold term len count
    exact refinementBlockTaggedSum_sub_coarseContribution href hi
  have htriangle :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum term count))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat => RealTheory.abs (term h)) count) :=
    RealTheory.abs_finiteSum_le_finiteSum_abs term count
  have hpoint :
      forall h : Nat, h < count ->
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (term h)) (bound h) := by
    intro h hh
    have hfine_mem :
        PartitionCell p i (fineTag (cut i + h)) :=
      refinementBlockFineTag_mem_coarseCell href hfine hi hh
    have hcoarse_mem : PartitionCell p i (coarseTag i) :=
      hcoarse.right i hi
    have hdiff :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (RealTheory.sub (f (fineTag (cut i + h))) (f (coarseTag i))))
          omega :=
      le_of_isCellOscillation homega hfine_mem hcoarse_mem
    have hlen_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (len h) := by
      unfold len
      exact refinementBlockCellLength_nonnegative href hfine.left hi hh
    unfold term bound
    change
      F.le
        (RealTheory.abs
          (F.mul
            (RealTheory.sub (f (fineTag (cut i + h))) (f (coarseTag i)))
            (len h)))
        (F.mul omega (len h))
    rw [RealTheory.abs_mul
      (RealTheory.sub (f (fineTag (cut i + h))) (f (coarseTag i)))
      (len h)]
    rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hlen_nonneg]
    exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hdiff hlen_nonneg
  have hsum_point :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat => RealTheory.abs (term h)) count)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum bound count) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun h : Nat => RealTheory.abs (term h)) bound count hpoint
  have hbound_eq :
      RealTheory.finiteSum bound count =
        RealTheory.mul omega (cellLength p i) := by
    unfold bound len count
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left]
    rw [finiteSum_refinementBlockCellLength href hi]
  rw [hformula]
  exact RealTheory.le_trans htriangle
    (RealTheory.le_trans hsum_point (by
      rw [hbound_eq]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl (RealTheory.mul omega (cellLength p i))))

name: abs_taggedSum_sub_taggedSum_le_sum_oscillation_of_block_refines
statement:
theorem abs_taggedSum_sub_taggedSum_le_sum_oscillation_of_block_refines
    {a b : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {q p fineTag coarseTag : Nat -> Point}
    {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat} {omega : Nat -> Point}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    (hfine : TaggedPartition a b m q fineTag)
    (hcoarse : TaggedPartition a b n p coarseTag)
    (homega :
      forall i : Nat, i < n -> IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (taggedSum f q fineTag m)
          (taggedSum f p coarseTag n)))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (omega i) (cellLength p i))
        n)
proof:
:= by
  let fineBlock := fun i : Nat =>
    refinementBlockTaggedSum f q fineTag cut i
  let coarseBlock := fun i : Nat =>
    coarseCellContribution f p coarseTag i
  let diff := fun i : Nat => RealTheory.sub (fineBlock i) (coarseBlock i)
  let bound := fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (omega i) (cellLength p i)
  have hfine_sum :
      taggedSum f q fineTag m =
        RealTheory.finiteSum fineBlock n := by
    unfold fineBlock
    exact taggedSum_eq_finiteSum_refinementBlockTaggedSum href
  have hcoarse_sum :
      taggedSum f p coarseTag n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum coarseBlock n := by
    unfold coarseBlock
    exact taggedSum_eq_finiteSum_coarseCellContribution f p coarseTag n
  have htriangle :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum diff n))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.abs (diff i)) n) :=
    RealTheory.abs_finiteSum_le_finiteSum_abs diff n
  have hpoint :
      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (diff i)) (bound i) := by
    intro i hi
    unfold diff fineBlock coarseBlock bound
    exact abs_refinementBlockTaggedSum_sub_coarseContribution_le
      href hfine hcoarse hi (homega i hi)
  have hsum_point :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.abs (diff i)) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum bound n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.abs (diff i)) bound n hpoint
  rw [hfine_sum, hcoarse_sum]
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_sub fineBlock coarseBlock n]
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum diff n))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum bound n)
  exact RealTheory.le_trans htriangle hsum_point

name: riemannCauchyCriterion_of_riemannOscillationCriterion
statement:
theorem riemannCauchyCriterion_of_riemannOscillationCriterion
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hcrit : RiemannOscillationCriterion f a b) :
    RiemannCauchyCriterion f a b
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hab ?_
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro eps heps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  cases riemannOscillationCriterion_half hcrit heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro leftCount left leftTag rightCount right rightTag
        hleft hright hmeshLeft hmeshRight
      cases hdelta.right leftCount left hleft.left hmeshLeft with
      | intro leftOmega hleftOmega =>
          cases hdelta.right rightCount right hright.left hmeshRight with
          | intro rightOmega hrightOmega =>
              cases exists_commonTaggedBlockRefinement hleft hright with
              | intro mergeCount hmergeCount =>
                  cases hmergeCount with
                  | intro merge hmerge =>
                      cases hmerge with
                      | intro mergeTag hmergeTag =>
                          cases hmergeTag with
                          | intro leftCut hleftCut =>
                              cases hleftCut with
                              | intro rightCut hcommon =>
                                  let leftSum :=
                                    taggedSum f left leftTag leftCount
                                  let rightSum :=
                                    taggedSum f right rightTag rightCount
                                  let mergeSum :=
                                    taggedSum f merge mergeTag mergeCount
                                  have hleft_est :
                                      RealTheory.le
                                        (RealTheory.abs
                                          (RealTheory.sub mergeSum leftSum))
                                        (oscillationWeightedSum left
                                          leftCount leftOmega) := by
                                    unfold mergeSum leftSum
                                    exact
                                      commonTaggedBlockRefinement_left_estimate
                                        hcommon hleft hleftOmega.left
                                  have hright_est :
                                      RealTheory.le
                                        (RealTheory.abs
                                          (RealTheory.sub mergeSum rightSum))
                                        (oscillationWeightedSum right
                                          rightCount rightOmega) := by
                                    unfold mergeSum rightSum
                                    exact
                                      commonTaggedBlockRefinement_right_estimate
                                        hcommon hright hrightOmega.left
                                  have htri :
                                      RealTheory.le
                                        (RealTheory.abs
                                          (RealTheory.sub leftSum rightSum))
                                        (RealTheory.add
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub mergeSum leftSum))
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              mergeSum rightSum))) :=
                                    by
                                      change
                                        RealTheory.le
                                          (RealFunction.dist
                                            leftSum rightSum)
                                          (RealTheory.add
                                            (RealFunction.dist
                                              mergeSum leftSum)
                                            (RealFunction.dist
                                              mergeSum rightSum))
                                      rw [RealFunction.dist_comm
                                        mergeSum leftSum]
                                      exact RealFunction.dist_triangle
                                        leftSum mergeSum rightSum
                                  have hsum_le :
                                      RealTheory.le
                                        (RealTheory.add
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub mergeSum leftSum))
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              mergeSum rightSum)))
                                        (RealTheory.add
                                          (oscillationWeightedSum left
                                            leftCount leftOmega)
                                          (oscillationWeightedSum right
                                            rightCount rightOmega)) :=
                                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
                                      hleft_est hright_est
                                  have hosc_sum :
                                      RealTheory.lt
                                        (RealTheory.add
                                          (oscillationWeightedSum left
                                            leftCount leftOmega)
                                          (oscillationWeightedSum right
                                            rightCount rightOmega))
                                        eps := by
                                    have hadd :=
                                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
                                        hleftOmega.right hrightOmega.right
                                    change
                                      F.lt
                                        (F.add
                                          (oscillationWeightedSum left
                                            leftCount leftOmega)
                                          (oscillationWeightedSum right
                                            rightCount rightOmega))
                                        (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                                    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                                      F eps] at hadd
                                  have hsum_lt :
                                      RealTheory.lt
                                        (RealTheory.add
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub mergeSum leftSum))
                                          (RealTheory.abs
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              mergeSum rightSum)))
                                        eps :=
                                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                                      hsum_le hosc_sum
                                  exact
                                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                                      htri hsum_lt

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
statement:
theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I)
    (hJ : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b J) :
    I = J
proof:
:= by
  cases hI with
  | inl hIforward =>
      cases hJ with
      | inl hJforward =>
          exact hasRiemannIntegral_unique
            (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
              hIforward.right.left hIforward.right.right)
            (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
              hJforward.right.left hJforward.right.right)
      | inr hJreverse =>
          cases hJreverse with
          | intro K hK =>
              have hab_eq : a = b :=
                RealTheory.le_antisymm hIforward.left hK.left
              subst b
              have hIzero : I = RealTheory.zero :=
                hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                  (Or.inl hIforward)
              have hJzero : J = RealTheory.zero :=
                hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                  (Or.inr (Exists.intro K hK))
              rw [hIzero, hJzero]
  | inr hIreverse =>
      cases hIreverse with
      | intro K hK =>
          cases hJ with
          | inl hJforward =>
              have hab_eq : a = b :=
                RealTheory.le_antisymm hJforward.left hK.left
              subst b
              have hIzero : I = RealTheory.zero :=
                hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                  (Or.inr (Exists.intro K hK))
              have hJzero : J = RealTheory.zero :=
                hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
                  (Or.inl hJforward)
              rw [hIzero, hJzero]
          | inr hJreverse =>
              cases hJreverse with
              | intro L hL =>
                  have hKL : K = L :=
                    hasRiemannIntegral_unique
                      (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                        hK.right.left hK.right.right.left)
                      (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                        hL.right.left hL.right.right.left)
                  rw [hK.right.right.right, hL.right.right.right, hKL]

theorem taggedSum_const
    (c : Point) (p tag : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      taggedSum (fun _ : Point => c) p tag n =

name: exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt
statement:
theorem exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt
    {a b delta : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
            Exists
              (fun tag : Nat -> Point =>
                And (TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
                  (RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta))))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_nat_uniformStep_lt hab hdelta with
  | intro n hn_step =>
      let step := uniformStep a b n
      have hstep_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero step :=
        uniformStep_nonnegative hab hn_step.left
      have hspan : RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) step =
          RealTheory.sub b a := by
        unfold step
        exact nat_mul_uniformStep hn_step.left
      cases exists_leftTaggedUniformPartition_mesh_lt
          (a := a) (b := b) (step := step) (delta := delta) (n := n)
          hstep_nonneg hspan hn_step.right with
      | intro p hp =>

name: exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt_with_prescribed_tag
statement:
theorem exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt_with_prescribed_tag
    {a b x delta : Point}
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hdelta : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
            Exists
              (fun tag : Nat -> Point =>
                And (TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
                  (And (RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta)
                    (Exists
                      (fun k : Nat =>
                        And (k < n) (tag k = x)))))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := RealTheory.sub b a
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b := RealTheory.le_trans hx.left hx.right
  have hL_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero L :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hab
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_mul_gt hL_nonneg hdelta with
  | intro n hlarge =>
      have hn : Not (n = 0) := by
        intro hn0
        have hbad : F.lt L F.zero := by
          rw [hn0] at hlarge
          change F.lt L (F.mul (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat F 0) delta)
            at hlarge
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_zero F] at hlarge
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_mul F] at hlarge
          exact hlarge
        exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.not_le_of_lt F hbad) hL_nonneg
      have hleft_len :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub x a) L := by
        unfold L
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
          F hx.right (RealTheory.le_refl a)
      have hleft_large :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x a)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) delta) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hleft_len hlarge
      have hright_len :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub b x) L := by
        unfold L
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
          F (RealTheory.le_refl b) hx.left
      have hright_large :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub b x)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) delta) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hright_len hlarge
      have hleft_step :
          RealTheory.lt (uniformStep a x n) delta :=
        uniformStep_lt_of_intervalLength_lt_nat_mul
          (a := a) (b := x) (delta := delta) (n := n)
          hn hleft_large
      have hright_step :
          RealTheory.lt (uniformStep x b n) delta :=
        uniformStep_lt_of_intervalLength_lt_nat_mul
          (a := x) (b := b) (delta := delta) (n := n)
          hn hright_large
      let p := splitUniformPartition a x b n
      let tag := leftTags p
      have hp : IntervalPartition a b (n + n) p :=
        splitUniformPartition_intervalPartition (a := a) (x := x)
          (b := b) hn hx
      have htag : TaggedPartition a b (n + n) p tag :=
        leftTags_taggedPartition hp
      have hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh p (n + n)) delta :=
        mesh_splitUniformPartition_lt (a := a) (x := x) (b := b)
          (delta := delta) (n := n) hn hdelta hleft_step hright_step
      have hk : n < n + n := by
        omega
      have htagx : tag n = x := by
        unfold tag leftTags p
        exact splitUniformPartition_middle (a := a) (x := x)
          (b := b) hn
      exact Exists.intro (n + n)
        (Exists.intro p
          (Exists.intro tag
            (And.intro htag
              (And.intro hmesh
                (Exists.intro n (And.intro hk htagx))))))

:= by

  cases hI.right eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>

          RealFunction.IntervalPartition.exists_threshold_refinement_mesh_lt
            hI.left hdelta.left hbase with
      | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>

          | intro threshold hthreshold =>
              refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
              refine Exists.intro threshold ?_

name: darbouxGapSmall_of_hasRefinementRiemannIntegral
statement:
theorem darbouxGapSmall_of_hasRefinementRiemannIntegral
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hI : HasRefinementRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    DarbouxGapSmall f a b
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e4 := RealTheory.quarter eps
  have he4_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e4 :=
    RealTheory.quarter_pos heps
  let base := twoPointPartition a b
  have hbase : IntervalPartition a b 1 base := by
    dsimp [base]
    exact twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hI.left
  cases hI.right e4 he4_pos 1 base hbase with
  | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
      cases hthresholdCount with
      | intro threshold hthreshold =>
          have hthresholdPart :
              IntervalPartition a b thresholdCount threshold :=
            hthreshold.left
          have hclose := hthreshold.right.right
          have hinf :
              forall k : Nat, k < thresholdCount ->
                Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f threshold k m) :=
            fun k hk =>
              exists_hasCellInf_of_closedIntervalBounded_partition
                hbdd hthresholdPart k hk
          have hsup :
              forall k : Nat, k < thresholdCount ->
                Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f threshold k M) :=
            fun k hk =>
              exists_hasCellSup_of_closedIntervalBounded_partition
                hbdd hthresholdPart k hk
          have hfixedGlb :
              IsGreatestLowerBound
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
                (FixedTaggedSumValueSet f a b threshold thresholdCount)
                (lowerSum f threshold thresholdCount) :=
            lowerSum_isGreatestLowerBound_fixedTaggedSumValueSet
              hthresholdPart hinf
          have hfixedLub :
              IsLeastUpperBound
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
                (FixedTaggedSumValueSet f a b threshold thresholdCount)
                (upperSum f threshold thresholdCount) :=
            upperSum_isLeastUpperBound_fixedTaggedSumValueSet
              hthresholdPart hsup
          have hlowerBound :
              IsLowerBound
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
                (FixedTaggedSumValueSet f a b threshold thresholdCount)
                (RealTheory.sub I e4) := by
            intro v hv
            cases hv with
            | intro tag htagv =>
                rw [htagv.right]
                have hvclose :=
                  hclose thresholdCount threshold tag htagv.left
                    (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionRefines_self
                      hthresholdPart)
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hvclose)
          have hlower :
              RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub I e4)
                (lowerSum f threshold thresholdCount) :=
            hfixedGlb.right (RealTheory.sub I e4) hlowerBound
          have hupperBound :
              IsUpperBound
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
                (FixedTaggedSumValueSet f a b threshold thresholdCount)
                (RealTheory.add I e4) := by
            intro v hv
            cases hv with
            | intro tag htagv =>
                rw [htagv.right]
                have hvclose :=
                  hclose thresholdCount threshold tag htagv.left
                    (RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionRefines_self
                      hthresholdPart)
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hvclose)
          have hupper :
              RealTheory.le (upperSum f threshold thresholdCount)
                (RealTheory.add I e4) :=
            hfixedLub.right (RealTheory.add I e4) hupperBound
          have hgap_le :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (upperSum f threshold thresholdCount)
                  (lowerSum f threshold thresholdCount))
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.add I e4) (RealTheory.sub I e4)) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F hupper hlower
          have hrhs_eq :
              RealTheory.sub
                  (RealTheory.add I e4) (RealTheory.sub I e4) =
                RealTheory.add e4 e4 := by
            change F.sub (F.add I e4) (F.sub I e4) = F.add e4 e4
            rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg I e4]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
              F I e4 I (F.neg e4)]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self F I]
            rw [F.zero_add]
            rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg e4 (F.neg e4)]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F e4]
          have he4_add :
              RealTheory.add e4 e4 =
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps := by
            dsimp [e4]
            unfold RealTheory.quarter
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
              F (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps)
          refine Exists.intro thresholdCount ?_
          refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
          refine And.intro hthresholdPart ?_
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hgap_le
            (by
              rw [hrhs_eq, he4_add]
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps)

name: hasRiemannIntegral_of_hasRefinementRiemannIntegral
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_of_hasRefinementRiemannIntegral
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hI : HasRefinementRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    HasRiemannIntegral f a b I
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsmall : DarbouxGapSmall f a b :=
    darbouxGapSmall_of_hasRefinementRiemannIntegral hbdd hI
  cases riemannIntegrableOn_of_darbouxGapSmall hI.left hbdd hsmall with
  | intro J hJ =>
      have hriJ : HasRiemannIntegral f a b J :=
        hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral hJ.left hJ.right
      have hvalue : I = J := by
        apply RealFunction.eq_of_forall_dist_lt
        intro eps heps
        let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
        have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
        let base := twoPointPartition a b
        have hbase : IntervalPartition a b 1 base := by
          dsimp [base]
          exact twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hI.left
        cases hI.right e2 he2_pos 1 base hbase with
        | intro thresholdCount hthresholdCount =>
            cases hthresholdCount with
            | intro threshold hthreshold =>
                cases hriJ.right e2 he2_pos with
                | intro delta hdelta =>
                    cases
                        RealFunction.IntervalPartition.exists_threshold_refinement_mesh_lt
                          hI.left hdelta.left hthreshold.left with
                    | intro fineCount hfineCount =>
                        cases hfineCount with
                        | intro fine hfine =>
                            let tag := leftTags fine
                            have htag :
                                TaggedPartition a b fineCount fine tag :=
                              leftTags_taggedPartition hfine.left
                            have hrefSelf :
                                PartitionRefines
                                  fine fineCount fine fineCount :=
                              RealFunction.IntervalPartition.partitionRefines_self
                                hfine.left
                            have hcloseI :
                                RealTheory.lt
                                  (RealFunction.dist
                                    (taggedSum f fine tag fineCount) I)
                                  e2 := by
                              dsimp [RealFunction.dist]
                              exact hthreshold.right.right
                                fineCount fine tag htag hfine.right.left
                            have hcloseJ :
                                RealTheory.lt
                                  (RealFunction.dist
                                    (taggedSum f fine tag fineCount) J)
                                  e2 := by
                              dsimp [RealFunction.dist]
                              exact hdelta.right fineCount fine tag htag
                                (hfine.right.right
                                  fineCount fine tag htag hrefSelf)
                            have hI_close :
                                RealTheory.lt
                                  (RealFunction.dist I
                                    (taggedSum f fine tag fineCount))
                                  e2 := by
                              rw [RealFunction.dist_comm]
                              exact hcloseI
                            have htri :
                                RealTheory.le (RealFunction.dist I J)
                                  (RealTheory.add
                                    (RealFunction.dist I
                                      (taggedSum f fine tag fineCount))
                                    (RealFunction.dist
                                      (taggedSum f fine tag fineCount) J)) :=
                              RealFunction.dist_triangle I
                                (taggedSum f fine tag fineCount) J
                            have hsum :
                                RealTheory.lt
                                  (RealTheory.add
                                    (RealFunction.dist I
                                      (taggedSum f fine tag fineCount))
                                    (RealFunction.dist
                                      (taggedSum f fine tag fineCount) J))
                                  eps := by
                              have hadd :=
                                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                                  F hI_close hcloseJ
                              change F.lt
                                (F.add
                                  (RealFunction.dist I
                                    (taggedSum f fine tag fineCount))
                                  (RealFunction.dist
                                    (taggedSum f fine tag fineCount) J))
                                (F.add e2 e2) at hadd
                              rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps]
                                at hadd
                            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                              F htri hsum
      rw [hvalue]
      exact hriJ

name: VolterraRiemannObstructionDatum.not_riemannIntegrableOn
statement:
theorem VolterraRiemannObstructionDatum.not_riemannIntegrableOn
    {g : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (h : VolterraRiemannObstructionDatum g a b) :

name: leftTendstoWithin_subset_domain
statement:
private theorem leftTendstoWithin_subset_domain
    {E G : Domain} {f : Map} {x0 L : Point}
    (hsub : forall x : Point, E x -> G x)
    (hf : LeftTendstoWithin G f x0 L) :
    LeftTendstoWithin E f x0 L
proof:
:= by
  unfold LeftTendstoWithin at hf
  unfold LeftTendstoWithin
  intro eps heps
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      exact hdelta.right x
        (And.intro (hsub x hx.left) hx.right)
        hxne hxd

name: leftTendstoWithin_rightHalfOpenInterval_weaken_left
statement:
private theorem leftTendstoWithin_rightHalfOpenInterval_weaken_left
    {f : Map} {a c B L : Point}
    (hcB : RealTheory.lt c B)
    (hf : LeftTendstoWithin (RightHalfOpenInterval c B) f B L) :
    LeftTendstoWithin (RightHalfOpenInterval a B) f B L
proof:
:= by
  unfold LeftTendstoWithin at hf
  unfold LeftTendstoWithin
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let gap := RealTheory.sub B c
  have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap := by
    dsimp [gap]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hcB
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      let delta' := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F delta gap
      have hdelta' : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta' :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdelta.left hgap_pos
      refine Exists.intro delta' ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta' ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      have hxd_delta : RealTheory.lt (dist x B) delta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F delta gap)
      have hxd_gap : RealTheory.lt (dist x B) gap :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F delta gap)
      have habs : F.lt (F.abs (F.sub x B)) gap := by
        dsimp [dist] at hxd_gap
        exact hxd_gap
      have hleft_close : F.lt (F.sub B gap) x :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F habs
      have hB_gap : F.sub B gap = c := by
        dsimp [gap]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F B c
      have hcx : RealTheory.le c x := by
        rw [hB_gap] at hleft_close
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hleft_close
      exact hdelta.right x
        (And.intro (And.intro hcx hx.left.right) hx.right)
        hxne hxd_delta

name: rightTendstoWithin_leftHalfOpenInterval_weaken_right
statement:
private theorem rightTendstoWithin_leftHalfOpenInterval_weaken_right
    {f : Map} {A c b L : Point}
    (hAc : RealTheory.lt A c)
    (hf : RightTendstoWithin (LeftHalfOpenInterval A c) f A L) :
    RightTendstoWithin (LeftHalfOpenInterval A b) f A L
proof:
:= by
  unfold RightTendstoWithin at hf
  unfold RightTendstoWithin
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let gap := RealTheory.sub c A
  have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap := by
    dsimp [gap]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hAc
  cases hf eps heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      let delta' := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F delta gap
      have hdelta' : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta' :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hdelta.left hgap_pos
      refine Exists.intro delta' ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta' ?_
      intro x hx hxne hxd
      have hxd_delta : RealTheory.lt (dist x A) delta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F delta gap)
      have hxd_gap : RealTheory.lt (dist x A) gap :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hxd
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F delta gap)
      have habs : F.lt (F.abs (F.sub x A)) gap := by
        dsimp [dist] at hxd_gap
        exact hxd_gap
      have hright_close : F.lt x (F.add A gap) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F habs
      have hA_gap : F.add A gap = c := by
        dsimp [gap]
        change F.add A (F.sub c A) = c
        rw [F.add_comm A (F.sub c A)]
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F c A
      have hxc : RealTheory.le x c := by
        rw [hA_gap] at hright_close
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hright_close
      exact hdelta.right x
        (And.intro (And.intro hx.left.left hxc) hx.right)
        hxne hxd_delta

name: finiteSingularitySplitValues_before
statement:
private theorem finiteSingularitySplitValues_before
    (V : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (L R : Point)
    {i : Nat} (hi : i < k) :
    finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R i = V i
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteSingularitySplitValues
  rw [dif_pos hi]

name: finiteSingularitySplitValues_at
statement:
private theorem finiteSingularitySplitValues_at
    (V : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (L R : Point) :
    finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R k = L
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteSingularitySplitValues
  rw [dif_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl k), dif_pos rfl]

name: finiteSingularitySplitValues_right
statement:
private theorem finiteSingularitySplitValues_right
    (V : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (L R : Point) :
    finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R (k + 1) = R
proof:
:= by
  have hnot_before : Not (k + 1 < k) :=
    Nat.not_lt_of_ge (Nat.le_succ k)
  have hnot_at : Not (k + 1 = k) := by
    intro h
    have hk_lt : k < k + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self k
    rw [h] at hk_lt
    exact (Nat.lt_irrefl k) hk_lt
  unfold finiteSingularitySplitValues
  rw [dif_neg hnot_before, dif_neg hnot_at, dif_pos rfl]

name: finiteSingularitySplitValues_after
statement:
private theorem finiteSingularitySplitValues_after
    (V : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (L R : Point)
    {i : Nat}
    (hbefore : Not (i < k))
    (hat : Not (i = k))
    (hright : Not (i = k + 1)) :
    finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R i = V (i - 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteSingularitySplitValues
  rw [dif_neg hbefore, dif_neg hat, dif_neg hright]

name: finiteSingularitySplitValues_after_of_gt
statement:
private theorem finiteSingularitySplitValues_after_of_gt
    (V : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (L R : Point)
    {i : Nat} (hi : k + 1 < i) :
    finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R i = V (i - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hnot_before : Not (i < k) := by
    intro hik
    have hle : k + 1 <= k :=
      Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt hi) (Nat.le_of_lt hik)
    exact (Nat.not_succ_le_self k) hle
  have hnot_at : Not (i = k) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hi
    have hle : k + 1 <= k := Nat.le_of_lt hi
    exact (Nat.not_succ_le_self k) hle
  have hnot_right : Not (i = k + 1) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hi
    exact (Nat.lt_irrefl (k + 1)) hi
  exact
    finiteSingularitySplitValues_after V k L R
      hnot_before hnot_at hnot_right

name: finiteSingularitySplitValues_prefix_finiteSum
statement:
private theorem finiteSingularitySplitValues_prefix_finiteSum
    (V : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (L R : Point) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum (finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R) k =
      RealTheory.finiteSum V k
proof:
:= by
  exact
    RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt k
      (fun i hi =>
        finiteSingularitySplitValues_before V k L R hi)

name: finiteSingularitySplitValues_after_tail
statement:
private theorem finiteSingularitySplitValues_after_tail
    (V : Nat -> Point) (k : Nat) (L R : Point) (j : Nat) :
    finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R
      (k + ((j + 1) + 1)) =
        V (k + 1 + j)
proof:
:= by
  have hnot_before : Not (k + ((j + 1) + 1) < k) :=
    Nat.not_lt_of_ge (Nat.le_add_right k ((j + 1) + 1))
  have hnot_at : Not (k + ((j + 1) + 1) = k) := by
    intro h
    have hpos : 0 < (j + 1) + 1 := Nat.succ_pos (j + 1)
    have hlt : k < k + ((j + 1) + 1) :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_left hpos k
    rw [h] at hlt
    exact (Nat.lt_irrefl k) hlt
  have hnot_right :
      Not (k + ((j + 1) + 1) = k + 1) := by
    intro h
    have hpos : 1 < (j + 1) + 1 :=
      Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.succ_pos j)
    have hlt : k + 1 < k + ((j + 1) + 1) :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_left hpos k
    rw [h] at hlt
    exact (Nat.lt_irrefl (k + 1)) hlt
  rw [finiteSingularitySplitValues_after V k L R
    hnot_before hnot_at hnot_right]
  have hsub :
      k + ((j + 1) + 1) - 1 = k + 1 + j := by
    simp [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]
  rw [hsub]

name: finiteSingularitySplitValues_tail_finiteSum
statement:
private theorem finiteSingularitySplitValues_tail_finiteSum
    (V : Nat -> Point) (k m : Nat) (L R : Point) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun j : Nat =>
        finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R (k + j))
      ((m + 1) + 1) =
      RealTheory.add L
        (RealTheory.add R
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => V (k + 1 + j)) m))
proof:
:= by
  let tail : Nat -> Point :=
    fun j : Nat =>
      finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R (k + j)
  have htail0 : tail 0 = L := by
    dsimp [tail]
    exact finiteSingularitySplitValues_at V k L R
  have htail1 : tail 1 = R := by
    dsimp [tail]
    exact finiteSingularitySplitValues_right V k L R
  have hafter :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => tail ((j + 1) + 1)) m =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => V (k + 1 + j)) m := by
    exact
      RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt m
        (fun j _hj => by
          dsimp [tail]
          exact
            finiteSingularitySplitValues_after_tail
              V k L R j)
  change RealTheory.finiteSum tail ((m + 1) + 1) =
    RealTheory.add L
      (RealTheory.add R
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => V (k + 1 + j)) m))
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first tail (m + 1)]
  rw [htail0]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first
    (fun j : Nat => tail (j + 1)) m]
  rw [htail1]
  rw [hafter]

name: finiteSingularitySplitValues_finiteSum
statement:
private theorem finiteSingularitySplitValues_finiteSum
    (V : Nat -> Point) (k m : Nat) (L R : Point) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R)
      (k + ((m + 1) + 1)) =
      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.finiteSum V k)
        (RealTheory.add L
          (RealTheory.add R
            (RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun j : Nat => V (k + 1 + j)) m)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length
    (finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R) k ((m + 1) + 1)]
  rw [finiteSingularitySplitValues_prefix_finiteSum]
  rw [finiteSingularitySplitValues_tail_finiteSum]

name: finiteSingularitySplitValues_finiteSum_eq_of_split_value
statement:
private theorem finiteSingularitySplitValues_finiteSum_eq_of_split_value
    (V : Nat -> Point) (k m : Nat) (L R : Point)
    (hV : V k = RealTheory.add L R) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R)
      (k + ((m + 1) + 1)) =
      RealTheory.finiteSum V (k + (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSingularitySplitValues_finiteSum]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length V k (m + 1)]
  have htail :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => V (k + j)) (m + 1) =
        RealTheory.add (V k)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => V (k + 1 + j)) m) := by
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_split_first
      (fun j : Nat => V (k + j)) m]
    have hcongr :
        RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => V (k + (j + 1))) m =
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun j : Nat => V (k + 1 + j)) m := by
      exact
        RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt m
          (fun j _hj => by
            have hidx : k + (j + 1) = k + 1 + j := by
              simp [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]
            rw [hidx])
    rw [hcongr]
    rw [Nat.add_zero]
  rw [htail]
  rw [hV]
  rw [RealTheory.add_assoc L R
    (RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun j : Nat => V (k + 1 + j)) m)]

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_before
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_before
    {f : Point -> Point} {n k i : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    {d V : Point}
    (hi : i < k)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hcell :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell f n p i V) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
      f (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) i V
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell at hcell
  unfold HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
  have hnew_single : Not (n + 1 = 1) := by
    omega
  have hold_single : Not (n = 1) := by
    omega
  rw [dif_neg hold_single] at hcell
  rw [dif_neg hnew_single]
  by_cases hfirst : i = 0
  · rw [dif_pos hfirst] at hcell
    rw [dif_pos hfirst]
    refine And.intro (by omega) ?_
    have hi_le : i <= k := Nat.le_of_lt hi
    have hi_succ_le : i + 1 <= k := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi
    rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_of_le p k d hi_le]
    rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_of_le p k d hi_succ_le]
    exact hcell.right
  · rw [dif_neg hfirst] at hcell
    rw [dif_neg hfirst]
    by_cases hlast_old : i + 1 = n
    · omega
    · rw [dif_neg hlast_old] at hcell
      have hlast_new : Not (i + 1 = n + 1) := by
        omega
      rw [dif_neg hlast_new]
      refine And.intro hcell.left ?_
      refine And.intro (by omega) ?_
      have hi_le : i <= k := Nat.le_of_lt hi
      have hi_succ_le : i + 1 <= k := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi
      rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_of_le p k d hi_le]
      rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_of_le p k d hi_succ_le]
      exact hcell.right.right

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_after
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_after
    {f : Point -> Point} {n k i : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    {d V : Point}
    (hk_i : k < i)
    (hi : i < n)
    (hcell :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell f n p i V) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
      f (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) (i + 1) V
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell at hcell
  unfold HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
  have hnew_single : Not (n + 1 = 1) := by
    omega
  have hold_single : Not (n = 1) := by
    omega
  rw [dif_neg hold_single] at hcell
  rw [dif_neg hnew_single]
  have hnew_first : Not (i + 1 = 0) := by
    omega
  rw [dif_neg hnew_first]
  have hold_first : Not (i = 0) := by
    omega
  rw [dif_neg hold_first] at hcell
  by_cases hlast_old : i + 1 = n
  · rw [dif_pos hlast_old] at hcell
    have hlast_new : (i + 1) + 1 = n + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [dif_pos hlast_new]
    refine And.intro (by omega) ?_
    have hq_left :
        strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d (i + 1) = p i := by
      have hgt : k + 1 < i + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_after_of_gt p k d hgt]
      have hsub : i + 1 - 1 = i := by
        omega
      rw [hsub]
    have hq_right :
        strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d ((i + 1) + 1) =
          p (i + 1) := by
      have hgt : k + 1 < (i + 1) + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_after_of_gt p k d hgt]
      have hsub : (i + 1) + 1 - 1 = i + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [hsub]
    rw [hq_left, hq_right]
    exact hcell.right
  · rw [dif_neg hlast_old] at hcell
    have hlast_new : Not ((i + 1) + 1 = n + 1) := by
      omega
    rw [dif_neg hlast_new]
    refine And.intro (by omega) ?_
    refine And.intro (by omega) ?_
    have hq_left :
        strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d (i + 1) = p i := by
      have hgt : k + 1 < i + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_after_of_gt p k d hgt]
      have hsub : i + 1 - 1 = i := by
        omega
      rw [hsub]
    have hq_right :
        strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d ((i + 1) + 1) =
          p (i + 1) := by
      have hgt : k + 1 < (i + 1) + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_after_of_gt p k d hgt]
      have hsub : (i + 1) + 1 - 1 = i + 1 := by
        omega
      rw [hsub]
    rw [hq_left, hq_right]
    exact hcell.right.right

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_left_first
statement:

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_right_last
statement:

private theorem closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable_leftTendsto_rightEndpoint
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b)
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    LeftTendstoWithin (RightHalfOpenInterval a b)
      (closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable f a b hf)
      b I
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let hdata := hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hI
  let P := closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable f a b hf
  have hb : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab
  have hPb : P b = I := by
    have hP_b :
        HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b (P b) :=
      hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
        hf hb
    have hP_data :
        And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
          (HasDarbouxIntegral f a b (P b)) :=
      hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hP_b
    exact
      hasRiemannIntegral_unique
        (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
          hP_data.left hP_data.right)
        (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
          hdata.left hdata.right)
  cases hdata.left with
  | intro M hM =>
      intro eps heps
      let scale := RealTheory.add M RealTheory.one
      let delta := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv scale) eps
      have hM_lt_scale : RealTheory.lt M scale := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left C
          RealTheory.zero_lt_one M
        change C.lt (C.add M C.zero) (C.add M C.one) at h
        rwa [C.add_zero] at h
      have hscale_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero scale :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hM.left hM_lt_scale
      have hscale_ne : Not (scale = RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro h
        exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt C hscale_pos h.symm
      have hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta := by
        dsimp [delta]
        exact RealTheory.mul_pos
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos C hscale_pos) heps
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta_pos ?_
      intro x hx _hxne hdist
      have hx_closed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
        And.intro hx.left.left
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hx.left.right)
      have hprim_bound :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealFunction.dist (P x) I)
            (RealTheory.mul M (RealFunction.dist b x)) := by
        have hraw :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.abs
                (RealTheory.sub (P b) (P x)))
              (RealTheory.mul M
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b x))) :=
          closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable_abs_sub_le_bound_mul_abs_sub
            (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (x := x) (y := b) (M := M)
            hf hx_closed hb hM.right
        rw [hPb] at hraw
        have hdist_target :
            RealFunction.dist (P x) I =
              RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub I (P x)) := by
          rw [RealFunction.dist_comm (P x) I]
          rfl
        have hdist_source :
            RealFunction.dist b x =
              RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub b x) := rfl
        rwa [hdist_target, hdist_source]
      have hdist_bx_lt_delta :
          RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist b x) delta := by
        rwa [RealFunction.dist_comm b x]
      have hdist_bx_le_delta :
          RealTheory.le (RealFunction.dist b x) delta :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hdist_bx_lt_delta
      have hmul_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.mul M (RealFunction.dist b x))
            (RealTheory.mul M delta) :=
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
          hdist_bx_le_delta hM.left
      have hmul_lt_scale :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul M delta)
            (RealTheory.mul scale delta) :=
        RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_right hM_lt_scale hdelta_pos
      have hscale_delta :
          RealTheory.mul scale delta = eps := by
        dsimp [delta]
        change C.mul scale (C.mul (C.inv scale) eps) = eps
        rw [<- C.mul_assoc scale (C.inv scale) eps]
        rw [C.mul_inv_cancel hscale_ne]
        rw [C.one_mul]
      have hdist_lt_scale :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealFunction.dist (P x) I)
            (RealTheory.mul scale delta) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C
          (RealTheory.le_trans hprim_bound hmul_le)
          hmul_lt_scale
      rwa [hscale_delta] at hdist_lt_scale

              B (fun x : Point =>
                AddFun (fun _ : Point => K) Q x = R x) := by
          let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          let gap := RealTheory.sub B c
          have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap := by
            dsimp [gap]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hcB
          refine Exists.intro gap ?_
          refine And.intro hgap_pos ?_
          intro x hx _hxne hxd
          have habs : F.lt (F.abs (F.sub x B)) gap := by
            dsimp [dist] at hxd
            exact hxd
          have hleft_close : F.lt (F.sub B gap) x :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F habs
          have hB_gap : F.sub B gap = c := by
            dsimp [gap]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F B c
          have hcx : RealTheory.le c x := by
            rw [hB_gap] at hleft_close
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hleft_close
          dsimp [R, AddFun]
          rw [dif_pos hx.left, dif_pos hcx]
        exact
          tendstoWithin_congr_eventually
            (E := LeftDomain (RightHalfOpenInterval a B) B)
            (f := AddFun (fun _ : Point => K) Q)
            (g := R)
            (x0 := B)
            (L := RealTheory.add K J)
            hevent hbase

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_tail_of_initialSegment
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_tail_of_initialSegment
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c B I K : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcB : RealTheory.lt c B)
    (hI : HasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint f a B I)
    (hK : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a c K) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint f c B
      (RealTheory.sub I K)
proof:
:= by
  cases hI with
  | intro P hP =>
      let Q : Point -> Point := SubFun P (fun _ : Point => K)
      refine Exists.intro Q ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · intro x hx
        have hx_aB : RightHalfOpenInterval a B x :=
          And.intro (RealTheory.le_trans hac hx.left) hx.right
        have hPc :
            HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a c (P c) :=
          hP.left c (And.intro hac hcB)
        have hPc_eq :
            P c = K := by
          have hPc_data :
              And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a c)
                (HasDarbouxIntegral f a c (P c)) :=
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hac hPc
          have hK_data :
              And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a c)
                (HasDarbouxIntegral f a c K) :=
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hac hK
          exact
            hasRiemannIntegral_unique
              (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                hPc_data.left hPc_data.right)
              (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                hK_data.left hK_data.right)
        have hinc :
            HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f c x
              (RealTheory.sub (P x) (P c)) :=
          hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
            hac hx.left hPc (hP.left x hx_aB)
        unfold Q SubFun
        rwa [hPc_eq] at hinc
      · have hP_tail :
            LeftTendstoWithin (RightHalfOpenInterval c B) P B I :=
          leftTendstoWithin_subset_domain
            (E := RightHalfOpenInterval c B)
            (G := RightHalfOpenInterval a B)
            (fun x hx => And.intro
              (RealTheory.le_trans hac hx.left) hx.right)
            hP.right
        have hK_const :
            LeftTendstoWithin (RightHalfOpenInterval c B)
              (fun _ : Point => K) B K := by
          unfold LeftTendstoWithin
          exact
            tendstoWithin_const
              (LeftDomain (RightHalfOpenInterval c B) B) K B
        exact leftTendstoWithin_sub hP_tail hK_const

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_join_terminalSegment
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_join_terminalSegment
    {f : Point -> Point} {A c b J K : Point}
    (hAc : RealTheory.lt A c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hJ : HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint f A c J)
    (hK : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f c b K) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint f A b
      (RealTheory.add J K)
proof:
:= by
  cases hJ with
  | intro Q hQ =>
      classical
      let hK_data := hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hcb hK
      let hf_cb : RiemannIntegrableOn f c b :=
        riemannIntegrableOn_of_hasDarbouxIntegral
          hK_data.left hK_data.right
      let R : Point -> Point := fun x : Point =>
        if hx : LeftHalfOpenInterval A b x then
          if hxc : RealTheory.le x c then
            RealTheory.add (Q x) K
          else
            orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf
              (orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_of_le_riemannIntegrableOn
                hx.right
                (riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_right
                  (by
                    cases RealTheory.le_total c x with
                    | inl hcx => exact hcx
                    | inr hxc' => exact False.elim (hxc hxc'))
                  hx.right
                  hf_cb))
        else
          RealTheory.zero
      refine Exists.intro R ?_
      constructor
      case left =>
        intro x hx
        dsimp [R]
        rw [dif_pos hx]
        by_cases hxc : RealTheory.le x c
        case pos =>
          rw [dif_pos hxc]
          have hQx :
              HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x c (Q x) :=
            hQ.left x (And.intro hx.left hxc)
          have hQ_data :
              And (ClosedIntervalBounded f x c)
                (HasDarbouxIntegral f x c (Q x)) :=
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hxc hQx
          exact
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_adjacent_ordered
              hxc hcb
              hQ_data.left hQ_data.right
              hK_data.left hK_data.right
        case neg =>
          rw [dif_neg hxc]
          exact
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf
              (orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_of_le_riemannIntegrableOn
                hx.right
                (riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_right
                  (by
                    cases RealTheory.le_total c x with
                    | inl hcx => exact hcx
                    | inr hxc' => exact False.elim (hxc hxc'))
                  hx.right
                  hf_cb))
      case right =>
        have hQ_b :
            RightTendstoWithin (LeftHalfOpenInterval A b) Q A J :=
          rightTendstoWithin_leftHalfOpenInterval_weaken_right
            hAc hQ.right
        have hK_const :
            RightTendstoWithin (LeftHalfOpenInterval A b)
              (fun _ : Point => K) A K := by
          unfold RightTendstoWithin
          exact
            tendstoWithin_const
              (RightDomain (LeftHalfOpenInterval A b) A) K A
        have hbase :
            RightTendstoWithin (LeftHalfOpenInterval A b)
              (AddFun Q (fun _ : Point => K)) A
              (RealTheory.add J K) :=
          rightTendstoWithin_add hQ_b hK_const
        unfold RightTendstoWithin at hbase
        unfold RightTendstoWithin
        have hevent :
            EventuallyWithin (RightDomain (LeftHalfOpenInterval A b) A)
              A (fun x : Point =>
                AddFun Q (fun _ : Point => K) x = R x) := by
          let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          let gap := RealTheory.sub c A
          have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap := by
            dsimp [gap]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hAc
          refine Exists.intro gap ?_
          refine And.intro hgap_pos ?_
          intro x hx _hxne hxd
          have habs : F.lt (F.abs (F.sub x A)) gap := by
            dsimp [dist] at hxd
            exact hxd
          have hright_close : F.lt x (F.add A gap) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F habs
          have hA_gap : F.add A gap = c := by
            dsimp [gap]
            change F.add A (F.sub c A) = c
            rw [F.add_comm A (F.sub c A)]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F c A
          have hxc : RealTheory.le x c := by
            rw [hA_gap] at hright_close
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hright_close
          dsimp [R, AddFun]
          rw [dif_pos hx.left, dif_pos hxc]
        exact
          tendstoWithin_congr_eventually
            (E := RightDomain (LeftHalfOpenInterval A b) A)
            (f := AddFun Q (fun _ : Point => K))
            (g := R)
            (x0 := A)
            (L := RealTheory.add J K)
            hevent hbase

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_tail_of_terminalSegment
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_tail_of_terminalSegment
    {f : Point -> Point} {A c b I K : Point}
    (hAc : RealTheory.lt A c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hI : HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint f A b I)
    (hK : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f c b K) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint f A c
      (RealTheory.sub I K)
proof:
:= by
  cases hI with
  | intro P hP =>
      let Q : Point -> Point := SubFun P (fun _ : Point => K)
      refine Exists.intro Q ?_
      constructor
      case left =>
        intro x hx
        have hx_Ab : LeftHalfOpenInterval A b x :=
          And.intro hx.left (RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hcb)
        have hPc :
            HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f c b (P c) :=
          hP.left c (And.intro hAc hcb)
        have hPc_eq :
            P c = K := by
          have hPc_data :
              And (ClosedIntervalBounded f c b)
                (HasDarbouxIntegral f c b (P c)) :=
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hcb hPc
          have hK_data :
              And (ClosedIntervalBounded f c b)
                (HasDarbouxIntegral f c b K) :=
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hcb hK
          exact
            hasRiemannIntegral_unique
              (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                hPc_data.left hPc_data.right)
              (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                hK_data.left hK_data.right)
        have hinc :
            HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x c
              (RealTheory.sub (P x) (P c)) :=
          hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_rightIncrement_ordered_of_endpoints
            hx.right hcb (hP.left x hx_Ab) hPc
        unfold Q SubFun
        rwa [hPc_eq] at hinc
      case right =>
        have hP_tail :
            RightTendstoWithin (LeftHalfOpenInterval A c) P A I :=
          rightTendstoWithin_subset_domain
            (E := LeftHalfOpenInterval A c)
            (G := LeftHalfOpenInterval A b)
            (fun x hx => And.intro hx.left
              (RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hcb))
            hP.right
        have hK_const :
            RightTendstoWithin (LeftHalfOpenInterval A c)
              (fun _ : Point => K) A K := by
          unfold RightTendstoWithin
          exact
            tendstoWithin_const
              (RightDomain (LeftHalfOpenInterval A c) A) K A
        exact rightTendstoWithin_sub hP_tail hK_const

name: twoEndpoint_leftCut_value_add_eq
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.add (F.sub L K) (F.add K R) = F.add L R
  calc
    F.add (F.sub L K) (F.add K R) =
        F.add (F.add (F.sub L K) K) R := by
          rw [<- F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add L R := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F L K]

name: twoEndpoint_rightCut_value_add_eq
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change F.add (F.add L K) (F.sub R K) = F.add L R
  calc
    F.add (F.add L K) (F.sub R K) =
        F.add L (F.add K (F.sub R K)) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add L (F.add (F.sub R K) K) := by
          rw [F.add_comm K (F.sub R K)]
    _ = F.add L R := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F R K]

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_decomposition_at_cutpoint
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_decomposition_at_cutpoint
    {f : Point -> Point} {A B I c d L R : Point}
    (hAc : RealTheory.lt A c)
    (hcB : RealTheory.lt c B)
    (hAd : RealTheory.lt A d)
    (hdB : RealTheory.lt d B)
    (hL : HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint f A c L)
    (hR : HasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint f c B R)
    (hI : I = RealTheory.add L R) :
    Exists
      (fun Ld : Point =>
        Exists
          (fun Rd : Point =>
            And (HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint f A d Ld)
              (And (HasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint f d B Rd)
                (I = RealTheory.add Ld Rd))))
proof:
:= by
  cases RealTheory.le_total d c with
  | inl hdc =>
      cases hL with
      | intro P hP =>
          let K := P d
          have hd_left : LeftHalfOpenInterval A c d :=
            And.intro hAd hdc
          have hK : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f d c K := by
            dsimp [K]
            exact hP.left d hd_left
          have hL_full :
              HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint f A c L :=
            Exists.intro P hP
          have hLd :
              HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint f A d
                (RealTheory.sub L K) :=
            hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_tail_of_terminalSegment
              hAd hdc hL_full hK
          have hRd :
              HasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint f d B
                (RealTheory.add K R) :=
            hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_join_initialSegment
              hdc hcB hK hR
          refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.sub L K) ?_
          refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.add K R) ?_
          refine And.intro hLd ?_
          refine And.intro hRd ?_
          exact hI.trans
            (Eq.symm (twoEndpoint_leftCut_value_add_eq L K R))
  | inr hcd =>
      cases hR with
      | intro Q hQ =>
          let K := Q d
          have hd_right : RightHalfOpenInterval c B d :=
            And.intro hcd hdB
          have hK : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f c d K := by
            dsimp [K]
            exact hQ.left d hd_right
          have hR_full :
              HasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint f c B R :=
            Exists.intro Q hQ
          have hLd :
              HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint f A d
                (RealTheory.add L K) :=
            hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_join_terminalSegment
              hAc hcd hL hK
          have hRd :
              HasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint f d B
                (RealTheory.sub R K) :=
            hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_tail_of_initialSegment
              hcd hdB hR_full hK
          refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.add L K) ?_
          refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.sub R K) ?_
          refine And.intro hLd ?_
          refine And.intro hRd ?_
          exact hI.trans
            (Eq.symm (twoEndpoint_rightCut_value_add_eq L K R))

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_decomposition_at_cutpoint_of_value
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_decomposition_at_cutpoint_of_value
    {f : Point -> Point} {A B I d : Point}
    (hI : HasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint f A B I)
    (hAd : RealTheory.lt A d)
    (hdB : RealTheory.lt d B) :
    Exists
      (fun Ld : Point =>
        Exists
          (fun Rd : Point =>
            And (HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint f A d Ld)
              (And (HasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint f d B Rd)
                (I = RealTheory.add Ld Rd))))
proof:
:= by
  cases hI with
  | intro c hc =>
      cases hc.right.right with
      | intro L hLrest =>
          cases hLrest with
          | intro R hpieces =>
              exact
                hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_decomposition_at_cutpoint
                  hc.left hc.right.left hAd hdB
                  hpieces.left hpieces.right.left hpieces.right.right

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_unique
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_unique
    {f : Point -> Point} {A B I J : Point}
    (hI : HasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint f A B I)
    (hJ : HasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint f A B J) :
    I = J
proof:
:= by
  cases hJ with
  | intro d hd =>
      cases hd.right.right with
      | intro LJ hJrest =>
          cases hJrest with
          | intro RJ hJpieces =>
              cases
                  hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_decomposition_at_cutpoint_of_value
                    hI hd.left hd.right.left with
              | intro LI hIrest =>
                  cases hIrest with
                  | intro RI hIpieces =>
                      have hLeq : LI = LJ :=
                        hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_unique
                          (leftHalfOpenInterval_rightClusterPoint_endpoint
                            hd.left)
                          hIpieces.left hJpieces.left
                      have hReq : RI = RJ :=
                        hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_unique
                          (rightHalfOpenInterval_leftClusterPoint_endpoint
                            hd.right.left)
                          hIpieces.right.left hJpieces.right.left
                      calc
                        I = RealTheory.add LI RI :=
                          hIpieces.right.right
                        _ = RealTheory.add LJ RJ := by
                          rw [hLeq, hReq]
                        _ = J :=
                          Eq.symm hJpieces.right.right

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_unique
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_unique
    {f : Point -> Point} {A B : Point} {n : Nat}
    {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat} {V W : Point}
    (hp : StrictIntervalPartition A B n p)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hV : HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell f n p k V)
    (hW : HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell f n p k W) :
    V = W
proof:
:= by
  have hcell_lt : RealTheory.lt (p k) (p (k + 1)) :=
    hp.right.right.right k hk
  unfold HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell at hV hW
  by_cases hsingle : n = 1
  case pos =>
    rw [dif_pos hsingle] at hV hW
    exact hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique hV.right hW.right
  case neg =>
    rw [dif_neg hsingle] at hV hW
    by_cases hfirst : k = 0
    case pos =>
      rw [dif_pos hfirst] at hV hW
      exact
        hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_unique
          (rightHalfOpenInterval_leftClusterPoint_endpoint hcell_lt)
          hV.right hW.right
    case neg =>
      rw [dif_neg hfirst] at hV hW
      by_cases hlast : k + 1 = n
      case pos =>
        rw [dif_pos hlast] at hV hW
        exact
          hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_unique
            (leftHalfOpenInterval_rightClusterPoint_endpoint hcell_lt)
            hV.right hW.right
      case neg =>
        rw [dif_neg hlast] at hV hW
        exact
          hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_unique
            hV.right.right hW.right.right

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_proper_split
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_proper_split
    {f : Point -> Point} {a d b V L R : Point}
    (had : RealTheory.le a d)
    (hdb : RealTheory.le d b)
    (hV : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b V)
    (hL : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a d L)
    (hR : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f d b R) :
    And
      (HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
        f 2 (splitPointPartition a d b) 0 L)
      (And
        (HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
          f 2 (splitPointPartition a d b) 1 R)
        (V = RealTheory.add L R))
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
        f 2 (splitPointPartition a d b) 0 L := by
    unfold HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
    rw [dif_neg (by decide : Not (2 = 1))]
    rw [dif_pos rfl]
    change And (0 + 1 < 2)
      (HasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint f a d L)
    exact And.intro (by decide)
      (hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_of_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        had hL)
  have hright :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
        f 2 (splitPointPartition a d b) 1 R := by
    unfold HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
    rw [dif_neg (by decide : Not (2 = 1))]
    rw [dif_neg (by decide : Not (1 = 0))]
    rw [dif_pos (by decide : 1 + 1 = 2)]
    change And (0 < 1)
      (HasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint f d b R)
    exact And.intro (by decide)
      (hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_of_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        hdb hR)
  have hL_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a d)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f a d L) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le had hL
  have hR_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f d b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f d b R) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hdb hR
  have hsum :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b
        (RealTheory.add L R) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_adjacent_ordered
      had hdb hL_data.left hL_data.right hR_data.left hR_data.right
  exact And.intro hleft
    (And.intro hright
      (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique hV hsum))

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_split_exists
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_split_exists
    {f : Point -> Point} {a d b V : Point}
    (had : RealTheory.le a d)
    (hdb : RealTheory.le d b)
    (hV : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b V) :
    Exists
      (fun L : Point =>
        Exists
          (fun R : Point =>
            And (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a d L)
              (And (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f d b R)
                (V = RealTheory.add L R))))
proof:
:= by
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b := RealTheory.le_trans had hdb
  have hdata :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f a b V) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hV
  have hf : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_of_hasDarbouxIntegral
      hdata.left hdata.right
  have hleft_int : OrientedRiemannIntegrableOn f a d :=
    orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_of_le_riemannIntegrableOn
      had (riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_left had hdb hf)
  have hright_int : OrientedRiemannIntegrableOn f d b :=
    orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_of_le_riemannIntegrableOn
      hdb (riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_right had hdb hf)
  cases hleft_int with
  | intro L hL =>
      cases hright_int with
      | intro R hR =>
          have hsplit :=
            hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_proper_split
              had hdb hV hL hR
          exact Exists.intro L
            (Exists.intro R
              (And.intro hL
                (And.intro hR hsplit.right.right)))

name: rightEndpoint_split_tail_value_eq
statement:
private theorem rightEndpoint_split_tail_value_eq (L V : Point) :
    V = RealTheory.add L (RealTheory.sub V L)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change V = F.add L (F.sub V L)
  rw [F.add_comm L (F.sub V L)]
  exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F V L)

name: leftEndpoint_split_tail_value_eq
statement:
private theorem leftEndpoint_split_tail_value_eq (V R : Point) :
    V = RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub V R) R
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change V = F.add (F.sub V R) R
  exact Eq.symm (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F V R)
