name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_split_exists
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_split_exists
    {f : Point -> Point} {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    {d V : Point}
    (hk : k < n)
    (hleft : RealTheory.lt (p k) d)
    (hright : RealTheory.lt d (p (k + 1)))
    (hcell :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell f n p k V) :
    Exists
      (fun L : Point =>
        Exists
          (fun R : Point =>
            And
              (HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
                f (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) k L)
              (And
                (HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
                  f (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) (k + 1) R)
                (V = RealTheory.add L R))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell at hcell
  by_cases hsingle : n = 1
  · rw [dif_pos hsingle] at hcell
    have hk0 : k = 0 := hcell.left
    cases
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_split_exists
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hleft)
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hright)
          hcell.right with
    | intro L hLrest =>
        cases hLrest with
        | intro R hpieces =>
            have hleft_cell :
                HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
                  f (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) k L :=
              hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_left_first
                hk0 hk
                (hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_of_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hleft) hpieces.left)
            have hlast : k + 1 = n := by
              omega
            have hright_cell :
                HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
                  f (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) (k + 1) R :=
              hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_right_last
                hlast
                (hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_of_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hright)
                  hpieces.right.left)
            exact Exists.intro L
              (Exists.intro R
                (And.intro hleft_cell
                  (And.intro hright_cell hpieces.right.right)))
  · rw [dif_neg hsingle] at hcell
    by_cases hfirst : k = 0
    · rw [dif_pos hfirst] at hcell
      cases
          hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_split_initialSegment_exists
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hleft)
            hright hcell.right with
      | intro L hLrest =>
          cases hLrest with
          | intro R hpieces =>
              have hleft_cell :
                  HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
                    f (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) k L :=
                hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_left_first
                  hfirst hk
                  (hasImproperRiemannIntegralRightEndpoint_of_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hleft)
                    hpieces.left)
              have hnot_last : Not (k + 1 = n) := by
                omega
              have hright_two :
                  HasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint
                    f d (p (k + 1)) R :=
                hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_of_rightEndpoint
                  hright hpieces.right.left
              have hright_cell :
                  HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
                    f (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) (k + 1) R :=
                hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_right_interior
                  hnot_last hk hright_two
              exact Exists.intro L
                (Exists.intro R
                  (And.intro hleft_cell
                    (And.intro hright_cell hpieces.right.right)))
    · rw [dif_neg hfirst] at hcell
      by_cases hlast : k + 1 = n
      · rw [dif_pos hlast] at hcell
        cases
            hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_split_terminalSegment_exists
              hleft (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hright)
              hcell.right with
        | intro L hLrest =>
            cases hLrest with
            | intro R hpieces =>
                have hleft_two :
                    HasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint
                      f (p k) d L :=
                  hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_of_leftEndpoint
                    hleft hpieces.left
                have hleft_cell :
                    HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
                      f (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) k L :=
                  hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_left_interior
                    hcell.left hk hleft_two
                have hright_cell :
                    HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
                      f (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) (k + 1) R :=
                  hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_right_last
                    hlast
                    (hasImproperRiemannIntegralLeftEndpoint_of_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hright)
                      hpieces.right.left)
                exact Exists.intro L
                  (Exists.intro R
                    (And.intro hleft_cell
                      (And.intro hright_cell hpieces.right.right)))
      · rw [dif_neg hlast] at hcell
        cases
            hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_split_cutpoint
              hleft hright hcell.right.right with
        | intro L hLrest =>
            cases hLrest with
            | intro R hpieces =>
                have hleft_two :
                    HasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint
                      f (p k) d L :=
                  hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_of_leftEndpoint
                    hleft hpieces.left
                have hright_two :
                    HasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint
                      f d (p (k + 1)) R :=
                  hasImproperRiemannIntegralTwoEndpoint_of_rightEndpoint
                    hright hpieces.right.left
                have hleft_cell :
                    HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
                      f (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) k L :=
                  hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_left_interior
                    hcell.left hk hleft_two
                have hright_cell :
                    HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
                      f (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) (k + 1) R :=
                  hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_right_interior
                    hlast hk hright_two
                exact Exists.intro L
                  (Exists.intro R
                    (And.intro hleft_cell
                      (And.intro hright_cell hpieces.right.right)))

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularities_insert_point
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularities_insert_point
    {f : Point -> Point} {A B I d : Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hI : HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong f A B n p I)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hleft : RealTheory.lt (p k) d)
    (hright : RealTheory.lt d (p (k + 1))) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong
      f A B (n + 1) (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) I
proof:
:= by
  have hstrict_new :
      StrictIntervalPartition A B (n + 1)
        (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d) :=
    strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint_strictIntervalPartition
      hI.left hk hleft hright
  cases hI.right with
  | intro V hVdata =>
      have hcell_old :
          HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
            f n p k (V k) :=
        hVdata.left k hk
      cases
          hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_split_exists
            hk hleft hright hcell_old with
      | intro L hLrest =>
          cases hLrest with
          | intro R hsplit =>
              let W := finiteSingularitySplitValues V k L R
              refine And.intro hstrict_new ?_
              refine Exists.intro W ?_
              refine And.intro ?_ ?_
              · intro j hj
                by_cases hbefore : j < k
                · have hWj : W j = V j := by
                    dsimp [W]
                    exact finiteSingularitySplitValues_before V k L R hbefore
                  rw [hWj]
                  exact
                    hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_before
                      hbefore hk (hVdata.left j (Nat.lt_trans hbefore hk))
                · by_cases hjk : j = k
                  · subst j
                    have hWk : W k = L := by
                      dsimp [W]
                      exact finiteSingularitySplitValues_at V k L R
                    rw [hWk]
                    exact hsplit.left
                  · by_cases hjk1 : j = k + 1
                    · subst j
                      have hWk1 : W (k + 1) = R := by
                        dsimp [W]
                        exact finiteSingularitySplitValues_right V k L R
                      rw [hWk1]
                      exact hsplit.right.left
                    · have hafter : k + 1 < j := by
                        omega
                      have hj_old : j - 1 < n := by
                        omega
                      have hk_old : k < j - 1 := by
                        omega
                      have hWj : W j = V (j - 1) := by
                        dsimp [W]
                        exact
                          finiteSingularitySplitValues_after_of_gt
                            V k L R hafter
                      rw [hWj]
                      have htransport :
                          HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
                            f (n + 1)
                              (strictIntervalPartitionInsertPoint p k d)
                            ((j - 1) + 1) (V (j - 1)) :=
                        hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_insert_after
                          hk_old hj_old (hVdata.left (j - 1) hj_old)
                      have hj_eq : (j - 1) + 1 = j := by
                        omega
                      rw [hj_eq] at htransport
                      exact htransport
              · let m := n - (k + 1)
                have hn_old : n = k + (m + 1) := by
                  dsimp [m]
                  omega
                have hn_new : n + 1 = k + ((m + 1) + 1) := by
                  dsimp [m]
                  omega
                have hsum_new_old :
                    RealTheory.finiteSum W (n + 1) =
                      RealTheory.finiteSum V n := by
                  rw [hn_new, hn_old]
                  dsimp [W]
                  exact
                    finiteSingularitySplitValues_finiteSum_eq_of_split_value
                      V k m L R hsplit.right.right
                calc
                  I = RealTheory.finiteSum V n := hVdata.right
                  _ = RealTheory.finiteSum W (n + 1) :=
                    Eq.symm hsum_new_old

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularities_unique_samePartition
proof:
:= by
  cases hI.right with
  | intro V hV =>
      cases hJ.right with
      | intro W hW =>
          have hsum :
              RealTheory.finiteSum V n =
                RealTheory.finiteSum W n :=
            RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt n
              (fun k hk =>
                hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell_unique
                  hI.left hk (hV.left k hk) (hW.left k hk))
          calc
            I = RealTheory.finiteSum V n := hV.right
            _ = RealTheory.finiteSum W n := hsum
            _ = J := Eq.symm hW.right

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong_of_insertionReachable
statement:
private theorem
    hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong_of_insertionReachable
    {f : Point -> Point} {A B I : Point}
    {n m : Nat} {p q : Nat -> Point}
    (hreach : StrictIntervalPartitionInsertionReachable A B n p m q)
    (hI :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong
        f A B n p I) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong
      f A B m q I
proof:
:= by
  induction hreach with
  | refl _hp =>
      exact hI
  | step hreach hq hk hleft hright ih =>
      exact
        hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularities_insert_point
          (ih hI) hk hleft hright

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong_congr_prefix
statement:
private theorem
    hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong_congr_prefix
    {f : Point -> Point} {A B I : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p q : Nat -> Point}
    (hp : StrictIntervalPartition A B n p)
    (hq : StrictIntervalPartition A B n q)
    (hpq : forall k : Nat, k <= n -> p k = q k) :
    HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong f A B n p I <->
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong f A B n q I
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hI
    cases hI.right with
    | intro V hV =>
        refine And.intro hq ?_
        refine Exists.intro V ?_
        refine And.intro ?_ hV.right
        intro k hk
        have hpk : p k = q k := hpq k (Nat.le_of_lt hk)
        have hpk1 : p (k + 1) = q (k + 1) :=
          hpq (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)
        have hcell := hV.left k hk
        unfold HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell at hcell
        unfold HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
        simpa only [hpk, hpk1] using hcell
  · intro hI
    cases hI.right with
    | intro V hV =>
        refine And.intro hp ?_
        refine Exists.intro V ?_
        refine And.intro ?_ hV.right
        intro k hk
        have hpk : p k = q k := hpq k (Nat.le_of_lt hk)
        have hpk1 : p (k + 1) = q (k + 1) :=
          hpq (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)
        have hqk : q k = p k := Eq.symm hpk
        have hqk1 : q (k + 1) = p (k + 1) := Eq.symm hpk1
        have hcell := hV.left k hk
        unfold HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell at hcell
        unfold HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesCell
        simpa only [hqk, hqk1] using hcell

name: hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong_unique
statement:
private theorem hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong_unique
    {f : Point -> Point} {A B I J : Point}
    {n m : Nat} {p q : Nat -> Point}
    (hI :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong
        f A B n p I)
    (hJ :
      HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong
        f A B m q J) :
    I = J
proof:
:= by
  cases
      exists_commonStrictIntervalPartition_reachableByInsertions
        hI.left hJ.left with
  | intro hcommon =>
      have hIr :
          HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong
            f A B hcommon.count hcommon.left I :=
        hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong_of_insertionReachable
          hcommon.left_reachable hI
      have hJs :
          HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong
            f A B hcommon.count hcommon.right J :=
        hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong_of_insertionReachable
          hcommon.right_reachable hJ
      have hIs :
          HasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong
            f A B hcommon.count hcommon.right I :=
        (hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularitiesAlong_congr_prefix
          hcommon.left_strict hcommon.right_strict
          hcommon.eq_on_prefix).mp hIr
      exact
        hasImproperRiemannIntegralFiniteSingularities_unique_samePartition
          hIs hJs

name: hasInteriorPrincipalValueTruncation_unique
statement:
private theorem hasInteriorPrincipalValueTruncation_unique
    {f : Point -> Point} {A B C delta T S : Point}
    (hT : HasInteriorPrincipalValueTruncation f A B C delta T)
    (hS : HasInteriorPrincipalValueTruncation f A B C delta S) :



    T = S
proof:
:= by
  cases hT with
  | intro LT hTrest =>
      cases hTrest with
      | intro RT hTdata =>
          cases hS with
          | intro LS hSrest =>
              cases hSrest with
              | intro RS hSdata =>
                  have hL : LT = LS :=
                    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
                      hTdata.left hSdata.left
                  have hR : RT = RS :=
                    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique
                      hTdata.right.left hSdata.right.left
                  calc
                    T = RealTheory.add LT RT := hTdata.right.right
                    _ = RealTheory.add LS RS := by
                      rw [hL, hR]
                    _ = S := Eq.symm hSdata.right.right

name: interiorPrincipalValueDeltaDomain_rightClusterPoint_zero
statement:
private theorem interiorPrincipalValueDeltaDomain_rightClusterPoint_zero
    {A B C : Point}
    (hAC : RealTheory.lt A C) (hCB : RealTheory.lt C B) :
    RightClusterPoint
      (InteriorPrincipalValueDeltaDomain A B C) RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let leftGap := RealTheory.sub C A
  have hleftGap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero leftGap := by
    dsimp [leftGap]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hAC
  let rightGap := RealTheory.sub B C
  have hrightGap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rightGap := by
    dsimp [rightGap]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hCB
  let sideGap := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F leftGap rightGap
  have hsideGap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero sideGap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F hleftGap_pos hrightGap_pos
  let r := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F eps sideGap
  have hr_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero r :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F heps hsideGap_pos
  have hr_le_eps : RealTheory.le r eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F eps sideGap
  have hr_le_side : RealTheory.le r sideGap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F eps sideGap
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F r
  have hh_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h := by
    dsimp [h]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hr_pos
  have hh_lt_r : RealTheory.lt h r := by
    dsimp [h]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hr_pos
  have hh_lt_eps : RealTheory.lt h eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hh_lt_r hr_le_eps
  have hside_le_left : RealTheory.le sideGap leftGap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F leftGap rightGap
  have hside_le_right : RealTheory.le sideGap rightGap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F leftGap rightGap
  have hh_le_leftGap : RealTheory.le h leftGap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hh_lt_r hr_le_side)
        hside_le_left)
  have hh_le_rightGap : RealTheory.le h rightGap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hh_lt_r hr_le_side)
        hside_le_right)
  have hA_le_C_sub : RealTheory.le A (RealTheory.sub C h) := by
    have hsub :
        F.le (F.sub C leftGap) (F.sub C h) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
        F (F.le_refl C) hh_le_leftGap
    have hC_gap : F.sub C leftGap = A := by
      dsimp [leftGap]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F C A
    rwa [hC_gap] at hsub
  have hC_add_le_B : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.add C h) B := by
    have hadd : F.le (F.add C h) (F.add C rightGap) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hh_le_rightGap C
    have hC_gap : F.add C rightGap = B := by
      dsimp [rightGap]
      calc
        F.add C (F.sub B C) =
            F.add (F.sub B C) C := by rw [F.add_comm]
        _ = B := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F B C
    rwa [hC_gap] at hadd
  have hdomain : InteriorPrincipalValueDeltaDomain A B C h :=
    And.intro hh_pos (And.intro hA_le_C_sub hC_add_le_B)
  have hh_ne_zero : Not (h = RealTheory.zero) := by
    have hzero_ne_h : Not (RealTheory.zero = h) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hh_pos
    intro hhz
    exact hzero_ne_h hhz.symm
  have hdist : RealTheory.lt (dist h RealTheory.zero) eps := by
    have hleft : F.lt (F.sub RealTheory.zero eps) h := by
      have hsub_lt : F.lt (F.sub RealTheory.zero eps) RealTheory.zero :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hsub_lt hh_pos
    have hright : F.lt h (F.add RealTheory.zero eps) := by
      change F.lt h (F.add F.zero eps)
      rwa [F.zero_add]
    unfold dist
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds F hleft hright
  exact Exists.intro h
    (And.intro (And.intro hdomain hh_pos)
      (And.intro hh_ne_zero hdist))

name: hasCauchyPrincipalValueInteriorSingularity_unique
statement:
theorem hasCauchyPrincipalValueInteriorSingularity_unique
    {f : Point -> Point} {A B C I J : Point}

    (hJ : HasCauchyPrincipalValueInteriorSingularity f A B C J) :

proof:
:= by
  cases hI.right.right with
  | intro TI hTI =>
      cases hJ.right.right with
      | intro TJ hTJ =>
          have hJ_to_I :
              RightTendstoWithin
                (InteriorPrincipalValueDeltaDomain A B C)
                TI RealTheory.zero J := by
            unfold RightTendstoWithin at hTJ
            unfold RightTendstoWithin
            exact
              tendstoWithin_congr
                (fun delta hdelta _hdelta_ne =>
                  hasInteriorPrincipalValueTruncation_unique
                    (hTJ.left delta hdelta.left)
                    (hTI.left delta hdelta.left))
                hTJ.right
          exact
            rightTendstoWithin_unique
              (interiorPrincipalValueDeltaDomain_rightClusterPoint_zero
                hI.left hI.right.left)
              hTI.right hJ_to_I

name: hasCauchyPrincipalValueAtInfty_unique
statement:

    {f : Point -> Point} {I J : Point}

proof:
:= by

                  (hS.left R hR) (hT.left R hR)
            exact RealFunction.tendstoAtPosInf_congr_eventually hevent hS.right

name: ImproperInternal.rightHalfLine_unboundedAbove
statement:
theorem ImproperInternal.rightHalfLine_unboundedAbove (a : Point) :
    UnboundedAbove (RightHalfLine a)
proof:
:= by
  intro threshold
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.le_total a threshold with
  | inl ha_threshold =>
      let x := RealTheory.add threshold RealTheory.one
      have hthreshold_x : RealTheory.lt threshold x := by
        dsimp [x]
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
          F RealTheory.zero_lt_one threshold
        change F.lt (F.add threshold F.zero)
          (F.add threshold F.one) at h
        rwa [F.add_zero] at h
      have ha_x : RealTheory.le a x :=
        RealTheory.le_trans ha_threshold
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hthreshold_x)
      exact Exists.intro x (And.intro ha_x hthreshold_x)
  | inr hthreshold_a =>
      let x := RealTheory.add a RealTheory.one
      have ha_lt_x : RealTheory.lt a x := by
        dsimp [x]
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left
          F RealTheory.zero_lt_one a
        change F.lt (F.add a F.zero)
          (F.add a F.one) at h
        rwa [F.add_zero] at h
      have hthreshold_x : RealTheory.lt threshold x :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hthreshold_a ha_lt_x
      exact Exists.intro x
        (And.intro (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F ha_lt_x)
          hthreshold_x)

name: ImproperInternal.leftHalfLine_unboundedBelow
statement:

proof:
:= by

      have hx_threshold : RealTheory.lt x threshold := by
        dsimp [x]

          F RealTheory.zero_lt_one
      have hx_b : RealTheory.le x b :=
        RealTheory.le_trans
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hx_threshold)

  | inr hb_threshold =>

      have hx_b_lt : RealTheory.lt x b := by

      have hx_threshold : RealTheory.lt x threshold :=

name: ImproperInternal.rightHalfOpenInterval_leftClusterPoint_endpoint
statement:
theorem ImproperInternal.rightHalfOpenInterval_leftClusterPoint_endpoint
    {a B : Point} (haB : RealTheory.lt a B) :
    LeftClusterPoint (RightHalfOpenInterval a B) B
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let gap := RealTheory.sub B a
  have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap := by
    dsimp [gap]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F haB
  let r := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F eps gap
  have hr_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero r :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F heps hgap_pos
  have hr_le_eps : RealTheory.le r eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F eps gap
  have hr_le_gap : RealTheory.le r gap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F eps gap
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F r
  have hh_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h := by
    dsimp [h]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hr_pos
  have hh_lt_r : RealTheory.lt h r := by
    dsimp [h]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hr_pos
  have hh_lt_eps : RealTheory.lt h eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hh_lt_r hr_le_eps
  have hh_le_gap : RealTheory.le h gap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hh_lt_r hr_le_gap)
  let x := RealTheory.sub B h
  have hx_lt_B : RealTheory.lt x B := by
    dsimp [x]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hh_pos
  have ha_le_x : RealTheory.le a x := by
    have hsub :
        F.le (F.sub B gap) (F.sub B h) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
        F (F.le_refl B) hh_le_gap
    have hB_gap : F.sub B gap = a := by
      dsimp [gap]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F B a
    dsimp [x]
    rwa [hB_gap] at hsub
  have hx_ne : Not (x = B) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx_lt_B
  have hdist : RealTheory.lt (dist x B) eps := by
    have hleft : F.lt (F.sub B eps) x := by
      dsimp [x]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt F hh_lt_eps
    have hright : F.lt x (F.add B eps) := by
      have hB_lt_add : F.lt B (F.add B eps) := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps B
        change F.lt (F.add B F.zero) (F.add B eps) at h
        rwa [F.add_zero] at h
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx_lt_B hB_lt_add
    unfold dist
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds F hleft hright
  exact Exists.intro x
    (And.intro (And.intro (And.intro ha_le_x hx_lt_B) hx_lt_B)
      (And.intro hx_ne hdist))

name: ImproperInternal.leftHalfOpenInterval_rightClusterPoint_endpoint
statement:
theorem ImproperInternal.leftHalfOpenInterval_rightClusterPoint_endpoint
    {A b : Point} (hAb : RealTheory.lt A b) :
    RightClusterPoint (LeftHalfOpenInterval A b) A
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let gap := RealTheory.sub b A
  have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap := by
    dsimp [gap]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hAb
  let r := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F eps gap
  have hr_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero r :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F heps hgap_pos
  have hr_le_eps : RealTheory.le r eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left F eps gap
  have hr_le_gap : RealTheory.le r gap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right F eps gap
  let h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F r
  have hh_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero h := by
    dsimp [h]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hr_pos
  have hh_lt_r : RealTheory.lt h r := by
    dsimp [h]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hr_pos
  have hh_lt_eps : RealTheory.lt h eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hh_lt_r hr_le_eps
  have hh_le_gap : RealTheory.le h gap :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hh_lt_r hr_le_gap)
  let x := RealTheory.add A h
  have hA_lt_x : RealTheory.lt A x := by
    dsimp [x]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hh_pos
  have hx_le_b : RealTheory.le x b := by
    have hadd : F.le (F.add A h) (F.add A gap) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add_left F hh_le_gap A
    have hA_gap : F.add A gap = b := by
      dsimp [gap]
      calc
        F.add A (F.sub b A) =
            F.add (F.sub b A) A := by rw [F.add_comm]
        _ = b := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel F b A
    dsimp [x]
    rwa [hA_gap] at hadd
  have hx_ne : Not (x = A) := by
    intro hxeq
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hA_lt_x hxeq.symm
  have hdist : RealTheory.lt (dist x A) eps := by
    have hleft : F.lt (F.sub A eps) x := by
      have hsub_lt : F.lt (F.sub A eps) A :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hsub_lt hA_lt_x
    have hright : F.lt x (F.add A eps) := by
      dsimp [x]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hh_lt_eps A
    unfold dist
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds F hleft hright
  exact Exists.intro x
    (And.intro (And.intro (And.intro hA_lt_x hx_le_b) hA_lt_x)
      (And.intro hx_ne hdist))

statement:

      ImproperTailCauchyAtPosInf f a
proof:

  constructor
  · intro hconv
    cases hconv with
    | intro I hI =>
        cases hI with
        | intro P hP =>
            exact
              improperPrimitiveCauchyAtPosInf_to_improperTailCauchyAtPosInf
                hP.left
                (RealFunction.tendstoAtPosInf_to_cauchyAtPosInf
                  hP.right)
  · intro hTail
    let P : Point -> Point :=
      fun x : Point => by
        classical
        exact
          if hx : RightHalfLine a x then
            orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf
              (locallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_orientedRiemannIntegrableOn
                hf hx)
          else RealTheory.zero
    have hprim : IsImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf f P a := by
      intro x hx
      dsimp [P]

        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf

            hf hx)

      improperTailCauchyAtPosInf_to_improperPrimitiveCauchyAtPosInf
        hprim hTail
    cases RealFunction.cauchyAtPosInf_to_exists_tendstoAtPosInf
        (rightHalfLine_unboundedAbove a) hC with
    | intro I hlim =>
        exact Exists.intro I (Exists.intro P (And.intro hprim hlim))

statement:
theorem ImproperInternal.dist_zero_eq_abs (x : Point) :
    dist x RealTheory.zero = RealTheory.abs x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_tail_dist_le_of_le
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_tail_dist_le_of_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b J A : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b J)
    (habs : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (RiemannAbsFun f) a b A) :
    RealTheory.le (dist J RealTheory.zero) (dist A RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hf_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f a b J) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hf
  have habs_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded (RiemannAbsFun f) a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral (RiemannAbsFun f) a b A) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab habs
  have hJ_le_A : RealTheory.le J A :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le hab
      (fun x _hx => by
        unfold RiemannAbsFun
        exact RealTheory.le_abs_self (f x))
      hf_data.left hf_data.right habs_data.left habs_data.right
  have hneg_oriented :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.neg (f x))
        a b (RealTheory.neg J) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_neg_of_le
      hab hf_data.left hf_data.right
  have hneg_data :
      And
        (ClosedIntervalBounded
          (fun x : Point => RealTheory.neg (f x)) a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral
          (fun x : Point => RealTheory.neg (f x)) a b
          (RealTheory.neg J)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hneg_oriented
  have hnegJ_le_A : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg J) A :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le hab
      (fun x _hx => by
        unfold RiemannAbsFun
        exact RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self (f x))
      hneg_data.left hneg_data.right
      habs_data.left habs_data.right
  have hAbsJ_le_A : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs J) A :=
    RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds hJ_le_A hnegJ_le_A
  have hzero_le_A : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero A :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le hab
      (fun x _hx => by
        unfold RiemannAbsFun
        exact RealTheory.abs_nonneg (f x))
      (closedIntervalBounded_const RealTheory.zero a b)
      (hasDarbouxIntegral_zero_of_le hab)
      habs_data.left habs_data.right
  rw [dist_zero_eq_abs J, dist_zero_eq_abs A]
  rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hzero_le_A]
  exact hAbsJ_le_A

name: ImproperInternal.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_tail_dist_le
statement:
theorem ImproperInternal.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_tail_dist_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {x y J A : Point}
    (hf : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y J)
    (habs : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (RiemannAbsFun f) x y A) :
    RealTheory.le (dist J RealTheory.zero) (dist A RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_tail_dist_le_of_le
          hxy hf habs
  | inr hyx =>
      have hf_rev :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f y x (RealTheory.neg J) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reverse hf
      have habs_rev :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
            (RiemannAbsFun f) y x (RealTheory.neg A) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reverse habs
      have hrev :
          RealTheory.le
            (dist (RealTheory.neg J) RealTheory.zero)
            (dist (RealTheory.neg A) RealTheory.zero) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_tail_dist_le_of_le
          hyx hf_rev habs_rev
      rw [dist_zero_eq_abs (RealTheory.neg J),
        dist_zero_eq_abs (RealTheory.neg A)] at hrev
      change RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.neg J))
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.neg A)) at hrev
      rw [RealTheory.abs_neg J, RealTheory.abs_neg A,
        <- dist_zero_eq_abs J, <- dist_zero_eq_abs A] at hrev
      exact hrev

name: ImproperInternal.isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_value_eq
statement:
theorem ImproperInternal.isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_value_eq
    {f P Q : Point -> Point} {a x : Point}

proof:
:= by

      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a x)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f a x (P x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      hx (hP x hx)
  have hQ_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a x)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f a x (Q x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      hx (hQ x hx)
  exact
    hasRiemannIntegral_unique
      (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
        hP_data.left hP_data.right)
      (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
        hQ_data.left hQ_data.right)

        (HasDarbouxIntegral f x b (P x)) :=

    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)

    (hg : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral g a b J) :

        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => d) g))
      a b

proof:
:= by
  have hf_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hf
  have hg_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded g a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral g a b J) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hg
  have hcf :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => c) f) a b
        (RealTheory.mul c I) := by
    change
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul c (f x)) a b
        (RealTheory.mul c I)
    exact
      hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_left_of_le
        c hab hf_data.left hf_data.right
  have hdg :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => d) g) a b
        (RealTheory.mul d J) := by
    change
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul d (g x)) a b
        (RealTheory.mul d J)
    exact
      hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_left_of_le
        d hab hg_data.left hg_data.right
  have hcf_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => c) f) a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral
          (MulFun (fun _ : Point => c) f) a b
          (RealTheory.mul c I)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hcf
  have hdg_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => d) g) a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral
          (MulFun (fun _ : Point => d) g) a b
          (RealTheory.mul d J)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hdg
  exact
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_add_of_le
      hab hcf_data.left hcf_data.right hdg_data.left hdg_data.right

theorem ImproperInternal.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_rightIncrement_ordered_of_endpoints
    {f P : Point -> Point} {x c b : Point}
    (hxc : RealTheory.le x c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hPx : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x b (P x))
    (hPc : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f c b (P c)) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x c
      (RealTheory.sub (P x) (P c))
proof:
:= by
  have hXb_forward :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f x b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f x b (P x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      (RealTheory.le_trans hxc hcb) hPx
  have hCb_forward :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f c b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f c b (P c)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hcb hPc
  have hf_xb : RiemannIntegrableOn f x b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_of_hasDarbouxIntegral
      hXb_forward.left hXb_forward.right
  have hdecomp :
      Exists
        (fun I : Point =>
          Exists
            (fun J : Point =>
              And (HasDarbouxIntegral f x c I)
                (And (HasDarbouxIntegral f c b J)
                  (P x = RealTheory.add I J)))) :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_decomposition_ordered
      hxc hcb hf_xb hXb_forward.right
  cases hdecomp with
  | intro I hI =>
      cases hI with
      | intro J hJ =>
          have hJ_eq :
              J = P c :=
            hasRiemannIntegral_unique
              (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                hCb_forward.left hJ.right.left)
              (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                hCb_forward.left hCb_forward.right)
          have hPx_eq :
              P x = RealTheory.add I (P c) := by
            rw [<- hJ_eq]
            exact hJ.right.right
          have hI_eq :
              I = RealTheory.sub (P x) (P c) :=
            RealTheory.eq_sub_of_eq_add_right hPx_eq
          have hxc_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f x c :=
            riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
              (riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_left hxc hcb hf_xb)
          rw [<- hI_eq]
          exact
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_of_le_hasDarbouxIntegral
              hxc hxc_bdd hJ.left

name: ImproperInternal.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_leftPrimitive_tail_of_endpoints
statement:
theorem ImproperInternal.hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_leftPrimitive_tail_of_endpoints
    {f P : Point -> Point} {a x y : Point}
    (hax : RealTheory.le a x)
    (hay : RealTheory.le a y)
    (hPx : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a x (P x))
    (hPy : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a y (P y)) :
    HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y
      (RealTheory.sub (P y) (P x))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
          hax hxy hPx hPy
  | inr hyx =>
      have hforward :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f y x
            (RealTheory.sub (P x) (P y)) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_increment_ordered_of_endpoints
          hay hyx hPy hPx
      have hreverse :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.sub (P x) (P y))) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reverse hforward
      change HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y
        (F.sub (P y) (P x))
      change HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y
        (F.neg (F.sub (P x) (P y))) at hreverse
      rwa [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (P x) (P y)]
        at hreverse

name: hasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral_of_abs
statement:
private theorem hasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral_of_abs
    {f : Point -> Point} {x y eps : Point}
    (hxy : OrientedRiemannIntegrableOn f x y)
    (habs :
      HasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral (RiemannAbsFun f) x y eps) :
    HasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral f x y eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases habs with
  | intro A hA =>
      let J := orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf hxy
      have hJ : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y J :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf hxy
      refine Exists.intro J ?_
      constructor
      · exact hJ
      · exact
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
            (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_abs_tail_dist_le hJ hA.left)
            hA.right

name: ImproperInternal.improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_of_absolutelyImproperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf
statement:
theorem ImproperInternal.improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_of_absolutelyImproperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf
    {f : Point -> Point} {a : Point}
    (hf : LocallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf f a)
    (habs_loc : LocallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf (RiemannAbsFun f) a)
    (habs : AbsolutelyImproperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf f a) :
    ImproperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf f a
proof:
:= by
  have hAbsTail :
      ImproperTailCauchyAtPosInf (RiemannAbsFun f) a :=
    (improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_iff_improperTailCauchyAtPosInf
      habs_loc).mp habs
  have hTail : ImproperTailCauchyAtPosInf f a := by
    intro eps heps
    cases hAbsTail eps heps with
    | intro threshold hthreshold =>
        refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
        intro x y hx hy htx hty
        exact
          hasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral_of_abs
            (locallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_tail_orientedRiemannIntegrableOn
              hf hx hy)
            (hthreshold x y hx hy htx hty)
  exact
    (improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_iff_improperTailCauchyAtPosInf
      hf).mpr hTail

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_nonnegative_value_of_le
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_nonnegative_value_of_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I)

    (hnonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f x)) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero I
proof:
:= by
  have hdata :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hI
  exact
    hasDarbouxIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le hab hnonneg
      (closedIntervalBounded_const RealTheory.zero a b)
      (hasDarbouxIntegral_zero_of_le hab)
      hdata.left hdata.right

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_nonincreasing_bounds_of_le
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_nonincreasing_bounds_of_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I)
    (hdec :
      forall x y : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y ->
            RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (f y) (f x)) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b a)) I)
      (RealTheory.le I
        (RealTheory.mul (f a) (RealTheory.sub b a)))
proof:
:= by
  have hdata :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hab hI
  have ha : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab
  have hb : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    And.intro hab (RealTheory.le_refl b)
  have hlower :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (f b) (RealTheory.sub b a)) I :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le hab
      (fun x hx => hdec x b hx hb hx.right)
      (closedIntervalBounded_const (f b) a b)
      (hasDarbouxIntegral_const_of_le (c := f b) hab)
      hdata.left hdata.right
  have hupper :
      RealTheory.le I
        (RealTheory.mul (f a) (RealTheory.sub b a)) :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le hab
      (fun x hx => hdec a x ha hx hx.left)
      hdata.left hdata.right
      (closedIntervalBounded_const (f a) a b)
      (hasDarbouxIntegral_const_of_le (c := f a) hab)
  exact And.intro hlower hupper

name: nat_succ_sub_nat_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [RealTheory.nat_succ]
  change RealTheory.sub
    (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat k) RealTheory.one)
    (RealTheory.nat k) = RealTheory.one
  rw [RealTheory.add_comm]
  exact RealTheory.add_sub_cancel RealTheory.one (RealTheory.nat k)

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_nonincreasing_natUnit_bounds
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_nonincreasing_natUnit_bounds
    {f : Point -> Point} {k : Nat} {I : Point}
    (hI :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f
        (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) I)
    (hdec :
      forall x y : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) x ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval
            (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) y ->
            RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (f y) (f x)) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le (f (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))) I)
      (RealTheory.le I (f (RealTheory.nat k)))
proof:
:= by
  have hbounds :
      And
        (RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul (f (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))
            (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
              (RealTheory.nat k))) I)
        (RealTheory.le I
          (RealTheory.mul (f (RealTheory.nat k))
            (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
              (RealTheory.nat k)))) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_nonincreasing_bounds_of_le
      (RealTheory.nat_le_nat_succ k) hI hdec
  have hlen : RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
      (RealTheory.nat k) = RealTheory.one :=
    nat_succ_sub_nat_eq_one k
  constructor
  case left =>
    have h := hbounds.left
    rw [hlen, RealTheory.mul_one] at h
    exact h
  case right =>
    have h := hbounds.right
    rw [hlen, RealTheory.mul_one] at h
    exact h

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_natUnit_finiteSum
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_natUnit_finiteSum
    {f : Point -> Point} {J : Nat -> Point}
    (hunit :
      forall k : Nat,
        HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f
          (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) (J k)) :
    forall n : Nat,
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f
        (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum J n)
  | 0 => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      exact hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_degenerate f (RealTheory.nat 0)
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      have hleft :
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f
            (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n)
            (RealTheory.finiteSum J n)
proof:
:=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_natUnit_finiteSum hunit n
      have hleft_data :
          And (ClosedIntervalBounded f (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n))
            (HasDarbouxIntegral f (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n)
              (RealTheory.finiteSum J n)) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
          (RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (Nat.zero_le n)) hleft
      have hright_data :
          And
            (ClosedIntervalBounded f
              (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)))
            (HasDarbouxIntegral f
              (RealTheory.nat n) (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (J n)) :=
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
          (RealTheory.nat_le_nat_succ n) (hunit n)
      exact
        hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_adjacent_ordered
          (RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (Nat.zero_le n))
          (RealTheory.nat_le_nat_succ n)
          hleft_data.left hleft_data.right
          hright_data.left hright_data.right

name: finiteSum_natUnit_nonincreasing_bounds
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_natUnit_nonincreasing_bounds
    {f : Point -> Point} {J : Nat -> Point}
    (hunit :
      forall k : Nat,
        HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f
          (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) (J k))
    (hdec :
      forall k : Nat,
        forall x y : Point,
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval
            (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) x ->
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval
              (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) y ->
              RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (f y) (f x)) :
    forall n : Nat,
      And
        (RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))) n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum J n))
        (RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.finiteSum J n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat k)) n))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  have hpoint :
      forall k : Nat,
        And
          (RealTheory.le (f (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))) (J k))
          (RealTheory.le (J k) (f (RealTheory.nat k))) := by
    intro k
    exact
      hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_nonincreasing_natUnit_bounds
        (hunit k) (hdec k)
  exact And.intro
    (RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))) J n
      (fun k _hk => (hpoint k).left))
    (RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      J (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat k)) n
      (fun k _hk => (hpoint k).right))

name: natUnit_nonincreasing_of_rightHalfLine_nonincreasing
statement:
private theorem natUnit_nonincreasing_of_rightHalfLine_nonincreasing
    {f : Point -> Point}
    (hdec :
      forall x y : Point,
        RightHalfLine (RealTheory.nat 0) x ->
          RightHalfLine (RealTheory.nat 0) y ->
            RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (f y) (f x)) :
    forall k : Nat,
      forall x y : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval
          (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) x ->
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval
            (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) y ->
            RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (f y) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  intro k x y hx hy hxy
  have h0k : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat k) :=
    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (Nat.zero_le k)
  exact hdec x y
    (RealTheory.le_trans h0k hx.left)
    (RealTheory.le_trans h0k hy.left)
    hxy

name: isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_natUnit_finiteSum_eq
statement:
private theorem isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_natUnit_finiteSum_eq
    {f P : Point -> Point} {J : Nat -> Point}
    (hprim : IsImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf f P (RealTheory.nat 0))
    (hunit :
      forall k : Nat,
        HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f
          (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) (J k)) :
    forall n : Nat,
      P (RealTheory.nat n) = RealTheory.finiteSum J n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  have h0n : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n) :=
    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (Nat.zero_le n)
  have hP_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n))
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n)
          (P (RealTheory.nat n))) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      h0n (hprim (RealTheory.nat n) h0n)
  have hsum_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n))
        (HasDarbouxIntegral f (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum J n)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le
      h0n (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_natUnit_finiteSum hunit n)
  exact
    hasRiemannIntegral_unique
      (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
        hP_data.left hP_data.right)
      (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
        hsum_data.left hsum_data.right)

name: isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_natUnit_increment_integral
statement:
private theorem isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_natUnit_increment_integral
    {f P : Point -> Point}
    (hprim : IsImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf f P (RealTheory.nat 0)) :
    forall k : Nat,
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f
        (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
        (RealTheory.sub (P (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))
          (P (RealTheory.nat k)))
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  have h0k : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat k) :=
    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (Nat.zero_le k)
  have h0ks :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) :=
    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (Nat.zero_le (k + 1))
  exact
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_leftPrimitive_tail_of_endpoints
      h0k h0ks
      (hprim (RealTheory.nat k) h0k)
      (hprim (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) h0ks)

name: isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_monotoneOn_of_nonnegative
statement:
private theorem isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_monotoneOn_of_nonnegative
    {f P : Point -> Point} {a : Point}
    (hprim : IsImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf f P a)
    (hnonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RightHalfLine a x -> RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f x)) :
    MonotoneOn (RightHalfLine a) P
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  have htail :
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y
        (RealTheory.sub (P y) (P x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_leftPrimitive_tail_of_endpoints
      hx hy (hprim x hx) (hprim y hy)
  have htail_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub (P y) (P x)) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_nonnegative_value_of_le hxy htail
      (fun t ht =>
        hnonneg t (RealTheory.le_trans hx ht.left))
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_sub_nonneg F htail_nonneg

name: exists_tendstoAtPosInf_of_nonnegative_improperPrimitive_boundedAbove
statement:
private theorem exists_tendstoAtPosInf_of_nonnegative_improperPrimitive_boundedAbove
    {f P : Point -> Point} {a : Point}
    (hprim : IsImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf f P a)
    (hnonneg :
      forall x : Point,

          (Image (RightHalfLine a) P))) :

proof:
:=
  exists_tendstoAtPosInf_of_monotoneOn_boundedAbove
    (rightHalfLine_unboundedAbove a)
    (isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_monotoneOn_of_nonnegative hprim hnonneg)

name: tendstoAtPosInf_boundedAbove_of_monotoneOn
statement:
private theorem tendstoAtPosInf_boundedAbove_of_monotoneOn
    {E : Domain} {f : Map} {L : Point}
    (hunbounded : UnboundedAbove E)
    (hmono : MonotoneOn E f)
    (hlim : TendstoAtPosInf E f L) :
    Exists
      (IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
        (Image E f))
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro L ?_
  intro v hv
  cases hv with
  | intro x hx =>
      rw [<- hx.right]
      apply tendstoAtPosInf_le_of_eventually_le
        hunbounded (tendstoAtPosInf_const E (f x)) hlim
      refine Exists.intro x ?_
      intro t ht hxt
      exact hmono x t hx.left ht
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hxt)

name: improperPrimitiveBoundedAboveAtPosInf_of_natUnit_upperSeries_bounded
statement:
private theorem improperPrimitiveBoundedAboveAtPosInf_of_natUnit_upperSeries_bounded
    {f P : Point -> Point} {J : Nat -> Point}
    (hprim : IsImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf f P (RealTheory.nat 0))
    (hnonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RightHalfLine (RealTheory.nat 0) x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f x))
    (hunit :
      forall k : Nat,
        HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f
          (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) (J k))
    (hdec :
      forall k : Nat,
        forall x y : Point,
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval
            (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) x ->
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval
              (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) y ->
              RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (f y) (f x))
    (hbdd :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.SeqBoundedAbove
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat k)))) :
    ImproperPrimitiveBoundedAboveAtPosInf P (RealTheory.nat 0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hbdd with
  | intro B hB =>
      refine Exists.intro B ?_
      intro y hy
      cases hy with
      | intro x hx =>
          cases hx with
          | intro hx0 hxy =>
              rw [<- hxy]
              cases RealTheory.exists_nat_gt x with
              | intro n hxn_lt =>
                  have hxn : RealTheory.le x (RealTheory.nat n) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxn_lt
                  have h0n :
                      RightHalfLine (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n) :=
                    RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (Nat.zero_le n)
                  have hmono :
                      MonotoneOn (RightHalfLine (RealTheory.nat 0)) P :=
                    isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_monotoneOn_of_nonnegative
                      hprim hnonneg
                  have hPx_Pn :
                      RealTheory.le (P x) (P (RealTheory.nat n)) :=
                    hmono x (RealTheory.nat n) hx0 h0n hxn
                  have hPn_eq :
                      P (RealTheory.nat n) = RealTheory.finiteSum J n :=
                    isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_natUnit_finiteSum_eq
                      hprim hunit n
                  have hbounds :=
                    finiteSum_natUnit_nonincreasing_bounds hunit hdec n
                  have hupperB :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.finiteSum
                          (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat k)) n)
                        B := by
                    change RealTheory.le
                      (RealTheory.finiteSum
                        (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat k)) n)
                      B
                    exact hB n
                  have hPn_B :
                      RealTheory.le (P (RealTheory.nat n)) B := by
                    rw [hPn_eq]
                    exact RealTheory.le_trans hbounds.right hupperB
                  exact RealTheory.le_trans hPx_Pn hPn_B

name: nonnegative_improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_iff_improperPrimitiveBoundedAboveAtPosInf
statement:
private theorem nonnegative_improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_iff_improperPrimitiveBoundedAboveAtPosInf
    {f P : Point -> Point} {a : Point}
    (hprim : IsImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf f P a)
    (hnonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RightHalfLine a x -> RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f x)) :
    ImproperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf f a <->
      ImproperPrimitiveBoundedAboveAtPosInf P a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hconv
    cases hconv with
    | intro I hI =>
        cases hI with
        | intro Q hQ =>
            have hlimP :
                TendstoAtPosInf (RightHalfLine a) P I :=
              tendstoAtPosInf_congr
                (fun x hx =>
                  isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_value_eq
                    hQ.left hprim hx)
                hQ.right
            exact
              tendstoAtPosInf_boundedAbove_of_monotoneOn
                (rightHalfLine_unboundedAbove a)
                (isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_monotoneOn_of_nonnegative
                  hprim hnonneg)
                hlimP
  · intro hbdd
    cases
        exists_tendstoAtPosInf_of_nonnegative_improperPrimitive_boundedAbove
          hprim hnonneg hbdd with
    | intro I hlim =>
        exact Exists.intro I
          (Exists.intro P (And.intro hprim hlim))

name: positiveSeriesSummable_shifted_nat_of_integralTestAtPosInf
statement:
theorem positiveSeriesSummable_shifted_nat_of_integralTestAtPosInf
    {f P : Point -> Point}
    (hseq :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.MonotoneConvergencePrinciple
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base)
    (hprim : IsImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf f P (RealTheory.nat 0))
    (hnonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RightHalfLine (RealTheory.nat 0) x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f x))
    (hdec :
      forall x y : Point,
        RightHalfLine (RealTheory.nat 0) x ->
          RightHalfLine (RealTheory.nat 0) y ->
            RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (f y) (f x))
    (hconv : ImproperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf f (RealTheory.nat 0)) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.PositiveSeriesSummable
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let J : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.sub (P (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))
        (P (RealTheory.nat k))
  have hunit :
      forall k : Nat,
        HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f
          (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) (J k) := by
    intro k
    dsimp [J]
    exact isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_natUnit_increment_integral hprim k
  have hunit_dec :
      forall k : Nat,
        forall x y : Point,
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval
            (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) x ->
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval
              (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) y ->
              RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (f y) (f x) :=
    natUnit_nonincreasing_of_rightHalfLine_nonincreasing hdec
  have hbddP :
      ImproperPrimitiveBoundedAboveAtPosInf P (RealTheory.nat 0) :=
    (nonnegative_improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_iff_improperPrimitiveBoundedAboveAtPosInf
      hprim hnonneg).mp hconv
  have hshift_nonneg :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.NonnegativeSeq F
        (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))) := by
    intro k
    exact hnonneg (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))
      (RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (Nat.zero_le (k + 1)))
  have hbdd :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.SeqBoundedAbove F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
          (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))) := by
    cases hbddP with
    | intro B hB =>
        refine Exists.intro B ?_
        intro n
        have hbounds :=
          finiteSum_natUnit_nonincreasing_bounds hunit hunit_dec n
        have h0n : RightHalfLine (RealTheory.nat 0) (RealTheory.nat n) :=
          RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (Nat.zero_le n)
        have hPn_eq :
            P (RealTheory.nat n) = RealTheory.finiteSum J n :=
          isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_natUnit_finiteSum_eq
            hprim hunit n
        have hP_B : RealTheory.le (P (RealTheory.nat n)) B :=
          hB (P (RealTheory.nat n))
            (Exists.intro (RealTheory.nat n) (And.intro h0n rfl))
        have hJ_B : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.finiteSum J n) B := by
          rw [<- hPn_eq]
          exact hP_B
        change RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat (k + 1))) n)
          B
        exact RealTheory.le_trans hbounds.left hJ_B
  exact
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.positiveSeriesSummable_of_seriesPartialSum_boundedAbove
      F hseq hshift_nonneg hbdd

name: improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_of_positiveSeriesSummable_nat
statement:
theorem improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_of_positiveSeriesSummable_nat
    {f P : Point -> Point}
    (hprim : IsImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf f P (RealTheory.nat 0))
    (hnonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RightHalfLine (RealTheory.nat 0) x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f x))
    (hdec :
      forall x y : Point,
        RightHalfLine (RealTheory.nat 0) x ->
          RightHalfLine (RealTheory.nat 0) y ->
            RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (f y) (f x))
    (hsum :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.PositiveSeriesSummable
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat k))) :
    ImproperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf f (RealTheory.nat 0)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let J : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.sub (P (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)))
        (P (RealTheory.nat k))
  have hunit :
      forall k : Nat,
        HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f
          (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) (J k) := by
    intro k
    dsimp [J]
    exact isImproperPrimitiveAtPosInf_natUnit_increment_integral hprim k
  have hunit_dec :
      forall k : Nat,
        forall x y : Point,
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval
            (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) x ->
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval
              (RealTheory.nat k) (RealTheory.nat (k + 1)) y ->
              RealTheory.le x y -> RealTheory.le (f y) (f x) :=
    natUnit_nonincreasing_of_rightHalfLine_nonincreasing hdec
  have hsample_nonneg :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.NonnegativeSeq F
        (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat k)) := by
    intro k
    exact hnonneg (RealTheory.nat k)
      (RealTheory.nat_le_nat_of_le (Nat.zero_le k))
  have hbdd :
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.SeqBoundedAbove F
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
          (fun k : Nat => f (RealTheory.nat k))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum_boundedAbove_of_positiveSeriesSummable
      F hsample_nonneg hsum
  have hbddP :
      ImproperPrimitiveBoundedAboveAtPosInf P (RealTheory.nat 0) :=
    improperPrimitiveBoundedAboveAtPosInf_of_natUnit_upperSeries_bounded
      hprim hnonneg hunit hunit_dec hbdd
  exact
    (nonnegative_improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_iff_improperPrimitiveBoundedAboveAtPosInf
      hprim hnonneg).mpr hbddP

name: ImproperInternal.locallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_tail_riemannIntegrableOn_of_le
statement:
theorem ImproperInternal.locallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_tail_riemannIntegrableOn_of_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {a x y : Point}

    (hx : RightHalfLine a x)
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y) :
    RiemannIntegrableOn f x y
proof:
:= by
  have hy : RightHalfLine a y := RealTheory.le_trans hx hxy

name: hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_dist_le_of_nonnegative_le_of_le
statement:
private theorem hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_dist_le_of_nonnegative_le_of_le
    {f g : Point -> Point} {x y I J : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y I)
    (hJ : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral g x y J)
    (hf_nonneg :
      forall z : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f z))
    (hfg :
      forall z : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
        RealTheory.le (f z) (g z)) :
    RealTheory.le (dist I RealTheory.zero) (dist J RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  have hI_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f x y) (HasDarbouxIntegral f x y I) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hxy hI
  have hJ_data :
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded g x y) (HasDarbouxIntegral g x y J) :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hxy hJ
  have hI_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero I :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le hxy hf_nonneg
      (closedIntervalBounded_const RealTheory.zero x y)
      (hasDarbouxIntegral_zero_of_le hxy)
      hI_data.left hI_data.right
  have hIJ : RealTheory.le I J :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le hxy hfg
      hI_data.left hI_data.right hJ_data.left hJ_data.right
  have hJ_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero J :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hI_nonneg hIJ
  rw [dist_zero_eq_abs I, dist_zero_eq_abs J,
    RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hI_nonneg,
    RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg hJ_nonneg]
  exact hIJ

name: hasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral_of_nonnegative_le
statement:
private theorem hasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral_of_nonnegative_le
    {S : ImproperBoundaryTailModel}
    {f g : Point -> Point} {x y eps : Point}
    (hf : BoundaryLocallyRiemannIntegrable S f)
    (hf_nonneg :
      forall z : Point, S.domain z ->
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f z))
    (hfg :
      forall z : Point, S.domain z ->
        RealTheory.le (f z) (g z))
    (hx : S.domain x) (hy : S.domain y)
    (hg : HasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral g x y eps) :
    HasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral f x y eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hg with
  | intro J hJ =>
      cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
      | inl hxy =>
          have hforiented : OrientedRiemannIntegrableOn f x y :=
            orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_of_le_riemannIntegrableOn hxy
              (hf x y hxy hx hy)
          let I := orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf hforiented
          have hI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y I :=
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf hforiented
          have hdist :
              RealTheory.le (dist I RealTheory.zero)
                (dist J RealTheory.zero) :=
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_dist_le_of_nonnegative_le_of_le
              hxy hI hJ.left
              (fun z hz =>
                hf_nonneg z
                  (S.closedInterval_subset_domain hxy hx hy z hz))
              (fun z hz =>
                hfg z (S.closedInterval_subset_domain hxy hx hy z hz))
          refine Exists.intro I (And.intro hI ?_)
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hdist hJ.right
      | inr hyx =>
          have hforiented : OrientedRiemannIntegrableOn f y x :=
            orientedRiemannIntegrableOn_of_le_riemannIntegrableOn hyx
              (hf y x hyx hy hx)
          let I := orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf hforiented
          have hI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f y x I :=
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_orientedRiemannIntegralValueOf hforiented
          have hJrev :
              HasOrientedRiemannIntegral g y x (RealTheory.neg J) :=
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reverse hJ.left
          have hdist :
              RealTheory.le (dist I RealTheory.zero)
                (dist (RealTheory.neg J) RealTheory.zero) :=
            hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_dist_le_of_nonnegative_le_of_le
              hyx hI hJrev
              (fun z hz =>
                hf_nonneg z
                  (S.closedInterval_subset_domain hyx hy hx z hz))
              (fun z hz =>
                hfg z (S.closedInterval_subset_domain hyx hy hx z hz))
          have hdist' :
              RealTheory.le (dist (RealTheory.neg I) RealTheory.zero)
                (dist J RealTheory.zero) := by
            rw [dist_zero_eq_abs I, dist_zero_eq_abs (RealTheory.neg J)] at hdist
            rw [dist_zero_eq_abs (RealTheory.neg I), dist_zero_eq_abs J]
            change F.le (RealTheory.abs (F.neg I)) (RealTheory.abs J)
            change F.le (RealTheory.abs I) (RealTheory.abs (F.neg J)) at hdist
            rw [RealTheory.abs_neg J] at hdist
            rw [RealTheory.abs_neg I]
            exact hdist
          refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.neg I) ?_
          constructor
          · exact hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reverse hI
          · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hdist' hJ.right

name: ImproperInternal.boundaryTailCauchy_of_nonnegative_le
statement:
theorem ImproperInternal.boundaryTailCauchy_of_nonnegative_le
    {S : ImproperBoundaryTailModel}
    {f g : Point -> Point}
    (hf : BoundaryLocallyRiemannIntegrable S f)
    (hf_nonneg :
      forall z : Point, S.domain z ->
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f z))
    (hfg :
      forall z : Point, S.domain z ->
        RealTheory.le (f z) (g z))
    (hg : BoundaryTailCauchy S g) :
    BoundaryTailCauchy S f
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hg eps heps with
  | intro threshold hthreshold =>
      refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
      refine And.intro hthreshold.left ?_
      intro x y hx hy htx hty
      exact
        hasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral_of_nonnegative_le
          hf hf_nonneg hfg hx hy
          (hthreshold.right x y hx hy htx hty)

name: improperTailCauchyAtPosInf_of_eventually_nonnegative_le
statement:
private theorem improperTailCauchyAtPosInf_of_eventually_nonnegative_le
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a : Point}
    (hf : LocallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf f a)
    (horder :
      EventuallyAtPosInf (RightHalfLine a)
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f x))
            (RealTheory.le (f x) (g x))))
    (hg : ImproperTailCauchyAtPosInf g a) :
    ImproperTailCauchyAtPosInf f a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases horder with
  | intro orderThreshold horderThreshold =>
      let S := improperBoundaryTailModelAtEventuallyPosInf a orderThreshold
      have hf_boundary : BoundaryLocallyRiemannIntegrable S f := by
        intro x y hxy hx hy
        exact riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_right hx.left hxy (hf y hy.left)
      intro eps heps
      cases hg eps heps with
      | intro tailThreshold htailThreshold =>
          refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.max orderThreshold tailThreshold) ?_
          intro x y hx hy htx hty
          have horder_x : RealTheory.lt orderThreshold x :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
              (RealTheory.le_max_left orderThreshold tailThreshold) htx
          have horder_y : RealTheory.lt orderThreshold y :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
              (RealTheory.le_max_left orderThreshold tailThreshold) hty
          have htail_x : RealTheory.lt tailThreshold x :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
              (RealTheory.le_max_right orderThreshold tailThreshold) htx
          have htail_y : RealTheory.lt tailThreshold y :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
              (RealTheory.le_max_right orderThreshold tailThreshold) hty
          exact
            hasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral_of_nonnegative_le
              (S := S) hf_boundary
              (fun z hz => (horderThreshold z hz.left hz.right).left)
              (fun z hz => (horderThreshold z hz.left hz.right).right)
              (And.intro hx horder_x) (And.intro hy horder_y)
              (htailThreshold x y hx hy htail_x htail_y)

name: improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_of_eventually_nonnegative_le
statement:
theorem improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_of_eventually_nonnegative_le
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a : Point}
    (hf : LocallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf f a)
    (hg : LocallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf g a)
    (horder :
      EventuallyAtPosInf (RightHalfLine a)
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f x))
            (RealTheory.le (f x) (g x))))
    (hg_conv : ImproperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf g a) :
    ImproperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf f a
proof:
:= by
  have hg_tail : ImproperTailCauchyAtPosInf g a :=
    (improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_iff_improperTailCauchyAtPosInf hg).mp
      hg_conv
  have hf_tail : ImproperTailCauchyAtPosInf f a :=
    improperTailCauchyAtPosInf_of_eventually_nonnegative_le
      hf horder hg_tail
  exact
    (improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_iff_improperTailCauchyAtPosInf hf).mpr
      hf_tail

name: ImproperInternal.boundaryLocallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf
statement:
