name: hasSmallOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_monotoneEither_of_prefix_suffix_bounds
statement:
private theorem hasSmallOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_monotoneEither_of_prefix_suffix_bounds
    {f g : Point -> Point} {x y C G : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.le x y)
    (hf : RiemannIntegrableOn f x y)
    (_hfg : RiemannIntegrableOn (MulFun f g) x y)
    (hg_mono :
      FunctionMonotoneEitherOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y) g)
    (hC_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C)
    (_hG_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero G)
    (hprefix :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
          forall A : Point,
            HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x z A ->
              RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs A) C)
    (hsuffix :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y z ->
          forall B : Point,
            HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f z y B ->
              RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs B) C)
    (hgx_abs : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (g x)) G)
    (hgy_abs : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (g y)) G) :
    Exists
      (fun I : Point =>
        And (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (MulFun f g) x y I)
          (RealTheory.le (dist I RealTheory.zero)
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul G C)
              (RealTheory.mul G C))))
proof:
:= by
  have finish :
      forall xi A B : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval x y xi ->
          HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x xi A ->
            HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f xi y B ->
              HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (MulFun f g) x y
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.mul (g x) A)
                  (RealTheory.mul (g y) B)) ->
                Exists
                  (fun I : Point =>
                    And (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral (MulFun f g) x y I)
                      (RealTheory.le (dist I RealTheory.zero)
                        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul G C)
                          (RealTheory.mul G C)))) := by
    intro xi A B hxi hA hB hI
    have hA_abs : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs A) C :=
      hprefix xi hxi A hA
    have hB_abs : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs B) C :=
      hsuffix xi hxi B hB
    let I := RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.mul (g x) A) (RealTheory.mul (g y) B)
    have hbase :
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs I)
          (RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (g x)) (RealTheory.abs A))
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (g y)) (RealTheory.abs B))) := by
      dsimp [I]
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have htri := RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
        (RealTheory.mul (g x) A) (RealTheory.mul (g y) B)
      change
        F.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (F.add (F.mul (g x) A) (F.mul (g y) B)))
          (F.add
            (RealTheory.abs (F.mul (g x) A))
            (RealTheory.abs (F.mul (g y) B))) at htri
      change
        F.le
          (RealTheory.abs
            (F.add (F.mul (g x) A) (F.mul (g y) B)))
          (F.add
            (F.mul (RealTheory.abs (g x)) (RealTheory.abs A))
            (F.mul (RealTheory.abs (g y)) (RealTheory.abs B)))
      rwa [RealTheory.abs_mul (g x) A,
        RealTheory.abs_mul (g y) B] at htri
    have hleft :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (g x)) (RealTheory.abs A))
          (RealTheory.mul G C) :=
      RealTheory.le_trans
        (RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
          hA_abs (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (g x)))
        (RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hgx_abs hC_nonneg)
    have hright :
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.abs (g y)) (RealTheory.abs B))
          (RealTheory.mul G C) :=
      RealTheory.le_trans
        (RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
          hB_abs (RealTheory.abs_nonneg (g y)))
        (RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hgy_abs hC_nonneg)
    have hbound :
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs I)
          (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul G C)
            (RealTheory.mul G C)) :=
      RealTheory.le_trans hbase
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hleft hright)
    refine Exists.intro I ?_
    refine And.intro hI ?_
    rwa [dist_zero_eq_abs I]
  cases hg_mono with
  | inl hinc =>
      cases exists_point_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_increasing_bonnet
          hxy hf hinc with
      | intro xi hxi =>
          cases hxi with
          | intro A hA =>
              cases hA with
              | intro B hdata =>
                  exact finish xi A B hdata.left hdata.right.left
                    hdata.right.right.left hdata.right.right.right
  | inr hdec =>
      cases exists_point_hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_decreasing_bonnet
          hxy hf hdec with
      | intro xi hxi =>
          cases hxi with
          | intro A hA =>
              cases hA with
              | intro B hdata =>
                  exact finish xi A B hdata.left hdata.right.left
                    hdata.right.right.left hdata.right.right.right

name: boundaryTailCauchy_mul_monotoneEither_of_integrable_bounded
statement:
private theorem boundaryTailCauchy_mul_monotoneEither_of_integrable_bounded
    {S : ImproperBoundaryTailModel}
    {f g : Point -> Point} {G : Point}
    (hf : BoundaryLocallyRiemannIntegrable S f)
    (hfg : BoundaryLocallyRiemannIntegrable S (MulFun f g))
    (hf_tail : BoundaryTailCauchy S f)
    (hg_mono : FunctionMonotoneEitherOn S.domain g)
    (hG_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero G)
    (hg_abs_bound :
      forall x : Point, S.domain x ->
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (g x)) G) :
    BoundaryTailCauchy S (MulFun f g)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro eps heps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg hG_nonneg he2 with
  | intro C hC =>
      have hC_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hC.left
      have hGC : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul G C) e2 := hC.right
      have hbudget :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul G C)
              (RealTheory.mul G C)) eps := by
        have hsum := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hGC hGC
        change
          F.lt (F.add (F.mul G C) (F.mul G C))
            (F.add e2 e2) at hsum
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hsum
      cases hf_tail C hC.left with
      | intro threshold hthreshold =>
          refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
          refine And.intro hthreshold.left ?_
          intro x y hx hy htx hty
          have forward :
              forall {u v : Point},
                S.domain u -> S.domain v ->
                  S.beyond threshold u -> S.beyond threshold v ->
                    RealTheory.le u v ->
                      HasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral
                        (MulFun f g) u v eps := by
            intro u v hu hv htu htv huv
            have hg_uv :
                FunctionMonotoneEitherOn
                  (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v) g := by
              cases hg_mono with
              | inl hinc =>
                  exact Or.inl (fun p q hp hq hpq =>
                    hinc p q
                      (S.closedInterval_subset_domain huv hu hv p hp)
                      (S.closedInterval_subset_domain huv hu hv q hq)
                      hpq)
              | inr hdec =>
                  exact Or.inr (fun p q hp hq hpq =>
                    hdec p q
                      (S.closedInterval_subset_domain huv hu hv p hp)
                      (S.closedInterval_subset_domain huv hu hv q hq)
                      hpq)
            have hprefix :
                forall z : Point,
                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v z ->
                    forall A : Point,
                      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f u z A ->
                        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs A) C := by
              intro z hz A hA
              have hz_domain :=
                S.closedInterval_subset_domain huv hu hv z hz
              have hz_beyond :=
                S.closedInterval_subset_beyond hthreshold.left
                  huv hu hv htu htv z hz
              cases hthreshold.right u z hu hz_domain htu hz_beyond with
              | intro J hJ =>
                  have hJA : J = A :=
                    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique hJ.left hA
                  have hsmall := hJ.right
                  rw [dist_zero_eq_abs J, hJA] at hsmall
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsmall
            have hsuffix :
                forall z : Point,
                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v z ->
                    forall B : Point,
                      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f z v B ->
                        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs B) C := by
              intro z hz B hB
              have hz_domain :=
                S.closedInterval_subset_domain huv hu hv z hz
              have hz_beyond :=
                S.closedInterval_subset_beyond hthreshold.left
                  huv hu hv htu htv z hz
              cases hthreshold.right z v hz_domain hv hz_beyond htv with
              | intro J hJ =>
                  have hJB : J = B :=
                    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique hJ.left hB
                  have hsmall := hJ.right
                  rw [dist_zero_eq_abs J, hJB] at hsmall
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsmall
            cases
                hasSmallOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_monotoneEither_of_prefix_suffix_bounds
                  huv (hf u v huv hu hv) (hfg u v huv hu hv)
                  hg_uv hC_nonneg hG_nonneg hprefix hsuffix
                  (hg_abs_bound u hu) (hg_abs_bound v hv) with
            | intro I hI =>
                exact Exists.intro I
                  (And.intro hI.left
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                      F hI.right hbudget))
          cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
          | inl hxy => exact forward hx hy htx hty hxy
          | inr hyx =>
              cases forward hy hx hty htx hyx with
              | intro I hI =>
                  refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.neg I) ?_
                  refine And.intro
                    (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reverse hI.left) ?_
                  have hdist_neg :
                      dist (RealTheory.neg I) RealTheory.zero =
                        dist I RealTheory.zero := by
                    rw [dist_zero_eq_abs (RealTheory.neg I),
                      dist_zero_eq_abs I]
                    change RealTheory.abs (F.neg I) = RealTheory.abs I
                    exact RealTheory.abs_neg I
                  rw [hdist_neg]
                  exact hI.right

name: boundaryTailCauchy_mul_monotoneEither_of_boundedOrientedTails_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem boundaryTailCauchy_mul_monotoneEither_of_boundedOrientedTails_tendsto_zero
    {S : ImproperBoundaryTailModel}
    {f g : Point -> Point} {C : Point}
    (hf : BoundaryLocallyRiemannIntegrable S f)
    (hfg : BoundaryLocallyRiemannIntegrable S (MulFun f g))
    (hg_mono : FunctionMonotoneEitherOn S.domain g)
    (hg_zero : BoundaryTendstoZero S g)
    (hC_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C)
    (hf_bound :
      forall x y : Point,
        S.domain x -> S.domain y -> RealTheory.le x y ->
          Exists
            (fun J : Point =>
              And (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y J)
                (RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs J) C))) :
    BoundaryTailCauchy S (MulFun f g)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro eps heps
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg hC_nonneg he2 with
  | intro G hG =>
      have hG_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero G :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hG.left
      have hGC : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul G C) e2 := by
        change F.lt (F.mul G C) e2
        rw [F.mul_comm G C]
        exact hG.right
      have hbudget :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul G C)
              (RealTheory.mul G C)) eps := by
        have hsum := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F hGC hGC
        change
          F.lt (F.add (F.mul G C) (F.mul G C))
            (F.add e2 e2) at hsum
        rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hsum
      cases hg_zero G hG.left with
      | intro threshold hthreshold =>
          refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
          refine And.intro hthreshold.left ?_
          intro x y hx hy htx hty
          have forward :
              forall {u v : Point},
                S.domain u -> S.domain v ->
                  S.beyond threshold u -> S.beyond threshold v ->
                    RealTheory.le u v ->
                      HasSmallOrientedRiemannTailIntegral
                        (MulFun f g) u v eps := by
            intro u v hu hv htu htv huv
            have hg_uv :
                FunctionMonotoneEitherOn
                  (RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v) g := by
              cases hg_mono with
              | inl hinc =>
                  exact Or.inl (fun p q hp hq hpq =>
                    hinc p q
                      (S.closedInterval_subset_domain huv hu hv p hp)
                      (S.closedInterval_subset_domain huv hu hv q hq)
                      hpq)
              | inr hdec =>
                  exact Or.inr (fun p q hp hq hpq =>
                    hdec p q
                      (S.closedInterval_subset_domain huv hu hv p hp)
                      (S.closedInterval_subset_domain huv hu hv q hq)
                      hpq)
            have hgu_abs : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (g u)) G := by
              have hsmall := hthreshold.right u hu htu
              rw [dist_zero_eq_abs (g u)] at hsmall
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsmall
            have hgv_abs : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (g v)) G := by
              have hsmall := hthreshold.right v hv htv
              rw [dist_zero_eq_abs (g v)] at hsmall
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsmall
            have hprefix :
                forall z : Point,
                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v z ->
                    forall A : Point,
                      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f u z A ->
                        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs A) C := by
              intro z hz A hA
              have hz_domain :=
                S.closedInterval_subset_domain huv hu hv z hz
              cases hf_bound u z hu hz_domain hz.left with
              | intro J hJ =>
                  have hJA : J = A :=
                    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique hJ.left hA
                  have hJ_bound := hJ.right
                  rwa [hJA] at hJ_bound
            have hsuffix :
                forall z : Point,
                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v z ->
                    forall B : Point,
                      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f z v B ->
                        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs B) C := by
              intro z hz B hB
              have hz_domain :=
                S.closedInterval_subset_domain huv hu hv z hz
              cases hf_bound z v hz_domain hv hz.right with
              | intro J hJ =>
                  have hJB : J = B :=
                    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_value_unique hJ.left hB
                  have hJ_bound := hJ.right
                  rwa [hJB] at hJ_bound
            cases
                hasSmallOrientedRiemannIntegral_mul_monotoneEither_of_prefix_suffix_bounds
                  huv (hf u v huv hu hv) (hfg u v huv hu hv)
                  hg_uv hC_nonneg hG_nonneg hprefix hsuffix
                  hgu_abs hgv_abs with
            | intro I hI =>
                exact Exists.intro I
                  (And.intro hI.left
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                      F hI.right hbudget))
          cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
          | inl hxy => exact forward hx hy htx hty hxy
          | inr hyx =>
              cases forward hy hx hty htx hyx with
              | intro I hI =>
                  refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.neg I) ?_
                  refine And.intro
                    (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_reverse hI.left) ?_
                  have hdist_neg :
                      dist (RealTheory.neg I) RealTheory.zero =
                        dist I RealTheory.zero := by
                    rw [dist_zero_eq_abs (RealTheory.neg I),
                      dist_zero_eq_abs I]
                    change RealTheory.abs (F.neg I) = RealTheory.abs I
                    exact RealTheory.abs_neg I
                  rw [hdist_neg]
                  exact hI.right

name: boundaryOrientedTailsBounded_of_leftPrimitive
statement:
private theorem boundaryOrientedTailsBounded_of_leftPrimitive
    {D : Domain} {f P : Point -> Point} {base B : Point}
    (hbase : forall x : Point, D x -> RealTheory.le base x)
    (hP : forall x : Point, D x ->
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f base x (P x))
    (hP_abs_bound : forall x : Point, D x ->
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (P x)) B) :
    forall x y : Point,
      D x -> D y -> RealTheory.le x y ->
        Exists
          (fun J : Point =>
            And (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y J)
              (RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs J)
                (RealTheory.add B B)))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let J := RealTheory.sub (P y) (P x)
  have hJ : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y J :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_leftPrimitive_tail_of_endpoints
      (hbase x hx) (hbase y hy) (hP x hx) (hP y hy)
  refine Exists.intro J (And.intro hJ ?_)
  have htri :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs J)
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs (P y))
          (RealTheory.abs (P x))) := by
    dsimp [J]
    exact abs_sub_le_abs_add_abs (P y) (P x)
  exact RealTheory.le_trans htri
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (hP_abs_bound y hy) (hP_abs_bound x hx))

name: boundaryOrientedTailsBounded_of_rightPrimitive
statement:
private theorem boundaryOrientedTailsBounded_of_rightPrimitive
    {D : Domain} {f P : Point -> Point} {terminal B : Point}
    (hterminal : forall x : Point, D x -> RealTheory.le x terminal)
    (hP : forall x : Point, D x ->
      HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x terminal (P x))
    (hP_abs_bound : forall x : Point, D x ->
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (P x)) B) :
    forall x y : Point,
      D x -> D y -> RealTheory.le x y ->
        Exists
          (fun J : Point =>
            And (HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y J)
              (RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs J)
                (RealTheory.add B B)))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let J := RealTheory.sub (P x) (P y)
  have hJ : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f x y J :=
    hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_rightPrimitive_tail_of_endpoints
      (hterminal x hx) (hterminal y hy) (hP x hx) (hP y hy)
  refine Exists.intro J (And.intro hJ ?_)
  have htri :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs J)
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs (P x))
          (RealTheory.abs (P y))) := by
    dsimp [J]
    exact abs_sub_le_abs_add_abs (P x) (P y)
  exact RealTheory.le_trans htri
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (hP_abs_bound x hx) (hP_abs_bound y hy))

name: add_self_nonneg_of_abs_le
statement:
private theorem add_self_nonneg_of_abs_le
    {x B : Point} (hB : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs x) B) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.add B B)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hB_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero B :=
    RealTheory.le_trans (RealTheory.abs_nonneg x) hB
  have hsum := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hB_nonneg hB_nonneg
  change F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero) (F.add B B) at hsum
  rwa [F.zero_add] at hsum

    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasOrientedRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    RiemannIntegrableOn f a b
proof:
:= by
  cases hI with
  | inl h =>
      exact Exists.intro I (And.intro h.right.left h.right.right)
  | inr h =>
      cases h with
      | intro J hJ =>
          have habEq : a = b :=

          subst b
          exact
            Exists.intro J
              (And.intro hJ.right.left hJ.right.right.left)

name: tendstoAtNegInf_le_of_eventually_le
statement:
private theorem tendstoAtNegInf_le_of_eventually_le
    {E : Domain} {f g : Map} {A B : Point}
    (hunbounded : UnboundedBelow E)
    (hf : TendstoAtNegInf E f A)
    (hg : TendstoAtNegInf E g B)
    (hfg :
      EventuallyAtNegInf E
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.le (f x) (g x))) :
    RealTheory.le A B
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hAB : F.le A B
  · exact hAB
  · have hBAle : F.le B A := by
      cases F.le_total B A with
      | inl hBA => exact hBA
      | inr hAB' => exact False.elim (hAB hAB')
    have hBA : F.lt B A :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hBAle hAB
    have hgap : F.lt F.zero (F.sub A B) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hBA
    let eps := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F (F.sub A B)
    have heps : F.lt F.zero eps :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hgap
    cases hf eps heps with
    | intro thresholdF hthresholdF =>
        cases hg eps heps with
        | intro thresholdG hthresholdG =>
            cases hfg with
            | intro thresholdO hthresholdO =>
                let thresholdFG :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F thresholdF thresholdG
                let threshold :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2 F thresholdFG thresholdO
                cases hunbounded threshold with
                | intro x hx =>
                    have hxE : E x := hx.left
                    have hsmall : F.lt x threshold := hx.right
                    have hsmallFG : F.lt x thresholdFG :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsmall
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                          F thresholdFG thresholdO)
                    have hsmallO : F.lt x thresholdO :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsmall
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                          F thresholdFG thresholdO)
                    have hsmallF : F.lt x thresholdF :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsmallFG
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_left
                          F thresholdF thresholdG)
                    have hsmallG : F.lt x thresholdG :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hsmallFG
                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_le_right
                          F thresholdF thresholdG)
                    have hfclose := hthresholdF x hxE hsmallF
                    have hgclose := hthresholdG x hxE hsmallG
                    have hfgx := hthresholdO x hxE hsmallO
                    have hlow : F.lt (F.sub A eps) (f x) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left F hfclose
                    have hmid : F.lt (F.sub A eps) (g x) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hlow hfgx
                    have hhigh : F.lt (g x) (F.add B eps) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right F hgclose
                    have hbad : F.lt (F.sub A eps) (F.add B eps) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hmid hhigh
                    have hcollapse :
                        F.add B eps = F.sub A eps := by
                      unfold eps
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_half_sub_eq_sub_half
                        F A B
                    rw [hcollapse] at hbad
                    exact False.elim
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
                        F (F.sub A eps) hbad)

name: improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_iff_of_eventually_same_order_nonnegative
statement:
theorem improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_iff_of_eventually_same_order_nonnegative
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a c1 c2 : Point}
    (hf : LocallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf f a)
    (hg : LocallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf g a)
    (hc1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c1)
    (_hc2 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c2)
    (horder :
      EventuallyAtPosInf (RightHalfLine a)
        (fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f x))
            (And (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (g x))
              (And
                (RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul c1 (f x)) (g x))
                (RealTheory.le (g x) (RealTheory.mul c2 (f x))))))) :
    ImproperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf f a <->
      ImproperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf g a
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hscaled_f_local :
      LocallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => c2) f) a := by
    intro x hx
    exact riemannIntegrableOn_mul_left_of_le c2 hx (hf x hx)
  have hscaled_g_local :
      LocallyRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf
        (MulFun (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.inv c1) g) a := by
    intro x hx
    exact riemannIntegrableOn_mul_left_of_le (RealTheory.inv c1)
      hx (hg x hx)
  have hc1_ne : Not (c1 = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hc1) hzero.symm
  have hinv_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv c1) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hc1)
  constructor
  · intro hf_conv
    apply improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_of_eventually_nonnegative_le
      hg hscaled_f_local
    · cases horder with
      | intro threshold hthreshold =>
          refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
          intro x hx htx
          exact And.intro
            (hthreshold x hx htx).right.left
            (hthreshold x hx htx).right.right.right
    · exact improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_mul_left hf_conv
  · intro hg_conv
    apply improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_of_eventually_nonnegative_le
      hf hscaled_g_local
    · cases horder with
      | intro threshold hthreshold =>
          refine Exists.intro threshold ?_
          intro x hx htx
          refine And.intro (hthreshold x hx htx).left ?_
          have hmul :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left F
              (hthreshold x hx htx).right.right.left hinv_nonneg
          change
            F.le
              (F.mul (F.inv c1) (F.mul c1 (f x)))
              (F.mul (F.inv c1) (g x)) at hmul
          have hleft :
              F.mul (F.inv c1) (F.mul c1 (f x)) = f x := by
            calc
              F.mul (F.inv c1) (F.mul c1 (f x)) =
                  F.mul (F.mul (F.inv c1) c1) (f x) := by
                    rw [F.mul_assoc]
              _ = F.mul F.one (f x) := by
                    rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hc1_ne]
              _ = f x := by rw [F.one_mul]
          rwa [hleft] at hmul
    · exact improperRiemannIntegrableAtPosInf_mul_left hg_conv

name: finiteSum_le_nat_mul_of_slotInjection
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_le_nat_mul_of_slotInjection
    {n N : Nat} (P : Nat -> Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (weight : Nat -> Point) (slot : Nat -> Nat) (delta : Point)
    (hslot : forall i : Nat, i < n -> P i -> slot i < N)
    (hinj : forall i k : Nat, i < n -> k < n -> P i -> P k ->
      slot i = slot k -> i = k)
    (hinactive : forall i : Nat, i < n -> Not (P i) ->
      weight i = RealTheory.zero)
    (hdelta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero delta)
    (hweight_lt : forall i : Nat, i < n -> P i ->
      RealTheory.lt (weight i) delta) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.finiteSum weight n)
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N) delta)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let slotTerm := fun i j : Nat =>
    if And (P i) (slot i = j) then weight i else RealTheory.zero
  have hrow : forall i : Nat, i < n ->
      weight i = RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => slotTerm i j) N := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases hactive : P i
    · have hsum :
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => slotTerm i j) N =
            slotTerm i (slot i) :=
        RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_single_of_eq_zero_off
          (hslot i hi hactive)
          (fun j _hj hne => by
            dsimp [slotTerm]
            rw [if_neg]
            intro hbad
            exact hne hbad.right.symm)
      rw [hsum]
      dsimp [slotTerm]
      rw [if_pos (And.intro hactive rfl)]
    · have hzero :
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => slotTerm i j) N =
            RealTheory.zero :=
        RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero
          (term := fun j : Nat => slotTerm i j) N
          (fun j _hj => by
            dsimp [slotTerm]
            rw [if_neg]
            intro hbad
            exact hactive hbad.left)
      calc
        weight i = RealTheory.zero := hinactive i hi hactive
        _ = RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => slotTerm i j) N :=
          Eq.symm hzero
  have hcolumn : forall j : Nat, j < N ->
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => slotTerm i j) n)
        delta := by
    intro j _hj
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    by_cases hex : Exists (fun i : Nat =>
        And (i < n) (And (P i) (slot i = j)))
    · cases hex with
      | intro i hi_pack =>
          have hi : i < n := hi_pack.left
          have hPi : P i := hi_pack.right.left
          have hslot_i : slot i = j := hi_pack.right.right
          have hsum :
              RealTheory.finiteSum (fun k : Nat => slotTerm k j) n =
                slotTerm i j :=
            RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_single_of_eq_zero_off hi
              (fun k hk hne => by
                dsimp [slotTerm]
                rw [if_neg]
                intro hbad
                have hslot_ki : slot k = slot i :=
                  hbad.right.trans hslot_i.symm
                exact hne (hinj k i hk hi hbad.left hPi hslot_ki))
          rw [hsum]
          dsimp [slotTerm]
          rw [if_pos (And.intro hPi hslot_i)]
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
            (hweight_lt i hi hPi)
    · have hzero :
          RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => slotTerm i j) n =
            RealTheory.zero :=
        RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero
          (term := fun i : Nat => slotTerm i j) n
          (fun i hi => by
            dsimp [slotTerm]
            rw [if_neg]
            intro hbad
            exact hex (Exists.intro i (And.intro hi hbad)))
      rw [hzero]
      exact hdelta_nonneg
  have hrows :
      RealTheory.finiteSum weight n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => slotTerm i j) N)
          n :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt n hrow
  have hswap :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => slotTerm i j) N) n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => slotTerm i j) n) N :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_fubini slotTerm n N
  have hcolumns :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => slotTerm i j) n) N)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum (fun _j : Nat => delta) N) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun j : Nat =>
        RealTheory.finiteSum (fun i : Nat => slotTerm i j) n)
      (fun _j : Nat => delta)
      N
      hcolumn
  rw [hrows, hswap]
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hcolumns (by
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_const]
    exact RealTheory.le_refl (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N) delta))

name: refinementSplitLengthSum_le_nat_mul_delta_of_injection
statement:
theorem refinementSplitLengthSum_le_nat_mul_delta_of_injection
    {a b : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {n N : Nat}
    {cut slot : Nat -> Nat} {delta : Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) delta)
    (hinj : RefinementSplitCellInjection n N cut slot) :
    RealTheory.le
      (refinementSplitLengthSum p n cut)
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N) delta)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold refinementSplitLengthSum
  apply finiteSum_le_nat_mul_of_slotInjection
    (P := RefinementSplitCell cut) (slot := slot)
    (hslot := hinj.left) (hinj := hinj.right)
  · intro i _hi hnot
    have hblock : refinementBlockLength cut i = 1 :=
      Classical.byContradiction hnot
    unfold refinementSplitCellLength
    rw [if_pos hblock]
  · exact RealTheory.le_trans (mesh_nonnegative hp)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hmesh)
  · intro i hi hsplit
    unfold refinementSplitCellLength
    rw [if_neg hsplit]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
      (cellLength_le_mesh p n i hi) hmesh

name: refinementSplitLengthSum_endpointMergeLeft_le_nat_mul_delta
statement:
theorem refinementSplitLengthSum_endpointMergeLeft_le_nat_mul_delta
    {a b : Point} {left right : Nat -> Point}
    {leftCount rightCount : Nat} {delta : Point}
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a b leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition a b rightCount right)
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh left leftCount) delta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (refinementSplitLengthSum left leftCount
        (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut left right leftCount rightCount))
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat rightCount) delta)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hpos : 0 < leftCount
  · let cut := endpointMergeLeftBlockCut left right leftCount rightCount
    let slot := endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount
    have href := endpointMergeLeft_partitionBlockRefines hleft hright hpos
    have hinj :
        RefinementProperSplitCellInjection leftCount rightCount cut slot :=
      endpointMergeLeftBlockCut_refinementProperSplitCellInjection
        hleft hright
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    unfold refinementSplitLengthSum
    apply finiteSum_le_nat_mul_of_slotInjection
      (P := RefinementProperSplitCell cut) (slot := slot)
      (hslot := hinj.left) (hinj := hinj.right)
    · intro i hi hnot
      by_cases hblock_one : refinementBlockLength cut i = 1
      · unfold refinementSplitCellLength
        rw [if_pos hblock_one]
      · have hblock_zero : refinementBlockLength cut i = 0 := by
          unfold RefinementProperSplitCell at hnot
          omega
        exact refinementSplitCellLength_eq_zero_of_blockLength_zero
          href hi hblock_zero
    · exact RealTheory.le_trans (mesh_nonnegative hleft)
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hmesh)
    · intro i hi hproper
      have hsplit : RefinementSplitCell cut i :=
        refinementProperSplitCell_refinementSplitCell hproper
      unfold refinementSplitCellLength
      rw [if_neg hsplit]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
        (cellLength_le_mesh left leftCount i hi) hmesh
  · have hcount : leftCount = 0 :=
      Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_not_gt hpos)
    have hdelta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero delta := by
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      have hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta := by
        rw [<- mesh_zero left]
        rwa [hcount] at hmesh
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hdelta_pos
    rw [hcount]
    unfold refinementSplitLengthSum
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
    exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg
      (RealTheory.nat_nonneg rightCount) hdelta_nonneg

name: refinementSplitOscillationSum_le_mul_splitLengthSum
statement:
theorem refinementSplitOscillationSum_le_mul_splitLengthSum
    {a b : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    {cut : Nat -> Nat} {omega : Nat -> Point} {Omega : Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hOmega :
      forall i : Nat, i < n -> RealTheory.le (omega i) Omega) :
    RealTheory.le
      (refinementSplitOscillationSum p n cut omega)
      (RealTheory.mul Omega (refinementSplitLengthSum p n cut))
proof:
:= by
  unfold refinementSplitOscillationSum refinementSplitLengthSum
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (omega i)
              (refinementSplitCellLength p cut i)) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul Omega
              (refinementSplitCellLength p cut i)) n) := by
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun i : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul (omega i)
          (refinementSplitCellLength p cut i))
      (fun i : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul Omega
          (refinementSplitCellLength p cut i))
      n
      (fun i hi =>
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
          (hOmega i hi)
          (refinementSplitCellLength_nonnegative hp hi))
  have hright :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul Omega
              (refinementSplitCellLength p cut i)) n =
        RealTheory.mul Omega
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat =>
              refinementSplitCellLength p cut i) n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left Omega
      (fun i : Nat => refinementSplitCellLength p cut i) n
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hsum (by
    rw [hright]
    exact RealTheory.le_refl
      (RealTheory.mul Omega
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => refinementSplitCellLength p cut i) n)))

name: refinementSplitOscillationSum_le_mul_of_splitLengthSum_le
statement:
theorem refinementSplitOscillationSum_le_mul_of_splitLengthSum_le
    {a b : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    {cut : Nat -> Nat} {omega : Nat -> Point} {Omega L : Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hOmega_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero Omega)
    (hOmega :
      forall i : Nat, i < n -> RealTheory.le (omega i) Omega)
    (hsplit :
      RealTheory.le (refinementSplitLengthSum p n cut) L) :
    RealTheory.le
      (refinementSplitOscillationSum p n cut omega)
      (RealTheory.mul Omega L)
proof:
:= by
  have hweighted :
      RealTheory.le
        (refinementSplitOscillationSum p n cut omega)
        (RealTheory.mul Omega (refinementSplitLengthSum p n cut)) :=
    refinementSplitOscillationSum_le_mul_splitLengthSum hp hOmega
  have hbudget :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul Omega (refinementSplitLengthSum p n cut))
        (RealTheory.mul Omega L) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hsplit hOmega_nonneg
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hweighted hbudget

name: hasRiemannIntegral_hasLowerDarbouxIntegral
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_hasLowerDarbouxIntegral
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    HasLowerDarbouxIntegral f a b I
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded (Exists.intro I hI)
  have hupperLimit :
      UpperDarbouxSumsTendTo f a b I :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_upperDarbouxSumsTendTo hI
  have hlowerLimit :
      LowerDarbouxSumsTendTo f a b I :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_lowerDarbouxSumsTendTo hI
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro v hv
    cases hv with
    | intro n hn =>
        cases hn with
        | intro p hpv =>
            have hp : IntervalPartition a b n p := hpv.left
            have hv_eq : v = lowerSum f p n := hpv.right
            rw [hv_eq]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_forall_lt_add_pos F
              (x := lowerSum f p n) (y := I)
              (fun eps heps => by
                cases hupperLimit.right eps heps with
                | intro delta hdelta =>
                    cases exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt
                        (intervalPartition_interval_le hp) hdelta.left with
                    | intro m hm =>
                        cases hm with
                        | intro q hq =>
                            cases hq with
                            | intro tag htag =>
                                have hqpart :
                                    IntervalPartition a b m q :=
                                  htag.left.left
                                have hclose :
                                    RealTheory.lt
                                      (RealTheory.abs
                                        (RealTheory.sub
                                          (upperSum f q m) I))
                                      eps :=
                                  hdelta.right m q hqpart htag.right
                                have hupper_lt :
                                    RealTheory.lt (upperSum f q m)
                                      (RealTheory.add I eps) :=
                                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt
                                    F hclose
                                have hle :
                                    RealTheory.le (lowerSum f p n)
                                      (upperSum f q m) :=
                                  lowerSum_le_upperSum_of_intervalPartitions
                                    hbdd hp hqpart
                                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                  F hle hupper_lt)
  · intro u hu
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_forall_lt_add_pos F
      (x := I) (y := u)
      (fun eps heps => by
        cases hlowerLimit.right eps heps with
        | intro delta hdelta =>
            cases exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt
                hab hdelta.left with
            | intro n hn =>
                cases hn with
                | intro p hp =>
                    cases hp with
                    | intro tag htag =>
                        have hp_part : IntervalPartition a b n p :=
                          htag.left.left
                        have hclose :
                            RealTheory.lt
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (RealTheory.sub (lowerSum f p n) I))
                              eps :=
                          hdelta.right n p hp_part htag.right
                        have hI_lt :
                            RealTheory.lt I
                              (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) eps) :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_left_add_of_abs_sub_lt
                            F hclose
                        have hlower_le_u :
                            RealTheory.le (lowerSum f p n) u :=
                          hu (lowerSum f p n)
                            (lowerSum_mem_lowerDarbouxSumValueSet hp_part)
                        have hsum_le :
                            RealTheory.le
                              (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) eps)
                              (RealTheory.add u eps) :=
                          RealTheory.add_le_add_right hlower_le_u eps
                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                          F hI_lt hsum_le)

statement:

            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_forall_lt_add_pos F
              (x := I) (y := upperSum f p n)
              (fun eps heps => by
                cases hlowerLimit.right eps heps with
                | intro delta hdelta =>
                    cases exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt

                    | intro m hm =>

                                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                                  F hI_lt hsum_le)
  · intro l hl
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_forall_lt_add_pos F

                hab hdelta.left with
            | intro n hn =>
                cases hn with

                    cases hp with
                    | intro tag htag =>
                        have hp_part : IntervalPartition a b n p :=
                          htag.left.left
                        have hclose :
                            RealTheory.lt
                              (RealTheory.abs
                                (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) I))
                              eps :=
                          hdelta.right n p hp_part htag.right
                        have hupper_lt :
                            RealTheory.lt (upperSum f p n)
                              (RealTheory.add I eps) :=
                          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt
                            F hclose
                        have hl_le_upper :
                            RealTheory.le l (upperSum f p n) :=
                          hl (upperSum f p n)
                            (upperSum_mem_upperDarbouxSumValueSet hp_part)
                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                          F hl_le_upper hupper_lt)

theorem hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_ordered

    (RealTheory.le_trans hac hcb)

name: riemannIntegrableOn_adjacent_ordered

    RiemannIntegrableOn f a b
proof:

      cases hright with
      | intro J hJ =>
          exact riemannIntegrableOn_of_taggedRiemannIntegrableOn
            (RealTheory.le_trans hac hcb)
            (Exists.intro (RealTheory.add I J)
              (hasRiemannIntegral_adjacent_ordered hac hcb

name: hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_decomposition_ordered
statement:
theorem hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_decomposition_ordered
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b K : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hf : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b)
    (hK : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b K) :
    Exists
      (fun I : Point =>
        Exists
          (fun J : Point =>
            And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a c I)
              (And (HasDarbouxIntegral f c b J)
                (K = RealTheory.add I J))))
proof:
:= by
  let hleft := riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_left hac hcb hf
  let hright := riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_right hac hcb hf
  cases hleft with
  | intro I hI =>
      cases hright with
      | intro J hJ =>
          refine Exists.intro I ?_
          refine Exists.intro J ?_
          refine And.intro hI.right ?_
          refine And.intro hJ.right ?_
          have hsum :
              HasDarbouxIntegral f a b (RealTheory.add I J) :=
            hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_ordered
              hac hcb hI.left hI.right hJ.left hJ.right
          have hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
            riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded hf
          exact hasRiemannIntegral_unique
            (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral hbdd hK)
            (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral hbdd hsum)

name: refinementBlockWeightedDifference_le
statement:
private theorem refinementBlockWeightedDifference_le
    {a b : Point} {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat}
    {cut : Nat -> Nat} {omega : Point}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    (hq : IntervalPartition a b m q)
    {i : Nat}
    (hi : i < n)
    (left right : Nat -> Point)
    (hpoint : forall h : Nat, h < refinementBlockLength cut i ->
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (left h) (right h)) omega) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat => RealTheory.mul (left h)
            (refinementBlockCellLength q cut i h))
          (refinementBlockLength cut i))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun h : Nat => RealTheory.mul (right h)
            (refinementBlockCellLength q cut i h))
          (refinementBlockLength cut i)))
      (RealTheory.mul omega (cellLength p i))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let count := refinementBlockLength cut i
  let len := fun h : Nat => refinementBlockCellLength q cut i h
  let leftWeighted := fun h : Nat => RealTheory.mul (left h) (len h)
  let rightWeighted := fun h : Nat => RealTheory.mul (right h) (len h)
  let error := fun h : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub (left h) (right h)) (len h)
  let bound := fun h : Nat => RealTheory.mul omega (len h)
  have hformula :
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.finiteSum leftWeighted count)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum rightWeighted count) =
        RealTheory.finiteSum error count := by
    rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_sub leftWeighted rightWeighted count]
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro h
    unfold leftWeighted rightWeighted error len
    exact Eq.symm
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F
        (left h) (right h) (refinementBlockCellLength q cut i h))
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum error count)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum bound count) := by
    unfold error bound len count
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le _ _ _
      (fun h hh =>
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
          (hpoint h hh)
          (refinementBlockCellLength_nonnegative href hq hi hh))
  have hbound :
      RealTheory.finiteSum bound count =
        RealTheory.mul omega (cellLength p i) := by
    unfold bound len count
    exact finiteSum_const_mul_refinementBlockCellLength
      href hi omega
  change RealTheory.le
    (RealTheory.sub
      (RealTheory.finiteSum leftWeighted count)
      (RealTheory.finiteSum rightWeighted count))
    (RealTheory.mul omega (cellLength p i))
  rw [hformula, <- hbound]
  exact hsum

name: refinementBlockUpperError_le
statement:

    {a b : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}

name: refinementBlockLowerError_le
statement:
theorem refinementBlockLowerError_le
    {a b : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat}
    {omega : Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    (hq : IntervalPartition a b m q)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    {i : Nat}
    (homega : IsCellOscillation f p i omega)
    (hi : i < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub
        (refinementBlockLowerSum f q cut i)
        (RealTheory.mul (cellLower f p i) (cellLength p i)))
      (RealTheory.mul omega (cellLength p i))
proof:
:= by
  have herr := refinementBlockWeightedDifference_le
    href hq hi

name: exists_common_partition_darbouxGaps_lt
statement:
theorem exists_common_partition_darbouxGaps_lt
    {f h : Point -> Point} {a b epsF epsH : Point}
    (hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hh_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded h a b)
    (hfsmall : DarbouxGapSmall f a b)
    (hhsmall : DarbouxGapSmall h a b)
    (hepsF : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero epsF)
    (hepsH : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero epsH) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b n p)
              (And
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))
                  epsF)
                (RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.sub (upperSum h p n) (lowerSum h p n))
                  epsH))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hfsmall epsF hepsF with
  | intro leftCount hleftChoice =>
      cases hleftChoice with
      | intro left hleftChoice =>
          have hleftPart : IntervalPartition a b leftCount left :=
            hleftChoice.left
          have hleftGap :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.sub
                  (upperSum f left leftCount)
                  (lowerSum f left leftCount))
                epsF :=
            hleftChoice.right
          cases hhsmall epsH hepsH with
          | intro rightCount hrightChoice =>
              cases hrightChoice with
              | intro right hrightChoice =>
                  have hrightPart :
                      IntervalPartition a b rightCount right :=
                    hrightChoice.left
                  have hrightGap :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.sub
                          (upperSum h right rightCount)
                          (lowerSum h right rightCount))
                        epsH :=
                    hrightChoice.right
                  cases exists_commonTaggedBlockRefinement
                      (leftTags_taggedPartition hleftPart)
                      (leftTags_taggedPartition hrightPart) with
                  | intro mergeCount hmergeCount =>
                      cases hmergeCount with
                      | intro merge hmerge =>
                          cases hmerge with
                          | intro mergeTag hmergeTag =>
                              cases hmergeTag with
                              | intro leftCut hleftCut =>
                                  cases hleftCut with
                                  | intro rightCut hcommon =>
                                      have hmergeTagged :
                                          TaggedPartition a b mergeCount
                                            merge mergeTag :=
                                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_taggedPartition
                                          hcommon
                                      have hmergePart :
                                          IntervalPartition a b mergeCount
                                            merge :=
                                        hmergeTagged.left
                                      have hleftRefines :
                                          PartitionBlockRefines
                                            merge mergeCount left leftCount
                                            leftCut :=
                                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_left_refines
                                          hcommon
                                      have hrightRefines :
                                          PartitionBlockRefines
                                            merge mergeCount right rightCount
                                            rightCut :=
                                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_right_refines
                                          hcommon
                                      have hleftGap_le :
                                          RealTheory.le
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (upperSum f merge mergeCount)
                                              (lowerSum f merge mergeCount))
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (upperSum f left leftCount)
                                              (lowerSum f left leftCount)) := by
                                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
                                          F
                                          (upperSum_le_upperSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                                            hf_bdd hleftRefines hmergePart hleftPart)
                                          (lowerSum_le_lowerSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                                            hf_bdd hleftRefines hmergePart hleftPart)
                                      have hrightGap_le :
                                          RealTheory.le
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (upperSum h merge mergeCount)
                                              (lowerSum h merge mergeCount))
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (upperSum h right rightCount)
                                              (lowerSum h right rightCount)) := by
                                        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
                                          F
                                          (upperSum_le_upperSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                                            hh_bdd hrightRefines hmergePart hrightPart)
                                          (lowerSum_le_lowerSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                                            hh_bdd hrightRefines hmergePart hrightPart)
                                      refine Exists.intro mergeCount ?_
                                      refine Exists.intro merge ?_
                                      refine And.intro hmergePart ?_
                                      exact And.intro
                                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                          F hleftGap_le hleftGap)
                                        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                          F hrightGap_le hrightGap)

name: hasRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b I J : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hfg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le (f x) (g x))
    (hf : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I)
    (hg : HasRiemannIntegral g a b J) :
    RealTheory.le I J
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_forall_lt_add_pos F
    (x := I) (y := J)
    (fun eps heps => by
      let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
      have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
      cases hf.right e2 he2_pos with
      | intro deltaF hdeltaF =>
          cases hg.right e2 he2_pos with
          | intro deltaG hdeltaG =>
              let delta := RealTheory.min deltaF deltaG
              have hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_min2 F
                  hdeltaF.left hdeltaG.left
              cases exists_taggedPartition_mesh_lt hab hdelta_pos with
              | intro n hn =>
                  cases hn with
                  | intro p hp =>
                      cases hp with
                      | intro tag htag =>
                          have hmeshF :
                              RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaF :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                              htag.right
                              (RealTheory.min_le_left deltaF deltaG)
                          have hmeshG :
                              RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaG :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                              htag.right
                              (RealTheory.min_le_right deltaF deltaG)
                          let sf := taggedSum f p tag n
                          let sg := taggedSum g p tag n
                          have hfclose :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub sf I)) e2 := by
                            dsimp [sf]
                            exact hdeltaF.right n p tag
                              htag.left hmeshF
                          have hgclose :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.abs
                                  (RealTheory.sub sg J)) e2 := by
                            dsimp [sg]
                            exact hdeltaG.right n p tag
                              htag.left hmeshG
                          have hI_lt_sf_e2 :
                              RealTheory.lt I
                                (RealTheory.add sf e2) :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_left_add_of_abs_sub_lt
                              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hfclose
                          have hsf_le_sg : RealTheory.le sf sg := by
                            dsimp [sf, sg]
                            exact taggedSum_le_of_pointwise_le
                              htag.left hfg
                          have hsf_e2_le_sg_e2 :
                              RealTheory.le
                                (RealTheory.add sf e2)
                                (RealTheory.add sg e2) :=
                            RealTheory.add_le_add_right hsf_le_sg e2
                          have hI_lt_sg_e2 :
                              RealTheory.lt I
                                (RealTheory.add sg e2) :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                              hI_lt_sf_e2 hsf_e2_le_sg_e2
                          have hsg_lt_J_e2 :
                              RealTheory.lt sg (RealTheory.add J e2) :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt
                              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hgclose
                          have hsg_e2_lt_J_e2_e2 :
                              RealTheory.lt
                                (RealTheory.add sg e2)
                                (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add J e2) e2) :=
                            RealTheory.add_lt_add_right hsg_lt_J_e2 e2
                          have hI_lt_J_e2_e2 :
                              RealTheory.lt I
                                (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add J e2) e2) :=
                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                              hI_lt_sg_e2 hsg_e2_lt_J_e2_e2
                          have hadd :
                              RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add J e2) e2 =
                                RealTheory.add J eps := by
                            rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
                            have he2_add : RealTheory.add e2 e2 = eps := by
                              dsimp [e2]
                              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                                F eps
                            rw [he2_add]
                          rwa [hadd] at hI_lt_J_e2_e2)

      (endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro i hi hproper
    exact
      endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot_lt_rightCount_of_refinementProperSplitCell
        hi hproper
  · intro i j hi hj hproper_i hproper_j hslot
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · exact hij
    have hcases : i < j ∨ j < i := by
      omega
    cases hcases with
    | inl hij_lt =>
        have hnext_lt :
            endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount i <
              endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount
                (i + 1) :=
          endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot_lt_next_of_refinementProperSplitCell
            hi hproper_i
        have hleft_pos : 0 < leftCount :=
          Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le i) hi
        have hmono :
            endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount
                (i + 1) <=
              endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount j :=
          endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot_mono_of_le
            hleft hright hleft_pos
            (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hij_lt) (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
        have hlt_slot :
            endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount i <
              endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount j :=
          Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hnext_lt hmono
        rw [hslot] at hlt_slot
        exact False.elim
          ((Nat.lt_irrefl
            (endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount j))
            hlt_slot)
    | inr hji_lt =>
        have hnext_lt :
            endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount j <
              endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount
                (j + 1) :=
          endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot_lt_next_of_refinementProperSplitCell
            hj hproper_j
        have hleft_pos : 0 < leftCount :=
          Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le j) hj
        have hmono :
            endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount
                (j + 1) <=
              endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount i :=
          endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot_mono_of_le
            hleft hright hleft_pos
            (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hji_lt) (Nat.le_of_lt hi)
        have hlt_slot :
            endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount j <
              endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount i :=
          Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hnext_lt hmono
        rw [hslot] at hlt_slot
        exact False.elim
          ((Nat.lt_irrefl
            (endpointMergeLeftSplitSlot left right leftCount rightCount j))
            hlt_slot)

private theorem refinementBlockError_le_splitCellLength
    {p : Nat -> Point} {cut : Nat -> Nat} {i : Nat}
    {omega error : Point}
    (hunit : refinementBlockLength cut i = 1 ->
      error = RealTheory.zero)
    (hgeneral : RealTheory.le error

      (RealTheory.mul omega (refinementSplitCellLength p cut i))
proof:

name: upperSum_sub_upperSum_le_refinementSplitOscillationSum
statement:
theorem upperSum_sub_upperSum_le_refinementSplitOscillationSum
    {a b : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {q p : Nat -> Point} {m n : Nat}
    {cut : Nat -> Nat} {omega : Nat -> Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    (hq : IntervalPartition a b m q)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (homega : forall i : Nat, i < n -> IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (upperSum f q m))
      (refinementSplitOscillationSum p n cut omega)
proof:
:= by
  rw [upperSum_eq_finiteSum_refinementBlockUpperSum href]
  unfold upperSum Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedUpperSum
    refinementSplitOscillationSum
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_sub
    (fun i : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul
        (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellUpper f p i)
        (cellLength p i))
    (fun i : Nat => refinementBlockUpperSum f q cut i) n]
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
    (fun i : Nat =>
      RealTheory.sub
        (RealTheory.mul (cellUpper f p i) (cellLength p i))
        (refinementBlockUpperSum f q cut i))
    (fun i : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul (omega i)
        (refinementSplitCellLength p cut i))
    n
    (fun i hi =>
      refinementBlockError_le_splitCellLength
        (fun hblock => by
          change RealTheory.sub
            (RealTheory.mul (cellUpper f p i) (cellLength p i))
            (refinementBlockUpperSum f q cut i) = RealTheory.zero
          rw [refinementBlockUpperSum_eq_coarseUpperContribution_of_blockLength_eq_one
            hbdd href hq hp hi hblock]
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
            (RealTheory.mul (cellUpper f p i) (cellLength p i)))
        (refinementBlockUpperError_le
          hbdd href hq hp (homega i hi) hi))

    {a b : Point} {f : Point -> Point}

proof:
:= by
  rw [lowerSum_eq_finiteSum_refinementBlockLowerSum href]
  unfold lowerSum Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedLowerSum
    refinementSplitOscillationSum
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_sub

    (fun i : Nat =>

    (fun i : Nat =>
      RealTheory.sub

        (RealTheory.mul (cellLower f p i) (cellLength p i)))
    (fun i : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul (omega i)
        (refinementSplitCellLength p cut i))
    n
    (fun i hi =>
      refinementBlockError_le_splitCellLength
        (fun hblock => by
          change RealTheory.sub
            (refinementBlockLowerSum f q cut i)
            (RealTheory.mul (cellLower f p i) (cellLength p i)) = RealTheory.zero

            hbdd href hq hp hi hblock]
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base

name: exists_lowerSum_gt_sub_of_hasLowerDarbouxIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_lowerSum_gt_sub_of_hasLowerDarbouxIntegral
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I eps : Point}
    (hI : HasLowerDarbouxIntegral f a b I)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b n p)
              (And
                (RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub I eps) (lowerSum f p n))
                (RealTheory.le (lowerSum f p n) I))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbelow : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub I eps) I :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F heps
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub F hI hbelow with
  | intro v hv =>
      cases hv.left with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              have hp_part : IntervalPartition a b n p := hp.left
              have hv_eq : v = lowerSum f p n := hp.right
              have hlt : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub I eps)
                  (lowerSum f p n) := by
                have hvlt := hv.right
                rwa [hv_eq] at hvlt
              have hle : RealTheory.le (lowerSum f p n) I := by
                have hmem :
                    LowerDarbouxSumValueSet f a b (lowerSum f p n) :=
                  lowerSum_mem_lowerDarbouxSumValueSet hp_part
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F hI hmem
              refine Exists.intro n ?_
              refine Exists.intro p ?_
              exact And.intro hp_part (And.intro hlt hle)

name: exists_upperSum_lt_add_of_hasUpperDarbouxIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_upperSum_lt_add_of_hasUpperDarbouxIntegral
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I eps : Point}
    (hI : HasUpperDarbouxIntegral f a b I)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun p : Nat -> Point =>
            And (IntervalPartition a b n p)
              (And
                (RealTheory.le I (upperSum f p n))
                (RealTheory.lt (upperSum f p n)
                  (RealTheory.add I eps)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have habove : RealTheory.lt I (RealTheory.add I eps) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F heps I
    change F.lt (F.add I F.zero) (F.add I eps) at h
    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_gt_of_glb_lt F hI habove with
  | intro v hv =>
      cases hv.left with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              have hp_part : IntervalPartition a b n p := hp.left
              have hv_eq : v = upperSum f p n := hp.right
              have hlt : RealTheory.lt (upperSum f p n)
                  (RealTheory.add I eps) := by
                have hvlt := hv.right
                rwa [hv_eq] at hvlt
              have hle : RealTheory.le I (upperSum f p n) := by
                have hmem :
                    UpperDarbouxSumValueSet f a b (upperSum f p n) :=
                  upperSum_mem_upperDarbouxSumValueSet hp_part
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.glb_le_of_mem F hI hmem
              refine Exists.intro n ?_
              refine Exists.intro p ?_
              exact And.intro hp_part (And.intro hle hlt)

name: exists_isCellOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded
statement:
theorem exists_isCellOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n) :
    Exists (fun omega : Point => IsCellOscillation f p k omega)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hbdd with
  | intro B hB =>
      apply RealTheory.exists_lub
      · refine Exists.intro
          (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f (p k)) (f (p k)))) ?_
        exact oscillationValueSet_mem
          (intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hp hk)
          (intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hp hk)
      · refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.add B B) ?_
        intro v hv
        cases hv with
        | intro x hx =>
            cases hx with
            | intro y hy =>
                have hxab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
                  partitionCell_mem_closedInterval hp hk hy.left
                have hyab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y :=
                  partitionCell_mem_closedInterval hp hk hy.right.left
                have hxB : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f x)) B :=
                  hB.right x hxab
                have hyB : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f y)) B :=
                  hB.right y hyab
                have htri :
                    RealTheory.le
                      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))
                      (RealTheory.add
                        (RealTheory.abs (f x))
                        (RealTheory.abs (f y))) :=
                  abs_sub_le_abs_add_abs (f x) (f y)
                have hsum :
                    RealTheory.le
                      (RealTheory.add
                        (RealTheory.abs (f x))
                        (RealTheory.abs (f y)))
                      (RealTheory.add B B) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hxB hyB
                rw [hy.right.right]
                exact RealTheory.le_trans htri hsum

    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}

        (Exists.intro (p k) (intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hp hk))
        (Exists.intro (RealTheory.neg B) (fun x hx => by
          have hxab : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=

              RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg (f x)) B :=
