name: hasRiemannIntegral_adjacent_ordered
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_adjacent_ordered
    {f : Point -> Point} {a c b I J : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hleft : HasRiemannIntegral f a c I)
    (hright : HasRiemannIntegral f c b J) :
    HasRiemannIntegral f a b (RealTheory.add I J)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro (RealTheory.le_trans hac hcb) ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  let e4 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F e2
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have he4_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e4 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F he2_pos
  have hc : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c :=
    And.intro hac hcb
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hac hcb
  have hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalBounded_adjacent
      hleft hright
  have hclosed_ne : Exists (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) := by
    refine Exists.intro a ?_
    exact And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab
  cases exists_isClosedIntervalOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded
      hbdd hclosed_ne with
  | intro Omega hOmega =>
      have hOmega_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero Omega :=
        isOscillationOn_nonnegative hOmega hclosed_ne
      cases hleft.right e4 he4_pos with
      | intro deltaL hdeltaL =>
          cases hright.right e4 he4_pos with
          | intro deltaR hdeltaR =>
              cases exists_pos_delta_omega_nat_mul_lt
                  (Omega := Omega) (eps := e2) (N := 2)
                  hOmega_nonneg he2_pos with
              | intro deltaI hdeltaI =>
                  let delta := RealTheory.min deltaI
                    (RealTheory.min deltaL deltaR)
                  refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
                  · have hdeltaLR_pos :
                        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                          (RealTheory.min deltaL deltaR) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_min2 F
                        hdeltaL.left hdeltaR.left
                    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_min2 F
                      hdeltaI.left hdeltaLR_pos
                  · intro n p tag htag hmesh
                    have hmeshI :
                        RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaI :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                        hmesh
                        (RealTheory.min_le_left deltaI
                          (RealTheory.min deltaL deltaR))
                    have hmeshLR :
                        RealTheory.lt (mesh p n)
                          (RealTheory.min deltaL deltaR) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                        hmesh
                        (RealTheory.min_le_right deltaI
                          (RealTheory.min deltaL deltaR))
                    have hmeshL0 :
                        RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaL :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                        hmeshLR
                        (RealTheory.min_le_left deltaL deltaR)
                    have hmeshR0 :
                        RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaR :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                        hmeshLR
                        (RealTheory.min_le_right deltaL deltaR)
                    by_cases hpos : 0 < n
                    · let split := splitPointPartition a c b
                      let merge := endpointMergePoint p split n 2
                      let cut := endpointMergeRightBlockCut p split n 2 1
                      let mergeTag :=
                        refinementPreserveUnsplitTags merge tag n
                          (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut p split n 2)
                      let suffix := suffixPartition merge cut
                      let suffixTag := suffixTags mergeTag cut
                      let refinedSum := taggedSum f merge mergeTag (n + 2)
                      let originalSum := taggedSum f p tag n
                      let leftSum := taggedSum f merge mergeTag cut
                      let rightSum := taggedSum f suffix suffixTag
                        ((n + 2) - cut)
                      let omega := fun i : Nat =>
                        if hi : i < n then
                          Classical.choose
                            (exists_isCellOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded
                              (f := f) (a := a) (b := b)
                              (n := n) (k := i) (p := p)
                              hbdd htag.left hi)
                        else
                          RealTheory.zero
                      have homega :
                          forall i : Nat, i < n ->
                            IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i) := by
                        intro i hi
                        unfold omega
                        simp [hi]
                        exact Classical.choose_spec
                          (exists_isCellOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded
                            (f := f) (a := a) (b := b)
                            (n := n) (k := i) (p := p)
                            hbdd htag.left hi)
                      have hcell_le :
                          forall i : Nat, i < n ->
                            RealTheory.le (omega i) Omega := by
                        intro i hi
                        exact isCellOscillation_le_closedIntervalOscillation
                          htag.left hi (homega i hi) hOmega
                      have hinsert_le :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub refinedSum originalSum))
                            (RealTheory.mul Omega
                              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat 2) deltaI)) := by
                        dsimp [refinedSum, originalSum, mergeTag, merge,
                          split]
                        exact
                          abs_taggedSum_splitPointEndpointMergeLeft_refinementError_le_mul_two_delta
                            htag hc homega hOmega_nonneg hcell_le hmeshI
                      have hinsert_lt :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub refinedSum originalSum))
                            e2 :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                          hinsert_le hdeltaI.right
                      have hprefixTag :
                          TaggedPartition a c cut merge mergeTag := by
                        dsimp [cut, merge, mergeTag, split]
                        exact endpointMergeSplitPoint_prefix_taggedPartition
                          htag hc
                      have hsuffixTag :
                          TaggedPartition c b ((n + 2) - cut)
                            suffix suffixTag := by
                        dsimp [suffix, suffixTag, cut, mergeTag, merge,
                          split]
                        exact endpointMergeSplitPoint_suffix_taggedPartition
                          htag hc
                      have hprefix_mesh_le :
                          RealTheory.le (mesh merge cut) (mesh p n) := by
                        dsimp [merge, cut, split]
                        exact endpointMergeSplitPoint_prefix_mesh_le_of_pos
                          htag.left hc hpos
                      have hsuffix_mesh_le :
                          RealTheory.le
                            (mesh suffix ((n + 2) - cut)) (mesh p n) := by
                        dsimp [suffix, merge, cut, split]
                        exact endpointMergeSplitPoint_suffix_mesh_le_of_pos
                          htag.left hc hpos
                      have hprefix_mesh_lt :
                          RealTheory.lt (mesh merge cut) deltaL :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                          hprefix_mesh_le hmeshL0
                      have hsuffix_mesh_lt :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (mesh suffix ((n + 2) - cut)) deltaR :=
                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                          hsuffix_mesh_le hmeshR0
                      have hleft_close :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub leftSum I)) e4 := by
                        dsimp [leftSum]
                        exact hdeltaL.right cut merge mergeTag
                          hprefixTag hprefix_mesh_lt
                      have hright_close :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (RealTheory.abs
                              (RealTheory.sub rightSum J)) e4 := by
                        dsimp [rightSum]
                        exact hdeltaR.right ((n + 2) - cut)
                          suffix suffixTag hsuffixTag hsuffix_mesh_lt
                      have hrightPart :
                          IntervalPartition a b 2 split := by
                        dsimp [split]
                        exact splitPointPartition_intervalPartition hc
                      have hmergeI :
                          IntervalPartition a b (n + 2) merge :=
                        endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition
                          htag.left hrightPart
                      have href :
                          PartitionBlockRefines merge (n + 2) p n
                            (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut p split n 2) :=
                        endpointMergeLeft_partitionBlockRefines
                          htag.left hrightPart hpos
                      have hmergeTagged :
                          TaggedPartition a b (n + 2) merge mergeTag :=
                        refinementPreserveUnsplitTags_taggedPartition
                          href hmergeI htag
                      have hright_ref :
                          PartitionBlockRefines merge (n + 2)
                            split 2
                            (endpointMergeRightBlockCut p split n 2) :=
                        endpointMergeRight_partitionBlockRefines
                          htag.left hrightPart (by omega : 0 < 2)
                      have hcut_le : cut <= n + 2 :=
                        partitionBlockRefines_cut_le_right hright_ref
                          (show 1 <= 2 by omega)
                      have hrefined_eq :
                          refinedSum = RealTheory.add leftSum rightSum := by
                        dsimp [refinedSum, leftSum, rightSum, suffix,
                          suffixTag]
                        exact taggedSum_cut f hmergeTagged hcut_le
                      dsimp [e2, e4] at hinsert_lt hleft_close hright_close
                      exact
                        abs_sub_add_lt_of_refinement_error_budget
                          (s := originalSum) (refined := refinedSum)
                          (left := leftSum) (right := rightSum)
                          (I := I) (J := J) (eps := eps)
                          hrefined_eq hinsert_lt hleft_close
                          hright_close
                    · have hn : n = 0 :=
                        Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
                          (Nat.le_of_not_gt hpos)
                      subst n
                      have hab_eq : a = b := by
                        have hright : p 0 = b :=
                          intervalPartition_right_endpoint htag.left
                        exact Eq.trans
                          (Eq.symm
                            (intervalPartition_left_endpoint htag.left))
                          hright
                      subst b
                      have hca : c = a :=
                        RealTheory.le_antisymm hcb hac
                      subst c
                      have hI0 : I = RealTheory.zero :=
                        hasRiemannIntegral_unique
                          hleft
                          (hasRiemannIntegral_degenerate f a)
                      have hJ0 : J = RealTheory.zero :=
                        hasRiemannIntegral_unique
                          hright
                          (hasRiemannIntegral_degenerate f a)
                      have hsum0 :
                          taggedSum f p tag 0 = RealTheory.zero :=
                        taggedSum_eq_zero_of_degenerate htag
                      rw [hsum0, hI0, hJ0]
                      change
                        RealTheory.lt
                          (RealTheory.abs
                            (F.sub F.zero (F.add F.zero F.zero)))
                          eps
                      rw [F.add_zero]
                      rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F F.zero]
                      change
                        RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs RealTheory.zero) eps
                      rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg
                        (RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero)]
                      exact heps

name: hasRiemannIntegral_lowerDarbouxSumsTendTo
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_lowerDarbouxSumsTendTo
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hI : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    LowerDarbouxSumsTendTo f a b I
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hI.left ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have he2_lt_eps : RealTheory.lt e2 eps := by
    dsimp [e2]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps
  cases hI.right e2 he2_pos with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro n p hp hmesh
      have hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
        taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
          (Exists.intro I hI)
      have hinf :
          forall k : Nat, k < n ->
            Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m) :=
        exists_hasCellInf_of_closedIntervalBounded_partition hbdd hp
      let tag0 := leftTags p
      have htag0 : TaggedPartition a b n p tag0 :=
        leftTags_taggedPartition hp
      have hclose0 :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub (taggedSum f p tag0 n) I))
            e2 :=
        hdelta.right n p tag0 htag0 hmesh
      have htag0_lt_I_e2 :
          RealTheory.lt (taggedSum f p tag0 n)
            (RealTheory.add I e2) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt F hclose0
      have hlower_le_tag0 :
          RealTheory.le (lowerSum f p n)
            (taggedSum f p tag0 n) :=
        lowerSum_le_taggedSum htag0 hinf
      have hlower_lt_I_e2 :
          RealTheory.lt (lowerSum f p n) (RealTheory.add I e2) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
          hlower_le_tag0 htag0_lt_I_e2
      have hI_e2_lt_I_eps :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add I e2) (RealTheory.add I eps) :=
        RealTheory.add_lt_add_left he2_lt_eps I
      have hlower_lt_I_eps :
          RealTheory.lt (lowerSum f p n) (RealTheory.add I eps) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
          hlower_lt_I_e2 hI_e2_lt_I_eps
      have hsub_lower_I :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub (lowerSum f p n) I) eps :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hlower_lt_I_eps
      have hglb :
          IsGreatestLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
            (FixedTaggedSumValueSet f a b p n)
            (lowerSum f p n) :=
        lowerSum_isGreatestLowerBound_fixedTaggedSumValueSet hp hinf
      have hlower_lt_lower_add_e2 :
          RealTheory.lt (lowerSum f p n)
            (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) e2) := by
        have h := RealTheory.add_lt_add_left he2_pos (lowerSum f p n)
        change F.lt
          (F.add (lowerSum f p n) F.zero)
          (F.add (lowerSum f p n) e2) at h
        rwa [F.add_zero] at h
      cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_gt_of_glb_lt F
          hglb hlower_lt_lower_add_e2 with
      | intro v hv =>
          cases hv.left with
          | intro tag htagv =>
              have htag_lt_lower_e2 :
                  RealTheory.lt (taggedSum f p tag n)
                    (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) e2) := by
                have hvlt := hv.right
                rwa [htagv.right] at hvlt
              have hclose :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (RealTheory.sub (taggedSum f p tag n) I))
                    e2 :=
                hdelta.right n p tag htagv.left hmesh
              have hI_lt_tag_e2 :
                  RealTheory.lt I
                    (RealTheory.add (taggedSum f p tag n) e2) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_left_add_of_abs_sub_lt F hclose
              have htag_e2_lt_lower_e2_e2 :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.add (taggedSum f p tag n) e2)
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) e2) e2) :=
                RealTheory.add_lt_add_right htag_lt_lower_e2 e2
              have hI_lt_lower_e2_e2 :
                  RealTheory.lt I
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) e2) e2) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                  hI_lt_tag_e2 htag_e2_lt_lower_e2_e2
              have hadd :
                  RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) e2) e2 =
                    RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) eps := by
                rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
                have he2_add : RealTheory.add e2 e2 = eps := by
                  dsimp [e2]
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps
                rw [he2_add]
              have hI_lt_lower_eps :
                  RealTheory.lt I
                    (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) eps) := by
                rwa [hadd] at hI_lt_lower_e2_e2
              have hsub_I_lower :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub I (lowerSum f p n)) eps :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F
                  hI_lt_lower_eps
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_two_sided_sub_lt F
                hsub_lower_I hsub_I_lower

name: hasRiemannIntegral_upperDarbouxSumsTendTo
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_upperDarbouxSumsTendTo
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hI : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    UpperDarbouxSumsTendTo f a b I
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hI.left ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have he2_lt_eps : RealTheory.lt e2 eps := by
    dsimp [e2]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps
  cases hI.right e2 he2_pos with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro n p hp hmesh
      have hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
        taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
          (Exists.intro I hI)
      have hsup :
          forall k : Nat, k < n ->
            Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M) :=
        exists_hasCellSup_of_closedIntervalBounded_partition hbdd hp
      let tag0 := leftTags p
      have htag0 : TaggedPartition a b n p tag0 :=
        leftTags_taggedPartition hp
      have hclose0 :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.abs
              (RealTheory.sub (taggedSum f p tag0 n) I))
            e2 :=
        hdelta.right n p tag0 htag0 hmesh
      have hI_lt_tag0_e2 :
          RealTheory.lt I
            (RealTheory.add (taggedSum f p tag0 n) e2) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_left_add_of_abs_sub_lt F hclose0
      have htag0_le_upper :
          RealTheory.le (taggedSum f p tag0 n)
            (upperSum f p n) :=
        taggedSum_le_upperSum htag0 hsup
      have htag0_e2_le_upper_e2 :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.add (taggedSum f p tag0 n) e2)
            (RealTheory.add (upperSum f p n) e2) :=
        RealTheory.add_le_add_right htag0_le_upper e2
      have hI_lt_upper_e2 :
          RealTheory.lt I (RealTheory.add (upperSum f p n) e2) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
          hI_lt_tag0_e2 htag0_e2_le_upper_e2
      have hupper_e2_lt_upper_eps :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add (upperSum f p n) e2)
            (RealTheory.add (upperSum f p n) eps) :=
        RealTheory.add_lt_add_left he2_lt_eps (upperSum f p n)
      have hI_lt_upper_eps :
          RealTheory.lt I (RealTheory.add (upperSum f p n) eps) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
          hI_lt_upper_e2 hupper_e2_lt_upper_eps
      have hsub_I_upper :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub I (upperSum f p n)) eps :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hI_lt_upper_eps
      have hlub :
          IsLeastUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
            (FixedTaggedSumValueSet f a b p n)
            (upperSum f p n) :=
        upperSum_isLeastUpperBound_fixedTaggedSumValueSet hp hsup
      have hupper_sub_e2_lt_upper :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) e2)
            (upperSum f p n) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F he2_pos
      cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.exists_lt_of_lt_lub F
          hlub hupper_sub_e2_lt_upper with
      | intro v hv =>
          cases hv.left with
          | intro tag htagv =>
              have hupper_sub_e2_lt_tag :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) e2)
                    (taggedSum f p tag n) := by
                have hvlt := hv.right
                rwa [htagv.right] at hvlt
              have hupper_lt_e2_tag :
                  RealTheory.lt (upperSum f p n)
                    (RealTheory.add e2 (taggedSum f p tag n)) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt F
                  hupper_sub_e2_lt_tag
              have hupper_lt_tag_e2 :
                  RealTheory.lt (upperSum f p n)
                    (RealTheory.add (taggedSum f p tag n) e2) := by
                rwa [RealTheory.add_comm e2 (taggedSum f p tag n)]
                  at hupper_lt_e2_tag
              have hclose :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.abs
                      (RealTheory.sub (taggedSum f p tag n) I))
                    e2 :=
                hdelta.right n p tag htagv.left hmesh
              have htag_lt_I_e2 :
                  RealTheory.lt (taggedSum f p tag n)
                    (RealTheory.add I e2) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt F hclose
              have htag_e2_lt_I_e2_e2 :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.add (taggedSum f p tag n) e2)
                    (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add I e2) e2) :=
                RealTheory.add_lt_add_right htag_lt_I_e2 e2
              have hupper_lt_I_e2_e2 :
                  RealTheory.lt (upperSum f p n)
                    (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add I e2) e2) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                  hupper_lt_tag_e2 htag_e2_lt_I_e2_e2
              have hadd :
                  RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add I e2) e2 =
                    RealTheory.add I eps := by
                rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
                have he2_add : RealTheory.add e2 e2 = eps := by
                  dsimp [e2]
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps
                rw [he2_add]
              have hupper_lt_I_eps :
                  RealTheory.lt (upperSum f p n)
                    (RealTheory.add I eps) := by
                rwa [hadd] at hupper_lt_I_e2_e2
              have hsub_upper_I :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) I) eps :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F
                  hupper_lt_I_eps
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_two_sided_sub_lt F
                hsub_upper_I hsub_I_upper

name: hasRiemannIntegral_darbouxSumsTendTo
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_darbouxSumsTendTo
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hI : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I) :
    DarbouxSumsTendTo f a b I
proof:
:=
  And.intro
    hI.left
    (And.intro
      (taggedRiemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
        (Exists.intro I hI))
      (And.intro
        (hasRiemannIntegral_lowerDarbouxSumsTendTo hI)
        (hasRiemannIntegral_upperDarbouxSumsTendTo hI)))

name: darbouxSumsTendTo_hasRiemannIntegral
statement:
theorem darbouxSumsTendTo_hasRiemannIntegral
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hD : DarbouxSumsTendTo f a b I) :
    HasRiemannIntegral f a b I
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hD.left ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have he2_lt_eps : RealTheory.lt e2 eps := by
    dsimp [e2]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps
  cases hD.right.right.left.right e2 he2_pos with
  | intro deltaL hdeltaL =>
      cases hD.right.right.right.right e2 he2_pos with
      | intro deltaU hdeltaU =>
          let delta := RealTheory.min deltaL deltaU
          have hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta := by
            dsimp [delta, RealTheory.min]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
              hdeltaL.left hdeltaU.left
          refine Exists.intro delta ?_
          refine And.intro hdelta_pos ?_
          intro n p tag htag hmesh
          have hmeshL : RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaL :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hmesh
              (RealTheory.min_le_left deltaL deltaU)
          have hmeshU : RealTheory.lt (mesh p n) deltaU :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hmesh
              (RealTheory.min_le_right deltaL deltaU)
          have hinf :
              forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m) :=
            exists_hasCellInf_of_closedIntervalBounded_partition
              hD.right.left htag.left
          have hsup :
              forall k : Nat, k < n ->
                Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M) :=
            exists_hasCellSup_of_closedIntervalBounded_partition
              hD.right.left htag.left
          have hlower_le_tag :
              RealTheory.le (lowerSum f p n)
                (taggedSum f p tag n) :=
            lowerSum_le_taggedSum htag hinf
          have htag_le_upper :
              RealTheory.le (taggedSum f p tag n)
                (upperSum f p n) :=
            taggedSum_le_upperSum htag hsup
          have hlower_close :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub (lowerSum f p n) I))
                e2 :=
            hdeltaL.right n p htag.left hmeshL
          have hupper_close :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs
                  (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) I))
                e2 :=
            hdeltaU.right n p htag.left hmeshU
          have hI_lt_lower_e2 :
              RealTheory.lt I
                (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) e2) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_left_add_of_abs_sub_lt F hlower_close
          have hlower_e2_le_tag_e2 :
              RealTheory.le
                (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) e2)
                (RealTheory.add (taggedSum f p tag n) e2) :=
            RealTheory.add_le_add_right hlower_le_tag e2
          have hI_lt_tag_e2 :
              RealTheory.lt I
                (RealTheory.add (taggedSum f p tag n) e2) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
              hI_lt_lower_e2 hlower_e2_le_tag_e2
          have htag_e2_lt_tag_eps :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.add (taggedSum f p tag n) e2)
                (RealTheory.add (taggedSum f p tag n) eps) :=
            RealTheory.add_lt_add_left he2_lt_eps
              (taggedSum f p tag n)
          have hI_lt_tag_eps :
              RealTheory.lt I
                (RealTheory.add (taggedSum f p tag n) eps) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
              hI_lt_tag_e2 htag_e2_lt_tag_eps
          have hsub_I_tag :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.sub I (taggedSum f p tag n)) eps :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hI_lt_tag_eps
          have hupper_lt_I_e2 :
              RealTheory.lt (upperSum f p n)
                (RealTheory.add I e2) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt F hupper_close
          have htag_lt_I_e2 :
              RealTheory.lt (taggedSum f p tag n)
                (RealTheory.add I e2) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
              htag_le_upper hupper_lt_I_e2
          have hI_e2_lt_I_eps :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.add I e2)
                (RealTheory.add I eps) :=
            RealTheory.add_lt_add_left he2_lt_eps I
          have htag_lt_I_eps :
              RealTheory.lt (taggedSum f p tag n)
                (RealTheory.add I eps) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
              htag_lt_I_e2 hI_e2_lt_I_eps
          have hsub_tag_I :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.sub (taggedSum f p tag n) I) eps :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F htag_lt_I_eps
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_two_sided_sub_lt F
            hsub_tag_I hsub_I_tag

name: hasRiemannIntegral_iff_darbouxSumsTendTo
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_iff_darbouxSumsTendTo

:=
  Iff.intro

name: lowerSum_le_taggedSum_le_upperSum
statement:
theorem lowerSum_le_taggedSum_le_upperSum
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hinf :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m))
    (hsup :
      forall k : Nat, k < n ->
        Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M)) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le (lowerSum f p n) (taggedSum f p tag n))
      (RealTheory.le (taggedSum f p tag n) (upperSum f p n))
proof:
:=
  And.intro
    (lowerSum_le_taggedSum htag hinf)
    (taggedSum_le_upperSum htag hsup)

name: lowerSum_le_upperSum_of_closedIntervalBounded
proof:
:= by
  let tag := leftTags p
  have htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag :=
    leftTags_taggedPartition hp
  have hbounds :
      And
        (RealTheory.le (lowerSum f p n) (taggedSum f p tag n))
        (RealTheory.le (taggedSum f p tag n) (upperSum f p n)) :=
    lowerSum_le_taggedSum_le_upperSum htag
      (exists_hasCellInf_of_closedIntervalBounded_partition hbdd hp)
      (exists_hasCellSup_of_closedIntervalBounded_partition hbdd hp)
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hbounds.left hbounds.right

name: lowerSum_le_upperSum_of_intervalPartitions
statement:
theorem lowerSum_le_upperSum_of_intervalPartitions
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {n₁ n₂ : Nat} {p₁ p₂ : Nat -> Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hp₁ : IntervalPartition a b n₁ p₁)
    (hp₂ : IntervalPartition a b n₂ p₂) :
    RealTheory.le (lowerSum f p₁ n₁) (upperSum f p₂ n₂)
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_commonTaggedBlockRefinement
      (leftTags_taggedPartition hp₁)
      (leftTags_taggedPartition hp₂) with
  | intro mergeCount hmergeCount =>
      cases hmergeCount with
      | intro merge hmerge =>
          cases hmerge with
          | intro mergeTag hmergeTag =>
              cases hmergeTag with
              | intro leftCut hleftCut =>
                  cases hleftCut with
                  | intro rightCut hcommon =>
                      have hmergeTagged :
                          TaggedPartition a b mergeCount merge mergeTag :=
                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_taggedPartition hcommon
                      have hmergePartition :
                          IntervalPartition a b mergeCount merge :=
                        hmergeTagged.left
                      have hleftRefines :
                          PartitionBlockRefines
                            merge mergeCount p₁ n₁ leftCut :=
                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_left_refines hcommon
                      have hrightRefines :
                          PartitionBlockRefines
                            merge mergeCount p₂ n₂ rightCut :=
                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_right_refines hcommon
                      have hleft :
                          RealTheory.le (lowerSum f p₁ n₁)
                            (lowerSum f merge mergeCount) :=
                        lowerSum_le_lowerSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                          hbdd hleftRefines hmergePartition hp₁
                      have hmiddle :
                          RealTheory.le (lowerSum f merge mergeCount)
                            (upperSum f merge mergeCount) :=
                        lowerSum_le_upperSum_of_closedIntervalBounded
                          hbdd hmergePartition
                      have hright :
                          RealTheory.le (upperSum f merge mergeCount)
                            (upperSum f p₂ n₂) :=
                        upperSum_le_upperSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                          hbdd hrightRefines hmergePartition hp₂
                      exact RealTheory.le_trans hleft
                        (RealTheory.le_trans hmiddle hright)

name: abs_taggedSum_sub_taggedSum_le_refinementSplitOscillationSum_of_preserves
statement:
private theorem abs_taggedSum_sub_taggedSum_le_refinementSplitOscillationSum_of_preserves
    {a b : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {q p fineTag coarseTag : Nat -> Point}
    {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat} {omega : Nat -> Point}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    (hfine : TaggedPartition a b m q fineTag)
    (hcoarse : TaggedPartition a b n p coarseTag)
    (hpreserve :
      RefinementTagsPreserveUnsplitBlocks fineTag coarseTag n cut)
    (homega :
      forall i : Nat, i < n -> IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (taggedSum f q fineTag m)
          (taggedSum f p coarseTag n)))
      (refinementSplitOscillationSum p n cut omega)
proof:
:= by
  let fineBlock := fun i : Nat =>
    refinementBlockTaggedSum f q fineTag cut i
  let coarseBlock := fun i : Nat =>
    coarseCellContribution f p coarseTag i
  let diff := fun i : Nat => RealTheory.sub (fineBlock i) (coarseBlock i)
  let bound := fun i : Nat =>
    RealTheory.mul (omega i) (refinementSplitCellLength p cut i)
  have hfine_sum :
      taggedSum f q fineTag m =
        RealTheory.finiteSum fineBlock n := by
    unfold fineBlock
    exact taggedSum_eq_finiteSum_refinementBlockTaggedSum href
  have hcoarse_sum :
      taggedSum f p coarseTag n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum coarseBlock n := by
    unfold coarseBlock
    exact taggedSum_eq_finiteSum_coarseCellContribution f p coarseTag n
  have htriangle :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum diff n))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.abs (diff i)) n) :=
    RealTheory.abs_finiteSum_le_finiteSum_abs diff n
  have hpoint :
      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (diff i)) (bound i) := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases hblock : refinementBlockLength cut i = 1
    · have heq : fineBlock i = coarseBlock i := by
        unfold fineBlock coarseBlock
        exact
          refinementBlockTaggedSum_eq_coarseCellContribution_of_blockLength_one_of_tag
            href hi hblock (hpreserve i hi hblock)
      have hdiff_zero : diff i = RealTheory.zero := by
        unfold diff
        rw [heq]
        rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg, RealTheory.add_neg]
      have hbound_zero : bound i = RealTheory.zero := by
        unfold bound refinementSplitCellLength
        rw [if_pos hblock]
        rw [RealTheory.mul_zero]
      rw [hdiff_zero, hbound_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg (RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero)]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
    · have hcell :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.abs (diff i))
            (RealTheory.mul (omega i) (cellLength p i)) := by
        unfold diff fineBlock coarseBlock
        exact abs_refinementBlockTaggedSum_sub_coarseContribution_le
          href hfine hcoarse hi (homega i hi)
      have hbound_cell :
          bound i = RealTheory.mul (omega i) (cellLength p i) := by
        unfold bound refinementSplitCellLength
        rw [if_neg hblock]
      rw [hbound_cell]
      exact hcell
  have hsum_point :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.abs (diff i)) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum bound n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.abs (diff i)) bound n hpoint
  rw [hfine_sum, hcoarse_sum]
  rw [<- RealTheory.finiteSum_sub fineBlock coarseBlock n]
  unfold refinementSplitOscillationSum
  change
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.finiteSum diff n))
      (RealTheory.finiteSum bound n)
  exact RealTheory.le_trans htriangle hsum_point

name: abs_taggedSum_refinementError_le_mul_of_splitLengthSum_le
statement:
private theorem abs_taggedSum_refinementError_le_mul_of_splitLengthSum_le
    {a b : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {q p fineTag coarseTag : Nat -> Point}
    {m n : Nat} {cut : Nat -> Nat} {omega : Nat -> Point}
    {Omega L : Point}
    (href : PartitionBlockRefines q m p n cut)
    (hfine : TaggedPartition a b m q fineTag)
    (hcoarse : TaggedPartition a b n p coarseTag)
    (hpreserve :
      RefinementTagsPreserveUnsplitBlocks fineTag coarseTag n cut)
    (homega : forall i : Nat, i < n -> IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i))
    (hOmega_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero Omega)
    (hOmega :
      forall i : Nat, i < n -> RealTheory.le (omega i) Omega)
    (hsplit :
      RealTheory.le (refinementSplitLengthSum p n cut) L) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (taggedSum f q fineTag m)
          (taggedSum f p coarseTag n)))
      (RealTheory.mul Omega L)
proof:
:= by
  exact RealTheory.le_trans
    (abs_taggedSum_sub_taggedSum_le_refinementSplitOscillationSum_of_preserves
      href hfine hcoarse hpreserve homega)
    (refinementSplitOscillationSum_le_mul_of_splitLengthSum_le
      hcoarse.left hOmega_nonneg hOmega hsplit)

name: abs_taggedSum_refinementError_le_mul_nat_mul_delta_of_injection
statement:
theorem abs_taggedSum_refinementError_le_mul_nat_mul_delta_of_injection
    {a b : Point} {f : Point -> Point}

name: abs_taggedSum_endpointMergeLeft_refinementError_le_mul_nat_mul_delta
statement:
private theorem abs_taggedSum_endpointMergeLeft_refinementError_le_mul_nat_mul_delta
    {a b : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {left right leftTag : Nat -> Point}
    {leftCount rightCount : Nat} {omega : Nat -> Point}
    {Omega delta : Point}
    (hleft : TaggedPartition a b leftCount left leftTag)
    (hright : IntervalPartition a b rightCount right)
    (homega :
      forall i : Nat, i < leftCount ->
        IsCellOscillation f left i (omega i))
    (hOmega_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero Omega)
    (hOmega :
      forall i : Nat, i < leftCount -> RealTheory.le (omega i) Omega)
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh left leftCount) delta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs
        (RealTheory.sub
          (taggedSum f
            (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)
            (refinementPreserveUnsplitTags
              (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)
              leftTag leftCount
              (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut left right leftCount rightCount))
            (leftCount + rightCount))
          (taggedSum f left leftTag leftCount)))
      (RealTheory.mul Omega
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat rightCount) delta))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpos : 0 < leftCount
  · have href :
        PartitionBlockRefines
          (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)
          (leftCount + rightCount) left leftCount
          (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut left right leftCount rightCount) :=
      endpointMergeLeft_partitionBlockRefines hleft.left hright hpos
    have hmergeI :
        IntervalPartition a b (leftCount + rightCount)
          (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount) :=
      endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition hleft.left hright
    have hmergeTagged :
        TaggedPartition a b (leftCount + rightCount)
          (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)
          (refinementPreserveUnsplitTags
            (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)
            leftTag leftCount
            (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut left right leftCount rightCount)) :=
      refinementPreserveUnsplitTags_taggedPartition
        href hmergeI hleft
    have hpreserve :
        RefinementTagsPreserveUnsplitBlocks
          (refinementPreserveUnsplitTags
            (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)
            leftTag leftCount
            (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut left right leftCount rightCount))
          leftTag leftCount
          (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut left right leftCount rightCount) :=
      refinementPreserveUnsplitTags_preserves href
    exact abs_taggedSum_refinementError_le_mul_of_splitLengthSum_le
      href hmergeTagged hleft hpreserve homega hOmega_nonneg hOmega
      (refinementSplitLengthSum_endpointMergeLeft_le_nat_mul_delta
        hleft.left hright hmesh)
  · have hcount : leftCount = 0 :=
      Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_not_gt hpos)
    have hab : a = b := by
      have hright_endpoint : left 0 = b := by
        have h := intervalPartition_right_endpoint hleft.left
        rwa [hcount] at h
      exact Eq.trans (Eq.symm (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hleft.left))
        hright_endpoint
    subst b
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    have hcoarse_zero :
        taggedSum f left leftTag leftCount = RealTheory.zero := by
      rw [hcount]
      unfold taggedSum
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
    have hmerge_zero :
        taggedSum f
            (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)
            (refinementPreserveUnsplitTags
              (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)
              leftTag leftCount
              (endpointMergeLeftBlockCut left right leftCount rightCount))
            (leftCount + rightCount) =
          RealTheory.zero := by
      unfold taggedSum
      apply RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero
      intro k hk
      rw [cellLength_eq_zero_of_degenerate
        (endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition hleft.left hright) hk]
      rw [RealTheory.mul_zero]
    have hdelta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero delta := by
      have hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta := by
        rw [<- mesh_zero left]
        rwa [hcount] at hmesh
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hdelta_pos
    have hrhs_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.mul Omega
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat rightCount) delta)) :=
      RealTheory.mul_nonneg hOmega_nonneg
        (RealTheory.mul_nonneg
          (RealTheory.nat_nonneg rightCount) hdelta_nonneg)
    rw [hmerge_zero, hcoarse_zero]
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (F.sub F.zero F.zero))
        (RealTheory.mul Omega
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat rightCount) delta))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F F.zero]
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.mul Omega
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat rightCount) delta))
    rw [RealTheory.abs_of_nonneg (RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero)]
    exact hrhs_nonneg

    {a b : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    {omega : Nat -> Point} {Omega delta : Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a b leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition a b rightCount right)
    (homega :

    (hOmega_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero Omega)
    (hOmega :
      forall i : Nat, i < leftCount -> RealTheory.le (omega i) Omega)
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh left leftCount) delta) :

      (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f left leftCount)
        (upperSum f (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)
          (leftCount + rightCount)))
      (RealTheory.mul Omega
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat rightCount) delta))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpos : 0 < leftCount
  · exact upperSum_refinementError_le_mul_of_splitLengthSum_le
      hbdd
      (endpointMergeLeft_partitionBlockRefines hleft hright hpos)
      (endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition hleft hright)
      hleft homega hOmega_nonneg hOmega
      (refinementSplitLengthSum_endpointMergeLeft_le_nat_mul_delta
        hleft hright hmesh)
  · have hcount : leftCount = 0 :=
      Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_not_gt hpos)
    have hab : a = b := by
      have hright_endpoint : left 0 = b := by
        have h := intervalPartition_right_endpoint hleft
        rwa [hcount] at h
      exact Eq.trans (Eq.symm (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hleft))
        hright_endpoint
    subst b
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    have hcoarse_zero :
        upperSum f left leftCount = RealTheory.zero :=
      upperSum_eq_zero_of_degenerate hleft
    have hfine_zero :
        upperSum f (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)
            (leftCount + rightCount) =
          RealTheory.zero :=
      upperSum_eq_zero_of_degenerate
        (endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition hleft hright)
    have hdelta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero delta := by
      have hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta := by
        rw [<- mesh_zero left]
        rwa [hcount] at hmesh
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hdelta_pos
    have hrhs_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.mul Omega
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat rightCount) delta)) :=
      RealTheory.mul_nonneg hOmega_nonneg
        (RealTheory.mul_nonneg
          (RealTheory.nat_nonneg rightCount) hdelta_nonneg)
    rw [hcoarse_zero, hfine_zero]
    change RealTheory.le (F.sub F.zero F.zero)
      (RealTheory.mul Omega
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat rightCount) delta))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F F.zero]
    exact hrhs_nonneg

statement:
theorem exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
    {C eps : Point}
    (hC : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul C delta) eps))
proof:
:= by
  cases RealTheory.exists_pos_eta_mul_lt_of_nonneg hC heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta (And.intro hdelta.left ?_)
      rw [RealTheory.mul_comm C delta]
      exact hdelta.right

name: exists_pos_delta_omega_nat_mul_lt
statement:
theorem exists_pos_delta_omega_nat_mul_lt
    {Omega eps : Point} {N : Nat}
    (hOmega_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero Omega)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun delta : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
          (RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.mul Omega
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N) delta))
            eps))
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeff :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul Omega (RealTheory.nat N)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_nonneg hOmega_nonneg (RealTheory.nat_nonneg N)
  cases RealTheory.exists_pos_eta_mul_lt_of_nonneg hcoeff heps with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta (And.intro hdelta.left ?_)
      have heq :
          RealTheory.mul Omega
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat N) delta) =
            RealTheory.mul delta
              (RealTheory.mul Omega (RealTheory.nat N)) := by
        rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]
        exact RealTheory.mul_comm
          (RealTheory.mul Omega (RealTheory.nat N)) delta
      rw [heq]
      exact hdelta.right

name: lowerSum_endpointMergeLeft_refinementError_le_mul_nat_mul_delta
statement:
theorem lowerSum_endpointMergeLeft_refinementError_le_mul_nat_mul_delta
    {a b : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {leftCount rightCount : Nat}
    {omega : Nat -> Point} {Omega delta : Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hleft : IntervalPartition a b leftCount left)
    (hright : IntervalPartition a b rightCount right)
    (homega :
      forall i : Nat, i < leftCount -> IsCellOscillation f left i (omega i))
    (hOmega_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero Omega)
    (hOmega :
      forall i : Nat, i < leftCount -> RealTheory.le (omega i) Omega)
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh left leftCount) delta) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub
        (lowerSum f (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)
          (leftCount + rightCount))
        (lowerSum f left leftCount))
      (RealTheory.mul Omega
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat rightCount) delta))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpos : 0 < leftCount
  · exact lowerSum_refinementError_le_mul_of_splitLengthSum_le
      hbdd
      (endpointMergeLeft_partitionBlockRefines hleft hright hpos)
      (endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition hleft hright)
      hleft homega hOmega_nonneg hOmega
      (refinementSplitLengthSum_endpointMergeLeft_le_nat_mul_delta
        hleft hright hmesh)
  · have hcount : leftCount = 0 :=
      Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_not_gt hpos)
    have hab : a = b := by
      have hright_endpoint : left 0 = b := by
        have h := intervalPartition_right_endpoint hleft
        rwa [hcount] at h
      exact Eq.trans (Eq.symm (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hleft))
        hright_endpoint
    subst b
    let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
    have hfine_zero :
        lowerSum f (endpointMergePoint left right leftCount rightCount)
            (leftCount + rightCount) =
          RealTheory.zero :=
      lowerSum_eq_zero_of_degenerate
        (endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition hleft hright)
    have hcoarse_zero :
        lowerSum f left leftCount = RealTheory.zero :=
      lowerSum_eq_zero_of_degenerate hleft
    have hdelta_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero delta := by
      have hdelta_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta := by
        rw [<- mesh_zero left]
        rwa [hcount] at hmesh
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hdelta_pos
    have hrhs_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.mul Omega
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat rightCount) delta)) :=
      RealTheory.mul_nonneg hOmega_nonneg
        (RealTheory.mul_nonneg
          (RealTheory.nat_nonneg rightCount) hdelta_nonneg)
    rw [hfine_zero, hcoarse_zero]
    change RealTheory.le (F.sub F.zero F.zero)
      (RealTheory.mul Omega
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat rightCount) delta))
    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F F.zero]
    exact hrhs_nonneg

name: hasLowerDarbouxIntegral_lowerDarbouxSumsTendTo_of_closedIntervalOscillation
statement:
theorem hasLowerDarbouxIntegral_lowerDarbouxSumsTendTo_of_closedIntervalOscillation
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I Omega : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hOmega : IsClosedIntervalOscillation f a b Omega)
    (hI : HasLowerDarbouxIntegral f a b I) :
    LowerDarbouxSumsTendTo f a b I
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hab ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have he2_lt_eps : RealTheory.lt e2 eps := by
    dsimp [e2]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps
  cases exists_lowerSum_gt_sub_of_hasLowerDarbouxIntegral
      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (I := I) hI he2_pos with
  | intro baseCount hbase =>
      cases hbase with
      | intro base hbase =>
          have hbase_part : IntervalPartition a b baseCount base :=
            hbase.left
          have hnear_left :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub I e2)
                (lowerSum f base baseCount) :=
            hbase.right.left
          have hclosed_ne :
              Exists (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) := by
            refine Exists.intro a ?_
            exact And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a)
              (intervalPartition_interval_le hbase_part)
          have hOmega_nonneg :
              RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero Omega :=
            isOscillationOn_nonnegative hOmega hclosed_ne
          cases exists_pos_delta_omega_nat_mul_lt
              (Omega := Omega) (eps := e2) (N := baseCount)
              hOmega_nonneg he2_pos with
          | intro delta hdelta =>
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
              intro n p hp hmesh
              have hp_le_I :
                  RealTheory.le (lowerSum f p n) I :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F hI
                  (lowerSum_mem_lowerDarbouxSumValueSet hp)
              have hsub_p_I :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.sub (lowerSum f p n) I) eps := by
                have hnonpos :
                    RealTheory.le
                      (RealTheory.sub (lowerSum f p n) I)
                      RealTheory.zero :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hp_le_I
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                  hnonpos heps
              have hsub_I_p :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.sub I (lowerSum f p n)) eps := by
                by_cases hbase_pos : 0 < baseCount
                · let merge :=
                    endpointMergePoint p base n baseCount
                  have hmerge_part :
                      IntervalPartition a b (n + baseCount) merge :=
                    endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition hp hbase_part
                  have href_base :
                      PartitionBlockRefines merge (n + baseCount)
                        base baseCount
                        (endpointMergeRightBlockCut p base n baseCount) :=
                    endpointMergeRight_partitionBlockRefines
                      hp hbase_part hbase_pos
                  have hbase_le_merge :
                      RealTheory.le (lowerSum f base baseCount)
                        (lowerSum f merge (n + baseCount)) :=
                    lowerSum_le_lowerSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                      hbdd href_base hmerge_part hbase_part
                  have hI_lt_base_e2 :
                      RealTheory.lt I
                        (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f base baseCount) e2) := by
                    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt
                      F hnear_left
                    change F.lt I
                      (F.add e2 (lowerSum f base baseCount)) at h
                    rwa [F.add_comm e2 (lowerSum f base baseCount)] at h
                  have hbase_e2_le_merge_e2 :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f base baseCount) e2)
                        (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f merge (n + baseCount)) e2) :=
                    RealTheory.add_le_add_right hbase_le_merge e2
                  have hI_lt_merge_e2 :
                      RealTheory.lt I
                        (RealTheory.add
                          (lowerSum f merge (n + baseCount)) e2) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
                      hI_lt_base_e2 hbase_e2_le_merge_e2
                  let omega := fun i : Nat =>
                    if hi : i < n then
                      Classical.choose
                        (exists_isCellOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded
                          (f := f) (a := a) (b := b)
                          (n := n) (k := i) (p := p)
                          hbdd hp hi)
                    else
                      RealTheory.zero
                  have homega :
                      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
                        IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i) := by
                    intro i hi
                    unfold omega
                    simp [hi]
                    exact Classical.choose_spec
                      (exists_isCellOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded
                        (f := f) (a := a) (b := b)
                        (n := n) (k := i) (p := p)
                        hbdd hp hi)
                  have hcell_le :
                      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
                        RealTheory.le (omega i) Omega := by
                    intro i hi
                    exact isCellOscillation_le_closedIntervalOscillation
                      hp hi (homega i hi) hOmega
                  have herr_le :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.sub
                          (lowerSum f merge (n + baseCount))
                          (lowerSum f p n))
                        (RealTheory.mul Omega
                          (RealTheory.mul
                            (RealTheory.nat baseCount) delta)) :=
                    lowerSum_endpointMergeLeft_refinementError_le_mul_nat_mul_delta
                      hbdd hp hbase_part homega
                      hOmega_nonneg hcell_le hmesh
                  have herr_lt :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.sub
                          (lowerSum f merge (n + baseCount))
                          (lowerSum f p n))
                        e2 :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                      herr_le hdelta.right
                  have hmerge_lt_p_e2 :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (lowerSum f merge (n + baseCount))
                        (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) e2) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt F herr_lt
                  have hmerge_e2_lt_p_e2_e2 :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.add
                          (lowerSum f merge (n + baseCount)) e2)
                        (RealTheory.add
                          (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) e2) e2) :=
                    RealTheory.add_lt_add_right hmerge_lt_p_e2 e2
                  have hI_lt_p_e2_e2 :
                      RealTheory.lt I
                        (RealTheory.add
                          (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) e2) e2) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                      hI_lt_merge_e2 hmerge_e2_lt_p_e2_e2
                  have hadd :
                      RealTheory.add
                          (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) e2) e2 =
                        RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) eps := by
                    rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
                    have he2_add : RealTheory.add e2 e2 = eps := by
                      dsimp [e2]
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps
                    rw [he2_add]
                  have hI_lt_p_eps :
                      RealTheory.lt I
                        (RealTheory.add (lowerSum f p n) eps) := by
                    rwa [hadd] at hI_lt_p_e2_e2
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F
                    hI_lt_p_eps
                · have hbase_zero : baseCount = 0 :=
                    Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
                      (Nat.le_of_not_gt hbase_pos)
                  have hab : a = b := by
                    have hright : base 0 = b := by
                      have h := intervalPartition_right_endpoint hbase_part
                      rwa [hbase_zero] at h
                    exact Eq.trans
                      (Eq.symm (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hbase_part))
                      hright
                  subst b
                  have hp_zero : lowerSum f p n = RealTheory.zero :=
                    lowerSum_eq_zero_of_degenerate hp
                  have hbase_lower_zero :
                      lowerSum f base baseCount = RealTheory.zero :=
                    lowerSum_eq_zero_of_degenerate hbase_part
                  have hI_sub_e2_lt_zero :
                      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub I e2)
                        RealTheory.zero := by
                    rwa [hbase_lower_zero] at hnear_left
                  have hI_lt_e2 :
                      RealTheory.lt I e2 := by
                    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt
                      F hI_sub_e2_lt_zero
                    change F.lt I (F.add e2 F.zero) at h
                    rwa [F.add_zero] at h
                  have hI_lt_eps : RealTheory.lt I eps :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                      hI_lt_e2 he2_lt_eps
                  rw [hp_zero]
                  change F.lt (F.sub I F.zero) eps
                  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_zero F I]
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_two_sided_sub_lt F
                hsub_p_I hsub_I_p

name: hasLowerDarbouxIntegral_lowerDarbouxSumsTendTo
statement:
theorem hasLowerDarbouxIntegral_lowerDarbouxSumsTendTo
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}

  | intro baseCount hbase =>

      | intro base hbase =>
          have hbase_part : IntervalPartition a b baseCount base :=
            hbase.left
          have hclosed_ne :
              Exists (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) := by
            refine Exists.intro a ?_
            exact And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a)
              (intervalPartition_interval_le hbase_part)
          cases exists_isClosedIntervalOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded

name: hasUpperDarbouxIntegral_upperDarbouxSumsTendTo_of_closedIntervalOscillation
statement:
theorem hasUpperDarbouxIntegral_upperDarbouxSumsTendTo_of_closedIntervalOscillation
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I Omega : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hOmega : IsClosedIntervalOscillation f a b Omega)
    (hI : HasUpperDarbouxIntegral f a b I) :
    UpperDarbouxSumsTendTo f a b I
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro hab ?_
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  have he2_lt_eps : RealTheory.lt e2 eps := by
    dsimp [e2]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F heps
  cases exists_upperSum_lt_add_of_hasUpperDarbouxIntegral
      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (I := I) hI he2_pos with
  | intro baseCount hbase =>
      cases hbase with
      | intro base hbase =>
          have hbase_part : IntervalPartition a b baseCount base :=
            hbase.left
          have hnear_right :
              RealTheory.lt (upperSum f base baseCount)
                (RealTheory.add I e2) :=
            hbase.right.right
          have hclosed_ne :
              Exists (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) := by
            refine Exists.intro a ?_
            exact And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl a)
              (intervalPartition_interval_le hbase_part)
          have hOmega_nonneg :
              RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero Omega :=
            isOscillationOn_nonnegative hOmega hclosed_ne
          cases exists_pos_delta_omega_nat_mul_lt
              (Omega := Omega) (eps := e2) (N := baseCount)
              hOmega_nonneg he2_pos with
          | intro delta hdelta =>
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
              intro n p hp hmesh
              have hI_le_p :
                  RealTheory.le I (upperSum f p n) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.glb_le_of_mem F hI
                  (upperSum_mem_upperDarbouxSumValueSet hp)
              have hsub_I_p :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.sub I (upperSum f p n)) eps := by
                have hnonpos :
                    RealTheory.le
                      (RealTheory.sub I (upperSum f p n))
                      RealTheory.zero :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonpos_of_le F hI_le_p
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                  hnonpos heps
              have hsub_p_I :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) I) eps := by
                by_cases hbase_pos : 0 < baseCount
                · let merge :=
                    endpointMergePoint p base n baseCount
                  have hmerge_part :
                      IntervalPartition a b (n + baseCount) merge :=
                    endpointMergePoint_intervalPartition hp hbase_part
                  have href_base :
                      PartitionBlockRefines merge (n + baseCount)
                        base baseCount
                        (endpointMergeRightBlockCut p base n baseCount) :=
                    endpointMergeRight_partitionBlockRefines
                      hp hbase_part hbase_pos
                  have hmerge_le_base :
                      RealTheory.le (upperSum f merge (n + baseCount))
                        (upperSum f base baseCount) :=
                    upperSum_le_upperSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                      hbdd href_base hmerge_part hbase_part
                  have hmerge_lt_I_e2 :
                      RealTheory.lt (upperSum f merge (n + baseCount))
                        (RealTheory.add I e2) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                      hmerge_le_base hnear_right
                  let omega := fun i : Nat =>
                    if hi : i < n then
                      Classical.choose
                        (exists_isCellOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded
                          (f := f) (a := a) (b := b)
                          (n := n) (k := i) (p := p)
                          hbdd hp hi)
                    else
                      RealTheory.zero
                  have homega :
                      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
                        IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i) := by
                    intro i hi
                    unfold omega
                    simp [hi]
                    exact Classical.choose_spec
                      (exists_isCellOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded
                        (f := f) (a := a) (b := b)
                        (n := n) (k := i) (p := p)
                        hbdd hp hi)
                  have hcell_le :
                      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
                        RealTheory.le (omega i) Omega := by
                    intro i hi
                    exact isCellOscillation_le_closedIntervalOscillation
                      hp hi (homega i hi) hOmega
                  have herr_le :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n)
                          (upperSum f merge (n + baseCount)))
                        (RealTheory.mul Omega
                          (RealTheory.mul
                            (RealTheory.nat baseCount) delta)) :=
                    upperSum_endpointMergeLeft_refinementError_le_mul_nat_mul_delta
                      hbdd hp hbase_part homega
                      hOmega_nonneg hcell_le hmesh
                  have herr_lt :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n)
                          (upperSum f merge (n + baseCount)))
                        e2 :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
                      herr_le hdelta.right
                  have hp_lt_merge_e2 :
                      RealTheory.lt (upperSum f p n)
                        (RealTheory.add
                          (upperSum f merge (n + baseCount)) e2) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt F herr_lt
                  have hmerge_e2_lt_I_e2_e2 :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.add
                          (upperSum f merge (n + baseCount)) e2)
                        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add I e2) e2) :=
                    RealTheory.add_lt_add_right hmerge_lt_I_e2 e2
                  have hp_lt_I_e2_e2 :
                      RealTheory.lt (upperSum f p n)
                        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add I e2) e2) :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                      hp_lt_merge_e2 hmerge_e2_lt_I_e2_e2
                  have hadd :
                      RealTheory.add (RealTheory.add I e2) e2 =
                        RealTheory.add I eps := by
                    rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
                    have he2_add : RealTheory.add e2 e2 = eps := by
                      dsimp [e2]
                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps
                    rw [he2_add]
                  have hp_lt_I_eps :
                      RealTheory.lt (upperSum f p n)
                        (RealTheory.add I eps) := by
                    rwa [hadd] at hp_lt_I_e2_e2
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F
                    hp_lt_I_eps
                · have hbase_zero : baseCount = 0 :=
                    Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
                      (Nat.le_of_not_gt hbase_pos)
                  have hab : a = b := by
                    have hright : base 0 = b := by
                      have h := intervalPartition_right_endpoint hbase_part
                      rwa [hbase_zero] at h
                    exact Eq.trans
                      (Eq.symm (intervalPartition_left_endpoint hbase_part))
                      hright
                  subst b
                  have hp_zero : upperSum f p n = RealTheory.zero :=
                    upperSum_eq_zero_of_degenerate hp
                  have hbase_upper_zero :
                      upperSum f base baseCount = RealTheory.zero :=
                    upperSum_eq_zero_of_degenerate hbase_part
                  have hzero_lt_I_e2 :
                      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                        (RealTheory.add I e2) := by
                    rwa [hbase_upper_zero] at hnear_right
                  have hneg_e2_lt_I :
                      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.neg e2) I := by
                    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right
                      F hzero_lt_I_e2 (RealTheory.neg e2)
                    change F.lt
                      (F.add F.zero (F.neg e2))
                      (F.add (F.add I e2) (F.neg e2)) at h
                    have hrhs :
                        F.add (F.add I e2) (F.neg e2) = I :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_neg_cancel_right F I e2
                    rwa [F.zero_add, hrhs] at h
                  have hneg_eps_lt_I :
                      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.neg eps) I := by
                    have hneg_lt : RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.neg eps) (RealTheory.neg e2) :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F he2_lt_eps
                    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                      hneg_lt hneg_e2_lt_I
                  rw [hp_zero]
                  change F.lt (F.sub F.zero I) eps
                  have hlt : F.lt (F.neg I) eps := by
                    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F
                      hneg_eps_lt_I
                    change F.lt (F.neg I) (F.neg (F.neg eps)) at h
                    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F eps] at h
                  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_sub F I]
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_two_sided_sub_lt F
                hsub_p_I hsub_I_p

statement:
theorem hasDarbouxIntegral_abs_le_bound_mul_length
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I M : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hfI : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I)

    (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral hf_bdd hfI) hM

name: upperSum_isUpperBound_lowerDarbouxSumValueSet
statement:
theorem upperSum_isUpperBound_lowerDarbouxSumValueSet
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)

    IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
      (LowerDarbouxSumValueSet f a b) (upperSum f p n)
proof:
:= by

      cases hn₁ with

name: lowerDarbouxIntegral_isLowerBound_upperDarbouxSumValueSet
statement:
theorem lowerDarbouxIntegral_isLowerBound_upperDarbouxSumValueSet

          have hupper :

            upperSum_isUpperBound_lowerDarbouxSumValueSet hbdd hp_part

theorem lowerDarbouxIntegral_le_upperDarbouxIntegral
