name: upperDarbouxIntegral_le_lowerDarbouxIntegral_of_darbouxGapSmall
statement:
theorem upperDarbouxIntegral_le_lowerDarbouxIntegral_of_darbouxGapSmall
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b Il Iu : Point}
    (hlower : HasLowerDarbouxIntegral f a b Il)
    (hupper : HasUpperDarbouxIntegral f a b Iu)
    (hsmall : DarbouxGapSmall f a b) :
    RealTheory.le Iu Il
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hle : RealTheory.le Iu Il
  · exact hle
  · have hIl_le_Iu : RealTheory.le Il Iu := by
      cases RealTheory.le_total Il Iu with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr hIu_le_Il =>
          exact False.elim (hle hIu_le_Il)
    have hlt : RealTheory.lt Il Iu :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hIl_le_Iu hle
    let gap := RealTheory.sub Iu Il
    have hgap_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero gap := by
      dsimp [gap]
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hlt
    cases hsmall gap hgap_pos with
    | intro n hn =>
        cases hn with
        | intro p hp =>
            have hp_part : IntervalPartition a b n p := hp.left
            have hgap_lt :
                RealTheory.lt
                  (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))
                  gap :=
              hp.right
            have hIu_le_upper :
                RealTheory.le Iu (upperSum f p n) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.glb_le_of_mem F hupper
                (upperSum_mem_upperDarbouxSumValueSet hp_part)
            have hlower_le_Il :
                RealTheory.le (lowerSum f p n) Il :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem F hlower
                (lowerSum_mem_lowerDarbouxSumValueSet hp_part)
            have hdiff_le :
                RealTheory.le
                  (RealTheory.sub Iu Il)
                  (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n)) :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
                hIu_le_upper hlower_le_Il
            have hbad :
                RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub Iu Il) gap :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hdiff_le hgap_lt
            change F.lt gap gap at hbad
            exact False.elim (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F gap hbad)

name: lowerDarbouxIntegral_eq_upperDarbouxIntegral_of_darbouxGapSmall
statement:
theorem lowerDarbouxIntegral_eq_upperDarbouxIntegral_of_darbouxGapSmall
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b Il Iu : Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hlower : HasLowerDarbouxIntegral f a b Il)
    (hupper : HasUpperDarbouxIntegral f a b Iu)
    (hsmall : DarbouxGapSmall f a b) :
    Il = Iu
proof:
:= by
  exact RealTheory.le_antisymm
    (lowerDarbouxIntegral_le_upperDarbouxIntegral hbdd hlower hupper)
    (upperDarbouxIntegral_le_lowerDarbouxIntegral_of_darbouxGapSmall
      hlower hupper hsmall)

name: darbouxGapSmall_of_hasDarbouxIntegral
statement:
theorem darbouxGapSmall_of_hasDarbouxIntegral
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hI : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I) :
    DarbouxGapSmall f a b
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  cases exists_lowerSum_gt_sub_of_hasLowerDarbouxIntegral
      (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (I := I) hI.left he2_pos with
  | intro lowerCount hlowerChoice =>
      cases hlowerChoice with
      | intro lowerPart hlowerChoice =>
          have hlowerPart :
              IntervalPartition a b lowerCount lowerPart :=
            hlowerChoice.left
          have hnearLower :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub I e2)
                (lowerSum f lowerPart lowerCount) :=
            hlowerChoice.right.left
          cases exists_upperSum_lt_add_of_hasUpperDarbouxIntegral
              (f := f) (a := a) (b := b) (I := I)
              hI.right he2_pos with
          | intro upperCount hupperChoice =>
              cases hupperChoice with
              | intro upperPart hupperChoice =>
                  have hupperPart :
                      IntervalPartition a b upperCount upperPart :=
                    hupperChoice.left
                  have hnearUpper :
                      RealTheory.lt (upperSum f upperPart upperCount)
                        (RealTheory.add I e2) :=
                    hupperChoice.right.right
                  cases exists_commonTaggedBlockRefinement
                      (leftTags_taggedPartition hlowerPart)
                      (leftTags_taggedPartition hupperPart) with
                  | intro mergeCount hmergeCount =>
                      cases hmergeCount with
                      | intro merge hmerge =>
                          cases hmerge with
                          | intro mergeTag hmergeTag =>
                              cases hmergeTag with
                              | intro lowerCut hlowerCut =>
                                  cases hlowerCut with
                                  | intro upperCut hcommon =>
                                      have hmergeTagged :
                                          TaggedPartition a b mergeCount
                                            merge mergeTag :=
                                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_taggedPartition
                                          hcommon
                                      have hmergePart :
                                          IntervalPartition a b mergeCount
                                            merge :=
                                        hmergeTagged.left
                                      have hlowerRefines :
                                          PartitionBlockRefines
                                            merge mergeCount lowerPart
                                            lowerCount lowerCut :=
                                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_left_refines
                                          hcommon
                                      have hupperRefines :
                                          PartitionBlockRefines
                                            merge mergeCount upperPart
                                            upperCount upperCut :=
                                        commonTaggedBlockRefinement_right_refines
                                          hcommon
                                      have hlowerMono :
                                          RealTheory.le
                                            (lowerSum f lowerPart
                                              lowerCount)
                                            (lowerSum f merge
                                              mergeCount) :=
                                        lowerSum_le_lowerSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                                          hbdd hlowerRefines hmergePart
                                          hlowerPart
                                      have hupperMono :
                                          RealTheory.le
                                            (upperSum f merge
                                              mergeCount)
                                            (upperSum f upperPart
                                              upperCount) :=
                                        upperSum_le_upperSum_of_partitionBlockRefines
                                          hbdd hupperRefines hmergePart
                                          hupperPart
                                      have hgapRefines :
                                          RealTheory.le
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (upperSum f merge mergeCount)
                                              (lowerSum f merge mergeCount))
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (upperSum f upperPart
                                                upperCount)
                                              (lowerSum f lowerPart
                                                lowerCount)) :=
                                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
                                          F hupperMono hlowerMono
                                      have hI_lt_lower_e2 :
                                          RealTheory.lt I
                                            (RealTheory.add
                                              (lowerSum f lowerPart
                                                lowerCount)
                                              e2) := by
                                        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt
                                          F hnearLower
                                        change F.lt I
                                          (F.add e2
                                            (lowerSum f lowerPart
                                              lowerCount)) at h
                                        rwa [F.add_comm e2
                                          (lowerSum f lowerPart
                                            lowerCount)] at h
                                      have hI_e2_lt_lower_e2_e2 :
                                          RealTheory.lt
                                            (RealTheory.add I e2)
                                            (RealTheory.add
                                              (RealTheory.add
                                                (lowerSum f lowerPart
                                                  lowerCount)
                                                e2)
                                              e2) :=
                                        RealTheory.add_lt_add_right
                                          hI_lt_lower_e2 e2
                                      have hupper_lt_lower_e2_e2 :
                                          RealTheory.lt
                                            (upperSum f upperPart
                                              upperCount)
                                            (RealTheory.add
                                              (RealTheory.add
                                                (lowerSum f lowerPart
                                                  lowerCount)
                                                e2)
                                              e2) :=
                                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
                                          hnearUpper hI_e2_lt_lower_e2_e2
                                      have hadd :
                                          RealTheory.add
                                              (RealTheory.add
                                                (lowerSum f lowerPart
                                                  lowerCount)
                                                e2)
                                              e2 =
                                            RealTheory.add
                                              (lowerSum f lowerPart
                                                lowerCount)
                                              eps := by
                                        rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
                                        have he2_add :
                                            RealTheory.add e2 e2 = eps := by
                                          dsimp [e2]
                                          exact
                                            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                                              F eps
                                        rw [he2_add]
                                      have hupper_lt_lower_eps :
                                          RealTheory.lt
                                            (upperSum f upperPart
                                              upperCount)
                                            (RealTheory.add
                                              (lowerSum f lowerPart
                                                lowerCount)
                                              eps) := by
                                        rwa [hadd] at hupper_lt_lower_e2_e2
                                      have hbaseGap :
                                          RealTheory.lt
                                            (RealTheory.sub
                                              (upperSum f upperPart
                                                upperCount)
                                              (lowerSum f lowerPart
                                                lowerCount))
                                            eps :=
                                        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add
                                          F hupper_lt_lower_eps
                                      refine Exists.intro mergeCount ?_
                                      refine Exists.intro merge ?_
                                      refine And.intro hmergePart ?_
                                      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                        F hgapRefines hbaseGap

name: exists_hasLowerDarbouxIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_hasLowerDarbouxIntegral
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b) :
    Exists (fun Il : Point => HasLowerDarbouxIntegral f a b Il)
proof:
:= by
  let base := twoPointPartition a b
  have hbase : IntervalPartition a b 1 base :=
    twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hab
  have hne : Exists (LowerDarbouxSumValueSet f a b) :=
    Exists.intro (lowerSum f base 1)
      (lowerSum_mem_lowerDarbouxSumValueSet hbase)
  have hbddAbove :
      Exists
        (IsUpperBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (LowerDarbouxSumValueSet f a b)) :=
    Exists.intro (upperSum f base 1)
      (upperSum_isUpperBound_lowerDarbouxSumValueSet hbdd hbase)
  exact RealTheory.exists_lub
    (LowerDarbouxSumValueSet f a b) hne hbddAbove

name: exists_hasUpperDarbouxIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_hasUpperDarbouxIntegral
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b) :
    Exists (fun Iu : Point => HasUpperDarbouxIntegral f a b Iu)
proof:
:= by
  let base := twoPointPartition a b
  have hbase : IntervalPartition a b 1 base :=
    twoPointPartition_intervalPartition hab
  have hne : Exists (UpperDarbouxSumValueSet f a b) :=
    Exists.intro (upperSum f base 1)
      (upperSum_mem_upperDarbouxSumValueSet hbase)
  have hbddBelow :
      Exists
        (IsLowerBound RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.le
          (UpperDarbouxSumValueSet f a b)) := by
    refine Exists.intro (lowerSum f base 1) ?_
    intro v hv
    cases hv with
    | intro n hn =>
        cases hn with
        | intro p hp =>
            have hpPart : IntervalPartition a b n p := hp.left
            have hvEq : v = upperSum f p n := hp.right
            rw [hvEq]
            exact lowerSum_le_upperSum_of_intervalPartitions
              hbdd hbase hpPart
  exact RealTheory.exists_glb
    (UpperDarbouxSumValueSet f a b) hne hbddBelow

name: exists_hasDarbouxIntegrals
statement:
theorem exists_hasDarbouxIntegrals
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b) :
    Exists
      (fun Il : Point =>
        Exists
          (fun Iu : Point =>
            And
              (HasLowerDarbouxIntegral f a b Il)
              (HasUpperDarbouxIntegral f a b Iu)))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_hasLowerDarbouxIntegral hab hbdd with
  | intro Il hlower =>
      cases exists_hasUpperDarbouxIntegral hab hbdd with
      | intro Iu hupper =>
          exact Exists.intro Il
            (Exists.intro Iu (And.intro hlower hupper))

name: exists_hasDarbouxIntegral_of_darbouxGapSmall
statement:
theorem exists_hasDarbouxIntegral_of_darbouxGapSmall
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hsmall : DarbouxGapSmall f a b) :
    Exists (fun I : Point => HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I)
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_hasDarbouxIntegrals hab hbdd with
  | intro Il hIl =>
      cases hIl with
      | intro Iu hIu =>
          have heq : Il = Iu :=
            lowerDarbouxIntegral_eq_upperDarbouxIntegral_of_darbouxGapSmall
              hbdd hIu.left hIu.right hsmall
          subst Iu
          exact Exists.intro Il (And.intro hIu.left hIu.right)

name: sub_add_eq_add_sub_real
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  change
    F.add (F.sub x y) z =
      F.add x (F.sub z y)
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [F.add_assoc]
  rw [F.add_comm (F.neg y) z]

name: sub_mul_add_mul_eq_mul_add_mul_sub_real
statement:
private theorem sub_mul_add_mul_eq_mul_add_mul_sub_real
    (x y z t : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x y) z)
      (RealTheory.mul y t) =
    RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.mul x z)
      (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.sub t z))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  calc
    RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x y) z)
        (RealTheory.mul y t) =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul x z) (RealTheory.mul y z))
        (RealTheory.mul y t) := by
        change
          F.add (F.mul (F.sub x y) z) (F.mul y t) =
            F.add (F.sub (F.mul x z) (F.mul y z)) (F.mul y t)
        rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F x y z]
    _ =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul x z)
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul y t) (RealTheory.mul y z)) :=
        sub_add_eq_add_sub_real
          (RealTheory.mul x z) (RealTheory.mul y z)
          (RealTheory.mul y t)
    _ =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul x z)
        (RealTheory.mul y (RealTheory.sub t z)) := by
        change
          F.add (F.mul x z) (F.sub (F.mul y t) (F.mul y z)) =
            F.add (F.mul x z) (F.mul y (F.sub t z))
        rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F y t z]

name: rightEndpointSub_nonnegative_of_decreasing

name: hasDarbouxIntegral_tail_of_prefix_primitive
statement:
private theorem hasDarbouxIntegral_tail_of_prefix_primitive
    {f F : Point -> Point} {a c b : Point}
    (hac : RealTheory.le a c)
    (hcb : RealTheory.le c b)
    (hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hF_prefix :
      forall x : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
        HasDarbouxIntegral f a x (F x)) :
    HasDarbouxIntegral f c b
      (RealTheory.sub (F b) (F c))
proof:
:= by
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b := RealTheory.le_trans hac hcb
  have hc_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b c :=
    And.intro hac hcb
  have hb_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab
  have hFb : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b (F b) :=
    hF_prefix b hb_mem
  have hFc : HasDarbouxIntegral f a c (F c) :=
    hF_prefix c hc_mem
  have hf_ab : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_of_hasDarbouxIntegral hf_bdd hFb
  have hleft_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a c :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
      (riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_left hac hcb hf_ab)
  have hdecomp :
      Exists
        (fun I : Point =>
          Exists
            (fun J : Point =>
              And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a c I)
                (And (HasDarbouxIntegral f c b J)
                  (F b = RealTheory.add I J)))) :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_decomposition_ordered
      hac hcb hf_ab hFb
  cases hdecomp with
  | intro I hI =>
      cases hI with
      | intro J hJ =>
          have hI_eq : I = F c :=
            hasRiemannIntegral_unique
              (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                hleft_bdd hJ.left)
              (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                hleft_bdd hFc)
          have hFb_eq :
              F b = RealTheory.add (F c) J := by
            rw [<- hI_eq]
            exact hJ.right.right
          have hFb_eq_comm :
              F b = RealTheory.add J (F c) := by
            rw [hFb_eq, RealTheory.add_comm]
          have hJ_eq :
              J = RealTheory.sub (F b) (F c) :=
            RealTheory.eq_sub_of_eq_add_right hFb_eq_comm
          rw [<- hJ_eq]
          exact hJ.right.left

name: exists_point_hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_bonnet_explicit
statement:
private theorem exists_point_hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_bonnet_explicit
    {f g F : Point -> Point} {a b I W : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hfw_bdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded
        (MulFun f
          (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (g x) (g b))) a b)
    (hfwI :
      HasDarbouxIntegral
        (MulFun f
          (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (g x) (g b))) a b W)
    (hF_cont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F)
    (hF_prefix :
      forall x : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
        HasDarbouxIntegral f a x (F x))
    (hg_decr :
      FunctionDecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g)
    (hI_decomp :
      I = RealTheory.add W
        (RealTheory.mul (g b) (F b))) :
    Exists fun xi : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b xi)
        (And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a xi (F xi))
          (And
            (HasDarbouxIntegral f xi b
              (RealTheory.sub (F b) (F xi)))
            (I =
              RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.mul (g a) (F xi))
                (RealTheory.mul (g b)
                  (RealTheory.sub (F b) (F xi))))))
proof:
:= by
  cases RiemannInternal.exists_point_hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight
      (f := f)
      (g := fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (g x) (g b))
      (F := F) (a := a) (b := b) (I := W)
      hab hf_bdd hfw_bdd hfwI hF_cont hF_prefix
      (fun x hx =>
        rightEndpointSub_nonnegative_of_decreasing
          (g := g) hab hg_decr hx)
      (rightEndpointSub_decreasing_of_decreasing
        (g := g) (a := a) (b := b) hg_decr) with
  | intro xi hxi =>
      have htail :
          HasDarbouxIntegral f xi b
            (RealTheory.sub (F b) (F xi)) :=
        hasDarbouxIntegral_tail_of_prefix_primitive
          (f := f) (F := F)
          hxi.left.left hxi.left.right hf_bdd hF_prefix
      refine Exists.intro xi ?_
      refine And.intro hxi.left ?_
      refine And.intro hxi.right.left ?_
      refine And.intro htail ?_
      calc
        I =
            RealTheory.add W
              (RealTheory.mul (g b) (F b)) := hI_decomp
        _ =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul
                (RealTheory.sub (g a) (g b)) (F xi))
              (RealTheory.mul (g b) (F b)) := by
              rw [hxi.right.right]
        _ =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.mul (g a) (F xi))
              (RealTheory.mul (g b)
                (RealTheory.sub (F b) (F xi))) :=
              sub_mul_add_mul_eq_mul_add_mul_sub_real
                (g a) (g b) (F xi) (F b)

name: exists_point_hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_bonnet
statement:
theorem exists_point_hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_bonnet
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b)
    (hg_decr :
      FunctionDecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g) :
    Exists fun xi : Point =>
      Exists fun A : Point =>
        Exists fun B : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b xi)
            (And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a xi A)
              (And (HasDarbouxIntegral f xi b B)
                (HasDarbouxIntegral (MulFun f g) a b
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.mul (g a) A)
                    (RealTheory.mul (g b) B)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded hf
  have hg : RiemannIntegrableOn g a b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_of_functionDecreasingOn_closedInterval
      hab hg_decr
  have hfg : RiemannIntegrableOn (MulFun f g) a b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_mul_of_le hab hf hg
  cases hfg with
  | intro I hfgI =>
      have hconst_gb :
          RiemannIntegrableOn (fun _ : Point => g b) a b :=
        riemannIntegrableOn_const_of_le hab
      have hshift :
          RiemannIntegrableOn
            (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (g x) (g b)) a b :=
        riemannIntegrableOn_sub_of_le hab hg hconst_gb
      have hfw :
          RiemannIntegrableOn
            (MulFun f
              (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (g x) (g b))) a b :=
        riemannIntegrableOn_mul_of_le hab hf hshift
      cases hfw with
      | intro W hfwI =>
          let F : Point -> Point :=
            closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
              f a b hf
          have hF_prefix :
              forall x : Point,
                RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
                  HasDarbouxIntegral f a x (F x) := by
            intro x hx
            have hforward :=
              hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_forwardData_of_le hx.left
                (hasOrientedRiemannIntegral_closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable
                  hf hx)
            exact hforward.right
          have hF_cont :
              RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F :=
            closedIntervalUpperRiemannPrimitiveOfRiemannIntegrable_continuousOn
              hab hf
          cases hf_bdd with
          | intro M hM =>
              have hb_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
                RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab
              have hfI : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b (F b) :=
                hF_prefix b hb_mem
              have hgbf_bdd :
                  ClosedIntervalBounded
                    (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul (g b) (f x)) a b :=
                closedIntervalBounded_mul
                  (closedIntervalBounded_const (g b) a b)
                  (Exists.intro M hM)
              have hgbfI :
                  HasDarbouxIntegral
                    (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul (g b) (f x))
                    a b (RealTheory.mul (g b) (F b)) :=
                hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_left_of_le
                  (g b) hab (Exists.intro M hM) hfI
              have hfwR :
                  HasRiemannIntegral
                    (MulFun f
                      (fun x : Point => RealTheory.sub (g x) (g b)))
                    a b W :=
                hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral hfwI.left hfwI.right
              have hgbfR :
                  HasRiemannIntegral
                    (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul (g b) (f x))
                    a b (RealTheory.mul (g b) (F b)) :=
                hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral hgbf_bdd hgbfI
              have hsumR :
                  HasRiemannIntegral
                    (fun x : Point =>
                      RealTheory.add
                        ((MulFun f
                          (fun y : Point =>
                            RealTheory.sub (g y) (g b))) x)
                        (RealTheory.mul (g b) (f x)))
                    a b
                    (RealTheory.add W
                      (RealTheory.mul (g b) (F b))) :=
                hasRiemannIntegral_add hfwR hgbfR
              have hsum_as_fgR :
                  HasRiemannIntegral (MulFun f g) a b
                    (RealTheory.add W
                      (RealTheory.mul (g b) (F b))) :=
                hasRiemannIntegral_congr_pointwise
                  (f :=
                    fun x : Point =>
                      RealTheory.add
                        ((MulFun f
                          (fun y : Point =>
                            RealTheory.sub (g y) (g b))) x)
                        (RealTheory.mul (g b) (f x)))
                  (g := MulFun f g)
                  (fun x => by
                    unfold MulFun
                    calc
                      RealTheory.add
                          (RealTheory.mul (f x)
                            (RealTheory.sub (g x) (g b)))
                          (RealTheory.mul (g b) (f x)) =
                        RealTheory.add
                          (RealTheory.mul
                            (RealTheory.sub (g x) (g b)) (f x))
                          (RealTheory.mul (g b) (f x)) := by
                            rw [RealTheory.mul_comm (f x)
                              (RealTheory.sub (g x) (g b))]
                      _ = RealTheory.mul (g x) (f x) := by
                        rw [<- RealTheory.add_mul]
                        exact congrArg
                          (fun y : Point => RealTheory.mul y (f x))
                          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
                            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
                            (g x) (g b))
                      _ = RealTheory.mul (f x) (g x) := by
                        rw [RealTheory.mul_comm])
                  hsumR
              have hI_decomp :
                  I = RealTheory.add W
                    (RealTheory.mul (g b) (F b)) :=
                hasRiemannIntegral_unique
                  (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                    hfgI.left hfgI.right)
                  hsum_as_fgR
              cases exists_point_hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_bonnet_explicit
                  (f := f) (g := g) (F := F) (a := a) (b := b)
                  (I := I) (W := W)
                  hab (Exists.intro M hM) hfwI.left hfwI.right
                  hF_cont hF_prefix hg_decr hI_decomp with
              | intro xi hxi =>
                  refine Exists.intro xi ?_
                  refine Exists.intro (F xi) ?_
                  refine Exists.intro
                    (RealTheory.sub (F b) (F xi)) ?_
                  refine And.intro hxi.left ?_
                  refine And.intro hxi.right.left ?_
                  refine And.intro hxi.right.right.left ?_
                  have hproduct := hfgI.right
                  rw [hxi.right.right.right] at hproduct
                  exact hproduct

name: exists_point_hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_increasing_bonnet
statement:
theorem exists_point_hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_increasing_bonnet
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b)
    (hg_mono :
      RealTheory.FunctionMonotoneOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g) :
    Exists fun xi : Point =>
      Exists fun A : Point =>
        Exists fun B : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b xi)
            (And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a xi A)
              (And (HasDarbouxIntegral f xi b B)
                (HasDarbouxIntegral (MulFun f g) a b
                  (RealTheory.add
                    (RealTheory.mul (g a) A)
                    (RealTheory.mul (g b) B)))))
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hneg_decr :
      FunctionDecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.neg (g x)) := by
    intro x y hx hy hxy
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg C
      (hg_mono x y hx hy hxy)
  cases exists_point_hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_bonnet
      (f := f) (g := fun x : Point => RealTheory.neg (g x))
      (a := a) (b := b) hab hf hneg_decr with
  | intro xi hxi =>
      cases hxi with
      | intro A hA =>
          cases hA with
          | intro B hB =>
              have hneg_g :
                  RiemannIntegrableOn
                    (fun x : Point => RealTheory.neg (g x)) a b :=
                riemannIntegrableOn_neg_of_le hab
                  (riemannIntegrableOn_of_functionMonotoneOn_closedInterval
                    hab hg_mono)
              have hneg_product :
                  RiemannIntegrableOn
                    (MulFun f (fun x : Point => RealTheory.neg (g x)))
                    a b :=
                riemannIntegrableOn_mul_of_le hab hf hneg_g
              have hnegR :
                  HasRiemannIntegral
                    (MulFun f (fun x : Point => RealTheory.neg (g x)))
                    a b
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg (g a)) A)
                      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg (g b)) B)) :=
                hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                  (riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded hneg_product)
                  hB.right.right.right
              have hdoubleNegR :
                  HasRiemannIntegral
                    (fun x : Point =>
                      RealTheory.neg
                        ((MulFun f
                          (fun y : Point => RealTheory.neg (g y))) x))
                    a b
                    (RealTheory.neg
                      (RealTheory.add
                        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg (g a)) A)
                        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg (g b)) B))) :=
                hasRiemannIntegral_neg hnegR
              have hfgR :
                  HasRiemannIntegral (MulFun f g) a b
                    (RealTheory.neg
                      (RealTheory.add
                        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg (g a)) A)
                        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg (g b)) B))) :=
                hasRiemannIntegral_congr_pointwise
                  (fun x => by
                    unfold MulFun
                    rw [RealTheory.mul_neg, RealTheory.neg_neg])
                  hdoubleNegR
              have hvalue :
                  RealTheory.neg
                      (RealTheory.add
                        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg (g a)) A)
                        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.neg (g b)) B)) =
                    RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.mul (g a) A)
                      (RealTheory.mul (g b) B) := by
                change
                  C.neg
                      (C.add
                        (C.mul (C.neg (g a)) A)
                        (C.mul (C.neg (g b)) B)) =
                    C.add (C.mul (g a) A) (C.mul (g b) B)
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_add_distrib C]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul C,
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg C]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_mul C,
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg C]
              rw [hvalue] at hfgR
              refine Exists.intro xi ?_
              refine Exists.intro A ?_
              refine Exists.intro B ?_
              refine And.intro hB.left ?_
              refine And.intro hB.right.left ?_
              refine And.intro hB.right.right.left ?_
              exact hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral hab hfgR

name: hasDarbouxIntegral_first_mean_value_nonneg_weight_of_le
statement:
theorem hasDarbouxIntegral_first_mean_value_nonneg_weight_of_le
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b m M G I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hg_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded g a b)
    (hgI : HasDarbouxIntegral g a b G)
    (hfg_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded (MulFun f g) a b)
    (hfgI : HasDarbouxIntegral (MulFun f g) a b I)
    (hlower :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x -> RealTheory.le m (f x))
    (hupper :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x -> RealTheory.le (f x) M)
    (hg_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (g x)) :
    Exists fun mu : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.le m mu)
        (And (RealTheory.le mu M)
          (I = RealTheory.mul mu G))
proof:
:= by
  have ha_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab
  have hmM : RealTheory.le m M :=
    RealTheory.le_trans (hlower a ha_mem) (hupper a ha_mem)
  have hzero_bdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero) a b :=
    closedIntervalBounded_const RealTheory.zero a b
  have hzeroI :
      HasDarbouxIntegral
        (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero) a b
        RealTheory.zero :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_zero_of_le hab
  have hGnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero G :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le hab
      (fun x hx => hg_nonneg x hx)
      hzero_bdd hzeroI hg_bdd hgI
  have hmg_bdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul m (g x)) a b := by
    exact closedIntervalBounded_mul
      (closedIntervalBounded_const m a b) hg_bdd
  have hMg_bdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul M (g x)) a b := by
    exact closedIntervalBounded_mul
      (closedIntervalBounded_const M a b) hg_bdd
  have hmgI :
      HasDarbouxIntegral
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul m (g x)) a b
        (RealTheory.mul m G) :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_left_of_le m hab hg_bdd hgI
  have hMgI :
      HasDarbouxIntegral
        (fun x : Point => RealTheory.mul M (g x)) a b
        (RealTheory.mul M G) :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_left_of_le M hab hg_bdd hgI
  have hleft : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul m G) I :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le hab
      (fun x hx =>
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
          (hlower x hx) (hg_nonneg x hx))
      hmg_bdd hmgI hfg_bdd hfgI
  have hright : RealTheory.le I (RealTheory.mul M G) :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le hab
      (fun x hx =>
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
          (hupper x hx) (hg_nonneg x hx))
      hfg_bdd hfgI hMg_bdd hMgI
  exact RiemannInternal.exists_coeff_between_of_mul_bounds
    hmM hGnonneg hleft hright

name: hasDarbouxIntegral_first_mean_value_continuous_nonneg_weight_of_le
statement:
theorem hasDarbouxIntegral_first_mean_value_continuous_nonneg_weight_of_le
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b G I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf_cont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hg_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded g a b)
    (hgI : HasDarbouxIntegral g a b G)
    (hfg_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded (MulFun f g) a b)
    (hfgI : HasDarbouxIntegral (MulFun f g) a b I)
    (hg_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (g x)) :
    Exists fun xi : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b xi)
        (I = RealTheory.mul (f xi) G)
proof:
:= by
  have hext :
      And
        (RealTheory.FunctionAttainsMinimumOn
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
        (RealTheory.FunctionAttainsMaximumOn
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f) :=
    RealTheory.function_continuousOn_closedInterval_attainsExtrema
      hab hf_cont
  cases hext.left with
  | intro xmin hmin =>
      cases hext.right with
      | intro xmax hmax =>
          have hbase :
              Exists fun mu : Point =>
                And (RealTheory.le (f xmin) mu)
                  (And (RealTheory.le mu (f xmax))
                    (I = RealTheory.mul mu G)) :=
            hasDarbouxIntegral_first_mean_value_nonneg_weight_of_le
              (f := f) (g := g) (a := a) (b := b)
              (m := f xmin) (M := f xmax)
              hab hg_bdd hgI hfg_bdd hfgI
              (fun x hx => hmin.right x hx)
              (fun x hx => hmax.right x hx)
              hg_nonneg
          cases hbase with
          | intro mu hmu =>
              have hbetween :
                  RealTheory.Between (f xmin) mu (f xmax) :=
                And.intro hmu.left hmu.right.left
              cases RealTheory.function_intermediate_value_of_connected
                  (RealTheory.connected_closedInterval a b)
                  hf_cont hmin.left hmax.left hbetween with
              | intro xi hxi =>
                  refine Exists.intro xi ?_
                  refine And.intro hxi.left ?_
                  rw [hxi.right]
                  exact hmu.right.right

name: hasDarbouxIntegral_continuous_mean_value
statement:
theorem hasDarbouxIntegral_continuous_mean_value
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf_cont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f)
    (hI : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I) :
    Exists fun xi : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b xi)
        (I = RealTheory.mul (f xi) (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:= by
  have hf_integrable : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_of_functionContinuousOn_closedInterval
      hab hf_cont
  have hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b :=
    riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded hf_integrable
  have hone_bdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one) a b :=
    closedIntervalBounded_const RealTheory.one a b
  have honeI :
      HasDarbouxIntegral (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one) a b
        (RealTheory.sub b a) := by
    have h := hasDarbouxIntegral_const_of_le
      (a := a) (b := b) (c := RealTheory.one) hab
    rwa [RealTheory.one_mul] at h
  have hproduct_bdd :
      ClosedIntervalBounded
        (MulFun f (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)) a b :=
    closedIntervalBounded_mul hf_bdd hone_bdd
  have hproductR :
      HasRiemannIntegral
        (MulFun f (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)) a b I :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_congr_pointwise
      (f := f)
      (g := MulFun f (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one))
      (fun x => by
        unfold MulFun
        rw [RealTheory.mul_one])
      (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral hf_bdd hI)
  have hproductI :
      HasDarbouxIntegral
        (MulFun f (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)) a b I :=
    hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral hab hproductR
  exact hasDarbouxIntegral_first_mean_value_continuous_nonneg_weight_of_le
    (f := f) (g := fun _ : Point => RealTheory.one)
    (a := a) (b := b) (G := RealTheory.sub b a) (I := I)
    hab hf_cont hone_bdd honeI hproduct_bdd hproductI
    (fun _ _ =>
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        RealTheory.zero_lt_one)

name: hasRiemannIntegral_pos_of_nonnegative_of_continuousAt_pos
statement:
theorem hasRiemannIntegral_pos_of_nonnegative_of_continuousAt_pos
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I x : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hf : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b)
    (hI : HasRiemannIntegral f a b I)
    (hf_nonneg :
      forall y : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f y))
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hf_cont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousAtOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f x)
    (hfx_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (f x)) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero I
proof:
:= by
  let C := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let c := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half C (f x)
  have hc_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero c := by
    dsimp [c]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos C hfx_pos
  cases hf_cont.right c hc_pos with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      have hlocal_lower :
          forall z : Point,
            RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z ->
              RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist z x) delta ->
                RealTheory.le c (f z) := by
        intro z hz hzx_dist
        by_cases hzx : z = x
        case pos =>
          rw [hzx]
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self C hfx_pos)
        case neg =>
          have hvalue_dist :
              RealTheory.lt
                (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f z) (f x))) c :=
            hdelta.right z hz hzx hzx_dist
          have hlower :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub (f x) c) (f z) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left C hvalue_dist
          have hc_eq : RealTheory.sub (f x) c = c := by
            dsimp [c]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_half_self C (f x)
          rw [hc_eq] at hlower
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hlower
      have hsmall_interval :
          Exists fun u : Point =>
            Exists fun v : Point =>
              And (RealTheory.le a u)
                (And (RealTheory.lt u v)
                  (And (RealTheory.le v b)
                    (forall z : Point,
                      RealTheory.ClosedInterval u v z ->
                        RealTheory.le c (f z)))) := by
        by_cases hxb : RealTheory.lt x b
        case pos =>
          have hx_add_delta :
              RealTheory.lt x (RealTheory.add x delta) := by
            have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left C
              hdelta.left x
            change C.lt (C.add x C.zero) (C.add x delta) at h
            rwa [C.add_zero] at h
          let d := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint C x
            (RealTheory.add x delta)
          have hxd : RealTheory.lt x d :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint C hx_add_delta
          have hd_sub_lt :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub d x) delta := by
            dsimp [d]
            change
              C.lt (C.sub (C.midpoint x (C.add x delta)) x) delta
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_sub_left C]
            have hsub :
                C.sub (C.add x delta) x = delta := by
              rw [C.add_comm x delta]
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel C delta x
            rw [hsub]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self C hdelta.left
          cases RealTheory.le_total d b with
          | inl hdb =>
              refine Exists.intro x ?_
              refine Exists.intro d ?_
              refine And.intro hx.left ?_
              refine And.intro hxd ?_
              refine And.intro hdb ?_
              intro z hz
              have hz_original :
                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z :=
                And.intro
                  (RealTheory.le_trans hx.left hz.left)
                  (RealTheory.le_trans hz.right hdb)
              have hsub_le :
                  RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub z x)
                    (RealTheory.sub d x) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le C
                  hz.right (RealTheory.le_refl x)
              have hsub_lt :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub z x) delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hsub_le hd_sub_lt
              have hdist :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist z x) delta := by
                change C.lt (C.abs (C.sub z x)) delta
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg C
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hz.left)]
                exact hsub_lt
              exact hlocal_lower z hz_original hdist
          | inr hbd =>
              let v := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint C x b
              have hxv : RealTheory.lt x v :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_lt_midpoint C hxb
              have hvb : RealTheory.le v b :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_le_right C
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hxb)
              have hvd : RealTheory.le v d :=
                RealTheory.le_trans hvb hbd
              refine Exists.intro x ?_
              refine Exists.intro v ?_
              refine And.intro hx.left ?_
              refine And.intro hxv ?_
              refine And.intro hvb ?_
              intro z hz
              have hz_original :
                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z :=
                And.intro
                  (RealTheory.le_trans hx.left hz.left)
                  (RealTheory.le_trans hz.right hvb)
              have hzd : RealTheory.le z d :=
                RealTheory.le_trans hz.right hvd
              have hsub_le :
                  RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub z x)
                    (RealTheory.sub d x) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le C
                  hzd (RealTheory.le_refl x)
              have hsub_lt :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub z x) delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hsub_le hd_sub_lt
              have hdist :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist z x) delta := by
                change C.lt (C.abs (C.sub z x)) delta
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg C
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hz.left)]
                exact hsub_lt
              exact hlocal_lower z hz_original hdist
        case neg =>
          have hbx : RealTheory.le b x := by
            by_cases hbx' : RealTheory.le b x
            case pos => exact hbx'
            case neg =>
              exact False.elim
                (hxb
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le C
                    hx.right hbx'))
          have hxeq : x = b :=
            RealTheory.le_antisymm hx.right hbx
          have hax : RealTheory.lt a x := by
            rw [hxeq]
            exact hab
          let d := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint C
            (RealTheory.sub x delta) x
          have hbase_left :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x delta) x :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos C hdelta.left
          have hdx : RealTheory.lt d x :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right C hbase_left
          have hx_sub_d_lt :
              RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x d) delta := by
            dsimp [d]
            change
              C.lt
                (C.sub x (C.midpoint (C.sub x delta) x)) delta
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.right_sub_midpoint C]
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub C x delta]
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self C hdelta.left
          cases RealTheory.le_total a d with
          | inl had =>
              refine Exists.intro d ?_
              refine Exists.intro x ?_
              refine And.intro had ?_
              refine And.intro hdx ?_
              refine And.intro hx.right ?_
              intro z hz
              have hz_original :
                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z :=
                And.intro
                  (RealTheory.le_trans had hz.left)
                  (RealTheory.le_trans hz.right hx.right)
              have hsub_le :
                  RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub x z)
                    (RealTheory.sub x d) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le C
                  (RealTheory.le_refl x) hz.left
              have hsub_lt :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x z) delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hsub_le hx_sub_d_lt
              have hdist :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist z x) delta := by
                change C.lt (C.abs (C.sub z x)) delta
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm C z x]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg C
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hz.right)]
                exact hsub_lt
              exact hlocal_lower z hz_original hdist
          | inr hda =>
              let u := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint C a x
              have hau : RealTheory.le a u :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.left_le_midpoint C
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hax)
              have hux : RealTheory.lt u x :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.midpoint_lt_right C hax
              have hdu : RealTheory.le d u :=
                RealTheory.le_trans hda hau
              refine Exists.intro u ?_
              refine Exists.intro x ?_
              refine And.intro hau ?_
              refine And.intro hux ?_
              refine And.intro hx.right ?_
              intro z hz
              have hz_original :
                  RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z :=
                And.intro
                  (RealTheory.le_trans hau hz.left)
                  (RealTheory.le_trans hz.right hx.right)
              have hdz : RealTheory.le d z :=
                RealTheory.le_trans hdu hz.left
              have hsub_le :
                  RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub x z)
                    (RealTheory.sub x d) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le C
                  (RealTheory.le_refl x) hdz
              have hsub_lt :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x z) delta :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt C hsub_le hx_sub_d_lt
              have hdist :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist z x) delta := by
                change C.lt (C.abs (C.sub z x)) delta
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_comm C z x]
                rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_of_nonneg C
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le C hz.right)]
                exact hsub_lt
              exact hlocal_lower z hz_original hdist
      cases hsmall_interval with
      | intro u hu =>
          cases hu with
          | intro v hv =>
              have huv : RealTheory.le u v :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hv.right.left
              have hav : RealTheory.le a v :=
                RealTheory.le_trans hv.left huv
              have hf_av : RiemannIntegrableOn f a v :=
                riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_left hav hv.right.right.left hf
              have hf_uv : RiemannIntegrableOn f u v :=
                riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_right hv.left huv hf_av
              cases hf_uv with
              | intro J hJ =>
                  have hconstR :
                      HasRiemannIntegral (fun _ : Point => c) u v
                        (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub v u)) :=
                    hasRiemannIntegral_const_of_le u v c huv
                  have hJR : HasRiemannIntegral f u v J :=
                    hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral hJ.left hJ.right
                  have hconst_le_J :
                      RealTheory.le
                        (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub v u)) J :=
                    hasRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
                      huv hv.right.right.right hconstR hJR
                  have hconst_pos :
                      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                        (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub v u)) :=
                    RealTheory.mul_pos hc_pos
                      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt C hv.right.left)
                  have hJ_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero J :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C
                      hconst_pos hconst_le_J
                  have hab_le : RealTheory.le a b :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt C hab
                  have htotalD : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I :=
                    hasRiemannIntegral_hasDarbouxIntegral hab_le hI
                  cases hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_decomposition_ordered
                      hav hv.right.right.left hf htotalD with
                  | intro A hA =>
                      cases hA with
                      | intro R hR =>
                          cases hasDarbouxIntegral_adjacent_decomposition_ordered
                              hv.left huv hf_av hR.left with
                          | intro L hL =>
                              cases hL with
                              | intro J' hJ' =>
                                  have hJ'_eq : J' = J :=
                                    hasRiemannIntegral_unique
                                      (hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                                        (riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded
                                          (riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_right
                                            hv.left huv hf_av))
                                        hJ'.right.left)
                                      hJR
                                  have hf_au : RiemannIntegrableOn f a u :=
                                    riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_left
                                      hv.left huv hf_av
                                  have hzeroL :
                                      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero L := by
                                    have hzeroR :
                                        HasRiemannIntegral
                                          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
                                          a u
                                          (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
                                            (RealTheory.sub u a)) :=
                                      hasRiemannIntegral_const_of_le
                                        a u RealTheory.zero hv.left
                                    have hLR : HasRiemannIntegral f a u L :=
                                      hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                                        (riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded hf_au)
                                        hJ'.left
                                    have hle :=
                                      hasRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
                                        hv.left
                                        (fun z hz =>
                                          hf_nonneg z
                                            (And.intro hz.left
                                              (RealTheory.le_trans hz.right
                                                (RealTheory.le_trans huv
                                                  hv.right.right.left))))
                                        hzeroR hLR
                                    rwa [RealTheory.zero_mul] at hle
                                  have hf_vb : RiemannIntegrableOn f v b :=
                                    riemannIntegrableOn_restrict_right
                                      hav hv.right.right.left hf
                                  have hzeroRemainder :
                                      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero R := by
                                    have hzeroRI :
                                        HasRiemannIntegral
                                          (fun _ : Point => RealTheory.zero)
                                          v b
                                          (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
                                            (RealTheory.sub b v)) :=
                                      hasRiemannIntegral_const_of_le
                                        v b RealTheory.zero hv.right.right.left
                                    have hRR : HasRiemannIntegral f v b R :=
                                      hasDarbouxIntegral_hasRiemannIntegral
                                        (riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded hf_vb)
                                        hR.right.left
                                    have hle :=
                                      hasRiemannIntegral_le_of_pointwise_le
                                        hv.right.right.left
                                        (fun z hz =>
                                          hf_nonneg z
                                            (And.intro
                                              (RealTheory.le_trans hv.left
                                                (RealTheory.le_trans huv hz.left))
                                              hz.right))
                                        hzeroRI hRR
                                    rwa [RealTheory.zero_mul] at hle
                                  have hJ_le_LJ :
                                      RealTheory.le J
                                        (RealTheory.add L J) := by
                                    have hle :=
                                      RealTheory.add_le_add_right hzeroL J
                                    rwa [RealTheory.zero_add] at hle
                                  have hLJ_le_total :
                                      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.add L J)
                                        (RealTheory.add
                                          (RealTheory.add L J) R) := by
                                    have hle :=
                                      RealTheory.add_le_add_left
                                        hzeroRemainder (RealTheory.add L J)
                                    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at hle
                                  have hpositive :
                                      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                                        (RealTheory.add
                                          (RealTheory.add L J) R) :=
                                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le C
                                      hJ_pos
                                      (RealTheory.le_trans hJ_le_LJ
                                        hLJ_le_total)
                                  have hI_eq :
                                      I = RealTheory.add
                                        (RealTheory.add L J) R := by
                                    rw [hR.right.right, hJ'.right.right, hJ'_eq]
                                  rwa [hI_eq]

name: hasDarbouxIntegral_pos_of_nonnegative_of_continuousAt_pos
statement:
theorem hasDarbouxIntegral_pos_of_nonnegative_of_continuousAt_pos
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b I x : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hI : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I)
    (hf_nonneg :

  hasRiemannIntegral_pos_of_nonnegative_of_continuousAt_pos

    hf_nonneg hx hf_cont hfx_pos

name: mul_mul_inv_cancel_right_real
statement:
private theorem mul_mul_inv_cancel_right_real
    (x : Point) {y : Point}
    (hy : Not (y = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x y) (RealTheory.inv y) = x
proof:
:= by
  change
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
      (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul x y)
      (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.inv y) = x
