name: mul_inv_mul_cancel_right_real
statement:
private theorem mul_inv_mul_cancel_right_real
    (x : Point) {y : Point}
    (hy : Not (y = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv y)) y = x
proof:
:= by
  change
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
      (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul x
        (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.inv y)) y = x
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x hy

name: sub_add_cancel_real
statement:
private theorem sub_add_cancel_real (x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub x y) y = x
proof:
:= by
  change
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.add
      (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.sub x y) y = x
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base x y

name: mul_sub_add_cancel_right_real
statement:
private theorem mul_sub_add_cancel_right_real (c x y : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.mul c (RealTheory.sub x y))
      (RealTheory.mul c y) =
    RealTheory.mul c x
proof:
:= by
  rw [<- RealTheory.mul_add]
  rw [sub_add_cancel_real]

name: sub_mul_add_mul_cancel_right_real
statement:
private theorem sub_mul_add_mul_cancel_right_real (x y c : Point) :
    RealTheory.add
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x y) c)
      (RealTheory.mul y c) =
    RealTheory.mul x c
proof:
:= by
  rw [<- RealTheory.add_mul]
  rw [sub_add_cancel_real]

name: finiteSum_reverse_telescope_sub
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_reverse_telescope_sub
    (v : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.sub (v i) (v (i + 1))) n =
        RealTheory.sub (v 0) (v n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcongr :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.sub (v i) (v (i + 1))) n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.sub (v (i + 1)) (v i))) n := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
    intro i
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F
      (v (i + 1)) (v i)
  rw [hcongr]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_neg]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_telescope_sub]
  exact Eq.symm
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (v n) (v 0))

name: finiteSum_prefix_le_of_nonneg
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_prefix_le_of_nonneg
    {term : Nat -> Point} {k n : Nat}
    (hk : k <= n)
    (hnonneg :
      forall j : Nat, j < n ->
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (term j)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.finiteSum term k)
      (RealTheory.finiteSum term n)
proof:
:= by
  let tail := fun j : Nat => term (k + j)
  have htail_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.finiteSum tail (n - k)) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_nonneg tail (n - k)
      (fun j hj => by
        have hjn : k + j < n := by
          omega
        exact hnonneg (k + j) hjn)
  have hprefix_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum term k)
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.finiteSum term k)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum tail (n - k))) := by
    have h :=
      RealTheory.add_le_add_left htail_nonneg
        (RealTheory.finiteSum term k)
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.finiteSum term k) RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.finiteSum term k)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum tail (n - k))) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
  have hsplit :
      RealTheory.finiteSum term n =
        RealTheory.add (RealTheory.finiteSum term k)
          (RealTheory.finiteSum tail (n - k)) := by
    have hidx : k + (n - k) = n := Nat.add_sub_of_le hk
    have hraw := RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length term k (n - k)
    rw [hidx] at hraw
    exact hraw
  rwa [hsplit]

name: finiteSum_abel_transform
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_abel_transform
    (u v : Nat -> Point) :
    forall n : Nat,
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (u i) (v i)) n =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.finiteSum u (i + 1))
                (RealTheory.sub (v i) (v (i + 1)))) n)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.finiteSum u n) (v n))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_zero]
      rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
      rw [RealTheory.add_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
      let A := RealTheory.finiteSum u n
      let B :=
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.finiteSum u (i + 1))
              (RealTheory.sub (v i) (v (i + 1)))) n
      calc
        RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (u i) (v i)) (n + 1) =
            RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (u i) (v i)) n)
              (RealTheory.mul (u n) (v n)) := by
              rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
        _ = RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add B (RealTheory.mul A (v n)))
              (RealTheory.mul (u n) (v n)) := by
              rw [ih]
        _ = RealTheory.add B
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.mul A (v n))
                (RealTheory.mul (u n) (v n))) := by
              rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
        _ = RealTheory.add B
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add A (u n)) (v n)) := by
              rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
        _ = RealTheory.add B
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.finiteSum u (n + 1)) (v n)) := by
              rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
        _ = RealTheory.add B
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.finiteSum u (n + 1))
                (RealTheory.add
                  (RealTheory.sub (v n) (v (n + 1)))
                  (v (n + 1)))) := by
              rw [sub_add_cancel_real]
        _ = RealTheory.add B
              (RealTheory.add
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.finiteSum u (n + 1))
                  (RealTheory.sub (v n) (v (n + 1))))
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.finiteSum u (n + 1))
                  (v (n + 1)))) := by
              rw [RealTheory.mul_add]
        _ = RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.add B
                (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.finiteSum u (n + 1))
                  (RealTheory.sub (v n) (v (n + 1)))))
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.finiteSum u (n + 1))
                (v (n + 1))) := by
              rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
        _ = RealTheory.add
              (RealTheory.finiteSum
                (fun i : Nat =>
                  RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.finiteSum u (i + 1))
                    (RealTheory.sub (v i) (v (i + 1)))) (n + 1))
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.finiteSum u (n + 1))
                (v (n + 1))) := by
              rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
              rfl

name: finiteSum_abel_transform_between_mul_initial
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_abel_transform_between_mul_initial
    {u v : Nat -> Point} {m M : Point} :
    forall n : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        RealTheory.le m (RealTheory.finiteSum u k)) ->
      (forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.finiteSum u k) M) ->
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (v n) ->
      (forall i : Nat, i < n ->
        RealTheory.le (v (i + 1)) (v i)) ->
      And
        (RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul m (v 0))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (u i) (v i)) n))
        (RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (u i) (v i)) n)
          (RealTheory.mul M (v 0)))
proof:
:= by
  intro n hlower hupper hv_tail hv_decr
  let diff : Nat -> Point :=
    fun i : Nat => RealTheory.sub (v i) (v (i + 1))
  let prefixSum : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat => RealTheory.finiteSum u k
  have hdiff_nonneg :
      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (diff i) := by
    intro i hi
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      (hv_decr i hi)
  have hsum_lower :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul m (diff i)) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (prefixSum (i + 1)) (diff i)) n) := by
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul m (diff i))
      (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (prefixSum (i + 1)) (diff i))
      n
      (fun i hi =>
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
          (hlower (i + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi))
          (hdiff_nonneg i hi))
  have hsum_upper :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (prefixSum (i + 1)) (diff i)) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul M (diff i)) n) := by
    exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (prefixSum (i + 1)) (diff i))
      (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul M (diff i))
      n
      (fun i hi =>
        RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
          (hupper (i + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi))
          (hdiff_nonneg i hi))
  have htail_lower :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul m (v n))
        (RealTheory.mul (prefixSum n) (v n)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      (hlower n (Nat.le_refl n)) hv_tail
  have htail_upper :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (prefixSum n) (v n))
        (RealTheory.mul M (v n)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      (hupper n (Nat.le_refl n)) hv_tail
  have hleft_add :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul m (diff i)) n)
          (RealTheory.mul m (v n)))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (prefixSum (i + 1)) (diff i)) n)
          (RealTheory.mul (prefixSum n) (v n))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsum_lower htail_lower
  have hright_add :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (prefixSum (i + 1)) (diff i)) n)
          (RealTheory.mul (prefixSum n) (v n)))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul M (diff i)) n)
          (RealTheory.mul M (v n))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hsum_upper htail_upper
  have hleft_eq :
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul m (diff i)) n)
          (RealTheory.mul m (v n)) =
        RealTheory.mul m (v 0) := by
    have hmul :
        RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul m (diff i)) n =
          RealTheory.mul m (RealTheory.finiteSum diff n) :=
      RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left m diff n
    rw [hmul]
    rw [finiteSum_reverse_telescope_sub]
    exact mul_sub_add_cancel_right_real m (v 0) (v n)
  have hright_eq :
      RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul M (diff i)) n)
          (RealTheory.mul M (v n)) =
        RealTheory.mul M (v 0) := by
    have hmul :
        RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul M (diff i)) n =
          RealTheory.mul M (RealTheory.finiteSum diff n) :=
      RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left M diff n
    rw [hmul]
    rw [finiteSum_reverse_telescope_sub]
    exact mul_sub_add_cancel_right_real M (v 0) (v n)
  have habel :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (u i) (v i)) n =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul (prefixSum (i + 1)) (diff i)) n)
          (RealTheory.mul (prefixSum n) (v n)) := by
    exact finiteSum_abel_transform u v n
  have hleft_final :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul m (v 0))
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (u i) (v i)) n) := by
    rw [habel]
    rwa [hleft_eq] at hleft_add
  have hright_final :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (u i) (v i)) n)
        (RealTheory.mul M (v 0)) := by
    rw [habel]
    rwa [hright_eq] at hright_add
  exact And.intro hleft_final hright_final

name: taggedSum_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_initial
statement:
private theorem taggedSum_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_initial
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b m M : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hlower :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        RealTheory.le m (taggedSum f p tag k))
    (hupper :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        RealTheory.le (taggedSum f p tag k) M)
    (hg_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (g x))
    (hg_decr :
      FunctionDecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul m
          (if _h : 0 < n then g (tag 0) else RealTheory.zero))
        (taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n))
      (RealTheory.le
        (taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n)
        (RealTheory.mul M
          (if _h : 0 < n then g (tag 0) else RealTheory.zero)))
proof:
:= by
  let u : Nat -> Point :=
    fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (f (tag i)) (cellLength p i)
  let weight : Nat -> Point :=
    fun i : Nat => if _h : i < n then g (tag i) else RealTheory.zero
  have hprod_eq :
      taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (u i) (weight i)) n := by
    unfold taggedSum
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt
    intro i hi
    dsimp [u]
    simp [weight, hi]
    unfold MulFun
    calc
      RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.mul (f (tag i)) (g (tag i)))
          (cellLength p i) =
          RealTheory.mul (f (tag i))
            (RealTheory.mul (g (tag i)) (cellLength p i)) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      _ = RealTheory.mul (f (tag i))
            (RealTheory.mul (cellLength p i) (g (tag i))) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_comm (g (tag i)) (cellLength p i)]
      _ = RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.mul (f (tag i)) (cellLength p i))
            (g (tag i)) := by
            rw [<- RealTheory.mul_assoc]
  have hprefix_lower :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        RealTheory.le m (RealTheory.finiteSum u k) := by
    intro k hk
    change RealTheory.le m (taggedSum f p tag k)
    exact hlower k hk
  have hprefix_upper :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.finiteSum u k) M := by
    intro k hk
    change RealTheory.le (taggedSum f p tag k) M
    exact hupper k hk
  have htail_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (weight n) := by
    simp [weight]
    exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  have hweight_decr :
      forall i : Nat, i < n ->
        RealTheory.le (weight (i + 1)) (weight i) := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases hsucc : i + 1 < n
    case pos =>
      simp [weight, hsucc, hi]
      have htag_i : PartitionCell p i (tag i) :=
        htag.right i hi
      have htag_succ : PartitionCell p (i + 1) (tag (i + 1)) :=
        htag.right (i + 1) hsucc
      have htag_i_mem :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (tag i) :=
        intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
          htag.left hi htag_i
      have htag_succ_mem :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (tag (i + 1)) :=
        intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
          htag.left hsucc htag_succ
      have htag_le :
          RealTheory.le (tag i) (tag (i + 1)) :=
        RealTheory.le_trans htag_i.right htag_succ.left
      exact hg_decr (tag i) (tag (i + 1))
        htag_i_mem htag_succ_mem htag_le
    case neg =>
      simp [weight, hsucc, hi]
      have htag_i : PartitionCell p i (tag i) :=
        htag.right i hi
      have htag_i_mem :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (tag i) :=
        intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
          htag.left hi htag_i
      exact hg_nonneg (tag i) htag_i_mem
  have habel :
      And
        (RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul m (weight 0))
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (u i) (weight i)) n))
        (RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun i : Nat => RealTheory.mul (u i) (weight i)) n)
          (RealTheory.mul M (weight 0))) :=
    finiteSum_abel_transform_between_mul_initial
      (u := u) (v := weight) (m := m) (M := M)
      n hprefix_lower hprefix_upper htail_nonneg hweight_decr
  have hweight_zero :
      weight 0 =
        (if _h : 0 < n then g (tag 0) else RealTheory.zero) := by
    rfl
  have hleft_final :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul m
          (if _h : 0 < n then g (tag 0) else RealTheory.zero))
        (taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n) := by
      rw [hprod_eq]
      rw [<- hweight_zero]
      exact habel.left
  have hright_final :
      RealTheory.le
        (taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n)
        (RealTheory.mul M
          (if _h : 0 < n then g (tag 0) else RealTheory.zero)) := by
      rw [hprod_eq]
      rw [<- hweight_zero]
      exact habel.right
  exact And.intro hleft_final hright_final

name: taggedSum_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_left_endpoint
statement:
private theorem taggedSum_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_left_endpoint
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b m M : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hm_nonpos : RealTheory.le m RealTheory.zero)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (hlower :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        RealTheory.le m (taggedSum f p tag k))
    (hupper :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        RealTheory.le (taggedSum f p tag k) M)
    (hg_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (g x))
    (hg_decr :
      FunctionDecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul m (g a))
        (taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n))
      (RealTheory.le
        (taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n)
        (RealTheory.mul M (g a)))
proof:
:= by
  let initial : Point :=
    if _h : 0 < n then g (tag 0) else RealTheory.zero
  have hdiscrete :
      And
        (RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul m initial)
          (taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n))
        (RealTheory.le
          (taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n)
          (RealTheory.mul M initial)) := by
    dsimp [initial]
    exact taggedSum_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_initial
      (f := f) (g := g) (a := a) (b := b)
      (m := m) (M := M) htag hlower hupper hg_nonneg hg_decr
  have hab : RealTheory.le a b :=
    intervalPartition_interval_le htag.left
  have ha_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab
  have hga_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (g a) :=
    hg_nonneg a ha_mem
  have hinitial_le_ga : RealTheory.le initial (g a) := by
    by_cases hn : 0 < n
    case pos =>
      simp [initial, hn]
      have htag0 : PartitionCell p 0 (tag 0) :=
        htag.right 0 hn
      have htag0_mem :
          RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b (tag 0) :=
        intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval
          htag.left hn htag0
      have ha_tag0 : RealTheory.le a (tag 0) := by
        rw [<- intervalPartition_left_endpoint htag.left]
        exact htag0.left
      exact hg_decr a (tag 0) ha_mem htag0_mem ha_tag0
    case neg =>
      simp [initial, hn]
      exact hga_nonneg
  have hleft_scale :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul m (g a))
        (RealTheory.mul m initial) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_le_mul_nonpos_left
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hinitial_le_ga hm_nonpos
  have hright_scale :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul M initial)
        (RealTheory.mul M (g a)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left hinitial_le_ga hM_nonneg
  exact And.intro
    (RealTheory.le_trans hleft_scale hdiscrete.left)
    (RealTheory.le_trans hdiscrete.right hright_scale)

name: darbouxGap_prefix_le_of_le
statement:
private theorem darbouxGap_prefix_le_of_le
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {n k : Nat} {p : Nat -> Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k <= n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p k) (lowerSum f p k))
      (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))
proof:
:= by
  unfold upperSum lowerSum
  rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedDarbouxGap_eq_finiteSum_cellGap_mul_weight
    f (cellLength p) p k]
  rw [Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.weightedDarbouxGap_eq_finiteSum_cellGap_mul_weight
    f (cellLength p) p n]
  exact finiteSum_prefix_le_of_nonneg hk
    (fun j hj => by
      have hsup :
          Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p j M) :=
        exists_hasCellSup_of_closedIntervalBounded hbdd hp hj
      have hinf :
          Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p j m) :=
        exists_hasCellInf_of_closedIntervalBounded hbdd hp hj
      have hx : PartitionCell p j (p j) :=
        intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hp hj
      have hcell :
          RealTheory.le (cellLower f p j) (cellUpper f p j) :=
        RealTheory.le_trans (cellLower_le hinf hx) (le_cellUpper hsup hx)
      have hspread :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
            (RealTheory.sub
              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellUpper f p j)
              (Tautology.RealFunction.IntervalPartition.cellLower f p j)) := by
        change RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.sub (cellUpper f p j) (cellLower f p j))
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hcell
      have hlen : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (cellLength p j) :=
        cellLength_nonnegative hp hj
      exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hspread hlen)

name: taggedSum_lt_bounds_of_hasDarbouxIntegral_gap_lt
statement:
private theorem taggedSum_lt_bounds_of_hasDarbouxIntegral_gap_lt
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b m M I eps : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hI : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I)
    (hmI : RealTheory.le m I)
    (hIM : RealTheory.le I M)
    (hgap :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))
        eps) :
    And
      (RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub m eps)
        (taggedSum f p tag n))
      (RealTheory.lt
        (taggedSum f p tag n)
        (RealTheory.add M eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := lowerSum f p n
  let U := upperSum f p n
  let S := taggedSum f p tag n
  have hS_between :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval L U S := by
    dsimp [L, U, S]
    exact lowerSum_le_taggedSum_le_upperSum htag
      (exists_hasCellInf_of_closedIntervalBounded_partition
        hbdd htag.left)
      (exists_hasCellSup_of_closedIntervalBounded_partition
        hbdd htag.left)
  have hI_between :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval L U I := by
    dsimp [L, U]
    exact hasDarbouxIntegral_between_darbouxSums htag.left hI
  have habs_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I))
        (RealTheory.sub U L) :=
    abs_sub_le_of_closedInterval_mem hS_between hI_between
  have habs_lt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I)) eps := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F habs_le hgap
  have hI_lt_S_eps :
      RealTheory.lt I (RealTheory.add S eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_left_add_of_abs_sub_lt F habs_lt
  have hm_lt_S_eps :
      RealTheory.lt m (RealTheory.add S eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hmI hI_lt_S_eps
  have hm_sub_S_lt_eps :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub m S) eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hm_lt_S_eps
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub m eps) S :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right F hm_sub_S_lt_eps
  have hS_lt_I_eps :
      RealTheory.lt S (RealTheory.add I eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt F habs_lt
  have hI_eps_le_M_eps :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.add I eps) (RealTheory.add M eps) :=
    RealTheory.add_le_add_right hIM eps
  have hright :
      RealTheory.lt S (RealTheory.add M eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hS_lt_I_eps hI_eps_le_M_eps
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: hasDarbouxIntegral_lt_bounds_of_taggedSum_gap_lt
statement:
private theorem hasDarbouxIntegral_lt_bounds_of_taggedSum_gap_lt
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b A B I eps : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hI : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b I)
    (hA : RealTheory.le A (taggedSum f p tag n))
    (hB : RealTheory.le (taggedSum f p tag n) B)
    (hgap :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))
        eps) :
    And
      (RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub A eps)
        I)
      (RealTheory.lt
        I
        (RealTheory.add B eps))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let L := lowerSum f p n
  let U := upperSum f p n
  let S := taggedSum f p tag n
  have hS_between :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval L U S := by
    dsimp [L, U, S]
    exact lowerSum_le_taggedSum_le_upperSum htag
      (exists_hasCellInf_of_closedIntervalBounded_partition
        hbdd htag.left)
      (exists_hasCellSup_of_closedIntervalBounded_partition
        hbdd htag.left)
  have hI_between :
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval L U I := by
    dsimp [L, U]
    exact hasDarbouxIntegral_between_darbouxSums htag.left hI
  have habs_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I))
        (RealTheory.sub U L) :=
    abs_sub_le_of_closedInterval_mem hS_between hI_between
  have habs_lt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub S I)) eps := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F habs_le hgap
  have hS_lt_I_eps :
      RealTheory.lt S (RealTheory.add I eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_right_add_of_abs_sub_lt F habs_lt
  have hA_lt_I_eps :
      RealTheory.lt A (RealTheory.add I eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hA hS_lt_I_eps
  have hA_sub_I_lt_eps :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub A I) eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hA_lt_I_eps
  have hleft :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub A eps) I :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right F hA_sub_I_lt_eps
  have hI_lt_S_eps :
      RealTheory.lt I (RealTheory.add S eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_left_add_of_abs_sub_lt F habs_lt
  have hS_eps_le_B_eps :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.add S eps) (RealTheory.add B eps) :=
    RealTheory.add_le_add_right hB eps
  have hright :
      RealTheory.lt I (RealTheory.add B eps) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hI_lt_S_eps hS_eps_le_B_eps
  exact And.intro hleft hright

name: taggedSum_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals_full_gap_lt
statement:
private theorem taggedSum_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals_full_gap_lt
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b m M eps : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hm_nonpos : RealTheory.le m RealTheory.zero)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (hprefixIntegral :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        Exists
          (fun I : Point =>
            And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a (p k) I)
              (And (RealTheory.le m I) (RealTheory.le I M))))
    (hg_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (g x))
    (hg_decr :
      FunctionDecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g)
    (hgap :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))
        eps)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub m eps) (g a))
        (taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n))
      (RealTheory.le
        (taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add M eps) (g a)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hprefix_bounds :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        And
          (RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.sub m eps)
            (taggedSum f p tag k))
          (RealTheory.lt
            (taggedSum f p tag k)
            (RealTheory.add M eps)) :=
    taggedSum_prefixes_lt_bounds_of_hasDarbouxIntegral_full_gap_lt
      hbdd htag hprefixIntegral hgap
  have hlower :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.sub m eps)
          (taggedSum f p tag k) :=
    fun k hk =>
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (hprefix_bounds k hk).left
  have hupper :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        RealTheory.le
          (taggedSum f p tag k)
          (RealTheory.add M eps) :=
    fun k hk =>
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F (hprefix_bounds k hk).right
  have heps_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eps :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F heps
  have hm_eps_nonpos :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub m eps) RealTheory.zero := by
    have hsub_le_m :
        RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub m eps) m :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic
        F heps_nonneg
    exact RealTheory.le_trans hsub_le_m hm_nonpos
  have hM_eps_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.add M eps) := by
    have h :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hM_nonneg heps_nonneg
    change
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero)
        (RealTheory.add M eps) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.zero_add] at h
  exact taggedSum_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_left_endpoint
    (f := f) (g := g) (a := a) (b := b)
    (m := RealTheory.sub m eps) (M := RealTheory.add M eps)
    htag hm_eps_nonpos hM_eps_nonneg hlower hupper
    hg_nonneg hg_decr

name: hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals_gaps_lt
statement:
private theorem hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals_gaps_lt
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b m M I epsF epsFG : Point}
    {n : Nat} {p tag : Nat -> Point}
    (hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hfg_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded (MulFun f g) a b)
    (htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag)
    (hm_nonpos : RealTheory.le m RealTheory.zero)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (hprefixIntegral :
      forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
        Exists
          (fun J : Point =>
            And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a (p k) J)
              (And (RealTheory.le m J) (RealTheory.le J M))))
    (hg_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (g x))
    (hg_decr :
      FunctionDecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g)
    (hfgI : HasDarbouxIntegral (MulFun f g) a b I)
    (hgapF :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))
        epsF)
    (hgapFG :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub
          (upperSum (MulFun f g) p n)
          (lowerSum (MulFun f g) p n))
        epsFG)
    (hepsF : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero epsF) :
    And
      (RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub m epsF) (g a))
          epsFG)
        I)
      (RealTheory.lt
        I
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add M epsF) (g a))
          epsFG))
proof:
:= by
  have htag_bounds :
      And
        (RealTheory.le
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub m epsF) (g a))
          (taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n))
        (RealTheory.le
          (taggedSum (MulFun f g) p tag n)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add M epsF) (g a))) :=
    taggedSum_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals_full_gap_lt
      (f := f) (g := g) (a := a) (b := b)
      (m := m) (M := M) (eps := epsF)
      hf_bdd htag hm_nonpos hM_nonneg hprefixIntegral
      hg_nonneg hg_decr hgapF hepsF
  exact hasDarbouxIntegral_lt_bounds_of_taggedSum_gap_lt
    (f := MulFun f g) (a := a) (b := b)
    (A := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub m epsF) (g a))
    (B := RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add M epsF) (g a))
    (I := I) (eps := epsFG) (n := n) (p := p) (tag := tag)
    hfg_bdd htag hfgI htag_bounds.left htag_bounds.right hgapFG

name: hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals_approx
statement:
private theorem hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals_approx
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b m M I Ftotal eps : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hfI : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b Ftotal)
    (hfg_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded (MulFun f g) a b)
    (hfgI : HasDarbouxIntegral (MulFun f g) a b I)
    (hm_nonpos : RealTheory.le m RealTheory.zero)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (hprefixIntegral :
      forall x : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
        Exists
          (fun J : Point =>
            And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a x J)
              (And (RealTheory.le m J) (RealTheory.le J M))))
    (hg_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (g x))
    (hg_decr :
      FunctionDecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g)
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    And
      (RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul m (g a))
        (RealTheory.add I eps))
      (RealTheory.lt
        I
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul M (g a)) eps))
proof:
:= by
  let OF := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let G := g a
  have hG_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero G := by
    dsimp [G]
    exact hg_nonneg a (RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab)
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half OF eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos OF heps
  cases exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
      (C := G) (eps := e2) hG_nonneg he2_pos with
  | intro d hd =>
      have hd_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero d := hd.left
      have hdG_lt_e2 : RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.mul d G) e2 := by
        have h := hd.right
        dsimp [G] at h
        rw [RealTheory.mul_comm (g a) d] at h
        dsimp [G]
        exact h
      have hbudget :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul d G) e2)
            eps := by
        have h :=
          RealTheory.add_lt_add_right hdG_lt_e2 e2
        have he2_add : RealTheory.add e2 e2 = eps := by
          dsimp [e2]
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half OF eps
        rwa [he2_add] at h
      have hfsmall : DarbouxGapSmall f a b :=
        darbouxGapSmall_of_hasDarbouxIntegral hf_bdd hfI
      have hfgsmall : DarbouxGapSmall (MulFun f g) a b :=
        darbouxGapSmall_of_hasDarbouxIntegral hfg_bdd hfgI
      cases exists_common_partition_darbouxGaps_lt
          (f := f) (h := MulFun f g)
          (a := a) (b := b)
          (epsF := d) (epsH := e2)
          hf_bdd hfg_bdd hfsmall hfgsmall hd_pos he2_pos with
      | intro n hn =>
          cases hn with
          | intro p hp =>
              have hpart : IntervalPartition a b n p := hp.left
              have hgapF :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n)
                      (lowerSum f p n))
                    d := hp.right.left
              have hgapFG :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.sub
                      (upperSum (MulFun f g) p n)
                      (lowerSum (MulFun f g) p n))
                    e2 := hp.right.right
              let tag := leftTags p
              have htag : TaggedPartition a b n p tag :=
                leftTags_taggedPartition hpart
              have hprefix :
                  forall k : Nat, k <= n ->
                    Exists
                      (fun J : Point =>
                        And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a (p k) J)
                          (And (RealTheory.le m J)
                            (RealTheory.le J M))) := by
                intro k hk
                exact hprefixIntegral (p k)
                  (intervalPartition_point_mem_closedInterval hpart hk)
              have herr :
                  And
                    (RealTheory.lt
                      (RealTheory.sub
                        (RealTheory.mul
                          (RealTheory.sub m d) (g a))
                        e2)
                      I)
                    (RealTheory.lt
                      I
                      (RealTheory.add
                        (RealTheory.mul
                          (RealTheory.add M d) (g a))
                        e2)) :=
                hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals_gaps_lt
                  (f := f) (g := g) (a := a) (b := b)
                  (m := m) (M := M) (I := I)
                  (epsF := d) (epsFG := e2)
                  hf_bdd hfg_bdd htag hm_nonpos hM_nonneg
                  hprefix hg_nonneg hg_decr hfgI hgapF hgapFG hd_pos
              have hleft_base :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub m d) G)
                    (RealTheory.add I e2) := by
                have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_sub_lt
                  OF herr.left
                change
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub m d) G)
                    (RealTheory.add e2 I) at h
                rwa [RealTheory.add_comm e2 I] at h
              have hleft_add :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub m d) G)
                      (RealTheory.mul d G))
                    (RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.add I e2)
                      (RealTheory.mul d G)) :=
                RealTheory.add_lt_add_right hleft_base
                  (RealTheory.mul d G)
              have hright_rearr_left :
                  RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.add I e2)
                      (RealTheory.mul d G) =
                    RealTheory.add I
                      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul d G) e2) := by
                rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
                rw [RealTheory.add_comm e2 (RealTheory.mul d G)]
              have hmG_lt_I_budget :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.mul m G)
                    (RealTheory.add I
                      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul d G) e2)) := by
                rwa [sub_mul_add_mul_cancel_right_real m d G,
                  hright_rearr_left] at hleft_add
              have hI_budget_lt :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.add I
                      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul d G) e2))
                    (RealTheory.add I eps) :=
                RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hbudget I
              have hleft_final :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.mul m (g a))
                    (RealTheory.add I eps) := by
                dsimp [G] at hmG_lt_I_budget
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans OF
                  hmG_lt_I_budget hI_budget_lt
              have hright_rearr :
                  RealTheory.add
                      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add M d) G)
                      e2 =
                    RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul M G)
                      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul d G) e2) := by
                rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
                rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
              have hright_mid :
                  RealTheory.lt I
                    (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul M G)
                      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul d G) e2)) := by
                have h0 :
                    RealTheory.lt I
                      (RealTheory.add
                        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add M d) G) e2) := by
                  change
                    RealTheory.lt I
                      (RealTheory.add
                        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.add M d) (g a)) e2)
                  exact herr.right
                rwa [hright_rearr] at h0
              have hright_budget_lt :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul M G)
                      (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul d G) e2))
                    (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul M G) eps) :=
                RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hbudget
                  (RealTheory.mul M G)
              have hright_final :
                  RealTheory.lt I
                    (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.mul M (g a)) eps) := by
                dsimp [G] at hright_mid
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans OF
                  hright_mid hright_budget_lt
              exact And.intro hleft_final hright_final

name: hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals
statement:
private theorem hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals
    {f g : Point -> Point} {a b m M I Ftotal : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hfI : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b Ftotal)
    (hfg_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded (MulFun f g) a b)
    (hfgI : HasDarbouxIntegral (MulFun f g) a b I)
    (hm_nonpos : RealTheory.le m RealTheory.zero)
    (hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M)
    (hprefixIntegral :
      forall x : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
        Exists
          (fun J : Point =>
            And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a x J)
              (And (RealTheory.le m J) (RealTheory.le J M))))
    (hg_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (g x))
    (hg_decr :
      FunctionDecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g) :
    And
      (RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul m (g a)) I)
      (RealTheory.le I (RealTheory.mul M (g a)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_forall_lt_add_pos F
    (x := RealTheory.mul m (g a)) (y := I)
    (fun eps heps =>
      (hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals_approx
        (f := f) (g := g) (a := a) (b := b)
        (m := m) (M := M) (I := I) (Ftotal := Ftotal)
        (eps := eps)
        hab hf_bdd hfI hfg_bdd hfgI hm_nonpos hM_nonneg
        hprefixIntegral hg_nonneg hg_decr heps).left)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_forall_lt_add_pos F
    (x := I) (y := RealTheory.mul M (g a))
    (fun eps heps =>
      (hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals_approx
        (f := f) (g := g) (a := a) (b := b)
        (m := m) (M := M) (I := I) (Ftotal := Ftotal)
        (eps := eps)
        hab hf_bdd hfI hfg_bdd hfgI hm_nonpos hM_nonneg
        hprefixIntegral hg_nonneg hg_decr heps).right)

name: RiemannInternal.exists_coeff_between_of_mul_bounds
statement:
theorem RiemannInternal.exists_coeff_between_of_mul_bounds
    {m M G I : Point}
    (hmM : RealTheory.le m M)
    (hGnonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero G)
    (hleft : RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul m G) I)
    (hright : RealTheory.le I (RealTheory.mul M G)) :
    Exists fun mu : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.le m mu)
        (And (RealTheory.le mu M)
          (I = RealTheory.mul mu G))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hGzero : G = RealTheory.zero
  ·
      have hI_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero I := by
        rwa [hGzero, RealTheory.mul_zero] at hleft
      have hI_nonpos : RealTheory.le I RealTheory.zero := by
        rwa [hGzero, RealTheory.mul_zero] at hright
      have hIzero : I = RealTheory.zero :=
        RealTheory.le_antisymm hI_nonpos hI_nonneg
      refine Exists.intro m ?_
      refine And.intro (RealTheory.le_refl m) ?_
      refine And.intro hmM ?_
      rw [hIzero, hGzero, RealTheory.mul_zero]
  ·
      have hnot_le_G0 : Not (RealTheory.le G RealTheory.zero) := by
        intro hGle0
        exact hGzero (RealTheory.le_antisymm hGle0 hGnonneg)
      have hGpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero G := by
        exact (RealTheory.lt_def).mpr
          (And.intro hGnonneg hnot_le_G0)
      have hGne : Not (G = RealTheory.zero) := hGzero
      have hinv_nonneg :
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv G) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos
            RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hGpos)
      have hm_le_mu :
          RealTheory.le m (RealTheory.mul I (RealTheory.inv G)) := by
        have hmul :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul m G)
                (RealTheory.inv G))
              (RealTheory.mul I (RealTheory.inv G)) :=
          RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hleft hinv_nonneg
        rwa [mul_mul_inv_cancel_right_real m hGne] at hmul
      have hmu_le_M :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul I (RealTheory.inv G)) M := by
        have hmul :
            RealTheory.le
              (RealTheory.mul I (RealTheory.inv G))
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul M G)
                (RealTheory.inv G)) :=
          RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right hright hinv_nonneg
        rwa [mul_mul_inv_cancel_right_real M hGne] at hmul
      refine Exists.intro (RealTheory.mul I (RealTheory.inv G)) ?_
      refine And.intro hm_le_mu ?_
      refine And.intro hmu_le_M ?_
      exact Eq.symm (mul_inv_mul_cancel_right_real I hGne)

name: RiemannInternal.exists_point_hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight
statement:
theorem RiemannInternal.exists_point_hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight
    {f g F : Point -> Point} {a b I : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hfg_bdd : ClosedIntervalBounded (MulFun f g) a b)
    (hfgI : HasDarbouxIntegral (MulFun f g) a b I)
    (hF_cont :
      RealTheory.FunctionContinuousOn
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F)
    (hF_prefix :
      forall x : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
        HasDarbouxIntegral f a x (F x))
    (hg_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (g x))
    (hg_decr :
      FunctionDecreasingOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) g) :
    Exists fun xi : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b xi)
        (And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a xi (F xi))
          (I = RealTheory.mul (g a) (F xi)))
proof:
:= by
  have ha_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b a :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_left_mem hab
  have hb_mem : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b b :=
    RealTheory.closedInterval_right_mem hab
  have hfI : HasDarbouxIntegral f a b (F b) :=
    hF_prefix b hb_mem
  have hbdd_aa : ClosedIntervalBounded f a a :=
    closedIntervalBounded_restrict_left
      (RealTheory.le_refl a) hab hf_bdd
  have hFa_zero : F a = RealTheory.zero :=
    hasDarbouxIntegral_value_eq_zero_of_degenerate
      hbdd_aa (hF_prefix a ha_mem)
  have hext :
      And
        (RealTheory.FunctionAttainsMinimumOn
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F)
        (RealTheory.FunctionAttainsMaximumOn
          (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) F) :=
    RealTheory.function_continuousOn_closedInterval_attainsExtrema
      hab hF_cont
  cases hext.left with
  | intro xmin hmin =>
      cases hext.right with
      | intro xmax hmax =>
          let m := F xmin
          let M := F xmax
          have hmM : RealTheory.le m M := by
            dsimp [m, M]
            exact hmin.right xmax hmax.left
          have hm_nonpos : RealTheory.le m RealTheory.zero := by
            dsimp [m]
            have h := hmin.right a ha_mem
            rwa [hFa_zero] at h
          have hM_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero M := by
            dsimp [M]
            have h := hmax.right a ha_mem
            rwa [hFa_zero] at h
          have hprefix_bounds :
              forall x : Point, RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
                Exists
                  (fun J : Point =>
                    And (HasDarbouxIntegral f a x J)
                      (And (RealTheory.le m J) (RealTheory.le J M))) := by
            intro x hx
            refine Exists.intro (F x) ?_
            refine And.intro (hF_prefix x hx) ?_
            exact And.intro (hmin.right x hx) (hmax.right x hx)
          have hbounds :
              And
                (RealTheory.le (RealTheory.mul m (g a)) I)
                (RealTheory.le I (RealTheory.mul M (g a))) :=
            hasDarbouxIntegral_mul_decreasing_nonneg_weight_between_prefix_integrals
              (f := f) (g := g) (a := a) (b := b)
              (m := m) (M := M) (I := I) (Ftotal := F b)
              hab hf_bdd hfI hfg_bdd hfgI
              hm_nonpos hM_nonneg hprefix_bounds
              hg_nonneg hg_decr
          have hga_nonneg : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (g a) :=
            hg_nonneg a ha_mem
          by_cases hga_zero : g a = RealTheory.zero
          case pos =>
            have hleft_zero : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero I := by
              have hleft := hbounds.left
              rwa [hga_zero, RealTheory.mul_zero] at hleft
            have hright_zero : RealTheory.le I RealTheory.zero := by
              have hright := hbounds.right
              rwa [hga_zero, RealTheory.mul_zero] at hright
            have hI_zero : I = RealTheory.zero :=
              RealTheory.le_antisymm hright_zero hleft_zero
            refine Exists.intro a ?_
            refine And.intro ha_mem ?_
            refine And.intro (hF_prefix a ha_mem) ?_
            rw [hI_zero, hga_zero, RealTheory.zero_mul]
          case neg =>
            cases RiemannInternal.exists_coeff_between_of_mul_bounds
                (m := m) (M := M) (G := g a) (I := I)
                hmM hga_nonneg hbounds.left hbounds.right with
            | intro mu hmu =>
                have hbetween :
                    RealTheory.Between (F xmin) mu (F xmax) := by
                  dsimp [m, M] at hmu
                  exact And.intro hmu.left hmu.right.left
                cases RealTheory.function_intermediate_value_of_connected
                    (RealTheory.connected_closedInterval a b)
                    hF_cont hmin.left hmax.left hbetween with
                | intro xi hxi =>
                    refine Exists.intro xi ?_
                    refine And.intro hxi.left ?_
                    refine And.intro (hF_prefix xi hxi.left) ?_
                    rw [hxi.right]
                    rw [RealTheory.mul_comm (g a) mu]
                    exact hmu.right.right

name: intervalPartition_partitionCell_mem_closedInterval
statement:
theorem intervalPartition_partitionCell_mem_closedInterval
    {a b : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat} {x : Point}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)

    (hx : PartitionCell p k x) :
    RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x
proof:
:= by
  have ha_le_pk : RealTheory.le a (p k) := by
    rw [<- intervalPartition_left_endpoint hp]
    exact intervalPartition_le_of_le hp 0 k
      (Nat.zero_le k) (Nat.le_of_lt hk)
  have hpk1_le_b : RealTheory.le (p (k + 1)) b := by
    rw [<- intervalPartition_right_endpoint hp]
    exact intervalPartition_le_of_le hp (k + 1) n
      (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk) (Nat.le_refl n)
  exact And.intro
    (RealTheory.le_trans ha_le_pk hx.left)
    (RealTheory.le_trans hx.right hpk1_le_b)

theorem finiteSum_shifted_cellLength
    (p : Nat -> Point) (start count : Nat) :

      RealTheory.sub (p (start + count)) (p start)
proof:
:= by

  have hcongr :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => cellLength (suffixPartition p start) j) count =

name: abs_sub_le_add_bound_of_closedIntervalBoundedWitness
statement:
theorem abs_sub_le_add_bound_of_closedIntervalBoundedWitness
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b B x y : Point}
    (hbound :
      forall z : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b z ->
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.abs (f z)) B)
    (hx : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x)
    (hy : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.abs (RealTheory.sub (f x) (f y)))
      (RealTheory.add B B)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htri := RealTheory.abs_add_le_abs_add_abs
    (f x) (RealTheory.neg (f y))
  change
    F.le
      (RealTheory.abs (F.add (f x) (F.neg (f y))))
      (F.add (RealTheory.abs (f x))
        (RealTheory.abs (F.neg (f y)))) at htri
  rw [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg (f x) (f y)] at htri
  rw [RealTheory.abs_neg (f y)] at htri
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.abs (f x)) (RealTheory.abs (f y)))
      (RealTheory.add B B) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F (hbound x hx) (hbound y hy)
  exact RealTheory.le_trans htri hsum

name: exists_cellOscillationBound_of_closedIntervalBounded
statement:
theorem exists_cellOscillationBound_of_closedIntervalBounded
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b) :
    Exists
      (fun C : Point =>
        And (RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C)
          (forall {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat} {omega : Point},
            IntervalPartition a b n p ->
            k < n ->
            IsCellOscillation f p k omega ->
            RealTheory.le omega C))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hbdd with
  | intro B hB =>
      let C := RealTheory.add B B
      refine Exists.intro C ?_
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · have hzero :
            F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero) (F.add B B) :=
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hB.left hB.left
        change F.le F.zero (F.add B B)
        rwa [F.zero_add] at hzero
      · intro p n k omega hp hk homega
        refine isCellOscillation_le_of_pairwise_le homega ?_
        intro x y hx hy
        exact abs_sub_le_add_bound_of_closedIntervalBoundedWitness
          hB.right
          (intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval hp hk hx)
          (intervalPartition_cell_subset_closedInterval hp hk hy)

private theorem partitionCellOpenCover_ordered
    {a b radius : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}

proof:

  have hleft_lt :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub (p k) radius) (p k) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hradius
  have hleft_le :
      RealTheory.le (RealTheory.sub (p k) radius) (p k) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hleft_lt
  have hcell : PartitionCell p k (p k) :=
    intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hp hk
  have hright_lt :
      RealTheory.lt (p (k + 1)) (RealTheory.add (p (k + 1)) radius) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hradius
  have hright_le :
      RealTheory.le (p (k + 1))
        (RealTheory.add (p (k + 1)) radius) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hright_lt
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hleft_le
    (RealTheory.le_trans hcell.right hright_le)

name: doubleRadius_nonnegative
statement:
private theorem doubleRadius_nonnegative
    {radius : Point}
    (hradius : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero radius) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (doubleRadius radius)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hradius)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hradius)
  unfold doubleRadius
  change F.le (F.add F.zero F.zero) (F.add radius radius) at h
  rwa [F.zero_add] at h

name: partitionCellOpenCover_length_eq
statement:
private theorem partitionCellOpenCover_length_eq
    (p : Nat -> Point) (radius : Point) (k : Nat) :
    RealNegligibility.intervalLength
        (partitionCellOpenCoverLeft p radius k)
        (partitionCellOpenCoverRight p radius k) =
      RealTheory.add (cellLength p k) (doubleRadius radius)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealNegligibility.intervalLength partitionCellOpenCoverLeft
    partitionCellOpenCoverRight cellLength doubleRadius
  change
    F.sub (F.add (p (k + 1)) radius) (F.sub (p k) radius) =
      F.add (F.sub (p (k + 1)) (p k)) (F.add radius radius)
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (p k) radius]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
    F (p (k + 1)) radius (p k) (F.neg radius)]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg radius (F.neg radius)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F radius]

name: partitionPointOpenCover_ordered
statement:
private theorem partitionPointOpenCover_ordered
    {radius : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    (hradius : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero radius) :
    RealTheory.le
      (partitionPointOpenCoverLeft p radius k)
      (partitionPointOpenCoverRight p radius k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hleft_lt :
      RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub (p k) radius) (p k) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hradius
  have hright_lt :
      RealTheory.lt (p k) (RealTheory.add (p k) radius) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hradius
  exact RealTheory.le_trans
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hleft_lt)
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hright_lt)

name: partitionPoint_mem_openCover
statement:
private theorem partitionPoint_mem_openCover
    {radius : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    (hradius : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero radius) :

      (partitionPointOpenCoverLeft p radius k)
      (partitionPointOpenCoverRight p radius k) (p k)
proof:

  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · unfold partitionPointOpenCoverLeft
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hradius
  · unfold partitionPointOpenCoverRight
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hradius

name: partitionPointOpenCover_length_eq
statement:
private theorem partitionPointOpenCover_length_eq

name: finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_partitionPointOpenCover
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_partitionPointOpenCover
    (p : Nat -> Point) (radius : Point) (n : Nat) :
    finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
        (partitionPointOpenCoverLeft p radius)
        (partitionPointOpenCoverRight p radius) n =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) (doubleRadius radius)
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
  have hcongr :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealNegligibility.intervalLength
              (partitionPointOpenCoverLeft p radius k)
              (partitionPointOpenCoverRight p radius k)) n =
        RealTheory.finiteSum (fun _k : Nat => doubleRadius radius) n :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt n
      (fun k _hk => partitionPointOpenCover_length_eq p radius k)

name: countableOpenIntervalCover_of_finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo
statement:
private theorem countableOpenIntervalCover_of_finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo
    {E : Point -> Prop} {left right : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hcover : FiniteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo E left right n) :
    RealNegligibility.CountableOpenIntervalCover E
      (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableLeft left n)
      (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableRight right n)
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro k
    unfold finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableLeft
    unfold finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableRight
    by_cases hk : k < n
    · simp [hk]
      exact hcover.left k hk
    · simp [hk]
      exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  · intro x hx
    cases hcover.right x hx with
    | intro k hk =>
        refine Exists.intro k ?_
        unfold finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableLeft
        unfold finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableRight
        simp [hk.left]
        exact hk.right

name: finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountable_prefix_length_eq

          (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableLeft left n)
          (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableRight right n)) n =
      finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right n

  intro k hk
  unfold RealNegligibility.coverLength
  unfold finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableLeft
  unfold finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableRight

name: finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountable_tail_length_zero
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountable_tail_length_zero
    (left right : Nat -> Point) (n j : Nat) :

      RealTheory.zero
proof:

  unfold finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableLeft
  unfold finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableRight
  simp [hnot]

name: coverBudgetLt_of_finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_lt
statement:
private theorem coverBudgetLt_of_finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_lt
    {E : Point -> Prop} {left right : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    {eps : Point}
    (hcover : FiniteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo E left right n)
    (hlength :
      RealTheory.lt
        (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right n) eps) :
    RealNegligibility.CoverBudgetLt
      (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableLeft left n)
      (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableRight right n) eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hordered :
      forall k : Nat,
        RealTheory.le
          (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableLeft left n k)
          (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableRight right n k) :=
    (countableOpenIntervalCover_of_finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo hcover).left
  have hprefix :
      RealTheory.le
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
          (RealNegligibility.coverLength
            (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableLeft left n)
            (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableRight right n)) n)
        (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right n) := by
    rw [finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountable_prefix_length_eq]
    exact RealTheory.le_refl (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right n)
  have htail :
      forall N : Nat,
        RealTheory.le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.seriesPartialSum F
            (fun j : Nat =>
              RealNegligibility.coverLength
                (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableLeft left n)
                (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableRight right n) (n + j)) N)
          RealTheory.zero := by
    intro N
    rw [finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountable_tail_partialSum_zero]
    exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero
  have hbudget :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right n)
          RealTheory.zero) eps := by
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero]
  exact
    RealNegligibility.coverBudgetLt_of_prefix_tail_bounds
      n hordered hprefix htail hbudget

name: nullSet_of_arbitrarily_small_finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo
statement:
private theorem nullSet_of_arbitrarily_small_finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo
    {E : Point -> Prop}
    (hfinite :
      forall eps : Point,
        RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps ->
          Exists
            (fun n : Nat =>
              Exists
                (fun left : Nat -> Point =>
                  Exists
                    (fun right : Nat -> Point =>
                      And
                        (FiniteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo E left right n)
                        (RealTheory.lt
                          (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right n)
                          eps))))) :
    RealNegligibility.NullSet E
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hfinite eps heps with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases hn with
      | intro left hleft =>
          cases hleft with
          | intro right hright =>
              refine Exists.intro
                (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableLeft left n) ?_
              refine Exists.intro
                (finiteOpenIntervalCoverCountableRight right n) ?_
              exact And.intro
                (countableOpenIntervalCover_of_finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo
                  hright.left)
                (coverBudgetLt_of_finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_lt
                  hright.left hright.right)

name: finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo_largeCellOrPartitionPoint
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo_largeCellOrPartitionPoint
    {a b eps cellRadius pointRadius : Point}
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hcellRadius : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero cellRadius)
    (hpointRadius : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero pointRadius) :
    FiniteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo
      (PointCoveredByLargeCellOrPartitionPoint f p n eps)
      (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
      (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
      (n + (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro k hk_total
    by_cases hk : k < n
    · unfold largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
      unfold largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
      by_cases hlarge : CellOscillationNotLtThreshold f p k eps
      · simp [hk, hlarge]
        exact partitionCellOpenCover_ordered hp hk hcellRadius
      · simp [hk, hlarge]
        exact RealTheory.le_refl (p k)
    · unfold largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
      unfold largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
      simp [hk]
      exact partitionPointOpenCover_ordered hpointRadius
  · intro x hx
    cases hx with
    | inl hlarge =>
        cases hlarge with
        | intro k hk =>
            refine Exists.intro k ?_
            have hk_total : k < n + (n + 1) :=
              Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk.left (Nat.le_add_right n (n + 1))
            refine And.intro hk_total ?_
            unfold largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
            unfold largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
            simp [hk.left, hk.right.right]
            exact partitionCell_mem_openCover_of_partitionCell
              hcellRadius hk.right.left
    | inr hpoint =>
        cases hpoint with
        | intro j hj =>
            refine Exists.intro (n + j) ?_
            have hj_lt : j < n + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj.left
            have htotal : n + j < n + (n + 1) :=
              Nat.add_lt_add_left hj_lt n
            refine And.intro htotal ?_
            have hnot : Not (n + j < n) :=
              Nat.not_lt_of_ge (Nat.le_add_right n j)
            unfold largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
            unfold largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
            simp [hnot, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
            rw [hj.right]
            exact partitionPoint_mem_openCover hpointRadius

name: largeCellPartitionPointCoverLength_prefix_term_le
statement:
private theorem largeCellPartitionPointCoverLength_prefix_term_le
    {eps cellRadius pointRadius : Point}
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}
    (hcellRadius : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero cellRadius)
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealNegligibility.intervalLength
        (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
          f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n k)
        (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
          f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n k))
      (RealTheory.add
        (largeOscillationCellLengthTerm f p eps k)
        (doubleRadius cellRadius))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
  unfold largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
  by_cases hlarge : CellOscillationNotLtThreshold f p k eps
  · simp [hk, hlarge]
    rw [partitionCellOpenCover_length_eq]
    unfold largeOscillationCellLengthTerm
    simp [hlarge]
    exact RealTheory.le_refl
      (RealTheory.add (cellLength p k) (doubleRadius cellRadius))
  · simp [hk, hlarge]
    unfold RealNegligibility.intervalLength
    rw [RealTheory.sub_eq_add_neg, RealTheory.add_neg]
    unfold largeOscillationCellLengthTerm

name: finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_largeCellPartitionPoint_prefix_le
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_largeCellPartitionPoint_prefix_le
    {eps cellRadius pointRadius : Point}
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hcellRadius : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero cellRadius) :
    RealTheory.le
      (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
        (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
          f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
        (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
          f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n) n)
      (RealTheory.add
        (largeOscillationCellLengthSum f p n eps)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
          (doubleRadius cellRadius)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealNegligibility.intervalLength
              (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
                f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n k)
              (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
                f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n k)) n)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.add
              (largeOscillationCellLengthTerm f p eps k)
              (doubleRadius cellRadius)) n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealNegligibility.intervalLength
          (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
            f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n k)
          (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
            f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n k))
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.add
          (largeOscillationCellLengthTerm f p eps k)
          (doubleRadius cellRadius))
      n
      (fun k hk =>
        largeCellPartitionPointCoverLength_prefix_term_le
          (f := f) (p := p) (eps := eps)
          (cellRadius := cellRadius) (pointRadius := pointRadius)
          hcellRadius hk)
  have hbudget :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.add
              (largeOscillationCellLengthTerm f p eps k)
              (doubleRadius cellRadius)) n =
        RealTheory.add
          (largeOscillationCellLengthSum f p n eps)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
            (doubleRadius cellRadius)) := by
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
    unfold largeOscillationCellLengthSum
    rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_const]
  rwa [hbudget] at hsum

name: largeCellPartitionPointCoverLength_tail_eq_pointCover

name: finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_largeCellPartitionPoint_tail_eq
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_largeCellPartitionPoint_tail_eq
    {eps cellRadius pointRadius : Point}
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat} :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          RealNegligibility.intervalLength
            (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
              f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n (n + j))
            (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
              f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n (n + j))) (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (doubleRadius pointRadius)
proof:
:= by
  have hcongr :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat =>
            RealNegligibility.intervalLength
              (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft

        finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
          (partitionPointOpenCoverLeft p pointRadius)

    RealTheory.finiteSum_congr_lt (n + 1)
      (fun j _hj =>
