          (f := f) (p := p) (eps := eps)
          (cellRadius := cellRadius) (pointRadius := pointRadius)
          (n := n) (j := j))
  rw [hcongr]
  exact finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_partitionPointOpenCover
    p pointRadius (n + 1)

name: finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_largeCellOrPartitionPoint_le
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_largeCellOrPartitionPoint_le
    {eps cellRadius pointRadius : Point}
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hcellRadius : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero cellRadius) :
    RealTheory.le
      (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
        (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
          f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
        (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
          f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
        (n + (n + 1)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.add
          (largeOscillationCellLengthSum f p n eps)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
            (doubleRadius cellRadius)))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
          (doubleRadius pointRadius)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length]
  have hprefix :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealNegligibility.intervalLength
              (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
                f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n k)
              (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
                f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n k)) n)
        (RealTheory.add
          (largeOscillationCellLengthSum f p n eps)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
            (doubleRadius cellRadius))) :=
    finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_largeCellPartitionPoint_prefix_le
      (f := f) (p := p) (eps := eps)
      (cellRadius := cellRadius) (pointRadius := pointRadius)
      hcellRadius
  rw [finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_largeCellPartitionPoint_tail_eq
    (f := f) (p := p) (eps := eps)
    (cellRadius := cellRadius) (pointRadius := pointRadius)
    (n := n)]
  exact RealTheory.add_le_add_right hprefix
    (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1)) (doubleRadius pointRadius))

name: eps_mul_largeOscillationCellLengthTerm_le_weightedTerm
statement:
private theorem eps_mul_largeOscillationCellLengthTerm_le_weightedTerm
    {a b eps : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {p omega : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n)
    (homega : IsCellOscillation f p k (omega k)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul eps
        (largeOscillationCellLengthTerm f p eps k))
      (RealTheory.mul (omega k) (cellLength p k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hlarge : CellOscillationNotLtThreshold f p k eps
  · unfold largeOscillationCellLengthTerm
    simp [hlarge]
    have heps_le :
        RealTheory.le eps (omega k) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F (hlarge (omega k) homega)
    exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      heps_le (cellLength_nonnegative hp hk)
  · unfold largeOscillationCellLengthTerm
    simp [hlarge]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_zero]
    have hne : Exists (PartitionCell p k) :=
      Exists.intro (p k) (intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hp hk)
    have homega_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (omega k) :=
      isCellOscillation_nonnegative homega hne
    exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg homega_nonneg
      (cellLength_nonnegative hp hk)

name: isCellOscillation_le_darbouxCellSpread
statement:
private theorem isCellOscillation_le_darbouxCellSpread
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    {omega : Point}
    (hsup : Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M))
    (hinf : Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m))
    (homega : IsCellOscillation f p k omega) :
    RealTheory.le omega (darbouxCellSpread f p k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  refine isCellOscillation_le_of_pairwise_le homega ?_
  intro x y hx hy
  unfold darbouxCellSpread
  apply RealTheory.abs_le_of_bounds
  · exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
      (le_cellUpper hsup hx) (cellLower_le hinf hy)
  · change F.le (F.neg (F.sub (f x) (f y)))
      (F.sub (cellUpper f p k) (cellLower f p k))
    rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F (f x) (f y)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
      (le_cellUpper hsup hy) (cellLower_le hinf hx)

name: darbouxCellSpread_nonnegative
statement:
private theorem darbouxCellSpread_nonnegative
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {k : Nat}
    (hsup : Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M))
    (hinf : Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m))
    (hne : Exists (PartitionCell p k)) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (darbouxCellSpread f p k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hne with
  | intro x hx =>
      have hle :
          RealTheory.le (cellLower f p k) (cellUpper f p k) :=
        RealTheory.le_trans (cellLower_le hinf hx) (le_cellUpper hsup hx)
      unfold darbouxCellSpread
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hle

name: eps_mul_largeOscillationCellLengthTerm_le_darbouxSpreadTerm
statement:
private theorem eps_mul_largeOscillationCellLengthTerm_le_darbouxSpreadTerm
    {a b eps : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {p : Nat -> Point} {n k : Nat}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hk : k < n) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul eps
        (largeOscillationCellLengthTerm f p eps k))
      (RealTheory.mul (darbouxCellSpread f p k) (cellLength p k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hsup : Exists (fun M : Point => HasCellSup f p k M) :=
    exists_hasCellSup_of_closedIntervalBounded hbdd hp hk
  have hinf : Exists (fun m : Point => HasCellInf f p k m) :=
    exists_hasCellInf_of_closedIntervalBounded hbdd hp hk
  have hne : Exists (PartitionCell p k) :=
    Exists.intro (p k) (intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hp hk)
  by_cases hlarge : CellOscillationNotLtThreshold f p k eps
  · unfold largeOscillationCellLengthTerm
    simp [hlarge]
    have hnot_spread_lt :
        Not (RealTheory.lt (darbouxCellSpread f p k) eps) := by
      intro hspread_lt
      cases exists_isCellOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded hbdd hp hk with
      | intro omega homega =>
          have homega_le :
              RealTheory.le omega (darbouxCellSpread f p k) :=
            isCellOscillation_le_darbouxCellSpread hsup hinf homega
          have homega_lt : RealTheory.lt omega eps :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
              homega_le hspread_lt
          exact hlarge omega homega homega_lt
    have heps_le :
        RealTheory.le eps (darbouxCellSpread f p k) :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_not_lt F hnot_spread_lt
    exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      heps_le (cellLength_nonnegative hp hk)
  · unfold largeOscillationCellLengthTerm
    simp [hlarge]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_zero]
    have hspread_nonneg :
        RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (darbouxCellSpread f p k) :=
      darbouxCellSpread_nonnegative hsup hinf hne
    exact RealTheory.mul_nonneg hspread_nonneg
      (cellLength_nonnegative hp hk)

name: eps_mul_largeOscillationCellLengthSum_le_darbouxGapSpreadSum
statement:
private theorem eps_mul_largeOscillationCellLengthSum_le_darbouxGapSpreadSum
    {a b eps : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {p : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul eps
        (largeOscillationCellLengthSum f p n eps))
      (darbouxGapSpreadSum f p n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold largeOscillationCellLengthSum
  unfold darbouxGapSpreadSum
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul eps
              (largeOscillationCellLengthTerm f p eps k)) n =
        RealTheory.mul eps
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (largeOscillationCellLengthTerm f p eps) n) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left eps
      (largeOscillationCellLengthTerm f p eps) n
  rw [<- hmul]
  exact RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
    (fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul eps
        (largeOscillationCellLengthTerm f p eps k))
    (fun k : Nat =>
      RealTheory.mul (darbouxCellSpread f p k) (cellLength p k))
    n
    (fun k hk =>
      eps_mul_largeOscillationCellLengthTerm_le_darbouxSpreadTerm
        hbdd hp hk)

name: closedInterval_pointLocallyContainedInPartitionCell_or_partitionPoint
statement:
private theorem closedInterval_pointLocallyContainedInPartitionCell_or_partitionPoint
    {a b x : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} :
    forall {n : Nat},
      IntervalPartition a b n p ->
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
        Or
          (PointLocallyContainedInPartitionCell
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) p n x)
          (PartitionPointUpTo p n x)
  | 0, hp, hx => by
      right
      refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
      refine And.intro (Nat.le_refl 0) ?_
      have hp0a : p 0 = a
proof:
:= hp.left
      have hp0b : p 0 = b := hp.right.left
      have hp0_le_x : RealTheory.le (p 0) x := by
        rw [hp0a]
        exact hx.left
      have hx_le_hp0 : RealTheory.le x (p 0) := by
        rw [hp0b]
        exact hx.right
      exact RealTheory.le_antisymm hx_le_hp0 hp0_le_x
  | n + 1, hp, hx => by
      let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      cases intervalPartition_cell_cover_succ (n := n) (p := p) hp hx with
      | intro k hkcell =>
          by_cases hleft : x = p k
          · right
            refine Exists.intro k ?_
            exact And.intro (Nat.le_of_lt hkcell.left) hleft
          · by_cases hright : x = p (k + 1)
            · right
              refine Exists.intro (k + 1) ?_
              refine And.intro ?_ hright
              omega
            · left
              have hpk_lt_x : RealTheory.lt (p k) x :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
                  F hkcell.right.left
                  (by
                    intro hx_le_pk
                    exact hleft
                      (RealTheory.le_antisymm hx_le_pk
                        hkcell.right.left))
              have hx_lt_pk1 : RealTheory.lt x (p (k + 1)) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
                  F hkcell.right.right
                  (by
                    intro hpk1_le_x
                    exact hright
                      (RealTheory.le_antisymm hkcell.right.right
                        hpk1_le_x))
              let leftGap := RealTheory.sub x (p k)
              let rightGap := RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) x
              let delta := RealTheory.min leftGap rightGap
              have hleftGap_pos :
                  RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero leftGap := by
                dsimp [leftGap]
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hpk_lt_x
              have hrightGap_pos :
                  RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero rightGap := by
                dsimp [rightGap]
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx_lt_pk1
              have hdelta_pos :
                  RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta := by
                dsimp [delta, RealTheory.min]
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos
                  F hleftGap_pos hrightGap_pos
              refine Exists.intro k ?_
              refine And.intro hkcell.left ?_
              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
              refine And.intro hdelta_pos ?_
              intro y hy
              unfold PartitionCell
              have hdist :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) delta := hy.right
              have hsub_lt_y :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x delta) y :=
                sub_radius_lt_of_dist_lt
                  (x := y) (c := x) (radius := delta) hdist
              have hy_lt_add :
                  RealTheory.lt y (RealTheory.add x delta) :=
                lt_add_radius_of_dist_lt
                  (x := y) (c := x) (radius := delta) hdist
              have hdelta_le_left :
                  RealTheory.le delta leftGap := by
                dsimp [delta]
                exact RealTheory.min_le_left leftGap rightGap
              have hdelta_le_right :
                  RealTheory.le delta rightGap := by
                dsimp [delta]
                exact RealTheory.min_le_right leftGap rightGap
              have hpk_le_sub :
                  RealTheory.le (p k) (RealTheory.sub x delta) := by
                have hraw :
                    RealTheory.le
                      (RealTheory.sub x leftGap)
                      (RealTheory.sub x delta) :=
                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le
                    F (RealTheory.le_refl x) hdelta_le_left
                have hleft_eq :
                    RealTheory.sub x leftGap = p k := by
                  dsimp [leftGap]
                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self_sub F x (p k)
                rwa [hleft_eq] at hraw
              have hpk_le_y : RealTheory.le (p k) y :=
                RealTheory.le_trans hpk_le_sub
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hsub_lt_y)
              have hadd_le :
                  RealTheory.le
                    (RealTheory.add x delta)
                    (RealTheory.add x rightGap) :=
                RealTheory.add_le_add_left hdelta_le_right x
              have hright_eq :
                  RealTheory.add x rightGap = p (k + 1) := by
                dsimp [rightGap]
                rw [RealTheory.add_comm x
                  (RealTheory.sub (p (k + 1)) x)]
                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_cancel
                  F (p (k + 1)) x
              have hle_right :
                  RealTheory.le (RealTheory.add x delta) (p (k + 1)) := by
                rwa [hright_eq] at hadd_le
              have hy_le_pk1 : RealTheory.le y (p (k + 1)) :=
                RealTheory.le_trans
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hy_lt_add)
                  hle_right
              exact And.intro hpk_le_y hy_le_pk1

name: largeOscillationCellLengthSum_lt_of_darbouxGap_lt_mul
statement:
private theorem largeOscillationCellLengthSum_lt_of_darbouxGap_lt_mul
    {a b eps badLengthBudget : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {p : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)

      RealTheory.lt

      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul eps
          (largeOscillationCellLengthSum f p n eps))

    eps_mul_largeOscillationCellLengthSum_lt_of_darbouxGap_lt

name: finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo_closedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet_length_lt_of_darbouxGap_lt
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo_closedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet_length_lt_of_darbouxGap_lt
    {a b eps badLengthBudget cellRadius pointRadius totalBudget : Point}
    {f : Point -> Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {n : Nat}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b n p)
    (hcellRadius : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero cellRadius)
    (hpointRadius : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero pointRadius)
    (hgap :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub (upperSum f p n) (lowerSum f p n))
        (RealTheory.mul eps badLengthBudget))
    (hbudget :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add badLengthBudget
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
              (doubleRadius cellRadius)))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (doubleRadius pointRadius)))
        totalBudget) :
    And
      (FiniteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo
        (ClosedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet f a b eps)
        (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
          f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
        (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
          f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
        (n + (n + 1)))
      (RealTheory.lt
        (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
          (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
            f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
          (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
            f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
          (n + (n + 1)))
        totalBudget)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcover :
      FiniteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo
        (ClosedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet f a b eps)
        (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
          f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
        (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
          f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
        (n + (n + 1)) :=
    finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo_closedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet_of_partition
      hp hcellRadius hpointRadius
  have hlarge_lt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (largeOscillationCellLengthSum f p n eps)
        badLengthBudget :=
    largeOscillationCellLengthSum_lt_of_darbouxGap_lt_mul
      heps hbdd hp hgap
  have hlength_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
          (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
            f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
          (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
            f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
          (n + (n + 1)))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (largeOscillationCellLengthSum f p n eps)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
              (doubleRadius cellRadius)))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (doubleRadius pointRadius))) :=
    finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum_largeCellOrPartitionPoint_le
      (f := f) (p := p) (eps := eps)
      (cellRadius := cellRadius) (pointRadius := pointRadius)
      hcellRadius
  have hprefix_lt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add
          (largeOscillationCellLengthSum f p n eps)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
            (doubleRadius cellRadius)))
        (RealTheory.add badLengthBudget
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
            (doubleRadius cellRadius))) :=
    RealTheory.add_lt_add_right hlarge_lt
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n) (doubleRadius cellRadius))
  have hbound_lt :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add
            (largeOscillationCellLengthSum f p n eps)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
              (doubleRadius cellRadius)))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (doubleRadius pointRadius)))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.add badLengthBudget
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
              (doubleRadius cellRadius)))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
            (doubleRadius pointRadius))) :=
    RealTheory.add_lt_add_right hprefix_lt
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
        (doubleRadius pointRadius))
  exact And.intro hcover
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hlength_le
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hbound_lt hbudget))

name: closedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet_nullSet_of_darbouxGapSmall
statement:
private theorem closedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet_nullSet_of_darbouxGapSmall
    {a b eps : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps)
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hsmall : DarbouxGapSmall f a b) :
    RealNegligibility.NullSet
      (ClosedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet f a b eps)
proof:
:= by
  apply nullSet_of_arbitrarily_small_finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo
  intro coverBudget hcoverBudget
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let halfBudget := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F coverBudget
  let quarterBudget := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F halfBudget
  have hhalfBudget_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero halfBudget :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hcoverBudget
  have hquarterBudget_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero quarterBudget :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hhalfBudget_pos
  have hgapBudget_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.mul eps halfBudget) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos heps hhalfBudget_pos
  cases hsmall (RealTheory.mul eps halfBudget) hgapBudget_pos with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases hn with
      | intro p hpdata =>
          cases exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
              (C := RealTheory.nat n)
              (eps := quarterBudget)
              (RealTheory.nat_nonneg n) hquarterBudget_pos with
          | intro cellDelta hcellDelta =>
              cases exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
                  (C := RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
                  (eps := quarterBudget)
                  (RealTheory.nat_nonneg (n + 1))
                  hquarterBudget_pos with
              | intro pointDelta hpointDelta =>
                  let cellRadius := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F cellDelta
                  let pointRadius := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F pointDelta
                  let cellOverhead :=
                    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                      (doubleRadius cellRadius)
                  let pointOverhead :=
                    RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
                      (doubleRadius pointRadius)
                  have hcellRadius_pos :
                      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero cellRadius :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hcellDelta.left
                  have hpointRadius_pos :
                      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero pointRadius :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hpointDelta.left
                  have hcellOverhead_lt :
                      RealTheory.lt cellOverhead quarterBudget := by
                    dsimp [cellOverhead, cellRadius]
                    unfold doubleRadius
                    change
                      F.lt
                        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                          (F.add (F.half cellDelta)
                            (F.half cellDelta)))
                        quarterBudget
                    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F cellDelta]
                    exact hcellDelta.right
                  have hpointOverhead_lt :
                      RealTheory.lt pointOverhead quarterBudget := by
                    dsimp [pointOverhead, pointRadius]
                    unfold doubleRadius
                    change
                      F.lt
                        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat (n + 1))
                          (F.add (F.half pointDelta)
                            (F.half pointDelta)))
                        quarterBudget
                    rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F pointDelta]
                    exact hpointDelta.right
                  have hoverhead_lt_half :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.add cellOverhead pointOverhead)
                        halfBudget := by
                    have h :=
                      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add F
                        hcellOverhead_lt hpointOverhead_lt
                    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                      F halfBudget] at h
                  have hsum_lt_budget :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.add halfBudget
                          (RealTheory.add cellOverhead pointOverhead))
                        coverBudget := by
                    have h :=
                      RealTheory.add_lt_add_left
                        hoverhead_lt_half halfBudget
                    change
                      F.lt
                        (F.add halfBudget
                          (RealTheory.add cellOverhead pointOverhead))
                        (F.add halfBudget halfBudget) at h
                    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                      F coverBudget] at h
                  have hbudget :
                      RealTheory.lt
                        (RealTheory.add
                          (RealTheory.add halfBudget cellOverhead)
                          pointOverhead)
                        coverBudget := by
                    rw [RealTheory.add_assoc]
                    exact hsum_lt_budget
                  have hpack :
                      And
                        (FiniteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo
                          (ClosedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet
                            f a b eps)
                          (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
                            f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
                          (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
                            f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
                          (n + (n + 1)))
                        (RealTheory.lt
                          (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
                            (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
                              f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
                            (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
                              f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n)
                            (n + (n + 1)))
                          coverBudget) :=
                    finiteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo_closedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet_length_lt_of_darbouxGap_lt
                      (badLengthBudget := halfBudget)
                      (cellRadius := cellRadius)
                      (pointRadius := pointRadius)
                      heps hbdd hpdata.left
                      hcellRadius_pos hpointRadius_pos
                      hpdata.right hbudget
                  refine Exists.intro (n + (n + 1)) ?_
                  refine Exists.intro
                    (largeCellPartitionPointCoverLeft
                      f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n) ?_
                  refine Exists.intro
                    (largeCellPartitionPointCoverRight
                      f p eps cellRadius pointRadius n) ?_
                  exact hpack

name: finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm_le_indexCellLengthSum
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm_le_indexCellLengthSum
    {a b : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {partitionCount k : Nat}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {coverCount : Nat}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b partitionCount p)
    (hk : k < partitionCount) :
    RealTheory.le
      (finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm p left right coverCount k)
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat =>
          finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm p left right i k)
        coverCount)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbad :
      PartitionCellMeetsFiniteOpenIntervalCover
        p k left right coverCount
  · rw [finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm_of_meets hbad]
    rcases hbad with ⟨x, hx⟩
    rcases hx.right with ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hindex :
        PartitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex p k left right i :=
      Exists.intro x (And.intro hx.left hi.right)
    have hterm :
        finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm p left right i k =
          cellLength p k :=
      finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm_of_meets hindex
    rw [<- hterm]
    exact
      RealTheory.finiteSum_term_le_of_nonneg
        (fun j : Nat =>
          finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm p left right j k)
        hi.left
        (fun j hj =>
          finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm_nonnegative
            (p := p) (partitionCount := partitionCount)
            (k := k) (i := j) hp hk)
  · rw [finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm_of_not_meets hbad]
    exact
      RealTheory.finiteSum_nonneg
        (fun i : Nat =>
          finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm p left right i k)
        coverCount
        (fun i hi =>
          finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm_nonnegative
            (p := p) (partitionCount := partitionCount)
            (k := k) (i := i) hp hk)

name: sub_right_lt_of_lt
statement:
private theorem sub_right_lt_of_lt
    {x y z : Point}
    (hxy : RealTheory.lt x y) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x z) (RealTheory.sub y z)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right F hxy (F.neg z)
  change F.lt (F.add x (F.neg z)) (F.add y (F.neg z)) at h
  rwa [<- F.sub_eq_add_neg x z, <- F.sub_eq_add_neg y z] at h

name: partitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex_between
statement:
private theorem partitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex_between
    {a b : Point} {p : Nat -> Point} {partitionCount i k j : Nat}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {coverIndex : Nat}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b partitionCount p)
    (hj : j < partitionCount)
    (hik : i < k)
    (hkj : k < j)
    (hi_cell :
      PartitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex
        p i left right coverIndex)
    (hj_cell :
      PartitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex
        p j left right coverIndex) :
    PartitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex p k left right coverIndex
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hk : k < partitionCount := Nat.lt_trans hkj hj
  cases hi_cell with
  | intro x hx =>
      cases hj_cell with
      | intro y hy =>
          have hsucc_le_k : i + 1 <= k := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hik
          have hpk_from_left :
              RealTheory.le (p (i + 1)) (p k) :=
            intervalPartition_le_of_le hp (i + 1) k
              hsucc_le_k (Nat.le_of_lt hk)
          have hx_le_pk : RealTheory.le x (p k) :=
            RealTheory.le_trans hx.left.right hpk_from_left
          have hleft :
              RealTheory.lt (left coverIndex) (p k) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hx.right.left hx_le_pk
          have hpk_le_pj :
              RealTheory.le (p k) (p j) :=
            intervalPartition_le_of_le hp k j
              (Nat.le_of_lt hkj) (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
          have hpk_le_y : RealTheory.le (p k) y :=
            RealTheory.le_trans hpk_le_pj hy.left.left
          have hright :
              RealTheory.lt (p k) (right coverIndex) :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hpk_le_y hy.right.right
          refine Exists.intro (p k) ?_
          refine And.intro (intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hp hk) ?_
          exact And.intro hleft hright

name: leftEndpoint_sub_radius_lt_of_openIntervalIndexCell
statement:
private theorem leftEndpoint_sub_radius_lt_of_openIntervalIndexCell
    {a b radius : Point} {p : Nat -> Point}
    {partitionCount k : Nat} {left right : Nat -> Point} {i : Nat}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b partitionCount p)
    (hk : k < partitionCount)
    (hcell : PartitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex p k left right i)
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh p partitionCount) radius) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub (left i) radius) (p k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hcell with
  | intro x hx =>
      have hleft_cell : PartitionCell p k (p k) :=
        intervalPartition_cell_left_mem hp hk
      have hdist_left_x_le :
          RealTheory.le (RealFunction.dist (p k) x) (cellLength p k) := by
        unfold RealFunction.dist
        exact dist_le_cellLength_of_partitionCell hleft_cell hx.left
      have hcell_lt : RealTheory.lt (cellLength p k) radius :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
          (cellLength_le_mesh p partitionCount k hk) hmesh
      have hdist_left_x_lt :
          RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (p k) x) radius :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
          hdist_left_x_le hcell_lt
      have hxminus_lt :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.sub x radius) (p k) :=
        sub_radius_lt_of_dist_lt hdist_left_x_lt
      have hleft_minus_lt :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.sub (left i) radius)
            (RealTheory.sub x radius) :=
        sub_right_lt_of_lt hx.right.left
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hleft_minus_lt hxminus_lt

name: rightEndpoint_lt_add_radius_of_openIntervalIndexCell
statement:
private theorem rightEndpoint_lt_add_radius_of_openIntervalIndexCell
    {a b radius : Point} {p : Nat -> Point}
    {partitionCount k : Nat} {left right : Nat -> Point} {i : Nat}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b partitionCount p)
    (hk : k < partitionCount)
    (hcell : PartitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex p k left right i)
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh p partitionCount) radius) :
    RealTheory.lt (p (k + 1)) (RealTheory.add (right i) radius)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases hcell with
  | intro x hx =>
      have hright_cell : PartitionCell p k (p (k + 1)) :=
        intervalPartition_cell_right_mem hp hk
      have hdist_right_x_le :
          RealTheory.le
            (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) x) (cellLength p k) := by
        unfold RealFunction.dist
        exact dist_le_cellLength_of_partitionCell hright_cell hx.left
      have hcell_lt : RealTheory.lt (cellLength p k) radius :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
          (cellLength_le_mesh p partitionCount k hk) hmesh
      have hdist_right_x_lt :
          RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (p (k + 1)) x) radius :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
          hdist_right_x_le hcell_lt
      have hright_raw :
          RealTheory.lt (p (k + 1)) (RealTheory.add x radius) :=
        lt_add_radius_of_dist_lt hdist_right_x_lt
      have hxright :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.add x radius)
            (RealTheory.add (right i) radius) :=
        RealTheory.add_lt_add_right hx.right.right radius
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hright_raw hxright

name: openIntervalIndexActiveCellEnvelope_block
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · rw [openIntervalIndexActiveCellEnvelope_count_end henv]
    exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt henv.right.left
  · intro j hj
    have hidx_le_hi : lo + j <= hi := by
      omega
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · rw [hj0, Nat.add_zero]
      exact henv.right.right.left

name: expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength_nonnegative
statement:
private theorem expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength_nonnegative
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {coverIndex : Nat} {radius : Point}
    (hle : RealTheory.le (left coverIndex) (right coverIndex))
    (hradius : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero radius) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero
      (expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength left right coverIndex radius)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength
  have hleft_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub (left coverIndex) radius)
        (left coverIndex) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_le_self_of_nonneg_basic F hradius
  have hright_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (right coverIndex)
        (RealTheory.add (right coverIndex) radius) := by
    have h := RealTheory.add_le_add_left hradius (right coverIndex)
    rwa [RealTheory.add_zero] at h
  have hle_total :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.sub (left coverIndex) radius)
        (RealTheory.add (right coverIndex) radius) :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hleft_le (RealTheory.le_trans hle hright_le)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_nonneg_of_le F hle_total

name: finiteSum_shifted_cellLength_le_expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength_of_block
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_shifted_cellLength_le_expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength_of_block
    {a b radius : Point} {p : Nat -> Point}
    {partitionCount start count : Nat}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {coverIndex : Nat}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b partitionCount p)
    (hblock :
      ConsecutiveOpenIntervalIndexCellBlock
        p partitionCount start count left right coverIndex)
    (hcount : 0 < count)
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh p partitionCount) radius) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat => cellLength p (start + j)) count)
      (expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength left right coverIndex radius)
proof:
:= by
  let L := RealTheory.sub (left coverIndex) radius
  let R := RealTheory.add (right coverIndex) radius
  have hstart_lt : start < partitionCount := by
    have h :=
      consecutiveOpenIntervalIndexCellBlock_index_lt
        (j := 0) hblock hcount
    rwa [Nat.add_zero] at h
  have hstart_meets :
      PartitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex
        p start left right coverIndex := by
    have h :=
      consecutiveOpenIntervalIndexCellBlock_meets
        (j := 0) hblock hcount
    rwa [Nat.add_zero] at h
  have hleft : RealTheory.lt L (p start) := by
    dsimp [L]
    exact leftEndpoint_sub_radius_lt_of_openIntervalIndexCell
      hp hstart_lt hstart_meets hmesh
  have hlast_lt : count - 1 < count := by
    omega
  have hlast_index_lt : start + (count - 1) < partitionCount :=
    consecutiveOpenIntervalIndexCellBlock_index_lt
      (j := count - 1) hblock hlast_lt
  have hlast_meets :
      PartitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex
        p (start + (count - 1)) left right coverIndex :=
    consecutiveOpenIntervalIndexCellBlock_meets
      (j := count - 1) hblock hlast_lt
  have hright_raw :
      RealTheory.lt
        (p ((start + (count - 1)) + 1))
        R := by
    dsimp [R]
    exact rightEndpoint_lt_add_radius_of_openIntervalIndexCell
      hp hlast_index_lt hlast_meets hmesh
  have hidx : (start + (count - 1)) + 1 = start + count := by
    omega
  have hright : RealTheory.lt (p (start + count)) R := by
    rwa [hidx] at hright_raw
  unfold expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength
  exact finiteSum_shifted_cellLength_le_of_endpoint_lt_bounds
    hleft hright

name: finiteSum_openIntervalIndexCellLengthTerm_eq_envelope_sum
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_openIntervalIndexCellLengthTerm_eq_envelope_sum
    {p : Nat -> Point} {partitionCount lo hi : Nat}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {coverIndex : Nat}
    (henv :
      OpenIntervalIndexActiveCellEnvelope
        p partitionCount lo hi left right coverIndex) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm
            p left right coverIndex k) partitionCount =
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat =>
          finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm
            p left right coverIndex (lo + j))
        (hi + 1 - lo)
proof:
:= by
  let term : Nat -> Point :=
    fun k : Nat =>
      finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm p left right coverIndex k
  let count : Nat := hi + 1 - lo
  let tail : Nat := partitionCount - (hi + 1)
  change RealTheory.finiteSum term partitionCount =
    RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => term (lo + j)) count
  have hn_decomp : partitionCount = lo + (count + tail) := by
    dsimp [count, tail]
    have hlohi : lo <= hi := henv.left
    have hhi_n : hi < partitionCount := henv.right.left
    omega
  have hleft_zero : RealTheory.finiteSum term lo = RealTheory.zero := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero
    intro k hk
    dsimp [term]
    exact
      finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm_eq_zero_of_activeCellEnvelope_left
        henv hk
  have htail_zero :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat => term (lo + (count + j))) tail =
        RealTheory.zero := by
    apply RealTheory.finiteSum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    dsimp [term, count, tail]
    apply finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm_eq_zero_of_activeCellEnvelope_right
      henv
    · have hlohi : lo <= hi := henv.left
      omega
    · have hlohi : lo <= hi := henv.left
      have hhi_n : hi < partitionCount := henv.right.left
      omega
  calc
    RealTheory.finiteSum term partitionCount =
        RealTheory.finiteSum term (lo + (count + tail)) := by
          rw [hn_decomp]
    _ = RealTheory.add (RealTheory.finiteSum term lo)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => term (lo + j)) (count + tail)) := by
          rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length]
    _ = RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => term (lo + j)) (count + tail)) := by
          rw [hleft_zero]
    _ = RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat => term (lo + j)) (count + tail) := by
          rw [RealTheory.zero_add]
    _ = RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => term (lo + j)) count)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun j : Nat => term (lo + (count + j))) tail) := by
          rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add_length]
    _ = RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.finiteSum (fun j : Nat => term (lo + j)) count)
        RealTheory.zero := by
          rw [htail_zero]
    _ = RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun j : Nat => term (lo + j)) count := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_zero]

name: finiteSum_openIntervalIndexCellLengthTerm_le_expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_openIntervalIndexCellLengthTerm_le_expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength
    {a b radius : Point} {p : Nat -> Point}
    {partitionCount : Nat} {left right : Nat -> Point}
    {coverIndex : Nat}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b partitionCount p)
    (hle : RealTheory.le (left coverIndex) (right coverIndex))
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh p partitionCount) radius) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm
            p left right coverIndex k) partitionCount)
      (expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength left right coverIndex radius)
proof:
:= by
  have hconvex :
      forall i k j : Nat,
        i <= k -> k <= j -> j < partitionCount ->
          PartitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex
            p i left right coverIndex ->
          PartitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex
            p j left right coverIndex ->
          PartitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex
            p k left right coverIndex := by
    intro i k j hik hkj hj hi_cell hj_cell
    by_cases hik_eq : i = k
    · simpa [hik_eq] using hi_cell
    by_cases hkj_eq : k = j
    · simpa [hkj_eq] using hj_cell
    exact partitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex_between
      hp hj (by omega) (by omega) hi_cell hj_cell
  cases RealFunction.IntervalPartition.exists_consecutiveActiveIndexBlock_or_none
      (fun k : Nat =>
        PartitionCellMeetsOpenIntervalIndex
          p k left right coverIndex)
      partitionCount hconvex with
  | inl hblock_exists =>
      rcases hblock_exists with ⟨lo, hi, hlohi, hhi, hactive⟩
      have hlo_lt : lo < partitionCount :=
        Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hlohi hhi
      have henv :
          OpenIntervalIndexActiveCellEnvelope
            p partitionCount lo hi left right coverIndex := by
        refine And.intro hlohi ?_
        refine And.intro hhi ?_
        refine And.intro
          ((hactive lo hlo_lt).mpr
            (And.intro (Nat.le_refl lo) hlohi)) ?_
        refine And.intro
          ((hactive hi hhi).mpr
            (And.intro hlohi (Nat.le_refl hi))) ?_
        intro k hk hcell
        exact (hactive k hk).mp hcell
      exact
        finiteSum_openIntervalIndexCellLengthTerm_le_expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength_of_full_envelope
          hp henv hmesh
  | inr hnone =>
      rw [finiteSum_openIntervalIndexCellLengthTerm_eq_zero_of_no_active hnone]
      exact
        expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength_nonnegative hle
          (radius_nonnegative_of_mesh_lt hp hmesh)

name: expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength_eq_intervalLength_add_doubleRadius
statement:
private theorem expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength_eq_intervalLength_add_doubleRadius
    (left right : Nat -> Point) (coverIndex : Nat) (radius : Point) :
    expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength left right coverIndex radius =
      RealTheory.add
        (RealNegligibility.intervalLength (left coverIndex) (right coverIndex))
        (doubleRadius radius)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength
  unfold RealNegligibility.intervalLength
  unfold doubleRadius
  change
    F.sub (F.add (right coverIndex) radius)
        (F.sub (left coverIndex) radius) =
      F.add (F.sub (right coverIndex) (left coverIndex))
        (F.add radius radius)
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg (left coverIndex) radius]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_add_eq_sub_add_sub
    F (right coverIndex) radius (left coverIndex) (F.neg radius)]
  rw [F.sub_eq_add_neg radius (F.neg radius)]
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F radius]

name: finiteSum_expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength_eq_lengthSum_add_meshOverhead
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength_eq_lengthSum_add_meshOverhead
    (left right : Nat -> Point) (coverCount : Nat) (radius : Point) :
    RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun i : Nat =>
          expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength left right i radius) coverCount =
      RealTheory.add
        (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right coverCount)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat coverCount)
          (doubleRadius radius))
proof:
:= by
  have hcongr :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength left right i radius) coverCount =
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.add
              (RealNegligibility.intervalLength (left i) (right i))
              (doubleRadius radius)) coverCount :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_congr
      (fun i : Nat =>
        expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength_eq_intervalLength_add_doubleRadius
          left right i radius)
      coverCount
  rw [hcongr]
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_add]
  unfold finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
  rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_const]

name: finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthSum_le_lengthSum_add_meshOverhead
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthSum_le_lengthSum_add_meshOverhead
    {a b radius : Point} {p : Nat -> Point}
    {partitionCount : Nat} {left right : Nat -> Point}
    {coverCount : Nat}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b partitionCount p)
    (hcoverOrder :
      forall i : Nat, i < coverCount ->
        RealTheory.le (left i) (right i))
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh p partitionCount) radius) :
    RealTheory.le
      (finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthSum
        p partitionCount left right coverCount)
      (RealTheory.add
        (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right coverCount)
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat coverCount)
          (doubleRadius radius)))
proof:
:= by
  have hdecomp :
      RealTheory.le
        (finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthSum
          p partitionCount left right coverCount)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm
                  p left right i k)
              partitionCount)
          coverCount) :=
    finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthSum_le_indexFirstCellLengthDoubleSum
      (p := p) (partitionCount := partitionCount)
      (left := left) (right := right) (coverCount := coverCount) hp
  have hindex :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            RealTheory.finiteSum
              (fun k : Nat =>
                finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm
                  p left right i k)
              partitionCount)
          coverCount)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun i : Nat =>
            expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength left right i radius)
          coverCount) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun i : Nat =>
        RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            finiteOpenCoverIndexCellLengthTerm p left right i k)
          partitionCount)
      (fun i : Nat =>
        expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength left right i radius)
      coverCount
      (fun i hi =>
        finiteSum_openIntervalIndexCellLengthTerm_le_expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength
          (p := p) (partitionCount := partitionCount)
          (left := left) (right := right) (coverIndex := i)
          hp (hcoverOrder i hi) hmesh)
  have htotal :=
    RealTheory.le_trans hdecomp hindex
  rwa [finiteSum_expandedOpenIntervalIndexLength_eq_lengthSum_add_meshOverhead
    left right coverCount radius] at htotal

name: finiteOpenCoverOscillationWeightedTerm_eq_add_good_bad

name: finiteOpenCoverGoodOscillationWeightedTerm_le_eta_mul_cellLength

name: finiteSum_finiteOpenCoverGoodOscillationWeightedTerm_le_eta_mul_intervalLength
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_finiteOpenCoverGoodOscillationWeightedTerm_le_eta_mul_intervalLength
    {a b eta : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {p omega : Nat -> Point} {partitionCount : Nat}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {coverCount : Nat}
    (heta : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b partitionCount p)
    (hcontrol :
      FiniteOpenCoverGoodCellPairwiseOscillationControl
        f p partitionCount left right coverCount eta)
    (homega : forall i : Nat, i < partitionCount ->
      IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i)) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          finiteOpenCoverGoodOscillationWeightedTerm
            p left right coverCount omega k) partitionCount)
      (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a))
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            finiteOpenCoverGoodOscillationWeightedTerm
              p left right coverCount omega k) partitionCount)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
          partitionCount) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun k : Nat =>
        finiteOpenCoverGoodOscillationWeightedTerm
          p left right coverCount omega k)
      (fun k : Nat => RealTheory.mul eta (cellLength p k))
      partitionCount
      (fun k hk =>
        finiteOpenCoverGoodOscillationWeightedTerm_le_eta_mul_cellLength
          (f := f) (partitionCount := partitionCount)
          (left := left) (right := right)
          (coverCount := coverCount)

name: finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm_le_mul_bound_badCellLengthTerm
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm_le_mul_bound_badCellLengthTerm
    {a b C : Point} {p omega : Nat -> Point}

    RealTheory.le
      (finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm
        p left right coverCount omega k)
      (RealTheory.mul C
        (finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm
          p left right coverCount k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbad :
      PartitionCellMeetsFiniteOpenIntervalCover
        p k left right coverCount
  · unfold finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm
    simp [hbad]
    rw [finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm_of_meets hbad]
    exact RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_right
      homegaC (cellLength_nonnegative hp hk)
  · unfold finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm
    simp [hbad]
    rw [finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm_of_not_meets hbad]
    rw [RealTheory.mul_zero]
    exact RealTheory.le_refl RealTheory.zero

name: finiteSum_finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm_le_mul_bound_badCellLengthSum
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm_le_mul_bound_badCellLengthSum
    {a b C : Point} {p omega : Nat -> Point}
    {partitionCount : Nat} {left right : Nat -> Point}
    {coverCount : Nat}
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b partitionCount p)
    (homegaC : forall i : Nat, i < partitionCount ->
      RealTheory.le (omega i) C) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm
            p left right coverCount omega k) partitionCount)
      (RealTheory.mul C
        (finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthSum
          p partitionCount left right coverCount))
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm
              p left right coverCount omega k) partitionCount)
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul C
              (finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm
                p left right coverCount k)) partitionCount) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_le_of_pointwise_le
      (fun k : Nat =>
        finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm
          p left right coverCount omega k)
      (fun k : Nat =>
        RealTheory.mul C
          (finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm
            p left right coverCount k))
      partitionCount
      (fun k hk =>
        finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm_le_mul_bound_badCellLengthTerm
          (p := p) (omega := omega)
          (partitionCount := partitionCount) (k := k)
          (left := left) (right := right)
          (coverCount := coverCount)
          hp hk (homegaC k hk))
  have hmul :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            RealTheory.mul C
              (finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm
                p left right coverCount k)) partitionCount =
        RealTheory.mul C
          (RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm
                p left right coverCount k) partitionCount) :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left C
      (fun k : Nat =>
        finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthTerm p left right coverCount k)
      partitionCount
  rw [hmul] at hsum
  unfold finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthSum
  exact hsum

name: finiteSum_finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm_le_mul_bound_lengthSum_add_meshOverhead
statement:
private theorem finiteSum_finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm_le_mul_bound_lengthSum_add_meshOverhead
    {a b C radius : Point} {p omega : Nat -> Point}
    {partitionCount : Nat} {left right : Nat -> Point}
    {coverCount : Nat}
    (hC : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b partitionCount p)
    (hcoverOrder :
      forall i : Nat, i < coverCount ->
        RealTheory.le (left i) (right i))
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh p partitionCount) radius)
    (homegaC : forall i : Nat, i < partitionCount ->
      RealTheory.le (omega i) C) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm
            p left right coverCount omega k) partitionCount)
      (RealTheory.mul C
        (RealTheory.add
          (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right coverCount)
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat coverCount)
            (doubleRadius radius))))
proof:
:= by
  have hbad :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm
              p left right coverCount omega k) partitionCount)
        (RealTheory.mul C
          (finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthSum
            p partitionCount left right coverCount)) :=
    finiteSum_finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm_le_mul_bound_badCellLengthSum
      (p := p) (omega := omega)
      (partitionCount := partitionCount)
      (left := left) (right := right)
      (coverCount := coverCount)
      hp homegaC
  have hbudget :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul C
          (finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthSum
            p partitionCount left right coverCount))
        (RealTheory.mul C
          (RealTheory.add
            (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right coverCount)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat coverCount)
              (doubleRadius radius)))) :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
      (finiteOpenCoverBadCellLengthSum_le_lengthSum_add_meshOverhead
        (p := p) (partitionCount := partitionCount)
        (left := left) (right := right)
        (coverCount := coverCount)
        hp hcoverOrder hmesh)
      hC
  exact RealTheory.le_trans hbad hbudget

name: oscillationWeightedSum_lt_of_finiteOpenCover_good_bad_half_budgets
statement:
private theorem oscillationWeightedSum_lt_of_finiteOpenCover_good_bad_half_budgets
    {a b C eta eps radius : Point} {f : Point -> Point}
    {p omega : Nat -> Point} {partitionCount : Nat}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {coverCount : Nat}
    (heta : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero eta)
    (hC : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero C)
    (hp : IntervalPartition a b partitionCount p)
    (hcoverOrder :
      forall i : Nat, i < coverCount ->
        RealTheory.le (left i) (right i))
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh p partitionCount) radius)
    (hcontrol :
      FiniteOpenCoverGoodCellPairwiseOscillationControl
        f p partitionCount left right coverCount eta)
    (homega : forall i : Nat, i < partitionCount ->
      IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i))
    (homegaC : forall i : Nat, i < partitionCount ->
      RealTheory.le (omega i) C)
    (hgoodBudget :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps))
    (hbadBudget :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul C
          (RealTheory.add
            (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right coverCount)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat coverCount)
              (doubleRadius radius))))
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base eps)) :
    RealTheory.lt (oscillationWeightedSum p partitionCount omega) eps
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hgood :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            finiteOpenCoverGoodOscillationWeightedTerm
              p left right coverCount omega k) partitionCount)
        (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a)) :=
    finiteSum_finiteOpenCoverGoodOscillationWeightedTerm_le_eta_mul_intervalLength
      (f := f) (partitionCount := partitionCount)
      (left := left) (right := right) (coverCount := coverCount)
      heta hp hcontrol homega
  have hbad :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.finiteSum
          (fun k : Nat =>
            finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm
              p left right coverCount omega k) partitionCount)
        (RealTheory.mul C
          (RealTheory.add
            (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right coverCount)
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat coverCount)
              (doubleRadius radius)))) :=
    finiteSum_finiteOpenCoverBadOscillationWeightedTerm_le_mul_bound_lengthSum_add_meshOverhead
      (p := p) (omega := omega)
      (partitionCount := partitionCount)
      (left := left) (right := right)
      (coverCount := coverCount)
      hC hp hcoverOrder hmesh homegaC
  have hsum_le :
      RealTheory.le (oscillationWeightedSum p partitionCount omega)
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a))
          (RealTheory.mul C
            (RealTheory.add
              (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right coverCount)
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat coverCount)
                (doubleRadius radius))))) := by
    rw [oscillationWeightedSum_eq_finiteOpenCover_good_add_bad
      (left := left) (right := right) (coverCount := coverCount)]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hgood hbad
  have hbudget :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul eta (RealTheory.sub b a))
          (RealTheory.mul C
            (RealTheory.add
              (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum left right coverCount)
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat coverCount)
                (doubleRadius radius)))))
        eps := by
    have hadd := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
      F hgoodBudget hbadBudget
    rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F eps] at hadd
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hsum_le hbudget

name: riemannOscillationCriterion_of_closedIntervalBounded_finiteOpenCoverData
statement:
private theorem riemannOscillationCriterion_of_closedIntervalBounded_finiteOpenCoverData
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hbdd : ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
    (hdata : FiniteOpenCoverCriterionData f a b) :
    RiemannOscillationCriterion f a b
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases exists_cellOscillationBound_of_closedIntervalBounded hbdd with
  | intro C hC =>
      rcases hdata eps C heps hC.left with
      ⟨eta, coverCount, left, right, radius, delta,
        heta, hradius, hdelta, hdelta_radius, hcoverOrder,
        hgoodBudget, hbadBudget, hcontrolData⟩
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta ?_
      intro partitionCount p hp hmesh
      let omega := fun i : Nat =>
        if hi : i < partitionCount then
          Classical.choose
            (exists_isCellOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded
              (f := f) (a := a) (b := b)
              (n := partitionCount) (k := i) (p := p)
              hbdd hp hi)
        else
          RealTheory.zero
      have homega :
          forall i : Nat, i < partitionCount ->
            IsCellOscillation f p i (omega i) := by
        intro i hi
        unfold omega
        simp [hi]
        exact Classical.choose_spec
          (exists_isCellOscillation_of_closedIntervalBounded
            (f := f) (a := a) (b := b)
            (n := partitionCount) (k := i) (p := p)
            hbdd hp hi)
      have homegaC :
          forall i : Nat, i < partitionCount ->
            RealTheory.le (omega i) C := by
        intro i hi
        exact hC.right hp hi (homega i hi)
      have hcontrol :
          FiniteOpenCoverGoodCellPairwiseOscillationControl
            f p partitionCount left right coverCount eta :=
        hcontrolData partitionCount p hp hmesh
      have hmesh_radius :
          RealTheory.lt (mesh p partitionCount) radius :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
          hmesh hdelta_radius
      refine Exists.intro omega ?_
      refine And.intro homega ?_
      exact
        oscillationWeightedSum_lt_of_finiteOpenCover_good_bad_half_budgets
          (f := f) (p := p) (omega := omega)
          (partitionCount := partitionCount)
          (left := left) (right := right)
          (coverCount := coverCount) (radius := radius)
          heta hC.left hp hcoverOrder hmesh_radius hcontrol homega homegaC
          hgoodBudget hbadBudget

name: finiteSubcoverList_ordered
statement:
private theorem finiteSubcoverList_ordered
    {left right : Nat -> Point} (indices : List Nat)
    (hordered : forall i : Nat, RealTheory.le (left i) (right i)) :
    forall k : Nat,
      k < indices.length ->
        RealTheory.le
          (finiteSubcoverListLeft left indices k)
          (finiteSubcoverListRight right indices k)
proof:
:= by
  induction indices with
  | nil =>
      intro k hk
      exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k hk)
  | cons i indices ih =>
      intro k hk
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          exact hordered i
      | succ k =>
          exact ih k (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk)

name: finiteOpenIntervalCoverSet_of_mem_finiteSubcoverList
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenIntervalCoverSet_of_mem_finiteSubcoverList
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {indices : List Nat}
    {i : Nat} {x : Point}
    (hmem : List.Mem i indices)
    (hopen : RealNegligibility.OpenInterval (left i) (right i) x) :
    FiniteOpenIntervalCoverSet
      (finiteSubcoverListLeft left indices)
      (finiteSubcoverListRight right indices)
      indices.length x
proof:
:= by
  induction indices with
  | nil =>
      cases hmem
  | cons j indices ih =>
      cases hmem with
      | head =>
          refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
          refine And.intro ?_ ?_
          · exact Nat.zero_lt_succ indices.length
          · simpa [finiteSubcoverListLeft, finiteSubcoverListRight] using hopen
      | tail _ hmem_tail =>
          cases
            ih hmem_tail with
          | intro k hkcover =>
              refine Exists.intro (Nat.succ k) ?_
              refine And.intro ?_ ?_
              · exact Nat.succ_lt_succ hkcover.left
              ·
                simpa [finiteSubcoverListLeft, finiteSubcoverListRight]
                  using hkcover.right

  · intro x hx

    {E : Point -> Prop} {left right : Nat -> Point}

name: natListBoundedBy_natListBound
statement:
private theorem natListBoundedBy_natListBound
    (indices : List Nat) :
    NatListBoundedBy indices (natListBound indices)
proof:
:= by
  induction indices with
  | nil =>
      intro i hmem
      cases hmem
  | cons j indices ih =>
      intro i hmem
      cases hmem with
      | head =>
          exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_max_left j (natListBound indices))
      | tail _ hmem_tail =>
          have hi_bound : i < natListBound indices := ih i hmem_tail
          have hbound_le :
              natListBound indices <= Nat.max j (natListBound indices) :=
            Nat.le_max_right j (natListBound indices)
          have hi_max : i < Nat.max j (natListBound indices) :=
            Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi_bound hbound_le
          exact Nat.lt_trans hi_max
            (Nat.lt_succ_self (Nat.max j (natListBound indices)))

name: countableOpenIntervalListSubcover_of_compact_countableOpenIntervalCover
statement:

      (fun indices : List Nat =>
        CountableOpenIntervalListSubcover E left right indices)
proof:
:= by
  let U : Nat -> Point -> Prop :=
    fun i x => RealNegligibility.OpenInterval (left i) (right i) x
  have hopen : forall i : Nat, RealTheory.IsOpen (U i) := by
    intro i
    change
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.IsOpen
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (left i) (right i))
    exact
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.open_interval
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base (left i) (right i)
  have hcovers : IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Covers U E := by
    intro x hx
    exact hcover.right x hx
  cases hcompact U hopen hcovers with
  | intro indices hindices =>
      refine Exists.intro indices ?_
      exact hindices

name: closedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet_closed
statement:
private theorem closedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet_closed
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b eps : Point}
    (heps : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero eps) :
    RealTheory.IsClosed
      (ClosedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet f a b eps)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let good : Point -> Prop :=
    fun x : Point =>
      PointOscillationLtOn (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f x eps
  have hclosedInterval :
      RealTheory.IsClosed (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closed_interval F a b
  have hgoodOpen : RealTheory.IsOpen good := by
    unfold good
    exact pointOscillationLtOn_set_open
  have hnotGoodClosed :
      RealTheory.IsClosed (SetPred.Compl good) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closed_compl_of_open F hgoodOpen
  have hinter :
      RealTheory.IsClosed
        (SetPred.Inter (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
          (SetPred.Compl good)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closed_inter F hclosedInterval hnotGoodClosed
  apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.closed_congr F hinter
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact And.intro hx.left (And.intro heps hx.right)
  · intro hx
    exact And.intro hx.left hx.right.right

              (fun coverCount : Nat =>

                  (FiniteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo

                      f a b threshold)
                    left right coverCount)

                    (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
                      left right coverCount)

              RealTheory.IsCompact.{0}
                (ClosedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet
                  f a b threshold) :=
            closedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet_compact hab hthreshold
          cases
              finiteOpenIntervalPrefixCoverData_of_compact_countableOpenIntervalCover
                hcompact hright.left hright.right with

name: pointOscillationLtOn_of_closedIntervalAwayFromPositiveThresholdCover
statement:

    {f : Point -> Point} {a b threshold : Point}
