name: finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius_control
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius_control
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {coverCount : Nat} {eta : Point}
    (hdata :
      FiniteOpenCoverGoodPointOscillationData
        f a b left right coverCount eta)
    {z : Point}
    (hz :
      ClosedIntervalAwayFromFiniteOpenIntervalCover
        a b left right coverCount z) :
    forall x y : Point,
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
      RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y ->
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x z)
        (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z) ->
      RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y z)
        (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z) ->
        RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (f x) (f y)) eta
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius
  simp [hz]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (hdata z hz)).right

name: finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet_open
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet_open
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {coverCount : Nat} {eta : Point}
    (hdata :
      FiniteOpenCoverGoodPointOscillationData
        f a b left right coverCount eta) :
    forall idx :
      Sum Nat
        {z : Point //
          ClosedIntervalAwayFromFiniteOpenIntervalCover
            a b left right coverCount z},
      RealTheory.IsOpen (finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet hdata idx)
proof:
:= by
  intro idx
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases idx with
  | inl i =>
      classical
      by_cases hi : i < coverCount
      · unfold finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet
        simp [hi]
        change
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.IsOpen F
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval F (left i) (right i))
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.open_interval F (left i) (right i)
      · unfold finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet
        simp [hi]
        change
          IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.IsOpen F
            (SetPred.Empty : Point -> Prop)
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.open_empty F
  | inr z =>
      unfold finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet
      change
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.IsOpen F
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.OpenInterval F
            (RealTheory.sub z.val
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
                (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val)))
            (RealTheory.add z.val
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
                (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val))))
      exact
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.open_interval F
          (RealTheory.sub z.val
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
              (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val)))
          (RealTheory.add z.val
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
              (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val)))

name: finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet_bad_mem
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet
  simp [hi, hx]

name: finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet_good_center_mem
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet_good_center_mem
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {coverCount : Nat} {eta : Point}
    (hdata :
      FiniteOpenCoverGoodPointOscillationData
        f a b left right coverCount eta)
    {x : Point}
    (hx :
      ClosedIntervalAwayFromFiniteOpenIntervalCover
        a b left right coverCount x) :
    finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet hdata (Sum.inr ⟨x, hx⟩) x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet
  have hrpos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata x) :=
    finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius_pos hdata hx
  have hhalf_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
          (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata x)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hrpos
  exact
    And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hhalf_pos)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hhalf_pos)

name: finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet_covers_closedInterval
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet_covers_closedInterval
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {coverCount : Nat} {eta : Point}
    (hdata :
      FiniteOpenCoverGoodPointOscillationData
        f a b left right coverCount eta) :
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Covers
      (finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet hdata)
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  classical
  by_cases hbad : FiniteOpenIntervalCoverSet left right coverCount x
  · cases hbad with
    | intro i hi_mem =>
        exact
          Exists.intro (Sum.inl i)
            (finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet_bad_mem hdata
              hi_mem.left hi_mem.right)
  · exact
      Exists.intro (Sum.inr ⟨x, And.intro hx hbad⟩)
        (finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet_good_center_mem hdata
          (And.intro hx hbad))

name: partitionCell_dist_lt_of_mesh_lt
statement:
private theorem partitionCell_dist_lt_of_mesh_lt
    {delta : Point} {p : Nat -> Point}
    {partitionCount k : Nat} {x y : Point}
    (hk : k < partitionCount)
    (hx : PartitionCell p k x)
    (hy : PartitionCell p k y)
    (hmesh : RealTheory.lt (mesh p partitionCount) delta) :
    RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x y) delta
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcell_lt : RealTheory.lt (cellLength p k) delta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
      (cellLength_le_mesh p partitionCount k hk) hmesh
  have hdist_base :
      RealTheory.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x y) delta :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F
      (dist_le_cellLength_of_partitionCell hx hy) hcell_lt
  unfold RealFunction.dist
  exact hdist_base

name: exists_finiteOpenCoverGoodCellPairwiseOscillationControl_of_goodPointOscillationData
statement:
private theorem exists_finiteOpenCoverGoodCellPairwiseOscillationControl_of_goodPointOscillationData
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    {left right : Nat -> Point} {coverCount : Nat} {eta : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hdata :
      FiniteOpenCoverGoodPointOscillationData
        f a b left right coverCount eta) :
    Exists fun delta : Point =>
      And (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta)
        (forall partitionCount : Nat,
          forall p : Nat -> Point,
            IntervalPartition a b partitionCount p ->
            RealTheory.lt (mesh p partitionCount) delta ->
              FiniteOpenCoverGoodCellPairwiseOscillationControl
                f p partitionCount left right coverCount eta)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hLeb :
      RealTheory.HasLebesgueNumber
        (finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet hdata)
        (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) :=
    RealTheory.closed_interval_lebesgue_number
      a b (finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet hdata) hab
      (finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet_open hdata)
      (finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet_covers_closedInterval hdata)
  cases hLeb with
  | intro delta hdelta =>
      refine Exists.intro delta ?_
      refine And.intro hdelta.left ?_
      intro partitionCount p hp hmesh k hk hgood x y hx hy
      have hx_closed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x :=
        intervalPartition_partitionCell_mem_closedInterval hp hk hx
      have hy_closed : RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b y :=
        intervalPartition_partitionCell_mem_closedInterval hp hk hy
      cases hdelta.right x hx_closed with
      | intro idx hidx =>
          have hxx_dist :
              RealTheory.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F x x) delta := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist_self F x]
            exact hdelta.left
          have hxU : finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet hdata idx x :=
            hidx x hx_closed hxx_dist
          have hy_dist :
              RealTheory.lt (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist F y x) delta := by
            have hdist :
                RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y x) delta :=
              partitionCell_dist_lt_of_mesh_lt
                hk hy hx hmesh
            unfold RealFunction.dist at hdist
            exact hdist
          have hyU : finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet hdata idx y :=
            hidx y hy_closed hy_dist
          cases idx with
          | inl i =>
              have hbad :
                  FiniteOpenIntervalCoverSet
                    left right coverCount x := by
                unfold finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet at hxU
                by_cases hi : i < coverCount
                · simp [hi] at hxU
                  exact Exists.intro i (And.intro hi hxU)
                · simp [hi] at hxU
              exact False.elim
                (hgood (Exists.intro x (And.intro hx hbad)))
          | inr z =>
              unfold finiteOpenCoverBadGoodOpenSet at hxU hyU
              have hrpos :
                  RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
                    (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val) :=
                finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius_pos hdata z.property
              have hhalf_lt :
                  RealTheory.lt
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
                      (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val))
                    (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_lt_self F hrpos
              have hx_half :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x z.val)
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
                      (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val)) :=
                RealFunction.dist_lt_of_mem_center_interval
                  (center := z.val)
                  (radius :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
                      (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val))
                  hxU
              have hy_half :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y z.val)
                    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
                      (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val)) :=
                RealFunction.dist_lt_of_mem_center_interval
                  (center := z.val)
                  (radius :=
                    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F
                      (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val))
                  hyU
              have hx_radius :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist x z.val)
                    (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hx_half hhalf_lt
              have hy_radius :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist y z.val)
                    (finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius hdata z.val) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hy_half hhalf_lt
              have hvalue :
                  RealTheory.lt (RealFunction.dist (f x) (f y)) eta :=
                finiteOpenCoverGoodPointRadius_control hdata z.property
                  x y hx_closed hy_closed hx_radius hy_radius
              unfold RealFunction.dist IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dist at hvalue
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hvalue

name: finiteOpenCoverCriterionData_of_positivePointOscillationThresholdsNull
statement:
private theorem finiteOpenCoverCriterionData_of_positivePointOscillationThresholdsNull
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.lt a b)
    (hnull : PositivePointOscillationThresholdsNull f a b) :
    FiniteOpenCoverCriterionData f a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  intro eps C heps hC
  let e2 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F eps
  have he2_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e2 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F heps
  let e4 := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F e2
  have he4_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero e4 :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F he2_pos
  cases
      exists_pos_eta_mul_intervalLength_lt
        (a := a) (b := b) (gap := e2) hab he2_pos with
  | intro eta heta =>
      cases
          exists_pos_delta_mul_lt_of_nonneg
            (C := C) (eps := e4) hC he4_pos with
      | intro coverBudget hcoverBudget =>
          have hbadData :
              PositiveThresholdCountableBadCoverData
                f a b eta coverBudget :=
            positiveThresholdCountableBadCoverData_of_thresholdsNull
              hnull heta.left hcoverBudget.left
          have hab_le : RealTheory.le a b :=
            IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hab
          cases
              finiteOpenIntervalPrefixCoverData_of_positiveThresholdCountableBadCoverData
                hab_le heta.left hbadData with
          | intro left hleft =>
              cases hleft with
              | intro right hright =>
                  cases hright with
                  | intro coverCount hcoverCount =>
                      have hcover :
                          FiniteOpenIntervalCoverUpTo
                            (ClosedIntervalPositivePointOscillationSet
                              f a b eta)
                            left right coverCount :=
                        hcoverCount.left
                      have hlength :
                          RealTheory.lt
                            (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
                              left right coverCount)
                            coverBudget :=
                        hcoverCount.right
                      cases
                          exists_pos_delta_omega_nat_mul_lt
                            (Omega := C) (N := coverCount)
                            hC he4_pos with
                      | intro rho hrho =>
                          let radius := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half F rho
                          have hradius :
                              RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero radius := by
                            dsimp [radius]
                            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos F hrho.left
                          have hdouble : doubleRadius radius = rho := by
                            dsimp [radius]
                            unfold doubleRadius
                            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half F rho
                          have hpoint :
                              FiniteOpenCoverGoodPointOscillationData
                                f a b left right coverCount eta :=
                            finiteOpenCoverGoodPointOscillationData_of_positiveThresholdCover
                              heta.left hcover
                          cases
                              exists_finiteOpenCoverGoodCellPairwiseOscillationControl_of_goodPointOscillationData
                                hab_le hpoint with
                          | intro delta0 hdelta0 =>
                              let delta := RealTheory.min delta0 radius
                              have hdelta_pos :
                                  RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero delta := by
                                dsimp [delta]
                                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.min2_pos F
                                  hdelta0.left hradius
                              have hdelta_radius :
                                  RealTheory.le delta radius := by
                                dsimp [delta]
                                exact RealTheory.min_le_right delta0 radius
                              have hlengthBudget :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealTheory.mul C
                                      (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
                                        left right coverCount))
                                    e4 := by
                                have hlength_le :
                                    RealTheory.le
                                      (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
                                        left right coverCount)
                                      coverBudget :=
                                  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlength
                                have hmul_le :
                                    RealTheory.le
                                      (RealTheory.mul C
                                        (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
                                          left right coverCount))
                                      (RealTheory.mul C coverBudget) :=
                                  RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left
                                    hlength_le hC
                                exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
                                  F hmul_le hcoverBudget.right
                              have hoverheadBudget :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealTheory.mul C
                                      (RealTheory.mul
                                        (RealTheory.nat coverCount)
                                        (doubleRadius radius)))
                                    e4 := by
                                rw [hdouble]
                                exact hrho.right
                              have hbadBudget :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (RealTheory.mul C
                                      (RealTheory.add
                                        (finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
                                          left right coverCount)
                                        (RealTheory.mul
                                          (RealTheory.nat coverCount)
                                          (doubleRadius radius))))
                                    e2 := by
                                let lengthTerm :=
                                  finiteOpenIntervalCoverLengthSum
                                    left right coverCount
                                let overheadTerm :=
                                  RealTheory.mul
                                    (RealTheory.nat coverCount)
                                    (doubleRadius radius)
                                have hmul_add :
                                    RealTheory.mul C
                                        (RealTheory.add lengthTerm
                                          overheadTerm) =
                                      RealTheory.add
                                        (RealTheory.mul C lengthTerm)
                                        (RealTheory.mul C overheadTerm) :=
                                  RealTheory.mul_add C lengthTerm overheadTerm
                                have hadd :
                                    RealTheory.lt
                                      (RealTheory.add
                                        (RealTheory.mul C lengthTerm)
                                        (RealTheory.mul C overheadTerm))
                                      (RealTheory.add e4 e4) := by
                                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add
                                    F hlengthBudget hoverheadBudget
                                have he4_add : RealTheory.add e4 e4 = e2 := by
                                  dsimp [e4]
                                  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_add_half
                                    F e2
                                rw [hmul_add]
                                rwa [he4_add] at hadd
                              refine Exists.intro eta ?_
                              refine Exists.intro coverCount ?_
                              refine Exists.intro left ?_
                              refine Exists.intro right ?_
                              refine Exists.intro radius ?_
                              refine Exists.intro delta ?_
                              refine And.intro
                                (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
                                  heta.left) ?_
                              refine And.intro hradius ?_
                              refine And.intro hdelta_pos ?_
                              refine And.intro hdelta_radius ?_
                              refine And.intro hcover.left ?_
                              refine And.intro heta.right ?_
                              refine And.intro hbadBudget ?_
                              intro partitionCount p hp hmesh
                              have hmesh_delta0 :
                                  RealTheory.lt
                                    (mesh p partitionCount) delta0 :=
                                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                                  F hmesh
                                  (by
                                    dsimp [delta]
                                    exact RealTheory.min_le_left
                                      delta0 radius)
                              exact
                                hdelta0.right partitionCount p hp
                                  hmesh_delta0

name: riemannOscillationCriterion_of_closedIntervalBounded_positivePointOscillationThresholdsNull

name: riemannIntegrableOn_of_closedIntervalBounded_positivePointOscillationThresholdsNull
statement:
private theorem riemannIntegrableOn_of_closedIntervalBounded_positivePointOscillationThresholdsNull
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}

    (hnull : PositivePointOscillationThresholdsNull f a b) :
    RiemannIntegrableOn f a b
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  by_cases hba : RealTheory.le b a
  · have hab_eq : a = b := RealTheory.le_antisymm hab hba
    rw [hab_eq]
    exact riemannIntegrableOn_degenerate f b
  · have hab_lt : RealTheory.lt a b :=
      IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le F hab hba
    exact
      riemannIntegrableOn_of_riemannOscillationCriterion hab
        (riemannOscillationCriterion_of_closedIntervalBounded_positivePointOscillationThresholdsNull
          hab_lt hbdd hnull)

name: closedIntervalDiscontinuitySet_subset_countablePositivePointOscillationThresholds

name: riemannIntegrableOn_iff_closedIntervalBounded_and_closedIntervalDiscontinuitySet_null
statement:
theorem riemannIntegrableOn_iff_closedIntervalBounded_and_closedIntervalDiscontinuitySet_null
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b) :
    RiemannIntegrableOn f a b <->
      And (ClosedIntervalBounded f a b)
        (RealNegligibility.NullSet (ClosedIntervalDiscontinuitySet f a b))
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro

        (riemannIntegrableOn_closedIntervalBounded hf)

name: almostEverywhereOn_eq_zero_of_nonnegative_of_integral_zero
statement:
theorem almostEverywhereOn_eq_zero_of_nonnegative_of_integral_zero
    {f : Point -> Point} {a b : Point}
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (hf : RiemannIntegrableOn f a b)
    (hzero : HasRiemannIntegral f a b RealTheory.zero)
    (hf_nonneg :
      forall x : Point,
        RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b x ->
          RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (f x)) :
    RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn
      (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
      (fun x : Point => f x = RealTheory.zero)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlt : RealTheory.lt a b
  case pos =>
    exact
      RealNegligibility.almostEverywhereOn_mono
        (E := RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
        (P := fun x : Point =>
          RealTheory.FunctionContinuousAtOn
            (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b) f x)
        (Q := fun x : Point => f x = RealTheory.zero)
        (fun x hx hcont => by
          have hnot_pos : Not (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (f x)) := by
            intro hpos
            have hzero_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero RealTheory.zero :=
              hasRiemannIntegral_pos_of_nonnegative_of_continuousAt_pos
                hlt hf hzero hf_nonneg hx hcont hpos
            exact
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
                RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.zero)
                hzero_pos
          have hle_zero : RealTheory.le (f x) RealTheory.zero :=
            by
              cases Classical.em
                  (RealTheory.le (f x) RealTheory.zero) with
              | inl hle => exact hle
              | inr hnot_le =>
                  exact False.elim
                    (hnot_pos
                      (RealTheory.lt_def.mpr
                        (And.intro (hf_nonneg x hx) hnot_le)))
          show f x = RealTheory.zero
          exact RealTheory.le_antisymm hle_zero (hf_nonneg x hx))
        (almostEverywhereOn_closedInterval_functionContinuousAtOn_of_riemannIntegrableOn
          hf)
  case neg =>
    have hba : RealTheory.le b a := by
      cases Classical.em (RealTheory.le b a) with
      | inl hle => exact hle
      | inr hnot_le =>
          exact False.elim
            (hlt (RealTheory.lt_def.mpr (And.intro hab hnot_le)))
    have hab_eq : a = b := RealTheory.le_antisymm hab hba
    subst b
    unfold RealNegligibility.AlmostEverywhereOn
    exact
      RealNegligibility.nullSet_mono
        (E := fun x : Point =>
          And (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a a x)
            (Not (f x = RealTheory.zero)))
        (F := fun x : Point => x = a)
        (fun x hx => RealTheory.le_antisymm hx.left.right hx.left.left)
        (RealNegligibility.nullSet_singleton a)

theorem mem_lt_natListBound {n : Nat} :

      List.Mem n xs -> n < natListBound xs
  | [], h => nomatch h
  | x :: xs, h => by
      cases h with
      | head =>
          dsimp [natListBound]
          omega
      | tail _ htail =>
          have hlt

          dsimp [natListBound]
          omega

proof:

  classical
  intro xs
  by_cases hxs : Exists (fun x : alpha => And (S x) (Not (List.Mem x xs)))
  · exact hxs
  · have hcover : ListedBy xs S := by
      intro x hxS
      by_cases hmem : List.Mem x xs
      · exact hmem
      · exact False.elim (hxs (Exists.intro x (And.intro hxS hmem)))

theorem sumSide_countable
    {alpha : Type u} {beta : Type v}
    (ha : Enumerable alpha) (hb : Enumerable beta) :
    forall n : Nat, CountableSet (sumSide alpha beta n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      exact countableSet_image_of_enumerable ha Sum.inl
  | succ n =>
      cases n with
      | zero =>
          exact countableSet_image_of_enumerable hb Sum.inr
      | succ n =>
          exact countableSet_empty

name: sumSide_covers
statement:
theorem sumSide_covers
    {alpha : Type u} {beta : Type v}
    (s : Sum alpha beta) :
    CountableUnion (sumSide alpha beta) s
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | inl a =>
      refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
      exact Exists.intro a (And.intro True.intro rfl)
  | inr b =>
      refine Exists.intro 1 ?_
      exact Exists.intro b (And.intro True.intro rfl)

name: enumerable_sum
statement:
theorem enumerable_sum
    {alpha : Type u} {beta : Type v}
    (ha : Enumerable alpha) (hb : Enumerable beta) :
    Enumerable (Sum alpha beta)
proof:
:= by
  have hUnion :
      CountableSet (CountableUnion (sumSide alpha beta)) :=
    countableSet_countableUnion (sumSide_countable ha hb)
  have hUniv :
      CountableSet (fun _ : Sum alpha beta => True) :=
    countableSet_mono hUnion
      (fun s _ => sumSide_covers s)
  exact enumerable_of_countableSet_univ hUniv

:= by
  intro x y hxy
  by_cases hx : Core f g x
  · by_cases hy : Core f g y
    · apply hf
      calc
        f x = map f g x := (map_of_core hx).symm
        _ = map f g y := hxy
        _ = f y := map_of_core hy
    · have hycore : Core f g y := by
        have hgy : g (map f g y) = y :=
          g_map_of_not_core hy
        rw [<- hgy, <- hxy, map_of_core hx]
        exact core_step hx
      exact False.elim (hy hycore)
  · by_cases hy : Core f g y
    · have hxcore : Core f g x := by
        have hgx : g (map f g x) = x :=
          g_map_of_not_core hx
        rw [<- hgx, hxy, map_of_core hy]
        exact core_step hy
      exact False.elim (hx hxcore)
    · have hgx : g (map f g x) = x :=
        g_map_of_not_core hx
      have hgy : g (map f g y) = y :=
        g_map_of_not_core hy
      calc
        x = g (map f g x) := hgx.symm
        _ = g (map f g y) := by rw [hxy]
        _ = y := hgy

name: map_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  by_cases hgy : Core f g (g y)
  · cases core_predecessor_of_core_range hg hgy with
    | intro x hx =>
        refine Exists.intro x ?_
        rw [map_of_core hx.left, hx.right]
  · refine Exists.intro (g y) ?_
    apply hg
    exact g_map_of_not_core hgy

name: countableSet_countableUnion
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Nat -> Nat -> Option alpha :=
    fun n => Classical.choose (hS n)
  have he :
      forall n : Nat, Enumerates (e n) (S n) := by
    intro n
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hS n)
  refine Exists.intro (countableUnionEnumFrom e) ?_
  intro x hx
  cases hx with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases he n x hn with
      | intro k hk =>
          refine Exists.intro (triangular (n + k) + k) ?_
          unfold countableUnionEnumFrom
          have hk_le : k <= n + k := by omega
          have hdiag := diagonalEnum_tri_add (n + k) k hk_le
          rw [hdiag]
          have hfirst : n + k - k = n := by omega
          rw [hfirst]
          exact hk

name: countableSet_indexedUnion
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases hi with
  | intro ei hei =>
      let e : iota -> Nat -> Option alpha :=
        fun i => Classical.choose (hS i)
      have he :
          forall i : iota, Enumerates (e i) (S i) := by
        intro i
        exact Classical.choose_spec (hS i)
      refine Exists.intro (indexedUnionEnumFrom ei e) ?_
      intro x hx
      cases hx with
      | intro i hiS =>
          cases hei i with
          | intro r hr =>
              cases he i x hiS with
              | intro k hk =>
                  refine Exists.intro (triangular (r + k) + k) ?_
                  unfold indexedUnionEnumFrom
                  have hk_le : k <= r + k := by omega
                  have hdiag := diagonalEnum_tri_add (r + k) k hk_le
                  rw [hdiag]
                  have hfirst : r + k - k = r := by omega
                  rw [hfirst]
                  simp [hr, hk]

          exact hfa
        exact hdiag hfa
      · have hdiag : diagonal a := hfa

name: diagonalEnum_start_and_within
statement:
theorem diagonalEnum_start_and_within (s : Nat) :
    And
      (diagonalEnum (triangular s) = (s, 0))
      (forall k : Nat,
        k <= s ->
          diagonalEnum (triangular s + k) = (s - k, k))
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero =>
      constructor
      · simp [triangular, diagonalEnum]
      · intro k hk
        have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
        subst hk0
        simp [triangular, diagonalEnum]
  | succ s ih =>
      have hend : diagonalEnum (triangular s + s) = (s - s, s) :=
        ih.right s (Nat.le_refl s)
      have hzero : s - s = 0 := by omega
      have hstart :
          diagonalEnum (triangular (s + 1)) = (s + 1, 0) := by
        have htri :
            triangular (s + 1) = (triangular s + s) + 1 := by
          simp [triangular]
        rw [htri]
        change
          (match diagonalEnum (triangular s + s) with
            | (0, b) => (b + 1, 0)
            | (a + 1, b) => (a, b + 1)) =
            (s + 1, 0)
        rw [hend, hzero]
      constructor
      · exact hstart
      · intro k
        induction k with
        | zero =>
            intro _hk
            simpa using hstart
        | succ k ihk =>
            intro hk
            have hkprev : k <= s + 1 := by omega
            have hprev :
                diagonalEnum (triangular (s + 1) + k) =
                  (s + 1 - k, k) :=
              ihk hkprev
            have hstep :
                triangular (s + 1) + (k + 1) =
                  (triangular (s + 1) + k) + 1 := by omega
            have hfirst : s + 1 - k = (s - k) + 1 := by omega
            have htarget : s + 1 - (k + 1) = s - k := by omega
            rw [hstep]
            change
              (match diagonalEnum (triangular (s + 1) + k) with
                | (0, b) => (b + 1, 0)
                | (a + 1, b) => (a, b + 1)) =
                (s + 1 - (k + 1), k + 1)
            rw [hprev, hfirst, htarget]

name: diagonalEnum_tri_add
statement:
theorem diagonalEnum_tri_add
    (s k : Nat) (hk : k <= s) :
    diagonalEnum (triangular s + k) = (s - k, k)
proof:
:=
  (diagonalEnum_start_and_within s).right k hk

      unfold natPairEnum
      have hb : b <= a + b := by omega

      have hfirst : a + b - b = a := by omega

name: exists_productEnum_pair
statement:
private theorem exists_productEnum_pair
    {alpha : Type u} {beta : Type v}
    (ea : Nat -> Option alpha) (eb : Nat -> Option beta)
    {a : alpha} {b : beta}
    (ha : Exists (fun i : Nat => ea i = some a))
    (hb : Exists (fun j : Nat => eb j = some b)) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat => productEnum ea eb n = some (a, b))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨triangular (i + j) + j, ?_⟩
  unfold productEnum
  rw [diagonalEnum_tri_add (i + j) j (by omega)]
  simp [hi, hj]

  | intro ea hea =>
      cases hb with
      | intro eb heb =>
          refine Exists.intro (productEnum ea eb) ?_
          intro p
          cases p with
          | mk a b =>
              exact exists_productEnum_pair ea eb (hea a) (heb b)

  | [], h => nomatch h
  | y :: ys, h => by
      cases h with

          exact Exists.intro 0 rfl
