  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.NestedBasic.length_lt_of_close_to_zero
    (F C) hnest hclose

name: common_point_le
statement:
theorem common_point_le {a b : Nat -> alpha} {x y : alpha}
    (hnest : (F C).NestedClosedIntervals a b)
    (hlen : (F C).IntervalLengthsToZero a b)
    (hx : forall n : Nat, And ((F C).le (a n) x) ((F C).le x (b n)))
    (hy : forall n : Nat, And ((F C).le (a n) y) ((F C).le y (b n))) :
    (F C).le x y
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.NestedBasic.common_point_le
    (F C) hnest hlen hx hy

name: common_points_equal
statement:
theorem common_points_equal {a b : Nat -> alpha} {x y : alpha}
    (hnest : (F C).NestedClosedIntervals a b)
    (hlen : (F C).IntervalLengthsToZero a b)
    (hx : forall n : Nat, And ((F C).le (a n) x) ((F C).le x (b n)))
    (hy : forall n : Nat, And ((F C).le (a n) y) ((F C).le y (b n))) :
    y = x
proof:
:=
  IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.NestedBasic.common_points_equal
    (F C) hnest hlen hx hy

name: exists_point
statement:
theorem exists_point {a b : Nat -> alpha}
    (hnest : (F C).NestedClosedIntervals a b) :
    Exists
      (fun x : alpha =>
        forall n : Nat,
          And ((F C).le (a n) x) ((F C).le x (b n)))
proof:
:=
  Exists.intro (supLowerEndpoints C hnest)
    (supLowerEndpoints_in_interval C hnest)

name: unique_point_of_lengths_zero
statement:
theorem unique_point_of_lengths_zero {a b : Nat -> alpha}
    (hnest : (F C).NestedClosedIntervals a b)
    (hlen : (F C).IntervalLengthsToZero a b) :
    Exists
      (fun x : alpha =>
        And
          (forall n : Nat,
            And ((F C).le (a n) x) ((F C).le x (b n)))
          (forall y : alpha,
            (forall n : Nat,
              And ((F C).le (a n) y) ((F C).le y (b n))) ->
                y = x))
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro (supLowerEndpoints C hnest) ?_
  constructor
  · exact supLowerEndpoints_in_interval C hnest
  · intro y hy
    exact common_points_equal C hnest hlen
      (supLowerEndpoints_in_interval C hnest) hy

name: nestedIntervalPrinciple
statement:
theorem nestedIntervalPrinciple :
    (F C).NestedIntervalPrinciple where
  exists_point
proof:
:= by
    intro a b hnest
    exact exists_point C hnest
  unique_point_of_lengths_zero := by
    intro a b hnest hlen
    exact unique_point_of_lengths_zero C hnest hlen

name: le_max_left
statement:
theorem le_max_left (x y : alpha) :
    F.le x (max F x y)
proof:
:=
  le_max2_left F x y

name: le_max_right
statement:
theorem le_max_right (x y : alpha) :
    F.le y (max F x y)
proof:
:=
  le_max2_right F x y

name: max_le
proof:
:=
  max2_le F hx hy

name: min_le_left
statement:
theorem min_le_left (x y : alpha) :
    F.le (min F x y) x
proof:
:=
  min2_le_left F x y

name: min_le_right
statement:
theorem min_le_right (x y : alpha) :
    F.le (min F x y) y
proof:
:=
  min2_le_right F x y

name: le_min
proof:
:=
  le_min2 F hx hy

name: radius_pos
statement:
theorem radius_pos (k : Nat) :
    F.lt F.zero (radius F k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold radius
  exact half_pos F
    (inv_pos F (nat_succ_pos F k))

name: cauchyIndex_spec
statement:
theorem cauchyIndex_spec {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hu : F.SeqCauchy u) (k : Nat) :
    forall n m : Nat,
      cauchyIndex F hu k <= n ->
        cauchyIndex F hu k <= m ->
          F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u m))) (radius F k)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (hu (radius F k) (radius_pos F k))

name: band_tail_mem
statement:
theorem band_tail_mem {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hu : F.SeqCauchy u) (k n : Nat)
    (hn : cauchyIndex F hu k <= n) :
    And
      (F.le (bandLower F hu k) (u n))
      (F.le (u n) (bandUpper F hu k))
proof:
:= by
  have hclose :=
    cauchyIndex_spec F hu k n (cauchyIndex F hu k) hn
      (Nat.le_refl (cauchyIndex F hu k))
  constructor
  · exact le_of_lt F (abs_sub_lt_left F hclose)
  · exact le_of_lt F (abs_sub_lt_right F hclose)

name: lower_zero
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: upper_zero
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: lower_succ
statement:
theorem lower_succ {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hu : F.SeqCauchy u) (k : Nat) :
    lower F hu (k + 1) =
      max F (lower F hu k) (bandLower F hu (k + 1))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: upper_succ
statement:
theorem upper_succ {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hu : F.SeqCauchy u) (k : Nat) :
    upper F hu (k + 1) =
      min F (upper F hu k) (bandUpper F hu (k + 1))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: tail_mem_interval
statement:
theorem tail_mem_interval {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hu : F.SeqCauchy u) :
    forall k : Nat,
      forall n : Nat,
        tailIndex F hu k <= n ->
          And
            (F.le (lower F hu k) (u n))
            (F.le (u n) (upper F hu k))
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro n hn
      exact band_tail_mem F hu 0 n hn
  | succ k ih =>
      intro n hn
      have htail_prev : tailIndex F hu k <= n :=
        Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_max_left (tailIndex F hu k)
          (cauchyIndex F hu (k + 1))) hn
      have htail_band : cauchyIndex F hu (k + 1) <= n :=
        Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_max_right (tailIndex F hu k)
          (cauchyIndex F hu (k + 1))) hn
      have hprev := ih n htail_prev
      have hband := band_tail_mem F hu (k + 1) n htail_band
      constructor
      · rw [lower_succ]
        exact max_le F hprev.left hband.left
      · rw [upper_succ]
        exact le_min F hprev.right hband.right

name: interval_order
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := tail_mem_interval F hu k (tailIndex F hu k)
    (Nat.le_refl (tailIndex F hu k))
  exact F.le_trans hmem.left hmem.right

name: lower_step_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [lower_succ]
  exact le_max_left F (lower F hu k) (bandLower F hu (k + 1))

name: upper_step_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [upper_succ]
  exact min_le_left F (upper F hu k) (bandUpper F hu (k + 1))

name: lower_mono
proof:
:= by
  induction hnm with
  | refl =>
      exact F.le_refl (lower F hu n)
  | step h ih =>
      exact F.le_trans ih (lower_step_le F hu _)

name: upper_antitone
proof:
:= by
  induction hnm with
  | refl =>
      exact F.le_refl (upper F hu n)
  | step h ih =>
      exact F.le_trans (upper_step_le F hu _) ih

name: bandLower_le_lower
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      rw [lower_zero]
      exact F.le_refl (bandLower F hu 0)
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [lower_succ]
      exact le_max_right F (lower F hu k) (bandLower F hu (k + 1))

name: upper_le_bandUpper
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      rw [upper_zero]
      exact F.le_refl (bandUpper F hu 0)
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [upper_succ]
      exact min_le_right F (upper F hu k) (bandUpper F hu (k + 1))

name: band_length
statement:
theorem band_length {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hu : F.SeqCauchy u) (k : Nat) :
    F.sub (bandUpper F hu k) (bandLower F hu k) =
      F.inv (nat F (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let c := u (cauchyIndex F hu k)
  let r := radius F k
  have hrr : F.add r r = F.inv (nat F (k + 1)) := by
    unfold r radius
    exact half_add_half F (F.inv (nat F (k + 1)))
  have hmain :
      F.sub (F.add c r) (F.sub c r) = F.add r r := by
    have hright :
        F.add (F.add r r) (F.sub c r) = F.add c r := by
      calc
        F.add (F.add r r) (F.sub c r) =
            F.add r (F.add r (F.sub c r)) := by
              rw [F.add_assoc]
        _ = F.add r (F.add (F.sub c r) r) := by
              rw [F.add_comm r (F.sub c r)]
        _ = F.add r c := by
              rw [sub_add_cancel F c r]
        _ = F.add c r := by rw [F.add_comm r c]
    apply add_right_cancel F (a := F.sub c r)
    calc
      F.add (F.sub (F.add c r) (F.sub c r)) (F.sub c r) =
          F.add c r := sub_add_cancel F (F.add c r) (F.sub c r)
      _ = F.add (F.add r r) (F.sub c r) := hright.symm
  unfold bandUpper bandLower
  change F.sub (F.add c r) (F.sub c r) = F.inv (nat F (k + 1))
  rw [hmain, hrr]

name: length_le_band_length
statement:
theorem length_le_band_length {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hu : F.SeqCauchy u) (k : Nat) :
    F.le (length F hu k)
      (F.sub (bandUpper F hu k) (bandLower F hu k))
proof:
:= by
  unfold length
  exact sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
    (upper_le_bandUpper F hu k)
    (bandLower_le_lower F hu k)

name: length_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold length
  exact sub_nonneg_of_le F (interval_order F hu k)

name: nested_intervals
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact interval_order F hu
  · constructor
    · intro n m hnm
      exact lower_mono F hu hnm
    · intro n m hnm
      exact upper_antitone F hu hnm

name: length_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem length_tendsto_zero {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hu : F.SeqCauchy u)
    (hinvNat : F.InvNatArchimedeanPrinciple) :
    F.IntervalLengthsToZero (lower F hu) (upper F hu)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hinvNat.small_inv_succ heps with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have hlen_le_N :
          F.le (length F hu n) (length F hu N) := by
        unfold length
        exact sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
          (upper_antitone F hu hn)
          (lower_mono F hu hn)
      have hlenN_le_inv :
          F.le (length F hu N) (F.inv (nat F (N + 1))) := by
        have h := length_le_band_length F hu N
        rwa [band_length F hu N] at h
      have hlen_lt : F.lt (length F hu n) eps :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt F
          (F.le_trans hlen_le_N hlenN_le_inv) hN
      have hnonneg := length_nonneg F hu n
      change
        F.lt (abs F (F.sub (length F hu n) F.zero)) eps
      rwa [sub_zero F (length F hu n), abs_of_nonneg F hnonneg]

name: interval_points_close
statement:
theorem interval_points_close {a b x y eps : alpha}
    (hx : And (F.le a x) (F.le x b))
    (hy : And (F.le a y) (F.le y b))
    (hlen : F.lt (F.sub b a) eps) :
    F.lt (abs F (F.sub x y)) eps
proof:
:=
  NestedBasic.interval_points_close F hx hy hlen

name: tendsto_nested_point
statement:
theorem tendsto_nested_point {u : Nat -> alpha} {l : alpha}
    (hu : F.SeqCauchy u)
    (hinvNat : F.InvNatArchimedeanPrinciple)
    (hl :
      forall n : Nat,
        And (F.le (lower F hu n) l) (F.le l (upper F hu n))) :
    F.SeqTendsto u l
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  have hlen := length_tendsto_zero F hu hinvNat eps heps
  cases hlen with
  | intro K hK =>
      refine Exists.intro (tailIndex F hu K) ?_
      intro n hn
      have htail := tail_mem_interval F hu K n hn
      have hlenK_close := hK K (Nat.le_refl K)
      have hlenK : F.lt (length F hu K) eps := by
        have hnonneg := length_nonneg F hu K
        change
          F.lt (abs F (F.sub (length F hu K) F.zero)) eps
          at hlenK_close
        rwa [sub_zero F (length F hu K), abs_of_nonneg F hnonneg]
          at hlenK_close
      exact interval_points_close F htail (hl K) hlenK

name: cauchyCriterion
statement:
theorem cauchyCriterion
    (hnested : F.NestedIntervalPrinciple)
    (hinvNat : F.InvNatArchimedeanPrinciple) :
    F.CauchyCriterionPrinciple where
  converges
proof:
:= by
    intro u hu
    have hnest : F.NestedClosedIntervals (lower F hu) (upper F hu) :=
      nested_intervals F hu
    have hlen : F.IntervalLengthsToZero (lower F hu) (upper F hu) :=
      length_tendsto_zero F hu hinvNat
    cases hnested.unique_point_of_lengths_zero
        (lower F hu) (upper F hu) hnest hlen with
    | intro l hl =>
        exact Exists.intro l
          (tendsto_nested_point F hu hinvNat hl.left)

name: dyadic_zero
statement:
theorem dyadic_zero :
    dyadic F 0 = F.one
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: dyadic_succ
statement:
theorem dyadic_succ (n : Nat) :
    dyadic F (n + 1) = F.mul (dyadic F n) (two F)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: dyadic_succ_eq_add
statement:
theorem dyadic_succ_eq_add (n : Nat) :
    dyadic F (n + 1) = F.add (dyadic F n) (dyadic F n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dyadic_succ]
  unfold two
  rw [F.mul_add, F.mul_one]

name: dyadic_pos
statement:
theorem dyadic_pos (n : Nat) :
    F.lt F.zero (dyadic F n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [dyadic_zero]
      exact zero_lt_one F
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [dyadic_succ]
      exact mul_pos F ih (zero_lt_two F)

name: dyadic_ne_zero
statement:
theorem dyadic_ne_zero (n : Nat) :
    Not (dyadic F n = F.zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact ne_of_lt F (dyadic_pos F n) h.symm

name: one_le_dyadic
statement:
theorem one_le_dyadic (n : Nat) :
    F.le F.one (dyadic F n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [dyadic_zero]
      exact F.le_refl F.one
  | succ n ih =>
      have h0 : F.le F.zero (dyadic F n) :=
        le_of_lt F (dyadic_pos F n)
      have hle_self_add :
          F.le (dyadic F n) (F.add (dyadic F n) (dyadic F n)) := by
        have h := add_le_add_left F h0 (dyadic F n)
        rwa [F.add_zero] at h
      exact F.le_trans ih (by
        rwa [<- dyadic_succ_eq_add F n] at hle_self_add)

name: nat_le_dyadic
statement:
theorem nat_le_dyadic (n : Nat) :
    F.le (nat F n) (dyadic F n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [nat_zero, dyadic_zero]
      exact zero_le_one F
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [nat_succ, dyadic_succ_eq_add]
      exact add_le_add F ih (one_le_dyadic F n)

name: exists_dyadic_gt
statement:
theorem exists_dyadic_gt (x : alpha) :
    Exists (fun n : Nat => (F C).lt x (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadic (F C) n))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_nat_gt C x with
  | intro n hn =>
      refine Exists.intro n ?_
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le (F C) hn
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.nat_le_dyadic (F C) n)

name: small_mul_inv
statement:
theorem small_mul_inv {L eps : alpha}
    (_hL : (F C).le (F C).zero L)
    (heps : (F C).lt (F C).zero eps) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        (F C).lt
          ((F C).mul L
            ((F C).inv (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadic (F C) n)))
          eps)
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_dyadic_gt C ((F C).mul L ((F C).inv eps)) with
  | intro n hn =>
      let d := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadic (F C) n
      have hdpos : (F C).lt (F C).zero d :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadic_pos (F C) n
      have hdne : Not (d = (F C).zero) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.dyadic_ne_zero (F C) n
      have heps_ne : Not (eps = (F C).zero) := by
        intro h
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt (F C) heps h.symm
      have hinv_eps_pos : (F C).lt (F C).zero ((F C).inv eps) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos (F C) heps
      have hmul_gt :
          (F C).lt L ((F C).mul d eps) := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_lt_mul_pos_right (F C) hn heps
        have hleft :
            (F C).mul ((F C).mul L ((F C).inv eps)) eps = L := by
          calc
            (F C).mul ((F C).mul L ((F C).inv eps)) eps =
                (F C).mul L ((F C).mul ((F C).inv eps) eps) := by
                  rw [(F C).mul_assoc]
            _ = (F C).mul L (F C).one := by
                  rw [(F C).inv_mul_cancel heps_ne]
            _ = L := by rw [(F C).mul_one]
        have hright :
            (F C).mul d eps = (F C).mul d eps := rfl
        rwa [hleft, hright] at h
      refine Exists.intro n ?_
      apply IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right (F C)
        (z := d) ?_ hdpos
      have hleft :
          (F C).mul
              ((F C).mul L ((F C).inv d)) d = L := by
        calc
          (F C).mul
              ((F C).mul L ((F C).inv d)) d =
              (F C).mul L ((F C).mul ((F C).inv d) d) := by
                rw [(F C).mul_assoc]
          _ = (F C).mul L (F C).one := by
                rw [(F C).inv_mul_cancel hdne]
          _ = L := by rw [(F C).mul_one]
      have hright :
          (F C).mul eps d = (F C).mul d eps := by
        rw [(F C).mul_comm eps d]
      rwa [hleft, hright]

name: dyadicArchimedean
statement:
theorem dyadicArchimedean :
    (F C).DyadicArchimedeanPrinciple where
  small_mul_inv
proof:
:= by
    intro L eps hL heps
    exact small_mul_inv C hL heps

name: limit_ge_of_eventually_ge
statement:
theorem limit_ge_of_eventually_ge {u : Nat -> alpha} {l c : alpha}
    (hu : F.SeqTendsto u l)
    (h : Eventually (fun n : Nat => F.le c (u n))) :
    F.le c l
proof:
:=
  seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le F
    (seqTendsto_const F c) hu h

name: limit_le_of_eventually_le
statement:
theorem limit_le_of_eventually_le {u : Nat -> alpha} {l c : alpha}
    (hu : F.SeqTendsto u l)
    (h : Eventually (fun n : Nat => F.le (u n) c)) :
    F.le l c
proof:
:=
  seqTendsto_le_of_eventually_le F
    hu (seqTendsto_const F c) h

name: lower_limit_in_interval
statement:
theorem lower_limit_in_interval {a b : Nat -> alpha} {l : alpha}
    (hnest : F.NestedClosedIntervals a b)
    (ha : F.SeqTendsto a l)
    (n : Nat) :
    And (F.le (a n) l) (F.le l (b n))
proof:
:= by
  refine And.intro ?_ ?_
  · apply limit_ge_of_eventually_ge F ha
    refine Exists.intro n ?_
    intro m hnm
    exact hnest.right.left n m hnm
  · apply limit_le_of_eventually_le F ha
    refine Exists.intro n ?_
    intro m hnm
    have ham_bm : F.le (a m) (b m) :=
      hnest.left m
    have hbm_bn : F.le (b m) (b n) :=
      hnest.right.right n m hnm
    exact F.le_trans ham_bm hbm_bn

name: length_lt_of_close_to_zero
statement:
theorem length_lt_of_close_to_zero {a b : Nat -> alpha} {eps : alpha}
    (hnest : F.NestedClosedIntervals a b)
    {n : Nat}
    (hclose :
      F.lt
        (abs F (F.sub (F.sub (b n) (a n)) F.zero))
        eps) :
    F.lt (F.sub (b n) (a n)) eps
proof:
:= by
  have hlen_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub (b n) (a n)) :=
    sub_nonneg_of_le F (hnest.left n)
  rwa [sub_zero F (F.sub (b n) (a n)),
    abs_of_nonneg F hlen_nonneg] at hclose

name: interval_points_close
statement:
theorem interval_points_close {a b x y eps : alpha}
    (hx : And (F.le a x) (F.le x b))
    (hy : And (F.le a y) (F.le y b))
    (hlen : F.lt (F.sub b a) eps) :
    F.lt (abs F (F.sub x y)) eps
proof:
:= by
  have hxy_le : F.le (F.sub x y) (F.sub b a) :=
    sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F hx.right hy.left
  have hyx_le : F.le (F.sub y x) (F.sub b a) :=
    sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F hy.right hx.left
  by_cases h0 : F.le F.zero (F.sub x y)
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg F h0]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt F hxy_le hlen
  · have hnonpos : F.le (F.sub x y) F.zero :=
      nonpos_of_not_nonneg F h0
    rw [abs_of_nonpos F hnonpos]
    rw [<- sub_rev_eq_neg_sub F x y]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt F hyx_le hlen

name: common_gap_le_length
statement:
theorem common_gap_le_length {a b : Nat -> alpha} {x y : alpha}
    (hx : forall n : Nat, And (F.le (a n) x) (F.le x (b n)))
    (hy : forall n : Nat, And (F.le (a n) y) (F.le y (b n)))
    (n : Nat) :
    F.le (F.sub x y) (F.sub (b n) (a n))
proof:
:=
  sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F (hx n).right (hy n).left

name: common_point_le
statement:
theorem common_point_le {a b : Nat -> alpha} {x y : alpha}
    (hnest : F.NestedClosedIntervals a b)
    (hlen : F.IntervalLengthsToZero a b)
    (hx : forall n : Nat, And (F.le (a n) x) (F.le x (b n)))
    (hy : forall n : Nat, And (F.le (a n) y) (F.le y (b n))) :
    F.le x y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : F.le x y
  · exact hxy
  · have hyx_le : F.le y x := by
      cases F.le_total y x with
      | inl hyx => exact hyx
      | inr hxy' => exact False.elim (hxy hxy')
    have hyx_lt : F.lt y x :=
      lt_of_le_of_not_le F hyx_le hxy
    let eps := F.sub x y
    have heps : F.lt F.zero eps :=
      sub_pos_of_lt F hyx_lt
    cases hlen eps heps with
    | intro N hN =>
        have hlength_lt :
            F.lt (F.sub (b N) (a N)) eps :=
          length_lt_of_close_to_zero F hnest (hN N (Nat.le_refl N))
        have hgap_le :
            F.le eps (F.sub (b N) (a N)) := by
          change F.le (F.sub x y) (F.sub (b N) (a N))
          exact common_gap_le_length F hx hy N
        have hbad : F.lt eps eps :=
          lt_of_le_of_lt F hgap_le hlength_lt
        exact False.elim (lt_irrefl F eps hbad)

name: common_points_equal
statement:
theorem common_points_equal {a b : Nat -> alpha} {x y : alpha}
    (hnest : F.NestedClosedIntervals a b)
    (hlen : F.IntervalLengthsToZero a b)
    (hx : forall n : Nat, And (F.le (a n) x) (F.le x (b n)))
    (hy : forall n : Nat, And (F.le (a n) y) (F.le y (b n))) :
    y = x
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : F.le x y :=
    common_point_le F hnest hlen hx hy
  have hyx : F.le y x :=
    common_point_le F hnest hlen hy hx
  exact F.le_antisymm hyx hxy

name: lower_zero
statement:
theorem lower_zero (u : Nat -> alpha) (B : alpha) :
    lower F u B 0 = u 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: upper_zero
statement:
theorem upper_zero (u : Nat -> alpha) (B : alpha) :
    upper F u B 0 = B
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: lower_succ_right
statement:
theorem lower_succ_right {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha} {n : Nat}
    (h :
      HasTermAbove F u
        (midpoint F (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n))) :
    lower F u B (n + 1) =
      midpoint F (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h' :
      HasTermAbove F u
        (midpoint F (bisectInterval F u B n).fst
          (bisectInterval F u B n).snd) := by
    simpa [lower, upper] using h
  simp [lower, upper, bisectInterval, stepInterval, h']

name: upper_succ_right
statement:
theorem upper_succ_right {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha} {n : Nat}
    (h :
      HasTermAbove F u
        (midpoint F (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n))) :
    upper F u B (n + 1) = upper F u B n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h' :
      HasTermAbove F u
        (midpoint F (bisectInterval F u B n).fst
          (bisectInterval F u B n).snd) := by
    simpa [lower, upper] using h
  simp [upper, bisectInterval, stepInterval, h']

name: lower_succ_left
statement:
theorem lower_succ_left {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha} {n : Nat}
    (h :
      Not
        (HasTermAbove F u
          (midpoint F (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n)))) :
    lower F u B (n + 1) = lower F u B n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h' :
      Not
        (HasTermAbove F u
          (midpoint F (bisectInterval F u B n).fst
            (bisectInterval F u B n).snd)) := by
    simpa [lower, upper] using h
  simp [lower, bisectInterval, stepInterval, h']

name: upper_succ_left
statement:
theorem upper_succ_left {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha} {n : Nat}
    (h :
      Not
        (HasTermAbove F u
          (midpoint F (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n)))) :
    upper F u B (n + 1) =
      midpoint F (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h' :
      Not
        (HasTermAbove F u
          (midpoint F (bisectInterval F u B n).fst
            (bisectInterval F u B n).snd)) := by
    simpa [lower, upper] using h
  simp [lower, upper, bisectInterval, stepInterval, h']

name: interval_order
statement:
theorem interval_order {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha}
    (_hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbdd : IsUpperBoundSeq F u B) :
    forall n : Nat, F.le (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [lower_zero, upper_zero]
      exact hbdd 0
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases h :
        HasTermAbove F u
          (midpoint F (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n))
      · rw [lower_succ_right F h, upper_succ_right F h]
        exact midpoint_le_right F ih
      · rw [lower_succ_left F h, upper_succ_left F h]
        exact left_le_midpoint F ih

name: lower_step_le
statement:
theorem lower_step_le {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbdd : IsUpperBoundSeq F u B)
    (n : Nat) :
    F.le (lower F u B n) (lower F u B (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h :
    HasTermAbove F u
      (midpoint F (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n))
  · rw [lower_succ_right F h]
    exact left_le_midpoint F (interval_order F hmono hbdd n)
  · rw [lower_succ_left F h]
    exact F.le_refl (lower F u B n)

name: upper_step_le
statement:
theorem upper_step_le {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbdd : IsUpperBoundSeq F u B)
    (n : Nat) :
    F.le (upper F u B (n + 1)) (upper F u B n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h :
    HasTermAbove F u
      (midpoint F (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n))
  · rw [upper_succ_right F h]
    exact F.le_refl (upper F u B n)
  · rw [upper_succ_left F h]
    exact midpoint_le_right F (interval_order F hmono hbdd n)

name: lower_mono
statement:
theorem lower_mono {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbdd : IsUpperBoundSeq F u B)
    {n m : Nat} (hnm : n <= m) :
    F.le (lower F u B n) (lower F u B m)
proof:
:= by
  induction hnm with
  | refl =>
      exact F.le_refl (lower F u B n)
  | step h ih =>
      exact F.le_trans ih (lower_step_le F hmono hbdd _)

name: upper_antitone
statement:
theorem upper_antitone {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbdd : IsUpperBoundSeq F u B)
    {n m : Nat} (hnm : n <= m) :
    F.le (upper F u B m) (upper F u B n)
proof:
:= by
  induction hnm with
  | refl =>
      exact F.le_refl (upper F u B n)
  | step h ih =>
      exact F.le_trans (upper_step_le F hmono hbdd _) ih

name: tail_in_interval
statement:
theorem tail_in_interval {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbdd : IsUpperBoundSeq F u B) :
    forall k : Nat,
      Exists
        (fun N : Nat =>
          forall n : Nat,
            N <= n ->
              And
                (F.le (lower F u B k) (u n))
                (F.le (u n) (upper F u B k)))
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      refine Exists.intro 0 ?_
      intro n hn
      constructor
      · rw [lower_zero]
        exact hmono 0 n hn
      · rw [upper_zero]
        exact hbdd n
  | succ k ih =>
      cases ih with
      | intro N hN =>
          by_cases h :
            HasTermAbove F u
              (midpoint F (lower F u B k) (upper F u B k))
          · cases h with
            | intro M hM =>
                refine Exists.intro (Nat.max N M) ?_
                intro n hn
                have hNn : N <= n :=
                  Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_max_left N M) hn
                have hMn : M <= n :=
                  Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_max_right N M) hn
                constructor
                · rw [lower_succ_right F (Exists.intro M hM)]
                  exact F.le_trans (le_of_lt F hM)
                    (hmono M n hMn)
                · rw [upper_succ_right F (Exists.intro M hM)]
                  exact (hN n hNn).right
          · refine Exists.intro N ?_
            intro n hn
            constructor
            · rw [lower_succ_left F h]
              exact (hN n hn).left
            · rw [upper_succ_left F h]
              apply le_of_not_lt F
              intro hmn
              exact h (Exists.intro n hmn)

name: length_zero
statement:
theorem length_zero (u : Nat -> alpha) (B : alpha) :
    length F u B 0 = F.sub B (u 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold length
  rw [lower_zero, upper_zero]

name: length_succ
statement:
theorem length_succ {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha}
    (_hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (_hbdd : IsUpperBoundSeq F u B)
    (n : Nat) :
    length F u B (n + 1) =
      half F (length F u B n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold length
  by_cases h :
    HasTermAbove F u
      (midpoint F (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n))
  · rw [lower_succ_right F h, upper_succ_right F h]
    exact right_sub_midpoint F (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n)
  · rw [lower_succ_left F h, upper_succ_left F h]
    exact midpoint_sub_left F (lower F u B n) (upper F u B n)

name: length_formula
statement:
theorem length_formula {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbdd : IsUpperBoundSeq F u B)
    (n : Nat) :
    length F u B n =
      F.mul (F.sub B (u 0)) (F.inv (dyadic F n))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [length_zero, dyadic_zero, inv_one F, F.mul_one]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [length_succ F hmono hbdd n, ih]
      unfold half
      rw [dyadic_succ]
      have hdne : Not (dyadic F n = F.zero) :=
        dyadic_ne_zero F n
      have htwo_ne : Not (two F = F.zero) :=
        two_ne_zero F
      rw [inv_mul F hdne htwo_ne]
      calc
        F.mul (F.mul (F.sub B (u 0)) (F.inv (dyadic F n)))
            (F.inv (two F)) =
            F.mul (F.sub B (u 0))
              (F.mul (F.inv (dyadic F n)) (F.inv (two F))) := by
              rw [F.mul_assoc]
        _ = F.mul (F.sub B (u 0))
              (F.mul (F.inv (two F)) (F.inv (dyadic F n))) := by
              rw [F.mul_comm (F.inv (dyadic F n)) (F.inv (two F))]

name: nested_intervals
statement:
theorem nested_intervals {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbdd : IsUpperBoundSeq F u B) :
    F.NestedClosedIntervals (lower F u B) (upper F u B)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact interval_order F hmono hbdd
  · constructor
    · intro n m hnm
      exact lower_mono F hmono hbdd hnm
    · intro n m hnm
      exact upper_antitone F hmono hbdd hnm

name: length_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem length_tendsto_zero {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbdd : IsUpperBoundSeq F u B)
    (hdyadic : F.DyadicArchimedeanPrinciple) :
    F.IntervalLengthsToZero (lower F u B) (upper F u B)
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let L := F.sub B (u 0)
  have hL_nonneg : F.le F.zero L :=
    sub_nonneg_of_le F (hbdd 0)
  cases hdyadic.small_mul_inv hL_nonneg heps with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have hlen_le :
          F.le (length F u B n) (length F u B N) := by
        unfold length
        exact sub_le_sub_of_le_of_le F
          (upper_antitone F hmono hbdd hn)
          (lower_mono F hmono hbdd hn)
      have hlenN :
          F.lt (length F u B N) eps := by
        rwa [length_formula F hmono hbdd N]
      have hlen_lt : F.lt (length F u B n) eps :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt F hlen_le hlenN
      have hlen_nonneg : F.le F.zero (length F u B n) := by
        unfold length
        exact sub_nonneg_of_le F (interval_order F hmono hbdd n)
      change
        F.lt (abs F (F.sub (length F u B n) F.zero)) eps
      rwa [sub_zero F (length F u B n),
        abs_of_nonneg F hlen_nonneg]

name: interval_points_close
statement:
theorem interval_points_close {a b x y eps : alpha}
    (hx : And (F.le a x) (F.le x b))
    (hy : And (F.le a y) (F.le y b))
    (hlen : F.lt (F.sub b a) eps) :
    F.lt (abs F (F.sub x y)) eps
proof:
:=
  NestedBasic.interval_points_close F hx hy hlen

name: increasing_tendsto_nested_point
statement:
theorem increasing_tendsto_nested_point {u : Nat -> alpha} {B l : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbdd : IsUpperBoundSeq F u B)
    (hdyadic : F.DyadicArchimedeanPrinciple)
    (hl :
      forall n : Nat,
        And
          (F.le (lower F u B n) l)
          (F.le l (upper F u B n))) :
    F.SeqTendsto u l
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  have hlen := length_tendsto_zero F hmono hbdd hdyadic eps heps
  cases hlen with
  | intro K hK =>
      cases tail_in_interval F hmono hbdd K with
      | intro N hN =>
          refine Exists.intro (Nat.max K N) ?_
          intro n hn
          have hKn : K <= n :=
            Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_max_left K N) hn
          have hNn : N <= n :=
            Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_max_right K N) hn
          have htail := hN n hNn
          have hlenK_close := hK K (Nat.le_refl K)
          have hlenK : F.lt (length F u B K) eps := by
            have hlen_nonneg : F.le F.zero (length F u B K) := by
              unfold length
              exact sub_nonneg_of_le F (interval_order F hmono hbdd K)
            change
              F.lt (abs F (F.sub (length F u B K) F.zero)) eps
              at hlenK_close
            rwa [sub_zero F (length F u B K),
              abs_of_nonneg F hlen_nonneg] at hlenK_close
          exact interval_points_close F htail (hl K) hlenK

name: increasing_converges
statement:
theorem increasing_converges
    (hnested : F.NestedIntervalPrinciple)
    (hdyadic : F.DyadicArchimedeanPrinciple)
    {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbdd : F.SeqBoundedAbove u) :
    Exists (fun l : alpha => F.SeqTendsto u l)
proof:
:= by
  cases hbdd with
  | intro B hB =>
      have hnest : F.NestedClosedIntervals (lower F u B) (upper F u B) :=
        nested_intervals F hmono hB
      have hlen : F.IntervalLengthsToZero (lower F u B) (upper F u B) :=
        length_tendsto_zero F hmono hB hdyadic
      cases hnested.unique_point_of_lengths_zero
          (lower F u B) (upper F u B) hnest hlen with
      | intro l hl =>
          exact Exists.intro l
            (increasing_tendsto_nested_point F hmono hB hdyadic hl.left)

name: decreasing_converges
statement:
theorem decreasing_converges
    (hnested : F.NestedIntervalPrinciple)
    (hdyadic : F.DyadicArchimedeanPrinciple)
    {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneDecreasing u)
    (hbdd : F.SeqBoundedBelow u) :
    Exists (fun l : alpha => F.SeqTendsto u l)
proof:
:= by
  let v : Nat -> alpha := fun n => F.neg (u n)
  have hvmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing v :=
    FromCauchyMonotone.neg_monotone_increasing_of_decreasing F hmono
  have hvbdd : F.SeqBoundedAbove v :=
    FromCauchyMonotone.neg_boundedAbove_of_boundedBelow F hbdd
  cases increasing_converges F hnested hdyadic hvmono hvbdd with
  | intro L hL =>
      refine Exists.intro (F.neg L) ?_
      have hneg := seqTendsto_neg F hL
      intro eps heps
      apply Eventually.mono ?_ (hneg eps heps)
      intro n hn
      simpa [v, neg_neg F (u n)] using hn

name: monotoneConvergence
statement:
theorem monotoneConvergence
    (hnested : F.NestedIntervalPrinciple)
    (hdyadic : F.DyadicArchimedeanPrinciple) :
    F.MonotoneConvergencePrinciple where
  increasing
proof:
:= by
    intro u hmono hbdd
    exact increasing_converges F hnested hdyadic hmono hbdd
  decreasing := by
    intro u hmono hbdd
    exact decreasing_converges F hnested hdyadic hmono hbdd

name: lower_endpoints_seqCauchy
statement:
theorem lower_endpoints_seqCauchy {a b : Nat -> alpha}
    (hnest : F.NestedClosedIntervals a b)
    (hlen : F.IntervalLengthsToZero a b) :
    F.SeqCauchy a
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hlen eps heps with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n m hn hm
      have hlenN :
          F.lt (F.sub (b N) (a N)) eps :=
        NestedBasic.length_lt_of_close_to_zero F hnest
          (hN N (Nat.le_refl N))
      have hnmem :
          And (F.le (a N) (a n)) (F.le (a n) (b N)) := by
        constructor
        · exact hnest.right.left N n hn
        · exact F.le_trans (hnest.left n)
            (hnest.right.right N n hn)
      have hmmem :
          And (F.le (a N) (a m)) (F.le (a m) (b N)) := by
        constructor
        · exact hnest.right.left N m hm
        · exact F.le_trans (hnest.left m)
            (hnest.right.right N m hm)
      exact NestedBasic.interval_points_close F hnmem hmmem hlenN

name: unique_point_of_lengths_zero
statement:
theorem unique_point_of_lengths_zero
    (hcauchy : F.CauchyCriterionPrinciple)
    {a b : Nat -> alpha}
    (hnest : F.NestedClosedIntervals a b)
    (hlen : F.IntervalLengthsToZero a b) :
    Exists
      (fun x : alpha =>
        And
          (forall n : Nat,
            And (F.le (a n) x) (F.le x (b n)))
          (forall y : alpha,
            (forall n : Nat,
              And (F.le (a n) y) (F.le y (b n))) ->
                y = x))
proof:
:= by
  have ha_cauchy : F.SeqCauchy a :=
    lower_endpoints_seqCauchy F hnest hlen
  cases hcauchy.converges a ha_cauchy with
  | intro l hl =>
      refine Exists.intro l ?_
      have hlmem :
          forall n : Nat,
            And (F.le (a n) l) (F.le l (b n)) :=
        NestedBasic.lower_limit_in_interval F hnest hl
      refine And.intro hlmem ?_
      intro y hy
      exact NestedBasic.common_points_equal F hnest hlen hlmem hy

name: lower_endpoints_bounded_above
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro (b 0) ?_
  intro n
  have hb : F.le (b n) (b 0) :=
    hnest.right.right 0 n (Nat.zero_le n)
  exact F.le_trans (hnest.left n) hb

name: exists_point
statement:
theorem exists_point
    (hmono : F.MonotoneConvergencePrinciple)
    {a b : Nat -> alpha}
    (hnest : F.NestedClosedIntervals a b) :
    Exists
      (fun x : alpha =>
        forall n : Nat,
          And (F.le (a n) x) (F.le x (b n)))
proof:
:= by
  have hinc : F.MonotoneIncreasing a :=
    hnest.right.left
  have hbdd : F.SeqBoundedAbove a :=
    lower_endpoints_bounded_above F hnest
  cases hmono.increasing a hinc hbdd with
  | intro l hl =>
      exact Exists.intro l (NestedBasic.lower_limit_in_interval F hnest hl)

name: unique_point_of_lengths_zero
statement:
theorem unique_point_of_lengths_zero
    (hmono : F.MonotoneConvergencePrinciple)
    {a b : Nat -> alpha}
    (hnest : F.NestedClosedIntervals a b)
    (hlen : F.IntervalLengthsToZero a b) :
    Exists
      (fun x : alpha =>
        And
          (forall n : Nat,
            And (F.le (a n) x) (F.le x (b n)))
          (forall y : alpha,
            (forall n : Nat,
              And (F.le (a n) y) (F.le y (b n))) ->
                y = x))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_point F hmono hnest with
  | intro x hx =>
      refine Exists.intro x ?_
      refine And.intro hx ?_
      intro y hy
      exact NestedBasic.common_points_equal F hnest hlen hx hy

name: nestedIntervalPrinciple
statement:
theorem nestedIntervalPrinciple
    (hmono : F.MonotoneConvergencePrinciple) :
    F.NestedIntervalPrinciple where
  exists_point
proof:
:= by
    intro a b hnest
    exact exists_point F hmono hnest
  unique_point_of_lengths_zero := by
    intro a b hnest hlen
    exact unique_point_of_lengths_zero F hmono hnest hlen

name: eventually_subsequence_of_eventually
proof:
:= by
  cases hP with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have hn_phi : n <= phi n :=
        subsequenceIndex_ge_self hphi n
      exact hN (phi n) (Nat.le_trans hn hn_phi)

name: seqCauchy_eventually_upper
proof:
:= by
  cases hu F.one (zero_lt_one F) with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro (F.add (u N) F.one) ?_
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have hclose := hN n N hn (Nat.le_refl N)
      exact le_of_lt F (abs_sub_lt_right F hclose)

name: seqCauchy_eventually_lower
proof:
:= by
  cases hu F.one (zero_lt_one F) with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro (F.sub (u N) F.one) ?_
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      have hclose := hN n N hn (Nat.le_refl N)
      exact le_of_lt F (abs_sub_lt_left F hclose)

name: monotoneIncreasing_boundedAbove_of_eventually_le
statement:
theorem monotoneIncreasing_boundedAbove_of_eventually_le
    {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hB : Eventually (fun n : Nat => F.le (u n) B)) :
    F.SeqBoundedAbove u
proof:
:= by
  cases hB with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro B ?_
      intro n
      cases Nat.le_total n N with
      | inl hnN =>
          exact F.le_trans (hmono n N hnN) (hN N (Nat.le_refl N))
      | inr hNn =>
          exact hN n hNn

name: monotoneDecreasing_boundedBelow_of_eventually_ge
statement:
theorem monotoneDecreasing_boundedBelow_of_eventually_ge
    {u : Nat -> alpha} {B : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneDecreasing u)
    (hB : Eventually (fun n : Nat => F.le B (u n))) :
    F.SeqBoundedBelow u
proof:
:= by
  cases hB with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro B ?_
      intro n
      cases Nat.le_total n N with
      | inl hnN =>
          exact F.le_trans (hN N (Nat.le_refl N)) (hmono n N hnN)
      | inr hNn =>
          exact hN n hNn

name: seqTendsto_of_cauchy_subsequence
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let delta := half F eps
  have hdelta : F.lt F.zero delta :=
    half_pos F heps
  cases hu delta hdelta with
  | intro Nc hNc =>
      cases hsub delta hdelta with
      | intro Ns hNs =>
          let K := Nat.max Nc Ns
          refine Exists.intro K ?_
          intro n hn
          have hNc_n : Nc <= n :=
            Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_max_left Nc Ns) hn
          have hNs_K : Ns <= K :=
            Nat.le_max_right Nc Ns
          have hK_phi : K <= phi K :=
            subsequenceIndex_ge_self hphi K
          have hNc_phi : Nc <= phi K :=
            Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_max_left Nc Ns) hK_phi
          have hclose_cauchy :
              F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u (phi K)))) delta :=
            hNc n (phi K) hNc_n hNc_phi
          have hclose_sub :
              F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u (phi K)) l)) delta :=
            hNs K hNs_K
          have hsum :
              F.lt
                (F.add
                  (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u (phi K))))
                  (abs F (F.sub (u (phi K)) l)))
                eps := by
            have hsum_delta :
                F.lt
                  (F.add
                    (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u (phi K))))
                    (abs F (F.sub (u (phi K)) l)))
                  (F.add delta delta) :=
              add_lt_add F hclose_cauchy hclose_sub
            rwa [half_add_half F eps] at hsum_delta
          have htri :
              F.le (abs F (F.sub (u n) l))
                (F.add
                  (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u (phi K))))
                  (abs F (F.sub (u (phi K)) l))) := by
            have h :=
              abs_add_le_abs_add_abs F
                (F.sub (u n) (u (phi K)))
                (F.sub (u (phi K)) l)
            rwa [sub_add_sub_cancel F (u n) (u (phi K)) l] at h
          exact lt_of_le_of_lt F htri hsum

name: cauchy_converges
statement:
theorem cauchy_converges
    (hmono : F.MonotoneConvergencePrinciple)
    {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hu : F.SeqCauchy u) :
    Exists (fun l : alpha => F.SeqTendsto u l)
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_monotone_subsequence F u with
  | intro phi hphi =>
      cases hphi.right with
      | inl hinc =>
          cases seqCauchy_eventually_upper F hu with
          | intro B hB =>
              have hBsub :
                  Eventually
                    (fun n : Nat =>
                      F.le (subsequence u phi n) B) :=
                eventually_subsequence_of_eventually hphi.left hB
              have hbdd :
                  F.SeqBoundedAbove (subsequence u phi) :=
                monotoneIncreasing_boundedAbove_of_eventually_le
                  F hinc hBsub
              cases hmono.increasing (subsequence u phi) hinc hbdd with
              | intro l hl =>
                  exact Exists.intro l
                    (seqTendsto_of_cauchy_subsequence F hu hphi.left hl)
      | inr hdec =>
          cases seqCauchy_eventually_lower F hu with
          | intro B hB =>
              have hBsub :
                  Eventually
                    (fun n : Nat =>
                      F.le B (subsequence u phi n)) :=
                eventually_subsequence_of_eventually hphi.left hB
              have hbdd :
                  F.SeqBoundedBelow (subsequence u phi) :=
                monotoneDecreasing_boundedBelow_of_eventually_ge
                  F hdec hBsub
              cases hmono.decreasing (subsequence u phi) hdec hbdd with
              | intro l hl =>
                  exact Exists.intro l
                    (seqTendsto_of_cauchy_subsequence F hu hphi.left hl)

name: cauchyCriterion
statement:
theorem cauchyCriterion
    (hmono : F.MonotoneConvergencePrinciple) :
    F.CauchyCriterionPrinciple where
  converges
proof:
:= by
    intro u hu
    exact cauchy_converges F hmono hu

name: add_le_of_sub_le
proof:
:= by
  have h' := F.add_le_add_right h x
  have hleft : F.add eps x = F.add x eps :=
    F.add_comm eps x
  rwa [hleft, sub_add_cancel F y x] at h'

name: add_nat_mul_succ
statement:
theorem add_nat_mul_succ (x eps : alpha) (k : Nat) :
    F.add (F.add x (F.mul (nat F k) eps)) eps =
      F.add x (F.mul (nat F (k + 1)) eps)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    F.add (F.add x (F.mul (nat F k) eps)) eps =
        F.add x (F.add (F.mul (nat F k) eps) eps) := by
          rw [F.add_assoc]
    _ = F.add x
        (F.add (F.mul (nat F k) eps) (F.mul F.one eps)) := by
          rw [F.one_mul]
    _ = F.add x (F.mul (F.add (nat F k) F.one) eps) := by
          rw [F.add_mul]
    _ = F.add x (F.mul (nat F (k + 1)) eps) := by
          rw [nat_succ]

name: exists_bad_pair_of_not_cauchy_at
statement:
theorem exists_bad_pair_of_not_cauchy_at {u : Nat -> alpha}
    {eps : alpha}
    (hbad :
      Not
        (Exists
          (fun N : Nat =>
            forall n m : Nat,
              N <= n ->
                N <= m ->
                  F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u m))) eps)))
    (N : Nat) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        Exists
          (fun m : Nat =>
            And (N <= n)
              (And (N <= m)
                (Not (F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u m))) eps)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hex :
      Exists
        (fun n : Nat =>
          Exists
            (fun m : Nat =>
              And (N <= n)
                (And (N <= m)
                  (Not (F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u m))) eps)))))
  · exact hex
  · have hgood :
        forall n m : Nat,
          N <= n ->
            N <= m ->
              F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u m))) eps := by
      intro n m hn hm
      by_cases hlt : F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u m))) eps
      · exact hlt
      · exact False.elim
          (hex
            (Exists.intro n
              (Exists.intro m
                (And.intro hn (And.intro hm hlt)))))
    exact False.elim (hbad (Exists.intro N hgood))

name: exists_later_add_eps_le_of_not_cauchy
statement:
theorem exists_later_add_eps_le_of_not_cauchy {u : Nat -> alpha}
    {eps : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbad :
      Not
        (Exists
          (fun N : Nat =>
            forall n m : Nat,
              N <= n ->
                N <= m ->
                  F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u m))) eps)))
    (N : Nat) :
    Exists (fun M : Nat =>
      And (N <= M) (F.le (F.add (u N) eps) (u M)))
proof:
:= by
  cases exists_bad_pair_of_not_cauchy_at F hbad N with
  | intro n hn =>
      cases hn with
      | intro m hm =>
          have hNn : N <= n := hm.left
          have hNm : N <= m := hm.right.left
          have hnot : Not (F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u m))) eps) :=
            hm.right.right
          have hle_abs : F.le eps (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u m))) :=
            le_of_not_lt F hnot
          cases Nat.le_total n m with
          | inl hnm =>
              have hunm : F.le (u n) (u m) :=
                hmono n m hnm
              have hgap_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub (u m) (u n)) :=
                sub_nonneg_of_le F hunm
              have hle_gap : F.le eps (F.sub (u m) (u n)) := by
                rwa [abs_sub_comm F (u n) (u m),
                  abs_of_nonneg F hgap_nonneg] at hle_abs
              have hadd : F.le (F.add (u n) eps) (u m) :=
                add_le_of_sub_le F hle_gap
              have hN_add :
                  F.le (F.add (u N) eps) (F.add (u n) eps) :=
                F.add_le_add_right (hmono N n hNn) eps
              exact Exists.intro m
                (And.intro hNm (F.le_trans hN_add hadd))
          | inr hmn =>
              have humn : F.le (u m) (u n) :=
                hmono m n hmn
              have hgap_nonneg : F.le F.zero (F.sub (u n) (u m)) :=
                sub_nonneg_of_le F humn
              have hle_gap : F.le eps (F.sub (u n) (u m)) := by
                rwa [abs_of_nonneg F hgap_nonneg] at hle_abs
              have hadd : F.le (F.add (u m) eps) (u n) :=
                add_le_of_sub_le F hle_gap
              have hN_add :
                  F.le (F.add (u N) eps) (F.add (u m) eps) :=
                F.add_le_add_right (hmono N m hNm) eps
              exact Exists.intro n
                (And.intro hNn (F.le_trans hN_add hadd))

name: jumpIndex_step_le
statement:
theorem jumpIndex_step_le {u : Nat -> alpha} {eps : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbad :
      Not
        (Exists
          (fun N : Nat =>
            forall n m : Nat,
              N <= n ->
                N <= m ->
                  F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u m))) eps)))
    (k : Nat) :
    F.le
      (F.add (u (jumpIndex F hmono hbad k)) eps)
      (u (jumpIndex F hmono hbad (k + 1)))
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec
    (exists_later_add_eps_le_of_not_cauchy F hmono hbad
      (jumpIndex F hmono hbad k))).right

name: jumpIndex_lower_bound
statement:
theorem jumpIndex_lower_bound {u : Nat -> alpha} {eps : alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbad :
      Not
        (Exists
          (fun N : Nat =>
            forall n m : Nat,
              N <= n ->
                N <= m ->
                  F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u m))) eps)))
    (k : Nat) :
    F.le
      (F.add (u 0) (F.mul (nat F k) eps))
      (u (jumpIndex F hmono hbad k))
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      change F.le (F.add (u 0) (F.mul (nat F 0) eps)) (u 0)
      rw [nat_zero, zero_mul F, F.add_zero]
      exact F.le_refl (u 0)
  | succ k ih =>
      have hprev_add :
          F.le
            (F.add (F.add (u 0) (F.mul (nat F k) eps)) eps)
            (F.add (u (jumpIndex F hmono hbad k)) eps) :=
        F.add_le_add_right ih eps
      have hstep := jumpIndex_step_le F hmono hbad k
      have hmain :
          F.le
            (F.add (F.add (u 0) (F.mul (nat F k) eps)) eps)
            (u (jumpIndex F hmono hbad (k + 1))) :=
        F.le_trans hprev_add hstep
      rwa [add_nat_mul_succ F (u 0) eps k] at hmain

name: increasing_seqCauchy_of_bounded
statement:
theorem increasing_seqCauchy_of_bounded
    (harch : F.LinearArchimedeanPrinciple)
    {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing u)
    (hbdd : F.SeqBoundedAbove u) :
    F.SeqCauchy u
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  classical
  by_cases hgood :
      Exists
        (fun N : Nat =>
          forall n m : Nat,
            N <= n ->
              N <= m ->
                F.lt (abs F (F.sub (u n) (u m))) eps)
  · exact hgood
  · cases hbdd with
    | intro B hB =>
        let L := F.sub B (u 0)
        have hL_nonneg : F.le F.zero L :=
          sub_nonneg_of_le F (hB 0)
        cases harch.large_nat_mul hL_nonneg heps with
        | intro K hK =>
            have hlow :=
              jumpIndex_lower_bound F hmono hgood K
            have hupper : F.le (u (jumpIndex F hmono hgood K)) B :=
              hB (jumpIndex F hmono hgood K)
            have hsum_le_B :
                F.le
                  (F.add (u 0) (F.mul (nat F K) eps))
                  B :=
              F.le_trans hlow hupper
            have hB_lt_sum :
                F.lt B (F.add (u 0) (F.mul (nat F K) eps)) := by
              have h := add_lt_add_right F hK (u 0)
              have hright :
                  F.add (F.mul (nat F K) eps) (u 0) =
                    F.add (u 0) (F.mul (nat F K) eps) :=
                F.add_comm (F.mul (nat F K) eps) (u 0)
              rwa [sub_add_cancel F B (u 0), hright] at h
            exact False.elim ((not_le_of_lt F hB_lt_sum) hsum_le_B)

name: seqCauchy_of_neg_seqCauchy
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  cases hv eps heps with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n m hn hm
      have h := hN n m hn hm
      simpa [sub_neg_neg_eq_neg_sub F (u n) (u m),
        abs_neg F (F.sub (u n) (u m))] using h

name: decreasing_seqCauchy_of_bounded
statement:
theorem decreasing_seqCauchy_of_bounded
    (harch : F.LinearArchimedeanPrinciple)
    {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hmono : F.MonotoneDecreasing u)
    (hbdd : F.SeqBoundedBelow u) :
    F.SeqCauchy u
proof:
:= by
  let v : Nat -> alpha := fun n => F.neg (u n)
  have hvmono : F.MonotoneIncreasing v :=
    neg_monotone_increasing_of_decreasing F hmono
  have hvbdd : F.SeqBoundedAbove v :=
    neg_boundedAbove_of_boundedBelow F hbdd
  have hvcauchy : F.SeqCauchy v :=
    increasing_seqCauchy_of_bounded F harch hvmono hvbdd
  exact seqCauchy_of_neg_seqCauchy F hvcauchy

name: monotoneConvergence
statement:
theorem monotoneConvergence
    (hcauchy : F.CauchyCriterionPrinciple)
    (harch : F.LinearArchimedeanPrinciple) :
    F.MonotoneConvergencePrinciple where
  increasing
proof:
:= by
    intro u hmono hbdd
    exact hcauchy.converges u
      (increasing_seqCauchy_of_bounded F harch hmono hbdd)
  decreasing := by
    intro u hmono hbdd
    exact hcauchy.converges u
      (decreasing_seqCauchy_of_bounded F harch hmono hbdd)

name: eventualLowerBound_mono
statement:
theorem eventualLowerBound_mono {u : Nat -> alpha} {x y : alpha}
    (hxy : (F C).le y x)
    (hx : EventualLowerBound C u x) :
    EventualLowerBound C u y
proof:
:= by
  cases hx with
  | intro N hN =>
      exact Exists.intro N
        (fun n hn => (F C).le_trans hxy (hN n hn))

name: cauchy_tail_center_lower
statement:
theorem cauchy_tail_center_lower {u : Nat -> alpha}
    {eps : alpha} {N n : Nat}
    (hc :
      forall n m : Nat,
        N <= n ->
          N <= m ->
            (F C).lt
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs (F C)
                ((F C).sub (u n) (u m))) eps)
    (hn : N <= n) :
    (F C).lt ((F C).sub (u N) eps) (u n)
proof:
:= by
  have hclose : (F C).lt
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs (F C) ((F C).sub (u n) (u N))) eps :=
    hc n N hn (Nat.le_refl N)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_left (F C) hclose

name: cauchy_tail_center_upper
statement:
theorem cauchy_tail_center_upper {u : Nat -> alpha}
    {eps : alpha} {N n : Nat}
    (hc :
      forall n m : Nat,
        N <= n ->
          N <= m ->
            (F C).lt
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs (F C)
                ((F C).sub (u n) (u m))) eps)
    (hn : N <= n) :
    (F C).lt (u n) ((F C).add (u N) eps)
proof:
:= by
  have hclose : (F C).lt
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs (F C) ((F C).sub (u n) (u N))) eps :=
    hc n N hn (Nat.le_refl N)
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right (F C) hclose

name: eventual_lower_nonempty_of_cauchy
proof:
:= by
  cases hu (F C).one (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one (F C)) with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro ((F C).sub (u N) (F C).one) ?_
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt (F C)
        (cauchy_tail_center_lower C hN hn)

name: eventual_lower_bounded_above_of_cauchy
proof:
:= by
  cases hu (F C).one (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.zero_lt_one (F C)) with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro ((F C).add (u N) (F C).one) ?_
      intro x hx
      cases hx with
      | intro M hM =>
          let K := Nat.max N M
          have hNK : N <= K := Nat.le_max_left N M
          have hMK : M <= K := Nat.le_max_right N M
          have hxK : (F C).le x (u K) := hM K hMK
          have hKupper : (F C).lt (u K) ((F C).add (u N) (F C).one) :=
            cauchy_tail_center_upper C (n := K) hN hNK
          exact (F C).le_trans hxK
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt (F C) hKupper)

name: tail_center_lower_mem
statement:
theorem tail_center_lower_mem {u : Nat -> alpha}
    {eps : alpha} {N : Nat}
    (hc :
      forall n m : Nat,
        N <= n ->
          N <= m ->
            (F C).lt
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs (F C)
                ((F C).sub (u n) (u m))) eps) :
    EventualLowerBound C u ((F C).sub (u N) eps)
proof:
:= by
  refine Exists.intro N ?_
  intro n hn
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt (F C)
    (cauchy_tail_center_lower C (n := n) hc hn)

name: tail_center_upper_bound
statement:
theorem tail_center_upper_bound {u : Nat -> alpha}
    {eps : alpha} {N : Nat}
    (hc :
      forall n m : Nat,
        N <= n ->
          N <= m ->
            (F C).lt
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs (F C)
                ((F C).sub (u n) (u m))) eps) :
    IsUpperBound (F C).le (EventualLowerBound C u)
      ((F C).add (u N) eps)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  cases hx with
  | intro M hM =>
      let K := Nat.max N M
      have hNK : N <= K := Nat.le_max_left N M
      have hMK : M <= K := Nat.le_max_right N M
      have hxK : (F C).le x (u K) := hM K hMK
      have hKupper : (F C).lt (u K) ((F C).add (u N) eps) :=
        cauchy_tail_center_upper C (n := K) hc hNK
      exact (F C).le_trans hxK
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt (F C) hKupper)

name: limitCandidate_is_lub
statement:
theorem limitCandidate_is_lub {u : Nat -> alpha}
    (hu : (F C).SeqCauchy u) :
    IsLeastUpperBound (F C).le
      (EventualLowerBound C u) (limitCandidate C hu)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec
    (C.exists_lub (EventualLowerBound C u)
      (eventual_lower_nonempty_of_cauchy C hu)
      (eventual_lower_bounded_above_of_cauchy C hu))

name: limitCandidate_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  intro eps heps
  let d := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half (F C) eps
  have hd : (F C).lt (F C).zero d :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.half_pos (F C) heps
  cases hu d hd with
  | intro N hN =>
      refine Exists.intro N ?_
      intro n hn
      let s := limitCandidate C hu
      have hs : IsLeastUpperBound (F C).le
          (EventualLowerBound C u) s :=
        limitCandidate_is_lub C hu
      have hlower_mem : EventualLowerBound C u ((F C).sub (u N) d) :=
        tail_center_lower_mem C hN
      have hlower_le_s : (F C).le ((F C).sub (u N) d) s :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_lub_of_mem (F C) hs hlower_mem
      have hupper_bound : IsUpperBound (F C).le
          (EventualLowerBound C u) ((F C).add (u N) d) :=
        tail_center_upper_bound C hN
      have hs_le_upper : (F C).le s ((F C).add (u N) d) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lub_le_of_upper (F C) hs hupper_bound
      have hcenter_close : (F C).lt
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs (F C)
            ((F C).sub (u N) (u n))) d :=
        hN N n (Nat.le_refl N) hn
      have hcenter_lt_n_add :
          (F C).lt (u N) ((F C).add (u n) d) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_right (F C) hcenter_close
      have hupper_lt_n_eps :
          (F C).lt ((F C).add (u N) d) ((F C).add (u n) eps) := by
        have h := (F C).add_lt_add_right hcenter_lt_n_add d
        have hright :
            (F C).add ((F C).add (u n) d) d =
              (F C).add (u n) eps := by
          unfold d
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_half_add_half (F C) (u n) eps
        rwa [hright] at h
      have hs_lt_n_eps :
          (F C).lt s ((F C).add (u n) eps) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt (F C)
          hs_le_upper hupper_lt_n_eps
      have hsdiff_lt :
          (F C).lt ((F C).sub s (u n)) eps :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add (F C) hs_lt_n_eps
      have hleft : (F C).lt ((F C).sub s eps) (u n) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_right (F C) hsdiff_lt
      have hn_upper_center :
          (F C).lt (u n) ((F C).add (u N) d) :=
        cauchy_tail_center_upper C (n := n) hN hn
      have hcenter_le_s_eps :
          (F C).le ((F C).add (u N) d) ((F C).add s eps) := by
        have h := (F C).add_le_add_right hlower_le_s eps
        have hleft_eq :
            (F C).add ((F C).sub (u N) d) eps =
              (F C).add (u N) d := by
          unfold d
          exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_half_add_self (F C) (u N) eps
        rwa [hleft_eq] at h
      have hright : (F C).lt (u n) ((F C).add s eps) :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le (F C)
          hn_upper_center hcenter_le_s_eps
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.abs_sub_lt_of_bounds (F C)
        hleft hright

name: cauchyCriterion
statement:
theorem cauchyCriterion :
    (F C).CauchyCriterionPrinciple where
  converges
proof:
:= by
    intro u hu
    exact Exists.intro (limitCandidate C hu)
      (limitCandidate_tendsto C hu)

name: reciprocalFun_eq_invIdentity
statement:
theorem reciprocalFun_eq_invIdentity :
    ReciprocalFun = RealFunction.InvFun RealFunction.IdentityFun
proof:
:= by
  funext x

name: reciprocalFun_continuousOn_closedInterval_one_left
statement:
theorem reciprocalFun_continuousOn_closedInterval_one_left

name: finiteSum_congr_lt
statement:
theorem finiteSum_congr_lt
    {term term' : Nat -> RealFunction.Point} :
    forall n : Nat,
      (forall k : Nat, k < n -> term k = term' k) ->
        RealTheory.finiteSum term n = RealTheory.finiteSum term' n
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, h => by
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_succ]
      rw [finiteSum_congr_lt n
        (fun k hk => h k (Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))]
      rw [h n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]

/
the grid of `[c a, c b]` has steps `c` times those of `[a, b]`. -/

name: step_scale_left
statement:
theorem step_scale_left
    (c a b : RealFunction.Point) (n : Nat) :
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.step
        (RealTheory.mul c a) (RealTheory.mul c b) n =
      RealTheory.mul c
        (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.step a b n)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealIntegral.EqualPartition.step
  change
    F.mul (F.sub (F.mul c b) (F.mul c a))
        (F.inv (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.denom n)) =
      F.mul c
        (F.mul (F.sub b a)
          (F.inv (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.denom n)))
  rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub F c b a]
  rw [F.mul_assoc]

name: gridPoint_scale_left
statement:
theorem gridPoint_scale_left
    (c a b : RealFunction.Point) (n k : Nat) :
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.gridPoint
        (RealTheory.mul c a) (RealTheory.mul c b) n k =
      RealTheory.mul c
        (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.gridPoint a b n k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  unfold RealIntegral.EqualPartition.gridPoint
  rw [step_scale_left]
  change
    F.add (F.mul c a)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
          (F.mul c (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.step a b n))) =
      F.mul c
        (F.add a
          (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
            (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.step a b n)))
  calc
    F.add (F.mul c a)
        (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
          (F.mul c (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.step a b n))) =
        F.add (F.mul c a)
          (F.mul c
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
              (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.step a b n))) := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
          rw [F.mul_comm (RealTheory.nat k) c]
          rw [F.mul_assoc]
    _ =
        F.mul c
          (F.add a
            (F.mul (RealTheory.nat k)
              (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.step a b n))) := by
          rw [F.mul_add]

name: gridPoint_pos_of_ordered_pos
statement:
theorem gridPoint_pos_of_ordered_pos
    {a b : RealFunction.Point}
    (ha : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain a)

    (n k : Nat)
    (hk : k < RealIntegral.EqualPartition.partitions n) :
    RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.gridPoint a b n k)
proof:
:= by

  have hmem :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.gridPoint_mem_closedInterval_of_lt
      hab n k hk

name: reciprocalFun_mul_of_pos
statement:
theorem reciprocalFun_mul_of_pos
    {c z : RealFunction.Point}
    (hc : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain c)
    (hz : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain z) :
    ReciprocalFun (RealTheory.mul c z) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) (ReciprocalFun z)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hcne : Not (c = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hc) h.symm
  have hzne : Not (z = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro h
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hz) h.symm
  unfold ReciprocalFun
  change F.inv (F.mul c z) = F.mul (F.inv c) (F.inv z)
  rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_mul F hcne hzne]
  rw [F.mul_comm]

name: reciprocalFun_leftSum_scale_ordered
statement:
theorem reciprocalFun_leftSum_scale_ordered
    {a b c : RealFunction.Point}
    (hc : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain c)
    (ha : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain a)
    (hab : RealTheory.le a b)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.leftSum ReciprocalFun
        (RealTheory.mul c a) (RealTheory.mul c b) n =
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.leftSum ReciprocalFun a b n
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let s := RealIntegral.EqualPartition.step a b n
  let S :=
    RealTheory.finiteSum
      (fun k : Nat =>
        ReciprocalFun
          (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.gridPoint a b n k))
      (n + 1)
  have hcne : Not (c = RealTheory.zero) :=
    by
      intro h
      exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hc) h.symm
  have hsum :
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          ReciprocalFun
            (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.gridPoint
              (RealTheory.mul c a) (RealTheory.mul c b) n k))
        (n + 1) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) S := by
    calc
      RealTheory.finiteSum
        (fun k : Nat =>
          ReciprocalFun
            (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.gridPoint
              (RealTheory.mul c a) (RealTheory.mul c b) n k))
        (n + 1) =
          RealTheory.finiteSum
            (fun k : Nat =>
              RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c)
                (ReciprocalFun
                  (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.gridPoint a b n k)))
            (n + 1) := by
            apply finiteSum_congr_lt
            intro k hk
            rw [gridPoint_scale_left]
            exact reciprocalFun_mul_of_pos hc
              (gridPoint_pos_of_ordered_pos ha hab n k hk)
      _ = RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv c) S := by
            unfold S
            rw [RealTheory.finiteSum_mul_left]
  unfold RealIntegral.EqualPartition.leftSum
  rw [step_scale_left]
  rw [hsum]
  change
    F.mul (F.mul c s) (F.mul (F.inv c) S) =
      F.mul s S
  have hcancel :
      F.mul (F.mul c s) (F.inv c) = s := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul c s) (F.inv c) =
          F.mul (F.mul s c) (F.inv c) := by
            rw [F.mul_comm c s]
      _ = F.mul s (F.mul c (F.inv c)) := by
            rw [F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul s F.one := by
            rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hcne]
      _ = s := by rw [F.mul_one]
  calc
    F.mul (F.mul c s) (F.mul (F.inv c) S) =
        F.mul (F.mul (F.mul c s) (F.inv c)) S := by
          rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
    _ = F.mul s S := by rw [hcancel]

name: le_left_mul_of_one_le
statement:
theorem le_left_mul_of_one_le
    {x y : RealFunction.Point}
    (hy : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain y)
    (h : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.le y (RealTheory.mul y x)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left h
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt
        RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hy)
  rwa [RealTheory.mul_one] at hmul

name: one_le_of_le_left_mul
statement:
theorem one_le_of_le_left_mul
    {x y : RealFunction.Point}
    (hy : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain y)
    (h : RealTheory.le y (RealTheory.mul y x)) :
    RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hyne : Not (y = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hy) hzero.symm
  have hinv_nonneg :
      RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hy)
  have hmul :=
    RealTheory.mul_le_mul_nonneg_left h hinv_nonneg
  change
    F.le (F.mul (F.inv y) y)
      (F.mul (F.inv y) (F.mul y x)) at hmul
  have hright :
      F.mul (F.inv y) (F.mul y x) = x := by
    calc
      F.mul (F.inv y) (F.mul y x) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.inv y) y) x := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ = F.mul F.one x := by
            rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hyne]
      _ = x := by rw [F.one_mul]
  rwa [F.inv_mul_cancel hyne, hright] at hmul

name: reciprocalFun_orientedSum_scale_one
statement:
theorem reciprocalFun_orientedSum_scale_one
    {x y : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x)
    (hy : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain y)
    (n : Nat) :
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.orientedSum ReciprocalFun
        y (RealTheory.mul y x) n =
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.orientedSum ReciprocalFun
        RealTheory.one x n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h1x : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x
  · have hy_le_yx : RealTheory.le y (RealTheory.mul y x) :=
      le_left_mul_of_one_le hy h1x
    unfold RealIntegral.EqualPartition.orientedSum
    rw [if_pos hy_le_yx, if_pos h1x]
    have hleft :=
      reciprocalFun_leftSum_scale_ordered
        (a := RealTheory.one) (b := x) (c := y)
        hy RealTheory.zero_lt_one h1x n
    simpa [RealTheory.mul_one] using hleft
  · have hx_le_one : RealTheory.le x RealTheory.one := by
      cases RealTheory.le_total x RealTheory.one with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr hone_le_x => exact False.elim (h1x hone_le_x)
    have hnot_y_le_yx :
        Not (RealTheory.le y (RealTheory.mul y x)) := by
      intro hy_le_yx
      exact h1x (one_le_of_le_left_mul hy hy_le_yx)
    unfold RealIntegral.EqualPartition.orientedSum
    rw [if_neg hnot_y_le_yx, if_neg h1x]
    have hleft :=
      reciprocalFun_leftSum_scale_ordered
        (a := x) (b := RealTheory.one) (c := y)
        hy hx hx_le_one n
    have hleft' :
        RealIntegral.EqualPartition.leftSum ReciprocalFun
            (RealTheory.mul y x) y n =
          RealIntegral.EqualPartition.leftSum ReciprocalFun
            x RealTheory.one n := by
      simpa [RealTheory.mul_one] using hleft
    rw [hleft']

name: reciprocalFun_hasIntegral_scale_one
statement:
theorem reciprocalFun_hasIntegral_scale_one
    {x y I : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x)
    (hy : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain y)
    (hI :
      RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
        ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one x I) :
    RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
      ReciprocalFun y (RealTheory.mul y x) I
proof:
:= by
  change
    RealTheory.SeqTendsto
      (RealIntegral.EqualPartition.orientedSum
        ReciprocalFun y (RealTheory.mul y x)) I
  have hseq :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.orientedSum
          ReciprocalFun y (RealTheory.mul y x) =
        RealIntegral.EqualPartition.orientedSum
          ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one x := by
    funext n
    exact reciprocalFun_orientedSum_scale_one hx hy n
  rw [hseq]
  exact hI

theorem integralNaturalLog_formula :
