name: integralNaturalLog_scaled_formula
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_scaled_formula
    {x y : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x)
    (hy : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain y) :
    RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
      ReciprocalFun y (RealTheory.mul y x)
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
proof:
:=
  reciprocalFun_hasIntegral_scale_one hx hy
    (integralNaturalLog_formula x hx)

name: integralNaturalLog_mul_law
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_mul_law :
    RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalLogMultiplicativeAdditive
      IntegralNaturalLogFun
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hyx_pos :
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        (RealTheory.mul y x) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hy hx
  have hxy_pos :
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        (RealTheory.mul x y) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hx hy
  have hI_1_y :
      RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
        ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one y
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun y) :=
    integralNaturalLog_formula y hy
  have hI_y_yx :
      RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
        ReciprocalFun y (RealTheory.mul y x)
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) :=
    integralNaturalLog_scaled_formula hx hy
  have hI_1_yx :
      RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
        ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul y x)
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun (RealTheory.mul y x)) :=
    integralNaturalLog_formula (RealTheory.mul y x) hyx_pos
  have hcont_1_y :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one y :=
    reciprocalFun_continuousOnSegment_pos
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one hy
  have hcont_y_yx :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        ReciprocalFun y (RealTheory.mul y x) :=
    reciprocalFun_continuousOnSegment_pos hy hyx_pos
  have hcont_1_yx :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one (RealTheory.mul y x) :=
    reciprocalFun_continuousOnSegment_pos
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one hyx_pos
  have hadd :=
    RealTheory.equalPartition_orientedIntervalAdditivity
      ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one y (RealTheory.mul y x)
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun y)
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun (RealTheory.mul y x))
      hcont_1_y hcont_y_yx hcont_1_yx
      hI_1_y hI_y_yx hI_1_yx
  calc
    IntegralNaturalLogFun (RealTheory.mul x y) =
        IntegralNaturalLogFun (RealTheory.mul y x) := by
          rw [RealTheory.mul_comm]
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (IntegralNaturalLogFun y)
          (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) := hadd
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
          (IntegralNaturalLogFun y) := by
          rw [RealTheory.add_comm]

name: reciprocalFun_le_one_of_one_le
statement:
theorem reciprocalFun_le_one_of_one_le
    {t : RealFunction.Point}
    (h1t : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one t) :
    RealTheory.le (ReciprocalFun t) RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htpos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero t :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one h1t
  unfold ReciprocalFun
  have h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
      F RealTheory.zero_lt_one htpos h1t
  change F.le (F.inv t) F.one
  change F.le (F.inv t) (F.inv F.one) at h
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at h

name: inv_right_le_reciprocalFun_of_le
statement:
theorem inv_right_le_reciprocalFun_of_le
    {t x : RealFunction.Point}
    (htpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain t)
    (hxpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x)
    (htx : RealTheory.le t x) :
    RealTheory.le (RealTheory.inv x) (ReciprocalFun t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ReciprocalFun
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_le_inv_of_le_pos
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base htpos hxpos htx

name: integralNaturalLog_weak_upper_of_one_le
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_weak_upper_of_one_le
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (h1x : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.le (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
      (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one h1x
  have hlog :
      RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
        ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one x
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) :=
    integralNaturalLog_formula x hxpos
  have hconst :
      RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
        (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.one x
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)) :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.hasIntegral_const_ordered
      (a := RealTheory.one) (b := x) (c := RealTheory.one) h1x
  have hle_raw :
      RealTheory.le (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
        (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)) :=
    RealTheory.equalPartition_integralOrderPreservation
      ReciprocalFun
      (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.one)
      RealTheory.one x
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
      (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.one
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))
      h1x
      (fun t ht => reciprocalFun_le_one_of_one_le ht.left)
      hlog hconst
  rwa [RealTheory.one_mul] at hle_raw

name: integralNaturalLog_weak_lower_of_one_le
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_weak_lower_of_one_le
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (h1x : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.le
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv x))
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one h1x
  have hlog :
      RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
        ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one x
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) :=
    integralNaturalLog_formula x hxpos
  have hconst :
      RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
        (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.inv x)
        RealTheory.one x
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x)
          (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)) :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.hasIntegral_const_ordered
      (a := RealTheory.one) (b := x)
      (c := RealTheory.inv x) h1x
  have hle_raw :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x)
          (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) :=
    RealTheory.equalPartition_integralOrderPreservation
      (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.inv x)
      ReciprocalFun
      RealTheory.one x
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x)
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
      h1x
      (fun t ht =>
        inv_right_le_reciprocalFun_of_le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F
            RealTheory.zero_lt_one ht.left)
          hxpos ht.right)
      hconst hlog
  rwa [RealTheory.mul_comm] at hle_raw

name: add_sub_one_lt_mul_self_sub_one_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem add_sub_one_lt_mul_self_sub_one_of_one_lt
    {r : RealFunction.Point}
    (h1r : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one r) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one))
      (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul r r) RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := F.sub r F.one
  have hdpos : F.lt F.zero d :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F h1r
  have hd_lt_dr : F.lt d (F.mul d r) := by
    have h := F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left h1r hdpos
    change F.lt (F.mul d F.one) (F.mul d r) at h
    rwa [F.mul_one] at h
  have hsum :
      F.lt (F.add d d) (F.add d (F.mul d r)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_left F hd_lt_dr d
  have htarget :
      F.add d (F.mul d r) =
        F.sub (F.mul r r) F.one := by
    unfold d
    calc
      F.add (F.sub r F.one)
          (F.mul (F.sub r F.one) r) =
          F.add (F.sub r F.one)
            (F.sub (F.mul r r) (F.mul F.one r)) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F r F.one r]
      _ =
          F.add (F.sub r F.one)
            (F.sub (F.mul r r) r) := by
            rw [F.one_mul]
      _ =
          F.add (F.sub (F.mul r r) r)
            (F.sub r F.one) := by
            rw [F.add_comm]
      _ =
          F.sub (F.mul r r) F.one := by
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
              F (F.mul r r) r F.one
  change F.lt (F.add d d) (F.sub (F.mul r r) F.one)
  rwa [htarget] at hsum

name: mul_self_sub_one_mul_inv_self_lt_add_sub_one_inv
statement:
theorem mul_self_sub_one_mul_inv_self_lt_add_sub_one_inv
    {r : RealFunction.Point}
    (h1r : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one r) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.mul r r) RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.mul r r)))
      (RealTheory.add
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv r))
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv r)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let d := F.sub r F.one
  let x := F.mul r r
  let A := F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x)
  let B := F.add (F.mul d (F.inv r)) (F.mul d (F.inv r))
  have hrpos : F.lt F.zero r :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F F.zero_lt_one h1r
  have hrne : Not (r = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hrpos) hzero.symm
  have hxpos : F.lt F.zero x := by
    unfold x
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos hrpos hrpos
  have hxne : Not (x = F.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxpos) hzero.symm
  have hdpos : F.lt F.zero d :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F h1r
  have hd_lt_dr : F.lt d (F.mul d r) := by
    have h := F.mul_lt_mul_pos_left h1r hdpos
    change F.lt (F.mul d F.one) (F.mul d r) at h
    rwa [F.mul_one] at h
  have hsub_identity :
      F.sub x F.one =
        F.add d (F.mul d r) := by
    unfold d x
    symm
    calc
      F.add (F.sub r F.one)
          (F.mul (F.sub r F.one) r) =
          F.add (F.sub r F.one)
            (F.sub (F.mul r r) (F.mul F.one r)) := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F r F.one r]
      _ =
          F.add (F.sub r F.one)
            (F.sub (F.mul r r) r) := by
            rw [F.one_mul]
      _ =
          F.add (F.sub (F.mul r r) r)
            (F.sub r F.one) := by
            rw [F.add_comm]
      _ =
          F.sub (F.mul r r) F.one := by
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_add_sub_cancel
              F (F.mul r r) r F.one
  have hsum_strict :
      F.lt (F.sub x F.one)
        (F.add (F.mul d r) (F.mul d r)) := by
    rw [hsub_identity]
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_lt_add_right
      F hd_lt_dr (F.mul d r)
    change
      F.lt (F.add d (F.mul d r))
        (F.add (F.mul d r) (F.mul d r)) at h
    exact h
  have hA_mul :
      F.mul A x = F.sub x F.one := by
    unfold A
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right
      F (F.sub x F.one) hxne
  have hterm_mul :
      F.mul (F.mul d (F.inv r)) x = F.mul d r := by
    unfold x
    calc
      F.mul (F.mul d (F.inv r)) (F.mul r r) =
          F.mul (F.mul (F.mul d (F.inv r)) r) r := by
            rw [<- F.mul_assoc]
      _ =
          F.mul d r := by
            rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.mul_inv_mul_cancel_right F d hrne]
  have hB_mul :
      F.mul B x =
        F.add (F.mul d r) (F.mul d r) := by
    unfold B
    rw [F.add_mul]
    rw [hterm_mul]
  have hmul :
      F.lt (F.mul A x) (F.mul B x) := by
    rw [hA_mul, hB_mul]
    exact hsum_strict
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_pos_right F hmul hxpos

name: integralNaturalLog_strict_upper_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_strict_upper_of_one_lt
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (h1x : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.lt (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
      (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let r := RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 x
  have hxpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one h1x
  have hxnonneg : RealFunction.Elementary.NonnegativeDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxpos
  have h1r : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one r := by
    unfold r
    exact RealFunction.Elementary.one_lt_nthRoot_succ_of_one_lt
      h1x 1
  have hrpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain r :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one h1r
  have hrle : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one r :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F h1r
  have hpow :
      RealFunction.powNat r 2 = x := by
    unfold r
    exact RealFunction.Elementary.powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg
      1 hxnonneg
  have hrr : RealTheory.mul r r = x := by
    rw [<- hpow]
    exact (RealFunction.powNat_two r).symm
  have hmul := integralNaturalLog_mul_law r r hrpos hrpos
  change
    IntegralNaturalLogFun (RealTheory.mul r r) =
      RealTheory.add (IntegralNaturalLogFun r)
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun r) at hmul
  rw [hrr] at hmul
  have hweak :
      RealTheory.le (IntegralNaturalLogFun r)
        (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one) :=
    integralNaturalLog_weak_upper_of_one_le hrle
  have htwo_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add (IntegralNaturalLogFun r)
          (IntegralNaturalLogFun r))
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hweak hweak
  have hlog_le :
      RealTheory.le (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)) := by
    rwa [<- hmul] at htwo_le
  have hstrict :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one))
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) := by
    have h := add_sub_one_lt_mul_self_sub_one_of_one_lt h1r
    rwa [hrr] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt F hlog_le hstrict

name: integralNaturalLog_strict_lower_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_strict_lower_of_one_lt
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (h1x : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv x))
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let r := RealFunction.Elementary.nthRoot 2 x
  have hxpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one h1x
  have hxnonneg : RealFunction.Elementary.NonnegativeDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxpos
  have h1r : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one r := by
    unfold r
    exact RealFunction.Elementary.one_lt_nthRoot_succ_of_one_lt
      h1x 1
  have hrpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain r :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one h1r
  have hrle : RealTheory.le RealTheory.one r :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F h1r
  have hpow :
      RealFunction.powNat r 2 = x := by
    unfold r
    exact RealFunction.Elementary.powNat_nthRoot_succ_eq_of_nonneg
      1 hxnonneg
  have hrr : RealTheory.mul r r = x := by
    rw [<- hpow]
    exact (RealFunction.powNat_two r).symm
  have hmul := integralNaturalLog_mul_law r r hrpos hrpos
  change
    IntegralNaturalLogFun (RealTheory.mul r r) =
      RealTheory.add (IntegralNaturalLogFun r)
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun r) at hmul
  rw [hrr] at hmul
  have hweak :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv r))
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun r) :=
    integralNaturalLog_weak_lower_of_one_le hrle
  have htwo_le :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.inv r))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.inv r)))
        (RealTheory.add (IntegralNaturalLogFun r)
          (IntegralNaturalLogFun r)) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_le_add F hweak hweak
  have htwo_le_log :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.inv r))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.inv r)))
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) := by
    rwa [<- hmul] at htwo_le
  have hstrict :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv x))
        (RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.inv r))
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub r RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.inv r))) := by
    have h := mul_self_sub_one_mul_inv_self_lt_add_sub_one_inv h1r
    rwa [hrr] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hstrict htwo_le_log

name: inv_inv_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem inv_inv_of_ne_zero
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv x) = x
proof:
:= by
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_inv_of_ne_zero
    RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hx

name: one_sub_inv_eq_sub_one_mul_inv
statement:
theorem one_sub_inv_eq_sub_one_mul_inv
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  calc
    F.sub F.one (F.inv x) =
        F.sub (F.mul x (F.inv x))
          (F.mul F.one (F.inv x)) := by
          rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hx, F.one_mul]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x) := by
          exact Eq.symm
            (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul F
              x F.one (F.inv x))

name: neg_inv_sub_one_eq_sub_one_mul_inv
statement:
theorem neg_inv_sub_one_eq_sub_one_mul_inv
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.inv x) RealTheory.one) =
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  calc
    F.neg (F.sub (F.inv x) F.one) =
        F.sub F.one (F.inv x) := by
          rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
            F (F.inv x) F.one]
    _ =
        F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x) :=
          one_sub_inv_eq_sub_one_mul_inv hx

name: neg_inv_sub_one_mul_inv_inv_eq_sub_one
statement:
theorem neg_inv_sub_one_mul_inv_inv_eq_sub_one
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : Not (x = RealTheory.zero)) :
    RealTheory.neg
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.inv x) RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv (RealTheory.inv x))) =
      RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  calc
    F.neg
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.inv x) F.one)
          (F.inv (F.inv x))) =
        F.neg
          (F.mul (F.sub (F.inv x) F.one) x) := by
          have hinv_inv : F.inv (F.inv x) = x :=
            inv_inv_of_ne_zero hx
          rw [hinv_inv]
    _ =
        F.neg
          (F.sub (F.mul (F.inv x) x)
            (F.mul F.one x)) := by
          rw [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_mul_eq_sub_mul
            F (F.inv x) F.one x]
    _ =
        F.neg (F.sub F.one x) := by
          rw [F.inv_mul_cancel hx, F.one_mul]
    _ =
        F.sub x F.one := by
          rw [<- IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
            F F.one x]

name: integralNaturalLog_inv_eq_neg
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_inv_eq_neg
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x) :
    IntegralNaturalLogFun (RealTheory.inv x) =
      RealTheory.neg (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx) hzero.symm
  have hinv_pos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx
  have h := integralNaturalLog_mul_law x (RealTheory.inv x)
    hx hinv_pos
  change
    IntegralNaturalLogFun (F.mul x (F.inv x)) =
      F.add (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun (F.inv x)) at h
  rw [F.mul_inv_cancel hxne] at h
  change
    IntegralNaturalLogFun RealTheory.one =
      F.add (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun (F.inv x)) at h
  rw [integralNaturalLog_one_value] at h
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left
    F h.symm

name: one_lt_inv_of_pos_lt_one
statement:
theorem one_lt_inv_of_pos_lt_one
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hxpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have h :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
      F hxpos RealTheory.zero_lt_one hxlt
  change F.lt (F.inv F.one) (F.inv x) at h
  rwa [IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_one F] at h

name: integralNaturalLog_strict_lower_of_pos_lt_one
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_strict_lower_of_pos_lt_one
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hxpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.lt
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv x))
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxpos) hzero.symm
  have hinv_gt_one :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    one_lt_inv_of_pos_lt_one hxpos hxlt
  have hupper :=
    integralNaturalLog_strict_upper_of_one_lt hinv_gt_one
  have hneg := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hupper
  change
    F.lt
      (F.neg (F.sub (F.inv x) F.one))
      (F.neg (IntegralNaturalLogFun (F.inv x))) at hneg
  have hloginv := integralNaturalLog_inv_eq_neg hxpos
  change IntegralNaturalLogFun (F.inv x) =
    F.neg (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) at hloginv
  rw [hloginv, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F] at hneg
  have hrewrite := neg_inv_sub_one_eq_sub_one_mul_inv hxne
  change
    F.neg (F.sub (F.inv x) F.one) =
      F.mul (F.sub x F.one) (F.inv x) at hrewrite
  rwa [hrewrite] at hneg

name: integralNaturalLog_strict_upper_of_pos_lt_one
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_strict_upper_of_pos_lt_one
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hxpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x RealTheory.one) :
    RealTheory.lt (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
      (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxpos) hzero.symm
  have hinv_gt_one :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    one_lt_inv_of_pos_lt_one hxpos hxlt
  have hlower :=
    integralNaturalLog_strict_lower_of_one_lt hinv_gt_one
  have hneg := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hlower
  change
    F.lt
      (F.neg (IntegralNaturalLogFun (F.inv x)))
      (F.neg
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.inv x) F.one)
          (F.inv (F.inv x)))) at hneg
  have hloginv := integralNaturalLog_inv_eq_neg hxpos
  change IntegralNaturalLogFun (F.inv x) =
    F.neg (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) at hloginv
  rw [hloginv, IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_neg F] at hneg
  have hrewrite := neg_inv_sub_one_mul_inv_inv_eq_sub_one hxne
  change
    F.neg
        (F.mul (F.sub (F.inv x) F.one)
          (F.inv (F.inv x))) =
      F.sub x F.one at hrewrite
  rwa [hrewrite] at hneg

name: integralNaturalLog_local_lower
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_local_lower :
    RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalLogLocalLower
      IntegralNaturalLogFun
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hne
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hne with
  | inl hxlt =>
      exact integralNaturalLog_strict_lower_of_pos_lt_one hx hxlt
  | inr hgt =>
      exact integralNaturalLog_strict_lower_of_one_lt hgt

name: integralNaturalLog_local_upper
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_local_upper :
    RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalLogLocalUpper
      IntegralNaturalLogFun
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hne
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_or_gt_of_ne F hne with
  | inl hxlt =>
      exact integralNaturalLog_strict_upper_of_pos_lt_one hx hxlt
  | inr hgt =>
      exact integralNaturalLog_strict_upper_of_one_lt hgt

name: integralNaturalLog_strictMonotoneOn
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_strictMonotoneOn :
    RealFunction.StrictMonotoneOn
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      IntegralNaturalLogFun
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let Ixy :=
    RealTheory.equalPartitionIntegral ReciprocalFun x y
      (RealTheory.equalPartition_continuousIntegrability
        ReciprocalFun x y
        (reciprocalFun_continuousOnSegment_pos hx hy))
  have hIxy :
      RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
        ReciprocalFun x y Ixy :=
    RealTheory.equalPartitionIntegral_spec
      (RealTheory.equalPartition_continuousIntegrability
        ReciprocalFun x y
        (reciprocalFun_continuousOnSegment_pos hx hy))
  have hxy_le : RealTheory.le x y :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hxy
  have hconst :
      RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
        (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.inv y)
        x y
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv y)
          (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
    RealIntegral.EqualPartition.hasIntegral_const_ordered
      (a := x) (b := y) (c := RealTheory.inv y) hxy_le
  have hconst_le_I :
      RealTheory.le
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv y)
          (RealTheory.sub y x))
        Ixy :=
    RealTheory.equalPartition_integralOrderPreservation
      (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.inv y)
      ReciprocalFun
      x y
      (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv y)
        (RealTheory.sub y x))
      Ixy
      hxy_le
      (fun t ht =>
        inv_right_le_reciprocalFun_of_le
          (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hx ht.left)
          hy ht.right)
      hconst hIxy
  have hinvy_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv y) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hy
  have hsub_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.sub y x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxy
  have hconst_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv y)
          (RealTheory.sub y x)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hinvy_pos hsub_pos
  have hIxy_pos : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero Ixy :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le F hconst_pos hconst_le_I
  have hI_1_x :
      RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
        ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one x
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) :=
    integralNaturalLog_formula x hx
  have hI_1_y :
      RealTheory.EqualPartitionHasIntegral
        ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one y
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun y) :=
    integralNaturalLog_formula y hy
  have hcont_1_x :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one x :=
    reciprocalFun_continuousOnSegment_pos
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx
  have hcont_x_y :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        ReciprocalFun x y :=
    reciprocalFun_continuousOnSegment_pos hx hy
  have hcont_1_y :
      RealIntegral.EqualPartition.ContinuousOnSegment
        ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one y :=
    reciprocalFun_continuousOnSegment_pos
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one hy
  have hadd :
      IntegralNaturalLogFun y =
        RealTheory.add (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) Ixy :=
    RealTheory.equalPartition_orientedIntervalAdditivity
      ReciprocalFun RealTheory.one x y
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) Ixy
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun y)
      hcont_1_x hcont_x_y hcont_1_y
      hI_1_x hIxy hI_1_y
  have hlt :
      RealTheory.lt (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
        (RealTheory.add (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) Ixy) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hIxy_pos
  rwa [<- hadd] at hlt

name: integralLogLowerSqueeze_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem integralLogLowerSqueeze_tendsto_one :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      IntegralLogLowerSqueezeFun
      RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  have hid :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        RealFunction.IdentityFun
        RealTheory.one RealTheory.one :=
    (RealFunction.continuousAtOn_identity
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one).right
  have hconst_one :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.one)
        RealTheory.one RealTheory.one :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      RealTheory.one RealTheory.one
  have hsub := RealFunction.tendstoWithin_sub hid hconst_one
  have hsub_lim :
      RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one RealTheory.one =
        RealTheory.zero := by
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_self
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base RealTheory.one
  have hsub' := RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hsub_lim hsub
  have hinv := RealFunction.tendstoWithin_inv
    hid RealTheory.one_ne_zero
  have hmul := RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hsub' hinv
  change
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      (RealFunction.MulFun
        (RealFunction.SubFun RealFunction.IdentityFun
          (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.one))
        (RealFunction.InvFun RealFunction.IdentityFun))
      RealTheory.one
      (RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one))
      at hmul
  have hlim :
      RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
          (RealTheory.inv RealTheory.one) =
        RealTheory.zero := by
    rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun _x _hx _hxne => rfl)
    (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim hmul)

name: integralLogUpperSqueeze_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem integralLogUpperSqueeze_tendsto_one :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin

proof:
:= by
  have hid :

        RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        RealFunction.IdentityFun
        RealTheory.one RealTheory.one :=
    (RealFunction.continuousAtOn_identity
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one).right

name: integralNaturalLog_tendstoWithin_one
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_tendstoWithin_one :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      IntegralNaturalLogFun RealTheory.one RealTheory.zero
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hbounds :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain RealTheory.one
        (fun x : RealFunction.Point =>
          And
            (RealTheory.le
              (IntegralLogLowerSqueezeFun x)
              (IntegralNaturalLogFun x))
            (RealTheory.le
              (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
              (IntegralLogUpperSqueezeFun x))) := by
    refine Exists.intro RealTheory.one ?_
    refine And.intro RealTheory.zero_lt_one ?_
    intro x hx hxne _hdist
    have hlower := integralNaturalLog_local_lower x hx hxne
    have hupper := integralNaturalLog_local_upper x hx hxne
    exact And.intro
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hlower)
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hupper)
  have hlower :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain RealTheory.one
        (fun x : RealFunction.Point =>
          RealTheory.le
            (IntegralLogLowerSqueezeFun x)
            (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)) :=
    RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_mono
      (fun _x hx => hx.left) hbounds
  have hupper :
      RealFunction.EventuallyWithin
        RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain RealTheory.one
        (fun x : RealFunction.Point =>
          RealTheory.le
            (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
            (IntegralLogUpperSqueezeFun x)) :=
    RealFunction.eventuallyWithin_mono
      (fun _x hx => hx.right) hbounds
  exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_of_squeeze
    integralLogLowerSqueeze_tendsto_one
    integralLogUpperSqueeze_tendsto_one
    hlower hupper

name: integralLogRatioTo_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem integralLogRatioTo_tendsto_one
    (x0 : RealFunction.Point)
    (hx0 : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x0) :
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      (IntegralLogRatioTo x0)
      x0 RealTheory.one
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hx0ne : Not (x0 = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx0 hzero.symm
  have hid :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        RealFunction.IdentityFun x0 x0 :=
    (RealFunction.continuousAtOn_identity hx0).right
  have hconst :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.inv x0)
        x0 (RealTheory.inv x0) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      (RealTheory.inv x0) x0
  have hmul := RealFunction.tendstoWithin_mul hid hconst
  change
    RealFunction.TendstoWithin
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      (RealFunction.MulFun RealFunction.IdentityFun
        (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => RealTheory.inv x0))
      x0
      (RealTheory.mul x0 (RealTheory.inv x0)) at hmul
  have hlim :
      RealTheory.mul x0 (RealTheory.inv x0) =
        RealTheory.one :=
    RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hx0ne
  exact RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun _x _hx _hxne => rfl)
    (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim hmul)

name: integralLogRatioTo_maps_positive
statement:
theorem integralLogRatioTo_maps_positive
    (x0 : RealFunction.Point)
    (hx0 : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x0) :

      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x ->
        Not (x = x0) ->
          RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
            (IntegralLogRatioTo x0 x)
proof:

name: integralNaturalLog_continuousAtOn
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_continuousAtOn
    {x0 : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx0 : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x0) :
    RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      IntegralNaturalLogFun x0
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hx0ne : Not (x0 = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hx0 hzero.symm
  have hcont_one :
      RealFunction.ContinuousAtOn
        RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        IntegralNaturalLogFun RealTheory.one :=
    And.intro RealTheory.zero_lt_one
      (RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
        integralNaturalLog_one_value.symm
        integralNaturalLog_tendstoWithin_one)
  have hcomp :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_comp_continuousAtOn
      (integralLogRatioTo_tendsto_one x0 hx0)
      hcont_one
      (integralLogRatioTo_maps_positive x0 hx0)
  have hcomp_zero :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        (RealFunction.CompFun IntegralNaturalLogFun
          (IntegralLogRatioTo x0))
        x0 RealTheory.zero :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit
      integralNaturalLog_one_value hcomp
  have hconst :
      RealFunction.TendstoWithin
        RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        (fun _ : RealFunction.Point => IntegralNaturalLogFun x0)
        x0 (IntegralNaturalLogFun x0) :=
    RealFunction.tendstoWithin_const
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun x0) x0
  have hsum := RealFunction.tendstoWithin_add hcomp_zero hconst
  have hlim :
      RealTheory.add RealTheory.zero (IntegralNaturalLogFun x0) =
        IntegralNaturalLogFun x0 :=
    RealTheory.zero_add (IntegralNaturalLogFun x0)
  have hsum' := RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr_limit hlim hsum
  refine And.intro hx0 ?_
  apply RealFunction.tendstoWithin_congr
    (fun x hx _hxne => ?_)
    hsum'
  unfold RealFunction.AddFun RealFunction.CompFun IntegralLogRatioTo
  let ratio := RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv x0)
  have hratio_pos :
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain ratio := by
    unfold ratio
    exact RealTheory.mul_pos hx
      (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hx0)
  have hratio_mul :
      RealTheory.mul ratio x0 = x := by
    unfold ratio
    calc
      RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.mul x (RealTheory.inv x0)) x0 =
          RealTheory.mul x
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.inv x0) x0) := by
            rw [RealTheory.mul_assoc]
      _ = RealTheory.mul x RealTheory.one := by
            rw [RealTheory.inv_mul_cancel hx0ne]
      _ = x := by rw [RealTheory.mul_one]
  have hlog_mul :=
    integralNaturalLog_mul_law ratio x0 hratio_pos hx0
  change
    IntegralNaturalLogFun (RealTheory.mul ratio x0) =
      RealTheory.add (IntegralNaturalLogFun ratio)
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun x0) at hlog_mul
  rw [hratio_mul] at hlog_mul
  exact hlog_mul.symm

proof:

name: integralLogTwo_pos
statement:
theorem integralLogTwo_pos :
    RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain IntegralLogTwo
proof:
:=

    RealTheory.zero_lt_one integralLog_one_lt_two

name: integralNaturalLog_two_pos
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_two_pos :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
      (IntegralNaturalLogFun IntegralLogTwo)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have htwo_ne_one : Not (IntegralLogTwo = RealTheory.one) := by
    intro h
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F
      integralLog_one_lt_two) h.symm
  have hlower :=
    integralNaturalLog_local_lower
      IntegralLogTwo integralLogTwo_pos htwo_ne_one
  have hsub :
      RealTheory.sub IntegralLogTwo RealTheory.one =
        RealTheory.one := by
    unfold IntegralLogTwo
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel
      RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
      RealTheory.one RealTheory.one
  have hprod_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul
          (RealTheory.sub IntegralLogTwo RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv IntegralLogTwo)) := by
    rw [hsub]
    rw [RealTheory.one_mul]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F integralLogTwo_pos
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hprod_pos hlower

name: integralNaturalLog_powNat_two
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_powNat_two :
    forall n : Nat,
      IntegralNaturalLogFun
          (RealFunction.powNat IntegralLogTwo n) =
        RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
          (IntegralNaturalLogFun IntegralLogTwo)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_zero]
      rw [integralNaturalLog_one_value]
      rw [RealTheory.nat_zero]
      change
        RealTheory.zero =
          RealTheory.mul RealTheory.zero
            (IntegralNaturalLogFun IntegralLogTwo)
      rw [RealTheory.zero_mul]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [RealFunction.powNat_succ]
      have hpow_pos :
          RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
            (RealFunction.powNat IntegralLogTwo n) :=
        RealFunction.powNat_pos integralLogTwo_pos n
      have hmul :=
        integralNaturalLog_mul_law
          (RealFunction.powNat IntegralLogTwo n)
          IntegralLogTwo hpow_pos integralLogTwo_pos
      change
        IntegralNaturalLogFun
            (RealTheory.mul
              (RealFunction.powNat IntegralLogTwo n)
              IntegralLogTwo) =
          RealTheory.add
            (IntegralNaturalLogFun
              (RealFunction.powNat IntegralLogTwo n))
            (IntegralNaturalLogFun IntegralLogTwo) at hmul
      rw [hmul, ih]
      rw [RealTheory.nat_succ]
      change
        RealTheory.add
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
              (IntegralNaturalLogFun IntegralLogTwo))
            (IntegralNaturalLogFun IntegralLogTwo) =
          RealTheory.mul
            (RealTheory.add (RealTheory.nat n) RealTheory.one)
            (IntegralNaturalLogFun IntegralLogTwo)
      rw [RealTheory.add_mul]
      rw [RealTheory.one_mul]

name: integralLog_exists_powNat_two_gt
statement:
theorem integralLog_exists_powNat_two_gt
    {L : RealFunction.Point}
    (hL : RealTheory.le RealTheory.zero L) :
    Exists
      (fun n : Nat =>
        RealTheory.lt L
          (RealFunction.powNat IntegralLogTwo n))
proof:
:= by
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_mul_gt hL RealTheory.zero_lt_one with
  | intro n hn =>
      have hn' : RealTheory.lt L (RealTheory.nat n) := by
        change
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.lt L
            (RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul
              (RealTheory.nat n)
              RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.one) at hn
        rwa [RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base.mul_one] at hn
      exact Exists.intro n
        (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
          RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base hn'
          (by
            unfold IntegralLogTwo
            exact RealFunction.nat_le_powNat_two n))

name: integralNaturalLog_exists_log_gt
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_exists_log_gt
    (y : RealFunction.Point) :
    Exists
      (fun x : RealFunction.Point =>
        And (RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x)
          (RealTheory.lt y (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_mul_gt
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg y)
      integralNaturalLog_two_pos with
  | intro n hn =>
      let x := RealFunction.powNat IntegralLogTwo n
      refine Exists.intro x ?_
      refine And.intro (RealFunction.powNat_pos integralLogTwo_pos n) ?_
      have hy_abs : RealTheory.le y (RealTheory.abs y) :=
        RealTheory.le_abs_self y
      have habs_log :
          RealTheory.lt (RealTheory.abs y)
            (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) := by
        unfold x
        rw [integralNaturalLog_powNat_two n]
        exact hn
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_lt
        F hy_abs habs_log

name: integralNaturalLog_exists_log_lt
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_exists_log_lt
    (y : RealFunction.Point) :
    Exists
      (fun x : RealFunction.Point =>
        And (RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x)
          (RealTheory.lt (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) y))
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases RealTheory.exists_nat_mul_gt
      (RealTheory.abs_nonneg y)
      integralNaturalLog_two_pos with
  | intro n hn =>
      let p := RealFunction.powNat IntegralLogTwo n
      let x := RealTheory.inv p
      have hp_pos :
          RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain p := by
        unfold p
        exact RealFunction.powNat_pos integralLogTwo_pos n
      have hx_pos :
          RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x := by
        unfold x
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hp_pos
      refine Exists.intro x ?_
      refine And.intro hx_pos ?_
      have hlogp :
          IntegralNaturalLogFun p =
            RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
              (IntegralNaturalLogFun IntegralLogTwo) := by
        unfold p
        exact integralNaturalLog_powNat_two n
      have hneg_abs_le_y :
          RealTheory.le (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.abs y)) y := by
        have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_le_neg
          F (RealTheory.neg_le_abs_self y)
        change
          RealTheory.le
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.abs y))
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.neg y)) at h
        rwa [RealTheory.neg_neg] at h
      have hneg_bound :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                (IntegralNaturalLogFun IntegralLogTwo)))
            (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.abs y)) := by
        exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg F hn
      have hneg_bound_y :
          RealTheory.lt
            (RealTheory.neg
              (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.nat n)
                (IntegralNaturalLogFun IntegralLogTwo)))
            y :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
          F hneg_bound hneg_abs_le_y
      have hloginv := integralNaturalLog_inv_eq_neg hp_pos
      change
        IntegralNaturalLogFun (RealTheory.inv p) =
          RealTheory.neg (IntegralNaturalLogFun p) at hloginv
      unfold x
      rw [hloginv, hlogp]
      exact hneg_bound_y

name: integralNaturalLog_image_surjective_raw
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_image_surjective_raw :
    forall y : RealFunction.Point,
      RealFunction.Image
        RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        IntegralNaturalLogFun y
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  cases integralNaturalLog_exists_log_lt y with
  | intro a ha =>
      cases integralNaturalLog_exists_log_gt y with
      | intro b hb =>
          have hnot_ba : Not (RealTheory.le b a) := by
            intro hba
            by_cases hab : RealTheory.le a b
            · have hab_eq : a = b :=
                RealTheory.le_antisymm hab hba
              rw [hab_eq] at ha
              have hbad :
                  RealTheory.lt (IntegralNaturalLogFun b)
                    (IntegralNaturalLogFun b) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
                  F ha.right hb.right
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
                F (IntegralNaturalLogFun b) hbad
            · have hba_lt : RealTheory.lt b a :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
                  F hba hab
              have hlog_ba :=
                integralNaturalLog_strictMonotoneOn
                  b a hb.left ha.left hba_lt
              have hbad :
                  RealTheory.lt (IntegralNaturalLogFun b)
                    (IntegralNaturalLogFun b) :=
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
                  F hlog_ba
                  (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans
                    F ha.right hb.right)
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
                F (IntegralNaturalLogFun b) hbad
          have hab : RealTheory.le a b := by
            cases RealTheory.le_total a b with
            | inl h => exact h
            | inr h => exact False.elim (hnot_ba h)
          have hcont_interval :
              RealFunction.ContinuousOn
                (RealTheory.ClosedInterval a b)
                IntegralNaturalLogFun :=
            RealFunction.continuousOn_subset
              (fun z hz =>
                IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                  F ha.left hz.left)
              integralNaturalLog_continuousOn
          have hbetween :
              RealTheory.Between
                (IntegralNaturalLogFun a)
                y
                (IntegralNaturalLogFun b) := by
            unfold RealTheory.Between IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.Between
            exact And.intro
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F ha.right)
              (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.le_of_lt F hb.right)
          cases RealFunction.intermediate_value_closedInterval
              hab hcont_interval hbetween with
          | intro c hc =>
              refine Exists.intro c ?_
              refine And.intro ?_ hc.right
              exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_lt_of_le
                F ha.left hc.left.left

name: integralNaturalLog_image_surjective
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_image_surjective :
    IntegralLogImageSurjective reciprocalFun_integrability
proof:
:=
  integralNaturalLog_image_surjective_raw

name: integralNaturalLog_injective

:=

name: integralNaturalLog_lt_reflect
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_lt_reflect
    {x y : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x)
    (hy : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain y)
    (hlog :
      RealTheory.lt (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun y)) :
    RealTheory.lt x y
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hnot_yx : Not (RealTheory.le y x) := by
    intro hyx
    by_cases hxy : RealTheory.le x y
    · have hEq : x = y := RealTheory.le_antisymm hxy hyx
      rw [hEq] at hlog
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl
        F (IntegralNaturalLogFun y) hlog
    · have hyx_lt : RealTheory.lt y x :=
        IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
          F hyx hxy
      have hlog_yx :=
        integralNaturalLog_strictMonotoneOn
          y x hy hx hyx_lt
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_asymm F hlog hlog_yx
  cases RealTheory.le_total x y with
  | inl hxy =>
      exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_of_le_of_not_le
        F hxy hnot_yx
  | inr hyx =>
      exact False.elim (hnot_yx hyx)

name: integralLogExpFun_add_law
statement:
theorem integralLogExpFun_add_law :
    RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalExpAdditiveMultiplicative
      (IntegralLogExpFun reciprocalFun_integrability)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  let E := IntegralLogExpFun reciprocalFun_integrability
  have hsum_pos :
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        (E (RealTheory.add x y)) :=
    integralLogExpFun_mem_positive
      reciprocalFun_integrability
      integralNaturalLog_image_surjective
      (RealTheory.add x y)
  have hx_pos :
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain (E x) :=
    integralLogExpFun_mem_positive
      reciprocalFun_integrability
      integralNaturalLog_image_surjective x
  have hy_pos :
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain (E y) :=
    integralLogExpFun_mem_positive
      reciprocalFun_integrability
      integralNaturalLog_image_surjective y
  have hprod_pos :
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
        (RealTheory.mul (E x) (E y)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hx_pos hy_pos
  apply integralNaturalLog_injective
    (x := E (RealTheory.add x y))
    (y := RealTheory.mul (E x) (E y))
    hsum_pos hprod_pos
  change
    IntegralNaturalLogFun (E (RealTheory.add x y)) =
      IntegralNaturalLogFun (RealTheory.mul (E x) (E y))
  calc
    IntegralNaturalLogFun (E (RealTheory.add x y)) =
        RealTheory.add x y := by
          exact integralLogExpFun_log_value
            reciprocalFun_integrability
            integralNaturalLog_image_surjective
            (RealTheory.add x y)
    _ =
        RealTheory.add
          (IntegralNaturalLogFun (E x))
          (IntegralNaturalLogFun (E y)) := by
          have hxlog :
              IntegralNaturalLogFun (E x) = x := by
            exact integralLogExpFun_log_value
              reciprocalFun_integrability
              integralNaturalLog_image_surjective x
          have hylog :
              IntegralNaturalLogFun (E y) = y := by
            exact integralLogExpFun_log_value
              reciprocalFun_integrability
              integralNaturalLog_image_surjective y
          rw [hxlog, hylog]
    _ =
        IntegralNaturalLogFun (RealTheory.mul (E x) (E y)) := by
          rw [integralNaturalLog_mul_law (E x) (E y) hx_pos hy_pos]

name: integralLogExpFun_local_lower
statement:
theorem integralLogExpFun_local_lower :
    RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalExpLocalLower
      (IntegralLogExpFun reciprocalFun_integrability)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxpos hxlt
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let E := IntegralLogExpFun reciprocalFun_integrability
  let base := RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x
  have hbase_gt_one : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one base := by
    unfold base
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_add_of_pos F hxpos
  have hbase_pos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain base :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
      RealTheory.zero_lt_one hbase_gt_one
  have hbase_ne_one : Not (base = RealTheory.one) := by
    intro h
    exact (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hbase_gt_one) h.symm
  have hsub_eq :
      RealTheory.sub base RealTheory.one = x := by
    unfold base
    rw [RealTheory.add_comm RealTheory.one x]
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel
      F x RealTheory.one
  have hlog_base_lt_x :
      RealTheory.lt (IntegralNaturalLogFun base) x := by
    have hupper :=
      integralNaturalLog_local_upper
        base hbase_pos hbase_ne_one
    rwa [hsub_eq] at hupper
  have hE_pos :
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain (E x) :=
    integralLogExpFun_mem_positive
      reciprocalFun_integrability
      integralNaturalLog_image_surjective x
  have hlog_E :
      IntegralNaturalLogFun (E x) = x :=
    integralLogExpFun_log_value
      reciprocalFun_integrability
      integralNaturalLog_image_surjective x
  have hlog_lt :
      RealTheory.lt (IntegralNaturalLogFun base)
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun (E x)) := by
    rwa [hlog_E]
  exact integralNaturalLog_lt_reflect
    hbase_pos hE_pos hlog_lt

name: integralLogExpFun_local_upper
statement:
theorem integralLogExpFun_local_upper :
    RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalExpLocalUpper
      (IntegralLogExpFun reciprocalFun_integrability)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxpos hxlt
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  let E := IntegralLogExpFun reciprocalFun_integrability
  let den := RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x
  let target := RealTheory.inv den
  have hden_pos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain den := by
    unfold den
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hxlt
  have hden_lt_one : RealTheory.lt den RealTheory.one := by
    unfold den
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_self_of_pos F hxpos
  have htarget_pos :
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain target := by
    unfold target
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hden_pos
  have hsub_den_one :
      RealTheory.sub den RealTheory.one = RealTheory.neg x := by
    unfold den
    calc
      RealTheory.sub (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one x)
          RealTheory.one =
          RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.add x RealTheory.one) := by
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_sub_eq_sub_add
              F RealTheory.one x RealTheory.one
      _ =
          RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x) := by
            rw [RealTheory.add_comm x RealTheory.one]
      _ =
          RealTheory.neg
            (RealTheory.sub
              (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
              RealTheory.one) := by
            exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_rev_eq_neg_sub
              F (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one x)
              RealTheory.one
      _ = RealTheory.neg x := by
            rw [RealTheory.add_comm RealTheory.one x]
            have hcancel :
                RealTheory.sub
                    (RealTheory.add x RealTheory.one)
                    RealTheory.one =
                  x :=
              IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.add_sub_cancel
                F x RealTheory.one
            rw [hcancel]
  have hlog_den_lt_negx :
      RealTheory.lt (IntegralNaturalLogFun den)
        (RealTheory.neg x) := by
    have hupper :=
      integralNaturalLog_strict_upper_of_pos_lt_one
        hden_pos hden_lt_one
    rwa [hsub_den_one] at hupper
  have hx_lt_neg_log_den :
      RealTheory.lt x
        (RealTheory.neg (IntegralNaturalLogFun den)) := by
    have h := IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.neg_lt_neg
      F hlog_den_lt_negx
    change
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.neg (RealTheory.neg x))
        (RealTheory.neg (IntegralNaturalLogFun den)) at h
    rwa [RealTheory.neg_neg] at h
  have hlog_target :
      IntegralNaturalLogFun target =
        RealTheory.neg (IntegralNaturalLogFun den) := by
    unfold target
    exact integralNaturalLog_inv_eq_neg hden_pos
  have hE_pos :
      RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain (E x) :=
    integralLogExpFun_mem_positive
      reciprocalFun_integrability
      integralNaturalLog_image_surjective x
  have hlog_E :
      IntegralNaturalLogFun (E x) = x :=
    integralLogExpFun_log_value
      reciprocalFun_integrability
      integralNaturalLog_image_surjective x
  have hlog_lt :
      RealTheory.lt (IntegralNaturalLogFun (E x))
        (IntegralNaturalLogFun target) := by
    rw [hlog_E, hlog_target]
    exact hx_lt_neg_log_den
  exact integralNaturalLog_lt_reflect
    hE_pos htarget_pos hlog_lt

name: integralNaturalLog_pos_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem integralNaturalLog_pos_of_one_lt
    {x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x) :
    RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hsub_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hx1
  have hinv_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (RealTheory.inv x) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_pos F hxpos
  have hprod_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
          (RealTheory.inv x)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hsub_pos hinv_pos
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hprod_pos
    (integralNaturalLog_strict_lower_of_one_lt hx1)

name: integralLog_scaled_log_window
statement:
theorem integralLog_scaled_log_window
    {mu x : RealFunction.Point}
    (hmu : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain mu)
    (hx1 : RealTheory.lt RealTheory.one x)
    (hxlt : RealTheory.lt x
      (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv mu))) :
    And
      (RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)))
      (RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x))
        RealTheory.one)
proof:
:= by
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hxne : Not (x = RealTheory.one) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hx1
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.one hx1
  have hlog_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero (IntegralNaturalLogFun x) :=
    integralNaturalLog_pos_of_one_lt hx1
  have hscaled_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hmu hlog_pos
  have hlog_upper :=
    integralNaturalLog_local_upper x hxpos hxne
  have hmul_upper :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x))
        (RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hlog_upper hmu
  have hx_sub_lt_inv :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv mu) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hxlt
  have hmu_ne : Not (mu = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hmu hzero.symm
  have hscaled_lt_one :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul mu (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))
        RealTheory.one := by
    have h :=
      RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hx_sub_lt_inv hmu
    rwa [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hmu_ne] at h
  exact And.intro hscaled_pos
    (IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hmul_upper hscaled_lt_one)

name: integralLogPowerFun_mul_law
statement:
theorem integralLogPowerFun_mul_law :
    RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalPowerPositiveBaseMultiplicative
      (IntegralLogPowerFun reciprocalFun_integrability)
proof:
:= by
  intro mu x y hx hy
  have hxy : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain
      (RealTheory.mul x y) :=
    RealTheory.mul_pos hx hy
  rw [integralLogPowerFun_of_pos
    reciprocalFun_integrability mu hxy]
  rw [integralLogPowerFun_of_pos
    reciprocalFun_integrability mu hx]
  rw [integralLogPowerFun_of_pos
    reciprocalFun_integrability mu hy]
  have hlog_mul :=
    integralNaturalLog_mul_law x y hx hy
  change
    IntegralLogExpFun reciprocalFun_integrability
        (RealTheory.mul mu
          (IntegralNaturalLogFun (RealTheory.mul x y))) =
      RealTheory.mul
        (IntegralLogExpFun reciprocalFun_integrability
          (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)))
        (IntegralLogExpFun reciprocalFun_integrability
          (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun y)))
  rw [hlog_mul]
  have hdist :
      RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.add (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)
            (IntegralNaturalLogFun y)) =
        RealTheory.add
          (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x))
          (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun y)) := by
    rw [RealTheory.mul_add]
  rw [hdist]
  exact integralLogExpFun_add_law
    (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x))
    (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun y))

name: integralLogPowerFun_positive_exponent_local_lower
statement:
theorem integralLogPowerFun_positive_exponent_local_lower :
    RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalPowerPositiveExponentLocalLower
      (IntegralLogPowerFun reciprocalFun_integrability)
proof:
:= by
  intro mu hmu x hx1 hxlt
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hxne_one : Not (x = RealTheory.one) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hx1
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.one hx1
  have hxne_zero : Not (x = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hxpos hzero.symm
  have hwindow := integralLog_scaled_log_window hmu hx1 hxlt
  rw [integralLogPowerFun_of_pos
    reciprocalFun_integrability mu hxpos]
  have hlog_lower :=
    integralNaturalLog_local_lower x hxpos hxne_one
  have hmul_lower :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.inv x)))
        (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hlog_lower hmu
  have hrewrite :
      RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one (RealTheory.inv x)) =
        RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
            (RealTheory.inv x)) := by
    rw [one_sub_inv_eq_sub_one_mul_inv hxne_zero]
  rw [hrewrite]
  have hadd :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul mu
            (RealTheory.mul (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
              (RealTheory.inv x))))
        (RealTheory.add RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x))) :=
    RealTheory.add_lt_add_left hmul_lower RealTheory.one
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F hadd
    (integralLogExpFun_local_lower
      (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x))
      hwindow.left hwindow.right)

name: integralLogPowerFun_positive_exponent_local_upper
statement:
theorem integralLogPowerFun_positive_exponent_local_upper :
    RealFunction.Elementary.NaturalPowerPositiveExponentLocalUpper
      (IntegralLogPowerFun reciprocalFun_integrability)
proof:
:= by
  intro mu hmu x hx1 hxlt
  let F := RealTheory.current_ordered_field_base
  have hxpos : RealFunction.Elementary.PositiveDomain x :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F RealTheory.zero_lt_one hx1
  have hxne_one : Not (x = RealTheory.one) := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hx1
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_irrefl F RealTheory.one hx1
  have hwindow := integralLog_scaled_log_window hmu hx1 hxlt
  rw [integralLogPowerFun_of_pos
    reciprocalFun_integrability mu hxpos]
  have hlog_upper :=
    integralNaturalLog_local_upper x hxpos hxne_one
  have hmul_upper :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x))
        (RealTheory.mul mu
          (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)) :=
    RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hlog_upper hmu
  have hx_sub_lt_inv :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)
        (RealTheory.inv mu) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_of_lt_add F hxlt
  have hmu_ne : Not (mu = RealTheory.zero) := by
    intro hzero
    exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.ne_of_lt F hmu hzero.symm
  have hmu_sub_lt_one :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.mul mu (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))
        RealTheory.one := by
    have h :=
      RealTheory.mul_lt_mul_pos_left hx_sub_lt_inv hmu
    rwa [RealTheory.mul_inv_cancel hmu_ne] at h
  have hden_t_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hwindow.right
  have hden_u_pos :
      RealTheory.lt RealTheory.zero
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul mu
            (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_pos_of_lt F hmu_sub_lt_one
  have hden_order :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul mu
            (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)))
        (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
          (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.sub_lt_sub_left_of_lt F hmul_upper
  have hinv_order :
      RealTheory.lt
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x))))
        (RealTheory.inv
          (RealTheory.sub RealTheory.one
            (RealTheory.mul mu
              (RealTheory.sub x RealTheory.one)))) :=
    IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.inv_lt_inv_of_lt_pos
      F hden_u_pos hden_t_pos hden_order
  exact IsOrderedFieldBaseLike.lt_trans F
    (integralLogExpFun_local_upper
      (RealTheory.mul mu (IntegralNaturalLogFun x))
      hwindow.left hwindow.right)
    hinv_order

name: IntegralLogRoutePackage.log_integral_formula
statement:
theorem IntegralLogRoutePackage.log_integral_formula
    (P : IntegralLogRoutePackage) :
    NaturalLogIntegralFormula P.log
proof:
:=
  integralLogFun_formula P.integrability
